headline: Art Performance Given to Celebrate Birthday of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- There took place an art performance for celebrating the 76th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in the capital city of Pyongyang on Monday.
The venue for the performance in front of the Mansudae Assembly Hall was full of working people, youth and students who came to see the performance.
Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, other senior officials of the Party and the government, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly, labor innovators, persons of merits, officials of ministries and national agencies, service personnel of the People's Army, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, Pyongyang citizens and inhabitants of flood-hit areas staying in Pyongyang.
The overseas compatriots visiting the homeland on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the DPRK, including the members of the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan, and representatives and staff members of the foreign diplomatic missions here and other foreigners were invited to watch the performance.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Put on the stage of the performance, which started with "The Glorious Motherland", a monumental ode to the country, born along with its founding, were colorful numbers including famous songs on the theme of patriotism sung aloud in the past decades when gigantic struggles were waged to build and glorify our great state.
The performers sang highly of the undying glory of our Republic, which has demonstrated its might as a prospering country of miracles and heroic Korea recognized by the world under the unique state-building idea and leadership of the peerlessly great men, and the happiness of its people leading a dignified and worthwhile life as members of an independent powerful nation.
The performance reached its climax with the song "Our National Flag".
Fireworks were set off to peculiarly decorate the end of the performance. -0-

headline: 106th Candlelight Rally and Demo Staged in ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The 106th candlelight rally and demonstration were staged in Seoul of the puppet ROK on Saturday in demand of the impeachment of puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, amid the population's wrath at Yoon, a war stooge of the U.S. and Japan, fascist dictator and man-killing demon, growing stronger with each passing day.
People from all walks of life turned out in the candlelight action to decisively oust puppet Yoon through a 100-day all-people movement.
At the rally, its participants disclosed the puppet's crimes, holding such placards as "Drive out Yoon Suk Yeol, a pro-U.S. and Japanese traitor" and "Impeach Yoon" and chanting slogans.
Then an appeal of the candlelight rally was read out. It stressed that Yoon is the only person to be impeached as he is driving the population to death.
At the end of the rally, the participants took a demonstration toward the Japanese embassy in Seoul, calling for the impeachment of puppet Yoon.
Similar rallies were held in other parts of the ROK.
Meanwhile, 107 civic and public organizations made public a declaration on the situation that day, stressing that the impeachment of Yoon is the only way out for the existence of the ROK and it should be realized within this year.
The declaration called on all the people to turn out in the struggle for ousting Yoon in 100 days without fail by their concerted efforts.
On Sept. 4, an anti-Japanese action was organized and a ceremony took place to declare its struggle outside the Japanese embassy in Seoul, amid the intensified anti-U.S., anti-Japanese struggle by organizations of various circles. -0-

headline: Greetings to FM of Tajikistan
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, on Sept. 9 sent a message of greeting to Sirojiddin Muhriddin, foreign minister of Tajikistan, on the occasion of its national day.
The message expressed belief that the bilateral relations would be further developed, through close cooperation between the foreign policy bodies of the two countries, and mutual support and cooperation be strengthened in the international arenas. -0-

headline:
Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il

[Juche113.9.10.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren in the DPRK visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasion of the 76th DPRK birthday.
Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill here were floral baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries and national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, and institutions, and industrial establishments at all levels and universities in Pyongyang.
The visitors paid tribute to the statues of the great leaders, recollecting their immortal revolutionary careers and exploits.
Laid at the statues of the great leaders in different parts of the capital city, includingKim Il SungUniversity, the Ministry of National Defence and the Mansudae Art Studio, were floral baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises, units of the KPA and the PSF and bouquets and flowers.
Officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren across the country visited the statues of the great leaders in their residential areas to pay high tribute to them. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from King of Sweden
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Carl ⅩⅥ Gustaf, king of the Kingdom of Sweden, on Sept. 9.
The message said:
On the occasion of the Anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea I wish to convey to Your Excellency my best wishes for the future and for the welfare of the people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. -0-

headline: Banquet Given for Labor Innovators
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- A banquet was given for labor innovators and meritorious persons from various fields across the country at the People's Palace of Culture on Monday. They were specially invited to the celebrations of the 76th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), our great country.
Jo Chun Ryong and Pak Thae Song, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), and Han Kwang Sang, department director of the C.C., WPK, sat together with them.
The venue of the banquet was full of boundless gratitude to the great WPK and socialist system which value ordinary citizens who are devoting themselves at their posts and workplaces as the cornerstones and pillars of the country.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Thae Song made a speech at the banquet.
Upon authorization of the Party and the government, he warmly congratulated labor innovators and meritorious persons who made distinguished feats in the vanguard of the struggle for bolstering up the national defence capability, developing the economy and improving the people's living standard and took part in the celebrations of the national day this year.
He stressed that the pioneers who have firmly supported the prosperity of the DPRK and the advance of the revolution in major fronts of socialist construction with the utmost sincerity for the Party and the leader, the country and its people, and the genuine people who cannot live even a moment away from patriotism and have never thought of their destiny and life and their families' apart from their conscience and service dedicated to the country are the models of the times who deserve boundless blessing by the country and its people.
He expressed belief that the socialist DPRK, which is supported by the noble spirit of sacrifice to devote their all to the happiness of the rising generations and the prosperous future of the state, not for today's enjoyment, and by the unyielding spirit of service to firmly defend their workplaces and posts despite ordeals, would surely achieve the ideal of comprehensive national rejuvenation and demonstrate its dignity as a genuine people's country.
All the participants were filled with ardent determination to glorify their patriotic lives as personifiers of the Chollima spirit of the new era in the vanguard of the advance for great upsurge under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is setting the building of an ideal society of the working people as the signpost and leading it to victory. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Important Speech on National Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), made an important speech "Let Us Further Strive for the Prosperity of Our Great State" on September 9, the 76th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unin his speech extended warm greetings to the cadres of the Party and government, who are making ceaseless efforts to repay the trust of the great people with dedication to the heavy duties entrusted by them, and to all the people and service personnel, who are proudly celebrating the national day with precious pride  of devoting their pure and sincere patriotic loyalty and indomitable efforts to the dynamic creation struggle for prosperity, on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK.
He also extended his warm greetings to all overseas Koreans, including the patriotic compatriots of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan  who invariably take the road of patriotism with warm love for their socialist homeland, and expressed his thanks to the peoples and friends of all friendly countries who recognize and support the sovereignty and just cause of the DPRK.
And he paid high tribute to the revolutionary forerunners, patriotic martyrs and persons of merits of the preceding generations, who devoted their precious lives and feats to the foundation and development of the DPRK and the victorious advance of the socialist cause and created excellent traditions and examples to be followed by posterity.
He said as follows:
Whenever we see with pride our national flags fluttering everywhere on this land invariably and more brilliantly and greet our national day every year, we naturally realize keenly that no country in the world is as great, wonderful and glorious as our Republic.
When the DPRK was beating back the aggression of the imperialist allied forces which were incomparably superior in number, to say nothing of the time when our people were building a genuine people’s country free from the vicious colonial rule, miracles unheard-of in other parts of the world were performed in the DPRK, and the historic course of Chollima Korea, which had made leaps forward to build a socialist nation on the ruins, and of Juche Korea was always full of miracles, too.
We take greater pride in the fact that such honorable course followed by our state was not confined to the past history of the preceding generations.
Today's reality is also an extension of those miracles.
We are evidently making steady advance.
During the period when one generation was replaced completely by another, our Party and people have defended and developed the socialist cause without any slightest vacillation or deviation despite countless severe challenges and trials - this is the most faithful and perfect continuity of the cause of Kimilsungism and a great political victory and historic miracle that has proved in practice the truth, eternal viability and vitality  of the great Juche idea and its entity - socialism of our style.
This clearly showed the whole world the truth of Juche and the immutable truth of invincibility that socialism, in which the people became its masters and remain faithful to their responsibility and role as masters, neither get ruined nor vacillate but  emerge victorious and develop forever, despite the vicious moves of the imperialist reactionary forces and the shifts in generation within the revolutionary ranks.
This year, too, our Party and government have organized and launched a gigantic undertaking which serves as a watershed in the course of the current advance for making epoch-making development of our cause of socialism.
As you all know, under the situation in which the tasks of the fourth year of the Five-Year Plan, decided and assigned by the Eighth Party Congress, are being carried out, we have added to the domain of our struggle and assumed such new intermediate- and long-range task as regional development. This is an expression of our firm trust and confidence in our strength, our Party Central Committee's revolutionary viewpoint and attitude to fulfill the responsibility and duty it has assumed for the times and history and, at the same time, a manifestation of its steadfast spirit of serving the people.
We are full of confidence to successfully brave such challenging trials and historical stages in the course of the advancing revolutionary cause.
This revolutionary decision we made recently is an important strategic decision to give full play to the advantages of socialism in actuality through the promotion of the well-being of the people throughout the country, thus further consolidating the foundations of our system and accelerating the overall state development.
As the country's economy still is not in conditions smooth enough to exert any reserve power, to provide cities and counties across the country with the basic material and technical foundations strong enough for their diversified and independent development in the next ten years would have been unthinkable in the past.
But in order to live up to the great expectations and trust of the people, the Party and the government worked out scientific strategies and realistic implementation plans, believing in the unconditional and absolute loyalty of our army and its strong fighting efficiency, and the entities of major regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties are becoming clear as expected.
Not content with this, the Party and the Government initiated an additional plan and are making preparations for putting it into thoroughgoing practice in order to get rid of the backwardness of regions as quickly as possible.
I have already stressed to regard the regional development as the top-priority revolutionary task of the Party and the government, viewing it as a serious political issue.
As it is the work impossible to carry out for over 70 years and nearly 80 years, some would surely take sceptical attitude and stand towards the regional development plan.
But availing myself of this opportunity, I reaffirm on behalf of the Party and government.
Is there a guarantee of success in implementing our regional development policy? Is it possible? It is possible.
After ten years we will answer this question with real changes.
It is our successes that we steadily push forward with the implementation of the goals for  readjustment and reinforcement to be attained this year, while keeping the overall growth trend of the national economy and fulfilling without fail monthly and quarterly production plans in various sectors of the national economy, including key industries, despite manifold difficulties and obstacles.
This year we have provided conditions for making further improved and changed results in light industry, urban management and other sectors directly linked with the stabilization of the people’s livelihood. The overall crops have so far been well and it is possible to expect fair good harvests.
We can appreciate that a series of progress have been made in reinforcing the national functions and capabilities for coping with any crisis brought by natural disasters.
Severe floods hit some areas of North Phyongan Province along the lower River Amnok and of Jagang and Ryanggang provinces in late July, which hindered the state work and required the mobilization of huge forces for rehabilitation, but the Party and the government take it as an opportunity for making a new detailed survey of the shortcomings and discontinuities in coping with natural disasters and take prospective and irreversible measures for preventing them in the future. It can also be said as important progress.
Despite this, we have achieved great epochal results by vigorously promoting the radical development of the defence capabilities to secure a reliable environment for security of the country and create conditions favourable to socialist construction.
This year, especially in some recent months, we secured wonderful military strength by making important achievements in national defence studies and production.
When we comprehensively assess the present situation of all these state affairs, we can  analyze that almost all the major extra political tasks set forth by the Party Central Committee in planning and arranging this year's work are progressing successfully, correctly and satisfactorily.
Urgent efforts should be made to further enrich and boost the successes achieved this year by making the most effective use of the remaining months, he said, and continued:
The most important thing for doing so is to further raise and expand the boundless patriotism and loyalty of all the Party members, working people and service personnel of the People's Army and lead them to successful fruition.
This is just the important and essential revolutionary duty facing the leading officials of our Party and Government.
We should complete the economic work for this year in a responsible manner to make fresh progress in the efforts for the comprehensive national rejuvenation and further improve the material and cultural life of the people.
So far, almost all the sectors of the national economy which are in charge of the 12 major goals have carried out their quotas without fail. The present fighting atmosphere and spirits are very good.
In order to maintain this trend in a sustainable way, it is necessary for all the sectors and units of the national economy to actively apply skilful operations and innovative methods of giving full play to the working people's enthusiasm for production and creativity and improving their technical skill levels.
And by maintaining and repairing the existing equipment regularly, all the production sectors should prevent equipment accidents, raise the rate of operation to the maximum and ensure the quantitative and qualitative level of the products by constantly updating the production processes and equipment.
He referred to the tasks for fully ensuring stable production activities of major sectors of the national economy.
To further increase the national productivity by unconditionally finishing by the appointed time the plans of the key industries for adjustment and reinforcement to be fulfilled this year, the Cabinet and the state economic guidance organs should learn about the implementation of all the state measures and take a decisive measure at an early date by finding out other lacking problems and elements.
He went on:
Since the development of the state and social life as well as the economy is expressed as entities of structures, the construction sector must carry out this year’s plan without fail with the main emphasis on ensuring the quality thoroughly.
We should  thoroughly ensure the quality of the buildings directly related to the actual life of the people, including the 10 000 flats of the third stage in the Hwasong area and rural houses and, at the same time, raise the level of architectural design to the world level and make a remarkable change in the work for standardizing and modernizing construction equipment and tools.
The new hostels in Samjiyon City should be turned into hotels and more places developed as tourist resorts to make Samjiyon a world-class mountain tourist resort, he said, calling for steadily pushing forward with the projects for perfectly building the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area so as to run it from the next year.
He underscored the need to direct efforts to building a firm guarantee for actively enhancing the control and command of the economy as a whole by decisively updating the economic means and methods for directing and managing the national economy in keeping with the development of the times and the requirements of the reality, and underlined the need for the state to attach importance to smooth and comfortable circulation of products, to give priority to creating favorable conditions and environment for production and management activities based on the relative independence of enterprises and to take effective measures for continuously raising the real income of the working people.
Saying that to carry out the grain production plan is not just a matter confined to the agricultural sector, but a political work to guarantee the victorious advance of socialism, he indicated the clear ways for successfully finishing this year's farming and making good preparations for next year's farming.
He analyzed and appreciated the work for recovering from flood damage to date and said:
Even though the period is short and there are so many reconstruction projects, the quality of structures should never be reduced.
Now that enough reconstruction forces have been mobilized and the enthusiasm of the soldier-builders and shock brigade members is great, whether the projects are completed in time or not depends on how the building materials, equipment and vehicles are supplied.
The Cabinet, the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Railways and other ministries and national agencies should provide that steel, cement, fuel, timber, glass and other building materials and equipment at the fixed date according to plan, and take decisive measures to solve the acute transport problems so as to smoothly promote the projects.
We must finish the recovery from flood damage in a qualitative way within the fixed period and thus ensure a normal and stable life of the people in the flood-hit areas and put the damaged sectors of the national economy on their track so as to successfully complete the struggle with nature.
He said that the prerequisite task the Party and the government should specially place importance on and push ahead with is the unconditional and perfect implementation of the regional development policy in the new era.
He continued:
As I have already said, there is no more urgent revolutionary task than this in terms of the fundamental principle of activities of our Party and state that are orienting all the works of revolution and construction to firmly defending and ensuring the rights and interests of the people and constantly expanding the policy for the welfare of the people, irrespective of conditions and circumstances and at the present moment when the epochal regional changes have become the most important task and indispensable requirement for the comprehensive development of socialism and for the comprehensive national rejuvenation.
We must not try to assess characteristics and advantages of the Korean-style socialist system through some new streets built in the capital city and the material and cultural standards of its citizens, and we must not think that the recent successes are great ones as they have been achieved in the face of the unprecedentedly severe manifold difficulties.
This opinion and viewpoint are harmful to the development of the revolution.
Like the principles of architectural engineering and structural mechanics, which high-rise and super-high-rise buildings need firm foundations, if the socialist system is to be consolidated under any circumstances, the foundation of the people’s mind  for its advantages should be solid, and all the people should actively sympathize with it through their actual life, and the social system should be based on the desire of all the people to share their destiny with socialism to the last and defend it through generations.
He referred to the importance of the regional development policy on developing the cities, counties and rural areas, the regional bases and lowest units, in a substantial, material and planned way, which constitute the whole territory of the DPRK and support the state system of the DPRK, and continued:
Like this, regional development has arisen as a matter of faith in socialism, not a simple economic and business issue, and a very important and urgent matter directly linked with the future of our revolution. Therefore, I convened an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau again, set forth the Regional Development 20×10 Policy and attached the more important political significance to its powerful implementation as soon as the discussion of the work ended at the plenary meeting earlier this year.
Some time ago, l indicated the new orientation towards accelerating the historic cause of regional rejuvenation by simultaneously building public health facilities, sci-tech dissemination bases and grain management facilities as well as regional-industry factories facilities in cities and counties.
As we rang the roar of artillery solemnly  to implement the regional development policy in the new era, we should carry out the planned tasks without fail while steadily expanding the successes made so far and thus confidently open up the full-scale enforcement stage of the ten-year revolution for realizing our Party’s desire.
It is necessary to simultaneously produce the completed entities in twenty cities and counties without fail at the end of the year by putting spurs to the construction of regional-industry factories, which arises the primary task for implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy.
The officers and men of the units at all levels who were mobilized in regional construction should direct all their efforts to perfectly completing the construction of regional-industry factories at the highest quality level, staking the dignity of the Party and the honour of the People’s Army.
As the construction of regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties has entered the demarcation of 90 percent so far, the units in charge of equipment manufacture and import should also push ahead with the work to perfectly carry out their tasks and supply equipment in time.
Light industry factories and relevant universities in the capital city, and provinces, cities and counties should make a positive contribution to implementing our Party’s policy on regional development by thoroughly and within the fixed date working out the plan for training technicians and skilled workers capable of managing and operating regional-industry factories to be built in a modern way.
Ministries, national agencies and relevant provinces, cities and counties should prepare and supply raw materials needed for normalizing production as soon as regional-industry factories are completed.
It is very important for each city and county to create their reserves in translating the Regional Development 20×10 Policy into reality and making it substantially contribute to improving the living standard of the regional people.
So, we took new measures to make a breakthrough in solving this problem by building the Sinpho City Offshore Farm as a model base for offshore cultivation and to revitalize its operation.
Referring to the importance and significance of the construction of three projects newly added to the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, he said that we are going to expand and build the centers for sci-tech learning, which had been already expected to be additional projects, into comprehensive bases for cultural life. And he underlined the need to building not only bases for sci-tech learning equipped with modern IT means but also multi-functional comprehensive cultural centers including trade networks and all sorts of service establishments with good hygienic environment in which inhabitants can watch films and lead a sports and cultural life in cities and counties and use the centers.
He went on:
As the comprehensive centre for cultural life is a new project which is the first conception in the history of regional construction, I will make sure that designs for architecture including layouts are properly made in consideration of the scale and characteristics according to topographic condition and population and a budget bill for construction is definitely drawn up on its basis.
If we spruce up 20 cities and counties every year like this, it may be that the differences between cities and rural areas that have lasted historically will be remarkably reduced and the living conditions of the regional people will become rich and civilized as good as the urban people.
Kim Jong Unstressed the need to continue to push ahead with the work for further consolidating the national defence capabilities as required by the present situation.
As the reckless expansion of the military bloc system led by the U.S. and its development into the character of a nuclear-based military bloc, the military security environment around the DPRK has come close to us as a grave threat.
Such actual threats will inevitably bring about more various threats in the future and, accordingly, such situational development requires us to take more important measures and make constant efforts to maintain and further boost military supremacy.
The obvious conclusion is that the nuclear force of the DPRK and the posture capable of properly using it for ensuring the state's right to security in any time should be more thoroughly perfected.
We are now perfectly carrying out the policy on building the nuclear armed forces on increasing the number of nuclear weapons by geometrical progression, and the nuclear combat forces of the Republic are being operated under the strict command and control system.
Our state is a responsible nuclear weapons state.
We are constantly exposed to a serious nuclear threat. Our nuclear weapons for defending ourselves do not pose a threat to anyone.
Forces, which call the nuclear armed force of the DPRK threatening, only reveal their admission that they have the hostile intention to attack the DPRK with nukes.
Under the different threats posed by the United States and its followers and under the security circumstances facing us, the possession of powerful military power is the duty and right to existence that our Party and Government should not miss even a moment and make no concession.
Strong power is just a genuine peace and an absolute guarantee for the development of our state.
It is the most important national affairs of the Party and the government and the first task of the revolution to constantly strengthen and develop our army' capability to fight a war and thus actively cope with the regional security environment and defend the sovereignty, security and interests of the state by dint of powerful strength.
The DPRK will steadily strengthen its nuclear force capable of fully coping with any threatening acts imposed by its nuclear-armed rival states and redouble its measures and efforts to make all the armed forces of the state including the nuclear force fully ready for combat.
Repeatedly stating, the DPRK's military muscle will develop in an accelerated and continued way thanks to our aspiration and steady efforts and we will not set a limit to its attainment.
He said that the success of this year's struggle for providing a sure guarantee for implementing the decisions of the Party congress entirely depends on the responsibility and role of the party organizations and their officials, the political staff of the relevant units.
Today our revolution expects that Party organizations and officials will work with devotion and work harder than ever before.
The organizations and officials of the whole Party should be well aware of the requirements of the revolution and their responsibilities and duties and bear deep in mind their mission and thus conduct energetic organizational and political work to carry out the tasks of this year’s struggle unconditionally and correctly.
First of all, they should examine in detail the political tasks assigned to their sectors and units and the implementation of the Party decisions adopted for their implementation, and take appropriate measures to ensure correct implementation.
And they should intensify the control and guidance for their implementation and reassignment and conduct the work in a three-dimensional way and at a lightning speed.
When all Party organizations and officials launch operation and guidance for unconditionally attaining this year's struggle goals in a sweeping and dynamic manner by giving full play to their organizing ability, leadership and executive faculty from the standpoint that they should be entirely responsible for the work of the fields and units under their charge, it is quite possible to bring about substantial results until the end of this year.
In particular, it is necessary to get rid of the wrong viewpoint and attitude of leaving the work for fulfilling this year's plans and goals entirely to the administrative officials and intensify the organization and control from the standpoint that Party committees take the full responsibility for it.
The fighting efficiency and activity of the Party organizations are gauged by their ability of inspiring mental power and wisdom of the masses.
Party organizations at all levels should launch a vigorous ideological offensive to give full play to the patriotic enthusiasm and creative ingenuity of the producer masses by displaying a high sense of responsibility and making redoubled efforts, thus making sure that every part of the country seethes with enthusiasm and the collective innovation movement gets brisk in every unit.
To this end, it is necessary to instill into the Party members and other working people the viewpoint that the policy tasks facing their sectors and units are realistic and feasible struggle targets, which were set on the basis of enough calculation into overall conditions and possibility of their implementation, and that they must carry them out without fail in any case and they can do so, thus providing them with confidence and courage.
We should concentrate information and motivation means and forces on the sites of vibrant struggle and launch a vigorous ideological offensive without interruption, so that the intention and mind of the masses are all oriented towards attaining the target of this year’s plan and the soaring enthusiasm for revolution and struggle never cools but steadily goes up at every workplace.
In successfully concluding this year’s struggle, it is very important to encourage the officials and Party members, who are the organizers and executors of the Party’s lines and policies, to give fuller play to their leadership, creativity and activity.
Party organizations should intensify their guidance over the officials' Party life so that the officials make redoubled efforts and work harder to carry out successfully and perfectly the struggle goals, set for their sectors and units, out of a single resolve to repay the Party’s trust with high work results.
The relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee and the Party organizations at all levels of ministries and national agencies in the government should supervise and actively encourage their leading cadres so that they are deeply conscious of their responsibilities, explore the ways to properly discharge their duties, as required by the Party policies, always in a keen sense of responsibility, and conduct operations and work in a meticulous and strenuous manner, fully aware of their heavy duty.
Party organizations should strengthen the organization and guidance of Party life among their members so that they find themselves earlier than others in the most difficult jobs, which others may hesitate to do, lead the masses in a revolutionary and positive manner and stand in the vanguard of the struggle for resolutely eliminating all obstacles hindering our advance in every worksite seething with the efforts for implementing the Party decisions.
It is needed to further enhance the responsibility and role of the officials of power organs at all levels, and of leading economic officials, in particular.
We have not much time left until the end of this year, in which we should confirm the success in attaining the goal of struggle set forth by the Eighth Party Congress.
It is just the leading economic officials who should work more responsibly during the time left, which can be said to be decisive of the implementation of the Five-Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy.
Officials in charge of economic affairs should waste no time but concentrate on fulfilling their duties, aware that they have only 110-odd days until the expiry of the deadline for their pledge to implement the decision of the Ninth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party without fail.
Saying that all officials should conduct their work in a bold and innovative way with the spirit of ardently serving the country and the people and revolutionary optimism, he called for enhancing the function and role of law-enforcement organs in every way so as to make sure that the overall work of the state is conducted smoothly as required by the Party, the revolution, the people and the rapidly changing times. He went on:
As I mentioned earlier, this year our Party and government have designed and strongly propelled the gigantic and worthwhile undertakings for overall prosperity of the state and well-being of the people.
All these undertakings are not easy to carry out and we have not a few difficulties to overcome, but we must bring about remarkable results without fail with firm confidence and steadfast will, and thus glorify this year as a year of proud victory in the history of state development.
Let us all wage a more vigorous struggle with greater pride and confidence in our efforts for accomplishing the sacred cause for peace, prosperity and grandeur of our motherland and well-being of the people throughout the country.
I extend my warm best wishes to all citizens of this country once again and warmly congratulate them on the national day of the great motherland. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Mongolian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, president of Mongolian, on Sept. 9.
In the message the Mongolian president extended the sincere congratulations, on behalf of the Mongolian people and on his own behalf, to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand, through him, to the friendly Korean people on the 76th DPRK birthday.
He said that he was pleased that the friendly relations between Mongolia and the DPRK have steadily developed, on the basis of the roots of solid relations provided by the preceding leaders of the two countries, overcoming the trials and challenges of history.
He hoped that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would be expanded and developed and friendship between their peoples be consolidated through close cooperation withKim Jong Unwho is guiding the responsible work for development and prosperity of the DPRK.
He wishedKim Jong Unand his respectable family members good health and happiness.
He also hoped that the diligent and honest Korean people would develop and prosper. -0-

headline:
Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il

[Juche113.9.10.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren in the DPRK visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasion of the 76th DPRK birthday.

headline: Papers Call for Making Redoubled Efforts for National Prosperity
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 11 (KCNA) -- The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unmade an important speech "Let Us Make Redoubled Efforts for the Prosperity of Our Great State" on the occasion of the national day.
His speech serves as a powerful action programme that makes it possible to further promote balanced, substantial and simultaneous transformations and development in all sectors of socialist construction and as a militant banner guaranteeing the dynamic leap forward, leading newspapers of the DPRK editorially stresses on Wednesday.
It is the working spirit and stamina peculiar to the Korean people to win a series of bigger victories and make uninterrupted innovation and advance with more courageous vigor and strenuous efforts, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial, and goes on:
Every undertaking for us to successfully conclude this year is not so easy and there are still a lot of difficulties ahead. But we have courage and confidence in our own strength, solid foundations of self-sustenance and potentiality for development which have been consolidated in the steady and vigorous, practical struggle for a better future.
All the officials, Party members and other working people should bring admirable results, eye-opening events and achievements one after another with high self-confidence, strong will and stubborn efforts and thus definitely lead the dynamic advance of the Korean revolution for a thriving nation, their desire, to a bold leap forward and success.
The plan and determination of the Party Central Committee are science and truth, and very high and strong is our confidence and will to realize the noble ideal at an early date and bring earlier the bright future.
Victory is sure to be won as there are the outstanding and seasoned leadership of General SecretaryKim Jong Unand the people displaying their inexhaustible strength of loyalty and patriotism to the full, rallied as one in mind around the Party Central Committee.
Minju Joson in an editorial stresses that all the people should more vigorously advance along the path indicated by the great Party Central Committee with the revolutionary pride and honor of achieving the prosperity of their beloved motherland.-0-

headline: Intellectual Property Development Exhibition Prepared in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 11 (KCNA) -- The Intellectual Property Office in the DPRK is stepping up the preparations for the 2024 intellectual property development exhibition at the final stage.
The organizing committee for the exhibition has carried on the preparations in touch with at least 100 ministries and national agencies and provinces.
Presented to the exhibition will be more than 2 600 proposals of over 640 units, which were granted patent rights, invention rights, trademark rights, industrial design rights, name of origin and geographical representation rights, copyright and rights to new species of plants.
The identification of exhibits among various categories of intellectual property protection objects was concluded.
The work is going on to build data at the virtual exhibition hall, set up a section for the formation of exhibition-in-kind and confirm the mode of exhibition. -0-

story_text:

Those cozy houses of various styles with all living conditions, built in harmony with rural features and modern beauty, clearly prove the validity and vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's programme for the rural revolution.

headline: Meetings of Exemplary SWUK Members Held in DPRK
story_text:

Present there were leading Party officials, officials of the women's union, activists in displaying noble traits and union members in those regions.
Reports were made at the meetings to be followed by speeches.
The reporters and speakers noted that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unshowed the highest trust and warm love for the union members and other women who have striven to do things helpful to the country, stressing that their warm sincerity gave great strength to the Korean revolution advancing in the face of ordeals.
They said that the women's union officials and members have displayed the communist virtues and traits of helping and leading each other forward, giving priority to the state affairs to live up to the benevolence of the Party with loyalty, and a large number of patriots have been produced in the course.
They expressed the will to always trust and follow the Workers' Party of Korea and devote their pure conscience and sincere sweat and efforts to the worthwhile patriotic work for glorifying the era of our state-first principle by the united efforts based on loyalty and patriotism.
They stressed the need to pool patriotic mind and wisdom at every worksite for implementing the decisions of the plenary meetings of the WPK Central Committee and bring about the harmony of society and families, bearing in mind the trust of the Party which put forward the women as a powerful force pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot.
They called upon all the women's union officials and members to bring a rosy future of the country and dynamically promote the great transformation of the times with the strong spiritual power and patriotic devotion of the Korean women, true to the ideology and leadership ofKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chairman of C.C., Communist Party of Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from G. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on Sept. 9.
In the message Zhuganov extended congratulations toKim Jong Unon the 76th birthday of the DPRK, the significant day of the Korean people.
After the all-people elections, the DPRK, a socialist state liberated from the oppression of Japanese militarism, emerged on the world map on September 9, 1948 with Pyongyang as its capital city, the message said, adding:
The DPRK has turned into a prospering country thanks to ComradeKim Il Sungand ComradeKim Jong Iland the most respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
You are creditably carrying forward the cause of the preceding leaders.
These successes could be achieved, thanks to your strong political will and indomitable spirit and the efforts and devotion of the Korean people who have made significant contributions to the prosperity and future of their country.
Our two countries are interested in strengthening the strategic cooperation in all possible fields despite a number of global difficulties and challenges and should make every effort necessary to develop planned cooperation.
I am sure that our two countries can cope with international threats only when they make concerted efforts.
The message wishedKim Jong Ungood health and success in his energetic work for the prosperity of all the Korean people. -0-

headline: Work to Ensure Accuracy of Forecast of Fishing Conditions Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- The East Sea Fishery Research Institute under the Academy of Fishery Science in the DPRK conducts field survey to ensure the accuracy of forecast of fishing conditions.
The institute has timely detected the amount of fish flock and their movement on the basis of the regional characteristics and water conditions and temperature in the East and West Sea of Korea.
Its researchers took steps to ensure the accuracy of such data in the system for forecasting fishing conditions.
The institute is intensifying the research in order to develop the fishery science and technology. -0-

Press Statement of Head of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- The head of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement "The U.S. instigating NATO and agents to confrontation with Russia is a serious threat to Europe" on September 13:
Recently, U.S. Secretary of State Blinken groundlessly slandered the cooperation based on mutual benefit and equality between the Russian Federation and other sovereign states, and committed a political provocation terming it a "threat" to Europe.

The U.S. and its vassal forces held the second defense authority meeting between the ROK and member nations of the "UN Command" on September 10.
Their moves to revitalize a tool for war and confrontation, which usurped the signboard of the UN, on the Korean peninsula are arousing a serious concern of the international community.
Another anti-DPRK confrontation confab was held in the name of the "UN Command" whose dismantlement was declared by the international community decades ago. This is an insult to the inviolable UN and the UN Charter and one more important occasion judging who is the illegal force inciting military conflict in the Korean peninsula.
A "joint statement" adopted after the meeting shows that the U.S. is buckling down to drawing member states of the "UN Command" into different joint military drills of aggressive nature to make them proficient in its-led war scenario and substantially enhance their capabilities to fight a war.
Terming the U.S. and its vassal forces' confrontational movement an extremely dangerous political and military provocation that causes security imbalance and escalates the danger of war in the Korean peninsula and the region, we resolutely denounce and reject it.
The expansion of the "UN Command" is a prelude to the establishment of "NATO of Asian version" which will result in pushing the Asia-Pacific region deeper into the structure of new cold war, not easing the military tensions in the Korean peninsula and the region.
When taking into consideration the fact that the revival of the "UN Command" is further increasing the possibility of military conflict in the Korean peninsula by stirring up the war hysteria of the ROK military gangsters running amuck in the military confrontation with the DPRK, the danger of such moves can never be overlooked.
Moreover, if countries in different regions take part in the moves to revive the "UN Command", blindly following the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, military conflict in the Korean peninsula will not be confined to the one between the DPRK and the U.S. but will inevitably lead to the start of a new world war.
It is an essential requirement for the national security and the region's peaceful development to steadily improve the strategic force capable of deterring and weakening the hostile countries' will for war provocation.
The U.S. and its vassal countries' collective military confrontation against the DPRK will serve as a motive and catalyst for accelerating the formation and development of a just strategic axis that thoroughly disallows the imbalance of power in the Korean peninsula and the region.
The DPRK will steadily take a new strategic counteraction to contain and frustrate the reckless confrontation moves of the hostile forces to disturb peace and stability in the Korean peninsula by mobilizing the illegal war organization. -0-

headline: Technical Foundation Strengthened in Thermal Power Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- Thermal power plants in the DPRK boost production by giving priority to technical innovation.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex has carried out its daily plan by keeping each generator in full-capacity operation through application of valuable technical achievements.
The Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant installed a new device necessary for normal operation of equipment to ensure the accuracy of the production control system. And it remodeled the slag outlet to prevent the penetration of cold air and raise the combustion efficiency of boiler.
The Sunchon Thermal Power Plant introduced an advanced method for improving the performance of equipment while reducing the steam loss at turbines.
The same is true of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant. -0-

story_text:

Chairwoman Choe Un Bok and officials of the GAKC headquarters and its regional associations and other Koreans in China paid tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, founder and builder of the DPRK, socialist Korea, and the benevolent father of overseas Koreans.
A film show of the GAKC took place in Shenyang of China.
Present there were Chairwoman Choe Un Bok and other officials of the GAKC headquarters and members of the Shenyang City branch of the Liaoning Regional Association.
The participants watched a Korean film dealing with part of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's sacred history of revolutionary leadership.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Nuclear Weapons Institute and Production Base for Weapon-grade Nuclear Materials
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Nuclear Weapons Institute and the production base of weapon-grade nuclear materials, acquainted himself with the production of nuclear warheads and current nuclear materials and set forth important tasks for long-term plan for increasing the production of weapon-grade nuclear materials.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Hong Sung Mu, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).
He highly praised the scientists, technicians and officials in the field of nuclear weapons production for having carried out without fail the plan for producing weapon-grade nuclear materials needed for manufacturing nuclear warheads, cherishing the firm and steadfast revolutionary spirit and faith to firmly defend the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche with the strongest nuclear force.
He went round the control room of the uranium enrichment base to learn about the overall operation of the production lines.
Being briefed on the fact that the base is dynamically producing nuclear materials by studying, developing and introducing all the system elements including centrifugal separators and various kinds of sensors and controllers with its own efforts and technology, he expressed his great satisfaction over it.
When he personally went round the worksite, he said that he felt strong to see the worksite. He stressed the need to further augment the number of centrifuges in order to exponentially increase the nuclear weapons for self-defence true to the Party's line of building up nuclear armed forces, not content with the successes and, at the same time, to further raise the individual separation ability of the centrifuge and push forward the introduction of a new-type centrifuge which has already reached its completion stage as planned so as to further strengthen the foundation for producing weapon-grade nuclear materials.
Going round the construction site for expanding the capacity for the current production of nuclear weapons, he learned in detail about the daily plan for assembling equipment.
Expressing great satisfaction repeatedly over the wonderful technical force of the nuclear power field of the DPRK, he said that the WPK has set forth a new important strategy for building up nuclear force, believing in those of the nuclear power field who have turned out as one with their ardent mind to open up the road of the revolutionary cause of Juche by dint of nuclear weapons. He encouraged the nuclear scientists faithful to the Party to unconditionally implement the Party's policy of building up nuclear force without an inch of deflection with their strong faith and high practical ability.
Noting that anti-DPRK nuclear threats perpetrated by the U.S. imperialists-led vassal forces have become more undisguised and crossed the red-line, he said the security environment facing the DPRK, the peculiarity of the Korean revolution to constantly confront with the U.S. and contain it and prospective threats require the DPRK to steadily expand and bolster up its defence capability for self-defence and the capability for a preemptive attack with the nuclear force as a pivot. He stressed again that an accelerated and sure advance should be stepped up in the struggle to always maintain the thoroughgoing counteraction posture of nuclear force and enhance it at the highest level.
He called on those in the field of nuclear weapons production who assumed the most important responsibility for the historic mission to bolster up the nuclear war deterrence of the country in quality and quantity in a substantial and accelerated way  should exert themselves to produce nuclear weapons and thus fulfill their sacred duty before the Party and the revolution more creditably.
He stressed the need to set a higher long-term goal in producing nuclear materials necessary for the manufacture of tactical nuclear weapons and concentrate all efforts on bringing about fresh leap forward, setting forth important tasks and orientation.
Upon receiving his on-site instructions, all the nuclear combatants made a firm determination to make a great leap forward in implementing the Party's line of nuclear strategy by absolutely and firmly guaranteeing the continuous and successful birth of powerful Korean-style nuclear weapons, bearing in mind the deep trust ofKim Jong Unwho further consolidated the nuclear arsenal which is the strongest in the world to firmly defend the independent development of the state, the happy life and safety of the people and the rosy road of the Juche revolution, and put forward them on the outpost of the sacred struggle. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Training Base of Special Operation Forces of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the training base of the special operation forces of the Korean People's Army to guide the drill of combatants on September 11.
He was accompanied by Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Ri Chang Ho, deputy chief of the General Staff and director of the General Reconnaissance Bureau of the KPA, Kim Yong Bok, deputy chief of the KPA General Staff, and other commanding officers in the field of operation and training of the KPA General Staff.
Kim Jong Unwent round different facilities in the training base to learn in detail about the situation.
Highly appreciating the base which is strictly training the combatants to be versatile ones by furnishing all the facilities and training grounds in a way that drills simulating an actual war can be conducted efficiently, he stressed the need for the Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff to pay positive attention to providing conditions for further updating training facilities and putting their operation on a scientific basis in the future.
He mounted the observation post to watch the combatants conducting a drill of scouting and raiding objects according to a training programme.
All the combatants, who have shed the sweat of loyalty and feats at training grounds with the firm readiness to make a sudden attack on the heart of the enemy and open up the route of advance of the attacking units at a go when the moment of fierce decisive battle comes, fully demonstrated the fighting mettle and spirit of the invincible revolutionary armed forces, which are able to fight a real war and surely win victory once they fight, also in the training conducted in the presence ofKim Jong Un.
Looking with satisfaction at the soldiers, who were sweeping the training ground like lightning, being well versed in the Juche-based and modern combat methods, he highly praised all the combatants for thoroughly maintaining the sure war posture after growing up as stout and brave a-match-for-a-hundred combatants through revolutionary and intensive training.
Saying that he felt assured and proud to see the soldiers prepared as brave fighters like tightly-packed bullets, he encouraged the combatants who have grown up to be reliable guards and passionate warriors of the KPA which always emerges victorious and had a photo session with them.
The combatants, who received high praise and great honour in the benevolent embrace of the invincible and iron-willed brilliant commander, were full of boundless gratitude and joy and infinite pride and self-esteem, which turned into enthusiastic cheers as loud as thunder.
Saying that as seen in today’s training, such competent and stalwart fighters are needed in the KPA, he gave important instructions calling for more firmly building up the special operation forces of the KPA by training possessors of a-match-for-a-hundred spirit and core combatants capable of wiping out the enemies while courageously sweeping battlefields where bullets and shells rain thick and fast without the slightest hesitation in case of emergency.
Considering the mood and character of modern warfare, to make well-trained and prepared special operation forces as the main combat force in the battlefield has an important influence on the outcome of battles, and the building of special operation forces is an important component in the building of the armed forces of the DPRK, he said, and set forth the militant task of putting main efforts into strengthening elite Korean-style special operation forces by holding fast to the line of making a revolution in training, ideas and equipment.
Referring to the need to keep intensifying actual war drills above anything else, he said that as he always emphasizes, sweating a lot in training is the way to shed less blood in a war, a war is not preceded by any notice and, therefore, the KPA should be fully ready to control the enemies at a stroke immediately, mercilessly sweep them away and completely subjugate them even if a war breaks out right today. It is the primary patriotism and loyalty to the state and people and the foremost revolutionary duty for armed soldiers to devote their all to the intensive actual war drills, he said.
He conclusively said that it is necessary to continue to make strict demands in training and constantly improve the contents and methods of Korean-style training so as to get fully ready for war and thereby compel the enemies to shed blood when they encounter the KPA soldiers in case of emergency.
Saying that victory of an army is unthinkable if it is not possessed of the might of ideology, he stated that even a well-prepared army is nothing but an undisciplined army if it has no ideology and that victory will always on the side of the servicemen when they become genuinely patriotic soldiers who know the Party, the country and the people before knowing how to fight. He called for more wonderfully cultivating and giving full play to the political and ideological advantages peculiar to the KPA and thus preparing the soldiers more firmly as the strongest in mental power.
In intensifying ideological education among the service personnel, class education is an important task which should never be neglected even a moment, he said, calling for conducting the education in an offensive way to make all the service personnel keep as an element of their faith the unwavering anti-enemy consciousness and view of the principal enemy.
An indomitable and heroic character and fighting spirit that no other army in the world can imitate pervade all the ranks of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK and they will grow stronger in the future, too, and become a war deterrent preventing the enemy from provoking, being afraid of them for their reputation and entity alone, he said with confidence.
All the combatants were filled with revolutionary enthusiasm and high spirit to become the first standard-bearers who always defend the DPRK and its people most honourably and reliably in the vanguard of the advance by striving to build more perfect capability for fighting an actual war with a firm patriotic spirit, bearing in mind the great trust and expectation ofKim Jong Unwho visited their training ground to tell them ever-victorious war methods and give them militant encouragement. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Marked in Uzbekistan
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- The Social Confederation of Koreans in Uzbekistan held a meeting on September 7 to celebrate the 76th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

Ko Tae Chun made a speech at the meeting.
He noted that PresidentKim Il Sungwon victory in the war of aggression ignited by the U.S. imperialists within two years since the birth of the DPRK, restored the ruined country by dint of self-reliance, believing in the strength of the people and fully demonstrated the DPRK's dignity and might before the whole world as a country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence.
He said that the DPRK could reliably defend its dignity and sovereignty, despite the decades-long moves of the U.S.-led imperialist allied forces to isolate and stifle it, entirely thanks to the outstanding and wise leadership of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.

headline: Press Statement by Spokesperson for Disarmament and Peace Institute of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Disarmament and Peace Institute of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) on Friday released the following press statement "The collective confrontational cooperation against the DPRK will be accompanied by the strengthened formation of strategic axis for improving the security environment of the region":
The U.S. and its vassal forces held the second defense authority meeting between the ROK and member nations of the "UN Command" on September 10.
Their moves to revitalize a tool for war and confrontation, which usurped the signboard of the UN, on the Korean peninsula are arousing a serious concern of the international community.
Another anti-DPRK confrontation confab was held in the name of the "UN Command" whose dismantlement was declared by the international community decades ago. This is an insult to the inviolable UN and the UN Charter and one more important occasion judging who is the illegal force inciting military conflict in the Korean peninsula.
A "joint statement" adopted after the meeting shows that the U.S. is buckling down to drawing member states of the "UN Command" into different joint military drills of aggressive nature to make them proficient in its-led war scenario and substantially enhance their capabilities to fight a war.
Terming the U.S. and its vassal forces' confrontational movement an extremely dangerous political and military provocation that causes security imbalance and escalates the danger of war in the Korean peninsula and the region, we resolutely denounce and reject it.
The expansion of the "UN Command" is a prelude to the establishment of "NATO of Asian version" which will result in pushing the Asia-Pacific region deeper into the structure of new cold war, not easing the military tensions in the Korean peninsula and the region.
When taking into consideration the fact that the revival of the "UN Command" is further increasing the possibility of military conflict in the Korean peninsula by stirring up the war hysteria of the ROK military gangsters running amuck in the military confrontation with the DPRK, the danger of such moves can never be overlooked.
Moreover, if countries in different regions take part in the moves to revive the "UN Command", blindly following the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, military conflict in the Korean peninsula will not be confined to the one between the DPRK and the U.S. but will inevitably lead to the start of a new world war.
It is an essential requirement for the national security and the region's peaceful development to steadily improve the strategic force capable of deterring and weakening the hostile countries' will for war provocation.
The U.S. and its vassal countries' collective military confrontation against the DPRK will serve as a motive and catalyst for accelerating the formation and development of a just strategic axis that thoroughly disallows the imbalance of power in the Korean peninsula and the region.
The DPRK will steadily take a new strategic counteraction to contain and frustrate the reckless confrontation moves of the hostile forces to disturb peace and stability in the Korean peninsula by mobilizing the illegal war organization. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Training Base for Special Operation Armed Force of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the training base of the special operation armed force of the Korean People's Army (KPA) to guide the drill of combatants on September 11.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Ri Chang Ho, deputy chief of the General Staff and director of the General Reconnaissance Bureau of the KPA, Kim Yong Bok, deputy chief of the KPA General Staff, and other commanding officers in the field of operation and training of the KPA General Staff.
Kim Jong Unwent round various facilities of the training base to learn in detail about the situation.
Highly appreciating the fact that all the facilities and training grounds of the base are effectively arranged to practically conduct simulated drills for real war so as to train strictly the combatants to be all-purpose ones, he stressed the need for the Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff to pay positive attention to providing conditions for further updating training facilities and putting their operation on a scientific basis in the future.
He mounted the observation post to watch the scout and raid drills being conducted by the combatants according to their training programme.
All the combatants have shed their sweat of loyalty and feats at training grounds with the firm readiness to make a sudden attack on the hearts of the enemies and open up the road of advance of the attacking units at a go when the moment of a stern decisive battle comes. They fully demonstrated the fighting mettle and spirit of the invincible revolutionary armed forces that are able to really fight and surely win victory if they fight in the training conducted in the presence ofKim Jong Un.
Watching with satisfaction the soldiers who are fully versed in the Juche-based and modern combat methods and are sweeping the training ground like lightning, he highly praised all the combatants for growing up to be stout and brave one-match-for-a-hundred combatants with the revolutionary and strong training enthusiasm and thoroughly maintaining the sure war posture.
Saying that he felt assured and proud to see the soldiers prepared as brave fighters  like bullets, he encouraged the combatants who have grown up to be reliable guards and passionate warriors of the KPA which is demonstrating only victory, and had a photo session with them.
The combatants were full of boundless emotion, joy, great pride and self-esteem, turning into enthusiastic cheers like thunder, as they received high appreciation and great honor under the warm loving care of the invincible and iron-willed brilliant commander.
Saying that as seen in today’s training, such competent and stalwart fighters are needed in the KPA, he gave important instructions calling for more firmly building up the special operation armed force of the KPA by training possessors of a-match-for-a-hundred spirit and  core combatants capable of wiping out the enemy while courageously sweeping the battlefield where bullets and shells rain thick and fast without an inch of hesitation in case of emergency.
When considering the mood and character of a modern war, to put forward the well-trained and prepared special operation armed force as the main combat force in the battlefield has an important influence on victory and defeat, and the building of special operation armed force is an important component in building the armed forces of the DPRK, he said, and set forth the militant task to put main efforts into strengthening the elite Korean-style special operation armed force by firmly holding fast to the revolution in training, ideas and equipment.
Noting that the first task is to continue to intensify the drills for real war, he said that as emphasized always, a lot of sweat in training is the way to shed less blood in a war, war is not a premeditated one and, therefore, the KPA should be fully ready to check the enemy at once and mercilessly and completely repress them even if a war breaks out at once today, and it is the first patriotism and loyalty to the state and people and the foremost revolutionary duty for the soldiers to devote their all to the intensive drills for a real war.
He said with decision that it is necessary to continue to make strict demands in training, steadily improve the contents and methods of Korean-style training and make full preparations for war so as to make the enemies shed blood when they encounter with the KPA in an emergency.
Saying that it is impossible to think about the victory of the army which is not possessed of the might of ideology and the well-prepared army with no ideology is nothing but undisciplined army and when soldiers become true patriotic soldiers who know the Party, the country and the people before learning about battles, victory always comes to their side, he called for more wonderfully cultivating and giving full play to the political and ideological advantages peculiar to the KPA and thus preparing the soldiers more firmly as the strongest in mental power.
Saying that in intensifying the ideological education among the service personnel, class education is an important task which can never be neglected even a moment, he called for intensifying the education in an offensive way to make all the service personnel cherish the transparent sense of the enemy and their outlook on the arch enemy as their faith.
The revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK in which the whole ranks were prevailed by the indomitable heroic spirit and fighting spirit that no army in the world can imitate will grow stronger in the future, too and will become war deterrents making the enemy not dare to provoke, being afraid of its prestige and entity alone, he stressed.
All the combatants were filled with revolutionary enthusiasm and high spirit to become the best standard-bearers who defend our state and people most honorably and most reliably in the vanguard of the advance always by striving to build more perfect capability for real war with a firm patriotic spirit, bearing in mind the great trust and expectation ofKim Jong Unwho visited their training ground and gave them the ever-victorious war method and militant encouragement. -0-
