topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Kim Jong Un University of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) --Kim Jong UnUniversity of National Defence, which has made distinguished contributions to building up the incomparably powerful self-defence capability of the DPRK, while glorifying its proud history and tradition as the country’s comprehensive base for education in defence science and technology in the long course of the revolution for accomplishing the great cause of building a rich country with a powerful army, is greeting its 60th founding anniversary with great pride.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the university, the supreme temple dedicated to the training of talents in the Juche-oriented defence science and technology, on October 7 to congratulate its teaching staff and students on its 60th founding anniversary.
All the teaching staff and students of the university and the officials in the field of munitions industry and meritorious graduates, who visited their university, were full of great emotion and joy as they would get the greatest glory and happiness of receiving ComradeKim Jong Unin the campus on its diamond jubilee at the time when socialist Korea is demonstrating its dignity and prestige all over the world with its tremendous defence capability rapidly growing stronger thanks to the Party's far-reaching plan for building a military power and its ever-victorious leadership ability.
AsKim Jong Unarrived there, enthusiastic cheers went up.
All the participants paid the highest glory and respect toKim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness and ever-victorious banner of Juche Korea who ushers in a new era of the greatest and most dignified power in the history of the development of the DPRK with his iron faith, pluck, far-sighted wisdom and energetic and immortal leadership, as he regards the self-reliant defence as the mainstay of the defence and development of the revolution.
He received a salute from Col. General Jon Il Ho, president of the university.
An educator and a student of the university presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers in humble reverence.
He warmly congratulated the reliable teaching staff and students who are upholding the Party's far-reaching cause of building a military power with the steadfast revolutionary spirit, matchless scientific and technological capabilities and proud academic achievements at the university, the source of the inexhaustible self-defensive military capability firmly guaranteeing the mightiness and invincibility of the state.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first deputy department director of the WPK Central Committee, Jang Chang Ha, director general of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the KPA General Political Bureau.
Kim Jong Unmade a historic speech in commemoration of his congratulatory visit to the university.
Saying that it is a great pleasure of the WPK and the people and an auspicious event of the whole country to mark the 60th founding anniversary of the supreme academy of defence science and technology of the DPRK, which was born with the most sacred and just mission and has added brilliance to its name with the proud feats and academic achievements that it made for the country and revolution, he warmly congratulated all the lecturers, researchers, officials and students of the university on behalf of the WPK Central Committee, the government and all the armed forces of the DPRK.
Clarifying the immutable truth that the university of national defence is the most precious strategic asset for the revolutionary Party and people, he referred to the historic significance of the founding of the university which was born 60 years ago as a creation of the steadfast revolutionary will of the WPK to defend to the end the gains of the revolution won at the cost of blood by firmly holding its destiny in its own hands and the crystallization of its firm faith and ideal to provide an eternal guarantee for dignity and prosperity by building up great strength, and to its proud history and remarkable feats.
Analyzing the true colours and unchangeable nature of the imperialist aggressive entity which the DPRK has been confronting and its ever-more frantic provocative acts, he demonstrated the perfectness and validity of the DPRK's logic of building self-defence capability that it should have physical strength capable of always deterring the enemy and keeping the situation under control. He solemnly declared that the WPK and the government of the DPRK would never allow the balance of forces to be disrupted on the Korean peninsula, but bring about a continuous leap forward in defence science and industry and limitlessly bolster up the war deterrent for self-defence.
Underscoring the need to neutralize the imperialists' aggressive and adventurous military activities with absolute superiority of the Juche-oriented defence sci-tech capabilities, he set forth the basic duty the university assumes in accomplishing the important historic mission and just cause of building a new world, in which war, hegemony and injustice are not tolerated, by dint of the Juche-oriented weapons loaded with the might of revolutionary ideology and the spirit of death-defying resistance, and important tasks for fulfilling it.
Expressing the firm will of the Party Central Committee to successfully build the university into the supreme temple where the revolutionary talents and world-famous inventors representing the future of the DPRK's munitions industry and defence science are continually trained and into a prestigious and renowned defence science research centre, so as to guarantee the eternal well-being and prosperity of the country, he expressed belief that all the lecturers, researchers, students and graduates of the university would demonstrate forever the supremacy of the revolutionary industry with the fruition of noble revolutionary spirit and educational development and excellent academic successes and powerful entities, mindful of the expectations of the Party, country and people.
When he finished his speech, the participants responded with cheers of single-hearted loyalty as they looked up to the great teacher who clarified the great strategy of struggle for firmly defending and glorifying forever the ever-victorious prestige and honour of our state gained with the great revolutionary ideology and indomitable spirit and through the costly struggle and has guided the defence scientists in the drive to break through the cutting edge for boosting the defence capabilities.
He extended militant greetings to the teaching staff, students and graduates who were filled with the burning enthusiasm to absolutely guarantee the implementation of the Party’s policy on defence science with death-defying patriotic devotion, steady exertions and remarkable educational and scientific achievements by redoubling the absolute sense of mission they have assumed before the Party, revolution, country and people.
He went round the room for education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the university.
He recalled with deep emotion the immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho declared the establishment of the centre for training talents in defence science and technology for the eternal dignity and might of the Korean revolution in the first half of the 1960s when the historic advance for the simultaneous promotion of economic construction and defence buildup, the embodiment of the WPK's idea of defending the country by national efforts, started and who developed it into a national defence university with worldwide prestige and reputation.
Saying that the proud history of the university, which has produced more than 180 DPRK heroes and labour heroes and dozens of winners of the highest orders in the past 60 years, is the epitome of the brilliant feats it performed as it played a core and pivotal role in accomplishing the historic cause of increasing national self-defence capabilities, he noted that the legendary reputation of the university, which has paved the way for the victorious advance of the country with loyalty to the Party and the revolution and great ability, should flutter as a banner in the vanguard of the struggle for securing the greatest military technological capability in the world.
The present world in which the destiny of a country and nation is decided by the national defence capability clearly proves that there is a sure guarantee for the existence of a state and its prosperity in systematically training a large contingent of talented personnel in the field of defence science and technology who have made the validity of their cause and ardent patriotism part of their mental qualities, he said, urging the university to train more revolutionary talents representing the future of the munitions industry and defence science, directly related to the future destiny of the country and revolution, and thus fulfill the important mission it has assumed before the times.
He repeatedly stressed the steadfast will of the Party to develop the university into the best one with the highest ability in the country and the most prestigious research-type one in the world where the integration of education, scientific research and production has been realized on the highest level, and took a benevolent measure to successfully spruce up its educational conditions and environment in a comprehensive way as required by the new era.
He met the meritorious officials, scientists and technicians in the field of national defence industry, who visited their alma mater on the occasion of its diamond jubilee, and had a picture taken with them.
Then he had a photo session with the teaching staff and students of the university greeting its 60th founding anniversary, which will be eternally recorded in the history.
All the teaching staff, students and graduates extended their gratitude to the benevolent father who visited the university to illuminate the path of a new revolution in the defence education with his original ideological and theoretical wisdom and extraordinary scientific insight and to show them warm love.
All the teaching staff and students raised stormy cheers out of loyalty and resolution while warmly seeing offKim Jong Unwho was leaving the university after showing love and trust to be handed down through generations.
The noble trace left by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin the pedigree institution for training talents in defence science and technology will shine forever in history as a significant occasion which injected great vitality into the implementation of the WPK's far-reaching strategy for further consolidating and glorifying the irreversible position of the DPRK, which has emerged as the world’s military power, and as an important milestone in the revolution in national defence education. -0-

headline: Truth behind Murder of Empress Myongsong
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- The Japanese aggressors were a horde of brutes indulging in unethical crimes unprecedented in history.
Their brutal murder of the Empress Myongsong, a power holder of the feudal Joson dynasty, clearly proves the ferocity of the Japanese aggressors.
The Japanese aggressors' moves to colonize Korea reached their extremes in the late 19th century. However, Japan's domination over Korea reached the brink of collapse due to interference and pressure by big powers, and the Empress Myongsong's enforcement of anti-Japanese policy served as another big blow to Japan.
The Japanese aggressors, unable to fulfil their wild ambition, sought a way out in eliminating the Empress Myongsong.
They, who hatched a criminal plot to murder the first lady of the country, appointed Lieutenant General Miura Goro as its spearhead and dispatched him to Korea.
The military gangster, granted the absolute authority to mobilize any means necessary for murdering the Empress Myongsong, worked out a detailed plan for carrying it out.
On October 8, 1895, atrocities were launched under the direction of Miura.
The Japanese murderers infiltrated into the Korean Imperial Palace, confined the emperor and the prince, where they were, and ransacked the palace to find the empress.
They went on a killing spree, murdering all court ladies on their way. They finally found the empress breathing the last breath among the dead ladies. They dragged her body wrapped in quilt to a pile of firewood they had already prepared, poured oil and set fire on it.
Later, the Japanese imperialists, who brutally killed the Empress Myongsong, got more undisguised in their moves to subjugate Korea, and occupied Korea by force of arms at last.
The murder case was a hideous state-sponsored terrorism directly linked with the implementation of the policy of aggression on Korea.
The Japanese imperialists can never evade the responsibility for the past crimes. -0-

headline: Okryu Children's Hospital Associated with Loving Care of Tender-hearted Father
Invincible Workers' Party of Korea Guided by Great Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- Today the Workers' Party of Korea has grown stronger into an invincible party which is confidently guiding the socialist cause despite severe hardship.
This reality would be unthinkable without the outstanding leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is cementing the leadership ability and fighting efficiency of the WPK in every way.
Kim Jong Unhas energetically led the struggle to dynamically accelerate the modeling of the whole Party on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and steadily enhance the leadership role of the Party in the new century of Juche.
At the Fourth Conference of the WPK in April Juche 101 (2012), he solemnly clarified the revolutionary faith and will of the WPK to uphold great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as its eternal guiding ideology.
At the Seventh WPK Congress, too, he specified it again as the general task in the Party building to develop the WPK into the one of the great leaders.
He prioritized the strengthening of the Party cells and the primary Party committees as the two major tasks for strengthening the whole Party and clarified the practical programmes that serve as guidelines for further enhancing the functions and role of the basic Party organizations at the First Conference of Chairpersons of the Primary Party Committees and the Fifth Conference of Cell Chairpersons of the WPK.
In his important speech at a lecture given on the 76th founding anniversary of the WPK, he indicated the ideal goal of the work for establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee at present.
He visited the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK, the highest institute of training Party cadres, and gave a historic lecture before its teaching staff and students on October 17, 2022. At that time he advanced the orientation of the Party building in the new era, a crucial milestone in the development of the Party and the revolution.
His great leadership has developed the Party further into an ideologically pure entity and an integral organization with the leader as the one and only center and into a guiding force for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche.
The great WPK is demonstrating its dignity and might to the world, guided byKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a new heyday of strengthening the whole Party with his outstanding ideology and seasoned leadership. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech at Congratulatory Visit to Kim Jong Un University of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the congratulatory visit toKim Jong UnUniversity of National Defence.
The full text of the speech is as follows:
Comrades,
This defence university, which was established with the most sacred and righteous mission and has glorified its name with unexcelled merits and proud academic records for the country and the revolution, is greeting its meaningful 60th founding anniversary.
Celebration of this anniversary of the school, an institute for training steadfast and capable personnel in defending the Party and the revolution by force of arms and the highest defence sci-tech institute in our Republic that reliably supports the historic cause of building a prosperous country with a strong army, is a source of great delight for our Party and people and an auspicious event for the whole country.
On behalf of the Party Central Committee, our government and the whole armed forces of the Republic, I extend warm congratulations to all the teachers, researchers, officials and students of the university standing here with the most dignified and proud feeling of building up the defence industry of lasting significance, which represents the strength of our country, Korea, and its ever-victorious glory.
My warm greetings also go to the family members, who are making painstaking efforts to care for the educators in adding to the weight and prestige of this sacred university, and to those who have sent their beloved sons and daughters willingly to the forefront of defending the country and the revolution.
Comrades,
If someone asks our Party and people waging the revolution what is their most valuable strategic asset, they will say that is this defence university, a “pedigree farm” for training defence sci-tech talents.
And if he asks what are the most precious resources that can guarantee the future of a powerful country, they will also say they are the revolutionary talented personnel studying at this university.
The university has proved this iron truth of history with its dignified history and wonderful feats.
As I am standing here on this meaningful day, I am reminded of how epochal and decisive the day of 60 years ago was in achieving the success of our revolutionary cause and carving out the destiny of our state.
The founding of this university was not simply something created by the fateful decade, when confrontation between socialism and imperialism and between revolution and counterrevolution was acute on the globe and when the urgency of building self-reliant defences in every country posed itself not in words but by shocking events and as a stark reality.
It was an institute born of the steadfast revolutionary will of the Workers’ Party of Korea to take its destiny firmly in its own hands and defend to the last the gains of the revolution achieved at the cost of blood; it was also a crystallization of its firm faith and ideals for setting up a notable landmark in achieving dignity and prosperity by building great strength.
It would not be so hard to imagine how extraordinary and audacious the decision was to found this university amid the then global political landscape and internal and external situations of our country.
If the great leader ComradeKim Il Sunghad lived to continue to write his reminiscences without stopping it to our painful memory, he would have recollected why this university had to be founded, I believe.
As it was founded from scratch with the spirit of self-respect and self-reliance as its lifeblood, since the first day of its founding the university, with Juche as its lifeline and characteristic feature, has served as a reliable base for implementing the Workers’ Party of Korea’s line of self-reliant defence and added inexhaustible potential and dynamism to the growth and development of the defence capability of our state.
The Juche orientation and modern character are two attributes and buttresses of our self-reliant national defence, and these can be defended and built up only when it has a base for training its own sci-tech talents.
In fact, from the day of this university’s founding our defence industry could set a clear goal and orientation for its development as a Juche-oriented industry that develops and produces our own style of weapons and other combat equipment, and make rapid development as an industry possessed of self-supporting, modern and advanced characters.
Though it made its start literally from scratch–without the foundations of the machine-building industry and an asset of munitions industry–our defence industry laid already in the 1970s its firm production foundations based on modern defence science and technology, and has since supported the Party’s cause on the strength of Juche-oriented science and industry. The annals of its great history have been written together with those of the history of this university’s development.
This is the very place where large contingents of competent personnel have grown up equipping themselves with the spirit of Juche and up-to-date military science and made tangible contributions to the victorious revolution by satisfactorily raising our country’s defence capabilities to the level as high as is required by the revolution at each period and stage of its development. The fine people trained in this campus now constitute the backbone of the revolutionary industry in writing, together with our Party, a new chapter of history of strength the world has never known.
Our own style of weaponry has attained the power which nobody else on this planet could copy, the powerful strength by which the embryo of great historic events is developing. This strength is undoubtedly the might of potentialities of the Juche-oriented science, crystallization of the pride of Korea and the resourcefulness of the Korean people, and of our proud defence scientists who are the incarnation of those qualities.
The university has untiringly injected the two essential attributes of vitality, that is, the Juche orientation and modern character, into the revolutionary industry that shoulders the destiny and future of the Party, the state and the people, and laid solid and stable foundations for our country to rise as a world-class power. Herein lies the historic importance of the founding of the university and the incomparable glory of its 60-year history.
We know there are long-standing institutes around the world boasting their time-honoured traditions of defence science education and training of capable personnel; yet none of them could be a match for this university, a revolutionary institute, which, based in the capital city of the revolution, has maintained its lineage of absolute loyalty to the Party Central Committee and its lines while firmly supporting the revolutionary cause without a slightest vacillation or hesitation for 60 years for its steadfast inheritance and accomplishment.
This honourable history and traditions of the university and the names and exploits of the numerous heroes born of the university are rather little-known, but the imprints of their life are left anywhere in our country, and their soul of national defence is reflected in the hatred-charged powerful weapons that strike terror into the enemy.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to highly appreciate the teachers and researchers of the university for the ennobling careers they have made and the patriotic feats they have performed while living a wartime-like life even in peacetime on their uninterrupted march of service for the country and their fellow people, mindful of the heavy class mission charged by the Party and the revolution to them.
Also, I hope from the bottom of my heart that the students will grow as reliable successors to the cornerstone of our Republic.
Comrades,
The defence university does not simply represent the glorious past and present of the revolutionary industry which is a strong buttress of our independent, powerful and self-sustaining country; it also serves as a bulwark of strategic importance for achieving one victory after another in the years to come.
Your campus is a fierce battlefield, not a comfortable place.
The enemy you are facing are die-hard anti-communists, who would not change their hostile consciousness against our Republic until their doomsday. And they are imperialist aggressive forces that boast their highly advanced military science and technology and munitions industry plus their centuries-old belligerency.
It is a matter of course that the more fearfully they become aware of their doomsday coming closer, the more frantic the ringleader of aggression and its lackeys, dependent on anti-communism and war for their existence, will go and rush to war till they collapse with sheer exhaustion.
This is evident when we consider what happened on October 1 last, when the rulers of the Republic of Korea, holding a pompous ceremony to mark what they called the “ROK Army Day,” glibly read ignoble and disgraceful lines only to reveal their abnormal way of thinking to the outside world.
The puppet regime, attaching special importance to the inauguration of the “strategic command” which they had pushed ahead with as the “core project of the state administration,” claimed that their “latest conventional combat capability has finally merged with the extended deterrent capability of the U.S.”
Obviously they do not have any strategic weapons worth mentioning, but they have made up the “strategic command”–without real worth–by borrowing their master’s nukes, and praised it as “core unit” and “great build-up of the defence capabilities.” They went so far as to give a long and nice narration of how a latest strategic nuclear submarine of the U.S. entered the ROK for the first time in some 40 years, followed by the landing of a strategic bomber for the first time in history. This is a frank and self-praising admission of the record of their intentional and planned worsening of the regional situation in cooperation with their master.
The “congratulatory speech” is simply a presentation of desperate bluff that comes from their inferiority complex in strength and their morbid consciousness of persecution by our state. In a nutshell, it reveals only their absurd intention to maintain at any cost the balance of strength with us by relying on the ROK-U.S. alliance that has mutated into a nuke-based military bloc.
I am saying this as you need to have a clear understanding of our enemy.
In delivering the “congratulatory speech” Yoon Suk Yeol intentionally made mean and vulgar remarks about ending the government of our Republic. This indicates that he is totally gripped by a blind belief in his master’s “might.”
As you have learned through newspapers and broadcasts, some days ago I made clear my view of and stand towards this matter.
A wise statesman would not act so rashly as to endanger the security of his country and its population; in dealing with a nuclear-armed rival, rather than opt for a confrontation or face-off with it, he would put emphasis on, and concern himself about, how to handle the situation and avoid military conflict.
It is because this option is absolutely right and helpful to ensure the security of his country.
Doing so is just what a veteran statesman would choose to do, an expression of his political proficiency and finesse.
Then what did the man say in Seoul?
Speaking on the doorstep of a nuclear-armed state, he clamoured about responding with overwhelming military strength. How would this be commented on by the audiences the world over?
Would he be praised for having been born with rare courage? Or would he be described as a patriotic commander or the like?
Even if there appeared a matchless commander unheard-of in the time-honoured history, he would not be able to come up with a realistic method of overcoming the distinctions between the capabilities of nukes and conventional weapons.
This is the very reason that I called him one who is most likely to be considered a man lacking something.
For the Republic of Korea, all that it needs to do in order to guarantee its security is not provoking us into using our military strength.
This is so simple a method.
It would find itself safe if it refrained from provoking us or flexing its muscles before us at times, but it seems that Seoul has no one capable of doing such a simple thing.
To be honest, we have no intention of attacking the Republic of Korea.
Thinking of it is abominable, and we hate dealing with those in it.
Formerly, we often spoke about liberating the south and reunification by force of arms, but now we are not interested in it. And since our statement about two separate states, we have been all the more unwilling to be conscious of the state in the south.
However, the point is that the latter provokes us now and then.
We must keep close watch on the recent developments around our country.
Deeply engrossed in their preposterous schemes to “contain” the non-existent threat against them, the U.S. imperialists and their puppets have converted the ROK-U.S. alliance into a nuclear-based one, and they are growing frantic in their arms build-up. Their desperate clamour for war and provocations threaten to disrupt the balance of strength on the Korean peninsula at any moment.
Their expansion of armaments and military actions are justifiable and self-defensive, whereas our responses are threats and provocations–this is the U.S. imperialists’ and their stooges’ way of thinking, an illogical and perverted approach that is tantamount to that of the thief crying “Stop thief!”
In other words, it is a robber’s logic, namely the problem is not what is being done, but who is doing it.
We do not recognize it, and such far-fetched sophism of the enemy can never check our strength from growing.
The disturbed balance of strategic strength on the Korean peninsula precisely means the outbreak of war.
Therefore, the logic on the self-reliant defence building, the logic that we should possess physical strength with which to always contain the enemy and control the situation is absolutely open and above board.
Our progress towards a military superpower, a nuclear power, will grow faster.
Now that the ROK-U.S. military alliance has completely changed into a nuclear alliance as the puppets advertise themselves, the preparedness of our state for nuclear counteractions should be further perfected on the high level defying limits.
By the way, I would like to mention that on October 4 a spokesman for the UN secretary general asked us to lower the rhetoric.
I am not sure that such a request was also conveyed to Seoul, but I would take this opportunity to stress once again that the international community should have a proper understanding of my remarks.
I have clearly and consistently put a precondition of the word “if” whenever I clarified our stand on the use of military strength.
Under the precondition of “if,” our Constitution will issue a strict order to our armed forces.
If the enemy attempt to have recourse to arms against our state, the armed forces of our Republic will use all the strike capabilities without hesitation.
They will not rule out the use of nuclear weapons.
I stress once again: Pinning hopes for survival in such a situation is useless and no fortune or alleged guardianship of God can protect the ROK.
This is not an issue related to rhetoric as mentioned by the UN, but it is exactly a warning of action.
Confronting us are the largest nuclear power in the world and the most vicious of its puppets attempting to fool with its nukes.
Under such circumstances our view, option and resolve can never be changed.
The enemy should refrain from acting rashly.
They should never slight our warning that if they misunderstand it as something like their worn-out, half-baked bluff, they would pay more dearly for it.
The absolute strength we have possessed at present is discharging in a responsible manner the mission of deterring a war and defending peace.
No forces will dare opt for the use of military strength against the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, a military conflict.
However, the more desperately the enemy try to hold supremacy by dint of the “nuclear alliance” and reverse the strategic situation, the more steadily we should make a leap forward in defence science and industry and the more firmly we should consolidate our war deterrent for self-defence.
Our Party and the government of our Republic will never tolerate the balance of strength being disturbed on the Korean peninsula.
We should neutralize the imperialists’ adventurist military acts of aggressive nature by dint of the absolute superiority of the strength of the Juche-oriented defence science and technology.
Nothing will overwhelm the strength of the Juche-type weapons loaded with the might of the revolutionary ideas and the do-or-die resistance spirit, and we, based on this strength, should create a new world, in which war, hegemony and injustice shall not be allowed.
This defence university should continue to make responsible and devoted efforts until we accomplish this important mission and righteous cause entrusted to us by the times and history.
The basic task facing the university is to train in larger numbers pillars who would further consolidate and glorify the position of our Republic as a world-class military superpower, competent talents who are possessed of the Juche-oriented ideology and theory on defence science, a wealth of specialist knowledge and practical abilities, and the key to this end is to radically improve the level of its education.
To improve the level of its education is the absolute demand of our Party and revolution, and the university should take the lead in implementing the Party’s policy on bringing about a radical turn in education.
True to the essence of our Party’s defence policy on guaranteeing the security of the country and people by our own efforts and in accordance with the characteristics of education in defence science and technology and the global trend of the development of military hardware, the university should formulate its educational programme correctly, reorganize the overall structure of its education and make positive efforts to study and apply advanced teaching methods with the main stress on putting the contents of education on a scientific, practical, comprehensive and modern footing, thus increasing the ranks of talents capable of confidently leading the steady advance and development of our defence industry.
It should thoroughly establish the Juche orientation in the education of defence science and technology so as to play a decisive role in rooting out dogmatic, stereotyped and imitative practices that remain in the defence industry, and pay special attention to intensifying basic science education as suited to its characteristics.
In order for the university to keep up its appearance as befits its position and weight, it should, above all else, improve the quality of the ranks of its teachers and ensure that all of them possess high intellect combined with the qualifications of educators.
With a clear view and stand that improved qualifications are inconceivable separate from scientific research, the teachers and researchers should be proactive in participating in developing cutting-edge military hardware urgently needed in strengthening the country’s defence capabilities and perfecting the combat preparedness of the People’s Army, as well as in projects to push back the frontiers of defence science and technology. In this way, they can prepare themselves to be talented educationists, who possess as their essential qualifications rich experience in education and latest science and technology so as to create a climate of talented persons training students to be more talented ones.
The university Party committee should make strenuous efforts to establish more firmly the unified leadership system of the Party and a climate of strictly observing order, keeping secrets and maintaining moral discipline in the campus and lay firm material foundations of the university. In this way, it can constantly improve the working and living conditions for the teachers, researchers and students, who are invaluable for our Party.
The Party and the state should give active support to the defence university in its work and throw their weight behind it.
Relevant departments of the Party Central Committee should pay close attention to the university’s work and give proper Party-oriented guidance to the university. Other relevant sectors and units should take measures for solving on a priority basis the problems arising in the management and operation of the university.
It is the determination of the Party Central Committee to radically transform the appearance and educational environment of the university with the goal of turning it into one of the most prestigious universities in the world at an earlier date.
The university should be furnished with the latest educational apparatuses and equipment and IT means so that other universities dare not compare themselves with it in terms of the level of modernization.
…
The validity and superiority of our Party’s defence policy and the Korean-style education policy and our state’s scientific and technological force and its level of remarkable development should be represented by the prestige and reputation of this university, and the honour of renowned red scientists creating new things from nothing if they are needed for our revolution should belong to its graduates.
Defence university students who will carry through the revolution following our Party,
All of you, wearing the military uniform of the revolution in your precious university days and spending these days filled with a sense of uncommon mission and patriotic enthusiasm, should keep in mind that your academic records reflect your revolutionary faith, patriotism and loyalty and be ardent in studying and earnest in thinking, thus preparing yourselves to be pillars who will shoulder the future of the Juche-oriented defence science and munitions industry.
You should always bear in mind that as students of the defence university, you should be called exemplary young students of Korea, who cherish loyalty to your country and revolution as your lifeblood, are well-versed in the latest scientific and technological advances in your major fields, and are possessed of creative abilities.
To develop the defence university into the highest institute responsible for producing without interruption talented revolutionary personnel and world-renowned inventors that are representative of the future of our munitions industry and defence science, and into an authoritative and prestigious defence science research centre, in order to ensure the eternal security and prosperity of our country–this is the Party Central Committee’s firm determination and will.
Fully convinced that all the teachers, researchers, students and graduates of the university, mindful of the expectations of their Party, country and fellow people, will continue to demonstrate the excellence of the revolutionary industry by displaying their ennobling revolutionary spirit, achieving substantial progress in education, making high academic achievements and developing powerful weapons, I once again extend warm congratulations and offer my heartfelt tribute to our Party’s faithful revolutionary soldiers and true patriots on the occasion of their holiday. -0-

headline: Nampho Municipal Revolutionary Museum Visited by Many People in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- The Nampho Municipal Revolutionary Museum in the DPRK has been visited by many people with the resolve to defend and add shine to the leadership exploits of the Workers' Party of Korea and steadily carry forward the tradition of loyalty and patriotism shown by the pioneers in the Chollima era.
On display at the museum are photos showing the undying leadership exploits of the Party, which developed Nampho Municipality into a modern port city and a region playing an important role in the country's economic development, and the greatness of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unushering in a new era of comprehensive national prosperity. Also displayed there are precious historical relics and data on the revolutionary activities.
Recently, officials of the Party and power organs and working people’s organizations in the municipality and working people, youth and students of many units including the Chollima Steel Complex, the Kumsong Tractor Factory, the West Sea Barrage Office, the Nampho Municipal Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory, the Nampho Municipal School Uniform Factory, the Taedae Vegetable Farm in Waudo District and the Nampho University of Education have visited the museum to deeply grasp the revolutionary exploits of the peerlessly great persons. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Monday.
The message said:
My closest Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin,
I extend sincere and warm congratulations to you on your birthday.
You have made remarkable successes in the course of resolutely defending the sovereignty, security, development and interests of the country and building powerful Russia with energetic and wise leadership with your heavy and sacred duty for the prosperity of Russia and promotion of the wellbeing of the Russian people for a long time and thus enjoy boundless trust and support by the Russian people.
I am now recollecting with deep emotion the days when we developed the traditional DPRK-Russia relations into the invincible alliance relations and eternal strategic relations with the realization of independence and justice as the common idea and deepened our friendship by declaring to the world together with you the establishment of the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries in Pyongyang on last June 19.
Meetings and comradely ties between us to be continued in the future will make a positive contribution to further consolidating the eternal foundation of the DPRK-Russia friendship and strategic and cooperative relations put on an orbit of fresh comprehensive development and defending regional and global peace and international justice.
I believe you will as ever lead great Russia only to the road of victory and honor full of vigor.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I reaffirm our full and disinterested support and solidarity with the just cause of the army and people of Russia.
I toast your good health and bigger success in your work, congratulating you on your birthday here in Pyongyang together with my friends.
Pyongyang will always stand by Moscow.
To my closest comrade. -0-

headline: Truth behind Murder of Empress Myongsong
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- The Japanese aggressors were a horde of brutes indulging in unethical crimes unprecedented in history.
Their brutal murder of the Empress Myongsong, a power holder of the feudal Joson dynasty, clearly proves the ferocity of the Japanese aggressors.
The Japanese aggressors' moves to colonize Korea reached their extremes in the late 19th century. However, Japan's domination over Korea reached the brink of collapse due to interference and pressure by big powers, and the Empress Myongsong's enforcement of anti-Japanese policy served as another big blow to Japan.
The Japanese aggressors, unable to fulfil their wild ambition, sought a way out in eliminating the Empress Myongsong.
They, who hatched a criminal plot to murder the first lady of the country, appointed Lieutenant General Miura Goro as its spearhead and dispatched him to Korea.
The military gangster, granted the absolute authority to mobilize any means necessary for murdering the Empress Myongsong, worked out a detailed plan for carrying it out.
On October 8, 1895, atrocities were launched under the direction of Miura.
The Japanese murderers infiltrated into the Korean Imperial Palace, confined the emperor and the prince, where they were, and ransacked the palace to find the empress.
They went on a killing spree, murdering all court ladies on their way. They finally found the empress breathing the last breath among the dead ladies. They dragged her body wrapped in quilt to a pile of firewood they had already prepared, poured oil and set fire on it.
Later, the Japanese imperialists, who brutally killed the Empress Myongsong, got more undisguised in their moves to subjugate Korea, and occupied Korea by force of arms at last.
The murder case was a hideous state-sponsored terrorism directly linked with the implementation of the policy of aggression on Korea.
The Japanese imperialists can never evade the responsibility for the past crimes. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Kim Jong Un University of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) --Kim Jong UnUniversity of National Defence, which has made distinguished contributions to bolstering up powerful self-defence capability of the DPRK while glorifying the proud history and tradition as a comprehensive defence science and technology educational base of the country in the long course of the revolution for realizing the great cause of building a rich country with strong army, is greeting its 60th founding anniversary with high pride.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the university, the highest seat of training the Juche-oriented national defence sci-tech talents, on Monday to congratulate its teaching staff and students on its 60th founding anniversary.
All the teaching staff and students of the university and officials in the field of munitions industry and graduates of merits who visited their university, were full of great emotion and joy, having the greatest glory and happiness as they were to meet the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin the campus on the day marking its founding anniversary at a time when socialist Korea is demonstrating its dignity and reputation all over the world with its tremendous national defence capability rapidly growing stronger thanks to the Party's far-reaching plan for building a military power and its ever-victorious leadership ability.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived, enthusiastic cheers were raised.
All the participants paid the highest glory and tribute toKim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness and ever-victorious banner of Juche Korea who ushers in a new era of the greatest and dignified power in the history of the development of the DPRK with his iron faith, pluck, far-sighted wisdom and energetic and immortal leadership while regarding the self-reliant defence as the mainstay of defending and developing the revolution.
He received a salute from Colonel General Jon Il Ho, president of the university.
An educator and a student of the university presented bouquets of fragrant flowers to him in humble reverence.
He warmly congratulated the reliable teaching staff and students who are upholding the Party's far-sighted cause of building a military power with the steadfast revolutionary spirit, matchless scientific and technological capabilities and proud academic achievements at the university, the source of the inexhaustible self-defensive military capability firmly guaranteeing the mightiness and invincibility of the state.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Jang Chang Ha, director general of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the KPA General Political Bureau.
Kim Jong Unmade a historic speech in commemoration of his congratulatory visit to the university.
Saying that it is the great pleasure of the WPK and the people and an auspicious event of the whole country to mark the 60th founding anniversary of the supreme academy for national defence science and technology of the Republic, which was born with the most sacred and just mission and has glorified its name with proud merits and academic accomplishments that it made for the country and revolution, he warmly congratulated all the teachers, researchers, officials and students of the university on behalf of the WPK Central Committee and the government and all the armed forces of the Republic.
Clarifying the immutable truth that the university of national defence is the most precious strategic resource for the revolutionary party and people, he referred to the historic significance of the founding of the university which was born 60 years ago as a creation of the steadfast revolutionary will of the WPK to defend to the end the revolutionary gains won at the cost of blood by firmly hold fast to its destiny in its own hands and a crystal of its firm faith and ideal to provide an eternal guarantee for dignity and prosperity by bolstering its powerful strength, and to its proud history and remarkable feats.
Analyzing the real appearance and unchangeable nature of the imperialist aggressive entity with which the DPRK has been confronting and its ever-more frantic provocative acts, he proved the perfection and validity of the DPRK's logic of building self-defence capability that it should have physical strength capable of always deterring the enemy and keeping the situation under control. He solemnly declared that the WPK and the government of the DPRK would never allow the destruction of the balance of force on the Korean peninsula, but bring about continuous leap forward in defence science and industry and bolster up the war deterrent for self-defence limitlessly.
Underscoring the need to neutralize the imperialists' aggressive and adventurous military activities with absolute superiority of the Juche-oriented defence sci-tech capabilities, he set forth the main mission which the university should carry out in accomplishing an important historic mission and just cause of building a new world in which war, hegemony and injustice are not allowed by dint of the Juche-oriented weapons equipped with the might of revolutionary idea and the spirit of death-defying resistance, and important tasks for doing so.
Expressing the firm will of the Party Central Committee to successfully build the university into the highest seat where the revolutionary talents and world-famous inventors representing the future of the DPRK's munitions industry and national defence science are continually growing up and into a prestigious and famous national defence science research center, and to guarantee the eternal well-being and prosperity of the country, he expressed belief that all the teachers, researchers, students and graduates of the university would demonstrate forever the supremacy of revolutionary industry with a fruition of noble revolutionary spirit and educational development and excellent academic successes and powerful entities, bearing in mind the expectations of the Party, country and people.
When he finished his speech, the participants responded with cheers of single-minded loyalty, looking up to the great teacher who clarified the great strategy for struggle to firmly defend and glorify forever the ever-victorious prestige and honor of our state gained with the great revolutionary ideology and indomitable spirit and through precious struggle and has guided the scientists in the field of national defence science to the drive of breaking through the cutting edge in bolstering up the defence capabilities.
He extended militant greetings to the teaching staff, students and graduates full of high enthusiasm to firmly guarantee the Party's policy on national defence science with death-defying patriotic devotion, strenuous efforts and signal educational and scientific achievements by doubling the absolute sense of duty they have assumed before the Party, revolution, country and people.
He went round the room for education in the revolutionary history and the room dedicated to the history of the university.
He recollected with deep emotion the immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho declared the establishment of the center for training talents of national defence science and technology for the eternal dignity and might of the Korean revolution in the first half of the 1960s when the historic advance of simultaneous development in economic construction and building of defence that becomes the embodiment of the WPK's idea of defending the country by self-defence started, and developed it into the national defence university with world prestige and reputation.
Saying that the proud history of the university which has produced more than 180 heroes of the Republic and labor heroes and tens of winners of the highest orders over the past 60 years is the epitome of the brilliant feats it performed by playing a core and pivotal role in accomplishing the historic cause of bolstering national self-defensive capabilities, he added that the legendary reputation of the university which has laid an ever-victorious cornerstone for the advance of the country with loyalty to the Party and the revolution and tremendous ability should flutter as a banner in the van of the struggle for securing the strongest military technological force in the world.
Noting that the present world in which the destiny of a country and a nation is decided by the strength of national-defensive muscle clearly proves that there is a sure guarantee for the existence of the state and its prosperity in systematically training a large contingent of talented personnel in the field of national defence science and technology who believe the validity of their cause and have ardent patriotism, he stressed the need for the university to train more revolutionary talents representing the future of the munitions industry and defence science directly related to the future destiny of the country and revolution and thus fulfill the important mission it has assumed before the times.
He repeatedly stressed the firm will of the Party to develop the university into one with the highest ability in the country and most prestigious research-type one in the world where the integration of education, scientific research and production has been realized on the highest level, and took benevolent measures for successfully sprucing up its educational conditions and environment in a comprehensive way as required by the new era.
He met the officials, scientists and technicians of merits in the field of national defence industry who visited their old university on the occasion of its founding anniversary and had a picture taken with them.
Then he had a photo session with the teaching staff and students of the university who greeted its 60th founding anniversary to be recorded in history.
All the teaching staff, students and graduates extended their gratitude to the benevolent father who visited the university to illuminate the path of the new revolution in the defence education with his unique ideological and theoretical wisdom and extraordinary scientific insight and show warm love for them.
All the teaching staff and students raised stormy cheers out of loyalty and resolution while warmly seeing offKim Jong Unwho was leaving the university after showing love and trust to be handed down through generations.
The noble trace left by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin the pedigree establishment for training talents of national defence science and technology will shine forever in history as a significant occasion which injected great vitality into the implementation of the WPK's far-reaching strategy to further consolidate and glorify the irreversible position of the DPRK emerged as the military power in the world and as an important milestone in the revolution in national defence education. -0-

headline: 11th Session of 14th SPA of DPRK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The 11th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall from October 7 to 8.
Present there were deputies to the SPA, and as observers officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Standing Committee of the SPA, the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, chairpersons of provincial, city and county people’s committees and other officials concerned in Pyongyang and local areas.
The platform was taken by senior officials of the Party, the government and the military including Kim Tok Hun, Choe Ryong Hae and Ri Pyong Chol who are Presidium members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, chairperson and vice chairpersons of the SPA, members of the State Affairs Commission and vice chairperson, secretary general and members of the Standing Committee of the SPA.
Deputy Pak In Chol, chairman of the SPA, made an opening address.
As the session was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played.
The 11th Session of the 14th SPA of the DPRK brought up the following agenda items for discussion:
First, on amending and supplementing some contents of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK
Second, on deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry
Third, on deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs
Fourth, on the state of supervision of the enforcement of the Law of the DPRK on Quality Control
Fifth, organizational matter
Deputy Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made a report on the first agenda item.
He said that the outstanding ideology of the WPK on national building and action programme for it to meet the requirements of the changing and developing revolution and the aspirations and interests of the people should be specified in time in order to make the Socialist Constitution fully discharge its mission as a powerful legal weapon for glorifying the new era of a great power, an era of our state-first principle.
He noted that the content of amending the ages of citizens of the DPRK for working and participating in election was reflected in the relevant agenda item was reflected in the relevant agenda item as the age of students graduating from senior middle schools changes from this year after the adoption of the Law of the SPA on Enforcement of the Universal 12-Year Compulsory Education System.
He said that the ages of citizens for working and participating in election were rectified and stipulated in the drafts on amending and supplementing the Socialist Constitution so that the right of the schoolchildren to learn to their heart's content under the benevolent care of the best socialist educational system and the right to devote their wisdom and passion to the prosperity of the country with a noble sense of the consciousness of civic duty are be guaranteed by law.
Saying that it is the firm will of the DPRK government to usher in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation by remaining loyal to the outstanding ideology and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, holding fast to the Socialist Constitution as a strong political weapon for building a powerful country, he proposed the relevant amended and supplemented plan to the current SPA for deliberation.
The session adopted with unanimous approval the Law of the SPA of the DPRK "On amending and supplementing some contents of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK".
It discussed the drafts of the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry and the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs as following agenda items.
Deputy Kang Yun Sok, vice chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made a report on the second and third agenda items.
He said that the relevant draft laws reflected principled issues arising in providing a firm legal guarantee for the rapid development of light industry which plays an important role in improving the people's living standard and in expanding the external economic relations in a diverse way, and explained the relevant contents according to chapters.
The SPA Standing Committee submitted the drafts of the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry and the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs in accordance with Article 95 of the Socialist Constitution to the current SPA for deliberation.
Deputies Kim Myong Hun, Kim Chang Sok, Jo Yong Chol, Pak Kun Sok, Mun Yong Son, Yun Jong Ho, Sin Chang Il and Kim Hye Yong made speeches on the relevant agenda items at the session.
The speakers expressed full support, recognizing that the relevant drafts of the laws proposed for deliberation were worked out to be able to provide legal environment and conditions for the development of light industry directly related to the improvement of the people's living standard and contribute to the independent and sustainable development of the national economy by conducting external economic affairs on a wide scale.
The session held study and consultative meetings on the drafts of the sector-specific laws and adopted the laws of the SPA of the DPRK "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry" and "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs" through deliberation and supplement of the constructive opinions of deputies.
At the discussion of the fourth agenda item, a report on the supervision of the enforcement of the Law on Quality Control was made to be followed by speeches of Deputies Jo Kyong Guk, Ri Song Bom, Rim Sun Hui, Ri Yong Chol and Kim Yun Sil.
The reporter and speakers said that the quality of products is the one of important criterions showing the level of economic and technical development and civilization of the country, referring to the successes made in the work for improving the quality of products in hearty response to the important tasks set forth at the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and to a series of shortcomings to be overcome surely.
They vowed to further intensify the quality control work and enhance the role of the supervision organs so as to make positive contributions to the national economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard, stressing that the observance of the law on quality control entirely is the defence of the people's demand and interests and thoroughgoing implementation.
Deputies raised views and measures to improve quality control as required by the reality.
A decision of the SPA of the DPRK "On Thoroughly Executing the Law of the DPRK on Quality Control" was adopted at the session.
The organizational matter as its fifth agenda item was discussed.
No Kwang Chol was appointed as minister of National Defence of the DPRK.
Ri Man Su was appointed as minister of State Construction Control.
Kim Song Bin was appointed as chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology.
Deputy Pang Tu Sop was by-elected as chairman of the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
Deputy Pak In Chol, chairman of the SPA, made a closing address.
The 11th Session of the 14th SPA successfully finished its work amid the high political consciousness and high enthusiasm of the participants to thoroughly guarantee the implementation of the state administration through their positive action and efforts for the prosperity of the great state and the promotion of the people's well-being, deeply aware of their responsibility as representatives of the people. -0-

headline: At 11th Session of 14th SPA of DPRK
Report of KPA General Staff
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The General Staff of the Korean People's Army (KPA) issued the following report on Wednesday:
The hostile forces are getting ever more reckless in their confrontational hysteria, openly revealing their scheme to use armed forces in violation of the sovereignty of the DPRK. This pushes the grave security situation of the Korean peninsula to a more unpredictable phase.
Amid various war exercises for aggression being staged simultaneously in the region of the ROK every day near the southern border of the DPRK, strategic nuclear assets of the U.S. frequent the region and the war maniacs loudly talk about the "end of regime" in the DPRK so often. This proves the gravity of the situation that can never be overlooked.
The acute military situation prevailing on the Korean peninsula requires the armed forces of the DPRK to take a more resolute and stronger measure in order to more creditably defend the national security.
Given the critical situation where touch-and-go danger of war is ever-escalating in the area along the southern border of the DPRK, the General Staff of the KPA proclaims that it will take a substantial military step to completely separate the territory of the DPRK, where its sovereignty is exercised, from the territory of the ROK (Republic of Korea).
To this end, a project will be launched first on October 9 to completely cut off roads and railways connected to the ROK and fortify the relevant areas of our side with strong defence structures.
For our army to permanently shut off and block the southern border with the ROK, the primary hostile state and invariable principal enemy, in the current situation is a self-defensive measure for inhibiting war and defending the security of the DPRK.
Our army sent a telephone message to the U.S. forces side at 09:45 of October 9, prompted by an intention to prevent any misjudgment and accidental conflict over the fortification project to be launched in the acute southern border area. -0-

headline: DPRK Academy of Defence Sciences Conducts Test-fire of 240 mm-caliber Controllable Multiple Rocket Launcher Shells
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The DPRK Academy of Defence Sciences conducted a test-fire of 240 mm-caliber controllable multiple rocket launcher shells under production at defence industrial enterprises under the Second Economy Commission on Oct. 8.
The test-fire aimed at reconfirming the hit accuracy of the controllable multiple rocket launcher shells at a maximum range of 67 km while checking the reliability of the automatic firing system.
The test-fire was watched by Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Revolutionary Site for Party Foundation
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- People in the DPRK are visiting the Revolutionary Site for Party Foundation at the foot of Mt Haebang on the occasion of the anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, with their strong will to glorify the eternal history of the great WPK with continued victory and glory.

headline: DPRK Academy of Defence Sciences Conducts Test-fire of 240 mm-caliber Controllable Multiple Rocket Launcher Shells
story_text:

headline: 11th Session of 14th SPA of DPRK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The 11th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall from October 7 to 8.
Present there were deputies to the SPA, and as observers officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Standing Committee of the SPA, the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, chairpersons of provincial, city and county people’s committees and other officials concerned in Pyongyang and local areas.
The platform was taken by senior officials of the Party, the government and the military including Kim Tok Hun, Choe Ryong Hae and Ri Pyong Chol who are Presidium members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, chairperson and vice chairpersons of the SPA, members of the State Affairs Commission and vice chairperson, secretary general and members of the Standing Committee of the SPA.
Deputy Pak In Chol, chairman of the SPA, made an opening address.
As the session was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played.
The 11th Session of the 14th SPA of the DPRK brought up the following agenda items for discussion:
First, on amending and supplementing some contents of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK
Second, on deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry
Third, on deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs
Fourth, on the state of supervision of the enforcement of the Law of the DPRK on Quality Control
Fifth, organizational matter
Deputy Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made a report on the first agenda item.
He said that the outstanding ideology of the WPK on national building and action programme for it to meet the requirements of the changing and developing revolution and the aspirations and interests of the people should be specified in time in order to make the Socialist Constitution fully discharge its mission as a powerful legal weapon for glorifying the new era of a great power, an era of our state-first principle.
He noted that the content of amending the ages of citizens of the DPRK for working and participating in election was reflected in the relevant agenda item was reflected in the relevant agenda item as the age of students graduating from senior middle schools changes from this year after the adoption of the Law of the SPA on Enforcement of the Universal 12-Year Compulsory Education System.
He said that the ages of citizens for working and participating in election were rectified and stipulated in the drafts on amending and supplementing the Socialist Constitution so that the right of the schoolchildren to learn to their heart's content under the benevolent care of the best socialist educational system and the right to devote their wisdom and passion to the prosperity of the country with a noble sense of the consciousness of civic duty are be guaranteed by law.
Saying that it is the firm will of the DPRK government to usher in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation by remaining loyal to the outstanding ideology and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, holding fast to the Socialist Constitution as a strong political weapon for building a powerful country, he proposed the relevant amended and supplemented plan to the current SPA for deliberation.
The session adopted with unanimous approval the Law of the SPA of the DPRK "On amending and supplementing some contents of the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK".
It discussed the drafts of the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry and the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs as following agenda items.
Deputy Kang Yun Sok, vice chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made a report on the second and third agenda items.
He said that the relevant draft laws reflected principled issues arising in providing a firm legal guarantee for the rapid development of light industry which plays an important role in improving the people's living standard and in expanding the external economic relations in a diverse way, and explained the relevant contents according to chapters.
The SPA Standing Committee submitted the drafts of the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry and the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs in accordance with Article 95 of the Socialist Constitution to the current SPA for deliberation.
Deputies Kim Myong Hun, Kim Chang Sok, Jo Yong Chol, Pak Kun Sok, Mun Yong Son, Yun Jong Ho, Sin Chang Il and Kim Hye Yong made speeches on the relevant agenda items at the session.
The speakers expressed full support, recognizing that the relevant drafts of the laws proposed for deliberation were worked out to be able to provide legal environment and conditions for the development of light industry directly related to the improvement of the people's living standard and contribute to the independent and sustainable development of the national economy by conducting external economic affairs on a wide scale.
The session held study and consultative meetings on the drafts of the sector-specific laws and adopted the laws of the SPA of the DPRK "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on Light Industry" and "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on External Economic Affairs" through deliberation and supplement of the constructive opinions of deputies.
At the discussion of the fourth agenda item, a report on the supervision of the enforcement of the Law on Quality Control was made to be followed by speeches of Deputies Jo Kyong Guk, Ri Song Bom, Rim Sun Hui, Ri Yong Chol and Kim Yun Sil.
The reporter and speakers said that the quality of products is the one of important criterions showing the level of economic and technical development and civilization of the country, referring to the successes made in the work for improving the quality of products in hearty response to the important tasks set forth at the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and to a series of shortcomings to be overcome surely.
They vowed to further intensify the quality control work and enhance the role of the supervision organs so as to make positive contributions to the national economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard, stressing that the observance of the law on quality control entirely is the defence of the people's demand and interests and thoroughgoing implementation.
Deputies raised views and measures to improve quality control as required by the reality.
A decision of the SPA of the DPRK "On Thoroughly Executing the Law of the DPRK on Quality Control" was adopted at the session.
The organizational matter as its fifth agenda item was discussed.
No Kwang Chol was appointed as minister of National Defence of the DPRK.
Ri Man Su was appointed as minister of State Construction Control.
Kim Song Bin was appointed as chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology.
Deputy Pang Tu Sop was by-elected as chairman of the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
Deputy Pak In Chol, chairman of the SPA, made a closing address.
The 11th Session of the 14th SPA successfully finished its work amid the high political consciousness and high enthusiasm of the participants to thoroughly guarantee the implementation of the state administration through their positive action and efforts for the prosperity of the great state and the promotion of the people's well-being, deeply aware of their responsibility as representatives of the people. -0-

headline: Love Shown by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for Victims of Flood-hit Areas
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Untook an important step to make the inhabitants and schoolchildren in the flood-hit areas come to Pyongyang to live and learn during the recovery from flood damage. Since then, he has shown meticulous care for them with paternal love.
Under the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea, those from the flood-hit areas have spent happy days, enjoying various cultural and emotional life such as sea bathing, visits, enjoying performances and touring scenic spots.

Looking various kinds of quality and smart new clothes, those inhabitants and schoolchildren were moved to tears by his warm loving care. -0-

headline: Report of KPA General Staff
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The General Staff of the Korean People's Army (KPA) issued the following report on Wednesday:
The hostile forces are getting ever more reckless in their confrontational hysteria, openly revealing their scheme to use armed forces in violation of the sovereignty of the DPRK. This pushes the grave security situation of the Korean peninsula to a more unpredictable phase.
Amid various war exercises for aggression being staged simultaneously in the region of the ROK every day near the southern border of the DPRK, strategic nuclear assets of the U.S. frequent the region and the war maniacs loudly talk about the "end of regime" in the DPRK so often. This proves the gravity of the situation that can never be overlooked.
The acute military situation prevailing on the Korean peninsula requires the armed forces of the DPRK to take a more resolute and stronger measure in order to more creditably defend the national security.
Given the critical situation where touch-and-go danger of war is ever-escalating in the area along the southern border of the DPRK, the General Staff of the KPA proclaims that it will take a substantial military step to completely separate the territory of the DPRK, where its sovereignty is exercised, from the territory of the ROK (Republic of Korea).
To this end, a project will be launched first on October 9 to completely cut off roads and railways connected to the ROK and fortify the relevant areas of our side with strong defence structures.
For our army to permanently shut off and block the southern border with the ROK, the primary hostile state and invariable principal enemy, in the current situation is a self-defensive measure for inhibiting war and defending the security of the DPRK.
Our army sent a telephone message to the U.S. forces side at 09:45 of October 9, prompted by an intention to prevent any misjudgment and accidental conflict over the fortification project to be launched in the acute southern border area. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Dmitri Anatoliyevich Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on Oct. 7.
In the message Medvedev extended sincere congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon the occasion of the founding anniversary of the WPK.
Under your leadership the DPRK is continuing to advance successfully along the road of strengthening its sovereignty and improving the well-being of the Korean people despite the sustained external pressure, the message said, adding:
Moscow and Pyongyang laid a solid foundation for multilateral cooperation within the framework of the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries.
I am convinced that the further promotion of the ties between the United Russia Party and the Workers' Party of Korea based on the agreement on exchange and cooperation, adopted on October 25, 2018, will facilitate the solution of a wide range of issues of mutual concern including the movement against modern neocolonialism.
Medvedev in the message wishedKim Jong Unand all members of the WPK good health and fresh successes. -0-

In the message Bashar Al-Assad extended congratulations toKim Jong Unon the occasion of the 79th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The WPK honorably defended the freedom and independence of the country by leading the Korean people, and has rallied all the people to lay the foundations of socialism and build a prosperous and powerful country, the message noted.
The Baath Arab Socialist Party and the WPK are adhering to the firm principles and ideals and struggling together to attain the noble goal that confirms not only to the interests of the peoples of Syria and the DPRK but also to the peace, security and prosperity of the whole world, it said, adding:

The message wishedKim Jong Ungood health and happiness, hoping that the WPK would always achieve success and prosperity and the DPRK would steadily develop. -0-
