headline: People Fully Armed with Class Consciousness Are Sure to Win: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun says in an article on Sunday that the decisive factor of a victory in the fierce class struggle against the hostile forces lies in our own strength, the ideological and mental strength of all the people fully armed with class consciousness.
Class consciousness is the life of the revolutionary people, and the victory of socialism precisely means the one of class principle, the article notes, and goes on:
The absolute prestige and reputation of an independent power shining in the present century while containing the hostile forces by dint of strong power are attributable to the strong class self-respect, fortitude and death-defying resistance will of the Korean people.
As the class will of the people to prove the validity and invincibility of Korean-style socialism with the irresistibility of collectivism remains unshakeable, Juche-oriented socialism will continue to emerge victorious, further expanding the absolute force capable of completely putting an end to the moves of the hostile forces.
Class self-respect means the spirit of achieving self-development by one's own efforts.
The might of self-reliance and self-development precisely means the might of science and technology.
The manifestation of the transparent class consciousness of all the people to frustrate the enemies' moves by dint of Juche-oriented science and technology means the growth of the Juche-oriented power.
The DPRK will emerge as a socialist power prospering with self-sustenance and self-respect in the near future, thanks to the indomitable efforts of all the people to make the might of self-development more invincible while looking down the enemy with high class self-respect. -0-

headline: Joint On-line Seminar Held by Brazilian Political Parties and Organizations on 79th Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- A joint on-line seminar titled "The Workers' Party of Korea shining with its 79-year long history" held by Brazilian political parties and organizations on Oct. 11 to mark the 79th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Present there were personages of political parties and organizations, members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in Brazil.
Speeches were made there.
A member of the National Political Committee of the Brazilian Communist Party said that the WPK has successfully played its role as the guiding force leading the independent and prosperous socialist construction to victory as it has been led by PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, and that under the leadership ofKim Jong Un, the WPK will always emerge victorious in the future, too.
The chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, the chairperson of the Brazilian Center for Peace and Solidarity with Peoples and the official representative of the Brazilian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association lauded the WPK founded by PresidentKim Il Sung, founder of the Juche idea and great revolutionary, as the iron-willed vanguard ranks successfully carrying forward the glorious revolutionary traditions.
Meanwhile, a joint celebration meeting of Venezuelan political parties took place on Oct. 9 on the occasion of the 79th founding anniversary of the WPK. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Xi Jinping
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on October 16.
The reply message says:
The respected Comrade General Secretary,
I express my heartfelt thanks to you for sending a message of greeting on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China.
For 75 years since the founding of the new China, the Communist Party of China has united and led the peoples of different nations throughout the country, performing two miracles of achieving rapid economic development and long-term social stability, and the great prosperity of the Chinese nation has entered an irreversible historical process.
The Chinese people will work tirelessly to push forward with the cause of building a powerful country and achieving national prosperity comprehensively through the modernization of the Chinese style, more firmly united behind the Party Central Committee.
I sincerely hope that the fraternal DPRK people will continue to achieve fresh successes by promoting the cause of socialist construction under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by you, Comrade General Secretary.
China and the DPRK are linked by the same mountain and rivers, and the traditional friendship between the two countries is growing stronger with the passage of time.
I am willing to make greater contributions, together with you, Comrade General Secretary, to leading the traditional China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations to sustainable and stable development, steadily promoting the well-being of the peoples of the two countries and safeguarding regional and global peace, stability, development and prosperity.
I wish you good health and success in your work.
I wish your country prosperity and your people happiness and well-being. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- DPRK Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui on October 19 made public the following press statement titled "The countries involved in imposing illegal and outrageous sanctions on the DPRK will have to pay a dear price":
Contrary to the recognized principles of international law with sovereignty equality and noninterference in internal affairs as their core, the U.S. and its vassal countries are working hard to revive the structure of sanctions and pressure on the DPRK, which went bankrupt structurally and is on the verge of collapse.
The "multilateral sanctions monitoring team," which allegedly acts on behalf of the panel of experts, a has-been involved in monitoring the implementation of the UN "sanctions resolutions" for more than 10 years, is utterly unlawful and illegitimate in terms of its justification for existence and purpose, and its existence itself constitutes a denial of the UN Charter.
I express serious concern and regret at the U.S. habitual misconduct of arbitrarily flouting the international order in pursuit of its hegemonic interests, and vehemently condemn and reject it as a challenge to international justice and the most undisguised violation of the DPRK's sovereignty.
The U.S.-led sanctions against the DPRK are by no means a new experience for us.
However, the unilateral behavior of the U.S., obsessed with the suicidal concept of pressure without sound thinking and sense of reality, and of some countries blindly following it has emerged as a threatening entity shaking the international relations to their foundations and seriously polluting the world security environment.
The emergence of another hostile threatening factor calls for ceaselessly adding new factors to the corresponding counteraction force for deterring it.
Wrong practice is bound to entail an inevitable reaction and corresponding punishment.
If the U.S. expected that it can surprise the DPRK and stop its advance with such worn-out means as sanctions and pressure, it is just a fatal misjudgment.
As clarified by the president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, the pain the U.S. has inflicted on our people has provoked a towering rage towards the U.S. and this has become a decisive factor and a strategic opportunity for redoubling our strength.
If the U.S. seeks to control the world by dint of high-handed and arbitrary practices, self-righteousness and prejudice, more countries will become interested in putting an end to the American-style hegemony and it will bring earlier the emergence of the anti-U.S. global solidarity structure.
The DPRK remains steadfast in its will to safeguard its sovereign rights, development and interests, regional and global peace and security to cope with the ever more undisguised sinister and hostile scheme of the U.S. and its satellite countries.
I take this opportunity to recall the criminal act of the ROK which violated the sovereignty and territory of the DPRK and caused the current mishap, and make it clear that the U.S. will be held accountable for it.
We will correctly remember the U.S. and the ROK, which have taken the lead in illegal and outrageous sanctions and pressure on the DPRK, and Japan, Canada, Britain, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Australia and New Zealand, which actively joined it, and record all their hostile acts.
The forces involved in the smear campaign against the DPRK will have to pay a dear price for it. -0-

headline: Struggle Staged in Puppet ROK to Demand Resignation of Yoon Group
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- A massive struggle is going on in the puppet ROK to demand the resignation of the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol group, which is escalating the danger of war through serious provocations against the DPRK and driving the population into the abyss of destruction through illegal prosecution-based fascist dictatorship and arbitrary practices.
On Oct. 19, an anti-war peace rally was held in Seoul under the sponsorship of such organizations as the headquarters of movement for the impeachment of the Yoon Suk Yeol regime and the people's action.
Speakers there denounced the Yoon group for resorting to military provocations through drone infiltration and leaflet-scattering operations, not content with ceaseless war drills. The group, driven into a tight corner due to its untold evil deeds and fascist dictatorship which fomented the war crisis and resulted in economic bankruptcy, people's destitution and disasters, is engrossed in war gambling with the lives of the people to get rid of its ruling crisis, and such action should never be allowed, they said.
On the same day, there took place the 111th candlelight rally and demonstration on the theme of "Down with Yoon-Kon Hui, the war tyrant and kingpin of injustices!"
The speakers at the candlelight rally charged that Yoon is instigating the military to provoke armed conflict in a bid to maintain his power and wielding the prosecution dictatorship to hush up the hideous scandals of his wife Kim Kon Hui and, in this way, driving the whole ROK into the crucible of war and the cesspool of corruption.
Meanwhile, the candlelight action made public a "bill on impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol" carrying the public demand.
In the rally, there was a ceremony of tearing down placards with the letters "trickster for war martial law" and the dirty looks of Yoon group and Kim Kon Hui.
Then a resolution on intensive candlelight demonstrations in October was read out.
At the end of the rally, its participants staged a demonstration, chanting slogans and holding large placards and posters with such letters reading "Down with Yoon-Kon Hui!"
The demonstrators with candlelight in their hands expressed their will to continue the struggle until puppet Yoon has been impeached. -0-

headline: Advanced Equipment Management System Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- The intelligence development institute underKim Il SungUniversity in the DPRK developed a system for monitoring machine conditions and diagnosing trouble, called "Jinungjindan" (intelligence diagnosis).
This advanced equipment management system helps monitor the state of machinery in real time and determine the time of maintenance by predicting the trouble. It also makes it possible to analyzes the monitoring data and give help to finding out the trouble and maintain the equipment according to its state, thus contributing to prolonging its life.
"Jinungjindan" 2.4 was selected as one of the ten top IT products in 2024. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Lauds Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as Outstanding Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- An era of comprehensive development of socialism being opened up on this land amid the vigorous struggle to create a world-class example of building an independent and powerful state is a brilliant fruition brought about by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, peerlessly great man and outstanding leader of the Juche revolution, Rodong Sinmun Monday says in an article, and goes on:
The era of comprehensive development of socialism is a heyday of the strengthened national power, in which development is simultaneously made in all fields, including politics, national defence, economy and culture, to demonstrate the dignity and prestige of a powerful country.
The great ComradeKim Jong Un's noble ideals and profound thinking are a fundamental source that brought an era of a true power.
He made a radical development in the politics and national defence, which is a great achievement for posterity. And he has continued this thinking to develop all sectors of socialist construction and all regions of the country simultaneously to the world level, while working his heart and soul to put ill-balanced national economy on a normal track and reduce the regional differences.
He has completely settled all problems arising in politics and economy, diplomacy, military affairs and all other fields and sectors. His revolutionary leadership is an offensive leadership of braving all sorts of hardships and a people-oriented leadership of giving full play to initiative, creativeness and activity of the masses.
The presentation of high goal and clear-cut orientation for fresh and development-oriented attainments, the great progress at once and the series of creation at the same time--they are main features of the revolutionary leadership of the General Secretary creating examples of the times in succession.
His extraordinary revolutionary leadership bringing about world-level successes by dint of strong wind of creation through a bold and big operation at a great leaping speed for uninterrupted innovation steers the steadfast trend of socialist development and the dynamic advance of the times.
His love and devotion is the most ardent love and self-sacrificing devotion.
Pains for the country and people mean the highest honor. This is the noble view cherished in his mind and herein lies all his joy, happiness, speculation and practice.
The General Secretary is the greatest man in the world as he is making a new great and glorious history of powerful socialist Korea with his undying feats, and the era of comprehensive development of socialism will be always brilliant with his great august name. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Construction Site for Recovery in Flood-hit Areas of Jagang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site for rehabilitating the flood-hit areas in Jagang Province on Oct. 21.
He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the C.C., WPK, and relevant cadres of the Party Central Committee.
He was greeted on the spot by Pak Hun, vice-premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the WPK, and commanding officers of the provincial regiments of Party members involved in the recovery project.
Builders of the regiments of Party members, who were dispatched to the rehabilitation areas in Jagang Province in order to implement the decision of the Party Central Committee on splendidly building dwelling houses as early as possible in the flood-hit areas of North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces that were severely destroyed by flooding in July, have completed the housing construction in the main by powerfully waging all-night construction struggle and are vigorously pushing ahead with the internal construction work at the final stage.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwent round the construction site for rehabilitation and learned in detail about the progress of housing construction.
He acknowledged the painstaking efforts of the builders and gave warm encouragement to them who are devoting their pure conscience and sincere efforts at the difficult and labor-consuming posts true to the call of the Party, fully displaying the spirit of devoted service for the people, extraordinary sense of responsibility and strong practical ability.
Expressing satisfaction over the fact that the flood-hit areas, reduced into ruin in an instant due to unexpected natural disaster, are undergoing a radical change without any sign of disaster, he highly appreciated the precious feats of the combatants of the regiments of Party members who are faithfully discharging their noble mission and duty as the members of the Workers' Party at the rehabilitation project site for the people in the flood-hit areas, far away from their dear houses and workplaces.
He called for working hard to bring earlier the happy moment of providing good houses for the flood victims who are waiting for the day of living in new villages and new houses even at this moment.
He referred to the fact that a series of deviations have been revealed in the design and construction of multi- and low-storied houses in the flood-hit areas, and analyzed their reasons. And he clarified the measures to be taken by the state in the future in overcoming the relevant matters arising in the rehabilitation and in launching a vigorous struggle for the overall regional construction.
Recalling that he has already stressed many times that architecture is an extension of politics as it is criterion showing the degree of the idea, national power and civilization in a visual way, and, therefore, even if a building is built, we should regard it as the one related with the self-respect, dignity and honor of our times, he said that some deviations underrating the structural quality have yet been revealed and they should be rectified.
Just like monumental edifices rising all over the country, the dwelling houses under construction for the flood victims, too, are precious assets of the state and the people that should be guaranteed forever, and therefore, it is necessary to overcome even the slightest shortcomings perfectly and direct greater efforts to ensuring perfection, he said, adding that a decision will be made to prolong the completion of the housing projects for the disaster areas, scheduled to be finished by early November, to early December.
He gave detailed instructions on taking practical measures to ensure that the inhabitants and schoolchildren of the flood-hit areas staying in Pyongyang could not feel inconvenience in their living, as regards the delay of the housing construction.
Noting that lots of houses for the flood victims are being built all at once in every flood-hit area of the country thanks to the heroic struggle of the Party members, youths and service personnel and to the support of all the people in the country, he said this gigantic work is not confined to the practical issue for housing construction but a crucial political issue of defending the character of our style socialist system based on the people-first principle and demonstrating its advantages. And he set forth the tasks for completing the project, calling on all the builders to further fully display their extraordinary patriotic enthusiasm and indomitable will so as to successfully complete the construction of houses and provide them to the flood victims with delight.
He stressed the need to further enhance the requirements and role of construction control organs.
He also gave detailed instructions on the important tasks such as the issue of ensuring timely and responsible transport and supply of materials without hindering the schedule of the project, the issue of properly greening the residential areas along with the housing construction and the issue of taking good care of the builders' living conditions.
That day the Secretariat of the WPK Central Committee decided to newly dispatch the chief and the political chief of the field headquarters for rehabilitating the flood-hit areas in Jagang Province.
Expressing expectation and belief that the Party members, youths and service personnel, whom the Party Central Committee dispatched to the difficult and arduous yet sacred and worthwhile struggle with deep trust, would remain faithful to their heavy mission to the end in the patriotic construction theaters for the country and the people, he ardently called for making redoubled efforts once again to build a splendid paradise for the people in the flood-hit areas without fail.
All the builders were filled with a firm determination to make the flames of loyalty and patriotism flare up more highly and vigorously struggle for the socialist country, responding with a firm pledge to the ardent call of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: WPK Praised Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- In congratulatory messages and letters on the occasion of the 79th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), foreign figures highly praised the WPK.
The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association said:
HEKim Jong Unhas laid the foundation for the development of the Party by setting forth the unique idea and theory on Party building in the new era.
He has thoroughly embodied the people-first political idea and the selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people in the Party building and activities, thus translating the people's dreams and ideals into reality.
Under the outstanding leadership of HEKim Jong Un, a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation is being ushered in and the DPRK is shedding its rays as a fortress of independence and justice.
The chairman of the Finland-Korea Society and the national leader of the Workers' Party of Mexico said that the DPRK could work unprecedented miracles and usher in a new era of self-respect and prosperity under the severe condition in which others might have collapse a hundred times. It was thanks to the experienced and seasoned leadership of the WPK which has always taken the initiative and turned misfortune and adversity into blessing and prosperity, they added.
The chairman of the Bangladesh Jatiya Party and the chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party said that the guiding force of the WPK which puts the dignity and national power of the DPRK on the highest level and confidently leads it toward a brighter future is the fundamental source of epochal changes and miracles.
The chairperson of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics and the chief of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism expressed belief that the future of the DPRK would be rosy as the great Party is leading its people to victory, firmly holding fast to the helm of the revolution.
The chairperson of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, general secretary of the Central Committee of the All-India Forward Bloc, the chairperson of the Motherland Party of Türkiye, the national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria, the national leader of the Communist Party of Canada (Marxist-Leninist) and other party leaders, too, expressed full support and solidarity to the cause of the WPK, highly praising the great personality of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a heyday of the Party building in the new era. -0-

headline: Mission of Service Workers
story_text:
One day in April 1967, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited a shop in Pyongyang.
Saying that he came to the shop as he heard that it renders good order services, he demanded the ordering book.
Reading out the list of goods ordered by a newly-married couple in the book, he asked a saleswoman if the shop had fully supplied the ordered goods.
Expressing satisfaction over her positive answer, he said that it was the spirit of service.
He looked carefully the book once again and asked the saleswoman again if she had been to the house of the newly-married couple.
Hearing her negative answer, he said with regrettable voice that she would not know whether the couple had a bookcase or not.
He said that it can not be said that the shop fully meets the demand of inhabitants even though it writes an ordering book and accepts orders from them. He warmly instructed that in order to sincerely promote the convenience of the inhabitants, it is necessary to visit their houses and commercial workers should become mothers responsible for the people's living.
The instructions given by him that day were precious teachings reminding the service workers responsible for the people's living of their mission once again. -0-

headline: Importance of Scientific Farming
story_text:
In the presence of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, a splendid banquet for labor innovators and persons of meritorious service, who took part in the celebrations of the 73rd birthday of the DPRK, was given in the garden of the headquarters building of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee on September 8, 2021.
On this significant day, agricultural officials and workers had the honor of meeting the General Secretary before others.
The General Secretary repeatedly stressed the importance of scientific farming, indicating in detail the tasks and ways for doing farming well.
Saying that agricultural production should be put on a scientific, IT and intensive basis by raising a strong wind of scientific farming, he added that the per-hectare yield of grain is increasing in recent years as compared with the past despite the unfavorable weather conditions in the country because the agricultural workers have conducted farming in a scientific way.
He stressed the need to disseminate advanced agricultural science and technology and new farming methods to the officials and working people in the agricultural field on a regular basis through the state computer network.
The agricultural officials and workers could hardly repress their excitement, looking up to him who is working heart and soul for the country's farming. -0-

headline: WPK Founding Anniversary Marked Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 23 (KCNA) -- Political parties and organizations and personages in different countries made public statements and articles to mark the 79th birthday of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The New Communist Party of Britain and the Korean Friendship Association UK in a joint statement stressed that the party-building cause of Juche pioneered and advanced by the great leaders ComradeKim Il Sungand ComradeKim Jong Ilis being creditably carried forward by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The general secretary of the Communist Party of DR Congo said in a statement that the DPRK could make an eye-opening development despite the worldwide political upheaval and unprecedented difficulties as the WPK has invariably uplifted the banner of socialism.
The chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea in their statements praised the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungfor Party founding and the glorious course of the ever-victorious WPK.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Loving Care for Orphans
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 23 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Baby Home and the Pyongyang Orphanage called palaces of children are situated on the picturesque Taedong River bank.
The baby home and the orphanage with all conditions and environment for nursing, education and living are the cradles of happiness for orphans, built under the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's noble loving care for posterity.
After initiating the construction of the baby home and the orphanage, the General Secretary chose their sites at the best place, guided their layouts and gave field guidance at the construction sites several times, indicating the orientation and ways for the construction.
One day in October 2014, he visited the completed baby home and the orphanage and said with satisfaction that there would be no such wonderful home for children in the world as them.
Saying that all the elements of the baby home and the orphanage are suitable for living environment and educational places, he gave precious instructions on enhancing the responsibility and role of the nursery school and kindergarten teachers, stressing that it is more important to bring up the children well than to build such establishments.
The song "We Are the Happiest in the World" is always heard at the baby home and orphanage built thanks to the paternal loving care of the General Secretary who spares nothing for the children. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Strategic Missile Bases
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 23 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected strategic missile bases.
He was accompanied by Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the C.C., WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unexamined the readiness for action of strategic deterrence directly connected with the security of the country, including the important functions and capabilities of launch-related facilities in the missile bases and the strategic missile combat duty.
He appreciated the services of the missile soldiers in the strategic missile bases for fulfilling the sacred duty they have assumed before the country and the people, being always on combat duty in a tight posture as required by the prevailing situation.
Noting that the strategic missile force is the core force playing a pivotal role in the DPRK's war deterrence, he stressed that it is an important principle of the strategy for building the national defence consistently maintained by the WPK to technically modernize overall armed forces by giving priority to the strategic missile force in the future, too.
As was stressed on several occasions recently, the U.S. strategic nuclear means pose ever-increasing threat to the security environment of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the long-term threats urgently demand that the DPRK more definitely bolster its war deterrence and take a thorough and strict counteraction posture of the nuclear forces, he said.
He stressed the need to further modernize and fortify the strategic missile bases and make all bases fully ready to keep thorough counteraction posture capable of promptly dealing a strategic counterblow to the enemies at any time in different circumstances. -0-

story_text:

Your assumption of heavy responsibility as the president of the state is an expression of the deep trust and expectation of the Communist Party of Vietnam and all the Vietnamese people.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I wish you success in your responsible work, expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties and two countries would develop in conformity with the common socialist cause and the interests of peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Symposium on Intangible Cultural Heritage Conservation Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- A symposium on the intangible cultural heritage conservation took place at the Sci-Tech Complex in the DPRK on October 23 to mark the tenth anniversary of the publication of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's immortal work "National Heritage Conservation Is a Patriotic Undertaking for Adding Brilliance to the History and Traditions of Our Nation".
Present there were officials, teachers, researchers and students in the field of national heritage conservation and relevant units and exemplary officials and working people in the work for protecting intangible cultural heritages.
Speeches were made by Hwang Kwang Il, director of the Bureau for the Protection of Cultural Heritage, Kang Pok Sil, a teacher ofKim Il SungUniversity, Mun Kyong Ho, manager of the Okryu Restaurant, Pak Ryong Un, dean of a faculty of Pyongyang University of Fine Arts, Ri Ae Ryong, a doctor of Mangyongdae District Hospital, Kyong Nam Chol, head of a department of Pyongyang Kim Won Gyun University of Music and Dance, etc.
Speakers said thatKim Jong Un, who is always paying deep attention to inheriting and developing the excellent culture and history of the Korean nation, has wisely led the work for protecting intangible cultural heritages.
They noted that the work for preserving and glorifying the soul of the nation in all social life has been conducted with vigor over the past decade.
The successes made in the work for protecting intangible cultural heritages are a precious fruition of the Workers' Party of Korea's correct policy for protecting national heritage, which regards it as an important affair of the revolution and construction to preserve and glorify the national character, they stressed. -0-

headline: Winter Wheat Cultivation Area Expands in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK has increased the area of winter wheat cultivation by 9 000 hectares more than last year, while sowing winter wheat seeds in the optimum season.
The province is pushing ahead with the work to bring about due fruition in the wheat farming next year by properly manuring and cultivating wheat given the increased area. -0-

headline: Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- The Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory in the DPRK is a model factory leading the development of the country's medical appliances industry.
The factory, which has put production and management on a high scientific and IT basis, is precious fruition of the warm loving care and devoted efforts made by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto make sure that the people lead a highly civilized life in good health under the socialist public health system.
Out of his intention to bring about a turn in the country's medical appliances industry and public health, the General Secretary visited the factory many times and set a high target to modernize the factory and took measures to implement it.
One day in October 2019, he visited the factory to learn about its modernization, saying that it was perfect in both architectural and technical aspects as its interior and exterior met the requirements of an icon factory in the medical field along with its excellent architectural style, clean environment of its surroundings and well-distributed space.
Watching the trial medical appliances produced by the factory, he said that it is necessary to design them well to suit the actual conditions of hospitals and constitutions of patients and steadily update them in an innovative way so as to develop and produce high-performance quality medical appliances.
Under his guidance, the factory, built as a model of the country's medical appliances industry, has developed tens of kinds of modern medical appliances and remarkably increased the production capacity.
The factory has sent medical appliances to provincial, city and county-level curative and preventive organs and hospitals in mountainous counties.
Recently, it sent hundreds of medical equipment and appliances, including high-performance combined dental treatment machines, to curative and preventive organs. -0-

headline: National Heritage Conservation Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unmade public the famous work "National Heritage Conservation Is a Patriotic Undertaking for Adding Brilliance to the History and Traditions of Our Nation" on October 24, 2014.
In the work he clarified the firm will of the Workers' Party of Korea to glorify the DPRK as a world-class advanced civilized nation with a long history and brilliant culture and a prosperous power, true to the noble intention of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho correctly formulated the 5 000-year-long history of the nation and demonstrated the superiority of the Korean nation to the world.
He also indicated the importance of the work for protecting national heritage and the tasks and ways for doing this work well.
Thanks to the immortal guidelines, the work for protecting national heritage in the DPRK has been conducted as a nationwide and all-people campaign and many successes made in the course of this work.
Many objects, including the custom of making kimchi, the Yangdok hot spring culture and the Kyongsong ceramic technology were newly registered as part of world, national and local intangible cultural heritage, and natural monuments, adding to cultural heritage of the Korean nation.
The Rangnang Museum was built to intensively show the excellent history and brilliant culture of the Korean nation and relics worthy of national treasure were unearthed in different parts of the country.
A geographical information system program for national heritage dealing with photos, maps and explanations of historical relics was developed and an e-book on scenic spots and natural monuments, natural heritage of the country, was completed and activities were conducted to put the national heritage conservation on a scientific basis.
Meanwhile, the work for restoring tangible heritage and natural heritage damaged by natural factors was pushed ahead with in different parts of the country. -0-

headline: G7 Is Developing into Global War Contractor Group: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 25 (KCNA) -- G7 that has come under worldwide criticism recently held a meeting of defense ministers in Napoli of Italy for the first time in its history.
At the recent confab attended by the defense ministers of G7 and even representatives of the European Union and NATO under the manipulation of the U.S., they made public a "joint statement" inciting the inter-camp confrontation, while making reckless remarks that the "framework of international security has been plunged into graver danger" by such independent and sovereign states as the DPRK, Russia and China.
G7, formed as a group for the interests of a few countries to facilitate the "economic buildup" of the West in the 1970s, held a meeting of defense ministers, the first of its kind, which is unfit for its "mission and duty".
The "moneymaking group", which is not entitled to represent the international community and "supervise or control" the sovereign states in terms of its structure, impudently dealt with global security. This shows that G7 has turned definitely into a "club of war", not a "club of economy".
It is a vivid manifestation of the double standards, a wanton challenge to international peace and an open declaration of new Cold War in the world that they justify the expansion of their defense industry and term sovereign states' exercise of legitimate rights "threats", while talking about "incompatibility-brought confrontation".
Today G7 has become the primary political servant for ensuring the U.S. hegemony.
G7's grave moves to further foster and expand the war of aggression under the pompous signboard of "international security and prosperity" are getting ever more undisguised in the Korean peninsula.
G7's interference in the Korean peninsula issue actually means the military expansion of NATO, the global war alliance.
NATO has invited the puppet ROK to its summit since 2022 and its secretary general was recently closeted with puppet Yoon Suk Yeol to discuss the intensified "cooperation system" against the DPRK.
Meanwhile, Western countries, NATO member states and member states of G7, which account for the backbone of the U.S.-led “UN Command”, are directly involved in the war drills for aggression against the DPRK.
Western countries are working hard to make the flames of war in Europe spill over into Asia, claiming "Asia and Europe are inseparable in terms of security". This grave reality seriously teaches that G7 has rapidly developed into a global "war contractor group".
The U.S. is now scheming to establish an axis of war serving its strategy for hegemony by rallying all its servants, including G7, in which war criminal states that inflicted huge damage on mankind in the last century hold a majority, and NATO, the worst-ever group seeking military confrontation.
G7 is committing an act of robbing others in broad daylight without shame and getting increasingly vocal in condemning someone's measures for bolstering up self-defensive capabilities. It had better look at its despicable image reflected in the eyes of the international community before pointing an accusing finger at others.
The more desperately G7, which is no more than a "shadow" of the U.S., slanders the DPRK's policy of the state nuclear force, bereft of reason, the more clearly it will betray its criminal colors as a harasser of peace, confrontation maniac and war merchant.
Explicitly speaking again, those who seek to deprive the DPRK of its inviolable right will have to pay a high price for it. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a wreath to the Friendship Tower on Oct. 25 on the occasion of the 74th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front.
Written on the ribbon of the wreath sent by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwere letters reading "We will remember the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers forever".
Upon authorization, Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, laid the wreath before the tower. -0-

headline: Devoted Efforts for Country's Agricultural Development
New Houses Built in Sinphyong County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- A praiseworthy entity of creating rural civilization in the new era has appeared at the Sonam Farm in Sinphyong County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The low-and single-storied houses of various forms designed in line with the characteristic of the mountainous region are the agricultural workers' home of happiness.
Attending the ceremony for moving into new houses were Kim Sok Jun, secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs and agricultural workers in Sinphyong County.
Kim Son Il, chairman of the North Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory address.
The farmers who received licenses for using houses expressed their thanks to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a fresh phase of the socialist rural development with his tireless guidance.
Amid the festive mood, officials visited the farmers' families to congratulate them upon moving into the new houses. -0-

headline: Press Statement of External Policy Office Chief of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Saturday released the following press statement titled "The U.S. will be held wholly responsible for pushing the situation on the Korean peninsula to an uncontrollable one":
Amid the extreme tension prolonging on the Korean peninsula due to the recent crucial provocation of the ROK against the DPRK, the U.S. more openly reveals its military confrontational attempt against the DPRK.
From October 21, the U.S., together with the ROK military warmongers, has staged a large-scale joint air drill Freedom Flag by drawing the Australian Air Force into the Korean peninsula. And it has resorted to extreme confrontation hysteria, openly claiming that the purpose of the drill is aimed at the DPRK.
The U.S. and the ROK are trumpeting that they would master the compound operation capability by mobilizing fighters and drones for the first time and conduct exercises for increasing the survivability in airborne infiltration into an enemy's position through the large-scale joint air drill which integrates the annual combined joint formation drill and a joint air drill Vigilant Defense.
The military drill of the U.S. and the ROK, which shows the offensive and aggressive nature more vividly in its scale, content and character, is a very dangerous military provocation aimed at preemptive and surprise strike at the DPRK.
The U.S. is staging "joint air re-supply drill" and "joint river-crossing drill" with the ROK and a large-scale marine corps' joint military drill Keen Sword with Japan. At the same time, it is further escalating the military tension while dispatching the super-large nuclear carrier George Washington task force around the Korean peninsula.
We strongly denounce the U.S. hostile act of resorting to reckless military demonstration with its allies, not content with the present political and military tension on the Korean peninsula which is exposed to the danger of a touch-and-go explosion, as a clear threat and a grave provocation to the security of the region.
The U.S. can never cover up its criminal nature of driving the situation on the Korean peninsula into an uncontrollable one with any rhetoric.
It is a fact known to the world that the ROK committed illegal and grave provocation of openly infiltrating military attack means into the sky above a sovereign state under the shelter of "military cooperation" with someone.
The DPRK keeps in sight the dark shadow of the U.S. which is hidden behind the fearless provocative acts of the ROK.
The U.S. has patronized the ROK's scattering of political motivational rubbish over the territory of the DPRK as the so-called "freedom of expression" and instigated the bellicose hysteria of its ally with frequent deployment of strategic assets and ceaseless joint military drills. The U.S. confrontation history will be exactly recorded and calculated.
If a situation that no one wishes is created on the Korean peninsula, the U.S., the arch criminal and mastermind escalating the tension in the region, will be held wholly responsible for it. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Hyesan City of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- New houses have appeared at the Kanggu Vegetable Farm in Hyesan City, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK.
The modern houses, built in harmony with the surrounding environment, are a striking demonstration of the validity and vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's rural construction policy on turning all rural villages across the country into rich and cultured ideal socialist villages in the near future.
Present at the ceremony for moving into those houses were Ri Song Il, secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials of the Party and power organs and agricultural workers in Hyesan City.
Kim Chol Nam, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory address. Then the licenses for the use of houses were conveyed to agricultural workers and speeches made. -0-

DPRK Ambassador Presents Credentials to President of Equatorial Guinea
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- The DPRK ambassador presented his credentials to the president of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea on October 24.
Ambassador Ri Jae Son courteously conveyed the warm greetings ofKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to President Obiang Nguema Mbasogo.
The president expressed deep thanks for this and asked the ambassador to convey his best wishes to HEKim Jong Un.

headline: DPRK Men's Football Team Qualified for 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- The qualifying matches for the 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup are being held divided into ten groups.
The DPRK team belongs to group A and the matches of the group A are taking place in Jordan.
The DPRK team beat the Chinese Hong Kong team 8:2, Syrian team 2:1 and Iranian team 4:1 and played the last match with the Jordanian team on October 25. It beat its rival 3:0 in the match.
The DPRK team obtained 12 points in the total score and took the first place in the group to win the qualification for the 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup. -0-

headline: Spokesman for DPRK Ministry of National Defence Makes Public Final Results of Investigation into Case of Grave Infringement upon Sovereignty by Drone from ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK released Sunday the final results of investigation into the case of infringement upon its sovereignty which confirmed the take-off point and route and purpose of intrusion by the drone from the ROK found in the area of the DPRK capital city.
According to the spokesman, under the instruction of the DPRK government on scientifically and thoroughly proving the truth behind the case of the grave infringement upon the country's sovereignty by a drone, a military means recognized by the world, the joint investigation group involving the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of State Security and other relevant specialized organs completely dismantled the flight control module from the remains of a crashed enemy drone and analyzed the flight plan and flight log in a comprehensive way.
The results of analysis of the flight control program of the enemy drone conducted by the joint investigation group indefensibly and clearly proved the most vulgar and shameless provocative nature of the ROK military gangsters who have persistently evaded the responsibility for the illegal intrusion by their drone into the sky above the capital city of the DPRK.
The collected evidence data include 238 flight plans and flight logs worked out between June 5, 2023 and October 8, 2024, and the remaining data except the data of October 8 are the data of flight in the territory of the ROK.
According to the analysis of the flight control program, a plan for scattering political motivational rubbish is to be worked out when the flight plan is drawn out, and when the drone reaches the position reflected in the scattering plan, the flight control module is to send an electrical signal to the scattering means.
The flight data number of the enemy drone crashed after intruding into the DPRK on October 8 was analyzed.
The plan for scattering political motivational rubbish and the scattering log were recorded correctly in the enemy drone.
It was proved that the drone of the ROK military gangsters which took off at Paekryong Island at 23:25:30 on Oct. 8 and intruded into the territorial air of the DPRK flied over Jangyon County of South Hwanghae Province and the waters around the Cho Islet till the waters around Namjoap Islet, and then over Chollima District, Nampho Municipality and intruded into the capital city of the DPRK.
The enemy drone scattered the political motivational rubbish in the sky above the area between the building of the DPRK Foreign Ministry and Sungri Station of the Pyongyang Metro at 1:32:8 on Oct. 9 and in the sky above the building of the Ministry of National Defence at 1:35:11.
The confirmed objective and scientific evidence data expose that the intrusion by the drone is aimed at scattering the anti-DPRK political motivational rubbish and that the principal of the hostile infringement upon the DPRK sovereignty is none other than the puppet ROK military gangsters.
The spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence stressed once again that the last warning to the dangerous and reckless, political and military provocation by the ROK military gangsters which went beyond the limit of patience has already been made.
In the case of infringement upon the sovereignty of the DPRK reoccurs due to the blind trust in the master, seizing the ROK, the most vulgar and malignant rogue state, and its extremely bad habit of challenge, the source of all misfortunes and provocations will disappear forever by the merciless offensive of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on Sunday:
An unidentified drone appeared in the sky above Seoul and leaflets criticizing puppet Yoon were scattered.
The military, individual organization or any individual of the DPRK did not let fly a drone. We can not confirm it and it is worthless to give answer to it.

Under such situation, I'd like to see once how the dirty curs in Seoul bark.
The world may also be curious about it. -0-

headline: Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest Brisk in DPRK
112th Candlelight Rally and Demo in Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- A massive struggle is being intensified in the puppet ROK to impeach the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol regime getting hell-bent on the anti-DPRK war moves, pursuant to the U.S. policy for hegemony.
The 112th candlelight rally and demonstration were staged in Seoul on Oct. 26.
The broad masses took part in the rally and demonstration. They gave vent to towering anger and curse at puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, the war maniac and fascist dictator, chanting such slogans as "Down with the war-seeking regime" and "Expel  Yoon Suk Yeol on the strength of population".
They charged that Yoon has turned the ROK into a scapegoat and a war theatre for outsiders, ceaselessly staging war drills with the U.S. and Japan and other forces.
The longer Yoon stays in power, the more critical the life of the population will be, they said, stressing that Yoon, the war maniac, should be impeached at once for peace.
At the candlelight rally, an appeal was read out to call on the people from all walks of life to join in the struggle for the impeachment of Yoon-Kon Hui who have ignored and maltreated the population and pursued only war and confrontation to maintain the power.
On the same day, there was a meeting of voters for impeaching puppet Yoon in North Jolla Province. Its participants warned that it is the will of the people to impeach Yoon and if lawmakers turn down this public mindset, they will become a target of punishment. And they stressed that Yoon should be ousted from power without fail on the strength of the population.
Meanwhile, various organizations and puppet political parties issued protest statements and commentaries all at once over the fact that the puppet Yoon group, upset by the ever-mounting public mindset on impeachment, is getting frantic with the wholesale suppression of media.
Media and many organizations in the puppet ROK said that such suppression is an expression of the last-ditch efforts of the fascist regime driven into the crisis of ruin, adding that the Yoon's impeachment is the trend of the times and the candlelight for impeachment will get fiercer and the population will surely impeach Yoon within this year. -0-

headline: Invincible Is Sacred Revolutionary Cause of WPK: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:

The WPK is the powerful general staff of the revolution which confidently leads the Korean revolution and socialist construction to rapid development and comprehensive upsurge with the philosophy of trust, the article says, and goes on:

The WPK is victoriously advancing the revolution and construction, regarding trust as the weapon of realizing the politics as it serves as the fundamental factor in firmly uniting the popular masses, the masters directly responsible for accomplishing the revolutionary cause, with one intention and will.
Today the WPK is developing the noble relations of trust, respect, devotion and obligation between the leader and the masses into the eternal national custom of the DPRK, adding heroic epics startling the world people to the new history of the Juche revolution.
The ardent love and trust shown by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto the beloved people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army during his visit to different parts of the country were the source of matchless heroism and collective innovations at worksites and posts.
The WPK is a powerful political leadership organization which adorns a new era of the Juche revolution with victories and miracles by dint of the philosophy of trust.
The fighting programme and practical strategies clarified by the WPK at the Party Congress and other major meetings are all consistent with the validity of its cause and its trust in the future.

Nothing can block the dynamic advance of the DPRK as it is led by the WPK which is proving the validity of the revolutionary cause through an indomitable struggle, defending the eternal vitality of socialism, the ideal and future of mankind, and dynamically advancing its steady development.
Our revolutionary cause is sure to win thanks to the WPK's philosophy of trust. -0-

headline:
Standard of Modernization Taught by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2024.10.29.]
story_text:
One day in July 2016, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a factory and looked round its combined control room.
Seeing the general interface of the integrated production system on a large display board, he said with pleasure that it is wonderful and that the integrated production system has developed a lot.
An official explained a measuring device to him, saying that all of operators want it to be installed at their machines first.
Listening to the official, the General Secretary expressed his great satisfaction and said it is truly successful modernization when the workers have appreciated after operating equipment.
The official was given a great shock as he had regarded modernization as a technical undertaking for further developing production lines or machinery and equipment, without clear standards.
Looking at the official, the General Secretary stressed that the order of objects to be updated should be set as demanded by the workers.
The official came to realize once again that the people's demands and interests are the absolute standard of all work. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Benevolence for Workers
story_text:
PresidentKim Il Sunghosted a banquet for exemplary workers on May 1, 1947.
Acknowledging the cheering workers at the banquet hall, he congratulated them on their labour successes.
He shook hands with them one by one in praise of their exploits. Then he recognized a pitman among them.
Shaking hands with him, he told the audience that the pitman fulfilled his yearly plan for national economy ahead of schedule. Asking the audience to drink the first toast to good health and happiness of all coal miners, the backbone of national economy, he offered a cup to the pitman.
At that time the pitman told the President that the first toast would be made to good health of the President who liberated the nation and built a people-oriented country. Gently declining the offer, the President said that he was the host of the banquet and they were the guests so the first toast was for the workers.
All the participants were moved to tears by his warm benevolence. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Musical Instrument Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Musical Instrument Factory is the mother factory of the musical instrument industry of the DPRK, which contributes to the development of the Juche-oriented musical art and the cultural life of the people.
The factory, which was born into the country's first musical instrument manufacturing base, left a clear mark in the development of the country's musical instrument industry under the care of the peerlessly great men.
With a far-reaching plan to build the base for producing musical instruments after the war, PresidentKim Il Sungfounded the State Musical Instrument Manufacturing Research Institute, the predecessor of the factory, in October 1953 and solved the problems arising in the production of musical instruments.
The factory made the first test goods of the accordion in October 1955 and piano No. 1 in July 1961.
In October 1962, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the factory and said that the production of musical instruments is an art, adding that only when we develop national instruments can the socialist national culture and art be brought into fuller bloom and Juche be established in the field of producing musical instruments.
True to his instructions, the officials, technicians and workers of the factory carried out the task of finding out national musical instruments and of improving 50 kinds of national musical instruments including kayagum, Janggo and Jangsaenap, thus contributing to the development of the national musical art of the country.
Under his guidance the factory successfully manufactured an accordion "Unbangul" and developed and completed the bayan and other instruments in Korean style.
Under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Untaking all necessary steps for production, the factory is now taking the lead in the drive to produce musical instruments. -0-

headline: 2024 DPRK-Russia IT Products Exhibition Opens

Presented to the exhibition, held under the theme of "IT and digital development and cooperation", are high-tech IT products and scientific and technological achievements developed by educational and scientific research units and enterprises of the DPRK and the Russian Federation.

The speakers noted that the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations are developing into a high stage of comprehensive strategic partnership under the energetic guidance of the top leaders of the two countries, adding that the exhibition will contribute to strengthening exchange and cooperation in the field of science and technology including IT promoting the economic development and civilization.

Then followed a closing ceremony of the DPRK Championships and the 2024 Inter-Provincial Mass Sports Contest.
In the DPRK Championships, men and women players of the April 25 Sports Team took the first place in the basketball event and men players of the Kigwancha Sports Team and women players of the April 25 Sports Team in the volleyball event respectively. And 25 new national records were set in the track-and-field, weightlifting, swimming and shooting events.
Pyongyang Municipality came first in total standings of the inter-provincial mass sports contest.
The standings of the championships and the contest as well as the list of players who set new national records in the championships were announced. And trophies, rotating trophy cups and new record medals were awarded to the successful organizations and players.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline:
Test-fire of DPRK's Latest-type ICBM Hwasongpho-19 Successfully Conducted under Guidance of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un

[2024.11.01.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- The cause of the DPRK reliably defending the regional and global peace and security as a responsible nuclear weapons state and achieving the comprehensive rejuvenation of the country and promoting the well-being of its people is accompanied with vicious challenges of the most hostile and threatening rival states and an ever-growing war crisis.
The most hostile enemies of the DPRK have evolved into a nuclear alliance and the U.S. imperialists and the ROK puppets have recently intensified the frantic arms buildup and provocative attempts at the most serious level in history while often letting loose reckless threatening remarks against the DPRK government. All these are posing a grave danger to the DPRK's sovereignty and security environment and provoking the surging anger and retaliatory will of its army and people.
The present grave reality, seriously reminding people of the instructive law of history that the disrupted balance of forces between friend and foe just leads to a war, more clearly emphasizes the necessity of the absolute power capable of deterring the enemy and controlling the situation at all times and the validity of its steady increase. It also calls for continuously developing and updating the strategic weapons as a deterrent capable of actively coping with any military threat and foiling the enemy's provocative attempt and will for war in advance.
At a time when the strategic option for reliably defending national security and regional peace from the adventurous military manoeuvres of the U.S. and its vassal forces for aggression and the urgency of its powerful implementation are being further highlighted, another new entity has emerged to demonstrate the absolute edge of the DPRK nuclear combat forces rapidly developing with each passing day.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, issued an order to the Missile Administration to conduct a test-fire of the latest-type ICBM Hwasongpho-19 and oversaw on the spot the crucial test, which would set an epochal milestone in perpetuating the absolute superiority of the strategic armed forces of the DPRK, on the morning of October 31.
The tremendously powerful absolute weapon, a product of the DPRK's might and spirit which have been steadily augmented for the great dignity and honour of the country and people, for the duty of defending peace and the right to existence that should never be conceded, and for a new world of justice where war, hegemony and injustice are not allowed, advanced to the launching position at dawn, showing signs of new strength the world has never experienced.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, assuming the noblest and heavy mission of firmly safeguarding the sovereignty of the DPRK and its absolute security and rights to development, went to the launch site to learn about the preparations and plan for the test-fire and went to the central command and observation post.
The launch site, prior to the historic moment when the DPRK's new updated ultra-powerful offensive means, an ICBM of ultimate version, would reveal its appearance, was seething with the will of all the defence scientists and strategic missile soldiers to strike terror into the most ferocious enemies keen on nuclear confrontation with the DPRK by demonstrating its war deterrent which has reached the highest level in the world.
The moment has come to display the awesome force of the world's most powerful strategic missile.
WhenKim Jong Unapproved the test-fire, General Jang Chang Ha, director general of the Missile Administration, gave an order to the Honoured 2nd Red Flag Company.
The moment, the entity with absolute power lifted off revealing its imposing figure, loaded with the DPRK people's bitter enmity and strong will to punish all evils and injustice on earth and annihilate the enemy.
The missile travelled up to the maximum altitude of 7 687.5km and flew a distance of 1 001.2km for 5 156 seconds before landing on the preset target area in the open waters of the East Sea of Korea.
The test-fire had no negative effect on the security of neighbouring countries.
The test of the ultramodern strategic weapon system updated the latest records of strategic missile capabilities and showed off the modernity and creditability of the world's most powerful strategic deterrent of the DPRK.
On the spot,Kim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction, saying that the successful test-fire of the new-type ICBM has come to prove before the world that the dominant position the DPRK has secured in the development and manufacture of nuclear delivery means of the same kind is absolutely irreversible.
The perfected weapon system of ICBM Hwasongpho-19, to be used by the strategic forces of the DPRK along with Hwasongpho-18, pursuant to the long-term plan for building the state nuclear forces set forth by the Party Congress, will perform the mission and duty as the primary core means in defending the DPRK, thoroughly deterring the enemies' acts of aggression and reliably protecting national security.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the test-fire is an appropriate military action that fully meets the purpose of declaring the DPRK’s counteraction will to the rivals who have recently escalated the regional situation deliberately and posed a threat to its security, and also constitutes an indispensable process in the course of constantly developing its strategic strike forces.
He went on to say:
As we have witnessed these days, the rivals' dangerous moves to strengthen their nuclear alliance and various adventurist military activities further highlight the importance of the buildup of our nuclear forces. We should never allow any threat to approach the sphere of influence of our national security.
The security situation of our state and the ever-growing prospective threats and challenges require us to continue to bolster up our modern strategic strike forces and more perfectly round off our nuclear response posture.
He clearly reaffirmed that the DPRK would never change its line of bolstering up its nuclear forces under any circumstances.
On behalf of the Party, the government and all the Korean people, he gave the highest thanks to the defence scientists and the munitions workers for their distinguished contribution to fully demonstrating the DPRK's matchless strategic nuclear strike capability to the whole world.
He once again stressed that only the peace that can be defended by the strength great enough to control and deter the enemy is the reliable, secure and durable peace and herein lies a sure guarantee for the peace and future of the DPRK and its people. And he clarified important tasks to be constantly tackled by the defence science field in implementing the line of bolstering up the state nuclear forces.
Expressing expectation and belief that the defence science and technology group, always faithful and absolute in fulfilling the demand of the revolution, would achieve better defence development successes and thus always remain faithful to the sacred obligation and duty, he had a photo session with the masters of this great event at the historic site where the absolute prestige of the state was lifted once again.
All the defence scientists and strategic missile soldiers vowed to devote themselves with redoubled courage to the sacred struggle for building up the arsenal of the Juche revolution into an invincible one and strengthening the state's nuclear response posture. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Marks Its 79th Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Friday dedicates an editorial to its 79th founding anniversary.
The founding of the organ of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea provided a powerful weapon leading the modeling of the whole society on the monolithic idea and made it possible to victoriously advance the revolution with the power of pen, the editorial notes, and goes on:

headline: DPRK-Russia IT Products Exhibition-2024 Closes
story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline:
Test-fire of DPRK's Latest ICBM Hwasongpho-19 Successfully Conducted under Guidance of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un

[2024.11.01.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- The cause of the DPRK reliably defending the regional and global peace and security as a responsible nuclear weapons state and achieving the comprehensive national prosperity and promoting the well-being of its people is faced with vicious challenges and ever-escalating war crisis by the most hostile and threatening rival states.
The most hostile enemies of the DPRK have developed into a nuclear alliance and the U.S. imperialists and the ROK puppet forces have recently intensified the frantic arms buildup and provocations largest-ever in history while often letting loose threatening reckless remarks against the DPRK government. All these are posing a grave danger to the DPRK's sovereignty and security environment and sparking off the surging anger and retaliatory will of its army and people.
The present grave reality, seriously reminding of the instructive law of history that the destructed balance of forces between friend and foe means a war, more clearly emphasizes the necessity of the overwhelming force capable of containing the enemy and controlling the situation at all times and the validity of its steady improvement. It also calls for continuously developing and updating the strategic weapons as deterrent capable of actively coping with any military threat and foiling the enemy's provocative attempt and will for war in advance.
At a time when the strategic option for reliably defending the national security and regional peace from the adventurous military moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces for aggression and the urgency of its powerful implementation are being further highlighted, a new entity has emerged again to demonstrate the absolute might of the DPRK nuclear combat forces rapidly developing day by day.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, issued an order to the Missile Administration to conduct a test-fire of the latest ICBM Hwasongpho-19 and guided on the spot the crucial test, which would set an epochal milestone in perpetuating the absolute superiority of the strategic armed forces of the DPRK, in the morning of October 31.
The absolute weaponry strongest in the world, a result of the DPRK's might and spirit that have been steadily augmented for the great dignity and honor of the country and people, for the duty of defending peace and the right to existence that should never be conceded, and for a new world of justice where war, hegemony and injustice are not allowed, advanced into its launching position, giving birth to the new strength the world has not yet experienced.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, with his noblest and heavy mission to firmly defend the sovereignty of the DPRK and its absolute security and rights to development, personally went to the launching site to learn about the preparations and plan for the test-fire and took the central command post.
The venue waiting a historic moment when the DPRK's newly-updated ultra-powerful offensive means, an ICBM of ultimate version, would show its appearance, was seething with the will of all defence scientists and strategic missile soldiers to strike terror into the most ferocious rivals keen on nuclear confrontation with the DPRK by demonstrating its war deterrent which has reached the highest level in the world.
The moment has come to display the tremendous power of the world's strongest strategic missile.
WhenKim Jong Unapproved the test-fire, General Jang Chang Ha, director general of the Missile Administration, gave an order to the honored Second Red Flag Company.
The moment, the entity of absolute power loaded with the DPRK people's soaring enmity and strong will to punish all evils and injustice on earth was launched toward the sky.
The missile traveled up to a maximum altitude of 7,687.5 km and flew a distance of 1,001.2 km for 5,156 s before landing on the preset area in the open waters off the East Sea of Korea.
The test-fire had no negative effect on the security of neighboring countries.
The test of the latest strategic weapon system updated the recent records of the strategic missile capability of the DPRK and demonstrated the modernity and creditability of its world's most powerful strategic deterrent.
On the launching spot,Kim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction at the fact that the successful test-fire of the new-type ICBM proved before the world that the hegemonic position we have secured in the development and manufacture of nuclear delivery means of the same kind is absolutely irreversible.
The perfected weapon system of ICBM Hwasongpho-19, to be used by the strategic forces of the DPRK along with Hwasongpho-18, pursuant to the long-term plan for building the state nuclear forces set forth by the Party Congress, will perform the mission and duty as the primary core means in defending the DPRK, thoroughly containing the enemies' acts of aggression and reliably protecting the national security.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the test-fire is an appropriate military action that fully meets the purpose of informing the rivals, who have intentionally escalated the regional situation and posed a threat to the security of our Republic recently, of our counteraction will, and it also constitutes an indispensable process in the course of constantly developing our state's strategic attack forces.
He went on to say:
As recently witnessed by us, the rivals' dangerous tightening of their nuclear alliance and various adventuristic military maneuvers go to further highlight the importance of strengthening our nuclear forces. We should never allow any threat to approach the security sphere under our state's influence.
The security situation of our state and ever-aggravating prospective threats and challenges require us to continue to bolster up our modern strategic attack forces and more perfectly round off our nuclear forces' response posture.
And he clearly reaffirmed that the DPRK would never change its line of bolstering up its nuclear forces.
On behalf of the Party and the government and all the Korean people, he gave the highest thanks to the defence scientists and the workers in the field of munitions industry for their distinguished contribution to demonstrating the DPRK's matchless strategic nuclear attack capability before the whole world.
He once again stressed that only peace, to be defended by the powerful force capable of controlling and deterring the enemy, is reliable and safe and durable and herein lies a sure guarantee for the security and future of the state and people of the DPRK. And he clarified the important tasks to be constantly carried out by the field of national defence science in implementing the line of bolstering up the state nuclear forces.
Expressing expectation and belief that the national defence science and technology group, always faithful and absolute to implementing the requirements of the revolution, would achieve the better defence development successes and thus always remain faithful to its sacred responsibility and duty, he had a photo session with the masters of this great event at the historic site where the absolute prestige of the state was lifted once again.
All the defence scientists and strategic missile soldiers vowed to devote themselves with redoubled courage to the sacred struggle for further bolstering up the arsenal of the Juche revolution and strengthening the state's nuclear response posture. -0-
