headline: Press Statement on Strategic Dialogue between DPRK and Russian FMs Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A press statement on strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, was issued on November 1.
The press statement says:
The relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation are growing stronger at a new strategic level in the spirit of the DPRK-Russia treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit in June 2024. Against this backdrop, a strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, took place in Moscow on November 1.
Prior to the strategic dialogue, the two foreign ministers attended a ceremony held at Yaroslavl Railway Station to unveil the tablet to honor the first visit of ComradeKim Il Sung, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, to the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in March 1949.
At the strategic dialogue, there was an in-depth exchange of views on the practical issues for development of the bilateral relations, with the emphasis on implementing the agreements reached at the DPRK-Russia summit meeting during the DPRK visit of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, in June.
Both sides reaffirmed their firm will to correctly implement the provisions of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership which put the traditional DPRK-Russia friendly relations on a new quality level.
The exchange of views on major international issues confirmed that the two sides are unanimous in their assessment of the present international situation.
The two sides expressed the common understanding that the root cause of ever-escalating tensions in the Korean peninsula, Northeast Asia and other parts of the world lies in the provocations of the U.S. and its vassal countries.
The Russian side expressed full support for the measures taken by the DPRK leadership to deter the aggressive policy of the U.S. and its allies and ensure regional peace and stability.
The strategic dialogue marked an important occasion of substantially contributing to comprehensively developing the bilateral relations in conformity with the comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
The foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia agreed to hold more dialogues between external policy organs of the two countries, including the ministerial strategic dialogue, at various levels. -0-

headline: Many Farmers in DPRK Reap Good Harvest
Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on Friday:
On October 31, the UN secretary-general made public the stand of him who unreasonably takes issue with the recent test-fire of a strategic weapon conducted by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) via a spokesperson.
I express my strong dissatisfaction and categorically reject the unfair and prejudiced attitude of the UN secretary-general taking issue with the DPRK's just exercise of its right to self-defence.
I emphasize once again the point that the relevant activity of the DPRK is a part of our due and just exercise of the right to self-defence for sending a clear warning to the recent negative influence on the security environment of the DPRK and the various actions and plans of the outside forces escalating it in a planned way and for defending sovereignty and security from daily-increasing possible threats.
The UN secretary-general has consistently kept mum about the U.S. and its allies' anti-DPRK rhetoric and acts with a strong aggressive coloring that become the main cause of the escalated military tension, but stuck to prejudiced and stupid efforts to take issue only with the DPRK's right to self-defence and make it give it up. I can not but express regret at such behavior.
Does the UN secretary-general think that if we unilaterally restrain ourselves in the environment in which countries hostile against us have formed a military bloc based on nukes and inflicted a serious injury on the security of our state through unprecedented political and military provocations, peace can be ensured on the Korean peninsula?
In case the balance of strategic forces is destroyed on the Korean peninsula owing to the unlimited allowance for the hegemonic forces' military buildup aiming at "superiority of strength", can the UN secretary-general cope with a catastrophic consequence to be entailed by it?
The UN secretary-general should no longer remain a passive onlooker to the U.S. and its allies' moves for arms buildup against the DPRK which have steadily updated their highest record.
The UN secretary-general should clearly understand that his prejudiced stand on the Korean peninsula issue is acting as a factor of further aggravating the regional situation and inciting the hostile acts of the U.S. and its followers against the DPRK.
The UN secretary-general should not lose impartiality in fulfilling his important duty but stop a shameful act of volunteering to act as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of State.
The head of our state clearly reaffirmed the stand of the DPRK government yesterday, too.
There can never be a change of the line.
Have sanction, pressure and threats stopped us?
They have only made us stronger.
If one is not a fool, one should not do a stupid act of expecting our change.
The DPRK will never tolerate any attempt to threaten the security environment of the state. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following statement titled "The DPRK will further intensify its practical efforts to deter the military threat of the hostile forces and maintain the balance of forces in the region" on Friday:
The test-fire of the latest ICBM Hwasongpho-19 recently conducted by the DPRK constitutes a legitimate and just exercise of the right of a sovereign state to self-defence from A to Z as it is a part of the practical counteraction to the provocative reckless moves of the hostile forces to openly destroy peace and stability in the region around the Korean peninsula while blatantly challenging the sovereignty, security and interests of the DPRK.
However, the U.S. and its vassal forces revealed their provocative intention to convene a meeting of the UNSC with an aim to seriously encroach upon the DPRK's right to self-defence, not content with staging joint air drills of aggressive nature on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity while viciously slandering its reasonable exercise of sovereignty.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the hostile forces' confrontational behavior to create a critical situation against the security environment of the DPRK by means of illegal double standards and sophism just like a guilty party filling the suit first. It strongly denounces and rejects this as a wanton violation of the UN Charter and other recognized international laws with sovereign equality and non-interference in internal affairs as their core and a grave challenge to international peace and security.
There is no such place on earth as the Korean peninsula where touch-and-go and acute nuclear confrontation continues and unilateral military provocations against a sovereign state and extremely malicious and provocative rhetorical threats like the "end of regime" are rampant.
This year alone, the U.S. and the ROK have further detailed a dangerous nuclear war scenario while breeding various sorts of war plots more than 20 times to use nuclear weapons against the DPRK, including the third meeting of the "Nuclear Consultative Group" and the 5th meeting of the "Extended Deterrence Strategy and Consultation Group".
According to it, various strategic assets of the U.S. including the Theodore Roosevelt nuclear carrier task force, Bermont nuclear submarine and B-52H nuclear strategic bomber were deployed on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity more than ten times and various forms of war drills against the DPRK including "Freedom Shield", "Ulji Freedom Shield", "Freedom Edge", "Iron Mace", "Nuclear Consultative Group simulation drill" and "Freedom Flag" were staged without a break this year.
The reckless military confrontation racket kicked up by the hostile forces far beyond the sphere of stereotyped threat becomes a grave challenge to the DPRK's right to security and a root cause of destroying the balance of power in Northeast Asia and Asia-Pacific region beyond the Korean peninsula.
It is the steadfast strategic option and will of the DPRK to thoroughly deter the danger of outbreak of a nuclear war and powerfully control and manage the political and military situation in the region by countering the ever-dangerous military threat of the U.S. and its vassal forces with the overwhelmed and absolute power.
The DPRK will perfectly defend its sovereign right, security and development interests under any circumstances and further intensify its practical efforts to ensure the permanent stability of the Korean peninsula and the region in a responsible manner and resolutely counter any threat and challenge in the present and future.
The more provocative act the hostile forces take in defiance of the DPRK's grave warning, the stronger counteraction they will face. -0-

headline: Press Statement on Strategic Dialogue between DPRK and Russian FMs Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A press statement on strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, was issued on November 1.
The press statement says:
The relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation are growing stronger at a new strategic level in the spirit of the DPRK-Russia treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit in June 2024. Against this backdrop, a strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, took place in Moscow on November 1.
Prior to the strategic dialogue, the two foreign ministers attended a ceremony held at Yaroslavl Railway Station to unveil the tablet to honor the first visit of ComradeKim Il Sung, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, to the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in March 1949.
At the strategic dialogue, there was an in-depth exchange of views on the practical issues for development of the bilateral relations, with the emphasis on implementing the agreements reached at the DPRK-Russia summit meeting during the DPRK visit of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, in June.
Both sides reaffirmed their firm will to correctly implement the provisions of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership which put the traditional DPRK-Russia friendly relations on a new quality level.
The exchange of views on major international issues confirmed that the two sides are unanimous in their assessment of the present international situation.
The two sides expressed the common understanding that the root cause of ever-escalating tensions in the Korean peninsula, Northeast Asia and other parts of the world lies in the provocations of the U.S. and its vassal countries.
The Russian side expressed full support for the measures taken by the DPRK leadership to deter the aggressive policy of the U.S. and its allies and ensure regional peace and stability.
The strategic dialogue marked an important occasion of substantially contributing to comprehensively developing the bilateral relations in conformity with the comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
The foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia agreed to hold more dialogues between external policy organs of the two countries, including the ministerial strategic dialogue, at various levels. -0-

headline: Tablet to Honor President Kim Il Sung's First Official Visit to USSR Displayed in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A tablet to honor PresidentKim Il Sung's first official visit to the Soviet Union was displayed at Yaroslavl Railway Station, Moscow City of Russia.
Inscribed on the tablet are the Russian and Korean letters reading "ComradeKim Il Sung, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, arrived at the Yaroslavl Railway Station of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on March 3, 1949".
An unveiling ceremony of the tablet took place on the spot on Nov. 1.
Prior to it, a floral basket was laid at the tablet.

Speeches were made at the ceremony.

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on Friday:
On October 31, the UN secretary-general made public the stand of him who unreasonably takes issue with the recent test-fire of a strategic weapon conducted by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) via a spokesperson.
I express my strong dissatisfaction and categorically reject the unfair and prejudiced attitude of the UN secretary-general taking issue with the DPRK's just exercise of its right to self-defence.
I emphasize once again the point that the relevant activity of the DPRK is a part of our due and just exercise of the right to self-defence for sending a clear warning to the recent negative influence on the security environment of the DPRK and the various actions and plans of the outside forces escalating it in a planned way and for defending sovereignty and security from daily-increasing possible threats.
The UN secretary-general has consistently kept mum about the U.S. and its allies' anti-DPRK rhetoric and acts with a strong aggressive coloring that become the main cause of the escalated military tension, but stuck to prejudiced and stupid efforts to take issue only with the DPRK's right to self-defence and make it give it up. I can not but express regret at such behavior.
Does the UN secretary-general think that if we unilaterally restrain ourselves in the environment in which countries hostile against us have formed a military bloc based on nukes and inflicted a serious injury on the security of our state through unprecedented political and military provocations, peace can be ensured on the Korean peninsula?
In case the balance of strategic forces is destroyed on the Korean peninsula owing to the unlimited allowance for the hegemonic forces' military buildup aiming at "superiority of strength", can the UN secretary-general cope with a catastrophic consequence to be entailed by it?
The UN secretary-general should no longer remain a passive onlooker to the U.S. and its allies' moves for arms buildup against the DPRK which have steadily updated their highest record.
The UN secretary-general should clearly understand that his prejudiced stand on the Korean peninsula issue is acting as a factor of further aggravating the regional situation and inciting the hostile acts of the U.S. and its followers against the DPRK.
The UN secretary-general should not lose impartiality in fulfilling his important duty but stop a shameful act of volunteering to act as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of State.
The head of our state clearly reaffirmed the stand of the DPRK government yesterday, too.
There can never be a change of the line.
Have sanction, pressure and threats stopped us?
They have only made us stronger.
If one is not a fool, one should not do a stupid act of expecting our change.
The DPRK will never tolerate any attempt to threaten the security environment of the state. -0-

Today our Party has set ambitious goals for the people one after another and is pushing ahead with their realization under the worst condition, in which others might have collapsed a hundred times. This is aimed to provide the people with the best living conditions.

The red flag of the WPK is associated with the people's appearance and their destiny.

headline: Press Statement on Strategic Dialogue between DPRK and Russian FMs Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A press statement on strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, was issued on November 1.
The press statement says:
The relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation are growing stronger at a new strategic level in the spirit of the DPRK-Russia treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit in June 2024. Against this backdrop, a strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, took place in Moscow on November 1.
Prior to the strategic dialogue, the two foreign ministers attended a ceremony held at Yaroslavl Railway Station to unveil the tablet to honor the first visit of ComradeKim Il Sung, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, to the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in March 1949.
At the strategic dialogue, there was an in-depth exchange of views on the practical issues for development of the bilateral relations, with the emphasis on implementing the agreements reached at the DPRK-Russia summit meeting during the DPRK visit of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, in June.
Both sides reaffirmed their firm will to correctly implement the provisions of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership which put the traditional DPRK-Russia friendly relations on a new quality level.
The exchange of views on major international issues confirmed that the two sides are unanimous in their assessment of the present international situation.
The two sides expressed the common understanding that the root cause of ever-escalating tensions in the Korean peninsula, Northeast Asia and other parts of the world lies in the provocations of the U.S. and its vassal countries.
The Russian side expressed full support for the measures taken by the DPRK leadership to deter the aggressive policy of the U.S. and its allies and ensure regional peace and stability.
The strategic dialogue marked an important occasion of substantially contributing to comprehensively developing the bilateral relations in conformity with the comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
The foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia agreed to hold more dialogues between external policy organs of the two countries, including the ministerial strategic dialogue, at various levels. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following statement titled "The DPRK will further intensify its practical efforts to deter the military threat of the hostile forces and maintain the balance of forces in the region" on Friday:
The test-fire of the latest ICBM Hwasongpho-19 recently conducted by the DPRK constitutes a legitimate and just exercise of the right of a sovereign state to self-defence from A to Z as it is a part of the practical counteraction to the provocative reckless moves of the hostile forces to openly destroy peace and stability in the region around the Korean peninsula while blatantly challenging the sovereignty, security and interests of the DPRK.
However, the U.S. and its vassal forces revealed their provocative intention to convene a meeting of the UNSC with an aim to seriously encroach upon the DPRK's right to self-defence, not content with staging joint air drills of aggressive nature on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity while viciously slandering its reasonable exercise of sovereignty.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the hostile forces' confrontational behavior to create a critical situation against the security environment of the DPRK by means of illegal double standards and sophism just like a guilty party filling the suit first. It strongly denounces and rejects this as a wanton violation of the UN Charter and other recognized international laws with sovereign equality and non-interference in internal affairs as their core and a grave challenge to international peace and security.
There is no such place on earth as the Korean peninsula where touch-and-go and acute nuclear confrontation continues and unilateral military provocations against a sovereign state and extremely malicious and provocative rhetorical threats like the "end of regime" are rampant.
This year alone, the U.S. and the ROK have further detailed a dangerous nuclear war scenario while breeding various sorts of war plots more than 20 times to use nuclear weapons against the DPRK, including the third meeting of the "Nuclear Consultative Group" and the 5th meeting of the "Extended Deterrence Strategy and Consultation Group".
According to it, various strategic assets of the U.S. including the Theodore Roosevelt nuclear carrier task force, Bermont nuclear submarine and B-52H nuclear strategic bomber were deployed on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity more than ten times and various forms of war drills against the DPRK including "Freedom Shield", "Ulji Freedom Shield", "Freedom Edge", "Iron Mace", "Nuclear Consultative Group simulation drill" and "Freedom Flag" were staged without a break this year.
The reckless military confrontation racket kicked up by the hostile forces far beyond the sphere of stereotyped threat becomes a grave challenge to the DPRK's right to security and a root cause of destroying the balance of power in Northeast Asia and Asia-Pacific region beyond the Korean peninsula.
It is the steadfast strategic option and will of the DPRK to thoroughly deter the danger of outbreak of a nuclear war and powerfully control and manage the political and military situation in the region by countering the ever-dangerous military threat of the U.S. and its vassal forces with the overwhelmed and absolute power.
The DPRK will perfectly defend its sovereign right, security and development interests under any circumstances and further intensify its practical efforts to ensure the permanent stability of the Korean peninsula and the region in a responsible manner and resolutely counter any threat and challenge in the present and future.
The more provocative act the hostile forces take in defiance of the DPRK's grave warning, the stronger counteraction they will face. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Lays Wreath before Tomb of Unknown Soldiers
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and her party on an official visit to the Russian Federation laid a wreath before the Tomb of the Unknown Soldiers by the wall of the Kremlin on Nov. 1.
Accompanying her were Vice-minister Andrei Rudenko and other officials of the Foreign Ministry of the Russian Federation.
A wreath in the name of the DPRK foreign minister was placed at the tomb.
The visitors observed a moment's silence in memory of the soldiers who laid down their lives in the sacred war to annihilate fascism.
During their stay in Moscow, Choe Son Hui and her party visited various places of the city. -0-

headline: 2nd Festival of Architectural Information Modeling Technology Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- The 2nd Festival of Architectural Information Modeling Technology was held on the theme of "Application, practice and prospect of the architectural information modeling technology".
Attending the festival were officials, teachers, researchers, designers of Pyongyang University of Architecture, the Green Architecture Technology Trading Company, the Pyongyang City Design Institute and other units.
It took place, divided into the exhibition of architectural information modeling technology and the exhibition of architectural design program.
Presented there were more than 50 valuable proposals studied and completed by scientists and technologists.
A architectural information modeling support program, designs for indoor architectural decoration of hotel and landscaping, architectural information modeling of neighborhood-serving  amenities and other proposals were highly appreciated as they are of great practical significance. -0-

headline: Autumn Campaign for Protecting National Heritage Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, a mass movement is being conducted in spring and autumn every year to protect the national heritage.
Working people across the country are displaying patriotic zeal in the autumn campaign for loving the national heritage.
Kangwon Province arranged ing Phyohun Temple and Singye Temple, historical relics of Mt Kumgang, a world-famous scenic spot, in a short span of time.
South Phyongan Province conducted a mass campaign to protect historical sites in the province, including Anguk Temple and Paeksang Pavilion.
Yonthan County of North Hwanghae Province spruced up the area of Simwon Temple, a historical relic, and makes sure that all units in the county take part in the work for managing the temple.
Kaesong Municipality restored the red-and-blue painting of Sunyang School on the principle of historicism and is recovering historical relics around the Pakyon Falls.
The autumn campaign for loving the national heritage was also conducted in Pyongyang Municipality and other parts of the country. -0-

White Paper of DPRK Institute of Enemy State Studies Betrays Criminal Colors and Miserable Plight of Puppet Yoon Suk Yeol
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea made public on October 27 the final results of investigation into the case of a ROK-borne drone's serious encroachment upon the sovereignty of the DPRK, thus fully bringing to light the plot hatched by hideous criminals.
The provocative wanton violation of the sovereignty of the DPRK is a product of the last-ditch effort of the Yoon Suk Yeol regime seeking to defuse its worst ruling crisis brought by its totally bankrupt internal and external policies through perpetration of shocking provocations on the Korean peninsula and to prolong its renaming days full of crimes.
The DPRK Institute of Enemy State Studies on Saturday released a white paper disclosing the criminal colors and miserable plight of Yoon, a puppet rare to be found in other parts of the world, who adds to his crimes in a bid to escape the pitfall of ruin.
The white paper says "Yoon's disastrous policy" has exposed the ROK to the danger of a nuclear war.
Puppet Yoon's two and a half years in power were continuity of the "deadly gamble" that has exposed the whole ROK to the danger of a nuclear war.
The puppet, gripped by the idea of hostility, let out such reckless remarks as "large-scale punitive retaliation", "not ruling out a war", "readiness for war escalation", "absolute preparations for war" and "end of regime" at security events held on different occasions, including the "June 25 war memorial day" and the "ROK army day", and at such security-related meetings as the meeting of major army commanders and the central combined defense meeting. Such abusive language worked as dangerous sparks thrown into a heated arsenal.
Worse still, the puppet pushed the situation to an unpredictable phase by unhesitatingly abrogating the September 19 military agreement, the last safety gear for ensuring peace of the Korean peninsula, not content with malignantly slandering it as a "unilateral one beneficial only to such enemy as the north".
The puppet has driven the situation to the brink of a nuclear war at breakneck speed by producing, together with his American master, such nuclear war declaration as "Washington declaration" in April last year, turning the ROK-U.S. alliance into a nuclear-based one and putting into full operation the ROK-U.S. nuclear consultation group and "guidelines for nuclear operation on the Korean peninsula".
The puppet has got frantic in establishing the triangular military alliance with the U.S. and Japan and tightening the military nexus with even NATO, thus reducing the puppet ROK to a bridgehead for "Crusade in 21st century".
The expended nuclear war saber-rattling targeting the DPRK and its neighboring countries and the reckless moves to turn the ROK into an advanced base of multinational armed forces, pursuant to the U.S. strategy for world domination, has made the whole land of the puppet ROK a double and triple target of nuclear powers around it.
Not content with this, the puppet Yoon group staged such hideous anti-DPRK moves as the scattering of political motivational rubbish and the resumption of loudspeaker broadcasting under the pretext of "freedom of expression", drawing the minute hand of the puppet ROK security clock closer to the time of war.
Its ever-worsening military moves resulted only in the paradoxical consequences of pushing the DPRK to stockpile its nuclear weapons at an exponential rate and further develop its nuclear attack capability.
The white paper discloses the fact that ruined Yoon has brought about an era of despair driving the population into a veritable hell.
It was the starting point of great disaster that a stupid, who hardly passed the official's qualification exam after experiencing nine rounds of its kind, came to the presidential office.
Yoon's two and a half years in office has clearly proved that it is not excessive to have asserted that it would be better for a dog to sit in the Ryongsan presidential office rather than him.
Soon after coming to power, he rigged up the horrible "prosecution Republic", as befits a former prosecutor enjoying wielding a sword.
After giving major posts of over 30 power organs, including the puppet presidential office, to more than 180 gangsters of prosecutor, the puppet has blocked the anti-government struggle and staged a campaign to sweep away the political opposition camp under the pretext of "ensuring fairness".
The retaliatory investigation into the ex-president, who set up a ladder of success for Yoon, and his whole family and attendants was intensified in an overall way, including investigation into their bank accounts and seizure and search of houses and villas, which stunned the public and aroused strong backlash from the opposition parties.
Self-righteousness, diehardism, arrogance and arbitrary practices constitute another disgrace of Yoon's rule.
The true colors of the "self-destructive rule" of Yoon's style are being fully revealed through the shattered economy and people's livelihood.
The debts of major large enterprises, which allegedly seize the lifeline of the puppet ROK's economy, are the hugest ones ever in history, and the debt rate of enterprises reaches 173.6 percent, which is far beyond business assets.
Closures of many businesses have been witnessed this year, too, as one million independent enterprises gave up their business last year and this year, while prices were skyrocketing due to puppet Yoon who knows nothing about the economy.
Medical reform, related to the increased entrants to medical universities, met with strong opposition in medical field from the beginning and has not been executed for more than one year in the puppet ROK. Furthermore, the collective resignation of doctors caused a great confusion called collapse of the medical system.
It is becoming more common practice that more than 13 000 people, equivalent to one division, have committed suicide every year, maintaining the world's record in suicide. This is the present reality of the puppet ROK advocating "freedom" and "equality".
Great irony is that the power holder behind the curtain who enacted the tragedy of the "ruined ROK" is not puppet Yoon but his wife Kim Kon Hui.
Choe Sun Sil had manipulated Park Geun Hye behind her in the past, but Kim Kon Hui has dominated Yoon Suk Yeol to interfere in the state affairs and be engrossed in illicit fortunes, posing herself as the president.
The white paper says that a wrecked ship "Yoon Suk Yeol" is sinking.
The ship "Yoon Suk Yeol", which set sail 30 months ago, blowing a siren of "fairness and common sense" and "freedom and peace", has got wrecked in the crisis of sinking without arriving even half at the opposite shore of his five-year term of office.
The ship is now wrapped in violent waves and only sending an SOS in a hurry, without elation at the time of its departure.
More than 200 sorts of irregularities and corruption committed by sycophantic traitors and the Yoon's whole family kowtowing to the U.S. and Japan and wealth of power gathered by the presidential office and "Yoon's core bureaucracy" are filled in the wrecked ship to accelerate its sinking.
The Yoon's approval rate is in the line of 19 percent, a more dangerous numerical valve than Park Geun Hye who was sent to prison after the impeachment in the past.
The support rate has rapidly declined in the sixties, the core supporters, to say nothing of the conservative forces who voted for the last presidential election, shaking the foundation of the Yoon Suk Yeol regime.
In the whole of the puppet ROK, the struggle is now getting violent to oust puppet Yoon Suk Yeol so as to put an end to the misfortune, pain, disgrace and contempt it has experienced for two and a half years by making a wrong vote for him.
Faced with the worst ruling crisis at present, puppet Yoon is making desperate efforts to find a way out for his existence in reckless criminal provocations against the DPRK.
Fire can be extinguished by fire, but the crisis cannot be covered by crisis.
The more desperately Yoon tries to escalate the present crisis and get rid of the abyss of ruin, the more deeply he will be suppressed by the thrice-cursed crimes he committed.
The people's angry voice is shaking the whole of the puppet ROK with knell of punishment to drive a nail in the coffin of Yoon Suk Yeol, a living dead. -0-

headline: Ilhae Farm in Jongju City Over-fulfills State Grain Production Plan
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- The Ilhae Farm in Jongju City of North Phyongan Province of the DPRK has reaped rich harvest every year by dint of scientific farming, true to the programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
The farm has directed primary efforts to raising the scientific level of agricultural production and established a scientific cultivation method by introducing high-yielding strains strong in salt, drought, rainstorm and disease to suit the regional features of the coastal area.
It has put the operation of the newly-built base for producing slow-action granulated fertilizer on a normal basis and applied a lot of organic fertilizer and manure to fields and conducted a drainage project in the tens of kilometer-long sections to provide a guarantee for high and stable yield.
As a result, it reaped rich harvest and finished harvesting and threshing in a short span of time through a collective innovation.
Its farmers took part in the year-end account settlement and income distribution with the pride of having over-fulfilled the state grain production plan again this significant year. They were congratulated by Ri Hi Yong, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Kwang Un, chairman of the provincial rural economy committee, and officials in Jongju City. -0-

headline: Lesson Taught by "Human Shield" in Gaza Strip
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- The Israeli troops have come under worldwide criticism for committing massacres in Gaza Strip. The world was again stunned by the recently revealed fact that they have used innocent Palestinians as "human shields."
Such fact was opened to public recently by the testimonies of an Israeli soldier and five Palestinian victims.
The Israeli soldier testified that his unit detained Palestinian civilians to use them as "human shields" when searching dangerous places.
The civilian victims said that the Israeli soldiers addressed the victims in military uniforms and put cameras on them before pushing them into the buildings and tunnels likely to be hideouts of Hamas combatants or booby-trapped areas.
According to their testimonies, Israeli troops stormed a dwelling and killed all inhabitants except a teenager. Then they handcuffed him and dragged him into minefields.
It is not the first time for the Israeli troops to commit such atrocity.
Israeli troops had used Palestinians as "human shields" on the West Bank of the Jordan River in 2005, provoking international human rights organizations' protest and condemnation.
The recently revealed fact goes to prove that the misanthropy of the Israeli forces making no scruple of taking hostage even innocent civilians, an evil habit of murderers, has assumed the "legitimate" nature to be an ordinary and undisguised act.
Israeli brasshats openly call for "sacrificing the lives of Palestinians and disregarding international law to save the lives of Israeli troops." No wonder, even a military term meaning such human shield has been produced by them.
International law bans using civilians as a cover for military action or forcibly mobilizing them for military operation.
Nevertheless, the Zionists are using innocent civilians as shields under the pretext of "annihilating Hamas," making even terrorists feel ashamed in their brutality. This brings to light the true colors of the Israeli army as the modern-day terrorist group that has plunged the whole Middle East into the quagmire of a bloody war.
The U.S., called the "terrorist kingpin ", has trained, patronized and supported in an all-round way such hideous Israeli brutes indulging in genocide and territorial expansion in disregard of the international community's denunciation.
As long as the evil empire U.S. and its henchmen seeking to unhesitatingly sacrifice all humanity to fulfil their hegemonic design and interests go scot-free, bloodbath will not stop on the earth.
If you don't want to fall victim as "human shields" of murderers, you must consolidate more firmly your national defences that guarantee your dignity and destiny as human beings.
This is the bitter lesson taught by the Palestinian situation. -0-

headline: Autumn Campaign of Land Management Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Efforts are directed to spruce up the appearance of the land in different parts of the DPRK.
South Phyongan Province has carried out a large amount of river-bed dredging and building retaining walls in autumn.
North Hamgyong Province secured saplings to be planted in mountains covering an area of hundreds of hectares in tree planting season.
Sinhung County of South Hamgyong Province has pushed ahead with the work to improve the technical condition of roads in the autumn period of general mobilization for land administration.
Meanwhile, officials and builders of the provincial railway construction companies finished anti-land-sliding projects and road restoration work. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Electric Power Industrial Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the field of electric power industry of the DPRK are making a leap in production.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex is making uninterrupted innovations and progress while consolidating the successes made in increasing the power production as compared with the same period of last year.
The Sunchon, Chongchongang and other thermal power plants are boosting the production by introducing valuable technical innovations and restoring the original capacity of equipment.
Officials and workers at the Hochongang, Sodusu, Jangjingang and other hydro-power stations are operating generators at full capacity while making effective use of the water already secured.
Thus, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry has produced more electricity than that of the same period of last year. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Han Hyon Ok, a woman centenarian living in the people's neighborhood unit No. 57 of Pidan-ri, Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
Officials of the Kumya County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers visited her family to congratulate her.
She and her family and relatives were deeply impressed by the loving care shown byKim Jong Unwho sent a birthday spread even to an ordinary old woman.
Born into a poor peasant family before the liberation of Korea, she was subject to a fate as a stateless slave. She could lead a genuine life as the master of the country and the land only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
After the Fatherland Liberation War, she devoted herself to her work to repay the benevolence of the Party, which takes warm care of the lives of the families of the fallen fighters, and brought up her children as pillars of the country. -0-

headline: Protest Demanding Impeachment of Puppet Yoon Suk Yeol Staged in Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- An atmosphere of impeaching the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, who is making desperate efforts to get rid of the worst ruling crisis while resorting to the reckless moves to ignite a war against the DPRK and to the fascist suppression, prevails in the whole of the puppet ROK, and it is running high as days go by.
The 113th candlelight rally and demonstration calling for impeaching Yoon took place in Seoul on Nov. 2 under the sponsorship of the Candlelight Action, the Headquarters of the Movement for Ousting Yoon Suk Yeol regime, etc.
300 000 people from all walks of life, including workers, peasants, students, old people, children and lawmakers from opposition parties, took part in the candlelight rally and demonstration.
They condemned Yoon for bringing war crisis, economic catastrophe, destitution of the people’s living, etc., saying that the ROK faces a general crisis two years and six months after Yoon came into power.
They accused Yoon group of trying to unleash a war on the Korean peninsula through the infiltration of drones and the scattering of leaflets, and to involve themselves in the Ukrainian war through a smear campaign. And they called for toppling Yoon from power without fail and said that the impeachment is the way to prevent a war.
They said that the grand candlelight procession, which has been held on over 100 occasions on every Saturdays in demand of the impeachment of Yoon, is to see its end at last. They noted that Yoon should be suspended from his duty through the impeachment, adding that the impeachment is the way of averting a war and a constitutional amendment. And they said Yoon must be impeached and that a presidential election should be enforced next year. They added that one million people will gather and open the way for it in the nationwide intensive candlelight march scheduled for Nov.16.
They called upon people from all walks of life to turn out in the candlelight struggle for putting an end to Yoon's regime as early as possible.
The participants staged a demonstration while chanting slogans, holding large placards and posters.
Many citizens responded to the call of the demonstrators.
Meanwhile, rallies of voters took place in Seoul, Pusan, Ulsan, South Kyongsang Province andother parts of the puppet ROK amid the growing enthusiasm for referendum for impeachment of the puppet Yoon.
In "the people's order for proposing the impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol" given to the lawmakers, they said that the impeachment of Yoon is the stern intention of the people and warned that even lawmakers would be judged if they turn blind eyes to the public mindset.
Then they held a ceremony of tearing a large suspension placard picturing the ugly colors of Yoon and Kim Kon Hui, chief culprits of abuses of the state affairs and kingpins of corruption and irregularities. -0-

headline: 2024 National Open Table-Tennis Tournament Begins in DPRK
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Han Hyon Ok, a woman centenarian living in the people's neighborhood unit No. 57 of Pidan-ri, Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
Officials of the Kumya County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers visited her family to congratulate her.
She and her family and relatives were deeply impressed by the loving care shown byKim Jong Unwho sent a birthday spread even to an ordinary old woman.
Born into a poor peasant family before the liberation of Korea, she was subject to a fate as a stateless slave. She could lead a genuine life as the master of the country and the land only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
After the Fatherland Liberation War, she devoted herself to her work to repay the benevolence of the Party, which takes warm care of the lives of the families of the fallen fighters, and brought up her children as pillars of the country. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Electric Power Industrial Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the field of electric power industry of the DPRK are making a leap in production.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex is making uninterrupted innovations and progress while consolidating the successes made in increasing the power production as compared with the same period of last year.
The Sunchon, Chongchongang and other thermal power plants are boosting the production by introducing valuable technical innovations and restoring the original capacity of equipment.
Officials and workers at the Hochongang, Sodusu, Jangjingang and other hydro-power stations are operating generators at full capacity while making effective use of the water already secured.
Thus, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry has produced more electricity than that of the same period of last year. -0-

headline: Sinuiju Textile Mill Associated with Leadership Feats of Peerlessly Great Men
Kangdong Greenhouse Complex
Autumn Campaign of Land Management Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Efforts are directed to spruce up the appearance of the land in different parts of the DPRK.
South Phyongan Province has carried out a large amount of river-bed dredging and building retaining walls in autumn.
North Hamgyong Province secured saplings to be planted in mountains covering an area of hundreds of hectares in tree planting season.
Sinhung County of South Hamgyong Province has pushed ahead with the work to improve the technical condition of roads in the autumn period of general mobilization for land administration.
Meanwhile, officials and builders of the provincial railway construction companies finished anti-land-sliding projects and road restoration work. -0-

headline: Urban Management Sector of DPRK to Ensure People's Living Conditions
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- The urban management sector of the DPRK directs efforts to providing the people with more stable and civilized living conditions and environments.
The Ministry of Urban Management and the relevant units have worked out this year's stepwise plan for repairing flats and public buildings and are now pushing ahead with the project as scheduled.
North Hamgyong Province repaired hundreds of flats ahead of schedule and gave Chongjin City a facelift.
South Hamgyong Province arranged the roofs of more than 1 900 flats and dozens of public buildings.
South Hwanghae Province established a regular preventive repair system and learned about the condition of buildings. And it applied advanced working methods to ensure the quality of the project at a high level.
North Hwanghae Province and Nampho Municipality have repaired dwelling houses and public buildings as scheduled. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Vice Department Director of WPK Central Committee Kim Yo Jong
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made public the following press statement "Ever-escalating military threats of hostile forces only prove the validity of our line of bolstering up nuclear forces" on Monday:
The U.S., Japan and the ROK frantically staged a combined air drill targeting our Republic once again in front of us on November 3.
Various fighter jets of the three countries, led by U.S. strategic bomber B-1B, were involved in the drill under the signboard of "counteraction" and "warning" to our latest strategic weapon test. They reportedly got familiar with the "mode of promptly and correctly striking" the simulated opponent's core objects.
The military gangsters of the ROK declared that they would further tighten the triangular military cooperation against us in the future, blustering "the drill showcased the strong countering will and capability based on the ROK-U.S.-Japan security cooperation, as well as the integrated extended deterrence execution faculty of the ROK-U.S. alliance to counter and deter ever-escalating nuclear and missile threats from the north."
This is just another outright action-based explanation of the most hostile and dangerous aggressive nature of the enemy toward our Republic and, at the same time, another absolute proof of the validity and urgency of the line of building up the nuclear forces we have opted for and put into practice.
Today upset of the balance of power between rivals on the Korean peninsula and in the region precisely means a war. And this is an undeniable objective reality.
I point out once again that the U.S. and its followers held more than 20 rounds of various war confabs to map out plans for using nuclear weapons against our state this year alone and ceaselessly staged one hundred and tens of anti-DPRK military drills all the year round to implement them.
The drastically increased number of war rehearsals like Freedom Edge, the first multi-domain joint military exercises between the U.S., Japan and the ROK, and Iron Mace, a nuclear operation drill simulating an all-out nuclear war on the Korean peninsula, posed a serious threat to not only our state but also regional peace and security.
This year nuclear aircraft carrier strike groups, including the one of Theodore Roosevelt, were deployed near the Korean peninsula three times and the nuclear-powered strategic submarine Vermont made its first appearance in the ROK, while B-52H and other nuclear-capable strategic bombers flied in the sky above the Korean peninsula five times, updating once again the recent records of deployment of U.S. strategic assets.
The critical security environment facing our state eloquently proves the inevitability of the strategic choice made by us to creditably defend our state's security and regional peace from the U.S. and its followers' aggressive and adventuristic military threats.
The ever-escalating hysteric military threats of the rivals will further highlight the justness and urgency of our line and it will be implemented in corresponding dynamic and intensity.
The line of bolstering up the self-defensive nuclear deterrent, being pursued by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, is the most correct, one and only choice made by it in the current situation, and we will never vacillate in that way. -0-

headline: Efforts Directed to Expanding Arable Land
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK are striving to expand the area of arable land.
North Hamgyong and South Hamgyong provinces focus on restoring farmland damaged by flood.
Hoeryong City and Onsong County concentrated vehicles on riverbed dredging and riverbank reinforcement, while Tanchon City and Toksong and Kowon counties restored a large area of lost farmland by stepping up the soil improvement.
Phyongwon and Taedong counties of South Phyongan Province and Pyoksong and Samchon counties of South Hwanghae Province transformed tens of hectares of dry fields into paddy fields by addressing the lack of irrigation water.
Jongju City and Nyongbyon County of North Phyongan Province and Phangyo and Kumgang counties of Kangwon Province improved farmland with low soil fertility and reclaimed other land to expand the area of arable land.
Officials and working people in North Hwanghae and Jagang provinces and other parts of the country, too have turned out in the campaign for securing more arable land. -0-

headline: By Providing Comprehensive Medical Service Centre for Women
Loving Care Shown for Health of Workers
story_text:
One day of the hottest period of summer in 2016, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a factory.
After looking round various places of the fodder storehouse at it, he was going to enter a worksite.
An official of the factory tried to hold him back from entering the worksite because of strong smell.
But, the General Secretary went into the site, saying that he should go into any place where the workers are doing their jobs.
The worksite was ventilated but smelled. Stressing that the workers should never be allowed to work in such a gas-smelling place, he said that the health of workers is more precious than high production results and that more ventilation equipment should be installed as early as possible, though much more funds are needed.
The official of the factory could not raise his face, deeply moved by the warm loving care of the General Secretary who is concerned about the health of the workers before the production results.
Later, the factory improved the environment of worksite and installed more ventilation equipment to make it fill up with fresh air as in the compound where the forest and greening are ensured. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Luong Cong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on November 1.
The message said:
I express my sincere thanks to you for sending me a congratulatory message on my election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
My visit to the DPRK in 2013 gave me a great many good impressions of the DPRK, a fine and beautiful country, and its friendly people holding their friends dear.
I am pleased that the traditional friendly relations between the two countries have been steadily consolidated and developed for the past 74 years.
The Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to the traditional friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK and, in particular, desire to further develop the bilateral friendly relations in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and for regional and global peace, stability, cooperation and development against a backdrop that our two countries are making preparations to mark the 75th anniversary of the establishment of the diplomatic relations in 2025.
I wish you good health and more successes in carrying out your noble heavy responsibility. -0-

headline: Regional Development Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- A campaign for promoting the regional development and improvement of people's living standards is underway in South Hamgyong Province, Kangwon Province and Nampho Municipality.
New goat farms with milk powder and fermentation feed production facilities were built in cities and counties of South Hamgyong Province. They now focus on putting the goat farming on a high sci-tech basis.
Kangwon Province continues to direct much effort to the construction of hydroelectric power stations. Thanks to the untiring efforts of provincial officials and builders, the Kosong Army-People Power Station is nearing completion and the construction of Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, Ichon Army-People Power Station No. 2 and Hoeyang Army-People Power Station No. 2 is proceeding as scheduled.
Officials and working people in Nampho Municipality are speeding up the construction of an instant noodle factory at the final stage. Structural construction and necessary equipment production have finished. -0-

headline: DPRK Ministry of Forestry Focuses on Consolidating Production Foundations
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- The DPRK Ministry of Forestry puts efforts into strengthening its production bases.
It took measures to ensure the scientific and technological operation of modern production processes, thus producing a large number of highly efficient sawing machines.
Meanwhile, the ministry is pushing ahead with the efforts to modernize the producers of woodwork so as to increase their production capacities. And according to a well thought-out plan, it is also making preparations to successfully ensure winter timber production. -0-

headline: Farmers in Yanggok and Manjong Farms of DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- Modern rural dwelling houses have been built at Yanggok and Manjong farms in Paekam County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK. And the farmers moved into their new houses.
The modern houses preserving the features of remote mountain villages in the northern part of the country are associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a new era of a civilized and wealthy socialist rural community.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses were Kim Bom, secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, builders and agricultural workers of Yanggok and Manjong farms.
Kim Hae, vice-chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory speech. And licenses for the use of houses were handed over and vowing speeches made.
When the removal to new houses began, the people danced to the tune of cheerful peasant music. Officials congratulated the farmers and other residents and shared joy with them. -0-

headline: DPRK Player Wins at IBA Youth World Boxing Championships 2024
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- DPRK player Son Su Rim came first at the IBA Youth World Boxing Championships 2024.
The championships brought together more than 590 ace men and women players from over 70 countries and regions.
Son Su Rim beat all the rivals in the women's 60kg category event and advanced into the finals. In the finals, she defeated her Chinese rival 3:2 and won the trophy and gold medal.
Pak Sin A of the DPRK placed second in the women's 63kg category.
Meanwhile, DPRK players Choe Wi Hyon and Ri Phyong Gwang bagged silver medals in the men's 10 meter synchronized platform event, Kim Kyong Sim and Ri Hyang Sim in the women's 10 meter synchronized platform event and Ri Hyang Sim and Phyo So Yon in the women's 3 meter synchronized springboard event at the 11th Asian Diving Championships held in China.
Choe Wi Hyon and Ri Hyang Sim placed third in the men's individual 10 meter platform event and the women's individual 10 meter platform event respectively. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Sites of Reconstruction of Flood-hit Areas in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected again sites of reconstruction of flood-hit areas in North Phyongan Province on November 4.
He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the C.C., WPK, and cadres concerned of the C.C., WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted by Ri Hi Yong, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army units and the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade involved in the reconstruction.
Thanks to the dynamic patriotic efforts of all the builders who have risen up as one in hearty response to the militant call of the WPK Central Committee to turn the flood-hit areas into ideal "modern rural city" by building the dwelling houses as civilized and modern as those in city, the flood-hit farm villages on an islet of the northwestern part of the country that suffered disasters are showing their new appearances every day while fully demonstrating the beautiful reality of superior socialist system of our own style and instilling confidence and optimism about the future.
Going round the recovery areas in Ojok-ri of Uiju County and in Hadan-ri of Sinuiju City, he learned in detail about the reconstruction.
He said that he always had a heavy heart due to the vivid memory of looking at the flooded villages in an emergency rescue of the local people just some months ago, adding that he is really pleased to look at the fine banks and see that dwellings of peculiar urban styles are being built in the safe zone in a competitive way. He noted with pleasure that a worthwhile and proper decision was made and that a great change was brought about with our own efforts.
He highly praised the brilliant feats and innovations of the builders, expressing great satisfaction over the fact that the army, which has successfully fulfilled its sacred mission as the army of the Party and the people, and the young people, who have always been faithful to the honorable reputation as reliable reserves and advancing group of the Party, are making remarkable reconstruction successes with their unique courage, true to the call of the country and the revolution, in the site for the reconstruction of the flood-hit areas, the forefront of defending the people.
We have come to believe in our strength once again through the on-going huge rehabilitation campaign and I regard it as mental wealth more important than any physical result, he said, adding: We are deeply experiencing our own tremendous strength once again and have become squarely convinced that the single-minded unity of our society, in which all people help and lead each other forward, is getting stronger in the spirit of self-development and self-determination and amid a sacred patriotic struggle.
Saying we should take pride in the invincible spirit and might exclusive to our great state, never to be found in other countries, and ceaselessly create our future prouder and more worthwhile through a great demonstration of that spirit and might, he called for bringing about good fruition as planned by continuously waging an all-out honourable and patriotic campaign for the people who suffered misfortune and for healing the wounds of the country that suffered a natural disaster.
Noting that a good beginning is important but a good ending is more important and the outcome of rehabilitation will be evaluated by the results of the remaining projects, he greatly encouraged the builders, calling on them to bring about greater innovations in the remaining days by carrying on the intensive struggle with the sense of responsibility, efforts and courage, ten times and one hundred times stronger than usual.
Noting that it is necessary to reinforce the construction forces with more skilled workers and take some state measures to successfully finish the projects, he made a determination to complete the rehabilitation campaign at the highest level before the December Party plenary meeting and gave detailed instructions to successfully accelerate the reconstruction.
Time has slipped away since young people and service personnel left for the reconstruction site in hot summer and new season has arrived, but a modern rural city has already taken shape in the disaster-stricken area once covered with mud only, and this indicates the change made by our young people through their creative struggle is faster than the change of season, he said, praising our young people and service personnel once again for having done a great deal of work to be honourable before the country and the times. He expressed conviction that an eye-opening new world would soon emerge in the area thanks to the indomitable struggle of the dependable builders who dedicate their patriotic sweat to every structure.
The builders, who have all turned out once again to attain the sacred goal of their struggle with redoubled ambitious pluck and fighting spirit that they can lift even the earth under the trust ofKim Jong Un, were filled with a firm determination to create a new legendary tale of world-startling construction miracles in the flood-hit areas. -0-

headline: DPRK Wins at 2024 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- The DPRK team won the trophy in the 2024 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
It beat its Spanish rival 5:4 (1:1 in the first and second halves, 4:3 in the 11 meter penalty kick) in the finals held on November 3 amid the attention of football experts, fans and spectators across the world.
At the awarding ceremony, the trophy and gold medals were awarded to the DPRK women footballers and the Golden Ball award, the best player prize, to Jon Il Chong. -0-

headline: Regional Development Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- A campaign for promoting the regional development and improvement of people's living standards is underway in South Hamgyong Province, Kangwon Province and Nampho Municipality.
New goat farms with milk powder and fermentation feed production facilities were built in cities and counties of South Hamgyong Province. They now focus on putting the goat farming on a high sci-tech basis.
Kangwon Province continues to direct much effort to the construction of hydroelectric power stations. Thanks to the untiring efforts of provincial officials and builders, the Kosong Army-People Power Station is nearing completion and the construction of Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, Ichon Army-People Power Station No. 2 and Hoeyang Army-People Power Station No. 2 is proceeding as scheduled.
Officials and working people in Nampho Municipality are speeding up the construction of an instant noodle factory at the final stage. Structural construction and necessary equipment production have finished. -0-

headline: Seed Is Main in Farming
story_text:
One day in March 2004, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited Jungsan County, South Phyongan Province where land realignment was going on at the final stage.
An official told the Chairman about the resolve to increase grain production by raising good crops that year and needs. The Chairman said that the seed is the main in farming and officials should think this problem first, not demanding plastic sheet or fertilizer.
Of course, it is not bad to demand plastic sheet or fertilizer, he said, asking an official about the fact that he knows that our people like kaoliang.
Looking at the officials who were perplexed, the Chairman said that in old times our people planted kaoliang on a large scale and a kaoliang cake was very delicious.
He said that he had never heard of eating wheat and barley cakes and, as in the revolutionary opera "The Sea of Blood", our people ate the kaoliang cake in the past, and that the high-yielding varieties of kaoliang would gain popularity among the agricultural workers.
Like this,Kim Jong Il, through a story about kaoliang farming, made the officials realize the truth that they should pay a priority to seed in any crop in order to increase grain yield. Looking up to him, the officials expressed their resolve to direct efforts to the seed revolution and thus bring about high yield without fail. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Luong Cong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on November 1.
The message said:
I express my sincere thanks to you for sending me a congratulatory message on my election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
My visit to the DPRK in 2013 gave me a great many good impressions of the DPRK, a fine and beautiful country, and its friendly people holding their friends dear.
I am pleased that the traditional friendly relations between the two countries have been steadily consolidated and developed for the past 74 years.
The Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to the traditional friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK and, in particular, desire to further develop the bilateral friendly relations in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and for regional and global peace, stability, cooperation and development against a backdrop that our two countries are making preparations to mark the 75th anniversary of the establishment of the diplomatic relations in 2025.
I wish you good health and more successes in carrying out your noble heavy responsibility. -0-
