headline: Press Statement of Vice Department Director of WPK Central Committee Kim Yo Jong
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made public the following press statement "Ever-escalating military threats of hostile forces only prove the validity of our line of bolstering up nuclear forces" on Monday:
The U.S., Japan and the ROK frantically staged a combined air drill targeting our Republic once again in front of us on November 3.
Various fighter jets of the three countries, led by U.S. strategic bomber B-1B, were involved in the drill under the signboard of "counteraction" and "warning" to our latest strategic weapon test. They reportedly got familiar with the "mode of promptly and correctly striking" the simulated opponent's core objects.
The military gangsters of the ROK declared that they would further tighten the triangular military cooperation against us in the future, blustering "the drill showcased the strong countering will and capability based on the ROK-U.S.-Japan security cooperation, as well as the integrated extended deterrence execution faculty of the ROK-U.S. alliance to counter and deter ever-escalating nuclear and missile threats from the north."
This is just another outright action-based explanation of the most hostile and dangerous aggressive nature of the enemy toward our Republic and, at the same time, another absolute proof of the validity and urgency of the line of building up the nuclear forces we have opted for and put into practice.
Today upset of the balance of power between rivals on the Korean peninsula and in the region precisely means a war. And this is an undeniable objective reality.
I point out once again that the U.S. and its followers held more than 20 rounds of various war confabs to map out plans for using nuclear weapons against our state this year alone and ceaselessly staged one hundred and tens of anti-DPRK military drills all the year round to implement them.
The drastically increased number of war rehearsals like Freedom Edge, the first multi-domain joint military exercises between the U.S., Japan and the ROK, and Iron Mace, a nuclear operation drill simulating an all-out nuclear war on the Korean peninsula, posed a serious threat to not only our state but also regional peace and security.
This year nuclear aircraft carrier strike groups, including the one of Theodore Roosevelt, were deployed near the Korean peninsula three times and the nuclear-powered strategic submarine Vermont made its first appearance in the ROK, while B-52H and other nuclear-capable strategic bombers flied in the sky above the Korean peninsula five times, updating once again the recent records of deployment of U.S. strategic assets.
The critical security environment facing our state eloquently proves the inevitability of the strategic choice made by us to creditably defend our state's security and regional peace from the U.S. and its followers' aggressive and adventuristic military threats.
The ever-escalating hysteric military threats of the rivals will further highlight the justness and urgency of our line and it will be implemented in corresponding dynamic and intensity.
The line of bolstering up the self-defensive nuclear deterrent, being pursued by the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, is the most correct, one and only choice made by it in the current situation, and we will never vacillate in that way. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on November 1.
The message said:
I express my deep thanks to you for extending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 79th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Expressing belief that the long-standing friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and the two countries would continue to develop in the future, too, I wish you success in your responsible work for strengthening the party and achieving the prosperity of the country. -0-

headline: To  Provide Highly-civilized Living Conditions for People
Permanent Mission of DPRK at UN Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The permanent mission of the DPRK at the UN released the following press statement on Wednesday:
Recently the European Union submitted again a "resolution" taking issue with the human rights situation in the DPRK to the Third Committee of the 79th Session of the UN General Assembly.
The EU, at the instigation of the U.S., has annually conducted such moves as submitting "human rights resolution" against the DPRK for more than 20 years. This is a politically-motivated provocation aimed to tarnish the image of the dignified DPRK and bring down its ideology and social system under the signboard of "human rights protection".
The DPRK permanent mission at the UN categorically rejects the "resolution" submitted by the EU again as a document for ill-intended political propaganda and a confrontational document contrary to the UN Charter, which stipulates respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs, and to the efforts of UN member states to ensure the genuine protection and promotion of human rights through dialogue and cooperation.
Today, the World Declaration of Human Rights and universal international human rights standards have become political means for interfering in the internal affairs of other countries by the U.S. and Western countries and the genuine dignity and rights of mankind have not been realized. This reality would be unthinkable apart from the moves of the dishonest forces perverting the universal definition of human rights for their geopolitical purposes.
The harmful consequences, the European countries styling themselves "advanced nation in human rights" have inflicted on the work for protecting and promoting human rights in the world, are very serious and nothing can cover up them.
Such institutional and widespread human rights abuses as racial discrimination, sexual assault, maltreatment of immigrants, flesh traffic and police violence rampant in the European region go to clearly prove how absurd and hypocritical the gibberish about "human rights" preached by politicians in Europe are.
Many refugees, who left homes for living, lost their lives in the Mediterranean Sea and even survivors became victims of all kinds of crimes, getting cold reception and contempt, anywhere they go. This horrible reality is attributable to the bloody act of the European "human rights missionaries" who absolutely followed the U.S. strategy for hegemony.
EU, which should sit in the dock at a human rights tribunal to face severe judgment by the international community, is trying to assess and admonish over the human rights situation in other countries at will, far from reflecting on itself. This is the height of the guilty party filing the suit first and an intolerable mockery and insult to human rights.
No international law authorized EU to interfere in the internal affairs of sovereign states with its dual normative criterion.
The EU should be clearly mindful that its persistent illegal anti-DPRK "human rights" racket, pursuant to the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, will only bring to light its poor plight of being plunged deeper into "strategic subjugation", instead of "strategic autonomy".
The human rights system and situation of the DPRK are estimated by its people themselves, not by hypocrites in other continents across the ocean.
The DPRK will never tolerate any attempt of the hostile forces seeking to deprive its people of their happy and independent life with ill-minded repugnance toward the Korean-style socialist system. It will more reliably defend the genuine human rights of its people by the most responsible and proactive efforts. -0-

headline: WPK Central Committee Sends Congratulatory Message to Manpho Smeltery
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory message to the workers, technicians and officials at the Manpho Smeltery on the occasion of its 50th founding anniversary. A meeting to convey it took place on the spot on Tuesday.
Present there were Jon Hyon Chol, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials and employees at the smeltery.
Jon Hyon Chol read out the congratulatory message.
The history of the smeltery is shining more brilliantly with the course of its workers' staunch struggle and it is being firmly carried forward by the steadfast personifiers of loyalty, who have cherished the leadership exploits of the Party as their most precious treasure, the younger generation who are defending the revolutionary posts of their parents generation after generation, the message said and went on:
The smeltery has not only over-fulfilled the national economic plans every year but also carried out the orders and instructions of the Party without a single pending item in the drive for implementing the tasks set forth by the 8th Party Congress. The proud records are a clear proof of the high spiritual world and fighting spirit of its workers.
The WPK Central Committee in the message extended warm congratulations to the workers, technicians and officials at the Manpho Smeltery who are displaying boundless responsibility and devotion in carrying out the important tasks entrusted by the Party by inheriting the precious tradition of loyalty and setting an excellent example in implementing the Party's policies.
Speakers at the meeting expressed their determination to glorify with proud successes in increased production the honor and pride of receiving the congratulatory message of the WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Ryongchon Farm in Hwangju County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- New modern villages have appeared at the Ryongchon Farm in Hwangju County, North Hwanghae Province of DPRK.
The dwelling houses of various styles, built to be convenient to the living of agricultural workers while preserving the regional features, show the development of the countryside where a new life and happiness are coming into full bloom.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses were Mun Chang Il, secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials of the party and power organs and agricultural workers in Hwangju County.
Ho Yun Guk, vice-chairman of the provincial people's committee, made a congratulatory address. Then licenses for the use of houses were conveyed and speeches made.
When the moving into new houses began, a sea of cheerful dances with merry peasant music was displayed to make the villages lively. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Power Transmission and Distribution Field
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the power transmission and distribution sector of the DPRK strive to produce means necessary for ensuring the electricity supply in a stable and rational way.
The Ministry of Electric Power Industry established a cost-saving plated ware production process for ultra-high voltage transmission line tower.
It also established an efficient lightening conductor production process in a short span of time in cooperation with workers and technicians at the North Hwanghae Provincial Power Transmission and Distribution Station.
The work for installing the lightening conductors at major steel towers has been pushed forward to improve the stability of electric power supply.
The Kyongsong Electric Appliances Factory has striven to produce insulators needed for transmission of ultra-high voltage electricity.
Meanwhile, efforts are made to speed up the technical updating of industrial establishments in the power transmission and distribution field and increase the productivity of various electric equipment and accessories. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Builders Involved in Reconstruction of Flood-hit Areas in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- Members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade, service personnel and other builders, who are writing a new history of great changes and creating new civilization in the flood-hit areas of the northwestern part of the DPRK, received gifts associated with the warm love of the tender-hearted father.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the builders, who are dedicating themselves to the reconstruction of the flood-hit areas, are vanguard fighters who are taking the lead in the honorable struggle for the great people our Party holds in high esteem as Heaven. Always paying deep attention to their health and life, he visited the sites of reconstruction of flood-hit areas and took important measures to ensure the builders' living conditions. And he sent the builders even seasonal necessities.
On Nov. 4 and 5, there took place ceremonies for conveying the gifts sent byKim Jong Unto the builders involved in the reconstruction of flood-hit areas in North Phyongan Province.
Present there were Secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Jo Yong Won, Ri Il Hwan and Pak Thae Song, officials of the Party and power organs in North Phyongan Province, leading officials of the reconstruction headquarters and builders.
Speeches were made at the ceremonies.
Noting thatKim Jong Unsent gifts to the builders who are performing great feats with indomitable courage and fighting spirit, responding to the call of the Party with ardent patriotic enthusiasm, the speakers said that despite his day-and-night work to deal with a great many important Party and state affairs, the respected General Secretary is always thinking of those who are building the places of happiness for the people of the flood-hit areas.
They also noted that the sites of reconstruction of flood-hit areas in Sinuiju City and Uiju County are major thrust areas of key importance in successfully completing the campaign for the reconstruction of flood-hit areas, and that a very important issue - whether to successfully complete this year's struggle for valiantly ushering in a new era of national rejuvenation or not - hinges on the efforts of the builders. The speakers called for successfully building new houses, new villages and a durable embankment on the flood-stricken land in order to demonstrate once again to the whole world the vitality and advantages of socialism that is further consolidated in adversity.
The gifts were handed over amid the enthusiastic applause by the participants.
Then vowing speeches were made.
The speakers expressed their great excitement of having received gifts associated with the warm affection of the tender-hearted father taking care of all his people with his warm love.
They said that the noble image ofKim Jong Un, who had mapped out a gigantic reconstruction plan to relieve the people in the afflicted areas of their inconveniences as early as possible and personally attended the ceremony of seeing off the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade and showed deep trust in them, is deeply touching all the people.
The speakers vowed to build all the structures into model entities representing the Party's policy for regional development and socialist civilization in the new era, bearing deep in mind the paternal loving care and affection shown byKim Jong Un.
The meetings fully displayed the unshakable will of all the builders who are determined to defend the prestige of the Party Central Committee and fully display the advantages of Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses by performing new miracles in construction overpowering natural disaster at any cost with their patriotic enthusiasm and through a courageous struggle. -0-

More than 60 youth shock brigades at the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex, the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and other units fulfilled their yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule.
And several shock brigades have carried out their two-year national economic plans or worked hard to do so. -0-

headline: Commodity Exhibition Closes in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The 15th Commodity Exhibition at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 closed in the DPRK.
During the exhibition, its participants shared successes and experience gained in the course of improving the quality of consumer goods and accelerating the expansion of varieties, and heard the opinions of visitors.
The closing ceremony took place at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 on Nov. 5.
Minister of Commerce Kwak Jong Jun made a closing address.
Diplomas and prizes were awarded to the successful units. -0-

headline: Permanent Mission of DPRK at UN Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The permanent mission of the DPRK at the UN released the following press statement on Wednesday:
Recently the European Union submitted again a "resolution" taking issue with the human rights situation in the DPRK to the Third Committee of the 79th Session of the UN General Assembly.
The EU, at the instigation of the U.S., has annually conducted such moves as submitting "human rights resolution" against the DPRK for more than 20 years. This is a politically-motivated provocation aimed to tarnish the image of the dignified DPRK and bring down its ideology and social system under the signboard of "human rights protection".
The DPRK permanent mission at the UN categorically rejects the "resolution" submitted by the EU again as a document for ill-intended political propaganda and a confrontational document contrary to the UN Charter, which stipulates respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs, and to the efforts of UN member states to ensure the genuine protection and promotion of human rights through dialogue and cooperation.
Today, the World Declaration of Human Rights and universal international human rights standards have become political means for interfering in the internal affairs of other countries by the U.S. and Western countries and the genuine dignity and rights of mankind have not been realized. This reality would be unthinkable apart from the moves of the dishonest forces perverting the universal definition of human rights for their geopolitical purposes.
The harmful consequences, the European countries styling themselves "advanced nation in human rights" have inflicted on the work for protecting and promoting human rights in the world, are very serious and nothing can cover up them.
Such institutional and widespread human rights abuses as racial discrimination, sexual assault, maltreatment of immigrants, flesh traffic and police violence rampant in the European region go to clearly prove how absurd and hypocritical the gibberish about "human rights" preached by politicians in Europe are.
Many refugees, who left homes for living, lost their lives in the Mediterranean Sea and even survivors became victims of all kinds of crimes, getting cold reception and contempt, anywhere they go. This horrible reality is attributable to the bloody act of the European "human rights missionaries" who absolutely followed the U.S. strategy for hegemony.
EU, which should sit in the dock at a human rights tribunal to face severe judgment by the international community, is trying to assess and admonish over the human rights situation in other countries at will, far from reflecting on itself. This is the height of the guilty party filing the suit first and an intolerable mockery and insult to human rights.
No international law authorized EU to interfere in the internal affairs of sovereign states with its dual normative criterion.
The EU should be clearly mindful that its persistent illegal anti-DPRK "human rights" racket, pursuant to the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, will only bring to light its poor plight of being plunged deeper into "strategic subjugation", instead of "strategic autonomy".
The human rights system and situation of the DPRK are estimated by its people themselves, not by hypocrites in other continents across the ocean.
The DPRK will never tolerate any attempt of the hostile forces seeking to deprive its people of their happy and independent life with ill-minded repugnance toward the Korean-style socialist system. It will more reliably defend the genuine human rights of its people by the most responsible and proactive efforts. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Meets Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- DPRK Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui on an official visit to the Russian Federation met with Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, in Kremlin, Moscow on Nov. 4.
Choe Son Hui courteously conveyed warm comradely greetings of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto Vladimir Putin.
Putin asked her to convey his warm greetings toKim Jong Un.
They had a good talk over many undertakings for steadily developing the relations between the two countries and reaffirmed the will to further consolidate the DPRK-Russia friendship on a track of new comprehensive development. -0-

headline: Successes Made at Coal Mining Complexes of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The youth shock brigades at coal mining complexes in the DPRK make signal progress in production.
More than 60 youth shock brigades at the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex, the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex, the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and other units fulfilled their yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule.
And several shock brigades have carried out their two-year national economic plans or worked hard to do so. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Power Transmission and Distribution Field
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the power transmission and distribution sector of the DPRK strive to produce means necessary for ensuring the electricity supply in a stable and rational way.
The Ministry of Electric Power Industry established a cost-saving plated ware production process for ultra-high voltage transmission line tower.
It also established an efficient lightening conductor production process in a short span of time in cooperation with workers and technicians at the North Hwanghae Provincial Power Transmission and Distribution Station.
The work for installing the lightening conductors at major steel towers has been pushed forward to improve the stability of electric power supply.
The Kyongsong Electric Appliances Factory has striven to produce insulators needed for transmission of ultra-high voltage electricity.
Meanwhile, efforts are made to speed up the technical updating of industrial establishments in the power transmission and distribution field and increase the productivity of various electric equipment and accessories. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill
Central Zoo Showing Great Man's Devoted Service for People's Wellbeing
Preparations for Next Year's Farming Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- The Agricultural Commission of the DPRK intensifies its arrangements and guidance to make substantial preparations for next year's farming.
The commission is directing efforts to ensuring that all the agricultural production units provide a sure guarantee for increasing the fertility by producing much more quality organic fertilizer. It is also pays attention to rounding off the preparations for seedbed materials on all indices.
It is organizing the work to secure and store high-yielding seeds of various kinds, to readjust and reinforce irrigation facilities, to speed up the repair and maintenance of farm machines, and to secure enough medium and small farm implements.
It is making more positive and substantial measures to round off the preparations for next year's farming by the end of the year. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Successful Implementation of Programme for Rural Revolution in New Era
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article says that those in charge of rural rejuvenation to be certainly brought about by the Workers' Party of Korea are just ourselves and the programme for the rural revolution in the new era set forth by the Party is the historic cause that can be successfully accomplished only with the redoubled efforts of our generation.
The more hardships we undergo and the more we devote ourselves, the earlier the rosy future of rural rejuvenation will be brought and a solid foundation and environment for new life and new civilization will be provided, the article says, and goes on:
The successful implementation of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, vast and gigantic in scope and depth, requires the stubborn and indomitable struggle of our generation.
Today our Party is directing efforts to consolidating the material and technical foundations of the countryside, increasing state investment in the countryside and making conditions favorable for boosting the agricultural productivity by raising the hot wind of support throughout society.
We have a strong foundation and potentiality to open up a new era of rural rejuvenation.
The outstanding and seasoned leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unis the decisive guarantee for implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
It is his unshakable will that we should do everything possible and accelerate everything we can do in our generation.
Thanks to the General Secretary who illuminates the bright future of socialist rural construction and guides it one by one, the programme for the rural revolution in the new era is sure to be successfully implemented. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Nampho of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers of the Taedae Vegetable Farm and the Ryongnam Farm in Waudo District of Nampho Municipality, the DPRK, have moved into new houses at a time when new appearances of rural civilization in the era of the Workers' Party are witnessed one after the other across the country.
Those hundreds of modern houses with all living conditions and environment and peculiar styles go to clearly prove the validity and vitality of the programme for the socialist rural revolution set forth by the Party.
Ceremonies for moving into new houses took place at the farms.
Congratulatory addresses were made there with the attendance of Choe Ung Chol, secretary of the Nampho Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Rim Yong Man, vice-chairman of the municipal people's committee, and officials of the Party and power organs and agricultural workers in Waudo District.
Then licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches made.
There were peasant dances and officials visited new houses to share joy with the owners. -0-

headline: National Wheat Flour Foods Show Continues in DPRK
DPRK Foreign Minister Back Home
Women's Union Officials Conduct Political Work at Housing Construction Sites
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- Officials and primary information workers of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) across the DPRK launched the political work in the Hwasong area of Pyongyang.
The SWUK Central Committee organized a political work contest among officials and primary information workers of the union from different parts of the country at sites for building 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area.
Union officials of Pyongyang conducted information and motivation activities with poems, songs and other artistic works.
Those from North Phyongan and Jagang provinces represented the deep reverence for the benevolent father who visited the construction sites to provide the inhabitants in the flood-hit areas with new dwelling houses as early as possible.
Those from North Hwanghae and North Hamgyong provinces ardently called upon the builders to make a dynamic advance to move up the day when they would inform the Party of the completion.
Women's union officials from South Hwanghae, South Hamgyong, Ryanggang, South Phyongan and Kangwon provinces and Kaesong, Nampho and Rason municipalities boosted the builders' enthusiasm through their vigorous political work. -0-

headline: Jongsong General Pharmaceutical Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- The Jongsong General Pharmaceutical Factory in the DPRK is a modern base for producing medicines conducive to the promotion of people's health and the preventive and curative medical care for them.
The factory is associated with the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho has devoted himself to the production of quality medicines.
One day in November 2014, the General Secretary visited the factory and learnt in detail about its production and management while looking round various production lines.
He appreciated that its officials and employees have produced efficient medicines and strictly and responsibly examined them with the latest equipment after establishing a modern medicine examination center and put the overall production lines on an automated, germ-free and dust-free basis on a high level.
He set forth the tasks facing the factory, saying that it has an important duty and role to play in further displaying the advantages of the socialist public health system and developing the country's pharmaceutical industry.
True to his instructions, the factory has made successes in increasing the proportion of locally available raw materials and equipment more than the past by giving priority to science and technology and making technological innovations.
It has increased the production of liquid medicine and the kinds of officinal medicines and improved their qualities. Its production processes for injections and capsule medicines won the GMP authentication. -0-

headline: National Wheat Flour Foods Show Continues in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- A national wheat flour foods show is going on in the DPRK. It was opened at the Chongchun Restaurant on Nov. 5.
The show brought together 50 public catering establishments selected from ministries, national agencies and all the provinces and the Pyongyang municipal committee of the women's union.
It includes a flour food show, an exchange of cookery (including sale) and a flour food cookery demonstration by cooks and housewives. -0-

headline: Trade Union Shock Brigade Campaign Launched in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- The South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea launched a trade union shock brigade campaign.
The committee has conducted effective political work to ensure that trade unions at all levels organize shock brigades in conformity with the actual conditions by following the examples of the advanced units and make substantial contributions to implementing the Party's policies.
The Kowon Coal Mine trade union shock brigade is striving to carry out its plan for the second half of the year while over-fulfilling the tunneling plan every day and every month.
The trade union organizations at the Komdok Mining Complex organized the Cha Kwang Su trade union shock brigade and trained dozens of union members as labor innovators and made sure that they took a big share in the project for expanding the capacity for transporting ore.
Similar innovations are made by the trade union shock brigades in Hamhung City and other areas. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren's Rabbit Show Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 8 (KCNA) -- The 2024 national rabbit show and experience-sharing workshop of Children's Union organizations and schoolchildren took place at the training institute of the Central Committee of the youth league on Nov. 6 and 7.
Present there were officials of the youth league in the capital, provinces, cities and counties, instructors of the school Children's Union organizations and schoolchildren who set an example in raising rabbits.
The show was held in the way of examining and evaluating new breeds of rabbits raised by schoolchildren from across the country at the extra-curricular time.
The workshop heard experience, gained in breeding good breeds of rabbits and introducing scientific breeding methods while providing nutritious feed, and successes made in reducing the death rate by taking veterinary and anti-epidemic measures and laying such material and technical foundations as feed processing equipment.
The participants watched a video on good deeds of pupils and students of various schools who have conducted a brisk rabbit-breeding campaign. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Makes Achievements in Land Management
FA Cup Tournament Ends in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 8 (KCNA) -- The FA (Football Association) Cup tournament, started on October 25, came to a close in the DPRK.
Taking part in the tournament were the national men's and women's football teams which have contributed to the country's football development with successes in the DPRK Championships and premier league football matches.
In the men's football matches, the Ryomyong Team came first, the Amnokgang Team second and the Hwaebul Team third.
In the women's football matches, the April 25 Team took the first place, the Amnokgang Team the second place and the Pyongyang Team the third place.
Trophies and medals were conferred on the successful teams and footballers at an awarding ceremony held atKim Il SungStadium on Thursday. -0-

headline: Efforts Paid to Securing Raw Materials for Regional-Industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 8 (KCNA) -- North and South Hwanghae provinces of the DPRK are pushing ahead with the work to secure raw materials needed for the operation of regional-industry factories.
South Hwanghae Province has already carried out its overall plan for securing raw materials by more than 85 percent.
The province finished farming at raw material bases to secure raw materials for cultivation as planned and conducted a mass movement to collect wild fruits.
North Hwanghae Province has increased the area of oil-producing crops this year.
It has waged an emulation drive among cities and counties to achieve successes in securing oil-bearing materials. -0-

headline: 549th Triplets Born at Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in DPRK
story_text:

The mother of triplets is Kim Hyang Mi living in the neighborhood unit No. 21 in Puksam-ri, Phihyon County, North Phyongan Province, and their father Kim Chun Gil is a peasant of the Puksam Farm.

The triplets weighed 1.9kg, 2kg and 1.9kg at birth and over 4kg each 60 days after.

headline: Central Tree Nursery
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- The Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection is a leading sapling production base of the DPRK, in which sapling production has been put on a high scientific, industrial and intensive basis.
The tree nursery is associated with the patriotic devotion made by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto turn all mountains of the country into gold and treasure mountains.
The General Secretary visited the Central Tree Nursery on November 10, 2014 and gave invaluable instructions concerning the tree nursery operation, including the one of expanding the sapling production base to produce more saplings and the one of perfecting the tree planting and cultivating method suited to the specific features of the country.
He set forth important tasks for covering the whole country with trees and flowers and ardently called upon all the Party members, service personnel and people to turn out as one in a campaign for forest restoration, regarding it as a campaign to conserve nature.
The patriotic appeal of the peerlessly great man aroused all the people to the forest restoration and brought about a radical turn in the tree nursery work as well.
Officials and employees of the tree nursery built a new seed selection and sowing ground and expanded the area of outdoor cultivation ground to lay a material foundation for increasing the sapling production several times the past's.
They also studied and adopted a new method of optimizing the growth conditions of saplings and raising their survival rate.
The tree nursery has produced a large number of saplings and sent them to different parts of the country every year. -0-

headline: Successful DPRK Women Players Return Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- The DPRK's promising women footballers won the title of the 2024 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in the wake of the 2024 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup by making strenuous efforts with a burning desire to live up to the expectations of the country and the people. As a result, women footballers have won four trophies this year to fully display the reserved strength and prospects of development as Asian and world champions.
A DPRK woman boxer bagged a gold medal in the women's 60kg category event of the IBA Youth World Boxing Championships 2024. Other remarkable successes in various international games this year added a wonderful and remarkable page to the history of the development of Juche-oriented physical culture and sports.
The successful DPRK players returned home on Nov. 9.
At Pyongyang International Airport, there were many people who turned out to welcome the players who won victories in international games through their strong spiritual strength and strenuous offensive peculiar to Juche Korea and glorified the powerful DPRK with gold medals.
Present at the stopping place were Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports of the DPRK, members of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials concerned, officials in the sports field and families of the players.
When the plane arrived, sportspersons and working people put garlands around the necks of the players and coaches and presented bouquets to them amid the playing of song "Our National Flag".
The parents hugged their children, sports stars of the country who brought their dreams, hopes and talents into full bloom under the loving care of the Party.
The sportspersons, who demonstrated the ever-victorious spirit and reputation of the dignified DPRK, left Pyongyang International Airport on a splendidly-decorated open vehicle.
Along streets, Pyongyang citizens, students and children warmly congratulated the players who created another sensation in the world sport circles.
The sportspersons, who received warm affection and congratulations from the whole country, extended their warm greetings to the citizens with excitement and the desire to glorify the country with more gold medals. -0-

headline: Tenth Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Field Guidance at Central Tree Nursery Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place on Nov. 9 to mark the tenth anniversary of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection.
Present there were Kim Kyong Jun, minister of Land and Environment Protection, officials concerned and officials and employees of the tree nursery.
Ri Yong Sik, manager of the tree nursery, made a report.
He said that the General Secretary, who inspected the Central Tree Nursery on November 10, 2014 with a far-reaching plan to cover all mountains of the country with green woods, bestowed deep trust on the tree nursery by tasking it with a big role in covering the whole country with trees and flowers, and indicated the tasks and ways for doing so.
The General Secretary paid deep attention to sapling production at the tree nursery, sent good species of saplings and seeds to it and guided its modernization including the construction of its outdoor cultivation ground, the reporter noted.
The reporter recalled that the officials and employees of the tree nursery have made a positive contribution to the country's forest restoration with their sincere patriotic efforts for the past decade, true to the instructions given byKim Jong Unduring his field guidance.
He called upon all officials and employees to defend and glorify the leadership exploits of the Party and steadily raise the scientific, industrial and intensive level of sapling production so as to contribute to covering the whole country with trees and flowers.
He stressed the need to continuously revitalize the modern production base to increase the production of saplings of high economic and ornamental value in a planned way and send more saplings to various sectors of the national economy and grand socialist construction sites.
He called upon all the officials and employees to discharge their responsibility and duty in turning all mountains of the country into gold and treasure mountains covered with thick woods by displaying patriotism, true to the ideology and leadership ofKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Activities for Creation and Management of Forests Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 11 (KCNA) -- Officials and researchers of the Academy of Forest Science in the DPRK are conducting sci-tech activities for creating forests of economic value and managing them.
The academy has organized a nationwide workshop and provincial shows through video conferencing and on the spot to help the officials, technicians and employees in relevant cities and counties know well about the scientific and technological problems arising in the creation and management of forests of economic value and apply them to the reality.
Many seedlings and scions of trees with high economic value were sent to cities and counties. Researchers have scrupulously conducted technical guidance on tree-planting, manuring and tending and grafting on the spots to raise the rooting rate of planted trees and alive rate of grafts.

headline: All-people Action for Impeaching Puppet Yoon Suk Yeol Launched in Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 11 (KCNA) -- A massive public protest is getting stronger across the puppet ROK to resolutely punish puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, who is making desperate efforts to tide over the ruling crisis through fascist dictatorship while attempting to ignite a war of aggression against the DPRK with the backing of the U.S. and Japan.
The 114th candlelight rally and demonstration march demanding the impeachment of Yoon took place in Seoul under the sponsorship of the candlelight action.
Attending it were more than 100 000 people from all walks of life, including members of public organizations, citizens, youth and children and lawmakers from opposition parties.
The venues of the rally and demonstration march were full of voices of participants denouncing puppet Yoon for evading the responsibility for all sorts of crimes he has committed by bringing the danger of war, pursuing fascist dictatorship, plunging the people's living into destitution and causing various disasters, in disregard of the public demand for his impeachment.
The public anger at the war maniac, lunatic dictator and evil killer was also manifested at the rally for marking the "Day of second people's action" held under the sponsorship of the Minju Party.
Nearly 200 000 people from all walks of life took part in the rally, holding candles and such posters as "No War! For Peace!", "Impeach Yoon Suk Yeol!" and "Investigate Kim Kon Hui!"
Representatives of opposition parties in solidarity speeches condemned puppet Yoon's deceptive talk, calling for bringing to court the graft cases, impeaching Yoon and conducting ad-hoc investigation into the scandal related to Kim Kon Hui.
The Minju Party adopted a resolution calling for checking the war provocation and passing the law on special investigation into the case of Kim Kon Hui.
Meanwhile, the South Jolla Provincial Branch of the Minju Party launched a 10 million signature campaign for passing the law on special investigation into the Kim's case, and the Jinbo (progressive) Party and other opposition parties joined the action for impeachment.
A large-scale all-out people's action was staged to impeach without fail puppet Yoon threatening the lives and security of the people through a murderous rule.
More than 130 000 workers, peasants, poor people, civic organizations and members of political parties took part in the first general meeting for ousting Yoon Suk Yeol and the workers' rally held in Seoul under the co-sponsorship of the Confederation of Trade Unions, the People's Action and the headquarters of the movement for resignation of Yoon Suk Yeol.
The participants, holding such posters as "Let's prevent war through impeachment!" and "Let's make a plaza for impeaching Yoon Suk Yeol!", condemned puppet Yoon for the crimes he has committed since he took office by staging nuclear war drills with the U.S., destroying trade unions and lives of peasants and pursuing the prosecution-based dictatorship.
The participants in the rally declared an action for punishing puppet Yoon and staged a demonstration march, chanting such slogans as "Let's drive out the Yoon Suk Yeol regime!", "Let's oust the Yoon Suk Yeol and Kim Kon Hui clan with one million people's candlelight within this year!", etc.
The puppet media said that political parties and workers' circles joined the candlelight rally sponsored by public organizations, including the candlelight action and people's action, expanding the size of the struggle, adding that the action for impeaching Yoon Suk Yeol, involving workers, peasants and political parties, is growing stronger, and large-scale resistance and general meeting of angry people will be held on Nov. 16. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in Kangwon Province

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 11 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected various units in Kangwon Province of the DPRK.

Going round the Kosan County Raw Materials Base Station, he called for raising the per-hectare yield at the raw materials bases by manuring and tending crops in a scientific and technological way and improving the management method to ensure the normal operation of regional-industry factories.

He said that the Ogye Farm, the forest management station and the goat farm in Anbyon County should make steady preparations for next year's farming on the basis of successes, experience and lessons in this year's farming, create forests in a profitable way so as to contribute to the economic development and the improvement of people's living standards in the region and increase the milk production by holding fast to the four main links of the stockbreeding development, including the securing of supra-species and the supplying of feed.
Learning about the judicial administration of the Anbyon County People's Committee, he stressed the need for the deputies to fulfill their mission and duty as servants of the people and conduct diverse education in law observance with the main emphasis on establishing the law-abiding climate among the masses and, in particular, decisively enhance the role of members in charge of law explanation. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Activities for Creation and Management of Forests Brisk in DPRK
story_text:

The academy has organized a nationwide workshop and provincial shows through video conferencing and on the spot to help the officials, technicians and employees in relevant cities and counties know well about the scientific and technological problems arising in the creation and management of forests of economic value and apply them to the reality.

headline:

story_text:

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the machine-building industry of the DPRK have made successes in the production of custom-built equipment needed for production revitalization, adjustment and reinforcement in various economic sectors.
Those of the Ryongsong Machine Complex strive to produce compressors for coal mines in cooperation with the members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians.
The Taean Heavy Machine Complex produces in a responsible manner the custom-built equipment needed for the capacity expansion and modernization of industrial establishments in electric power and metallurgical industries and for regional-industry factories.
The Ranam Coal-mining Machine Factory produces and supplies the mining equipment in good time.
The Anju Pump Factory is speeding up the production of various kinds of pumps, and the Rakwon Oxygen Separator Factory of the Rakwon General Machine Enterprise is pushing ahead with the production of air conditioners.
Similar successes have been made by the Tongrim Mining Machine Factory and other industrial establishments in the sector of machine-building industry. -0-

headline: Mothers Lead Worthwhile Life in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- November 16 is Mother's Day in the DPRK.
On this occasion, tens of millions of children of the DPRK are extending warm congratulations and thanks to their mothers who have devoted their warm love and affection to their families and society.
Mothers have led a worthwhile life as heroines of the country and meritorious persons of socialist patriotism decade after decade under the care of the peerlessly great men.
PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilopened up a noble world of prioritizing and respecting women and led them to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the education of their children and socialist construction all their lives.
Now, mothers are leading a more brilliant life, blessed by the times, under the loving care of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The respected General Secretary saw to it that November 16 was instituted as Mother's Day and the Fourth National Conference of Mothers was held on the occasion of the first Mother's Day. It is the day when the President made a speech "The Duty of Mothers in the Education of Children" at the First National Conference of Mothers.
Attaching great significance to the position and duty of mothers in the struggle for the advance of the revolution and the prosperity of the country, he provided invaluable guidelines at the Sixth Congress of the Democratic Women's Union of Korea and other major meetings to enable the mothers to fulfil their responsibility and role as a powerful force in the development of the state and society.
At the Fifth National Conference of Mothers, he glorified the ordinary lives of mothers with the title of communist mother and praised them as architects of the era of a dignified powerful nation.
The healthcare facilities built at the best level for mothers and children and the ever-deepening state care of the heroines who raise many children are all associated with the loving care of the respected General Secretary.
Mothers are saying aloud that their dignity, happiness and future are guaranteed under the benevolent care of the respected General Secretary. -0-

headline: Korean Women Leading Worthwhile Life
DPRK Taekwon-Do Players Return Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- DPRK players returned home on Thursday after taking part in the 9th International Martial Arts Games held in Uzbekistan.
DPRK players, who competed in the senior category events of "Taekwon-Do World Cup-2024", took the first place in the men's team pattern and team sparring matches. Wang Myong Guk and Kim Jong Gun won the men's individual pattern competitions second and third degrees and Pak Ryon Song came first in women's individual pattern competition second degree.
Jo Kuk Hyon, Sin Yun Hyok and Wang Myong Guk took the first place in the men's 78 kg, 92 kg, and 92+ kg individual sparring matches, while Pak Ryon Song and Kim Yu Jong came first in the women's 57 kg and 77 kg individual sparring matches.
Jong Won Pom and Pak Su Jong bagged gold medals in the senior category events of the15th Juvenile, Youth, Senior and Veteran World Championships and 15th Children's World Cup of the World Karate Confederation.
They were greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Kum Chol, secretary general of the Cabinet who is member of the National Sports Guidance Committee, officials of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee and their families. -0-

headline: DPRK Cabinet Hosts Reception for Successful Players
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- The Cabinet of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea hosted a reception at the Okryu Restaurant here on Thursday in welcome of the players who won the 2024 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup and the IBA Youth World Boxing Championships 2024.
Present there were Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Sin Yong Chol, secretary general of the Football Association, Kim Won Chol, secretary general of the Boxing Association, players and coaches of the football and boxing players teams, their families, officials concerned, officials in the sports field and others.
Kim Tok Hun made a congratulatory address.
He congratulated the women’s footballers and boxers and coaches upon adding shine to powerful Korea by winning gold medals in international games and reporting the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unon their successes.
He expressed belief and conviction that all the players and coaches would steadily fly the national flag of the dignified DPRK in the international games in future, too.
Jon Il Chong and Son Su Rim in their reply addresses expressed their determination to further demonstrate the dignity and honor of the great state with gold medals by steadily putting spur to training with no satisfaction over the already-won successes. -0-

headline: Many Model Youth Workteams and Subworkteams Produced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, many young people have volunteered to work in socialist countryside after the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea in January 2021 and hundreds of model youth workteams and model youth sub-workteams have been produced in the country.
Since more than 140 youths in Nampho Municipality volunteered to work at 20-odd farms in the municipality in March 2021, many young people across the country have volunteered to work in the socialist countryside.
Hundreds of units, including the youth workteam at the Ryongrim Farm in Mundok County of South Phyongan Province and the youth sub-workteam at the Hakso Farm in Yomju County of North Phyongan Province that distinguished themselves in carrying out the three-revolution tasks of ideology, technology and culture and the state grain production plan, won the honor of model youth sub-workteam (workteam) and twice and thrice model youth sub-workteams (workteams). -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Performance Test of Suicide Attack Drones of Various Types
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided on the spot the performance test of suicide attack drones of various types produced by an affiliated institute of the Unmanned Aerial Technology Complex (UATC) and enterprises on Nov. 14.
He was accompanied by Ri Pyong Chol and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and other senior officials of the C.C., WPK and the general manager of the UATC.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Ungot firsthand information on the attack drones under development and watched the test.
The suicide attack drones to be used within different striking ranges are to perform a mission to precisely attack any enemy targets on the ground and in the sea.
In the test, the drones of various types precisely hit the targets after flying along different preset tactical routes in striking ranges.
Expressing satisfaction with the tactical and technical characteristics and data of the newly developed drones,Kim Jong Unhighly appreciated the fact that the UATC has achieved remarkable successes in promoting the objects the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and the Party Central Military Commission decided and instructed to the defence industry. Then he underscored the need to build a serial production system as early as possible and go into full-scale mass production.
He said: The competition for using drones as the main means of military capabilities by introducing innovative technology is being accelerated in the world. It is easy to use them as a component of striking power in a new domain due to their ever-expanding range of use in military activities, low production cost and simple production lines. The military authorities in the world will probably recognize that the drones are achieving clear successes in big and small conflicts. This is a trend that has emerged as an essential requirement in military aspect nowadays.
Such objective change urgently calls for updating many parts of military theory, practice and education and keenly calls upon the fields of defence science and education to redouble the prompt practical action and efforts, he said.
He affirmed that the DPRK has full possibility and potentiality to produce and introduce various types of drones and it would find a prospect of combining and applying new and promising tactical methods in the aspect of tactics as required by modern warfare, too.
He said that the WPK has recently attached importance to the line of perfectly combining unmanned military hardware systems with operational plans and war principle in a military policy way and steadily supplemented and completed them. He referred to the plan of the Party Central Committee on developing unmanned military hardware and set forth a crucial strategic policy for implementing it.
His on-site guidance at the work of the Unmanned Aerial Technology Complex serves as a landmark occasion that gave fresh vitality to the struggle for firmly defending the sovereignty and security of our Republic by dynamically promoting the qualitative development of the unmanned military hardware systems that are practical and essential in bolstering up the national defence capabilities and actively deterring and controlling potential challenges and threats in all aspects with their absolute superiority. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Regional-Industry Factories under Construction in Jaeryong County
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at regional-industry factories under construction in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province on Nov. 14.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Yong Su, Kim Yo Jong and Pak Song Chol, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, and Pak Kwang Ju, general officer of the Korean People's Army.
He was greeted on the spot by Jo Yong Chol, minister of Regional Industry, the chief secretary of the Jaeryong County Committee of South Hwanghae Province of the WPK, the chairperson of the county people's committee and the commanding officers of KPA unit engaged in the construction project.
Thanks to the dynamic struggle of the service personnel, who have turned out with confidence in the drive to carry out the grandiose historic task of implementing the regional development policy in the new era set forth by the Party Central Committee with brilliant fruition, regional-industry factories demonstrate their vivid appearance in 20 cities and counties across the country day after day, symbolizing the Korean-style civilization and prosperity and emerging like mushrooms after rain.
Officers and men engaged in the construction of the regional-industry factories in Jaeryong County, too, are making successes by dynamically pushing ahead with the project, while directing all efforts to raising the quality of the final process of construction in order to thoroughly implement the important instructions of the Party Central Committee on ensuring the highest quality in the construction of regional-industry factories.
Going round the construction sites of the foodstuff and daily necessities factories,Kim Jong Unlearned in detail about the construction and the manufacture and assembling of equipment.
He highly appreciated and expressed his heartfelt thanks to the soldier-builders, who are creating precious and perfect entities to be handed down to posterity as the people's wealth by displaying their strength, wisdom and enthusiasm in the worthwhile construction project to bring about a great epochal change, faithful to their great sense of responsibility that they turned out in the first year's struggle of the proud regional development revolution.
It is important for all the builders to enhance their responsibility and role more than ever before as the end of the year is near and the completion of the factories is at the final stage, he said, stressing repeatedly that they should overcome the hastiness and push ahead with the construction more deliberately to ensure the quality of the construction to the last.
After acquainting himself with the manufacture and assembling of equipment, he said that the work should not be a mere review of the results. He stressed the need to manufacture all equipment at the highest quality and conduct their installation and test-run in a responsible manner so as to keep them in full-capacity operation from the first stage of the management of the factories.
He learned in detail about the preparations for operating regional-industry factories including the training of technicians and skilled workers, farming in raw materials bases and the securement of raw materials for normalizing production and indicated the scientific orientation and ways for solving knotty problems.
He said: The factories should go into production as soon as they are completed and prove their worth from the beginning. All preparations should be made persistently and steadily to ensure a full operation of the factories, thus bringing about a substantial change in the living of the regional people with successful fruition from the first year of the 10-year revolution for regional development.
He said that the construction of the regional-industry factories is a far-reaching policy of the Party and a historic task for realizing the centuries-old desire of the regional people, not merely the construction work. He noted that it is more precious to ask about a clean conscience before discussing only the result figures in the construction of the factories, adding that if one devotes patriotic sweat and sincere efforts to the construction of the factories, the eye-opening era of regional change will surely come true.
Kim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that the soldier-builders full of ardent patriotism and loyalty and the spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies would successfully adorn the first year of implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy by waging a dynamic and courageous struggle.
Officers and men of the unit pledged to fully display the mental disposition of the KPA which is always boundlessly loyal to the leadership ofKim Jong Unand the great Party at all construction sites and thus leave patriotic footprints in the sacred revolutionary struggle for the prosperity of the country and happiness of posterity. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Branch Representatives
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the participants in the 2024 Conference of Representatives of Branches of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on Nov. 10.
The letter said that thanks to the leadership of the respected Marshal over the building of the basic organizations of Chongryon, it was possible to glorify the conference as an epochal occasion in raising the function and role of the branches in every way and putting the work of the branches on a new stage.
It stressed that they would build all the branches into lively organizations full of national character, devote time and effort to the national education, the mainstay of the movement of Koreans in Japan, and conduct vigorous activities for preserving the excellent folk customs and tradition of the Korean nation, thus making the compatriots of all ages and both sexes live as genuine Koreans having the soul of the DPRK and the nation.
It expressed the will to further develop the movement for creating patriotic examples in a new heyday into a movement for intensifying the branches of new type and thus turn the appearance of the branches into the ones embracing all the masses of compatriots as masters.
It said that all the members of the branch committees and officials of the basic organizations of Chongryon would achieve innovative successes in the work of the branches to bring about a new era of prosperity of Chongryon by displaying high sense of responsibility and devotion, true to the important instructions of the respected Marshal, and thus repay his great love and trust with patriotic loyalty. -0-

Conference of Representatives of Chongryon Branches Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- The 2024 conference of representatives of branches of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on November 10.
Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently director of its Organization Department, vice-chairpersons, officials of central organizations of Chongryon and its affiliates, headquarters and branches and chiefs of branches of Chongryon and the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan and other delegates.
Ho Jong Man said in his address that the conference of representatives of Chongryon branches, which has a history and tradition of 63 years since the first conference of activists of Chongryon branches held in 1961, is a proud one unprecedented in the world history of the movement of overseas compatriots and a meeting of loyalty and patriotism demonstrating to the whole world Chongryon officials' patriotism, compatriotism and love for the younger generation.
He said that the conference should be an important occasion for ushering in a new era of prosperity of Chongryon as desired and intended by the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
Pak Ku Ho in a report said that all branches have consistently held fast to the four major tasks for strengthening the branches set forth by the respected MarshalKim Jong Unfor the past four years since the 2020 conference of representatives of Chongryon branches and conducted the movement for creating patriotic models in the new heyday without interruption, thus making successes in sprucing up the appearance of the branches.
The next year marks the 70th anniversary of the formation of Chongryon, which is associated with the ideas on the Juche-oriented movement of overseas compatriots, outstanding leadership and noble history of compatriotism of PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the reporter said, calling for successfully greeting the anniversary with the high spirit and innovative successes of Chongryon organizations and compatriots united with loyalty and patriotism.
Then followed speeches.
Commendations were awarded to the branches, which have made successes in the movement for creating patriotic models in the new heyday in the past four years, at the conference.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas read out there. -0-

headline: Platform Given for Meritorious Women
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- A story-telling platform was given for women heroes and meritorious women of socialist patriotism at the Central Hall of Workers here on November 14.
Present there were Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, trade union officials, workers and trade union members in Pyongyang.
At the platform women heroes and meritorious women of socialist patriotism referred to the passion and love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho puts forward all the mothers of the DPRK as the most precious beings and leads them to glorify their worthwhile life in the struggle for prosperity and development of the country.
Among those meritorious women are a girl who volunteered to be a mother of dozens of orphans and has trained them to be excellent pillars of the country and a woman who has worked as a member of the road management station for a long time with pure conscience. Their deeds showed the true life and pride of the human beings in our era.
The participants were deeply moved by the story about the beautiful deed of a woman doctor who devoted her sincerity to the treatment of disabled soldiers in order to make them keep the flower of revolution in bloom.
Referring to the loving care shown by the Workers' Party of Korea which awarded to them the title of labor hero and the precious honor of meritorious persons of socialist patriotism, the performers expressed their determination to repay the Party's love and trust with invariable loyalty and patriotic practice. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Greeting to Syrian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Bashar Al-Assad, president of the Syrian Arab Republic, on November 16.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations to you and the friendly government and people of Syria on the occasion of the 54th anniversary of the corrective movement in Syria.
After the corrective movement, the Syrian people have achieved many successes in the struggle to frustrate the ever-increasing sanctions and stifling of the hostile forces and build an independent and prosperous Syria.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I express belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Syria would grow stronger in the common struggle for independence against imperialism and extend invariable support and solidarity to the Syrian people in their just cause for defending the sovereignty of the country and achieving territorial integrity. -0-

headline: Devoted Efforts for Comprehensive Mechanization of Agriculture
Mansudae Art Studio in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- November 17 is the 65th anniversary of the Mansudae Art Studio in the DPRK.
Since its foundation, the Mansudae Art Studio has developed into a comprehensive art studio of the country and a center for developing Juche-oriented fine art under the guidance of PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Its creators opened up a new path of creating works depicting the leaders through the work to erect the statues of the President and the Chairman at the highest level across the country.
The Samjiyon Grand Monument, the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Arch of Triumph, the International Friendship Exhibition House, the Sci-Tech Complex, the Natural History Museum, the Mausoleum of King Tangun and many other grand monuments and edifices are associated with the efforts of the creators.
Korean painting "An Evening Glow over Kangson", Korean jewel paintings "Snow Falls" and "Pigeon Dance", and ivory work "Mangyongdae in April" and other famous works enriched the treasure house of the Juche-oriented fine art.
Famous works of the studio were highly appreciated over 100 times at international expositions.
So the studio won Order ofKim Il Sungand Order ofKim Jong Il. And it has produced many talented creators, includingKim Il SungPrize winners,Kim Jong IlPrize winners, Labor Heroes, People's Artists and Merited Artists. -0-

headline: DPRK Newspapers Mark Mother's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- DPRK leading newspapers dedicate editorials to Mother's Day on Nov. 16.
This day, all the sons and daughters of the country extend warm congratulations and thanks to the mothers, who are beautifully cultivating the future of the country with love and devotion, with reverence for them, say papers.
The mothers, who are providing the rosy future of a powerful country while devoting themselves to bolstering up the national power and adding fresh beauty to the whole society, are the great strength of the Workers' Party of Korea and the high pride and honor of all the sons and daughters in the country, Rodong Sinmun says, and goes on:
The history of the DPRK's growth and development has recorded the devoted efforts of the mothers who overcame all sorts of difficulties and hardships with laughter, regarding their trouble as pleasure to remain faithful to the revolution, loyal to their families and upright to their children.
Families associated with the affection of mothers have firmly supported the country as cornerstone, and their selfless sincerity and devotion have served as nutritious matter for the great socialist family advancing in unity.
The mothers' spirit is strong and their spiritual world is noble, so the true nature of Korean-style socialism remains unchanged, and the pace of the country’s advance is growing longer as mothers are advancing, rallied firmly with patriotism.
Thanks to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the future of our cause of holding dear and prioritizing the posterity representing the future of the country and the mothers is brighter and the day is approaching when the DPRK will demonstrate its dignity as the best paradise where the mothers' centuries-old dreams and ideals have been realized before anything else.
Minju Joson says that as we hold the respected Comrade
Kim Jong Unin high esteem as the father of the great socialist family, the life of devotion of mothers is shining with the most sacred and precious call of communist mother, like the heroes who devoted themselves to the country. -0-

headline: Metallurgical Industry of DPRK Focuses on Expansion of Production Capacity
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- The metallurgical industry of the DPRK concentrates efforts on strengthening the production foundations.
The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry has often acquainted itself with the project for putting the production processes on a Juche basis and solved in time the problems arising in hastening the project.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex finished the repair of steel production process and has made successes in production.
The Chollima Steel Complex opened up a prospect of accelerating the construction of the melting shop building and finished technical preparations for building a UHP electric arc furnace and a new electrode production base.
The Chongjin Steel Plant and the Posan Iron Works are directing efforts to the repair of rotary kilns of various systems, and the Kangdok Fireproof Material Factory finished the construction of calcining furnace. -0-

headline: Commodity Exhibition Opens in DPRK
Japan's Bolstering of "Counterattack Capability" Imperils Its Existence: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The Japanese reactionaries are getting ever more undisguised in pursuing the wild ambition for preemptive attack, seriously disturbing regional peace and security.
The chief executive of Japan, inspecting the "Self-Defense Forces" recently, said that he would steadily carry out the bolstering of defense capabilities based on the "counterattack capability" (capability of attack on enemy bases).
The "counterattack capability" he claimed is the military capability for mounting a strike outside the attack range of rival. It is just a vivid manifestation of the scheme for a dangerous preemptive attack on other countries.
Now that the regional situation is being exacerbated due to the aggressive war drills of the U.S., Japan and the ROK against the DPRK, he unhesitatingly called for "steady bolstering" of the "capability for attack on the enemy base" right after his inauguration as prime minister. This can not be overlooked as it is another example showing that Japan's wild ambition for reinvasion and war has reached the extremes.
Japan has built up the public opinion through the absurd law interpretation since the mid-1950s that the possession of the "capability for attack on enemy base" conditionally comes within the range of self-defence, and worked covertly for its realization. It legalized the possession of "capability for attack on enemy base" with an expression "counterattack capability," a cunning trick to blur the eyes of the international community, in its three security-related documents, including the newly revised "national security strategy" in December 2022.
The 2024 defense white paper, published by Japan in July this year, said that it is the way for possessing the "attack capability on enemy base" to develop the hypersonic  long-range missile capabilities.
To this end, the Ministry of Defense of Japan recently went busy making a contract worth a fabulous amount of money with Mitsubishi Heavy Industry Co. Ltd. over glide phase interceptor (GPI) for shooting down hypersonic weapons under joint development with the U.S.
Under the signboard of "interception," Japan openly says that development of new type offensive weapons better than hypersonic weapons developed so far is to cope with the "threats from neighboring countries", thus specifying the targets of its preemptive attack.
Japan's hare-brained idea to ensure the security of Japan proper through “preemptive strike” will only make the archipelago a common target of neighboring countries.
Japan should be mindful that its bolstering of "counterattack capability" will lead to a complete loss of the chance of its "survival". -0-
