headline: Meeting for Conveying Thanks of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Held at Wonhwa Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The agricultural workers at the Wonhwa Farm in Phyongwon County harvested bumper crops this year, too, as they did last year. A meeting for conveying thanks sent by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto the agricultural workers at the Wonhwa Farm took place on the spot on November 16.
Present there were Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and officials and working people of the farm.
Ri Kyong Chol made an address conveying thanks.
The thanks sent byKim Jong Unare associated with the love and trust of the great father who makes the patriotic loyalty of the agricultural workers known to the whole country, he said.
He called upon all the officials and working people of the farm to add luster to the honor of the farm holding PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin high esteem as honorary farmers and bring about a bumper harvest every year.
Then followed speeches. -0-

headline: Mother's Day Marked in DPRK
Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following statement on November 17:
On November 16, various kinds of political agitation leaflets and dirty things sent by the ROK scum were dropped in many areas near the southern border and even in the depth area of the DPRK.
A continuous report of this was made from various parts all day long yesterday.
The security forces organs in the areas where the report of discovery was made have blocked the relevant districts and are conducting the work for searching, gathering and disposal.
We strongly denounce the shameful and dirty acts of the ROK scum who committed the provocation of scattering anti-DPRK political and conspiratorial agitation things once again in disregard of our repeated warnings.
There will be no house owner who hardly gets enraged at such dirty rubbish scattered in the clean yard, which even a mutt dislikes to touch.
The inviolable territory of the DPRK is being polluted, and much labor had to be used in disposing of these wastes.
There is a limit to patience.
The DPRK people's anger at the most disgusting curs has reached the extremes.
The scum will have to pay a dear price. -0-

story_text:

headline: Mother's Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The people across the DPRK significantly greeted the Mother's Day amid the struggle for the prosperity and development of the country and the promotion of the people's well-being.
The sons and daughters of the country extended warm congratulations to their mothers in reflection of sincere thanks.
People entered the plaza park of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state and paid tribute to them, recollecting their revolutionary exploits.
Many people visited the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and in different parts of the country and mosaics depicting their images to pay floral tribute to them.
Officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea and union officials in different parts of the country spent a pleasant time at baby homes and orphanages and  families of women prolific of children.
Colorful performances were given in Pyongyang and provinces on the occasion of the Mother's Day.
Souvenir shops, flower shops and flower stands across the country were crowded with those buying bouquets and flowers to be presented to their mothers.
Public catering establishments across the country provided peculiar services for mothers, and cultural and emotional life bases were full of the laughter and optimism of those greeting the Mother’s Day. -0-

headline: Manuring Fruit Trees Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people of various fruit farms of the DPRK are directing efforts to the preparations for increasing fruit production next year. They pay attention to ensuring the nutritive conditions of fruit trees.
The fruit farms in Pukchong and Kwail counties are putting manure on fruit trees in compliance with technical regulations.   They apply chemical and organic fertilizers in a good mixture ratio to preserve the nutritive state of fruit trees and promote the floral bud differentiation and raise the fruiting rate.
The Onchon Fruit Farm, which has produced quality organic fertilizers by establishing a ring-shaped rotation production system of fruit and livestock farming, rationally allocate manpower and delivery means.
The Pyongyang Fruit Farm boosts the enthusiasm of producers through a socialist emulation drive. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Rural Village of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Modern houses have been built at the Yakjon Farm in Sukchon County, South Phyongan Province, the DPRK, making a new appearance of creating our style of civilization.
The changes of the villages demonstrate the validity and vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's policy, which set it as an important political task to turn all the rural villages across the country into rich and cultured ideal socialist villages.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses were Kim Man Jo, secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials and agricultural workers of Sukchon County.
At the ceremony, a congratulatory address was made. Then, licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches were made.
Amid a cheerful dancing party, officials visited the owners of the new houses to share joy with them. -0-

headline: Russian Government Delegation Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- A Russian government delegation headed by Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, arrived here on Nov. 17 to take part in the 11th meeting of the committee.
The flags of the DPRK and the Russian Federation were fluttering at the flagstaffs of Pyongyang International Airport.
The delegation was warmly greeted by Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, officials concerned and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK and staff members of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Technology of Producing Potassic Compound Fertilizer Established
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK has established a new technology of producing potassic compound fertilizer with rich domestic raw materials.
The new technology ensures less production cost and energy consumption.
Its application showed that the fertilizer helped to raise the yield of rice, maize, wheat and barley.
The academy has also made progress in the research into developing the technology of locally producing potassium hydroxide, the basic raw material of nutrient solution needed at large-scale greenhouse farms, and producing potassium fertilizer and alumina simultaneously with less energy. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Speech Before Those Attending Fourth Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of Korean People’s Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, made a speech on November 15, titled, On the Prevailing Situation and the Tasks of the Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Armed Forces of the Republic, before those attending the Fourth Conference of the Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Korean People’s Army.
All the battalion commanders and political instructors of the armed forces of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea,
Commanders of the military and political organs at all levels of the armed forces of the Republic,
Comrades,
At the historic time, when the prestige and honour of our legendary army is being fully demonstrated in all the theatres of the revolution seething with struggles and transformations, the Fourth Conference of the Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Korean People’s Army has been convened.
First, on behalf of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the Workers’ Party of Korea, I extend warm congratulations to all the battalion commanders and political instructors of the Republic’s armed forces attending this conference.
I also send my warm greetings to all the officers and men of the army, who are unsparingly devoting their ardent loyalty, patriotism and efforts at their honourable outposts for defending the sovereignty of our state and at the construction sites for bringing earlier the comprehensive prosperity of socialism.
In recent years many theoretical and practical tasks have been raised to strengthen the Party, achieve the rejuvenation of the state and promote the wellbeing of the people in addition to the enormous policy-oriented tasks set forth at the congress of our Party and the plenary meetings of its Central Committee. As all these tasks had to be tackled after finding out the correct ways and means through sincere and painstaking efforts, I have always been busy.
However, I have come here today without any regret to see you, who have gathered in Pyongyang, and I am very glad about it.
Why do we attach such importance and special concern to this gathering of the battalion commanders and political instructors?
It can be explained in various ways, but the main reason is that you are our Party’s loyal revolutionary fighters, who are firmly and silently consolidating the cornerstone for increasing the military capability while experiencing more difficulties than any others at the grass-roots level of our armed forces.
Battalions are at the lowest level in the military organizational system and command system for realizing the Party’s leadership over the army, but the Party and the country have always regarded you as being in very important positions.
Battalions are not large, but the pure and ardent patriotism and loyalty of their commanders and political instructors, who are leading their men and treading the road of devotion unknown to others as they live in the large family of the Party, revolution, country and socialism, constitute the sustenance for the high honour and military feats of our armed forces.
Exactly ten years have passed since the Third Conference of the Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Korean People’s Army was held.
Looking back, over the past ten years our Party, country and people have wrought miracles and transformations in the face of every manner of trials and challenges that could not be described but as being unprecedented. All these are imprinted on the course of struggle of our army that has lived up to its precious appellation as the army of the Party by shouldering by itself the two fronts of national defence and creation, and each page of the chronicles of these heroic feats records your unknown devoted efforts.
All the current battalion commanders and political instructors, commanding personnel of the main combat units of our revolutionary armed forces, are a generation that has grown up in this arduous yet glorious decade, when the importance of presence and feats of our army has become conspicuous.
Because you have played the leading role, our revolutionary army has written another chapter of history of pioneering the road of advance and upswing not only at the borderline posts, where friend and foe are leveling their guns directly at each other, but also on all other fronts, decisive of the future destiny of our state and people.
A precious success achieved in building up the army in these ten years is that its commanding officers, loyal and trustworthy, have been trained. They are leading the ranks of soldiers with an ennobling outlook on life that the army exists to translate the Party’s plans and determination into reality and that even though they may fall on this road, it is their glory, and with high-minded examples of death-defyingly implementing them.
Seeing you numbering thousands, the core that can be said to be representing the army’s commanding personnel grown up in our era, I am fully convinced that our armed forces’ history of loyalty and tradition of patriotism are being stoutly carried forward. I feel most pleased and satisfied with this.
As for the mightiness and promising future of the ever-victorious Korean People’s Army, the army of the Workers’ Party of Korea, there would be no clearer explanation than this.
True to the sacred mission and genuine conscience of commanding personnel of the revolutionary army, who made an oath before the state, you have overcome manifold difficulties and mental suffering to turn your battalions into elite combat units, thoroughgoing, brave and immaculate in carrying out any orders. Through this courageous struggle, you have added great strength and support to our Party. I extend gratitude to you once again for this.
Kim Jong Unstressed that our armed forces are occupying a position, for which no other forces can substitute in the present and future stages of the revolution as in the past decade, and that immutable and invariable is our Party’s stand to propel the revolution steadily and bring about an upsurge in socialist construction with the support of these reliable armed forces, adding:
Availing myself of this opportunity of meeting you, I am going to remind all the service personnel of our armed forces of their natural mission and tasks they must never forget whatever they do at any place, and brief you on how important it is to prepare your battalions well for fulfilling them and what are the tasks facing you.
Our revolutionary armed forces are now in charge of not a few fronts, every one of which is decisive of the future of our country and people and the advance of the revolution.
Among them, however, the most important is the anti-imperialist class front, and making full preparations for war is the most crucial task facing our armed forces.
This is their main front and their basic duty, for which no other forces can take their place.
The armed forces of our Republic should be prepared so thoroughly that they can foil all manner of aggressive manoeuvres by the enemy through powerful military actions wherever our national sovereignty is exercised, and that they can accomplish their tasks with credit in times of emergency.
They must never forget that the enemy will joyously take advantage of any laxity in their combat readiness to launch an attack, and the price for it will be the dear blood shed by their beloved parents, wives and children.
The more fully they are prepared for war, the more durable peace will prevail on this land, and the closer we will come to our goal of building a powerful and prosperous state.
The moment when our armed forces become fully prepared for war, our state’s sovereignty and peace will become permanent.
I would like to reiterate that preparing for war is the most important and vital of all the tasks facing our armed forces.
This is just the revolutionary armed forces’ inherent mission and duty.
Noting that the gravity of the recent developments in different parts of the world, the Korean peninsula in particular, demands that all the service personnel of the Republic’s armed forces be better prepared for war with a correct understanding of the prevailing situation,Kim Jong Unpointed to the danger of the military provocations by the United States and its vassal forces that are ratcheting up tension to an unprecedented level in pursuit of their adventurist military policy for supremacy in the peninsula, the hottest spot in the world. He went on:
As a key factor threatening peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and other regions of the Asia-Pacific, the tripartite military bloc of the United States, Japan and the ROK is more clearly revealing its menacing nature.
The United States has already converted its alliance with the ROK into a nuclear-based one and created an “Asian NATO” in haste by cementing its military ties with Japan and the ROK. And almost every day it has brought strategic military hardware and the troops of its allies, including those of NATO member states, into and around the ROK, staging intensive drills of all hues to get these forces familiarized with a war of aggression.
The strengthening of the exclusive military bloc and successive military drills simulating a real war are gradually undermining the strategic environment in the Korean peninsula. These dangerous moves by the United States, Japan and the ROK remind us of the criminal actions that NATO committed to create a security crisis in Europe by steadily expanding its military alliance system and pursuing its unjustifiable eastward advance policy.
After all, the US-led military alliance is gaining in scope to include Europe and the Asia-Pacific, and the spearhead of its aggression is being directed at our country, which is the rival most hostile to the United States and the longest belligerent state against it.
The present situation is such that there will be nothing strange about the troops of the US imperialists and their vassal countries, in times of emergency, showing themselves in the Korean peninsula under the signboard of such a military alliance as NATO, not the UN.
The US and ROK scum are approaching closer to the actions that will entail very dangerous consequences.
The United States, Japan and the ROK can never dodge the criminal responsibility for disturbing peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the region.
The United States has proven to be the ringleader of the disturbers of peace and stability, who are constantly driving the security environment in the peninsula to a labyrinth, and its evil identity as such reminds us repeatedly of what kind of strategic option we must choose to control our rivals.
The more frantic the United States’ moves of confrontation against our Republic grow, the clearer it becomes that our efforts and actions in defence of our state’s security and regional peace are justified.
Long ago, the line of building up our nuclear forces became an irreversible policy, so what remains to be done now is for these forces to get more fully ready for action so that they can carry out the mission of deterring war and the second mission at any moment.
Recently, I have clarified on several occasions the geopolitical change because of which our option can or should never be changed, and what we should do to cope with it.
We will build up our nation’s self-defence forces, the pivot of which is its nuclear capability, limitlessly and endlessly without satisfaction.
War is by no means what concerns others alone, nor is it a thing of a distant future, stressedKim Jong Un, adding:
As the United States and other Western countries are using Ukraine as a shock force in the war against Russia, we should view it as a manoeuvre to enrich their real-war experience and expand the scope of military intervention all over the world.
Currently, by sustaining their military assistance to Ukraine and Israel, the US warmongers are prolonging the wars there, in which an increasing number of countries are being involved. This aggravates the international security situation, stoking fears of a third world war.
The danger of war lurks in all parts of the planet, and no one is certain when and where it will break out.
Witnessing the use of force in Europe and the Middle East, the world recognizes that another armed conflict is most likely to erupt in the Korean peninsula.
All the levels of our armed forces should completely orient and subordinate their actions to making preparations for war, going all out to perfect them as soon as possible.
Each passing day now is very precious in stepping up preparations to cope with war.
The armed forces of the Republic should make the most effective use of this precious time, regarding a day as a hundred or thousand days, and be fully ready to take the initiative and be active in any military developments.
"All efforts for completing war preparations!"–this is a requirement of the revolution and the present situation, as well as a military slogan to be held aloft by every level of our armed forces.
It is especially important to build up the battalion in maintaining the political and military superiority and accelerating the increase of the military strength for our regular and other armed forces of the Republic to cope with war.
Our Party regards the battalion as the main unit in fighting a revolutionary war, and attaches great significance to building it up.
The battalion is a combat unit that should accomplish a combat mission independently, given the organizational system of our armed forces and all the subjective and objective conditions of our country.
In case of emergency, the role of battalions is pivotal for our armed forces to move adroitly and exactly in accordance with the strategic intentions of the Party Central Committee and to firmly take hold of the initiative and good chance of winning in accordance with our own tactics whatever the circumstances.
As the wars going on now in several regions of the world give living proof, victory in modern warfare, characterized by colossal deployment of intelligent and informatized state-of-the-art military hardware and comprehensive and multi-dimensional phase of operations and battles, covering land, sea, air and outer and cyber spaces, is dependent on how the battalions, tactical sub-units, are strengthened and commanded.
If a war breaks out, we have to fight the enemy who possess state-of-the-art military technology. Given the situation, the optimum unit is the battalion which can cover up its military action plan from the enemy’s various advanced reconnaissance and detection means, launch surprise attacks and preserve the manpower and combat equipment. It is also a group that can effectively manoeuvre in the combat areas in our country with complex topographical features.
Therefore, the battalion constitutes a basic combat unit, a major tactical unit, most important in combat group formation and operation, and a lead unit in demonstrating the powerful combat strength of our army.
I am going to make maximum use of the strength of battalions in possible war by assigning missions with battalions as the basic unit, giving independence to them and ensuring their active operation.
The position and role of the battalion are given such great importance that the Party took a measure for holding this meeting and a short course by summoning all the battalion commanders and political instructors of the army at the same time, even though this is a period pivotal in completing most important state-level projects and the security environment of the country is extremely unstable.
Kim Jong Unstressed once again our Party’s steadfast policy on prioritizing battalions–that completion of their war preparations immediately means completion of the whole army’s war preparations and their capabilities to fight a real war represent the war potentials of the revolutionary armed forces–and referred to the important tasks facing the battalion commanders and political instructors as follows:
The first basic task for battalion commanders and political instructors is to step up the turning of battalions into ideological and spiritual elite forces with the definite viewpoint that the political and ideological preparedness of revolutionary soldiers decides victory in war.
You should bear in mind that ideology is the most powerful weapon and the only guarantee of invincibility of the revolutionary armed forces.
It is our ever-invariable war method and philosophy of victory to prioritize overwhelming ideological and spiritual victory, no matter how the aspects of modern warfare evolve and what effects advanced military and technical means have on operations and battles.
Our Republic’s armed forces should overwhelm the enemy, above all, in the ideological and spiritual aspects.
We, who advocate the Juche-oriented theory of ideology, ought to gain definite control of the enemy’s vicious anti-communist consciousness of confrontation by dint of political and moral superiority before military and technical edge, and demonstrate the might of our powerful revolutionary army that always emerges victorious by dint of the communist ideology and morality.
The ideological and spiritual characteristics of the powerful revolutionary army that all the officers and men of the Republic’s armed forces should possess are just the absolute loyalty to the Party and the revolution, ardent love for the country, the spirit of devoted service for the people, steadfast class awareness and the will to annihilate the enemy.
The Party has consistently identified the first generation of our revolutionary armed forces and wartime heroes as the noble example in this regard.
We should hold fast, as the primary task in strengthening the battalion, to training all the service personnel to be men strong in ideas and spirit like the first generation of the revolutionary armed forces and wartime heroes.
The work of the battalion should definitely be oriented to this point, and its practical effects should be exhibited just in that.
It is needed to make service personnel burn with the heroic spirit that they would fight against the enemy, standing firmly and holding the red flag in their arms to the death, as the anti-Japanese guerrillas and the victorious wartime generation of the 1950s did.
At the present moment, it is important to deeply imbue service personnel with the thoroughgoing viewpoint on the archenemy and the will to fight a decisive battle against the enemy.
The American and ROK scum we are confronting are whipping up extreme war hysteria as they advocate the heinous anti-communist ideas and the spirit of destroying communism.
We should not view anti-communism merely as the national policy of the United States and the ROK.
It is necessary to make all the service personnel clearly know and always remember that the enemy we should fight are the wicked beings steeped in anti-communism and trained in the spirit of destroying communism and the utter confrontation maniacs who whet swords till they die out of their class nature.
A bullet in the rifle of a soldier with an obscure viewpoint on the archenemy is as good as a dud.
The security of the country and the people should be guaranteed by the staunch class awareness of service personnel, ahead of the force of their arms.
We should inspire all the service personnel to display matchless heroism in a sacred war, once it breaks out, to punish and annihilate the enemy who infringe upon the sovereignty of our beloved country and endanger the lives of our people.
I avail myself of this opportunity to emphasize that battalions should not try to conduct ideological education only on special occasions and under special circumstances.
It is essential to actively explore and apply original methods of education so that all the processes and occasions of performing daily service and carrying out military tasks, as well as the ideological offensive under the situation where the outbreak of war can be said to have become a fait accompli and the countdown to have begun, can be a course of spiritual arming of service personnel.
It is particularly important to make education for them begin with love and be run through with a tender feeling.
As each of children is precious to their parents, the true heart of warmly embracing and taking good care of every soldier constitutes speechless teaching and an inspiration with definite practical effects on service personnel.
Battalion commanders and political instructors should care for service personnel more deeply than anybody else and, by dint of affection and tender feeling, prevent them from becoming ideologically heterogeneous and inspire them to display their spiritual strength.
You should take this in your mind as my request to the commanding officers, who should take care of service personnel as their blood brothers would do, rather than my order.
I hope you will pour more affection and tender feeling on service personnel who should go to battlefields at the risk of their lives, instil into them the approach to war and powerfully inspire them to a heroic struggle.
The second basic task for battalion commanders and political instructors is to concentrate all efforts on boosting their battalions’ capability of fighting a war so as to surely guarantee victory in a revolutionary war militarily and technically.
In order to strengthen our armed forces qualitatively and provide for a revolutionary war, we should step up efforts for building them into an army strong both in the political and ideological aspects and in military and technical aspects.
Noting that modern warfare proves from hour to hour that an army which is technically superannuated cannot beat back the enemy which is armed to the teeth,Kim Jong Ununderscored the necessity to step up more dynamically the technological revolution in the People’s Army, too, and continued:
The battlefields require combatants, who are capable of overpowering the enemy not only in ideological and spiritual aspects but also in military techniques.
I stress once again: We should make a straight advance towards bolstering up the armed forces of the Republic in military techniques.
Battalion commanders and political instructors should have a clear understanding of the changing aspects of modern warfare and the main orientation of building a powerful army corresponding to the changes, and train all their men into brave fighters fully prepared not only spiritually but in military techniques, into versatile combatants capable of skilfully handling sophisticated weapons and other combat equipment and accomplishing any combat missions with credit.
The actual war capabilities to secure victory in the battlefield can be consolidated through intensive training.
Pointing out some weak points and shortcomings revealed in the course of inspecting the combat readiness of battalions across the army,Kim Jong Unstressed that combat training for the army, which has to defend the country and the people with arms, is the primary revolutionary task that must not be neglected under any conditions and circumstances, and that there is no other revolutionary task more vital and important than that.
Noting that battalion commanders and political instructors should always visualize in their mind the circumstances of battlefields and effect a drastic turn in practical training with the main emphasis put on performing combat duty true to the Party’s five-point policy of bringing about a revolution in training so as to ensure that all the officers and men acquire flawless combat capability to correctly carry out the Party’s order of military operations,Kim Jong Unindicated the tasks for the commanding officers to improve their abilities to organize and command battles and steadily improve the manoeuvrability and fighting efficiency of battalions.
He clarified the demands of principle for both the operations units and the combat units across the army to maintain in training, including those of exploring and applying the training contents, forms and methods in an innovative way in keeping with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern war and constantly studying innovative tactics and combat plans of our own style to hold the initiative in battlefields.
Noting that enhancing the soldiers’ abilities to fight an actual war and putting weapons and other combat equipment on a regular readiness means making war preparations, he stressed the need to thoroughly establish the spirit and culture of loving and handling weapons with care in battalions across the army.
Even at this moment the United States and riffraff, including the ROK puppets, hand in glove with one another, are resorting to provocative sabre-rattling around our country, he said, adding that this situation absolutely highlights the importance of combat guard duty, and continued:
If the sky becomes cloudy often, it will rain, and if dark clouds gather and cover the sky, there will be a flash of lightning. Likewise, it is clear that there will inevitably be a military conflict on this land over which the dark clouds of war hover and, accordingly, it is necessary to be always prepared to contain and frustrate any slight provocation by the enemy immediately and thoroughly by building up all the posts and positions into fortresses of no retreat and carrying on various combat guard duties with high vigilance.
The third basic task for battalion commanders and political instructors is to raise a strong wind of improving their qualifications, being conscious that their own politico-ideological, military and practical preparedness is decisive of their battalions’ fighting efficiency and victory in battles,Kim Jong Unsaid, and went on:
They should become competent and action-oriented commanders of field-officer type, who stand readily in the vanguard before issuing an order and who are equipped with qualifications and organizing and commanding capabilities high enough to accomplish whatever mission the Party gives them in a perfect, thoroughgoing way.
Above all, they should become persons of faith and moral obligation, who follow the Party Central Committee without an inch of deviation, persons strong in ideological faith, who are dyed red with its revolutionary ideas.
They should also make painstaking efforts to enhance their practical abilities so that they can acquire as soon as possible the qualifications and capabilities needed for commanding and controlling their battalions as intended by the Party.
The commanding personnel of battalions should possess a revolutionary work method, militant way of life and ennobling traits, and turn their battalions, by means of their personal examples and effective education of their officers and men, into fighting groups that have established strict ethos and assumed the appearance appropriate to a regular army,Kim Jong Unsaid, and clarified the ways to do so, before continuing:
Battalion commanders and political instructors,
You are not only masters of your battalions who are responsible for the grass-roots level of our armed forces, but also reserve military and political cadres who will form the backbone of our armed forces in the future.
Most of those officers who attended the Third Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors have grown into cadres at higher commanding organs now, and you, present here, will surely be assigned to higher ranks than the battalion ones in a few years.
Yet, battalion commanders and political instructors gain experience and lessons and attain the traits and qualifications due for military and political officers while getting invaluable experiences in different spheres like military, political and supply service work. They will find that there is no more worthwhile period of their careers than this one in learning how to work.
This is why we keep it as an essential principle to form the ranks of army commanders with those who have been battalion commanders and political instructors; this will continue to be the consistent principle in dealing with military and political personnel administration, which is of core importance in following the line of building a powerful army.
Battalions are where army commanders grow up, and it is here that the future of our army is shaped to win victory after victory.
Considering that the key to the building of a powerful army in the new era and victory in war is how to prepare its core force, you have assumed important missions in truly important positions.
As befits the backbone shouldering the future of our revolutionary armed forces, you should make ceaseless efforts to improve your abilities, qualifications and personalities and put your heart and soul in whatever you are doing now, thus proving yourselves worthy of the Party’s great trust.
Comrades,
In the prevailing subjective and objective situations, it is a pressing task–which brooks not a day’s delay–to make full preparations for war.
If we are to mount a counterattack to the enemy if they attempt to infringe upon the sovereignty and security of our state even in the slightest degree and to win decisive victory in war once it is unleashed, strengthening battalions is posed as an important and urgent task that requires sure progress.
You must not confine yourselves to shouting a slogan or taking an oath in regard to the defence of sovereignty and rights of our state, but must be fully prepared to carry out any combat missions in a perfect way at any time and in any circumstances.
To prepare the battalion into that capable of going into action and engaging in battle immediately after receiving an order, not merely making speeches and taking an oath, and into an all-purpose one that is capable of bringing any missions to brilliant perfection–this is the goal that all the battalions of our armed forces should attain without fail and the spirit of this conference.
Fully aware of the noble mission and duty entrusted by the Party and the revolution, let us all march forward to bring about a substantial and fundamental improvement in strengthening the battalions’ capabilities for an actual war, and to defend the state and the people and bring earlier honourable victory in war with the powerful military deterrent that we have long built up.
My most beloved comrades-in-arms,
All the commanding officers of our armed forces,
Availing myself of this opportunity, I extend my warm encouragement to all the beloved officers and men of the army.
For the eternal prosperity and peace of our socialist country and for the safety and happiness of our beloved people, let us all equip ourselves fully with the revolutionary ideology of the Party and fight on dynamically. -0-

headline: Russian Government Delegation Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- A Russian government delegation headed by Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, arrived here on Nov. 17 to take part in the 11th meeting of the committee.
The flags of the DPRK and the Russian Federation were fluttering at the flagstaffs of Pyongyang International Airport.
The delegation was warmly greeted by Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, officials concerned and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK and staff members of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: All-people Resistance Staged in Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- The 115th candlelight rally and demonstration was staged in Seoul of the puppet ROK on Nov. 16 to bring puppet Yoon Suk Yeol to the court of history.
A large number of people turned out in the struggle, denouncing the criminal acts of puppet Yoon.
Speakers at the rally noted that the Yoon group is running amuck, frightened of impeachment, stressing that all-people resistance is the key to impeachment and the people's mindset for impeachment will wipe out all the war forces.
The rally heard a report on the impeachment movement conducted jointly by the representatives of candlelight actions in different regions of Seoul, and a resolution for struggle.
The report and resolution declared that it is the resolute will of the people to give an end to the Yoon group within this year and further stir up the atmosphere of impeachment in all parts of the ROK.
Members of the parliamentary solidarity for impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol, too, made solidarity speeches, noting that 41 lawmakers from the five opposition parties formed an organization for impeachment of Yoon on Nov. 13.
At the end of the rally, its participants staged a demonstration, shouting slogans calling for the impeachment of the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol who is trying to put down the candlelight resistance through fascist dictatorship while seeking war and martial law.
That day, the third people's action took place to denounce puppet Yoon's misrule and demand a special investigation into Kim Kon Hui, under the sponsorship of the Minju Party.
Then, a demonstration was waged to demand the special investigation into Kim Kon Hui and oppose the Yoon's rule.
Meanwhile, political parties and civic organizations in Kwangju staged a protest action, urging the puppet parliament to join in the movement for proposing the impeachment bill.
Over such struggle, media in the puppet ROK said that the people's mindset is for the impeachment of Yoon, adding that the demand for it was getting stronger with the passage of time. -0-

headline: Technology of Producing Potassic Compound Fertilizer Established
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK has established a new technology of producing potassic compound fertilizer with rich domestic raw materials.
The new technology ensures less production cost and energy consumption.
Its application showed that the fertilizer helped to raise the yield of rice, maize, wheat and barley.
The academy has also made progress in the research into developing the technology of locally producing potassium hydroxide, the basic raw material of nutrient solution needed at large-scale greenhouse farms, and producing potassium fertilizer and alumina simultaneously with less energy. -0-

headline: 4th Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of KPA Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- The 4th Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Korean People's Army (KPA) took place with splendor in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, at a historic time when the august name and fighting spirit of the armed forces of the Workers' Party Korea, the guardian of the DPRK government and genuine people's army are fully demonstrated in the forefront of the drive for building a rich country with strong army under the invincible guidance of the great Party Central Committee.
The conference, the fourth of its kind in the history of the Juche-based army building, is of great significance in accelerating the drive for making the revolutionary armed forces the most elite and powerful ones by remarkably enhancing the role of the commanding officers of battalions, the lowest-level commanding organs and major combat units of the People's Army, and bringing about a substantial and fundamental improvement in strengthening battalions, as required by the revolutionary practice that calls for   decisively frustrating all threats and challenges from the hostile forces, firmly defending the inviolable sovereignty, dignity and honour of the country and people and hastening the overall upward development of national rejuvenation.
All the battalion commanders and political instructors of the army arrived on the same day in Pyongyang where there are the Party Central Committee they have pictured with loyalty and feats in military service, and the Supreme Commander they have always longed to see, while dedicating their pure conscience and sincere sweat to firmly consolidating the cornerstone of the military muscle.
Along the streets the capital citizens warmly waved their hands to the battalion commanders and political instructors who have dedicated their youth to standing guard in the first-line trench for defending the country and its interests and to the grand construction projects for bringing happiness to the people.
The 4th Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the KPA took place on Nov. 14 and 15.

headline: New Modern Houses Built for Farmers in DPRK
story_text:

story_text:

headline: "Three-Party Cooperation" Brings Strong Retaliatory Actions: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) -- The U.S. Biden administration is jittery about its DPRK policy on the verge of total bankruptcy.
Occasioned by the APEC summit on November 15, Biden chaired the "three-party summit talks" with the chief executives of Japan and the puppet ROK in Lima, Peru.
At the talks they agreed to establish a "tripartite cooperation office" against the DPRK, while Biden blew his own horn, touting it as a "new era of tripartite cooperation".
Japan and the puppet ROK shamelessly danced to his tune, terming the "three-party cooperation" not only beneficial to their national interests but also "indispensable for peace and prosperity" in region. They loudly said that the "three-party cooperation office" will serve as a "durable foundation" for leading stronger cooperation between the three nations.
Timed to coincide with the confab of the chief executives of the three countries for securing the institutional and structural establishment of "three-party cooperation", the three-party multi-domain exercises, Freedom Edge, were launched again, involving U.S. super-large nuclear carrier George Washington as flagship and new-generation fighter jets mainly tasked with precision strikes on core facilities of the DPRK. Such regular anti-DPRK war rehearsals provoke serious concern.
The master and its servants established "new three-party cooperative relations" one year ago and have busied themselves to put it into an institutional, regular and general basis since then.
It is primarily aimed at perpetuating their anti-DPRK "confrontational policy" based on "tripartite cooperation" as their "invariable national policy" by bequeathing it as "legacy" to their next regimes and thus upsetting the balance of power in the Korean peninsula and the region.
What the world has witnessed since the start of the "era of tripartite cooperation" talked big by the U.S., Japan and the ROK is by no means peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the region.
In actuality, the current U.S. administration has put its policy of nuclear confrontation with the DPRK into practice and frantically staged various war exercises to invade the DPRK, calling for putting into operation the real-time missile information sharing system and intensifying the three-party joint military drills with its henchmen along with the "era of tripartite cooperation".
The U.S., Japan and the ROK frequently brought nuclear strategic assets and even NATO forces to the Korean peninsula and its vicinity to disturb peace of the Asia-Pacific region and provoke regional countries' heightened surveillance, all of which have nothing to do with security and peace.
In a joint statement, released at the end of the "summit", the U.S. specified the DPRK and other independent countries in the region as targets of siege and stifling, thereby producing the entity called the "tripartite cooperation office" as an institutional foundation for expanding the U.S.-led military bloc in the Asia-Pacific region.
Such moves of the U.S., Japan and the ROK for securing permanent "three-party cooperation" have sown the seed of discord and confrontation deeper into the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region. This is a revelation of the scheme to seize the political and military supremacy in the region by dint of the military bloc that has evolved into a nuclear alliance.
But such unprecedented confrontational hysteria of the hostile states has brought such undesirable catastrophic results as the DPRK's possession of powerful sighting telescope and ICBMs targeting the U.S. at all times and the establishment of a just strategic structure in Northeast Asia.
In the final analysis, the "tripartite cooperation era" billed by the U.S., Japan and the ROK as the greatest, has turned into the "era of tripartite ruin".
Among those who met in Camp David last August allegedly to open up an "era of completely new three-party cooperation", one has already been ousted from his premiership and another one will soon leave the Oval Office and the last one is on the verge of being impeached, for being forsaken by the public.
No wonder, such miserable fates of the pioneers of the "three-party cooperation" illustrate that the "three-party cooperation era" has no future.
Their tightening of ill-minded military cooperation will only bring the DPRK's strong and regular retaliatory actions. -0-

headline: Undying Feats Performed to Train Party Members into Vanguard Fighters for Building Powerful Socialist Nation
DPRK Government Hosts Reception for Russian Government Delegation
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) -- The government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception at Yanggakdo International Hotel on Monday evening in welcome of the government delegation of the Russian Federation on a visit to the DPRK.
Present there on invitation were the Russian government delegation led by Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy.
Present were Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, and other officials concerned.
Speeches were made there.
Warmly welcoming the Russian government delegation on a visit to the DPRK, Yun Jong Ho said that mutual cooperation and visits have been brisk in all fields, including politics, economy, culture and sports, under the agreement signed at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit.
He said that the 11th Meeting of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology would produce practical results conducive to the promotion of the well-being of the peoples of the two countries by making a leap forward in cooperation between the two countries.
Expressing deep thanks for warm reception and hospitality to his delegation, Alexandr Kozlov said that the 11th meeting would be an important occasion in indicating the tasks and directions for boosting cooperation between the two countries.
Saying that the friendly relations between the top leaders of the two countries and the cooperation and support between the two sides serve as a good example of the coexistence of the two powerful states in the present century, he expressed the will to contribute to the expansion and development of the Russia-DPRK friendly relations in a golden age. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Minister of Natural Resources and Ecology of Russian Federation Alexandr Kozlov
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who is heading the government delegation of the Russian Federation on a visit to the DPRK to take part in the 11th meeting of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, on Nov. 18.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmet with Alexandr Kozlov at the headquarters building of the WPK Central Committee and had a talk with him.
Kim Jong Unappreciated the fact that the bilateral solidarity and cooperation have been closer and deepened in different fields since the conclusion of a new treaty between the two countries.
He said that it is necessary to mutually and powerfully propel the co-prosperity and development of the two countries by further promoting the inter-governmental trade, economic, scientific and technological exchange and cooperation in a more extensive and diversified way as the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations have reached a new strategic level.
The talk proceeded in a friendly and sincere atmosphere. -0-

headline: Many Historical Sites Restored in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK devote their patriotic efforts to the protection of national heritage.
The province reviewed the actual conditions of historical sites and organized the work to restore them on the principle of Juche character, scientific accuracy and historicism.
It provided necessary materials and sent officials and working people in the field of national heritage protection, able artists and others in the province to repair and restore them in conformity with the historical facts.
They successfully repaired and repainted nearly 30 historical sites in the area of Mt Kumgang, including Phyohun and Singye temples. -0-

What the world has witnessed since the start of the "era of tripartite cooperation" talked big by the U.S., Japan and the ROK is by no means peace and stability of the Korean peninsula and the region.
In actuality, the current U.S. administration has put its policy of nuclear confrontation with the DPRK into practice and frantically staged various war exercises to invade the DPRK, calling for putting into operation the real-time missile information sharing system and intensifying the three-party joint military drills with its henchmen along with the "era of tripartite cooperation".
The U.S., Japan and the ROK frequently brought nuclear strategic assets and even NATO forces to the Korean peninsula and its vicinity to disturb peace of the Asia-Pacific region and provoke regional countries' heightened surveillance, all of which have nothing to do with security and peace.
In a joint statement, released at the end of the "summit", the U.S. specified the DPRK and other independent countries in the region as targets of siege and stifling, thereby producing the entity called the "tripartite cooperation office" as an institutional foundation for expanding the U.S.-led military bloc in the Asia-Pacific region.
Such moves of the U.S., Japan and the ROK for securing permanent "three-party cooperation" have sown the seed of discord and confrontation deeper into the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region. This is a revelation of the scheme to seize the political and military supremacy in the region by dint of the military bloc that has evolved into a nuclear alliance.
But such unprecedented confrontational hysteria of the hostile states has brought such undesirable catastrophic results as the DPRK's possession of powerful sighting telescope and ICBMs targeting the U.S. at all times and the establishment of a just strategic structure in Northeast Asia.
In the final analysis, the "tripartite cooperation era" billed by the U.S., Japan and the ROK as the greatest, has turned into the "era of tripartite ruin".
Among those who met in Camp David last August allegedly to open up an "era of completely new three-party cooperation", one has already been ousted from his premiership and another one will soon leave the Oval Office and the last one is on the verge of being impeached, for being forsaken by the public.
No wonder, such miserable fates of the pioneers of the "three-party cooperation" illustrate that the "three-party cooperation era" has no future.
Their tightening of ill-minded military cooperation will only bring the DPRK's strong and regular retaliatory actions. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Regional-Industry Factories under Construction in Songchon County
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 20 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the regional-industry factories under construction in Songchon County of South Phyongan Province on Nov. 19.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He was greeted by senior officials of the Party, administrative and economic organs in the region and commanding officers of the unit of the Korean People's Army involved in the construction.
Going round the construction site, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that sure successes in carrying out the Party's decisions have been made in twenty cities and counties this year when the first year's campaign for implementing a new policy of the WPK to open up a new era of regional development started after its adoption and the validity and prospect of the Party's line and policy to achieve the simultaneous, balanced and rapid development across the country have been proved in practice.
He acquainted himself with the level of machinery and equipment produced at home, their assembling, building construction, preparation of raw and other materials, training of skilled workers, etc. and gave important instructions on operation and management of regional-industry factories and the orientation of their long-term development.
He stressed that the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee to be held in December 2024 should strictly review the first year's work for implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy of special significance in the history of comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism and conduct in a responsible manner the work for expanding the experience and successes at an accelerating pace.
Referring to the requirements of the era in which the continuous construction revolution aspiring and creating a new civilization of socialism goes on and to the primary tasks for dynamically launching and pushing forward any huge construction project, he set forth an important task for deciding at the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee on practical measures to be studied and taken by the state.
Saying that we have not much time left until the end of this year, he gave important instructions on the issues to be solved without fail in perfectly concluding the construction of regional-industry factories in twenty cities and counties which has been pushed forward this year and on drawing up the plan for regional construction in 2025. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 21 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an editorial says that in order to make steady progress and leap forward on all fronts of building a powerful socialist country, it is necessary to hold higher the line of the three revolutions in all sectors, units and regions of the country.
Our Party has ceaselessly set the scientific and development-oriented goals and clear-cut practical strategies for leading Korean-style socialism to a more powerful and wealthy road, the editorial says, and goes on:
Success in the struggle for its realization depends entirely on the responsible role of each sector and unit, and the line of the three revolutions is a powerful weapon guaranteeing it.
The fundamental way for providing a powerful impetus for comprehensive national rejuvenation is to further intensify the three revolutions.
The new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation is a watershed of history provided as a result of the struggle of the Workers' Party of Korea and the people of the DPRK to implement the line of the three revolutions and a new era of development which will be achieved only through the three revolutions of a higher stage.
To kindle the flames of the three revolutions more fiercely is a fundamental guarantee for turning all sectors, units and regions into a solid fortress and base for comprehensive national rejuvenation.
The comprehensive development we aspire to is the simultaneous and balanced development in all sectors, units and domains and a leap to the world level. It is our Party's outlook on development that we should develop the whole society together.
Only when all sectors, units and regions make uninterrupted advance and innovations in the three domains of ideology, technology and culture, can it be possible to put the advanced and modern character of our state on a new high level and more powerfully demonstrate the dignity and prestige of a socialist power prospering with self-reliance and self-respect.
It is the unshakable will of our Party to accelerate the prosperity and development of our great state with the three revolutions as a dynamic force.
The line of the three revolutions is a great fighting programme that gives full play to our people's enthusiasm for revolution and struggle and patriotism and thus gives rise to a strong surge of advance and leap forward across the country. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Fourth Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the Fourth Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the Korean People's Army on Nov. 21.
The venue for the photo session was full of boundless reverence for and trust in the respected Supreme CommanderKim Jong Un, who gave a precious name, "My most beloved comrades-in-arms", to battalion commanding officers performing the vanguard mission in strengthening the armed forces of the DPRK into the unshakable mainstay of the WPK and the revolution and into an entity of great and matchless strength honorably defending the sovereignty and dignity of our state and who has shown warm affection and trust for them so that they could become passionate warriors consolidating the ever-victorious foundation of the KPA.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived amid the playing of welcome music, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" was raised.
Kim Jong Unwas courteously greeted by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, and Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the KPA General Political Bureau.
All the participants paid the highest tribute to the great father who made the conference of battalion commanders and political instructors, the fourth of its kind in the history of building the Juche-oriented army, a historic great meeting to bolster up a powerful motive force of building a strong army in the new era, showed deep love for them and gave them the glory and happiness they desired even in their dreams, although he was so busy with work.

headline: Autumn Commodity Exhibition Closes in DPRK
story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Weaponry Exhibition "National Defence Development-2024" Splendidly Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- The great Workers' Party of Korea has vigorously led the second revolution in national defence industry aimed at making the Korean People's Army stronger in terms of military techniques after declaring a grand national defence development strategy at its historic Eighth Congress on developing the KPA into an elite army equipped with ultra-modern weapons by highly developing national defence science and technology and researching and developing more ultra-modern weapons and combat equipment.
The WPK Central Committee headed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unset it as the most important and primary task for defending the country, revolution and people to highly develop the country's war deterrent with nuclear force as its pivot and has stubbornly propelled the struggle for its implementation. It has uninterruptedly accelerated great technological changes both in quality and quantity and in bolstering up the country's self-defensive capabilities and thus steadily increased the strongest combat power for defending the nation’s sovereignty and peace.
The weaponry exhibition "National Defence Development-2024" opened with splendor in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Nov. 21, demonstrating the increased power and great leap forward of the DPRK.
The exhibition brought together the latest products of the national defense scientific and technological group of the DPRK with the strategic and tactical weapons, which have been updated and developed once again in light of modern and advanced characters and precision and power of strike and have drew the world’s attention through continuous development of their new kinds, as the main ones.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended an opening ceremony of the exhibition.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived, the participants raised the stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" out of the absolute trust and respect of the DPRK’s armed forces for him, the strong and matchless DPRK’s might and the representative of its great dignity, who is leading to victory and glory the revolutionary struggle for achieving the great historic cause of building a rich country with strong army, wished by the nation history spanning 5 000 years, with his brilliant wisdom, extraordinary leadership ability and tireless devotion.
A demonstration of the air force flying corps took place in commemoration of the opening ceremony.
Three-color vapors were trailing in the sky of Pyongyang.
An opening ceremony of the exhibition took place.
A storm of hand clapping arose whenKim Jong Untook the platform together with senior officials in the field of defence munitions industry and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.
Present at the opening ceremony were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other leading officials of the Party central leadership organ, major commanding officers of all military and political organs of the Korean People's Army and workers, scientists and officials in the field of munitions industry.
Jo Chun Ryong, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an opening address.
At this moment when another milestone is to be set up in the course of building a rich country with strong army, we are deeply moved by the absolute trust and boundless reverence for the great ComradeKim Jong Unwho ushered in a new era of the development of the Juche-based defence industry and made the country and its people possess high dignity and matchless might, and visitors here would realize his ardent patriotism and world of boundless creation associated with the entities of powerful might, the reporter said, and declared the exhibition open.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant commemorative speech.
Referring to the political and military significance of the exhibition, he said with pride that the brilliant successes in the field of national defence are enough to be convinced that we have the firm capability and security guarantee for actively coping with not only various threats being posed by the enemies to us but also the prospective security threats which we may face in the future, and our defence industry has been updated into the ultra-modern industry which supports the military activities most accurately and thoroughly as required by each stage and every period of the revolution and every situation and has been further strengthened into a strategic fortress firmly defending the position of our state, the world's military power.
Saying that as long as the forces infringing upon our sovereignty exist, it is necessary to steadily update various kinds of weapons and equipment and to develop them into ultra-modern ones as required by the security environment of our state, he affirmed that our Party and government will defend the DPRK, our glorious country, by dint of national defence by making all efforts to build up higher military and technical force and powerful military capabilities.
When he concluded his speech, all the participants paid the highest glory and respect to the peerlessly brilliant commander who is vigorously writing the history of just strength to achieve the eternal prosperity of the country and defend the security of the people, renewing their solemn resolution to go all out for the sacred cause of bolstering up the national defence capabilities with a single mind.
Kim Jong Un, together with the visitors, looked round the exhibition.
Going round the weapons and equipment on display, he highly appreciated the noble patriotism and loyalty of the WPK's red national defence soldiers who are devoting themselves to defending the dynamic breathing of the Korean revolution winning victory after victory and upholding the invincibility and mightiness of our state.
He said that the inexhaustible military and technical edge of the armed forces of the Republic and the eye-opening progress of the self-supporting defence industry which firmly supports it are the pride and costly victory which can be won only by our great people who have unconditionally and absolutely supported the WPK's line of building the powerful army and its national defence policy, without the slightest deviation, unyieldingly overcoming any hardships and trials.
The weaponry exhibition "National Defence Development-2024", which opened with splendor, demonstrating the grandiose development and signal prospects of the national defence capabilities of the DPRK, will serve as a significant occasion of redoubling the pride of all the people across the country in the spirit, ideal and might of the DPRK outpacing the world and dynamically encouraging them in their heroic advance toward the comprehensive national rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Friday released the following press statement:
A "resolution" distorting and fabricating the human rights situation in the DPRK was railroaded at the Third Committee of the 79th Session of the UN General Assembly on Nov. 21.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry brands the farce of adopting of the "human rights resolution" led by the U.S. and its followers as a grave politically-motivated provocation encroaching upon the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK, and strongly denounces and rejects the farce.
Not content with branding the DPRK's exercise of its legitimate sovereign rights to defend its security and people's interests as "human rights abuses", the U.S. and its followers took issue with the legislative measures to defend our sound culture and ethics from the U.S. and the Western corrupt and immoral cultural poisoning. This is a wanton violation of the basic spirit of the UN Charter whose core is the respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs of countries.
We express serious concern over the fact that the practice of adopting of resolution at the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly is turning into a political means for interfering in the internal affairs and damaging the image of independent and sovereign states which are raising voices of concern about the unethical atrocities of the U.S. and the West.
Taking ourselves of this opportunity, we again call attention to the fact that the UN whose original mission is to promote reconciliation and unity among countries is being abused as a tool for confrontation to trample down the dignity of sovereign states and stamp out their sovereignty by the U.S. high-handed and arbitrary practices.
The behavior of the U.S. and its followers who are abusing the universal concept of human rights and international human rights norms for attaining their sinister geopolitical purposes while inciting the inter-camp confrontation, a direct product of the Cold War way of thinking is now acting as a harmful factor challenging the aspiration and efforts of the international community for the protection and promotion of genuine human rights.
It is an insult to the inviolable human rights that the U.S., the chieftain of institutional human rights abuses fostering serious and widespread violation of human rights stunning the world, arbitrarily judges and slanders the human rights situation of sovereign states with its yardstick of human rights.
No matter how the hostile forces may be the master of confusing right and wrong and hatching plots, they can never cover up the true human rights situation in the DPRK which gives top priority to the dignity, right and interests of the popular masses and regards them as absolute.
Protection of human rights apart from the national sovereignty is nothing but an empty talk.
It is an exercise of the normal and legitimate right of a sovereign state which no one can slander for the DPRK to take all necessary measures for defending its sovereignty and protecting the security and interests of its citizens as it has been exposed to the serious, political and military threats by the U.S. and its allies.
The DPRK will never overlook the daily-increasing hostile acts of the U.S. and its followers but make every effort to defend the socialist system of the DPRK which its people value as dear as their lives and their genuine rights. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Automation Appliances Factory

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the power industry of the DPRK are striving to carry out the tasks for readjustment and reinforcement planned for this year.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex has pushed ahead with the work to restore and modernize the original performance of generator No. 3, which is of key importance in production.
The Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant has boosted the output of electricity by installing turbine generators in addition. East Pyongyang and Sunchon thermal power plants carried out the overhaul of boilers and turbines in a qualitative way to provide a guarantee for the normal production.
