headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on Nov. 15.
The message said:
Dear ComradeKim Jong Un,
I express my sincere thanks to you for sending a beautiful floral basket to me in congratulation of my birthday.
The interest and good wishes expressed by you greatly inspire me and show that the long-standing traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, two states and two peoples of the LPDR and the DPRK are full of vitality.
We are convinced that the DPRK will continue to register greater and new successes in accomplishing the cause of firmly defending the country, developing it to be highly civilized and prosperous and bringing happiness to the fraternal Korean people under the wise and courageous leadership of the WPK with you as its great leader and successor.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I wish you good health, happiness and success in your noble and honorable work.
Please accept the assurances of my highest consideration. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Speech at Opening Ceremony of Military Hardware Exhibition Defence Development-2024
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- The following is the full text of the speech made by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the opening ceremony of the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2024 on Nov. 21:
Dear comrades and friends,
In a stirring period, when the precious successes achieved in various fields of state work and socialist construction through a vigorous struggle in 2024 are approaching us, an exhibition has opened here today, introducing the successes gained in the defence sector this year.
First, I extend warm thanks to the persons in the relevant sectors and others, who have made efforts for the preparation of this exhibition.
The exhibition hall is really wonderful.
Seeing the exhibition hall encapsulating remarkable development of the defence capability of our state that has given a new feeling in less than one year, we can give a satisfactory appraisal to the work of the defence industry for making a steady and rapid growth.
I extend thanks to Full Generals Kim Jong Sik and Jang Chang Ha, Chairman Ko Pyong Hyon, Presidents Kim Yong Hwan and Jon Il Ho and other leading cadres in the defence sector, the defence sci-tech group and the officials and workers at the munitions industry enterprises under the Second Economy Commission, who have made greater contributions than others for achieving remarkable successes in the development of our armed forces every year.
In recent years fundamental changes have been brought about in our defence sci-tech field, and many knotty problems in this sector have been resolved correctly by our internal forces, our defence sci-tech group.
While witnessing the process of these changes in person, I have become more confident of the practical abilities of this group and confirmed the promising nature and inexhaustible potential of our Democratic People’s Republic of Korea that is justifiably matchless in the sector of the brain industry.
I am confident that this is an outcome of the perfect combination of the good qualities of our nation with the policy of training the group of brains in a correct way and enlisting them in a concentrated way.
The weapon systems on display here all differ in their missions, but I attach special meaning to the fact that they are crystallization of the modern defence sci-tech strength and economic potential of the defence industry, and that these have been developed by our own resources, ie our internal forces.
Great changes have taken place in recent years, indeed.
All these we are seeing today are a proud record of the successes achieved again in a year in the defence industry revolution in the new era, which our Party has planned and is dynamically pushing forward. And with this, we have demonstrated on a larger scale the righteousness and vitality of our Party’s idea of self-reliant defence–defending the state, the people and the revolutionary cause by our own efforts–and made a decisive stride in attaining the goal of building up the defences, advanced by the Eighth Congress of the Party.
What makes the current exhibition weightier in the practical aspects and more significant in the political and military aspects is that these exhibits are fruition gathered in defence development by exercising our right to self-defence on the principle of countering power with power and of head-on contest in 2024, when the hostile attitude of the United States and its allied forces for confrontation and their adventurist military records exceeded the peak year level.
These brilliant successes we have achieved in the defence sector year after year afford us glimpses at its development potential and speed, which fairly convince us that we are possessed of definite capability and a guarantee for security to cope proactively with not only the various threats the enemies are posing to us now but also the security threats we are likely to face in future.
Our defence industry has at last been upgraded as a cutting-edge one that can offer the most suitable and thoroughgoing support for military activities as required in each stage, each period and each situation of our revolution; it has also been built up as a strategic fortress that firmly guarantees the position of our state as a world-class military power.
Our cutting-edge defence sci-tech sector and the technological foundations of our munitions economy are also exerting important effects on, and playing the leading role in, transforming the structure of the national industry as a whole.
Comrades,
The military hardware on display here represent what we have achieved this year, 2024, and yet, until they presented their majestic appearance here, they witnessed arduous courses accompanied by painstaking and pioneering research work in renewing each of their records, whose value can hardly be measured by the lapse of time alone.
We can compare these military hardware with world-class ones of their kinds in terms of design, manufacturing skills, grade of materials or combat and technical specifications, but it is hard to fully estimate their true value.
In an attempt to suffocate and destroy our self-reliant defence industry completely, the hostile forces have pursued unprecedentedly cruel sanctions and blockade against us, leaving us in difficulty and in short supply of everything. But the Party and the people have adhered to the view that strengthening the defence capabilities is the supreme expression of their patriotism and consciousness of the revolution, and fully aware of their great expectations, our defence sci-tech group and workers in the munitions industry have worked with devotion to live up to them, regarding doing so as their duty. Their ennobling spirit is embodied in the weapons here.
For this reason, our military hardware, in terms of the righteous purpose and character, the indomitable spiritual strength and unheard-of fighting spirit embodied in them, has thousands of times greater–utterly incomparable–power than those the military-industrial complexes of imperialist countries manufacture in pursuance of massacre, destruction and economic profit.
Comrades,
Today our Republic has risen as a powerful axis exerting an influence on political and military developments around the world. It owes this status to the absolute dignity and strength it has gained thanks to its revolutionary ideology, cause of justice and perseverance.
However, without the extraordinary wisdom and courage and undying perseverance that would surpass those which we have displayed in clearing a thorny path and going through the successive stages by leaps and bounds, we can neither cope with the ever-changing reality nor guarantee our foreseeable future.
As we are witnessing now, our planet is in the grip of confusion and violence, the worst ever since the end of the Second World War.
The United States is growing more brazen in trying to place the whole world under the sphere of its interests, and the consequent contradictions and confrontations of every hue have passed all critical points to develop into too unjust, horrible wars and catastrophic disasters.
This is literally a pandemonium, in which some reckless and high-handed powers violate international norms, regardless of their obvious purpose of, and orientation towards, respecting the territories and sovereignty of all countries and nations and defending global peace and security.
Nearly a century ago, fascisms in Europe and Asia colluded with each other to throw the world into turmoil. Likewise, the reactionary forces in the West and East, allied under the baton of the US imperialists, are now attempting to establish a rapacious and tyrannical world order. This is a present reality.
In particular, the United States is expanding the nuke-sharing military alliance system to contain our Republic’s rapid rise, which is an insurmountable obstacle in the way of implementing its policy of dominationism, and to retain and increase its influence over its vassal countries. On the other hand, it is going to great lengths to ratchet up the military pressure and provocations against our country by deploying around it a vast array of strategic strike means and troops of its allies.
The Korean peninsula has never been under such a critical situation as the present, in which there is a growing likelihood of a most destructive thermonuclear war breaking out amid the acutely dangerous confrontation between the belligerents.
Another fact that we must point out here is that this extreme tension in the peninsula is by no means something caused by the misunderstanding of each other’s rival.
We already did everything possible in the bilateral negotiations with the United States, and what we were eventually convinced of was not the superpower’s will to co-exist with us but its domineering stand and unchangeably aggressive and hostile policy towards the DPRK.
American politicians still say, as they are wont to do, that the United States has never been hostile. This odd-sounding rhetoric has long been rejected by the world as anything but plausible.
The US imperialists’ and their vassal forces’ wild ambition to obliterate our ideology and system at any cost and destroy our people to the last one has never changed. Rather, they are recklessly manoeuvring to realize this ambition in this century.
In the present world where military conflicts are growing rampant, a country which gave up building its own defence capability cannot be called a sovereign state; a weak country will fall victim to tyranny and is bound to be ravaged by foreign invasion.
All facts convince us, with each passing moment of the day, that the greatest defence capability with which to overpower the enemies is just the key to safeguarding peace and guaranteeing durable stability and development.
Our Party and government will never remain an onlooker to any encroachment upon our state’s sphere of security, and we make clear once again that we will never lower the weight of military balance on our side by ourselves.
We will go on with resolute actions for removing all manner of military threats to our state and people and thoroughly break the enemies’ will to use armed forces by steadily developing our defence capability and exercising our legitimate right to self-defence.
Comrades,
It is an indispensable and consistent demand of our Party’s line of building up the self-reliant defence to bolster up our strength without interruption and limit and steadily raise the tremendous capabilities of deterring and fighting a war to defend the sovereignty, interests and security environment of our state in a responsible manner.
The enemies, too, keep whetting their sword for evolution.
Accordingly, only when we make a more unequalled leap forward can we prevent military conflicts with the enemies and take the strategic initiative in controlling the political and military situation.
We should not content ourselves with the present mightiness but push for infinite mightiness. In this aspiration and will lie the true mightiness of our state and the sure guarantee for its security.
Our main purpose of holding this military hardware exhibition is not merely to look back on the history or to congratulate ourselves on the current level.
It is to highlight more clearly the necessity for us to step up the important change of defence capability and markedly enhance its strategic position and role by bringing about leaps forward in the self-reliant defence industry at any cost.
I think that as long as there exist the forces attempting to infringe upon our sovereignty and the enemies persist in their vicious moves, we should continue to upgrade various kinds of military hardware and make them cutting-edge as much as the security environment of our state requires us and as many as the changes in the current wars show us.
Given the new aspects of modern warfare and the enemies’ war tactics that are transforming in a dangerous way day after day, we should develop our defence capability more aggressively and limitlessly while promoting technological modernization of our army and equipping it with a larger number of powerful means.
Rapid development of science and technology is continuously transforming the world, and this transformation of enormous significance greatly affects the security of every country.
That it must acclimatize to the change of the objective world and cope with it rapidly and promptly is the character of the main duty and development orientation of our defence science sector today.
Military capability should be constantly upgraded.
Stagnation in increasing overwhelming military strength means the start of the defence capability becoming inferior.
Our Party and government will show more concern to search for answers to this end, mapping out a greater number of long-term projects and implementing them actively.
Comrades,
To remain more faithful to the line of self-reliance in national defence, whose scientific accuracy and power have been clearly proved through the prolonged revolutionary practice, and make steady, invariable and more vigorous advance–herein lies the eternal security and future of our state and our people.
Pioneering this road and the will to pioneer the road constitute our boundless worth of life, pride and honour.
Our Party and government will make all their efforts to increase more advanced capability of military technology, powerful military strength, thus safeguarding our glorious motherland, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, on the strength of reliable defence capability.
I hope that all those attending this event will have a pleasant time looking round the exhibition with due pride in our defence capability and with optimism for and confidence in the limitlessness of its development.
Thank you. -0-

headline: Credentials of Swedish Ambassador Accepted
Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Friday released the following press statement:
A "resolution" distorting and fabricating the human rights situation in the DPRK was railroaded at the Third Committee of the 79th Session of the UN General Assembly on Nov. 21.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry brands the farce of adopting of the "human rights resolution" led by the U.S. and its followers as a grave politically-motivated provocation encroaching upon the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK, and strongly denounces and rejects the farce.
Not content with branding the DPRK's exercise of its legitimate sovereign rights to defend its security and people's interests as "human rights abuses", the U.S. and its followers took issue with the legislative measures to defend our sound culture and ethics from the U.S. and the Western corrupt and immoral cultural poisoning. This is a wanton violation of the basic spirit of the UN Charter whose core is the respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs of countries.
We express serious concern over the fact that the practice of adopting of resolution at the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly is turning into a political means for interfering in the internal affairs and damaging the image of independent and sovereign states which are raising voices of concern about the unethical atrocities of the U.S. and the West.
Taking ourselves of this opportunity, we again call attention to the fact that the UN whose original mission is to promote reconciliation and unity among countries is being abused as a tool for confrontation to trample down the dignity of sovereign states and stamp out their sovereignty by the U.S. high-handed and arbitrary practices.
The behavior of the U.S. and its followers who are abusing the universal concept of human rights and international human rights norms for attaining their sinister geopolitical purposes while inciting the inter-camp confrontation, a direct product of the Cold War way of thinking is now acting as a harmful factor challenging the aspiration and efforts of the international community for the protection and promotion of genuine human rights.
It is an insult to the inviolable human rights that the U.S., the chieftain of institutional human rights abuses fostering serious and widespread violation of human rights stunning the world, arbitrarily judges and slanders the human rights situation of sovereign states with its yardstick of human rights.
No matter how the hostile forces may be the master of confusing right and wrong and hatching plots, they can never cover up the true human rights situation in the DPRK which gives top priority to the dignity, right and interests of the popular masses and regards them as absolute.
Protection of human rights apart from the national sovereignty is nothing but an empty talk.
It is an exercise of the normal and legitimate right of a sovereign state which no one can slander for the DPRK to take all necessary measures for defending its sovereignty and protecting the security and interests of its citizens as it has been exposed to the serious, political and military threats by the U.S. and its allies.
The DPRK will never overlook the daily-increasing hostile acts of the U.S. and its followers but make every effort to defend the socialist system of the DPRK which its people value as dear as their lives and their genuine rights. -0-

headline: Concert Commemorating Weaponry Exhibition "National Defence Development-2024" Given
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- A concert was given on Thursday night to mark the opening ceremony of the weaponry exhibition "National Defence Development-2024" in which the mightiness of the DPRK will be proudly demonstrated once again.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appreciated the concert together with g members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other members of the Party central leadership body, major commanding officers of all military and political organs of the Korean People's Army, workers, scientists and officials in the munitions industry, and the participants in the Fourth Conference of Battalion Commanders and Political Instructors of the KPA.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium, all the participants raised stormy cheers with their boundless reverence for the peerlessly illustrious commander who is writing the heroic story of bolstering up the national defence capability to realize the cherished desire of the nation's history spanning five thousand years and is ushering in a new period of a great turn in building a powerful nation while leaving sacred traces of great service and devoted efforts on a long journey of history for accomplishing the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army, shouldering the destiny of the country and people and their eternal future.
Put on the stage of the performance started with a ceremony of the combined military band were colorful numbers including hymns praising the leaders, songs of the revolutionary army and odes to the motherland.
The performers portrayed the heroic combat spirit and noble patriotism of the KPA which has written its proud history as the first death-defying corps in defending the leader, defender of the government of the Republic and genuine people's army, holding aloft the colors of honor embroidered with the sacred letters "For the eternal prosperity of the country and the people's wellbeing" while cherishing the historic heavy responsibility for defending the nation’s sovereignty which could never be easily defended.
The audience unsparingly applauded the numbers evoking the memories of the long and glorious history of victory won by the DPRK and its people by relying on the vanguard role of the revolutionary armed forces which have been ideologically elite and possessed the most powerful arms.
The performance impressively showed that the security of the beloved country and people, independence, justice and genuine peace are firmly guaranteed by matchless self-defensive capability and there are the dignity of the state to be more firmly defended and the dream and ideal about prosperity to be certainly realized at any cost on the great service and feats which have been performed century after century.
The concert reached its climax with monumental odes fully representing the firm will of all the people across the country to eternally support with loyalty the socialist motherland, the benevolent embrace of the dear father who is translating the people's long-cherished desire into brilliant reality, embracing the destiny of all the people across the country. The concert ended with the national anthem of the DPRK.
The venue of the performance was again filled with stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" raised by all the participants, full of their pledge to death-defyingly defend the absolute prestige of the great ComradeKim Jong Unand the invincibility of the cause of Juche by dint of the world's strongest military muscle.
The concert brilliantly decorated the night of the significant opening ceremony of the exhibition. -0-

headline: Contest of UAWK Lectures Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- A contest of lecturers from the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) took place on November 20 and 21.
In the contest, its performers showed the methods they have acquired in the days of enhancing the penetration power of ideology and the effectiveness of ideological work while explaining the greatness and immortal exploits of the Workers' Party of Korea and the validity and vitality of the Party's policies among the masses on farm fields and at worksites.
They explained about a brilliant new history of rural and regional development, in which the rural communities across the country are undergoing a rapid change day by day under the outstanding ideology and energetic guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, in combination with detailed facts witnessed in their regions and units.
They also told that they have given lectures in a theoretical and simple way in conformity with the principles of social phenomena and the logic of life after understanding the psychology of the audience and conducted the information work in diverse forms and ways by combining the revolutionary poems and songs with various agitation means.
The contest grasped the understanding of policy issues, science and technology, and common knowledge in literature that the lecturers should know so as to lead the masses to the struggle for implementing the Party's decisions, and evaluated the excellent lecturers. -0-

story_text:

This process helps turn out important parts necessary for the production of various kinds of machinery including rice combine harvesters. -0-

headline: Nationwide Show Given to Raise Operation Rate of Farm Machines
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- A nationwide show was given at the Ryongyon County Farm Machine Station, Ongjin County Farm Machine Station and the Haeju Tractor Parts Factory in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
Present there were Ri Chol Man, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the Agricultural Commission, and officials concerned including those of the Agricultural Commission, provincial Party committees and provincial rural economy committees.
The show introduced the successes made by relevant units taking the lead in the production, repair and maintenance of farm machines and accessories by enhancing the role of talents and consolidating the material and technical foundation on the basis of the Party's strategy for developing farm machines.
Going round the farm machine stations and the factory, the visitors exchanged and shared experience gained in the course of raising the operation rate of tractors and various farm machines by improving the repair and maintenance while increasing their technical force and updating the production process of accessories and expanding their capacity. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Chief of Information Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Information Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Nov. 23 issued a press statement titled "It is constitutional duty of the DPRK to take self-defensive measures for defending its security environment", which said:
The military tension in the region has recently become more acute as the U.S. continuously flexes its military muscle against the DPRK on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity.
The U.S., which deployed the George Washington nuclear carrier strike group in the waters around the Korean peninsula, staged Freedom Edge, the multi-domain joint military drills, with Japan and the ROK from Nov. 13 to 15.
On Nov. 18, Los Angeles-class nuclear-powered attack submarine Columbia, arrived at the Pusan operation base to incite the atmosphere of nuclear confrontation, and on Nov. 21, the strategic reconnaissance plane RC-135S flied above the East Sea of Korea, conducting undisguised air spying on the strategic depth of the DPRK.
The U.S. military provocations, being committed in the Korean peninsula where huge armed forces of two belligerent sides are on high alert and the possibility of constant military conflict lingers, constitute the source of plunging the regional situation into an irretrievable catastrophe.
We strongly warn the U.S. and its followers hostile towards the DPRK to immediately stop the hostile acts of further causing provocation and instability that can drive the military confrontation in the Korean peninsula and its vicinity into a real armed conflict.
The danger of the U.S. military provocations against the DPRK is that it will never end in muscle-flexing for frightening other or security instability limited to the region of the Korean peninsula.
The present grave political and military situation in which the U.S. military adventurism has gone beyond the red-line on a global scale foretells that the U.S. military moves targeting the DPRK can lead to a real war situation anytime.
It is the constitutional duty of the armed forces of the DPRK to take self-defensive measures to protect the security environment of the state and maintain the strategic stability and balance of strength in the region.
The KPA is closely following the military moves of the U.S. and its allies, opening up the possibility of all options in its combat readiness. If it is judged necessary, it will immediately take action to pre-contain the danger and achieve the military and strategic goal of the state. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 24 (KCNA) -- Over 1 450 units of the DPRK won the titles of the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag, the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Three-Revolution Red Flag for the past three years after the Fifth Conference of Frontrunners in the Three Revolutions in November 2021.

Struggle Staged in Puppet ROK to Demand Yoon Suk Yeol's Resignation
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 25 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of thousands of people, including workers, peasants, students and lawmakers from opposition parties, simultaneously staged all-people protests across the puppet ROK on Nov. 23, in demand of puppet Yoon Suk Yeol's resignation.
The 116th candlelight rally and demonstration was held in Seoul on the theme of "Let us break the silence and oust Yoon Kon Hui oppressing the people!".
Puppet Yoon's crimes were condemned at the rally and demo.
The co-representative of the Candlelight Action, the permanent representative of the Progressive Federation of Students and other speakers charged that Yoon, whose regime is on the verge of collapse, is persisting in strengthening a military alliance with the U.S. and Japan to plunge the ROK into the raging waves of war, not stopping the reckless war attempt.
Referring to the fact that the leaflet scattering was committed again, they said that it a war provocation and that war may break out due to war maniac Yoon Suk Yeol. And they added that the measure to prevent war is badly needed and that the way is to impeach Yoon.
The co-representative of the Network of Intellectuals and Religionists for Democratic Society read out a declaration on the situation.
The declaration said that ignorant, incompetent, brutal and thoughtless Yoon can never be pardoned as he is persisting in denying his crimes and more cruelly oppressing the people, far from making an apology for his worst murderous misrule.
The participants in the rally marched to the venue for the citizens' march, chanting slogans like "Impeachment is peace! Let us impeach Yoon Suk Yeol!"
Then, citizens' demonstration was held under the co-sponsorship of opposition parties and the emergency action denying the veto.
The emergency action in an article called for fighting against the cruel power and defending the people's right to existence.
In response to it, citizens staged a demonstration, shouting "Reject Yoon Suk Yeol!"
On the same day, the "4th People's Action Day" rally was held under the sponsorship of the Minju Party to denounce puppet Yoon for his abuse of power and demand a special investigation into his wife Kim Kon Hui.
At the rally attended by more people than the last week's that involved over 300 000, the floor leader of the Minju Party said that the tyranny of Yoon Suk Yeol and Kim Kon Hui is the misfortune of the ROK and the misfortune of all the people, adding that the fabrication of a stock price, the red herring, the interference in the election and the abuse of power are all intolerable crimes.
Meanwhile, a rally was held in demand of Yoon's resignation in Jonju of North Jolla Province, under the sponsorship of the North Jolla Provincial Movement Headquarters for Yoon Suk Yeol's Resignation formed by more than 60 civic and public organizations.
Members of workers', peasants' and civic and public organizations who took part in the rally said in speeches and declarations that Yoon's promise to build a society governed by law, principles and common sense has been already proved false, adding that the controversial abuse of power and interference in the election reminds one of the scandal of Choe Sun Sil's interference in state affairs during Park Geun Hye's tenure of office.
The participants in the rally expressed their will to fight staunchly to impeach and remove Yoon from power and get Kim Kon Hui arrested, chanting "Let us oust Yoon Suk Yeol bringing war and deteriorating people's livelihood!", "Immediately arrest Kim Kon Hui for interfering in the state affairs!" and "Parliament, immediately impeach Yoon Suk Yeol!" -0-

headline: Criteria of Thinking and Practice of Officials
story_text:
One day in January 2015, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Ryuwon Footwear Factory.
He appreciated that the factory made great achievements in implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on realizing the diversification and multi-coloring in the footwear production. He also acquainted himself with the development of new products at the factory.
Saying that all consumer goods are directly related to the people's living, he added that to fully supply quality consumer goods is not merely an economic and technical affair but an important matter of valuing and defending our own things and demonstrating the advantages of our social system.
He stressed the need for industrial establishments to put production on a normal footing and steadily improve the quality of products so that the people can benefit from them, not content with the production and display of samples.
His instructions clearly indicate the criteria of thinking and practice of officials who are directly responsible for improving the people's standard of living. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Visit to Korea April 26 Animation Studio Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 26 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place on Monday to mark the 10th anniversary of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Korea April 26 Animation Studio.
His field guidance was a historic event that ushered in a new heyday of Korean-style animation production and helped its creators and artistes break with triteness and formulism and make a U-turn in their work.
Ho Yong Chol, director of the studio, made a report at the meeting.
He said that the General Secretary indicated the tasks and ways for producing more animations of high cognitional and educational significance, including animations dealing with history and common sense, and showed warm benevolence for creators and artistes.
He noted that the officials, creators and artistes of the studio have dedicated themselves to the production of animations conducive to the cultural and emotional life of all the people, young or old, encouraged by the trust and benevolence of the Party, for the past decade.
He called on them to work harder to produce more excellent animations favored by the people. -0-

headline: To Realize Farmers' Long-cherished Desire for Water
story_text:
One day in May 1946, PresidentKim Il Sung, together with officials, visited the Anju Plain.
He met a farmer working on a dry field and took his muddy hands, asking about his impressions of the agrarian reform and how he could farm well despite drought.
The farmer said that he could do farming better than the period of the colonial rule by the Japanese imperialists despite drought as he had his own land and that he would do farming well this year and thus buy a motor to pump out water next year.
After meeting the farmer, the President told officials that an irrigation project should be undertaken as soon as possible though the country's situation was very difficult and every farmer was demanding water.
Saying that the farmer's determination to buy a motor by doing farming well is a good idea, he said that if the state and farmers pool their efforts, the irrigation project will be no problem and that large irrigation projects should be done by the state and small irrigation ones by farmers themselves.
He visualized a plan for irrigation in rural areas, listening to even simple words of a farmer and realized the long-cherished desire of farmers for water by wisely leading the campaign for irrigation project. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Sinpho City Offshore Farm in South Hamgyong Province under Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited the Sinpho City Offshore Farm under construction in the Phungo-dong area in the city of Sinpho, South Hamgyong Province, to acquaint himself with the progress made in its construction, creation of its culture grounds and preparations for their management and operation.
Accompanying him were major cadres of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, leading cadres of design and construction units, Jang Kyong Guk, chief secretary of the Sinpho City Committee of South Hamgyong Province of the WPK, and other senior officials of the city.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, chairing a historic consultative meeting on regional economic development on July 15, set forth a revolutionary policy of putting the material and cultural life of the regional people on a track of radical development by working out a proper plan for exploiting and utilizing the economic resources and overall potentialities of each region in keeping with its actual conditions and by taking practical measures to decisively boost the regional economy with strong national support. To confirm its feasibility, he gave a task for building a new model of offshore farming on a trial basis. According to his instructions, the construction of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm has been propelled for several months as a major target of the regional construction policy.
With firm resolve to thoroughly implement the Party’s regional economic development policy, soldier-builders and officials, technicians and employees of the farm have simultaneously pushed ahead with the construction of buildings and culture grounds and preparations for their management and operation. As a result, the overall construction project has been carried out at over 70 percent along with the completion of 100 hectares of culture grounds, where scallops and kelp are being farmed on a trial basis.
Under a goal to put its modern offshore farming on the highest scientific level, the farm has proactively introduced new farming techniques and methods to ensure the survival rate of a fast-growing species of scallop at 80 percent and provide a scientific and technical guarantee for increasing its production. It has also achieved important successes in applying advanced techniques to kelp farming.
Thanks to the direct care and solicitude of the Party Central Committee, the farm is being furnished with essential production means, equipment and implements, including various fish farming materials, plastic boats and aquaculture mother ships, and the manufacturing and securing of sets of equipment to be installed at the processing grounds is proceeding at the final stage.
Saying that to secure the motive force of regional economic development by fully exploiting various resources and natural and geographical environments of regions, in addition to the main construction projects in each region specified by the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, also takes an important share in the Party’s regional economic development policy, he repeatedly stressed the need to help all regions lay the foundations for developing independently by effectively developing and using their own natural and economic resources. To this end, it is important to first map out correct long-term development orientation and plan for each city and county to make the most of their conditions and environments for their own economic development, he added.
Through the designing of this farm, the industrial facility design sector has grasped and put into practice new concepts of design based on the proactive application of various space-using methods, focusing on functions and management convenience, by eliminating such a previous mode as planning the plane uniformly without considering scientific accuracy and practicability, he said, appreciating this trend as a positive change that has resolved stagnation in designing industrial facilities.
But our overall construction still fails to strictly go through all the processes, ranging from the working out of the requirements of the construction progress to designing, deliberating, approving and budget planning, according to scientific and legal procedures based on the construction law, he said. Pointing out that in recent years, architectural designs have revealed not a few such taste-oriented undisciplined practices of not ensuring economic profitability as laying stress only on the visual effect, rather than the uses, capacities and functions of the relevant facilities, and fixing scales without proper calculations, he cited their typical examples.
Saying that the overall design sector should base itself on an improved work system on the principle of properly calculating the economic efficiency and profitability, reflecting on designs the way of obtaining optimum results and enhancing the utility-specific functions of relevant structures, he stressed the need to further strengthen the system of inspecting, deliberating and approving designs.
He instructed the relevant national agencies to establish a well-regulated system for disseminating the latest sci-tech data of advanced shallow-sea culture and push ahead with improving the technical skills of the relevant units’ employees.
After learning about the progress made in construction, he concluded that it is necessary to send more skilled workers in order to successfully complete the project, which is being pushed ahead as a major policy-oriented project this year, before the forthcoming December Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee, and gave relevant instructions.
Calling for properly building and managing the Sinpho City Offshore Farm to turn it into a model of offshore farming and propagate its experience across the country, he noted that the state should responsibly provide coastal cities and counties with conditions for revitalizing aquaculture. He stressed repeatedly that in order to implement the Party’s regional development policy, it is necessary to create maximum possibilities for the regions to achieve their development, after making scientific calculations on the basis of a comprehensive survey of all resources across the country.
His field guidance at the offshore farm under construction serves as an important occasion that provided a firm practical guarantee for all regions to work out a clear development strategy and set long-term goals for radically improving the scientific character and efficiency of their development and to actively push ahead with their implementation from an innovative and creative standpoint in the drive for carrying out the historic cause of regional rejuvenation, which is being dramatically expanded and intensified. -0-

headline: Many Modern Villages Newly Built in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- Many modern rural houses have been built in different parts of the DPRK, vibrant with the implementation of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era. Such realities are outcome of the grand ambition and noble devotion of the Workers' Party of Korea to make our countryside a rich and cultured ideal village equipped with modern technology and civilization and thus achieve the rapid development of the socialist countryside.
Over the past three years, more than 1 500 fairyland villages characterized by modern aesthetic tastes, Korean-style socialism and specific regional features have appeared in different parts of the country, proving the rapid development of the countryside which is making a substantial contribution to the improvement of the peasants' living standards.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unhas led the drive for rural housing construction in all parts of the country with his extraordinary wisdom and stubborn practical ability.
Under the leadership of the Party, a solid foundation was laid for pushing forward the construction in a prospective way, looking forward to the eternal future of the socialist rural development.
The central and regional headquarters for the rural construction were formed all at once and the relevant sections were composed of competent officials. As a result, the rural construction has been conducted in a shipshape manner.
The architectural design and construction forces were built up in every region.
The material and technical foundations of the building-materials industrial sector, an arsenal for regional construction, have been further consolidated.
Measures were taken in time to supply materials necessary for the rural housing construction.
Officials and builders of provinces, cities and counties have pushed ahead with the work to create models in the rural housing construction and generalize them.
The scientific and technological strength has been steadily augmented to bring about a significant improvement in quality.
Amid the great eruption of patriotic enthusiasm in the new era of rural development, many officials and working people conducted vigorous agitation activities at construction sites and rendered material and moral assistance to them.
Consequently, rural houses with a high level of modernity, culture and diversity have appeared one after another for the last three years since the adoption of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era. They are now giving a pleasure to the agricultural workers and many modern houses are nearing completion.
Steadfast is the determination of the Party Central Committee to powerfully push ahead with the grand regional development policy for bringing about the regional prosperity and, at the same time, to make the agricultural workers and other regional people become the masters of communist society earlier than others by thoroughly implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era. -0-

headline: Telemedicine System Further Improved in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- A telemedicine system is further improving in the DPRK public health sector.
All the provincial general hospitals in the country have been equipped with hundreds of extra IT machines of 10-odd kinds so as to better the system for an operation through videoconferencing.
At hospitals in Pyongyang, work was also conducted to ensure the normal operation of the telemedicine system so that all the regional hospitals could get assistance in medical treatment.
Meanwhile, measures to improve the rapid consultation and diagnosis were taken. And rapid diagnoses and proper remedies have been ensured keeping in touch with each other through IT means.
Through the telemedicine system, tens of thousands of telemedicine consultations, thousands of online technical lectures, etc. took place this year. -0-

headline: Housing Construction Progresses Apace in Ryanggang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- Builders involved in the reconstruction of flood-hit areas in Ryanggang Province of the DPRK are speeding up the housing construction.
Members of the regiments of Party members have over-fulfilled their daily plans since the start of the reconstruction project.
The North Hamgyong provincial regiment ensured the quality of every part of the houses by enhancing a high sense of responsibility of construction and supervision officials in inside tiling and doorframe fitting, etc. and completed the greening, the building of resting places and exterior-wall painting.
The Rason municipal regiment, too, finished the interior project in a qualitative way by enhancing the role of skilled workers and is pushing ahead with the construction of waterworks and the securing of building parts.
Builders from cities and counties in Ryanggang Province did the exterior-wall decoration plastering in a peculiar way with locally available raw and other materials and are accelerating the projects for heating, water supply and drainage. -0-

Rodong Sinmun Calls for Holding Higher Banner of Self-reliance
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun notes in an article on Thursday that a series of events demonstrating the absolute prestige of the DPRK is now being witnessed in bolstering up the national defence capabilities, the steady growth of national economy is maintained and the substantial changes are made in the fields directly-related with the stability of the people's living.
What the DPRK is taking more pride are the width and depth of development, the extensiveness of the targets and speed of advance and the fact that such successes are being made by dint of self-reliance, the article says, and goes on:
Self-reliance is the only fighting spirit that runs through with the whole course of the Korean revolution and the invariable direction of advance and mode of development of the DPRK.
The high dignity and greatness of our state and people are achieved through self-reliance in every way.
There still remain many shortages and difficulties, but we have the tremendous potentiality and foundation to revitalize the country's economy and leap forward to a higher level of development as soon as possible.
Under the wise leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea, our people are pushing ahead with the gigantic and great tasks which serve as a watershed in the advance for radically developing the socialist cause.
In the period when one whole generation has been replaced by another, we have defended and developed the socialist cause without any slightest vacillation or deviation in the face of countless severe difficulties. This is a clear proof of the truthfulness and vitality of self-reliance.
No matter what road others may take and what method they choose, we have no other road and way but to go self-reliance whose validity and vitality have been clearly proved in the long course of the revolution.

headline: Successes Made in Designing
story_text:

Pyongyang University of Architecture has put the design of afforestation on a higher scientific basis and helped create landscapes with formative art in different parts of the country, including the Central Botanical Garden.
It also invented a new labor-saving protection dam design with high ecological and landscape effect and convenience in construction.
Researchers of the Institute of Land Planning under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection established an innovative methodology for mapping out urban arrangement plan, contributing to the rational use of land resources and the optimization realization of industrial structure.

headline: 550th Triplets Born at Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- The 550th boy triplets were born at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in the DPRK, and left the hospital on Nov. 27 amid the blessing of people.
The mother of the triplets is Mun Hyang Ok living in Sadong-ri, Phangyo County, Kangwon Province.
In June, she was confirmed to be pregnant with triplets. And she received the best medical care under the deep love of the motherly Party and the benefits of the socialist healthcare system.
She gave easy birth to her triplets with the medical help of doctors and nurses of the Obstetrical Department No. 2 at the hospital.
The triplets weighed 1.9 kg, 2.3 kg and 2.1 kg at birth and over 4 kg when they were discharged from the hospital. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Holding Higher Banner of Self-reliance
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun notes in an article on Thursday that a series of events demonstrating the absolute prestige of the DPRK is now being witnessed in bolstering up the national defence capabilities, the steady growth of national economy is maintained and the substantial changes are made in the fields directly-related with the stability of the people's living.
What the DPRK is taking more pride are the width and depth of development, the extensiveness of the targets and speed of advance and the fact that such successes are being made by dint of self-reliance, the article says, and goes on:
Self-reliance is the only fighting spirit that runs through with the whole course of the Korean revolution and the invariable direction of advance and mode of development of the DPRK.
The high dignity and greatness of our state and people are achieved through self-reliance in every way.
There still remain many shortages and difficulties, but we have the tremendous potentiality and foundation to revitalize the country's economy and leap forward to a higher level of development as soon as possible.
Under the wise leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea, our people are pushing ahead with the gigantic and great tasks which serve as a watershed in the advance for radically developing the socialist cause.
In the period when one whole generation has been replaced by another, we have defended and developed the socialist cause without any slightest vacillation or deviation in the face of countless severe difficulties. This is a clear proof of the truthfulness and vitality of self-reliance.
No matter what road others may take and what method they choose, we have no other road and way but to go self-reliance whose validity and vitality have been clearly proved in the long course of the revolution.
It is the absolute truth taught by the past and the present of the Korean revolution which has recorded only epochal miracles and victories and the firm confidence and faith of our people who are sure of the bright future that we can live well by our own efforts and proudly open up the road of development and prosperity in our own way. -0-

headline: New Technology of Coal Gasification Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- The State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK recently developed a new coal gasification technology, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This technology is a high-tech one completely developed in our own way for the gasification of anthracite and lignite with very high efficiency.
The development of the technology provides a scientific and technological guarantee for producing high-quality syngas with much content of effective gas while reducing the consumption of coal by over 30 percent in the process of coal gasification than the previous gasification method.
The State Academy of Sciences is now pushing ahead with the work to build the test processes for producing synthetic fuel oil and reduced iron using this syngas. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 29 (KCNA) -- Officials in the field of the preservation of revolutionary relics from across the DPRK started a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu.
A kicking-off meeting took place at the plaza before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat the Samjiyon Grand Monument on November 28.
The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statue of the President and paid tribute to him.
Ri Thae Jin, director of the Revolutionary Relics Administration Guidance Bureau, made a speech at the meeting.
He called upon the members of the study tour group to learn from the spirit of making Yongil bombs and the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and fortitude displayed by the anti-Japanese forerunners.
He said that they should study and deepen the methodological issues for keeping the revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites in their origin, preserving and managing them in a sci-tech way and conducting effective education through them, and thoroughly apply them in their work.
He stressed that all the group members should add luster to their honor as standard-bearers and frontline soldiers on the ideological front of the Workers' Party of Korea in the ongoing worthwhile struggle to usher in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation, true to the idea and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 30 (KCNA) -- A military delegation of the Russian Federation led by Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov arrived here on Nov. 29 to visit the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence.
The flags of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation were fluttering at the flagstaffs in Pyongyang International Airport, and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at the apron before the terminal.
The delegation were greeted by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officials concerned, KPA officers and men, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy.
A woman soldier of the KPA presented a bouquet to Andrei Beloussov.
There was a ceremony for welcoming the Russian military delegation.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
Conducted by No Kwang Chol, Andrei Beloussov reviewed the KPA guard of honor.
KPA officers and men gave a big clap to the Russian delegation to warmly welcome it with warm militant friendship toward the Russian service personnel and people who are displaying matchless bravery and unity in the just struggle to defend the sovereign rights and security of the country from the vicious challenges and threats of the hostile forces.
The military delegation headed for the lodging quarters amid the welcome by KPA officers and men. -0-

story_text:

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Russian Minister of Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 30 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received on Nov. 29 Minister of Defence Andrei Beloussov on a visit to the DPRK as the head of the military delegation of the Russian Federation.
Kim Jong Ungladly greeted Beloussov, who visited Pyongyang again after five months, and had a friendly and trustworthy talk with him.
Beloussov courteously conveyed the friendly greetings of Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin toKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for this and asked him to convey his warm comradely greetings to the respected Vladimir Putin.
During the talk, there was a wide-ranging exchange of views on the issues of further developing the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries, including the defence field, and defending sovereignty, security, interests and international justice of the two countries to cope with the rapidly-changing regional and international security environment, and a satisfactory consensus was reached on the views.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the visit to the DPRK by Beloussov would greatly contribute to bolstering up the defence capabilities of the two countries and ensuring their security and serve as a useful occasion in promoting the friendly, mutual cooperation and development of the relations between the two armies.
Expressing great concern over the ever-escalating development of the Ukrainian situation,Kim Jong Unexpressed the stand that the recent anti-Russia measures taken by the U.S. deserve condemnation by the international community as they are irresponsible acts of fomenting prolonged conflict and threatening all mankind.
Noting that the U.S. and the West made Kiev authorities attack Russia's territory with their own long-range strike weapons, he added that it means their direct military intervention in the conflict and that it is an exercise of the right to self-defence for Russia to take resolute action to make the hostile forces pay the price as it has emerged as an aggressive entity in the anti-Russia war. And he stressed the need to take clear action to give a signal that the provocative forces led by the U.S. will not benefit from their disregard for the warning of Russia.
The recent counterattack against Ukraine by the Russian government and army is a timely and effective measure to inform the U.S., the West and Ukraine, which are resorting to reckless military adventurism, of the gravity of the situation and the will of Russia to take tough counteraction, he said, affirming that the DPRK government, army and people will invariably support the policy of the Russian Federation to defend its sovereignty and territorial integrity from the imperialists' moves for hegemony.
The strong DPRK-Russia relations serve as a powerful security device for promoting the well-being of the two peoples, defusing the regional situation and ensuring international strategic stability, he said, expressing the will to more vigorously expand and develop the relations between the two countries in all fields, including politics, economy and military affairs, under the agreement reached at the DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit in June last.
Kim Jong Unasked Beloussov to convey his best wishes to the respected Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the Russian government, army and people, and reaffirmed again that Pyongyang would always be with Moscow. -0-

headline: Military Delegation of Russian Federation Arrives in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 30 (KCNA) -- A military delegation of the Russian Federation led by Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov arrived here on Nov. 29 to visit the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence.
The flags of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation were fluttering at the flagstaffs in Pyongyang International Airport, and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army (KPA) lined up at the apron before the terminal.
The delegation were greeted by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officials concerned, KPA officers and men, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy.
A woman soldier of the KPA presented a bouquet to Andrei Beloussov.
There was a ceremony for welcoming the Russian military delegation.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
Conducted by No Kwang Chol, Andrei Beloussov reviewed the KPA guard of honor.
KPA officers and men gave a big clap to the Russian delegation to warmly welcome it with warm militant friendship toward the Russian service personnel and people who are displaying matchless bravery and unity in the just struggle to defend the sovereign rights and security of the country from the vicious challenges and threats of the hostile forces.
The military delegation headed for the lodging quarters amid the welcome by KPA officers and men. -0-

headline: DPRK Ministry of National Defence Hosts Reception for Russian Military Delegation
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 30 (KCNA) -- The DPRK Ministry of National Defence gave a reception at the April 25 House of Culture on Friday evening in welcome of the visit to the DPRK by the military delegation of the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were members of the military delegation of the Russian Federation led by Minister of Defence Andrei Beloussov, Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was present at the reception.
Present there were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Pak Jong Chon and Jo Chun Ryong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and senior major officials of the WPK Central Committee, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, commanders of the KPA services and officials concerned.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the reception hall together with Beloussov amid the playing of welcome music, the participants warmly applauded them.
No Kwang Chol made a speech at the reception.
He paid warm militant tribute to all the officers and men of the heroic Russian army on behalf of all the service personnel of the armed forces of the DPRK.
Referring to the fact that the DPRK-Russia friendship is developing into relations of invincible alliance and comrade-in-arms relations thanks to the special comradely relations between the heads of state of the two countries, he expressed the steadfast stand and will of the WPK and the DPRK government and armed forces which fully and most powerfully support and encourage the just sacred war of the Russian army and people to defend the sovereign rights, security and interests of the country.
He said that Beloussov's Pyongyang visit would serve as an important military and political occasion for powerfully demonstrating the militant friendship and unity between the two armies getting stronger day by day in the same trench of the common front for independence against imperialism.
Then Andrei Beloussov made a reply speech.
Saying that the two armies have carried on long-standing and good cooperative relations, he noted that they are further consolidating the invincible comradely ties in the struggle to cope with all threats of the present era challenging independence and justice.
The comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the DPRK provided a crucial driving force for firmly defending the sovereignty of the two countries from all sorts of aggression and arbitrary practices by imperialism and developing the precious Russia-DPRK friendly relations in a diversified and long-term way, he said.
Extending heartfelt thanks to the militant solidarity of the Party and government of the DPRK with the sacred war waged by the Russian army and people against the imperialist strategy for hegemony, he expressed the will to make more positive contributions to global peace, regional stability and prosperity of the two countries.
The participants toasted the good health of ComradeKim Jong Unand President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the further expansion and strengthening of the cooperative relations between the armed forces of the two countries.
The reception proceeded in an amicable atmosphere full of comradeship. -0-

headline: Chairman Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in South Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 1 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected various units in South Hamgyong Province.
Learning in detail about the production at the Sinpho Canned Fish Factory, Jongphyong County Foodstuff Factory and Hamhung Wheat Processing Factory, he called upon the officials and employees to give precedence to the supply of raw and other materials and boost the output through a brisk mass technical innovation movement, mindful of the importance of their duty in improving the people's diet and implementing the Party's childcare policy.
He acquainted himself with the project for updating the Ryongsong Machine Complex on the spot and stressed the need for all the builders to push ahead with the project as scheduled while ensuring the quality of construction. He called on the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm to put the production of vegetables on a normal track by dint of science and technology so that the benevolence of the Party reaches the people better.
At the mother tree nursery and the Ryulsong Farm in Jongphyong County, he called for further increasing the output of saplings for afforestation and greening and making good preparations for next year's farming, taking into full consideration the prospect of the regional economic development.
Going round classrooms, labs, music and dance rooms of Haeam Primary School and Sinpho Senior Middle School in Sinpho City, he said that the teaching staff should bring about innovations in the contents and methods of education and steadily improve the educational conditions and environments, true to the intention of the Party which most prioritizes the education of the rising generation, and underscored the need for the Hamhung School Uniform Factory to make good preparations for the production of school uniforms for the new year.
Learning about the work of the people's power organs at all levels in South Hamgyong Province, he underlined the need for the officials and deputies of power organs to further enhance their sense of responsibility and role in successfully concluding the struggle for this significant year, ensuring that the policies of the Party and the state for the people are correctly implemented, making the people have stronger law-abiding spirit and establishing a revolutionary climate of law observance.
Meanwhile, he took part in the meetings for awarding the title of model education city to Sinpho City of South Hamgyong Province, and the title of model sports county to Jongphyong County. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls upon Officials to Fulfill Their Duties
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 1 (KCNA) -- Now is the time for our officials to take more accurate, responsible, devoted and positive attitude in fulfilling their duties, once again mindful of the weight of the revolutionary tasks they have determined to carry out unconditionally before the Party and the people, Rodong Sinmun says in an editorial on Sunday.
Stressing that the above-said revolutionary tasks are important ones for defending the high dignity and absolute prestige of the Workers' Party of Korea in every way, the editorial goes on to say:
Whether we further expand and develop the favorable situation and phase of comprehensive development created through the stubborn struggle and review our work proudly before the Party after achieving more gigantic and brilliant successes or not, depends on the fulfillment of this year’s policy-oriented tasks.
All officials should bring about the successful implementation of the Party's decisions without fail by redoubling their efforts and spirit in the vanguard of the front of struggle for the national development and prosperity, always mindful of the heavy mission and responsibility entrusted to them by the Party and the revolution.
Though they have no time to spare and face manifold difficulties, they should concentrate all efforts on the implementation of their plans with the feeling of pressure and high sense of responsibility.
The editorial calls upon officials to thoroughly implement the Party's decisions with courageous efforts, deeply aware of the weight of the revolutionary tasks they have determined to carry out unconditionally before the Party and the people and thus brilliantly adorn this year with more substantial and brilliant successes. -0-

headline: All-People Protests Launched in Demand of Puppet Yoon Suk Yeol's Resignation
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- Massive protests are going on in the puppet ROK to impeach puppet Yoon Suk Yeol who is engrossed in all sorts of dictatorship and arbitrary practices while creating the war and security crisis with the backing of the U.S.
More than 100 000 people from all walks of life, including workers, peasants and youth and students, took part in the grand candlelight march, the "People's Action Day" rally and civic march held in Seoul on November 30 in demand of the resignation of Yoon Suk Yeol and the special investigation into Kim Kon Hui.
The 117th candlelight rally and demonstration sponsored by the Candlelight Action was held on the theme of "Let us overthrow Yoon Suk Yeol who is protecting Kim Kon Hui and intervening in Ukraine!"
The participants in the rally and demonstration burst out their surging anger at such crimes of puppet Yoon as creating war crisis, seeking sycophantic and humiliating diplomacy and abusing the veto power, chanting a slogan "Let us overthrow traitor Yoon Suk Yeol!"
As revealed through the interference in the election rigging, Yoon took the power through the red herring in the past presidential election, they said, adding that the Yoon regime was the one which should not have been emerged as it has been engrossed in lies and fabrication from the beginning.
Recalling that 4 300 professors from 85 universities have taken part in campaign for declaring the situation as of November 29 amid the brisk campaign for the resignation of Yoon at all universities, speakers called upon all professors, intellectuals, religionists, merchants and other people at all social standings to join  the campaign in protest against anti-peace, anti-democracy and prosecution dictatorship.
At the end of the candlelight rally and demonstration, the "5th People's Action Day" rally was held under the sponsorship of the Minju Party to denounce puppet Yoon Suk Yeol for peddling in the state affair and demand a special investigation into Kim Kon Hui.
At the rally attended by 100 000 people from all walks of life, the representative of the Minju Party and lawmakers from opposition parties revealed and condemned the crimes committed by Yoon who has been impatient to intervene in the Ukrainian war and vetoing again a draft special investigation into the irregularities and corruption of Kim Kon Hui.
Then the 3rd civic rally co-sponsored by opposition parties, including the Minju Party, and the "national emergency action denying the veto" was held to demand the special investigation into Kim Kon Hui and probe the peddling in state affair and deny Yoon.
The national emergency action said in a statement on the same day that the hideous power rejecting the will of the people and reigning over them will surely collapse, adding that they will surely oust Yoon by the efforts of the people.
The puppet media reported about the struggle under the titles of "Shouts raised in Seoul in demand of 'Yoon Suk Yeol's resignation' and 'special investigation into Kim Kon Hui'", "117th grant candlelight demonstration-5th People's Action Day-civic march" and "100 000 citizens struggle for Yoon's resignation in spite of heavy snowfall." -0-

headline: WPK Central Committee Sends Greetings to General Council of United Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a message of greeting to the General Council of the United Russia Party (URP) on December 1.
In the message, the WPK Central Committee extended warm congratulations to the URP leadership, all its members and its supporters throughout the country on the occasion of the 23rd anniversary of the founding of the United Russia Party.
We are pleased that the URP is dynamically pushing ahead with the implementation of the programme of building powerful and prosperous Russia by pooling the patriotic enthusiasm of the people of all social strata as one, and express firm support and solidarity with the just cause of the United Russia Party and the Russian people to defend the sovereignty, security and development interests of the country, the message said.

headline: Chollima Steel Complex Boosts Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- The Chollima Steel Complex in the DPRK strives to attain the goal of producing iron and steel.
The steel shop is increasing the amount of molten iron per charge with the method of high-temperature oxidation by continuous charging method and oxygen blowing while boosting the cooperation between shifts and shortening the melting time.
The rolling shop has launched a mass technical innovation movement to improve the performance of equipment, thus raising the rolling yield more than ever before.
Meanwhile, the complex is pushing ahead with the work to improve the Juche-based iron production system and expand its production capacity.
The technical team of the complex has completed the technical preparations for the construction of a new UHP electric arc furnace and a base for producing electrodes with a capacity of thousands of tons in close contact with scientific research institutes, thus contributing to perfecting the Korean-style method of iron production and strengthening the production foundation. -0-

headline: National Economic Plan for November Fulfilled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 3 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the labor efforts of officials and working people across the country to unconditionally and correctly carry out the tasks for this year's struggle, true to the decisions of the plenary meetings of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the national economic plan for November was successfully fulfilled in different economic sectors and units.
The key industrial sector has increased production in the outposts for self-supporting economic development.
The steel workers overfulfilled their production plan for rolled steel by 120 percent.
The chemical industry, a core industry for self-supporting economic development, brought about a surge in production in the spirit of Chollima in the new era.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex increased the production of Juche fertilizer. And the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Sunchon Chemical Complex, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and other units have made signal achievements by tapping reserves and possibilities and updating equipment.
The electric-power industry sector put the management of generating equipment and power transmission and distribution system on a scientific basis and hastened the technical upgrading, and thus fulfilled its national economic plan.
The Ministry of Coal Industry fulfilled its production plan for November at 100.6 percent.
The machine-building industry sector made successes in the production of custom-built equipment.
The Ministry of Mining Industry fulfilled its production plan for nonferrous metals and minerals.
The railway transport workers carried out their monthly freight plan at 109.1 percent.
Several units in the forestry sector set felling sites right and increased the utilization of machinery and equipment, and thus carried out their yearly plan. -0-

headline: Most Honorable Revolutionary Task
story_text:
One day in October 1957, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a middle school and went round various parts of it.
He met teachers to learn about their work and living conditions and asked them if they were conducting information work in rural areas.
Looking at them with no answer, he said that it was the most honorable revolutionary task for them to educate peasants.
He added that he had experienced the teacher’s life in need of undercover operation in the past, and stressed that it is an important task of the teachers in local areas at present to educate the peasants in the Party’s policies well and teach agricultural techniques well.
He said that the teachers at rural schools should not only teach the students well but also give to the peasants lectures on the Party's policies such as the one on using mountains, mindful that education is not a mere job but a revolutionary task.
Upon receiving the instructions of the President, the teachers keenly realized once again the importance of their duty. -0-

A research group of Kim Chaek University of Technology and a technical force of the Kim Chaek Rock Drill Factory developed an energy-saving pneumatic rock drill. The newly developed drill is more efficient and higher than the existing drills of same type in performance.
