headline: Agricultural Workers Move into New Houses in DPRK
DPRK Premier Inspects Kumsong Tractor Factory and Namhung Youth Chemical Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex.
Going round various places of the Kumsong Tractor Factory, he encouraged the officials and workers in their efforts for successfully attaining the goal of this year's struggle set forth by the Party and learned in detail about the second-stage modernization.
He stressed the need for the officials to grasp in detail the overall construction by displaying high sense of responsibility and intensify operation and command in line with the modernization being pushed ahead with at the final stage.
He stressed the need to take timely measures to prevent any defect in all elements while taking into consideration practicality and efficiency of production processes in reliance on the Party's strategy for developing farm machines and carry on construction work, assembling of equipment and trial operation according to projects and systems in keeping with the high demand of the modernization target.
He called for steadily improving the performance of products by strengthening the factory's own technical forces and providing all conditions on advanced level necessary for producing enough high-performance and quality tractors and farm machines including the maximum efficiency test of newly-made farm machines.

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Kumsong Tractor Factory and Namhung Youth Chemical Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, inspected the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex.
Going round various places of the Kumsong Tractor Factory, he encouraged the officials and workers in their efforts for successfully attaining the goal of this year's struggle set forth by the Party and learned in detail about the second-stage modernization.

He stressed the need to take timely measures to prevent any defect in all elements while taking into consideration practicality and efficiency of production processes in reliance on the Party's strategy for developing farm machines and carry on construction work, assembling of equipment and trial operation according to projects and systems in keeping with the high demand of the modernization target.

Field consultative meetings discussed the issue of completing the supply and installation of production equipment and the products under contract at relevant units in the set time, the issue of further increasing productivity by expanding production capacity and managing equipment and improving technical control in a responsible manner, etc. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson on Anti-Syria Terrorism
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on Dec. 5 as regards the situation in Syria getting worse day by day due to the reckless military moves of terrorists:
The terrorists of all kinds, who have been prolonging their remaining days in mountainous areas of Syria, recently committed sudden attack under political manipulation of outside forces and their military support on various regions under control of the Syrian government and army, destroying peaceful cities and villages and killing innocent civilians. This is a hideous crime against humanity which can never be justified.
What should not be overlooked is that a new bloodshed occurred in Syria by the terrorists just at the time when the Arab people's hope and expectation for peace and stability in the Middle East are growing stronger thanks to the recent adoption of ceasefire agreement between the patriotic force organization of Lebanon and Israel.
The recent incident is a product of the vicious plots of the hostile forces to "demonize" the legitimate government of Syria from A to Z, create uneasiness and horror in Syria and, at the same time, reproduce the scenario of the massacre in the Gaza Strip and Lebanon in Syria again, thus pushing the situation in the Middle East to a catastrophic situation.
We strongly denounce the reckless military moves of terrorists in Syria and the sinister intention of the behind-the-scene forces conniving at and fostering them, and express full support and solidarity with the Syrian government and people in their just struggle to defend the sovereignty of the country and territorial integrity and settle the crisis, and the efforts of Arab countries to achieve durable peace and stability in the Middle East region. -0-

headline: Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between DPRK and Russian Federation Comes into Force
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- The ratification instruments of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation signed by the heads of states of the two countries in Pyongyang on June 19, 2024 were exchanged in Moscow on December 4.
Vice Foreign Minister of the DPRK Kim Jong Gyu and Vice Foreign Minister of the Russian Federation Andrei Yurievich Rudenko signed the protocol on exchange of ratification instruments.
The treaty has an effect from December 4, 2024 when the ratification instruments were exchanged according to Article 22 of the treaty.
Thereby, the treaty of friendship, good neighborliness and cooperation between the DPRK and the Russian Federation concluded on February 9, 2000 became ineffective.
The treaty serves as a legal framework for realizing the far-reaching plan of the state leadership of the two countries and the desire of the two peoples by putting the bilateral relations on a new strategic level and building a powerful state while firmly defending the regional and global security environment in conformity with the common interests.
The mighty DPRK-Russia relations based on the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership will be a powerful security device that promotes the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries, eases the regional situation and guarantees international strategic stability, and will serve as a strong driving force accelerating the establishment of independent and just multi-polarized world order without domination, subjugation and hegemony. -0-

Present at ceremonies for moving into those new houses were Kim Yong Hak, secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials, builders and agricultural workers in Hamju County.

story_text:

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- The 34th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday.
Present there were vice-chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and other members of the SPA Standing Committee.
Officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies were on hand as observers.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, presided over the plenary meeting.
The plenary meeting discussed as its agendas the issue of convening the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the issue of deliberating and adopting the law on managing identification and the law on preventing noise pollution, the issue of recalling and electing judges and people's assessors of the Central Court, etc.
The decision of the SPA Standing Committee on convening the Twelfth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was adopted with unanimous approval at the plenary meeting.
Then, there was a report on the main contents of relevant drafts of laws discussed by the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
On the basis of study and discussion on the proposed bills, the plenary meeting adopted with unanimous approval a decree of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Managing Identification" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Preventing Noise Pollution".
The plenary meeting recalled and elected the judges and people's assessors of the Central Court of the DPRK. -0-

story_text:

The session will discuss the work of the DPRK Cabinet in 2024, the issue of the tasks for 2025, the issue of the settlement of the implementation of the state budget in 2024 and the state budget in 2025, the issue of deliberating and adopting the law on building-materials industry and the law on offshore farming, the issue of the work of the Central Court in 2024, the issue of revising some provisions of the Socialist Constitution and the organizational matter.
The registration of the deputies will be held on January 20 and 21, 2025.
A related official notice was issued by the SPA Standing Committee on Dec. 5. -0-

headline: Land Improvement Campaign Brisk in N. Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK conducted an autumn public campaign for land improvement, thus adding beauty to the provincial landscape.
Thanks to the hard-working officials and citizens in the province, roads extending tens of kilometers were paved or technically improved, hundreds of thousands of square meters of river embankments reinforced and over 1.6 million cubic meters of river bed dredged along with the remodeling of many houses and public buildings.
Kujang County dredged thousands of cubic meters of river bed in a 200-odd meter-long section by mobilizing mechanical means, and Nyongbyon County carried out an embankment project for protecting the arable land.

headline: Many People Spend Their Holiday at Yangdok Hot Spring Resort
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- The Yangdok Hot Spring Resort in the DPRK, built under the great loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea, is awash with tourists all year round.
The wonderland in the hot spring area of Yangdok County has drawn many visitors for its beautiful mountainous landscape and good water. A total of at least 740 000 working people have so far spent their holiday at the resort.
The resort mirrors the devoted service made by the great Party Central Committee to bring highly civilized life to the people.
Out of his firm will to make his people the happiest in the world, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uninitiated the construction of a combined hot spring resort and energetically guided the project.
He examined more than 2 000 layouts of the resort to build it as an icon of Korean-style hot spring health spa and a multi-functional sports and cultural complex.
Many people, including war veterans and disabled soldiers across the country, spent their holiday at the resort associated with the tender-hearted leader's energetic guidance. -0-

headline: Advanced Agricultural Sci-tech Products Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, research institutes under the Academy of Agricultural Science in the DPRK developed a soil improvement agent and a mixed herbicide.
The soil improvement agent was introduced into many farms across the country, including North Phyongan, South Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces this year, contributing to improving the soil fertility of paddy and non-paddy fields and increasing the per-hectare grain yield.
The mixed herbicide was introduced into tens of thousands of hectares of land and is well appreciated by agricultural officials and workers. It helps kill aquatic weeds such as barnyard grass in the paddy fields. -0-

headline: Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm Overfulfills Vegetable Production Plan for Five Years
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- When visiting the completed Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm on December 3, 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed satisfaction with the fact that vegetables produced by the farm contribute to improving the diet of people in North Hamgyong Province, and gave an instruction on producing and supplying nutritious and tasty vegetables to people on a regular basis.
The Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm has produced plenty of vegetables for the people every year since its inauguration.
Giving priority to putting the vegetable production on a scientific basis, it has raised the per-hectare yields of various tasty and fresh vegetables.
The farm organized a show of advanced farming methods in each process and workshops to improve the technical skills of employees.
It installed cylindrical cultivation devices to increase the production of lettuce and others in contrast to hydroponic cultivation, and secured dozens of new equipment to lay a material foundation for putting the vegetable production on a modern, intensive and industrial basis.
The farm introduced air purifiers to prevent damage by harmful insects and promote the growth of crops, and developed and applied new microbial agrochemicals to raise the quality and ensure the safety of production.
It has increased the output for the past five years. Notably, it produced thousands of tons of vegetables more than the planned this year. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- The 34th Plenary Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the DPRK took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday.
Present there were vice-chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and other members of the SPA Standing Committee.
Officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies were on hand as observers.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, presided over the plenary meeting.
The plenary meeting discussed as its agendas the issue of convening the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the issue of deliberating and adopting the law on managing identification and the law on preventing noise pollution, the issue of recalling and electing judges and people's assessors of the Central Court, etc.
The decision of the SPA Standing Committee on convening the Twelfth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was adopted with unanimous approval at the plenary meeting.
Then, there was a report on the main contents of relevant drafts of laws discussed by the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
On the basis of study and discussion on the proposed bills, the plenary meeting adopted with unanimous approval a decree of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Managing Identification" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Preventing Noise Pollution".
The plenary meeting recalled and elected the judges and people's assessors of the Central Court of the DPRK. -0-

Achievements in Electric Power Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the electric power industry of the DPRK have made remarkable successes this year.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex succeeded in the oxygen-dust anthracite ignition technology, which improved its performance, thus opening up a prospect for expanding and introducing it into all boilers. It also raised the power output of turbines and the combustion efficiency to boost the electricity production.
Workers and technicians of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant created tens of thousands of more kilowatts generating capacity and finished the overhaul of several turbogenerators before schedule.
The East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant carried out its production plan by further boosting the steam production through rational updating of equipment.
Sodusu and Hochongang power stations improved the performance of water wheel blades and manufactured and introduced real-time water level measuring device to raise the efficiency of equipment and put the water control on a scientific basis of higher level.
The Kumyagang Army-People Power Station and the Huichon Power Station completed retaining wall construction at lower reaches of the dams by introducing advanced construction methods and laid a foundation for increased electricity production by enhancing the reservoir capacity.
Jangjingang, Pujongang, Namgang and Thaechon power stations finished flood gate repair and Suphung, Wiwon, Jangjagang and Taedonggang power stations made it sure that the flood control is put on a rapid, correct and scientific basis by introducing a flood-calculating program.
Provincial power transmission and distribution stations established a lightning protection system on major substations and transmission lines and substituted or newly installed breakers, disconnectors, insulators of various kinds, etc. while solving technical problems arising in further perfecting the national integrated power control system. -0-

headline: Women's Union Officials Start Study Tour of Mt Paektu Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Officials of the women's union from across the DPRK started a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu.
A kick-off meeting took place at the plaza before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat the Samjiyon Grand Monument on Dec. 6.
The participants laid bouquets at the statue of the President.
Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, made an address to be followed by speeches at the meeting.
The speakers said that the study tour would serve as an occasion of further hardening the faith and will of the women's union officials to fulfill their responsibility and duty as women revolutionaries in the drive for ushering in a new era of national prosperity and the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, after being fully armed with the indomitable revolutionary spirit of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners.
They called upon all the members of the study tour group to further grasp how the traditions of the Korean revolution have been provided and firmly carried forward and developed during the expedition.
They expressed their determination to dynamically accelerate the march to the battle sites of Mt Paektu while singing the song "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and demonstrate the might of the women's union in the on-going general advance for hastening the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism with strong spiritual power and patriotic devotion.
At the end of the meeting, the group members went round the Samjiyon Grand Monument. -0-

headline: Researcher of NATA on Deployment of U.S. Space Force in Asia-Pacific Region
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Ri Song Jin, a researcher of the National Aerospace Technology Administration (NATA) of the DPRK, issued the following article titled "The deployment of the U.S. Space Force in the Asia-Pacific region is the end product of Washington's attempt for regional hegemony":
The U.S. attempt for aggression to contain its strategic rivals and establish military supremacy in the Asia-Pacific region is becoming more conspicuous in space, too.
A typical example is the fact that the U.S. held a ceremony of founding the U.S. space force in Japan at the Yokoda Air Force Base on December 4.
The U.S. Indo-Pacific Space commander tried to deceive the international community, building public opinion that this is an inevitable measure to contain the "military threats" from the DPRK, Russia and China.
But the offensive mission of the U.S. Space Force and its continuous expansion into the overseas region clearly prove that such military moves are not aimed to cope with someone's "threat".
As already recognized by the Pentagon's senior officials, the mission of the U.S. Space Force is not only to monitor the situation of the conflict on the earth, but also to neutralize the enemy in case of the space-based military operations and to make the forces deployed in space part of the US war capabilities.
The number of the U.S. Space Force, which had been more than 200 in the early period of its foundation in 2019, has increased over 40 times in just three to four years and the development and test of various weapons for space warfare are being accelerated according to the ever-increasing space force budget.
The U.S., after setting the Asia-Pacific region as the first overseas stationing place of the offensive space force, formed the Indo-Pacific Space Command in November 2022 to deploy its first space field forces in the puppet ROK region in December that year and organized the U.S. space force in Japan this time.
The true purpose is clear.
The purpose is to rapidly turn outer space, a common asset of the whole mankind, into a battlefield in case of emergency, preemptively secure the space-based strike capability against independent sovereign states in the region and hold an absolute military edge with the involvement of vassal forces by intensively deploying space field forces in the Asia-Pacific region.
This is proved by the fact that the U.S. space force in the puppet ROK has frequently joined Ulji Freedom Shield and other joint military exercises to master capability for operation in contingency of the Korean peninsula and the U.S. and Japan in November conspired to expand the inter-state space cooperation including the development of low-orbit satellite under the pretext of coping with the "threat" of ultra-supersonic missiles from other countries.
Obviously, the deployment of the U.S. Space Force in the Asia-Pacific region is part of Washington's moves to seek hegemony, and it is another new factor of instability that draws the military tension in the region into the real danger of armed conflict.
The gravity of the situation lies in the fact that the possibility of a military conflict in the region is rapidly expanding into space beyond the existing military operation sphere, including the ground, sea and air, due to the irresponsible behavior of the U.S.
The reality in which the U.S. is getting frantic with space militarization by massively deploying space force into the Korean peninsula and its vicinity urgently requires the DPRK to firmly ensure the strategic security balance in the region by putting spurs to grasping all the military moves of the hostile forces in space and taking timely measures for action.
The DPRK will deter any military provocation of the hostile forces and firmly defend the security interests of the state and peace and stability in the region by dint of exercising more thoroughly and perfectly the right to self-defence. -0-

Provincial power transmission and distribution stations established a lightning protection system on major substations and transmission lines and substituted or newly installed breakers, disconnectors, insulators of various kinds, etc. while solving technical problems arising in further perfecting the national integrated power control system. -0-

headline: Researcher of NATA on Deployment of U.S. Space Force in Asia-Pacific Region
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Ri Song Jin, a researcher of the National Aerospace Technology Administration (NATA) of the DPRK, issued the following article titled "The deployment of the U.S. Space Force in the Asia-Pacific region is the end product of Washington's attempt for regional hegemony":
The U.S. attempt for aggression to contain its strategic rivals and establish military supremacy in the Asia-Pacific region is becoming more conspicuous in space, too.
A typical example is the fact that the U.S. held a ceremony of founding the U.S. space force in Japan at the Yokoda Air Force Base on December 4.
The U.S. Indo-Pacific Space commander tried to deceive the international community, building public opinion that this is an inevitable measure to contain the "military threats" from the DPRK, Russia and China.
But the offensive mission of the U.S. Space Force and its continuous expansion into the overseas region clearly prove that such military moves are not aimed to cope with someone's "threat".
As already recognized by the Pentagon's senior officials, the mission of the U.S. Space Force is not only to monitor the situation of the conflict on the earth, but also to neutralize the enemy in case of the space-based military operations and to make the forces deployed in space part of the US war capabilities.
The number of the U.S. Space Force, which had been more than 200 in the early period of its foundation in 2019, has increased over 40 times in just three to four years and the development and test of various weapons for space warfare are being accelerated according to the ever-increasing space force budget.
The U.S., after setting the Asia-Pacific region as the first overseas stationing place of the offensive space force, formed the Indo-Pacific Space Command in November 2022 to deploy its first space field forces in the puppet ROK region in December that year and organized the U.S. space force in Japan this time.
The true purpose is clear.
The purpose is to rapidly turn outer space, a common asset of the whole mankind, into a battlefield in case of emergency, preemptively secure the space-based strike capability against independent sovereign states in the region and hold an absolute military edge with the involvement of vassal forces by intensively deploying space field forces in the Asia-Pacific region.
This is proved by the fact that the U.S. space force in the puppet ROK has frequently joined Ulji Freedom Shield and other joint military exercises to master capability for operation in contingency of the Korean peninsula and the U.S. and Japan in November conspired to expand the inter-state space cooperation including the development of low-orbit satellite under the pretext of coping with the "threat" of ultra-supersonic missiles from other countries.
Obviously, the deployment of the U.S. Space Force in the Asia-Pacific region is part of Washington's moves to seek hegemony, and it is another new factor of instability that draws the military tension in the region into the real danger of armed conflict.
The gravity of the situation lies in the fact that the possibility of a military conflict in the region is rapidly expanding into space beyond the existing military operation sphere, including the ground, sea and air, due to the irresponsible behavior of the U.S.
The reality in which the U.S. is getting frantic with space militarization by massively deploying space force into the Korean peninsula and its vicinity urgently requires the DPRK to firmly ensure the strategic security balance in the region by putting spurs to grasping all the military moves of the hostile forces in space and taking timely measures for action.
The DPRK will deter any military provocation of the hostile forces and firmly defend the security interests of the state and peace and stability in the region by dint of exercising more thoroughly and perfectly the right to self-defence. -0-

headline: "Simple Calculation" Will Only Bring Miserable Result
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- The Biden administration recently told the Zelenskiy puppet clique that Ukraine should lower the age of recruitment in order to keep fighting with Russia and thus sharply increase the number of troops.
And they said that "simple calculation" for breaking through the present situation is to accept their demands and put more troops into battles.
It is said that the population under 30 has become the smallest in the history of Ukraine because many young people are now going abroad to evade military service and the number of casualties is increasing at the battlefields.
It is clear that the existence of Ukraine will be finally settled if the young men just out of boyishness are driven into the battlefields as bullet-shields.
Military experts of the world now comment that the attainment of Russia's special military operations is a matter of time, and even Zelenskiy, the war shock brigade commander "faithful" to the U.S., is making such rhetoric that his army is incapable of regaining the "lost territory".
But the present U.S. ruling quarters are unhesitatingly blustering that their approval of Ukraine's use of long-range missile was too late, not content with pushing their servants to the battlefields while claiming that Russia's nuclear fear is exaggerated.
The U.S. and the West opened "Pandora's box" without hesitation. Such act is driving them into the pitfalls of the worst-ever inferiority and bringing the powerful countermeasures of Russia one after another to hasten the final doom of the Ukrainian puppet forces.
The U.S. master is keen on high-handed and arbitrary practices to push the stooge to the commonly acknowledged unsuccessful battlefields to the end. This is the height of impudence.
It is deplorable that the Ukrainian puppet forces are suffering from the hard-fought proxy war, believing such master.
The fact clearly shows once again that the U.S. is the most ferocious chieftain of evils on the earth, which will unhesitatingly destroy global peace and stability and even commit such an act of exterminating mankind with the "simple calculation" of putting forward its servant as cannon fodder for a war for its ambition for hegemony and selfish purpose.
But the U.S. should clearly understand that the result of the "simple calculation" is always miserable. -0-

headline: DPRK Women's Football Rising to World’s Top
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 8 (KCNA) -- The DPRK's U-20 and U-17 women football teams won four trophies in the international games this year. These successes are amazing the football world.
The DPRK women's football teams have won U-20 and U-17 Women's World Cups three times respectively, which showed the status of the DPRK women's football rapidly rising to the top of the world.
The DPRK U-20 and U-17 women's football teams won the Third FIFA U-20 Women's World Championships in 2006 and the First FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in 2008. They also won FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup and FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in 2016 and 2024.
So the DPRK U-20 women's football team has became one of the three strong teams which won the World Cup three times in the history of the World Cup, and the DPRK U-17 women's football team the strongest team that won the World Cup three times for the first time.
The DPRK women footballers and coaches are determined to fully display the ever-victorious spirit and prestige of their country with gold medals and trophies in international games by further intensifying training. -0-

headline: Many People in DPRK Visit Phyongchon Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 9 (KCNA) -- The Phyongchon Revolutionary Site in Pyongyang draws an endless stream of visitors. The site is associated with the exploits performed by the peerlessly great persons of the DPRK for developing the Juche-based defence industry.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the remodeled revolutionary site in December 2015. Since then, more than 890 000 working people, service personnel, youngsters and students from at least 9 000 units have visited the site for the past nine years.
The visitors were briefed on the history of the site in front of a mosaic depicting PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland anti-Japanese war heroine Kim Jong Suk expressing satisfaction with the performance of a home-made submachine gun after personally testing it on June 16, 1949.
At the revolutionary museum, they looked around the historical mementos dealing with the exploits of the peerlessly great persons for the development of the Juche-based defence industry, including photos of the President and his work "We Must Build Our Own Ordnance Industry".
They learned about the fighting spirit of the working class of the preceding generations, who pioneered the cause of building the domestic defence industry, in different parts of the site.
They were told about the fact that the respected General Secretary, during his visit to the site 9 years ago, gave important instructions that the site should fulfil its mission as an ideological education base.
They also looked at the photos showing the ever-developing Korean-style defence industry. -0-

headline: Cement Carriers Launched in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 9 (KCNA) -- A fleet of cargo ships formed in the mountainous counties of North Phyongan and Jagang provinces near the Suphung Lake amid the vigorous drive for the revolution for regional development and rural construction across the DPRK according to the grand blueprint of the Workers' Party of Korea.
True to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to provide the local people with civilized and affluent living conditions and environment as early as possible, the workers of the Sinuiju Shipbuilding Yard and the Suphung Marine Transport Company built cement carriers and excavation ship with their own efforts and technology and thus laid another solid material foundation for dynamically pushing forward the regional and rural construction even in the areas where transport conditions are unfavorable.
The successes achieved by the workers in the field of marine transport in the drive to successfully conclude this significant year and greet the 11th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Party Central Committee with proud labor feats are an expression of boundless patriotism and loyalty of the people who regard the Party's plan and intention as their sacred and honorable revolutionary tasks and devotedly struggle for carrying them out perfectly.
The newly-built cargo ships "Jinhung-1", "Jinhung-2" and "Jinhung-3" and the excavation ship "Jinhung-4" were launched.
A launching ceremony took place on the spot on December 8.
Present there were Kang Jong Gwan, minister of Land and Maritime Transport, Ri Hi Yong, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport and North Phyongan and Jagang provinces, employees of the Sinuiju Shipbuilding Yard and the Suphung Maritime Transport Company and working people in Sakju County.
Choe Yong Man, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, made an address to be followed by speeches.
The speakers noted that the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who made sure that the state made it a policy and law to supply cement regularly to all cities and counties every year, took a revolutionary measure to organize a transport fleet so that cement for rural construction can be transported to counties around the Suphung Lake quickly and clarified in detail the issues arising in building and operating it.
They said that officials, technicians and employees of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport and the Sinuiju Shipbuilding Yard completed the Korean-style new and unique design for cargo ships and successfully completed the shipbuilding in a short span of time with a single mind to implement the plan of the Party Central Committee with practice.
They said that the workers of the Suphung Maritime Transport Company made a great contribution to building cargo ships and an excavation ship by mobilizing the potentiality and built cement big storehouses together with builders in Sakju County.
They said that the formation of the transport fleet in Lake Suphung under the initiative and wise guidance of the Party Central Committee made it possible to ship cement and other building materials which are carried hundreds of kilometers by land in the areas around Lake Suphung and provided practical conditions for accelerating the rural development by making good use of the regional features.
The speakers called upon all the officials and working people to further stir up the fighting spirit for ushering in a fresh era of regional rejuvenation in hearty response to the decisions of the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and thus make a positive contribution to the overall prosperity and development of the country.
At the end of the launching ceremony, the cargo ships filled with cement left a port with a loud whistle. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 10 (KCNA) -- Premier Kim Tok Hun, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, inspected the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and the Sariwon Tinning Factory.
Going round the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, he stressed the need to conduct the test operation of the newly-built energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnace in a sci-tech way so as to make a substantial contribution to the development of the country's metallurgical industry and the strengthening of the production foundation of the complex and to steadily raise the practicality and efficiency of the establishment of the overall production process of the complex and its management system in line with the trend of metallurgical technology development and complete the planned maintenance and reinforcement as soon as possible.
At the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, he said that officials should further improve their leadership abilities to unconditionally carry out the task for the production of custom-built equipment this year and repair industrial buildings in a substantial way.
At the Sariwon Tinning Factory, he called for positively introducing innovative methods to raise the plating technology to an advanced level and taking practical measures to consolidate the material and technical foundation of the factory.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of concentrating efforts and means on strengthening and perfecting the existing production foundation by increasing their technical power and successfully completing the project for putting the production lines on a Juche basis, the issue of increasing the production of iron and steel, lowering the production cost and steadily introducing Korean-style iron-producing technology, the issue of directing steady efforts to improving the working and living conditions of employees, etc.
Meanwhile, the premier learned about the updating of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory and discussed such issues as the supply of equipment and the technical and skill passing-on and organized relevant work. -0-

headline: DPRK Social Scientists Prove Building Period of Tudaedong Fort
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 10 (KCNA) -- Scholars in the sector of social science of the DPRK proved that the Tudaedong Fort in Ryonghyon-ri, Suan County of North Hwanghae Province, was built in the period of Koguryo Kingdom (B.C. 277 - A.D. 668).
The plane shape of the fort looks like a bottle gourd, and a total distance around the walls is 1 500 meters.
The fort was built on the mountain slope with well-trimmed basalt stones in the method of one-side building.
The basalt stones are typical of the Koguryo period with a convex front and round four corners. From bottom to the third layer, a step-wise lower part of the wall was made, and from above it the upper stones were arranged in tiers. The quadrangular pyramid-shaped stones at the bottom of the wall were covered with rubbles to prevent them from being come out.
This is the peculiar method of building walls of Koguryo.
The red tiles found during the survey are marked with a cord on the front and a pattern of hemp cloth on the back. They are the same with tiles discovered from the Taesongsan Fort.
This fact shows that the Tudaedong Fort is typical one on a mountain of Koguryo.
Besides, the scholars deepened the study of historical data in relation to the designations of the surrounding areas of the fort, and proved that the fort was built by Koguryo in the early 5th century. -0-

Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 11 (KCNA) -- Russian Ambassador to the DPRK Alexandr Matsegora hosted a reception on December 10 on the occasion of the ratification of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, and officials concerned.
Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand.
Alexandr Matsegora made a speech at the reception.
Saying that they met to celebrate an important event which will play a historic part in the relations between Russia and the DPRK, he noted that the treaty has an effect as the ratification instruments of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Russian Federation and the DPRK were exchanged on December 4.
He said that Russia and the DPRK have strived for putting the bilateral friendly relations on a level of perfect alliance in the fundamental interests of the two countries and peoples, the maintenance of peace and security in Eurasia and the requirement for establishing a new global order based on justice and equality of all countries. And he called for supporting each other and realizing the reciprocal cooperation in all sectors, including politics, economy, culture and military affairs, in keeping with the new treaty.
Saying that the meetings of the top leaders of the two countries in Vladivostok, the Vostochny Spaceport and Pyongyang deepened their friendly relations and mutual trust and enriched the genuine fraternal character and militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK, he expressed thanks to the DPRK people's solidarity and absolute support for Russia.
The validity of the new treaty between the Russian Federation and the DPRK is a great event that gives pleasure to friends and uneasiness and horror to the enemies, he stressed.
Then, Choe Son Hui made a speech.
She said that the birth of the new inter-state treaty, which sets the strategic path to be followed by the two countries and boosts the conviction in its victory at a time when the DPRK-Russia relations face an important turning point in their development, is a brilliant fruition of the outstanding foresight, political will and decision of the heads of states of the two countries.
The treaty serves as a driving force for realizing the far-reaching plan of the state leadership of the two countries and the desire of the two peoples by putting the bilateral relations on a new strategic level and building a powerful state while firmly defending the regional and global security environment in conformity with the common interests, she noted.
She clarified the invariable stand of the DPRK government to closely and multilaterally cooperate with Russia in all fields in the spirit of the treaty and achieve the lasting development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, true to the noble intention of the heads of states of the two countries.
She expressed belief that the heroic Russian army and people would achieve victory in their just cause of defending the sovereign rights and security of the country and building an independent multi-polar world by closely uniting around the respected President Putin.
The participants toasted the health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the health of Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the steady development of the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: New Species of Fruit Trees Bred in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 11 (KCNA) -- The Institute of Pomiculture under the Academy of Agricultural Science in the DPRK has made achievements in the work to propagate high-yielding fruit trees.
Officials and researchers of the institute bred many high-yielding fruit trees, including apple, pear, peach and apricot trees, and sent them to different parts of the country in recent years.
Among the fruit trees of high-yielding species are fast-ripening (ten day faster than existing ones) apple and apricot trees bearing big fruits with higher sugar content, and a plum tree highly resistant to cold and an ornamental peach tree with red leaves.
There are also high-yielding chestnut, hazelnut and other fruit trees to be cultivated in mountains.
On the basis of such successes, researchers are focusing their work on acclimatizing not only apple but also pear, plum, grape and other species of fruit trees to the cold in Samjiyon City, Ryanggang Province. -0-

headline: Cabinet Decision for Farmers
story_text:
One day in June 1955, PresidentKim Il Sungwas on his way of field guidance in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
When he reached the edge of a paddy field in the county of Phyongwon, he saw farmers dibbling young rice plants into the dried field, sprinkling jar water on it, although it was too late for them to do rice-transplanting at that time.
He asked them from where they were bringing the water and how much water they carried a day with their water jars. And he said in a regretful tone that the farmers had boils on their heads for their hard work.
He got in his car with a heavy heart, and altered his schedule and visited Jungsan and Onchon counties and the then Kangso county to learn in detail about the rice-transplantation in rain-dependent paddy fields of those counties.
Somewhere, he was so disappointed that he got into his car with dibbled rice seedlings. That evening, the dibbled rice seedlings were put on the table in the room where the Cabinet members met.
He showed the rice seedling to them, and said that when farmers produce rice with ease, people can eat it with a light heart.
The members of the Cabinet were remorseful.
Soon adopted was a Cabinet decision for carrying out the second-stage project for the Phyongnam irrigation and launching at the same time hundreds of small and medium-scale irrigation projects and river improvement on a nationwide scale. -0-

And he called for supporting each other and realizing the reciprocal cooperation in all sectors, including politics, economy, culture and military affairs, in keeping with the new treaty.
Saying that the meetings of the top leaders of the two countries in Vladivostok, the Vostochny Spaceport and Pyongyang deepened their friendly relations and mutual trust and enriched the genuine fraternal character and militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK, he expressed thanks to the DPRK people's solidarity and absolute support for Russia.
The validity of the new treaty between the Russian Federation and the DPRK is a great event that gives pleasure to friends and uneasiness and horror to the enemies, he stressed.
Then, Choe Son Hui made a speech.
She said that the birth of the new inter-state treaty, which sets the strategic path to be followed by the two countries and boosts the conviction in its victory at a time when the DPRK-Russia relations face an important turning point in their development, is a brilliant fruition of the outstanding foresight, political will and decision of the heads of states of the two countries.
The treaty serves as a driving force for realizing the far-reaching plan of the state leadership of the two countries and the desire of the two peoples by putting the bilateral relations on a new strategic level and building a powerful state while firmly defending the regional and global security environment in conformity with the common interests, she noted.
She clarified the invariable stand of the DPRK government to closely and multilaterally cooperate with Russia in all fields in the spirit of the treaty and achieve the lasting development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, true to the noble intention of the heads of states of the two countries.
She expressed belief that the heroic Russian army and people would achieve victory in their just cause of defending the sovereign rights and security of the country and building an independent multi-polar world by closely uniting around the respected President Putin.
The participants toasted the health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the health of Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the steady development of the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 12 (KCNA) -- Personages of different countries have expressed deep reverence for ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho devoted his all to the victorious advance of the revolutionary cause of Juche.
The international secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the People of Spain said that the whole life of ComradeKim Jong Ilwas only for the prosperity of the country and happiness of its people.
A vice-director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway and the chairman of the Sri Lanka Society for Self-Reliance Studies stressed that the history ofKim Jong Il's revolutionary leadership is associated with his efforts for developing the Workers' Party of Korea into a party of the leader in which the uniqueness of idea and leadership is firmly realized and for energetically guiding the struggle to defend the revolutionary traditions of Paektu and the unity and cohesion of the revolutionary ranks.
The chairperson of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, the general secretary of the Communist Party of the DR Congo and the chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics said that the world history of revolutionary movement has recorded many politicians who contributed to the pioneering and building of socialism but there is no such great man as HEKim Jong Ilwho defended the revolution and laid a solid foundation for accomplishing the socialist cause in the worst adversity.
The first secretary of the Maritime Territorial Regional Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation and the chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association said that thanks to HEKim Jong Il's Songun politics, the Korean people won victory in the unprecedented struggle for defending socialism and could lead a peaceful life without a war despite the protracted confrontation with the imperialists.
A member of the Central Executive Committee of the Myanmar Journalist Association, the chairperson of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the South African National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and other personages stressed that the undying exploits performed by HEKim Jong Ilfor the accomplishment of the cause of global independence and the development of the friendly relations among countries aspiring after independence would shine long in the history of struggle of the progressive peoples for independence against imperialism and for peace and friendship. -0-

Strengthening Education in Revolutionary Traditions Is Strategic Task of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 12 (KCNA) -- The Korean revolution has fully demonstrated the invincibility of its cause, preserving its orthodoxy in the face of the severe difficulties. The secret of it lies in the fact that all the people live and struggle in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu, regarding the revolutionary traditions of Paektu as their eternal lifeline, says Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article.
To intensify education in the revolutionary traditions is not a temporary measure to tide over the current difficulties but a strategic task of the revolution for ensuring the ever-victorious advance and eternal vigour of our cause, the article says, and goes on:
The revolution, whose great idea, great spirit, great heritage and great traditions are steadily preserved, always emerges victorious.
The revolutionary traditions of our Party are the precious ones created and enriched under the guidance of the leader.
Herein lies the absolute position of the revolutionary traditions of Juche and inexhaustible might.
When all the people cherish the leader's revolutionary idea as their firm faith and staunchly defend and add lustre to his revolutionary exploits by intensifying education in the revolutionary traditions, our revolutionary position based on loyalty to the leader will be further consolidated as firm as rock and the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered in Mt Paektu will advance victoriously.
Everlasting is the absolute value of the work for arming all the people with the revolutionary traditions of Paektu, the great attraction and vitality of which have been clearly proved in the long course of the Korean revolution, and nothing can replace the education in the revolutionary traditions in the victorious advance and completion of the revolution. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 12 (KCNA) -- December 12, 1948 was a historic day when PresidentKim Il Sungtest-fired the first submachine gun of the DPRK.
That day he came to the firing range in the Phyongchon plain and personally conducted a historic test-fire of the submachine gun.
The gunshot declared the birth of the Juche-oriented defence industry.
After firing it, the President said that the production of submachine guns by our workers and technicians with their own efforts and technology is the first victory of the munitions industry of the DPRK and another praiseworthy success achieved by our people in building a new country.
On March 6, 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Untold officials that the sound of gunfire by the President with the first submachine gun is echoing as a great explosion of a nuclear bomb and H-bomb reliably defending the sovereignty and dignity of the country and the nation, stressing that it is the most precious of the President's revolutionary exploits that he created the powerful Juche-based defence industry by successfully applying the idea of attaching importance to the army and the military affairs. -0-

headline: Lots of Hothouse Vegetables Produced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 13 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people in the field of agriculture of the DPRK have made successes in the production of greenhouse vegetables by introducing scientific cultivation technology and methods.
North Hamgyong Province has produced more 6 800 tons of vegetables in comparison with last year by introducing advanced farming techniques and making effective use of the existing capacity.
The Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm  has been equipped with tens of facilities to lay a material foundation for the vegetable production.
Chongjin and Hoeryong cities and Kyonghung County secured high-yielding varieties and introduced rational vegetable distribution and advanced cultivation methods to raise the per-hectare yield.
The Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm in South Hamgyong Province produces a large number of fruit vegetables for the people.
Tanchon City and Sinhung County applied nutrient solution suitable for all species to improve their growth conditions, and took measures to prevent damage by harmful insects.
Hanggu and Waudo districts in Nampho Municipality have introduced an efficient method of cultivating vegetables with cylindrical devices and established the food production cycle.
Pyongyang Municipality and South Phyongan Province have increased the vegetable production by using solar heat and introducing drip irrigation. -0-

headline: Women's Union Officials Make Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites in Area of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 13 (KCNA) -- Officials of the women's union from across the DPRK made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from December 6 to 12.
They toured the Paektusan Secret Camp, the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, the Chongbong Bivouac, the Konchang Bivouac, the Taehongdan Revolutionary Battle Site and the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site.
They laid bouquets before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin the revolutionary battle sites and Samjiyon City and paid tribute to them.
At the birthplace ofKim Jong Ilin the Paektusan Secret Camp, they recollected his revolutionary career and exploits.
Going round the site of campfire, the site of cooking rice and trees bearing slogans, they learned about the revolutionary spirit and fighting spirit of the fighters who fought the bloody battles against the Japanese imperialists under the guidance of the President.
They marched to Mt Paektu, singing the song "We Will Go to Mt Paektu".
Officials of the women's union shouted hurrah at the top of Mt Paektu.
They held an oath-taking meeting at the plaza before the statue ofKim Jong Ilin Samjiyon City.
During the study tour, they conducted colorful political and cultural works including a meeting to give impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array and toured the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory and the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on December 12 on the occasion of the ratification of the Treaty on the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology who doubles as chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Mikhail Galujin, Vice-Minister of Defense Alexandr Fomin and other personages of the parliament, government, organizations and institutions, including the  Federation Council, the State Duma, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of Interior.
Ambassador Sin Hong Chol and staff members of the DPRK embassy in Moscow were on hand.
The participants laid floral baskets and bouquets before the art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
Then they looked round photos showing the undying exploits performed by PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, works of the peerlessly great men and photos showing the national power and development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception.
Expressing thanks to the DPRK for its full support and solidarity with the Russian Federation, Alexandr Kozlov said that Russia is full of the will to develop practical cooperation in various fields in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. The issues of cooperation between the two countries will bring practical results, he added.
The ratification of the Treaty on the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the DPRK and the Russian Federation signed by President Putin and President of the State Affairs of the DPRKKim Jong Unconfirmed the traditional and allied relationship of Russia-DPRK friendly ties, Mikhail Galujin said, adding that the treaty would contribute to maintaining the strategic stability not only in the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia but also in the rest of the world.
Alexandr Fomin said that the conclusion of a new inter-state treaty between Russia and the DPRK became a powerful driving force in the process of detente in Northeast Asia and would serve as the most solid foundation for maintaining the balance of forces in the region and realizing the plan for establishing a new Eurasian security system. And he expressed the belief that the traditional friendly relations between the two countries would make a great contribution to peace and security of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world. -0-

headline: Great Life of People's Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 14 (KCNA) -- The whole life of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwas a brilliant one of the people's leader, characterized by his warm love for the people.
It was his faith and will that if there is an almighty being in the world, it is the people, the country exists thanks to the people, and one should pluck even a star and bring a flower into bloom even on a rock if this is desired by people.
He made ceaseless visits to all parts of the country till the last moments of his life, regarding the happiness of the people as his greatest pleasure and happiness and overcoming his extreme mental and physical fatigue with his superhuman will.
Whenever he was able to provide people with a good resort on his way of field guidance, he was so pleased.
Whenever he saw a new product or a new building, he first asked if they were popular with people, and at all factories he visited, he called on them to become the ones loved by the people for devotedly serving them.
In order to improve the people's living standards, he visited more than 14 290 units throughout his life despite the midwinter biting cold and the midsummer scorching heat.
In the last three years of his great life, he visited nearly 1 000 units.
That is why the DPRK people still earnestly sing a song praising the great feats he performed for the people all his life.  -0-

They gave easy births to their triplets with the help of medical workers.
The triplets, who were brought up by doctors and nurses with sincerity at the incubators, are healthy and weigh more than four kg each at present.
The triplets and their parents were seen off by medical workers of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital after receiving benevolent gifts. -0-

Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- Memorial events took place in different countries on the occasion of the 13th anniversary of demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
They included memorial meetings, seminars, lectures, round-table talks, book and photo exhibitions and film shows in Myanmar, Iran, Kuwait, Germany, Italy, the Czech Republic and Tanzania from Nov. 21 to Dec. 8.
Present at the events were personages of political and social circles and masses in those countries.
Screened at the film shows were a film dealing with the immortal revolutionary career and exploits ofKim Jong Iland videos showing the proud reality of Juche Korea ushering in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation.
Speeches were made at the events.
Personages of political parties and organizations including the Czech and Moravian Communist Party, the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea and the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association highly praisedKim Jong Ilas the great son of the Korean people and a genuine patriot as he had always found himself among the people and made a journey of love for the people and devotion.
The secretary general of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups said thatKim Jong Il, the greatest man, turned Juche Korea into an invincible socialist fortress unfazed by any trials and difficulties and made a great contribution to accomplishing the cause of global independence. His exploits are shining with the dynamic advance of the DPRK people advancing toward a new victory in socialist construction under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the secretary general stressed. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Rural Villages of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- New villages have appeared in Thaehung-ri and Unha-ri of Yangdok County, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK, to show the development of the countryside in a visual way while preserving the regional features and provide the inhabitants with more affluent and civilized living conditions and environment.
The radical change in the rural villages is a precious fruition of the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is bringing about entities of Korean-style socialist rural civilization one after another.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot on December 13. Present there were Kim Man Jo, secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs and builders in Yangdok County and agricultural workers.
Ro In Gwon, vice-chairman of the South Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, addressed the ceremony. The licenses for the use of new houses were handed over and speeches made there.
When moving into new houses began, a dancing party was given and officials visited the owners of the new houses to share joy with them. -0-

headline: Consumer Goods Production Increases in N. Hamgyong Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK directs big efforts to increasing the quantity of consumer goods and improving their quality.
The production of goods has increased 1.2 times this year as against last year, amid the high enthusiasm for emulation among regions and units to produce many more quality consumer goods favored by the citizens.
The Chongjin Condiments Factory produces various health foodstuffs, tasty and nutritious fermented soybean powder and fermented soybean cayenne with locally available raw materials.
The Kyongsong Ceramic Factory has produced various kinds of quality ceramics.
The Susongchon General Foodstuff Factory, the Chongjin Footwear Factory and the Chongjin School Uniform Factory established a scientific quality control system and improved the quality indices of products to increase the production of goods essential for the people's living.
Kilju, Kyonghung and Onsong counties are concentrating efforts on the production of popular goods based on locally available raw materials to develop the regional economy in a many-sided and peculiar way. -0-

headline: Ever-growing Reverence of Mankind for Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- Thirteen years has passed since the demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il(December 17, 2011).
In those days, the whole world keenly realized thatKim Jong Ilwas a peerlessly great man.
It can be seen from the fact that the world progressives have ardently revered and yearned for him even after his demise.
Rare gifts were presented and orders and honorary titles were awarded to him from different parts of the world, out of the mind to hold him in high esteem forever.
Foreign political parties, organizations and institutions, international and regional bodies and prominent figures of political and social circles across the world have presented floral baskets to the Chairman, praying for his eternal life.
Many foreign friends have made public songs, poems and writings in reflection of their deep reverence for him.
Seminars, film shows, book and photo exhibitions and other events are held on major occasions every year to praiseKim Jong Ilfor having defended global peace and made an immortal contribution to the human cause of independence.
This year, too, various political and cultural events took place on the occasion of the February holiday whenKim Jong Ilwas born. The king and the great queen of Cambodia sent large floral baskets to the DPRK embassy in their country.
Personages of various circles in different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries and laid floral baskets and bouquets before the portraits of smiling PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland art works depicting the President and the Chairman standing together.
The world progressives' boundless reverence forKim Jong Ilis growing deeper with each passing day. -0-

headline: Increased Production of Building Materials in DPRK
story_text:

The Munchon Steel Works established a steel production line based on a tunnel reduction furnace and built a gas generator in close contact with relevant unit, thus providing a guarantee for normal production.
The Anbyon Ceramic Factory improved its tile production capacity and the Wonsan Glass Bottle Factory established new production lines for glass fiber and heat ray reflection glass to produce quality building materials.
The building materials institute in South Hamgyong Province manufactured water-permeable color paving blocks to contribute to the city beautification and building materials production units in Tanchon City and Sinhung and Toksong counties have produced processed serpentine products and sent them to rural housing construction sites.
The Phyongsong City Construction Brigade developed an alkali compound additive necessary for recycling raw materials to produce new-type green building materials. The new technology research dissemination center of the Tokchon City Science and Technology Commission developed inorganic foaming agent with industrial waste.

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- The impeachment motion against the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol was approved in the puppet ROK on Saturday.
That day, the parliament voted for the impeachment motion against Yoon, which was presented for the second time by members from opposition parties, and passed it with 204 in favour and 85 against.
On Dec. 7, there was a vote on the impeachment motion against Yoon, but it was scrapped after lawmakers from the "People Power Party" boycotted the vote in a group.
More than one million people, enraged at the news that the impeachment motion was not approved at that time, thronged to the puppet parliament building and presidential office and demanded the immediate impeachment and arrest of the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol and lawmakers from the "People Power Party" who opposed the impeachment.
The puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, upset by this, released a press statement spliced with lies and obstinacy on Dec. 12, but it sparked off stronger rebuff and resentment of the political and public circles as the puppet shifted the responsibility for foolish emergency martial law declaration onto the opposition parties and the "threat" from someone and insulted the struggle of the broad masses for impeachment as a "sword dance of chaos".
Amid the growing denunciation and enthusiasm for impeachment of the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol and his accomplices who totally denied the crimes they committed in their office in Seoul and other parts of the ROK, many members of the "People Power Party" withdrew from it, disillusioned with their party's despicable behavior, aggravating the division within the ruling party.
As a result, the impeachment motion was passed by vote on Saturday to suspend the puppet president Yoon Suk Yeol.
The puppet Constitutional Court will finally decide the impeachment.
At the news of the passage of the impeachment motion against the puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, citizens in Seoul, Pusan, Taejon and other major cities and across the ROK turned out in streets, raising cheers.
Meanwhile, it was reported that the puppet minister of Defense, the puppet director of the Police Agency and the puppet director of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency were detained and then, the puppet Army chief of Staff who was appointed as the martial law commander, the puppet commander of the Defense counter-intelligence Command, the puppet commander of special warfare, the puppet chief of the Defense Intelligence Command, etc. were suspended from their duties, the puppet army metropolitan garrison commander was arrested, and the investigation into puppet Yoon Suk Yeol, the ringleader of rebellion, and his accomplices is under way. -0-

headline: Patriotic Devotion of Peerlessly Great Man for Country and People
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilis a peerlessly great man who devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people.
The figure, over 1 674 610 ri (one ri is 392.73 meters), well known to all the Korean people is the total length of the course of field guidance made byKim Jong Ilin the whole period of his revolutionary leadership.
The length is equivalent to nearly 17 rounds of the earth's circumference. It includes a way of snowstorm for field guidance in Jagang Province reaching to over 6 000 ri in distance and a forced march reaching to over 1 000 ri in distance that he made for a night from the east coast to the west coast of the country.
The Korean people are now recalling with deep emotion the stories about the days when he had a few roasted potatoes for a meal at the head of a windy field in the northern part of the country and his long journey for field guidance to factories and construction sites of power stations, even forgetting his meals.
He had never accepted the people's earnest desire for his well-being, but he did his best for the people.
Thanks to his patriotic devotion and leadership, the national power of the DPRK grew stronger and such precious assets for the people as the Thaechon Power Station and the Kaechon-Lake Thaesong Waterway appeared one after another in the country.
At this moment of marking the 13th anniversary of his demise, the Korean people keenly feel that his high-intensity forced march for field guidance was a long journey of patriotic devotion unprecedented in history. -0-

headline: Meetings Held to Commemorate Chairman Kim Jong Il's Demise Anniversary
Greatest National Memorial Day Commemorated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK on Tuesday dedicate editorials to the greatest national memorial day.
The papers say that the DPRK people have keenly felt the scientific accuracy, truth and great value of the revolutionary ideology and exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwhile advancing socialism, overcoming the challenges and obstacles unprecedented in history since December of bitter tears, 13 years ago.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilis a great revolutionary, peerless patriot and tender-hearted father of the people as he devoted his all to the prosperity and development of the country and happiness of the people, holding high the red flag of Juche all his life, Rodong Sinmun says in an editorial, and goes on:
Today the immortal dignity and glory of the DPRK shining all over the world and the high reputation and honor of its people are associated with the undying feats ofKim Jong Ilwho laid an eternal foundation for the prosperity of socialist Korea all his life.
It is his distinguished patriotic feats that he provided precious mental weapon and encyclopedic guidelines for dynamically leading the times and the revolution along the road of victory with the strong strength of justice and truth, no matter how much water has flowed under the bridge and how often circumstances have changed.
Under his leadership, the Workers' Party of Korea could demonstrate its dignity as a revolutionary party in which the ideological and guidance system of the leader was firmly established, and as an invincible party with iron discipline and fighting efficiency.
With his faith in independence, matchless pluck, indomitable spirit and superhuman will, the Chairman paved the road of Korean-style for building a rich country with a strong army and built the unshakable pillar of self-sustenance and self-defence. His feats are a precious treasure for building a thriving and powerful country.
Today the patriotic exploits of the Chairman are shining as eternal treasure firmly guaranteeing the steady advance of the DPRK and the happiness of posterity under the wise guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Minju Joson in an editorial stresses thatKim Jong Il's history of revolutionary leadership under the sacred red flag of Juche is shining along with the undying feats he performed to provide an eternal foundation for the victorious advance of socialist Korea and its prosperity. -0-

headline: Tokchon Holiday Camp Inaugurated in DPRK
story_text:

headline: Tangible Successes Witnessed in Fishing Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the fishing sector of the DPRK have made tangible successes this year.
Fishery stations in the East and West seas, including the Songdowon, Kim Chaek and Mundok fishery stations, boosted productivity by introducing advanced fishing methods and conducting an intensive fishing campaign suited to seasonal conditions.
Culturists of the Pupho Offshore Farm increased the production of kelp and employees of the Wonsan Seafood Production and Processing Station registered a high result in the mussel farming.
The Kumipho Fishery Station, the Sinpho Fishery Station and other units set up facilities for next year's production and hastened the spreading of seedlings, thus creating more than 1 530 hectares of cultivation area.
Officials and workers of Haeju and Mundokthaehyang fishery stations built several more fishing boats than the planned this year.
The Thongchon Fishery Station built a modern fishing base with its ship repair capacity expanded by 1.5 times and the Yomju Net-weaving Factory opened up a prospect for increasing the net production.
The Hungnam Ship Accessories Factory provided a guarantee for ensuring the quality of various accessories and the Hanchon Fishery Station established a modern product packing line.
The Kaechon City Office for Stocking Rivers with Fishes stocked Lake Yonphung with more than 70 000 young mandarin fish. Over 190 million fry have been released into rivers, lakes and reservoirs across the country this year.
Researchers of the Institute of Fisheries have made successes in the study of new fish farming methods. -0-
