The number of designs that he personally examined and perfected while reflecting the minds of the people suffering from the loss of their houses in every line and dot is more than 540 pieces.
Under his energetic guidance, new standards were created from the formation of town to every structure, road facility, visual motivation aid including slogans and watchwords and light decoration, and the afforestation was carried out on a high level in good harmony with the mountainous areas.
The irresistible strength of all the people who turned out in response to the call of the great Party Central Committee with patriotism and loyalty was fully demonstrated on all fronts of recovery projects.

The huge front of recovery campaign was formed amid the immensely growing militant enthusiasm of the heroic people and service personnel of the People's Army who turned out in the drive to overcome the crisis.
The construction of dwelling houses was pushed ahead with to provide the inhabitants in the afflicted areas with a cradle of happiness as early as possible.

The heroic deed of building a model edifice symbolic of the new era in the northern border area of the country further convinced the pride of the inexhaustible spirit and strength of the millions of Party members who cherished the noble intention of the WPK's devotion to the people as the inherent duty in their life and struggle, service personnel of the People's Army who have always been perfect in their sacred mission as the army of the Party and the army of the people and the Korean youth who have always been faithful to the honorable prestige of the reliable reserves and advancing group of the Party.
The patriotic enthusiasm and devotion of the people across the country, who unanimously supported the decision of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee with one mind, accelerated the advance speed in the rehabilitation theatre.
The warm minds of all the people who are devoting their pure and sincere patriotic devotion to the sacred struggle for the peace and prosperity of the motherland and the well-being of the people have run to the sites for recovering from flood damage and the beautiful traits of aiding the army and aiding the people have been fully displayed.
The dynamic advance in which the whole country has accelerated the vigorous struggle for the great victory in the reconstruction under the leadership of the Party is a great event that proudly demonstrated before the world where the driving power and development capability peculiar to the DPRK are based.

headline: Garment Exhibition-2024 Opens
Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered by Overseas Koreans
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 24 (KCNA) -- Organizations of overseas Koreans held memorial services on the occasion of the 13th anniversary of demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) held a meeting at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on December 16 to lay a floral basket before the portrait ofKim Jong Il.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and concurrently Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee.
Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters reading "The great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilwill always be with us".
All the participants paid tribute toKim Jong Il, benevolent father of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, praying for his immortality.
On the same day, officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, the Korean Educationists Association in Japan, the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Union of Korean Students in Japan and the Korean Youth Publication, including Ri Kwang Il, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Ri Song Chol, chairman of the Central Standing Council of the Korean Educationists Association in Japan, and Song Sang Gi, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, laid bouquets before the portrait ofKim Jong Iland paid tribute to him.
The General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) held memorial services on December 17.
Floral baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City Branch of the Jilin Provincial Association of the GAKC, the Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC, the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and others were laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and its mission in China.
A film dealing with the immortal history ofKim Jong Il's revolutionary leadership was shown in Shenyang of China. Present there were officials of the headquarters of the GAKC and members of the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association.
Meanwhile, the Social Confederation of Koreans in Russia held a memorial service on December 16.
Present there were members of the Social Confederation and members of political parties and social organizations of Russia.
Prior to the meeting, the members of the Social Confederation laid a floral basket before the art work depictingKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilat the DPRK embassy in Moscow and paid tribute to them.
The secretary general of the Social Confederation made a speech there. -0-

headline: Great Man's Pleasure
story_text:
One day in October 2019, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm nearing its completion.
He went round several blocks of greenhouses at the farm, and an official told him that it was dark.
Saying that he can't leave without looking round the houses for the farm's employees to live, the General Secretary went to the residential quarters.
After looking round the houses, he said with satisfaction that when the employees live at such wonderful houses, they would sing the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" of their own accord.
He told officials that he was very pleased to think that another great work had been done for the people, adding that he was relieved of all fatigue.
Indeed, the General Secretary is the benevolent father who feels his greatest pleasure in the people's happiness. -0-

headline: Inhabitants and Schoolchildren from Flood-Hit Areas Sojourn in Pyongyang 130 Days under Benefits of Party and State
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 24 (KCNA) -- Flood victims from North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces of the DPRK came to Pyongyang under the loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who spares nothing for relieving the people of pain, and spent their dreamy sojourn in Pyongyang. In those days, their emotional voices were admired by all people across the country.
130 day-long sojourn the flood victims spent in Pyongyang under the warm care of the Party and the state were the days and months of love that started and continued by the ardent devotion ofKim Jong Un, who regards it as the most important affair that can not be delayed even for a moment to relieve the people of pain and misfortune at an early date, and a significant period that instilled into all the people the faith that our leader, our Party and our socialist system are the best.
Kim Jong Un, who is standing against any challenges for the sake of the beloved people and future, miraculously saved the flood victims who were at the crossroads of life and death due to the severe natural disaster and made sure that the Party and the government bear the full responsibility for them and take care of them with utmost sincerity.
He convened the 22nd emergency enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on train and set forth important tasks and ways for recovering from damage as soon as possible. Then, he went round the makeshift tents, in which the flood victims were living temporarily, in the sweltering hot weather and took a special measure so that the children, students, the elderly and others from the flood-hit areas were under the state protection in the capital city Pyongyang without any worries in the rehabilitation period.
Under his boundless loving care, more than 13 000 inhabitants and students from the flood-hit areas enjoyed the highest glory, happiness and civilization in the capital city while receiving a special favor and privilege.
The first day of the flood victims' sojourn in Pyongyang started under the loving care and solicitude of the benevolent father.
He warmly greeted the flood victims at lodging quarters in Pyongyang on August 15. He in a significant welcome speech full of kindred feelings affirmed that the highest sincerity would be offered to them with the meticulous attention to their health and comfort as absolute criteria, hoping that all of them would have an unforgettable and significant time while staying in the capital city of their beloved motherland.
The inhabitants from the flood-hit areas enjoyed their cultural and emotional life to their heart's content under the loving care ofKim Jong Unwho personally worked out the itinerary and took benevolent measures so that they spend pleasant and memorable days during their stay in Pyongyang.
Pupils and students from the flood-hit areas brought into full bloom their dreams of learning in Pyongyang.
From the very day of the disaster, he made sure that an emergency system was put in place to make the students and all other children from flood-hit areas stay in Pyongyang and be provided with a safe and comfortable environment for care and education, entirely at state expense. He saw to it that they received education without cease after vacation.
He visited the April 25 Hostel on August 16 to watch a demonstration lesson for a class of primary school pupils, which was organized as part of the preparations for new-term teaching of the pupils, and acquainted himself in detail with the provision of educational equipment and school fixtures.
The measures for provisional education of children and students from the flood-hit areas in the environment of rehabilitation campaign were another important step of loving care to be taken by onlyKim Jong Unwho regards the issue of caring and educating the children and students as the primary state affair which could never be given up even if the sky may fall in.
Students with disabilities were also treated at central hospitals in Pyongyang and went to school in a bright and cheerful manner.
The primary schoolchildren from the flood-hit areas competed with those in the capital city, and several students of senior middle school class took part in the examination for entrance toKim Il SungUniversity and Kim Chaek University of Technology and over 70 percent of students grew to be A ones.
Bondless was the warm love of the father with the dreamy days and months passing.
Kim Jong Unsent the 70th and 80th birthday spreads to the elderly and first birthday spreads to babies though they enjoyed special favor to be envied by the world. Deeply moved by his warm affection, the inhabitants and schoolchildren from the flood-hit areas expressed gratitude to him, saying that their father is MarshalKim Jong Unand their home is the embrace of the Party.
During their significant stay, the flood victims were deeply moved by the sincerity and devotion of the members of mobile educational, medical and service teams, service personnel in the field of military medicine of the Korean People's Army and officials and employees of the hostel, and by the cordial hospitality of Pyongyangites who greeted them as honored guests at the Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Pyongyang Noodle House, Chongryu and Changgwang health complexes, etc. They keenly felt that they could not live even a moment without the great socialist family which is harmonious with virtue and affection, holdingKim Jong Unas their father.
The people in the afflicted areas are filled with the ardent desire to turn their radically changed native villages into places good to live in by reaping rich harvest and thus repay the great benevolence generation after generation, always keeping in mind  the honor and happiness provided by the devotion of the great father and devoting all their loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm. -0-

headline: Inhabitants and Schoolchildren from Flood-Hit Areas Sojourn in Pyongyang 130 Days under Benefits of Party and State
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 24 (KCNA) -- Flood victims from North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces of the DPRK came to Pyongyang under the loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who spares nothing for relieving the people of pain, and spent their dreamy sojourn in Pyongyang. In those days, their emotional voices were admired by all people across the country.
130 day-long sojourn the flood victims spent in Pyongyang under the warm care of the Party and the state were the days and months of love that started and continued by the ardent devotion ofKim Jong Un, who regards it as the most important affair that can not be delayed even for a moment to relieve the people of pain and misfortune at an early date, and a significant period that instilled into all the people the faith that our leader, our Party and our socialist system are the best.
Kim Jong Un, who is standing against any challenges for the sake of the beloved people and future, miraculously saved the flood victims who were at the crossroads of life and death due to the severe natural disaster and made sure that the Party and the government bear the full responsibility for them and take care of them with utmost sincerity.
He convened the 22nd emergency enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on train and set forth important tasks and ways for recovering from damage as soon as possible. The first day of the flood victims' sojourn in Pyongyang started under the loving care and solicitude of the benevolent father.
He warmly greeted the flood victims at lodging quarters in Pyongyang on August 15. He in a significant welcome speech full of kindred feelings affirmed that the highest sincerity would be offered to them with the meticulous attention to their health and comfort as absolute criteria, hoping that all of them would have an unforgettable and significant time while staying in the capital city of their beloved motherland.
The inhabitants from the flood-hit areas enjoyed their cultural and emotional life to their heart's content under the loving care ofKim Jong Unwho personally worked out the itinerary and took benevolent measures so that they spend pleasant and memorable days during their stay in Pyongyang.
Pupils and students from the flood-hit areas brought into full bloom their dreams of learning in Pyongyang.
From the very day of the disaster, he made sure that an emergency system was put in place to make the students and all other children from flood-hit areas stay in Pyongyang and be provided with a safe and comfortable environment for care and education, entirely at state expense. He saw to it that they received education without cease after vacation.
He visited the April 25 Hostel on August 16 to watch a demonstration lesson for a class of primary school pupils, which was organized as part of the preparations for new-term teaching of the pupils, and acquainted himself in detail with the provision of educational equipment and school fixtures.
The measures for provisional education of children and students from the flood-hit areas in the environment of rehabilitation campaign were another important step of loving care to be taken by onlyKim Jong Unwho regards the issue of caring and educating the children and students as the primary state affair which could never be given up even if the sky may fall in.
Students with disabilities were also treated at central hospitals in Pyongyang and went to school in a bright and cheerful manner.
The primary schoolchildren from the flood-hit areas competed with those in the capital city, and several students of senior middle school class took part in the examination for entrance toKim Il SungUniversity and Kim Chaek University of Technology and over 70 percent of students grew to be A ones.

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered by Overseas Koreans
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 24 (KCNA) -- Organizations of overseas Koreans held memorial services on the occasion of the 13th anniversary of demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) held a meeting at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on December 16 to lay a floral basket before the portrait ofKim Jong Il.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and concurrently Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee.
Written on the ribbon of the floral basket were letters reading "The great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilwill always be with us".
All the participants paid tribute toKim Jong Il, benevolent father of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, praying for his immortality.
On the same day, officials of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, the Korean Educationists Association in Japan, the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Union of Korean Students in Japan and the Korean Youth Publication, including Ri Kwang Il, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, Ri Song Chol, chairman of the Central Standing Council of the Korean Educationists Association in Japan, and Song Sang Gi, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, laid bouquets before the portrait ofKim Jong Iland paid tribute to him.
The General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) held memorial services on December 17.
Floral baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City Branch of the Jilin Provincial Association of the GAKC, the Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC, the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and others were laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and its mission in China.
A film dealing with the immortal history ofKim Jong Il's revolutionary leadership was shown in Shenyang of China. Present there were officials of the headquarters of the GAKC and members of the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association.
Meanwhile, the Social Confederation of Koreans in Russia held a memorial service on December 16.
Present there were members of the Social Confederation and members of political parties and social organizations of Russia.
Prior to the meeting, the members of the Social Confederation laid a floral basket before the art work depictingKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilat the DPRK embassy in Moscow and paid tribute to them.
The secretary general of the Social Confederation made a speech there. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in S. Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- New villages have appeared at the Chollisong Farm in Taehung County and the Magundam Stockbreeding Farm in Nyongwon County, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The villages, designed to meet the needs of socialism and preserve the characters of mountainous area, are places of happiness provided by the energetic guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making a new history of rural development.
Ceremonies for moving into new dwelling houses took place on the spots respectively.
Present there were Kim Man Jo, secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Hyon Chol, vice-chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials of the Party and power organs, builders and agricultural workers in the relevant areas.
Congratulatory addresses were made there. The licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches made.
Amid the display of cheerful peasant music and dance, officials shared joy with the owners of the new houses. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- Memorial meetings took place in Pakistan, Norway, Denmark, Romania, Sweden, Britain, Austria, the Czech Republic, France, Finland, Nigeria, Equatorial Guinea and Mexico from December 12 to 17 on the occasion of the 13th anniversary of demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by political and social figures and masses of those countries.
A senator of Pakistan, a member of the Central Committee of the Pakistan Awami National Party and the chairman of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee said that the great ComradeKim Jong Ildevoted his whole life to the country and the revolution with his iron will and superhuman devotion, adding that he was the strength and symbol of socialist Korea.
The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway praisedKim Jong Ilas a rare thinker-theoretician, defender of socialism, peerless patriot and prominent leader of the global socialist movement.
The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association and the general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico said that the great exploits performed byKim Jong Ilare precious legacy left for the mankind.
The chairman of the Finnish National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea noted that ComradeKim Jong Ilis a great revolutionary, outstanding leader and great practitioner.
The first vice-chairperson of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea stressed that the exploits performed by ComradeKim Jong Il, a peerless statesman, before the country and its people, the times and history will be immortal.
Messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the memorial meetings in Denmark, Sweden and Nigeria. -0-

headline: Advanced Sports Teaching Methods Introduced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- The Central Sports School in the DPRK has made successes by introducing new teaching methods.
Many teachers of the school obtained the qualification of October 8 Model Professor and advanced new teaching and training methods conducive to raising the scientific level of sports teaching.
Such events as panel discussion on teaching, show of multimedia teaching programs and experience-sharing meeting were organized to improve the quality of sports education. In the course, over 150 pieces of experimental apparatuses and teaching aids of dozens of kinds were invented.
The school has concentrated its efforts on the study of basic science including sports psychology and strengthened the basic education of persons with suitable physical constitution.
This year alone, its students won eight trophies and at least 350 medals at domestic games including the DPRK Championships. Ri Suk, its player, set new world records at the 2024 IWF World Championships to demonstrate the honor of the country. -0-

headline: New Gymnasium Built at Kumhwa Mine in N. Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- A gymnasium has been built at the Kumhwa Mine in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The gymnasium has a multi-functional court capable of playing basketball, volleyball, table-tennis, tennis and other sports events, stage, sci-tech learning space and cultural and welfare facilities.
Its completion provides another base for the miners to enjoy diverse cultural and emotional life. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers in Kumya County of DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- A fairyland village showing the socialist rural civilization has appeared at the township farm in Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
The panoramic view of the township farm, where modern dwelling houses with peculiar regional features and refined beauty have been built in keeping with unique regional-industry factories, clearly shows the change in the era of the Workers' Party.
Present at a ceremony for moving into new houses held on the spot were Wi Chol Su, secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs in Kumya County, builders and agricultural workers.
Ri Kwang Hyok, vice-chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory address.
The licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches made at the ceremony.
Then, the agricultural workers moved into new houses amid the playing of lively peasant music and cheerful dance.
Officials of the Party and power organs visited the owners of the new houses to share joy with them. -0-

headline: Message of Greeting to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Egyptian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah Al Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on December 25.
The message said:
As we welcome the New Year 2025, it is my honor to extend to Your Excellency and friendly people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea my warmest wishes for a New Year filled with success and happiness.
On this special occasion, I would like to express my sincere hope that the coming year will prioritize promoting dialogue and understanding among people across the globe.
Together, let us strive to foster peace and tolerance while rejecting violence and hatred, ensuring a brighter future for the coming generations.
Additionally, I would like to reaffirm our strong commitment to strengthening the distinguished relations between our two countries. I believe that it is through dedicated joint efforts and ongoing coordination on matters of mutual interest that we can make significant progress in addressing global challenges, particularly in Middle East region, by pursuing just and peaceful solutions to the pressing conflicts of our time to save human lives.
Dear Mr. President, may this year being you and your friendly people continued prosperity, progress, and lasting peace.
Highest consideration and appreciation
Happy New Year! -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to O Kum Sun, a woman centenarian living in people's neighborhood unit No. 6, Choin-ri, Kumya County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
Officials of the Kumya County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers congratulated the centenarian and her family members.

headline: Reinforcement Project Finished in Phosphate Fertilizer Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the phosphate fertilizer industry of the DPRK have carried out the production and reinforcement project for this year through a drive for increased production and creation.
The Yongyu Mine secured a large amount of ore by paying attention to the maintenance and repair of mining equipment and the development of stope. It has pushed ahead with tunneling by introducing advanced technology and ensured the operation of equipment at full capacity.

headline: Socialist Code Centered on Popular Masses
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- December 27 is the day when the Socialist Constitution was adopted and promulgated in the DPRK 52 years ago.
On this occasion, the Korean people are recollecting with deep emotion the undying feats of the peerlessly great men who instituted the most revolutionary and popular constitution and successfully completed it as required by the times and the developing revolution.
After promulgating the "Socialist Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" in December 1972, PresidentKim Il Sungsaw to it that laws and regulations of various fields including the Public Health Law, the Law on the Nursing and Upbringing of Children and the Socialist Labour Law were instituted, thus laying a legal foundation for guaranteeing the people's independent life in a systematic and legal way.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilmade sure that the exploits of the President for original state building were legalized and the laws of the state played the role of a weapon for defending the Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses.
Today, the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK is being further developed and completed under the wise guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The General Secretary indicated important guidelines for strengthening the socialist legal system.
He set forth the idea of building a genuine people's country where law defends the people and the people observe it and made sure that all the laws thoroughly embody the people-first principle.
The work of amending and supplementing the laws and regulations of the state is getting intensified with the people's demand as a standard, further consolidating the legal conditions for an independent and creative life of the people.
In recent years alone, the law of the DPRK on social insurance and social security, the law on emergency anti-epidemic work, the law on land administration planning, the law on tourism and other laws were adopted and the state policy of nuclear force was legalized, thus providing a political and institutional mechanism for firmly guaranteeing the eternal security of the country and its people and the future of lasting significance. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Remembered Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- Seminars took place in Nepal, India, Thailand, Pakistan, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belarus, Algeria, Egypt and Mexico on the occasion of the 13th anniversary of demise of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were personages of political parties, organizations and institutions of those countries, members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people.
Speeches were made at the seminars.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the Nepal Communist Party (Marxist-Leninist), the chairman of the Study Forum for Self-Reliance of Nepal and the secretary general of the Nepal-Korea Friendship Association said that the great ComradeKim Jong Ildevoted himself to the development of the state, happiness of the people and the human cause of independence till the last moments of his life and greatly encouraged the world people by defending the national sovereignty, the security of the people and the destiny of socialism with his steadfast independent politics.
Personages of the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association, the Supreme Court of India and the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India paid high tribute to HEKim Jong Ilwho built the Democratic People's Republic of Korea into a powerful socialist state, highly lauding the exploits performed by him as the peerlessly great man who led the fierce DPRK-U.S. confrontation to victory.
The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania noted that ComradeKim Jong Ilpublished many famous works to clearly indicate the road ahead of the Korean revolution and the world socialist movement and made a great contribution to the accomplishment of the cause of independence.
Messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the seminars in Nepal and Germany. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory letter from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Dec. 17.
In his letter, the Russian president extended the most sincere New Year greetings to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The talks between me and you held in Pyongyang in June put the Russia-DPRK relations onto a new and qualitative level, the letter said, and went on:
The treaty on the comprehensive strategic partnership, concluded according to the results of the talks, provided conditions for a fundamental expansion of beneficial bilateral cooperation in all major fields.
I am convinced that in the coming 2025 we will continue our joint work to implement this historic treaty more closely and further coordinate our efforts to cope with the threats and challenges of the present era.
This undoubtedly conforms to the fundamental interests of the friendly peoples of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
I wish you and your intimates good health, happiness and success and all the citizens of the DPRK well-being and prosperity. -0-

headline: Newspapers Observe Socialist Constitution Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK on Friday dedicate editorials to the Socialist Constitution Day.
The DPRK people have raised the dignity and might of our state higher this year with the firm and positive pioneering spirit and staunch and thorough action, full of confidence in sure victory under the leadership of the great Party. They cherish the absolute value of the DPRK Constitution which reliably guarantees the dynamic advance of building a powerful socialist country, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial, and goes on:

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory letter from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Dec. 17.
In his letter, the Russian president extended the most sincere New Year greetings to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The talks between me and you held in Pyongyang in June put the Russia-DPRK relations onto a new and qualitative level, the letter said, and went on:
The treaty on the comprehensive strategic partnership, concluded according to the results of the talks, provided conditions for a fundamental expansion of beneficial bilateral cooperation in all major fields.
I am convinced that in the coming 2025 we will continue our joint work to implement this historic treaty more closely and further coordinate our efforts to cope with the threats and challenges of the present era.
This undoubtedly conforms to the fundamental interests of the friendly peoples of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
I wish you and your intimates good health, happiness and success and all the citizens of the DPRK well-being and prosperity. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Salt Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the salt industry of the DPRK make progress in putting the salt production on an intensive, mechanized and modern basis.
Kwangryangman, Kumsong, Nampho and other salt works have further raised salinity at reserve evaporating ponds and evaporating ponds, developed and introduced machines to suit the actual conditions and established an efficient water circulation system to guarantee the increased production.
The salt-making machine repair plant installed a dust collector, further perfected the streamlined process in a technical way and produced high-performance water pumps.
The Onchon Tile Factory newly manufactured more than 150 molding and other machines. It is now pushing ahead with the work to install more drying furnaces using waste heat and secure raw materials and reserve molding materials. -0-
