Banquet Given in Celebration of New Year 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- A banquet was given at the People's Palace of Culture on December 31 to mark the hopeful New Year 2025.
Present there were labor innovators and persons of merit who were invited to the celebrations of the New Year after making great contributions to glorifying 2024 as a year of gigantic changes and leap forward, to be specially recorded in the history of the country, through their sweat and sincere efforts with pure patriotic conscience.
The venue of the banquet was filled with boundless gratitude and reverence for the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee which values the loyalty and uprightness of ordinary working people devoting themselves to the prosperity of the country and holds them in public esteem.
Attending it were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Jo Chun Ryong and Choe Tong Myong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Thae Song made a congratulatory speech at the banquet.
Upon authorization of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the speaker warmly congratulated the labor innovators and persons of merit who took part in the grand banquet with the pride of having devoted themselves to the vanguard of the all-people struggle for prosperity of the country.
All the assets and successes shining along with the absolute position of the DPRK were provided by the patriotic citizens with indomitable pioneering spirit, heroic stamina, warm blood and sweat, and their noble conscience and undaunted struggle laid a foundation for bringing about the sure success and change in 2024, he noted.
He said that the struggle in the new year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea and the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation requires the strong and energetic efforts of all the people.
He expressed belief that all the participants would launch an intensive campaign for increasing production and performing new miracles in the drive to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK by fully displaying their single-minded loyalty and patriotism in supporting the Party and the state, saying the strong foundations for prosperity, secured by dint of self-reliance only and in our own way, and the people's self-respect and patriotic spirit, which have grown stronger, will surely bring about the implementation of the five-year plan and record the 9th Congress of the WPK as a glorious one in history.
All the participants toasted the good health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the prominent leader of our state and dear father of the people, and for the new victory in 2025 when a greater stride will be made toward prosperity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Art Performance Given for Seeing in New Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- An art performance was given with splendour at the May Day Stadium in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, to see in the hopeful new year 2025, which will be a watershed for steady success and progress, after seeing out a year of great transformation when unprecedented progress was made to be specially recorded in the history of Korean-style socialist construction.
The venue for the performance was overflowing with deep emotion of spectators reviewing 2024, a year that witnessed another crucial and responsible journey for the revolution and the state development, in which such a great undertaking as comprehensive rejuvenation, unprecedented since the founding of the nation, was carried on by dint of the irresistible might peculiar to the Korean revolution, their great pride in the truth of our ideals and cause and confidence in new victory and new civilization to be brought about in the new year.
Prior to the performance, figure skaters and schoolchildren added to the festive atmosphere by presenting optimistic and beautiful rhythms to the tune of the all-people hymn "Dear Father" on the ice.
The national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
All the audience paid high tribute to the sacred national flag reflecting the great history, eternal future and immortal glory of the country and its people.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the performance.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium amid the playing of welcome music, the audience broke into stormy cheers.
They paid the highest glory and tribute toKim Jong Un, the prominent leader of the revolution and the benevolent father who ushers in a new era of a powerful nation with high confidence, in which the people's dreams and ideals come true, steering the sacred cause for the prosperity and beautiful future of our great state along a road of brilliant progress.
Warmly acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers,Kim Jong Unextended his greeting of best wishes to all the beloved people across the country seeing in the New Year.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, members of the Political Bureau, other senior officials of the Party and the government, commanding officers of armed forces organs, labour innovators and persons of distinguished services invited to the new year celebrations, Pyongyangites, service personnel of the Korean People's Army and students of revolutionary schools.
Overseas compatriots staying in the socialist homeland saw the performance.
The performance was divided into two parts.
Part One, which began with instrumental music, song and dance "The People Offer Glory to the Party", touched the audience deeply with all-people hymns to the WPK and other colorful numbers.
Hearing the narrative poem "Only Our Party," which evoked strong memories of the great events in the year 2024 when the country made bold advance under the guidance of the great Party Central Committee which translates the long-cherished desires of the people into reality, producing legendary tales in the new era, with its most sacred ideas and noble spirit, the audience visualized in great joy the era of eye-opening transformations to be brought about by the far-reaching ideal and outstanding leadership of the motherly Party and the rosy future of the country that will endlessly prosper.
The song "We Are Koreans" excited the audience as it gave an intensely lyrical poetic description of the thoughts and feelings of all the people determined to firmly support the mightiness of socialist Korea with steadfast pioneering spirit and patriotic will, adding glory to their honour of having successfully defended their dignity while undauntedly covering the untrodden path of history.
When the emotion-charged countdown for seeing the old year out ended to signal the start of a new year at 00:00, January 1, 2025, celebration torch was kindled and fireworks let off to bring excitement and joy to the climax.
Children presented bouquets toKim Jong Unand senior Party, government and military officials, wishing them a happy New Year.
The venue was overflowing with the great honour and happiness of the audience seeing in the New Year to be charged with confidence and optimism in the presence of their great leader and dear father.
Put on the stage of Part Two, which started with song and dance "Snow Is Falling on New Year's Day," were newly produced musical masterpieces truthfully reflecting our people's patriotic feelings which have grown stronger in the new era of a great powerful nation.
Greatly applauded by the audience were such songs as "Motherland and My Destiny", "My Powerful Motherland" and "I Will Love My Motherland Forever" singing of the highest tribute and glory to and firm pledge before the great and dignified DPRK which has always emerged victorious in the tempest of history.
The performance ended with the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK.
When the performance ended, loud cheers of "Hurrah!" forKim Jong Unrocked the venue and fireworks were let off to gorgeously decorate the nocturnal sky.
The last night of the old year passed with precious recollection and pride of victors and the New Year to be filled with new hope and enthusiasm began. -0-

headline: Open-air Ice Rink in Downtown of Pyongyang Begins Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The open-air ice rink in the downtown of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, began its operation on December 31, 2024 on the occasion of the hopeful New Year.
The winter mass sports service centre, which has all service facilities including protective walls, a skate lending room, a skating repair room and soft drinks, was crowded with citizens from the first day of its operation.
Optimistic figures of working people, youth and students and children skating and sledging at the open-air ice rink added to the scenery of the capital city greeting the new year 2025.
The ice rink is open mainly in the evening time, and skates and slides are served according to weather conditions. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Rural Village of Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Jangsuwon Farm of the Pyongyang Municipal Rural Economy Committee.
Officials and builders in Samsok District built modern houses by putting the quality of construction on the top priority and pushing ahead with the project in a three-dimensional way by displaying their fighting spirit of devotedly implementing the Party’s policy.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot on December 31, 2024.
Present there were Choe Hak Chol, secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs, builders and agricultural workers in the district.
Kim Yong Chun, vice-chairman of the Pyongyang Municipal People's Committee, made a congratulatory address. Licenses for the use of new houses were handed over and speeches made there.
Amid the cheerful dancing, officials visited families of farmers to share joy with them. -0-

headline: National Flag-Hoisting Ceremony Held on New Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- A national flag-hoisting ceremony was held atKim Il SungSquare in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on January 1, 2025 amid the full joy and excitement for celebrating the significant New Year.

Showing the pride and joy of the people of a powerful state who have grown up under the national flag of glory, the magnificent and bright fireworks redoubled all the people’s revolutionary will to dynamically accelerate the new historic advance for vigorously hastening the era of comprehensive prosperity of our state, praying for the prosperity of the country. -0-

headline: Banquet Given in Celebration of New Year 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- A banquet was given at the People's Palace of Culture on December 31 to mark the hopeful New Year 2025.
Present there were labor innovators and persons of merit who were invited to the celebrations of the New Year after making great contributions to glorifying 2024 as a year of gigantic changes and leap forward, to be specially recorded in the history of the country, through their sweat and sincere efforts with pure patriotic conscience.
The venue of the banquet was filled with boundless gratitude and reverence for the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee which values the loyalty and uprightness of ordinary working people devoting themselves to the prosperity of the country and holds them in public esteem.
Attending it were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Jo Chun Ryong and Choe Tong Myong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Thae Song made a congratulatory speech at the banquet.
Upon authorization of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the speaker warmly congratulated the labor innovators and persons of merit who took part in the grand banquet with the pride of having devoted themselves to the vanguard of the all-people struggle for prosperity of the country.
All the assets and successes shining along with the absolute position of the DPRK were provided by the patriotic citizens with indomitable pioneering spirit, heroic stamina, warm blood and sweat, and their noble conscience and undaunted struggle laid a foundation for bringing about the sure success and change in 2024, he noted.
He said that the struggle in the new year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea and the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation requires the strong and energetic efforts of all the people.
He expressed belief that all the participants would launch an intensive campaign for increasing production and performing new miracles in the drive to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK by fully displaying their single-minded loyalty and patriotism in supporting the Party and the state, saying the strong foundations for prosperity, secured by dint of self-reliance only and in our own way, and the people's self-respect and patriotic spirit, which have grown stronger, will surely bring about the implementation of the five-year plan and record the 9th Congress of the WPK as a glorious one in history.
All the participants toasted the good health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the prominent leader of our state and dear father of the people, and for the new victory in 2025 when a greater stride will be made toward prosperity. -0-

The square was crowded with Pyongyangites seeing out 2024 recorded with eye-opening events and unforgettable stories and waiting for the moment of excitement to be filled with confidence in the new year.
At 00:00 sharp, a bell tolled the start of the New Year and melodies of the immortal revolutionary hymns "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" and "Song of GeneralKim Jong Il" resounded in the sky above the capital city.
On behalf of the workers, peasants and intellectuals, model working people of the capital city courteously hoisted up the national flag amid the solemn playing of the national anthem of the DPRK.
Masses paid high tribute to the national flag of the DPRK which is fluttering invariably and more brilliantly on this land displaying the independent dignity and prestige of our powerful state and the destiny and rosy future of the people.
With the DPRK flag fluttering in the sky above the capital city, marvelous fireworks were displayed to celebrate the New Year.
Showing the pride and joy of the people of a powerful state who have grown up under the national flag of glory, the magnificent and bright fireworks redoubled all the people’s revolutionary will to dynamically accelerate the new historic advance for vigorously hastening the era of comprehensive prosperity of our state, praying for the prosperity of the country. -0-

headline: Greetings to DPRK Foreign Minister from Her Cambodian Counterpart
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Prak Sokhon, deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Cambodia, on December 12, 2024 on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
Noting that the two countries have a long history of relationship and close friendship, the message said that Cambodia would continuously keep the bilateral relations for mutual interests. -0-

headline: New Year Performance Given by Schoolchildren
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- Amid the blessing of the whole country, a performance of schoolchildren greeting the New Year 2025 was given at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on January 1.
Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, and other senior Party, government and military officials, labour innovators and persons of distinguished services invited to the New Year celebrations, Pyongyangites, students of the revolutionary schools and schoolchildren.
Overseas compatriots staying in the socialist homeland enjoyed the performance.
The performance began with prologue "We present New Year's greeting to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un". The schoolchildren presented a floral basket to the stage, reflecting their gratitude to the respected fatherly Marshal.
They showed through their cheerful songs and beautiful dances the fact that the bright future and eternal happiness are guaranteed thanks to the fatherly Marshal who is taking care of all students and pupils and children of the country, including Pyongyang and the remote mountain and islet villages and those in alien lands, with his paternal love and affection.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it artistically represented the aspiration and determination of the young revolutionaries and patriots. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK significantly greeted the new year 2025, when a milestone of new victory and change will be set in the history of the country through the sacred course of glorifying the great annals of building a rich country with strong army under the ever-victorious leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
They are paying the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho carved out a new history of an independent power with their outstanding ideas, leadership and immortal patriotic devotion and firmly consolidated the eternal foundation of the revolutionary cause of Juche.
Senior officials of the Party and the government, including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and commanding officers of armed forces organs visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, on January 1 on the occasion of the New Year.
The sacred temple of Juche, where the eternal leaders of the Party, state and people and peerlessly great sages lie in state, was wrapped in the most solemn atmosphere.
Seen before the statues ofKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilthere was a floral basket bearing the august name of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Officials of the relevant organs laid floral baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the Cabinet of the DPRK and the Korean People's Army.
The participants paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the participants made deep New Year's bows to them in humblest reverence for them.
All the participants hardened their firm will to dynamically usher in the era of prosperity of the powerful state by fully discharging the important responsibility and duties entrusted to them by the Party, the revolution and the people in the historic advance of the comprehensive development of socialism that is rapidly rising and expanding, upholding the revolutionary ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unwith intense loyalty. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
DPRK People Significantly Greet New Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- The people of the DPRK significantly greeted the new year 2025.
An endless stream of visitors with intense loyalty and deep yearning flew into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
The visitors made New Year greetings to the eternal images of the great leaders at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun.
Working people, service personnel, school youth and children laid floral baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill and other parts of the country and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men.
Children and pupils of primary schools across the country received gifts associated with the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea on the occasion of the New Year.
The Korean feature film "Day and Night of Confrontation", a sequel to "One Day and One Night", was screened at the film-show units across the country.
Colorful performances were given in Pyongyang and local areas to rev up the festive mood.
The working people, pupils and students and children enjoyed themselves at the people's cultural recreation grounds including the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Munsu Water Park.
Public catering establishments across the country including Okryu Restaurant in Pyongyang and Sinhung Restaurant in Hamhung were crowded with visitors.
The pleasant smell of roast chestnut and sweet potato, served at outdoor stalls in different parts of the capital city, added to the festive mood.
Congratulatory cards were served at the greeting card and souvenir shops in Pyongyang and congratulatory cards and mobile phone messages exchanged between parents and their children, teachers and their disciples, relatives and friends across the country.
The streets of Pyongyang and other parts of the country were decorated with peculiar lights. -0-

headline: Fertilizer Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) -- Workers and technicians of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in the DPRK turned out in the drive to produce more fertilizers than last year.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex raised actual extraction rate of gas producers by conducting the equipment management and technical control in all processes in a responsible way.
The workers at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, who accumulated good experience in fulfilling the plan for manuring year and the yearly fertilizer production plan ahead of schedule last year, are conducting the drive for increased production and creation with the enthusiasm to make a greater leap forward in 2025. -0-

headline: Pyongyangites Receive Fresh Vegetables Produced at Kangdong Greenhouse Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) -- Vegetables produced at the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex in the DPRK were supplied to Pyongyang citizens on the New Year's Day.
The newly-built vegetable sales stations and other commercial service bases were crowded with people supplied with various kinds of fruit vegetables, leafy vegetables and functional vegetables including cucumber and tomato.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Taken with Labour Innovators and Persons of Merit on Occasion of New Year 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, called labour innovators and persons of merit to the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the WPK and had a photo taken with them on January 2 on the occasion of the New Year 2025.
The participants were filled with great emotion and joy as they entered the yard of the Party Central Committee with boundless gratitude to the respected Marshal
Kim Jong Unwho values the life and struggle of ordinary working people devoting themselves to the prosperity of the country, shows warm benevolence for them to participate in the significant New Year celebrations and puts them on the peak of glory again.
When the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unappeared, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of “Hurrah!” looking up to the leader, symbol of the great Party, the absolute dignity and invincibility of the powerful state and the destiny and happiness of all the people.
Kim Jong Unextended warm greetings to the labour innovators and persons of merit in various fields, who made contributions to bringing about great changes in 2024 which are of epochal significance in the historic struggle toward the comprehensive development of socialism.
He highly appreciated their efforts, saying that the great successes and proud edifices, symbolic of the self-dependence and prosperity of our state, clearly reflect the pure conscience and devoted efforts of the patriotic working people as reliable cornerstones supporting the country.
Thanks to the large contingent of genuine patriots filled with the strong will and ardent enthusiasm to bring earlier the future of a powerful country by dint of their strenuous efforts, only victory is always in store for our glorious motherland, the DPRK, which is making a dynamic advance and leap forward, ushering in a new era of national prosperity, he said.
Expressing his belief that the participants would glorify their worthwhile life as creators of heroic feats and the standard-bearers of the collective innovation movement in the vanguard for increased production and patriotic struggle for carrying out the struggle tasks set forth by the Eighth Party Congress, he had a photo taken with them.
On the same day, he met female footballers and coaches who won the first place in the 2024 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup finals, congratulated them on their successful games, which fully demonstrated the honour of the DPRK and added national pride and self-esteem to the feeling of the people across the country, and encouraged them to make uninterrupted development in the future.
The labour innovators and persons of merit made a firm pledge to make the meaningful year 2025 as a year of great victory of fully demonstrating the validity and vitality of the fighting programme of the Party and as a historic watershed that provides a phase of upturn for a higher stage of development, by charging forward with a single mind to accomplish the sacred patriotic cause for the prosperity of the socialist country, true to the ideas and leadership of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Severe Socio-political Confusion Spirals in Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) -- A series of impeachment cases, unprecedented in history, broke out and a warrant for arresting the president was issued in the wake of the short-lived "Dec. 3 emergency martial law" in the puppet ROK, resulting in paralysis of its state administration and spiraling socio-political confusion.
An impeachment motion against puppet President Yoon Suk Yeol was passed at the puppet National Assembly on December 14 last year and even puppet Prime Minister Han Tok Su, who took over presidency instead of Yoon, was also impeached on December 27.
Meanwhile, the Criminal Investigation Office for high-ranking officials requested the arrest of Yoon who doggedly refuses to be investigated. When it had an arrest warrant issued by the puppet court later, it announced that it would enforce the arrest within the effective period till January 6.
An investigation into the case of the rebellion has been conducted in all aspects and the truth has come to light. But Yoon, chief culprit of the rebellion, stubbornly refuses to be investigated, totally denying his crimes with sheer lies.
The pro-Yoon clan of the ruling "People Power Party" is shielding Yoon, displeased with the warrant issued for arresting him, for their dirty partisan interests. It seeks to reverse the impeachment-oriented trend, frontally challenging the public demand for impeachment.
In response to it, the opposition parties are intensifying their political offensive and pressure, saying even "serial impeachment" of all state council members eligible for presidency may occur in case their demand is not met.
In the new year, too, mammoth public candlelight rallies, demonstrations, marches and other protest actions are taking place in Seoul every day, under slogans that call for ousting Yoon and dissolving the "People Power Party."
More than 500 000 people of various circles, involved in the protests, termed the Yoon's attempted rebellion was a crime to deprive the people of their sovereignty by holding them hostage, and that uneasiness has become a daily occurrence due to Yoon who declared martial law against the people, accusing him of having fomented unrest through ceaseless war drills with the U.S. and Japan and declared even martial law to maintain his power.
Reporting the impeachment of the acting president two weeks after the impeachment of Yoon who declared martial law, foreign media said that as Yoon is waiting for court decision over impeachment, an impeachment motion against the acting president was passed again to plunge the ROK deeper into an abyss of political upheaval and its oft-repeated liberal democracy has collapsed. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 4 (KCNA) -- This year we will commemorate the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea, says Rodong Sinmun Saturday in an editorial, and goes on:
The 80th founding anniversary of the WPK is a grand political festival, which will powerfully demonstrate once again the seasoned leadership, the longest ruling history and the bright future of the ever-victorious WPK that has brought about the highest dignity and glory, unprecedented in the nation's history spanning 5 000 years, by successfully building the most advantageous Korean-style socialism, being responsible for the working people and the country.
It is the tradition, pride and honour peculiar to our people to celebrate with splendour the birth anniversary of the great Party, our dignity, destiny and future, with proud labour successes.
Only when we go all out for making miraculous successes in the sacred patriotic struggle for comprehensive rejuvenation and development of our great country, can we greet the 9th Congress of the WPK as a glorious meeting of victors.
"Let us struggle courageously full of confidence for the great victory in 2025!" - this is our important fighting slogan for this year.
We should defend the 80th founding anniversary of the Party and its congress and make great transformation and vigorous advance in all aspects of state building by successfully carrying out the five-year plan.
A sure victory is in store for our this year's struggle as we are under the experienced and seasoned leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, prominent leader of our Party and revolution, and there is the great might of the single-minded unity in which all the people are rallied close around the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Message of Thanks of C.C., WPK Conveyed to Employees of Munphyong Smeltery
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a message of thanks to the workers, technicians and officials of the Munphyong Smeltery who successfully completed the project for modernizing the calcinations-sulfuric acid line.
A meeting for conveying the message of thanks took place on January 5.
Present there were Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Paek Song Guk, chief secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials and employees of the smeltery.
Kim Tok Hun conveyed a message of thanks of the WPK Central Committee.
The WPK Central Committee in the message of thanks said that another significant entity increasing the might of Juche-based industry was born at the Munphyong Smeltery, a leading nonferrous metal producer, to brilliantly adorn the year of 2024.
The WPK Central Committee extended thanks to the workers, technicians and officials of the smeltery, who established an advanced calcinations-sulfuric acid line of pollution-free, labor-saving and site-saving type to make it possible to produce sulfuric acid in a stable way while making remarkable progress in improving the production environment, and set an example in carrying out the Party's strategy for readjustment and reinforcement.
They completed the project by their own efforts despite the manifold difficulties and obstacles hindering their advance, the message said, adding this is a manifestation of their unshakable faith to support the Party with increased production of nonferrous metal, cherishing the tradition and pride as a factory with many patriots and a powerful factory.
Speeches were made at the meeting. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Thanks from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter of thanks from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on January 4.
Upon hearing the good news that the respected MarshalKim Jong Unshowed a special solicitude for members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan, who took part in the New Year performance, at the outset of 2025, Chongryon and all Koreans in Japan are now filled with great joy and excitement and the Korean compatriots' community is seething with delight and great emotion, the letter said.
The letter said that the Chongryon Central Standing Committee extends thanks toKim Jong Unwho has repeatedly shown the greatest privilege, carrying the ardent reverence of all the Korean people in Japan, including officials, educators and parents of students of Chongryon.
The letter noted that they are filled with the determination of more vigorously carrying forward the patriotic cause of Chongryon, including the national education, following the great sunbeams, true to the noble intention of the respected Marshal who invited members of the art troupe of schoolchildren of Chongryon to the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Supreme Staff of the Korean revolution, and showed the greatest favor for them.
All the officials and educators of Chongryon will regard the benevolence shown byKim Jong Unfor the Korean schoolchildren in Japan as the greatest happiness for all of them and devote their all to developing the national education, the lifeline of the movement of Koreans in Japan, and training reserves of the patriotic movement, the letter stressed.
The letter sincerely wishedKim Jong Un, the great sun of the revolutionary cause of Juche, good health and comfort, considerate of the most ardent desire of all Chongryon officials, Koreans in Japan and schoolchildren who will shoulder the future of the patriotic movement. -0-

headline: Celebrations Held by General Association of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- Events took place at the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) to celebrate the New Year 2025.
Officials of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Jilin City branch of the Jilin Regional Association of the GAKC and family members of the chairperson of the Jilin Regional Association laid floral baskets before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin on Dec. 31 last year and paid tribute to him.
Floral baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC and the Dandong City branch of the Liaoning Regional Association were laid before the portraits and pictures of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilat the DPRK embassy in Beijing and the DPRK missions in Shenyang and Dandong on January 1.
A meeting for adopting a congratulatory letter to the respected ComradeKim Jong Untook place at the conference hall of the GAKC.
Present there were Chairwoman Choe Un Bok and other officials of the GAKC headquarters and members of the Shenyang City branch of the Liaoning Regional Association.
A congratulatory letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
Then the participants studied a "report on the Enlarged Meeting of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea". -0-

headline: Pyongyang Bag Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Bag Factory called a treasure factory among the people is located in Rangnang District, Pyongyang Municipality, the capital city of the DPRK.
The factory has all the conditions necessary for producing various kinds of bags including sample room, cutting, sewing and packing worksites, sci-tech learning space, technical preparation room and designing room.
This modern bag production base with a large capacity was built on the initiative of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
He personally guided the layout and solved the problems arising in the construction. One day in January 2017 he visited the newly built Pyongyang Bag Factory as his first field guidance for that year.
Going round various places of the factory, he learned in detail about its construction and production. He said that the bags of various shapes and colors suited to the hobbies and tastes of the children and students were made well.
He expressed satisfaction over the fact that our people and children have been provided the bags produced at the factory with locally available raw and other materials.
True to his noble intention, the factory manufactured and introduced equipment for measuring the quality of products, thus making a scientific assessment of the quality of products and steadily improving their quality.
The factory also manufactured a device for measuring thread consumption with high accuracy, saved many materials and lowered the cost of products.
It invented and manufactured efficient jigs and equipment conducive to raising the work efficiency to improve the quality, and many products were awarded the December 15 Quality Medal. -0-

headline: Bearing Steel Production Line Established at Musan Mining Complex
story_text:

The complex finished the line designing in a short span of time and manufactured and installed necessary equipment. And it established rational technical indices for normalizing production, including pursuing suitable melting time and method.
As a result, it provided a guarantee for saving many materials and increasing the output of iron ore and earth-scrapping. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Benevolence for Agricultural Workers
story_text:
PresidentKim Il Sungguided a national conference of agricultural officials in February 1969.
After speeches at the conference, he asked the participants if they had anything to offer.
The then management board chairwoman of the Ryongsan Co-op Farm in Songchon County of South Phyongan Province told the President that she wanted some trucks, tractors and bulldozers, a rice-polishing machine and materials needed for construction of a school.
Writing down the problems raised by her on his notebook, the President told officials to settle them and asked if she had another thing to offer.
The management board chairwoman said to him that it was her ardent wish to meet him at their village. The President agreed to her request with a smile on his face.
After the conference, he sent trucks, tractors and other farm machines and materials needed for building the school to Ryongsan Village. And he visited Songchon County some years later, not forgetting the promise with the chairwoman at the conference venue.
He met her with tears on her eyes and acquainted himself with the farming situation. That day he discussed with the villagers till late at night the ways for yielding bumper crops at the mountain village. -0-

Artists of the Mansudae Art Studio and the Pyongyang Municipal Fine Arts Studio sketched the looks of workers at heat production workshops of the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant. They called upon the workers to take the lead in attaining the production target this year, giving aid materials to them.
Creators of the Central Fine Arts Studio presented scores of pencil drawings depicting the innovators at the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant.
The artists of the Art Studio of the Ministry of Railways produced notice-boards while creating pencil drawings of workers at the Pyongyang Railway Bureau. -0-

headline: Work for Supporting Farms Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 7 (KCNA) -- Citizens in different parts of the DPRK have turned out in the work for supporting the socialist countryside, true to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Those in the capital city of Pyongyang carried more than 25 000 tons of manure to different farms in the city on January 5.
Officials and working people in North Hwanghae Province have made high results in manure production and transport.
North Hamgyong Province is increasing the enthusiasm for support to the agricultural sector. The provincial revolutionary museum, the provincial designing institute and other units transported manure by trucks to farms and Hoeryong City and Onsong and Kilju counties raised the operation rate of vehicles to hasten the transport of manure. Officials of the provincial public security bureau and young people in the province sent thousands of tons of manure and small farm implements to several farms.
The Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee transported tens of thousands of tons of manure to rural areas in the province and the provincial management bureau for regional construction and building-materials production, the provincial public prosecutors office and the provincial youth league committee, too, carried quality manure to farms by trucks.
Officials and working people in Kaesong Municipality carried a large amount of compost to Uipho and Tokam farms of the Kaesong Municipal Rural Economy Committee.
Encouraged by the assistance of officials and working people across the country, the agricultural workers are putting spurs to the preparations for this year's farming. -0-

Officials are organizing the work while discussing the proposals for decisively improving the economic guidance and management and establishing a well-regulated national crisis control system.

story_text:

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Tireless Efforts for People
story_text:
One day in November 2000, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the newly-built Hwangju Chicken Farm.
Looking round various places of the farm for a long time, he paid deep attention to providing the people with more chickens and eggs.
When the sun was sinking in the west, an official told him that he had to go back quickly, worrying about his overstrain.

headline: DPRK Missile Administration Succeeds in Test-fire of New-type Intermediate-range Hypersonic Ballistic Missile
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 7 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea successfully conducted a test-fire of new-type intermediate-range hypersonic ballistic missile on January 6.
General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, and leading officials of the defence science institute guided the test-fire on the spot.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the test-fire of new-type intermediate-range hypersonic ballistic missile through a monitoring system.
The test of the new strategic weapon system is part of the plans for the development of the national defence capabilities to raise the durability and effectiveness of strategic deterrent against potential rivals in conformity with the changing regional security environment.
The new compound of carbon fiber was used in the manufacture of the engine body of the new-type hypersonic missile and a new comprehensive and effective method based on the already-accumulated technologies introduced in the flight and guidance control system.
Expressing great satisfaction over the result of the test-fire, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unreferred to the new weapon system.
He said:
The current test-fire proved without doubt that we are actively developing such powerful new-type weapon systems as intermediate-range hypersonic ballistic missile to cope with different security threats the hostile forces posed to our state at present.
A few countries in the world might possess such weapon system.
Just like the intentional purpose of all military powers, the development of new-type hypersonic missile is mainly aimed to steadily put the country's nuclear war deterrent on an advanced basis by making the means of changing the war situation, the weapon system to which no one can respond, the linchpin of strategic deterrence.
This is clearly a plan and effort for self-defence, not an offensive plan and action.
As shown by the result of today's test-fire, the effectiveness of the missile system fully equipped with the expected militant performance was confirmed.
The performance of our latest intermediate-range hypersonic missile system can not be ignored worldwide, and the system can deal a serious military strike to a rival while effectively breaking any dense defensive barrier.
Through the current test of the strategic weapon, we fully demonstrated the potentiality and development speed of our inexhaustible self-defensive technical force capable of fully coping with prospective threats and clearly showed the rivals what we are doing and that we are fully ready to use even any means to defend our legitimate interests.
The hypersonic missile system will reliably contain any rivals in the Pacific region that can affect the security of our state.
We have acquired a technical force which is by no means easy.
This is a clear achievement and a special event in strengthening the self-defensive capabilities of which we should be proud.
I express thanks to all the researchers and technicians and the workers of munitions industry enterprise, who contributed to the successful development of the new-type strategic weapon system.
The hypersonic glide vehicle of the missile fired northeastward at a launching ground in a suburb of Pyongyang reached its first peak at the height of 99.8 kilometers and the second peak at the height of 42.5 kilometers while making 1 500-km-long flight as scheduled at the speed amounting to twelve times of the speed of sound and accurately landed on the waters of simulated target in the open sea.
The test-fire had no negative effect on the security of the neighboring countries.
The development of the defence capabilities of the DPRK aiming to be a military power will be further accelerated. -0-

headline: Pruning of Fruit Trees Brisk in Field of Fruit Farming
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 7 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the fruit farming sector of the DPRK direct efforts to the pruning of fruit trees in winter.
Those in Pukchong County are doing pruning as required by the technical norms, while putting the main stress on branch thinning and bending to suit the characters of species and growth state of fruit trees.

story_text:

Officials are organizing the work while discussing the proposals for decisively improving the economic guidance and management and establishing a well-regulated national crisis control system.

headline: Efforts Concentrated on Preparation for New Year's Farming
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK have turned out in the work to make full preparations for farming this year.
Rural areas of South Hwanghae Province, the biggest agricultural province of the country, are bringing about good results.
Anak and Unchon counties are concentrating manpower and means on the work of carpeting sandy and low-fertility fields with humus soil.
The work to attain the goal of producing organic fertilizer is going on in the rural areas of Pyongyang Municipality.
The production of high-quality organic fertilizer is stepped up in Mangyongdae District and agricultural workers in Sadong District and Kangdong County are striving to secure more humus soil and liquid manure.
Hwadae County in North Hamgyong Province pushes forward with the work of securing materials for seed-plots, while paying attention to revitalizing the production at the county organic compound fertilizer factory.
South Hamgyong Province has taken measures to supply electric power and materials to the Hamhung Tractor Parts Factory and the Jongphyong Farm Machine Parts Factory and paid attention to solving technical problems to put production of various parts on a normal basis. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories in Jaeryong County Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories in Jaeryong County of the DPRK were inaugurated, significantly decorating the outset of 2025, a year of great turn for raising the overall development of socialism onto a higher stage, true to the idea and spirit of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The inauguration of modern regional-industry factories built in Jaeryong Namuri Plain, a granary in the western area of the DPRK, bringing about a rare change of regional rejuvenation, is a powerful proof of the unshakable will and executive power of the great  Party Central Committee which has launched the great historic cause for realizing the centuries-old desire of the regional people and is unconditionally keeping a promise with them, and a great inspiring event foreseeing a dynamic progress and miraculous successes.
An inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories in Jaeryong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy took place on January 7.
The venue of the ceremony was full of the great pride of the soldier-builders who have wonderfully built the regional-industry factories into precious entities of our Party’s people-first politics and the crystallization of their pure conscience as servants of the people in the steadfast spirit of defending the Party’s policies and through their devoted practices and of the great excitement and joy of the people in Jaeryong County who will enjoy a new civilized life to their heart's content under the care of the Party.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers, extending the greatest glory and respect to the outstanding leader and the great father who opened up a new era in which the whole of the country develops all at once, provided a springboard of dynamic advance and upswing of the DPRK and has led the sacred cause for changes in the vanguard with his outstanding ideology and theory and rare leadership ability.
Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and other senior officials of the Party and the government, service personnel involved in the construction, officials and employees of the regional-industry factories, officials and working people in South Hwanghae Province and Jaeryong County.
Ju Chang Il, director of the Information and Publicity Department of the WPK Central Committee, made an inaugural address.
The speaker said that he was very excited to greet the significant New Year with the inauguration of such modern regional-industry factories, adding that it is a great revolution which can be made only byKim Jong Unthat the overall development of the regions which had been an ideal for nearly 80 years was adopted as the most important political task of the Party and the state and its brilliant entities have been completed that year.
He said that if anyone goes round the regional-industry factories to which modernity, civilization and profitability are applied, he or she would bear deep in mind the great efforts ofKim Jong Unwho is devoting his all to bringing about changes that reach the regional people actually and that will be cheered by them, and would be convinced of the future of the regional changes to be brought about in a larger scale under his great care.
Today’s grand inauguration is a proud success of the regional-industry revolution and, at the same time, a springboard of a new struggle and a cornerstone for greater and higher and more dynamic progress, he said, adding that this important event welcomed by all people across the country should surely be led to perfect results every year regardless of conditions.
Saying that the great cause of regional rejuvenation shouldered by the Party is a science, practice and victory, he called for working harder for brilliantly accomplishing the Party's policy on regional development and bringing earlier the future of a rich, civilized, prosperous and powerful country by redoubling confidence and courage.
Kim Jong Uncut an inaugural tape.
The enthusiastic cheers raised by the participants out of their ardent reverence and absolute trust in the great Party Central Committee resounded throughout the venue of the ceremony, where a historic picture was unfolded to record another brilliant page in the history of regional development in the new era.
All the participants extended profound gratitude to the benevolent leader of the people who sets it as his lifelong mission and the most important work for the Party and the state to promote the people's happiness and well-being and translates into a reality a socialist paradise in which all the people would enjoy happiness and an overall efflorescence for national rejuvenation.
Kim Jong Unwent round the factories.
Noting that it is a great auspicious event of the whole country which gives great pleasure to the people who start the worthwhile journey in the new year that the inauguration ceremonies for the regional-industry factories take place one after another in 20 cities and counties including Songchon and Jaeryong counties as a fruition of sincere efforts rendered for the people last year, he said he feels greater pride in making a revolution and struggling as he saw the people of the region full of excitement and joy like today and that it makes him determine more firmly to find more jobs for the people and carry them out.
Watching the trial products, he set forth principles and ways to be consistently adhered to in operation and production of the regional-industry factories and discussed with senior officials accompanying him a series of measures to be taken by the Party and the government for leading and powerfully supporting this work in a sustained way in order to guarantee the long-term development of regional industry.
He repeatedly stressed the need for the Party and power organs in cities and counties to always pay deep attention to providing conditions necessary for normalizing production at the regional-industry factories including the issues of providing raw materials and training skilled workers and put them into practice unconditionally so that the new regional development policy of the WPK would make a substantial contribution to promoting the material well-being of the inhabitants in the relevant regions.
He affirmed that he would make this year a year of another upsurge in regional construction by setting a higher standard as a goal on the basis of last year's successes and ensuring the economic profitability, effectiveness and prospectiveness to the maximum.
The inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Jaeryong County held in the presence ofKim Jong Unserved as a significant occasion which instilled the confidence in sure victory and optimism into the hearts of the people across the country, who turned out as one in the drive to open up a new avenue for prosperity according to the viewpoint on development and in the spirit of creation of the Korean style and greet the Ninth Congress of the Party as the congress of victors and glory. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party (LPRP) and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), on December 30, 2024.
In the message, Thongloun Sisoulith expressed sincere thanks on behalf of the LPRP Central Committee and the LPDR government and people and on his own behalf to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor having sent warm and good congratulations and best wishes to the Lao party, government and people and to him on the occasion of the 49th founding anniversary of the LPDR.
I feel great pleasure over the fact that the traditional friendship and good cooperative relations between the LPDR and the DPRK have been steadily developed and strengthened in recent years and express belief that the good relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples will continue to develop in depth and obtain greater results, bringing substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and promoting the cooperative relations for peace, stability and development in the region and the rest of the world, the message said.
On the occasion of the New Year 2025, I wish you good health and happiness and greater success in your noble and honourable cause, and the fraternal DPRK people sustained happiness and prosperity, it added. -0-

Korean schoolchildren in Japan, who metKim Jong Unand had the honor to be remembered forever, gave the dance story "We grow under the national flag of the Republic" with the determination to give steadfast continuity to the patriotic generation. Their performance was enthusiastically acclaimed by the audience.
Working people and school youth and children in Pyongyang enjoyed the New Year performance. -0-

headline: Songchon Hot Spring in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- Songchon Hot Spring, one of the famous mineral springs in the DPRK, is in Songchon County of South Phyongan Province, well known for home of tobacco, silk and medicinal chestnut.
The main ionic components of the hot spring are bicarbonate and sodium ions. Also contained in it are radon and sulfur. Its temperature is 45.5°C and pH 8.6. Its daily gush amount is very high.
The hot spring is efficacious for the treatment of nervous system diseases, gynecopathy, operation sequela, rheumatoid arthritis and other diseases.
There are also medical facilities with hot spring and mineral water as the main treatment means.
In his speech at the inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories in Songchon County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy in December last year, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed the need for the county to sustain its peculiar features and tap its potentialities and make the most of its traffic advantages to effectively develop and utilize such local resources for cultural tourism as the shores of the Piryu River and the Songchon Hot Spring.
Songchon County is now taking practical measures to develop and utilize the hot spring as local resources for cultural tourism. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier from Vietnamese PM
story_text:

In the message, Pham Minh Chinh noted that the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK, personally provided and cultivated by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sungwith much effort, have been steadily consolidated and developed.
Expressing belief that the cooperative relations between Vietnam and the DPRK would continue to dynamically develop thanks to the common interests and efforts of the leaders and peoples of the two countries and contribute to keeping peace, stability and cooperation in the region and the rest of the world, he wished the premier success in his new job. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories in Sukchon County Held
Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories in Sukchon County Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories in Sukchon County, the DPRK were inaugurated in the wake of the inauguration ceremonies of those in Songchon and Jaeryong counties amid the simultaneous appearance of precious entities of regional-industry revolution across the country under the wise guidance of the Central Committee of the great Workers’ Party of Korea.
The smart factories built in a granary in the western area of the DPRK, demonstrating the new development of regional industry, are the precious assets which will signally improve the living condition of the residents in Sukchon County and firmly support the regional economic development and a proud creation which inspires them with confidence that they can bring forward the rosier future by their own efforts in their region.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Sukchon County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy took place on Jan. 8.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs and working people in South Phyongan Province and Sukchon County, soldier-builders and the employees of the factories.
Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an inaugural address.
He warmly congratulated the residents of Sukchon County on participating in the inauguration ceremony at the beginning of the hopeful new year.

headline: Innovative Measures Taken in Agricultural Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- In hearty response to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, agricultural officials in the DPRK conduct the work in a scientific and innovative way to increase grain production.
Officials of the Agricultural Commission and agricultural guidance organs at all levels are seriously discussing the ways for implementing the tasks facing the agricultural sector.
On the basis of the successes and experience gained in last year's farming, they are taking foresighted economic and practical measures to put all farming processes on a scientific basis and carry out the grain production plan for this year without fail.
Steps are also taken to keep farm machines on a normal track and maintain and repair them in a responsible manner, increase the proportion of mechanization in farming and update the farm machine sector.
Practical measures are taken to ensure the stability of farming by accelerating the irrigation projects for paddy and non-paddy fields affected by water shortage, drought and flooding and maintaining and repairing already-built irrigation facilities, drainage canals and waterway structures.
Innovative proposals are being made to increase the area of cropland by speeding up the construction of outer and inner-nets of tidelands and directing efforts to land realignment.

Practical ways are being discussed to consolidate the material and technical foundations of the grain management sector. -0-

headline: Commemorative Meeting Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place on January 8 to mark the 10th anniversary of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Ryugyong Mushroom Farm.
Present there were Ri Man Song, chairman of the Pyongyang Municipal Rural Economy Committee, Ri Un Sok, secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and employees of the farm.
Manager Ok Song Mun made a report.
The reporter noted that the General Secretary initiated the construction of a modern mushroom farm and solved all problems arising in its construction in order to translate into reality the noble intention of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho made all efforts to turn the country into a country of mushroom.
In January 2015, the General Secretary visited the newly-built farm. Saying that he was very pleased to see a wonderful edifice for the people, he had a significant photo taken with its officials and employees.
Recalling the fact, the reporter called upon the officials and employees of the farm to widely introduce advanced mushroom cultivation methods and techniques and put production on a higher scientific and intensive basis with the pride and honor of working at the glorious worksite associated with the leadership exploits of the Party and thus further increase the mushroom production.
He stressed that all the officials and employees should wage a dynamic drive for increased production to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, true to the General Secretary’s ideas and leadership, and thus make a tangible contribution to the improvement of the people's living standards. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier from Vietnamese PM
story_text:

headline: Songchon Hot Spring in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- Songchon Hot Spring, one of the famous mineral springs in the DPRK, is in Songchon County of South Phyongan Province, well known for home of tobacco, silk and medicinal chestnut.
The main ionic components of the hot spring are bicarbonate and sodium ions. Also contained in it are radon and sulfur. Its temperature is 45.5°C and pH 8.6. Its daily gush amount is very high.
The hot spring is efficacious for the treatment of nervous system diseases, gynecopathy, operation sequela, rheumatoid arthritis and other diseases.
There are also medical facilities with hot spring and mineral water as the main treatment means.
In his speech at the inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories in Songchon County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy in December last year, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed the need for the county to sustain its peculiar features and tap its potentialities and make the most of its traffic advantages to effectively develop and utilize such local resources for cultural tourism as the shores of the Piryu River and the Songchon Hot Spring.
Songchon County is now taking practical measures to develop and utilize the hot spring as local resources for cultural tourism. -0-

headline: Scientific Plan and Operation for Improvement in People's Living Intensified
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- Officials in the fields of light industry, fishery, commerce, land and environment protection and urban management of the DPRK are working hard to promote the people's well-being and provide them with more affluent and civilized living conditions and environment.
The light industrial sector set it as the primary task to improve the quality of products and has discussed the measures for completing the five-year plan, developing new products, expanding capabilities and building new production bases.
The fishery sector is seeking practical ways to increase the production of seafood by consolidating the material and technical foundations and directing efforts to fish farming and aquaculture.
The commercial sector is focusing on taking measures to preserve the nature of socialist commerce and offer the conveniences to the people.
The field of land and environment protection is conducting the study and discussion for promoting the work to minimize flood damage and improving the country's forest ecological environment.
The urban management sector is working out plans to make a substantial contribution to the people's living by repairing public buildings in a qualitative way and pushing ahead with the landscaping in a scientific way.
Officials in the relevant fields are further perfecting the ways suited to the specific conditions of their fields. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- Machine-building units across the DPRK make progress in the production of important custom-built equipment necessary for this year's irrigation project.
Officials of the Ministry of Machine-building Industry are intensifying their control and guidance to make the relevant units carry out their daily production plans on the principle of giving priority to quality.
The Anju Pump Factory is striving to increase the production while taking economic and technical measures to ensure quality in the production of irrigation pumps.
Taedonggang and Jangsan electric appliances factories strive to manufacture the custom-built equipment for irrigation projects at a level of high quality. -0-

headline: First-Term Winter Camping Begins at Songdowon Int'l Children's Camp in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- The first-term winter camping of schoolchildren started with due ceremony at the Songdowon International Children's Camp in the DPRK.
Present at the ceremony, held on Jan. 9, were Paek Song Guk, chief secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, Ju Mun Jin, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials and teaching staff of the camp and campers.
The participants in the ceremony laid a floral basket and bouquets before the statues of the great GeneralissimosKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilat the camp and paid tribute to them.
The sound of a bugle heralding the start of camping was resounded. Then the campers responded to the slogan "Let us be always ready for the socialist country!"
They made a schoolchildren's salute, vowing to prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters of the socialist country who are knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy and reserves for the building of communism, bearing in mind the love and trust of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
A report and speeches were made at the ceremony. -0-

headline: Efforts Directed to Putting Country's Sports on Higher Stage of Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- The sports sector of the DPRK makes innovative work to attain higher goals in the light of the idea and spirit of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports and the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee are studying the proposals for putting the country's sports on a higher stage of development and organizing the work to carry them into practice.
The ministry has proposed plans conducive to improving the quality of sports teaching and training and winning more medals in international games this year, too.
Measures are discussed to guide the sports work in a scientific way and strengthen the reserve players training by working out realistic plans for technical development at sports teaching and training units at all levels.
The sports education and scientific research units are taking practical steps to further perfect the training methods suited to the constitutional features of Korean players, introduce new cross-disciplinary sciences into educational practice and achieve research successes conducive to putting the teaching and training on a higher scientific basis.
The detailed work is going on to rev up the enthusiasm for sports throughout the country, organize mass sports games in various forms and methods and increase the ranks of referees for mass sports games.
Discussed are the practical issues arising in building and remodeling sports facilities on a modern basis, developing and producing various kinds of quality sports goods at the athletic apparatus production units and conducting sports exchange.
The Korean Taekwon-Do Committee concentrates its efforts on improving the system of selecting reserve players and achieving bigger successes in the world championships to be held in the future. -0-

story_text:

They went to the Kumchon Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, the Jangchon Vegetable Farm in Sadong District and the agricultural production shop of the Central Zoo with quality manure and lots of farming materials.
Officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Urban Management and other units handed over small farm implements to the Kumchon Vegetable Farm and manured fields.
Officials of the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Light Industry, the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and other units informed the agricultural workers at the Jangchon Vegetable Farm of the idea and spirit of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee and helped them in their work.

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories in Unpha County Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories have been built in Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, an intermediate mountainous area, under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The inhabitants of Unpha County are extending thanks to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho shapes every state policy only to promote the people's well-being and realize their ideals and guides the work for implementing it.
Present at the inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Unpha County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy held on Jan. 10 were officials and working people in the province and the county, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, said in his address at the ceremony that the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, cherished in the hearts of the people, is an eventful bold decision and gigantic revolution made for the first time since the foundation of the Party and the country, adding that the great change for regional rejuvenation in the county is a fruition brought by the ardent desire and iron will of the General Secretary to provide the people and posterity with a better life and a brighter future.
As long as there are the wise leadership of the great Party Central Committee and the single-minded unity, the absolute strength of socialist Korea, we will surely and steadily work fresh miracles and new myths of Korea, the speaker said, calling for fully displaying patriotism and loyalty to bring about a radical development and comprehensive prosperity of regions with great confidence and courage.
Ri Ung Chon, chief secretary of the Unpha County Committee of the WPK, in his speech referred to the benevolence of the General Secretary who developed Unpha County into a blessed land envied by all the people across the country.
He vowed to carry through the plan of the Party Central Committee for making the regional development represent the advance and development of our state and making the ideal appearance of regions show the true picture of our-style socialism by devoting himself to the perfect implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, always mindful of the heavy responsibility for the great revolutionary work for its implementation.

headline: Coal Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- In hearty response to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the coal industry of the DPRK takes practical measures to consolidate the material and technical foundation of coal mines and increase their productivity.
Officials of the Ministry of Coal Industry and relevant units are intensifying discussion and consultation on the issues arising in consolidating the production basis of coal mines and increasing coal production.
Steps have been taken to give precedence to the supply of materials needed for the construction of new coal mines and pits and provide coal miners with improved living conditions.
Proposals are made to raise the transportation capacity at the Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine and Wolbong and other coal mines.
Coal miners at Namdok, Inpho and Phunggok youth coal mines under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex produced hundreds of more tons of coal in the first week of the year.
February 8 Jikdong, Ryongdae and Chonsong youth coal mines under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex have introduced efficient blasting methods and operated equipment at full capacity to register high production results.
The same is true of other coal mining complexes across the country. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories in Unpha County Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories have been built in Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, an intermediate mountainous area, under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The inhabitants of Unpha County are extending thanks to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho shapes every state policy only to promote the people's well-being and realize their ideals and guides the work for implementing it.
Present at the inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Unpha County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy held on Jan. 10 were officials and working people in the province and the county, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, said in his address at the ceremony that the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, cherished in the hearts of the people, is an eventful bold decision and gigantic revolution made for the first time since the foundation of the Party and the country, adding that the great change for regional rejuvenation in the county is a fruition brought by the ardent desire and iron will of the General Secretary to provide the people and posterity with a better life and a brighter future.
As long as there are the wise leadership of the great Party Central Committee and the single-minded unity, the absolute strength of socialist Korea, we will surely and steadily work fresh miracles and new myths of Korea, the speaker said, calling for fully displaying patriotism and loyalty to bring about a radical development and comprehensive prosperity of regions with great confidence and courage.
Ri Ung Chon, chief secretary of the Unpha County Committee of the WPK, in his speech referred to the benevolence of the General Secretary who developed Unpha County into a blessed land envied by all the people across the country.
He vowed to carry through the plan of the Party Central Committee for making the regional development represent the advance and development of our state and making the ideal appearance of regions show the true picture of our-style socialism by devoting himself to the perfect implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, always mindful of the heavy responsibility for the great revolutionary work for its implementation.
Then owners of the factories cut an inaugural tape.
The participants looked round the factories after enjoying an art performance.
The new modern factories started their operations. -0-
