headline: Ryugyong Mushroom Farm
Efforts Concentrated on Improving Quality of Foodstuff
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Foodstuff factories in the DPRK boost production while directing efforts to the improvement of quality and the development of new products.
The Kwangbok Kumgangsan Foodstuff Factory set it as its main business strategy to improve the quality of products and has reduced production costs by introducing valuable technical innovation proposals.
Its officials and technical group improved the quality and smoothness of instant noodles and increased the productivity through remodeling of equipment.
The Sonhung Foodstuff Factory has improved the quality of its products by settling the sci-tech problems arising in the production of new products and the improvement of their quality.
The Kanggye Winery has made progress in preserving the peculiar taste and flavor of wine.
The Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory and Songdo and other foodstuff factories, too, are striving to improve the quality and productivity of products. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Hae Nam, a woman centenarian living in people's neighbourhood unit No. 37, Tongsan-dong No. 2, Rangnang District, Pyongyang Municipality.
After receiving the birthday spread amid congratulations by officials of the Rangnang District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers, the woman centenarian expressed deep gratitude toKim Jong Un, saying that she has lived for a hundred years thanks to the grateful socialist system.
With a resolve to repay the benevolence of the Party which put her forward as a child of revolutionary martyr and a full-fledged official of the country, she had worked hard at her revolutionary post to implement the Party's policies for decades and did for herself good things such as helping railway workers even after becoming a pensioner.
She brought up her eight children to be reliable pillars for the country and has always asked them to become patriots faithfully supporting the Party and contributing to the national prosperity. -0-

headline: Sangwon Cement Complex Vows to Produce Hundreds of Thousands of More Tons of Cement This Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- In order to successfully complete this year's huge construction projects as monumental entities of Juche architecture to be handed down to the younger generation for the honor of our times and generation, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea called upon the workers at the Sangwon Cement Complex standing on the arsenal of grand construction to perform miracles again.
The workers at the complex held up the torch of innovation and stood at the vanguard of all-people general advance to greet the 80th founding anniversary of the Party and the Ninth Party Congress with labor successes.
The complex, seething with the drive to create new standard and new records, has increased its output of clinker and cement by 105 percent and 114 percent respectively every day from the outset of the year up to now as compared with the same period of last year when it surpassed the peak year level.
Upon hearing the news of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee held in late December last year, the workers at the complex presented a letter reflecting their determination to take the lead in the drive for increased production to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho firmly believed in and put forward them on the outpost of the great socialist construction.
The goal for increased cement production they pledged in the letter amounted to ten times of cement increased by them last year. This high goal is a huge one that can never be attained by the existing conception and method even at the complex which has surpassed several times the peak year level since its operation in recent years.
Bearing in mind the requirements of the Party's policy that a way of attaining the huge goal with existing capabilities is to attach importance to science and technology, its officials worked out daily and monthly plans in detail and are making strenuous efforts to carry out the plans by dint of science and technology,.
Thanks to ardent loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm of all the employees that they are taking charge of cement production before the Party and the state, a large amount of cement has been produced every day, breaking the rated capacity. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter from members of the 34th art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan, who had taken part in the New Year performance for 2025, on Saturday.
The members of the art troupe said in the letter that they made a deep bow to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who took a measure to take part in the New Year performance before leaving the homeland in consideration of their minds and bestowed the greatest privilege and glory they had never thought in the yard of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, with the minds of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and all Koreans in Japan.
The letter said that during their stay in the homeland, they keenly cherished the true image of a genuine power holding the greatest man in high esteem, while witnessing the reality of the homeland where hurrah for the Workers' Party and socialism are heard everywhere under the people-first politics pursued by the respected fatherly Marshal and the innovative entities of self-reliance and self-support spring up like mushrooms after rain.
It went on:
All the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who enjoyed the greatest glory and happiness in the history of Chongryon and the history of the movement of overseas compatriots in the world are filled with a firm pledge to grow up to be the sunflowers of patriotism and loyalty following the sun only in an alien land to repay the warm love of the fatherly Marshal.
We will regard the song of loyalty and filial devotion that we sang before the fatherly Marshal as a theme song of our life and firmly prepare ourselves as pillars of carrying forward the patriotic cause of Chongryon while flying high the flag of the DPRK at our schools in capitalist Japan.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Lauded by Foreign Personages
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The reverence for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis growing stronger among the world people.
In the congratulatory messages and letters sent on the occasion of the New Year, personages of different countries praisedKim Jong Unfor having recorded the sacred revolutionary history in 2024, expressing belief that the future of the DPRK would be rosy as it is led by the peerlessly great man.
The secretary of the Central Committee of the All-Union Communist Party of Bolsheviks of Russia said that under the leadership ofKim Jong Un, the Korean people have registered great successes in the work to build a rich socialist society and cope with the moves of the U.S. imperialists and their followers.
The world-startling miracles were made in the DPRK last year thanks to the devoted efforts of HEKim Jong Un, and his energetic and wise leadership not only encourages the Korean people but also promotes the world peace and stability, the chairman of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialism) and the national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria said, adding that the new year will be an important milestone in the course of building prosperous socialist Korea.
The chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party said that the DPRK achieved a great turn and leap in all fields of state building, economy and social development in 2024, and the general secretary of the People's Front of Workers, Peasants and Students of Peru said that the simultaneous balanced development of the DPRK would lead to a rapid upsurge and development of regional economy and the people's enjoyment of a highly civilized life.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt affirmed that victory is always in store for the DPRK, and the Korean people would realize all their desire as they are led by HEKim Jong Un.
The chairman of the GeneralKim Jong IlPeruvian Amicable Institute, the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the Karachi Juche Study Center of Pakistan, the chairman of the Mexican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea and other personages of different countries said that 2025 will be another watershed in the history of the DPRK's growth and development as it is led by HEKim Jong Unwho is leading the revolutionary cause of Juche, clearly indicating the road to be followed by the country and its people with his far-sighted wisdom and great leadership. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier from Chinese PM
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Li Qiang, premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, on January 9.
The message extended the sincere congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his appointment as the premier of the DPRK Cabinet on behalf of the government of China.
Saying that China and DPRK are the friendly neighbors linked by the same mountain and rivers, it stressed that General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unhave jointly led and propelled the development of the China-DPRK relations.
The message expressed the willingness to promote the steady and fresh development of the traditional China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations by implementing the important common understanding reached by the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries. -0-

The goal for increased cement production they pledged in the letter amounted to ten times of cement increased by them last year. This high goal is a huge one that can never be attained by the existing conception and method even at the complex which has surpassed several times the peak year level since its operation in recent years.
Bearing in mind the requirements of the Party's policy that a way of attaining the huge goal with existing capabilities is to attach importance to science and technology, its officials worked out daily and monthly plans in detail and are making strenuous efforts to carry out the plans by dint of science and technology,.
Thanks to ardent loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm of all the employees that they are taking charge of cement production before the Party and the state, a large amount of cement has been produced every day, breaking the rated capacity. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Lauded by Foreign Personages
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The reverence for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis growing stronger among the world people.
In the congratulatory messages and letters sent on the occasion of the New Year, personages of different countries praisedKim Jong Unfor having recorded the sacred revolutionary history in 2024, expressing belief that the future of the DPRK would be rosy as it is led by the peerlessly great man.
The secretary of the Central Committee of the All-Union Communist Party of Bolsheviks of Russia said that under the leadership ofKim Jong Un, the Korean people have registered great successes in the work to build a rich socialist society and cope with the moves of the U.S. imperialists and their followers.
The world-startling miracles were made in the DPRK last year thanks to the devoted efforts of HEKim Jong Un, and his energetic and wise leadership not only encourages the Korean people but also promotes the world peace and stability, the chairman of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialism) and the national chairman of the People's Progressive Party of Nigeria said, adding that the new year will be an important milestone in the course of building prosperous socialist Korea.
The chairman of the Hungarian Workers' Party said that the DPRK achieved a great turn and leap in all fields of state building, economy and social development in 2024, and the general secretary of the People's Front of Workers, Peasants and Students of Peru said that the simultaneous balanced development of the DPRK would lead to a rapid upsurge and development of regional economy and the people's enjoyment of a highly civilized life.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt affirmed that victory is always in store for the DPRK, and the Korean people would realize all their desire as they are led by HEKim Jong Un.
The chairman of the GeneralKim Jong IlPeruvian Amicable Institute, the secretary general of the African Regional Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Thailand-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the Karachi Juche Study Center of Pakistan, the chairman of the Mexican Institute for the Study of the Juche Idea and other personages of different countries said that 2025 will be another watershed in the history of the DPRK's growth and development as it is led by HEKim Jong Unwho is leading the revolutionary cause of Juche, clearly indicating the road to be followed by the country and its people with his far-sighted wisdom and great leadership. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier from Chinese PM
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Li Qiang, premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, on January 9.
The message extended the sincere congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his appointment as the premier of the DPRK Cabinet on behalf of the government of China.
Saying that China and DPRK are the friendly neighbors linked by the same mountain and rivers, it stressed that General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unhave jointly led and propelled the development of the China-DPRK relations.

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Various Fields and Units of DPRK National Economy Fulfill First Ten-day Plans for New Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The first ten-day plans for the new year were fulfilled in various fields and units of the national economy amid the growing enthusiasm of the officials and workers for struggle across the DPRK.
The workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex have turned out in the all-people general advance this year to implement the decisions of the 11th Plenary Meeting of the 8th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Workers in the field of metallurgical industry have carried out their first ten-day iron and steel production plan for the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex increased the production of more than 1 200 tons of fertilizer in the first three days.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Jangjingang Power Station and the Pujongang Power Station overfulfilled their quotas by 120 percent in the first five days.
The Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex produced hundreds of tons of coal more in the first week alone.
The Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Taean Heavy Machine Complex have introduced effective technical innovation proposals and tapped internal reserves.
The Hyesan Youth Mine and the Yongyu Mine doubled their production results in the first ten days as compared with the same period of last year, and the Jungsan and Phungnyon mines raised the production more than threefold.
Workers of the Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureau of the DPRK have carried out their timber production plans for January in ten days.
The railway transport sector has raised the level of putting the transport organization and control on an IT basis. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Jang So Jo, a woman centenarian living in people's neighbourhood unit No. 10, Sangso-ri, Hyangsan County, Jagang Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
The woman centenarian was congratulated by officials of the Hyangsan County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, her families, relatives and neighbors.

headline: Creation of Industrial Art Design Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- The Central Industrial Art Bureau of the DPRK is methodologically conducting the work to create industrial art designs conducive to implementing the new policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on regional development.
It is pushing ahead with the creation of industrial art designs for advanced public health facilities, facilities for science, education and cultural activities and grain management facilities to be built in regional areas this year.
Meanwhile, it is conducting the work to improve the level of industrial art creation in regional areas.
It organized a workshop to broaden the outlook of creators and made them recognize the issues arising in ensuring simplicity, concentration and symbolism in the creation of trademarks of products.
Industrial art creators in Kangwon and South Hwanghae provinces and other regions have designed trademarks of products with peculiarity and modernity.
Officials and creators in the field of industrial art are striving to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the work for economic construction and regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Millions of Tons of Ore Secured at Taehung Youth Hero Mine
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- The Taehung Youth Hero Mine of the DPRK opened a wide avenue for increased production of minerals by successively conducting three rounds of blasting.
Two rounds of blasting were conducted at the underground face of the Muhak Branch Mine to lay an inexhaustible ore field, and the blasting of 50 000 cubic meters of earth was launched at the open-cast cutting site of the Pukdu Branch Mine on January 8 to secure 2.5 million tons of ore.
The workers of the Taehung Youth Hero Mine were convinced of attaining the goal for increased production ahead of schedule this year through the blasting of 30 000 cubic meters of earth and 50 000 cubic meters of earth at the underground face and open-cast cutting site. -0-

headline: Kelp-transplantation Starts at Offshore Farms of South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- Kelp-transplantation started at the offshore farms in South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK.
The provincial fishery management bureau has taken measures to make the cultivation units raise seedlings needed for kelp-transplantation and supply cultivation materials and thus transplant kelp seedlings in the planned area of cultivation.
Officials and employees of the Pupho Offshore Farm are accelerating kelp-transplantation after finishing the repair of boats and securing hundreds of thousands of meters of rows and thousands of floats.
Officials and employees of the Ongjin Offshore Farm are also providing a guarantee for increasing the productivity of sea culture per hectare by transplanting kelp seedlings in the right time and in good quality as required by technical regulations while solving the problems arising in cultivation by themselves. -0-

headline: Regional-Industry Factories Inaugurated in Kyongsong County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- The people in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, too, greeted a auspicious event amid the inauguration ceremonies of modern regional-industry factories, which will substantially contribute to the improvement of regional people's material and cultural living, taking place one after another in the country.
Kyongsong County in the northern end of the country is full of joy of the inhabitants, who will enjoy a new socialist civilization to the full while leading a beautiful life in the new era of rejuvenation when the capital city and all the regions develop and change simultaneously.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in the county took place on Jan. 12.
Present there were officials and working people in North Hamgyong Province and Kyongsong County, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, addressed the ceremony.
He stressed that this significant inauguration ceremony, which has shown up the looks of the wonderfully changed county with the beginning of the hope-filled new year, is strikingly demonstrating the plan of the great WPK Central Committee to make the ideal appearance of regions a true picture of Korean-style socialism as well as the bright prospect of the new regional development policy.
Thanks to the undying trace left by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin the county, the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm, a large-scale vegetable producer, sprang up before anything else, the fine Yombunjin Coastal Park is being built on a scenic beach and in pine forests, and modern regional-industry factories have appeared as the first entity for regional rejuvenation to give joy of a fresh life and new civilization, he said.
Pak Kun Sok, chairman of the Kyongsong County People's Committee, in his speech expressed the will to ensure a full operation of the modern regional-industry factories, a brilliant embodiment of the WPK's people-first politics, so that they can turn out popular goods.
Employees of the factories cut off the inauguration tape.
Kyongsong County, which has been famous for ceramics and hot springs from olden times, is changing beyond recognition every year under the loving care ofKim Jong Un, Kim Ki Dok, a worker at the Kyongsong Electric Appliances Plant, said, adding that he would devote all his loyalty and patriotic zeal to the grateful motherly Party translating into reality the long-cherished desire of the regional people.
A colorful performance was given to add to joy of the people in the county greeting the inauguration day. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Major Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- More than 80 youths in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered for theaters of socialist construction amid the surging spirit of young vanguard across the country out in a drive for implementing the important tasks set forth at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Tens of youths in the cities of Kaechon and Tokchon and in the counties of Pukchang and Mundok vowed to work at the youth shock brigades of coal mines.
Young people in the counties of Sukchon, Songchon and Unsan volunteered for the raw material bases in the counties, and those in Taedong County, Sunchon City and Maengsan County for the county construction brigade, highway maintenance team and ridgeway maintenance team.
A meeting for congratulating those who volunteered for the difficult and labor-consuming sectors took place in the city of Phyongsong on Jan. 12.
The volunteer certificates were conferred on those youths and congratulatory and other speeches made.
Officials and youth and students warmly saw off the volunteers leaving for their new revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: Patriotic Activities of Women in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- Women's union officials and members in the DPRK display their patriotism for the national prosperity, true to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Those in Kangwon and North Hwanghae provinces sent a large amount of quality manure to the Ogye Farm in Anbyon County and the Taechong Farm in Unpha County.
Women's union members at the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex provided the coal miners with working implements and supplies to encourage them to create new standards and records in production.
Women's union officials of the Forest Complex 121 conducted a powerful political work at timber felling stations to stir up the workers' confidence and optimism.
Women's union officials and members in Central District of Pyongyang, Tongrim County of North Phyongan Province, Musan County of North Hamgyong Province and Jasong County of Jagang Province sent inspiring letters to servicepersons to encourage them to glorify their military service with loyalty and feats.
Officials of South Phyongan and South Hamgyong provincial committees of the women's union visited baby homes and orphanages to take warm care of the children there enjoying the New Year. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the Rakwon General Machine Enterprise, a leading machine manufacturer of the country, the premier toured its oil-pressure device shop, heavy-machine building shop, Rakwon Oxygen Separator Factory and other parts to give a pep talk to officials, workers and technicians who have turned out in a campaign for increased production and economization in hearty response to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
He underscored the need for the officials to play the initiative, creative and positive role in implementing the Party's policies, mindful of the importance of their duty for developing the machine-building industry of the country, and more dynamically organize and direct the work to raise the productivity and quality of machine products.
He also called for steadily strengthening its own technical forces to improve the performance of equipment and enhance the accuracy in processing and assembling products and for raising the practicality and efficiency of the building of overall production lines and the system of their management and operation.
At the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill, the premier learned about the installation of new equipment and called for generalizing the successes and experience in the modernization of the mill to complete the project at an early date.
He stressed the need to resolve technical problems arising in improving the quality of paper by regarding the arousing of the workers' spiritual strength and science and technology as reserves for increased production and to improve the management of equipment and technical control so as to successfully fulfill the paper production plan for this year.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for relevant units to provide materials necessary for increased production in a responsible manner, the issue of lowering production costs by further enhancing the role of the April 15 technical innovation shock brigade and actively introducing advanced science and technology and the issue of directing steady efforts to the improvement of employees' working and living conditions. And the meetings took the necessary measures.
The premier also visited the headquarters of construction project for 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, which started the grand construction campaign for this year. At the headquarters, he stressed the need to step up in a farsighted way the preparations for inauguration of 10 000 flats at the third-stage in the Hwasong area, which has entered final stage, while examining whether there is any shortcoming in the project. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier from Lao PM
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Sonexay Siphandone, prime minister of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on Jan. 8.
In the message, the Lao prime minister extended warm congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his appointment as premier of the DPRK Cabinet at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Expressing belief that the bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation would steadily grow stronger on the basis of the long tradition of the friendly and cooperative relationship between the two countries, the message hoped that the bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation would continue to develop in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and the regional and global peace, stability, cooperation and development. -0-

headline: Noble Virtues and Traits of DPRK People
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people greeted the New Year of 2025 with warm affection of respecting and helping each other.
In the DPRK society, excellent virtues and traits are becoming noble character of the people and turning into social climate and national custom as days go by.
The excellent virtues and traits are the life of the DPRK people who have struggled under the slogan "Unite with Patriotism!"
It is the fragrance and charm of the people in our era to perform praiseworthy deeds and regard them as ordinary ones.
It is natural in our society to think and care for others first and the number of people who regard it as an example of their living is increasing with each passing day.
Among the heroes of virtues and traits are young people, women and even members of the Children's Union.
It is the nature peculiar to our society where all the people uphold the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas their own father of the great family to place the interests of the collective above one's own.
The noble traits of regarding other's trouble as one's own and helping each other to overcome difficulties with love and affection have become the soul of the people and the breathing of their life.
The virtues and traits displayed for the society and the collective are adding a great spur to the comprehensive prosperity of our great state and today's advance for the people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Emir of State of Kuwait
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Mishal Al Ahmad Al Jaber Al Sabah, emir of the State of Kuwait, on December 22, 2024.
In the message, the emir extended the sincerest congratulations and best wishes to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon the occasion of the new year 2025.
He hoped that the new year would be a year when peace and stability has settled for the whole of mankind and the well-being and prosperity of all the people in the world is realized.
He wishedKim Jong Ungood health, hoping that the good relations between the peoples of the two friendly countries would grow stronger. -0-

headline: Noble Virtues and Traits of DPRK People
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people greeted the New Year of 2025 with warm affection of respecting and helping each other.
In the DPRK society, excellent virtues and traits are becoming noble character of the people and turning into social climate and national custom as days go by.
The excellent virtues and traits are the life of the DPRK people who have struggled under the slogan "Unite with Patriotism!"
It is the fragrance and charm of the people in our era to perform praiseworthy deeds and regard them as ordinary ones.
It is natural in our society to think and care for others first and the number of people who regard it as an example of their living is increasing with each passing day.
Among the heroes of virtues and traits are young people, women and even members of the Children's Union.
It is the nature peculiar to our society where all the people uphold the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas their own father of the great family to place the interests of the collective above one's own.
The noble traits of regarding other's trouble as one's own and helping each other to overcome difficulties with love and affection have become the soul of the people and the breathing of their life.
The virtues and traits displayed for the society and the collective are adding a great spur to the comprehensive prosperity of our great state and today's advance for the people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Enlarged Plenary Meetings of Pyongyang Municipal and Provincial Committees of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- Enlarged plenary meetings of Pyongyang municipal and provincial committees of the Workers' Party of Korea took place to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee.
The meetings were guided by members of the Presidium and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee.
Present there were members and alternate members of the provincial committees of the WPK and, as observers, officials of Party and power organs and administrative and economic bodies in the relevant regions.
The meetings comprehensively analyzed and reviewed the work of the relevant regions for thoroughly implementing the important tasks set forth at the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee last year, and discussed and decided on the measures for correctly and perfectly carrying out this year's tasks on the basis of the orientation of struggle set forth at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
They analyzed and reviewed the successes and experience, made in the implementation of the Party decisions by the provincial Party committees last year, as well as the shortcomings and lessons.
They also referred in detail to the tasks and ways for the provincial Party committees to successfully attain the goals for the five-year plan by enhancing their functions and role in every way.
They stressed the importance of the issue for making the valuable results of the regional development policy, provided under the energetic guidance of the Party Central Committee, prove effective from the first year and, at the same time, pushing ahead with the implementation of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era including the rural housing construction.
The meetings discussed measures to fully satisfy the qualitative and quantitative demands for consumer goods badly needed for the people's living and consistently and substantially implement the socialist policy for the children and students by regarding it as the first task to put the production at regional-industry factories and enterprises on a normal track and improve the quality of products.
They stressed the need for all Party organizations to do their best to supply school things and supplies and equipment and materials for education, to dynamically push forward with the project for modernizing schools planned for this year, to improve the qualifications of educators and the quality of basic education, and to continue to increase the enthusiasm for supporting the educational sector, true to the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee to get the DPRK recognized as a country which gives the greatest importance to education and which is most advanced in education in the world.
They also indicated the ways for further improving the land and urban management and establishing a well-regulated crisis control system to definitely enhance the disaster prevention capability of relevant regions.
The meetings raised the principled matters that the provincial Party committees and Party organizations at all levels should adhere to in actively arousing the Party members and other working people to the implementation of the decisions of the Party Congress while expanding the valuable experience they gained in last year's struggle and strictly overcoming the deviations.
The plenary meeting of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK underscored the need for Pyongyang, the capital city of our dignified state, to create exemplary successes and excellent experience in all fields of politics, economy and culture and to make the Party members and other working people fulfill their duty as citizens of the capital city in splendidly glorifying the 80th birthday of the WPK and the 80th anniversary of national liberation as the grand political festivals of victory and glory.
The plenary meetings of South Phyongan and North and South Hamgyong provincial and Nampho municipal Party committees were held amid the revolutionary enthusiasm of the participants to concentrate all their efforts on attaining the important goals set forth at the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee so as to push forward with the comprehensive economic development and thoroughly carry out the readjustment and reinforcement plans and thus successfully implement the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK.
The plenary meetings of North and South Hwanghae provincial Party committees discussed in depth the issues of making good preparations for this year's farming, on the basis of scientific analysis of the successes, experience and lessons gained in last year's farming, doing all farm works on a more scientific basis and steadily increasing the agricultural workers' zeal for production and thus ensuring the Party's agricultural policy with increased grain production.
The plenary meeting of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK showed the strong desire to repay the loving care and benevolence with loyalty and patriotism and with dynamic creation and innovation, always cherishing the revolutionary struggle of 2024 to be specially recorded in the history of the WPK's people-first politics.
The plenary meetings of Jagang, Kangwon and Ryanggang provincial and Rason and Kaesong municipal committees of the WPK, too, indicated the ways of key importance in preserving regional features in the development of regional economy and bettering the people's living standards, true to the idea and spirit of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee.
Speeches were made at the plenary meetings.
At the plenary meetings, there were sectional consultative meetings to confirm the detailed goals for regions and units and work out plans for attaining them, on the basis of the important tasks and fighting strategy set forth at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
Adopted at the meetings with unanimous approval were decisions drawn up on the premise of the participants' strong enthusiasm to faithfully discharge their responsibility and duty in this year's crucial struggle for the successful fulfillment of the five-year plan and of clear practical guarantee. -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- More than 60 youths in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major theaters of socialist construction.
Young people in the city of Kusong and the counties of Kujang, Unsan and Ryongchon vowed to advance into the raw material stations, mindful of the noble intention of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unproviding regional-industry factories as the precious entities of the Workers' Party of Korea's people-first politics.
Members of the youth league in the city of Sinuiju and the counties of Yomju, Sonchon, Cholsan, and Chonma decided to work at farms, determined to increase the grain production with their creation and efforts at socialist fields.
With the desire to play a vanguard role in implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, those in the counties of Phihyon, Tongrim, Taegwan and Pakchon petitioned to work at county construction brigades.
A meeting was held at the North Phyongang Provincial Art Theater on Tuesday to congratulate those volunteers. Present there were Kim Chol Sam, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and young people.
Volunteer's certificates were awarded and a congratulatory address and speeches made.
Officials and young people presented bouquets and gave encouragement to the volunteers leaving for their new worksites to implement the Party's decisions. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:

Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on December 25, 2024.
In the message, the chairman extended the heartfelt congratulations on behalf of the C.C., Communist Party of the Russian Federation and on his own behalf to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon the occasion of the new year 2025.
He expressed belief that the new year would be a year when the friendly and comprehensive cooperation between the two parties, peoples and states grow stronger.

headline: Trade Union Organizations Conduct Brisk Motivational Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- Trade union organizations at all levels in the DPRK are conducting information and motivation activities to encourage workers and other trade union members to make a great stride forward in the first advance of the new year.
Officials of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea (GFTUK) have conducted a political work at the production sites of the Jagang Provincial Supply Coal Mine, the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, and encouraged the workers and trade union members to make innovations in the first production of this year while giving aid materials to them.
Those, who went to major industrial establishments in Pyongyang, conducted political work to arouse the workers and trade union members to implement the decisions of the plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. And members of the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the GFTUK conducted motivational activities at the housing construction sites in the Hwasong area and the Sangwon Cement Complex.
Officials of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the GFTUK went to the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex with many aid materials and explained and explained the ideas of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, implanting the loyalty and patriotism in the minds of coal miners.
Officials and primary information workers of the North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provincial committees of the GFTUK aroused the enthusiasm of the masses for struggle and patriotism through motivational activities at the Sinuiju Textile Mill and the February 8 Vinalon Complex.
Trade union organizations of provinces, ministries and national agencies conducted political information and motivational activities for increased production at major industrial establishments. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK direct efforts to strengthening the construction forces in cities and counties.
The cities of Sunchon and Anju have pushed ahead with the work to raise the technical knowledge and skills of workers in keeping with the progress made in securing necessary vehicles and construction equipment.
The cities of Phyongsong and Kaechon and the county of Sukchon have manufactured various efficient construction tools by introducing the proposals raised by builders.
Other regions of the province are securing construction equipment and tools. -0-

headline: Sokhwa Tideland Reclamation Completed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- The reclamation of the Sokhwa Tideland has been completed in the DPRK.
The reclamation was a huge project to build thousands of meter-long dykes from Sinmi-ri to Sokwa-ri, Sonchon County of North Phyongan Province.
Soldier-builders completed the project for building the emptying-gate in two months and the project for interval plugging only in ten days. -0-

headline: East Sea of Korea with Good Prospects for Offshore Farming
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- The Sinpho City Offshore Farm, a new model base of advanced offshore farming, was successfully built in the Phungo-dong area in the city of Sinpho, South Hamgyong Province, on the east coast of the DPRK in December last year.
In the east coast there are many areas favorable for offshore farming, including Sinpho City which had been famous as a leading city in fishing and Chongjin City of North Hamgyong Province and Anbyon County of Kangwon Province.
It is because the ecological environment of the East Sea of Korea including the quality, depth and temperature of water is suitable for living of marine animals and plants.
The conditions for offshore farming are good as the whole waters of the East Sea of Korea are clear, the water flow is good and the topography of seabed is relatively deep close to the coast.
As the content of nutrition and salt is high in the water areas as large and small rivers including the Tuman River are flowing there, sea cucumber, sea urchin, scallop, ear shell, kelp and seaweed can be selected as ones for farming.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid in his significant speech made in commemoration of the inauguration ceremony of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm that our seas are clean and their ecological conditions are very good, stressing the need to conduct aquatic farming and culture on a large scale in coastal areas by utilizing these favorable conditions. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Major Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- Young people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK volunteered for major theaters of socialist construction.
Those in Sinpho City advanced into the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, out of the mind to uphold the noble intention of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who is ushering in a new era of regional rejuvenation, with the praiseworthy successes in the seafood production.
Youth league members in the cities of Hamhung and Tanchon and the counties of Sinhung, Pukchong and Yonggwang petitioned to work at raw material bases of regional-industry factories, coal mines and construction brigades.
Those in the counties of Hamju, Riwon and Pujon volunteered for stockbreeding bases and road administration.
A ceremony for congratulating those who volunteered for difficult and labour-consuming sectors of socialist construction was held in the city of Hamhung on Jan. 15.
Present there were Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and young people. At the ceremony, volunteer certificates were conferred and a congratulatory speech and vowing speeches made.
Officials and young people presented bouquets to the volunteers and gave them a warm send-off. -0-

headline: Measures for Making Major Researches Taken in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- The State Commission of Science and Technology in the DPRK is taking positive measures to make major researches.
According to Minju Joson, the commission has provided a sci-tech guarantee for producing and supplying the major materials with domestic raw materials and has taken measures to provide conditions for carrying them out in keeping with the establishment of such major researches as the completion of Korean-style iron-making technology.
It has made in detail the stage-by-stage plans for the establishment of the technology for breeding and cultivating high-yielding spring-sown wheat and barley, the settlement of the technical problems arising in improving the quality of school uniforms, the domestic production of medicines and medicinal intermediates, the establishment of the production line of wheat flour improvement agent.
On this basis, they are establishing practical ways for successfully making the researches in contact with relevant institutions. -0-

headline: Scientific Research Activities Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- Universities across the DPRK are conducting scientific research activities in various fields of the national economy.
Research groups ofKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other universities are conducting scientific research activities in the metal, chemical, electric power, machine and coal industrial sectors.
Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering has sent research groups to machine factories in different parts of the country to conduct scientific researches for modernization and upgrading of technological lines.
Research groups of Han Tok Su University of Light Industry are concentrating efforts on carrying on the researches arising in improving the quality of products, upgrading technical processes and normalizing production at the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and foodstuff factories in different regions.
Research groups of Phyongsong University of Coal Mining are solving sci-tech problems arising in putting coal production on a normal footing and making a deep exploration at coal mines in Sunchon, Kaechon and Tukjang areas.
Research groups of Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering are conducting scientific researches to establish the C1 chemical industry and put fertilizer production on a normal track at major chemical industrial bases including Hungnam and Sunchon.
Members of research groups of agricultural universities across the country are active in the scientific farming promotion team, and research groups of major universities and provincial universities are conducting a campaign to achieve scientific and technological successes conducive to implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy. -0-

headline: Young People  in Kangwon Province Volunteer to Work at Difficult and Labour- consuming Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- More than 50 young people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK volunteered to work at difficult and labor-consuming worksites called by the Workers’ Party of Korea.
Young people in the counties of Kimhwa, Phyonggang and Thongchon volunteered to work at raw material stations, keeping pace with the sacred footsteps of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
Young people in the city of Wonsan and the counties of Sepho and Anbyon volunteered to work at construction brigades with a resolve to fully display the spirit and mettle peculiar to the Korean youth in their worthwhile patriotic drive for opening up a great new history of rural rejuvenation and regional development.
Young people in the counties of Changdo, Phangyo and Kumgang also volunteered to work at posts of managing ridge ways and roads.
At the meeting attended by Kim Song Chol, secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Kwang Chol, vice-chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials of the youth league, youth and students certificates were awarded to the volunteers and congratulatory addresses and speeches were made.
At the end of the meeting, a meeting with the young people performing labor feats at major construction sites took place.
Officials and young people warmly saw off the volunteers, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Friday issued the following press statement "We will contain the planned hostile military provocations and control the unstable regional situation with more thorough exercise of the right to self-defence":
From the outset of the year the U.S. and its satellites are getting evermore undisguised in their military provocations to pose a grave challenge to the security environment of the DPRK.
On January 6 and 9, the U.S. Air Force strategic reconnaissance planes flew over the Korean peninsula several times to perpetrate aerial espionage against the DPRK's strategic depth. On January 10, the 4th U.S.-ROK "nuclear consultative group" meeting was held in Washington to simulate a nuclear war drill on the Korean peninsula and an increase in the visibility of deploying U.S. strategic assets.
On Jan. 15, B-1B strategic bombers of the U.S. Air Force were deployed in the sky over the open sea near the Korean peninsula to conduct a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill. On the same day, the U.S. and ROK air forces staged the first air live-shell firing drill for this year.
The U.S. political and military provocations, witnessed day after day in the Korean peninsula where huge armed forces of warring countries are on high alert and the possibility of permanent military conflict is wandering, are the direct root cause of inciting the danger of armed conflict and disturbing the regional stability.
The U.S., which spent the end of last year through the largest-ever war drills, entered the new year with military provocations involving its satellite countries. This goes to prove that it is the U.S. which has brought instability to the region, and heralds this year's development of the military and political situation in the Korean peninsula with a dangerous tendency.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry expresses serious concern over the provocations of the U.S. and its allies that add another factor of instability to the very serious tension in the Korean peninsula, and clarifies once again that the DPRK's exercise of the right to self-defence to defend the sovereign rights and security interests of the state will be conducted more intensively.
The DPRK's access to a more overwhelming war deterrent aimed at countering the U.S.-led hostile states' military threat is an essential requirement for maintaining the balance of forces on the Korean peninsula and ensuring the security of the regional situation.
As already clarified, the DPRK will strongly deter any military provocation planned by the hostile forces and firmly defend the security interests of the state and the regional peace and stability by exercising more thoroughly and perfectly the right to self-defence, pursuant to its toughest counteraction strategy. -0-

story_text:

headline: Enlarged Plenary Meetings of Party Committees Held at Ministries and National Agencies of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- Enlarged plenary meetings of the Party committees at the Ministry of Railways, the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Pyongyang Construction Commission, the State Academy of Sciences, the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports were held to carry out the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were members and alternate members of the Party committees of those units and, as observers, officials concerned.
The plenary meetings analyzed and reviewed in detail the last year’s work for implementing the Party's decisions and seriously discussed the measures for perfectly carrying out the tasks facing each sector and unit this year on the basis of the important orientation of struggle set forth at the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee.
Reports were made at the plenary meetings.
The reporters stressed the need for all Party organizations and officials to enhance to the maximum their role as an organizer and executor in arousing the Party members and other working people to the struggle for implementing the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee and to push ahead with the successful implementation of the fighting programme of the WPK.
They indicated detailed tasks and ways for the Party organizations at all levels to defend the 80th birthday of the WPK and its 9th Congress with the successful fulfillment of the five-year-plan.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Railways stressed the need to concentrate the operation and guidance on fully meeting the demands of the national economy for transport by vigorously pushing ahead with the modernization of railways and waging a vigorous drive for increased transport capacity.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport discussed the measures to improve the capacity of harbor facilities and the performance of cargo ships and boost their operation and increase the capacity of transport by land.
The plenary meeting at the Pyongyang Construction Commission discussed the issue of vigorously conducting the Party's organizational and political work with the main emphasis put on completing major construction projects, taking a strong step to improve the quality of construction and modernizing, readjusting and reinforcing the production lines for building materials while realizing the diversification and home production of finishing building materials this year.
Discussed at the plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the State Academy of Sciences were the measures for scientists to turn out and preferentially settle the sci-tech problems badly necessary for various economic sectors.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Culture discussed the issues of intensifying the creation of masterpieces pulsating with the breath of the times and inspiring the masses and of briskly conducting the mass cultural and artistic activities and raising the level and skills of the guidance officials, creators and artistes.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports dealt with the issues for putting the country's sports development on a stage of upturn, including raising the scientification level of sports through strengthened Korean-style sports teaching and training and effectively conducting in various forms and methods the work for stirring up the enthusiasm for mass sports.
Speeches were made at the plenary meetings.
At the plenary meetings, there were sectional consultative meetings for drawing up action plans to thoroughly and perfectly implement the Party's policies facing the units, on the basis of the tasks set forth at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on U.S. Increase in Defence Budget
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The present world is more eager for peace and stability than ever before as it has witnessed ceaseless bloody massacres and wars.
But the desire of mankind is being trampled underfoot by the U.S., the worst war state.
Shortly ago, the U.S. adopted the "national defense authorization act for fiscal 2025" envisaging the largest-ever defence budget, an increase of 8.9 billion U.S. dollars over last year's.
No one in the world believes the U.S. poor explanation that it is for the "defence of its territory" and for "countering the hostile forces the world over".
The U.S. military spending accounts for 40 percent of the total world military expenditure and is larger than the military spending of ten countries in the next rankings all put together.
Its amount will be beyond imagination, if unannounced funds, which are spent in military affairs under various pretexts, are calculated in addition to the defence expenses publicly announced by the government.
It is worth noting that such frantic arms buildup is being made in the U.S., which is not a very rich country but a "state with the largest debt" that has reached more than $35 trillion in astronomical figures.
This is neither the spending for defence nor the money for the world peace.
The U.S. is spending military funds lavishly on inciting and carrying out war, conflicts, confusion and slaughter in different parts of the world, not on defending itself, as it did in the past.
Despite the denunciation and rejection at home and abroad, it has rendered huge military aid to the Israeli murderers and Ukrainian military gangsters year after year to prolong the wars and incite bloody killings. This is the reality.
The world clearly knows how many innocent children and other people are deprived of their lives, hope and living space by the U.S. lethal weapons and how much money the U.S. arms industries are making at the cost of their blood and pain.
The U.S. has ceaselessly deployed its ultra-modern military hardware and strategic assets in the Korean peninsula and other parts of Asia-Pacific, as well as in Europe and the Middle East, sparking off a vicious cycle of tensions and arms race.
The chaotic world and worldwide upheaval are the aftermath of the U.S. persistent arms buildup.
The U.S., which emerged and has existed through aggression and massacre, is desperately spending funds on the military field, despite its worst debt crisis ever in history, to gratify its ambition for dominating the whole world by upper-hand in strength and to retain its collapsing dominant position as the "only superpower" in the world.
It is as clear as noonday that such increased military spending for this year will be directed to further escalating the danger of military conflict in the Korean peninsula and the region when the fact that the U.S. is the most reactionary state entity regarding anti-communism as an invariable state policy is taken into account.
To cope with the outrageous moves of the U.S. challenging the desire of mankind for peace and bringing instability to the world, the DPRK will further step up the bolstering of the powerful military capability for self-defence, a basic guarantee for defending the people and sovereignty, and continue to achieve great successes this year, too. -0-

story_text:

headline: Press Statement of Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Friday issued the following press statement "We will contain the planned hostile military provocations and control the unstable regional situation with more thorough exercise of the right to self-defence":
From the outset of the year the U.S. and its satellites are getting evermore undisguised in their military provocations to pose a grave challenge to the security environment of the DPRK.
On January 6 and 9, the U.S. Air Force strategic reconnaissance planes flew over the Korean peninsula several times to perpetrate aerial espionage against the DPRK's strategic depth. On January 10, the 4th U.S.-ROK "nuclear consultative group" meeting was held in Washington to simulate a nuclear war drill on the Korean peninsula and an increase in the visibility of deploying U.S. strategic assets.
On Jan. 15, B-1B strategic bombers of the U.S. Air Force were deployed in the sky over the open sea near the Korean peninsula to conduct a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill. On the same day, the U.S. and ROK air forces staged the first air live-shell firing drill for this year.
The U.S. political and military provocations, witnessed day after day in the Korean peninsula where huge armed forces of warring countries are on high alert and the possibility of permanent military conflict is wandering, are the direct root cause of inciting the danger of armed conflict and disturbing the regional stability.
The U.S., which spent the end of last year through the largest-ever war drills, entered the new year with military provocations involving its satellite countries. This goes to prove that it is the U.S. which has brought instability to the region, and heralds this year's development of the military and political situation in the Korean peninsula with a dangerous tendency.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry expresses serious concern over the provocations of the U.S. and its allies that add another factor of instability to the very serious tension in the Korean peninsula, and clarifies once again that the DPRK's exercise of the right to self-defence to defend the sovereign rights and security interests of the state will be conducted more intensively.
The DPRK's access to a more overwhelming war deterrent aimed at countering the U.S.-led hostile states' military threat is an essential requirement for maintaining the balance of forces on the Korean peninsula and ensuring the security of the regional situation.
As already clarified, the DPRK will strongly deter any military provocation planned by the hostile forces and firmly defend the security interests of the state and the regional peace and stability by exercising more thoroughly and perfectly the right to self-defence, pursuant to its toughest counteraction strategy. -0-

headline: Regional-Industry Factories Inaugurated in Yonthan County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- Modern regional-industry factories have appeared in Yonthan County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, as an outcome of the warm love and devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who spares nothing for the people, and his great ideal and ambition and ardent desire for comprehensive national rejuvenation.
Their emergence in Yonthan County, a place abundant in resources for traditional medicines and well-known for lots of Aronia melanocarpa, helps the regional people enjoy a new life, keenly feeling again the advantages of the Korean-style socialist system in which all policies of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the state are being enforced for the promotion of people's well-being.
An inauguration ceremony of the factories took place on the spot on Jan. 16.
Present there were officials in North Hwanghae Province and Yonthan County, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, addressed the ceremony.
Noting that the comprehensive regional development was advanced as the most important political task of the Party and the state last year and its brilliant entities sprang up in the year, he stressed that they are a precious fruition of the noble love for the people and the great revolutionary leadership ofKim Jong Un, who set forth the grand action programme for regional development to provide the people with civilized and happy living conditions and has devoted himself to its implementation, visiting construction theaters across the country one after another.
Jon Nam Chol, chief secretary of the Yonthan County Committee of the WPK, in a speech expressed the will to ensure a full operation of the factories, built under the loving care of the Party, by making effective use of the natural and geographical advantages and resources peculiar to a mountainous county, and thus make the validity of the Party's policies and the inhabitants' affection for their region settle deep in their life.
The managers of those factories cut the inauguration tape amid the cheers and applause of the residents in the county.
Thousands of balloons rose up into the air, beautifully decorating the clear and blue sky over the township, and fireworks were set off one after another.
An art performance was given by the provincial art troupe to celebrate the inauguration of the factories.
After the ceremony the participants went round the modern factories.
That evening, there was a firework display in celebration of the inauguration of the factories. -0-

headline: More Young Korean People Volunteer to Work at Major Theaters of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The young people across the country are significantly greeting the founding anniversary of the Juche-oriented youth organization in the historic advance for glorifying 2025 as an eye-opening year of  great turn. They are filled with the firm determination to fully display the wisdom and courage of the patriotic youth through world-startling miracles and innovations once again.
Young people in different parts of the country including South and North Phyongan provinces and South Hamgyong Province have volunteered to work at major theaters of socialist construction in the new year, true to the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. Their good deeds are a manifestation of the noble mental world of the rising generation who always responds to the call of the Party with practice and the mettle and a proud tradition of a large contingent of young people.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who has the noble intention and will to complete to the end the Korean revolution which started and has advanced through the youth movement, trained the young people to be reliable reserves of the Party and solid pillars supporting the socialist country.
With his great loving care and trust in them as their lifeline, the young people have built many monuments to their feats in all parts of the country through vigorous struggle with vigor and passion.
In response to the Party's call for successfully building the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station as a grand monument to our youth till the 70th founding anniversary of the Party, the members of the youth shock brigade carried out in more than 120 days the huge tasks equivalent to those they had done in ten years, creating the spirit of the Paektusan hero youth and the legendary tale of heroic youth.
When MarshalKim Jong Unindicated the path towards a new victory of the revolution at the historic Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the young people across the country turned out as one in the grand advance for making a breakthrough in implementing the new five-year plan and advanced to the posts for the prosperity and development of the country and the well-being of the people, following the advance indicated by the Party Central Committee.
This year, too, more patriotic young people have volunteered to work at the posts called by the country to support the Party's new policy on regional development with perfect practice.
The reliable and proud appearance of the large contingent of young people defending the Party and the revolution adds great strength to the general onward march for dynamically opening up a broad avenue to overall national prosperity. -0-

Tele-reeducation Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Grand People's Study House in the DPRK promotes the tele-reeducation for strengthening the technical forces of regional-industry factories.
The study house is now remodeling various tele-reeducation subjects to offer more knowledge and techniques necessary for cities and counties in most effectively developing and utilizing their regional economic resources and potentials.
In cooperation with officials concerned, it is pushing ahead in a planned way the work to enlist scientists, technicians and field officials of many regional-industry factories across the country in the tele-reeducation system.
Meanwhile, it is working out various teaching programs and multimedia programs on such subjects as the cultivation of sugar crop, the sugar production technology, the sea fish farming and culture, the seafood processing technology and the service for tourism.
It is also directing its efforts to the project for developing and introducing a comprehensive information service system to build up advanced sci-tech data bases of various fields including agricultural production, stockbreeding and fishery in conformity with the regional features of cities and counties. -0-

headline: Vol. 63 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
Enlarged Plenary Meetings of Party Committees Held at Ministries and National Agencies of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- Enlarged plenary meetings of the Party committees at the Ministry of Railways, the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Pyongyang Construction Commission, the State Academy of Sciences, the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports were held to carry out the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were members and alternate members of the Party committees of those units and, as observers, officials concerned.
The plenary meetings analyzed and reviewed in detail the last year’s work for implementing the Party's decisions and seriously discussed the measures for perfectly carrying out the tasks facing each sector and unit this year on the basis of the important orientation of struggle set forth at the plenary meeting of the WPK Central Committee.
Reports were made at the plenary meetings.
The reporters stressed the need for all Party organizations and officials to enhance to the maximum their role as an organizer and executor in arousing the Party members and other working people to the struggle for implementing the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee and to push ahead with the successful implementation of the fighting programme of the WPK.
They indicated detailed tasks and ways for the Party organizations at all levels to defend the 80th birthday of the WPK and its 9th Congress with the successful fulfillment of the five-year-plan.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Railways stressed the need to concentrate the operation and guidance on fully meeting the demands of the national economy for transport by vigorously pushing ahead with the modernization of railways and waging a vigorous drive for increased transport capacity.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport discussed the measures to improve the capacity of harbor facilities and the performance of cargo ships and boost their operation and increase the capacity of transport by land.
The plenary meeting at the Pyongyang Construction Commission discussed the issue of vigorously conducting the Party's organizational and political work with the main emphasis put on completing major construction projects, taking a strong step to improve the quality of construction and modernizing, readjusting and reinforcing the production lines for building materials while realizing the diversification and home production of finishing building materials this year.
Discussed at the plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the State Academy of Sciences were the measures for scientists to turn out and preferentially settle the sci-tech problems badly necessary for various economic sectors.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Culture discussed the issues of intensifying the creation of masterpieces pulsating with the breath of the times and inspiring the masses and of briskly conducting the mass cultural and artistic activities and raising the level and skills of the guidance officials, creators and artistes.
The plenary meeting of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports dealt with the issues for putting the country's sports development on a stage of upturn, including raising the scientification level of sports through strengthened Korean-style sports teaching and training and effectively conducting in various forms and methods the work for stirring up the enthusiasm for mass sports.
Speeches were made at the plenary meetings.
At the plenary meetings, there were sectional consultative meetings for drawing up action plans to thoroughly and perfectly implement the Party's policies facing the units, on the basis of the tasks set forth at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 18 (KCNA) -- More than 300 youths in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major theaters of socialist construction.
With their strong will to translate into a brilliant reality the cherished desire of the Workers' Party of Korea which spares nothing for the well-being of the people, 240 young people vowed to work at the grand socialist construction sites.
Youths in various cities and counties including Hoeryong City and Myongchon and Musan counties decided to advance into coal and other mines, out of the mind to carry forward the tradition of young pioneers of the preceding generations.
Those in Orang, Kyongsong and other counties advanced into construction brigades, road management stations and farms.
Many young people in the province, including Chongjin and Kim Chaek cities and Kyongwon, Hwadae and Yonsa counties, made their mind to work at raw material base stations.
Among them are youth league members and university graduates petitioning to work at the management office for the revolutionary battle sites in the area of the Paektusan Secret Camp, newly-built regional-industry factories and the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm.
Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, youth league officials and youth and students took part in a meeting held on Friday to congratulate and encourage the volunteers. -0-

headline: Art Performance Given to Mark Anniversary of SPYL
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 18 (KCNA) -- The art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in the DPRK gave a performance "Country and Youth" at the Central Youth Hall on Friday to mark the 79th founding anniversary of the SPYL.
Among the audience were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Mun Chol, chairman of the SPYL Central Committee, officials of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang.
Put on the performance stage were colorful numbers reflecting the proud history of the Juche-oriented youth movement, which has been developed under the leadership of the WPK, and the noble spiritual world of patriotic youths who have dynamically advanced the country in the annals of the revolution.
The performers well represented the boundless pride and honor of glorifying their worthwhile life as successors to the revolution and masters of the times under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who put forward the young people as the vanguard in building a powerful country and has shown deep trust and love for them.
The strong stamina of the young vanguard, who will perform fresh miracles and feats at every worksite for a great upsurge in socialist construction, bearing deep in mind the idea and spirit of the historic Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee, was fully demonstrated through male quartet "We Are Koreans" and other numbers.
Also put on the stage full of youthful stamina and enthusiasm was the song "Song about Country" reflecting the ardent desire and will of the rising generation to glorify their beloved motherland with their whole soul.
The performance ended with a chorus "National Anthem of DPRK". -0-
