headline: Press Statement Issued by Chief of Foreign News Section of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Foreign News Section of the Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on Sunday issued a press statement titled "The U.S. and the ROK will never evade the responsibility for the aggravation of regional situation to be entailed by an  increase in the visibility of military provocations", which said:
Recently, the U.S. and the ROK are staging serious military provocations aiming at the DPRK one after another, adding a danger variable to the unstable security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region.
The U.S. and the ROK staged Ssangmae joint air drill in the Wonju air force base on January 21-24 under the pretext of increasing the capability for cooperation between the two sides in air operations.
Earlier, the hostile forces staged a large joint firing drill aimed at "early eradication" of the long-range artillery fire system of the DPRK on January 14-16, and the U.S. Department of Defense made public a decision on a large-scale weapon sale to the ROK on January 22.
After raising the first curtain this year with the start of the U.S.-Japan-ROK three-party joint air drill with strategic bombers involved, the U.S. and the ROK are staging various war drills targeting the DPRK every day. This is a grave challenge to ensuring peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the region.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry is closely watching the military provocations of the U.S. and the ROK escalating the tension on the Korean peninsula and seriously warns them that such moves will entail a reflective counteraction.
The security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region is becoming ever more critical because the U.S. seeks the advantage of strength through the ceaseless expansion of the military alliance system and the enforcement of joint military drills of various kinds.
The reality stresses that the DPRK should counter the U.S. with the toughest counteraction from A to Z as long as it refuses the sovereignty, security and interests of the DPRK and this is the best option for dealing with the U.S.
The DPRK will not permit the imbalance of strength imposed by the military nexus between the U.S. and the ROK and take the toughest counteraction to defend the sovereign right, security and interests of the state and thoroughly ensure peace and stability in the region.
The U.S. and the ROK will never evade the responsibility for the aggravation of the regional situation to be entailed by the increase in the visibility of their military nexus and provocations. -0-

headline: Modern Regional-industry Factories Built in Usi County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The people in Usi County, Jagang Province of the DPRK, too, have greeted the start of a new, richer and happier socialist life, along with the news of ceaseless completion of regional-industry factories across the country that proudly inform the whole world of the first fruition of the implementation of the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The outstanding guidance of the great Party Central Committee provided an auspicious event to the county people who had eagerly waited for the completion of new wonderful factories from the start of their construction.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories took place in Usi County on January 25.
Present there were officials and working people in Jagang Province and Usi County, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the provincial Party committee, said at the ceremony that the regional development policy reflecting the noble idea of the great Party Central Committee, which regards the people as Heaven, is ushering in a new era of radical changes in the country.
The wonderful edifices showing the dynamic regional development are unthinkable apart from the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has the noble outlook on life of making selfless sincerity for the happiness of the beloved people, he noted.
Kang Myong Song, chief secretary of the Usi County Committee of the WPK, in his speech expressed the determination to become a standard-bearer and model in applying the popular character of the WPK and its people-first politics and turn the county associated with the leadership exploits of the Party into a people's paradise good to live in and work.
The owners of the new factories cut an inauguration tape, with their high pride and honor of entering the ideal socialist village before others amid the warm blessings of the benevolent father though they are in a mountainous area.
Beautiful fireworks were displayed and balloons flew up to add to the delight of the completion, decorating the sky of the celebration.
An art performance reflecting the worthwhile life of the county people and a cheerful dancing party were displayed to stir up the festive mood.
The participants went round the factories wonderfully built to ensure modernity, civilization and utility. -0-

headline: Triplets Discharged from Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The 556th triplets, born at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in the DPRK, were discharged from the hospital amid the blessing of people.
The mother of the triplets (two sons and one daughter) is Cha Sol Gyong living in the township of Kosan County, Kangwon Province and their father is Kim Chung Hyok, a worker of the Kosan County Evodia daniellii Benn Forest Station.
Cha Sol Gyong was sent to the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital last year to get the best medical assistance under the socialist healthcare system.
Medical workers of the hospital helped her to give birth to triplets safely by holding several consultative meetings and taking scientific treatment measures.
The triplets weighed 1.9 kg, 2.0 kg and 2.2 kg respectively at birth.
Thanks to the sincerity of doctors and nurses, the triplets weigh more than 4 kilograms at present.
The triplets and their parents leaving the hospital in good health were seen off by doctors and nurses. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Test of Important Weapon System Conducted
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted a test-fire of sea (underwater)-to-surface strategic cruise guided weapons on January 25.
The test was conducted as a link in the whole chain of efforts for carrying out the plan for building up the defence capability of the country, aimed at improving the effectiveness of the strategic deterrence against the potential enemies in conformity with the changing regional security environment.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the test-fire of the weapon system.
He was accompanied by Full General Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK.
The launched strategic cruise missiles precisely hit the targets after traveling 1 500km-long elliptical and 8-shaped flight orbits for 7 507-7 511 seconds.
The test-fire had no negative impact on the security of the neighbouring countries.
Noting that the means of war deterrence of the armed forces of the DPRK are being perfected more thoroughly,Kim Jong Unaffirmed that the DPRK will always make strenuous efforts in a responsible manner to perform its important mission and duty for defending durable and lasting peace and stability on the basis of more powerfully developed military muscle in the future. -0-

Officials, working people and schoolchildren in Kaechon City and Kujang County warmly greeted and encouraged the expedition members.
The expedition members visited the Soson Hostel, the Tokgol Revolutionary Site, etc., to deeply grasp the glorious revolutionary history and undying feats of the peerlessly great men.
During a break of their march, they conducted diverse political and cultural work, including study ofKim Il Sung's reminiscences "With the Century" and a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas.
They entered Hyangsan Township on January 24, flying the flag of expedition in front of the ranks. Officials, working people and schoolchildren in Hyangsan County welcomed them.
They laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statue ofKim Il Sungin Hyangsan Township and paid tribute to him.
They left the township on January 25 to continue the march. -0-

headline: Modern Regional-industry Factories Built in Usi County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The people in Usi County, Jagang Province of the DPRK, too, have greeted the start of a new, richer and happier socialist life, along with the news of ceaseless completion of regional-industry factories across the country that proudly inform the whole world of the first fruition of the implementation of the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The outstanding guidance of the great Party Central Committee provided an auspicious event to the county people who had eagerly waited for the completion of new wonderful factories from the start of their construction.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories took place in Usi County on January 25.
Present there were officials and working people in Jagang Province and Usi County, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the provincial Party committee, said at the ceremony that the regional development policy reflecting the noble idea of the great Party Central Committee, which regards the people as Heaven, is ushering in a new era of radical changes in the country.
The wonderful edifices showing the dynamic regional development are unthinkable apart from the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has the noble outlook on life of making selfless sincerity for the happiness of the beloved people, he noted.
Kang Myong Song, chief secretary of the Usi County Committee of the WPK, in his speech expressed the determination to become a standard-bearer and model in applying the popular character of the WPK and its people-first politics and turn the county associated with the leadership exploits of the Party into a people's paradise good to live in and work.
The owners of the new factories cut an inauguration tape, with their high pride and honor of entering the ideal socialist village before others amid the warm blessings of the benevolent father though they are in a mountainous area.
Beautiful fireworks were displayed and balloons flew up to add to the delight of the completion, decorating the sky of the celebration.
An art performance reflecting the worthwhile life of the county people and a cheerful dancing party were displayed to stir up the festive mood.
The participants went round the factories wonderfully built to ensure modernity, civilization and utility. -0-

headline: Press Statement Issued by Chief of Foreign News Section of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 26 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Foreign News Section of the Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on Sunday issued a press statement titled "The U.S. and the ROK will never evade the responsibility for the aggravation of regional situation to be entailed by an  increase in the visibility of military provocations", which said:
Recently, the U.S. and the ROK are staging serious military provocations aiming at the DPRK one after another, adding a danger variable to the unstable security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region.
The U.S. and the ROK staged Ssangmae joint air drill in the Wonju air force base on January 21-24 under the pretext of increasing the capability for cooperation between the two sides in air operations.
Earlier, the hostile forces staged a large joint firing drill aimed at "early eradication" of the long-range artillery fire system of the DPRK on January 14-16, and the U.S. Department of Defense made public a decision on a large-scale weapon sale to the ROK on January 22.
After raising the first curtain this year with the start of the U.S.-Japan-ROK three-party joint air drill with strategic bombers involved, the U.S. and the ROK are staging various war drills targeting the DPRK every day. This is a grave challenge to ensuring peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the region.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry is closely watching the military provocations of the U.S. and the ROK escalating the tension on the Korean peninsula and seriously warns them that such moves will entail a reflective counteraction.
The security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region is becoming ever more critical because the U.S. seeks the advantage of strength through the ceaseless expansion of the military alliance system and the enforcement of joint military drills of various kinds.
The reality stresses that the DPRK should counter the U.S. with the toughest counteraction from A to Z as long as it refuses the sovereignty, security and interests of the DPRK and this is the best option for dealing with the U.S.
The DPRK will not permit the imbalance of strength imposed by the military nexus between the U.S. and the ROK and take the toughest counteraction to defend the sovereign right, security and interests of the state and thoroughly ensure peace and stability in the region.
The U.S. and the ROK will never evade the responsibility for the aggravation of the regional situation to be entailed by the increase in the visibility of their military nexus and provocations. -0-

headline: Funeral Service for Late Hwang Jin Yong Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 27 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of bidding farewell to the late Hwang Jin Yong, winner ofKim Il SungPrize, labor hero and People's Artist, took place at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri on Jan. 26.
Hwang Jin Yong grew up to be a gifted composer and musical talent loved by the people under the special care of the peerlessly great men. He had created hundreds of songs praising the great Workers' Party of Korea, the most advantageous socialist system of the DPRK and the spirit of the times vibrant with the creation of a new life as national famous songs for nearly 40 years, thus greatly contributing to the development of the Juche-oriented musical art.
Present at the ceremony were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials in the field of culture and art, creators and artistes and the bereaved family members.
Jang Ryong Sik, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a condolatory address.
He expressed condolences over the death of Hwang Jin Yong, a veteran composer who represented the era of the Juche-oriented music development, saying that all the people without reference to age and sex in this country, moved by his creative talent and enthusiastic about the powerful, attractive and emotional melodies peculiar to his works, are grieving about his death.
Every song, composed by Hwang, has been played at construction sites, factories, farms and fishing villages across the country and become a companion of life favored by everyone as they are famous songs giving deep impression to the people, the speaker noted, adding that the staunch image of the composer, who had devoted his burning zeal and thought to the musical creation, will remain as a model revolutionary artiste in the memory of the people and rising generations.
A ceremony of burying the remains of the late Hwang Jin Yong took place.
A wreath from the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid at the grave.
The participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the late Hwang who had enjoyed the life of an enthusiastic and talented musician, remaining faithful to the Party his whole life.
The traces of his worthwhile and beautiful life and echoes of his heart will be everlasting, along with the ceaseless development of the Juche-oriented music which encourages the dynamic advance of the socialist country ushering in a heyday of fresh cultural efflorescence under the leadership of the great WPK and gives enthusiasm for the revolution, optimism and pride and joy of struggle to the people. -0-

headline: Steps Taken in DPRK against High Risk of Forest Fire
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 27 (KCNA) -- Kim Sung Hyok, head of an office of the Forest Guidance Bureau under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in the DPRK, gave an answer to the question raised by KCNA as regards the recent weather feature and the preventive measure against any possible forest fire.
He said:
This winter, the atmospheric humidity is getting low and the weather is getting dry with decrease in the total precipitation.
It is expected that the risk of forest fire will increase in the future, due to such abnormal weather.
In order to prevent any possible forest fire, officials in provinces, cities and counties should intensify education among the inhabitants and woodcutters in their regions and enhance the forest rangers' sense of responsibility to prevent any practice of violating the established rules and orders for entry into mountains.
It is needed to set up fixed observation posts on the spots favorable for monitoring the overall forests including special protection forests, reinforce the mobile observation posts and ensure in an effective way the establishment of a regular forest fire monitoring system and the normal operation of surveillance cameras.
In particular, it is more important to further enhance the sense of responsibility and role of anti-forest fire combined guidance teams, allocate competent officials to the anti-forest fire sections and keep the forest fire information system in good order.
Industrial establishments should increase the number of forest fire rangers and forest rangers in forests in their charge to take a preliminary step against any possible forest fire, and conduct the repair and maintenance of fire-belts, stone barriers and catch basins in a substantial way before the period of danger of forest fire.
It is necessary to reinforce the fire brigades, fully arrange the vehicles and fire extinguishing equipment and make thorough preparations for putting out fire at once in case of the outbreak of forest fire.
He stressed the need to have regular access to the forest-fire monitoring information service system and intensively display watchwords related to the anti-forest fire work and the notice phone numbers on roadsides along the forest or roads to and from forests. -0-

headline: National Dish on Lunar New Year's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 27 (KCNA) -- Roast meat is one of the peculiar national dishes the people in the DPRK would like to have on the Lunar New Year's Day.
This tasty and nutritious dish is one of the three famous foods in the country
The restaurant of the Pothongmun Street Fish and Meat Shop in the center of Pyongyang is famous for roast meat. Its cooks would say that, to preserve peculiar taste and smell of roast meat, it is needed to cut meat thinly and season it with Welsh onion, garlic, sesame oil, black pepper, liquor and pear juice.
The Korean steak cooking method was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2015.
Restaurants specializing in roast meat and other catering establishments across the country are now busy with the preparations for better service to the people on the occasion of the Lunar New Year's Day (January 29). -0-

headline: Drive for Increased Cement Production Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 27 (KCNA) -- Cement producers in the DPRK are intensifying a drive for increased production to supply enough cement for this year's huge construction projects.
With their determination to attain this year's production goal, set higher than last year's, ahead of the schedule, workers and technicians of the Sunchon Cement Complex are striving to renew the already-made high production speed.
The Chonnaeri Cement Factory established a floating calcination system superior to the existing production method and launched a socialist emulation to carry out its daily quota 1.2 times on an average.
The same is true of other cement factories across the country. -0-

headline: Number of Young Volunteers Grows in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 27 (KCNA) -- The patriotic tradition of young people in the DPRK, who set coordinates of their life and translate their ideals into reality at those workplaces called by the Party, is being given steady continuity in the advance for this year.
More than 60 youths in Nampho Municipality have volunteered for outposts of socialist construction.
Those in Onchon County and Chollima and Taean districts advanced into to regional-industry factories and raw material base stations.
Youth league members in Waudo and Kangso districts and Ryonggang County petitioned to work at construction brigades and the Kumsong Tractor Factory.
Young people in Hanggu District and graduate students of Nampho University of Education vowed to work at stockbreeding bases and branch schools on remote islets.
A meeting took place at the Nampho Municipal Art Theatre on Jan. 26 to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were Choe Yong, secretary of the Nampho Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and youths. Volunteer certificates were conferred on the volunteers and speeches, including a congratulatory address, were made.
After the meeting, a congratulatory performance was given.
Officials and young people saw off the volunteers leaving for their new posts. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Creating New Standards and Records in Each Economic Sector and Unit
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 28 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun on Tuesday says in an editorial that today's worthwhile struggle for victoriously concluding the final year for the implementation of the Five-Year Plan and bringing about an upward trend towards a higher development stage requires all sectors and units to intensify the movement for creating new standards and records.
It is the revolutionary spirit and the working mettle peculiar to our people to steadily challenge new things, transcend the limitation and continuously create new standards and records, the editorial says, adding:
The movement for creating new standards and records is a mass innovation movement to produce and build more, faster and better with less manpower and materials and existing equipment by giving the fullest play to the revolutionary enthusiasm and creative ingenuity of the masses in production and construction.
When time goes by with rapid progress and innovation at each worksite of socialist construction and new standards and records are created everywhere, our Party's plan and decision to usher in a new era of overall national prosperity will be translated into wonderful fruition.
Now, the torch of miraculous increased production, held aloft by the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex on an outpost for grand socialist construction, has spread like a prairie fire to the whole country so as to remarkably inspire the enthusiasm for revolution, struggle and patriotic efforts among the masses out in the implementation of the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
It is the ardent desire of all the people to defend the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and its congress and make great transformation and vigorous advance in all aspects of socialist construction by courageously braving the hardships and difficulties through fresh innovations, bold creation and steady advance and continuously creating new standards and records to successfully carry out the Five-Year Plan.
Let us all perform eye-opening miracles and proud feats in the ongoing general advance for successfully attaining the goals set forth by the Eighth Party Congress and surely guaranteeing the transition of new development stage, the upward stage through the intensified movement to create new standards and records. -0-

headline: Haksadae, Scenic Sea Spot
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 28 (KCNA) -- Haksadae, a scenic spot, is on the seashore of Haksadae-ri, Riwon County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
The spot consisting of rocks, moss-covered cliffs and trees in harmony with sea reminds one of Sea Kumgang.
The rocks and cliffs with different shapes there are formed with granite cut and washed by sea for many years. In particular, one hundred-ton granite rock moves with waves and a sandy beach came into being on the seashore, adding beauty to the natural scenery.
There are rocks submerged in sea water and marine plants like seaweed and kelp are distributed on them according to depth of the sea water. Sea urchins, sea cucumbers, octopus and others are seen in clear water. They are reminiscent of natural aquarium.
Sunrise from the rock mountains is very spectacular.
Modernly-built resorts are located in different parts of Haksadae with a section of about one kilometer.
On the seashore before the resorts, angling sites and various facilities for body building are provided to delight the visitors. -0-

headline: Great Man's Happiness
story_text:
One day in May 1991, PresidentKim Il Sungcame to return to the then Kumsusan Assembly Hall ahead of schedule after giving field guidance at local areas.
When he arrived at the hall, a road pavement project was going on in its compound. The President called an official to account for having launched the project though he instructed not to repave the road.
The official replied that it was the unanimous desire of all the people in the country to provide smooth roads for the President's field guidance and that if they knew about the broken compound road in the hall, they would reprove officials.
The President said that his pleasure was not in that work, but in the happiness of the people and he would go along even rough roads with pleasure every day, if it is for the wellbeing of the people.
He stressed that he would regard any pains for the people's happiness as his great pleasure, saying that whenever he saw people feel inconvenience in their life, his mind was very heavy and he didn't want to get on his car, so he used to visit farms on foot to make the people be better off, though he was old.
Indeed, the President had spent days and months with love and devotion to the people while making ceaseless journey for their wellbeing, regarding it as his motto to believe in them as in Heaven. -0-

story_text:

headline: Production Line Associated with Love for People
story_text:
One day in January 2018, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory.
While going round its various parts, he stopped before tablet-compressing machine No. 1 at the drug shop, from which tablets were dropping into containers.
Watching them carefully, he told officials that big tablets might be broken to pieces, so their effectiveness would be different according to the size.
In fact, tablets were rarely broken as the height from the machine to containers was about one meter. The automatic adjustment for the height of containers could prevent such phenomenon at once, but officials of the factory were only keen on fulfilling the production plan, neglecting this problem.
The General Secretary said that the production line of the factory should be well designed to ensure hygienic condition as required by standard technical processes related to the production of medicines, stressing it is needed to design a closed streamlined process well and arrange machines in keeping with it.
The officials were moved by the noble intention of the General Secretary being careful about the people's health over even a small tablet. -0-

headline: Haksadae, Scenic Sea Spot
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 28 (KCNA) -- Haksadae, a scenic spot, is on the seashore of Haksadae-ri, Riwon County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
The spot consisting of rocks, moss-covered cliffs and trees in harmony with sea reminds one of Sea Kumgang.
The rocks and cliffs with different shapes there are formed with granite cut and washed by sea for many years. In particular, one hundred-ton granite rock moves with waves and a sandy beach came into being on the seashore, adding beauty to the natural scenery.
There are rocks submerged in sea water and marine plants like seaweed and kelp are distributed on them according to depth of the sea water. Sea urchins, sea cucumbers, octopus and others are seen in clear water. They are reminiscent of natural aquarium.
Sunrise from the rock mountains is very spectacular.
Modernly-built resorts are located in different parts of Haksadae with a section of about one kilometer.
On the seashore before the resorts, angling sites and various facilities for body building are provided to delight the visitors. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Creating New Standards and Records in Each Economic Sector and Unit
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 28 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun on Tuesday says in an editorial that today's worthwhile struggle for victoriously concluding the final year for the implementation of the Five-Year Plan and bringing about an upward trend towards a higher development stage requires all sectors and units to intensify the movement for creating new standards and records.
It is the revolutionary spirit and the working mettle peculiar to our people to steadily challenge new things, transcend the limitation and continuously create new standards and records, the editorial says, adding:
The movement for creating new standards and records is a mass innovation movement to produce and build more, faster and better with less manpower and materials and existing equipment by giving the fullest play to the revolutionary enthusiasm and creative ingenuity of the masses in production and construction.
When time goes by with rapid progress and innovation at each worksite of socialist construction and new standards and records are created everywhere, our Party's plan and decision to usher in a new era of overall national prosperity will be translated into wonderful fruition.
Now, the torch of miraculous increased production, held aloft by the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex on an outpost for grand socialist construction, has spread like a prairie fire to the whole country so as to remarkably inspire the enthusiasm for revolution, struggle and patriotic efforts among the masses out in the implementation of the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
It is the ardent desire of all the people to defend the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and its congress and make great transformation and vigorous advance in all aspects of socialist construction by courageously braving the hardships and difficulties through fresh innovations, bold creation and steady advance and continuously creating new standards and records to successfully carry out the Five-Year Plan.
Let us all perform eye-opening miracles and proud feats in the ongoing general advance for successfully attaining the goals set forth by the Eighth Party Congress and surely guaranteeing the transition of new development stage, the upward stage through the intensified movement to create new standards and records. -0-

headline: Many Women in North Phyongan Province Volunteer to Work in Urban Management Field
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) -- Many members of the women's union in Sinuiju City and Uiju County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK petitioned their organizations to work in the field of urban management.

headline: Custom of Korean People on Lunar New Year's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) -- The Lunar New Year’s Day is the first day of the new year according to the lunar calendar. The Korean people have significantly celebrated the lunar New Year's Day in accordance with the custom.
The event of the Lunar New Year’s Day began at dawn on the first day of the first lunar month. There were ancestor-memorial service, formal bow of respect to the elders, Lunar New Year’s dishes treatment, folk plays, etc.
The Korean people, who have respected and paid high tribute to the elders, performed a New Year's bow to the elders of the families and villages, relatives and teachers early in the morning of the Lunar New Year’s Day.
They prepared glutinous rice-cake, steamed rice-cake, fancy rice-cake, pancake, fruit punch, sweet rice drink, roast and fruits as the dishes of the Lunar New Year’s Day. In particular, rice dumpling soup was regarded as the main dish for the day.
On the Lunar New Year's day, people played various folk plays including yut-game, seesawing, kite-flying, sleighing and pinwheel play.
Yut-game is a typical folk play loved by all people. Fine yut sticks throwing, wonderful and witty moving pieces, happy laughter of people added to the atmosphere of the Lunar New Year's Day.
The custom of the Lunar New Year's Day is being carried forward and developed under the leadership and benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which values and adds lustre to our things. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Thanks from Members of Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of thanks from the participants in the meeting for the report on returning from the homeland of the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who received the best solicitude of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unon Jan. 24.
The letter said that they held the meeting at a time when the Korean community in Japan was filled with joy and gratitude to the benevolence of the respected Marshal who bestowed the parental love to the children of Koreans in Japan who took part in the New Year performance for 2025.
It extended the greatest glory and warmest thanks toKim Jong Unwho kindly embraced the members of the art troupe with a sunny smile and showed the parental love and solicitude for them and personally extended New Year greetings to the officials of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and compatriots in Japan, reflecting the boundless reverence and loyalty of all Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan.
It stressed that they are deeply regarding the best solicitude shown byKim Jong Unfor the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan as the honor and happiness of all the officials of Chongryon and compatriots and as the fortune and privilege that can be enjoyed only by Chongryon and Koreans in Japan who hold him in high esteem as their leader even though they live in an alien land.
It said that they are full of ardent determination to convey forever the highest and greatest solicitude the members of the art troupe received to be recorded in the history of Chongryon and national education and repay the solicitude with loyalty, filial piety single mind and, bearing in mind the noble idea and intention of MarshalKim Jong Unand invariably cherishing the patriotic mind following the country no matter how difficult the circumstance in an alien land may be.
It wholeheartedly wishedKim Jong Un, the great sun of Juche Korea and benevolent father of Korean compatriots and Korean schoolchildren in Japan, good health. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Nuclear-material Production Base and Nuclear Weapons Institute
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, inspected the nuclear-material production base and the Nuclear Weapons Institute.
He was accompanied by Hong Sung Mu, first deputy department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and leading officials in the relevant field.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unhighly praised scientists, technicians, workers and officials in the field of nuclear weapons production for achieving remarkable successes in the new long-term projects while putting spurs to the fighting task which the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK additionally assigned to the field related to the nuclear forces after the nuclear-material production field, the Nuclear Weapons Institute and other relevant field registered amazing production results in 2024.
Looking round the core processes for producing weapons-grade nuclear materials, he learned in detail about the present production of nuclear materials, the long-term plan and the 2025 plan of the Nuclear Weapons Institute.
Noting that the struggle in 2025 is very important as the five-year tasks the Eighth Congress of the WPK assigned to the fields of nuclear weapons research and production should be perfectly carried out, he said that this year is a crucial year as it is an important watershed in which we should carry out the tasks in the important period in the course of implementing the line of bolstering up the nuclear forces, a line which has been propelled by the WPK and the DPRK government, and switch over to the fulfillment of the next duty. He underlined the need to further raise the present surging spirit and thus to achieve epochal successes in overfulfilling the plan for producing weapons-grade nuclear materials and in strengthening the nuclear shield of the country.
Noting that the nuclear technical forces of the DPRK growing stronger day by day and the results made by them are a symbol of the incomparable self-respect and valiant spirit of our Party, state and people, he affirmed that guaranteeing peace and security by dint of strength is our mode of struggle and option that are most righteous and an immutable truth.
The external situation facing the DPRK remains grave and the challenges of the hostile forces to take the predominance of strength are becoming ever more pronounced, he said, adding that the absolute force capable of thoroughly containing the enemies and taking the initiative to control the situation is not provided by any declaration or slogan, but the stockpiling of the physical strength of practical use and its increase by geometrical progression.
The DPRK’s security situation, the world's most unstable situation in which a long-term confrontation with the most vicious hostile countries is inevitable, makes it indispensable for the country to steadily strengthen the nuclear shield capable of strategically coping with not only the various existing threats but also new prospective security dangers and at the same time reliably guaranteeing the sovereignty, interests and development right of the state, as we should bear the responsibility for not only the present but also the future of the country, he said. And he said that everything should be subordinated to enhancing the prestige of the state and defending its interests and that it is our firm political and military stand and invariable noble task and duty to develop the state's nuclear counteraction posture indefinitely.
He expressed expectation that all the nuclear experts of the DPRK would bear in mind the invariable view of the state, courageously turn out in the sacred struggle to highly develop the self-defensive nuclear war deterrent gained at the dear cost and push forward with the building up of the overwhelming nuclear strategic capability of the DPRK with brilliant increased production.
His inspection serves as an occasion that gave great encouragement to all the nuclear scientific and technological forces of the DPRK standing in the vanguard of the struggle for bolstering up the national defence capabilities. -0-

headline: Meeting Held in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) – A meeting for the report on returning from the homeland of members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who received the best solicitude of the respected MarshalKim Jong Untook place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on January 24.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organizational Department Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Education Department Song Kun Hak of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Principal of Kyoto Korean Middle and High School Mun Pong Su who is the head of the art troupe, and other officials, teachers and students.
The participants watched a film dealing with the news of revolutionary activities ofKim Jong Un"The respected ComradeKim Jong UnMet Members of Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan". They also watched a video showing the dance story "We grow under the national flag of the Republic" presented by the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan to the New Year performance for 2025.
Then the members of the art troupe sang in chorus the song of loyalty, filial devotion and single mind "We will follow Marshal only" that they had sung before the respected Marshal.
Ho Jong Man made an address at the meeting.
He stressed the need to bear in mind the noble idea and intention ofKim Jong Unwho had reposed the highest glory and great trust that can never be compared with anything. He expressed his will to make great progress in the national education this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of Chongryon, bearing in mindKim Jong Un's instruction to bring up the students to be true pillars of carrying forward the patriotic cause of Chongryon.
Mun Pong Su in his report on returning called for surely preserving the national education opened by GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand developed by GeneralissimoKim Jong Iland adding shine to the worthy life on the sacred patriotic road of ushering in a brilliant heyday of national education, true to the noble idea and intention ofKim Jong Un.
Then followed speeches.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas read out at the meeting. -0-

headline: Report on 30th Enlarged Meeting of Secretariat of Eighth Central Committee of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) -- The 30th Enlarged Meeting of the Secretariat of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea was held at the headquarters of the Party Central Committee on January 27.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, guided the meeting.
Present there were members of the Secretariat of the Party Central Committee and, as observers, chief secretaries of the provincial, city and county Party committees and Party committees of the complexes, leading officials of the Party committees of ministries and national agencies, and department directors and first deputy department directors of the Party Central Committee and relevant officials of its Organizational Leadership Department, Information and Publicity Department and Discipline Inspection Department.
The WPK has written the longest history in the world as a socialist ruling party in the sacred course of accomplishing the most just mission and realizing the far-reaching ideals, shouldering the destiny of the country and the people. Its mightiness and invincibility have been guaranteed through the struggle for firmly defending the immaculate political climate and discipline system peculiar to it and perfectly applying the people-first political ideals.
At the present time, the Party Central Committee set forth the idea and line of building discipline on administering and strengthening the Party by dint of a strict discipline system, established a powerful discipline inspection system throughout the Party and laid down the rules of work and the action guidelines calling on all the Party organizations and officials to work and live in a revolutionary way based on their high political consciousness.
The Secretariat of the Party Central Committee convened the meeting of leading officials of the whole Party in connection with the occurrence of serious cases of gravely infringing upon the dignity, rights and interests of the people while wantonly violating Party discipline and exercising negative privileges in Onchon County of Nampho Municipality and Usi County of Jagang Province.
The Party Central Committee stressed that the enlarged meeting of the Secretariat was convened to further consolidate the Party’s political climate and revolutionary position, taking serious note of the violation of Party discipline and anti-people acts going against the requirements of the times when the entire Party and all the people have turned out in the implementation of the decisions of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee as a top-priority problem to be urgently settled.
At the enlarged meeting, there were first a briefing on data gathered by the Organizational Leadership Department of the Party Central Committee through a survey and a report on data by the Discipline Inspection Department of the Party Central Committee as regards the violation of Party discipline by leading cadres of the Onchon County Party Committee of Nampho Municipality and the county who gave rise to a mega case of totally denying Party discipline and perpetrating wrongdoings in group.
Severely exposed were the wrong deeds of officials in Onchon County, who openly denied the idea and intention of the Party Central Committee to firmly guarantee the existence and development of the Party by dint of discipline by establishing a strict discipline-observance habit and iron discipline in the entire Party, and its harmfulness and gravity.
Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Organizational Leadership Department of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Jae Ryong, director of the Discipline Inspection Department, said in the briefing and report:
Today when we are faced with the unprecedentedly huge struggle tasks of completely implementing the decisions of the Eighth Party Congress and opening up a new phase towards a higher development stage in this significant year of the 80th founding anniversary of the Party, our officials have to fulfill the heavy task of carrying out their mission and duty as the core of the Party and the faithful servants of the people by displaying vigorous courage, exertion and devotion more than ever before in the vanguard of the revolution.
But, on the contrary to such demand of the Party and the highly charged revolutionary atmosphere, Onchon County made poor preparations for a plenary meeting of the county Party committee for implementing the decisions of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee and held the meeting in a grossly formalistic way. After that, there occurred the mega case, in which more than 40 officials, including Party officials, committed wrongdoing in group.
This is an act of flagrant violation of Party discipline that demands leading Party officials at all levels should not lead an indolent and careless life like being treated to drinking bouts at public service facilities. The leading official of the county Party committee personally organized the irregularities and dozens of leading Party and administrative officials in the county, including officials of the county Party committee, flocked together to commit such irregularities. It was a reckless act unheard-of in the history of our Party.
The group drinking spree openly committed in Onchon County is an act utterly contrary to the Party's line on building discipline, and this clearly proves that the ringleader of the case and those involved are a corrupt group and impudent rabble with no elementary qualifications as leading cadres.
The respected General Secretary made an important speech.
In the speech he said:
These are the days when revolutionary moral discipline should be established in a thoroughgoing way in the Party, Party officials, its leading cadres in particular, should strictly observe the rules of life and activities, and its internal discipline should be further strengthened than ever before. The serious case that occurred in Onchon County in this period is regarded as a grave crime of violating Party discipline and moral and cultural order and an open denial of our Party’s line of building discipline.
Had there not been discipline in defending the firm unity of the revolutionary ranks and the strict political and moral discipline in and uncompromising struggle for establishing the leadership system of the Party Central Committee and defending the organizational and ideological unity of the whole Party, there would not have been the Party’s glorious ruling history of 80 years nor today when its inheritance and innovation are being designed. It is useful for and beneficial to the revolution to boldly recognize such a grave deviation in the Party and to deal with it as an especially serious case in time.
Making a critical analysis of the ideological origin and gravity of the malpractices committed against the Party’s intentions by officials, who should be more faithful to their duties than anyone else as persons in direct charge of regional development in the crucial period when the whole Party is paying close attention to strengthening cities and counties and new innovative projects in regions are being carried on one after another or planned, he pointed out that these malpractices are not only a serious case that could undermine the foundations for strengthening our Party and make the county, occupying one-two hundredth of the country’s territory, a non-Party, non-political and non-socialist region, but also a dangerous signal which directly indicates that a privileged social stratum, seeking more special favours than the people by abusing their authority, may be formed.
He criticized that although all sorts of alien and heterogeneous ideological elements undermining the sound Party climate and obstructing the advance of the revolution, the political and moral crimes undermining Party discipline, occurred in the given region, it shows that the work of qualitative consolidation of cadre ranks, to which we have attached special importance and directed efforts for Party building in the new era, has not been conducted in a substantial way.
Giving the Party Central Committee’s estimation that there is little improvement in the style of work and the spirit of observing discipline although there seems to be a change in them outwardly, he stressed that the conclusion drawn from this is that however revolutionary and perfect the line of Party building is, it would only remain a theory for theory’s sake if the cadres were not ideologically prepared and failed to make efforts to implement it absolutely and unconditionally.
Noting that the current meeting marked an occasion for making a practical review and reaffirmation of the need to put greater efforts into establishing proper Party discipline at the beginning of 2025, the year that marks the 80th anniversary of the founding of our Party, he said that the meeting would constitute a turning point in further consolidating the Party consciousness, political awareness, revolutionary spirit and we-serve-the-people spirit of the officials who make up the core and leading forces of the Party, and in making substantial progress in strengthening the ranks of cadres and in building up the Party.
The core, central task in the new course of Party building is the transformation of cadres along revolutionary lines as well, he said, adding that the solution to this end is to conduct more intensive education, training and struggle across the Party. He specified the principles and ways for launching a dynamic organizational and ideological offensive throughout the Party to consolidate its sound political climate.
He emphasized that the main target of the discipline inspection sector should be practices of corruption within the Party and all other violations of its discipline to be proactively and aggressively contained, practices that the Party despises most, reiterating the need to “aim at, pursue, search and wipe out” such malpractices on the basis of strict regulations and rules.
He said that this year should be set as a year for establishing a revolutionary Party climate and strengthening the whole Party, in order to dynamically open up a new stage of building a ruling party that is strong in discipline and full of a revolutionary climate. He stressed the necessity of waging a resolute struggle for the eternal development of the Workers’ Party of Korea and for the accomplishment of the sacred revolutionary cause.
The Secretariat of the WPK Central Committee, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the “Rules of the Workers’ Party of Korea”, decided and instructed to dissolve the Onchon County Party Committee of Nampho Municipality, which seriously damaged our Party’s revolutionary trait and hindered the single-hearted unity of the Party and the revolutionary ranks by committing a wrong deed in group in wanton violation of Party discipline, and announced a strict proposal for dealing with those involved in the extra-large case related to the violation of Party discipline.
Then, the Enlarged Meeting of the Secretariat of the Party Central Committee dealt with the serious anti-people crimes committed in Usi County of Jagang Province.
He sternly pointed out the fact that the Usi county agricultural inspection organ, which is duty bound to monitor and regulate in an exclusive and responsible manner the implementation of the Party’s policy on rural construction and its agricultural policy, flagrantly encroached upon the interests and property of the people by abusing the legal power, instead of orienting its work to checking major illegal practices latent in the agricultural sector and establishing a well-regulated order and discipline.
Noting that those who abuse their power and work in a bureaucratic manner in local areas are attempting to destroy the sacred fortress of unity between the Party and the people without batting an eye, he stated that this is a mega crime which can never be pardoned by our Party, our people, our system and our legal power.
At the meeting there was a report on data about the mega crime perpetrated by inspectors of the Usi county agricultural inspection organ.
Those inspectors unhesitatingly committed an unpardonable crime of inflicting sufferings on regional inhabitants and misappropriating their property at random by abusing the inviolable legal power.
Very grave is the criminal act that seriously undermined the single-hearted unity of the Party and the people, the mainstay of the revolution and our lifeblood, by challenging the people-first politics of our Party which orients all affairs of the revolution and construction to the protection of the rights and interests of the people and makes selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people.
The Secretariat of the Party Central Committee announced a strict proposal to dissolve the Usi county agricultural inspection organ and organize a new one and to deal with the chief secretary of the Usi County Party Committee, who fostered and connived at the anti-people acts, and the inspectors of the county agricultural inspection organ.
The ringleaders and those involved in the hideous criminal case will be put under investigation by law.
The meeting proved that the practices of corroding the sound moral traits of the Party, hindering the strengthened discipline throughout the Party and encroaching upon the rights and interests of the people which our Party regards as the most sacred, contrary to the original ideals and spirit of the Party, are being thoroughly repelled.
The 30th Enlarged Meeting of the Secretariat of the Eighth WPK Central Committee highlighted once again the immutable truth that the eternal vitality of the struggling and advancing Party lies on the iron discipline. And it serves as a political occasion of great significance in further clarifying the original features and character of the WPK which maintains the people-first principle as its mode of existence and its trait and in increasing its militant might in every way. -0-

headline: Custom of Korean People on Lunar New Year's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 29 (KCNA) -- The Lunar New Year’s Day is the first day of the new year according to the lunar calendar. The Korean people have significantly celebrated the lunar New Year's Day in accordance with the custom.
The event of the Lunar New Year’s Day began at dawn on the first day of the first lunar month. There were ancestor-memorial service, formal bow of respect to the elders, Lunar New Year’s dishes treatment, folk plays, etc.
The Korean people, who have respected and paid high tribute to the elders, performed a New Year's bow to the elders of the families and villages, relatives and teachers early in the morning of the Lunar New Year’s Day.
They prepared glutinous rice-cake, steamed rice-cake, fancy rice-cake, pancake, fruit punch, sweet rice drink, roast and fruits as the dishes of the Lunar New Year’s Day. In particular, rice dumpling soup was regarded as the main dish for the day.
On the Lunar New Year's day, people played various folk plays including yut-game, seesawing, kite-flying, sleighing and pinwheel play.
Yut-game is a typical folk play loved by all people. Fine yut sticks throwing, wonderful and witty moving pieces, happy laughter of people added to the atmosphere of the Lunar New Year's Day.
The custom of the Lunar New Year's Day is being carried forward and developed under the leadership and benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which values and adds lustre to our things. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 30 (KCNA) -- An open-air ice rink in the center of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, was decorated in a peculiar way as the venue for an art performance in celebration of the lunar New Year's Day.
The performance venue was filled with joy of the people greeting the holiday at an exciting time when they are decorating the first page of 2025, to be specially recorded in the history of the DPRK's growth and development, with auspicious events unprecedented in the nation-building history.

The performers showed beautiful dance rhythms and elegant and refined skills to the emotional melodies reminding one of the worthwhile course covered with the country, and to the tune of cheerful music instilling confidence in the bright future.
The cheerful serial folk songs, which resounded in the night sky of Pyongyang in harmony with the spectacular figure skating and ice dance and acrobatics, revved up the festive atmosphere and delighted the audience.
The performance reached its climax with songs "Dear Father" and "We Are the Happiest in the World" representing the honor and happiness of the Korean people leading a happy life in the big socialist family, the world's most powerful country guided by the peerlessly great leader.

headline: Yangdok Songi Mushroom, Specialty of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 30 (KCNA) -- Among the regional specialties in the DPRK is Yangdok Songi mushroom (Tricholoma matsutake) growing in South Phyongan Province.
85 percent of the Yangdok area in the province consists of forests, and the forests are mainly covered with old pine trees suitable for the growth of Songi mushroom.
The Songi mushroom starts to come out from 15-16 year-old pine, especially from 40-60 year-old pine in the main.
The surface of this mushroom is pale yellow brown or dark brown and covered with fibrous scales. Its cap is 8-20 centimeters in diameter. It has white flesh with a peculiar aroma.
This nutritious mushroom is efficacious for treating various diseases like cancer.
Recorded in historical documents compiled in the 15th and 16th centuries is the mushroom as one of the famous specialties in Yangdok area. -0-

Various experimental simulation programs, developed by the academy, have been disseminated to all parts of the country, proving their effects. Such smart programs enable students to choose experimental apparatus and reagents freely and conduct any of experiments reflected in the educational program as they create an experimental environment.

The experiment simulation programs effective in enhancing the students' practical abilities are popular throughout the country. -0-

Pyongyang, January 30 (KCNA) -- Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children of the DPRK paid floral tribute to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin different parts of the country on the occasion of the lunar New Year's Day.
Placed at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were floral baskets, together with bouquets, in the name of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in the capital city of Pyongyang.
The visitors paid high tribute to the peerlessly great men, deeply recollecting the immortal exploits of the President and the Chairman who had devoted their all to making the time-honored history and culture of the Korean nation shine more brilliantly before the world.
Floral baskets in the name of institutions, enterprises, units of the KPA and the PSF and others were laid before the statues of the great leaders atKim Il SungUniversity, the Ministry of National Defence, the Mansudae Art Studio and other places in Pyongyang.
Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children across the country visited the statues of the great leaders in their residential areas to pay high tribute to them. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Brisk among Agricultural Workers in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 30 (KCNA) -- Organizations of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) at all levels are conducting a mass movement.
The South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the UAWK worked out a socialist emulation programme for effecting collective innovations in the farming preparations and sent it to city and county committees of the union and has made a strict demand for implementing it.
The North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the UAWK has organized the work to generalize the experience of advanced units in a methodical way.
The South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the UAWK organized a socialist emulation among agricultural workers and has conducted the work to create examples and generalize them in a substantial way so as to achieve greater successes in improving the fertility of soil.
UAWK organizations in Pyongyang and Nampho municipalities, South Phyongan and North Hamgyong provinces and other parts of the country, too, have conducted a socialist emulation for farming preparations. -0-

headline: Achievements Made at Academy of Pedagogical Science in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 30 (KCNA) -- The Academy of Pedagogical Science in the DPRK is striving to improve the intellectual and practical abilities of schoolchildren.
Various experimental simulation programs, developed by the academy, have been disseminated to all parts of the country, proving their effects. Among them are the physical experiment simulation program, the chemical experiment simulation program, the biological experiment simulation program and the natural experiment simulation program that help students be practiced in the whole course of experiment including handling of experimental apparatus in a virtual environment before real experiment.
Such smart programs enable students to choose experimental apparatus and reagents freely and conduct any of experiments reflected in the educational program as they create an experimental environment.
Through such simulation experiments, students can consolidate their knowledge while conducting experimental operation proficiently in real experiment time.
The experiment simulation programs effective in enhancing the students' practical abilities are popular throughout the country. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to General Secretary of C.C., CPV and Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, and Luong Cong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on January 31.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations on behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea, the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the people of the DPRK to the Communist Party of Vietnam, the government of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and the Vietnamese people on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
The parties and the governments of the two countries set this year as a year of friendship. This conforms to the common aspiration and desire of the peoples of the two countries to develop the friendly and cooperative relations which were forged and consolidated in the joint struggle for socialism onto a new, higher stage.
I am pleased to declare this year marking the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries as a year of friendship, and express my belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Vietnam with a long history and tradition will steadily develop and thus powerfully encourage and propel the cause of socialist construction in the two countries and the struggle of the world people aspiring after independence and justice.
I wish you good health and success in your responsible work to lead the party and the state and the friendly Vietnamese people well-being and prosperity. -0-

headline: Fertilizer Production Goes up in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- Innovations have been made at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in the DPRK.
The complexes registered good production results in 20 days from the outset of this year, carrying out their daily plans at 113 percent.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex has introduced tens of technical innovation proposals conducive to increased fertilizer production.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex is raising the operation rate of equipment and the extraction rate of products by observing the technical rules and standard regulations. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Luong Cong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on January 22.
In the message the Vietnamese president extended the warmest congratulations on behalf of the state and people of Vietnam and on his own behalf to the respected Comrade
Kim Jong Unand, through him, to the state and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Vietnam and the DPRK.
The message said that the two countries have traditional relations of friendship.
The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea became one of the three countries that established diplomatic relations with the then Democratic Republic of Vietnam, the Socialist Republic of Vietnam today, on January 31, 1950, 75 years ago.
The traditional relations of friendship cultivated by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sungand the leaders of several generations and peoples of the two countries with much effort have steadily developed in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries and in favor of peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world, the message noted.
The message said that the Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to the cooperative relations with the DPRK and hope that these relations will accelerate more powerful and substantial development in many fields in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries and commitment of each country to the international community and peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world.
It noted that he is pleased to declare withKim Jong Unthe start of the year 2025 of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK.
On this basis, all ministries and related sectors of the two countries will launch and accelerate various significant activities to mark and celebrate the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations.
It noted that he will make joint efforts withKim Jong Unto maintain regular exchange of views in the future and contribute to the development of the Vietnam-DPRK relations and he hopes the efforts will bring substantial interests to the states and peoples of the two countries, and he is ready to do so.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I wish you good health and hope that the DPRK will develop and be prosperous with each passing day under your leadership, the message said.
The president in the message hoped that the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK would continue to grow stronger. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories Inaugurated in Kusong City of DPRK
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from Vietnamese Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory letter from To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, on January 31.
In the message the general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam extended warm congratulations on behalf of the party, state and people of Vietnam toKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, and the party, state and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries (January 31, 1950-January 31, 2025).
The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea is one of the countries with which the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (the Socialist Republic of Vietnam today) established diplomatic relations before others, the message said.
It noted that in the past course spanning 75 years since the establishment of diplomatic relations, the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK, which were personally provided by President Ho Chi Minh and President
Kim Il Sungand had been cultivated by the leaders of several generations of the two countries with much effort, have made steady progress.
It said that the top-level visits between the two sides contributed to laying a solid foundation for the bilateral relations and in particular, the official goodwill visit to Vietnam in March 2019 paid by General SecretaryKim Jong Unserved as an important and significant historic landmark as it confirmed the strategic orientation of the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries and left very beautiful and excellent traces of friendship between the two parties and the two countries.
It said that Vietnam has maintained its external line to become a reliable friend and partner and an active and responsible member of the international community while making its external line and relations of independence, sovereignty, peace, friendship, cooperation and development multilateral and diverse on its own initiative and actively despite the complicated and rapid changes of the global and regional situation.
It noted that the Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to the traditional relations of friendship with the party, government and people of the DPRK and always value the support and solidarity given by the Korean comrades to the cause of national liberation, state building and national defence in Vietnam.
The party, state and people of Vietnam have always observed with care the successes made by the party, government and people of the DPRK in all aspects in recent years, including the work to prevent and control epidemic diseases, overcome the aftermath of natural disasters, develop the economy and society and improve the people's living standard, and sincerely congratulate them.
Such successes are associated with the will and determination of the Korean comrades to implement the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea.
We are convinced that the Korean people will victoriously attain the goals for socialist economic construction on reliance of self-development, development of a prosperous state and improvement of the people's standard of living under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
We are making every effort to, together with you, steadily cultivate and develop the traditional relations of friendship between the two parties and two countries in conformity with the bilateral interests and peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world, the message said.
The message expressed firm belief that under the meticulous care and guidance of the leaders of the two parties and two countries, both sides will mark a new milestone in the course of the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK by holding celebrations for the year 2025 of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK jointly and successfully through significant exchanges and cooperative activities.
It extended warm greetings to General SecretaryKim Jong Unon the occasion of the spring of 2025, wishing him good health, happiness and success.
The general secretary in the message wished the party, state and people of the DPRK fresh and greater successes in accomplishing the cause of socialist construction. -0-

headline: Agricultural Technical Course Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK held a technical course for disseminating the agricultural sci-tech successes and experience gained in high-yielding farming last year under the sponsorship of the scientific farming promotion team.
Present there were members of the scientific farming promotion team and officials from the agricultural guidance organs across the country and units of city and county raw materials bases.
The course gave more than 30 lectures dealing with advanced farming technologies and technical characteristics and using methods of portable measuring equipment and showed various multimedia programs dealing with high-yield farming experience.
The scientific farming promotion team selected as lecturers the able scientists and researchers and put great effort on making lecture plans and multimedia programs to make the advanced farming technology and methods dealt in the course effective in increasing grain production.
The technical course marked an important occasion in ensuring the grain production this year by dint of science and technology. -0-

The complexes registered good production results in 20 days from the outset of this year, carrying out their daily plans at 113 percent.

headline: Forestry Sector in DPRK Fulfills Plan for January
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- The forestry sector of the DPRK fulfilled its January plan for timber production ahead of schedule.
Forestry and mine timber production stations of the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau stood in the vanguard of increased production drive. In particular, officials and workers of Paekam and Yonam mine timber production stations have over-fulfilled their daily timber production plans by introducing efficient working methods and raising the operation rate of equipment like motor saw.
Those of Kangwon, Jagang and South Hamgyong provincial forestry management bureaus boosted the timber production by concentrating manpower on the felling places.
Those of North and South Phyongan and North Hamgyong provincial forestry management bureaus, too, have produced much more timber than planned every day. -0-

headline: General Bureau of Tanchon Area Mining Industry Strives for Increased Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry in the DPRK have turned out in a drive for attaining their goals for this year.
The Komdok Mining Complex is directing efforts to ensuring the smooth operation of equipment to increase the mineral production.
The Kumgol Mine has striven to register good mining results with high enthusiasm to add luster to the honor of the 1 00 000-ton Mining Platoon of Loyalty and 1 000-meter Tunneling Platoon of Loyalty this year, too.
The Taehung Youth Hero Mine has increased ore production by ensuring the full operation of mining and transport equipment and improving the technical condition of equipment in the crushing system. It has also pushed ahead with the work to boost the production of quality clinker by the two-stage calcination method.
Ryongyang and Paekbawi mines are concentrating efforts on the massive mining of high-grade ores while ensuring the output and backflow of ores by focusing on technical management of heavy machines.
Officials and workers of the Tanchon Smeltery, the Tanchon Magnesia Factory, the Tanchon Mining Machine Factory and the Songjin Fireproof Material Factory, too, are registering successes in carrying out their economic tasks. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- It has been 45 years since the inauguration of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in the DPRK.
In the period, the hospital has helped many women to give birth to children safely, including more than 790 triplets and quadruplets, and turned into a comprehensive medical service center for women and a scientific research base equipped with modern medical facilities.
ChairmanKim Jong Il, who took a measure to build the hospital into the best one in the world, sent a letter of thanks to its health workers on January 31, 1990 in high appreciation of the achievements made by them in medical service for nearly 10 years after its opening.
He gave instructions for the development of the hospital in even in the last moments of his revolutionary life.
His great loving care for the women is being carried forward by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The General Secretary repeatedly bestowed favors on the pregnant women with many children and women delivered of children to ensure that they enjoy better benefits from the state and led the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital to play its role as a medical service center for women.
The hospital has a new and modern medical service base capable of preventing and treating breast diseases and conducting scientific research on them. This base is also associated with the efforts and devotion of the General Secretary for the women. -0-
