headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Luong Cong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on January 22.
In the message the Vietnamese president extended the warmest congratulations on behalf of the state and people of Vietnam and on his own behalf to the respected Comrade
Kim Jong Unand, through him, to the state and people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Vietnam and the DPRK.
The message said that the two countries have traditional relations of friendship.
The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea became one of the three countries that established diplomatic relations with the then Democratic Republic of Vietnam, the Socialist Republic of Vietnam today, on January 31, 1950, 75 years ago.
The traditional relations of friendship cultivated by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sungand the leaders of several generations and peoples of the two countries with much effort have steadily developed in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries and in favor of peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world, the message noted.
The message said that the Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to the cooperative relations with the DPRK and hope that these relations will accelerate more powerful and substantial development in many fields in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries and commitment of each country to the international community and peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world.
It noted that he is pleased to declare withKim Jong Unthe start of the year 2025 of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK.
On this basis, all ministries and related sectors of the two countries will launch and accelerate various significant activities to mark and celebrate the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations.
It noted that he will make joint efforts withKim Jong Unto maintain regular exchange of views in the future and contribute to the development of the Vietnam-DPRK relations and he hopes the efforts will bring substantial interests to the states and peoples of the two countries, and he is ready to do so.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I wish you good health and hope that the DPRK will develop and be prosperous with each passing day under your leadership, the message said.
The president in the message hoped that the traditional relations of friendship between Vietnam and the DPRK would continue to grow stronger. -0-

headline: Forestry Sector in DPRK Fulfills Plan for January
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 31 (KCNA) -- The forestry sector of the DPRK fulfilled its January plan for timber production ahead of schedule.
Forestry and mine timber production stations of the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau stood in the vanguard of increased production drive. In particular, officials and workers of Paekam and Yonam mine timber production stations have over-fulfilled their daily timber production plans by introducing efficient working methods and raising the operation rate of equipment like motor saw.
Those of Kangwon, Jagang and South Hamgyong provincial forestry management bureaus boosted the timber production by concentrating manpower on the felling places.

headline: Regional-Industry Factories Inaugurated in Orang County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 1 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories have been successfully built in Orang County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
They include a modern seafood processing factory capable of producing tens of kinds of tasty marine products by making use of economic conditions of coastal area, a foodstuff factory and a daily necessities factory.
Their successful construction provides a solid foundation for steadily improving the residents' living standards.
The people of Orang County splendidly celebrated the inauguration of the regional-industry factories on Jan. 31.
Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, addressed the ceremony.
The eye-opening reality of the new era is a clear demonstration of the steadfast will and unshakable executive power of the WPK to make the capital envious of regions, to make regional rejuvenation represent the progress and development of the country and to make the ideal appearance of regions a true picture of Korean-style socialism, he stressed.
Noting that when the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Orangchon Power Station No. 5 in July 2018 despite the midsummer heat, he called for undertaking fish farming and aquaculture well by making good use of the sea and lake and indicated the detailed tasks and ways for doing farming and improving the people's living in the county, the speaker stressed that today the General Secretary has provided the residents in the county with new modernly-equipped factories.
This grand inauguration ceremony is the first declaration of victory for bringing earlier the future of great transformation, in which the people's dreams and ideals come true, and a springboard for new struggle and advance toward further development, he said.
Kim Chol Ho, chief secretary of the Orang County Committee of the WPK, made a speech.
He expressed the resolve to ensure that the regional-industry factories produce famous goods and products favored by the people to make the regional people fully enjoy the benefits of the Party.
The owners of the new factories cut off the tape for inauguration.
Then the participants went round the newly-built regional-industry factories.
A performance was given and fireworks were displayed in the sky over Orang County to celebrate the inauguration of the factories. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren on Tour of 250-mile Journey Arrive in Kanggye
story_text:

headline: Moral Treasure of DPRK People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- The fighting spirit and traits of the preceding generations who worked miracles and innovations, overcoming the grim difficulties facing the revolution, are the moral treasure to be followed by all the people and glorified generation after generation.
The DPRK people have recorded the proud history of development of the Republic, working world-startling miracles one after another from the outset of nation building up to now, the era of building a great power, including the periods of postwar reconstruction, the great Chollima upswing.
In the latter half of the 1950s, the workers of the then Kangson Steel Plant produced 120 000 tons of steel billets with a blooming mill with a capacity of 60 000 tons, and the smelters of the then Kim Chaek Iron Works produced 270 000 tons of pig iron with a blast furnace with a capacity of 190 000 tons.
In the same period, the workers of the then Ryongsong Machine Factory manufactured eight-meter turning lathe and 3 000-ton press, the workers and technicians of the then Rakwon General Machine Enterprise "Chollima" excavator and the large water pump "Rakwon 1", the workers of the then Kiyang Machine Factory "Chollima" tractor and those of the then Tokchon Automobile Plant "Sungni-58 " truck.
The builders of the capital city created the miraculous speed of building more than 20 000 flats with materials, funds and labor force for 7 000 flats only in one year even though it was said that such construction would take three or four years.  They also created the Pyongyang Speed of assembling a flat within 14 minutes.
The preceding generations have made miraculous successes in the all-people drive for increased production, knowing no such word as impossible on the road of realizing the intention of the leader and of achieving the prosperity and development of the country.
Still now, the DPRK people have dynamically advanced, full of enthusiasm to bring earlier the new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation by following the fighting spirit and traits of the preceding generations. -0-

headline: Myongsasimni, Scenic Spot of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- There is Myongsasimni, the height of the coastal scenic spot in the Kalma peninsula of the East Sea of Korea.
Myongsasimni means the ten-ri white beach (four kilometers) of the Kalma peninsula.
The white beach is a coast sandy beach sedimentary stratum in the Quaternary of the Cenozoic Era.
The main mineral constituents of the coast sandy beach are quartz, feldspar, mica, etc.
The scenery of Myongsasimni in the background of tall pine trees and clear and blue waves of the East Sea is beautiful. When sweet briers are in full bloom on the shiny, white and clear sandy beach, it looks like a red flower carpet. So it has been well known at home and abroad from long ago.
Many hotels, hostels, sea-bathing service facilities, sports and amusement facilities, commercial and catering establishments and other public service establishments have been built at Myongsasimni on the initiative and under the wise guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
In the daytime, buildings with peculiar architectural beauty suit with the natural scenery of Myongsasimni and in the evening, electric light decorations add shine to its peculiar scenery.
The Kalma Coastal Resort will be famous as a scenic spot of the DPRK and the world which will be frequented by the DPRK people and friends of different countries in the future. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors of South Phyongan Province.
He visited the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex to encourage the officials and workers of the mine who are putting spurs to their drive for increased production to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK. And he underlined the need to secure enough reserve coal cutting faces by giving precedence to prospecting and tunneling and ensure the stable and sustained production growth by steadily improving the transport capacity.
At the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory, he learned in detail about the production of ammonium phosphatic fertilizer for this year's farming. He stressed the need to direct efforts to the readjustment and reinforcement of processes and systems and, at the same time, keep the production going at a high rate and positively introduce advanced production methods.
Going round the Sunchon Catfish Farm, he called for taking thoroughgoing measures to ensure the appropriate water temperature of fish ponds and supply feed for each stage of growth in keeping with the winter conditions so as to increase the productivity and thus glorify the leadership exploits of the Party with increased production.
The field consultative meetings took measures after discussing the issue of accelerating the technical upgrading of coal-dressing processes at coal mines, the issue for the relevant units to supply enough raw and other materials to the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory and the issue of introducing advanced fish farming technology at the Sunchon Catfish Farm. -0-

headline: Students in Kangwon Province of DPRK Make Study Tour of Chol Pass
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- Students of the graduating classes of senior middle schools in Kangwon Province of the DPRK made a study tour of Chol Pass, a symbol of the Songun revolutionary leadership.
The provincial committee of the youth league organized the expedition to Chol Pass with the purpose of preparing all students to be reserves of communist construction who faithfully uphold the noble intention of the peerlessly great men associated in the sacred course for the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people.
Officials of the province encouraged the students while marching together with them.
While climbing Chol Pass, the students deeply grasped the immortal revolutionary career and exploits of GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilwho made an indefatigable high-intensity forced march, shouldering the destiny of the country and the nation.
They held a campfire meeting to express their excitement through their poems and songs. They held a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array.
After arriving at the peak of the pass, they laid bouquets before the monument to the revolutionary activities ofKim Jong Iland made a pledge to add luster to his immortal exploits and remain loyal to the leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Quality of Medical Service Improved in Provincial General Hospitals of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- The provincial general hospitals in the DPRK are directing big efforts to improving the quality of medical service.
The North Phyongan Provincial General Hospital has built up the telemedicine room staff with medical workers with rich clinical experience and established a double power supply system to successfully conduct tele-consultation among doctors.
The Ryanggang Provincial General Hospital made sure that doctors and nurses have grasped the problems arising in introducing advanced medical science and technology to the specific conditions and improved their technical qualifications.
The North Hwanghae Provincial General Hospital has directed efforts to making sure that all medical workers study and perfect scientific treatment methods and apply them to treatment. -0-

story_text:

headline: KCNA Commentary on U.S. Arms Support to Puppet ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- The U.S., the world's biggest war merchant, is getting more frantic in its arms sale to its vassal states than ever before.
According to the "Fiscal Year 2024 U.S. Arms Transfers and Defense Trade" recently announced by the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. foreign military sales aimed at arms support to its allies in the last fiscal year reached 117.9 billion U.S. dollars, 45.7 percent increase over the previous fiscal year.
In this regard, the U.S. Department of State loudly claimed that it is the highest record of the annual foreign military sales to the allies.
That is very likely.
Last year the U.S. provided the Zelenskiy clique with a large amount of ultra-modern equipment, including long-range strike means, in order to reverse the military inferiority in the Ukrainian battlefield and expand the war in a sustainable way. It also handed over weapons of mass destruction to Israeli Zionists to instigate them to bloody massacres in the Gaza Strip.
If the weapons sold out by the U.S. to its allies in private, avoiding the eyes of the world people, are put together, the sales will reach an astronomical figure.
In retrospect, the U.S. has earned its geopolitical profit from turning various countries and regions of the world into hotspots and disputes by instigating its followers and worked at arms trade on a large scale under the pretext of "preventing disputes" to fill its money bags. It is the U.S. stereotyped method and selfish calculation method of killing two birds with one stone.
What merits attention is that the U.S. is getting ever more undisguised in its arms sale to the puppet ROK, top-class stooge and the first war servant.
A ceremony of handing over the U.S. latest sea-patrol planes took place in the puppet ROK in July last year. The U.S. approved the sale of latest attack helicopter AH-64E and related goods worth the 3.5 billion U.S. dollars to the puppet ROK in August and the sale of AWACS worth 4.92 billion U.S. dollars in November. All the facts go to prove that the U.S. moves to arm the ROK puppets with its weapons and drive them to confrontation and war with the DPRK are far beyond the danger level.
Such moves are going on in the new year, too. The U.S. officially notified the puppet ROK of two arms sales.
According to them, the arms sale includes the equipment worth a total of 170.6 million U.S. dollars including latest drones to be delivered to the puppet navy and the weapons parts 350 million U.S. dollars.
In this regard, the U.S. has long advertised that the introduction of weapons would make the puppet ROK “bolster up the deterrence and defense capabilities against threats” in the region.
The U.S. is getting more zealous in its huge arms support to the puppet ROK while talking about the so-called "improvement of security" and the "enhancement of military capabilities". Lurking behind this is the U.S. sinister intention to wreck the balance of strength in the region and consolidate its hegemonic position.
The puppet ROK has turned into a thoroughgoing anti-communist advanced base by the U.S., the most reactionary state entity regarding anti-communism as an invariable state policy. This reality clearly tells us which direction we should take, and what and how to do.
Any arms support of the U.S. can not save the puppet ROK from the destiny of the strategic inferiority, and  the U.S. shameless and outrageous ambition for killing two birds with one stone which is getting ever more undisguised with each passing day will never be realized by the just strength of the DPRK. -0-

headline: People of Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality of DPRK Celebrate Inauguration of Regional-Industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 2 (KCNA) -- The people of Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK splendidly celebrated the inauguration of the regional-industry factories.
The regional-industry factories built in Jangphung County according to the noble intention of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) are a fruition of loving care associated with the Party’s sacred ideal of the people-first principle and our style of the view on development.
There took place an inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories of Jangphung County for the regional Development 20×10 Policy on February 1.
Attending the ceremony were officials and working people in Kaesong Municipality and Jangphung County, soldier-builders and the employees of the newly-built factories.
Kim Yong Gyu, chief secretary of the Kaesong Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, addressed the ceremony.
He stressed that the successive appearance of the first valuable entities of the new regional-industry revolution is a proud outcome of the energetic leadership, based on the noble idea of "The people are God" and devoted service for the people of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand an inspiring event proving that the annals of great emotion in which the regions change and prosper are coming true.
He said that the scientific and revolutionary policies on a rapid development of the regions were shaped and the positive measures for accelerating their implementation taken and the fresh phase of regional rejuvenation could be further expanded under the energetic thinking, extraordinary leadership and meticulous guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a brilliant heyday of comprehensive state prosperity on this land.
He ardently called upon all officials, Party members and other working people in the municipality to go all out for the implementation of the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and thus make a tangible contribution to glorifying this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK as a year of great victory to be specially recorded in the history of the comprehensive development of the state.
Hong Song Il, chief secretary of the Jangphung County Committee of the WPK, made a speech.
He expressed his determination to make sure that the regional-industry factories associated with the great loving care of the WPK for the people keep production going at a high rate and thus become a solid fortress and precious asset for guaranteeing the improvement of the living standard of the people of the county.
Owners of the new factories cut the inauguration tape.
After the ceremony, the participants went round the factories fully equipped with modern production lines.
An art performance was given to celebrate the inauguration of the factories, revving up the festive mood.
That evening fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky over Jangphung County, adding pleasure and emotion to the people. -0-

headline: KCNA Report on Over-fulfillment of National Economic Plans for January
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency on February 2 released a report on the fact that a mass innovation movement for creating new norms and records was launched in all sectors of the national economy, and many units over-fulfilled their economic plans for January.
According to the report, the torch of miraculous increased production, held aloft by the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex, has developed into the flames of mass innovation movement across the country and new norms and new records have been created one after another in the overall national economy. In the course, the national economic plans for January were successfully fulfilled.
The Sangwon Cement Complex set a high goal to produce 10 times more cement than the increased production quantity in 2024 and registered the highest monthly production results since its inauguration through a collective innovation movement from the outset of the year, finishing the first monthly plan by January 28.
Workers of the Sunchon Cement Complex produced thousands of more tons of cement in the first 20-odd days of the year and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory carried out its high production plan.
The Sunchon Limestone Mine and the Manpho August 2 Cement Factory conducted the blasting of 200 000 and 100 000 cubic meter earth respectively to provide a sure guarantee for supplying much more cement to the grand construction theaters.
January production plans for pig iron, rolled steel and other major indices were fulfilled across the country, thanks to the efforts of workers in the field of metal industry.
Workers at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex produced thousands of more tons of fertilizer in the first ten days of the year alone.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has carried out its production plan at 110 percent every day.
The power production plan for January was carried out in the electric power industrial sector.
Coal miners across the country carried out their production plans for January at 104 percent by waging a dynamic socialist patriotic movement for increased coal production.
Officials and workers in the machine-building industry sector fulfilled their first monthly plans on indices.
The Ministry of Mining Industry successfully carried out its first monthly national economic plan.
The railway transport sector fulfilled its freight transport plan for January at 104 percent.
The monthly log production plan was fulfilled at 103 percent across the country.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill fulfilled its January production plan. In the first ten days alone, more than 90 weavers of the mill carried out their monthly plans and 10-odd weavers their first quarterly plans.
Workers and technicians of the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Wonsan Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Leather Shoes Factory, the Sinuiju Footwear Factory and other factories set an example in fulfilling the production plans while concentrating efforts on the work to diversify the products in kinds, types and colors and make them lighter.
The fishery sector carried out its seafood production plan for January at 127 percent.
As a result, the January production target to attain major goals for the national economic development was hit through a vigorous drive for increased production to successfully conclude the final year in implementing the five-year plan. This made a breakthrough in bringing the miraculous successes this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulations to General Secretary of C.C., CPV
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, sent a message of greeting to To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, on February 3.
The message said:
I extend congratulations to you and, through you, to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and all its members on the 95th founding anniversary of the CPV.
With the founding of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the Vietnamese people were able to have their own reliable political staff and win victory in the struggle to achieve national independence and establish a socialist system.
I am pleased that the Vietnamese people are achieving remarkable successes in the struggle to build a rich and prosperous state under the leadership of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Expressing the belief that the traditional friendly relations between our two parties would grow stronger in the common struggle to defend the socialist cause, I wish you success in your responsible work. -0-

headline: Spokesman for DPRK Foreign Ministry Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK released the following press statement titled "The most depraved country in the world is not entitled to take issue with other countries" on Feb. 2:
Recently, U.S. Secretary of State Rubio, in an interview with media, talked nonsense by terming the DPRK a "rogue state" while enumerating the foreign policy of the new U.S. administration.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK deems the U.S. State Secretary's hostile remarks to thoughtlessly tarnish the image of a sovereign state as a grave political provocation totally contrary to the principle of international law which regards respect for sovereignty and non-interference in other's internal affairs as its core and strongly denounces and rejects it.
In view of Rubio's political inclination and the U.S. inveterate repugnancy towards the DPRK, his speech is nothing new, and it would be more surprising if he had said good word about the DPRK.
But it is necessary to mention how absurd and illogical it is that the most depraved state in the world brands another country a rogue state.
The hostile words and deeds of the person who is in charge of the U.S. foreign policy served as an occasion of confirming once again the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK which remains unchanged.
Rubio's coarse and nonsensical remarks only show directly the incorrect view of the new U.S. administration on the DPRK and will never help promote the U.S. interests as he wishes.
We will never tolerate any provocation of the U.S., which has been always hostile to the DPRK and will be hostile to it in the future, too, but will take tough counteraction corresponding to it as usual. -0-

headline: KCNA Report on Over-fulfillment of National Economic Plans for January
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency on February 2 released a report on the fact that a mass innovation movement for creating new norms and records was launched in all sectors of the national economy, and many units over-fulfilled their economic plans for January.
According to the report, the torch of miraculous increased production, held aloft by the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex, has developed into the flames of mass innovation movement across the country and new norms and new records have been created one after another in the overall national economy. In the course, the national economic plans for January were successfully fulfilled.
The Sangwon Cement Complex set a high goal to produce 10 times more cement than the increased production quantity in 2024 and registered the highest monthly production results since its inauguration through a collective innovation movement from the outset of the year, finishing the first monthly plan by January 28.
Workers of the Sunchon Cement Complex produced thousands of more tons of cement in the first 20-odd days of the year and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory carried out its high production plan.
The Sunchon Limestone Mine and the Manpho August 2 Cement Factory conducted the blasting of 200 000 and 100 000 cubic meter earth respectively to provide a sure guarantee for supplying much more cement to the grand construction theaters.
January production plans for pig iron, rolled steel and other major indices were fulfilled across the country, thanks to the efforts of workers in the field of metal industry.
Workers at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex produced thousands of more tons of fertilizer in the first ten days of the year alone.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has carried out its production plan at 110 percent every day.
The power production plan for January was carried out in the electric power industrial sector.
Coal miners across the country carried out their production plans for January at 104 percent by waging a dynamic socialist patriotic movement for increased coal production.
Officials and workers in the machine-building industry sector fulfilled their first monthly plans on indices.
The Ministry of Mining Industry successfully carried out its first monthly national economic plan.
The railway transport sector fulfilled its freight transport plan for January at 104 percent.
The monthly log production plan was fulfilled at 103 percent across the country.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill fulfilled its January production plan. In the first ten days alone, more than 90 weavers of the mill carried out their monthly plans and 10-odd weavers their first quarterly plans.
Workers and technicians of the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Wonsan Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Leather Shoes Factory, the Sinuiju Footwear Factory and other factories set an example in fulfilling the production plans while concentrating efforts on the work to diversify the products in kinds, types and colors and make them lighter.
The fishery sector carried out its seafood production plan for January at 127 percent.
As a result, the January production target to attain major goals for the national economic development was hit through a vigorous drive for increased production to successfully conclude the final year in implementing the five-year plan. This made a breakthrough in bringing the miraculous successes this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Song Remembered by Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- In the township of Kim Hyong Jik County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK, there is a monument to "Song of the River Amnok". This is the song PresidentKim Il Sunghad always remembered in the whole period of his great life.
Singing the song in his teens, the President crossed the Amnok River with his firm determination not to return home until Korea was liberated from the Japanese imperialists' aggression.
The day when he made a heavy step on the frozen river at the neck of the rapids down the Phophyong Ferry in Kim Hyong Jik County was February 3, 1925.
Recalling that time, he wrote in his reminiscences "With the Century" as follows:
As I sang this song, I wondered when I would be able to tread this land again, when I would return to this land where I grew up and where my forefathers' graves lay. Young as I was, I could not repress my sorrow at this thought.
One day in August 1938 when the President was waging the anti-Japanese armed struggle, he sang the "Song of the River Amnok" at the secret base in Kumchang not far from Phophyong to harden the Korean People's Revolutionary Army members' will for national liberation.
Along with this song, he embarked on the road of revolution in his early years and achieved the historic cause of national liberation on August 15, 1945 by waging the heroic anti-Japanese revolutionary war.
One day in September 1991, the President visited the Phophyong Revolutionary Site. That day, he sang the song, recollecting with deep emotion the time when he had ardently desired to retake the country as early as possible and make everything the eternal one of Korea.
He said on several occasions that his career as a revolutionary began with the song. In his reminiscences he wrote a section titled "Song of the River Amnok".
The Korean people are still singing the song with deep reverence for the President, telling about his exploits for national liberation. -0-

headline: Expedition of Schoolchildren Arrives at Phophyong
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- The expedition of schoolchildren from across the DPRK on the march to trace the course of the 250-mile Journey for National Liberation arrived at Phophyong on February 3.
Fluttering the flag of the expedition, its members entered the place, where the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungcrossed the Amnok River with his firm resolve not to return home until Korea was liberated. They were warmly welcomed by officials, working people and schoolchildren in Kim Hyong Jik County of Ryanggang Province.
The expedition members held a meeting upon their arrival in the compound before the statue of GeneralissimoKim Il Sungat the Phophyong Revolutionary Site.
Present there were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Thae Il, chief secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the WPK, Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials concerned, youth league officials and members of the expedition.
The members of the expedition laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statue of GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand paid tribute to him.
Read out at the meeting was a letter to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unpresented by the participants in the expedition along the route of the 250-mile Journey for National Liberation.
In their letter, all the expedition members made a report on the successful completion of their study tour, held on the occasion of the centenary of the Journey made by the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand the 50th anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Il's first expedition along this route, and the safe arrival at Phophyong.
Then followed speeches. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Major Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- Young people in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK have volunteered for major economic sectors seething with the struggle to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A graduate student of Songdo University of Education vowed to become a teacher at a branch school in a mountain village.
Many youths petitioned their youth league organizations to dispatch them to regional-industry factories and raw materials bases, out of the mind to devote themselves to the patriotic work for ushering in a great era of regional rejuvenation.

Officials, youth and students of the municipality warmly saw off those volunteers leaving for the workplaces called by the Party. -0-

headline: Commemorative Meeting Held at Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place in the DPRK on February 3 to mark the 10th anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory.
Present there were Kim Kwang Su, secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials and employees of the factory.
Choe Song Ae, secretary of the primary Party committee of the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, made a report at the meeting.
The reporter noted thatKim Jong Unvisited the factory in February 2015 and indicated the detailed orientation and ways for putting the country's cosmetics industry on a world level at an early date, while going round various parts of the factory, and showed great benevolence by taking measures to modernize the factory as the world's leading producer of cosmetics.
The reporter referred to the fact that the officials and employees of the factory, determined to live up to his trust and expectation, have devoted all their wisdom and enthusiasm to making the world's competitive cosmetics.
The reporter called for turning out as one in the drive for increased production and economization in order to implement the WPK's decisions, always mindful that to unconditionally carry out the factory's national economic plan through normal production is the way for repaying the benevolence of the Party.
All the officials and employees should make strenuous efforts to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee with the honor and pride of working at the glorious factory and thus glorify the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK with praiseworthy successes in production, the reporter stressed. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Coexistence of Truce and Murder in Middle East
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- Killing and destruction goes on in the Middle East where the truce was declared.
Days ago, the Israeli military conducted a large-scale military operation in Jenin, a northern city of the West Bank of the Jordan River, under the pretext of "anti-terrorism", killing a large number of Palestinian refugees and destroying dwelling houses and infrastructure.
In the border area south of Lebanon, the murderers attacked villages with tanks and bulldozers, causing a hundred and tens of civilian casualties.
Under international arbitration, Israel and Hezbollah, in November last year reached a ceasefire agreement and in January this year, truce between Israel and Hamas took effect, but as seen above, Israel's massacre has not stopped.
The reckless military action which is being conducted almost daily behind the curtain of the ceasefire is making everyone doubt whether Israel has a will to restore stability and peace in the region and is escalating the concern of the international community about the fragile ceasefire.
It is also necessary to pay attention to the backstage forces that tolerate and instigate the violent breach of the truce by the Jewish state and the present situation which is neither war nor ceasefire.
The prime minister of Israel in his video statement on the cease-fire agreement with Hamas said that if they were forced to resume war, they would conduct it with powerful strength and new methods. He said that even the U.S. fully supports the possible resumption of war by Israel if the negotiations are "futile".
His remarks reminded everyone of the dark shadow of the U.S., which has repeatedly vetoed the resolutions of the UNSC demanding immediate cease-fire and shielded and encouraged the bloody massacre by arming the Israeli military with huge amount of lethal weapons.
In its statements on the cease-fire in Gaza, the U.S. has taken double-dealing attitude by positively welcoming the release of Israeli hostages while remaining silent as regards the release of Palestinian prisoners. It is still keeping silence about the wanton violation of cease-fire agreement by the Jewish state.
Some days ago, the U.S. went the length of making an unjust proposal for moving the Palestinians in Gaza Strip to Egypt and Jordan. And it is unhesitatingly blocking the fair settlement of dispute and inciting the aggravation of the situation by allowing continued offer of large bombs to Israel which had been withheld for fear of the international community's criticism.
The coexistence of cease-fire and killing can never be tolerated.
All facts clearly prove that the U.S. strategy for dominating Middle East to fish in troubled waters in the aggravated situation is unchanged just as Israel's ambition for territorial seizure to forcibly displace Palestinians and expand Jewish settlements remains unchanged.
Unless the root cause of dispute is removed, there can be no durable peace.
It is still uncertain whether the fragile cease-fire in the region would lead to permanent and durable peace.
The prospect of the implementation of the cease-fire agreement in Gaza Strip will highlight once again the true colors of the world's peace and anti-peace forces. -0-

headline: Efforts Made in DPRK for Normal Operation of Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- Members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians, dispatched to the non-permanent central committee for promoting the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, and other scientists and technicians of different units in the DPRK strive to settle the sci-tech problems arising in putting the operation of newly-built regional-industry factories on a normal track.
Last year those scientists, technicians and officials designed thousands of equipment  amounting to more than 70 percent and manufactured most of them, ensuring their installation and trial operation. Successes were also made in training skilled workers and disseminating advanced sci-tech data.
Kim Il SungUniversity organized cooperation among different faculties and units and provided guidance to establish an integrated production system at the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry established a refined oil production line of Korean style that is highly efficient and suited to the production conditions in all regions.
The State Academy of Sciences and the Academy of Light Industry established a soap production line suited to the specific conditions of the country and settled the problems arising in producing quality soap.
This year, too, many scientists and technicians are pooling their creative wisdom and efforts with officials and working people on the spot to solve the sci-tech problems arising in normalizing the operation of newly-built regional-industry factories. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), sent a congratulatory message to Aleksandr Lukashenko, president of the Republic of Belarus, on February 3.

headline: Exhibition of Utensils and Tools Held at Housing Construction Site in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of utensils and tools for making the preparations for housing construction in a far-sighted way took place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on February 4, true to the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on pushing ahead with the project for building houses at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area.
Displayed there were valuable and practical construction utensils, tools and equipment invented and manufactured at  construction units by their own efforts and technology on the basis of the successes and experience gained in the past construction.
The brigades of the Ministry of Public Security and the Pyongyang Construction Commission produced efficient and labor- and material-saving mixers and cutters by introducing new technology.
The first, second and third brigades of ministries and national agencies and other construction units, too, have prepared utensils, tools and equipment conducive to ensuring the quality of construction. -0-

headline: Various Species of Animals Increase at Central Zoo in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- Entering this year, seven species of animals, including two species of gift animals, brought forth more than 30 young at the Central Zoo in the DPRK.
The Asiatic black bear, a gift animal, brought forth several cubs after settling in the zoo 20-odd years ago. It produced one cub again on January 1.
The number of the Cavia porcellus has increased.
The hamadryas baboon and other animals, too, gave birth to their young.
The weight and length of the three young tigers (two females and one male) produced by a Korean tiger in November last year are about 7 kilograms and 60 centimeters on average.
Those animals are giving pleasure to the working people and schoolchildren. -0-

headline: Mass Movements Launched in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- Industrial establishments in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are conducting mass movements for the regional economic development and the improvement of people's living standards.
The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex launched a mass movement for maintaining equipment to make innovative successes at every worksite.
The Kyongam Cement Factory has conducted ideological education to follow the fighting spirit and traits of the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex while launching a socialist emulation to raise the rate of fulfilling its daily quotas.
The Sariwon Textile Mill and the Ryesonggang Power Station are boosting production through such mass movements as the multi-spindle and multi-loom tending movement and the movement of helping the next shift.
Employees of the Sariwon Bag Factory and the Sariwon Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory are reducing the production cost by using scraps of cloth from the viewpoint that economy means increased production and patriotism.
The Sariwon Equipment Assembly Station, the Sariwon Aeguk Essential Plastic Goods Factory and the Unpha County Daily Necessities Factory have directed efforts to recycling materials and turned the technical innovation movement into the work of the masses themselves to increase the production of various kinds of parts and plastic goods.
The Jongbangsan General Foodstuff Factory, the Sariwon Winery, the Sohung County Furniture Goods Factory and other factories have manufactured efficient equipment and tools with their own efforts and done various good-conduct movements. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Applying Idea and Spirit of 30th Enlarged Meeting of Secretariat of Eighth C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- In order to build up the Workers' Party of Korea into a powerful political general staff and genuine party of the people, which is strong in discipline and truly serves the people, it is necessary to thoroughly apply the idea and spirit of the 30th Enlarged Meeting of the Secretariat of the Eighth Party Central Committee, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial on February 5.
It is the iron will of the Party Central Committee to establish a sound political climate within the Party by waging a strong struggle in time, never conniving at any factor which undermines and destroys the Party's discipline, the editorial says, and goes on:
For our Party, the people are roots of life and sacred beings upheld as Heaven, and making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people is the mode of existence of our Party and the source of its invincible might.
The recent enlarged meeting of the Secretariat strictly dealt with those who violated the rights and interests of the people. This clearly shows the will of our Party to consolidate the fortress of single-minded unity, the mainstay of our revolution.
In the light of the idea and spirit of the meeting, all officials should constantly cultivate and train themselves, wondering how they have observed the Party discipline and if they can honorably stand before their consciences as Party members without any shame.
A great offensive should be launched throughout the Party to thoroughly establish the revolutionary climate of the Party that respects the people and serves them.
All officials should be true and faithful servants of the people who can keep the people's laughter with their own painstaking efforts, bearing deep in mind the Party Central Committee’s noble idea of "The People Are God" and devoted service for the people's wellbeing.
What is essential for the eternal development of our Party, for the victorious development of our socialism and for the eternal well-being of our people is to thoroughly implement the five-point party-building line and to make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people. -0-

headline: Study Tour Group of Schoolchildren Visits Phophyong Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren from across the DPRK involved in the expedition of the 250-mile Journey for National Liberation visited the Phophyong Revolutionary Site on February 4.
They went round different parts of the site associated with the undying exploits of the great leader Generalissimo
Kim Il Sung, who made a 250-mile journey for the revolution with his high patriotic ambition.
At the Phophyong Revolutionary Museum, they looked round historic relics and data on display, being briefed on the noble revolutionary career of the Generalissimo who devoted his all to the country and the people all his life since he embarked on the road of revolution in his early years.
Then they made rounds of the Phophyong Ferry whereKim Il Sungcrossed the Amnok River with a firm pledge that he would not return home until Korea was liberated, the Monument to "Song of the River Amnok", the Monument to the Phophyong Revolutionary Site, etc.
Through the visit, they deeply grasped the exploits ofKim Il Sungand renewed their determination to prepare themselves as sons and daughters faithful to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unand as masters of the future who will shoulder the socialist country. -0-

headline: Regarding People as Most Admirable Teacher
story_text:
One winter day in 1964, ChairmanKim Jong Ilcalled an official to ask about the way for solving the traffic problem in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.
The official replied that he would present a proposal a week later, because he had no idea at that moment. Then the Chairman told the official to meet teachers together with him for advice at 20:00.
That evening, the Chairman, together with the official, listened to the voices of citizens carefully on a bus, and met the workers repairing a bus to listen to their opinions. Then he returned to his office.
He called the official at dawn of the next day and handed over the proposal representing the voices of citizens in the bus and the opinions of bus repairmen.
The Chairman told the official, who was surprised to receive the proposal, that he had only written his teachers' idea, adding that those whom he met at the previous night were his most admirable teachers.
Only then, the official came to realize that the teachers whom the Chairman wanted to receive advice from were ordinary people, not a grey-haired old professor or a doctor. -0-

headline: Attentive Care for Schoolchildren
story_text:
One day in October 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unlooked round a junior middle school in the newly-built Wisong Scientists Residential District.
Kim Jong Undropped in at a classroom on the first floor to learn about its construction and school fixtures. Unexpectedly he told an official accompanying him to put a ball-pen on a desk.
When he lifted the top panel of the desk, the ball-pen rolled down the floor of the classroom.
He said that if students lifted the top panels of their desks to take out books and school things from their drawers, books and school things on the top panels would fall down. He told the officials that it is necessary to make a raised part or groove on the upper part of the top surface, otherwise, pencils or ball-pens on the desks could roll down the floor even if they were touched a little.
Looking up to him, the officials keenly realized that the work for the rising generation should not be overlooked even in the minutiae. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Utensils and Tools Held at Housing Construction Site in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of utensils and tools for making the preparations for housing construction in a far-sighted way took place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on February 4, true to the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on pushing ahead with the project for building houses at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area.
Displayed there were valuable and practical construction utensils, tools and equipment invented and manufactured at  construction units by their own efforts and technology on the basis of the successes and experience gained in the past construction.
The brigades of the Ministry of Public Security and the Pyongyang Construction Commission produced efficient and labor- and material-saving mixers and cutters by introducing new technology.
The first, second and third brigades of ministries and national agencies and other construction units, too, have prepared utensils, tools and equipment conducive to ensuring the quality of construction. -0-

headline: Vietnamese Embassy Members Visit Kangdong Greenhouse Complex
story_text:

headline: Study Tour Group of Schoolchildren Visits Phophyong Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren from across the DPRK involved in the expedition of the 250-mile Journey for National Liberation visited the Phophyong Revolutionary Site on February 4.
They went round different parts of the site associated with the undying exploits of the great leader Generalissimo
Kim Il Sung, who made a 250-mile journey for the revolution with his high patriotic ambition.
At the Phophyong Revolutionary Museum, they looked round historic relics and data on display, being briefed on the noble revolutionary career of the Generalissimo who devoted his all to the country and the people all his life since he embarked on the road of revolution in his early years.
Then they made rounds of the Phophyong Ferry whereKim Il Sungcrossed the Amnok River with a firm pledge that he would not return home until Korea was liberated, the Monument to "Song of the River Amnok", the Monument to the Phophyong Revolutionary Site, etc.
Through the visit, they deeply grasped the exploits ofKim Il Sungand renewed their determination to prepare themselves as sons and daughters faithful to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unand as masters of the future who will shoulder the socialist country. -0-

headline: Usanjang, Scenic Spot in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- Among the scenic spots in the DPRK is Usanjang located in Usan-ri, Hanggu District of Nampho Municipality.
Its annual average temperature is about 10 degrees Celsius, annual average precipitation 837.4 mm and sunshine ratio 56 percent. Therefore, it has a good condition for thermotherapy.
Usanjang, located in the deep valley of Peak Kuksa, has a beautiful lake. Its natural scenery is very beautiful.
There is a tree of Usanjang zelkova recorded as a natural monument.
There are also various sports facilities and a route of climbing Peak Kuksa.
Usanjang has been spruced up as a recreation resort and a scenic spot to contribute to the emotional life of working people. -0-

headline: KPA Construction Regiments Leave for New Theatres for Transformation
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- Officers and men of the construction regiments at all levels of the Korean People's Army, who presented their first edifices before the country and its people in the vanguard of implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, are advancing into new theaters.
They worked miracles of simultaneously building the first entities for regional development in 20 cities and counties of the country in less than one year after the start of groundbreaking.
Last year, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the groundbreaking ceremony for regional-industry factories in Songchon County to encourage the officers and men of the construction regiments at all levels and personally hand over the flags of regiments. His trust served as nourishment that trained the soldier-builders to be creators of transformation for the people and pioneers of a new era of civilization and as a source of strength that made them demonstrate the fighting spirit, offensive disposition and creative mettle peculiar to the revolutionary army.
With the noble intention of the great brilliant commander kept in their mind, the service personnel of the construction regiments made strenuous efforts with the will to devote all their soul to the struggle for keeping the promise made by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea with the people and to the sacred cause of loyalty and patriotism for turning their native places into prosperous ones and bringing about a new civilization and new life for the people.
Thanks to the patriotic devotion of soldier-builders who have cherished pure conscience in hearty response to the call of the Party Central Committee, a fairyland of the times was opened in which the local areas changed and the auspicious events of inauguration of regional-industry factories were heard one after another from the outset of the new year, making the whole country seethe with excitement and joy.
Cities and counties were filled with enthusiasm to give warm send-off to the genuine army of the people and patriot units leaving for new theatres again.
But, the officers gave silent marching orders at the barracks of construction regiments at all levels at early dawn when the residents fell asleep.
The soldiers left for the new theatres of creation and construction where the Party is calling and the people are waiting. -0-

headline: KPA Displaying Matchless Might
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK are greeting the 77th birthday of the heroic Korean People's Army which has demonstrated its might as the revolutionary armed forces of the Workers' Party of Korea, the guards of the DPRK government and the genuine people's army.
The army's original idea, embroidered on the sacred colours at the beginning of the army building, and the true picture of the heroic KPA glorifying the brilliant tradition of the anti-Japanese war with victories are more clearly highlighted as the appearance of the powerful army along with the immortal annals, the greatest heyday of bolstering up the military muscle, and the new era of the Juche revolution.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unset forth the unique army-building line and policies, including the programme for modeling the whole army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the four-point policy on building a powerful army.
He advanced the militant task for turning all units of different services, arms and core and sub-units into a-match-for-a-hundred combat ranks and personally went to the training grounds to guide actual maneuvers. Under his guidance, the KPA brought about a revolutionary turn in rounding off its combat preparedness and remarkably increased its combat capability.
He developed the KPA into the strongest army with the powerful nuclear treasured sword. This is a distinguished exploit he performed in building the Juche-based revolutionary armed forces.
The year 2024, which brilliantly recorded a page in the history of building a powerful army under his guidance, made the Korean people deeply feel the name of the strong self-defensive nation and the dignity of the strong people and redoubled the courage and conviction of a bright future of Juche Korea which is guaranteed by the powerful military muscle.
Under the illustrious commander’s idea of building a powerful army and energetic guidance, the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK have grown into the army strong in idea and faith and a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army. They have been prepared as the invincible militant ranks possessed of perfect actual war capability for fighting any form of war, regarding it as their lifeblood and supreme honour to defend the Party Central Committee at the cost of their lives. And they are now further consolidating the militant might to annihilate any formidable enemy at a single blow. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ground-breaking Ceremony of Kangdong County Hospital and General Service Center for Regional Development 20×10 Policy Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- The grand construction struggle for 2025 to implement the regional development policy in the new era started thanks to the grand intention of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea to steadily carry forward the era of great rejuvenation in which 20 cities and counties of different parts of the country are changing every year while making bigger and more correct and responsible strides of advance for epochal changes dynamically revitalizing the whole country to be the ideal of the people suited to the dignity and prestige of a powerful country.
The WPK, which made a breakthrough in accomplishing the historic cause of restoring the local economy on a completely new foundation across the country, confirmed the policy orientation and practical plan in depth to ensure the wider and practical development of regional areas and accelerate the construction of a highly civilized and powerful country. On the basis of this, it unfolded a bright blueprint for building public health facilities, general service center and grain management facilities in parallel with the construction of regional-industry factories.
The WPK is trying to establish not only the modern light industry foundation, but also a development environment in all parts of the local areas under which the progress of science, education and public health are used as a dynamic force to effloresce into advanced civilization, and thus promote faster and more dynamically the development and prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people. Such great ambition of the WPK is magnificently making proud annals of the revolutionary turn to be specially recorded in the history of the DPRK.
A ground-breaking ceremony to build the Kangdong County Hospital and General Service Center for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy whose construction will be powerfully propelled hewing out the new sphere and  ground of overall rejuvenation was held with splendor on February 6.
The venue of the ceremony was filled with the militant enthusiasm of soldier-builders to steadily carry forward this year with continuous leaping successes with the same spirit and mettle they displayed in glorifying with precious entities of great change the first year struggle for implementing the great strategic programme for the regional development of the WPK and with the stirring excitement of the working people in Kangdong County who are optimistic about the hopeful future, which will be highly civilized and rich day by day along with the assets of prosperity to be built soon.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the ground-breaking ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants raised stormy cheers.
All the participants paid the highest tribute and glory toKim Jong Un, the great pioneer of socialist civilization and great master of creation who set the realization of the people's ideals as the supreme principle of activities of our Party and state and is ushering in a new era of transformation unprecedented in the history of the country when the whole country changes and prospers, with his ardent service spirit and steadfast revolutionary will.
Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and other senior Party, government and military officials, members of the non-permanent committees at all levels for promoting the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, service personnel of the People's Army involved in the construction, and officials and working people in Pyongyang Municipality and Kangdong County.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech in commemoration of the ceremony.
Noting that the construction work for the significant year 2025 starts with the ground-breaking of the construction of Kangdong County Hospital and general service center, he expressed his pleasure and deep emotion over the fact that another sincerity of our Party and government will reach the regional people and a remarkable change in the new era will settle in a part of the country.
Referring to the urgency of the improvement of regional people's cultural living environment in fundamentally and ultimately eradicating the distinctions between towns and the countryside, he said it is an ideal result of the regional development policy to make the whole country enjoy the same cultural level.
He said that it is the top priority of the Party and the government to put the public health service on a modern and advanced basis, clarifying the WPK's plan and absolute will to newly develop the public health into a soil that cultivates the might of the country’s life and into strong roots for regional rejuvenation and thus get the year 2025 recorded in the history as the first year of revolution in the public health.
To build modern public health facilities and multi-functional bases for cultural life in cities and counties is a crucial undertaking of high strategic value and an urgent task which brooks no further delay in accelerating the simultaneous and balanced development of all fields and regions and hastening the complete victory of socialism, he said, affirming that the everlasting prosperity of regions precisely means the everlasting prosperity of our state and the prospect of Korean-style socialism.
Today's ground-breaking ceremony is the start of a great course and a decisive stride forward and an important watershed towards the future, he said, ardently calling for more courageously and vigorously advancing for the great ideal of our people and for the victory of our cause.
All the participants broke into cheers of great excitement, looking up to the great father who is bringing a new world of cultural efflorescence under socialism where all the desires and ideals of the people are translated into life and reality and the future appearance of changes that will surely be made through the Korean-style creative struggle.
The commander of the construction regiment made a speech of pledge on behalf of the builders.
Referring to the excitement of soldier-builders to be involved in the construction of essential objects, a meaningful start of substantial and qualitative change in realizing the grand cause of regional transformation, the speaker said that they are filled with confidence as they have consolidated their genuine outlook on the people, indomitable pioneering spirit and powerful strength of creation under the care of the respected Supreme Commander.
He solemnly pledged to successfully build monumental edifices symbolic of the new era of regional development in Kangdong County, where a large-scale sea of greenhouses was opened thanks to the great loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea, as a model for the whole country and thus glorify this year marking the 80th birthday of the WPK with great victory and glory.
Kim Jong Untook up the first spade to signal the start of the construction project.
The venue for ground-breaking ceremony was seething with joy as a historic scene was shown to be specially recorded in the history of victorious development of the dignified DPRK.
WhenKim Jong Unpressed the detonator, the ground-breaking sound was heard.
Fireworks were displayed amid the lively manifestation of boundless reverence and trust in the great Party Central Committee, which is cultivating a flower garden of all blessings for all ages in the land based on the idea "The People Are God", regarding it as its absolute mission to achieve the prosperity of the country and improve the people's well-being.
Kim Jong Unextended warm encouragement to the soldier-builders replete with the militant morale to more courageously display the spirit of unconditional implementation and strong executive faculty, peculiar to our army, in the great revolutionary work to promote the overall prosperity of the country.
He expressed expectation and belief that the soldier-builders would remain intensely loyal to their honorable duty as pioneers of transformation and defenders of happiness for the country and the people in the outpost of the struggle for realizing the cherished desire of the Party.
The grand ground-breaking of the construction of the Kangdong County Hospital and general service center is a clear proof of the firm will and matchless power of execution of the WPK to most thoroughly and perfectly achieve the epochal regional changes, the most sacred and just cause demanded by the times and expected by the people, as well as of the validity and bright prospect of our cause and the firm confidence in it. -0-

headline: Working People's Organizations Hold Meetings with DPRK Heroes and War Veteran
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- Working people's organizations in the DPRK held meetings with heroes of the Republic and a war veteran on Thursday on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
DPRK Hero Pak In Ho, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, told about the feats performed by the KPA seamen in January 1968 when they captured the U.S. imperialists’ armed spy ship Pueblo which intruded into the DPRK territorial waters.
He said that the U.S. imperialists threatened and blackmailed the DPRK, clamoring "retaliation" under the pretext of this incident, but they could not but kneel down before the courage and pluck of the peerlessly great men. This is a signal victory of historical significance won by PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, outstanding military strategists and iron-willed commanders.
Ho Ryong, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, said that he has led a worthwhile life as a pilot hero known to the whole country under the care of the peerlessly great men.
His story about military feat that he beat back the U.S. imperialists' strategic reconnaissance plane which intruded into the sky over the economic waters of the East Sea of Korea touched the heartstrings of the participants.
He said that as he fought with the outstanding military strategic idea and tactics, courage and pluck given by the Workers' Party of Korea, he could win victory in the confrontation with the enemies.
Kim Juk Song, a war veteran, told about the words in the letter of pledge adopted by KPA seamen before the naval battle in the waters off Jumunjin and about the days when she was engaged in a medical campaign to save the lives of comrades-in-arms as chief nurse.
She said that the KPA has developed into the strongest revolutionary armed forces reliably guaranteeing the defence of the sovereignty and the enhancement of the prestige of the state with matchless arms under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Through the meetings with the heroes and war veteran, the participants realized that the country is great and the people can demonstrate glory as they have held the great brilliant commander in high esteem. They vowed to devote their all to the national defence, sincerely assist the People's Army and conduct mass movements to contribute to bolstering up the military capabilities.
Present at the meetings were Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials of the youth league, the trade unions and the women's union, youth and students, workers and members of the trade unions and the women's union in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Sword Dance, Korean Folk Dance
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- Among the folk dances created and developed by the Korean people is sword dance.
The Korean people have danced it from ancient times.
The sword dance can be divided into several types according to the number of swords and props like mask.
Sword dances in Koguryo tomb murals show the courageous spirit of the resourceful and brave people at that time and the fact that sword dances were widely being performed.
The sword dance was also popular in the period of Koryo (918-1392). It can be well known by the fact that the sword dance was included in some folk dances of the period.
Later, the sword dance was developed into the one with high artistic skill.
Today, the folk dance "Sword Dance" is widely performed as a stage art work. -0-

story_text:

On display at the festival venue are sculptures showing the changes in Samjiyon City and the happiness of the people.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Feats for Bolstering up Military Capabilities of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- The revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK are greeting the significant founding anniversary.
All the service personnel and people in the country recall the feats of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho made sure that historic conferences, short courses and meetings were held in the past decade to be specially recorded in the army building history and indicated the immortal great programme to be constantly adhered to by the KPA.
Kim Jong Unsaw to it that the meetings of company commanders and political instructors and meetings of battalion commanders and political instructors were organized and clearly indicated the way for the companies and battalions to follow.
Conferences were convened to mark important occasions in remarkably enhancing the role of commanding officers and political officials of units at all levels who will improve the Party work and the work of youth league in the People's Army and carry out the line and tasks for making the revolutionary armed forces elite and strong advanced by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Saying that he would defend the sky of the country himself, he ensured that a grand gathering was held with all the pilots of the whole army involved in the period when the U.S. and its followers were intensifying their moves for confrontation with the DPRK.
In his historic speech made at the 5th Conference of Training Workers of the KPA he organized in April 2015, he clearly indicated the goal of the training revolution, the main task arising in carrying out the training revolution, the seed and key point of the training revolution.
He also saw to it that historic meetings were held to improve the supply service, military education, the work of officers’ wives and other affairs of the KPA and raise a strong wind of revolutionary mass movement for increasing the combat efficiency of the whole army.
"Let us make the People’s Army an invincible elite revolutionary army which will win only victory in every battle by bringing about a revolution in training!" and other militant slogans, set forth at the historic meetings which will shine long along with the history of the Juche-oriented army building, have become the standard of life and struggle for all the service personnel of the KPA. -0-

They vowed to devote their all to the national defence, sincerely assist the People's Army and conduct mass movements to contribute to bolstering up the military capabilities.
Present at the meetings were Pak In Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials of the youth league, the trade unions and the women's union, youth and students, workers and members of the trade unions and the women's union in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Sword Dance, Korean Folk Dance
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- Among the folk dances created and developed by the Korean people is sword dance.
The Korean people have danced it from ancient times.
The sword dance can be divided into several types according to the number of swords and props like mask.
Sword dances in Koguryo tomb murals show the courageous spirit of the resourceful and brave people at that time and the fact that sword dances were widely being performed.
The sword dance was also popular in the period of Koryo (918-1392). It can be well known by the fact that the sword dance was included in some folk dances of the period.
Later, the sword dance was developed into the one with high artistic skill.
Today, the folk dance "Sword Dance" is widely performed as a stage art work. -0-
