headline: Superior Folk Customs of Korean People
Customs of Korean People on First Full Moon Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 11 (KCNA) -- January 12 is the first full moon day (January 15th of the lunar calendar).
The day is one of the folk holidays enjoyed by the Korean people.
From olden times, the Korean people held various ceremonial events reflecting their simple desire for the new year's fortune and rich harvest.
Typical of them are a game of hanging crops on a long pole and enjoying the full moon.
On the occasion of the day, there was a custom of composting fields early in the morning. It clearly shows the diligence of the Korean people.
On the evening of the day, people had pleasant talks, enjoying the full moon on a high mountain and a hill.
The first full moon day and custom of enjoying the full moon were registered as national intangible cultural heritages.
Special dishes of the day are boiled rice admixed with four other staple cereals, dishes made of nine kinds of dried edible herbs, etc.
Colorful folk games including kite-flying and a tug of war and sports activities revved up the festive mood.
The holiday enjoyed by the people every year is associated with the care of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho saw to it that the Korean nation's excellent folk tradition and culture are glorified.
One day in February 2002,Kim Jong Ilexplained to the officials the origin of the above-said holiday and the peculiar national foods of the day, and next year, too, gave precious instructions to make the people enjoy the day with pleasure.
The Korean people are now enjoying the day as a folk holiday full of the spirit of the times, revolutionary optimism and noble emotion. -0-

headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony of Largest-ever Greenhouse Farm and Vegetable Science Research Centre Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 11 (KCNA) -- There started another important undertaking for regional development to be specially recorded in the new era of great changes, when the people-first idea of the Workers' Party of Korea is comprehensively realized.
In December last year, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the inauguration ceremony of a modern rural cultural city in the Sinuiju area whose looks had undergone a radical change after eradicating the aftermath of the severe flooding. At the ceremony he declared a grand new construction plan for the greater local change and showed deep loving care by personally dispatching the construction forces to carry it out.
Thanks to the warm sincerity of the dear father who is unrolling a brighter future in the people's cradle built on the road of devoted efforts made by him for the flood victims, the largest-ever modern greenhouse farm and vegetable science research base will be built in Hadan-ri of Sinuiju City, border gateway of the country, and in Soho-ri of Uiju County as creations symbolic of the lively and bold progress in regional rejuvenation.
A groundbreaking ceremony of the 450-hectare greenhouse farm and the vegetable science research center took place with splendor on February 10.
Officers and men of the navy and air force units of the Korean People's Army and commanding officers and members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade to be involved in the undertaking for the gigantic regional change lined up in the venue of the ceremony.
Kim Jong Unattended the ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers in reflection of the highest tribute to the benevolent father of a great socialist family who is pioneering the sacred revolution unprecedented in the history which is called the comprehensive development of regions in which the long-cherished desire of the people across the country is successfully achieved, and who is ushering in a new era of high civilization and prosperity shining with the people's laughter and the promotion of their well-being.
Pak Thae Song and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, and other senior Party, government and military officials were present at the ceremony together with builders.
Pak Thae Song, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, addressed the ceremony.
Noting that the grand greenhouse farms, which have been put on a modern, intensive and industrial basis, have been built one after another in the era of changes led by the great Party, and thereby a new ground of improving the people's living standards is being hewed out, the premier said that the edifices of the times built in different parts of the country are a crystal of the noble desire and bold leadership activities of the WPK which orients everything towards providing the people with a more affluent life and ushers in a great heyday of construction, self-support and self-respect which is unprecedented in the history.
The fourth greenhouse farm construction in recent years is an important state affair to be carried out thanks to the noble intention ofKim Jong Unto turn this islet area, where only sand dust is flying in the strong river wind, into a socialist paradise where the people will lead a highly civilized and affluent life, he noted.
According to the plan and intention ofKim Jong Un, not only different types of vegetable greenhouses, vegetable processing factory and storages but also vegetable science research center, trial cultivation greenhouses, hundreds of flats, hostels and neighborhood-serving amenities will be built here simultaneously in a more vast area than what is put together all the large-scale greenhouse farms built in recent years, he noted.
If the large-scale greenhouse farm which will be put on a scientific and IT basis is built in the background of modern dwelling houses standing in rows while showing the true picture of socialism on the opposite side of the River Amnok, the islet area here will enjoy fame as a new model of regional development with its own strong potentials of development and as a brilliant symbol of prosperity in our era, he stressed.
Noting that the current construction of the greenhouse farm is part of the struggle to turn the city of Sinuiju into an advanced city which can intuit and represent the development and might of socialist Korea and an important political work for displaying the advantages of the Party’s policy on regional development, the premier affirmed that the grand construction campaign will be certainly and triumphantly concluded thanks to the clear stratagem of construction revolution indicated by the great Party, strong conviction, indomitable fighting spirit and army-people unity.
Kim Jong Unmade a rallying speech.
The speech reads as follows:
Officers and soldiers of the Navy and Air Force units of the Korean People’s Army, which are famed for their ardent spirit of patriotism and brilliant exploits,
Officers and other members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade with the most honourable name,
I extend my warm encouragement to you, who have come to the important construction site with a high ambition of playing a major role in implementing the Party’s far-reaching plan.
As I have already clarified, our Party and government are planning to implement a new, promising regional development project on the shore of this Amnok River, where damage caused by a natural calamity was removed and a new socialist life has settled.
The site for the construction of a large greenhouse farm, on which we are now standing, will symbolize our cause of rejuvenating the whole country through a continuous, accelerated struggle, and it will provide another clear picture of the higher stage and processes of development of the regional and rural rejuvenation as has been designed by our Party.
I take pride in launching this ambitious regional development project, yet I feel more proud of the fact that I have entrusted the important task of carrying out this project to our most faithful large combined units of the services of the revolutionary armed forces and the youth brigade whose members are in a soaring spirit to wage an unyielding struggle.
Wherever miraculous successes are achieved and legendary tales of construction are created, I can see the officers and soldiers of the Navy and Air Force units. This is by no means coincidental, and I believe it is an inevitable relationship between you and me, as we always share purpose.
I am convinced that the officers and soldiers of our Navy and Air Force and the officers and other members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade will give full pay to their qualities as befits the elite ranks that are carrying forward the great pioneering spirit with great creations and transformations, and thus present the most splendid and satisfactory structure to our country and people.
Comrades,
We are filled with confidence and courage great enough to change the times because we believe in our own strength, and we have the army and young people who are infinitely loyal to the Party’s leadership. And we are pushing ahead uninterruptedly towards the building of a powerful country along the path that nobody else in the world has ever trodden because our heroic army and young people are performing feats of labour.
What you will build is a large-scale greenhouse farm, and yet what surpasses it by far is the prestige of our dignified state, a beautiful life of our beloved people and a lofty ideal we are going to achieve.
I pay high tribute to the days of creation, which you will glorify with vibrant youth and enthusiasm, and the traces, which you will leave with your strenuous efforts reflective of your ennobling spirit and vigorous steps.
Along with our ever-prospering times, the happy future of our parents and siblings will always encourage you.
Let us all advance forward,
For the high prestige of our army and young people,
For the transformation of this region to be envied by the world,
For the eternal prosperity of our motherland!
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his rallying speech, all the builders raised the stormy cheers “Hurrah!” with the pledge of single mind and loyalty looking up with soaring emotion to the great master of creation and construction that is finding all honors and prides of the revolutionary Party from the people’s happiness and bringing earlier the comprehensive rejuvenation and realistic change with his ardent spirit serving the people and great revolutionary will.
Kim Jong Undug the first spadeful of earth in celebration of the ceremony and pressed the button for blasting.
There was a loud sound of detonation signalling the brilliant future and fireworks were displayed.
The groundbreaking venue was filled with the ardent reverence for the great Party Central Committee that is turning the islet of disasters handed down generations into an urbanized and modern ideal village of civilization and efflorescence.
Meeting and encouraging the commanding officers of the large combined units of the services and the commanding officers of the youth shock brigade,Kim Jong Ungave a series of important instructions related to the project.
Repeatedly appraising that the People’s Army has always supported the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee without an inch of deflection and in unconditional practice, he advanced the militant task that the People’s Army should provide an eternal security guarantee on the islet area on the lower River Amnok and dynamically push forward with the dike project qualitatively to reliably defend the happy life of the people from any natural disaster in parallel with the construction of the greenhouse farm.
All the builders were full of the burning enthusiasm to invariably display the fame as the staunch defender and thoroughgoing executor of the Party’s policy by dedicating themselves to the revolutionary work for promoting the well-being of the people with the deep trust and expectation ofKim Jong Un, who put forward them as the vanguard of carrying out the historic cause unprecedented in the state building, and of the Party Central Committee cherished in their pulsating hearts.
The construction of the extra-large greenhouse farm to be launched in the northwestern end of the country is a great demonstration of the matchless guidance and inexhaustible fighting efficiency of the great WPK which is regarding the policy of regional development in the new era as the oath and pledge of the Party that solemnly made before the history and people and is stepping up the huge tasks of the centuries-old change most scientifically, revolutionarily and carefully. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 11 (KCNA) – A spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK issued the following press statement titled “We will make clearer our choice of action and mode of counteraction against the U.S.” on Feb.11:
The Los Angeles class nuclear-powered submarine Alexandria of the U.S. Navy entered the Pusan operation base of the ROK on February 10 under the pretext of the rest of the crew and replenishment of munitions.
The first overt emergence of a U.S. nuclear submarine in the Korean peninsula this year is a clear expression of the U.S. invariable hysteria for confrontation with the DPRK, and it is an undeniable threat to the security environment of the DPRK and an instable factor further escalating the military tension in the region.
The U.S. is openly ignoring the security concern of the DPRK.
We express grave concern over the U.S. dangerous hostile military act that can lead the acute military confrontation in the region around the Korean peninsula to an actual armed force conflict and strongly warn that the U.S. should stop provocations stirring up the instability any longer.
The practical reality clearly indicates why a new step for strengthening the nuclear capability and self-defensive power clarified by our head of state recently is just and which way we inevitably advance.
We will not flinch even an inch from the conflicting structure of the outrageous rival state.
To thoroughly contain only with corresponding strength the U.S., the hegemonic entity believing blindly in domination by strength, is the answer the reality is giving and the responding principle we have already maintained.
Our armed forces are strictly watching the frequent appearance of the U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula and are ready for using any means to defend the security and interests of the state and the regional peace.
We will make clearer our choice of action and mode of counteraction against our rivals.
The armed forces of the Republic always faithful to the constitutional duty to defend the security of the state will do acts of deterring the factors threatening the regional security environment and unhesitatingly exercise the legitimate right to punish the provokers. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary Denounces U.S. as Ferocious Robber
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- The world is now seething with the U.S. "bomb declaration".
The present U.S. administration on February 4 declared that if Palestinians in the Gaza Strip are displaced to other parts, the U.S. will take over it.
On February 9 the U.S. again blustered that it would buy, own and administer Gaza and that it could be divided into other regions to be rebuilt by other countries.
The whole world is stunned by the outrageous outbursts which wantonly trample on the slightest expectation of the Palestinians aspiring to regional peace and a stable life at a time when the domestic and international concern about the fragile truce in the tear- and blood-stained Gaza Strip is growing.
Not only Palestine, Iran and other Middle East countries but also even the Western allies of the U.S. denounce this as an "act of deporting people in Gaza ", "wanton violation of the UN Charter and international law", "disregard of the right to self-determination of Palestinians", "major obstacle to the two-state solution" and "act that can never be tolerated".
The U.S. natural character of existing through massacre and plunder and its hegemonic and aggressive ambition for world domination are clearly proved by the present days of Gaza, not by the past history.
The world people clearly remember who patronized and fostered the inhuman atrocities and vetoed several times the resolution of the UNSC which reflected the demand for an immediate truce, talking about Israel's "right to self-defence", and who gave the murderers cutting-edge lethal equipment and invited the war criminal to Congress to applaud him.
A voice was openly heard within Israel that the war can not be waged without the U.S. and world media commented that the U.S. policy towards the Middle East is the main cause of the Gaza crisis. Such facts clearly prove the criminal acts of the U.S., active participant and supporter of the massacres.
Far from feeling a bit of reflection at the wretched Gaza which turned into a grave of masses and debris, the U.S. openly blustered that it would displace Palestinians and administer the land, only to reveal by itself that its brigandish intention based on the jungle law to finally occupy the Gaza Strip and expand a new springboard for carrying out the strategy for dominating the Middle East is the bottom line of fanning the ambition of the territorial expansion of its minion.
This is the U.S., a ferocious robber of grabbing territory and sovereignty of other countries and nations, not content with wantonly violating their life and rights for its own interests.
It is by no means a problem belonging only to the Gaza Strip.
As soon as the present U.S. administration took office, it has mocked at international law and principles by attempting to make Greenland part of the U.S., advocating jurisdiction over the Panama Canal and renaming the Mexico Bay the "American Bay".
The sovereignty, right to self-determination and territorial integrity of the countries and nations can never be a bargaining chip or a mockery of the U.S.
The present era is not the old age when Anglo-Saxons crossed the sea and were keen on developing the West by exterminating the American aborigines and plundering them of their cradle of life. And the unipolar era when the United States lorded it over as the "only superpower", making international rules and order as it pleases, has already gone.
The U.S. should awaken from its anachronistic daydream and stop at once the act of encroaching upon the dignity and sovereignty of other countries and nations. -0-

headline: 20 Meters and 15 Minutes
story_text:
One day in June 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Sports Goods Factory.
Kim Jong Undevoted the utmost attention to the quality of products.
At the sample room, he hit the tennis ball on the floor and appreciated its good quality.
Saying that the quality of sports apparatuses is important, he told officials of the factory that they cannot improve the quality of sports goods if they were satisfied with the existing products in the manner of regarding them better than the old days.
He repeatedly said that the issue of improving quality should never be neglected, as if he was not relieved.
He said that he attached great importance to the issue of improving the quality of sports goods and that he made rounds of the section of the sample room less than 20 meters long for 15 minutes, judging the quality of each sample.
20 meters, it was the distance that will take only few seconds on foot, but he examined the sports goods in detail and gave instructions devoting precious 15 minutes as all sports goods were to be used by our children and people.
That day, the officials learned the truth that the issue of quality of products is precisely the one of the viewpoint on the people and that only when they have a true viewpoint of serving the people, can they produce famous products favoured by everybody. -0-

headline: Best Players and Coaches for 2024 Announced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- Those sportspersons, who fully demonstrated the dignity and might of Juche Korea in international and domestic games and contributed to the development of the country's sports technique last year, have been selected as the 10 best players and the 10 best coaches of the DPRK for 2024.
The 10 best players are Choe Il Son, a footballer of the April 25 Players Team, Jon Il Chong, a footballer of the Amnokgang Sports Club, Kang Hyon Gyong, a weightlifter of the Amnokgang Sports Club, Kim Il Gyong, a weightlifter of the April 25 Combat Sports Team, Ri Song Gum, a weightlifter of the April 25 Combat Sports Team, Jo Jin Mi, a diver of the Sobaeksu Players Team, Kim Mi Rae, a diver of the Pyongyang Sports Club, Kim Kum Yong, a table-tennis player of the Hwaebul Sports Club, Ri Jong Sik, a table-tennis player of the Amnokgang Sports Club, and Wang Myong Guk, a Taekwon-Do player of the Ryongaksan Taekwon-Do Players Team.
The 10 best coaches are Ri Song Ho, a coach of the Wolmido Football Team, Song Sung Gwon, chief coach of the Naegohyang Women's Football Players Team, Ri Song Hui, a weightlifting coach of the Amnokgang Sports Club, So Un Hak, a weightlifting coach of the April 25 Combat Sports Team, Kye Song Il, a weightlifting coach of the April 25 Combat Sports Team, Sin Jong Rim, a diving coach of the Sobaeksu Players Team, Kim Yun Mi, a table-tennis coach of the Hwaebul Sports Club, Kang Hyong Rak, a table-tennis coach of the Amnokgang Sports Club, Ri Chol Rim, a Taekwon-Do coach of the Ryongaksan Taekwon-Do Players Team, and Kim Mun Il,  chief greco-roman coach of the April 25 Combat Sports Team.
A meeting took place at the Weightlifting Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on February 11 to announce the 10 best players and the 10 best coaches of the DPRK for 2024.
Present there were Kim Myong Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, Kim Myong Gun, chairman of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, officials concerned and sportspersons.
The 10 best players and 10 best coaches of the DPRK for 2024 were announced at the meeting.
The vice-premier of the Cabinet awarded to the sportspersons, selected as 10 best players and 10 best coaches, the certificates and sportswear inscribed with the letters reading "DPRK's 10 Best Players for 2024" and "DPRK's 10 Best Coaches for 2024".
At the end of the meeting, a performance was given to congratulate the said players and coaches. -0-

Symposium of Social Scientists Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- A symposium of social scientists took place on February 11 to deeply grasp the undying feats the respected ComradeKim Jong Unperformed by ushering in a new era of regional development and transformation.
Present there were Thae Hyong Chol, president of the Academy of Social Sciences, and officials, teachers and researchers in the fields of science and education and Party cadres training institutions.
The symposium heard papers dealing with the undying feats ofKim Jong Un, who set it as the supreme principle of activities of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state to promote the people's well-being and realize their ideals and ushered in a new era, in which the regions are changing and prospering, with his outstanding ideas and seasoned leadership.
The papers were made public by Kim Myong Hui, a researcher of the WPK Central Cadres Training School, Pang Chol Jin, a researcher ofKim Il SungUniversity, Choe Jung Son, a teacher of the University of National Economy, and Hwang Kwang Yun, a researcher of the Academy of Social Sciences.
The speakers proved that the regional development policy set forth byKim Jong Unis a great action programme as it put an end to the centuries-old backwardness of regions and opened up a new history of regional rejuvenation.
They explained that the eye-opening changes in cities and counties across the country are a precious fruition of his revolutionary leadership for devotion to the people.
They stressed the need for the social scientists to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the sacred struggle for upholding his great idea and leadership over the regional development.
It is the first task of social scientists to explain and propagate in a theoretical and profound way his revolutionary ideas to the officials, Party members and other working people and prepare them as passionate loyalists cherishing the ideas of the Party Central Committee as their faith, they said, stressing the need to devote themselves to satisfactorily solving the theoretical and practical problems urgently arising in accelerating the regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Son of Working People
story_text:
It was one day in May 1961 when the project for expanding the Wasandong-Ryongsong road was under way.
During a break in the work, ChairmanKim Jong Ilmet a grandmother who came there to take coal frequently coming out from the place.
He asked if coal had run out at her house. Unaware of him, she said that the coal is too worthy to be buried underground.
Saying that she is right, he said the coal, although not abundant, can't be buried underground, and that students should learn from the people in this point and he personally put coal in her bucket with a shovel.
Moved by the personality ofKim Jong Ilfor the people, she said that she heard even the son of PresidentKim Il Sungwas at the construction site and that she wanted to meet him.
With a smile on his face, the Chairman said that she would meet him without fail in the future as she ardently wishes.
After knowing though belatedly that the man who was kind to her was the Chairman, she rushed to him.
Kim Jong Ilwarmly took the hands of her who was moved to tears and said that he was also the son of the working people and that he would do everything for the people.
Son of the working people!
His words to an ordinary grandmother reflect the world of the peerlessly great man who is determined to lead a glorious life as the son of the people. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket from Palestinian President
KCNA Commentary Denounces U.S. as Ferocious Robber
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- The world is now seething with the U.S. "bomb declaration".
The present U.S. administration on February 4 declared that if Palestinians in the Gaza Strip are displaced to other parts, the U.S. will take over it.
On February 9 the U.S. again blustered that it would buy, own and administer Gaza and that it could be divided into other regions to be rebuilt by other countries.
The whole world is stunned by the outrageous outbursts which wantonly trample on the slightest expectation of the Palestinians aspiring to regional peace and a stable life at a time when the domestic and international concern about the fragile truce in the tear- and blood-stained Gaza Strip is growing.
Not only Palestine, Iran and other Middle East countries but also even the Western allies of the U.S. denounce this as an "act of deporting people in Gaza ", "wanton violation of the UN Charter and international law", "disregard of the right to self-determination of Palestinians", "major obstacle to the two-state solution" and "act that can never be tolerated".
The U.S. natural character of existing through massacre and plunder and its hegemonic and aggressive ambition for world domination are clearly proved by the present days of Gaza, not by the past history.
The world people clearly remember who patronized and fostered the inhuman atrocities and vetoed several times the resolution of the UNSC which reflected the demand for an immediate truce, talking about Israel's "right to self-defence", and who gave the murderers cutting-edge lethal equipment and invited the war criminal to Congress to applaud him.
A voice was openly heard within Israel that the war can not be waged without the U.S. and world media commented that the U.S. policy towards the Middle East is the main cause of the Gaza crisis. Such facts clearly prove the criminal acts of the U.S., active participant and supporter of the massacres.
Far from feeling a bit of reflection at the wretched Gaza which turned into a grave of masses and debris, the U.S. openly blustered that it would displace Palestinians and administer the land, only to reveal by itself that its brigandish intention based on the jungle law to finally occupy the Gaza Strip and expand a new springboard for carrying out the strategy for dominating the Middle East is the bottom line of fanning the ambition of the territorial expansion of its minion.
This is the U.S., a ferocious robber of grabbing territory and sovereignty of other countries and nations, not content with wantonly violating their life and rights for its own interests.
It is by no means a problem belonging only to the Gaza Strip.
As soon as the present U.S. administration took office, it has mocked at international law and principles by attempting to make Greenland part of the U.S., advocating jurisdiction over the Panama Canal and renaming the Mexico Bay the "American Bay".
The sovereignty, right to self-determination and territorial integrity of the countries and nations can never be a bargaining chip or a mockery of the U.S.
The present era is not the old age when Anglo-Saxons crossed the sea and were keen on developing the West by exterminating the American aborigines and plundering them of their cradle of life. And the unipolar era when the United States lorded it over as the "only superpower", making international rules and order as it pleases, has already gone.
The U.S. should awaken from its anachronistic daydream and stop at once the act of encroaching upon the dignity and sovereignty of other countries and nations. -0-

headline: KCNA Report on Successfully Completing First Year's Task for Implementing Regional Development 20×10 Policy Set Forth by WPK Central Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 13 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency Wednesday released a report on the successful completion of the first year's task for implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy set forth by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
According to the report, the service personnel, officials and  working people across the country took a great step of the first advance in implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy of the Party and have successfully built modern regional-industry factories in conformity with the regional characteristics of 20 cities and counties and a new model base of offshore farming through an indomitable heroic struggle as structures commensurate with the idea, national power and the level of civilization of our times.
At the first workshop of chief secretaries of city and county Party committees, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the plan for opening up a new period of regional development, formulated the policy orientation and set forth a great revolutionary strategy for completely renovating regional-industry factories on the basis of proving the possibility of developing the material and cultural life of all cities and counties across the country.
The Regional Development 20×10 Policy, set forth at the Tenth Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly on January 15, 2024, is a great transformative line and a gigantic revolution in whichKim Jong Unhas chosen a proper time and made a crucial decision to eliminate the century-old backwardness of regions, realize the long-cherished desire of regional people and bring about a turn in the realm of our people's understanding.
The 19th Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK solemnly declared the measures and policies for thoroughly implementing the most revolutionary, popular and original Regional Development 20×10 Policy, which comprehensively reflectedKim Jong Un's spirit of ardently serving the people and resolute will of a great revolutionary.
Kim Jong Unenergetically led the first year's advance for implementing the regional development policy, making a ceaseless journey of devotion and efforts.
He took a dawn road of the field guidance at Kimhwa County again in February 2024 and made sure that the architectural style and modern level of the new regional-industry factories were set higher and set forth the principled requirements and important tasks to be observed in construction.
He attended a ground-breaking ceremony of regional- industry factories in Songchon County, personally awarded the regiment flags to the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army newly formed for the implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy and declared before the world the start of a gigantic regional development revolution. This was a significant event that redoubled the conviction of a bright future of the general advance for dynamically opening up a new era of national prosperity, united with patriotism.
Under his energetic guidance, the city of Sinpho of South Hamgyong Province was set as a model unit of offshore farming, and the Tenth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK adopted the issue of successfully building the Sinpho City Offshore Farm into a new model offshore farming base as a decision of the Party.
At a consultative meeting of regional development work, an important speech he made on the national day and other occasions, he set forth a new policy orientation on accelerating the historic cause of regional rejuvenation by adding three essential projects including public health facilities, leisure complexes and grain management stations to the construction of regional-industry factories.
The People's Army, the most reliable defender of our state and the devoted implementer of the Party policies, stood in the vanguard of another grand construction projects for opening up a new phase of regional development along with the implementation of the programme for the rural revolution.
The soldier-builders dispatched to Songchon County, holding high the glorious regiment flag conferred by the Party Central Committee as the banner of advance, made the first breakthrough in attaining the long-term goal.
Despite difficulties of the northern geographical and climatic conditions from the start, the soldier-builders dispatched to Usi, Tongsin, Kyongsong, Orang and Kim Hyong Jik counties continued the excavating work even in cold mud and laid the foundations of regional-industry factories by introducing advanced construction methods.
True to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to ensure the highest quality in the construction of regional-industry factories, a new change was brought about in the viewpoint of officials and builders on the construction and a climate of giving priority to quality was thoroughly established throughout the construction sites.
By thoroughly applying the Party's policy on afforestation, the soldier-builders radically changed the appearance around the factories by planting more than 15 000 trees including zelkova, ginkgo, apricot and persimmon trees, flower shrubs and turfs.
Remaining faithful to the order of the Party Central Committee with single mind and loyalty, service personnel of the Korean People's Army pushed ahead with the construction of the modern Sinpho City Offshore Farm, a new model of offshore farming.
Many servicepersons of the KPA units at all levels did difficult and labor-consuming work at the construction sites of regional-industry factories during their citation furlough. Servicepersons' families encouraged the builders through peculiar frontline-style motivation and sincere supply service and devoted the sincerity to them as their mothers and sisters would do.
Under the slogan "Let Us Help the People!" the officers and men of the People's Army launched the mass movement to do even one good thing for the people in the bustling days of construction.
The first fruits of the regional rejuvenation were produced as the people's treasures thanks to the patriotic devotion of the officers and men of the 124th regiments of the KPA who have achieved miraculous successes and created legendary tales of construction.
In the first year for the implementation of the regional development policy of our Party, valuable experience and great assets were provided in laying the material and technical foundations for the self-supporting and sustainable development of the regions.
In parallel with the construction work, the manufacturing and assembling of the equipment for furnishing the regional-industry factories with a complete set of various kinds of comprehensive and modern equipment were stepped up as planned.
The workers of industrial establishments in metal, chemical, electric power, construction and building materials, forestry and other sectors of the national economy have also brought about an upsurge in production at their workplaces, and the railway and land and marine transport sectors have meticulously organized and commanded transport to ensure the transport of materials to the construction theatres.
The February 17 Shock Brigades of Scientists and Technicians were formed to dynamically push forward the successful implementation of the regional development policy of the WPK by dint of science and technology and excellently played the role of the sci-tech advancing group and the vanguard of mass technological innovation movement.
The Ministry of Regional Industry, the Ministry of Labour and other relevant ministries, national agencies and every province worked out detailed plans for training skilled workers at modernly-built regional-industry factories and carried them out steadily, and thus trained a large number of skilled workers to be deeply involved in putting production on a normal basis.
The work for creating their own solid raw material bases and revitalizing their operation was launched at all the cities and counties as the Party committees’ work, only to achieve rich results.
The State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Grain Administration, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Light Industry, etc., and provinces, cities and counties secured and supplied various kinds of raw materials so that the regional-industry factories use them until they fully lay their foundations of production.
Officials and workers of the Ministry of Fisheries, the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry and the machine-building and chemical industrial sectors in the Hamhung area gave precedence to supplying raw materials and conducted the mass technical innovation movement to fully produce equipment and materials needed for the operation of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
The relevant sector of the KPA and the Taesong Trading Guidance Bureau built and donated a new-type factory mother-ship and scores of farming ships and submarine boats and made a great contribution to laying the material and technical foundations of the farm.
Many officials, working people, young people and women's union members have volunteered to work at regional-industry factories and raw materials bases and their ranks are on the steady increase.
A wave of jubilation and emotion has swept the whole country day by day thanks to the inaugurations of the regional-industry factories in Songchon County and the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, which significantly decorated the end of the last year, and the inaugurations of the regional-industry factories across the country, which opened up a brilliant prelude to the year of 2025.
The struggle in the past one year which confidently opened up the stage of full-scale implementation for realizing the WPK's cherished desire was a gigantic drive for creation to be specially recorded in the history, which redoubled the conviction that everything the respected ComradeKim Jong Undecides and unfolds would always turn into excellent entities, and instilled into the whole people the boundless confidence and optimism that the great historic cause of comprehensive development can be surely accomplished when they fully display the spirit of self-sustenance, upholding single-mindedly the Party's plan and leadership.
All the officials, working people and officers and men of the People's Army are dynamically advancing toward higher goals with loyalty and patriotic desire to glorify this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea with the new successes of the regional rejuvenation under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of the great Party Central Committee which leads to victory the epochal changes of the national prosperity, the report stressed. -0-

headline: Youth League Organizations Support Farms
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 13 (KCNA) -- Youth league organizations in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK render active assistance to the youth workteams and sub-workteams in farms out in a drive to attain the grain production goal for this year.

The Regional Development 20×10 Policy, set forth at the Tenth Session of the 14th Supreme People’s Assembly on January 15, 2024, is a great transformative line and a gigantic revolution in whichKim Jong Unhas chosen a proper time and made a crucial decision to eliminate the century-old backwardness of regions, realize the long-cherished desire of regional people and bring about a turn in the realm of our people's understanding.
The 19th Enlarged Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK solemnly declared the measures and policies for thoroughly implementing the most revolutionary, popular and original Regional Development 20×10 Policy, which comprehensively reflectedKim Jong Un's spirit of ardently serving the people and resolute will of a great revolutionary.
Kim Jong Unenergetically led the first year's advance for implementing the regional development policy, making a ceaseless journey of devotion and efforts.
He took a dawn road of the field guidance at Kimhwa County again in February 2024 and made sure that the architectural style and modern level of the new regional-industry factories were set higher and set forth the principled requirements and important tasks to be observed in construction.
He attended a ground-breaking ceremony of regional- industry factories in Songchon County, personally awarded the regiment flags to the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army newly formed for the implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy and declared before the world the start of a gigantic regional development revolution. This was a significant event that redoubled the conviction of a bright future of the general advance for dynamically opening up a new era of national prosperity, united with patriotism.
Under his energetic guidance, the city of Sinpho of South Hamgyong Province was set as a model unit of offshore farming, and the Tenth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK adopted the issue of successfully building the Sinpho City Offshore Farm into a new model offshore farming base as a decision of the Party.
At a consultative meeting of regional development work, an important speech he made on the national day and other occasions, he set forth a new policy orientation on accelerating the historic cause of regional rejuvenation by adding three essential projects including public health facilities, leisure complexes and grain management stations to the construction of regional-industry factories.
The People's Army, the most reliable defender of our state and the devoted implementer of the Party policies, stood in the vanguard of another grand construction projects for opening up a new phase of regional development along with the implementation of the programme for the rural revolution.
The soldier-builders dispatched to Songchon County, holding high the glorious regiment flag conferred by the Party Central Committee as the banner of advance, made the first breakthrough in attaining the long-term goal.
Despite difficulties of the northern geographical and climatic conditions from the start, the soldier-builders dispatched to Usi, Tongsin, Kyongsong, Orang and Kim Hyong Jik counties continued the excavating work even in cold mud and laid the foundations of regional-industry factories by introducing advanced construction methods.
True to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to ensure the highest quality in the construction of regional-industry factories, a new change was brought about in the viewpoint of officials and builders on the construction and a climate of giving priority to quality was thoroughly established throughout the construction sites.
By thoroughly applying the Party's policy on afforestation, the soldier-builders radically changed the appearance around the factories by planting more than 15 000 trees including zelkova, ginkgo, apricot and persimmon trees, flower shrubs and turfs.
Remaining faithful to the order of the Party Central Committee with single mind and loyalty, service personnel of the Korean People's Army pushed ahead with the construction of the modern Sinpho City Offshore Farm, a new model of offshore farming.
Many servicepersons of the KPA units at all levels did difficult and labor-consuming work at the construction sites of regional-industry factories during their citation furlough. Servicepersons' families encouraged the builders through peculiar frontline-style motivation and sincere supply service and devoted the sincerity to them as their mothers and sisters would do.
Under the slogan "Let Us Help the People!" the officers and men of the People's Army launched the mass movement to do even one good thing for the people in the bustling days of construction.
The first fruits of the regional rejuvenation were produced as the people's treasures thanks to the patriotic devotion of the officers and men of the 124th regiments of the KPA who have achieved miraculous successes and created legendary tales of construction.
In the first year for the implementation of the regional development policy of our Party, valuable experience and great assets were provided in laying the material and technical foundations for the self-supporting and sustainable development of the regions.
In parallel with the construction work, the manufacturing and assembling of the equipment for furnishing the regional-industry factories with a complete set of various kinds of comprehensive and modern equipment were stepped up as planned.
The workers of industrial establishments in metal, chemical, electric power, construction and building materials, forestry and other sectors of the national economy have also brought about an upsurge in production at their workplaces, and the railway and land and marine transport sectors have meticulously organized and commanded transport to ensure the transport of materials to the construction theatres.
The February 17 Shock Brigades of Scientists and Technicians were formed to dynamically push forward the successful implementation of the regional development policy of the WPK by dint of science and technology and excellently played the role of the sci-tech advancing group and the vanguard of mass technological innovation movement.
The Ministry of Regional Industry, the Ministry of Labour and other relevant ministries, national agencies and every province worked out detailed plans for training skilled workers at modernly-built regional-industry factories and carried them out steadily, and thus trained a large number of skilled workers to be deeply involved in putting production on a normal basis.
The work for creating their own solid raw material bases and revitalizing their operation was launched at all the cities and counties as the Party committees’ work, only to achieve rich results.
The State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Grain Administration, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Light Industry, etc., and provinces, cities and counties secured and supplied various kinds of raw materials so that the regional-industry factories use them until they fully lay their foundations of production.
Officials and workers of the Ministry of Fisheries, the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry and the machine-building and chemical industrial sectors in the Hamhung area gave precedence to supplying raw materials and conducted the mass technical innovation movement to fully produce equipment and materials needed for the operation of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
The relevant sector of the KPA and the Taesong Trading Guidance Bureau built and donated a new-type factory mother-ship and scores of farming ships and submarine boats and made a great contribution to laying the material and technical foundations of the farm.
Many officials, working people, young people and women's union members have volunteered to work at regional-industry factories and raw materials bases and their ranks are on the steady increase.
A wave of jubilation and emotion has swept the whole country day by day thanks to the inaugurations of the regional-industry factories in Songchon County and the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, which significantly decorated the end of the last year, and the inaugurations of the regional-industry factories across the country, which opened up a brilliant prelude to the year of 2025.
The struggle in the past one year which confidently opened up the stage of full-scale implementation for realizing the WPK's cherished desire was a gigantic drive for creation to be specially recorded in the history, which redoubled the conviction that everything the respected ComradeKim Jong Undecides and unfolds would always turn into excellent entities, and instilled into the whole people the boundless confidence and optimism that the great historic cause of comprehensive development can be surely accomplished when they fully display the spirit of self-sustenance, upholding single-mindedly the Party's plan and leadership.
All the officials, working people and officers and men of the People's Army are dynamically advancing toward higher goals with loyalty and patriotic desire to glorify this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea with the new successes of the regional rejuvenation under the outstanding and seasoned leadership of the great Party Central Committee which leads to victory the epochal changes of the national prosperity, the report stressed. -0-

headline: First Full Moon Day Observed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 13 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK enjoyed the first full moon day (January 15th of the lunar calendar), a folk holiday.
Citizens in Pyongyang visited the Rangnang Museum in the Rangnang area and spent a pleasant time with archery and other colorful folk games.
Various kinds of national foods were served at public catering establishments in the capital city and regions of the country decked in a festive mood.
The Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum, the Munsu Water Park and other amenities were crowded with working people, youth and students.
The holiday atmosphere was revved up with housewives making national foods and dishes with sincerity at homes, working people playing chess and yut-game and cheerful children enjoying folk games.
When the full moon came up, conspicuous scenes of citizens enjoying it were seen in Moran Hill, Ryongwang Pavilion, Songhwa, Hwasong, Rimhung and Jonwi streets of Pyongyang and in all other parts of the country.
Enjoying the folk holiday, the people in the county heartily wished good health to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who is cultivating a grand flower garden of love for the people with his immense passion and warm affection, and hoped for the national prosperity and the happiness of families. -0-

story_text:

headline: Celebrations Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Meetings, book and photo exhibitions and film shows took place in Laos, Myanmar, Pakistan, Norway, Switzerland and Finland between Feb. 7 and 9 on the occasion of the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present at the events were personages of various circles and masses in those countries.
Screened at film shows were a film dealing with the noble revolutionary career and exploits ofKim Jong Iland videos showing the proud reality of the DPRK being changed under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and the happy life of its people.
Speeches were made at the events.
The chairman of the Norway-Korea Friendship Association and the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League said that the world people are recollecting with deep emotion the exploits ofKim Jong Il, who made great contributions to the Korean revolution and the human cause of independence, on the occasion of the February holiday, adding that his devotion and efforts for the cause of global peace are deeply cherished in the minds of mankind.
The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee praisedKim Jong Ilas a seasoned and experienced state leader who consolidated the single-minded unity of the whole society as firm as a rock and bolstered up the national defence capabilities in every way to smash the U.S. imperialists' moves for aggression at every step and firmly defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country and the destiny of the people.
The revolutionary cause of Juche dynamically led by ComradeKim Jong Ilis victoriously advancing thanks to ComradeKim Jong Un, he noted. The future of the DPRK guided byKim Jong Unis bright and rosy, he said, adding that the world progressives are convinced of the victory of the socialist cause in the DPRK's development.
A congratulatory message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the event held in Switzerland. -0-

headline: Overhauling Waterway Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Officials and shock brigade members of the waterway construction division are pushing ahead with the project for overhauling the Kaechon-Lake Thaesong and Phyongnam irrigation waterways at the final stage.
The Pyongyang Municipal Brigade finished the project for concrete covering of some parts of the waterway tunnels till November last year and completed the project for waterway tunnel in the area of Komhung-ri in Sukchon County.
The North Hamgyong Provincial Brigade has overfulfilled its daily project task by raising the operating rate of equipment and introducing valuable technical innovations. The South Hamgyong Provincial Brigade has increased the working speed and quality, ensuring mixing ratio of concrete mixture.
The Nampho Municipal Brigade and the South Phyongan Provincial Brigade have introduced a rational method to shorten the hardening time and made good result in concrete tamping, giving precedence to transporting materials.
The Jagang Provincial Brigade finished the concrete covering project of the section under its charge in a qualitative way and the Taedong Irrigation Construction Brigade completed the waterway tunnel project, pushing ahead with the concrete covering and muck conveying in a three-dimensional way. -0-

headline: Floral Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Abroad
KCNA Commentary Sneers at Puppet ROK and Its Master
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- The confrontation hysteria against the DPRK is getting evermore pronounced in the puppet ROK amid the worsening political chaos.
In January alone, riff-raffs acting for the arrested former bosses were busy visiting units of the puppet army to let loose such reckless remarks as "punishment by overwhelming force" and "heavy price" that put even the predecessors into the shade. The puppet defence ministry announced a "business plan for 2025" with clear-cut anti-DPRK confrontational nature, in which it decided to increase the number of field mobile maneuvers at brigade and above level by far more than last year, hitting an all-time high, in the period of Freedom Shield, a joint military drill with the U.S. to be staged this year.
What is more serious is the moves for arms buildup in parallel with the confrontational reckless remarks.
The puppet ROK is planning to purchase helicopters for naval operations from the U.S. in a bid to enhance the attack capability against submarine and others of the DPRK, while accelerating the introduction of attack and reconnaissance drones for special operation.
Some days ago, it cooked up a "naval task force command", loudly advertising it as the "core force of national defence" to cope with "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK. And it even cried out for "winning a war", improper to the position of a colonial servant.
What matters is that though the incumbent president has turned into a defendant and a political confusion by the scramble for power and the dog-fight for existence has appeared in the puppet ROK, the puppet military is persistently resorting to the confrontation moves aimed at the DPRK.
It is as clear as noonday that the U.S. played its role to inspire the puppet military.
With the great political confusion in the puppet ROK by Yoon Suk Yeol's announcement of the emergency martial law, the U.S. authorities vied with each other to remark that mutual military cooperation is still strongly maintained and it will last beyond the present government and that the ROK is an important partner of the U.S. in the India-Pacific region.
Shortly ago, the U.S. secretary of Defence phoned a person acting as the puppet defence minister to incite the confrontation with the DPRK, talking about the "strong joint defence posture" to effectively "deter" and "counter" the "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK.
It is the demand of the master U.S. that the puppet ROK should continue to "faithfully play the role" of a shock brigade in carrying out the former's strategy for hegemony, whether the latter falls into chaos or not. And it is the plight of the puppet forces, the servants of the U.S., that they have to meet the demand of their master even if their family collapses.
The DPRK can never overlook the reckless nature of the enemies, though it is little short of the acts of the foolish servant with the dull-witted master.
The desperate confrontation moves of the immutable arch enemies show in practice that entirely just is the DPRK's steadfast stand which is to thoroughly contain and frustrate their moves on the strength of powerful military muscle by bolstering up its defence capabilities more radically.
The U.S. should directly look at its rival and the change of the world and stop such foolish act as burning itself to the fire it has set. -0-

headline: Oratorical Meeting Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- An oratorical meeting took place at the People's Palace of Culture on Friday to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Kyong Chol, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, and officials and working people in Pyongyang.
At the oratorical meeting, the performers highly praised the noble revolutionary career ofKim Jong Ilwho devoted his all to the beloved country and people and performed immortal exploits in the history of the country and the personality of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the peerlessly great man who ushered in a heyday of the DPRK's overall prosperity with his rare idea and theory and gigantic leadership practices.
They impressively depicted the noble traits of the peerlessly great men who adorned the Korean revolution with a great history of comradeship, making their revolutionary soldiers enjoy an eternal life with their noble moral obligation that no one can have in the world.
They said that the future of the DPRK is rosy as it is led byKim Jong Unwho regards it as the greatest honor to shoulder everything that is for making the people live with pleasure and promoting their well-being.
They called for demonstrating to the whole world the mightiness of greatKim Jong Un's Korea, saying that workers should be pioneers and masters of making miracles in the struggle for increased production, peasants patriotic those who reap a good harvest and sportspersons patriots who fly the flag of the DPRK in international games. -0-

headline: Great Life Embroidered with Creation for Country and People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilwas a genius of creation and construction who laid a solid foundation for the prosperity and development of the country with his rare wisdom and distinguished leadership ability.
The noblest pleasure of man lies in creation. This is his outlook on life and motto. So he regarded it as his life’s pleasure and happiness to ceaselessly create new things for the country and people.

headline: KCNA Commentary Sneers at Puppet ROK and Its Master
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- The confrontation hysteria against the DPRK is getting evermore pronounced in the puppet ROK amid the worsening political chaos.
In January alone, riff-raffs acting for the arrested former bosses were busy visiting units of the puppet army to let loose such reckless remarks as "punishment by overwhelming force" and "heavy price" that put even the predecessors into the shade. The puppet defence ministry announced a "business plan for 2025" with clear-cut anti-DPRK confrontational nature, in which it decided to increase the number of field mobile maneuvers at brigade and above level by far more than last year, hitting an all-time high, in the period of Freedom Shield, a joint military drill with the U.S. to be staged this year.
What is more serious is the moves for arms buildup in parallel with the confrontational reckless remarks.
The puppet ROK is planning to purchase helicopters for naval operations from the U.S. in a bid to enhance the attack capability against submarine and others of the DPRK, while accelerating the introduction of attack and reconnaissance drones for special operation.
Some days ago, it cooked up a "naval task force command", loudly advertising it as the "core force of national defence" to cope with "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK. And it even cried out for "winning a war", improper to the position of a colonial servant.
What matters is that though the incumbent president has turned into a defendant and a political confusion by the scramble for power and the dog-fight for existence has appeared in the puppet ROK, the puppet military is persistently resorting to the confrontation moves aimed at the DPRK.
It is as clear as noonday that the U.S. played its role to inspire the puppet military.
With the great political confusion in the puppet ROK by Yoon Suk Yeol's announcement of the emergency martial law, the U.S. authorities vied with each other to remark that mutual military cooperation is still strongly maintained and it will last beyond the present government and that the ROK is an important partner of the U.S. in the India-Pacific region.
Shortly ago, the U.S. secretary of Defence phoned a person acting as the puppet defence minister to incite the confrontation with the DPRK, talking about the "strong joint defence posture" to effectively "deter" and "counter" the "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK.
It is the demand of the master U.S. that the puppet ROK should continue to "faithfully play the role" of a shock brigade in carrying out the former's strategy for hegemony, whether the latter falls into chaos or not. And it is the plight of the puppet forces, the servants of the U.S., that they have to meet the demand of their master even if their family collapses.
The DPRK can never overlook the reckless nature of the enemies, though it is little short of the acts of the foolish servant with the dull-witted master.
The desperate confrontation moves of the immutable arch enemies show in practice that entirely just is the DPRK's steadfast stand which is to thoroughly contain and frustrate their moves on the strength of powerful military muscle by bolstering up its defence capabilities more radically.
The U.S. should directly look at its rival and the change of the world and stop such foolish act as burning itself to the fire it has set. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Chief of Policy Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Policy Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Saturday issued the following press statement titled "The DPRK's bolstering of its self-defensive capabilities is an essential requirement for deterring rivals' ever-increasing various provocative attempts and ensuring the security of the state":
Some days ago, the commander of the U.S. Northern Command said that the DPRK has secured the capability to strike the whole of North America with nukes, adding that the DPRK's ICBM forces are posing a threat to the security of the U.S. mainland and its missile defense system.
The U.S. is bringing a serious threat to the security environment of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world while seeking reckless arms buildup and radical modernization of nuclear force. Therefore, the U.S. talking about the "threat" from someone is a brigandish sophism like a guilty party filing the suit first, making profound confusing of right and wrong.
The strategic armed forces of the DPRK are the ones for defence to guarantee the security of the state and the strategic balance of the region.
The U.S. describing this as a "threat" only proves that it is hostile to the DPRK.
We express serious concern over the U.S. military's confrontational behavior to build up public opinion about the non-existent "threat" from the DPRK and justify the adventurous military ambition to gain the superiority of strength in the region under its pretext.
The present U.S. administration is advocating the establishment of an offensive missile defense system aimed at preemptive attack on other countries and weaponization of outer space under the pretext of defending its mainland. Timed to coincide with this, the commander of the U.S. Northern Command is talking about "the threat from the DPRK". This clearly shows what its real purpose is.
Shortly ago, the U.S. nuclear submarine openly entered the Korean peninsula, interested persons of the U.S. Space Force conspired with the Japanese and the ROK military gangsters to share information for detecting the ballistic missiles of the DPRK and conduct joint space exercises and the U.S. and the ROK militaries are planning to enforce the large-scale war drill Freedom Shield in March. All these facts become a good reason for the DPRK's bolstering of its corresponding defence capabilities to cope with the escalating military threat by rival states.
If the U.S. has real concern about the security of its mainland, the only way to remove it is to thoroughly abandon its military threat and hostile policy toward independent and sovereign states.
It is the just self-defensive right of a sovereign state to steadily develop the self-defence capability capable of effectively containing all the security threats of the present and future and ensuring the security of the state and the strategic balance of the region.
The armed forces of the DPRK will as ever fully deter and control all kinds of challenges and threats from its rival countries by dint of powerful self-defence capability and faithfully discharge their mission for reliably defending peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the region. -0-

headline: Outstanding Thinker and Theoretician
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- Today the Korean people are dynamically advancing the cause of building a powerful socialist country based on the revolutionary exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Regarding the building of a powerful socialist country of Juche as his lifetime desire,Kim Jong Ilindicated the road of building a powerful country with his outstanding ideo-theoretical activities and laid a solid foundation for the prosperity of the country while making a ceaseless forced march for field guidance.
He clarified the theoretical and practical issues arising in building a powerful country with his energetic thinking and extraordinary inquiry.
As he formulated the Juche idea, the revolutionary idea of PresidentKim Il Sung, as Kimilsungism, the DPRK could put forward the advantageous revolutionary idea suited to its actual conditions as the state political idea and, on its basis, renovate all fields of state and social life.
His unique ideas and theories, including the Juche-oriented theory of ideology and the idea of living in our own way, served as the banner of sure victory in the revolution and construction.
The line of attaching importance to ideology, arms and science and technology, the strategy of self-reliance in the new century and other ideas and theories clarified byKim Jong Ilwere powerful weapons that made it possible to successfully pave the road of building a Korean-style rich country with strong army in all fields of state activities.
Thanks to his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and leadership, the destiny of the country and people was firmly defended and a foundation for the happiness of posterity was laid in the acute and complicated vortex of the 20th century.
The idea of building a powerful socialist country, advanced byKim Jong Illooking forward to the rosy future of Juche Korea with confidence, and his revolutionary exploits are shining along with the new era of the comprehensive national development. -0-

headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony of Rakwon County Offshore Farm Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- A modern large-scale offshore farm will be built in Rakwon County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, under the 2025 regional development plan decided by the historic Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Last year the respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaw to it that the Sinpho City Offshore Farm was built as a model of offshore farming in the new era, opening up a bright prospect for boosting the economic independence of cities and counties along the coast. And he set forth the honourable tasks to build an offshore farm in Rakwon County, advanced and adapted to local conditions, and to turn the fishing village area into an ideal people's village symbolic of new socialist civilization by building houses in parallel, after indicating a more development-oriented goal for restoring the fishing industry of the country with aquaculture as the main sphere and fundamentally improving the material foundation for regional economy and the people's livelihood at the enlarged meeting of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee.
The grand construction campaign for implementing the regional development policy, which is being expanded day by day while making a more dynamic advance thanks to the steadfast will ofKim Jong Unto make the regional people the happiest as early as possible, is a clear manifestation of the noble political idea and the legendary creativity and practical ability of our great Party and socialist state which are ushering in the great era of the people-first principle.
A groundbreaking ceremony of the Rakwon County Offshore Farm took place on February 14.
The venue of the ceremony was filled with the uplifted spirit of the soldier-builders to prove the validity and vitality of the Party's policies with the development of regional economy and happy laughter of the regional people by creating a peculiar edifice of regional changes and another fairyland of the East Sea in Rakwon County through the continuous devoted efforts for the eternal prosperity of the country and the promotion of people's well-being, and with the delight and joy of the inhabitants in Rakwon County who feel the vibrant new life.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the groundbreaking ceremony.
Present there were Jo Yong Won, Pak Jong Chon and No Kwang Chol and officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province and Rakwon County and soldier-builders.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the ceremony venue, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, extending boundless gratitude to the prominent leader of the revolution, the great father of the people who is continuously following the long journey of devoted service to the people, to be immortal in the history of the country's prosperity, and steadfastly carrying out the centuries-old cause of regional rejuvenation for the simultaneous and balanced development of the country.
Waving back to the cheering masses,Kim Jong Unsent warm blessings to all the inhabitants and officials in Rakwon County greeting the historic occasion of heralding the greater happiness.
He said that the construction of the second modern offshore base would be started in the wake of Sinpho City under the policy of the WPK on effectively developing and utilizing the regional natural and economic resources. After deciding the construction of the Rakwon County Offshore Farm at the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee, the Party Central Committee had discussed and examined a lot of issues including the fixing of right place for aquaculture and the architectural design from the outset of the year, he said, adding that even this site was the one he personally chose.
This place is free from adverse marine meteorological effects and convenient to build wharf and breakwater as it is enclosed with land on three sides and it is very close to the farm, rich in aquatic animals and plants and superior in the aspect of marine ecology and therefore, it is the most suitable site for building a farm, he noted. He said with pleasure that he would present the most beautiful fishing village in the world to Rakwon County by building a modern offshore farm in the area and even flats sustaining the characteristics of the coastal area and that it would be a good idea to call the fishing village "Rakwonpho" in the future.
Noting that the prospect of the development of Rakwon County, which belongs to the smallest county in the country and has weak economic foundations, lies in making good use of the sea, he said it is his desire to lay a sure foundation for development and create a model socialist paradise to be proud of so that Rakwon County would prosper forever to suit its name Rakwon (paradise).
He proudly said that if the farm was built more peculiar and excellent than the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and a rare fishing village was created that no one has yet witnessed, it would become a symbol of the validity and prospect of the regional development policy pursued by the Party, a model symbolizing the future change of Rakwon County and a brilliant page will be recorded in the history of the county.
He noted that the inauguration ceremonies of regional-industry factories have been held with splendor in the areas of one tenth of the whole country almost everyday for more than one month from the end of last year as a proud fruition of the one-year struggle for implementing the regional development policy of the WPK. This proves that the scope of our struggle has been remarkably expanded and a powerful motive force has been created to advance our cause, he added.
He said that our Party would as ever be more transparent and steadfast in defending the demand and rights and interests of the people, adding that in such meaning the present groundbreaking ceremony serves as an important occasion for reaffirming and re-clarifying the steadfast principled stand of the Party and the government absolutely serving the people.
Saying that aquaculture in our country is a sphere of resources development whose economic and prospective nature have already been proved and a sure guarantee for the development of cities and counties located in the coastal areas, he indicated the orientation and ways for the coastal cities and counties to effectively mobilize and utilize marine resources on the basis of scientific study and analysis of the natural and geographical conditions and marine ecological environment.
The future of Rakwon entirely depends on its inhabitants, he said, calling on the officials and working people in the county to turn out in the maritime industry, regarding it as a vital issue, and thus open up a new sphere of aquaculture peculiar to Rakwon County.
He said that it is necessary to dynamically usher in, with our resolute struggle and ceaseless creation of miracles, the new era of comprehensive prosperity, a period of new development and turn to be greeted by all the people in rich life improved in quality, expressing again his firm will to dynamically push forward with the great cause of regional transformation for realizing the people's long-cherished desire.
Kim Jong Undug the first spadeful of earth in celebration of the ceremony.
The venue was swept with the absolute trust in our great Party and great emotion and thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" broke out again amid the fireworks setting off to beautifully decorate the sky of February.
Expressing his respect for the warm sincerity and courageous efforts of the service personnel who are devoting themselves to the people's happiness true to the Party's plan,Kim Jong Unexpressed the belief and expectation that the officers and soldiers of the People's Army would build an ideal sea village of Korean style admired by the world with boundless loyalty, courageous disposition and unique creative mettle and proudly bring about a new miracle of regional change.
All the soldier-builders, bearing deep in their mind the glorious mission and duty as the performers of the great revolution, hardened the will to fully display the noble name of our army in the vanguard for realizing the sacred cause of regional development in the new era guided by our Party.
The groundbreaking ceremony of the modern offshore farm and fishing village, held with splendor in Rakwon County, serves as a significant occasion of demonstrating once again the spirit and stamina of the DPRK which is making a steady leap forward toward a prosperous future with the steadfast will, noble ideal and grandiose ambition of our Party to turn all cities and counties of the whole country into highly-civilized and rich places, independent and developed in a diverse way and good to live in. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Baskets from Abroad
Outstanding Thinker and Theoretician
