Regarding the building of a powerful socialist country of Juche as his lifetime desire,Kim Jong Ilindicated the road of building a powerful country with his outstanding ideo-theoretical activities and laid a solid foundation for the prosperity of the country while making a ceaseless forced march for field guidance.
He clarified the theoretical and practical issues arising in building a powerful country with his energetic thinking and extraordinary inquiry.
As he formulated the Juche idea, the revolutionary idea of PresidentKim Il Sung, as Kimilsungism, the DPRK could put forward the advantageous revolutionary idea suited to its actual conditions as the state political idea and, on its basis, renovate all fields of state and social life.
His unique ideas and theories, including the Juche-oriented theory of ideology and the idea of living in our own way, served as the banner of sure victory in the revolution and construction.
The line of attaching importance to ideology, arms and science and technology, the strategy of self-reliance in the new century and other ideas and theories clarified byKim Jong Ilwere powerful weapons that made it possible to successfully pave the road of building a Korean-style rich country with strong army in all fields of state activities.

headline: Study Tour of Mt Paektu
Press Statement by Chief of Policy Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Policy Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Saturday issued the following press statement titled "The DPRK's bolstering of its self-defensive capabilities is an essential requirement for deterring rivals' ever-increasing various provocative attempts and ensuring the security of the state":
Some days ago, the commander of the U.S. Northern Command said that the DPRK has secured the capability to strike the whole of North America with nukes, adding that the DPRK's ICBM forces are posing a threat to the security of the U.S. mainland and its missile defense system.
The U.S. is bringing a serious threat to the security environment of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world while seeking reckless arms buildup and radical modernization of nuclear force. Therefore, the U.S. talking about the "threat" from someone is a brigandish sophism like a guilty party filing the suit first, making profound confusing of right and wrong.
The strategic armed forces of the DPRK are the ones for defence to guarantee the security of the state and the strategic balance of the region.
The U.S. describing this as a "threat" only proves that it is hostile to the DPRK.
We express serious concern over the U.S. military's confrontational behavior to build up public opinion about the non-existent "threat" from the DPRK and justify the adventurous military ambition to gain the superiority of strength in the region under its pretext.
The present U.S. administration is advocating the establishment of an offensive missile defense system aimed at preemptive attack on other countries and weaponization of outer space under the pretext of defending its mainland. Timed to coincide with this, the commander of the U.S. Northern Command is talking about "the threat from the DPRK". This clearly shows what its real purpose is.
Shortly ago, the U.S. nuclear submarine openly entered the Korean peninsula, interested persons of the U.S. Space Force conspired with the Japanese and the ROK military gangsters to share information for detecting the ballistic missiles of the DPRK and conduct joint space exercises and the U.S. and the ROK militaries are planning to enforce the large-scale war drill Freedom Shield in March. All these facts become a good reason for the DPRK's bolstering of its corresponding defence capabilities to cope with the escalating military threat by rival states.
If the U.S. has real concern about the security of its mainland, the only way to remove it is to thoroughly abandon its military threat and hostile policy toward independent and sovereign states.
It is the just self-defensive right of a sovereign state to steadily develop the self-defence capability capable of effectively containing all the security threats of the present and future and ensuring the security of the state and the strategic balance of the region.
The armed forces of the DPRK will as ever fully deter and control all kinds of challenges and threats from its rival countries by dint of powerful self-defence capability and faithfully discharge their mission for reliably defending peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the region. -0-

He proudly said that if the farm that will be more distinctive and wonderful than the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and a spectacular fishing village that no one has yet witnessed are built, it will directly demonstrate the validity and prospect of the regional development policy pursued by the Party and serve as a model symbolic of the future change of the county, and a brilliant page will be recorded in the history of the county.

This proves that the scope of our struggle has remarkably expanded and a powerful motive force, capable of advancing our cause, has been created, he added.
He said that our Party will be more thoroughgoing and steadfast, in the future, too, in defending the demands, rights and interests of the people, stressing that to see in this context, today’s groundbreaking ceremony serves as an important occasion for reaffirming and reclarifying the steadfast principled stand of the Party and the government that perform absolute service for the people.

The future of Ragwon entirely depends on its inhabitants, he said, calling on the officials and working people in the county to turn out, regarding the maritime industry as their vital issue, and thus open up a new sphere of aquaculture unique to the county.
He said that it is necessary to dynamically advance, through our resolute struggle and constant creation of miracles, the new era of comprehensive prosperity, a period of new development, that will be welcomed by all the people enjoying a rich life improved in quality, expressing once again his firm will to forcefully push forward with the great cause of regional transformation for realizing the people's long-cherished desires.

All the soldier-builders, bearing deep in their mind the glorious mission and duty as makers of a great revolution, hardened their will to fully display the noble name of our army in the vanguard of the struggle for realizing the sacred cause of regional development in the new era guided by our Party.
The groundbreaking ceremony of a modern offshore farm and fishing village, held with splendour in Ragwon County, serves as a significant occasion for demonstrating once again the steadfast will of our Party to turn all the cities and counties across the country into highly-civilized and rich places, self-supporting and developed in a diverse way and good to live in, and the spirit and stamina of Korea that is making a steady leap forward towards a prosperous future with ennobling ideals and a grand ambition. -0-

headline: Chairman Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex seething with the struggle to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee, he reiterated the importance of the complex's duty in attaining the iron and steel production goal for this year and stressed the need to wage a dynamic drive for increased iron and steel production and steadily push ahead with the project for further strengthening the Juche-based iron production foundation of Korean style.
At the Taean Friendship Glass Factory, he called for improving the ideological viewpoint and work style of officials, actively enlisting the mental power of the working people and making remarkable progress in the readjustment and reinforcement work by dint of such mass movements as the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement.
Learning about the work of the Taean District People's Committee, he said that the officials of power organs should fulfill their responsibility and role as servants of the people, and in particular, all deputies should become standard-bearers in the struggle for achieving the comprehensive development of the state and realizing the well-being of the people. He stressed the need to further intensify the work for raising the consciousness of law observance of the masses and establishing a social atmosphere of law observance.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of strengthening cooperation with the relevant units in charge of supplying raw and other materials for iron and steel production, the issue of raising the effectiveness of the mass movement in conformity with the characteristics of relevant sectors and units, the issue of carrying on the work in a responsible manner to consolidate the supply service base at industrial establishments.
Earlier, he learned about the construction of the Kangdong Cement Factory and its equipment assembling. -0-

headline: Many Songs Praising Immortal Revolutionary Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Created in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- All the people of the DPRK have enthusiastically sung famous songs of the times, praising the immortal revolutionary exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilthrough generations and deeply taken the pride in the most glorious era in the 5 000-year-long history of the nation which upheld with his revolutionary heritage as a cornerstone and the deep weight of the Korean February.
The first hymn "We Will Be Loyal to You Generation after Generation", presented toKim Jong Ilby the Korean people with ardent fascination and trust in him, highly resounded in the early years of the 1970s.
Hymns onKim Jong Ilwho proclaimed the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the Workers' Party of Korea and ushered in an era of brilliant prosperity unprecedented in the history of the country were reverberated in the advance of the 1970s and 1980s.
The songs including the "Song of the Dear ComradeKim Jong Il" and "ComradeKim Jong IlIs the Glory of Korea" were the expression of the glorious era for the outstanding leader and an eruption of the unanimous desire of all the people to hold him with loyalty.
Produced in the first half of the 1990s were famous songs reflecting the delight of the civilians and service personnel for holding the peerlessly illustrious commander at the top post of the revolutionary armed forces and the good luck of having brilliant commander generation after generation.
"Ode to ComradeKim Jong Il", the hymn of all the people, and songs like "Best Wishes" and "No Motherland without You" are singing the people's emotion and firm pledge to holdKim Jong Ilin high esteem.
The "Song of GeneralKim Jong Il", the immortal revolutionary hymn, was created in February 1997 to mark the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation to shake the whole planet.
The creation of a national treasure work which successfully represented the unanimous desire of all people to praise and follow the rare elder statesman, a peerlessly brilliant commander, on a high artistic level was a great event of weighty significance in the history of the development of Juche-oriented music.
Also created were many monumental songs to praise the immortal exploits of the Songun brilliant commander who made a long journey for defending the country.
The Korean people deeply grasped the noble feats ofKim Jong Ilwho devoted his whole life to the people, while singing songs "O We Miss You" and "Song of Love for People" in those days when the whole country was grieved at the sorrow of the sudden demise of the father of the nation.
The songs of yearning for the immortality ofKim Jong Ilresounded throughout the country in the new era of the Juche revolution in which a new history of the cause of immortalizing the great leaders was ushered in under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The song "Might of Korea" resounded far and wide in the morning of the New Year 2012 amid the boundless reverence of the Korean people and service personnel for the great sage of the revolution, the peerless patriot who made a long journey of devotion for the people.
Songs "The General Is Immortal as the Sun", "Endless Is Our Yearning" and "White Snowflakes of Yearning" representing the ardent yearning for the peerlessly great man who made a ceaseless forced march day and night with superhuman energy are still being sung by the people nowadays. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) on April 16.
The letter said that the officials of the GAKC and all Korean residents in China, looking up to the benevolent image of ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the auspicious February holiday, pay the noblest tribute to him who built up the DPRK into an invincible politico-ideological power and military power to guarantee the eternal prosperity of the nation and defended the justice and peace of the world, and extend the highest glory and best wishes to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man who is translating the Chairman's patriotic desire for a powerful country into brilliant reality.
The Chairman, who was born as the son of Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of revolution, and grew up hearing the gunfire of the anti-Japanese war as a lullaby, recorded the immortal revolutionary history, to remain in the nation's history forever, with his outstanding ideas and theories, extraordinary leadership ability and gigantic revolutionary practice for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the eternal prosperity of posterity in the long period of revolutionary leadership, it noted, and went on:
The Chairman had taken warm care of the Korean residents in China with his paternal love, always remembering them, though he was very busy leading the revolution and construction. He carefully guided the GAKC to creditably perform its mission and role as befitting a genuine overseas citizens' organization of the DPRK and highly appreciated the small achievements made by us, awarding the highest honor of a DPRK citizen.
The letter expressed the determination to further consolidate the GAKC into a patriotic organization whose members are united with one mind and strengthen it into a promising organization by well training reserves to carry forward the baton of the association.
The GAKC in the letter, reflecting the unanimous desire of all Koreans in China, heartily wishedKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of the Koreans in China, good health for the eternal prosperity and rosy future of Juche Korea. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Mozambican President
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Daniel Francisco Chapo, secretary general of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and president of the Republic of Mozambique, on January 28.
In the message, Daniel Francisco Chapo said that the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and its members and supporters are very pleased to celebrate February 16, 2025, together with the Workers' Party of Korea and the people of the DPRK, on the occasion of the 83rd birth anniversary of the great leader ComradeKim Jong Il, the eternal leader of the WPK.
He, on behalf of Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party, and its members and supporters and on his own behalf, most sincerely wished the WPK and the DPRK progress and prosperity.
On this historic occasion of celebrating the birthday of the great leader who impressed the whole world, I reaffirm that I have deep interest in steadily developing the good relations of friendship and cooperation always existed between the two parties, the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and the Workers' Party of Korea, for progress and well-being of the two countries and peoples, the message said.
It most heartily wished General SecretaryKim Jong Ungood health and the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK people prosperity. -0-

headline: Floral Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Foreign Organizations and Personages

Papers Dedicate Editorials to 83rd Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il

story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Sunday dedicate editorials to the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The papers say that all the people and officers and service personnel across the DPRK pay the highest tribute and extended their best wishes for immortality toKim Jong Ilwho led the DPRK to victory with his ardent love and devotion to the country and its people.
The sacred revolutionary history of the Chairman who devoted himself to the prosperity of the country and the wellbeing of the people, undergoing all sorts of hardships that he could experience as the leader, revolutionary and human being, is the most vivid expression of his love for the country and the people, Rodong Sinmun says, and goes on:
With total dedication, he provided a solid foundation for building a powerful country and an unlimited potentiality of development that can never be bartered for anything. Herein lies his immortal exploits for the country and its people.
Eternally invincible is the DPRK that is winning victory after victory with the great patriotic exploitsKim Jong Ilperformed for the prosperity of the rising generation as a cornerstone.
The sacred history ofKim Jong Il's love for the country and the people is being successfully carried forward by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The future of the powerful country of Juche is rosy as it is led byKim Jong Un, the prominent leader of the revolution who is ushering in a great new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation with his noble sense of responsibility and mission for the destiny of the country and the people.
Minju Joson notes thatKim Jong Ilis the image of socialist Korea and the benevolent father of the people as he had led the DPRK to victory with his high sense of responsibility for the Workers' Party of Korea and the revolution and his warm love for the country and the people and performed great exploits which will be immortal in the history of the country. -0-

headline: Unjong Tea Associated with Loving Care of Peerlessly Great Men for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Unjong Tea is appreciated by the DPRK people as a table luxury as it has a good taste and smell and is good for the health. The tea is associated with the loving care of the peerlessly great men for the people.
PresidentKim Il Sungplanted tea saplings at the garden of his house and learnt about their efficiency while personally cultivating them.
He sent hundreds of tea saplings to the Academy of Agricultural Sciences to make sure that they are cultivated across the country after acclimatization.
He also set a sunny place in Kangryong County, South Hwanghae Province as a location to plant tea saplings and indicated the orientation of the research work.
ChairmanKim Jong Iltook measures to revitalize the research into tea cultivation and named the tea produced in the country Unjong Tea in order to convey the benevolence ofKim Il Sungto posterity.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unrepeatedly stressed the need to create tea-tree fields in Unjong Tea cultivation districts as planned, normalize the production of tea leaves, develop tea leaf processing technology and make a lot of tea such as iced tea to contribute to promoting the people's health and enjoying a highly civilized life.
The Unjong Tea Factory was built in a modern way thanks to the great devotion of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who personally chose the site for the factory and solved all problems arising in its construction.
The tasty tea products made by the factory are sold at the Unjong Tea House in the center of Pyongyang, the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp, the Masikryong Ski Resort and many other service units.
The tea culture, which includes broad contents ranging from the cultivation technology to production technology, packing, storage and boiling method of Unjong tea (Unjong Tea cultivation and drinking ways), was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage last year as it contributes to promoting the people's health and longevity and improving their material and cultural standards. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Mozambican President
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Daniel Francisco Chapo, secretary general of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and president of the Republic of Mozambique, on January 28.
In the message, Daniel Francisco Chapo said that the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and its members and supporters are very pleased to celebrate February 16, 2025, together with the Workers' Party of Korea and the people of the DPRK, on the occasion of the 83rd birth anniversary of the great leader ComradeKim Jong Il, the eternal leader of the WPK.
He, on behalf of Filipe Jacinto Nwussi, president of the Mozambique Liberation Front Party, and its members and supporters and on his own behalf, most sincerely wished the WPK and the DPRK progress and prosperity.
On this historic occasion of celebrating the birthday of the great leader who impressed the whole world, I reaffirm that I have deep interest in steadily developing the good relations of friendship and cooperation always existed between the two parties, the Mozambique Liberation Front Party and the Workers' Party of Korea, for progress and well-being of the two countries and peoples, the message said.
It most heartily wished General SecretaryKim Jong Ungood health and the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK people prosperity. -0-

headline: Kumsong Tractor Factory Updated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- An inauguration ceremony of the second-stage project for modernizing the Kumsong Tractor Factory took place on February 15.
Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Yang Sung Ho, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Jae Nam, chief secretary of the Nampho Municipal Committee of the WPK, officials and employees of the municipality and the factory, officials concerned and officials and soldier-builders who contributed to the remodeling.
Pak Thae Song made an inauguration address.
The premier said that the successful project for updating the Kumsong Tractor Factory according to the grand strategy for the development of the machine-building industry set forth by the Eighth Congress of the WPK is a radical fruition attained in carrying out the first-stage task assigned by the Party Central Committee to the farm machine industrial sector and a clear progress promising the bright future of the rural rejuvenation which will be further accelerated together with the vigorous development of the Juche industry.
He noted that the respected ComradeKim Jong Ununfolded a grand plan for the development of the factory and energetically led its implementation for the present change demonstrating the great vitality of the DPRK's economy and boosting the courage and conviction of the agricultural workers and other people across the country.
He called upon the workers, scientists and technicians of the factory to master modern equipment and set higher goals and steadily carry them out to make a qualitative leap forward to the next stage.
He called for making positive efforts to bring about a substantial change in the rural mechanization and rejuvenation this year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK and bring earlier the rosy future of a comprehensively developed state.
Ri Kye Bong, manager of the factory, in his speech extended the warmest thanks toKim Jong Unfor turning the factory into a model factory of the vehicle-building industry in the new century and a core factory advancing in the vanguard of the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture, reflecting the unanimous desire of all the officials and employees of the factory.
He expressed his determination to make the employees take good care of the equipment provided by the Party and normalize the production on a high level and thus demonstrate the honor as the vanguards and frontline soldiers in rural mechanization.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants went round various places of the factory. -0-

headline: Seminars on Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Held in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Seminars on the exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Iltook place in Cambodia, Denmark, Austria, the Czech Republic and Serbia from February 4 to 9 on the occasion of his 83rd birth anniversary.
Speeches were made at the events attended by political and social figures and masses of those countries.
The vice-chairman of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia said that the Cambodian people are still now highly praising the great exploits and noble personality of HEKim Jong Ilas a great man.
The chief of the Danish Group for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association praisedKim Jong Ilas a rare thinker-theoretician, staunch defender of socialism and peerless statesman, and referred to his ideo-theoretical exploits and leadership feats.
The chief and members of the Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria praisedKim Jong Ilas an outstanding statesman who showed the road ahead of the era of independence and recorded only victories and miracles in the proud history of socialist Korea through his great revolutionary practice.
The first vice-chairman of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea said that the reality of the DPRK fully demonstrating the might of a powerful country would be unthinkable without the devoted leadership of ComradeKim Jong Iland the exploits of the great man would be kept deep in the hearts of mankind.
Personages of the New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that HEKim Jong Ilis an outstanding leader in the era of independence who made immortal contributions to the socialist cause, the cause of global independence with his profound ideas and theories and energetic leadership, adding that the Juche idea, comprehensively systematized by him, is the great philosophy, great ideology and great outlook on the world and the ideas and theories of the great man serve as a compass for progressive mankind aspiring after independence and justice. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from General Association of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) on April 16.
The letter said that the officials of the GAKC and all Korean residents in China, looking up to the benevolent image of ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the auspicious February holiday, pay the noblest tribute to him who built up the DPRK into an invincible politico-ideological power and military power to guarantee the eternal prosperity of the nation and defended the justice and peace of the world, and extend the highest glory and best wishes to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man who is translating the Chairman's patriotic desire for a powerful country into brilliant reality.
The Chairman, who was born as the son of Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of revolution, and grew up hearing the gunfire of the anti-Japanese war as a lullaby, recorded the immortal revolutionary history, to remain in the nation's history forever, with his outstanding ideas and theories, extraordinary leadership ability and gigantic revolutionary practice for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the eternal prosperity of posterity in the long period of revolutionary leadership, it noted, and went on:
The Chairman had taken warm care of the Korean residents in China with his paternal love, always remembering them, though he was very busy leading the revolution and construction. He carefully guided the GAKC to creditably perform its mission and role as befitting a genuine overseas citizens' organization of the DPRK and highly appreciated the small achievements made by us, awarding the highest honor of a DPRK citizen.
The letter expressed the determination to further consolidate the GAKC into a patriotic organization whose members are united with one mind and strengthen it into a promising organization by well training reserves to carry forward the baton of the association.
The GAKC in the letter, reflecting the unanimous desire of all Koreans in China, heartily wishedKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of the Koreans in China, good health for the eternal prosperity and rosy future of Juche Korea. -0-

headline: Floral Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Chongryon Organizations
Chairman Kim Jong Il, Great Father of People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Il's whole life was a brilliant one of the genuine leader of the people who had always kept them in his mind all his life.
It was his noble outlook on the people that the popular masses are an almighty being in the world and if the people to be called with the title of "great" exist, they are none other than the Korean people.
That's why he put up the people in the centre of all thoughts and activities, regarded their demands and will as the absolute standard in shaping any line and policy and thoroughly implemented them without an inch of deflection.
Once, a factory of high economic value was to be built in the upper reaches of the Songchon River in South Hamgyong Province.
After receiving the report about that, the Chairman said that the site was a good place for the factory, but it could affect the supply of drinking water to Hamhung citizens. And he saw to it that the site was found elsewhere.
Whenever excellent recreation grounds, including the Jongbangsan Pleasure Park and the Amusement Park of Kaeson Youth Park, were built for people, he was very pleased. When visiting a chicken farm and silk cloth and cosmetics production units, he said that they should faithfully serve the people to get their favor.
The number of units visited by the Chairman till the last moments of his life for the happiness of people while regarding the people’s happiness as his greatest joy is more than 14 290.
Such revolutionary anecdotes and words of the times "doze and rice-ball", "field haircut", "forced march in blizzards" and "forced march in the sweltering weather" came into being in the course of his devotion to the people.
His lifelong definite mission, standard and pride were only for the people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on February 16.
The letter said that, reflecting the unanimous mind of all Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the historic February holiday when the great fortune of Korea was greeted, the Chongryon Central Standing Committee pays the noblest tribute to the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Il, the eternal sun of Juche Korea, and extends the highest glory and warmest congratulations to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho is leading the cause of building a socialist power and the patriotic cause of Chongryon to victory.
It noted thatKim Jong Il, born as the son of Mt Paektu, clearly indicated the path of the Korean revolution with his gifted ideo-theoretical wisdom, made a history of great miracles with his outstanding and tested leadership, reliably defended the country and people with his iron-willed pluck and will and wrote an epic of benevolence unprecedented in history with his noble virtues and warm love in those days when he led the cause of Juche along the road of victory and glory, true to the intention of PresidentKim Il Sung.
His sacred leadership reached Japan, an alien land over the sea, the letter said, adding that the great GeneralKim Jong Ilis, indeed, an outstanding leader who brought up Chongryon as a patriotic pioneer, model of patriotic loyalty and model of overseas compatriots' organization of the world, true to the noble intention of the President, and a guardian of the destiny of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan.
The letter said that the history of warm affection and kinship he had maintained with Koreans in Japan is given steady continuity thanks to the paternal loving care and meticulous care of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
The letter stressed that they would bring about a fresh advance in the patriotic movement to usher in a new era of prosperity of Chongryon by pooling the inexhaustible efforts of Koreans in Japan and braving any hardships, true to the important letter sent byKim Jong Unto the participants in the 25th Congress of Chongryon, keeping pace with the advance of the people in the homeland to successfully attain the goals, set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, through miraculous innovations winning the admiration of the world people.
In the letter, the Chongryon Central Standing Committee wholeheartedly wishedKim Jong Ungood health for the complete victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the patriotic cause of Chongryon, reflecting the ardent loyalty and boundless reverence of all Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan. -0-

headline: Ideological Offensive Conducted in North Hamgyong Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK is conducting a revolutionary ideological offensive to inspire the masses to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
At the Chongjin School Uniform Factory, the Chongjin Footwear Factory and the Chongjin Bag Factory, the Party information workers called upon all workers and technicians to display vigorous exertion, explaining the idea and intention of the Party which called for increased production and economy.
Members of the provincial artistic information team, who prepared colorful works reflecting the spirit and fighting traits of the present times, visited the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Komusan Cement Factory and other places to encourage the working masses to make innovations.
Officials of the provincial committees of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the Socialist Women's Union of Korea doubled the enthusiasm of the farmers who are carrying on the immediate farming processes through their informal political work at farms in Chongjin City, including the Jikha Farm in Chongam District. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il, Great Father of People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Il's whole life was a brilliant one of the genuine leader of the people who had always kept them in his mind all his life.
It was his noble outlook on the people that the popular masses are an almighty being in the world and if the people to be called with the title of "great" exist, they are none other than the Korean people.
That's why he put up the people in the centre of all thoughts and activities, regarded their demands and will as the absolute standard in shaping any line and policy and thoroughly implemented them without an inch of deflection.
Once, a factory of high economic value was to be built in the upper reaches of the Songchon River in South Hamgyong Province.
After receiving the report about that, the Chairman said that the site was a good place for the factory, but it could affect the supply of drinking water to Hamhung citizens. And he saw to it that the site was found elsewhere.
Whenever excellent recreation grounds, including the Jongbangsan Pleasure Park and the Amusement Park of Kaeson Youth Park, were built for people, he was very pleased. When visiting a chicken farm and silk cloth and cosmetics production units, he said that they should faithfully serve the people to get their favor.
The number of units visited by the Chairman till the last moments of his life for the happiness of people while regarding the people’s happiness as his greatest joy is more than 14 290.
Such revolutionary anecdotes and words of the times "doze and rice-ball", "field haircut", "forced march in blizzards" and "forced march in the sweltering weather" came into being in the course of his devotion to the people.
His lifelong definite mission, standard and pride were only for the people's wellbeing. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony for the Fourth-stage Project to Build 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area Takes Place with Splendour
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- Construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, decided by the Eighth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea to turn Pyongyang into a wonderful world-class city, in which the people-first principle is thoroughly applied, in the new era of comprehensive development towards the supreme ideal of civilization and prosperity, has entered its final stage.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally planned to have 50 000 flats built in the capital city, a project to be specially recorded in the sacred history of development of the Party and the state, and set it as the most important task and cherished desire to be realized without fail. And since he declared the first meaningful groundbreaking for implementing the project, he has ceaselessly given brilliant guidance at the grand construction sites to usher in a new heyday of Pyongyang, in which ideal streets of the people to be proud of in the eyes of the world are built every year.
The final-stage struggle of the five-year plan for the monumental construction of the capital city is the most important undertaking of creation in this year for perfectly fulfilling the pledge, which our Party made before the people and has discharged without an inch of deflection. It is also an honourable revolutionary undertaking to inject greater vitality into the all-people general advance towards the 80th founding anniversary of the Party and the Ninth Congress of the Party.
A groundbreaking ceremony for the fourth-stage project to build 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area took place with splendour on the afternoon of February 16.
The venue of the ceremony was filled with the great pride and enthusiasm for working new miracles of all the builders of the capital city, who had built modern large architectural groups in the suburbs of the city over the past four years and glorified the greatKim Jong Un’s era with brilliant legendary tales of construction for tremendous change, holding high the flag of the construction headquarters of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang given by the Party Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the groundbreaking ceremony.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and other senior Party, government and military officials, officials of the Cabinet, armed forces organs, ministries, national agencies and Pyongyang and military and civilian builders.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the groundbreaking ceremony, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the outstanding statesman and benevolent leader of the people, who is steadily ushering in a golden age of rejuvenation and an era of comprehensive prosperity on this land where all the people’s well-being and socialist civilization are coming into full bloom, by bringing about epochal victories and grand transformations unprecedented in history with his great state building idea of believing in the people as in Heaven and extraordinary leadership.
Kim Jong Unmade a speech on the occasion of the groundbreaking.
Explaining the significance of holding another groundbreaking ceremony for the new year’s project to build 10 000 flats, just as we did without fail over the past four years, he extended warm thanks and militant greetings to all the builders who are taking a vigorous step forward to attain more ambitious goals with the dignity and pride in having performed brilliant exploits in the worthwhile construction work.
After clarifying the great role of construction in the course of our struggle to move from a revolution to a more gigantic one and from a stage of development to a higher level of transformation, he declared his intention to have the capital city construction continued until all conditions are provided for its citizens to lead a civilized and happy life without any inconvenience, and introduced an immediate construction plan for expanding the capital city.
Expressing belief that the fourth-stage construction project in the Hwasong area will surely bear good fruit and thus make the area more famous not only as a cradle of the happy and civilized life of the people but as a land of history, which tells new miraculous tales of indomitable socialist Korea, he ardently called for turning out more courageously in the great struggle for the great appearance and eternal prosperity of our capital city, for the civilization of our state and for the happy life of our people.
All the builders broke into enthusiastic cheers with boundless reverence forKim Jong Un, who is warmly inspiring them with great trust so that they can perform eye-opening feats once again in this year’s struggle for successfully concluding the tasks decided by the Party congress.
The venue of the groundbreaking ceremony was filled with the ardent enthusiasm of the builders of the capital city to uphold the cherished desire of our Party with miracles of creation, bearing deep in mindKim Jong Un’s instructions that the Hwasong area is the epitome that intensively shows the spirit peculiar to the Workers’ Party of Korea that wages the revolution uninterruptedly and the onward march of our state that advances towards the future with a great ambition.
Kim Jong Unpressed the button for blasting to herald the start of the project for building 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area.
Fireworks were set off one after another to declare the start of a new advance as the loud sound of blasting shook the sky and the land.
Expressing expectation that all the military and civilian builders will as ever demonstrate the honour of our times and our generation and steadily carry forward the glorious history of the people-first architecture, he warmly acknowledged their cheers for a long time.
All the participants made a firm pledge to successfully build a new flourishing living space of socialist civilization in the Hwasong area where a greater happiness of the people will be in full bloom and to turn our great Pyongyang into an ideal city to be envied by the world and into the capital city of the most dignified and prosperous power by implementingKim Jong Un’s far-reaching plan for the capital city construction with devoted practice. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un’s Speech at Groundbreaking Ceremony for Fourth-stage Project to Build 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the groundbreaking ceremony for the fourth-stage project to build 10 000 flats in the Hwasong area on February 16.
His speech is as follows:
Comrades,
Today we are holding another groundbreaking ceremony for the new year’s project to build 10 000 flats, just as we have done without fail over the past four years.
With the 10 000 flats to be built this year, the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, which has progressed full steam ahead since the Party congress, will enter the final phase.
At this significant moment, when we are to launch into the fourth-stage housing construction in the Hwasong area, I am reminded of how strenuously we have worked over the whole course of the past four years to achieve amazing exploits and hasten the schedule for transformations. I also recall with deep emotion the loud cheers that rang out year after year to celebrate the completion of the new streets for the people.
Thanks to your ennobling spirit and devotion to the capital city construction, Pyongyang has turned into a more splendid city as we wished. Its dignified and vibrant looks instil great confidence and courage in the people across the country as they are greeting a period of massive transformations.
This is precisely a proud record of the times and a high appreciation of the immortal exploits and glorious feats you have achieved through a stubborn and vigorous struggle to honour our Party’s cherished desires with miracles of creation.
As we can see in reality, the yearly construction of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang has been promoted most steadily during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee.
In this period, despite the persistent difficult conditions facing our state, the economic sectors have built up their capacities, the overall national economy has definitely entered a phase of sustained growth, and new records have been set up in various aspects of state affairs thanks to the outstanding successes unprecedented in the history of the Republic.
Let me cite a few examples. In the period of the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth Party Congress, the electric power industry has maintained a remarkable trend towards increased production while steadily expanding its scope of upturn; cement production has attained a record high; and the agricultural sector has also entered a trajectory that is secure enough to keep a high and stable level of grain production.
In particular, housing construction in Pyongyang has become the most stable and rapidly growing sector, with the perfect and unconditional fulfilment every year of the ambitious plans that, in consideration of the long-term requirements, were added to the goals decided on by the Party congress. In 2024 the growth rate in this sector reached a striking level of 391% as against 2020.
The construction projects that have progressed country-wide over the past four years, particularly the yearly construction of 10 000 flats in the capital city, have made a record of great transformations, a record so outstanding that the phrase groundbreaking accompanied by inauguration has come into common use. This can be called the greatest of successes that we can be proud of before the world.
I said this in Ragwon County two days ago.
To be frank, these days I am really tired and busy attending inauguration and groundbreaking ceremonies that have been scheduled one after another. We are facing such moments of drastic change.
This is a fact that clearly proves how many goals we have advanced and are striving to achieve for the prosperity and transformation of the country.
Amid this strenuous struggle our belief in our own strength has become firmer, and we have fostered an indomitable fighting spirit and self-confidence to advance our cause.
The belief in our own strength and self-confidence--this is the most important of all, a spiritual asset that is more precious than our wealth in physical form.
Availing myself of this significant opportunity to launch a new struggle for the development of the capital city construction onto a higher plane, I extend warm thanks and militant greetings to all the builders who are taking a vigorous step forward to attain more ambitious goals with the dignity and pride in having performed brilliant exploits in the worthwhile construction work.
I also express my heartfelt thanks to the officials and workers in the relevant sectors for having raised the fierce flames of a leap forward and increased production to provide a guarantee for the implementation of our Party’s construction policy and inject vigour into it.
Comrades,
Now construction has become a major realm of our struggle, and it is expanding its position at the centre of the times.
We are engaged in the struggle to move from a revolution to a more gigantic one and from a stage of development to a higher level of transformation. In the course of this struggle, construction is gaining an extraordinary significance and power.
Construction is precisely investment in, and pioneering of, the future.
The revolution in construction is the essential prerequisite for our Party’s development strategy for bringing about epochal changes on this land, and the implementation of all important policies of the Party and the state is, without exception, accompanied by construction, regardless of sectors, units and regions.
It can be said that the historic cause for comprehensive rejuvenation of our state and improvement of the people’s well-being begins with construction, moves ahead with construction and comes to accomplishment with successful construction.
It would be no exaggeration to say that construction, among others, intuitively expresses our politics, helps us get nearer to attainment of our ideals of civilization and prosperity, and rapidly increases the wealth of our country.
Construction not only plays the role of a powerful weapon for steady advance and development of our state, but also exerts, as an ensemble of the national strength, a leading, powerful influence on the efforts to transform the economy, science, technology, culture and all other fields.
The obvious signs of our country improving its appearance and the rapid succession of remarkable changes in different fields of state and social life, never seen in the history of our nation building, are directly associated with the miraculous development our architecture has achieved amid the flames of a new revolution in construction.
With the extensive construction projects now underway across the country, the trend of irreversible change and upturn is becoming more and more dominant, and our cause is gaining greater momentum for its dynamic advance.
When construction consists in the main front that is decisive of the advance of our revolution, the main factor in its successful implementation can be said to be how we understand and confirm once again the purpose and character of our construction struggle.
The groundbreaking ceremony we are having at the moment serves as a meaningful occasion for refreshing our understanding of what is the true aim our Party and state pursue in dynamically pushing ahead with the gigantic construction projects with such great efforts, and how the dynamic advance of our struggle and our own style of change and development is being achieved.
This housing construction site in the Hwasong area is vivid proof of the people-first politics and a clear symbol of our cause that is making a more vigorous advance and higher leap forward day by day towards the goal of a powerful country.
This can be said to be the core and character of the grand construction campaign that will stir the Hwasong area.
The fourth-stage project in the Hwasong area will include various modern amenities as well as 10 000 flats.
To build the Hwasong area into a model administrative district in Pyongyang, where everything needed for the life of the residents is well furnished--this is the idea I have put forward and maintained since the beginning of this whole project.
Therefore, I have ensured that the master plan and designs for construction in the Hwasong area were worked out through greater effort, with a concept different from that of previous street formations, and that the construction itself has also been conducted to this end.
It is true that the amenities to be built this year in this area are functional buildings which are large in scale and demand high technical requirements. To build them together with 10 000 flats is by no means an easy task.
But this plan is linked with the people’s demands, and so we must put it into reality without fail and we will do it.
This is our Party’s consistent principle of struggle.
If the Hwasong area with new wonderful flats is furnished with these immaculate amenities, it will be turned into a model urban-block formation, a beautiful and magnificent place where the formative artistic beauty and advanced civilization are in good harmony.
Comrades,
Housing construction in Pyongyang should continue until the Party’s plan is turned into reality to provide its citizens with perfect conditions for leading a civilized and happy life without any inconvenience.
Today, availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to outline some of our Party’s policy-oriented plans for the capital city construction.
We plan to implement with serious intent the policy of extending streets of Pyongyang towards Kangdong as the second stage after winding up the construction in the Hwasong area.
As major scientific research institutes, technical colleges and military academies are to be built in Taesong District, we are going to have tens of thousands of modern flats built in the area between the Hwasong area and Songmun-dong in Samsok District.
This will form another wonderful scientific, cultural and dwelling area in Pyongyang.
In addition, we will transform such culturally backward metropolitan areas and suburbs as Tungme-dong in Songyo District, Wolhyang-dong in Moranbong District and Hadang-dong in Hyongjesan District, thereby eliminating and renovating all the elements unbecoming of the appearance of the capital city in its overall formation.
These initiatives will be reported to the Party congress and handed over as a major task of the next-term Party Central Committee.
Comrades,
The fourth-stage project in the Hwasong area, which our Party has courageously shouldered for our most precious people, is the crystallization of the unyielding offensive spirit of us, revolutionaries, who are faithful to our unchangeable mission, and the whole area of construction here is the epitome that intensively shows the spirit peculiar to the Workers’ Party of Korea that wages the revolution uninterruptedly and the onward march of our state that advances towards the future with a great ambition.
The enthusiasm for creation and vigorous fighting spirit to be displayed in the Hwasong area will redouble the unrivalled strength and courage at the construction sites across the country and further boost the advance of our state.
Although this project is large in scale, I am convinced that it will surely bear good fruit thanks to the strong drive and practical abilities of the commanding personnel and the confidence and soaring morale of all the builders.
The Hwasong area will soon become more famous not only as a cradle of the happy and civilized life of the people but as a land of history, which tells new miraculous tales of indomitable socialist Korea.
Elite capital city builders, a source of pride for our Party,
The 80th founding anniversary of our glorious Party and its Ninth Congress that will be specially recorded in history will witness the immortal exploits to be performed by you, who are boundlessly loyal to the Party’s ideas and cause.
Our capital city should be most beautiful and greatest in the world.
For the great appearance and eternal prosperity of our capital city,
For the civilization of our state and for the happy life of our people,
Let us turn out more courageously in the great struggle.
Long live Pyongyang, the great capital city of our motherland–our beloved, proud, dignified and glorious city! -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 18 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Tuesday released a press statement "The anachronistic and futile attempt to challenge the inviolable sovereignty and the prestige of the DPRK will entail self-destructive results".
The full text of the press statement is as follows:
Recently, the U.S. revealed again its sinister intention to put extreme political and military pressure on the DPRK in collusion with its vassal states, while viciously taking issue with the DPRK's just exercise of independent right with the international security conference held in Munich of Germany as an occasion.
The U.S. secretary of State held a confab with the diplomatic authorities of Japan and the ROK on February 15 to fabricate and make public a "joint statement" full of groundless mud-slinging and provocative rhetoric against the DPRK, talking about the "complete denuclearization of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea".
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the adventuristic and foolish acts of the U.S., Japan and the ROK inciting collective confrontation and conflict on the Korean peninsula and in the region and strongly warns that any provocation and threat of the hostile countries will face an overwhelming and decisive counteraction.
The U.S. is pursuing an outdated and absurd plan of "denuclearization", which is now getting more impossible and impracticable even practically and conceptually from the viewpoint of the present time. As for the shortsighted "goal" of the U.S., it is no more than the height of stupidity that arouses the astonishment of the world people as is the case with the fact that ignorant primitives ask the moderns to return to their society.
The U.S. is not yet awakened from the failed old dream of the "denuclearization" that dims in the memory of the present time. It is the official stand of the DPRK government that it is not worth consideration to counter the stand of the U.S. escaping from reality and we condemn and reject the U.S. action in the most resolute tone.
The U.S. should have to think itself first what consequences the futile attempt of the imperialist forces to unilaterally hurt the security of the DPRK in disregard of the origination and existence of the nuclear issue on the Korean peninsula for the past three decades has led to today.
Explicitly speaking once again, as long as the U.S. and its vassal forces' hostile threat exists, the DPRK's nukes are means for defending peace and sovereignty and a means for legitimate self-defence entrusted by the Constitution of the state.
The more desperately the U.S. resorts to ineffective means of pressure against the DPRK, failing to face up to the reality, the more the DPRK will continue to take a new opportunity for the upward coordination of its strategic force and hold further favorable position in the conflicting structure between the DPRK and the U.S.
The DPRK will as ever consistently adhere to the new line of bolstering up the nuclear force clarified by the head of state and thoroughly deter the U.S. and its vassal forces from the threat and blackmail of encroaching upon the sovereignty and security interests of the state by making use of all political and military tools in its hands and perfectly attain its strategic goal. -0-

story_text:

headline: Drive for Increased Production and Economy Waged in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:

Officials and workers at the Kumsong Tractor Factory are making innovations in the production of different kinds of farm machines true to the noble intention of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is energetically leading the work to turn it into a core factory which plays a leading role in realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture and a model of the vehicle-building industry.
Employees of the Kangso Mineral Water Factory have put production on a normal basis with the pride of working at the worksite associated withKim Jong Un’s guidance feats to make a positive contribution to promoting the people's health.
The Kangso Silk Mill and the Kangso Engine Accessory Factory increase the effectiveness in the ideological work, thus inspiring all their employees to greet the Ninth Congress of the Party with proud labor achievements through the drive for increased production and economy.
The Chongsan, Yaksu and Tokhung farms are stirring up the enthusiasm of the agricultural workers to carry out the programme for the rural revolution in the new era by purposefully pushing ahead with the educational work to make them deeply grasp the revolutionary careers and exploits of the peerlessly great men who put their heart and soul into the agricultural development of the country. -0-

headline: Celebration Meeting Held in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place in Beijing, China on Feb. 14 to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, personages of various units of China including the Association for International Friendly Contact, and the DPRK ambassador to China and staff members of his embassy.
The participants laid a floral basket before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland paid tribute to them.
Speeches were made there.
Zhou Wei, daughter of Zhou Baozhong, Feng Songguang, son of Feng Zhongyun, Yu Ming, son of Li Zade, Yue Zhi-yun, daughter of Zhang Wei-hua's daughter, and Shang Xiaowei, son of Mentor Shang Yue, praisedKim Jong Ilas an outstanding leader who made immortal contributions to the Korean revolution, the cause of global socialism and the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations.
They stressed that the exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho led the Korean people to advance along the road of glory without fear of ordeals and difficulties will be kept deep in the minds of progressive mankind.
They talked about the loving care and benevolence shown byKim Jong Ilfor the families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and expressed deep yearning for the tender-hearted father.
They affirmed that the desire of PresidentKim Il Sungand GeneralKim Jong Ilwould surely come true and the socialist cause of the DPRK would win a great victory thanks to  ComradeKim Jong Un, sincerely wishing the DPRK prosperity and its people happiness. -0-

headline: Drive for Increased Production Brisk in Coal Mines of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Workers at the Onsong, Kyongwon and Myongchon area coal mining complexes in the DPRK are over-fulfilling their assignments every day.
Workers at the Onsong Area Coal Mining Complex are taking the lead in making innovations.
The Kangan Coal Mine has over-fulfilled its daily quotas by displaying collective spirit and the Jungbong Coal Mine has produced 1.2 times more coal than the daily plan by introducing advanced work methods.
The Kyongwon Area Coal-mining Complex has given priority to tunneling, raised the coal-mining and transport capacities and generalized the successes and experience of advanced units.
The tunneling workers at the Tokchon Pit of the Ryongbuk Youth Coal Mine have secured reserve coal beds by rationally distributing a drilling work suited to the rock quality condition and conducting continuous blasting, and the Kogonwon and Thaesan coal mines are increasing the coal production by operating equipment at full capacity.
The Yangjong Coal Mine under the Myongchon Area Coal Mining Complex has directed efforts to increasing the proportion of mechanization in the face work to ensure the rapid transport of coal and the Soksong Coal Mine has provided a guarantee for increased production by giving precedence to the main tunneling and preparative tunneling. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan led by Kim Chol, chairman of the Hyogo Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), to celebrate the greatest and auspicious February holiday of the nation, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of PresidentKim Il Sung, on February 18.
Members of the congratulatory group visited sacred place of the revolution in boundless reverence for PresidentKim Il Sungand looked round various places of the historic site associated with the President's history.
They toured the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum.
Being briefed on the historical relics preserved with much care at the old home of the President, they looked back upon the immortal revolutionary exploits of the President who devoted himself to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and put his heart and soul into developing Chongryon. -0-

headline: Unforgettable Consultative Meeting
story_text:
PresidentKim Il Sungleft for field guidance at a farm where new farm machines were on display on a snowy day of February 1974.
Officials expressed their intention that the President would take a rest and look round farm machines after the snow stopped.
Saying with a bright smile on his face that you never mind, even if snow falls, he watched the new farm machines attentively.
His hat and overcoat were covered with snow as time advanced.
After watching all the farm machines, he headed for a room to hold a consultative meeting with officials.
Some of the officials were still standing in the yard as the room was very small.
Saying that the room was warm but small, the President quietly suggested them going out.
An official told the President that it was cold outside, so it would be good to hold the consultative meeting in the room.  But the President went out, saying that if he sits in the room, seeing the officials are exposed to snow outside, he would feel uncomfortable and that if they are exposed to snow, he should be exposed to snow together with them.
He gave precious instructions on the work of the agricultural sector for a long time, being exposed to snow.
The unforgettable consultative meeting made people keenly feel the noble popular traits of the President who regarded it as his lifelong motto to believe in the people as in Heaven. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Honors Workers with Bow before Drawing
story_text:
One day in May 2009, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the then Taehung Youth Mine.
After being briefed on the fact that the mine established a perfect magnesia clinker production process in conformity with the actual conditions of the country, he said with great satisfaction that it is wonderful and doing so is the Korean style and the Juche industry.
Looking at the intuition drawing of the Korean-style fireproof production process, he slowly approached it and highly praised the merits of the workers of the mine again.
Saying that he would like to pay respect to the intuition drawing to the effect that he paid respect to the workers as they were absent there, he made a deep bow toward the intuition drawing.
Indeed, this showed his outlook on the people. -0-

headline: Women in Chongjin City Advance into Major Theatres of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- More than 100 women in Chongjin City, North Hamgyong Province in the DPRK volunteered to work at honorable posts with the desire to glorify their true life as women workers in the revolutionary advance for the comprehensive development of socialism.
Members of the women's union in Ranam, Sinam and Phohang districts vowed to work at the Ranam Coal-Mining Machine Factory, Chongjin Footwear Factory, etc.
Women's union members in the city including Sunam and Songphyong districts advanced into the Chongjin School uniform Factory and raw material bases of the regional-industry factories and women in Chongam District into the countryside.
A meeting to congratulate them took place at the Chongjin City Hall of Culture on Tuesday. Present there were Choe Yong Ho, secretary of the provincial committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials and members of the women's union.
At the meeting, a speaker called upon all the volunteers to become innovators loved by the masses at every worksite seething with the drive for increased production and economy.
Volunteers in the speeches expressed their determination to glorify the honor of the socialist workers and contribute to the comprehensive rejuvenation and development of the country. Their speeches met the response of the participants.
Officials and women's union members  saw off the volunteers leaving for new posts. -0-

headline: Industrial Art Exhibitions Held in DPRK

Displayed at the exhibitions were industrial art designs personally watched and guided by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Experts and amateurs of the relevant areas presented various industrial art designs, models and products reflecting the development of civilization and changes in the new era.
Many officials, experts, amateurs and working people have visited the venues of the exhibitions.
On display are designs of various construction machines conducive to the Workers' Party of Korea's cherished desire for the promotion of the people's well-being, including the construction of regional-industry factories and dwelling houses, and models of new-type tractors and multipurpose farm machines suited to the actual conditions of rural areas.
Highly appreciated by the visitors are the designs of various products manufactured by regional-industry factories across the country, which were wonderfully built as the first entities for implementing the regional development policy of the Party, and trademarks, advertisements, signboards and font designs reflecting the characteristics of the regions in an intensive and symbolic ways.

Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Workers at the Onsong, Kyongwon and Myongchon area coal mining complexes in the DPRK are over-fulfilling their assignments every day.
Workers at the Onsong Area Coal Mining Complex are taking the lead in making innovations.
The Kangan Coal Mine has over-fulfilled its daily quotas by displaying collective spirit and the Jungbong Coal Mine has produced 1.2 times more coal than the daily plan by introducing advanced work methods.
The Kyongwon Area Coal-mining Complex has given priority to tunneling, raised the coal-mining and transport capacities and generalized the successes and experience of advanced units.
The tunneling workers at the Tokchon Pit of the Ryongbuk Youth Coal Mine have secured reserve coal beds by rationally distributing a drilling work suited to the rock quality condition and conducting continuous blasting, and the Kogonwon and Thaesan coal mines are increasing the coal production by operating equipment at full capacity.
The Yangjong Coal Mine under the Myongchon Area Coal Mining Complex has directed efforts to increasing the proportion of mechanization in the face work to ensure the rapid transport of coal and the Soksong Coal Mine has provided a guarantee for increased production by giving precedence to the main tunneling and preparative tunneling. -0-

headline: Applause at Changsong Restaurant
story_text:
One day in June 2013, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built Changsong Restaurant in Changsong County, North Phyongan Province.
When he reached a dining room on the first floor, he said that the dining rooms were empty now, and that it would have been better if he had came to the rooms when the people were having a meal.
At that time, a senior official of the county Party committee toldKim Jong Unthat the restaurant arranged birthday and wedding spreads for the inhabitants of the county  and showed him their photos.
Seeing the photos of a war veteran couple and triplets receiving their birthday spreads and wedding photos of a teacher couple who volunteered to work in Changsong County, he said with a broad smile on his face that there are many good photos.
When the chief of the restaurant proposed that he would read a piece of good writings left by the people who were served at Changsong Restaurant,Kim Jong Unreadily accepted to his proposal.
When he read impressions of an old man,Kim Jong Unrose from the seat and clapped his hands.
After a while, he said that the fairest assessment of officials' work is the voices of the people and that if the people say that they are good, there needs no other appraisal. Saying that the officials should do anything favored by the people, he added that the people's demands and interests are the standard of all work.
The applause at Changsong Restaurant was an echo conveying to the world the noble view on the people of the respected General Secretary who valued the people most and spared nothing for their happiness, and an earnest request to do more work for them. -0-

headline: Celebration Meeting Held in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place in Beijing, China on Feb. 14 to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, personages of various units of China including the Association for International Friendly Contact, and the DPRK ambassador to China and staff members of his embassy.
The participants laid a floral basket before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland paid tribute to them.
Speeches were made there.
Zhou Wei, daughter of Zhou Baozhong, Feng Songguang, son of Feng Zhongyun, Yu Ming, son of Li Zade, Yue Zhi-yun, daughter of Zhang Wei-hua's daughter, and Shang Xiaowei, son of Mentor Shang Yue, praisedKim Jong Ilas an outstanding leader who made immortal contributions to the Korean revolution, the cause of global socialism and the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations.
They stressed that the exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho led the Korean people to advance along the road of glory without fear of ordeals and difficulties will be kept deep in the minds of progressive mankind.
They talked about the loving care and benevolence shown byKim Jong Ilfor the families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and expressed deep yearning for the tender-hearted father.
They affirmed that the desire of PresidentKim Il Sungand GeneralKim Jong Ilwould surely come true and the socialist cause of the DPRK would win a great victory thanks to  ComradeKim Jong Un, sincerely wishing the DPRK prosperity and its people happiness. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan led by Kim Chol, chairman of the Hyogo Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), to celebrate the greatest and auspicious February holiday of the nation, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of PresidentKim Il Sung, on February 18.
Members of the congratulatory group visited sacred place of the revolution in boundless reverence for PresidentKim Il Sungand looked round various places of the historic site associated with the President's history.
They toured the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum.
Being briefed on the historical relics preserved with much care at the old home of the President, they looked back upon the immortal revolutionary exploits of the President who devoted himself to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and put his heart and soul into developing Chongryon. -0-
