headline: Industrial Art Exhibitions Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Industrial art exhibitions on the theme of "A new era of regional rejuvenation and industrial art" are going on in all provinces (municipalities) of the DPRK on the occasion of the significant February holiday.
Displayed at the exhibitions were industrial art designs personally watched and guided by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Experts and amateurs of the relevant areas presented various industrial art designs, models and products reflecting the development of civilization and changes in the new era.
Many officials, experts, amateurs and working people have visited the venues of the exhibitions.
On display are designs of various construction machines conducive to the Workers' Party of Korea's cherished desire for the promotion of the people's well-being, including the construction of regional-industry factories and dwelling houses, and models of new-type tractors and multipurpose farm machines suited to the actual conditions of rural areas.
Highly appreciated by the visitors are the designs of various products manufactured by regional-industry factories across the country, which were wonderfully built as the first entities for implementing the regional development policy of the Party, and trademarks, advertisements, signboards and font designs reflecting the characteristics of the regions in an intensive and symbolic ways.
Looking round the venues of the exhibitions, industrial art creators, designers and amateurs exchanged successes and experience gained in the course of thinking, inquiry and creation for putting the industrial art of the country on a sustainable development track. -0-

headline: Art Creation and Motivation Activities for Increased Production in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Officials, creators and artistes in the field of stage art in the DPRK are briskly conducting artistic creation and motivation activities for increased production.
The Phibada Opera Troupe is pushing ahead with the work to create new forms of performances, which show famous songs and scenes of the five revolutionary operas created and completed under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, and new operas, and directing efforts to creating songs on the theme of patriotism.
The National Folk Art Troupe is creating art pieces showing the rapid development of the country and the vibrant spirit of the times and, at the same time, making progress in the work to recreate musical and dance works which gave deep impressions to the people in the past.
The creative group of the National Theatrical Troupe is perfecting a short play showing the validity and vitality of the regional development policy in the new era, and stepping up preparations to put on the stage the revolutionary drama "Mountain Shrine" by representing it again.
The National Acrobatic Troupe is creating peculiar and high-tech physical acrobatics and jugglery works. The creators and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra and the Pyongyang Puppet Company are striving to produce orchestral music with great artistic influence and deep emotion and marionette shows of diverse themes.
At major socialist construction sites seething with the struggle to implement the decisions of the plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, artistes of art troupes in Pyongyang and local areas encouraged the masses to raise their enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle through mobile frontline-style motivation activities for increased production. -0-

headline:
National Seminar Held in India on 83rd Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
[2025.02.20.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- A national seminar on the theme of "Self-reliance is indispensable in defending the national sovereignty and building socialism" took place in New Delhi on Feb. 13 on the occasion of the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were the director general and the secretary general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, the secretary general of the Indian Society for Juche Idea-Self-Reliance Studies and members of Juche Idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people.
Speeches were made there.
Harish Gupta, vice director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and director general of the Asian Regional Institute of the Juche Idea, and other speakers said that the great ComradeKim Jong Ilconsistently adhered to the principle of independence in the revolution and construction throughout his life, thus making the DPRK demonstrate its might as an invincible country independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence.
Many countries of the world fell into crisis and confusion, yielding to the U.S. pressure, but the DPRK has never hesitated in the face of the imperialist threat as it has consistently applied the line of independence, they stressed.
They said that the DPRK has dynamically waged the struggle for achieving the comprehensive development of socialism, upholding the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand, in this course, is working world-startling miracles one after another in all fields.
A congratulatory message to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwas adopted at the seminar. -0-

headline: Many People Join Tele-education System in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- Many working people in the DPRK have joined the tele-education system run by different universities across the country from the beginning of this year.

A large number of agricultural workers are enrolled in the tele-education system of agricultural universities across the country to acquire advanced agricultural science and technology. -0-

headline: Natural Science Prize Instituted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- The newly-instituted Natural Science Prize will be awarded from this year.
An official concerned of the State Commission of Science and Technology said this.
According to him, the Natural Science Prize was instituted to appreciate more scientists and technicians and encourage them to exert greater energies in scientific research.
It is the prize awarded to those who have laid a scientific and theoretical foundation of great significance in economic construction by making a tangible contribution to the development of new scientific theories and methodologies in the basic science, cross-disciplinary science and other natural sciences by carrying out the state tasks of sci-tech development.
The prize is awarded to the persons who carried out the state tasks of sci-tech development and registered his or her successes as national sci-tech successes and those recognized by the world for his or her scientific research successes. -0-

Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- The General Association of Koreans in China held events to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
On February 15, officials and members of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Jilin City branch of the Jilin Regional Association under the GAKC and the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the family of a former vice chairperson of the Jilin Provincial Association laid floral baskets before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and paid tribute to him.
Floral baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC and the Dandong City branch of the Liaoning Regional Association of the GAKC were placed before the portraits and pictures of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilat the DPRK embassy in Beijing and DPRK missions in Shenyang and Dandong on Feb. 16.

She said thatKim Jong Il, who was born as the son of the guerrillas in Mt Paektu, the holy mountain of revolution, made ceaseless high-intensity forced march all his life with his great ideal and firm faith to build the DPRK into a  socialist power with strong defence capabilities that no aggression forces dare to invade, and performed the great exploits to remain long in the history of the country.

Then followed a celebration performance.
Meanwhile, the Changbai County branch of the Jilin Regional Association of the GAKC and other affiliated organizations watched the meeting and celebration performance by the GAKC through videos and had colorful celebration events. -0-

headline: U.S. Nuclear Stick Can Never Work in Asia-Pacific Region: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- The U.S., which recently received hundreds of millions of U.S. dollars from Australia according to the AUKUS nuclear submarine agreement, showed its moves to provide Virginia-class nuclear submarines to Australia.
This is not just a simple money deal but a full-scale operation of another nuclear alliance with the U.S. as the principal axis. It is a dangerous attempt to further deteriorate the unstable political and military environment in the Asia-Pacific region.
As everybody knows, the U.S., obsessed with the ambition for establishing hegemony, set it as its main goal to contain and encircle nuclear states in the Asia-Pacific region and has been keen on the moves to organize the nuclear alliance for its attainment.
It organized a confrontational entity AUKUS, the Anglo-Saxon nuclear submarine alliance, under the pretext of the so-called "tripartite security cooperation" while bringing down the international nuclear non-proliferation system. This is a link in the whole chain of such moves.
The fact that the special security agreement was signed between the three parties to share the latest military technologies including nuclear submarine technology after the birth of AUKUS clearly proves the dangerous nature of the military bloc.
Against this backdrop, the present U.S. administration is actively pushing ahead with the provision of nuclear submarines to Australia.
Such moves of the U.S. gravely threatening regional peace and stability are becoming a matter of serious concern.
The U.S. already cooked up the "nuclear operation guidelines" with the puppet ROK and promised that nuclear weapons are included in the "offer of extended deterrence" to Japan. Like this, it has turned the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation system into a thorough nuclear alliance.
Now, there is a threatening entity called the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite nuclear alliance. Under such situation, if another nuclear alliance has its own structure perfectly, the U.S. will get a multilayer nuclear encirclement ring against its "rivals" in the Asia-Pacific region.
It is quite clear to which the U.S. regarding the DPRK and other nuclear states in the region as a "stumbling block" to the establishment of its hegemony and taking much pain to remove them, would direct the orientation of those aggressive military blocs' simultaneous attack.
The U.S. should ponder over the consequences to be entailed by such military adventurist act aimed at bringing nuclear clouds to the Asia-Pacific region at any cost.
The U.S. nuclear stick can never work in the Asia-Pacific region.
Can nuclear states in the region remain a passive onlooker to the U.S. reckless moves? -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Accelerating Production and Construction with Great Enthusiasm
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- Hearing with great joy and excitement the news about the clear, lively and bold progress in regional rejuvenation, the people in the DPRK are filled with their strong will to repay the loving care and benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea with loyalty and patriotism, Rodong Sinmun Thursday says in an editorial.
It is the work method peculiar to the WPK to accelerate the victorious advance of socialist construction by giving full play to the loyalty and patriotic strength of our people, the editorial says, and goes on:
It is the firm creed of our Party that there are nothing impossible to do and no fortress unconquerable when it relies on the ideological and mental strength of the masses boundlessly loyal to its cause.
Today our Party has set forth the gigantic tasks for successfully attaining the goal for this year, the last year of implementing the Five-Year Plan, and ushering in a new heyday of socialist construction as it trusts patriotism and loyalty of the masses that rise up as one and resolutely struggle in hearty response to its call.
Our people have the firm belief that following the Party is the way for realizing the noblest ideal and aspiration, confidence that they can surely build a powerful country, to be envied by the world, in their own way and by their own efforts, and the fighting spirit of self-sustenance. The ranks of those people out in the on-going general onward march are replete with such loyalty, patriotic zeal and revolutionary stamina.
The heroic struggle of 2025, which will be recorded as another year of great victory in history, calls upon all the people to perform new miracles and feats.
The editorial calls upon all the people to give full play to their irresistible strength of loyalty and patriotism so as to greet the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and the Ninth Party Congress with high political enthusiasm and brilliant labour achievements. -0-

headline: Hoeryong White Apricot, Specialty of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 20 (KCNA) -- Hoeryong white apricot is an intermediate variety of apricot which has been cultivated in the Hoeryong area of North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK from long ago.
It can bear fruit within four or five years since its sapling is planted and it is possible to reap it since ten years.
Output from a tree is 30-50 kilograms on an average and from per hectare approximately 15-25 tons.
As its demand for soil is not high, it can be planted in the vicinity of houses and along roads, including hillsides.
It weighs about 60 grams and has a flat round or round shape and yellowish white peel.
Its pulp is yellow white, refreshing and sweet with rich water and aroma.
It contains sugar and organic acid such as malic acid and citric acid, and is rich in oil, pectin, vitamins and other substances, which are efficacious for strengthening blood vessels and preventing cancer.
Its seeds stop coughing and loosen phlegm.
It is a good raw material for making various processed products including wine, canned, jam, jelly, fruit juice and dried fruit.
PresidentKim Il Sungvisited Hoeryong in July, 1954 and other several times and gave detailed instructions ranging from an issue of planting many white apricot trees in Hoeryong to a method of fruit processing.
The Hoeryong white apricot was registered as a regional intangible cultural heritage in the DPRK. -0-

headline: Reception Given by Russian Diplomats
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 21 (KCNA) -- Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora and the military attaché of the Russian embassy here hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on Thursday to mark the Day of Defenders of the Motherland.
Present there on invitation were Minister No Kwang Chol, Vice-Minister Kim Kang Il of National Defence of the DPRK, Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs Kim Jong Gyu, generals and other officers of the Korean People's Army and officials concerned, and members of the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here.
Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand.
Alexei Bartusov, Russian military attaché, made a speech at the reception.
He said that Russia proudly regards the Great Patriotic War veterans, internationalist soldiers and all other people who honorably performed the serviceperson's duty with bravery and loyalty to the motherland.
He stressed it was a key event that the Russia-DPRK cooperative relations were put on an unprecedentedly high level and the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership was concluded thanks to the political will of President of Russian Federation V. V. Putin and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of KoreaKim Jong Un.

He, on behalf of all the service personnel of the armed forces of the DPRK, extended noble militant salute to the service personnel of the Russian army, the honorable defenders of the motherland who are devoting themselves to the sacred cause of defending the dignity and sovereignty of the country and people and realizing the international justice.
The traditional DPRK-Russia relations of friendship and cooperation have been developed into the comprehensive strategic partnership and invincible comradely-in-arms relations with the DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit held in June last year as an occasion, demonstrating their vitality and might to the full, he said.

headline: Production Boosted in Key Industrial Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 21 (KCNA) -- Factories and enterprises in the key industrial sector of the DPRK are boosting production.

And the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex has provided a guarantee for the increased production of iron and steel by raising the operating rate of oxygen blast furnaces.

headline: Medical Service Brisk at Housing Construction Site in Hwasong Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 21 (KCNA) -- Medical workers in the capital city of Pyongyang are conducting the brisk medical service at the construction site for building 10 000 flats at the third-stage in the Hwasong area.
Doctors and nurses of the Kim Man Yu Hospital and the Pyongyang Municipal General Hospital No. 1 expound the common knowledge of health care and general information on hygiene related to respiratory diseases that can easily occur in winter, while taking good care of the health of builders through proper medical examination.

headline: Press Statement of Information Office Chief at DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The chief of Information Office at the DPRK Ministry of National Defence on Friday issued the following press statement "We will counter the enemies' strategic threat with our strategic means":
Since the emergence of the Trump administration, the U.S. and its vassal forces are getting evermore pronounced in their military provocations threatening the security environment of the DPRK.
On Feb. 20, the U.S. staged a provocative joint air drill with the ROK by dispatching B-1B strategic bomber into the sky over the Korean peninsula. Earlier, on Feb. 19, it test-fired the ICBM Minuteman 3 at the Vandenberg Space Force Base towards the target in the Pacific.
Such military muscle-flexing of the U.S. clearly show the invariable supremacy ambition of the present U.S. administration to gain an overwhelming edge of strength through the maintenance and updating of military capabilities capable of mounting a nuclear attack on any country and region of the world without prior warning.
The U.S. provocative military moves in the vicinity of the DPRK in less than two months this year are a clear answer to where the real threat increasing the world's concern over peace and security originates from.
Since Feb. 3, the U.S. military has waged a provocative joint live-shell firing drill with the ROK military gangsters, mobilizing thousands of troops and 150-odd pieces of military hardware of various missions in the area just 30 km away from the southern border of the DPRK.
The U.S. deployed a nuclear submarine in the Pusan operation base from Feb. 10 to 15, and on Feb. 13 in the ROK Bombardier BD-700 Global Express, the latest reconnaissance plane of a new generation which underwent a flight-test last year. It has also conducted air espionages on the DPRK's areas from Feb. 15 with the mobilization of various tactical and strategic reconnaissance planes including P-8A sea patrol plane and RC-135V.
The U.S. is also mulling again staging the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield, which includes seven rounds of brigade-level joint field maneuvers more compared to that of last year, in March in collusion with ROK in order to push the military tension in the region to an extreme phase.
The typical Yankee-style arrogance and shameless and gangster-like double-standards logic of the U.S., which brands the DPRK's nuclear deterrence for self-defence as an injustice means and places "legality" and "regularity" on former’s moves for bolstering up nuclear force for hegemony, can never work on the DPRK.
The DPRK's nuclear force is a means for legitimate defence to safeguard the national sovereignty and the security of the region. Its rapid and accelerated bolstering up is a realistic requirement for coping with the military threat of the U.S. and its satellite countries which are getting more rampant recently.
The adventuristic military moves of the U.S. premised on the use of nuclear strike means in an actual war are getting brisk and the hostile forces' attempt at military confrontation is getting ever more undisguised. This reality clearly proves why the DPRK armed forces' building up of the capability to fight a war with nuclear deterrence as a pivot is a just and inevitable option.
The DPRK's solution to the military threat and challenge to the security being posed by the U.S. is clear and consistent.
The DPRK will counter the strategic threat of the U.S. and other enemies with strategic means and continue its responsible military activities to control and manage the unstable security environment on the Korean peninsula with powerful deterrence. -0-

headline: 38th Sci-Tech Festival of Kim Il Sung University Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The 38th Science and Technology Festival ofKim Il SungUniversity took place in the DPRK from February 19 to 21.
Teachers, researchers, postgraduate students and students of the university have made many achievements over the last one year through a campaign of brains and quest.
Presented to the festival, held on the theme "Science and technology are a traction engine for comprehensive national rejuvenation", were more than 180 scientific research successes conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the people's living standards.
The festival was held in the forms of presentation and exhibition of sci-tech achievements, exhibition contests among units, sci-tech forum and exchange of new technologies, divided into six panels including key industry, agriculture and land and environmental protection.
Drawing the attention of the participants were an integrated production system of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, developed and completed true to the Workers' Party of Korea's policy plan, a technical proposal for solving the problem of phosphatic fertilizer and other achievements.
During the festival, there were the presentation and examination of sci-tech achievements and the exchange of experience gained in the scientific research activities. And the themes of future research were newly selected.
The rotating pennants and certificates were conferred on the units and participants who won a high appreciation. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on Feb. 22.
The message said:
The respected Comrade Ho Jong Man,
I extend warm congratulations on behalf of our state and all the people to Comrade Chairman on greeting your 90th birthday  on the  shining long road of patriotism for the country and nation.
And I convey warm greetings to your wife Yun Yong Ja, who has so far supported and encouraged you with her pure mind and taken pains more than anyone else.
In every February when I feel strong longing for GeneralKim Jong Il, I feel ardent yearning for you, Comrade Chairman, whom the General valued and loved most.
You, Comrade Ho Jong Man are a precious veteran of our revolution as you have devoted your heart and soul to the development of Chongryon with absolute loyalty to the leader and homeland for 70 years, true to the patriotic pledge you made in the days of forming Chongryon. You are also a patriotic standard-bearer and pioneer of struggle who has fluttered the glorious flag of our Republic in the vanguard of the Juche-oriented movement of Koreans in Japan.
Thanks to the patriotic predecessors like you, Comrade Chairman, who have firmly defended and preserved Chongryon, a part of the Republic, with transparent loyalty and strong faith in the harsh circumstances of the capitalist Japanese land, Chongryon could develop into an icon organization to be handed down long in the history of the world overseas compatriots' movement and into a renowned overseas compatriots' organization enjoying the absolute support and love of the compatriots.
The heroic life and distinguished feats of you, Comrade Chairman, that shine like a jewel in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan proud with loyalty and patriotism will be recorded long in the history of the Korean revolution along with the powerful homeland.
I hope that you, Comrade Chairman, a witness to the Juche-oriented movement of Koreans in Japan and representative of the forming generation of Chongryon, would enjoy a long life in good health for the rosy future of Chongryon and for the prosperity of the Korean community and greet all the glory together with the prosperous motherland.
I pay heartfelt tribute to the noble life of an ardent patriot and loyalist and genuine overseas revolutionary. -0-

headline: 38th Sci-Tech Festival of Kim Il Sung University Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The 38th Science and Technology Festival ofKim Il SungUniversity took place in the DPRK from February 19 to 21.
Teachers, researchers, postgraduate students and students of the university have made many achievements over the last one year through a campaign of brains and quest.
Presented to the festival, held on the theme "Science and technology are a traction engine for comprehensive national rejuvenation", were more than 180 scientific research successes conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the people's living standards.
The festival was held in the forms of presentation and exhibition of sci-tech achievements, exhibition contests among units, sci-tech forum and exchange of new technologies, divided into six panels including key industry, agriculture and land and environmental protection.
Drawing the attention of the participants were an integrated production system of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, developed and completed true to the Workers' Party of Korea's policy plan, a technical proposal for solving the problem of phosphatic fertilizer and other achievements.
During the festival, there were the presentation and examination of sci-tech achievements and the exchange of experience gained in the scientific research activities. And the themes of future research were newly selected.
The rotating pennants and certificates were conferred on the units and participants who won a high appreciation. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Information Office Chief at DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The chief of Information Office at the DPRK Ministry of National Defence on Friday issued the following press statement "We will counter the enemies' strategic threat with our strategic means":
Since the emergence of the Trump administration, the U.S. and its vassal forces are getting evermore pronounced in their military provocations threatening the security environment of the DPRK.
On Feb. 20, the U.S. staged a provocative joint air drill with the ROK by dispatching B-1B strategic bomber into the sky over the Korean peninsula. Earlier, on Feb. 19, it test-fired the ICBM Minuteman 3 at the Vandenberg Space Force Base towards the target in the Pacific.
Such military muscle-flexing of the U.S. clearly show the invariable supremacy ambition of the present U.S. administration to gain an overwhelming edge of strength through the maintenance and updating of military capabilities capable of mounting a nuclear attack on any country and region of the world without prior warning.
The U.S. provocative military moves in the vicinity of the DPRK in less than two months this year are a clear answer to where the real threat increasing the world's concern over peace and security originates from.
Since Feb. 3, the U.S. military has waged a provocative joint live-shell firing drill with the ROK military gangsters, mobilizing thousands of troops and 150-odd pieces of military hardware of various missions in the area just 30 km away from the southern border of the DPRK.
The U.S. deployed a nuclear submarine in the Pusan operation base from Feb. 10 to 15, and on Feb. 13 in the ROK Bombardier BD-700 Global Express, the latest reconnaissance plane of a new generation which underwent a flight-test last year. It has also conducted air espionages on the DPRK's areas from Feb. 15 with the mobilization of various tactical and strategic reconnaissance planes including P-8A sea patrol plane and RC-135V.
The U.S. is also mulling again staging the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield, which includes seven rounds of brigade-level joint field maneuvers more compared to that of last year, in March in collusion with ROK in order to push the military tension in the region to an extreme phase.
The typical Yankee-style arrogance and shameless and gangster-like double-standards logic of the U.S., which brands the DPRK's nuclear deterrence for self-defence as an injustice means and places "legality" and "regularity" on former’s moves for bolstering up nuclear force for hegemony, can never work on the DPRK.
The DPRK's nuclear force is a means for legitimate defence to safeguard the national sovereignty and the security of the region. Its rapid and accelerated bolstering up is a realistic requirement for coping with the military threat of the U.S. and its satellite countries which are getting more rampant recently.
The adventuristic military moves of the U.S. premised on the use of nuclear strike means in an actual war are getting brisk and the hostile forces' attempt at military confrontation is getting ever more undisguised. This reality clearly proves why the DPRK armed forces' building up of the capability to fight a war with nuclear deterrence as a pivot is a just and inevitable option.
The DPRK's solution to the military threat and challenge to the security being posed by the U.S. is clear and consistent.
The DPRK will counter the strategic threat of the U.S. and other enemies with strategic means and continue its responsible military activities to control and manage the unstable security environment on the Korean peninsula with powerful deterrence. -0-

headline: Work for Successfully Concluding Five-year Plan for Capital City Construction Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 22 (KCNA) -- The construction headquarters for 50 000 flats in Pyongyang is meticulously organizing the work to successfully complete the five-year plan for the capital city construction.
Officials have taken practical measures to perfectly push forward the huge task for turning the Hwasong area into a model of urban-block formation and a beautiful and magnificent place where the formative artistic beauty and advanced civilization are in good harmony, while keeping pace with bold operation and scientific guidance.
The construction of infrastructure and main road is progressing apace to turn the Hwasong area into a model administrative district in Pyongyang where everything needed for the life of inhabitants is splendidly provided.
The relevant sections are organizing the work to timely supply materials needed for construction so as to ensure the schedule of the project.
Such work has been timely conducted to supply technical designs to construction units so that they can build the bases for cultural life to be erected as functional buildings, which are large in scale and demand high technical requirements, and modern dwelling houses without any slightest defects.
Assignment of duty has been conducted, thus making all the units push ahead with a new street construction.
All construction units have taken measures to supply heavy machines and tools without hindrance and in a far-sighted way as the amount of construction is greater than last year. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Brisk among Trade Union Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- Trade union organizations at all levels in the DPRK have provided reserves for increased production through a mass movement, contributing to the production growth.
The trade union committee of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex aroused its members to the mass movement for increased production of iron and steel and provided production sites with tens of tons of raw material reserves.
Workers and trade union members of the Sodusu Power Station provided a lot of repair tools to contribute to finishing the overhaul of generator by the appointed time.
More than 10 trade union members of the part processing shop at the Taedonggang Electric Appliances Factory manufactured a speed-control device for large drawing machine by themselves to contribute to boosting the production.
Trade union members of different units, including the Anju Pump Factory, the Anju Tractor Accessory Factory and the Haeju Tractor Accessory Factory, have displayed the spirit of devoting themselves to collecting idle materials and securing spare parts.
Trade union organizations in South Phyongan Province, including Kaechon City and Sukchon County, have turned the good-conduct movement into work of the masses themselves, thus contributing to the production of daily necessities with collected idle materials.
Trade union members in Ongjin and Kwail counties of South Hwanghae Province, too, collected a large amount of idle materials to contribute to producing consumer goods. -0-

headline: Celebration Events Held at DPRK Missions Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- Such events as reception, friendly meeting, book and photo exhibition and film show were held at the DPRK missions in Vladivostok and Khabarovsk of Russia, Shenyang and Dandong of China, Vietnam, Laos, Mongolia, Singapore, Iran, India, Indonesia, Cambodia, Kuwait, Thailand, Pakistan, Germany, Romania, Belarus, Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, Italy, the Czech Republic, Nigeria, South Africa, Algeria, Egypt, Ethiopia, Equatorial Guinea, Mexico and Venezuela and the DPRK permanent mission to the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva and the  DPRK permanent mission at the UN from February 10 to 16 to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there on invitation were personages of parliaments, governments, political parties, organizations and institutions of relevant countries and foreign diplomatic envoys in those countries. Officials of the DPRK missions were on hand.
Screened at the film shows were a film dealing with the exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho made great contributions to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence and videos showing the picture of the DPRK making a radical development under the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Speeches were made at the events.
Speakers praised the great ComradeKim Jong Ilas a renowned political activist, outstanding state leader, peerlessly great statesman and peerless patriot.
Lauding the DPRK people for having achieved proud successes in the work to make comprehensive national rejuvenation under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the speakers wished them greater progress in their future struggle. -0-

headline: Support to Nurseries and Kindergartens Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- Various units in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, are rendering active support to nurseries and kindergartens.
Officials of the Central District Public Prosecutors Office set a goal to further improve the appearance of Pyongyang March 3 Nursery and giving a helping hand to its remodeling project while ensuring the supply of materials. As a result, they spruced up the room for intelligence games, bedrooms, etc.
They also offered various kinds of toys conducive to developing intelligence and helping growing tall and nutritive foodstuffs to the nursery.
The Moranbong District Public Security Station worked out monthly and yearly plans for supporting kindergartens in the district and has made sure that all its branch stations provide labor and material assistance to kindergartens in their sections. And it has also conducted a review and evaluation work to increase the enthusiasm for support.
Tongdaewon, Songyo, Samsok and Hyongjesan district power distribution stations have paid attention to the work of nurseries and kindergartens and solved knotty problems. -0-

headline: Farming Preparation Brisk in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the production and transport of self-sufficing manure to turn all farm fields into fertile soil.
Millions of tons of manure were secured thanks to the high enthusiasm of agricultural officials and farmers in the province.
Officials in Jangyon and Anak counties have conducted the political work on farm fields and set personal examples to arouse the farmers to increasing the production of manure and transporting it.
Paechon, Yonan and Pongchon counties secured hundreds of thousands of tons of self-sufficing manure by raising the enthusiasm for socialist emulation to make good quality manure suited to the soil conditions in their regions.
Agricultural workers in Haeju City and Kangryong, Thaethan, Sinwon, Songhwa, Unchon and Unryul counties have produced much more manure than planned and piled up them on fields.
Jaeryong and Sinchon counties have mobilized all kinds of vehicles to transport manure to all farm fields in good time.
Pyoksong County is operating the compound microorganism fertilizer factory at full capacity and Chongdan County is boosting the production of compound microorganism fertilizer and slow-action granulated fertilizer. -0-

headline: Mushroom Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- Officials and employees of the Thaechon Mushroom Farm in the DPRK have produced 1.2 times more mushroom than the same period of last year.
The farm put its enterprise and business management on a scientific basis and made substrate materials with wheat and barley straw by strengthening its own technical force and existing production base. It also directed efforts to the readjustment and reinforcement of various kinds of equipment to lay a foundation for normalizing production.
Meanwhile, it established a cultivation method suited to actual condition to lower the standard of per unit consumption and raise the productivity, while solving technical problems arising in the introduction of new strains of mushroom with good taste and high nutritive value. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Production of School Uniform and Bag Cloth
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Light industrial factories in the DPRK finished the first-stage production of school uniform and bag cloth and are expanding their successes.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill successfully completed the first-stage production of school uniform and bag cloth and entered the production of next stage, recording high results.
The Sinuiju Textile Mill has intensified its control and guidance to make the workers observe the technical rules and standard operating method and ensure the quality indices in the production of school uniform and bag cloth.
Besides, the light industrial factories producing school uniform and bag cloth across the country, including the Haeju Textile Mill, have restored the original performance of equipment and conducted the management of equipment and technical control in a responsible manner, thus increasing the productivity as compared with the same period of last year. -0-

headline: Cement Production Units in DPRK Boost Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Workers of various cement production units in the DPRK are over-fulfilling their daily production assignments.
The main production units of the Sangwon Cement Complex have updated the quadruple-field inspection system and preventive repair system, thus witnessing the highest result in daily production at every shift.
In February, the complex increased 10 000 more tons of cement than the same period of last year.
The Sunchon Cement Complex has steadily created new standard and new records to produce several thousand more tons of cement, while conducting the mass technological innovation movement.
The main production units of the Chonnaeri Cement Factory have increased the production every day by conducting an inter-process and inter-machine socialist emulation. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Thanks from Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of thanks from Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on Feb. 22.
Ho Jong Man in the letter expressed his deep thanks to MarshalKim Jong Unfor bestowing the great benevolence and vitality upon old him again while wishing that he would enjoy a long life in good health for the rosy future of Chongryon and the prosperity of the Korean community in Japan and would get all glory together with the prosperous motherland.
He expressed his firm pledge to resolutely defend Chongryon, part of the DPRK, and devote all his energy and soul to ushering in a new era of the comprehensive development of Chongryon and its prosperity along with the homeland.
And he manifested his will to further consolidate Chongryon as a dignified overseas revolutionary organization of the DPRK, a reliable flank front of the Korean revolution and a powerful overseas combat unit and lead the Koreans in Japan to be members of the family of the Marshal who regard loyalty and patriotism as their creed even in an alien land by thoroughly implementing the compatriots-first principle in the whole of patriotic activities.
He said that he would fly the flag of the DPRK higher in the van of all Chongryon officials to defend the dignity and destiny of Koreans in Japan and definitely guarantee the happiness of compatriots and the future of their posterity, as instructed by the Marshal.
Only when MarshalKim Jong Unis in good health, the Korean revolution will dynamically advance towards the high peak of communism so that a bright ideal society desired by the people can be built on the homeland and Chongryon and Koreans in Japan can greet the day of great victory, the letter stressed. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- More than 300 workers in the textile industry of the DPRK have become innovators through a drive for increased production.
160-odd workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill carried out their first quarterly plans and six of them fulfilled their first half-yearly plans.
Tens of workers of the Sinuiju Textile Mill fulfilled their first quarterly plans and the innovators are increasing in number with each passing day.
The Sariwon Textile Mill, the Kusong Textile Mill and other textile mills are making collective innovations by intensifying such mass movements as the movement of doing one more shift and helping the next shift. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued on Feb. 23 the following press statement "Illegal anti-DPRK sanctions-breeding moves will precipitate the DPRK's behavioral counteraction to defend its sovereign right":
Recently the U.S. and its followers held a confab, called a meeting of the steering committee of the "multilateral sanctions monitoring team" (MSMT), in Washington and talked about strengthening the implementation of the UN "sanctions resolutions" to cope with the nuclear and missile "threats" of the DPRK.
The "MSMT", formed by the states that are only doing harmful things, far from contributing to international peace and security, is nothing but an illegal, illegitimate and criminal ghost group in terms of the reason of its existence and purpose.

headline: Many Innovators Produced in Textile Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- More than 300 workers in the textile industry of the DPRK have become innovators through a drive for increased production.
160-odd workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill carried out their first quarterly plans and six of them fulfilled their first half-yearly plans.
Tens of workers of the Sinuiju Textile Mill fulfilled their first quarterly plans and the innovators are increasing in number with each passing day.

headline: Wreaths Laid at Liberation Towers and Cemeteries of Fallen Fighters of Soviet Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Staff members of the Russian embassy here laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on Feb. 23 to mark the Day of Defenders of the Motherland.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the tower.
Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Ambassador Alexandr Matsegora, Military Attache Alexei Bartusov and  members of the embassy.
They were accompanied by Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of the National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
A wreath in the name of the Russian embassy was placed at the Liberation Tower amid the playing of wreath-laying music.
The participants paid tribute to the memory of the fallen fighters of the Soviet Army, who dedicated their precious lives to the just struggle for Korea's liberation with noble internationalism, and looked round the tower.
They also laid wreaths, bouquets and flowers at the cemetery of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in Sadong District.
Meanwhile, the members of the Russian embassy visited the liberation towers in local areas. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects North and South Hamgyong Provinces
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of various sectors in North and South Hamgyong provinces.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, a leading machine-building base of the country, the premier called upon its officials, technicians and workers to unconditionally attain the modernization goal set for this year, true to the intention of the Party to turn the complex into a model of the machine-building industry, and make fresh innovations in the production of major custom-built equipment by waging a dynamic drive for increased production as befitting the creator of the Chollima spirit in the new era.
He stressed the need to steadily update the performance of equipment by regarding science and technology as the main link in the chain of increasing production and thus improve the precision of processing and assembling of products and the quality of castings.
At the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the premier called for boosting the productivity of fertilizer and basic chemical products by making effective use of the existing capacity and positively pushing forward the work for establishing the production capacity of slow effective fertilizer and perfecting the production process of melamine resin to contribute to increasing the agricultural production and improving the people's living standards.
Going round the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, he stressed the need to increase the Juche iron production by raising the operation rate of the energy-saving oxygen blast furnace to increase the number of charges per day and the amount of molten iron per charge, and to actively conduct a mass technical innovation movement for reducing the fuel consumption.
He learned in detail about the production and the implementation of the plan for readjustment and reinforcement at the Chongjin Steel Plant and the Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill. And he stressed the need to ensure proper process-by-process engagement and introduce rational production methods so as to turn out much more quality Samhwa iron and fibre goods.
Field consultative meetings discussed the issue of intensifying the research for reducing the standard of material consumption per unit and improving the quality of steel and fireproof materials, the issue of ensuring enterprise and business management on a scientific basis in conformity with the actual conditions of relevant units and the issue for relevant units to supply enough raw and other materials in time.
Earlier, the premier learned about the trial operation of a new-type tube train at the metro line in Pyongyang. He stressed the need to rectify the shortcomings as soon as possible so as to ensure the safety of traffic and the convenience of passengers in a perfect way and to standardize various kinds of parts, accessories and materials and establish a strict quality inspection system. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Thanks from Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of thanks from Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on Feb. 22.
Ho Jong Man in the letter expressed his deep thanks to MarshalKim Jong Unfor bestowing the great benevolence and vitality upon old him again while wishing that he would enjoy a long life in good health for the rosy future of Chongryon and the prosperity of the Korean community in Japan and would get all glory together with the prosperous motherland.
He expressed his firm pledge to resolutely defend Chongryon, part of the DPRK, and devote all his energy and soul to ushering in a new era of the comprehensive development of Chongryon and its prosperity along with the homeland.
And he manifested his will to further consolidate Chongryon as a dignified overseas revolutionary organization of the DPRK, a reliable flank front of the Korean revolution and a powerful overseas combat unit and lead the Koreans in Japan to be members of the family of the Marshal who regard loyalty and patriotism as their creed even in an alien land by thoroughly implementing the compatriots-first principle in the whole of patriotic activities.
He said that he would fly the flag of the DPRK higher in the van of all Chongryon officials to defend the dignity and destiny of Koreans in Japan and definitely guarantee the happiness of compatriots and the future of their posterity, as instructed by the Marshal.
Only when MarshalKim Jong Unis in good health, the Korean revolution will dynamically advance towards the high peak of communism so that a bright ideal society desired by the people can be built on the homeland and Chongryon and Koreans in Japan can greet the day of great victory, the letter stressed. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Light industrial factories in the DPRK finished the first-stage production of school uniform and bag cloth and are expanding their successes.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill successfully completed the first-stage production of school uniform and bag cloth and entered the production of next stage, recording high results.
The Sinuiju Textile Mill has intensified its control and guidance to make the workers observe the technical rules and standard operating method and ensure the quality indices in the production of school uniform and bag cloth.
Besides, the light industrial factories producing school uniform and bag cloth across the country, including the Haeju Textile Mill, have restored the original performance of equipment and conducted the management of equipment and technical control in a responsible manner, thus increasing the productivity as compared with the same period of last year. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kim Il Sung University of Politics
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- At a time when the outlook on the revolution, transparent patriotic spirit and matchless fighting efficiency peculiar to the heroic Korean People's Army (KPA) are being demonstrated as the unprecedented legendary feats in the sacred course of building a rich country with strong army led by the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), the great leadership adding a great viability to the brave stride of the KPA has been recorded in the cradle of its political and ideological mightiness and the strategic fortress for building a powerful army.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visitedKim Il SungUniversity of Politics, the supreme military and political school of the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces, on February 24.
All the teaching staff and students of the university and soldiers of sub-units under it were filled with boundless emotion and joy before the glorious moment of meeting the great teacher and the great brilliant commander, whom they wanted to see so much at the campus in the historic year marking the 80th founding anniversary of university.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived in the university, service personnel broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"  of the greatest respect, looking up to the peerlessly illustrious commander who is leading the brilliant history of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK to the eternal victory and glory and dynamically ushering in a new era of building a powerful army on the ideology-first principle with his outstanding idea of building the army and energetic leadership.
Kim Il SungUniversity of Politics courteously greeted the head of the state.
After receiving a salute from the president of the university, he paid militant tribute to the glorious colors.
An educator and a student of the university presented him with fragrant bouquets in humble reverence.
Acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers, he extended warm greetings to the teaching staff who are reliably guaranteeing the sacred cause of making the KPA ideologically elite with their steadfast revolutionary spirit and brilliant educational and scientific achievements at the prestigious military and political school and to the students who are firmly preparing themselves to be promising political workers in the future.
He was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other members of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
The teaching staff and students had a march-past, flying the colors associated with the great honor and feats of the university.
Kim Jong Unmade an important speech to be specially recorded in the history of building the Juche-oriented powerful army.
The political and ideological traits of the KPA have remained consistently honorable and faithful to the generation of the army founding and the country and people along with the long days and changes of history, he said, adding that this would be unthinkable without the exploits ofKim Il SungUniversity of Politics which has steadfastly fulfilled its role in the key position guaranteeing the succession of the revolutionary armed group. He noted that the prestige of the university shines with pride in a new era of great change and renovation and its existence is characterized with remarkable meaning because it is defending the basis of a revolutionary powerful army which is imbued with the idea of the Party and remains absolutely loyal to its leadership.
Saying that the arms of the KPA stand in sharp contrast in the past and present in the history of building the Juche-oriented army, but only the idea with which they are charged has remained unchanged, andKim Il SungUniversity of Politics has remained boundlessly faithful to its mission and duty in the course of the revolutionary struggle in which the mightiness of the ideology-first principle is fully verified, he recalled with deep emotion the glorious history of the university which has made a great contribution to training many communists and defending the succession of our revolutionary cause over 80 years since its founding.
Saying that the WPK always appreciates the political workers imbuing the service personnel with the noble spirit and bravery and their alma maters as well as the heroic feats of the KPA and highly raises as the character peculiar to the KPA the matchless loyalty and heroism of overcoming hardship and sacrifice cheerfully if the country calls, cherishing the glorious colors as its life, he noted that it is the most brilliant achievement of the university which cannot be compared with any academic prestige or educational and scientific successes. And he paid respects to the educators who have devoted themselves to accomplishing the Party's sacred cause of building a powerful army.
He stressed that the KPA, which defends the most just cause, the most just state and the most just people, should surely become the strongest army in the world, and the foremost mightiness and superiority of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK to steadily adhere to and strengthen for this important historic mission and heavy responsibility are none other than the political, ideological, spiritual and moral advantages of the army of the Party and the people.
Referring to the fact that it has been an established theory to count soldiers and weapons as two elements of the armed forces in any century and any country and that it has not been broken from advocating the theory of centering on military technology in the building of armed forces and in the course of war up to now of the 21st century, he said that from the historical point of view and from the viewpoint of modern war, we can clearly see in practice the limitation of the theory of centering on military technology that ignored the ideological building of the army.
It is the stark immutable truth that the ideological and moral superiority of the army means the qualitative superiority of the army, he stressed. And he expressed a new view that soldiers, weapons and ideology are regarded as three elements of the armed forces, saying that imbuing the army with ideology before arming it with military technology is the core of army building.
Saying that the arms without ideology are little short of ironware, and it is a conclusion to be drawn by us once again that it is the basic way of building a powerful army to strengthen the political force of the army on a preferential basis and in a qualitative way, he clarified that proceeding from it, the building the KPA should be invariably and thoroughly oriented toward giving priority to making the army politically, ideologically and morally strong and toward steadily realizing the purity of combat ranks and then highly developing military technology equipment in all domains including nuclear armed forces.
Saying that today when the struggle for transformation, unprecedented in the history of the DPRK, is being staged amid the rapid changes of the world, the role of the KPA contributing to carrying out the state strategy plan and policies is in a more signally important position than ever before, he stressed that the KPA should have political workers who always conduct positive activities to redouble the power of ideology in the fields of military activities for implementing the Party's line and policies in order to successfully fulfill its more important mission and role. And he referred to the important mission and role ofKim Il SungUniversity of Politics as the supreme military and political school which should firmly guarantee the political force of the KPA.
Analyzing the reason why some deviations failing to meet the demands and expectations of the Party Central Committee are being revealed among political workers standing in the position of educators of service personnel, he clarified in detail all tasks to be carried out by the teaching staff and students of the university in the struggle to further perfect the political, ideological, mental and moral preparations of the army.
Saying that the supreme political school of the KPA should surely become the best university in view of its important position and duty directly related to the prospect of the Korean revolution, he expressed the firm will of the WPK to completely improve the educational conditions and environment of the university.
Saying that when the university, a main base for implementing the WPK's line of making the army politically and ideologically stronger and a pedigree farm for cultivating the heroic spirit of the KPA, remains more faithful to its duty, the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK will grow stronger and their invincible mightiness be steadily redoubled, he affirmed that the immortal dignity and glory of the heroic KPA will shine forever along withKim Il SungUniversity of Politics which gives an eternal continuity to its sacred blood vessel and tradition of victory.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his speech, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers with their great excitement of receiving his unique revolutionary doctrine of army building that indicated the path for further developing the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK into an ever-victorious vanguard, more elite in ideology and strongest in fighting efficiency, with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom, profound insight and outstanding enunciation.
Kim Jong Unwent round several places of the university including the study room of the WPK building, the combined pedagogical information control room and the exhibition hall of educational achievements.
Highly appreciating that if the precious being indispensable for the destiny and future of the country and people is the KPA, the precious being indispensable for the KPA is just the university, educators and officials rendering loyal service to it, he stressed again that the KPA is resolute in politics and ideology and the strongest in fighting efficiency as the university trains the political workers of every generation in a single shape and produces competent political workers who constantly imbue the entire army with the red idea of the WPK.
He heard the speeches of students on the plan of the party political work and gave precious instructions for the university to train the students to be political workers who can master the Juche-oriented military idea and theory of the WPK and Korean-style tactics and conduct the party political work skillfully in conformity with different combat situations and to be skillful political activists who vigorously promote the work to make the entire army ideologically and mentally elite and perfect the war preparations.
He called upon all teachers of the university to verify before the Party and their disciples that they should become revolutionaries before becoming educators in practice and with ability and personality and to make a tangible contribution to innovating and developing the work for training party political workers with loyalty cherished as faith, pure patriotism, perfect ability of educator and scientific and theoretical prestige.
Kim Jong Unhad a significant photo taken with the teaching staff and students in token of his visit to the university.
When he appeared at the venue of the photo session, all the participants extended their deep thanks to him, looking up to the dear father who visited the university to offer an immortal great programme for dynamically steering a new turning point in training political workers of the revolutionary army and bestowed the loving care and benevolence to be handed down through generations.
After meeting the students exemplary in study and military service and warmly encouraging them, he had a photo to be recorded forever in the history of army building together with all the teaching staff and students.
Saying that the teaching staff and students of the university are the most core revolutionaries whom the Party trusts best and pins a particularly great expectation to their role, he expressed expectation and belief that all the teaching staff and students would become genuine revolutionaries full of the soul and breath of the WPK before anyone else and thus become the cornerstones and pillars of the revolutionary army with their excellent role.
That day,Kim Jong Unenjoyed sports games between the teaching staff and students ofKim Il SungUniversity of Politics and Kang Kon Military Academy.
The games between the prestigious educational institutions of the KPA were held, divided into football and volleyball events.
The football match in heated offensive and defensive movements was over with 11 meter penalty kick after drawing 1:1.
In the football match, the team of the university of politics defeated the team of the military academy 5:3 in total points.
The team of the university of politics also beat its rival team 3:1 in the volleyball match.
All the participants renewed their firm will to uphold the idea and leadership of the great Party Central Committee with absolute loyalty and distinguished educational achievements, paying the highest tribute toKim Jong Unwho warmly encourages them to fulfill their sacred duty in further consolidating the strongest political and military mightiness of the heroic KPA, spending the precious whole day with his military educational soldiers.
His sacred leadership over the highest institute of army political education will shine long in the history as a historic visit which provided a powerful ideological and theoretical guideline for making the heroic Korean People's Army, the pride of our great Party, state and people and symbol of their strength, carry forward the brilliant honor of the politically, ideological and morally strong army, which has carried forward century after century, with its absolute prestige for a hundred and a thousand years and for further consolidating its mightiness and incomparableness overwhelming any enemy and challenge at a stroke. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Jong Jong Gum, a woman centenarian living in people's neighborhood unit No. 26, Sangse-ri, Pukchong County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Reckless War Moves
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- Japan is making more desperate efforts than ever before to bring disaster to the Asia-Pacific region again in collusion with outside forces.
It was vividly expressed in the fact that shortly ago, Japan staged a joint drill with foreign strategic forces, including aircraft carriers of the U.S. Navy and the French Navy, in the Asia-Pacific region in nearly 10 days for the first time by mobilizing the large escort warship Kaga of its Maritime "Self-Defense Force" and other war equipment.
It is not exaggeration to say that one of the main factors causing the danger of destroying the balance of strength and creating a new conflicting structure in the region is Japan's action of frequently inviting the war maniacs from across the ocean under the pretext of "security".
Last year alone, Japan ran amuck to further aggravate the regional situation in collusion with outside forces, talking about "growing threat" by neighboring countries.
Not content with joining various confrontational groups such as QUAD and SQUAD to play an active role of a core member, it made desperate efforts to get recognized as a full-fledged member of AUKUS, an exclusive group of the Anglo-Saxons, being closeted with it.
Japan, which stretched out its tentacles to most of the military blocs in the region, made more frantic efforts than others to avail itself of the U.S. moves to form the Asian version of NATO with the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military alliance system as its axis and establish the military cooperative relations with NATO member states.
It is a part of such schemes that Japan set up even its independent full-time mission at NATO as soon as the new year started.
It is hard to count the number of various joint military drills staged under such situation.
This year alone, Japan has got hell-bent on the largest-ever parachute drill aimed at a sudden invasion of neighboring countries by introducing overseas aggression forces of more than 10 countries including the U.S. and UK into its islands.
Japan is busy with the preparations for a war of aggression, illustrated by the full-scale development and purchase of long-range strike means and the active movement to transfer the SDF headquarters into underground tunnels. Meanwhile, it has joined the outside aggression forces, dispatching even a virtual carrier to an area far away from its "exclusive defense" boundary. The reality hints that the militarists' ambition for overseas aggression has entered the stage of full-scale action.
It is by no means unreasonable for the world public to brand Japan as the most zealous element harassing the regional peace and stability and as the "guide of NATO".
Though Japan is letting loose a spate of rhetoric about the "security environment around it which is getting severe", pretending not to know its cause, the record of militarist acts performed by it which does not abandon its ambition for reinvasion even a moment will never get vague.
Gone are the days when the "Imperial Army" could ignite wars at its will to realize the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere".
Those countries in the region which suffered huge damage by Japan in the last century will never allow the descendants of the "Imperial Army" to ignite another war for realizing the old dream of "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- Young people in Ryanggang Province of the DPRK have advanced into difficult and labour-consuming sectors with their enthusiasm to glorify this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea as a year of performing feats to be recorded with pride on their personal accounts of youth.
Determined to work miracles and innovations in implementing the WPK's regional development policy, youths in Phungso County asked the youth league organization to dispatch them to the county construction brigade, and those in Unhung County advanced into raw material base stations.
Youths in Kim Jong Suk and Taehongdan counties volunteered to work in rural areas, and youth league members in Paekam County and other counties at remote posts in charge of managing ridge ways.
A meeting took place at the Ryanggang Provincial Hall of Culture on February 23 to congratulate those volunteers.
At the meeting attended by Kang Sin Chang, secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the WPK, youth league officials and young people, certificates were awarded to the volunteers and then a congratulatory address and pledge-making speeches were made.
At the end of the meeting, there was a congratulatory performance.
Officials, youth and students encouraged the volunteers leaving for new revolutionary posts, giving bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Souvenir Photo
story_text:
One day in February 1960, PresidentKim Il Sungcame to go via the then Thaekam-ri, Sunan County, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK, on a car at sunset.
Seeing young women turning manure over in a near rice field, the President got out of the car and went up to them. They were so pleased to meet the President in the field.
He took a fork from a young woman and climbed a compost heap to stab and turn it over with the fork.
After a good while he stopped it and was so delighted that the compost was rotten well. And he told the women to see him again at the field after having a bumper crop.
Then he had a photo taken with the young women in working clothes against a background of the compost heap. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Famous Work Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- It has been ten years since the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unmade public his famous work "Let the Entire Party, the Whole Army and All the People Conduct a Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign to Cover the Mountains of the Country with Green Woods" on Feb. 26, 2015.
The General Secretary in the work advanced important guidelines for covering the whole country with trees and flowers and aroused our people and service personnel to the forest restoration campaign. He called for building fine tree nurseries and dynamically conducting a tree-planting campaign at every place he visited.
In March 2022, he planted two fir trees on Hwasong Hill, saying that this is not merely tree planting but work to implant our Party's policies, warm patriotism and invariable pure conscience.
Thanks to his noble patriotic will to cover all the mountains with green woods, great progress has been made in the country's forest restoration work for the past decade.
More than one million hectares of forests were created and the Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery was successfully built. And North Hamgyong Province and other provinces have built labor- and land-saving tree nurseries, whose all production lines are automated and streamlined.
All provincial, city and county mother tree nurseries have necessary conditions for the production of saplings. As a result, the country's sapling output has risen by 1.5 times as compared with 10 years ago.
The provincial forestry science institutes have been built or remodeled in the country to lay a foundation for pushing ahead with afforestation and conservation of forests by dint of science and technology. And successes have been made in the work for protecting forests.
In those days many units were awarded the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest, and forest resources, which can contribute substantially to implementing the regional development policy of the Workers’ Party of Korea, were increased.
Thanks to the General Secretary's patriotic devotion and guidance, the mountains and fields of the country are getting greener day by day and the people's happy laughter resounds more loudly. -0-

headline: Groundbreaking Ceremonies of Regional-industry Factories, Hospital and Leisure Complex Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The grand construction struggle in 2025 to implement the regional development policy in the new era is going on in a three-dimensional and full-scale way in the DPRK.
There took place on Monday the groundbreaking ceremonies of regional-industry factories in Sinyang and Koksan counties, a hospital in Kusong City and regional-industry factories and a leisure complex in Jongphyong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy.
Present there were Kim Tok Hun, member of the Political Bureau  and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, officials and working people in relevant provinces, city and counties, service personnel and builders.
At the ceremonies, speakers said that the stirring reality, in which the unprecedented gigantic revolution is being made one after another to transform the regional areas, is an eye-opening change that can be made only by the steadfast outlook on the revolution and the people of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho never feels contented with the work for the people.
They referred to the fact that the General Secretary set forth the iron rule that the factories to be built for the promotion of people's well-being should be Korean-style ones fully suited to the regional conditions and convenience of the inhabitants, and clearly indicated the orientation and ways for raising the next-stage regional construction onto a higher level in line with the simultaneous construction of new factories in 20 cities and counties and has energetically led the work to do so.
They said that the new factories, which are to be built in a modern way in harmony with surrounding environment to make effective development and use of regional economic resources, are precious assets greatly conducive to promoting the improvement of the living standards of the people in the city and counties and sprucing up their appearance as regional bases of the highly-civilized, prosperous and powerful country.
They said that the construction of multifunctional bases for cultural activities and modern public health facilities under the noble plan of the General Secretary is the work essential for the comprehensive and sustained development of regions.
The speakers stressed that the new change to be certainly made in 20 cities and counties this year, too, would more powerfully prove the validity of the revolutionary cause of the WPK ushering in a new great era of regional transformation and the rosy future of socialism.
Then, officials and commanding officers of the construction units made speeches of pledge.
With the high confidence to bring about another epochal change in the new era, the builders started the projects in high spirits, operating construction equipment at full capacity. -0-

headline: Steep Water Slide
story_text:
One day in July 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Untoured the Songdowon International Children's Camp, where he examined a steep water slide at the outdoor wading pool.
The slide was made by service personnel. Early in June that year,Kim Jong Unlooked carefully at it and took a benevolent measure to install it at the outdoor wading pool of the camp.
Stroking the slide, he was so pleased that it was successfully made in our own way.
Then he looked round various places of the camp, and he went back to the slide as he wanted to see the slide used.
He made the accompanying officials use slide and said that it is very nice that it has the DPRK's trademark "Taedonggang".
After a while, he laughed, saying that our product was better.
His smile was the affection smile of the tender-hearted father, who was very pleased to provide the younger generation with another wonderful thing of our own. -0-
