Work for Strengthening Technical Forces Launched in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- Industrial establishments in the DPRK direct efforts to strengthening their own technical forces.
The Taean Heavy Machine Complex spruced up a school of skilled workers and has concentrated effort on improving its teachers' educational and practical qualifications.
In the course, the educational conditions and environment were renewed and superior teaching methods were introduced. As a result, many graduates from the school are playing an active role at production sites to contribute to the increased production.
Officials of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex are taking the lead in the technical innovation movement while organizing the work to increase the ranks of inventors and appreciating them to stir up the masses' enthusiasm.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has enrolled the new workers in the study-while-working educational system and made achievements by conducting technical and skill passing-on group activities.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex built a simulation practice place for operators by using information processing technology to train technical talents.
The Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Phyongsong School Uniform Factory and other units, too, are conducting the work to train technical talents, regarding it as a link in the whole chain for putting production on a normal basis and developing units. -0-

headline: Many Units Win Title of Socialist Patriotic Forest
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- Ten years have passed since the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade public a famous work "Let the Entire Party, the Whole Army and All the People Conduct a Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign to Cover the Mountains of the Country with Green Woods" on February 26, 2015.
In his work, he comprehensively clarified the issues related to forest restoration and stressed the need for the Party and working people's organizations to dynamically conduct the movements for winning the titles of Socialist Patriotic Forest and Model County in Afforestation.
In hearty response to his noble will of patriotism, a new mass movement has been launched across the whole society and many units won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest for the past decade.
Party and power organs across the country worked out clear long-term goals and stage-by-stage plans and conducted meticulous operations and command to unconditionally carry out the tasks for forest restoration, arousing the mental power of the masses.
Amid the practical successes being made in the afforestation and forest conservation, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory, the Unhung Farm in Thaechon County and the Tansan Farm in Pakchon County were the first to be awarded the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest in January 2019.
The enthusiasm of the working people to plant and tend even one more tree has been heightened day by day. As a result, more than 380 units won the title in 2020.
In 2021, the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest was awarded to many units including Unsan County of North Phyongan Province, Kwail County of South Hwanghae Province and Chollima District of Nampho Municipality.
Last year, Kangwon Province effectively organized a demonstration of model unit and brought into full play the enthusiasm for emulation among regions and units. As a result, hundreds of units won the title.
The movement is now going on in all fields and units, demonstrating its great vitality. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Kang Kon Military Academy
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- The prestigious military academy, which has recorded innumerable brilliant feats in the glorious colors while creditably performing its duty of training the junior commanding personnel, the backbone of basic combat units reliably supporting the immortal mightiness and invincibility of the heroic Korean People's Army, has greeted the glorious moment unprecedented in the proud 80-year history of its development.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Kang Kon Military Academy, a parent body of military education institutions in the country and the most prestigious commanding officers training centre, on February 25.
He was accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the Party Central Committee, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other members of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
After arriving at the academy, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the bust of an anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter, Kang Kon, who was the most faithful comrade-in-arms of PresidentKim Il Sungand a competent commanding officer, and laid a wreath at it.
Written on the ribbon of the wreath were letters reading "Our army will remember Kang Kon, your name, forever".
Recalling the distinguished feats of Kang Kon, the first chief of the KPA General Staff who dedicated as a solid cornerstone his precious life to the sacred cause for the birth and remarkable development of the DPRK's regular revolutionary armed forces,Kim Jong Unpaid high respects to the great army founding generation.
There was a ceremony of greeting the head of state.
All the teaching staff and students of the academy broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the invincible and iron-willed commander who is ushering in a golden age of strengthening  the military capabilities most brilliant in the history of the country by wisely leading the cause of building a powerful army of Juche.
An educator and student of the academy presented fragrant bouquets toKim Jong Un, in reflection of the unanimous mind of loyalty of all its members.
Acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers,Kim Jong Unextended militant greetings to all the educators who are devoting themselves to the steady innovation and development in the training of military cadres, keeping with their pure conscience the sacred teaching platform entrusted to them by the Party and the country and to the students who are preparing themselves as excellent commanding officers in the future.
He reviewed a march-past of the teaching staff and students of the academy and then watched a Kyoksul (a Korean martial art) demonstration of students.
Full of high morale and great emotion at havingKim Jong Un, the supreme commander of the DPRK, in the campus of the academy, its students strikingly demonstrated the militant stamina of them who are firmly preparing themselves politically, ideologically, military-technically and physically, true to the Party's policy of bringing about a radical turn in training and military education.
Guided by leading officials of the academy,Kim Jong Unmade rounds of various places of the academy including the tactical study room, the unit's commanding and management study room, the military topography study room and the shooting gallery.
The worthy feats of the military education institutions, which have firmly defended the core stronghold of the army, are clearly recorded in the course of brilliant exploits of our armed forces which have led the dynamic upswing of the revolution as the main force of national defence, but there is no such a military academy with noble and proud history and tradition as the Kang Kon Military Academy, he said, adding that the academy's distinguished position in the glorious army-building history can be well understood through the fact that it was awarded the first colours of the armed forces of the Republic and it stood in the van as the first column of the first military parade of the regular army.
He said that the academy should firmly defend and carry forward its sacred history and tradition in the van of the military education institutions at all levels and this holds an important position in implementing the military policy of the WPK determined to open up a new avenue for strengthening the whole army by further consolidating the basic units of the People's Army.
After learning in detail about the military educational state of the academy, he referred to the problems that the management and operation of educational facilities and the educational environment are not meeting the policy-oriented requirements for building a powerful army by the WPK aspiring after modernity and advanced character. And he added that  the Party committee of the People's Army and the policy-oriented guidance departments of the military education institutions have not fully fulfilled their responsibilities and roles.
Saying that we can see what important role the academy has played in strengthening and developing the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK, with only its unique name called the first military educational institution of our state, the pedigree farm for training military cadres and the symbol of the regular appearance and combat capability of the KPA, he gave precious instructions in correctly implementing the military educational policy of the Party, adding that we can wonderfully update the commanding officers training bases related to the future of the KPA in line with the principles of modern pedagogy and the level of modern culture as we have the precious tradition of the army founding generation that brought about a legendary miracle in army building from scratch and have the might further strengthened in the trials.
He said that the WPK attaches importance to the academy as the graduates from it are in the important position closest by soldier masses, the lowest-echelon of the army, though their first post is not high, and they can grow into competent warriors who always know victory only when they started their first steps as the military commander. And he expressed the steadfast will of the WPK to turn the KPA into an invincible powerful army without fortress unconquerable when determined.
Saying that the front of military education is the eternal first echelon and forefront in increasing the military capability and it is the constant view cherished by the WPK that a shortcut to training a powerful army is to further raise the flames of revolution in military education, he clarified that it is his unshakable determination to successfully build the military academy as a standard unit of training army commanders, in which modern educational culture is perfectly embodied, and renew the military education sector of the country.
He watched the live shooting contest of teachers and students of the academy and their exercises with multi-purpose apparatus.
Saying that the qualitative strengthening of the KPA and its might largely depend on how junior commanding officers of tactical-level units are trained, he stressed that the military education sector should surely instill in the students the resolute revolutionary consciousness to make revolution before transferring military knowledge to them, and at the same time prepare them to be fighters of combat type possessed of crack-shot marksmanship, skilful combat methods and strong physical ability.
Saying that the basic task facing the academy is to firmly consolidate the cornerstone of building a powerful army by training heroes who devote their all to the road of faithful service for the Party, the revolution and the people and creditably carry out any difficult task, he added that the academy should make sure that all students carry forward the faith of loyalty and patriotic spirit consistently cherished by the commanding officers of the revolutionary armed forces from the first generation of founding an army to the present.
Noting that the present international situation, in which the aggressive and bellicose nature of the imperialists is most openly expressed in history and war and bloodshed become commonplaces, requires the armed forces of the DPRK to perfectly cope with a war, he set forth the important tasks facing the military education sector in intensifying the military practice-centered education and preparing all students to be reliable military personnel of field-officer type who win only sure victory by making them learn about the actual experiences of modern warfare in the Korean style and master the rapidly advanced weapons and combat and technical equipment and acquire the commanding ability corresponding to modern warfare.
That day,Kim Jong Unhad a photo session with the teaching staff and students of the academy.
The campus resounded with the boundless gratitude and enthusiastic cheers of all the teaching staff and students who came to receive the greatest glory and happiness they had desired even in dreams during their honorable military service and the greatest trust to be dearly cherished in their minds forever.
Kim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that the academy would steadily carry forward the sacred tradition and valuable feats, in which it has firmly consolidated and defended the core stronghold of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK, the cornerstone for a powerful army, and train more competent military commanders boundlessly loyal to the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and possessed of every capability to fight a war and thus make a positive contribution to accomplishing the Party's cause of building a powerful army.
The loud shout of "Death-defying Defence" reflecting the unanimous pledge of loyalty of the teaching staff and students of the military academy to the great brilliant commander resounded far and wide.
Kim Jong Un's historic field guidance at the Kang Kon Military Academy serves as a decisive turning point that provided a foundation for clear change and progress in bringing about a radical improvement in military education in the new era and as an important occasion of landmark significance in developing the KPA into an invincible and matchless army forever. -0-

headline: Kwangbop Temple - Historical Relic at Foot of Mt Taesong
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- Among historical relics showing the excellent architecture of the Korean ancestors is Kwangbop Temple at the foot of Mt Taesong in Pyongyang.
The temple was built in 392 when the 24th King of Koguryo Kingdom Kwanggaetho ruled, and was repaired in 1727, one of the years when the feudal Joson dynasty ruled.
The temple was completely destroyed by the enemy's barbarous bombing during the Fatherland Liberation War in the 1950s and restored to its original state in 1990.
It is a typical temple style of the Koguryo Kingdom. There are the Haethal Gate, the gate of the temple, five-storied octagonal pagoda and the main hall where Buddhist priests sit in meditation east and west on both sides of its central axis.
The main hall painted red and blue is the building with two-storied hip-saddle roof.
In the main hall, there are three Buddhist statues, including a statue of Shakyamuni, and a picture of Buddha.
In the centre of the temple yard there is a five-storied octagonal pagoda, which is very magnificent and elegant and harmonizes with the surrounding buildings.
The temple, a precious cultural heritage showing the excellent architecture of the ancestors and the long cultural tradition, is now preserved and managed as a relic of national treasure.
One day in February 1991, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the temple, where he expressed satisfaction over the fact that it was successfully rebuilt on the principle of historicism.
Later, a resting place was built around the temple. So the visitors have a good time. -0-

Officials of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex are taking the lead in the technical innovation movement while organizing the work to increase the ranks of inventors and appreciating them to stir up the masses' enthusiasm.

The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex built a simulation practice place for operators by using information processing technology to train technical talents.
The Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Phyongsong School Uniform Factory and other units, too, are conducting the work to train technical talents, regarding it as a link in the whole chain for putting production on a normal basis and developing units. -0-

Measures for Irrigation Water Taken in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- In different parts of the DPRK, measures have been taken to supply irrigation water.
Ryongchon County in North Phyongan Province has taken measures to supply manpower, equipment and materials to push ahead with the project for building a permanent embankment of the Songjong first-stage waterway. And the county is ensuring both the quality and the speed of the project by organizing and commanding the construction on time.
Officials and working people involved in the project are pushing forward with the transport of soil and compaction to carry out the project ahead of schedule.
Anbyon County in Kangwon Province is concentrating on securing water.
After planning to increase pumping capacity by building dammed pools in some areas, which suffered lots of drought damage in the past, the county is giving priority to designing with the help of scientists and technicians in the relevant field.
Kowon County in South Hamgyong Province has taken technical measures to increase water-drawing capacity after learning about reservoirs of farms.
The Unpha County Irrigation Management Station in North Hwanghae Province is solving problems arising in the repair of pumping equipment by exploring and tapping reserves, possibilities and potentials.
Meanwhile, workers of the Phyongsong Irrigation Machine Factory are putting spurs to the production of water pumps. -0-

headline: Many Graduate Students in Pyongyang Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- More than 300 graduate students of senior middle schools in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, have volunteered for military service at forefront border posts, out of the ardent desire to devote their youth and hope to upholding the socialist cause with arms, amid the patriotic will of the rising generation growing stronger to add eternal luster to our ideology, system and beloved country.
A meeting took place at the Pyongyang Municipal Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on Wednesday to congratulate them who are leaving for the forefront of defending the country, regarding the national defence as the most vivid expression of patriotism, the most sacred duty and the first mission.
A congratulatory address was made at the meeting.
The speaker warmly congratulated the graduate students who vowed to serve at the military posts for national defence with the will to record the immortal military feats on their personal accounts before anything else, though there are many places to go from the campus associated with the unforgettable memories of their school days and many workplaces to translate their dreams and ideals into reality.
It is the highest honor and pride of the young people in the present era to glorify their youth in the military uniform of the revolution, the speaker said, requesting the volunteers to adorn every moment of their military service with loyalty and patriotic feats.
Then there were speeches of volunteers.
They expressed their determination to reliably defend peace and security on this land from the enemies' aggression and challenge at the forefront of national defence, saying that it is the proud tradition of the Korean youth to take arms of defenders for the very precious motherland.
DPRK Hero Ho Ryong, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, handed over the national flag of the DPRK shining as the symbol of heroism and victory of Juche Korea to the reliable volunteers.
The volunteers and participants in the meeting broke out shouts of ardent determination to fully display the stamina and mettle of the Korean youth by carrying forward the spirit of the victorious wartime generation, with ardent patriotism and love for the country and the people and the will to annihilate the enemy.
The proud stride of the volunteers in the capital city toward the outposts is a manifestation of the noble mental world of the rising generation determined to share the destiny with the country to the last after realizing how precious the country is under the care of the Party. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Secretaries of WPK and Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Talks were held in Moscow on Feb. 25 between Ri Hi Yong, Politburo member and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK, on a visit to Russia as head of the WPK delegation, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Yakushev, secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party and first vice-chairman of the Russian Federation Council.
Present there from the DPRK side were members of the WPK delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and, from the Russian side, officials of the leadership of the United Russia Party and members concerned.
The talks discussed realistic proposals for further expanding the bilateral exchange and joint action between the ruling parties of the two countries to suit the DPRK-Russia relations which were developed into the comprehensive strategic partnership, and reached a consensus on them.
Signed at the end of the talks was a 2025-2027 protocol on the expansion and development in depth of multi-faceted cooperation between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party. -0-

headline: Timber Production Units in DPRK Fulfill Their Annual Plans
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the forestry industry of the DPRK are bringing about a surge in production.
More than 10 units under the Ministry of Forestry have carried out their yearly plans for the timber production.
Various units of the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, including the Paekam Mine Timber Production Station and the Paekja Forestry Station, introduced efficient working methods and displayed the might of collectivism, registering high daily results every day.
The Toan Forestry Station, the Komdok Mine Timber Production Station and  other units under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau conducted socialist emulations among workteams and  sub-workteams and a technological innovation movement  to increase per-hour timber output.
Fellers at the Pukchang Mine Timber Production Station, etc. also put spurs to the timber production while providing favorable conditions for production. -0-

headline: Building-Materials Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Several factories under the Pyongyang Construction Commission have boosted the building-materials output.
The Phyongchon Prefab Factory set a plan for increasing the output by 1.5 times as compared with last year and is putting spurs to the production.
The Kangnam Ceramic Factory, which over-fulfilled its January plan, is producing lots of quality bricks while consolidating the successes made in improving drying capacity of kilns.
The Pyongyang Steel Works has laid a foundation for producing quality rolled steel.
Meanwhile, the Pyongyang Plastic Building Materials Factory, the Pyongyang Cast Iron Pipe Factory, the Pyongyang Metallic Building Materials Factory and other units are concentrating their efforts on the production of building materials for the housing construction sites in Pyongyang and major construction sites.
The output of various and quality building materials for grand construction sites is on the increase amid the elated enthusiasm of workers at various units. -0-

headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories and Grain Management Station of Hwangju County for Regional Development 20×10 Policy Held in DPRK
Production Goes Up at Complexes in Key Industrial Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- The production is going up at several complexes of the key industrial sector of the DPRK.
At the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex the daily iron and steel output has risen by 1.5 times on average or 1.7 times at the maximum as compared with the same time of last year.
In February, the workers at the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex have produced hundreds of thousands of more kWh of electricity than planned every day.
Officials and coal miners of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex are successfully carrying out the ambitious coal production goal through a drive for increased production. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Floral Basket and Congratulatory Letter from Vietnamese Ambassador
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a floral basket and a congratulatory letter from Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK, on the occasion of the sixth anniversary of his historic official goodwill visit to Vietnam.
The floral basket and congratulatory letter were conveyed to an official concerned by the ambassador on Feb. 26. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Secretaries of WPK and Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Talks were held in Moscow on Feb. 25 between Ri Hi Yong, Politburo member and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK, on a visit to Russia as head of the WPK delegation, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Yakushev, secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party and first vice-chairman of the Russian Federation Council.
Present there from the DPRK side were members of the WPK delegation and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and, from the Russian side, officials of the leadership of the United Russia Party and members concerned.
The talks discussed realistic proposals for further expanding the bilateral exchange and joint action between the ruling parties of the two countries to suit the DPRK-Russia relations which were developed into the comprehensive strategic partnership, and reached a consensus on them.
Signed at the end of the talks was a 2025-2027 protocol on the expansion and development in depth of multi-faceted cooperation between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party. -0-

headline: Ground-breaking Ceremonies of Regional-industry Factories Held in Various Counties of DPRK
Efforts Concentrated in Increased Cement Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Officials of the DPRK Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry are organizing the economic work for increased cement production on the basis of scientific calculation.
The ministry has concentrated all efforts on the work to shorten the period of equipment repair after learning about the capacity of equipment and their operation at the cement producers.
It gave concrete duties to raise the production capacity to a higher level and reviewed the results of the work while solving the problems arising in the production lines and equipment operation.
Thanks to the help and guidance of officials of the ministry, the Sunchon Cement Complex is pushing ahead with the work to increase the number of kiln operation days and reduce the time of repairing all kinds of equipment.
At the Chonnaeri Cement Factory, officials of the ministry are striving to settle the problems arising in improving the quality of cement with the help of scientific research institutes.
In the meantime, the ministry has paid efforts to the work for stepping up the overhaul of the glass melting furnace and increasing the variety of glass products and improving their quality at the Taean Friendship Glass Factory. -0-

headline: Secretary of WPK Central Committee Meets President of United Russia Party
Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il Celebrated Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Meetings were held in Denmark, Bulgaria, Sweden, Britain, Austria, Italy, France, Mexico and Peru from February 12 to 15 to celebrate the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by personages of political parties, organizations and institutions and masses in those countries.
The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association praisedKim Jong Ilas the prominent leader of the Korean and world revolution, outstanding statesman and benevolent father of the people.
The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association laudedKim Jong Ilfor consistently adhering to the principle of independence and socialism and remarkably strengthening the international position of the DPRK in the whole period of his revolutionary career.
The chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK and the secretary general of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK praised the immortal exploits and noble devoted career ofKim Jong Il, the peerlessly veteran statesman and peerless patriot.
The general secretary and the international secretary of the C.C., People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the chairperson of the Mexico-Korea Solidarity Committee, the secretary general of the France-Korea Friendship Association and other personages highly praised the world-historic exploits performed byKim Jong Ilwho had recorded the most successful political history for decades through his energetic ideo-theoretical activities and with his distinguished leadership ability.
The coordinator of the Organization of Communists of Italy and the chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea laudedKim Jong Il's Songun leadership exploits, stressing: The reality of the DPRK conducting the gigantic work to put the regional industry on a new high stage of development in parallel with the housing construction while frustrating the hostile forces' moves to stifle it clearly demonstrates the validity and vitality of the Juche idea. The Korean people will surely build a socialist power under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the meetings held in Denmark, Bulgaria and Sweden. -0-

headline: DPRK Cabinet Makes Efforts to Create Modern Essential Oil and Pigment Industries
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK Cabinet is intensifying the work to create modern essential oil and pigment industries.
The Cabinet ensured that relevant sectors and units gave priority to the work for analyzing in detail the necessary amount of essential oil and pigment for regional-industry factories across the country, the world trend of their development, the research and introduction by educational research units, domestic production and supply of domestic raw materials from last year.
On the basis of such preparations, the Cabinet worked out a correct plan for creating the essential oil and pigment industries and has deepened the research and discussion on its implementation.
As an immediate task, the cabinet set the goal of laying a foundation for smoothly supplying essential oil and pigment for consumer goods producing sectors and units. And it is mapping out the plans for the implementation.
Relevant sectors and units discussed the issues of working out concrete stepwise plans for building modern essential oil and pigment industries and are pushing ahead with the work for taking scientific measures. -0-

headline: Secretary of WPK Central Committee Meets President of United Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Ri Hi Yong, Politburo member and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK, on a visit to Russia as head of the WPK delegation, met with Dmitri Anatoliyevich Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on February 26.
Ri Hi Yong courteously conveyed the warm greetings ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, to Dmitri Anatoliyevich Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party.
Expressing his heartfelt thanks for it, Medvedev asked Ri Hi Yong to convey his sincere wishes that ComradeKim Jong Unwould achieve bigger success in his important work to lead the Party and the state.
Saying that he warmly welcomes the visit of a high-ranking delegation of the WPK to Moscow, he added that the revitalization of the relations between the ruling parties of the two countries would further enrich the bilateral relations between Russia and the DPRK developing wonderfully.
He noted that a new era was opened in the development of Russia-DPRK relations thanks to the positive role of the leaders of the two countries and that the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded last year was the one fully confirming with the international law and considering the changing reality.
Expressing thanks for the DPRK's support to the Russian Federation, he stressed that all measures taken by the DPRK to defend its sovereignty and security are legitimate and just.
He expressed his will to steadily boost the close cooperation between the United Russia Party and the Workers' Party of Korea and open a new chapter in the development of the bilateral relations by further expanding the many-sided exchange and contact with the current visit as a momentum.
Present on the occasion were Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, Sin Hong Chol, DPRK ambassador to Russia, Vladimir Vladimirovich Yakushev, secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party and first vice-chairman of the Russian Federation Council, Andrei Klimov, member of the Bureau of the Supreme Council of the United Russia Party and vice-chairman of the International Affairs Committee of the Federation Council, and others. -0-

headline: Efforts Made in DPRK Chemical Industry to Improve Quality of Goods
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK chemical industry is improving the quality of products.
The Ministry of Chemical Industry is taking substantial steps in close cooperation with the Quality Control Commission while acquainting itself with the ensuring of quality at industrial establishments and the problems arising in the process.
Meanwhile, it has learned again about the production indices of all the units and intensified the work to work out, modify and supplement the regulations for quality inspection at all the production processes according to the law and regulations on quality control, the detailed enforcement regulations, technical rules and standard operating methods.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex intensify supervision and control of the observation of the technical rules and standard operating methods in the production of nitrogenous fertilizer and checks raw-materials supply and production lines and analyzes indices of all the processes over two times. And they have taken measures to ensure the quality of products as required by the standards by establishing the order of recording checks of all the production lines.
The Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory has pushed ahead with the work to turn out quality products by establishing the proper order of process check and supervision of apatite concentrate, anthracite and silica so as to increase the production of ammonium phosphate fertilizer. -0-

headline: Preparations for Building Factories in Education Field Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The preparations for building factories in the education sector of the DPRK are progressing apace as scheduled under the guidance of the construction project headquarters.
A group of prestigious and competent designers involved in the project has accelerated the designing of factories and production lines at the final stage and on the highest level.
The headquarters' section in charge of modernization of factories and preparation for their operation is putting efforts into selecting the kinds and indices of school things, teaching furnishings and equipment and facilities for experiment and practical training to be produced at those factories.
Officials of the section for planning, materials and transport are taking steps to supply building materials as soon as the factories are designed.
Thanks to the efforts of officials at the headquarters, scientists and educators, signal successes have been made in the preparations for building the factories in the field of education. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Strategic Cruise Missile Launching Drill Conducted
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- A relevant sub-unit of the combined missile units of the Korean People's Army in the western area conducted a strategic cruise missile launching drill in the West Sea of Korea on the morning of February 26.
The purpose of the launching drill was to inform the enemies, who are seriously violating the security environment of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and fostering and escalating the confrontation environment, of the KPA's counterattack capability in any space and the readiness of its various nuke operation means, and to demonstrate the reliability of the state nuclear deterrence and make the strategic cruise missile sub-units get adept in fulfilling their sudden firing mission.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, oversaw the launching drill.
Accompanying him were Full General Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the DPRK Missile Administration.
The strategic cruise missiles precisely hit the targets after making a flight along 1 587 km-long oval trajectory for 7 961-7 973 seconds.
Expressing satisfaction over the result of the launching drill,Kim Jong Unsaid that it is a responsible exercise of the DPRK's war deterrence to continuously test the reliability and operation of the components of its nuclear deterrence and demonstrate their might.
What is guaranteed by powerful striking ability is the most perfect deterrence and defence capacity, he said, stressing that it is the responsible mission and duty of the DPRK's nuclear armed forces to permanently defend the national sovereignty and security with the reliable nuclear shield by getting more thorough battle readiness of nuclear force and full preparedness for their use. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Completed Pyongyang General Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the steadfast will and energetic guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto develop the public health of the DPRK into the most advantageous and advanced socialist one so that the people can fully enjoy the benefits of modern medicine and lead a happy life in good health, a world-class medical service center has been successfully built in the capital city of Pyongyang as a perfect embodiment of the Workers' Party of Korea's plan for modernizing public health and its idea on Juche-oriented architectural beauty.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the completed Pyongyang General Hospital on February 27.
He was accompanied by Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and officials of the Party Central Committee, public health officials and officials concerned.
He was greeted on the spot by senior officials of the hospital and construction and design units.
Guided by the officials, he went round such parts of the hospital as emergency department, professional treatment departments, general operating hall, symposium hall, service facilities and helicopter landing ground to learn in detail about its overall construction.
Saying that all demands of advanced architecture were thoroughly embodied to every element of the hospital and its construction was done perfectly in conformity with the health policy of the WPK, which gives precedence to the promotion of the people's health and regards their lives as the most precious ones, and the construction policy for its implementation and that the specialized facilities of all systems including treatment rooms and wards were furnished on a high quality level, he added that this is attributable to the substantial three-party agreement of design, construction and operation the relevant units provided as intended by the Party.
He noted with high appreciation that in particular, the general operating hall with 30 modern operating rooms was successfully completed to ensure the best health and hygienic conditions and the scientific accuracy and smoothness of treatment, as befitting the most important core establishment of the hospital.
He also toured a restaurant and service establishments on the upper floor of the building. He said that he was very pleased to think that the people can be completely recovered from diseases and promote their health while receiving the most advanced medical service as well as the civilized and excellent convenience, adding that the hospital is another proud asset of our state which absolutely subordinates everything to the people.
He expressed great satisfaction, saying that it is very proud to have the world-level modern medical service base and medical science research center capable of more reliably protecting the people's health and well-being and we can see our great strength rapidly growing despite ordeals and that a solid springboard has been laid for restoring and radically developing the country's public health sector on an advanced basis.
He highly praised the ardent patriotism, loyalty and devotion displayed by all the builders who contributed to the successful construction of another monumental edifice representing the era, upholding the WPK's policy with heroic creative practice.
Saying that there should be no slightest weakness in the preparation for the hospital's operation in order to make it fulfill its inherent mission and role in curing people of illness and completely recovering them from it after the opening of the hospital, he stressed the need to reinforce the first-aid system of the hospital, the first gateway to it and the one like its face, in aspects of practical utility, rationality and efficiency so as to ensure the promptness and mobility of emergency treatment more thoroughly.
To better the overall public health of the country on the basis of the completion of the hospital as a model medical center is an important revolutionary undertaking to defend and develop the advantages and nature of Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses, he said, setting forth the important tasks arising in building modern new hospitals to appear not only in Pyongyang but also in cities and counties across the country in the future.
He said that what is important, above all, for the building of hospital is to design all elements, ranging from site selection to building layout and arrangement of the line of flow, in conformity with the professional technical requirements on the principle of guaranteeing the level of specialization and functional qualities peculiar to the public health facilities to make it be favorable for medical service activities including diagnosis and treatment for patients.
The designing sector should lead other sectors at the present time when the scope of construction is steadily expanding and the struggle for comprehensive national rejuvenation is being accelerated, and the design of a structure to be built by the socialist ruling party for the people should properly combine modern character with national character while prioritizing the guarantee of people's life and safety and the promotion of their well-being and reflect the great ideology, noble political idea and aspiration of our times after higher ideals and civilization, he said. In this sense, it can be said that designers are "political artists" who make the ideas and policies of the WPK be translated into reality, he added, giving precious instructions to be regarded as the guideline in architectural design.
Whether or not the wonderful hospital, provided by the Party, is conducive to promoting the people's health entirely depends on the medical workers' transparent spirit of serving the people and their professional qualifications, he said, stressing the need for the public health sector to decisively strengthen the medical force, effectively conduct the work to raise medical science and technology to the world's advanced level and ensure that all doctors and nurses devote their utmost sincerity to the treatment with warm human love.
He stressed that in particular, it is necessary to organize and conduct with a correct methodology re-education, practice, experience-sharing workshop, sci-tech presentation and others for broadening the regional medical workers' outlook and improving their medical skills, in line with the full-scale construction of hospitals going on in cities and counties under the WPK's new regional development policy, and dispatch guidance and assistance forces of hospitals in Pyongyang to regional hospitals and introduce the telemedicine system and other systems and methods for giving more reasonable and efficient medical service to promote diagnosis, treatment and health and provide necessary conditions and thus make sure that everyone receive the substantial benefit and protection by the advantageous socialist public health system irrespective of region.

headline: Efforts Made in DPRK Chemical Industry to Improve Quality of Goods
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK chemical industry is improving the quality of products.
The Ministry of Chemical Industry is taking substantial steps in close cooperation with the Quality Control Commission while acquainting itself with the ensuring of quality at industrial establishments and the problems arising in the process.
Meanwhile, it has learned again about the production indices of all the units and intensified the work to work out, modify and supplement the regulations for quality inspection at all the production processes according to the law and regulations on quality control, the detailed enforcement regulations, technical rules and standard operating methods.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex intensify supervision and control of the observation of the technical rules and standard operating methods in the production of nitrogenous fertilizer and checks raw-materials supply and production lines and analyzes indices of all the processes over two times. And they have taken measures to ensure the quality of products as required by the standards by establishing the order of recording checks of all the production lines.
The Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory has pushed ahead with the work to turn out quality products by establishing the proper order of process check and supervision of apatite concentrate, anthracite and silica so as to increase the production of ammonium phosphate fertilizer. -0-

headline: Preparations for Building Factories in Education Field Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The preparations for building factories in the education sector of the DPRK are progressing apace as scheduled under the guidance of the construction project headquarters.
A group of prestigious and competent designers involved in the project has accelerated the designing of factories and production lines at the final stage and on the highest level.
The headquarters' section in charge of modernization of factories and preparation for their operation is putting efforts into selecting the kinds and indices of school things, teaching furnishings and equipment and facilities for experiment and practical training to be produced at those factories.
Officials of the section for planning, materials and transport are taking steps to supply building materials as soon as the factories are designed.
Thanks to the efforts of officials at the headquarters, scientists and educators, signal successes have been made in the preparations for building the factories in the field of education. -0-

headline: Foundation Excavation for Housing Construction Accelerated in Hwasong Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- The military and civilian builders, out in the construction of the final stage of the five-year plan for the capital city construction, are speeding up the foundation excavation for the project to build 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area.
The construction headquarters has taken far-sighted measures to secure aggregate and supply cement while intensifying its control and command to make all the construction units raise the operation rate of construction equipment and push ahead with foundation excavation as planned.
The brigade of the Ministry of Public Security is expanding the successes day by day while rationally deploying heavy machines and forming forces.
Soldier-builders are removing a large amount of earth every day by raising the operation rate of excavators and trucks.
The brigade of the Pyongyang Construction Commission and the first brigade of ministries and national agencies are pushing ahead with the foundation excavation project.
The second brigade of ministries and national agencies, too, is registering high results in the foundation excavation project by mobilizing all manpower and means. -0-

headline: Secretary of C.C., WPK Meets Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- Ri Hi Yong, Politburo member and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK, on a visit to Russia as head of the WPK delegation, met Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, at the Kremlin in Moscow on February 27.
On the occasion, President Putin asked Ri Hi Yong to convey his warmest greetings and best wishes toKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Ri Hi Yong courteously conveyed the militant greetings of ComradeKim Jong Unto Vladimir Putin.
Noting thatKim Jong Unhas paid deep attention to the development of the Russia-DPRK cooperative relations, Putin warmly welcomed the WPK delegation's current visit to Russia.
He highly appreciated once again the historic meaning of 2024 in which the traditional Russia-DPRK friendly relations were remarkably developed into the comprehensive strategic partnership.
The two countries are firmly linked with the excellent tradition of friendship and good neighborliness and militant friendship, he said, expressing thanks to the DPRK for its positive support to the Russian Federation.
He expressed the belief that the 2025-2027 protocol on the expansion and development in depth of multi-faceted cooperation between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party, concluded this time, would make a great contribution to the development of the relations between the ruling parties of the two countries.
The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
Present there were Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, Yuri Ushakov, aide to the president of Russia for Foreign Policy, Vladimir Vladimirovich Yakushev, secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party and first vice-chairman of the Russian Federation Council, and Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology. -0-

headline: Japanese Imperialists' Unethical Crimes Committed in Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- It has been 106 years since the March First Popular Uprising.
The uprising was an eruption of the pent-up grudge of the Korean people who had undergone severe humiliation and maltreatment under the barbarous military rule of the Japanese imperialists.
Early in the last century, the Japanese imperialists cooked up treaties with military threat and blackmail to occupy Korea. Then they turned it into a huge prison with their medieval terror-ridden politics.
The Korean people's bitter grudge and anger at the Japanese imperialists' heinous colonial rule exploded as a nationwide anti-Japanese resistance on March 1, 1919.
With the bell at 12:00 as a signal, people of all strata gathered at the playground on Jangdaejae in Pyongyang and staged a fierce street demonstration, shouting slogans "Long live the independence of Korea!" and "Japanese and Japan troops, go home!" The struggle swept the whole country at once and spread to the Korean community abroad, developing into an all-Korean resistance.
Much upset by such developments, the Japanese imperialists mobilized all their repressive forces in Korea and even huge armed forces from the Japan proper to put down the uprising.
They employed all sorts of means to suppress the uprisers. The Japanese imperialist murderers tore up the limbs of Koreans, cut their necks, arms and legs with fodder-choppers and hung them on trees, saying that shooting to death is not "interesting" and to use knives is too lenient for Koreans.
They tied the two hands of arrested Koreans with wire and hung them in the air, beating them with whips and triangular sticks and thrusting them with sharp bamboo needles, and scorching them with red-heated rakes. They also placed arrested persons in a lower box with sharp iron nails on all its sides four to five hours, making them unable to sit or stand, and pulled out their fingernails and toenails with pincers and even twisted their fingers between a nail to break them.
No one in the world slaughtered the empty-handed participants in peaceful demonstration in such cruel means as the Japanese imperialists did.
The Korean people will not let pass the Japanese imperialists' unethical crimes but surely give vent to the pent-up grudge. -0-

story_text:

Present there were Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun and Choe Tong Myong, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Han Kwang Sang, department director of the C.C., WPK, Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK, officials and working people of the relevant provinces, counties and district, and service personnel and builders.
Speeches were made at the ceremonies.
The speakers noted that the gigantic construction projects requiring huge investment are being launched every year without fail, stressing this stirring reality is a great construction campaign that could be launched only by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
They said that the blueprints preserving peculiarities of the relevant areas and optimizing all elements of the buildings were provided, thanks to the meticulous guidance of him who clearly indicated the orientation and ways for putting the next-stage regional construction on a higher level of development and gave detailed instructions so that industrial facilities can be built in a diverse, non-repetitive and efficient way in conformity with their functions.
They ardently called for more dynamically advancing toward the Ninth Congress of the WPK and achieving only proud victories, saying that the people's joy and happiness will be redoubled and the country will confidently advance towards the eternal prosperity, along with the increase of entities of transformation intensively reflecting the Party's ideology and policy and aesthetic view in cities and counties across the country.
Then followed oath-taking speeches.
Officials and working people encouraged soldier-builders advancing to the construction sites to the tune of the dynamic songs of the revolutionary army, flying the flags of regiments associated with the great trust of the Party Central Committee.
The builders started the projects with a single mind to uphold the grand plan of the Party with their brave and vigorous labor efforts, operating heavy machines at full capacity. -0-

Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- Girl triplets of Taehongdan County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK, left the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on Friday amid the blessing of all people.
The mother of the triplets is Nam Ji Hyang working as a farmer with her husband in Hongam-ri, Taehongdan County.
The medical workers of the maternity hospital had made every effort with sincerity, observing the condition of the pregnant woman and fetuses.

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 2 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of resolution from the members of a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the greatest and auspicious February holiday of the nation on Saturday.
In the letter, they noted that the respected Marshal called the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan to the homeland this significant year marking the 70th anniversary of the formation of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) in consideration of the ardent desire of the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan yearning for ChairmanKim Jong Iland bestowed immeasurable privileges on them every day and every moment.
The letter said that it is the highest honor to come to the embrace of the motherland for which they always yearn but they dropped tears of gratitude to the cordial hospitality they were accorded from the first moment when they placed their steps on the homeland, warmly thinking of the trust and love of the respected Marshal for the overseas soldiers.
The letter noted that they cherished again in the homeland is that the blessing of the illustrious leaders is never a good fortune for any country an any nation and that the revolutionary history and immortal feats of ChairmanKim Jong Ilis given continuity every year and the dignity and glory of Juche Korea shine as the Korean people hold the respected Marshal as the head of state in high esteem.
The letter stressed that they would always bear in mind the unforgettable days they spent in the embrace of the respected Marshal and glorify their worthwhile life with patriotic faith and pure conscience just as the generation that formed Chongryon did.
It noted that they would always remember patriotism, the fundamental idea of the formation of Chongryon and the justification for its existence, and proudly leave clearer traces on the road of prosperity and development of our powerful state in the van of overseas compatriots in conformity with the idea and intention of the respected Marshal.
They wholeheartedly wished the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the head of our state and the benevolent father of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan, good health for the eternal prosperity ofKim Il Sung's nation andKim Jong Il's Korea and the happy life and beautiful future of the people. -0-

headline: Ideological Offensive Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Organizations at all levels of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea are conducting the ideological work in an offensive way.
Officials of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the UAWK conducted an explanation about the Workers' Party of Korea's idea on the comprehensive development of socialism among the agricultural workers to stir up their enthusiasm for increased production.
The Sinpho City and Kowon County committees of the UAWK organized economic motivation teams with primary information workers and conducted touring performances at farms.
UAWK officials in North Hwanghae Province and Nampho Municipality conducted a vigorous ideological offensive and informed farmers of new agricultural sci-tech data in a plain language during a break to further broaden their view.

headline: Media Persons in DPRK Start Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Journalists and other media persons in the DPRK launched their study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu.
A kick-off meeting of the expedition took place at the plaza before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province on March 2.
The participants laid a floral basket and bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them.
Ryom Chol Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Journalists Union of Korea, made a speech at the meeting.

headline: Rain Gauge
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Among the Korean nation's precious cultural heritages is a rain gauge, invented in the mid-15th century for the first time in the world.
Before this instrument came out, the Korean ancestors would measure the amount of rainfall in the way of finding out how much rainwater soaked into ground.
But, the penetration depth of rain was different according to soil conditions and other various factors. So, it was difficult to measure the correct amount of rainfall.
To overcome such shortcoming, the Korean ancestors invented a rain gauge, 40 cm in height and 16 cm in diameter, in August 1441, and later bettered it to be a measurement instrument with 30 cm in height and 14 cm in diameter.
The rain gauge had a round-shaped drip mould with detailed division of scales on a stone support, thus making it possible to know the amount of rainfall.
At that time, it was institutionalized in local areas of Korea to report the time of rainfall and its amount to higher organs. And the central organ collected and recorded those data.
It was in 1639 that Italy began to measure the depth of rainwater with an instrument.
The rain gauge invented and used in Korea is about 200 years earlier than Italy's. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Devotes Himself to Agricultural Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Ten best agricultural counties and 30 best farms for 2024 were selected in the DPRK recently.
Amid the great enthusiasm for scientific farming and high-yield competition growing in the new era of rural rejuvenation, more regions and units have registered remarkable successes in producing grains and laying a sustained growth foundation.
This exciting reality makes the DPRK people look back with deep emotion on the devoted efforts made by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto develop the country's agriculture.
At the major meetings held after the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the General Secretary took all necessary measures for the country's agricultural development.
He advanced the tasks for boosting the grain production such as the issues of decisively improving the people's diet through a change in the grain production structure, giving positive support to the agricultural sector through general mobilization of the whole Party, the entire country and all the people and providing farms with more efficient and new farm machines badly needed for the modern and advanced agricultural production.
At the Ninth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee, he called for setting out a clear strategy and a stepwise goal to develop farm machines on the basis of survey and estimation of the country's overall agricultural infrastructure and agricultural technical force, pushing ahead with the mechanization of agriculture and perfecting the irrigation system of the country.
All the people say with excitement that the said vital guidelines are associated with the tireless thinking and efforts ofKim Jong Unto put the agricultural production on a stable track of development and solve the food problem of the country.
Thanks to his energetic leadership, irrigation water flows into farm fields in some regions where there was a shortage of water in the past, and modern home-made farm machines are used in every farm field of the country. -0-

headline: Women in Jangyon County of DPRK Advance into Raw Material Bases
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- More than 120 women's union officials and members in Jangyon County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, have volunteered to work at raw material bases for implementing the regional development policy.
More than 70 women in the Rakyon Workers' District decided to work at the Evodia daniellii Benn forest station with the desire to devote themselves to the regional transformation work, like the women workers in the preceding generations who devoted their all to the society and collective.
Many women's union members in the county township, who volunteered to work at raw material base station, are filled with the enthusiasm to glorify their worthwhile life at the worksites of patriotism for bringing earlier the future of a prosperous and powerful country unfolded by the Workers' Party of Korea, not being confined to families.
Among the volunteers are officials of women's union primary committees and women's union members known as labor innovators at worksites in their maidenhood, and women full of enthusiasm to become honorable socialist workers before their husbands, children, neighbors and collectives.
A meeting to congratulate the volunteers took place on March 2.
Present at the meeting were officials concerned and women's union officials and members. A congratulatory address and speeches were made there.
At the end of the meeting, a congratulatory art performance was given and officials and members of the women's union presented bouquets to the volunteers and warmly saw them off. -0-

At the Ninth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Committee, he called for setting out a clear strategy and a stepwise goal to develop farm machines on the basis of survey and estimation of the country's overall agricultural infrastructure and agricultural technical force, pushing ahead with the mechanization of agriculture and perfecting the irrigation system of the country.

headline: Rain Gauge
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Among the Korean nation's precious cultural heritages is a rain gauge, invented in the mid-15th century for the first time in the world.
Before this instrument came out, the Korean ancestors would measure the amount of rainfall in the way of finding out how much rainwater soaked into ground.
But, the penetration depth of rain was different according to soil conditions and other various factors. So, it was difficult to measure the correct amount of rainfall.
To overcome such shortcoming, the Korean ancestors invented a rain gauge, 40 cm in height and 16 cm in diameter, in August 1441, and later bettered it to be a measurement instrument with 30 cm in height and 14 cm in diameter.
The rain gauge had a round-shaped drip mould with detailed division of scales on a stone support, thus making it possible to know the amount of rainfall.
At that time, it was institutionalized in local areas of Korea to report the time of rainfall and its amount to higher organs. And the central organ collected and recorded those data.
It was in 1639 that Italy began to measure the depth of rainwater with an instrument.
The rain gauge invented and used in Korea is about 200 years earlier than Italy's. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "Constant deployment of U.S. strategic assets highlights urgency of the DPRK to bolster up its self-defensive nuclear war deterrent" on Monday:
The U.S. is frequently committing provocative acts of aggravating the situation in disregard of the security concern of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The U.S. Navy nuclear carrier Carl Vinson strike group entered the Pusan operation base in the ROK again on March 2 under the pretext of "demonstrating the ROK-U.S. alliance and increasing inter-operability".
The Carl Vinson strike group took part in the war drills together with Japan and the ROK in the waters around the Korean peninsula in January last year. It is reported that the strike group consists of cruiser Princeton, Aegis destroyer Sterett and others.
Entering this year, the deployment of the U.S. nuclear strategic means on the Korean peninsula is the second one in the wake of the nuclear submarine Alexandria, and the U.S. Navy carrier appeared eight months after the Theodore Roosevelt in June last year.
If the actions of strategic bombers are put together, the U.S. is hurling strategic assets into the Korean peninsula at the constant deployment level.
In fact, the U.S. spent the whole of 2024 with the largest anti-DPRK war exercises ever in history. As soon as its new administration appeared this year, the U.S. has stepped up the political and military provocations against the DPRK, "carrying forward" the former administration's hostile policy.
It is necessary to read a diary of the confrontation hysteria of the U.S. and its stooges one by one.
On January 10, just before the retirement of the former administration, the U.S. held the 4th U.S.-ROK "nuclear consultative group" meeting in Washington to discuss a nuclear war drill on the Korean peninsula and an increase in the visibility of deploying U.S. strategic assets. And it deployed B-1B strategic bombers in the sky near the Korean peninsula on Jan. 15 to conduct a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill, as part of the clear action practice.
Timed to coincide with this, the U.S., together with the ROK army, staged a large joint firing drill aimed at the long-range artillery fire system of the DPRK on Jan. 14-16, and a Ssangmae joint air drill on Jan. 21-24 under the pretext of increasing the capability for cooperation in air operations.
The U.S. held a confab with the diplomatic authorities of Japan and the ROK on Feb. 15, with the international security conference held in Munich of Germany as an occasion, and cooked up and made public a "joint statement" with "strengthened offer of U.S. nuclear umbrella through U.S.-ROK and U.S.-Japan alliances" as the main point, viciously pulling up the DPRK over its sovereign rights.
A few days later, it let its B-1B strategic bomber fly over the sky of the Korean peninsula again on February 20 to stage a joint air drill together with the Air Force of the ROK.
The U.S. vicious moves for confrontation with the DPRK have been intensified in March with the appearance of Carl Vinson in the Korean peninsula. Such moves will reach the climax with the U.S.-Japan-ROK naval drill and the Freedom Shield joint military exercises, to be staged this month with Carl Vinson involved, as a momentum.
ROK media claim that the entry of Carl Vinson is aimed "to substantially implement the U.S. government's reaffirmed commitment to permanent and iron-like extended deterrence" and to "display the strong joint defence posture of the ROK-U.S. alliance to cope with threat" from someone.
With such practical action measures, the U.S. has clearly shown its most hostile and confrontational will to the DPRK.
The root cause of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula clearly lies in the U.S. and its allies which are further intensifying military moves to implant NATO infrastructure in the region and improve the level of war preparations.
The DPRK bitterly condemns the reckless visible actions and muscle-flexing of the U.S. and its vassal forces disregarding and violating a sovereign state's security concern and jeopardizing the peaceful environment in the whole region.
As indicated by the regional military situation, the U.S. and its stooges' heinous ambition to threaten, pressurize and bring the DPRK to its knees by force of arms is developing into a more reckless phase with the passage of time.
As for the DPRK's nuclear policy formulated as a main law of the DPRK, it was adopted in correct reflection of the concern for state's security by the present and future threats. And the present reality further highlights the justness, validity and necessity of the DPRK's line on bolstering up its nuclear forces.
The action-accompanied hostile policy toward the DPRK pursued by the U.S. at present is offering sufficient justification for the DPRK to indefinitely bolster up its nuclear war deterrent.
We will never confine ourselves to sitting still and commenting on the situation.
If the U.S. continues to renew its records in the anti-DPRK military demonstration, the DPRK will be naturally compelled to renew its records in the exercise of strategic deterrence.
The DPRK is also planning to carefully examine the option for increasing the actions threatening the security of the enemy at the strategic level to cope with the fact that the deployment of U.S. strategic assets in the Korean peninsula has become a vicious habit and adversely affects the security of the DPRK.
The enemies should not test the will and ability of the DPRK to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state by mobilizing all means in hand.
It's a very dangerous thing. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Loving Care for Children
story_text:
One day in November 2016, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Samjiyon Schoolchildren's Palace.
In a hobby group room of the palace, the General Secretary asked if the room had no thermostat, pointing out that its temperature was too high.
The officials could find no word to reply since children, teachers and parents there all thought that hot temperature is all right under the winter condition.
But,Kim Jong Unwas concerned to provide the schoolchildren with a more suitable indoor temperature.
Looking at the officials with kindness, he earnestly called for establishing an integrated control system so that the temperature of hobby group rooms could be automatically adjusted.
In the fine art group room, he said that a combined control room should be set up at the palace and a temperature sensor installed in every hobby group room to monitor the room temperature in real time and automatically control it so that the temperature of rooms can be always kept at 21-22 degrees C even in winter.
Looking up to the General Secretary who takes such warm care of the children, the officials could hardly repress their surging emotion. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- Seminars took place in India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Tajikistan, Germany, Belarus, Britain, Algeria and Mexico on the occasion of the 83rd birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages of political and social circles, Juche idea followers and members of organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in those countries.
Members of the Bangladesh Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Juche Philosophy Study Committee of India, the Indian Intellectuals' Society for the  Study of the Juche Idea and the All India Indo-Korean Friendship Association lauded the energetic ideo-theoretical activities and exploits ofKim Jong Il, who enriched the treasure house of human thoughts and defended the national sovereignty and security with the treasured sword of Songun and laid a solid foundation for a military power no formidable enemy dares provoke.
Personages of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Karachi Juche Study Center of Pakistan and the Karachi Women's Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Pakistan said that HEKim Jong Il, who led the Korean revolution to victory with his outstanding leadership, made a great contribution to the cause of independence against imperialism and the establishment of a just world order, adding that he devoted his all to the people's happiness and prosperity of the country and made the DPRK work world-startling miracles in all fields.
The chairman of the Communist Party of Great Britain (Marxist-Leninist) who doubles as its international secretary, the secretary general of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK and the chairman of the Algeria-Korea Friendship Association noted that the world people are recollecting with deep emotion the immortal revolutionary exploits of the great guardian who firmly defended independence, justice and socialism on the occasion of the significant February holiday. They highly praisedKim Jong Ilas a rare thinker-theoretician, prominent leader, peerless statesman and ever-victorious brilliant commander.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the seminars held in Germany. -0-
