headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea issued the following press statement "The illegal violation of copyright by U.S. information dealers can never be tolerated" on March 3:
The U.S. shameless infringement on the inviolable sovereignty of the DPRK is being perpetrated in various realms.
Typical of such deeds is the U.S. unhesitating illegal infringement on the intellectual property of the dignified DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) through the internet.
The U.S. online medium on the DPRK "NK NEWS" posts on its sister sites "NK PRO" and "KOREA PRO" articles smearing the DPRK and Chongryon by craftily misusing the information from their publications and news items.
It has openly put in a database of the site "KCNA WATCH" the said DPRK information, illegally stolen irrespective of the publicly-recognized international law, allowing its subscribers free access to the information as its own. So far more than 600 000 pieces of information of over 70 kinds has been posted on the site without permission.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly condemns the impudent act of "NK NEWS" as an online violent robbery on the inviolable intellectual property of the DPRK and as a wanton violation of the Berne Convention and the WIPO Copyright Treaty.
It is illegal and criminal to duplicate, post and distribute any writings without permission from its author.
However, as the U.S. does not hesitate to invade other countries in order to satisfy its cupidity, it regards the infringement on other countries' copyright as a trifle.
Chongryon, a dignified overseas compatriots' organization of the DPRK and authorized by the media of the DPRK, has strongly demanded the immediate deletion of the data, posted without permission, as well as compensation and apology several times since August 2024. But, "NK NEWS" shamelessly behaved, talking about "mistakes of the operators".
It was fully disclosed through investigation that such DPRK's media data, posted on the website of the "KCNA WATCH" without any permission, had been stolen from a state library in Europe which reads under a contract the KPM website run by Korean Media of Chongryon.
Nevertheless, the "NK NEWS" side blustered that the credentials related to the protection of copyright and the right to use, issued by the DPRK media to the Korean Media of Chongryon under the legal procedures, cannot be recognized as it has not been certified by the U.S. jurisdictional authorities. Moreover, it has gone the lengths of making preposterous gangster-like logic that our side has to be thankful for having introduced the DPRK.
This is nothing but a reckless behavior of adding to the crimes already committed by itself.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly urges the U.S. to stop at once such poor excuses that will not work on anyone and to make an official apology and compensation for its illegal deed.
We will closely watch the future attitude of "NK NEWS". -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea
Taekwon-Do, Orthodox Martial Art of Korean Nation
story_text:

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea issued the following press statement "The illegal violation of copyright by U.S. information dealers can never be tolerated" on March 3:
The U.S. shameless infringement on the inviolable sovereignty of the DPRK is being perpetrated in various realms.
Typical of such deeds is the U.S. unhesitating illegal infringement on the intellectual property of the dignified DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) through the internet.
The U.S. online medium on the DPRK "NK NEWS" posts on its sister sites "NK PRO" and "KOREA PRO" articles smearing the DPRK and Chongryon by craftily misusing the information from their publications and news items.
It has openly put in a database of the site "KCNA WATCH" the said DPRK information, illegally stolen irrespective of the publicly-recognized international law, allowing its subscribers free access to the information as its own. So far more than 600 000 pieces of information of over 70 kinds has been posted on the site without permission.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly condemns the impudent act of "NK NEWS" as an online violent robbery on the inviolable intellectual property of the DPRK and as a wanton violation of the Berne Convention and the WIPO Copyright Treaty.
It is illegal and criminal to duplicate, post and distribute any writings without permission from its author.
However, as the U.S. does not hesitate to invade other countries in order to satisfy its cupidity, it regards the infringement on other countries' copyright as a trifle.
Chongryon, a dignified overseas compatriots' organization of the DPRK and authorized by the media of the DPRK, has strongly demanded the immediate deletion of the data, posted without permission, as well as compensation and apology several times since August 2024. But, "NK NEWS" shamelessly behaved, talking about "mistakes of the operators".
It was fully disclosed through investigation that such DPRK's media data, posted on the website of the "KCNA WATCH" without any permission, had been stolen from a state library in Europe which reads under a contract the KPM website run by Korean Media of Chongryon.
Nevertheless, the "NK NEWS" side blustered that the credentials related to the protection of copyright and the right to use, issued by the DPRK media to the Korean Media of Chongryon under the legal procedures, cannot be recognized as it has not been certified by the U.S. jurisdictional authorities. Moreover, it has gone the lengths of making preposterous gangster-like logic that our side has to be thankful for having introduced the DPRK.
This is nothing but a reckless behavior of adding to the crimes already committed by itself.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly urges the U.S. to stop at once such poor excuses that will not work on anyone and to make an official apology and compensation for its illegal deed.
We will closely watch the future attitude of "NK NEWS". -0-

headline: Traits to Be Acquired by Officials
story_text:
One day in February 1965, ChairmanKim Jong Ilmet officials to give precious instructions on the people’s living.
He said to officials that the people entrust their all to the Workers' Party of Korea and call it the motherly party.
The word "mother" carries the meaning that a mother's sincerity and efforts for her children are untold, he said, adding that mothers would regard such great efforts as their pleasure and pride.
He earnestly told officials that if they always think of the people first and strive for their well-being with maternal affection and traits, there would be no problem impossible to settle for the people’s living.
Reflected in his instructions was the idea that all the officials should become faithful servants devotedly working for the people with the warm affection of the mother. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "Constant deployment of U.S. strategic assets highlights urgency of the DPRK to bolster up its self-defensive nuclear war deterrent" on Monday:
The U.S. is frequently committing provocative acts of aggravating the situation in disregard of the security concern of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The U.S. Navy nuclear carrier Carl Vinson strike group entered the Pusan operation base in the ROK again on March 2 under the pretext of "demonstrating the ROK-U.S. alliance and increasing inter-operability".
The Carl Vinson strike group took part in the war drills together with Japan and the ROK in the waters around the Korean peninsula in January last year. It is reported that the strike group consists of cruiser Princeton, Aegis destroyer Sterett and others.
Entering this year, the deployment of the U.S. nuclear strategic means on the Korean peninsula is the second one in the wake of the nuclear submarine Alexandria, and the U.S. Navy carrier appeared eight months after the Theodore Roosevelt in June last year.
If the actions of strategic bombers are put together, the U.S. is hurling strategic assets into the Korean peninsula at the constant deployment level.
In fact, the U.S. spent the whole of 2024 with the largest anti-DPRK war exercises ever in history. As soon as its new administration appeared this year, the U.S. has stepped up the political and military provocations against the DPRK, "carrying forward" the former administration's hostile policy.
It is necessary to read a diary of the confrontation hysteria of the U.S. and its stooges one by one.
On January 10, just before the retirement of the former administration, the U.S. held the 4th U.S.-ROK "nuclear consultative group" meeting in Washington to discuss a nuclear war drill on the Korean peninsula and an increase in the visibility of deploying U.S. strategic assets. And it deployed B-1B strategic bombers in the sky near the Korean peninsula on Jan. 15 to conduct a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill, as part of the clear action practice.
Timed to coincide with this, the U.S., together with the ROK army, staged a large joint firing drill aimed at the long-range artillery fire system of the DPRK on Jan. 14-16, and a Ssangmae joint air drill on Jan. 21-24 under the pretext of increasing the capability for cooperation in air operations.
The U.S. held a confab with the diplomatic authorities of Japan and the ROK on Feb. 15, with the international security conference held in Munich of Germany as an occasion, and cooked up and made public a "joint statement" with "strengthened offer of U.S. nuclear umbrella through U.S.-ROK and U.S.-Japan alliances" as the main point, viciously pulling up the DPRK over its sovereign rights.
A few days later, it let its B-1B strategic bomber fly over the sky of the Korean peninsula again on February 20 to stage a joint air drill together with the Air Force of the ROK.
The U.S. vicious moves for confrontation with the DPRK have been intensified in March with the appearance of Carl Vinson in the Korean peninsula. Such moves will reach the climax with the U.S.-Japan-ROK naval drill and the Freedom Shield joint military exercises, to be staged this month with Carl Vinson involved, as a momentum.
ROK media claim that the entry of Carl Vinson is aimed "to substantially implement the U.S. government's reaffirmed commitment to permanent and iron-like extended deterrence" and to "display the strong joint defence posture of the ROK-U.S. alliance to cope with threat" from someone.
With such practical action measures, the U.S. has clearly shown its most hostile and confrontational will to the DPRK.
The root cause of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula clearly lies in the U.S. and its allies which are further intensifying military moves to implant NATO infrastructure in the region and improve the level of war preparations.
The DPRK bitterly condemns the reckless visible actions and muscle-flexing of the U.S. and its vassal forces disregarding and violating a sovereign state's security concern and jeopardizing the peaceful environment in the whole region.
As indicated by the regional military situation, the U.S. and its stooges' heinous ambition to threaten, pressurize and bring the DPRK to its knees by force of arms is developing into a more reckless phase with the passage of time.
As for the DPRK's nuclear policy formulated as a main law of the DPRK, it was adopted in correct reflection of the concern for state's security by the present and future threats. And the present reality further highlights the justness, validity and necessity of the DPRK's line on bolstering up its nuclear forces.
The action-accompanied hostile policy toward the DPRK pursued by the U.S. at present is offering sufficient justification for the DPRK to indefinitely bolster up its nuclear war deterrent.
We will never confine ourselves to sitting still and commenting on the situation.
If the U.S. continues to renew its records in the anti-DPRK military demonstration, the DPRK will be naturally compelled to renew its records in the exercise of strategic deterrence.
The DPRK is also planning to carefully examine the option for increasing the actions threatening the security of the enemy at the strategic level to cope with the fact that the deployment of U.S. strategic assets in the Korean peninsula has become a vicious habit and adversely affects the security of the DPRK.
The enemies should not test the will and ability of the DPRK to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state by mobilizing all means in hand.
It's a very dangerous thing. -0-

headline: Story about High-rise Apartment House
story_text:
One day in March 1970, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited Sariwon City in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The President stopped in the main street of the city and pointed to an open space in opposite side, saying that it would be better to build a ten-storeyed apartment house there.
An official told that the site was a good building lot for houses, but was excluded from the design for reason that a high-rise apartment house to be built there might lower the grade of a power organ building in the opposite side.
After hearing his story, the President shook his head and said it cannot be a flaw in our country where the people are masters that a power organ building is lower than the people's houses.
It was his noble intention that the people are the most precious in the world and nothing can be put above their interests.
Afterward, a high-rise apartment house, higher than a power organ building, came to appear in the open space.-0-

headline: Maebongsan Footwear Popular among DPRK Citizens
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and other commercial service establishments in the capital city of the DPRK are crowded with visitors wanting to purchase footwear with trademark Maebongsan.
Maebongsan-trademarked shoes, produced at the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, are designed to be light and comfortable for people with different foot shapes. Those shoes are popular among all citizens without reference to sex and age as they are diverse and rich in colors and variety.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the factory several times and saw to it that the trademark of shoes produced by the factory was named "Maebongsan". He stressed the need for the factory to steadily strive to improve the quality of products as its main task and thus make its products well-known to the country.
True to his noble intention, the officials and workers of the factory have made successes in the work to produce more and nicer Maebongsan shoes, popular among the people.
The Maebongsan shoes won a high appreciation at the National Footwear Exhibition-2018, the Spring National Footwear Exhibition-2019, the Autumn National Footwear Exhibition-2019 and other exhibitions. They also took the top prize in the light industrial goods exhibition "Light Industry Developemnt-2023" and the first place in the Spring National Footwear Exhibition-2024.
Officials and workers of the factory are now devoting their wisdom and zeal to ensuring the practicality, convenience and aesthetic value of shoes on a higher level and making them more diverse in shapes and colors and lighter in weight. -0-

A few days later, it let its B-1B strategic bomber fly over the sky of the Korean peninsula again on February 20 to stage a joint air drill together with the Air Force of the ROK.
The U.S. vicious moves for confrontation with the DPRK have been intensified in March with the appearance of Carl Vinson in the Korean peninsula. Such moves will reach the climax with the U.S.-Japan-ROK naval drill and the Freedom Shield joint military exercises, to be staged this month with Carl Vinson involved, as a momentum.
ROK media claim that the entry of Carl Vinson is aimed "to substantially implement the U.S. government's reaffirmed commitment to permanent and iron-like extended deterrence" and to "display the strong joint defence posture of the ROK-U.S. alliance to cope with threat" from someone.

The root cause of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula clearly lies in the U.S. and its allies which are further intensifying military moves to implant NATO infrastructure in the region and improve the level of war preparations.
The DPRK bitterly condemns the reckless visible actions and muscle-flexing of the U.S. and its vassal forces disregarding and violating a sovereign state's security concern and jeopardizing the peaceful environment in the whole region.

It's a very dangerous thing. -0-

story_text:

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea issued the following press statement "The illegal violation of copyright by U.S. information dealers can never be tolerated" on March 3:
The U.S. shameless infringement on the inviolable sovereignty of the DPRK is being perpetrated in various realms.
Typical of such deeds is the U.S. unhesitating illegal infringement on the intellectual property of the dignified DPRK and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) through the internet.
The U.S. online medium on the DPRK "NK NEWS" posts on its sister sites "NK PRO" and "KOREA PRO" articles smearing the DPRK and Chongryon by craftily misusing the information from their publications and news items.
It has openly put in a database of the site "KCNA WATCH" the said DPRK information, illegally stolen irrespective of the publicly-recognized international law, allowing its subscribers free access to the information as its own. So far more than 600 000 pieces of information of over 70 kinds has been posted on the site without permission.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly condemns the impudent act of "NK NEWS" as an online violent robbery on the inviolable intellectual property of the DPRK and as a wanton violation of the Berne Convention and the WIPO Copyright Treaty.
It is illegal and criminal to duplicate, post and distribute any writings without permission from its author.
However, as the U.S. does not hesitate to invade other countries in order to satisfy its cupidity, it regards the infringement on other countries' copyright as a trifle.
Chongryon, a dignified overseas compatriots' organization of the DPRK and authorized by the media of the DPRK, has strongly demanded the immediate deletion of the data, posted without permission, as well as compensation and apology several times since August 2024. But, "NK NEWS" shamelessly behaved, talking about "mistakes of the operators".
It was fully disclosed through investigation that such DPRK's media data, posted on the website of the "KCNA WATCH" without any permission, had been stolen from a state library in Europe which reads under a contract the KPM website run by Korean Media of Chongryon.
Nevertheless, the "NK NEWS" side blustered that the credentials related to the protection of copyright and the right to use, issued by the DPRK media to the Korean Media of Chongryon under the legal procedures, cannot be recognized as it has not been certified by the U.S. jurisdictional authorities. Moreover, it has gone the lengths of making preposterous gangster-like logic that our side has to be thankful for having introduced the DPRK.
This is nothing but a reckless behavior of adding to the crimes already committed by itself.
The Democratic Lawyers Association of Korea strongly urges the U.S. to stop at once such poor excuses that will not work on anyone and to make an official apology and compensation for its illegal deed.
We will closely watch the future attitude of "NK NEWS". -0-

headline: Fertilizer Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in the DPRK produced 7 000 and 3 000 more tons of fertilizer respectively than planned in February, saving a large amount of anthracite.
The gas producing shop, gas cleaning shop and urea shop of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex increased the productivity by shortening the repair time and raising the operation rate of equipment.
The workers at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, too, contributed to the fulfillment of the plan by boosting the actual extraction rate while introducing rational operating methods in conformity with the requirements of standard operating methods in close cooperation among processes. -0-

headline: Farming Preparations Brisk in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Farms in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are busy with preparations for farming.
City and county short courses on the Juche farming methods and provincial inter-sector passing-on-technique conferences were held to raise the scientific and technological level of the agricultural guidance officials and primary officials of rural areas and to prepare the farmers as performers of advanced scientific farming.
Paeksok and Usan farms in Sinchon County, Oguk and Toksong farms in Anak County, and many other farms have carried quality self-sufficing manure to farm fields.
Farms in Kangryong, Anak, Songhwa, Pyoksong, Ongjin and Samchon counties are increasing the production of huminite.
In the province, more than 100 000 tons of fertile soil and tens of thousands of tons of slaked lime have been secured to improve soil fertility.
All the rural communities are pushing ahead with the preparations for humus soil for rice seeding beds and rice seedling bed covering material and securing plastic sheets at the final stage as well as providing seeds, reagent for seeds treatment, etc.
After the completion of waterway cleaning at rural communities, a project for repairing several large irrigation facilities is being pushed forward under the operation and command of the province.
The work to secure more water in major and other reservoirs has been pushed ahead with at the Yonbaek Area Irrigation Management Station and other area irrigation management stations, city and county irrigation management stations and  rural areas.
Meanwhile, the work to increase the proportion of mechanization in farming is being conducted. -0-

headline: Women's Union Officials and Members Meet with Winners of Communist Mother Honor Prize
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea met with winners of the Communist Mother Honor Prize at the Hall of Women on March 4 to mark the 115th March 8 International Women's Day.
Present there were Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials of the women's union and members of the women's union in Pyongyang.

Paek Jong Suk, a woman living in Kwangmyong-dong of Unjong District, said that she would make sure that the patriotic tradition of placing the country above the happiness of a family is given steady continuity, calling upon all the mothers to train their sons and daughters to be true revolutionaries boundlessly loyal to the ideas and leadership of the Party with pure conscience and sincere maternal affection.

headline: Promulgation Anniversary of Agrarian Reform Law Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 79th anniversary of the promulgation of the Agrarian Reform Law in the DPRK.
The agrarian reform was the first in the democratic reforms enforced in new Korea after its liberation from the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule on August 15, 1945.
At that time, the enforcement of the agrarian reform was of special importance in the country where the peasants made up an overwhelming majority of the population. It was the centuries-old desire of the Korean peasants to do farming in their own land to their heart’s content.
PresidentKim Il Sunggratified their wishes for land.
He went to rural areas to learn in detail about the demands of peasants and put forward it as the basic principle of agrarian reform to make them masters of land. And he set forth the policy of carrying out the agrarian reform on the principle of confiscation without compensation and distribution without charge and of converting the confiscated land into private property of the peasants, instead of state ownership.
On this basis, he promulgated the historic "Law on Agrarian Reform in North Korea".
The agrarian reform was completed in a short span of time and more than one million hectares of land, owned by the Japanese imperialists, their stooges and landlords, were distributed to more than 720 000 peasant households free of charge.
As a result, the Korean peasants were freed from feudal relations of exploitation and subjugation and became the masters of land for the first time in history.
The rural construction in the country, started with the agrarian reform, has now greeted the era of historic turn under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The programme for the rural revolution in the new era was put forward and a new history of radical transformation was opened on this land as the rural areas across the country are undergoing a radical change as required by the great guidelines for its prosperity. -0-

headline: Delegation of Lao Foreign Ministry Leaves
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Lao Foreign Ministry led by Vice-Minister Phongsavanh Sisoulath left here for home on March 4.
It was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by officials of the DPRK Foreign Ministry and the Lao ambassador to the DPRK and members of his embassy. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Marks Anniversary of Agrarian Reform Law
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Today is a significant day marking the anniversary of the historic Agrarian Reform Law promulgated by PresidentKim Il Sung.
Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial says that the Korean peasants entered into a road of dramatic turn in their destiny to enjoy their worthwhile life as masters of land and the country under the benevolent care of the President 79 years ago.
The agrarian reform, which was carried out successfully under the wise guidance of the President, serves as an important occasion in liquidating for good and all the feudal relations of land ownership deep-rooted in the rural areas of the country and opening up a prelude to the development of the Korean-style rural communities, the editorial says, and goes on:
PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilattached importance to the peasant and agricultural problems as the key problems arising in accomplishing the socialist cause and devoted themselves to the successful solution of the problems in the whole period of their revolutionary leadership.
It is the noble intention of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto build a land of bliss to be envied by the world on the socialist land associated with the patriotic desire ofKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilfor building a powerful country.
Remarkable entities of rural rejuvenation have appeared as the agricultural and rural problems have been raised as the major agenda items and strong practical measures have been taken at the important Party meetings to discuss the country's crucial affairs. This stirring reality of the country is a precious fruition of the steadfast patriotic will of the respected General Secretary.
The victory of the historic cause of putting the country's agriculture on a steady track of development and bringing about a radical change in the countryside is sure to be come thanks to the wise leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea, the programme for the rural revolution in the new era and the noble loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm of the Party members and other working people.
On the same day, Minju Joson says in an article that the socialist land cultivated by the President and the Chairman through great painstaking efforts all their lives is now turning into a land of bliss where the people's dreams and ideals are coming true along with the programme for the rural revolution in the new era indicated byKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Mass Movement for Repairing and Maintaining Tractors
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Organizations of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) at all levels are conducting a mass movement for repairing and maintaining tractors.
Officials of the UAWK committees in Pyongyang Municipality and North and South Phyongan, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces have conducted organizational and political work so that the primary committees of the union in the municipality and provinces have a large share in repairing and maintaining tractors.
All primary committees of the union provided more than 2 000 accessories of 50-odd kinds, 2 500 repair tools of 20-odd kinds and many daily necessities to tractor drivers, technicians and skilled workers, thus contributing to the repair and maintenance of farm machines.
Many organizations of the union such as the union committees in Anak and Paechon counties of South Hwanghae Province and Sangwon and Sungho counties of North Hwanghae Province and the primary committee of the union of the Sariwon Fruit Farm conducted the mass movement to suit their specific conditions, contributing to the preparations for farming. -0-

headline: Might of DPRK Strong in Ideology Is Inexhaustible: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- The DPRK is a great country which has emerged as the first ideological power in the history of mankind and is winning victory after victory with its inexhaustible strength, says Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article.
An ideological power is the name peculiar to Juche Korea which no country in the world can have, the article says, and goes on:
Ideology is the most vital and core factor propelling the building of a powerful country.
Thanks to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, our state could establish the most scientific revolutionary idea, the acme in the history of human thought, as a political philosophy of the state and apply it to the state building and activities.
The myth of war victory in the 1950s, miracles of Chollima and victory in the struggle to defend socialism in the 1990s are the great fruition of the doctrine of ideology almighty.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unis the peerless statesman and great leader who is ushering in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation, the great era of power, holding the Juche-oriented theory of ideology as an almighty weapon.
The revolutionary idea ofKim Jong Unis the greatest one displaying extraordinary truth and vitality in attaining the goal of building a powerful state and translating all the ideals of the people into reality.
Under his care, the Party, state and people are strong in ideology and demonstrating their honor as the invincible Party, powerful state and great people advancing and emerging victorious by dint of ideology.
The immense might of all the people, who hold the great leader of the revolution in high esteem and are possessed of the great revolutionary mode of advancing and winning victory by dint of ideology, will surely bring about a great thriving power on the horizon of the new era. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Cheyukchon Revolutionary Site in Chongchun Street
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- The Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports in the DPRK is conducting effective education through the Cheyukchon (sports village) Revolutionary Site in Chongchun Street, which tells about the undying feats of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of Juche-oriented sports.
Entering this year, sportspersons from professional sports units and many officials and working people from the Sports Facilities Management Bureau under the ministry, the Academy of Sports Science, the Pyongyang Sports Goods Factory, Sosan Hotel and other units have visited the revolutionary site associated with the sacred traces of the peerlessly great men to grasp the leadership feats of the Workers' Party of Korea.

They went round the site, being told about the fact thatKim Jong Unmade sure that the sports village in Chongchun Street associated with the immortal leadership exploits of the President and the Chairman was successfully remodeled. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Work Hard to Glorify This Year with Increased Grain Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers across the DPRK have turned out in a drive to glorify this year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with high grain production results.
The daily quotas on all indices for farming preparations including the production and transport of self-sufficing manure have been over-fulfilled at 120 percent, and successes have been made in springtime farming.
Agricultural workers in South Hwanghae Province are making innovations in the preparation for sowing rice seeds in nurseries, securing water and keeping pumping equipment in full-capacity operation.
Those in South Phyongan Province are working hard to introduce the method of cultivating nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings into 80 percent area of rice fields.
Those in North Phyongan Province are stepping up the work to improve acid soil and soil affected by cold and humidity and to spread fertile soil on farm fields.
The sowing of spring wheat and barley is being pushed ahead with in the rural areas of North Hwanghae Province, and the agricultural workers in South Hamgyong Province are striving to raise the proportion of mechanization in farming.
Agricultural workers in North Hamgyong and Kangwon provinces, too, are devoting themselves to bringing about a rich harvest. -0-

headline: Motivation Activities Brisk at Housing Construction Site in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in the DPRK conducted motivation activities at the housing construction site in the Hwasong area.

Watching the performance full of joy and optimism of youth and pulsating with the spirit of the times, the builders keenly felt the unusual pride of erecting with their sincere sweat and efforts a paradise for the people's eternal happiness.

headline: Youths and Women in North Hwanghae Province Advance into Major Theatres
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Youths and women in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK have joined the ranks of loyalty and patriotism, amid all the people's trust in the Workers' Party of Korea's policies growing deeper while witnessing significant progress for the comprehensive national prosperity through the first entities of regional rejuvenation.
Youths in Koksan County requested the youth league organization to dispatch them to the county raw material base station and those in Hwangju County voluntarily formed a youth sub-workteam to work at a raw material base.
More than 250 women's union members in Unpha County volunteered to work at the county raw material base station and housewives in Yonsan, Kumchon and Pongsan counties advanced into regional-industry factories and raw material bases.
Officials, youths and women in the relevant areas gave bouquets and encouragement to those volunteers leaving for the honorable posts of socialist construction. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Work Hard to Glorify This Year with Increased Grain Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers across the DPRK have turned out in a drive to glorify this year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with high grain production results.
The daily quotas on all indices for farming preparations including the production and transport of self-sufficing manure have been over-fulfilled at 120 percent, and successes have been made in springtime farming.
Agricultural workers in South Hwanghae Province are making innovations in the preparation for sowing rice seeds in nurseries, securing water and keeping pumping equipment in full-capacity operation.
Those in South Phyongan Province are working hard to introduce the method of cultivating nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings into 80 percent area of rice fields.
Those in North Phyongan Province are stepping up the work to improve acid soil and soil affected by cold and humidity and to spread fertile soil on farm fields.
The sowing of spring wheat and barley is being pushed ahead with in the rural areas of North Hwanghae Province, and the agricultural workers in South Hamgyong Province are striving to raise the proportion of mechanization in farming.
Agricultural workers in North Hamgyong and Kangwon provinces, too, are devoting themselves to bringing about a rich harvest. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on U.S.-ROK Large-scale Joint Military Exercises
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- In every March, a bleak war wind blows for sure from the southern part of the Korean Peninsula.
This year is no exception. Warmongers of the U.S. and the puppet ROK will stage a large-scale joint military exercises, Freedom Shield, in the ROK under the simulated conditions of an all-out war against the DPRK from next week.
No matter how frequently the enemy states describe the said large-scale war rehearsal targeting a sovereign state as "annual" and "defensive" one, they can never cover up its habitual, offensive and confrontational nature since it has "contributed" in a sustained way to violating the sovereignty, security and interests of the DPRK and deteriorating the regional situation.
Here's some open data that make the exercises' real character clear.
The forthcoming Freedom Shield will include seven more joint field mobile drills by units of brigade-level and above than last year. This shows in a visual way that the exercises will renew the record of last year, in which field mobile drills of various missions more than twice than the previous year were staged with even involvement of forces from ten-odd satellite countries belonging to the "UN Command", and that the enemy states' nonstop reckless war moves are inching to an dangerous phase moment by moment, drawing a mounting curve.
What is also noticeable is the fact that the military ruffians of the U.S. and the ROK will use lots of cutting-edge military hardware in the forthcoming rehearsal, in the light of lessons from the recent wars, to further boost its aggressive and threatening nature as offensive one for an actual war.
The U.S. Space Force staged a space operation drill targeting the DPRK in January in cooperation with the ROK Air Force. And this time it is going to participate in the forthcoming rehearsal so as to stage a "joint command and control drill" aimed at increasing the capability of intercepting missiles and destroying artificial satellites.
As seen above, the enemy state's scheme to stifle the DPRK by military edge even in the outer space as well as in ground, naval and air military operation spheres and destroy the regional strategic security balance is going over to the phase of confrontational action.
To follow it, the military gangsters of the ROK are planning to stage a large-scale "United Defense Exercises" involving the army, the police, government agencies, local self-governing bodies and even civilians and, furthermore, employ artificial intelligence on an experimental basis during the joint exercises with the U.S. forces, increasing the present danger in every aspect.
It is no wonder that the world is now watching carefully the developments in the Korean Peninsula in March with great concern and uneasiness.
With the Freedom Shield approaching, the task force of the U.S. nuclear carrier Carl Vinson has entered the Pusan operation base in the ROK and a B-1B strategic bomber and other aircraft fly in the sky over areas in and around the Korean Peninsula every day. And the U.S. and ROK forces are waging various war drills in the air, on the ground and at sea as preliminary drills almost every day.
Under the observation of bosses of the U.S. forces in the ROK and its army, a large-scale live shell firing drill of air and ground forces of the two countries with the mobilizations of such huge military equipment as tanks, armored cars, fighters, helicopter gunship and unmanned reconnaissance aircraft was conducted near the southern border of the DPRK on March 6 to show the "prelude" of escalating the tension.
The Freedom Shield in 2025 will soon bring a storm of aggravated situation to the Korean Peninsula as it has repeatedly undergone the worst change with all its existing features of evil.
In the world, there will be no country that tolerates such threat to its security dramatically increasing under its eyes, regarding it as "defensive" to comfort itself.
Counteraction is inevitable.
We have already made it clear that if the U.S. continues to renew its record of military muscle-flexing, we will have no option but to renew our record of displaying strategic deterrent.
The enemy states will have to pay dearly for their stupid and reckless war drills that will result in the self-defensive, fair and square, threatening toughest response from the DPRK. -0-

headline: Spring Bowling Amateurs Tournament Held in DPRK
Support to Farms Brisk in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality in the DPRK is conducting a mass-based movement to render material and technical aid to farms.
The municipality sent much manure to the farms early in January. It also organized an exhibition of medium and small farm implements to boost enthusiasm of the agricultural workers out in immediate farming.
Officials and working people of many units and areas including Nampho Port, the West Sea Barrage Office and the municipal power transmission and distribution station provided tens of thousands of medium and small farm implements necessary for spring farming with the consciousness that they are responsible for the country's granary together with agricultural workers.
Working people in Chollima and Kangso districts devoted themselves to securing farming materials and farm implements including vinyl sheets and knapsack sprayers and those in Taean and Hanggu districts concentrated efforts on preparing various kinds of small farm implements and equipment for leveling the ground and manuring and cultivating crops.
Making rounds of the venues of exhibitions of small and medium farm implements, officials of the municipality, districts and counties encouraged the working people who contributed to increasing the proportion of mechanization in farming by presenting excellent farm implements, and discussed the ways for more positively supporting farms. -0-

headline: Transport of Farming Materials Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- The railway sector of the DPRK is steadily expanding achievements in the transport of farming materials this month as it did in February.
The Ministry of Railways, in close cooperation with relevant units in the agricultural sector, has frequently learned about the securing of goods and arranged the order of trains and composed trains for intensive transportation in a rational way.
The Pyongyang Railway Bureau is directing efforts to raising the operation rate of locomotives and reducing the round-trip time of intensive transport trains.
The Kaechon Railway Bureau has learned about the wagons staying in the station and loading of goods and taken relevant measures, thus registering high transport results.
Similar successes are registered by Hamhung and Chongjin railway bureaus, too. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Steps Taken in DPRK to Attain This Year's Grain Production Goal
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK strives to attain the grain production goal for this year by raising the enthusiasm for scientific farming.
The provincial rural economy committee organized a sci-tech short course for technical experts of workteams at farms. It also organized the work to generalize the experience of the Yakjon Farm in Sukchon County, which made achievements in agricultural production last year by introducing new farming techniques and methods, so that everyone can turn out in a drive for scientific farming.
The short course on the Juche farming methods and the technical study according to the farming processes have been organized to increase the agricultural workers' zeal for scientific farming.
The committee has made agricultural scientists and researchers create scientific farming methods to cope with disastrous abnormal weather. Meanwhile, it worked out technical guidelines on each farming process to suit the regional characteristics and sent them to cities and counties for prearrangement.
It is also making  the effective preparations for coping with various forms of disastrous abnormal weather like high temperature, drought and typhoon as well as further strengthening the material and technical foundations of irrigational sector. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Meet with Winners of Communist Mother Honor Prize
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers met with winners of the Communist Mother Honor Prize and meritorious women of socialist patriotism on March 6 on the occasion of the 115th March 8 International Women's Day.
Present there were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea, officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers and union members in Pyongyang.
Speeches were made at the meeting by winners of the Communist Mother Honor Prize and meritorious women of socialist patriotism.
Hong Kum Ran, chief of the ten-day kindergarten at the Posok Farm in Unjon County, noted that she brought up five children to stand them at the post for national defence and has assisted the army for more than ten years.
She did only what she should do as a mother, but the respected ComradeKim Jong Uninvited her to the celebrations of the 75th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army, the 5th National Conference of Mothers and other events and gave her the valuable honor as a communist mother and a gold ring of love, thus putting her on the highest peak of glory, she said.
Mun Kwang Nyo, a woman living in people's neighborhood unit No. 2, Phaeyop-ri, Anak County, said that she has over-fulfilled her grain production plan every year and made her four sons stand at the post for national defence, but the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unset up her in the front rank of mothers across the country. She paid her deep thanks to the General Secretary.
Choe Song Ok, a technical expert of the crop-raising workteam No. 4 at the Sinhung Farm in Kangnam County, noted that she had devoted herself to raising the grain yield on five hectares of low-yielding land over the past years and, in those days, was awarded the title of Labor Hero, the highest honour of citizens, and was honored with the title of meritorious person of socialist patriotism. She called upon all the agricultural workers to fully play their role as masters responsible for the country's granary.
Oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting. -0-

headline: Women's Rights Fully Guaranteed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the 115th March 8 International Women's Day, all the people in the DPRK warmly congratulate the women who are adding pleasure to their families and society and supporting the country.
Great is the pride and honor of the Korean women who have led a happy and dignified life while being given genuine rights in all fields of social life, thanks to the politics of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government on attaching importance to women.
In the country, the women are granted all rights under such many laws as the law on the provision of women's rights and the Socialist Labour Law as well as the state and social policies for women.
Thanks to the Law on Sex Equality, mapped out and promulgated by PresidentKim Il Sungin July 1946, the Korean women could contribute to the revolution, construction and social development with the same rights as men.
An ordinary woman worker has become a deputy to the Supreme People's Assembly and many women have exercised their political rights to the full at power organs at all levels.
Nurseries, kindergartens and public service facilities have been built in different parts of the country to help women take part in labor without worry, and their children are brought up at state and public expense.
As many women have honestly performed their duties while bringing up their children, they are highly respected by society and the collective as cadres and labor innovators.
Women who gave birth to many children are regarded as heroes, and prolific mothers are provided with food, houses and other living conditions and medical services are offered to their families on a preferential basis.
Today, the Communist Mother Honor Prize is awarded to women who have made distinguished contributions to the prosperity of the country by fulfilling their responsibility and duty as mothers before the society and families, thanks to the love and trust of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho attaches importance to the women as a powerful force of the development of the state and society.
This is the reality of our socialist country that truly provides the women with all rights of a social human being, including the rights to development and honor, to say nothing of the rights to existence and equality. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Shipyards to Learn about Warship-building and Advance Strategic Policy for Epochal Development in Shipbuilding Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 8 (KCNA) -- At a time when the important goals for realizing the grandiose plan of the Workers' Party of Korea on building an advanced maritime power are being pushed ahead with under the schedule set by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, there took place the guidance work of the Party Central Committee, which is of a remarkable significance in defending the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK and in developing its shipbuilding industry.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, toured major shipyards to give field guidance at their shipbuilding.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted by leading officials of those shipyards.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, and major leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
He acquainted himself with the ongoing work for attaining the goal of building warships set forth by the Party Congress and the technical equipment level and modernization of shipyards.
He expressed great satisfaction over the high spirit and labor feats of the workers who are registering signal successes in the implementation of the militant task for radically improving the modernity of our navy in the shortest span of time in line with the primary requirement for the state security and the world trend of naval force development.
He was reported on the progress made in attaining with confidence the goals for putting the shipbuilding industry on a Juche, modern and scientific basis, set forth by the Party Central Committee, by pushing ahead with the work for technical updating and enhancement of the production capacity to ensure the rapid development of our naval force.
He gave a high appreciation of the fact that a firm prospect has been opened for introducing into the operation the strongest warships capable of establishing the core of the Juche naval force and meeting all the requirements of the national defence strategy in the shortest possible time, true to the strategic line of our Party on building the national defence.
He said that the maritime sovereignty is the core of the sovereign rights of our country, whose both eastern and western sides are washed by seas, and the development of the naval force into an elite and nuclear-armed force constitutes an important content in the strategy for the development of the national defence which intensively reflects our Party's will to defend the sovereignty at present.
Only when there is a powerful naval force that no one can provoke, is it possible to defend the security of the country and the people and ensure normal development of the fishing industry and the overall national economy, he said, adding that the sea is an inviolable territory where the dignity and prestige of our state and the people's life are ensured, before it is an indefinite site for prosperity.
Saying that the eternal history of our socialist Korea depends on how we defend the sea, a major front decisive of the life and death of the state and people and a main route of aggression by the enemy countries, he stressed the need to make the incomparably overwhelming warships fulfill their mission as powerful deterrent of a nuclear power capable of containing the inveterate "gunboat diplomacy" of the hostile forces.
It is really significant progress that the rejuvenation of the DPRK's ideal warship-building industry has entered the full-scale stage of laying a sure foundation and kindling the flame of modernization while enduring hardships, he said, stressing the need to decisively enhance the warship-building capacity on the basis of the existing precious experience and technology and put spurs to the improvement of overall technical processes, and thus  build a large number of modern warships of different missions desired by our naval force.
The key to radically strengthening the warship-building industry, which can be called an aggregate of ultra-modern defence science and technology, is the science and technology and training of talents, he said, calling for regarding them as the two elements for development and leap forward so as to vigorously lead the rejuvenation of warship-building industry, whose new appearance will be recorded in the history of the DPRK.
He said that the modernization of the shipyards, which should play an important role in the revolution in the new era for bolstering up the naval force, should not be conducted in the passive method of bridging the gaps in the processes of the existing foundation, but in the way of boldly and perfectly creating new and high-tech bases suited to the prestige and status of a powerful nation. And he clarified the strategic plan of the WPK for doing so.
He said that the DPRK would never remain an idle onlooker to the naval and underwater military activities of the enemies seriously threatening the sovereignty and interests of the DPRK by constantly deploying large numbers of strategic assets but reliably defend the maritime sovereignty and firmly ensure a security guarantee on the Korean peninsula and the region through the important innovations and changes of its naval force and the upper hand in the ever-evolving strength.
Noting that the justness to put the DPRK naval force's war posture and capability to fight a war on the most powerful and perfect level is increasing the DPRK's will and desire for the rejuvenation of the warship-building industry, he affirmed that the sea defence capability of the DPRK, which is in a responsible and key position for defending peace in the Korean peninsula and the region, will be fully displayed in any necessary waters without limitation.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the officials and workers in the warship-building industry would further consolidate the arsenal for defending the maritime sovereignty with a courageous struggle, well aware of their sacred honor and important mission as revolutionary industrial soldiers of the WPK who is responsible for the fatal state affair holding sway over the future of the DPRK's navy and the territorial integrity and peace keeping of the country.
The basic orientation for radically bolstering up the navy's combat power valued by the Party is to simultaneously push forward with the modernization of water-surface and underwater warships and the further improvement of their operational capabilities, he said, and advanced the long-term essential plan for the possession of the warships and its stepwise goals to substantially guarantee the mission of the DPRK's armed forces to defend the maritime sovereignty and the future direction of the defence economic work and all the tasks for doing so.
He also learned about the building of a nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine pushed forward with under the decision of the 8th Congress of the WPK.
His field guidance at the major shipyards is a significant event heralding a new phase of bolstering up the Juche-based naval force. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Shipyards to Learn about Warship Building and Advance Strategic Policy for Epochal Development of Shipbuilding Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 8 (KCNA) -- At a time when the struggle for attaining the important goals for realizing the grandiose plan of the Workers’ Party of Korea for building the country into an advanced maritime power is powerfully being pushed ahead with under the schedule set by the Eighth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea, there took place the guidance work of the Party Central Committee, which is of remarkable significance in defending the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK and in developing its shipbuilding industry.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited major shipyards to give field guidance to warship building.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted by leading officials of those shipyards.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Senior Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the Navy of the Korean People’s Army, and major leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
He acquainted himself with the ongoing work for attaining the goal of building warships, set forth by the Party Congress, and the technical equipment level of the shipyards and the progress of their modernization projects.
He expressed great satisfaction over the soaring spirit and labour feats of the workers who are registering signal successes in the implementation of the militant task for radically improving the modernity of our navy in the shortest span of time in line with the prerequisite requirement for the security of the state and the world development trend of naval forces.
He was reported on the progress made in attaining with confidence the goals for putting the shipbuilding industry on a Juche-oriented, modern and scientific basis, set forth by the Party Central Committee, by actively pushing ahead with the work for technical updating and expansion of production capacity to ensure the rapid development of our naval forces.
He gave a high appreciation of the fact that a bright prospect has been opened for introducing into the operations the most powerful warships capable of establishing the core of our Juche-oriented naval forces and meeting all the requirements of the national defence strategy in the shortest possible time, true to the strategic line of our Party on building up the national defences, and said:
The maritime sovereignty is the core of the sovereign rights of our country, which borders the sea both on the east and the west, and developing its naval forces into an elite, nuclear-armed force constitutes an important content of the strategy for the development of the national defence, which intensively reflects our Party’s present will to defend the sovereignty.
Only when there are powerful naval forces that no one can provoke, is it possible to defend the security of the country and the people and guarantee normal development of the fishing industry and the overall national economy. For us, the sea, before being a limitless base for prosperity, is an inviolable territory where the dignity and prestige of our state and the people’s life are defended.
The everlasting prosperity of our socialist Korea depends on how we defend the sea, a major front decisive of the life and death of the state and the people and a main route of aggression by the enemy countries. We should ensure that incomparably threatening warships fulfil their mission as powerful deterrent of a nuclear power, capable of containing the inveterate “gunboat diplomacy” of the hostile forces.
It is really significant progress that the rejuvenation of the country’s warship-building industry, which we aspire to, has laid its solid foundations and entered the full-scale stage of kindling the flame of modernization while enduring hardships. On the basis of the precious experience and technology we have gained so far, we should put spurs to decisively enhancing the warship-building capacity and upgrading the overall technological processes, so as to build a large number of modern warships of different missions desired by our naval forces.
The key to radically developing the warship-building industry, which can be called an ensemble of cutting-edge defence science and technology, is science and technology and training of talents. Regarding them as two elements for development and leap forward, we should vigorously lead the rejuvenation of warship-building industry, whose new appearance will be recorded in the history of the DPRK.
He said that the modernization of the shipyards, which should play an important role in the revolution in the new era for bolstering up the naval forces, should not be conducted in a passive way of filling up the missing processes of the existing foundations, but in the way of boldly and perfectly creating new and hi-tech bases suited to the prestige and status of a powerful nation. And he clarified the strategic plan of the WPK to this end.
He stated that the DPRK will never remain an onlooker to the naval and underwater military manoeuvrings of the enemies, who are seriously threatening its sovereignty and interests by constantly deploying large numbers of strategic assets, but reliably defend its maritime sovereignty and ensure a sure security guarantee on the Korean peninsula and the region through important innovations and changes of its naval forces and supremacy of its ever-developing strength.
Noting that the justness to put the country’s naval forces’ war posture and capability to fight a war on the most powerful and perfect level is increasing our will and desire for the rejuvenation of the warship-building industry, he affirmed that the sea defence capability of the DPRK, which is in a responsible and key position for defending peace on the Korean peninsula and the region, will be fully displayed in any necessary waters without limitation.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the officials and workers in the warship-building industry would further consolidate the arsenal for defending the country’s maritime sovereignty through a courageous struggle, mindful of their sacred honour and important mission as revolutionary industrial soldiers of the WPK, who have shouldered the state affair decisive of the future of the country’s navy and the defence of the territorial integrity and peace of the country.
The basic orientation for radically bolstering up the navy’s combat power considered important by the Party is to simultaneously push forward with modernization of surface and underwater warships and further improvement of their operations capabilities, he said. And he advanced the essential long-term plan and stage-by-stage goals for the possession of the warships to substantially guarantee the mission of our armed forces to defend the maritime sovereignty, as well as the future direction of the defence economic work and all the tasks to this end.
He also learned about the building of a nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine, which is being pushed forward according to the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK.
His field guidance at the major shipyards is a significant event heralding a new phase of bolstering up the Juche-based naval forces. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Onpho Working People’s Holiday Camp under Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 8 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, gave field guidance over the project for newly building the Onpho Working People’s Holiday Camp under the Recreation Management Bureau of the Ministry of Labour.
He was accompanied by Ri Hi Yong and Kim Jae Ryong, leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He was greeted on the spot by the chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, the chairman of the provincial people’s committee and officials of the construction field command team.
The project is for building a recreation and recuperation centre, which is under way in accordance with the on-site instructions given by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unduring his field guidance over various sectors of North Hamgyong Province in July 2018. At that time, he stressed the need to newly build the Onpho Holiday Camp in Kyongsong County, a famous hot-spring area of the country, into a comprehensive cultural recreation and medical service base so that the people can receive hot-spring therapy while enjoying highly-civilized cultural and leisure activities.
Kim Jong Unmet senior cadres and working-level officials at the construction site and learned in detail about the progress in the construction project.
He said that the construction of the holiday camp and the preparations for its operation should be done without any slightest defect in order to complete it as another distinctive base for cultural life and an advanced recreation and recuperation facility for the people to enjoy spa culture to their heart’s content, and referred to a series of deviations being revealed in the ongoing project and to the measures for overcoming them.
It is important to fully embody the functional requirements in conformity with the mission and use of the construction object aimed mainly at recreation and recuperation, maximize the utilization rate of the building area and ensure convenience, he said, stressing the need to pay attention to the detailed issues lest the visitors should experience even the slightest inconvenience, since the overall project has reached the final stage, and to finish it in a qualitative way.
He set forth important tasks to be tackled in the construction of the holiday camp and its future management and operation, including those of further improving the service conditions and the treatment environment level so that the hot-spring therapy, a specific feature of the camp and the main category of its service work, can contribute to the promotion of the people’s health and their enjoyment of civilization, of expanding the sphere and space of diverse cultural life by actively making the most of the topographical features of the picturesque mountainous area and of making full preparations so that it can start its operation at the same time as the completion of the project. He then continued:
It is an important component of the people-oriented policies of our Party and government and a responsible undertaking to provide the working people with excellent treatment and recuperation facilities and more advanced service conditions for their maximum convenience. We should be more faithful to our original mission of existing for the people and fighting for their interests and always serve them with an innovative and positive attitude.
It is the intention of our Party to build modern holiday resorts and sanatoriums for the people, which blend well with the beautiful natural scenery, in famous mountains and scenic spots of the country and furnish them with a larger number of comprehensive service facilities so that they can fully enjoy the entities of civilization and promote their health thanks to the benefits of the advantageous socialist policy, and thus make those facilities serve as bases for cultural progress and result in a steady improvement of the life of the working masses.
When the Onpho Working People’s Holiday Camp is built as a comprehensive cultural recreation and health service centre in this mountainous area, which fully meets all the requirements of modern architecture while preserving well the unique charms and features unique to the region, it will be another worthwhile achievement of ours in pioneering really diverse fields and diverse realms of life, he said, proposing that the camp be successfully built in this significant year of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and presented to the people.
Kim Jong Unalso indicated important tasks related to the construction of the Yombunjin Haeyang Hostel in North Hamgyong Province.
He approved on the spot a detailed work plan and proposals for the completion of the construction projects for the Onpho Working People’s Holiday Camp and the Yombunjin Haeyang Hostel, including the additional budget expenditure and workforce formation for the final stage of the projects, and assigned the tasks for their implementation. -0-

It is important to fully embody the functional requirements in conformity with the mission and use of the construction object mainly aimed at recreation and recuperation, maximize the utilization rate of the building area and ensure convenience, he said, stressing the need to pay attention to the detailed issues so as to prevent the visitors from feeling even the slightest inconvenience, since the overall construction project has reached the final stage, and to finish it in a qualitative way.
He set forth the important tasks for the construction of the holiday camp and its future management and operation, including an issue for further improving the service conditions and the treatment environment level so that the hot-spring cure, a peculiarity of the camp and a type of its main service business, can be conducive to the promotion of the people's health and to their enjoyment of civilization, an issue of expanding and creating the sphere and space of diverse cultural life by actively applying the geographical features of the picturesque mountain area, and an issue of making full preparations for operation to start service at the same time with the completion of the project.
He said that it is an important component and a responsible undertaking for the popular policies of our Party and government to provide the working people with good treatment and recuperation facilities and more advanced service conditions for their maximum convenience. We should be more faithful to our true mission, that is to exist for the people and struggle for their interests, and serve them always with an innovative and positive attitude, he added.
He stressed that it is the intention of our Party to build on a modern basis resorts and sanatoriums for the people in good harmony with beautiful natural scenery in famous mountains and scenic spots of the country and provide more comprehensive service facilities so that they can fully enjoy the entities of civilization and promote their health under the benefits of the advantageous socialist policy, and thus make them serve as a base for cultural progress and be led to a steady improvement in the life of the working masses.
When the Onpho Kulloja Holiday Camp is built as a comprehensive cultural rest and health service centre in mountain area which fully embodies all the requirements of modern architecture while well preserving regional unique charms and features, it will be another worthwhile achievement of ours in carving out really diverse fields and diverse living sphere, he said, adding that the camp should be successfully built this significant year marking the 80th birthday of the WPK and presented to the people.
Kim Jong Unalso indicated important tasks related to the construction of the Yombunjin Haeyang (maritime) Hostel in North Hamgyong Province.
On the sport, he approved a detailed work plan and proposals for the completion of construction projects for the Onpho Kulloja Holiday Camp and the Yombunjin Haeyang Hostel, including the expenditure of additional budget for the final project and the organization of labor force and assigned the work on their implementation. -0-

headline: Dancing Party of Women Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 8 (KCNA) -- A dancing party of women's union officials and members took place at the plaza of the Arch of Triumph here on March 7 to mark the 115th March 8 International Women's Day.
The dancing party began with the playing of the song "Our Leader Loved by People".
The participants danced in circles, paying the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho gave origin to the Juche-oriented women's movement and put forward the Korean women as masters performing a part of the revolution while guiding them step by step.

The atmosphere revved up amid the display of the women's union members' unanimous aspiration and desire to firmly believe in and follow the Workers' Party of Korea as all their destinies and contribute to building a highly-civilized and prosperous country with the sincere sweat and efforts.

Korean Residents in Russia Hit Out at U.S. Escalating Tension on Korean Peninsula
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- Organizations of Koreans in Russia issued statements denouncing the U.S. for escalating the tension on the Korean peninsula.
The Central Association of Korean Nationals in Russia in a statement titled "The U.S. should stop at once the provocative act of threatening the security environment of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" on March 4 said that the U.S. nuclear carrier Carl Vinson entered Pusan Port in the ROK on March 2, adding that it is the U.S. invariable policy toward the DPRK to stifle it by force.
The U.S. is persistently resorting to the criminal aggressive war drills targeting the DPRK, regardless of the Korean and world people's unanimous desire and demand for the military detente and durable peace, the statement said, stressing the U.S. should clearly understand that its reckless aggressive war drills with the ROK will only hasten their own destruction  .
The Social Confederation of Koreans in the Far Eastern Region of Russia, in a statement titled "The U.S. extreme war exercises are a main factor of threatening peace and security on the Korean peninsula" on March 5, said that it is entirely attributable to the DPRK's military line for self-defence and powerful war deterrent that peace has been kept in the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region up to now. And it warned that it is advisable for the U.S. to behave with a clear understanding of its rival. -0-

headline: Media Persons' Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- A group of journalists and other media persons from across the DPRK made a study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from March 2 to 8.
Its members toured the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, Chongbong Bivouac and other places, following the immortal footprints of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man who personally left at the historic places associated with the soul of the revolutionary forerunners.
Then they arrived at the historic birthplace of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin the Paektusan Secret Camp, the sacred place of the revolution. At his old home, they recollected the sacred revolutionary career and immortal exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and made a ceaseless long journey of patriotic devotion all his life.
Making rounds of the site of campfire, slogan-bearing trees and others associated with the activities of forerunners, they deeply grasped the fighting spirit and traits of the anti-Japanese war guerrillas who devoted their youth and lives, registering the history of war victory on the glorious course under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung.
They accelerated the march with the song "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" and climbed Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of the revolution.
They held an oath-taking meeting at the plaza in front of the statue ofKim Jong Ilin Samjiyon City on March 8.
A reporter and speakers called upon all journalists and other media persons to fulfill their honorable mission and duty as standard-bearers and buglers on the ideological front of the Workers' Party of Korea in  the grand struggle to achieve the great victory and glory of 2025 under the guidance ofKim Jong Un.
Then a letter of pledge was adopted.
During the study tour, the expedition members had such diverse events as a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, a question-and-answer study contest, and a quick-writing contest on the theme of education in the revolutionary traditions. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls upon All Sectors and Units to Increase Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Sunday in an editorial calls upon all sectors and units of the country to intensify a drive for increased production through campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them, and thus glorify this significant year with unprecedented production successes.
Unprecedented production successes have been made in every part of the country, in hearty response to the call of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea for achieving miraculous successes through a new drive for increased production, the editorial says, and go on:
In order to intensify the drive for increased production and creation across the country by steadily raising the fighting spirit of our people out in the struggle to implement the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee, all sectors and units should conduct brisk campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them.
There is no better way than the mass movement for overtaking the advanced people and units, helping backward people and units, and actively sharing and transferring good successes and experience in the ongoing drive for boosting production.
Only when units standing in the vanguard of advancing ranks of the times continue to create model experience and share it with each other and when backward units conduct a fierce pursuit campaign to overtake the advanced units, is it possible to successfully carry out the vast tasks and glorify this year as an eye-opening year, a year of great changes to be specially recorded in the history of development of our Party and Republic.
All the officials, Party members and other working people should turn out in the struggle to produce more, better and faster under the slogan "Let us greet the glorious Congress by dint of increased production!" -0-
