headline: Int'l Women's Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- On the 115th March 8 International Women's Day, the whole of the DPRK is full of joy of the women honestly serving as flowers of amity and laughs of happiness at their houses and workplaces.
Many citizens visited the sacred temple of Juche with ardent yearning and reverence for PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
A large number of people visited the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill in Pyongyang and in other parts of the country and the mosaics of the peerlessly great men to pay floral tribute to them.
Officials of all provinces, cities and counties, institutions, industrial establishments and farms met and congratulated women scientists, teachers, innovators and other exemplary women workers on the March 8 International Women's Day.
Colorful congratulatory performances were given at theatres and outdoor stages in Pyongyang and local areas.
A concert was given by the National Symphony Orchestra at the Moranbong Theatre and a music and dance performance by the Mansudae Art Troupe at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre to mark the 115th International Women's Day.
A one-act play, "laughter", was given at the National Theatre, and a circus show given by artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theater.
Artistes of the Central Artistic Information Team, the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the art group of the Central Committee of the women's union and the Railway Artistic Information Team gave colorful performances in different parts of Pyongyang.
Similar performances, dancing parties and colorful sports and amusement games took place in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae, Jagang and South Hamgyong provinces, Nampho and Kaesong municipalities and other parts of the country.
Public catering establishments across the country gave special holiday service.
Many people bought bouquets, flowers, greeting cards, souvenirs and other things for their wives and mothers at the souvenir and flower shops and flower stands. -0-

headline: National Meeting Marks 115th March 8 Int'l Women's Day
Ranks of Socialist Patriotic Young Vanguard Grow in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- The noble mental world of the younger generation in the DPRK is stirring up the times with the steadily increasing number of socialist patriotic young vanguard.
A young worker at the large machine-tool workshop of the Ryongsong Machine Complex has made lots of inventions and over-fulfilled his national economic plan every year, thus receivingKim Jong IlYouth Honor Prize.
A researcher at the Automation Institute under the State Academy of Sciences won many inventions certificates and sci-tech achievements introduction certifications and thus became a winner of the February 16 Science and Technology Prize and the Youth Science and Technology Prize.
A young weaver at the Sariwon Textile Mill has steadily raised her technical knowledge and skills and created new standards and records to become a winner ofKim Il SungYouth Honor Prize and a girl innovator and a high-level skilled worker under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea.
A young technical worker of the Samri Farm in Unryul County of South Hwanghae Province has turned 10-odd hectares of low-yielding land into a fertile land for the past nine years.
Among those youths honored with socialist patriotic young vanguard under the care of the WPK are a worker at the Rakwon General Machine Enterprise who has contributed to implementing the national economic plan through a brisk technical innovation movement while voluntarily taking care of orphans, a driver of the Paekam Mine Timber Production Station under the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau who fulfilled his timber transport plan ahead of schedule with the consciousness that transport means production, and a worker at the Ungok Pit of the Sudong Coal Production Station under the Hamnam Area Coal-mining Complex who made a contribution to increasing the coal production. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson of the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families issued the following press statement titled "Japanese imperialists' unethical atrocities against Korean people will be surely counted" on March 9:
Nearly 80 years have passed since Korea was liberated from the barbarous colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists. But the bloody shouts of the souls of the people who were taken to alien lands by the Japanese imperialists' abduction and died rancorous are still resounding vigorously.
After annexing Korea by force of arms in the last century, the Japanese imperialists committed unheard-of unethical crimes. Among the atrocities clearly recorded in the crime-woven history are the historical facts that the Japanese imperialists forcibly took away more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged Koreans and drove them out to the aggressive battle fields and toilsome worksites for bullet shields and labor slaves and made them undergo the wholesale deaths in the large-scale air raids by the U.S. forces.
Hundreds of B-29 large bombers of the U.S. forces flew into the sky over Tokyo and Osaka of Japan on March 10 and 13, 1945, the end of the Pacific War ignited by the Japanese imperialists, made massive air raids while dropping incendiaries and other bombs at random.
At that time the Japanese imperialists kept Koreans in custody in groups, claiming that Koreans who had been subjected to subhuman maltreatment and humiliation, dangerous and toilsome labor could escape in the confusion of air raids. As a result, many Koreans died an accidental death.
According to "Study of War Responsibilities" No.53, the organ of the Japanese Data Center for War Responsibilities, on the damage of Korean people in the large-scale air raids on Tokyo, the war victims are 41 300 and the death toll will far exceed 10 000.
Immediately after the large-scale air raids, the Japanese imperialists buried the Korean dead in 67 places of parks, temples and campuses, not investigating their identity, under the pretext of the "emperor's" junket to the area. Later, they committed such hideous unethical crimes as digging out the dead and dealing with the remains of Koreans at will.
The Korean victims did not returned to their native places where their beloved parents, wives and children were waiting for even after their death and became the fate of forlorn wandering spirits in alien lands. This miserable fate is entirely attributable to the Japanese imperialists' occupation of Korea and their colonial rule over it, and a direct product of the abduction of Koreans.
Nevertheless, the successive Japanese authorities have never paid attention to probing the unethical atrocities at that time and confirming the identity of the Korean victims without any slightest compunction, and have made desperate efforts to bury the forcible drafting in the oblivion of history.
Japan formulated it as a governmental stand that forcible drafting of Koreans should not be expressed with "forced labor". And it has issued the guidelines on noting the "forcible drafting" as "mobilization" and "labor draft" in history textbooks, rubbing salt into the unhealed wounds of the victims and bereaved families.
Japan should bear in mind that its moves to obliterate its past aggressive crimes and implant its distorted outlook on history into the younger generation, evading its state responsibility for the crimes against humanity, will only add to the debt of its crimes, remaining a shameless country bereft of human ethics and morality in the international community.
The forcible drafting and forcible labor of Koreans are crimes committed by the government and military of Imperial Japan with all authority involved, and they are the crime against important ethics and morality, slavery crime and war crime. The international conventional law and statute law on legal prescription stipulate that no prescription applies to the crimes related to basic human rights.
Japan, a war criminal state, should make a full investigation into the fact that the remains of Korean victims have been left for 80 years and open to the public the truth. At the same time Japan should make a thorough apology and reparation to the victims and their bereaved families for the thrice-cursed crimes of pushing innocent people into death.
It is the unshakable will of all the Korean people to certainly give vent to the deep-rooted grudge of the victims who lost their flowery youth and precious lives due to the forcible drafting by the Japanese imperialists and of their bereaved families.
The unethical atrocities committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people during the air raids on Tokyo and Osaka by the U.S. forces will be surely counted. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Department of Press and Information of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- The Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on March 9 issued the following press statement "U.S. random exercise of strength will result in aggravated security crisis":
The roaring sound of war machinery, full of hostility and mistrust, is being heard from the area over the southern border of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The U.S. is going to stage the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025, an aggressive and confrontational war rehearsal, in collusion with the ROK military gangsters to heat up the atmosphere of the cease-fire region.
Despite of the DPRK's repeated warning, the U.S. and the ROK are persistently staging the large-scale joint military exercises. This is a dangerous provocative act of leading the acute situation on the Korean peninsula, which may spark off a physical conflict between the two sides by means of an accidental single shot, to the extreme point.
What should not be overlooked is that the enemies are scheming to apply the "OPLAN 2022", aimed at a "preemptive attack" on the nuclear weapons facilities of the DPRK, in the current exercises under the "guidelines for nuclear deterrence and nuclear operations" cooked up and published in July 2024.
Such military hysteria of the U.S., which is surely going on irrespective of the policy ambiguity inevitably witnessed with the regime change, clearly proves the instinctive anti-DPRK practice of the U.S. engrossed in sanctions, pressure and confrontation, being seized by its inveterate hostility toward the DPRK.
Lurking behind the above-said war exercises, traditionally staged by the U.S. and the ROK, is the persistent and unchangeable aggression ambition of the U.S., which seeks to propagate the American-style view on value and the Yankee-style liberal democracy into the inviolable territory of a sovereign state and finally to overthrow the DPRK government and its social system, just seen through the operational name "Freedom Shield", and of the ROK following the U.S.
For its long history alone, the DPRK-U.S. political and military confrontation structure makes one intuitively understand the origin of deep-rooted conflict and the gravity of situation. The structure has been closer to the threshold of explosion due to the frantic U.S. war saber-rattling directly aiming at the DPRK, and its aspect of confrontation is developing into the more dangerous phase.
Then, should we regard various military drills staged by the U.S. at any time under such unctuous signboards as annual and defensive as a temerarious muscle-flexing of those frightened at the DPRK's strong defence capability growing in direct proportion to the U.S. nuclear threat or as a comfort means for pacifying its stooge at security unrest?
The U.S. and the ROK decided to sharply increase the number of field mobile drills by units of brigade-level and above than last year, simultaneously conduct the second-stage joint command and control drill of the U.S. Space Force present in the ROK aimed at verifying the capability of space operation assistance in the region in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula and employ the generative artificial intelligence on an experimental basis during the joint military exercises. All the facts go to clearly show the multi-domain and all-round offensive nature of Freedom Shield.
Obviously, the U.S. intends to push the situation in the Korean peninsula and the region to an uncontrollable phase by ceaselessly staging in a gradual and wavelike way Freedom Shield and other large-scale war drills and thus perpetuate the vicious cycle structure of provocation and tension.
It is seeking an anachronistic attempt to gain the advantage of strength in the Asia-Pacific region and realize the geopolitical realignment by expanding the military alliance with its stooges into a comprehensive strategic alliance under the pretext of "threats" from someone.
Under this confrontation and hegemony-oriented line of the U.S., strategic means including the nuclear submarine Alexandria, B-1B strategic bombers and the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson are constantly deployed in the Korean peninsula and reckless aerial espionages and all kinds of joint military exercises are being staged one after another. Such acts are increasing the legitimate security concerns of not only the DPRK but also regional countries.
In the wake of the said exercises, various anti-DPRK war drills including the one jointly sponsored by the U.S.-ROK Allied Command and the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the ROK are to be conducted more than 110 times, 9.7 percent more as compared with last year. This fact indicates that the military confrontation hysteria of enemy countries will continue as a chronic symptom, not as a single fit.
The increase in the visibility of deployment of U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula and the U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral war rehearsals reminding one of the actual war prove more evidently that the DPRK should be the most thoroughgoing and more overwhelming in deterring the enemies' various anti-DPRK nuclear war threats.
The U.S., which is overusing the toughest high-handed power politics in different parts of the world, has gradually stepped up the actual maneuvers in the Korean peninsula and the region, professing the "demonstration of alliance". They may help to calm down the alienation of its stooges, but it is necessary to mention that they will never act as "plus" to the promotion of security of the U.S. and its allies.
The reckless action and unreasonable choice of the U.S. seeking to "solemnly" play the first movement of a war symphony through the largest-ever military provocation this year will act as "minus" to the U.S. security.
The DPRK has already expressed its will to continue to exercise its strategic deterrence to cope with the U.S. continued demonstration of military strength.
The U.S. should be mindful that its habitual hostile policy toward the DPRK, openly denying the DPRK's legitimate existence and victorious advance, will only add justification to the principle of toughest anti-U.S. counteraction, declared by the DPRK, and face the undesirable consequences, escalated security threat.
The trite "succession" to the malicious anti-DPRK practice will inevitably lead to a serious strategic misjudgment. If the ability to judge it is lack, the prospect of the U.S. will be gloomy.
The DPRK will redouble its responsible efforts to keep lasting peace in the Korean peninsula and the region through the trustworthy strength accompanied by the radical growth of the nuclear force. -0-

After annexing Korea by force of arms in the last century, the Japanese imperialists committed unheard-of unethical crimes. Among the atrocities clearly recorded in the crime-woven history are the historical facts that the Japanese imperialists forcibly took away more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged Koreans and drove them out to the aggressive battle fields and toilsome worksites for bullet shields and labor slaves and made them undergo the wholesale deaths in the large-scale air raids by the U.S. forces.
Hundreds of B-29 large bombers of the U.S. forces flew into the sky over Tokyo and Osaka of Japan on March 10 and 13, 1945, the end of the Pacific War ignited by the Japanese imperialists, made massive air raids while dropping incendiaries and other bombs at random.
At that time the Japanese imperialists kept Koreans in custody in groups, claiming that Koreans who had been subjected to subhuman maltreatment and humiliation, dangerous and toilsome labor could escape in the confusion of air raids. As a result, many Koreans died an accidental death.
According to "Study of War Responsibilities" No.53, the organ of the Japanese Data Center for War Responsibilities, on the damage of Korean people in the large-scale air raids on Tokyo, the war victims are 41 300 and the death toll will far exceed 10 000.
Immediately after the large-scale air raids, the Japanese imperialists buried the Korean dead in 67 places of parks, temples and campuses, not investigating their identity, under the pretext of the "emperor's" junket to the area. Later, they committed such hideous unethical crimes as digging out the dead and dealing with the remains of Koreans at will.
The Korean victims did not returned to their native places where their beloved parents, wives and children were waiting for even after their death and became the fate of forlorn wandering spirits in alien lands. This miserable fate is entirely attributable to the Japanese imperialists' occupation of Korea and their colonial rule over it, and a direct product of the abduction of Koreans.
Nevertheless, the successive Japanese authorities have never paid attention to probing the unethical atrocities at that time and confirming the identity of the Korean victims without any slightest compunction, and have made desperate efforts to bury the forcible drafting in the oblivion of history.
Japan formulated it as a governmental stand that forcible drafting of Koreans should not be expressed with "forced labor". And it has issued the guidelines on noting the "forcible drafting" as "mobilization" and "labor draft" in history textbooks, rubbing salt into the unhealed wounds of the victims and bereaved families.
Japan should bear in mind that its moves to obliterate its past aggressive crimes and implant its distorted outlook on history into the younger generation, evading its state responsibility for the crimes against humanity, will only add to the debt of its crimes, remaining a shameless country bereft of human ethics and morality in the international community.
The forcible drafting and forcible labor of Koreans are crimes committed by the government and military of Imperial Japan with all authority involved, and they are the crime against important ethics and morality, slavery crime and war crime. The international conventional law and statute law on legal prescription stipulate that no prescription applies to the crimes related to basic human rights.
Japan, a war criminal state, should make a full investigation into the fact that the remains of Korean victims have been left for 80 years and open to the public the truth. At the same time Japan should make a thorough apology and reparation to the victims and their bereaved families for the thrice-cursed crimes of pushing innocent people into death.
It is the unshakable will of all the Korean people to certainly give vent to the deep-rooted grudge of the victims who lost their flowery youth and precious lives due to the forcible drafting by the Japanese imperialists and of their bereaved families.
The unethical atrocities committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people during the air raids on Tokyo and Osaka by the U.S. forces will be surely counted. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique Starts for Health Workers of Kangdong County Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- A passing-on technique began for health workers of the Kangdong County Hospital in the DPRK.
The Pyongyang Municipal People's Committee took a measure so that those health workers can get passing-on technique at the relevant specialized departments of such central-level hospitals as the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital, the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, the Okryu Children's Hospital, the Ryugyong Dental Hospital and the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital.
Officials of the municipal people's committee went to Kangdong County to hold consultations for the short course on foreign languages and the re-education of health workers while taking steps for the selection of teachers, teaching preparation and the provision of living conditions for those involved in the passing-on technique.
Meanwhile, they dispatched doctors of central-level hospitals to the county hospital to offer the technical guidance on the spot while treating the patients with field health workers.
They also selected members for the operation of medical equipment, IT and the supply and have organized the work to give them passing-on technique at the relevant hospitals.
The passing-on technique for the health workers of the Kangdong County Hospital is scheduled to be conducted several times according to stepwise plans. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Department of Press and Information of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- The Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on March 9 issued the following press statement "U.S. random exercise of strength will result in aggravated security crisis":
The roaring sound of war machinery, full of hostility and mistrust, is being heard from the area over the southern border of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The U.S. is going to stage the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025, an aggressive and confrontational war rehearsal, in collusion with the ROK military gangsters to heat up the atmosphere of the cease-fire region.
Despite of the DPRK's repeated warning, the U.S. and the ROK are persistently staging the large-scale joint military exercises. This is a dangerous provocative act of leading the acute situation on the Korean peninsula, which may spark off a physical conflict between the two sides by means of an accidental single shot, to the extreme point.
What should not be overlooked is that the enemies are scheming to apply the "OPLAN 2022", aimed at a "preemptive attack" on the nuclear weapons facilities of the DPRK, in the current exercises under the "guidelines for nuclear deterrence and nuclear operations" cooked up and published in July 2024.
Such military hysteria of the U.S., which is surely going on irrespective of the policy ambiguity inevitably witnessed with the regime change, clearly proves the instinctive anti-DPRK practice of the U.S. engrossed in sanctions, pressure and confrontation, being seized by its inveterate hostility toward the DPRK.
Lurking behind the above-said war exercises, traditionally staged by the U.S. and the ROK, is the persistent and unchangeable aggression ambition of the U.S., which seeks to propagate the American-style view on value and the Yankee-style liberal democracy into the inviolable territory of a sovereign state and finally to overthrow the DPRK government and its social system, just seen through the operational name "Freedom Shield", and of the ROK following the U.S.
For its long history alone, the DPRK-U.S. political and military confrontation structure makes one intuitively understand the origin of deep-rooted conflict and the gravity of situation. The structure has been closer to the threshold of explosion due to the frantic U.S. war saber-rattling directly aiming at the DPRK, and its aspect of confrontation is developing into the more dangerous phase.
Then, should we regard various military drills staged by the U.S. at any time under such unctuous signboards as annual and defensive as a temerarious muscle-flexing of those frightened at the DPRK's strong defence capability growing in direct proportion to the U.S. nuclear threat or as a comfort means for pacifying its stooge at security unrest?
The U.S. and the ROK decided to sharply increase the number of field mobile drills by units of brigade-level and above than last year, simultaneously conduct the second-stage joint command and control drill of the U.S. Space Force present in the ROK aimed at verifying the capability of space operation assistance in the region in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula and employ the generative artificial intelligence on an experimental basis during the joint military exercises. All the facts go to clearly show the multi-domain and all-round offensive nature of Freedom Shield.
Obviously, the U.S. intends to push the situation in the Korean peninsula and the region to an uncontrollable phase by ceaselessly staging in a gradual and wavelike way Freedom Shield and other large-scale war drills and thus perpetuate the vicious cycle structure of provocation and tension.
It is seeking an anachronistic attempt to gain the advantage of strength in the Asia-Pacific region and realize the geopolitical realignment by expanding the military alliance with its stooges into a comprehensive strategic alliance under the pretext of "threats" from someone.
Under this confrontation and hegemony-oriented line of the U.S., strategic means including the nuclear submarine Alexandria, B-1B strategic bombers and the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson are constantly deployed in the Korean peninsula and reckless aerial espionages and all kinds of joint military exercises are being staged one after another. Such acts are increasing the legitimate security concerns of not only the DPRK but also regional countries.
In the wake of the said exercises, various anti-DPRK war drills including the one jointly sponsored by the U.S.-ROK Allied Command and the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the ROK are to be conducted more than 110 times, 9.7 percent more as compared with last year. This fact indicates that the military confrontation hysteria of enemy countries will continue as a chronic symptom, not as a single fit.
The increase in the visibility of deployment of U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula and the U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral war rehearsals reminding one of the actual war prove more evidently that the DPRK should be the most thoroughgoing and more overwhelming in deterring the enemies' various anti-DPRK nuclear war threats.
The U.S., which is overusing the toughest high-handed power politics in different parts of the world, has gradually stepped up the actual maneuvers in the Korean peninsula and the region, professing the "demonstration of alliance". They may help to calm down the alienation of its stooges, but it is necessary to mention that they will never act as "plus" to the promotion of security of the U.S. and its allies.
The reckless action and unreasonable choice of the U.S. seeking to "solemnly" play the first movement of a war symphony through the largest-ever military provocation this year will act as "minus" to the U.S. security.
The DPRK has already expressed its will to continue to exercise its strategic deterrence to cope with the U.S. continued demonstration of military strength.
The U.S. should be mindful that its habitual hostile policy toward the DPRK, openly denying the DPRK's legitimate existence and victorious advance, will only add justification to the principle of toughest anti-U.S. counteraction, declared by the DPRK, and face the undesirable consequences, escalated security threat.
The trite "succession" to the malicious anti-DPRK practice will inevitably lead to a serious strategic misjudgment. If the ability to judge it is lack, the prospect of the U.S. will be gloomy.
The DPRK will redouble its responsible efforts to keep lasting peace in the Korean peninsula and the region through the trustworthy strength accompanied by the radical growth of the nuclear force. -0-

headline: KCNA Detailed Report on Great Vitality of Movement for Increased Production and Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency Sunday released a detailed report on the great vitality of the movement for increased production and economy, which promoted the birth of the Chollima era, and its proud history of succession and development.
The Chollima era shining as the annals of miracles was an era of upheaval, in which all the people made great leaps forward and innovations in every theatre of economic construction by waging a dynamic drive for increased production and economy, upholding the Workers' Party of Korea's ideas and leadership with one mind, the report says, adding:
Our people, who had successfully fulfilled the three-year national economic plan for postwar reconstruction, were faced with the difficult and enormous tasks for completing the basic socialist construction and carrying out the socialist industrialization as soon as possible under the Party’s line of building the independent economy.
At the Third Congress of the WPK in April 1956, PresidentKim Il Sungindicated the tasks and ways for the five-year national economic plan for the completing the basic socialist construction. At the December 1956 Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee, he put forward the militant slogan "Let's produce more, practise economy, and overfulfill the Five-Year Plan ahead of schedule!"
In hearty response to the patriotic appeal of the President, our working class turned out in a drive for increased production to carry out the five-year plan ahead of schedule by dynamically advancing in the spirit of Chollima.
Workers of the then Kangson Steel Plant took the lead in the drive for increased production, the Chollima movement, holding high the torch of great upsurge, bearing deep in mind the great trust and expectation of the President who visited them in the difficult post-war period.
With their warm loyalty and uprightness, they worked a miracle in the metallurgical sector by producing 120 000 tons of billets from the blooming mill with a capacity of 60 000 tons, true to the instructions of the President that the country would be relieved if it had 10 000 more tons of steel.
Amid the ever-growing enthusiasm of the Kangson workers to keep their pledge before the President without fail, members of the Jin Ung Won-led electric furnace workteam at a steel workshop of the plant held a meeting on March 8, 1959 to respond to the Party's call for making uninterrupted innovations and progress with the initiative of the Chollima workteam movement.
The flames of the Chollima movement, a drive for increased production kindled by the Kangson workers, rapidly spread over the whole country.
Every movement, which made a distinguished contribution to glorifying the Chollima era, was a strong manifestation of the unshakable will of our working class and all other people to carry out the Party's plan and intention without fail.
The mass movement, a drive for increased production which brought up ordinary people into heroes and reeducated stragglers into progressive elements and gave full play to their spiritual strength to make them dash ahead at the speed of Chollima, served as the great motive force for rapid progress and advance of the Chollima era and for the fulfillment of the First Five-year Plan.
The reserves for miraculous increased production in the Chollima era, which recorded the world-startling economic growth speed despite the difficult condition that the country was hard pressed for everything, were the economization spirit and trait pervading the whole country, the report says, and goes on:
Cherishing the Party's appeal "Let us all increase the production through economy!" deep in their mind, all the people had waged a dynamic drive for economy involving all the masses, firmly convinced that they are masters of the country and workplaces, and thus laid a solid foundation for increased production.
All sectors and units of the national economy found ways for economization in innovating science and technology and giving fullest play to the masses' patriotism. And they mobilized all their technical force and economic potentials and, at the same time, developed the economization drive into a patriotic movement to make a breakthrough in implementing the Five-Year Plan.
The prefabricated construction method, introduced first in the construction of the capital city as instructed by PresidentKim Il Sung, was a construction revolution that made it possible to successfully realize the Party's grand construction plan by saving manpower, materials and funds in the construction field while shortening the period of construction project.
The capital city builders, who turned out in a drive to make innovations in construction with the prefabricated construction method, true to the spirit of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee held in October 1957, introduced this method in an overall way to put the production of building parts and elements on an industrial basis. They raised the construction speed by 7.3 times while saving the labor force much more than before and thus created the Pyongyang Speed, to be specially recorded in the construction history, by building the houses for more than 20 000 families with the materials and funds planned for 7 000 households while assembling one flat in only 14 minutes.
The prefabricated construction based on large building parts and elements gained momentum in regional cities, evidently proving the validity of the Party's policies.
Thanks to the diverse struggle for economy waged as an all-people movement in all sectors and units, huge material wealth and reserves like the building of tens of factories, power stations and coal mines were provided in the period of the Five-Year Plan.  As a result, all the economic targets, regarded it as impossible to hit, were attained at a stroke.
In the flames of the great Chollima upswing, the First Five-Year National Economic Plan was carried out in two and a half years as the total industrial output value and in four years as the indices of items in kind. Since 1957 the industrial production had grown at a high rate of 19.1 percent on an average every year.
As a result of the intensified struggle for increased production and economy, the strategic tasks for the First Five-Year Plan set forth by the Third Congress of the WPK were completed ahead of schedule in the shortest period and our people could greet the Fourth Congress of the WPK with the pride of being victors.
The revolutionary spirit and working trait of the heroic generation, who created the miracles of Chollima and the spirit of the times on the debris through an all-people struggle for increased production and economy true to the call of the leader, have been steadily carried forward as the ideological and moral qualities and creative mettle peculiar to the Korean people building a socialist paradise on this land, the report says, and continues:
The Korean people, who completed the socialist industrialization in a matter of 14 years by dashing ahead in the spirit of Chollima, had steadily raised the flames of such great innovation movements as the movements for creating the speed of the 70-day campaign and the speed of the 1980s, decade after decade to victoriously surmount the arduous march and forced march and proudly embark on the road of advance in the new century. They are giving fuller play to the potentiality and the spirit of the DPRK and the steadfastness of the Korean revolution in the new era of the Juche revolution, true to the great Party Central Committee's outstanding idea on building a powerful country and its leadership.
With the firm faith that all victories and glory lie in remaining loyal to the great ComradeKim Jong Unonly with a single mind and the confidence in successful realization of their cause and ideals, all the people in the country proudly have brought a new era of comprehensive rejuvenation, the annals of great changes and miracles in all spheres of the state development, unprecedented in the nation-building history and in the history of humankind, while braving myriads of challenges and difficulties with their indefatigable struggle and efforts.
Thanks to the noble idea of the Party Central Committee that the eternal prosperity of regions means the eternal rosy future of our state and Korean-style socialism, a great revolution has been made to implement the programme for the rural revolution in the new era and the regional development policy, thus opening up a broad avenue for accomplishing the unprecedented great cause of advancing toward the comprehensive development of socialist construction with the eye-opening entities of rural development and regional transformation emerging one after another in different parts of the country.
In the flames of creating the Chollima spirit in the new era kindled byKim Jong Un, with his firm belief in the inexhaustible pioneering spirit, loyalty and patriotism of the great Korean people trusting and following the Party only, to give the fullest play to their mental power, all the people are more vigorously waging the drive for increased production and economy and further accelerating the speed of general advance to successfully complete the Five-Year Plan set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Party and proudly enter the venue of its Ninth Congress.
In the course of the struggle to accomplish the historic cause of courageously ushering in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation while upholding the leadership of the Party Central Committee with a single mind and loyalty, the Korean people will ceaselessly open up the annals of miracles ,beyond the world people's imagination, in building a socialist power while further augmenting the strength of the great tradition of struggle inherited from generation to generation and century after century and the spirit of devoted struggle and patriotic enthusiasm. -0-

They raised the construction speed by 7.3 times while saving the labor force much more than before and thus created the Pyongyang Speed, to be specially recorded in the construction history, by building the houses for more than 20 000 families with the materials and funds planned for 7 000 households while assembling one flat in only 14 minutes.
The prefabricated construction based on large building parts and elements gained momentum in regional cities, evidently proving the validity of the Party's policies.
Thanks to the diverse struggle for economy waged as an all-people movement in all sectors and units, huge material wealth and reserves like the building of tens of factories, power stations and coal mines were provided in the period of the Five-Year Plan.  As a result, all the economic targets, regarded it as impossible to hit, were attained at a stroke.
In the flames of the great Chollima upswing, the First Five-Year National Economic Plan was carried out in two and a half years as the total industrial output value and in four years as the indices of items in kind. Since 1957 the industrial production had grown at a high rate of 19.1 percent on an average every year.
As a result of the intensified struggle for increased production and economy, the strategic tasks for the First Five-Year Plan set forth by the Third Congress of the WPK were completed ahead of schedule in the shortest period and our people could greet the Fourth Congress of the WPK with the pride of being victors.
The revolutionary spirit and working trait of the heroic generation, who created the miracles of Chollima and the spirit of the times on the debris through an all-people struggle for increased production and economy true to the call of the leader, have been steadily carried forward as the ideological and moral qualities and creative mettle peculiar to the Korean people building a socialist paradise on this land, the report says, and continues:
The Korean people, who completed the socialist industrialization in a matter of 14 years by dashing ahead in the spirit of Chollima, had steadily raised the flames of such great innovation movements as the movements for creating the speed of the 70-day campaign and the speed of the 1980s, decade after decade to victoriously surmount the arduous march and forced march and proudly embark on the road of advance in the new century. They are giving fuller play to the potentiality and the spirit of the DPRK and the steadfastness of the Korean revolution in the new era of the Juche revolution, true to the great Party Central Committee's outstanding idea on building a powerful country and its leadership.
With the firm faith that all victories and glory lie in remaining loyal to the great ComradeKim Jong Unonly with a single mind and the confidence in successful realization of their cause and ideals, all the people in the country proudly have brought a new era of comprehensive rejuvenation, the annals of great changes and miracles in all spheres of the state development, unprecedented in the nation-building history and in the history of humankind, while braving myriads of challenges and difficulties with their indefatigable struggle and efforts.
Thanks to the noble idea of the Party Central Committee that the eternal prosperity of regions means the eternal rosy future of our state and Korean-style socialism, a great revolution has been made to implement the programme for the rural revolution in the new era and the regional development policy, thus opening up a broad avenue for accomplishing the unprecedented great cause of advancing toward the comprehensive development of socialist construction with the eye-opening entities of rural development and regional transformation emerging one after another in different parts of the country.

headline: Paektusan Institute of Architecture
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- Many creations representing the rapid development of Juche-oriented architecture have appeared in the DPRK where a new era of the people-first architecture was ushered in.
Each monumental edifice is associated with the painstaking efforts of designers, architects and researchers of the Paektusan Institute of Architecture that has grown into a prestigious research group for architectural creation and led the architectural development of the country.
One day in March 2017, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the institute and noted that its designers, architects and researchers had created lots of architectural masterpieces of national treasure on the highest level over the past years. And he said that the institute is a competent and reliable design group and a model and standard of the architectural design units in the country.
That day he set forth important tasks to be regarded as guidelines in the work of the institute, saying that its duty is very important.
Keeping deep in their mind the instructions ofKim Jong Un, the designers, architects and researchers of the institute have devoted their wisdom and enthusiasm to creating new architectural styles reflecting socialist civilization and the people's ideals and dreams in their designs.
The Sci-Tech Complex, the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, the Songdowon International Children's Camp, modern apartment houses built in different parts of the capital city, and orphanages, baby homes, primary and secondary schools for orphans across the country are an outcome of the creative thinking and enthusiasm of officials, designers, architects and researchers of the institute.
The institute presented books on architectural technology, articles on architectural science and theory and national design standards and pushed ahead with the work to put the architectural designing on a modern and scientific basis. And it has introduced the research findings into reality to contribute to the development of the country's architectural science. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique Starts for Health Workers of Kangdong County Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- A passing-on technique began for health workers of the Kangdong County Hospital in the DPRK.
The Pyongyang Municipal People's Committee took a measure so that those health workers can get passing-on technique at the relevant specialized departments of such central-level hospitals as the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital, the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, the Okryu Children's Hospital, the Ryugyong Dental Hospital and the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital.
Officials of the municipal people's committee went to Kangdong County to hold consultations for the short course on foreign languages and the re-education of health workers while taking steps for the selection of teachers, teaching preparation and the provision of living conditions for those involved in the passing-on technique.
Meanwhile, they dispatched doctors of central-level hospitals to the county hospital to offer the technical guidance on the spot while treating the patients with field health workers.
They also selected members for the operation of medical equipment, IT and the supply and have organized the work to give them passing-on technique at the relevant hospitals.
The passing-on technique for the health workers of the Kangdong County Hospital is scheduled to be conducted several times according to stepwise plans. -0-

Press Statement by Department of Press and Information of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- The Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on March 9 issued the following press statement "U.S. random exercise of strength will result in aggravated security crisis":
The roaring sound of war machinery, full of hostility and mistrust, is being heard from the area over the southern border of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The U.S. is going to stage the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025, an aggressive and confrontational war rehearsal, in collusion with the ROK military gangsters to heat up the atmosphere of the cease-fire region.
Despite of the DPRK's repeated warning, the U.S. and the ROK are persistently staging the large-scale joint military exercises. This is a dangerous provocative act of leading the acute situation on the Korean peninsula, which may spark off a physical conflict between the two sides by means of an accidental single shot, to the extreme point.
What should not be overlooked is that the enemies are scheming to apply the "OPLAN 2022", aimed at a "preemptive attack" on the nuclear weapons facilities of the DPRK, in the current exercises under the "guidelines for nuclear deterrence and nuclear operations" cooked up and published in July 2024.
Such military hysteria of the U.S., which is surely going on irrespective of the policy ambiguity inevitably witnessed with the regime change, clearly proves the instinctive anti-DPRK practice of the U.S. engrossed in sanctions, pressure and confrontation, being seized by its inveterate hostility toward the DPRK.
Lurking behind the above-said war exercises, traditionally staged by the U.S. and the ROK, is the persistent and unchangeable aggression ambition of the U.S., which seeks to propagate the American-style view on value and the Yankee-style liberal democracy into the inviolable territory of a sovereign state and finally to overthrow the DPRK government and its social system, just seen through the operational name "Freedom Shield", and of the ROK following the U.S.
For its long history alone, the DPRK-U.S. political and military confrontation structure makes one intuitively understand the origin of deep-rooted conflict and the gravity of situation. The structure has been closer to the threshold of explosion due to the frantic U.S. war saber-rattling directly aiming at the DPRK, and its aspect of confrontation is developing into the more dangerous phase.
Then, should we regard various military drills staged by the U.S. at any time under such unctuous signboards as annual and defensive as a temerarious muscle-flexing of those frightened at the DPRK's strong defence capability growing in direct proportion to the U.S. nuclear threat or as a comfort means for pacifying its stooge at security unrest?
The U.S. and the ROK decided to sharply increase the number of field mobile drills by units of brigade-level and above than last year, simultaneously conduct the second-stage joint command and control drill of the U.S. Space Force present in the ROK aimed at verifying the capability of space operation assistance in the region in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula and employ the generative artificial intelligence on an experimental basis during the joint military exercises. All the facts go to clearly show the multi-domain and all-round offensive nature of Freedom Shield.
Obviously, the U.S. intends to push the situation in the Korean peninsula and the region to an uncontrollable phase by ceaselessly staging in a gradual and wavelike way Freedom Shield and other large-scale war drills and thus perpetuate the vicious cycle structure of provocation and tension.
It is seeking an anachronistic attempt to gain the advantage of strength in the Asia-Pacific region and realize the geopolitical realignment by expanding the military alliance with its stooges into a comprehensive strategic alliance under the pretext of "threats" from someone.
Under this confrontation and hegemony-oriented line of the U.S., strategic means including the nuclear submarine Alexandria, B-1B strategic bombers and the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson are constantly deployed in the Korean peninsula and reckless aerial espionages and all kinds of joint military exercises are being staged one after another. Such acts are increasing the legitimate security concerns of not only the DPRK but also regional countries.
In the wake of the said exercises, various anti-DPRK war drills including the one jointly sponsored by the U.S.-ROK Allied Command and the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the ROK are to be conducted more than 110 times, 9.7 percent more as compared with last year. This fact indicates that the military confrontation hysteria of enemy countries will continue as a chronic symptom, not as a single fit.
The increase in the visibility of deployment of U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula and the U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral war rehearsals reminding one of the actual war prove more evidently that the DPRK should be the most thoroughgoing and more overwhelming in deterring the enemies' various anti-DPRK nuclear war threats.
The U.S., which is overusing the toughest high-handed power politics in different parts of the world, has gradually stepped up the actual maneuvers in the Korean peninsula and the region, professing the "demonstration of alliance". They may help to calm down the alienation of its stooges, but it is necessary to mention that they will never act as "plus" to the promotion of security of the U.S. and its allies.
The reckless action and unreasonable choice of the U.S. seeking to "solemnly" play the first movement of a war symphony through the largest-ever military provocation this year will act as "minus" to the U.S. security.
The DPRK has already expressed its will to continue to exercise its strategic deterrence to cope with the U.S. continued demonstration of military strength.
The U.S. should be mindful that its habitual hostile policy toward the DPRK, openly denying the DPRK's legitimate existence and victorious advance, will only add justification to the principle of toughest anti-U.S. counteraction, declared by the DPRK, and face the undesirable consequences, escalated security threat.
The trite "succession" to the malicious anti-DPRK practice will inevitably lead to a serious strategic misjudgment. If the ability to judge it is lack, the prospect of the U.S. will be gloomy.
The DPRK will redouble its responsible efforts to keep lasting peace in the Korean peninsula and the region through the trustworthy strength accompanied by the radical growth of the nuclear force. -0-

headline: Many Senior Middle School Graduates in Pyongyang Volunteer to Join KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- Graduates of senior middle schools in Pyongyang met before the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on March 9 to express their determination to join the Korean People's Army.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
Speakers said that they volunteered to join the KPA though they grew up with nothing to envy in the world under the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea and had many places to go with great hope.
They expressed their determination to firmly defend the security of the motherland and wellbeing of the people with arms of revolution and thus glorify every moment of their service with loyalty and feats.
Kim Hyong Won, a war veteran, handed over the national flag of the DPRK to the rising generation.
Then, there began a contest of singing wartime songs in chorus while marching by graduates of senior middle schools in Pyongyang.
Those successors passed along streets, singing in chorus the songs for defending the leader and the country with such watchwords as "Human bullets and bombs" and "Death-defying defence" held in their hands. Their stamina instilled into the citizens the conviction that the victory of the DPRK is inevitable and sure as there is the younger generation. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson of the Association of Korean Victims of Forcible Drafting and Their Bereaved Families issued the following press statement titled "Japanese imperialists' unethical atrocities against Korean people will be surely counted" on March 9:
Nearly 80 years have passed since Korea was liberated from the barbarous colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists. But the bloody shouts of the souls of the people who were taken to alien lands by the Japanese imperialists' abduction and died rancorous are still resounding vigorously.
After annexing Korea by force of arms in the last century, the Japanese imperialists committed unheard-of unethical crimes. Among the atrocities clearly recorded in the crime-woven history are the historical facts that the Japanese imperialists forcibly took away more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged Koreans and drove them out to the aggressive battle fields and toilsome worksites for bullet shields and labor slaves and made them undergo the wholesale deaths in the large-scale air raids by the U.S. forces.
Hundreds of B-29 large bombers of the U.S. forces flew into the sky over Tokyo and Osaka of Japan on March 10 and 13, 1945, the end of the Pacific War ignited by the Japanese imperialists, made massive air raids while dropping incendiaries and other bombs at random.
At that time the Japanese imperialists kept Koreans in custody in groups, claiming that Koreans who had been subjected to subhuman maltreatment and humiliation, dangerous and toilsome labor could escape in the confusion of air raids. As a result, many Koreans died an accidental death.
According to "Study of War Responsibilities" No.53, the organ of the Japanese Data Center for War Responsibilities, on the damage of Korean people in the large-scale air raids on Tokyo, the war victims are 41 300 and the death toll will far exceed 10 000.
Immediately after the large-scale air raids, the Japanese imperialists buried the Korean dead in 67 places of parks, temples and campuses, not investigating their identity, under the pretext of the "emperor's" junket to the area. Later, they committed such hideous unethical crimes as digging out the dead and dealing with the remains of Koreans at will.
The Korean victims did not returned to their native places where their beloved parents, wives and children were waiting for even after their death and became the fate of forlorn wandering spirits in alien lands. This miserable fate is entirely attributable to the Japanese imperialists' occupation of Korea and their colonial rule over it, and a direct product of the abduction of Koreans.
Nevertheless, the successive Japanese authorities have never paid attention to probing the unethical atrocities at that time and confirming the identity of the Korean victims without any slightest compunction, and have made desperate efforts to bury the forcible drafting in the oblivion of history.
Japan formulated it as a governmental stand that forcible drafting of Koreans should not be expressed with "forced labor". And it has issued the guidelines on noting the "forcible drafting" as "mobilization" and "labor draft" in history textbooks, rubbing salt into the unhealed wounds of the victims and bereaved families.
Japan should bear in mind that its moves to obliterate its past aggressive crimes and implant its distorted outlook on history into the younger generation, evading its state responsibility for the crimes against humanity, will only add to the debt of its crimes, remaining a shameless country bereft of human ethics and morality in the international community.
The forcible drafting and forcible labor of Koreans are crimes committed by the government and military of Imperial Japan with all authority involved, and they are the crime against important ethics and morality, slavery crime and war crime. The international conventional law and statute law on legal prescription stipulate that no prescription applies to the crimes related to basic human rights.
Japan, a war criminal state, should make a full investigation into the fact that the remains of Korean victims have been left for 80 years and open to the public the truth. At the same time Japan should make a thorough apology and reparation to the victims and their bereaved families for the thrice-cursed crimes of pushing innocent people into death.
It is the unshakable will of all the Korean people to certainly give vent to the deep-rooted grudge of the victims who lost their flowery youth and precious lives due to the forcible drafting by the Japanese imperialists and of their bereaved families.
The unethical atrocities committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people during the air raids on Tokyo and Osaka by the U.S. forces will be surely counted. -0-

headline: Motivation Campaign Brisk at Chollima Steel Complex of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- A motivation campaign for increased production is getting brisk at the Chollima Steel Complex in the DPRK.
The Chollima District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea has intensively displayed slogans, watchwords and visual information aids arousing the masses to the implementation of the Party's policies in the compound of the complex and at workplaces and intensified the organizational and political work to conduct frontline-style information and motivation offensive.
Such information and motivation activities as explanation, agitprop in the morning rush hour and artistic motivation are being conducted in various forms and ways to implant the Party's leadership exploits in officials and workers.

Primary officials of the district building repair station, the district commercial agency and other units have done good things helpful to normal production while conducting the field political work at the gas producing shop and the rolling shop.
Members of the mobile artistic motivation team of the complex and those of mobile art motivation team of the women's union have staged their motivation campaign to boost the morale of workers devoting their patriotic sweat to the increased iron and steel production.
Officials of the youth league organizations at all levels in the district displayed tens of visual information aids at production sites, calling upon all the workers to carry forward the baton of loyalty and patriotism of the preceding generation. -0-

headline: Construction of Ragwon County Offshore Farm Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- The construction of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm is progressing apace in the DPRK.
Officials of the non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy have meticulously organized the construction project. The relevant sections are giving precedence to the supply of equipment and materials needed for the construction while hastening the design related to it.
Soldier-builders finished the land leveling of the construction site for the farm and the residential quarters in fishing village as well as the expansion of work road. And they have turned out a large amount of aggregate every day at quarries near the construction site.
South Hamgyong Province formed a field command team for the construction of the offshore farm and is carrying on the work to step up the construction project with the command force, design force and construction force.
Working people in different units of the province are speeding up the landscaping of hillocks around the construction site and the production of burying anchors. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of various sectors.
Going round 10 000 flats at the third-stage in the Hwasong area near their completion, the premier said it is necessary to perfect the construction of all structures, including connected service building which will be an icon structure of the third-stage project, without any slight defect on the highest quality level and make a thorough preparation for their inauguration and, in particular, officials of the construction supervisory institution should fulfill their responsibility and duty.
At the construction site for building 10 000 flats at the fourth-stage in the Hwasong area, he encouraged officials and builders to make another brilliant miracle and innovation in the fresh struggle for putting the capital city construction on a higher stage with redoubled self-confidence and exertion, deeply cherishing the significant speech made by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the groundbreaking ceremony for the fourth-stage project.
He called for thoroughly observing the overall schedule for the project at the stage of foundation work by scrupulously organizing and guiding the construction work, arranging manpower and supplying materials according to a well thought-out plan and further increasing the operation rate of construction equipment given the fact that the scale and volume of construction are expanded owing to additional objects.
Visiting the Phyongsong Lighting Goods Factory under construction, the premier stressed the need to carry on the building work and the manufacture and installation of equipment and facilities with great efforts on the principle of thoroughly applying economic efficiency and advanced technology so that the factory will be able to perform its mission and role as a model necessities production base, and simultaneously push ahead in an effective way with the preparations for its operation including the training of skilled workers and the supply of raw materials.
Learning about the operation of the medium test sites of the Heat Engineering Institute and the Ferrous Metal Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, he called upon scientists and researchers to bring about a clear fruition in developing the core technology and ultra-modern technology of Korean style conducive to strengthening the independence of economy and intensify the work for identifying technical indices for industrialization so that the successes in technical development can be introduced into reality as soon as possible.
The field consultative meetings discussed an issue for realizing the landscaping of residential quarters in the Hwasong area and their surroundings on a high level and  stepping up the land leveling, an issue for the relevant units to ensure the timely supply and transport of building materials, an issue for providing researchers with sufficient conditions necessary for their scientific research activities and an issue for directing the state efforts to the work for sprucing up the medium test sites. -0-

headline: Successes Made at Light Industrial Factories in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- The number of persons who fulfilled their national economic plans is increasing at light industrial factories in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, seething with a dynamic increased production and creation drive for the improvement of the people's standard of living.
Workers who have completed their first half-yearly plans were produced first at the spinning combined shop of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill. Amid the successive innovations made at the chemical fibre spinning combined shop, the spinning combined shop, the silk-spinning combined shop and other workshops, the mill has produced up to now more than 30 persons who completed the first half-yearly plan and 400 persons who carried out the first quarterly production plan.
More than 20 workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill have taken the lead in the all-people general onward march to glorify this year with labor achievements.
Workers of the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory have made big efforts to turn out more various kinds of quality products favored by the people, thus demonstrating the honor of innovators. Those of the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory and the Ryuwon Footwear Factory developed tens of kinds of new products to contribute to improving the people's standard of living.
Among the innovators who have fulfilled their national economic plans are also workers of the Pyongyang Children's Knitted Goods Factory, the Aeguk Knitwear Factory and other units who are devoting their wisdom and passion to fulfilling the school uniform production plan. -0-

headline: Modernization Project Accelerated in Farm Machine Production Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- A modernization project is accelerated in the farm machine production sector of the DPRK.
The builders involved in a project for remodeling the Farm Machine Institute under the Agricultural Commission have introduced various working methods according to the characteristics of objects to raise both the quality and the speed of the project.
Those involved in a project for remodeling the Hamhung Trailing Farm Machine Factory and the Haeju Farm Machine Factory are meeting the requirements of technical regulations in every process.
Renovation project has already been finished at the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory, the Namsi Livestock Machine Factory and the Kangso Sprayer Factory. They are now stepping up the work to normalize the operation of equipment and immediately start the production.
Those units in charge of provision of machines and equipment necessary for the modernization of farm machine production units, too, are striving to supply high-performance and quality machines and equipment. -0-

headline: More Senior Middle School Graduates in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:

headline: For Convenience of People
story_text:
One day in February 2005, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited a newly-remodeled theatre.
Looking round the atrium with satisfaction, he was heading for the stairs. Then he stopped with his eyes directed to the floor and stairs.
After a while, he told officials in an anxious voice that new visitors to the theatre or the elderly may slip on the stairs since the color of the floor and stairs are same and even the copper strips stuck at the ends of stairs are similar with floor in color.
And he warmly advised them to attach the dark brown glasses to the inside of the copper strip at the top of the stairs so that the floor and stairs could be distinguished.
The officials were seized with remorse at the moment.
It was the Chairman's standard of evaluation over the creation of lasting value that a priority should be given to the people's liking and convenience before attaching importance to the magnificence, splendor, economic effectiveness and aesthetic taste of the times of architectural structures. -0-

High Appreciation
story_text:
One day in June 2016, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill.
He went round various places of the mill and dropped in at a newly-built production site.
Taking in modern equipment there at a glance, he asked with a tone of joy and surprise if it is really home-made.
Officials said with pride that the equipment was something hard to venture in the past, but it was manufactured by ourselves with the spirit of self-reliance and self-development implanted by the General Secretary.
The mill set a high goal to unconditionally build the latest production lines conducive to improving the people's living standards in reliance on our own efforts, technology and resources and successfully established modern production lines in  touch with scientists, technicians and workers in relevant fields.
The General Secretary opened the protective windows to look at the inside and outside of equipment and then personally called a university researcher, who contributed to its manufacture, and warmly grasped his hand.
Praising the researcher repeatedly, he said with pleasure that the manufacture of such modern equipment was a great success.
Upon receiving the high appreciation ofKim Jong Un, the officials came to realize the true meaning that only when the self-development capability is steadily enhanced in reliance on science and technology, is it possible to bring about a surge and a leap forward in production. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- More than 250 women in Jagang Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at posts of socialist construction.
A large number of women's union primary officials and members in Janggang and Rangrim counties vowed to advance into theaters for implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's regional development policy.
Housewives in Jonchon County volunteered to work at new worksites with the firm determination to glorify their honor as socialist workers.
Women's union members in Huichon City and Junggang, Tongsin, Hwaphyong and other counties volunteered to work at factories and farms.
Meetings to congratulate the volunteers took place in relevant city and counties.
Congratulatory performances were given at the end of the meetings, and officials and  women's union members saw the volunteers off. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Construction of Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- Service personnel of the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army, dispatched to the different parts of the DPRK, are expanding the success in the foundation excavation for the construction of regional-industry factories.
The soldier-builders in Kangdong County completed the foundation excavation for a leisure complex by introducing advanced construction methods and using machines. And they are registering high results in the foundation excavation for regional-industry factories every day.
Those in Hwangju County made a large number of formworks and paved roads for the rapid transport of materials to shorten the construction period. On this basis, they are making progress in the foundation excavation.
Those in Paechon County have made preparations for foundation concreting for objects to be built in a fresh way suited to the regional geological conditions, while removing a huge amount of earth by raising the utilization rate of construction equipment.
The 124th regiments dispatched to Puryong, Taegwan and Kilju counties and other regions, too, have introduced rational working methods to speed up the construction project on the basis of survey of regional geological conditions. -0-

headline: Many Trees Planted in New Rural Villages of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- The appearance of new rural villages in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, has been renewed again.
Officials and working people in different districts and counties planted more than 10 000 trees of good species and ornamental value in those rural villages.
The Pyongyang municipal headquarters for rural construction has carried on the operation and guidance with the main emphasis on landscaping the whole residential quarters in combination of trees and turf.
And it selected garden trees and turf and directed efforts to introducing advanced greening technology in  cooperation with technical groups of relevant units.
Officials and working people in Sunan District set an example in tree planting, and Rangnang and Samsok districts finished tree planting on a high level of quality.
Ryokpho, Mangyongdae and other districts, too, took measures to raise the survival rate of planted trees, while planting trees in consideration of the biological characteristics of species and regional climatic and soil conditions. -0-

headline: Evil Presage of Dangerous U.S.-ROK Joint Military Exercises: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, there occurred an accident showing why the U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral joint military drills, staged frantically in the Korean peninsula, are so dangerous and why they deserve the denunciation by the world people.
With the full-scale operation of the worst-ever joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 near at hand, there took place a record case of "simultaneous accidental attacks", in which two fighters of the puppet ROK army hell-bent in "firepower demonstration" air-raided a civilian village during a large-scale U.S.-ROK live shell firing drill as prelude to the exercises.
It was reported that the intensive dropping of eight bombs, due to the pilots' mistakes in inputting coordinates, caused tens of civilian and military casualties and such property damage as the destruction of private houses and vehicles.
Such accidental firing case is a common practice for the U.S. forces and the ROK army, but what merits an attention is the fact that the case occurred near the southern border of the DPRK on the eve of the large-scale joint military exercises simulating a total war against the DPRK.
As reported by the New York Times and other U.S. and puppet ROK media, there is no need to explain how the situation would have developed if a bomb had been dropped towards the north a little further to cross the border of the DPRK.
The DPRK armed forces are now keeping highly alert to cope with the malicious large-scale joint military exercises of the U.S. and the ROK in the cease-fire area where the Korean War between the DPRK and the U.S. exists in the present continuous form, the most dangerous area in the world in which nuclear forces are standing in confrontation with one another. Under such situation, it is not unreasonable to imagine that an accidental spark might plunge the Korean peninsula and the region and the rest of the world into a new armed conflict.
The recent case is no more than an example showing that various kinds of war rehearsals precisely aiming at the DPRK, frequently staged by the U.S. and its vassal forces, are not for "peace and stability of the ROK and the region" as advocated by them, but are the most dangerous and undesirable doings germinating a touch-and-go situation, the world's first nuclear war.
Frightened at the danger of such horrible situation, the U.S. and the ROK have now turned Freedom Shield 2025 into a kind of "dumb exercises" prohibiting any live firing. However, they can neither conceal nor quell the danger and gravity of the exercises amplified at home and abroad.
Unless the enemy states including the U.S. and the puppet ROK military gangsters stop their frantic war games in the Korean peninsula, a threat to peace and security environment of the DPRK and the region will last forever.
The DPRK is keeping a close watch on every reckless military movement of the enemies to cope with any unexpected developments and, if necessary, will go over into a merciless action without warning.
Then, they will have no time enough to excuse themselves.
The enemies should seriously approach to the evil presage of the dangerous U.S.-ROK joint military exercises and stop at once the nuclear war rehearsals, the root cause of aggravated situation in the Korean peninsula, rather than breathing a sigh of relief. -0-

headline: Many Trees Planted in New Rural Villages of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- The appearance of new rural villages in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, has been renewed again.
Officials and working people in different districts and counties planted more than 10 000 trees of good species and ornamental value in those rural villages.
The Pyongyang municipal headquarters for rural construction has carried on the operation and guidance with the main emphasis on landscaping the whole residential quarters in combination of trees and turf.
And it selected garden trees and turf and directed efforts to introducing advanced greening technology in  cooperation with technical groups of relevant units.
Officials and working people in Sunan District set an example in tree planting, and Rangnang and Samsok districts finished tree planting on a high level of quality.
Ryokpho, Mangyongdae and other districts, too, took measures to raise the survival rate of planted trees, while planting trees in consideration of the biological characteristics of species and regional climatic and soil conditions. -0-

headline: Campaign for Training Technicians and Skilled Worker Intensified in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- The work is progressing apace in the DPRK to increase the ranks of technical and skilled personnel well versed in their factories, jobs and machines.
South Phyongan Province has taken practical steps to improve the qualifications of technicians and skilled workers in a short span of time.
South Hamgyong Province concentrates efforts on training the talents able to compete with any technical group at light industrial factories in the capital city.
Kaesong Municipality makes sure that the employees of the regional industry factories, to be built in Kaephung District, master various kinds of equipment more quickly through the process of operating equipment at light industrial factories in the municipality.
North Phyongan, Jagang and other provinces worked out detailed plans and methodologies for training technicians and skilled workers and are striving to carry them into practice. -0-
