headline: Evil Presage of Dangerous U.S.-ROK Joint Military Exercises: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, there occurred an accident showing why the U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral joint military drills, staged frantically in the Korean peninsula, are so dangerous and why they deserve the denunciation by the world people.
With the full-scale operation of the worst-ever joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 near at hand, there took place a record case of "simultaneous accidental attacks", in which two fighters of the puppet ROK army hell-bent in "firepower demonstration" air-raided a civilian village during a large-scale U.S.-ROK live shell firing drill as prelude to the exercises.
It was reported that the intensive dropping of eight bombs, due to the pilots' mistakes in inputting coordinates, caused tens of civilian and military casualties and such property damage as the destruction of private houses and vehicles.
Such accidental firing case is a common practice for the U.S. forces and the ROK army, but what merits an attention is the fact that the case occurred near the southern border of the DPRK on the eve of the large-scale joint military exercises simulating a total war against the DPRK.
As reported by the New York Times and other U.S. and puppet ROK media, there is no need to explain how the situation would have developed if a bomb had been dropped towards the north a little further to cross the border of the DPRK.
The DPRK armed forces are now keeping highly alert to cope with the malicious large-scale joint military exercises of the U.S. and the ROK in the cease-fire area where the Korean War between the DPRK and the U.S. exists in the present continuous form, the most dangerous area in the world in which nuclear forces are standing in confrontation with one another. Under such situation, it is not unreasonable to imagine that an accidental spark might plunge the Korean peninsula and the region and the rest of the world into a new armed conflict.
The recent case is no more than an example showing that various kinds of war rehearsals precisely aiming at the DPRK, frequently staged by the U.S. and its vassal forces, are not for "peace and stability of the ROK and the region" as advocated by them, but are the most dangerous and undesirable doings germinating a touch-and-go situation, the world's first nuclear war.
Frightened at the danger of such horrible situation, the U.S. and the ROK have now turned Freedom Shield 2025 into a kind of "dumb exercises" prohibiting any live firing. However, they can neither conceal nor quell the danger and gravity of the exercises amplified at home and abroad.
Unless the enemy states including the U.S. and the puppet ROK military gangsters stop their frantic war games in the Korean peninsula, a threat to peace and security environment of the DPRK and the region will last forever.
The DPRK is keeping a close watch on every reckless military movement of the enemies to cope with any unexpected developments and, if necessary, will go over into a merciless action without warning.
Then, they will have no time enough to excuse themselves.
The enemies should seriously approach to the evil presage of the dangerous U.S.-ROK joint military exercises and stop at once the nuclear war rehearsals, the root cause of aggravated situation in the Korean peninsula, rather than breathing a sigh of relief. -0-

headline: More Senior Middle School Graduates in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK are inflamed with anger and hostility towards the U.S. imperialists and the puppet group of the ROK getting hell-bent on the joint military exercises unprecedented in their aggressive nature and scale to provoke another war while seeking to check the stable development of the DPRK and extremely aggravate the political and military situation in the Korean peninsula.
Under such situation, more than 500 graduates of senior middle schools in South Hamgyong Province have volunteered for military service at forefront border posts.
Many graduate students volunteered to join the Korean People's Army, in response to the call of the Children's Union instructor at Yonggo Senior Middle School in Sinhung County who decided to take arms to defend the country and the revolution.
Graduates of senior middle schools in Sinpho City, Hamju County, Hoesang District of Hamhung City and other areas vowed to stand at posts for national defence, not at universities.
Among those volunteers are graduate students in Tanchon City, Kumya, Riwon and Jongphyong counties.
Graduates in Pukchong, Jangjin, Hochon and Yodok counties expressed their will to wipe out the enemies, as befitting the brave sons and daughters of heroic Korea, if the enemies dare to invade even an inch of the DPRK's territory. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Construction of Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- Service personnel of the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army, dispatched to the different parts of the DPRK, are expanding the success in the foundation excavation for the construction of regional-industry factories.
The soldier-builders in Kangdong County completed the foundation excavation for a leisure complex by introducing advanced construction methods and using machines. And they are registering high results in the foundation excavation for regional-industry factories every day.
Those in Hwangju County made a large number of formworks and paved roads for the rapid transport of materials to shorten the construction period. On this basis, they are making progress in the foundation excavation.
Those in Paechon County have made preparations for foundation concreting for objects to be built in a fresh way suited to the regional geological conditions, while removing a huge amount of earth by raising the utilization rate of construction equipment.
The 124th regiments dispatched to Puryong, Taegwan and Kilju counties and other regions, too, have introduced rational working methods to speed up the construction project on the basis of survey of regional geological conditions. -0-

headline: Interview on Spring Forest Conservation
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- The seasonal character of spring in the DPRK witnessing low precipitation, long spell of dry weather, and frequent strong wind requires each region of the country to take a more thorough step for preventing forest fire.
In this regard, a KCNA reporter had an interview with Kim Sung Hyok, head of an office of the Forest Guidance Bureau of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, over the forest protection and management during the forest fire prevention in spring.
True to the idea of the Workers' Party of Korea on turning all mountains into treasure and gold mountains, officials and working people across the country have devoted their patriotic and sincere efforts to the work for covering  mountains with green woods, Kim Sung Hyok said, and went on:
If we are careless about the forest fire prevention and relax our guard, the precious forest resources of the country created with painstaking efforts up to now will suffer big damage, and this will result in huge losses to the economic development, the people's livelihood and the land management.
The reality proves that to prevent the forest fire is an important political undertaking directly related to the defence of the Party's policy and a priority requirement for forest conservation and management, before it is a simple practical matter.
It is important for provinces, cities and counties to push ahead with the project for establishing a well-regulated system of forest-fire monitoring and notice and extinguishment mobilization.
Each forest ranger and forest-fire watchman should conduct the forest-fire monitoring and control in the forest areas under their charge in a responsible manner.
Full advance preparations should be made to ensure the timely mobilization of fire extinguishing equipment and vehicles, and thorough readiness should be maintained for immediate extinguishment once a forest fire breaks out.
All officials and working people should positively turn out in the forest-fire prevention with a firm viewpoint that it is just for the forest conservation and also the important political work. -0-

headline: OANA-NEWSYoung People in Jagang Province Advance into Major Economic Theatres
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- More than 40 young people in Jagang Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major theatres for implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A youth league official in Junggang County decided to work at the county raw material base station together with his family, out of the mind to contribute to the implementation of the Party's regional development policy.
Youths in Huichon City vowed to work at the construction brigade, raw material base and goat farm.
Discharged soldiers and other youths in Manpho City and Kophung County joined the ranks of volunteers with a strong desire to become young heroes at production and construction sites.
Those in the counties of Hwaphyong, Janggang, Usi and Jasong, too, volunteered to work at difficult and labour-consuming posts.
Present at a congratulatory meeting held at the Jagang Provincial Art Theatre on Wednesday were Jon Yong Jae, secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the WPK, youth league officials, youth and students.
Certificates were awarded to the volunteers and then a congratulatory address and speeches were made.
After the meeting, a congratulatory performance was given.
Officials, youth and students gave a pep talk to the volunteers leaving for their new revolutionary posts, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Construction of 450-hectare Greenhouse Farm Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- The construction of a modern greenhouse farm is progressing apace in the area of Hadan-ri of Sinuiju City and Soho-ri of Uiju County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
When a large-scale greenhouse is built on a scientific and IT basis against the background of modern houses along the shore of the Amnok River, this islet area will be renowned as a new model of regional development with its strong development potential and as a dazzling symbol of prosperity in the present era.
In a matter of 20 days after the significant ground-breaking ceremony for the project on February 10, officers and men of the Navy and Air Force units of the Korean People’s Army and commanding officers and members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade produced lots of blocks and carried out the pavement of roads and the laying of power line.
They are now making fresh innovation in the foundation work for greenhouses every day. -0-

headline: Ryomyong Street in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- Near the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, there is Ryomyong Street, which was splendidly built to herald the dawn of victory of socialism.
Ryomyong Street is associated with the undying devoted efforts of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who dedicated himself to building the street into a world-level one for the people's happiness and into a fairyland in the era of the Workers' Party.
The General Secretary proposed the construction of this street and named it Ryomyong Street. And he guided all its construction process, being active as a designer, operator and builder.
He ratified more than a thousand and hundreds of layouts for the construction of Ryomyong Street.
The builders of the street created a new legendary tale of  construction speed by waging a fierce 24-7 struggle since the start of the construction project.
One day in March 2017, the General Secretary inspected the street under construction, saying that its quarters of super-high-rise and multi-storied apartment houses were built in a peculiar style with their own features and that Ryomyong Street, built in a perfect harmony of super-high-rise and multi-storied architectural groups, is a model and icon for modern architectural streets.
That day he said that he could imagine the laughing faces of people moving into Ryomyong Street, and stressed that any difficult work should be done unconditionally to satisfy the people's desire and respect their interests. Adding that both speed and quality should be ensured lest any slight defect be revealed in the final project, he set forth important tasks for completing the construction of Ryomyong Street.
The street was inaugurated on April 13, 2017 on the occasion of the 105th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung. -0-

headline: High-speed Tunneling Contest Brisk at Coal Mines in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- Coal mines in the coal industry of the DPRK provide a guarantee for increased production through a high-speed tunneling contest.
Officials of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex are encouraging the tunneling workteams to create a new standard and a new record. They have also generalized the experience gained by the well-known high-speed tunneling units, including the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade at the Namyang Coal Mine.
The Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex has stepped up the tunneling for the expansion of production capacity at the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine.
Coal mines of various complexes, including Kujang, Kaechon, Tukjang, Chonnae and Kyongwon area coal-mining complexes, too, are increasing coal reserve through a socialist emulation among high-speed tunneling units. -0-

headline: OANA-NEWSMore Graduate Students in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- The present acute situation, in which the U.S. and the puppet ROK military gangsters are staging anti-DPRK war exercises more frantically than ever before, makes all the young people in the DPRK, who have grown up under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea, aware of the value of the country, burn their hearts with hatred for the enemies and the spirit of annihilating them.
More than 600 graduate students of senior middle schools in North Phyongan Province have turned out on the road for national defence.
Those graduate students in Hadan-ri of Sinuiju City volunteered for military service at forefront border posts before anyone else. Tens of graduate students at Hadan Senior Middle School No. 1, who had experienced the value of the country during their stay in Pyongyang, vowed to defend their beloved native places with arms.
Students of Kim Kwang Chol Senior Middle School in Kujang County hoped to stand at the forefront posts, vowing to glorify every moment of military service with loyalty and feats and register their names at their alma mater which is boastful with the name of the hero.
Many graduate students in Changsong, Unjon, Phihyon and other counties volunteered to join the People's Army with a resolve to wipe out the enemies with arms of revolution.
At congratulatory and petition meetings held in relevant areas, the speakers handed over the flags of the DPRK to those students who vowed to leave their first step of recompense and practice at the forefront border posts after finishing their school days.
Graduate students expressed their determination to display the honor of being the socialist patriotic youth at every post for national defence, cherishing the trust and expectation of their folks at native places and parents and siblings. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japanese Militarists' Suicidal Act
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party of Japan convened its congress to decide a "policy of movement" for 2025, which shows its intention to make all efforts to realize the revision of the Constitution, pushed forward so far, at an early date.
After all, Japan has fully revealed its militaristic nature to change the constitution, the fundamentals of the state, and emerge as the worst war force threatening the region to opt for a straight course for reinvasion.
As already known, the "Pacifist Constitution", which legally guaranteed the existence of a Japanese state after the Second World War, stipulated in paragraph 1 of Article 9 the "renunciation of war" and in paragraph 2 the "ban on possession of combat capability", thus permanently formulating that Japan should no longer be a war state.
This is a "wire-netting" to tighten Japan obsessed with the old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere".
Therefore, Japan has worked out lots of evil laws under various pretexts to evade the constitutional restrictions and has been keen on gradually bolstering the military capabilities of the "Self-Defense Forces" (SDF) till now for 80 years after its defeat.
Under such signboards as "rescue of overseas Japanese in case of emergency", "security of Japan", "contingencies in surrounding areas" and "cooperation in anti-terrorism", the "law on the SDF" was drastically revised several times. And different war laws avoiding the "Pacifist Constitution" such as "law on cooperation in UN peace-keeping activities", "law to deal with contingencies in surrounding areas", "law on special measures against terrorism" and "emergency legislation" were cooked up to lay a legal foundation for the dispatch of "SDF" troops to overseas.
Finally, Japan openly denied the "ban on possession of combat capability", claiming that "it is not the purport of the Constitution to sit and wait for death in case there is no other means". And it has stepped up the improvement of the capabilities of the "SDF" for aggression by spending a huge amount of money.
Recently, it planned to introduce hundreds of attack drones into the "SDF" for the first time and is mulling purchasing a U.S.-made large transport plane for the rapid transport of its aggression forces.
After all, the "Pacifist Constitution", made up of such words as "renunciation of war" and "ban on possession of combat capability", is nothing but a line of letters on a sheet of paper and Japan has already turned into a war state possessed of full-fledged aggression forces.
It's just a matter of time to formally revise the obsolete "Pacifist Constitution" into a "war constitution". Therefore, it is no exaggeration to say that Japan's advance into overseas aggression is decided by the time the war criminal state sets.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan, which has buckled down to the U.S. political and military confrontation moves against the DPRK, is trying to orient its first reinvasion towards the Korean peninsula.
In January last, Japan desperately took part in a three-party joint air drill with the U.S. and the puppet ROK in the sky near the Korean peninsula. In March it is trying to stage joint naval drill in waters off the Korean peninsula with them again.
Japan is dashing for a war again after sweeping its past crimes under the carpet with the passage of time. This is little short of repeating the history of its defeat by itself.
Time will soon prove that the act of changing the fundamentals of the state is a self-destructive act. -0-

headline: Mass Movements Waged by Young People across DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Young people across the DPRK are waging mass movements at every worksite for increased production.
Youths at the Kumsong Pit of the Jungsan Mine have invented and introduced valuable technical innovation proposals conducive to increasing blasting efficiency through a mass technical innovation movement and over-fulfilled their daily production plan.
Those at the Songchongang Electric Appliances Factory have made successes in the production of electric motors by conducting a dynamic drive in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experience with each other.
Young people at Pongchon and Samsin coal mines under the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex have done good things after finishing their daily work to contribute to the increased coal production.
Those of the Munchon Fruit Farm under the Kangwon Provincial Rural Economy Committee secured tens of tons of quality manure through shock brigade activities.
The Hwaphyong Forestry Station fulfilled its yearly plan for timber production by mid-February, thanks to the labour feats of young people who created new norms and records. -0-

headline: University Graduates in DPRK Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- University graduates in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have decided to work at revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and schools in mountainous areas.
A graduate of the History Faculty of Phyongsong University of Education volunteered for a lecturer of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu.
Graduates from Phyongsong University of Education and Phyongsong Teachers Training College volunteered to work at schools in Taehung, Maengsan, Sinyang and other mountainous counties.
Among them are graduates determined to work at a branch school in a remote area and to teach disabled students.
Present at a congratulatory meeting held on Thursday were Secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea Jang Ki Chol, officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students.
Speeches were made there.
After a congratulatory performance, officials, youth and students gave bouquets to those volunteers and encouraged them. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japanese Militarists' Suicidal Act
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party of Japan convened its congress to decide a "policy of movement" for 2025, which shows its intention to make all efforts to realize the revision of the Constitution, pushed forward so far, at an early date.
After all, Japan has fully revealed its militaristic nature to change the constitution, the fundamentals of the state, and emerge as the worst war force threatening the region to opt for a straight course for reinvasion.
As already known, the "Pacifist Constitution", which legally guaranteed the existence of a Japanese state after the Second World War, stipulated in paragraph 1 of Article 9 the "renunciation of war" and in paragraph 2 the "ban on possession of combat capability", thus permanently formulating that Japan should no longer be a war state.
This is a "wire-netting" to tighten Japan obsessed with the old dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere".
Therefore, Japan has worked out lots of evil laws under various pretexts to evade the constitutional restrictions and has been keen on gradually bolstering the military capabilities of the "Self-Defense Forces" (SDF) till now for 80 years after its defeat.
Under such signboards as "rescue of overseas Japanese in case of emergency", "security of Japan", "contingencies in surrounding areas" and "cooperation in anti-terrorism", the "law on the SDF" was drastically revised several times. And different war laws avoiding the "Pacifist Constitution" such as "law on cooperation in UN peace-keeping activities", "law to deal with contingencies in surrounding areas", "law on special measures against terrorism" and "emergency legislation" were cooked up to lay a legal foundation for the dispatch of "SDF" troops to overseas.
Finally, Japan openly denied the "ban on possession of combat capability", claiming that "it is not the purport of the Constitution to sit and wait for death in case there is no other means". And it has stepped up the improvement of the capabilities of the "SDF" for aggression by spending a huge amount of money.
Recently, it planned to introduce hundreds of attack drones into the "SDF" for the first time and is mulling purchasing a U.S.-made large transport plane for the rapid transport of its aggression forces.
After all, the "Pacifist Constitution", made up of such words as "renunciation of war" and "ban on possession of combat capability", is nothing but a line of letters on a sheet of paper and Japan has already turned into a war state possessed of full-fledged aggression forces.
It's just a matter of time to formally revise the obsolete "Pacifist Constitution" into a "war constitution". Therefore, it is no exaggeration to say that Japan's advance into overseas aggression is decided by the time the war criminal state sets.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan, which has buckled down to the U.S. political and military confrontation moves against the DPRK, is trying to orient its first reinvasion towards the Korean peninsula.
In January last, Japan desperately took part in a three-party joint air drill with the U.S. and the puppet ROK in the sky near the Korean peninsula. In March it is trying to stage joint naval drill in waters off the Korean peninsula with them again.
Japan is dashing for a war again after sweeping its past crimes under the carpet with the passage of time. This is little short of repeating the history of its defeat by itself.
Time will soon prove that the act of changing the fundamentals of the state is a self-destructive act. -0-

headline: DPRK Newspapers Observe Tree-planting Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- On March 14, 1952, PresidentKim Il Sungstressed the need to create lots of forests through a mass movement, showing concern about the fact that many forests in the country were burned by the barbarous bombing of the U.S. imperialists.
DPRK leading newspapers on Friday dedicate editorials to the tree-planting day.
The President advanced scientific guidelines on afforestation in each period and at each stage of the developing revolution and wisely led the struggle for implementing them, Rodong Sinmun says, and goes on:
Whenever seeing thick forests and vast realigned land, ChairmanKim Jong Ilwould say with his affection that they are mountains and fields in verdure. And whenever he saw mountains with few trees on the way of his field guidance, he felt more anxious than anyone else. So he put his heart and soul into the work for covering the whole country with trees and flowers.
Now, tree planting is dynamically conducted as an important undertaking for the national prosperity and development and the people's happiness under the wise guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The General Secretary said that tree planting is not merely the work to plant trees but the work to implant our Party's policy, warm patriotism and invariable pure conscience.
Thanks to the patriotic zeal and devoted efforts of all the people in the country who turned out as one, bearing in mind the noble patriotic intention of the peerlessly great man, progress has been made in afforestation.
The importance and significance of the tree-planting campaign are being further emphasized in the ongoing gigantic struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism.
When everyone displays patriotism and conscience in tree planting, mindful of its importance and significance, precious wealth will be provided, a more promising prospect for the afforestation and greening of the whole country will be opened, and posterity will lead a better life in the distant future, enjoying the benefits of forests cultivated by our generation.
Minju Joson calls upon all officials and working people to turn out in the spring tree-planting campaign and increase the forest wealth of the country with patriotic devotion. -0-

headline: Noble Patriotic Intention Associated with Afforestation
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- March 14 is tree-planting day in the DPRK.
On March 14, 1952, when the Fatherland Liberation War was at its height, PresidentKim Il Sunggave an instruction on launching a tree-planting movement involving all the masses, feeling painful about the fact that many forests were burned by the barbarous bombing of the U.S. imperialists.
The tree-planting has been dynamically conducted in the country as an important project for national prosperity and development and happiness of the people under the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The General Secretary authored such famous works as "Let the Entire Party, the Whole Army and All the People Conduct a Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign to Cover the Mountains of the Country with Green Woods" to clarify the principled issues arising in tree-planting and afforestation. Personally planting trees with officials, service personnel and schoolchildren, he indicated the tasks and ways for covering the whole country with trees and flowers.
His noble patriotic world can be felt in the two fir trees planted on Hwasong Hill, the new name of "Kumya black pine" and such trees of good species as Sangwon poplar growing across the country.
Modern tree nurseries were built in different parts of the country to expand the sapling production capacity, and a brisk tree-planting campaign has been conducted through a mass movement to create a large area of forests.
Meanwhile, steps have been taken in a farsighted way to prevent landslides, forest fires and damage by blight and insects and thus protect the precious forests.
All the mountains of the country turning into gold and treasure mountains convey the noble patriotic intention of the peerlessly great men. -0-

Attending it were personages of the government, organizations and institutions in Vietnam, including the Foreign Ministry, the Union of Friendship Organizations, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association and the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee, and the DPRK ambassador to Vietnam and members of his embassy.
The participants laid a floral basket before the photo of PresidentKim Il Sungmeeting with President Ho Chi Minh in the section arranged for displaying the historic mementoes related with the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's visit to Vietnam and paid tribute. Then they went round the section.
Speeches were made at the round-table talk.
Personages of the Foreign Ministry and the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee of Vietnam noted that the friendly and cooperative relations between Vietnam and the DPRK were provided by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sung, saying that ComradeKim Jong Un's official goodwill visit to Vietnam in 2019, in particular, served as an occasion in developing the relations between the two parties and the two countries onto a new high stage.
They sincerely hoped that the Korean people under the wise guidance of ComradeKim Jong Unwould achieve bigger successes with their high resolution and will this year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation. -0-

headline: Tree-planting Day Observed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- Many trees were planted across the DPRK on the occasion of the tree-planting day.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA), and officials of the SPA Standing Committee planted trees at the Songmun Revolutionary Site.
Vice-Premier Kim Jong Gwan, officials of the construction headquarters of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang Municipality and military and civilian builders planted trees of good species in the Hwasong area.
The children of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School who went to the Hwasong area planted trees out of their patriotism.
Officials of commissions, ministries and national agencies planted trees around the Grand Monument on Mansu Hill, the Central Botanical Garden, the Monument to Party Founding and other places.
Officials and working people in Pyongyang planted more than 1 500 trees in the special protection forest of the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site.
Officials, working people, youth and students in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces and Kaesong Municipality planted trees around the statues of the peerlessly great men, revolutionary sites, revolutionary battle sites and the cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army in their residential areas.
Tree-planting was also conducted in the Rakwon County Offshore Farm on the east coast of the DPRK where a gigantic construction is underway thanks to the loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Officials, working people, youth and students planted many trees at the fairyland villages and surrounding mountains in Songgan and Sijung counties of Jagang Province.
Working people in South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces and Nampho Municipality worked heart and soul to create economic forests necessary for supplying raw materials to regional-industry factories.
Officials, working people and inhabitants of different regions took part in the work to landscape their residential quarters with trees of good species and flower shrubs.
Officials and employees of the tree nurseries across the country fully supplied saplings to ensure the successful tree-planting. -0-

Young people in South Phyongan, North Phyongan, South Hamgyong, North Hamgyong and other provinces planted trees in conformity with the seasonal conditions in their relevant areas.
Officials of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea made efforts to plant trees in Hwasong Hill.
Officials and members of trade unions across the country planted trees with sincerity, full of determination to fulfill their mission and duty in the on-going grand general advance.
The Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and its organizations at all levels planted trees of various species at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site and other places to add beauty to the landscape.

headline: Int'l Affairs Analyst of DPRK on Doctrine of "America First"
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article titled "'America first' prioritizing the U.S. exclusive interests will positively promote the whole world's multi-polarization":
The centuries-old desire of mankind to live in a just, peaceful, stable and rich world is faced with a grave challenge due to the emergence of the present U.S. administration and the whirlwind by the "America first", its political philosophy.
The unprecedented evil cycle of confusion, distrust, confrontation and contradiction, caused by the inevitable decline of U.S. imperialism and the avaricious foreign policy of the successive U.S. administrations for delaying it even a little, is being further accelerated by the reemergence of the Trump administration and the "America first".
The doctrine "America first" of the American empire, appearing to embody the universal attribute of international relations centered on national interests, has clearly revealed its peculiar high-handed, aggressive and predatory nature with the passage of time. The world progressive mankind aspiring after peace and international justice are strictly watching the hypocritical entity of U.S. imperialism wrapped in a cloth of the "America first".
Clear is the reason why the "America first" is denounced and rejected in different parts of the world.
The "America first" is, in essence, a continued and expanded version of imperialism and hegemonism pursued by the U.S. since its birth in the world. It is based on the extreme chauvinism and Yankee way of thinking that it is all right to violate the rights to sovereignty, existence and development of other countries and nations for the interests of the U.S.
When taking into consideration its inborn attribute as well as its ideological characters such as "muscle flexing" and "peace by strength", the "America first" has nothing to do with the idea of different countries and nations for preserving, promoting and developing their good qualities.
The present U.S. administration's remarks and deeds according to the doctrine "America first" make one easily understand the aggressive nature of the doctrine.
The present U.S. administration adorned the beginning of its second-term office, internally with the enforcement of extreme discrimination policy aimed at the massive deportation of "illegal immigrants" and externally with the withdrawal from international organizations such as WHO, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and the UN Human Rights Council and the demonstration of its gangster-like will to annex inviolable territories of a sovereign state.
After its inauguration, the administration has further enhanced the scale and pace of its aggressive and hegemonic foreign policy based on the "America first".
It seeks exclusive economic interests by wielding an indiscriminate tariff club against neighboring countries, allies and enemy countries. And it has thrown off even its deceptive "humanitarian" mask to totally stop the "foreign assistance" to other countries. It is also pushing the international community into a great shock by repeating the unreasonable and surprising acts such as proposed "taking-over of Gaza Strip and its development as a resort".
European countries, Japan, the ROK and other allies, which have zealously followed the U.S. domination strategy for unipolar world, boasting of the "alliance" of nearly 80 years after the Second World War, are suffering "humiliation" and "contempt". This is a natural result of the "America first".
Politicians and media of Western countries, that have been so faithful to the U.S., are deploring that the present U.S. administration's blackmail policy heralds a new era of jungle law and its "America first" is not isolationism but interventionism that has put on another mask.
Even conservative media and experts of the U.S. unhesitatingly contend that definiteness and concreteness should be added to the doctrine of "America first" to make it more positively contribute to expanding the U.S. external role as "international leader".
Such comments are only a few partial examples showing that the international community has looked into the essence of the "America first" anatomically and made a correct conclusion about it.
The "American first" gives the international community and the present times a suggestion of great significance.
In conclusion, this means that one must be strong in order to defend oneself and that the promotion of self-development is just the truth and a powerful means for propelling the law-governed development of history.
The DPRK, which has emerged as the strongest anti-imperialist and anti-U.S. fortress, is bolstering up its strength with tighter grip on the treasured nuclear sword of justice, the banner of independence. This is aimed at putting an end to the hateful invasion and plunder attempt by the empire of evil and at writing a new page in the world history aspiring after independence and multipolarization.

headline: Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Visit to Vietnam Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- A round-table talk took place at a museum in Lang Son Province of Vietnam on March 10 to mark the sixth anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's historic official goodwill visit to Vietnam.
Attending it were personages of the government, organizations and institutions in Vietnam, including the Foreign Ministry, the Union of Friendship Organizations, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association and the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee, and the DPRK ambassador to Vietnam and members of his embassy.
The participants laid a floral basket before the photo of PresidentKim Il Sungmeeting with President Ho Chi Minh in the section arranged for displaying the historic mementoes related with the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un's visit to Vietnam and paid tribute. Then they went round the section.
Speeches were made at the round-table talk.
Personages of the Foreign Ministry and the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee of Vietnam noted that the friendly and cooperative relations between Vietnam and the DPRK were provided by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sung, saying that ComradeKim Jong Un's official goodwill visit to Vietnam in 2019, in particular, served as an occasion in developing the relations between the two parties and the two countries onto a new high stage.

headline: Tree Planting Conducted by Working People's Organizations in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- Working people's organizations of the DPRK planted trees on the occasion of the tree-planting day.
Officials and members of the youth league, the trade unions, the agricultural workers' union and the women's union sincerely planted many trees in their relevant areas.
Officials and members of the Central Committee of the youth league and the youth league in Pyongyang planted fir, white birch, picea Koraiensis and flower shrubs at the April 15 Children's Flower Garden.
Young people in South Phyongan, North Phyongan, South Hamgyong, North Hamgyong and other provinces planted trees in conformity with the seasonal conditions in their relevant areas.
Officials of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea made efforts to plant trees in Hwasong Hill.
Officials and members of trade unions across the country planted trees with sincerity, full of determination to fulfill their mission and duty in the on-going grand general advance.
The Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and its organizations at all levels planted trees of various species at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Site and other places to add beauty to the landscape.
Officials and members of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea and the women's union in Pyongyang visited the construction site for building 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area and devoted themselves to tree planting, picturing the future of the large architectural group to be delighted with the completion of the project.
Members of the women's union in North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces, Kaesong Municipality and other areas planted trees in a responsible manner. -0-

headline: 67th-term Graduation Ceremony of Korean University of Chongryon Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- The 67th-term graduation ceremony of Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan took place at the university hall in Tokyo on March 9.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Education Department, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan, Han Tong Song, rector of Korean University, and other officials, teaching staff, graduates, parents and students.
The national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played.
A congratulatory message from the Ministry of Education of the DPRK was read out at the ceremony.
Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, made a congratulatory speech.
He said that there are many universities in the world, but only the graduates of Korean University make a new, hopeful start along the broad road of patriotism indicated by the respected MarshalKim Jong Unafter spending their glorious university life at the DPRK's only university for overseas compatriots.
He called upon the graduates of the university to discharge their duty through a dynamic movement for patriotism by learning all the time from compatriots and relying on their wisdom and strength, bearing in mind that the inexhaustible strength of compatriots precisely means the strength of Chongryon and a shortcut to ushering in a new heyday of the movement of Koreans in Japan.
A report was made by Han Tong Song, rector of Korean University. Then there were a ceremony of awarding the citations to graduates and vowing speeches.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas read out at the ceremony.
The graduates gave an art performance. -0-

headline: Int'l Affairs Analyst of DPRK on Doctrine of "America First"
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article titled "'America first' prioritizing the U.S. exclusive interests will positively promote the whole world's multi-polarization":
The centuries-old desire of mankind to live in a just, peaceful, stable and rich world is faced with a grave challenge due to the emergence of the present U.S. administration and the whirlwind by the "America first", its political philosophy.
The unprecedented evil cycle of confusion, distrust, confrontation and contradiction, caused by the inevitable decline of U.S. imperialism and the avaricious foreign policy of the successive U.S. administrations for delaying it even a little, is being further accelerated by the reemergence of the Trump administration and the "America first".
The doctrine "America first" of the American empire, appearing to embody the universal attribute of international relations centered on national interests, has clearly revealed its peculiar high-handed, aggressive and predatory nature with the passage of time. The world progressive mankind aspiring after peace and international justice are strictly watching the hypocritical entity of U.S. imperialism wrapped in a cloth of the "America first".
Clear is the reason why the "America first" is denounced and rejected in different parts of the world.
The "America first" is, in essence, a continued and expanded version of imperialism and hegemonism pursued by the U.S. since its birth in the world. It is based on the extreme chauvinism and Yankee way of thinking that it is all right to violate the rights to sovereignty, existence and development of other countries and nations for the interests of the U.S.
When taking into consideration its inborn attribute as well as its ideological characters such as "muscle flexing" and "peace by strength", the "America first" has nothing to do with the idea of different countries and nations for preserving, promoting and developing their good qualities.
The present U.S. administration's remarks and deeds according to the doctrine "America first" make one easily understand the aggressive nature of the doctrine.
The present U.S. administration adorned the beginning of its second-term office, internally with the enforcement of extreme discrimination policy aimed at the massive deportation of "illegal immigrants" and externally with the withdrawal from international organizations such as WHO, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and the UN Human Rights Council and the demonstration of its gangster-like will to annex inviolable territories of a sovereign state.
After its inauguration, the administration has further enhanced the scale and pace of its aggressive and hegemonic foreign policy based on the "America first".
It seeks exclusive economic interests by wielding an indiscriminate tariff club against neighboring countries, allies and enemy countries. And it has thrown off even its deceptive "humanitarian" mask to totally stop the "foreign assistance" to other countries. It is also pushing the international community into a great shock by repeating the unreasonable and surprising acts such as proposed "taking-over of Gaza Strip and its development as a resort".
European countries, Japan, the ROK and other allies, which have zealously followed the U.S. domination strategy for unipolar world, boasting of the "alliance" of nearly 80 years after the Second World War, are suffering "humiliation" and "contempt". This is a natural result of the "America first".
Politicians and media of Western countries, that have been so faithful to the U.S., are deploring that the present U.S. administration's blackmail policy heralds a new era of jungle law and its "America first" is not isolationism but interventionism that has put on another mask.
Even conservative media and experts of the U.S. unhesitatingly contend that definiteness and concreteness should be added to the doctrine of "America first" to make it more positively contribute to expanding the U.S. external role as "international leader".
Such comments are only a few partial examples showing that the international community has looked into the essence of the "America first" anatomically and made a correct conclusion about it.
The "American first" gives the international community and the present times a suggestion of great significance.
In conclusion, this means that one must be strong in order to defend oneself and that the promotion of self-development is just the truth and a powerful means for propelling the law-governed development of history.
The DPRK, which has emerged as the strongest anti-imperialist and anti-U.S. fortress, is bolstering up its strength with tighter grip on the treasured nuclear sword of justice, the banner of independence. This is aimed at putting an end to the hateful invasion and plunder attempt by the empire of evil and at writing a new page in the world history aspiring after independence and multipolarization.
Some countries are taking a hands-off approach towards the U.S. outrageous threat and blackmail as they have failed to build up their strength. So the U.S. is mercilessly violating their dignity and interests like their lives. This reality makes one understand once again the true meaning of the common proverb that a wolf must be tamed with a club only.
History always stand on the side of justice, and justice and conscience are the main factors that prevented the history of complicated international relations from running off the correct track of its development, braving all sorts of trials and difficulties.
The Yankees' logic of hegemony that everything in the world should be prey only for the U.S. and the anachronistic behavior of the impudent empire of evil, which imposes "the rules-based international order" on other countries, unhesitatingly neglecting the international law and international organizations for its exclusive interests, can no longer be allowed by the conscience of mankind aspiring after the era of independence, the new era of multipolarization.
The evil forces obsessed with the frantic idea of destroying global peace and security and threatening the existence of human beings will not escape from a stern punishment by history. When the world progressives united by justice bolster up their strength and fully display it, the destruction of the Yankees' hegemonism will be further hastened.
The more recklessly the present U.S. administration pursues the unilateral policy based on "America first" prioritizing the U.S. exclusive interests, the further the whole world's multi-polarization will be accelerated. This will lead to the total downfall of the U.S., the empire of evil, and imperialism. -0-

headline: Graduate Students in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of senior middle school graduate students in Ryanggang Province of the DPRK have volunteered for military service at frontline posts.
All the graduate students of Rodong Senior Middle School in Hyesan City vowed to join the People's Army.
Those graduate students in Kim Jong Suk and Kim Hyong Jik counties expressed their determination to become defenders of the socialist system.
Those in Hyesan City, Taehongdan and Kapsan counties petitioned for military service at forefront border posts.
Students of Hyesan Middle School for Orphans and those in Samsu, Paekam and other counties are filled with the will to put on the military uniform of the revolution and spend their youth at the posts for national defence.
At the meetings held on the spots, war veterans and speakers handed over the national flags of the DPRK to the volunteers, asking them to glorify every moment of military service with merits.
Those volunteers in their speeches expressed their resolve to defend at  posts for national defence the peace and security of the country from the enemy's aggression and challenge.
Teachers and students of alma maters gave bouquets and garlands to the volunteers and encouraged them. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary Warns against Any War Reinforcements
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The U.S. is getting ever more undisguised in its intention to become the most hostile and confrontational entity to the DPRK through practical actions.
Recently, a squadron of F-35B, the latest stealth fighter stationed in the U.S. mainland, was additionally deployed in the U.S. military base in Iwakuni of Japan.
The F-35B, capable of making immediate sortie through vertical take-off and landing as helicopters, is one of the main forces of the U.S. marines and constitutes a core reinforcements and strategic asset to be dispatched first to the ROK in contingency.
The F-35B stealth fighters of two squadrons belonging to the U.S. marines, already deployed in the Iwakuni base, have always been involved in the various U.S.-led war drills conducted in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula to practice the performance of operational mission.
The U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and other war forces in the field are now inciting a war fever to the full, asserting that the air combat capability of the U.S. marines in Japan would make a greater contribution to the combined joint operation with allies in the Indo-Pacific region through the additional deployment of F-35B and that the bolstering of deterrent force is expected to prove effective.
The additional deployment of offensive war reinforcements to cope with contingency in the Korean peninsula is hourly increasing the unpredictability of actual armed conflict and a nuclear war.
As known, being staged in the puppet ROK is the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 including a nuclear war rehearsal aimed at a "preemptive strike" on the core facilities and areas of the DPRK. And the U.S. Navy's nuclear carrier Carl Vinson task force is involved in various joint drills while staying in the waters off the Korean peninsula.
At a critical point when an accidental gunshot may cause a physical conflict between the two sides, the mastering of capability to fight a war by the local forces and the additional deployment of offensive reinforcements are being carried out in parallel.
No one in the world will believe this as a visible demonstration or just a warning of the U.S.
It is the undeniable reality witnessed by the international community that the U.S. war machines with no brake have switched to an accelerated motion that can no longer be stopped in the Korean peninsula and the region.
This year, the deployment of U.S. strategic assets targeting the DPRK has visibly increased and the U.S.-led bilateral and multi-lateral war military drills  have been ceaselessly conducted. Such reality clearly proves that the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK is the immutable "legacy of its regime" handed down irrespective of regime change and a bad habit of unconditionally denying the DPRK.
The U.S. desperate moves of military adventurism aimed to create military imbalance and incite a new geopolitical conflict in the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia provide the DPRK with reasonable justification and the urgent need to give tougher warning of action.
It is our invariable judgment and correct answer to those who worship upper hand in strength to respond with language and action that they only can understand.
F-35B will advance to a battlefield first in contingency on the Korean peninsula?
It's absurd.
The U.S. anti-communist outposts which neglect and infringe upon the security concern of the DPRK and put the whole area under the critical situation are within the constant sighting and striking range of the DPRK's indefinite forces.
Any war reinforcements of the U.S. will be completely contained and wiped out. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Construction Site of 10 000 Flats at Third Stage in Hwasong Area ahead of Completion
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the strategy for capital city construction set forth at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the scientific and energetic leadership of the Party Central Committee, Pyongyang, the capital city of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, is turning into a world-famous civilized city, taking on the majestic appearance peculiar to it.
Another large and splendid architectural group of 10 000 flats has been successfully built in the Hwasong area again to near completion as if it demonstrates a new era of prosperity of Pyongyang.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area on March 15.
Accompanying him were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Ri Hi Yong and Kim Tok Hun, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and other major senior Party and government officials and officials concerned of designing institutions.
With his great ambition to turn the Hwasong area into a model in layout of city constitution elements, a prototype of administrative district function and a beautiful and modern block of city where architectural formative art and advanced civilization are in good harmony, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclearly indicated the orientation and ways for building its third-stage district into the one with another distinction different from the first- and second-stage districts and energetically led the work for drawing up the construction plan while giving personal guidance to the huge amount of layouts.
Thanks to the strenuous efforts of military and civilian builders who upheld with the death-defying executive ability the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to build all the creations on this land into the people-first entities to be found only in the great people's country and into the innovative ones with marked individuality, another home of the people where skyscrapers, high-rise apartment houses and public buildings including educational, commercial and service facilities are in ideal harmony has been magnificently built in a matter of one year.
Saying with pleasure that another new and large architectural group symbolic of the dynamic trend of Korean-style change and development has appeared in a dignified way to add to the picture of the Hwasong area which has undergone a dramatic change,Kim Jong Unexpressed his great satisfaction over the fact that the people's material and cultural well-being can be provided on a higher level.
He learned in detail about the overall situation of housing construction at the third stage in the Hwasong area nearing completion.
Going round the dwelling houses, he highly appreciated the quality of the overall construction work that made a stride forward in the housing construction at the third stage in the Hwasong area. He commanded a bird's-eye view of the change in the Hwasong area, a scenic spot of the socialist cultural efflorescence.
He said that with the start of the significant ground-breaking ceremony in spring of 2021 when he personally gave the flag of the command headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang to its commanding officers, a cheerful sound of blasting was heard on this land every year to hasten the time of rejuvenation and the capital city of Pyongyang was enveloped in joy of people moving into new houses in every April. This is truly a worthwhile struggle and pride in realizing our Party's long-cherished desire, he noted.
When the fourth-stage construction in the Hwasong area is completed, the DPRK will become a proud country which perfectly settled the housing problem of the capital city in the world, he said, adding that the construction in the Hwasong area, vigorously continued for the consecutive years, has verified the development-oriented principles to be observed in opening up a new era of the capital city construction.
He said that Ryomyong Street, Mirae Scientists Street and other new streets have sprung up every year to renew the appearance of the capital city but there has never been a city block as the Hwasong area which was erected gigantically with perfect function in a short span of time, adding that this is of great experimental significance in putting the new era of prosperity of Pyongyang on a higher level.
He clarified all the issues arising in achieving clear-cut changes and progress suited to the new era by meeting the requirements of the Party's policy and retaining the modernity of our own style in the construction work, an epitome of national power and civilization.
He said that the Hwasong area has attained the political, economic and cultural function as a full-fledged city administrative district and been turned into a centre and icon capable of leading the existing areas of the capital city to civilization and enlightenment, stressing that this is a significant development of enhancing the strategic function and position of the capital city.
He called for proactively applying the precious experience gained in the construction of the Hwasong area, which proved the validity of the Party's policy on the capital city construction and set an example in the layout of city constitution elements, to the capital city construction field and thus accelerating the modernization of our style suited to the political character of the capital city of our state and the world trend of architectural development.
What is particularly important in pushing forward the construction project is to steadily regulate and renew the legal guarantee for the city formation and development in the capital and regional areas and carry out the nationwide construction strictly in accordance with the construction law of new standard, he said, stressing the need to readjust and reinforce the well-regulated system of working out such city constitution elements as industrial buildings and sci-tech, educational and public health facilities in a theoretical, scientific and planned way in conformity with the population density and characteristics of relevant regions and then strictly deliberating them before application.
Specially underlining the importance to successfully draw up and give precedence to the scientific and future-oriented design of city infrastructure and realize the modernization of this work and to radically improve the level of city management, he indicated important principles and tasks that should be regarded as guidelines in implementing the policy on developing the capital city.
He assigned a task for holding an inauguration ceremony with splendor ahead of the Day of the Sun, the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation, expressing his deep emotion over the fact that the WPK, which is dynamically carrying out the project for realizing the cherished desire getting stronger in the face of difficulties, has faced another splendid fruition - the completion of the third-stage construction in the Hwasong area. -0-

Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK produced more than ten million saplings of 50-odd species necessary for spring tree-planting and launched a tree-planting campaign on a mass basis.
The municipal forest management bureau worked out a step-wise plan for raising the level of scientific and intensive sapling production at the tree nurseries in districts and counties and conducted technical guidance and review of work.

Officials and working people in Onchon County and Taean District established a gravity-fed irrigation system to grow zelkova and Sangwon poplar trees while securing good species of seeds and storing and sowing them as required by science and technology.

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The U.S. is getting ever more undisguised in its intention to become the most hostile and confrontational entity to the DPRK through practical actions.
Recently, a squadron of F-35B, the latest stealth fighter stationed in the U.S. mainland, was additionally deployed in the U.S. military base in Iwakuni of Japan.
The F-35B, capable of making immediate sortie through vertical take-off and landing as helicopters, is one of the main forces of the U.S. marines and constitutes a core reinforcements and strategic asset to be dispatched first to the ROK in contingency.
The F-35B stealth fighters of two squadrons belonging to the U.S. marines, already deployed in the Iwakuni base, have always been involved in the various U.S.-led war drills conducted in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula to practice the performance of operational mission.
The U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and other war forces in the field are now inciting a war fever to the full, asserting that the air combat capability of the U.S. marines in Japan would make a greater contribution to the combined joint operation with allies in the Indo-Pacific region through the additional deployment of F-35B and that the bolstering of deterrent force is expected to prove effective.
The additional deployment of offensive war reinforcements to cope with contingency in the Korean peninsula is hourly increasing the unpredictability of actual armed conflict and a nuclear war.
As known, being staged in the puppet ROK is the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 including a nuclear war rehearsal aimed at a "preemptive strike" on the core facilities and areas of the DPRK. And the U.S. Navy's nuclear carrier Carl Vinson task force is involved in various joint drills while staying in the waters off the Korean peninsula.
At a critical point when an accidental gunshot may cause a physical conflict between the two sides, the mastering of capability to fight a war by the local forces and the additional deployment of offensive reinforcements are being carried out in parallel.

The U.S. desperate moves of military adventurism aimed to create military imbalance and incite a new geopolitical conflict in the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia provide the DPRK with reasonable justification and the urgent need to give tougher warning of action.

F-35B will advance to a battlefield first in contingency on the Korean peninsula?
It's absurd.
The U.S. anti-communist outposts which neglect and infringe upon the security concern of the DPRK and put the whole area under the critical situation are within the constant sighting and striking range of the DPRK's indefinite forces.

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement titled "G7, the U.S.-led nuclear criminal group, should thoroughly abandon its anachronistic ambition for nuclear hegemony" on Sunday:
At the G7 foreign minister meeting recently held in Canada, the U.S. and other Western countries perpetrated a political provocation talking about someone's "dismantlement of nukes", while pulling up the DPRK over its exercise of the just and legitimate sovereign rights.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses a serious concern over the fact that the member states of G7, the chief criminals wrecking the global peace and security and the international nuclear non-proliferation system, are taking issue with the possession of the just war deterrence of a sovereign state just like a guilty party filing the suit first, and clarifies that it will never tolerate any encroachment upon the sovereignty and internal affairs of the DPRK.
Those countries which regard nuclear weapons as the main means for realizing their aggressive and hegemonic political and military purposes are the member states of the G7, and those countries which are hell-bent on illegal and malicious nuclear proliferation act under the pretext of "nuclear sharing" and "offer of extended deterrence" are none other than the member states of the G7.
It is an irrefutable well-known fact that the U.S., the only state that used nuclear weapons in the world, is a typical nuclear threat entity that is bringing the crisis of nuclear conflict to the Korean peninsula, Europe and other parts of the world through unlimited nuclear arms buildup and reckless nuclear war drills and it is the biggest country of the world proliferating nuclear weapons.
Britain, not content with its nuclear weapons, is openly attempting to introduce again the U.S. nukes into its country and taking the lead in transferring nuclear submarine technology to a non-nuclear weapons state, and the U.S. nukes have been deployed in Germany and Italy.
Meanwhile, claiming "offering of nuclear umbrella" to western European counties, France is fostering another concerning possibility of nuclear proliferation in the region, and Japan has been provided with the U.S. "extended deterrence" including nuclear weapons, thus raising the relationship of security and cooperation with the U.S. to the one of nuclear alliance.
All facts shows that G7 which consists of the U.S. and its vassal allies is, indeed, the root cause of the occurrence of global nuclear crisis and its aggravation and that G7 should start the "complete and irretrievable abandonment of nukes".
G7, which has turned into a nuclear criminal group gravely threatening the global peace and security, should thoroughly abandon its anachronistic ambition for nuclear hegemony before talking about someone's "denuclearization" and "dismantlement of nukes".
The DPRK's position of nuclear weapons state which has been fixed permanently by the supreme law of its state will not change according to the recognition of anyone, and the DPRK's nuclear armed forces will exist forever as a powerful means of justice which defends the sovereignty of the state, territorial integrity and fundamental interests, prevents a war in the Korean peninsula and Northeast Asia and guarantees a strategic stability of the world.
The DPRK will steadily update and strengthen its nuclear armed forces both in quality and quantity in response to the nuclear threat from outside as stipulated in its Constitution and other domestic laws and reliably defend the peace and security of the state, the region and the rest of the world as the responsible nuclear weapons state. -0-

headline: More Graduate Students in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- Many senior middle school graduates in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered for military service at frontline posts, when all the young people across the country are hardening their will to mercilessly punish the enemies bringing dark clouds of a nuclear war.
One hundred and tens of graduates in Chongjin City vowed to go to the forefront for defending the country, regarding the military service as the most vivid expression of patriotism and their most sacred duty and first mission.
Graduates in Hoeryong City and Kyonghung, Musan, Myonggan and Hwadae counties are filled with the enthusiasm to join the revolutionary army and register brilliant military feats on their personal accounts of youth.
Those of Kim Chaek City and Myongchon, Orang and Kyongwon counties, too, volunteered for military service.
Among them who decided to stand at the posts for national defence, not to go to universities, are graduate students in Kilju and Kyongsong counties.
At the meetings held in relevant cities and counties, the graduate students hardened their pledge again to perform proud feats in defending the country, true to the ideology and leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Russian Foreign Ministry Delegation Visits Various Places
Iron Ore Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of the Unryul Mine in the DPRK strive to set new standards and records in the production of iron ore.
They overfulfilled their production plan for February. This means that they increased the production of iron ore 1.5 times as compared with the same period of last year.
The Chongnyon mine-lot has concentrated efforts on the stopes with large iron ore deposits while raising the utilization rate of striking rotary drills and other mining equipment and introducing advanced working methods to increase the per-hour output.
Miners in the Jungsan mine-lot have carried on the effective repair and maintenance of equipment while securing small tools and spare parts and displayed the collectivist spirit of one shift helping another.
Workers and technicians in charge of the earth-scraping have directed efforts to ensuring the effectiveness of large long-distance belt conveyor while inspecting and repairing equipment in a responsible manner to register the results of earth-scraping 1.3 times higher than the last year. -0-

headline: Meeting of Chongryon Headquarters Chairpersons
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- The fifth meeting of headquarters chairpersons of the 25th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on March 12.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organizational Department Pak Ku Ho and vice-chairpersons of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, members of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon and chairpersons of headquarters of Chongryon. Councilors and vice department directors of the Central Committee of Chongryon attended the meeting as observers.
Pak Ku Ho made a report.
The main work orientation of Chongryon for this year is to launch an offensive campaign for comprehensively carrying through the important letter sent by the respected MarshalKim Jong Unto the participants in the 25th Congress of Chongryon and thus provide a sure guarantee for implementing the decision of the Congress, the reporter said.
He called upon the chairpersons of headquarters to unconditionally carry out the major tasks for this year, the last year of implementing the decision of the 25th Congress of Chongryon, overcoming all difficulties, true to the noble idea and intention ofKim Jong Unwho indicated the main orientation of Chongryon work for this year.
He stressed the need for the chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters to activate all the basic organizations this year marking the 70th anniversary of Chongryon through powerful political work and scrupulous organizational work and thus turn Chongryon into a powerful organization invariably carrying forward the tradition of patriotism and loyalty, deeply rooted among the compatriots.
Speeches were made by chairpersons of headquarters of Chongryon.
Chairman Ho Jong Man concluded the meeting. -0-

headline: Van Carrying Dairy Products Runs for Three Children in Mountain Village
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- In the northern end of the DPRK, there is Uam-dong, Sonbong District of Rason Municipality.
The country's road starting from Pyongyang ends at the place.
The Thori village, far away from the seat of Uam-dong, is a small village with only 30-odd households visited by few people.
Anyhow, a van carrying dairy products comes to the place for three children every day, running more than 100 ri (40kms).
That's why the inhabitants in the Thori village would say that this van carries not just milk but the warm love of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The total distance the van traveled for the children in the village for a past few years is hundreds of thousands of ri.
The road of conveying dairy products to every part of the country where children live reflects the Party's warm love for the rising generations. -0-
