story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Ma Tong Hui, ambassador of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to Egypt and concurrently to Yemen, gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on Tuesday over the U.S. recent military attack on Yemen that caused many casualties among peaceful inhabitants:
Recently the U.S. launched a large-scale military attack on Yemen under the pretext of protecting international trade from so-called terrorism.
A hundred and tens of innocent peaceful inhabitants including children and women were killed or wounded and huge property damage caused due to the indiscriminate military attack committed by vast forces of the U.S. Air Force and Navy, including a nuclear aircraft carrier.
This military attack by the U.S. is a wanton violation of all international laws including the UN Charter and it is an open encroachment upon the sovereignty of other nation that can never be justified.
I express serious concern over and strongly condemn and reject the illegal military moves of the U.S. which is resorting to its exclusive and unilateral geopolitical ambition while gravely violating the sovereignty and territorial integrity of other countries through the violence of injustice in disregard of international law.
At present the situation in the Middle East has plunged into an uncontrollable evil cycle and the prospect of political settlement of disputes in the region has become gloomier. This is attributable to the high-handed and arbitrary practices and unreasonable interference by the outside forces seeking only hegemonic interests.
The international community will have to express serious concern and protest against the U.S. hooliganism seriously disturbing regional peace and stability, and the U.S. should stop at once such indiscriminate use of force that will invite its own international isolation. -0-

headline: DPRK Government Economic Delegation Leaves for Russia
Third National Meeting of Active Leaders of People's Neighbourhood Units Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- The third national meeting of active leaders of people's neighbourhood units in the DPRK was held here on March 16-17.
The meeting discussed practical ways in detail for making innovations in the work of dongs and people's neighbourhood units as required by the new era, true to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to further consolidate the cornerstone of the Korean-style socialist system centered on the popular masses and the foundation of the DPRK government and build a comprehensively developed, prosperous state on its solid ground.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and other senior Party and government officials, exemplary leaders of people's neighbourhood units and chiefs of dong offices from across the country, officials of the provincial, city and county people's committees and officials concerned.
Premier Pak Thae Song made an opening address.
He expressed belief that the third national meeting of active leaders of people's neighbourhood units, convened in the historic period when policies for the comprehensive development of our state and the realization of all ideals of the people are being adopted and enforced and great changes are being made in the whole of socialist construction under the wise leadership of the great Party Central Committee, would mark an important occasion in bringing about a radical improvement in the work of dongs and people's neighbourhood units.
Kim Myong Hun, vice premier of the Cabinet, made a report.
He stressed that the people's neighbourhood unit in the country is a lower-echelon organization of social life linking the inhabitants with people's power organs and the base of inhabitants' living and that the work to actively preserve the nature of our society starts from the people's neighbourhood unit and it is guaranteed by its role.
The past 10-odd years that witnessed a new era of prosperity unprecedented in the history of the country was a proud period when signal progress was made in the work of dongs and people's neighbourhood units, he said.
The report introduced the inhabitants who are respecting and preferentially treating the revolutionary forerunners and persons of merits and displaying the beautiful traits of assisting the army, as well as the achievements and experience gained in finding out many reserves through an economy drive to positively contribute to  socialist construction and in sprucing up streets and villages as socialist fairylands.
The report referred to a series of deviations and lessons to be overcome without fail in the work of dongs and people's neighbourhood units.
Saying that we are faced with an important and urgent task to radically renovate the work of dongs and people's neighbourhood units in line with the rapid development of our state making a continuous leap forward in all sectors and fields, the reporter referred to the ways for its materialization.
He called upon the participants in the meeting and all other leaders of people's neighbourhood units throughout the country to work harder for the eternal prosperity of our great state, happy laughter of the beloved people and the Korean-style socialism best in the world, bearing deep in mind the heavy mission they have assumed before the Party and the people.
Then followed speeches. -0-

story_text:

Speakers at the meeting referred to the great loving care shown by the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who invited those youths, who volunteered for major worksites of socialist construction and performed labor feats, as delegates to the celebrations of the Youth Day and had a photo taken with them.

They ardently called upon all the young people to devote themselves to the prosperity of the dignified DPRK with loyalty and patriotic mind and become true sons and daughters of the Party remembered by the country and regarded as pride by the people.

headline:
Rest of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.03.18.]
story_text:
One day in September 1973, the Political Committee of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea adopted a special decision that PresidentKim Il Sungshould take a rest for one month.
So the President came to leave for a recreation center, but the schedule of recreation had not been carried out since the first day.
When an official earnestly called upon him to have a rest according to the decision of the Political Committee of the WPK Central Committee, the President said that he could not take a rest in peace as he had a lot of work to do.
Several days passed amid such dialogues.
In one of the days, the President visited the fifth workteam of the then Ryongbuk Co-op Farm in Yomju County and gave field guidance at different units. And he met senior officials of North Phyongan Province and discussed affairs of the province with them.
Though officials asked him to take a rest even for a few days, the President decided to stop recreation and leave for Pyongyang without delay.
When the officials repeatedly asked him to have a rest at the center, he said that rest is not a special thing for him but it is a rest for him to talk with workers and peasants, settle their difficulties and please them.
As a result, the special decision of the Political Committee of the Party Central Committee was not executed. -0-

headline: Prizing Products Made by Our Workers
story_text:
One day in September 2013, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a stone dressing plant.
Seeing with pleasure the newly-processed granite newels piled up before him and stroking one of them on top of the heap, the General Secretary said that they were processed in a precise way.
An official of the factory told him that the newel was coated with stone dust as it was just processed.
The General Secretary said that it didn't matter if there are some dust and that he couldn't just have a look at the excellent products made with stones abundant in our country.
And he continued to stroke the dusty newel, valuing products made by our workers with the resources of our country.
That day he said that he was convinced to see the processed stone products mass-produced in the plant and hardened his determination to usher in a great heyday of construction.
Looking up to the General Secretary, the officials vowed to build splendid creations for the people on this land by our own resources and efforts and thus uphold the Party's grand plan for construction in practice. -0-

headline: Housing Construction Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- The military and civilian builders, out in the project for construction of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area of the DPRK, continue to expand achievements in the construction, pushing ahead with the foundation work.
Soldier-builders are making miracles and innovations at every construction site while displaying the spirit of stubborn offensive peculiar to the revolutionary army.
They have steadily raised the level of specialization in the work, while positively applying advanced building methods to shorten the time of form assembly, concrete mixture placement and striking.
Various civilian construction units finished the foundation excavation in a short span of time, following the working spirit and manner of the service personnel of the People's Army, and are stepping up the foundation concreting in real earnest.
The construction project in the Hwasong area is now progressing apace, thanks to the high enthusiasm of builders to successfully complete the construction of a new flourishing living space of the socialist civilization in which the people enjoy a happy life. -0-

headline: Credentials of DPRK Ambassador to Thailand Accepted

The ambassador conveyed the greetings ofKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, to King Maha Vajiralongkorn Phra Vajiraklaochaoyuhua.
The king asked the ambassador to convey his sincere greetings to HEKim Jong Un.
He said that the relations with the DPRK are the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation. -0-

headline: Kangso Mineral Water Factory
story_text:

headline: Press Statement by Policy Section Chief of Institute for Japan Studies under DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) -- The policy section chief of the Institute for Japan Studies under the DPRK Foreign Ministry on Thursday issued the following press statement titled "Japan's reckless possession of preemptive attack capability will only expose the archipelago as a common target of regional countries":
The geopolitical crises caused by the U.S. are increasing the danger of the outbreak of a new great war in different parts of the world. Against this backdrop, Japan, obsessed with the ambition for overseas expansion, has further accelerated its militarist moves, attracting the attention of the world public.
According to media, the Japanese government is mulling deploying home-produced long-range missiles for action in Kyushu area in the southwestern part of the archipelago in March 2026 in order to "secure the capability of attacking enemy bases".
Such missiles are modified version of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles possessed by the Japan Ground "Self-Defence Force", which are intended for attack even on the ground targets with about 1 000 km range, and the DPRK and the coastal areas of China are reportedly within their striking range.
Earlier, the Japan Ministry of Defence announced that it would deploy in 2026 high-speed gliding projectiles, a hypersonic weapon which proved successful in a test-fire. It also opened to public the research and manufacture of new-type ballistic missile with a range of 3 000 km.
Moreover, Japan secured the U.S approval for the sale of medium-range air-to-air missiles and long-range air-to-surface cruise missiles and is putting spurs on the building of long-range missile force while seeking to deploy the U.S.-made long-range cruise missiles Tomahawk.
This clearly shows that Japan's possession of preemptive attack capability, formulated through the revision of "national security strategy" at the end of 2022, is becoming a present perfect form and the descendants of the samurais, who had so far made a feint of being a "pacific nation" under the signboard of "exclusive defence" before the international community, have fully revealed their wild ambition of militarism.
Japan's possession of the capability for preemptive attack is an immediate product of the reinvasion policy to realize its ambition for the second "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", persistently pursued by Japan regarding it as a strategic goal while whetting a sword for revenge for 80 years since its defeat.
It is not a secret that the successive regimes of Japan have misled the public opinion with such absurd interpretation that the "possession of the capability of attacking enemy base" is within the limit of "self-defence", claiming that it is not the purport of the Constitution to sit and wait for self-destruction, and worked hard for its realization.
Not content with having staged joint military drills for aggression at all times by drawing unbidden guests from over continents and oceans into the Asia-Pacific region to constantly incite war fever, Japan is seeking to deploy even long-range strike means capable of rapidly attacking specific countries in the region any moment. This clearly shows that Japan's military expansion has been developed into an extremely grave stage.
Japan, a war criminal state which has much possibility to repeat its crime as it has totally denied and justified the past history of aggression, is going reckless to get the capability for preemptive attack on other country's territory beyond the borders of its archipelago in the near future. Such "bold action" is a dangerous provocation that will bring about constant escalation of tension by sowing the spark of new military conflict in Northeast Asia.
The rumor about "threat from its surroundings", so zealously clamored by Japan, is only for providing a pretext to cover up its reckless reinvasion war preparations going beyond its own defence demands, as illustrated by all-time high military spendings growing every year, frantic securement of preemptive attack means, constant strengthening of the Japan-U.S. military alliance and multilateral collusion and nexus with NATO forces.
Japan has worked hard to turn itself into a major military power, crying out for the "free and open Indo-Pacific", an expanded version of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". Such moves make one keenly realize that the "imperial army", which inflicted indelible wounds on the peoples in the Asia-Pacific region, is being reborn.
All the facts go to clearly prove once again that all military means and various forms of movement directly targeting the DPRK as well as the aggressive and challenging consciousness against it are an object to be wiped out and that the DPRK efforts for bolstering up the defence capabilities are an indispensable contribution to thoroughly containing the provocations of enemy countries and maintaining the strategic balance and stability in the region.
Japan's reckless possession of preemptive attack capability to put neighboring countries in the striking range while seeking a chance for reinvasion will, on the contrary, expose its archipelago to the attack by righteous regional countries as a common target. -0-

headline: Implementation of Regional Development Policy Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) -- Cities and counties of the DPRK are pushing ahead with the work to implement the regional development policy.
Kangdong County of Pyongyang Municipality directs efforts to securing hundreds of hectares of raw materials bases and increasing the fertility of soil.
Meanwhile, a project for improving the soil of raw material bases is going on in Pukchang County of South Phyongan Province, Paechon County of South Hwanghae Province, Sepho County of Kangwon Province, Sinpho City of South Hamgyong Province and other cities and counties.
Various counties including Jongphyong County of South Hamgyong Province, Puryong County of North Hamgyong Province and Koksan County of North Hwanghae Province sent delivery means, farm machines and small and medium farm implements to the raw material bases.
Sinyang County of South Phyongan Province and Ryonggang County of Nampho Municipality take measures to supply manpower needed for the operation of raw materials bases. Taegwan County of North Phyongan Province and other counties are concentrating their efforts on securing seeds of high-yielding sugar crop, oil crop and aromatic herbs.
Ragwon County of South Hamgyong Province is increasing the marine resources by creating artificial fish bank while introducing new aquicultural techniques and methods.
Kilju County of North Hamgyong Province and Kim Jong Suk County of Ryanggang Province have improved the educational conditions and environment of vocational technology colleges in their regions to make progress in training technicians and skilled workers.
Jangyon County of South Hwanghae Province and Janggang County of Jagang Province are encouraging the selected technicians and skilled workers to receive technical training at modern regional-industry factories and improve their technical skills through a tele-education system.
Cities and counties, where modern hospitals, leisure complexes and grain management stations are being built as model ones this year, are striving to train medical workers, service workers and skilled workers. -0-

Such missiles are modified version of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles possessed by the Japan Ground "Self-Defence Force", which are intended for attack even on the ground targets with about 1 000 km range, and the DPRK and the coastal areas of China are reportedly within their striking range.
Earlier, the Japan Ministry of Defence announced that it would deploy in 2026 high-speed gliding projectiles, a hypersonic weapon which proved successful in a test-fire. It also opened to public the research and manufacture of new-type ballistic missile with a range of 3 000 km.
Moreover, Japan secured the U.S approval for the sale of medium-range air-to-air missiles and long-range air-to-surface cruise missiles and is putting spurs on the building of long-range missile force while seeking to deploy the U.S.-made long-range cruise missiles Tomahawk.
This clearly shows that Japan's possession of preemptive attack capability, formulated through the revision of "national security strategy" at the end of 2022, is becoming a present perfect form and the descendants of the samurais, who had so far made a feint of being a "pacific nation" under the signboard of "exclusive defence" before the international community, have fully revealed their wild ambition of militarism.
Japan's possession of the capability for preemptive attack is an immediate product of the reinvasion policy to realize its ambition for the second "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", persistently pursued by Japan regarding it as a strategic goal while whetting a sword for revenge for 80 years since its defeat.
It is not a secret that the successive regimes of Japan have misled the public opinion with such absurd interpretation that the "possession of the capability of attacking enemy base" is within the limit of "self-defence", claiming that it is not the purport of the Constitution to sit and wait for self-destruction, and worked hard for its realization.
Not content with having staged joint military drills for aggression at all times by drawing unbidden guests from over continents and oceans into the Asia-Pacific region to constantly incite war fever, Japan is seeking to deploy even long-range strike means capable of rapidly attacking specific countries in the region any moment. This clearly shows that Japan's military expansion has been developed into an extremely grave stage.
Japan, a war criminal state which has much possibility to repeat its crime as it has totally denied and justified the past history of aggression, is going reckless to get the capability for preemptive attack on other country's territory beyond the borders of its archipelago in the near future. Such "bold action" is a dangerous provocation that will bring about constant escalation of tension by sowing the spark of new military conflict in Northeast Asia.
The rumor about "threat from its surroundings", so zealously clamored by Japan, is only for providing a pretext to cover up its reckless reinvasion war preparations going beyond its own defence demands, as illustrated by all-time high military spendings growing every year, frantic securement of preemptive attack means, constant strengthening of the Japan-U.S. military alliance and multilateral collusion and nexus with NATO forces.
Japan has worked hard to turn itself into a major military power, crying out for the "free and open Indo-Pacific", an expanded version of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere". Such moves make one keenly realize that the "imperial army", which inflicted indelible wounds on the peoples in the Asia-Pacific region, is being reborn.
All the facts go to clearly prove once again that all military means and various forms of movement directly targeting the DPRK as well as the aggressive and challenging consciousness against it are an object to be wiped out and that the DPRK efforts for bolstering up the defence capabilities are an indispensable contribution to thoroughly containing the provocations of enemy countries and maintaining the strategic balance and stability in the region.
Japan's reckless possession of preemptive attack capability to put neighboring countries in the striking range while seeking a chance for reinvasion will, on the contrary, expose its archipelago to the attack by righteous regional countries as a common target. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for Ministry of National Defence of DPRK Releases Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK on Thursday issued the following press statement titled "It is within the range of the option of the DPRK's armed forces to use the most deadly military means against the hostile forces seriously threatening the sovereignty and security of its state":
Recently the U.S. and the ROK military gangsters staged a special warfare drill aimed at "destroying the secret underground tunnel network" and "removing nuclear weapons" of someone as part of the large-scale war exercises Freedom Shield.
This proves that the joint military exercises of "defensive nature" much touted by the U.S. and the ROK are no more than a rehearsal of war of aggression aimed at invading and occupying the DPRK from A to Z.
During the period of Key Resolve and Foal Eagle joint military maneuvers in March 2016, the U.S. and the ROK staged the drills of "beheading operation" and "high-density strike" at strategic objects in accordance with OPLAN 5015. In 2017 they carried out "beheading operation" and "preemptive strike operation" drills targeting major military installations with a special unit more than 3 000-strong involved.
As the military provocations of the hostile countries are committed at the grave level that can never be overlooked and tolerated, clear is the stand of the DPRK's armed forces to counter them.
The DPRK's relevant law clearly stipulates what means and methods should be used in contingency to remove hostile forces threatening the existence of our state, and it is the mission of the armed forces of the DPRK to strictly observe and implement it.
All options for containing the U.S. and the ROK and for eliminating the source of provocation, if necessary, including the use of the most destructive and deadly military means, are under the consideration of our armed forces.
The accumulated reckless military moves of the U.S. and the ROK, seized with the daydream that they can jeopardize the sovereignty and security of a nuclear weapons state, can undoubtedly bring the gravest consequences they do not want.
The Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK strongly warns the U.S. and the ROK military to stop at once the irresponsible and dangerous military acts, issuing a warning once again about the catastrophic result to be entailed by the adventuristic saber-rattling of the hostile forces. -0-

headline: Russian Delegation of Security Council Visits Liberation Tower
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Security Council of the Russian Federation led by Secretary Sergei Shoigu on a visit to the DPRK laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on Friday.
Present there were Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and staff members of his embassy.

headline: Afforestation and Forest Conservation Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- Today is the International Forest Day.
Forest is a precious resource for human life and socio-economic development.
In the DPRK, where mountains make up the bulk of its territory, afforestation and forest conservation have been actively promoted as an important state policy.
Every year, trees of good species suited to the regional climatic and soil conditions are planted and cultivated on a mass scale to renew the appearance of land.
In the last decade, more than one million hectares of forests have been created through a forest restoration campaign. Last year alone, at least 2 billion saplings of 100-odd species were produced across the country through the persevering work to put the sapling production on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis.
Modern tree nurseries were built in provinces, cities and counties and forest science research bases built in different parts of country to contribute to turning the mountains into golden and treasure mountains.
This year, too, practical measures have been taken to improve the forest ecological environment of the country by stepping up the forest restoration with the main stress on the work to plant many trees of high economic value.
Many trees of good species including wild fruit trees are being planted across the country with spring season as an occasion. Tree nurseries have produced hundreds of millions of saplings needed for spring tree planting to ensure the smooth tree-planting.
Meanwhile, steps are taken to conserve forests, precious asset of the country, by establishing a well-regulated system for monitoring and notifying forest-fire and for extinguishment mobilization and producing various biological agrochemicals to stamp out forest insects in the right time.
Preparations are also being made to map out the national forest restoration plan with the main emphasis on improving the forest ecological environment and laying the foundation for regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Permanent Representative of DPRK at UN Office and International Organizations in Geneva Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- Jo Chol Su, permanent representative of the DPRK at the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva issued the following press statement titled "The U.S. act to use international body as a tool for implementing its strategy for hegemony can never be tolerated" on Friday:
The fact that the present U.S. Administration, which is bringing chaos and disorder to the international community with its unpredictable foreign policy, sent weird questionnaires to international organizations was out in the open, sparking off great uproar again.
It is reported that the questionnaires recently sent by the U.S. administration to UN organizations and non-governmental organizations contain dozens of questions on the influence of the activities of the relevant organizations on the security and economic fields of the U.S., their cooperative relations with organizations related to communism, socialism, totalitarian or anti-U.S. forces, and whether they have received funds from China, Russia, Cuba and Iran.
It is a product which can be cooked up only by the U.S., obsessed with the gangster-like hegemonic logic that all international relations should exist only for the interests of America, styling itself an ultra-privileged being reigning over the international community.
It is well known that the U.S. has earned an ill-fame as it has so far ignored international organizations including repeating its withdrawal from and entry into international organizations as if coming in and out of its own house and unhesitatingly wiretapping high-ranking officials of the UN.
However, the U.S. is trying to treat international organizations as an organ under the U.S. Department of State. This is far beyond arrogance and impertinence of the past, stunning the world people.
"Serious encroachment upon the internal activities of the UN bodies with independence" and "litmus paper examining the support for 'America first'" - these are the angry response of the international community to the U.S. questionnaires.
International organization, whose mission is to promote mutual exchange and cooperation among states and establish a fair international order, regards impartiality and objectivity as its fundamental principle for its specific feature and bans pressure and interference of a specific state.
If an international organization interferes in internal affairs of its member nation, raises unfair demand and gives pressure to it, following the demand of any individual country, it is already not an international body in a real meaning.
The questionnaires that can be called an "open threatening letter" prove that the U.S. is trying to subordinate the international organizations as the body executing "America first" policy which moves according to its baton and serves its interests.
The behavior of the present U.S. Administration which forces the international community to follow "America first" doctrine predicts the emergence of "McCarthyism" of the 21st century version.
Such behavior of inciting confrontation against the international trend aspiring after multipolarization deserves condemnation, and international community should remain vigilant so that the U.N. and other international organizations are not yielded to the unilateralism and arbitrary practices of the U.S. -0-

headline: Technical Innovation Emulation Brisk in Mining Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- Mines and smelteries in the mining industry of the DPRK conduct a brisk technical innovation emulation to boost the production.
The Jungsan Mine has over-fulfilled its daily plan for phosphorus concentrate production by pushing ahead with technical innovation to raise the operation rate of equipment.
While reinforcing the tunneling forces and giving precedence to securing cutting faces, Yongyu and Phungnyon mines have raised production results every day through updating of the technical performance of excavators and ore conveying equipment.
Munphyong and Manpho smelteries have conducted technical innovation emulations among workshops, workteams and shifts.  And the Unpha Mine and other nonferrous metal ore production units are bringing about a surge in production by introducing efficient blasting methods and raising the carrying capability. -0-

headline: Changgwang Health Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- It has been 45 years since the inauguration of the Changgwang Health Complex on the bank of the Pothong River in Pyongyang.
The complex making a practical contribution to the promotion of citizens' health and civilization is associated with the leadership of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The Chairman personally appointed the site for the health complex on the bank of the picturesque Pothong River and meticulously guided the whole course of its construction.
He visited the construction site several times to indicate the way for increasing the accommodation capacity of the health complex. And he stressed that 100 percent of water should be replaced every day at the complex, saying there should be no 1 percent of used water left in it to be visited by the people. Under his loving care, the complex was successfully built into a comprehensive welfare service center with all necessary conditions in nine months after the start of its construction.
On March 21, 1980, he visited the completed Changgwang Health Complex and gave a precious instruction on ensuring its smooth management and service to make all the people enjoy themselves there.
Over the past years, the complex has conducted its kind service activities to make the visitors enjoy the socialist cultural and emotional life to the full, while steadily improving the service conditions and environment. Every day, it renders such services at a high level as swimming, bathing and hair-dressing to thousands of customers, including war veterans, disabled soldiers and labor innovators,.
In those days, the complex won the Order of National Flag First Class, the title of Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag and the title of Thrice "Lathe No.26" Model Machine Prize and produced many recipients of state commendations and honorary title holders including Merited Barber. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Third National Meeting of Active Leaders of People's Neighbourhood Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with the participants in the third national meeting of active leaders of people's neighbourhood units on March 20.
The participants were filled with great excitement and joy, boundless happiness and pride as they were having a photograph taken with the benevolent MarshalKim Jong Unfor whom they have always yearned.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of photographing, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" in token of highest respect and boundless gratitude, looking up with emotion to the dear father of the great socialist family who bestows on them the greatest glory to be cherished as their lifelong wealth.
Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the exemplary leaders of people's neighbourhood units across the country, expressing deep gratitude to them who are devoting themselves to the work of the people's neighbourhood units, finding exceptional honour and pride and worth of living in consolidating the foundation of the people's government and taking warm care of the convenience of inhabitants in their living.
Saying that there are many duties to serve the people in our society but there is a rare name like the leader of a people's neighbourhood unit most closely and intimately linked to the people, he highly appreciated the noble spiritual world and unknown efforts of the leaders of a people's neighbourhood unit who are rendering their sincerity to the inhabitants and making the people's neighbourhood units the groups of patriots without wishing for any honour or reward.
He said that dongs and people's neighborhood units are the cornerstones supporting our people-centered state and social system and the base of the inhabitants' living and that the function and role of dongs and people's neighborhood units serve as the motive force dynamically propelling the advance of our state toward the comprehensive development. He stressed that to strengthen dongs and people's neighbourhood units precisely means consolidating of the mass foundation of the people's government and to achieve harmony and unity in the people's neighbourhood units precisely means the single-minded unity of our society firmly united with love and affection.
Noting that the duties of the chiefs of dong offices and leaders of people's neighbourhood units are very important in making sure that the efforts of the Party and the government for improving the people's living standards are led to the people's bright laughter, he added that the chiefs of dong offices and leaders of people's neighbourhood units should become the possessors of beautiful virtue and traits, genuine householders and kind-hearted eldest daughters-in-law who are preferably visited by everyone in line with the characteristics of their work keeping personal contact with inhabitants, so that beautiful human relations and noble moral ethics pervade the whole villages and people's neighbourhood units like air.
Expressing expectation and belief that the third national meeting of active leaders of people's neighbourhood units would serve as an important milestone whereby all the chiefs of dong offices and leaders of people's neighbourhood units turn dongs and people's neighbourhood units into a great single-minded family strong with patriotism and establish a noble and civilized socialist way of life throughout the whole society as genuine servants enjoying respect, trust and love from inhabitants, he had a significant photo session with them.
All the participants were filled with ardent enthusiasm to fully demonstrate the advantages of Korean-style socialism and make a tangible contribution to the prosperity and development of our great state by bringing about a fresh turn in the work of the people's neighbourhood units as required by the era of great changes out of their lifelong desire to repay the greatest love and trust shown byKim Jong Un. -0-

In 2017 they carried out "beheading operation" and "preemptive strike operation" drills targeting major military installations with a special unit more than 3 000-strong involved.
As the military provocations of the hostile countries are committed at the grave level that can never be overlooked and tolerated, clear is the stand of the DPRK's armed forces to counter them.
The DPRK's relevant law clearly stipulates what means and methods should be used in contingency to remove hostile forces threatening the existence of our state, and it is the mission of the armed forces of the DPRK to strictly observe and implement it.
All options for containing the U.S. and the ROK and for eliminating the source of provocation, if necessary, including the use of the most destructive and deadly military means, are under the consideration of our armed forces.
The accumulated reckless military moves of the U.S. and the ROK, seized with the daydream that they can jeopardize the sovereignty and security of a nuclear weapons state, can undoubtedly bring the gravest consequences they do not want.
The Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK strongly warns the U.S. and the ROK military to stop at once the irresponsible and dangerous military acts, issuing a warning once again about the catastrophic result to be entailed by the adventuristic saber-rattling of the hostile forces. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Third National Meeting of Active Neighbourhood Unit Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with the participants in the third national meeting of active neighbourhood unit leaders on March 20.
The participants were filled with great excitement and joy, boundless happiness and pride as they were to have a photograph taken with the benevolent MarshalKim Jong Un, whom they have always longed to see.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the photo session, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!" as a reflection of their highest respect and boundless gratitude, looking up with emotion to the dear father of the great socialist family who bestows on them the greatest glory to be cherished as their lifelong wealth.
Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the exemplary neighbourhood unit leaders from across the country, expressing deep gratitude to them for devoting themselves to the work of neighbourhood units, finding exceptional honour and pride and worth of living in consolidating the basic units of the people's government and taking warm care of the convenience of inhabitants in their living.
Saying that there are many jobs for serving the people in our society but rare is the appellation neighbourhood unit leader, most closely and intimately linked to the people, he highly appreciated the lofty spiritual world and unknown efforts of the neighbourhood unit leaders, who are showing their sincerity for the inhabitants and turning their units into groups of patriots without claiming any honour or reward.
He said that dong and neighbourhood units constitute a cornerstone supporting our people-centred state and social system and the base of the inhabitants' living, and that the functions and roles of dong and neighborhood units serve as a motive force dynamically propelling the advance of our state towards its comprehensive development. He stressed that to strengthen dong and neighbourhood units precisely means consolidating the mass foundation of the people's government and harmony and unity in the neighbourhood units precisely means the single-minded unity of our society firmly united with affection and tender feeling.
Noting that the duties of the secretaries of dong offices and leaders of neighbourhood units are very important in making sure that the efforts our Party and government make for improving the people's living standards are led to the people's bright laughter, he said that they should become possessors of beautiful virtue and traits and genuine householders and kind-hearted eldest daughters-in-law, who are welcomed and visited first by everyone, in line with the characteristics of their work--working directly with the inhabitants--to make beautiful human relations and noble moral ethics pervade the whole villages and neighbourhood units like the air.
Expressing expectation and belief that the third national meeting of active neighbourhood unit leaders would serve as an important milestone for all the secretaries of dong offices and leaders of neighbourhood units to turn dong and neighbourhood units into a great single-minded family strong with patriotism and establish a noble and civilized socialist way of life throughout the whole society as genuine servants enjoying respect, trust and love from inhabitants, he had a photo session with them.
All the participants were filled with ardent enthusiasm to fully demonstrate the advantages of Korean-style socialism and make a tangible contribution to the prosperity and development of our great state by bringing about a fresh turn in the work of the neighbourhood units as required by the era of great changes with their lifelong desire to repay the great affection and trust bestowed on them byKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Permanent Representative of DPRK at UN Office and International Organizations in Geneva Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- Jo Chol Su, permanent representative of the DPRK at the UN Office and international organizations in Geneva issued the following press statement titled "The U.S. act to use international body as a tool for implementing its strategy for hegemony can never be tolerated" on Friday:
The fact that the present U.S. Administration, which is bringing chaos and disorder to the international community with its unpredictable foreign policy, sent weird questionnaires to international organizations was out in the open, sparking off great uproar again.
It is reported that the questionnaires recently sent by the U.S. administration to UN organizations and non-governmental organizations contain dozens of questions on the influence of the activities of the relevant organizations on the security and economic fields of the U.S., their cooperative relations with organizations related to communism, socialism, totalitarian or anti-U.S. forces, and whether they have received funds from China, Russia, Cuba and Iran.
It is a product which can be cooked up only by the U.S., obsessed with the gangster-like hegemonic logic that all international relations should exist only for the interests of America, styling itself an ultra-privileged being reigning over the international community.
It is well known that the U.S. has earned an ill-fame as it has so far ignored international organizations including repeating its withdrawal from and entry into international organizations as if coming in and out of its own house and unhesitatingly wiretapping high-ranking officials of the UN.
However, the U.S. is trying to treat international organizations as an organ under the U.S. Department of State. This is far beyond arrogance and impertinence of the past, stunning the world people.
"Serious encroachment upon the internal activities of the UN bodies with independence" and "litmus paper examining the support for 'America first'" - these are the angry response of the international community to the U.S. questionnaires.
International organization, whose mission is to promote mutual exchange and cooperation among states and establish a fair international order, regards impartiality and objectivity as its fundamental principle for its specific feature and bans pressure and interference of a specific state.
If an international organization interferes in internal affairs of its member nation, raises unfair demand and gives pressure to it, following the demand of any individual country, it is already not an international body in a real meaning.
The questionnaires that can be called an "open threatening letter" prove that the U.S. is trying to subordinate the international organizations as the body executing "America first" policy which moves according to its baton and serves its interests.
The behavior of the present U.S. Administration which forces the international community to follow "America first" doctrine predicts the emergence of "McCarthyism" of the 21st century version.
Such behavior of inciting confrontation against the international trend aspiring after multipolarization deserves condemnation, and international community should remain vigilant so that the U.N. and other international organizations are not yielded to the unilateralism and arbitrary practices of the U.S. -0-

headline: University Graduates in DPRK Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites
story_text:

A graduate of Cha Kwang Su Sinuiju University of Education resolved to become a soldier on the outpost of ideological front of the Workers' Party of Korea, whose mission is to firmly arm the people with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu while glorifying the immortal revolutionary exploits of the peerlessly great persons in the battle sites of Mt Paektu forever.
Graduates of Sinuiju Teachers Training College and Songdo University of Education vowed to work at schools in mountainous areas and islet branch schools, with the desire to leave distinguished trace as revolutionary teachers responsible for the future of the country, whether they are known and recognized or not.
Among the volunteers are graduates determined to work as teachers at rural schools, true to the Party's policy on reducing the difference in the educational level between town and countryside.
At meetings held on spots to congratulate those volunteers, speakers requested all graduates to glorify the honor of patriotic youth in the vanguard of the struggle for realizing the Party's plan and intention and fulfill their duties as frontline soldiers on the ideological front of the Party and as persons directly responsible for the education of the rising generation.

story_text:

The Jungsan Mine has over-fulfilled its daily plan for phosphorus concentrate production by pushing ahead with technical innovation to raise the operation rate of equipment.

headline: Changgwang Health Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- It has been 45 years since the inauguration of the Changgwang Health Complex on the bank of the Pothong River in Pyongyang.
The complex making a practical contribution to the promotion of citizens' health and civilization is associated with the leadership of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The Chairman personally appointed the site for the health complex on the bank of the picturesque Pothong River and meticulously guided the whole course of its construction.
He visited the construction site several times to indicate the way for increasing the accommodation capacity of the health complex. And he stressed that 100 percent of water should be replaced every day at the complex, saying there should be no 1 percent of used water left in it to be visited by the people. Under his loving care, the complex was successfully built into a comprehensive welfare service center with all necessary conditions in nine months after the start of its construction.
On March 21, 1980, he visited the completed Changgwang Health Complex and gave a precious instruction on ensuring its smooth management and service to make all the people enjoy themselves there.
Over the past years, the complex has conducted its kind service activities to make the visitors enjoy the socialist cultural and emotional life to the full, while steadily improving the service conditions and environment. Every day, it renders such services at a high level as swimming, bathing and hair-dressing to thousands of customers, including war veterans, disabled soldiers and labor innovators,.
In those days, the complex won the Order of National Flag First Class, the title of Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag and the title of Thrice "Lathe No.26" Model Machine Prize and produced many recipients of state commendations and honorary title holders including Merited Barber. -0-

headline: Afforestation and Forest Conservation Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- Today is the International Forest Day.
Forest is a precious resource for human life and socio-economic development.
In the DPRK, where mountains make up the bulk of its territory, afforestation and forest conservation have been actively promoted as an important state policy.
Every year, trees of good species suited to the regional climatic and soil conditions are planted and cultivated on a mass scale to renew the appearance of land.
In the last decade, more than one million hectares of forests have been created through a forest restoration campaign. Last year alone, at least 2 billion saplings of 100-odd species were produced across the country through the persevering work to put the sapling production on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis.
Modern tree nurseries were built in provinces, cities and counties and forest science research bases built in different parts of country to contribute to turning the mountains into golden and treasure mountains.
This year, too, practical measures have been taken to improve the forest ecological environment of the country by stepping up the forest restoration with the main stress on the work to plant many trees of high economic value.
Many trees of good species including wild fruit trees are being planted across the country with spring season as an occasion. Tree nurseries have produced hundreds of millions of saplings needed for spring tree planting to ensure the smooth tree-planting.
Meanwhile, steps are taken to conserve forests, precious asset of the country, by establishing a well-regulated system for monitoring and notifying forest-fire and for extinguishment mobilization and producing various biological agrochemicals to stamp out forest insects in the right time.
Preparations are also being made to map out the national forest restoration plan with the main emphasis on improving the forest ecological environment and laying the foundation for regional rejuvenation. -0-

He noted that we should open up a new era when the shipbuilding industry undergoes a rapid change and we should guarantee that it changes without fail.
To this end, it is necessary to perfect the machinery of the shipbuilding industry on an effective basis, intensify the policy and technical guidance, give top priority to the work of rapidly raising the level of modernization in the shipbuilding industry as a whole and ensure a national and widespread support to it in a sustainable way, he stressed again.

He made a relevant conclusion on the important issues arising in carrying out the huge plan for strengthening the material and technical foundation of the dockyard, repeatedly stressing that the dockyard, which is the reliable large-scale shipbuilding base of the country and boasts of its wonderful history and tradition of self-reliance, should become a core and engine in the ongoing struggle to usher in a new era of the development of the shipbuilding industry. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Secretary of Russian Security Council
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on March 21 received Sergei Shoigu, secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation, on a visit to the DPRK as the head of the Security Council delegation.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Ungladly met Sergei Shoigu visiting Pyongyang again in six months and had a talk with him in a trustworthy and warm atmosphere.
Sergei Shoigu courteously conveyed the friendly greetings and an important autograph letter from Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to the DPRK leader.
Kim Jong Unexpressed his deep thanks for it and conveyed his militant greetings to the respected Russian president.
At the talk, there was a wide-ranging exchange of views and opinions between the leaderships of the DPRK and Russia on the important issues for defending the security interests of the two countries and international justice and on the regional and international situation. The talk confirmed the consensus of stand on the part of both sides.
Noting that the special military operations being conducted by the Russian army and people serve as a demonstration of the indomitable strength, patriotism and just cause,Kim Jong Unstated that it is the steadfast option and resolute will of the DPRK government to invariably support Russia in the struggle for defending the national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests in the future, too.
The talk expressed the willingness of the leaderships of the two countries to unconditionally implement the provisions of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
Kim Jong Unhad an important and useful conversation with Sergei Shoigu on the prospective projects for further expanding and boosting the exchange and cooperation in security and other  many-sided fields.
Wishing victory, prosperity, happiness and fortune always to the Russian people in the future, he conveyed warm wishes to the respected President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin of the Russian Federation and to its government, army and people. -0-

headline: Project for Rational Use of Water Resources Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) -- March 22 is World Water Day.
Water is a source of life and a precious and essential resource indispensable to human life.
A brisk project is going on in the DPRK to manage and use water resources in a rational way.
This year the DPRK Law on Water Resources was amended and supplemented to provide a strong legal guarantee for the central land and environment protection guidance organ, the central underground resources development guidance organ and other relevant institutions to regularly grasp and control the survey, prospecting, development, protection and use of water resources.
Importance is given to the water conservation in the country. The water resources sector is promoting the work to manage reservoirs well, establish a proper irrigation system and raise the utilization rate of water resources.
The water environment and water ecological sectors are taking measures to thoroughly prevent water pollution and preserve and protect aquatic ecosystem.
The water control sector has directed efforts to establishing a unified machinery system and a proper water control system with the watershed as a unit.
Achievements have been made in the research for making effective use of water resources.
An IT product was developed to regulate water level at reservoirs and an advanced technology for securing and making effective use of water resources in rural areas was introduced into practice. -0-

headline: More Senior Middle School Graduates in DPRK Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) -- Senior middle school graduates in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK have joined the ranks of those who volunteered for military service, regarding the national defence as the most vivid expression of patriotism and as their most sacred duty and foremost mission.
The graduates of Susan and Paekryong senior middle schools in Kangso District volunteered in group to go to forefront border posts with the determination to become honorable defenders of the country and people's security.
Those of Onchon County vowed to join the People's Army with their firm determination to defend their native places and the precious country at the risk of their lives.
Tens of graduates from Husan Senior Middle School in Ryonggang County pledged to take arms of the revolution and deal a merciless sledge-hammer blow at the U.S. imperialists and the puppet group seeking to bring the dark clouds of war again, oblivious of the lesson of history.
Many graduates in Chollima, Taean and other districts of the municipality, too, volunteered to stand on the forefront of defending the country.
At meetings and congratulatory stages held in relevant areas, war veterans handed over the flags of the DPRK to the rising generation out in defending the country. -0-

story_text:

headline: Project for Rational Use of Water Resources Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) -- March 22 is World Water Day.
Water is a source of life and a precious and essential resource indispensable to human life.
A brisk project is going on in the DPRK to manage and use water resources in a rational way.
This year the DPRK Law on Water Resources was amended and supplemented to provide a strong legal guarantee for the central land and environment protection guidance organ, the central underground resources development guidance organ and other relevant institutions to regularly grasp and control the survey, prospecting, development, protection and use of water resources.
Importance is given to the water conservation in the country. The water resources sector is promoting the work to manage reservoirs well, establish a proper irrigation system and raise the utilization rate of water resources.
The water environment and water ecological sectors are taking measures to thoroughly prevent water pollution and preserve and protect aquatic ecosystem.
The water control sector has directed efforts to establishing a unified machinery system and a proper water control system with the watershed as a unit.
Achievements have been made in the research for making effective use of water resources.
An IT product was developed to regulate water level at reservoirs and an advanced technology for securing and making effective use of water resources in rural areas was introduced into practice. -0-

headline: Modernization of Meteorological Observation and Forecast Propelled in DPRK
Spring Tree Planting Brisk in South Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Organizations of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK are arousing the agricultural workers to spring tree planting.
The provincial committee of the UAWK has generalized the experience of advanced units in tree planting and introduced positive deeds made by agricultural workers so that everyone can take part in tree planting voluntarily.
The Mundok County Committee of the UAWK mapped out a plan to secure tens of thousands of saplings and create pine-nut tree, Evodia daniellii Benn and oil-bearing chestnut tree forests in one hundred and tens of hectares of mountains. And it has encouraged its officials and agricultural workers to devote their sincere efforts to carrying it into practice.
The Phyongwon County Committee of the UAWK is intensifying a socialist emulation to plant more trees of good species and high economic value in the forests of hundreds of hectares by arousing agricultural workers in the county.
The Taedong County Committee of the UAWK worked out a plan to create forests of raw materials for paper in tens of hectares of mountains and is encouraging its officials and agricultural workers to plant bamboo willow and Sangwon poplar trees.
UAWK committees in Tokchon City and Hoechang and Sinyang counties, too, are directing efforts to creating woodland of high economic effectiveness and high utilization value. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on March 19 to mark the 76th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Andrei Rudenko, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and personages of government, parliament and institutions of Russia, including the State Duma, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology, the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Transport.
DPRK Ambassador Sin Hong Chol and staff members of his embassy were on hand.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
Then they looked round photos dealing with the noble revolutionary careers and exploits of the President and the Chairman, the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations and the tremendous might and eye-opening development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception. -0-

headline: Modernization of Meteorological Observation and Forecast Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- March 23 is World Meteorological Day.
Now, when cooperation among countries is getting closer with the rapid development of science and technology, signal progress has been made in the worldwide meteorological observation and forecast.
The meteorological sector of the DPRK is making successes in the work to put the meteorological observation and forecast on a modern and scientific basis of higher level.
The National Meteorological Forecast Squad confirmed the rational indices of forecasting system on the basis of the analysis of rainfall in recent years and steadily improved the scientification level of the short-term weather forecast model, thus further raising the exactness of short- and medium-term forecasts.
It has also paid attention to bettering the long-term agricultural weather forecast system to perfect in a scientific way the methods of forecasting drought expected in spring and heavy rainfall expected in autumn and of forecasting weather data such as temperature, precipitation and percentage of sunshine.
The meteorological observation sector is pushing ahead with the work to expand and introduce to the whole country the county-level early warning system for downpour and flooding that was already applied on a trial basis to Songchon County of South Phyongan Province.
It also directs steady efforts to putting the nationwide ground meteorological observation on a higher level and developing and introducing advanced observation devices and means.
The DPRK, which joined the World Meteorological Organization in May 1975, has striven to further improve the weather forecast and boost international cooperation in this field. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Units in Sukchon County
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected various units in Sukchon County of South Phyongan Province.
Going round the regional-industry factories, wonderfully built in Sukchon County to demonstrate the validity and vitality of the WPK's regional development policy, he encouraged officials and employees making devoted efforts to provide the inhabitants with diverse quality foodstuffs and daily necessities in a larger quantity.
He underscored the need to take thorough measures for supplying raw materials in conformity with the natural, geographical and economic conditions of the region, methodologically conduct lecture on science and technology and passing-on technique for employees in touch with relevant fields and continue to direct efforts to the establishment of cultured practices in production and life so that the light industrial bases built under the care of the Party can prove effective.
Learning about the spring tree-planting plan and the sapling production at the Sukchon County Forest Management Station, he called for selecting good species of trees conducive to the afforestation of the county and the development of regional industry, planting them in the right time and manuring and tending them in a scientific and technological way to raise the survival rate to the maximum.
Acquainting himself with the construction of greenhouse for cultivating rice seedlings at the Yakjon Farm, he stressed the need to study and introduce the latest sci-tech data and learn from the experience of advanced units so as to turn it into a greenhouse substantially contributing to the growth of grain production at the farm.
He stressed that the Sukchon County People's Committee should further enhance the role of explainers of judicial affairs and enhance the law-abiding spirit of the masses through a movement for winning the title of model law-observance unit and that deputies to the people's assemblies at all levels should fulfill their responsibility and duty as representatives of the people in implementing the Party's decisions.
Going round the Namyang Salt Works, Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need to conduct a dynamic mass technical innovation movement and increase the proportion of mechanization to firmly guarantee the sustained growth of production. -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Ninety young people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at difficult and labour-consuming fields called by the Party.
More than 40 youths in Sunchon, Kaechon and Tokchon cities and Pukchang County volunteered to work in the coal industry and those in Phyongwon, Jungsan and Sukchon counties advanced into the county construction brigades and raw material base stations.
Those in Yangdok and Mundok counties pledged to go to the highway management stations, goat farms and other worksites.
A meeting took place in Phyongsong City to congratulate those young volunteers.
Present there were Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, youth league officials and young people.
Certificates were awarded to the volunteers and there were a congratulatory address and oath-taking speeches.
Officials and young people saw off the volunteers leaving for their new posts. -0-

headline: Work for Implementing Regional Development Policy Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- The non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy is stepping up the work to make preparations for the operation of hospitals under construction in Kangdong County of Pyongyang Municipality, Ryonggang County of Nampho Municipality and Kusong City of North Phyongan Province.
The committee set in a rational way the scale of training nurses and dentists and other technical personnel to work at those three hospitals and launched the project for training them in a short time.
The work is also going on in various forms and ways to improve the academic qualifications and medical skills of medical workers of the said hospitals and prepare them to handle modern medical equipment skillfully.
Medical workers, technicians and skilled workers are encouraged to widen their intellectual horizon in the course of technical training through a telemedicine system, while disseminating the advanced medical technology data to the hospitals.
Competent medical workers from the central-level hospitals are conducting on the spots a project for passing diagnostic and treatment methods suited to the development trend of modern medicine.
The committee also directs efforts to perfecting and introducing the advanced intelligent medical service system in order to put all medical service processes and management and operation of at city and county hospitals on an IT basis. -0-

Expressing the stand that Bulgaria would continue to develop the long-standing friendly relations with the DPRK, he hoped that everything would go well in the DPRK. -0-
