headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Conducting Brisk Socialist Emulation among Provinces, Cities and Counties
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Monday in an editorial calls for more dynamically kindling the flames of the socialist emulation for implementing the policies of the Workers' Party of Korea among provinces, cities and counties in order to accelerate the comprehensive prosperity and development of our state.
It is the traditional leadership method of the WPK to give fullest play to the revolutionary enthusiasm and creative ingenuity of the officials, Party members and other working people and make uninterrupted innovations and development on all fronts of socialist construction by conducting the brisk socialist emulation, the editorial says, and goes on:
The WPK set forth the most revolutionary and scientific fighting strategy for turning the whole country into an ideal land of the people and is leading its implementation powerfully and certainly. It stressed the need for the provinces, cities and counties to conduct the brisk socialist emulation and achieve independent and multi-faced development.
When the socialist emulation is briskly conducted in provinces, cities and counties as intended by the Party, the ideological and spiritual traits of officials, Party members and other working people will be raised to suit the prestige and status of a powerful country, substantial progress be made in implementing the new regional development policy and the general advance for overall prosperity and development of our state be accelerated.
Officials, Party members and other working people across the country should positively take part in the emulation for implementing the Party's policies with a white gem-like loyalty and ardent patriotism to the Party and thus steadily increase the good results of glorifying a new era of regional rejuvenation.
All the officials, Party members and other working people should conduct the brisk emulation among provinces, cities and counties, true to the intention of the Party to accelerate more rapidly and viably  the prosperity and development of our state and the promotion of the people's well-being, and thus glorify this year as a year of great changes to be specially recorded in the history of the country. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Institute for Disarmament and Peace of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The Institute for Disarmament and Peace of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Monday made public the following press statement "It is our inevitable option to further accelerate the self-defensive efforts to ensure the security interests of the country from the regional security environment getting instable day after day":
Despite the serious concern of the international community, the U.S. and its vassal allies staged the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 from March 10 to 20.
Freedom Shield, which has been certainly staged every year to destabilize the situation in the Korean peninsula, reached the highest level in its aggressive and offensive nature this year.
The Institute for Disarmament and Peace of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK publishes this press statement to inform the international community of how dangerous and reckless military provocation the large-scale war exercises Freedom Shield staged by the U.S. and the ROK under the pretext of "defensive" and "annual" rehearsal are and why the DPRK's efforts to deter the military moves of the enemy states are just.

Freedom Shield Started from the Outset of the Year in Reality

It is a cross-sectional view to construe that the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield of the U.S. and the ROK started on March 10.
It is not exaggeration to say that the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill with the involvement of a B-1B strategic bomber of the U.S. Air Force in the sky over the Korean peninsula in January was a preliminary drill for Freedom Shield in reality.
The U.S. has continuously staged various kinds of joint military drills with its satellites in the region, including the ROK, from the outset of the year, getting frantic with the creation of preliminary atmosphere for the full-scale operation of Freedom Shield.
From January to March, the U.S. had successively staged such joint military drills under different names aimed to master war scenarios for striking the in-depth area of the DPRK as "Ssangmae drill", "combined arms live-firing drill", "joint search drill", "joint integrated firepower live-firing drill" and "joint special strike drill".
On January 15, it introduced a formation of B-1B strategic bombers into the sky over the Korean peninsula to conduct a joint air-to-ground live-firing drill with the ROK. On February 10, it made the attack nuclear submarine Alexandria call at the Pusan operational base and, on February 20, mobilized a B-1B strategic bomber formation again to conduct a provocative joint air drill.
In particular, on March 2, it committed a military provocative act of deploying in the region of the Korean peninsula a nuclear carrier strike group, which consists of the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson, Aegis cruiser Princeton, Aegis destroyer Sterett and others.
Four years have passed since the start of Freedom Shield, but the U.S. strategic offensive means had never been deployed in the Korean peninsula in a sequential way and in succession on the eve of the exercises as seen above.
This proves that this year's Freedom Shield is a more premeditated and provocative nuclear war rehearsal staged by the U.S. and its satellites on the basis of full examination of their war readiness.

Aggressive and Offensive War Drills from A to Z

The recent joint military exercises Freedom Shield were conducted in a multi-domain space, including ground, sea, air, cyber and outer space in an all-round way for the first time in the history of joint drills staged by the U.S. and the ROK. And the number of brigade-level field mobile drills increased six times the last year's as it was 16, the biggest in history.
The U.S. involved in the joint military exercises a lot of aggression forces and military hardware, including the U.S. Eighth Army, the U.S. Seventh Air Force, the U.S. Space Force, the U.S. Seventh Fleet and the Third Expedition and the First Division of the U.S. marines.
During the joint military exercises, the U.S. and the ROK staged such provocative military drills aimed at attack on a belligerent party as the joint air strike drill of paratroops, the mountain warfare drill of marine troops, the drills of special warfare troops for special reconnaissance of enemy's interior and strike at enemy's core facilities and the drills of armored troops for breaking through enemy's defense line and occupying major bases.
What should not be overlooked is that OPLAN 2022, a war scenario under the simulated conditions of "a preemptive strike" at the DPRK's nuclear facilities worked out according to the "nuclear operations guidelines" cooked up by the U.S. and the ROK in July last year, was officially applied to the recent joint military exercises.
A typical example is that the U.S. and ROK military gangsters staged a joint special warfare drill for "destroying someone's secret underground tunnel network" and "removing nuclear weapons" by mobilizing armored and special warfare forces, reconnaissance drones and artificial intelligence attack robots from March 17 to 20.
In particular, the U.S. conducted a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint naval drill with the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson task force involved in the waters off the Korean peninsula, timed to coincide with the joint military exercises Freedom Shield.
Lurking behind the war drills the U.S. staged together with its satellites by mobilizing large-scale marine troops including the nuclear carrier is its sinister design to link Freedom Shield with the tripartite joint naval drill and expand the scope of the U.S.-ROK joint military exercises into the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint military exercises in future.
As above-seen, this year's Freedom Shield revealed its offensive nature as a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint military rehearsal and as a multinational war drill involving even the troops from twelve member states of the "UN Command".
The threatening nature of Freedom Shield, which is being turned into a more expanded and offensive anti-DPRK war rehearsal, fully proves that the enemy states' military attempt to contain the DPRK by upper-hand in hegemonic strength has developed into a more dangerous level.

Inevitable Choice by DPRK to Defend Regional and Global Peace

Shortly ago, international affairs analysts said that the U.S.-ROK joint military rehearsal Freedom Shield more clearly shows its aggressive nature of targeting not only the DPRK but also other countries in the region, adding that this is part of the U.S. world strategy for securing military domination over the Asia-Pacific region.
Such comments hint that the Freedom Shield and other various joint military drills staged by the U.S. and its satellites in and around the Korean peninsula are becoming the core means for carrying out Washington's strategy for hegemony to contain not only the DPRK but also strategic rivals in the region and that the U.S. war drills will be further expanded in the future.
The continuity of military drills for aggression in the Korean peninsula, where the belligerents are in acute confrontation and where is under mature condition in which an accidental spark may develop into a destructive armed conflict, is driving the regional situation into an uncontrollable state no one can predict.
The fact that pro-U.S. countries including NATO member states have joined the U.S.-led joint military drills including Freedom Shield, pursuant to the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, predicts that a military conflict in the Korean peninsula will be by no means limited between the DPRK and the U.S. but it will inevitably lead to the start of a new world war.
The case of accidental attack by fighters of the ROK near the southern border of the DPRK on the eve of the recent Freedom Shield served as a vivid occasion for the international community to imagine the disastrous consequences to be entailed by the war exercises being staged by the U.S. and the ROK under the signboard of "defensive" and "annual".
It is an inevitable option of the DPRK to make more self-defensive efforts to ensure its security interests from the regional security environment which is getting instable with each passing day.
The absolute value of defending the sovereignty and stability is to provide the most powerful war deterrence capable of always preemptively containing the military provocations of the enemy states and definitely steering the situation.
The genuine defence capability precisely means the powerful offensive capability and it is the most confident guarantee for preventing a war and effectively deterring and controlling any threat and blackmail of the aggressors to acquire the formidable offensive capabilities no one can stop, the overwhelming striking capabilities.
The DPRK will steadily upgrade and bolster up its strong counteraction capability of all categories, able to overwhelmingly contain any military moves of the enemy states seriously threatening its sovereignty and security interests, and reliably defend peace and security in the region and the rest of the world as a responsible nuclear weapons state. -0-

headline: Traditional Fish-Pickling Culture
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The Korean people have long used pickled fish as one of their diets. In the course they created an excellent fish-pickling culture.
Shells of dozens of kinds of shellfish, including clams, scallops and short neck clams, fish bones, pots, and earthenware were discovered at the historical Kungsan site in Unha-ri, Onchon County of the DPRK. These relics show a part of the culture of pickling fish created by the Korean people.
According to a history book in other country, all the people from palace to hovel of Koryo (918-1392) had taken pickled fish dishes.
If fish is pickled, lots of protein contained in fish flesh and intestines is dissolved into amino acid and peptide, which give peculiar flavor and savory taste with the flavor of a sauce.
Pickled fish dishes have special effects on the prevention of thrombus and aging. They are also efficacious to the prevention and treatment of adult diseases as they have an anticancer effect.
The Korean people's excellent fish-pickling culture (tiny shrimp pickling) was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage.
Under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, a modern fish pickling factory appeared in the Kumsanpho area on the west coast.
This Kumsanpho Fish Pickling Factory produces at least 50 kinds of pickled dishes with 23 sorts of fishes at present.
The factory won the top prize at the national exhibitions of processed seafood, which have been held for several years, and its products were highly appreciated as the most excellent ones. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The Institute for Disarmament and Peace of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on Monday made public the following press statement "It is our inevitable option to further accelerate the self-defensive efforts to ensure the security interests of the country from the regional security environment getting instable day after day":
Despite the serious concern of the international community, the U.S. and its vassal allies staged the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025 from March 10 to 20.
Freedom Shield, which has been certainly staged every year to destabilize the situation in the Korean peninsula, reached the highest level in its aggressive and offensive nature this year.
The Institute for Disarmament and Peace of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK publishes this press statement to inform the international community of how dangerous and reckless military provocation the large-scale war exercises Freedom Shield staged by the U.S. and the ROK under the pretext of "defensive" and "annual" rehearsal are and why the DPRK's efforts to deter the military moves of the enemy states are just.

Freedom Shield Started from the Outset of the Year in Reality

It is a cross-sectional view to construe that the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield of the U.S. and the ROK started on March 10.
It is not exaggeration to say that the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill with the involvement of a B-1B strategic bomber of the U.S. Air Force in the sky over the Korean peninsula in January was a preliminary drill for Freedom Shield in reality.
The U.S. has continuously staged various kinds of joint military drills with its satellites in the region, including the ROK, from the outset of the year, getting frantic with the creation of preliminary atmosphere for the full-scale operation of Freedom Shield.
From January to March, the U.S. had successively staged such joint military drills under different names aimed to master war scenarios for striking the in-depth area of the DPRK as "Ssangmae drill", "combined arms live-firing drill", "joint search drill", "joint integrated firepower live-firing drill" and "joint special strike drill".
On January 15, it introduced a formation of B-1B strategic bombers into the sky over the Korean peninsula to conduct a joint air-to-ground live-firing drill with the ROK. On February 10, it made the attack nuclear submarine Alexandria call at the Pusan operational base and, on February 20, mobilized a B-1B strategic bomber formation again to conduct a provocative joint air drill.
In particular, on March 2, it committed a military provocative act of deploying in the region of the Korean peninsula a nuclear carrier strike group, which consists of the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson, Aegis cruiser Princeton, Aegis destroyer Sterett and others.
Four years have passed since the start of Freedom Shield, but the U.S. strategic offensive means had never been deployed in the Korean peninsula in a sequential way and in succession on the eve of the exercises as seen above.
This proves that this year's Freedom Shield is a more premeditated and provocative nuclear war rehearsal staged by the U.S. and its satellites on the basis of full examination of their war readiness.

Aggressive and Offensive War Drills from A to Z

The recent joint military exercises Freedom Shield were conducted in a multi-domain space, including ground, sea, air, cyber and outer space in an all-round way for the first time in the history of joint drills staged by the U.S. and the ROK. And the number of brigade-level field mobile drills increased six times the last year's as it was 16, the biggest in history.
The U.S. involved in the joint military exercises a lot of aggression forces and military hardware, including the U.S. Eighth Army, the U.S. Seventh Air Force, the U.S. Space Force, the U.S. Seventh Fleet and the Third Expedition and the First Division of the U.S. marines.
During the joint military exercises, the U.S. and the ROK staged such provocative military drills aimed at attack on a belligerent party as the joint air strike drill of paratroops, the mountain warfare drill of marine troops, the drills of special warfare troops for special reconnaissance of enemy's interior and strike at enemy's core facilities and the drills of armored troops for breaking through enemy's defense line and occupying major bases.
What should not be overlooked is that OPLAN 2022, a war scenario under the simulated conditions of "a preemptive strike" at the DPRK's nuclear facilities worked out according to the "nuclear operations guidelines" cooked up by the U.S. and the ROK in July last year, was officially applied to the recent joint military exercises.
A typical example is that the U.S. and ROK military gangsters staged a joint special warfare drill for "destroying someone's secret underground tunnel network" and "removing nuclear weapons" by mobilizing armored and special warfare forces, reconnaissance drones and artificial intelligence attack robots from March 17 to 20.
In particular, the U.S. conducted a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint naval drill with the nuclear carrier Carl Vinson task force involved in the waters off the Korean peninsula, timed to coincide with the joint military exercises Freedom Shield.
Lurking behind the war drills the U.S. staged together with its satellites by mobilizing large-scale marine troops including the nuclear carrier is its sinister design to link Freedom Shield with the tripartite joint naval drill and expand the scope of the U.S.-ROK joint military exercises into the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint military exercises in future.
As above-seen, this year's Freedom Shield revealed its offensive nature as a U.S.-Japan-ROK joint military rehearsal and as a multinational war drill involving even the troops from twelve member states of the "UN Command".
The threatening nature of Freedom Shield, which is being turned into a more expanded and offensive anti-DPRK war rehearsal, fully proves that the enemy states' military attempt to contain the DPRK by upper-hand in hegemonic strength has developed into a more dangerous level.

Inevitable Choice by DPRK to Defend Regional and Global Peace

Shortly ago, international affairs analysts said that the U.S.-ROK joint military rehearsal Freedom Shield more clearly shows its aggressive nature of targeting not only the DPRK but also other countries in the region, adding that this is part of the U.S. world strategy for securing military domination over the Asia-Pacific region.
Such comments hint that the Freedom Shield and other various joint military drills staged by the U.S. and its satellites in and around the Korean peninsula are becoming the core means for carrying out Washington's strategy for hegemony to contain not only the DPRK but also strategic rivals in the region and that the U.S. war drills will be further expanded in the future.
The continuity of military drills for aggression in the Korean peninsula, where the belligerents are in acute confrontation and where is under mature condition in which an accidental spark may develop into a destructive armed conflict, is driving the regional situation into an uncontrollable state no one can predict.
The fact that pro-U.S. countries including NATO member states have joined the U.S.-led joint military drills including Freedom Shield, pursuant to the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, predicts that a military conflict in the Korean peninsula will be by no means limited between the DPRK and the U.S. but it will inevitably lead to the start of a new world war.
The case of accidental attack by fighters of the ROK near the southern border of the DPRK on the eve of the recent Freedom Shield served as a vivid occasion for the international community to imagine the disastrous consequences to be entailed by the war exercises being staged by the U.S. and the ROK under the signboard of "defensive" and "annual".
It is an inevitable option of the DPRK to make more self-defensive efforts to ensure its security interests from the regional security environment which is getting instable with each passing day.
The absolute value of defending the sovereignty and stability is to provide the most powerful war deterrence capable of always preemptively containing the military provocations of the enemy states and definitely steering the situation.
The genuine defence capability precisely means the powerful offensive capability and it is the most confident guarantee for preventing a war and effectively deterring and controlling any threat and blackmail of the aggressors to acquire the formidable offensive capabilities no one can stop, the overwhelming striking capabilities.
The DPRK will steadily upgrade and bolster up its strong counteraction capability of all categories, able to overwhelmingly contain any military moves of the enemy states seriously threatening its sovereignty and security interests, and reliably defend peace and security in the region and the rest of the world as a responsible nuclear weapons state. -0-

headline: South Phyongan Province's Efforts for Development of Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK directs efforts to developing the regional education.
The province strengthens the teachers' forces in cities and counties, sets up technical senior middle schools in areas with distinct economic and geographical characteristics, and helps the other areas to organize technical classes.
In order to introduce the elective system from the new school year of next year, the province has selected various senior middle schools as model schools for the education of literature and natural science, and helped draw up curriculums and teaching programs.
Universities organize various short courses for teachers and guide the application of the research-type teaching and studying methods. -0-

headline: Scientific Research Intensified at Academy of Fishery Science
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The West Sea Offshore Farming Institute under the Academy of Fishery Science of the Ministry of Fisheries in the DPRK is making valuable scientific research achievements to push ahead with the development of offshore farming.
Last year the institute introduced functional bottom material amendment and seaweed growth stimulants made out of natural minerals abundant in our country to reduce the mortality of shellfish, sea cucumber and jellyfish and the incidence of diseases of laver and kelp while increasing the production of aquaculture by more than 1.3 times.
It also succeeded in raising the productivity of young sea cucumbers and increasing the per-hectare yield of laver by 1.2 times even at high temperature.
This year, its researchers are working hard to survey and determine the amount of marine resources and production potential in the coastal waters of South Hwanghae Province, to preserve kelp species and select heat-resistant kelp plants in the West Sea, introduce biological activators into the fishing sector and breed high-yielding sea cucumbers so as to open up a bright prospect for increasing seafood production. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Agricultural Sector in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 25 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of the agricultural sector in South Hwanghae Province.
Going round agricultural production units in Jaeryong, Sinchon, Pyoksong, Kangryong, Chongdan and other counties, the premier learned in detail about the immediate farming, giving pep-talks to the agricultural workers who are making full farming preparations to attain this year's grain production goal set forth by the WPK.
In order to make South Hwanghae Province, a granary of the country, play an important role in the state's grain yield, all officials should actively introduce advanced farming methods, regarding the scientific farming as their lifeline, and give detailed guidance over the overall farming and the fulfillment of plan according to farming season, displaying powerful executive abilities, he stressed.
He called for taking a timely measure to supply farming materials to the areas with unfavourable farming conditions, scrupulously organizing and conducting the work to cope with disastrous abnormal weather in a foresighted way and manuring and cultivating earlier wheat and barley to suit their growth state so as to reap a good harvest in the production of early-ripening crops.
Going round irrigation facilities in the province and the Paechon County Farm Machine Station, he stressed the need to direct primary efforts to the maintenance and repair of drainage canals and waterway structures and the normal operation of water pumps and other equipment and conduct a brisk technical innovation movement to decisively improve the quality of accessories necessary for the manufacture and repair of different kinds of farm implements.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for relevant units to supply farming and other materials in time to South Hwanghae Province, the issue of intensifying the research for improving the tideland farming, the issue of increasing the per-hectare yield by properly conducting the work for sharing and disseminating the experience of high-yield units.
The premier also inspected the newly-built Kangryong County Wheat Processing Factory to learn about its construction, the operation of equipment and the supply of raw materials, calling for making the full preparations for its inauguration. -0-

headline: U.S. Doctrine of Strength-almighty Doesn't Work in Security Domain of DPRK: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 25 (KCNA) -- Timed to coincide with the climax of the U.S.-ROK large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield 2025, the U.S.-Japan-ROK naval drill directly aimed at the DPRK was simultaneously staged in the waters off Jeju Island from March 17 to 20.
The tripartite naval drill, frantically staged for four days with the involvement of big and small warships of three countries led by the U.S. nuclear carrier Carl Vinson task force, which has incited the war fever in the waters around the Korean peninsula from the beginning of this month, and various kinds of warplanes including the fifth-generation stealth fighter F-35, further aggravated the serious political and military situation in the region.

headline: Immortal Programme for Development of Juche-oriented Sports
story_text:

headline: Unprecedented Order of Supreme Commander
story_text:
One day in January 2014, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected a fish-freezing facility built by a unit of the Korean People's Army.
He said that the aim of his visit was to discuss the possibility of providing fish to all the baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans and old people's homes in the country.
Stressing it is the firm determination and will of the Workers' Party of Korea to make all the orphans grow up happily and healthily as successors to the revolution and backbones of the revolution without knowing the sorrow of having no parents, he calculated in his pocketbook how many fishes should be supplied to them in a year if each of them eats 300 grams of fish per day.
He said that the KPA should take charge of the work to supply fish to the baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans and old people's homes all the year round. And he issued on the spot an order of the KPA Supreme Commander on setting up a KPA fishery station in charge of the fish supply exclusively for them.
Noting that the fishery station should be built into a model one with the highest level, he chose the site for the station and the design and construction units and took all measures to supply materials and equipment, recruit fishermen and provide fishing boats and fishing tackle.
The story about the order issued by the Supreme Commander on the spot while looking round a fish-freezing facility on the distant shore is a legendary story of love that could be created only in our socialist country led by the father of the people. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Moves for Reinvasion
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 26 (KCNA) -- Japan, a war criminal state, is stepping up the battle formation to launch a war for reinvasion.
On March 24, it officially inaugurated an "integrated operation command" comprehensively commanding the Ground, Maritime and Air "Self-Defense Forces" for the practical use of long-range missiles.
Prior to this, it was disclosed that Japan is going to deploy U.S.-made intermediate-range missiles for action in the archipelago and home-made missiles with a range of about 1 000 km in Kyushu.
The reality proves that the Japanese militarists' overseas aggression is no longer imagination or speculation but a fait accompli, and it is as clear as noonday that the DPRK will be the first target of their attack.
Japan, a defeated nation gnashing its teeth with revenge, has concentrated all efforts on the scheme to turn itself into a war state capable of invading other countries again anytime over the past 80 years.
Such preparations are now accelerated at the final stage.
Japan created environment and conditions for joining a war anytime by forming an Asian version of NATO based on the U.S.-Japan-ROK military alliance system in the Northeast Asian region, zealously pursuant to the U.S. aggression moves for hegemony, and by establishing its independent full-time mission at NATO in January this year. And it is putting spurs to the revision of the constitution to turn itself into a "state capable of fighting a war" at an early date.
Japan's arms buildup is also at serious stage.
It was announced that the amount of weapons purchased by Japan from abroad in recent years has nearly doubled as compared with the past, 97 percent of them imported from the U.S. Such survey data draw the attention of the international community.
This year alone, Japan is going to purchase a large quantity of various kinds of strike means, including intermediate-range air-to-air missile and air-to-ground long-range cruise missile from the U.S., while getting more frantic than ever before to further increase the range of missiles it has already developed and possessed.
Amid the successive commissioning of various kinds of warships to stand in the van of overseas aggression, a project for moving the commands of the SDF to underground was launched and the purchase of large transport planes is being stepped up to ensure the rapid transfer of armed forces to the continent. Shortly ago, Japan inaugurated even a maritime transport force of the SDF.
Japan's moves for getting familiar with war of aggression are going beyond precedent.
In January, it staged the largest-ever parachute drill aimed at a sudden preemptive attack by inviting troops of 11 countries such as the U.S. and Britain to the archipelago and conducted the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint air drill in the sky near the Korean peninsula. In February, it dispatched even a virtual aircraft carrier to the waters out of its territory to frantically stage a drill for overseas aggression with the U.S. and other war forces across the ocean.
In March, Japan also conducted saber-rattling with riff-raffs in the waters around it. Not content with this, it took part in the U.S.-Japan-ROK naval drill recently conducted in the waters near Jeju Island, openly flying the "flag of rising sun shedding rays".
It is clear what it means to step up the deployment of long-range strike means for action and establish a command system for their use in an actual war, under such environment in which Japan is pushing the situation to the extreme.
Japan has accelerated its institutional and military preparations for aggression on the continent at the final stage and created an international climate for them.  It is now advancing into a line of fire to invade the continent.
It is a matter of time for Japan to fire the first gun for reinvasion.
The Japanese militarists, the sworn enemy of the Korean people, should be clearly mindful that the line of fire Japan is daring to approach will be turned into its bottomless grave. -0-

headline: Graduates of Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans Volunteer for Military Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 26 (KCNA) -- Graduates of Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans have volunteered to join the Korean People's Army.
110 graduates volunteered for military service, being aware that it is their bounden duty and natural obligation to make proud military feats on the road of national defence.
A meeting of those volunteers took place on March 25.
Present there were officials concerned and officials and students of the school and a war veteran. A congratulatory address and speeches were made.
The war veteran handed over the sacred national flag of the DPRK to the graduates with the request of the victorious wartime generation who wish them to reliably defend the precious country with arms.
The volunteers pledged to win victory and demonstrate honor in defending the country and the revolution with their love for the socialist country and hatred for the enemies. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Railway Transport of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 26 (KCNA) -- A hundred and tens of engine drivers at the Ministry of Railways of the DPRK have over-fulfilled their first quarterly plans amid the brisk drive to transport more materials to the grand economic construction theaters.
More than 100 engine drivers of several engine service brigades under the Pyongyang Railway Bureau carried out the first quarterly plan ahead of schedule and are striving to accomplish their first half-yearly and yearly plans earlier than scheduled.
Engine drivers of the Kaechon Engine Service Brigade under the Kaechon Railway Bureau and the Cholsong Engine Service Brigade under the Chongjin Railway Bureau, in touch with dispatchers of relevant stations and railway bureaus, frequently check the state of loading and reduce the stoppage time at the departing and arriving stations to transport a lot of materials to different sectors of the national economy.
Those of engine service brigades under the Hamhung Railway Bureau and the Rason Railway Bureau have increased the rate of locomotive operations by conducting inspections on a normal basis while registering high results in freight transport. -0-

headline: Onpho Hot Spring in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 26 (KCNA) -- In Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, there is the Onpho Hot Spring that has been well-known as it is very good for human health and treatment.
According to an old record, this hot spring has been used by many people at least 500 years ago.
The area of this hot spring, located in a cozy valley surrounded by mountains, is very good for climatotherapy for its fine climate and thick forest. And it is a scenic place where the hot spring water swells in all seasons.
The Onpho Hot Spring is designated as a natural monument.
The main ingredients of the hot spring are simple silica and radon spring, which are efficacious for such diseases as chronic gastritis (hyperacidity), chronic enterocolitis, chronic bronchitis, slight diabetes, obesity, neuritis, neuralgia, trauma and operation sequelae, eczema and disorder of autonomic nervous system.
While guiding the project for newly building the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp on the spot, the respected ComradeKim Jong Ungave instructions on further improving the service conditions and the treatment environment level so that the hot spring therapy can contribute to the promotion of people's health and their enjoyment of civilization.
Now, the construction is underway in this area to build a comprehensive cultural recreation centre, a medical service centre for the people, under the wise guidance of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Seminar Held in Sports Field of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 26 (KCNA) -- A seminar in the field of sports took place at the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports of the DPRK on March 25 to mark the 10th anniversary of the publication of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's famous work "Let Us Usher in a New Golden Age in Building a Sports Power in the Revolutionary Spirit of Paektu".
Speeches were made there by Minister Kim Il Guk, Vice-Minister Pak Chon Jong and Department Director Pak Yong Il of Physical Culture and Sports, Ri Tong Chol, president of the Academy of Sports Science, and Kim Chun Sik, director of the Secretariat of the National Sports Guidance Committee.
Speakers said thatKim Jong Un's work is a great action programme as it indicated the path of building a sports power.
The ideas and theories advanced by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unare still shining as a powerful ideological and theoretical weapon vigorously encouraging with extraordinary traction and vitality the DPRK people and sportspersons in their struggle to put the country's sports on a higher stage, they noted.
They said that making sports mass-based and part of everyday life is an important content of the sports policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
They noted that the Party's policy on sports is the people-centered one on sports as it indicates the way for the state to fully ensure the promotion of the people's health and physical training in a responsible manner and conduct brisk mass sports activities.
They said that to push forward with the project for putting the sports on a scientific basis is a fundamental requirement for steadily developing the country's sports technology.
They added that the realization of putting sports on a scientific basis is an important guarantee for putting the technical development of various sports events on a steady upward stage and accelerating the development of overall sports events on the basis of successes and experience.
They called upon the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports and sports guidance organs at all levels to map out and organize the work for implementing the Party's policy on sports in a far-sighted way and further boost the enthusiasm for competition among sports clubs and the enthusiasm for mass sports. -0-

headline: Vol. 33 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 27 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 33 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection ofKim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea which comprehensively deals with the classic works of PresidentKim Il Sungin a chronological order.
The book contains 51 classic works including historic speeches, talks, reports and conclusions made by the President in the period from October 1958 to February 1959.
In his works "On the Method of Party Work" and "Concluding Speech at the February 1959 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea", the President comprehensively clarified the issues arising in the Party work, including the one for Party's organizations to give correct guidance to peripheral organizations, fully explain the Party's policies to the masses and unite them closely behind the Party.
Among the works are those indicating the concrete tasks and ways for turning the countryside into a rich and cultured socialist one by carrying out the technical and cultural revolutions in the countryside.
Some works deal with important guidelines to be held fast to in implementing the Party's construction policy, including providing the specialized construction companies with sufficient construction equipment, introducing prefabricated construction, standardizing designs, industrializing the production of building parts and elements and mechanizing the construction.
The book also contains famous works giving clear answers to the theoretical and practical problems arising in various fields of the revolution and construction, including the issue of training technicians and experts on a large scale, the issue of improving the material and cultural living of workers and the issue of actively protecting and propagating useful animals and plants. -0-

The Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau has ensured the continuity of processes and introduced a transport method suited to the mountainous conditions.

headline: Scientists and Technicians in DPRK Strive for Implementation of Regional Development Policy
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 27 (KCNA) -- Members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians, dispatched to the non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy, are conducting research activities to successfully implement the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea through science and technology.
Scientists ofKim Il SungUniversity successfully solved the sci-tech problems arising in the development of essential oils.
Those of the State Academy of Sciences introduced a profitable innovation into the soap production line at a daily necessities factory, and those of the Food and Consumer Goods Research Institute under the Ministry of Regional Industry calculated the standard index value for raising the quality of wheat paste.
Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry resolved the irrational problems in the packing line at a foodstuff factory, in cooperation with scientists and technicians from various units in Jagang Province, thus contributing to improving the quality of foodstuff.
Scientists and technicians of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering and various units of Kangwon Province solved the problems arising in the soy and bean paste production line by devising and introducing a rational equipment-manufacturing innovation. And scientists of Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce resolved the problems arising in the operation of sewing equipment at worksites and improved the workers' technique and skills.
The Academy of Forest Science has conducted a brisk campaign to provide a sci-tech guarantee for increasing the timber production in the forests for paper materials. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Defence Science Research Work
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the defence science research work of the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Complex and the detective electronic warfare research group on March 25-26.
Accompanying him were Pak Jong Chon and Jo Chun Ryong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Pyong Chol, general advisor for the munitions policy of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, and other senior officials of the WPK Central Committee and defence science research institutes.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about various kinds of reconnaissance and suicide attack drones, newly developed and being produced by an institute and enterprises under the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Complex, and oversaw their performance test.
Proved at the test was the innovative performance of a new-type strategic reconnaissance drone with the detective ability capable of tracking and monitoring different strategic targets and enemy troops' activities on the ground and the sea. And fully demonstrated was the striking capability of suicide drones to be used for various tactical attack missions.
Kim Jong Unmade an important evaluation of the military effectiveness and strategic value of the strategic reconnaissance drone with improved performance and the suicide attack drones with the introduction of new artificial intelligence.
He positively supported the new plans of the complex and agreed with its proposal for expanding the production capacity.
Saying that the field of unmanned equipment and artificial intelligence should be top-prioritized and developed in modernizing the armed forces, he stressed it is important to correctly shape the state long-term plan for promoting the rapid development of the work to use intelligent drones and perseveringly and dynamically propel it as a medium and long-term project, in keeping with the trend of modern warfare in which the competition for using intelligent drones as a major means of military power is being accelerated and the range of their use is steadily expanding in military activities.
As already stated, a lot of objective transformation being made under the rapid sci-tech development calls for updating a large part of our military theory, practice and education, he said, adding it is an important task facing our Party to adopt a correct line and solution proper for it.
Saying that the WPK shaped a clear line for perfectly combining unmanned weapons and equipment systems with operational plans and fundamentals of battle, regarding it as an important component of modernizing the armed forces to put weapons and equipment on an unmanned basis, he re-clarified the scientific and practical orientation and ways for successively accelerating the qualitative and quantitative and technical transformation in the development and production of unmanned weapons and equipment and putting operational ability on a highly-developed basis.
He learned about the performance of reconnaissance and intelligence gathering means and electronic jamming and attack systems newly developed by the detective electronic warfare research group and its long-term plan.
He said that our special means developed with up-to-date technology would play a big role in monitoring the potential threats and collecting vital intelligence and they would give full play to their might in enhancing our army's capability of conducting various kinds of intelligence-gathering operations and neutralizing the enemy's combat means of various missions.
Expressing great satisfaction over the fact that new electronic jamming and attack weapon systems began to be produced, he noted with high appreciation that the stages of the WPK's line of modernizing the army are being qualitatively attained, thanks to the clear brains of our younger generation defence science research group.
Saying that the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Complex and the detective electronic warfare research group have a very important role to play in coping with the developing modern war of today characterized by confrontation between intelligent hi-tech weapon systems, he gave an important task related to the immediate duty and the long-term goals to be attained by this sector. -0-

headline: Sowing Rice Seeds Brisk in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- Sowing rice seeds in nurseries is now in full swing at the farms in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
Farms in Haeju City, Anak County and other areas fully secured farming materials including vinyl sheet, arch support and straw matting and have registered high results, examining weather and soil conditions.
Farmers in Kangryong and Jangyon counties have sown seeds in nurseries in a responsible and meticulous manner.
Agricultural workers in Unryul, Songhwa and Samchon counties have spread humus, organic fertilizer, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassic fertilizer on nurseries and adjusted the amount of seeds according to the sorts of rice seedlings.
Sinchon, Pongchon, Chongdan and other counties have properly set the sorts and period of sowing according to farm fields and raised the role of technological workers in applying various methods of cultivating seedlings, including dry-field cold-bed rice seedlings, to ensure the speed and quality of sowing rice seeds. -0-

headline: New Historical Remains Found in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- The remains of Sojin Fort, a mud castle in the period of the Imjin Patriotic War, were unearthed and ascertained in Sangam-ri, Kangnam County, Pyongyang Municipality of the DPRK.
A research group of the Pyongyang Municipal Agency for National Heritage Conservation and the Archaeological Institute of the Academy of Social Sciences has deepened the survey and unearthing of historical remains.
In the course, the remains of Sojin Fort were found at the site about 1.2 kms away northeast of the Sangam-ri seat.
The fort is a well-known combat position, in which the 400-odd Rim Jung Ryang volunteers of Korea killed thousands of Japanese aggressors when the latter invaded the Walled City of Pyongyang in 1592, a period of the Imjin Patriotic War.
Preserved in the township of Junghwa County, North Hwanghae Province, is a memorial telling about the fort. Written in it are the combat merits of the Rim Jung Ryang volunteers who had formed a camp in the west of Junghwa district.
The fort was an earthen castle built along the edge of hills, and it was a long oval in its plane shape from the north to the south.
The present castle wall remains in the upper east and north of the hills and only trace in the lower west and south.
The castle remains are about 1 010m in circumference, and found there during the excavation were relics like porcelain and ceramic pieces used by the people at that time.
The then castle was a clay-filled earthen wall, and the present remains of it are located 200 metres away from a shrine in Kangnam, a historic site.
The remains of Sojin Fort are of high academic value and educational significance as they are associated with the proud combat feats of Korean ancestors who bravely defeated the Japanese invaders.
The Archaeological Society of the DPRK admitted that the remains of Sojin Fort dating back to the feudal Joson Dynasty (1392-1910) are of weighty historic significance. And the Non-permanent Tangible Heritage Examination and Appraisal Committee evaluated the remains' value and registered them as a preservation historic site. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Remodeled Korean Revolution Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- At least 2.277 million officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students in the DPRK have visited the Korean Revolution Museum for the last eight years since it was remodeled as a great hall of national treasure of Juche Korea on March 30, 2017. Through the visit to it, they came to more firmly cherish the precious revolutionary traditions and the indomitable revolutionary faith and will to carry them forward.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who unfolded a far-reaching plan to turn the museum into the best one without an equal in the world, personally initiated a remodeling project and guided its layout and plan for exhibition several times. He visited the remodeled museum to clearly indicate the specific orientation and ways for further enriching the treasure house for education in the revolutionary traditions and intensifying education through it.
Thanks to the devoted efforts of officials and lecturers at the museum, the Hall of Revolutionary Comrades-in-Arms and others were newly established and more than 12 190 revolutionary relics and data newly exhibited. As a result, the character of the museum as a great hall of national treasure of Juche Korea has been elevated, and the museum has creditably fulfilled its mission and role as a base for education like a textbook positively contributing to the accomplishment of the cause of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
More than 84 000 officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students from over 1 180 units have visited the museum this year when an all-people struggle is dynamically going on to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as a glorious one of victors. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Remodeled Korean Revolution Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- At least 2.277 million officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students in the DPRK have visited the Korean Revolution Museum for the last eight years since it was remodeled as a great hall of national treasure of Juche Korea on March 30, 2017. Through the visit to it, they came to more firmly cherish the precious revolutionary traditions and the indomitable revolutionary faith and will to carry them forward.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who unfolded a far-reaching plan to turn the museum into the best one without an equal in the world, personally initiated a remodeling project and guided its layout and plan for exhibition several times. He visited the remodeled museum to clearly indicate the specific orientation and ways for further enriching the treasure house for education in the revolutionary traditions and intensifying education through it.
Thanks to the devoted efforts of officials and lecturers at the museum, the Hall of Revolutionary Comrades-in-Arms and others were newly established and more than 12 190 revolutionary relics and data newly exhibited. As a result, the character of the museum as a great hall of national treasure of Juche Korea has been elevated, and the museum has creditably fulfilled its mission and role as a base for education like a textbook positively contributing to the accomplishment of the cause of modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
More than 84 000 officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students from over 1 180 units have visited the museum this year when an all-people struggle is dynamically going on to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as a glorious one of victors. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Brisk in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- Trade union organizations in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK are boosting the enthusiasm and competitiveness of the working masses in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Workers and trade union members of the Chollima Steel Complex have increased the production of iron and steel by raising the utilization rate of equipment after securing more than 72 000 tools of 250-odd kinds.
Those of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, Nampho Port and the municipal communication management bureau invented and introduced valuable technical innovation proposals and thus contributed to improving the performance of equipment and modernizing the production lines.
The trade union committees in Kangso and Chollima districts are making sure that all their members fulfill their civic duty in the spring tree-planting, manuring and tending and forest-fire prevention through a socialist emulation for the vigorous forest restoration campaign and the movement for winning the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
Workers and trade union members in the municipality including Hanggu and Waudo districts sent to farms manure secured through a mass-based movement.
Officials and trade union members of the municipal people's committee, the municipal regional-industry management bureau, the metal construction company and other units sent 700-odd small tools to the Kangso Coal Mine. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on WPK's Unshakable Determination
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- A new era of socialist cultural efflorescence welcomed by all the people is ushering in the country, Rodong Sinmun Sunday in an article says, and goes on:
The phrase - groundbreaking accompanied by inauguration - has naturally come into common use amid the high admiration as the great entities of creation and change are appearing one after another in the capital city and regions, in the countryside and fishing villages. The present eye-opening reality is a vivid picture visually showing how the future of a prosperous power dreamed by the people is approaching and what the simultaneous and multiple development of the whole country is.
Our people are now naturally singing the song that the Workers' Party of Korea's policy for the people is good, while deeply experiencing the advantages of the socialist system by heart, not in words or writings. What all of them have keenly felt in this great era is remarkable transformation in the country where everything is definitely changing under the care of our Party.
Steadfast is the will of the WPK to clearly show how honest it is before the great people and what sincere and do-or-die exertion it displays for their destiny and future, through unconditional accomplishment of the historic cause for turning all parts of the country into a paradise for the people.
Today our Party is defending its noble name as the motherly party for the people through its devoted practice as it is guided by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho has regarded it as his unshakable creed to make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unis hewing out the sacred revolution for comprehensive development of regions to gratify the long-cherished desire of the people across the country and ushering in a new era of high civilization and prosperity shining with the laughter and improved well-being of the people.
The more clearly the country's development is known and the more eye-opening changes are made in various fields of state and social life, the stronger the people's aspiration and desire are growing to uphold higher the people's Party, country and world and the higher the dignity and might of a powerful country are being displayed.
Steadfast is the determination of the WPK to bring about epochal changes through ceaseless creation and struggle and thus build the most powerful socialist country in the world, the paradise desired by the people, in the near future.
Thanks to our great motherly Party that regards the people-first principle as its noble political idea and devotes itself to the people, the whole country will be turned into a people's paradise better to live in, along with the steady appearance of miraculous entities and eye-opening events unprecedented in the world. -0-

headline: Motivation Activities Brisk at Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex in the DPRK is conducting frontline-style information and motivation activities to boost the enthusiasm for increasing the production of Juche iron.
The enthusiasm for the revolution and patriotism of the working class of the complex are being boosted through the frontline-style mobile motivation activities with great appeal in diverse combination of explanation of the greatness of the Workers' Party of Korea, agitprop by loudspeaker van in the morning rush hour and visual motivation.
Officials have increased the efficiency of the political work at worksites and their families encouraged the workers through peculiar motivation activities at the blast furnace shop No. 1 and steel shop No. 2.
Touring the worksites, primary information workers of the trade union at the complex are conducting field political work to make the workers glorify this significant year with increased production of Juche iron by carrying forward the tradition of loyalty and patriotism of the working class of the preceding generations who supported the Party with steel. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Production of Fireproof Materials
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- Units in the fireproof materials industry of the DPRK make innovations in production.
The Jangsan Mine over-fulfilled its production plan for January and February 1.6 times and 2 times, and has steadily increased the production on a daily average in March, too.
The Ramjong Mine carried out its plans for January and February by 104 percent and 122 percent respectively and has produced a larger amount of fireproof materials than planned every day in March, too.
Officials and workers of the Yuson Coal Mine and the Taesong Mine are increasing the production to glorify this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud labor achievements. -0-

headline: Movement for Winning Title of Socialist Patriotic Forest Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- Many units in the DPRK are making successes through a movement for winning the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
After the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest was instituted in February 2015, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and other units won the title in January 2019 for the first time. And the number of units honored with the title has increased every year in provinces, cities and counties of the country.
This year alone, hundreds of units, including the Equipment Assembly Station of the Kangdong Hydro-power Construction Complex, the Namjong Farm of the South Hwanghae Provincial Rural Economy Committee and the Kyongwon County Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, were awarded the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
Nearly ten thousands of units have won the title over the past decade. -0-

headline: Grand Short Course of KCU Instructors of Schools Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- A grand short course of Korean Children's Union (KCU) instructors from schools across the country took place here from March 26 to 29 for the first time in its history.
Present there were Choe Tong Myong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ju Chang Il and Kim Jong Sun, department directors of the C.C., WPK, Kim Sung Du, minister of Education, officials of the Central Committee and provincial, city and county committees of the youth league, officials of sector related to the affairs with schoolchildren and KCU instructors from across the country.
Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made an opening address.
He said that the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Untook a measure to significantly organize the grand short course and gave detailed instructions on the preparations for it.
Expressing conviction that the grand short course would serve as an epochal occasion for all the KCU instructors and officials related to the affairs with schoolchildren to bring about a fresh development in the work of KCU organizations at schools, true to the idea of the respected fatherly Marshal on training the new generation, he declared the grand short course opened.
Then,Kim Jong Un's teachings on the Children's Union work were conveyed.
A report was made at the grand short course.
The reporter said that the ideas and policies on the work of the Children's Union set forth by the respected fatherly Marshal are the precious guidelines to be held fast to in the work of the Children's Union in the new era.
The deep trust and love of the great father, who honored the instructors with the precious title of designers, operators and doers in the work of the Children's Union, has served as the motive force that made them follow only the road of loyalty and repayment with unflagging enthusiasm, he noted.
The successes made by many school Children's Union organizations across the country proved that it is possible to prepare all schoolchildren to be genuine successors to the revolution and pillars of building a thriving nation only when the instructors work heart and soul with conscience and sincerity.
The report analyzed a series of shortcomings revealed in the work to improve the method of educating the Children's Union members, strengthen the KCU organizations of schools and enhance their role.
The reporter said that today the Children's Union instructors are faced with the honorable duty to prepare all the KCU members to be young revolutionaries and patriots who would firmly shoulder the future of powerful Korea, adding that the success in this important and responsible revolutionary work depends on the new determination, preparedness, extraordinary efforts and hard work of all the Children's Union instructors across the country.
He stressed that all the school Children's Union instructors should regard the WPK's ideology on the KCU work as the immutable guidelines and organize and implement every work as instructed by the respected fatherly Marshal.
The reporter called on all the participants to further strive for the good mental growth of the KCU members and for the development of the glorious KCU, bearing deep in mind the sacred mission and duty they have assumed before the Party and the revolution, the country and the people.
Then, there was a short course on theoretical and practical issues arising in bringing about innovations in the work of Children's Union instructors.
The short course dealt with the issue for the Children's Union instructors to fully play their role as political guardians in firmly preparing the Children's Union members to be young revolutionaries and patriots intensely loyal to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
There was a lecture on the need to conduct the education of Children's Union members in a substantial way by actively studying new methods in conformity with their level of consciousness, psychological characteristics and actual conditions.
The short course dealt with the issue of intensifying the guidance over the Children's Union members' study and organizational life and the issue of more briskly organizing and conducting the good-conduct movement and socio-political activities for giving benefits to the country's economic life and contributing to building a powerful socialist country.
It had a question-and-answer and an explanation lecture on the practical matters arising in the Children's Union work and a lecture on the fact that the era of a great power unprecedented in the history of the nation spanning 5 000 years is being ushered in under the wise guidance of the respected fatherly Marshal.
The grand short course heard experience speeches. -0-

headline: Assistance to Educational Sector Gains Momentum
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces and Nampho Municipality of the DPRK are striving to consolidate the material and technical foundations of the educational field.
Officials and working people of many units in North Phyongan Province, including the provincial rural economy committee, the provincial public prosecutors office, the provincial foreign trade administration bureau, the provincial regional-industry management bureau, the Sinuiju Textile Mill and the Ponghwa Chemical Factory, have rendered sincere assistance to the educational field.
Support organizations in Jongju City and Nyongbyon, Pakchon, Tongchang and Changsong counties sent various kinds of school furniture, educational equipment and experimental and practical apparatuses to educational institutions.
Officials of the South Hamgyong Provincial Rural Economy Committee provided materials necessary for strengthening the educational foundation of Hamhung University of Agriculture. And the February 8 Vinalon Complex, the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex supplied lots of building materials and experimental apparatuses to Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, Hamhung Middle School for Orphans and other educational units.
Hochon, Yodok, Kumya and other counties provided equipment necessary for putting the education on a modern and IT basis.
Nampho Municipality has sent materials to schools and universities to help them improve educational conditions and environment in the new school year. -0-

headline: Juche Idea - Great Guiding Ideology in Era of Independence
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- On March 31, 1982, ChairmanKim Jong Ilmade public his famous work "On the Juche Idea".
The work is an encyclopedic library and a great programme of the revolution that comprehensively deals with the Juche idea, which PresidentKim Il Sungfounded and thoroughly applied in the course of the decades-long revolutionary struggle, and systematizes its theories and principles.
The publication of the work helped clarify the world-historic position and epochal role of the Juche idea and made it possible for the Korean people and the progressive mankind of the world to victoriously advance the cause of independence of the popular masses, the cause of socialism, under the banner of Juche.
Thanks to the energetic ideo-theoretical activities of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the Juche idea has been formulated as Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and steadily developed and enriched as required by the times and the developing revolution.
The General Secretary solemnly declared that only the road of Juche is the immutable path to be followed by our Party and people and the ever-victorious banner of our revolution is the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
The great fighting programmes and ever-victorious strategic and tactical guidelines clarified by him reflect his iron will to solve all the problems arising in the revolution and construction as required by Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism from A to Z.
The DPRK's overall national power and strategic position have reached the highest level in the vortex of complicated world politics and factories and enterprises for improving the people's standard of living have been built one after another. Such eye-opening reality clearly proves once again the validity and great vitality of the great Juche idea.
Thanks to the leadership of the respected General Secretary, the immortal ideo-theoretical exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwill shine century after century and the DPRK will further demonstrate its might as a socialist power of Juche forever. -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Grow in Number in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- Youths in South Hwanghae Province and Rason Municipality of the DPRK have joined the ranks of young vanguard advancing into theatres for implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Graduates of Haeju Kim Jong Thae University of Education and Haeju Jo Ok Hui Teacher Training College determined to work as teachers at schools on remote islets and in mountainous areas.
Young people in Rason Municipality volunteered to work at difficult and labor-consuming posts of socialist construction.
Those in Rajin District pledged to advance into the construction mechanization brigade, water supply and sewerage management station, etc.
Those in Sonbong District decided to work at a coal mine and a fishery station.
Meetings to congratulate the volunteers took place in the relevant areas.
Speeches of the volunteers vowing to devote themselves to the education of the rising generation and bring about collective innovations touched the heartstrings of the participants.
Officials and young people in South Hwanghae Province and Rason Municipality gave bouquets to the volunteers and encouraged them. -0-

headline: Preparations for New School Year Finished in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- Teaching preparations for the new school year have been completed in the DRRK.
The Ministry of Education organized various short courses for implementing the educational programmes in the new school year to help teachers improve their practical qualifications and prepare for teaching.
Universities across the country completed the work for reshaping the teaching programs so as to raise the specialty of students and conducted the preparations for teaching programs.
Teachers of primary schools and junior and senior middle schools in the field of general education worked heart and soul to develop various teaching methods suited to the psychological characteristics of schoolchildren and conducive to raising their cognitive ability, while possessing qualifications to successfully conduct teaching.
Technical senior middle schools provided modern conditions for ensuring experiments and practical training specified in teaching schedule.
Meanwhile, teacher retraining units at all levels organized workshops to improve the qualifications of teachers. -0-

headline: DPRK Player Sets New Record at 20th Asian Marathon Championships
DPRK Wrestler Bags Gold Medal
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- DPRK wrestlers have proved successful at the 2025 Asian Wrestling Championship.
Han Chong Song advanced into the finals on March 29 (local time) after beating all his rivals in the 57kg category of freestyle wrestling.
In the finals, he beat his Iranian rival 8:1 to take the first place.
Meanwhile, Kim Kwang Jin bagged a bronze medal in the 65kg category of freestyle wrestling. -0-

headline: Russian Party Delegation Visits Liberation Tower
Russian Party Delegation Visits Liberation Tower
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- The visiting delegation of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation led by Kazbek Taysaev, secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma, laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on March 31.
Present there were officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Russian ambassador to the DPRK.
A wreath in the name of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation was placed at the Liberation Tower.
The participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the fallen fighters of the Soviet Army, who dedicated their precious lives to the sacred war for the liberation of Korea with noble internationalist spirit, before looking round the tower. -0-

headline: Consistent Policy of WPK and DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- A new school year began in the DPRK with due ceremonies at universities and schools across the country.
Education is an important undertaking that gives continuity to our revolution and propels the development of the country. So, definite priority should be given to the educational work, and this work for the rising generation should neither be interrupted nor neglected even though there are lots of difficulties. This is the idea and policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state on attaching importance to education.
A new heyday of the development of Juche-oriented education is being ushered in the country under the wise guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho regards the educational work as the first state affair and spares nothing for the rising generations.
The universal 12-year compulsory education was enforced and children's camps and palaces including the Songdowon International Children's Camp and the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace were renovated.
Remodeled were many schools, branch schools and kindergartens across the country, and teachers training colleges were built in all provinces.
Under the loving care of the Party and the state which set it as a consistent and eternal, national policy to provide all the schoolchildren with uniforms and school things at the state expense, a well-regulated system for supplying school uniforms, bags and footwear to all the schoolchildren in the country has been established with the factories producing them built in all provinces.
Mindulle-branded notebooks and other school things are produced on a normal basis for the children and schoolers.

headline:

[2025.04.01.]

Acquainting himself with the construction state, the Chairman saw large concrete pillars standing behind a folding screen-style apartment house.
