headline:
Tideland Reclaimed under Guidance of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.04.01.]
story_text:
One day in June 1960, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited Onchon County in South Phyongan Province (at that time) of the DPRK.
He told officials that he would inspect tideland that day.
The President got out of his car on a rough road and climbed an embankment bounding the tideland.
Looking at the tideland for a long time, he said to officials with satisfaction that if the tideland was reclaimed, the grain production would be increased.
Then, he suggested going ahead into the muddy field.
He told the hesitating officials that if there was no way, they should open up the road for the people, and took the first step.
Whenever he stepped forward, his shoes were caught in the mud and his clothes were dirty by splashing muddy water, but he continued to walk ahead of others.
When he arrived at the middle of the tideland, he looked round and said it would be very good to reclaim the tideland and its prospect was very good.
He also selected a site where a new sea dyke would be built and gave instructions on the construction of other structures. He even personally chose a site for building a new residential quarter in the future. He called for reclaiming the tideland on a large scale and building farms with modern machines.
Under the guidance of the President who took his first step to unfold the blueprint for tideland reclamation, paddy fields covering thousands of hectares came into being and a new farm village appeared. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors in South Phyongan Province of DPRK
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors in South Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors in South Phyongan Province.
The premier called upon the farms and raw material base stations in Sukchon and Phyongwon counties to actively introduce various advanced farming methods for increasing the agricultural production while saving farming materials, improve the growth of earlier wheat and barley by manuring and cultivating them in a scientific and technological way and raise the land utility rate in conformity with the characteristics of regions.
He stressed the need for the agricultural guidance organs at all levels to give substantial guidance and assistance to consolidating the material and technical foundations of farms and continue to direct big efforts to studying and introducing high-yielding strains of grain seeds.
He visited the Mundok County Rural Economy Committee, where he learned about the introduction of the new water management method and called for further perfecting the management information system in the field of agriculture in contact with scientific research institutions to accelerate the work for putting guidance over and management of agriculture on a scientific and IT basis.
He said that the Anju City Grain Management Station and the Mundok County Paper Factory should take practical measures in a workable way to raise the proportion of homemade equipment and the rate of cleaned rice output and increase the production of farming materials necessary for mulching cultivation.
After acquainting himself in detail with progress made in the construction project for establishing the C-1 chemical industry and the production of the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory, he called for thoroughly carrying out the project including the manufacture and assembly of equipment according to the stepwise plan and taking proper measures for the supply of raw materials to bring about remarkable progress in the work for increasing fertilizer production.
Earlier, the premier discussed the ways for increasing the production of wagons and improving their quality at the Wonsan Rolling-Stock Factory. -0-

headline: Feats Made by Youth Shock Brigade Members in Coal Industry of DPRK
story_text:

Members of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade at the Tukjang Youth Coal Mine under the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex have carried out their daily quotas at over 150 percent in the second-stage belt heading construction for increasing transport capacity.
Members of the Kim Hyok youth shock brigades at the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex fulfilled their first quarterly plan ahead of schedule. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Vice General Director of General Armaments Bureau of Ministry of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- The vice general director of the General Armaments Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement on April 1 under the title "The new 'co-produced weapon' of the U.S.-Japan military alliance signals the further unstable security environment of the region":
The U.S.-Japan alliance styling itself a key axis of the U.S.-led military alliance system in the Asia-Pacific region is taking on a fresh appearance to give repeated signals of instability to the surrounding countries and the regional society.
A typical example is that the U.S. and Japan formally agreed to co-produce the latest air-to-air missile AIM-120, with the recent visit of the U.S. secretary of Defense to Japan as an occasion.
What is serious is that it can never be accepted only as the production of weapons for fighters aimed at defending airspace and securing the command of the air. The danger of it is further highlighted in the light of the peculiarities of the geopolitical and military security environment in Northeast Asia.
All types of main fighters, involved in the U.S.-Japan and U.S.-Japan-ROK three party joint aerial drills that we have frequently witnessed in the sky near the Korean peninsula and further in the sky above the East Sea and South Sea of China, can carry the AIM-120 with a range of more than 160 km.
In view of the military doctrine of the U.S. Air Force which specified that the command of the air should be secured through massive introduction and use of the ultra-modern long-range air weapons such as AIM-120, the anti-aircraft system of enemy states be neutralized through preemptive strike and then strategic bombers be sent to deal a heavy blow to the strategic depth of the opponent, AIM-120 is now becoming another "co-produced weapon" of the U.S.-Japan military alliance, which is turning offensive and aggressive from A to Z.
The joint production of ultra-modern weapons pursued by the U.S. and Japan is adding new element of strategic instability to the Asia-Pacific region, bringing ominous dark clouds.
The U.S. has connived at and encouraged Japan's moves for a military giant since last century. It has sharply expanded the application range of the U.S.-Japan security treaty, which was limited to "contingency in Japan", to space and cyber fields, to say nothing of "contingencies in areas surrounding Japan" in recent years. It has also actively backed Japan's possession of "counterattack capability" and unhesitatingly offered long-range attack means such as Tomahawk cruise missile.
At a time when the U.S. and Japan are seeking to integrate the existing military operation control system through the U.S. military reorganization in Japan and the establishment of the "integrated operation command" and to steadily access to the wartime environment, their cooperation in the field of munitions industry is being accelerated in direct proportion to it. It is not a secret that such moves are aimed at militarily deterring the regional countries.
Certainly, the center of gravity of the U.S. hegemony-oriented military security strategy is changing and it is a new warning signal for the Asia-Pacific regional society including the countries in Northeast Asia.
A force without justice is a tyranny and justice without a force is meaningless.
It will be a priority task of the DPRK in the future, too, to actively cope with the unstable strategic environment being created around the DPRK by the U.S. and its followers and to bolster up the powerful deterrence capable of making enemy countries have no other choice but to give up their political and military ambition.
The DPRK's efforts to apply the most appropriate solution to control and manage the military tension in the region will continue, and Washington and its servants' attempt to hold military hegemony will never be allowed. -0-

headline: Preparations for Tideland Farming Hastened in North Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK directs big efforts to increasing the grain production this year by doing farming well on the Honggondo Tideland.
The province has pushed ahead with the work to perfect the irrigation system, while taking measures to supply enough water.
It made sure that a rational design for the irrigation project was completed on the basis of organizing a field survey and examining the irrigation canals and paddy fields with water shortage.
It took steps to push ahead with the project for cleaning up and repairing and expanding the waterway from Tongraegang and Maebong reservoirs to the Honggondo Tideland.
Officials and working people in the province finished the project in many sections of the waterway while removing a large amount of earth.
The province is pushing ahead with the construction of water pumping stations for the supply of irrigation water to tideland paddy fields in the terminal areas. Meanwhile, the construction of floodgate, pipe-burying and other structures is progressing in a three-dimensional way.
And measures were taken to secure seeds necessary for tideland farming and supply farming materials.
The work for bringing a rich harvest to thousands of hectares of Honggondo tideland-turned fields is progressing apace. -0-

The U.S.-Japan alliance styling itself a key axis of the U.S.-led military alliance system in the Asia-Pacific region is taking on a fresh appearance to give repeated signals of instability to the surrounding countries and the regional society.
A typical example is that the U.S. and Japan formally agreed to co-produce the latest air-to-air missile AIM-120, with the recent visit of the U.S. secretary of Defense to Japan as an occasion.
What is serious is that it can never be accepted only as the production of weapons for fighters aimed at defending airspace and securing the command of the air. The danger of it is further highlighted in the light of the peculiarities of the geopolitical and military security environment in Northeast Asia.
All types of main fighters, involved in the U.S.-Japan and U.S.-Japan-ROK three party joint aerial drills that we have frequently witnessed in the sky near the Korean peninsula and further in the sky above the East Sea and South Sea of China, can carry the AIM-120 with a range of more than 160 km.
In view of the military doctrine of the U.S. Air Force which specified that the command of the air should be secured through massive introduction and use of the ultra-modern long-range air weapons such as AIM-120, the anti-aircraft system of enemy states be neutralized through preemptive strike and then strategic bombers be sent to deal a heavy blow to the strategic depth of the opponent, AIM-120 is now becoming another "co-produced weapon" of the U.S.-Japan military alliance, which is turning offensive and aggressive from A to Z.
The joint production of ultra-modern weapons pursued by the U.S. and Japan is adding new element of strategic instability to the Asia-Pacific region, bringing ominous dark clouds.
The U.S. has connived at and encouraged Japan's moves for a military giant since last century. It has sharply expanded the application range of the U.S.-Japan security treaty, which was limited to "contingency in Japan", to space and cyber fields, to say nothing of "contingencies in areas surrounding Japan" in recent years. It has also actively backed Japan's possession of "counterattack capability" and unhesitatingly offered long-range attack means such as Tomahawk cruise missile.
At a time when the U.S. and Japan are seeking to integrate the existing military operation control system through the U.S. military reorganization in Japan and the establishment of the "integrated operation command" and to steadily access to the wartime environment, their cooperation in the field of munitions industry is being accelerated in direct proportion to it. It is not a secret that such moves are aimed at militarily deterring the regional countries.
Certainly, the center of gravity of the U.S. hegemony-oriented military security strategy is changing and it is a new warning signal for the Asia-Pacific regional society including the countries in Northeast Asia.
A force without justice is a tyranny and justice without a force is meaningless.
It will be a priority task of the DPRK in the future, too, to actively cope with the unstable strategic environment being created around the DPRK by the U.S. and its followers and to bolster up the powerful deterrence capable of making enemy countries have no other choice but to give up their political and military ambition.
The DPRK's efforts to apply the most appropriate solution to control and manage the military tension in the region will continue, and Washington and its servants' attempt to hold military hegemony will never be allowed. -0-

headline: Preparations for Tideland Farming Hastened in North Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK directs big efforts to increasing the grain production this year by doing farming well on the Honggondo Tideland.
The province has pushed ahead with the work to perfect the irrigation system, while taking measures to supply enough water.
It made sure that a rational design for the irrigation project was completed on the basis of organizing a field survey and examining the irrigation canals and paddy fields with water shortage.
It took steps to push ahead with the project for cleaning up and repairing and expanding the waterway from Tongraegang and Maebong reservoirs to the Honggondo Tideland.
Officials and working people in the province finished the project in many sections of the waterway while removing a large amount of earth.
The province is pushing ahead with the construction of water pumping stations for the supply of irrigation water to tideland paddy fields in the terminal areas. Meanwhile, the construction of floodgate, pipe-burying and other structures is progressing in a three-dimensional way.
And measures were taken to secure seeds necessary for tideland farming and supply farming materials.
The work for bringing a rich harvest to thousands of hectares of Honggondo tideland-turned fields is progressing apace. -0-

Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce
Thungso, National Instrument
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- Thungso (Korean six-holed bamboo flute) is one of the national instruments loved by the Korean people from long ago.
A person playing a bamboo flute was depicted in a mural of a Koguryo tomb dating back to the mid-4th century. This shows that Thungso has been made and used before that time.
Thungso was also called Thongso as it is a wood wind-instrument held out vertically.
Thungso with peculiar timbre had been rapidly disseminated to the people as it was a major instrument of civilian band in the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910). It was widely used in accompanying folk song and solo in Hamgyong Province and other regions.
It is characterized by tuneful and soft timbre.
The typical music played by it is a national instrumental heritage "Sinau".
Today, "Sinau", rearranged in various forms including chorus and national orchestra, is recognized as the piece depicting well the people's sentiments and emotions with the peculiar sound of national instruments such as the charming timbre of Thungso. -0-

headline: Spring Campaign for Land Management Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- The spring campaign for land management is getting brisk in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The province has pushed ahead with the work to finish the spring land construction projects like dredging, embankment project and project for irrigation facilities in a qualitative way, while paying close attention to the allotment of manpower, vehicles and building materials needed for the improvement of the Amnok River basin extending tens of kilometers.
Officials and working people in Jongju and Kusong cities, Unsan, Nyongbyon and Pakchon counties have accelerated the projects in a three-dimensional way, ensuring the rational organization of manpower and the full operation of vehicles.
Working people in Uiju, Cholsan and Taegwan counties have found rubble and mixed aggregate resources to provide a quality guarantee for the embankment foundation projects, and officials and working people in Sakju and Kwaksan counties have speeded up the projects by employing advanced construction methods.
Ryongchon and Unsan counties have carried out dredging and straightening waterway by mobilizing excavators and hydraulic loaders on the basis of scientific calculation of the amount of precipitation in rainy season.
Unjon, Tongrim and Sonchon counties are pushing ahead with the construction of emptying gates and ditches for supplying irrigation water. -0-

headline: SPA Chairman Meets Head of Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group
Great Leadership for Development of Public Health
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- It has been 45 years since the Public Health Law was adopted in the DPRK.
In April 1980, PresidentKim Il Sungsaw to it that the Public Health Law of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was adopted at the Fourth Session of the Sixth Supreme People's Assembly. And he made public the famous work "Let Us Implement the Public Health Law to the Letter" to indicate the important guidelines to be held fast to in comprehensively applying the Juche-oriented idea and policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on public health.
The adoption of the Public Health Law made it possible to give fuller play to the advantages of the socialist health system, in which the Party and the state take care of the people's lives and health in a full responsible manner, and to provide a powerful weapon for developing the public health onto a new high stage.
Thanks to the energetic guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho set it as the eternal national policy of the DPRK to steadily develop the public health, the Breast Tumour Institute of the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital, the Ryugyong Dental Hospital, the Okryu Children's Hospital and other hospitals were newly built and the medical service has been further improved.
Standard pharmacies with enough functions as a specialized dispensary have appeared in all cities and counties of the country, and the construction of advanced health facilities is progressing apace as part of the three essential projects added to the WPK's Regional Development 20×10 Policy.
Going round the completed Pyongyang General Hospital in February last, the General Secretary stressed that it is the firm determination of the WPK to bring about a revolution in public health in the new era and thus turn our public health into the most advanced, modern and world-class one.
Thanks to the leadership ofKim Jong Unwho is writing a new history of the development of socialist public health with his ardent love and affection for the people, they are receiving the benefits of modern medicine to the full, enjoying a long and healthy life in happiness. -0-

headline: WPK's Plan and Determination Precisely Mean Practice: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun says in an article Thursday that the plan and determination of the Workers' Party of Korea are a grand blueprint for the prosperity of our state and a struggle goal for realizing the beautiful ideal of our people.
Every project decided and pursued by the WPK is based on a scientific policy for building a prosperous country, the article says, and goes on:
Socialist construction of Korean-style has now entered a period of new development and comprehensive prosperity in which gigantic changes and a dynamic advance are being made in all spheres.
The WPK set forth a scientific action programme and struggle policy to glorify this year as an eye-opening year of providing a phase of upturn for a higher stage of development and a year of great change.
Every project determined and pursued by the WPK is the one for the people from A to Z.
It is the steadfast view of the WPK that the Party and the state and others exist thanks to the people and anything, if it is desired by the people, should be done unconditionally, irrespective of its possibility.
The WPK has steadily set a development-oriented goal for promoting the wellbeing of the people and attained it without fail.
The rosy future, in which everyone in the country will enjoy all blessings of socialism, singing the song "We Are the Happiest in the World", is now coming nearer, thanks to the ennobling political creed, spirit of making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people and legendary creative and executive abilities of the WPK that believes in the people as in Heaven and devotes itself to them. -0-

headline: National Cooking Festival Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- The 28th National Cooking Festival took place at the Pyongyang Noodle House in the DPRK from March 31 to April 3 on the occasion of the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation.
Taking part in the festival were cooks and waitresses selected from fields of the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service, public catering establishments of Pyongyang and provinces (municipalities), external service, ministries and national agencies and housewives. Presented to it were more than 800 peculiar dishes and drink beverages and over 270 scientific and technological achievements.
The exhibition of designated dishes was highly appreciated by visitors for the good taste of national dishes such as Pyongyang Raengmyon (cold noodle) of Okryu Restaurant and noodle in flat vessel with meat of Chongryu Restaurant and dishes presented by Ansan Noodle House under the Phyongchon District Restaurants Management Office, Okryu Restaurant under the Taedonggang District Restaurants Management Office, Ragwon Noodle House under the Pothonggang District Restaurants Management Office and others.
The cooks of Pyongyang Hotel, the Pyongyang Koryo Hotel, the Haebangsan Hotel, the Pothonggang Hostel, Sosong Drink Shop under the Sosong District Restaurants Management Office, Jongphyong County Hostel of South Hamgyong Province and the Sunam District Restaurants Management Office in Chongjin City of North Hamgyong Province made various kinds of famous dishes, drawing attention.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Training Base of KPA Special Operations Units and Guides General Training
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the training base of the special operations units of the Korean People's Army and guided the general training on April 4.
Accompanying him were Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and other leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, and the first vice-minister of National Defence, the director of the combat training department of the KPA General Staff and commanding officers of the special operations units.
After receiving a salute from commanding officers of the KPA, he mounted the observation post to watch the general tactical training and small-arms shooting contest conducted and held by combatants of various special operations units according to the training programme.
The training was aimed at steadily exploring and applying new military tactics and methodologies of Korean style for bolstering up the special operations forces in keeping with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern warfare and mastering them through practical training for real war so as to prepare all combatants more thoroughly to reliably and skilfully carry out their special operations tasks under any combat situation.
The brave combatants, who have grown up to be the strongest combat group and the core vanguard of the armed forces of the DPRK while cultivating matchless strength and courage under the outstanding guidance of the great brilliant commander, fully demonstrated the strong independent operations capability and the fighting spirit and crack-shot marksmanship of our invincible army in all drills.
Kim Jong Unhighly appreciated the lofty ideological and spiritual world of the combatants who are devoting themselves to their noble mission and duty for defending the security of the state and the safety of the people always with battlefield in their mind, true to the Party's idea of building the special operations forces.
The actual war capability for guaranteeing victory in the battlefield is bolstered up through intensive training and it is the most vivid expression of patriotism and loyalty to the country and the people and the first revolutionary duty for the soldiers with arms to complete the combat preparations, he said, calling for taking it as the core goal of army building to turn the army into a strong one in which all the officers and men fight shoulder to shoulder, in one body and with one idea and one intention.
The strengthening of the special operations forces constitutes a major component of our army building strategy at present, he said, indicating important tasks to take a series of crucial measures for putting the special operations capability on a highly-developed basis.
He guided an automatic rifle firing drill and a sniper rifle firing drill of the combatants.
He personally conducted the test-fire of a sniper rifle to be newly supplied to special operations units and learned about its results, expressing great satisfaction over the performance and power of the sniper rifle developed in our own way.
Then he watched general special physical exercises of special operations unit combatants.
The combatants, who have prepared themselves to be a-match-for-a-hundred soldiers with iron fists as sturdy as bullets and brave fighters, fully demonstrated their physical and technical abilities.
Watching the exercises pulsating with the fighting spirit to annihilate the enemy and the heroic mettle,Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the officers and men of the special operations forces filled with patriotic enthusiasm and militant courage.
He had a photo session with the reliable officers and men who are further improving the strongest capability for an actual war in the training with courage, pluck and towering self-confidence to counter any war and crisis without hesitation.
When the photo session was over, the KPA's reliable guards and passionate warriors broke into thunderous cheers reflecting their pledge of loyalty, looking up to the great iron-willed commander with deep emotion.
Kim Jong Unexpressed expectations and belief that all the units of the special operations forces would remain absolutely faithful to their mission of defending the country, the revolution and the people and firmly safeguard the victorious advance of the most just and sacred cause of the DPRK with matchless arms.
All the servicepersons, who took part in the training, hardened their firm determination to more reliably prepare themselves as the spearhead of the elite revolutionary armed forces that always wins victory in every battle and conquers any fortress when it is determined, for the great ComradeKim Jong Un, the eternal prosperity of our dignified state and happiness of the people.  -0-

headline: Director of Int'l Department of C.C., WPK Meets Russian Party Delegation
Efforts Paid to Putting Fish Farming on Scientific and Intensive Basis
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- The Sohung Poman Fish Farm in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to put fish farming on a scientific and intensive basis of higher level.
The farm has conducted the operation of sci-tech learning space, passing-on technique and show to encourage all its employees to introduce advanced fish farming technology into practice.
It has solved the problems arising in settling the breed problem and improving the effectiveness of artificial propagation and assorted feed by its own efforts and technology and pushed ahead with the work to put sturgeon and snakehead farming on a scientific basis.
It built a Hermetia illucens and mud snail habitats, provided animal protein feed and water temperature by using natural energy and introduced assorted feed additives to raise the survival rate and weight ratio of catfish, tilapia, Ryongjong fish and other fish.
The farm has bred rainbow trout with high taste and nutritive value in every season by taking good advantage of the regional conditions rich in spring water and by doing collection of eggs, hatching and management of water quality in a responsible way.
It also created scientific ratio among species of fish according to the living habit of carp, silver carp, Aristichthys nobilis and other fish, thus raising the level of intensive fish farming and opening up a prospect for reducing the cost and increasing the productivity. -0-

Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, on April 4 met and had a friendly talk with the delegation of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation led by Kazbek Taysaev, secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma, which paid a courtesy call on him.
Present there were An Hyon Min, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other officials of the C.C., WPK and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: Efforts Paid to Putting Fish Farming on Scientific and Intensive Basis
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- The Sohung Poman Fish Farm in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to put fish farming on a scientific and intensive basis of higher level.
The farm has conducted the operation of sci-tech learning space, passing-on technique and show to encourage all its employees to introduce advanced fish farming technology into practice.
It has solved the problems arising in settling the breed problem and improving the effectiveness of artificial propagation and assorted feed by its own efforts and technology and pushed ahead with the work to put sturgeon and snakehead farming on a scientific basis.
It built a Hermetia illucens and mud snail habitats, provided animal protein feed and water temperature by using natural energy and introduced assorted feed additives to raise the survival rate and weight ratio of catfish, tilapia, Ryongjong fish and other fish.
The farm has bred rainbow trout with high taste and nutritive value in every season by taking good advantage of the regional conditions rich in spring water and by doing collection of eggs, hatching and management of water quality in a responsible way.
It also created scientific ratio among species of fish according to the living habit of carp, silver carp, Aristichthys nobilis and other fish, thus raising the level of intensive fish farming and opening up a prospect for reducing the cost and increasing the productivity. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Housing Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- The frame work for 10 000 flats at the fourth-stage in the Hwasong area of the DPRK is progressing apace amid the surging enthusiasm of military and civilian builders.
The Ministry of Public Security brigade completed the frame work for apartment houses under its charge in 30-odd days after the ground-breaking ceremony, creating new standards and new records. Its commanding officers and soldiers are now making uninterrupted innovations in the project.
Builders of civilian construction units, too, finished the ground concrete tamping in a short span of time and are pushing ahead with the frame work in full swing. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Training Base of KPA Special Operation Units and Guides General Training
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the training base of the special operation units of the Korean People's Army and guided the general training on April 4.
Accompanying him were Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and other leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, and the first vice-minister of National Defence, the director of the combat training department of the KPA General Staff and commanding officers of the special operation units.
After receiving a salute from commanding officers of the KPA, he mounted the observation post to watch the general tactical training and small-arms shooting contest conducted by combatants of various special operation units under the training program.
The training was aimed at steadily exploring and applying the new military tactics and methodology of Korean style for bolstering up the special operation forces in keeping with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern warfare and mastering them through practical training for real war so as to prepare all combatants more thoroughly to reliably and skillfully carry out their special operation tasks under any combat situation.
The brave combatants, who have grown up to be the strongest combat group and the core vanguard of the armed forces of the DPRK while cultivating matchless strength and courage under the outstanding guidance of the great brilliant commander, fully demonstrated the strong independent operation capability and the fighting spirit and crack-shot marksmanship of our invincible army in all drills.
Kim Jong Unhighly appreciated the transparent ideological and spiritual world of the combatants who are devoting themselves to their noble mission and duty for defending the security of the state and the safety of the people always with battlefield in their mind, true to the Party's idea of building the special operation forces.
The actual war capability for guaranteeing victory in the war field is bolstered up through intensive training and it is the most vivid expression of patriotism and loyalty to the country and the people and the first revolutionary duty for the soldiers with arms to complete the combat preparations, he said, calling for regarding it as the core goal of army building to turn the army into a strong one in which all the officers and men fight shoulder to shoulder with one idea and one intention.
Noting that strengthening of the special operation forces constitutes a major component of the army building strategy at present, he indicated crucial tasks to take a series of important measures for putting the special operation capability on a highly-developed basis.
He guided an automatic rifle firing drill and a sniper rifle firing drill of the combatants.
He personally conducted the test-fire of a sniper rifle, to be newly supplied to special operation units, and learned about its results, expressing great satisfaction over the performance and power of the sniper rifle developed in our own way.
Then he watched general special physical exercises of special operation unit combatants.
The combatants, who have prepared themselves to be a-match-for-a-hundred iron fists like tightly-packed bullets and brave fighters, fully demonstrated their physical and technical abilities.
Watching the exercises pulsating with the fighting spirit to annihilate the enemy and the heroic mettle,Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the officers and men of the special operation forces filled with patriotic enthusiasm and militant courage.
He had a photo session with the reliable officers and men who are fully displaying the strongest capability for an actual war in the training with courage, pluck and towering self-confidence to counter any war and crisis without hesitation.
When the photo session was over, the KPA's reliable guards and passionate warriors broke into thunderous cheers reflecting their pledge of loyalty, looking up to the great iron-willed commander with deep emotion.
Kim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that all the units of the special operation forces would remain absolutely faithful to their mission of defending the country, the revolution and the people and firmly safeguard the victorious advance of the most just and sacred cause of the DPRK with matchless arms.
All the servicepersons, who took part in the training, hardened their firm determination to more reliably prepare themselves as the spearhead of the elite revolutionary armed forces that always win victory in every battle and that conquer any fortress when it is determined, to defend the great ComradeKim Jong Unand the eternal prosperity of our dignified state and happiness of the people. -0-

headline: Russian Party Delegation Visits Mangyongdae
Women in DPRK Advance into Major Theatres for Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- More than 90 women's union members in Rason Municipality of the DPRK have volunteered to work at worksites for socialist construction.
Women in Rajin District resolved to advance into fishery station, garment factory and other units, out of their mind to make a tangible contribution to translating into reality the grand plan of the Workers' Party of Korea which ushered in a great era of transformation for the regional development revolution.
Those in Sonbong District volunteered to work at the road management office, fuel station and other units, with their patriotic desire to devote themselves to the future of the younger generation.
Officials and women's union members in the relevant areas presented bouquets to the volunteers and warmly saw off them leaving for revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Further Increasing Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- In order to victoriously conclude the last year of the implementation of the five-year plan and confidently bring about an upward trend towards a higher development stage, it is necessary to steadily intensify the ideological offensive for boosting the elated spirit of the masses out in a drive for increased production, Rodong Sinmun on Sunday says in an editorial.
The motivation of the ideological and mental strength of the masses is the great might of the collective, the uplifted enthusiasm of the masses for increased production and innovative successes in implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea, the editorial says, and goes on:
The proud successes of increased production made in the overall socialist construction this year are not an outcome of favorable conditions and plentiful reserve but the result of the effective ideological work and familiar political work giving full play to the noble loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm of our people who regard it as their duty to uphold the Party's plan and determination with their death-defying practices.
The key to boosting production and economizing as much as possible by mobilizing possibilities and potential to the maximum and to making a more dynamic advance toward greater victory lies in the ideological and political work.
All sectors and units should positively arouse the revolutionary spirit and creative enthusiasm of the masses through a powerful ideological campaign so as to further display the spirit of uninterrupted innovations and progress and fully demonstrate the fighting spirit of the people overcoming difficulties.
It is the traditional work method of the WPK to steadily advance the revolution and construction by arousing the mental power of the masses through the ideological and political work.
Let us all glorify this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK as a year of great victory and change with greater successes in increasing production. -0-

headline: Land Realignment Project Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Jagang Province of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the land realignment project to turn thousands of hectares of dry fields into paddy fields.
In recent years, the provincial rural economy committee turned hundreds of hectares of dry fields in Hyangsan County into paddy fields, thus making several farms produce three more tons of grain per hectare than maize farming.
On the basis of this experience, it set a goal to turn thousands of hectares of dry fields into paddy fields and has conducted the work for realizing it while providing machines on a preferential way.
Officials and working people in charge of land realignment made a survey of fields to be realigned and have introduced rational working methods to register high results.
The land realignment project is progressing faster than schedule, under the provincial interest. -0-

story_text: Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Marathoners of China, Romania, Morocco and Ethiopia arrived here on April 3 and 5 by air to attend the 31st Pyongyang International Marathon to be held on the occasion of the significant April spring holiday, the birthday of PresidentKim Il Sung. -0-

headline: Happy Schoolchildren
Assistance to Education Intensified in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Enthusiasm for supporting the educational sector is growing high in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
Officials of the province inspected a university of medicine and teachers training college to learn about their real situation and took measures for providing educational equipment and apparatuses and furniture helpful to raising the level of education.
Provincial institutions and many other units have supplied necessary equipment and materials to the university and college.
Cities and counties, too, worked out plans for helping schools at all levels and provided lots of educational apparatuses and equipment to them. -0-

headline: Many Trees Planted in Ragwonpho of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- During the spring tree-planting campaign, people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have planted hundreds of thousands of trees in Ragwonpho and its vicinity on the east coast, where a gigantic construction project has been launched.
The province worked out a plan for planting many trees of good species in the coastal areas, including creating landscape by combining fruit trees and flower shrubs in the vicinity of dwelling houses to be built in a modern way.
Officials and working people in Ragwon County devoted their patriotic sweat to tree-planting, picturing in their mind the future of Ragwonpho to be more beautiful.
The county paid attention to ensuring the responsible technical guidance over tree-planting with forces of its forest management station. -0-

Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation led by Kazbek Taysaev, secretary of its Central Committee and head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma, visited Mangyongdae, the birthplace of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Being briefed on the noble revolutionary career of the President, the members of the delegation looked round the historical relics preserved at the old home in Mangyongdae.
The delegation also toured the Tower of the Juche Idea, the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, the International Friendship Exhibition House, the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex, Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies and other places and visited the Jongbaek Church. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Condolence to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of condolence to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on April 2.
The message said:
I express deep condolences, on behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea, the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Korean people and on my own behalf, to you and the party, government and people of Laos and the bereaved family, upon hearing the sad news that Comrade Khamtay Siphandone passed away.
I am convinced that the party, government and people of Laos would overcome the pain of loss and achieve bigger success in the struggle for defending and advancing the cause of socialism as desired by Comrade Khamtay Siphandone. -0-

headline: River Improvement Brisk in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK pushes ahead with the project for improving medium and small rivers.
The municipality is expanding successes by concentrating efforts and means on the work to finish the planned medium and small river improvement before the rainy season.
It sent officials to the areas with many medium and small rivers to reinforce the guiding forces and has provided conditions for increasing the operation rate of vehicles.
It held a show on the improvement of medium and small rivers to generalize the successes and experience gained in the work, and helps ensure quality in all processes of river improvement including dredging, riverbank reinforcement and turf planting.
Ryonggang County is pushing ahead with dredging as scheduled by raising the utilization rate of hydraulic excavators and other heavy machines.
Onchon County concentrates heavy machines on the improvement of the Sobongryong Stream, a huge project. Taean District completed the dredging of the Wolha Stream and is concentrating efforts on planting turf on its surroundings. -0-

headline: DPRK Officials Pay Condolatory Visits to Lao Embassy
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Cabinet,  working people's organizations and ministries of the DPRK visited the Lao embassy here on April 6 to express condolences over the death of Khamtay Siphandone, former chairman of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.
Among them were Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Sang Gil, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned.
Laid before a photo of Khamtay Siphandone was a wreath in the joint name of the WPK Central Committee, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK.
Also placed were wreaths in the name of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Pyongyang Municipal People's Committee, the C.C., Socialist Patriotic Youth League and the C.C., General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea.
Written on the ribbons of the wreaths were letters reading "In memory of Comrade Khamtay Siphandone".
The visitors observed a moment's silence in memory of Khamtay Siphandone who made a contribution to the development of the Lao party and state and the DPRK-Laos friendly relations.
They made entries in a condolence book. -0-

headline: Grand Chorus Given by Senior Middle School Graduates in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- A grand chorus "We Are Successors to Revolution" was given by graduates of senior middle schools in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Sunday.
Put on the stage were the numbers reflecting their strong aspiration and desire to add glory to their honour of being the young vanguard at the posts for national defence and worksites for building a powerful socialist country.
A narrative poem "We Are Successors to Revolution" well represented the spiritual world of the young people determined to adorn their youth with loyalty and feats, always remembering the days when they happily grew up under the loving care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
Chorus "Song of National Defence" and other songs sang by them in chorus fully reflected their strong will to perform military feats, to be proud of before their parents and siblings in their home villages and teachers of their schools, during the sacred military service for national defence.
The performance ended with a chorus "We Will Defend GeneralKim Jong Unwith Our Lives". It showed the iron will of the young vanguard in the capital city to give full play to their wisdom and courage at national defence posts and socialist construction theaters. -0-

headline: Academic Titles Conferred on Teachers of Korean University under Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- A meeting for conferring professorship and associate professorship of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on teachers of Korean University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on April 2.
Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and director of the Organizational Department of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, read out a decision of the DPRK State Commission for Conferment of Academic Degrees and Titles.
Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, addressed the conferring ceremony before handing over the certificates of academic titles.
Present there were Song Kun Hak, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Education Department, Han Tong Song, rector of Korean University, other officials and the teaching staff of the university. -0-

headline: Ploughing Finished in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Ploughing has finished in the main in the rural areas of North Hwanghae Province, the DPRK.
Officials of the provincial rural economy committee intensified the economic organization and technical guidance so that farms more actively introduce effective tillage methods whose advantages have been proved in farming practice.
Farms in Songnim City and Hwangju County made good preparations for using farm machines and recorded high ploughing results every day.
Farms in Singye County organized a socialist emulation among machine drivers and conducted evaluation on the principle of ensuring quality, thus adding to enthusiasm of tractor drivers.
Farms in Suan County and other areas, too, pushed ahead with ploughing while taking timely measures to resolve knotty problems. -0-

headline: 31st Pyongyang International Marathon Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- The 31st Pyongyang International Marathon took place on the occasion of the birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The contest, divided into marathon, half marathon, 10km running and 5km running, brought together marathoners from the DPRK, China, Romania, Morocco and Ethiopia and amateurs from different countries and regions.
An opening ceremony took place atKim Il SungStadium on April 6.
Present there were Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier and chairman of the State Planning Commission who is vice-chairman of the National Sports Guidance Committee, Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned, officials in the field of sports, Pyongyangites and foreign guests.
The contest began after a speech.
Players of the DPRK took the first place in men's and women's marathon.
Players of the DPRK won gold, silver and bronze medals in men's and women's half-marathon.
Polish players took the first, second and third places in men's amateur marathon and a Hong Kong player of China came first in women's amateur marathon.
There took place a closing ceremony.
Trophy cups, medals and diplomas were awarded to the winners. -0-

story_text:

headline: President Kim Il Sung Lauded by Italian Political Figure
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- Roberto Gabriele, general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy, issued a press statement on April 1 on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
He said in the press statement titled "PresidentKim Il Sung, the great leader of the world revolution" that the world progressives are recollecting with deep emotion the career of PresidentKim Il Sung, an outstanding leader of the Korean people and great revolutionary, on the occasion of the significant April holiday. He went on:
The President founded the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, guided by the immutable truth that national liberation should be achieved by force of arms, and led the hard-fought anti-Japanese war to victory, thus finally gaining the national independence.
In the 1950s when the Korean War was ignited by the U.S. imperialists, he defeated the imperialists with his rare military wisdom and outstanding commanding art and defended the sovereignty of the country.
Indeed, PresidentKim Il Sungis the great leader and the father of the people as he dedicated himself to the freedom and independence of Korea and the happiness of its people.
He regarded it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven and shared his destiny with the people throughout his life and built the DPRK into a country where the people are its masters, a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence.
The world progressives highly praise him as the eternal President of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy will give wide publicity to the exploits of the peerlessly great men in various forms and methods and positively support the Korean people in their struggle for dynamically accelerating socialist construction under the wise guidance of ComradeKim Jong Un, the press statement stressed. -0-

headline: Origin of Let-one-machine-tool-make-another Movement in DPRK
story_text:
In March 1959, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a small factory in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
After being told that the factory was making a universal lathe, the President went to the production spot.
Approaching the lathe, he learnt about its design and supply of materials. And he told an official accompanying him that the factory has lots of precious things and its workers are brave and bold.
That day he went round even the cupola. Then he said that the factory is one of those which won victory in the struggle against mysticism about technology, true to the Party's call and it is qualified to put up the Party's slogan that iron and machine are the king of industry. And he stressed the need to launch a widespread let-one-machine-tool-make-another movement by following the example of the factory, adding that he would make many people visit the factory for study and the factory should transfer its experience to them and host a short course for them.
The President found in the self-reliant spirit of workers at the factory and the lathe manufactured by them a new bud capable of developing the machine-building industry through an all-people movement.
As seen above, the let-one-machine-tool-make-another movement in the DPRK started at a small factory, not a specialized machine factory, under the guidance of the President. -0-

headline:
Photo Exhibition Opens to Celebrate 113th Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung

[2025.04.08.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- A national photo exhibition, "Journey dedicated to happiness of people", opened with due ceremony at the Okryu Exhibition House here on April 7 to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Displayed at the exhibition hall are photos showing the personality of PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who are all praised as great men for having laid eternal foundations for building a powerful socialist country with their outstanding ideology and theory, rare leadership ability and gigantic revolutionary practice and working hard to bring earlier the rosy future when the people's dreams and ideals will come true.
The photos deal with the immortal revolutionary exploits of the President who put forward the working class in the vanguard of miraculous creation and wrote a brilliant history of national prosperity.
The visitors recall the ceaseless journey of devotion made by the President all his life to provide the people with happy life, seeing the photos titled "The great leader ComradeKim Il Sungtalking with farmers in Chongsan-ri, Kangso County", "The great leader ComradeKim Il Sungopening up prospects for the construction of regional cities", etc.
Photos show the President's noble outlook on and great love for the rising generation, with which he worked heart and soul to make the children the happiest in the world.
Other photos impressively tell the sacred revolutionary careers of the peerlessly great men who were always together on the road for the well-being of the people.
There are also photos showing the great devotion of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho visited pharmacies in Pyongyang Municipality to acquaint himself with the supply of medicines during the period of the maximum emergency anti-epidemic campaign and left his sacred traces in the dangerous flood-hit areas.
Present at the opening ceremony were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials concerned and working citizens.
Vice-Premier Kim Myong Hun made an opening address. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The anachronistic 'denuclearization' idea of the U.S., Japan and the ROK can never affect the position of our state" on April 8:
The diplomatic authorities of the U.S., Japan and the ROK again talked about someone's "complete denuclearization", terming the Democratic People's Republic of Korea's exercise of its sovereign rights a "threat" at the recent NATO foreign ministers' meeting.
It only fully exposed the uneasiness of the U.S., Japan and the ROK in a desperate plight of having to talk about "denuclearization" in chorus although they just know that "denuclearization" of us is nothing but a daydream that can never come true.
Just two months ago, we clarified how stupid the U.S. is in pursuing the goal of "denuclearizing" the DPRK, something utterly impossible and unrealistic in practice and conception.
They still talk about "complete denuclearization," lost in the past daydream that brought them to failure, revealing themselves how anachronistic and absurd their level of political judgment is.
Did they come up with a good way to realize someone's "denuclearization" whenever they had a loud brainstorming session?
If they frantically cry out for "denuclearization", really believing in it, they must be termed nonsensical.
The position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state, established along with the existence of its substantial and very strong nuclear deterrent and permanently fixed in its supreme and basic state law according to the unanimous will of all its people, is a result of the inevitable option which accurately reflected the hostile threat from outside and the change in the present and future world security mechanical structure. So it does not change no matter how desperately anyone denies.
We don't care about anyone's denial and recognition and we never change our option.
This is our steadfast choice that can never be reversed by any physical strength or sly artifice.
If anyone openly talks about dismantlement of nuclear weapons before us or seeks to revive the dead concept of "denuclearization" under various pretexts, it just constitutes the most hostile act of denying the sovereignty of the DPRK and forcing it to renounce its constitution and social system. I made it clear once again on this occasion.
The nuclear forces of the DPRK not only play a key role in deterring aggression and threat from outside and defending the sovereignty and security of the state but also make an important contribution to ensuring the regional and global balance of power and strategic security.
The only way for the U.S., Japan and the ROK to defuse their current security concern is to completely refrain from their unilateral attempt to change the status quo and shake the present position of the DPRK and sincerely find a method to avoid head-on conflict.
If the U.S. and its vassal forces continue to insist on anachronistic "denuclearization" while talking about "threat" from someone, it will only give unlimited justness and justification to the advance of the DPRK aspiring after the building of the strongest nuclear force for self-defence.
The DPRK will make steady responsible efforts to thoroughly defend the supreme interests of the state and ensure regional peace and stability, given that the U.S. has gone to extremes in its nuclear threat and its nuclear alliance is getting desperate in its confrontational moves as days go by. -0-

headline: Educational Aid System for Children with Disabilities Operated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- The educational sector of the DPRK has directed efforts to the preparations for operating a new educational aid system for children with disabilities in an experimental way this year.
Officials and educators in the relevant field set up a class for children with hearing disorder at the Hwawon Kindergarten No. 2 in Hwasong District, Pyongyang Municipality, assigned teachers and doctors in charge of them and improved teaching program to suit the actual conditions.
And they produced multimedia, published new teaching materials for deaf-and-dumb education and provided hundreds of teaching aids and toys.
They also provided living conditions for children with disabilities as they organize the weekly kindergarten class and made sure that the children attend the kindergarten from their home by bus.
On April 1, the first lesson for children with disabilities from various districts of the municipality was given at the Hwawon Kindergarten No. 2.
On the basis of generalizing the experience gained by the kindergarten in education given in an experimental way, kindergarten classes for children with disabilities will be organized and operated in all provinces from next year. -0-

headline:
Measure for Workers Taken by Chairman Kim Jong Il
[2025.04.09.]
story_text:
One day in June 1998, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited Jagang Province of the DPRK.
That day, the Chairman asked a senior official of the province about the arrival time of the representatives of workers who were to enjoy an art performance for congratulating them in the afternoon.
Hearing the official's reply that those from the farthest area were unlikely to arrive in time, the Chairman told him to start the performance an hour later if they would not arrive in time.
The official was surprised as he knew well that every second is very precious in the Chairman's work schedule.
As if he fathomed the official's feelings, the Chairman said in a soft voice that the performance is given to congratulate the workers who created the Kanggye spirit and working manner of the people of Jagang Province and that the performance should not be given without their participation. Though he is busy, he should wait for them and the performance should start after the representatives arrived, the chairman added.
That day the Chairman postponed his afternoon schedule and waited for them for an hour. -0-

headline: National Industrial Art Exhibition Opens
Educational Aid System for Children with Disabilities Operated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- The educational sector of the DPRK has directed efforts to the preparations for operating a new educational aid system for children with disabilities in an experimental way this year.
Officials and educators in the relevant field set up a class for children with hearing disorder at the Hwawon Kindergarten No. 2 in Hwasong District, Pyongyang Municipality, assigned teachers and doctors in charge of them and improved teaching program to suit the actual conditions.
And they produced multimedia, published new teaching materials for deaf-and-dumb education and provided hundreds of teaching aids and toys.
They also provided living conditions for children with disabilities as they organize the weekly kindergarten class and made sure that the children attend the kindergarten from their home by bus.
On April 1, the first lesson for children with disabilities from various districts of the municipality was given at the Hwawon Kindergarten No. 2.
On the basis of generalizing the experience gained by the kindergarten in education given in an experimental way, kindergarten classes for children with disabilities will be organized and operated in all provinces from next year. -0-

headline: State Academic Degrees and Titles Awarded to Intellectuals
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- State academic degrees and titles were awarded to intellectuals.
Present at the awarding ceremony, held on April 8, were Vice-Premier Jon Sung Guk and intellectuals.
The title of candidate academician went to Dean of a faculty O Chon Il, Head of a department Yu Chol Jun and Section Chief Kim Nam Chol ofKim Il SungUniversity, Official Choe Chol of University of National Economy and Director of an institute Hong Chol Hwa of the Academy of Social Sciences.
Professorship was awarded to Pak Kyong Il, head of a department ofKim Il SungUniversity, O Hui Nam, teacher of the university, Kim Kuk Mo, vice department director of Kim Chaek University of Technology, Kang Hyon Mi, head of a department of Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies, and Ri Sok Ryong, rector of the Unjong area postgraduate school of the State Academy of Sciences.
Doctoral degrees were conferred on 54 persons including Pak Kyong Hui, teacher of the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Un Hak, head of a department of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, and Kim Hye Yong, rector of Hyesan Teacher Training College.
True to our Party's idea of attaching importance to science and technology, they made research successes conducive to the development of the country's economy and the improvement of the people's standard of living and made positive contributions to the education of the rising generation. -0-

Implementation of Party's Childcare Policy in 2024 Reviewed
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- A meeting to review the work for implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's childcare policy in 2024 was held at the Cabinet of the DPRK on April 9 through video conferencing.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior party and government officials, officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries, national agencies, armed forces organs, provincial, city and county party and power organs and officials of relevant fields.
A report was made.
The reporter said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who set it as the most important policy to provide the children with better conditions for upbringing, wisely led the struggle for implementing it.
Many successes have been made in the work of last year to thoroughly implement the Party's childcare policy, true to the lofty intention of the Party Central Committee which set it as an important revolutionary work to bring up the children, the future of the country, stoutly, the reporter noted.
He referred to the fact that the creation of pasture and the construction of goat pens have been pushed forward in real earnest and the number of cows and goats of  supra-species increased amid the brisk work for strengthening the production foundation at milk production units across the country.
The report analyzed and reviewed some defects and deviations revealed by some units including failing to ensure the quality of milk products at a standard level.
The meeting called on all officials to fulfill their duty, always bearing in mind that the work for thoroughly implementing the Party's childcare policy is an important work for bringing into practice the socialist policy for the children. -0-

headline: Highly Appreciated "Feedback Book"
story_text:
One day in December 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory.
That dayKim Jong Unhighly praised the officials of the factory for making and using a "feedback book".
It is a good thing that the factory has made "feedback books" in shops and sums up the opinions of the people on the products of the factory to apply them into the production, he said, adding that it is necessary in the future, too, to lend an ear to the people's stern estimation and look into the tastes of the people in conformity with their characteristics of age and occupation as well as seasons so as to produce more shoes favored by all the people.
He said with satisfaction that he had seen a heap of shoes although he visited the factory without notice and that he was very pleased to see the factory putting production on a normal footing and churning out quality shoes.
Looking up to the respected General Secretary who praises the officials though they just fulfilled their duty, they more keenly realized that it is their important duty to find out what the people like. -0-

headline: Forest Restoration and Land Management Reviewed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- A meeting for reviewing the forest restoration and the general mobilization for land management in 2024 took place via video conferencing at the DPRK Cabinet on Wednesday.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the C.C., WPK, other senior Party and government officials and officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries, national agencies, armed forces organs, provincial, city and county party and power organs and relevant sectors.
The participants watched videos on last year's work for forest restoration and general mobilization for land management.
A video on forest restoration dealt with the fact that modern tree nurseries have been built in provinces, cities and counties, more than one million hectares of forests, including hundreds of thousands of hectares of forests with wild fruit, created and forest scientific research bases successfully built in different parts of the country over the past decade under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A video on general mobilization for land management dealt with the successful completion of the anti-land-sliding and road improvement project for the Bobachi Pass located in the suburbs of Hyesan City by the Cabinet, the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the 216 Division and Ryanggang Province, which removed the traces of damage and improved the appearance of border areas. It also showed a vigorous drive conducted across the country to improve rivers and streams, repair houses and public buildings, remodel parks and recreation grounds, and plant trees and turfs.
It dealt with the fact that the working people's organizations heightened the atmosphere of general mobilization for land management in combination with various mass movements, and that the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, the Ministry of Metal Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Railways and the Ministry of Finance and other relevant units provided equipment and materials necessary for land development and management in a responsible manner.
On the same day, there was a meeting for reviewing the 2024 work for increasing the railway intensity.
The successes made in replacing all existing sleepers with concrete ones, efforts for improving the stability of railways and improving the appearance of their surroundings reminded again the participants of the importance of railway work.
The meetings referred to the deviations revealed in last year's work.
They called upon all officials to bring about improvement in afforestation, land management, ecological environment protection and railway modernization with a fresh determination, and stressed the need to make full nationwide preparations for countering disastrous danger. -0-

headline: Crystal Mirabilite Production Expanded at December 5 Youth Mine in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- The December 5 Youth Mine in the DPRK is expanding the crystal mirabilite production
The workers and technicians of the mine introduced advanced blasting methods by down hole drilling and increased the production 2.5 times by intensifying the transfer of technology between shifts.
They increase the transport capacity of electric and mining cars and raise the operation rate of belt conveyors by introducing valuable technical innovation proposals.
They strengthen real-time monitoring by integrated automation system and cooperation between processes and ensure that the crystal mirabilite is produced in conformity with scientific and technological requirements.
They produce high quality crystal mirabilite while attaching importance to the management of equipment and technical control. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- Photo exhibitions dealing with the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's immortal exploits in glorifying 2024 as a year of proud victory are going on in all provinces, cities and counties of the DPRK.
Officials, working people, youth and students visit the exhibition venues with boundless reverence for the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho adorned the days and months of the significant last year with eye-opening events and gigantic changes with his rare ideo-theoretical wisdom and bold revolutionary practice.
Looking at the photo titled "The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmaking an important conclusion at the Enlarged Meeting of the Tenth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea", etc., the visitors deeply grasp the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great man who clarified the far-reaching strategy and perfect practical programmes for the Korean revolution and worked hard to translate the long-cherished desires of the people into reality all year round.

headline: DPRK Countryside Spruced up
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- Housing construction has been propelled in rural areas of the DPRK this year, too. More than 20 000 flats in the rural areas are under construction.
Since the Workers' Party of Korea set forth the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, more than 80 000 flats have been newly built at 1 500-odd rural villages for the past 3 years.
The rural villages in which trees of good species and flower shrubs were planted around single- and low-storied dwelling houses are as beautiful as a picture.
If this year's plan for rural housing construction is carried out, more than 100 000 modern flats will be built at the rural countryside.
The countryside, the pronoun of centuries-old backwardness in the past, has become the pronoun of epoch-making change and civilization. Farmers who envied the urban life have become the masters of happiness who receive free of charge the new houses to be envied by citizens.
Every year, new villages and new life have been witnessed in rural areas, which regarded backwardness from modern civilization as their fate.
The owners of the wonderfully-changed new villages express their deep emotion, saying that they came to enjoy a happy life at beautiful farm villages like the park and at dwelling houses in the garden.
The agricultural workers are filled with the hope for new life and new happiness and confidence along with the fairyland villages which have been built like a dream in the new era of rural rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Hung Jom, a woman centenarian living in neighborhood unit No. 28, Kwangdap-ri, Kaephung District, Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
Officials of the district committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers shared joy with her family.

The chairman of the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association said that the great ComradeKim Il Sungis the founder of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the prominent leader who built the socialist system centered on the popular masses in Korea.

The chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association and the secretary general of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said that they paid the highest tribute to ComradeKim Il Sungwho ushered in a new era of independence by founding the Juche idea on the occasion of his birth anniversary. They noted that the validity and great vitality of the Juche idea are being clearly proved in practice.
Personages of the Bulgarian Communists' Party praisedKim Il Sungas an outstanding leader of the world revolution who devoted his whole life to accomplishing the cause of socialism, the cause of independence against imperialism.
