headline: President Kim Il Sung's Love for Workers
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- One day in April 1947, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory and decided to have lunch together with its employees.
At a room, the President asked why an old worker of the pulverized-coal workshop was absent.
When the President looked round the factory, the manager pointed at the old worker passing through the yard and told the President that he became deaf due to the noisy sound of coal crusher in the course of working at the factory for a long time.
Not forgetting the old worker, the President called him to have lunch together.
After a short time, the old worker came in haste in working clothes. The President took the old worker's bruised hand, expressing gladness, and offered him a chair near him.
The President offered the meal to him who is hesitating, relaxing his tension.
The President said that he was very pleased to see the old worker who had suffered many hardships, and offered him the first drink. Then the President pushed the dishes before him.
It was a significant lunch arranged by the President for the workers who became masters of the factory and the country. -0-

headline: Flower Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Abroad

Signboard of "Joint" Is "Disguise" of Belligerent Japan: KCNA Commentary
							
							
							[2025.04.12.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 12 (KCNA) -- The signboard of "joint" is recently emerging as a "term" frequently used in various military acts of Japan.
Shortly ago, Japan and the U.S. agreed on the joint production of the latest air-to-air missile AIM-120, occasioned by the U.S. secretary of Defense's visit to Japan. Such examples are numerous: on-going joint development of the next-generation fighter planes with the U.K. and Italy, joint development of new-type warships with Australia, joint research with the U.S. to put microwave weapons to practical use, joint maintenance and overhauling of U.S. warships and aircraft, etc.
Given the joint military exercises between the forces of different countries including NATO, which Japan is staging not only in the Asia-Pacific region but also in the far-off regions, it is not difficult to understand that the signboard of "joint" put up by Japan covers most of the military moves of the archipelago nation.
This does not merely mean the strengthening of Japan's external military cooperation.
Japan has been bound by various internal and external institutional mechanisms deterring its military expansion as a war criminal state which inflicted huge damage on the Asian people in the last century.
Now all the constraints have become a thing of the past. For example, Japan abolished the principle of banning weapons export it had observed for decades and has come up with the new "three principles of defense equipment transfer".

headline: Premieres of April Spring People's Art Festival Given in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 12 (KCNA) -- Premieres of the Ninth April Spring People's Art Festival were given at theatres and halls in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Friday.
Enjoying the performances were members of the festival organizing committee and officials, working people and youth and students in Pyongyang.
Put on the stages of performances given by art group members from industrial establishments, farms and other units across the country were monumental hymns praising the peerlessly great men and famous songs of the times reflecting the indomitable stamina and ideological and moral world of the heroic Korean people.
Performances by art group members from Changsong County, the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Kangson Vinyl Sheet Factory and the Sariwon Disabled Soldiers' Sewing Thread Factory were given at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre and the Pyongyang Grand Theatre.
The performances were highly acclaimed by the audience as they were full of boundless reverence for the peerlessly great men and of the revolutionary zeal to further intensify a drive for increased production and economy by making the flames of the creation of Chollima spirit in the new era.

The performances gave deep impression to the audience as they well depicted in an ideological and artistic way the endless joy and happiness of the Korean people leading the most worthwhile life by holding the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unas the father of the great family of the country.
Art group members from the Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant, the Ryongchon Fruit Farm in Pukchong County, the Kyenam Stockbreeding Farm of the South Hwanghae Provincial Rural Economy Committee and the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant gave their performances at the Cultural Hall of the Ministry of Railways and the Central Hall of Workers.

Visitors are moved to see the photos showing the boundless devotion of the President, who had made ceaseless field guidance at farms and ports in all weathers until the last moments of his great life.

headline: Pukchang Thermal Power Complex Lays Foundation for Boosting Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 12 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex in the DPRK are striving to create new standard and new record.
The complex renewed the records of operating days per ignition by improving its management method and laid a foundation for producing hundreds of millions kWh more of electricity every year.
It introduced a new method of assessment in an overall way to orient and subordinate all the economic organization and production control to the management of equipment and technical control and give priority to quality.
In the course, it over-fulfilled the first quarterly production plan, set at a high level, by increasing the number of operating days per ignition to 19 days in January and 26 in February for the first time in several decades. The number of operating days per ignition in the past had been 15 days on the average.
The innovative successes, made in raising the generating capacity 1.2 times by ensuring normal operation of the power system and updating the performance of generators, proved the validity and vitality of the strategy for readjustment and reinforcement set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea.
With the patriotic enthusiasm of officials and workers growing, the consumption of coal for producing 1 kWh of electricity in one generator alone decreased considerably as compared with the previous one, thus saving more than 6 000 tons of coal in the quarter of the year and opening up a prospect for remarkably increasing electricity production every year. -0-

headline:
Meaningful "Photo Letter"
							
							
							[2025.04.12.]
story_text:
One day in December 2013, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Ungave his field guidance at a fishery station.
Looking round a pickled fish store, he said that he couldn't leave the store filled with fish and that he would like to take a photo against a background of the fish to be supplied to the servicepersons. And he sat down on an elevated place of a pickling tank where the pickled fish were piled up.
He also dropped in at a refrigerating chamber and expressed great satisfaction at the sight of the frozen fish piled up to the ceiling. He then proposed to take a photo in the narrow passage of the chamber.
And he had photo sessions with the officials sitting and standing before and beside him.
When an official told him that soldiers liked to eat more fish than when they were at home and to eat it every day and that their parents would not believe it easily if soldiers wrote about this to their parents, the General Secretary said with a broad smile that the parents would believe it through the photograph he had taken before a pile of fish.
The photos he took before the piles of fish are the Supreme Commander's "photo letter" to all the families of service personnel in the country who had sent their sons and daughters to the military posts. -0-

headline: Paeksong Revolutionary Site in DPRK Draws Many Visitors
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK is conducting the substantial education in the revolutionary traditions through visits to a revolutionary site.
On the occasion of the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation, officials and working people of many units and youth and students have visited the Paeksong Revolutionary Site to deeply grasp the immortal feats of PresidentKim Il Sung, who ushered in the future of the country's prosperity in the flames of the fierce war.
The Paeksong Revolutionary Site is a historic place associated with the immortal history of the President. The President visited there in April 1952 to instill confidence in victory into the teaching staff and students ofKim Il SungUniversity and clearly indicated the road ahead of the university and the prospect of postwar reconstruction.
At the Paeksong Revolutionary Museum, the visitors recollected with deep emotion the noble life of the President who gave importance to the training of national cadres of the country, led the establishment of the first university in the liberated country and personally visited Paeksong-ri during the war to show great love and trust for the teaching staff and students.
They went round various places of the revolutionary site, picturing the teaching staff and students who made a pledge of loyalty to glorify the country of GeneralKim Il Sungall over the world, reciting the poem "Song Dedicated to the Leader" reflecting their best wishes to the President on the occasion of his 40th birthday. -0-

They include the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, the General Association of Koreans in China, the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Federation of Korean Economic Workers in China, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Association of Korean Women in China and the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan.
The flower baskets were laid at the statues of the great leaders on April 12. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Feats for Nation-building
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungis a prominent leader who opened up a new era of building a prosperous state by dint of self-reliance.
He glorified the DPRK's course of nation building and development as the annals of self-reliance, regarding independence, self-support and self-reliance as treasured sword of victory in the revolution.
After the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945), he called for those with strength to offer their energies and those with knowledge and money to offer their knowledge and money so as to contribute to the nation-building. This nation-building idea served as an important occasion in bringing about a dramatic turn in the ideological and moral sphere of the Korean people.
The cause of building the Party, the state and the army in Korea was successfully realized, thanks to the energetic leadership of the President who set forth the line of building a new country, a prosperous and independent sovereign state, by the Korean people themselves and wisely guided the struggle for its implementation.
Our Republic could proudly emerge on the world stage as an independent and sovereign state and achieve a brilliant victory in the three-year Fatherland Liberation War.
Under the leadership of the President, who definitely adhered to the original lines of building an independent national economy and of simultaneously carrying on the economic and defence construction, constantly maintaining the independent stand despite the harsh circumstances, the DPRK turned into a socialist country with the foundation of the self-supporting economy and the self-reliant defence capability.
Thanks to the solid foundations for independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence provided by the President, the Korean people could make steady progress and development, creating world-startling miraculous events one after another and building many monumental edifices despite the hostile forces' continued moves to stifle the DPRK. -0-

headline: Work to Protect Useful Animals Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, a period from March to July is for the protection of useful animals.
Amid a nationwide protection campaign, the number of useful animals has increased in North Phyongan and South Hwanghae provinces and other parts of the country in the last few years alone, adding to its landscape.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unhas meticulously guided the work to protect and propagate useful animals, regarding it as a patriotic undertaking to provide the people with a more beautiful and better paradise.
In April 2012, he set the days from March to July every year as a period for the protection of useful animals and gave an instruction on intensively carrying on the protection of animals with involvement of the entire Party and state and all the people in the period.
He saw to it that the Fifth Plenary Meeting of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea adopted it as a decision for each province to breed and release such animals as roe deer and pheasant and supply with fodder in autumn so as to protect and propagate useful animals.
Sanctuaries and temporary sanctuaries for useful animals have been created in different parts of the country and relevant units are managing the sanctuaries well.
Such projects are conducted to create mixed forests in and around the sanctuaries and prevent damage by harmful insects so as to provide favorable habitat for useful animals. Especially in spring, big efforts are directed to preventing forest-fire to protect forests and useful animals.
Also, conducted on a regular basis is the work to survey and register the range of animals living in sanctuaries, those designated as objects of protection and propagation, endemic and rare species of animals in the country and endangered species of animals. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Proceeds to Quarterfinals of 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- The 2025 AFC U-17 Asian Cup is under way in Saudi Arabia.
The tournament brought together teams of 16 countries including the DPRK, China, Uzbekistan and Vietnam.
The DPRK team, belonging to Group D, drew 1:1 with the Iranian team in the first group league match. And it beat the Tajikistan team 3:0 and drew 2:2 with the Oman team.
As a result, it proceeded to the quarterfinals, with five points in total and as the second in the group standing. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Feats for Nation-building
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungis a prominent leader who opened up a new era of building a prosperous state by dint of self-reliance.
He glorified the DPRK's course of nation building and development as the annals of self-reliance, regarding independence, self-support and self-reliance as treasured sword of victory in the revolution.
After the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945), he called for those with strength to offer their energies and those with knowledge and money to offer their knowledge and money so as to contribute to the nation-building. This nation-building idea served as an important occasion in bringing about a dramatic turn in the ideological and moral sphere of the Korean people.
The cause of building the Party, the state and the army in Korea was successfully realized, thanks to the energetic leadership of the President who set forth the line of building a new country, a prosperous and independent sovereign state, by the Korean people themselves and wisely guided the struggle for its implementation.
Our Republic could proudly emerge on the world stage as an independent and sovereign state and achieve a brilliant victory in the three-year Fatherland Liberation War.
Under the leadership of the President, who definitely adhered to the original lines of building an independent national economy and of simultaneously carrying on the economic and defence construction, constantly maintaining the independent stand despite the harsh circumstances, the DPRK turned into a socialist country with the foundation of the self-supporting economy and the self-reliant defence capability.
Thanks to the solid foundations for independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence provided by the President, the Korean people could make steady progress and development, creating world-startling miraculous events one after another and building many monumental edifices despite the hostile forces' continued moves to stifle the DPRK. -0-

headline: Performances of Ninth Spring April People's Art Festival Go on
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of National Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
The premier called upon the Kumsong Tractor Factory and the Kangso Engine Accessory Factory to further improve the machining accuracy and quality of products by actively introducing advanced science and technology and push ahead with the development and production of effective farm machines of various kinds so as to uphold with high production results the Party's idea on continuously raising the proportion of the farm work done by machines.
He acquainted himself in detail with the steel tower production process for super-high voltage transmission line and the operation of equipment at the transmission line laying station. And he underlined the need to unconditionally implement the task planned for this year by effectively utilizing the existing production capability and show special care for the employees' living in conformity with the features of the unit which has lots of itinerant work to do.
At the Pyongyang Bearing Factory, the premier called on its officials and workers to intensify the drive for increased production in the same spirit as displayed to over-fulfill the first quarterly national economic plan and further raise the actual output ratio and the quality of bearings by steadily strengthening the sci-tech force of the factory.
Visiting the State General Bureau of Design, he said that the bureau should produce more new and peculiar architectural designs symbolic of the era of great prosperity in construction by updating the design means and positively introducing advanced design methods, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, and fulfill its mission as a powerful design guidance organ by improving the ability of designers and intensifying the training of talents and the guidance over design and the assessment system.
The premier visited the Unjom Farm in Singye County of North Hwanghae Province to learn in detail about the growth of earlier wheat and burley and called for reaping a good harvest in the production of early-ripening crops by manuring and tending them in a responsible way. He also called upon the agricultural guidance organs at all levels to direct efforts to the farming in intermediate and mountainous area.
Then he learned about the preparation for operating a new wheat processing factory built in the county and took such practical steps for its normal operation as the reinforcement of transport means and the improvement of employees' technical knowledge and skills.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving precedence to the supply of products under contract and materials needed for the production of farm machines and the laying of super-high voltage transmission lines and establishing a proper system to provide the workers involved in laying transmission lines with better living conditions, the issue of further strengthening the foundation for bearing production, the issue of steadily improving the design assessment work, etc. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Criteria of Thinking and Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungwas the benevolent father of the people who devoted his all to the people all his life.
The President had always put the people's interests above anything else in thinking and activities, and his love for the people was laid in the centre of his thinking and practice.
One day he saw a rare hen with long feathers of various colors on its heels.
He asked an official how many eggs it laid in a year and said with great regret that for the hen, priority should be given to lay many eggs, not good in appearance, adding that he would come to see a hen every day if there were any hen that lay many eggs, no matter how ugly it may look.
He went on to say earnestly that it would be good to have a hen laying 400 eggs a year and then, more eggs would be supplied to our people.
Like this, the absolute criteria of all value assessment for him were the interests and happiness of the people.
One day in August, 1958, the President got aboard and arrived the water off the Panwol Islet in the River Taedong. He looked at the rock spreading like a screen on the shore for a while, pointed a finger at it and said that the rock is Okryu Wall and it is a very good place for the site of the house, adding that a Korean-style restaurant which matches well with the scenery of the River Taedong and looks like a floating building should be built there and provided it for our people.
The President took a measure to build a Korean-style restaurant for the people in the famous place on the Okryu Wall boasting of superb scenic beauty and named it "Okryu Restaurant".
Indeed, he devoted himself to the happiness of the people while thinking only of the people. Such legendary stories about his love for the people can be heard at every place of the country. -0-

headline: Passing-on-technique for Operation of Largest-scale Greenhouse Farm Underway
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- Amid the construction of the 450-hectare greenhouse farm and the vegetable science research centre on an islet in the northwestern frontier of the DPRK, a passing-on-technique for their operation is under way at the Kangdong Central Vegetable Research Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Science and the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unensured that North Phyongan Province selected persons to be trained as technicians and skilled workers for the operation of the greenhouse farm and sent them to the institute and the complex to get the stepwise passing-on-technique.
North Phyongan Province made preparations for getting passing-on-technique.
Since the start of the passing-on-technique, researchers of the Kangdong Central Vegetable Research Institute have personally given lectures to transfer more ample knowledge to the trainees.
The Kangdong Greenhouse Complex, too, provides the trainees with conditions for consolidating their knowledge while seeing and practicing many things related to greenhouse vegetable cultivation at worksites.
The trainees are actively participating in theoretical education and field practice to learn more technical issues arising in all farming processes ranging from seed treatment to sowing, transplanting seedlings, manuring and cultivating and harvesting, giving importance to putting the vegetable production on a higher-level scientific basis.
Management officials involved in the trainee group, too, are learning advanced management methods and technical issues for production and management. -0-

headline: Flower Festival-2025 Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- The Flower Festival-2025 opened with due ceremony on April 13 in the April 15 Children's Flower Garden on the occasion of the meaningful April holiday.
The festival, which was held on the theme of "Beautiful Spring, Our Beautiful Life", brought together flower research and production units in Pyongyang and local areas, some institutions, enterprises, organizations and flower fanciers.
Displayed at the venue of the festival decorated with various plant sculptures and ornamental plants are various kinds of flower plants, products made with flowers and tools used in the field of horticulture presented by more than 200 units and fanciers across the country.
Present at the opening ceremony were officials concerned, participants in the festival and working people in Pyongyang.
At the ceremony a speaker expressed belief that the festival would add pleasure to the people greeting the auspicious April spring holiday, boost social interests in floriculture and make a positive contribution to turning the whole country into a socialist paradise where all sorts of flowers are in full bloom.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the venue of the festival.
During the festival, a public presentation of experience and other technical exchange and flower-serving activities will be conducted. -0-

headline: Design for Overpass
story_text:
One day in April 1972, PresidentKim Il Sungcame to pass a factory on his way for field guidance.
It was time for the workers to go to work, and a train was running towards the crossing point, whistling. Some workers stopped and waited for the train to pass, greeting the engine driver.
While watching them, the President felt anxiety and told officials to take a necessary step to remove their inconvenience.
The President returned to Pyongyang after his field guidance, called an official and asked him about a railway crossing.
The official replied that it was planned to build an underground passage, showing its design to the President.
After examining the design, the President said that the train should not be allowed to run over the workers' heads but the workers should go over the train, and gave an instruction on building an overpass.
Thus, the design of underground crossing was replaced by the overpass design. -0-

headline:
Rodong Sinmun on Immortal Feats of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.04.14.]

Rodong Sinmun on Immortal Feats of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.04.14.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Monday in an article says that the great ideas and advance policies set forth by PresidentKim Il Sung, looking forward to the distant future of Juche Korea, are now dynamically leading the struggle for the new victory of the revolution and the brilliant victory and happy life of the Korean people are associated with his benevolent care.
History tells many stories about famous persons who stunned an era or a generation with rare strategy, courage and distinguished feats, but there is no such a greatest man as the President who brought about great changes and innovations of the times and organized everything in a far-sighted way looking forward to the distant future with his outstanding foresight and gifted wisdom and thus made posterity benefit from them generation after generation, the article says, adding:
The ideological and theoretical wisdom of the President is the most outstanding insight and the essence of farsightedness full of impeccable analysis and judgment and perfect solution of foreseeing the eternal future of the country.
The President provided the precious tradition of building the Juche-oriented defence industry in the flames of the anti-Japanese war. He foresaw the distant future of the Korean revolution and advanced the original idea on building the self-supporting defence industry for the first time in history right after the liberation of the country. And he wisely led the struggle for its realization and advanced the line of simultaneously pushing forward economic construction and defence building, thus taking the untrodden path of history for building a powerful defence industry.
Indeed, the independent and modern defence industry, which the President provided with much effort looking far ahead into the future and handed over to the Korean people, is a precious legacy and a valuable asset reliably guaranteeing the security of the country and the people.
The precious victories won in the Korean revolution were a precious fruition of the extraordinary foresightedness of the President who always looked far ahead and established correct strategies and measures foreseeing all possible events, not taking measures for overcoming imminent difficulties.
The outstanding leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unserves as a great driving force that makes the sacred revolutionary history of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilgo down forever on this land. -0-

Visiting the State General Bureau of Design, he said that the bureau should produce more new and peculiar architectural designs symbolic of the era of great prosperity in construction by updating the design means and positively introducing advanced design methods, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, and fulfill its mission as a powerful design guidance organ by improving the ability of designers and intensifying the training of talents and the guidance over design and the assessment system.
The premier visited the Unjom Farm in Singye County of North Hwanghae Province to learn in detail about the growth of earlier wheat and burley and called for reaping a good harvest in the production of early-ripening crops by manuring and tending them in a responsible way. Then he learned about the preparation for operating a new wheat processing factory built in the county and took such practical steps for its normal operation as the reinforcement of transport means and the improvement of employees' technical knowledge and skills.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving precedence to the supply of products under contract and materials needed for the production of farm machines and the laying of super-high voltage transmission lines and establishing a proper system to provide the workers involved in laying transmission lines with better living conditions, the issue of further strengthening the foundation for bearing production, the issue of steadily improving the design assessment work, etc. -0-

headline: Photo Exhibition Showing Eye-opening Development of Pyongyang Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- A photo exhibition "Pyongyang, our capital city undergone a radical turn in the great era ofKim Jong Un" was opened on the occasion of the significant April holiday. It shows the new history of change of Pyongyang in a period of great prosperity in construction, the great heyday of creation provided by the great ambition and energetic leadership of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
The photo exhibition intensively and visually shows the eye-opening development of prosperous Pyongyang in the new era while recording the unprecedented miracles in the history of capital construction, and is an epitome making the people keenly feel the bright prospect of the DPRK and the capital city advancing and making a leap forward on the people-first principle.
A photo of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unindicating the tasks and ways for building Ryomyong Street is displayed at the venue of the exhibition.
On display at the venue of the exhibition are more than 380 photos of the new and peculiar monumental edifices and magnificent spectacular scenes of Pyongyang in various aspects, while recording unprecedented miracles of creation in width and depth of changes in the new era of the glorious Juche revolution, the great era ofKim Jong Un, in the content and form of architecture, and in the speed and scale of construction.
The photo exhibition clearly shows that the epochal change in Pyongyang is the vigorous breath and valiant spirit of the great era ofKim Jong Undynamically advancing toward the bright future of a socialist power and the appearance of Juche Korea symbolic of the comprehensive development of our state and the new cultural efflorescence.
An opening ceremony of the photo exhibition took place at the Okryu Exhibition House on Sunday.

The change in Pyongyang is not merely a success brought about for ten-odd years but a brilliant fruition of the outstanding wisdom and immortal efforts of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho led the great changes with his ardent patriotic will that the capital of our state should become the most beautiful and great one in the world.

headline: Passing-on-technique for Operation of Largest-scale Greenhouse Farm Underway
story_text:

The respected ComradeKim Jong Unensured that North Phyongan Province selected persons to be trained as technicians and skilled workers for the operation of the greenhouse farm and sent them to the institute and the complex to get the stepwise passing-on-technique.
North Phyongan Province made preparations for getting passing-on-technique.
Since the start of the passing-on-technique, researchers of the Kangdong Central Vegetable Research Institute have personally given lectures to transfer more ample knowledge to the trainees.
The Kangdong Greenhouse Complex, too, provides the trainees with conditions for consolidating their knowledge while seeing and practicing many things related to greenhouse vegetable cultivation at worksites.
The trainees are actively participating in theoretical education and field practice to learn more technical issues arising in all farming processes ranging from seed treatment to sowing, transplanting seedlings, manuring and cultivating and harvesting, giving importance to putting the vegetable production on a higher-level scientific basis.
Management officials involved in the trainee group, too, are learning advanced management methods and technical issues for production and management. -0-

headline: Father of Socialist Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people are celebrating the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Thanks to this significant day, a radical turn was brought about in the destiny of the Korean people and a new history of socialist Korea opened up.
In his teens, the President set forth the programme of the revolutionary struggle for building a country where the people become the masters of everything and everything serves them. He led the armed struggle against the Japanese imperialists to victory and finally achieved the historic cause of national liberation.
He instilled into the Korean people the consciousness that they were the masters of liberated Korea and worked heart and soul to establish the spirit of national independence throughout the country.
He provided the people with socio-economic and cultural conditions for creating a genuine new life by enforcing democratic reforms such as the promulgation of the law on agrarian reform, the law on nationalization of major industries, the labor law and the law on sex equality.
Under his leadership, the Korean people grew up to be genuine masters of the state and society and independent and creative people who shape their destiny with their own hands.
They defeated the U.S. imperialist aggressors and won a great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950 - July 27, 1953), realized the socialist industrialization in a matter of 14 years and built a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence on this land.
They are now holding in high esteem the President as the father of socialist Korea and the eternal President of the DPRK as he turned Korea, once eclipsed in the world map after being reduced into a colony of the Japanese imperialists, into the dignified socialist state of Juche. -0-

headline: Life of Popular Leader Brilliant with Devotion for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- Greeting the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation, the people in the DPRK are looking back with deep emotion on the life of PresidentKim Il Sungwho believed in the people as in Heaven.
Regarding as his motto of life and struggle the truth that if one believes in the people and relies on them, one will always win a victory, but if one is forsaken by them, one will always suffer a defeat, the President had continued his field guidance till the last moments of his revolutionary life to find himself among the people.
He had made ceaseless journey for the happiness of the people, not minding the muddy and rugged roads, since the day he firstly visited the workers of the then Kangson Steel Plant before others, not visiting his beloved old home after liberating Korea from Japan's colonial rule.
One day in September 1948 he visited a village on the west coast to see the inhabitants drink water in a puddle and initiated a plan for a waterway project to bring life-giving water to them, thus realizing their long-cherished desire.
He also transplanted rice seedlings in paddy fields with the farmers and taught the knack of farming while walking on a footpath between rice paddies.
Whenever he visited a factory, he took oil-stained hands of the workers and watched the products they produced one by one.
Lots of touching stories were created during his field guidance such as the one in which he visited a mountain village in the northern part of the country by pushing his car caught in a marshland, saying that he should visit every place where people live. And in another story the President went into a working face where waters dripped from the ceiling, saying that he visited the mine to see the miners work in the face.
The number of units the President visited from the days immediately after the liberation of Korea to the last moments of his life is over 20 600 and the total length of the course of his field guidance is over 578 000 km.
Indeed, his whole life was the noble one of the popular leader who made indefatigable efforts for the happiness of the people. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Flower Baskets from Russian Figures
August Name Shining All Over World
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- With his rare wisdom, outstanding leadership ability and noble virtue, PresidentKim Il Sungglorified the 20th century as a century of independence and set an example in the world history of the revolution and construction.
That's why the progressive mankind named at least 480 streets, institutions and organizations of more than 100 countries afterKim Il Sungtill the late 1990s, reflecting the will to convey his immortal revolutionary exploits forever.
In 1945, workers belonging to a political party of Costa Rica formed theKim Il SungCell with deep reverence for the President who was building a new society where the people became masters with his experienced and seasoned leadership.
The Chinese party and government formed theKim Il SungClass at Beijing Middle School No. 5 in November 1950.
In the 1970s, groups for studying his works, committees for the study of works, groups for the study of the Juche idea and groups for reading works named after the august name of the President were organized one after another in many countries.
Prominent figures of political, social and academic circles of different countries established the InternationalKim Il SungPrize Council in New Delhi of India on the occasion of the 81st birth anniversary of the President.
The ardent desire of the world progressives to glorify his immortal exploits forever, holding in high esteem the august name of the President, is still expressed even after his demise.
A ceremony of naming GeneralissimoKim Il SungStreet took place with splendor and the signboard of the street was unveiled in Cambodia in November 1994 and theKim Il SungLibrary, theKim Il SungClass and others were formed in many countries.
The ceaseless establishment of units and organizations bearing the august name of the President in the five continents of the world is an expression of the praise of all people for the precious exploits performed by him for the country, revolution and mankind. -0-

headline: Life of Popular Leader Brilliant with Devotion for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- Greeting the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation, the people in the DPRK are looking back with deep emotion on the life of PresidentKim Il Sungwho believed in the people as in Heaven.
Regarding as his motto of life and struggle the truth that if one believes in the people and relies on them, one will always win a victory, but if one is forsaken by them, one will always suffer a defeat, the President had continued his field guidance till the last moments of his revolutionary life to find himself among the people.
He had made ceaseless journey for the happiness of the people, not minding the muddy and rugged roads, since the day he firstly visited the workers of the then Kangson Steel Plant before others, not visiting his beloved old home after liberating Korea from Japan's colonial rule.
One day in September 1948 he visited a village on the west coast to see the inhabitants drink water in a puddle and initiated a plan for a waterway project to bring life-giving water to them, thus realizing their long-cherished desire.
He also transplanted rice seedlings in paddy fields with the farmers and taught the knack of farming while walking on a footpath between rice paddies.
Whenever he visited a factory, he took oil-stained hands of the workers and watched the products they produced one by one.
Lots of touching stories were created during his field guidance such as the one in which he visited a mountain village in the northern part of the country by pushing his car caught in a marshland, saying that he should visit every place where people live. And in another story the President went into a working face where waters dripped from the ceiling, saying that he visited the mine to see the miners work in the face.
The number of units the President visited from the days immediately after the liberation of Korea to the last moments of his life is over 20 600 and the total length of the course of his field guidance is over 578 000 km.
Indeed, his whole life was the noble one of the popular leader who made indefatigable efforts for the happiness of the people. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of 10 000 Flats at Third Stage in Hwasong Area Takes Place with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, is turning into a world-class ideal city and a paradise of happiness for the people enjoying a new life and a new civilization of socialism, fully demonstrating its unique majesty and reputation with the spirit of the DPRK racing against time and dynamic advance of the times full of great changes.
Thanks to the capital city construction strategy adopted and set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the scientific and energetic guidance of the great Party Central Committee, modern skyscrapers and high-rise apartment houses embodying an ideal harmony of architectural formative and artistic beauty and advanced civilization and commercial and public catering facilities with strong symbolic and specific characters have been built majestically to form a new large architectural group in the Hwasong area and are ready to greet the third auspicious event of inauguration along with the greatest April holiday of the nation.
The eye-opening reality, in which another modern urban quarter has been created to demonstrate the radical development of Juche-oriented architecture and the change in civilization and efflorescence after the emergence of Songhwa Street, Hwasong Street, Rimhung Street and Jonwi Street in just 4 years since the first blasting for the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang was heard, is a brilliant fruition of the transparent outlook on the people and outstanding leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, who regards the people as his God and devotes his all to their well-being, and a monumental picture showing the spirit of uninterrupted revolution peculiar to the WPK knowing no satisfaction and end in the work for the people and the dynamic advance of our powerful state.
The inauguration ceremony of 10 000 flat at the third-stage in the Hwasong area took place with splendor on April 15.
The venue of the ceremony was full of excitement and joy of the military and civilian builders, who had recorded a history of great change in the Hwasong area year after year through a stubborn struggle upholding the cherished desire of our Party with miracles of creation, and citizens who would happily move into the new modern apartment houses.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the ceremony, fireworks were displayed and thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded far and wide.
All the participants raised enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the outstanding revolutionary, great master of creation and construction and benevolent father who opened up a new history of eye-opening changes in the capital city of Pyongyang through the great drive for creation, the first of its kind after the founding of the state, and ushered in the greatest heyday of prosperity for the people to enjoy an affluent and civilized life full of happiness.
Present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, officials of the Cabinet, armed forces organs, ministries and national agencies, builders and working people in Pyongyang.
Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an inaugural address.
Saying that the capital city construction plan decided by the Eighth Party Congress has been proved fruitful in the fourth year, too, to greet the moment of its grand ceremony of presenting another 10 000 flats to Pyongyang citizens in the Hwasong area, he warmly congratulated the citizens of all social strata who became masters of a modern new street and new houses, upon the authorization of the Party and the government, and extended thanks to all the builders and workers and officials in the field concerned and supporters who have splendidly translated the high level of urban culture intended by the Party into a reality, not leaving it as a future project on a blueprint.
He said that the third-stage construction in the Hwasong area has brought to light the perfect features of the Hwasong area as a centre and model capable of leading the existing areas of the capital city to civilization and efflorescence by securing the political, economic and cultural functions befitting a full-fledged administrative district in conformity with the plan and principle consistently maintained by the Party during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee. And this is a development truly meaningful enough to be called the birth of a new urban district making modernized Pyongyang of today present a striking contrast with itself in the past which had undergone change of several decades since the founding of the state, he added.
Thanks to the great thought and efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho personally plans the changes in all fields of the economy, culture, national defence  and all domains covering the capital and regional areas and clearly indicates the guidelines for firmly preserving and developing the popular and revolutionary character of Juche-oriented architecture while showing much care for the well-being of the people and prosperity of our socialist system, everything changes and a new era of prosperity and rejuvenation hastening the future is opened up on this land, he said, adding that the socialist ideal land wonderfully built in the Hwasong area is a historic monument which makes the Korean people keenly feel the happy life and rosy future of our state under the guidance of the great leader.
Saying that our Party and government will, in the future, too, always continue to push forward with the construction work to give fuller play to the advantages of our style of socialist system and promote the change and development of the whole country, thus actively promoting and steadily improving the people’s satisfaction with a new, cultured and wealthy life, he called for striving more courageously for the future of the capital city of Pyongyang which will thrive and become civilized year after year and for the eternal prosperity of the best country in the world, under the milestone of epoch-making changes in the new era indicated by the Party Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were displayed and balloons flew at the venue of the inauguration ceremony, which witnessed another historic scene to be immortally recorded in the history of struggle of the great WPK continuously and vigorously making a sacred journey for the promotion of well-being of the beloved people by erecting monumental edifices symbolic of the era of great change one after another, to beautifully decorate the Hwasong area.
Songs in praise of the times filled with strong stamina and ardent desire of all the Korean people to devote their all to the building of an ideal society where socialist civilization is in full bloom, upholding the dignity and mightiness of our state with their steadfast spirit of pioneering and patriotic will, resounded throughout the venue of the ceremony to make the participants feel deep emotion and joy.
The songs praising the great era ofKim Jong Un, in which the capital city of the revolution, a heroic city that newly emerged by breaking through the debris after the war and glorified the annals of creation and miracles with the eye-opening Pyongyang speed, has reached a new stage of civilization and efflorescence by undergoing more majestic and splendid change beyond recognition every year, added to the joy of the inauguration.
The national anthem of the great DPRK, our socialist country where dreams and ideals of the people are being translated into reality and which upholds the most prominent great man as its leader and father, was solemnly played and fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky of Pyongyang, the city of boundless happiness and glory, to present a sea of flames.
The venue of the ceremony turned into a crucible of excitement with cheers of "Hurrah!" bursting out forKim Jong Unagain.
Kim Jong Unmet working people and old persons who would move into new flats.
Families of a teacher and a worker presented bouquets of flowers to him who put forward ordinary working people as masters of the gorgeous socialist ideal street, in reflection of the unanimous gratitude of the citizens of the capital city and other people across the country.
Kim Jong Unsaid that he was sorry to provide the modern apartment houses only now and that he was firmly determined to take upon himself more work for the people while seeing the citizens full of emotion and joy today. And he wished them happy life in the new houses in good health.
He met and encouraged military and civilian labor innovators who are making contributions to the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, true to the Party's policy on the capital city construction.
He said with love and trust that thanks to the patriotic and elite army of construction carrying out the Party's plan unconditionally like the innovators, the gun-report of victory in the implementation of the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK will be heard first in the Hwasong area and a new era of prosperity of Pyongyang will be given steady continuity.
He warmly waved his hand for a long time to citizens of the capital city expressing boundless gratitude in tears of emotion, and wished good fortune to all families to settle in a new splendid street.
All the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers with their iron-willed pledge to invariably go along the road of loyalty and patriotism for the great ComradeKim Jong Un, for the eternal prosperity of our great state and for the rosy future of our great capital.
The completion of the 10 000 flats at the third-stage in the Hwasong area is a great demonstration of the true picture peculiar to our prosperous and powerful state, which is created by the outstanding leadership of the great Party Central Committee guiding socialist Korea to the peak of prosperity and the patriotic strength of our people single-mindedly rallied close around the Party, and an encouraging great event that further livens up the spirit of all-people advance toward the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and the Ninth Party Congress with redoubled fighting spirit and confidence. -0-

headline:

story_text:

The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited an islet defence detachment in the forefront.

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of 10 000 Flats at Third Stage in Hwasong Area Takes Place with Splendour
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang, the capital of the DPRK, is turning into a world-class ideal city and a paradise of happiness for the people where they enjoy a new life and civilization of socialism, fully demonstrating its unique majesty and reputation with the spirit of the country racing against time and the pulse of the times vibrant with great changes.
Thanks to the capital city construction strategy adopted and set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the scientific and energetic guidance of the great Party Central Committee, modern skyscrapers and high-rise apartment houses embodying an ideal harmony of architectural formative and artistic beauty and advanced civilization and distinctive commercial and public catering facilities with a strong symbolic character have been built majestically as another new large architectural group in the Hwasong area, to greet the third auspicious event of inauguration on the occasion of the greatest April holiday of the nation.
Another modern urban quarter has been created to demonstrate the radical development of Juche-oriented architecture and the transformation of civilization and efflorescence after the emergence of Songhwa, Hwasong, Rimhung and Jonwi streets in just four years since the first blasting for the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang resounded. This eye-opening reality is a brilliant fruition of the transparent outlook on the people and outstanding leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, who regards the people as his God and devotes his all to their well-being, and a monumental picture portraying the spirit of uninterrupted revolution peculiar to the WPK knowing no satisfaction and end in the work for the people and the dynamic advance of our powerful state.
The inauguration ceremony of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area took place with splendour on April 15.
The venue of the ceremony was full of excitement and joy of the military and civilian builders, who had recorded a history of great change in the Hwasong area year after year through a stubborn struggle upholding the cherished desire of our Party with miracles of creation, and citizens who would happily move into the new modern apartment houses.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the ceremony, fireworks were set off and thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded far and wide.
All the participants raised enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the outstanding revolutionary, great artist of creation and construction and benevolent father who has opened up a new history of eye-opening changes in the capital city of Pyongyang through a great drive for creation, the first of its kind after the founding of the state, and ushered in a golden age of rejuvenation and prosperity, when the people will enjoy an affluent and civilized life full of happiness.
Also present at the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, officials of the Cabinet, armed forces organs, ministries and national agencies, builders and working people in Pyongyang.
Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an inaugural address.
Saying that the capital city construction plan decided by the Eighth Party Congress has proved fruitful in the fourth year, too, to greet in the Hwasong area the moment of a grand ceremony of presenting another 10 000 flats to the Pyongyang citizens, he warmly congratulated the citizens of all social strata on becoming masters of the new modern street and new houses, upon the authorization of the Party and the government, and extended thanks to all the builders and workers and officials in the relevant sectors and supporters who have splendidly translated the high level of urban culture intended by the Party into reality, not leaving it as a future project on a blueprint. And he continued:
The third-stage construction in the Hwasong area has given full appearance to the Hwasong area as a centre and model capable of leading the existing areas of the capital city to civilization and efflorescence by providing it with the political, economic and cultural functions befitting a fully-fledged administrative district in conformity with the plan and principle consistently maintained by the Party during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee. And this is a development truly meaningful enough to be called the birth of a new urban district making modernized Pyongyang of today present a striking contrast with itself of the past which had undergone changes for several decades since the founding of the state.
Thanks to the great thinking and efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho personally plans the changes in all fields of the economy, culture, national defence and all realms covering the capital and regions and clearly indicates the guidelines for firmly preserving and developing the people-oriented and revolutionary characters of Juche architecture as he cares more than anybody else for the well-being of the people and the prosperity of our socialist system, everything changes and a new era of prosperity and rejuvenation hastening the future is being ushered in on this land. The socialist paradise wonderfully built in the Hwasong area is a historic monument which makes our people keenly feel their blessed life and the rosy future of their country as they are guided by the great leader.
Saying that our Party and government, in the future, too, will continue to push forward with construction work which gives fuller play to the advantages of our style of socialist system and accelerates the transformation and development of the whole country, thus actively and steadily bringing the people deeper and greater satisfaction with a new, cultured and wealthy life, he called for striving more courageously for the future of the capital city of Pyongyang which will thrive and be more cultured year after year and for the eternal prosperity of the country which is the best in the world, according to the roadmap of epoch-making changes in the new era indicated by the Party Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
Beautifully decorating the Hwasong area, fireworks were set off and balloons flew at the venue of the inauguration ceremony, which witnessed another historic scene to be etched in the history of struggle of the great WPK continuously and vigorously making a sacred journey for the promotion of well-being of the beloved people by erecting monumental edifices symbolic of the era of great change one after another.
Songs in praise of the times filled with strong stamina and ardent desire of all the Korean people to devote their all to the building of an ideal society where socialist civilization is in full bloom, exalting the dignity and mightiness of their state with their steadfast pioneering spirit and patriotic will, resounded throughout the venue of the ceremony filling the participants with deep emotion and joy.
The songs praising the greatKim Jong Un's era, in which the capital city of the revolution, a heroic city that newly emerged on the debris of the war and glorified the annals of creation and miracles with the eye-opening Pyongyang speed, has reached a new stage of civilization and efflorescence while undergoing more majestic and splendid changes beyond recognition every year, added to the joy of the inauguration.
The national anthem of the great DPRK, our socialist country where the people's dreams and ideals are being translated into reality and which upholds the greatest man as its leader and father, was solemnly played and fireworks were set off decorating the nocturnal sky over Pyongyang, the city of boundless happiness and glory.
The venue of the ceremony was filled with excitement as cheers of "Hurrah!" burst out forKim Jong Unagain.
Kim Jong Unmet the working people and the elderly who would move into new flats.
Families of a teacher and a worker presented bouquets of flowers to him, who put forward the ordinary working people as masters of the wonderful, ideal socialist street, in reflection of the unanimous feeling of gratitude of the citizens of the capital city and other people across the country.
Kim Jong Unsaid that he was sorry to provide the modern apartment houses only now and that he was firmly determined to take upon himself more tasks for the people while seeing the citizens full of emotion and joy today. And he wished them happy life in good health in the new houses.
He met and encouraged military and civilian labour innovators who are making a great contribution to the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, true to the Party's policy on the capital city construction.
He said with affection and trust that thanks to the patriotic and elite ranks of builders like them who carry out the Party's plan unconditionally, the gun report of victory in the implementation of the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK will resound first in the Hwasong area and a new era of prosperity of Pyongyang will continue steadily.
Warmly waving his hand for a long time to the citizens of the capital city expressing boundless gratitude in tears of emotion, he wished all blessings to all families that would settle in the new splendid street.
All the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers with their firm pledge to invariably go along the road of loyalty and patriotism for the great ComradeKim Jong Un, for the eternal prosperity of their great state and for the rosy future of its great capital city.
The completion of the 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area is a great demonstration of the true picture unique to our prosperous and powerful state, which has been created by the outstanding leadership of the great Party Central Committee guiding socialist Korea to the peak of prosperity and the patriotic strength of its people closely rallied around the Party with a single mind, and a great encouraging event that has further enlivened the spirit of all-people advance towards the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and the Ninth Party Congress with redoubled fighting spirit and confidence. -0-

headline: Production Capacity of Dairy Products Expanded in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- The goals for raising the milk production and milk processing capacity were set higher than last year across the DPRK and spurs have been put to their realization, thus bringing about a clear fruition in the implementation of the Workers' Party of Korea's childcare policy.
Pyongyang Municipality has pushed ahead with the construction of new sheds of goats and dairy cattle in some stockbreeding farms in Kangdong County and provided a guarantee for increasing the milk production including sending goats and dairy cattle to the farms.
South Hamgyong Province has boosted the milk production capacity by cultivating feed grass on a large scale and increasing the rate of increment and breeding of dairy cattle and goats.
North Hamgyong Province has made sure that a scientific breeding system were established at stock farms of several cities and counties to increase the number of goats and dairy cattle and, at the same time, prepared various kinds of veterinary medicines to reduce the death rate of goats and dairy cattle.
South Hwanghae and North Hwanghae provinces and Rason Municipality have pushed ahead with the manufacturing and installation of the spray-drying milk powder production equipment and with the technical upgrading of existing equipment.
Other provinces have stepped up the completion of the veterinary medicine production process and the installation of vacuum concentrators to lay a solid foundation for the production of dairy products. -0-

headline: Construction and Reconstruction of Schools Propelled in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province in the DPRK set the goal of building or updating more than 90 schools, branch schools and kindergartens this year and is pushing ahead with the work to carry it out.
Officials learned about the construction of schools in the relevant cities and counties and have made sure that the projects were propelled at a high qualitative level.
Building materials production units in the province have taken practical measures to supply building materials needed for the construction of schools.
Phyongsong City has taken measures to ensure the supply of heavy machines and pushed ahead with the construction in a three-dimensional way as it is building and remodeling Haksu and Toksong senior middle schools, Hacha Kindergarten and other objects this year.
Taedong, Mundok and Sukchon counties have also propelled the school construction as scheduled and simultaneously pushed ahead with the work to provide schools to be newly built or reconstructed with modern educational equipment and furniture by mobilizing support organizations. -0-

Present there were officials of the Central Committee of the youth league and members of the delegation of the United Russia Youth Guards.

headline: Holiday of Happiness Full of Bright Laughter of Posterity
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unsent gifts of warm love to the children of revolutionary schools, primary schools for orphans, baby homes and orphanages, primary schools, nurseries and kindergartens across the DPRK on the occasion of the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation.
The students of the revolutionary schools including Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School renewed their resolve to prepare themselves as reliable successors and core elements of the Juche revolution who are firmly carrying forward the bloodline of the revolution, bearing in mind the loving care and affection of the respected fatherly Marshal growing stronger day by day.
Primary and secondary schools for orphans, baby homes and orphanages across the country were full of happy laughter of the children who received fine clothes, shoes, school things and foodstuff.
The benevolence of the motherly Party, which regards the work for the rising generation as the most important state affair, has reached every part of the country from the capital city of Pyongyang to the remote mountain villages on the northern part of the country and to the islet villages on the east and west coasts. -0-

headline:
Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Celebrated in China
							
							
							[2025.04.16.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- Families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle met at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on April 11 to celebrate the April holiday (birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung).
Present there were families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the DPRK ambassador to China and his embassy members.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland paid tribute to them.
Then they watched videos showing the President's birthplace at Mangyongdae and the eye-opening development of socialist Korea.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
Zhou Wei, daughter of Zhou Baozhong, Yu Ming, son of Li Zade, Feng Songguang, son of Feng Zhongyun, Shang Xiaowei, son of Mentor Shang Yue, Yue Zhi-yun, daughter of Zhang Weihua's daughter, highly praised the President for taking care of the people with warm kindness and making a great contribution to the international communist movement.

ComradeKim Jong Unis steadfastly carrying forward the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered and advanced by the preceding leaders. headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Ministry of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement titled "The U.S. reckless bluffing military demonstration is a futile act of increasing the security threat to its mainland only" on Wednesday:
On April 15, the U.S. and the ROK staged a provocative joint air drill with B-1B strategic bomber involved under the pretext of the enhanced regular visibility of "extended deterrence".
The U.S. fully showed its confrontational attitude and will against the DPRK through its repeated demonstrative military actions.
The recent military move of the U.S. and the ROK is an open threat to the security of our state and a grave provocation that raises the military tension in the region to an extreme dangerous level.
The continuous appearance of B-1B serves as an occasion of highlighting once again the fact that the U.S. and its vassal forces are the only ones that unilaterally escalates the military tension nowadays while inciting the hostile atmosphere of confrontation in the Korean peninsula.
Recently, the U.S. has renewed its record in openly deploying nuclear submarine, strategic bomber, aircraft carrier and other strategic assets to the Korean peninsula.
This fully shows that the deployment of the U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula has been fixed as a routine military practice, not as part of emergency measures, and is a constant, not a variable, threatening the regional security environment.
The gravity of the deployment of such strategic assets is not simply limited to the increase in the number of times, but it is the process of increasing the skillfulness in tactics and procedures for attacking the DPRK, and completing preparations for going into real action at any time.
The DPRK Ministry of National Defence strongly warns that the U.S. bluffing military action that poses a serious danger to the sovereignty of our state and the regional situation will inevitably bring serious negative consequences to the security situation of the U.S.
The DPRK will exercise the overwhelming deterrence and continue to make the U.S. recognize that its unannounced deployment of strategic means is a reckless and unnecessary abuse of strength, and get the U.S. realize by itself that the higher the level of provocation against the DPRK is, the greater the level of danger returning to the U.S. will be.
The armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will never tolerate the slightest sign of threat of the hostile forces against the security sovereignty of the state and will deter by dint of powerful force the U.S. aggressive attempt to permanently fix the malignant instability element in the security environment of the region. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Launched in North Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Trade union organizations in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK are conducting the socialist patriotic movement, a revolutionary mass movement.
Trade union officials of the Ponghwa Chemical Factory have turned a technical innovation movement and a drive for economy into the work of the working masses to contribute to lowering the standard of material consumption per unit and establishing a new production line.
Trade union members at the regional-industry factories in Kusong City and Kujang and Unsan counties newly built under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea are pooling their creative wisdom and enthusiasm to carry on the meticulous management and technical control over equipment and produce more consumer goods vital to the people's livelihood.
Trade union organization at the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex launched a high-speed tunneling campaign and conducted ideological work to encourage the tunneling workers and coal miners to turn out in the collective innovation movement, thus contributing to the fulfillment of the first quarterly plan.
Trade union members at the Kujang Cement Factory are expanding the successes in increased production in April too, through strengthened inter-shift cooperation and introduction of effective production methods.
The primary trade union committee of the Sinuiju Textile Mill has brought about a surge in production by dint of such mass movements as a multi-machine and multi-spindle tending campaign. As a result, at least 150 workers carried out their first half-yearly plans and their number is increasing day by day.
Trade union members of the Sinuiju Footwear Factory and the Sinuiju Bag Factory have directed efforts to developing new products and improving their quality through a campaign in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with each other. -0-

headline: Celebration Meetings Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Celebration meetings took place in Myanmar, Norway, Denmark, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Sweden, Britain, Austria, Finland and Mexico from April 3 to 12 on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by political and social figures and masses of those countries.
Personages of the Myanmar Journalist Association, the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK said that the ardent reverence for PresidentKim Il Sung, the peerlessly great man, is growing deeper in all parts of the world with every April holiday as an occasion.
They praised the great PresidentKim Il Sungas the prominent leader who guided the DPRK to victory and glory, the benevolent father of the people, peerless statesman and the greatest man in the 20th century who made immortal contributions to the cause of independence against imperialism.
The chairperson of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said that one of the most brilliant exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwas that he built Korean socialism into people-centred socialism based on the Juche Idea, not just a copy of other countries. The general secretary of the New Communist Party of Britain recollected with deep emotion the unforgettable days when he met the fatherly leader for the first time and was impressed with his noble personality as the peerlessly great man.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico referred to the noble revolutionary career and immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand said in detail that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis leading the struggle for reliably defending the sovereignty of the country to victory by bolstering up the national defence capabilities in every way.
The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway, the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association and the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League called PresidentKim Il Sungan outstanding thinker and theoretician and a great practitioner who showed the road ahead of mankind with the brilliant rays of Juche and energetically worked for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution and the global cause of socialism.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the celebration meetings in Norway, Denmark, Switzerland, Sweden, Britain and Finland. -0-

headline:
KCNA Commentary on Israel's Ambition for Territorial Annexation
							
							
							[2025.04.17.]
story_text:

headline: Hydroelectric Power Stations Built in Jagang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Jagang Province of the DPRK strives to create much more hydroelectric generating capacity.
It is accelerating the on-going construction of power stations along with preparations for building new small- and medium-sized power stations.
Cities and counties have surveyed the hydroelectric resources in their areas and given precedence to the designs for the construction of power stations. They ensure that construction forces are formed and building materials and equipment supplied in a rational way to suit the scale of construction projects.
Usi County has pushed ahead with the construction of the Usi Power Station No. 3 at the final stage to finish it within the first half of the year.
Janggang County completed the waterway tunnel project, a key to the construction of the Janggang Power Station No. 6, and is stepping up the construction of hydraulic structures.
Ryongnim and Songwon counties which are building the Ryongnim Kyedong Power Station and the Myongmun Power Station No. 3 are stepping up the projects for dams, generator rooms and other projects as scheduled. -0-
