headline: Koreans in Japan Significantly Celebrate April Holiday
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Koreans in Japan significantly celebrated the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) met at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on April 14 to lay a flower basket before the portrait of PresidentKim Il Sung.
All the participants paid tribute to the President, praying for his eternal life.
Officials of the central leadership bodies of Chongryon, too, laid bouquets at the portrait of the President and paid tribute to him on the same day.
A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon on April 13 to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary ofKim Il Sung.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organizational Department Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairmen Nam Sung U and Jo Il Yon, Vice-Chairman and concurrently Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Education Department Song Kun Hak and Vice-Chairman and Director of the International Affairs Department So Chung On of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, school inspectors, advisers, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan and chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters in the Kanto area.
Chairman Ho Jong Man made a report.
The reporter praised the great GeneralissimoKim Il Sungas the great man who enjoyed absolute support and trust from the people for his outstanding ideology, leadership and noble virtue and glorified all the annals of the revolution and construction with proud victory and glory.
The great GeneralissimoKim Il Sunggave joy of national liberation to Koreans in Japan, who were dragged to Japan and shed tears of blood as a stateless nation, and formed Chongryon on May 25, 1955, thus firmly putting the movement of Koreans in Japan on the orbit of Juche, he said.
The ideas and cause of the fatherly leader were steadily carried forward and developed by the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Iland are now developing onto a new high stage thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unpossessed of extraordinary leadership ability, he added.
The reporter ardently called upon all the officials of Chongryon and compatriots to further consolidate their faith in sure victory, more powerfully demonstrate the might of Chongryon, the precious patriotic legacy of the great GeneralissimoKim Il Sung, and make all-out efforts to usher in an era of comprehensive development of the movement of Koreans in Japan under the brilliant blueprint of the prosperity of Chongryon clarified by the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
A congratulatory letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas read out at the meeting.
A lecture was given at the Central Hall of Chongryon on April 11 to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung.
A video titled "A Great Man of the People" was shown at the lecture to celebrate April 15. -0-

headline: Spring Farm Work Brisk in Rural Areas of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Rural areas of the DPRK are busy with the spring farm work to reap a good harvest.
Since hearing the news that 30 farms were selected as the best farms for 2024, the agricultural workers' enthusiasm for increased grain production has grown higher.
To follow those farms' examples, more proactive efforts are being made to effect practical change and development in all aspects of the agricultural production by introducing advanced farming methods and technology, making the agriculture IT-based, constructing irrigation and increasing the proportion of the farm work done by machines.
The Sinam Farm in Ryongchon County of North Phyongan Province boosted the production and transport of organic fertilizer more than two times as compared with the past period. The farm has been pushing forward with all the farm work, including the tilling of paddy fields, as planned, and is positively applying advanced farming methods.
Primary organization officials of farms have taken a new attitude towards the scientific farming. Those of the Sampha Farm in Sinyang County of South Phyongan Province and the Sadong Farm in Ragwon County of South Hamgyong Province themselves are learning hard the scientific farming methods and taking the lead in the farm work. Other farms' officials are exchanging and sharing the good experience and advanced farming methods so as to effect radical change in their grain production.
All the agricultural workers are doing their farm work in a responsible manner.
The agricultural workers of the Janggyo Farm in Kangnam County of Pyongyang Municipality are carrying on all the farm work such as applying leaf fertilizing and growing rice seedlings in a responsible manner.
The agricultural workers of the Tokhung Farm in Kangso County of Nampho Municipality, too, devote themselves to the nutrition care of wheat and barley so as to reap rich harvests. -0-

headline: Celebration Meetings Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Celebration meetings took place in Myanmar, Norway, Denmark, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Sweden, Britain, Austria, Finland and Mexico from April 3 to 12 on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by political and social figures and masses of those countries.
Personages of the Myanmar Journalist Association, the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and DPRK said that the ardent reverence for PresidentKim Il Sung, the peerlessly great man, is growing deeper in all parts of the world with every April holiday as an occasion.
They praised the great PresidentKim Il Sungas the prominent leader who guided the DPRK to victory and glory, the benevolent father of the people, peerless statesman and the greatest man in the 20th century who made immortal contributions to the cause of independence against imperialism.
The chairperson of the British Group for the Study of the Juche Idea said that one of the most brilliant exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwas that he built Korean socialism into people-centred socialism based on the Juche Idea, not just a copy of other countries. The general secretary of the New Communist Party of Britain recollected with deep emotion the unforgettable days when he met the fatherly leader for the first time and was impressed with his noble personality as the peerlessly great man.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico referred to the noble revolutionary career and immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand said in detail that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis leading the struggle for reliably defending the sovereignty of the country to victory by bolstering up the national defence capabilities in every way.
The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway, the chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association and the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League called PresidentKim Il Sungan outstanding thinker and theoretician and a great practitioner who showed the road ahead of mankind with the brilliant rays of Juche and energetically worked for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution and the global cause of socialism.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the celebration meetings in Norway, Denmark, Switzerland, Sweden, Britain and Finland. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Israel's Ambition for Territorial Annexation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- The Israeli aggressors are now making more undisguised attempts to switch its policy to territorial annexation from territorial expansion.
Israel, which broke the atmosphere of the fragile ceasefire in March and resumed the invasion of Gaza Strip, occupied more than 50 percent of the area.
The Zionists "justified" their occupation with such brigandish sophism that it's for so-called "creation of a new security channel" and claimed that they would "occupy a large area of Gaza and include it in the security zone of Israel."
Especially, they took a step further to say that they will "block any attempt of the Palestinian authorities from hurting Jewish settlements" and that they will "not allow the Palestinian authorities to control the West Bank of the Jordan River", only to reveal their intention to completely occupy a state called Palestine far beyond a region.
It is none other than the Israeli Zionists who have persistently opposed the implementation of the "two-state solution" demanded by the international community, obsessed with the ambition to annex the whole territory of Palestine any time since the emergence of a Jewish state under the patronage and manipulation of the U.S.
The military attack on Gaza Strip and the expansion of Jewish settlements are still going on under the pretext of "destroying Hamas". All these are, in fact, part of the moves for annexing territory, not for "expanding the security zone".
Israel has openly revealed such ambition for territorial seizure and unsheathed the sword of annexation against the whole of the legitimate state of Palestine nowadays. This would be unthinkable without the U.S. direct intervention.
The U.S. said that if the conflict is terminated in Gaza Strip, Israel will hand over the area to it, adding that if it is handed over, the U.S. will reconstruct Gaza Strip and turn it into a seaside resort.
This is little short of an order to Israel to completely occupy Gaza Strip, and of further inciting the ambition of the servant to swallow up the whole territory of Palestine at any cost.
Not content with this, the U.S. staged joint military exercises with Israel by mobilizing B-52, a U.S. strategic bomber, under the signboard of so-called "operational cooperation to cope with different threats from the region", thus encouraging the Israeli warmongers.
For Israel which had cast greedy eyes upon the Palestinian territory from long ago, such encouragement and military support from its master must be a good opportunity for its realization, and after all it has openly entered into the full annexation of the whole territory of Palestine nowadays.
The reality clearly shows that Israel's indiscriminate destruction and bloody killings in Gaza Strip will last until it swallows up the whole Palestinian state.
The reckless military moves of the Israeli aggressors in the Middle East with the backing of the U.S. clearly prove once again who the wrecker of global peace and security is. -0-

headline: Celebration Performances Given in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- The participants in the 9th April Spring People's Art Festival have given performances every day.
The East Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, the Central Youth Hall and other venues of performances were replete with the strong aspiration and desire of the people to glorify the April spring holiday forever along with the brilliant history of prosperity of their great country.
Pak Thae Song and Choe Ryong Hae, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials enjoyed the performances together with Pyongyang citizens on April 16.
Put on the stages of performances were monumental famous songs highly praising the spring holiday of Korea with loyalty of the people from year to year.
The performers well represented the deep emotion of people greeting the significant spring holiday in such numbers as song and dance "People Sing of April Holiday", narration and chorus "Our Yearning for the Leader" and "Mine Is Always the Country ofKim Il Sung".
Watching the performances, the audience recollected with deep emotion the sacred revolutionary career and exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, the peerless patriot and great sage who led the Korean revolution to victory under the banner of independence and thus laid a solid foundation for the eternal prosperity of the genuine people's country, the invincible socialist state.
The audience was very excited to hear such songs as "Dear Father" and "We Follow His Tender Heart" reflecting the ardent reverence for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unushering in a new era of a prosperous power, in which all the dreams and ideals of the people are translated into reality, with his outstanding idea and seasoned leadership
The audience was also deeply moved by the numbers that redouble enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle of all the people across the country.
Such numbers as male chorus "See the 'Golden' Trees on the Hillsides, Rows of Apple Trees" and a national instrumental ensemble "My Prospering Country" well represented the people's pride of steadily creating and enjoying a new life and new civilization of socialism along with the appearance of entities of happiness in all parts of the country in the era of transformation when both capital and regional areas are changing and prospering.
The performances were acclaimed by the audience -0-

headline: Research on Cultivation and Propagation of Garden Plants Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- The Central Botanical Garden in the DPRK has made successes in the research into the cultivation and propagation of garden plants.
Its officials and researchers recently perfected the methods of growing and propagating garden plants of over ten species, and registered them as national species. As a result, it opened up a prospect for various and peculiar landscaping.
Among the plants are "light pink" crape myrtles. -0-

headline: Koreans in Japan Significantly Celebrate April Holiday
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- Koreans in Japan significantly celebrated the greatest auspicious April holiday of the nation.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) met at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on April 14 to lay a flower basket before the portrait of PresidentKim Il Sung.
All the participants paid tribute to the President, praying for his eternal life.
Officials of the central leadership bodies of Chongryon, too, laid bouquets at the portrait of the President and paid tribute to him on the same day.
A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon on April 13 to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary ofKim Il Sung.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organizational Department Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairmen Nam Sung U and Jo Il Yon, Vice-Chairman and concurrently Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Education Department Song Kun Hak and Vice-Chairman and Director of the International Affairs Department So Chung On of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, department directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, school inspectors, advisers, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan and chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters in the Kanto area.
Chairman Ho Jong Man made a report.
The reporter praised the great GeneralissimoKim Il Sungas the great man who enjoyed absolute support and trust from the people for his outstanding ideology, leadership and noble virtue and glorified all the annals of the revolution and construction with proud victory and glory.
The great GeneralissimoKim Il Sunggave joy of national liberation to Koreans in Japan, who were dragged to Japan and shed tears of blood as a stateless nation, and formed Chongryon on May 25, 1955, thus firmly putting the movement of Koreans in Japan on the orbit of Juche, he said.
The ideas and cause of the fatherly leader were steadily carried forward and developed by the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Iland are now developing onto a new high stage thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unpossessed of extraordinary leadership ability, he added.
The reporter ardently called upon all the officials of Chongryon and compatriots to further consolidate their faith in sure victory, more powerfully demonstrate the might of Chongryon, the precious patriotic legacy of the great GeneralissimoKim Il Sung, and make all-out efforts to usher in an era of comprehensive development of the movement of Koreans in Japan under the brilliant blueprint of the prosperity of Chongryon clarified by the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
A congratulatory letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas read out at the meeting.
A lecture was given at the Central Hall of Chongryon on April 11 to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung.
A video titled "A Great Man of the People" was shown at the lecture to celebrate April 15. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Ministry of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 17 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement titled "The U.S. reckless bluffing military demonstration is a futile act of increasing the security threat to its mainland only" on Wednesday:
On April 15, the U.S. and the ROK staged a provocative joint air drill with B-1B strategic bomber involved under the pretext of the enhanced regular visibility of "extended deterrence".
The U.S. fully showed its confrontational attitude and will against the DPRK through its repeated demonstrative military actions.
The recent military move of the U.S. and the ROK is an open threat to the security of our state and a grave provocation that raises the military tension in the region to an extreme dangerous level.
The continuous appearance of B-1B serves as an occasion of highlighting once again the fact that the U.S. and its vassal forces are the only ones that unilaterally escalates the military tension nowadays while inciting the hostile atmosphere of confrontation in the Korean peninsula.
Recently, the U.S. has renewed its record in openly deploying nuclear submarine, strategic bomber, aircraft carrier and other strategic assets to the Korean peninsula.
This fully shows that the deployment of the U.S. strategic means on the Korean peninsula has been fixed as a routine military practice, not as part of emergency measures, and is a constant, not a variable, threatening the regional security environment.
The gravity of the deployment of such strategic assets is not simply limited to the increase in the number of times, but it is the process of increasing the skillfulness in tactics and procedures for attacking the DPRK, and completing preparations for going into real action at any time.
The DPRK Ministry of National Defence strongly warns that the U.S. bluffing military action that poses a serious danger to the sovereignty of our state and the regional situation will inevitably bring serious negative consequences to the security situation of the U.S.
The DPRK will exercise the overwhelming deterrence and continue to make the U.S. recognize that its unannounced deployment of strategic means is a reckless and unnecessary abuse of strength, and get the U.S. realize by itself that the higher the level of provocation against the DPRK is, the greater the level of danger returning to the U.S. will be.
The armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will never tolerate the slightest sign of threat of the hostile forces against the security sovereignty of the state and will deter by dint of powerful force the U.S. aggressive attempt to permanently fix the malignant instability element in the security environment of the region. -0-

headline: KCNA Detailed Report on Completion of Third-stage Project in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 18 (KCNA) -- The military-civilian builders in the DPRK have attained the huge goal for the capital city construction, set forth by the 8th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, year after year without fail, while upholding the WPK Central Committee's plan and long-cherished desire with miracles of creation. Through their stubborn and dynamic continuous struggle, they successfully completed the third-stage project in the Hwasong area in a short span of one year and thus provided a decisive guarantee for the completion of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang. In this regard, the Korean Central News Agency issued a detailed report on April 17.
According to the report, another large architectural group was built in the Hwasong area with the appearance of a distinctive urban district different from the first- and second-stage districts and with a peculiar and good combination of skyscrapers, high-rise apartment houses, educational and public health facilities and different kinds of modern neighbourhood-serving networks like commercial, public catering, technical and recreation service facilities. So the Hwasong area has turned into a center and model that can lead the existing areas of the capital city to civilization and enlightenment with political, economic and cultural functions as a full-fledged city administrative district.
Another proud entity that has sprung up in the Hwasong area is a brilliant fruition of the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, a prominent revolutionary and great master of creation and construction, and precious outcome of the indomitable stamina and extraordinary creation spirit of our people dynamically advancing with the strong will to overcome difficulties and bring changes and development in order to realize the long-cherished desire of the WPK with single mind and loyalty.
Saying that it is the true nature and duty of our Party and government to keep unconditionally the promises made to the people in the face of any hardships, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Ungave meticulous guidance over the preparations for the grand construction of a new stage so that it could be substantially pushed forward with, and energetically led the whole course of the project.
He perfected over 660 designs so that the third-stage area could have a peculiar style different from the preceding stages so as to provide material and cultural wellbeing of higher level to the people.
Looking up to the General Secretary who pressed the blasting button at the groundbreaking ceremony in February 2024 and warmly encouraged the builders to firmly guarantee the construction struggle, launched by our Party as a patriotic undertaking for eternal prosperity, with eye-opening results of transformation, those builders in the Hwasong area hardened their strong will to successfully implement the plan of the Party Central Committee with fresh miracles and innovations.
The construction of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area was a great creation struggle beyond the existing stages in size and quality as a group of houses and public and service buildings, including educational, public health, commercial and public catering establishments, were to be built at the same time in an area of over 90 hectares and a total floor space of nearly 1.52 million square meters.
As befitting the pioneers ushering in a great golden age of capital city construction, the military-civilian builders kindled the flames of creating miraculous Hwasong speed and myth by displaying the indefatigable spirit.
In a short span of time after the groundbreaking ceremony, more than 1.66 million cubic meters of earth were successfully excavated for the foundation. And the foundation concrete placing was completed in a short period, and the housing framing project was carried out in earnest.
At the third-stage project, more vigorous sci-tech activities were conducted to put the construction work on an industrial and modern basis of higher level.
While inspecting the construction site in April last year,Kim Jong Unstressed that the housing construction is the most important task for providing the people with a beautiful cradle of happiness, so it is necessary to perfectly conclude even the finishing process with the goal of completing it on the highest level to be impeccable even in the distant future.
With a resolve to uphold the Party's far-reaching plan for providing the people with better material and cultural wellbeing with thoroughgoing executive ability, the builders successfully built such colorful commercial, public catering, technical and recreation service facilities with strong symbolic and specific characters as the Hwasong Kumgang Restaurant of overpass style, the Hwasong Vehicle Service Station and the 300-seat video game house.
Preparations for landscaping suited to the modern urban division were made with foresight. So more than 69 400 trees were planted and over 300 000 square meters of lawn created.
Officials and workers across the country made solidarity innovations for the construction of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area.
Officials and primary information workers of many units, art squads and mobile art squads in different parts of the country visited the construction sites to further stir up the revolutionary enthusiasm of builders out in implementing the Party's decision.
The third-stage housing construction in the Hwasong area was completed at last and the task for the fourth year of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang successfully carried out, thanks to the boundless loyalty and staunch offensive spirit of the military-civilian builders who have worked fresh miracles and myths, regarding as their highest honour and pride the trust of the Party Central Committee which put them forward in the vanguard of the capital city construction.
The report said that the emergence of another architectural group of 10 000 flats again in Pyongyang is a striking demonstration of the great Party's spirit of continuous revolution and the inexhaustible potential of our powerful country.
As long as there is the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unand the invincible might of our single-minded unity rallied around the Party Central Committee, the new era of Pyongyang prosperity of socialist Korea will continue with more vigorous creation and innovation and our country will shine more brilliantly as an ideal land full of the people's happiness, the report stressed. -0-

headline: Triplets Leave Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 18 (KCNA) -- Triplets of Kangryong County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, left the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on April 17 amid the blessing of all the people.
The mother of the triplets is Yun Un Ju, who works as a farmer with her husband in Obong-ri, Kangryong County.
Last year, Yun was diagnosed as a woman pregnant with triplets to be sent to the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital, where she received various nutritious foods and tonics and enjoyed the best medical care assistance.
Thanks to the sincere efforts of medical workers at the hospital, she gave an easy birth to her triplets (two daughters and one son).
The babies weighed 1.45 kg, 1.54 kg and 1.26 kg respectively at birth. Their present weights are over 4 kg.
The healthy triplets and their parents were seen off by doctors and nurses at the hospital. -0-

headline:
Soy Jar
							
							
							[2025.04.18.]
story_text:
One day in March 1959, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a farm in Kilju County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
He told its officials greeting him that he would call at peasants' houses before anything else.
At a peasant's house, he personally opened the door to the kitchen and entered it. Then, looking at the jars standing orderly in a line, he asked the house owner which the soy jar was.
He got the lid off the soy jar to examine its inside. And he leaned the jar and looked again more closely at the inside, and came to know that there was not much soybean paste left in the jar.
After learning about the soybean farming through the jar, the President held a consultative meeting at the office of the farm management board.
At the meeting, he set forth a new goal for increasing the per-hectare yield of soybeans and taught all the soybean-farming methods, including seed processing at the seedtime and manure applying. -0-

headline: DPRK Hero Meets with Members of Russian Youth Delegation
Department Director of C.C., WPK Meets Russian Youth Delegation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 18 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, met and had a friendly talk at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday with leading members of the visiting delegation of the United Russia Youth Guards led by Anton Zemidov, chairman of its Coordinating Council, that paid a courtesy call on her.
Present there were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials concerned and Alexandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: Joint On-line Seminar Held in Brazil
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 18 (KCNA) -- A joint on-line seminar of Brazilian political parties and organizations took place on April 11 on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present at the seminar on the theme of "PresidentKim Il Sung, peerlessly great man" were personages and members of political parties, social organizations, organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people, including the Brazilian Communist Party, the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics, the Brazilian Center for Peace and Solidarity with Peoples and the Brazilian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association.
Speeches were made by a member of the National Political Committee of the Brazilian Communist Party, the chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics and others.
Speakers highly praised PresidentKim Il Sungas the most prominent statesman and peerlessly brilliant commander in the 20th century who performed great exploits that no great man in the world could achieve, as he defeated the two formidable imperialist foes in one generation and devoted himself to the development of the world socialist movement, the victorious advance of the cause of independence against imperialism and the global peace and security.
They said that PresidentKim Il Sungmet leaders of political parties and heads of state of many countries and led them along the road of revolutionary struggle throughout his life, adding that he was the great leader of the world revolution who rendered material and moral assistance to the peoples of the countries aspiring after independence in the struggle for national liberation and building of a new society.
A video dealing with the energetic external activities of the President was shown at the seminar. -0-

The construction of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area was a great creation struggle beyond the existing stages in size and quality as a group of houses and public and service buildings, including educational, public health, commercial and public catering establishments, were to be built at the same time in an area of over 90 hectares and a total floor space of nearly 1.52 million square meters.
As befitting the pioneers ushering in a great golden age of capital city construction, the military-civilian builders kindled the flames of creating miraculous Hwasong speed and myth by displaying the indefatigable spirit.
In a short span of time after the groundbreaking ceremony, more than 1.66 million cubic meters of earth were successfully excavated for the foundation. And the foundation concrete placing was completed in a short period, and the housing framing project was carried out in earnest.
At the third-stage project, more vigorous sci-tech activities were conducted to put the construction work on an industrial and modern basis of higher level.
While inspecting the construction site in April last year,Kim Jong Unstressed that the housing construction is the most important task for providing the people with a beautiful cradle of happiness, so it is necessary to perfectly conclude even the finishing process with the goal of completing it on the highest level to be impeccable even in the distant future.
With a resolve to uphold the Party's far-reaching plan for providing the people with better material and cultural wellbeing with thoroughgoing executive ability, the builders successfully built such colorful commercial, public catering, technical and recreation service facilities with strong symbolic and specific characters as the Hwasong Kumgang Restaurant of overpass style, the Hwasong Vehicle Service Station and the 300-seat video game house.
Preparations for landscaping suited to the modern urban division were made with foresight. So more than 69 400 trees were planted and over 300 000 square meters of lawn created.
Officials and workers across the country made solidarity innovations for the construction of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area.
Officials and primary information workers of many units, art squads and mobile art squads in different parts of the country visited the construction sites to further stir up the revolutionary enthusiasm of builders out in implementing the Party's decision.
The third-stage housing construction in the Hwasong area was completed at last and the task for the fourth year of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang successfully carried out, thanks to the boundless loyalty and staunch offensive spirit of the military-civilian builders who have worked fresh miracles and myths, regarding as their highest honour and pride the trust of the Party Central Committee which put them forward in the vanguard of the capital city construction.
The report said that the emergence of another architectural group of 10 000 flats again in Pyongyang is a striking demonstration of the great Party's spirit of continuous revolution and the inexhaustible potential of our powerful country.
As long as there is the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unand the invincible might of our single-minded unity rallied around the Party Central Committee, the new era of Pyongyang prosperity of socialist Korea will continue with more vigorous creation and innovation and our country will shine more brilliantly as an ideal land full of the people's happiness, the report stressed. -0-

headline: DPRK Hero Meets with Members of Russian Youth Delegation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 18 (KCNA) -- A meeting between DPRK Hero Pak In Ho, a lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, and members of the visiting delegation of the United Russia Youth Guards led by Anton Zemidov, chairman of its Coordinating Council, took place in front of the U.S. imperialist armed spy ship Pueblo on display at the museum on April 17.
Present there were Vice-Chairman Kim Song Il and other officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and officials of youth league organizations at all levels.
Referring to the fact that under the wise leadership of the peerlessly great men, the DPRK captured the armed spy ship Pueblo and wrested a written apology from the U.S. imperialists who talked about "retaliation", Pak In Ho stressed that the ship would always remain an exhibit proving the U.S. imperialists' history of defeat and the end of the aggressors.
Then followed speeches.
Youth league officials expressed the will of the Korean youth to become the model and vanguard of the world progressive youth in the struggle for independence and justice as well as the full support and solidarity with the Russian army, people and youths in the just struggle to defend their national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests.
The head of the Russian youth delegation paid tribute to the heroic and self-sacrificing spirit of the sailors of the Korean People's Army and affirmed that the Russian youth would always stand by the Korean people in the resistance against the U.S.-led imperialism, fully supporting their cause. -0-

headline: Department Director of C.C., WPK Meets Russian Youth Delegation
Passing-on Technique Meeting for Potato Farming held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- A passing-on technique meeting for introducing Samjiyon-style potato farming method was held at the Junghung Farm in Samjiyon City, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK.
The Samjiyon-style potato farming method created under the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis an advantageous farming method for raising potato yield and quality by applying the high-yielding virus-free potato seed, scientific soil improvement, prevention of damage from moisture, extermination of epidemics and fertilization technology suited to the natural and geographical features and climatic and soil conditions of Samjiyon City.
The passing-on technique meeting, attended by officials of agricultural guidance organs in Jagang Province and other provinces, introduced the advantages of new high-yielding potato seeds with a large amount of dry materials and high per-hectare yield.
There was a discussion on scientific and technological issues arising in potato farming in keeping with the period and season.
The meeting also dealt with the issues of over-fulfilling the potato production plans by introducing the Samjiyon-style potato farming method at the potato farming units. -0-

headline: Celebration Events Held by Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- The General Association of Koreans in China held celebrations on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung, the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation.
The GAKC, its affiliated organizations, organizations of Koreans in China and compatriots in China laid flower baskets before the statue of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin on April 15 and paid tribute to him.
The GAKC held a meeting at Yuwen Middle School in Jilin to celebrate the 113th birth anniversary of ComradeKim Il Sung.
Present there were Chairwoman Choe Un Bok, vice-chairperson and other officials of the GAKC, representatives of its affiliated organizations, senior officials of organizations of Koreans in China, compatriots, officials of the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang and DPRK citizens working in three northeastern provinces of China.
The meeting was attended by the director of the Foreign Affairs Office of the Jilin Provincial People's Government of China, a vice-mayor of the Jilin City People's Government, the director of its Foreign Affairs Office and the secretary of the party committee of Yuwen Middle School in Jilin.
Choe Un Bok made a report.
The reporter praised the President as a legendary hero of anti-Japanese war who embarked on the road of revolution in his teens and accomplished the historic cause of national liberation by defeating Japanese imperialism and an ever-victorious iron-willed commander and peerless hero who led the Fatherland Liberation War against the U.S. imperialists' armed invasion to victory and defeated the two formidable imperialist countries in one generation.
She said that the President turned the DPRK into an invincible power demonstrating its dignity with independent politics, self-supporting economy and self-reliant national defence and performed undying feats for socialism and the cause of global independence.
The revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered by the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungwas successfully carried forward and developed by the great leader ComradeKim Jong Iland is now further developing under the wise leadership of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, she said.
Saying that the future of the DPRK is always bright and rosy thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, she stressed that members of the GAKC would invariably cherish patriotism for the prosperity and development of the great motherland and faithfully uphold the revolutionary leadership of the respected Marshal.
Then followed an art performance and a reception.
A meeting for adopting a congratulatory letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas held at the conference hall of the GAKC in Shenyang City, China on April 13.
Meanwhile, colorful events were held at the Zhongnan Regional Association of the GAKC and other affiliated organizations. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on April 14 on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present there on invitation were personages of the government, parliament, political parties, organizations and institutions of Russia, including the of Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Interior, the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology, the Ministry of Health, the Federation Council, the State Duma, the Party for Peace and Unity and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK.

Meanwhile, the DPRK missions in Vladivostok and Khabarovsk of Russia hosted receptions on April 11 and 14 on the occasion of the significant April holiday. -0-

headline: Drive for Increased Production and Economy Waged in Knitting Industry Field
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the field of knitting industry in the DPRK are waging a dynamic drive for increased production and economy by giving definite precedence to science and technology.
The Hamhung Knitwear Factory is ensuring the processing of products at a high level while concentrating on improving the technical knowledge and skills of its employees and increasing the ranks of skilled workers.
The technicians and skilled workers of the factory invented and installed a machine for shortening the time spent in tying thread, thus creating a large amount of reserves for economy.
Officials of the Pyongyang Children's Knitted Goods Factory acquired wide-ranging science and technology at sci-tech learning space, which led to the achievements in selecting talents, training them and putting production on a normal footing and improving the quality of products.
The Jongju Disabled Soldiers' Knitwear Factory and the Sinuiju Disabled Soldiers' Knitwear Factory, too, have improved their equipment to increase the production by 2.5 times and invented and introduced technical innovation proposals to produce quality knitwear. -0-

headline:
There Should Be No Neglect in Education
							
							
							[2025.04.19.]
story_text:
One day in February 2017, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans.
The respected General Secretary went round various places of the school for a long time to learn in detail about its operation.
When he dropped in at an education room, he sat down on a school-chair and gave instructions to correct the narrow space between the desk drawer and the chair and to put low bookstands for the common use of books.
Looking at the blackboard, he said that the blackboard using chalk should have a wet cloth and that he would send a sample rubber brush for wiping the blackboard.
He told officials that the modernization of the educational sector and the improvement of the quality of education are the important matter of the state and the important and strategic matter related to the future of the state, adding that there should be no neglect ranging from the even trifling matter in education.
There should be no neglect in education.
With such a noble intention, the respected General Secretary did not miss even a small problem, including the ordinary chairs and blackboard for orphans. -0-

headline: Movement for Increased Production Gains Momentum
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- The trade union organizations at all levels in the DPRK are conducting a campaign for increased production so that new innovations can be made at every worksite.
The trade union organizations of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex have improved the effectiveness of ideological education in various forms and methods and, at the same time, waged a collective innovation movement, producing a large amount of coal in April alone.
Workers and trade union members of the Munchon Coal Mine of the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex over-fulfill their production plans every day while finding good things.
The Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex and the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex conduct dynamic campaign for increased production in which shifts are helping each other and advanced units are leading those fell behind.
Officials and members of the trade union in the Ministry of Railways, including the West Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine under the Pyongyang Railway Bureau, are registering increased transport results while improving the stability of train service.
Workers of the Hwaphyong Forestry Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau carried out their yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule by conducting a socialist emulation to increase timber production.
Workers and members of the trade union at the Jongju Tractor Parts Factory introduced efficient processing methods and strengthened cooperation between processes, providing a guarantee for over-fulfilling their monthly production plans. -0-

headline:
U.S. Measure to Ease Arms Export Regulations Precisely Means One to Expand Wars
							
							
							[2025.04.20.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- Shortly ago, the present U.S. administration took a measure to ease the "regulations" that had been obstacles to the export of homemade military equipment.
In this regard, a White House aide justified the measure saying that "We're unable to provide weapons systems in a reliable, effective way to key allies of ours, and the key driver of that is inefficiencies and inconsistencies with the process by which we approve foreign military sales."
For the United States, arms sale is not only merely a money-making space to meet monetary desire but also a major means of supporting the realization of aggressive foreign policy, the hegemony-seeking one.
Military conflicts in Europe and the Middle East that have lasted for several years are a single example of proving this.
Since the outbreak of the Ukrainian crisis and the crisis in the Gaza Strip, the U.S. has persistently resorted to the provision of war hardware to its vassal forces, who are "doing  their best" to realize the U.S. hegemonic strategy, under the plausible signboard of "improving the security of the allies."
According to the published data, U.S. arms sale has increased considerably in recent years, and most of the exported military equipment has flowed into the hands of war maniacs in Europe and the Middle East.
Nearly half of the weapons purchased by the Ukrainian puppet forces taking the first place in the standings of world weapons importers from 2020 to 2024 are U.S.-made ones. The fact clearly proves how much means of aggression the U.S. has handed over to war servants.
The same is the case with the arms sale to Israel.
Shortly ago, the U.S. Senate dismissed all the resolutions on the halt to arms sale to Israeli Zionists which had been deceptively put up to evade the public opinion of the international community focusing on them over the massacre of Palestinians committed by Israeli murderers.
The U.S. shameless and persistent arms sale has injected vitality into the servants who resort to reckless military acts, and the U.S.-made weapons poured into the hotspots led the situation to the worse one.
The U.S. plays the role of a "mediator" on the one hand, pretending to recommend dialogue and negotiations, and on the other hand, encourages the warmongers to further expand and prolong wars by continuously handing over all kinds of lethal weapons.
The U.S. measure to ease arms export regulations precisely means the one to expand wars.
Amid the continuous massacres and destructions threatening peace and stability in different parts of the world caused by the U.S., the chieftain of aggression, it is as clear as noonday that when more U.S.-made lethal weapons will be handed over to the proxy war forces as the U.S. eases the regulations on exporting military hardware, what consequences will be entailed by it.
The international community should never overlook the U.S. dangerous attempt to make the world more disturbing. -0-

Nearly half of the weapons purchased by the Ukrainian puppet forces taking the first place in the standings of world weapons importers from 2020 to 2024 are U.S.-made ones. The fact clearly proves how much means of aggression the U.S. has handed over to war servants.
The same is the case with the arms sale to Israel.
Shortly ago, the U.S. Senate dismissed all the resolutions on the halt to arms sale to Israeli Zionists which had been deceptively put up to evade the public opinion of the international community focusing on them over the massacre of Palestinians committed by Israeli murderers.

headline: Salt Production Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the devoted efforts of officials and workers in the field of salt industry of the DPRK, the salt output has increased 1.6 times as compared with the same period of last year.

headline: Events Held in Indonesia
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- A ceremony for visiting the monument to Kimilsungia, a photo and book exhibition and a film show were held at the Bogor Botanical Garden of Indonesia on April 17 on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the historic visit to Indonesia by PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were personages of the government, political parties, organizations and institutions of Indonesia, including the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle, the Foreign Ministry, and the Indonesia-Korea Association for Friendship and Cultural Exchange, and the charge d'affaires ad interim of the DPRK embassy in Jakarta and his embassy members.
The participants looked round the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, photos of the great leaders and the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, famous works of the peerlessly great men, books and picture albums introducing the DPRK, pictures showing the brilliant development of socialist Korea on display at the venue for events and the monument to Kimilsungia.
They also watched a film dealing withKim Il Sung's historic visit to Indonesia.
Speeches were made there.
The general chairperson of the Central Directive Council of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle said that President Sukarno warmly welcomed PresidentKim Il Sungwho visited Indonesia at that time with the utmost sincerity and a close friendship was formed between them, underscoring the need to make efforts to hand this legacy down to the next generations.
The personages of the Indonesian foreign ministry and other institutions said that PresidentKim Il Sung's visit to Indonesia served as a firm foundation for the development of the relations between the two countries, adding that it is a stand of the Indonesian government to develop the cooperation with the DPRK, which has a history of traditional relations of friendship, in various fields and in the mutual interests and in the future. -0-

headline: Tree-planting for Creating Raw Material Forests Conducted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people across the DPRK out in the drive for implementing the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea have devoted themselves to creating forests of raw materials.
South Phyongan Province planted more than 1.6 million trees including pine-nut tree, Evodia daniellii Benn and oil-bearing chestnut tree in the areas of one thousand and hundreds of hectares.
Officials and working people in North Phyongan Province made devoted efforts to creation of forests of oil-bearing trees and paper raw materials.
South Hwanghae Province planted trees in 2 500-odd hectares of raw material forests.
Working people in South Hamgyong Province introduced advanced tree-planting method and worked in each process as required by technical norms, thus creating conditions favorable for ensuring the survival rate.
In other areas too, many trees were planted in raw material forests in spring. -0-

headline: Joint Friendship Gathering of DPRK and Russian Young People Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- A joint friendship gathering of the DPRK and Russian young people took place at the Central Youth Hall on April 20.
Present there were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league, university students in Pyongyang Municipality and members of the visiting delegation of the United Russia Youth Guards led by Anton Zemidov, chairman of its Coordinating Council.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the DPRK were played.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
Mun Chol said that the DPRK youth are pleased to see the Russian people and youth carrying forward the history and tradition of victory in war, smashing the moves of the hostile forces under the leadership of President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
He stressed that the peoples and youth of the two countries would be closely united forever as true comrades and comrades-in-arms and win victory after victory as there are deep friendship between the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia and the common ideal struggling for justice and truth.
Anton Zemidov and other youth organization delegates said that they felt the feelings of friendship of the DPRK youth during their stay.
All the members of the United Russia Youth Guards are impressed by the wisdom and determination of ComradeKim Jong Un, the outstanding state leader, and his devotion to the people, they said, adding that under his leadership the DPRK is demonstrating its strength and achieving unprecedented development and prosperity in all fields.
They expressed deep thanks to the DPRK for extending full support and solidarity to the Russian cause against the hegemony of the West and its practice of neocolonialism, saying that the Russian youth would always stand by the DPRK youth on the road for genuine international justice and peace.
An art performance was given by the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
Colorful numbers were staged and Russian songs resounded.
The young people of the DPRK and Russia danced together to the tune of delightful melodies, deepening the friendship. -0-

headline: DPRK Young People Volunteer to Work at Worksites for Implementing Regional Development Policy
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- Many young people in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK volunteered to work at workplaces seething with the implementation of regional development policy.
The young people in Hanggu District and Ryonggang County wrote their names on the list of volunteers, pledging to have a large share in translating into reality the plan of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea which has ushered in a great era of regional change.
Dozens of graduates of senior middle schools in Onchon County raised to the youth league organization to send them to the raw materials base station of modern regional-industry factories.
Graduates of senior middle schools in the districts of Kangso, Waudo, Taean and Chollima also volunteered to work at raw materials bases.
The volunteers were awarded certificates at the meeting held on April 20 to congratulate them.
Then speeches were made.
Officials and young people presented bouquets to the volunteers and gave a pep talk to them. -0-

headline: Int'l Table Tennis Championships Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- The East Asian Qualification Event for the 29th Asian Youth Table Tennis Championships 2025 took place at the Table-Tennis Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here on April 19 and 20.
In the games, attended by players of the DPRK and Hong Kong and Taipei of China, the men's and women's team matches took place by the league matches.

headline: New Regional-industry Factories in DPRK Focus on Expanding Variety of Products and Improving Their Quality
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 22 (KCNA) -- The newly-built regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties of the DPRK are concentrating efforts on expanding a variety of products and improving their quality. And they are also operating all the production lines at full capacity.
Foodstuff factories are striving to produce more and better soybean paste, soy sauce, oil, sweets, cakes, fruit juice, etc. with the locally available raw materials.
In April, 20 foodstuff factories in 20 cities and counties produced much more foodstuffs of various kinds than last month.
Employees of daily necessities factories in Kim Hyong Jik, Usi and Tongsin counties are making innovations every day in the production of laundry soaps, various kinds of plastic goods and wooden products.

headline: Helicopter and Passenger Plane Fly for Life of Ordinary Miner
story_text:
One day in April 1988, ChairmanKim Jong Ilheard a report on the fact that a young miner was on the verge of death.
The patient was unconscious, and even doctors were losing confidence in the face of severe fatal injuries.
The Chairman gave a hospital concerned the task to prolong the patient's life as long as possible until the medical team of Pyongyang arrives, and took a measure that competent doctors in Pyongyang make the preparations for first aid and leave there.
As soon as the doctors arrived on the spot, they started an operation and prolonged his life as a stopgap measure. They reported the results to the Chairman.
The Chairman sent a helicopter to bring the patient to Pyongyang and made sure that the doctors take careful measures to prevent accidental symptoms during the flight.
However, the helicopter carrying the patient began to jolt due to the sudden strong wind.
At that time, the helicopter received a radio wave on landing at the nearest airport.
The Chairman, who foresaw that the helicopter can shake due to the severe weather, sent a large passenger plane again which wouldn't jolt by the wind.
He also took meticulous measures such as arranging a treatment room inside the passenger plane and making doctors stand ready with medicines at the airport where the two planes would land and give intermediate medical treatment assistance.
Thanks to the measure of love taken by the Chairman, the miner recovered consciousness within ten-odd days after he arrived in Pyongyang, and then he was completely cured and went back to his post.
The Chairman is the benevolent leader of the people who valued every one of them and took care of them and defended them with his warm love. -0-

story_text:

headline: Russian Delegation Members Laud DPRK as Invincible Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 22 (KCNA) -- The might of a powerful country where all the people are rallied close around the Workers' Party of Korea and achieve the overall development of socialism aroused deep emotion among the members of delegation of the United Russian Youth Guards that visited the DPRK.
Anton Zemidov, the head of the delegation, said as follows:
We were impressed by the tenacity and high ideological readiness of the Korean people defending the sovereignty and dignity of the country against the U.S. moves for aggression.
All the members of the United Russian Youth Guards admire the wise leadership and resolution of ComradeKim Jong Un, the outstanding leader of the state, and his devotion to the people.
During our visit, we witnessed a society where the leader and the people are united as one and an invincible country building a bright future full of confidence and optimism.
The people of the two countries are the ideological allies aspiring after justice and independence and opposing foreign interference in internal affairs.
Diana Alumants, chief of the headquarters of the Moscow Regional Branch said that the visit to the DPRK left an unforgettable impression all her life.
Visiting modern educational institutions, extracurricular education bases and other places, she could feel the care of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state shown for the new generation, she said, adding:
The Korean youth are devoting their all to their leader and the country.
They are a model of the true patriots we should learn from.
We will always stand by the Korean youth on the road of international justice and peace.
Yuri Bakurov, chairman of the Maritime Territorial Branch, said that he could be optimistic about the good future of the Russia-DPRK relations, entertaining the good faith and sincere hospitality accorded by the Korean youth, adding that the United Russian Youth Guards would further strengthen exchange and cooperation with the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and thus make a positive contribution to the development of the friendly relations between the two countries in the future, too. -0-

headline: Foreign Figures Highly Praise President Kim Il Sung as Most Distinguished Leader of 20th Century
story_text:

We will always remember the noble devotion of PresidentKim Il Sungwho supported the Arab people and made efforts to develop the Non-Aligned Movement.

He went on:
Whenever we think about the socialist revolution, we remember the great ComradeKim Il Sungwith reverence.
His august name is kept forever in the hearts of the progressive people of the whole world and his many works and theories serve as guidelines for the struggle of international revolutionaries.

headline: Great Father Bringing about Auspicious Event of Moving into New Houses for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 23 (KCNA) -- On the auspicious April holiday, the DPRK people greeted another significant event.
An inauguration ceremony for 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area was held with splendor in the presence of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Skyscrapers, high-rise apartment houses and public buildings including educational, commercial and service facilities were wonderfully built in ideal harmony into a flourishing socialist living space, a home of the people.
The magnificent residential quarters built one after another in Songhwa Street, Hwasong Street, Rimhung Street and other parts of the country are associated with the painstaking efforts made by the respected General Secretary for the people.
He attended the ground-breaking ceremonies of declaring the construction of new streets, made speeches full of confidence and enthusiasm and personally took up the first spade to signal the start of construction.
He, who regarded it as his cherished desire to provide the people with happy living places to be envied by the world, guided more than 1 000 layouts of Songhwa Street and examined 1 630-odd layouts of the apartment district at the first stage in the Hwasong area and gave precious instructions.
He guided the construction site of 10 000 flats at the third stage in the Hwasong area nearing completion on March 15 and gave field guidance to the preparations for the operation of major service facilities built in the district nearing its completion on April 3.
On the day of the inaugural ceremony, he came to the spot to cut off the inauguration tape and met working people and old persons who are to move into new houses, hoping that they would all lead a happy life in good health in new houses.
The happiness of the DPRK people is growing day by day under the loving care of the great father who regards the people as his own flesh and blood and shows boundless favor for them. -0-

headline: Buildings in Masikryong Ski Resort Decorated with Real Logs
story_text:
One day in August 2013, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Masikryong Ski Resort under construction.
Officials reported to the General Secretary, who is acquainting himself in detail with the construction state of the Masikryong Hotel, about the project plan to decorate some parts of the interior and the exterior of the hotel with log patterns.
But the General Secretary shook his head lightly. The officials didn't know the reason, because he had already given instructions to decorate the interior and the exterior of the building with log patterns in order to preserve the characteristics of mountainous areas.
Looking around the officials, the General Secretary said that when he entered the construction site of the ski resort just now, he saw the log patterns being embossed with cement on the exterior walls of some buildings, and if so, they would look like logs from a distance, but it can be quickly known that they would be not logs when seeing them from a short distance and that, in a word, they could be "beautiful from a distance".
Officials lightly laughed out.
After a while, the General Secretary said that the buildings should be decorated with real logs and if so, they would be well matched with the scenery of the ski resort in the mountainous areas, and taught the way one by one.
Like this, the buildings of the ski resort are associated with his noble intention that there should not be any slight shortcomings in the work for the people. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Korean Jurists Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Korean Jurists Committee on Wednesday issued the following press statement titled "No one can infringe upon the sacred right of Koreans in Japan to democratic national education":
April 24, 1948 is recorded in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan as the day when the Koreans in Japan defended the right to democratic national education at the cost of their blood, resolutely countering through a massive struggle the fascist suppression by the U.S. and the Japanese reactionaries to wipe out the Korean schools in their cradle.
Even after its defeat in August 1945, the Japanese reactionary government persistently forced the Koreans in Japan to receive "assimilation education" in the period of the Japanese imperialist colonial rule and, at the instigation of the U.S. imperialists, issued the "closure order" to Korean schools in January 1948.
Moreover, it issued to all the prefectural governors of Japan a brigandish order that the Koreans' independent school establishment can never be recognized and the Korean children in Japan should enter the Japanese school without fail.
Enraged by this, many Koreans in Japan turned out in a protest campaign to defend the democratic national education, but the Japanese reactionaries, ignoring their just demands, declared the "emergency situation" on April 24, 1948 and ran amuck in such bloody suppression as firing water cannon and bullets and arresting and detaining them by mobilizing huge police force.
It has been nearly 80 years since the defeat of the Japanese imperialists, but there is no slight change in the Japanese authorities' extreme national chauvinism and unethical discrimination policy to obliterate the national education of Koreans in Japan.
A typical example is that in August 2019 the Japanese authorities, with kindergartens under the Korean schools in mind, issued an instruction to all local autonomous bodies not to receive the application for licensing of childcare facilities but to dismiss all the applications they received.
It is quite natural for Koreans in Japan to teach their children the Korean language and it is the basic requirement of international law that the children should be provided with the best interests and financial assistance.
Article 28 of the Convention on Children Rights adopted by the United Nations stipulates that states parties shall recognize the right of the child to education, and achieve this right progressively and on the basis of equal opportunity.
However, the Japanese authorities are foolish enough to interpret the Convention on Children Rights in conformity with their chauvinism-stained law, and they have not kept even their commitment to equitably apply the "Child Rearing Support Act" to all the children.
It is a hideous violation of human rights that can never be found in the history of any country to deprive people of even their elementary right to teach the rising generations their mother tongue.
The Japanese authorities are imposing the same tax-paying obligation as the Japanese on Koreans in Japan, but they are excluding only the Korean schools for their children from various educational assistance systems including the application of "tuition-free program for senior high schools" and "free education and upbringing of children" under the unreasonable pretext, thus wounding the innocent children in their hearts.
The enforcement of democratic national education by Koreans in Japan is a natural exercise of their rights which fully conforms to international human rights conventions including the Convention on Children Rights, the Convention against Discrimination in Education of UNESCO and many other international laws accepted by Japan and Japan's national laws such as the Constitution and the Fundamental Law of Education of Japan.
The Japanese government has a legal obligation as well as moral responsibility to provide the Koreans in Japan, the direct victims of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule over Korea and their children, with national rights such as the right to education and the right to life.
The legitimate right to national education of Koreans in Japan is a sacred one which can neither be denied on all occasions nor infringed upon by anyone.
The Korean Jurists Committee strongly demands that the Japanese authorities immediately withdraw all illegal institutional and administrative discrimination measures encroaching upon the democratic national rights of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and Koreans in Japan and fulfill their legal and moral obligations. -0-

headline: Work to Protect and Manage National Cultural Heritage Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Municipality has conducted the work to protect and manage historical relics, scenic spots and natural monuments.
The mud castle of Anhak Palace and embankments around tens of old ponds are being repaired and their surroundings rearranged in the area of Mt Taesong.
Mangyongdae District is planting turf additionally and repairing the masonries around an old castle and old buildings in a planned way.
Central District is pushing ahead with the work to repair the historic relic buildings partially and support the trees, dangerous elements, around Ulmil and Choesung pavilions.
The Rangnang Museum is repairing partially and manages ancient tombs, mud castle and wooded areas and stepping up the work to provide tourism and visits in cooperation with relevant units.
Ryongsong and Samsok districts, Kangdong County and other districts and county, too, are protecting and managing historical relics, scenic spots and natural monuments in their areas. -0-

headline: 38th National Festival of Science and Technology Opens in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- The 38th National Festival of Science and Technology opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on April 23 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.
The festival, being held on the theme of "Successful completion of the Five-Year Plan and the turning out of the scientific circle", brought together officials, scientists and technicians from more than 650 units who were nominated by ministries and national agencies and highly appreciated at provincial sci-tech festivals.
The festival is being held, divided into more than 30 panels, including metal, chemical, electric power, coal, machine-building, light industries and agriculture. On display in the forms of actual objects and operating exhibits  were the achievements made in scientific researches for the economic development of the country and the improvement of the people's living standards and scientific and technological proposals conducive to implementing the Party's policy on regional development.
During the festival there will be a presentation andexamination of sci-tech achievements, exchange service for new technical products, lecture on new technologies, scientific and technological symposium and presentation.
Present at the opening ceremony were Choe Tong Myong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and working people.
Kim Song Bin, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, made an opening address.
He called upon all the participants to concentrate all efforts on the perfect implementation of the decision of the plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea while actively sharing and exchanging the successes and technologies gained in the scientific researches and technological innovations through the festival.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the venue for the festival. -0-

headline: Spring Garment Exhibition Closes in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- The 2025 Spring Garment Exhibition closed in the DPRK with due ceremony.
The exhibition of excellent level of exhibiting and service marked a significant occasion in creating and developing more new and peculiar fashion designs and clothes by actively introducing advanced clothing processing techniques.
The Ponghwa Trade Bureau, Pyongyang Municipality, the Hadang Unha Garment Factory, the Combined Tailor Shop in Taesong District, the Taesong Tailor Shop, etc. presented new-style seasonal clothes providing artistry and various kinds of light industrial goods which add to the refinement of dressing, which were highly appreciated.
Also attracting the attention of visitors were women's, men's and children's clothes of different colors presented by garment factories in Sukchon, Unsan, Kimhwa and Songchon counties.
Present at a closing ceremony held on April 23 were officials concerned and officials, technicians, experts and producers of the units which presented the exhibits.
Diplomas as well as prizes were awarded to the units and participants that were highly appreciated. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Noble Outlook on People
story_text:
One day in July 1976, PresidentKim Il Sungcalled an official in the public service sector.
After exchanging greetings with the official, the President said that he had made a study of the ordering list of the daily necessities made by officials, met with persons who would use them and heard their opinions, and that he was going to discuss the matter together with the official that day.
And the President gave the official the ordering list of the daily necessities.
The list was worked out according to the tasks given by the President to the official at a meeting on the issue of light industry.
At the meeting that day, the President said that when one knows well what daily necessities and how much of them are required for every household and person a year, one can properly produce and supply them, and gave the official the task of making the ordering list of daily necessities according to regions, strata and ages.
The official turned over the pages of the list and saw that ten-odd kinds of daily necessities including household hygrothermograph were newly written on the list.
Looking up to the President, who was devoting precious time even to such small daily necessities as hygrothermograph, though he was busy with the overall work of the Party and the state, the official felt again his noble outlook on the people. -0-

headline: Symposium in Field of Intellectual Property Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- A symposium in the field of intellectual property was held at the Grand People's Study House on April 23 on the occasion of World Intellectual Property Day.
Attending the symposium which is aimed at raising public cognition of intellectual property and practical ability were officials and workers of ministries and national agencies, including the Ministry of Culture, the Central Industrial Art Bureau and the Publication Guidance Bureau.
Speakers referred to the geographical mark, national heritage and traditional knowledge, new species of plants, concept and characteristics of genetic resources, the  necessity and significance of protecting intellectual property, protection system and the trend in different countries.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government, the DPRK law on the place of origin and geographical identification, the Law on the Protection of National Heritage and the Law on the Protection of New Strains of Plants were adopted, providing a legal framework for briskly conducting intellectual property work throughout the society and on an all-people basis and making progress in this work under the unified guidance of the state, they said.
They explained the practical issues arising in making the most rational use of the natural and geographical conditions in the relevant regions and in positively developing, protecting and utilizing special products to usher in a new era of regional rejuvenation.
The speakers stressed the need to steadily develop intellectual property work on a more scientific basis and thus make a substantial contribution to developing the country's economy and improving the people's standard of living. -0-

headline: Joint Meeting Held to Mark 16th Anniversary of Establishment of Russian Center
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- A joint meeting with the Russian embassy here was held at Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies on April 23 to mark the 16th anniversary of the establishment of the Russian Center of the university.
Present there were officials of the university and relevant fields, teachers and students of the university, the Russian ambassador and his embassy officials and teachers and students of the embassy school.
Congratulatory speeches were made at the meeting.
Speakers said the joint meeting was held on the occasion of the 16th anniversary of the establishment of the Russian Center of Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies at a significant time marking the 6th anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's historic first visit to Russia and meeting with President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
They expressed belief that the Russian Center of Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies would fulfill its mission and role in glorifying the undying feats of the top leaders of the two countries ushering in a new era of DPRK-Russia friendship and promoting mutual understanding and cooperation between the peoples of the two countries.
Then the participants enjoyed an art performance given by students of Pyongyang University of Foreign Studies and the Russian embassy school. -0-
