Upon authorization of the President of the State Affairs of the DPRK, Choe Ryong Hae, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, received the credentials from Serbian Ambassador Maja Stefanovic at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on April 23.

headline: Study Tour of Anti-Japanese Battle Areas Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of April 25, the significant day when the anchor of the Korean revolution was raised, an endless stream of people, determined to carry forward the revolutionary traditions of the Workers' Party of Korea generation after generation, visit the anti-Japanese battle sites.
North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK is directing efforts to equipping officials, working people, youth and students with the revolutionary spirit so that they can more deeply grasp the transparent ideological and moral world of the first generation of the revolution that defeated the brigandish Japanese imperialists and brought the bright dawn of national liberation under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sungthrough the study tour of the Kuksabong Revolutionary Battle Site and the Sangdansan Revolutionary Battle Site.
Officials, working people, youth and students in Jagang Province are touring the Rangnim Revolutionary Battle Site and the Ogasan Revolutionary Battle Site.
Being briefed on the fact that the full preparations for national liberation through the all-people resistance with the Korean People's Revolutionary Army as the main force under the leadership of the President were made, the visitors went round various places of the revolutionary battle sites with deep emotion.
Youth and students in South Hamgyong Province toured the Majon Revolutionary Battle Site associated with the activities of the members of small units of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army in the Hungnam area true to the President's line of all-people resistance.
The Nampho Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea has made it an important occasion for officials, working people, youth and students to arm themselves more firmly with the revolutionary traditions of the WPK, taking the revolutionary history as their practical experience and eternal breathing of the revolution, not remaining merely as the paragraphs of reminiscences, through a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites.
While visiting the Ponghwajae Temporary Secret Base of the Wonsan City Revolutionary Battle Site, members of the trade union in Kangwon Province keenly realized once again that the grim annals of the revolution could be glorified with victory and glory thanks to the revolutionary spirit and tradition created by the anti-Japanese fighters.
Officials, working people, youth and students in North and South Phyongan provinces and Rason Municipality visit the revolutionary battle sites every day with one mind to greet the Ninth Congress of the Party with innovative successes by learning from the fighting spirit of self-reliance displayed by the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners.
During the study tour, there were meetings to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, contests of singing revolutionary songs in chorus and oath-taking meetings. -0-

Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- Dozens of university graduates in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK volunteered for the revolutionary battle sites, mountainous schools and branch schools.
Graduates of Sinpho Kim Hyong Gwon University of Technology and Education and Hamhung University of Education expressed their will to become lecturers at the revolutionary battle sites in the areas of Mt Paektu and Sinhung and ex-servicemen graduates volunteered to do their jobs at mountainous schools in Pujon and Jangjin counties together with their families.
Graduates of Hamhung Choe Hui Suk Teachers Training College were determined to devote their youth wisdom and enthusiasm to upholding the Workers' Party of Korea's plan for building an educational power and a talent power.
Among them are a girl who has grown up learning to her heart's content at primary and middle schools for orphans and a "pedigree farm" for education of the rising generation, and sisters-graduates who want to become a teacher for the children of workers in Komdok.
Other graduates pledged to work at mountainous branch schools and schools in Pukchong, Yonggwang and Hochon counties.
Present at a congratulatory meeting held on April 23 were officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students.
Officials, youth and students presented bouquets to the volunteers and gave them a pep talk. -0-

headline: KPRA Heralds Start of Korean Revolution Advancing by Force of Arms
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- April 25, 1932 is the day when PresidentKim Il Sungfounded the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA), the first revolutionary armed forces of the Juche type.
Since the founding of the KPRA, a genuine revolutionary army fighting for the liberation of Korea and the freedom and happiness of the people, the glorious history of the Korean revolution advancing by force of arms started.
In the days of the arduous great anti-Japanese war, the President ensured that the KPRA played a pivotal role in carrying out the overall Korean revolution and paid deep attention to strengthening the political and military might of the armed ranks in every way.
The KPRA rapidly grew and strengthened into the leading force of the revolution under the outstanding leadership of the President and fully demonstrated its might in the armed struggle to annihilate the brigandish Japanese imperialists.
The Battle of Pochonbo, the Battle of Jiansanfeng, the Battle of Taehongdan and many other battles in which the KPRA inflicted heavy deaths on the Japanese imperialists proved the truth that no force on earth can match the revolutionary army led by the peerlessly great man.
Regarding the building of armed force as the fundamental issue of the revolution, the President directed primary efforts to organizing and developing the armed ranks. He defeated the Japanese imperialists armed to the teeth with the KPRA as the main force in the worst ordeals without state-backing home front or the support of regular army and accomplished the historic cause of national liberation on August 15, 1945.

headline:
President Kim Il Sung's Noble Outlook on People
							
							
							[2025.04.24.]
story_text:
One day in July 1976, PresidentKim Il Sungcalled an official in the public service sector.
After exchanging greetings with the official, the President said that he had made a study of the ordering list of the daily necessities made by officials, met with persons who would use them and heard their opinions, and that he was going to discuss the matter together with the official that day.
And the President gave the official the ordering list of the daily necessities.
The list was worked out according to the tasks given by the President to the official at a meeting on the issue of light industry.

headline:
Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Sends Musical Instruments to Newly-built Schools in Flood-hit Areas
							
							
								
[2025.04.25.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) --The deep love and affection of the benevolent father who spares nothing for the younger generation and glorifies the bright laughter of the children as the image of Korean-style socialism are overflowing in the schools wonderfully built in the northwestern parts of the DPRK, where the aftereffects of flood damage were removed.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unsent pianos, accordions, guitars, oungum, kayagum, harmonicas and other musical instruments as gifts to the schools newly built in the flood-hit areas in North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces.
Last year he took special measures for the education of schoolchildren from the flood-hit areas and personally visited the April 25 Hostel to warmly bless the future of the children. He took a measure to build wonderful schools adding pride to their native villages whose looks had undergone radical changes, and supply modern teaching aids and furnishings, educational equipment and sports apparatuses to them. This time he showed great benevolence of sending many musical instruments to them.
This reflects the meticulous love and affection of the fatherly Marshal who regards the children as priceless treasures and all hope and future and wants the schoolchildren to grow up cheerfully and bravely without envy in the world.
Meetings were held on the spot to convey the musical instruments sent byKim Jong Un.
The venues of the meetings were in a festive mood with the deep gratitude and joy of the students and teaching staffs who were to receive the gifts.
Present at the meetings were officials of the Party and power organs, officials concerned, teaching staff, students and their parents in North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces. Speeches of conveying the gifts were made at the meetings.
Speakers said with deep emotion that the respected fatherly Marshal, cherishing the noble idea that there are our children before and above the people our Party upholds as Heaven, repeatedly provided the rising generations with dreamy happiness.
Representing the unanimous mind of schoolchildren and their parents, they respectfully extended deep thanks toKim Jong Unwho puts forward education as the first state affair to which priority should be given and the biggest efforts should be directed in any period and at any stage and brings the bright future of the rising generations into full bloom.
They called upon all the officials and teaching staffs to devote themselves to education and upon the students to study hard, take an active part in the organizational life and extracurricular activities and thus prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters of the fatherly Marshal, bearing deep in mind the great love and trust of the motherly Party.
The meetings were held at Hadan Senior Middle School No. 1 in Sinuiju City, Soho Senior Middle School in Uiju County, Kwangmyong Senior Middle School in Songgan County, Muphyong Branch School under Hwaam Primary School in Jonchon County, Sampho Senior Middle School in Kim Hyong Jik County and other schools. After receiving with boundless emotion the gifts associated with the benevolence of the Party, the participants at the meetings said that the embrace of the respected Marshal is the greatest one in the world as he is taking good care of the children across the country with his paternal love and affection as their tender-hearted father and parent would do.
The cheerful laughter of the children and the song We Are the Happiest in the World will resound forever in the clear and blue sky over the country, conveying to the whole world the great benevolence ofKim Jong Unwho is cultivating the socialist motherland more brightly and beautifully with his ardent love and boundless affection for the rising generations. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary Warns against Deployment of B-1Bs
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) -- The notorious "death swan" nested in Japan.
According to the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command on April 20, several B-1B strategic bombers of the U.S. Air Force were forward-deployed from the U.S. mainland to the Misawa Air Force base of the U.S. forces in Japan.
Its military significance is in the fact that it is the long-term presence and permanent settlement of the U.S. strategic assets in the depth of the Asia-Pacific region, far from being the temporary deployment for the U.S.-Japan joint drill or for muscle-flexing against regional countries.
As everybody knows, B-1B is one of the strategic bomber triad of the U.S. together with B-52 and B-2 and the enemies are vociferously calling them "death swan".
The deployment of B-1Bs in Japan shows that the military basis of the U.S. which had resorted to the use of force in the Asia-Pacific region with Guam mainly as its launching base and starting position is changing into a more vicious one. This is clearly a very serious development harmful to regional security.
The U.S. is claiming that it is "the first deployment of 'Bomber Task Force' of the U.S. Air Force into Japan that can make sudden sortie anywhere in the world" and that "the deployment contributes to the strengthening of the interoperability between the U.S. and Japan and regional stability" and that it will "show devotion to the free and open Indo-Pacific security." However, it is as clear as noonday how the "death swan" would "dedicate" to security.
The world knows about the "colossal role" the U.S. forces, especially the U.S. strategic assets, which had made their appearance in the Asia-Pacific region, played in destroying the security environment of the region and aggravating the situation.
The U.S. has long been frantic in pressurizing regional countries and expanding military involvement by frequently sending various kinds of strategic bombers and other strategic assets to Japan, ROK and other regions.
Typically, this year alone, the U.S. sent B-1B strategic bombers to the sky around the Korean peninsula for three times to stage joint air drills with its junior allies, thus driving  the acute military confrontation on the Korean peninsula, the world's biggest hotspot, into the dangerous phase of conflict.
Not content with this vicious cycle, the U.S. is now trying to increase the level of confrontation targeting regional countries to the highest ever with the Japanese archipelago and the ROK as its outpost by operating strategic assets capable of flying at any time in the depth of the region through the long-term deployment of strategic bombers in Japan.
The "death swan" nested in Japan will not "contribute" to regional security but only serve the U.S. political and military hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region and the formation of the U.S.-led exclusive military bloc.
The U.S. should clearly understand.
The Asia-Pacific region is not a fragile area where the U.S. can move the balance weight of regional security at will with a few strategic bombers.
The U.S. moves to destroy peace and stability by escalating military threats to the Asia-Pacific region will be subject to due counterattack by the regional people. -0-

And they praised the President for ushering in a new era of independence by creating the Juche idea.
The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany and members of the German Executive Committee of the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK lauded the President for consistently adhering to the transparent idea of independence in the whole period of his revolutionary career.
The president of the Group of Dialectical Materialists of Italy and the official representative of the Italian branch of the Korean Friendship Association said that the great ComradeKim Il Sungworked energetically for socialism, justice and global peace and security, and that he was the genuine leader of the people as he made ceaseless journeys for field guidance to bring happiness to the people.
Personages of the New Yugoslav Communist Party, the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of the Republic of Tajikistan praised the President for devoting himself to accomplishing the cause of socialism and the cause of independence against imperialism. -0-

headline: KPRA Creates True Model of Army-People Relations
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 93rd founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA).
This day, the Korean people recollect with deep emotion the proud history of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK which have always been faithful to its mission as not only defenders of the country but creators of the people's happiness since it had the letter "People" in its name.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who founded the KPRA (the then Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army) on April 25, 1932, put forward the idea that "As fish cannot live without water, so guerrillas cannot live without the people" as the principle governing activities of the revolutionary army.
He regarded it as the issue decisive of the existence of the guerrilla army before the issue decisive of the victory and defeat of a battle to love the people and to be supported by them. He always told his men to love the people more deeply and said that if we neglect the people, they will turn their backs on us, that there is nothing more dreadful than being forsaken by the people and that for a revolutionary, the biggest tragedy is to lose the people's love.
He reflected the popular character of the revolutionary army in the "Tentative Regulations of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army" and led all the commanding officers and men with his practical examples to devote themselves to the interests of the people, always giving top priority to the life and security of the people.
The revolutionary legend "Commander is a son of the people", which was brought into full bloom in the days of the anti-Japanese war, is still remembered by our people.
After knowing the fact that recruits picked corn ears in a peasant's field, he made them put the corn ears at the edge of the field. And before attacking the internment villages and fortified towns of the enemy, he evacuated the people to safe places or lured the enemy out of residential areas and destroyed them. Such lots of legendary stories about his love for the people have been conveyed.
Thanks to the leadership of the President, who regarded it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven, the KPRA created a genuine model of the army-people relations unprecedented in history and could win only victory in every battle amid the active support and encouragement of the people. -0-

The deployment of B-1Bs in Japan shows that the military basis of the U.S. which had resorted to the use of force in the Asia-Pacific region with Guam mainly as its launching base and starting position is changing into a more vicious one. This is clearly a very serious development harmful to regional security.
The U.S. is claiming that it is "the first deployment of 'Bomber Task Force' of the U.S. Air Force into Japan that can make sudden sortie anywhere in the world" and that "the deployment contributes to the strengthening of the interoperability between the U.S. and Japan and regional stability" and that it will "show devotion to the free and open Indo-Pacific security." However, it is as clear as noonday how the "death swan" would "dedicate" to security.
The world knows about the "colossal role" the U.S. forces, especially the U.S. strategic assets, which had made their appearance in the Asia-Pacific region, played in destroying the security environment of the region and aggravating the situation.
The U.S. has long been frantic in pressurizing regional countries and expanding military involvement by frequently sending various kinds of strategic bombers and other strategic assets to Japan, ROK and other regions.
Typically, this year alone, the U.S. sent B-1B strategic bombers to the sky around the Korean peninsula for three times to stage joint air drills with its junior allies, thus driving  the acute military confrontation on the Korean peninsula, the world's biggest hotspot, into the dangerous phase of conflict.
Not content with this vicious cycle, the U.S. is now trying to increase the level of confrontation targeting regional countries to the highest ever with the Japanese archipelago and the ROK as its outpost by operating strategic assets capable of flying at any time in the depth of the region through the long-term deployment of strategic bombers in Japan.
The "death swan" nested in Japan will not "contribute" to regional security but only serve the U.S. political and military hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region and the formation of the U.S.-led exclusive military bloc.
The U.S. should clearly understand.
The Asia-Pacific region is not a fragile area where the U.S. can move the balance weight of regional security at will with a few strategic bombers.
The U.S. moves to destroy peace and stability by escalating military threats to the Asia-Pacific region will be subject to due counterattack by the regional people. -0-

headline: KPRA Creates True Model of Army-People Relations
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 93rd founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA).
This day, the Korean people recollect with deep emotion the proud history of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK which have always been faithful to its mission as not only defenders of the country but creators of the people's happiness since it had the letter "People" in its name.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who founded the KPRA (the then Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army) on April 25, 1932, put forward the idea that "As fish cannot live without water, so guerrillas cannot live without the people" as the principle governing activities of the revolutionary army.
He regarded it as the issue decisive of the existence of the guerrilla army before the issue decisive of the victory and defeat of a battle to love the people and to be supported by them. He always told his men to love the people more deeply and said that if we neglect the people, they will turn their backs on us, that there is nothing more dreadful than being forsaken by the people and that for a revolutionary, the biggest tragedy is to lose the people's love.
He reflected the popular character of the revolutionary army in the "Tentative Regulations of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army" and led all the commanding officers and men with his practical examples to devote themselves to the interests of the people, always giving top priority to the life and security of the people.
The revolutionary legend "Commander is a son of the people", which was brought into full bloom in the days of the anti-Japanese war, is still remembered by our people.
After knowing the fact that recruits picked corn ears in a peasant's field, he made them put the corn ears at the edge of the field. And before attacking the internment villages and fortified towns of the enemy, he evacuated the people to safe places or lured the enemy out of residential areas and destroyed them. Such lots of legendary stories about his love for the people have been conveyed.
Thanks to the leadership of the President, who regarded it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven, the KPRA created a genuine model of the army-people relations unprecedented in history and could win only victory in every battle amid the active support and encouragement of the people. -0-

headline:
Railroad Rebuilt for People
							
							
							[2025.04.25.]
story_text:
One day in July 1976, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the Naegok Hot Spring in Pochon County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK together with officials after seeing the spectacular sunrise on Mt Paektu.
After estimating the temperature of the hot spring water gushing out with his hand and water quantity, the Chairman looked around the surroundings and taught the ways to build a modern sanatorium and cultural and welfare facilities in the area.
Then he told officials that it is good to build more bath-houses for the visitors to Pochonbo and Samjiyon should be built.
When an official said that the railroad going through the village must be removed in order to build more bath-houses, the Chairman noted that if the forestry railway was rebuilt in other place, many bath-houses could be built.
That day, the Chairman gave officials detailed instructions to make sure that the hot spring made a positive contribution to promoting the people's health, including the direction to build the bath-houses and their management and operation method and remedies.
After the Chairman visited the Naegok Hot Spring, the railway going through the village was rebuilt in a distant place, and the happy laughter of the people, instead of whistling, resounded in the hot spring. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Sends Musical Instruments to Newly-built Schools in Flood-hit Areas
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) --The deep love and affection of the benevolent father who spares nothing for the younger generation and glorifies the bright laughter of the children as the image of Korean-style socialism are overflowing in the schools wonderfully built in the northwestern parts of the DPRK, where the aftereffects of flood damage were removed.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unsent pianos, accordions, guitars, oungum, kayagum, harmonicas and other musical instruments as gifts to the schools newly built in the flood-hit areas in North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces.
Last year he took special measures for the education of schoolchildren from the flood-hit areas and personally visited the April 25 Hostel to warmly bless the future of the children. He took a measure to build wonderful schools adding pride to their native villages whose looks had undergone radical changes, and supply modern teaching aids and furnishings, educational equipment and sports apparatuses to them. This time he showed great benevolence of sending many musical instruments to them.
This reflects the meticulous love and affection of the fatherly Marshal who regards the children as priceless treasures and all hope and future and wants the schoolchildren to grow up cheerfully and bravely without envy in the world.
Meetings were held on the spot to convey the musical instruments sent byKim Jong Un.
The venues of the meetings were in a festive mood with the deep gratitude and joy of the students and teaching staffs who were to receive the gifts.
Present at the meetings were officials of the Party and power organs, officials concerned, teaching staff, students and their parents in North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces. Speeches of conveying the gifts were made at the meetings.
Speakers said with deep emotion that the respected fatherly Marshal, cherishing the noble idea that there are our children before and above the people our Party upholds as Heaven, repeatedly provided the rising generations with dreamy happiness.
Representing the unanimous mind of schoolchildren and their parents, they respectfully extended deep thanks toKim Jong Unwho puts forward education as the first state affair to which priority should be given and the biggest efforts should be directed in any period and at any stage and brings the bright future of the rising generations into full bloom.
They called upon all the officials and teaching staffs to devote themselves to education and upon the students to study hard, take an active part in the organizational life and extracurricular activities and thus prepare themselves to be true sons and daughters of the fatherly Marshal, bearing deep in mind the great love and trust of the motherly Party.
The meetings were held at Hadan Senior Middle School No. 1 in Sinuiju City, Soho Senior Middle School in Uiju County, Kwangmyong Senior Middle School in Songgan County, Muphyong Branch School under Hwaam Primary School in Jonchon County, Sampho Senior Middle School in Kim Hyong Jik County and other schools. After receiving with boundless emotion the gifts associated with the benevolence of the Party, the participants at the meetings said that the embrace of the respected Marshal is the greatest one in the world as he is taking good care of the children across the country with his paternal love and affection as their tender-hearted father and parent would do.
The cheerful laughter of the children and the song We Are the Happiest in the World will resound forever in the clear and blue sky over the country, conveying to the whole world the great benevolence ofKim Jong Unwho is cultivating the socialist motherland more brightly and beautifully with his ardent love and boundless affection for the rising generations. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony of Launching Destroyer of KPA Navy Takes Place with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The tremendous strength of Juche Korea, which confidently attains the phased goals for building a rich country with a strong army through the first arduous journey and vigorous stride of great pioneering along the milestone of victory indicated by the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea, is ushering in a grand new era of an advanced maritime power while powerfully reaching out to the vast ocean.
A new entity has emerged to firmly guarantee the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK, demonstrating the prestige of a powerful country rising bravely despite all difficulties, the irresistible might of the indomitable and strong Korean people and the modernity of the Juche-oriented naval force making rapid progress.
The birth of the new-type multipurpose destroyer, which is an ensemble of the state economy and conglomerate of defence technology for self-defence and equipped with the powerful cutting-edge strike weapon systems of Korean style which do not allow comparison, is a brilliant fruition of the iron faith, will and outstanding leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unwho indicated the path for rapidly developing the naval force of the DPRK into the strong treasured sword for defending justice and peace and a service equipped with the comprehensive fighting power with nuclear weapons as the main axis and is dynamically steering the rejuvenation of the warship industry, and a valuable victory won by the strong aspiration and desire and indomitable advance of the Korean people to outpace the world with the conviction in their own strength and courageous struggle.
A ceremony of launching the newly-built destroyer was held with splendor at the Nampho Dockyard on April 25, the significant founding anniversary of the first armed forces of the Korean revolution, in the presence ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Present at the ceremony were senior Party, government and military officials, workers of the Nampho Dockyard, officials and researchers in the field of warship industry who contributed to building the destroyer, officers and men of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, discharged navy generals, teaching staff and students of Kim Jong Suk Naval University, commanding officers of the services and corps of the KPA and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The venue of the ceremony was full of the ardent reverence for the great Party Central Committee which has firmly consolidated the absolute might and irreversible strength of the DPRK's armed forces by dynamically leading the rapid development of the revolution in national defence industry for the prosperity of our country and its long-term development and fully realized the centuries-old desire of the Korean people to have the strongest naval force.
The guard of honor of the KPA Navy solemnly lined up waiting for the moment of glory.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers looking up to the great revolutionary and ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander who is vigorously ushering in a new era of building a rich country with a strong army, bringing the dignity and prestige of our state and people onto the highest peak of the century with his outstanding revolutionary idea, matchless pluck and persevering devotion.
There was a ceremony of greeting the head of state.
Kim Jong Unreviewed the colors of honor of the KPA Navy and the guard of honor.
He was courteously greeted by Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the KPA Navy, and other major commanding officers of the Navy and commanding officers of the East and West Sea Fleets of the Navy and their affiliated underwater and water-surface warship squadrons with boundless reverence for him.
There was a march-past of the guard of honor of the KPA Navy.
Kim Jong Untook the platform followed by leading officials of the Party, government and military, the commander of the Navy, commanders of the East and West Sea Fleets of the Navy, the manager of the Nampho Dockyard and others.
Officials of the Party Central Committee, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK, officials, persons of merit and labor innovators who contributed to the building of the warship and commanding officers of the services and corps of the KPA took the reserved seats.
The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played.
Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a memorial speech.
The 5 000-tonnage destroyer, equipped with the most powerful weapons, built by the workers in the field of warship industry, is to record the sacred new name of the defender in the blue sea of the country, he said, adding that it is a very encouraging reality and an event that made decisive progress in the course of strengthening naval capacities that we have built the modern destroyer within 400-odd days perfectly with our own strength and technology.
The new-type destroyer, which was imposingly born as a creation symbolizing the strength and spirit of Korea, is the fruition of the great patriotic idea ofKim Jong Unand his will to build a rich country with a strong army and a precious entity in which every meter of the hull and every equipment is associated with the sacred responsibility for the revolution.
The speaker said that today came to be recorded not only as a day when a new origin of the warship industry was opened but also as a day when a new start was made by the workers and officials of the munitions industry of the DPRK, adding that the heyday of the DPRK Navy will brightly be brought about and the historic picture of the DPRK's arms demonstrating their might as the treasured sword for defending justice and peace will continuously be opened up as the respected ComradeKim Jong Unleads our struggle in the van.
Yun Chi Gol, manager of the Nampho Dockyard, made a reply speech.
He proudly reported that the workers of the Nampho Dockyard are prepared for presenting the first new generation destroyer of the Republic to the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a gift of patriotic loyalty by honorably implementing the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK on building modern destroyer.
The latest warship is a precious product of the revolution in warship industry rose up by the iron faith, will and outstanding strategy ofKim Jong Unwith the ambition to build our country into an advanced maritime power, not merely by a buoyancy of nature, he said, adding that in the course of warship building the way of thinking and manner of work of officials and employees have been changed, strong technical ranks and skilled workers built up and scientific and advanced warship building technology and processes established.
He solemnly pledged that the Nampho Dockyard would become the pacemaker and engine of the revolution of the warship industry in the new era faithfully upholding the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee with practice and thus glorify forever the honor of the group of revolutionary industry by taking the core position of the development of the shipbuilding industry in the DPRK and perfectly carrying out any warship building task entrusted by the Party to the dockyard.
Pak Jong Chon announced a written order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK on the grading regulations, name and number of the new-type multipurpose destroyer and conveyed it to the commander of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy.
According to the order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK signed byKim Jong Un, the newly built new-type 5 000-tonnage multipurpose destroyer was graded and classified as the Choe Hyon-class and named after anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Choe Hyon, a model military activist possessed of boundless loyalty to the leader, a veteran of the armed forces of the DPRK and a veteran general.
Kim Jong Unconferred the ensign of destroyer Choe Hyon on the commanding officers of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy.
Vice-Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the East Sea Fleet, made a speech of pledge.
Referring to the honor of our Navy of clearly recording in the history of army building its true appearance of a service as a blueprint, suited to the prestige of a military power, he said that the earnest desire for the strongest armed forces to overwhelmingly control the naval supremacy of the arrogant imperialist pirates was realized in the glorious era of holdingKim Jong Unin high esteem.
Saying that the position of our navy will be far in the future five years and ten years after today when the era of the greatKim Jong Un-style fleet building started, he extended warm gratitude and militant salute toKim Jong Unwho is ushering in the greatest heyday of strengthening the navy and to the heroic workers of the dockyard and the fields concerned that are upholding the Party's grand plan for building the naval forces with ardent loyalty and valuable struggle in the name of all the officers and men of the navy.
He solemnly pledged to fully demonstrate the honor of the fleet which took the most responsible battlefield for the great revolutionary cause of defending the country by making all efforts to bolster up the combat capability of the warship and round off the war preparations of the fleet and preparing to be a navy which smashes the enemy unconditionally in every battle, on the honor of the army of the WPK and seaman of the DPRK.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, cut the launching rope in token of the launching ceremony of the destroyer.
Amid the sound of the warship whistle at the naval port, a powerful entity revealed its magnificent appearance in the sea of the country announcing the advent of a new era of modernization of the navy. And confetti and colored tapes were poured out, fireworks were set off and balloons flew up, reflecting the excitement and joy of this historic moment.
Kim Jong Unmounted the destroyer.
The warship received the honor of being first reviewed by the head of state.
After receiving the salute of the captain,Kim Jong Unmet with seamen and gave them warm and combat encouragement, going round the stem and quarter deck of the warship.
The memorial image of anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Choe Hyon in relief was unveiled on the destroyer.
Kim Jong Unplaced a flower before the memorial image of Choe Hyon in relief and paid high tribute to him.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the absolute loyalty to the leader and the spirit of unconditionally implementing the orders and instructions of the leader constitute the core of the revolutionary traits and military temperament of Choe Hyon, adding that the sea of the country will remain unfazed and the ever-victorious tradition will continuously be carried forward when the reputation and noble soul of the veteran general whom the two formidable imperialist enemies trembled only with his name become the symbol of invincibility and militant banner of our navy.
Kim Jong Ungot off the warship and met the meritorious persons of the Nampho Dockyard who contributed to the building of the destroyer.
He highly appreciated that the historic event which can be called a new birth of the Juche-oriented navy could be brought about thanks to the patriotic and inexhaustible efforts and enthusiasm of the workers, scientists and technicians of the Nampho Dockyard who are upholding the strategic line and policies on building up the national defence clarified by the WPK with absolute loyalty and devoted efforts.
The workers, scientists and technicians in the field of warship industry raised enthusiastic cheers, extending the greatest glory toKim Jong Unwho placed them at the vanguard of accomplishing the sacred cause of radically and by leaps and bounds strengthening the naval forces of the DPRK to suit the national prestige and status of a powerful country and is ushered in a new era of the rejuvenation of warship industry with his energetic leadership.
He awarded commemoration copper coins to the commanding officers and officers of the destroyer, wishing the destroyer Choe Hyon a distinguished service and boundless glory.
Kim Jong Unmade a historic speech on the occasion of the ceremony of launching the destroyer.
Expressing the historic significance and deep emotion of declaring the launching of the new generation multipurpose attack destroyer No. 1, which is essential for building up the strength for thoroughly defending the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK and serves as an important starting point on the road towards advanced maritime power, on April 25, the birthday of the first revolutionary armed forces of Korea,Kim Jong Unextended militant encouragement to the workers, technicians and officials of the Nampho Dockyard who successfully built the new-type destroyer true to the Party's line of strengthening the naval forces, and to the scientists, technicians and workers in the field of the shipbuilding industry who are struggling as the main force of the revolution in warship industry in the new era.
After making a stern analysis of the situation in the vicinity which poses a very serious threat to the security environment of the DPRK, he said that the strength to launch aggression is directly proportional to the strength to prevent aggression, and set forth in detail the plan of the WPK to radically bolster up the naval combat power in line with the justness and necessity of the possession of the pelagic fleet, the prerequisite for national security and the world trend of developing the naval force and the ways for its realization.
His speech is an immortal great programme which is of great theoretical and practical significance in leading the revolution in the warship industry in the new era to a steady upsurge and remarkably strengthening the DPRK Navy into a core service for national defence and a component of nuclear war deterrent.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his commemorative speech, all the participants broke into the thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!" out of boundless excitement and enthusiasm of loyalty which resounded into the vast sea endlessly.
Kim Jong Unhad a significant photo session with all the commanding officers and seamen of the destroyer Choe Hyon against the background of the destroyer.
He expressed great expectation and conviction that all the seamen of the destroyer would firmly carry forward the indomitable faith and tradition of victory cherished by the pioneering generation of the Korean revolution and thus become the brave warriors of the sea fully guaranteeing the prosperity of the country and the well-being and happiness of the people by force of arms and create a new legendary tale of heroes of the Juche-oriented navy.
All the commanding officers and seamen of the destroyer made a firm pledge to enhance the reputation as the matchless warship demonstrating the invincible valour in defending the territorial waters of the country, looking up to the great brilliant commander who gave them the strongest treasured sword unprecedented in the naval force of the country and personally mounted the warship to wish distinguished military service and instilled the spirit of sure victory into them.
Kim Jong Unhad a photo session with officials and persons of merit of the dockyard and institute who made contributions to building the destroyer.
On the same day, there were a banquet given by the KPA Navy with sincerity and a congratulatory performance by national-level art troupes in commemoration of the ceremony of launching the new-type multipurpose destroyer.
After the performance,Kim Jong Unmet discharged navy generals.
Highly appreciating the feats performed by the generals of the past days who had long served the navy's important posts and recorded the immortal exploits in the history of the navy with boundless self-sacrificing spirit and indomitable mettle, he said that their great spirit should be invariably carried forward as the eternal soul of defence.
Kim Jong Unwho is making ceaseless journey of devoted efforts for the accelerated growth of the national defence capability and the people's well-being, was courteously seen off by the leading officials of the Nampho Dockyard and discharged navy generals.
The ceremony of launching the new-type multipurpose destroyer held in the presence ofKim Jong Unwill shine forever in history as an auspicious event heralding the new birth of the DPRK Navy and a great event that powerfully demonstrated to the whole world the spirit of advance and sure victory of our state and people dynamically advancing toward the grand goal of building an advanced maritime power. -0-

headline: Road to Yasukuni Shrine Will Lead "Samurai State" to Doom: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The Japanese reactionaries are persistently resorting to indoctrination of militarist ideas, challenging the trend of the times and history.
The Japanese chief executive offered Sakaki trees to the Yasukuni Shrine on April 21 on the occasion of the spring ancestral rite day.
Afterwards, about 70 Dietmen belonging to the "Association of Dietmen for visiting Yasukuni Shrine", the supra-party Dietmen's federation, thronged to the shrine.
The issue of visiting the Yasukuni Shrine is a touchstone of assessing the attitude and stand of the Japanese authorities towards aggression and war.
The Japanese reactionaries are making it a rule and "tradition" to visit the shrine every year on the occasions of spring and autumn ancestral rite days, the day of defeat and so on and offer tribute to it. This is a vivid manifestation of their sinister intention to invariably and deeply implant the poison of militarism in the whole area of the archipelago with the shrine as the origin.
What merits serious attention is the fact that the positive spread of war and fascist culture through the visit to the Yasukuni Shrine is being conducted in parallel with the reckless moves of the present Japanese authorities rushing toward the perfection of a war state while clamoring for "steady bolstering of defense capabilities" since they took office.
Being stepped up at the final stage are such legal, institutional and military preparations for invading the continent as the formation of the "integrated operation command" leading the ground, maritime and air "Self-Defense Forces" in contingency, the deployment of U.S.-made intermediate-range missiles and home-made long-range missiles designed for "counterattack capability" and persistent revision of constitution.
The war hysterics for aggression frequently going off at any time by inviting foreign forces under the pretexts that "the creation of Asian version of NATO is indispensable" and "European Atlantic Ocean and the Indo-Pacific are inseparable in guaranteeing security" are driving the security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region to the worst phase.
As a result, the reinvasion of Japan, which has systematically and extensively pushed forward with its political and military rearmament for decades since its defeat, is approaching as the reality, not expectation.
No one can vouch that the faithful "grave keepers" of militarism obsessed by aggression and revenge will not repeat the bloody genocide of the past just like their ancestors.
The road to the Yasukuni Shrine is the road to militarization, which will only precipitate the ruin of the whole Japan.
The samurai descendants' ambition will push the archipelago forever into the "grave". -0-

headline: Intellectual Property Protection Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- April 26 is World Intellectual Property Day.
On this occasion, a symposium aiming at enhancing social cognition of intellectual property and practical ability was held in Pyongyang on April 23.
The work to strengthen the intellectual property protection system and lay foundations and environment for dynamically pushing ahead with the development of science and technology is intensified in the DPRK.
In particular, the work to ensure the unified guidance by the state over intellectual property work and perfect the intellectual property protection system is being stepped up in keeping with the developing reality.
Many units across the country have made remarkable progress by creating intellectual property with a correct understanding of intellectual property and the protection system and making good use of them in their management activities.
The February 16 Science and Technology Prize, the Technical Innovation Prize and the Prize for Best Inventor instituted by the state are awarded to scientists, technicians and inventors who made direct contributions to intellectual creations of great social significance every year.
Meanwhile, the DPRK has held exhibitions including the national industrial art exhibition and the intellectual property development exhibition and conducted information activities with World Intellectual Property Day as an occasion to raise the awareness of law observance and interest in protecting intellectual property in society.
The DPRK joined the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) in August 1974.
Scientists and technicians of the DPRK were warded the WIPO's inventor prizes, medals and certificates as they created inventions of world significance in various fields of national economy including agriculture, light industry and public health in the past. -0-

headline: Dancing Party of Women Held in DPRK
Dancing Party of Women Held in DPRK
story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony of Launching Destroyer of KPA Navy Takes Place with Splendour
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The tremendous strength of Juche Korea, which confidently attains the phased goals for building a rich country with a strong army through the first arduous journey and vigorous stride of great pioneering along the milestone of victory indicated by the ever-victorious Workers’ Party of Korea, is ushering in a grand new era of an advanced maritime power while powerfully reaching out to the vast ocean.
A new entity has emerged to firmly guarantee the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK, demonstrating the prestige of a powerful country rising bravely despite all difficulties, the irresistible might of the indomitable, tenacious and intrepid Korean people and the modernity of the Juche-oriented naval force making rapid progress.
The birth of the new-type multi-mission destroyer, which is an ensemble of the state economy and an aggregate of self-reliant defence technology and which is equipped with the powerful cutting-edge strike weapon systems of the Korean style which do not allow comparison, is a brilliant fruition of the iron faith and will and outstanding leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, who indicated the path for rapidly developing the naval force of the DPRK into a powerful treasured sword for defending justice and peace and a service equipped with the comprehensive fighting power with nuclear weapons as the main axis and is dynamically steering the rejuvenation of the warship-building industry, and a valuable victory won by the strong aspiration and indomitable advance of the Korean people to outpace the world with the conviction in their own strength and courageous struggle.
A ceremony of launching the newly-built destroyer was held with splendour at the Nampho Shipyard on April 25, the significant founding anniversary of the first armed forces of the Korean revolution, in the presence ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
Present at the ceremony were senior Party, government and military officials, the workers of the Nampho Shipyard and officials and researchers in the field of the warship-building industry who contributed to building the destroyer, officers and men of the Navy of the Korean People’s Army, discharged navy generals, teaching staff and students of Kim Jong Suk Naval University, commanding officers of the services and corps of the KPA and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The venue of the ceremony was full of the ardent reverence for the great Party Central Committee which has firmly consolidated the absolute might and irreversible superiority of the DPRK’s armed forces by dynamically leading the rapid development of the revolution in national defence industry for the prosperity of our country and its long-term development and fully realized the centuries-old desire of the Korean people to have the strongest naval force.
The guard of honour of the KPA Navy solemnly lined up waiting for the moment of glory.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers looking up to the great revolutionary and ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander who is vigorously ushering in a new era of building a rich country with a strong army, bringing the dignity and prestige of our state and people onto the highest peak of the century with his outstanding revolutionary ideas, matchless pluck and round-the-clock devotion.
There was a ceremony of greeting the head of state.
Kim Jong Unreviewed the colours of honour of the KPA Navy and its guard of honour.
He was courteously greeted by Senior Admiral Kim Myong Sik, commander of the KPA Navy, other major commanding officers of the Navy and commanding officers of the east and west sea fleets of the Navy and their affiliated underwater and surface warship squadrons with boundless reverence for him.
There was a march-past of the guard of honour of the KPA Navy.
Kim Jong Untook the platform followed by senior officials of the Party, government and military, the commander of the Navy, commanders of the east and west sea fleets of the Navy, the manager of the Nampho Shipyard and others.
Officials of the Party Central Committee, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK, the officials, persons of merit and labour innovators who contributed to the building of the warship and commanding officers of the services and corps of the KPA took the seats for invited guests.
The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played.
Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, delivered a commemorative address.
He said: The 5 000-tonnage destroyer, which is equipped with the most powerful weapons and which has been built by the workers in the field of our warship-building industry, is to record a sacred new name of the defender in the blue sea of the country. It is a very encouraging reality and an event marking decisive progress in the course of strengthening the war capability of the Navy that we have perfectly built the modern destroyer in a little over 400 days with our own strength and technology.
The new-type destroyer, which was born as an imposing creation symbolizing the strength and spirit of Korea, is the fruition of the great patriotic idea of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand his will to build a rich country with a strong army and a precious entity in which every metre of the hull and every piece of equipment are permeated with the sacred responsibility for the revolution as the soul.
Today came to be recorded not only as a day when a new era of the warship-building industry was opened but also as a day when a new start was made by the workers and officials of our munitions industry, the speaker noted, adding that a brilliant golden age of the DPRK Navy will be brought about and the historic picture of the DPRK’s arms demonstrating their might as the treasured sword for defending justice and peace will steadily spread out as the respected ComradeKim Jong Unleads our struggle in the van.
Yun Chi Gol, manager of the Nampho Shipyard, made a speech in reply.
He proudly reported that the workers of the Nampho Shipyard are prepared for presenting the first new-generation destroyer of the DPRK to the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a gift of patriotic loyalty by honourably implementing the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK on building modern destroyer.
The latest warship is a precious creation of the revolution in the warship-building industry floated by the iron faith and will and outstanding strategy ofKim Jong Un, who cherishes the great ambition to turn our country into an advanced maritime power, not merely by the buoyancy of nature, he said, adding that in the course of building the warship the way of thinking and manner of work of officials and employees have been changed, powerful ranks of technicians and skilled workers built up and scientific and advanced warship building technology and processes established.
He solemnly pledged that the Nampho Shipyard would become the pacemaker and engine of the revolution in the warship-building industry in the new era faithfully upholding the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee with practice and thus glorify forever the honour of the revolutionary industry group by taking the core position in the development of the shipbuilding industry of the country and perfectly carrying out any warship building task entrusted by the Party.
Pak Jong Chon announced a written order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK on the grading regulations, name and number of the new-type multi-mission destroyer and conveyed it to the commander of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy.
On the order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK signed byKim Jong Un, the newly built new-type 5 000-tonnage multi-mission destroyer was graded and classified as the Choe Hyon class and named after the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Choe Hyon, a model military activist who had made boundless loyalty to the leader part of his mental qualities, an elder of the armed forces of the DPRK and a veteran general.
Kim Jong Unconferred the ensign of destroyer Choe Hyon on the commanding officers of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy.
Vice Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the East Sea Fleet, made a speech of pledge.
Referring to the honour of the Navy of clearly recording as a blueprint in the history of army building its true appearance as a service commensurate with the prestige of a military power, he said that the earnest desire for the most powerful arms to overwhelmingly smash the naval supremacy of the arrogant imperialist pirates has been fulfilled in the glorious era of holdingKim Jong Unin high esteem.
Saying that the position of our Navy will surely be in the distant future five or ten years from today when the era of the greatKim Jong Un-style fleet building has started, he, on behalf of all the officers and men of the Navy, extended warm gratitude and militant salute toKim Jong Unwho is ushering in the greatest heyday in the strengthening of the Navy and to the heroic workers of the shipyard and the relevant field that are upholding the Party’s grand plan for building the naval force with ardent loyalty and worthwhile struggle.
He, on the honour of the army of the WPK and seaman of the DPRK, solemnly pledged to fully demonstrate the honour of the fleet which has taken the most responsible battlefield for the great revolutionary cause and for defending the country by making all efforts to bolster up the combat capability of the warship and round off the war preparations of the fleet and preparing to be a navy which smashes the enemy unconditionally in every battle.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, cut the rope in token of the ceremony of launching the destroyer.
Amid the sound of the warship whistle at the naval port, a powerful entity revealed its magnificent appearance in the sea of the country signalling the advent of a new era of modernization of the Navy. And confetti and coloured tapes were poured out, fireworks were set off and balloons flew up, reflecting the excitement and joy of this historic moment.
Kim Jong Unmounted the destroyer.
The warship had the honour of undergoing the first inspection by the head of state.
After receiving the salute of the captain,Kim Jong Unmet with seamen and gave them warm militant encouragement, going round the stem and quarter deck of the warship.
The memorial relief image of anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Choe Hyon was unveiled on the destroyer.
Kim Jong Unplaced a flower before the relief image of Choe Hyon and paid high tribute to him.
He said that the absolute loyalty to the leader and the spirit of unconditionally implementing the orders and instructions of the leader constitute the core of the revolutionary traits and military temperament of Choe Hyon, adding that the seas of the country will remain unperturbed and the ever-victorious tradition will continuously be carried forward when the reputation and noble soul of the veteran general whose mere name used to strike horror into the hearts of the two imperialist powers become the symbol of invincibility and militant banner of our Navy.
Kim Jong Ungot off the warship and met the meritorious persons of the Nampho Shipyard who contributed to the building of the destroyer.
He highly appreciated that the historic event which can be called a new birth of the Juche-oriented navy could be brought about thanks to the patriotic and inexhaustible efforts and enthusiasm of the workers, scientists and technicians of the Nampho Shipyard who are supporting the strategic line and policies on building up the national defence clarified by the WPK with absolute loyalty and devoted efforts.
The workers, scientists and technicians in the field of the warship-building industry raised enthusiastic cheers, extending the greatest glory toKim Jong Unwho placed them at the vanguard of the struggle for accomplishing the sacred cause of strengthening the naval force of the DPRK radically and by leaps and bounds to suit the national prestige and status of a powerful country and is ushering in a new era of the rejuvenation of the warship-building industry with his energetic leadership.
He awarded commemorative copper coins to the commanders and other officers of the destroyer, wishing the destroyer Choe Hyon would perform distinguished feats and enjoy boundless glory.
Kim Jong Unmade a historic speech on the occasion of the ceremony of launching the destroyer.
Expressing the historic significance and deep emotion of declaring the launch of the new-generation multi-mission attack destroyer No. 1, which is indispensable in building up our capability for stoutly defending the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK and which will represent an important starting point of the journey towards building an advanced maritime power, on April 25, the birthday of the first revolutionary armed forces of Korea,Kim Jong Unextended militant encouragement to the workers, technicians and officials of the Nampho Shipyard who successfully built the new-type destroyer true to the Party’s line of strengthening the naval force, and to the scientists, technicians and workers in the field of the shipbuilding industry who are struggling as the main force of the revolution in the warship-building industry in the new era.
After making a stern analysis of the situation in the vicinity which poses a very serious threat to the security environment of the DPRK, he said that the strength to launch aggression is directly proportional to the strength to prevent it, and set forth the plan of the WPK to radically bolster up the war capability of the Navy in line with the justness and necessity of the possession of pelagic fleet, the prerequisite for national security and the world trend of developing the naval force and the detailed ways for implementing the plan.
His speech is an immortal great programme which is of great theoretical and practical significance in leading the revolution in the warship-building industry in the new era to a steady upsurge and remarkably strengthening the DPRK Navy into a core service for national defence and a component of nuclear war deterrent.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his commemorative speech, all the participants broke into the thunderous cheers of “Hurrah!” out of boundless excitement and ardent loyalty, which resounded into the vast sea.
Kim Jong Unhad a significant photo session with all the commanding officers and seamen of the destroyer Choe Hyon against the background of the warship.
He expressed great expectation and conviction that all the seamen of the destroyer would steadfastly carry forward the indomitable faith and tradition of victory cherished by the pioneering generation of the Korean revolution and thus become the brave warriors of the sea fully guaranteeing the prosperity of the country and the peace and happiness of the people by force of arms and create a new legendary tale of heroes of the Juche-oriented navy.
All the commanding officers and seamen of the destroyer made a firm pledge to enhance the reputation as a matchless warship demonstrating the invincible valour in defending the territorial waters of the country, looking up to the great brilliant commander who gave them the strongest treasured sword unprecedented in the naval force of the country and personally mounted the warship to wish them distinguished military feats and instil the spirit of sure victory into them.
Kim Jong Unhad a photo session also with officials and persons of merit of the shipyard and institute who made contributions to building the destroyer.
On the day, there were a banquet given by the KPA Navy with sincerity and a congratulatory performance by national-level art troupes in celebration of the ceremony of launching the new-type multi-mission destroyer.
After the performance,Kim Jong Unmet discharged navy generals.
Highly appreciating the feats performed by the generals of the past days who had long served at the Navy’s important posts and recorded immortal exploits in the history of the Navy with boundless self-sacrificing spirit and indomitable mettle, he said that their great spirit should be invariably carried forward as the eternal soul of defence.
Kim Jong Unwho is making an uninterrupted journey of devoted efforts for the accelerated growth of the national defence capability and the people’s peace, was courteously seen off by the leading officials of the Nampho Shipyard and discharged navy generals.
The ceremony of launching the new-type multi-mission destroyer held in the presence ofKim Jong Unwill shine forever in history as an auspicious event heralding the new birth of the DPRK Navy and a great event that powerfully demonstrated before the whole world the spirit of advance and sure victory of our state and people dynamically advancing towards the grand goal of building an advanced maritime power. -0-

headline: Issue of Supplying Dairy Products Established as Party's Policy
story_text:
One day in April 2021, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unmet senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Untold the officials to supply cow milk or goat milk to the children of nurseries and kindergartens and the pupils of the first-, second- and third-year classes of primary schools in the future. He also gave instructions on making it a policy to supply dairy products to these children and pupils in and on ensuring the necessary quantities.
Officials, who were examining the necessary amount of dairy products, faced a difficult problem.
Dairy products can be supplied from June to September when milk is mass-produced, but it was difficult from October to May next year when milk production reduces because a huge amount of money was needed.
At a consultative meeting urgently convened to discuss the issue of people's living standard in June that year the General Secretary taught the importance of the work for supplying dairy products to the children of nurseries and kindergartens.
Thanks to the noble love of the great father, the historic Third Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea discussed the issue of improving and strengthening the Party's childcare policy as an important agenda item. As a result, it was established as the Party's policy to supply dairy products and other nutritious foods to the children across the country. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Mun Myon Gi, a war veteran living in Neighborhood Unit No. 30, Kisan-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, on his 100th birthday.
The old man, who was deeply moved by the deep love of the respected Marshal, expressed his gratitude to him.
Officials of the Unpha County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers shared joy with the family and relatives of the old man.
He was born into a poor peasant's family before the liberation and came to know well how precious the country is, being subject to all sorts of maltreatment and contempt. He volunteered for the army during the Fatherland Liberation War and performed military exploits in several battles. He worked with devotion at his revolutionary posts in the postwar period of rehabilitation and the period of socialist construction.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Uninvited him to the national conferences of war veterans and glorified the life of the victorious wartime generation as he has remained loyal to the Party and the revolution with the invariable attitude of a frontline soldier and brought his children up to be pillars of the country. -0-

headline: Performance Given to Mark 93rd Founding Anniversary of KPRA
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The Ensemble of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK gave a music and dance performance "Everlasting echo of the Paektu curriculum" at the April 25 House of Culture here on April 25, the 93rd founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
Among the audience were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Choe Tong Myong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, and other commanding officers of armed forces organs, service personnel, teaching staff and students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School and Pyongyang citizens.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played solemnly. Put on the stage were colorful numbers including famous songs of the times demonstrating the ever-victorious tradition of the Korean revolution.
The performers sang in high praises of the bright heyday of a powerful country unfolded on this land, which was permeated with the blood and soul of the guerrillas along with the bloody traces of pioneering, the unprecedented resistance history of the forerunners who defeated the imperialist tyranny.
Such umbers as the male solo and pangchang "Nostalgia", an immortal classic, male quintet and chorus "Let's Keep the Revolutionary Faith to the Death" touched the hearts of the audience, recollecting a warm memory of the noble life of the first generation of the Korean revolution who devoted their youth and lives to the sacred war for national liberation, cherishing ardent love for the country and indomitable revolutionary faith.
The excitement and joy of the people ushering in a new era of prosperity and rejuvenation unprecedented in the history of the DPRK, holding the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin high esteem at the helm of the revolution, erupted in the song and dance "Dear Father".
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it inspired the revolutionary faith and will of the people and service personnel. -0-

headline:
KPRA Birthday Marked in DPRK
							
							
								
[2025.04.26.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel in the DPRK significantly celebrated the 93rd founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA).
An endless stream of people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
Entering the plaza park of the palace, the visitors paid the highest tribute toKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilwho opened up the sacred origin of the Juche revolution and provided a powerful military guarantee for the prosperity of all generations.
The people and service personnel visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting their images on Mansu Hill and in different parts of the country to lay flower baskets and bouquets before the statues and mosaics of the peerlessly great sages and pay deep homage to them.
Many people visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, which reminded them of the strong revolutionary faith and indomitable will of the forerunners who covered the long journey of blizzards of Mt Paektu, holding the President as the centre of unity and leadership in the pioneering period of the Korean revolution.
Officials, working people and schoolchildren across the country visited the service personnel defending the country impregnably, the families of war veterans and honored disabled soldiers to share joy of the holiday.
Colorful art performances were given at theatres in Pyongyang and regions.
Open-air performances were given in different parts of the capital city, revving up the festive atmosphere.
Colorful performances were given in South Phyongan, South Hwanghae, Kangwon and South Hamgyong provinces and Nampho Municipality.
On the same day, public catering units across the country gave diverse holiday services to people and the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum, the Amusement Park of Kaeson Youth Park and other cultural and leisure bases were full of happy laughter of the working people who spent a pleasant time. -0-

The old man, who was deeply moved by the deep love of the respected Marshal, expressed his gratitude to him.

He was born into a poor peasant's family before the liberation and came to know well how precious the country is, being subject to all sorts of maltreatment and contempt. The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Uninvited him to the national conferences of war veterans and glorified the life of the victorious wartime generation as he has remained loyal to the Party and the revolution with the invariable attitude of a frontline soldier and brought his children up to be pillars of the country. -0-
