headline: Coal Production Goes Up in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- The production of coal has increased by more than 107 percent throughout the Ministry of Coal Industry, compared with the same period of last year thanks to the indefatigable fighting spirit and creation of the officials and workers in the field of coal industry.
Officials of the Ministry of Coal Industry and relevant units are giving priority to prospecting and tunneling while securing reserve cutting faces and conducting operations and commands with the main emphasis on strengthening the material and technical foundations of coal mines.
Officials and coal miners of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex are carrying out their production plans set at higher level.
The coal miners of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex secured more than 80 reserve cutting faces this year.
The Tukjang Youth Coal Mine under the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex is boosting the production every day.
The coal miners in the northern part of the country are also making collective innovations by displaying their strong practical ability.
The Onsong Area Coal-mining Complex conducts the frontline-style political work to arouse coal miners to the socialist patriotic coal production movement so that all the pit faces are seething with the drive for increased production to implement the decisions of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Soksong and Myongchon coal mines of the Myongchon Area Coal-mining Complex are giving priority to the main tunneling and the preparatory tunneling while ensuring the rapid transport of coal to provide a guarantee for increased production. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in Seminar on Juche Idea
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a letter from the participants in the Latin American regional Juche idea seminar on "Independence, global peace and social justice" on May 4.
The participants in the letter said that the building of a just and peaceful new world, the ideal and aspiration of mankind, is faced with grave challenges and difficulties and human independence and dignity are being wantonly violated in all parts of the world due to the ever-increasing arbitrariness and high-handedness of the hegemonic forces trying to maintain the unipolar ruling system at present.
The seminar held in such circumstances particularly referred to the fact that the DPRK is victoriously advancing for the overall prosperity and development of socialism under the wise guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand this is a great contribution to independence, social justice and global peace, the letter said.
Only when each country and nation firmly defends and realizes independence, can social justice and global peace be firmly guaranteed and the brilliant embodiment of the Juche idea in the DPRK is powerfully encouraging the struggle of the world progressives advancing along the road of independence against imperialism, it noted.
The Latin American regional Juche idea seminar served as a very important and meaningful large meeting which clearly highlighted the immutable truth that the Juche idea is the immortal banner for realizing the human cause of independence and that the DPRK, which is prosperous with independent politics, self-supporting economy and self-reliant national defence, is the beacon of the regional and world's progressive people aspiring after independence and social justice, it said.
The participants in the letter sincerely wished the DPRK new eye-opening successes in the future, too, under the outstanding leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Many Workers Fulfill Yearly or First Half-yearly Plans in Sector of Textile Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of workers in the sector of textile industry of the DPRK have carried out their yearly or first half-yearly plans.
In February, a worker at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill was the first to carry out the yearly plan and then, more than 30 workers fulfilled their yearly plans and hundreds of workers fulfilled their first half-yearly plans.
At the Sinuiju Textile Mill more than 10 workers carried out their yearly plans and over 170 workers their first half-yearly plans.
At the Sariwon Textile Mill, more than ten workers fulfilled their yearly plans and more than a hundred workers their first half-yearly plans.
The similar successes were made by workers at the September Textile Mill, the Hamhung Woolen Mill, the Kaesong Textile Mill, etc. -0-

headline: Introduction of Advanced Farming Methods and Techniques Brisk in Agricultural Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- The DPRK agricultural sector is briskly introducing advanced farming methods and techniques.
The Paeksok Farm in Sinchon County, the Sinsaeng Farm in Chongdan County, and the Sokchon Vegetable Farm in Haeju City of South Hwanghae Province, the Jehyon Farm of the South Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee, the Honam Farm of the Pyongyang Municipal Rural Economy Committee and many other farms are applying the labor- and plot-saving method of cultivating seedlings in a greenhouse.
South Hwanghae Province has introduced the mulching cultivation method in many areas, including Anak, Unryul and Pongchon counties, to solve the shortage of manpower.
Many regions and farms, including Yomju County of North Phyongan Province, Yonggwang County of South Hamgyong Province, the Unjong Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province, the Tongam Farm in Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province and the Jangchon Vegetable Farm in Sadong District of Pyongyang Municipality are pushing ahead with the work to increase the areas for introducing the organic farming method by mud snails.
Sinchon County of South Hwanghae Province, Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province and the Kumdae Farm of the Pyongyang Municipal Rural Economy Committee and many other areas and farms are stepping up the work to protect the land and introduce water-saving farming methods. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in Seminar on Juche Idea
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a letter from the participants in the Latin American regional Juche idea seminar on "Independence, global peace and social justice" on May 4.
The participants in the letter said that the building of a just and peaceful new world, the ideal and aspiration of mankind, is faced with grave challenges and difficulties and human independence and dignity are being wantonly violated in all parts of the world due to the ever-increasing arbitrariness and high-handedness of the hegemonic forces trying to maintain the unipolar ruling system at present.
The seminar held in such circumstances particularly referred to the fact that the DPRK is victoriously advancing for the overall prosperity and development of socialism under the wise guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand this is a great contribution to independence, social justice and global peace, the letter said.
Only when each country and nation firmly defends and realizes independence, can social justice and global peace be firmly guaranteed and the brilliant embodiment of the Juche idea in the DPRK is powerfully encouraging the struggle of the world progressives advancing along the road of independence against imperialism, it noted.
The Latin American regional Juche idea seminar served as a very important and meaningful large meeting which clearly highlighted the immutable truth that the Juche idea is the immortal banner for realizing the human cause of independence and that the DPRK, which is prosperous with independent politics, self-supporting economy and self-reliant national defence, is the beacon of the regional and world's progressive people aspiring after independence and social justice, it said.
The participants in the letter sincerely wished the DPRK new eye-opening successes in the future, too, under the outstanding leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Latin American Regional Juche Idea Seminar Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- A Latin American regional Juche idea seminar on "Independence, global peace and social justice" took place in Mexico City, the capital city of Mexico on May 3 and 4.
Present there were the director general, vice-director general and directors of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea, chiefs of the organizations for the study of the Juche idea in Peru, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica and other Latin American regions, members of a delegation of the Secretariat of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and figures of political and social circles in Mexico.

The secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the director general, vice-director general and directors of the Latin American Institute of the Juche Idea and other speakers explained in detail that the Juche idea founded by PresidentKim Il Sungand developed and enriched by ChairmanKim Jong Ilwas formulated as Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
They stressed that it is most important for the Latin American and Caribbean countries to independently hew out all fields including politics and economy in conformity with the actual conditions of their countries and build up the strength of self-respect along the path of independence indicated by the Juche idea and that the anti-imperialist independent forces in the regions should unite firmly and jointly struggle against the imperialist high-handed and arbitrary practices.

headline: Irrigation Project
story_text:
One day in September 1976, PresidentKim Il Sungguided a consultative meeting of primary officials at the then ten cooperative farms in Sangso-ri, the then Anju County, South Phyongan Province, the DPRK.
Saying that the crop yield of Sangso-ri is not high due to drought, he personally calculated the equipment and materials needed to irrigate the fields of Sangso-ri with the water of Lake Yonphung.
In order to supply patches and terraced paddy fields in Sangso-ri with the water of the lake, it was necessary to pump through several stages the water which arrives at the neighboring village by three-stage pumping. So this project required a lot of equipment, materials and manpower.
And it was difficult to expect the effectiveness of the investment as the area under irrigation was scores of hectares of mountain fields and terraced paddy fields.
While removing the practical calculation and thinking of the officials, the President said that the state would provide the necessary equipment and materials for irrigation, although it would be a thing to kill a fly with a long spear.
The officials were deeply moved by his instructions associated with his warm love for the farmers. -0-

headline: Social Interest and Support to Strengthening Educational Foundation Intensified
Koryo Celadon
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 12 (KCNA) -- Koryo celadon (jade green ceramics) symbolizing the famous Koryo ceramics of Korea is widely known worldwide for its beautiful color.
The term of jade green is derived from the color of green jadeite. It is a soft blue color that is bright and yet produces noble and deep emotions.
People of Koryo (918-1392) made famous celadon by selecting a peculiar color suited to the beauty of nature and the emotions and sentiments of the nation.
Creators of the Mansudae Art Studio, a comprehensive fine art producer of the DPRK, said that it is not easy to get such a beautiful color as Koryo celadon and the color of the ceramics varies according to the components of the ground clay and glaze, and their interrelationship, the characteristics of the kiln, the quality of firewood, the amount of moisture and the skill of the ceramist. Noting that many Koryo celadon represent the same beautiful color, they said that such fact shows a glimpse of the high ceramic technique of Korean ancestors.
Koryo celadon has been further developed to the height of beauty by introducing a special decoration method called the inlaid technique. The soft color of jade green glaze and subtle and elaborate pattern decoration of the ceramic are the peculiar aesthetic tastes that can be seen only in Koryo celadon.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilgave instructions on the proper development of the ceramic workmanship, especially Koryo celadon, which shows the superiority of the national culture.
The Chairman clarified the issues arising in the development of ceramic workmanship including Koryo celadon and led the country's ceramic workmanship to be world-famous.
The Koryo celadon workmanship, which fully embodies the national characteristics of the Korean people, was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in May 2014. -0-

headline: Volume 64 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 12 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Vol. 64 of "Complete Collection ofKim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively carries the classic works of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a chronological order.
Contained in the book are 47 famous works made public byKim Jong Ilin the period from January to August 2002.
In his work "On Some Tasks Arising in Intensifying Party Work and Improving the People's Living Standards as Required by the Prevailing Situation", the Chairman clarified that the revolutionary ranks should be firmly consolidated by intensifying the internal work of the Party as the enemy's moves to provoke a new war are getting ever more undisguised and the danger of war is increased, and set forth tasks for fully producing and supplying the people with various foodstuffs and essential consumer goods.
In his work "On Having a Correct Understanding of Nationalism", he clarified that nationalism is an idea that loves one's nation and defends its interests, and that true nationalism is patriotism.
There are also works dealing with the principled issues arising in making the Korean People's Army invariably defend the tradition of devotedly defending the leader, glorify it forever and prepare all the service personnel as a-match-for-a-hundred fighters by conducting brisk combat drills.
The book contains works dealing with policy tasks arising in satisfactorily solving the food problem for the people by carrying out the policies of the Party for bringing about a radical turn in potato farming and double cropping, and developing stockbreeding and fish farming.
The book also contains famous works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction, including the issue of turning the country into a beautiful land in the era of the Workers' Party through effective forest and water conservation, the issue of giving a good explanation of the position and role of the Korean women and the issue of conducting the work of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan in a creative and active way. -0-

headline: Unsan County in North Phyongan Province Takes Lead in Land Management
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The general mobilization for land administration has been under way in spring and autumn every year in the DPRK in which regards land management as the patriotic work of lasting value and the work for providing the people with good living place.
Unsan County, North Phyongan Province, is in the van of the whole country in the land management.
Many people across the country are visiting the county to learn from its experience.
The place with frequent clouds and many mountains had been severely damaged by irregular landslides and flooding rivers.
But, the county has been turned into the place benefited from mountains and rivers.
In the county, the Tapsang Mother Tree Nursery and other tree nurseries were built, hundreds of hectares of forest was created and many mountains were turned into golden and treasure mountains.
The county carried out a river embankment project in 300 km-long sections, dug up 25 million cubic meters of earth from the river beds and conducted hundreds of thousands of square meters of masonry work to restore hundreds of hectares of land which had been lost by flood long ago. It also improved cold and damp soil and protected thousands of hectares of land.
It built nearly 20 kilometers of embankment which can be used as road and completed the anti-land-sliding project to cope with any flood in the area of Tapsang-ri.
North Phyongan Province witnessed much rain last year, but Unsan County was free from heavy rain and flood.
Officials and working people in the county have conducted effective forest and water conservation every year to turn their region into a more beautiful place good to live in. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Spring Int'l Trade Fair Opens
Dance "Yangsando" Recreated into Korean-style Janggu Dance
story_text:
One day in January 1972, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the Mansudae Art Troupe and watched the dance "Yangsando".
The female dancers with flower-patterned parasols in their right hands and light kerchiefs in their left hands cheerfully danced to the tune of the folk song "Yangsando".
Watching the dance, the Chairman called a creator and asked him if he could create Janggu dance with the folk song.
He could not answer soon the Chairman's unexpected question.
The Chairman said that it would be more pleasant to dance with the national percussion instrument Janggu, instead of the parasol, to the tune of the folk song "Yangsando" singing of the gentle flow of the River Taedong.
The creators were deeply moved by what he said.
Later, the dance "Yangsando" was recreated into a Korean-style Janggu dance with the fine rhythms and diverse dance movements which are well harmonized, and it was enthusiastically acclaimed by the audience as an excellent work showing the appearance of the Juche-oriented efflorescing art of dance under the care of the Chairman. -0-

story_text:

Presented to the fair, held under the theme of "For the common development and prosperity", were such excellent products as electronic appliances, building materials, medicines, light industrial goods, foodstuffs and daily necessities produced by more than 110 enterprises and companies of the DPRK, Russia, China, Myanmar, Mongolia, Bangladesh and Thailand including the Korean Kaesong Koryo Insam Trading Company  the Pugang Pharmaceutical Company, the Songdo Footwear Economic Cooperation Co., Ltd and the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory
A speech was made at the opening ceremony.
The speaker stressed that it is the consistent external economic policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to expand external economic relations with different countries and regions of the world on the principle of complete equality and mutual benefit and continue to develop bilateral and multilateral cooperation.
He declared the fair open, convinced that it would mark a significant occasion in developing foreign trade, promoting friendship between countries and expanding economic relations. -0-

headline: Technology for Producing Soil-covering Paper Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- Scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK developed a new technology for producing soil-covering biodegradable paper by industrial method.
This biodegradable paper helps prevent pollution, erosion and nutritive loss of soil and reduce farming processes requiring much labor.
It has abundant raw materials as it is made of straw and reeds and has a great prospect of introduction as it can be produced by the existing production equipment of paper factories in cities and counties.
At present, several cities and counties are increasing the cultivation area of crops by using biodegradable paper.
The development and introduction of soil-covering paper production technology opened up another prospect for overcoming the effects of the disastrous abnormal weather and producing high and safe yields.
Scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences are conducting the work to widely introduce this technology. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique Meetings and Shows Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- In different parts of the DPRK, there took place passing-on technique meetings and shows on putting rice-transplanting and cultivation and tending of field crops on a scientific basis.
The province show on rice-transplanting, held at the Yakjon Farm in Sukchon County, South Phyongan Province, dealt with several issues for successfully conducting rice-transplanting.
There took place passing-on technique meetings and shows in South Hwanghae, North Phyongan and Kangwon provinces to conduct rice-transplanting and cultivation and tending of field crops in a scientific way.
The meetings and shows dealt with the issues arising in attaining this year's goal of grain production and laying a foundation for decisively increasing agricultural output during the new long-term plan.
Passing-on technique meetings and shows held in different provinces stressed the need for the participants to organize the work to let know the sci-tech issues to not only the cities and counties but also farms, workteams, sub-workteams and farmers in order to raise the enthusiasm for scientific farming in all regions and units. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Great Leaders' Field Guidance Marked in Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- Meetings were held at various units in Kangwon Province of the DPRK to mark the 60th anniversary of the field guidance of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present at the meetings were Paek Song Guk, chief secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned and officials and working people of relevant units.
There were commemorative reports at the meetings.
The reporters referred to the fact that the President and the Chairman gave field guidance at the Munphyong Smeltery, the Songdowon Fishery Station, the Phochon Farm in Hoeyang County, the Songbuk Branch Farm of the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm, the Songdowon Pleasure Park Management Office, the Songdowon Hotel, etc. in May 1965.
The President and the Chairman visited the Munphyong Smeltery to indicate the orientation and ways for raising the lead and zinc extraction rate through proper equipment management and took measures for the health of workers and for providing them with good living conditions.
At the Songdowon Fishery Station, they solved problems arising in fishing and processing. And while learning about farming at the Phochon Farm in Hoeyang County, the Songbuk Branch Farm of the Kosan Combined Fruit Farm and others, they led the work to create and generalize the sub-workteam management system, the type of production organization and management method of Korean style.
Going round the Songdowon Pleasure Park Management Office and the Songdowon Hotel, they made sure that the coastal scenic spot Songdowon is built into a pleasure ground for the people and a world-class tourist resort and showed deep loving care and trust to the officials and workers so that they fulfill their mission and duty as servants of the people.
The reporters referred to the progress made in the development of the relevant units over the past 60 years in hearty response to the tasks set forth by the President and the Chairman during their on-site guidance.
They called upon all the officials and working people to glorify the leadership exploits of the Party forever and unite as one around the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto fulfill their responsibility and duty in the struggle to implement the decisions of the Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: Unsan County in North Phyongan Province Takes Lead in Land Management
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The general mobilization for land administration has been under way in spring and autumn every year in the DPRK in which regards land management as the patriotic work of lasting value and the work for providing the people with good living place.
Unsan County, North Phyongan Province, is in the van of the whole country in the land management.
Many people across the country are visiting the county to learn from its experience.
The place with frequent clouds and many mountains had been severely damaged by irregular landslides and flooding rivers.
But, the county has been turned into the place benefited from mountains and rivers.
In the county, the Tapsang Mother Tree Nursery and other tree nurseries were built, hundreds of hectares of forest was created and many mountains were turned into golden and treasure mountains.
The county carried out a river embankment project in 300 km-long sections, dug up 25 million cubic meters of earth from the river beds and conducted hundreds of thousands of square meters of masonry work to restore hundreds of hectares of land which had been lost by flood long ago. It also improved cold and damp soil and protected thousands of hectares of land.
It built nearly 20 kilometers of embankment which can be used as road and completed the anti-land-sliding project to cope with any flood in the area of Tapsang-ri.
North Phyongan Province witnessed much rain last year, but Unsan County was free from heavy rain and flood.
Officials and working people in the county have conducted effective forest and water conservation every year to turn their region into a more beautiful place good to live in. -0-

Technology for Producing Soil-covering Paper Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- Scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK developed a new technology for producing soil-covering biodegradable paper by industrial method.
This biodegradable paper helps prevent pollution, erosion and nutritive loss of soil and reduce farming processes requiring much labor.
It has abundant raw materials as it is made of straw and reeds and has a great prospect of introduction as it can be produced by the existing production equipment of paper factories in cities and counties.
At present, several cities and counties are increasing the cultivation area of crops by using biodegradable paper.
The development and introduction of soil-covering paper production technology opened up another prospect for overcoming the effects of the disastrous abnormal weather and producing high and safe yields.
Scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences are conducting the work to widely introduce this technology. -0-

headline: Jonwi Street
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- In the area of the northern gateway to Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, there is Jonwi Street built by DPRK young builders.
Ordinary people in the capital city, including families of war veterans, honored disabled soldiers and educators and families with many children, are leading a happy life in Jonwi Street where high-rise and super-high-rise apartment houses of various styles and public buildings form a large architectural group.
The street, initiated and named by the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, was successfully built under his meticulous leadership.
At the Sixth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unset forth the task of building a new street in the Sopho area on the sidelines of the construction of 10,000 flats in Pyongyang in 2023, and entrusted this huge construction project to the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade.
He came to the venue for the groundbreaking ceremony and encouraged the young vanguard with his exciting speech and made the construction-starting thunder resound. And he indicated the orientation and ways for building a modern new street.
Engraving in their mind the love and trust of the great father, the young builders successfully built the large architectural group, a symbol of socialist development and future, in a short span of one year.
Kim Jong Un, who attended the inauguration ceremony of Jonwi Street in May 2024 and cut the inauguration tape, expressed belief that the young people would continue to fully demonstrate the wisdom and bravery of the youth they displayed in the construction of the capital city and perform brilliant feats in the vanguard of the times advancing towards the comprehensive development of the state.
The street is a proud youth grand monument associated with the great love and trust of the peerlessly great man, who is making a noble history of valuing the youth, and the spirit of the Paektusan hero youth and the irresistible struggle of DPRK young people. -0-

headline: DPRK Schoolchildren's Art Troupe Gives Performances in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- A schoolchildren's art troupe of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace visited the Primorsky Krai of Russia from May 2 to 12 and returned home after successfully finishing its performance activities.
During the visit, the schoolchildren's art troupe, which gave the premiere at the Primorsky Krai Branch of the Mariinsky Theatre, gave performances in Vladivostok and Artyom cities again in the admiration of the people, thus showing well the features of the proud new generations of Juche Korea.
The schoolchildren fully demonstrated their artistic talents which they have cultivated to the full under the warm care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho spares nothing for the rising generations in such colorful numbers as prologue "We Are the Happiest in the World", duet "Our Father Is the Best" and female solo "My Country Is the Best".
The performers sang such Russian songs as "Katyusha" and "Happy Birthday" well to add the feeling of friendship to the audience. Their performances evoked a great response from the Russian people.
The deputy prime minister of the Primorsky Krai government and concurrently minister of Culture, the mayor of Vladivostok City and others repeatedly expressed their thanks to the performers for their wonderful performances, saying that all inhabitants of Primorsky Krai are excited with the performances of the young art troupe, that they pay respects to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho brought up such outstanding students and that the future of the DPRK loving the rising generation and attaching importance to education is very bright.
Citizens from all walks of life and students enthusiastically applauded them whenever each number ended, and a veteran impressed by the performance of the schoolchildren's art troupe came on the stage to give his medal to a child and sincerely congratulated them on their performance success.
They unanimously praised the schoolchildren of the Korean art troupe who gave the excellent performances as art prodigies. -0-

headline: Students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School Conduct Motivation Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- Students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School visited the Chongsan Farm in Kangso District, the DPRK on May 13 to conduct motivation activities for increased production.
The performance which started with the playing of the cheerful song "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain" revved up the atmosphere of the seething farm field through colourful numbers including serial songs and accordion ensemble reflecting the changed appearance of the country which is turning into a more beautiful people's paradise better to live in under the leadership of the Workers' Party.
The poem recitation "There is Road to Pyongyang beside My Field", representing the desire of the agricultural workers to glorify their lives as genuine patriotic farmers, redoubled the patriotic enthusiasm of the masses who are devoting their honest conscience and efforts to carrying out the immediate farming process.
The motivation activities of the students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School marked an occasion of adding to the revolutionary optimism and enthusiasm for struggle of the agricultural workers of the Chongsan Plain in their efforts for bumper harvest. -0-

headline: Everyone Should Conduct Sci-tech Research
story_text:
One day in May 2015, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex and dropped in at the sci-tech learning space.
After looking round the sci-tech learning space for a while, the General Secretary said that it should not be confined to building a scientific and technological base but be equipped with a large number of valuable scientific and technological data suited to the world trend so that people can actively use them.
He said that the development of the country depends on the development of science and technology, scientific and technological research should be conducted not only by scientists and technicians but also by all people, and for it, everyone should study hard under the study-while-working educational system and all units should build up sci-tech learning spaces well and operate them on a regular basis.
Officials were remorseful.
Thinking that scientific and technological research is conducted by a specified few people, they did not pay attention to making sure that everyone possesses modern science and technology and promotes the production of the complex by dint of them.
The officials of the complex cherished the instructions by the General Secretary as his earnest request to prepare all the employees as possessors of modern science and technology and thus make a leap forward in the worthwhile struggle to create a new history of "gold seas". -0-

headline: Exhibition of Finishing Building Materials Held in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of finishing building materials for rural housing construction took place in Pyongyang.
Displayed at the exhibition, named "Finishing Building Materials Exhibition for Pyongyang Municipal Rural Construction -2025", were more than 2 000 finishing building materials of 50-odd kinds presented by the districts and counties where rural housing constructions are under way.
The exhibition showed that the number of sorts of finishing building materials awarded the Quality Certification has increased over 1.8 times than last year and the overall production capacity of finishing building materials has increased more than 1.3 times and the building materials production units are boosting production by relying on their local raw materials resources.
Visiting the exhibition venue, officials, builders and technicians of the district and county construction brigades and employees of the building materials production units exchanged successes and experience gained in the work for diversifying finishing building materials, improving their quality and boosting the production. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Combined Tactical Drill of Different Arms Conducted under Training Course of Conference of Training Officers of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- The combined tactical drill of special operations sub-units for passing the standard of all-purpose battalion took place as demonstration drill under the training course of the conference of training officers of the Korean People's Army and training match and joint fire strike demonstration were held between tankmen's sub-units on May 13.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Training Camp No. 60 of the Capital City Defence Corps of the KPA and watched the tactical drill demonstrations of different arms held under the training course of the conference of training officers.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other leading commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of large combined units of the KPA.
Before watching the drill,Kim Jong Unacquainted himself with the function and components of the training base and appreciated that all conditions are well provided for properly conducting various tactical drills of sub-units as befitting the multi-functional combined training base.
He watched various tactical drill demonstrations together with commanding officers of the KPA at the observation post.
The participants in the Conference of the Training Officers of the Korean People's Army watched the demonstrations, too.
The combat training department of the KPA General Staff explained to visitors the forms, methods and contents of various tactical drills and matches.
Various tactical drills conducted by special operations sub-units for passing the standard of all-purpose battalion and the training match between tankmen's sub-units held afterwards aroused the visitors' special interest.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the scientific combat training system has been established throughout the whole army as our Party set forth the five-point policy for effecting a revolution in the training and showed deep interest in thoroughly establishing the traits of prioritizing training at all levels of the People's Army in keeping with the developing patterns and changing trend of modern warfare, strengthening the integral system of organizing, judging and reviewing training, and putting main stress on the actual war drills. He affirmatively appreciated that this promotes substantial changes in the training sector and the strengthening and development of combat capability of units and sub-units.
He said:
Amid the training matches of different services and arms being held in an innovative way in various spheres to cope with the actual war, changes began to take place in the understanding of the training officials. The fundamental change in the viewpoint on training will play a great role in cultivating the high combat spirit of the service personnel, fully perfecting the military and technical preparations and enhancing the combat efficiency and effectiveness of our weapon systems and this serves as a potential driving force for developing our armed forces' capability to fight a war to the full.
Saying that our revolutionary armed forces are now in charge of not a few fronts, but the most important among them is the anti-imperialist class front and making full preparations for war is the most crucial task, he stressed that combat drill to turn the whole army into an elite ranks that are prepared thoroughly and perfectly to execute any order is the first revolutionary task.
In order to implement the Party's military strategic plan for making the special operations forces all-purpose arms and all-round specialists, it is important to launch a vigorous revolutionary movement to pass the standard of all-purpose battalion, he said.
The modern warfare is a showdown between military talents and war of commanding officers' brains, he said, stressing that in order to firmly maintain and strengthen the qualitative superiority of our army, all combat drills should be organized on the principle of enhancing the initiative, independence and creativity of commanding officers and practical brain drills and actual maneuvers should be intensified.
Saying that the reliable prospect for building a powerful army desired by our Party is provided on the training front and the combat preparations of the People's Army are completed and guaranteed from the training sector, he stressed the need to decisively improve the quality of military education and put main emphasis on training and strengthening the ranks of training officers.
He underlined the need to perfect in all aspects the training apparatuses and elements of training grounds for preparing all levels for modern warfare as required by the reality that urges the qualitative change of our armed forces, to introduce IT system and scientific judgment system into training and to establish a new training system in keeping with the developing trend of the new century.
That day, he met the combatants of the sub-unit under the 11th Corps of the KPA who passed the standard of all-purpose battalion and appreciated and warmly encouraged them, saying that they played a role as vanguard fighters in bringing about revolution in training and as model for rounding off the war preparations. Then he had a photo session with them.
He clarified different tasks for fundamentally improving the contents, forms and methods of operational and combat drills in the training sector and making the drills part of life and habit in order to prepare the People's Army to be the one capable of fighting a war at any time and the one that wins without fail if it fights, and for expanding its strategic potential as a powerful army.
He wished the seventh conference of training officers would mark an epochal leap forward in further enhancing the qualities and abilities of all the training officers and extended militant encouragement to all the participants in the conference. -0-

headline: Vol. 34 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 34 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection ofKim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea which contains classic works of PresidentKim Il Sungin chronological order.
The book contains 47 classic works including historic speeches, talks and conclusions made by the President in the period from March to May 1959.
In his works "Tasks of the Party Organizations of North Hamgyong Province", and others, the President comprehensively clarified the issues arising in eliminating bureaucracy and localism, improving Party work and arousing the political enthusiasm and creativity of the masses in the revolutionary struggle and construction work.
The book contains works dealing with idea of educating Party members and other working people with vivid materials of the revolutionary traditions.
In several works, the President stressed the need to bring about an upsurge in socialist construction by mobilizing all the people and lay solid material and technical foundations of the national economy by directing great efforts to heavy industry, especially the metallurgical and machine-building industries.
The book also contains works giving clear answers to theoretical and practical issues arising in various fields of the revolution and construction including the issue of improving urban afforestation, the issue of producing various kinds of quality ceramic goods in large quantities and the issue of increasing the number of days spent fishing to catch more fish. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Patriotic Will Associated with Sapling Production Bases
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade public the famous work "Modern Tree Nurseries Should Be Built to Conduct a More Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign" on May 14, 2016.
In the work, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unsaid that tree nurseries are the powerful arsenal for afforestation and   land- and labor-saving tree nurseries where the sapling production has been put on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis should be built in all provinces.
Thanks to his noble patriotic intention to turn the DPRK into a socialist paradise with green woods, the work to build modern tree nurseries conducive to covering the whole country with trees and flowers have been conducted across the country.
Kangwon Province built a model and standard tree nursery with plastic-sheet greenhouse, outdoor cultivation ground, circular cutting bed, substrate-producing ground, seed selection and sowing ground, etc. in tens of hectares of area by its own effort.
In North Hamgyong, North Phyongan and other provinces, tree nurseries where all the production lines have been automated and streamlined were built one after another and the material and technical foundations of the city and county mother tree nurseries were improved.
The modernly-built tree nurseries have produced good species of saplings suited to the characteristics of their regions every year. Last year alone, the nurseries across the country produced more than 2 billion saplings of 100-odd species.
The DPRK is turning into a beautiful land in the era of the Workers' Party day by day along with the modern sapling production bases built thanks to the great patriotic will ofKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Bases for Cultural and Leisure Activities Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp, a comprehensive cultural recreation base and treatment service base, has been under construction in Kyongsong County of North Hamgyong Province, a famous hot spring area and a scenic mountainous area of the DPRK.
True to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to build cultural recreation grounds and sanatoriums well-harmonized with beautiful natural scenery in famous mountains and scenic spots for the promotion of the people's health, paradise of civilization has been built in excellent places across the country.
The DPRK people still remember the days when the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort was being built as a peculiar service base for the people by the direct initiative and meticulous guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The respected General Secretary unfolded a bright blueprint for the construction of the hot spring resort which no one had ever seen and heard till then and led to build it at the highest qualitative level in keeping with the people's aspirations, demands and aesthetic feelings, and world trend.
People also recollect with deep emotion the fact that he, who dipped his hand in tens of degrees Celsius water gushing out from the hot spring with a broad smile on his face, initiated the construction of the skiing ground and confirmed its location, considering the temperature of the snowy Yangdok area.
Thanks to the loving care of the respected General Secretary who devotes himself to the wellbeing of people, many bases for cultural and leisure activities of the people such as the Rungna People's Pleasure Park, the Munsu Water Park and the Mirim Riding Club have been built in the country.
Last year, he visited the Wonsan Kalma area being turned into a splendid and beautiful cultural tourist resort for the people, and took important measures related to the preparations for operation. In March, he also left sacred traces in the construction site of the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp for the wellbeing of the people.
True to his instruction on making the people enjoy a civilized cultural and emotional life and receive hot-spring therapy, the construction of the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp is progressing at the final stage. -0-

headline: Measures to Strengthen Industrial Assistance to Agriculture Taken in DPRK
story_text:

The Cabinet has paid attention to establishing the system and order for supplying equipment and materials necessary for the agricultural sector and conducting economic operation and command.
The Ministry of Electric Power Industry has carried on the work to uninterruptedly supply electricity to the countryside, and the Ministry of Chemical Industry has detailed the production and supply while examining the variety and the necessary amount of various chemical products needed by the agricultural sector.
The Ministry of Machine-building Industry has striven to produce various kinds of modern and efficient farm machines and send them to the countryside.
The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry and the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry have taken measures to bring about innovations in the production of iron and steel and building materials necessary for the production of farm machines, irrigation projects, etc.

headline: Young People in North Hamgyong Province Volunteer for Theaters of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- Dozens of young people in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK volunteered to work at theaters of socialist construction.
Young people in Puryong and Kilju counties proposed to the youth league organizations to send them to the county construction brigades.
Those in Kim Chaek City and Orang, Kyonghung and Myonggan counties volunteered to work at raw material bases.
Young people in Chongjin City, Hoeryong City, Musan County and Myongchon County advanced into workplaces including mines, farms and forestry stations seething with the drive for increased production and economy.
A girl teacher of the township of Myonggan County decided to work at a branch school in the mountainous area out of the mind to repay the trust of the Workers' Party of Korea which set her up as a teacher revolutionary.
A meeting was held on May 14 to congratulate the volunteers.
Certificates were awarded to the volunteers and congratulatory and oath-taking speeches were made at the meeting attended by Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth.
There was a congratulatory performance at the end of the meeting.
Officials and young people presented bouquets to the volunteers and encouraged them leaving for the new revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: 17th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The 17th Symposium on Architectural Aesthetics took place at the Sci-Tech Complex in the DPRK on Wednesday through video-conferencing.
Present there were officials concerned, officials and technicians in the fields of construction design, inspection of construction, building operation, city management and land and environment protection.
The symposium was held under the theme of "New era of efflorescence of socialist civilization and Juche-based architecture". There were speeches made by Kim Kang Chol, head of an office of the State General Bureau of Design, Min Hyon Ju, vice general director of the National Industrial Design Administration, Ri Il Gon, chief of staff of the Pyongyang Construction Commission, Jo Won Chol, vice-minister of State Construction Control, and Ryang Pong Jin, dean of a faculty of Pyongyang University of Architecture.
Speakers referred to the fact that flourishing socialist living spaces boasting of modern architectural beauty have been built in Pyongyang every year and cultured country towns and fairyland villages built everywhere in the country amid the struggle to implement the programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
They explained the significance and importance of strengthening construction forces and positively introducing modern construction equipment under the condition that the construction of the largest-scale greenhouse farm, the vegetable science research center, multi-functional leisure complexes and grain storage stations has been conducted dynamically.
They called for respecting the construction law reflecting the Party's policy on construction and the requirements of the developing reality, establishing a climate of voluntarily observing the law and bringing about a radical improvement in the inspection of construction. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Calling People King
story_text:
It was one day in July 1965.
PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a place on his way of field guidance for the wellbeing of the people.
It was a good place for rest as it locates near a scenic mountain and clear lake.
But the President spent a busy time, talking with officials without a moment's rest.
An official accompanying him told the President of his regret.
Then the President said that as an old saying goes, if a vassal does many things, his king will be comfortable. I am a vassal of the people and the people are our king, so, only when we do many things, can the people get along comfortably, the President added.
He said with a smile that it is a rest for him to do a lot of work.
The official was much moved by the saying of the President. -0-

headline: Multi-storey Houses Should be Built in Peculiar Way
story_text:
One day in May 1984, ChairmanKim Jong Ilwas looking at a model board showing the Kim Chaek City Construction Plan.
The Chairman could not take his eyes off the area of the single-story apartment houses.
The Chairman looked at the model board for a while without saying anything. Then he told officials around him that the single-storey houses should be pulled down without hesitation and multi-storey houses built in a peculiar way.
The officials had been satisfied with building many single-storey houses for the people thinking that it was great.
Looking at them seized with remorse, the Chairman said that the Party stresses the need for the officials to enhance the Party spirit, the working-class spirit and the popular spirit in order to make them put the main emphasis on the interests of the people in designing everything and putting them into practice, adding that they should therefore give primary attention to the convenience of the people in their daily life when constructing a city and building a house.
Looking up to the Chairman, who points out the defects to be corrected in the model board and teaches them the direction of the revision, the officials pledged to fulfill their mission and duty as faithful servants of the people true to his noble intention. -0-

headline: Manufacture of Grain Dryers Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- The Agricultural Commission of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work for manufacturing grain dryers.
Shortly ago, the Ryongrim Farm in Mundok County, South Phyongan Province made a grain dryer with low coal consumption per hour and high drying capacity.
On the basis of calculating the capacity and practicality of grain dryer, the Agricultural Commission has taken measures to introduce it into farms.
In order to finish wheat and barely farming in a short time by completing and using hundreds of grain dryers in keeping with the weather conditions expected to be rainy during the harvest of wheat and barley, the commission has issued design guidelines to provincial, city and county agricultural guidance organs and pushed ahead with the work for manufacturing grain dryers.
Shortly ago, there took place a show on the grain dryers manufactured by farms in the county at the Oguk Farm in Anak County, South Hwanghae Province. -0-

headline: Mausoleum of King Tongmyong - Korean People's Precious Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- Among the precious national cultural heritages of the Korean people is the Mausoleum of King Tongmyong.
The mausoleum situated in Ryongsan-ri, Ryokpho District, Pyongyang is the tomb of King Tongmyong (B.C.298-B.C.259), the founder of Koguryo which demonstrated its might as a powerful state that existed for one thousand years in the Korean nation's history spanning 5 000 years.
The middle ages started and the feudal society appeared in Korea as Koguryo was founded by King Tongmyong.
Koguryo, with the vastest territory in the history of the Korean nation, was the powerful country which demonstrated the dignity and honor of the nation with advanced economy, culture and military muscle.
The mausoleum was transferred into the present location when Koguryo moved its capital to Pyongyang in 427.
PresidentKim Il Sungmade sure that the mausoleum of King Tongmyong who built Koguryo, the first feudal state in the history of the Korean nation, was unearthed and its character was scientifically interpreted. He also initiated the reconstruction of the mausoleum and wisely led it.
Looking round the mausoleum successfully rebuilt on May 16, 1993, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the mausoleum was rebuilt to represent the phases of the times of Koguryo on the principle of historicism. He stressed the need to preserve and manage historical remains and relics well and show the wisdom and talents of the ancestors who had created a long history and culture to the people through actual objects.
The mausoleum consists of the tomb supported by more than 160 platforms, the image of King Tongmyong, over 30 stone sculptures, dozens of fine art pieces showing the fortitude and customs of the Koguryo people and the Jongrung Temple and other structures peculiar to the nation.
In front of the gate of the mausoleum is the "Monument to the Reconstruction of the Mausoleum of King Tongmyong", inscribed with letters written by the President.
The Mausoleum of King Tongmyong was registered as a world cultural heritage in July 2004. -0-

headline: Entities of Rural Rejuvenation Appeared in Succession in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- In the new era of rural rejuvenation unfolded by the Workers' Party of Korea, modern rural houses are being built throughout the DPRK.
More than 20 000 rural houses are under construction with different and peculiar shapes in 130 cities and counties this year. Among them many rural houses in Yokgudo-ri of Paechon County, Rajinpho-ri of Yonan County and Sinsaeng-ri of Chongdan County in South Hwanghae Province, Osongsan-ri of Kimhwa County in Kangwon Province, Rajin and Sonbong districts in Rason Municipality and Songrim City and Sungho County in North Hwanghae Province are nearing completion.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, with the will to turn all the rural villages across the country into rich and cultured socialist ideal villages, indicated the orientation and ways for realizing it at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea in December 2021.
In October 2024, he guided on the spot the rehabilitation of the flood-hit areas in Jagang Province and gave instructions on building rural houses peculiar to their regional features.
True to his intention, more than 500 designers from all provinces, cities and counties came to Pyongyang and are conducting the architectural designs at the final stage.
The agricultural workers are full of belief in the Party's programme for the rural revolution and optimism about the future, witnessing dwelling houses which are under construction in good harmony with the surrounding environment of relevant areas, while preserving their peculiar characteristics and taste in all cities, counties and villages.
Proud entities of rural rejuvenation are rising one after another in different parts of the country, following the above-said cities and counties where housing construction is nearing inauguration. -0-

story_text:

The builders removed over 60 000 cubic meters of earth in a short span of time and mainly completed the construction of tens of kilometers of road.
While conducting frontline-style political work, the division commanding team pushed ahead with the work for expanding the width of roads and ensuring their flatness by giving precedence to the supply of materials and increasing the operation rate of construction equipment.
Soldier-builders made leaps forward and innovations in the vanguard of the road project.
The civilian construction units, too, brought about collective innovations, following the working spirit and manner of the service personnel. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement titled "The U.S. should stop offending the DPRK with unnecessary and inefficient malicious provocations" on Friday:
Recently, the U.S. Department of State committed a political provocation of re-designating the DPRK as an "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" under the pretext of not joining in its "anti-terrorist efforts."

headline: Collective Innovation Movement Waged by Young People in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Young people across the DPRK are kindling the flames of increased production through revolutionary mass movements.
Young smelters at the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex are conducting the socialist emulation among workshops and shifts to turn out more tons of molten iron. They raised their production results by introducing effective and rational furnace operation method suited to the technical indices of fuel.
Young people at the Chollima Steel Complex are making innovations while conducting a mass technological innovation movement to increase output while saving fuel and raw materials.
Those at the Munchon Coal Mine of the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex conducted a campaign to do good deeds after the shift work to collect tens of tons of coal, and those at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex waged shock brigade activities to finish the difficult carrying work, thus contributing to the fulfillment of the production plan.
Members of the youth league of the Hyon-ri Stockbreeding Farm in Sepho County, Kangwon Province secured hundreds of tons of self-sufficient manure through a collective innovation movement.
The feats performed by young people from across the country including those of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory who are achieving successes in the production of various kinds of farm machine parts are recorded as valuable patriotic deeds on the road of advance for the country's prosperity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Flying Group of Guards 1st Air Wing of Korean People’s Army and Guides Drills
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited a flying group of the Guards 1st Air Wing of the Korean People’s Army and guided anti-air combat and air raid drills of flying corps of the Air Force on May 15.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, Jo Chun Ryong and Kim Jong Sik, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, Ri Pyong Chol, general advisor for the munitions policy of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences.
He was greeted by Air Chief Marshal Kim Kwang Hyok, commander of the KPA Air Force, and air wing commanders of the Air Force.
After hearing the report on the results of the agreement between clients and producers on the development of air weapons and equipment and the long-term plan, he clarified the view of the Party Central Committee as regards the development of the new-generation air assault and anti-air weapon systems of a high level, and advanced important tasks for its realization.
He mounted the observation post at the flight control station, and guided the anti-air combat and air raid drills of the flying corps of the Air Force.
The drills were aimed at making the flying corps, anti-air missile sub-units, radar sub-units and electronic warfare sub-units experienced in the anti-air mission to detect, track and destroy the enemy cruise missiles and suicidal drones attacking from different directions and in the combat mission to make the enemy drones blind and destroy them with different electronic means.
There also took place an application test of new-type long-range precision guided glide bomb and a drill of flying corps’ raid on targets.
In performing the anti-air defence tactical mission to detect, track and destroy enemy cruise missiles and suicidal drones attacking from different directions, the anti-air missile sub-units and detection and electronic warfare sub-units carried out only the task of detecting and tracking air targets and the flying corps, while performing guard flight mission in the air duty area as in an actual war environment, detected, tracked and destroyed the attacking air targets.
The drills proved the anti-air defence capabilities of the groups of the Guards 1st Air Wing.
Saying that it is very important to judge the abilities of the anti-air units for carrying out their missions in actual war and take necessary measures,Kim Jong Unstressed that such drills as today’s are very useful for making pilots experienced in modern air combat methods.
Expressing the view of the Party Central Committee on the theoretical and practical issues arising in further enhancing the combat effectiveness of the state anti-air defence systems, he set forth important tasks for the orientation of the development of air weapon systems, anti-air defence means, integrated detection and electronic warfare system and integrated anti-drone system.
The flying corps of the Guards 1st Air Wing, which perfectly carried out their anti-air tactical mission, made zero-feet flight over the observation post to pay the highest tribute toKim Jong Un, who has remarkably developed the KPA into an ever-victorious revolutionary army for the security of the state and the well-being of the people with his outstanding military ideas, far-sighted military wisdom and energetic leadership.
Kim Jong Unacknowledged the flying corps and expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the pilots proved the combat reliability of the KPA Air Force with practical manoeuvrings and set an excellent example in rounding off the war preparations.
There took place a drill of destroying enemy drones with helicopter and flying corps’ precision bombing of naval targets, followed by a demonstration flight of strategic reconnaissance drones and multi-mission drones.
Saying that victory in war is decided first on the training ground and that when all the service personnel devote themselves to combat and political training with the noble sense of mission of defending the country and the revolution, the sky, land and sea of our sacred country will be further consolidated as an impregnable fortress no enemy would dare attack, he called upon all the units of the entire army to bring about a radical turn in making preparations for war in constant readiness while remaining on full alert.
He met the pilots who took part in the drills, highly praised them for fully demonstrating their combat capability that deserves trust and confidence of the country and the people, and gave thanks to the commanding officers of the Air Force and the pilots.
Expressing belief that all the officers and men of the Air Force will reliably defend the security of the territorial airspace of our state and the safety of its people with matchless bravery and a heroic fighting spirit in the future, too, he had a photo taken with them.
The service personnel of the Air Force, who won the great trust ofKim Jong Un, pledged to fully consolidate their air operations combat capability under the slogan "We only wait for the Party’s order to make a sortie!" and thus fulfill their honourable mission as the army of lifeguards of the Party Central Committee and the first death-defying corps for defending the revolution. -0-

headline: Seventh Conference of Training Officers of Korean People's Army Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Amid the invincible prestige of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK being fully demonstrated in firmly defending the national sovereignty and well-being of the people with arms and powerfully promoting the comprehensive rejuvenation and development in the vanguard of the sacred struggle for defending the ideology and cause of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Seventh Conference of the Training Officers of the Korean People's Army took place in the capital city of Pyongyang on May 14 and 15.
The conference, the seventh in the history of building the Juche-oriented army, is of weighty significance in accelerating the qualitative change of the armed forces of the DPRK by possessing the overwhelming capability for countering a war and thoroughly keeping full war posture capable of smashing at a stroke the reckless war hysteria of hostile countries and the undisguised act of aggravating the tension by kindling further fiercely the flames of effecting a revolution in training throughout the entire army.
The conference analyzed and reviewed the successes and experience gained in the training sector of the People's Army over the past seven years since the Sixth Conference of Active Training Officers of the Korean People's Army. And it discussed the tasks and practical ways for consolidating the training front as a strong fulcrum firmly guaranteeing the mightiness and invincibility of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK and a reliable fortress for training the elite army, and for highly improving the actual war capability of all units and sub-units.
Present there were the training officers of the armed forces of the Republic, commanding officers of military and political organs, officers of military educational institutions at all levels and officials concerned.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, leading commanding officers of military and political organs and exemplary training officers took the platform.
Ri Yong Gil made a report at the conference.
The reporter said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unhas put forward the strengthening of training as a vital issue decisive of the destiny of the revolution and the success in the building of the revolutionary armed forces and energetically led the entire army to bolster up the strongest combat capability in every way in the flames of effecting the revolution in training.
Kim Jong Unset forth the five-point policy for effecting a revolution in training, the idea of opening up a new stage of developing the revolutionary armed forces with the strengthening of the KPA politically, ideologically and in military technique as the core goal of army building, the idea of holding fast to effecting a revolution in training and military education as the two fronts for building a powerful army, etc., he said, stressing thatKim Jong Un's important guidelines are the militant banner that the training sector should hold high in the struggle for powerfully promoting and accelerating the work for putting the People's Army on an elite and strong basis.
Kim Jong Unredoubled the militant enthusiasm of the soldiers and instilled great vitality into the training front through his ceaseless leadership to units, sub-units and training grounds, and attributed all the successes to the training officers, the reporter said, adding that his great loving care and trust serve as pabulum for making the officers and men of the entire army training heroes and future combat heroes.
The reporter referred to the great successes made in bolstering up the political and military might of the People's Army in the days of strengthening the actual war capability, holdingKim Jong Unin the vanguard of campaign for effecting a revolution in training.
The noble idea of the great brilliant commander that the ideological and moral superiority of the army means the qualitative superiority of the army has been thoroughly embodied in all training, the political and ideological strength of the army has been further consolidated as an invincible one and a scientific combat training system was established, and thus innovative changes have taken place in units and sub-units in possessing a perfect actual war capability to fight any time and win without fail if they fight, he said, adding:
Thanks to the tireless enthusiasm, militant spirit and unsparing devotion of the training officers who deeply cherished the trust of the Party which put forward them at the outpost of effecting a revolution in training, the training front is being consolidated and the militant might of the People's Army is further increased.
The proud successes made in the training sector are a precious fruition of the energetic leadership and boundless devotion ofKim Jong Unwho has firmly consolidated the training front with the unshakable will that the shortcut to making a strong army and victory in the revolutionary war relies on prioritizing training and intensifying training.
The report analyzed and reviewed the deviations to be surely corrected in the training sector.
The thorough and perfect implementation of the Party's line of building a powerful army in the new era aiming at the strongest military muscle and the victory in the future revolutionary war are firmly guaranteed by successfully effecting a revolution in training, the reporter said, calling upon all the officers in the training sector to strive for firmly consolidating the invincible combat capability and ever-victorious might of the People's Army in hearty response to the Party's policy of giving priority to training.
Then followed by speeches.
Introduced at the speeches were successes and experience gained in the course of firmly preparing the commanding officers and soldiers to be the strongest in mental power pulsating with the indomitable spirit, matchless bravery and mettle of anti-Japanese war generals, stalwart fighters possessed of high combat spirit and perfect military temperament and the spearhead of the elite revolutionary armed forces that make enemies shudder by putting primary efforts into spiritual arming true to the unique military idea ofKim Jong Unwho stipulated ideology as one of three major elements of armed forces together with soldiers and weapons, and turning all training into practical actual war drills centred on accomplishment of combat missions which have been brought closer to the war.
Mentioned in speeches were a series of deviations and lessons training officers revealed in their work as they failed to be deeply aware of the Party's intention that innovation in the training sector begins with a change in the level and qualifications of the training officers who are directly responsible for it and the preparedness of the training officers is the actual war capability of the army.
The speakers expressed their firm determination to possess the practical qualifications and ability to lead a new innovation and development of the training sector and put the training front on a high level as early as possible in conformity with the Party's military strategic plan and the requirements of modern warfare by deeply bearing in mind their important mission who hold a vanguard position and key role in effecting a revolution in training, and thus firmly prepare all the officers and men to be the strongest in mental strength and the brave fighters with indomitable revolutionary faith, heroic combat spirit and transparent outlook on war.
The venue of the conference was full of extraordinary determination and militant enthusiasm of all the participants to hold fast toKim Jong Un's idea of attaching importance to training and the Juche-oriented military training tactics as the lifeline and make more vigorous efforts to effect a revolution in training to prepare the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK to be invincible strong army in conformity with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern warfare.
The conference was followed by a ceremony of awarding Party and state commendations to the meritorious officers in strengthening training.
Jong Kyong Thaek read out a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK.
The venue of the awarding ceremony was full of boundless gratitude and pledge of loyalty towardsKim Jong Unwho understands the unknown efforts of the training officers devoting all their life to the sacred road for implementing the Party's policy on effecting a revolution in training and puts them on the high platform of honor.
The Seventh Conference of the Training Officers of the Korean People's Army marked a significant occasion in setting a new milestone in further strengthening the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK into the ever-victorious elite ranks equipped with perfect capability to fight a war and the world's strongest revolutionary army ofKim Jong Unby thoroughly establishing a scientific combat training system in the entire army in keeping with the developing trend of the new century and bringing about a radical leap forward and fundamental change in rounding off the combat preparations. -0-
