headline: Japan's Move of Turning Archipelago into Huge Powder Magazine is Suicidal Act of Dashing toward Second Defeat
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Kim Ryo Won, an international security analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article "Japan's move of turning the archipelago into a huge powder magazine is a suicidal act of dashing toward the second defeat":
Recently, the military buildup of Japan, a war criminal state, has entered a grave phase day by day amid the frequent geopolitical crises of raising concerns about the outbreak of a new great war in the world.
According to media, Japan is planning to conduct a test-fire of a ship-based electromagnetic gun, an ultra-modern weapon system that continuously launches shells at hypersonic speed by using electromagnetic power, in the near future.
Japan, which started the developing of the electromagnetic gun in 2016, conducted the world's first test-fire of ship-based weapon with a small prototype in 2023 and is going to conduct the test-fire with a prototype for actual war this time.
Japan is making self-estimation that the electromagnetic gun is a "game changer in the battlefield", saying that it is effective both in making an attack on targets on the ground and in the sea and air and in missile defense. At the same time, Japan is openly revealing its military confrontational attempt to use the electromagnetic gun to intercept supersonic weapons of the DPRK and the neighboring countries in the future.
The appearance of electromagnetic gun, which will be positioned as one of the core means of attack under the guise of "defense", clearly shows that Japan is turning the archipelago into an exhibition venue for various kinds of missiles and a test ground for ultra-modern weapons while getting more undisguised in its attempt at preemptive attack than ever before.
Japan has informally arranged the time and place of deployment of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missile with a range of about 1 000 km and high-speed gliding projectile, a hypersonic weapon, which have already passed through the test-fire stage, and is stepping up the development of a new-type ballistic missile with a range extending 3 000 km and a ground-launched long-range precision guided missile.
On the other hand, it has completed the plan for forming the surface-to-sea missile unit of the ground "Self-Defense Force" and is trying to openly conduct missile launching drill in Hokkaido, the doorstep of the neighboring countries, in the coming June breaking the precedent of conducting it outside the archipelago due to the principle of "exclusive defense".
It is also trying to introduce medium-range air-to-air missiles, air-to-surface long-range cruise missiles and Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles from the U.S. and deploy them for actual war and, not content with this, to jointly produce medium-range air-to-air missile AIM-120 with the U.S.
Japan is hell-bent on developing new-type ultra-modern offensive weapons such as electromagnetic guns as well as the possession of long-range strike means. This is aimed at enhancing and expanding the utility of preemptive attack directly targeting the DPRK and the neighboring countries and thus realizing at any cost the old ambition of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", which has not been achieved, by plunging into a new war of aggression at any time.
Depending on who holds the sword, its character and mission will radically change into a treasured sword for defending peace or into a weapon for aggression.
It is as clear as noonday what disastrous catastrophe will be brought about on this planet if the weapons of mass destruction fall again into the hands of Japan, a war criminal state which stained the vast Asia-Pacific region with blood and inflicted an indescribable war disaster on mankind in the last century.
The Japanese defense chief recently proposed to the U.S. Secretary of Defense an extremely dangerous initiative that Japan, the U.S., Australia, the Philippines and the ROK should strengthen military nexus, regarding the area centered on the East Sea and South Sea of China and the Korean peninsula as "a theater of war." This makes it easy to sense Japan's sinister aggressive attempt to launch reinvasion by creating military imbalance and a new conflicting structure in the region.
Various kinds of military moves of Japan to revive the vicious "great Japanese empire" free from the political and military fetters of the defeated nation by taking advantage of the trend of change in the global geopolitical structure while advocating the "severe surrounding security environment" urgently demand that the DPRK fully stockpile the stronger overwhelming power to deter it.
The reckless military buildup of Japan, a war criminal state, to make a preemptive attack on nuclear weapons states while turning the archipelago into a huge powder magazine will be a suicidal act of dashing toward the second defeat. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Devotion to Providing People with Enough Fish
story_text:
One day in March 2015, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a fish meal fodder factory newly built by the People's Army.
After looking round various places of the factory, he stopped in front of a building and asked if it is a refrigerating chamber and suggested an official to look at it.
The embarrassed official expressed his wish not to look round the fishy refrigerating chamber.
But the respected General Secretary repeatedly asked him to see how many fish there were in the refrigerating chamber of the fish meal fodder factory.
The official could not but open the door of the refrigerating chamber and told the respected General Secretary that there was nothing to show in it.
Then the respected General Secretary went into the refrigerating chamber, saying with a smile that those who did not like the fragrance of the sea should not be followed.
The chamber was scented with fishiness, but the General Secretary, as if it were satisfactory, said that he was pleased to smell fishiness at the fish meal fodder factory and that he would like to smell fishiness all day long if he can provide the service personnel and people with enough fish.
Looking up to the respected General Secretary, who is making ceaseless devotion and efforts for the people, officials pledged to uphold his noble intention in the vanguard. -0-

He was greeted by Air Chief Marshal Kim Kwang Hyok, commander of the KPA Air Force, and divisional commanders of the Air Force units.
After hearing the report on the results of the agreement between consumers and producers on the development of air weapons and equipment and its long-term plan, he clarified the viewpoint of the Party Central Committee as regards the development of the new generation aerial assault and air defence weapons system of high level and indicated important tasks for its realization.
Kim Jong Unmounted the observation post at the flight control station and guided the anti-air combat and air raid drills of flying corps of the Air Force.
The drills were aimed at making the flying corps, anti-air missile sub-units, radar sub-units and electronic warfare sub-units experienced in the air defence mission to detect, track and destroy the enemy cruise missiles and suicide drones coming from different directions and the combat mission to blind and destroy the enemy drones with different electronic means.
There also took place an application test of new-type long-range precision glide guided bomb and a drill of flying corps' attack on targets.
In the air defence tactical mission to detect, track and destroy enemy cruise missiles and suicide drones coming from different directions, anti-aircraft missile sub-units and detection and electronic warfare sub-units performed only the task of detecting and tracking air targets and the frying corps detected, tracked and destroyed attacking air target while performing guard flight mission in the air duty area as in the actual war environment.
The drill proved the air defence capabilities of the groups under the Guards 1st Air Division.
Saying that it is very important to judge the ability of the air defence units to carry out their missions in actual war and take necessary measures,Kim Jong Unstressed that such training as today is a very useful drill for making pilots experienced in modern air combat methods.
Expressing the view of the Party Central Committee on the theoretical and practical issues arising in further enhancing the combat effectiveness of the state air defense systems, he set forth important tasks for the orientation of the development of air weapon systems, air defense means, detection and electronic warfare integrated system and anti-drone integrated system.
The flying corps under the Guards 1st Air Division, which perfectly carried out their anti-aircraft tactical mission, made zero feet flight over the observation post to pay the highest tribute toKim Jong Unwho remarkably developed the KPA into an ever-victorious revolutionary army for the security of the state and the well-being of the people with his outstanding military idea, far-sighted military wisdom and energetic leadership.
Kim Jong Unacknowledged the flying corps and expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the pilots proved the combat reliability of the KPA Air Force in practical action and set an excellent example in rounding off the war preparations.
There took place a drill of destroying enemy drones with helicopter and flying corps' precision bombing of naval targets.
Then there was demonstration flight of strategic reconnaissance drones and multi-purpose drones.
Saying that the victory in the war is decided from the training ground and the sky, land and sea of the inviolable country will be further consolidated as an impregnable fortress no enemy dares provoke when all the service personnel devote themselves to combat and political training with the noble sense of mission of defending the country and the revolution, he called upon all the units of the entire army to bring about a radical turn in the preparations for war in constant war posture while keeping highly alert.
He met the pilots who took part in the drill and highly praised them for fully demonstrating their combat capability that can enjoy trust and confidence of the country and people and gave thanks to the commanding officers of the Air Force and the pilots.
Expressing belief that all the officers and men of the Air Force would reliably defend the security of the territorial air of the DPRK and the safety of its people with the matchless bravery and heroic fighting spirit in the future, too, he had a photo session with them.
The service personnel of the Air Force, who won the deep trust ofKim Jong Un, pledged to fully consolidate their air operation combat capability under the slogan "We only wait for the Party's order to make sortie!" and thus fulfill their honourable mission as the army of lifeguards of the Party Central Committee and the first death-defying corps for defending the revolution. -0-

headline: Entities of Rural Rejuvenation Appeared in Succession in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- In the new era of rural rejuvenation unfolded by the Workers' Party of Korea, modern rural houses are being built throughout the DPRK.
More than 20 000 rural houses are under construction with different and peculiar shapes in 130 cities and counties this year. Among them many rural houses in Yokgudo-ri of Paechon County, Rajinpho-ri of Yonan County and Sinsaeng-ri of Chongdan County in South Hwanghae Province, Osongsan-ri of Kimhwa County in Kangwon Province, Rajin and Sonbong districts in Rason Municipality and Songrim City and Sungho County in North Hwanghae Province are nearing completion.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, with the will to turn all the rural villages across the country into rich and cultured socialist ideal villages, indicated the orientation and ways for realizing it at the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea in December 2021.

True to his intention, more than 500 designers from all provinces, cities and counties came to Pyongyang and are conducting the architectural designs at the final stage.
The agricultural workers are full of belief in the Party's programme for the rural revolution and optimism about the future, witnessing dwelling houses which are under construction in good harmony with the surrounding environment of relevant areas, while preserving their peculiar characteristics and taste in all cities, counties and villages.
Proud entities of rural rejuvenation are rising one after another in different parts of the country, following the above-said cities and counties where housing construction is nearing inauguration. -0-

headline: Japan's Move of Turning Archipelago into Huge Powder Magazine is Suicidal Act of Dashing toward Second Defeat
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Kim Ryo Won, an international security analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article "Japan's move of turning the archipelago into a huge powder magazine is a suicidal act of dashing toward the second defeat":
Recently, the military buildup of Japan, a war criminal state, has entered a grave phase day by day amid the frequent geopolitical crises of raising concerns about the outbreak of a new great war in the world.
According to media, Japan is planning to conduct a test-fire of a ship-based electromagnetic gun, an ultra-modern weapon system that continuously launches shells at hypersonic speed by using electromagnetic power, in the near future.
Japan, which started the developing of the electromagnetic gun in 2016, conducted the world's first test-fire of ship-based weapon with a small prototype in 2023 and is going to conduct the test-fire with a prototype for actual war this time.
Japan is making self-estimation that the electromagnetic gun is a "game changer in the battlefield", saying that it is effective both in making an attack on targets on the ground and in the sea and air and in missile defense. At the same time, Japan is openly revealing its military confrontational attempt to use the electromagnetic gun to intercept supersonic weapons of the DPRK and the neighboring countries in the future.
The appearance of electromagnetic gun, which will be positioned as one of the core means of attack under the guise of "defense", clearly shows that Japan is turning the archipelago into an exhibition venue for various kinds of missiles and a test ground for ultra-modern weapons while getting more undisguised in its attempt at preemptive attack than ever before.
Japan has informally arranged the time and place of deployment of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missile with a range of about 1 000 km and high-speed gliding projectile, a hypersonic weapon, which have already passed through the test-fire stage, and is stepping up the development of a new-type ballistic missile with a range extending 3 000 km and a ground-launched long-range precision guided missile.
On the other hand, it has completed the plan for forming the surface-to-sea missile unit of the ground "Self-Defense Force" and is trying to openly conduct missile launching drill in Hokkaido, the doorstep of the neighboring countries, in the coming June breaking the precedent of conducting it outside the archipelago due to the principle of "exclusive defense".
It is also trying to introduce medium-range air-to-air missiles, air-to-surface long-range cruise missiles and Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles from the U.S. and deploy them for actual war and, not content with this, to jointly produce medium-range air-to-air missile AIM-120 with the U.S.
Japan is hell-bent on developing new-type ultra-modern offensive weapons such as electromagnetic guns as well as the possession of long-range strike means. This is aimed at enhancing and expanding the utility of preemptive attack directly targeting the DPRK and the neighboring countries and thus realizing at any cost the old ambition of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", which has not been achieved, by plunging into a new war of aggression at any time.
Depending on who holds the sword, its character and mission will radically change into a treasured sword for defending peace or into a weapon for aggression.
It is as clear as noonday what disastrous catastrophe will be brought about on this planet if the weapons of mass destruction fall again into the hands of Japan, a war criminal state which stained the vast Asia-Pacific region with blood and inflicted an indescribable war disaster on mankind in the last century.
The Japanese defense chief recently proposed to the U.S. Secretary of Defense an extremely dangerous initiative that Japan, the U.S., Australia, the Philippines and the ROK should strengthen military nexus, regarding the area centered on the East Sea and South Sea of China and the Korean peninsula as "a theater of war." This makes it easy to sense Japan's sinister aggressive attempt to launch reinvasion by creating military imbalance and a new conflicting structure in the region.
Various kinds of military moves of Japan to revive the vicious "great Japanese empire" free from the political and military fetters of the defeated nation by taking advantage of the trend of change in the global geopolitical structure while advocating the "severe surrounding security environment" urgently demand that the DPRK fully stockpile the stronger overwhelming power to deter it.
The reckless military buildup of Japan, a war criminal state, to make a preemptive attack on nuclear weapons states while turning the archipelago into a huge powder magazine will be a suicidal act of dashing toward the second defeat. -0-

headline: Seventh Conference of Training Officers of Korean People's Army Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Amid the invincible prestige of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK being fully demonstrated in firmly defending the national sovereignty and well-being of the people with arms and powerfully promoting the comprehensive rejuvenation and development in the vanguard of the sacred struggle for defending the ideology and cause of the Workers' Party of Korea, the Seventh Conference of the Training Officers of the Korean People's Army took place in the capital city of Pyongyang on May 14 and 15.
The conference, the seventh in the history of building the Juche-oriented army, is of weighty significance in accelerating the qualitative change of the armed forces of the DPRK by possessing the overwhelming capability for countering a war and thoroughly keeping full war posture capable of smashing at a stroke the reckless war hysteria of hostile countries and the undisguised act of aggravating the tension by kindling further fiercely the flames of effecting a revolution in training throughout the entire army.
The conference analyzed and reviewed the successes and experience gained in the training sector of the People's Army over the past seven years since the Sixth Conference of Active Training Officers of the Korean People's Army. And it discussed the tasks and practical ways for consolidating the training front as a strong fulcrum firmly guaranteeing the mightiness and invincibility of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK and a reliable fortress for training the elite army, and for highly improving the actual war capability of all units and sub-units.
Present there were the training officers of the armed forces of the Republic, commanding officers of military and political organs, officers of military educational institutions at all levels and officials concerned.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, leading commanding officers of military and political organs and exemplary training officers took the platform.
Ri Yong Gil made a report at the conference.
The reporter said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unhas put forward the strengthening of training as a vital issue decisive of the destiny of the revolution and the success in the building of the revolutionary armed forces and energetically led the entire army to bolster up the strongest combat capability in every way in the flames of effecting the revolution in training.
Kim Jong Unset forth the five-point policy for effecting a revolution in training, the idea of opening up a new stage of developing the revolutionary armed forces with the strengthening of the KPA politically, ideologically and in military technique as the core goal of army building, the idea of holding fast to effecting a revolution in training and military education as the two fronts for building a powerful army, etc., he said, stressing thatKim Jong Un's important guidelines are the militant banner that the training sector should hold high in the struggle for powerfully promoting and accelerating the work for putting the People's Army on an elite and strong basis.
Kim Jong Unredoubled the militant enthusiasm of the soldiers and instilled great vitality into the training front through his ceaseless leadership to units, sub-units and training grounds, and attributed all the successes to the training officers, the reporter said, adding that his great loving care and trust serve as pabulum for making the officers and men of the entire army training heroes and future combat heroes.
The reporter referred to the great successes made in bolstering up the political and military might of the People's Army in the days of strengthening the actual war capability, holdingKim Jong Unin the vanguard of campaign for effecting a revolution in training.
The noble idea of the great brilliant commander that the ideological and moral superiority of the army means the qualitative superiority of the army has been thoroughly embodied in all training, the political and ideological strength of the army has been further consolidated as an invincible one and a scientific combat training system was established, and thus innovative changes have taken place in units and sub-units in possessing a perfect actual war capability to fight any time and win without fail if they fight, he said, adding:
Thanks to the tireless enthusiasm, militant spirit and unsparing devotion of the training officers who deeply cherished the trust of the Party which put forward them at the outpost of effecting a revolution in training, the training front is being consolidated and the militant might of the People's Army is further increased.
The proud successes made in the training sector are a precious fruition of the energetic leadership and boundless devotion ofKim Jong Unwho has firmly consolidated the training front with the unshakable will that the shortcut to making a strong army and victory in the revolutionary war relies on prioritizing training and intensifying training.
The report analyzed and reviewed the deviations to be surely corrected in the training sector.
The thorough and perfect implementation of the Party's line of building a powerful army in the new era aiming at the strongest military muscle and the victory in the future revolutionary war are firmly guaranteed by successfully effecting a revolution in training, the reporter said, calling upon all the officers in the training sector to strive for firmly consolidating the invincible combat capability and ever-victorious might of the People's Army in hearty response to the Party's policy of giving priority to training.
Then followed by speeches.
Introduced at the speeches were successes and experience gained in the course of firmly preparing the commanding officers and soldiers to be the strongest in mental power pulsating with the indomitable spirit, matchless bravery and mettle of anti-Japanese war generals, stalwart fighters possessed of high combat spirit and perfect military temperament and the spearhead of the elite revolutionary armed forces that make enemies shudder by putting primary efforts into spiritual arming true to the unique military idea ofKim Jong Unwho stipulated ideology as one of three major elements of armed forces together with soldiers and weapons, and turning all training into practical actual war drills centred on accomplishment of combat missions which have been brought closer to the war.
Mentioned in speeches were a series of deviations and lessons training officers revealed in their work as they failed to be deeply aware of the Party's intention that innovation in the training sector begins with a change in the level and qualifications of the training officers who are directly responsible for it and the preparedness of the training officers is the actual war capability of the army.
The speakers expressed their firm determination to possess the practical qualifications and ability to lead a new innovation and development of the training sector and put the training front on a high level as early as possible in conformity with the Party's military strategic plan and the requirements of modern warfare by deeply bearing in mind their important mission who hold a vanguard position and key role in effecting a revolution in training, and thus firmly prepare all the officers and men to be the strongest in mental strength and the brave fighters with indomitable revolutionary faith, heroic combat spirit and transparent outlook on war.
The venue of the conference was full of extraordinary determination and militant enthusiasm of all the participants to hold fast toKim Jong Un's idea of attaching importance to training and the Juche-oriented military training tactics as the lifeline and make more vigorous efforts to effect a revolution in training to prepare the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK to be invincible strong army in conformity with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern warfare.
The conference was followed by a ceremony of awarding Party and state commendations to the meritorious officers in strengthening training.
Jong Kyong Thaek read out a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK.
The venue of the awarding ceremony was full of boundless gratitude and pledge of loyalty towardsKim Jong Unwho understands the unknown efforts of the training officers devoting all their life to the sacred road for implementing the Party's policy on effecting a revolution in training and puts them on the high platform of honor.
The Seventh Conference of the Training Officers of the Korean People's Army marked a significant occasion in setting a new milestone in further strengthening the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK into the ever-victorious elite ranks equipped with perfect capability to fight a war and the world's strongest revolutionary army ofKim Jong Unby thoroughly establishing a scientific combat training system in the entire army in keeping with the developing trend of the new century and bringing about a radical leap forward and fundamental change in rounding off the combat preparations. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement titled "The U.S. should stop offending the DPRK with unnecessary and inefficient malicious provocations" on Friday:
Recently, the U.S. Department of State committed a political provocation of re-designating the DPRK as an "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" under the pretext of not joining in its "anti-terrorist efforts."
Such unilateral and malicious designating campaign staged by the U.S. every year should be duly denounced and rejected by the international community as it is a smear stratagem to brand the independent sovereign states as "state sponsor of terrorism" and make them targets of international criticism.
The "anti-terrorism" advocated by the U.S. is nothing but an excuse to justify interference in internal affairs of other countries and the overthrow of their social systems and in fact, the countries designated by the U.S. as "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" are becoming the main targets of the U.S. hostile policy and military threat, the expression of the most heinous state-sponsored terrorism.
No one has asked the U.S. to lead international anti-terrorist efforts, nor has anyone invested it with such power.

This proves that the U.S. illegal and unjust hostile acts against the DPRK and other sovereign states are the most serious political violence as well as state-level terrorism.
It is the consistent stand of the DPRK to resolutely oppose all forms of terrorism threatening international peace and security, but the so-called "anti-terrorist efforts" of the U.S., recognized as a synonym for interference in internal affairs and acts of aggression against independent countries, are irrelevant to the DPRK's will against terrorism.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri to Mark Third Anniversary of Demise of Hyon Chol Hae
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri on May 18 on the occasion of the third anniversary of demise of Hyon Chol Hae who was a prominent military and political activist of our state.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlaid a flower at the grave of Hyon Chol Hae, recalling the revolutionary comrade-in-arms who devoted himself to the glorious struggle for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche with genuine communist traits, noble human touch, ability through wide information and extensive knowledge and implacable power of execution.
He paid a silent tribute to the memory of Hyon Chol Hae, a true son of the DPRK and a model of steadfast revolutionaries and patriots.
Recalling Comrade Hyon Chol Hae, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid:
"Still vivid in my memory is Comrade Hyon Chol Hae, who was always with GeneralKim Jong Il. He was a shadow of the great General. He remains in all our memories as a model military and political official, highly principled and distinctive in political abilities and organizing skills, and as a paragon of a true person, always free and easy, unaffected, steadfast and upright. He will live forever in our minds, always reminding us of the era ofKim Jong Iland encouraging us in our sacred struggle for a great victory."
He hoped the noble spirit and distinguished exploits of Hyon Chol Hae, who remained loyal to the Party and the revolution all his life, would shine forever on the platform of the highest honor and dignity.
He paid high tribute to the martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the eternal prosperity and future of the country before the monument to martyrs at the cemetery. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- At the foot of picturesque Mt Taesong in Pyongyang there are the Natural History Museum and the Central Zoo where the DPRK people have frequented.
The Natural History Museum, which is a scientific knowledge dissemination base for giving comprehensive knowledge of the history of the earth, origin of life, animals and plants and other organisms, and the Central Zoo, which has many animal sheds including wild beast den, monkey shed and elephant shed, are bases for education and cultural and emotional life of the working people, youth and students.
They are associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho always pays deep attention to the cultural and emotional life of the people.
Kim Jong Unpersonally initiated the construction of the Natural History Museum and unfolded a plan to turn the Central Zoo into a world-wide zoo. He visited the construction sites of the museum and zoo nearing completion on one day in May 2016.
Going round various places of the wonderfully built museum, he said with great pleasure that another peculiar educational base, cultural recreation place for our people, youth and students has been built.
He visited the zoo built in a modern way in harmony with the surrounding scenery and expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the visitors could come to the zoo and spend pleasant time irrespective of a season, giving precious instructions on the preparations for the management and operation of the museum and the zoo.
Now the Natural History Museum and the Central Zoo built under his noble loving care are full of happy laughter of working people in various circles, youth and students enjoying cultural and emotional life to their heart's content. -0-

headline: Mirae Scientists Street
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- Mirae Scientists Street is situated on the bank of the River Taedong in Pyongyang.
The street has various shapes of houses including a skyscraper with symbolic tower on the top of inimitable electron orbit-shaped roof and an apartment building depicting a sailboat, public buildings and service facilities.
The street was successfully built thanks to the warm love and meticulous guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho regards the scientists and educators as precious treasures of the country.
One day in May 2014 when he gave field guidance at the construction site of apartment houses for educators of Kim Chaek University of Technology,Kim Jong Ununfolded a grand plan to build a modern scientists street on the bank of the River Taedong and named the street to be newly built "Mirae Scientists Street".
Afterwards, he took a measure to reinforce the construction force and solved all problems arising in speeding up the project. He personally guided the construction of Mirae Scientists Street not only on the spot but also in the sky as a builder and operator.
Stressing the need to successfully build street into the one to be handed down to posterity for long, he said that all the structures should be built in a unique way so that they can be symbolic of the street of scientists while preserving their peculiar features and appearances.
When visiting the completed Mirae Scientists Street, he said with great satisfaction that teachers and researchers could move into new houses with only their hand luggage.
Now ordinary scientists and educators are leading a happy life at the houses like palace in Mirae Scientists Street that they received free of charge. -0-

headline: Chairwoman Learned to Write
story_text:
One day in May 1948, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Ungam-ri of Sungho-myon while giving field guidance at the then Kangdong County in South Phyongan Province.
After entering the office of the Ri People's Committee, being greeted by the chairman of the Ri People's Committee and the chairwoman of the women's union, the President saw the report of the women's union meeting on the desk and asked what issue they were going to discuss.
The chairman of the Ri People's Committee said that the meeting will be held on such issues as spinning thread and planting pumpkins at homes and so on.
At that time, the chairwoman of the women's union told the President that she could not do the work of the women's union as she is illiterate and that the report was written by someone else.
With a smile on his face, the President said that it would be all right if she learns to write and asked her to write her name.
Reading her mind embarrassed at failing to write her own name, he encouraged her saying that she can do the work of the women's union if she learns to write and that she should often write the names of the women's union members to make herself familiar with the letters and also write the report herself and practice reading it.
After learning about her family's living conditions, the President told the chairman of the Ri People's Union to help the chairwoman of the women's union so that she could do the union work well.
After receiving the instructions of the President, the chairwoman learned to write and worked hard to become the leading chairwoman of the women's union in the county. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors in North and South Hamgyong Provinces
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors in North and South Hamgyong provinces of the DPRK.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, he called on the officials, technicians and workers to perfectly complete the modernization project planned this year with a redoubled sense of responsibility and efforts, and to steadily strengthen the sci-tech force so as to properly process materials and successfully ensure the quality of the products in the production of custom-built equipment.
At the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the February 8 Vinalon Complex, he stressed the need to put the production of fertilizer and basic chemical products on a normal basis by taking proper measures for supplying raw materials and fuel. He also underlined the need to step up the construction of a base of producing slow effective fertilizer, and to further intensify the research on the fields of the application of melamine resin, which plays an important role in the development of the chemical industry, and thus to make a substantial contribution to agricultural production and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
Learning about the first-stage construction of the Tanchon Power Station, the premier called for accelerating full preparations for its inauguration, including the test run of electricity-generating equipment, and for paying deep attention to ensuring the working and living conditions of the builders.
At the Sangnong Mine, he underscored the need to give definite precedence to the capital tunneling and reinforce the transport system in order to mine more ore. And he also stressed that the smelting process should be further perfected.
At the Hamhung Wheat Processing Factory, he said that it should expand its wheat-processing capacity so as to provide the regional-industry factories with quality wheat flour.
Going round the refractory shop and other places of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the premier emphasized the need to improve the performance of the furnace by taking technical measures to decisively improve the quality of fireproof materials, and he stressed the importance of increasing the operation rate of equipment in order to unconditionally attain the goal of iron and steel production set forth by the Party.
At the Musan Mining Complex, he called on it to push ahead with the work to expand the capacity of the production of concentrated iron ore, including big blasting, in a planned way, and to accelerate the growth in production of the big base of the metallurgical industry by utilizing the existing production foundations.
The field consultative meetings underlined the need for officials to thoroughly establish the working style of pushing ahead with the development of their units with science and technology as a lifeline, and discussed the issue of scrupulously organizing alternated production and lowering the standard of electricity consumption. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Chongsan Co-op Farm Associated with Leadership Exploits of Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
It was early in the morning one day in May 1971.
An official of the then Chongsan Co-op Farm in Kangso County, South Phyongan Province, the DPRK, who had come out to a field to see its irrigation gate, happened to meet ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The Chairman grasped the hand of the official, who hesitated to introduce himself, appreciating his labor at dawn. Then the Chairman said that he came to see the Chongsan Plain and kindly asked the official if the preparations for rice-transplantation were ready.
After hearing his reply that rice-transplantation would begin a few days later, the Chairman stressed that Chongsan-ri should be an example in rice-transplantation throughout the whole country and walked on a footpath between rice paddies to look around the plain.
When the official said that the footpath was rough, the Chairman said that PresidentKim Il Sungused to walk on a footpath, adding that he wanted to walk on such footpath every day.
Walking along the route of field guidance of the President, he acquainted himself with the situation of the farm and said that he would visit the farm frequently in the future. And he repeatedly asked the official to be good at farm work and rural construction as desired by the President.
Like this, the Chairman gave precious instructions related to farm work, walking on a rough footpath between rice paddies early in the morning. -0-

headline: Soldier-builders Make Achievements in Construction of 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- Soldier-builders are demonstrating the spirit of the powerful revolutionary army at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area of the DPRK.
The soldier-builders of Ko Kwang Bok-led unit of the Korean People's Army completed the frame projects for two blocks with a total floor space of over 14 000 square meters within more than 70 days.
They are now putting spurs to carrying out the next-stage project. -0-

headline: Pothong River Improvement Project
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- 79 years have passed since the ceremony for starting the Pothong River improvement project was held in the liberated Korea under the wise leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Now the DPRK people are recollecting with deep emotion the immortal exploits of the President who led to brilliant victory the Pothong River improvement project, the first great transformation of nature after the liberation of Korea.
Before the liberation, the Pothong River was a synonym of disaster and symbol of misfortune that caused huge human and material losses as it overflowed its banks even though little rain fell.
The President, who initiated the Pothong River improvement project to put an end to the people's misfortunes owing to the Pothong River, personally broke ground first at the ceremony for starting the project on May 21, 1946.
The first shovel taken by the President at the Pothong River improvement project was a solemn prelude to the start of the great transformation of nature for the prosperity of the liberated country and the happiness of all generations.
That day, he said that our happiness should be discovered by our own efforts and achieved through struggle, expressing the belief that all Pyongyang citizens would overcome all difficulties and display great strength in the patriotic work for great transformation of nature.
True to the noble patriotic will of the peerlessly great man, the Korean people removed hundreds of thousands of cubic meters of earth with indomitable spiritual strength and worked a miracle that they finished the vast project within 55 days, 15 days earlier than its schedule.
With the completion of the project, the river water going round the Pothong plain flowed along the new waterway to the Taedong River and the bank of the Pothong River was turned into the one of paradise that is free from flood damage forever.
The completion of the Pothong River improvement project was a brilliant fruition of the ardent love of the President for the country and people, and the first victory won by the Korean people rallied close around their leader in the great transformation of nature for building a thriving nation. -0-

headline: Securing Sugar Materials Brisk in Hoeryong City and Unchon County in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- Hoeryong City in North Hamgyong Province and Unchon County in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are concentrating efforts on securing sugar materials.
Hoeryong City found areas favorable for the cultivation of sugar beets and took measures to increase the fertility of soil. headline: Biodiversity Protection Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 22 (KCNA) -- May 22 is the International Day for Biological Diversity.
As a signatory to the Convention on Biological Diversity, the DPRK is striving to protect and make sustainable use of biodiversity.
It has planned medium- and long-term projects for biodiversity protection and conducted activities based on them.
Through the national medium- and long-term green plans, it is working out and implementing the work for rationally combining biodiversity protection with sustainable economic development.
As scientific research into comprehensive harmful insect extermination technology has been intensified and national measures were taken, the work for preserving ecological environment and ensuring agricultural development and clean urban environment are being stepped up.
Meanwhile, it has pushed ahead with the work to regularly identify and conserve the species of animals and plants and their inhabitation conditions.
On the basis of confirming the priority regions of biodiversity, it has set up sanctuaries in the regions with rich biodiversity and selected rational ecological channels connecting major sanctuaries, thus actively conserving the species of animals and plants in the country.
It scientifically evaluates and analyzes the effects of gigantic nature-remaking project, including forest restoration and tideland reclamation, on biodiversity and takes sci-tech measures for its protection.
The seasonal and annual number of water-birds is being comprehensively estimated in wetlands and major migratory bird reserves on the east and west coasts of the DPRK.
Relevant scientific research units are pushing ahead with the work to update the lists of species and endangered species, thus laying a scientific foundation for protecting the biological resources of the country. -0-

headline: Large-capacity Greenhouses for Cultivating Rice Seedlings Built in Kangnam County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 22 (KCNA) -- Large-capacity greenhouses for growing rice seedlings were built in Kangnam County, Pyongyang. The county produces nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings, which can be transplanted in thousands of hectares of paddy fields, at greenhouses covering an area of 23 000 square meters.
It built a glass greenhouse covering an area of more than 4 600 square meters, 13 blocks of arch-style plastic sheet greenhouse covering an area of 1 400-square meters, a yard for fertile soil for seedbeds, production and apartment buildings, and formed several hectares of experimental fields around the greenhouses.
The labor- and plot-saving greenhouses, where the cultivation of rice seedlings have been put on a scientific, modern and IT basis, make it possible to reduce the area of seedbeds by one fifty-fourths and manpower by one seventeenths and require no materials for making seedbeds.
Agricultural officials and workers say as follows: The method of cultivating rice seedlings at the greenhouse is good. It is not affected by unfavorable weather conditions and there is no necessary for making rice seedbeds, a difficult process in rice farming, and for removing the young rice plants from the seedbeds. This method is very profitable as it is possible to shorten the period of striking root and increase the yield, as well as to cultivate greenhouse vegetables after rice-transplantation.
Based on the Workers' Party of Korea's strategic developing outlook on turning the agriculture of the country into the advanced agriculture with science and technology as the main motive force for agricultural development, and achieving stable and sustainable growth of agricultural production, nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings were bred to be introduced into nearly 60 percent of the paddy fields across the country this year. -0-

headline: Kumsong Tractor Factory
story_text:
One day in August 2023, the respected ComradeKim Jong Ungave field guidance at the Kumsong Tractor Factory.
After going round the production site for a long time paying attention to the issue of ensuring performance and quality of tractors, he went out to the compound.
Looking with pleasure at the newly-made tractors lined up in the factory compound, he said that he would like to drive the tractor produced at the Kumsong Tractor Factory.
Moments later, the engine of the tractor driven by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unstarted to make smooth sound.
After a while, the respected General Secretary stopped the tractor and said that he could feel the transmission and steering gear have become more smooth and easy as compared to the previous period as he drove the tractor. And he taught in detail the orientation and ways for improving the performance of the tractor referring to such issues as the height of the brake pedal and position of acceleration pedal and the strength of spring fixed in the driver's seat.
Looking up to the respected General Secretary who indicated the shortcomings and the ways for correcting them by personally driving the newly-made tractor to free the agricultural workers from hard labour at the earliest date possible, the officials of the factory confirmed their determination to uphold his noble intention with loyalty. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Launching Newly-Built Destroyer Takes Place
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 22 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of launching a newly-built 5 000-tonnage destroyer took place at the Chongjin Shipyard on May 21.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the ceremony.
A serious accident occurred in the course of the launch of the destroyer.
Due to the inexperienced command and operational carelessness in the course of the launch, the launch slide of the stern has departed first and stranded as the flatcar failed to move in parallel, some sections of the warship's bottom crushed to destroy the balance of the warship and the bow couldn't leave the shipway, leading to a serious accident.
After watching the whole course of the accident, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade stern assessment saying that it was a serious accident and criminal act caused by absolute carelessness, irresponsibility and unscientific empiricism which is out of the bounds of possibility and could not be tolerated.
He warned solemnly that the irresponsible errors of the relevant officials of the Munitions Industry Department of the WPK Central Committee, the Mechanical Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the central ship designing institute and other relevant units and the Chongjin Shipyard responsible for the accident that brought the dignity and self-respect of our state to a collapse in a moment would have to be dealt with at the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee to be convened next month and censured them for the fault.
He earnestly said that the immediate restoration of the destroyer is not merely a practical issue but a political issue directly related to the authority of the state and it should be completed unconditionally before the June Plenary Meeting of the WPK Central Committee, so as to make the ardent patriotic loyalty and labour devotion of the workers of the Chongjin Shipyard and the Rajin Shipyard bear fruitful as proud feats conducive to bolstering up the defence capabilities.
He gave important instructions on the work of the accident investigation group. -0-

headline: Warm Love Associated with Educational Aid Fund and Stipends for Children of Koreans in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unin April sent to the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) the educational aid fund and stipends for democratic national education of children of Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 113th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The educational aid fund and stipends, sent in 171 occasions so far, are the warm loving care for Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan constantly shown by PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor nearly 70 years.
One day in January 1957 the President asked an official concerned why there isn't an item of education aid fund and stipends for children of Koreans in Japan while guiding the meeting in which the draft state budget was discussed.
The item was a task which had already been given by the President.
Hearing the answer of the official to execute the item apart from the state budget due to the strained financial situation, the President instructed in a serious tone that we should send money to overseas compatriots suffering troubles in an alien land so as to get their children to study, though we fail to build a few factories.
And he also stressed the need to newly specify in the state budget the item "Educational aid fund and stipends for children of Koreans in Japan" and hold fast to it as a permanent undertaking.
Thanks to the loving care of the President the first educational aid fund and stipends were sent to the children of Koreans in Japan under Chongryon in April that year.
True to the noble intention of the President, ChairmanKim Jong Iltook all measures for sending in time the educational aid fund and stipends to the DPRK citizens in Japan and their children.
The history of benevolent love of the President and the Chairman for the educational aid fund and stipends is being carried forward by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The respected General Secretary said that he would do his best for dignified life and bright future of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan, adding that Koreans in Japan are his own flesh and blood with deep love though they live far from the homeland.
Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan who will greet the 70th anniversary of Chongryon (May 25, 1955) are full of enthusiasm to vigorously usher in a new era of prosperity of Chongryon by dint of eternal patriotism while singing the song of memories "Warm Love of Motherland". -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Korea Association for Human Rights Studies
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson of the Korea Association for Human Rights Studies issued the following press statement on May 23:
A plenary meeting was convened at the venue of the UN General Assembly on May 20 to discuss the "human rights issue" of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
At the meeting, the U.S., the ROK and other hostile forces committed a heinous politically-motivated provocation of viciously picking on the human rights situation in the DPRK by putting forward the quasi "human rights" plot-breeding organizations.
The Korean Association for Human Rights Studies bitterly denounces and rejects the plot to convene the meeting as a wanton contravention of the UN Charter and international law which stipulate respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs and a grave violation of the dignity and sovereignty of our state.
More than 80 years have passed since the UN was founded and 70-odd years have passed since the World Declaration of Human Rights was adopted. But the UN has never been openly used as an arena for confrontation, plot and fabrication by the specific forces seeking to overthrow the system of a sovereign state as today.
The fact that the meeting was convened on the basis of all sorts of lies and fabricated data cooked up by the "human rights" servants backed by the hostile states including the U.S. and the ROK to earn a dirty living fully proves its illegal and conspiratorial nature.
No matter how desperately the hostile forces may try to confuse right and wrong by mobilizing even a handful of human scum, the fair international community's appreciation can never be changed and the Korean people's confidence in the socialist system guaranteeing genuine human rights can never be undermined.
Is there any country in the world like the DPRK to legalize and make it rule to enforce policies for the well-being of the people and children including free medical care, free supply of houses, free education, school uniforms, school things and dairy products?
It is only the DPRK where the elderly, orphans and disabled people, who are called delicate strata of society, are living without any worries under the care of the state, and many flood victims who have lost their homes come to the capital city to receive special treatment.
It is the DPRK where the standard of human rights is enforced which is far exceeding the standards of the World Declaration of Human Rights and international human rights conventions specifying the rights to existence, education, development and other universal rights.
The international norms and order, which were enacted and have been desired for the just cause of respecting the sovereignty of each nation and defending global peace and security, are completely being collapsed due to the high-handed and reckless acts of the hegemonic forces. This present reality once again makes us keep in mind the immutable truth that the protection of the sovereignty and dignity of a state and the peace and wellbeing of the people are guaranteed only by the powerful strength capable of defending itself.
The malicious acts of some countries which blindly followed the hostile forces to slander the most popular and just social system of the DPRK will be thoroughly taken into account.
The protection of human rights precisely means the protection of the sovereign rights.
The DPRK will never overlook the heinous "human rights" smear campaign of the hostile forces totally denying the ideology and system of the dignified DPRK and inciting the overthrow of the state, but further put spurs to the exercise of its sovereign rights for defending the dignity of the state and the people and protecting the genuine human rights. -0-

After finishing the foundation project, the framework project is underway at the final stage.
The paper factory being built in Unsan County is a modern one which can not only contribute to satisfying the paper needs of students and people in the province but also produce quality paper products for different purposes by relying on regional raw materials.

headline: Investigation into Destroyer Launch Accident Intensified
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- An investigation group of the destroyer launch accident got down to a full-scale investigation into the serious accident occurred at the Chongjin Shipyard.
The accident investigation group included a public prosecutors organ and relevant experts.
Detailed underwater and internal inspection of the warship confirmed that, unlike the initial announcement, there were no holes made at the warship's bottom, the hull starboard was scratched and a certain amount of seawater flowed into the stern section through the rescue channel.
Experts estimated that it will take two or three days to keep the balance of the warship by pumping up the seawater from the flooded chamber and making the bow leave the slipway and 10-odd days to restore the warship's side.
The accident investigation group reported the relevant investigation content to the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea on May 22.
The Party Central Military Commission gave the following stand and instructions to the investigation group:
The extent of damage to the warship is not serious and the result of the flooding process immediately after the accident is only information necessary to take practical rehabilitation measures. The above-said data have no connection with the cause of the accident and the identification of its responsibility.
It is necessary to make clear the cause of the accident.
The Party Central Military Commission instructed the investigation group to investigate and expose the cause of the accident which should never occur and could not be tolerated and those responsible for it.
No matter how good the state of the warship is, the fact that the accident is an unpardonable criminal act remains unchanged, and those responsible for it can never evade their responsibility for the crime.
Regarding this accident as a serous matter is not because of the damage to the warship or economic loss. The aim of doing so is to deal a telling blow to incautiousness, irresponsibility and unscientific empiricist attitude prevailing in any field and to sound an alarm bell.
On the basis of the investigation data of the accident investigation group, the law-enforcement organ started to follow the procedure for first restraining and investigating those who are clearly responsible for the accident.
Hong Kil Ho, manager of the Chongjin Shipyard, was summoned to the law-enforcement organ on May 22. -0-

headline: Offensive in Musan Area Gives Confidence in National Liberation to Korean People
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- Eighty-six years have passed since PresidentKim Il Sungorganized and commanded the offensive in the Musan area during the anti-Japanese armed struggle.
In the late 1930s, the Japanese imperialists further intensified their offensive against the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and revolutionary organizations and made desperate efforts to blight the hope of the Korean people for national liberation by false propaganda that the revolutionary army was annihilated.
At that time, the President put forward the policy of continuing to strike powerful counterblows at the Japanese imperialist aggressors and advancing to the homeland at the Beidadingzi Meeting held in April 1939 in order to foil the false propaganda of the enemy, thus giving confidence in victory to the people and striking the enemy with fear of death.
The main force of the KPRA crossed the Amnok River and advanced to the homeland on May 18 along the route indicated by the President. Through Chongbong, Konchang and Begae Hill, the main force passed proudly in daylight the Kapsan-Musan guard road, which was specially paved by the enemy, with the tactics of marching a long distance at a step and arrived at Mupho on the bank of the Tuman River.
The President set forth the task of advancing to Taehongdan area at the Mupho Bivouac and made sure that military and political activities were conducted in the areas of Sinsadong and Singaechok. He decided to annihilate the pursuing enemies in the Taehongdan Plain finally.
On May 23, the KPRA main force completely wiped out the enemies that followed by stealth a unit coming back from Singaechok direction after carrying out its task and a reinforcement unit and victoriously concluded the offensive in the Musan area under the wise command of the President.
The offensive in the Musan area was a great one which demonstrated once again that the people struggling to realize the independence of the country and nation from the Juche-oriented standpoint, holding fast to arms, could defeat any formidable enemy.
It is shining brilliantly in the history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle as it marked a turning point which opened a new upsurge of the whole Korean revolution. -0-

headline: Preparations for Operating Sci-tech Learning Spaces of Leisure Complexes Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- Preparations for operating the sci-tech learning spaces of leisure complexes to be built in cities and counties of the DPRK are being pushed forward.
The field of science and technology has concluded the general design of an integrated information service system to be run at the sci-tech learning spaces of leisure complexes now under construction in cities and counties in contact with relevant sectors, including major sci-tech dissemination units and universities in Pyongyang.
The system helps conduct online lecture, symposium and extracurricular study including discussion about sister subjects.
It is also designed to hold various kinds of meetings including technical study, experience-sharing meeting, retraining and sci-tech examination of relevant cities and counties in the method of video-conferencing and conduct relay service for lectures and seminars held in Pyongyang and other regions.
At present, officials, scientists and technicians of various units taking part in the development of the system completed the development of dozens of subsystems and conducted the test interlock. On this basis, they are pushing ahead with all the work including the preparation of passing-on technique. -0-

headline: Investigation into Destroyer Launch Accident Intensified
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 23 (KCNA) -- An investigation group of the destroyer launch accident got down to a full-scale investigation into the serious accident occurred at the Chongjin Shipyard.
The accident investigation group included a public prosecutors organ and relevant experts.
Detailed underwater and internal inspection of the warship confirmed that, unlike the initial announcement, there were no holes made at the warship's bottom, the hull starboard was scratched and a certain amount of seawater flowed into the stern section through the rescue channel.
Experts estimated that it will take two or three days to keep the balance of the warship by pumping up the seawater from the flooded chamber and making the bow leave the slipway and 10-odd days to restore the warship's side.
The accident investigation group reported the relevant investigation content to the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea on May 22.
The Party Central Military Commission gave the following stand and instructions to the investigation group:
The extent of damage to the warship is not serious and the result of the flooding process immediately after the accident is only information necessary to take practical rehabilitation measures. The above-said data have no connection with the cause of the accident and the identification of its responsibility.
It is necessary to make clear the cause of the accident.
The Party Central Military Commission instructed the investigation group to investigate and expose the cause of the accident which should never occur and could not be tolerated and those responsible for it.
No matter how good the state of the warship is, the fact that the accident is an unpardonable criminal act remains unchanged, and those responsible for it can never evade their responsibility for the crime.
Regarding this accident as a serous matter is not because of the damage to the warship or economic loss. The aim of doing so is to deal a telling blow to incautiousness, irresponsibility and unscientific empiricist attitude prevailing in any field and to sound an alarm bell.
On the basis of the investigation data of the accident investigation group, the law-enforcement organ started to follow the procedure for first restraining and investigating those who are clearly responsible for the accident.
Hong Kil Ho, manager of the Chongjin Shipyard, was summoned to the law-enforcement organ on May 22. -0-

headline: Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm in DPRK Increases Area under Functional Vegetable Cultivation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 24 (KCNA) -- The Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm in the DPRK is putting efforts into boosting the area under functional vegetable cultivation.
This year the farm set itself a goal of increasing the area under functional vegetable cultivation by more than 1.5 times as against last year and paid attention to growing seedlings of high-yielding functional vegetables.
It organized scientific and technological study to improve the technical knowledge and skills of its employees.
Now that new varieties of vegetables are grown, the farm arranges for the employees to grasp the scientific and technological knowledge.
The farm also made an effort to transplant the grown functional vegetable seedlings in a qualitative way in line with the scientific and technological requirements. By doing so, it ensured the high survival rate of the seedlings. -0-

DPRK FM Receives Greetings from Her Thai Counterpart
story_text:

headline: Koam-Tapchon Railways
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 24 (KCNA) -- There are Koam-Tapchon Railways crossing rough sea of Sokjon Bay in the East Sea of Korea.
The railways connecting Koam area in Munchon City of Kangwon Province to the Songjon peninsula is the first marine railway bridge of the DPRK.
The magnificent and peculiar railways are the precious fruit of the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho led the construction of a Korean-style marine railway bridge in order to develop the country's fishing industry and provide the people with a more affluent life.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Ununfolded a grand plan to build a large-scale fishing village area in the areas of Koam, Tapchon and Chonapho favorable for the development of the fishing industry and set forth the task of building modern Koam-Tapchon Railways as a preceding process.
He personally indicated the orientation and ways for the railway construction and guided the layout several times so as to resolve all problems arising in the construction.
One day in May 2018, when he visited the completed Koam-Tapchon Railways, he said with great satisfaction that they are really wonderful, looking at the railways crossing the rough sea, and he highly appreciated the exploits of the builders, scientists and technicians who successfully carried out the huge project.
That day, he told officials about his good idea of turning the bridge into a multipurpose one by widening the bridge so that even vehicles could use it.
Later, the builders made the Sokjonman Bridge a multipurpose one, which can be used by trains and vehicles, in a short span of time, and decorated the area with electric light. -0-

headline: Chongryon, Dignified Overseas Citizens' Organization of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 24 (KCNA) -- May 25 is the day marking the 70th anniversary of the formation of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), a dignified overseas citizens' organization of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Chongryon is the Juche-type overseas compatriots' organization whose formation, development, guiding idea, course of its struggle and others are unthinkable apart from the undying feats and warm compatriotism of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The movement of Koreans in Japan was at the crossroads of success or failure due to the Japanese reactionaries' suppression and wrong line of trucklers and national nihilists in the late 1940s and the early 1950s.
With a scientific insight into the situation of the movement of Koreans in Japan, the President, despite of leading the Fatherland Liberation War to victory in December 1952, set forth the Juche-oriented policy of switchover that the Koreans should struggle for their homeland, their nation and revolution of their country even though they live in Japan.
In September 1954 he clarified that a new type of overseas compatriots' organization should be formed and that the new organization should be an organization struggling with the main emphasis on the issue of life of the Koreans in Japan, the issue of defending the rights of citizens of the Republic and the issue of ensuring the rights of democratic national education, and that such organization should conduct activities under the guidance of the government of the Republic.
Thanks to the energetic leadership of the President, the movement of Koreans in Japan was turned into a national patriotic movement and Chongryon, a new-type compatriots' organization, was formed.
The formation of Chongryon was a precious fruition of the original idea and leadership of the President on overseas compatriots' movement and a historic event that brought about a fundamental turn in developing the movement of Koreans in Japan and carving out the destiny of Koreans in Japan.
Since its formation, Chongryon has maintained its legitimate position as an overseas citizens' organization of Juche Korea. It established a well-regulated organizational system and work system and realized the unity and cohesion of the ranks in one ideology and will, thus developing into an authoritative and powerful overseas compatriots' organization.
It is a pride of the DPRK to have such a powerful overseas compatriots' organization as Chongryon. -0-

headline: Drive for Increased Production and Economy Vigorously Waged
Light Industry Factories in DPRK Focus on Environmental Protection
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 24 (KCNA) -- Factories and enterprises in the light industry sector of the DPRK are putting efforts into the environmental protection.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill installed more compressors and pumps at the wastewater purification process to increase the efficiency of wastewater purification, and built over 1 000 cubic meters of outdoor settling pond to boost the capacity of the collection of dust from the operated boiler.
The Sariwon Textile Mill repaired and maintained the sodium hypochlorite generator and repaired the boiler dust collector to further improve the production environment.
Technicians of the Pyongyang Tannery succeeded in the trial introduction of wastewater purification medicine and solved technical problems arising in the adjustment and reinforcement of wastewater purification equipment. And the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory is further increasing the efficiency of wastewater purification while pushing ahead with the dredging of the settling basin.
The Pyongyang Hosiery Factory, the Pyongyang Cosmetics Factory, the Pyongyang Essential Oil Factory and other factories are laying material and technical foundations for the protection of the environment in a scientific way. -0-
