headline: Lecture Given in Japan to Mark Founding Anniversary of Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- A lecture was given at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on May 16 to mark the 70th founding anniversary of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon).
Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, vice-chairpersons and officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters in Kanto area, etc.
The director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan gave a lecture under the title "The great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung, the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Iland the respected MarshalKim Jong Unhave made the proud 70-year-long history of Chongryon with their brilliant wisdom, outstanding leadership, boundless loving and paternal care, and the 70-year-long history of Chongryon which has remained faithful to their intentions is the one of unity and struggle in which Chongryon has made a dynamic advance, united close as one".
He said that the 70-year-long history of Chongryon is the one of the outstanding leadership and paternal care of the great leaders and the respected Marshal, the history of unity in which Chongryon has united as one under the banner of patriotism, true to the noble intentions of the great Generalissimos and the respected Marshal and the one of struggle in which it has unyieldingly fought against all sorts of discrimination and suppression by the Japanese authorities and other reactionaries at home and abroad.
He referred to the tradition of loyalty of Chongryon to the leader, the tradition of unity and the devoted and self-sacrificing spirit of Chongryon officials and patriotic compatriots recorded in the course of struggle and called on the Chongryon officials to invariably and steadfastly carry forward the tradition of patriotic loyalty and unity under the leadership of the respected Marshal. -0-

headline: Cement for Rural Housing Construction Transported through Route on Lake Suphung
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- The cement-carrying vessels, provided under the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea, conducted this year the first transport of cement for the construction of rural dwellings to Pyokdong County, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Untook a revolutionary measure last year to organize a convoy of transport ships so as to rapidly carry cement for rural construction to the counties around Lake Suphung, and he indicated in detail the issues arising in the construction and operation of the ships.
The officials and workers at the Sinuiju Dockyard and the Suphung Marine Transport Company made devoted efforts to build cargo vessels and an excavation ship in a short span of time.
In December last year, the launching ceremony was held, and the cargo ships conveyed lots of cement to those areas.
Those vessels will continue carrying cement to the mountainous areas around Lake Suphung in the future, too. -0-

headline: Mass Technological Innovation Movement Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- The chemical industrial sector of the DPRK is making successes by launching a mass technological innovation movement for increased production and economy.
The humic acid workshop of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex has newly manufactured on-off valve to reduce the loss of pulverized coal in the crusher, thus saving over 1 000 tons of raw materials in the first quarter of the year and the drying workshop has remodeled the drying furnace to increase the amount of hot air circulation by more than twice.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has made progress in improving the performance of the compressor parts and making effective use of gas and laid a solid foundation for making various welding rods by itself.
The February 8 Vinalon Complex manufactured rust-protection paint and new catalyzer to prolong the life of equipment at low cost and increased the toughness of vinalon, while making a progress in increasing the proportion of locally available raw materials in producing pumps.
The technicians of the Sunchon Chemical Complex installed an efficient water circulation system into boiler and improved the capacity of the mixing condenser needed for the production of nutrient fertilizer production. And the Myonggan Chemical Factory opened up a prospect for producing basic raw materials for the synthetic resin industry.
The Ponghwa Chemical Factory and the Pyongyang Rubber Factory are making a dynamic drive for increased production and creation, while giving priority to strengthening sci-tech force. -0-

headline: Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 29 (KCNA) -- The Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, a comprehensive extracurricular educational base for schoolchildren and a "pedigree farm" for talent education, is situated in the Mangyongdae area in Pyongyang Municipality.
The palace has various hobby group rooms, theatre, library, gymnasium, swimming pool, etc. for extracurricular activities of schoolchildren. A large number of promising reserve scientists, sportspersons and artistes are growing there.
The Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace, which has changed its appearance into a palace of children without an equal in the world, is associated with the warm love of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho spares nothing for the rising generations and makes them the happiest in the world.
The palace, built in 1989 under the benevolent care of the great GeneralissimosKim Il SungandKim Jong Il, was remodeled more magnificently under the energetic and meticulous leadership of the respected fatherly Marshal.
One day in May 2014,Kim Jong Unvisited the palace and set forth the task of remodeling it. Saying that it is the firm determination of the Workers' Party of Korea to make the sons and daughters of the working people give full play to their hope and skill to their heart's content, he saw to it that designing and construction forces were organized, and took measures for supplying materials.
He personally examined hundreds of pieces of layouts, frequently acquainted himself with the construction and took benevolent measures.
In November next year he looked round the remodeled palace and gave precious instructions which would serve as guidelines for its management and operation. Then he sent a lot of musical instruments, modern educational equipment, apparatuses and buses.
Thanks to the boundless loving care of the great fatherly leader, the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" sung by the schoolchildren who are giving full play to their hope and talent reverberates far and wide across the socialist motherland. -0-

headline: Suyangsan General Foodstuff Factory Updated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 29 (KCNA) -- The Suyangsan General Foodstuff Factory in the DPRK was successfully updated.
Officials and working people in South Hwanghae Province turned the factory into a comprehensive foodstuff production base where the production lines have been put on a germ-free and dust-free basis. The factory has production rooms furnished with various equipment, sci-tech learning space, a technical preparation room, cultural and welfare establishments, etc.
The updating of the factory, which mass-produces more than ten kinds of foodstuffs including tasty and nutritious confectionery, drinks, nutritive foodstuffs for children and instant noodle, provides another firm material and technical foundation for improving the diet of the people in the province.
An inauguration ceremony took place on the spot on Wednesday.
Present there were Pak Thae Dok, chief secretary of the South Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials and employees of the factory and working people in Haeju City.
Kim Chol Bom, chairman of the provincial people's committee, made an inaugural address. -0-

The province completed the construction of some army-people power stations including the Kosong and Phyonggang army-people power stations to increase the generating capacity by more than 1.3 times and provided the foundation for the economic development and improvement of the people's living of the province.

Minister of Public Security of DPRK Meets Delegation of Russian Ministry of Interior

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 29 (KCNA) -- The Jangsan Mine in the DPRK succeeded in the production of high-quality chamotte firebricks by large-scale tunnel calcination.
The newly established high-quality chamotte firebrick production line is completely based on the country's technology, equipment and raw materials.
The high-quality chamotte firebricks have been introduced into the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and other units. According to it, they helped increase the repair cycle of kiln than before.
The high-quality chamotte firebricks are applicable not only to the field of metallurgical industry but also to the field of chemical industry and other units operating furnace.
Not content with this success, the mine set a goal of making new refractory by its own efforts and puts spurs to technological innovation. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Regards Walking along Road between Fields as Rest
story_text:
One day in August 1976, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a cooperative farm (then).
Looking at the ripening paddy rice with satisfaction, the President asked in detail the officials about the varieties of rice and the per-hectare yield and said that he was going to look round other fields planted with an early-ripening variety of rice.
An official of the cooperative farm was very sorry for making the President walk along the road between fields in the midsummer heat. When the official asked the President to have a rest a little, the President changed the topic of conversation into the issue of varieties, saying that he regards the walking along the road between fields as a rest.
That day the President gave precious instructions on farming while walking along the road between fields.
Indeed, he had devoted himself to the wellbeing of the people without a rest. -0-

headline: Eighth Enlarged Meeting of Eighth WPK Central Military Commission Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- The Eighth Enlarged Meeting of the Eighth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the headquarters building of the WPK Central Committee on May 28.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the enlarged meeting.
Present there were members of the WPK Central Military Commission and, as observers, leading commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, military and political commanding officers of the large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and officials of relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee.
The enlarged meeting discussed the important issues of exercising tight control and guidance so that all military and political activities of the DPRK armed forces are thoroughly conducted as required by the Party's military line and policies by further strengthening the functions and roles of the political organs at all levels in the armed forces organs as required by the new stage of the developing revolution and more firmly establishing revolutionary command system and steel-like discipline system.
Saying that only when the role of the Party organizations and political organs at all levels which perform the function of helm in realizing the guidance of the Party Central Committee over the army is steadily enhanced, can all the problems arising in the army building and military activities be successfully solved, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the important principles to be consistently maintained by the Party committees at all levels in the army in implementing the Party's military line and policies in conformity with their mission and duty as the political general staff and supreme leadership organ of relevant units and all tasks facing them.
The organizational matter was discussed at the meeting.
The WPK Central Military Commission newly appointed six commanding officers of corps-level units, the director of the Artillery Bureau and the director of the Security Bureau and newly dispatched some political commissars.
The meeting discussed the issue of powerfully pushing ahead with major projects of political and military significance and gave a relevant assignment.
It discussed and decided on military measures to firmly maintain the strategic and tactical superiority in all aspects on the basis of the analysis of the situation related to the national security.
It also approved and assigned a series of new projects in the fields of defence science and industry.
The Eighth Enlarged Meeting of the Eighth WPK Central Military Commission made an important conclusion on the enhancement of the national defence capabilities and the orientation and immediate tasks for the military and political activities of the armed forces of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- The 35th Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Thursday.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, presided the plenary meeting.
Present there were Vice-Chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol and members of the SPA Standing Committee and, as observers, officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies.
The plenary meeting discussed as its agenda items the deliberation and adoption of the Law of the DPRK on Manpower Management, Law on Prevention of Soil Pollution and the Law on the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Special Zone and the recall and election of judges of the Supreme Court and people's assessors.
There took place a report on the main contents of the drafts of relevant laws discussed by the SPA Legislation Committee.
On the basis of the study and discussion of the proposed bills, a decree of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Manpower Management", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Preventing Soil Pollution" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Special Zone" were adopted with unanimous approval.
The plenary meeting recalled and elected judges and people's assessors of the Supreme Court of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Watches Firing Contest of Artillery Sub-units of Large Combined Units of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- A firing contest among artillery sub-units of large combined units of the Korean People's Army was conducted on May 29 amid the intensive combat training for implementing the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on building a powerful army aiming at the strongest military muscle being organized and enforced in the entire army.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the artillery firing contest.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK and vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
He was greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of large combined units of the KPA.
The commanders of the frontline large combined units commanded the fire.
The artillery sub-units at all levels who participated in the firing contest fully demonstrated the skilled artillery firing technique they have consolidated through intensive training true to the Party's policy on training-first policy.
Kim Jong Unpraised the success of artillery sub-units of perfectly demonstrating the actual war capability of the KPA artillery force fully preparing itself in full combat readiness to be matchless combat ranks that can fight any time and surely win if they fight a war. He positively appreciated that a scientific combat training system has been thoroughly established in the entire army and qualitative changes are being made in strengthening the war capability of the artillery in conformity with the developing aspects and changing trend of modern warfare.
He said it is very important to frequently organize firing contests close to the actual warfare environment in training the artillerymen into all-round and a-match-for-a-hundred ones capable of directly hitting the target at any time and in any situation. He stressed once again that prioritizing training and intensifying training are absolute loyalty to the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and making exact demand on training to the maximum is the shortcut to training the powerful army.
He expressed expectation and belief that the units at all levels of the entire army would train all the service personnel into training heroes and combat heroes possessed of strong spiritual strength, stubborn militant spirit, high ability and qualifications for an actual war by thoroughly applying the spirit of the seventh conference of the training officers in the military activities and thus firmly guarantee the comprehensive development of the DPRK with arms. -0-

headline: Chongryon - Patriotic Overseas Compatriots' Organization of DPRK
story_text:
One day in May 1994, ChairmanKim Jong Ilarranged an occasion for a senior official of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) who came to the homeland as head of a congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the 82nd birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The Chairman told him that Chongryon is the pride of the homeland and a model of the movement of overseas compatriots in the world. Many overseas compatriots are living in the world and millions of Korean compatriots formed their own organizations in different countries, but there is no patriotic overseas compatriots' organization loyal to their leader, country and nation like Chongryon, the Chairman added.
Recalling the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho set forth the great policy of a switchover in the line of the movement of Koreans in Japan during the grim Fatherland Liberation War, the Chairman highly praised the merits of the first generation of Chongryon who founded it and invariably followed the road of Juche with the policy of the line switchover as the guideline.
He earnestly said that the second and third generations of Chongryon should carry forward the patriotic tradition of Chongryon established by the first generation at any cost.
Looking up to the Chairman, the official felt that the true pride of Chongryon is the one of having the peerlessly great men and vowed to glorify this pride forever in the future, too. -0-

headline: Music and Dance Performance Given to Celebrate 70th Founding Anniversary of Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- A music and dance performance "Shine always, our Chongryon" was given at a theater in Tokyo, Japan on May 27 to celebrate the 70th founding anniversary of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon).
Among the audience were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently director of its Organizational Department, vice-chairpersons and directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, chairpersons of Chongryon headquarters of Kanto area, leading officials of the central organizations of Chongryon and its affiliates and compatriots and students across Japan.
Present there on invitation were advisors of the Central Standing Committee, headquarters, central organizations and affiliates of Chongryon and meritorious persons and patriotic businessmen, including honorary title holders.
Also on hand on invitation were members of diplomatic missions of Russia, China and other countries in Japan, the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, the co-representatives of the nationwide network for Japan-Korea solidarity, a member of the House of Representatives from the Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan and other political, cultural and media figures of Japan.
The performance was given by members of the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe and the song and dance troupes in the regions, members of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, compatriots from all walks of life and students.
The performance began with orchestral music "Shine Always, Our Chongryon" depicting the brilliant history of Chongryon. Put on the stage were chorus and dance "Our pride is great", kayagum ensemble "Under the sky of an alien land", national dance "Janggu Dance", etc.
The performers sang the praise of the leadership exploits of the great GeneralissimosKim Il SungandKim Jong Iland the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho made immortal contributions to the formation and development of Chongryon, and of the boundless emotion of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan greeting the 70th founding anniversary of Chongryon.
The audience was filled with excitement when a narration "In the Broad Bosom" was given to show the excitement of the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who took part in the New Year performance in 2025 and received the special care and the benevolent image ofKim Jong Unmeeting them was shown.
The song and dance "Let Us Defend the National Flag of the Republic Generation after Generation" reflecting the lively and cheerful appearance of the students of Korean schools growing up to be pillars of Chongryon vividly showed the will of the new generations to carry forward the baton of the patriotic cause of Chongryon.
The performance was enthusiastically acclaimed by the audience.
Members of foreign diplomatic missions in Japan and Japanese personages who enjoyed the performance said that they were deeply moved by the performance, and that Chongryon is the only compatriots' organization which has conducted the patriotic movement, remaining loyal to the great leaders generation after generation abroad for 70 years while flying the national flag of the Republic. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Finishing Building Materials Held in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- The South Hwanghae Provincial Exhibition of Finishing Building Materials for Rural Construction - 2025 took place in the DPRK.
On display at the venue for the exhibition were more than 3 500 pieces of finishing building materials of 50-odd kinds presented by the provincial management bureau for regional construction and building-materials production, provincial building-materials production units, cities and counties.
The province, which had made finishing building materials of over 30 kinds till last year, laid a foundation to produce those of more than 50 kinds this year, and the indices, the quality of which was assessed by the state, were increased from over 20 kinds to over 40. This is what is noteworthy at the exhibition.
Haeju City and Chongdan, Yonan and Kwail counties which built their own technical forces and finishing building materials production bases and are developing and producing quality finishing building materials in large quantities were highly appreciated at the exhibition. And the work was organized to accelerate the domestic production of finishing building materials and improve their quality by sharing and generalizing the experience of the advanced units at the exhibition. -0-

headline: DPRK Minister of State Security Addresses at International Meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 30 (KCNA) -- The 13th International Meeting of High-Level Security Representatives was held in Moscow from May 27 to 29.
Present there were more than 120 delegations from over 100 countries including the DPRK and international organizations.
On May 28, a plenary meeting was held on the theme of "Establishment of an equal and inseparable security structure: Challenges and possibilities of the southern and eastern states of the world".
Ri Chang Dae, minister of State Security of the DPRK, made a speech at the meeting.
He said:
In today's international arena, universal principles of international relations are openly ignored by arbitrary and high-handed practices of specific forces. They lead to serious destruction of the global security environment and unabated vicious cycle of conflicts and clashes across the planet.
The U.S. passes unilateral judgement on other countries and imposes inter-camp confrontation in pursuit of hegemony and self-interests going against the aspirations of the international community. Such policy of unilateralism and military supremacy are unchanging factors undermining the basis of international peace and security.
The DPRK's stand on the hegemonic and confrontational policy of the U.S. and its followers is clear: We will never overlook any hostility threatening the DPRK's sovereignty and dignity and endangering our people's well-being. We will respond with righteous struggle and strong power.
The DPRK will continue to uphold the banner of independence, peace and friendship to develop neighbourly and friendly relations with all countries aspiring after justice and independence. We are fully committed to building a fair multipolar world and ensuring international peace and security. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 31 (KCNA) -- May 31 is World No Tobacco Day.
Today when nonsmoking is becoming the trend of the modern world, a nonsmoking campaign is brisk in the DPRK and the number of people who give up smoking, realizing the harmfulness and danger of tobacco, is increasing as days go by.
On November 4, 2020, the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK adopted the Tobacco-Prohibition Law composed of 31 provisions.
The country makes sure that all institutions, organizations and citizens strictly observe the law in protecting the life and health of the people and creating a more cultured and hygienic living environment by intensifying the legal and social control over tobacco production and sale and smoking as required by the state policy on tobacco prohibition.

headline: Many Young Workers in DPRK Fulfill Their Yearly, First Half-Yearly Economic Plans
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 31 (KCNA) -- The spirit and mettle peculiar to the brave and passionate Korean youth are being fully displayed on the all-people advance toward the grand festival in October.
According to data available, more than 2 110 young people fulfilled their yearly national economic plans and over 640 fulfilled their first half-yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule in various fields of the national economy.
More than 850 young people in the coal-mining industrial sector completed their yearly and first half-yearly national economic plans while launching the brisk drive for increased production.
More than ten young people of the Youth Tunneling Work-team of the April 5 Pit of the Kumgol Mine under the Komdok Mining Complex fulfilled their yearly tunneling plans in the first quarter of the year.
Many young people of the Wiwon Mine Timber Production Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau fulfilled their yearly national economic plans by making effective use of topographical conditions and introducing a rational middle transportation method.
70-odd young people of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Nyongbyon Silk Mill completed their yearly national economic plans from March to May.
Over 320 young people in the textile industrial sector, including the Sariwon Textile Mill and the Sinuiju Textile Mill, too, fulfilled their yearly and first half-yearly plans. -0-

headline: Valuable Technological Achievements made in Electric-Power Industrial Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 31 (KCNA) -- The electric-power industrial sector in the DPRK is making technical innovation to meet the demand of the national economy for electricity.
As dozens of proposals were introduced at the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, tens of millions of more kWh of electricity was produced till April this year, more than ten thousand tons of coal was saved and the original performance of generating equipment was restored.
The East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant is striving to introduce a new ignition technology and a wet dust remover into the boiler No. 3.
The Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant is searching a plan for raising the combustion efficiency in boiler and saving a lot of coal, and the workers of the Sunchon Thermal Power Plant are concentrating their efforts on improving the thermal efficiency by changing the boiler slag outlet into the enclosed one.
The Hochongang Power Station has conducted the work to develop a digital rainfall measuring system and real-time measuring systems for air temperature and reservoir water level for putting water management on a higher scientific basis.  The Jangjingang Power Station introduced a technology of restoring the original performance of generator stator winding into several generators.
The Sodusu Power Station installed a new X-type waterwheel to increase the efficiency of generating equipment and the Kanggye Youth Power Station is conducting the work to expand and introduce digital excitation devices. -0-

headline: Extracurricular Educational Base Associated with Loving Care of Great Man
story_text:
One day in May 2019, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited a schoolchildren's palace.
After going round hobby group rooms of the palace,Kim Jong Undropped in at the Taekwon-Do group room.
He satisfactorily looked at children who courageously performed the movements.
Then he asked officials about the place for videos show related to Taekwon-Do.
After receiving a report that there is no room for watching videos in other group rooms because there is an IT group room equipped with modern computers, he said that there should be a video-show room every floor.
He said that the video-show room should be equipped with a TV with large screen and chairs so that group members watch videos at need.
Even at the moment when he watched with pleasure the training of group members, he thought about how he could provide them with an extracurricular educational education base fully equipped with all conditions. -0-

headline: Happy Children of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 1 (KCNA) -- Today (June 1) is the International Children's Day.
This day, our children, who lead a happy life under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, showed their bright and cheerful appearances through the art performances and amusement games.
There are our children before or over the people our Party respect as Heaven and it is not hardship but happiness and glory to make painstaking efforts for the younger generation who should grow up to be bolder and more lively persons. This isKim Jong Un's noble view of the rising generation.
During his revolutionary leadership, he continued to leave his traces with his love for and devotion to the future of the country.
On June 1, 2014, he visited Pyongyang Orphanage, where he hugged little children and kindly asked them what they were doing to amuse themselves and if they ate something delicious.
After watching with pleasure the cute little orphans saying what they had done and eaten, he enjoyed their singing of a song and applauded them.
He was most pleased when he heard that the children were living a merry life. While inspecting a children's foodstuff factory, he called on the officials and employees of the factory to produce tasty and nutritious foodstuffs in larger quantities, bear in mind that normalization of production is the way to protect the children's laughter.
At the Third Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (June 2021), he made sure that the Party set it as its policy to supply dairy and other nutritious foods to the children across the country at the state expense, and specified the detailed tasks and ways for their implementation.
As a result, a well-regulated system of supplying dairy products to all children across the country every day has been established and the children are healthily growing up. -0-

headline: Happy Laughter of Children
Measures Taken to Improve Quality Control in Construction Control Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 1 (KCNA) -- The construction control sector of the DPRK is taking measures to improve the quality control.
The Ministry of State Construction Control is directing efforts to perfecting the system of construction control and making the construction units observe the requirements of the Workers' Party of Korea's construction policy and laws and regulations.
The ministry, which has newly examined and completed the "quality assessment and review regulations of construction" and "regulations for evaluation of construction control", issued them to the construction units and supervisory organizations and urged them to apply to the improvement of quality in construction and supervisory work. It also organized the rapid dissemination of construction laws and regulations through mobile networks to make all the inspectors and surveyors observe the regulations for quality control.
The ministry also urged the inspectors involved in important construction projects to carry the guide to the main construction control and inspection and the guide to the procedure and methods of processes to discharge their duties with a sense of responsibility.
A climate has been established that inspectors and surveyors have acquainted themselves with the whole courses of constructions on the spots on the basis of construction standard and the guides related to the relevant construction and have conducted the quality assessment according to the process.
The ministry makes sure that the inspectors review the state of the quality assurance weekly and monthly and according to processes to guarantee the quality of the construction.
The quality control committee is under operation at the construction sites of the 50 000 flats in Pyongyang and other major construction sites and the demonstration has been conducted before carrying out all the processes. -0-

headline: 21st Conference of WFDY Extends Full Support for Just Cause of DPRK People and Youth
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 1 (KCNA) -- The 21st Conference of the World Federation of Democratic Youth (WFDY) held in Namibia expressed full support for the just cause of the DPRK people and youth.
The "Solidarity statement of the World Federation of Democratic Youth to the DPRK people and youth struggling for independence, justice and socialism" adopted on May 24 disclosed the fact that the tension on the Korean peninsula is escalating as never before due to the U.S. reckless and mean hostile policy toward the DPRK.
It said that to prevent a war and achieve durable peace on the Korean peninsula is a contribution to defending global peace and security, extending full support and solidarity to the just cause of the DPRK people and youth who are devotedly struggling for independence, justice, socialism and the development of the world youth movement.
It said that the WFDY strongly demands the U.S. stop at once its annual unethical and aggressive nuclear war drills against the DPRK and immediately withdraw its all nuclear strategic assets threatening the situation on the Korean peninsula and the region.
It noted that the WFDY extends warm militant greetings and solidarity to all the people and youth of the DPRK who are fighting hard against the U.S., the wrecker of global peace.
It ardently called upon the world progressive people and youth to positively join in the struggle of the DPRK people and youth to defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country and put an end to the danger of a nuclear war on the Korean peninsula. -0-

headline: 21st Conference of WFDY Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 1 (KCNA) -- The 21st Conference of the World Federation of Democratic Youth (WFDY) was held in Namibia from May 22 to 25 on the theme of "Forward to our future!"
Present there were delegations and delegates of youth organizations from over 60 countries including the youth delegation of the DPRK headed by Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, and diplomatic envoys of different countries.
Speeches were made there.
The head of the DPRK delegation said that the conference serves as an important occasion in organizationally readjusting and strengthening the WFDY and improving its activities as required by the developing reality.
He stressed that the DPRK young people would fulfill their international duty by defending peace and stability of the country and region in the van of the struggle for defending socialism and opposing imperialism and the U.S. and called for waging a dynamic struggle to build an independent and prosperous new world free from aggression and war, uniting close under the banner of the federation whose mission is to achieve independence against imperialism.
Delegates of youth organizations of Russia, Vietnam, Venezuela and other countries, who took part in the conference, denounced that the U.S., Japan and the ROK moves to fabricate the NATO of Asian version and their hostile policy toward the DPRK, nuclear war drills and sanctions and blockade against the DPRK destroy the situation on the Korean peninsula and global peace and stability and called upon all the member organizations of the federation to extend full support and solidarity to the struggle of the DPRK people and youth for independence, justice and socialism.
The conference adopted a political declaration of the federation and the "Solidarity statement of the World Federation of Democratic Youth to the DPRK people and youth struggling for independence, justice and socialism".
A leadership body of the Federation was newly elected at the conference.
The Socialist Patriotic Youth League of the DPRK was reelected as a member of the leadership body of the WFDY.
During the conference, there took place a march for solidarity against imperialism. -0-

headline: Farms in Region of Kangryong and Ongjin Benefit from Desalted Water of Lake Kangryong
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- More than 10 farms in the region of Kangryong and Ongjin of South Hwanghae Province in the DPRK are stepping up rice-transplanting by using the desalted water of Lake Kangryong.
In the past, agricultural workers in the region suffered troubles in farming for lack of water. Various projects were conducted to solve this problem, but they were not substantially helpful to farming.
At the Seventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed that it is necessary to take a decisive measure to complete the desalination of Lake Kangryong and use it for agricultural production in order to solve the water problem in the region of Ongjin and Kangryong in South Hwanghae Province.
Under the energetic guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho took all necessary measures including the immediate settlement of technical problems arising in the construction, irrigation system was established in the region, thus bringing about a remarkable change in farming.

headline: President Kim Il Sung Regards People as Heaven
story_text:
One day in December 1992, PresidentKim Il Sungsaid officials that they should have a revolutionary viewpoint on the masses to become true servants of the people. Adding that he wrote "Believe in the people as in Heaven" in his reminiscences, which means that he regards the people as Heaven, he said that this is his opinion and philosophy.
He said that he regarded the masses of the people as heaven, served them and carried out the revolution by relying on their might all his life from the period when he embarked on the road of revolution. He noted that if a revolutionary believes in people and relies on them, he will win everything and emerge ever-victorious, but if he keeps himself aloof from them and is forsaken by them, he will always suffer a defeat, this truth was clearly proved through his long revolutionary practice.
Indeed, the whole life of the President was the one for the people, regarding it as his lifelong motto to believe in the people as in Heaven while always finding himself among them and bestowing all sorts of loving care. -0-

headline: Farms in Region of Kangryong and Ongjin Benefit from Desalted Water of Lake Kangryong
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- More than 10 farms in the region of Kangryong and Ongjin of South Hwanghae Province in the DPRK are stepping up rice-transplanting by using the desalted water of Lake Kangryong.

As the water of Lake Kangryong flows into the region through several main waterways, thousands of hectares of rain-dependent fields have turned into fully irrigated ones
It also makes it possible to transplant rice seedlings in the tideland fields. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on June 1 issued the following press statement titled "Our efforts to defend the dignity and interests of the state will not be bound by anyone's prejudiced viewpoint and malicious criticism":
Recently, the multilateral sanctions monitoring team (MSMT), the U.S.-led sanctions and plot-breeding body, committed a political provocation of fabricating and making public a "report" taking issue with the cooperative relations between the DPRK and Russia.
The hostile act of the MSMT, a bogus group which has no legality in terms of existence and purpose, is a wanton violation of the international legal principles with sovereignty equality and non-interference in others' internal affairs as the core and a mockery of the fair international community.
We express serious concern over the provocative acts of the West to encroach upon the sovereign rights of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with its unilateral and high-handed political and legal standards as a yardstick and give stern warning against the negative consequences to be entailed by its reckless acts.
No one has given the U.S. and its followers the mission and power to judge and denounce the legitimate relations between sovereign states at their own discretion, and herein lies the main reason why the existence and activities of the MSMT should be questioned and rejected.
The MSMT, which was formed arbitrarily by eleven countries hostile to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation, is thoroughly a political tool operating according to the geopolitical interests of the West and, therefore, it has no justification to investigate the exercise of sovereign rights of other countries.
The DPRK-Russia military cooperation aimed at protecting the sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests of the states and ensuring peace and stability in the Eurasian region is a legitimate exercise of the sovereign right granted by Article 51 of the UN Charter which stipulates that each state has the right to self-defence individually or collectively. It is also a legitimate exercise of the sovereign right fully conforming with Article 4 of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia which requires each of the parties to provide military and other assistance in case of an armed attack against the other.
There is a thing to make clear in this opportunity. The reason why the military cooperation between the countries involved in the MSMT has not become the target of international investigation isn't because it is just, defensive and, moreover, peaceful.
The legality and justness of the DPRK-Russia relations based on the new development-oriented point lies in the fact that they are the cream of inter-state relations that put an end to the era, in which a handful of countries formed an illegal and confrontation-oriented political and military group and resort to arbitrary practices at will, and establish a multi-polar world order based on genuine respect for sovereignty, equality and justice.
The DPRK has the right to take strong countermeasures to defend its interests from the outrageous encroachment on its sovereignty and interference in its internal affairs by the member states of the MSMT
The hostile forces' illegal plot-breeding moves will have no effect on the relations of cooperation between independent sovereign states and our efforts to defend the dignity and interests of the state will not be bound by anyone's prejudiced viewpoint and malicious criticism. -0-

headline: Immediate Rice-Transplantation and Other Farm Operations Conducted in Responsible Manner
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of various sectors.
The premier visited Samjiyon City where he learned about the remodeling of Samjiyon Airport and the progress made in construction projects for sprucing up the city into a fresh and highly civilized city as planned and intended by the Party including the construction of the tourist resort in the northern area of Mt Phothae, the Ponnamu Hotel and the Sobaeksu Hotel and inquired into the problems arising in the projects.
He stressed the need to push ahead with the construction of tourist roads and railways as planned, take thorough measures for protecting the ecological environment and forests, strengthen the workforce in keeping with the additional construction of various projects and enhance the responsibility and role of the construction inspectors so as to avoid any slightest shortcomings in ensuring the quality of construction.
He said that the Wonsan General Fishing Implement Factory should train a large number of competent technicians, increase the ranks of skilled workers and raise the proportion of locally available raw materials and recycling to produce more fishing implements of various kinds, thus making a substantial contribution to the country.
The premier visited the Pyongyang Construction Machine Plant and the Pyongyang Grain Processing Machine Factory to learn in detail about the manufacturing of equipment needed by regional-industry factories and stressed the need to strengthen their own technical forces to increase the processing accuracy of equipment and steadily improve the productivity and convenience of operation.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for the relevant units to supply equipment and materials necessary for the construction of Samjiyon City in a responsible manner and step up the finishing work in a qualitative way, the issue of raising the level of modernization of equipment for producing the fishing implements and the issue of strengthening the sci-tech force so as to make a qualitative leap forward in the production of machinery and equipment, and took measures for them.
Meanwhile, the premier visited the construction site of the general inclined shaft of the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex to learn about the tunneling and concreting. While going round the Namchil and Songhak farms in the city of Anju, he called for manuring and cultivating the crops in a scientific way according to their growth state and increasing the production of greenhouse vegetables. -0-

headline: Kaesong Koryo Insam Exhibition
Joint Friendship Gathering Marks International Children's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- A joint friendship gathering took place at the Taesongsan Pleasure Park in Pyongyang Municipality, the DPRK on Sunday to mark the 75th anniversary of the June 1 International Children's Day.
Present there were Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Choe Hui Thae, chairman of the Pyongyang Municipal People's Committee, officials of the women's union and officials concerned, exemplary teachers and women in educational work and education of children and kindergarten children in the municipality.
Present there were diplomatic envoys and members of diplomatic missions here and foreign guests and overseas Koreans staying in the socialist homeland.
Prior to the gathering, there was an acrobatic model aircraft demonstration of the players of the Pyongyang Municipal Air Club.
Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the women's union, made a speech at the gathering.
Amid the playing of children's songs, beautiful dance and gymnastic movements of children were displayed.
The festive mood of the gathering was revved up as the stage of pride and art performance were given by young prodigies, little players, soloists and dancers who presented their writings to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, giving delight to him, and came first in the national Taekwon-Do fan contest (children's group), national calligraphy festival, national children's paduk contest and the Pyongyang municipal open paduk contest 2025.
Then followed sports and amusement games.
The cute appearance of little players in the flower rope-skipping and ball shooting games added to the enthusiasm and optimism of the spectators.
The race of mothers taking hand of children with balls on their heads and in their arms and tug of war game boosted the atmosphere of the joint gathering.
The children of different countries participated in colorful amusement games, sharing friendship with the Korean children.
The children's beautiful circle dance was displayed, decorating the end of the gathering. -0-

headline: Activities of Scientific Farming Promotion Team Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- The activities of the scientific farming promotion team are being conducted in different parts of the DPRK.
Since April, hundreds of members of the scientific farming promotion team took many scientific and technological measures for improving the growth conditions of tens of thousands of hectares of wheat and barley fields and conducted more than 1 400 rounds of field lectures for sowing rice and maize seeds and cultivating and tending them in a scientific way.
The team dispatched to South Hwanghae Province has treated thousands of tons of rice seeds with advanced seed-covering material and installed electric impulse water treatment device at over 900 pumping stations, thus successfully conducting rice transplanting by dint of science.
The team dispatched to South Phyongan Province is directing efforts to solving technical problems arising in the production of high-quality multi-nutrients for rice seedlings and ensuring conditions for increasing the operation rate of high-speed nutritive rice-transplanting machines.
Members of the team dispatched to North Hwanghae Province toured farms in the province to effectively give more than 850 rounds of passing-on technique and technical lectures.
The team dispatched to South Hamgyong Province is organizing a tele-questioning and answering system for farming techniques in the province and making competent scientists and field workers give lectures to disseminate advanced farming techniques and good experience. -0-

headline: International Children's Day Marked by Children with Disability in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- A meeting of children of disability took place at gymnasium of the extracurricular sports school in Taedonggang District, Pyongyang on Sunday to mark the June 1 International Children's Day.
Present there were Jon Chol Hi, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned, children with disabilities, children of Tongmun Kindergarten No. 2 in Taedonggang District, nurses, kindergarten teachers and parents.
Speeches were made at the meeting, followed by colorful art performance and sports and amusement games of disabled children and kindergarten children.
Put on the stage were various numbers including poem and song "We Yearn for MarshalKim Jong Un". The faces of children were full of joy and optimism growing happily under the warm care of the motherly Party.
The lively images of the children who displayed competitive spirit in the sports and amusement games divided into "squirrel" and "hedgehog" teams and their parents' enthusiastic cheers added to the pleasure of the holiday. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on June 1 issued the following press statement titled "Our efforts to defend the dignity and interests of the state will not be bound by anyone's prejudiced viewpoint and malicious criticism":
Recently, the multilateral sanctions monitoring team (MSMT), the U.S.-led sanctions and plot-breeding body, committed a political provocation of fabricating and making public a "report" taking issue with the cooperative relations between the DPRK and Russia.
The hostile act of the MSMT, a bogus group which has no legality in terms of existence and purpose, is a wanton violation of the international legal principles with sovereignty equality and non-interference in others' internal affairs as the core and a mockery of the fair international community.
We express serious concern over the provocative acts of the West to encroach upon the sovereign rights of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with its unilateral and high-handed political and legal standards as a yardstick and give stern warning against the negative consequences to be entailed by its reckless acts.
No one has given the U.S. and its followers the mission and power to judge and denounce the legitimate relations between sovereign states at their own discretion, and herein lies the main reason why the existence and activities of the MSMT should be questioned and rejected.
The MSMT, which was formed arbitrarily by eleven countries hostile to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation, is thoroughly a political tool operating according to the geopolitical interests of the West and, therefore, it has no justification to investigate the exercise of sovereign rights of other countries.
The DPRK-Russia military cooperation aimed at protecting the sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests of the states and ensuring peace and stability in the Eurasian region is a legitimate exercise of the sovereign right granted by Article 51 of the UN Charter which stipulates that each state has the right to self-defence individually or collectively. It is also a legitimate exercise of the sovereign right fully conforming with Article 4 of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia which requires each of the parties to provide military and other assistance in case of an armed attack against the other.
There is a thing to make clear in this opportunity. The reason why the military cooperation between the countries involved in the MSMT has not become the target of international investigation isn't because it is just, defensive and, moreover, peaceful.
The legality and justness of the DPRK-Russia relations based on the new development-oriented point lies in the fact that they are the cream of inter-state relations that put an end to the era, in which a handful of countries formed an illegal and confrontation-oriented political and military group and resort to arbitrary practices at will, and establish a multi-polar world order based on genuine respect for sovereignty, equality and justice.
The DPRK has the right to take strong countermeasures to defend its interests from the outrageous encroachment on its sovereignty and interference in its internal affairs by the member states of the MSMT
The hostile forces' illegal plot-breeding moves will have no effect on the relations of cooperation between independent sovereign states and our efforts to defend the dignity and interests of the state will not be bound by anyone's prejudiced viewpoint and malicious criticism. -0-

headline: Joint Friendship Gathering Marks International Children's Day
Mt Komun, Cultural Recreation Ground for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- Mt Komun is in Sakju County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The central area of the mountain forms a mixed forest, and the thick forest is inhabited by raccoon dogs, roe deer, squirrels and other species of animals.
There is the Magnolia obovata stock which is difficult to find in the country.
The stock called Sakju hwangmokryon was designated as Natural Monument No. 96 and has been protected.
In the eastern part of the mountain, there is Sakju Hot Spring.
In the 1920s, the inhabitants of the area built an open bath around it.
As the hot spring with high temperature and slight alkalinity is especially effective for treating various skin diseases, inflammation, heavy metal poisoning and neuralgia, a rest home was built in around 1956 to contribute to the improvement of the health of the working people.
The water temperature is about 59°C and its gushing amount is about 100 cubic meters per hour.
The valley is harmonized with crystal-clear water, mysterious rocks and cliffs and thick forest.
Thanks to the solicitude of the Workers' Party of Korea, various facilities conducive to the cultural recreation and health promotion of the people were wonderfully built in the mountain, giving pleasure to visitors. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Joint Friendship Gathering Marks International Children's Day

story_text:
One day in May 1998, ChairmanKim Jong Ildropped in at a paddy field in Taebaek-ri, Changdo County, Kangwon Province on his tour of inspection to the front.
The officials accompanying him got out of the car and went to him with a thought that he would give instructions on military operations.
At that time, a touch-and-go situation prevailed in the forefront area by the enemy's moves to ignite a new war.
But the Chairman said that the lands of Kangwon Province should be realigned boldly, adding that he had this plan from long ago.
The officials were surprised at this as the whole country experienced difficulties.
Pointing to the patches of paddy fields, he said that soldiers of the Korean People's Army and people should be generally mobilized to realign the lands of Kangwon Province.
He said that if the lands of Kangwon Province are realigned, a lot of arable lands can be obtained and agricultural production can be radically increased, adding that the land realignment in Kangwon Province is a matter he has already thought and his firm determination, and that it is time to realign the lands.
Like this, the Chairman unfolded a grand conception for large-scale land realignment while inspecting the front, not in his office of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea or a large meeting hall. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Hospital and Leisure Complex under Construction in Kangdong County
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at a hospital and leisure complex under construction in Kangdong County of the DPRK on June 2.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Kim Tok Hun, Kim Jae Ryong, O Su Yong and other senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the units of the Korean People's Army involved in the construction and officials of designing institutions.
First, he looked round the Kangdong County Hospital under construction.
He heard from officials concerned about a report on the progress made in the construction so far and the long-term plan for construction progress.
Going round various places of the construction site including the outpatient ward section, operating theatre section, inpatient ward section and the underground car park section, he learned in detail about the construction.
Saying that the work of building modern public health facilities in cities and counties across the country is a great revolution for developing the public healthcare which has lagged behind any other sector to surpass other sectors in ten years, he stressed that our spirit of devoted service to the people and attitude to them should be examined once again through the course of successfully carrying out this innovative plan with redoubled efforts. And he reaffirmed his determination and will to build all city and county hospitals into symbols of socialist public health in our era which fully embody the Party's plan for modernizing public health and its idea on Juche-oriented architectural beauty.
Acquainting himself with the functionality and convenience of elements of different systems of the hospital, he pointed out every measure to be taken.
He referred to the importance of responsibly building three hospitals of different scales including the above-said construction project being carried out this year as model ones for the overall rejuvenation of public health of the country.
In the course of this, best plans for obtaining optimum results in designing regional hospitals of different classes will be confirmed and on the basis of it, the future plans for building overall public health facilities will be drawn up in detail in the principle of ensuring economical efficiency and practicality, he noted.
He said that the construction of a hospital is the complex of the latest medical technology and building techniques and what is as important as the construction is the medical equipment and medical force. And the strengthening of medical force should be regarded as the main link in the implementation of the public health policy and the main work that should be pushed ahead with on a medium- and long-term basis, he said, repeatedly stressing the importance of the task to improve the specialist qualifications of the regional public health workers in particular and train medical workers in a systematic, scientific and future-oriented way. Then he clarified the orientation and ways to this end.
Saying that the pharmaceutical industry of the country should be radically boosted in order to supply enough medicines to hospitals to be built in all cities and counties across the country, he stressed the need to thoroughly examine the state system of supplying medicines and take reinforcement measures.
He also indicated different issues arising in preparations for operating the hospital.
Then he visited the construction site of the Kangdong County Leisure Complex.
He learned in detail about the construction from the commanding officer of the unit.
He said that it is most important to firmly prepare construction force before anything else in carrying out the Party's policy on regional development without an inch of deflection and particularly stressed that all the construction regiments should have a vital stake in strengthening the ranks of skilled workers and push ahead with the training of skilled workers under scientific goals and plans.
Referring to the issues arising in training competent designing and construction forces, standardizing and legalizing advanced construction methods and achieving rapid development of the building-materials industry throughout the country, he set forth important tasks for implementing them.
Expressing militant tribute to the high ideological and spiritual world and patriotic devotion of the soldier-builders who are struggling with a single mind for completing the construction of the hospital, leisure complex and regional-industry factories in Kangdong County on the highest level, he expressed expectation and belief that they would achieve excellent successes in the construction projects by upholding the Party's sincerity towards the people with heroic and resourceful labour.
Encouraged by the field guidance ofKim Jong Un, all the soldier-builders hardened their firm determination to perfectly build new wealth of prosperity and model entities of civilization for the local people this significant year, bearing deep in mind the trust of the Party Central Committee which put forward them at the outpost of the sacred struggle for regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Monument to Victorious Battle of Pochonbo
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 4 (KCNA) -- In Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province, the DPRK, there is the monument built in commemoration of the victory of the Pochonbo battle which is of weighty significance in the anti-Japanese national liberation struggle of the Korean people.
This monument is an immortal one conveying the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, who dealt a heavy political and military blow to the aggressors and inspired the Korean people with hopes of national liberation by attacking Pochonbo, the strategic vantage point of the Japanese imperialists, on June 4, 1937.
It was unveiled on the occasion of the 30th anniversary of the historic victory in the Pochonbo battle.
The Monument to the Victorious Battle of Pochonbo, with the statue ofKim Il Sungerected in the center of the tower's front, consists of a white granite pedestal, a red marble tower depicting a fluttering flag and subsidiary bronze 60-figure groups in relief on either side of it.
The monument is 38.7 meters high and 30.3 meters long on the side.
The noble image of the President walking vigorously while looking forward with a pair of binoculars in his one hand and military cap in the other shows his personality as an ever-victorious and iron-willed brilliant commander and outstanding strategist.
Seen on either side of the tower are groups of subsidiary theme sculptures "Advance into the Motherland", "Advance" and "Overcoming Hardships". They artistically and vividly show the whole course of the anti-Japanese armed struggle with the main emphasis on the Pochonbo battle and its mass character through the depiction of vivid figures of marked individuality.
The tower has been gradually narrowed upward to ensure the sense of stability and balance. From the back to the front, the size of the sculptures is enlarged slightly and the relief is also processed from low to high one, thus emphasizing the process of expanding and developing the anti-Japanese armed struggle and the spirit of mass advance in a formative way.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the monument and said that it is the first monument on the theme of the revolutionary traditions built in the country. And he said that there is no monument which is excellent in terms of ideology and art like the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Pochonbo. -0-

headline: Education of Rising Generation Should Not Be Neglected Even for Moment
story_text:
One August day in 2024, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the April 25 Hostel and watched a demonstration lesson for a class of primary school pupils, which was organized as part of the preparations for new-term teaching of the pupils from the flood-hit areas.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unacquainted himself in detail with the provision of educational equipment and school fixtures and saw school things for the pupils.
Watching with a broad smile on his face the pupils from various regions, engrossed in class, he said that he was proud that this time the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea made a prompt and correct determination to take measures for provisional education of children and pupils from the flood-hit areas and enforced it.
Looking up to him who was going to make the children from the flood-hit areas learn to their heart's content without any shadow and grow up to be excellent talents of the country and pillars for building a prosperous country, the officials were unable to repress emotion.
He said that education is an important undertaking for providing steady continuity to the generations of the Korean revolution and promoting the development of the country, stressing that as the development of the country and the future of the revolution depends on how the younger generation is educated, the Party and the government should not neglect the education of the rising generation even for a moment, no matter how difficult it may be.
Upon receiving his instructions, the officials deeply kept in mind once again his noble intention to make the country's education the most advanced one. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Secretary of Russian Security Council Sergei Shoigu
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, met Sergei Shoigu on a visit to the DPRK leading a delegation of the Security Council of the Russian Federation upon authorization of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, at the headquarters building of the WPK Central Committee on June 4.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Ungladly received Sergei Shoigu visiting Pyongyang again in just 70-odd days and had a friendly and trustworthy talk with him.
Sergei Shoigu courteously conveyed the friendly greetings from Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unexpressed his deep thanks for it, and sent his warm comradely greetings to the respected Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
Sergei conveyed the special thanks of the Russian leadership to the matchless heroism and self-sacrificing spirit of the Korean people's excellent sons who participated in the operations for liberating the Kursk area and defended the precious part of the Russian territory as their own motherland, fighting shoulder to shoulder with Russian soldiers in the same trench
Kim Jong Unexpressed his thanks for it.
Discussed in depth at the talk were a series of important matters for defending the common core interests by more solidly developing the special and firm comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries of the DPRK and Russia and items of mutual cooperation in different fields. Also exchanged in a broad way at the talk were views and opinions of the leaderships of the two countries on the development of situation over the Ukrainian crisis and on the international and regional situation. The talk confirmed the consensus of stand of the two sides.
Kim Jong Unaffirmed that the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will, in the future, too, unconditionally support the stand of Russia and its foreign policies in all the crucial international political issues including the Ukrainian issue and responsibly observe the articles of the treaty between the DPRK and Russia.
He expressed expectation and conviction that Russia would, as ever, surely win victory in the sacred cause of justice for defending national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests.
Expressed at the talk was the will of the leaderships of the two countries to continue to dynamically expand and develop the DPRK-Russia relations into the powerful and comprehensive relations of strategic partnership fully conformed with the national interests of the two countries and wellbeing of the peoples and conducive to realizing genuine international justice.
Kim Jong Unwished the Russian people eternal victory, prosperity and happiness and extended warm wishes to the respected President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, and the Russian government, army and people. -0-

headline: France's Contradictory Behavior Is Main Reason Why It Cannot Be Representative of Europe
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- Choe Ju Hyon, an international security analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article "France's contradictory behavior is the main reason why it cannot be a representative of Europe" on June 4:
Shortly ago, French President Macron said at the 22nd Shangri-La Dialogue that NATO would have a hand in Asia unless it prevents the DPRK's intervention in Europe, taking issue with the normal cooperative relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Indeed, it is a paradox just like a guilty party filing the suit first.
Quite contrary to the claim of Macron, the armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea did not "intervene" in Europe but participated in the righteous liberation operations to repel the Ukrainian neo-Nazi forces who invaded the territory of the ally under Article 51 of the UN Charter and Article 4 of the DPRK-Russia treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
The normal relations of military cooperation between the DPRK and Russia fully coinciding with international law can neither be a subject of criticism in any case nor a pretext for NATO's military interference in the Asia-Pacific region.
Although Macron described the DPRK-Russia relations of military cooperation as a pretext for NATO's interference in Asia, it is a stark historical fact that NATO's military advance into the region had already begun long before the establishment of the DPRK-Russia relations of military cooperation and France is at the forefront of it, and no one can deny this.
France, which initiated the Indo-Pacific strategy for the first time in Europe in 2019, has sent warships and fighter planes to the Korean peninsular and other regions in Asia every year, escalating tension on a steady basis. And this year it even dispatched a carrier task force to the Asia-Pacific region for the first time in nearly 60 years since 1968 and staged powder-reeking joint military drill Pacific Steller 2025 with U.S. and Japan.
Meanwhile, NATO has stretched out its black tentacles to the Asian region for a long time, talking about "inseparable securities of Europe and Asia-Pacific region", and is intensifying its moves to enlist some regional countries kowtowing to the West in its strategy of separating into groups such as regularly inviting the ROK and Japan to the NATO summit and the NATO foreign ministers' meeting since 2022.
Now Asia-Pacific states are keeping a coldhearted watch on France standing in the van of NATO's military advance into the region which is showing the sign of steady increase in its scale and frequency in recent years.
This being the fact, Macron asserted reversed logic, which cannot be interpreted otherwise than he has very poor insight and knowledge about the situation in Asia-Pacific region or he intentionally lied.
It is a mistake if Macron thinks that he can cloak NATO's aggressive and wicked intention to put dirty military shoes on Asia-Pacific region by taking issue with the DPRK-Russia cooperative relations without reason while putting aside all their dangerous military moves.
The French president called on Europe and Asian countries to establish "coalition" not to become victims of U.S.-China rivalry. This is nothing but a selfish hypocrisy to sell its weapons to Asian countries and justify its military advance and expansion of its influence to the region.
The imprudent remarks of the French president fully highlighted once again the fact that he is publicly recognized as a politician who loves to demonstrate his existence by making a series of shocking, claptrap and unrealistic assertions unmindful of consequences to be entailed.
France is obsessed with extreme self-assurance and is unable to properly judge the situation.
The further France and NATO disturb peace and stability in Asia-Pacific region by meddling in the region, the fiercer reaction of the regional countries they will trigger and this will lead to the eroding of their strategic position.
France should realize as early as possible that its contradictory behaviour keeps it from being recognized as a representative of Europe. -0-
