headline: National Attention Paid to Environment Protection
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- June 5 is World Environment Day.
The natural environment is the material source of human life and an essential element for people to live.
As the natural environment plays an important role in human life, the UN General Assembly in 1972 raised the environment protection as an important issue to be solved by the whole world and decided to achieve international cooperation in this field and commemorate June 5 every year as World Environment Day.
The DPRK is taking practical measures for environmental protection in keeping with the international efforts for environmental protection.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unin his report at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea set the land management and the protection of ecological environment as an important matter for defending the lives and health of the people and making the mountains and rivers of the country more beautiful and as a strategic work related to the future of the country.
The DPRK intensifies the supervision of sources of pollution, including air pollutants which exceed environmental standards, and strictly enforces environmental impact assessment prior to development and construction.
It is also conducting the work to reduce urban pollution by exhaust fumes from automobiles, establish an environmental monitoring system and manufacture and introduce air pollution measuring instruments.
At the same time, it is making all members of society take an active part in protecting the ecological environment while disseminating and explaining common sense on environmental protection through various media. -0-

headline: Aquaculture Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- This year the Ragwon County Offshore Farm is under construction in the DPRK after the successful completion of the Sinpho City Offshore Farm, a new model base of advanced offshore farming, in the Phungo-dong area in the city of Sinpho, South Hamgyong Province, last year.
Aquaculture in the country is a sphere of resources development whose profitability and prospective nature capable of attaining greater profits with less investment have already been proved, Associate Professor Ri Il Gwang, director of the Maritime Research Institute under the Global Environment Science Faculty ofKim Il SungUniversity, said, and went on:
As the East Sea of Korea has favorable conditions for the aquaculture in terms of quality, depth and temperature of water, large culture grounds can be built in the sea near the land and their productivity increased while saving manpower. Less material needed for establishing aquaculture facilities is consumed as the depth of water in the waters off aquaculture grounds is shallow. The security of the facilities is guaranteed and their management is favorable as the waves are lower than the ones in the deep sea.
The Sinpho City Offshore Farm has a favorable condition of not suffering damage from high wave, tidal wave, etc. as there is a big islet playing a role of natural breakwater near the farm. The place where the Ragwon County Offshore Farm is under construction is free from unfavorable marine meteorological effects as it is enclosed by land on its three sides, and it is the most suitable site for building the farm as it is favorable for building a wharf and breakwater and nears aquaculture ground.

headline: National Attention Paid to Environment Protection
France's Contradictory Behavior Is Main Reason Why It Cannot Be Representative of Europe
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- Choe Ju Hyon, an international security analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article "France's contradictory behavior is the main reason why it cannot be a representative of Europe" on June 4:
Shortly ago, French President Macron said at the 22nd Shangri-La Dialogue that NATO would have a hand in Asia unless it prevents the DPRK's intervention in Europe, taking issue with the normal cooperative relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Indeed, it is a paradox just like a guilty party filing the suit first.
Quite contrary to the claim of Macron, the armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea did not "intervene" in Europe but participated in the righteous liberation operations to repel the Ukrainian neo-Nazi forces who invaded the territory of the ally under Article 51 of the UN Charter and Article 4 of the DPRK-Russia treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
The normal relations of military cooperation between the DPRK and Russia fully coinciding with international law can neither be a subject of criticism in any case nor a pretext for NATO's military interference in the Asia-Pacific region.
Although Macron described the DPRK-Russia relations of military cooperation as a pretext for NATO's interference in Asia, it is a stark historical fact that NATO's military advance into the region had already begun long before the establishment of the DPRK-Russia relations of military cooperation and France is at the forefront of it, and no one can deny this.
France, which initiated the Indo-Pacific strategy for the first time in Europe in 2019, has sent warships and fighter planes to the Korean peninsular and other regions in Asia every year, escalating tension on a steady basis. And this year it even dispatched a carrier task force to the Asia-Pacific region for the first time in nearly 60 years since 1968 and staged powder-reeking joint military drill Pacific Steller 2025 with U.S. and Japan.
Meanwhile, NATO has stretched out its black tentacles to the Asian region for a long time, talking about "inseparable securities of Europe and Asia-Pacific region", and is intensifying its moves to enlist some regional countries kowtowing to the West in its strategy of separating into groups such as regularly inviting the ROK and Japan to the NATO summit and the NATO foreign ministers' meeting since 2022.
Now Asia-Pacific states are keeping a coldhearted watch on France standing in the van of NATO's military advance into the region which is showing the sign of steady increase in its scale and frequency in recent years.
This being the fact, Macron asserted reversed logic, which cannot be interpreted otherwise than he has very poor insight and knowledge about the situation in Asia-Pacific region or he intentionally lied.
It is a mistake if Macron thinks that he can cloak NATO's aggressive and wicked intention to put dirty military shoes on Asia-Pacific region by taking issue with the DPRK-Russia cooperative relations without reason while putting aside all their dangerous military moves.
The French president called on Europe and Asian countries to establish "coalition" not to become victims of U.S.-China rivalry. This is nothing but a selfish hypocrisy to sell its weapons to Asian countries and justify its military advance and expansion of its influence to the region.
The imprudent remarks of the French president fully highlighted once again the fact that he is publicly recognized as a politician who loves to demonstrate his existence by making a series of shocking, claptrap and unrealistic assertions unmindful of consequences to be entailed.
France is obsessed with extreme self-assurance and is unable to properly judge the situation.
The further France and NATO disturb peace and stability in Asia-Pacific region by meddling in the region, the fiercer reaction of the regional countries they will trigger and this will lead to the eroding of their strategic position.
France should realize as early as possible that its contradictory behaviour keeps it from being recognized as a representative of Europe. -0-

headline: National Attention Paid to Environment Protection
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- June 5 is World Environment Day.
The natural environment is the material source of human life and an essential element for people to live.
As the natural environment plays an important role in human life, the UN General Assembly in 1972 raised the environment protection as an important issue to be solved by the whole world and decided to achieve international cooperation in this field and commemorate June 5 every year as World Environment Day.
The DPRK is taking practical measures for environmental protection in keeping with the international efforts for environmental protection.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unin his report at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea set the land management and the protection of ecological environment as an important matter for defending the lives and health of the people and making the mountains and rivers of the country more beautiful and as a strategic work related to the future of the country.
The DPRK intensifies the supervision of sources of pollution, including air pollutants which exceed environmental standards, and strictly enforces environmental impact assessment prior to development and construction.
It is also conducting the work to reduce urban pollution by exhaust fumes from automobiles, establish an environmental monitoring system and manufacture and introduce air pollution measuring instruments.
At the same time, it is making all members of society take an active part in protecting the ecological environment while disseminating and explaining common sense on environmental protection through various media. -0-

headline: Projects for Expanding Tide Embankment and Stone-covering Hastened in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- Projects for expanding tide embankment and stone-covering have been conducted at the tideland reclamation sites across the DPRK.
In May alone, servicepersons and builders covered an area of more than 102 000 square meters with stones and conducted the project for expanding tide embankment of 1.24 million cubic meters.
Servicepersons in charge of the projects for the third and fifth districts of the Taedongman Tideland, the Ongjin Tideland and the second district at the third stage of the Kwaksan Tideland completed the first damming projects and are directing their efforts to stone-covering project.
Those in charge of the projects for the Haebang Tideland and the first district of the Phungjong Tideland transplanted many stones in a month by operating construction machines and vehicles at full capacity and are hastening the stone-covering projects.
At the construction site for the first district of the Aedo Tideland, builders raised the drilling speed and introduced a rational blasting method, thus speeding up the stone-covering project.
Builders in charge of the fourth district project for the Taedongman Tideland carried out the first damming project at 87 percent and are pushing ahead with the project for filling up the embankment with earth.
Thanks to the efforts of the servicepersons and builders, the construction speed is increasing day by day. -0-

headline: State Organ Building Turns into School
story_text:
PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Pyongyang Primary School No. 19 early in April, 1954.
After going round the inside and outside of the school, which hasn't healed the scar of the war, for a long time, the President looked round the school campus. Pointing at a building on the opposite side of the school, he asked an official accompanying him what it is.
Upon hearing the answer of the official that it is the newly built office of the Ministry of Commerce, the President asked again about the possibility of using the office as a school.
The official couldn't reply soon as there was no other building for the Ministry of Commerce at that time.
The President told the official that the Ministry of Commerce can build an office by itself or the public servants can work in a small building, giving instructions that the office should be given to students.
As a result, the office of the Ministry of Commerce turned into a school in a day.
This story is one of the legends of love created by the President who spared nothing for the rising generations and made efforts for providing them with better conditions for education. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Group of Koreans in Japan for Expressing Thanks to Homeland
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from members of the group of Koreans in Japan for expressing thanks to the homeland on the 70th anniversary of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on June 3.
They said in the letter thatKim Jong Uninvited to the homeland the group of Koreans in Japan for expressing thanks to the homeland on the 70th anniversary of Chongryon and carefully considered lodging and boarding conditions as well as the schedule of their stay, bestowing his paternal benevolence on them.
The letter said:
On May 25, the anniversary of the formation of Chongryon, he sent a historic letter "Let Us Write a New Great Chapter in the History of the Movement of Koreans in Japan by Carrying Forward the Patriotic Spirit of the Founder Generation" to the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, thus making the exploits of the patriotic forerunners shine forever and providing our generation with new guidelines for strengthening Chongryon to be upheld by our generation.
We received a new strategy of struggle reflecting the intention and affection of the respected Marshal for attaching importance to Chongryon. It is a special privilege and the highest honor that only the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan can enjoy.
We will always remember this boundless love and emotion with which we celebrated the anniversary of the formation of Chongryon under the care of the respected Marshal and carry forward forever the 70-year patriotic history of Chongryon which has demonstrated its pride as a prestigious overseas compatriots' organization of the Republic by inheriting the original ideals of the foundation and the patriotic spirit of the preceding generations while flying higher the flag of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, our dignity and glory, in the sky above the alien land.
We wholeheartedly wish the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, our destiny and future, good health, for the eternal happiness of all the Korean people, the eternal prosperity of the socialist homeland and the victorious advance of the movement of Koreans in Japan. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 6 (KCNA) -- The field restoration promotion team informed the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea of its work to restore the damaged destroyer on June 5.
After restoring the balance of the destroyer early in June, the team moored it at the pier by safely conducting its end launching on Thursday afternoon.
The team will start the next-stage restoration after the reexamination of a group of experts into the overall hull of the destroyer.
The next-stage elaborate restoration is to be carried out at the dry dock of the Rajin Dockyard for the period of 7-10 days.
Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, who is guiding the work of the field restoration promotion team, said that the perfect restoration of the destroyer will be completed without fail before the convening of the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK. -0-

headline: Sports and Amusement Games Held to Mark 79th Founding Anniversary of KCU
Offering Glass of Mineral Water to Ordinary Lecturer
story_text:
One day in April 1996, ChairmanKim Jong Iltoured Ryongmun Cavern, a underground scenic spot, which was newly turned into a recreation ground for the people after its discovery.
Kim Jong Iltoured the cavern with stalagmites and dripstones of ten thousand forms, being briefed on their features. He arrived in a broad area of Ryongmun Cavern after a long time.
He stopped for a moment and called upon an official to bring mineral water.
He personally poured the mineral water into a glass and offered it to a lecturer.
He said that the lecturer would have a sore throat as she explained the features of the cavern for a long time and warmly called upon her to drink it.
He poured the mineral water into another glass and gave it to her, saying that she gave him a good explanation of the cavern.
The lecturer was deeply impressed.
That dayKim Jong Ilhad a photo session with her. -0-

story_text:

The spiritual strength of the DPRK people ushering in a new era of change is the spiritual strength of absolute loyalty devotedly supporting the ideas and leadership of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea while responding to the call of the leader with one mind and intention, the article says, and goes on:

Seeing the appearance of the country newly changed under the far-reaching plan of the respected General Secretary with each passing day, our people have cherished the viewpoint of our Party on civilization and development to steadily make a leap forward toward the higher stage of development, and hardened their firm conviction and optimism that the rosier future is not far away and their strong desire to bring earlier the bright future.
The new era of change will prosper forever as the great and proud era thanks to the indomitable spiritual strength of our people who are redoubling under the warm trust of the peerlessly great man and growing stronger in ordeals. -0-

headline: Warm Loving Care for Children
story_text:
One day in August 2023, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unphoned an official to learn about the production of school uniforms.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Untold the official that school uniforms should be produced in a qualitative way and that the sizes and measures should be ensured correctly according to designs.
He said that if parents call for school uniforms larger than sizes, it is necessary to make the tucks of trousers and skirts with 5-6 cm ease and if then, the tucks would be lowered according to children's growth. And he said that it is imperative to make a study of it and take relevant measures.
The official was deeply moved by his meticulous instructions. That day, with his warm loving care for children,Kim Jong Unstressed the need for provinces to build factories specializing in producing school uniforms and footwear and supply quality school uniforms and shoes to students.
Thanks to the measures taken byKim Jong Un, factories specializing in producing school uniforms and shoes were built in the provinces, thus establishing a well-regulated system for supplying school uniforms and shoes to the students across the country. -0-

headline: Potato Farina Production Base Is under Construction in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- A potato farina production base equivalent to the production capacity of the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory is now under construction in Paekam County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK.
If the construction of the factory is finished, it would mass- produced processed potatoes like potato noodles, potato chips and potato twist as well as potato farina.
The construction of the main production building is now entering the final stage and the construction of potato storehouse is progressing apace.
The officials and workers involved in the construction successfully carried out the huge earth removal, foundation and frame projects.
They are introducing technical innovation proposals for accelerating the next-stage project qualitatively by pooling their creative wisdom. And they are ensuring the project speed while raising their technical knowledge and skills.
The relevant units have made good results in manufacturing and assembling tens of kinds of equipment including conveyor, dryer and mixer. -0-

headline: River Improvement Projects Accelerated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- River improvement projects are being pushed forward in different parts of the DPRK.
Rason Municipality is pushing ahead with the planned task in a qualitative way while paying attention to supplying excavators, trucks, fuel and other necessary equipment and materials.
Anju City of South Phyongan Province has made good results by pushing ahead with the work to secure heavy machines like excavators by tapping internal reserves and raise the proportion of mechanization.
Pukchong County of South Hamgyong Province is ensuring the safety of arable lands and roads while pushing ahead with the projects for dredging rivers, building dikes and retaining walls as planned.
Songhwa County of South Hwanghae Province is speeding up the project, calculating the maximum amount of water, the speed of water flow and pressure on embankment. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Sectors of South Hwanghae Province
Researches Brisk at Hamhung Branch of State Academy of Sciences
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- Scientists of the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK are making achievements in the researches to ensure the fulfillment of the project in a scientific and technological way.
They solved the key problems in industrializing the production of melamine resin and put forward a rational plan for remodeling various technical processes so as to lower the standard of material consumption per unit and have contributed to putting the production of sodium carbonate on a normal basis.
They completed the technology for manufacturing the acid-proof pump blade of significance in fertilizer production in their own way and have stepped up the preparations for serial production in cooperation with field technicians.
They introduced a technology for producing synthetic resin into a paint factory and built large-capacity synthetic resin and paint production lines to ensure test operation.
They established the technology of manufacturing pigments for making soap with excellent performance indices and have expanded the production.
They studied the slow action fertilizer effective in kelp farming and have intensified the test of its application and introduction. They developed an energy-saving separation membrane technology of the Korean style which is of significance in solving the sugar problem and have pushed ahead with its introduction.
They made a contribution to modernizing the metallurgical industry by ensuring the domestic production of general gas analyzers and manufactured more than 10 kinds of analytical and measuring equipment to send them to agricultural science institutes.
They developed efficacious slow action fertilizer based on locally available raw materials and solved scientific and technological problems arising in the production of nutrient solution. -0-

headline: Anti-imperialist Independence Entirely Means Justice, Strength, Victory and Future: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- As long as mankind aspires after anti-imperialist independence, a fair and just new world will surely be built, says Rodong Sinmun Sunday in an article.
The world is now in the era of extreme chaos and radical changes, the article says, adding that threat and blackmail, confrontation and armed conflict are rampant and the danger of a nuclear war is increasing.
It goes on:
The imperialists are openly pursuing adventurous confrontation and war of driving the planet into danger to reverse the world trend of multi-polarization, an inevitable result of the development of history, and to maintain their hegemonic position at any cost.
But the trend of the times toward progress can never be reversed. The advance of mankind toward the building of a fair and just new world is accelerating despite the threat and blackmail and the worst danger of war.
The colonial era of imperialism collapsed rapidly and a new history in which the people of each country are responsible for their destiny and pioneer it has ushered in.
Though the U.S. and Western countries are running wild, the aspiration of mankind to build a fair and just new world based on the idea of anti-imperialist independence is growing stronger in different parts of the world.
Amid the ever-growing spirit of anti-imperialist independence, the imperialists' doctrine of strength-almighty is being smashed and the system of their domination is rapidly collapsing.
The role of various multilateral cooperation bodies, including the BRICS, Eurasia Economic Union and Shanghai Cooperation Organization, is enhancing day by day.  Anti-imperialist independent countries are boosting mutual cooperation in political, economic, military and other fields to cope with the moves of the U.S. and Western countries to ignite a nuclear war.
As history and reality prove, anti-imperialist independence entirely means justice, strength, victory and future.
A beautiful new world aspired by mankind is sure to be built when advancing under the uplifted banner of anti-imperialist independence. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Various Sectors of South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, inspected various sectors of South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
Learning about the preparations for operating the Hwangnam Steel Works nearing completion, Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need to thoroughly establish the system of supplying raw materials and fuel and push ahead with the work for strengthening its own technical forces in a far-sighted way, so that the works should make a substantial contribution to the economic development of the province and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
At the Sinwon Cement Factory and the wharf construction site of the Kumpho Mine under the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, he stressed the importance to put efforts into the management of equipment and technical control and actively introduce advanced construction methods, regarding it as the main task to improve the quality of products, calling on officials to make redoubled efforts and fulfill their responsibility and duty with high awareness of being leading personnel of the revolution.
Going round the Raengjong Farm in Ongjin County, the Yonyang Farm in Haeju City, the Taephung Farm in Chongdan County and other farms, he said that it is necessary to make substantial preparations for finishing the harvest of wheat and barley in good time in keeping with the remarkable increase in the area under first crop cultivation compared with last year and cultivate many good varieties of oil crops and sugar crops to supply enough raw materials to regional-industry factories.
He visited the Haeju Tractor Parts Factory and the Chongdan County Irrigation Management Station where he underscored the need to steadily improve the quality of various kinds of accessories by relying on science and technology and repair pumping power equipment and irrigation facilities in a responsible manner. At the provincial tree nursery, he called for raising a large number of wild fruit tree seedlings to suit the natural and geographical characteristics of the area and saplings needed for greening.
Learning in detail about the work of the provincial people's committee, Choe Ryong Hae underlined the need to further strengthen the guidance over law-abiding life in a methodological way as required by the policy and called on officials of power organs, the deputies to the people's assemblies in particular, to become standard-bearers in implementing the Party's policies and true servants of the people who find even one more good thing for the people. -0-

headline: Many Oil-bearing Trees Planted in Ryanggang Province
story_text:

Unhung County planted more than 30 000 oil-bearing chestnut trees in tens of hectares of areas including Taeosichon Workers' District.
Kim Jong Suk County turned the creation of 10-odd hectares of oil-bearing chestnut forest into the county work.
Officials and working people in Hyesan City and Kim Hyong Jik and Samsu counties turned out as one in creating oil-bearing forests and contributed to consolidating the foundations for the development of their regional industry. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant boasting of a unique and delicate architectural beauty is situated on the picturesque bank of the River Taedong.
As the restaurant has been furnished with indoor ponds of various kinds of freshwater and sea fish, dining rooms of different shapes and counters for processed goods, it can quickly cook and serve with various kinds of delicious fishes according to our people's taste.
The public service centre is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho spares nothing for the people, paying deep attention to providing them with a civilized life.
One day in June 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant. Seeing sturgeons, Ryongjong fishes, salmons, rainbow trout and other delicious fishes swim in indoor ponds and the counters for processed goods suited to the characteristics of the restaurant, he said people would be glad if they serve with tasty and nutritious seafood dishes prepared with fresh fishes and processed goods.
Going round the dining room, family dining room, national cookery and other dining rooms, he stressed the need for the restaurant to make the working people take a meal with their families and taste foreign dishes and to make foreign guests visiting the country serve with fish dishes.
He underlined the need to pay special attention to improving the quality of seafood dishes and meticulously conduct service activities so that the customers would not feel any inconvenience.
The restaurant serves with sturgeon, freshwater salmon, Ryongjong fish and other tasty fish.
State banquets and receptions of welcoming foreign delegations visiting the DPRK were held at the restaurant. -0-

headline: School Uniforms Supplied by State
story_text:
One day in April 1957, PresidentKim Il Sungmet some women who participated in the National Meeting of Women Activists.
The President, who offered seats to the women, asked them to talk about any problem in the work of the women's union and their life.
When they said that they had no problems, he repeatedly told them to talk about the problems frankly.
Encouraged by his repeated saying, a woman said without hesitation that students are well-clothed, but they do not look like students when they act in groups owing to their diverse clothes.
Listening to her, the President said that it is a very good opinion and that such issues should be presented, and wrote her opinion in his memo.
After a while, he consulted the officials near him about the state's supply of school uniforms and said that the state would supply the students with school uniforms from next year.
Thanks to the benevolent measures of the President who listened to the simple opinions of ordinary people and established them as state policies, all the students have been supplied with school uniforms by the state since 1958. -0-

headline: Participants in Celebrations of 79th KCU Birthday Visit Mangyongdae
Participants in Celebrations of 79th KCU Birthday Visit Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The participants in the celebrations of the 79th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union visited Mangyongdae, a sacred place of the revolution.
They visited the Mangyongdae Revolutionary Museum.
Being told about the historical relics preserved at the time-honored native home of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung, they grasped his personality as a peerlessly great man.
They also went round the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, etc.
At the Youth Movement Museum, they looked round historical relics and data telling about the exploits of the great GeneralissimosKim Il SungandKim Jong Iland the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho provided the brilliant tradition of the Juche-oriented children's movement and led the growth of the KCU members step by step.
They visited the National Exhibition of Children's Science Fiction Models and Inventions-2025 and consolidated the knowledge they learned at schools and broadened their common sense at the Central Zoo and the Natural History Museum.
The participants enjoyed a performance given by artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theater, and enjoyed themselves at cultural recreation grounds, including the Munsu Water Park and the Rungna People's Pleasure Park. -0-

Students of Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School Conduct Motivation Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- Students of Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School conducted the motivation activities at the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
They gave a performance at the farm field with a female chorus "MarshalKim Jong UnIs Our Father", motivation and song "We Are Koreans", flag motivation and song "We Are Masters of the Farm" and other numbers.
The numbers singing the pride and happiness of the agricultural workers met a response of the audience.
The songs "Burning Desire" and "My Strong Motherland", sung by the students requesting the agricultural workers to have a rich harvest in every field, inspired them with the greater sense of mission and responsibility. -0-

headline: 561st Triplets Leave Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The 561st girl triplets, born at the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital in the DPRK, left the hospital on June 9 amid the blessing of all people.
The mother of the triplets is Pak Song Mi living in the neighborhood unit No. 3, Wolhyang-dong, Moranbong District, and their father is Kim Kwang Song, an officer of the Korean People's Army.
Immediately after being diagnosed as a triplet pregnant woman in October last year, Pak Song Mi was sent to the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital to get various kinds of nutritive foods and medicines on a regular basis under the best medical assistance.
The triplets born in March weighed 2.38kg, 1.93kg and 1.7kg respectively at birth. And they weigh more than 4 kilograms at present.
The triplets and their parents in good health under the benefits of the socialist healthcare system were seen off by doctors and nurses of the hospital. -0-

headline: Driving Ordinary Woman to Hospital
story_text:
One day in December 1966, a woman was going to hospital with a sick child on her back.
After a while, a car was pulled up beside her.
When ChairmanKim Jong Ilasked where she was going with her child on back in cold weather, she said she was going to the hospital.
The Chairman personally opened the door, asking her to get into his car.
After asking her about the reason why she went to hospital, the Chairman said that if one was ill, he or she should be treated soon, not making illness worse, worrying about the health of the child.
Saying that if children are ill, we cannot expect the future and happiness, he added that only when children, the king of the country, are in good health and have a bright smile, we can smile brightly and hope for a good future.
Then he drove her to the hospital.
Only a moment later she knew that he was the Chairman and shed hot tears with emotion. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance over Construction Site of Kusong City Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance over the construction site of Kusong City Hospital on June 9.
He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Ri Hi Yong, secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Jae Ryong and Kim Yong Su, department directors of the Central Committee of the WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by officials of construction unit and design institutions.
Making rounds of the construction site, he learned in detail about the progress made in the construction.
Kusong City Hospital is one of the hospitals under construction in different scales on a demonstration basis in three cities and counties in 2025, according to the decision of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Unsaid that at present the construction sector, the major sphere of our struggle and the main front symbolizing the steady advance and development of our state, is continuously expanding and developing, and the fulfillment of the huge construction plan designed by our Party requires the rapid and qualitative strengthening of the workforce indispensably.
Construction which proves with clear entity the leap forward civilization and prosperity we are idealizing is thoroughly conducted by the workforce, the mainstay of the gigantic creative struggle, he said, adding that it is our Party's view that the preparation of the workforce means a sure guarantee for the construction revolution in the new era.
Saying that the historic task of rapidly establishing a system for expanding and strengthening the workforce by the state in a qualitative way should be solved in a right way, he underscored its importance repeatedly.
Strengthening the workforce is not an immediate short-term issue but a strategic task in the ten-year construction struggle for regional rejuvenation, he noted. He pointed out that although many workforce of the People's Army are now being dispatched to the huge construction areas unfolded by our Party and their revolutionary enthusiasm is growing day by day, the efficiency of using the workforce is not ensured at the up-to-the-standard level due to the non-specialization and inexperience in the organization and command of construction.
In order to make a vigorous advance of gigantic grand construction which our Party and state are directing much efforts, a rapid state measure should be taken for qualitative strengthening of the workforce with the main emphasis on training skilled workers, he said, adding that an intensive short course will be organized for the present to improve the practical abilities of officials in the construction sector at all levels for it.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the intensive short course of officials at all levels in the construction sector to be held after the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party should deal with the urgent problems arising in carrying out the construction revolution, including the establishment of a well-regulated system of training skilled workers.
He said that the gigantic struggle for the implementation of our Party's regional development policy should be a revolution to fundamentally and ultimately put an end to the centuries-old backwardness and laggardness of the regional areas and, at the same time, a process of transforming the old customs, outdated culture and obsolete technology that remain in the construction sector to suit the new era and a historic process of training all the builders to be creators of new culture and new civilization and genuine socialist builders.
We have a guards hero unit, that is a unit of competent construction educators with excellent construction potentiality, and if all the experience and models created by them in construction are positively applied to the construction enterprises at all levels and military construction groups, remarkable progress will be made in carrying out our Party's construction policy, he said, adding that this problem also can be solved through the practical short course.
Saying that it is a key issue to train the reliable technical forces necessary for the assembly of equipment as the hospital is a functional building which should be technically compatible with the termination of the substructure, medical equipment and appliances and all other things, unlike dwelling houses and industrial buildings,Kim Jong Unset forth a series of important tasks, which should be carried out in the construction field without a moment's delay, including the issue of examining the establishment of an enterprise specializing in the assembling of medical equipment and the issue of further increasing the proportion of construction work done by machines and steadily improving the level of modernization of equipment. -0-

headline: Entry into U.S. Is Not Matter of Our Interest: International Affairs Analyst
story_text:

This cannot be interpreted otherwise than one-sided judgment not knowing well the past and present relations between the DPRK and the U.S.
In 2017, the first term of office, the present U.S. administration included the DPRK in the list of countries subject to entry ban to the U.S. for the unjust reason that it refused to cooperate with the U.S. government and did not meet the demand for sharing information, and maintained it throughout its ruling.
This year when the second term of office began, the U.S. re-designated the DPRK as an "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" and extended again the effect of the measure for totally banning the U.S. citizens' trip to the DPRK.
The reason why the U.S. does not include the DPRK in the list can be explained only by the U.S., whether it is purely for technical reason or for political purpose.
But one obvious fact is that we are not interested in the least in the matter of entry into the U.S.
Even if the present U.S. administration has not placed the DPRK intentionally on the list of countries subject to entry ban, the DPRK is not interested in it and has no reason to be glad.

If the present U.S. administration thinks that the DPRK will accept the allowing of the entry into the U.S. as a "gift" which it neither thinks nor wants, it is miscalculation.
It is not the matter of the DPRK's concern that the U.S. unilaterally makes illegal regulations outside and places the DPRK in them or not. I think that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will, in the future, too, not welcome the entry of Americans into it.
This is a just and legitimate exercise of sovereign rights to defend the state and social system and the welfare of the people from all hostile threats of the U.S. and is quite different from the U.S. prejudiced prohibition measure on entry with malicious intention.
The DPRK will not evaluate the U.S. actions on the basis of someone's hopeful observations or subjective interpretation. It will face the U.S. on the basis of the reality and by relying on its own independent judgment. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area where a great campaign for creation is being waged to more splendidly turn the capital city of Pyongyang into an ideal city for the people, the premier encouraged the builders who are expanding the successes in the project with a single mind of loyalty to translate the noble intention of the Party Central Committee into a brilliant reality.
He stressed the need to rationalize manpower allotment and give precedence to the supply of materials now that the project is being carried out at the full-scale stage in three dimensions and, at the same time, to put efforts into raising the efficiency of construction equipment and strengthening the technical forces and actively utilize advanced construction methods so as to finish all edifices in a qualitative way by the appointed time.
At the central wholesale exchange market under construction in the Hwasong area, he heard a detailed report on the project progress made by construction units and on the finishing project plan, and took necessary measures.
Making a round of the Taedonggang Battery Factory, the premier called upon its officials and employees to boost the output of batteries with various purposes widely used in economic construction and people's living and to push forward with the work of developing and producing more new-type batteries more practical and efficient in cooperation with scientists and technicians of relevant units in a planned way.
At the Pyongyang Pig Farm and the Hadang Chicken Farm, he stressed the need to hold fast to the four links of the stockbreeding development, including putting the breeding on a scientific and technological basis and improving the veterinary and anti-epizootic work, to increase the production of pork, chicken and eggs and thus make a positive contribution to improving the diet of Pyongyang citizens.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of preferentially ensuring the transport of materials for the construction of flats in the capital city and intensifying the drive for economizing in materials and the issue of steadily increasing the productivity and quality of various kinds of batteries and dynamically putting the stockbreeding sector on a modern and scientific basis, and took measures for them. -0-

headline: Effective Nutritive Germicide Developed and Introduced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The State Bacilli-Culture Institute of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK has made achievements in developing and applying the efficacious nutritive germicide "Saengsin (freshness) No. 1".
Scientists intensified the researches for developing a germicide effective in preventing damage by various diseases, including rice bacterial leaf blight, in paddy rice, wheat, vegetable and fruit farming. In the course, they developed "Saengsin No. 1", which can be applied effectively to various crops, and introduced it into some farms.
According to the experience of the units which have introduced it, it is effective in preventing various diseases which occur in paddy rice, wheat and vegetables like cucumber, and in minimizing the damage by them.
The nutritive germicide won the new technology goods development prize at the 38th National Festival of Science and Technology. -0-

headline: Entry into U.S. Is Not Matter of Our Interest: International Affairs Analyst
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article titled "Entry into the U.S. is not a matter of our interest" on June 9:
Recently, the U.S. announced a measure to designate the peoples of 19 countries as the subjects of ban to entry into the U.S. under the pretext of "threat" to its national security.
The arrogant acts of the U.S., which is self-righteous, exclusive and racist, are now faced with strong denunciation and rejection of the international community.
Of course, it is a matter belonging to the sphere of sovereign rights of a relevant country to restrict and control the entry of foreigners.
Nevertheless, the above-said measure taken by the U.S. is incurring a censure of the international community because it is used as a malicious political tool for discriminating and pressurizing other countries.
Great irony is that there is strange interpretation that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was not included in the subjects of the U.S. ban on entry and this measure may reflect the U.S. administration's carrot stand towards the DPRK to open the door to the resumption of dialogue between the two countries.
This cannot be interpreted otherwise than one-sided judgment not knowing well the past and present relations between the DPRK and the U.S.
In 2017, the first term of office, the present U.S. administration included the DPRK in the list of countries subject to entry ban to the U.S. for the unjust reason that it refused to cooperate with the U.S. government and did not meet the demand for sharing information, and maintained it throughout its ruling.
This year when the second term of office began, the U.S. re-designated the DPRK as an "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" and extended again the effect of the measure for totally banning the U.S. citizens' trip to the DPRK.
The reason why the U.S. does not include the DPRK in the list can be explained only by the U.S., whether it is purely for technical reason or for political purpose.
But one obvious fact is that we are not interested in the least in the matter of entry into the U.S.
Even if the present U.S. administration has not placed the DPRK intentionally on the list of countries subject to entry ban, the DPRK is not interested in it and has no reason to be glad.
The U.S., which is the most hostile country to the DPRK and where xenophobia and racial discrimination have been established as a social climate and all sorts of social evils flood, can never be welcomed as the destination of the DPRK citizens' trip.
Shortly ago, the vice-president, the second-ranking person of the present U.S. administration, denounced a U.S. university for lacking "ideological diversity" and made absurd sophism about the political system of the DPRK. This is another typical example why the DPRK has repugnance for the U.S.
If the present U.S. administration thinks that the DPRK will accept the allowing of the entry into the U.S. as a "gift" which it neither thinks nor wants, it is miscalculation.
It is not the matter of the DPRK's concern that the U.S. unilaterally makes illegal regulations outside and places the DPRK in them or not. I think that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will, in the future, too, not welcome the entry of Americans into it.
This is a just and legitimate exercise of sovereign rights to defend the state and social system and the welfare of the people from all hostile threats of the U.S. and is quite different from the U.S. prejudiced prohibition measure on entry with malicious intention.
The DPRK will not evaluate the U.S. actions on the basis of someone's hopeful observations or subjective interpretation. It will face the U.S. on the basis of the reality and by relying on its own independent judgment. -0-

headline: Pyongyang International Football School
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- In Rungna Islet of Pyongyang, there is a professional sports school for training reserve football players.
The Pyongyang International Football School with modern school building, playground, dormitory and cultural and welfare facilities is a base for training reserve football players which was built under the loving care of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The respected General Secretary chose the site of the school, dispatched a construction force and named it "Pyongyang International Football School".
Going round the school one day in June 2013, he gave instructions on steadily improving the educational contents and methods as required by the developing reality and thus training more promising football players.
Over the past years, the school have created and introduced effective teaching and training methods and scientific research findings to develop the intelligence of students and increase their physical and technical abilities.
The school strengthened the teaching and training according to positions to increase the number of players with special skills and introduced various teaching and training methods combined with physical, technical, tactical and psychological training, thus making progress in improving the students' abilities.
It also developed and updated programs for putting training and coaching on a scientific basis, optical speed measuring instrument and comprehensive measuring device for physical ability, etc.
Students of the school won the AFC U-14 Girls' Regional Championship 2016 for East Zone and the Children's Festival (East Asian region).
Graduates of the school are now distinguishing themselves as forwards with score skills and as excellent organizers at the April 25 Players Team, Amnokgang Sports Team, Kigwancha Sports Team and others.
Among them are those belonging to the DPRK teams won the 2024 FIFA U-17 and U-20 women's world cups and the qualification for the 2025 FIFA U-17 World Cup. -0-

headline: New Village Built in Rason Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built in Ungsang-dong, Sonbong District of Rason Municipality, the northern end of the DPRK. So there took place the moving into new houses, which is the third of its kind in the municipality in June.
The new appearance of the countryside, where the people and mountains and rivers change beyond recognition, is a precious entity of the validity and vitality of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era set forth by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, and clearly proves that the plan of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to certainly build an ideal society in which all the regions of the country develop together and all the people are evenly well-off is being translated into a brilliant reality.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot on June 9.
Present there were officials in the municipality and the district and workers of the Ungsang agro-stock production branch of the Rason Ship Repair Factory. A congratulatory speech was made, licenses for the use of new houses were handed over and speeches were made there.
Then, the moving into new houses started amid the cheerful dancing party.
Officials visited the families moving into new houses and congratulated them, sharing the joy with them. -0-

headline: Immortal Great Programme for Development of Juche-Oriented Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade public his famous work "On Improving Secondary General Education" on June 10, 2012.
The work serves as a milestone which enabled to put the overall level of secondary general education of the country onto a new higher stage in conformity with the realistic requirements of the development of education and the world trend of development and an immortal great programme that ushered in a new era of the development of the Juche-oriented education.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unin the work comprehensively clarified the importance and main task of the secondary general education and the principled issues arising in putting the education of the country on a new high stage by decisively strengthening the secondary general education.
True to the important tasks set forth in the work, great progress has been made in the work to decisively improve and strengthen the secondary general education for over ten years.
A new history of universal 12-year compulsory education was opened, the contents of secondary general education have been updated, and effective and superior educational methods created and generalized to enable students to more deeply grasp and apply new and useful knowledge.
Many school buildings have been newly erected, remodeled and repaired, classrooms have turned into the multi-functional ones, experimental and practical apparatuses have been fully provided in experimental and practical training rooms and the whole course of teaching and experiments and practical training put on a modern and IT basis.
Universities of education and teacher training colleges have been newly turned into pedigree farms for the rising generation which train competent teachers possessed of versatile and comprehensive knowledge, practical abilities and excellent education methods.
All the people have turned out in the work to improve the educational conditions and environment in the mind of parents, thus consolidating the material foundations of education.
Thanks to the respected General Secretary, who is ushering in a new heyday of the development of the Juche-oriented education, looking forward to the future of an educational power and talent power, the younger generation of the country is growing up to be able revolutionary talents and pillars who will shoulder the future of the country. -0-

Nevertheless, the above-said measure taken by the U.S. is incurring a censure of the international community because it is used as a malicious political tool for discriminating and pressurizing other countries.
Great irony is that there is strange interpretation that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was not included in the subjects of the U.S. ban on entry and this measure may reflect the U.S. administration's carrot stand towards the DPRK to open the door to the resumption of dialogue between the two countries.
This cannot be interpreted otherwise than one-sided judgment not knowing well the past and present relations between the DPRK and the U.S.
In 2017, the first term of office, the present U.S. administration included the DPRK in the list of countries subject to entry ban to the U.S. for the unjust reason that it refused to cooperate with the U.S. government and did not meet the demand for sharing information, and maintained it throughout its ruling.
This year when the second term of office began, the U.S. re-designated the DPRK as an "uncooperative state in combating terrorism" and extended again the effect of the measure for totally banning the U.S. citizens' trip to the DPRK.
The reason why the U.S. does not include the DPRK in the list can be explained only by the U.S., whether it is purely for technical reason or for political purpose.
But one obvious fact is that we are not interested in the least in the matter of entry into the U.S.
Even if the present U.S. administration has not placed the DPRK intentionally on the list of countries subject to entry ban, the DPRK is not interested in it and has no reason to be glad.
The U.S., which is the most hostile country to the DPRK and where xenophobia and racial discrimination have been established as a social climate and all sorts of social evils flood, can never be welcomed as the destination of the DPRK citizens' trip.
Shortly ago, the vice-president, the second-ranking person of the present U.S. administration, denounced a U.S. university for lacking "ideological diversity" and made absurd sophism about the political system of the DPRK. This is another typical example why the DPRK has repugnance for the U.S.
If the present U.S. administration thinks that the DPRK will accept the allowing of the entry into the U.S. as a "gift" which it neither thinks nor wants, it is miscalculation.
It is not the matter of the DPRK's concern that the U.S. unilaterally makes illegal regulations outside and places the DPRK in them or not. I think that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea will, in the future, too, not welcome the entry of Americans into it.
This is a just and legitimate exercise of sovereign rights to defend the state and social system and the welfare of the people from all hostile threats of the U.S. and is quite different from the U.S. prejudiced prohibition measure on entry with malicious intention.
The DPRK will not evaluate the U.S. actions on the basis of someone's hopeful observations or subjective interpretation. It will face the U.S. on the basis of the reality and by relying on its own independent judgment. -0-

headline: Pyongyang International Football School
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- In Rungna Islet of Pyongyang, there is a professional sports school for training reserve football players.
The Pyongyang International Football School with modern school building, playground, dormitory and cultural and welfare facilities is a base for training reserve football players which was built under the loving care of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The respected General Secretary chose the site of the school, dispatched a construction force and named it "Pyongyang International Football School".
Going round the school one day in June 2013, he gave instructions on steadily improving the educational contents and methods as required by the developing reality and thus training more promising football players.
Over the past years, the school have created and introduced effective teaching and training methods and scientific research findings to develop the intelligence of students and increase their physical and technical abilities.
The school strengthened the teaching and training according to positions to increase the number of players with special skills and introduced various teaching and training methods combined with physical, technical, tactical and psychological training, thus making progress in improving the students' abilities.
It also developed and updated programs for putting training and coaching on a scientific basis, optical speed measuring instrument and comprehensive measuring device for physical ability, etc.
Students of the school won the AFC U-14 Girls' Regional Championship 2016 for East Zone and the Children's Festival (East Asian region).
Graduates of the school are now distinguishing themselves as forwards with score skills and as excellent organizers at the April 25 Players Team, Amnokgang Sports Team, Kigwancha Sports Team and others.
Among them are those belonging to the DPRK teams won the 2024 FIFA U-17 and U-20 women's world cups and the qualification for the 2025 FIFA U-17 World Cup. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade public his famous work "On Improving Secondary General Education" on June 10, 2012.
The work serves as a milestone which enabled to put the overall level of secondary general education of the country onto a new higher stage in conformity with the realistic requirements of the development of education and the world trend of development and an immortal great programme that ushered in a new era of the development of the Juche-oriented education.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unin the work comprehensively clarified the importance and main task of the secondary general education and the principled issues arising in putting the education of the country on a new high stage by decisively strengthening the secondary general education.
True to the important tasks set forth in the work, great progress has been made in the work to decisively improve and strengthen the secondary general education for over ten years.
A new history of universal 12-year compulsory education was opened, the contents of secondary general education have been updated, and effective and superior educational methods created and generalized to enable students to more deeply grasp and apply new and useful knowledge.
Many school buildings have been newly erected, remodeled and repaired, classrooms have turned into the multi-functional ones, experimental and practical apparatuses have been fully provided in experimental and practical training rooms and the whole course of teaching and experiments and practical training put on a modern and IT basis.
Universities of education and teacher training colleges have been newly turned into pedigree farms for the rising generation which train competent teachers possessed of versatile and comprehensive knowledge, practical abilities and excellent education methods.
All the people have turned out in the work to improve the educational conditions and environment in the mind of parents, thus consolidating the material foundations of education.
Thanks to the respected General Secretary, who is ushering in a new heyday of the development of the Juche-oriented education, looking forward to the future of an educational power and talent power, the younger generation of the country is growing up to be able revolutionary talents and pillars who will shoulder the future of the country. -0-

headline: Socialist Emulation to Implement WPK's Childcare Policy Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 11 (KCNA) -- A socialist emulation among large-scale dairy cattle farms, goat farms and stockbreeding farms is brisk to increase the number of cows and goats and boost milk production in hearty response to the childcare policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea organized the socialist emulation with the main emphasis put on modernizing the already-built dairy cattle farms, restoring and rehabilitating the city and county goat farms, taking veterinary and anti-epizootic measures and securing protein feed and feed additives.
The units participating in the emulation are strengthening their own technical forces and consolidating their material foundations and, at the same time, carrying on the examination of domestic animals and disinfection of their corrals in a responsible manner.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Efforts for Opening up New History of Socialist Health Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 12 (KCNA) – A vigorous campaign is launched in the DPRK to bring about a revolution in public health in the new era in order to promote the overall public health.
The Pyongyang General Hospital, which has been built as a world-famous medical service center on the picturesque bank of the Taedong River in the capital city, is on the eve of its opening. And the modern hospitals in Kangdong County of Pyongyang Municipality, Ryonggang County of Nampho Municipality and Kusong City of North Phyongan Province on a demonstration basis this year according to a new regional development policy are under construction on a full scale and the preparations for their operations are being stepped up.
Thanks to the noble intention of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto make the people enjoy the benefits of modern medicine to their heart's content, many modern public health facilities have been built on this land for the past ten-odd years to contribute to protecting the people's lives and promoting of their health.
The hospital village without parallel in the world has appeared in the Munsu area of Pyongyang and the Samjiyon City Hospital was built in Ryanggang Province, the northern part of the country, as the first entity which shows the outlook on socialist development of our style, to give play to its vitality.
Pharmaceutical factories, medical supplies factories, disease prevention facilities and standard pharmacies which are of great significance in promoting the people's health and taking preventive and curative medical care for them were built in different parts of the country.
Our people say with emotion that these precious creations are the fruition of love brought about by the ardent desire ofKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Un, who has aspired after the good health of the people across the country, included the construction of modern health facilities in essential projects of the regional development policy for the improvement of the health of the regional people. And he personally attended a groundbreaking ceremony of the Hospital and the Leisure Complex in Kangdong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy in February and dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the construction.
Regarding it as an important revolutionary work to improve the comprehensive public health of the country, he set forth the tasks for building not only the central-level hospitals but also hospitals in cities and counties across the country on a modern basis. He gave field guidance at the construction site of Kangdong County Hospital in June 2 and the construction site of the Kusong City Hospital some days ago to give precious instructions.
The people are enjoying a civilized life to their heart's content in good health thanks to the devoted efforts ofKim Jong Unwho is creating a new history of development of socialist public health, regarding the well-being of the people as his greatest desire. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Metro Stations Remodeled
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 12 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang, which is turning into a magnificent city with the great golden age of construction, is creating a history of huge change not only on the ground but also underground.
The Pyongyang Metro, which is associated with the noble love of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilfor the people, has been successfully remodeled under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, contributing to promoting the people's wellbeing.
ComradeKim Jong Ungave precious instructions on remodeling the stations of the Pyongyang Metro into the ones like the terminal of Pyongyang International Airport, and on issues arising in the management and operation of the metro.
Kaeson Station was remodeled ahead of May Day, the international holiday of the working people of the whole world, in 2019 and most of the metro stations have been modernized to meet the requirements of the new century, adding beauty to the scenery of the capital city of Pyongyang, true to the intention of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The underground halls and connecting corridors of Jonu, Sungri, Kwangbok, Ragwon and other stations, and their escalator sections, ceilings, pillars and walls were constructed more graceful with various styles of decorations and lightings, thus opening a new phase in formative art.
Benches, TVs, newspaper boards and temperature and humidity electric signs have been arranged in a rational way to promote the convenience of passengers waiting for subway trains.
The new-type subway trains made by DPRK workers on the principle of convenience and architectural beauty first run, adding to the beauty of changed underground Pyongyang.
The Pyongyang Metro, which Pyongyang citizens love to use, is being turned into a reliable means of transportation, a place for ideological and cultural education and good underground palace to be recorded long in history. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 12 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on June 12.
The message said:
My dearest friend Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin,
On the occasion of the national day of the Russian Federation, I, on behalf of the government and people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and on my own, extend warm congratulations and comradely greetings to you and, through you, to the fraternal government and people of Russia.
The Day of Russia, which every Russian greets with boundless dignity and self-respect filled with a solemn feeling of patriotism, is a significant holiday with a really profound meaning in the whole historical course of the Russian state, whose values are justice, freedom, self-sustenance and unity.
Today Russia is shaping its future with confidence, overcoming all sorts of internal and external challenges and threats under your wise and seasoned leadership, and we feel really pleased with the successes achieved by the Russian Federation, our fraternal state.
I am fully convinced that the sacred cause of the government and people of your country to defend their national sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity and build a powerful Russia will surely emerge victorious.
Esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin,
Today the traditional DPRK-Russia friendship has been further cemented thanks to the militant comradeship the service personnel of the two countries have forged at the cost of their blood in the just sacred war to defend the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Russia; it has developed into an excellent model of indestructible, genuine relationship between comrades-in-arms and between allies.
It is an unshakable will of the government of the DPRK and of my own steadfastly to carry on the DPRK-Russia relations, which have been sealed and verified in the face of all sorts of trials and challenges of history, to a heyday of comprehensive prosperity.
I and the DPRK will always stand with you and the Russian Federation.
My dearest comrade,
I sincerely wish you good health, and the fraternal Russian people success, well-being and prosperity all the time.
I reaffirm my best wishes to you. -0-

headline: To Free Farmers from Labor-Consuming Work
story_text:
One day in November 1965, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Chongsan Cooperative Farm in Kangso County, South Phyongan Province.
After discussing the work of the farm with its primary officials until sunset, the President asked them if they had anything to propose.
An official of the farm said that there is a tendency among some farmers not to use tractors well as they think that they would receive less share after paying off the tractor fee, adding that it is good to make sure that farmers use farm machines at will.
An official of a national agency got up and said that if tractors are handed over to the cooperative farm according to him, they would be broken.
After thinking for a while, the President said that we made tractors while working hard to mechanize farming and free the farmers from labor-consuming work and if farmers do not use tractors owing to the breakout of tractors and fee, they would not free from the labor-consuming work.
He warmly said that his desire would be attained if he heard the word that farmers use machines as much as they wish, although tractors are out of order and the state suffers a loss.
Like this, the President, who regarded it as his desire to free farmers from labor-consuming work, made a far-reaching plan for mechanization of agriculture and energetically led the struggle to realize it. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony of Launching Destroyer of KPA Navy Takes Place with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The firm faith and steadfast revolutionary will of the Workers' Party of Korea to firmly defend the long-term development of the prosperity and flourish of our great state with its strong, matchless and absolute strength are ushering in a shining heyday of the naval forces of the DPRK along with the steady birth of the powerful Juche-based military hardware.
Another multi-mission destroyer, which will firmly guarantee the maritime sovereignty and national interests of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, has greeted the historic moment of recording the sacred name of defender in the history, demonstrating the invariable will of our Party to build a powerful army aspiring after only advance without tolerating frustration and stagnation under any unfavourable conditions.
A continuous possession of a new-type destroyer, which has been achieved by the stubborn efforts and unyielding fighting spirit in the sacred journey for the strengthening and development of the Juche-oriented naval forces, serves as a great demonstration of indomitable mental power of the workers in the field of the warship-building industry and the reserved strength of our national power and, at the same time, a matchless step forward in realizing the marine strategy of the Party Central Committee to reliably defend the security of the country and the world peace.
A ceremony of launching the destroyer of the Navy of the Korean People's Army took place at the Rajin Shipyard on June 12.
Present at the ceremony were senior Party, government and military officials, workers, scientists, technicians and officials in the field of the warship-building industry, officers and men of the KPA Navy, the commanding officers and seamen of the destroyer, teaching staff and students of Kim Jong Suk Naval University, commanding officers of the services and corps-level units of the KPA and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The venue of the ceremony, which shows the far-reaching ideal and valiant spirit of Juche Korea towards an advanced maritime power, was full of absolute trust in ComradeKim Jong Un, who is steadfastly accelerating the historic rejuvenation of the revolution in the warship-building industry in the new era, and great pride and self-respect in the ever-growing inexhaustible strength of our state.
The guard of honor of the KPA Navy solemnly lined up, waiting for the moment of glory.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony where the latest multi-mission destroyer was moored majestically, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers with the greatest glory and respect, looking up to the peerless patriot and ever-victorious brilliant commander who is overcoming the untrodden path for the country's prosperity and safety of all generations to come and rough road for hewing out it with his great strenuous efforts and iron will to usher in a great heyday of building a maritime power where the desire of the nation's history spanning 5 000 years is being met relievedly.
There was a ceremony of greetingKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unreviewed the colours of honour of the KPA Navy and its guard of honour.
He was courteously greeted by major commanding officers of the Navy with boundless reverence for him.
There was a march-past of the guard of honour of the KPA Navy.
Kim Jong Untook the platform followed by senior officials of the Party and government, the commander of the KPA Navy and other commanding officers of the navy, commanding officers of the services and corps-level units of the KPA, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, officials in the field of munitions industry, and officials and merited persons in the field of warship-building.
The national anthem of the DPRK was solemnly played.
Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, delivered a commemorative address.
Expressing his profound emotion about the fact that the new-type destroyer No. 2, which will take the place on the forefront of the DPRK's sea defence capability thanks to the high revolutionary enthusiasm and strenuous efforts of the workers in the field of the warship-building industry, is to launch in the blue waters of the East Sea at last and the result could be given to the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee, the speaker said that this serves as a proud and auspicious event which makes it possible to feel that the era which the ideal and goal of the DPRK and its growing national power reach the ocean, is really coming closer as the dignified entity of the warship.
Referring to the fact that as for the leading restraining force for sea defence, the new-type multi-mission destroyer is equipped with comprehensive combat capability which was developed in our own way and improved in its might to make a retaliatory strike for annihilation against the hostile forces who are going to challenge the sovereignty of our state and encroach upon its right to peace and prosperity, though they are in the coastal waters, the ocean and the land while freely moving in and out the East Sea and the Pacific as a yard, he affirmed that today's launching ceremony will demonstrate that the new era of the maritime power aspired by our Party, state and people is an undeniable reality.
