The DPRK's warship-building industry will achieve more remarkable successes as it is led by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand has the precious experience and lessons gained in the unyielding struggle, the speaker said, expressing his determination to give fuller play to the transparent spirit of faithfully supporting the idea and leadership of the great Party Central Committee and to develop greater strength of creation and thus make all efforts to the sacred struggle for proudly demonstrating the DPRK, our dignified and powerful country, before the world.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, announced an order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK on the grading regulations and naming of the destroyer which signed byKim Jong Unand conveyed a certificate of the warship grading and naming to the commander of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy at the ceremony.
According to the order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the newly-built destroyer was graded as the Choe Hyon class and named Kang Kon.
Kim Jong Unconferred the ensign of destroyer Kang Kon on the commanding officers of the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy.
Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, cut the rope in token of the ceremony of launching the destroyer.
For a moment, a veil over the warship name was removed with the warship whistle and fireworks were set off and balloons flew up and decorated the sky beautifully.
Kim Jong Unmounted the destroyer.
The warship, which greeted the moment of honour of undergoing the first inspection by the Supreme Commander, was filled with militant enthusiasm.
After receiving the salute of the captain,Kim Jong Ungave them warm encouragement, going round the stem and quarter deck of the warship.
The memorial relief image of anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter Kang Kon, the first chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, was unveiled on the destroyer.
Praying that the youthfulness devoted to the cause of building a state and founding an army and the strong and brave stamina and valuable spirit which Kang Kon, a prominent militarist representing the heroic spirit of the KPA and genuine communist revolutionary, demonstrated on the road of the southward advance, would be a propelling power pushing the warship and permanent nutrition of a-match-for-a-hundred combat spirit to encourage the seamen in the new era to record only victorious furrow and inspire the eternal prosperity of the navy of the DPRK,Kim Jong Unplaced a flower before the relief image of him, army-building meritorious retainer, and paid high tribute to him.
He met and encouraged the scientists, technicians and workers in the field of warship-building industry who contributed to the construction of the destroyer and its restoration of the original state.
Shaking the hands of each meritorious person,Kim Jong Unexpressed his heartfelt thanks to the patriotic loyalty and labor feats of them who made a contribution to perfectly implementing the order of the Central Military Commission of the Party by displaying their excellent professional qualifications and ability with one mind in building warships of the new generation and restoring it.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a commemorative address.
He said that the grand launching ceremony of destroyer No. 2 shows that the new era of building a fleet, which has raised the anchor of sacred pioneering, is making steady progress and our huge warship-building plans aimed at building the world-level naval forces are being pushed forward with most correctly and quickly. And he expressed his deep thanks to the heroic workers in the field of the warship-building industry, including those of Chongjin and Rajin shipyards, and scientists, technicians and officials of relevant sector who brought about a very important event showing a change made by the extremely rapid development of our warship-building industry.
There was an absurd cause which impaired the dignity and prestige of the country in a moment due to the absolute irresponsibility and unscientific empiricism, but no obstacle could delay the important course of bolstering up the naval combat power, he said, adding that this is another proof of the power of our mode of revolution and development as nourishment essential for the progress and leap of the warship-building industry.
He said that we can bring about a radical turn in the warship-building industry as we have a strong will and have secured our own reliable forces and great technical power to guarantee it in practice, and he clarified the defence strategy and practical measures of our Party for the rapid strengthening of the naval forces, including the building of two destroyers, which are like Choe Hyon class or bigger than it, and the deployment of them in operational waters every year from next year according to the constant view of our navy that it must have the counterattacking strength and capability to prevent aggression.
Our cause of ushering in the golden era of the Navy has entered the full-scale stage, he said, expressing expectation and conviction that the workers in the field of shipbuilding industry would build many large modern warships, which are suitable for the great image of the military power planned and decided by the Party, with their boundless loyalty, patriotism, ability which can not be ignored and unyielding executive ability, and thus continue to write a new history of the leap forward in the shipbuilding industry.

He highly praised the heroic feats of Jo Kum Hyok, head of the Sheet Metal Processing Workteam No. 1 of the Modernization Workshop under the Chongjin Shipyard who died at the worksite during the building of the destroyer, and met his wife and son to console them.
Kim Jong Unawarded the main commanding officers of the destroyer commemorative copper coins and had a photo taken with the commanding officers and sailors of the destroyer in front of the destroyer Kang Kon, which will be recorded in the army-building history.
He expressed his great trust that all the sailors of the destroyer would reliably carry forward the great spirit and indomitable bravery of the army-founding generation who honorably defended the sovereignty of our Republic, and thus glorify with brilliant feats the immortal exploits performed by the Navy before the country and its glorious furrow of defence.
All the commanding officers and sailors of the destroyer with the highest honor of being the first to be inspected and blessed by the head of state, expressed gratitude toKim Jong Un, and pledged to fully demonstrate the heroic fighting spirit of the DPRK Navy and firmly defend the territorial waters of the country along the sea route of victory indicated by the Party Central Committee.
He also met the workers, scientists, technicians, skilled workers and officials in the shipbuilding field, including those of Chongjin and Rajin shipyards, who contributed to the building of the warships. And he had left a picture of love and trust, expressing expectation that they would launch invincible warships one after another in the sea of the country with more vigorous redoubled efforts and dynamic struggle so as to continue to dynamically write a great history of steadily increasing the great power of the Korean People's Army.
A performance was given to celebrate the launching of the destroyer.
The launching ceremony is a full demonstration of the prompt decision and will of the WPK to firmly defend the national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests by rapidly developing the DPRK Navy as a powerful service performing a part of the state nuclear deterrent. It is also an occasion of great importance that injects great vitality in the patriotic struggle of the DPRK people advancing dynamically toward the future of prosperity with high aims and ideal.
The fame of the heroic people's navy increasing daily with the glorious era ofKim Jong Unwill shine as a symbol of the bravery and victory of indomitable socialist Korea, and the fighting power reaching the vast ocean will demonstrate to the whole world its dignity and might as the treasured sword of defending justice and peace. -0-

headline: Officials of C.C., Youth League Support Rural Areas Materially and Morally
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League are turning out in assisting rural areas.
The Central Committee of the youth league learned about the Ryongsan Farm in Sinchon County and is taking measures to solve the problems arising in farming.
They provided the furniture for arranging well and managing the bases for ideological education, displayed the Workers' Party of Korea's basic slogans and mottos at the ri seat and workteams in a brighter and more respectful manner, and conducted the political work to encourage the agricultural workers to do farming as befitting the masters.
They took the lead in the difficult and labor-consuming work by setting personal examples, concentrating on finishing rice-transplanting in the right time and in a qualitative way.

headline: Regeneration Rice Cultivation Technique Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences of the DPRK have newly established a regeneration rice cultivation technique which contributes to minimizing flood damage in paddy rice farming.
This technique is of great significance in overcoming the effects of the disastrous abnormal weather and increasing grain production because it can increase rice production in the paddies which are difficult to expect crop yields owing to flood damage.
Scientists conducted the researches to establish the regeneration rice cultivation technique suited to the actual conditions of the country in some areas flooded last year.
The scientists who developed the regeneration rice cultivation technique in flooded paddies won a national sci-tech achievements introduction certification. -0-

headline: Activities of Scientists and Technicians Brisk at Major Worksites in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians in the DPRK are playing an active part in major worksites for the development of the self-supporting economy.

Scientists of various scientific and educational units dispatched to the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration have settled many sci-tech problems arising in putting the hydro-meteorological field on a modern and scientific basis including developing the Korean-style numerical weather forecast system and various integrated forecast system by artificial intelligence technology.

Those who dispatched to the Ministry of Public Health have developed high-performance nucleic-acid rapid test equipment by their own way.
The members of the February 17 Scientists and Technicians Shock Brigade dispatched to the tideland reclamation command team opened up a prospect for tideland embankment project in a scientific way. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Greatest Pleasure
story_text:
One day in November 2000, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited a newly-built chicken farm.
Making rounds of various places of the modern chicken farm for a long time, the Chairman paid deep attention to providing the people with more tasty and nutritious chicken and eggs.
The sun was setting in the west.

Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The Komdok Mining Complex of the DPRK has made another guarantee for further increasing the productivity by updating a large long-distance belt conveyor transport line.

headline: Wreaths Laid at Liberation Towers and Cemeteries of Fallen Fighters of Soviet Army in DPRK
story_text:

Those who dispatched to the Ministry of Public Health have developed high-performance nucleic-acid rapid test equipment by their own way.

The message hoped that the relations between the two countries would develop. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Makes Speech at Ceremony of Launching Destroyer of Navy of Korean People's Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at a ceremony of launching a destroyer of the Navy of the Korean People's Army on June 12.
The full text of the speech is as follows:
Workers, scientists, technicians and officials in the shipbuilding industry and several other sectors, who are working with devotion on the major front of the warship-building industry with a far-reaching ambition of building a military giant,
Officers and men of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, who are boundlessly loyal to their mission of defending the territorial waters, and cadets of the naval university,
Family members of the employees of the shipyards and ship repair yards, who are devoting unknown efforts to the patriotic work of increasing our national strength,
Comrades,
The second new-type destroyer, convincing proof of the rapid transformation of our Navy, has assumed its sturdy appearance and greeted the day when it will get its name.
No one will doubt, I think, the rapid transformation of our Navy as they have witnessed the launching of another new-type destroyer less than two months after a similar event at the Nampho Shipyard.
As I made it clear at Nampho last April, they will deeply feel that a new era of modernization of our Navy has now arrived and is making an uninterrupted, steady headway.
Despite the persisting difficulties and obstacles, our gigantic warship building projects to build an advanced naval capability are being promoted most correctly and quickly.
Of course, we felt panic-stricken in front of the unexpected and ridiculous accident caused while launching this destroyer in Chongjin last month, but our crucial journey for increasing the combat capability of our Navy has never been delayed.
The challenge was created not by any failure or setback that we may face or experience unavoidably in the course of advance, but by sheer irresponsibility, carelessness and other factors. This was something that must never occur, but it simply did not mean a loss for us, I think.
We judged the accident not as a simple mistake but as a never-to-be-forgiven, serious criminal act that lowered the dignity and self-respect of our state in a moment, and investigated the root cause of the accident in a comprehensive way. In the course of this, we discovered to the last one the dangerous factors that had to be removed without fail, took relevant measures, and ensured that rapid restoration of the vessel was conducted at lightning speed, regarding it as an important political task.
As a result, the vessel was set on a safe posture and put to sea just over two weeks after the accident had taken place; and today its complete restoration has been rounded off as planned in the lead-up to a plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee.
I believe that the course of restoring the destroyer was an epochal occasion for making those responsible for the warship-building industry perform themselves a cool examination of their own ideological viewpoint and stand towards their professional jobs and acquire a responsible and immaculate way of work.
During the recent restoration work, the reliability and technical superiority of the destroyer's design was confirmed and development-oriented opinions were raised for building warships.
And a strict and due blow was delivered to incautiousness, irresponsibility, indolence, unscientific work attitude and empiricism latent in different sectors of our work.
Terrible man-made disasters caused by such irresponsibility and lack of scientific accuracy are now a commonplace in several other sectors and fields–railways, transport, power industry and construction sites to name a few.
This time we dealt a telling blow at the unscientific attitudes and viewpoints steeped in such irresponsibility and empiricism.
In a certain sense, I think that we have gone through a necessary process, and in view of all our future work, it was not a loss of time. I also think that this time we have drawn a great lesson.
The super-radical growth of our Navy's operations capability is now being proved by powerful entities, not by a prediction or possibility, and this has already become an unstoppable, powerful current of history.
Our steps in writing a new chapter in the history of the Navy are being accelerated by a great motive power, and more innovative and successive results prepared–this is the important meaning of today's launching and naming ceremony of the warship.
Our launching of Choe Hyon-class destroyer No. 2 that will perform multi-mission operations is another significant event, which fully demonstrates the indomitable will and strong executing abilities peculiar to our Party and people bravely clearing the untrodden path for realizing their ennobling ideals.
This warship will be handed over to the Navy in the middle of next year after its weapon systems have become integrated, and the assessment of its performance and capability for conducting operations, the test of its integrated operation and other several necessary procedures have been rounded off.
Availing myself of this important opportunity, I would like to express my warm thanks to the workers, technicians and officials of the Chongjin and Rajin shipyards and other units in the shipbuilding industry for powerfully demonstrating the invincible might of Korea and the mettle of its people in admirably building new-generation destroyer No. 2 of our Republic by responding through collaborative innovations to the miraculous achievement at the Nampho Shipyard. My thanks also go to the related sectors that are directing devoted efforts to the warship-building industry.
I would also like to offer my warm congratulations to the sailors of this destroyer, who I believe will write pages of distinguished services in the annals of our proud Navy together with the honourable name of Kang Kon.
Comrades,
As far as I know, there are only a few nations in the world that build such a warship by their own efforts.
Our warship-building industry has set sail for its development in real earnest, setting long-term objectives to be attained by the related industries, and this process is promoting their development.
As innovative warship-building processes have been established in the field of shipbuilding industry and an absolute standard, namely, new-generation destroyer, has been set, research and development projects for appropriate equipment are now underway to reach the targets set clearly in compliance with the strict requirements.
To take an example, the detection and electronic warfare sector has made a leap forward.
As it has to be consistent with the destroyer's tactical and technical specifications, the radar system research sector has accelerated its work to meet the strict standards and attain targets, with the result that it has achieved remarkable progress and opened a bright prospect for its development.
The success is not limited only to the on-board radar; it will serve as a solid springboard for a chain of technical revolution in the whole of our military hardware development and manufacturing sector.
Also, the development of a complex integrated on-board weapon management system has made it possible to apply AI technology under combat situations and define the development orientation of this sector.
Various kinds of surface and torpedo weapon systems are now under research and development and, importantly, a radical change is predicted in the engine dynamic system configuration of warships.
Today we are stepping up the revolution in the warship-building industry full steam not only because we are firm in our will but because we have secured our own industrial potentials and a high level of technical capabilities for guaranteeing the revolution in practice.
We ought to feel self-confident and proud in the rapid development of our warship-building industry.
The fact that the leading shipbuilding bases in the western and eastern coastal areas have built new-generation destroyers immaculately confirms that we have two powerful pillars capable of supporting the rapid development of our shipbuilding industry.
In the course of building new-type destroyers, our shipbuilding industry has recorded a new page of developing and building giant warships by its own efforts, set an eye-opening record in its speed and standards, and verified its inexhaustible potentials fully capable of propelling the revolution in the warship-building industry.
In the struggle to implement the Party's lines and policies, the internal forces that are capable of shouldering the present and future of the warship-building industry have increased remarkably and a large number of workers have grown up into hard-core elements. These are the most precious and powerful asset for achieving our cause of building an advanced maritime power which we must carry out without fail and accomplish with credit.
Through the recent course of building a new-type destroyer despite many difficulties, the workers of the Chongjin and Rajin shipyards have added lustre to their proud struggling tradition and mettle of building ships badly needed in defending the maritime sovereignty and developing the marine transport and fishing industry of the country, and grown up into reliable masters of the shipbuilding industry.
In particular, they produced a patriot who ended his ennobling life that will remain long in the affectionate memory of all people.
That was Jo Kum Hyok, leader of sheet-metal processing workteam No. 1 of the modernization workshop of the Chongjin Shipyard.
I was told that he put his heart and soul into the building of this destroyer though his health was in a poor condition, before breathing his last at his workplace.
I feel my heart rending to recall him, who passed away a few days before this ceremony of launching the destroyer associated with his painstaking efforts.
As I think that this warship is on the sea not merely by means of physical buoyancy but by dint of the pure loyalty and ardent patriotism of our working class, I am wrapped in solemn feelings.
His wife and son must be present here at this ceremony.
I extend deep sympathy to his wife and family members. Our motherland will highly appreciate his genuine life and remember it for ever.
The bereaved family members will be given a socialist patriotic sacrifice certificate, and the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Party and the Party organization of the Chongjin Shipyard will take good care of them and ensure that his son grows up to be a genuine man who will devote himself for the sake of the Party and the country just as his father did.
Our Party will propose to award high official commendations to exemplary persons who have been tested and tempered spiritually and ideologically in the struggle for building the modern warships at the Nampho and Chongjin shipyards and to admit them to its organization.
Highly appreciating Jo Kum Hyok and other workers of the Chongjin Shipyard for the ennobling spiritual world and feats of labour they displayed and performed while working with devotion in the struggle for the country's prosperous future, I express deep thanks to all the workers in the shipbuilding sector for discharging their honourable mission and revolutionary duty in the effort to make ceaseless progress in modernizing our Navy.
Comrades,
The warship the Chongjin Shipyard has built this time is a super-powerful, state-of-the-art multi-mission destroyer, whose structure, performance and all other elements of the weapon systems are identical with those of the Choe Hyon launched earlier.
I am sure that these two warships built in 2025 will play a great role in improving the operations capability of our Navy.
As we have declared already, we will continue to build every year two destroyers of the same or higher class and commission them into the Navy.
Not long ago, the Party Central Military Commission officially endorsed a project of building two 5 000 ton-class destroyers additionally next year.
This portends an important and epochal change in the position and defence activities of our Republic's Navy.
The new-generation warships, which will be built and commissioned according to the already-confirmed warship-building plan and the general warship designs, will enlarge the operations scope and capabilities of our Navy at a strategic level.
The greater the combat capability of our naval forces becomes, the farther waters our Navy will reach away from our territorial waters; and the farther the operations sphere of our Navy extends on the oceans, the more inevitable our enemies' strategic retreat will be.
This means that the dignity of our Republic's honourable Navy, famed for its heroic fighting spirit, will be demonstrated not only in our territorial waters but in the vast expanse of oceans as well.
Comrades,
I would like to remind you, in a brief summary, that our state's overall security environment, namely on land, at sea, and in the air, is unpredictably perilous owing to the enemy's adventurous sabre-rattling that may trigger a nuclear war.
In particular, our neighbouring waters have turned into the most dangerous hotbed of nuclear war, where nuclear strike means, such as the US Navy's nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and submarines and other warships, appear any time.
The military situation around our state has deteriorated, so much so that we can feel it not unusual but quite common to see the appearance of the US Navy's and Air Force's strategic nuclear means.
No waters adjacent to any other country is as dangerous as ours, where one of the belligerents deploys a large number of warships and persists with its open nuclear war drills against the other.
Recently, the armies of the United States and its vassal states grow undisguised in their provocative ambitions, and their threats to our security have clearly gone well beyond the danger limit.
Given the prevailing situation, our decision is definite and consistent.
In dealing with our aggressive rival we will respond to each one of its manoeuvres immediately and with equal strength, and we will take overwhelming military actions each time.
Possessing operations capability on the oceans and exercising naval power there is our indispensible option for defending our national sovereignty and security interests.
It is not long before the enemy forces themselves will experience how offending and unpleasant it is to have to watch their rival's warships cruising on the fringes of their territorial waters.
Certainly, soon afterwards, our warships' routes to the enemy's naval ports, outposts of their invasion, in the Pacific will be opened, and the names of our enemy states' major ports and sea waters will be recorded in the logbooks of our East Sea and West Sea fleets.
This accords with the freedom of navigation that is guaranteed for our state.
We will exercise our rights fairly and squarely.
Our Navy's creed should be that it can prevent invasion only when it is capable of counter-attacking and builds up such a capability.
We have such a capability.
And we will surely build it up.
We should accelerate the development of our Navy's fighting capability in a more comprehensive way so that the enemy will not dare attempt to initiate any aggressive action in our neighbouring waters.
Comrades,
Our cause of opening up a golden age for the Navy has entered a full-scale stage, but this is no reason for us to rest on our laurels.
The workers, scientists and technicians in the shipbuilding industry, standing in the vanguard of our grandiose struggle to develop the Juche-oriented naval forces, should give full play to their unfailing loyalty, patriotism, remarkable qualifications and unflinching executing abilities, thus creditably building powerful warships as planned and decided upon by our Party.
My future plan is to open up a new booming stage for the shipbuilding industry with the Chongjin Shipyard as the backbone and build on an extensive scale modern large warships befitting the prestige of a military power.
It is high time for us to advance towards the goal of attaining the global standards in our shipbuilding industry, which will represent the future of a maritime country.
As a shipbuilding giant of the country, the Chongjin Shipyard should boldly upgrade its technical and production processes and supplement what is lacking, so as to complete its features as a modern industrial unit; then it should build more advanced warships than this Choe Hyon-class destroyer.
This may seem to be a challenging task, but only by carrying it out can the shipyard fulfil its role, which has been rated primary, in helping the country take on the true appearance of a maritime power.
The Party and the state should put an emphasis on ensuring that, in addition to the Chongjin Shipyard, this Rajin Shipyard and all the other shipbuilding bases, which have their due role to play in effecting the revolution in the warship-building industry, push ahead, according to schedule, with their long-term projects and immediate work plans. This will give renewed impetus to the comprehensive upgrading of our shipbuilding industry that is definitely advancing on a new track of development.
Comrades,
We should keep in mind that every warship we are building and their launching has a direct bearing not only on our maritime sovereignty but also on the sacred dignity and prestige of our state.
I trust the workers in the warship-building sector.
I hope that the workers, technicians and officials of this shipyard, united with one mind and will behind the Party Central Committee, will make a substantial contribution to ushering in an era of great rejuvenation for our shipbuilding industry.
Comrades,
Our beloved East Sea is welcoming its trustworthy defender.
The Kang Kon will set out on a voyage, which is linked to our people's peace and wellbeing.
Warships of a new generation are to be launched one after another in the coming years, and they will form the backbone of our maritime defence forces. They will demonstrate the honour and dignity of our state, opening up a route to peace and prosperity for our country and people advancing towards the goal of comprehensive rejuvenation.
Courageous sailors of the Kang Kon, who are beginning an honourable service aboard this matchless warship named after the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter,
The Kang Kon, along with the Choe Hyon, will win fame as an invincible warship defending the purity and beauty of our seas with credit.
I believe you will brave any raging storm and follow the route to victory, mindful of the patriotic desires of Kang Kon who, in the prime of his life, performed brilliant exploits in the battlefields for achieving national liberation and defending the country.
Officials and workers in the shipbuilding sector and all the workers at the Chongjin and Rajin shipyards,
Let us march vigorously towards the goal of building an advanced maritime power in the new century, while carrying out the historic tasks facing us without fail.
Long live our heroic working class!
Long live the brave Navy of Korea!
Long live the Democratic People's Republic of Korea! -0-

headline: Many People in DPRK Visit Yuphyong Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- An endless stream of ranks of succession have visited the Yuphyong Revolutionary Site telling about the exploits performed by PresidentKim Il Sungfor war victory.
At dawn on October 26, 1950, the President arrived in Yuphyong-ri despite the gunfire, and stayed outside of a house by a campfire, keeping the attendants back from waking up the house owner.
At this place the President instilled faith in sure victory into commanding officers and men of the Korean People's Army during the grim Fatherland Liberation War and set forth an operational plan for wiping out the aggressors by switch over to a counteroffensive on all fronts.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Yuphyong Revolutionary Site in June 2013 and said that one day when the President stayed there is an unforgettable day to be recorded long in the history of the Workers' Party of Korea.
More than 100 000 officials, working people, service personnel, school youth and children of over 2 200 units, including the Party and power organs, ministries, national agencies, universities and units of the People's Army across the country, visited the Yuphyong Revolutionary Site for over ten years to bear in mind the noble intention of the peerlessly great man. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Rajinpho Farm in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Rajinpho Farm in Yonan County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK. So farmers there moved into new houses, which is the third of its kind.
Modern houses and nurseries have been built this year again and trees of good species grow in the new villages. The appearance of the new villages tells about the great benevolence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making indefatigable efforts to make the agricultural workers of the country enter the  communist society before anyone else.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses held on the spot on June 12 were officials and agricultural workers in the province and the county.
At the ceremony, a speech was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over.
At the end of the ceremony, the officials congratulated the agricultural workers on moving into new houses amid the cheerful dancing party.
A performance of the central artistic information team was given to congratulate the farmers moving into the new houses. -0-

headline: Equipment Made on Experimental Basis for Regional-Industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- The February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians, dispatched to the non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy, studied and manufactured tens of kinds of equipment on an experimental basis for the regional-industry factories, which are newly being built, by the end of May.
The State Academy of Sciences produced various kinds of equipment including bread and sugar production equipment.
Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry designed and manufactured a vacuum concentrator in conformity with the actual conditions of the country in a peculiar way, thus reducing the power consumption of the vacuum pump as compared with the imported equipment and increasing the output by two times.
Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering developed various kinds of equipment by promoting their designing and manufacturing.
Scientists of Kim Chaek University of Technology studied and manufactured a handy vacuum wrapper with high performance and low cost.
Several production units have started the operation test on tens of kinds of the new equipment made on an experimental basis. -0-

headline: Field Medical Service Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- Medical service of the preventive and curative organizations in the DPRK is brisk at major worksites of the national economy.
Medical workers in North Hamgyong Province went to coal mines in the northern part of the country, carrying with various kinds of medical appliances and medicines. They have taken measures for treating coal miners according to their health state and contributed to helping them produce more coal.
Medical workers of the South Phyongan Provincial Pediatric Hospital examined and cured the children at the nursery and kindergarten of the Sunchon Cement Complex.
Medical workers of the North Hwanghae Provincial General Hospital installed ophthalmic treatment equipment and conducted medical activities at the production sites of the Sunchon Chemical Complex and the Sariwon Textile Mill, encouraging their workers.
Medical workers of the Nampho Municipal General Hospital and other preventive and curative units in Nampho Municipality devoted their sincerity to the medical examination and treatment for farmers and helpers.
Medical workers of the South Hamgyong Provincial General Hospital and the Hamhung Orthopedic Hospital are redoubling the morale of the working people at major worksites. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprise
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at a major munitions industry enterprise on June 13.
The enterprise was visited by Jo Yong Won, Kim Tok Hun, Ri Hi Yong, O Su Yong, Kim Jong Sik and other leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister, Ko Pyong Hyon, chairman of the Second Economic Commission, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army and chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK.
Making the rounds of various production sites of the enterprise, including press, spinning and assembly workshops, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned in detail about the production of shells, capacity expansion and modernization in the first half of the year 2025.
He expressed his great satisfaction over the high enthusiasm for the patriotic deeds and struggle displayed by the workers at the munitions industry enterprise who are kindling the fierce flames of innovation after turning out in the drive to greet the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and the Ninth WPK Congress with the praiseworthy successes of boosting the military hardware output.
Kim Jong Unpraised the development successes of the enterprise which has modernized itself at a high level by rationally relocating all the production lines in hearty response to the plan of the Party Central Committee for rapidly developing our defence industry into a world-level advanced one. He underscored the need to set the development-oriented goal in order to meet the long-term demand of the development of the national defence capabilities and set forth new tasks to be carried out by the enterprise.
In order to satisfy all the requirements of the national defence strategy and increase the output of new-type powerful shells to meet the requirements of the modern warfare, it is necessary to further expand and reinforce the production capacity, arrange the production lines more rationally and steadily raise the level of putting production on an unmanned basis, he said and advanced the tasks for doing so.
The accompanying visitors felt the civilized way of life of the workers in the munitions industry, looking round the ideological education bases in an educational district of the enterprise where the landscaping has been realized at a high level, and a cultural hall, comprehensive cultural and welfare establishments, modern childcare facilities and cosy dwelling houses built well in the district for workers' living. -0-

headline:
Valuable Appreciation Given by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2025.06.14.]
story_text:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Chollima Tile Factory one day in August 2014.
While making the rounds of the factory,Kim Jong Undropped in at the field laboratory.
An official of the factory toldKim Jong Unthat it is a field laboratory and that technicians of the factory assembled an adhesive production equipment and developed a new product by themselves, adding the determination of the factory to increase the variety of products and improve their quality by developing stone materials in the future.
Kim Jong Unsaid his desire to work is very high and that a senior official should have a strong desire to work and that he was pleased that the field laboratory was arranged for the development of products and analysis of raw materials.
Hearing the story of the official of the factory that it is producing and providing various kinds of quality tiles for the construction sites, he instructed the accompanying officials that we should do everything by our own efforts and technology, not relying on others.
At the place where the iron fence production process was arranged, he said that the factory is producing iron fences by itself, how good it is to arrange the raw materials and product storehouses with the iron fences produced at the factory and that this factory is really a patriots' factory and a splendid factory.
The valuable appreciation given by him reflected his deep intention wanting to produce more excellent products which can be proud of as ours, both in name and reality, by our own efforts and technology by giving full play to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Rajinpho Farm in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Rajinpho Farm in Yonan County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK. So farmers there moved into new houses, which is the third of its kind.
Modern houses and nurseries have been built this year again and trees of good species grow in the new villages. The appearance of the new villages tells about the great benevolence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making indefatigable efforts to make the agricultural workers of the country enter the  communist society before anyone else.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses held on the spot on June 12 were officials and agricultural workers in the province and the county.
At the ceremony, a speech was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over.
At the end of the ceremony, the officials congratulated the agricultural workers on moving into new houses amid the cheerful dancing party.
A performance of the central artistic information team was given to congratulate the farmers moving into the new houses. -0-

headline: North Hwanghae Province Strives to Increase Productivity of Oil Crops
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK is making sustained efforts to satisfactorily supply the oil raw materials needed for putting the production of regional-industry factories on a normal basis.
The province saw to it that the cities and counties organized technical courses on the cultivation of high-yielding oil crops and made them exchange and share experience and technologies gained from the experimental cultivation and expand the cultivation area of oil crops every year.
At the same time, the province has pushed ahead with the replacement of existing Evodia daniellii Benn with high-yielding ones to provide conditions for harvesting more oil fruit.
It has also planted high-yielding oil crops in waste lands and cultivated crops necessary for the production of edible oil. -0-

headline: General Education Units in DPRK Create and Introduce New Teaching Methods
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- The efforts to create and apply advanced teaching methods have been brisk at the general education units of the DPRK.
Teachers of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Kang Pan Sok Revolutionary School created a pursuit-style teaching method so that the students would develop the ability of using their own brains to practice.
Segori Senior Middle School in Pothonggang District attached to Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, has developed and introduced new teaching methods by image recognition technology, etc. so as to give the students more vivid images and help them to improve their cognitive faculty.
Ryongsong Senior Middle School in Ryongsong District, Pyongyang, makes sure that the students solve a problem by themselves through repeated discussions between teachers and students, between students and between groups.
Teachers of Hungsim Senior Middle School in Songchongang District, Hamhung City, created a method of teaching students a knack of the balance beam exercise on the basis of the motion mechanical and physiological principles in the physical education.
Sariwon Secondary School No. 1 has developed and generalized throughout the country various teaching methods of ensuring that teachers cultivate students' individuality and help them use their own brains.
Besides, the teaching methods developed by schools in the field of general education in Phyongsong and Kaechon cities in South Phyongan Province and other parts of the country are also effective in educational practice. -0-

headline: Weeding Brisk on Farms of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers and those who are working in support of rural communities are making more successes in weeding.
South Phyongan Province has introduced the method of mulching cultivation into over 10 000 hectares of fields, which is helpful to the weeding.
Phyongwon and Unsan counties have finished the first weeding of paddy fields and the second weeding of cornfields and are pushing ahead with the third weeding of cornfields.
South Hwanghae Province has paid attention to meeting scientific and technological requirements in applying herbicide.
At present, the third weeding of the cornfields in the province has been carried out at 57 percent.
North Hwanghae Province is ensuring both the quality and speed of weeding according to plans for each field and day.
The second weeding of cornfields in Kangwon Province is nearing completion.
Farms in Mangyongdae and Sadong districts and other parts of Pyongyang Municipality have taken measures to remove all weeds.
Nampho Municipality and other parts of the country concentrate workforce and means on weeding. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Director of Institute for Japan Studies under DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The director of the Institute for Japan Studies under the DPRK Foreign Ministry on Sunday issued the following press statement titled "It is the moral responsibility and international legal obligation of Japan, a war criminal state, to face up to the history and liquidate its past":
80 years have passed since the Japanese imperialists, who had stained the continent of Asia with blood and imposed unprecedented misfortune upon the peoples of the regional countries, knelt down and declared their unconditional surrender.
According to recent media, there are conflicting opinions in Japan on the issue of making public the prime minister's press statement over the past war of aggression on the day seeing the 80 years after the defeat of the Japanese imperialism.
Conscientious organizations and personages are demanding that the government clearly clarifies its stand on apology at an important historical point and, on the other hand, the ultra-right conservative politicians are quibbling that Japan wrote finis to the "diplomacy of apology" with the Abe's press statement issued after 70 years of the war.
What should not be overlooked is that the present Japanese prime minister is taking a confused attitude in this regard and is trying to patch up by making public his personal opinion through the review of the Second World War.
The "war review" to be conducted by Japan is not a verification of the aggressive war crimes committed in the past but an extremely inessential and confused one like the institutional issue that the government failed to prevent the military's individual action and the circumstances that the military caused civilian damage at the reckless war.
In particular, the prime minister said at the Diet's discussion on the issue of the press statement some days ago that the civilian control method in which the "officer of the Self-Defense Forces" is not allowed to appear in the Diet under the present constitutional law is called to account. His remarks reveal the sinister scheme to pave the way for the legalization of the "Self-Defense Forces" with the "war review".
In front of the international community, Japan is trying to pass the 80 years of its defeat with specious words like "war review" and "achievements as a peaceful state", while talking about the "termination of the diplomacy of apology". This is an unpardonable mockery and insult upon the peoples of the DPRK and other Asian countries that are suffering from the hideous crimes of the Japanese imperialists and an open provocation to the international justice and conscience.
The history has recorded many war criminal states which had mercilessly destroyed the peace and civilization of mankind by resorting to aggression against other countries and nations, but it is only Japan which is subject to international criticism due to its persistent distortion of history and evasion of settlement of its past.
The Abe's press statement, which the right-wing conservative forces of Japan are trying to regard as a "review of the past history of aggression", is run through with shameless sophisms that the next generation should not be allowed to suffer the same fate of making an apology and there is no more apology for the history of aggression, far from making a frank and sincere apology for the past crimes,.
However much water has flowed under the bridge, the Korean people clearly remember the thrice-cursed past crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against Korea, which inflicted huge human, material, mental and cultural damage on it while perpetrating the barbarous colonial fascist rule for over 40 years after occupying it with arms.
The Japanese imperialists brutally massacred more than one million Koreans, hurled more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged people into battle sites of aggression and slave labour sites by forcibly abducting them and mercilessly trampled down the youth of 200 000 women by reducing them into sexual slaves of the Japanese army. Those were hideous unethical crimes unprecedented in history.
The Japanese imperialists had made desperate efforts to eliminate the family name, surname, language and words of the Korean nation with the time-honored history spanning thousands of years and brilliant culture on the earth while asserting that "the Japanese and the Korean are of the same ancestry" and "Japan and Korea are one community". It is none other than the Japanese imperialists to destroy and plunder the precious cultural assets and rich natural resources of Korea at random.
For the past 80 years since its defeat, Japan has seriously threatened the sovereignty, right to development and right to existence of the DPRK while persistently refusing to make an apology and reparation for its crimes against the Korean people and pursuing its hostile policy toward the DPRK. It has committed more crimes by encroaching upon the national rights of the Koreans in Japan, descendants of the Korean victims of forcible drafting.
A Japanese media once said that if the documents accusing the criminal acts committed by the Japanese imperialists in Korea and other Asian countries were piled up, they are as much as 20 000 meters high. And the data on the germ warfare of the notorious 731 unit and other powerful evidence that are still being found disclose the crimes against humanity committed by the Japanese imperialists, brutes in human skin.
History cannot be erased by ink, burned by fire, or torn by sword.
The history of the aggressors and war criminal state remains forever though Japan desperately tries to erase its past crimes with all sorts of trickeries and evade its responsibility for them and no statute of limitations is applicable even after 80 years and 800 years.
It is the unavoidable moral responsibility of Japan, the war criminal state, and its duty before international law to face up to the history and liquidate its past with the 80th anniversary of the Japanese imperialists' defeat in the war as a turning point. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim In Bok, a woman living in Neighbourhood Unit No. 6, Naemun-dong, Tanchon City, South Hamgyong Province, the DPRK on her 100th birthday.
The centenarian, who received a dreamlike glory and happiness, was very grateful toKim Jong Unwho sent the birthday spread to an ordinary old woman, even though he is very busy with the state affairs.
Officials in Tanchon City and villagers congratulated the centenarian's family.

Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The director of the Institute for Japan Studies under the DPRK Foreign Ministry on Sunday issued the following press statement titled "It is the moral responsibility and international legal obligation of Japan, a war criminal state, to face up to the history and liquidate its past":
80 years have passed since the Japanese imperialists, who had stained the continent of Asia with blood and imposed unprecedented misfortune upon the peoples of the regional countries, knelt down and declared their unconditional surrender.
According to recent media, there are conflicting opinions in Japan on the issue of making public the prime minister's press statement over the past war of aggression on the day seeing the 80 years after the defeat of the Japanese imperialism.
Conscientious organizations and personages are demanding that the government clearly clarifies its stand on apology at an important historical point and, on the other hand, the ultra-right conservative politicians are quibbling that Japan wrote finis to the "diplomacy of apology" with the Abe's press statement issued after 70 years of the war.
What should not be overlooked is that the present Japanese prime minister is taking a confused attitude in this regard and is trying to patch up by making public his personal opinion through the review of the Second World War.
The "war review" to be conducted by Japan is not a verification of the aggressive war crimes committed in the past but an extremely inessential and confused one like the institutional issue that the government failed to prevent the military's individual action and the circumstances that the military caused civilian damage at the reckless war.
In particular, the prime minister said at the Diet's discussion on the issue of the press statement some days ago that the civilian control method in which the "officer of the Self-Defense Forces" is not allowed to appear in the Diet under the present constitutional law is called to account. His remarks reveal the sinister scheme to pave the way for the legalization of the "Self-Defense Forces" with the "war review".
In front of the international community, Japan is trying to pass the 80 years of its defeat with specious words like "war review" and "achievements as a peaceful state", while talking about the "termination of the diplomacy of apology". This is an unpardonable mockery and insult upon the peoples of the DPRK and other Asian countries that are suffering from the hideous crimes of the Japanese imperialists and an open provocation to the international justice and conscience.
The history has recorded many war criminal states which had mercilessly destroyed the peace and civilization of mankind by resorting to aggression against other countries and nations, but it is only Japan which is subject to international criticism due to its persistent distortion of history and evasion of settlement of its past.
The Abe's press statement, which the right-wing conservative forces of Japan are trying to regard as a "review of the past history of aggression", is run through with shameless sophisms that the next generation should not be allowed to suffer the same fate of making an apology and there is no more apology for the history of aggression, far from making a frank and sincere apology for the past crimes,.
However much water has flowed under the bridge, the Korean people clearly remember the thrice-cursed past crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against Korea, which inflicted huge human, material, mental and cultural damage on it while perpetrating the barbarous colonial fascist rule for over 40 years after occupying it with arms.
The Japanese imperialists brutally massacred more than one million Koreans, hurled more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged people into battle sites of aggression and slave labour sites by forcibly abducting them and mercilessly trampled down the youth of 200 000 women by reducing them into sexual slaves of the Japanese army. Those were hideous unethical crimes unprecedented in history.
The Japanese imperialists had made desperate efforts to eliminate the family name, surname, language and words of the Korean nation with the time-honored history spanning thousands of years and brilliant culture on the earth while asserting that "the Japanese and the Korean are of the same ancestry" and "Japan and Korea are one community". It is none other than the Japanese imperialists to destroy and plunder the precious cultural assets and rich natural resources of Korea at random.
For the past 80 years since its defeat, Japan has seriously threatened the sovereignty, right to development and right to existence of the DPRK while persistently refusing to make an apology and reparation for its crimes against the Korean people and pursuing its hostile policy toward the DPRK. It has committed more crimes by encroaching upon the national rights of the Koreans in Japan, descendants of the Korean victims of forcible drafting.
A Japanese media once said that if the documents accusing the criminal acts committed by the Japanese imperialists in Korea and other Asian countries were piled up, they are as much as 20 000 meters high. And the data on the germ warfare of the notorious 731 unit and other powerful evidence that are still being found disclose the crimes against humanity committed by the Japanese imperialists, brutes in human skin.
History cannot be erased by ink, burned by fire, or torn by sword.
The history of the aggressors and war criminal state remains forever though Japan desperately tries to erase its past crimes with all sorts of trickeries and evade its responsibility for them and no statute of limitations is applicable even after 80 years and 800 years.
It is the unavoidable moral responsibility of Japan, the war criminal state, and its duty before international law to face up to the history and liquidate its past with the 80th anniversary of the Japanese imperialists' defeat in the war as a turning point. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Rajinpho Farm in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
Message of Sympathy to Indian PM
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Narendra Modi, prime minister of the Republic of India, on June 15 over a passenger plane crash in Gujarat State of India which caused heavy casualties.
Expressing deep sympathy and condolences to the bereaved families and victims, the message hoped that the aftermath of the accident would be removed as early as possible and stability brought to the bereaved families and victims. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories Produce Quality Goods
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Modern regional-industry factories in the DPRK, which were built as the first entities of the regional rejuvenation, have turned out various kinds of quality products.
The Tongsin County Garment Factory in Jagang Province has introduced into production a garment design program developed by Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry, thus getting a big profit from it. The introduction of advanced scientific and technological achievements made it possible for the factory to mass-produce various kinds of clothing products suited to the tastes of inhabitants while raising cutting yield as compared with the past.
The Jangphung County Foodstuff Factory in Kaesong Municipality is producing various kinds of functional goods conducive to promoting the people's health by relying on the raw materials resources abundant in its region.
The factory set a goal to make the functional goods like fermented vinegar and sugar made from ginger, bean paste mixed with fruits of toothache tree and brined fruits of toothache tree represent its region and is directing efforts to its realization.
The Ichon County Daily Necessities Factory in Kangwon Province produces functional laundry soaps by using the fruits of Juglans cordiformis which grow well in its region, thus enjoying popularity among the people.
The factory is making efforts to produce not only laundry soaps but also liquid soap, detergent and shampoo with the oil of Juglans cordiformis. -0-

headline: Congratulations to Mongolian Prime Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, sent a congratulatory message to Gombojavyn Zandanshatar upon his appointment as prime minister of Mongolia on June 14.
Expressing belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries will develop in the common interests of both sides, the message wished him success in his responsible work for the economic development of the country and the promotion of the people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Commentary on "Strategic Flexibility" of U.S. Forces in ROK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Following is the full text of the commentary released by Kim Hyok Nam on Monday titled "Commentary on the 'strategic flexibility' of the U.S. forces in the ROK":
The commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK and other former and present high-ranking figures in the U.S. are making a great fuss about coordination of posture and expansion of role of the U.S. forces in the ROK, talking about "strategic flexibility" every day or less.
They even stressed that the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK is focusing on restraining China and this will make the DPRK, Russia and China change their methods of calculation, while revealing their black ulterior intention hidden under the pretext of "flexibility".
It is extremely provocative in its purpose, far from the rhetorical threats and visible words.
The U.S. has formulated that it will directly commit its forces in the ROK to the conflicts and battlefields of the Asia-Pacific region by turning them into the regional mobile task ones. This is a U.S. strategic intention to maintain its hegemonic position in the Asia-Pacific region by changing its role.
The "strategic flexibility" of expanding the role of the U.S. overseas-based forces, including the U.S. forces in the ROK, has not been in existence for only a day or two.
It is a deep-rooted doctrine of aggression of the U.S. which has thought out under the pretext of promptly coping with the "uncertain security threat" in any region on the earth since the end of the Cold War and evolved into a vicious one under the pretext of "flexibility".
The upgrade of the U.S. forces in the ROK has been stepped up in a systematic way with the aim of dispatching them into a surrounding operational area, including the redeployment of the U.S. forces in the ROK under the pretext of "flexibility" and the rotation deployment of the mobile task force Striker brigade.
The gravity of the situation is that the "strategic flexibility" is raising its head again with more visible strike target and more detailed operational scope under such condition that the remodeling of the U.S. forces in the ROK into the mobile task forces was completed in fact.
It is as clear as noonday that the moment the "strategic flexibility" heated with the hegemonic ambition starts, it will ignite various elements of conflicts latent in Northeast Asia and bring about a huge chain explosion.
It is by no means accidental that the U.S. institute for policy studies recently announced the shocking results of computer simulated war that the conflict between China and the U.S. in a particular region may spread to the Korean peninsula and Japan in an instant and lead to the outbreak of a nuclear war, thus giving rise to concern among the public.
The uneasy mental state of the White House seeing the rapid growth of the independent camp against the U.S. in the Asia-Pacific region and feeling its inferiority in strength and loss of its hegemonic position owing to the rapid growth is the bottom line of the U.S. such provocative acts full of recklessness and impatience.
The situation in the Middle East being complicated with each passing day and the unstable trend of military and political situation in Europe make the U.S. have more worries about the Asia-Pacific region.
It is the U.S. attempt of aggression to optimize its strategic efficiency and maintain its hegemony in use of the strength of even its satellite countries by putting the role of its forces stationed in the ROK on a multi-purposed and diversified basis in the Asia-Pacific region to cope with the current "compound crisis" situation.
In case that the advance of the U.S. forces in the ROK into major regions is realized, the ROK will play the role of the most effective sortie base and the first forward base and the involvement of the ROK Army in the war under the subordinated structure of the U.S.-ROK alliance will be inevitable.
It is the clear evidence that the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK has openly asserted that there are no other U.S. troops than the U.S. forces in the ROK in the regions 400-600km away from Beijing in a straight line and there is no such powerful and threatening means of committing combat power as the aircraft carrier called the ROK.
There is no doubt that the U.S. reckless moves to pressurize its enemy states by using the ROK as an aircraft carrier will accelerate the concentration, accumulation and expansion of huge war energy in the Asia-Pacific region.
All facts clearly show that the U.S. adventurous acts of seeking its hegemony are an incurable evil factor that destroys the strategic balance of the region and pushes the global security environment to an uncontrollable catastrophic phase.
The U.S. hegemonic acts of seeking the active intervention of its troops in the Asia-Pacific region create another new instable climate that poses a multi-sided and multi-layered threat to the peace and security environment in the region and rest of the world.
The multi-polarization of the world aspiring after justice is tolling the death knell for the U.S. seeking hegemony of injustice.
The evermore reckless provocative acts of the enemies with the appearance of the present U.S. administration are giving us the justness and urgency for updating and building the most overwhelming and offensive deterrent and translating into the tough action signaling our great warning.
The "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces stationed in the ROK based on the anachronistic "doctrine of strength-almighty" will result in the inevitable strategic isolation of the U.S. and the decline of its irrevocable strength. -0-

headline: Different Units in DPRK Support Work for Education of Rising Generation
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Different units in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, are actively helping schools and kindergartens.
The Pyongyang Municipal Power Transmission and Distribution Station sent modern educational equipment and sports goods to Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans, Wonam Primary School in Rangnang District and Ryonghung Kindergarten No. 2 in Taesong District.
The Tongdaewon District Public Prosecutors Office sent a lot of toys and foodstuffs to Sinhung Kindergarten No.1, taking measures to provide materials and manpower necessary for further sprucing up its appearance.
The officials and researchers of the Zoology Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences made over 300 stuffed specimens of animals and sent them to schools across the country.
The Taedonggang District Restaurants Management Office and the Greengrocery Wholesale Store of Taedonggang District are devoting their sincere efforts to strengthening the material foundation of educational units while providing the necessary materials for schools including computers and school things. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Care for Schoolchildren
story_text:
One day in March 1962, PresidentKim Il Sunghad a talk with the neighbourhood unit leaders to learn about the living conditions of the citizens of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, and suddenly asked if there was a primary school on the side of the Taedong Gate.
An official said that there was a university, not a primary school.
With a serious look, the President said he often sees the children going to school across the main street, and that it is dangerous for them as many motorcars run.
He said that primary school should be newly built or the university should be moved to other place to use it as the primary school in order to prevent the young pupils from crossing the main street. And he said earnestly that the best things and conditions should be provided for the children.
Thanks to the warm love of the President who spares nothing for the rising generations, Pyongyang Taedongmun Primary School (Kim Song Ju Primary School) came into being. -0-

headline: Prospect of DPRK's Tourist Industry: Vice General Director of National Tourism Administration
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Ri Jong Hyok, vice general director of the National Tourism Administration in the DPRK, told KCNA that mountain and coastal tourism is promising in the country, and went on:
Our country has a mountainous area of nearly 80 percent of the territory and is very abundant in mountain and coastal tourist resources as it is bounded by the seas on both sides of the east and the west.
In particular, the grand nature in the area of Mt Paektu is a tourist resource we can be proud of. If we build a tourist resort in the world-famous Mt Paektu, we will make great progress in developing the country's tourist industry.
On the east coast, there are many beautiful scenic spots including Mts Kumgang and Chilbo, Majon, Kumya, Riwon and Yombunjin. If we use these rich tourist resources rationally, we will be able to exploit in a unique manner the resources of tourism for sports, leisure activities and marine sightseeing.
If we exploit the mountain and coastal tourist resources in conformity with the natural and geographical features of the country, we can develop the tourist industry in a far-sighted way.
The work to wonderfully build the Mt Paektu tourist resort and the Kalma coastal resort into the places enjoyed by our people and foreigners has been propelled under the care of the state.
Ri Jong Hyok said that he would fulfill his responsibility and duty in developing the tourist industry to make the people enjoy a higher civilized life to the full and in expanding and developing multifaceted exchange and cooperation with other countries. -0-

headline: Persons with Disabilities Bring Their Hope and Talents into Full Bloom under Popular Policy of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- The Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Persons with Disabilities was adopted and amended and supplemented in detail in November 2013, thus providing a firm legal guarantee for further developing the work of protecting the persons with disabilities under the care of the whole society in the DPRK.

headline: Persons with Disabilities Bring Their Hope and Talents into Full Bloom under Popular Policy of WPK
Yearly and First Half-yearly Economic Plans Fulfilled at Coal Mines of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- More than 40 youth shock brigades at coal mines of South Phyongan Province in the DPRK have fulfilled their yearly and first half-yearly economic plans and expanded their successes.
The Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the Ripsok Coal Mine of the Anju Area Coal-mining Complex carried out its yearly economic plan before anyone else by recording its high tunneling results every day.
The members of the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex carried out a high tunneling plan and provided eight coal fields.
The Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine overfulfilled their daily tunneling plans.
The members of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the Tukjang Youth Coal Mine of the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex carried out the plan for the first quarter by conducting a good-conduct movement and fulfilled the yearly national economic plan by May.
The Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the Ryongrim Coal Mine of the Anju Area Coal-mining Complex overfulfilled its first quarter tunneling plan by February and the first half-yearly tunneling plan by May.
The Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade of the Jenam Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex, the O Jung Hup Youth Shock Brigade of the Sinri Coal Mine of the Anju Area Coal-mining Complex and the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Brigade of the Joyang Coal Mine of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex have carried out the national economic plans for the first half of the year ahead of schedule. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Secretary of Russian Security Council Sergei Shoigu
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, met Comrade Sergei Shoigu who visited the DPRK again, leading a delegation of the Security Council of the Russian Federation upon special authorization of Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on June 17.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Ungladly greeted Comrade Sergei Shoigu who visited Pyongyang at a significant time marking the first anniversary of the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation and had a warm talk with him.
Shoigu courteously conveyed the verbal letter of Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed his deep thanks for it and conveyed his comradely greetings to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
The talk appreciated again the important meaning of the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic relationship between the DPRK and Russia and discussed the items of immediate cooperation and long-term plans arising in implementing the important matters agreed by the heads of states of the two countries through the exchanges of personal letters for several weeks.
It also discussed and approved some ideas and plans for conveying long the heroic feats displayed by soldiers of units of the Korean People's Army in the operations for liberating the Kursk area.
Proceeding from a correct understanding of the current situation in the special military operations and Kursk Region,Kim Jong Unconfirmed the contents of the DPRK's cooperation within the range of the treaty between the two countries, accepted the relevant plans and discussed in detail the necessary cooperation plans.
The talk widely exchanged the views and opinions of the leaderships of the two countries on the issues of mutual concern including the complicated international and regional situation and reached a consensus of view.
Kim Jong Unexpressed again the steadfast option and will of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to invariably and unconditionally support the policy of the Russian Federation to defend its state sovereignty, territorial integrity and international justice against the imperialist moves of hegemony and to honestly implement the articles of the treaty between the DPRK and Russia in the future, too.
ComradeKim Jong Unconveyed the noble respect and fraternal greetings of the Korean people to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and all the Russian people on the occasion of the first anniversary of the conclusion of the treaty on the comprehensive strategic relations between the DPRK and Russia, hoping that greater victory, prosperity and happiness will be always in store in the future of the powerful Russia.
The talks consistently proceeded in a congenial atmosphere of friendship and trust. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Paternal Love for People
story_text:
One hottest day in August, 1998, ChairmanKim Jong Ilgave field guidance at some units.
The Chairman, who was busy looking at documents while giving field guidance, called an official, saying that it is very sweltering.
The Chairman told an official that on a hot day as now, it would be so hot for the people when they watch games at stadiums, and that ice cream would relieve them from heat.
And the Chairman asked him if there were machines for making ice cream in stadiums.
He told the official, who failed to answer soon, that we should think of the people first even when we feel hot and that the machines for making ice cream should be installed in the gymnasiums.
Ice cream, which our people enjoy today, is associated with the paternal love of the Chairman. -0-

headline: Namhung Youth Chemical Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex is one of the leading fertilizer production bases in the DPRK.
The complex has over-fulfilled its yearly national economic plans in recent years. This year, too, it produced thousands of more tons of fertilizer to fulfill the fertilizer-production plan for manuring year ahead of schedule.
Successes made by the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, which is making a leap forward and innovations in the spirit of self-reliance, are associated with the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho put forward the complex as the arsenal of the socialist agricultural front and showed great trust in the workers.
One day in June 2013, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the complex. He said that it seemed to see a heap of rice while watching the fertilizer piled up at the shipping workshop of the complex, adding that the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex is like an arsenal of the socialist agricultural front.
That day, the respected General Secretary set forth important tasks facing the complex, saying that the complex should produce more fertilizer in order to turn the country into the one rich in rice.
True to the instructions of the respected General Secretary, the officials and workers of the complex have made a great progress in production through a mass technological innovation movement to produce and supply more fertilizer needed for agricultural production.
The complex has built hundreds of thousands of data in its sci-tech learning space and put its operation on a normal footing. It has reduced the loss of coal and improved the capacity of equipment and processes by introducing valuable technical innovations and inventions into production, thus increasing the amount of fertilizer.
Last year, the complex was selected as one of the ten best enterprises in the country for 2023. -0-
