headline: Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory is a comprehensive dental hygiene product producer which mass-produces various kinds of toothpastes, toothbrushes, gargle, etc.
The factory with modern production lines has even an institute, so science and technology have been integrated with production.
Various kinds of dental hygiene products of the factory with the trademark "Paekhak" (white crane) are popular among the people as they have various functions and therapeutic effects and are convenient for using.
All the dental hygiene products are associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho always pays attention to promoting the people's health.
Kim Jong Unpersonally initiated the construction of the factory, solved the problems arising in its construction, and provided a complete set of modern production equipment when the project was nearing completion.
One day in June 2017, he visited the newly-built factory, where he said that he is very pleased that another worthwhile work for the people's long life in good health has been done. And he stressed that the factory should keep the production going at a high rate and supply quality dental hygiene goods to the people, so that they enjoy the benefits of the factory.
In hearty response to his on-site instructions, researchers and workers at the factory have made efforts to develop and produce quality dental hygiene goods in large numbers.
In the course of the efforts, a number of new products with various functions and therapeutic effects, including Kaesong Koryo Insam toothpaste, have been developed, and some production lines have been put on a GMP basis to make progress in improving the quality of products.
The products of the factory were awarded the highest prize at the light Industry goods exhibition "Light Industry Development-2023" and the factory was selected last year as one of the ten best enterprises for 2023.
The researchers and workers of the factory are now devoting their wisdom and enthusiasm to developing and producing many quality dental hygiene products favored by the people. -0-

headline: Namhung Youth Chemical Complex
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of National Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
Going round the blast furnace workshop, the oxygen plant workshop No. 3 and the heavy rail finishing workshop of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the premier encouraged the workers turning out in the iron and steel production for implementing the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
He called upon officials to push ahead with the projects reflected in the plan for the maintenance and reinforcement as scheduled with a high sense of responsibility that they have shouldered the destiny of the Party decisions, and at the same time, to increase the output of iron and steel and improve the quality of steel by efficiently managing and operating the production lines and actively introducing rational iron making methods.
Acquainting himself with the yield of earlier wheat and barley at the Sinhung and Taesong farms in Singye County, the Sokgyo Farm in Suan County and other farms in North Hwanghae Province, he called for setting the right harvest time on the basis of taking into account the ripening rate of ears and weather conditions and make good preparations for harvesting the grain in time and without any waste by concentrating efforts and means.
At the Taean Friendship Glass Factory, the premier learnt about the repair of the glass melting furnace and discussed technical and practical issues for ensuring the normal operation of the furnace by thoroughly ensuring the quality in the repair and took relevant measures.
At the construction site of the Taehung Additives Factory and the Pyongyang Poultry Equipment Factory, he called to step up the construction and remodeling of the factories in order to fully produce and supply feed additives and breeding equipment necessary for increasing the poultry production as intended by the Party.
Earlier, the premier met with scientists and officials at the agricultural high-tech exchange center under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences and exchanged views on the agricultural scientific researches and the latest agricultural sci-tech achievements.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of further strengthening the cooperation of relevant sectors and units so as to ensure sufficient supply of raw and other materials necessary for the pig iron production, the issue of intensifying research activities at the scientific research institutions with emphasis put on solving the key link in the economic development, the issue of making the relevant units treating the technicians and skilled workers preferentially and pay deep attention to the living conditions of the employees, etc. -0-

headline: Construction Sector Takes Measures to Prevent Damage Caused by Rainy Season
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The construction sector of the DPRK has taken foresighted measures to prevent damage caused by the rainy season.
Measures have been taken in advance at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area to provide a guarantee for carrying on the construction on a high qualitative level without letup in the rainy season.
The headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang make each construction unit ensure the safety of the builders from lightning and thunderbolt and the relevant sections, including materials and construction sections, find out the factors which may affect the construction during the rainy season and eliminate them in time.
Meanwhile, the work has been pushed forward to prevent the electric equipment and power lines at the construction sites from damage by flood and rainstorm.
Besides, the construction sites of regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties, including Taegwan, Paechon and Puryong counties, and construction sites of rural dwelling houses have taken the measures to push ahead with the construction without letup in the rainy season. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement titled "The aggressive forces who brought a new war to the Middle East will never evade the responsibility for destroying global peace" on June 19:
The illegal act of state-sponsored terrorism by Israel which launched a reckless large-scale military attack on the Islamic Republic of Iran at dawn of June 13 is sparking off strong denunciation and concern of the international community, raising the danger of a new all-out war in the Middle East region.
The daily-escalating Israel's reckless military attack on civilians in wanton violation of international law and the basic principle of the UN Charter is a hideous act of aggression wantonly violating the sovereignty and territorial integrity of a sovereign state and an unpardonable crime against humanity.
The DPRK expresses serious concern over the Israel's military attack and resolutely denounces it.
The present grave situation witnessed by the world clearly proves that Israel, supported and patronized by the U.S. and the West, is a cancer-like entity for the peace in the Middle East and a chief culprit of destroying global peace and security.
Israel has steadily expanded its territory through four Middle East wars and tens of military invasions in the past. In recent years alone, it has escalated military attacks on the Gaza Strip of Palestine, the West Bank of the Jordan River, Lebanon, Syria and other regional countries step by step, thus massacring tens of thousands of civilians and creating a serious humanitarian crisis.
The international community is strictly watching the U.S. and Western forces fanning up the flames of war, taking issue with the legitimate sovereign right and exercise of the right to self-defence of Iran, the victim, far from condemning Israel for getting frantic with the territorial expansion, pushing the situation in the Middle East to an uncontrollable catastrophic phase.
The Zionists who brought a new war to the Middle East and the behind-the-scene forces who zealously patronize and support them will be held totally responsible for destroying international peace and security. -0-

headline: Invincible Might of Alliance between DPRK and Russia Will Be More Powerfully Displayed: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday carries an article titled "The invincible might of the alliance between the DPRK and Russia will be more powerfully demonstrated".
The article says:
The DPRK and Russia are significantly greeting the first anniversary of the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries at a time when greater importance is more clearly attached to the solidity and invincibility of the DPRK-Russia friendship and solidarity.
Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, held a historic meeting in Pyongyang on June 19, 2024, and signed the "Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation" to open a new chapter of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations.
The traditional DPRK-Russia friendship has been promoted into the genuine alliance and firm strategic partnership with the realization of independence and justice as the common idea and a reliable guarantee for the development of the bilateral relations has been provided. This is a brilliant fruition of the foresightedness and outstanding leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
The conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia provided a powerful legal framework for firmly guaranteeing the future of the bilateral relations in the face of any challenge and difficulties.
This is a historic event which is unprecedented in the history of the DPRK-Russia relations spanning nearly 80 years and which all the peoples of the two countries can be proud of.
365 days since the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia fully proved the vitality of the treaty between the two states and the accelerated development of the bilateral relations.
The bilateral solidarity and cooperation are getting closer and stronger in all fields after the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia.
Visits of high-level delegations of the two countries are brisk and the prospective work to further boost the exchange and cooperation in various fields is being conducted on a wide scale.
Intergovernmental exchanges and cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology are being promoted in a wider and diversified way and mutual understanding is being unprecedentedly boosted in various fields including economy, diplomacy, education, public health and art, and mutual visits are being positively increased.
The construction of a motor bridge linking the borders between the DPRK and Russia which started in April under the deep care and expectation of the two governments is the work to build and reinforce an important infrastructure of the economic cooperation between the two countries and provide a substantial guarantee for further activating the bilateral cooperation, adding momentum to boosting the friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Russia which get close with each passing day.
The participation of combat sub-units of the DPRK armed forces in the operation for liberating the Kursk area drawing the world public attention fully demonstrated the might of the armed forces of the two countries and the absolute solidity of their alliance as the most exemplary practice of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
Fine sons of the DPRK people displayed the matchless bravery and self-sacrificing spirit in the fierce battlefields, regarding the territory of the Russian Federation as the part of their motherland and the Russian people as their brothers, true to the order of the head of their state.
The complete liberation of the Kursk area achieved through the joint operation of the armed forces of the two countries clearly proved the invincibility of the DPRK-Russia alliance which is being more firmly cemented as the strategic fortress of defending justice and peace, the spirit of genuine unity and cooperation and the genuine internationalist obligation.
The DPRK-Russia relations based on the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership serve as a powerful driving force for establishing a new fair and multi-polarized international order and opening a bright prospect for mankind as they are a powerful security device for easing the regional situation and ensuring the global strategic stability.
The steadfast will and wise guidance of the heads of the states of the two countries to further consolidate the framework of the DPRK-Russia friendship and strategic cooperative relations which have been put on an orbit of comprehensive development and to defend the peace in the region and the rest of the world and international justice are the fundamental factor that helps the two countries defend their interests and bring about their prosperity.
To achieve the common prosperity and well-being, deepening the militant friendship, is the steadfast stand of the peoples of the two countries who have experienced the vitality of the friendly relations and alliance displayed in the struggle to put an end to the imperialists' hegemony, threat and blackmail and defend peace, stability and national interests.
The new inter-state treaty will give fuller play to its vitality and might in further promoting the development of the strategic relations between the DPRK and Russia, true to the noble intention of the leaders of the two countries, and only victory and glory will always be in store for the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Love for People
story_text:
One day in September 2020, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the face-lifted village of Kangbuk-ri seat, Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province, the DPRK.
Looking around the village as beautiful as a picture, the respected General Secretary walked to the cultural hall with satisfaction.
After looking round the hall, he came out into the corridor and looked at the new dwelling houses through a window with a smile on his face.
Shortly afterwards, the respected General Secretary said officials that the houses are good to look as they have proper height, and that the people are designers and judges as he said when he looked round Taechong-ri.
At the moment the officials felt tears welling up in their eyes, thinking of his tireless effort.
Some days ago, the respected General Secretary visited Taechong-ri in Unpha County where new houses are rising like bamboo shoots after rain and said it was completely turned into a rural city, expressing great satisfaction.
Saying that he took a measure to build dwelling houses as desired by the farmers, he laughed broadly and noted that people discuss and ratify the designs for houses.
That day the officials cherished the great love of him who is valuing and loving the agricultural workers and giving them everything. -0-

headline: Woljong Temple Repaired in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The Woljong Temple in South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK is under repair.
The temple, located in Mt Kuwol, a scenic spot on the west coast, is a precious national heritage of the country as the big one with 1 000-odd-long history.
The temple has the Manse Pavilion and other accessory buildings.
The province is pushing ahead with the work to keep the temple in its origin. It has worked out a plan for repairing it and is giving precedence to the supply of manpower, equipment and materials as well as construction and technical guidance.
The officials and working people mobilized to the repair project are ensuring the quality in wood processing, assembling and completing while meeting the technical requirements. -0-

headline: By Manuring and Tending Crops in Scientific and Technological Way
Invincible Might of Alliance between DPRK and Russia Will Be More Powerfully Displayed: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday carries an article titled "The invincible might of the alliance between the DPRK and Russia will be more powerfully demonstrated".
The article says:
The DPRK and Russia are significantly greeting the first anniversary of the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries at a time when greater importance is more clearly attached to the solidity and invincibility of the DPRK-Russia friendship and solidarity.
Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, held a historic meeting in Pyongyang on June 19, 2024, and signed the "Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation" to open a new chapter of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations.
The traditional DPRK-Russia friendship has been promoted into the genuine alliance and firm strategic partnership with the realization of independence and justice as the common idea and a reliable guarantee for the development of the bilateral relations has been provided. This is a brilliant fruition of the foresightedness and outstanding leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
The conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia provided a powerful legal framework for firmly guaranteeing the future of the bilateral relations in the face of any challenge and difficulties.
This is a historic event which is unprecedented in the history of the DPRK-Russia relations spanning nearly 80 years and which all the peoples of the two countries can be proud of.
365 days since the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia fully proved the vitality of the treaty between the two states and the accelerated development of the bilateral relations.
The bilateral solidarity and cooperation are getting closer and stronger in all fields after the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia.
Visits of high-level delegations of the two countries are brisk and the prospective work to further boost the exchange and cooperation in various fields is being conducted on a wide scale.
Intergovernmental exchanges and cooperation in trade, economy, science and technology are being promoted in a wider and diversified way and mutual understanding is being unprecedentedly boosted in various fields including economy, diplomacy, education, public health and art, and mutual visits are being positively increased.
The construction of a motor bridge linking the borders between the DPRK and Russia which started in April under the deep care and expectation of the two governments is the work to build and reinforce an important infrastructure of the economic cooperation between the two countries and provide a substantial guarantee for further activating the bilateral cooperation, adding momentum to boosting the friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Russia which get close with each passing day.
The participation of combat sub-units of the DPRK armed forces in the operation for liberating the Kursk area drawing the world public attention fully demonstrated the might of the armed forces of the two countries and the absolute solidity of their alliance as the most exemplary practice of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
Fine sons of the DPRK people displayed the matchless bravery and self-sacrificing spirit in the fierce battlefields, regarding the territory of the Russian Federation as the part of their motherland and the Russian people as their brothers, true to the order of the head of their state.
The complete liberation of the Kursk area achieved through the joint operation of the armed forces of the two countries clearly proved the invincibility of the DPRK-Russia alliance which is being more firmly cemented as the strategic fortress of defending justice and peace, the spirit of genuine unity and cooperation and the genuine internationalist obligation.
The DPRK-Russia relations based on the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership serve as a powerful driving force for establishing a new fair and multi-polarized international order and opening a bright prospect for mankind as they are a powerful security device for easing the regional situation and ensuring the global strategic stability.
The steadfast will and wise guidance of the heads of the states of the two countries to further consolidate the framework of the DPRK-Russia friendship and strategic cooperative relations which have been put on an orbit of comprehensive development and to defend the peace in the region and the rest of the world and international justice are the fundamental factor that helps the two countries defend their interests and bring about their prosperity.
To achieve the common prosperity and well-being, deepening the militant friendship, is the steadfast stand of the peoples of the two countries who have experienced the vitality of the friendly relations and alliance displayed in the struggle to put an end to the imperialists' hegemony, threat and blackmail and defend peace, stability and national interests.
The new inter-state treaty will give fuller play to its vitality and might in further promoting the development of the strategic relations between the DPRK and Russia, true to the noble intention of the leaders of the two countries, and only victory and glory will always be in store for the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Construction Sector Takes Measures to Prevent Damage Caused by Rainy Season
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The construction sector of the DPRK has taken foresighted measures to prevent damage caused by the rainy season.
Measures have been taken in advance at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area to provide a guarantee for carrying on the construction on a high qualitative level without letup in the rainy season.
The headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang make each construction unit ensure the safety of the builders from lightning and thunderbolt and the relevant sections, including materials and construction sections, find out the factors which may affect the construction during the rainy season and eliminate them in time.
Meanwhile, the work has been pushed forward to prevent the electric equipment and power lines at the construction sites from damage by flood and rainstorm.
Besides, the construction sites of regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties, including Taegwan, Paechon and Puryong counties, and construction sites of rural dwelling houses have taken the measures to push ahead with the construction without letup in the rainy season. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- Recorded in the glorious history of the DPRK is the Chollima age in which new miracles stunning the world people were created one after another in socialist construction.
During the great Chollima upswing, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill produced the first Chollima workteam and won the title of the Chollima factory in Pyongyang Municipality. It has taken a big part in improving the people's standard of living in every period of the revolution, fully displaying the honor of icon mill and model unit.
The course of development of the silk mill which has developed into a proud base for the silk thread production along with the Chollima age is associated with the meticulous care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
One day in June 2016,Kim Jong Unvisited the mill. He called upon the workers of the mill to further glorify the proud tradition and honor of the mill, saying that the fighting spirit of the great Chollima age should be carried forward forever.
Noting that the mill is a very important one in improving the people's standard of living, he expressed expectation and conviction that the mill would continue to set an example throughout the country in implementing the Party's policies like the preceding generation and had a photo taken with the employees of the mill.
True to his instructions, officials and workers of the mill turned out in the struggle for following the heroes of the Chollima age, and the mill produced many labor innovators.
The mill realized the streamlining of overall production processes ranging from preparation of raw materials to production of goods and newly built the production line of silk protein with waste water.
Today, the mill is playing a role as a pivotal one in the field of light industry while putting its management on a scientific basis and raising the quality of goods. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The Woljong Temple in South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK is under repair.
The temple, located in Mt Kuwol, a scenic spot on the west coast, is a precious national heritage of the country as the big one with 1 000-odd-long history.
The temple has the Manse Pavilion and other accessory buildings.
The province is pushing ahead with the work to keep the temple in its origin. It has worked out a plan for repairing it and is giving precedence to the supply of manpower, equipment and materials as well as construction and technical guidance.
The officials and working people mobilized to the repair project are ensuring the quality in wood processing, assembling and completing while meeting the technical requirements. -0-

headline: Grain Dryers Manufactured in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The manufacturing of grain dryers was concluded thanks to the high enthusiasm of the officials and working people in the agricultural sector of the DPRK.
Hundreds of more grain dryers than planned have been manufactured throughout the country.
The Agricultural Commission sent the designs completed by the scientists of the Farm Machine Institute and technicians of the Ryongnim Farm in Mundok County of South Phyongan Province and the Oguk Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province by pooling their efforts and wisdom to the provincial, city and county manufacturing units, and supplied materials for them.
North Hwanghae Province manufactured grain dryers more than twice of the initial plan, and South Hwanghae Province more than 340 high-efficient grain dryers in a little more than one month.
South and North Phyongan provinces have made more grain dryers than planned through the campaign for increased production and economy.
Other provinces, too, finished manufacturing grain dryers. -0-

North Hwanghae Province Strives to Increase Building-materials Production Capacity
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK set a goal to realize self-sufficiency of building materials necessary for regional construction and is directing efforts to strengthening the production foundation for it.
The province has pushed ahead with the projects to expand the production capacities of the Unpha Cement Factory and the Kyongam Cement Factory, restore and rehabilitate the production line of building parts and elements at the Kyongam Building Materials Factory and provide a foundation for producing tiles and colorpaving blocks.
The Sariwon Steel Works pushes ahead with the project to increase productivity while reducing costs.
In addition, the province steps up the construction of modern base capable of producing various kinds of building materials, while ensuring that all construction units lay their building-materials production foundations and produce and supply finishing building materials.
Sinphyong County provided a foundation for producing fittings and plastic tubes by strengthening its technical forces, and the competition among cities and counties is gaining momentum to produce the building materials needed for regional construction with their efforts, technology and resources. -0-

Quintuplets Leave Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- Quintuplets born for the first time in the DPRK left the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on June 19.
The mother of the quintuplets (two sons and three daughters) who were born on January 31 is Pak Kyong Sim living in the neighbourhood unit No. 76 in Janghyon-dong, Moranbong District and their father Son Chung Hyo is a student of Pyongyang Commercial Service College.
Under the advantageous public health policy of the socialist state, Pak Kyong Sim was urgently sent to the maternity hospital soon after being confirmed as a woman pregnant with several embryos. And she received the best medical assistance, including scientific and advanced treatment for pregnancy maintenance, under the special care of a medical team, and safely gave birth to babies.
The babies who have grown up in the incubators weigh over 4.7 kg, and the fourth baby (son) 6.48 kg.
The healthy mother and quintuplets were warmly seen off by doctors and nurses of the maternity hospital. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Ministry and Russian Embassy Here Host Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the embassy of the Russian Federation here jointly hosted a reception on June 19 on the occasion of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the first anniversary of the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia.
Present there were Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, Jo Yong Won and Ri Hi Yong, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other leading officials of the Party, government and military, and officials of the Party Central Committee, ministries and armed forces organs.
Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members were on hand.
Choe Son Hui made a speech at the reception.
She said that the birth of the new inter-state treaty which confirms the new strategic path of the relations between the two countries and assures its victory at a crucial time when the whole world is experiencing unprecedented changes is a brilliant fruition of the outstanding foresightedness, bold decision and experienced leadership of the heads of states of the DPRK and Russia.
She said that, thanks to the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries, the traditional friendship between the two countries was definitely put on an orbit of the most solid and invincible alliance and relations of comrades-in-arms and a strong legal framework for firmly guaranteeing the bilateral relations in the face of any challenge and difficulty was provided.
Invariable is the stand of the DPRK government to closely and multilaterally cooperate with the Russian Federation in all fields and to steadily promote the development of the DPRK-Russia relations for the continuous wellbeing and beautiful future of the peoples of the two countries in accordance with the spirit of the new inter-state treaty, she noted.
She expressed belief that the alliance between the DPRK and Russia, which greeted a heyday, will continuously and invariably be carried forward in the future, too, and the militant friendship forged between the two countries in the grandiose journey of opening up a new chapter of friendship will promise a brighter future of the people and posterity of the two countries.
Next, Aleksandr Matsegora made a speech.
He said that a treaty which put the relations between the Russian Federation and the DPRK on a high stage and gave them a completely new character was concluded in Pyongyang a year ago, adding that there was no period in the history of recent decades when the two countries had such close and deep mutual understanding and trust.
The firmness of the relations between Russia and the DPRK was verified and strengthened in the flames of the bloody war in which the excellent sons of the peoples of the two countries fought a fierce battle shoulder to shoulder against the common enemy and won victory, he said, adding that Russia would never forget the feats of the soldiers of the Korean People's Army who displayed miraculous heroism in the battlefields of Kursk Region and glorified their colours with immortal glory as they defend their country.
He said that no one doubts that the two countries are the closest states and that their alliance conforms to the fundamental interests of the peoples of the two countries, aspires after the future and aims at building a new and just world order based on equality and respect for sovereignty.
He expressed belief that the tasks for the development of the bilateral relations set forth by the leaders of the two countries would be surely realized, overcoming all obstacles, and thereby the relations between Russia and the DPRK would develop more significantly and dynamically.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health of ComradeKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and the steady development of the invincible alliance between the peoples of the DPRK and Russia.
The reception proceeded in an atmosphere of comradeship and friendship. -0-

headline: Chollima Street Tailor Shop
Party-member Battalions Make Successes in Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The Party-member battalions, which were dispatched to Ryanggang Province of the DPRK, are making progress in the next-stage construction of public buildings and rural houses in the spirit of completing the construction of hundreds of single- and low-storied houses in different parts of the Paektu area.
The Pyongyang Municipal Party-member Battalion, which built new houses at the village of the Saphyong Farm in Kapsan County last year, is setting an example in the construction of the cultural hall in Saphyong-ri.
The South Hamgyong Provincial Party-member Battalion is carrying on the project to build hundreds of meters-long river embankment and dig thousands of cubic meters of riverbed while stepping up the construction under its charge.
The South Phyongan Provincial Party-member Battalion mainly completed the roofing work of single- and low-storied dwelling houses and started the project for interior and exterior plastering. It is constructing a pumping station and water collecting well to provide the rural houses with drinking water.
Other Party-member battalions are striving to attain the phased goals.
In response to the spirit of the Party-member battalions, cities and counties in Ryanggang Province, including Kim Hyong Gwon, Unhung and Samsu counties, are putting spurs to the construction of rural houses. -0-

headline: Sports Contest of Revolutionary Schools-2025 Held in DPRK
Mass Movement Brisk among Women's Union Members
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent an important letter "Let the Women's Union Become a Powerful Unit in Propelling the Advance and Development of Our Style of Socialism" to the participants in the Seventh Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea in June 2021 and thus provided an immortal guideline for bringing about a radical turn in the work of the women's union as required by the new era of the Juche revolution.
True to the noble intention of the peerlessly great man, the officials and members of the women's union across the country have made tangible achievements for the country, people and posterity by conducting the socialist patriotic movement and the revolutionary mass movement in the worksites of the state prosperity for the past four years.
Since the Seventh Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, more than 400 000 women have volunteered to work at honorable posts for socialist construction.
Various mass movements for the economic development of the country have been vigorously conducted as the work of the women's union.
Women in Phyongsong City, Kwaksan County, Kangso District and Hanggu District have produced a lot of cocoons every year by directing efforts to creating mulberry fields and improving soil fertility.
In hearty response to the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on obtaining meat from grass, members of the women's union in South Hwanghae Province took the lead in the rabbit-raising movement.
The members of the women's union of the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex and the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex encouraged the workers to implement the Party's decision through their vigorous motivation activities, while finding out and doing good things conducive to increasing coal production.
The women's union members in Songchon and Pukchang counties and Sunchon and Anju cities conveyed goods for supply service to builders at construction sites while conducting public service for them.
The women's union officials and members are contributing to the country's economy through the movement for collecting materials lying idle and finding work which needs to be done on the road of prosperity of the country. Their deeds are encouraging the whole people to work steady miracles. -0-

He expressed belief that the tasks for the development of the bilateral relations set forth by the leaders of the two countries would be surely realized, overcoming all obstacles, and thereby the relations between Russia and the DPRK would develop more significantly and dynamically.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health of ComradeKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and the steady development of the invincible alliance between the peoples of the DPRK and Russia.
The reception proceeded in an atmosphere of comradeship and friendship. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Brisk among Women's Union Members
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent an important letter "Let the Women's Union Become a Powerful Unit in Propelling the Advance and Development of Our Style of Socialism" to the participants in the Seventh Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea in June 2021 and thus provided an immortal guideline for bringing about a radical turn in the work of the women's union as required by the new era of the Juche revolution.
True to the noble intention of the peerlessly great man, the officials and members of the women's union across the country have made tangible achievements for the country, people and posterity by conducting the socialist patriotic movement and the revolutionary mass movement in the worksites of the state prosperity for the past four years.
Since the Seventh Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, more than 400 000 women have volunteered to work at honorable posts for socialist construction.
Various mass movements for the economic development of the country have been vigorously conducted as the work of the women's union.
Women in Phyongsong City, Kwaksan County, Kangso District and Hanggu District have produced a lot of cocoons every year by directing efforts to creating mulberry fields and improving soil fertility.
In hearty response to the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on obtaining meat from grass, members of the women's union in South Hwanghae Province took the lead in the rabbit-raising movement.
The members of the women's union of the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex and the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex encouraged the workers to implement the Party's decision through their vigorous motivation activities, while finding out and doing good things conducive to increasing coal production.
The women's union members in Songchon and Pukchang counties and Sunchon and Anju cities conveyed goods for supply service to builders at construction sites while conducting public service for them.
The women's union officials and members are contributing to the country's economy through the movement for collecting materials lying idle and finding work which needs to be done on the road of prosperity of the country. Their deeds are encouraging the whole people to work steady miracles. -0-

headline: Plan for Reconstruction of Pyongyang
story_text:
One day in January 1951, a designer arrived at the Supreme Headquarters, called by PresidentKim Il Sung.
The President told the designer that if the U.S. imperialist aggressors destroy one building, we should build ten, a hundred or a thousand ones and we should reconstruct the destroyed cities, rural areas, factories and enterprises into more beautiful, magnificent and modern ones than before. And the President asked the designer if he designs the reconstruction of Pyongyang.
The President indicated the detailed orientation of rebuilding Pyongyang into a more modern and cultural city, marking even the locations of the centre, residential quarters, roads, bridges and pleasure grounds of the city with a pencil.
In those grim days when everyone thought about war only, the President pictured to himself the future of the country which will win, so the designer was deeply moved by the President's faith in certain victory and foresight. -0-

headline: Party-member Battalions Make Successes in Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The Party-member battalions, which were dispatched to Ryanggang Province of the DPRK, are making progress in the next-stage construction of public buildings and rural houses in the spirit of completing the construction of hundreds of single- and low-storied houses in different parts of the Paektu area.
The Pyongyang Municipal Party-member Battalion, which built new houses at the village of the Saphyong Farm in Kapsan County last year, is setting an example in the construction of the cultural hall in Saphyong-ri.
The South Hamgyong Provincial Party-member Battalion is carrying on the project to build hundreds of meters-long river embankment and dig thousands of cubic meters of riverbed while stepping up the construction under its charge.
The South Phyongan Provincial Party-member Battalion mainly completed the roofing work of single- and low-storied dwelling houses and started the project for interior and exterior plastering. It is constructing a pumping station and water collecting well to provide the rural houses with drinking water.
Other Party-member battalions are striving to attain the phased goals.
In response to the spirit of the Party-member battalions, cities and counties in Ryanggang Province, including Kim Hyong Gwon, Unhung and Samsu counties, are putting spurs to the construction of rural houses. -0-

headline: Grain Dryers Manufactured in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 20 (KCNA) -- The manufacturing of grain dryers was concluded thanks to the high enthusiasm of the officials and working people in the agricultural sector of the DPRK.
Hundreds of more grain dryers than planned have been manufactured throughout the country.
The Agricultural Commission sent the designs completed by the scientists of the Farm Machine Institute and technicians of the Ryongnim Farm in Mundok County of South Phyongan Province and the Oguk Farm in Anak County of South Hwanghae Province by pooling their efforts and wisdom to the provincial, city and county manufacturing units, and supplied materials for them.
North Hwanghae Province manufactured grain dryers more than twice of the initial plan, and South Hwanghae Province more than 340 high-efficient grain dryers in a little more than one month.
South and North Phyongan provinces have made more grain dryers than planned through the campaign for increased production and economy.
Other provinces, too, finished manufacturing grain dryers. -0-

headline: Second-stage Production of School Uniforms and Shoes Finished in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of the Ministry of Light Industry and relevant units in the DPRK finished the second-stage production of school uniforms and shoes.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill finished the production of school uniform and bag cloths in May.
The Pyongyang Rayon Factory, the Sariwon Textile Mill and the Sariwon Disabled Soldiers' Sewing Thread Factory solved technical problems and supplied materials needed for the production of school uniforms and bags.

headline: New Organic Food Production System Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- The agricultural high-tech exchange company under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK newly established the organic food production system Paekmi (rice).
As the exchange company built an organic food production line based on processing equipment, sorting and vacuum-packing, it came to build the organic food production system Paekmi that guarantees the nutritive function and quality, free from contamination in the whole processes ranging from production and harvest to processing, storage and transport.
The sci-tech achievements made in the production of organic farm products which conform with the standard indices won the Advanced Science and Technology and Products Exhibition-2024 and the 37th National Festival of Science and Technology.
The exchange company has presented Paekmi products that awarded organic quality certification to domestic public catering networks and international trade fairs, winning great popularity. In the course it has conducted academic and product exchanges with foreign countries and international organic agricultural institutions and its products are winning popularity among purchasers.
Meanwhile, it is paying attention to the service activities through the shops displaying thousands of excellent agricultural sci-tech products presented by agricultural scientific research institutes, universities of agriculture and production units across the country and to the exchanges of agricultural sci-tech achievements and experience and the organic certificate technology service through computer networks. -0-

headline: Many Neighbourhood-Serving Amenities Remodeled in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- More than 300 barbershops, beauty salons and tailor shops in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, have been remodeled for the past two years.
Officials in the welfare service sector in Central and Phyongchon districts set goals to remodel barbershops and beauty salons in the districts in accordance with modern aesthetic tastes and carried out the interior finishing projects, including lighting and wall decoration, in a qualitative way.
Officials and employees of the Songyo District Welfare Service Station face-lifted the barbershop, beauty salon in Chongnyon Street and the Mujin Bath House.
Similar successes are being made in Taedonggang, Moranbong, Sosong, Ryongsong and Sadong districts.
The remodeled tailor shops in the capital city are crowded with people. -0-

headline: Triplets Leave Pyongyang Maternity Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- Triplets left the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital on June 20, being blessed by all people.
Kim Song Hui, mother of the triplets (a son and two daughters), is living in neighbourhood unit No. 78, Sanop-dong, Phohang District, Chongjin City of North Hamgyong Province and their father Kim Kum Hyon is a student of Chongjin University of Technology.
Soon after being confirmed as a woman pregnant with several embryos in October last year, Kim Song Hui was sent to the Pyongyang Maternity Hospital and underwent an intensive medical treatment, receiving the best medical assistance under the benevolent care of the socialist public health system.
The triplets weighed 1.9 kg, 2.1 kg and 1.82 kg at birth and more than 4 kg at present.
Healthy triplets and their parents leaving the hospital were warmly seen off by doctors and nurses. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il Keeps People's Convenience Above All Else
story_text:
One day in November 1981, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited Chongryu Restaurant which was nearing its opening.
Being pleased that the people will be provided with a more abundant and happy life, the Chairman asked an official how many guests can take meals at the restaurant a day.
After hearing with pleasure the official's answer, the Chairman asked again about the mealtime.
The official said that he assessed a mealtime for 40 minutes.
After a while, the Chairman said:
Forty minutes are too short. People will visit the restaurant with welcome guests or friends. At that time, they will exchange conversation with each other while taking a meal in an amicable atmosphere. In my opinion, one hour and a half are not enough for them at that time.
A little later, the Chairman looked around the officials and said that our intention is not to build such an excellent restaurant while spending a lot of funds and materials for moneymaking, but to make the people enjoy themselves, demanding foods they like to their heart's content. And he repeatedly told the officials that they should calculate the mealtime again.
Looking up to the Chairman, who was so concerned about the mealtime to be enjoyed by the people, the officials cherished again their duty as faithful servants of the people. -0-

headline: Day of Persons with Disabilities Marked in DPRK
Action Counter for Lightening Arrester Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- The Electric Power Industry Research Institute under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry in the DPRK has made an achievement for guaranteeing the safety of electric power system on a sci-tech way.
A research group of the institute has newly manufactured action counter for lightening arrester with its own efforts and technology. The counter plays an important role in analyzing accidents of electric power equipment and protecting them by grasping the operation of lightening arresters in real time.
The research group strived to manufacture more efficient counter suited to the actual conditions of the country.
It has succeeded in making a new counter more precise than the previous one by intensifying researches with the main emphasis on ensuring the accuracy of countering.
It has proved the advantages of the counters by introducing them into various units, including the Jagang Provincial Power Transmission and Distribution Station, and built a technical process to meet the demand of the whole country. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Prove Successful at U17, U23 Asian Wrestling Championships 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- DPRK players are proving successful at the U17, U23 Asian Wrestling Championships 2025 being held in Vietnam.
The championships brought together men and women players from over 20 countries and regions including the DPRK, Uzbekistan and India.
On June 20, Kim Kwang Hyon, Kim Ji Hyang and An Jin Ju won gold medals in the 57kg category of freestyle wrestling and 53kg and 57kg categories of women wrestling under 23.
Meanwhile, Kim Chung Ryol placed third in the 55kg category of greco-roman under 23. -0-

headline: Electronic Recreation Room Arranged by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Love for Children
story_text:
One day in December 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the remodeled December 6 Children's Camp in Kangwon Province.
That day, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unlooked round various places of the camp and dropped in at the electronic recreation room.
The room was equipped with various recreational equipment including car-playing apparatus, rhythmic apparatus and shooting apparatus.
The respected General Secretary, who was watching the recreational equipment carefully, said it is better to put computers than those apparatuses, adding that such recreational equipment should be sent to kindergartens.
Saying that the children should be allowed to play electronic games by installing computers in the electronic recreation room, the respected General Secretary told officials that only when the children are allowed to play electronic games, can they raise their level as required by the developing situation.
Later, the electronic recreation room equipped with computers was arranged at the camp thanks to the loving care of the respected General Secretary who worked heart and soul to arrange an electronic recreation room helpful to the children's intellectual development in conformity with their psychology. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on People-first Principle of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea is an invincible revolutionary Party which serves the people and forms a harmonious whole with them, says Rodong Sinmun in an article on Sunday.
There are many parties in the world at present but no party has consistently maintained its revolutionary nature and popular character as a genuine party of the people for 80 years like the WPK, the article notes, and goes on:
The great Party has been steadily advancing straight ahead without a single hesitation or an inch of deviation in the journey of believing in the people as in Heaven and devoting itself to them since it reflects the desire of the people in its red flag. Herein lies the true picture of the WPK based on the people-first principle as its basic principle of struggle.
The past 10-odd years in which the arduous history of our revolution has been compressed shine as immortal years in which the greatness of our Party regarding the people-first principle as the basic principle of struggle has been clearly demonstrated to the whole world.
The people-first principle embodies our Party's outlook on the people and philosophy of the people which regard them as the most precious and powerful beings in the world and reflects its transparent spirit of service to boundlessly love the people and thoroughly realize their demands and interests.
As the Party's politics start with the people-first principle and are thoroughly consistent with it, they shine all over the world as the great politics that win everything and bring about victory.
The DPRK's advance towards comprehensive rejuvenation will be further accelerated as there are the great Workers' Party of Korea dynamically leading the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche to the steady victory and glory under the uplifted banner of the people-first principle and loyal and patriotic people who believe in and follow the Party as the beacon of their destiny and genuine mother and support the Party's ideology and cause with single-minded efforts. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique Brisk in Public Health Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- Public health sector of the DPRK is actively conducting passing-on technique to strengthen the medical forces.
The Ryugyong Dental Hospital initiated medical workers of city and county hospitals into mysteries of more than 40 advanced dental treatment methods.
Medical workers of the Kim Man Yu Hospital went to the South Hwanghae Provincial General Hospital to conduct 100-odd technical lectures and operations and hand over more than 600 advanced scientific and technological data and video data.
Pyongyang Doctor Retraining College made over 10 920 copies of reference books in at least 20 kinds helpful to the study of medical workers of city and county hospitals and distributed them throughout the country. It is also organizing mobile lectures to contribute to the improvement of qualifications of regional medical workers. -0-

headline: Lots of Projects Brisk in South Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- One hundred and dozens of projects have been propelled in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The buildings of the city and county raw materials base stations in the province were renovated and several branch schools including Hwanggak Branch of Soje Senior Middle School in Taedong County were newly built.
The officials and builders in charge of the construction of the Unsan Paper Factory finished the framework project while keeping technical requirements according to processes and introducing advanced working methods. They are now pushing ahead with the interior project.
The builders in charge of the construction of the Phyongsong Lighting Goods Factory are speeding up the project, concentrating on ensuring quality and proper process-by-process engagement.
At the construction sites of the provincial institute of agricultural science, the provincial three-revolution exhibition house, the city and county plant quarantine stations and the Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factory, officials and builders are putting spurs to the fulfillment of their tasks.
Meanwhile, the province produced hundreds of tons of plant nutrients necessary to overcome the effects of the disastrous abnormal weather and improve the growth of crops and supplied them to farms. -0-

headline: Construction of Greenhouse Accelerated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- Members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade are demonstrating the spirit and mettle peculiar to the DPRK youth in the construction of the 450-hectare greenhouse farm.
Thanks to their devoted efforts, the frame project of the semi-arch greenhouse was completed and the greenhouse is being titled and production buildings and annexes built.
The North Phyongan provincial brigade is titling the greenhouse at the final stage after finishing the frame project of more than 20 semi-arch greenhouses.
The High-Speed Youth Shock Brigade has finished the external plastering project while ensuring proper process-by-process engagement in the work to finish the construction of the dwelling houses of employees of the greenhouse qualitatively and made innovations in the interior construction.
The brigades of North Hamgyong, South Hwanghae and ministries and national agencies and other construction units are pushing ahead with the construction after completing the arrangement of the interior of greenhouse. -0-

story_text:

headline: New Production Line of Active Quicklime Established at Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- A new production line of active quicklime was established at the roasting furnace workshop of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex in the DPRK and started its operation.
The production line has mass-produced active quicklime by using limestone and coal abundant in the country.
On this basis, the complex has established a technical process for improving the quality of steel with the use of active quicklime. It made it possible to increase the quality and productivity of iron and steel while saving manpower, electric power and fuel than before. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Prove Successful at U17, U23 Asian Wrestling Championships 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- DPRK players are proving successful at the U17, U23 Asian Wrestling Championships 2025 being held in Vietnam.
The championships brought together men and women players from over 20 countries and regions including the DPRK, Uzbekistan and India.
On June 20, Kim Kwang Hyon, Kim Ji Hyang and An Jin Ju won gold medals in the 57kg category of freestyle wrestling and 53kg and 57kg categories of women wrestling under 23.
Meanwhile, Kim Chung Ryol placed third in the 55kg category of greco-roman under 23. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- In recent years, a number of art pieces have been created and registered as state's possession.
Displayed at the national art exhibitions, shows and festivals held more than 20 times since the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea were art works depicting the immortal revolutionary exploits and noble traits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, drawing boundless excitement and joy of visitors.

headline: Finding Pleasure in Happiness of Rising Generation
story_text:
One day in January 1969, PresidentKim Il Sung, who went round Pyongyang, had the car stopped on the bank of the Pothong River and looked at one place.
There, young pupils in new uniforms and padded clothes were playing snowball fight not feeling the cold.
Looking at them laughing and playing, he said with a broad smile on his face that as clothes make the man, all the children have become beautiful boys and girls and the street is like in bloom of flowers.
Then he said that it is best when feeling such joy and instructed that summer clothes should be made better than winter clothes.
School uniforms have been supplied to all students and pupils in our country since 1958, which is associated with the warm love of the President for the rising generation.
Indeed, the President was the benevolent father of the people who found pleasure in the happiness of the rising generation. -0-

headline: Students of Chilgol Revolutionary School Conduct Motivation Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- Students of Chilgol Revolutionary School conducted motivation activities at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area of the DPRK.
The students revved up the atmosphere of the construction site through numbers reflecting the fighting spirit of the service personnel who are performing heroic feats in the vanguard of the construction revolution in the new era.
The famous songs of the times and the revolutionary songs of the army singing of the aspirations of the soldier-builders to glorify their noble name as creators of the people's happiness gave strength and courage to the soldiers who are devoting their patriotic sweat and efforts to the buildings.
The motivation performance, which showed the vigorous appearance of the students, further raised the spirit of the soldier-builders who are leading the days and months of innovations to the beautiful future of Pyongyang. -0-

headline: High-speed Tunneling Campaign in Coal-mining Industry Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- Coal miners in the sector of coal industry in the DPRK are making successes in securing reserve cutting faces.
Hundreds of reserve cutting faces were provided during high-speed tunneling campaign under the Ministry of Coal Industry.
The Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex secured over 100 reserve cutting faces.
The Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex increased the number of reserve cutting faces as compared with the same period last year.
The members of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the Namyang Coal Mine and the High-speed Tunneling Platoon of the Pit No. 5 and the High-speed Tunneling Platoon of the Taesong Pit of the Hyongbong Coal Mine under the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex are introducing rational working methods and providing a guarantee for increased coal production.
Coal mines of Tukjang, Kaechon, Kujang, Chonnae, Kyongwon area coal-mining complexes are expanding the reserve cutting faces through the socialist emulation among high-speed tunneling units. -0-

headline: Prop Timber Production Goes Up in Forestry Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the forestry sector of the DPRK are stepping up the production of prop timber.
The North Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau is over-fulfilling its plan for the production of prop timber. Tongchang and Taegwan forestry stations under the bureau take the lead in the production of prop timber.
The Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureau is boosting the production of prop timber by raising the operation rate of vehicles.
The Yuson Forestry Station under the North Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Sinhung Mine Timber Production Station under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau and other forestry and mine timber production stations are conducting the work to meet the demand for prop timber in the field of coal industry even in the rainy season. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Class Education House
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- The towering hatred against the U.S. imperialists and class enemies and fierce feelings of revenge are growing stronger with the passage of time and the placement of generations.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Press Release for Enlarged Meeting of Twelfth Plenary Meeting of Eighth Central Committee of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- The Enlarged Meeting of the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea was held from June 21 to 23, 2025.
The plenary meeting was convened to conduct an interim review of the implementation of the major Party and state policies for this year, which were assigned by the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, to reconfirm the central tasks of the work and the orientation of the struggle for the second half of the year and to discuss and decide on the issues arising in the course of expanding and deepening the short-, intermediate- and long-term plans for economic construction.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau and members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the WPK.
Present there as observers were officials of the departments of the Party Central Committee, leading officials of ministries, national agencies and provincial-level guidance bodies, chief secretaries of city and county Party committees, leading Party and administrative officials of major industrial establishments and major commanding officers of the Korean People’s Army.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, presided over the plenary meeting.
The meeting heard a report on the successes made in all fields of socialist construction, including politics, the economy, culture, science, education and national defence in response to the call of the Party Central Committee for glorifying the year 2025 as an epochal year of fulfilling the grand revolutionary programme set forth at the Eighth Party Congress and a year of eye-opening turn in bringing about an upward trend towards a new stage of development and on the work of the Party organizations at all levels in the period of the first half of the year.
The Party Central Committee made a very affirmative appreciation of the remarkable results achieved in the struggle to implement the major Party and state policies in the first half of the year and the spirit of vigorous advance definitely prevailing in overall socialist construction.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade an important speech at the meeting.
The meeting examined and approved strategic adjustment of a series of the Party and state policy tasks and proposals for their timely implementation on the principle of positively promoting successes and experiences and steadily drawing lessons and solutions in keeping with the features of the times, in which a gigantic struggle unprecedented in terms of the width and depth of the state development and the immensity of its goal is being waged, and with the changing objective situations.
A decision on convening the Ninth Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea, which would be another watershed in the course of the development of our Party and revolution, received unanimous approval, and practical measures were taken for the successful opening of the historic Party Congress.
The plenary meeting discussed and decided on the tasks for radically accelerating the revitalization and modernization of major industrial sectors of the national economy standing in the vanguard of further strengthening the independent character and development potential of our national economy and guaranteeing the sustainable and stable comprehensive rejuvenation and growth.
It discussed the tasks essential for improving the fighting efficiency and activeness of the basic Party organizations, which occupy an important position in the organizational structure and system of the Party and for putting the work for the inner-Party structure on a more streamlined and efficient basis as required by the line of Party building in the new era, and adopted a relevant decision.
It dealt with the organizational matter.
The sector-specific study and consultative meetings were held for two days under the guidance of members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee to take measures for correctly carrying out the plans for the second half of the year on the basis of the main spirit of the plenary meeting for thoroughly attaining the goals set for this year by making more courageous, effective and intensive efforts in the most responsible course, in which the work for significantly celebrating the 80th anniversary of national liberation and the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK coincides with the campaign to greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a congress of victors, a glorious congress, and thus bringing about epochal achievements to be specially recorded in the history of the Party and the country.
The draft decisions, amended and supplemented on the basis of the constructive and dynamic opinions presented at the consultative meetings, were discussed at the 25th meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
The finally confirmed decisions were submitted to the plenary meeting and adopted with the unanimous approval of members of the Party Central Committee.
Through the enlarged meeting of its Twelfth Plenary Meeting, the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK discussed and decided on practical measures for expanding the ideal and solid cornerstone for the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism as soon as possible, firmly maintaining the rising trend of the development of the state which was achieved with the revolutionary spirit of self-sustenance and indomitable courage of advance, and thus successfully went through an important process essential for accelerating the advance towards a new victory.
The important speech made byKim Jong Unat the June 2025 Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the WPK and the decisions adopted at the meeting will be published as inner-Party documents and distributed to the Party organizations at all levels. -0-

headline: Motivation Campaign Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- Members of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the art squad of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea conducted more than 400 rounds of motivation activities at over 230 units across the country this year, encouraging Party members, working people and service personnel.
At the construction site of the large greenhouse farm, members of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League conducted intensive and offensive motivation activities.
At the construction sites of the leisure complex in Kangdong County and the regional-industry factories in Yomju County, the members of the art squad inspired the soldier-builders with songs of the revolutionary army.
The songs sung by the members of the Workers' Art Group of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea resounded at major construction sites in the capital city and farm fields in Jangyon, Anak, Jaeryong and Sinchon counties.
The members of the art squad of the C.C., the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea gave motivation performances at farms in South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces.
The members of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea visited the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area where they increase the effectiveness of the frontline-style motivation activities with various motivation forms and methods.
They also conducted  motivation activities at farm fields in Pyongyang to encourage the farmers to put spurs to carrying out their immediate farming tasks. -0-

headline: Benevolent Measure for Miners
story_text:
At one midnight in June 1976, ChairmanKim Jong Ilcalled an official by phone who was dispatched to the Musan Mining Complex.
After acquainting himself with the overall situation of the mine, the Chairman asked him why he did not tell of the housing problem of workers.
As the official did not answer properly, hesitating, the Chairman said that the good dwelling houses for the newly-deployed discharged soldiers should be built as soon as possible.
The Chairman said that the problem is not materials or manpower, but the ideological viewpoint of the officials who lacked the spirit of serving the people, not properly establishing the revolutionary viewpoint on the masses, officials should think first about miners who produce concentrated ores before thinking about them and that officials were not paying attention to the miners' lives.
The Chairman said that the houses should be built in a cozy way at the foot of mountains before winter, single-room houses should not be built and that there is nothing to spare for the miners.
The official cherished with warm emotion the teachings of the Chairman who always leads the officials to live and work as faithful servants of the people with a correct viewpoint on them.
In less than three months afterwards, many new dwelling houses were built and miners including the discharged soldiers moved into the new houses. -0-

The finally confirmed decisions were submitted to the plenary meeting and adopted with unanimous approval of the members of the Party Central Committee.
Through the enlarged meeting of its Twelfth Plenary Meeting, the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK discussed and decided on practical measures to expand the ideal and solid cornerstone for the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism as soon as possible, firmly holding fast to the rising trend of the development of the state which was achieved with the revolutionary spirit of self-sustenance and indomitable courage of advance and thus successfully went through the important processes essential for accelerating the advance toward new victory.

headline: Efficacious Seed-covering Material Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- Researchers of the Institute of Agro-chemicalization under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK developed an efficacious seed-covering material "Phungnyonmo No. 1".
This seed-covering material is an agricultural sci-tech product that makes it possible to cultivate healthy rice seedlings even in unfavorable climatic conditions by increasing the germination rate of seeds, strengthening seedling growth and root activity and preventing the outbreak of various diseases.
This seed-covering material, effective for cultivating rice seedlings, has been introduced into many farms, winning high appreciation.
The seed-covering material was registered as a high-tech product. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Chongdan County of South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- New houses were built in Sinsaeng-ri, Chongdan County in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK amid the continuous appearance of proud entities of the creation of the Korean-style rural civilization.
The cozy houses, built to ensure modernity and architectural beauty while preserving the regional features and refinement, are the home of happiness brought about by the noble devotion to the people of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea which sees to it that the agricultural workers enjoy rural civilization in the new era.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses held on the spot on June 22 were officials of the Party and power organs in South Hwanghae Province and Chongdan County, builders and farmers, the owners of the new houses.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
Officials congratulated the working people who moved to their new house.
Listening to the impressions of owners of new houses, the officials encouraged them to work hard for the Party and the socialist system.
The new houses were filled with songs of happiness and laughter and the village was merry with sparking play. -0-

story_text: Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Korean Central News Agency headed by Vice General Director Kang Chol returned home by air on June 23 after taking part in the 19th general meeting of the Organization of Asia-Pacific News Agencies (OANA) held in Sankt-Peterburg of Russia. -0-

headline: Dairy Production Goes Up in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 24 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK has striven to implement the childcare policy of the Workers' Party of Korea, thus renovating nearly 400 production rooms for dairy products, secured tens of thousands of goats and built many goat farms and branch farms.
The remodeling of the production rooms for dairy products in a short span of time laid material and technical foundations for producing more and good-quality tasty and nutritious dairy products for children.
The province pushed ahead with the work to increase the number of goats, thus securing tens of thousands of goats and increasing milk production. It opened up a prospect for solving the feed problem by increasing grass area.
It accelerated the construction of large goat pen in the relevant area of Sinuiju City.
Goat farms and branch farms were built in Jongju City, Sakju and Tongnim counties and other areas. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 25 (KCNA) -- An art exhibition on the theme of class education opened at the Pyongyang International House of Culture on Tuesday ahead of June 25, the day of struggle against U.S. imperialism.
On display there were art works showing the thrice-cursed crimes committed by the U.S. imperialists, the Japanese imperialists and other sworn enemies.
Oil paintings "The Grudge Cherished on the Western Coast" and "The Shout of the 103rd Child" that denounce the U.S. imperialists for cruelly slaughtering innocent residents and even mere children during the past Fatherland Liberation War add to the strong hatred and resentment of the revenge-seekers.
Korean painting "The Night of the New Year's Day", sculpture "In the Badger Cave" and other art pieces disclose the crimes of the Japanese imperialists who illegally occupied Korea and forced its people into miserable fate of slaves.
Also displayed are calligraphy "Countering Nukes of Tyranny with Nukes of Justice" and poster "Let's Mercilessly Annihilate the Shabby and Despicable ROK Gangsters" reflecting the will to mercilessly wipe out the U.S. imperialists and the ROK war maniacs keen on stifling the dignified DPRK.
Officials and creators in the field of fine arts and working people in the city looked round the exhibition venue. -0-
