headline: Construction of Hoeyang Army-People Power Station Brisk in Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 25 (KCNA) -- Kangwon Province of the DPRK is speeding up the construction of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station.
The builders have completed the tunneling of waterway tunnel and the banking project and are now pushing ahead with the construction of overflow dam, establishment of pressure iron pipe conduit and other projects.
They have already finished tunneling, widening and covering several kilometers of waterways and building a dam of over 1.1 million cubic meters.
Officials and builders in Kangwon Province are making collective innovations to finish the construction of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station in a qualitative way. -0-

headline: Youth and Students Meet to Vow Revenge on U.S. Imperialists
Electric Insulating Paper Production Line Established at Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 25 (KCNA) -- The Chongjin Chemical Fibre Mill of the DPRK has built an electric insulating paper production line and put it into full operation, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The factory developed and introduced a multi-purpose electric insulating paper production line combining modern multi-layer paper production technology with coating and calendering process, thus making it possible to mass-produce various kinds of electric insulating papers in our own way.
The paper produced by the factory is highly appreciated by relevant experts for its high level of all technical indices including tensile strength, fold strength and insulation resistance. -0-

headline: Thunder of Victory in June 75 Years Ago
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 25 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungwon a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) with his iron will, matchless courage and pluck.
The President convened an emergency meeting of the Cabinet on June 25, 1950, when the U.S. imperialists' invasion of the DPRK started.
At the time when all the participants in the meeting were worried in the face of the grim reality that the war is between the young DPRK and the U.S. imperialists, the ringleader of world imperialists, the resonant voices of the President who said "The enemies are foolish. The Yankees misjudged the Koreans!" were heard like thunder at the corridor of the hall of the emergency meeting of the Cabinet.
Entering the meeting hall, the President looked around and declared that the we should show the mettle of the Korean people to the Yankees who look down upon the Koreans, not aware of them, just as the wolves should be tamed with a stick.
The courage and pluck of the illustrious commander to show the mettle of the Korean people with a stick, regarding the U.S. imperialists as a wolf running recklessly, removed the momentary uneasiness and fear of the participants in the meeting and instilled confidence in victory into them.
The victory was already decided on the first day when the U.S. imperialist aggressors provoked the Korean War.
The U.S. imperialists' bombast that the destiny of the DPRK "would be settled within 72 hours" turned into a surrender document after three years when 72 hours were repeated hundreds of times, and the Korean people proudly fired fireworks of war victory with joy and excitement of defeating the U.S. imperialists for the first time in history.
The victory in the Fatherland Liberation War which smashed to atoms the myth about the "mightiness" of the U.S. imperialists and brought about the beginning of a downhill turn for them is recorded in the proud history of the DPRK as the victory of the extraordinary military wisdom and outstanding commanding art of the President and the great victory of the faith in sure victory, pluck and optimism. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Leadership Ability of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article says that Korean-style socialism could achieve the comprehensive development while making a radical change and a dynamic leap forward without any depression and stalemate since the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. This is unthinkable without the seasoned leadership of the WPK, the article says, and goes on:
The leadership of the WPK, which clearly indicates the path to be followed in each period and at each stage of the developing revolution, is a powerful driving force that leads all the people to a new victory in socialist construction.
In the new era of the Juche revolution, the WPK has adopted scientific lines and policies capable of overcoming the complicated situation and grim subjective and objective environment, illuminated the correct path and goals and aroused the people to the struggle for realizing them and victoriously advanced the revolution and construction.
The leadership of the WPK, which skillfully mobilizes the high enthusiasm and extraordinary creativity of our people to implement the Party's decisions, is a fundamental source of helping bring about the remarkable successes and results in all fields of social life.
It is the truth proved by the history of our revolutionary struggle that if we believe in the people and rely on them, we will emerge ever-victorious, but if we keep ourselves aloof from them and are forsaken by them, we will lose everything.
The revolutionary spirit of our people, who absolutely support the Party's plans and determinations and carry them out with their thoroughgoing practice of action, is constantly bringing about world-startling miracles.
The seasoned leadership ability of the WPK, which indicates the scientific path and sets forth clear practical policies according to each period and stage of the developing revolution and powerfully leads the people to thoroughly and perfectly implement the policies, is the strength of miracles bringing about epoch-making changes and a steady leap forward on this land. -0-

headline: Mass Rally Held at Sinchon Class Education House
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of June 25, the DPRK people are further hardening their will to reliably defend justice, peace and socialism from the persistent tyranny and aggression of imperialism and make a new history of great victory and change, demonstrating the dignity and spirit of a great power before the whole world.
There took place a mass rally in Sinchon, a historic place clearly proving the crimes committed by the U.S. imperialists and the source of the DPRK people's will to take revenge upon the enemies, on June 25, the day of struggle against U.S. imperialism.
The plaza of the Sinchon Class Education House and its surroundings were crowded with masses of people with deep hatred and resentment against the sworn enemies who plunged this land into the bloodbath of the war of aggression and are hell-bent on the confrontation with the DPRK, committing crimes one after another.
Present at the mass rally were Choe Tong Myong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, officials of working people's organizations, ministries and national agencies and officials, working people, youth and students in South Hwanghae Province.
Prior to the mass rally, the participants laid flowers before the tombs of 400 mothers and 102 children and paid a silent tribute to them.
At the rally, an artistic motivation on the theme of class education was given to expose and denounce the brutal atrocities committed by the U.S. imperialist murderers and class enemies against the Korean people during the Fatherland Liberation War.
Through the numbers vividly reminding the people of the war which left a permanent scar in the hearts of the Korean people and the terrible scene in which the land of the country reduced into the bloodbath, the masses clearly realized once again the immutable truth that if the country had been as strong as the present and its people had been equipped with transparent class consciousness, there would not have been the lesson drawn on this land 70-odd years ago.
At the meeting, speakers, representing the DPRK people's retaliatory spirit and anti-U.S. resistance will, expressed their firm determination to mercilessly smash the enemies' desperate moves and firmly defend the most just cause of the DPRK, the beloved country and the socialist system, bitterly denouncing the thrice-cursed atrocities committed by the U.S. imperialists and class enemies on this land.
The DPRK people's will to take revenge upon the enemies is growing stronger as they cherish the immutable truth of class and the determination of punishment in Sinchon, the source of the DPRK people's bitter hatred and enraged public sentiment, they said, adding that the barbarity of the U.S. imperialism, who has become ill-famed as "the native place of massacre" since its birth and hardened the war of aggression and massacre of other nations as its instinct for existence.
They stressed that it is the unshakable creed of the DPRK people through June 25 that one must be strong and build the strongest national power in order to defend justice, never repeating the bitter history, so that no one can challenge.
The speakers said that the heroic struggle of the DPRK people single-mindedly uniting around the Party Central Committee with the will to fight to the last against the forces trying to encroach upon the sovereignty and undermine the dignity of their country and firm belief that their choice is justice would frustrate the hegemony and arbitrary practices of the imperialists and create a new world of independence and justice.
Then followed demonstrations.
The ranks of avengers, regarding taking revenge upon the enemies with their steadfast class awareness as the urgent duty of the generation, marched, chanting such slogans of annihilating the enemies as "Let us annihilate the U.S. imperialist aggressors, the sworn enemy of the Korean people!" and "Let us show the mettle of heroic Korea in the showdown with the U.S.!"
The ranks filled with unshakable faith and courage to defend the great Party, the country and socialism demonstrated the fighting spirit and courage of the defenders to deal a hard blow to the enemies by steadily carrying forward the patriotic spirit and with the will of punishment and to cover the path of strengthening the national power and accelerating the socialist advance.
The mass rally held on the occasion of June 25, the day of struggle against U.S. imperialism, fully demonstrated once again the spirit and mettle of the DPRK people to surely win a great victory in the confrontation with the U.S. and glorify the dignity, honor and rosy future of the powerful state forever by fully displaying the invincibility of ever-victorious heroic Korea. -0-

headline: Potato-processing Base Associated with Warm Love of Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
One day in January 2001, ChairmanKim Jong Ilcalled an official to learn about various issues. Among them was the issue related with the then Taehongdan Potato Starch Factory.
He said that the factory should be equipped with a production line of processed potato products including dehydrated starch noodle.
He stressed the need to build the production line so as to provide the people with a lot of dehydrated starch noodle and taffy, saying that our people liked dehydrated starch noodles but they were not supplied enough to the people as they were not produced in quantities in the past.
He personally drew with a piece of wood on the snow-covered walkway the places for building new lines of producing dehydrated starch noodles, taffies and wines at the factory that he matured during field guidance.
He instructed with pleasure that it would be well done if the factory was remodeled as he had drawn.
Like this, the wonderful potato-processing base built in Taehongdan is associated with the warm love and devotion ofKim Jong Il. -0-

headline: Epoxy Resin Paint Production Line Built in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- The Songyong Paint Factory in the DPRK has newly built an epoxy resin paint production line.
The high-quality epoxy resin paint is used to paint various kinds of machineries and devices, electronic appliances and household goods and the floors of foodstuff factories and pharmaceutical factories. The establishment of epoxy resin paint makes it possible to satisfy the demand for chemical products.
The factory has successfully conducted test operations several times since January. It is putting spurs to revitalizing production at a high level. -0-

headline: Mass Rallies Held in DPRK
Employees Trained for Operation of Leisure Complex in Kangdong County
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Municipality is pushing ahead with the training of employees for the operation of the leisure complex in Kangdong County.
The municipality organizes training work in the fields of commerce, public catering and neighborhood-servicing so that the employees who will work at the leisure complex can acquire high qualifications in theory and practice.
Several educational units in the municipality are giving theoretical lectures suited to different occupations for the employees.
Practical trainings and visits for the employees of the leisure complex are also being organized at commercial, public catering and neighborhood-servicing networks.
Training for employees in the commercial sector has already been completed and training of employees in the public catering and neighborhood-servicing sectors is going on.
The municipality regularly reviews the training of employees and takes necessary measures while providing the necessary conditions for theoretical and practical education. -0-

headline: Inaugural Ceremony of Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the firm revolutionary will of the Workers' Party of Korea to bring about the shining efflorescence of socialist civilization on our land in our own way with our own resources, entities of new life and new wellbeing are created one after another in different parts of the country. In the days of such rejuvenation, a modern coastal tourist area was created on the Kalma peninsula, famous for its beautiful seaside scenery, greeting the auspicious time of inauguration.
The Wonsan Kalma area, in which hundreds of buildings of modern beauty of various forms have been built in harmony with the scenery of the coastal area widely known for an outstanding landscape from olden times to form a perfect artistic compatibility and connectivity, is a coastal tourist city of our own style without an equal in the world both in name and reality.
The tourist area houses hotels and hostels with accommodations for nearly 20 000 people that the guests at home and abroad can choose according to their tastes. It has sea-bathing service facilities, various sports and recreation facilities and commercial and public catering facilities fully equipped with all conditions and cultural life bases for providing the beauty of the scenic spot on the east coast in all seasons, excitingly picturing a 4km-long stretch of beach to be crowded with the people every year.
The change in the Wonsan Kalma area, a great auspicious event of the whole country, is a brilliant fruition of the profound thinking and undying efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho unfolded a grand blueprint for building a world-class cultural resort and saw to it that all the edifices are perfectly created staking the dignity of our state and the honour of our generation. And it is a prelude to the new era of our country's tourist industry came along with the great spirit of service of the Workers' Party of Korea which is steadily carving out a new sphere of socialist civilization and an important cultural progress that made a weighty milestone in the building of our own-style tourist industry.
The inaugural ceremony of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area, a proud and encouraging creation that redoubles the patriotic enthusiasm of our people to outpace the world, was held with splendor on June 24.
The venue of the inaugural ceremony was full of pride of the builders who proudly built a wonderful cultural tourist resort for the people by upholding the noble intention of the great Party Central Committee with vigorous struggle and extraordinary mettle of creation, and the joy of the working people who feel the birth of the proud coastal tourist city of national value.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the inaugural ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded far and wide.
All the participants paid the highest tribute toKim Jong Un, the great master of creation and construction and the dear father, who is ushering in a new era of prosperity and development full of laughter and happiness of the people with the ardent desire to provide the beloved people with a brighter and richer life and new civilization and with his brilliant wisdom and energetic leadership practice.
Present at the ceremony were the members of central leadership body of the Party including leading cadres of the Party and government, officials of ministries and national agencies, military and civilian builders, officials and employees of the units in charge of construction and operation and officials, working people and youth and students in Kangwon Province and Wonsan City.
The Russian ambassador to the DPRK and his embassy members were invited as special guests.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Thae Song, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made an inaugural address.
The inauguration of the coastal tourist area, which has emerged on the beautiful Kalma peninsula as a masterpiece of Korean-style tourism, demonstrating the tremendous strength and rapid development of our state, is a clear proof of the inexhaustible creativity and vigorous practical ability of socialist Korea which makes a new history of great change and civilization, the premier said, expressing warm militant tribute in the name of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK to all the builders who have powerfully demonstrated the spirit of the DPRK which splendidly paves the way for the eye-opening development toward future with such precious wealth.
He went on:
The Kalma peninsula, which can be called the coastal scenic spot with the best ecological environment, has assumed a new elegant and modern appearance - this is an epoch-making change that can be made only by our Party.
It is a symbol of the great dignity and wellbeing of the people upheld by the people-first politics of our Party and the socialist system of our own style.  Herein lies the true meaning of the coastal tourist area and beauty peculiar to it and the noble state no tourist attractions can reach.
He said thatKim Jong Unenergetically led the work to make sure that the worthwhile grand construction for providing the DPRK people with the most civilized recreation ground in the world is dynamically accelerated as the Party and state work.
The speaker stressed that the valuable teachings ofKim Jong Un, who developed judgment of officials while giving meticulous guidance to thousands of architectural layouts, saw to it that all the structures in the tourist area are completed at the highest level and gave detailed solution to all the issues including the one of establishing unique service methods and capabilities, are a great encyclopedia that comprehensively deals with the orientation and ways for building a tourist industry in the new era.
Noting thatKim Jong Unvisited the construction site despite the wild sea wind several times a year to call upon the builders to present the coastal tourist area to the people by building it into a cultural recreation ground without an equal in the world, the speaker said that his ardent appeal redoubled the loyalty and patriotic faith of all the builders and powerfully encouraged them to the heroic labour struggle. The speaker referred to the fact that the builders successfully erected grand miraculous edifices, creating amazing construction speed, advanced methods and model experience one after another, cherishing the sacred mission of implementing the intention of the great Party Central Committee on the road of breaking a new ground of tourist culture.
The erection of the world-level coastal tourist city, the best marine park, by our own efforts is the valuable honour and worth of our generation which holds in high esteem the great leader who is making a new history of rejuvenation and prosperity in which men, mountains and streams and times are undergoing change beyond recognition through the dynamic construction revolution, the speaker said, adding that the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area will shine as a monument to the people-first idea and leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The premier said that the eye-opening change made on the Kalma peninsula through the indomitable pioneering and fortitude indicates a new watershed for comprehensive prosperity to be certainly approached by the state and people of the DPRK despite all difficulties, calling upon all the people to make a dynamic advance with higher ideals and dreams for the future of our state which will be turned into a paradise for the people along the road set by the Party Central Committee.
Kim Jong Uncut the inaugural tape.
Enthusiastic cheers were raised and fireworks of celebrations displayed and balloons flown up, beautifully decorating the clear and blue sky over Myongsasimni.
Kim Jong Unwent round various places of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area including the Myongsasimni Outdoor Wading Pool, the Kalma Moranbong Hotel and the Myongsasimni Hotel together with leading officials of the Party and the government.
Enjoying a bird's-eye view of the coastal tourist city which presents a grand sight, he said with great satisfaction that what he wanted to do most for the people and the Party's cherished desire into which it has thrown energy for a long time were translated into a brilliant reality and our inexhaustible spirit of pioneering was fully demonstrated once again through the gigantic construction.
Noting that all the structures in the Wonsan Kalma area are the monumental edifices that comprehensively represent the mature phase of our architecture which has rapidly made a leap forward with each passing year, he expressed his deep emotion over the building of an eye-opening entity to be recorded as one of the greatest successes this year concluding the implementation of the decisions made at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Saying that the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area should play a leading role in establishing the tourist culture of the DPRK, he stressed the need for all the units in charge of operation to provide all tourists to the scenic spot on the eastern coast with the best convenience and leisure space in order to help them spend pleasant and satisfactory days.
Noting that in our country with diverse and rich tourist resources and the political safety and institutional stability peculiar to it, tourist industry is of great prospective significance as a motive power promoting the efflorescence and the development of the cultural field and the rejuvenation of the relevant region and contributing to the overall economic growth of the state, he indicated an important orientation for expanding and developing our style tourism on a large scale.
He said that the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area is the proud first step in the course of implementing the policy of the Party and the government on the development of cultural tourism and the Ninth Congress of the WPK would confirm an important plan for building promising large tourist cultural areas of various types in different regions in the shortest time possible on the basis of the successes and experience gained in the development of the Kalma peninsula.
A performance was given to mark the inauguration of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area.
The night of celebration was jubilant with famous songs full of the stir of the prosperous times in which every dream and ideal have been translated into the brilliant reality along with the blooming socialist civilization, hope for future and burning patriotic enthusiasm and with gorgeous fireworks.
Kim Jong Unexpressed belief that the wave of the happiness to be raised in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area would enhance its attractive name as a world-level tourist cultural resort, heralding the future of paradise to be built in different parts of the country.
The landscape of civilization on the beautiful beach of the eastern coast whose looks have undergone a dramatic change thanks to the most popular view of the WPK on the development of the state will shine long as a cultural treasure which brings the people's laughter into full bloom year after year, demonstrating the inexhaustible development potential and valiant pioneering spirit peculiar to the DPRK which is confidently ushering in a promising new era of prosperity.
The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area starts service for tourists at home from July 1. -0-

headline: Number of Entrants to Tele-education Faculty Increases
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Working people of the regional-industry factories built as the first entities of the regional rejuvenation in 20 cities and counties across the DPRK are now entering the tele-education faculty of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry.
Many working people of foodstuff, garment and daily necessities factories in the relevant areas have entered the tele-education faculty of the university last year and this year and the number of applicants is increasing.
Hundreds of workers in Kimhwa County have become students of the tele-education faculty to learn scientific and technological knowledge suited to their factories and occupations.
Working people in Songchon, Kyongsong, Sukchon, Jaeryong and Hamju counties and many other parts of the country are and preparing themselves to be intelligent workers and sci-tech talents while receiving tele-education.
The university is  making tele-education teaching programs and multimedia in an effective way, in reflection of the trend of development of modern science and technology. -0-

headline: Month of Anti-U.S. Joint Struggle Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- A solidarity meeting took place in the Czech Republic on June 16 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Present there were personages of political parties and organizations including the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea and masses.
Iri Grunbauer, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, made a speech at the meeting.
He said that the U.S. is persistently staging war drills for aggression and, at the same time, dispatching lots of nuclear strategic assets to the ROK while watching for a chance to occupy the DPRK at any time.
The reality clearly proves that the U.S. is the chieftain of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula, he said.
He stressed that the progressive people of the Czech Republic bitterly denounce the moves of the U.S., a world peace disturber, to isolate and stifle the DPRK.
Video dealing with the crimes committed by the U.S. imperialists, provokers of the Korean war and wreckers of peace, was shown at the meeting.
Meanwhile, an anti-U.S. demonstration took place outside the U.S. embassy in London, UK on June 21 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Letters sent by members of the organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in different countries and regions including Germany and Brazil were read out at the demonstration attended by personages of the New Communist Party of Britain, the Revolutionary Communist Party of Britain (Marxist-Leninist) and the Korean Friendship Association UK and other masses. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in  Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on June 23 on the occasion of the first anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology, Andrei Rudenko, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and personages of the government, parliament, organizations and institutions including the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Interior, the Federation Council, the State Duma and the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK.
Present there were Sin Hong Chol, DPRK ambassador to Russia, and his embassy members.
The participants first laid a flower basket and bouquets before the art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
Then they looked round photos showing the noble revolutionary careers and exploits of the President and the Chairman and the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, immortal classic works of the peerlessly great men and photos of the invincible might and proud development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception.
Meanwhile, DPRK missions in Vladivostok and Khabarovsk of Russia hosted receptions on June 20 on the occasion of the first anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries. -0-

headline: Integrated Management Information System Introduced into Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- The work for putting the management on a scientific and IT basis is progressing apace at the regional-industry factories of 20 cities and counties of the DPRK.
Practical successes have been made in putting operations of the factories on a normal footing through the introduction of the integrated management information system developed by scientists ofKim Il SungUniversity into daily necessities factories and garment factories in cities and counties.
From January to mid-May this year, the integrated management information system was introduced into not only daily necessities factories and garment factories in 20 cities and counties but also the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
The relevant units, with the foundation for realizing real-time control and analysis of management activities and putting economic calculation on a scientific basis and putting the economic management on a regular basis, are concentrating efforts on making the management and production activities effective by tapping their regional resources to the maximum. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Successfully Completing Five-year Plan
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Friday in an editorial says that the Enlarged Meeting of the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea is of great significance as it discussed and decided key issues in the struggle for strengthening and developing our Party and state.
The plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee is a significant one which clarifies the guidelines for successfully fulfilling the five-year plan and further strengthening the independence and development potentials of the state economy, the editorial says, and goes on:
The plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee unanimously approved to convene the Ninth Congress of the WPK, another important watershed in the course of the development of our Party and revolution, and decided on the essential issues arising in improving the fighting efficiency and activeness of the basic Party organizations as required by the line of Party building in the new era.
Only when the tasks set forth by the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee are carried out thoroughly, will the 80-year history of leadership of our Party, which has written the longest history as a socialist ruling Party, shine more brilliantly and another historic milestone be recorded at the stage of the development of Korean-style socialism.

headline: Integrated Management Information System Introduced into Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- The work for putting the management on a scientific and IT basis is progressing apace at the regional-industry factories of 20 cities and counties of the DPRK.
Practical successes have been made in putting operations of the factories on a normal footing through the introduction of the integrated management information system developed by scientists ofKim Il SungUniversity into daily necessities factories and garment factories in cities and counties.
From January to mid-May this year, the integrated management information system was introduced into not only daily necessities factories and garment factories in 20 cities and counties but also the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
The relevant units, with the foundation for realizing real-time control and analysis of management activities and putting economic calculation on a scientific basis and putting the economic management on a regular basis, are concentrating efforts on making the management and production activities effective by tapping their regional resources to the maximum. -0-

headline: Month of Anti-U.S. Joint Struggle Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- A solidarity meeting took place in the Czech Republic on June 16 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Present there were personages of political parties and organizations including the Czechoslovak Communist Party, the Paektusan Czech-Korean Friendship Association and the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea and masses.
Iri Grunbauer, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Czechoslovak Communist Party, made a speech at the meeting.
He said that the U.S. is persistently staging war drills for aggression and, at the same time, dispatching lots of nuclear strategic assets to the ROK while watching for a chance to occupy the DPRK at any time.
The reality clearly proves that the U.S. is the chieftain of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula, he said.
He stressed that the progressive people of the Czech Republic bitterly denounce the moves of the U.S., a world peace disturber, to isolate and stifle the DPRK.
Video dealing with the crimes committed by the U.S. imperialists, provokers of the Korean war and wreckers of peace, was shown at the meeting.
Meanwhile, an anti-U.S. demonstration took place outside the U.S. embassy in London, UK on June 21 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Letters sent by members of the organizations of friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in different countries and regions including Germany and Brazil were read out at the demonstration attended by personages of the New Communist Party of Britain, the Revolutionary Communist Party of Britain (Marxist-Leninist) and the Korean Friendship Association UK and other masses. -0-

headline: Teleconference System in Agricultural Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- The teleconference system is actively operated in the agricultural sector of the DPRK.
The teleconference system in the agricultural sector is an IT system by which officials and scientists exchange opinions and take measures on technical issues arising in farm work by connecting the Agricultural Commission, the Academy of Agricultural Sciences, agricultural guidance organs at all levels and farms with computer networks.
It makes it possible to disseminate advanced science and technology among lower-echelon units and discuss and take immediate measures for the issues arising in farming at farms located in mountainous areas as well as in flat areas.
Tele-questioning and answering lectures on farming techniques are being given with dozens of scientific and technological issues arising in agricultural production.
Officials of the Agricultural Commission and scientists of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences are storing the data for helping solve technical problems arising in this year's farming according to sectors and farming processes on the basis of the achievements made in agricultural scientific researches and the high-yield experience in recent years, and disseminating them. -0-

headline: Volume 65 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 65 of "Complete Collection ofKim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively carries the immortal classic works of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a chronological order.
The book contains 44 classic works made public byKim Jong Ilin the period from September 2002 to February 2003.
In the immortal classic work "The Songun-Based Revolutionary Line Is a Great Revolutionary Line of Our Era and an Ever-Victorious Banner of Our Revolution"Kim Jong Ilclarified the tasks and ways for defending and carrying forward with arms the sacred revolutionary cause which was pioneered and has won victory by force of arms.
There are works dealing with tasks arising in satisfactorily solving the food problem for the people by thoroughly implementing the Party's policies for bringing about a radical turn in potato farming, seed improvement and double cropping, and in developing fish farming.
The book contains works clarifying the tasks for all counties to make a turn in developing the regional economy and improving the people's standard of living by promoting the economic life of the county in conformity with their regional characteristics.
The book also contains immortal works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction, including the issue for the art troupes of the Korean People's Army to create and give more good performances suited to the thoughts and feelings of the service personnel and people and the issue of actively preserving the excellent national traditions of the Korean people. -0-

headline: Collective Innovation Movement in Key Industrial Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- Young people in the key industrial sector of the DPRK are increasing production through the collective innovation movement.
The young people of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex finished disposing slag and fly ashes.
The production has been put on a normal footing in various sectors of the national economy thanks to  the young people in the field of electricity production who conduct shock brigade activities including collecting hundreds of tons of the dropped coal and reducing wagons' stoppage time.
Officials and members of the youth league in the Ministry of Railways secured more than 100 000 concrete sleepers and hundreds of cubic meters of gravels to contribute to ensuring the stability of railway operation.
Young people of the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex overhauled an electric locomotive by conducting the repair support team activities. In May, more than 100 locomotives and over 430 freight cars were repaired through the brisk mass movement.
As of June, the young people of the Kim Kwang Chol Youth Shock Brigade of the Ryongdung Coal Mine fulfilled their tunneling plans for two years, and the young people of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade of the Kogonwon Coal Mine are contributing to increasing the coal production by collecting the dropped coal every day. -0-

headline: Farms in South Hwanghae Province Focus on Immediate Farming Processes
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are displaying a high sense of responsibility in the immediate farming.
Officials and farmers in Unchon, Anak and Jaeryong counties finished the wheat and barley harvest ahead of others and are stepping up threshing.
Kangryong and Sinchon counties are carrying the grain without any waste to threshing grounds and pushing ahead with threshing, thus increasing the successes every day.
Farmers in Paechon, Thaethan and Samchon counties completed the harvesting while stepping up potato harvesting.
Haeju City and Jangyon County finished rice transplanting first, and several counties have pushed ahead with the after-crop rice-transplanting at the final stage while giving priority to harrowing paddy fields.
Meanwhile, cities and counties have taken measures to secure high-yielding strains of after-crop bean and plant them in the right season.
Officials and agricultural workers in the province are propelling the immediate farming processes, including finishing the third-round weeding of cornfields and intensifying the insect monitoring. -0-

headline: Story about Meeting to Convey Congratulatory Message
story_text:
One day in January 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmet officials and highly appreciated the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex for their unprecedented success in cement production in the previous year. And he said that he made sure that a congratulatory message was sent to them.
The officials were much impressed by the great loving care ofKim Jong Unwho made the feats of the workers of the complex shine before the whole world. They wanted to inform them of his loving care as soon as possible.
After a while,Kim Jong Unstressed that the meeting to convey the congratulatory message to the workers, technicians and officials of the complex should not be held on Sunday when they were resting, but on the next day.
Thus, the meeting to convey the congratulatory message was held on January 18, the next day.
Workers, technicians and officials of the complex were deeply impressed by the story.
Indeed, the loving care of the great father was boundless. -0-

headline: General Education Units in Pyongyang Improve Experimental and Practical Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- General education units in Pyongyang are improving the educational contents and methods.
Namsin Senior Middle School in Songyo District organizes exhibitions of experimental apparatuses and teaching aids on a regular basis and properly reviews and evaluates the results while providing laboratories with better conditions so that all teachers turn out in the work to improve the practical abilities of students in different subjects.
Jungsin Senior Middle School in Sosong District strives to improve the educational conditions and environment so as to enhance the students' theoretical cognition and practical abilities.
Teachers of Tongan Primary School in Central District are using experimental apparatuses suitable for teaching subjects to make pupils acquire basic knowledge that can use in practice.
Sinni Kindergarten in Tongdaewon District has produced teaching aids for science playing and multimedia suited to the children's minds. -0-

headline: Progress Witnessed in Construction of Ryonggang County Hospital and Regional-Industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The framework of the Ryonggang County Hospital and the external plastering of regional-industry factories were completed thanks to the struggle of officers and men of the 124th Regiment of the Korean People's Army dispatched to Ryonggang County, Nampho Municipality of the DPRK.
While concentrating efforts on putting the construction equipment on a modern and standardized basis, the commanding officers of the unit conducted organization and command to ensure the quality of the construction by strengthening the ranks of the skilled workers.
Officers and men in charge of the construction of the hospital organized and arranged construction forces, equipment and means in a rational way and ensured proper process-by-process engagement to step up the framework project.
Soldier-builders increased the operation rate of heavy machines and carried out the processing of steel bars and concrete tamping as required by technical regulations.
The officers and men in charge of the construction of regional-industry factories conducted technical study and demonstration in a substantial way and made innovations in the construction of infrastructure, roofing work and exterior plastering.
More successes are being registered in the projects thanks to the devoted efforts of the soldier-builders. -0-

headline: Delegation of Russian Ministry of Culture Arrives Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation headed by Minister Olga Lyubimova, arrived here on Saturday to visit the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of Culture on the occasion of the first anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
The delegation was warmly greeted by Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture of the DPRK, officials concerned, artistes and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members.
Earlier, artistes of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M.E.Pyatnichki and Gzhel Moscow State Academic Theatre of Dance arrived here by air.
The DPRK Ministry of Culture hosted a reception at Yanggakdo International Hotel on Saturday evening in welcome of the Russian art missions. -0-

headline: Month of Anti-U.S. Joint Struggle Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- Political parties and organizations of different countries made public statements on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
The New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement:
Under the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Il Sung, the DPRK people fought bravely to repel the most cruel and destructive imperialists' war of the 20th century.
The Korean War was not merely a confrontation between the two countries but the fierce one between socialism and imperialism and between the independent and sovereign forces and the dominationist forces.
We strongly denounce the sanctions and blockade, threats of aggression and military provocation by the U.S. imperialists on the DPRK lasting for decades.
The Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies and organizations for the study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement:
The Korean War in the 1950s was from A to Z a war of aggression of the US imperialists who were trying to occupy Korea and, furthermore, dominate Asia and the rest of the world.
The Korean War was the first war to herald the defeat of imperialism by inflicting a shameful defeat on the U.S. imperialists who were boasting of being the world's "strongest".
Thanks to PresidentKim Il Sung, an ever-victorious and iron-willed brilliant commander with matchless courage and pluck, the DPRK people could win the three-year-long hard-fought war.
The Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand in its statement recalled that the Korean War in the 1950s was the most severe and disastrous war unprecedented in the world history of wars, and noted:
The world progressives do not want the breakout of the second Korean war.
We extend firm solidarity to the DPRK people, fully supporting the sincere efforts of the DPRK to prevent a war. -0-

headline: Harvest of Earlier Crops Accelerated on Farms of DPRK
Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory is widely known throughout the DPRK along with "Pomhyanggi"-trademarked cosmetics.
All people like "Pomhyanggi"-trademarked cosmetics giving affectionate emotion and prudent fragrance as their name.
The factory is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho made painstaking efforts to provide the people with quality and excellent cosmetics.
One day in June 2018,Kim Jong Unvisited the factory. He highly appreciated the officials and employees of the factory for mass-producing quality cosmetics favoured by the people through the dynamic drive to develop more famous products, kindling the flames of mass technological innovation.
After learning in detail about various production lines of the factory, he said that the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory should continue to wage a vigorous struggle to improve the quality of products so that our people enjoy the cosmetics produced by the factory.
He indicated the tasks and ways to be held fast to in the production of cosmetics including the issue of further developing the factory into a technology-intensive one with integrated scientific research and production by raising the technical skill of the producers and building up the ranks of technicians and researchers.
True to his noble intention, the factory has made progress in improving the quality of products by strengthening the scientific and technological forces and skilled workers capable of steering its development while developing new products.
Recently, many cosmetics produced by the factory were highly appreciated at the Commodity Exhibition at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and other exhibitions.
The factory was selected as one of the ten best enterprises in the country for 2023 as it promoted the development of new products with a competitive edge and the improvement of quality and created a model of quality control. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian in Ryanggang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Im Hyok, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 16 of Saengjang Workers' District, Unhung County of Ryanggang Province, on her 100th birthday.
Officials of the county committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, relatives and neighbors congratulated the family of the woman centenarian and the whole village was wrapped in a festive mood.
After receiving a dreamlike glory, Kim Im Hyok extended her gratitude toKim Jong Unfor sending the birthday spread to an ordinary old woman, though he was so busy with state affairs.
She, who brought up all her children well and found good things to contribute to the country's economic life even in her old age, always asks her descendants to do more things to defend and glorify the grateful socialist system valuing the people most. -0-

headline: Peerlessly Great Man's Precious Instruction
story_text:
One day in October 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited a greenhouse farm under construction in Jungphyong area of Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province, the DPRK.
Going round the farm,Kim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the fact that a greenhouse farm with a vast area had been built by the service personnel in a little over a year.
When he dropped in at a block of the greenhouse farm, he told about the advantage of vegetable cultivation in a hydroponic way.
He said that the farm built under the deep care of the Workers' Party of Korea should become a standard-bearer and a spark in raising a hot wind of scientific farming and make a deep study of the world trend of the development of agricultural science and technology and advanced sci-tech data in the field of greenhouse vegetable to actively introduce them in conformity with our actual condition.
His instruction on that day serves as a precious guideline to be held fast to by the farm in successfully fulfilling its mission and duty. -0-

headline: Month of Anti-U.S. Joint Struggle Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- Political parties and organizations of different countries made public statements on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
The New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement:
Under the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Il Sung, the DPRK people fought bravely to repel the most cruel and destructive imperialists' war of the 20th century.
The Korean War was not merely a confrontation between the two countries but the fierce one between socialism and imperialism and between the independent and sovereign forces and the dominationist forces.
We strongly denounce the sanctions and blockade, threats of aggression and military provocation by the U.S. imperialists on the DPRK lasting for decades.
The Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies and organizations for the study of the Juche Idea said in a joint statement:
The Korean War in the 1950s was from A to Z a war of aggression of the US imperialists who were trying to occupy Korea and, furthermore, dominate Asia and the rest of the world.
The Korean War was the first war to herald the defeat of imperialism by inflicting a shameful defeat on the U.S. imperialists who were boasting of being the world's "strongest".
Thanks to PresidentKim Il Sung, an ever-victorious and iron-willed brilliant commander with matchless courage and pluck, the DPRK people could win the three-year-long hard-fought war.
The Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand in its statement recalled that the Korean War in the 1950s was the most severe and disastrous war unprecedented in the world history of wars, and noted:
The world progressives do not want the breakout of the second Korean war.
We extend firm solidarity to the DPRK people, fully supporting the sincere efforts of the DPRK to prevent a war. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian in Ryanggang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Im Hyok, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 16 of Saengjang Workers' District, Unhung County of Ryanggang Province, on her 100th birthday.
Officials of the county committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, relatives and neighbors congratulated the family of the woman centenarian and the whole village was wrapped in a festive mood.
After receiving a dreamlike glory, Kim Im Hyok extended her gratitude toKim Jong Unfor sending the birthday spread to an ordinary old woman, though he was so busy with state affairs.
She, who brought up all her children well and found good things to contribute to the country's economic life even in her old age, always asks her descendants to do more things to defend and glorify the grateful socialist system valuing the people most. -0-

headline: Delegation of Russian Ministry of Culture Arrives Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation headed by Minister Olga Lyubimova, arrived here on Saturday to visit the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Ministry of Culture on the occasion of the first anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
The delegation was warmly greeted by Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture of the DPRK, officials concerned, artistes and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members.

The DPRK Ministry of Culture hosted a reception at Yanggakdo International Hotel on Saturday evening in welcome of the Russian art missions. -0-

headline: Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory is widely known throughout the DPRK along with "Pomhyanggi"-trademarked cosmetics.
All people like "Pomhyanggi"-trademarked cosmetics giving affectionate emotion and prudent fragrance as their name.
The factory is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho made painstaking efforts to provide the people with quality and excellent cosmetics.
One day in June 2018,Kim Jong Unvisited the factory. He highly appreciated the officials and employees of the factory for mass-producing quality cosmetics favoured by the people through the dynamic drive to develop more famous products, kindling the flames of mass technological innovation.
After learning in detail about various production lines of the factory, he said that the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory should continue to wage a vigorous struggle to improve the quality of products so that our people enjoy the cosmetics produced by the factory.
He indicated the tasks and ways to be held fast to in the production of cosmetics including the issue of further developing the factory into a technology-intensive one with integrated scientific research and production by raising the technical skill of the producers and building up the ranks of technicians and researchers.
True to his noble intention, the factory has made progress in improving the quality of products by strengthening the scientific and technological forces and skilled workers capable of steering its development while developing new products.
Recently, many cosmetics produced by the factory were highly appreciated at the Commodity Exhibition at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and other exhibitions.
The factory was selected as one of the ten best enterprises in the country for 2023 as it promoted the development of new products with a competitive edge and the improvement of quality and created a model of quality control. -0-

headline: Title of DPRK Hero Instituted in Days of War
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- The title of DPRK Hero was instituted on June 30, 1950 in the early days of the Fatherland Liberation War.
The institution of the title of hero is associated with the noble love of PresidentKim Il Sungwho was desirous of adding eternal lustre to the feats of wartime fighters.
The President, who paid deep attention to conferring commendation or orders on the brave soldiers of the Korean People's Army who were fighting at the cost of their youth and lives for the country, called officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly (SPA) on the next day when the war broke out and gave them the instructions on instituting the title of DPRK Hero and the order.
At the Third Session of the Military Commission of the DPRK, the President said that the title of DPRK Hero should be awarded with Gold Star Medal and Order of National Flag First Class, the highest order of the DPRK, and the decree on instituting the title of hero should be proclaimed according to relevant procedures.
The news of the decree of the Standing Committee of the SPA of the DPRK on instituting the title of DPRK Hero gave matchless strength and courage to the officers and men of the KPA and the people who turned out in the sacred war to annihilate the enemy.
Within the fifteen days after the decree was issued, the title of DPRK Hero was conferred on more than 10 officers and noncommissioned officers of the KPA, including commanding officers of the Second Torpedo Boat Squadron who sank the U.S. heavy cruiser Baltimore and destroyed the U.S. light cruiser with four torpedo boats, airmen who shot down bomber B-29 of the U.S. imperialists who boasted of being the "fortress in the sky" and a tankman who performed distinguished military feats in the battle for liberating Seoul.
More than 600 heroes were produced during the war (June 1950-July 1953) amid the mass heroism being displayed at every place of the front and the rear.
Thanks to the President, who led the service personnel and people with his love and trust and put forward them as heroes, the defenders of the country could work military miracles of defeating the imperialist allied forces led by the U.S. imperialists in the fierce three-year war. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Love for Old People
story_text:
One day in May 1948, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Sungho Old People's Home in Kangdong County, South Phyongan Province.
That day, the President met the old people of the home, told them not to regret having no children as the country would take good care of them from now on. And he said that they should read newspapers to know the situation and work for their health in accordance with their physical condition.
When he dropped in at the restaurant, he earnestly said that various kinds of dishes suited to the tastes of the old people of the home should be made.
Before leaving the home, the President said that we should take care of the old people with no children though it is a painstaking job. Looking back on sufferings of the old people who had been humiliated and despised under exploitation and oppression in the past, he told them that they should live long in the good world.
They were moved to tears by the great loving care of the President who bestowed a true life on them who had suffered every kind of humiliation and contempt like pebbles on roadsides during the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Russian Minister of Culture and Enjoys Art Performances
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- The peoples of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation are significantly commemorating as a common auspicious event the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit, which put the traditional relations of the two countries on the most excellent level, and the first anniversary of the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Minister of Culture Olga Lyubimova, who is visiting the DPRK on the occasion of the first anniversary of the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia, leading a delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation, at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on June 29.
Present there was Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly welcomed the visit to Pyongyang by the delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation and had a warm and friendly talk.
At the talk, the head of the delegation expressed her sincere greetings to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor paying deep attention to the visit to Pyongyang by the delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation, though he is very busy with state affairs.
Appreciating that extensive and profound exchange and cooperation in all fields are further expanding and developing day by day after the conclusion of the new treaty between the DPRK and Russia,Kim Jong Unsaid that this is substantially contributing to the co-prosperity, development and the promotion of the wellbeing of the two countries and two peoples.
Kim Jong Unstressed that all fields of state and social life are important but the exchange in the field of culture and art in particular plays a great role in strengthening the foundation of the public mindset of the two countries and firmly consolidating the ties of friendship, comradeship, mutual understanding and sympathy between the peoples.
Kim Jong Unsaid that from this point of view, it is important for the cultural sector to guide the relations between the two countries. To this end, it is necessary to further expand the exchange and cooperation in the field of culture and art to know well about each other's excellent cultural traditions and learn more, he added.
Minister of Culture Olga Lyubimova expressed her impression of visiting beautiful Pyongyang at a time when the solidity and invincibility of the DPRK-Russia friendship and solidarity have been more clearly proved and the cooperation between the two countries in the cultural field reached the highest level in history and of meeting with the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand conducting significant art and cultural events together with friends of the fraternal neighbors.
Saying that the current Pyongyang visit by the minister of Culture of the Russian Federation, personally leading the art troupes in significant June, is an important occasion for the DPRK people to have deeper understanding of the excellent culture of the Russian people,Kim Jong Unexpressed belief that the current visit would further raise the militant comradeship and feelings of friendship between the two countries.
During the talk, he exchanged views on the prospective plans for cultural exchange and cooperation.
The conversation proceeded in a warm atmosphere of friendship from beginning to end.
Guided by Olga Lyubimova, minister of Culture of the Russian Federation,Kim Jong Unlooked round the photos of grand monuments, famous edifices and beautiful landscape of Russia and scenes of its major cities displayed at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre.
That day he, together with the minister of Culture of the Russian Federation, enjoyed a performance given by the Russian artistes on a visit to Pyongyang and a return performance given by DPRK artistes.
Among the audience were senior Party and government officials, officials concerned, and officials, creators and artistes in the field of culture and art.
The delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation and staff members of the Russian embassy here appreciated the performances.
The Russian artistes put on the stage colorful numbers reflecting the Russian people's ardent love for their country and their just, strong and optimistic national character.
Russian famous songs and folk dances reflecting the peculiar traditional culture, customs and long history left a deep impression on the audience.
The Korean folk song "Arirang" and other songs of the DPRK were played to the beautiful and elegant tunes to please the audience.
Kim Jong Unhad a floral basket presented to the Russian artistes, who sang the daily-blooming DPRK-Russia friendship with their peculiar and passionate performance, to congratulate them.
Then DPRK artistes gave a return performance, through which they sang the high praises of the noble thoughts and feelings and patriotism of the peoples of the two countries who are confidently carving out the future while overcoming all challenges of history.
The performance was enthusiastically acclaimed by the audience as it added to the strong desire and stamina to build a prosperous and powerful state without fail, and to the confidence that the militant ties of friendship and the genuine internationalist obligation between the peoples and armies of the two countries that were forged at the cost of blood and are shining in the annals of the DPRK-Russia friendship will last forever along with the history of victory.
The performances fully demonstrated the appearances of the two art troupes as popular ones by truthfully showing the fraternal friendship and friendly ties between the peoples of the two countries with rich artistic ability and elegant representation. The audience was deeply moved by the performances.
Kim Jong Unwaved a farewell at the delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation and asked Olga Lyubimova, minister of Culture, to convey his warm wishes to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and all the Russian people. -0-

New Posters Created in DPRK
Reed Production Base in Sindo County of North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- Sindo County in North Phyongan Province, which is located in the northwestern coastal area of the DPRK, is famous for reed production.
Sindo County, called Pidan Island, is associated with the loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho pays deep attention to providing the DPRK people with more civilized living conditions.
One day in June 2018,Kim Jong Unvisited Sindo County and unfolded a grand blueprint for turning the county into a raw material base for Juche-oriented chemical fibre.
Saying that it is necessary to put the reed cultivation on a scientific and modern basis to boost the per-hectare yield and solve the problem arising in reed transportation to supply the factories with sufficient fibre raw materials, he indicated the tasks and ways for bringing about a fresh turn in reed farming.
He learned in detail about the housing problem and the supplies of cement and food and took a benevolent measure for solving the traffic problem of the people in the county.
Thanks to the noble intention ofKim Jong Un, the county was turned into a large reed producer of the country and a place good to work and live in.
The people in the county are devoting their sincere efforts to repaying his great love with a good reed harvest. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Ministers of Culture of DPRK and Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- Talks between Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Olga Lyubimova, minister of Culture of the Russian Federation, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on June 29.
Present there from the DPRK side were Pak Kyong Chol, vice-minister of Culture, and officials concerned and from the Russian side were major members of the delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK.
Discussed in depth at the talks were the detailed issues for expanding and strengthening the exchange and cooperation in the cultural field between the two countries.
Then, 2025-2027 plan for cultural cooperation between the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK and the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation was signed. -0-

headline: Foreign Personages Release Press Statements
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 1 (KCNA) -- Personages of Romanian and Mexican political parties issued press statements on June 25 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party (Romania) said that the Korean War was a merciless invasion by the U.S.-led imperialist allied forces against the young DPRK.
But they could not break the faith of the DPRK people led by PresidentKim Il Sung, distinguished leader, and annihilate the heroic people with the outstanding spirit of holding the dignity and honor of the country dearer than their own lives, the chairman said.
He respectfully paid tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungwho wisely led the Korean people to win a great victory in the war.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico said:
We witness abnormal things happening in different parts of the world due to the U.S. evermore undisguised hegemonic ambition.
We denounce the reckless moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces to ignite a new war on the Korean peninsula and strongly demand that the U.S. forces withdraw from the ROK as soon as possible.
I extend full support and solidarity to the Korean people in their struggle to frustrate the provocative war moves of the hostile forces and defend the sovereignty and peace of the country. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 1 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province in the DPRK completed the Amnok River embankment projects covering tens of kilometers.
While directing efforts to increasing the proportion of mechanization in the project, the province took measures to directly transport building materials to the spots in connection with the railway transport sector.
Kim Hyong Gwon County completed the project before others and Kim Jong Suk, Samsu and Paegam counties devoted their all to protecting their regions from floods.
The provincial-level units involved in the project met the demands for construction, including reinforcing embankments and building retaining walls, while giving precedence to the construction of structures.
Officials in the designing and supervising sectors devoted themselves to ensuring the quality of the projects. -0-

headline: Culture of River Taedong Proves Superiority of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 1 (KCNA) -- Culture of the River Taedong proves the superiority of the Korean nation who has created and developed an excellent culture from the dawning of human history development.
The Taedong River basin with crystal river courses, broad and fertile plain, rich products and warm temperature has become one of the cradles of mankind and human culture as a place good to live in from ancient times.
The basin was the cradle where Korean ancestors had lived through the successive stage of human evolution and the place where the early culture of mankind began.
The Komunmoru relics where primitive men had lived more than one million years ago were unearthed in Huku-ri, Sangwon County long ago. In addition, fossils of Paleolithic men called "Ryokpho man" and "Tokchon man" and fossils of Neolithic men called "Sungrisan man" and "Mandal man" were unearthed in the basin.
The basin is the home of the Koreans, the descendants of Neolithic men belonging to the late Paleolithic period who had lived in this place. They had developed from a very early period the culture of the Neolithic Age based on agricultural culture, and the culture of the Bronze Age with a high level of metal culture.
They acquired metallurgical techniques in the course of their production activities and, on its basis, made bronze stronger than pure copper by alloying tin with copper, thus creating a bronze culture.
From the period of the first Korean state founded by King Tangun, gold products had been produced by means of metal art processing by sheet and amalgamation process.
More than 14 000 dolmens had been distributed in the basin of the River Taedong until the mid-1990s.
Engraved on hundreds of lid stones are pictures of constellations. From this point of view, the basin of the River Taedong draws attention as the cradle of ancient astronomy.
The inhabitants of the basin had used the Sinji characters, one of the criteria for judging the level of ancient cultural development.
In the basin favourable for farming, the Korean ancestors cultivated rice, foxtail millet, bean and kaoliang by using farming tools at that time. Korea is widely known to the world as the origin of bean.
In the 1990s, the History Society of the DPRK named this ancient culture centered on Pyongyang the Culture of the River Taedong. -0-

headline: Farmers' Opinions Are Important
story_text:
At early dawn of one day in May 1999, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited a cooperative farm (at that time) in Anbyon County, Kangwon Province, the DPRK.
After looking at various types of tractors lining on the edge of a field of the farm, he told drivers to start the engines and learned about the speed, radius of rotation, performance and mechanism of each tractor.
Seeing a Chollima tractor, in which our workers increased the horsepower by their own efforts, the Chairman said with pleasure that it was great and they had managed to make it although many things were not available and there were many things in short supply and at difficult time.
Watching the operation of tractors, he asked all the officials if farmers saw the tractors and to which one they prefer.
After hearing their answers, the Chairman specially stressed that farmers' opinions were important because they best know about farming and would handle machines.
His teachings carried his intention that farmers had the absolute authority to decide to make any type of tractors. -0-

headline: Shuddering Germ Warfare of U.S. Imperialists during Korean War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 2 (KCNA) -- During the Korean War (June 1950 - July 1953), the U.S. imperialists committed shuddering massacres, unhesitatingly using even germ weapons against the DPRK people in wanton violation of international law.
The U.S. imperialist aggressors found a way out in the germ warfare as they suffered repeated defeats from the beginning of the war by the powerful counterattack of the Korean People's Army.
The U.S. imperialists massively spread smallpox virus to Pyongyang, Jangjin, Kowon and Yangdok areas, fleeing owing to the KPA's re-advance. At that time, thousands of people suffered from smallpox in the areas, and 10 percent of them were dead.
The U.S. imperialists killed many innocent people by spreading the lice contaminated with typhus and recurrent fever pathogens in houses along the highway, and selected bacteria with high infectivity and mortality, strong resistance and different latent periods. As a result, epidemics including pest, cholera and typhoid fever spread rapidly and many people were dead or disabled, suffering from the diseases.
The U.S. imperialists dropped various kinds of germ bombs for over 800 times in more than 160 areas of the DPRK between January and March, 1952.
The number of planes involved in the criminal germ warfare amounted to one quarter of the planes involved in bombing the DPRK and to 480 on one day.
History has so far not known a precedent of the germ warfare which is large in scale and vicious in means and methods. Thus, the world public and media revealed that the brutal germ warfare waged by the U.S. imperialist aggressors in the Korean War is the largest-ever germ warfare in the war history.
At that time, a member of an investigation team of the Women's International Democratic Federation, too, denounced the crimes of the U.S. imperialist murderers, saying that there were no such heinous human butchers as the US scoundrels in the world. -0-
