headline: Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area Starts Service
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 2 (KCNA) -- A spectacular sight of laughter and optimism was presented at the 4km-long sandy beach of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area, the east coastal tourist scenic spot of national value which has been built under the people-first politics of the Workers' Party of Korea and Korean-style socialist system based on "The People Are God".
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade sure that an unusual leisure complex for the people, the world-class tourist park, was built at the east coastal scenic spot, which is famous for its seaside emotion from old times, in order to make the people enjoy the maritime tourist culture to their heart's content. A tourist service started at the top-class resort on July 1 while conveying his great benevolence.
After hearing the news of the inauguration ceremony of the tourist resort exciting the whole country and startling the world, many tourists from across the country took off their traveling attire on the first day of its operation amid the ardent desire for travel to the wonderful tourist resort without an equal in the world.
Not only working people from Kangwon and South Hamgyong provinces but also many men and women of all ages from the capital city of Pyongyang and North Hamgyong, Ryanggang and Jagang provinces in the northern tip of the country and from provinces, cities and counties in the western areas of the country entered the tourist resort with the joy of enjoying a new highly-civilized life.
They admired the magnificence of the tourist city, where the gatepost harmonizing well with the coastal environment and more than 400 buildings with unique formative artistic beauty have been built along the sandy beach in ideal harmony with each other.
Making rounds of the tourist area equipped with beach-bathing service facilities, various sports and recreation facilities and commercial and neighborhood-serving networks, the tourists felt a new wonderful ground of the tourist culture of our own style which is blooming in the era of the Workers' Party.
The people's happy laughter resounded in each place of the scenic spot.
Myongsasimni (4km-long beach) was crowded with working people bathing in the clean and blue east sea, taking high-speed boats, driving motorcycles on silver-colored sandy beach and having photos taken with joy and optimism of enjoying the best coastal tourist civilization before anyone else.
The Myongsasimni outdoor wading pool was full of tourists enjoying steep water slides, sledge water slides, bowl-type quick water slides, water skis and other latest water amusement apparatuses.
The tourists spent a good time, receiving kind services at commercial and neighborhood-serving networks.
The night on the Kalma peninsula, where they enjoy themselves with new civilization and a new wellbeing, led to a new hopeful day, picturing a 4km-long tide of the people which will be spread boundlessly. -0-

headline: Measures Taken for Return Flight of Participants in Celebrations of 66th KCU Birthday
story_text:
One evening in June 2012 when the celebrations of the 66th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) successfully ended, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uncalled a senior official of the then Air Koryo Administration as regards the flight for the representatives of the KCU organizations.
After hearing a report from the official that it was expected to be foggy at the airport in North Hamgyong Province until 10 o'clock,Kim Jong Unsaid that the flight should be organized in a responsible way according to weather conditions and it was the first duty to organize the safest flight.
And then he said that if the weather was bad, the flight should be organized on the next day and the official should inform relevant departments of it. He requested the official to organize and command the flight in a responsible way to the last.
The next dayKim Jong Unreceived a report that representatives of Ryanggang Province were transported but only half of the representatives of North Hamgyong Province transported due to bad weather, and then he said that the flight should be organized under the safest conditions.
Thanks to his warm loving care, the representatives of KCU organizations could return home in safe.
The flight of the representatives of KCU organizations is associated with the profound love and noble view on the rising generation by the peerlessly great man who takes warm care of the children, the future of the country, as their father would do. -0-

The Namdok Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex sends large quantities of coal to a thermal power plant every day while increasing the operation rate of production equipment. The Hoean and Phunggok youth coal mines are conducting a collective innovation movement to record high production results every day.
Coal miners of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex carry out their coal production goals while conducting the socialist emulation among pits, companies and platoons.
The Kaechon Coal Mine of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex keeps coal production going at a high rate while conducting mass movements, and the Pongchon Coal Mine of the complex solves problems arising in production to bring about an upsurge in production.
Coal miners of the Anju Area Coal-mining Complex and other coal-mining complexes are expanding successes in the coal production. -0-

headline: Delegation of Russian Ministry of Culture Leaves Here for Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 2 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation headed by Minister Olga Lyubimova, left here for home on July 1 after visiting the DPRK on the occasion of the first anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the two countries.
The delegation was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture of the DPRK, officials concerned and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members.
Earlier, artistes of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M.E. Pyatnichki and Gzhel Moscow State Academic Theatre of Dance left here for home by air. -0-

headline: Many Units Win Three-Revolution Red Flag and Honored Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 3 (KCNA) -- Many units in Pyongyang Municipality of the DPRK won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag in the first half of the year.
As a result, the units which won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag nearly doubled as compared with the same period of last year.
The Munsu Foodstuff Factory and the Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory improved the quality of foodstuff and efficacy of Koryo medicines and fulfilled their national economic plans every year, thus winning the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag.
The Taedonggang Battery Factory, the Pothonggang Footwear Factory and the Pyongyang Beer Factory have produced workshops which won the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag in the course of putting production lines on a modern basis through a mass technical innovation movement.
The Pyongyang Municipal Power Transmission and Distribution Station and the Pyongyang Optical Fiber Cable Factory were awarded the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag respectively as they put the electricity supply and management on a scientific and IT basis and made a stride forward in the production of optical fiber cables.
Among the units that won the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag were the workteam No.3 of the Jungdan Vegetable Farm and the vegetable workteam No.3 of the Namsa Farm in Rangnang District.
The Pyongyang Bag Factory and the Mangyongdae District Mushroom Farm took the lead in carrying out the national economic plans, establishing the cultured practice in production and life and conducting mass sports activities and thus won the Three-Revolution Red Flag.
Various units in the public health and commercial sectors in the municipality won the Three-Revolution Red Flag in the course of conducting the medical treatment for residents and improving the service environment.
The Twice Red Flag was awarded to Sanop Senior Middle School in Songyo District, Sinwon Primary School in Pothonggang District, Janggyong Senior Middle School and Wasan Primary School in Sosong District which are increasing the number of the October 8 Model Professors and steadily improving the abilities of students. -0-

headline: Nano Composite Antibacterial Agent Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 3 (KCNA) -- Researchers in the DPRK have developed nano composite antibacterial agent which is of significance in economic development and the improvement of the people's standard of living and, on its basis, established a production line with the annual capacity of hundreds of tons.
As it has very strong strength of sterilization and resolving deleterious organic matters, the newly developed nano composite antibacterial agent are used in making various kinds of functional antibacterial products, treating  diseases and disinfecting medical appliances.
It is effective in purifying air, water, domestic and industrial wastewater and disinfecting seeds.
Having a high UV screening effect, it helps prevent products from aging and prolong their serviceable life. -0-

headline: Rice Seedlings Transported by Air
story_text:
One day in May 1961, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a farm in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province, the DPRK and went to rice-seedling beds.
The President asked officials why the rice seedlings were not healthy.
An official of the farm said that seeds were sown lastly because the frozen lands thawed later than other areas.
After a while, the President told officials that as the rice-transplanting date was late, it is good that they should send a telegram to South Hamgyong Province, bring rice seedlings by air and test them in about one hectare of paddy fields.
And he saw to it that officials of rich experience in the west coastal areas were sent to this farm and other farms in the northern part of the east coast to help them.
Thanks to his loving care, rice seedlings were transported by air and officials of experience in the west coastal areas went to the northern part of the east coast to help farming. -0-

headline: Advanced Farming Methods and Technologies Introduced at Farms of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 3 (KCNA) -- Farms across the DPRK are pushing ahead with the work to apply the advanced farming methods and technologies.
Farms in Kwaksan County of North Phyongan Province have introduced advanced rice-paddy irrigation management method, thus draining water from rice paddy fields and watering them on a scientific way and raising the active rooting of paddy rice.
Rural areas in Chongdan County of South Hwanghae Province are promoting the growth of crops and preventing the damage from harmful insects by using the laser light treatment technology.
The Hyangjong Farm in Paechon County takes measures to apply portable semiconductor laser irradiation device for plants to the manuring and cultivation of crops.
Officials and working people in the agricultural sector of Waudo District of Nampho Municipality are installing electrical impulse water treatment device at pumping stations to provide paddy rice with good conditions. -0-

headline: First Party Organization-Society for Rallying Comrades
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 3 (KCNA) -- 95 years have passed since the first party organization-the society for rallying comrades was formed in Korea.
The Communist Party of Korea was organized in Korea in the 1920s, but it had no existence owing to the harsh suppression by the Japanese imperialists and factional strife among top figures.
Proceeding from this actual condition, PresidentKim Il Sungkeenly felt the historic mission of building a Juche-oriented revolutionary party.
He made up his mind to scrupulously consolidate the organizational and ideological basis of party founding and, on its basis, to found a party capable of playing the role of the general staff of the Korean revolution, not by the method of declaring the party central committee in a quick-tempered manner.
At the historic Kalun Meeting (June 30-July 2, 1930), he set forth the original policy of party founding by forming the basic party organization first and steadily expanding and strengthening it.
On July 3, the next day after the Kalun Meeting, he formed the first party organization with revolutionaries of the new generation.
He took the first step of the revolution from winning comrades and saw to it that the name of the party organization was called the society for rallying comrades by reflecting the ambition and will to advance and complete the Korean revolution by finding and rallying comrades who would share their destiny with him.
The society for rallying comrades was the embryo and seed of the Workers' Party of Korea and an organization which is of parent-body significance in forming and expanding the basic party organizations.
After the formation of the society for rallying comrades, the party organization was formed on Turu Hill of Onsong County on Oct. 1 that year for the first time in the homeland, and basic party organizations and party leadership bodies at all levels were built and expanded in broad areas at home and abroad in the first half of the 1930s.
The formation of the Party Committee of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army in May 1934 provided a well-regulated system of unified guidance to party organizations at all levels and firmly ensured the party's leadership over the armed struggle and the overall Korean revolution.
Thanks to the valuable successes and experience gained in the days of the anti-Japanese revolution under the leadership of the President, the historic cause of founding the party could be successfully accomplished in less than two months after the country's liberation (August 15, 1945). -0-

headline: Campaign for Minimizing Damage by Disastrous Abnormal Weather Launched
Young People in DPRK Volunteer to Work in Forefronts of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 3 (KCNA) -- More than 120 young people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work in the forefronts of socialist construction.
Dozens of young people in Sunchon, Kaechon and Tokchon cities and Pukchang County volunteered to work at coal mines with their resolution to become young innovators and heroes.
Young people in Anju City and Taedong, Sinyang, Jungsan and Unsan counties volunteered for construction brigades and raw materials bases in their areas.
Among the volunteers are young people in Yangdok and Mundok counties who volunteered to work at the youth workteam for maintaining ridge ways, the workteam for repairing and maintaining express highways and the county goat farm.
A meeting to congratulate the volunteers was held in Phyongsong City on July 1.
Present there were Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and young people.
Certificates were awarded to the volunteers and a congratulatory address and speeches were made at the meeting.
After a congratulatory performance, young people in the city warmly saw off the volunteers leaving for the spots with the enthusiasm to become pioneers of miracles and feats in the worthwhile struggle for socialist construction. -0-

headline: Meeting Held to Hear Stories about President Kim Il Sung's Virtues
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- Workers and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea met at the Central Hall of Workers on July 3 to hear stories about the virtues of PresidentKim Il Sungon the occasion of the 31st anniversary of his demise.
First, there was a recitation of the epic "Our Eternal Leader ComradeKim Il Sung" which highly praises the great life of the popular leader who devoted his all to the country and the people, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven.
Kim Song Ho, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, said that the warm love, trust and wise leadership of the President who glorified the life of the working class at the highest level were the key to making the GFTUK invariably follow the road of loyalty and patriotism.
Yun Song Hak, a worker of the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, told about the devotion of the President who made painstaking efforts to improve the people's standard of living while walking along the roads of factories and farms rain or shine.
Song Kum Sil, chairwoman of the primary trade union committee of the Mangyongdae Amusement Park Management Office, said that she could not forget the tender-hearted image of the President who chose the site of the amusement park in picturesque Mangyongdae.
Labour Hero Kim Myong Chol, a workshop head of the Sogu Public Building Construction Company, said that there is no such person in the world as the President who lived at a simple house since the liberation of the country and allowed no privilege for himself but provided the people with homes of happiness.
Present at the meeting were Pak In Chol, chairman of the C.C., the GFTUK, officials of the trade union and workers and members of the trade union in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the DPRK Foreign Ministry issued the following press statement titled "QUAD should stop unilateral coercive act to change the present position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" on July 3:
Recently the U.S. committed another grave political provocation denying the legitimate sovereign rights of our state and insisting on "denuclearization" with the QUAD foreign ministers' meeting as an occasion.
The U.S. hegemonic act of interfering in the internal affairs of independent sovereign states, stirring up inter-camp confrontation and creating instability in the international relations by relying on exclusive minority groups such as QUAD, is acting as a major risk factor hindering peace and security in the region and the world.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry strongly denounces and rejects the U.S. malicious act of clearly exposing its invariable hostile intention against the DPRK, wantonly encroaching upon the dignity and rights and interests of our state, and expresses serious concern over the negative consequences to be entailed by it.
It is none other than the U.S. which is attempting to unilaterally change the existing situation by force or coercive way in the Asia-Pacific region including the Korean peninsula.
Nothing can change the position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state which has been permanently fixed by the supreme law of the state and physically proved.
Preaching someone's "denuclearization" is, indeed, anachronistic, contradictory and, in fact, self-deceptive for the country concerned which has caused serious losses to global peace and security through its radical nuclear weapons modernization and illegal use of military force.
The U.S. attempt to deny the present position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is not only the gravest violation of sovereignty but also a dangerous act of escalating tension which creates instability in the region and escalates the tension.
It is within the sovereignty peculiar to our state to take appropriate and reflective countermeasures of the self-defensive nature against such provocative military actions as the U.S. moves to strengthen the multilateral military alliance threatening the security of the region and joint military drills with clear aggressive character.
We will never tolerate the attempt of the U.S. and its vassal forces to unilaterally change the position of the DPRK and the current situation on the Korean peninsula. We will continue to make responsible efforts to ensure peace in the region and the rest of the world, strictly based on the reality in which the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK is becoming more undisguised. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for Foreign Ministry of DPRK Gives Answer
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on July 3 as regards the fact that the U.S. judicial authorities recently prosecuted DPRK citizens on the suspicion of a "cyber crime" and put them on a wanted list:
The recent incident is an absurd smear campaign and grave violation of sovereignty aimed at tarnishing the image of our state as it is a continuation of the hostile move of the successive U.S. administrations that have talked much about the non-existent "cyber threat" from the DPRK.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the U.S. judicial authorities' provocation which is threatening and encroaching on the security, rights and interests of our citizens by fabricating the groundless "cyber" drama, and strongly denounces and rejects it.
The real threat of creating international cyberspace instability comes not from the DPRK but from the U.S.
The U.S. has long been posing a constant threat to the cyber security of the DPRK and other sovereign states by making cyber space a scene of battle and abusing the cyber issue as a political weapon to tarnish the image of other countries and impair the exercise of their legitimate rights.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea has the right to take a proper and proportionate countermeasure to thoroughly protect the security and rights of its citizens from the judicial enforcement for a sinister political purpose, and to call to strict legal account the outsiders who took malicious action.
We will never tolerate any hostile act of the U.S. to encroach upon our state's sovereignty through groundless slander and illegal application of judicial means but will firmly defend the legitimate rights and interests of the citizens. -0-

headline: Pothonggang Shop
story_text:
One day in August 2009, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the newly-built Pothonggang Shop.
After looking round the ground floor counters where various kinds of fruits were displayed,Kim Jong Ilwent to the first floor counters where meat and processed meat were shown.
He saw the counters with a broad smile on his face.
Going down from the first floor, the Chairman suddenly stopped and asked if there was a lift here.
An official said that the lift was not designed as the shop was a two-storied building.
No one thought that it was necessary to install the lift in the building with over 20 stairs between the ground and first floors.
But the Chairman thought differently as he placed the interests and convenience of the people above all else.
He said that it would be all right for the young people but that the elderly and women would feel inconvenience when they went upstairs and downstairs with goods, adding that whatever we do, we must do it perfectly lest the people feel inconvenience. And he told the officials again and again to install the lift.
Thus, the lift began to be installed soon, and the shop opened afterwards. -0-

headline: Proactive Transportation of Farming Materials
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- The railway transport sector of the DPRK strives to transport farming materials in time.
The Pyongyang Railway Bureau has grasped the wagons' stoppage time and loading of farming materials and commanded their operation meticulously.
The Kaechon Railway Bureau has transported more freight by inspecting and repairing wagons, uncoupling and coupling wagons.
The Chongjin Railway Bureau is strengthening its ties with the driving commanders to take control of the movement of transport trains and take measures to conduct the loading and unloading as soon as they arrive at their destinations.
The Hamhung Railway Bureau has introduced advanced shunting method to increase the operation rate of locomotives, and established discipline and order to register high transport results every day.
The Pyongyang and Sinuiju service brigades of engine have conducted self-checking and self-repairing strictly and observed the standard driving operation method. -0-

headline: Solidarity Meetings Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- Solidarity meetings took place in Britain and Germany on June 25 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Present at the meetings were personages of progressive political parties of Britain and members of foreign organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people, including the Korean Friendship Association UK and the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany.
Speeches were made at the meetings.
The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany said that under the outstanding leadership of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, the DPRK people won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, thus humbling the arrogant U.S. imperialists who boasted of their "mightiness" and bringing about the beginning of a shameful downhill turn for them.
The U.S. imperialists blustered that the DPRK could not rise up on its feet for a hundred years, but the DPRK has developed into the world's strongest country with a tremendous nuclear deterrent, he said.
The chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK said that June 25, 1950 was recorded in history as the day of aggression when the U.S. imperialists ignited the Korean war, adding that this day is becoming the day of solidarity extending support and encouragement to the DPRK people firmly defending the just cause, their beloved country and the socialist system and the day of struggle against the U.S. imperialists.
He stressed that the friends of the DPRK in Britain would always be with the DPRK people who are dynamically advancing along the road of socialism and justice. -0-

headline: By Actively Applying Profitable Fish Farming Methods
KCNA Report on Completion of Coastal Tourist Resort in Myongsasimni of Kalma Peninsula
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency Thursday released a report on the wonderful completion of Korean-style coastal tourist city, a cultural resort of the people, in Myongsasimni, a scenic spot in the east coast.
The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area is a precious fruition of the grand plan and wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho regards the people's laughter and happiness as a symbol of the socialist system and the standard of national power assessment and devotes himself to promoting the people's wellbeing and realizing their ideal. It is also a gift of love of the motherly Party for the great people this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, the report said, and went on:
Kim Jong Ununfolded a grand blueprint for building a world-class cultural resort in the scenic spot in the east coast.
He had matured a far-reaching plan to build a cultural recreation ground for the people on scenic and beautiful beaches from long ago. In his New Year Address for 2018, he set forth the task for completing the construction of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area in the shortest time by the concerted efforts of the army and people and took all measures ranging from forming powerful construction forces to providing equipment, materials and funds.
He examined thousands of layouts to turn the area into a magnificent world-class coastal tourist city, the best marine park boasting of its fascinating appearance and modern beauty.
In the first year of the project, he visited the construction site three times and organized and commanded the whole course of the construction of the tourist city from the viewpoint of a designer, builder and operator
The outstanding leadership ofKim Jong Un, who is making a long journey of devotion and efforts to provide our people with the best place of happy life in the world with his noble outlook on the people, brought about a dramatic change in Myongsasimni, the scenic spot in the east coast.
The Kalma area was seething from the beginning of the construction thanks to the strong will and unyielding struggle of the army and people who turned out in hearty response to the far-reaching plan and determination ofKim Jong Unto provide the people with quite new happiness and civilization as soon as possible.
Thanks to the steadfast offensive spirit of the builders, more than 3 million cubic meters of bedding project, 20-odd kilometers of roadbed project, waterway project extending 15 kilometers, building of embankment along coastal promenade, the project for coastal park, readjustment of 40 hectares of sandy beach, the project for building 170 000 meters of substructure and the framework construction of hundreds of buildings were completed to newly change the appearance of Myongsasimni in less than one year.
The edifices in Myongsasimni reflect the people-first architectural idea of the Party that all the structures to be built on this land should be created in conformity with our people's emotions and aesthetic feelings and embody the people's demands and aspirations, and the level of the rapidly developing Juche architecture.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the inauguration ceremony of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area on June 24 and personally cut off the inauguration tape. And he highly appreciated the building of an eye-opening entity to be recorded as one of the greatest successes for this year of rounding off the implementation of the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK.
Saying that the coastal resort should play a leading role in establishing our tourist culture, he indicated an important orientation for expanding and developing our style of tourism on a large scale.
The construction of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area proved once again the immutable truth that the plan and determination of the Party Central Committee are a science, practice and victory, and clearly showed the world how gigantic the level of creation and civilization we want is.
The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area, which has been magnificently built as a scenic spot of the DPRK and a world's coastal tourist city along with the great era ofKim Jong Un, will demonstrate generation after generation the proud name as a 4km-long coast of joy and optimism where hurrah for the Workers' Party and socialism resounds forever amid the happy laughter of the people and as a 4km-long stretch of beach to be crowded with the people. -0-

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- The 36th Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on July 3.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the SPA, presided over the plenary meeting.
Present there were vice-chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol and other members of the SPA Standing Committee.
On hand as observers were officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies.
The plenary meeting discussed as its agenda items the deliberation and adoption of the DPRK laws on the implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, on the biosafety and on medical appraisal of working abilities and the recall and election of judges and people's assessors of the Supreme Court.
There took place a report on the main contents of the relevant draft laws deliberated by the SPA Legislation Committee.
On the basis of the study and discussion of the proposed bills, a decree of the SPA Standing Committee "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Implementation of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Biosafety" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Medical Appraisal of Working Abilities" were adopted with unanimous approval.
The plenary meeting recalled and elected judges and people's assessors of the Supreme Court of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for Foreign Ministry of DPRK Gives Answer
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on July 3 as regards the fact that the U.S. judicial authorities recently prosecuted DPRK citizens on the suspicion of a "cyber crime" and put them on a wanted list:
The recent incident is an absurd smear campaign and grave violation of sovereignty aimed at tarnishing the image of our state as it is a continuation of the hostile move of the successive U.S. administrations that have talked much about the non-existent "cyber threat" from the DPRK.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the U.S. judicial authorities' provocation which is threatening and encroaching on the security, rights and interests of our citizens by fabricating the groundless "cyber" drama, and strongly denounces and rejects it.
The real threat of creating international cyberspace instability comes not from the DPRK but from the U.S.
The U.S. has long been posing a constant threat to the cyber security of the DPRK and other sovereign states by making cyber space a scene of battle and abusing the cyber issue as a political weapon to tarnish the image of other countries and impair the exercise of their legitimate rights.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea has the right to take a proper and proportionate countermeasure to thoroughly protect the security and rights of its citizens from the judicial enforcement for a sinister political purpose, and to call to strict legal account the outsiders who took malicious action.
We will never tolerate any hostile act of the U.S. to encroach upon our state's sovereignty through groundless slander and illegal application of judicial means but will firmly defend the legitimate rights and interests of the citizens. -0-

headline: Month of Anti-U.S. Joint Struggle Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- A Serbian political party and a Danish organization issued statements on June 25 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
The Serbian Communist Party said in a statement that it paid the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungwho wisely led the DPRK people to a brilliant victory in the war against the U.S. imperialists.
It also paid regards to the Workers' Party of Korea inspiring all the DPRK people to the struggle for opposing imperialism and the U.S. and defending socialism under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The statement said that it is the solemn duty of the communists to fight against capitalism, especially  U.S. imperialism, and the DPRK set a good example in the struggle.
The Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said in a statement that June 25 this year was the day when the U.S. ignited a war against the DPRK 75 years ago with a purpose of conquering the newly emerging independent country by force of arms.
The DPRK people repelled the imperialists' aggression and defended freedom and independence of the country under the leadership of ComradeKim Il Sung, the great revolutionary, the statement said, and went on:
The U.S. has not yet abandoned its ambition for aggression.
The U.S. poses a constant threat to peace and security on the Korean peninsula in conspiracy with the ROK government, scheming to stifle the DPRK, the socialist fortress.
However, the DPRK people do not yield to it.
Their struggle to bolster up the military capability for self-defence and defend peace in the forefront of the anti-imperialist struggle gives a great courage to the world people.
We extend solidarity to the DPRK people fighting against  imperialism. -0-

headline: Solidarity Meetings Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 4 (KCNA) -- Solidarity meetings took place in Britain and Germany on June 25 on the occasion of the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
Present at the meetings were personages of progressive political parties of Britain and members of foreign organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people, including the Korean Friendship Association UK and the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany.
Speeches were made at the meetings.
The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany said that under the outstanding leadership of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, the DPRK people won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, thus humbling the arrogant U.S. imperialists who boasted of their "mightiness" and bringing about the beginning of a shameful downhill turn for them.
The U.S. imperialists blustered that the DPRK could not rise up on its feet for a hundred years, but the DPRK has developed into the world's strongest country with a tremendous nuclear deterrent, he said.
The chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK said that June 25, 1950 was recorded in history as the day of aggression when the U.S. imperialists ignited the Korean war, adding that this day is becoming the day of solidarity extending support and encouragement to the DPRK people firmly defending the just cause, their beloved country and the socialist system and the day of struggle against the U.S. imperialists.
He stressed that the friends of the DPRK in Britain would always be with the DPRK people who are dynamically advancing along the road of socialism and justice. -0-

headline: Meeting of Officials and Members of Women's Union Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea met at the Hall of Women on July 4 to hear the stories about noble virtues of PresidentKim Il Sungon the occasion of the 31st anniversary of his demise.
At the meeting, the performers highly praised the immortal exploits performed by the President, the peerlessly great sage and benevolent father of the people, for the country and revolution, times and history.
Kim Son Sil, former head of the Management Office of the Tower of the Juche Idea and the Arch of Triumph who was the fourth daughter of Kim Tuk Ran, the first woman deputy of the DPRK, said that the President saved the Korean women, who had been subjected to social restraint and inequality for thousands of years, from their miserable destiny and put them forward as a powerful force of the revolution.
Pak Sun Hui, a member of the women's union from Hwawon-dong No. 2, Hwasong District, impressively told about the personality of the President as the peerlessly great man who led the Fatherland Liberation War to brilliant victory with his outstanding commanding art and rare wisdom.
The story of Jong Su Rim, head of the Youth Workteam of the Rihyon Vegetable Farm in Sadong District, who is a granddaughter of Ri Sin Ja, known all over the country as a red agitator, deeply moved the audience.
Present at the meeting were Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, officials of the women's union and its members in Pyongyang. -0-

story_text:

Choe Son Hui said in the message that she was pleased that the government and people of Belarus are achieving successes in the struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country and achieving social unity while overcoming all difficulties and challenges at home and abroad.
The message expressed expectation that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries with a long history and tradition would continue to expand and develop, and that mutual support and cooperation in the international arenas would be further strengthened. -0-

headline: Many Literary Works on Immortal Revolutionary Feats of President Kim Il Sung Created
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- Lots of literary works created for decades reflect the ardent aspiration and desire of the DPRK people to convey through all generations the noble revolutionary career of PresidentKim Il Sungwho performed immortal exploits for the country, revolution, times and history.
The cycle of novels "Immortal History", a winner ofKim Il SungPrize, is a literary work of national treasure that comprehensively deals with the glorious revolutionary history of the President in a chronological order.
49 full-length novels have been created since "The Year 1932", the first work of the cycle of novels "Immortal History", was created on the occasion of the 60th birth anniversary of the President.
Also published were the books "The Leader and Ryu Kyong Su" and "The World of Comradeship Reflected in the Reminiscences" depicting the revolutionary comradeship and warm human love of the President.
"Collection ofKim Il Sung's Anecdotes", a collection of the revolutionary anecdotes, "Among the People", a collection of reminiscences, "With the Nation", a collection of real-life revolutionary stories, and other books make the people recollect with deep emotion the sacred life of the President. The books tell the people that the victory and glory shining on the road of the Korean revolution and all happiness blooming on this land were provided under the wise leadership of the President.
Also produced were many poems and songs full of great reverence and ardent yearning of all the people for the great father.
Prominent figures of all social standings, including statesmen of the world, wrote and published lots of books praising the President for making a great contribution to accomplishing the socialist cause and the human cause of independence.
The monumental masterpieces shining with the history of the revolutionary activities of the peerlessly great man are the precious treasures of socialist Korea telling about the greatness and immortal exploits of the fatherly leader. -0-

headline: Many Literary Works on Immortal Revolutionary Feats of President Kim Il Sung Created
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- Lots of literary works created for decades reflect the ardent aspiration and desire of the DPRK people to convey through all generations the noble revolutionary career of PresidentKim Il Sungwho performed immortal exploits for the country, revolution, times and history.
The cycle of novels "Immortal History", a winner ofKim Il SungPrize, is a literary work of national treasure that comprehensively deals with the glorious revolutionary history of the President in a chronological order.
49 full-length novels have been created since "The Year 1932", the first work of the cycle of novels "Immortal History", was created on the occasion of the 60th birth anniversary of the President.
Also published were the books "The Leader and Ryu Kyong Su" and "The World of Comradeship Reflected in the Reminiscences" depicting the revolutionary comradeship and warm human love of the President.
"Collection ofKim Il Sung's Anecdotes", a collection of the revolutionary anecdotes, "Among the People", a collection of reminiscences, "With the Nation", a collection of real-life revolutionary stories, and other books make the people recollect with deep emotion the sacred life of the President. The books tell the people that the victory and glory shining on the road of the Korean revolution and all happiness blooming on this land were provided under the wise leadership of the President.
Also produced were many poems and songs full of great reverence and ardent yearning of all the people for the great father.
Prominent figures of all social standings, including statesmen of the world, wrote and published lots of books praising the President for making a great contribution to accomplishing the socialist cause and the human cause of independence.
The monumental masterpieces shining with the history of the revolutionary activities of the peerlessly great man are the precious treasures of socialist Korea telling about the greatness and immortal exploits of the fatherly leader. -0-

headline: Respected General Secretary Kim Jong Un Pays Attention to School Fixtures
story_text:
One day in April 2019, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited Samjiyon Junior Middle School in Samjiyon County (then) which was nearing completion.
When the respected General Secretary went into a classroom, he looked at the desks and chairs and said that it is necessary to properly organize the work related to the production of school fixtures so as to ensure their quality, adding that school fixtures should be of good quality.
Saying that the height of the desks and chairs is low compared to the physiques of the junior middle school students aged 12 and over, he stressed the need to make the height of the desks and chairs a little higher than the existing ones so that all the students of different physiques can sit comfortably and study.
Officials looked at the desks again.
Then they keenly felt that they did not take into account different physiques of students.
Even a little while ago, the respected General Secretary had judged the quality of the blackboard and told them to make and fix the blackboard again.
That day he also visited the IT study room where he said that the school should be equipped with not only computers, but also enough educational equipment and school fixtures including experimental equipment.
Bearing in mind again the unshakable will of the respected General Secretary to provide the younger generation with better educational conditions and environment, the officials could see the reliable images of the schoolchildren growing up to be versatile talents under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea and the appearance of the country which will be more prosperous by them. -0-

headline: Plasterers Contest Held at Housing Construction Site in Pyongyang
story_text:

headline: Korean-style Socialism
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 6 (KCNA) -- Socialism centered on the masses is the greatest patriotic legacy handed down by PresidentKim Il Sungto our people.
Born in a thatched house of Mangyongdae,Kim Il Sungwitnessed the misery of the people in his childhood, and cherished a great ambition to build a new society free from the exploiting class. He made a firm resolution to build at any cost a world where the working people lead their happy life in view of his experience of unfair and contradictory social phenomena in the days of his early revolutionary activities.
On the historic day when the Korean revolution weighed the anchor under the banner of the Down-with-Imperialism Union, he set it as the goal of the revolution to liberate Korea and build socialism and communism on the land where the independence of the masses are fully realized.
In the days of conducting the anti-Japanese armed struggle and carrying out the democratic revolution after the liberation of Korea, the President thought again and again what kind of socialism should be built in our country in the future and what direction and principle should be adhered to in the cause of socialist construction.
He was sure that socialism to be built in our country should be a socialism in which the masses become the masters of everything from A to Z and everything in society serves the masses.
In the mid-1950s after the war, the dogmatists advanced the "theory of prematurity" of socialist transformation, saying that it was impossible to transform the relations of production without socialist industrialization.
In April 1955,Kim Il Sungmade public the historic theses on the character and tasks of our revolution, clarifying the stand of independence to pave the way for socialism by our own efforts.
In August 1958, the socialist transformation of the relations of production was completed and the socialist revolution triumphed in our country under the original line of the President. Thus the socialist system centred on the masses was established.
The Korean-style socialism centered on the masses, handed down by the President as a legacy, is the lifeblood, life and unshakable faith of the Korean people. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of Sodusu Power Station Marked in DPRK
story_text:

PresidentKim Il Sunggave the orientation and ways for designing the main dam of the power station in conformity with the actual conditions of the country and made sure that the power station was founded on July 6, 1965 and clearly indicated the road ahead of it.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited several times the power station successfully built as a gigantic creation in the era of the Workers' Party under the far-reaching plan of the President and gave precious instructions for normalizing the production of electricity.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unencouraged the workers of the power station to conduct the dynamic drive for increased electricity production.
In recent years alone, the power station has introduced many technical innovations and invention proposals to increase the production of electricity while giving many benefits to the state.
A meeting was held on July 5 to mark its 60th anniversary.
Present there were Vice-Premier Jon Sung Guk, officials concerned, officials and employees of the power station. -0-

headline: Korean Revolutionary Army, First Revolutionary Armed Organization
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 6 (KCNA) -- 95 years have passed since PresidentKim Il Sungformed the Korean Revolutionary Army (KRA), the first revolutionary armed organization.
Kim Il Sunghad already been convinced that only the armed struggle could be the most thoroughgoing and revolutionary anti-Japanese resistance in the first period of his revolutionary struggle. He advanced the line of armed struggle at the historic Kalun Meeting (June 30-July 2, 1930) and formed the KRA on July 6, 1930, as the first work for its preparations.
The KRA was the first armed organization of the Korean communists, who set it as a goal to fight for the independence of the country and the freedom and emancipation of the people by their own efforts, and a political and paramilitary organization to organize and prepare for the anti-Japanese armed struggle.
The formation of the KRA made it possible to deal a blow to the Japanese imperialists keen on a war of aggression and further promote the preparations for developing the anti-Japanese national liberation struggle in Korea into a stage of organized armed struggle.
Members of the KRA successfully carried out the tasks at the stage of preparing for the anti-Japanese armed struggle by disposing of Japanese imperialists and their stooges in vast areas of the homeland and northeastern China and vigorously conducting military and political activities to arouse the broad masses to the revolutionary struggle.
As a result, the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, a new-type permanent revolutionary armed forces, was formed in less than two years to wage an armed struggle.
The President wrote in his reminiscences “With the Century” as follows:
“The feats performed by the members of the Korean Revolutionary Army who had opened up the path ahead of our revolution were truly great and noble. It was by drawing on the experiences and lessons of their heroic struggle and at the cost of the precious blood shed by them that the Korean People’s Revolutionary Army came into the world as a permanent revolutionary armed force."
The immortal exploits performed by the President, who provided the eternal cornerstone of the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces at the beginning of the Korean revolution, are shining forever along with the proud history of our Republic which has won only victories. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Zionists' Reckless Moves
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 6 (KCNA) -- Israel's "war machine" which plunged the whole area of Gaza in blood is running madly.
The Gaza area has already turned into a "ground hell" where the human existence environment was completely destroyed due to the war that has been going on for nearly two years.
Since October 2023, the number of Palestinians killed by Israeli army has increased at least 56 000 and all the inhabitants in the Gaza Strip are facing food shortage. Of them, 470 000 are in "fatal hunger", the worst stage in the international index on the food situation.
Even in the present situation that the humanitarian crisis has reached its extreme phase, Israeli murderers are constantly expanding military attacks in the Gaza Strip, which was turned into ruins, updating the record of genocide every day.
Where is the end of bloody massacre and destruction, indeed?
The Zionists have justified their unethical atrocities in the Gaza Strip under the pretext of the "hostage rescue" and "sweeping of Hamas (Islamic Resistance Movement of Palestine)" and have so far misled public opinion as if they were the end of bloodshed.
In the early days of the Gaza crisis, the prime minister of Israel asserted that Israel had no thought for permanently occupying Gaza or making the civilians emigrate from it, and that "the aim is to sweep away Hamas in Gaza and obtain hostages' release."
In contrast with this, the sweeping of Hamas has already turned into massacre of civilians, total destruction of existence environment and forcible exile of the inhabitants in Gaza and the release of hostages has been placed in the back long ago.
Voices to demand for ending war and realizing the humanitarian ceasefire are growing in Israel, saying that "sweeping of Hamas", the main goal of the war, has not been achieved and the release of hostages is not feasible without negotiation. But the Zionists are persistently divorcing from this reality.
It is proved by the acts of the Israeli warmongers who deliberately broke the ceasefire which had been difficultly created through the mediation of the international community in the past and gradually expanded the war, thus fling away the opportunity to exchange thousands of Palestinian prisoners for their hostages.
The Israeli prime minister, who has recently become more upbeat under the patronage of his American master, is openly saying that there is no way to stop the war even if Israel brings hostages, swinging from his previous attitude of giving priority to the release of hostages.
The Israeli military warmongers' rhetoric is more direct. They asserted that "we will act with all our efforts and will not stop action until all the goals are achieved, including the voluntary immigration plan of the Gaza residents" and "unlike in the past, the Israel Defense Forces will not withdraw from the seized areas (although the Gaza war ends)," openly agitating full occupation and annexation of the Gaza Strip.
The reality clearly shows that even if all the hostages are released, the bloody military atrocities in Gaza will continue with no reason and justification, and that only the result of the complete annexation of Gaza is the ultimate goal pursued by Israel and its behind-the-scene forces.
After all, the Zionists are committing heinous crimes, regarding not only the lives of Israeli hostages but also the lives of millions of Palestinians as victims of the Jewish state's wild ambition for territorial annexation and hostages for realizing their ambition to dominate the Middle East.
The Jewish state's crime to make peace in the Middle East and the rest of the world a sacrifice for realizing its expansionist ambition can never be tolerated. -0-

headline: New Technology for Manufacturing Inorganic Composite Disinfectant Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 6 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun,  researchers of the Clinical Research Centre of North Phyongan Provincial General Hospital in the DPRK have made successes by establishing a new technology for manufacturing inorganic composite disinfectant effective in preventing hospital infection.
Researchers succeeded in developing nano-zinc oxide antibacterial agent capable of putting various production lines of foodstuff factories, treatment rooms, inpatient wards and operating rooms of hospitals on a germ-free basis.
They applied this technology in developing medicines good for the treatment of various diseases including skin diseases.
Their achievements were highly appreciated at several exhibitions. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of Sodusu Power Station Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 6 (KCNA) -- The Sodusu Power Station in the DPRK marked its 60th founding anniversary.
The 60-year-long journey covered by the power station is the glorious one associated with the devotion, efforts, loving care and trust of the peerlessly great men who made sure that the power station was built as a great power base in the northern part of the country and led it to bring about a radical turn in the electricity production and its management and operation.
PresidentKim Il Sunggave the orientation and ways for designing the main dam of the power station in conformity with the actual conditions of the country and made sure that the power station was founded on July 6, 1965 and clearly indicated the road ahead of it.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited several times the power station successfully built as a gigantic creation in the era of the Workers' Party under the far-reaching plan of the President and gave precious instructions for normalizing the production of electricity.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unencouraged the workers of the power station to conduct the dynamic drive for increased electricity production.
In recent years alone, the power station has introduced many technical innovations and invention proposals to increase the production of electricity while giving many benefits to the state.
A meeting was held on July 5 to mark its 60th anniversary.
Present there were Vice-Premier Jon Sung Guk, officials concerned, officials and employees of the power station. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Pays Deep Attention to Farming during His Life
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 7 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people sing the song "When we walk along the road between fields" with deep emotion in July, yearning for PresidentKim Il Sung.
The song reminds them of the devoted efforts of the President who visited many farm fields and discussed farm work with peasants.
As the words of the song tell, the nearly half course among the whole one of the President's field guidance was farm road.
From the outset of the nation building to the last moments of his life, he made ceaseless journeys to the fields of the country to solve the food problem of the people and farming problem.
One day in June 1947, he visited the Mirim Plain and transplanted rice seedlings with peasants to give instructions on enriching the distributed land and expanding the irrigated area to increase the area of paddy fields.
In the days of his efforts to solve the food problem of the people, he visited the Onchon Plain on the west coast more than 110 times. He chose a reservoir site with torchlight at midnight to solve the water problem of a farm in the suburbs of Pyongyang.
In June 1994, the last period of his great life, the President visited a field of the then Kumdang Cooperative Farm in Onchon County despite of his old age, and acquainted himself with the county's crop prospects and discussed the ways for farming well.
The immortal traces of the President who walked along the farm road and roads between fields, irrespective of the bad weather and rough roads, are left in all parts of the country.
The history of the President's love for the people who regarded the happiness of the people as the greatest pleasure is being carried forward by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's devoted effort for the people. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Manpho and Munphyong Smelteries
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 7 (KCNA) -- The Manpho and Munphyong smelteries in the DPRK are achieving successes by putting the production control on a scientific basis of high level.
The Manpho Smeltery has modernized the process by installing a new electrolytic cell to make a breakthrough in revitalizing production.
The smeltery has raised the actual extraction rate of the products by conducting researches into lowering the copper grade of slag and actively made technological innovations for routine overhaul of pressure motor, thus increasing the daily production by 1.2 times on an average.
The Munphyong Smeltery is fully ensuring the operation of equipment and increasing the actual extraction rate of products. It is also carrying out its daily plan by making effective use of raw and other materials.
And it is putting the operation of electric furnace and revolving furnace on a scientific basis of high level and ensuring the recycling by the zinc oxide production process, thus laying a foundation for increased production. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Qualified for 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 7 (KCNA) -- Matches of group H for the qualification for the 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup took place in Tajikistan.
The matches were held in league matches, divided into eight groups. Eight teams which won the first place in each group and the top three teams in the 2022 AFC Women's Asian Cup will advance into the final tournament, together with the team of the host nation.
The DPRK team took the first place in its group by beating the Tajik and Palestinian teams 10:0 respectively on June 29 and July 2 and the Malaysian team 6:0 on July 5. So, the DPRK team was qualified for the 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup.
Meanwhile, DPRK players Jon Ju Phyong and Jo Hong Rim took the third place in the U-19 mixed doubles of the 29thAsian Youth Table Tennis Championships held in Uzbekistan. -0-

headline: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Cabinet Party Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- An enlarged plenary meeting of the Cabinet Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea took place on July 7 to implement the decisions of the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission, Kim Jong Gwan, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and other members and alternate members of the Cabinet Party Committee. And officials concerned were present as observers.
The plenary meeting reviewed the work in the first half of the year for implementing the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK and discussed in depth the measures for perfectly carrying out the important tasks set forth at the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK by making more courageous, effective and intensive efforts.
Ri Yong Sik, chief secretary of the Cabinet Party Committee, made a report.
The plenary meeting strictly analyzed and reviewed some shortcomings revealed in implementing the Party's decisions in the first half of the year and their causes and discussed the measures for achieving sustainable and stable development of the overall economy.
Speeches were made at the plenary meeting.
The plenary meeting adopted a decision for thoroughly carrying out the tasks set forth at the Twelfth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK. -0-

headline: Great Life Brilliant with Devotion for Country and People
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- The revolutionary career of PresidentKim Il Sungwas the life of the popular leader shining with devotion for the country and its people.
The number of units the President visited from the days immediately after the liberation of Korea to the last period of his great life is more than 20 600 and the total length of the course of his field guidance is over 578 000 km.
He continued his field guidance to find himself among the people at factories, rural areas, fishing villages, underground faces, etc., saying that he was most pleased in his lifetime when he was with the people.
Instead of visiting his old home in Mangyongdae which he had never forgotten during the anti-Japanese war, he visited the then Kangson Steel Plant by passing through the fork of Mangyongdae right after the national liberation and aroused its workers to build a new country.
He headed for the Kangnam Ceramic Factory right after getting down the mass rally platform celebrating the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Afterwards, he visited various units to arouse the people to postwar reconstruction.
Saying that the country would be relieved if it had 10 000 more tons of steel, he put forward the working class of the Kangson Steel Plant in the vanguard of a great revolutionary upswing and ushered in a new era of creation and leap forward, the Chollima age, on this land.
The Chongsanri Spirit and Chongsanri Method, the superior idea of guiding the masses and the method of leading them, and the Taean work system, the Juche-oriented economic management system, were the great political mode and precious wealth created by him during his field guidance.
The era of great prosperity, in which the socialist system was established in 1958 and the socialist industrialization was realized in a brief period of 14 years, could be ushered in thanks to his wise leadership.
He said in the last days of his life that he always believed in the people, struggled for them and found himself among them, adding that he would always be with them in the future, too.
Thanks to the devotion and efforts of the President who continued his field guidance for the country and its people all his life, finding his best worthwhile life and pleasure, the DPRK could demonstrate its might as a socialist state with invincible power. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Tuesday dedicate editorials and articles to the greatest national memorial day.
Rodong Sinmun in an editorial says that the world historic events and eye-opening changes made by our people in the last century are linked with the immortal august name of PresidentKim Il Sungand the dignity and prestige of our state which have been fully displayed before the world are unthinkable apart from his revolutionary exploits.
The editorial goes on:
Korean-style socialism, a noble patriotic legacy of the President, is an invincible power which is ever-victorious with the revolutionary idea of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea as its lifeline.
It is a miraculous country that ushers in a heyday of comprehensive national rejuvenation thanks to the extraordinary leadership practice of the Party Central Committee.
PresidentKim Il Sungfirmly defended the dignity and sovereignty of our Republic and laid the foundation for powerful economy and national defence for the happiness of the people. It holds a shining place in the exploits performed by him in building a thriving nation.
Korean-style socialism, the precious patriotic legacy of the President, is a dignified country of the people where the ideal of the people is brought into full bloom thanks to the intention and will of the Party Central Committee for the devoted service for the people's wellbeing.
Today, the DPRK greets a new era of unprecedented changes in which the dignity, right and interests of the people are thoroughly defended and the people's dreams and ideals are fully realized under the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The editorial calls upon all the people to dynamically struggle for the eternal prosperity of our state shining with the august name of the President by getting united more firmly aroundKim Jong Un.
Minju Joson in an article says that the President's exploits for state building fully displaying the vitality which will be immortal not only in books recorded in history but also in the dynamic advance of the revolutionary cause that has lasted generation after generation, are the precious eternal treasure guaranteeing the prosperity of socialist Korea for all ages. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- All the people across the DPRK are filled with ardent yearning and boundless reverence for PresidentKim Il Sung, founder of socialist Korea and great sage of the revolution, on the occasion of the 31st anniversary of his demise.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00 on July 8.

Also laid were the flower baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the DPRK State Affairs Commission, the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the DPRK Cabinet.
Kim Jong Unpaid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls, where the President and the Chairman lie in state, he made a deep bow of best wishes for immortality to the great leaders.
He affirmed that the revolutionary careers and exploits of the President and the Chairman will shine forever along with the eternal prosperity of our socialist state which is successfully realizing the ideal of the people in a comprehensive way while winning victory after victory for centuries. -0-

headline:
Impressive Anecdotes Associated with Noble Revolutionary Career of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.07.08.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- Many revolutionary anecdotes were produced during the days when PresidentKim Il Sungsuccessfully applied his noble intention of "The People Are God" in revolutionary practice.
It was lunchtime on one day in January 1962, whenKim Il Sungfinished his talk with officials on his field guidance at Sinchon County of South Hwanghae Province.
Before going to a lodging place, the President asked an official the name of the then cooperative farm where women stopped the front car.
Hearing the fact from the official that it was the then Wonam Cooperative Farm and the women who wanted to see the President were sent back, the President said that he should meet them even if he skipped a lunch, and went to the farm to meet the people's wishes.
In a winter day of one year, he saw the students not putting on overcoats and it weighed so heavily on his mind. Next day, he discussed the issue of solving the clothing problem of the children and students in the rural areas at a meeting of the Political Committee of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
At the meeting of the Political Committee of the Party Central Committee, he gave detailed instructions on the ways to solve the clothing problem of the children and students in the rural areas. He personally guided the production of clothes to ensure that winter padded clothes were supplied to all the children and students in the rural areas across the country free of charge.
One day, an official asked the President to have a rest even for a moment. The President said: As an old saying goes, if a vassal does many things, the king will be comfortable, and I am a vassal of the people and the people are our king.
Such impressive anecdotes still convey the noble popular traits of the President. -0-

headline: Measure Taken for Supplying Chickens
story_text:
One day in December 1967, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a grocer's shop in Pyongyang and learned in detail about the foodstuffs in great demand, the supply of eggs and the sale of chickens.
Upon hearing that live chickens were on sale, the President told a salesperson to weigh the chickens.
The weight of each chicken decreased 200g on an average as compared to the time when the chickens were transported to the shop.
The President said that the weights of chickens would decrease as they were carried to the shop from the chicken farm and then were cooped up in narrow roosts for several days without being fed enough.
Saying that people including married couples going to work would be burdened with boiling the water to slaughter and eat the live chicken they bought, he stressed that the meat processing factory near the chicken farm should slaughter and freeze chickens and supply them to shops.
Thanks to the meticulous teachings of the President, a change was made in supplying chickens to the people. -0-

headline: Great Life Brilliant with Devotion for Country and People
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- The revolutionary career of PresidentKim Il Sungwas the life of the popular leader shining with devotion for the country and its people.
The number of units the President visited from the days immediately after the liberation of Korea to the last period of his great life is more than 20 600 and the total length of the course of his field guidance is over 578 000 km.
He continued his field guidance to find himself among the people at factories, rural areas, fishing villages, underground faces, etc., saying that he was most pleased in his lifetime when he was with the people.
Instead of visiting his old home in Mangyongdae which he had never forgotten during the anti-Japanese war, he visited the then Kangson Steel Plant by passing through the fork of Mangyongdae right after the national liberation and aroused its workers to build a new country.
He headed for the Kangnam Ceramic Factory right after getting down the mass rally platform celebrating the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. Afterwards, he visited various units to arouse the people to postwar reconstruction.
Saying that the country would be relieved if it had 10 000 more tons of steel, he put forward the working class of the Kangson Steel Plant in the vanguard of a great revolutionary upswing and ushered in a new era of creation and leap forward, the Chollima age, on this land.
The Chongsanri Spirit and Chongsanri Method, the superior idea of guiding the masses and the method of leading them, and the Taean work system, the Juche-oriented economic management system, were the great political mode and precious wealth created by him during his field guidance.
The era of great prosperity, in which the socialist system was established in 1958 and the socialist industrialization was realized in a brief period of 14 years, could be ushered in thanks to his wise leadership.
He said in the last days of his life that he always believed in the people, struggled for them and found himself among them, adding that he would always be with them in the future, too.
Thanks to the devotion and efforts of the President who continued his field guidance for the country and its people all his life, finding his best worthwhile life and pleasure, the DPRK could demonstrate its might as a socialist state with invincible power. -0-

headline: Newspapers on Greatest National Memorial Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 8 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Tuesday dedicate editorials and articles to the greatest national memorial day.
Rodong Sinmun in an editorial says that the world historic events and eye-opening changes made by our people in the last century are linked with the immortal august name of PresidentKim Il Sungand the dignity and prestige of our state which have been fully displayed before the world are unthinkable apart from his revolutionary exploits.
The editorial goes on:
Korean-style socialism, a noble patriotic legacy of the President, is an invincible power which is ever-victorious with the revolutionary idea of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea as its lifeline.
It is a miraculous country that ushers in a heyday of comprehensive national rejuvenation thanks to the extraordinary leadership practice of the Party Central Committee.
PresidentKim Il Sungfirmly defended the dignity and sovereignty of our Republic and laid the foundation for powerful economy and national defence for the happiness of the people. It holds a shining place in the exploits performed by him in building a thriving nation.
Korean-style socialism, the precious patriotic legacy of the President, is a dignified country of the people where the ideal of the people is brought into full bloom thanks to the intention and will of the Party Central Committee for the devoted service for the people's wellbeing.
Today, the DPRK greets a new era of unprecedented changes in which the dignity, right and interests of the people are thoroughly defended and the people's dreams and ideals are fully realized under the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The editorial calls upon all the people to dynamically struggle for the eternal prosperity of our state shining with the august name of the President by getting united more firmly aroundKim Jong Un.
Minju Joson in an article says that the President's exploits for state building fully displaying the vitality which will be immortal not only in books recorded in history but also in the dynamic advance of the revolutionary cause that has lasted generation after generation, are the precious eternal treasure guaranteeing the prosperity of socialist Korea for all ages. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- The Agricultural Commission of the DPRK is taking agro-technical measures to protect fruit trees from blight and harmful insects.
The commission is focusing on eliminating the cause of blight outbreak with physical and chemical methods.
It is making fruit farms across the country spray insecticides as required by the technical regulations while making sure that agro-chemicals, farm machines and implements necessary for farm work are provided in contact with relevant fields.
It promotes the production of biological agro-chemicals based on botanical materials and intensifies technical guidance to introduce it in farming practice.
It also ensures that soil management on fruit farms is conducted in a qualitative way. -0-

headline: Seasonal Divisions in July and Folk Customs
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- July is the month when the hottest period of a year begins and much rain falls in the DPRK.
July has Soso, the 11th of the 24 seasonal divisions according to the lunar calendar when the summer heat begins, and Taeso, the 12th of the 24 seasonal divisions when the summer heat is at its height.
Soso and Taeso fall on July 7 and July 22 this year.
From olden times, the Korean people have weeded paddies and fields several times in Soso as the corps grow well.
Before and after Taeso, they have secured green manure to be used for next year's farming. The grasses which were cut and piled up in the period were turned into the organic fertilizer good for next year's farming.
In July, there are the first and second periods of the midsummer heat called Chobok and Jungbok.
Chobok and Jungbok fall on July 20 and July 30 respectively
From olden times, the Korean people used to make various foods good for preventing heat and protecting their health in those periods.
Typical of them are chicken soup boiled with glutinous rice, garlic of one bulb and ginseng, and rice gruel prepared with red beans mashed and strained.
The favorite folk game in July is koni game. -0-
