headline: Flower Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from Nigerian President
Floral Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
Car Parked Outside Compound
story_text:
One day in April, 1984, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited a foodstuff factory in Pyongyang.
As the car approached the factory, the Chairman asked the driver to park the car outside the main gate unlike before and walked into the compound.
The officials who came out to greet him as well as those accompanying him were puzzled.
They could know the reason only when the Chairman was about to leave the factory.
That day, the Chairman, who was heading towards the main gate after giving precious teachings while going round various production lines of the factory, suddenly stopped. He then pointed to a building towered high and asked what it is.
Upon hearing from an official of the factory that it is a garage, he remained silent for a while as if it was something of a surprise and then stressed that even a mote or dust should not be allowed in the foodstuff to be eaten by our people and that the factory should be fenced and the garage moved out of the compound and any vehicles prevented from entering the compound. He added that even when carrying out the products, vehicles should be parked outside the factory and the products should be carried to the vehicles.
Such noble intention was behind the reason why the Chairman made the car parked outside the compound when he visited the factory. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the construction of anti-tidal dykes.
It filled the low ground in the dangerous places of the Unha bank with over 3 000 cubic meters of earth and repaired and built retaining walls extending several kilometers. It is concentrating forces and means on repairing anti-tidal dykes in the Kumsong-ri area of Onchon County.
As the section for managing anti-tidal dykes has increased, the municipality made sure that the Onchon anti-tidal dyke station takes charge of the Kumsong bank while taking measures to remove dangerous places.

headline: Seminars on Exploits of President Kim Il Sung Held in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- Seminars on the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungtook place in Mongolia, Pakistan, Bulgaria and Egypt on the occasion of the 31st anniversary of his demise.
Present there were personages of parliaments, political parties, organizations and institutions and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people in the relevant countries.
Speeches were made at the seminars.
Personages of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the Karachi Juche Study Center of Pakistan, the Karachi Women's Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Pakistan and the Organization of Youth and Students of the Juche Idea in Karachi of Pakistan said the revolutionary ideas of PresidentKim Il Sunghave been invariably carried forward in the DPRK though decades have passed and that the truthfulness and vitality of the Juche idea have been clearly proved in the 21st century, too.
The exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho laid an eternal foundation for the prosperity of socialist Korea will be handed down century after century, they stressed, adding that the President will always be alive in the hearts of mankind.
Members of the State Great Hural of Mongolia and the president of J. Sambuu Herders Development Fund of Mongolia said that the Mongolian people are still ardently revering PresidentKim Il Sung, referring to the immortal exploits performed by the great leader for the development of friendly relations between the DPRK and Mongolia.
The chief and members of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism praised the President for wisely leading the Korean revolution and the world revolution under the uplifted banner of independence and devoting himself to the wellbeing of the people.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt praised the immortal ideo-theoretical exploits, the exploits for national liberation and exploits for winning victory in the Fatherland Liberation War performed by the President and his noble international obligation. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Cornerstone of DPRK's Mightiness
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The tradition of the great July 27 victory is a strong blood vessel giving steady continuity to the Juche revolution, a source of getting Korean-style socialism to make a nonstop leap forward and a powerful weapon guaranteeing the eternal prosperity of the country, says Rodong Sinmun in an article on July 10.
It goes on:
The tradition of victory of Juche Korea is a great tradition created by the Juche-oriented military idea, outstanding strategy and tactics and rare commanding art of PresidentKim Il Sung, and a brilliant tradition provided by the heroic struggle and indomitable revolutionary spirit of the victorious wartime generation who fought, dedicating their youth and lives readily in hearty response to the call of the President.
For our people, who had experienced the miserable fate of being a stateless nation in the past, the President was the sun of their destiny, the future of the country and the banner of victory as he liberated Korea and gave them the right to true life.
It is the greatest of the victorious wartime generation's feats that they recorded in history the immutable truth that no one in the world can match the strength of all the people who  turned out as one, firmly united behind the great leader and left the tradition of loyalty as an immortal legacy.
The tradition of patriotism created by the victorious wartime generation at the cost of blood and life is still being carried forward.
It is thanks to the wise leadership of the President that our people could have the revolutionary optimism confident of victory and future despite any hardships.

headline: 29th Regular General Meeting of Chongsanghoe Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The 29th regular general meeting of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan (Chongsanghoe) was held in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan on July 5.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Jo Il Yon, vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, Hyon Tae Sik, director of its Economic Department, Kim Min Gwan, chairman of Chongsanghoe, and its members.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Introduced at the meeting was a congratulatory message from the homeland.
O Hyong Se, chairman of the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, made a report.
The reporter referred to the successes made in the work for supporting national education and strengthening the fighting efficiency of all basic organizations during the period under review.
In hearty response to the historic letter sent by the respected MarshalKim Jong Unto Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the formation of Chongryon, he will carry forward the spirit and tradition of patriotism and lead the patriotic movement including national education to bring the overall work of Chongsanghoe to a higher stage in the period of its 29th-term Chongsanghoe, he said.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
Then "Chongsanghoe Prize" was awarded to exemplary members.
An Kang Ji was newly elected as chairperson of Chongsanghoe.
Pak Ku Ho made a speech.
He called for glorifying generation after generation the immortal exploits performed by the peerlessly great men who formed and developed Chongsanghoe and further strengthening the organization into a broad-based powerful youth organization and an attractive economic organization which set a new model of patriotism with its 30th formation anniversary as an occasion. -0-

headline: Work to Join Ranks of Best Farms Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- Enthusiasm for joining the ranks of the best farms is growing in different parts of the DPRK.
The Agricultural Commission and other agricultural guidance organs at all levels are conducting the work to generalize the experience gained by the units selected as the 30 best farms for 2024.
The Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality, provides a guarantee for high yields by putting the paddy rice cultivation on a higher scientific basis and the Jangchon Vegetable Farm in Sadong District, Pyongyang, increases the area of introducing a farming method by mud snails, thus saving much manpower and fertilizer and improving the growth of paddy rice.
Officials and agricultural workers of the Kim Je Won Farm in Jaeryong County and many other farms in South Hwanghae Province reaped unusual bumper crop of wheat and barley and have made doubled efforts to achieve successes in the second crop farming, too.

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province in the DPRK has improved rivers extending hundreds of kilometers this year to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
It also launched anti-land-sliding projects in thousands of places in the mountainous areas.

headline: Production of Cocoons and Silk Goods Goes Up
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The sericulture and silk industrial field in the DPRK is increasing the production of cocoons and silk products both in quantity and quality.
Sericulture units in South Hwanghae Province are picking mulberry leaves in a responsible manner and taking nutritional care of young silkworms to increase the output of cocoons and enhance their quality.
They are paying attention to preventing silkworm jaundice by regularly ventilating, disinfecting and sterilizing silkworm rearing rooms.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill manufactured and installed machine equipment, directed efforts to ensuring the technical indices and made active use of advanced technology to improve the quality of products.
The Pakchon Silk Mill and the Phalwon Silk Mill conducted technical innovation activities to further improve silk cloth processing technique and enhance the quality of products and increase the varieties.
The workers and technicians of the Anju Silk Mill  produce quality silk goods of various kinds while pushing ahead with the upgrading of equipment. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Cornerstone of DPRK's Mightiness
story_text:

The tradition of victory of Juche Korea is a great tradition created by the Juche-oriented military idea, outstanding strategy and tactics and rare commanding art of PresidentKim Il Sung, and a brilliant tradition provided by the heroic struggle and indomitable revolutionary spirit of the victorious wartime generation who fought, dedicating their youth and lives readily in hearty response to the call of the President.
For our people, who had experienced the miserable fate of being a stateless nation in the past, the President was the sun of their destiny, the future of the country and the banner of victory as he liberated Korea and gave them the right to true life.

The tradition of patriotism created by the victorious wartime generation at the cost of blood and life is still being carried forward.
It is thanks to the wise leadership of the President that our people could have the revolutionary optimism confident of victory and future despite any hardships.
The tradition of July 27 victory is shedding its rays as a driving force that defends the strong breathing of the Korean revolution century after century and enables our great state and people to achieve greater victory and glory under the leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: National Traits to Be Thoroughly Established
story_text:
One day in October 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited a farm.
Kim Jong Unsaw high-yielding crops which were newly bred at the farm and said that he took a measure to build a cutting-edge agricultural scientific research base at the farm and requested it to produce proud successes every year. Officials, Party members and other working people of the farm continue to wage a dynamic struggle to live up to the expectation of the Party and wait for him with interesting scientific and technological successes whenever he visited the farm every year, he added.
Being delighted to see the precious crops cultivated by dint of science and technology that day, he said that as he always emphasizes at any unit and any sector, what we believe is the strength of science and technology, stressing the need for all sectors and units to firmly maintain the trait of attaching importance to science and technology and thoroughly establish as national traits the viewpoint of prioritizing science and technology and the working manner to solve the tasks facing them with their own efforts by dint of science and technology.
Looking up toKim Jong Un, the officials pledged to fulfill their responsibility and duty, holding fast to science and technology as an all-round weapon and invincible weapon in thoroughly establishing the work of attaching importance to science and technology as national traits. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Fields
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various fields.
He visited the construction site of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area and learned about the progress made in the construction according to projects among units. And he stressed the need to ensure the quality and speed of projects by further enhancing the responsibility and role of officials of construction units and supervisory organs and hasten the construction of public buildings and service amenities networks on the ground floors to successfully carry out the project tasks.
Learning about farming at the Rimok Farm in Sinchon County, the township farm in Thaetan County, the Jangsong Farm in Ongjin County, the Pumin Farm in Kangryong County, the Hakchon Farm in Unchon County and other farms in South Hwanghae Province, the premier called for rationally organizing manpower to cope with climate change and increasing the operation rate of farm machines to finish the harvest, transport and threshing of wheat and barley in a short span of time and for pushing ahead with the sowing as scheduled by selecting as after-crops the high-yielding varieties suitable to the characteristics of fields and areas.
He underlined the importance for the farms located in low-elevation areas to properly judge the natural disaster-prone places and take thorough measures for drainage and readjust paddy ridges in a qualitative way in order to prevent damage to crops.
Earlier, at the Songyong Paint Factory and the Unsan Prospecting Machine Factory, the premier referred to the practical issues and ways for further pushing ahead with the improvement of product quality and modernization of production lines by dint of science and technology.
The field consultative meetings held on the spots discussed the issue for the construction units to intensify the drive for saving materials and for the agricultural field to widely generalize the experience gained by the advanced units in farming, the issue of further perfecting the production lines as the energy- and cost-saving ones and the issue for the leading economic officials to put the planning work on a scientific basis of higher level and thoroughly establish discipline in implementing plans and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: Chinese Ambassador Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy on July 9 on the occasion of the 64th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Present there on invitation were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Ri Chang Sik, vice-minister of Education, and officials concerned.
Members of the Chinese embassy were on hand.
Wang Yajun said at the reception that for the past 64 years since the conclusion of the treaty which confirmed the orientation of steady development of China-DPRK relations, the exchange and cooperation have been intensified in several fields to develop the traditional relations of friendship under the strategic leadership of the leaders of the two parties and the two countries.
The Chinese side would as ever firmly support the DPRK advancing along the road of independent development, he said, affirming that the spirit of friendship and mutual assistance contained in the treaty would shine forever in the future, too.
Kang Yun Sok in his speech said that the two countries have mutually supported and cooperated with each other in the struggle for safeguarding and developing socialism, the common cause, since the conclusion of the treaty which serves as the firm legal foundation for consolidating and developing the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations.
He stressed that he would continue displaying the spirit of the treaty and make joint efforts to steadily develop the friendly and cooperative relations in conformity with the noble intentions of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries.
On the same day, the Chinese consulate general in Chongjin hosted a reception. -0-

headline: Korean Jewel Painting
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- Korean jewel painting, the treasure and pride of the Korean nation, gives a peculiar emotion to the people as it vividly depicts reality with natural gems and precious stone powders.
The artistic characteristic of Korean jewel painting is the organic combination of pictorial and technical art methods, such as the harmony of vivid, soft and elegant colours, the delicate and sophisticated techniques and the wonderful decorative effect in combination of various materials.
Korean jewel painting, created more than 30 years ago, is newly developing while the theme and creation objects are widening under the wise guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Going round the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum under construction more than ten years ago,Kim Jong Ungave instructions to depict with Korean jewel paintings the images of anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners who boundlessly remained loyal to PresidentKim Il Sung.
The creators of the Korean Jewel Painting Creative Group of the Mansudae Art Studio vividly depicted the images of anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners and thus contributed to ensuring the prestige and style of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum.
Korean jewel painting, with the main stress put on depicting image, flower and animal and displaying them in the interior in the past, reflects the great era and is also created in mural painting.
The Korean jewel paintings "Soaring into Sky" and "Jonwi Street at Night" reflecting the great event that demonstrated the national power of the DPRK to the whole world and the fantastic sceneries of modern new streets in Pyongyang Municipality were created and the large-size Korean jewel painting depicting mountaineering road maps of Mt Chilbo and Mt Myohyang was created.
Korean jewel painting is shining more brilliantly in the great new era as it is instilling the great national pride and self-confidence, beautiful emotion and optimism into the DPRK people. -0-

headline: Brisk Activities of Families of Officials of City- and County-level Organs in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- More than 100 platoons consisting of families of officials of city- and county-level organs are conducting brisk activities at the forefronts of North Phyongan Province in the DPRK.
Thousands of members of the platoons are rendering manpower and material support to the forefronts.
The wives of officials of the county-level organs in Sakju County went to a farm to help farmers in the immediate farming, and the members of the family platoon of Thaechon County went to the countryside with goods for supply service and encouraged agricultural workers while working with them.
Members of the family platoons in Phihyon County and Nyongbyon County are making efforts to increase grain production on low-yielding fields.
Those in Kusong and Jongju cities and Ryongchon and Tongnim counties are encouraging builders who are sprucing up the island area of Sinuiju City through sincere support and art performances. They are stepping farming processes at the farms that fell behind others.
Wives of officials of other city- and county-level organs are farming at raw materials bases, managing roads and sprucing up townships while conducting motivation activities. -0-

headline: Wangjaesan Art Troupe Gives Music and Dance Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The Wangjaesan Art Troupe gives a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre from July 10 to instill confidence in sure victory and exertion into the mind of the DPRK people who have turned out in the drive for increased production to glorify this year with miraculous victories and epochal achievements.
The performance started with female chorus "My Strong Motherland". Put on the stage were female solo and pangchang "Care of My Destiny", national dance "Joy of Rich Harvest", song and dance "Socialism Is Ours" and shadow dance "Song of Happiness, Ring out Far and Wide".
Through their colourful artistic depiction, the performers represented the great pride of our people who greeted the new era of dignified powerful state under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and the ideological feelings that Korean-style socialism is the best as the excellent national tradition is further blooming.
Dance "It Is Offensive" and modern dance and tap dance "Campfire, Flare Up" reflecting the spirit of the DPRK making a leap forward and the breathing of the times through nimble and dynamic dance movements inspired the audience with enthusiasm to achieve heroic feats at every worksite.
When national dance "Janggu Dance", serial folk songs "Ballad of Gold Mountains" and "Song of Big Hauls in the Sea" were put on the stage, arousing the national emotion and interest, the audience chimed in with the performers, full of the pride that our songs and dances are best in the world.
Hearing song and dance "We Are Koreans" and female chorus "Song about the Country", the audience made pledges to glorify the motherland forever with the irresistible might of the single-minded unity firmly united around the great Party Central Committee and with the patriotic efforts of devoting themselves to the eternal prosperity and development of the DPRK.
The theatre hall was filled with excitement when the song "Dear Father" resounded, arousing the people's reverence for the peerlessly great man.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience.
The audience presented bouquets to the performers, congratulating them on their successful performance. -0-

headline: Improved Educational Conditions and Environment in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Municipality pushes ahead with the work to improve the educational conditions and environment.
Mangyongdae District provided equipment and materials needed for remodeling Samhung Middle School and Phalgol Primary School on a preferential basis.
Songyo District spruced up Kumbong Senior Middle School and Ryulgok Kindergarten and Moranbong District steps up the construction of Inhung Junior Middle School by supplying cement and steel in a responsible way.
Pothonggang District set the Pulgungori Kindergarten No. 1 as a model unit and is pushing forward with the project at the final stage by sending officials to frequently learn about the construction and solve knotty problems.
Lots of support organizations in the municipality are rendering active assistance to educational institutions. -0-

headline: Love and Trust Shown by Chairman Kim Jong Il for Workers in Jagang Province
story_text:
One day in June 1998, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited Jagang Province in the DPRK.
Kim Jong Illooked round various production lines of an enterprise and then went to a hostel and restaurant.
He inquired with parental affection whether quilts in hostel rooms were thin or not and whether the rooms were cold or not.
At the restaurant, he looked at the nutrition analysis table. He acquainted himself with the variety of the foods for workers and earnestly requested the officials to take good care of the workers' livelihood.
Saying that he always remembers the workers in Jagang Province, the Chairman showed great trust to the workers in Jagang Province to dynamically advance in the van of the struggle to defend socialism.
Thanks to the great love and trust of the Chairman, the workers in Jagang Province could create the Kanggye spirit in the period of grim trials, greatly encouraging the people across the country. -0-

headline: Wangjaesan Art Troupe Gives Music and Dance Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The Wangjaesan Art Troupe gives a music and dance performance at the East Pyongyang Grand Theatre from July 10 to instill confidence in sure victory and exertion into the mind of the DPRK people who have turned out in the drive for increased production to glorify this year with miraculous victories and epochal achievements.
The performance started with female chorus "My Strong Motherland". Put on the stage were female solo and pangchang "Care of My Destiny", national dance "Joy of Rich Harvest", song and dance "Socialism Is Ours" and shadow dance "Song of Happiness, Ring out Far and Wide".
Through their colourful artistic depiction, the performers represented the great pride of our people who greeted the new era of dignified powerful state under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and the ideological feelings that Korean-style socialism is the best as the excellent national tradition is further blooming.
Dance "It Is Offensive" and modern dance and tap dance "Campfire, Flare Up" reflecting the spirit of the DPRK making a leap forward and the breathing of the times through nimble and dynamic dance movements inspired the audience with enthusiasm to achieve heroic feats at every worksite.
When national dance "Janggu Dance", serial folk songs "Ballad of Gold Mountains" and "Song of Big Hauls in the Sea" were put on the stage, arousing the national emotion and interest, the audience chimed in with the performers, full of the pride that our songs and dances are best in the world.
Hearing song and dance "We Are Koreans" and female chorus "Song about the Country", the audience made pledges to glorify the motherland forever with the irresistible might of the single-minded unity firmly united around the great Party Central Committee and with the patriotic efforts of devoting themselves to the eternal prosperity and development of the DPRK.
The theatre hall was filled with excitement when the song "Dear Father" resounded, arousing the people's reverence for the peerlessly great man.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience.
The audience presented bouquets to the performers, congratulating them on their successful performance. -0-

headline: Wangjaesan Art Troupe Gives Music and Dance Performance
Brisk Activities of Families of Officials of City- and County-level Organs in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- More than 100 platoons consisting of families of officials of city- and county-level organs are conducting brisk activities at the forefronts of North Phyongan Province in the DPRK.
Thousands of members of the platoons are rendering manpower and material support to the forefronts.
The wives of officials of the county-level organs in Sakju County went to a farm to help farmers in the immediate farming, and the members of the family platoon of Thaechon County went to the countryside with goods for supply service and encouraged agricultural workers while working with them.
Members of the family platoons in Phihyon County and Nyongbyon County are making efforts to increase grain production on low-yielding fields.
Those in Kusong and Jongju cities and Ryongchon and Tongnim counties are encouraging builders who are sprucing up the island area of Sinuiju City through sincere support and art performances. They are stepping farming processes at the farms that fell behind others.
Wives of officials of other city- and county-level organs are farming at raw materials bases, managing roads and sprucing up townships while conducting motivation activities. -0-

headline: Early Peaches Supplied to People in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- Kwail County and the Onchon Fruit Farm of the DPRK have a rich harvest of early fruits.
They have improved the soil fertility of orchards and the nutrition management of fruit trees in a planned way to increase the per-hectare yields.
The transport fleets carrying the early peaches harvested in Kwail County and at the Onchon Fruit Farm arrived in Pyongyang and Nampho municipalities on July 11.
Officials and working people in the relevant regions greeted the transport fleets.
Officials of the Party and power organs and commercial service units organized transport and service for the peaches to reach baby homes, orphanages, primary schools for orphans, sanatoria for war veterans, homes for the aged and inhabitants.
That day, fruits were supplied in different parts of the municipalities. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Remembered in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- Memorial meetings took place in Myanmar, Germany, Switzerland and Mexico on the occasion of the 31st anniversary of demise of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by personages of political and social circles and masses in those countries.
A member of the Central Executive Committee of the Myanmar Journalist Association said that PresidentKim Il Sungextended unsparing support and encouragement to the peoples of many countries in their national liberation struggle in colonial countries and the building of a new society, holding aloft the banner of independence and international justice all his life.
The august name of the peerlessly great man shines long along with socialist Korea dynamically advancing along the road selected by it without wavering even under the complicated international political situation, he stressed.
The chairperson of the Switzerland-Korea Committee praised the President as an outstanding state leader, world elder statesman, great master of independent politics, invincible and iron-willed brilliant commander and peerless sage as he performed the great feats that no prominent one in the world can match.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico praised the President for making a great contribution to the country and its people, the times and history.
Personages of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany, the Group of the Study of Korean Culture, the German Executive Committee of the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK and other organizations praised the President for founding the Juche idea and thoroughly applying it to the revolution and construction.
A message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the memorial meeting held in Switzerland. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Unsan County of North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built for the working people of the Sangwon Farm in Unsan County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
Modern dwelling houses, built in a cozy way to suit the characteristics of the region and in harmony with landscaping, are  associated with the efforts of the officials and builders of Unsan County who devote their loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm to upholding the noble intention of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to provide the agricultural workers with civilized living conditions and environment.
A ceremony of moving into dwelling houses took place on the spot on July 10.
Present there were Kim Chol Sam, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials of the Party and power organs in Unsan County and builders and farmers, who will move into the houses.
Choe Yong Man, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory speech and licenses for the use of dwelling houses were conveyed to be followed by speeches.
People began to move into the new houses amid the congratulatory performance and cheerful dances.
Officials visited the families of agricultural workers to share impressions of moving into new houses and encouraged them to greet the Ninth Congress of the Party with proud successes of increased grain production. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Om Ok Nam, a woman living in the Neighborhood Unit No. 31 of Nammun-dong No. 1 in Songchongang District, Hamhung City, South Hamgyong Province, on her 100th birthday.
She extended her gratitude toKim Jong Un, being excited with a joy of receiving a birthday spread of love as an ordinary old woman who had not done a great thing for the country.
She is enjoying her remaining days in good health under the socialist policy for promoting the people's health and wellbeing.
Officials and villagers in Songchongang District shared joy, congratulating her family on its auspicious event. -0-

headline: Russian Foreign Minister Visits DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, arrived at Wonsan Kalma Airport on Friday night to visit the DPRK at the invitation of the DPRK Foreign Ministry.
The Russian foreign minister and his party were greeted at the airport by Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the DPRK, officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and members of his embassy.
During the visit, the talks will be held between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia. -0-

headline: Great Man's Love for Children
story_text:
One day in January 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited Pyongyang Teachers Training College and looked round its different places.
When he dropped in at the mother classroom, an official of the college explained in detail to him that students learn how to use all household goods in the education of children, how to educate orphans and how to give them parental affection at the classroom according to the extracurricular educational teaching program.
Kim Jong Unsaid with pleasure that the students learn how to combine school education with home training at the classroom in a simulated family environment, adding that it is a necessary education.
He stressed the need for the college to positively teach students such education as there are persons to be assigned teachers of Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans among the graduates of the college.
Educators deeply cherished his instructions as the earnest request of their benevolent teacher who wants them to train all the children throughout the country to be pillars possessed of high ability and fine traits. -0-

headline: Successes Witnessed in Pyongyang Railway Bureau
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Railway Bureau in the DPRK is organizing and directing transport in a mobile way, taking operational and technical measures to improve the traffic capacity of trains.
The Sariwon and Sunchon sleeper production companies are producing and supplying sleepers in time, thus contributing to speeding up the replacing of all existing wooden sleepers with concrete ones.
The Sunchon and Haeju trackmen's teams are pushing ahead with the replacement of sleepers to enhance the intensity of railways. The Sinsongchon railway structure repairing team and other units are repairing and reinforcing tunnels, railway bridges and retaining walls to improve the safety of train operation.
The West Pyongyang, Sinsongchon and Pukchang service brigades of engine are carrying more freight than planned by concentrating efforts on increasing the actual operation rate of locomotives and reducing the turnaround time of freight wagons.
The Pyongyang Marshalling Yard Passenger and Freight Car Corps, the Sunchon and Pukchang passenger and freight car corps are making a contribution to the normal operation of trains by meticulously repairing and maintaining the wagons of intensive transport trains.
The workers of the Sunchon, Pukchang and Haeju railway branch bureaus are increasing the transport through the May 18 non-breakdown, on-schedule operation and extra-traction movement. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Remembered by Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- The General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) held a memorial service for PresidentKim Il Sungon July 8, the 31st anniversary of his demise.
Officials of the GAKC, including a vice-chairperson of the GAKC and the chairman of the Jilin Regional Association, laid flower baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City branch of the Jilin Regional Association of the GAKC and the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and made a bow before the statue ofKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China.
Flower baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Zhongnan Regional Association and the Liaoning Regional Association under the GAKC were laid before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and DPRK missions in Shenyang and Dandong.
A study of the film dealing with the immortal revolutionary exploits ofKim Il Sungand the report on the revolutionary activities of the respected ComradeKim Jong Untook place at the conference hall of the GAKC in Shenyang City, China.
Present there were officials of the headquarters of the GAKC and members of the Shenyang City branch of the Liaoning Regional Association.
Choe Un Bok, chairwoman of the GAKC, made a speech.
She said that there are many countries and leaders in the world but no one has performed world historic exploits before the times, revolution, history and mankind as the President did, and praised the President as the benevolent father and great sage of the revolution boundlessly revered by all people.
She called upon the Koreans in China to turn out as one in the patriotic work for the prosperity of the motherland, full of the great pride and honor of being the people of a powerful nation, bearing in mind the iron faith that the DPRK is unshakable as long as it is led byKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Emulation Drive for Increased Production Brisk in Field of Metal Industry
Press Statement by Chief of Policy Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Policy Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Sunday issued the following press statement titled "The U.S.-Japan-ROK military nexus threatening regional peace should be closely watched and deterred":
Recently, the U.S.-Japan-ROK's military cooperation and joint military actions have been conducted periodically with more threatening nature. They are the main danger factors heightening the level of the military tension on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity.
On July 11, the U.S., Japan and the ROK waged a provocative tripartite joint air drill by mobilizing various kinds of combat bombers including the strategic bomber "B-52H" in the sky over the Korean peninsula and its vicinity. On the same day, they held a meeting of the chairpersons of the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint chiefs of staff to openly reveal their attempt to further accelerate the tripartite military cooperation targeting the DPRK and other regional countries.
We express serious concern over their hostile acts of persistently conducting provocative and threatening military actions while deliberately ignoring the security concern of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and strongly warn of the grave consequences to be entailed by them on the regional situation.
This year the U.S. is continuously posing a danger to the security environment of our state while renewing the records in the number of deploying strategic strike means on the Korean peninsula and drastically increasing the frequency and scale of joint military drills with its satellite countries.
The U.S. strategic bombers, stealth fighters and various air reconnaissance assets are being massively deployed at U.S. military bases in Japan and the ROK and the U.S. secretary of Defense, the secretary of Navy, the transportation commander and other military officials appeared in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula to fan up confrontation hysteria. The U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation is getting more offensive.
The serious development in which the military alliances between the U.S. and Japan and between the U.S. and the ROK have completely changed into a nuclear-based triangular military alliance and the tripartite military cooperation is being promoted in all spheres heralds the fact that the long-running instability and tension on the Korean peninsula can lead to an unpredictable phase of military confrontation at any moment.
Irresponsible acts of the U.S., Japan and the ROK steadily heightening the level of tension and danger on the Korean peninsula should be closely watched and deterred.
We clearly recognize that the attainment of the reliable and overwhelming military capability is the most realistic way to deter the practical application of the doctrine of "peace through strength" pursued by the U.S. and neutralize the joint military action plan of the U.S., Japan and the ROK.
It is our just sovereign right to take countermeasures against provocative military actions such as the moves to strengthen the multilateral military alliance threatening the security of the region and the joint military drills with clear aggressive character.
Our armed forces are in constant military preparedness to check the collective provocations by the U.S. and its vassal forces, deter their aggressive attempt and effectively cope with war acts.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea will more clearly express its invariable stand that it will never tolerate any slightest act which exerts a negative influence on the security environment of the state with its practical military counteraction and continue to take responsible measures to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Russian Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met on July 12 Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, who visited the DPRK to take part in the second strategic dialogue between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia.
Present there were Andrei Rudenko, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation, and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Ungladly received Lavrov and had a talk with him in an atmosphere full of warm comradely trust.
At the talk, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov courteously conveyed the warm greetings of Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin to ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for it and conveyed his friendly greetings to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
The talk widely exchanged the opinions of the leaderships of the two countries on a series of important matters for faithfully implementing the agreements made at the historic DPRK-Russia summit talks in June 2024, demonstrating the invincibility and vitality of the future-oriented DPRK-Russia relations in the new era and defending the common core interests by further developing the comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia, on the items of mutual cooperation in different fields and on the international and regional situations. And it confirmed the consensus of stands.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the two countries share the same views on all strategic issues in conformity with the level of alliance, adding that it shows the high strategic level established between the two countries.
Kim Jong Unlistened to the satisfactory result of the second strategic dialogue between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia and expressed conviction that the coordinated and harmonious diplomatic stands of the two countries to take initiative and proactive attitude towards the radically changing international geopolitical situation would make a positive contribution to ensuring peace and security in the region and the rest of the world.
Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov expressed his impressions of the strategic communication between the diplomatic fields of the DPRK and Russia which had been held and expressed the stand to further strengthen the strategic and tactical cooperation and intensify concerted action between the Russian Federation and the DPRK in the international arena.
Kim Jong Unreaffirmed that the DPRK is ready to unconditionally support and encourage all the measures taken by the Russian leadership as regards the tackling of the root cause of the Ukrainian crisis in keeping with the spirit of the inter-state treaty between the DPRK and Russia in the future, too.
Clearly expressed at the talks were the will of the leaderships of the two countries to closely support and cooperate with each other in the journey for thoroughly safeguarding the core interests of the two countries, powerfully promoting the overall development of bilateral ties and guaranteeing endless wellbeing of the peoples and their bright future in disregard of any change in situation in conformity with the spirit of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
Expressing firm belief that the Russian army and people would surely win victory in accomplishing the sacred cause of defending the dignity and basic interests of the country and achieving the prosperity of the Russian Federation under the outstanding leadership of President Putin,Kim Jong Unsincerely hoped that victory and glory would always be in store for the great Russia. -0-

headline: Press Statement on Second Strategic Dialogue between DPRK and Russian Foreign Ministers Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) -- A press statement on the second strategic dialogue between the foreign ministers of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation was issued on July 12.
The press statement says:
The second strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergei Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, took place in Wonsan on July 12 at a time when the bilateral relations are developing into the comprehensive and forward-looking invincible alliance under the strategic guidance of the heads of states of the two countries.
The strategic dialogue between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministers discussed in depth the immediate practical issues arising in accelerating the dynamic development of the DPRK-Russia relations in line with the plan and intention of the heads of states. It reaffirmed the firm will to faithfully implement the spirit and overall articles of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries and thus turn the long-standing DPRK-Russia relations with tradition into the eternal strategic relations.
Both sides expressed once again the stand to further intensify the strategic communication and cooperation for defending the state sovereignty, territorial integrity and international justice while boosting mutual cooperation in the international arenas.
The Russian side resolutely opposed any attempt to deny the present position of the DPRK as regards the situation on the Korean peninsula and expressed its firm support for the DPRK side in its just efforts for defending the security of the state and the sovereign right.
The DPRK side expressed full sympathy and support for all the measures taken by the Russian government to remove the root cause of the Ukrainian conflict and defend its national sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity.
The exchange of views on major international issues confirmed that the judgments of the two sides on the present complicated international situation are unanimous and agreed to coordinate the common stand while further heightening vigilance against the hostile forces' hegemony-oriented moves for aggression getting more undisguised worldwide and boosting strategic communication.
The DPRK and Russian foreign ministers agreed to continue exchange of views between the foreign policy organs of the two countries, including ministerial strategic dialogue.
The 2026-2027 exchange plan was signed between the DPRK Foreign Ministry and the Russian Foreign Ministry after the strategic dialogue.
The second strategic dialogue between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministers serves as a significant occasion in expanding and developing the bilateral relations in an all-round way and strengthening the strategic and tactical cooperation and support and solidarity between the two countries in line with the new inter-state treaty. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Chief of Policy Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Policy Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Sunday issued the following press statement titled "The U.S.-Japan-ROK military nexus threatening regional peace should be closely watched and deterred":
Recently, the U.S.-Japan-ROK's military cooperation and joint military actions have been conducted periodically with more threatening nature. They are the main danger factors heightening the level of the military tension on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity.
On July 11, the U.S., Japan and the ROK waged a provocative tripartite joint air drill by mobilizing various kinds of combat bombers including the strategic bomber "B-52H" in the sky over the Korean peninsula and its vicinity. On the same day, they held a meeting of the chairpersons of the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint chiefs of staff to openly reveal their attempt to further accelerate the tripartite military cooperation targeting the DPRK and other regional countries.
We express serious concern over their hostile acts of persistently conducting provocative and threatening military actions while deliberately ignoring the security concern of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and strongly warn of the grave consequences to be entailed by them on the regional situation.
This year the U.S. is continuously posing a danger to the security environment of our state while renewing the records in the number of deploying strategic strike means on the Korean peninsula and drastically increasing the frequency and scale of joint military drills with its satellite countries.
The U.S. strategic bombers, stealth fighters and various air reconnaissance assets are being massively deployed at U.S. military bases in Japan and the ROK and the U.S. secretary of Defense, the secretary of Navy, the transportation commander and other military officials appeared in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula to fan up confrontation hysteria. The U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation is getting more offensive.
The serious development in which the military alliances between the U.S. and Japan and between the U.S. and the ROK have completely changed into a nuclear-based triangular military alliance and the tripartite military cooperation is being promoted in all spheres heralds the fact that the long-running instability and tension on the Korean peninsula can lead to an unpredictable phase of military confrontation at any moment.
Irresponsible acts of the U.S., Japan and the ROK steadily heightening the level of tension and danger on the Korean peninsula should be closely watched and deterred.
We clearly recognize that the attainment of the reliable and overwhelming military capability is the most realistic way to deter the practical application of the doctrine of "peace through strength" pursued by the U.S. and neutralize the joint military action plan of the U.S., Japan and the ROK.
It is our just sovereign right to take countermeasures against provocative military actions such as the moves to strengthen the multilateral military alliance threatening the security of the region and the joint military drills with clear aggressive character.
Our armed forces are in constant military preparedness to check the collective provocations by the U.S. and its vassal forces, deter their aggressive attempt and effectively cope with war acts.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea will more clearly express its invariable stand that it will never tolerate any slightest act which exerts a negative influence on the security environment of the state with its practical military counteraction and continue to take responsible measures to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state. -0-

Korean War Famous for Deposition of "Renowned Generals" of U.S.
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) -- The Korean war in the 1950s became famous that many "renowned generals" of the U.S. were deposed.
The U.S. imperialists, who ignited the Korean war and run amuck to swallow the DPRK in a short time, mobilized all the distinguished U.S. military generals when they suffered defeat after defeat from the beginning of the war.
In order to set back the unfavourable situation of war, the U.S. imperialists threw the U.S. 24th Infantry Division called the "undefeated division" into the war.
Divisional Commander Dean, who boasted of his rich war experience and asserted that he did not know defeat, was doomed to ruin in the Korean war.
His division was annihilated and he in soldier's uniform was captured by a soldier of the People's Army on a way of escape and thus threw the prestige of the United States into the mud.
The fate of Walker, the U.S. Eighth Army commander, was more miserable.
Walker, who was getting hell-bent on the massacre, was ambushed by the People's Army and died.
As the war was prolonged, US imperialists' murderous generals were dismissed in succession.
The war situation became more unfavourable to the U.S. when the "general Christmas offensive" was failed completely at the end of 1950.
In the United States, a great chaos broke out, the work to inquire into responsibility for defeat began. Therefore the fate of MacArthur was like a fish out of water.
Ridgway and Clark, who became commanders of the "UN Forces" in succession to MacArthur, were branded as defeated generals in the Korean war, and Van Fleet, who had been newly appointed as commander of the U.S. Eighth Army, was dismissed as an "incapable commander."
In the end, even the enemy gave a cry that there was no generals to dispatch the Korean war. -0-

headline: Revised Height of Tower of Juche Idea
story_text:
One day in July 1980, ChairmanKim Jong Il, who initiated the construction of the Tower of the Juche Idea, came toKim Il SungSquare to decide on the position and height of the tower on the spot.
A balloon was floating in the sky above the construction site of the tower, which was seen in the square. The height of the balloon was just the same as the actual height of the tower.
Looking at the construction site for a long time, the Chairman said that it would be necessary to extend the height of the tower body to the top of the torch and put the torch on it.
Officials showed their surprise.
Originally, the height of the tower was planned to be 70 meters and it was increased to 150 meters, true to the intention of the Chairman.
The Chairman made a guess of the height of the balloon from the platform of the square again and said that the tower could be well-balanced if the height of the tower body is prolonged by 20 meters.
He climbed the steep stairs of the Grand People's Study House under construction to reach the observatory on it, looked all around the balloon and gave a final conclusion on fixing the height of the tower at 170 meters.
Therefore, the Tower of the Juche Idea could be built on the bank of the River Taedong in the capital city of Pyongyang as the world's largest stone tower. -0-

It reaffirmed the firm will to faithfully implement the spirit and overall articles of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries and thus turn the long-standing DPRK-Russia relations with tradition into the eternal strategic relations.
Both sides expressed once again the stand to further intensify the strategic communication and cooperation for defending the state sovereignty, territorial integrity and international justice while boosting mutual cooperation in the international arenas.
The Russian side resolutely opposed any attempt to deny the present position of the DPRK as regards the situation on the Korean peninsula and expressed its firm support for the DPRK side in its just efforts for defending the security of the state and the sovereign right.
The DPRK side expressed full sympathy and support for all the measures taken by the Russian government to remove the root cause of the Ukrainian conflict and defend its national sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity.
The exchange of views on major international issues confirmed that the judgments of the two sides on the present complicated international situation are unanimous and agreed to coordinate the common stand while further heightening vigilance against the hostile forces' hegemony-oriented moves for aggression getting more undisguised worldwide and boosting strategic communication.
The DPRK and Russian foreign ministers agreed to continue exchange of views between the foreign policy organs of the two countries, including ministerial strategic dialogue.
The 2026-2027 exchange plan was signed between the DPRK Foreign Ministry and the Russian Foreign Ministry after the strategic dialogue.
The second strategic dialogue between the DPRK and Russian foreign ministers serves as a significant occasion in expanding and developing the bilateral relations in an all-round way and strengthening the strategic and tactical cooperation and support and solidarity between the two countries in line with the new inter-state treaty. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Chief of Policy Office of DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 13 (KCNA) -- The chief of the Policy Office of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Sunday issued the following press statement titled "The U.S.-Japan-ROK military nexus threatening regional peace should be closely watched and deterred":
Recently, the U.S.-Japan-ROK's military cooperation and joint military actions have been conducted periodically with more threatening nature. They are the main danger factors heightening the level of the military tension on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity.
On July 11, the U.S., Japan and the ROK waged a provocative tripartite joint air drill by mobilizing various kinds of combat bombers including the strategic bomber "B-52H" in the sky over the Korean peninsula and its vicinity. On the same day, they held a meeting of the chairpersons of the U.S.-Japan-ROK joint chiefs of staff to openly reveal their attempt to further accelerate the tripartite military cooperation targeting the DPRK and other regional countries.
We express serious concern over their hostile acts of persistently conducting provocative and threatening military actions while deliberately ignoring the security concern of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and strongly warn of the grave consequences to be entailed by them on the regional situation.
This year the U.S. is continuously posing a danger to the security environment of our state while renewing the records in the number of deploying strategic strike means on the Korean peninsula and drastically increasing the frequency and scale of joint military drills with its satellite countries.
The U.S. strategic bombers, stealth fighters and various air reconnaissance assets are being massively deployed at U.S. military bases in Japan and the ROK and the U.S. secretary of Defense, the secretary of Navy, the transportation commander and other military officials appeared in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula to fan up confrontation hysteria. The U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation is getting more offensive.
The serious development in which the military alliances between the U.S. and Japan and between the U.S. and the ROK have completely changed into a nuclear-based triangular military alliance and the tripartite military cooperation is being promoted in all spheres heralds the fact that the long-running instability and tension on the Korean peninsula can lead to an unpredictable phase of military confrontation at any moment.
Irresponsible acts of the U.S., Japan and the ROK steadily heightening the level of tension and danger on the Korean peninsula should be closely watched and deterred.
We clearly recognize that the attainment of the reliable and overwhelming military capability is the most realistic way to deter the practical application of the doctrine of "peace through strength" pursued by the U.S. and neutralize the joint military action plan of the U.S., Japan and the ROK.
It is our just sovereign right to take countermeasures against provocative military actions such as the moves to strengthen the multilateral military alliance threatening the security of the region and the joint military drills with clear aggressive character.
Our armed forces are in constant military preparedness to check the collective provocations by the U.S. and its vassal forces, deter their aggressive attempt and effectively cope with war acts.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea will more clearly express its invariable stand that it will never tolerate any slightest act which exerts a negative influence on the security environment of the state with its practical military counteraction and continue to take responsible measures to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state. -0-

headline: Kyongsang Kindergarten
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 14 (KCNA) -- Kyongsang Kindergarten in Central District of Pyongyang Municipality is a well-known early art education base for training music prodigies.
The kindergarten is associated with the warm love of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho devotes his all to the children with his noble outlook on the rising generations.
One day in July 2012, he visited the kindergarten. Looking round the sports equipment installed in the kindergarten yard, the room dedicated to the history of the kindergarten, general playroom, wading pool and dining hall, he appreciated that they were wonderfully arranged.
Saying that the reason why he visited the kindergarten again is because the intellectual development of preschool children is important, he gave precious instructions for the education and management of the kindergarten.
True to his noble intention, the officials and teachers of the kindergarten have exerted themselves to turn it into a model one throughout the country and a comprehensive early art education base.
The kindergarten has turned all education rooms into multi-purpose ones and put the teaching on a modernized basis of high level. It is systematically training children with excellent talents.
The children of the kindergarten have demonstrated the advantages of socialist educational system of Korean style by startling the world's musical circle with excellent artistic skill in the international stages.
In particular, they participated in the 33rd international festival of child and juvenile art works held in Khabarovsk of Russia in 2024, causing a great sensation.
Now, the kindergarten shines as the cradle of happiness for the talented children and early art education base with bright future under the warm care of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Construction Site of Ragwon County Offshore Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 14 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm on July 13.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Jae Ryong and other major leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He was greeted on the spot by the commanding officers of the units of the Korean People's Army involved in the construction and officials of design institutions.
The construction of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm has been powerfully pushed forward and entered the final stage thanks to the plan for the regional development policy and direct guidance of the WPK to radically develop the offshore farming which conforms to the natural and geographical characteristics of the DPRK and proved its profitability and prospect and thus expand and strengthen the economic independence of coastal cities and counties in a sustained way.
Kim Jong Unheard the detailed progress made in the construction.
He highly appreciated the efforts of the soldier-builders who are spending the days and months of feats through successive offensive, devoting their all to the worthwhile struggle for bringing about the future changes in every coastal city and county, true to the decisions of the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK.
He made rounds of the construction site of the offshore farm.
He said that many things have changed beyond recognition in just a few months since the construction of the farm started in February, adding that the current practical changes, not words and letters, fully and visually show the grand plan, steadfast will and executive ability of our Party to powerfully promote the regional development.
Saying that the construction of modern offshore farm directly planned and pushed forward by the Party Central Committee is an innovative creation field to reliably guarantee the efficient rejuvenation and long-term development of more than 60 coastal cities and counties across the country, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the important construction work to give a fresh impetus to the realization of the regional development policy which is growing stronger day by day is being perfectly pushed forward.
He appreciated that the construction of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm has been pushed forward at a high level in good harmony with the environment of the coastal area, while further applying modernity, advanced character and originality, not confining itself to following the past experience.
He said that the construction of the offshore farm is a strategic creation work for fundamentally strengthening and developing the material foundation for regional economy and improvement of the people's living standards on the basis of the specific environment and economic potentials of relevant areas and thus it is necessary to exactly and substantially organize all the work from a long-term and scientific point of view. He stressed that it is necessary to rationally define the grade of the construction of the offshore farm on the basis of scientific research and analysis of the population, economic foundation and marine and ecological environment of the relevant region as well as other projects for the regional development policy and push ahead with it in a sustained way.
In order to effectively conduct the intermediate- and long-range work of developing and expanding the regional economies across the country on a new basis, it is necessary to give precedence to working out the annual plan for the construction of city and county offshore farms at the stage of the future struggle, he said, indicating the important orientation for it.
Underscoring the need to build the offshore farm as another stage of revolutionary development in the design of industrial facilities, he set forth the tasks and principles arising in massively building offshore farms on a nationwide scale, including the issue of attaching more importance to economic profitability and effectiveness in conformity with the rapid development of construction, the issue of increasing the proportion of afforestation in the sections of dwelling houses in rural areas and the issue of applying the most rational and optimized plan in the construction of coastal structures including breakwater.
He went round with pleasure the dwelling houses successfully built in the fishing village area.
He said that a new phase of development was opened up in the construction of dwelling houses suited to the characteristics of the coastal region, the modernity of the regional environment was improved and the seaside of paradise and the Korean style fishing village of bliss were born. He said with pleasure that our Party's desire to present the most beautiful fishing village in the world to the people of Ragwon County on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK is to be realized.
Noting that the fishing village in Ragwonpho is a proud visual entity of the new phase of development of regional rural culture and our architectural art which is undergoing a complete change racing against time, he stressed that it is the firm determination of our Party to turn all coastal areas across the country into seaside of paradise which is shining with new civilization and new wellbeing enjoyed by the people.
Saying that the Party's policy on construction is a policy of constantly aspiring after the new and development and there should be no absolute model or standard in its establishment and implementation, he stressed that in order to make our construction work pioneer the future both in name and reality, it is necessary to increase the already accumulated potential for construction and, at the same time, actively aspire after the advanced ones and wage a ceaseless struggle.
He said that the successes being made in the construction of the modern marine industrial base and Korean-style modern fishing village are another miracle that can be made only by our soldier-builders boundlessly loyal to the cause of the Party and a powerful proof of the validity and might of our Party's policy which sets radical changes and steady development in the regional areas as the most important task and carries them out vigorously.
He expressed expectation and belief that the soldier-builders would perfectly unfold in Ragwonpho until the founding anniversary of the WPK a peculiar creation to guarantee the wellbeing of the regional people forever and a socialist paradise to be proud of and thus translate the plan of the Party Central Committee into a brilliant reality by redoubling their high militant enthusiasm and bold redoubled efforts.
Receiving the militant encouragement and great trust ofKim Jong Un, all the builders took an oath of loyalty to surely set in time a valuable creative example in implementing the Party's policy on regional development which can be generalized and applied to other parts of the country by making more courageous efforts with the honor of the army of the DPRK which is absolutely faithful to the order and instructions of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Kaesong Municipality of DPRK Releases Lots of Fry
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 15 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Municipality in the DPRK is strengthening the material and technical foundations of fish farming.
The municipality is directing efforts to solving the feed problem of herbivorous fish while increasing the production of protein feed by breeding mud snails in conformity with the scientific and technological demand.
Fish-breeding units in the municipality are increasing the hatching rate by using advanced artificial insemination methods.
The Kaesong Municipal Breed-fish Station has secured feed rich in protein content and produced and supplied puffed feed while growing breed-fish by introducing advanced fish farming technology.
The station lowered the feed cost with three-dimensional fish farming method while providing favorable conditions for the growth of fry. This year it released millions of young fish and fry including carp, crucian carp and other fish into rivers and lakes.

headline: Trust Given by President Kim Il Sung to Workers
story_text:
It was one day in October 1953.
While giving field guidance to South Hamgyong Province, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Hungnam Fertilizer Factory again.
Officials and workers of the factory did not know the reason why the President called at the factory again because he had already visited it a few days ago and taught in detail the orientation and ways for its reconstruction.
The President said that he visited the factory again as he had something to entrust to its workers before leaving the province. He earnestly said that it is an urgent issue to rehabilitate the factory and that farming could not be well done as fertilizers were not supplied to the countryside during the war, adding that when he visited the countryside this time, farmers were eagerly demanding for fertilizers.
When he looked round various rural villages in the province for several days, he heard the unanimous voices of farmers demanding fertilizers.
Looking at the workers of the fertilizer factory with trust, the President said in an earnest tone that he told the farmers that they would be supplied with fertilizers after two years, adding that he said so because he believed in the workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Factory.
True to the trust of the President, the workers of the factory finished the reconstruction and produced and sent a lot of fertilizers to the countryside after two years. -0-

headline: Crumbled "Honor" of "Undefeated Division" of U.S.
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 16 (KCNA) -- At the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in the DPRK, there is a wax replica of an aggressor giving pleasure of victors to the visitors.
The aggressor standing in front of the graves of his soldiers with fear and disconsolate look is Commander of the First Division of the U.S. Marines Smith who left a bad name of grave general in the Korean war (June 1950-July 1953).
Smith was said to have rendered "distinguished military services" in succession in the world wars, but his figure of lonely standing in front of the graves, keeping company with the crow crying on the tree that was broken by bullets and shells, is jeered by the visitors.
The Smith's First Division of the U.S. Marines was a notorious killer unit boasting of the division's "tradition" of the "distinguished military services", setting a record high in the history of commendation in the U.S. imperialist aggression army.
Leading this "undefeated division", Smith arrived on the bank of Lake Jangjin in November 1950 to "successfully" carry out MacArthur's order of "General Christmas Offensive" and to demonstrate the unit's "honor" and his name to the world.
The enemies in full tide of passion even paved the runway to return to their hometowns by planes in the future, singing the triumphant war song before the beginning of the battle.
But they knew too little about their opponent.
The brave Korean People's Army staged bizarre assaults and ambush, dividing the enemy's group into several pieces and delivering wholesale death to them.
120 of 170 soldiers in the 2nd company of the fifth regiment of the division were killed on the bank of Lake Jangjin and enemies of the other companies, too, died in vain.
The "undefeated division" completely lost its combat capability by causing many corpses and the wounded in the battle on the bank of Lake Jangjin.
Even American journalists who came to the spot to report the results of the battle reported on the gruesome scene of the division, mockingly saying that it is the "retreat for the first time in the history of the Marines."
A journalist carried an article in a newspaper saying that their clothes were ragged, their faces were swollen with cold wind and drawn blood, and that there were some soldiers who walked with bare feet because their feet were swollen with frostbite.
The "honor" of the "undefeated division" which had styled itself "victor" wherever it set foot on as a shock brigade for aggression and plunder was crumbled in the Korean war.
This was just the disgrace of the United States. -0-

headline: Seminars on Immortal Exploits of President Kim Il Sung Held in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- Seminars on the immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungtook place in Cambodia, Belarus, Austria, France, Serbia, Algeria and Brazil from July 4 to 8 on the occasion of the 31st anniversary of his demise.

A vice-chairperson of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia and the chief of the Belarusian Group for Solidarity with the DPRK highly praised the President as the outstanding state leader in the 20th century, invincible and iron-willed  commander and the greatest man who made great contributions to the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence.
The chief and members of the Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria said that PresidentKim Il Sungled the DPRK to victory and glory with his rare idea and theory and gigantic revolutionary practice, adding that the DPRK people could be liberated from the colonial rule of  Japanese imperialism and defend the sovereignty and independence of the country from the U.S. imperialists' aggression as they were led by him.
Personages of the New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea in the seminar praised the President for achieving the historic cause of national liberation through the bloody anti-Japanese war and creating the myth of war victory unprecedented in the world history of wars, the military miracle in the 20th century, by shattering the myth of the U.S. imperialists' "mightiness".
Saying that PresidentKim Il Sungis a great revolutionary boundlessly revered by the progressive mankind and a prominent leader of the world socialist movement, a member of the National Political Committee of the Brazilian Communist Party praised the President for devoting his all to the victorious advance of the socialist cause and the cause of independence against imperialism under the uplifted banner of independence and international justice all his life. -0-
