headline: Measures for Preventing Damage from Heavy Rain and Flood in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- Measures are taken for preventing the damage from heavy rain and flood at the housing construction site in the Komdok area of the DPRK.
The General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry and the construction command team worked out the plans for continuously pushing forward with the projects in the rainy season, have completed to build retaining walls of at least 50 000 square meters, dredge over 100 000 cubic meters of riverbeds and reinforce over 150 000 cubic meters of embankments, and repaired railways and roads and removed defective places.
The builders of the Komdok Mining Complex, the Taehung Youth Hero Mine, the Ryongyang Mine and the Ryongchon Mine built retaining walls between Taehung-dong No. 1 and Ryongchon-dong.
All the construction units have lunched the work for ensuring the safety of roads and removing defective sections of railways.
They spread gravels on the road between Tongam-dong and Muhak-dong and packed them and installed water pipes and culverts as required by the technical regulations.
And they built retaining walls and dug ditches in the dangerous places between Paekgumsan Railway Station and Taehung Railway Station and sent lots of railway fixtures and metals to a relevant unit.
Lorry divers transported thousands of cubic meters of freights every day and the residents in the Komdok area turned out in a campaign for improving rivers and repairing roads. -0-

headline: Uninterrupted Supplying of Dairy Products
story_text:
One day in September 2022, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmet senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwas deeply concerned about the supply of dairy products to the children of the nurseries and kindergartens.
At that time, the dairy products were not supplied to the children as the nurseries and kindergartens were closed due to the emergency anti-epidemic measure.
Kim Jong Untold officials that if nurseries and kindergartens were closed in the emergency anti-epidemic period, a system for supplying the dairy products by coupons should have been established.
Then he noted that the Party's new childcare policy is to promote the growth of the children and bring about a better future of the country, adding that the Party said that dairy products should be supplied to the children all the year round and that the Party's childcare policy should be correctly implemented.
Thanks to his ardent love, tasty and nutritious dairy products could be supplied to the children without missing day. -0-

headline: Research Achievements in Sericulture
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, teachers and researchers of Nampho University of Agriculture in the DPRK have newly studied and completed a comprehensive method of using brine effective in increasing the production of sericulture.
They have studied and developed technical products for increasing the yielding ability of mulberry leaves and cocoons by using brine and established the scientific methods for applying brine, thus providing another technological guarantee for the development of sericulture.
The above-said comprehensive method has been introduced to several sericulture production units across the country and proved effective in increasing the yielding ability of mulberry leaves and cocoons.
The developers won a national sci-tech achievements introduction certificate.  -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Reckless Moves
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- Japan, obsessed with militarist fever, is more frantically resorting to the moves to sharpen the sword of reinvasion in collusion with outside forces.
The Japan minister of Defense recently held a confab with the defense ministers of Britain and Italy and agreed to accelerate the joint development of the next generation fighters.
Japan, which had already embarked on its own fighter development with Mitsubishi heavy industry and other evil war criminal enterprises as the main axis, allured Britain and Italy into the "joint development" from December 2022, and shamelessly dubbed it an "international combat aviation plan".
Japan established an "international organization" as the headquarters tower of "joint development" at the end of last year and appointed a former official of the Ministry of Defense as its first chief. It formally set up a joint venture for designing fighters in June this year and is running amuck to hasten even its deployment.
The next generation fighter Japan is going to develop and deploy is known to be superior to the U.S. F-35 Stealth fighters and is a multi-mission fighter capable of attacking ground, naval and air targets.
It is clear to everyone that possession of such an attack fighter is not for "defense" as it goes far beyond the scope of defense.
The war criminal state, which had to make deep bows, talking about the abandonment of the right to belligerency and the non-possession of combat capability, while dropping the "crocodile's tears" before the international community for imposing huge misfortune and pains on mankind in the last century, is now getting hell-bent on possessing ultra-modern military hardware for preemptive attack. This is a violation of not only its constitution but also international law and a frontal challenge to mankind.
What matters is that Japan's moves for modernizing its armed forces under the signboard of international "research and development" are aimed at realizing the revival of the old imperial era by restoring the past "war alliance".
Frequently witnessed are the Japan's moves of strengthening military nexus with members of NATO, which has turned into the world's biggest war alliance and the worst confrontation group in history, that are at the same time the old "sworn friends" which had been involved in the "world division" after establishing the "blood alliance" in the last century.
Japan practically concluded with Britain and Italy the "agreement on mutual supply of goods and manpower" on mutually offering the necessary food, fuel, ammunition and other goods and manpower for their transport to the relevant countries in case of joint military drills and contingency.
And it concluded with Britain the "reciprocal access agreement" which makes it easy to mutually dispatch armed forces and conduct joint drills, defined the relations between the two countries as the "semi-alliance" in defense cooperation ranking next to the one with the U.S. and is staging joint drills under various names.
In this regard, Abe said that at the time when he was in office as prime minister he and then British Prime Minister Johnson shared recognition on the importance of expanding the allies and that they reached a consensus of views on bringing Japan and the U.K. into closer relationship as the "Japan-U.K. alliance" in the period of World War I. This fully reveals the sinister purpose of the descendants of the samurais.
It is a cunning trick of Japan to rally its allies with the "reciprocal access agreement" and the "agreement on mutual supply of goods and manpower" and thus launch reinvasion at any cost and regain the position of the old colonial suzerain state.
After all, Japan's pursuing of fighter development is not merely aimed at modernizing its military hardware but at expanding the military bloc to create an environment favorable for carrying out the war of aggression in the future.
It is a foolish dream to think that the sinister militarist nature of aggression and war can be covered up by the mask of "defense" or "joint research".
If Japan persists in military cooperation with the "groups" of the old era, obsessed with the ambition of the "Leader of the East" and without proper recognition of the trend of the times, it will face only self-destruction. -0-

headline: New Data Displayed at Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- Lots of historic data, wartime relics and photos have been newly found and displayed at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in recent years.
Among those newly displayed are photos of PresidentKim Il Sung's work "On Measures for Combating the Enemy's Bacteriological Weapons" (speech made at the Enlarged Meeting of the Military Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, February 20, 1952) and book "By wisely leading the struggle to smash the bacteriological war of the U.S. imperialists", major slogans set forth by the President in the days of the Fatherland Liberation War and visual aids on major patriotic movements conducted by people behind the front.
Newly displayed at the hall of the DPRK heroes of the museum are photos of heroes of the Republic who performed distinguished feats for the country and revolution and the data of their feats.
Certificates of Distinguished Military Service Medal bearing the august name of PresidentKim Il Sungthat service personnel kept in their hearts in the days of war and their descendants have treasured as heirlooms for dozens of years, graduation diplomas given by military education institutions at all levels, Orders of Soldier's Honor, vengeance-taking book, the national flags of the Republic fluttered at heights of battle and other relics were newly exhibited.
Bereaved families of wartime brave soldiers honoured with the title of the DPRK Hero sent to the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum medals of DPRK Hero, certificates of heroes and certificates of participation in the national conference of combat heroes.
Also displayed were a letter written by an officer of the People's Army to his home before crossing the Rakdong River, letters to soldiers on heights of battle from people behind the front and other data.
Flags of model companies of the 7th Company of the 3rd Battalion under the 53rd Regiment of the 7th Infantry Division and the 9th Company of the 3rd Battalion under the 7th Regiment of the 3rd Infantry Division were displayed.
Lots of trophies captured from the U.S. imperialist aggressors were displayed to vividly show the defeat of U.S. imperialism. -0-

headline: Innovations in Timber Production in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- Units that have fulfilled their yearly plans for timber production are produced one after another in the forestry sector of the DPRK.
The North Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau is directing efforts to increasing the proportion of mechanization in timber production and pushing ahead with the work to meet the demand for vehicles, machine saws and other equipment.
The Tongchang, Pyokdong, Taegwan, Thaechon forestry stations and all other units under the management bureau fulfilled their yearly plans for timber production.
The forestry and mine timber production stations under the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau carried out their yearly plans for timber production.
The mine timber production stations under the South Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau pushed ahead with the cutting and gathering of trees to be used for timber.
The Chonnae Mine Timber Production Station and the Anbyon Forestry Station under the Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Toan Forestry Station and the Toksong Mine Timber Production Station under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Tongsin and Kasan mine timber production stations and the Songgan Forestry Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau are carrying out their daily plans with the aim to fulfill their yearly plans for timber production. -0-

headline: Information and Motivation Means Exhibition in Jagang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of information and motivation means and a ceremony for starting information activities by loudspeaker vans took place in Jagang Province, the DPRK.
The work to provide information and motivation apparatuses and visual aids was carried out in Huichon and Manpho cities, Janggang County, the provincial regional-industry management bureau, the Jonchon Coal Mine,  other cities, counties and units.
There was a demonstration on the means of information and motivation, and the measures for conducting the front-style political work in a fresh and effective way suited to the characteristics of the relevant sectors and units.
Appreciating the performance given by the provincial artistic information team, Party information workers, mobile artistic motivation teams and announcers hardened their resolve to fulfill their role as standard-bearers and pathfinders in implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's policies and went to construction sites, industrial establishments and farms.
The intensive motivation activities for increased production at the construction sites of regional-industry factories in Janggang and Rangnim counties, the Kanggye  School Uniform Factory, the Kanggye Bag Factory, the Kanggye Steel Woks and other units for implementing the Party's policies aroused the ardent response of the masses as they have a clear political standard and reflect the spirit of the times. -0-

headline: Successes in Production of Koryo Medicines
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- The Koryo medicine production units in Pyongyang Municipality are increasing the production, true to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to make more quality Koryo medicines and contribute to promoting the people's health.
The technical group of the Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory has put the production of Koryo medicines on a germ-free, dust-free and extractive basis to make more quality Koryo medicines.
The Sosong Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory increased the production of Ryukmihwan, Angunguhwanghwan and other Koryo medicines by introducing advanced methods into processing of medicinal herb extract.
The Songyo Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory explored ways to use the effective ingredients of various kinds of raw materials, thus raising the efficacy of Koryo medicines and further improved the performance of equipment.
The Pothonggang and the Moranbong Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories are increasing the production of more quality Koryo medicines. -0-

headline: State Academic Degrees and Titles Awarded to Intellectuals
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- State academic degrees and titles were awarded to the intellectuals who reliably guarantee the overall prosperity and development of the DPRK with proud scientific and technological research achievements.
Present at the awarding ceremony held on Thursday were Vice-Premier of the Cabinet Jon Sung Guk and intellectuals.
After a decision of the State Commission for Conferment of Academic Degrees and Titles of the DPRK was read out, professorship was conferred on Han Chol Hun, a researcher of the State Academy of Sciences.
Doctorate was conferred on 29 persons including section chiefs Pak Un Song and Rim Chol Min, researcher Kim Chol Song, graduate students Song Kil Song, Ri Yun Hyok, Ri Su Ryon, Kim Kon Gun and Kim Kum Dong ofKim Il SungUniversity, researchers Kim Jong Guk, Choe Un Hwa and Jon Chung Hyok of Kim Chaek University of Technology, teachers Ho Chung Hyok, Ryang Hui Son and Kim Hyon Mi of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Kim Ju Song, a researcher of Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering, Pak Chol U, a teacher of University of Sciences, Kim Chol Min, a section chief of Wonsan University of Education, Ri Sung Chol, a section chief of Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, Kim Chung Ryol, head of an office of Chongjin University of Medicine, Kim Sung Il, a researcher of the Academy of Social Sciences, Choe Jun Yop and Hyon Thae Ho, researchers of the State Academy of Sciences, Pak Sung Il, vice-president of the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, Ri Mi Gyong, a researcher of the Academy of Pedagogical Science, Jang Chang Sop, a section chief of the Meteorological and Hydrological Institute, Ryom Son Hui, a section chief of the Korea General Red Cross Hospital, and Hwang Il Guk, vice-president of the South Phyongan Provincial Dental Hospital. -0-

headline: Innovations in Timber Production in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- Units that have fulfilled their yearly plans for timber production are produced one after another in the forestry sector of the DPRK.
The North Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau is directing efforts to increasing the proportion of mechanization in timber production and pushing ahead with the work to meet the demand for vehicles, machine saws and other equipment.
The Tongchang, Pyokdong, Taegwan, Thaechon forestry stations and all other units under the management bureau fulfilled their yearly plans for timber production.
The forestry and mine timber production stations under the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau carried out their yearly plans for timber production.
The mine timber production stations under the South Phyongan Provincial Forestry Management Bureau pushed ahead with the cutting and gathering of trees to be used for timber.
The Chonnae Mine Timber Production Station and the Anbyon Forestry Station under the Kangwon Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Toan Forestry Station and the Toksong Mine Timber Production Station under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Tongsin and Kasan mine timber production stations and the Songgan Forestry Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau are carrying out their daily plans with the aim to fulfill their yearly plans for timber production. -0-

headline: DPRK Schoolchildren Plant Many Saplings in Mountains and Fields
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 19 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren across the DPRK have built tree nurseries with their own efforts and raised saplings to plant and cultivate them in mountains and fields of their regions.
Amid the brisk afforestation by the children's union organizations at schools, this year alone, more than 200 senior middle schools won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest and over 12 million saplings of 20-odd good species were planted in more than 7 400 hectares of forests of the children's union and surrounding mountains.
Children's union members of Jongbong Senior Middle School in Singye County planted more than 50 000 trees of good species in the Children's Union Forest and are monitoring forest fire and harmful insects in a regular way.
Schoolchildren in Mundok County, including Mundok Senior Middle School and Oryong Senior Middle School, have built tree nurseries with their own efforts and raised saplings by applying cultivation methods suited to biological characteristics and seasonal conditions.
Children's union members of Ponghak Senior Middle School in Phyongsong City, Munam Senior Middle School in Hoechang County and Yonphung Senior Middle School in Anju City have manured and tended the planted trees after securing hundreds of fire extinguishing equipment.
The children's union members of Hero Posan Senior Middle School in Cholsan County, who strive to protect forests from natural disaster, forest fire and harmful insects, are the model to be followed by all schoolchildren.
Thanks to the precious patriotic minds of the rising generation, the mountains and rivers of the country are changing with each passing day. -0-

story_text:

headline: New Houses Built at Rural Village in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 19 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers of the Chongun Farm in Songnim City, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK held the third ceremony for moving into new houses.
The new village, with modern, cultural and diverse houses and beauty of landscape, visually shows the changes in the era of the Workers' Party in which mountains, rivers and people are changing beyond recognition.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses held on the spot on July 17 were Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the city and the owners of the new houses.
At the meeting, an address was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
Officials visited the families of farmers and congratulated them on the auspicious event, requesting them to become patriotic peasants supporting the country with increased grain production.
The houses of the blessed cultural rural village were full of the happy laughter of a new living. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Field Guidance at Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 19 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place on July 18 to mark the tenth anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex in the DPRK.
Kim Jong Un, who pays deep attention to the development of railway transport of the country, visited the complex on July 19, 2015 and kindled the flames of modernizing the railways.
Saying that any fortress can be occupied when the revolutionary mettle of the heroic working class is combined with modern science and technology, he indicated the orientation and ways for satisfying the demands for railway transport and transport means.
Present at the meeting were Kim Yong Nam, chief secretary of the Ministry of Railways Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials and employees of the complex.
Mun Jong Ung, chief secretary of the Party committee of the complex, said in a report that the complex is significantly greeting the tenth anniversary ofKim Jong Un's immortal leadership to it amid the vigorous all-people drive for increased production for the successful completion of the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK.
True to his lofty intention, the workers of the complex have manufactured subway trains, modern electric locomotives and passenger cars with improved performance over the past decade, contributing to the development of railway transport, the reporter noted.
The reporter called upon all the officials and workers to display the revolutionary spirit and creation mettle of the heroic working class in the struggle to implement the decisions of the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee, always bearing in mind the trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Sinister Intention behind "Upside-down Map" Revealed
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 19 (KCNA) -- The full text of An Hyok Bom's article "What is the purpose of drawing 'upside-down map'?" released on July 19 is as follows:
Recently the U.S. Forces Command in ROK made public a map to become the topic of conversation among world people.
Marked in this strange map, in which the Korean Peninsula and the surrounding regions are turned upside down unlike normal maps, are the straight lines starting from Phyongthaek U.S. military base in the ROK and terminating at Pyongyang, Beijing, Tokyo, Manila and other capital cities in Asia.
Days ago, the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK in a press conference hung the "upside-down map" which is reportedly being used by the U.S. forces in the ROK as a military map for internal education from early this year and said that everyone can understand the reason why the "strategic flexibility" is definitely necessary and that the U.S. forces in the ROK should sometimes move to other regions to maintain peace.
Then he said the geopolitical importance of the U.S. forces in the ROK that can be promptly dispatched to any region in Asia and the necessity of expansion of their role beyond the Korean Peninsula for maintaining peace in the region can be recognized by intuition through the map.
It is the bizarre idea that can be thought out only by the U.S. which makes it inveterate habit to interpret everything in the world in reverse order.
The true nature of the expansion of "strategic flexibility" focused on invasion and war can neither be covered up nor its meaning interpreted in reverse order even though the U.S. inverted the map.
The map is a raw show of the aggressive intention of the U.S. to fulfill its wild ambition for hegemony in the Asian region at any cost by making the U.S. forces in the ROK a mobile task force.
A military map is not merely a miniature of the lay of and things on the ground, but an operational map reflecting military action and tactics, and encirclement is a military concept that means attack, not defence.
The new map used by the U.S. forces is a clear proof showing that the expansion of the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK has evolved more offensively.
The map, which is designed for the U.S. vassal forces, including the ROK, Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines, to encircle the DPRK and China, proves it.
It also reflects the hegemonic and aggressive plan for "one theatre" worked out by the U.S. and advocated by Japan, the Philippines and other satellite countries.
The plan for "one theatre" is saturated with the extremely provocative and dangerous attempts, including forming the U.S.-led integrated operation commanding system, staging multilateral joint military exercises and reinforcing and deploying long-range attack means.
The map, depicting that the U.S. military bases in Japan are to play the role of the main and logistic bases and the U.S. military bases in the ROK of advanced and launching bases with the Korean peninsula and the East Sea and South Sea of China as theatres, gives a visual explanation of the U.S. attempt for aggressive war against Asia.
The "upside-down map" highlighted the role played by the ROK in realizing the U.S. strategy for dominating Asia.
The map is marked with arrows radiating from the U.S. military base in Phyongthaek of the ROK. This clearly suggests that if a war breaks out in any region of Asia, the ROK should become its advanced base and launching base.
The "upside-down map” makes it possible to understand the role as an “aircraft carrier” of the ROK which is located closest to China and harbouring the only U.S. forces base in the Asian continent.” This is the interpretation of the commander of U.S. forces in the ROK on the role of the ROK in the “upside-down map”.
After all, this map shows the true nature of the expansion of the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK as it is a kind of the written order that 100 percent is the possibility of the ROK's entry into a war as a "shock brigade" of the U.S. in case a war breaks out in the Asia-Pacific region.
"The encirclement ring around China", "one theater" plan, "turning the ROK into the advanced base" …
This map is, indeed, a "map for invasion" which intensively shows the U.S. attempt to invade Asia and nothing but a "visual board" disclosing by itself the fact that the main factor in destroying peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific region is none other than the U.S.
The U.S. is making desperate efforts to justify the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK even by drawing the unreasonable "upside-down map". But it should be aware that such move only reveals its aggressive nature obsessed with its ambition for hegemony. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Remembered in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 20 (KCNA) -- There took place memorial meeting, seminar, round-table talks and other events at the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia, the Russian Veterans' Union, the Primorsky Krai Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity", the Khabarovsk Territory Committee of the Lenin Young Communist League of the Russian Federation, the Buryatia's Republic Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the DPRK, the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Primorsky Krai Branch of the "United Russia Youth Guards" and the Far East State Science Library from July 3 to 8 on the occasion of the 31st anniversary of demise of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages of the Russian government, parliament, political parties, organizations and institutions and the masses.
The chairwoman and vice chairman of the Party for Peace and Unity of Russia said that the great ComradeKim Il Sungis the outstanding statesman who liberated Korea and had led the DPRK people to victory and glory over the past several decades and the greatest person who dedicated his whole life to the prosperity and development of the country and the people's happiness.
The chairman of the Russian Veterans' Union stressed that the exploits performed by ComradeKim Il Sungbeing revered by all people as the founding father of socialist Korea and the great leader has been still conveyed long.
A member of the State Duma and the chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK praised the President for performing the exploits before the times and history and before the country and the people.
The chairman of the Primorsky Krai Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity" said that ComradeKim Il Sung, the founder of the Juche idea and prominent statesman, made a tangible contribution to the Korean revolution and accomplishment of the cause of global independence and his whole life is the one running through with patriotism and loving care for the people.
The chairperson of the Buryatia's Republic Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the DPRK and the chairperson of the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea referred in detail to the fact that the foundation for the development of the bilateral relations of the two countries was provided by the President and the DPRK-Russia relations of friendship and cooperation have been further consolidated and developed century after century. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Deep Attention to Costumes of Schoolchildren
story_text:
One day in May 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited a schoolchildren's palace and dropped in at a room of the accordion group.
Watching the students playing the accordions hard,Kim Jong Untold the officials that the group members are practicing in school uniforms and they will feel hot in summer. It would be good for them to wear T-shirts at groups in summer and sweaters in winter, he said.
At the moment the officials were much moved by his teaching.
They were satisfied, seeing the children cultivate their skills in their new neat uniforms in the palace, but they didn't think their inconvenience.
Kim Jong Untold officials that gym suits for sports group members should be made in a unified way and stressed that they should provide slippers and costumes for the members of the groups of the schoolchildren's palace in a unified way in collaboration with relevant field.
Deep care shown by him for the costumes of the members of the groups tells about the noble love ofKim Jong Unwho is not complacent with the work for the children. -0-

story_text:

headline: Development of New Goods Brisk at Regional-Industry Factories in DPRK

Pyongyang, July 20 (KCNA) -- The regional-industry factories in Jaeryong and Unchon counties of South Hwanghae Province in the DPRK are pushing ahead with the work to improve the quality of products and expand their varieties, regarding the demand of the people as their standard.
In connection with relevant sectors, the factories organized passing-on technique and practice several times to increase the ranks of technicians and skilled workers possessed of more technical knowledge and skills and newly developed tens of kinds of products with locally available raw materials.
The Jaeryong County Foodstuff Factory has increased the variety of foodstuffs including biscuits, carbonated juice, pepper paste and soybean sauce and the packaging containers and various forms of clothes made by the Jaeryong County Daily Necessities Factory and the Jaeryong County Garment Factory are appreciated by residents.

headline: Great Change in Agricultural Production by Programme for Rural Revolution in New Era
Great Change in Agricultural Production by Programme for Rural Revolution in New Era
story_text:
Pyongy6ang, July 20 (KCNA) -- In the new era of rural rejuvenation ushered in by the great Workers' Party of Korea, a great change is taking place in the direction of agricultural production of the DPRK and the material and technical foundations guaranteeing sustainable and stable growth are further being strengthened.
The Party Central Committee set it as the main task of the strategy for developing the countryside to completely solve the country's food problem by increasing agricultural production. It made a crucial decision on pushing ahead with rice and wheat farming by changing the crop distribution and led the struggle for realizing it, thus opening a new history of the bumper harvest of wheat and barley.
The work to implement the Party's policy of changing the structure of grain production set forth in the programme for the rural revolution in the new era has been launched on a nationwide scale. In the course, a change in the understanding of wheat farming among agricultural officials and working people bas been taken place, scientific farming methods, experience and solid foundations for the growth of wheat production laid and the area of wheat cultivation increased every year. This year alone, 30 000 more hectares of cultivation areas were turned into the ones for growing wheat as compared with last year.
Thanks to the completion of the harvest of wheat and barley in the right season this year, the state grain production plan was over-fulfilled and the wheat yield of this year is expected to be increased more than three times than 2021. Thirty-four high-yield counties and 664 high-yield farms were produced, and many high-yield workteams and sub-workteams and bumper croppers were produced.
Rich harvest in wheat and barley farming made in a major thrust front of socialist economic construction is a clear proof of the validity and vitality of the new agricultural policy of the WPK. It is also a brilliant fruition of the revolutionary creation and thoroughgoing spirit of implementation of the DPRK people who are upholding the plan and decision of the Party Central Committee with one mind and loyalty, cherishing the firm faith that the plan and decision of the Party Central Committee are science, practice and victory.
In his policy speech at the Fifth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unadvanced the policy of boldly changing the crop distribution and turning into rice farming and wheat and barley farming. At the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee, he clarified the programme for the rural revolution in the new era and underscored the need to change the people's dietary culture into the one with the main stress on white rice and flour dishes as the main.
Thanks to the great fatherly leader who has always discussed the issue of wheat farming and taken necessary measures to steadily increase the area of wheat cultivation and output every year at important meetings and wisely led to their execution, a unified system of command and supply of necessary farming materials for expanding and developing the wheat and barley farming was established throughout the country and a new turn was brought about in agricultural production.
Thanks to the active efforts of the officials and working people in the agricultural sector, the area for growing wheat has increased more than twice than four years ago.
As the area of wheat cultivation increased, a high-yield movement has been waged in different parts of the country to increase productivity.
The countryside set a bold goal of breaking through the national per-hectare yield standard and took measures to secure high-yielding wheat seed, improve fertility of fields, introduce advanced cultivation methods, manufacture grain dryers and cope with disastrous abnormal weather.
The scientific farming promotion teams have taken sci-tech measures to produce high yields and disseminate advanced agricultural knowledge to the sub-workteams, further increasing the enthusiasm for scientific farming.
With the change in the structure of grain production and farming methods and the growth of wheat production throughout the country, the number of high-yield units has increased, resulting in a special change in the history of socialist rural construction in the country.
In the course of pushing ahead with and reaping rich harvest in wheat farming in the rural areas across the country for the past four years, the agricultural working people have redoubled their confidence and enthusiasm that they can attain any goal of grain production if they do all the things according to the Party's policy.
All the officials and working people in the agricultural sector, not content with the successes they have achieved, are putting spurs to the struggle for attaining this year's goal of grain production set forth by the Party with loyalty and patriotism to make redoubled efforts to implement the Party's policy on ensuring the overwhelming proportion of rice and wheat farming in grain production. -0-

headline: Dissemination of Taekwon-Do in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- Efforts are being made in the DPRK to carry forward and develop Taekwon-Do, an orthodox martial art of the Korean nation.
The Ministry of IT Industry, Okryu Restaurant and Chongryu Restaurant are disseminating Taekwon-Do while instilling into their employees the immortal exploits the peerlessly great men performed in developing the orthodox martial art.
The Management Office of the Tower of the Juche Idea and the Arch of Triumph and the Hungnam Metal Factory have organized Taekwon-Do games and judged them on several occasions and introduced the exemplary employees in various forms and methods.
Taekwon-Do is also being disseminated at Tangsang Primary School in Mangyongdae District, Sariwon Primary School for Orphans, Hwangju Middle School for Orphans and Mirae Kindergarten in Phyongchon District.
In the course, many officials, working people, youth, students and children were awarded the Taekwon-Do grades and degrees this year. -0-

headline: Positive Activities of Scientific Farming Promotion Teams in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- The activities of scientific farming promotion teams have been brisk in different parts of the DPRK.
The members of the team dispatched to South Hwanghae Province are directing efforts to cultivating nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings in a scientific way on the basis of the data on the growth survey, as the areas for introducing nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings have increased considerably.
Those dispatched to South Phyongan Province are making researches on protecting crops from the persistent high temperature phenomenon. They are taking sci-tech measures to prevent rice sheath blight and rice bacterial leaf blight which widely occur in the latter half period of growth of paddy rice.
Those dispatched to South Hamgyong Province are making researches on the distribution of varieties of early crops farming next year while finding out the effect of treating wheat and barley seeds with seed-covering materials and bioactive materials and the technical characteristics of seeds cultivation. -0-

headline: Taean Heavy Machine Complex Updates Equipment Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- The Taean Heavy Machine Complex in the DPRK is concentrating its efforts on updating the performance of equipment.
The technical development section introduced an automatic control system into heat-treating furnaces and established an efficient dust-collecting and ventilation system in the electric furnace, thus contributing to improving the quality of materials and productivity per unit time.
The repairs and maintenance unit introduced an efficient processing method to the 16-meter turning lathe and resolved the technical problem arising in modernizing the 4-meter turning lathe.
The gear reducer workshop and the generating equipment assembling workshop are producing great gears of the grinding mill and custom-built equipment in good time, and the large-sized machine workshop is manufacturing more than 40 kinds of parts badly needed for the readjustment and reinforcement of equipment of various sectors of the national economy.
The sheet metal processing unit invented and introduced efficient jigs and is speeding up the technical updating of the production line.
Meanwhile, the complex completed the construction project for establishing a waste oil recycling process with a great capacity by utilizing advanced construction methods and technical innovation proposals and is manufacturing equipment. -0-

Positive Activities of Scientific Farming Promotion Teams in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- The activities of scientific farming promotion teams have been brisk in different parts of the DPRK.
The members of the team dispatched to South Hwanghae Province are directing efforts to cultivating nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings in a scientific way on the basis of the data on the growth survey, as the areas for introducing nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings have increased considerably.
Those dispatched to South Phyongan Province are making researches on protecting crops from the persistent high temperature phenomenon. They are taking sci-tech measures to prevent rice sheath blight and rice bacterial leaf blight which widely occur in the latter half period of growth of paddy rice.

headline: Taean Heavy Machine Complex Updates Equipment Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- The Taean Heavy Machine Complex in the DPRK is concentrating its efforts on updating the performance of equipment.
The technical development section introduced an automatic control system into heat-treating furnaces and established an efficient dust-collecting and ventilation system in the electric furnace, thus contributing to improving the quality of materials and productivity per unit time.
The repairs and maintenance unit introduced an efficient processing method to the 16-meter turning lathe and resolved the technical problem arising in modernizing the 4-meter turning lathe.
The gear reducer workshop and the generating equipment assembling workshop are producing great gears of the grinding mill and custom-built equipment in good time, and the large-sized machine workshop is manufacturing more than 40 kinds of parts badly needed for the readjustment and reinforcement of equipment of various sectors of the national economy.
The sheet metal processing unit invented and introduced efficient jigs and is speeding up the technical updating of the production line.
Meanwhile, the complex completed the construction project for establishing a waste oil recycling process with a great capacity by utilizing advanced construction methods and technical innovation proposals and is manufacturing equipment. -0-

headline: Screams of Losers Overwhelmingly Defeated in Korean War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- Under the outstanding leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung, the DPRK people and the service personnel of the People's Army defeated the U.S. imperialist aggressors boasting of being the world's "strongest" in the past Fatherland Liberation War (June 1950-July 1953) and performed the unprecedented myth of wining victory in the war.
At the time when the DPRK people and the service personnel shouted the hurrah of victory, the losers in the abyss of ruin made jargon of distress.
The then U.S. army general Taft said that it is quite natural that the U.S. suffered defeat in Korea and no army in the world is strong enough to defeat the Korean People's Army. And the then U.S. Secretary of State Marshall lamented that the myth has collapsed and the U.S. was not the strong country as others thought.
The then Chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff Bradley admitted about their defeat in the war that the Korean war was a wrong war with a wrong rival at the wrong time and in the wrong place.
Commanders of the "UN Forces" MacArthur and Ridgway deplored that "the reputation of the U.S. has never fallen to the ground as now in the world since its foundation" and "the U.S. should never forget the bitter mistake and lesson learnt in the Korean war and the truce talks in Korea."
The then Commander of the U.S. forces in the Far East and Commander of the "UN Forces" Clark raised a cry of distress, confessing that he had tasted defeat, felt indescribable frustration after signing the truce agreement and he even wept silently.
The preceding commanders MacArthur and Ridgway must have felt the same feelings, he added.
Eisenhower, the then U.S. president, appeared at press after signing ceremony of the truce agreement and said in a sad tone that the U.S. paid great price which was tragic and bitter experience.
The testimonies of losers who suffered overwhelming defeat in the Korean war and left shameful disgrace and dishonour further highlight the significance of the great V-Day shining with the symbol of sure victory of the DPRK. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Let Us Remain True to Our Party's Line of Building Military Giant by Building Mighty New-Type Warship
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 22 (KCNA) -- True to the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea's line of building a military giant, the workers at the Nampho Shipyard are making steady progress with uninterrupted innovations and successive leaps forward aimed at the rapid transformation of our navy.
The workers, technicians and officials at the Nampho Shipyard, a reliable base for building large warships which is honorable with the tradition and might of self-reliance, pledged to build another new-type destroyer by October 10, 2026 by redoubling the same spirit and mettle as were displayed in successfully building the first multi-mission destroyer of a new generation so as to make a breakthrough in accomplishing the historic sacred cause of rapidly turning our country into a maritime power of the 21st century.
On July 21, employees of the Nampho Shipyard gathered to vow to build Choe Hyon-class Destroyer No. 3.
The venue for the meeting was full of the high revolutionary enthusiasm of the workers at the shipyard for upholding with the building of a powerful warship of our own type the unshakable determination and will of the Party Central Committee to firmly defend the inviolable maritime sovereignty and national interests of the DPRK with the inexhaustible might of the naval forces.
Present there were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, and workers and technicians at the Nampho Shipyard and in the shipbuilding industry.
Yun Chi Gol, manager of the Nampho Shipyard, made a report.
The reporter referred to the pride of the workers of the Nampho Shipyard who successfully built the first multi-mission destroyer of the DPRK to honorably implement the decision of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee.
The new-type destroyer, which was built as a creation symbolic of the strength and spirit of the DPRK, is a priceless creation of the revolution in the warship-building industry that was brought about by the iron faith and will and outstanding strategy of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho visited the Nampho Shipyard ten times in a little more than a year and gave precious instructions on the building of the warship and inexhaustible wisdom and strength for working miracles, the reporter noted.
He said that through the process of building the destroyer in the face of countless challenges and hardships, the workers at the Nampho Shipyard hardened their faith that they can turn impossibility into a miracle and hasten even the remote future into reality when they do as instructed byKim Jong Un.
He expressed the unshakable will of all the officials and employees of the shipyard to demonstrate once again to the whole world the honor of the revolutionary industry group by achieving miraculous success also in the building of another new-type warship.
He called upon officials to launch a strong ideological offensive and conduct the operation and command in a bold and effective way at the pulsating worksites and upon technicians and skilled workers to continuously work new miracles in the overall production processes.
The reporter ardently called for more firmly uniting with the mind of patriotism while always remembering the greatest trust ofKim Jong Un, and for successfully building the destroyer within the fixed period by displaying the fighting spirit of self-reliance based on science and technology, thus demonstrating once again the inexhaustible creativity and indomitable spirit of the honorable vanguard who is taking the lead in upholding the Party Central Committee's plan for building a powerful army.
The meeting declared the start of the building of Choe Hyon-class Destroyer No. 3 and announced a schedule for finishing the building of the destroyer by October 10, 2026.
Then oath-taking speeches were made.
The venue for the meeting resounded with a shout of slogans reflecting the soaring spirit and enthusiasm of all the participants to glorify the great era ofKim Jong Unas a new heyday of strengthening the Juche-oriented naval forces.
A letter of pledge toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting amidst a storm of applause.
At the end of the meeting, the workers of the Nampho Shipyard started the building of Choe Hyon-class Destroyer No. 3. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 22 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
Going round farms in Paechon and Yonan counties, Pak Thae Song gave a pep talk to agricultural workers who are devoting their all to carrying out the immediate farming process with loyalty and patriotism to glorify this significant year with proud successes in increasing grain production.
He called upon officials of agricultural guidance organs at all levels to bear in mind that scientific farming is the secret of rich harvest, and to give effective guidance to the farms so that they can proactively introduce advanced farming methods suited to the climatic conditions of the relevant areas and the growth conditions of crops and apply agricultural chemicals and fertilizer in a scientific way. He also stressed the need to steadily strengthen the material and technical foundations of the farms.
At the Ryongmaedo Reclaimed Tideland, he acquainted himself in detail with the rice farming and underlined the need to steadily raise the proportion of the farm work done by machines in cooperation with the Academy of Agricultural Sciences and to improve the growth of rice by taking measures for the supply of farming materials necessary for rice farming in tideland.
At the Hasong Wheel Factory he called for raising the productivity and quality of products through a dynamic mass technical innovation movement and for setting a correct stepwise goal for modernization and carrying it out thoroughly.
Discussed at the field consultative meetings were the issue of manuring and tending the after-crops in a scientific and technical way, the issue of proactively introducing advanced farming methods into rice farming in tideland and the issue of making the relevant units take measures to supply raw and other materials necessary for modernizing the Hasong Wheel Factory and putting its production on a normal track.
Earlier, the premier learned about the production at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and took practical steps to produce more fabrics with beautiful patterns and various colors. -0-

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian

Officials of the Party and power organs in Singye County and neighbors visited her house to congratulate her and shared joy with her.
Deeply moved by the birthday spread, she extended her gratitude toKim Jong Un.
She lost her parents and was subjected to all maltreatments and contempt before Korea's liberation. After the liberation, she devoted her sincere sweat and efforts to the grateful motherland which provided her with a worthwhile life.
After becoming a pensioner, she helped her children do more work for the country in good health. So she was respected by the villagers. -0-

headline: Sopho Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 23 (KCNA) -- The Sopho Revolutionary Site is located in the suburb of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.
It is the place where PresidentKim Il Sungput forward the strategic and tactical policies for the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and organized and led the struggle for implementing them while staying from December 27, 1950 to January 5, 1951. It is also the place where ChairmanKim Jong Ilstayed from July 10 to September 21, 1950.
The President provided a brilliant victory of the third operation in the third stage of the war in the place.
He ratified more than 50 Cabinet decisions and Supreme Commander's order which are of important significance in bringing about victory in the war and organized and led all the affairs of the front and the rear.
He gave detailed instructions on the issues related with the war and the ways for their implementation and even on hygienic and anti-epidemic work as well as tasks facing the supply service sector of the People's Army.
During his stay in the place, the Chairman regarded it as a routine to listen to the news of the Supreme Headquarters through radio. When he heard the news that the People's Army liberated new areas, he used to find out all the liberated areas on the map and pasted red five-pointed stars on the areas with his younger sister.
Thanks to the ardent desire of the people to convey forever the exploits the President performed in winning victory in the war, the place has turned into the revolutionary site visited by many people. -0-

headline: Kosan Combined Fruit Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 23 (KCNA) -- The Kosan Combined Fruit Farm in Kosan County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK has a rich crop of fruits.
Thanks to the efforts of the agricultural workers at the farm who have manured and tended fruit trees since the beginning of the year, the orchards at the foot of Chol Pass were loaded with early-ripening fruits.
The Kosan Combined Fruit Farm is associated with the immortal feats of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho dedicated himself to providing the people with enough fruits.
One day in July 2014,Kim Jong Unvisited the farm, where he said that ChairmanKim Jong Ilwrote the first page in the history of the farm which was turned into the world's leading thriving orchards.
Kim Jong Unalso called for writing all other glorious pages in the history of the farm year after year by transforming the farm into a world-class fruit producer and a paradise and producing more fruits for the people.
That day, he set a goal to be attained by the farm in the near future and taught how to increase fruit production.
True to his noble intention, the farm has consistently do the work to put fruit production on a scientific, intensive and modern basis, thereby contributing to bringing about an abundant harvest of fruits in recent years.
The farm increased the size and weight of every fruit by taking agro-technical measures in conformity with the changing weather conditions while pruning fruit trees and thinning fruits in the right time in a qualitative way in keeping with the nutritional requirements according to the growth periods of fruit trees.
The farm has produced apples, pears, peaches and other fruits and sent them to cities and counties of the province every year. -0-

A ceremony of starting the DPRK-Russia children's friendship camping took place on July 22.
Present at the ceremony were Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials concerned and campers. A camping flag was hoisted at the ceremony.

Colorful fireworks were displayed in the sky above Songdowon and there were a ceremony of a schoolchildren's brass band and a small drum group and the march-past of campers. -0-

headline: Efforts Made by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for Turning Countryside into Socialist Fairyland
story_text:
One day in November 2021, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited Samjiyon City which was turned into a good standard of mountain cultural cities and then dropped in at the Junghung Farm.
After exchanging greetings with the officials who came to meet him,Kim Jong Unsaid that the farm villages in Samjiyon City including the Junghung Farm village were built to meet the needs of socialism and they passed the examination as the farmers were pleased. And he said that the new farm villages in Samjiyon City are models of the rural villages across the country we are planning to build in the future.
But even then, the officials did not know well the intention ofKim Jong Un.
That day, he said that the Junghung-ri seat village is a model rural village and standard of rural rejuvenation and it is the determination of the Workers' Party of Korea to build such a rural village not only in Samjiyon City but in all parts of the country.
He stressed that all the rural villages across the country should be built at the level of the Junghung-ri seat village, it is our fighting task and goal, not a foolish dream, and this is an undertaking to be surely carried out in our generation at any cost.
The undertaking to be surely carried out in our generation at any cost!
Indeed, he expressed his firm determination to bring about a radical change not only in Samjiyon City but also in the whole countryside, as he has the strong will to provide our people with wealth of lasting value and happier living conditions without fail however difficult and hard it may be.
Thanks to his sincere and steadfast will, a new era in which rural villages across the country are undergoing eye-opening changes is opening up, new civilization and new life are being brought into full bloom in the countryside, and this land is taking on a new appearance day by day. -0-

Kim Jong Unalso called for writing all other glorious pages in the history of the farm year after year by transforming the farm into a world-class fruit producer and a paradise and producing more fruits for the people.
That day, he set a goal to be attained by the farm in the near future and taught how to increase fruit production.
True to his noble intention, the farm has consistently do the work to put fruit production on a scientific, intensive and modern basis, thereby contributing to bringing about an abundant harvest of fruits in recent years.
The farm increased the size and weight of every fruit by taking agro-technical measures in conformity with the changing weather conditions while pruning fruit trees and thinning fruits in the right time in a qualitative way in keeping with the nutritional requirements according to the growth periods of fruit trees.
The farm has produced apples, pears, peaches and other fruits and sent them to cities and counties of the province every year. -0-

headline: Wreckage of Enemy Plane Displayed at Captured Arms Exhibition Hall of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 24 (KCNA) -- The wreckage of an enemy plane brought out of the waters off Cho Islet in the West Sea of Korea last year was newly displayed at the captured arms exhibition hall of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in the DPRK.
The enemy plane, shot down by the powerful firepower of the heroic People's Army while flying over the inviolable sky of the DPRK after participating in the Korean war from July 1950, had been buried in the sea for 70-odd years.
During the war, many enemy planes boasting of being equipped with latest technologies fell in mountains and fields and were buried in the sea.
Among them were AD-4 boasting of being equipped with modern radar device and automatic flight control system, a F4 U-4 styling itself the most powerful and remarkable carrier-borne plane and B-26 pretending to be the fastest one among the bombers of the U.S. imperialist aggression army.
According to a lecturer of the museum, many people are visiting the captured arms exhibition hall upon hearing the news that the wreckage of the enemy plane was newly displayed.
The visitors are warning the U.S. which is coveting the dignified and powerful DPRK, forgetting its defeat in the Korean war and being seized with a foolish dream:
The descendants of the then U.S. imperialist aggressors, not forget the bitter lesson in the 1950s and refrain from rash acts, there are many unoccupied places at our captured arms exhibition hall. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Firing Practice Contest of Artillery Sub-units of Large Combined Units of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 24 (KCNA) -- A firing practice contest among artillery sub-units of large combined units of the Korean People's Army was conducted on July 23 amid the hot wind of training sweeping the entire army to further consolidate the militant might of the elite revolutionary army.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the artillery firing contest.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK.
He was greeted on the spot by Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, and other commanding officers of the General Staff and military and political officers of the large combined units at all levels of the KPA.
He heard a report on the preparations for the contest on the spot and emphasized the importance of the contest to be conducted according to the plan of the General Staff.
The contest was conducted in the way of deciding ranks by examining the capability of each artillery sub-unit for performing the night march, combat deployment and firing attack on an unexpected enemy target in coastal regional environment and conditions in summer, making them master the combat methods in modern artillery warfare and judging the result of fulfiling the firing missions.
The commanders of the large combined units commanded the firing of their sub-units.
The artillery sub-units, which received the order to fire, fully displayed the capability that they had firmly developed to master the combat manual of our style and punish the enemy at one blow, thus hitting the suddenly-set marine targets in the set time.
Kim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the contest that was conducted like an actual war and its result.
This contest serves as a good occasion for showing the practical and fundamental changes taking place in the KPA's efforts to round off the combat readiness after the Seventh Conference of Training Officers of the KPA, he said, adding that this was a positive result of the outstanding political and ideological readiness of our service personnel supported by the scientific combat training regime and system.
The combat capability of the core arm of our revolutionary armed forces should be highly perfect and matchless to lead and pull in the vanguard of the entire army the implementation of the Party's training-first policy, he said, stressing the need to continuously and rapidly develop our-style artillery tactics and combat methods in an innovative way in keeping with the harsh and acute environment of the daily-changing modern battlefields.
He said that the courage, abilities and self-confidence with which to actively cope with any war and crisis are cultivated in the furnace of the training revolution transcending precedents and limits, and that the comprehensive and formidable combat strength capable of defeating any powerful enemy is the defenders' genuine heroism, toughness and feat deserving a gold-star medal.
Reiterating that the surest war deterrent is the most thoroughgoing outlook on the arch enemy, he expressed expectation and conviction that the units at all levels of the whole army would more firmly establish the atmosphere of attaching importance to training and concentrate on actual war-like drills in response to the epochal build-up of the overall artillery forces so as to bolster up in every way the combat capability of the a-match-for-a-hundred invincible army capable of immediately coping with a war anytime and destroying the enemy in every battle without fail.
Congratulating the combatants of the 2nd Battery of the 3rd Battalion of the 16th Artillery Regiment of the 28th Infantry Division of the 4th Corps of the KPA, who successfully attained all the goals set in the contest and won the contest with the highest score, he invited the battery as special guests to the celebrations of the 72nd anniversary of victory in the war as an award.
All the artillerymen, who received his deep trust and love, hardened their iron will to remain infinitely faithful to the mission and duty of the defenders who guarantee the security of the country and the people most staunchly and most powerfully with the thoroughgoing spirit of defending the country and the revolution. -0-

At the meeting the performers highly praised the personality of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungas the peerlessly great man who defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country and demonstrated the spirit of heroic Korea all over the world by leading the Fatherland Liberation War to brilliant victory.
Kang Chol Hae, a student of Pyongyang Secondary School No. 1, praised the great Generalissimo as an ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander and great man of the century as he shattered the myth of the "mightiness" of the U.S. imperialists and created the legendary tale of war victory unprecedented in history with his unique strategy and tactics and Juche-oriented military war methods.
Kim Ye Yon, a student of Kumsong Secondary School No. 2, said that the brutal atrocities committed by the U.S. imperialists against the Korean people during the war can never be forgotten or covered up for all ages.
An eloquence of Jon Se Gon, a student of Changjon Junior Middle School in Central District, hardened the willingness of the participants to be true successors who are steadfastly carrying forward the noble soul and spirit of the revolutionary forerunners.
Jang Mi Ryong, a student of Kaeson Senior Middle School in Moranbong District, in her eloquence expressed the new generation's will to perform military feats to be immortal in the personal accounts of youth for the first time by carrying forward the loyalty, bravery and patriotic spirit of the victorious wartime generation.
Kim Jun, a student of Kansong Senior Middle School in Phyongchon District, said that the dignity and might of heroic Korea are fully demonstrated all over the world along with July 27, an ever-victorious pronoun, thanks to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
The oratorical meeting ended with the song "Let Us Be Always Ready for Socialist Country". -0-

headline: Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- The Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery is located at the foot of Mt Sokbak in Pyongyang.
To convey long the worthwhile life of the defenders of the country in the 1950s who performed heroic feats in the sacred war for national defence, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally initiated the construction of the martyrs cemetery, chose its site and gave guidance to detailed elements such as a gatepost and wreath-laying stand as well as the layout.
Looking round the cemetery nearing completion, he said that graves had owners from olden times and that the Workers' Party of Korea is the owner of the graves of the known and unknown fallen fighters of the People's Army who laid down their lives in the Fatherland Liberation War, and put forward the heroic soldiers on the highest peak of glory and happiness.
Under his guidance, the cemetery could be built as a monument to the era of the Workers' Party conveying the warm love and revolutionary obligation of the Party for the revolutionary soldiers and a precious mental and moral legacy to be handed down to posterity forever.
At the inaugural ceremony of the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on July 25, 2013,Kim Jong Unpaid noble tribute to the heroic soldiers and highly appreciated the heroic feats performed by the service personnel of the People's Army who sacrificed their lives without hesitation for the only country.
The cemetery consists of the gatepost, the wreath-laying stand "Soul of Heroes" and a monument to the poem dedicated to the memory of heroic soldiers, group sculptures and graves of martyrs with the Memorial Tower for the Fallen Soldiers of the KPA as the center.
Today the cemetery instills into the people the mass heroism displayed by the victors of the great years and their spirit of defending the country. -0-

Millions of DPRK People Visit Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery

Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- More than 2.56 million officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students in the DPRK have visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery for ten-odd years since its inauguration.
The Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery is a monument of the era, which was built thanks to the deep revolutionary comradeship and noble moral obligation of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho values the heroic feats of the defenders of the country in the 1950s who repelled the invasion by the U.S. imperialists and honorably defended the country under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung, an ever-victorious and iron-willed brilliant commander and gives an everlasting life to them.
The cemetery was successfully built on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the war victory under the energetic guidance ofKim Jong Unand, thereby, the history of the war victory and the heroic feats performed in the great years have been further shined.
Visitors to the cemetery solemnly cherish the staunch spirit of defending the country and indomitable fighting spirit displayed by the victorious wartime generation who defeated the imperialist allied forces led by U.S. imperialism boasted of being the "strongest" in the world under the outstanding leadership of the President and worked unprecedented miracles in the world war history.
In front of the tombstones of the heroic soldiers, the visitors were greatly moved by the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea that puts forward the defenders of the country in the 1950s as the models of genuine patriots and ardent revolutionaries to be praised and followed for all ages.

He saw to it that the trademark of shoes produced by the factory was named "Maebongsan" symbolizing the high spirit and victory of the people and service personnel.

headline: Officials and Members of Women's Union Meet War Veteran
Officials and Members of Women's Union Meet War Veteran
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- Officials and members of the women's union met a war veteran at the Hall of Women on Thursday on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
War veteran Han Tong Su said that the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was a shining fruition brought about by the brilliant intelligence and outstanding leadership of PresidentKim Il Sungand his deep trust and love for the service personnel of the Korean People's Army.
Telling the story that he unexpectedly met the President on the road to the grim front in October 1950, Han referred to the President who said that we are sure to win as we have the Party, the country and the People's Army and the people who valued the country.
Saying that the tradition of victory of Juche Korea is being firmly carried forward as it is led by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, another illustrious commander, Han ardently called for dynamically striving for the steady prosperity of the socialist country, rallied closer around the great Party Central Committee with one mind.
Expressed at the meeting were the resolutions to become genuine patriotic women who cherish the spirit of defending the leader unto death and the spirit of defending the country displayed by the victorious wartime generation and push forward with a comprehensive development of the powerful motherland with pure conscience and inexhaustible devotion.
Present at the meeting were officials of the Central Committee of the women's union and its officials and members in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Poem Reciting and Singing of Agricultural Workers and Members of Agricultural Union
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- A poem reciting and singing of agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea "Victory Will Be Won Generation after Generation" was held at the Jangchon Hall of Culture in Sadong District, Pyongyang, on Thursday to celebrate the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
Present there were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the agricultural union, officials and members of the union and agricultural workers in Pyongyang.
The performers highly praised PresidentKim Il Sungfor performing immortal feats by bringing about victory in the war with his outstanding strategy and tactics and wise leadership and the defenders of the country in the 1950s for displaying their heroic spirit.
Narrative poem "For defence of the country" and song "Advance" impressively showed the transparent spirit of devotedly defending the leader and the staunch spirit of defending the country displayed by the fighters of the People's Army who devoted their youth and lives without hesitation to the one and only motherland.
Hearing a female solo "Victory Mill on Jiktong Pass", the audience recollected the spiritual world of the wartime patriotic farmers who plowed and seeded the fields under the gunfire with the faith that they are sure to win victory as they are led by the President.
Some numbers reflected the aspiration of the agricultural workers to uphold and glorify the motherland with increased grain production by inheriting the fighting spirit of the preceding generations.
The poem reciting and singing, that displayed the revolutionary enthusiasm of agricultural workers and members of the agricultural union, ended with choral poems and choruses "We Are Koreans" and "Dear Father". -0-

headline: Senior Officials of DPRK Visit Families of War Veterans
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials and leading officials of armed forces organs visited the families of war veterans on July 23 and 24 on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
Senior state officials visited war veterans' families in Pyongyang and warmly congratulated the veterans on greeting the significant V-day with the pride and self-confidence of victors on the platform of the priceless honor all people respect and look up to under the special attention and warm care of the Party and the state.
Learning about the veterans' health, the senior officials told them the deep trust and warm affection of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho wants the revolutionary forerunners, who defended the country at the cost of their blood and consolidated the foundation of the DPRK with invariable patriotism, loyalty and devoted efforts all their lives, to give strength to the rising generation and become the eternal spiritual pillar for them, full of energy despite their advanced age.
They spent a pleasant time with the veterans, appreciating the efforts of the families of war veterans devoting their sincerity as the good assistants of them who created and personified heroic Korea's history of mightiness and victory.
The veterans said that they would devote their remaining years to ensuring that the new generations of the revolution steadfastly carry forward the history and tradition of victory, always keeping in mind the benevolence of the great father, who takes good care of them as the models and true teachers of their descendants. And they requested the senior officials to remain faithful to the idea and leadership ofKim Jong Unwith their all possible efforts.
The senior officials hardened their will to dynamically carry forward the history of the powerful Juche Korea by making strenuous efforts in the vanguard of the general advance to usher in the comprehensive golden age of national rejuvenation in the spirit of victory given by the immortal July 27. -0-

headline: Iron-willed Brilliant Commander Hastens Victory in War with Powerful Strike Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungthoroughly smashed the reckless moves of the U.S. imperialists and hastened victory in the war with 3 rounds of powerful strike operations in the 4th stage period of the Fatherland Liberation War.
In 1953, when the "New Offensive" the U.S. imperialists had prepared as last hope ended in total failure, they were making last-ditch efforts dreaming of "Honorable Armistice."
On the basis of analyzing the prevailing situation, the President advanced an operational policy for hastening the final victory in the war by tightening the enemies' windpipes through powerful strike operations.
According to his operational policy, the service personnel dealt a powerful blow to the enemy on May 13 on the whole of the front.
The enemy suffered a great loss through the first strike of the People's Army in nearly 10 days.
After analyzing the situation on the front, the President organized the second strike from May 27 without delay and set the time and target area of the strike.
Even after the two strike operations of the Korean People's Army units, the enemy laid obstacles to the armistice talks.
To cope with this, the President organized the third powerful strike from July 13.
Through the strike operation, the combined units of the KPA killed and captured more than 78 000 enemy soldiers and liberated a large area of 160 square kilometers.
Under the wise leadership of the President, the purpose of the third strike was also successfully realized.
On July 27, the U.S. imperialists, in a tight corner and unable to find any other way out, were forced to sign the armistice agreement at last which they had delayed for 24 months and 17 days.
As such, the President led the three powerful strike operations to victory, mercilessly smashing the reckless attempt of the U.S. imperialists and concluding the war with brilliant victory. -0-
