headline: Intensive Short Course for Officials in Construction Sector Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- An intensive short course for officials in the construction sector took place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, from July 18 to 24.
The intensive short course was aimed at further enhancing the practical abilities of the officials in the construction sector and solving the urgent matters arising in carrying out the construction revolution, including qualitatively strengthening construction force.
Kim Jong Gwan, vice-premier of the Cabinet, made an opening address.
Noting that the intensive short course for officials in the construction sector is to be held thanks to the direct initiative and guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, he said that the construction sector is steadily expanding and developing as the main front symbolizing the dynamic advance and development of the state and that the completion of the grand construction plan designed by the Workers' Party of Korea urgently requires the rapid strengthening of the construction force.
Expressing belief that the short course would serve as an epoch-making occasion in ensuring that the officials in the construction sector take the lead in implementing the Party's idea and policy on Juche-oriented construction with their high political consciousness and technical and practical ability as the core and pivot of the construction revolution in the new era, he declared the intensive short course opened.
Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, courteously conveyed whatKim Jong Unsaid about the work of construction sector.
Then lectures were given on the theoretical and practical issues arising in the construction sector, including applying the Party's architectural ideals and construction policies in practice more correctly, firmly ensuring specialization in the organization and command of construction and rapidly accelerating the strengthening of the construction workforce with the main emphasis put on training skilled workers.
First of all, the short course discussed it as an important issue for officials to be well aware of the Party's policy-oriented requirements set forth before the construction sector recently and fulfill their responsibility and role as leading personnel in carrying out the construction revolution in the new era.
Explained at the short course were the issues for making all the architectural designs reflect the Party's Juche-oriented architectural ideas and ideals and steadily creating and developing new and unique architectural styles.
It also dealt with the ways for strictly meeting the requirements of designs in the construction projects and radically improving the officials' ability to guide construction.
Importance of the construction inspection was emphasized and there was a lecture dealing with the tasks and ways for strictly ensuring the structural quality by further strengthening the construction inspection.
A lecture on the proper organization and command of the project as required by the new construction revolution drew the attention of the audience.
Lectures, which explained rational methods for improving technical preparations for projects and ensuring the quality and speed of construction in combination with the experience data whose advantages and benefits were proved in reality, greatly helped the officials in the construction sector to enrich their knowledge and improve their professional qualifications.
A lecture dealt with the importance of timely measures to expand and strengthen the ranks of skilled workers in construction.
The lecture stressed the tasks for all the officials and commanding officers in the construction sector to thoroughly ensure the environmental culture of construction sites with a correct understanding that today's revolution in construction is a worthwhile undertaking to create the precious wealth of the country and, at the same time, a cultural revolution to lead people to the civilization of the new era and bring earlier a bright future, thus providing the builders with safer and more hygienic and cultural working conditions and environment.
There was a lecture to deal with the issues of saving even a gram of cement and a piece of steel bar and making effective use of them as much as possible without wasting by making effective reviews of the transport, storage, delivery and consumption of building materials.
During the short course, there was a video show introducing efficient and advanced construction methods, building materials and modern construction equipment and tools.
A demonstration at the construction site of the Kangdong County Hospital held during the short course became an effective process for sharing the model successes and experience created by the officers and men of the unit of construction educators and applying them to all construction units without delay.
Through the intensive short course, all the participants not only rearmed themselves with the Juche-oriented architectural idea and construction policy of the Party and acquired essential specialized technical knowledge but also fully shared and understood the experience gained in the past construction and made a fresh determination to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the vanguard of the gigantic construction revolution as intended by the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline:
Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Historic Sites Associated with War-victory Exploits of President Kim Il Sung

[2025.07.26.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel of the People's Army across the DPRK, on the threshold of July 27, the V-day, praise with pride the sacred war-victory exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho demonstrated the immortal glory and dignity of the state with his outstanding idea and leadership.
Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and other senior Party, government and military officials, officials of the WPK Central Committee, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, commanding officers of large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and leading officials of ministries and national agencies visited the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site and the Jonsung Revolutionary Site on July 25 on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the war.
Looking round the historic sites, the visitors recollected with deep emotion the immortal exploits of the President who saved the destiny of the country and its people from crisis and firmly defended the peace and security of mankind by preventing the disaster of a new world war.
The visitors could not repress their surging hatred to the enemy, seeing the holes punched by the enemy's strafing on the wall of the President's office room and an unexploded bomb left stuck near the Supreme Headquarters command post in the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site. And they keenly realized that the most dangerous frontline in the three-year war was the Supreme Headquarters, and that the history of leadership over the Fatherland Liberation War by the President who weathered out a hail of bullets is the heroic biography of the peerlessly great sage.
Looking round the historic house of the Jonsung Revolutionary Site where the President examined and ratified the Armistice Agreement document on July 27, 1953, the visitors were filled with the deep reverence for the invincible and iron-willed commander and peerlessly great man who performed the July 27 miracle.
The visitors realized once again that the brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War which firmly defended the most acute outpost line of the anti-imperialist struggle in an eastern part of the earth was the victory of the outstanding military idea, Juche-oriented war methods and superb strategy and tactics of the President, the peerlessly legendary hero, and the victory of the burning patriotism and indomitable spirit of defending the country displayed by the service personnel and people rallied close behind the Party with one mind.
All the visitors made a firm pledge to fulfill their responsibility and duty they assumed before the times and the revolution in steadily carrying forward the sacred history of war victory of heroic Korea and the heroic people shining in the revolutionary history of the peerlessly great men, true to the ideology and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Sinchon Class Education House
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, looked round the Sinchon Class Education House, a base of anti-imperialist class education, on July 24.
He was accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwent round the exhibition rooms of the Sinchon Class Education House, the tombs of 400 mothers and 102 children, the air-raid shelter of the county Party committee, the gunpowder storehouse and other places.
Seeing the exhibits and traces still making the bloody outcry in the tragic years pierce the visitors' hearts, he said that the bitter death and harsh sufferings our people were forced to experience in the three years of the war can never be faded away or forgotten even after the lapse of decades and the change of generations.
Saying that if the work for intensifying anti-imperialist class education is delayed or neglected even for a moment, the people's revolutionary consciousness and class consciousness will be paralyzed and the target of the revolution and the outlook on the arch enemy will be blurred, he stressed that as the revolution is a cause which is never accomplished in one or two generations but continues through generations, the issue of steadfastly carrying forward the baton of class struggle is an important and urgent task directly linked with the destiny of the country and the future of the revolution.
When socialism of our own style advances dynamically and the spirit of prosperity prevails on this land, we should never forget the painful lesson in Sinchon even for a moment, he said, adding that this is an indelible blood stain and a history of sufferings, and that the Sinchon Class Education House is all that shows why we must grow stronger and why we must surely be strong.
He said that our people shouted "Long live the Workers' Party of Korea!" to the last in defiance of the enemy's brutal atrocities and outrages, adding that thanks to those strong and indomitable people, the DPRK could win the great victory in the cruelest war unprecedented in the world history of wars and reach the stage of today by overcoming all challenges of history. He also noted that if we do not want the tragedy in Sinchon to be repeated again, we should have the powerful strength striking fear into the enemy and continue regarding as our lifeline the immutable truth that independent life and future is guaranteed in strengthening in every way the most powerful self-defence capacity.
Saying that only when our people and service personnel of the People's Army are fully prepared to be defenders of the revolution and vanguard fighters of the class who are always aware of their class origin in the hot wind of class education, can the history and tradition of great victory in the war be firmly carried forward as a national trait peculiar to our state,Kim Jong Unstressed the need to further intensify class education at present and indicated the tasks.
He met Ju Sang Won, the honorary curator of the class education house, who has been defending the position of class education for decades as an experienced person and witness of grudge.
Expressing belief that the lecturers in the field of class education, the defenders and disseminators of the revolutionary idea of our Party, would firmly defend the outpost of class education in the future, too, always being aware of the importance of their duty, he had a significant photo session with officials, lecturers and employees of the Sinchon Class Education House.
The senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs hardened their resolve to fully discharge their important mission and duty in the responsible work for consolidating our revolutionary position and class position in every way by cherishing the immutable truth of the class warfare deeply implanted byKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung's Inspection to Front during War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- During the Fatherland Liberation War (June 1950 - July 1953), PresidentKim Il Sungled the soldiers of the Korean People's Army to victory, inspecting the front.
In August 1950, the enemies, who were pressed into a small area by the dynamic advance of the People’s Army, made desperate efforts to check the latter's attack on the line of the Raktong River.
After seeing through the enemies' attempt, he left for the front, paying deep attention to the defence on the southwest coast, which no one has yet paid attention.
On the evening of August 10, enemies' planes appeared in the sky when the President and his party arrived on the Chungju line.
The President ordered to stop vehicles and take shelter in forest. The enemy planes dropped bombs at the place where the cars stopped and splinters of bombs embedded in the place near the President. When the enemy planes disappeared, the accompanying officials ardently asked him not to inspect such dangerous front again.
He said that he knew well their minds but if he encourages commanding officers and combatants at the front even though it is dangerous, the day of victory in the war would be brought earlier.
He inspected the headquarters at the front to inform it of the Supreme Command's final operation plan and went to the headquarters of the 26th Coastal Defence Brigade to give instructions on strengthening the southwest coastal defence to cope with the coming situation on the front.
During his inspection to the front, he crossed a dangerous railway bridge with a car and climbed Mt Jihye, covering the 8-odd kilometer-long road showered with napalm bombs and littered with time bombs dropped by the enemies.
The inspections to the front by the President were great historic events that instilled the strength and courage into the KPA soldiers and brought earlier the victory in the war. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to War Veterans in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea has put forward the victorious wartime generation as the masters of the legendary heroic era who provided ever-victorious cornerstone on the sacred course of development of the DPRK. Thanks to its love and trust, the lives and feats of the war veterans are shining forever on the platform of the respect and honor of the whole country.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent gifts to the war veterans across the country on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, the revolutionary holiday of the DPRK people.
The warm love and care shown byKim Jong Unare associated with deep sincerity of the tender-hearted father who wants the war veterans, the personifiers of the history of mightiness and great victory of Juche Korea, to lead a proud and worthwhile life in good health.
The gifts sent byKim Jong Unwere courteously handed over to the war veterans across the country.
The war veterans and their families were much moved by the benevolence ofKim Jong Unwho is constantly giving vitality of life to the war veterans with boundless love while saying that if the war veterans sit in good health, they will be unbounded strength for our Party and people and great encouragement to our revolution.
The war veterans expressed gratitude toKim Jong Unfor putting forward them as the precious forerunners of the revolution and giving them happiness and glory to be envied by the whole world.
They hardened their will to glorify their lives as true educators and teachers who add boundless loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm to the ranks of successors dynamically advancing along the road of the comprehensive rejuvenation under the leadership of the great Party with the spirit and mettle they displayed in the war. -0-

headline: Combat Equipment Shining with Hero Medal
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- The pursuit aircrafts No. 12, No. 009 and No. 1032 and the torpedo boat No. 21 bearing the medal of the Hero of the Republic are exhibited at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
They tell about the heroic feats of the DPRK pilots and sailors who bravely fought according to PresidentKim Il Sung's original tactics.
Kim Ki Ok, a pilot of the pursuit aircraft No. 12, shot down 11 enemy planes including bomber B-29 which the U.S. imperialists boasted of as the "fortress in the sky" and damaged 4 planes in several air battles.
The pilot of the pursuit aircraft No. 009 shot down aircrafts of the U.S. Air Force in the sky over the Chongchon River and Lake Jangjin.
The pilot of the pursuit aircraft No. 1032 shot down 7 enemy planes and damaged three in the sky over the east coast including Hamhung and Ryonpho in a month.
The torpedo boat No 21 performed a feat in sinking the U.S. imperialist aggressors' heavy cruiser Baltimore, which had been called a "moving island", off the coast of Jumunjin in early July 1950.
In November 2011, ChairmanKim Jong Iltook a measure to award the title of Hero to the weapons and combat equipment of merits.
The title of Hero of the Republic was respectively awarded to the pursuit aircrafts No. 12 and No. 009 in January 2012 and to the pursuit aircraft No. 1032 and the torpedo boat No. 21 in July. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Supply Base of KPA Unit and Acquaints Himself with Paddy-field Catfish Breeding
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday inspected a supply base of an unit of the Korean People's Army which has made a great achievement in implementing the Party's policy on encouraging paddy-field fish breeding to learn about its conditions.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and chief secretaries of provincial Party committees.
The supply base produced more than 70 tons of catfish per hectare while sharply lowering unit feed and increasing weight ratio than industrial catfish breeding methods by intensifying the research true to the policy of the Party on encouraging the paddy-field fish breeding. It also harvested 10-odd tons of grain of rice per hectare on low-yielding fields, not using any fertilizer and agricultural chemicals.
Watching with satisfaction the paddy fields teeming with catfishes,Kim Jong Unhighly appreciated that though the unit is not a special catfish farm, it started fish breeding with some employees and their family members and proved the economic effectiveness of paddy-field fish breeding and scientific and technological guarantee for it over a brief span of just three years by combing the scientific research with production practice.
Learning in detail about the method of paddy-field catfish farming created by the unit and its farming experience, he said that it is necessary to properly select a right place in consideration of water resources, water quality conditions, pollution source of the surrounding area, irrigation and drainage conditions and soil characteristics in order to introduce paddy-field fish breeding, adding that it is most important to remodel paddy fields such as making a ditch and pool so as to create favorable conditions for the growth of fish.
Explaining the advantage of the green cultivation and fish farming comprehensive system, which becomes a world trend, to the cadres accompanying him, he stressed the need to establish a scientific theory on the Korean-style paddy-field fish breeding, not confining to introduce the experience of individual units, and standardize it in order to make a leap forward in this field.
An official of the unit said that it has built a pedigree farm and sent two millions of young catfishes produced by itself to various units of the army and society from this year and harvested 7 tons of earlier wheat and 30 tons of garlic per hectare. The official also said that it is expected to produce 10-12 tons of grains of rice per hectare, 50-60 tons of grains of rice in five hectares of paddy fields and 60-70 tons of catfishes per hectare, 300-350 tons of catfishes in five hectares of paddy fields. Being informed by the official,Kim Jong Unencouraged the unit, saying that it set a practical example in the introduction of organic farming through fish breeding, which is prioritized by the WPK.
He said that the officials of the base who accept the Party's policies as truth and faith and bring about substantial successes in improving the soldiers' and people's living standard are genuine revolutionaries and patriots, and gave special thanks to the unit.
He instructed to organize with much effort a demonstration on the introduction of the Korean-style green cultivation and fish farming method established by the officials of the unit, saying that it is important to make the leading officials at all levels possess rich knowledge of paddy-field fish breeding. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Sympathy to Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on July 25.
The message is as follows:
The respected President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin,
Upon hearing the unexpected sad news that dozens of people were killed by the air crash in Amur Region, I express deep condolences to you and, through you, to your government, people, the bereaved families and the victims on behalf of the government and people of the DPRK and on my own.
Our people are now sharing the distress and sorrows that the fraternal Russian people experienced.
I, sharing the extremely regrettable feelings with the bereaved families who lost close relatives and friends, wish their pain to be healed as soon as possible.
I sincerely wish the government and people of Russia to firmly overcome the pain of loss and regain peace and stability as soon as possible under your leadership. -0-

Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Friendship Tower on July 26 on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
A wreath in the name ofKim Jong Unwas laid before the tower.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the DPRK would never forget the militant feats and merits of the fallen fighters of the Chinese People's Volunteers recorded in the history of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
He was accompanied by Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: Kaesong Municipality Makes Successes through Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK has achieved successes by conducting the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement.
Many units in the municipality were awarded the titles of the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag, the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag.
The Kaesong Municipal Information and Communications Centre and the Kaesong Towel Factory prepared their employees as revolutionary working people and led the mass movement aimed at the fulfillment of the national economic plan, thus winning the title of the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag.
The Kaesong Kyonghung Shop, etc. have made progress in improving the service level and remodeling the workplaces.
The Phanmun District Extracurricular Sports School, etc. have developed effective teaching methods and improved the students' ability by pushing ahead with the work for improving the qualifications of teachers methodologically.
Agricultural workers of the Work-team No. 4 of the Singwang Farm and the Pongdong Work-team of the Phanmun Fruit Farm of the Kaesong Municipal Rural Economy Committee are demonstrating their pride as high-yield units by introducing advanced farming methods suited to the characteristics of the areas.
Workteam No. 4 of Rimhan Farm in Phanmun District and Workteam No. 4 of Oksan Farm in Kaephung District, which are raising the proportion of the farm work done by machines and putting farm work on a more scientific basis according to their processes, are exemplary also in establishing its cultured practice in production and life. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Praised by Foreign Figures
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The young Democratic People's Republic of Korea won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War by resolutely defeating the imperialist aggressor forces headed by the U.S. imperialists. This was a precious fruition of the rare wisdom and outstanding commanding art of PresidentKim Il Sungwho created and successfully applied original military strategy, tactics and war methods.
That is why the world expressed boundless admiration and praise for the President's extraordinary military art and Juche-oriented strategy and tactics.
Gomes, the former Portuguese President, who was the chief of Staff of the Portuguese army during the Korean war, said that the then operational plan was made by the U.S. after several meetings of dozens of generals, chiefs of Staff and military experts of Western countries on the U.S. side.
But GeneralKim Il Sungfrustrated it. I saw it and understood that GeneralKim Il Sungis the gifted military strategist and great brilliant commander without an equal in the world, he added.
Other foreign figures praised the President as the peerlessly great man. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The more vigorously the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu advances, winning victory after victory, the more solemn the minds of all successive generations are with boundless respect for the pioneering generation of the revolution.
Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, chief secretaries of provincial Party committees, commanding officers of large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and leading officials of ministries and national agencies visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Saturday on the occasion of July 27, the great V-Day.
The guard of honor of the KPA lined up at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery.
Senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs laid flowers before the wreath-laying stand.
All the participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred cause of liberating Korea, defending its sovereignty and achieving the freedom and happiness of the people.
There was a march-past of the guard of honor of the KPA.
The participants looked round the cemetery.
The participants laid flowers before the busts of the martyrs and paid high tribute to them, recollecting with reverence the valuable merits performed by the first generation of the revolution who created the ever-victorious history of heroic Korea to defend the ideology and cause of PresidentKim Il Sungwith arms while waging the great anti-Japanese war and the Fatherland Liberation War.
All the participants hardened their ardent will to glorify the history and tradition of victory forever and fully demonstrate the absolute dignity and glory of socialist Korea all over the world, true to the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unwith transparent revolutionary spirit and bold practical ability. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Taken with Artillerymen
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, on July 26 met and had a photo taken with the officers and men of the 2nd Battery of the 3rd Battalion of the 16th Artillery Regiment of the 28th Infantry Division of the 4th Corps of the Korean People’s Army, who were invited as special guests to the celebrations of the 72nd anniversary of victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.
The participants were greatly excited and delighted to have a meaningful photo taken at the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, a grand temple of education in the tradition of victory encapsulating the history of war victory of Juche Korea, with the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwhom they always missed in the days of honourable service for defending the security of the country and the people.
Kim Jong Unwarmly congratulated the courageous artillerymen who set an example in implementing the Party’s training-first policy.
He said that in wartime a soldier who is good at fighting is a hero, but in peacetime a soldier who is good at training is a hero, and expressed his belief that the soldiers of the battery will firmly carry forward the fighting spirit of the victorious wartime generation and prepare themselves more fully to be a-match-for-a-hundred artillerymen who will make a breakthrough for victory in the vanguard with the strongest and most merciless gunfire of justice at the grim moment, before posing with them for a photo to be recorded forever in the history of army building.

headline: Feats and Life of Victorious Wartime Generation Shining under Care of Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the great V-Day (July 27), the Korean people and service personnel of the People's Army pay high tribute to the victorious wartime generation, the masters of the legendary heroic era.
Though more than 70 years have passed since the war ceased, but the feats performed by the victorious wartime generation are still shining thanks to the benevolent care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho regards the noble spirit of defending the country and the revolution displayed by them as the most precious political legacy and highly puts forward them.
One day in July 2012, ahead of the 59th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War,Kim Jong Untold officials to significantly and splendidly celebrate July 27, which shines with the war victory exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, as the holiday of victors, and gave instructions on taking care of the delegates of war veterans to be taken part in the celebrations with the greatest sincerity.
Kim Jong Unstressed the need to make it a tradition to invite the war veterans to Pyongyang every year and celebrate the great V-Day with splendor as a significant holiday of victors.
The noble image ofKim Jong Unmaking sure that the V-Day is significantly celebrated every year and paying tribute to the victors of the great years at the events commemorating the victory in the war is deeply kept in the hearts of the people across the country.
Under his energetic leadership, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum was built as the grand palace of victory conveying to the whole world the heroic feats of the victorious wartime generation and the noble spirit of defending the country, and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery, where the Workers' Party of Korea became a grave owner, was built in the best place in Pyongyang.
Indeed, the life of the victorious wartime generation is shining more brilliantly under the care ofKim Jong Unwho puts forward the war veterans as excellent revolutionary forerunners, proud heroes of the nation and genuine patriots and repeatedly shows loving care and benevolence to them. -0-

President Kim Il Sung Praised by Foreign Figures

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on July 26 on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the war.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, chief secretaries of provincial Party committees and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The flower basket in the name ofKim Jong Unwas laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Also laid were flower baskets in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK.
Kim Jong Unpaid the highest tribute to the President, the eternal symbol of the mightiness and dignity of Juche Korea and the ever-victorious legendary hero, in front of the statue.
He went round a hall dealing with four stages of the Fatherland Liberation War, the Guards Units Hall and the Hall of Victory.
He said that the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War which firmly defended the most acute outpost of the anti-imperialist struggle in the eastern part of the earth is the victory of the outstanding military ideology, Juche-oriented war methods and superb strategy and tactics of the President and the victory of the ardent patriotism and indomitable spirit of defending the country of the army and people rallied close around the President.
He said that though more than 70 years have passed since the fireworks of war victory were displayed, the exploits for war victory performed by the President have become the eternal foundation of all victories and shining dignity that our state and people have achieved century after century. All the revolutionary exploits the President performed through his whole precious life are great, but the legendary feat for war victory is an extraordinary and a core feat admired and revered by the world, he said.
He said that the President created the immortal heroic spirit in which the DPRK could win victory forever despite the flames of the war, provided a solid cornerstone for carrying forward the revolutionary traditions and decided a future course of a gigantic new history in the postwar socialist revolution and construction. His outstanding history of the war victory leadership is the most precious ideological and spiritual wealth our Party and people should invariably carry forward and glorify for all ages, he said.
Kim Jong Unaffirmed that our state and its people would surely achieve the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army and become honorable victors in the anti-imperialist, anti-U.S. showdown, braving any challenges and difficulties in the future with redoubled courage, as the victorious wartime generation brought the greatest victory and glory even in the face of the most severe national difficulties.
Saying that the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, which gives firm will to invariably carry forward the ever-victorious history to our people and service personnel of the People's Army, is an eternal treasure house of the revolution that can not be compared with anything, he indicated the tasks and ways for further intensifying the education in the tradition of victory through it.
The leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs hardened their firm pledge to fully discharge their responsibility and duty they have assumed before the times and the revolution, fully demonstrating the pride of heroic Korea and the heroic people. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army across the country significantly celebrating July 27 with the great pride and honor of being citizens of a powerful victor nation are paying the highest tribute to the defenders of the country in the 1950s who created the history of eternal victory of the heroic Korea.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery together with war veterans on July 26 on the occasion of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, chief secretaries of provincial Party committees and leading officials of ministries and national agencies.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up in front of the cemetery.
Kim Jong Unlaid a flower before the wreath-laying stand "Soul of Heroes" and paid high tribute, praying for the immortality of the fallen soldiers of the People's Army who won the priceless victory at great sacrifices in the grim years when the destiny of our state and its people was determined.
A gun salute was fired in memory of the Fatherland Liberation War martyrs.
Kim Jong Unwent round the cemetery together with war veterans.
He said that though the faces of the fallen soldiers of the People's Army carved on the gravestones are very ordinary, the immortal feats of the proud sons and daughters of our country who defended their beloved country and the gains of the revolution at the cost of their lives and safeguarded the peace of mankind, are shining brilliantly century after century along with the great world-historic significance of July 27.
He said that the staunch spirit of defending the country and indomitable revolutionary faith of the victorious wartime generation who created the great heroic era are precious ideological and spiritual wealth all the people and the service personnel of the entire army should firmly carry forward and glorify forever and the invincible force of our revolution.
Saying that it is the duty and revolutionary obligation of all of us, descendants of the victorious wartime generation, to build the world's most prosperous power without fail on this land dyed with the lifeblood of the fallen soldiers,Kim Jong Unaffirmed that our socialist state will prosper forever as it enriches the glorious history and tradition of victory and demonstrates its matchless national power and dignity.
The participants recalled with deep emotion the precious feats of wartime heroic soldiers who defended every inch of the motherland with their blood, and laid flowers before the graves, vowing to carry forward the victory of July 27 year after year.
Fireworks were set off in the sky of July, reflecting the noble tribute to the defenders of the country in the great years and the joy of celebrating the V-day.
Kim Jong Unhoped that the war veterans, true models of the revolutionary and patriotic life, would spend their remaining years in good health and happiness under the deep care of the Party and the government and the respect of the people across the country.
Only glory is in store for our people who are vigorously advancing toward the accomplishment of the great cause of building up a rich country with a strong army, winning great dynamic victories under the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, the peerlessly illustrious commander. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The more vigorously the sacred revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Mt Paektu advances, winning victory after victory, the more solemn the minds of all successive generations are with boundless respect for the pioneering generation of the revolution.
Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, chief secretaries of provincial Party committees, commanding officers of large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and leading officials of ministries and national agencies visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on Saturday on the occasion of July 27, the great V-Day.
The guard of honor of the KPA lined up at the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery.
Senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs laid flowers before the wreath-laying stand.
All the participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred cause of liberating Korea, defending its sovereignty and achieving the freedom and happiness of the people.
There was a march-past of the guard of honor of the KPA.
The participants looked round the cemetery.
The participants laid flowers before the busts of the martyrs and paid high tribute to them, recollecting with reverence the valuable merits performed by the first generation of the revolution who created the ever-victorious history of heroic Korea to defend the ideology and cause of PresidentKim Il Sungwith arms while waging the great anti-Japanese war and the Fatherland Liberation War.
All the participants hardened their ardent will to glorify the history and tradition of victory forever and fully demonstrate the absolute dignity and glory of socialist Korea all over the world, true to the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unwith transparent revolutionary spirit and bold practical ability. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Officials and Employees of Sinchon Class Education House
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Officials, lecturers and employees of the Sinchon Class Education House who are fulfilling their mission and duty as red information workers of the Workers' Party of Korea at the outpost of the revolutionary position and class position have received warm fatherly love and trust again.
On July 24, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Sinchon Class Education House to indicate tasks and ways for firmly preparing our people and service personnel as defenders of the revolution and vanguard fighters of the class and had a photo taken with the officials, lecturers and employees. Afterwards, he sent gifts of deep love to them.
A meeting for conveying the gifts took place on July 26.
A speech was made at the meeting.
The speaker said with great emotion thatKim Jong Un, who left a sacred trace of revolutionary leadership at the Sinchon Class Education House, gave precious instructions for further intensifying class education at present, recognized the unknown services of the lecturers and employees who are firmly defending the outpost of class education, and showed love for them again by sending the gifts.
It reflects the noble intention of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who regards the political and ideological front and the anti-imperialist class front as the forefront guaranteeing the steady carrying forward and accomplishing of our cause and highly praised the merits of the class-education lecturers, and the great expectation that they would as ever preserve the true nature of a professional revolutionary and reliably defend the important base of class education, the speaker said.
The speaker called upon the officials, lecturers and employees to creditably discharge their responsibility and role as befitting the red information workers and motivation workers of the Party, not forgetting even for a moment the love and trust shown byKim Jong Un.
The gifts were handed over amid the enthusiastic applause of the participants. -0-

headline: Brisk Activities of Delegation of Korean Women Officials on Visit to Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- A delegation of Korean women officials on a visit to Russia at the invitation of the "Russian Women's Union" developed cooperation between the DPRK and Russia women organizations and deepened the feeling of friendship through its diverse exchange activities.
A friendly meeting between the delegation of Korean women officials and members of the Russian Women's Union took place in Moscow on July 22.
Speeches were made at the meeting attended by the delegation of Korean women officials led by Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the DPRK mission in Russia, the chairwoman and other major figures of the Russian Women's Union and members of the Russian foreign ministry.
Kim Jong Sun said that the meeting is a peculiar and significant meeting demonstrating at home and abroad the common desire and will of the women of the two countries to uphold the noble intention of the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia.
The Korean women will make a substantial contribution to the development of the strategic and cooperative relations between the DPRK and the Russian Federation which greeted a historic turning point in close cooperation with the Russian women, she stressed.
The chairwoman of the Russian Women's Union said that the visit of the delegation of women officials of the DPRK, a genuine fraternal country, would mark an important occasion in developing dialogue, exchange, friendly and cooperative relations between the women's organizations of the two countries.
Noting that the invincibility of the Russia-DPRK friendship is clearly proved by the top leaders of the two countries, she expressed the will of her union to fulfill its mission and role in further boosting the bilateral cooperative relations.
The participants watched photos dealing with the undying feats performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations and videos showing the happiness of the DPRK women and the work of the Russian Women's Union.
A cooperative agreement on the development of friendly relations between the Socialist Women's Union of Korea and the Russian Women's Union was signed.
Meanwhile, the delegation of Korean women officials visited the building of the State Duma of Russia on July 23.
When the delegation of Korean women officials entered a room for invited guests in the hall, all the deputies to the State Duma stood up to welcome it warmly at the proposal of Byacheslav Wolodin, the speaker of the State Duma.
Expressed at a meeting and talk with the first vice-chairwoman of the International Affairs Committee of the State Duma and other women deputies were the unshakable support and solidarity of the DPRK women with the Russian people and women in their struggle to defend the sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity of the country.
During the stay, the delegation toured a museum on Poklonnaya Hill and other places in Moscow. -0-

headline: SPA Delegation Leaves for Geneva
DPRK People's Struggle Supported Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Foreign organizations and personages issued statements on the occasions of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War and the June 25-July 27 month of anti-U.S. joint struggle.
The Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Thailand in a statement said that PresidentKim Il Sungwisely led all the people to defeat the U.S. imperialists who boasted of being the "strongest" in the world in the Korean war and defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country.
His exploits for the victory in the war recorded in the world history of the anti-imperialist struggle are shining thanks to HEKim Jong Iland HEKim Jong Un, the statement said.
The Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in a statement condemned the U.S. imperialists for igniting a war of aggression against the two-year old DPRK, reducing its cities and villages to ashes and brutally killing many innocent Koreans.
It also disclosed that the U.S. imperialists are persistently resorting to sanctions and pressure against the DPRK and moves for aggression against it in collusion with their followers, far from drawing a lesson from the Korean war in the 1950s.
It strongly demanded the U.S. to immediately stop all its acts threatening the DPRK, expressing solidarity with the DPRK people in their struggle for defending the sovereignty.
The director of the International Department of the Socialist Workers' Party of Croatia said in a statement that his party was pleased to see the fact that the DPRK people are not only firmly defending the sovereignty and dignity of the country, resolutely foiling the U.S. imperialists' moves for a war of aggression, but also dynamically accelerating the socialist construction despite the complicated international political situation.
He noted that the DPRK people's struggle against the U.S. threat serves as a contribution to global peace and he fully supports their struggle. -0-

headline: Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- There is the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, a grand monumental edifice symbolizing the eternal victory of the DPRK, on the bank of the Pothong River in Pyongyang.
The museum, opened in August 1953, was newly built into a grand museum telling about the history and tradition of the great victory in the war under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Uninitiated the project for remodeling the museum and solved all problems arising in the project ranging from designing to the formation of construction forces and supply of materials.
He visited the construction site several times to indicate the orientation and ways for successfully remodeling the museum to glorify the immortal exploits performed by PresidentKim Il Sungfor winning the victory in the war and vividly show the merits of the service personnel and people and the enemy's defeat.
While guiding the work of the Mansudae Art Studio and various sectors of the People's Army, he watched the art works depicting the President, the historical mementoes and data to be displayed at the museum and set forth the principle to be observed in creating art works and finding historical data.
The Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum with a vast area centered on the sculpture "Victory" bearing the letters "Respects to the Great Years" written byKim Jong Unis a precious outcome of his wise leadership and indefatigable devotion.
The museum opened in the presence ofKim Jong Unon July 27, 2013 on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. It has a main hall, Taejon Hall, outdoor exhibition hall and others.
The exhibits of the museum increases as historical data on the exploits performed by the President for wining the victory in the war and relics showing the struggle of the service personnel and people in the war have been found and displayed.
Over the past 70 years many service personnel, working people, school youth and children have visited the museum and a large contingent of heroes and patriots carrying forward the tradition of the victorious wartime generation grew up to glorify and defend the dignity of the country and people, thus making a history of fresh victory in the history of the DPRK.
The history of the DPRK won victory in the war is given steady continuity along with the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum. -0-

headline: Feats and Life of Victorious Wartime Generation Shining under Care of Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the great V-Day (July 27), the Korean people and service personnel of the People's Army pay high tribute to the victorious wartime generation, the masters of the legendary heroic era.
Though more than 70 years have passed since the war ceased, but the feats performed by the victorious wartime generation are still shining thanks to the benevolent care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho regards the noble spirit of defending the country and the revolution displayed by them as the most precious political legacy and highly puts forward them.
One day in July 2012, ahead of the 59th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War,Kim Jong Untold officials to significantly and splendidly celebrate July 27, which shines with the war victory exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, as the holiday of victors, and gave instructions on taking care of the delegates of war veterans to be taken part in the celebrations with the greatest sincerity.
Kim Jong Unstressed the need to make it a tradition to invite the war veterans to Pyongyang every year and celebrate the great V-Day with splendor as a significant holiday of victors.
The noble image ofKim Jong Unmaking sure that the V-Day is significantly celebrated every year and paying tribute to the victors of the great years at the events commemorating the victory in the war is deeply kept in the hearts of the people across the country.
Under his energetic leadership, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum was built as the grand palace of victory conveying to the whole world the heroic feats of the victorious wartime generation and the noble spirit of defending the country, and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery, where the Workers' Party of Korea became a grave owner, was built in the best place in Pyongyang.
Indeed, the life of the victorious wartime generation is shining more brilliantly under the care ofKim Jong Unwho puts forward the war veterans as excellent revolutionary forerunners, proud heroes of the nation and genuine patriots and repeatedly shows loving care and benevolence to them. -0-

headline: SPA Delegation Leaves for Geneva
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Chairman Pak In Chol left here on July 26 to take part in the Sixth World Conference of Speakers of Parliament to be held in Geneva, Switzerland.
It was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Maeng Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly. -0-

headline: Brisk Activities of Delegation of Korean Women Officials on Visit to Russia
story_text:

headline: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- There took place an evening gala of youth and students in Pyongyang atKim Il SungSquare on July 26 to celebrate the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
The gala began with the song "July 27, Our Victory Day".
Amid the play of the song, the youth and students danced, forming the letters "July 27" and "Victory".
They danced to the tune of the song "Holiday of Great War Victory", paying high tribute and extending eternal glory to PresidentKim Il Sungwho made a miracle of wining victory in the war with the Juche-oriented military idea, outstanding strategy and tactics and rare military leadership and defended the dignity and sovereignty of the country.
The atmosphere of the gala was revved up with songs "Cheers of the People" and "Your Embrace Is the Best" dealing with the great pride and supreme happiness of holding in high esteem the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho is demonstrating to the whole world the power and prestige of Juche Korea, ushering in new era of the greatest and the most dignified power.
Fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky over the square full of the joy and enthusiasm of youth.
The gala ended with the song "We Will Defend GeneralKim Jong Unwith Our Lives". -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The DPRK-ROK relations have gone completely beyond the time zone of the concept of homogenous" on Monday:
The suspension of loudspeaker broadcasting against the DPRK, a halt to leaflet scattering and the allowance of individual ROK people for tour of the DPRK - these are details of the "sincere efforts" the Lee Jae Myung government of the ROK made since the moment of coming into office with hope for improved relations with the DPRK.
In addition to that, Jong Tong Yong, newly-appointed minister of Unification, proposed putting an end to the time of power for power and opening up the time of addressing the good will in kind, the time of reconciliation and cooperation, talking about the revival of the disappeared peace and the restoration of the collapsed south-north relations.
Recently, he is spinning a daydream, guessing the possibility of inviting someone to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit to be held in Kyongju a few months later.
We did not care who is elected president or what policy is being pursued in the ROK and, therefore, have not made any assessment of it so far.
But this time I'm going to make our stand clear.
As for the suspension of the anti-DPRK psychological propaganda broadcasting which the ROK authorities described as the first signal for the restoration of confidence between the south and the north, all this is the scourge they have voluntarily invited and thus it is the issue of themselves no matter how they settle it and is nothing but a reversible turning back of what they should not have done in the first place.
In other words, it is not the work worthy of appreciation.
If the ROK, which had stoked the atmosphere of extreme confrontation in the past after unilaterally declaring the DPRK as its principal enemy, expected that it could reverse all the results it had made with a few sentimental words, nothing is more serious miscalculation than it.
The past few years that the Lee Jae Myung government described as the worst and foolish period were not only the meaningless time for the DPRK.
The DPRK could reach a very important historical conclusion that the ROK, whether it advocates the "democracy" or assumes the mask of "conservativeness", can never be the partner of reconciliation and cooperation and throw away the preconceived idea contradictory to the reality after breaking away with a very tired and uncomfortable history fettered by the rhetorical expression of fellow countrymen.
We can confirm once again that the true nature of the ROK politician who is surely enslaved to the departed spirit of unification by absorption can not be changed as the fact shows that he has set as a task of the times the normal operation of the Ministry of Unification that must be dissolved along with the reality in which the state-to-state relations are permanently fixed on the Korean peninsula.
When only the 50-odd days since Lee Jae Myung's assumption to power are brought to light, leaving aside the past history of the successive regimes of the ROK, the ROK authorities made such sweet remarks as defusing tension on the Korean peninsula and improving the DPRK-ROK relations, but their blind trust to the ROK-U.S. alliance and their attempt to stand in confrontation with the DPRK are little short of their predecessor's.
The land of the ROK adjacent to our southern border will be stained by powder fumes through the successive large-scale joint military drills of aggressive nature, and the U.S. and the ROK will try to shift the blame for the deteriorating situation on the Korean peninsula caused by them onto us as they did in the past. The world will soon witness it.
No matter how desperately the Lee Jae Myung government may try to imitate the fellow countrymen and pretend they do all sorts of righteous things to attract our attention and receive international attention, there can be no change in our state's understanding of the enemy and they can not turn back the hands of the clock of the history which has radically changed the character of the DPRK-ROK relations.
We clarify once again the official stand that no matter what policy is adopted and whatever proposal is made in Seoul, we have no interest in it and there is neither the reason to meet nor the issue to be discussed with the ROK.
The DPRK-ROK relations have irreversibly gone beyond the time zone of the concept of homogeneous. -0-

headline: Drivers' Heroic Feats during Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- The history of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War is recorded with the feats of drivers of the Korean People's Army who drove trucks through fire and ensured wartime transport, displaying matchless heroism, self-sacrificing spirit and mass heroism.
The drivers grew up to be a force capable of performing a part of defending the country in a short span of time thanks to the measures taken by PresidentKim Il Sungwho instructed on strengthening the rank of drivers in January 1948, before the founding of the regular revolutionary armed forces.
During the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953), they carried munitions. The total running distance is more than 242 million kilometers and the total volume of transport over 500.368 million tons.
Among them were the indomitable brave soldiers who rushed into hails of bullets without hesitation to carry out the leader's order.
Ham Thae Ju, a driver, carried over 320 tons of munitions by traveling nearly 50 000 km between the front and the rear a hundred and dozens of times a year alone. He was awarded the title of Hero of the Republic in April 1952.
In June 1951, Kim Su Gun, Jo Jae Phung and Pae Won Ju received the title of Hero of the Republic on the same day as they cleared mines and time bombs dropped by enemy planes on the road to the front.
14 drivers were awarded the title of Hero of the Republic in the three-year war.
Thanks to the heroic struggle of the drivers, wartime transport like an artery connecting the front and the rear was not stopped even for a moment.
Among the wartime songs sung by the Korean people is a song about the drivers. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Commemorative March of Columns Symbolic of Units in Fatherland Liberation War Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of the commemorative march of the columns symbolic of the units in the Fatherland Liberation War took place in Pyongyang on the evening of July 27, the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the war.
The plaza of the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium was crowded with citizens of the capital city who came to see the ceremony of the commemorative march.
Leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs took the platform together with war veterans.
The chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the Workers' Party of Korea and the commanders of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army took the platform.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and members of foreign missions here.
Seen in the auditorium were the participants in the celebrations of the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, officials of the Party Central Committee, soldiers of the artillery sub-unit under the 4th Corps of the KPA who were invited to the celebrations of the V-Day as special guests and other service personnel, officials of ministries and national agencies and officials, meritorious persons, students of revolutionary schools, youth and students in Pyongyang.
The combined military band showed a ceremony with light melodies and peculiar skills, adding to the joy of the people celebrating July 27 of the victory and glory of Juche Korea generation after generation.
When the bugle call was sounded signaling the start of the march, the march started led by the column symbolic of the Bodyguard Company holding the portrait of PresidentKim Il Sung, the ever-victorious and iron-willed brilliant commander.
The portraits of and the passionate loyalists including Hyon Chol Hae, Yon Hyong Muk, Pak Song Bong and Sim Chang Wan who were the first generation guards of the powerful revolutionary army became the solid bulletproof walls defending the Supreme Headquarters, the destiny of Korea, were shining in the ranks of the marchers like a cluster of stars of loyalty defending the sun.
The columns, symbolic of legendary guards divisions that performed distinguished feats in the fierce three-year Fatherland Liberation War, entered the plaza in fine array, flying the colours of the Guards, which had fluttered at the square of the parade for celebrating the victory in the war.
Columns of the march passed accompanied by valuable memories of the 1 129 days of the Fatherland Liberation War in which commanding officers and soldiers of ordinary workers, peasants, youth and students origins created legendary feats and heroic tales about war victory, defending the new world of people they greeted for the first time in the history spanning fifty centuries, the national flag of an independent and sovereign state raised by them and the cradle of their happy life.
The honorary representatives of the victorious wartime generation including the phoenixes who blocked the enemy's pillbox with their chests and pressed the triggers of heavy machine-guns with their chins when their limbs were broken, the brave hero who threw himself to the enemy position with a hand grenade in his mouth, an artillery hero, a sniper hero and a hero of aircraft-hunting team for their only motherland passed together with the columns symbolic of guards divisions.
Marching past the plaza were the column symbolic of the Ministry of the Interior holding the portraits of scouts who had fought valiantly till their last moment for victory in the war on the front and in the battlefield without gunfire and the security workers who hastened the day of war victory while sacrificing their all in the invisible outpost line for defending the leader, social system and people and the column symbolic of railway soldiers conveying the matchless feats of wartime transport soldiers who had rushed to the front through a hail of bullets.
The columns of the three services of the KPA entered the plaza following the symbolic columns.
The army column marched with the colours of the Ministry of National Defence and large combined units demonstrating the tremendous might to inflict the most disastrous defeat to the enemies incomparable to the war in the 1950s with formidable offensive power and overwhelming military muscle that no one can stop by charging the strongest absolute weaponry in the world with the revolutionary idea of the great Party Central Committee.
Marched past in high spirit were the navy column making immortal tracks in the course of defending the country while displaying the modernity of the Juche-oriented naval force which is making rapid progress with the might and spirit of Juche Korea spreading far into the ocean, and the air force column with the high pride of being lifeguards of the Party Central Committee, the first death-defying corps of defending revolution and the brave flying corps in the sky.
The KPA Air Force squadron passed in the sky above the plaza in a fan-shaped formation, joyfully decorating the end of the event.
At the end of the ceremony, fireworks were set off shaking the earth and sky and beautifully adorning the nocturnal sky of the V-Day. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- More than 3.5 million people have visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in the DPRK for the past twelve years since its remodeling.
The museum, newly built on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the war victory under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, consists of a main hall and Taejon Hall and outdoor exhibition hall.
The revolutionary relics, historical relics, all wartime data and exhibits displayed at the museum make an impression on the visitors as they show in depth the Juche-oriented military ideology and theory, outstanding commanding art and noble traits of PresidentKim Il Sungand the spirit of defending the country displayed by the service personnel and people of the DPRK who fought with a dauntless spirit while defending even an inch of land of the country at the cost of their blood.
The exhibited data at the museum are getting richer as historical data showing the revolutionary exploits of the President who led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and relics showing the struggle of the victorious wartime generation are continuously found and displayed.
Going round various places of the museum, the visitors keenly realize once again how the President led the work of the Party, state and army during the war, how fierce and difficult the Fatherland Liberation War was and how valuable the spirit of defending the leader unto death, the spirit of defending the country and the indomitable fighting spirit displayed by the service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the people in the war were. -0-

headline: Victorious Wartime Generation's Great Spirit of Defending Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- People in the DPRK are well aware that their happiness is unthinkable without the indomitable fighting spirit of the heroes who devoted their youth and lives to their beloved country without hesitation, and that if they forget it even for a moment, they will become slaves of the enemy again. Therefore, they have cherished the heroic spirit and brilliant feats of the victorious wartime generation as the priceless moral treasure.
The ever-victorious history of our country will continue to be created forever thanks to the successors who are steadfastly carrying forward the revolution, bearing in mind as a symbol of victory the spirit of defending the country displayed by the heroes who defended even an inch of the land at the cost of their blood. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- More than 3.5 million people have visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in the DPRK for the past twelve years since its remodeling.
The museum, newly built on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the war victory under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, consists of a main hall and Taejon Hall and outdoor exhibition hall.
The revolutionary relics, historical relics, all wartime data and exhibits displayed at the museum make an impression on the visitors as they show in depth the Juche-oriented military ideology and theory, outstanding commanding art and noble traits of PresidentKim Il Sungand the spirit of defending the country displayed by the service personnel and people of the DPRK who fought with a dauntless spirit while defending even an inch of land of the country at the cost of their blood.
The exhibited data at the museum are getting richer as historical data showing the revolutionary exploits of the President who led the Fatherland Liberation War to victory and relics showing the struggle of the victorious wartime generation are continuously found and displayed.
Going round various places of the museum, the visitors keenly realize once again how the President led the work of the Party, state and army during the war, how fierce and difficult the Fatherland Liberation War was and how valuable the spirit of defending the leader unto death, the spirit of defending the country and the indomitable fighting spirit displayed by the service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the people in the war were. -0-

headline: Drivers' Heroic Feats during Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- The history of the great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War is recorded with the feats of drivers of the Korean People's Army who drove trucks through fire and ensured wartime transport, displaying matchless heroism, self-sacrificing spirit and mass heroism.
The drivers grew up to be a force capable of performing a part of defending the country in a short span of time thanks to the measures taken by PresidentKim Il Sungwho instructed on strengthening the rank of drivers in January 1948, before the founding of the regular revolutionary armed forces.
During the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953), they carried munitions. The total running distance is more than 242 million kilometers and the total volume of transport over 500.368 million tons.
Among them were the indomitable brave soldiers who rushed into hails of bullets without hesitation to carry out the leader's order.
Ham Thae Ju, a driver, carried over 320 tons of munitions by traveling nearly 50 000 km between the front and the rear a hundred and dozens of times a year alone. He was awarded the title of Hero of the Republic in April 1952.
In June 1951, Kim Su Gun, Jo Jae Phung and Pae Won Ju received the title of Hero of the Republic on the same day as they cleared mines and time bombs dropped by enemy planes on the road to the front.
14 drivers were awarded the title of Hero of the Republic in the three-year war.
Thanks to the heroic struggle of the drivers, wartime transport like an artery connecting the front and the rear was not stopped even for a moment.
Among the wartime songs sung by the Korean people is a song about the drivers. -0-

headline: Large Panorama Conveying Victory and Glory of Great Years
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- At the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum in the DPRK, there is a large panorama "Operation for Liberating Taejon" which vividly shows the matchless bravery and mass heroism displayed by the officers and men of the Korean People's Army during the Fatherland Liberation War.
The battle for liberating Taejon conducted on July 20, 1950 under the operational policy advanced by PresidentKim Il Sungis recognized in the world history of wars as an example of the modern siege warfare that various arms of the People's Army encircled large enemy forces and annihilated them through the reasonable combination of our style combat forms and methods.
In the battle which ended seven hours after the start of the attack, the 24th Infantry Division of the U.S. imperialists which had been bluffing as the "undefeated division" and the 1st and 7th divisions of the ROK army were completely annihilated, and Commander of the 24th Infantry Division of the U.S. imperialists Dean in poor soldier's uniform was captured by a soldier of the People's Army on a way of escape.
The large panorama vividly depicting the historical environment and combat situation at that time consists of four parts (the part of encirclement and annihilation, the part of reverence, the part of cutting off the enemy's retreat and reinforcement and the part of defeat of the U.S. imperialists) which are 15 meters high and over 130 meters round.
The President unfolded a plan to create and display large panorama of the operation for liberating Taejon at the newly-built Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and watched the completed work, saying that the large panorama is a masterpiece and that it is well planned and high in artistic representation.
The People's Prize was awarded to the large panorama which showed the victory in the battle for liberating Taejon on April 14, 1974.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and highly appreciated the large panorama and advanced a plan to enrich the representation as required by the new century.
The newly depicted large panorama shines as the immortal picture of victory and glory of the great years. -0-

headline: Receptions Given to Celebrate 72nd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- Receptions were given at the People's Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant and Chongryu Restaurant here on Sunday, the 72nd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
Present there as the guests were war veterans and persons of wartime merits who participated in the celebrations of V-Day.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae, Pak Jong Chon and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs.
Congratulatory speeches were made at the receptions.
Speakers warmly congratulated the war veterans for defending and glorifying at the cost of their blood the precious country to be lived by all generations to come on the occasion of the great V-Day which turned our state into heroic Korea and made its people the heroic people.
They said that the venues of the receptions are full of boundless reverence for those who defended all the precious things from the enemy's plunder and have glorified the 80-year history of modern Korea with victory and glory as the witnesses who experienced the glory of August 15, the day when a radical turn was brought about in the destiny of the people, and are remembering the eventful days of the founding of our Party and Republic.
They noted that the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean people are always remembering the fact that the costly self-sacrifice, blood and sweat of the victorious wartime generation permeate each page of history in which the national name and the national flag of the newly-born DPRK have shined as a symbol of the Korean people's heroism and the signpost of anti-imperialist independence before the times, and the true path of socialist construction was pioneered.
They stressed that they would firmly defend the dignity and honor of the country and attain without fail the grand goals of building a prosperous power by courageously struggling with the faith of absolute loyalty and indomitable fighting spirit handed down by the wartime brave soldiers, bearing in mind the desire and earnest request of the war veterans who wish their beloved country to be strong and prosperous forever.
The participants in the receptions toasted the eternal victory and prosperity of the DPRK, the gains of the revolution, in which the great soul of the forerunners are permeated, the glory and happiness of the people, and the health and eternal youth of the victorious wartime generation. -0-
