Efforts Made in Kangwon Province to Improve Ecological Environment
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- Kangwon Province of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to improve the ecological environment.
Atmosphere monitoring posts have been built in the Pongchun-dong area of Wonsan City and the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area.
More measuring instruments related to the protection of the atmosphere have been installed in Wonsan and Munchon cities and Chonnae County to increase the capability of monitoring the environment.
The province saw to it that the provincial environmental protection institute has examined and analyzed the water quality of the sea in a regular way. It also took steps to investigate the status of the ecological environment in factories and enterprises in the province, and to prevent any factors of environmental pollution. The province ensures that the relevant sectors, including the ones of road improvement, urban management, forestry, agriculture and river improvement, put efforts into improving the ecological environment by planting more turfs in the areas under their charge.
The province is also making an effort to resolve the sci-tech problem arising in improving the urban ecological environment in cooperation with the provincial commission of science and technology. -0-

headline: SPA Delegation Takes Part in Sixth World Conference of Speakers of Parliament
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took part in the Sixth World Conference of Speakers of Parliament held in Geneva, Switzerland from July 29 to 31.
The conference, attended by the president and the secretary general of the Inter-Parliamentary Union, the speakers of parliaments and parliamentary delegations from different countries, discussed the issues of strengthening cooperation and multilateralism among the parliaments in achieving global peace and prosperity and realizing international justice.
Pak In Chol, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, made a speech at the conference.
Denouncing the high-handed and arbitrary practices of the imperialists who plunge the world into social instability and chaos in order to maintain their monopolistic and hegemonic position, he stressed that in order to build a world where peace, justice and prosperity are guaranteed, each country should achieve independent development and, at the same time, establish international relations respecting the sovereign rights of all countries.
The Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK is dynamically conducting sovereign activities for defending the sovereignty and dignity of the country and achieving the prosperity and happiness of the people by its own efforts, he said, adding that the DPRK people are achieving miraculous successes in the struggle for the comprehensive development of the state, rallied close with patriotism around the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
He stressed that the DPRK would fulfill its responsibility for genuine international justice, global peace and stability and strengthen the relations with friendly parliaments respecting the dignity and national interests of the DPRK.
During the conference, Pak In Chol, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, separately met and had talks with the president and the secretary general of the Inter-Parliamentary Union, the chairman of the Federation Council of Russia, the chairperson of the State Great Hural of Mongolia, the chairperson of the Vietnamese National Assembly and the vice-president of the Lao National Assembly.
The chairman of the Russian Federation Council said that he regarded it as a great honor to visit the DPRK in 2018 and meet ComradeKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs, and asked to convey his sincerest greetings toKim Jong Un.
The main factor that put the relations between the two countries on the highest level in history as alliance and comradely relations is the fruition of the deep intimacy between the top leaders of Russia and the DPRK, he said, stressing that the bilateral relations proved their worth smashing all kinds of challenges in the past two years since the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
The Russian stand in supporting the DPRK remains unchanged, he said, affirming that the Russian Federation Council and the State Duma would be faithful to the spirit of the treaty between the two countries.
The chairperson of the State Great Hural of Mongolia asked to convey greetings from Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, hoping that the diligent and patriotic DPRK people making fresh progress in various fields including economic construction would achieve greater successes in the future, too.
The talks expressed full support for the struggle of the DPRK people in building a powerful state and the will to develop the friendly and cooperative relations between parliaments. -0-

headline: Mass Movements Launched among Women's Union Organizations in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- Officials and members of the women's union in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are actively conducting mass movements conducive to the development of the regional economy and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
Members of the women's union in Jangyon County went to farms to transplant rice seedlings in hundreds of hectares of paddy fields, readjust paddy ridges extending tens of thousands of metres and harvest wheat and barley in nearly 100 hectares of fields.
Women in Haeju City, Thaethan County and other regions in the province contributed to attaining this year's goals of grain production at over 200 farms.
Officials of the women's union in Unryul and Sinwon counties are setting practical examples while rousing the masses to the movement for winning the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
The women's union committee in Paechon County has increased the production of meat and fur considerably more than last year and Chongdan County is taking measures to increase the number of rabbits.
Officials and members of the women's union in Jaeryong and Ongjin counties set goals to mass-produce castor beans and laid a foundation for producing high yields by cultivating castor-oil plant in a scientific way.
Meanwhile, city and county women's union organizations are pushing ahead with the production of cocoons while giving precedence to the creation of mulberry fields and directing efforts to securing high-yielding silkworm species and materials. -0-

headline: Successes Achieved in Grain Management Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- The grain management sector in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to improve grain management.
The Ministry of Grain Administration is directing efforts to the procurement of early crops and, at the same time, progressing the work to increase the capacity for processing grain and the quality of processed goods.
The Hamhung and Wonsan wheat processing factories, the Pyoksong County Grain Management Station and other provincial, city and county grain management sectors are pushing forward with as scheduled the targets set for this year including the expansion of the wheat processing capacity and the construction of grain storage facilities.
The Pyongyang Grain Processing Machine Factory is stepping up the work to produce Korean-style wheat processing equipment with great capacity. -0-

headline: Achievements Made in Construction of Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- Officers and men of the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army dispatched to Puryong and Kilju counties of North Hamgyong Province are expanding the successes in the construction of regional-industry factories.
The soldier-builders involved in the construction of the regional-industry factories in Puryong County are strengthening the skilled workers' forces and assigning detailed tasks to enhance the spirit of evaluating the construction according to qualitative indices.
They are pushing ahead with all processes by using construction equipment and tools while rationally organizing manpower.
The service personnel involved in the construction of regional-industry factories in Kilju County are building structures including garment factory and daily necessities factory while improving the level of specialization in construction.
They are perfecting every element of the structures by supplying materials such as cement in time while arranging the area to add beauty to the surrounding landscape. -0-

headline: Efficacious Mixed Herbicide Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- The Institute of Agro-chemicalization under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK developed a mixed herbicide.
The newly developed mixed herbicide is efficacious for completely removing all aquatic weeds by suppressing photosynthesis, energy metabolism and protein synthesis after infiltration into shoots, roots, stems and leaves of various weeds growing in rice fields.
In particular, it can root out different kinds of weeds which are propagated in large quantities due to the recent high temperature.
The herbicide has great economic value as it keeps its efficacy for more than several ten days.
It is proved in practice at farms across the country that its effect of weeding is very high.
The institute is taking measures to further increase the introduction effect of the mixed herbicide while consolidating its success. -0-

headline: Ryanggang Province Makes Efforts to Implement Economic Development Plan
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province in the DPRK is concentrating its efforts on implementing the provincial economic development plan.
On the basis of the experience gained in establishing the production processes and assembling equipment at the regional-industry factories in Kim Hyong Jik County, it is taking practical measures to renew the production lines of regional-industry factories.
The Taehongdan County Potato-processing Factory completed the technical upgrading of the overall production processes, and the Chongbong General Foodstuff Factory is remodeling in a streamlined way the lines for producing sugar-coated beans and pop-rice cakes.
The Hyesan Essential Plastic Goods Production Station is securing the equipment needed for establishing the plastic pipes production line after supplying the products for the rural housing construction in the province during the first half of the year.
The province helps the cities and counties work out the plans for using their locally available raw and other materials and implement them by emulating the success of Kim Hyong Jik County, which makes soaps with its locally available materials
The city and county raw materials bases are producing raw materials needed for keeping the production at regional-industry factories going at a high rate.
While pressing ahead with the construction of the regional-industry factories planned this year, including the rebuilding of the Hyesan Condiments Factory, the province is paying attention to training skilled workers. -0-

headline: Preparations for Operating Leisure Complexes Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Multi-functional leisure complexes are now under construction in Kangdong County, Pyongyang Municipality, Jongphyong County in South Hamgyong Province and Kaephung District in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK.
The non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20 x 10 Policy is intensifying its guidance to help the relevant regions make preparations for operating the leisure complexes.
Under the guidance of the committee, Pyongyang Municipality held a workshop on commerce, public catering service and welfare service at Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce and the municipal school of commerce and technology for the persons selected from Kangdong County.
South Hamgyong Province has sent teachers of the provincial-level commercial service education units to Jongphyong County to give training courses for various occupations.
Kaesong Municipality has organized a technical short course and passing-on technique for the employees of the leisure complex at Koryo Songgyungwan University and the municipal school of commerce and technology.
Officials in the library field of Kangdong county, Jongphyong county and Kaephung District leisure complexes are learning necessary practical techniques at the Sci-tech Complex from June. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Reckless Military Moves
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Japan is putting spurs to deploying home-made long-range missiles for action.
According to a report, it will deploy type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles with the firing range of 1 000 km for action in Kumamoto by the end of 2025.
It is expected that the missiles will be deployed for action in Oita, Okinawa and other areas next year.
In this regard, Japanese media and politicians are openly boasting that Japan came to secure the "capability of attacking enemy base" in actuality.
It is a very dangerous move.
From some years ago, Japan has updated the type 12 surface-to-ship guided missile with longer firing range capable of being launched from ground, ship and fighter while asserting that it should secure the "capability of counterstrike".
The deployment of missiles capable of striking neighboring countries by going far beyond the scope of "exclusive defense" is not aimed to contain "threat" from someone but to secure Japan's capability for a preemptive attack to realize its ambition for the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" from A to Z.
Japan is now getting closer to the environment in which it can translate into action the war of aggression by reinforcing, reorganizing and modernizing its military muscle according to its "national security strategy", "national defense strategy" and "defense capability buildup outline".
What is noteworthy is that all these military moves are orientated to attain the purpose for preemptive attack.
The "integrated operation command" was newly organized to smoothly use long-range missiles, and the plan for forming missile units had already been completed.
In order to evade the denunciation of the world people, Japan had staged missile launching drills abroad but is openly conducting them in its mainland from June this year to improve its actual war capability.
In particular, the space militarization being enforced by Japan with the expenditure of a huge amount of money is being focused on ensuring the suddenness and accuracy of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles, high-speed gliding projectiles and hypersonic guided missiles.
Under such circumstance, the deployment of long-range missiles for action in different parts of Japan is little short of loading a bullet into an assembled weapon.
In the "2025 defense white paper", Japan termed the DPRK and other neighboring countries the "imminent threat" and the "unprecedented, greatest strategic challenge". This more clearly shows who the target of Japan is.
It was recently disclosed that while talking about the "theory on threat" from the DPRK and other neighboring countries, Japan instigated its master to make even a "nuclear strike" on them. This is evoking the strong vigilance of the international community.
The reality goes to prove that Japan, obsessed with the moves to turn it into a military giant, is making desperate efforts to bring earlier the day when it will launch reinvasion by accelerating the deployment of long-range strike means for a preemptive attack for action.
The war criminal state should not act rashly.
The day of reinvasion Japan tries to bring earlier so much will be the day when it sets foot in a hell without revival. -0-

headline: Agricultural Guidance Organs Take Measures to Cope with Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- Agricultural guidance organs at all levels of the DPRK are taking technical and practical measures to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
The Agricultural Commission is intensifying technical guidance to accurately predict the negative effects of various abnormal climates on the growth of crops and minimize the yield reduction.
The South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provincial rural economy committees are generalizing the farming experience gained in the areas that increased high and safe yields by putting manuring and cultivation on a scientific basis in conformity with the growth of crops in the past.
The North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee is pushing ahead with technical guidance to introduce and generalize various kinds of advanced water management methods and growth promoters into the immediate farming.
The Kangwon Provincial Rural Economy Committee is directing efforts to minimizing damage to crops and farmland caused by heavy rain and standing water in cities and counties.
The Hoeryong City Rural Economy Committee in North Hamgyong Province is introducing and generalizing the advanced farming techniques and farming methods to promote the growth of crops and ensure the safe yield despite the changing weather conditions.
The work to prevent disasters is being pushed forward by the Paechon County Rural Economy Committee in South Hwanghae Province, the Yonggwang County Rural Economy Committee in South Hamgyong Province and other city and county rural economy committees. -0-

headline: Foundation for Turning Out Dairy Products further Intensified in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK has given face-lifting to the rooms for turning out dairy products to perfect the production foundation on a higher level.
The province grasped the hygienic environment and equipment of production rooms and sent technical guidelines for ensuring the hygienic safety of dairy products to ris in rural areas.
Kumchon County completed the project for building more than 10 production rooms for dairy products.
Sinphyong County has made progress in improving the quality of dairy products and storing them by providing the equipment for turning out dairy products and new equipment.
The counties of Unpha and Hwangju have remodeled the production rooms. -0-

headline: Agricultural Guidance Organs Take Measures to Cope with Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- Agricultural guidance organs at all levels of the DPRK are taking technical and practical measures to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
The Agricultural Commission is intensifying technical guidance to accurately predict the negative effects of various abnormal climates on the growth of crops and minimize the yield reduction.
The South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provincial rural economy committees are generalizing the farming experience gained in the areas that increased high and safe yields by putting manuring and cultivation on a scientific basis in conformity with the growth of crops in the past.
The North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee is pushing ahead with technical guidance to introduce and generalize various kinds of advanced water management methods and growth promoters into the immediate farming.
The Kangwon Provincial Rural Economy Committee is directing efforts to minimizing damage to crops and farmland caused by heavy rain and standing water in cities and counties.
The Hoeryong City Rural Economy Committee in North Hamgyong Province is introducing and generalizing the advanced farming techniques and farming methods to promote the growth of crops and ensure the safe yield despite the changing weather conditions.
The work to prevent disasters is being pushed forward by the Paechon County Rural Economy Committee in South Hwanghae Province, the Yonggwang County Rural Economy Committee in South Hamgyong Province and other city and county rural economy committees. -0-

headline: Precise Prescription Given by President Kim Il Sung for Corn Farming
story_text:
One day in early autumn 1976, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the then Samjigang Cooperative Farm in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The rice on the farm was in good condition that year, but corn farming was not good.
In fact, the corns planted on the farm were not self-fertilizing because the corn tassels come out before corn silk and the pollen is blown off by wind.
So, the farm introduced another method, but as the method was laborious and technically difficult, the farm had no clear prescription for fertilizing corns until that time.
After acquainting himself with this fact, the President asked if there was the variety of corn whose tassels come out at a time when corn silk come out.
An official told him that there were various kinds of corns.
The President said that if the said-corns and the corns planted on the farm are planted together, they would be fertilized properly.
The moment, a wide prospect burst upon the views of officials.
The prescription given by the President was based on scientific insight into the physiological characteristics of corns doing self- and cross-fertilization, unlike rice. -0-

story_text:

headline: Choljuk-trademarked Socks Popular among DPRK People
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- Various kinds of Choljuk-trademarked socks sold at the commercial service units, including Pyongyang Department Store No. 1, are winning popularity among the people.
The socks produced at the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory are popular for their good quality and smartness.
The Choljuk-trademarked socks are associated with the warm loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has made efforts to provide the people with better daily necessities.
Visiting the factory one day in August 2014,Kim Jong Unacquainted himself in detail with the production and the quality of products and gave instructions to improve the management and operation of the factory.
He said that as the demand for socks varies according to season, trend, age and sex distinction, the factory should produce the goods suited to the tastes and characteristics of the people.
Advising officials of their wrong opinion that they were content with the mass-production of socks, he said that the socks should be produced in good quality and in a smart and diverse way. And he added that the trademark designs should be steadily updated and the products packed up well.
In the past, the factory introduced advanced technology to increase the variety of ground threads and installed the updated operation program of hosiery machine at the equipment, thus mass-producing new good products.
As the factory reflected the world trend in designs, more than 300 hosiery designs were introduced into production to develop new products in the first half of last year.
The Choljuk-trademarked socks are popular among the people for their diversity and good quality. -0-

Loving Care for Little Girl
story_text:
One day in November 2016, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the newly-remodeled Samjiyon Schoolchildren's Palace.
Making a round of the palace, he took a series of benevolent measures for children. Then he proposed to have a photo taken with group members.
The members ran to him with great pleasure and were eager to get closer to him, pushing the youngest girl at the back.
There, she wore a tearful face as she stood in the rear at the moment of honor.
But, unexpectedly, she came to receive a great honor.
Kim Jong Unwho looked at the children with great affection called her to come near.
As he held her on his lap and had a photo taken with the group members, her countenance brightened into a smile.
Her smile was the one of happiness that was brought about by the meticulous love of her real father. -0-

headline: Graphen Far-Infrared Rays Heating Element Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK developed the graphen far-infrared rays heating element with high efficiency of electric-thermal conversion and which is beneficial to health.
The element is a high-tech product made in the principle that heat discharges in the form of far-infrared rays radiation when electricity passes through carbon nano material.
Different types of far-infrared rays carbon nano radiators have the same heating effect as ordinary electric heaters while consuming less electricity. And they are fast in heating and good effective in treatment for various diseases and have no risk of fire.
Various kinds of radiators have been introduced into public health organs and many other units and highly appreciated for reducing the consumption of electricity for heating. -0-

headline: Support to Rural Youth Workteams and Sub-workteams
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK is helping the youth workteams and sub-workteams at farms.
The province set youth sub-workteams at the Naejung Farm in Yomju County and the Sinam Farm in Ryongchon County as model units, built hostels, youth schools, stables and greenhouses and provided them with LCD TVs, musical instruments and other cultural apparatuses.
Tongnim County newly erected the buildings for more than 10 rural youth workteams and sub-workteams, supplying building materials and goods and solving knotty problems.
Kusong and Jongju cities, Sonchon, Kwaksan and Cholsan counties are giving prominence to young people while providing them with better living conditions.
Encouraged by the guidance and assistance of officials in the province, young people of many farms are concentrating their efforts on carrying out the immediate farming process after over-fulfilling their plans for producing early crops. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls upon All Officials to Conduct Ideological Work
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- In order to successfully complete the five-year plan and bring about an upward trend towards a higher stage of development by further boosting the elated fighting spirit of all the people, officials should hold fast to the Juche-oriented theory of giving importance to ideology and more dynamically conduct the work with people, the ideological work, says Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an editorial.
When all officials wage a vigorous ideological offensive throughout the DPRK by dint of the weapon of ideology, the collective innovation movement will be launched in every workplace and miraculous successes in increasing production will be achieved one after another, the editorial says, and goes on:
What the Workers' Party of Korea believes in successfully attaining the goals of this year's struggle is the elated mental strength of the masses.
The infinite loyalty to the revolution and indomitable fighting spirit are given full play by the officials capable of conducting the ideological work to boost the revolutionary enthusiasm of the masses.
All the officials should glorify this year as a year of great turn by more dynamically and vigorously conducting the work with people, the ideological work with a firm viewpoint that nothing is impossible if they hold fast to ideology.
They should implant in the minds of masses the faith that our Party, our state and our social system are the best through the endless loving care and people-oriented policies of the Party and the state and the specific realities of our country which is changing as days go by.
Officials should instill into the producers the conviction that the goals of this year's struggle can be certainly attained by their own efforts, technology and resources to make them give full play to the fighting spirit of self-sustenance.
All the officials should hold fast to the Juche-oriented theory of giving importance to ideology as the banner of advance and dynamically conduct the work with people, the ideological work to achieve proud successes in the struggle for a new victory in the comprehensive national rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Advanced Farming Methods in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- The enthusiasm for introducing advanced farming methods is mounting across the DPRK.
Advanced farming methods and excellent agro-technical products including the method of raising rice seedlings in greenhouses, the method of cultivating nutritive cold-bed rice seedlings and phytosin have been introduced.
This year, South Phyongan Province has conducted the mulching cultivation in large areas of dry fields to solve the problem of manpower and save fertilizer.
The profitable farming method using mud snails has been introduced in the Yomju County of North Phyongan Province, Yonggwang County of South Hamgyong Province and at the Unjong Farm of Anak County of South Hwanghae Province and the Township Farm of Mundok County of South Phyongan Province.
The farms in Chongdan County, South Hwanghae Province strive to promote the growth of crops and prevent damage by blight and harmful insects by dint of laser technology.
The agricultural sci-tech service program "Golden Fruit" is winning popularity. -0-

headline: Basketball Tournament of Agricultural Workers Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- The 15th National Basketball Tournament of Agricultural Workers took place at the Basketball Gymnasium in Chongchun Street here from August 1 to 6.
24 men's and women's teams selected in Pyongyang and all provinces competed with each other, divided into four groups respectively, and the winners of each group played knock-out matches.
The men's team of South Hamgyong Province (the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm) and the women's team of North Phyongan Province (the Naejung Farm in Yomju County) won the first place at the finals held on Aug. 6.
Citations, cups and medals were awarded to the units and players who proved successful. -0-

headline: Construction of New Coal Mines and Pits in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- The coal mining industry of the DPRK is putting spurs to the construction of new coal mines and pits.
The Myongchon Area Coal Mining Complex is speeding up the construction of the Kukdong Coal Mine and the Pit No.1 of the Ryongban Coal Mine to produce hundreds of thousands of tons of more coal per year.
The Thaesan Coal Mine and the Youth Pit No. 2 of the Ryongbuk Youth Coal Mine under the Kyongwon Area Coal Mining Complex are accelerating the tunneling and installation of various kinds of equipment by dint of valuable technical innovation proposals and rational working methods.
The Phunggok Youth Coal Mine under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex is directing big efforts to building the Youth Pit. -0-

story_text:

Tiling of the exterior and plastering of the interior are now under way at the construction site.
The construction of a gymnasium with a total floor space of thousands of square meters is progressing apace. -0-

headline: Construction of Regional-Industry Factories in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- The construction of regional-industry factories and the production of equipment for the factories are progressing apace in different parts of the DPRK.
The soldiers of the 124th Regiment of the Korean People's Army (KPA) involved in the construction of regional-industry factories in Puryong County completed the construction of partition walls and the plastering of interior by introducing advanced construction methods.
The officers and soldiers of the 124th regiments of the KPA in charge of the construction of regional-industry factories in Taegwan and Sinyang counties are improving the speed and quality of interior projects.
The soldier-builders of the 124th regiments of the KPA dispatched to Sinpho City and Hwangju and Ryonggang counties are increasing the speed and quality of construction and introducing rational construction methods to shorten the working time of each process.
The non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy is increasing the proportion of locally available equipment.
The central industrial factories are pushing ahead with the production of hundreds of kinds of equipment while tapping internal reserves and introducing advanced techniques. -0-

story_text:

KCNA Commentary on Change of West's Stand on Palestine
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- When the residents in the Gaza Strip are on the verge of extinction owing to the moves of the U.S. and Israel, the efforts of the Western countries to recognize the State of Palestine have lately drawn attention.
On July 24, France announced that it would officially recognize the State of Palestine at the UN General Assembly to be held in September.
The United Kingdom, Canada and Finland expressed their intention to recognize Palestine as an independent state, though conditionally, and such current continues to expand.
It can be said that this is a grave change in the stand of the Western countries which have pursued a pro-Israel one-sided policy in pursuance of the U.S. in dealing with the issue of Palestine for a long time.
More than 140 UN member states have recognized Palestine as a state in support of the "two-state solution", but the G-7 and most of the EU members have so far turned away their faces from it.
Following the U.S. stand in dealing with the present crisis in the Gaza Strip, the West has given a green light to the Zionists' move to exterminate a nation, talking about Israel's unilateral "right to self-defence".
Then, is the sudden change of these countries' stand the "eruption" of the humanity, mercy and sense of justice of "Western gentlemen"?
It is not so.
It means that the Western countries have been in a difficult situation in which they can not blindly avail themselves of the U.S. and Israel any longer in settling the Middle East affairs.
As Israel persists in its unethical massacre, enforcing its policy on reducing the Gaza Strip to ashes, occupying it permanently and exterminating the Palestinians in disregard of international law and the humanitarian principle, the international community's censure and denunciation for the chieftain and wire-pullers are growing stronger day by day.
In particular, the U.S. has persistently exercised its veto over the matter related with the attainment of the position of Palestine as a full-fledged UN member state and inspired Israel with extinction of nation, making a gangster-like assertion that if Palestine acquires the same rights as member states, it is necessary to stop its expenditure on the UN. Its behavior is enraging the world people.
Witnessing the present wretched situation in the Gaza Strip, in which the whole zone has been reduced into a "hell on the ground" and all the survivors are little short of " walking dead bodies", the international community is censuring not only the U.S. and Israel but also the Western countries which assume the attitude of onlookers to the worst humanitarian crisis, blindly following them.
As well as misgiving that if they blindly follow the U.S. and Israel, they may be in the dock of the international court, the western countries came to be difficult in staying in power owing to the citizens' growing resentment against their government ignoring the unethical crimes in the Gaza Strip. Such situation made the ruling circle of the western countries no longer ignore the Palestinian affairs.
Although it is a sudden mutation caused by the political interests of the Western politicians like chameleon, the change in the pro-U.S. Western camp goes to prove again from a new angle that the international isolation against the U.S. and Israel, which trample down international justice and demands of the times, is growing and coming up to the surface with each passing day and a great breach is being made in the U.S.-led Western alliance.
Branding the western countries' stand as the "hasty decision", the U.S. and Israel assert vehemently that they will remain unchanged, no matter what they say.
The reality clearly shows that the more desperately the U.S. and Israel try to deprive the Palestinian people of their national rights for the building of an independent and sovereign state, the stronger the international efforts will be made to promote the building of the State of Palestine and the more quickly the evil forces will accelerate their ruin of their own accord.
No force on earth can stop the wheel of history toward independence and justice. -0-

Officials of the Mundok County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and power organs in the county visited her family to congratulate her on her birthday. -0-

headline: Scientific and Technological Guarantee for Implementing WPK's Policy on Regional Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- The Food and Consumer Goods Research Institute under the Ministry of Regional Industry is ensuring the implementation of the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on regional development in a scientific and technological way.
The research group of the Fermentation Research Institute went to the foodstuff factories in different parts of the country, including Kosan and Jaeryong counties, and solved the technical problems arising in improving the performance of equipment, including soy separator and filter press, thus enabling the factories increase their capacity of basic foodstuff production more than three times.
It also introduced the yeast with good qualitative characteristics into the Orang County Foodstuff Factory, thus increasing the actual extract rate of Korean gin made with acorn by more than 10 percent.
The researchers perfected a method of producing tasty paste with wheat as the main ingredient and raised the resolution rate of raw material 1.4 times, providing a scientific and technological guarantee for improving the quality of wheat paste.
The Foodstuff Research Institute also developed various kinds of cheese with locally available materials and indigenous technology and completed the technical guidelines necessary for production.
Its researchers made it possible to extend the storage time of Kimchi and preserve its peculiar taste by using phytosin and solved the technical problems arising in preserving the freshness of foodstuff and improving its quality. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique for Regional Medical Workers Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- The non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20 x 10 Policy is intensifying guidance to ensure that a passing-on technique for improving the academic qualifications and diagnostic  skills of regional medical workers is conducted successfully.
It is strengthening the system so that advanced medical service technologies are properly transferred to the regional medical workers.
At least 100 medical workers selected from the hospitals in Kangdong and Ryonggang counties and Kusong City are being instructed at the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital.
The non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20 x 10 Policy has directed efforts to the preparations for training course for directors and technical directors of city and county hospitals.

The committee is paying attention to the living conditions of regional medical workers so that they can dedicate their time to the passing-on technique without inconvenience in contact with the Pyongyang Municipal People’s Committee. -0-

headline: Measures for Improving Taste and Quality of Fruits Taken in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- Fruit farms across the DPRK are directing efforts to improving the taste and quality of products by manuring and tending fruit trees in a scientific and technological way.
The Sariwon Fruit Farm is directing big efforts to preventing damage by harmful insects.
This year, it has increased the variety and quantity of agricultural chemicals on the basis of the experience gained in the production and use of various kinds of vegetable agrochemicals including pyroligneous acid.
It has also established a rational fertilizing method to lower the cost of fruit production and raise the efficiency of extermination of harmful insect to the maximum.
The Onchon Fruit Farm is paying constant attention to the nutrition care for fruit trees.
After producing a lot of quality organic fertilizer, it has concentrated its efforts on increasing the utilization of machines while stepping up the application of topdressing of fertilizer according to the plan.
The Toksong Apple Farm, the Sukchon Youth Fruit Farm and other farms are pushing ahead with every farming process including spraying agrochemicals, conducting the summer pruning as scheduled. -0-

headline: Great Spiritual Strength Makes Everything Possible
story_text:
One day in November 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort nearing completion.
Watching with pleasure the Narae-trademarked products on display, he made a round of the resort.
After a while, he watched a Narae-trademarked ceramic ware beside a world-famous foreign product.
He told an official to operate the domestic product in contradistinction to the foreign one.
When the official operated the two products simultaneously,Kim Jong Unlooked at them with attention.
He smiled with satisfaction, saying that the domestic product is better than the foreign one.
He said that the product made with the highest spiritual strength can beat the world by going beyond the cutting edge.
It was a meaningful instruction reflecting the truth that there is no fortress that cannot be conquered if the producers display their high spiritual strength. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Minister of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 11 (KCNA) -- No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Sunday issued a press statement titled "It is the absolute mission of the armed forces of the Republic to defend its security interests from hostile threats of the U.S. and the ROK", which said:
The U.S. and the ROK military warmongers officially announced that the large-scale joint military exercises Ulji Freedom Shield will start from August 18.
The enemies do not conceal the fact that a new manual and methods of modern warfare targeting regional countries as well as the DPRK will be applied to the joint military exercises to be staged throughout the whole realms with the mobilization of the U.S. overseas troops, including the expedition of the U.S. Marine Corps, and even the troops from member states of the "UN Command".
We strongly denounce the U.S. and the ROK for their provocative moves of clearly showing the stand of military confrontation with the DPRK and making another serious challenge to the security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region and solemnly warn them of the negative consequences to be entailed by them.
The Ulji Freedom Shield to be staged under the simulated conditions of a real nuclear war is not only a direct military provocation against the DPRK but also a real threat to amplify the unpredictability of the situation on the Korean peninsula in the state of armistice and freeze the instability of the regional situation.
The unilateral military threat and confrontation attempt perpetrated by the U.S. and the ROK under the pretext of containing "threat" from someone are the main reason why the situation on the Korean peninsula and in its surrounding region is changing negatively day by day.
The military demonstration against the DPRK will certainly have a boomerang effect of plunging the security of the U.S. and the ROK into a less safe situation.
From the point of view of power, it is the absolute mission of the armed forces of the DPRK to contain offensive movements of the enemy states, counter their military provocations and defend the security of the state and the peace of the region.
The armed forces of the DPRK will cope with the war drills of the U.S. and the ROK with thoroughgoing and resolute counteraction posture and strictly exercise the sovereign right of the DPRK at the level of the right to self-defence in a case of any provocation going beyond the boundary line. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Minister of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 11 (KCNA) -- No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Sunday issued a press statement titled "It is the absolute mission of the armed forces of the Republic to defend its security interests from hostile threats of the U.S. and the ROK", which said:
The U.S. and the ROK military warmongers officially announced that the large-scale joint military exercises Ulji Freedom Shield will start from August 18.
The enemies do not conceal the fact that a new manual and methods of modern warfare targeting regional countries as well as the DPRK will be applied to the joint military exercises to be staged throughout the whole realms with the mobilization of the U.S. overseas troops, including the expedition of the U.S. Marine Corps, and even the troops from member states of the "UN Command".
We strongly denounce the U.S. and the ROK for their provocative moves of clearly showing the stand of military confrontation with the DPRK and making another serious challenge to the security environment on the Korean peninsula and in the region and solemnly warn them of the negative consequences to be entailed by them.
The Ulji Freedom Shield to be staged under the simulated conditions of a real nuclear war is not only a direct military provocation against the DPRK but also a real threat to amplify the unpredictability of the situation on the Korean peninsula in the state of armistice and freeze the instability of the regional situation.
The unilateral military threat and confrontation attempt perpetrated by the U.S. and the ROK under the pretext of containing "threat" from someone are the main reason why the situation on the Korean peninsula and in its surrounding region is changing negatively day by day.
The military demonstration against the DPRK will certainly have a boomerang effect of plunging the security of the U.S. and the ROK into a less safe situation.
From the point of view of power, it is the absolute mission of the armed forces of the DPRK to contain offensive movements of the enemy states, counter their military provocations and defend the security of the state and the peace of the region.

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Mt Paektu is where the Korean revolution took deep and strong root.
Mt Paektu is the place where the Great Paektu Ranges, the main branch of Korea, begins. And there are all sorts of natural wonders on the peaks of Mt Paektu where jagged peaks stand up as precipitously as walls.

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort and major enterprises in the city of Hamhung.
Going round construction projects of the tourist resort, the premier gave a pep talk to the builders who are making devoted efforts to translate the noble plan of the Party Central Committee into brilliant reality.
He stressed the need to make the best and effective use of the good construction time in keeping with the features of the area with high snowfall and low temperature in order to step up the projects. He also called for enhancing the responsibility and role of the designers, construction officials and supervisors, increasing the operation rate of the construction equipment, and taking more scrupulous measures for supplying manpower, equipment and materials.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the premier acquainted himself with its modernization project and production, and underlined the need to more dynamically plan and command the project and at the same time press ahead with the production of various kinds of compressors to steadily demonstrate the honor of the complex as a model of self-reliance and a powerful enterprise.
The premier underscored the need for the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex to give fuller play to the spirit of the workers advancing to implement the decisions of the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee so as to put the production of fertilizer on normal track, expand the variety of melamine resin products and speed up the construction of the line for producing slow effective granule urea fertilizer and of the base for producing catalysts.
Earlier, the premier visited the State Academy of Sciences and the State Commission of Science and Technology, where he called on the scientific circle to turn out as one to reliably ensure the successful implementation of the five-year plan with remarkable sci-tech successes and to vigorously lead the development of the national economy, true to the intention of the Party.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving top priority to the supply of materials for the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort, the issue of finishing the modernization project at the Ryongsong Machine Complex by the appointed time and the issue of giving precedence to the supply of coal needed for the production of fertilizer. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- A firing practice contest of tactical artillery sub-units under the large combined units of the Korean People's Army was conducted on August 11 according to the combat drill plan of the KPA General Staff for perfecting the capability to fight a war and battle readiness of the entire army.
The contest was aimed at strictly checking and judging the proficiency of the artillery sub-units of the tactical units in the fire support combat action method, and at generalizing the example of the excellent units to the entire army.
The contest was overseen by Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary of the WPK Central Committee.
He was accompanied by KPA Vice Marshal Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff.
The commanding officers of the KPA General Staff reviewed the contest.
The contest was attended by sub-units equipped with mortars of different calibers.
The mortar sub-units, that held the fire positions via the unfavorable obstacle area under the fire command of the commanding officers of the large combined units, started to carry out the missions of hitting the different enemy targets and major facilities according to the tactical duty.
Amid the rapid gun fire, the artillerymen hit and destroyed the targets in a fixed time with the crack-shot artillery marksmanship trained through intensive exercises for attaining the Party's training goals of hitting the targets without test firing.
The firing practice contest fully verified the high combat ability and the regular combat mobilization that the artillery sub-units of the tactical units improved in the course of mastering rapid mobile and surprise operations as required by the Juche-based artillery tactics and of steadily increasing the efficiency and operation of the artillery weapon systems in keeping with the aspect and development of the modern warfare.
Ri Yong Gil made public the standings of the large combined units. A citation of mater gunners was awarded to the 82 mm mortar battery of the 6th Battalion of the 55th Mechanized Infantry Brigade of the 9th Corps which won the contest with the highest score and medals and badges of master gunners to its soldiers.
The firing practice contest of tactical artillery sub-units under the large combined units of the Korean People's Army served as an occasion to demonstrate the strong will of the army to thoroughly contain military gangsters in the land adjacent to the border and reliably defend the security and sovereignty of the inviolable state with overwhelming combat power. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry on Israel's Attempt to Seize Gaza Strip
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on Tuesday as regards the fact that shortly ago, Israel openly revealed its attempt to completely occupy the Gaza Strip of Palestine:
A "decision" of the Israeli Cabinet on the complete occupation of the Gaza Strip of Palestine is a clear act of violating international law that plainly shows Israel's gangster-like intention to seize the internationally recognized territory of Palestine.
The Gaza Strip is an inseparable part of the Palestinian territory and a unilateral attempt to change the population and sovereign position of the Gaza Strip can never be allowed.
The DPRK bitterly denounces and rejects Israel's criminal act of seizing territory which aggravates the humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip and wantonly violates peace and stability in the Middle East region.
We strongly demand Israel immediately stop the illegal armed attack on Palestinians and completely withdraw from the Gaza Strip. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- A national contest among lecturers in the field of the preservation of revolutionary relics took place in Wonsan City, Kangwon Province of the DPRK from August 5 to 11.
The contest, divided into lecturers' and officials' groups, brought together lecturers and officials selected from commissions, ministries and national agencies and the regional preliminary contests.
During the contest, the participants shared the successes and experience they have gained in the course of actively conducting the ideological education so that the officials, Party members, working people, youth and students firmly carry forward the precious revolutionary traditions of the Workers' Party of Korea and display the  Party spirit, the revolutionary spirit and the popular spirit in implementing the Party's policies.
The lecturers from Pyongyang Municipality, and South Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces were highly appreciated as they gave a deep explanation of the rare wisdom, outstanding leadership ability and noble traits of the peerlessly great men and the originality and vitality of the people-first politics of the Workers' Party of Korea.

headline: Farmers in Ilbong-ri of DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Farmers in Ilbong-ri, Sonchon County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK moved into new houses.
The single-storied and terraced modern houses of various styles built in harmony with the regional natural scenery are the home of happiness brought about by the warm love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
A ceremony for moving into new houses was held on the spot on August 10.
Present there were officials and agricultural workers in North Phyongan Province and Sonchon County.
A speech was made at the ceremony and licenses for using the new houses were handed to the farmers. Then speeches were made.
Amid a cheerful dancing party, officials visited new houses to share joys with their owners. -0-

headline: Xiaohaerbaling Conference
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Recorded in the history of the Korean people's anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle is the Xiaohaerbaling conference which served as an important occasion in achieving the historic cause of national liberation.
The Xiaohaerbaling conference is a historic meeting that decided to change the strategic line at a new turning point of the revolution, like the Mingyuegou conference in December 1931 and the Nanhutou conference in February 1936 that set forth important strategic lines for the armed struggle against the Japanese.
The Korean revolution was faced with a grave situation, entering the 1940s.
At that time, PresidentKim Il Sungset forth a strategic policy on avoiding the losses caused by reckless battles, preserving and strengthening the revolutionary forces with initiative actions and making full preparations for the great event of national liberation.
The conference of military and political cadres of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army was held in Xiaohaerbaling, Dunhua County on August 10 and 11, 1940.
Before and after the conference, the President, who looked forward to the ruin of the Japanese imperialists, adhered to the stand that the decisive battle for national liberation and the building of a new country - these two tasks - could not be carried out by any foreigners and that the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and the Korean people had to carry them out themselves.
In order to ensure the success of the strategic tasks, he put forward a new fighting policy on switching over from large-unit operations to small-unit actions.
Recollecting the conference, the President said that if we had continued with large-unit operations in pursuit of only immediate successes, unable to see the trend of developments at the opportune moments, it would have been impossible to preserve our force and we would have been wiped out, to be remembered by history as mere martyrs.
The strategic decision made by the President at the Xiaohaerbaling conference made it possible for the KPRA to grow stronger and turn out in the general offensive for national liberation in a few years. -0-

headline: Students of Revolutionary Schools Spend Enjoyable Days in Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 13 (KCNA) -- The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area presents a spectacular sight of new civilization and well-being, enhancing its peculiar attraction as the most coastal scenic spot in the DPRK. The area is full of laughter and optimism of the students of the revolutionary schools.
The respected MarshalKim Jong Ungives everything best in the world to the children of revolutionary martyrs before anyone, being their tender-hearted father. He took a benevolent measure to ensure that the students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Chilgol Revolutionary School, Nampho Revolutionary School, Saenal Revolutionary School, Tonghae School for Orphans and Sohae School for Orphans enjoy a pleasant cultural and emotional life through coastal tourist activities.
Officials and employees of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area warmly greeted the students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Chilgol Revolutionary School who arrived in the area on August 9.
The spectacular scenery of the coastal tourist city, which was artistically harmonized with the scenery of the Kalma peninsula, famous for its beautiful seashore feelings, aroused wonders of the students and led them to the world of endless joy and optimism.
The scenery of the scenic spot was conspicuous as the students were bathing in the East Sea, taking high-speed sightseeing boats, driving motorcycles on silver-colored sandy beach, playing volleyball and having photos taken with marvelous seaside emotion.
The Myongsasimni outdoor wading pool was full of happy laughter of the students enjoying various kinds of water amusement apparatuses.
The video games room was also crowded with students who were fascinated by interesting games, unaware of the passage of time.
The coastal tourist area presented with a marvelous nocturnal view was full of the students' cheerful laughter and their songs of happiness.
The meaningful birthday amid the warm congratulations of the service workers and comrades, and the kind hospitality and service in the coastal tourist resort left precious memories to the students.
The enjoyable days the students spent at the world-class cultural resort built by the motherly Workers' Party of Korea were the days when they felt more keenly the fatherly feelings deepening day by day, and served as an occasion that added to their ardent desire to love and glorify their country, which would be brighter and more prosperous with the entities of civilization and prosperity. -0-

headline: Paddy-field Fish Breeding at Farms of South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 13 (KCNA) -- Nearly 400 farms in South Hwanghae Province are introducing paddy-field fish breeding.
Paechon and Yonan counties are breeding fish in paddy fields of over tens of hectares respectively.
Farms in Jaeryong, Chongdan, Ongjin and Jangyon counties properly fixed the locations and sizes of paddy fields for fish farming, released fry and supplied natural and artificial feed in a scientific and technological way to enhance the productivity per hectare.
The province is making a survey of fish farming of the units which introduced paddy-field fish breeding according to cities, counties and farms and giving technical guidance at them to prove paddy-field fish breeding beneficial. -0-

When we regard the victorious tradition of anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and the revolutionary traditions of Paektu as the eternal lifeline, there is no difficulty insurmountable and no fortress unconquerable for us and victory is always in store for the DPRK. This is the iron faith that has taken deep roots in the hearts of the DPRK people.
The revolutionary traditions of Paektu are the source of inexhaustible might that guarantees the long-term development of the DPRK.
The revolutionary traditions of Paektu comprehensively deal with everything that can bring radical innovation in the overall building of a powerful country including the great ideas and spirit, exploits and experience and work method and style firmly guaranteeing the victorious advance of the revolution.
For the past 10-odd years, the DPRK has made a leap forward racing against time and achieved a series of innovations and changes in every field of building a powerful country. This is the precious fruition of the outstanding ideology and leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho firmly maintains the revolutionary traditions of Paektu as the lifeline of Juche Korea.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the respected General Secretary, the DPRK people and the rising generations have grown to be the ones strong in ideology and faith fully charged with the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and the new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation has been ushered in on this land and the spirit of advancing towards the most powerful country in the world is further uplifted.  -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Holds Phone Conversation with Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 13 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, held a phone conversation with Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on August 12.
They exchanged greetings with each other and had a conversation in a warm comradely atmosphere.
Kim Jong Unexpressed heartfelt thanks to his most esteemed Vladimir Putin for warmly congratulating all the people of the DPRK on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea’s liberation.
He said that all the Korean people greeting the 80th anniversary of their country’s liberation will recollect with reverence the heroic feats performed by the officers and men of the Red Army 80 years ago as a genuine example of true internationalism and pay a high tribute to the fallen fighters of the Soviet army who sacrificed themselves for Korea’s liberation.
The heads of state of the two countries highly appreciated the further development of relations of cooperation in all fields in accordance with the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation, confirming their will to strengthen cooperation in the future.
The Russian president spoke highly once again of the support provided by the DPRK and the bravery, heroism and self-sacrificing spirit displayed by the service personnel of the Korean People’s Army in liberating Kursk, part of the Russian territory.
Expressing his heartfelt thanks to Putin for his high appreciation of the DPRK and its soldiers,Kim Jong Unexpressed firm conviction that the DPRK will always remain faithful to the spirit of the DPRK-Russia treaty and fully support in the future, too, all the measures to be taken by the Russian leadership.
The heads of state of the two countries exchanged their views on the issues of mutual concern.
Kim Jong Unand Putin agreed to keep closer contact in the future. -0-

headline: 2025 WIPO National Awards Given in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 13 (KCNA) -- The 2025 WIPO national awards were given in the DPRK.
Prof. and Dr. Sin Kye Ryong, a section chief of the Applied Chemistry Institute of the Chemical Faculty ofKim Il SungUniversity, and Dr. Jo Son Ok, director of the Moksong External Construction Economic and Technical Cooperation, received the WIPO National Inventor Award. They developed an intellectual product with a rare earth element abundant in the country as the main raw material. The product is popular among people for its high therapeutic effect and was highly appreciated at various festivals, exhibitions and shows last year.
Dr. and Associate Prof. Choe Ryon, a teacher of the Faculty of Korean Linguistics ofKim Il SungUniversity, won the WIPO National Creation Award. She created a full-length novel "Make the Youth Green" which took the first place in the copyright field of the Intellectual Property Development Exhibition-2024.
So Jae Ung, a student of Changdok School, was granted the WIPO National Children Award. A science fiction model "Agricultural Robot" invented by So Jae Ung took the special place at the National Exhibition of Children's Science Fiction Models and Inventions-2024.
The Korea Oriental Instant Pharmaceutical Company received the WIPO National Business Award. Many patent products, medicines and health foods produced by it are popular at home and abroad.
The WIPO national awards are the prizes awarded jointly by the World Intellectual Property Organization and its relevant member state to those who have contributed to the economic, sci-tech and cultural development of its country by creating intellectual wealth. -0-

headline: Song of Anti-Japanese War
story_text:
It was one day in January 1935, 90 years ago when PresidentKim Il Sungorganized and led the anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory.
The expedition led by him was returning from north Manchuria.
The enemy found the expedition in the area of Tianqiaoling and followed it persistently.
The President, who was always leading the expedition in the vanguard despite the ceaseless battles against the enemies, hunger and cold, had a chill.
The members of the expedition in great surprise shed tears around him.
The President wanted to soothe them even in an indistinct consciousness but he could not.
He was impatient and painful that he could not stand up and the members fell down, so he shed tears.
Suddenly poetic sentiment flashed upon him. Although he was unable to speak due to sore throat by a high fever, he made a soldier lying near him dictate the words.
At first, he sang with the soldier and then the fallen soldiers rose up and sang together. The song is the immortal masterpiece "Song of Anti-Japanese War ".
The song touched the soldiers to the heart, representing the independent faith of the President that they should make revolution even if the sky falls down and arouse the people by their own efforts to liberate the country.
Singing the song, the anti-Japanese fighters grew up into steel-strong ranks under the guidance of the President and achieved the historic cause of national liberation. -0-

headline: Farmers in Ilbong-ri of DPRK Move into New Houses
Press Statement by Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 14 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Thursday issued the following press statement titled "Hope of Seoul Is Nothing but a Foolish Dream":
The ROK has a dream of spring at an unseasonable time.
Media of the ROK made a supposition on August 12 that the DPRK's thoughts may be conveyed to the U.S. side at the Russia-U.S. summit meeting to be held soon. This is a typical proof that the ROK is having a false dream.
If a dream is dreamed very often, it will be an empty one, and so many suppositions will lead to so many contradictions that will not be solved.
Why should we send a message to the U.S. side.
I would like to remind again the world that is listening to the news of the ROK media spreading false suppositions. We have nothing to do with the U.S.
I have already said clearly that the special personal relations between the top leaders of the DPRK and the U.S. will not be reflected in the policy and that if the U.S. persists with the outdated way of thinking, the meeting between the top leaders will remain only the "hope" of the U.S. side.
We are not at all interested in talks that are obsessed with the irreversible past, and there is no more need to explain the reason.
I take this opportunity to comment on the fact that the ROK is misleading the public opinion by saying that we have removed the loudspeakers installed on the southern border area.
Recently, the ROK has tried to mislead public opinion by saying that its "goodwill measures" and "appeasement policy" are meeting a response, as well as to create public opinion that the DPRK-ROK relations are being "restored".
The ROK president said that after they first removed the loudspeakers facing towards the DPRK, we, too, seemed to be removing some loudspeakers, hoping that such each other's measures as removing "unnecessary and costly loudspeakers" would help improve the "inter-Korean relations".
Shortly ago, the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the ROK, too, announced that loudspeaker removal by the DPRK was seen.
The irony is that after hearing the military announcement, the authorities and experts of the ROK are describing it as a "response measure" and "change sensing" and a "positive response".
Stating the fact first, it is unfounded unilateral supposition and a red herring.
We have never removed loudspeakers installed on the border area and are not willing to remove them.
I think that by getting rid of the measures taken unilaterally during the Yoon Suk Yeol regime, the present government of the ROK seems to be trying to meet someone's response and be praised for the "such a good deed".
As to the joint military drills, it is pretending hard to make proactive efforts for detente, talking about adjustment and postponement. But it does not deserve praise and will prove futile.
The rulers of Seoul have some object in building up the public opinion while embellishing their new policy towards the DPRK.
It is their foolish calculation that if they manage to make us respond to their actions, it would be good, and if not, their actions will at least reflect their "efforts for detente" and they will be able to shift the responsibility for the escalation of tensions onto the DPRK and win the support of the world.
However, such a trick is nothing but a "pipedream" and it does not arouse our interest at all.
Whether the ROK withdraws its loudspeakers or not, stops broadcasting or not, postpones its military exercises or not and downscales them or not, we do not care about them and are not interested in them.
The shabby deceptive farce is no longer attractive.
I am confident that Seoul's policy towards the DPRK remains unchanged and can never change.
Although a filthy thing is wrapped with a wedding veil, it will emit a stench. And no matter how hard they pretend to be righteous and they beautify and justify their actions, they can never cover up the hostile intention.
The U.S.-ROK joint military drills to be started on August 18 will undoubtedly bring the light to the hostile nature of the ROK again.
We have clarified on several occasions that we have no will to improve relations with the ROK, the U.S. faithful servant and ally, and this conclusive stand and viewpoint will be fixed in our constitution in the future.
It is a very just measure.
The ROK stipulated its wild ambition for unification by absorption in its constitution, organized the "U.S.-ROK nuclear consultative group" focusing on preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK, and regularly holds a confab. And it is engrossed in different war drills of aggressive nature, while repeating such a silly talk as "denuclearization" and totally denying our constitution.
This is the stark reality of the DPRK-ROK relations which the world sees today.
Our stand on a dangerous and base state which is imposing a constant security threat on the DPRK should be clearer, and the ROK should be permanently described as the most hostile forces in its true colors, which should be stipulated in our national law.
It is no different than the wish for a flower in the desert to expect or divine the change of our cognition towards the most hostile state in the world. -0-

headline: Great Event of National Liberation Brought about by Faith and Will of Sure Victory
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 14 (KCNA) -- The history of the arduous anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle shines as a history that won victory with the indomitable faith and will of PresidentKim Il Sung.
In his teens, the President embarked on the road of revolution with his firm determination not to return home unless Korea became independent. He overcame the days of the anti-Japanese war with his indomitable faith and will.
When the enemy tightened the siege by mobilizing planes, the President, with his firm faith in the victory of the revolution, broke through the enemy's encirclement with only 10-odd members on the blizzard-swept heights of Luozigou.
At that time, the guerrilla members suffered from the piercing cold, heavy snow and the difficulty of obtaining food. Their uniforms were torn to pieces and the flesh was exposed.
The President rose resolutely with his determination to continue the armed struggle even if the sky collapsed and the land was turned down.
Remembering that time, he wrote in his reminiscences “With the Century” that "At that time I was conscious that if we should be frustrated, Korea could never rise from the dead.”
Thanks to his high sense of responsibility for the revolution and his faith and will of the victory of the revolution, the Arduous March which had been waged for over 100 days was successfully concluded and the Battle of Pochonbo, which demonstrated to the whole world that Korea is alive, not die, and inspired all the people more powerfully to the sacred war for national liberation, and other operations for advancing into the homeland were conducted.
