headline: Greetings from FM of Venezuela
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 16 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Yvan Eduardo Gil Pinto, foreign minister of the People's Power of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on August 15 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The message said that the day of Korea's liberation not only means liberation from the colonial yoke but also serves as an occasion for revealing its image before the world and aspiring after the building of an independent state, affirming the will to continue to propel the course towards the future for the prosperity and wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries and deepen the bilateral relations. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from General Association of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on August 15 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The General Association of Koreans in China in its congratulatory letter extended the highest glory and warmest congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is demonstrating the mightiness of Juche Korea before the world with his rare wisdom and outstanding leadership, paying the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sung, the benefactor of national liberation and founder of socialist Korea, with the boundless reverence of the officials of the general association and all Koreans in China.
The letter said thatKim Il Sungaccomplished the historic cause of national liberation and thus the Korean people under the Japanese imperialists' bayonet could greet a radical turn in carving out its destiny and the country could pave a broad avenue to building a new country where the people are the masters under the uplifted banner of independence.
The letter stressed that the immortal exploits of the President who saved the country and set an example in the world history of struggle for national liberation would shine forever in the history of the country.
It said that ChairmanKim Jong Ildefended the socialist motherland of Juche built by the President and the well-being of the people, laid a solid foundation for the people's happiness and performed the immortal feats of winning victory after victory in the anti-imperialist, anti-U.S. showdown with the DPRK.
The letter said thatKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man, is realizing the patriotic desire of the President and the Chairman into a brilliant reality and turning the DPRK into the most powerful country admired by the world and a socialist paradise where the people's dreams and ideals come true.
The letter wishedKim Jong Ungood health, the great sun of Juche Korea and benevolent father of Koreans in China, reflecting the unanimous desire of all Koreans in China. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Chairman of Central Committee of Russian Communist Party
story_text:

In the message, Zhuganov, on behalf of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, extended warm congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand all the DPRK people on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation from Japan's colonial rule.
The message said that on September 9, 1948, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a state free from foreign oppression, appeared on the world map.
The birth of a new socialist sovereign state is the result of the self-sacrificing struggle waged by the DPRK people for a long period under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, the message said, and went on:
Thanks to the indomitable will of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungand the great leader ComradeKim Jong Il, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea has become an influential independent state recognized by the whole world.
You are honorably carrying forward the cause of the great preceding leaders.
The prospering DPRK has achieved great successes in the work for bolstering up the defence capability and developing industry, education and the national economy.
The living standards of the working people are improving continuously, and the DPRK is advancing forward with confidence despite the outside pressure of the imperialists.
By annihilating the Japanese imperialists in August 1945, the eternal unity of the fraternal peoples of the two countries was achieved and a solid foundation of militant friendship was laid.
Since then the two countries have been staunchly following the road of struggle for opposing imperialism, establishing just world order and displaying internationalism.
The present situation of war has made the two countries unite more firmly, and as 80 years ago the two countries are fighting against fascism shoulder to shoulder.
The Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the patriotic left-wing forces of Russia highly appreciate the principled stand of the DPRK supporting Russia in its special military operations.
The Communist Party of the Russian Federation expresses its sincere thanks to you for helping liberate Kursk Region.
Russia will never forget the feats of the heroic DPRK soldiers who shed their blood for the just world and the common freedom of the two countries.
I am confident that the genuine friendly relations and beneficial cooperation between the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Workers' Party of Korea will continue to grow stronger in all aspects.
The message wished the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand all the fraternal DPRK people success and prosperity. -0-

headline: Chollima Steel Complex in DPRK Promotes Project for Expanding Production Capacity
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- The workers at the Chollima Steel Complex in the DPRK are pressing ahead with the project for expanding the production capacity with the fighting spirit of self-reliance and perseverance.
Giving precedence to supply of heavy machines and materials and making the builders adhere to technical regulations, the complex completed the excavation of the foundation of the 60-ton UHP electric arc furnace and a project for dozens of pile foundation.
The workers at the Metal Construction Company and the Kangson Industrial Construction Company are fulfilling their daily plans for making structures like a crane girder needed for the construction work.
Workers and technicians of the automation and repair workshops who have turned out in the construction of an electrode production base increased the work efficiency by rationally remodeling the mixers. As a result, they finished the excavation of the core pool and concrete placing ahead of schedule.
Officials and workers at the repair station, too, made successes in various projects such as building pilasters and tie beams. -0-

headline: Modernization of Fish Pickling Factory Promoted at Hanchon Fishery Station in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A fish pickling factory is being modernized at the Hanchon Fishery Station in the DPRK.
If this project is completed, hundreds of tons of pickled shrimps, fish soy, etc. will be produced at this factory every year.
Pressing ahead with the efforts to finish construction of the interior of the main production building and the production of equipment, the station is making preparations for trial production. -0-

headline: Celebration Meeting Held by Russian Social Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A meeting of Russian social organizations took place at the building of the Russian Veterans' Union on August 12 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Present there were personages of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Korean War Veterans' Council, the Russian Veterans' Union, the Foreign Ministry, the Academy of Sciences and other units and members of the Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK.
Speeches were made there.
The chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK said that the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation is a common holiday of not only the Korean people but also the world progressives.
After greeting the day of liberation under the leadership of ComradeKim Il Sung, the DPRK people have made eye-opening development, overcoming all sorts of challenges and trials of history, he said.
The DPRK people showed that only the people led by the outstanding leader can bravely overcome any difficulties and advance along the road chosen by themselves, he said, adding that under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the DPRK people have achieved world-startling miraculous successes in different fields.
The chairman of the Russian Veterans' Union said that August 15, 1945 is a historic day when the Korean people liberated the country by defeating the Japanese imperialists shoulder to shoulder with the officers and men of the Red Army under the leadership of the great ComradeKim Il Sung, adding that it was thanks to the outstanding commanding art ofKim Il Sungthat the Korean People's Revolutionary Army could defeat the Japanese aggressors armed to the teeth without state-backing home front at that time.
A section chief of the Institute of Oriental Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences said that Korea's liberation provided the Korean people with a reliable foundation for successfully pushing forward the building of an independent and sovereign state and made a great contribution to the security in the Asia-Pacific region, adding that he paid high tribute to the great ComradeKim Il Sungwho provided the Korean people with the liberation and laid the foundation for prosperity. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Shoe-making Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- The shoe-making industry sector of the DPRK has been waging a campaign for increase production and creation which is aimed at improving the people's living standards.
Officials of the Ministry of Light Industry and relevant units are taking measures to produce and supply more shoes of new types in a qualitative way.
The Ryuwon Footwear Factory paid attention to improving the performance of equipment on the principle of giving priority to quality. It is making quality shoes by accelerating the modernization of the shoemaking process.
The factory established a new line for removing impurities contained in raw materials and applied the working method to ensure the space between parts. And the production of goods at every line is being conducted in line with the requirements of the design.
The Wonsan Footwear Factory produces various sports shoes of high quality by improving the technical skills of technicians and skilled workers.
The Hamhung Footwear Factory has effectively operated the sci-tech learning space and introduced the successes and experience of advanced units to securing the materials needed for drawing a clear line and improving the quality of products.
By directing its efforts to the development of new products, the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory makes leather shoes suited to the characteristics of sex and age. -0-

headline: Over 250 Units Win "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- Over 250 units in the DPRK won the "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize (including twice and thrice ones) this year when all sectors and units are waging a mass campaign to bring about a surge in production by taking good care of their existing equipment to operate them at full capacity.
Workers of various units including the Polypropylene Workshop of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and workshops of the Pyongyang Musical Instrument Factory have registered high production results while taking good care of the equipment, thus winning the Thrice "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize.
Technicians and workers of the Sonhung Foodstuff Factory and Ragwon Foodstuff Factory, that are awarded Thrice "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize, are ensuring the hygienic safety of products by introducing inventions for normal operation of equipment and technical upgrading.
The swimming pool ofKim Il SungUniversity, the printing factory of the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea, the e-library of Kim Chaek University of Technology, the Changgwangsan Hotel, the faculty of Education Science and the faculty of Mathematics of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education and others were awarded the Thrice "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize.
The Mangyongdae Irrigation Management Station in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang, the Automation Workshop of the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Sakju County Children's Footwear Factory, etc. were awarded Twice "Lathe No. 26" Model Machine Prize.
Numerous units, including the Rehabilitation Institute of Korea General Red Cross Hospital, were awarded the prize. -0-

headline: North Hwanghae Province Improves Quality of Building Materials
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK is strengthening the foundation for producing building materials.
The province directs its efforts on putting the building materials on a diversified and multicolored basis while expanding the capacity of production bases and readjusting and reinforcing equipment.
It pays attention to introducing advanced technology and developing new products by generalizing the successes and experience of the advanced units through an exhibition and demonstration lecture.
Focusing on increasing the cement production both in quality and quantity, the province is speeding up at a final stage the projects for expanding the capacity of the Kyongam and Unpha cement factories.
Similar successes are being made at the Pongsan County Building Materials Factory, the Sinphyong County Cement Factory, the Kyongam Building Materials Factory, the Kyongam Tile Factory and in Sungho County. -0-

headline: Review of Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Following are major news items and articles in Rodong Sinmun, a leading newspaper of the DPRK, on Monday:
- An article deals with the vitality of the new regional development policy being demonstrated in cities and counties where the modern regional-industry factories have been built.
- Achievements are being made in different economic sectors and units.
- The music and dance true story-telling performance "Our Father" is being given in North Phyongan Province every day.
- There took place a national demonstration on the bases for producing building materials in South Hwanghae Province.
- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
- Another article says that the U.S. is the arch criminal who wrecks peace and sparks off arms race. -0-

headline: Schools Remodeled in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality in the DPRK is speeding up the projects for remodeling schools.
The projects for remodeling over 10 rural schools and branch schools were already finished and many other objects are nearing completion.
The municipality is taking measures to carry out the projects planned this year while giving priority to ensuring the supply of school fixtures.
It is also remodeling kindergartens. -0-

headline: State Academy of Sciences Steps up Research Projects
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- The State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK is pushing ahead with its major research tasks for establishing the production and technical processes of the Wihwado Combined Greenhouse Farm.
The Modernization Institute has concentrated its efforts on establishing an intelligent integrated production system, thus manufacturing a number of devices.
The Electronic Institute has designed and manufactured a new type of nutrient solution feeder with high feeding speed and control accuracy to lay a foundation for a modern nutrient solution feed system. Scientists have developed a high-voltage power supply by plasma technology and are accelerating the manufacturing of devices for making nitric acid at the final stage in cooperation with research groups of the Physics Institute and the Catalyst Research Institute.

headline:

headline: First Toast Cup for Model Worker
story_text:
It was May 2, 1946.
That evening, PresidentKim Il Sungcalled all the model workers from across the country and gave a reception to congratulate them on the occasion of the holiday of the working people of the whole world, the first in its kind after Korea's liberation from Japan's colonial rule, and personally attended the reception.
When the President appeared at the reception hall, the model workers warmly welcomed him.
With a bright smile on his face, the President waved to the cheering workers and told them to sit down repeatedly.
When all of them sat down, the President stood up with his cup and suggested to give the first toast cup to the best model workers, and gave the cup to a worker from the then Hungnam Fertilizer Factory sitting nearby him.
The worker was much excited with the toast cup. The President kindly offered him the cup.
All the model workers shed tears of gratitude.
Looking at them, the President said that they have done a lot of things up to now, but they should not be satisfied with the successes they have already achieved, and that we have more things to do in the future than what we have done so far.
He stressed that we cannot carry out all the tasks assigned to us by relying on the model workers and, therefore, we should train many innovators like the model workers, and that during the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule, one knows alone, not informing others of anything, but we should help each other and thus all of us should become innovators and take the lead all together. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Destroyer Choe Hyon and Learns about Training and Life of Sailors
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited the destroyer Choe Hyon on August 18 and acquainted himself with the course of the integrated operation test of the weapon system of the destroyer and the training and life of the sailors of the destroyer.
Senior Vice Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, greeted the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon the spot.
Kim Jong Unmet the sailors of the destroyer Choe Hyon and acquainted himself in detail with the training and living conditions of them. And he set the goal of military and technical qualifications to be attained by the sailors for the operation of the new-type destroyer and expressed his view on the training mode for its realization.
After receiving a report on the course of the sectional tests of the various weapon systems of the warship and the composition of the integrated operation system, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the major tasks for making the navy high-tech and nuclear-armed is progressing on a stage-by-stage basis as planned.
He underlined the need to complete the tasks slated for August and September and move on to the next stage, the process of assessing the performance and capability for conducting operations of the ship, in October as planned.
That day, he received a report on the third Choe Hyon-class new-type multi-mission destroyer being built at the Nampho Shipyard and its long-term plan. And he had an important conversation with technicians and experts in the field of the shipbuilding industry.
He said that it is the most important state affairs from the viewpoint of the development of the DPRK armed forces and in view of the military theory based on the geopolitical peculiarities of the DPRK to extremely rapidly develop the capability for operations of our Navy which is performing its duty in the major space of national defence.
He said that, as he had stressed before, the security environment around the DPRK is getting more serious day by day and the prevailing situation requires us to make a radical and swift change in the existing military theory and practice and rapid expansion of nuclearization.
Labeling the U.S.-ROK joint military exercises being staged again from now as a clear expression of stand of openly revealing their intention to remain most hostile and confrontational to the DPRK,Kim Jong Unsaid that the U.S.-ROK intensified military nexus and the muscle-flexing are the most obvious manifestation of their will to ignite a war and the source of destroying the peace and security environment in the region.
He said that the U.S.-ROK military exercises which had become habitual practice from long ago have always been provocative and dangerous in their nature but the gravity is increasing from the characteristics that they are recently plotting military nexus with the nuclear element involved. And such changing situation requires us to take counteraction with proactive and overwhelming changes, he stressed.
He said that the DPRK will continue to bring about important and eventful changes in the position and activities of the DPRK Navy defending the core of the national sovereignty with unstoppable struggle and strenuous efforts and that the Navy will become a reliable force firmly performing a part in the composition of the state nuclear forces and the realm of nuclear use in the near future. It means that the combat strength of the DPRK Navy is growing more adaptable to the fulfillment of the national defence strategy and the use of war deterrent, he added.
The most reliable and steadfast way and guarantee for controlling and keeping the security environment of the region and firmly defending the sovereignty and security of the DPRK is only to make enemies afraid of the DPRK, he said, adding that such view of the DPRK on controlling the situation and the national defence strategy will remain unchanged.
He affirmed that important measures for the accelerated growth of the national defence capabilities will surely be taken continuously and the firm will and capabilities of the DPRK to defend the sovereignty and security of the country will be expressed through practical actions. -0-

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- The 37th Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on August 19.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the SPA, presided over the plenary meeting.
Present there were vice-chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol, secretary general Ko Kil Son and other members of the Standing Committee of the SPA.
Present there as observers were officials of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet and relevant organs.
The plenary meeting discussed as agenda items the issue on convening the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the issue of deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Marine Ecological Environment, the Law on Savings Credit, the Law on Technological Trade and the Law on Preferential Treatment of Families with Many Children.
First, a decision of the SPA Standing Committee on convening the 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was adopted by a unanimous vote.
Then, there was a report on the main contents of the draft laws examined at the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
On the basis of the study and discussion of the draft laws, the plenary meeting adopted with full approval the decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of the Marine Ecological Environment ", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Savings Credit", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Technological Trade" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Preferential Treatment of Families with Many Children". -0-

headline: Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK, Censures Seoul Authorities for Deceptive Attempt at "Appeasement Offensive"
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, at a consultative meeting with major director generals of the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK on August 19 sharply criticized the essence of the deceptive "appeasement offensive" of the ROK government and its double character and conveyed the foreign policy plan of the head of state.
Kim Yo Jong analyzed the behaviour of Seoul which is feigning that the ROK's policy towards the DPRK is making a "rapid U-turn" while saying that it respects the social system of the DPRK and will not seek any form of unification by absorption and has no intention of committing all hostile acts.

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- The 37th Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on August 19.
Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the SPA, presided over the plenary meeting.
Present there were vice-chairmen Kang Yun Sok and Kim Ho Chol, secretary general Ko Kil Son and other members of the Standing Committee of the SPA.
Present there as observers were officials of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet and relevant organs.
The plenary meeting discussed as agenda items the issue on convening the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the issue of deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Marine Ecological Environment, the Law on Savings Credit, the Law on Technological Trade and the Law on Preferential Treatment of Families with Many Children.
First, a decision of the SPA Standing Committee on convening the 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was adopted by a unanimous vote.
Then, there was a report on the main contents of the draft laws examined at the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
On the basis of the study and discussion of the draft laws, the plenary meeting adopted with full approval the decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on the Protection of the Marine Ecological Environment ", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Savings Credit", "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Technological Trade" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Preferential Treatment of Families with Many Children". -0-

headline: U.S.-ROK Joint Military Drill Will Only Highlight Fact that Enemy Is Enemy: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- The U.S.-ROK large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield officially started on August 18.
Earlier, the enemies, while spreading such false rumor as the so-called adjustment, postponement and reduction of the drill on a large scale, misled the world public opinion as if they were "contributing" to peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the region by intentionally adjusting the level of the current war drill "in consideration of the security environment in the region".
The adjustment farce was not the first time in the 70-odd year-long history of the U.S.-ROK war drills for aggression against the DPRK, and every time there were such ear-piercing words as "computer simulation training mode" and "minimization of the level of participation and the reduction of scale".
However, such silly jargon has never played a practical role in defusing tension on the Korean peninsula and has never had a tinge of influence on the enforcement of provocative and aggressive anti-DPRK war drills.
Under such deceptive and embellishing trick of diverting the attention of the world people elsewhere, the enemies have renewed the worst and highest records in history and steadily increased the scale, form, method and intensity of the U.S.-ROK joint military drills and their provocative and violent nature.
This is an objective fact that no one can deny and a stark reality that is being confirmed again through this year's drill.
The drill is bringing together the U.S. forces in the ROK and the forces of the ROK army as the main, and the expedition of the U.S. marines and armed forces of "UN Command" member states outside the region. And more than 580 000 persons from 4 000-odd institutions and organizations across the ROK are participating in the drill. The scale of the drill is very enormous and the number of planned field mobile exercises is at the highest level.
The drill scenarios have been practiced in all-round domains including the ground, sea, air and cyber while steadily updating and applying new manuals and methods of modern warfare. In particular, the preemptive strike elements under the signboard of "deterrence of nuclear use" of someone have been set as the main item of the drill as in the past. This is another vivid expression of the hostile nature of Freedom Shield this year.
The enemies are claiming that some items of the field mobile exercises will be postponed to next month, but the basic exercises reflected in the U.S.-ROK joint drill plan are carried out as they are. Only the dirty drills to be staged by the ROK army alone will be carried over. The fact proves once again that the drill adjustment farce being staged by the present U.S. and the ROK authorities as if it was a measure different to the preceding drill is nothing but a deceptive trick.
No matter what duplicity of ostrich policy the enemies may use, they can never cover up their immutable nature of the U.S.-ROK joint military drill as the one with the longest history on the earth, the largest-ever war drill in the Asia-Pacific region and the most undisguised war rehearsal for aggression in hostility.
In view of the facts of the past and the present, the aggressive and provocative nature of the U.S.-ROK large-scale joint military drill and its negative impact on the situation on the Korean peninsula and in the region remain unchanged.
The world people should know clearly.
Where is the source of disaster harming the security of the Korean peninsula and the region and why do we call enemies are also enemies?
No matter how many years may pass and the regime may change, the U.S. has not changed its hostile policy toward the DPRK, the policy to persistently deny the constitutional position of the DPRK and stifle it by force of arms. The same is true in the wild ambition of the ROK that openly stipulated in its constitution the DPRK as its main enemy and mark the inviolable territory of the DPRK as its territory and is dreaming a pipedream of "unification by absorption".
As long as the hostile entity against the DPRK remains unchanged, there will be no change in the thoroughgoing and merciless will of our armed forces to counter the military provocations of the enemy states, and the trustworthy strength of the DPRK racing for lasting peace settlement on the Korean peninsula and in the region will steadily increase.
The firm will and ability of the DPRK to defend the sovereignty and security of the country against the U.S.-ROK joint military drill which is immutable in hostility will be clearly expressed as practical actions, and it is clear that the DPRK's counteraction will be proactive and overwhelming. -0-

headline: Official Notice on Convening SPA Session of DPRK Issued
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- The 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is to be convened in Pyongyang on September 20, 2025.
The session will discuss the issue of deliberating and adopting the DPRK laws on grain management and intellectual property and the issue of supervising the enforcement of the law on urban management.
The registration of deputies will be held on September 19, 2025.
An official notice of the SPA Standing Committee in this regard was issued on August 19. -0-

headline: Immortal Great Programme for Building New Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- On August 20, 1945, when the whole country was filled with the emotion of liberation, PresidentKim Il Sungmade a historic speech "On Founding the Party, State and Armed Forces in the Liberated Homeland" before military and political cadres.
In his speech, he set forth the idea of steadily advancing the Korean revolution and building a prosperous, independent and sovereign state by the Korean people themselves on the basis of the successes they achieved in the historic cause of national liberation, and the three tasks of building the Party, state and army.
The speech reflects the transparent independent stand that the building of a new country should be carried out by our own efforts, not by anyone, and in our own way, not in other's way, in conformity with the actual conditions of our country, just as the historic cause of national liberation was accomplished by our people.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the President, a Juche-type revolutionary party was founded on October 10, 1945, the Korean People's Army, the revolutionary regular armed forces, on February 8, 1948 and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on September 9 that year.
The undying feats of the President who set forth the original line of building a new country and accomplished the cause of building the Party, state and army after the liberation are shining forever along with the proud history of the prosperous DPRK. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Prize Contest and Presentation in North Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK held a sci-tech prize contest and presentation.
At the contest and presentation held in the newly-built Unpha County Foodstuff Factory, the high-performance plastic processing equipment presented by the Sariwon Equipment Assembly Station were highly appreciated by the participants for their great economic effectiveness in recycling and improving the quality of products.
The High-Tech Products Development Institute of Sariwon University of Technology developed a drying technique for ensuring the hygienic safety of products.
The Unpha County Foodstuff Factory established an energy-saving process and presented a technical innovation proposal to increase productivity while saving a lot of electricity.
Other units announced good proposals for improving the quality of processed foodstuffs and daily necessities and saving costs. -0-

headline: Reply Message to Russian Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on August 16 sent a reply message to Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, for sending a message of greeting to her on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The reply message said that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries forged in the grim days of the great anti-Japanese war have steadily developed despite all sorts of trials and challenges and the DPRK people always remember the internationalist feats performed by the officers and men of the Red Army who shed their blood in the fight for Korea's liberation.
The delegation of the State Duma of the Russian Federation and Russian artistes visited the DPRK to congratulate the DPRK people on greeting the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation, the message said, adding that this served as an occasion that demonstrated once again the invincibility and durability of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations.
The message expressed belief that the strategic communication and concerted action between the foreign policy agencies for the permanent development of the alliance between the two countries will further develop in the future, too, always remaining faithful to the inter-state treaty in conformity with the strategic plan and noble intention of the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia. -0-

Presented to the exhibition are more than 210 proposals and products of great scientific and technological significance and with great possibility for introduction and high economic effectiveness from dozens of units includingKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, the Agricultural Nano-technology Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences.

headline: Greetings to DPRK Foreign Minister from Russian Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on August 15 received a message of greeting from Sergei Viktorovich Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The message said that the Russian people celebrate the glorious day together with the DPRK people and extend warm thanks to the DPRK friends for deeply cherishing the memory of the soldiers of the Red Army of the Soviet Union who devoted their lives to the common cause of victory by fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Korean patriots.
The traditions of friendship and mutual cooperation provided by the forerunners are growing solid as the DPRK soldiers participated in the operation for liberating Kursk Region occupied by the Ukrainian neo-Nazi forces, the message said, adding that the Russian people will never forget the heroic feats of the DPRK soldiers.
The message said that Russia would do its best for the implementation of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership concluded at the historic Russia-DPRK Pyongyang summit in June 2024. -0-

Lee Jae Myung is not the sort of man who will change the course of history.
We clearly remember that Jo Hyon and An Kyu Baek, the chiefs of diplomacy and defense, which form the basis of the Lee Jae Myung regime, openly said at a time when they were designated as candidates that they regard the north Korean regime and the north Korean army as their enemies.

This is the part clearly illuminating the double character of the Seoul authorities who are carrying two faces under the hood.
As I emphasized a few days ago, there is a clear purpose for the rulers of the ROK in producing amicable image.
They also know that the DPRK-ROK relations desired by them will never come back.

headline: Immortal Great Programme for Building New Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- On August 20, 1945, when the whole country was filled with the emotion of liberation, PresidentKim Il Sungmade a historic speech "On Founding the Party, State and Armed Forces in the Liberated Homeland" before military and political cadres.
In his speech, he set forth the idea of steadily advancing the Korean revolution and building a prosperous, independent and sovereign state by the Korean people themselves on the basis of the successes they achieved in the historic cause of national liberation, and the three tasks of building the Party, state and army.
The speech reflects the transparent independent stand that the building of a new country should be carried out by our own efforts, not by anyone, and in our own way, not in other's way, in conformity with the actual conditions of our country, just as the historic cause of national liberation was accomplished by our people.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the President, a Juche-type revolutionary party was founded on October 10, 1945, the Korean People's Army, the revolutionary regular armed forces, on February 8, 1948 and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on September 9 that year.
The undying feats of the President who set forth the original line of building a new country and accomplished the cause of building the Party, state and army after the liberation are shining forever along with the proud history of the prosperous DPRK. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Paternal Loving Care for Children
story_text:
One day in April, 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the indoor swimming pool of the Songdowon International Children's Camp near its completion.
After giving precious instructions at the swimming pool, he looked at the glass gate for a while.
The gate looked clean as it was made of large glass.
Officials found no fault at the gate.
Pointing at the gate,Kim Jong Unsaid that children might knock their heads against the gate unconsciously as it has no signal.
The officials realized that they did not consider the mind of the children coming in and out only with pleasure.
Personally drawing a signal in the gate,Kim Jong Unsaid to the officials that it is necessary to decorate the glass gate in order to help children not to dash their heads against the gate.
The officials were deeply moved by the paternal loving care ofKim Jong Unwho provided a wonderful camp for children and gave attention to making it perfect. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Members of Expeditionary Group of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the expeditionary group of the General Association of Koreans in China for a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu on August 16.
The letter said that the period of the study tour they spent in the area of Mt Paektu under the special love and benevolence of the respected Marshal was a significant period they would never forget in their whole life as they cherished in their hearts the immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho left bloody traces of the anti-Japanese revolution on every mountain of Paektu and the patriotic spirit of the fighters.
During the visit, they keenly realized that the aspiration of the people becomes the long-cherished desire of the Party and the state and is being translated into reality without fail in any adversity in the motherland, the letter noted.
The letter said that they would set their direction of life under the great loving care of the respected Marshal even though they live in an alien land and would firmly trust and follow the Marshal only and devote themselves to the patriotic activities for the prosperity of the motherland no matter what trials and difficulties they may face in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu they grasped in the course of the expedition.
The members of the expeditionary group stressed in the letter they would strengthen the General Association of Koreans in China into a dignified overseas citizens' organization of Juche Korea, the patriotic compatriots' organization faithfully upholding the leadership of the respected Marshal only and make positive contributions to glorifying the traditional DPRK-China friendship. -0-

headline: Aesthetic Symposium Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- The summer aesthetic symposium in the field of urban management-2025 took place at the Sci-Tech Complex in the DPRK on August 20.
Present there were officials, scientists and technicians of the units related to the afforestation and greening including the urban management and land and environment protection sectors in Pyongyang Municipality and provinces.
There was a video show on the successes made and deviations revealed in the afforestation and greening.
Speakers said that under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, a vigorous campaign was conducted to create landscaping suited to the aesthetic tastes and emotions of the Korean people, thus creating models of greening in the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK, Hwasong Street, Jonwi Street and the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area.
They expressed their resolve to steadily apply and develop advanced science and technology in keeping with the world trend of development in the construction of urban parks, thoroughly apply the Juche character and modernity in the design of landscaping, increase the ranks of experts in the field of afforestation and thus uphold in practice the Party's plan and intention to build a prospering socialist paradise on this land.
Then the participants watched advanced sci-tech data on the field of afforestation. -0-

headline: Celebrations for Korea's Liberation in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- Meetings took place in Myanmar, Bulgaria and Switzerland from August 2 to 14 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Speeches were made at the meetings attended by personages of political parties, organizations and institutions and masses of relevant countries.
A member of the Central Executive Committee of the Myanmar Journalist Association said:
PresidentKim Il Sungadvanced the idea of self-reliant independence and waged an arduous armed struggle to liberate Korea from the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists.
Thanks to the victory in the great anti-Japanese war, the Korean people could regain their usurped sovereignty and freedom and advance along the road of building a new country.
The DPRK people are fully demonstrating to the whole world the pride and honor of being the citizens of a powerful nation, rallied close around His ExcellencyKim Jong Unwho is boundlessly loyal to the idea and leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Personages of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, the Taekwon-Do Association in Bulgaria and the DPRK culture and information centre in Vratsa City of Bulgaria praised the President for liberating the country through the bloody anti-Japanese struggle and successfully accomplishing the historic cause of building the Party, state and army.
They wished the DPRK people greater progress in their struggle for dynamically accelerating the overall development of socialism under the leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee said that Korea's liberation encouraged the peoples of many countries struggling for national liberation in colonies and that the DPRK people boundlessly revere as the eternal leader PresidentKim Il Sungwho brought about the dawn of rebirth and the freedom, independence and wellbeing.
A congratulatory message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting held in Switzerland. -0-

headline: Hydroelectric Power Sector of DPRK Increases Electricity Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- The hydroelectric power sector of the DPRK produces more electricity every day than planned in August.
The Suphung Power Station, which completed the task of overhauling the generating equipment planned for this year ahead of schedule, is increasing production.
The Hochongang and Jangjingang power stations are producing a lot of electricity every day by putting water control of reservoirs in a scientific and technological way and ensuring high water level and high efficiency operation.
The Kanggye Youth Power Station and Taedonggang, Pujongang, Sodusu and Thaechon power stations have also increased the electricity production.
The Wiwon, Namgang, Huichon and other hydroelectric power stations regard it as an important way of increasing the production to raise the efficiency of water turbines and direct efforts to readjusting and reinforcing the existing production foundations.
Thanks to the struggle of the workers of hydroelectric power stations across the country, more successes are being registered in increasing electricity production. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Leading Commanding Officers of Overseas Operation Unit of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met with the leading commanding officers of the overseas operation unit of the Korean People's Army who returned home to participate in the ceremony of awarding the state commendations of the DPRK at the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the WPK on August 20.
After receiving a detailed report on the military activities of the combat units of our armed forces in the overseas operational area from the commanding officers, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unhighly appreciated their feats of leading the combat units of our armed forces, which participated in the operations to liberate the Kursk Region of the Russian Federation, to victory.
Saying that the country assigned them and their combat units to carry out the most important duty,Kim Jong Unconveyed warm militant encouragement to all the commanding officers and the combatants of the units who participated in the operations for liberating Kursk to display boundless loyalty to the trust of the country with legendary military merits.
At the significant ceremony,Kim Jong Unspoke highly of the KPA's heroic mettle, before saying:
"Ours is a heroic army. It is because our army is made up of the sons whose lives were given by our heroic people and who have been raised by them. Our army has fully demonstrated its unique qualities. Such a result has cemented its appellation and reputation as the most powerful army in the world, giving everyone a clear understanding of it. Our army is now doing what it ought to do and what needs to be done. It will do so in the future, too."
The first ceremony of awarding the state commendations to the generals, officers and soldiers of the KPA who performed immortal feats in the overseas military operations will be held at the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the WPK. -0-

headline: Taesongsan Ice Cream
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- Nowadays, hot weather persists in the DPRK. Therefore, the people are looking for soft drinks in shops, restaurants and outdoor stalls.
Among them is ice cream with the trademark of "Taesongsan" which is popular among the people and children.
The Taesongsan Ice Cream Factory produces sweet goods with original taste and quality including grape-flavored ice cream, strawberry-flavored ice cream and peach-flavored ice cream.
The modern factory is associated with the warm loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is devoting his all to the promotion of the people's wellbeing.
One day in August, 2019, he proposed the building of a factory specializing in producing good-quality ice cream. He named the Taesongsan Ice Cream Factory and selected its site in a place with good sanitary environment and water quality and gave detailed guidance to its internal and external layout and emblem design.
At major Party meetings, he gave instructions on speeding up the construction of the factory and making the people benefit from it and guided the whole course of the construction.
He also paid deep attention to the production equipment and management and provided a foundation for keeping the production going at a high rate by forming powerful technical forces.
True to his noble intention, the factory develops and produces tasty and nutritious goods, contributing to improving the people's living standard.
The factory has directed efforts to developing products with high quality and hygienic safety by relying on science and technology to update the cream production line.
It has established an integrated production management system and put production sites on germ-free and dust-free basis.
Several goods such as ice cream produced by the factory were registered as February 2 goods (quality product) last year. -0-

headline: New Villages Built in Kosong County of Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- New houses were built at the Pongjuk and Sunhak farms in Kosong County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK.
The farm villages where low- and single-storied dwelling houses of various forms were built at the foot of Mt Kumgang hundreds of trees and flower shrubs were planted show the true picture of rural rejuvenation in the era of the Workers' Party.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place at the Pongjuk Farm in Kosong County on August 19. Attending the ceremony were officials of Kangwon Province and Kosong County, builders and agricultural workers who will move into new houses.
Speeches were made at the ceremony and then licenses for the use of new houses were handed over to their owners.
With the moving into new houses, a pleasant peasant dance and congratulatory performance were given and officials visited the owners of the new houses to share joy with them. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- The work for building educational aid program centers and preparing for their operation is progressing apace across the DPRK.
Pyongyang Municipality is scrupulously conducting the work to build the educational aid program center into a model for the whole country.
After completing miniatures and designs of offices, lobby and exterior, it is carrying out the daily construction plans according to processes.
Kangwon Province has made preparations for operating the state educational information system by providing a lot of information equipment.
Video conferencing room, server room, room for operating educational network and multimedia production room have been completed and practical measures have been taken for normal operation of the provincial educational aid program center.
South Hamgyong Province has also turned the above-said work into the provincial one and thus, remarkable successes have been made in the construction of the provincial educational aid program center. -0-

headline: War "Outing" of Old "British Empire" Will Not End in Pleasant Journey: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- An escort ship belonging to the carrier task force Prince of Wales of the British Navy, which was involved in the U.S.-led multi-national military drills in the west Pacific region, recently entered the Pusan operation base in the ROK.
The day before the escort ship came into the base, the British replenishment tanker Tidespring entered Pusan Port, and in September the Prince of Wales itself will reportedly enter the waters off the ROK to conduct a naval and air demonstration drill.
Britain claims that it will be an important milestone showing its firm will towards the "security and prosperity" of the Indo-Pacific region.
The main warships of the British navy, which left the distant Atlantic Ocean and conducted a war rehearsal in the west Pacific Ocean, advanced into the hotspot waters of the Asia-Pacific region. This is by no means a matter to be overlooked.
The port access of the warship of the old "British Empire" on the eve of the U.S.-ROK large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield against the DPRK is a war "outing" of pushing the situation on the Korean peninsula and in the region to the worst phase from A to Z.
It is no secret that Britain, which dispatched the largest number of troops to the Korean war in pursuance of the U.S. in the last century, has actively aligned itself with the hostile policy toward the DPRK, acting as the first agent in the most reactionary military bloc led by the U.S.
In April 2024, the British Ministry of Defense made a bluff that it would conduct regular joint military exercises with the U.S. and Japan in the region from next year under the pretext of "tightening security in the Indo-Pacific region" and it would be a powerful signal for those trying to undermine the "international order based on rules."
And it made bellicose remarks that Britain's defense relations are not confined to distance and Britain is ready to counter any threat from all over the world.
Last year, the British ambassador to Japan said that the actions of the DPRK and China were a geopolitical danger that harms the "international rules" and in June this year the British prime minister noted that it would be a core goal of the army to restore the readiness for fighting a war."
Britain, which has justified military intervention while talking about the security relationship on both sides of the Atlantic Ocean and in the Asia-Pacific region, is finally advancing into the Korean peninsula for its full-scale implementation.
The British carrier task force, which had already conducted powder-reeking war drills frantically in the Indo-Pacific region with the U.S., Japan and other allies for several months, entered the base on the eve of the U.S.-ROK large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield in which new manuals and methods of modern warfare are applied and even the practical nuclear war situation is simulated. Its purpose is as clear as noonday.
At a time when the situation on the Korean peninsula is inching close to the phase of dangerous conflict due to the ceaseless provocations of the U.S. and other hostile forces, the war "outing" of the old "British Empire" joining the provocations is a clear action measure of the anti-DPRK confrontational stand and, at the same time, an adventurous act to realize the unique military hegemony of the Anglo-Saxons not only in the region but also on a global scale.
The war "outing" of the old "British Empire" will never end in a pleasant journey. -0-

Banquet Given in Honor of Commanding Officers and Combatants of KPA Overseas Operation Unit and Bereaved Families of Martyrs
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- A grand banquet was given at the Mokran House in honor of the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operation unit of the Korean People's Army and bereaved families of the martyrs.
The banquet hall was filled with boundless emotion, joy and excitement of the commanding officers and combatants honored with high glory and happiness of their lives under the care of the motherland and the great brilliant commander they have yearned for even in a dream.
Leading officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and leading commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence attended the significant banquet together with the commanding officers, combatants of the overseas operation unit of the KPA and bereaved families of the martyrs.
Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the Party Central Committee, made a speech at the banquet.
At the decisive battlefields for defending the absolute authority of the Party Central Committee and safeguarding the dignity and honor of the DPRK and the appellation and tradition of the KPA, officers and men of the KPA wrote the immortal combat records at the cost of their blood, created a new great history of the KPA with their militant courage and legendary military merits that put the stories of heroes in the human history of war to shame and recorded a new glorious page in the history of war victory of the DPRK in gold letters, the speaker said.
The revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK will always emerge victorious in the sacred war to be faced with in succession regarding the brilliant and heroic life of the brave soldiers who participated in the war as an example, he said, stressing that all divisions, brigades, regiments and battalions and service personnel of the whole army will courageously advance along the road of victory the brave soldiers who participated in the war have won.
The commanding officers and combatants of the KPA overseas operation unit pledged to keep glorifying the dignity and honor of the KPA with the priceless military merits of the present generation in the militant journey of opening up a new era of building a rich country with a strong army, regarding the trust and love of the Party as the lifeline of their destiny and the spirit of their courage. -0-

headline: Output of Dairy Products Goes Up in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK is strengthening the foundation for producing dairy products.
The province organized the demonstrations for strengthening the foundation for producing dairy products in Thaechon and Sakju counties, thus increasing the enthusiasm of cities and counties for emulation.
The projects for renovating the rooms for producing dairy products were launched in cities, counties and the units with nurseries and kindergartens, and the number of goats is increasing.
Vacuum concentrators were newly installed at the bases for producing dairy products of tens of city and county goat farms and the rooms for producing dairy products of hundreds of units were remodeled.
Tens of thousands of goats were secured to lay a foundation for increasing milk powder production both in quality and quantity. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony of Awarding State Commendations to Commanding Officers and Combatants of KPA Overseas Operation Unit Takes Place
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- The outstanding fighting spirit and bravery of the Korean People's Army reliably guaranteeing the ever-victorious tradition of the Juche revolution with invincible arms are writing the legendary biography of heroes unprecedented in history, bringing the mightiness and sacred prestige of our state to the top of the world.
The combatants of the armed forces of the Republic who took part in overseas military operations in hearty response to the order of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea demonstrated to the whole world the transparent and outstanding ideological and spiritual superiority and fighting spirit of the KPA which no army in the world can match and the indomitable mettle of Koreans by weathering heavy gunfire in bloody life-and-death battles.
A ceremony of awarding state commendations to the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operation unit of the KPA was held at the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the WPK.
Officials of the WPK Central Committee warmly greeted the brave soldiers who participated in the war, entering the yard of the Party Central Committee after traveling tens of thousands of miles in response to the ardent desire and sincere call of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto glorify the life of the great successors and representatives, who firmly carried forward the tradition of victory peculiar to our state in the new century, with the honour of gold star.
Secretaries and other senior officials of the WPK Central Committee warmly congratulated the proud sons of the country putting garlands around their necks and giving bouquets.
The venue of the ceremony was full of respect for the brave soldiers who participated in the war with boundless loyalty to the order of the country.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
Present at the ceremony were commanding officers and combatants who performed distinguished feats in overseas military operations, and bereaved families of martyrs.
Present there were members of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, leading commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political officers of the large combined units of the KPA.
The DPRK national anthem was played solemnly.
The solemn melody of the national anthem, which redoubled pride of being the sons of the powerful country and the ardent patriotic desire in every moment of their life in the days of the decisive battles and inspired them to be in the van of the charge and to win immortal victories, made the hearts of the brave soldiers full of strong emotion.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech.
Expressing his deep emotion of seeing again the admirable sons, heroes of the country who are the greatest pride of our state and waited by all the people at such a significant place and of awarding the title of DPRK Hero and high-level state commendations to them, he extended deep gratitude and warmest militant respect on behalf of the Party and the government to the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operation unit who returned home with great honour and brilliant feats after bravely fighting as befitting the "Koreans" and the "Korean People's Army" despite the hail of bullets and bombs of the life-and-death war in the foreign country.
The WPK Central Committee organized a ceremony of awarding state commendations with splendor at the headquarters building of the WPK Central Committee out of the mind to hold up the admirable heroes, who performed feats in the battlefield to defend the sacred prestige and dignity of the state, before the country and the people and make them respected and praised by the whole country, he said, adding that this is a special and valuable commendation given by the country and the people to the honourable victors who performed great exploits that cannot be achieved without bloody struggle.
He said that holding the first awarding ceremony today, he misses even at this moment the images of the combatants who would be devoting themselves to carrying out their duties true to the order of the country and the martyrs who sacrificed their lives and that he could not repress his regret at failing to bring them all together to this glorious place, and courteously proposed to pay silent tribute to the immortality of the martyrs who devoted their precious lives in the overseas military operations.
At the proposal ofKim Jong Un, all the participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the martyrs who ensured the great victory with their indomitable fighting spirit and noble sacrifice.
Saying that all the participants in the overseas operations who performed great feats to be recorded in the history of the country for its eternal prosperity and mightiness are all great men, great heroes and great patriots,Kim Jong Unsaid with pride that the victory won by the brave soldiers who participated in the war is a great feat that firmly defended the great honour of the KPA, which should never be undermined, and provided a sure guarantee for the existence and development of our state and a victory to be recorded as a miracle in the history of our army building and the anti-imperialist revolutionary struggle and, at the same time, an event in the history of world wars that redefined the logic of the strong which has been handed down for thousands of years.
The combat activities of the overseas operation units, representing the armed forces of the DPRK, in the battlefield which became the focus of the world have fully proved the might of the heroic KPA which emerges victorious with the sure superiority in ideology, spirit and Juche-oriented strategy and tactics, he said, adding that what the Party Central Committee attaches importance to and appreciates most is that the reputation of the ever-victorious KPA has been most rigorously verified in its 70-odd-year history and the actual condition of the KPA fully prepared for the war has been clearly confirmed.
And he warmly said that today's awarding ceremony is an expression of gratitude and valuable appreciation of our Party, state and people for the historic deed of perfectly implementing the political decision made by the Party and government for the destiny and future of the country and of defending the great honour safeguarded by all generations of the DPRK for decades.
Referring to the outstanding valour and noble self-sacrificing spirit displayed by our service personnel in the operational area where bullets and shells showered,Kim Jong Unsaid that they should be called the best heroes and the overseas operation unit the heroic unit and stressed that the key to the event of the victorious conclusion of overseas military operations lies not in the merits of some distinguished military men or heroes but in the popular character of heroism from A to Z and in the fact that the noble and beautiful mental and moral traits firmly dominated as the ideological feelings of all officers and men.
Saying that all the participants in the overseas operations were thoroughgoing in executing orders, the original nature of the soldiers, and their love and devotion for the country and comrades-in-arms were at the same high level and they all had good moral quality of remaining loyal to their duties and making a choice according to conscience even at the last moment of their lives, he noted that with such extraordinary mental qualities, they let the world know what fundamental factor made our army strong and surely win in any battle, and this is an event that clearly marked the concept of the strong army and the law of victory on the times and history.
He stressed that it is the pride and honour of the WPK and the DPRK government to have such an army as the pioneer and defender of their revolutionary cause and that the country defended by the heroic army is strong forever and the cause advancing with the heroic army in the vanguard is invincible.
Referring to the important measures to be carried out as a national undertaking to hand down forever the feats of the great war participants, he affirmed that the glorious course pioneered by the brave soldiers' bloody struggle and the noble lives of the martyrs would never end and the records of the bloody battles bearing their names would shine forever as the most precious pages in the history of the country.
Saying that our state will remain dignified, powerful and strong forever thanks to such great heroes as them and our army will carry forward the trend of the great history of war victory for all ages with their peculiar loyalty and heroic stamina, he wished the heroic officers and men of the overseas operation unit, who recorded the highest and brilliant climax in the long history of victory of our people and the absolute prestige of the revolutionary armed forces, immortal glory.
The speech ofKim Jong Un, full of ardent love and true heart of the great father, stirred up the hearts of all the participants.
All the participants expressed their greatest respect and boundless gratitude toKim Jong Un, who clarified the clear strategy for victory in the battle with his outstanding military idea and extraordinary strategic and tactical wisdom, instilled the might and courage of annihilation into them with warm parental enthusiasm and affection and now puts them forward as great heroes and great patriots at the peak of the honour.
A decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on conferring the title of DPRK Hero, order and medal on commanding officers and combatants who performed feats in overseas military operations was conveyed.
Kim Jong Unpersonally awarded the title of DPRK Hero to the skilled military commanding officers who led the combat units of the armed forces of the Republic to victory and to the soldiers who performed distinguished feats.
He personally fixed the DPRK Hero Medal beside the portraits of the martyrs, recollecting with reverence the noble images of the martyrs, who sacrificed their youth and lives warming their hearts with one faith and one will to thoroughly carry out the order of the country, and their last moments.
At the venue of the ceremony, the "Song of Comradeship", reflecting the sacred history of the Korean revolution pioneered, advanced and emerged victorious with comradeship, resounded. And the touching picture to be immortal in the history of the country was seen conveying the warm blood ties between the leader and the soldiers.
Kim Jong Unlaid a flower before the memorial wall and paid silent tribute, wishing that the noble life of the martyrs who participated in the war to defend the dignity and honour of the great state with their precious lives would shine forever as a star of eternal feats in the memory of the country and the people.
Members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, military and political officers of the large combined units of the KPA and the bereaved families of the martyrs laid flowers before the memorial wall.
Kim Jong Unmet the bereaved families of the martyrs and consoled them, sharing with them the pain of loss.
Army Col. General Kim Yong Bok, commander of the special operation unit, made a resolution speech on behalf of all the officers and men of the overseas operation unit.
Expressing the impression of having the greatest honour of receiving the highest commendation of the DPRK at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee, the general staff of the Korean revolution, he said that the officers and men of the overseas operation unit more keenly felt the good fortune of soldiers of being led by the great brilliant commander in the foreign battlefield and kept it as their faith the iron truth that they would surely win if they fought only as taught byKim Jong Un.
All the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operation unit, faithful soldiers ofKim Jong Un, guardsmen of the Republic and sons of the heroic DPRK people, will devotedly defend the authority of the Party Central Committee and firmly safeguard the honour of the country, honour of the KPA and honour of the DPRK people till the day of returning home, he said, solemnly pledging to remain faithful to the mission and duty as the army of the Party, the people and the Supreme Commander, cherishing today's valuable commendations as absolute trust.
Kim Jong Unonce again extended sincere thanks and noble tribute to all the officers and men of the overseas operation unit who defended the trust of the Party and the country in the KPA and fully displayed the great honour of the KPA, weathering the fierce battle fire with the glorious national flag kept in their hearts, and to the heroic martyrs who laid the foundation of sure victory of our state and army with great feats and biographies to be handed down to generations to come.
The indomitable fighting spirit, mass heroism and immortal feats displayed by the combatants of the overseas operation unit of the armed forces of the DPRK will shine forever in the history of building a rich country with a strong army as an example of the absolute loyalty to the Party and the revolution peculiar to the KPA and a symbol of the eternal victory of our great state and our cause. -0-

Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- An artistic performance was given with splendor at the April 25 House of Culture here to congratulate the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units of the Korean People's Army who performed immortal feats in the sacred battle for defending the dignity and honor of the powerful DPRK.
