WhenKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!", looking up to the iron-willed brilliant commander who trained our People's Army into the strongest revolutionary armed forces in the world that are overwhelming any formidable enemy ideologically, mentally, militarily and technologically with his outstanding military strategic idea, extraordinary commanding art and great trust and love and put it on the highest level of the times.
The performers paid high tribute to the combat heroes of the era ofKim Jong Unwho demonstrated the fame of the motherland and set a good example of indomitable heroic mettle and fighting spirit of our army with legendary military feats while enthusiastically singing songs about the motherland that they had never forgotten even in their dreams and songs about the invincible revolutionary army.
The numbers representing the soul of loyalty and patriotism of the heroes who devoted their lives to our great Party, the inexhaustible might of our great state and the peace and happiness of our great people highly demonstrated the fact that the brilliant world-shaking war results of the KPA are the gains of the great ideological firmness, the precious tradition of the Korean revolution which was pioneered with ideology and has emerged victorious with ideology.
The participants were filled with solemn emotion, watching a video showing the feats of the brave soldiers who proved iron faith with the unheard-of legendary tales of miracles that peace is defended only by absolute strength and the representative of justice should possess the matchless strength to resolutely wipe out all injustice and showed with heroic choice what life a soldier of the Korean People's Army should live for the country and what to leave before the country.
When the songs "Stars of the Motherland", "We Will Remember" and "Only Victory" in memory of the brave soldiers who participated in the war resounded, all the audience warmly recollected with deep emotion the indomitable images of the brave soldiers who warmly loved their motherland and made the enemies shudder with mass heroism and the matchless self-sacrificing spirit which no army in the world has ever had, seen or heard by dedicating themselves to the call of the motherland.
The performance pulsating with firm faith and indomitable stamina of the service personnel of the People's Army to continuously write a proud heroic biography for all generations to come by developing the heroic spirit of the generation of army building and the victorious wartime generation onto a higher level in the new era of building a powerful army when our revolutionary armed forces are demonstrating the greatest heyday of their development was acclaimed by the audience.
When the performance was over, the audience broke into enthusiastic cheers again, looking up toKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unwarmly shook hands with brave soldiers cheering at the top of their voices with great emotion one by one and encouraged them.
The performance given to congratulate the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units of the Korean People's Army impressively showed the boundless praise of the Party, the country and the people for the heroic soldiers who glorified the great era ofKim Jong Unwith the victory won at the cost of their blood, and the pride and honor of having an invincible and powerful army. -0-

headline: Nicaraguan Ambassador Pays Tribute to Statues of Great Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Nicaraguan Ambassador to the DPRK Manuel Modesto Munguia Martinez on August 21 visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 46th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the DPRK and the Republic of Nicaragua.
The ambassador laid a bouquet before the statues of the President and the Chairman who led the cause of global independence to victory and performed the immortal exploits for the development of the friendly relations  between countries, and paid tribute to them. -0-

headline: Measures to Prevent Farmlands from Inundating in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Measures to prevent farmlands from being inundated by heavy rain and downpour are being taken in different parts of the DPRK.
Cities and counties in South Hamgyong Province observe water levels in small and medium rivers, reservoirs and waterways not to exceed their danger marks. They are dredging small and medium rivers and waterways and consolidating embankments by mobilizing forces and means.
North Hamgyong Province is concentrating efforts on minimizing damage caused by heavy rain. It takes measures to operate the equipment of drainage and pumping stations at full capacity and to prevent the arable lands from being buried or washed away by rainwater from hills and valleys.
Pyongyang Municipality is removing the places vulnerable to flood.
Other areas are also preventing lands from being buried and washed away by downpour. -0-

headline: Output of Dairy Products Goes Up in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK is strengthening the foundation for producing dairy products.
The province organized the demonstrations for strengthening the foundation for producing dairy products in Thaechon and Sakju counties, thus increasing the enthusiasm of cities and counties for emulation.
The projects for renovating the rooms for producing dairy products were launched in cities, counties and the units with nurseries and kindergartens, and the number of goats is increasing.
Vacuum concentrators were newly installed at the bases for producing dairy products of tens of city and county goat farms and the rooms for producing dairy products of hundreds of units were remodeled.
Tens of thousands of goats were secured to lay a foundation for increasing milk powder production both in quality and quantity. -0-

headline: Measures to Prevent Farmlands from Inundating in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Measures to prevent farmlands from being inundated by heavy rain and downpour are being taken in different parts of the DPRK.
Cities and counties in South Hamgyong Province observe water levels in small and medium rivers, reservoirs and waterways not to exceed their danger marks. They are dredging small and medium rivers and waterways and consolidating embankments by mobilizing forces and means.
North Hamgyong Province is concentrating efforts on minimizing damage caused by heavy rain. It takes measures to operate the equipment of drainage and pumping stations at full capacity and to prevent the arable lands from being buried or washed away by rainwater from hills and valleys.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Ceremony of Awarding State Commendations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a significant speech at a ceremony of awarding state commendations to the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units of the Korean People's Army.
The full text is as follows:
Comrades,
Generals, officers and soldiers,
My beloved comrades-in-arms,
The moment has come, for which our Party and government, together with the numerous families in this country that sent their dear sons to the battlefields, have waited so eagerly.
The whole country has waited for it.
It is also a moment, for which I have waited counting on my fingers.
As I see again at this meaningful ceremony the proud sons, the heroes of the country, who are a source of great pride for our state and for whom all the people have waited, I can hardly describe my feelings.
I extend heartfelt thanks and warm militant greetings to the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units, who fought bravely as befits Koreans and the Korean People’s Army under a hail of bullets and bombs in the do-or-die battles in the alien land and have returned home with dignity.
Comrades,
At the proposal of the Central Committee and Central Military Commission of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People’s Assembly of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea adopted a decree on awarding the title of Hero of the DPRK and other high commendations to the generals, officers and soldiers of our army who performed immortal feats in the overseas operations. I feel pleased to make the decree public here today.
These are the first commendations conferred on the combatants in the overseas operations, who are excellent sons of the Korean people and representatives of the great honour of their country.
Out of the desire to put forward in front of their country and fellow people the laudable heroes who have performed feats on the battlefields in the alien country in defence of the sacred prestige and dignity of their motherland and to make the whole country hold them in respect and esteem, the Central Committee of our Party has arranged a grand ceremony of awarding state commendations to them at its headquarters building.
These are special and valuable commendations the country and people confer on the honourable victors for their great feats that can be performed only in a bloody struggle.
You are entitled to enjoy this glory and the highest respect.
Since the day when I dispatched our special operations units overseas, I have frequently received reports on the course of their battles and have been deeply moved by the ennobling spirit, matchless bravery and invaluable sacrifice of our officers and soldiers. And I have been eager to award high commendations to all of them when they return home after fulfilling the missions entrusted to them.
As we are holding the first awarding ceremony today, I am reminded of the combatants who must be totally engaged in their tasks, even at this moment, true to the order of their motherland, as well as of the martyrs; and I am sorely sorry for failing to share this place of honour with all of them.
My heart aches and breaks as I am facing the reality in which I have no other alternative but to meet those, who dedicated their dear lives for the great victory and glory, by only seeing their photos on the memorial wall.
At the last moments of their lives of their own choice, they earned the most glorious eternity, leaving behind such feats and combat records as to be handed down through generations. My only thought is that how happy I would be if they shared this moment with me.
I have looked forward to hugging them warmly while every minute and every day wishing them safe and secure; I have been anxious to pin the Hero medal on their chests myself as they went through thick and thin with our glorious national flag in their bosoms. Now that all this is impossible, I feel really regretful.
As I am seeing the families of the fallen soldiers, I feel unspeakably sorry and chagrined for my failure to save the young lives, the invaluable sons they entrusted to us.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I express deep condolences to the families of the martyrs who laid down their precious lives in the overseas military operations, and propose a moment of silence praying for their eternity.
Our combatants in the war are all great men, great heroes and great patriots.
Through a staunch struggle and ennobling self-sacrifice, they performed great exploits to be etched in history for all eternity to bring lasting prosperity and strength to our country.
Kim Jong Unproudly said that the victory won by the combatants constitutes a great exploit that firmly defended the great honour of the Korean People’s Army, which must never be allowed to be stained, and provided a sure guarantee for the existence of our state and its development, a victory worth being recorded as a miracle in the history of our army building and in the chronicles of anti-imperialist revolutionary struggle, and at the same time, an epochal event in the world history of wars, which reformulated the thousands-of-years-old logic of the strong.
Stressing that the combat actions, which the overseas operations units, representing the armed forces of our Republic, carried out on the battlefields in the limelight of the world, fully demonstrated the mightiness of the heroic Korean People’s Army whose invincibility is based on the definite superiority of the ideological and spiritual preparedness and the Juche-oriented strategy and tactics, he continued:
What I prioritize and appreciate with satisfaction before anything else is the fact that the prestige of the ever-victorious Korean People’s Army has been verified most rigorously in its history of over 70 years, and that the true picture of our army fully prepared for war has been clearly confirmed.
The key to effectively coping with possible war and guaranteeing victory in it is to break the enemy’s will to fight it.
Now it has become an established theory that the army of any country will be doomed to death and ruin if they fight against our army.
It can be said that though you fought on the alien land and held trenches outside our territory, you have built high walls for the defence of your country.
In this sense, you have performed feats more precious and priceless than the victory in a war we might have fought on this land.
Today’s ceremony is an expression of gratitude and high praise of our Party, state and people for your historic feats of having carried out perfectly the political decision of the Party and the government for the destiny and future of the country and safeguarded the great honour maintained by all the generations of the Republic for decades.
Comrades,
The traces of fierce battles in the liberated region of the alien land where bullets and bombs showered will disappear and everything will change in the near future, but the memories of the outstanding valour and noble self-sacrificing spirit displayed by our service personnel will be neither erased nor buried in oblivion.
Their greatness and immortality are vividly enshrined on this land thousands of miles away from the hard-fought battlefields.
I greatly revere the spiritual world of you comrades who contributed to liberating the Kursk region, because the ennobling fighting spirit of heroes, which we have put forward so far, has become that of all the service personnel of the overseas operations units.
The heroism displayed by the service personnel of our overseas operations units gave rise to the feelings of both admiration and apprehension in many countries, and it was not confined to some specific performers of feats.
The overseas military operations produced a great number of heroes, all surpassing Ri Su Bok, Kang Ho Yong and Jo Kun Sil.
To be frank, the number took me by surprise, before anybody elsewhere in the world.
Our service personnel, be they military, political and medical officers, interpreters and even supply service soldiers, fought bravely, and all of them shared mind and purpose with one another under whatever circumstances.
They fought heroically and self-sacrificingly, irrespective of rank, age, career or exploit.
It was around the age of 18 that soldiers blocked the enemy’s gun muzzles with their chests. Contrary to this general belief, it was the officers in their thirties and forties who did so in the battles. Some, though aware that no remains of themselves would be left, unhesitatingly chose to blow themselves up, and some others shielded their superior officers with their bodies to protect them from bullets. I was strongly impressed by these facts.
Please look at that memorial wall in this hall of the Party Central Committee building.
These numerous officers, so stout and good-looking, stood in the vanguard and died a heroic death.
They deserve to be called model heroes, and the overseas operations units, heroic units.
The deeds of the individual heroes, which we put forward as paragons in the past, have now developed into a mass-based movement.
Countrywide, 600 or so holders of the title of Hero were produced during the three-year-long war of over seven decades ago, whereas, during the overseas military operations launched by the armed forces of our Republic, all the service personnel of an entire army group performed heroic exploits in a little more than six months.
The secret to victory in the recent overseas military operations lies not in the exploits performed by some outstanding military commanders or heroes, but entirely in the mass character of heroism and the spiritual and moral traits, both ennobling and beautiful, which definitely dominated the thoughts and feelings of all the service personnel of the overseas operations units.
They were thoroughgoing in implementing the orders from their superiors, as they ought to be as soldiers, and every one of them cherished a high sense of patriotism, loved their comrades-in-arms so ardently and was strong in the spirit of devotion. They were all excellent in terms of morality, performing their duties with credit and choosing to act honourably as dictated by their conscience, even when they were facing death.
Witnessing such exceptional, unique traits of yours, the world has come to realize why our army is so powerful and what the key factor is in guaranteeing its victory in whatever battle it engages in.
This is a landmark event in which the concept of a powerful army and the law of war victory have been clearly inscribed in the annals of the times and history.
I say this with certainty.
Whichever unit of our Army was to fight in the recent war and whichever arm it might belong to, its service personnel would have fought as bravely as you did and performed feats on a par with your heroic exploits.
I am most pleased and satisfied that, through you, I have reconfirmed the degree our service personnel’s spiritual and moral qualities have reached. Having such an army as the pioneer and defender of their revolutionary cause is a source of pride and honour for the Workers’ Party of Korea and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
As it has always done, in the present era, too, our army is adding lustre to its honourable appellation as a symbol of the heroic Korean people, as a representative of the great Korean people.
The country defended by this heroic army will remain powerful forever, and the cause advancing forward with such an army standing in the vanguard will be ever-victorious.
As it hardens such conviction, today’s ceremony is particularly significant and weighty.
At this meaningful ceremony, I, on behalf of the Party and the government, once again extend heartfelt thanks and militant salute to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who have demonstrated the great honour of the Korean People’s Army by living up to the Party’s and motherland’s trust in it, displaying unprecedentedly heroic fighting spirit and performing undying feats in the fierce flames of battles.
And availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to tell our brave combatants what I have repeated hundreds of times in my mind.
As it is defended by you and other heroic soldiers, this country is formidable.
Comrades,
Our Party will surely find out all the feats the combatants of the overseas operations units performed at the cost of their blood in every decisive battlefield in the alien land and proudly show them to their parents, wives and children and to the country, people and posterity.
We will tell the people, the KPA officers and soldiers, their sons and daughters and other children all those precious combat experiences you gained in the bloody struggle, your genuine camaraderie and absolute love for your motherland, the heartbreaking sacrifices you had to endure shedding tears of blood, your delight in winning invaluable victory at such a cost, and your beautiful life filled with optimism about a bright future.
In a prominent part of the capital city, a combat feats memorial museum and a monument to combat feats will be erected to hand down the great feats performed by the combatants, and the whole country will respect and learn from the heroes’ noble soul and mettle for all eternity.
The motherland will confer the highest and most brilliant honour on all the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units and at the same time bring all the glory to their parents who raised their children well and readily sent them to the scared war for the country.
Today’s ceremony is the beginning of these all.
The glorious path pioneered by the combatants at the cost of their blood on the battlefields in the alien land and the ennobling lives of the martyrs will not come to an end. The blood-stained combat records inscribed with their names will shine their eternal brilliance in the most precious pages of the history of the country.
Comrades,
Frustrating all challenges that threaten the sovereignty and security of the state and providing a firm military guarantee for its peace and development is the invariable mission of our revolutionary armed forces.
Now in the international arena, very serious and unpredictable security crises are being created by excessive use of military force by the fanatical forces buoyed by war fever, and our enemy states are becoming ever more undisguised in their dangerous attempt to undermine the prestige and superiority of our state which is maintaining the balance of the security situation in and around the Korean peninsula.
This environment leaves us no room for feeling at ease, and it demands that our army maintain a higher level of perfect and overwhelming preparedness.
Kim Jong Unadvanced important tasks for developing the armed forces of the Republic into an elite and strong army and winding up its war preparedness to cope with the prevailing situation and the military provocations by the enemy states.
He said that officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units who are still performing their honourable combat missions in the alien land should keep in mind that their beloved parents, wives and children and their motherland are waiting for the day when they will come back in good health, and continued:
Our state will remain dignified, powerful and strong forever as it has such great heroes as you.
Our army will carry forward the great history of war victory for all ages by displaying its unique loyalty and heroic mettle.
I wish immortal glory to the heroic officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units who have elevated our people’s long history of victory and the absolute strength of our revolutionary armed forces to the highest and most glorious plane.
Long live the heroic Korean People’s Army! -0-

headline: Vice-Chief of KPA General Staff Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Army Lieutenant General Ko Jong Chol, vice-chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, issued the following press statement "Dangerous provocation inciting military conflict in the southern border area should be stopped immediately" on August 22:
On August 19, the ROK military warmongers committed such a serious provocation as firing more than 10 warning shots with 12.7 mm large-caliber machine gun at the DPRK soldiers who were conducting a permanent barrier project near the southern border line.
This is a very serious prelude that would inevitably drive the situation in the southern border area where a huge number of forces are stationing in confrontation with each other to the uncontrollable phase and the DPRK army is keeping tabs on the present situation.
At present, the DPRK army is conducting a barrier project to permanently block the southern border with the ROK as part of the regular work to reinforce the border.
Completely separating the territory, where the DPRK exercises its sovereignty, from the one of the ROK is the undertaking to eliminate the factor of escalated tension in the militarily acute southern border area and secure the stable environment and therefore, it poses no threat to anyone.
As regards the barrier project in the southern border area, the DPRK army had already informed the U.S. forces side which is exercising control over the ROK army of the relevant contents on June 25 and July 18 out of the intention to prevent misunderstanding and accidental conflict.
Even the U.S. forces side accepted this as a sincere measure for détente and confirmed that the project by our personnel is obviously underway within the sovereign territory of the DPRK.
Nonetheless, the provocative acts rattling the nerves of our personnel still persist and worse still turn into more vicious ones and explosively increase in their scale.
The loudspeaker broadcasting provocation which was confined to one or two observation posts in the past has been expanded to several units of the ROK army including the 3rd, 6th, 15th and 28th divisions and they are making such threatening remarks as "We'll shoot" as a daily routine.
Shortly ago, a high-ranking official concerned of the ROK army made public to the media that he would continue the warning broadcasting that irritates the DPRK in the southern border area under the pretext of "maintenance of security and defense posture". This clearly reveals the standpoint of the U.S. forces side in dealing with our advanced notice.
In particular, the recent incident, timed to coincide with the large-scale joint military drills being staged in the region of the ROK, can not but be construed as a premeditated and deliberate provocation aimed at military conflict from A to Z.
All facts go to clearly prove that the sinister intention of the U.S. and the ROK warmongers to pursue military confrontation with the DPRK remains unchanged.
As the commanding officer responsible for the southern border management and security, I strongly demand to immediately stop the dangerous provocation aimed to make the fortification project in the southern border necessary for defending our sovereignty an excuse for escalation of tension.
If the act of restraining or obstructing the project unrelated to the military character persists, our army will regard it as deliberate military provocation and take corresponding countermeasure.
Until now, our side has not questioned the frequent approach to the border line by the airplanes as well as the forces and equipment of the ROK army notified by the U.S. forces side.
Therefore, I clarify that if a dangerous situation in which an advanced notice of the other party is ignored in the southern border area where a huge number of forces are stationing in sharp confrontation with each other, we will take no responsibility for the grave consequences to be entailed by it.
The General Staff of the KPA will closely watch the further development of situation. -0-

headline: Spokesman for KPA General Staff Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the General Staff of the Korean People's Army on August 22 issued the following press statement "The situation of the ROK clouded with powder smoke will further bolster the full readiness of our army":
Despite the unanimous concern and rejection of the public at home and abroad, the U.S. and the ROK clans finally started the large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield on August 18.
The joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield, being staged on land, at sea and in the air of the ROK under the deceptive signboard of "shield of freedom", is an extremely provocative and aggressive large-scale drill for an actual war clearly aimed at a sudden preemptive attack on the DPRK as it is an actual command and field maneuvering drill for applying and mastering new manuals and methods of modern warfare in actual conditions of the Korean peninsula.
The gravity and danger of the drill lie in the fact that it includes the application of "OPLAN 2022", a war scenario simulating "preemptive strike against origin" as regards the nuclear facilities of the DPRK, and various kinds of exercises staged by forces and mechanized strike groups of regimental-level and above to maneuver in attacking formation and fire live shells.
The reckless war drill of the U.S. and the ROK warmongers is seriously threatening the security environment of the DPRK and pushing the situation on the Korean peninsula and in the region to the extreme tension.
Particularly, some warships belonging to the British army which were engaged in the joint maritime drill in the Pacific entered the Pusan operational base and other forces of member states of the "UN Command" participated in the joint military drill, and thus the "Ulji Freedom Shield" completely turned into a multinational joint military drill and the military threats against the DPRK was redoubled.
All the facts clearly show once again that the adventurous military drill of the U.S. and the ROK leads to the destruction of balance of power in the region and the chief culprit of harassing peace on the Korean peninsula is none other than the U.S. and the ROK.
No place in the world is like the surrounding area of the DPRK where huge forces are concentrated and conduct actual military drills.
The full readiness of our army to perfectly contain and smash any hostile military move against the DPRK will be further bolstered.
The DPRK army as already declared will respond to the military provocations of the hostile forces posing direct threat to the safety of the country with proper and indiscriminate exercise of the right to self-defence. -0-

headline: Steps for Minimizing Crop Damage by Natural Disasters in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Rural areas in Pyongyang Municipality are protecting crops in a foresighted way to cope with the recent weather conditions accompanied with frequent rainfalls.
Farms in Mangyongdae District take measures to prevent the farmlands and crops from downpour by raising the operation rate of pumping equipment and correcting defects.
Officials and agricultural workers of Rangnang and Samsok districts and Kangnam County reinforce the embankments of small and medium rivers and repair waterways, while making good preparations for using mobile water pumps at any time and taking agro-technical measures to protect crops from blight and harmful insects.
Farms in Sadong, Hyongjesan and Sunan districts and Kangdong County introduce rational water conservation methods and increase the passing capacity of drainage channels.
Agricultural workers of Ryokpho District clear out the drainage channels and ditches around fields and strive to collect the safe yield. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Achievements in Metallurgical Industrial Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- The metallurgical industrial sector of the DPRK is laying the foundation for increasing production by steadily increasing its sci-tech force.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex increased the repair cycle of blast furnaces and raised the output of molten iron by introducing a new technology in cooperation with the relevant units, and manufactured a carbonic acid gas generator necessary for the process for producing concentrate transport pipelines by itself.
The Chollima Steel Complex lays a new foundation for producing reduced iron, while directing efforts to the study of a new variety of steel.
Officials and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the Unryul Mine and the Hungnam Electrode Factory strive to attain the technological innovation goals planned for this year. -0-

headline: Measures Taken to Minimize Damage by Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Various economic sectors of the DPRK have taken measures for minimizing damage by disastrous abnormal weather.
The electric power industrial sector has conducted the work to protect hydraulic structures and taken measures to keep transformers, breakers, transformer substations and steel towers from a thunderbolt.
The railway transport sector has launched the work to minimize the damage by heavy rain and much rain and ensure transport of major freights and safe run of passenger trains. It has made preparations to carry emergency relief teams and materials. Railway bureaus and branch bureaus are ready to use emergency vehicles.
The mining industrial sector is taking measures to mobilize manpower and vehicles in case of emergency while reinforcing embankments of tailing settling basins and increasing observation posts and personnel. It checked and repaired reserve pumps to ensure their full operation. -0-

headline: Cognitional and Educational Effect of Class Education Improved in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Class education houses in different parts of the DPRK have firmly built the revolutionary position, the class position.
The Sinchon Class Education House has worked out lecture programs in a broad way on the basis of the recently discovered and ascertained data, conducted the discussion on lecture and improved the visualization and vivid expression of exhibits.
The Central Class Education House has intensified education in faith among the visitors through the data on the struggle of the patriots who did not yield to the enemies' barbaric atrocities and tyranny and conducted the mobile lectures in combination with artistic motivation.
The South Hamgyong Provincial Class Education House improved the level of practical ability with the lecturers' day as an occasion and organized an expedition to the site for burying persons alive in Sudo-ri of Haean District, Hamhung City, which bears witness to the enemies' brutal killing, and a meeting with the persons who suffered atrocities.
The Nampho Municipal Class Education House exhibited the data on education in the way of ensuring academic significance and effectiveness of cognition and is conducting explanatory lectures in a more plain language.
Class education houses in Onsong County of North Hamgyong Province and Ichon County of Kangwon Province renovate their interior and exterior and improve the level of practical ability. -0-

headline: Steps for Minimizing Crop Damage by Natural Disasters in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Rural areas in Pyongyang Municipality are protecting crops in a foresighted way to cope with the recent weather conditions accompanied with frequent rainfalls.
Farms in Mangyongdae District take measures to prevent the farmlands and crops from downpour by raising the operation rate of pumping equipment and correcting defects.
Officials and agricultural workers of Rangnang and Samsok districts and Kangnam County reinforce the embankments of small and medium rivers and repair waterways, while making good preparations for using mobile water pumps at any time and taking agro-technical measures to protect crops from blight and harmful insects.
Farms in Sadong, Hyongjesan and Sunan districts and Kangdong County introduce rational water conservation methods and increase the passing capacity of drainage channels.
Agricultural workers of Ryokpho District clear out the drainage channels and ditches around fields and strive to collect the safe yield. -0-

headline: Spokesman for KPA General Staff Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the General Staff of the Korean People's Army on August 22 issued the following press statement "The situation of the ROK clouded with powder smoke will further bolster the full readiness of our army":
Despite the unanimous concern and rejection of the public at home and abroad, the U.S. and the ROK clans finally started the large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield on August 18.
The joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield, being staged on land, at sea and in the air of the ROK under the deceptive signboard of "shield of freedom", is an extremely provocative and aggressive large-scale drill for an actual war clearly aimed at a sudden preemptive attack on the DPRK as it is an actual command and field maneuvering drill for applying and mastering new manuals and methods of modern warfare in actual conditions of the Korean peninsula.
The gravity and danger of the drill lie in the fact that it includes the application of "OPLAN 2022", a war scenario simulating "preemptive strike against origin" as regards the nuclear facilities of the DPRK, and various kinds of exercises staged by forces and mechanized strike groups of regimental-level and above to maneuver in attacking formation and fire live shells.
The reckless war drill of the U.S. and the ROK warmongers is seriously threatening the security environment of the DPRK and pushing the situation on the Korean peninsula and in the region to the extreme tension.
Particularly, some warships belonging to the British army which were engaged in the joint maritime drill in the Pacific entered the Pusan operational base and other forces of member states of the "UN Command" participated in the joint military drill, and thus the "Ulji Freedom Shield" completely turned into a multinational joint military drill and the military threats against the DPRK was redoubled.
All the facts clearly show once again that the adventurous military drill of the U.S. and the ROK leads to the destruction of balance of power in the region and the chief culprit of harassing peace on the Korean peninsula is none other than the U.S. and the ROK.
No place in the world is like the surrounding area of the DPRK where huge forces are concentrated and conduct actual military drills.
The full readiness of our army to perfectly contain and smash any hostile military move against the DPRK will be further bolstered.
The DPRK army as already declared will respond to the military provocations of the hostile forces posing direct threat to the safety of the country with proper and indiscriminate exercise of the right to self-defence. -0-

At present, the DPRK army is conducting a barrier project to permanently block the southern border with the ROK as part of the regular work to reinforce the border.
Completely separating the territory, where the DPRK exercises its sovereignty, from the one of the ROK is the undertaking to eliminate the factor of escalated tension in the militarily acute southern border area and secure the stable environment and therefore, it poses no threat to anyone.

headline: Aesthetic Symposium Held in DPRK
Cognitional and Educational Effect of Class Education Improved in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Class education houses in different parts of the DPRK have firmly built the revolutionary position, the class position.
The Sinchon Class Education House has worked out lecture programs in a broad way on the basis of the recently discovered and ascertained data, conducted the discussion on lecture and improved the visualization and vivid expression of exhibits.
The Central Class Education House has intensified education in faith among the visitors through the data on the struggle of the patriots who did not yield to the enemies' barbaric atrocities and tyranny and conducted the mobile lectures in combination with artistic motivation.
The South Hamgyong Provincial Class Education House improved the level of practical ability with the lecturers' day as an occasion and organized an expedition to the site for burying persons alive in Sudo-ri of Haean District, Hamhung City, which bears witness to the enemies' brutal killing, and a meeting with the persons who suffered atrocities.
The Nampho Municipal Class Education House exhibited the data on education in the way of ensuring academic significance and effectiveness of cognition and is conducting explanatory lectures in a more plain language.
Class education houses in Onsong County of North Hamgyong Province and Ichon County of Kangwon Province renovate their interior and exterior and improve the level of practical ability. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Achievements in Metallurgical Industrial Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- The metallurgical industrial sector of the DPRK is laying the foundation for increasing production by steadily increasing its sci-tech force.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex increased the repair cycle of blast furnaces and raised the output of molten iron by introducing a new technology in cooperation with the relevant units, and manufactured a carbonic acid gas generator necessary for the process for producing concentrate transport pipelines by itself.
The Chollima Steel Complex lays a new foundation for producing reduced iron, while directing efforts to the study of a new variety of steel.
Officials and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex, the Unryul Mine and the Hungnam Electrode Factory strive to attain the technological innovation goals planned for this year. -0-

headline: Measures Taken to Minimize Damage by Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Various economic sectors of the DPRK have taken measures for minimizing damage by disastrous abnormal weather.
The electric power industrial sector has conducted the work to protect hydraulic structures and taken measures to keep transformers, breakers, transformer substations and steel towers from a thunderbolt.
The railway transport sector has launched the work to minimize the damage by heavy rain and much rain and ensure transport of major freights and safe run of passenger trains. It has made preparations to carry emergency relief teams and materials. Railway bureaus and branch bureaus are ready to use emergency vehicles.
The mining industrial sector is taking measures to mobilize manpower and vehicles in case of emergency while reinforcing embankments of tailing settling basins and increasing observation posts and personnel. It checked and repaired reserve pumps to ensure their full operation. -0-

headline: Explosion of Ukishima-maru Disclosing Viciousness of Japanese Imperialists
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Among the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people in the past is the explosion of Ukishima-maru in which the DPRK people are grinding their teeth with surging indignation.
The explosion of Ukishima-maru in the waters off Maizuru, Japan on August 24, 1945 was an unprecedented massacre of Koreans committed according to the scenario of the Japanese imperialists from A to Z.
At that time, the Japanese imperialists let a large number of Koreans on their way back to the country with the joy of liberation to embark on Ukishima-maru with the intention of revenging their defeat by killing more Koreans.
The Japanese naval transport ship Ukishima-maru left Ominato Port in Aomori Prefecture on August 22, 1945 and sailed to the south along the western coast of Japan. It suddenly turned the helm to the port of Maizuru, the naval port in northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, on the pretext of filling up water on August 24.
That afternoon, loud explosive sounds were heard several times and the ship was sunk, broken in two, in the water some 300 meters off from the coast of Maizuru Port.
Thousands of Koreans, who had been looking forward to the day of their return to their dear homeland, having a happy dream of living well in their liberated homeland, were buried in the sea at once.
After the incident, the Japanese reactionaries claimed that the ship was sunk by a mine, but it was a sophism to conceal their crimes.
The whole course from the departure of Ukishima-maru till the explosion in the waters off Maizuru, testimonies of the survivors and all the evidence unearthed clearly prove that the ship was sunk by the planned and deliberate manipulation of the Japanese imperialists.
However, the Japanese reactionaries have not made any apology and reparation for the hideous crimes against humanity committed by them, including the explosion of Ukishima-maru, even though 80 years have passed since their defeat. On the contrary, they have committed hostile acts against the DPRK more openly.
The DPRK people still remember all the bloody crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists in the past, and will make them pay a thousand-fold price. -0-

headline: Taekwon-Do Teams and Universities Introduce Scientific Research Achievements into Teaching and Training
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Taekwon-Do teams and universities across the DPRK have introduced significant achievements in putting teaching and training on a scientific and IT basis.
The Taekwon-Do teams of Kangwon Province and South Hwanghae Province developed an electronic-style subcutaneous fat measuring equipment and a system for measuring the exercise ability for assessing the players' physical abilities and conducting teaching and training guidance in a scientific way.
The North Hwanghae Provincial Taekwon-Do Team, which made an educational intelligence tactical training model necessary for explaining countermeasures and tactical movements according to the sudden situation in the sparring match, is expanding the tactical insight of the players.
Teachers and researchers of Kangwon Provincial Taekwon-Do University and the South Hamgyong Provincial Taekwon-Do Team introduced training apparatuses effective for measuring different movements and punching speed of players and training them in agility, thus increasing the physical and technical abilities of students and players.
South Phyongan Provincial Taekwon-Do University published books on Taekwon-Do training and guidance methods to inspire the students with enthusiasm for study. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Gigantic Revolutionary Projects of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Sunday in an article says that the gigantic revolutionary projects of the Workers' Party of Korea are a great revolutionary struggle for accelerating the comprehensive national rejuvenation.
The struggle for the comprehensive national rejuvenation is an unprecedentedly gigantic cause in the breadth and depth of its changes and in the huge-scale tasks, and a very difficult one to bring about epochal changes despite the arduous trials and difficulties, the article says, and goes on:.
The building of a great and powerful state with tremendous might which is unfazed by any challenges and obstacles and which no one dares to face, is a great historic cause which can be accomplished only by the revolutionary party led by an outstanding leader.
The past 10-odd years are shining as the immortal journey that our Party has dynamically pushed ahead with the overall development of socialist construction under the wise leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
In such stormy years that led to acute confrontation and moments of greatest hardship in which the arduous history of our revolution was compressed, our Party has attached importance to the prospective interests, not to the solution ahead of its eyes, and unfolded a grand blueprint one after another and persistently carried them out, looking forward to the distant future.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the Party, the history of the development of our state has been recorded as a chronicle of eye-opening changes and a legendary heroic epic.
Thanks to the leadership of the great Party which sets forth the guidelines for uninterrupted innovation and continuous leap forward for national rejuvenation and turns them into the entities of changes by implementing them most thoroughly and perfectly, new innovations and development suited to the prestige of the powerful country are being made in all fields.
Our Republic will prosper forever thanks to the ever-victorious leadership of the WPK which is dynamically ushering in a new era of the greatest and dignified power through its gigantic revolutionary project, looking forward to the future of a prosperous power with confidence. -0-

headline: 17 Objects Newly Registered as National and Local Intangible Cultural Heritages
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- 17 objects have recently been registered as national and local intangible cultural heritages in the DPRK.
13 objects including legendary tales about Mt Kuwol, custom of moving into new houses, folk instrumental music "Sinau", two folk dances, calligraphy, top spinning, custom of mushroom on Mt Chilbo, noodle with seasoned raw-sliced fish and rice gruel boiled with mussels were registered as the national intangible cultural heritages.
Coriander kimchi, pheasant boiled with rice and other two objects were registered as local intangible cultural heritages. -0-

headline: Central Tree Nursery in DPRK Produces Lots of Saplings
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- The Central Tree Nursery of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in the DPRK is concentrating efforts to producing saplings needed for autumn tree planting.
Researchers are displaying high responsibility in trial cultivation and survey work for acclimatizing saplings of good species.
All the employees are abiding by the requirements of technical rules according to the growth stage of saplings while properly manuring and cultivating them.
They are also conducting the work for coping with disastrous abnormal weather conditions in a foresighted way while properly managing temperature and humidity and monitoring harmful insects to prevent the damage from them.
Thanks to their efforts, millions of saplings including pine-nut tree and white birch have been fully grown for autumn tree planting.
Meanwhile, successes have been made in research on herbicide based on domestic raw materials and its introduction. -0-

headline: Events Held in Different Countries to Mark 80th Anniversary of Korea's Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- There took place seminars on the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand friendly meetings and other events in Germany, Austria, Egypt, Brazil and Venezuela from August 6 to 15 to celebrate the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages of political parties, parliaments and organizations of relevant countries and members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people.
The formal representative of the German Branch of the Korean Friendship Association said at a friendship meeting that Korea's liberation was a historic event that proved in practice that the people of the colonial countries can achieve their independence when they are led by the outstanding leader.  The world oppressed working masses achieved the independence of their countries, following the experience of the DPRK which set an example in the national liberation struggle in colonies, the formal representative said.
A vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and the chief of the Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria said at the seminars that August 15, 1945 was a significant day when a radical turn was brought about in carving out the destiny of the Korean people and the new epoch of socialist Korea was opened, praisingKim Il Sungas a peerlessly great man who led the grim anti-Japanese war to victory under the banner of independence and thus accomplished the cause of national liberation.
A member of the National Political Committee of the Brazilian Communist Party and the chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics praised the President's exploits for national liberation, saying that the anti-Japanese armed struggle was an arduous struggle unprecedented in history and its brilliant victory was a great event that instilled confidence and courage into the peoples of many countries fighting for national liberation in colonies.
The chairman of the Venezuela-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group said in a speech at a celebration event that the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho put an end to the Japanese imperialists' occupation of Korea and liberated the country serve the immortal exploits in holding a great position in the modern history of the DPRK and the cause of global independence. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Sunday in an article says that the gigantic revolutionary projects of the Workers' Party of Korea are a great revolutionary struggle for accelerating the comprehensive national rejuvenation.
The struggle for the comprehensive national rejuvenation is an unprecedentedly gigantic cause in the breadth and depth of its changes and in the huge-scale tasks, and a very difficult one to bring about epochal changes despite the arduous trials and difficulties, the article says, and goes on:.
The building of a great and powerful state with tremendous might which is unfazed by any challenges and obstacles and which no one dares to face, is a great historic cause which can be accomplished only by the revolutionary party led by an outstanding leader.
The past 10-odd years are shining as the immortal journey that our Party has dynamically pushed ahead with the overall development of socialist construction under the wise leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
In such stormy years that led to acute confrontation and moments of greatest hardship in which the arduous history of our revolution was compressed, our Party has attached importance to the prospective interests, not to the solution ahead of its eyes, and unfolded a grand blueprint one after another and persistently carried them out, looking forward to the distant future.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the Party, the history of the development of our state has been recorded as a chronicle of eye-opening changes and a legendary heroic epic.
Thanks to the leadership of the great Party which sets forth the guidelines for uninterrupted innovation and continuous leap forward for national rejuvenation and turns them into the entities of changes by implementing them most thoroughly and perfectly, new innovations and development suited to the prestige of the powerful country are being made in all fields.
Our Republic will prosper forever thanks to the ever-victorious leadership of the WPK which is dynamically ushering in a new era of the greatest and dignified power through its gigantic revolutionary project, looking forward to the future of a prosperous power with confidence. -0-

headline: Events Held in Different Countries to Mark 80th Anniversary of Korea's Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- There took place seminars on the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand friendly meetings and other events in Germany, Austria, Egypt, Brazil and Venezuela from August 6 to 15 to celebrate the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages of political parties, parliaments and organizations of relevant countries and members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people.
The formal representative of the German Branch of the Korean Friendship Association said at a friendship meeting that Korea's liberation was a historic event that proved in practice that the people of the colonial countries can achieve their independence when they are led by the outstanding leader.  The world oppressed working masses achieved the independence of their countries, following the experience of the DPRK which set an example in the national liberation struggle in colonies, the formal representative said.
A vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and the chief of the Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria said at the seminars that August 15, 1945 was a significant day when a radical turn was brought about in carving out the destiny of the Korean people and the new epoch of socialist Korea was opened, praisingKim Il Sungas a peerlessly great man who led the grim anti-Japanese war to victory under the banner of independence and thus accomplished the cause of national liberation.
A member of the National Political Committee of the Brazilian Communist Party and the chairman of the Brazilian Center for the Study of Songun Politics praised the President's exploits for national liberation, saying that the anti-Japanese armed struggle was an arduous struggle unprecedented in history and its brilliant victory was a great event that instilled confidence and courage into the peoples of many countries fighting for national liberation in colonies.
The chairman of the Venezuela-Korea Friendship Parliamentary Group said in a speech at a celebration event that the exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho put an end to the Japanese imperialists' occupation of Korea and liberated the country serve the immortal exploits in holding a great position in the modern history of the DPRK and the cause of global independence. -0-

headline: Explosion of Ukishima-maru Disclosing Viciousness of Japanese Imperialists
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Among the crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people in the past is the explosion of Ukishima-maru in which the DPRK people are grinding their teeth with surging indignation.
The explosion of Ukishima-maru in the waters off Maizuru, Japan on August 24, 1945 was an unprecedented massacre of Koreans committed according to the scenario of the Japanese imperialists from A to Z.
At that time, the Japanese imperialists let a large number of Koreans on their way back to the country with the joy of liberation to embark on Ukishima-maru with the intention of revenging their defeat by killing more Koreans.
The Japanese naval transport ship Ukishima-maru left Ominato Port in Aomori Prefecture on August 22, 1945 and sailed to the south along the western coast of Japan. It suddenly turned the helm to the port of Maizuru, the naval port in northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, on the pretext of filling up water on August 24.
That afternoon, loud explosive sounds were heard several times and the ship was sunk, broken in two, in the water some 300 meters off from the coast of Maizuru Port.
Thousands of Koreans, who had been looking forward to the day of their return to their dear homeland, having a happy dream of living well in their liberated homeland, were buried in the sea at once.
After the incident, the Japanese reactionaries claimed that the ship was sunk by a mine, but it was a sophism to conceal their crimes.
The whole course from the departure of Ukishima-maru till the explosion in the waters off Maizuru, testimonies of the survivors and all the evidence unearthed clearly prove that the ship was sunk by the planned and deliberate manipulation of the Japanese imperialists.
However, the Japanese reactionaries have not made any apology and reparation for the hideous crimes against humanity committed by them, including the explosion of Ukishima-maru, even though 80 years have passed since their defeat. On the contrary, they have committed hostile acts against the DPRK more openly.
The DPRK people still remember all the bloody crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists in the past, and will make them pay a thousand-fold price. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: DPRK Missile Administration Conducts Firing of New Air Defence Missiles
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on August 23 conducted the firing of two types of new air defence missiles of improved version at different targets to test their combat capability.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the firing.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first deputy department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Air Chief Marshal Kim Kwang Hyok, commander of the Air Force of the Korean People's Army, and Kim Yong Hwan, president of the DPRK Academy of Defence Sciences.
Through the firing, it has been assessed that the new air defence missile weapon systems have superior combat capability of fast response to various aerial targets such as attack drones and cruise missiles and their operation and reaction mode is based on unique and special technology.
The firing particularly proved that the technological features of two types of projectiles are very suitable for destroying various aerial targets.
That day, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unindicated an important task to be carried out by the sector of national defence science of the DPRK ahead of the Party Congress. -0-

headline: Explosion of Ukishima-maru Disclosing Viciousness of Japanese Imperialists
17 Objects Newly Registered as National and Local Intangible Cultural Heritages
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- 17 objects have recently been registered as national and local intangible cultural heritages in the DPRK.
13 objects including legendary tales about Mt Kuwol, custom of moving into new houses, folk instrumental music "Sinau", two folk dances, calligraphy, top spinning, custom of mushroom on Mt Chilbo, noodle with seasoned raw-sliced fish and rice gruel boiled with mussels were registered as the national intangible cultural heritages.
Coriander kimchi, pheasant boiled with rice and other two objects were registered as local intangible cultural heritages. -0-

headline: Efforts Paid to Strengthening Material and Technical Foundation of Agricultural Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Working people's organizations in Kaesong Municipality in the DPRK have conducted mass movement to contribute to strengthening the material foundation of agricultural production.
Youth league organizations of Koryo Songgyungwan University, the Kaesong Koryo Insam Processing Factory and the Kaephung Mine have collected a lot of materials to contribute to the manufacture of farm machines.
The municipal trade union committee and the municipal committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea have conducted the activities of farm machine repair support teams to ensure the full operation of farm machines and sent seed separator, maize threshing machine and other machines to the farms in the municipality.
Primary organizations at the Kaesong Municipal Koryo Medicine Production Management Bureau, the Songdo Foodstuff Factory and the Osan Taesong Insam Station worked out step-by-step plans for securing various agricultural implements according to the farming processes and carried them out substantially.
Women's union organizations and members in the municipality have devoted themselves to the manufacture of farm machines and implements. -0-

headline: Home-visiting Group of Korean Students in Japan Arrives in Pyongyang
Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Start of Leadership of Revolutionary Armed Forces Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK on Monday dedicated articles to the 65th anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il's start of the leadership of the revolutionary armed forces (August 25, 1960).
Rodong Sinmun says in a co-signed article that the Chairman had continued to lead the revolutionary armed forces for more than half a century since he visited the Seoul Ryu Kyong Su Guards 105th Tank Division of the Korean People's Army 65 years ago.
Thanks to the high-intensity forced march of the peerlessly brilliant commander, the DPRK has built up the strongest strength unprecedented in the history of the Juche revolution and the Korean revolution has demonstrated its dignity before the world as the invincible cause winning victory after victory despite all storms of history, the article notes, and goes on:
The history of building the revolutionary armed forces ofKim Jong Ilis shining as a sacred history in which the KPA was trained into the army strong in ideology and faith, upholding in the vanguard the revolutionary cause of the leader with arms.
The ideology of the leader uniquely dominated the KPA and the whole army could be strengthened into invincible militant ranks sharing intention, step and destiny with the Supreme Commander and into the ranks of bullets and bombs defending the leader at the risk of their lives. This would have been unthinkable without the leadership ofKim Jong Ilwho put forward the original idea of building the revolutionary armed forces and wisely led it.
He directed great efforts to developing the defence industry in the whole period of his leadership over the revolutionary armed forces, thus providing the KPA with material and technical guarantee for winning victory in the confrontation with any enemy.
The eternality and purity of the Korean revolution are firmly guaranteed thanks to the outstanding and seasoned leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is carrying forward the Chairman's exploits in building the revolutionary armed forces pure and clean.
Minju Joson says in an article that the immortal exploits of the Chairman, who put the DPRK on the status of a world-class military power and a full-fledged nuclear weapons state in the grim period when the destiny of the country and people was decisive and successfully realized the centuries-old desire of the Korean people who have aspired after powerful military capability for self-defence will shine forever. -0-

headline: DPRK Young People Volunteer to Work in Major Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Young people in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK volunteered for major theaters.
Young people in Waudo and Taean districts and Ryonggang county asked the youth league organizations to send them to the raw material base stations and the Evodia daniellii forest stations.
Young people in Hanggu District and Onchon County volunteered to work at construction brigades with a resolve to turn the countryside into a socialist paradise.
Young people in Chollima and Kangso districts volunteered to work at the Chollima Steel Complex and other production sites.
A meeting took place at the Nampho Municipal Art Theatre on Sunday to congratulate the young people on their volunteering to the difficult and labor-consuming sectors of socialist construction.
Attending the meeting were officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth and students. A certificate of petition was awarded to the volunteers and congratulatory speeches were made.
Officials, youth and students encouraged and saw off the volunteers leaving for the new revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: Competition among Skilled Workers Takes Place in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- A sewing competition as part of the "Contest of Skilled Workers with Different Jobs in Various Sectors of National Economy-2025" took place in Ryanggang Province.
It brought together dozens of skilled workers from 10-odd units in Pyongyang and local areas.
The contest was aimed at raising the quality of school uniforms and bag production to a higher level and further raising the technical knowledge and levels of skilled workers. It applied such methods as evaluating the preparations for tools and the production amount and quality of each participating unit.
The participants in the competition strove to make their products famous ones.
They explored practical ways to improve product quality and shared experience with each other.
After the competition, the standings were announced and trophies, diplomas and medals were awarded to the excellent skilled workers. -0-

headline: Fruit Saplings Secured in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun says that North Phyongan Province is directing big efforts to cultivating hundreds of thousands of fruit saplings of different kinds to be planted in the district of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
According to the newspaper, the province has applied more than 500 tons of organic manure after improving several hectares of land and digging a lot of trench-type pits for planting fruit saplings.
Hundreds of thousands of fruit saplings from the fruit farms and various parts of the country were planted with sincerity at the temporary nursery.
The production base was built near the nursery farm to increase the survival rate of fruit saplings to the maximum by regularly spraying Pyroligneous acid.
Hundreds of thousands of fruit saplings including apple and pear trees planted at the temporary nursery are in full leaves. -0-

headline: Seoul Ruler's Despicable Behavior as Scout for Triangular Military Cooperation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Kim Hyok Nam issued the following article titled "The Seoul ruler's despicable behavior as a scout for triangular military cooperation" on August 25:
A series of agreements were announced in the ROK-Japan summit held in Tokyo on August 23.
The ROK and Japan celebrated by themselves the outcome of the talks, saying that they would jointly open up the road of future-oriented mutual cooperation and that the "bonds and trust" were powerfully formed between them.
What merits attention is that the chief executive of the ROK did not forgot the begging message towards the master of the White House whom he would meet soon, saying that the firm cooperation between the ROK and Japan and between the ROK, U.S. and Japan is important before everything and the ROK and Japan agreed to make a cycle in which the development of the ROK-Japan relations leads to the intensification of the ROK-U.S.-Japan cooperation.
It would be right to say that the recent ROK-Japan summit was a diplomatic show caused by the uneasiness of Seoul, which aims to remove the "misunderstanding" of Washington.
Originally, the ROK ruler's visit to Japan drew public attention before its start as he violated the practice of the ROK diplomacy where its rulers visit the U.S. first after taking in office.
Without doubt, there is the U.S. distrust in the present ROK ruler and his worries as a servant of the U.S. at the background of his recent visit to Tokyo, which seems to ignore the tradition of pro-U.S. subservient diplomacy.
Lee Jae Myung used to spit out "hard-line remarks toward Japan" to win popularity during his days of representative of an opposition party. It is well known that he met with cold treatment and pressure from the U.S. as well as stern countenance of Japan after his assumption to power because of this "anti-Japanese" tendency.
So, he voluntarily took the journey to prove his pro-Japanese attitude in order to dispel the suspicion of his master and avoid the possible diplomatic disaster at the time of his visit to the White House by showing his firm attitude of "giving high priority" to the ROK-Japan relations, an axle of the U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military alliance which plays a core means for implementing the U.S. foreign strategy.
What matters is that the excess desire of the Seoul ruler to prove the pro-Japanese creed in practical way will further worsen the security crisis in the region in the future.
It is a matter of common knowledge that the structure and function of the aggressive U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military alliance will be further enhanced through the strengthening of cooperation between the ROK and Japan and this will have a grave effect on the situation on the Korean peninsula and in Northeast Asia.
This is proved by the fact that he said the two countries would counter the "rapidly changing international situation" and strengthen cooperation worldwide on the basis of the U.S.-Japan-ROK cooperation, clamoring about the "complete denuclearization of the north".
This is an expression of Seoul's intention to actively participate in carrying out the Indo-Pacific strategy of the U.S., which is directing all efforts to seizing hegemony on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity. It heralds the more catastrophic security environment to be created in the near future.
Herein lies the danger of the ROK-Japan summit.
The reality clearly illuminates the despicable confrontational nature of the chief executive of the ROK who is using peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the region as a bargaining chip, acting as a scout for realizing the aggressive U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military cooperation in order to be within his American master's consideration.
The DPRK will never remain a passive onlooker to the worrying situation being created by the U.S. and its followers seeking hegemony. -0-

headline: Loving Care of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for Educators
story_text:
One day in October 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited an apartment house for educators of Kim Chaek University of Technology which was splendidly built on the bank of the River Taedong like a sailboat sailing across the river.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unlooked round the successfully completed apartment house. He was pleased to provide the teachers and researchers of Kim Chaek University of Technology with the best place of happiness.
Looking round a room, he said this year is a year of scientists and his best wish is to make them live in more civilized living conditions.
Swept across the memory of the officials were the loving care and benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea shown for scientists in that year alone.
The Wisong Scientists Residential District, the Yonphung Scientists Holiday Camp, which is nearing completion, and the apartment houses for educators of Kim Chaek University of Technology built on the bank of the picturesque Taedong River.
After a while,Kim Jong Unsaid it is the firm determination of our Party to build a powerful socialist country by dint of science and technology, adding that we should build a new world by dint of science under the leadership of the Party.
He earnestly requested the scientists to make redoubled efforts, always bearing in mind the Party's plan and intention to build a people's paradise with science.
That day the officials deeply grasped the noble intention of the peerlessly great man to usher in a new era of prosperity with science and build a powerful socialist country to be admired by the whole world on this land. -0-

headline: DPRK Women Support Major Construction Sites
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- The noble mental world of the Korean women who are devoting their all to the prosperity of the socialist country is growing stronger.
Officials and members of the women's union in Pyongyang including Taedonggang District revved up the atmosphere through diverse motivation activities at the construction site of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area and encouraged the builders with material and moral support.
Officials and members of the women's union in Jongphyong County, South Hamgyong Province visited soldier-builders who performed feats in every worksite for regional changes and handed over aid materials to them.
Officials and members of the women's union in North Hamgyong Province, including Kilju and Puryong counties, rendered sincere assistance to the construction sites of regional-industry factories.
Women in Jangyon and Paechon counties of South Hwanghae Province and Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality have inspired the servicepersons with revolutionary enthusiasm and zeal. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Start of Leadership of Revolutionary Armed Forces Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK on Monday dedicated articles to the 65th anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il's start of the leadership of the revolutionary armed forces (August 25, 1960).
Rodong Sinmun says in a co-signed article that the Chairman had continued to lead the revolutionary armed forces for more than half a century since he visited the Seoul Ryu Kyong Su Guards 105th Tank Division of the Korean People's Army 65 years ago.
Thanks to the high-intensity forced march of the peerlessly brilliant commander, the DPRK has built up the strongest strength unprecedented in the history of the Juche revolution and the Korean revolution has demonstrated its dignity before the world as the invincible cause winning victory after victory despite all storms of history, the article notes, and goes on:
The history of building the revolutionary armed forces ofKim Jong Ilis shining as a sacred history in which the KPA was trained into the army strong in ideology and faith, upholding in the vanguard the revolutionary cause of the leader with arms.
The ideology of the leader uniquely dominated the KPA and the whole army could be strengthened into invincible militant ranks sharing intention, step and destiny with the Supreme Commander and into the ranks of bullets and bombs defending the leader at the risk of their lives. This would have been unthinkable without the leadership ofKim Jong Ilwho put forward the original idea of building the revolutionary armed forces and wisely led it.
He directed great efforts to developing the defence industry in the whole period of his leadership over the revolutionary armed forces, thus providing the KPA with material and technical guarantee for winning victory in the confrontation with any enemy.
The eternality and purity of the Korean revolution are firmly guaranteed thanks to the outstanding and seasoned leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is carrying forward the Chairman's exploits in building the revolutionary armed forces pure and clean.
Minju Joson says in an article that the immortal exploits of the Chairman, who put the DPRK on the status of a world-class military power and a full-fledged nuclear weapons state in the grim period when the destiny of the country and people was decisive and successfully realized the centuries-old desire of the Korean people who have aspired after powerful military capability for self-defence will shine forever. -0-
