headline: Press Statement of First Vice-chief of KPA General StaffGangster-like Logic of Impudent "War Apostle" Can Never Work
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Kim Yong Bok, first vice-chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, issued the following press statement "Gangster-like Logic of Impudent 'War Apostle' Can Never Work" on August 25:
As being witnessed by the international community, the U.S.-led joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield is now underway in the ROK which borders the DPRK, disturbing the regional security environment.
Against this backdrop, the U.S. accustomed to turning black into white revealed its impudence and shamelessness again, stunning the world public.
On August 24, the U.S. Forces Command in the ROK made absurd remarks that the drill is a "regular and defensive one without preemptive strike and offensive operation" and "it is not to prepare for aggression but to bolster up deterrence".
It is a generally-acknowledged fact that the large-scale war drill against a state can never be "defensive" one as it is being staged by the world's biggest nuclear weapons state and more than ten satellite states in the region of the Korean peninsula technically at war.
As proof of it, more than ten F-35 stealth fighters of the U.S. Air Force arrived at the U.S. military bases in the ROK on August 25 to participate in the drill.
The F-35 stealth fighters stationed in Japan as the core reinforcements to be sent to the ROK before everything in case of contingency on the Korean Peninsula are now engaged in intensive training day and night as soon as they landed on the U.S. military base in Kunsan. This fact makes it possible to realize well the purpose of the drill Ulji Freedom Shield.
And with the possibility of the permanent or routine deployment of F-35 stealth fighters in Kunsan or other U.S. military bases in the ROK becoming the topic of discussion due to their participation in the drill, all kinds of F-35 fighters including F-35A, F-35B and F-35 Lightning II are taking part in the drill, claiming that they are training the capability to carry out the combined operation with the ROK army. This is a new record in the history of the adventurous U.S.-ROK war drills.
In fact, the current joint military drill is the one for an actual war which makes its provocative nature more clear as it renewed the records of all the past rehearsals for anti-DPRK war in its nature, scale and mode.
The recent remarks of the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK serve as a supporting evidence of it. Soon after Ulji Freedom Shield started, he said that the mode they train today would be a basis for the capability to fight tonight and the power to win tomorrow's victory, fanning up the war fever of the ROK military warmongers and before the drill, he said that the important thing is not the number but the capacity and the key point is to keep the capacity to do something on the Korean peninsula.
The rehearsal of the new combined operational plan for expanding attack into the territory of the DPRK after the preemptive strike at its nuclear facilities, etc is the most solid expression of their will to invade the DPRK.
The current drill has changed its shape into a multi-national military one as even the expedition of the U.S. Marine Corps from the outside of the region and troops of members of the UN Command are taking part in it together with the U.S. forces in the ROK and the ROK army, the mainstay of it. And it has turned into the biggest, the longest and the worst war drill in the world as well as the Asia-Pacific region as it reached the highest record in number and period of field maneuvering drill. However, the U.S. side strongly insists that Ulji Freedom Shield is a "defensive one" from A to Z.
In particular, the training for preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK is a must in the U.S.-ROK military drills which have been a custom from long time ago. This more clearly indicates who is the arch criminal threatening humankind with nukes and the main culprit disturbing peace.
The threatening nature of Ulji Freedom Shield is clearly proved by the U.S. intention to occupy the Korean peninsula and direct the arrow of attack against its enemy states in the region. Recently the U.S. military authorities said that the U.S. forces in the ROK do not focus on the Korean Peninsula only and the ROK is like an island or an anchored aircraft carrier between Japan and the mainland of China, talking about the so-called strategic flexibility of the U.S. forces in the ROK.
The typical Yankee-style arrogance and impudence of the "war apostle" aimed to mislead the reality and turn black into white with the third-rate wordplay while infringing upon the security interests of a sovereign state and endangering the regional security environment can never work.
We are watching everything carefully and ready to cope with any situation.
The U.S. and the ROK sides would be well advised to bear in mind that if they continuously persist in the above-said military rehearsal, they will certainly face up the unpleasant situation and pay a dear price. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Chollima Steel Complex and Farms in Mangyongdae District
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Chollima Steel Complex and farms in Mangyongdae District.
Going round the steel shop, seamless steel pipe shop and others of the Chollima Steel Complex seething with the drive for producing iron and steel for the successful completion of the five-year plan, he learned in detail about the progress made in steel production and the projects for readjustment and reinforcement.
He called for dynamically speeding up the projects for reducing the melting time of electric furnaces per charge to the maximum and simultaneously improving the quantity and quality of steel by actively pushing forward the remodeling and repairing of irrational elements in production processes by dint of science and technology.
The field consultative meeting discussed the issues of fully supplying in time raw and other materials needed for iron and steel production and the issue for officials to conduct the enterprise and business management effectively with their clear goals and scientific insights for increasing production.
At the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality, he learned about the introduction of new cultivation methods and techniques including the wheat transplanting of our style capable of saving manpower and seeds and fully ensuring the period of growth. He called for organizing a nationwide demonstration lecture to actively generalize the successes and experience and, at the same time, concentrate efforts on immediate manuring and cultivation to bring about good results.
Visiting the Chilgol Vegetable Farm which introduced on trial the green cultivation and fish farming method prioritized by the Party at present, he called for thoroughly applying the scientific and technological requirements arising in fish farming in paddy field and thus proving the validity and vitality of the Party's policies and the economic effectiveness of fish farming in paddy field. -0-

headline: Harbor Transportation Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- The Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport in the DPRK is developing harbor transportation, according to Minju Joson.
The ministry is conducting economic operations and command to promote the work for modernizing the wharves of several ports and strengthening the material and technical foundations of shipbuilding and repair units.
The repair of wharf No. 1 and embankment No. 1 and the project of embankment No. 2 were completed at Hungnam Port and a container gantry crane capable of doubling the capacity of handling containers was newly manufactured and installed at Nampho Port.
The ministry is pushing ahead with the reconstruction and modernization of Chongjin and Wonsan ports.
It worked out the plan for repairing large cargo ships and is carrying it out.
It is dredging the sediments on trade ports and shipping lane of the Taedong River after working out the plan for operating cargo ships on a scientific and technological way. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Chollima Steel Complex and farms in Mangyongdae District.
Going round the steel shop, seamless steel pipe shop and others of the Chollima Steel Complex seething with the drive for producing iron and steel for the successful completion of the five-year plan, he learned in detail about the progress made in steel production and the projects for readjustment and reinforcement.
He called for dynamically speeding up the projects for reducing the melting time of electric furnaces per charge to the maximum and simultaneously improving the quantity and quality of steel by actively pushing forward the remodeling and repairing of irrational elements in production processes by dint of science and technology.
The field consultative meeting discussed the issues of fully supplying in time raw and other materials needed for iron and steel production and the issue for officials to conduct the enterprise and business management effectively with their clear goals and scientific insights for increasing production.
At the Mangyongdae Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality, he learned about the introduction of new cultivation methods and techniques including the wheat transplanting of our style capable of saving manpower and seeds and fully ensuring the period of growth. He called for organizing a nationwide demonstration lecture to actively generalize the successes and experience and, at the same time, concentrate efforts on immediate manuring and cultivation to bring about good results.

Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Kim Yong Bok, first vice-chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, issued the following press statement "Gangster-like Logic of Impudent 'War Apostle' Can Never Work" on August 25:
As being witnessed by the international community, the U.S.-led joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield is now underway in the ROK which borders the DPRK, disturbing the regional security environment.
Against this backdrop, the U.S. accustomed to turning black into white revealed its impudence and shamelessness again, stunning the world public.
On August 24, the U.S. Forces Command in the ROK made absurd remarks that the drill is a "regular and defensive one without preemptive strike and offensive operation" and "it is not to prepare for aggression but to bolster up deterrence".
It is a generally-acknowledged fact that the large-scale war drill against a state can never be "defensive" one as it is being staged by the world's biggest nuclear weapons state and more than ten satellite states in the region of the Korean peninsula technically at war.
As proof of it, more than ten F-35 stealth fighters of the U.S. Air Force arrived at the U.S. military bases in the ROK on August 25 to participate in the drill.
The F-35 stealth fighters stationed in Japan as the core reinforcements to be sent to the ROK before everything in case of contingency on the Korean Peninsula are now engaged in intensive training day and night as soon as they landed on the U.S. military base in Kunsan. This fact makes it possible to realize well the purpose of the drill Ulji Freedom Shield.
And with the possibility of the permanent or routine deployment of F-35 stealth fighters in Kunsan or other U.S. military bases in the ROK becoming the topic of discussion due to their participation in the drill, all kinds of F-35 fighters including F-35A, F-35B and F-35 Lightning II are taking part in the drill, claiming that they are training the capability to carry out the combined operation with the ROK army. This is a new record in the history of the adventurous U.S.-ROK war drills.
In fact, the current joint military drill is the one for an actual war which makes its provocative nature more clear as it renewed the records of all the past rehearsals for anti-DPRK war in its nature, scale and mode.
The recent remarks of the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK serve as a supporting evidence of it. Soon after Ulji Freedom Shield started, he said that the mode they train today would be a basis for the capability to fight tonight and the power to win tomorrow's victory, fanning up the war fever of the ROK military warmongers and before the drill, he said that the important thing is not the number but the capacity and the key point is to keep the capacity to do something on the Korean peninsula.
The rehearsal of the new combined operational plan for expanding attack into the territory of the DPRK after the preemptive strike at its nuclear facilities, etc is the most solid expression of their will to invade the DPRK.
The current drill has changed its shape into a multi-national military one as even the expedition of the U.S. Marine Corps from the outside of the region and troops of members of the UN Command are taking part in it together with the U.S. forces in the ROK and the ROK army, the mainstay of it. And it has turned into the biggest, the longest and the worst war drill in the world as well as the Asia-Pacific region as it reached the highest record in number and period of field maneuvering drill. However, the U.S. side strongly insists that Ulji Freedom Shield is a "defensive one" from A to Z.
In particular, the training for preemptive nuclear strike at the DPRK is a must in the U.S.-ROK military drills which have been a custom from long time ago. This more clearly indicates who is the arch criminal threatening humankind with nukes and the main culprit disturbing peace.
The threatening nature of Ulji Freedom Shield is clearly proved by the U.S. intention to occupy the Korean peninsula and direct the arrow of attack against its enemy states in the region. Recently the U.S. military authorities said that the U.S. forces in the ROK do not focus on the Korean Peninsula only and the ROK is like an island or an anchored aircraft carrier between Japan and the mainland of China, talking about the so-called strategic flexibility of the U.S. forces in the ROK.
The typical Yankee-style arrogance and impudence of the "war apostle" aimed to mislead the reality and turn black into white with the third-rate wordplay while infringing upon the security interests of a sovereign state and endangering the regional security environment can never work.
We are watching everything carefully and ready to cope with any situation.
The U.S. and the ROK sides would be well advised to bear in mind that if they continuously persist in the above-said military rehearsal, they will certainly face up the unpleasant situation and pay a dear price. -0-

headline: Harbor Transportation Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- The Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport in the DPRK is developing harbor transportation, according to Minju Joson.
The ministry is conducting economic operations and command to promote the work for modernizing the wharves of several ports and strengthening the material and technical foundations of shipbuilding and repair units.
The repair of wharf No. 1 and embankment No. 1 and the project of embankment No. 2 were completed at Hungnam Port and a container gantry crane capable of doubling the capacity of handling containers was newly manufactured and installed at Nampho Port.
The ministry is pushing ahead with the reconstruction and modernization of Chongjin and Wonsan ports.
It worked out the plan for repairing large cargo ships and is carrying it out.
It is dredging the sediments on trade ports and shipping lane of the Taedong River after working out the plan for operating cargo ships on a scientific and technological way. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Completed Ragwon County Offshore Farm and Fishing-Village Residential District
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the far-reaching plan of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea for regional development and its energetic leadership, a modern offshore farm and a modern fishing-village residential district have been built in Ragwon County on the east coast as another monumental edifice in the vibrant era of the most gigantic regional transformation in the history of the country.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the completed Ragwon County Offshore Farm and the modern fishing-village residential district on August 26.
He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, secretary of the C.C., the WPK, Kim Jae Ryong and Kim Yong Su, department directors of the C.C., the WPK, and Pak Song Chol and Kim Yo Jong, vice department directors of the C.C., the WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the unit involved in the construction.
The building of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm is this year's major project for the regional construction policy which was pushed forward with by the decision of the 11th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK according to the far-reaching plan ofKim Jong Unfor promoting the independent development of regional economy and improving the material life of regional people at the earliest possible date by effectively exploiting and utilizing the natural and geographical potential and resources in cities and counties on the coast which make up nearly one-third of the country.
Thanks to the spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies and great power of execution of the soldier-builders regarding the call of the Party as a battle order, modern and advanced production facilities of the farm, low- and single-storied houses of various styles and neighborhood-serving amenities have been built in good harmony with the surrounding natural landscape and along with the meaningful name of "Ragwonpho" in more than 190 days after starting the project.
Kim Jong Unwent round the Ragwon County Offshore Farm.
Enjoying the picturesque panorama of Ragwonpho,
Kim Jong Unsaid with pleasure that the groundbreaking ceremony was held at the sandy beach early this year and that the place turned already into a picturesque scene. And he added that the undertaking which had been planned since last year in order to build a fishing base which is more characteristic than the Sinpho City Offshore Farm was successfully completed, making it possible to present the fishing village in the most beautiful port to the people of Ragwon County.
He expressed satisfaction over the fact that a wonderful offshore farm and fishing village were built in Ragwon County, which is one of the tiny counties in the country and had a weak economic foundation, adding that the county turned into the one with bright prospect of development in the future and it goes well with the name "Ragwon" (paradise) both in name and reality.
He said that the amazing speed of creation at which the most backward county of the country has developed into the one with a strong economic foundation in a little over half a year would be specially recorded in the history of the regional-industry revolution in the new era and the growth and development of the DPRK and if such a remarkable speed of advance continues, our state would soon greet a great change in the whole country and it would serve as a powerful driving force for hastening the complete victory of socialism.
Going round the combined control room, raw material preprocessing plant and other production facilities, he learned about the completion of the loading test and technical interlocking test of the equipment.
He went round the fishing-village residential district.
Visiting different types of single- and low-storied houses, he referred to the measures taken by the Party to design the houses in unique way to be in good harmony with the natural environment of the shore. He repeatedly expressed his pleasure over the fact that every house in the fishing-village residential district was perfectly built, saying that construction was carried out in a very qualitative way to meet the design and technical requirements.
Appreciating that all the buildings erected in Ragwonpho are the outcome of the high ideological readiness and redoubled efforts of the Korean People's Army upholding the policy of the Party on regional development with absolute loyalty and devoted struggle, he said that we should never be satisfied in the work for the people and that even though the production buildings and dwelling houses built here are excellent, wonderful monumental entities that surpass them should be constructed in future.
He set forth the important tasks to be carried out in steadily pushing ahead with the construction of regional-industry factories and rural dwelling houses on a high level.
Referring to the long-term goals of the policy of the WPK on regional development again, he said that the epochal tasks of regional rejuvenation to be welcomed by the people will be successfully fulfilled only when all the regional builders make redoubled efforts with the ambition and courage to learn from and overtake the architectural culture and new civilization of the capital which have been put on a spectacular level through the construction of modern 50 000 flats.
He stressed that it is necessary to regard the demand and interests of the people as absolute standard and make sincere efforts in setting a site and erecting a building in the future, too, just like we built a seafood production base for the county residents in the best place of Ragwon County.
Enjoying a bird's-eye view of Ragwonpho together with officials, he discussed a new long-term plan for cultivating the economic potential of the county.
Saying that he would like to see the cheerful faces of the people in the county as soon as possible and the evaluation of the plan would be made by the residents, he gave an instruction to hold the inauguration ceremony of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm in a meaningful way in the near future. -0-

headline: Many Young People Over-fulfill Their National Economic Plans
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, more than 20 youth shock brigades and thousands of young people have fulfilled their national economic plans for three and two years and this year.
Members of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade in Ripsok Coal Mine under the Anju Area Coal Mining Complex fulfilled their two-year national economic plans ahead of schedule.
Members of the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Brigade in the Joyang Coal Mine under the Kaechon Area Coal Mining Complex, the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade at the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex and other youth shock brigades of coal mines have carried out their yearly plans during the first half of the year.
Members of the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade of the Komdok Mining Complex completed their yearly plans for transporting ores till May.
Young miners of the Kwangmyong Pit of the Unpha Mine and young people of the tunneling and Namsan pits are making innovations in mineral production after setting their goals for producing tens of thousands of tons of more ores ahead of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
All the young people of the Hwaphyong Forestry Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau and the Songgan Pulp-wood Production Station have carried out their yearly plans for timber production.
More than 700 girl weavers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, Sinuiju Textile Mill, September Textile Mill and other units finished their two-year and yearly plans ahead of schedule.
A spinning worker of the Sariwon Textile Mill carried out her three-year plan before others in the textile industry sector.
Many youth workteams and sub-workteams across the country have joined the ranks of high-yielding units in wheat and barley farming this year. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on True Colors of Lee Jae Myung as Hypocrite Seized with "Denuclearization Paranoia"
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Lee Jae Myung of the ROK showed his true colors as a hypocrite to the whole world.
On August 25, he said in a speech at the U.S. Centre for Strategic and International Studies that he would modernize the ROK-U.S. alliance in keeping with the change in the security environment and that the two countries would strongly counter someone's provocation.
He even insulted us as a "poor but fierce neighbour" and then talked about the unreasonable "denuclearization".
It was a crucial occasion and an adequate opportunity to prove why the ROK is called the enemy and a base clan.
To begin with, the ROK is a dyed-in-the-wool hostile state which set the policy of confrontation with the DPRK as its state policy.
The ROK Constitution reads "the territory of the ROK is the Korean peninsula and its islands". And more than ten regimes have been replaced in the ROK, but the anti-DPRK keynote remains unchanged.
The same is true of the Lee Jae Myung regime.
However, it was necessary for it to show the distinction with the Yoon Suk Yeol regime which was beaten by public opinion in the ROK and abroad as it drove the relations with us to the worst in history.
So Lee Jae Myung pretended that he had a will to restore the relations with the DPRK, saying that the dialogue with the DPRK had been stopped by the preceding regime and that a tangled skein should be carefully unreeled with perseverance and if small actions are piled up like pebbles, the mutual trust will be restored and the road of peace will be widened.
But Lee Jae Myung did not hide his real intention and revealed his true colors as a confrontation maniac, after 80-odd days of his office only and ten days just after making such plausible remarks as "pebble".
His behavior abroad clearly proved that the ROK's scheme for confrontation with the DPRK can never change and the DPRK's understanding and judgment that the ROK tamed with the heinous anti-communist idea and spirit is the unchangeable enemy are correct.
At the same time, Lee Jae Myung, with his unveiled confrontational intention, gave irrefutable evidence to prove why his remarks about "denuclearization" are a sheer sophism.
Availing ourselves of this opportunity, we once again remind him of the fact that our position as a nuclear weapons state is an inevitable option that correctly reflects the hostile threat from outside and the change of the structure of the world security dynamics.
In order to change our nuclear policy permanently fixed in the supreme law and basic law of the state according to the general will of the DPRK people, it is necessary to change the world and the political and military environment on the Korean Peninsula.
We remain unchanged in our stand not to abandon the nuclear weapons, the prestige and honor of the state.
The "denuclearization" much touted by the ROK had already become extinct theoretically, practically and physically.
This being a hard reality, Lee Jae Myung's talk about the "theory of three-stage denuclearization" and "denuclearization" is little short of a naive dream like trying to catch a cloud floating in the sky.
It is a daydream for the ROK, the one and only political poor in the world who has offered all its sovereignty to the U.S., to cherish an absurd hope for "denuclearization" unaware of the nature of the nuclear issue of the DPRK.
Lee Jae Myung should understand that if he continues to be engrossed in a wild dream about "denuclearization" like a "familial disease", it will not be helpful to anyone, to say nothing of the ROK. -0-

headline: Ministry of Grain Administration Takes Measure for Wheat Processing and Storage
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Ministry of Grain Administration in the DPRK is taking steps for wheat processing and storage.
The ministry manufactured new equipment in contact with relevant units and sent them to the Hamhung and Wonsan wheat processing factories to increase their production capacities more than two times.
It has pushed ahead with the work to manufacture and supply efficient wheat processing equipment to the city and county grain management stations across the country on the basis of experience gained in operating the newly-established wheat processing lines at the grain management stations in Anju City of South Phyongan Province, Pakchon County of North Phyongan Province and Pyoksong County of South Hwanghae Province.
Wheat processing factories and city and county grain management stations in different parts of the country ensure the optimum temperature of wheat storehouses and establish a proper ventilation control system to prevent damage in the rainy season.
The ministry has also made the city and county grain management stations to invent, manufacture and use grain dryers suited to the actual conditions by following the experience of the Mundok County Grain Management Station which is making successes in preventing the grain loss by making new mobile grain dryers. -0-

headline: Vol. 36 of "Complete Collection of Kim Il Sung's Works" Published in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 36 (enlarged edition) of "Complete Collection ofKim Il Sung's Works", a library of the immortal Juche idea which deals with classic works of PresidentKim Il Sungin a chronological order.
The book contains 37 works including speeches, talks and conclusions made by the President from November 1959 to February 1960.
In his works "On the Tasks of the Party Organizations in South Phyongan Province" and "On Improving the Work Methods of the County Party Organization in Accordance with the New Circumstances", he called upon the Party organizations to give definite precedence to political work and establish a firm system of collective guidance of the county Party committees so as to successfully conduct every work in the counties.
The work "On Some Immediate Tasks in Socialist Economic Construction" indicates the tasks and ways for dynamically conducting the all-people movement for increased production, economy and reserves, concentrating efforts on the main link in production and construction and for officials to carry out their daily, monthly and quarterly plans without fail by organizing the economic work scrupulously.
There are also works calling for accelerating mechanization in the agricultural sector, increasing wheat yields radically by irrigating wheat fields and spreading a plenty of quality compost to them and for increasing meat production by developing livestock farming and for solving problems arising in all fields of scientific research to suit the specific conditions of the country by thoroughly establishing the Juche orientation in these fields.
The book also contains works giving clear answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in various fields of the revolution and construction, including the issue for cadres to study hard to raise their political and theoretical level and the issue of taking good care of the living of the families of the war dead and of whose members were killed by the enemy. -0-

headline: Ryanggang Province Strives to Produce Farm Machines Suitable for Farm Work in Mountainous Areas
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province in the DPRK is stepping up the efforts to provide efficient farm machines suitable for farm work in mountainous areas, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province figured up the number of farm machines including the wheat and barley harvesters and trailing farm machines and took proper measures. It held technical consultations at industrial establishments and solved knotty problems by mobilizing technical forces in the province to push ahead with the farm machine production.
Those regions with large areas of sloping field secured cultivators and Kim Jong Suk, Kapsan, Taehongdan and Samsu counties produced mobile threshers and many other farm machines and accessories. -0-

headline: Artistes of Mansudae Art Troupe Give Intensive Motivation Performances
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Artistes of the Mansudae Art Troupe in the DPRK are giving motivation performances for increased production at major worksites of socialist construction.
The Mansudae Art Troupe gave intensive motivation performances at major construction sites and industrial establishments in South Hamgyong Province, which redoubled the enthusiasm of the workers in the industrial province.
The artistes conducted frontline-style motivation activities at the construction sites of the Leisure Complex in Jongphyong County and regional-industry factories in the city of Sinpho.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the artistes called upon their workers to successfully attain the goals they vowed before the Workers' Party of Korea, while enthusiastically singing songs such as "We Are Koreans".
The similar performances of high ideological and artistic value and influence at the Hamhung Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory and the Hamhung Knitwear Factory evoked a positive response of the audience.
Officials and workers in Hamhung and Sinpho cities and Ragwon County hardened their will to perform fresh miracles and feats with bold strenuous efforts at their posts and workplaces, while singing with the performers famous songs of the times full of the love for the country and the pride of the people of a powerful country. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Ministry of Grain Administration in the DPRK is taking steps for wheat processing and storage.
The ministry manufactured new equipment in contact with relevant units and sent them to the Hamhung and Wonsan wheat processing factories to increase their production capacities more than two times.
It has pushed ahead with the work to manufacture and supply efficient wheat processing equipment to the city and county grain management stations across the country on the basis of experience gained in operating the newly-established wheat processing lines at the grain management stations in Anju City of South Phyongan Province, Pakchon County of North Phyongan Province and Pyoksong County of South Hwanghae Province.
Wheat processing factories and city and county grain management stations in different parts of the country ensure the optimum temperature of wheat storehouses and establish a proper ventilation control system to prevent damage in the rainy season.
The ministry has also made the city and county grain management stations to invent, manufacture and use grain dryers suited to the actual conditions by following the experience of the Mundok County Grain Management Station which is making successes in preventing the grain loss by making new mobile grain dryers. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Special Operation Training Base under General Staff of KPA and Learns about Training of Soldiers
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the special operation training base directly under the authority of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army and learned about the training of the sniper sub-unit and special operation sub-unit on August 27.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first deputy department director of the WPK Central Committee, and other leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
He was greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army.
He met snipers and soldiers of the special operations unit organized for carrying out special duties at the training base and learned about the military equipment of the sub-units and their training.
He acquainted himself with the new-type sniper rifle being produced and supplied to the units.
He appreciated the high-precision long-range sniping character and superiority of the new-type sniper rifle designed and developed by the DPRK Academy of Defence Science this year in our own way to improve the ergonomic efficiency of the weapon and the tactical performance of snipers, and expressed satisfaction over the fact that the units were armed with the sniping weapon of new generation.
Saying that the sniper forces have a very important duty in the combat ability composition of the units, he noted that the sniper is a specially selected soldier ready to conduct independent and proactive military actions and like a hunter killing enemy soldiers with the marksmanship worthy of a crack shot in the battlefield. He added that it is an important task for building up our armed forces to drastically strengthen the special operations forces and specialized sniper forces in the future.
He said that the Central Military Commission of the WPK would examine the issue of organizing the Central Sniper Training Center under the General Staff in the future.
Saying that concentration and high observation are essential qualities for snipers, he mentioned that they should be trained for discerning different surroundings and getting used to the environment to improve their concentration, endurance and observation, and that they should establish a correct training methodology for selecting sniping object, concealing and moving, selecting and building shooting platform, acquiring the method of observation with  various equipment and precision long-range shooting method and learning the secret of adjusted fire in attack and defence between the teams of snipers and between sub-units, and intensify scientific specialized training to raise the capability for an actual war.
He instructed the Ministry of National Defence to produce quality camouflaged uniform to be supplied to the sniper sub-units from this year in conformity with the conditions and seasonal characteristics of the area under the mission.
He said that it is the most urgent task of the KPA at present for war preparation to thoroughly implement the policy of the Party on effecting a revolution in training, ideology and equipment and thus more firmly prepare the special operations forces to be the pivotal and core forces of fighting a war and the strongest combat group.
In order to hold the absolute upper hand over the special operations forces of any country at a battlefield at present in which powerful military equipment are being developed and introduced competitively, it is necessary to positively step up the modernization of military equipment, steadily explore and apply our own style innovative war methods and plans for combat and make the soldiers strictly master them, he said.
He oversaw a live shooting drill of the sniper sub-unit.
Watching with pleasure the training of the combatants demonstrating their crack-shot marksmanship, he said that they are really good at shooting and no enemy will survive within their sight.
Then he watched the general special physical exercises of the combatants of the special operations unit.
The soldiers participated in the drill fully demonstrated their physical and technical ability to be fully prepared as an invincible combat unit and advance detachment of the powerful revolutionary army.
Highly appreciating the transparent ideological and moral world of the combatants who always think about a battle, true to the Party's idea of building special operations forces and do their utmost to remain faithful to their noble mission and duty before the country and people, he had a photo session with them.
When the photo session was over, the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" with their pledge of loyalty to devotedly defend the Central Committee of the WPK headed byKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the reliable guards and passionate warriors full of firm will to win only victory in accomplishing any combat mission any time, saying "You must make enemies tremble with fear whenever they see you".
That day he congratulated three snipers who showed their distinguished marksmanship, fully displaying their high-precision long-range sniping capability and had a photo taken with them one by one.
He also had a photo session with the officers and soldiers of the sniper sub-unit cultivating the crack-shot marksmanship in the intensive drill for an actual war.
The soldiers of the sniper sub-unit and the combatants of the special operations unit, who were honored to be guided by the great brilliant commander in their training, hardened their firm determination to more firmly preparing themselves as core arms of the KPA and as ferocious tigers dominating mountains, cherishing the sense of duty to defend the country and revolution and thus fully display the might and immortal name of the invincible KPA. -0-

headline: DPRK Navy Developing into Service Possessed of Operations Capability on Oceans
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the Navy Day (August 28), the DPRK people extend warm congratulations to the officers and men of the Navy of the heroic Korean People's Army who are firmly defending the seas of the country.
After liberation, PresidentKim Il Sungnamed the regular naval force which had been expanded and strengthened with the maritime security force as its parent body "Korean Fleet" and declared the founding of the KPA Navy on August 28, 1949.
In July 1950, during the Fatherland Liberation War, the KPA Navy sank the U.S. imperialists' heavy cruiser that boasted of being the "island of the sea" with only four torpedo boats, and in the 1960s it captured the armed spy ship Pueblo in our territorial waters.
The naval force of the DPRK has now developed into a service equipped with comprehensive combat power with the nuclear weapons, the strong treasured sword for defending justice and peace, as the main force under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unvisited the Command of the Navy of the KPA on the occasion of the Naval Day in August 2023 and clarified the Party's idea of attaching importance to the navy and strategic and tactical issues arising in developing the naval force into an invincible service.
The ceremony of launching the tactical nuclear attack submarine of our own style held on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the founding of the DPRK and the ceremonies of launching destroyers of the KPA Navy in April and June this year demonstrated to the whole world the rapid development of the Juche-oriented naval force.
In his speeches at the launching ceremonies of the destroyers of the KPA Navy, he said that the DPRK should now build a fleet for ocean operations which has been recognized as a synonym for imperialist aggression, and stressed that it is an indispensable option for defending the state sovereignty and security interests to possess the operations capability on the ocean and exercise naval power there.
The leadership ofKim Jong Un, who is devoting himself to developing the navy into a powerful Juche-oriented service, is becoming a source of strength that enables our sailors to defend the seas of the country impregnably. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Korea's Liberation Observed in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Celebrations were held by the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Primorsky Krai Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity" and the Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the DPRK in the Republic of Buryatia on August 14 and 15 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation. They included seminar and photo exhibition.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages and other masses of relevant units.
The chairman of the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Primorsky Krai Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity", the chairman of the Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the DPRK in the Republic of Buryatia and other speakers said that August 15 this year marking the 80th anniversary of Korea's liberation when Korea was liberated from the colonial rule of Japan is a very significant day for not only the Korean people but also the Russian people.
Referring to the historic and world historic significance of Korea's liberation, they said that the traditions of militant friendship, friendship and cooperation between the two countries forged during the anti-Japanese war are still being carried forward.
The Russia-DPRK friendly relations have been further consolidated and developed into the invincible alliance as the combat sub-units of the armed forces of the DPRK participated in the operations for liberating the Kursk area, they noted.
A congratulatory message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the event held by the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea. -0-

headline: High-tech Product Developed by Nampho Municipal Science and Technology Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Researchers of the Nampho Municipal Science and Technology Committee in the DPRK developed a broad-spectrum insecticide which is high effective in preventing damage by forest insects, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This broad-spectrum insecticide is of great economic value as it can effectively exterminate major pests occurring in forests without negative effect on the ecological environment.
Very positive was the result of the introduction of the insecticide into stamping out the forest insects in Nampho Municipality and other regions.
The broad-spectrum insecticide with great economic benefit was registered as a high-tech product this year.
A research into introducing the broad-spectrum insecticide into grain, fruit and vegetable fields is under way. -0-

headline: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Ushering in New History of Valuing Youth
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- At the Youth Movement Museum, all visitors are paying attention to the meaningful letters.
It is an autograph sent by the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unthat the future to be prosperous will be brought earlier thanks to the vigorous struggle of the young people.
At this time of the Youth Day (August 28), all the people of the country are keeping in their minds the letters reflecting the love for and trust in the young people.
With his iron faith that the Party and the state will be strong only when young people are strong,Kim Jong Unhas always paid deep attention to the youth issue. He gave precious instructions, including training the officials of the youth league and ensuring that young people stand in the vanguard in developing all fields of society.
The DPRK people still remember the tender-hearted image ofKim Jong Unwho visited the construction site of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station ten years ago and highly appreciated the feats of the members of the youth shock brigade.
After looking round various places of the construction site,Kim Jong Unsaid that only the Korean young people educated and trained under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea can conduct the construction of a gigantic project in the unimaginable severe cold and gave strength and courage to them.
Kim Jong Unpersonally attended the inauguration ceremony of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station and warmly said that the young vanguard who cultivated pluck and faith in the blizzards of Mt Paektu are the most reliable successors to our Party and the strong pillars supporting our socialist country.
They successfully built Jonwi Street, a grand monument to the youth which reflects the future of the civilized and prosperous DPRK, last year under the care ofKim Jong Unwho is training ordinary young people to be heroes of the era and masters of the youth power.
It is the proud reality of the DPRK to advance rapidly by the inexhaustible strength and enthusiasm of the young people thanks to the trust and ardent love of the peerlessly great man. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday dedicates an editorial to the Youth Day.
All the DPRK people are extending warm congratulations to the youth who are fully demonstrating the honor and dignity of youth vanguard of the Workers' Party of Korea in every worksite of socialist construction while writing new biographies of heroes in the development course of the Korean youth movement and are convinced of the eternal youth of our cause by the presentable images of the young people possessed of youthful power and matchless courage, the editorial says, and goes on:
For the revolutionary Party, it is the greatest pride to have its reliable successors and reserves.

story_text:
Pyongyang, August 29 (KCNA) -- The February 16 Art Education Publishing House in the DPRK has produced new art educational books conducive to training reserve musicians.
The newly-published books are for the students of higher class and university class of art educational institutions and for  kindergarteners.
Compositions applying the characteristics and timbre of electronic instruments are edited in the books.

headline: Minute Sound of Wind
story_text:
One day in March 2017, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unlooked round the 70-storied apartment house in Ryomyong Street.
After visiting the flats on the 7th and 58th floors for a long time, ComradeKim Jong Unwent down to the first floor by elevator. At that time, he suddenly turned his eyes upon the elevator wall.
Looking at the officials who wondered why he did, he told them that it seems that the sound of wind was heard when the elevator goes up and down because the negative pressure was created in elevator shaft. And he added that if air holes were made in certain sections of the elevator shaft, it might get the negative pressure lowered.
The officials were surprised as they had not cared about the minute sound of wind though they conducted hundreds of test operations of the elevator.
Kim Jong Unpaid deep attention to even the minute sound of wind that others had not cared about as he regards all the undertakings for the people as the most important ones and demands that the structures the Workers' Party of Korea presents to the people are perfect. -0-

headline: New Method for Cultivating Wheat in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 29 (KCNA) -- Officials and agricultural workers in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality of the DPRK  reaped a bumper harvest in wheat farming this year.
They harvested more than 6 tons per hectare on an average in the fields of more than nearly 200 hectares than last year by introducing advanced farming techniques including the Korean-style new method of transplanting wheat seedlings, and fulfilled their wheat production plan by 195 percent.
They introduced the method of transplanting wheat seedlings into tens of hectares of paddy fields.
All farms of the district joined the ranks of high-yield farms with the honor of high-yield district in wheat farming, 44 high-yield workteams, 130 high-yield sub-workteams and more than 770 high-yield peasants were produced this year. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Talk to Bereaved Families of Martyrs Participated in Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade
Kim Jong Untalked to the bereaved families of the martyrs who participated in the overseas military operations.
The talk is as follows:
Comrades,
I want to say briefly to you, as I am here with you, the bereaved families of the martyrs who laid down their precious lives to defend their country’s dignity and honour.
I feel respectful and grateful to you for stoutly overcoming the unbearable pain caused by the loss of your family members.
The news on the death of your beloved children and husbands must have come as a great shock to you all, since you did not know whether they were alive or not. Thinking about you, I kept feeling uneasy and could hardly concentrate on my work.
To all the bereaved families of the martyrs, I once again express my regret about having failed to save the precious lives of our officers and soldiers who fell in the battlegrounds on a foreign land, as I am anxious that I could not bring them alive back here.
At the recent ceremony of awarding state commendations to the martyrs, I met the bereaved families of some martyrs, and I thought a lot about other martyrs’ families who were not present there.
So, I had this meeting arranged as I wanted to meet and console the bereaved families of all the heroes and relieve them of their sorrow and anguish even a little.
I extend my deep condolences to all the bereaved families who have come here with the sorrow of having lost their family members, even though they should naturally attend this meeting with those dear persons amid the blessing from all the people in the country.
Looking at the faces and names of our heroes, both handsome and sturdy, one by one on the memorial wall, I pictured in my mind their parents who had brought up such excellent sons and their dear wives and children.
How could there be such excellent sons if their parents are not excellent, and how could they be so brave till the last moments of their lives if they did not cherish genuine affection for their parents, wives, children and native places?
Being told about the exploits our heroes performed by charging forward death-defyingly to implement the orders of their country, we thought of the faces of the upright persons who had instilled love for their country and native places into their pure hearts and brought them up to be stalwart men, and we could clearly see in our mind’s eye the considerate persons who had supported them and given strength and courage to them during their faithful service in the army.
Ours is a heroic army that knows neither submission nor impossibility, and it surely emerges victorious in battle. This is because it is made up of the sons whose lives were given by the most tenacious, patriotic and just people in the world, the great heroic people who have shared their destiny with this country through an unyielding life and struggle generation after generation.
Though they passed away so young with a high ambition in their minds, the indomitable mettle and revolutionary spirit of the martyrs, who wrote a new chapter of victory in the history of our state at the cost of their blood and kindled the fierce flames of all-people heroism across the country, will remain etched in the minds of all our people.
Our Party and government will bring all the glory to the heroes revered by the whole nation and to their excellent parents who brought them up to be admirable men. They will also do their best to provide you, ahead of others, with a beautiful life in the country defended at the cost of the lives of the martyrs.
My heart breaks and aches more at the sight of those little children.
Our officers passed away, leaving their beloved children and their dear wives behind.
Our soldiers passed away, picturing the eyes of their warm-hearted mothers.
When they were charging to meet their death, bidding innermost farewell to all that was dear to them, they all left writings praying for the prosperity of their motherland and Pyongyang and shouted “Long live the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea!”
They did not write even a short letter to me, but I think they must have entrusted their families, including those beloved children, to me.
I am absolutely sure of this.
Their request is not to be read by letters.
It is not to be heard with the ears, either.
It is to be heard with the heart and with trust, and I heard it that way.
As the martyrs wished, I will take charge of their children and other members of the bereaved families.
Present here are the head teachers of the revolutionary schools.
You can also see leading cadres of our state here.
The children left behind by the heroes shall be sent to the revolutionary schools; I, our state and our army will take full responsibility for them and train them admirably as staunch and courageous fighters like their fathers, and help them join the backbone ranks of our revolution.
Soon, a new street shall be built in Taesong District, Pyongyang, for the bereaved families of the soldiers who fell to our great sorrow at such young ages after exalting their life like the morning star, just as a song says. We are going to name it Saebyol (morning star) Street in praise of our soldiers’ exploits as brilliant as the star.
And we will lay the remains of the martyrs to rest in the best place of the arboretum just in front of the street, and erect a monument to immortal combat feats in memory of the great soldiers who displayed the tenacity of the Korean people and defended the dignity and honour of the Korean People’s Army.
We will encourage the people from all over the country to visit the monument at any time to remember the martyrs and share all glory and happiness with them.
Our Party and government will offer sincere assistance to the bereaved families so that they will be able to start their happy life in Pyongyang enjoying nationwide respect and admiration.
I, on behalf of all the officers and soldiers of our army and in the name of all the people in the country, would like to make another deep bow to you as you are overcoming the painful loss of your beloved family members while supporting the ennobling life and last decisions of your children and husbands with pride and feeling honoured with them.
I hope all of you bereaved families will overcome the painful feelings of loss as early as possible. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Bereaved Families of Martyrs Who Performed Distinguished Feats in Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- The brave soldiers who participated in the overseas military operations created the tales about great heroes unprecedented in history out of their desire for the immortality of the sacred national flag of the DPRK and the rosy future of the prosperous motherland and emerged as heroes of the legendary feats who devoted their precious lives without regret, regarding their death as honor in the course of carrying out the orders of the country.
The Workers' Party of Korea adds luster to their feats with gold star medals and brings all the glory of the times to them. Thanks to its noble moral obligation, their soul is brilliantly shining as the eternal star of the motherland.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met the bereaved families of martyrs who performed distinguished feats in the overseas military operations at the Mokran House and sincerely consoled them on August 29.
Present there were senior officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and senior officials of revolutionary schools.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a consolatory speech before the bereaved families full of great excitement.
He expressed deep condolences to all the bereaved families with his grief at having failed to save the precious lives of the officers and men who fell in the battlegrounds on a foreign land in order to defend the dignity and honor of the country, and with his sorrow at failing to bring them alive back to the country.
Being told about the exploits our heroes performed by charging forward death-defyingly to implement the orders of their country, we thought of the faces of the upright parents who had instilled love for their country and native places into their pure hearts and brought them up to be stalwart men, and we could clearly see in our mind’s eye the considerate persons who had supported them and given strength and courage to them during their faithful service in the army, he said and went on.
Ours is a heroic army that knows neither submission nor impossibility, and it surely emerges victorious in battle. This is because it is made up of the sons whose lives were given by the most tenacious, patriotic and just people in the world, the great heroic people who have shared their destiny with this country through an unyielding life and struggle generation after generation.
Though they passed away so young with a high ambition in their minds, the indomitable mettle and revolutionary spirit of the martyrs, who wrote a new chapter of victory in the history of our state at the cost of their blood and kindled the fierce flames of all-people heroism across the country, will remain etched in the minds of all our people.
He paid high tribute once again to the bereaved families who regard the noble lives and final determinations of their children and husbands as admirable and honorable ones and support them, firmly mastering the sorrow of losing their beloved people.
All the bereaved families burst out sobbing at the ardent sincerity of the fatherly leader who is glorifying the immortal feats and noble lives of the martyrs for all ages and creating legends of love and trust unprecedented in history.
Kim Jong Unpresented to the bereaved families respectively photos of the martyrs wrapped in the national flag of the DPRK, the sacred flag of glory, whose dignity and honour the heroic soldiers devoted their lives to.
The moments of noble love and moral obligation ensued.
Kim Jong Unhad a significant photo taken with the bereaved families who were greatly moved after receiving the photos of the martyrs.
Kim Jong Uncalled senior officials of revolutionary schools and said that we should bring up the children of the martyrs to be hard-core elements of the revolution and genuine sons and daughters of the country.
Kim Jong Unaffirmed that the ardent desire of the martyrs which they wished till their last moments would surely be achieved and our Party and people would certainly build the most powerful and prosperous socialist ideal paradise with the brilliant exploits performed by the heroes. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Awarding State Commendations to Soldiers of KPA Overseas Military Operations Units Takes Place
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- All the people of the DPRK pay high praise and noble tribute to the officers and men of the overseas military operations units of the Korean People's Army who demonstrated the might of the elite revolutionary army before the world by displaying the matchless fighting spirit, bravery and indomitable self-sacrificing spirit for the honor of the glorious Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The second ceremony of awarding the state commendations to commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units of the KPA was held on August 29.
Attending the ceremony were the bereaved families of martyrs who died a heroic death, performing distinguished feats in overseas military operations.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made a speech.
He said that the ceremony is being held at the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the WPK to award the title of the DPRK Hero to the bereaved families of martyrs in the name of the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas military operations units who demonstrated the absolute dignity of the great state and the might of the ever-victorious KPA before the world and set a record of new victory in the history of the heroic struggle of the DPRK people.
He noted that it is a solemn oath sworn by all the service personnel to carry out the orders of the Party and the country even at the cost of their lives and it is their duty to remain true to the pledge of faith.
However, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that our every soldier is a precious being and his flesh and blood that can never be bartered for anything in the world and he spent all the days and months after their participation in the operation with worry about the combatants and the boundless loving care for them, he stressed.
Thanks to the tireless efforts ofKim Jong Unwho spent days and nights to bring back to the homeland the fallen heroes most respectfully and solemnly and to bring the greatest glory to their immortal life and soul, the martyrs could have a reunion with the people in the homeland and their beloved families as the most proud and honorable image, covered with the glorious national flag, and their names and images be shined at the highest level along with the memorial wall built at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee unprecedented in the history, he said.
He noted that the gold star medals of the DPRK Hero that the families of the martyrs are to receive on behalf of their beloved sons, husbands and fathers are the reflection of the unanimous respect and high appreciation of the Party, state and people for the martyrs who glorified the dignity of the country at the cost of their precious lives and youth and their bereaved families.
A decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on conferring the title of DPRK Hero on the soldiers who performed feats in overseas military operations was conveyed.
The title of DPRK Hero, Gold Star Medal and Order of National Flag 1st Class were awarded to the bereaved families.
The life of the martyrs will be immortal under the care of the great motherly Party which respects and bestows honor on the proud sons who devoted their precious lives to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of all generations to come. -0-

headline: Paddy-Field Fish Farming Method Introduced in North Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to introduce the method of efficient fish farming in paddy fields with great economic effectiveness on an expanded basis.
Officials of Unpha and Yonsan counties are encouraging farmers to turn out in the work, aware of the advantages of the Korean-style green cultivation and fish farming method.
The Township Farm of Yonthan County, the Sinsong Farm of Singye County and the Township Farm of Thosan County have created favorable conditions for the growth of paddy rice by introducing the method of fish farming in paddy fields in this year's farming. They are boosting the enthusiasm for scientific farming, while exchanging and sharing their experience.
Songnim City and Junghwa County have worked out the plans for expanding the areas of catfish farming in paddy fields and are securing seeds of improved variety and solving the feed problem.
The Kupho Farm in Hwangju County is raising the utilization of natural feed and survival rate and weight ratio of fish.
Agricultural workers in Pongsan, Sangwon and Sohung counties are laying the material and technical foundations for fish farming in paddy fields while making a purposeful technical study of the density of fish per cubic meter of water, selection of rational varieties of rice and scientific water management method. -0-

Pyongyang, August 30 (KCNA) -- The 6th Memory Contest of University Students took place at Kim Chaek University of Technology of the DPRK from August 26 to 29.
