topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Inaugural Ceremony of Ragwon County Offshore Farm Takes Place with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 31 (KCNA) -- The wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea which is turning cities and counties across the country into regional bases of a highly civilized, wealthy and developed socialist power is ushering in an unprecedented era of great changes in which assets of prosperity and welfare are being created one after another in different parts of the country, hastening the accomplishment of the centuries-old cause of regional rejuvenation.
The Ragwon County Offshore Farm and the modern fishing-village residential district, which have been pushed forward with as the major policy project of the Party and the state this year according to the Party's policy on regional development and the decision of the historic 11th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK on strengthening the independent foundations of the regional economy and improving the material life of local people by developing the fishing industry in cities and counties on the coast in conformity with the natural and topographical features of the country bounded on two sides of the east and west by the sea, are greeting the significant and grand inaugural day.
The soldier-builders, who turned out in the construction of "Ragwonpho" associated with the noble love for the country and the people of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, performed proud labor feats of building a seafood production base of peculiar style fully equipped with modern production facilities and processing lines and hundreds of modern houses in the fishing village, most unique in terms of convenience, aesthetic beauty and formative art while in harmony with the surrounding natural scenery along the undulating mountain, in the spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies and the fighting stamina of performing miracles peculiar to the Korean People's Army.
The grand inaugural ceremony of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm which has been built as another monumental creation on the east coast along with the new era of regional rejuvenation was held on August 30.
The venue of the ceremony was full of great delight of the people in Ragwon County who enjoy the joy of a new life and new civilization and the boundless pride of the soldier-builders who glorified their appellation as creators of the people's happiness through the construction of an ideal fishing village of our own style.
Kim Jong Unattended the inaugural ceremony.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the inaugural ceremony amid the playing of welcome music, all the participants cheered enthusiastically with strong emotion, looking up to the great leader who is ushering in the era of great prosperity, in which the whole country is prospering all together, spending days and months of ceaseless thinking and creation to make all our people enjoy all the benefits of the world.
Present at the ceremony were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, chief secretaries of the Party committees of provinces, cities and counties on the coast and chairpersons of provincial people's committees, members of the non-permanent committees for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy, officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province and Ragwon County, soldier-builders, employees of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm and their families.
Ju Chang Il, alternate member of the Political Bureau and department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, made an inaugural speech.
The speaker said that the site, in which a small port and sandy beach were all it had until February last, has been turned into a spectacular landscape symbolizing the eye-opening innovation and civilization of regional area within a short period of more than 190 days, adding that the Party's cherished desire to present the most beautiful port in the world to Ragwon County was successfully realized through the successful building of the farm with great economic effectiveness and prospect in an excellent location for an offshore farming base and even a modern residential district preserving the features of the coastal area.
This is the proud fruition achieved for the first time in the second year of implementing the regional development policy of our Party and the entity of change that vividly shows the appearance of the socialist paradise and the advanced development and the people's happiness brought about by the regional development policy in the new era, he said, adding that it is an important achievement that demonstrates the rapidly advancing speed of our creation and change and redoubles the faith in the future.
He said that the change we have faced today proves that the Party's regional development policy, which has taken the course of less than two years, is confidently switching over from satisfying the basic demands of the people for their living on a nationwide scale to bringing about a sure change in the more fundamental and comprehensive sphere.
He noted thatKim Jong Ungave detailed instructions on the principled issues arising in the construction of the Ragwon County Offshore Farm and energetically led the work to bring about a new phase of development in all aspects including viewpoint on and insight into architecture, design, construction and equipment and facilities for production.
The landmark change of Ragwonpho, which has emerged as an ideal land of the people in 2025 to be specially recorded in the history of the country thanks to the devotion and direct guidance ofKim Jong Un, will convey forever the ardent sincerity of the father for the people and the nobleness of the people-first politics of our Party, he stressed.
Upon authorization of the Party Central Committee, he extended warm thanks to all the service personnel who have most successfully fulfilled the tasks assigned by the Party and the people through devoted struggle and extraordinary efforts and proved the truth and vitality of the Party's policies with a visible entity.
Kim Jong Unrose to his feet and paid militant tribute to the absolute patriotic loyalty and noble devotion of the service personnel who are achieving proud results of unprecedented changes and rejuvenation with pure conscience and sincere and ardent love for the country, their hometowns and families.
The speaker said that it is the policy of the DPRK in the era ofKim Jong Unto find out more worthwhile things like the construction of Ragwonpho to do with credit and make all the cities and counties of the country prosperous, expressing the belief that the aquaculture in the new era, which our Party attaches importance to and steadily pushes forward with, will be revitalized with modern bases suited to the regional characteristics in different parts of the eastern and the western coasts and this will be a powerful source of revenue for fostering the development capability of regional areas and steadily bringing about an upsurge in the nationwide trend of innovation.
Kim Jong Uncut the inaugural tape.
At the venue of the ceremony where a historic picture unfolded itself to prove the new advance of regional change, fireworks were set off and a number of rubber balloons flown up to decorate the sky above Ragwonpho.
Boy and girl students presented fragrant bouquets toKim Jong Un, reflecting the unanimous gratitude of the people of Ragwon County.
He met the working people who would live in the fishermen's village of paradise and warmly blessed them.
He went round the Ragwon County Offshore Farm together with the participants in the inaugural ceremony.
He said that he felt boundless pride in having done another good thing for the people as he sees the county people full of joy, impressed by the eye-opening reality of their wonderfully remodeled place, adding that Ragwonpho is so beautiful as it vividly reflects the bright looks of the people before the spectacular and fantastic landscape.
Going round the product exhibition room, sci-tech learning space, combined control room, scallop and kelp processing facility, wharf, etc., he learned in detail about the management, operation, the state of processing aquaculture products and the prospect of the future development.
He said that seed is also the key to aquaculture and a rapid development can be made only when the Party's policy for bringing about a radical turn in seed improvement is consistently adhered to. He indicated the tasks and ways for increasing the profitability and utility of aquaculture, stressing the need to take long-term scientific and technological measures in keeping with the changes in the marine conditions caused by abnormal weather.
Kim Jong Unsaid that in order to ensure that the offshore farms provided by the Party with much effort contribute substantially to promoting the peculiar development of the regional economy and improving the standard of material life of the local people, the officials of county Party committee and offshore farms should give scientific guidance and make responsible efforts in the spirit of devoted service to the people and the offshore farms in Sinpho City and Ragwon County should help and learn from each other and make steady innovations in the hot wind of socialist emulation.
Enjoying the picturesque view of Ragwonpho for a long time, he said with pride it is an admirable miracle that the port, which was just the sandy beach six months ago, has now turned into an ideal cultural fishing village greeting a paradise of happiness, adding that this remarkable speed of development is a proud epitome representing the present day of socialist Korea where not only the people but also nature have been changed beyond recognition and clearly indicating the future of our state which will prosper forever.
Saying that we should not be satisfied with the present successes but make uninterrupted innovations and progress with higher ambition, ideal and goal, he clarified the important tasks related to the plan for development of aquaculture next year.
He said that the struggle for creating civilization in Pyongyang and other cities is speeding up at an admirable pace and this is highlighting the justness, urgency and durability of the regional development policy of our Party to remove differences between urban and rural areas as soon as possible. Adding that this way should be followed by us unconditionally for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people and this work should be done without fail, he reaffirmed his unshakable will to surely achieve the centuries-old great cause of the regional rejuvenation.
He visited the families of Han Kwang Son, Jo Tong Chol and Pak Chung Hyok, employees of the offshore farm, full of great emotion and joy after receiving new wonderful houses and bestowed warm paternal love and affection on them.
Going round various living rooms, he warmly congratulated them who became full-fledged masters of the Ragwon fishing village and encouraged them to become innovators of feats playing a big role in achieving the economic development of the county. He had photos taken with them against the background of their new houses.
Expressing the belief that Ragwonpho would prosper forever as the socialist ideal land along with the wealth of prosperity increasing year by year, he once again wished the county people all blessings year after year.
The inaugural ceremony of Ragwonpho, which was held with splendor as a great auspicious event of the whole country, served as a significant occasion to prove once again that thanks to the outstanding leadership of the great Party Central Committee which is ushering in a new era of prosperity where the people's desire is fully realized, upholding them as heaven, the great goal of the regional change, the victory of the regional rejuvenation will surely be achieved and the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" the people sing from the bottom of their hearts will resound forever in our prosperous socialist country. -0-

headline: Greetings of Thanks to Farmers
story_text:
On August 7, 2020, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally drove a car to Taechong-ri, Unpha County of North Hwanghae Province, where the flood has not yet subsided, and took a series of benevolent measures for restoration after learning about damages caused by flood and made his way home.
His car, which was making its way through the muddy pools created by the heavy rain, slipped into the paddy field on the roadside.
At that time, more than ten farmers came in haste from nowhere.
They choked their tears at the sight of the car stained with mud all over it and threw themselves into the paddy field.
It took a long time to get the car out.
Saying that they took much trouble, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unexpressed his thanks to the farmers.
The farmers, who haven't properly thanked the respected General Secretary for showing enthusiasm and affection before anybody else on the land hit by the natural disaster, were embarrassed to receive greetings of thanks from him instead.
The respected General Secretary stopped the car several times keeping pace with the farmers of Taechong-ri following the car in enthusiastic cheers.
After a while, he stopped his car again and earnestly told an official that although he came to help the people, he received assistance from them as the car was stuck in the mud.
Officials and the Taechong-ri farmers were filled with great honor and happiness as they were under the care of the great fatherly leader who regards the sincerity of the people as the most precious wealth, feeling so pleased at their simple and clean minds. -0-

headline: Dry-field Irrigation Projects Finished in Pyongyang Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Municipality in the DPRK completed the dry-field irrigation projects planned for this year ahead of three months.
The irrigation system of over 590 hectares of dry fields has been improved to lay a solid foundation for stably developing agricultural production in the region despite unfavorable weather conditions.
The Municipal Rural Economy Committee has conducted operation and command to build all the irrigation facilities on a permanent way in the shortest span of time so that farms can benefit from the irrigation system from this year's farming.
The districts and counties pushed forward with dry-field irrigation projects, giving priority to ensuring their quality.
The Rangnang Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory increased the production of over 45 000 meters of various kinds of plastic pipes, contributing to the irrigation construction.
The employees of the Pyongyang Motor Factory devoted their wisdom and enthusiasm to producing motors for dry-field irrigation, and many working people in the municipality rendered material and moral assistance to the successful irrigation projects.
At present, the municipality takes practical measures to finish the inauguration inspection of irrigation facilities. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advanced into Group Stage of 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Group D matches of the preliminary of the 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League took place in Laos.
The Naegohyang Team, which proved successful at the 2023-2024 DPRK women's premier football league, continued winning streak in the preliminary stage.
The Naegohyang team defeated the Master of Laos 11:0 on August 25, the RTC of Bhutan 7:0 on August 28 and the Kaohsiung Atackers of Taipei of China 5:0 on August 31, and advanced into the group stage of the 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League with the first place in the Group D at the preliminary stage.
The group stage, which will bring together 12 women's football teams, will be held in November this year. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Newly-inaugurated Combined Missile Production Line of Major Munitions Enterprise
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, went round the newly-inaugurated combined missile production line of a major munitions enterprise to learn about the overall condition of the state missile production capacity and its prospect on August 31.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, managers of major missile production enterprises and members of the non-permanent committee for modernizing the defence industry.
Kim Jong Unappreciated that the plan for expanding the missile production capacity ordered by the Eighth Congress of the WPK to meet the long-term demands for the operation of the state missile forces has been successfully fulfilled by this year, the last year of the Five-Year Plan, and various kinds of missiles were put into serial production, saying that this result would be the most important core and strategic success achieved by the munitions industry field in carrying out the plan for developing the defence capability during the period under review.
Kim Jong Unlearned in detail about the newly designed automated assembly-line missile production system.
He was greatly satisfied to hear the report that the automated assembly-line production system was established with the process of preparing materials, the process of manufacturing all components of the airframe and the equipment specialized in precision processing, measuring and assembling different parts, thus increasing the productivity and ensuring qualitative character of the products in a scientific and technical way.
He noted that the state missile production capacity has rapidly been increased and a sure guarantee has been provided for raising the fixed quantity for major missile units according to plan as a result of the establishment of the modern production line capable of meeting the long-term demand of the development-oriented missile forces of our army. He said that the eye-opening change has been made in the struggle for implementing the Party's core defence building policy on strengthening the missile forces, adding that this is a clear fruition of the remarkably increased spiritual strength, wisdom and enthusiasm of our research group and workers in the field of defence science.
He stressed that the missile production sector should be fully prepared to unconditionally accept and fully implement the new long-term production goals set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Party.
That day, he ratified three new long-term plans related to missile production capacity and the draft for defence expenditure on the plans.
The senior officials of the Missile Administration and major missile production enterprises pledged to uphold our Party's cause of building a powerful army by producing many more powerful war deterrents. -0-

story_text:

The city made a deep study of afforestation and conducted a mass campaign to plant and cultivate trees of good species and turfs as required by designs.

Those of Ikkal-dong planted various kinds of flowers at the new flower beds in streets and parks with the main emphasis on lifting the ornamental effect and planted flowers.

Officials of the Ryuwon Footwear Factory make the employees accelerate the technical upgrading of the shoe-making process and improve the quality of products.
The Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory increases the rate of cutting yield and produces leather shoes suited to the characteristics of ages and sexes while directing efforts to developing new products.
The Wonsan Footwear Factory has made progress in improving the quality through a mass technical innovation movement including building a rational sewing process and introducing the method of casting in various types of molds into outer rims of shoes.

headline: Press Statement of Department Director of Press and Information of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Kim Chon Il, director of the Department of Press and Information of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, on August 31 issued the following  press statement "Attempt of the U.S., Japan and the ROK to turn cyber space into a theatre of geopolitical confrontation should not be allowed":
The U.S., Japan and the ROK are expanding their provocative acts to a new domain with an aim to systematize and institutionalize the collective collaboration to put pressure on a sovereign state and aggravate geopolitical confrontation.
A typical example is that they recently made public a "joint statement" full of fabrication under the pretext of coping with the "cyber threat" from the DPRK and held a meeting of the cyber diplomatic working group.
The tripartite confab of the hostile forces is a political farce to tarnish the image of the DPRK and embellish the moves  for collaboration to put pressure on the DPRK by building up world public opinion about the groundless "cyber threat theory".
The DPRK Foreign Ministry strongly denounces and rejects the U.S., Japan and the ROK for their moves to use cyber space, the domain of development common to humankind, as a theatre of geopolitical confrontation and hostile propaganda against sovereign states.
The U.S., which formed the tripartite diplomatic working group for the first time under the pretext of "cyber threat" from the DPRK in December 2023, has held regular confabs with Japan and the ROK to use cyber space as a major means for sanctions and pressure.
This year alone, the U.S. set the "cyber threat" from the DPRK as the core agenda and incited the atmosphere of confrontation at the tripartite U.S.-Japan-ROK confabs on the sidelines of the Munich Security Conference and the NATO foreign ministers' meeting. It is also adding our citizens and organizations to the list of sanctions.
Meanwhile, the U.S., Japan and the ROK have staged the annual "Freedom Edge", the first tripartite multi-domain joint military exercises covering the cyber space, in the Korean peninsula since June last year to steadily improve the mode of joint cyber attack targeting our state between the three parties.
This proves that the motive and purpose of cyber confabs between the U.S., Japan and the ROK are to further intensify political and military pressure on our state from A to Z and to pave the way for the fabrication of the triangular military alliance.
We warn the U.S., Japan and the ROK for their hostile attempt to turn cyber space into a theatre of geopolitical confrontation aimed to threaten the security of our state and infringe upon its sovereign rights.
The more the U.S. persists in its anachronistic and malicious hostile acts against the DPRK through the intensified collaboration with its satellite countries, the more distrust and hostility will be piled up between the DPRK and the U.S.
The DPRK will take practical measures to defend its rights and interests against the undisguised acts of the hostile states in cyber space and other domains and neutralize their malicious influence. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advanced into Group Stage of 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Group D matches of the preliminary of the 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League took place in Laos.

headline: Efforts to Increase Cocoon Production  at Sericulture and Silk Industrial Bureau
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Sericulture and Silk Industrial Bureau of the DPRK is  increasing the production of cocoons both in quality and quantity.
The bureau set the goal of producing more than 100 million mulberry seedlings suitable for the relevant regions.
While providing sufficient fertilizer and agrochemicals for cultivating seedlings, it is intensifying its guidance to carry out the daily assignment according to processes.
It  is generalizing the successes and experience gained by the Pongchon Sericulture Management Office and other units.
It is increasing the cocoon production by introducing advanced silkworm-raising methods.
It introduces and generalizes into relevant units the experience of the Kangnam Sericulture Management Office which is achieving successes in the cocoon production by establishing a system of common breeding of young silkworms.
It is also  rebuilding and expanding the young silkworm raising rooms and installing necessary equipment at all sericulture management offices. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Learns about Composite Carbon Fiber Material Production Process and Production of High-thrust Missile Engine
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the relevant institute of the General Academy of Chemical Materials under the Missile Administration of the DPRK on September 1 and met experts in the field of the research into the composite carbon fiber material.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas told about the successes made in the research on the said material.
He acquainted himself with the test results of the institute which made the high-thrust solid-fuel engine with the composite carbon fiber material and verified the creditability of the operation of the engine and its accuracy through eight static firing tests in the past two years according to the defence science key technology development plan approved by the Ninth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, and he discussed the issue of laying a foundation for specialized serial production in the future.
The maximum thrust of the new-type solid-fuel engine using the composite carbon fiber material is 1 960kN. The engine is to be used in the ICBM Hwasongpho-19 series and the next-generation ICBM Hwasongpho-20.
Repeatedly appreciating the development of the engine as a significant success heralding a great change in bolstering up our strategic missile forces and expanding their capabilities,Kim Jong Unmade a proposal to award high-class state commendations to scientists of the relevant institute who opened a shortcut to bolstering up the strategic forces with important research result. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Formation of Korean Youth League in Japan Observed
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) -- A meeting was held at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on August 27 to mark the 70th anniversary of the formation of the Korean Youth League in Japan (Jochong).
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organization Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Ri Kwang Il, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Jochong, and its vice-chairpersons and delegates.
Read out there was a congratulatory message sent by the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League to the meeting.
Pak Ku Ho made a congratulatory speech and Ri Kwang Il made a report.
Reflecting the unanimous mind of loyalty of all the members of Jochong, the reporter extended the highest honour  and warmest thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho showed special love and care for significantly celebrating the 70th anniversary of the formation of Jochong.
He said that the 70-year-long course covered by Jochong is a proud history in which it has steadfastly carried forward the generation of Chongryon by thoroughly embodying the great idea of the movement of Koreans in Japan, true to the leadership of the peerlessly great men under the hard storm and stress in the alien land and firmly rallying the broad young Koreans.
He stressed that Jochong would hold fast to the important letter sent by the respected Marshal to the Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the formation of Chongryon as a treasured sword for sure victory, carry forward all the wonderful legacies left by the founder generation, take the lead in the three major undertakings for defending the rights and interests, bringing up the new generation and preserving the national identity, and ensure the glorious history of Chongryon's struggle for a hundred, nay a thousand years, filled with redoubled courage and stamina.
Oath-taking speeches were made.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Products of Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factories in Pyongyang Municipality

story_text:

It secured seed fishes and pushed ahead with fish farming according to the kinds of fishes as required by technical regulations to raise many fishes for feed. -0-

Officials of the province went to scientific research institutes and universities and urged their teachers and researchers to conduct a brisk brainstorming campaign, regarding the sci-tech problems arising in reality as their research seeds.
Production processes of various goods including fittings, paint, sanitary ware and plastic tube have been built to lay material and technical foundations for stepping up regional construction thanks to the thinking and efforts of scientists and researchers in the province to solve sci-tech problems.

headline: National Economic Plans for August Fulfilled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 3 (KCNA) -- Various sectors and units of the national economy in the DPRK fulfilled their national economic plans for August.
Officials and workers in the fields of metallurgical and chemical industries including the Musan Mining Complex, the Posan Iron Works, the Unryul Mine, the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Myonggan Chemical Factory brought about a great upsurge in production.
The Ministry of Electric Power Industry successfully fulfilled its August national economic plan.
Coal miners in the field of coal-mining industry including the Chonnae, Kyongwon and Myongchon area coal-mining complexes launched a mass movement to increase the coal output.
Officials and workers in the field of machine-building industry including the Ryongsong Machine Complex, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326, the Kumsong Tractor Factory, the Pyongyang Bearing Factory and the Kusong Machine Tool Factory fulfilled their assignments without fail.
Several units in the field of mining industry have made innovations in the mineral and nonferrous metal production.
The field of forestry sector fulfilled the August national economic plan for the Ministry of Forestry.
The railway transport sector established a unified command system and fulfilled the monthly transport plan for the Ministry of Railways through the non-breakdown, on-schedule operation and extra-traction movement.
The Sangwon Cement Complex, the Sunchon Cement Complex, the Chollima Tile Factory and other units in the field of building-materials industry increased the production.
The light industry sector waged a drive for increased production and creation to diversify consumer goods and improving their quality.
The fishing sector including the Yanghwa, Songdowon, Hongwon and Soho fishery stations introduced rational fishing methods to meet the changing fishing conditions, thus recording good results in catching fishes.
Successes for increased production have been expanded thanks to the patriotic enthusiasm of all the officials and workers across the country to significantly greet the founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, September 3 (KCNA) -- The Kanggye Building Materials Factory in the DPRK has been remodeled into a comprehensive base for producing finishing building materials, according to Rodong Sinmun.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Participates in Commemorations Marking 80th Anniversary of Victory in Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and World Anti-Fascist War
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 4 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, participated in the commemorations marking the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War held in Beijing, the capital city of the People's Republic of China, on September 3.
The great victory in the anti-Japanese war and the world anti-fascist war marked a world historic event that brought about a fundamental turn in carving out the destiny of the peoples of the DPRK and China and the progressive mankind and powerfully encouraged the national liberation struggle in the colonial countries and the human cause of independence.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue for the event through the Upright Gate of the Forbidden City in Beijing.
He met Comrade Xi Jinping with delight and exchanged greetings and had a picture taken with heads of state and government of different countries and leaders of international organizations invited to the event.
Kim Jong Unmounted the Rostrum of the Tian'anmen Square, chatting with Xi Jinping.
He met war veterans who participated in the anti-Japanese war at Tian'anmen and warmly congratulated them on greeting the significant and splendid V-Day.
The commemorative rally began at 9:00 (local time) to mark the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
The ceremony of raising the flag of the People's Republic of China was held amid 80 gun salutes.
Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, made an important address before reviewing troops.
Present in the military parade were 45 foot and armament columns and air echelons representing the services and arms of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.
Pigeons symbolizing peace and numerous balloons were released into sky over the square to significantly decorate the end of the rally.
That day there was a reception for guests of honor at the Great Hall of the People to mark the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
Kim Jong Unattended the reception together with the leaders of different countries.
A welcoming artistic performance was given by the Chinese artistes at the reception. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Russian President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 4 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and held talks with Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation who participated in the commemorations marking the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing in the afternoon on September 3.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unhad a photo taken with Comrade Putin in commemoration of their meeting in Beijing.
Present there were Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov, Minister of Natural Resources and Ecology Alexandr Kozlov and Aide to the President of Russia for Foreign Policy Yuri Ushakov.
Expressing his pleasure to meet Putin again,Kim Jong Unmade an affirmative appreciation of the bilateral relations expanding and developing vigorously into all fields after the conclusion of the DPRK-Russia inter-state treaty.
Putin highly appreciated the matchless bravery and heroism of the DPRK soldiers displayed in the operations for liberating Kursk, saying that the relations between the two countries are special ones of trust, friendship and alliance. He noted that Russia would always remember sacrifices made by the DPRK army and askedKim Jong Unto convey the warmest greetings to all the DPRK people on behalf of the Russian people.
Kim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for this.
He said that the DPRK would fully support the struggle of the Russian government, army and people for defending the national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests and remain faithful to the implementation of the inter-state treaty between the DPRK and Russia, regarding it as a fraternal duty in the future, too.
The heads of state of the DPRK and Russia discussed in detail the long-term plans for cooperation between the two countries and reaffirmed their steadfast will to continue to lead the bilateral relations to a high level.
Kim Jong Unhad an open-minded exchange of views with Putin on important international and regional issues.
The meeting proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
Conveying warm greetings to the fraternal Russian people,Kim Jong Unexchanged warm farewells with Putin. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Talks with Comrade Xi Jinping
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People in the afternoon on Sept. 4.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas warmly welcomed by Comrade Xi Jinping.
Kim Jong Unexchanged greetings with delight with Xi Jinping and had a photo taken with him against the background of the national flags of the two countries.
He expressed thanks to the Chinese party, government and people for having given special hospitality to the DPRK delegation with sincerity and congratulated them on their holding of excellent and splendid commemorations marking the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War as a grand political festival. He said that China showed its firm determination to defend world peace and clearly demonstrated its important international position and influence on this occasion.
On behalf of the Chinese party, government and people, Xi Jinping warmly welcomed once againKim Jong Un's visit to the People's Republic of China and said that his participation in the commemorations marking the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War served as an important occasion of showing the firm will of the DPRK side to resolutely defend the outcome of the victory in the Second World War and of further developing the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties and between the two countries.
Xi Jinping said that China and the DPRK are good neighbors, good friends and good comrades who share the destiny and help each other. Noting that the Chinese party and government are attaching great importance to the traditional China-DPRK friendship, he expressed his willingness to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations.
Noting that no matter how the international situation may change, this stand will not change, he said that as in the past, the Chinese side in the future, too, supports the DPRK in its struggle to steadily open up a new phase of the Korean-style socialist cause while taking the road of development suited to its actual conditions.
Affirming that the friendly feelings between the DPRK and China can not change no matter how the international situation may change and it is the steadfast will of the WPK and the government of the DPRK to steadily develop the DPRK-China relations,Kim Jong Unsaid that the DPRK will as ever invariably support and encourage the stand and efforts of the Communist Party of China and the government of the People's Republic of China to defend the sovereignty, territorial integrity and development interests of the state.
At the talks, the top leaders of the two countries had an open-minded exchange of views on the issues of intensifying the high-level visits and strategic communication between the DPRK and the PRC and informed each other of the independent policy stands maintained by the parties and governments of the two countries in the field of external relations.
They also referred to the issue of strengthening strategic cooperation and defending common interests in international and regional affairs.
The talks proceeded in a warm and friendly atmosphere.
That evening Xi Jinping hosted a reception forKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from General Secretary of C.C, CPV and President of SRV
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on September 4 received a congratulatory message from To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) and Luong Cuong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (SRV).
In the message, on behalf of the Vietnamese party, the state and the people and on their own behalves they extended the warmest congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand, through him, to the WPK, the state and its people on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK (September 9, 1948-September 9, 2025).

headline: Number of Farmers Involved in On-line Educational System Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, many agricultural workers across the DPRK have enrolled in the study-while- working on-line education system.
At the on-line education faculty of Pyongyang University of Agriculture, more than one thousand and hundreds of farmers are studying through on-line education and the number of applicants is increasing day by day.
This year, the number of farmers' entrants is 1.5 times as compared with that of last year.
At the Ponghwa Farm in Kangdong County, more than 40 farmers have joined the study-while-working on-line education system this year, of which more than 30 persons are ordinary farmers. Among them are young people, bumper croppers and housewives.
Farmers of the Hyongsan Vegetable Farm in Hyongjesan District and many other farms are joining the study-while-working educational system.
Many farmers have been enrolled in the on-line education system of agricultural universities in different regions including Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture and Haeju Kim Je Won University of Agriculture.
Tens of farmers of the Migok Farm in Sariwon City are studying through on-line education system. The farm provides farmers with conditions for study and encourages them to study hard through review and valuation on several occasions. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Culture Leaves for Russia
Name of DPRK Associated with Patriotic Will of Peerlessly Great Man
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- It has been 77 years since the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was founded.
Whenever the Korean people think about the name of the country with the honour and pride of being citizens of the DPRK, they look back with deep emotion on the noble patriotic will of PresidentKim Il Sungwho named the country.
After the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945), the President paid deep attention to the issue of naming the new country.
When the name of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was put forward, the factionalists completely imbued with flunkeyism said that the name is too long and foreign countries were not named in such a way as to name our country, and that our country should be called "people's republic" or "democratic republic".
The President told the officials that the name of the DPRK was absolutely supported and approved by all the people through the constitution discussion, adding that when we founded the Workers' Party of Korea, we set forth the founding of a democratic people's republic in the political line of the Party and steadily struggled for its realization.
He also noted that there is no need to read others' faces in naming our country as we should name our country to suit the actual conditions of our country and meet the requirements of our people, and that the name of the DPRK clearly reflects its independent, democratic and popular characters.
The President stressed that it is the most reasonable to name the country the Democratic People's Republic of Korea by fully reflecting the will of the people and taking into consideration both the immediate tasks and fundamental purpose of our revolution.
Like this, the President maintained the Juche-oriented stand and popular stand in naming the country from A to Z.
The name of the DPRK is a symbol of the dignity and glory of Juche Korea as it is associated with the ardent patriotism and outstanding foresightedness of the President, the founding father of the country, and his warm love for the people. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President of United Russia Party

Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on September 5.
The message said:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my sincere congratulations on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The founding of the DPRK on September 9, 1948 served as an event of eternal historic significance.
The Soviet Union's first recognition of a new state that was founded on the Korean peninsula has a very symbolic meaning.
Since then, the Republic has firmly held its position as a powerful sovereign state.
Under your leadership the Republic is demonstrating its solidity against external threats and making a constructive contribution to ensuring the security in Asia.
The comprehensive strategic partnership between Moscow and Pyongyang based on the tradition of friendship and good-neighborliness is steadily growing in the interests of the fraternal peoples of Russia and the DPRK.
In this course, the fruitful cooperation between the United Russia Party and the Workers’ Party of Korea is playing an important role.
I am convinced that close contacts between the two parties will promote many-sided mutual cooperation between the two countries in the future, too.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I wish you good health and success in your responsible activities and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and well-being. -0-

Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- Koreans in China sent flower baskets to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The flower baskets were laid before the statues of the great leaders on  Sept. 5 in the name of the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, Ri Sol Hui, director of the Secretariat of the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the family of Choe Su Jin, a Korean in China, Manager Ri Hwang and Deputy Manager Ri Kil of the Jiangshan Co. Ltd., Pak San Ho, general manager of the Dandong Huixing Economic Trading Co. Ltd. of China, Phyo Song Ryong, chairman of the Association of Korean Businessmen in China, Kil Kyong Gap, chairman of the Association of Korean Nationals in Shenyang City, Sim Chong Song, chairperson of the Association of Korean Nationals in Dandong City of China, Choe Kyu Chol, general manager of the Yingkou Shengfeng Commodity Exchange Co. Ltd., and his wife Choe Ok Hui,  Ma Mae Hwa, general manger of the Yanbian Quanlai Commercial Trade Co. Ltd., Ri Hyang Dan, general manager of the Dandong Baolin Trade Co. Ltd., Choe Kol, general manager of the Sobaeksu Culture Proliferation Co. Ltd. in Liaoning Province of China, Kim Nam Chol, general manager of the Beijing Jinmeng Future Cultural Media Co. Ltd., Kim Chol, director of the Shenyang Qingping Trade Corporation, Song Ho Gol, director of the Hunchun City Ouya Hospital, An Phyong Nam, representative of the Tianjin Jiujiang Trade Co. Ltd., Kang Yong Guk, general manager of the Liaoning Shenghan Trade Co. Ltd., Ro Yong Chol, general manager of the Juncheng Shijia Management and Consultation (Beijing) Co. Ltd. of China, Choe Un Bong of the Hongxing Trade Co. Ltd., Korean in China Kim Yong Il and his wife Kim Sin Suk, and Korean in China Kim Thae Song.
On the same day, members of the UN resident coordinator office and the missions of the UNDP, UNICEF, UNFPA, FAO, WFP and WHO here and Choe Ryong Ho, vice-rector of Pyongyang University of Science and Technology, laid flower baskets before the statues of the great leaders. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Culture Leaves for Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK led by Minister Sung Jong Gyu left here on September 5 to attend the eleventh international forum of culture to be held in Sankt-Peterburg.
The delegation was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Pak Kyong Chol, vice-minister of Culture, and Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Flower Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Koreans in China
124th Regiments of KPA Promote Construction of Regional-Industry Factories
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- The 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army are pushing ahead with the construction of regional-industry factories planned for this year.
The 124th regiments of the KPA dispatched to the counties of Paechon and Hwangju are pressing ahead with all the projects at a high qualitative level, observing the construction standards and regulations for all processes.
The 124th regiments in charge of the construction of regional-industry factories in the counties of Jangyon and Koksan are tiling exterior walls.
The 124th regiments in the counties of Pukchang, Rangnim and Ryonggang and other regions made efficient building tools by themselves to ensure the quality of structures.
The 124th regiments are sharing and transferring advanced techniques and experience to ensure the highest quality of structures.
The appearances of the construction sites are changing thanks to the efforts of officers and men of those regiments to build fine regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties this year. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Meet Meritorious Persons of Socialist Patriotism
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers in the DPRK met meritorious persons of socialist patriotism on September 5 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The meritorious persons made speeches at the meeting.
The speakers told the agricultural workers about the great love and benevolence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho gave the precious honor of meritorious person of socialist patriotism to them who should do much more work than what they have done.
They stressed that it is genuine patriotism and pride to keep in mind the trust and expectations of the Workers' Party of Korea and devote themselves to improving the people's standard of living.
Saying that nothing is impossible when the patriotic minds to love and glorify their native places are pooled as one, the speakers expressed their resolve to bring earlier the rural rejuvenation by preparing the agricultural workers as rural revolutionaries in the new era who uphold the Party's plan in the van.
Present at the meeting were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK), officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President of United Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on September 5.
The message said:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my sincere congratulations on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The founding of the DPRK on September 9, 1948 served as an event of eternal historic significance.
The Soviet Union's first recognition of a new state that was founded on the Korean peninsula has a very symbolic meaning.
Since then, the Republic has firmly held its position as a powerful sovereign state.
Under your leadership the Republic is demonstrating its solidity against external threats and making a constructive contribution to ensuring the security in Asia.
The comprehensive strategic partnership between Moscow and Pyongyang based on the tradition of friendship and good-neighborliness is steadily growing in the interests of the fraternal peoples of Russia and the DPRK.
In this course, the fruitful cooperation between the United Russia Party and the Workers’ Party of Korea is playing an important role.
I am convinced that close contacts between the two parties will promote many-sided mutual cooperation between the two countries in the future, too.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I wish you good health and success in your responsible activities and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and well-being. -0-

headline: More Workers at Silk Mills in DPRK Fulfill Two-year and Yearly Plans
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, more workers at silk mills in the DPRK carried out their two-year and yearly plans.
At the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill, more than 110 workers fulfilled their yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule through a drive for increased production. Two workers of a workshop carried out their two-year national economic plans ahead of others in the factory.
Over ten workers of the Songchon Silk Mill finished the yearly national economic plans ahead of schedule.
At the Hamhung Silk Mill, the collectivist spirit that skilled workers help new workers and exemplary workers help backward ones is displayed. In the course, more workers have fulfilled their yearly plans.
Many workers at the Kangso Silk Mill, too, implemented the yearly national economic plans. -0-

headline: National Emblem Associated with Peerlessly Great Man's Desire for Nation Building
Personages of Political Parties of Italy and Romania Issue Statement and Article
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Personages of political parties of Italy and Romania issued a statement and an article on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Roberto Gabriele, general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy, released a statement "The Democratic People's Republic of Korea which has recorded only victory and glory" in the magazine La Voce.
He said that the founding of the DPRK by the great ComradeKim Il Sungon September 9, 1948 was a historic event that declared the birth of an independent state centered on the masses of the people for the first time in the world.
Under the wise leadership of ComradesKim Il SungandKim Jong Il, the Republic turned into a power independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence, frustrating the hostile forces' persistent sanctions and stifling moves for decades since its foundation and has won victory after victory along the road chosen by itself, he noted.
Today the DPRK is fully demonstrating to the world its might as a dignified independent power and invincible socialist fortress under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, he said.
Vasile Orleanu, chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania, posted on its website an article dealing with the birth of the first people's democratic state in the East in accordance with PresidentKim Il Sung's original idea and line on state building, and with the fact that the DPRK defended its independent dignity and the people's destiny and laid a firm foundation for its powerful defence capability and self-supporting economy in the historic course of the grim Fatherland Liberation War, postwar reconstruction and socialist construction.
The DPRK people's struggle showed the whole world that if a small country builds up its strength and overcomes the trials and difficulties encountered, it will surely emerge victorious, the author said, adding that the precious exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungin the founding and development of the DPRK will be kept deep in the hearts of not only the DPRK people but also the world progressives. -0-

headline: Foreign Figures Laud DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- The boundless reverence of progressive mankind for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho put the dignity and position of the DPRK on the highest peak of the times with his outstanding ideology and political ability is being expressed.
The general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy said that the DPRK is fully demonstrating to the world its might as an independent power and invincible socialist state under the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The future of the DPRK led by the greatest man in the world is bright and rosy, he stressed.
The chairperson of the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association noted that there is no country like the DPRK which defends its principle and interests in the position equal to big powers and has a great influence on world politics although the territory and population are small.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, the chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association and the chairman of the Finnish National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea highly praised the DPRK as a beacon of hope and a precious living example of progressive mankind struggling for independence, justice and peace, as it is dynamically advancing at the centre of the world politics.
The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK praisedKim Jong Unas a prominent statesman and peerlessly great man recognized by the world as he glorified the DPRK as a symbol of justice and victory and turned it into a fortress of independence and people's paradise in the eastern corner.
The chairman of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialism), the chairman of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the chairman of the South African Association of Friendship and Solidarity with Korean People and other foreign figures also stressed that the DPRK would as ever record only victory and glory in its sacred history as it is holding in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the top leader of the revolution. -0-

headline: National Emblem Associated with Peerlessly Great Man's Desire for Nation Building
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- The prestige and might of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a socialist state with the longest history, are represented by its dignified national emblem.
The national emblem of the DPRK designed under the detailed guidance of PresidentKim Il Sung, founding father of socialist Korea, is incomparable in terms of meaning and popular character.
The issue of instituting the national emblem was first brought up for discussion at a major meeting held in Pyongyang in November 1947 after Korea's liberation (August 15, 1945).
The President guided the creators to a shortcut to the idea and even drew a transmission tower of a hydroelectric power station reflecting the electrification of the country and gave instructions on the details of the national emblem as well as artistic representation.
Through its five-pointed star and beam, the national emblem of the DPRK represents the future of the country advancing for the accomplishment of the revolutionary cause of Juche under the leadership of the President.
Mt Paektu under the five-pointed star symbolically shows that the DPRK is carrying forward the anti-Japanese revolutionary traditions.
The red band wrapping the rice ears reflects the invincible unity of our people rallied around the Party.
The name of the "Democratic People's Republic of Korea" in the centre of the lower part of the red band means that the DPRK ensures democracy to the maximum in state building and activities so that the masses of the people become genuine masters of state power, and provides them with political freedom, rights and happy material and cultural life.
The hydroelectric power station and rice ears on the emblem symbolize the future of a prosperous independent and sovereign state.
The national emblem of the DPRK reflecting the desire of the peerlessly great man for nation building was born with the sentiments, ideal and aspiration of the people. -0-

headline: National Flag of DPRK, Banner of Eternal Victory and Glory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Whenever we look at the national flag of the DPRK, we think of the proud history of the DPRK recorded on the road of victory and glory under the leadership of the peerlessly great men and are convinced of the bright future of our country, which will be more prosperous.
As the national flag illuminates the past, present and tomorrow of the DPRK, and the dignity of the socialist country of Juche and independent people are associated with it, the people of the DPRK could invariably advance straight along the road of victory despite stern trials and difficulties like Mt Paektu which remains unchanged in any storm and stress. They are demonstrating the dignity and might of the DPRK all over the world, single-mindedly upholding the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea with pure loyalty as the white snow of Mt Paektu.
The national flag of the Republic has been fluttered as a symbol of the victory and dignity of our homeland.
Fly high for all ages with the bright future of Juche Korea! -0-

headline: Tanchon Smeltery in DPRK Selected Again as One of Ten Best Enterprises for 2024
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- The Tanchon Smeltery in the DPRK was selected again as one of the ten best enterprises for 2024.
The smeltery over-fulfilled its national economic plan, raised the actual extraction rate of products by more than 2 percent and successfully fulfilled the major policy tasks set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea, including the manufacture of equipment for the regional-industry factories and the construction of houses in the area of Komdok.
Attracting special attention is the experience of the smeltery, which has defended for three years the honor of being one of the ten best enterprises, attracts special attention amid the great enthusiasm for competition among enterprises in various sectors of the national economy.

headline: National Sculpture and Craftwork Festival Opens in DPRK

story_text:

Kim Tok Hun read out the congratulatory message.
The WPK Central Committee in its congratulatory message said that the restaurants of the management office, which are lined up in the best places in the central part of Pyongyang, are a precious revolutionary legacy associated with the noble traits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho devoted their all to the people, feeling great pleasure and worth in the happy appearance of the people, and a wealth of the people which is thoroughly embodying the Party's policy of public catering service and the Korean-style socialist service culture putting the demands and interests of the people above all else.

headline: National Flag of DPRK, Banner of Eternal Victory and Glory
Foreign Figures Laud DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- The boundless reverence of progressive mankind for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho put the dignity and position of the DPRK on the highest peak of the times with his outstanding ideology and political ability is being expressed.
The general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy said that the DPRK is fully demonstrating to the world its might as an independent power and invincible socialist state under the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The future of the DPRK led by the greatest man in the world is bright and rosy, he stressed.
The chairperson of the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and the chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association noted that there is no country like the DPRK which defends its principle and interests in the position equal to big powers and has a great influence on world politics although the territory and population are small.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt, the chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association and the chairman of the Finnish National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea highly praised the DPRK as a beacon of hope and a precious living example of progressive mankind struggling for independence, justice and peace, as it is dynamically advancing at the centre of the world politics.
The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee and the chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK praisedKim Jong Unas a prominent statesman and peerlessly great man recognized by the world as he glorified the DPRK as a symbol of justice and victory and turned it into a fortress of independence and people's paradise in the eastern corner.
The chairman of the Nepal Communist Party (United Socialism), the chairman of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the chairman of the South African Association of Friendship and Solidarity with Korean People and other foreign figures also stressed that the DPRK would as ever record only victory and glory in its sacred history as it is holding in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the top leader of the revolution. -0-

headline: National Flag of DPRK, Banner of Eternal Victory and Glory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Whenever we look at the national flag of the DPRK, we think of the proud history of the DPRK recorded on the road of victory and glory under the leadership of the peerlessly great men and are convinced of the bright future of our country, which will be more prosperous.
As the national flag illuminates the past, present and tomorrow of the DPRK, and the dignity of the socialist country of Juche and independent people are associated with it, the people of the DPRK could invariably advance straight along the road of victory despite stern trials and difficulties like Mt Paektu which remains unchanged in any storm and stress. They are demonstrating the dignity and might of the DPRK all over the world, single-mindedly upholding the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea with pure loyalty as the white snow of Mt Paektu.
The national flag of the Republic has been fluttered as a symbol of the victory and dignity of our homeland.
Fly high for all ages with the bright future of Juche Korea! -0-

headline: Ideological Offensive Brisk at Construction Site of Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- A powerful ideological offensive is being conducted at the construction site of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
Political and ideological education and motivation activities are being conducted briskly to train all the builders into heroes of creation.
The performances of mobile artistic motivation teams, military bands and service personnel's wives are giving strength and courage to the officers and men who have conducted ceaseless creative struggle.
The Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade is also reporting the news of feats in a mobile way, increasing the enthusiasm for collective emulation.
The North Phyongan and South and North Hamgyong provincial brigades are boosting the effectiveness of the frontline-style political work by exploring and applying new forms and methods.
North Phyongan Province has deployed lots of loudspeaker vans and artistic motivational stages at construction sites and is raising the sound of the drums of the ideological campaign.
The provincial women's union committee organized a contest of officials of the city and county women's union committees and primary information workers of the women's union for political work and motivation at the construction site to encourage the members of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade.
Officials and members of the women's union committees in Sinuiju and Jongju cities and Unsan, Tongchang and Kwaksan counties displayed visual motivation aids, slogans, watchwords and flash news boards dealing with the feats of the builders, thus adding vigor to all the sites of grand construction. -0-

headline: Review of Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Following are major news items and articles in Rodong Sinmun, a leading newspaper of the DPRK, on Monday:
- A meeting of service personnel of the Korean People's Army was held to adopt a letter of loyalty to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the letter relay team left for Pyongyang.
- A political essay dedicates to the most beautiful and great motherland in the world.
- Successes are being made in different sectors and units.
- There took place a passing-on-technique session on sowing winter wheat and barley.

headline: Immortal Journey That Ushers in Era of Our State-First Principle
Founding Anniversary of DPRK Observed in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Meetings took place in Bulgaria and Switzerland and lectures, round-table talks and film shows in Germany, Romania and the Czech Republic on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Present at the events were personages of political and social circles and members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in those countries.
Films and videos showing the brilliant history of socialist Korea and the fighting spirit of the Korean people were screened at the film shows.
Speeches were made at the events.
The chief of theKim Il SungLibrary in Sofia of Bulgaria said that the great ComradeKim Il Sungwaged the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle for 20 years to achieve the cause of Korea's liberation and founded the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on September 9, 1948.
Under his leadership, the Korean people eradicated the aftermath of the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule in a short span of time and turned the country, a backward agricultural state, into a powerful and developed socialist industrial state which the principle of independence, self-sustenance and self-reliance in defence was thoroughly embodied, the chief said.
The chairman of the Switzerland-Korea Committee referred to the feats President Kim Il sung performed in building a country and winning the victory in a war and the exploits the President performed in ensuring that the stamina of heroic Korea in postwar reconstruction and socialist construction was shown and the spirit of the Korean people demonstrated.
The chairman of the Anti-Imperialist Forum of Germany said:
After the liberation of Korea, the genuine people's party, the people's power and the people's army were founded under the wise leadership of ComradeKim Il Sung.
Korea is a great country that performs miracles and feats day by day.
The chairman of the Romanian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea praisedKim Il Sungas the eternal President of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and founding father of socialist Korea.
A congratulatory message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting held in Switzerland. -0-

headline: Repair and Maintenance of Farm Machines for Harvesting Finished in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province in the DPRK finished repairing and maintaining farm machines for harvesting.
The workers of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory produced thousands of accessories by giving priority to the quality of products and introducing rational processing methods, and sent them to farms in the province.
Officials in Sariwon City and Pongsan County went to farms and solved the knotty problems, thus helping them finish repairing and maintaining farm machines in time.
Agricultural workers in Sohung, Sangwon and Junghwa counties made preparations for operating tractors and combine harvesters at full capacity.
The farm machine stations in Yonthan, Unpha and Singye counties produced various kinds of accessories in a qualitative way.
The Ryonghyon Farm in Suan County and the Phyongam Farm in Koksan County introduced rationalization proposals and technical innovation proposals to recover the original performance of farm machines by pooling their wisdom and efforts.
Hwangju, Sungho and Yonsan counties finished repairing and maintaining farm machines by enhancing the role of mobile repair teams and launching a mass technical innovation movement. -0-

headline: Immortal Journey That Ushers in Era of Our State-First Principle
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Today, the DPRK is fully demonstrating before the world its might as an independent power and invincible socialist state.
The people of the glorious DPRK greeting its 77th founding anniversary are recollecting the brilliant journey of the miraculous years that they opened up a new era of self-respect and prosperity, the era of our state-first principle, on this land while bringing about a series of epoch-making events admiring the world people under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
In December 2012 the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unexpressed his firm determination and will to turn the DPRK into the most powerful country and people's paradise admired by the world under the uplifted banner of Juche.
ComradeKim Jong Unadvanced the idea and theory of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism on nation building through his energetic ideological and theoretical activities on the road of leading the revolution and developed them in depth, thus opening a broad avenue to the era of our state-first principle, the building of a socialist power.
The world's most rare wealth came into being in different parts of the country thanks to the devoted efforts ofKim Jong Un, who had never stopped thinking about the country and its people and taking his steps even a day and a moment, saying that the country would advance ten years if we suffered hardships a year.
Many monumental edifices including model and standard factories have been built across the country, and the dreams and ideals of the people are translating into reality amid the grandiose blasting to herald the regional industrial revolution following the ground-breaking ceremonies for building 10 000 flats in the capital city of Pyongyang.
All these victories are a great demonstration of the tremendous potential of the DPRK which is dignified with independence, prosperous with self-sustenance and strong with self-reliance in defence.
The era of our state-first principle shines as a new era of self-respect and prosperity thanks toKim Jong Un, who demonstrates the dignity and might of the country to the whole world and brings the people's life and happiness into full bloom with his energetic leadership. -0-

headline: Projects for Regional Economic Development Propelled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Jagang and South Hwanghae provinces in the DPRK are pushing ahead with projects directly related to the regional economic development and improvement of the people's living standard.
Jagang Province set the goal of building and rebuilding dozens of projects this year and is striving to carry it out.
Builders in Kanggye City are putting spurs to the construction to finish rebuilding and modernizing the Kanggye Tannery in a qualitative way.
The construction of a zoo conducive to the cultural and emotional life of the people is being stepped up at the final stage.
Builders of the provincial rural economy committee are rebuilding the Kanggye Dairy Cattle Farm and workers of the Hungju Chicken Farm and the Kanggye Building-Materials Factory are stepping up the construction of black swan and ostrich aviaries and the reconstruction of the factory at the final stage.
South Hwanghae Province constructed industrial buildings, including the Hwangnam Steel Plant and the Haeju Brick Factory, and hundreds of rural dwelling houses.
Building-materials production bases are now being built in the province and major factories including the Haeju Paper Factory and the Haeju Farm Machine Factory are being renovated.
The construction of a purification plant and pumping station is being pushed forward to more satisfactorily supply domestic water to the residential households in Haeju City. -0-

headline: Passing-on Technique Session on Sowing Winter Wheat and Barley Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- A passing-on technique session on sowing winter wheat and barley was held at the Kumsong Farm in Onchon County, Nampho Municipality of the DPRK on September 7.
Present there were officials concerned, officials in the agricultural sector in Pyongyang and the regions.
The comprehensive explanation on sowing winter wheat and barley deals with the issues arising in securing and winnowing high-yielding seeds in keeping with the increasing the areas of wheat and barley, disinfecting and drying various kinds of seeds and raising the fertility of soil with self-sufficing manure like huminite.
The passing-on technique session dealt with the ways to observe technical regulations in each process by working out detailed plans and actively using the efficient farm machines on the basis of taking a proper account of field management and climatic conditions according to regions. There were a demonstration and video show on the efficient sowing method. -0-
