headline: Successes at Factory Colleges
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Factory colleges across the DPRK are putting spurs to training technical personnel who would contribute to the development of units.
Kyongamsan College of Technology is creating and applying superior educational methods to help students recognize and utilize the essence of teaching contents in conformity with the characteristics of the factory college.
Pyongyang College of Technology reflects the problems arising in production practice on teaching contents  and organizes field practice so that the students possess a high practical ability as well as versatile knowledge.
Teachers of Kyongsong College of Technology are steadily improving the contents of lectures while solving technical problems arising in putting the production of the Kyongsong Electric Appliances Plant on a normal footing.
Haeun and Sinuiju colleges of technology put efforts into practical education with good conditions for experiment and practice and put the teaching and administrative management on an IT basis to ensure the correct implementation of the educational programme.
Teachers of Sosong and Phyongchon colleges of technology  improve the quality of teaching while making educational contents more detailed, diverse and practical and introducing various experimental apparatuses. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from S. African President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Cyril Ramaphosa, president of the Republic of South Africa, on September 3.
The president in the message said that he and the government and people of the Republic of South Africa extend the warmest greetings and heartfelt congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the government and people of the DPRK on the auspicious occasion of celebrating September 9, 2025, the founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The occasion serves as an opportunity for the government and people of the DPRK to look back upon the history of the country and foresee its promising future, the message noted.
Recollecting the fact that the DPRK supported South Africa during the period of its struggle for freedom, the president noted that they would like to refer to the fact that the historic relations provided a foundation for friendship between the two countries.
He wishedKim Jong Ungood health, reaffirming their hope that friendship between the two countries would further grow stronger and promote the development of the bilateral relations. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on September 9.
The Lao president in the message extended warm congratulations, on behalf of the Central Committee of the LPRP, the government of the LPDR and its people and on his own behalf, to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand through him, to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and all the fraternal DPRK people on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
As a close friend of the fraternal DPRK people, we are very proud of and pleased about great successes achieved by the DPRK people for the past 70 years, he said, adding that we are sure that the DPRK would make successes continuously in carrying out the cause of building a socialist power under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed byKim Jong Un.
He expressed the will to closely cooperate withKim Jong Unto bring substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries, defend peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world and achieve cooperation and development by further expanding and developing the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, two states and two peoples of Laos and the DPRK with a long tradition.
He wishedKim Jong Ungood health and happiness and greater new success in his noble and honourable work. -0-

headline: National Flag-Hoisting Ceremony Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- A national flag-hoisting ceremony was held in Pyongyang in the evening of September 8 on the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Many officials, working people, youth and students gathered atKim Il SungSquare with joy and excitement to mark the significant national day on the grand journey for dynamically ushering in the overall prosperity of the state.
Amid the solemn playing of the national anthem of the DPRK, an exemplary worker, peasant and intellectual in the capital city hoisted the national flag with respect.
The masses paid high tribute to the glorious national flag shining as the banner of victory and glory of the Korean people for decades since the historic day when the birth of the genuine People's Republic was declared before the world.
Fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky of September where the national flag fluttered.
Amid the fireworks, the masses hardened ardent determination for ushering in a new era of the eternal prosperity of the country and greeting the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud labor achievements by unsparingly devoting their patriotic strength and enthusiasm. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Senegalese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Bassirou Diomaye Faye, president of the Republic of Senegal, on September 1.
The president in the message extended warm congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon his own behalf and on behalf of the Senegalese people on the occasion of the national day of the DPRK.
He sincerely wishedKim Jong Ungood health and the friendly DPRK people happiness and prosperity.
The message affirmed the will to boost the good relations of friendship between the two countries. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Jagang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built in the Sinyon Industrial Crop Farm of the Jagang Provincial Rural Economy Committee and the Township Farm in Wiwon County.
The low-storied, single-storied and terraced dwelling houses built to ensure modernity and architectural beauty while preserving with peculiar features of the countryside are the cradle of happiness created by the noble idea of the people-first principle of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is working heart and soul to provide the agricultural workers with more affluent and civilized living conditions.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in Jagang Province, builders and agricultural workers who are to move into new houses. A congratulatory speech was made, the licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches were made.
When moving into new houses began, a cheerful dance was given and officials visited the owners of the new houses to congratulate them. -0-

headline: Newspapers Mark National Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Tuesday dedicate editorials to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
September 9, 1948 is an important day when the great state in which the people seized the power, the will of the people is reflected in the national policies and the right of the people is guaranteed by the law was founded for the first time in a 5 000-year-long history, Rodong Sinmun says and goes on:
Our state's sacred course of development shining with victory and glory vividly shows the eternal truth that the great leader builds an invincible power.
Our Republic is the greatest patriotic legacy of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un's outstanding ideas, extraordinary leadership and absolute authority are decisive factors which put the dignity and mightiness of the Republic on the highest level after the nation building.
It is the greatest exploit of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto usher in an our-state-first era, an era of power which has been long desired through a 5 000-year-long history, on this land and to ensure eternal peace and permanent prosperity for the people and posterity.
The prestige of our state which has been fairly put on the centre of the global political landscape and its rosy future are linked with the absolute authority of the respected General Secretary, the man of great eminence in the present era.
It is inevitable and lawful that our Republic is powerful forever and prospers as it is supported by the people possessed of strong self-respect and patriotism that no one can break.
Our country is dignified as it holds the great leader in high esteem, and an invincible power making long strides following up the victory as it has the great people regarding loyalty and patriotism as their duties.
Minju Joson called upon all the people to hold aloft the banner of independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence under the leadership of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea and demonstrate before the world the dignity and prestige of the independent power and the honor and heroism of the people of the powerful country. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Cambodian King
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Norodom Sihamoni, king of the Kingdom of Cambodia, on August 19.
The king in the message extended warm congratulations to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the DPRK people on behalf of the people of the Kingdom of Cambodia and on his own behalf on the occasion of September 9, 2025, the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The message said that the king sincerely and highly appreciates the wise leadership ofKim Jong Unfor the firm development of the DPRK and happiness of all the people.
It expressed belief that the bonds of friendship and cooperation between the Kingdom of Cambodia and the DPRK would get closer and widely develop for the interests of the peoples of the two countries.
The king wishedKim Jong Ungood health and success in his work for the state and the DPRK people. -0-

headline:
Nation-Building Exploits of President Kim Il Sung
[2025.09.09.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people are recollecting with deep emotion the undying nation-building exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungon the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Kim Il Sungput forward the Juche-oriented line of building a people's government during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle.
In the "Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland", he set forth the tasks for overthrowing the rule of the gangster-like Japanese imperialists and establishing a genuine Korean people's government by forming an anti-Japanese united front.
The people's revolutionary government established in the guerrilla bases under the guidance of the President became a historic root that gave origin to building a new state centered on the popular masses.
The President wisely led the struggle to build a genuine people's country on the liberated homeland (August 15, 1945).
In his works including "On Founding the Party, State and Armed Forces in the Liberated Homeland", he advanced the most correct nation-building line and set it as the main orientation for solving the issue of power to build a democratic people's republic.
He ensured that local people’s committees at all levels were established by the people themselves on the basis of the thorough liquidation of the colonial ruling machinery of the Japanese imperialists and that the work of arming the masses with the nation-building line of the Workers' Party of Korea was firmly prioritized.
In those days, democratic reforms such as the publication of the Agrarian Reform Law, the Law on Nationalization of Major Industries, the Labour Law and the Law on Sex Equality were enforced, thus providing all conditions for building a new society in the country.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea was founded on September 9, 1948 under the guidance of the President.
The foundation of the DPRK opened a new era of building a socialist state centered on the popular masses on the land of Korea for the first time in history and provided a powerful political weapon for victoriously advancing the cause of independence of the popular masses. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on September 9.
In the message, Xi Jinping extended warm congratulations and heartfelt wishes on behalf of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese government and people and on his own behalf to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the Workers' Party of Korea, the DPRK government and people on the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Over the past 77 years, the Workers' Party of Korea has united the DPRK people and led them and propelled the steady development of the socialist cause of the DPRK in every field with strenuous efforts, the message said, adding:
In recent years the DPRK people have made many delightful successes by waging a vigorous struggle to successfully carry out the goals and tasks set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the leadership of the WPK headed by you, general secretary.
I believe that the DPRK people will greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with their surging spirit and distinguished successes and open up a new chapter in the cause of building Korean-style socialism without fail.
China and the DPRK are the traditional and friendly neighbors which are linked by the same mountain and river.
It is the consistent and steadfast strategic policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations.
Shortly ago, you, general secretary, visited China and participated in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War. I met you again and jointly presented a blueprint for the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries.
The Chinese side is ready to join hands in promoting the China-DPRK friendship and the socialist cause of the two countries through the intensified strategic communication and brisk visits and close cooperation with the DPRK side, thus making a greater contribution to peace and development in the region and the rest of the world.
The message wished the DPRK prosperity and its people happiness and well-being. -0-

headline: Newspapers Mark National Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Tuesday dedicate editorials to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
September 9, 1948 is an important day when the great state in which the people seized the power, the will of the people is reflected in the national policies and the right of the people is guaranteed by the law was founded for the first time in a 5 000-year-long history, Rodong Sinmun says and goes on:
Our state's sacred course of development shining with victory and glory vividly shows the eternal truth that the great leader builds an invincible power.
Our Republic is the greatest patriotic legacy of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un's outstanding ideas, extraordinary leadership and absolute authority are decisive factors which put the dignity and mightiness of the Republic on the highest level after the nation building.
It is the greatest exploit of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unto usher in an our-state-first era, an era of power which has been long desired through a 5 000-year-long history, on this land and to ensure eternal peace and permanent prosperity for the people and posterity.
The prestige of our state which has been fairly put on the centre of the global political landscape and its rosy future are linked with the absolute authority of the respected General Secretary, the man of great eminence in the present era.
It is inevitable and lawful that our Republic is powerful forever and prospers as it is supported by the people possessed of strong self-respect and patriotism that no one can break.
Our country is dignified as it holds the great leader in high esteem, and an invincible power making long strides following up the victory as it has the great people regarding loyalty and patriotism as their duties.
Minju Joson called upon all the people to hold aloft the banner of independence in politics, self-support in the economy and self-reliance in national defence under the leadership of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea and demonstrate before the world the dignity and prestige of the independent power and the honor and heroism of the people of the powerful country. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Construction Site of Kusong City Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site of the Kusong City Hospital on September 8.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Ju Chang Il, Kim Jae Ryong, Kim Yong Su and other senior officials of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He heard from officials concerned a report on the progress made in the construction.
He appreciated the efforts of the builders to achieve signal successes in the construction of the regional hospital by carrying through the intention of the Party Central Committee, which declared this year as the first year of the revolution in public health and gives top priority to the construction of the model city and county hospitals that will lead the overall rejuvenation of public health of the country, through resolute labor struggle.
He went round various places of the hospital to learn about its construction.
The construction of regional hospitals, the start of a great revolution to transform public health facilities across the country before any other sector, is the most responsible and important work to ensure that regional people receive advanced medical services in their regions just like in the capital, he said, adding that this is a substantial and new qualitative change of the region that our Party looks forward to and a meaningful progress in accelerating the building of a highly civilized and prospering state.
He noted that the public health revolution which is being carried on in parallel with the nationwide revolution in regional industry is the most urgent task which will give fresh vital power to our socialist public health, and that this work should be associated with absolute principle and the view on service of our state which subordinates and orients everything to the promotion of the people's health and well-being.
And he referred to a series of deviations revealed in the construction.
Saying that all the systems and elements of the hospital should be combined in a scientific, practical and artistic way in the many-sided aspects of functionality, convenience and architectural beauty, he clarified his opinion on important issues of finishing the construction of the hospital.
Stressing that preparations for operating the hospital should be made in a responsible manner as its construction has entered the final stage, he set forth the tasks related to the opening of the hospital. -0-

headline: Immortal Exploits of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for Bolstering up Self-Defence Capacity of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the national day, the DPRK people are recollecting with deep emotion the immortal exploits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho further consolidated the powerful self-defence capacity of the country.
In his speech made on the occasion of September 9, 2024, the founding anniversary of the DPRK,Kim Jong Unsaid:
Strong power - this just means a genuine peace and an absolute guarantee for the development of our state.
Steadily enhancing the capabilities of our army for fighting a war so as to cope with the regional security environment on its own initiative and to defend the sovereignty, security and interests of the state by dint of a powerful strength is the most important of the state affairs of our Party and government and the primary task of the revolution, he stressed.
It is the steadfast patriotic creed ofKim Jong Unto turn the DPRK into the most powerful country in the world by bolstering up the self-defence capacity.
Kim Jong Unguided the test-fire of submarine-launched strategic cruise missile in January 2024 and the artillery firing drill of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army in March 2024, etc.
The days of his leadership are associated with his patriotic devotion to the people and the rising generation.
Thanks to his devoted efforts to bolster up the powerful self-defence capacity, the DPRK has grown stronger, the dignity of the people has been further enhanced and an irreversible guarantee for the prosperity of the DPRK has been provided.
Kim Jong Unwho provided the irrevocable war deterrent is making a journey of devotion to further bolster up the self-defence capacity of the DPRK and glorify the socialist country of Juche dignified with independence all over the world. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: DPRK Missile Administration Conducts Ground Jet Test of Carbon Fiber Solid-fuel Engine
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the DPRK, together with the Academy of Chemical Materials, conducted another ground jet test of high-thrust solid-fuel engine using the composite carbon fiber material on September 8.
A spokesman for the DPRK Missile Administration made public such following contents:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unoversaw the important test.
The ninth ground jet test of the engine is the last one in the development process.
The maximum thrust of the engine is 1 971 kN.
On the same day, a decree on awarding the state commendations to the president of the Academy of Chemical Materials and the director of the Institute of Solid-fuel Engine under the Missile Administration was ratified.
Kim Jong Unappreciated that the eye-opening fruition of the development of high-thrust carbon fiber solid-fuel engine is the success assuming the most strategic nature in the recent modernization of defence technology and heralds a significant change in expanding and strengthening the nuclear strategic forces of the DPRK.
Present there were Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Munitions Industry of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the general director of the Missile Administration, the president of the Academy of Missile Science, the president of the Academy of Chemical Materials, managers and chief engineers of the Institute of Solid-fuel Engine and the Missile Engine Production Factory and other scientists, technicians and officials in the relevant sector. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Chinese President
story_text:

Over the past 77 years, the Workers' Party of Korea has united the DPRK people and led them and propelled the steady development of the socialist cause of the DPRK in every field with strenuous efforts, the message said, adding:
In recent years the DPRK people have made many delightful successes by waging a vigorous struggle to successfully carry out the goals and tasks set forth by the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the leadership of the WPK headed by you, general secretary.
I believe that the DPRK people will greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with their surging spirit and distinguished successes and open up a new chapter in the cause of building Korean-style socialism without fail.
China and the DPRK are the traditional and friendly neighbors which are linked by the same mountain and river.
It is the consistent and steadfast strategic policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations.
Shortly ago, you, general secretary, visited China and participated in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War. I met you again and jointly presented a blueprint for the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries.
The Chinese side is ready to join hands in promoting the China-DPRK friendship and the socialist cause of the two countries through the intensified strategic communication and brisk visits and close cooperation with the DPRK side, thus making a greater contribution to peace and development in the region and the rest of the world.

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
story_text:

They recollected with deep emotion the immortal patriotic feats of the President who set a world example in building a socialist state and a genuine people's government with his rare wisdom, outstanding ideology and theory and gigantic revolutionary practice and trained the Korean people who were suffered national ruin and hardships into independent human being and thus set them as performers of miracles and unyielding heroes.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech on Occasion of 77th Anniversary of Founding of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech on the occasion of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The full text is as follows:
Beloved people across the country and all officers and soldiers of the armed forces of the Republic,
Esteemed comrades,
Dear friends,
Recollecting with deep emotion the proud course we have covered achieving one precious victory after another while blazing the trail of history by dint of hot patriotic blood, we are now greeting the 77th anniversary of the founding of our motherland.
First of all, on the occasion of National Day I offer warm congratulations to the working people across the country and the officers and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army, who, sharing the destiny of their motherland, are adding lustre to the prestige and honour of the Republic with resourceful creation and sincere efforts, as well as to the families across the country.
I also pay ennobling tribute to the heroes and patriotic martyrs, who performed truly proud exploits for today and future of this Korea and remain alive forever in the memory of their motherland, and I extend a warm militant salute to the generals, officers and soldiers of our army, who have been dispatched for overseas military operations and would be greeting this day with their glorious national flag in the bosom in the far-away alien land.
My warm congratulations also go to the overseas compatriots and their organizations, who would be greeting their National Day with a patriotic desire for the prosperity of their homeland.
Greeting our National Day, we have just solemnly hoisted our sacred national flag and made a pledge of loyalty to our motherland.
Why did our hearts beat so strongly with indescribable emotion as we looked up at the glorious national flag today?
So sacred and moving are this dignity and honour, with which we have written over 70 arduous years of history and achieved victories by struggling dauntlessly, overcoming numerous difficulties and trials generation after generation.
The cause of building a powerful country covering 77 years, which started on the day when the birth of a new Korea was proclaimed, is being reviewed proudly now that our state has attained a remarkable status.
Now no one, by whatever means, can do harm to the absolute status and security of our state, and no force can reverse the powerful current towards an era of prosperity, which we have created by ourselves.
The dignity and powerfulness of our state, with which we can instil in ourselves self-confidence in winning against all manner of injustice and challenges and achieve the ideals desired by the people, are bringing forth enormous pride and great affection of all the people of this country.
At this moment, when our glorious and worthwhile struggle of immortal significance has brought into reality in history the high ambition that with force of unity fostered by the truth we will lead the whole world by and by, there is an iron truth that we cherish deep in our hearts.
The truth is that socialism we chose is the one and only right road.
It was on the strength of the justice and truth embodied in socialism that we have won all the glory we are enjoying today; having established a powerful political system and built a great national strength, we will not allow the destiny of our country to be left to any foreign forces’ devices.
Today all the people’s belief in socialism of our style and their strenuous efforts to defend and add lustre to it without fail are vigorously promoting our national development to open a new phase of prosperity.
As a symbol of this great and beautiful Korea, socialism is the cornerstone and inexhaustible dynamic power guaranteeing the eternal existence of our Republic and its infinite development and prosperity.
As long as socialism of our style thrives, this will remain an ever peaceful and prosperous land, and our people’s security and wellbeing will be defended for all ages.
Let us hold higher the banner of socialism and advance vigorously along the road of socialism for the undying glory of our Korea and for our coming generations who should lead an enduring dignified and happy life in the powerful and prosperous country.
Let us build a brighter and happier future through an indefatigable struggle and enterprising efforts befitting Koreans who live in this powerful country.
Warmly congratulating you once again on the founding anniversary of our glorious motherland, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, I wish all the families in this country joy and happiness.
Thank you. -0-

headline: Efforts on Reforming Educational Structure Made in Educational Sector of DPRK
story_text:

The Ministry of Education made preparations for introducing a new system of teaching management at major universities and universities in the teacher training sector and for implementing the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme in the field of general education from the new school year.
Major universities put spurs to merging and reorganizing faculties and subjects and introducing new teaching management system to suit the specific conditions of the units.
They make efforts to form teaching units in keeping with the mapping of curriculum for each subject and the educational requirements.
Universities in teacher training sector developed and introduced the integrated teaching management system in line with the introduction of a new system of teaching management, and solved the problems arising in its operation, thus making the new system prove effective in educational practice.
They concentrate efforts on solving the problems arising in enforcing new teaching management system such as strengthening the teachers' forces and setting up teaching units.
A workshop and demonstration for reforming the educational structure took place in different parts of the country amid the brisk work to generalize the experience gained by introducing the course of selective education at the senior middle school level into Songnim City of North Hwanghae Province, Hoechang County of South Phyongan Province and Jongphyong County of South Hamgyong Province. -0-

headline: Performance Given to Celebrate DPRK's 77th Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- A performance was given at the Ice Rink on September 9 to celebrate the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Among the audience were senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, members of the central leadership body of the Party in Pyongyang, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly, officials of ministries and national agencies, labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK, teachers and students of revolutionary schools and citizens of Pyongyang.
Overseas Koreans staying in the socialist homeland enjoyed the performance.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and members of missions of different countries in the DPRK.
The performance was given by artistes of art organizations at all levels, students of art education institutions, ice sportspersons and schoolchildren.
The performers presented a vivid performance by newly creating and depicting ice dancing and figure skating in artistic harmony with songs of patriotism and loyalty presented by the people to the motherland and songs praising socialism.
The performers paid tribute to the DPRK with 70-odd-long history, enthusiastically singing the famous songs including odes to motherland "Song of the Proclamation of the People's Republic" and "The Glorious Motherland" which were born at the first foot of nation building.
The performance reached its climax with famous songs of the new era which fully represent the desire to courageously advance for the high prestige and immortal glory of the DPRK.
The performance decorated the national day in a peculiar way. -0-

headline: New Books Published in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- New books were published to add pride and honor of being citizens of a powerful country to the DPRK people.
The Kumsong Youth Publishing House made public the cycle of revolutionary anecdotes "The Future of Juche Korea and ComradeKim Il Sung" (3-10), "The Future of Juche Korea and ComradeKim Jong Il" (3-10) and "The Future of Juche Korea and ComradeKim Jong Un" (3).
The revolutionary anecdotes impressively show the rare wisdom, outstanding foresight, iron will and ardent patriotism of PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The Social Science Book Publishing House published books "Kim Jong Un's Era and Single-minded Unity" and other books.
The book "Kim Jong Un's Era and Single-minded Unity" comprehensively deals with the rare personality and distinguished feats ofKim Jong Unwho made a proud new history of single-minded unity on the land of the DPRK by consolidating and developing the single-minded unity, the strongest weapon of Juche Korea, on a new level over the past more than ten years.
The Science and Encyclopedia Publishing House published the book "Revolutionary Soldiers Enjoying an Eternal Life along with War Victory History" (2).
The book deals with the struggle of the heroes of the Republic produced in the Fatherland Liberation War.
The Art and Literature Publishing House published the collection of medium-length stories "The Sky of Hero".
The work impressively shows the immortal feats ofKim Il Sungwho set forth the bold and original plan for fighting against enemy planes with small arms during the Fatherland Liberation War.
It also truthfully shows the heroic fighting spirit and traits displayed by the soldiers of the People's Army. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Mongolian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, president of Mongolia, on September 9, the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
In the message the Mongolian president extended the sincere congratulations, on behalf of the Mongolian people, to the respected HEKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and to the friendly DPRK people on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK. He said he was pleased that the large-scale projects for the improvement of the people's living standard, including five-year plan for national economic development and the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, are being successfully conducted in the DPRK under the wise leadership ofKim Jong Un.
He said that the Mongolian state and its government are attaching a special importance to the development of relations with the DPRK and affirmed that he would maintain the historic tradition of bilateral relations associated with the old generations' precious achievements, trust and sincerity and develop it in conformity with the common interests of the peoples of the two countries.
In the message he sincerely wishedKim Jong Ungood health and the diligent DPRK people development and prosperity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Labor Innovators and Meritorious Persons Invited to Celebrations of 77th Founding Anniversary of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, met with labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK and had a significant photo session with them, following the commemorations held in the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Sept. 9
The participants, who were greeting the moment of honor they ardently yearned for after meeting the dear father of our socialist state on the joyful national day, were filled with boundless emotion and excitement.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the photo session, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Highly appreciating the services of the labor innovators and meritorious persons who are making devoted efforts to lead the rapid development of their sectors and units in the historic struggle for this year of rounding off the implementation of the five-year plan decided at the Eighth Congress of the WPK, he extended warm encouragement to them.
The prosperity and mightiness of our Republic is the fruition and result of the ardent sincerity and extraordinary practice of the patriotic people who firmly consolidated the foundations of the state and added vigor to the vibrant country with inexhaustible passion and painstaking efforts, he said, adding that the labor innovators and meritorious persons who are making redoubled efforts while prioritizing the state affairs and keeping the national interests above all else are the qualified masters of our era and zealous patriots.
Expressing expectation and belief that all the participants would fully discharge their vanguard role as standard-bearers as ever in the worthwhile struggle of bringing earlier the future of the dignified DPRK while setting the aspiration and goal of their life for the sake of the socialist motherland, he had a photo session with the state assembly hall, where the sacred national flag flutters, as the background to remain long in history.
When the photo session was over, cheers of emotion burst out by all the participants reverberated again in the sky of auspicious September holiday.
Kim Jong Unwarmly acknowledged a long while the participants who were raising enthusiastic cheers out of surging excitement.
All the participants who won the great trust ofKim Jong Unvowed to keep today's honor and happiness as the most valuable asset in their life and greet the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and the Ninth Congress of the Party with proud results of hastening the comprehensive national development by ceaselessly making new miracles and innovations with more vigorous labor efforts. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Venezuelan President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Nicolas Maduro Moros, president of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on September 9.
The Venezuelan president in the message extended the most sincere congratulations toKim Jong Unon behalf of the government of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela and its people and on his own behalf on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK, the historic landmark recorded as the victory of Juche and the start of sovereignty and independence of the Korean nation.
At the time when the hegemonic countries try to revive the theory of the Cold War, the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea have demonstrated their might by actively cooperating in the struggle to defend the sovereignty, right to self-determination and unity and safeguard the new multi-centered and multipolarized world order which will appear inevitably, the message said.
The message expressed once again the political will of the Bolivarian government to intensify the common viewpoint on the issues for establishing peace and international equality as well as the fraternal and cooperative relations with the DPRK and strengthening the multilateral system on the occasion of such important day for the respected DPRK people.
The message once again wished, throughKim Jong Un, the DPRK people prosperity and well-being.
We will win victory through unity, the message said. -0-

headline: Reception Given to Mark 77th Founding Anniversary of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- A reception was given for labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK at the People's Palace of Culture on Sept. 9.
Leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs were on hand.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, made a congratulatory speech at the reception.
Upon authorization of the Party Central Committee and the DPRK government, he warmly congratulated the labor innovators and meritorious persons who celebrated the national day with the pride of having contributed to the development and prosperity of the socialist country with patriotic enthusiasm and sincere efforts at worksites and posts.
The noble appearance of all generations, who carry forward the great patriotic spirit and immortal tradition and form one organic body, is the dignified image of the DPRK people recorded in the nearly 80-year history, he noted.
He expressed belief that labor innovators and meritorious persons would steadily create more innovative successes with firm revolutionary will, pure conscience and redoubled passion in the van of the historic struggle dynamically carrying forward all precious things they have achieved with loyalty and patriotic sweat to the dynamic overall prosperity. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on September 9.
The message extended the warmest congratulations and best wishes to HEKim Jong Unand, through him, to the DPRK government and the friendly DPRK people on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The message wishedKim Jong Unhappiness in good health and success in his work and the DPRK and its people greater progress and prosperity. -0-

headline: DPRK Art Exhibition Held in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The DPRK Art Exhibition "The Great People's Country" opened with splendor at a decorative handicraft and folk art gallery in Russia on September 8 to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Displayed at the venue of the exhibition is a photo of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmeeting Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on a visit to the DPRK in June 2024.
Exhibited there are art pieces showing the brave spirit of the DPRK people dynamically accelerating the overall development of socialism under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, the invincible military muscle and the dignity of the DPRK fully demonstrated before the world and the dignified and happy life of the people.
Present at the opening ceremony were a delegation of the Ministry of Culture led by Minister Sung Jong Gyu and DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol and staff members of his embassy.
On hand there were Sergei Shoigu, secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation, Olga Lyubimova, minister of Culture, personages of the Russian government, political party, social organizations, cultural and art circles and media circle and foreign diplomatic envoys in Russia.
Speeches were made there.
Sung Jong Gyu said that the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations are fully demonstrating their vitality at a new high stage thanks to the most sincere comradely relations between the top leaders of the two countries.
Olga Lyubimova said that the two countries have jointly covered the road for establishing cultural sovereignty, preserving historical and cultural heritage and defending the traditional mental sense of value, welcoming the participants in the opening ceremony on behalf of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation.
The participants looked round the exhibited art pieces with deep emotion. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- All the people of the DPRK, who are significantly celebrating the national day in the sacred journey of opening up the heroic chapter unprecedented in history with absolute dignity and lofty spirit of a powerful country, are warmly recollecting the immortal feats of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho consolidated the eternal foundation of the Korean-style socialism with outstanding and seasoned leadership.
Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior officials of the Party and the government, Party and administrative officials of ministries and national agencies, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly and commanding officers of the armed forces organs visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, on September 9, the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
A flower basket in the august name of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid before the statues ofKim Il SungandKim Jong Il.
Laid before the statues were flower baskets in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK.
The participants paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the participants paid homage to them in humblest reverence.
All the participants vowed to fully demonstrate the mightiness and invincibility ofKim Jong Un's Korea by ceaselessly making miracles and innovations to be specially recorded in the history of the development of the DPRK with great pioneering spirit and noble view of serving the state and the people. -0-

headline: Efforts on Reforming Educational Structure Made in Educational Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The educational sector of the DPRK is striving to improve the educational structure to give more advanced and practical education to students, thus ensuring a guarantee for raising the overall educational level.
The Ministry of Education made preparations for introducing a new system of teaching management at major universities and universities in the teacher training sector and for implementing the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme in the field of general education from the new school year.
Major universities put spurs to merging and reorganizing faculties and subjects and introducing new teaching management system to suit the specific conditions of the units.
They make efforts to form teaching units in keeping with the mapping of curriculum for each subject and the educational requirements.
Universities in teacher training sector developed and introduced the integrated teaching management system in line with the introduction of a new system of teaching management, and solved the problems arising in its operation, thus making the new system prove effective in educational practice.
They concentrate efforts on solving the problems arising in enforcing new teaching management system such as strengthening the teachers' forces and setting up teaching units.
A workshop and demonstration for reforming the educational structure took place in different parts of the country amid the brisk work to generalize the experience gained by introducing the course of selective education at the senior middle school level into Songnim City of North Hwanghae Province, Hoechang County of South Phyongan Province and Jongphyong County of South Hamgyong Province. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: National Flag-raising and National Oath-taking Ceremony Takes Place to Mark 77th Founding anniversary of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The entire people of the DPRK are all afire with ardent patriotic desire to make single-minded efforts for the continuous prosperity and grandeur of the country on the occasion of the glorious September. A national flag-raising and national oath-making ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on September 9 to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was present at the commemorative event.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other senior officials of the Party and the government, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly and commanding officers of armed forces organs.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the venue of the commemorative ceremony of the Mansudae Assembly Hall.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK took place.
Guards of honor of the KPA solemnly escorted the national flag of the DPRK to the venue of the ceremony.
The leading officials of the state paid high tribute to the national flag of the DPRK which has served as an ever-victorious banner, recording in its flag the great history of the dignity and glory of the indomitable Korean people for decades along with the birth of the People's Republic.
The national flag was hoisted amid the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK.
Looking up to the national flag with reverence, the participants shared their patriotic will to hold higher and glorify the greatest and most beautiful country in the world.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a commemorative oath to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
At the call of the head of state, the leading officials of the state solemnly pledged before the sacred national flag to make devoted efforts to remain boundlessly faithful all the time to the promotion of the people's well-being and growth and development of the state, to firmly defend the Constitution of the DPRK and strictly observe its legal duty, to firmly adhere to the socialist ideology and safeguard the socialist system and to carry forward the greatness and beauty of the motherland forever with loyalty to the beloved motherland, as for the responsible members defending the sovereignty of the DPRK and interests of its people and serving the state and people.
Kim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech.
On the occasion of National Day, he extended warm congratulations to the working people across the country and the officers and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army, who, sharing the destiny of their motherland, are adding lustre to the prestige and honour of the Republic with resourceful creation and sincere efforts, as well as to the families across the country.
And he paid ennobling tribute to the heroes and patriotic martyrs, who performed truly proud exploits for today and future of this Korea and remain alive forever in the memory of their motherland, and extended a warm militant salute to the generals, officers and soldiers of our army, who have been dispatched for overseas military operations and would be greeting this day with their glorious national flag in the bosom in the far-away alien land.
He also extended warm congratulations to the overseas compatriots who would be greeting their National Day with a patriotic desire for the prosperity of their homeland.
The cause of building a powerful country covering 77 years, which started on the day when the birth of a new Korea was proclaimed, is being reviewed proudly now that our state has attained a remarkable status, he said, adding no force can reverse the powerful current towards an era of prosperity, which we have created by ourselves.
Noting that at this moment, when our glorious and worthwhile struggle of immortal significance has brought into reality in history the high ambition that with force of unity fostered by the truth we will lead the whole world by and by, there is an iron truth that we cherish deep in our hearts, he stressed the truth is that socialism we chose is the one and only right road. It was on the strength of the justice and truth embodied in socialism that we have won all the glory we are enjoying today; having established a powerful political system and built a great national strength, we will not allow the destiny of our country to be left to any foreign forces’ devices, he said.
As a symbol of this great and beautiful Korea, socialism is the cornerstone and inexhaustible dynamic power guaranteeing the eternal existence of our Republic and its infinite development and prosperity, he said, adding that as long as socialism of our style thrives, this will remain an ever peaceful and prosperous land, and our people’s security and wellbeing will be defended for all ages.
He ardently called for holding higher the banner of socialism and advancing vigorously along the road of socialism for the undying glory of our Korea and for our coming generations who should lead an enduring dignified and happy life in the powerful and prosperous country and for building a brighter and happier future through an indefatigable struggle and enterprising efforts befitting Koreans.
The participants were deeply moved by the ardent speech reflecting the steadfast faith and will ofKim Jong Unto hold the great DPRK and its people in esteem as the strongest country and the most dignified people in the world, and his earnest request calling on them to become vanguard fighters in carrying out the sacred cause for overall national prosperity and true servants of the people.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his speech, enthusiastic cheers of "hurrah!" burst out to shake the venue.
The leading officials of the state made a pledge of loyalty to uphold with a single mind the ideology and leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a new era of great changes and miracles to be specially recorded in the history of the DPRK's growth and development and to make devoted efforts for the eternal security and prosperity of the glorious DPRK which will shine forever. -0-

headline: DPRK's 77th Birthday Celebrated
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- All the people across the DPRK significantly celebrated the birthday of their beloved motherland as an auspicious holiday.
An endless stream of visitors flew into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
The plaza before the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun was full of the boundless reverence for the peerlessly great men who built a genuine independent and sovereign state and opened up the eternal future of the country demonstrating its might as a country of miracles and heroes.

headline: Sokwang Temple
story_text:
One day in September 1947, PresidentKim Il Sungvisited the Sokwang Temple during his field guidance to Kangwon Province.
At that time there was a small holiday camp.
The President gave instructions on preserving and managing well the Sokwang Temple, a precious cultural heritage. Then he asked an official about a good mineral spring, and went to the resort, guided by the official.
The President tasted mineral waters. There is a saying that the mineral waters in the Sokwang Temple are good, and they actually seem good as I drank them, the President said.
The President kindly asked an official of the holiday camp about the medicinal properties of mineral waters.
The official hesitated to reply.
Noting that people should not drink mineral waters just because they are good, but drink them according to chronic internal diseases, the President gave instructions to analyze mineral waters and study what kind of diseases it is good for.
Later, the prospecting of mineral waters was conducted in the area around the Sokwang Temple thanks to the benevolent measure of the President, and in the course of this, several more mineral springs were found.
And a sanatorium was built in the area, turning the area into a scenic spot. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the construction site of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area, he learned in detail about the overall project progress and stressed the need for the construction units to give top priority to ensuring quality and, in particular, to conduct more scrupulous operation and command so that all the undertakings including the finishing projects of public buildings and landscaping are carried out as required by designs and construction methods.
Acquainting himself with the paper production of the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill and the process of its modernization, he called for steadily improving the quality indices of paper by directing efforts to raising the scientific and technological force and pushing ahead with the construction work and equipment assembly according to each project and system as reflected in the modernization goal.
Going round the railway section between Jongmunri Railway Station and Wihwado Railway Station and the embankment on the shore of the Amnok River, he stressed the need to pay attention to qualitatively building the compound of Wihwado Railway Station and ensuring the intensity of railway so as to improve its functionality and practicality as it is built into a comprehensive transport center.
At the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the premier called for decisively improving the quality of castings and steel castings in the process of producing materials and for actively introducing advanced processing methods to satisfactorily produce and supply custom-built equipment necessary for various sectors of the national economy.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of ensuring timely supply of materials necessary for the construction of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area and supervising the construction in a responsible manner, the issue of giving importance to the management of talents and realizing the integration of production and scientific research at enterprises and the issue for relevant units to actively conduct an organizational work for producing goods under contract. -0-

Present there were Kim Tok Hun, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned and officials and employees of the power station.
Kim Tok Hun conveyed the congratulatory message of the Central Committee of the WPK to the workers, technicians and officials of the power station.
The WPK Central Committee in its congratulatory message warmly congratulated the workers, technicians and officials of the Sodusu Power Station on having defended the Party and the leader through their dynamic drive for electricity production with their boundless loyalty to the duty of the heroicKim Il Sung-Kim Jong Ilworking class defending the lifeline of the national economy for the past 60 years.
The message stressed that the steady upsurge in production at the large-scale hydroelectric power station associated with the immortal leadership exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, who gave hundreds of times of instructions to the power station to guide its construction and operation, and ChairmanKim Jong Il, who visited the power station twice to teach scientific ways of operation and encouraged its workers with his warm love and trust, has always been a great force for the WPK.
The WPK Central Committee in its congratulatory message highly praised the mental world and feats the workers, technicians and officials of the power station who are dynamically pushing ahead with production with their ardent patriotism and loyalty and unyielding efforts, cherishing the slogan of faith "Let us support the Party with increased electricity production!"
At the meeting speakers expressed their resolutions to firmly defend the outpost line of building an economic giant by producing more electricity, bearing deep in mind the honor of receiving the congratulatory message of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Electric Power System Reinforced and Updated in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK has made successes in implementing the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on pushing ahead with the work to put the supply and management of electricity on a scientific and IT basis.
The municipal power transmission and distribution station has spruced up the substations and taken prior measures to prevent accidents in the transmission and distribution lines, thus ensuring the stability of power supply.
It has introduced efficient accident distance estimator and accident analysis system into transmission line protection devices and other valuable innovations, thus reducing the loss of electricity in transmission and creating power reserves.
It has installed dozens of lightening conductors for power failure dispersion at substations  to minimize damage caused by natural disasters.
Officials and workers in the electric-power sector of districts and counties have introduced the action counters for lightening arresters to improve the scientific accuracy of operating zinc oxide lightening arresters, and the engineering sector remodeled the existing internal pressure test devices. -0-

At the construction site of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area, he learned in detail about the overall project progress and stressed the need for the construction units to give top priority to ensuring quality and, in particular, to conduct more scrupulous operation and command so that all the undertakings including the finishing projects of public buildings and landscaping are carried out as required by designs and construction methods.
Acquainting himself with the paper production of the Sinuiju Chemical Fibre Mill and the process of its modernization, he called for steadily improving the quality indices of paper by directing efforts to raising the scientific and technological force and pushing ahead with the construction work and equipment assembly according to each project and system as reflected in the modernization goal.
Going round the railway section between Jongmunri Railway Station and Wihwado Railway Station and the embankment on the shore of the Amnok River, he stressed the need to pay attention to qualitatively building the compound of Wihwado Railway Station and ensuring the intensity of railway so as to improve its functionality and practicality as it is built into a comprehensive transport center.
At the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the premier called for decisively improving the quality of castings and steel castings in the process of producing materials and for actively introducing advanced processing methods to satisfactorily produce and supply custom-built equipment necessary for various sectors of the national economy.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of ensuring timely supply of materials necessary for the construction of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area and supervising the construction in a responsible manner, the issue of giving importance to the management of talents and realizing the integration of production and scientific research at enterprises and the issue for relevant units to actively conduct an organizational work for producing goods under contract. -0-

headline: Kanggye Zoo Newly Built in Jagang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- A zoo was newly built in harmony with the characteristics of a mountainous area in the picturesque Woesan area of Kanggye City in Jagang Province, the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The zoo has tens of species of over one hundred animals such as wild ferocious animals, deer and reptiles.
The province is making preparations for its operation to give pleasure to the visitors and serve them well. -0-

headline: Electric Power System Reinforced and Updated in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK has made successes in implementing the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on pushing ahead with the work to put the supply and management of electricity on a scientific and IT basis.
The municipal power transmission and distribution station has spruced up the substations and taken prior measures to prevent accidents in the transmission and distribution lines, thus ensuring the stability of power supply.
It has introduced efficient accident distance estimator and accident analysis system into transmission line protection devices and other valuable innovations, thus reducing the loss of electricity in transmission and creating power reserves.
It has installed dozens of lightening conductors for power failure dispersion at substations  to minimize damage caused by natural disasters.
Officials and workers in the electric-power sector of districts and counties have introduced the action counters for lightening arresters to improve the scientific accuracy of operating zinc oxide lightening arresters, and the engineering sector remodeled the existing internal pressure test devices. -0-

headline: Absolute Authority of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Is Dignity and Might of Powerful DPRK: Rodong Sinmun Says
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun on Saturday says in an article that the dignity and national power of the DPRK are growing day by day, drawing attention of the world political circles and humankind, and those are linked with the absolute authority of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.

headline: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Observed Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- Seminars took place in Pakistan, Romania, Britain, Austria, Serbia, DR Congo and Mexico between August 31 and September 7 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Speeches were made at the seminars attended by personages of political parties and organizations, members of the Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in relevant countries.
The chairman of the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee, the chief of the Karachi Women's Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea of Pakistan and the chairperson of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies praised the undying feats of PresidentKim Il Sungwho founded the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a genuine people's country, and turned it into a socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence, and the world historic exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho led the DPRK to invariably defend the banner of Juche and socialism despite the great international political upheavals.
The chairman and vice-chairpersons of the Socialist Party of Romania referred to the nation-building exploits ofKim Il Sungand the significance of the founding of a democratic, independent and sovereign state.
The chief of the Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria, the chairman of the Korean Friendship Association UK, the chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and the secretary general of the National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea of the DR Congo said that the founding of the DPRK was a historic event that heralds the birth of a genuine socialist state in which the people can lead an independent life as masters of everything. They noted that for over 70 years since its founding the DPRK has covered the road of victory and glory, regarding the Juche Idea as its invariable guideline.
Personages of the New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unensured that the people-first principle has been thoroughly applied to state activities.
Meanwhile, a joint seminar was held in Mongolia on September 2 to mark the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Destruction of Balance of Power on Korean Peninsula and in Region Will Never Be Allowed: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- The U.S.-led hostile forces are desperately resorting to the strengthening of the military cooperation on the assumption that nuclear weapons would be used, posing a serious threat to the security environment of the Korean Peninsula and the rest of the region.
The U.S. is going to hold with the ROK the third nuclear operation drill dubbed Iron Mace simulating a full-scale nuclear war under the pretext of countering someone's "use of nuclear weapons" from September 15 in the wake of the ones in August last year and April this year.
It was open to public that the enemies will train themselves to be ready to take all extended deterrence measures to cope with the DPRK's "nuclear and missile threats" including the joint planning procedure which requires the ROK to support the U.S. nuclear strategic assets with its conventional combat power in case they are deployed.
The reality clearly shows that the U.S. completely made the nuclear strike on the DPRK a fait accompli and is recklessly pushing ahead with the military preparations for it at the practical stage.
Timed to coincide with the nuclear operation drill Iron Mace, the U.S., Japan and the ROK will launch the third multi-domain joint military exercises Freedom Edge in the open sea south of Jeju Island.
The U.S. and Japan are also staging actual manoeuvres Resolute Dragon on the largest scale ever seen before in Japan from September 11 with huge forces and latest war hardware involved in it.
And the U.S.-ROK will reportedly have "nuclear consultative group" meeting, a confab to map out the scenario for a nuclear war on the Korean peninsula, in October for the second time this year.
In particular, it is said that there is a possibility the U.S., together with Japan and the ROK, would prepare the "plan for using nuclear weapons in case of contingency in the Indo-Pacific region" with the "nuclear consultative group" meeting as an occasion. This public opinion shows that the danger of a nuclear war is expanding to a large area as well as the Korean peninsula.
As evidenced by the upcoming Iron Mace and Freedom Edge whose codenames themselves are bellicose and ongoing Resolute Dragon soon after the U.S.-ROK large-scale nuclear war drills Ulji Freedom Shield which included the drill of striking the DPRK's nuclear facilities, muscle-flexing of the U.S.-ROK, U.S.-Japan and U.S.-Japan-ROK targeting the DPRK and the regional states is dramatically increasing in its scale on the Korean peninsula and its vicinity. This clearly shows that the U.S.-Japan-ROK nuclear military alliance with the U.S. as its axis has entered into full operation.
This is evidently an alarming development that seriously threatens the security of the Korean peninsula and the region.
The Freedom Edge and Iron Mace are the products of the Camp David confab in 2023 and the "nuclear operation guidelines" of last year, as well as the dangerous nuclear war exercises devised by former heads of the three countries.
However, the obsolete policy legacy of triangular military cooperation is invariably inherited even though the rulers have been replaced. On the contrary, the U.S.-Japan-ROK military collusion and nexus are reaching the highest record in history with a composite and multilateral approach based on preemptive nuclear attack.
This proves that the war hysteria of the U.S. and its minions to dominate the Korean peninsula and the region by dint of upper hand in strength is growing stronger day by day.
The present situation urgently demands that the DPRK further harden the counteraction posture of the nuclear force and requires it to thoroughly neutralize the military activities of the aggressive nature among the U.S., Japan and the ROK with absolute military strength.
The destruction of the balance of power on the Korean peninsula and in the region will never be allowed. -0-

headline: To Add Eternal Brilliance to Feats of Young People
story_text:
One day in September 2015, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmet an official and said that the letters reading "Hero Youth" should be inscribed on the front of the dam of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station No. 1.
And he said that as there is a spillway in the center of the dam, the letters "Hero Youth" could be divided into "Hero" and "Youth" and inscribed separately on the left and right sides of the spillway.
Looking up to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who is so solicitous to glorify the heroic feats of the young people forever along with the dam of eternal value, the official was excited.
A few days later, the respected General Secretary gave instructions again as regards the inscription of "Hero Youth" on the dam of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station No. 1.
He stressed the need to depict a torch between the letters "Hero" and "Youth" to fill in the space that occurs when the letters "Hero Youth" are carved on the left and right sides of the spillway.
The letters "Hero Youth" and the torch emblem on the dam of the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station No. 1 are conveying forever the great love and trust of the respected General Secretary to record the feats of the young people before the times and history. -0-

headline: Modern High-rise Apartment Houses Built in Wonsan City of Kangwon Province
Preparations for Operation of Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK has secured tens of tons of seeds and tens of thousands of tons of self-sufficing manure in order to go into production along with the completion of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
The province paid attention to the seed issue and pushed ahead with the work to secure tens of tons of high-yielding vegetable seeds.
It also produced self-sufficing manure necessary for raising vegetable sprouts and normalizing the production of soil greenhouses.
Tens of thousands of tons of fermented manure and huminite were produced and thousands of tons of humus soil were found. -0-

headline: Modern High-rise Apartment Houses Built in Wonsan City of Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- Modern high-rise apartment houses were newly built in Wonsan City, Kangwon Province, the DPRK.
Hundreds of dwelling houses, service amenities including shop and pharmacy, and resting places with flowers and turfs, in which the political character, modernity and cultural refinement were applied, have been built in Sinsong-dong commanding a bird's-eye view of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area known as a tourist resort of national value.
The dwelling houses that have been built along with the new era of regional changes are a proud creation brought about by the noble outlook of the Workers' Party of Korea on the people which orients everything to the wellbeing of the people and spares nothing for them.
Paek Song Guk, chief secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, and other officials and builders of the province and the city congratulated the owners of the new houses.
The fireworks were displayed, adding to the joy of the working people who are full of pleasure receiving new houses, and their laughter and singing were heard from the windows of new houses. -0-
