headline: Meeting Held to Mark 30th Founding Anniversary of Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place in Tokyo on September 6 to mark the 30th founding anniversary of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan (Chongsanghoe).
Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of its Organizational Department, and other officials of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman and delegate of Chongsanghoe.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Ho Jong Man made a congratulatory speech.
He said that Chongsanghoe was formed with the sentiment of patriotism under the instruction given the great GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilto organize the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan on the occasion of the 17th Congress of Chongryon.
The respected MarshalKim Jong Unin his historic letters to Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan on the occasions of the significant anniversaries of Chongryon clearly indicated the road ahead of Chongsanghoe and led it to creditably fulfill its mission and duty in the vanguard of the patriotic movement, he stressed.
He called for glorifying the immortal leadership exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilfrom generation to generation and further developing Chongsanghoe into a powerful youth organization creating a new history of the movement of Koreans in Japan in the great era ofKim Jong Unon the occasion of its 30th founding anniversary.
Then, congratulatory messages from relevant organs of the homeland were introduced to be followed by a report and speeches.
On the same day, a reception was given to mark the 30th founding anniversary of Chongsanghoe. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Armoured Defensive Weapons Institute and Electronic Weapons Institute under Academy of Defence Sciences
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the Armoured Defensive Weapons Institute and the Electronic Weapons Institute under the Academy of Defence Sciences on September 11 and 12.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlistened to the report on the development of major core technologies completed through the joint research of the Armoured Defensive Weapons Institute and the Tank Designing Bureau.
He learned in detail about the research in the field of armoured defence including the development of special composite armour, the reaction test of the intelligent active protection system in the process of its final test before introduction and various designs of the effective defence structure against upper attack.
He appreciated that the combat capability of the armoured forces of the DPRK has been remarkably bolstered up as the directional infrared and jamming equipment, active protection system and passive protection means were successfully developed and introduced.
On the same day there was a comprehensive operation test of the new-type active protection system against the frontal, lateral and upper attack by live firing of anti-tank missiles of various kinds.
The test proved in practice the very high reactivity of the detection system and revolving intercepting projectile launchers and the great advantage of the newly developed active protection system.
Kim Jong Unvisited the Electronic Weapons Institute and learned about and guided important work.
Saying that the Ninth Congress of the WPK would put forward the policy of simultaneously pushing forward the building of nuclear forces and conventional armed forces in the field of building up national defence, he expressed the belief that the Academy of Defence Sciences would continue to stand in the vanguard in the work for modernizing the conventional armed forces true to the Party's line of building a powerful army. -0-

The U.S. and Japan are also staging actual manoeuvres Resolute Dragon on the largest scale ever seen before in Japan from September 11 with huge forces and latest war hardware involved in it.

The Freedom Edge and Iron Mace are the products of the Camp David confab in 2023 and the "nuclear operation guidelines" of last year, as well as the dangerous nuclear war exercises devised by former heads of the three countries.
However, the obsolete policy legacy of triangular military cooperation is invariably inherited even though the rulers have been replaced. On the contrary, the U.S.-Japan-ROK military collusion and nexus are reaching the highest record in history with a composite and multilateral approach based on preemptive nuclear attack.
This proves that the war hysteria of the U.S. and its minions to dominate the Korean peninsula and the region by dint of upper hand in strength is growing stronger day by day.
The present situation urgently demands that the DPRK further harden the counteraction posture of the nuclear force and requires it to thoroughly neutralize the military activities of the aggressive nature among the U.S., Japan and the ROK with absolute military strength.
The destruction of the balance of power on the Korean peninsula and in the region will never be allowed. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Construction Site of Ryonggang County Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site of the Ryonggang County Hospital on September 12.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK.
While looking round the construction site,Kim Jong Unclarified important issues which need to be paid attention to in the construction.
Saying that in the grand construction campaign for regional rejuvenation, too, we should create and introduce the most efficient and advanced ways and methods of construction, he stressed the need to take relevant measures to decisively raise the level of technical equipment and mechanization of the regiments at all levels of the Korean People's Army in charge of regional construction.
Noting that the work for the overall transformation of the regional areas is not the struggle to be completed in a year or two, but the medium- and long-term work to continue in the future, he said that what is important for all construction units is to have a vital stake in training technical forces and steadily increasing the ranks of skilled workers so as to successfully complete the huge construction projects which will be newly assigned to them every year by their own efforts. Then, he set forth tasks and ways to do so.
He said that our army should fight against the enemy and win victory but it should also fight against the backwardness of the regional areas remaining in the present era. Noting that our revolutionary cause can advance rapidly only when the army carves out and creates more wealth of the people and civilization in the new era and leads the era of prosperity, he expressed great belief and expectation that all the officers and men of the construction regiments would fulfill heavy yet honorable responsibility and duty assigned to them standing on the forefront of implementing the Party's policy on regional development. -0-

headline: Celebrations Held by Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- The General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) held celebrations on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
On September 8 and 9, flower baskets in the name of the GAKC, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Zhongnan Regional Association and the Jilin Regional Association and the Jilin City branch under the GAKC and the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, were laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin and the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland art works depicting them at the DPRK embassy in Beijing and the DPRK mission in Shenyang.
Chairwoman Choe Un Bok and officials of the GAKC headquarters and its regional associations and Koreans in China paid tribute to the President and the Chairman, founding father of the socialist Korea and founder and builder of the powerful DPRK.
A film show took place at the conference room of the headquarters of the GAKC to be followed by round-table talks on Sept. 9.
Speakers praised the President as the founding father of socialist Korea who built the DPRK into a dignified socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence and led the Korean revolution to victory in a short span of time with his rare wisdom, iron faith and wise leadership.
They praised the Chairman as an iron-willed commander who firmly defended the destiny and future of the country and the people, holding high the red flag and arms in grim circumstances when socialism collapsed in different countries one after another and the imperialists' moves to isolate and stifle the DPRK reached the extremes.
They stressed that the respected MarshalKim Jong Unis a peerless statesman and patriot who is building the DPRK into the strongest military power with powerful self-defensive capabilities that no one dares to provoke and a prosperous power where the ideals and dreams of the DPRK people have been fully realized.
The speakers pledged to firmly believe and follow the respected Marshal only as the pillar of their minds and further consolidate the GAKC into the overseas revolutionary organization of the Marshal, no matter how many times the world may change. -0-

headline: Bumper Yield of Fruits at Foot of Chol Pass
Preparations for Operation of Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK has secured tens of tons of seeds and tens of thousands of tons of self-sufficing manure in order to go into production along with the completion of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
The province paid attention to the seed issue and pushed ahead with the work to secure tens of tons of high-yielding vegetable seeds.
It also produced self-sufficing manure necessary for raising vegetable sprouts and normalizing the production of soil greenhouses.
Tens of thousands of tons of fermented manure and huminite were produced and thousands of tons of humus soil were found. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Shooting Contest between Sniper Sub-unit under Metropolitan Garrison Command and Sniper Sub-unit of Special Mobile Force of Central Security Organ
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 13 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited the training base No. 38 in the Pyongyang area and oversaw the shooting contest between the sniper sub-unit under the Metropolitan Garrison Command and the sniper sub-unit of the special mobile force of the central security organ on September 12.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the supply of high-precision long-range sniper rifles, various measuring instruments and special camouflage suits to major units and sub-units and watched the shooting contest between the sub-units.
The shooting contest was held in the way of evaluating the total scores recorded by ten snipers from each sub-unit through shooting at circular targets 1 000-meter and 1 500-meter away.
He gave to the chief of the General Staff the orientations of the prospective scale of training sniper force of our armed forces and the plan for the organization of snipers in the whole army and instructed him to take relevant measures.
Referring to the impact of expanding the sphere of snipers' activities on the overall military activities of our army,Kim Jong Unrepeatedly stressed the need to systematically train the special sniper force and intensify their activities.
Noting that it is important to build in a scientific way the comprehensive training bases, where snipers can personally experience the extreme combat conditions and adapt to them, in order to train all the snipers into excellent "hunters" with marksmanship of never missing targets, he said that various training methods and innovative education and training system should be established to meet the requirements of modern warfare, and set forth important tasks to this end. -0-

headline: Press Statement Issued by Vice-Chairman of WPK Central Military Commission
story_text:

The DPRK will make a very responsible choice under the present situation where all unreasonable actions of the enemy states against it are being systematically escalated. -0-

headline: Foundations of Construction Units Reinforced in North Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- North Hamgyong Province in the DPRK is directing efforts to reinforce the foundations of construction units.
The province sent excavators, hydraulic loaders, large trucks and many other heavy machines to the construction units to raise their level of construction equipment.
It organized a construction equipment and tools exhibition so that the construction units can share and generalize the experiences gained in the process of inventing and introducing tools.
It is also paying attention to improving the ranks of skilled workers of the construction units.
The province selects persons with rich experience in construction to assign them to the construction units and makes relevant units establish the well-organized system for training skilled workers by their own efforts. -0-

headline: Medical Oxygen Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- The Medical Oxygen Factory under the Ministry of Public Health is located in a scenic spot on the outskirts of Pyongyang Municipality.
All production lines of the factory are automated and computerized. It is a modern medical oxygen production and supply base with sufficient conditions that can provide the hospitals with oxygen without any inconvenience.
The factory is associated with noble love and devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has always worked heart and soul for the people's health promotion.
After looking round various places around Mt Taesong and the suburbs, he chose the site of the factory in the best place and personally formed the construction force as a builder and operator.
On September 14, 2016, he visited the factory nearing completion and said that the factory, though not large, is the one which makes a positive contribution to protect the lives of the people and promote their health.
The factory reflects the Workers' Party of Korea's outlook on the people and its spirit of devotedly serving them that one should pluck even a star and bring a flower into bloom even on the rock for the people, he said.
After its inauguration, the factory introduced dozens of inventions and technical innovation proposals into production, including the production of low and high pressure expanders by relying on its own technical forces, and the medical oxygen production line won a quality control system authentication. -0-

story_text: Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, sent a congratulatory flower basket to the DPRK embassy to Cuba on September 10 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County and Taechong Farm in Unpha County
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, inspected the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province and the Taechong Farm in Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province.
Choe Ryong Hae encouraged the agricultural workers who are devoting themselves to carrying out the immediate farming process to successfully conclude this significant year with increased grain production and learned about the farming.
In order to ensure good results while maintaining the present good crop, it is necessary to make substantial efforts to increase the thousand-kernel weight to the last, he said, calling for correctly fixing the harvesting time on the basis of the calculation of the ripening rate of grain and the climatic conditions of the region and making foresighted preparations for the operation of tractors, mobile rice combined threshers and other farm machines so that harvesting and threshing can be completed in a short span of time.
Going round paddy fields which adopted the Korean-style green cultivation and fish farming method, he stressed the need to ensure that the validity and vitality of the Party's policy and the economic effectiveness of paddy-field fish breeding lead to the substantial improvement of the living standards of agricultural workers.
Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need for the officials and agricultural workers of relevant farms to get better result in increasing grain production in the vanguard of implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era as befitting the units associated with the leadership exploits of the Party. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Yun Kwang Hung, a woman centenarian living in neighbourhood unit No. 127 of Okchon Workers' District, Pukchang County, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
She extended thanks toKim Jong Un, expressing her deep emotion at the tender love of the benevolent father who was considerate of the birthday of an ordinary old woman.
She, who was subjected to humiliation and contempt before liberation of the country, learned what a genuine life of human beings was like after the liberation and fulfilled her duty as an agricultural worker with a resolve to repay the benevolence of the Party which provided her with an independent and creative new life.
She devoted her sincere efforts to fulfilling the country's grain production goal. Even after becoming a pensioner, she kept herself busy to be helpful to the country.
Officials of the county and villagers visited the family and shared joy. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County and Taechong Farm in Unpha County
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, inspected the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County, South Hwanghae Province and the Taechong Farm in Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province.
Choe Ryong Hae encouraged the agricultural workers who are devoting themselves to carrying out the immediate farming process to successfully conclude this significant year with increased grain production and learned about the farming.
In order to ensure good results while maintaining the present good crop, it is necessary to make substantial efforts to increase the thousand-kernel weight to the last, he said, calling for correctly fixing the harvesting time on the basis of the calculation of the ripening rate of grain and the climatic conditions of the region and making foresighted preparations for the operation of tractors, mobile rice combined threshers and other farm machines so that harvesting and threshing can be completed in a short span of time.
Going round paddy fields which adopted the Korean-style green cultivation and fish farming method, he stressed the need to ensure that the validity and vitality of the Party's policy and the economic effectiveness of paddy-field fish breeding lead to the substantial improvement of the living standards of agricultural workers.
Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need for the officials and agricultural workers of relevant farms to get better result in increasing grain production in the vanguard of implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era as befitting the units associated with the leadership exploits of the Party. -0-

Press Statement Issued by Vice-Chairman of WPK Central Military Commission
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, on September 13 issued the following press statement titled "The DPRK will continue to exercise sovereignty in a responsible manner to make the enemy states realize that their war drills are a meaningless waste of strength":
I received a report from the General Reconnaissance Information Bureau that nuclear operation drill Iron Mace and multi-domain joint military exercises Freedom Edge will be staged simultaneously on the Korean peninsula and in its vicinity in the near future with the participation of the U.S. and its allies.
Iron Mace, aimed to improve the joint operation of the nuclear forces of the U.S. and the conventional forces of the ROK according to the "Guidelines for Nuclear Deterrence and Nuclear Operations on the Korean Peninsula" cooked up by the U.S. and the ROK, is an undisguised nuclear war rehearsal aimed at using nuclear weapons against the DPRK from A to Z.
And the multi-domain joint military exercises Freedom Edge to be staged by the U.S., Japan and the ROK are the most comprehensive and offensive war drill for aggression in its scale, content and nature as it is a series of the large-scale joint military drill Ulji Freedom Shield staged in August.
The reckless military moves of the U.S., Japan and the ROK on the Korean peninsula, the world's biggest hotspot, pose a grave challenge to the security interests of our state and a major danger of undermining regional stability and escalating military tension.
The U.S. and its allies are gradually undermining the security environment on the Korean peninsula through the expansion of exclusive military blocs and consecutive war drills. Their uneasy movements are calling for reinforcement of war deterrent and maintenance of thoroughgoing war posture.
The prevailing situation proves that the most appropriate option of the DPRK to ensure its security and defend the stability of the region is to constantly reinforce the strategic power to frustrate the hostile forces' attempt of aggression and remove the military danger.
The enemy states' attempt to cover up the aggressive nature of the war drills with a sheer sophism that their war drills are "annual" and "defensive" ones can never work on anyone and we have no reason to overlook the U.S.-Japan-ROK military adventure which adds an additional serious variable to the dangerous regional situation.
The U.S. and its followers should not try the patience of the DPRK and give up dangerous moves to further aggravate the tension and security environment of the region.
I stress that if the hostile forces persist in their muscle-flexing, the DPRK will respond to them with counteraction in a very clear and intensified way.
The DPRK's armed forces assume the important mission to deter war and defend its sovereignty.
The DPRK will make a very responsible choice under the present situation where all unreasonable actions of the enemy states against it are being systematically escalated. -0-

headline: Over 400 UAWK Organizations in DPRK Win Title of Socialist Patriotic Forest
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Amid high display of patriotic devotion among officials and agricultural workers of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK), more than 400 units have won the title of the Socialist Patriotic Forest.
The UAWK organizations in Jagang Province conducted forest restoration through a mass movement. In the course, 100-odd units won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
The primary UAWK organizations in Pongchon, Sinchon and Kwail counties of South Hwanghae Province are planting trees of different species according to plans and tending them in a responsible manner.
Officials and members of the primary UAWK organizations in Sariwon City, and Kumchon, Singye and Yonthan counties in North Hwanghae Province have conducted the afforestation work in conformity with their regional characteristics.
Primary UAWK organizations in Jongju City and Tongrim and Phihyon counties in North Phyongan Province installed the insect monitoring posts in mountains to prevent the damage from harmful insects. Members of the union in Jongphyong, Pukchong and Riwon counties in South Hamgyong Province have observed sci-tech requirements in tending trees.
Officials and members of the primary UAWK organizations in Hoeryong City, Onsong County and Orang County of North Hamgyong Province built tree nurseries by themselves and introduced advanced cultivation methods to manure and tend tree saplings in a proper way.
Those in Rangnang and Sunan districts of Pyongyang Municipality and Tokchon City and Sukchon County of South Phyongan Province have conducted the regular monitoring of surrounding mountains to prevent dangerous factors.
Agricultural workers in Nampho and Kaesong municipalities and Kangwon and Ryanggang provinces, too, have dynamically conducted the campaign for winning the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest. -0-

headline: Algerian President Sends Floral Basket and Greeting Card to DPRK Embassy
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- Abdelmadjid Tebboune, president of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, sent a floral basket and a greeting card to the DPRK embassy in El Djazair on Sept. 9 on the occasion of the 77th birthday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The floral basket was laid at the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il. -0-

headline: Medical Oxygen Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- The Medical Oxygen Factory under the Ministry of Public Health is located in a scenic spot on the outskirts of Pyongyang Municipality.
All production lines of the factory are automated and computerized. It is a modern medical oxygen production and supply base with sufficient conditions that can provide the hospitals with oxygen without any inconvenience.
The factory is associated with noble love and devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has always worked heart and soul for the people's health promotion.
After looking round various places around Mt Taesong and the suburbs, he chose the site of the factory in the best place and personally formed the construction force as a builder and operator.
On September 14, 2016, he visited the factory nearing completion and said that the factory, though not large, is the one which makes a positive contribution to protect the lives of the people and promote their health.
The factory reflects the Workers' Party of Korea's outlook on the people and its spirit of devotedly serving them that one should pluck even a star and bring a flower into bloom even on the rock for the people, he said.
After its inauguration, the factory introduced dozens of inventions and technical innovation proposals into production, including the production of low and high pressure expanders by relying on its own technical forces, and the medical oxygen production line won a quality control system authentication. -0-

headline: Press Statement of DPRK Permanent Mission to UN Office and International Organizations in Vienna
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 15 (KCNA) -- The DPRK permanent mission of the UN Office and International Organizations in Vienna released the following press statement on September 14:
With a recent session of the Board of Governors of the International Atomic Energy Agency as an opportunity, the U.S. again committed a grave political provocation, terming the DPRK's access to nuclear weapons "illegal" and talking about "denuclearization".
We strongly denounce and reject the U.S. provocative act of revealing once again its invariable hostile intention against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea while openly interfering in its internal affairs and infringing upon its sovereignty and express serious concern over the negative consequences to be entailed by it.
The U.S. repeated its anachronistic "denuclearization" assertion at the international meeting, clearly proving that the final goal of its policy towards the DPRK is to make the latter abandon its constitution and system and the U.S. has no intention to coexist with it.
The DPRK's access to nuclear weapons plays a key and important role in guaranteeing global peace and stability as an inevitable option for reliably defending the sovereignty and security of the state from the U.S. persistent nuclear threat and ensuring the balance of strength.
In contrast with this, the U.S. endangers global peace and security and undermines the foundation of the international nuclear non-proliferation system through radical nuclear arms buildup and reckless nuclear proliferation. Such hegemony-seeking act of the U.S. is the most serious threat that the international community faces.
As for the world's biggest nuclear weapons state, the U.S. should honestly fulfill its obligation for nuclear disarmament more than anybody else and immediately stop such worrying nuclear proliferation acts as "offering extended deterrence", realizing nuclear sharing with non-nuclear states and transferring nuclear submarine technology.
We warn the IAEA for its attempt to call into question and deter the just exercise of the sovereign rights of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, losing its independence and impartiality and disregarding the realistic and practical U.S. nuclear threat.
The position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as a nuclear weapons state which has been permanently specified in the supreme and basic law of the state has become irreversible. The IAEA, which has not formally established relations with the DPRK for more than 30 years, has no legal right and moral justification to interfere in the internal affairs of a nuclear weapons state which exists outside the NPT.
If the IAEA is sincerely concerned about the international nuclear threat and the ever-worsening international security environment caused by it, it would be logical to call into question the malicious act of the U.S. which wantonly violates the obligation it has assumed before the international community to prevent nuclear proliferation while concentrating more than anyone else on nuclear power buildup.
The U.S. has gone to extremes in its nuclear threat as days go by and the U.S.-led nuclear alliance is getting desperate in its confrontational moves. To steadily bolster up the nuclear deterrent for self-defence to cope with this reality is the best option for preventing the danger of a nuclear war on the Korean peninsula and in the region and reliably guaranteeing the right to existence and development of our state.
We will as ever thoroughly oppose and reject any attempt to change the present position of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and faithfully discharge our duty before the international community as a responsible nuclear weapons state. -0-

Concrete Sleeper Production Plan Fulfilled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- Sleeper production units of the railway transport sector of the DPRK fulfilled the five-year plan of the Ministry of Railways for producing concrete sleepers ahead of schedule and replaced the  sleepers with new ones in the sections extending thousands of kilometers.
The Sungho Concrete Sleeper Factory turned the production process into labor-, electricity- and plot-saving one and produced nearly 20 000 more sleepers than its five-year plan.
The sleeper production units under the Pyongyang Railway Bureau overfulfilled their five-year plan.
The Sariwon Sleeper Production Company carried out its plan by taking technical measures for the growth both in quality and quantity of sleepers as well as the production of railway fixtures and mobilizing internal reserves and potentials.
The Chongjin and Rason railway bureaus introduced valuable technical innovations and ensured full operation and capacity of equipment, thus increasing the production of sleepers.
Every railway bureau increased the proportion of mechanization in the railway work and replaced sleepers as required by technical regulations, thus improving the intensity of railways. -0-

headline: Production of Equipment for Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- Officials and scientists of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK are fulfilling their responsibility in the work for successfully building the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm, according to Rodong Sinmun.
They are carrying out their task for manufacturing technical equipment at the final stage.
The Electronic Institute and the Environmental Engineering Institute completed the manufacturing, assembling and test of hundreds of technical equipment of tens of kinds including the system of supplying nutrient solution and the system of reusing its waste, and transported them to the construction site.
The Modernization Institute finished manufacturing tens of greenhouse control panels of various kinds to be installed in the vegetable science research center and glass hydroponic greenhouse, and is manufacturing thousands of IT products and making automatic sprayer of agricultural chemicals and air purifier at the final stage.
The Automation Institute, the Laser Institute and other institutes are registering remarkable successes in manufacturing greenhouse control panels needed for building an intelligent integrated production system.
The Mechanical Engineering Institute, the Control Machine Institute, the Physics Institute and others are fulfilling their high sense of responsibility in manufacturing and testing multi-layer vegetable cultivation device, vehicle scales, nitric acid manufacturing device and other advanced sci-tech products to be sent to the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
Other institutes and branches are making innovations in carrying out their assignments. -0-

headline: Production of Building Materials for Rural Construction in South Hamgyong Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK directs efforts to the production of building materials needed for rural construction.
The province is boosting the enthusiasm for emulation while generalizing the experience gained in the cities and counties that are taking the lead in cementing the foundations for building materials production, thus making sure that all regions overhaul and reinforce the bases for building materials production and increase their production capacity by making effective use of their regional raw materials resources.
City and counties are increasing the variety and output of building materials.
Kumya, Jongphyong and Sinhung counties are making progress in the development of new products and the production of various kinds of building materials while laying material and technical foundations for building materials production.
Tanchon City is developing and producing more building materials with light burned magnesia while improving the quality of distemper paint. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Sijung County of Jagang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Yonghung Farm in Sijung County of Jagang Province of the DPRK.
The new cozy and modern houses, designed to match the surrounding landscape, are a cradle of happiness provided under the care of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea which is bringing about the beautiful future of rural civilization.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot. Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in Jagang Province and Sijung County, builders and agricultural workers who will move into new houses.
At the ceremony, an address was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over. And speeches were made there.
Amid the cheerful dancing party, officials of the Party and power organs visited new houses and shared joy with owners. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Fully Displaying Patriotic Spirit with Pride of Being Citizens of Great Power
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Tuesday in an editorial says that all officials, Party members and other working people should devote their patriotic enthusiasm and sincere efforts to the prosperity and development of the great country with the high pride and honor of being members of the dignified and powerful DPRK.
The DPRK has emerged as the powerful country, which exercises great influence on the world political structure and the trend of the international situation, and the strongest military power with the powerful self-defensive capabilities that no one in the world dares to provoke. The prestige of our state adds to all the people's pride and honor of living in the great country, the editorial says, and goes on:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unis a peerless statesman and patriot who puts our Republic on the peak of dignity and mightiness and guarantees eternal prosperity for all generations to come.
It is a precious truth our people have realized through their past ten-odd years of struggle that today's strong country and its rosy future are unthinkable without the leadership ofKim Jong Un.
The Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea unfolded a bright blueprint for the comprehensive national rejuvenation and has energetically led the struggle to build an ideal society where the people can enjoy an affluent and civilized life to their heart's content.
What our Party believes most in realizing this great historic cause is the patriotism of our strong people and the elated fighting spirit of all the people to absolutely support and uphold the plans and determinations of the Party Central Committee with their whole mind and strength.
When all the people display unbounded wisdom and make responsible efforts for the patriotic cause of the comprehensive national rejuvenation with the broad self-respect looking down the world and the ambitious pluck to outpace the world, our bright future will be accelerated according to the revolutionary timetable of the Party Central Committee.
The editorial calls upon all the people to more dynamically struggle for the prosperity of the great country, bearing deep in mind the great pride and self-confidence of living in the powerful and dignified socialist country of Juche. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Culture Returns Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK led by Minister Sung Jong Gyu returned home on September 15 after attending the eleventh international forum of culture held in Sankt-Peterburg.
The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Pak Kyong Chol, vice-minister of Culture, and Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Unusual Inaugural Ceremony
story_text:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited Wonsan Baby Home and Wonsan Orphanage before their inauguration on June 1, 2015.
Going round various places of the baby home and the orphanage, he learned in detail about the preparations for their operation. He called upon officials to make sure that children cut the inaugural tapes when the baby home and the orphanage were inaugurated, adding that they will always remember the day when they cut the tapes of their homes with their own small hands and entered the homes even after they become adults.
He warmly said that PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwould be pleased to see them.
The officials earnestly hoped thatKim Jong Unwould cut the inaugural tapes as he had made great efforts to successfully build Wonsan Baby Home and Wonsan Orphanage.
However,Kim Jong Unmade sure that the children cut the inaugural tapes, without any thought of all his efforts.
Thus, the children cut the inaugural tapes with their hands, being blessed by all people, and entered the cradle of love amid the applause of congratulations.
It was the first sight ever since the ceremony of cutting the inaugural tape came into being and an unusual inaugural ceremony that could not be witnessed without emotion. -0-

headline: Production of Equipment for Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- Officials and scientists of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK are fulfilling their responsibility in the work for successfully building the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm, according to Rodong Sinmun.
They are carrying out their task for manufacturing technical equipment at the final stage.
The Electronic Institute and the Environmental Engineering Institute completed the manufacturing, assembling and test of hundreds of technical equipment of tens of kinds including the system of supplying nutrient solution and the system of reusing its waste, and transported them to the construction site.
The Modernization Institute finished manufacturing tens of greenhouse control panels of various kinds to be installed in the vegetable science research center and glass hydroponic greenhouse, and is manufacturing thousands of IT products and making automatic sprayer of agricultural chemicals and air purifier at the final stage.
The Automation Institute, the Laser Institute and other institutes are registering remarkable successes in manufacturing greenhouse control panels needed for building an intelligent integrated production system.
The Mechanical Engineering Institute, the Control Machine Institute, the Physics Institute and others are fulfilling their high sense of responsibility in manufacturing and testing multi-layer vegetable cultivation device, vehicle scales, nitric acid manufacturing device and other advanced sci-tech products to be sent to the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm.
Other institutes and branches are making innovations in carrying out their assignments. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Sijung County of Jagang Province
New Houses Built in Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- The third ceremony for moving into new houses took place at the Phungthan Farm in Sunchon City, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The farm villages reflecting the rapid development and rejuvenation of the socialist countryside are a precious fruition of the energetic leadership and warm loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is paying deep attention to providing the agricultural workers with the best living conditions and environment in the world.
Present at the ceremony held on the spot were Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials, builders and agricultural workers in the city.
Ri Song Bom, chairman of the provincial people's committee, made a congratulatory speech.
Licenses for the use of houses were handed over and speeches made there.
After the ceremony, officials congratulated the owners of the new houses, sharing joy with them amid the playing of cheerful peasants' music. -0-

headline: Congratulations to PM of Thailand
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Anutin Charnvirakul upon his election as prime minister of the Kingdom of Thailand on September 12.
Expressing conviction that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would develop in mutual interests, the message wished the prime minister success in his work for the country's development and prosperity. -0-

headline: Thousands of Threshers Overhauled in South Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK completed the overhauling of thousands of threshing machines in a short span of time.
The province has ensured that the provincial level organs and industrial establishments help repair and readjust the threshing machines.
Cities and counties, too, launched the work to repair and readjust farm machines by mobilizing industrial establishments and strengthening the role of farm machine stations and farm mechanization workteams.
As a result, thousands of threshing machines were repaired and readjusted in the province just in 20 days.
Meanwhile, the farms put efforts into securing spare parts to provide a guarantee for the full operation of threshing machines. Progress has been made in preparing medium and small farm implements needed for harvesting. -0-

headline: Kosan Combined Fruit Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- The Kosan Combined Fruit Farm in Kosan County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK has a rich crop of fruits this year, too.
Thanks to the devoted efforts of the employees of the farm who tended fruit trees with sincerity since the beginning of the year, the trees of the orchards at the foot of Chol Pass were heavy loaded with fruits.
The farm paid primary attention to solving the sci-tech problems arising in sapling production suited to the climatic and soil conditions and actively introduced various advanced technologies, thus providing a guarantee for producing high-yielding and tasty fruits.
The farm is associated with the love and benevolence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho dedicated himself to providing the people with enough tasty and nutritious fruits.
One day in September 2016, when visiting the farm,
Kim Jong Unsaid that apples of various varieties produced at the farm are good in color and sweet in taste, adding that the people would be pleased if the apples harvested this year were sent to them.
Seeing the vehicles and forklifts provided by the Workers' Party of Korea, he said that he would send more modern fruit farming machines including power sprayers to the farm.
He expressed expectation and belief that the employees would turn the farm into a standard one suited to the appearance of a highly civilized socialist nation and a fruit farm to be proud of before the world and bring about a fresh leap forward in fruit production every year.
True to the noble intention of the Party, the farm sends apples, peaches, plums and other fruits to Wonsan and Munchon cities, Kosong and other counties of the province. -0-

Forum of DPRK Young People Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- A forum of youth and students "Patriotic Youths Produced by the Capital City of Pyongyang" took place at the Pyongyang Municipal Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on Tuesday.
Present there were officials of the youth league and youth and students in the municipality.
The speakers referred to the youthful days when they performed worthy labour feats on the road for the country and people, society and the collective.
Choe Hun Song, worker of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, has taken care of the surrounding area of the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill for several years and Kwon Un Jong, worker of the mill, has fulfilled the national economic plan for 15 years during the work of the Seventh Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the plan for 10 years during the work of the Eighth WPK Central Committee and thus wonKim Jong IlYouth Honor Prize.
Ri Hyo Sim, worker of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill who has overfulfilled the yearly national economic plan over the past 10-odd years and thus wonKim Il SungYouth Honor Prize, said that the strong patriotic spirit is the great driving force which enables ordinary women to become the pioneers of the era.
Kim Mi Gyong, student of Pyongyang University of Publication and Printing who gave pleasure to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unby successfully carrying out the task for creating designs for signboards of the public service amenities in a new street of Hwasong area, called upon all students to learn hard to become useful and creative talents required by the times.
Kim Kil Song, student ofKim Il SungUniversity, and Kim Hyon Gyong, student of Kim Chol Ju University of Education, referred to the fact that they bagged gold medals in the table tennis events of the First International Summer Sports Contest of University Students held in July, 2024.
Good deeds of Choe Hyang, educator of the Mirim Kindergarten in Sadong District, who married a special disabled soldier, and Pak Yong Sim, junior doctor of Unha General Clinic in Ryongsong District who has taken care of orphans though she is a girl, vividly represented the ideological and spiritual traits of the young people of the present era. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Real Intention of Descendants of Samurais to Secure "Allied Army" for War
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- In recent days, Japan has directed efforts to tightening the military cooperation with its allies more than ever before, arousing concern of Asian countries.
Days ago, a confab of diplomatic and military bosses of Japan and Australia took place in Tokyo under the signboard of defense cooperation.
Reached there was an agreement on developing the semi-allied relations between the two countries onto a "higher level". And Australia agreed to introduce a new-type escort ship of Japan.
In this regard, the Japanese minister of Defence boasted as if the strengthening of their military cooperation is for regional peace and security, saying that the introduction of the escort ship would lead to the improved security in the Indo-Pacific region.
Japan, which created a precondition for military nexus through the conclusion of the "agreement on mutual supply of goods and manpower" with Australia long ago, actively participated in the meetings of AUKUS, an exclusive group of the Anglo-Saxons, with the offer of nuclear submarine to Australia as its core.
It has been already well known that Japan, that emerged as a war state by stepping up the moves for turning itself into a military giant, has been hell-bent on  securing an allied army for war.
Japan, which has even launched the moves to recover the past war allies by concluding the "agreement on mutual supply of goods and manpower" with Germany and Italy, is now conducting joint drills with the past war criminal states in the sea and air of Japan, as part of its preparations for reinvading other countries any moment
Clear is the true intention of the descendants of samurais to secure an "allied army" for war.
It is aimed at holding a dominant position in strength in the Asian region even with the help of foreign forces and thus realizing the old dream of "dominating the East " at any cost.
Japan, which is rejected and hated by the international community owing to the denial of its past and moves for reviving militarism, is putting spurs to tightening the war alliance to realize its ambition for reinvasion. Such dangerous military move will inevitably invite due vigilance and strong retaliatory will of the Asian countries.
What is clear is that the second defeat to be suffered by Japan again as a tragic result of the reckless reinvasion will not be confined to signing a surrender document.
Today's Asia is not the arena at a time when the "Imperial Japanese Army" ran amuck in invading the continent, staining the flag of the rising sun with blood. The regional countries will never tolerate any behavior of the descendants of samurais dreaming of "dominating the East" in collusion with outside forces. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ho Ok Son, a woman centenarian living in People's Neighborhood Unit No. 3, Taman-ri, Hwadae County, North Hamgyong Province.
After receiving the birthday spread, she extended thanks toKim Jong Un, deeply moved by the warm loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea that respects and puts forward the aged as revolutionary forerunners and seniors and takes good care of them.
She, who keenly felt the value of the country through her bitter life before the liberation of the country, had devoted her sincere efforts of patriotism to farming over several decades with a single mind to repay the benevolence of the country which put her forward as the master of the land and made her enjoy a genuine life.
Many people respect her who has brought up her children well and helped them to make a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country and done good things helpful to the country even after becoming a pensioner. -0-

headline: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- Personages of various circles of different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The editor-in-chief of the organ of the People's Party of Cambodia and other personages of political parties, governments, organizations and institutions including the Communist Party of Germany, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Overseas Compatriots of Equatorial Guinea laid flower baskets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland paid tribute to them.
The secretary general of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia and the secretary of the Chamberlain of the Presidency of Egypt also paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions.
Meanwhile, flower baskets were sent to the DPRK missions by the Committee for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Laos-Korea Friendship Association, the president of the Central Committee of the Lao Federation of Trade Unions, the president of the Central Committee of the Lao Women's Union, the Lao vice-minister of Public Security and others on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The chairman of the Pakistani Organization for the Study of the Juche Idea and the general secretary of the Pakistani Branch of the Network Women's Rights Coordinating Body of the World March of Women sent a congratulatory flower basket in the joint name of them to the DPRK mission. -0-

headline: DPRK Wrestler Bags Gold Medal at World Wrestling Championship
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- Han Chong Song won a gold medal at the 2025 World Wrestling Championship being held in Croatia.
The championship brought together more than 860 men and women ace wrestlers from over 80 countries and regions including the DPRK, Kazakhstan, Germany, Italy and Brazil.
Han Chong Song beat all his rivals in the 57kg category of freestyle wrestling and thus advanced into the final stage.
In the finals held on September 15 (local time), he defeated his Kyrgyzstan rival 12:9 and bagged a gold medal. -0-

headline: Project for Upgrading Taehongdan County Potato-processing Factory Completed

headline: Effective Method of Saving Concrete Bars Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- In recent years, an effective method of saving concrete bars have been introduced into the construction projects, including the building of 50 000 flats in the capital city of Pyongyang, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This method, developed by Pyongyang University of Architecture, is an optimum bar-arrangement method as it ensures the maximum structural safety of the buildings made of reinforced concrete walls in keeping with the specific conditions of the country and saves large quantities of concrete bars.
The university's construction structure research group opened up a prospect of saving concrete bars by 25 to 30 percent as compared with the past.
The innovative method has been introduced into the construction of Hwasong Street as well as Songhwa Street and, as a result, it contributes to saving a lot of manpower and huge quantities of concrete bars.
The introduction of this method made it possible to save over 50 tons of concrete bars in the construction of 35-storeyed apartment house alone. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Kilju County of North Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built in Kilsong-ri, Kilju County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, adding luster to the socialist fairyland.
The modern houses which were built under the warm loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Uninstill confidence in new civilization and new life into the people and give pleasure to them.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place on the spot. Present there were officials in the province and county, builders and agricultural workers who will move into new houses.
At the ceremony an address was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over, to be followed by speeches.
As the agricultural workers began to move into new houses, a cheerful dancing party was given and the new houses were full of happy laughter of the people being convinced of a rosy future that would be better and more prosperous under the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: DPRK Founding Anniversary Marked in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- Celebrations took place in Laos, Myanmar, Pakistan, Germany, Bulgaria, Sweden, Austria, Iceland, France, Finland and Mexico in the period from September 4 to 8 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Present there were personages of governments, parliaments, political parties, organizations and institutions of relevant countries and members of organizations for the study of Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people. Speeches were made there.
The chief of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism praised the DPRK for covering the road of victory and glory under the guidance of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Today the DPRK people are working fresh miracles one after another on the road of the overall development of socialism under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the chief said.
A senator of the Pakistani parliament and figures of the Pakistan Awami National Party, the Pakistan People's Party, the National Party of Pakistan and the Pakistan-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Committee praised President
Kim Il Sungfor putting forward the Korean people as the masters of a dignified, independent and sovereign state.
They said that ChairmanKim Jong Illed the DPRK to advance along the road of socialism, consolidating the single-minded unity of the whole society with the Juche idea as its guideline, and that all the people are advancing toward the future, rallied around the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the chairperson of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association, the chairperson of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and the DPRK, the international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League and the chairperson of the Finland-Korea Society lauded the nation-building exploits ofKim Il Sungand the featsKim Jong Ilperformed for the prosperity of socialist Korea.
They explained that the international position of the DPRK has been enhanced and its might as a world-level military power demonstrated under the leadership of the respected General Secretary.
A member of the Central Executive Committee of the Myanmar Journalist Association said that the high position of the DPRK in the international arena was proved by the fact thatKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, occupied the centre of the platform together with the leaders of Russia and China during the commemorations marking the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War recently held in Beijing.
Congratulatory messages toKim Jong Unwere adopted at the celebrations held in Sweden and Iceland. -0-

headline: Art Souvenir Exhibition Opens in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- An art souvenir exhibition opened in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area successfully built into the Korean-style coastal tourist city and cultural recreation ground of the people on September 17.
The exhibition brought together fine art studios and folk crafts studios in Pyongyang and the regions including the Mansudae Art Studio. Presented to the exhibition were more than 2 500 pieces of 20-odd kinds including Korean painting, oil painting, acryl painting and ceramics reflecting the eye-opening reality, national symbols, 5 000-year-long history and brilliant culture and excellent folk traditions of the country.
During the exhibition there will be exchanges for sharing and generalizing the successes and experience achieved by the relevant units in the course of creating works, and the sale of souvenirs. -0-

New Houses Built in Kilju County of North Hamgyong Province
Sandy Beach in Rungna Water Park
story_text:
One day in May 2012, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unexamined a design for the Rungna Water Park.
Correcting defects in the design, he told officials that there should be a place where people can lie at their ease. And he told them the solution, pointing out spaces in the design.
If the area beside a swimming pool is covered with tiles or paving blocks only, swimmers cannot lie for a rest, he said, adding that it would be good to turn the space between a bathing booth and a swimming pool into a lawn or a sandy beach for the swimmers. In aesthetic terms, a lawn would be ideal, but people would prefer a sandy beach to a lawn when lying for a rest, he noted.
So a sandy beach was included in the design.
Looking up to the tender-hearted image of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho puts the people's convenience above all, the officials vowed to build the water park into a splendid monumental edifice which would resound with the people's happy laughter. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Work of Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Thursday guided the performance test of the unmanned weapons and equipment being developed and produced by an institute and enterprises under the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Complex.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Ri Pyong Chol, general advisor for the munitions policy of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials of the WPK Central Committee and officials in the defence science research field.
He learnt in detail about the performance and combat application of various types of unmanned weapons and equipment including strategic and tactical unmanned surveillance vehicles and multipurpose drones being developed and produced by the institute and enterprises under the UATC.
Clearly proved in the test held on the same day were the military strategic value and innovative performance of the strategic unmanned surveillance vehicle and the excellent combat effectiveness of Kumsong-series tactical attack drones.
Kim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the result of the test.
He said that as he already stressed, the reality, in which the utility range of unmanned equipment is being further expanded in modern warfare and unmanned equipment emerges as a major military activity asset, raises it as a top-priority and important task in modernizing the armed forces of the DPRK to put on a highly-developed basis the core technology of unmanned equipment and the artificial intelligence and operational ability of the unmanned weapons and equipment systems.
He referred to the issues arising in directing primary efforts to rapidly developing the newly-introduced artificial intelligence technology and expanding and strengthening the serial production capacity of drones.
That day he approved and signed a document related to an important plan reflecting an organizational and structural measure for further expanding and strengthening the technological potentialities of the UATC. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Construction of Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm and Work for Regional Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, guided on the spot the construction of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm and the work for regional development on September 18.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Pak Jong Chon, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Jae Ryong, department director of the WPK Central Committee.
He was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the large combined units of the services of the Korean People's Army and the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade involved in the construction and officials of design and relevant institutions.
Thanks to the far-reaching plan and direct guidance of
Kim Jong Unto turn the border area into a thriving area which embodies modern, original and national characters, different types of greenhouses, a vegetable processing factory, storage facilities, scientific and technological research and dissemination bases, trial cultivation greenhouses, dwelling houses and various cultural life bases are being built in a unique way in the vast area of Wihwado, the northwestern part of the country, presenting a magnificent scenery of a record greenhouse farm and the "big farm city".
Kim Jong Unwent round the glass hydroponic greenhouse district, the vegetable science research centre and other places of the construction site to learn in detail about the construction.
Watching a sea change of the area, he expressed satisfaction over it, saying that the might of the service personnel and young people is, indeed, great and the island area which was treated as an barren land only a year ago due to the yearly flood has become a "treasure island" with the great potential to lead the radical development of the regional economy and the improvement of the material life of the people in the region.
Saying that the construction of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm serves as an important occasion of clearly showing once again the higher stage and progressive process of the regional rejuvenation led by the WPK, he stressed that through the change in the area, he is more convinced it is possible to successfully turn all the regions of the country into the people's paradise within ten or twenty years.
He highly appreciated the thoroughgoing spirit of serving the people and efforts of the officers and men of the construction units and young vanguard who are devoting themselves to the eternal prosperity of the country with confidence and courage to change the era with their own efforts and asked the officials to convey to all the builders his special thanks and ardent call for building a monumental edifice demonstrating the eye-opening advance speed and development of Korean-style socialism in the northern part of the country and presenting it to the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Acquainting himself with the construction project for the regional development and its long-term plan, he pointed out a series of deviations.
He said that it is the core requirement of the WPK's policy on regional development to make the regional rejuvenation represent the advance and development of the state and the ideal appearance of regional areas a true picture of socialist Korea, stressing once again that the design sector should put its effort to making a meticulous calculation of economic effectiveness and profitability and applying optimum options while ensuring the functional occupancy and modernity at the stage of designing.
Noting that there should not be any slightest fault in the construction of the Sinuiju General Greenhouse Farm as it is the work the WPK has organized on the largest scale for the independent and diversified development of the regional economy and its result is an important issue directly linked to the improvement of the material life of the regional people, he indicated the detailed tasks and ways for successfully completing the construction of the general greenhouse farm including the issue of conducting the work to put the farm management on an IT and automated basis at a high level, the issue of improving the environment around the construction site in a qualitative way, regarding it as a key record indicator equivalent to the one of the building of facilities or the assembling of equipment and the issue of creating the landscape and overall greening in the district of the permanent embankments in an aesthetic and scientific way.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the soldier-builders and members of the youth shock brigade would give full play to the strong mental power, unflinching executing abilities and enthusiastic fighting spirit peculiar to the revolutionary army and heroic youth in the new era in the construction of the large-scale greenhouse farm and regional development and thus make a report on their proud achievements made in the construction for regional change to the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Construction of Water Pumping Stations Propelled in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province in the DPRK is building a hundred and tens of water pumping stations to irrigate paddy and non-paddy fields of tens of thousands of hectares next year.
The province is directing efforts to creating a model and generalizing it to exchange and share successes and experience and raising the enthusiasm of the masses while supplying workforce, equipment and materials.
Working people in the province involved in the construction are making collective innovations while giving precedence to ensuring quality.
Kaechon City and other cities and counties concluded the construction work of dozens of water pumping stations, and other regions are pushing forward with the construction at the final stage.
The province is expanding successes in building water pumping stations while ensuring normal operation of the existing irrigation facilities. -0-

headline: Education in Patriotism at Youth League Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- Youth league organizations of the DPRK at all levels are conducting education to prepare young people to be successors to the revolution with noble patriotic spirit.

headline: Amnokgang Sports Team
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- The Amnokgang Sports Team that has performed distinguished feats in the sports field of the DPRK marks its founding anniversary.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who put forward the development of sports as an important affair in building a new Korea, took a measure to organize the Interior Bureau Sports Team, the first professional sports organization in the country, on September 19, 1947 with the sportspersons who took part in the First World Festival of Youth and Students as pivots.
The team, which was founded with 30-odd players and coaches, has developed into a prestigious sportspersons' group loved by the people, adding luster to the honor of the country with gold medals under the energetic guidance and care of the peerlessly great persons.
It is an honor and pride of the team that it has produced many meritorious sportspersons including DPRK Hero, Labor Hero and People's Athlete.
Jong Song Ok came first in the women's marathon of the 7th World Track-and Field-Championships, Sin Kum Dan set new world records 11 times in international women's track and field events, and Ri Song Hui and Pak Yong Ok were known as a "woman of great strength" and the star of table tennis at world women's weightlifting and table tennis championships.
The team produced Olympic gold medalists including Ku Yong Jo (men's boxing in 1976), Kim Il (men's freestyle wrestling in 1992 and 1996), Ri Hak Son (men's freestyle wrestling in 1992), Pak Hyon Suk (women's weightlifting in 2008) and Om Yun Chol (men's weightlifting in 2012).
The players and coaches of the team are devoting their wisdom and passion to training with the single mind to contribute to the country's sports development with better successes in games. -0-

headline: Letter of Loyalty Relay Teams Heading for Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 20 (KCNA) -- The relay teams to present letters of loyalty to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unon behalf of all the people across the DPRK are heading for Pyongyang.
The members of the relay teams witnessed the eye-opening development of the country which is changing day by day under the guidance of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea in different parts of the country and the looks of the people who are leading a happy and civilized, new life.
The members of the relay teams of South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provinces toured the regional-industry factories  in Songchon and Jaeryong counties.
Those of the relay teams of North Phyongan Province conducted motivation activities for increased production at the construction site of dwelling houses in Kusong City, inspiring builders with the enthusiasm for the revolution and patriotism.
Those of the relay teams of North Hwanghae, Jagang and Kangwon provinces went round the Jongbangsan General Foodstuff Factory, the regional-industry factories in Tongsin County and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory.
Those of the relay teams of South Hamgyong, North Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces visited various places of Samjiyon City, the Wangjaesan Revolutionary Site, the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and the Ragwon County Offshore Farm.
Those of the relay teams of Nampho and Rason municipalities are running to Pyongyang with letters reflecting the boundless reverence forKim Jong Un, the ardent desire of the people and their pledge of loyalty.
The relay teams of the service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces are also running to Pyongyang.
The relay team of young vanguard is heading for Pyongyang with the revolutionary spirit of the passionate youth. -0-

headline: Wheat Processing Capacity Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 20 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the wheat processing capacity has further increased across the country since the Workers' Party of Korea put forward the policy on changing the country's structure of grain production.
The Kangryong Wheat Processing Factory and the Singye Wheat Processing Factory were built to suit the new era of regional rejuvenation. Wheat processing factories in Haeju, Nampho and Songrim have been remodeled at the higher level. And the wheat processing bases were set up at the grain management stations in different cities and counties according to the wheat output of their regions.
As a result, the nationwide wheat processing capacity has increased by two times since the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK to make a contribution to the improvement of the people's diet.
The Wonsan Wheat Processing Factory is now being successfully renovated on an expanded basis in the east coastal area and the Hamhung Wheat Processing Factory is to be inaugurated in the near future as it is accelerating the projects for its capacity expansion and modernization.
Technical preparations are now underway at the final stage to build the Phyongsong Wheat Processing Factory into a modern one of world level and the city and county grain management stations equipped with combined and integrated facilities and adapted to the characteristics of their regions next year. -0-

headline: Potato Harvest Begins in Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Potato harvest began at the farms in Ryanggang Province, the DPRK.
The province organized the economic work to make preparations for potato harvest in a qualitative way.
Samjiyon City is intensifying the technical guidance so as to conduct potato harvest as scheduled, while giving precedence to evaluating the crop estimate and mobilizing the manpower and mechanical means.
The mechanized workers of all farms in Taehongdan County are taking good care of the machines to attain high results in potato harvest. The Nongsadong and Hongam farms record good results every day amid the competition among farms and workteams.
Paegam County has set a proper time for potato harvest and directed all efforts to the fulfillment of the farming processes. In particular, the county strives for the transportation and storage while giving precedence to harvesting potato in seed fields.
Farms in Pochon, Phungso, Kim Hyong Gwon and Unhung counties and other regions fully mobilize the manpower and means to increase achievements. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Celebrated in Russia
story_text:
