headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
He visited Samjiyon City. He learned about the progress made in the projects, going round the area of Lake Chon on Mt Paektu, the northern area of Mt Phothae, Samjiyon Airport, the Ponnamu Hotel, the Ikkal Hotel and other major construction projects being accelerated under the grandiose plan of the Party Central Committee to turn the area of Mt Paektu into a cultural tourist resort frequented by the DPRK people and foreigners.
He stressed that the construction headquarters should map out plans and guide the work skillfully as required by the Party's Juche-oriented idea on architecture and policy on construction and thoroughly ensure the quality of structures by enhancing the responsibility and role of operators and inspectors and push ahead with the projects as scheduled in line with the seasonal conditions.
Inspecting farms in Pochon and Kapsan counties, he stressed the need to actively introduce the scientific farming methods suited to the characteristics of the regions with high altitude and promote stockbreeding to take advantage of the favorable conditions of mountainous counties.
Acquainting himself with the situation of the Jenam Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, he called for increasing coal and power production in the spirit of self-reliance based on science and technology, raising the proportion of mechanization, lowering the standard of material consumption per unit and rationally using various economic levers to further boost the enthusiasm of the producers.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving top priority to the supply of materials for the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort and making preparations for its operation, the issue of providing equipment and materials necessary for normalizing power and coal production in time and the issue of paying deep attention to improving the living conditions of the builders and employees. -0-

headline: System of Scientific Guidance and Control over Agricultural Production Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- A guarantee for guiding farming in a unified and scientific way was provided in the DPRK thanks to the establishment of the teleconference system and management information system in the agricultural sector, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The infrastructure of information and communications was built up and the scientific guidance and control system was established even in every ri throughout the country, thus making it possible to promptly and correctly grasp the actual conditions of the overall agricultural production of the country and organize and conduct the farming process and management control in a scientific and rational way.
Latest information technologies have been introduced in the agricultural sector.
Such IT products as e-map management program are being introduced and the agricultural sci-tech dissemination homepage "Hwanggumbol" (golden fields) and the agricultural sci-tech service program "Hwanggumyolmae" (golden fruit) are now in use for the dissemination of science and technology and the service of tele-questioning and answering for farming techniques.
The establishment of the system for evaluating the crop estimate across the country by the satellite information analysis and crop growth simulation technologies is making a contribution to putting the agricultural production on a scientific basis. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Anniversary of Formation of Union of Korean Students in Japan Marked in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on September 14 to mark the 80th anniversary of the formation of the Union of Korean Students in Japan.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organizational Department of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Song Sang Gi, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, vice-chairpersons and department directors of the union, officials of the local headquarters and members of the union.
Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organizational Department of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, made a congratulatory speech.
He said that the organization of overseas students just like the Union of Korean Students in Japan, which has covered the road of patriotism for 80 years in the alien land, can not be found anywhere in the world and it is the greatest pride of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan to have such a Juche-oriented traditional organization of overseas students as the Union of Korean Students in Japan.
Song Sang Gi, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Students in Japan, in his report extended the highest glory and warmest thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, who bestowed special loving care and solicitude so that it could significantly celebrate the 80th anniversary of the formation of the union, reflecting the single mind of loyalty of all its officials and members.
Then it was followed by speeches.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
On the same day, a reception was given to mark the 80th anniversary of the formation of the Union of Korean Students in Japan. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
He visited Samjiyon City. He learned about the progress made in the projects, going round the area of Lake Chon on Mt Paektu, the northern area of Mt Phothae, Samjiyon Airport, the Ponnamu Hotel, the Ikkal Hotel and other major construction projects being accelerated under the grandiose plan of the Party Central Committee to turn the area of Mt Paektu into a cultural tourist resort frequented by the DPRK people and foreigners.
He stressed that the construction headquarters should map out plans and guide the work skillfully as required by the Party's Juche-oriented idea on architecture and policy on construction and thoroughly ensure the quality of structures by enhancing the responsibility and role of operators and inspectors and push ahead with the projects as scheduled in line with the seasonal conditions.
Inspecting farms in Pochon and Kapsan counties, he stressed the need to actively introduce the scientific farming methods suited to the characteristics of the regions with high altitude and promote stockbreeding to take advantage of the favorable conditions of mountainous counties.
Acquainting himself with the situation of the Jenam Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, he called for increasing coal and power production in the spirit of self-reliance based on science and technology, raising the proportion of mechanization, lowering the standard of material consumption per unit and rationally using various economic levers to further boost the enthusiasm of the producers.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving top priority to the supply of materials for the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort and making preparations for its operation, the issue of providing equipment and materials necessary for normalizing power and coal production in time and the issue of paying deep attention to improving the living conditions of the builders and employees. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to So In Bae, a woman centenarian living in People's Neighborhood Unit No. 40 of the township of Jaeryong County.
She extended thanks toKim Jong Un, deeply moved by the paternal loving care for an ordinary old woman.
Born into a poor tenant's family, she lived in tears with the sorrow of a stateless nation. She steadily did farming on the land allocated for her with a single mind to repay the benevolence of the country which provided her with the genuine life and dignity, faithful to her duty as an agricultural worker all her life.
She, who experienced through her life the truth that there is the happiness of the family thanks to the grateful Workers' Party of Korea and the socialist system, encouraged her descendants to remain faithful to the country even after becoming a pensioner.
Officials of Jaeryong County and her neighbors visited her family to share joy with her. -0-

headline: Potato Harvest Begins in Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Potato harvest began at the farms in Ryanggang Province, the DPRK.
The province organized the economic work to make preparations for potato harvest in a qualitative way.
Samjiyon City is intensifying the technical guidance so as to conduct potato harvest as scheduled, while giving precedence to evaluating the crop estimate and mobilizing the manpower and mechanical means.
The mechanized workers of all farms in Taehongdan County are taking good care of the machines to attain high results in potato harvest. The Nongsadong and Hongam farms record good results every day amid the competition among farms and workteams.
Paegam County has set a proper time for potato harvest and directed all efforts to the fulfillment of the farming processes. In particular, the county strives for the transportation and storage while giving precedence to harvesting potato in seed fields.
Farms in Pochon, Phungso, Kim Hyong Gwon and Unhung counties and other regions fully mobilize the manpower and means to increase achievements. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of DPRK Celebrated in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Celebration events including seminar, lecture, photo exhibition and film show were held by the Khabarovsk Territorial Branch Committee and the Amur Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Maritime Territorial Branch Council of the Socialist Political Party "For Just Russia-Patriots-Truth", the Rostov Association for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism of Russia, the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the Buryatia's Republic Association for the Study of the Juche Idea and the DPRK on September 7 and 9 to celebrate the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Present at the events were personages of relevant units and other masses.
Screened at the film shows were videos showing the indomitable spirit and mental power of the DPRK people.
The participants in the events revered PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho founded a dignified socialist state and led it to glory and the respected Comrade
Kim Jong Unwho has wisely led the DPRK to defend justice and truth and carry forward the tradition of proud victory. -0-

headline: Chinese Organizations Host Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and the China-Korea Friendship Association jointly hosted a reception in Beijing on September 18 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Present there on invitation were Ri Ryong Nam, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy members.
Present there were Yang Wanming, president of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, and officials concerned of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Association for International Friendly Contact.
Speakers said at the reception that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the celebrations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and provided guidelines for further strengthening the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries through the meeting and talks with Comrade Xi Jinping.
They stressed that it is the steadfast stand of the parties and governments of the two countries to steadily develop the DPRK-China relations.
A performance was given by Chinese artistes at the reception. -0-

headline: Agricultural Science Research Centers under Construction in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, high-tech agricultural science research centers are under construction in different parts of the DPRK.
The command team for building agricultural science research centers finished building the Rice Research Institute and the Agricultural Informatics Institute of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences and several institutes under the Academy of Poultry Science and is dynamically pushing ahead with the construction of other research centers.
The builders involved in the construction of the main institute district of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences are pressing ahead with construction projects of general analysis station, institute for scientific and technological development prospect and hostel for scientists at the finishing stage.
The building of the Orang Branch of the Rice Research Institute and the Kyongsong Branch of the Institute of Pomiculture under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences is nearing the completion in North Hamgyong Province.
In South Phyongan Province, officials and builders are displaying a high sense of responsibility in the construction of the provincial institute of agricultural sciences.
South Hwanghae Province is building the Jaeryong Branch of the Maize Research Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences.
The Cabinet, the State Planning Commission, the Ministry of Finance and other ministries and national agencies are helping the construction of agricultural science research centers.
Meanwhile, the efforts have been directed to procuring research equipment and experimental apparatuses and strengthening the ranks of researchers. -0-

headline: Photo Exhibition Opens in DPRK
Production of Plate Glass at Taean Friendship Glass Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Taean Friendship Glass Factory in the DPRK is increasing the production of plate glass, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The factory finished overhauling the melting furnace ahead of schedule and is striving to attain this year's production goal.
Technicians and workers of the factory have introduced rational technical innovation proposals to cut down the period of overhauling the melting furnace and save a lot of materials.
Meanwhile, the raw materials, hydrogen and nitrogen, electric automation and repair and maintenance workshops repaired equipment of production processes through their mass technological innovation movement.
The factory is producing tens of thousands of square meters of plate glass every day. -0-

headline: Sowing of Winter Wheat and Barley Seeds Starts in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- Sowing of winter wheat and barley seeds began in rural areas of the DPRK.
South Hwanghae Province applied quality organic fertilizer to the farmland which has been increased by hundreds of hectares as compared with last year, and is sowing the seeds as scheduled.
Maengsan, Nyongwon and Yangdok counties in South Phyongan Province have given priority to land treatment and initial manure application just after the maize harvest and increased the operating rate of sowing machines to sow seeds in large areas every day.
Farms in Phihyon, Yomju and Nyongbyon counties of North Phyongan Province have secured high-yielding seeds and conducted drying, disinfection and other seed treatment in a scientific and technological way.
Officials and agricultural workers in Jagang, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces are sowing wheat and barley seeds according to the biological characteristics of the varieties and soil tilt. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Sijung County of Jagang Province
Photo Exhibition Opens in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- A photo exhibition "Epochal entities of regional rejuvenation made in the great era ofKim Jong Un" opened here to show intensively and visually the era of gigantic changes of regions unprecedented in the nation building and the new fairylands of rejuvenation.
On display at the venue of the exhibition is a photo of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unindicating the principled issues arising in regional construction while giving field guidance at the construction site of Samjiyon City.
Exhibited there are more than 630 photos showing the daily-changing appearances of regions including houses of the people, cultural recreation grounds and modern regional-industry factories which have been built in a unique manner while boasting of the architectural beauty peculiar to the regions.
The photo exhibition shows in a vivid way that the epochal changes in regions are the vigorous breathing of the great era ofKim Jong Undynamically advancing toward the comprehensive development of socialism and the image of Juche Korea symbolizing the new cultural efflorescence.
An opening ceremony of the photo exhibition took place at the Okryu Exhibition House on September 21.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Song Chol, vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, officials of ministries and national agencies, and officials and working people of institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang.
Ju Chang Il made an opening address.
The speaker said that through the exhibition, the participants will warmly feel the efforts ofKim Jong Unwho has devoted himself to bringing about remarkable changes in the regions and realize once again how unimaginably the country has changed.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the venue of the exhibition. -0-

headline: Earnest Request
story_text:
One day in July, 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited a foodstuff factory.
He listened to the briefing at the room dedicated to the history of the factory and then went round various production lines of the factory to learn in detail about the state of technical equipment and production.
He looked with satisfaction at various kinds of foodstuffs churned out at the worksites with foodstuff processing equipment standing in rows.
While coming out of the production site of a work-team, he stopped his walking to see a watchword displayed on the door wall on the opposite side.
Written on it was "Self-reliance, Self-sufficiency".
When all the officials were looking up to him, he said that the watchword was the best one that pleased him.
Even looking at a small watchword, he highly appraised the ideological and moral qualities of the officials and employees of the factory determined to achieve everything under the uplifted banner of self-reliance.
He underscored the need to turn the factory into the Juche-based production base that realizes the production with locally raw and other materials by carrying out modernization for putting all the production lines on an automated, unmanned and germ-free basis more perfectly by dint of our technical forces, materials and equipment under the uplifted banner of self-reliance.
His high appraisal reflected the great trust and request of him who wants the officials and working people of the factory to continue giving full play to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance. -0-

headline: 13th Session of 14th Supreme People's Assembly of DPRK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on September 20 and 21.
The session was convened at a time when all the people of the country are further accelerating the general advance to successfully complete all the tasks of the five-year plan for national economic development set forth by the historic Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and greet the 80th founding anniversary of the Party and the Ninth Congress of the Party with eventful successes to be specially recorded in the history of the country.
Present there were deputies to the SPA and, as observers, officials of the Party Central Committee, the SPA Standing Committee, the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs and other officials concerned in Pyongyang and local areas.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK was held.
Deputies to the SPA paid high tribute to the sacred national flag, reflecting their firm pledge to devote themselves to the struggle for staunchly defending the sovereignty of the state and the interests of the people, thoroughly observing the constitution of the Republic and steadfastly safeguarding and further consolidating the socialist system as masters of state affairs and representatives of the people.
Taking the platform were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, and other senior Party, government and military officials, members of the State Affairs Commission, and vice-chairmen, secretary general and members of the SPA Standing Committee.
Before discussing the agenda items, the session recalled the chairman of the SPA.
Deputy Maeng Kyong Il, vice-chairman of the SPA, presided over the session according to the regulations for the operation of the SPA.
When the session was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played.
The 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK brought out the following agenda items:
First, on the deliberation and adoption of the law of the DPRK on grain management
Second, on the deliberation and adoption of the law of the DPRK on intellectual property
Third, on the state of supervision of the enforcement of the law of the DPRK on urban management
Deputy Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, made reports on the first and second agenda items at the session.
The reporter explained the contents of the draft laws according to the chapters, saying that the full-dress SPA session will deliberate and adopt the law of the DPRK on grain management in order to better the grain management directly related to the improvement of the people's diet, true to the Workers' Party of Korea's grain policy.
The draft law on intellectual property stipulates the legal requirements and practical issues arising in hastening the comprehensive national rejuvenation through the steady increase and active use of intellectual creativity by further consolidating the well-regulated system of the state for guiding the intellectual property work and further strengthening the intellectual property protection system, the reporter said.
The SPA Standing Committee submitted the draft law of the DPRK on grain management and the draft law of the DPRK on intellectual property for deliberation at the Supreme People's Assembly.
Deputies Kim Kwang Jin, Kim Son Il, Kim Chol Won and Yun Chun Hwa made speeches on the first agenda item.
The speakers said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, with an insight into the significance and importance of grain management in the struggle to usher in a new era in which regional areas are developing radically and prospering in an all-round and concurrent way as early as possible, took an important measure to include the construction of the city and county grain management stations in the Regional Development 20 x 10 Policy as one of the three essential projects and carry it out with the state taking responsibility. They said that the adoption of the new law on grain management is a legalization of the determination and will of our Party to substantially promote the well-being of the regional people.
They expressed full support to the draft law, saying that it provided a sure legal guarantee for establishing a comprehensive and integrated system of grain management by specifying in detail all issues related to the procurement, storage, processing, supply, sale and consumption of grain.
Deputies Kim Song Bin, Ri Myong Guk, Pang Tu Sop, Pak Myong Ho, Pak Ji Min and Ri Kuk Chol made speeches on the second agenda item. They unanimously recognized that the strengthening of the intellectual property protection system by establishing a well-regulated system and order for intellectual property work is of great significance in encouraging the broad working masses to take part in the technological development and creation with the attitude of a master and bringing substantial benefits to the people, the sci-tech talents who work with knowledge and technology and contribute to social progress and development, and thus raising a hot wind of developing new technologies and new products and increasing the productivity across the country.
Speakers expressed their resolve to make positive contributions to accelerating the socialist economic construction and promoting the development of science, technology and culture by correctly abiding by the requirements of the law on intellectual property to be newly adopted.
The session adopted with unanimous approval ordinances of the DPRK SPA "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Grain Management" and "On adopting the Law of the DPRK on Intellectual Property".
The session discussed the state of supervision of the enforcement of the law of the DPRK on urban management as the third agenda item.
Deputy Ko Kil Son, secretary general of the SPA Standing Committee, made a report to be followed by speeches of deputies Im Kyong Jae, Choe Hui Thae, Choe Myong Su and Jo Kil Nyo.
The report and speeches analyzed and reviewed the reason why the urban management is failing to keep pace with the present situation in which the appearance of the capital city and regional areas, towns and rural areas is undergoing a facelift to meet the requirements of an advanced and highly civilized nation through gigantic creation and changes.
Expressing the will to radically improve and strengthen urban management with innovative working manner and roles, the deputies offered constructive opinions on more thoroughly guaranteeing the enforcement of the law on urban management.
Deputy Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet, made public measures for the presented opinions.
The session adopted with unanimous approval a decision of the SPA of the DPRK "On Thoroughly Executing the Law of the DPRK on Urban Management".
The head of state made an important speech at the second-day sitting of the 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly.
The moment thatKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appeared on the platform to clarify the important policy orientation of the DPRK government, all the deputies raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to him who is ushering in the era of comprehensive prosperity of our state by achieving great victories and epoch-making changes with the noble idea of the people-first principle and extraordinary leadership.
In his speech he expressed thanks to the Supreme People's Assembly for doing its work in a responsible manner on the basis of the mission and authority granted by the constitution, outlined the qualitative successes made in the development of all the national economic sectors in the nine months of this year, made a strict analysis of the trend of the situation on and around the Korean peninsula, and clarified the principled stand of the DPRK government towards the U.S. and the ROK.
He ardently called upon the deputies who have been entrusted with state affairs by the people and who pledged to work for them to make more proactive and devoted efforts to realize the prosperity of the Republic and its people's ideal.
Upon hearingKim Jong Un's speech full of a noble sense of duty for accomplishing the socialist cause and the great spirit of serving the country and the people, all the deputies expressed full support for and approval of the administrative policy of the head of state with enthusiastic applause and cheers.

headline: Sowing of Winter Wheat and Barley Seeds Starts in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- Sowing of winter wheat and barley seeds began in rural areas of the DPRK.
South Hwanghae Province applied quality organic fertilizer to the farmland which has been increased by hundreds of hectares as compared with last year, and is sowing the seeds as scheduled.
Maengsan, Nyongwon and Yangdok counties in South Phyongan Province have given priority to land treatment and initial manure application just after the maize harvest and increased the operating rate of sowing machines to sow seeds in large areas every day.

headline: Photo Exhibition Opens in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- A photo exhibition "Epochal entities of regional rejuvenation made in the great era ofKim Jong Un" opened here to show intensively and visually the era of gigantic changes of regions unprecedented in the nation building and the new fairylands of rejuvenation.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on September 21.
The message said:
I express thanks to comrade general secretary for sending warm congratulations and sincere wishes on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
When I participated in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and had a meaningful meeting with comrade general secretary during my recent visit to the People's Republic of China, I could feel well enough the invariable support and special friendly feelings of the Chinese Party, government and people towards our Party, government and people.
It is the steadfast stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to further strengthen and develop the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and China as required by the times.
We believe that the DPRK together with the Chinese comrades would more vigorously promote the development of the DPRK-China friendly relations in the common struggle for accomplishing the socialist cause and thus provide the peoples of the two countries with greater welfare.
I wish the Chinese people greater success in the course of successfully fulfilling the 14th Five-Year Plan and building a modern socialist state in an all-round way under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with comrade general secretary as its core. -0-

Rodong Sinmun on Mobilizing All Forces and Means for Concluding This Year's Farming
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Tuesday in an editorial says that whether the achievements in socialist construction are expanded into greater ones or not mainly depends on the success of this year's farming.
Only when we have a lot of rice, can we defend socialism and push ahead with the revolution and construction as we desire, the editorial says, and goes on:
Steadfast is the will of the Workers' Party of Korea to make hurrah for the Workers' Party and socialism resound from the dinner tables of the people.
Thanks to the sincere efforts made on all the fields in spring and summer, the crop looks good and the prospect for attaining the grain production goal planned for this year is bright.
All forces and means should be mobilized for harvesting and threshing.
All the officials, Party members and other working people should make redoubled efforts to successfully conclude this year's farming and thus glorify this year as an eye-opening year, a year of great turn that brings about an upward trend towards a higher stage of development by making the proud success in grain production.
Success in concluding this year's farming largely depends on the role of officials in the agricultural sector.
Farms should organize harvesting and threshing in a rational way and conduct the agricultural production and management activities, including managing manpower, equipment and materials, in a responsible manner.
It is important to push forward with harvesting, threshing and procurement simultaneously.
The agricultural workers are the masters of farming.
They should become patriotic peasants who work hard on every field to repay the Party's loving care with high-yielding successes, not those who only shed tears of gratitude.
The whole country should actively help conclude this year's farming.
The editorial calls on all the people to redouble their confidence and efforts and wage a dynamic struggle to successfully finish this year's farming, thus glorifying 2025 with the proud success in increased production on the agricultural front. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Pyongyang General Hospital Nearing Inauguration
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Pyongyang General Hospital nearing its inauguration on September 23.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ju Chang Il, Kim Jae Ryong and Kim Yong Su, department directors of the Central Committee of the WPK, and officials in the field of public health.
He was greeted on the spot by leading members of the hospital and construction and design units.
He went round various places of the hospital including the image diagnosis department, emergency department, general experimental test department, specialized treatment departments such as dental department and internal intensive treatment department, general operating room, inpatient ward, conference hall and helipad.
Saying that we have paid deep attention to ensuring that architectural aspects, ranging from design to all spatial environments, in hospital construction can be beneficial to the treatment of the physical and mental health of people, he noted that it is important to provide the patients with mentally and psychologically stable environment and conditions for treatment as treatment and recuperation are main in the hospital. He appreciated that the interior and exterior of the hospital are unique and refined in the architectural aspect and various colors are well combined with in a way to raise the visibility and formative beauty, thus giving modern and comfortable feelings.
Learning in detail about the interior finish of the hospital and preparations for medical service, he said that the primary attention has been paid to ensuring the smooth medical treatment plan, ranging from the layout of facilities and composition of space to the flow relation and the plane structure of individual rooms, and it is a great development made in our design field. He made a satisfactory appreciation of the fact that the functionality and specialization level of the hospital are high and the spatial and functional connectivity is ensured wonderfully.
The hospital facilities and treatment equipment should be good, but the important thing is the forces for medical service, he said, adding that as there is a saying that the treatment hinges on medicine and mind, the main thing in the treatment is the high level of medical practices and sincerity of a doctor in charge of a patient. He gave an instruction to make all the medical workers and nurses well prepared to devote their all to the treatment with warm human love as well as professional qualifications.
Saying that three modern city and county hospitals are to be inaugurated at the end of this year and the beginning of the next year and 20 regional hospitals to be built every year from next year, pursuant to the Party's policy on regional development, he stressed that Pyongyang General Hospital should play a key and leading role for sure in implementing the Party's policy on healthcare revolution intended to rebuild and dramatically develop the country's public health on an advanced basis.
He clarified a series of important tasks such as the issues of renewing some architectural styles in future hospital design, working out the detailed one for every element according to the long-term development plan and exactly predicting and reflecting the future demands and changes in it.
He said that it is needed to build an advanced and efficient digital medical service network and medical treatment system in city and county hospitals like Pyongyang General Hospital which put the whole course of its management and medical service on an IT and intellectual basis. He noted it is important to establish a nationwide public health and medical service infrastructure comprising central hospitals and provincial, city and county hospitals as well as individual families.
He added that we would study a series of important issues for further strengthening the foundations of the country's public health including the issue of setting up such essential medical treatment organs as emergency stations between city and county hospitals and ri clinics according to the population density and geographical and traffic conditions under the supervision of the relevant policy-oriented guidance department of the Party Central Committee in the future.
He referred to the complicated problems occurred in the course of the construction of Pyongyang General Hospital since the day of its groundbreaking ceremony.
He said that the main reason why its construction was delayed compared to the others was disorder in organizing the economic work due to the desire for fame sought by some leading officials of the then Cabinet and the officials of the then coordination commission for the construction of Pyongyang General Hospital, which resulted in the creation of the artificial obstacle inside the country, even though it was affected by the objective factor caused by the global health crisis.
He noted that, in those days, they pushed ahead with the construction at their own discretion without the approval of the total budget for construction reflecting the hospital scale and the change in design while neglecting the financial discipline of the state, and thus brought economic losses. The more serious problem was that they set up even an organization in the form of aid panel at will and conducted the campaign of fund-raising and aid across the country, he said, adding that it was led to a serious political problem of distorting the original intention of the Party, which initiated a glorious and worthwhile project for the people with sincerity in order to realize its cherished desire.
He said that the people-oriented character of this work initiated by our Party was almost to be misled and the prestige of the Party undermined due to the politically very immature people who failed to discern the purpose and character of this construction plan which the Party designated as its cherished desire and the fame-seekers who thought of being praised for their share by poking their noses in the construction to which the Party pays direct attention and gives importance. Among the officials who had done such an unreasonable act at that time were former senior officials of the Organizational Leadership Department of the Party Central Committee, who were politically responsible for the construction coordination commission, he said, adding that in order to recover the political loss caused by the fame-seeking individual officials who regarded their names more important than the Party's policy, we had to take a special measure inevitably and separately to pay all the funds back in December last year to the units and residents who offered aid funds to the construction of the hospital.
He said that the wrong practices and complications revealed in the course of the hospital construction resulted in its delay for one and a half years and this is a simple example showing the undisciplined practices in economic work, subjective desire of officials and their immaturity in political guidance still latent in the state. It presented the necessity to further increase the political preparedness of leading officials of the Party and government and gave a serious lesson related to the vacuum in our work, he added.
Saying that the political significance and innovative might of the construction are incomparably increasing in the course of our struggle to advance from a revolution to a more gigantic one and from a stage of development to a higher level of transformation, he stressed we should bear in mind that however difficult and hard it may be at present, every edifice created by dint of self-reliance should be the precious wealth of happy and comfortable life for our people and posterity and a substantial asset for the national development.
Noting that hospital, a functional building which requires highly strict and specialization level compared to any other fields, can be called an aggregation of architectural technology, he indicated in detail the ways for eliminating shortcomings revealed in the construction of the general hospital and its preparations for medical service.
He said that we should develop designs of public health facilities before anything else in order to put the country's public health sector, which was lagging behind the other fields, on the level of the world. To this end, organizing the design institute specializing in the architectural designs, ranging from the central hospitals to the city and county hospitals, clinics and pharmacies, presents itself as a primary issue, he said and indicated organizational and structural measures for it.
Expressing his pleasure of greeting the day when the one of the cherished desires is to be realized in the long run, he said with pride that the foundations of country's public health will experience fundamental change if modern hospitals rise up in over 200 cities and counties across the country in the future and Pyongyang General Hospital will be splendidly recorded in the history of the new era of the country's construction as a monumental entity symbolic of the first year of the healthcare revolution led by our Party and the first substantial starting point of the public health rejuvenation.
Noting that Pyongyang General Hospital is a present our Party gives to the people on the occasion of its founding day, he gave detailed instructions related to its inaugural ceremony. -0-

headline: Taedonggang Syringe Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- The Taedonggang Syringe Factory in the outskirts of Pyongyang produces various kinds of syringes and instillators.
The factory which contributes to the preventive and curative medical care for the people is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
One day in September 2016,Kim Jong Unvisited the Taedonggang Syringe Factory. Saying that the factory had a very important duty, he noted that it should strive to keep the production going at a high rate, thoroughly ensure the quality of products and diversify syringes.
Noting that the level of medical service largely depends on how to provide medical appliances, the main means of preventive and curative medical care, he said that the Workers' Party of Korea would take necessary measures to produce quality syringes and instillators for the people in greater numbers.
True to the noble intention of the Party, the factory has put production lines on an automated, assembly-line, germ-free and dust-free basis and optimized technical engineering problems arising in the production of needles to produce quality medical appliances.
In those days, the factory won the title of the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag, and the lines for producing syringes, needles and instillators were awarded the state's GMP authentication.

headline: Taedonggang Syringe Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- The Taedonggang Syringe Factory in the outskirts of Pyongyang produces various kinds of syringes and instillators.
The factory which contributes to the preventive and curative medical care for the people is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
One day in September 2016,Kim Jong Unvisited the Taedonggang Syringe Factory. Saying that the factory had a very important duty, he noted that it should strive to keep the production going at a high rate, thoroughly ensure the quality of products and diversify syringes.
Noting that the level of medical service largely depends on how to provide medical appliances, the main means of preventive and curative medical care, he said that the Workers' Party of Korea would take necessary measures to produce quality syringes and instillators for the people in greater numbers.
True to the noble intention of the Party, the factory has put production lines on an automated, assembly-line, germ-free and dust-free basis and optimized technical engineering problems arising in the production of needles to produce quality medical appliances.
In those days, the factory won the title of the Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag, and the lines for producing syringes, needles and instillators were awarded the state's GMP authentication.
Hypodermic sterile syringes for single use and needles were estimated as the best domestic products, and the December 15 Quality Medal and the certificate were conferred on the products. -0-

headline: Immortal Exploits of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un for Development of Juche-Oriented Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 25 (KCNA) -- The law on the enforcement of the universal 12-year compulsory education was promulgated at the Sixth Session of the Twelfth Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK in September 2012.
The enforcement of the universal 12-year compulsory education, an important measure taken in reflection of the noble outlook of the Workers' Party of Korea on the rising generations, was a revolution in the building of education in the new century and a great event demonstrating once again the advantages of the Korean socialist system before the world.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who started the education revolution in the new century with the enforcement of the universal 12-year compulsory education, set forth the tasks for turning the DPRK into an educational power and a talent power on several occasions.
He also took a series of measures of the Party and the state to develop school education and continued his field guidance at the educational sector.
During the past ten-odd years, progress has been made in successfully enforcing the universal 12-year compulsory education.
At senior middle schools, the system of selecting curriculums and subjects was enforced on a trial basis, innovations have been made in writing teaching materials according to educational programme and the contents and methods of education have been put on a concrete, diverse and practical basis.
Many schools, branches and kindergartens have been built or renovated on the level of a model and multi-functional classrooms have been built. Successes have been made in putting the whole courses of teaching and experiment and practice on a modern and IT basis.
The factories which specialize in the production of school uniforms, bags, shoes and school things including the Mindulle Notebook Factory were built in Pyongyang and provinces. As a result, a system of supplying school uniforms, bags, shoes and school things to students on a regular basis was set up across the country.
Becoming the parents of students, all the people have sent building materials, educational equipment, teaching aids and experiment and practical equipment necessary for the school construction and education, thus further strengthening the material foundation of the educational sector.
The DPRK is advancing more dynamically toward brighter and rosier future as it holds in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who has performed the immortal exploits along with the history of the development of Juche-oriented education. -0-

headline: Examining Quality of Product to Be Used by People
story_text:
One day in June 2018, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Uncalled an official of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
When the official arrived, the respected General Secretary told him about the men's lotion of the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory he had seen during the daytime and appreciated that it was well made.
The official who accompanied his field guidance at the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory was surprised.
When the respected General Secretary was looking round the factory, he personally put on his hands the after-shaving lotion at the sample room and said that its flavour and packaging are good, expressing his satisfaction.
He had been examining the quality of the product for several hours since he left the factory.
Looking up to the respected General Secretary, who personally examines and highly appreciates the quality of the new product to be used by the people, the official again realized with what stand and attitude the officials should work for the people. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Excavators for Rural Construction in Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 25 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province in the northern part of the DPRK is being steadily transformed thanks to the successful implementation of the policy on regional development in the new era and the programme for the rural revolution set forth by the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who is always paying deep attention to the work to turn Ryanggang Province, where the birthplace of the revolution is located, into a land of bliss where all blessings on the people come true, showed the great loving care of sending equipment for the rural construction in the cities and counties of the province.
He took measures to make hurrah for socialism sound from the first village at the foot of Mt Paektu and dispatch battalions of Party members from the capital city and regions to the province so as to push ahead with the rural construction in the province. And he sent excavators again to the cities and counties of the province to more dynamically promote the regional construction there.
It reflects the special trust and expectations of the great Party Central Committee that wants the people in the province to take the lead in the sacred and worthwhile struggle to usher in a new era of regional rejuvenation, in which people and mountains and streams are changing beyond recognition, bearing deep in mind the great honor and pride of living in the historic place.
The officials and working people in the province, who received the construction equipment provided under the care of the Party, were filled with deep reverence forKim Jong Unwho clearly indicated the orientation and ways so that the rural construction in the province is carried out on a high level and showed great loving care again.
All the officials and working people in Ryanggang Province are full of enthusiasm to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the general advance toward the 80th anniversary of the founding of the Party and the Ninth Congress of the WPK with the ever-growing great benevolence ofKim Jong Unas the driving force for performing miracles. -0-

headline: Reception Given by Chinese Ambassador to DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 26 (KCNA) -- Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at his embassy on September 25 on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China.
Present there on invitation were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Ryu Un Hae, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, officials concerned and members of the diplomatic corps here.
Present there were members of the Chinese embassy and Chinese guests staying here.
Wang Yajun made a speech at the reception.
Noting that the birth of new China strengthened the forces of global peace, democracy and socialism, he said that the PRC is dynamically advancing along the road of happiness of the people and prosperity of the nation under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.
The traditional China-DPRK friendship continues to record a new chapter, he said, adding that the Chinese side, together with the DPRK side, has the willingness to thoroughly implement the important joint understanding achieved by the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and make greater progress in the China-DPRK relations.
He expressed the belief that the DPRK people would win a new and greater victory in the course of promoting the Korean-style socialist cause in the future under the wise leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Next, Kang Yun Sok made a speech.
Noting that the founding of the PRC was an event that brought about a radical turn in the development of China's history, he said that the Chinese nation has waged a vigorous struggle to build a socialist society with the Chinese characteristics for the past 76 years, thus increasing the comprehensive national power and international prestige of the country.
The DPRK-China friendship, which was provided and strengthened in the struggle for accomplishing the common cause, is now being developed as required by the new era thanks to the direct interest and wise leadership of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, he stressed.
He expressed the stand to make joint efforts with the Chinese comrades to develop the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations in line with the noble intention of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries in the future, too.
The participants toasted the good health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the esteemed Comrade Xi Jinping, the prosperity of the PRC and the steady development of the DPRK-China relations of friendship and cooperation. -0-

headline: Great Leadership for Change in Grain Production Structure of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 26 (KCNA) -- A great change in the grain production structure of the DPRK is taking place at a time when modern dwellings are being built in all the rural areas and a new history of irrigation written amid the efforts to implementing the programme for the rural revolution in a new era.
At the Fifth Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK in September 2021, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the plan to boldly change the distribution of crops and switch over to rice, wheat and barley farming, stressing the need to provide the people with rice and flour and thus create the conditions for improving their diet in a civilized way.
At the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea held a few months later, he clarified again the grand plan and taught the ways to push ahead with the rice and wheat farming.
At the subsequent plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee, he underscored the need to press ahead with wheat farming and increase the per-hectare yield. He took measures to qualitatively finish sowing winter wheat and barley seeds in the right time by concentrating efforts and means and took effective steps to promote the growth of wheat and barley.
Our Party's policy on changing crop distribution is displaying tremendous vitality.
By August last year, the national wheat production plan was overfulfilled by more than 40 percent and over 140 farms produced more than 6 tons of wheat per hectare. Over the last four years, the nationwide area of wheat cultivation has increased by more than three times and the output by over four times.
The Haeju and Nampho wheat processing factories and other large-capacity wheat processing factories, which have been modernized under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, have produced a lot of wheat flour and the wheat processing equipment at farms is operating at full capacity to grind wheat into flour and make wheat noodles.
In reality in which a new life and culture are brought into full bloom along with a bumper wheat crop, our people cherish the truth that the Party's policy on wheat farming is science and victory. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Vietnamese Party Leader and President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and Luong Cuong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on September 26.
The message said:
We express heartfelt thanks to you, Comrade, the party, government and people of the DPRK on behalf of the Vietnamese party, state and people and on our own behalf for sending a congratulatory message of best wishes on the occasion of the 80th national day of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
The Vietnamese party, state and people hope to more substantially and effectively develop the traditional friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK in the interests of the peoples of the two countries in order to contribute to maintaining peace, stability, cooperation and development environment in the region and the rest of the world.
We express the conviction that the two countries will successfully organize a plenty of significant events to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations and "2025, the year of Vietnam-DPRK friendship" according to the will and determination of the top leaders of Vietnam and the DPRK and through the joint efforts of ministries, departments and sectors of the two countries, thus contributing to more substantially and effectively developing the traditional friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK in the future.
Availing ourselves of this opportunity, we wish you, Comrade, good health and greater success in your noble work.
We wish that the DPRK would prosper and develop day by day and the Korean people achieve greater successes in the cause of socialist construction. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un meets scientists and technicians in nuclear field and guides important consultative meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met scientists and technicians in the nuclear field including the Nuclear Weapons Institute and guided an important consultative meeting related to the production of nuclear materials and weapons on September 26.
Present at the meeting was Hong Sung Mu, first deputy department director of the WPK Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlistened to a report on the implementation of the plan for 2025 to increase the capacity of the nuclear-material production field and learned about the recent work and major production activities of the Nuclear Weapons Institute.
Saying that the nuclear-material production field and the Nuclear Weapons Institute thoroughly carried out two tasks according to the new important strategy set forth by our Party, he noted with great satisfaction that as a result, major problems in highly developing the country's nuclear capability were perfectly solved.
After acquainting himself with the scale of the next year plan and development prospect of the nuclear-material production field and the Nuclear Weapons Institute, he said that he highly appreciates with pleasure the ever-growing nuclear technology forces of the DPRK and their increased capabilities. He added that having such strategic nuclear technological potentials is a great encouragement to our Party and a reliable guarantee for the struggle of our people, the victorious advance of our cause and the security of the future.
As he clarified at the 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly a few days ago, the logic of keeping peace and security by force with a powerful deterrent, namely nuclear forces, as its backbone is the invariable stand of the DPRK, he said. He declared that steadily evolving the state's nuclear response posture is an essential top priority task in view of the security environment of the Republic, the most right choice for the present and future of the state and an unchangeable duty that we must carry out.
Saying that we should constantly strengthen and upgrade the nuclear shield and sword capable of reliably defending the security of the sovereignty, interests and right to development of the state, he noted that to this end, the WPK and the DPRK government will give top priority to providing and supporting every possibility and condition to the nuclear technology field for its sustained development.
Underlining the need for all the experts in the nuclear technology field to be well aware of the essence of our Party's line on increasing the nuclear forces and greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with outstanding research successes and proud results of increased production, he indicated important tasks for steadily and highly developing the self-defensive nuclear capabilities of the country. -0-

headline: Promising Tourist Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) -- Today (September 27) is World Tourism Day.
In the DPRK, mountain and coastal tourism is a promising tourist industry.
The mountain area accounts for nearly 80 percent of the territory and its east and west sides are bordered by sea, so mountain and coastal tourist resources are abundant.
In particular, the grand nature in the area of Mt Paektu is a proud tourist resource.
There are Mts Kumgang, Myohyang, Chilbo, Kuwol and many other famous mountains and scenic spots including Majon and Yombunjin.
The DPRK government pays deep attention to developing the tourist industry to make our people enjoy a more civilized life to their heart's content, and boost many-sided exchange and cooperation with other countries.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unindicated the orientation for developing the country's tourism at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and other major Party meetings and during his field guidance.
He saw to it that tourist resorts and tourist service facilities were built in all scenic spots of the country, and guided thousands of layouts while visiting major tourist areas under construction.
The Munsu Water Park, the Masikryong Ski Resort, the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, the national treasure-level Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area and other wonderful tourist service facilities were built in different parts of the country, and the construction of the Paektusan Tourist Cultural Area is progressing apace under the care of the state.
The DPRK joined the World Tourism Organization in September 1987. -0-

headline: Greetings to DPRK Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received messages of greeting from the foreign ministers of different countries on the occasion of the  77th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
They included the foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, the foreign minister of the Russian Federation, the foreign minister of the Republic of Cuba, the acting foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, the deputy prime minister and minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Kingdom of Cambodia, the foreign minister of the Republic of Philippines, the foreign minister of the Republic of Azerbaijan, the foreign minister of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, the foreign minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the foreign minister of the Republic of Indonesia, the foreign minister of the Czech Republic, the deputy prime minister and foreign minister of the Republic of Poland, the foreign minister of the Republic of San Marino, the foreign minister of the Republic of Serbia, the minister of state and concurrently minister of foreign affairs, overseas compatriots and African affairs of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria and the foreign minister of the People's Power of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela.
In the messages they warmly congratulated the 77th founding anniversary of the DPRK and expressed expectation and belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between countries would grow stronger. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Scientists and Technicians in Nuclear Fields and Guides Important Consultative Meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met scientists and technicians in the nuclear fields such as the DPRK Nuclear Weapons Institute and guided an important consultative meeting related to the production of nuclear materials and weapons on September 26.
Present at the meeting were Hong Sung Mu, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlistened to a report on the implementation of the plan to increase the capacity of the nuclear-material production field for 2025 and learned about the recent work and considerable production activities of the Nuclear Weapons Institute.
Saying that the nuclear-material production field and the Nuclear Weapons Institute thoroughly carried out two tasks according to new important strategy set forth by our Party, he noted that as a result, the main links in highly developing the country's nuclear capability were perfectly solved. He expressed great satisfaction over it.
After acquainting himself with the scale of the next year plan and development prospect of the nuclear-material production field and the Nuclear Weapons Institute, he said that he highly appreciates with pleasure the ever-growing nuclear technology forces of the DPRK and their increased capabilities. He added that having such strategic nuclear technological potentials is a great encouragement to our Party and a reliable guarantee for the struggle of our people, the victorious advance of our cause and the security of the future.
As he clarified at the 13th Session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly a few days ago, the powerful deterrent, namely, the logic of peace-keeping and security by force with nuclear forces as its backbone is the invariable stand of the DPRK, he said. He declared that steadily stepping up the preparations for the state's nuclear counteraction is an essential top priority task in view of the security environment of the Republic, the most right choice for the present and the future of the state and an unchangeable duty that we must carry out.
Saying that we should constantly strengthen and upgrade the nuclear shield and sword capable of reliably defending the security of the national sovereignty, interests and right to development of the state, he noted that to this end, the WPK and the DPRK government will give top priority to providing and supporting the every possibility and condition to the nuclear technology field for its sustained development.
Underlining the need for all the experts in the nuclear technology field to be well aware of the essence of our Party's line on increasing the nuclear forces and greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with outstanding research successes and proud results in increased production, he indicated important tasks for steadily and highly developing the self-defensive nuclear capabilities of the country. -0-

headline: New-type Geophysical Prospecting Instrument Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, officials and technicians of the Central Geophysical Prospecting Group have developed new-type geophysical prospecting instrument to improve the prospecting of nonferrous metal minerals.
It is said that the instrument is greatly conducive to bringing light to an ore body at the depth of hundreds of meters, one of the knotty problems at mines.
As the trial field operation of the instrument proved its high prospecting accuracy, it is attracting the great interest of experts. -0-

headline: Emulation for Increased Production and Quality Improvement of Products Brisk in DPRK

Turfing Methods Associated with Patriotism of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2025.09.28.]
story_text:
One day in September 2012, the respected ComradeKim Jong Ungave precious instructions on the overall work of the country to officials. At that time he talked about turfing.
Saying that turfing does not merely mean sowing of seeds after removing weeds, he personally briefed on its method.
After a while, he said that good result is unthinkable without efforts. He added that he personally turfed a lawn and took care of it in such a way as to tend a flowerpot while conducting various experiments in order to put our country in good species of turfs.
The officials were deeply moved by his remark.
The turfing methods taught by him were not those written in books but the experience and secret he had acquired in planting and cultivating turf.
The turfing methods applied in the DPRK are associated with his patriotism and noble sincerity to make the land of the country greener and more beautiful. -0-

headline: DPRK SPA Standing Committee Decides to Proclaim Amnesty
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 28 (KCNA) -- The Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea decided to grant an amnesty to those who have been convicted of committing crimes against the country and the people on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
The amnesty shall be proclaimed from October 1, 2025.
The DPRK Cabinet and relevant organs will take practical measures to enable those freed under the terms of the amnesty to settle down in their work and life.
A relevant decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK was released on September 26.
The decree stressed that it is the steadfast will of the WPK and the DPRK government to build the most powerful country where all dreams and ideals of the people come true by dint of the single-minded unity, the irresistible force of Juche Korea, regarding the absolute trust of the people in the Party as the greatest treasure of the revolution. -0-

Wonsan Kalma Cooking Festival-2025 Closes in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 28 (KCNA) -- The Wonsan Kalma Cooking Festival-2025 closed in the DPRK.
On display at the venue for the festival were various dishes prepared by public catering establishments across the country, and advanced technical experience was widely shared.
The famous dishes of cooks from Okryu Restaurant and Changgwang General Restaurant attracted the visitors' attention as they preserved well their own tastes and nutritive value and showed the daily-developing culinary culture and cookery of the country.
Highly appreciated were dishes of the Phyongchon District General Restaurant, the Sosong District General Restaurant and other public catering establishments in Pyongyang.
Cooks from North and South Hamgyong provinces presented dishes preserving local characteristics.
Various dishes and drinks prepared by the Kalmaegi Hotel, Kalma Taesong Hotel and other public service establishments in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area revved up the festive atmosphere.
Attracting visitors' attention were the demonstration and the instant food service contest of cooks and waiters and waitresses.
Officials concerned, cooks, waiters and waitresses were present at the closing ceremony held on September 27.
At the closing ceremony, the result of the jury was announced and diplomas were conferred on the highly appreciated units and participants. -0-
