headline: Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- The Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory is located in the picturesque area of Mt Ryongak in Pyongyang.
The Ryongaksan Spring Water is called the one for longevity from olden times as it is famous for its good taste, contains various kinds of minerals and major ions beneficial to people's health and has a great effect on the treatment of various kinds of diseases.
The Ryongaksan Spring Water being supplied to the Pyongyang citizens is associated with the paternal love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the people.
One day in September 2016, he visited the remodeled Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory and looked round various production lines to learn in detail about the production and hygienic safety of spring water.
He expressed satisfaction over the fact that the spring water in different containers was being streamed out of the production lines that put all the processes including the provision of containers and forwarding process on an automated, streamlined and unmanned basis.
Saying that the duty and role of the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory is important, he set forth the tasks facing the factory, including the issue of normalizing production at a high level and the issue of taking necessary measures to transport the produced spring water in time, and took measures for their implementation.
True to his noble intention, the factory doubled the spring water yield, put the production lines on a germ-free and dust-free basis and established an integrated production system.
This year the factory has upgraded the spring water production lines and won quality certification for its products. It is supplying quality spring water to the citizens on a regular basis. -0-

headline: DPRK FM Choe Son Hui Holds Talks with Chinese FM Wang Yi
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing on Sept. 28.
Choe Son Hui said that the historic exploits of the PRC and its present international position and overall national power were fully demonstrated through the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
She said that the meeting and talks between the top leaders held at a crucial time, when great changes are taking place in the internal and external circumstances of the two countries and the international situation, provided the main orientation and important guidelines for developing the DPRK-China relations in conformity with the changing situation and the requirements of the times.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the friendly feelings between the DPRK and China cannot change no matter how the international situation may change and that it is the steadfast stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to further strengthen and develop the traditional DPRK-China relations of friendship and cooperation as required by the times, she noted.
She expressed the stand to make positive efforts for developing in depth the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations in the spirit of the DPRK-China summit meeting and talks.
She hoped that the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 20th Central Committee of the CPC would be successfully held and that the Chinese people would achieve great successes in the struggle to push ahead with the cause of building a powerful nation and achieving national prosperity in an all-round way under the leadership of the CPC with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core.
Wang Yi said that Choe Son Hui's visit is the first visit to China by the DPRK high-level delegation after the meeting of the top leaders of the two countries held on the occasion of the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, adding that General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unmet after six years and set forth the orientation and blueprint for developing the relations between the two countries on a new high stage.
It is necessary to strengthen strategic communication between the two sides, promote mutual visits and cooperation and jointly defend regional peace and stability, regarding the common understanding of the top leaders of the two countries as the basic guidelines, he said.
Noting that the China-DPRK friendship provided and developed by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries is a precious common wealth of the two countries, he stressed that it is the consistent and steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the traditional China-DPRK friendship.
He expressed expectation that the current visit would mark an occasion in defending the common interests of the two countries and further strengthening the bilateral relations in conformity with the important common understanding achieved by the top leaders of the two countries.
At the talks there exchanged in-depth opinions related to international and regional issues and reached a full consensus of views on them.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were the party of the foreign minister and DPRK Ambassador to China Ri Ryong Nam, and from the Chinese side officials of the Chinese Foreign Ministry including Vice-Minister Sun Weidong. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Myong Ho, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 15, Tongchon-ri, Cholsan County, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK.
She, who was subjected to humiliation and insult before the liberation of Korea, keenly experienced the gratitude of the Workers' Party of Korea which put forward her as the master of the land and the country after the liberation of the country.
She had fulfilled her duty as an agricultural worker for decades and, even after becoming a pensioner, she has done good things helpful to the country.
Officials of the Cholsan County Committee of the WPK and villagers visited the family of the centenarian to congratulate her. -0-

headline: Foundations of Finishing Building Materials Production Reinforced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the DPRK provinces are laying the foundations for producing finishing building materials needed for regional construction.
South Hwanghae Province has established the processes for producing paints and plastic tubes and put the production of finishing building materials on a normal footing.
North Hwanghae Province built a new tile production base by introducing the successes and experience gained by building materials production units.
South Hamgyong Province set a goal of modernizing the Songchongang Tile Factory and other finishing building materials production units and provided them with high-performance moulding machines and raw materials sorters for their increased production capacity.
North Hamgyong Province has added the capacity of producing various kinds of finishing building materials to the existing finishing building materials production base.
The Kanggye Building Materials Factory and other building materials production units in Jagang Province are exploring sources of raw materials and improving quality, thus making a lot of finishing building materials with locally available materials.
Finishing building materials production units in Kangwon, South Phyongan and other provinces have produced dozens of kinds of finishing building materials with locally available raw materials, thus opening up a prospect for fully supplying finishing building materials needed for regional construction. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- The agricultural workers in Janggyo-ri, Kangnam County of Pyongyang Municipality have greeted again the ceremony for moving into new houses this year.
Peculiar dwelling houses built in the suburbs of the capital city are the happy places of agricultural workers provided by the great programme for the rural revolution in a new era.

headline: DPRK FM Choe Son Hui Holds Talks with Chinese FM Wang Yi
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing on Sept. 28.
Choe Son Hui said that the historic exploits of the PRC and its present international position and overall national power were fully demonstrated through the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
She said that the meeting and talks between the top leaders held at a crucial time, when great changes are taking place in the internal and external circumstances of the two countries and the international situation, provided the main orientation and important guidelines for developing the DPRK-China relations in conformity with the changing situation and the requirements of the times.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the friendly feelings between the DPRK and China cannot change no matter how the international situation may change and that it is the steadfast stand of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to further strengthen and develop the traditional DPRK-China relations of friendship and cooperation as required by the times, she noted.
She expressed the stand to make positive efforts for developing in depth the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations in the spirit of the DPRK-China summit meeting and talks.
She hoped that the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the 20th Central Committee of the CPC would be successfully held and that the Chinese people would achieve great successes in the struggle to push ahead with the cause of building a powerful nation and achieving national prosperity in an all-round way under the leadership of the CPC with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core.
Wang Yi said that Choe Son Hui's visit is the first visit to China by the DPRK high-level delegation after the meeting of the top leaders of the two countries held on the occasion of the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, adding that General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unmet after six years and set forth the orientation and blueprint for developing the relations between the two countries on a new high stage.
It is necessary to strengthen strategic communication between the two sides, promote mutual visits and cooperation and jointly defend regional peace and stability, regarding the common understanding of the top leaders of the two countries as the basic guidelines, he said.
Noting that the China-DPRK friendship provided and developed by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries is a precious common wealth of the two countries, he stressed that it is the consistent and steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the traditional China-DPRK friendship.
He expressed expectation that the current visit would mark an occasion in defending the common interests of the two countries and further strengthening the bilateral relations in conformity with the important common understanding achieved by the top leaders of the two countries.
At the talks there exchanged in-depth opinions related to international and regional issues and reached a full consensus of views on them.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were the party of the foreign minister and DPRK Ambassador to China Ri Ryong Nam, and from the Chinese side officials of the Chinese Foreign Ministry including Vice-Minister Sun Weidong. -0-

headline: Construction of Catalyst Production Bases Progresses Apace in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- The construction of the catalyst production bases of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex is progressing apace at the final stage, according to Minju Joson.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex completed the manufacture of more than 100 equipment and devices of 10-odd kinds necessary for the construction of the catalyst production base and has pushed ahead with their installation.
Workers of the complex installed equipment and devices for various processes at a qualitative level, thus providing a guarantee for launching a test operation in an early date.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex rationally organizes manpower and supplies equipment as the construction of the production process of slow effective granule urea fertilizer and the construction of catalyst production base is being propelled simultaneously. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Palace
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- There is the Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Palace on Jangdae Hill in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.
It has all necessary conditions for bringing into full bloom hopes and talents of schoolchildren including 200-odd hobby rooms, theatre, gymnasium and library.
The great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungpersonally initiated the construction of the palace, chose its site and gave detailed guidance to the whole course of construction.
Since its foundation on September 30, 1963, the palace has made a proud development as a base for extracurricular education of schoolchildren thanks to the deep interest and special loving care of the peerlessly great men who put forward the rising generations as the king of the country.
Many schoolchildren have learned diverse knowledge and cultivated talents to their heart's content at the palace according to their dreams and hopes.
Many schoolchildren have become competent scientists, talented artistes and sportsperson reserves and reliable pillars of the country, had the honors of People's Artiste, People's Artist, People's Athlete, Professor and Doctor and contributed to the prosperity and development of the country. They are the pride of the palace.
The palace was awarded the Order ofKim Il Sung, and its officials and teaching staff received state commendations and honorary titles.
The bright and cheerful appearance of the rising generations cultivating their hopes and talents and enjoying a boundless happiness at the palace adds the vigor to the advance of the country making a leap forward with fresh confidence and vibrant youth. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on WPK's Outstanding Leadership and Resolute Practical Abilities
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Tuesday in an article says that the great changes and vigorous advance being made in the overall state building are a precious fruition of the outstanding leadership ability and resolute practical ability of the Workers' Party of Korea which is strongly pulling the comprehensive prosperity and growth unprecedented in the nation building with its powerful strength of leadership.
The WPK is the great guide indicating the ever-victorious path of national prosperity by setting forth scientific lines and policies, the article says, and goes on:
Since its Eighth Congress, our Party has put forward the revolutionary policies and plans that could lead socialist construction to greater success and leap forward.
The revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee are great as it is an encyclopedic and scientific action program that gives perfect answers to all problems arising in building a powerful nation, ranging from the strengthening of single-minded unity, the mainstay of the Korean revolution, to the land development, greening, fruit culture, stockbreeding and fish farming and breeding.
The WPK is the experienced and seasoned general staff of the revolution which ushers in a new heyday of national prosperity on this land by applying the Juche-oriented leadership mode.
The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area which represents the new looks of the socialist civilization, the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm which is wonderfully being built in the northwestern part of the country and the Pyongyang General Hospital which is to be inaugurated soon are clearly proving the leadership ability of the Party which regards the promotion of the people's wellbeing as its cherished desire and realizes it unconditionally in any storm and stress.
Over the past ten years our Party has given a top priority to training people to be fully developed revolutionaries on the basis of making a deep insight into the role of the driving force in building a powerful state.
The leadership of the WPK bringing up all the people to be the personifiers of high political consciousness, revolutionary view of morality and science and technology will amplify an inexhaustible driving force for the cause of building a thriving nation and open up a new history of vigorous and dynamic state development. -0-

headline: Relay Teams Carrying Letters of Loyalty to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Approach Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- The relay teams to present the letters of loyalty to the respected Comrade
Kim Jong Unare approaching Pyongyang with the boundless trust in the Workers' Party of Korea.
The relay teams continue their march every day, enjoying the warm welcome and seen-off by the people everywhere.
The members of the relay teams of South Phyongan and North and South Hamgyong provinces went round the regional-industry factories in Sukchon, Hamju and Orang counties to keenly feel the loving care and benevolence of the motherly Party.
The relay teams of North and South Hwanghae provinces are greatly encouraging the agricultural workers who are devoting their sincere sweat and efforts of patriotism to fields.
The members of the relay team of Kangwon Province hardened their will to make innovations in the present struggle for overall prosperity and development at the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory, the provincial tree nursery, the Ogye and Wollang farms in Anbyon County.
Those of the relay teams of North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces are approaching Pyongyang while raising the enthusiasm of the masses for the revolution and patriotism.
The members of the relay teams of Nampho and Rason municipalities continue their march amid the warm welcome of the people in relevant regions.
The relay teams of the officers and men of the Korean People's Army are running, demonstrating their will to defend the Party's ideology and cause with invincible arms.
The relay team of the young vanguard carrying with the letter of loyalty to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unis filled with the aspiration and single mind of the passionate youth. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County and the Sowon Farm in Pyoksong County, he learned about the paddy rice yields according to species, manuring and cultivation of after-crops and the harvesting situation and called on South Hwanghae Province, a major granary, to reap a bumper crop to glorify this significant year with increased grain production.
He stressed the need to properly set the harvesting time in conformity with the ripening rate of rice ears and geographical conditions and rationally distribute manpower and farm machines in order to gather the grains cultivated with much effort without any waste and generalize the excellent experience gained by agricultural production units throughout the country.
At the Pupho Mine, the premier heard a detailed report on the operation of the mine and the project for expanding its capacity and called for reinforcing and perfecting the mining and transport system to provide a guarantee for revitalizing production at a high level as the production processes including the crushing and flotation processes have been fully provided.
After going round various production sites of the Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory, he took a battery-operated passenger bus on its trial to acquaint himself with its technical condition and said that the officials, technicians and workers of the factory and relevant units should bear in mind the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea, which always pays deep attention to the public transport issue of the capital city, put spurs to the modernization of equipment and steadily improve the safety and performance of battery-operated buses.
At the construction site of the farm machine institute under the Agricultural Commission which is nearing completion, the premier learned about the progress of the construction and referred to the ways for successfully building the institute which will play an important role in realizing the programme for the rural revolution in a new era. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Meets with Premier of State Council of China

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People’s Republic of China, on October 1.
The message said:
Comrade General Secretary,
I extend warm congratulations to comrade general secretary and, through comrade general secretary, to the Communist Party of China, the government of the People’s Republic of China and the Chinese people on behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea, the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and all the Korean people, on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the PRC.
Over the past 76 years since the founding of new China, the Chinese people have achieved noticeable successes in the struggle for defending the sovereignty of the country and its territorial integrity and building a modern socialist state, resolutely weathering through all challenges and trials under the leadership of the CPC.
We are convinced that the Chinese people will, in the future, too, firmly unite around the CPC with comrade general secretary as its core and continue to open up a new phase of vigorous and dynamic state development, thus surely winning a brilliant victory in the historic long journey for realizing the dream of prosperity of the Chinese nation.
The DPRK-China friendship provided by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries has been steadily consolidated and developed generation after generation, overcoming all the tempests of history in the common struggle for the cause of socialism.
The magnificent commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, which were held with splendor in Beijing on September 3 as a grand political festival, marked an important occasion in which the PRC clearly demonstrated its overall national power and international position.
It is the steadfast stand of our Party and the government of the Republic to steadily develop the traditional DPRK-China friendship no matter how the international situation may change.
The DPRK side has a willingness to make the joint efforts, together with the Chinese side, to further strengthen and develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and China as required by the new era and in line with the aspirations and desire of the peoples of the two countries, and defend peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world through the close strategic communication and cooperation.
I wish the PRC prosperity and the Chinese people happiness. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on September 29.
The message said:
I express thanks to you for extending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between our two parties, two states and the peoples of the two countries formed on the road of struggle for the common socialist ideal will be further developed, I wish you success in your responsible work. -0-

headline: Wheat Processing Equipment Manufactured in Pyongyang Grain Processing Machine Factory
story_text:

headline: Head of the DPRK Delegation Addresses at 80th Session of UN General Assembly
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- Kim Son Gyong, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs who is heading the DPRK delegation, made a speech at the 80th Session of the UN General Assembly on September 29.
As reflected in the theme of the current session "Better together: 80 years and more for peace, development and human rights", we are now at a pivotal watershed where we all look back on the 80-year-long history of the UN and design for the future, Kim Son Gyong said, and went on:
The modern history has recorded many incidents and events but has never seen a period like today when the international norms and order established and consolidated along with the foundation of the UN are disregarded and the sovereignty of states openly violated.
The indiscriminate tariff war against the entire world has thrown the world economy in general into the swamp of stagnation and instability. Even the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, committed to eliminating inequality and poverty and ensuring dignity of humankind on a global scale, is denied for the reason that it does not meet the interest of an individual country. This is the stark reality.
Underlying at the bottom of all these turbulences and pains suffered by the world are the high-handedness and arbitrariness of the hegemonic powers in their attempt to keep the whole world within the sphere of their interests and their greedy ambition to place their exclusive interests above the common good of humanity.
The complicated international situation today highlights the need to reconsider the role of the UN responsible for maintenance of global peace and security.
In particular, it is an essential requirement in preventing arbitrariness and high-handedness of specific forces to correct the Western-led inappropriate structure and expand and strengthen the representation of developing countries that take up absolute majority of the UN membership in the Security Council entrusted with an important mission of maintaining international peace and security.
Only when the UN puts an end to the arbitrary, high-handed, biased and double-dealing practices in all its activities and strictly adheres to the principles of sovereign equality, non-interference in internal affairs, impartiality and objectivity, can it restore its image as an organization with full qualifications and capacity for realizing the purposes of its charter.
However, the present objective security situation of the Korean peninsula is faced with serious challenges as never before.
As the U.S.-ROK, U.S.-Japan military alliances and the U.S.-Japan-ROK trilateral military cooperation system directly targeting the DPRK rapidly evolve into a more offensive and aggressive military bloc with nuclear element contained, the war exercises and military build-up against our state are breaking all the previous records in terms of scale, nature, frequency and scope.
Nowhere in the world can we find such a place as the Korean peninsula where the world's biggest nuclear weapon state and its allied forces conduct bilateral and multilateral war exercises all the year round and even stage actual drills simulating the use of nukes targeting a sovereign state, by mobilizing massive multi-national combined forces and latest strategic assets.
Yet, even under the tremendous military threat directed against the DPRK and the dangerous security landscape created by it, the roaring guns of war are not heard and the peace and security are firmly safeguarded on the Korean peninsula.
The physical war deterrent of the DPRK strengthened in direct proportion to the increased threat of aggression of the U.S. and its allies thoroughly saps the will of the enemy states to provoke a war and ensures the balance of power in the area of the Korean peninsula.
In order to permanently maintain this state of balance and make peace of the Korean peninsula everlasting, we have stipulated the nukes in our constitution as sacred and absolute thing that can never be touched nor changed.
Requesting us to "denuclearize" is equivalent to asking us to give up the sovereignty, abandon the right to existence and violate the constitution.
We will never give up the sovereignty, abandon the right to existence and violate the constitution.
ComradeKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, made it clear at the 13th session of the 14th Supreme People's Assembly that our Party and the government would invariably and firmly safeguard without slightest vacillation the constitution of the DPRK and its basic law on the policy of nuclear forces which perpetuates its possession of nukes and thoroughly guarantee the supreme interests of our state.
We will never give up the nuclear weapons which are our state law, national policy and sovereign power as well as the right to existence. Under any circumstances, we will not withdraw from this position.
The DPRK is convincingly following the road of its own choice without any stagnation and vacillation even under the worldwide political turmoil. This reality is the brilliant fruition of the unshakable spirit of independence and correct leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK.
Marking the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II this year, colourful political and cultural events have taken place in various countries commemorating the victory over the world anti-fascist war.
It represents the rock-firm will of the righteous international community not to tolerate the attempts to deny the result of the world anti-fascist war and national liberation struggle.
Yet, genocide and atrocities against humanity that can even overshadow Hitler are now openly committed in the Middle East, much to the consternation of the world.
After massacring over 60,000 Palestine civilians in the past 2 years, Israel is trying to occupy the whole area of Gaza with armed forces and completely exterminate the Palestine population.
We urge Israel to stop immediately the crimes against humanity and withdraw from the Gaza Strip. Likewise, we fully support the establishment of independent state of Palestine with East Jerusalem as its capital and its entry into the UN as a full-fledged member state.
Independence, peace and friendship are the invariable external policy ideas of the DPRK.
The DPRK will, as in the past, so also in the future, collaborate with all countries and nations that oppose and reject aggression, interference, domination and subjugation and aspire after independence and justice, transcending differences in ideas and systems. It will promote multifaceted exchanges and cooperation with the countries that respect our country and take friendly attitude. -0-

headline: Sculpture Depicting Korean Anti-Japanese Guerrillas Erected in Patriot Park, Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- A sculpture depicting Korean anti-Japanese guerrillas was erected at Patriot Park in the suburbs of Moscow, Russia.
An unveiling ceremony of the sculpture took place on the spot on October 1.
Present there were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense of the Russian Federation.
Also on hand were members of the DPRK military delegation, DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol, the defense attache of the DPRK embassy, Aide to the President of Russia Vladimir Medinski, Chairman of the National Defense Committee of the State Duma Andrei Kartapolov, officials of the Ministry of Defense and the Foreign Ministry.
At the ceremony, there was an introduction of the monument and the defence ministers of the two countries cut off the tape amid the music playing.
Then speeches were made.
Andrei Beloussov said that the sculpture depicting Korean anti-Japanese guerrillas can be called proudly to be a symbol of the invincible militant friendship between the peoples of the two countries, adding that the monument would make a great contribution to looking back upon the memory of the wartime generations and preserving the historical truth.
No Kwang Chol said in his speech that the two countries and peoples were closely united with warm affection of comrades-in-arms and friends in the bloody battles against the common enemy and this proud tradition has become the cornerstone of developing the DPRK-Russia relations into the ones of comprehensive strategic partnership and alliance, adding that only victory and glory are in store for the peoples of the two countries steadily strengthening militant friendship and solidarity.
Vladimir Medinski said that the monument symbolizing the militant friendship between the two countries forged at the cost of blood during the Second World War and in the struggle for liberating Kursk Region represents the common history, expressing belief that the Russia-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation would grow stronger in all fields in the future, too.
After the speeches, floral baskets and flowers were laid before the sculpture.
Written on the ribbon of a floral basket in the name of the military delegation of the DPRK were the letters reading "The anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs will be immortal."
The participants paid high tribute to the anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs.
Earlier, the DPRK military delegation laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldiers by the wall of the Kremlin. -0-

headline: Advanced Analytical Equipment Newly Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun,Kim Il SungUniversity has newly developed an advanced analytical equipment of Korean style for the large-sized oxygen separator of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex.
The equipment, first introduced into the oxygen plant workshop No. 3, is an infrared gas analyzer capable of measuring with very high precision the concentration of infinitesimal quantity of carbon dioxide, that is urgently needed for the operation of oxygen separators.

headline: "Trafficking in Persons Report" of United States under Fire
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- Ri Jin, researcher of the Korea Association for Human Rights Studies, Thursday issued the following article titled "'Trafficking in Persons Report' highlights only the incurable maladies of the United States":
Recently, the U.S. Department of State released again a "report" that willfully assesses and classifies the practices of "human trafficking" in the DPRK and all other countries of the world.
The "report", as in the past, repeated its slander against the sovereign states, citing the data of "human trafficking" in other countries and labeling them as "model states" or "backward states" after grading the countries in order of the governmental efforts for eradicating "human trafficking" and their results.
Last year we had already branded the annual "Trafficking in Persons Report" of the U.S. which was run through with the obsolete fabricated data as a diagnosis of mental derangement of the U.S. addicted to the politicization of human rights.
The U.S. still tries to style itself a "human rights judge" though it is breaking the world's worst human rights record every year. It is stunning the public.
It is illogical that the U.S., where horrible shooting incidents occur at schools, churches and shops almost every day and tens of thousands of people are being taken to prisons due to the policy of expelling immigrants, assesses the situation of human rights in the world.
This is not the only thing.
It is, indeed, a tragicomedy that the U.S. government made a "judgment" upon the world situation of "human trafficking" at a time when the whole world is astonished at a U.S. millionaire's hideous underage sex trafficking.
The reality clearly proves that the U.S. "Trafficking in Persons Report" is nothing but a means for veiling its records of human rights violation and politicizing human rights to justify the pressure on different countries and interference in their internal affairs, and has nothing to do with the substantial efforts to eradicate human trafficking.
It is by no means fortuitous that not only the anti-U.S. and independent countries but also the "countries sharing their mind" with the U.S. are openly criticizing the U.S for its deceitful and contradictory gibberish about "human rights".
Today when the world aspires after multi-polarization, the DPRK and many other countries are directing efforts to promoting human rights conforming to their own history, culture and socio-economic environment.
The U.S. is well advised to clearly understand the reality and realize that the old-fashioned and inefficient behavior of a "human rights judge" is no longer appropriate, and it moves to internationalize and politicize the "human rights" issues of other countries would only result in self-harming consequences of bringing its miserable human rights situation to a focus.
We will in the future, too, not lend an ear to the U.S. deceptive "human rights" rhetoric but do our best to defend the most advantageous socialist system of our own style and the genuine rights and interests of the people. -0-

The commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War held with splendor on September 3 marked an important occasion that clearly demonstrated the daily-growing overall national power and international position of the PRC, the message said, adding that the diplomatic fields of the two countries have assumed an important mission in consolidating and developing the traditional DPRK-China friendship as required by the new era.

headline: New Building for Refreshment Constructed at Yangdok Hot Spring Resort
story_text:
One day in November 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uninspected the construction site of the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort nearing its inauguration.
Going round various places of the resort, he gave instructions to step up the preparations for its inauguration and headed for the ski resort.
Looking down the ski trail No. 3 on its summit, he told an official that a large service building should be built on the summit of the ski trail No. 3 with easy slope.
Saying that many people will climb up the ski trail No. 3 with easy slope and therefore, it is necessary to construct another building for refreshment on the summit of the ski trail, he called for constructing two-storied building for refreshment in good harmony with its environment.
Earlier, he looked round a building for refreshment on the summit of a peak, paying deep attention to making the people do not feel the slightest inconvenience.
He said that the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort should not have any shortcomings as it is the hot spring treatment service base built under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea for the promotion of the people's health and their well-being.
Another resting structure was built at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort thanks to the warm sincerity ofKim Jong Unwho is working heart and soul to provide the people with the highest civilization and the best happiness. -0-

headline: Production of Daily Necessities for Children Completed
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- The light industrial sector in the DPRK completed the production of sportswear, thermal underwear, shoes and socks to be sent to the children across the country.
The Ministry of Light Industry and the Ministry of Regional Industry worked out the plans for producing daily necessities and gave production assignments to factories, while ensuring the supply of materials and technical guidance.
The Pyongyang School Uniform Factory, the Mangyongdae Garment Factory and the Sadong Garment Factory carried out their assignments for producing sportswear of different sizes, shapes and colors to suit the characteristics of children's ages and their aesthetic tastes by introducing rational and efficient cutting and processing methods.
The Pothonggang Garment Factory and the Pyongyang Changgwang Garment Factory raised cutting yield and observed the requirements of processing guides.
The Hamhung Knitwear Factory ensured proper process-by-process engagement and made collective innovation in the production of thermal underwear through a socialist emulation for improving quality.
The Ryuwon Footwear Factory established a quality control system to produce stylish sports shoes.
The Pyongyang Hosiery Factory finished producing hosiery of various colors and patterns suited to the tastes of children. -0-

headline: International Day of Older Persons Marked in DPRK

The aged across the country spent International Day of Older Persons with pleasure, enjoying a cultural and emotional life. -0-

Vladimir Medinski said that the monument symbolizing the militant friendship between the two countries forged at the cost of blood during the Second World War and in the struggle for liberating Kursk Region represents the common history, expressing belief that the Russia-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation would grow stronger in all fields in the future, too.
After the speeches, floral baskets and flowers were laid before the sculpture.
Written on the ribbon of a floral basket in the name of the military delegation of the DPRK were the letters reading "The anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs will be immortal."

headline: Advanced Analytical Equipment Newly Developed
story_text:

headline: Stream of Spring Water Associated with Care of Great Man
story_text:
One day in the autumn of 1969 PresidentKim Il Sungvisited a farm in the vicinity of Pyongyang Municipality.
Kim Il Sungacquainted himself with the construction of water supply system and knew that a site for a depositing reservoir had not been chosen yet.
Saying that let us choose the site together on our way here today, he headed for the well he had seen in the spring of 1957 when he guided the construction for building a small reservoir for a pumping station.
Clear water gushed out from the well but the quantity of water was not enough.
The President said that it would not be enough for the water supply and went to the sheepcote above the well.
He stopped walking in front of the sheepcote and looked around the surrounding area. Then he said that this place was wet all the time even in the drought and ordered officials to dig a hole there.
That was the place which the President saw 10-odd years ago when he guided the building of the reservoir and the small reservoir for a pumping station in order to provide the farmers of the farm with rice.
At that time he had seen the well for the pumping station and the stream of spring water in the entrance to the valley.
Looking up to the President who did not forget the things 10-odd years ago, the peasants were deeply moved. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of WPK Celebrated in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 3 (KCNA) -- Meetings, seminars, round-table talks, lectures and film shows took place in Germany, Bulgaria, Romania, Italy, Switzerland and Serbia on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present at the events were personages of political parties, organizations and institutions and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in those countries.
Screened at the film shows were films dealing with the glorious journey of the WPK and videos introducing the reality of the DPRK in which the entities of regional rejuvenation are being constructed one after another.
Speeches were made at the events.
The chairman of the Supreme Council of the National Socialist Party of Romania and the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania praised PresidentKim Il Sungfor advancing the original line of party founding and accomplishing the historic cause of founding a revolutionary party of Juche type and ChairmanKim Jong Ilfor building the WPK into the Party of the leader and laid a solid ideological and theoretical foundation for its development.
They said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who is adding luster to the undying exploits of the preceding leaders forever, clarified the line of party building in the new era and wisely leads it. The high dignity and prestige of the WPK are unthinkable without his seasoned leadership, they added.
Personages of the New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the WPK, which has been faithful to its idea for a long time since its foundation, has administered the people-first politics unprecedented in the political history of ruling socialist parties.
The chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea, the official representative of the Italian branch of the Korean Friendship Association and the chief of the Firenze group of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the DPRK is demonstrating its might as an independent power thanks to the wise leadership of HEKim Jong Unwho is steadfastly carrying forward the independent idea and independent politics of the great PresidentKim Il Sungand HEKim Jong Iland holding fast to them as powerful weapons for the advance and development of the DPRK. -0-

DPRK Player Proves Successful at IWF World Championships
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- DPRK player Ri Song Gum proved successful at the 2025 International Weightlifting Federation World Championships being held in Norway.
The championships brought together more than 470 competent men and women players from over 80 countries and regions, including the DPRK, China, Bulgaria, Canada and Egypt.
In the women's 48kg category held on October 2 (local time), Ri Song Gum lifted 91kg in snatch, 122kg in clean and jerk (new world record) and 213kg in total (new world record) and thus took the first place in snatch, clean and jerk and total respectively and bagged three gold medals. -0-

Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- The artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League gave a performance "Songs of Young Vanguard to the Great Party" at the Central Youth Hall on Friday to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Among the audience were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league, youth and students in Pyongyang.
The performance began with poems and songs "Fly High, Our Party Flag" and "Mother's Birthday". The performers represented the gratitude of the young vanguard to the motherly Party which has recorded the noble history of the Juche-oriented youth movement since the very day of the Party founding.
In female solo "Care of My Destiny" and male solo and pangchang "We Cannot Live without You" the performers sang of the sincere mind of the young vanguard that can not live even a moment without the care of the motherly Party.
Male quartet "Flame", flag dance and guitar ensemble "We Are Successors to Revolution" and other numbers expressed the boundless glory, happiness and endless pride of the new generations leading a worthwhile life of patriotic youth under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
The performance ended with choral recitation of a poem and chorus "We Will Travel One Road Forever", "Young People, Be Loyal to Our Party" and song and dance "Dear Father". -0-

headline: Meetings of Working People's Organizations
Meetings of Working People's Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- Meetings to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea were held by working people's organizations on Oct. 3.
Present there were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Min Sung Chol and Han Kwang Ho, vice department directors of the C.C., the WPK, officials concerned, officials of the trade unions, agricultural workers' union and the women's union, workers and members of the trade unions, agricultural workers and members of the agricultural workers' union and members of the women's union.
At the meeting of the workers and trade union members held at the Central Hall of Workers, the reporter and speakers highly praised the immortal exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho founded the Juche-type revolutionary Party and developed it into an integral organization and ideologically pure entity.
They called upon all the workers and trade union members to hold high in esteemKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilas the eternal leaders of the Party and the people and glorify their exploits for the Party building for all ages.
At the meeting of the agricultural workers and members of the agricultural workers' union held at the Unsan County Hall of Culture in North Phyongan Province, the reporter and speakers said that the founding of the WPK, the vanguard unit and powerful militant general staff of the working masses, on October 10, 1945, was a solemn declaration heralding the birth of a revolutionary party in the era of independence and a great event that brought about a radical turn in carving out the destiny of the Korean people.
They stressed that all the agricultural workers and members of the agricultural workers' union should vigorously advance towards the new victory of the socialist rural construction under the leadership of the great Party Central Committee which firmly defends and brilliantly carries forward the ideal of the Party founding and its glorious history.
At the meeting of officials and members of the women's union held before the Monument to Party Founding, the reporter and speakers said that thanks to the outstanding idea and energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the red Party flag held high by the WPK on the very day of the Party founding is more vigorously fluttering as a banner of brilliant victory and glory.
They called upon all the officials and members of the women's union to become true daughters of the WPK who powerfully promote the changes of the times, firmly united around the great Party Central Committee with single mind of loyalty and patriotism   -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Vietnamese Party Leader and President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, and Luong Cuong, president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on October 2.
The message said:
I express thanks to you for extending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
I express belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between our two parties and two countries will steadily develop in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Officials and Employees of Sangwon Cement Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- The warm love of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea is permeating the Sangwon Cement Complex, a great building materials producer of the country, which is making redoubled efforts in the vanguard of the struggle to implement the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK and the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee while raising the all-people enthusiasm for increased production.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unfirmly believes in the Sangwon Cement Complex, which has made a tangible contribution to strengthening the national power and developing the socialist civilization with increased cement production in response to the Party's call in every period of the revolution, and puts it forward at the outpost of great construction, the major forefront of comprehensive national rejuvenation, showing boundless love and solicitude for it. He sent gifts to the workers of the complex who are making leap forward and innovations in the general offensive of this year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
A meeting was held on Friday to convey the gifts.
Present there were officials and workers of the complex.
An address for conveying gifts was made at the meeting.
The speaker said thatKim Jong Unsent gifts of love again to the workers of the complex on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious WPK.
The meticulous love and solicitude shown byKim Jong Unreflect his great trust and expectation that the workers of the complex, who are glorifying generation after generation the honorable tradition of devotedly implementing the decisions of the Party, always cherishing the loyalty to the Party Central Committee as their lifeblood, would discharge their mission and duty as the Party's most important enterprise in the struggle to greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with proud labor successes, he said.
The speaker called upon all the officials and employees to carry out without fail the task for increased cement production they pledged before the Party with their revolutionary mettle of creation and sprit of thoroughgoing implementation, always bearing in mind that the successful implementation of the Party's policy depends on the workers of the complex.
Then resolution-taking speeches were made.
The speakers extended thanks toKim Jong Un, saying that the workers of the complex are the only ones in the world who lead a blessed life under the trust and love of the WPK.
They expressed their determination to fully display the revolutionary spirit and mettle of the heroicKim Il Sung-Kim Jong Ilworking class in the struggle to successfully conclude this year, the last year of implementing the five-year plan for national economic development, by upholding the leadership of the great Central Committee of the WPK with their single mind. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Long-term Development of WPK and Revolution
story_text:

headline: Mausoleum of King Tangun Associated with Patriotism of Peerlessly Great Men
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- An event took place at the Mausoleum of King Tangun at the foot of Mt Taebak in Kangdong County, Pyongyang on October 3 to mark the Foundation Day of Korea.
The mausoleum, where the remains of Tangun are buried, is a precious cultural treasure that contains the historical contents showing the developed culture, political, economic and military might of Ancient Korea and is associated with the traditional tomb style.
The ancestors called the birthday of Tangun who founded Ancient Korea, the first state in the history of Korea, Kaechonjol (the Foundation Day of Korea) and held events in memory of Tangun that day.
By the end of the last century the history of Tangun and Ancient Korea had been seriously distorted and obliterated by flunkeyists and Japanese imperialists-patronized historians and the story about the mausoleum of Tangun was a legend.
Thanks to the noble patriotic will of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the legendary tales about Tangun, which had been handed down for thousands of years, were proved to be a true fact in the era of the Workers' Party.
The President and the Chairman made sure that data and relics related to Tangun were comprehensively and concretely elucidated in order to correct the distorted history of ancient Korea.
They also energetically guided the work to make clear the entity of Tangun on the basis of the scientific analysis of the relics discovered at the mausoleum.
After the verification of the fact that Tangun was a real man, they unfolded a grand blueprint for the remodeling of the mausoleum and guided the work to turn the mausoleum into a monumental edifice to be handed down to posterity, preserving the then environment and the national customs.
The inauguration ceremony of the mausoleum which was remodeled magnificently as a historic treasure under the wise guidance of the peerlessly great men was held with splendor on the occasion of the Foundation Day of Korea in October, 1994.
The verification of the fact that Tangun was a real man and the remodeling of the mausoleum of Tangun scientifically proved that Korea is the cradle of human culture with the time-honored history spanning 5 000 years and Pyongyang is a sacred place where everything of the Korean nation was originated. -0-

I express belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between our two parties and two countries will steadily develop in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. -0-

story_text:
One day in September 2017, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited Kwail County after receiving a report that it had a great apple harvest despite the unfavourable weather conditions.
Looking at the sea of apples,Kim Jong Unasked a senior official of the county about this year's average harvest per hectare and said with satisfaction that it was great that the county produced 70 to 80 tons of apples per hectare.
Listening to the pledge of official to produce much more apples the following year, he said with a broad smile on his face that it would be good, hoping that the official would keep his word.

headline: Speech Made by Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Opening Ceremony of Military Hardware Exhibition Defence Development-2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 5 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the opening ceremony of the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025.
The full text is as follows:
Comrades,
I think it is very significant that in the run-up to the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025 is being held, which once again gives us a visual display of the general level attained by our defence capabilities.
This exhibition features the recent results of the important projects that we have pressed on with in order to put the structure of the DPRK’s military capabilities, with its nuclear deterrent as the backbone, on an increasingly modern, advanced footing.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I express my thanks to all the groups of defence scientists and technicians and all the workers in the munitions industry for having added significance to the revolutionary October holiday by achieving proud results of upgraded defence industry.
Comrades,
This exhibition brings into bold relief the historic meaning of the 80th founding anniversary of our Party.
Since the initial days of its founding our Party has consistently prioritized the Juche-oriented defence industry, laying the groundwork for its independent development and setting one ambitious goal after another for its steady growth. Recently, in less than one year, this industry has achieved notable successes again, and I am sure that making public those successes for our people to see constitutes the highest praise for our Party’s 80-year-long history.
It is because this exhibition eloquently shows that in building up the defence capabilities we have attained a much higher level than the founder generation of the Juche-oriented defence industry hoped to reach.
Our Party was born with the absolute mission of taking full responsibility for the destiny of the people, so it is a natural duty of the Party and its unique mode of activity to direct its main efforts to building the most powerful defence industry in the world and developing it without let-up so that it can protect the dignity and security of the nation, defend the rights and interests of the people and secure their future.
The history of our munitions industry, which provides a material and technical guarantee for our state’s overall military strength, started with the founding of the Party, and this industry, led by the Party, has followed a steady upward trajectory to become as it is today. These latest achievements of defence development, which fill up this venue, can proudly represent and symbolize our Party’s achievements for the state, revolution and people.
The destiny of a state and its people cannot be secured apart from the munitions industry which surely guarantees their security environment, as well as the vanguard organization which guides them politically.
As they had foreseen this undeniable truth and fully realized its realistic necessity, the first-generation revolutionaries of Korea, after national liberation, spared nothing for creating an armaments industry which would be the primary cornerstone in building a new country, while working to achieve the cause of founding the Party as their foremost concern.
The generations of our grandfathers and fathers, who had created the armaments industry of Korea, manufactured submachine guns which could be called their own things, both in name and in reality, from scratch after liberation. During the period of the hard-fought war, they even sacrificed their precious lives to produce weapons with which to destroy the imperialist invaders; in doing so, they created the tradition of the revolutionary spirit of Kunja-ri - the spirit of defending the country and displaying self-reliance.
As we have faithfully carried forward the spirit and tradition, the gunshots that rang out in Phyongchon-ri nearly eight decades ago led to a succession of explosions demonstrating the strength with which to reliably defend the independent dignity of our state and people and overpower the imperialist tyranny. And as we can see today, this has resulted in the steady production of Juche-based weapons, the like of which cannot be found in any ordnance encyclopaedia, thus decorating the venue for this splendid exhibition.
This exhibition can be said to be the epitome of epochal leaps forward made by our defence science and technology, and of the comprehensive development of our munitions industry.
At the recent session of the Supreme People’s Assembly, we reiterated that maintaining security and defending peace by dint of overwhelming strength is our unchangeable principle, and officially declared that we are prepared to cope with anything.
This exhibition will prove this guarantee.
Our latest achievements of defence development, which are on display here, have been proved to be sufficiently powerful on the highest level.
In recent years, military hardware capable of actively and effectively coping with the changing aspects of modern warfare has been newly developed or upgraded, and AI technology and other latest sci-tech findings have been widely introduced, with the result that the feasibility of their application not only to the present battlefield but also to the future one has been confirmed in view of the capability of fighting a war. This is an important feature of the development of our style of defence technology that can be seen in this exhibition.
I think that everyone present here can clearly see that our defence industry is now focusing on continuous upgrading and making a leap forward in order to protect the security environment of our state; it is doing so by relying on its self-supporting foundations, through a unique course of development and by highly ingenious methods of development.
This shows that we can review the work of the eighth-term Party Central Committee with pride in having attained its goals by fulfilling its ennobling mission and responsibility for the state and the people.
I, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, extend the warmest militant respect once again to all our groups of defence scientists and technicians and all our comrades working in the munitions industry for having prepared the most valuable presents for the celebration of the 80th founding anniversary of the Party.
Comrades,
I would like to stress once again that we must never allow ourselves to be complacent about the supremacy of our state’s defence capabilities, nor must we slow down on account of it.
The moment we feel complacency leads to the beginning of our advance getting sluggish.
Our military capabilities should be improved steadily.
As I have mentioned recently, the security environment and instability we are in at present never allow us to feel relieved or complacent even for a moment.
The US-ROK nuclear alliance is making rapid progress, and they are conducting various kinds of exercises to execute dangerous scenarios according to the so-called nuclear operations guidelines and to get adept at them. Recently, the United States is taking measures for expanding the stockpile of its military assets in and around the ROK, posing a real and serious threat to the security of our country and others in the region.
It is upgrading the whole structure of its military capabilities including strategic means of reconnaissance and offensive and defensive means.
What does this mean?
No one can deny or conceal the fact that the United States’ arms buildup schemes are mainly geared to making it easier to launch preemptive strikes against the other side in times of emergency.
This is the very situation.
Then, what should we do in such an environment?
We are closely watching the United States’ deployment of its means of strategic strike and reconnaissance in and around the Korean peninsula and their mobilization for hostile military acts in connection with a new possible threat to our state’s security.
And we have adopted clear measures.
In direct proportion to the US military’s arms buildup in the ROK region, our strategic concern about this region has also grown, and accordingly we have assigned our special assets to the major targets of our concern.
The enemy, I think, will have to worry about which direction their security environment is moving in.
I will not make a detailed comment about it.
They themselves should have to judge whether the territory of the ROK would be a safe place in any case.
We will surely adopt additional military measures corresponding to their manoeuvrings.
If the United States persists in the dangerous moves of reinforcing its military strength in blatant disregard of the security concerns of the states in the region, the developments will spur us more powerfully to implement the relevant military and technological measures aimed at removing the new threats and maintaining the balance of power.
Comrades,
Everyone will soon know the new goals to be set forth for the defence technology sector and the aspect of its development at the next stage.
The Party’s strategic programme for defence development specifies the development-oriented core goals for all the realms of the project.
Our powerful assets for national defence capability will develop more rapidly without a moment of delay, and the cause of the WPK for strengthening the war deterrent for self-defence without let-up will continue to follow the glorious road of victory.
I hope that all the comrades present at the opening ceremony of the military hardware exhibition, which has opened with splendour in celebration of the 80th founding anniversary of our Party, will have a good time, looking round in real earnest the exhibits with a high sense of dignity and pride in our tremendous strength. -0-

headline: Increased Production at Mines of Komdok Mining Complex
story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Military Hardware Exhibition Defence Development-2025 Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 5 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea has firmly ensured the dignity and eternal prosperity of the DPRK and magnificently put its reputation and prestige on the highest level in the world by bolstering up in every way the most powerful self-defence capacity in the course of dynamically leading the country and the people to great victory and glory under the uplifted banner of independence for 80 years. It serves as an extraordinary feat and immortal honor that will shine forever along with the history of the Juche revolution.
Giving the unique tremendous vitality and driving power to the course of our revolution pioneered with arms, our Party is imposingly building and steadily increasing the invincible military power, the powerful eruption of the DPRK's courageous spirit and self-respect that no one can resist and demonstration of most righteous strength, with its transparent faith and through the resolute struggle.
The military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025 opened with spendour in Pyongyang, the capital of the DPRK, on Oct. 4, demonstrating the development of the national defence capabilities accelerated beyond precedent and limit thanks to the matchless determination and outstanding leadership of the great Party Central Committee to surely build an eternally prospering socialist power, putting forward the self-reliant defence as the mainstay for defending and developing the revolution,.
The venue of the exhibition opened in celebration of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK is full of latest defence assets, an ensemble of the Juche-oriented defence sci-tech strength, including ultra-modern weapon systems developed into the pivotal military hardware of our armed forces in line with the Party's grandiose strategy for the development of national defence.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up to greet the head of state.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, arrived at the venue of the opening ceremony of the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreviewed the guard of honor of the KPA and the glorious colours of the three services.
Kim Jong Untook the platform together with members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee and leading officials in the fields of defence science and munitions industry.
All the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up toKim Jong Un, the supreme representative of the mightiness and dignity of Juche Korea and the banner of all victories and glory, and paid the highest tribute to him.
Attending the opening ceremony were members of the central leadership organ of the Party including leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the Party Central Committee, major commanding officers of all military and political organs of the Korean People’s Army, meritorious officials, workers, scientists and technicians in the field of munitions industry, leading officials of ministries and national agencies, teaching staff and students of military education institutions.
Jo Chun Ryong, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an opening address.
The speaker introduced the latest level of the innovative growth of the DPRK's defence capabilities and expressed belief that the exhibition, which displays the entities of strength associated with the staunch spirit of self-reliance and ideal of Koreans, would make visitors have new experience as a member of the powerful state and inspire them to win a greater victory, and declared the exhibition open.
The DPRK national anthem was played.
Kim Jong Undelivered a significant speech.
He said that the exhibition features the recent results of the important projects that we have pressed on with in order to put the structure of the DPRK’s military capabilities, with its nuclear deterrent as the backbone, on an increasingly modern, advanced footing.
Since the initial days of its founding our Party has consistently prioritized the Juche-oriented defence industry, laying the groundwork for its independent development and setting one ambitious goal after another for its steady growth, he noted, adding that recently, in less than one year, this industry has achieved notable successes again, and he is sure that making public those successes for our people to see constitutes the highest praise for our Party’s 80-year-long history.
He noted that our Party was born with the absolute mission of taking full responsibility for the destiny of the people, so it is a natural duty of the Party and its unique mode of activity to direct its main efforts to building the most powerful defence industry in the world and developing it without let-up so that it can protect the dignity and security of the nation, defend the rights and interests of the people and secure their future.
Referring to the proud history of the development of the munitions industry which started with the founding of the Party and has made a long journey flushed with victories under the guidance of the Party, he noted:
In recent years, military hardware capable of actively and effectively coping with the changing aspects of modern warfare has been newly developed or upgraded, and AI technology and other latest sci-tech findings have been widely introduced, with the result that the feasibility of their application not only to the present battlefield but also to the future one has been confirmed in view of the capability of fighting a war. This is an important feature of the development of our style of defence technology.
I think that everyone present here can clearly see that our defence industry is now focusing on continuous upgrading and making a leap forward in order to protect the security environment of our state; it is doing so by relying on its self-supporting foundations, through a unique course of development and by highly ingenious methods of development.
This shows that we can review the work of the eighth-term Party Central Committee with pride in having attained its goals by fulfilling its ennobling mission and responsibility for the state and the people.
Noting that the security environment and instability we are in at present never allow us to feel relieved or complacent even for a moment in bolstering up the national defence capabilities, he analyzed the U.S. real aim of arms buildup which poses a real and serious threat to the security of the DPRK and the regional countries.
He stressed that the DPRK will surely take additional military measures to counter it and if the U.S. persists in the dangerous arms buildup in blatant disregard of the regional states' security concern, the developments will further propel the DPRK to take relevant military and technical measures aimed at removing the new threats and maintaining the balance of power.
Saying that everyone will soon know the new goals to be set forth for the defence technology sector and the aspect of its development at the next stage, he affirmed that our powerful assets for national defence capability will develop more rapidly without a moment of delay, and the cause of the WPK for strengthening the war deterrent for self-defence without let-up will continue to follow the glorious road of victory.
The participants responded with enthusiastic applause to the speech ofKim Jong Unwho solemnly clarified the iron-willed declaration of the WPK which would more dynamically lead the tremendous development of the national defence capability and the great leap forward in building a powerful and modernized army for the everlasting victory and prosperity of the DPRK founded in reflection of the general will of all its people.
Kim Jong Unlooked round the venue of the exhibition together with leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs.
He said that he took great pride in covering the responsible and glorious road before the country and the rising generations, witnessing the tremendous defence capabilities achieved with warm heart and passion at an important moment of reviewing the 80-year-long history of the WPK's building and visualizing the journey of creation and change to be more resolutely made by the WPK.
He stressed that the remarkable progress of the self-supporting defence industry and the rapidly expanding sphere of modern defence science and technology are the strength and the mettle of the DPRK achieved by our great people who have defended the Party's line of self-defence with unprecedented toughness and absolute support and encouragement despite the trials and hardships that no one in the world has ever experienced.
Looking round the venue of the exhibition, the participants were struck with admiration from the beginning to the end at the entities of our defence capabilities, another development made just in a year.
The military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025 which opened to add excitement and joy to the whole country ahead of the auspicious 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea is a significant occasion that heralds the changes of our armed forces to be stronger along with the eye-opening advance and development of the revolution in the national defence industry in the new era led by the great Party Central Committee. -0-
