headline: Joint Statement between WPK and URP Adopted
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- A joint statement between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party was adopted on Thursday.
The joint statement was signed by Ri Hi Yong, secretary of the Party Central Committee, on behalf of the WPK, and V.V. Yakushev, secretary of the General Council, on behalf of the URP.
The joint statement said as follows:
The Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party jointly celebrated with splendor the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, the guiding force of the heroic people of the DPRK.
Both sides reaffirmed their will to continue developing the relations between the two parties and the two countries at a high level in the light of the ties of friendship between the peoples of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation and the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries and on the basis of the agreement on exchange and cooperation between the WPK and the URP concluded in Moscow on October 25, 2018.
Both sides shared the views that the mounting political and military tension on the Eurasian continent and the rest of the world is, above all, directly linked to the aggressive politics of the West to continue maintaining at any cost the dangerous and non-constructive line to realize overall hegemonism for only the self-interest of the ruling class and the illegal interference in internal affairs of sovereign states.
In this regard, the United Russia Party expressed firm support for the measures taken by the leadership of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to bolster up the country's defence capabilities.
The WPK expressed firm solidarity with Russia's stand on the issue of coordinating the crisis in Ukraine and full support for the special military operations being conducted by the Russian armed forces.
The United Russia Party expressed sincere thanks to the WPK and the leadership of the DPRK for making a decision on dispatching units of the Korean People's Army to Kursk Region and taking part in the operations for liberating the region from the robbers of the Kiev authorities.
The Russian people will always remember the feats of the officers and soldiers of the Korean People's Army who displayed distinguished bravery and heroism in the fight against the occupiers.
Both sides reached a consensus of views on the common goal for jointly coping with the attempts to distort historical events and struggling against the forces disturbing peace and stability in Northeast Asia including the Korean peninsula, revival of fascism and Nazi ideas and neocolonialist acts persistently committed by the West.
It is necessary to defend and promote the establishment of a new world order in which the rights of all countries and peoples are reliably guaranteed without coercion from the West.
Both sides expressed their intention to strengthen the ties through active dialogue between the party central bodies, between regional organizations and between the activists of the basic party cells in order to implement the already reached agreements, and planned a series of joint events including continuing and activating the exchange of delegations.
The participation of the delegation of the United Russia Party in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK marked a significant occasion in further developing the relations between the ruling parties of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation and deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership and alliance between the DPRK and Russia. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un during Visit to Party Founding Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech during a visit to the Party Founding Museum.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades,
Let us think about why we have gathered in front of this house in the lead-up to the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Today our visit here is very significant, since this is the historic house which witnessed the great event of the founding of our Party.
As I stand in front of the birthplace of our Party that still retains its old appearance despite the passage of time, telling of the great history of Party founding, it is quite moving to recollect the emotions of the day of 80 years ago.
This small and simple house is where the ever-victorious history of the WPK, which has greatly transformed the destiny of our country and our people, started; and this humble place housed the supreme General Staff of the Korean revolution, which led them to make a grand start towards building a powerful socialist country. To think of this, I cannot suppress the surging emotion.
This is a sincere and warm feeling that can be felt only by the later generation who, cherishing the value of the ennobling soul embodied in the birth of the revolutionary Party and the first pages of its great history, have left proud imprints for the present and future of our country through a worthwhile struggle to carry forward its original will.
Availing myself of this significant opportunity, I, reflecting the unanimous feelings of all our Party members and other people, pay the most ennobling tribute to the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungand the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners who paved an original way for building a revolutionary party during the bloody struggle for liberating the country, accomplished the historic cause of founding our revolutionary Party and laid a solid cornerstone for its durable existence and victorious development.
I also express deep appreciation for the contribution made by the Party central leadership members present here, other leading cadres of our Party and state and all the Party organizations and officials, who are doing their utmost to perform the weighty yet honourable missions and duties entrusted to them by the Party and the revolution, and on the 80th anniversary of the Party I extend heartfelt greetings and warm encouragement to all the Party members, who have powerfully propelled the advance of our revolutionary cause with pure Party conscience and through a vanguard role as befitting members of the WPK.
My thanks go to the officials and other employees of this Party Founding Museum and other officials and working people in the revolutionary relics administration sector, who are devoting their sincerity to conveying the glorious history of our Party to posterity.
Comrades,
To proudly open the first pages of the sacred history of the founding of their party and recollect the indelible historic traces of exploration for a great ideology, strenuous exertion and heroic struggle-this is not something that anyone can do.
It is a special honour given only to the revolutionaries who can review with invariable inheritance the secret behind the glory of the victorious 80-year course they have traversed from one century into the next.
Our Party is proud that it laid the foundations of socialism on this land in the face of manifold challenges and trials, that it is striving hard to build a powerful country, which no one would dare to provoke, and that it has defended the glory of socialism, which must never be buried in history, through an indomitable struggle over the past arduous 80 years. This pride defies any description.
What did make our Party so strong and what did give it the fame of achieving one victory after another without any frustration? This thought leads us to solemnly look up at this low-roofed house and look back upon the annals of those great decades.
At this special and auspicious moment of greeting the 80th anniversary of the Party at a watershed of new development and prosperity, looking back upon the decades of Party founding and inheritance will serve as an occasion for renewing the understanding and awareness of the revolutionary obligations and duties of our generation, who have to reach without fail the finish line of the socialist cause that was launched and advanced by the forerunners.
Comrades,
The 80-year history of our Party is so great not only because it was founded in an original way but also because it etched in its banner the socialist ideals of achieving the independence of the masses and invariably held fast to them.
The socialism the generation opted for in the days of taking the first step towards building our Party in the liberated country was Korean-style socialism that conforms to our actual conditions, and the way of building it was from A to Z self-sustenance and self-determination, i.e., believing in the people and relying on their strength.
Having etched the socialist ideology in its guiding ideology on the first day of its founding, our Party has always remained faithful to its ideals and paved an original way for advancing socialist construction in the tempest of such arduous and complicated history.
The Juche-oriented socialist ideology and theory which have displayed their scientific accuracy and vitality in the whole historic course of the socialist revolution and construction in our country demonstrated their unique power in fusing socialism and the people into one and oriented the history of our Party's administration in power towards a history of advancing and emerging victorious together with the people.
The key secret behind our Party's recording of the longest ruling history in the socialist movement lies in the immortal vitality of the people-centred socialist ideology and the thoroughgoing and perfect succession of it.
Our Party's guiding ideology is the socialist ideology which has been further enriched, developed and perfected through the 80-year-long struggle and by the transformations and victories our people and officers and soldiers of our army achieved at the cost of blood.
The acme and true weight of the 80-year history of our Party just lie in having proved that the path we follow together with the people is the road to victory of socialism.
Comrades,
The other important factor that enabled our Party to lead the socialist cause along the most correct road, while recording legendary victories and miraculous events for the past 80 years, is that it has given definite precedence to the building of an original ruling party that makes selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people by regarding them as the source of its life in carrying on the revolution and construction.
The history of our revolution and socialist construction gives clear answers to the questions of how a party, the people and socialism can be bound together with shared destiny, how the party can gain the dignity and fame as an ever-victorious guide and how the ordinary and simple people can become a great people with a strong character and temperament.
Only when it is steadily strengthened and developed politically, organizationally and ideologically and cultivates people-oriented leadership traits and styles of work, can a party fighting for the people can form one organism with them and organize and give the fullest play to their inexhaustible resourcefulness and strength and thus lead the socialist cause to ultimate victory.
The main feature of our Party building is that it has been strengthened and developed into a political General Staff fused with the people, while forming the most solid body that is ideologically pure and integral whole in organization and action and conducting its activities among the masses of the people by putting forward the people-centred revolutionary ideology as its guiding ideology and ideals.
As it has oriented everything to definitely ensuring the uniformity of ideology and leadership and fully embodied the people-oriented leadership traits in its work and activities, our Party has been able to develop into the most powerful and prestigious political force in the history of revolutionary party building and achieve the historic cause of training the people to be the independent driving force of socialism.
Our Party formulated the people-first principle as its political ideals and mode, made sure that making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people was established as its unchangeable trait, and particularly brought the discipline building and work style building to the fore, as its ruling history got longer, socialist construction intensified and generations changed, thereby making it possible to overcome laxity of discipline, abuse of power, bureaucracy and accumulation of wealth by illicit means which might be revealed within the Party.
Also, historically, our Party was strengthened into a more militant leading political organization through the struggle for establishing the Juche orientation in ideology in the postwar days and different rounds of self-purification process including the anti-factionalist struggle, and every time the people came to infinitely trust and support it and brought about periods of upsurge unprecedented in the history of socialist construction, being rallied firmly behind it.
It is a distinguished feat our Party etched in the human history of political parties that it created a new appearance of a genuine party that all the people love and defend like their own lives by throwing in their lot with it.
The five-point line of Party building in the new era constitutes a permanent charter for its building which enables our Party to boost its fighting efficiency and leadership abilities in every way while enjoying the high prestige as the guide for the people and the political General Staff in implementing the socialist cause.
In the course of reversing adversity and ordeals into victory and miracles, there were formed the purest and most powerful lineage of ideology and revolutionary traditions peculiar to the WPK, which can never be swayed, revised or discoloured.
The 80-year history of the WPK which has led the state and the people to socialism has left an iron truth of victory to be immortal for all ages and precious spiritual wealth.
It is that the Party, socialism and people are a community of shared destiny and that a party that always relies on the people and serves them and regards their trust and expectations as its lifeblood wins victory after victory forever enjoying their absolute support.
Along with this great truth, the ability of courageous leadership and the mode of struggle of the WPK, which has put the prestige of our state and people on the apex of the world and is ushering in an era of unprecedented transformations for the comprehensive development of socialism, illuminate the road of victory and glory that the present generation is following and our coming generations will continue to follow.
Comrades,
Since its eighth-term Central Committee, our Party has followed a new trajectory to achieve the comprehensive development of socialism.
In view of our ideals and objectives, we should innovate at a much faster pace than now; we should adopt a bolder approach and make redoubled, devoted efforts to transform all realms, all sectors and all regions in a decade.
The extraordinary political awareness and strenuous exertion of all the people, who have achieved unity on the strength of patriotism and turned all out in this endeavour, constitute the greatest of our capabilities, the most definite of our advantages and the highest of our potentials.
The speed and quality of our state's comprehensive development are determined by how much its citizens, linking their destiny to their country's and taking on the responsibility for the present and future of their state, display patriotism and loyalty in making efforts to produce the best possible results of their work.
Ours is a state of all the people, one being built by them all; as in the past, so in the future, too, it will be.
In the future, too, as we find solutions to all the theoretical and practical problems concerning Party and state affairs, our supreme principle and our cardinal standard should be to prepare all our people as befitting a powerful dynamic force opening up the present era.
The primary task facing us in leading all the people to advance along the road of victory for the cause of achieving the comprehensive development of socialism is to intensify, at a new high, the efforts to implement the five-point line of Party building in the new era, with a view to improving our Party's features, organizing abilities and fighting efficiency.
We should steadily step up political building to improve the Party's fighting efficiency and leadership abilities in every way. By doing so, we can ensure that all the people's patriotic enthusiasm and resourcefulness, as well as all the sectors' capabilities and potentials, are committed to achieving the comprehensive development of socialism under the unified leadership of the Party Central Committee.
To streamline the ranks of cadres and build up Party ranks as an elite force should be our crucial, core task for defending the lineage of the Party; we should ensure utmost prudence and perfection in carrying out this task so that ours will become a steel-strong party on a solid organizational and ideological basis.
What is important in this respect is to adopt an innovative approach towards improving the methods of Party work as required by the changing circumstances of the times and the level of the people's consciousness. In this way we can develop Party work into something novel and proactive, which is effective in understanding the public sentiments and leading them.
We should continually bolster and refine the Party's leadership abilities, fighting efficiency and art of leadership.
How seasoned a revolutionary party is depends not on the long span of its history, but on how hard it works to improve its leadership abilities and fighting efficiency, always aware of the weighty mission it has to perform in leading the cause of socialism as the political General Staff.
We should formulate in a systematic way, and use to good effect, the skills and methods of leadership, the traits of Party work and the habits of Party life, all of which have been displayed by our Party in its ruling history spanning eight decades. Furthermore, we should be active in creating and applying exemplary methods and styles of Party leadership in the new era to make our Party's ruling power absolute.
We should continue to firmly consolidate strict order and sound discipline climate within the Party, while giving precedence to the process of finding out and eliminating in time all sorts of elements and acts that undermine the Party's leadership prestige.
As I have emphasized on various occasions, cadres have very heavy and important responsibilities and duties in giving a strong impetus to the comprehensive development period which can be called the second era of nation building.
Today we need the same spirit, courage and self-confidence as we had at the time when the Party and a new country were built.
Leading officials of the Party and the state should keep the Party's original ideals and spirit as their mental attributes, have a correct understanding of the requirements of the times and reality and the essence and core of the Party's policies, and firmly cherish the intrinsic nature of the communists who shoulder their responsibilities while directly connecting all issues to the future of the Party and the state.
Success in work depends on how cadres play their role.
They should regard it as their political principle and iron rule to assume full responsibility for the work of their sectors and units.
They should lead the masses to have firm confidence from the outset through correct planning and organizational work for the implementation of the Party's policies, not by words. They should have the ability to organically combine Party guidance with economic and technical guidance to give the fullest play to the masses' strength and wisdom. They should also encourage the masses, through principled and fair reviews and appraisals, to feel by themselves the worth of and pride in their life and make redoubled efforts. Only such officials can lead the masses and make all of them genuine masters of their workplaces.
The change in the cadres' viewpoint on the masses, moral traits and style of work should precede the change in their way of thinking and abilities.
Our Party will accelerate the advance of the revolution, sweeping away all evil practices such as ignorance, incompetence, irresponsibility, self-protection, formalism and expediency, as well as arbitrariness, high-handedness and abuse of power which are rejected by the people and cause damage to socialism, the practices revealed among officials.
Only excellent cadres who live with the revolution, defend the revolution and lead their work correctly to the goals set, persons who are enterprising, heroic and staunch enough to brave any difficulties, can lead this current era.
When we feel tired and when we need greater courage, we should take to heart the spirit and fighting will of the Party-founding generation, who held high the red flag only in their empty hands and cut their way through bloody battles to bring about a new world of communism, and should display high enthusiasm for the revolution.
We should not suspend our struggle but continue to wage the revolution until we achieve the complete victory of socialism, successfully realize the ideals of our people and attain the ultimate goal of our revolution.
We are endeavouring for the loftiest cause and willingly sacrificing everything for the sake of it.
Let us struggle more staunchly for the great prosperity of our state with ardent revolutionary enthusiasm and courage to advance towards a greater victory, finding the worth of waging the revolution in overcoming difficulties without fearing hardships.
Comrades,
Indeed, it is a proud thing that, at this historic house where the Party was founded, we can recall the course the Party has followed from one century to the next and make a pledge to give steady continuity to the great course forever at this house.
Just as we proudly recall here today the road we have followed, we will continue to greet the days when we will look back with pride here again upon the arduous road ahead of us.
This historic house will shine forever as a sacred sanctuary which carries on the lineage of the WPK and its ever-victorious traditions for all ages.
Long live the Workers' Party of Korea! -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on October 7.
The message said:
Dear ComradeKim Jong Un,
I, on behalf of the Lao party, government and people, extend warm congratulations and wishes to you, Comrade, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, all its members and the fraternal Korean people on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK (October 10, 1945-October 10, 2025).
We are proud and pleased that the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the fraternal Korean people have achieved comprehensive and great successes in firmly defending the gains of the revolution, safeguarding political stability, strengthening national defence and security work, steadily developing the economy and improving the people's standard of living step by step and, at the same time, enhancing the role and influence of your country in the regional and international arenas under the bold and powerful leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
We are firmly convinced that the Korean people will achieve greater fresh successes in carrying out the cause for defending the state and steadily developing it under the wise leadership of the WPK headed by Comrade General Secretary
Kim Jong Un, successor to the great Juche idea.
I hope that the long-standing traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, two states and two peoples of Laos and the DPRK provided by the respected PresidentKim Il Sungand President Kaysone Phomvihane will continue to grow stronger by the leadership and peoples of the two countries, thus bringing benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contributing to peace, stability and the development of cooperative relations in the region and the rest of the world.
Taking this auspicious opportunity, I wish you, Comrade
Kim Jong Un, good health and happiness and success in carrying out the noble cause.
Yours sincerely. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from President of United Russia Party
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev on October 8.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend sincere congratulations to you on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The WPK, which made a decisive contribution to the nation- building of the DPRK, is becoming a core force of social life under your wise leadership and playing a guiding role in defending the country's sovereignty, independence and security.
The United Russia Party highly appreciates the constructive and trustworthy dialogue with the WPK based on the agreement on mutual collaboration and cooperation concluded on October 25, 2018.
I am convinced that we will achieve the great fruition with joint efforts in accomplishing the cause to jointly oppose neo-colonialist practices and interference in internal affairs of the states and preserve historical memories for the wellbeing of the peoples of our two countries consolidated by the bonds of militant friendship.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I hope that you would enjoy good health, everything would go well and the WPK would achieve prosperity and new successes. -0-

headline: Delegation of Russian Ministry of Culture Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation arrived here on October 8 to visit the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the invitation of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The delegation includes Russian popular singers Shaman and Aleksandra Vorobiyoba and her party, and artistes of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M. E. Pyatnichki and the "Todec" Ballet Theater Named after Alla Duhoba and the Air and Space Forces Ensemble of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.
The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by officials of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK, officials concerned and the minister-councilor of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Farmers of Songha Sericulture Farm in DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- Farmers of the Songha Sericulture Farm in Songgan County, Jagang Province, the DPRK, moved into new houses.
The cozy modern dwellings in which modernity, cultural refinement and diversity were applied tell about the warm love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making a long journey of devoted service for the people's wellbeing to provide the agricultural workers with a more civilized and happier life.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses were officials of Jagang Province and Songgan County, builders and agricultural workers who are to move into new houses.
A congratulatory speech was made at the ceremony, and licenses for using houses were handed over. Then resolution-taking speeches were made.
As a congratulatory performance was given and the farm village was in festive mood, officials visited the families of the agricultural workers who were moving into new houses, and shared joy with them. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Party Founding Museum and Makes Significant Speech on Occasion of 80th Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) is greeting its 80th founding anniversary on its militant journey to dynamically lead to a new victory the building of socialism and communism, the aspiration and ideal of the people, putting the dignity and prestige of the DPRK on the acme of 5 000-year-long history with its ever-victorious leadership.
The WPK has performed undying feats before the country and people, purely preserving the Party's original ideals and spirit and perfectly inheriting them since it was founded as the vanguard of the revolution representing the demands and interests of the working people. The history of the WPK that has believed in the people as in Heaven, its history of creation and change is shining brilliantly in the world.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Party Founding Museum on October 8 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Members of the central leadership body of the Party including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, officials of the WPK Central Committee and leading officials of the Party committees of ministries and national institutions also visited the museum.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the museum, all the visitors broke into enthusiastic cheers with the pleasure of greeting him, who is ushering in the new era of comprehensive prosperity of the state, demonstrating the immortal dignity and honor of the WPK with his outstanding revolutionary idea and experienced and seasoned leadership, in the sacred place of the revolution where the cause of founding the Party was accomplished.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech.
Expressing his feelings of visiting the old home, where the ever-victorious history of the WPK started and the supreme General Staff of the Korean revolution which led the great start towards a powerful socialist country was situated, ahead of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, he paid the most ennobling tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners who pioneered the original road of building a revolutionary party during the bloody struggle for liberating the country, accomplished the historic cause of founding the revolutionary Party and laid a solid cornerstone for its durable existence and victorious development.
Looking back upon the decades of Party founding and inheritance at this special and auspicious moment of greeting its 80th anniversary at the watershed of new development and prosperity will serve as an occasion for renewing the understanding and awareness of the revolutionary obligations and duties of our generation, who have to reach without fail the finish line of the socialist cause that was started and advanced by the forerunners, he said.
Noting that the 80-year history of our Party is so great not only because it was founded in an original way but also because it etched in its banner the socialist ideals of achieving the independence of masses and invariably held fast to it, he theoretically explained the journey peculiar to the WPK which has pioneered an original road of socialist construction from the first day of its founding, with self-sustenance and self-determination, i.e. believing in the people and relying on their strength from A to Z and enunciated the fundamental secret, in which the WPK has been able to record the longest ruling history in the history of socialist movement, the main characteristics of party building and the prominent exploits it has recorded in the human history of political parties.
Saying that the dynamic leadership and mode of struggle of the WPK which formed the purest, the most powerful ideological lineage and the revolutionary tradition peculiar to it and left the immutable truth about eternal victory and valuable spiritual assets in the course of turning adversities and trials into victory and miracles are illuminating the road of victory and glory to be followed by the present generation and rising generation, he indicated the ideals and prospective goal of the WPK in building a state and developing the Party, the orientation of struggle to realize them and overall principles in the comprehensive development period which can be called the second era of nation building.
Saying that it is a proud thing to recall the course the Party has followed from one century to the next at this historic house where the Party was founded and to make a pledge to give steady continuity to the great course forever for all ages, he affirmed that the Party Founding Museum would shine forever as the sacred sanctuary which carries on the lineage of the WPK and its ever-victorious tradition for all ages.
When he finished his speech, all the participants paid the greatest tribute to him, raising the thunderous cheers of "hurrah!" out of their boundless respect for and trust in the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution who is ushering in the great heyday of the Party building in the new era and the socialist cause with his profound ideological and theoretical activities and energetic leadership practice.
The important speech made byKim Jong Unserves as the immortal revolutionary programme and the banner of vigorous advance as it clarified the guidelines for firmly carrying forward forever the noble political ideal of the WPK put forth in the initial days of founding the Party and for the WPK to further demonstrate its might as the most dignified socialist ruling Party which has taken the deep root in the popular masses.
Kim Jong Unlooked round with deep emotion various places of the museum.
Saying that the eternity and invincibility of the vitality and the leadership of the Party depends on how the noble ideals and the revolutionary nature of the Party founding are preserved and glorified as the revolution is achieving victory after victory, he stressed that our Party should cherish more deeply the noble sense of responsibility and mission for the destiny of the country and the people and powerfully lead the state and the people to fresh peak of victory and glory with enthusiastic spirit and inexhaustible vitality and without decrepitude and discoloration, maintaining its purity, even though a generation is replaced by another.
Expressing the belief that officials, lecturers and employees of the museum would as ever remain faithful to their duty as powerful information workers and educators, who are acquainting the masses with the glorious history and tradition of our Party, with the pride and honor of defending the sacred place associated with the exploits of the President in Party building, he had a meaningful photo session with them.
All the participants pledged to carry forward the lineage and immortal reputation of the WPK for all ages by thoroughly implementing the original Party-building idea and line ofKim Jong Un, cherishing the boundless loyalty to revolution and spirit of devoted service to the people, displayed by the pioneering generation of the cause of Party building, as their lifeblood. -0-

headline: Director of International Kim Il Sung Prize Council and International Kim Jong Il Prize Council Arrives
Joint Statement between WPK and URP Adopted
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- A joint statement between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party was adopted on Thursday.
The joint statement was signed by Ri Hi Yong, secretary of the Party Central Committee, on behalf of the WPK, and V.V. Yakushev, secretary of the General Council, on behalf of the URP.
The joint statement said as follows:
The Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party jointly celebrated with splendor the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, the guiding force of the heroic people of the DPRK.
Both sides reaffirmed their will to continue developing the relations between the two parties and the two countries at a high level in the light of the ties of friendship between the peoples of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation and the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries and on the basis of the agreement on exchange and cooperation between the WPK and the URP concluded in Moscow on October 25, 2018.
Both sides shared the views that the mounting political and military tension on the Eurasian continent and the rest of the world is, above all, directly linked to the aggressive politics of the West to continue maintaining at any cost the dangerous and non-constructive line to realize overall hegemonism for only the self-interest of the ruling class and the illegal interference in internal affairs of sovereign states.
In this regard, the United Russia Party expressed firm support for the measures taken by the leadership of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to bolster up the country's defence capabilities.
The WPK expressed firm solidarity with Russia's stand on the issue of coordinating the crisis in Ukraine and full support for the special military operations being conducted by the Russian armed forces.
The United Russia Party expressed sincere thanks to the WPK and the leadership of the DPRK for making a decision on dispatching units of the Korean People's Army to Kursk Region and taking part in the operations for liberating the region from the robbers of the Kiev authorities.
The Russian people will always remember the feats of the officers and soldiers of the Korean People's Army who displayed distinguished bravery and heroism in the fight against the occupiers.
Both sides reached a consensus of views on the common goal for jointly coping with the attempts to distort historical events and struggling against the forces disturbing peace and stability in Northeast Asia including the Korean peninsula, revival of fascism and Nazi ideas and neocolonialist acts persistently committed by the West.
It is necessary to defend and promote the establishment of a new world order in which the rights of all countries and peoples are reliably guaranteed without coercion from the West.
Both sides expressed their intention to strengthen the ties through active dialogue between the party central bodies, between regional organizations and between the activists of the basic party cells in order to implement the already reached agreements, and planned a series of joint events including continuing and activating the exchange of delegations.
The participation of the delegation of the United Russia Party in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK marked a significant occasion in further developing the relations between the ruling parties of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation and deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership and alliance between the DPRK and Russia. -0-

headline: 80th Founding Anniversary of WPK Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun, Josoninmingun and Chongnyon Jonwi carry a joint editorial on Thursday on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The leadership of the great Party is the strength and victory of Juche Korea, the editorial says, and goes on:
The WPK, which has recorded the longest ruling history of socialism by leading the state and people with responsibility for the Korean revolution, is greeting its 80th founding anniversary.
The WPK was founded at a time when new Korea raised the anchor of the history. This was a turning point in carving out the destiny of the country and its people and developing their future.
The 80-year-long history of the WPK is a proud history in which it has regarded the great Juche idea as its guidelines and won victory after victory by dint of its truth.
In the period when all manner of arguments and isms were rampant over the path of a new country after its liberation, our Party solved all problems from the Juche-oriented standpoint and thus accomplished the great cause of nation building in such a short span of time.
With its Juche-oriented faith and will, the WPK created the myth of war victory in which rifles defeated A-bomb, brought about the great Chollima upswing from scratch by rejecting the interference and pressure of outside forces after the war and chose the road of simultaneously developing the two fronts it covered in accelerating socialist construction with arms in one hand and hammer and sickle in the other.
The WPK's 80-year-long history is the one of the revolutionary leadership of the socialist ruling party which clearly proved before the times and history that socialism is a science and its victory is a science.
It has built an industrial state with powerful potentials for development by realizing socialist industrialization just in 14 years.
By firmly adhering to the principle of collectivism, it fully displayed the advantages of Korean-style socialism and its institutional superiority.
The DPRK people have cherished socialism as their lives, life and future before it is any political ideal or mode in the struggle of the Party which has steadily enforced socialist policies and continued to promote the people's rights and interests and wellbeing even in the difficult period since its founding.
The WPK's 80-year-long history is an honorable history in which it has firmly defended the dignity and peace of the state and the people, winning victory after victory in the showdown with imperialism.
The great victory in the Fatherland Liberation War in which the young DPRK confronted with the U.S.-led imperialist aggression forces was the first historic victory our Party and people achieved in the showdown with imperialism after the party founding.
It is a great victory that it defeated the formidable enemy, but the greater victory than it is to prevent war and guarantee eternal peace.
Our Party has made our people lead a stable life without war and made the sky of our country clear and blue at all times in the biggest hotbed in the world. This is the greatest feat of our Party.
The WPK is a genuine people's Party which has struggled for the people in reliance on them for 80 years.
The people-first principle is the essence of the original idea and spirit of our Party.
When the people are under difficult and hardship conditions, the Party stands by the people first and provides the ordinary people with new houses free of charge and the Party always pursues policies for the people, taking care of and supporting them. Such era can be ushered in only by our Party.
The past ten-odd years, which have ushered in a great and dynamic new era in the 80-year-long leadership history of the WPK, occupy a distinguished place.
The new era of the Juche revolution is an epoch-making one in which the Party makes the state, people and future great through brilliant succession, new pioneering and profound changes.
Thanks to the Party, we exist and there are socialism and the future of the country. This is just the main review of 80-year-long history of the Party and the faith of our people confidently looking forward to the victory in the forthcoming 80, 800 and 8 000 years.
The great WPK is the dignity, strength and future of our state and people. -0-

headline: On-line Seminar of Latin American and Caribbean Region Held in Mexico
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- An on-line seminar of Latin American and Caribbean Region "Invincible Workers' Party of Korea becoming harmonious whole with popular masses" took place in Mexico on September 30 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
The seminar was co-sponsored by the Latin American and Caribbean Regional Committee for Solidarity with the DPRK and the Mexico-Korea Solidarity Committee.
Present there were personages of political parties, organizations for friendship and solidarity, organizations for the study of the Juche idea and institutions of Mexico, Brazil, Venezuela, Ecuador, Colombia and Peru.
The chairperson of the Mexico-Korea Solidarity Committee made a keynote report at the seminar.
The WPK has become a powerful Party supported and trusted by the people and a motherly Party entirely taking care of the destiny of the people, the reporter said, adding that this would be unthinkable apart from the guidance of the prominent leaders who founded the revolutionary idea centered on the popular masses and thoroughly applied it to the Party building and activities,.
The reporter praised the undying feats of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwhich will always go down in the history of building the WPK, saying that history knows no such politicians as the leaders of the DPRK who founded and developed the genuine people's party and made it possible for the party to pursue the most genuine and excellent politics for the people by relying on the inexhaustible strength of the popular masses.
H.E.Kim Jong Unset forth the wisest line and policies for the happiness and prosperity of the people and is energetically working to realize them, the reporter said, adding that the single-minded unity of all the people overcoming all hardships, rallied close around the leader, is an appearance peculiar to the DPRK which cannot be found in any other parts of the world.
The general secretary of the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the chairman of the Mexico-Korea Friendship Association, a director of the Brazil-Korea Friendship Association, the chairman of the Venezuelan Committee for Solidarity with the DPRK, the chairman of the Venezuelan Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, the chairman of the Committee for Solidarity with the DPRK in Ecuador, the chairman of the Ecuador-Guaranda Institute for Friendship and Cultural Solidarity with the Korean People, the chairman of the Colombia-Korea Friendship Association and the chairman of the GeneralKim Jong IlPeruvian Amicable Institute made speeches at the seminar.
A congratulatory message to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the seminar.
The message said that the WPK, which has invariably preserved its revolutionary nature for 80 years, is the most powerful party and a model of the world progressive political parties.
The message highly praised the personality ofKim Jong Unas a peerlessly great man who is wisely leading the struggle to firmly defend the destiny of the country and people, adding that it is a pleasure for the progressive people to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK together with the DPRK people. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on Oct. 10.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations and beautiful wishes to you, Comrade General Secretary, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and all the WPK members and other Korean people on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and on my own behalf on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Over the past 80 years the Workers' Party of Korea has achieved proud successes by rallying and leading the Korean people while overcoming difficulties and trials and promoting the socialist cause of Korea through enterprising efforts.
In recent years Comrade General Secretary has made positive efforts to strengthen party building, develop the economy and improve the people's living standards by leading the Party and people of the DPRK.
I wish the DPRK would make fresh success one after another in its socialist cause and greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with victory under the firm leadership of the WPK headed by Comrade General Secretary.
China and the DPRK are both socialist countries led by the communist party.
In recent years, I and Comrade General Secretary have taken the helm of the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries and opened up a new chapter of China-DPRK friendship through several meetings.
Some days ago, Comrade General Secretary visited China and attended the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the Victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
I and Comrade General Secretary had deep talks and indicated the way for further developing the China-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation.
No matter how the international situation may change, it is the consistent policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop China-DPRK relations.
The Chinese side is ready to contribute, together with the DPRK side, to the cause of socialist construction in the two countries and make positive contributions to peace, stability, development and prosperity of the region and the rest of the world by promoting the steady development of China-DPRK relations through strengthening of strategic communication, deepening of working-level collaboration and close coordination and cooperation.
I hope you, Comrade General Secretary, enjoy good health and everything goes well.
I wish the Workers' Party of Korea greater successes one after another.
I hope the China-DPRK friendship will shine long. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in International Seminar on Juche Idea
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the participants in the international seminar on the Juche idea on October 9.
The letter said that the DPRK is shining brilliantly due to its great international prestige in the world arena even in the prevailing complicated international political situation. It is because His ExcellencyKim Jong Un, who has personified the ideas and leadership ability of the great leaders, devotes himself to the people, finds himself among them and leads the country by dint of their strength, the letter added.
The letter noted that the respected His Excellency's participation in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War serves as an epochal occasion that powerfully encouraged progressive mankind in their struggle for independence and justice.
It said that the Juche idea followers in the world were greatly excited to seeKim Jong Unstanding in the front row of the ceremony attended by heads of state of different countries, adding that they came to feel once again the pride of their life as they have taken the only road of independence and justice indicated by His Excellency under the complicated situation and the responsibility and duty they have assumed as the followers of the Juche idea.
The seminar fully proved that the Juche idea founded and developed in depth by the great PresidentKim Il Sungand the great leaderKim Jong Ilwill be the immortal banner for building a just and peaceful world in the future, too, thanks to His ExcellencyKim Jong Un, and that the Workers' Party of Korea will demonstrate before the world its might as the defender of independence, justice and peace, the letter said.
Thanks to the outstanding leadership of His Excellency, the country of Juche shines and the future of not only the DPRK people but also the world people is bright, the letter said, sincerely wishing him good health for the victory of the people's struggle for independence. -0-

headline: Talks between Secretary of C.C., WPK and President of URP Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Talks between Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Dmitri Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on October 9.
Present there from the DPRK side were Ri Hi Yong, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Song Nam, alternate member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations of the DPRK, and officials concerned, and from the Russian side Vladimir Yakushev, secretary of the General Council  of the United Russia Party and first vice-chairman of the Russian Federation Council, Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology of Russia, and members of the delegation of the United Russia Party.
The talks appreciated that the bonds of friendship between the ruling parties and peoples of the two countries are being further deepened with the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK as a momentum.
Expressed there were the will to steadily boost many-sided exchange and cooperation between the WPK and the URP as required by the new era of development of the DPRK-Russia relations ushered in thanks to the leadership of the heads of state of the two countries and thus make a positive contribution to further enriching the bilateral relations.
At the end of the talks, a joint statement for the development of relations between the Workers' Party of Korea and the United Russia Party was adopted.
The joint statement was signed by Ri Hi Yong, secretary of the C.C., WPK, on behalf of the WPK, and Vladimir Yakushev, secretary of the General Council, on behalf of the URP. -0-

headline: C.C., WPK Hosts Reception in Welcome of Delegation of URP
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea hosted a reception at the Kumsusan State Guesthouse on Thursday evening in welcome of the visiting delegation of the United Russia Party.
Present there on invitation were Dmitri Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, members of the delegation and members of the Russian embassy here.
Present there were Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior Party and government officials.
Jo Yong Won made a speech at the reception.
Warmly welcoming the delegation of the United Russia Party led by Dmitri Medvedev on a visit to Pyongyang to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK together with the DPRK people, he stressed that the current visit is an expression of sincere congratulation and support of the Russian leadership and people to the WPK, the DPRK and its people.
Noting that the militant fraternity, friendship and solidarity between the DPRK and Russia are now developing onto a new high stage, fully displaying their might as an invincible alliance and relations of comrades-in-arms under the strategic guidance of the heads of state of the two countries, he expressed the belief that the cooperation between the ruling parties of the DPRK and Russia would consolidate the ties between the peoples of the two countries and add a fresh vitality to the strengthening of the comprehensive strategic partnership.
Then Dmitri Medvedev made a speech.
He expressed his sincere thanks to the WPK Central Committee for inviting him to visit the DPRK to take part in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and cordially according him.
Noting that the great feats the DPRK people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army performed for the operation to liberate Kursk Region will remain in the minds of the Russian people forever and be recorded as a noble part of the history of Russia, he expressed the will to further strengthen the many-sided cooperation between the two parties for the Russia-DPRK friendship.
The participants toasted to the health ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and the wellbeing and prosperity of the fraternal peoples of the two countries.
The reception proceeded in a comradely and amicable atmosphere. -0-

headline: International Seminar on Juche Idea Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- The international seminar on the Juche idea concerning the immortal banner of building a just and peaceful world was held here on October 8 and 9 under the co-sponsorship of the International Institute of the Juche Idea and the Korean Association of Social Scientists on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were Harish Gupta and Matteo Carbonelli, vice-director generals of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, and delegations and delegates of organizations for the study of the Juche idea from different countries and regions and a delegation of Korean social scientists in Japan.
Also present there were Thae Hyong Chol, president of the Academy of Social Sciences who doubles as first vice-chairman of the Korean Association of Social Scientists, and scientists in the field of social sciences.
Harish Gupta made an opening address at the seminar to be followed by a congratulatory speech of Thae Hyong Chol.
They said the history proved the truth that independence is the only way for a nation to live and for a country to prosper, and when independence is maintained, the genuine dignity of nation and the happy future of the rising generation can be guaranteed, expressing belief that the seminar would be a significant occasion for more deeply grasping the essence of the Juche idea and powerfully propelling the progressive people of different countries to the building of an ideal society of mankind.
Matteo Carbonelli made a keynote report.
The reporter said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclearly indicated the scientific fighting strategy and practical programmes for building a just and peaceful new world and opening up a new chapter for the development of international relations under the uplifted banner of socialism and independence against imperialism.
Noting that the DPRK is powerfully demonstrating its dignity and might while maintaining the independent stand in the international arena and steering the struggle of progressive mankind to establish a just world order under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, he stressed that such reality further highlights the historic mission of the pioneers of the times and the Juche idea followers.
Speeches were made.
The speakers said that the WPK has ushered in its heyday of strengthening the whole Party by thoroughly applying the revolutionary idea of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto the revolution and construction and steadfastly carrying forward the Party's original ideals and spirit, thus opening up a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation in which the people's dreams and wishes come true.
They highly praised the revolutionary idea of ComradeKim Jong Un, which is displaying great vitality and attractive power in accomplishing the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence, as the beacon of hope of progressive mankind.
Convinced that progressive mankind would invariably advance along the road of independence and justice and a new society free from exploitation, oppression and subordination would surely be built thanks to the great idea of the times which illuminates the way ahead them and the Workers' Party of Korea, the light of the world and the signpost of struggle, they expressed the will to conduct more positive activities for studying and disseminating the Juche idea in relevant countries and regions.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the seminar. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, received a message of greeting from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, on Oct. 10.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations and beautiful wishes to you, Comrade General Secretary, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and all the WPK members and other Korean people on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and on my own behalf on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Over the past 80 years the Workers' Party of Korea has achieved proud successes by rallying and leading the Korean people while overcoming difficulties and trials and promoting the socialist cause of Korea through enterprising efforts.
In recent years Comrade General Secretary has made positive efforts to strengthen party building, develop the economy and improve the people's living standards by leading the Party and people of the DPRK.
I wish the DPRK would make fresh success one after another in its socialist cause and greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with victory under the firm leadership of the WPK headed by Comrade General Secretary.
China and the DPRK are both socialist countries led by the communist party.
In recent years, I and Comrade General Secretary have taken the helm of the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries and opened up a new chapter of China-DPRK friendship through several meetings.
Some days ago, Comrade General Secretary visited China and attended the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the Victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.
I and Comrade General Secretary had deep talks and indicated the way for further developing the China-DPRK relations of friendship and cooperation.
No matter how the international situation may change, it is the consistent policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop China-DPRK relations.
The Chinese side is ready to contribute, together with the DPRK side, to the cause of socialist construction in the two countries and make positive contributions to peace, stability, development and prosperity of the region and the rest of the world by promoting the steady development of China-DPRK relations through strengthening of strategic communication, deepening of working-level collaboration and close coordination and cooperation.
I hope you, Comrade General Secretary, enjoy good health and everything goes well.
I wish the Workers' Party of Korea greater successes one after another.
I hope the China-DPRK friendship will shine long. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Participants in International Seminar on Juche Idea
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the participants in the international seminar on the Juche idea on October 9.
The letter said that the DPRK is shining brilliantly due to its great international prestige in the world arena even in the prevailing complicated international political situation. It is because His ExcellencyKim Jong Un, who has personified the ideas and leadership ability of the great leaders, devotes himself to the people, finds himself among them and leads the country by dint of their strength, the letter added.
The letter noted that the respected His Excellency's participation in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War serves as an epochal occasion that powerfully encouraged progressive mankind in their struggle for independence and justice.
It said that the Juche idea followers in the world were greatly excited to seeKim Jong Unstanding in the front row of the ceremony attended by heads of state of different countries, adding that they came to feel once again the pride of their life as they have taken the only road of independence and justice indicated by His Excellency under the complicated situation and the responsibility and duty they have assumed as the followers of the Juche idea.
The seminar fully proved that the Juche idea founded and developed in depth by the great PresidentKim Il Sungand the great leaderKim Jong Ilwill be the immortal banner for building a just and peaceful world in the future, too, thanks to His ExcellencyKim Jong Un, and that the Workers' Party of Korea will demonstrate before the world its might as the defender of independence, justice and peace, the letter said.
Thanks to the outstanding leadership of His Excellency, the country of Juche shines and the future of not only the DPRK people but also the world people is bright, the letter said, sincerely wishing him good health for the victory of the people's struggle for independence. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance for Celebrating WPK Founding Anniversary Given in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Songs our people sing in praise of our guiding Party, which has glorified the 80 years of victory and glory with the sacred Party's original ideals and spirit, are reverberating through the whole country. The Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea" for celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea was given with splendor at the May Day Stadium on Thursday evening.
The venue of the performance on Rungna Islet, which will beautifully and colorfully celebrate the founding anniversary of the great motherly Party, was filled with joy and excitement of citizens of Pyongyang, youth and students and service personnel.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the performance.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium with heads of parties and governments of different countries, enthusiastic cheers shook the night sky of the capital city.
Among the audience were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, participants in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, members of overseas compatriots' congratulatory groups and delegations and overseas compatriots.
Present there on invitation were members of the party and government delegations of different countries, delegations of international democratic organizations and organizations for the study of the Juche idea, diplomatic envoys here, families of overseas Koreans related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle and foreign guests.
The grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance started solemnly. The emblem of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK was shining brilliantly, representing the absolute dignity and prestige of the WPK which has recorded the longest ruling history of socialism under the banner of the great Juche idea, and the fierce torch was flaring up, like the flame started with the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union, the root of our Party.
The performance depicted in a grand epic style the great history of the genuine people's Party, the ever-victorious WPK, which has covered the sacred long road of the people-first principle without a moment's veering, weathering the storm of the grim revolution, since the day of 80 years ago when the Party took the responsibility of the destiny of the people under the uplifted red flag fluttered in Mt Paektu and set the realization of all the ideals of the people as its original ideal.
To the tune of songs of struggle and advance resounded in every period of the revolution, the performers presented vigorous gymnastics and elegant dance movements in high praise of the immortal exploits of our Party, which has led the socialist cause of Juche to steady success and victories by regarding the people as the root of its existence and arousing the inexhaustible spiritual strength of the masses.
Songs praising the great era ofKim Jong Unwhich has witnessed unprecedentedly great victories and changes since the founding of the Party and the nation revved up the atmosphere of the performance.
The audience was deeply moved by the scenes of the grand mass gymnastics reflecting miracles being created day by day by racing against time in the new heyday of strengthening the whole Party when the leadership ability of the WPK is given fullest play and in a new era of self-respect and prosperity when the might of self-reliance and single-minded unity, the tradition and lifeline of the revolution, brings about the comprehensive prosperity of the state.
The audience was overcome with boundless emotion and joy, mesmerized by the bright and happy images of the new generations growing up stoutly, bringing all dreams and hopes into full bloom, under the warm care of the fatherly Marshal who gives precedence to the training of the younger generation above all state affairs and cultivates the rosy future of the country with his great love and devotion.
Children presented bouquets of best wishes to MarshalKim Jong Un, reflecting the unbounded gratitude of the children and students across the country.
Kim Jong Unsent warm blessings to all the performers singing in chorus the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" with joy and happiness.
The audience was greatly delighted to see dance movements and stunts reflecting the excellent traditional culture, customs and martial traits of the Korean people, which the performers presented to the tune of folk songs "Moran Hill" and "My Prospering Country".
A powerful ceremony of the combined military band made the audience feel boundless patriotic enthusiasm to more firmly defend and eternally and wholeheartedly uphold our greatest socialist country in the world where the independent dignity of the people and their genuine lives are guaranteed.
The performers vividly depicted with background images, gymnastic movements and dances the militant spirit of the powerful Juche-oriented revolutionary army which has been developed and strengthened under great care of the peerlessly great men, the world's strongest Korean People's Army holding the peerlessly illustrious commander in high esteem. They showed that the only powerful strength is the firm guarantee for defending justice and peace and that the DPRK will further bolster up the matchless war deterrent for the country and the people and for peace and prosperity of all generations to come.
The performance reached its climax with torchlight gymnastics and song "We Are Koreans" reflecting the firm faith and revolutionary will of the DPRK people to accomplish the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army without fail with the wisdom and courage of Koreans, staking the honor of their times and generation, and dynamically advance towards a rosy future of socialism and communism.
Through the performance, the audience more keenly realized the immutable truth proven by history that the Party is great and the state and its people are strong as they are led by the outstanding leader and the truth of the revolution that only glory is always in store for the people taking the road of following the WPK even though any storm blows on this land.
The performance, which fully demonstrated the strong desire and enthusiasm of all the people across the country to glorify the powerful socialist country forever, flying high the sacred red flag of the Party as the ever-victorious banner, true to the leadership ofKim Jong Un, the great dignity and absolute strength of the Party and the state, ended with the finale "Our National Flag" amid the display of fireworks.
The grand mass gymnastics with the strong sense of organization, discipline and oneness and the artistic performance which presented a world of impressive and fascinating art with the full combination of beautiful and elegant dances, vocal and instrumental music, acrobatics and stunts, ever-changing lighting and back-ground stand were acclaimed by the audience.
When the performance was over, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" were raised.
Expressing satisfaction over the successful performance showing the sacred 80-year-long history of the WPK and the validity and invincibility of the cause of the Party as a great epical picture,Kim Jong Unextended warm congratulations to all the performers.
The grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance for celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK was an eruption of the boundless thanks of all the people across the country to the great Party which regards the people's laughter and happiness as the most powerful national power and takes care of a great flower garden of the people-first principle on this land and their unshakable pledge to greet every glory in the world on the road of believing in and following the Party forever. -0-
