headline:
Floral Tributes Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il

[2025.10.11.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- All the people of the DPRK who have greeted the significant 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea as a great revolutionary event pay the highest glory to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, founder and builder of the WPK.
Officials, working people, service personnel, school youth and children visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilacross the country to lay flower baskets before the statues.
Flower baskets were laid before the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, ministries, national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions, industrial establishments and universities at all levels in Pyongyang.
The visitors paid homage to the statues of the President and the Chairman.
Flower baskets in the names of institutions, enterprises, units of the KPA and the PSF, and bouquets and flowers were laid before the statues of the great leaders in various parts of the capital includingKim Il SungUniversity and the Mansudae Art Studio.
Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children in other parts of the country visited the statues of the President and the Chairman in their residential areas to pay homage to them. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: State Reception Given to Celebrate 80th Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- A state reception was given at the Mokran House on Oct. 10 to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the reception.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, senior officials of ministries and national agencies, and relevant officials in the foreign affairs sector.
The veteran cadres who had worked for a long time in important posts of the Party, government and armed forces organs were on hand.
Present there on invitation were heads and figures of foreign parties and governments, members of the delegations of different countries and international democratic organizations, foreign guests and heads of congratulatory groups and delegations of overseas compatriots on their visit to the DPRK to take part in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the reception hall, all the participants welcomed him with warm applause of respect.
Jo Yong Won made a speech at the reception.
Upon authorization of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jo Yong Won warmly welcomed foreign goodwill envoys and overseas compatriots who visited Pyongyang to celebrate the auspicious holiday together.
The speaker said that the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK is the culmination of victory and glory provided by the WPK, which has been faithful to the historic mission as the guide of the Juche revolution for realizing independence of the popular masses, and the people boundlessly devoted to accomplishing the cause of the Party. He referred to the great honor and pride of our Party recollecting and reviewing its long course it has followed from one century to the next and its exploits as a history of struggle in which it has shared joy and sorrow with the people.
Our Party is enjoying absolute support and trust from all the Korean people as it has laid an eternal foundation and base for the everlasting dignity and well-being of our people and their descendants, not allowing any other programme or mode of activities except devoted service to the people, he said, adding that the key to victory and future is to value history and tradition and firmly preserve and develop them.
The speaker stressed that our Party would always be faithful to the socialist cause which it has carried out for the good of the people together with the people and at the head of the people and continue to courageously struggle for the fresh and brilliant inheritance and completion.
Jo Yong Won affirmed that our Party is greatly encouraged by the sincere support of the close friends who love justice and support our cause and that it would make responsible efforts to ensure close solidarity and keep pace with each other in realizing the common goal for independence and peace.
All the participants toasted to the peace and well-being of our people and the world people.
The banquet proceeded in an amicable atmosphere full of friendship and fraternity. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Ul Chul, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 8, Kobu-ri, Sonchon County, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK.
The woman centenarian who received the birthday spread on the significant day marking the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea was deeply moved to express gratitude toKim Jong Un.
She had made contribution to the agricultural production with her sincere efforts to live up to the ever-increasing loving care of the Party for decades and, even after becoming pensioner, she has done good things helpful to the country.
Officials of the Sonchon County Committee of the WPK visited her family to share joy with her. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Palestinian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Oct. 10.
The message said:
I extend warm greetings.
We are pleased to extend tender-hearted congratulations to Your Excellency on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the powerful Workers' Party of Korea.
On the occasion of this important occasion, we wish Your Excellency and the members of the Workers' Party of Korea good health and happiness and your country and people greater progress and prosperity.
I pay the highest respect to Your Excellency. -0-

headline: General Secretary of CPV Central Committee To Lam Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, visited Mangyongdae, the sacred place of revolution.
Being briefed on the immortal revolutionary career of PresidentKim Il Sungat the historic old home in Mangyongdae, he looked round the historical relics preserved there.
To Lam had a picture taken in memory of his visit to Mangyongdae.
He also toured the Juche-oriented Musical Art Museum and enjoyed the art performance given by children after looking round the Ho Chi Minh Class of DPRK-Vietnam Friendship Kyongsang Kindergarten -0-

headline: Leading Officials of Party, Government and Armed Forces Organs Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- All the Party members, other working people and service personnel across the DPRK who have greeted the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea are paying the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the founder and builder of our dignified Party and eternal leaders.
Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and military and political officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Oct. 10.
A flower basket in the name of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid before the statues of the President and the Chairman.
Also laid were flower baskets in the names of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK.
The participants paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, the participants paid homage in humble reverence to them.
All the participants firmly pledged to fulfill their mission and duty as the core of the Party and the backbone of the revolution by carrying forward the original ideal and spirit of the Party more thoroughly and devoting themselves to the sacred cause of realizing the ideal of the people and bringing earlier the overall prosperity and development of our state under the wise leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Palestinian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Mahmoud Abbas, president of the State of Palestine and chairman of the Executive Committee of the Palestine Liberation Organization, on Oct. 10.
The message said:
I extend warm greetings.
We are pleased to extend tender-hearted congratulations to Your Excellency on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the powerful Workers' Party of Korea.
On the occasion of this important occasion, we wish Your Excellency and the members of the Workers' Party of Korea good health and happiness and your country and people greater progress and prosperity.
I pay the highest respect to Your Excellency. -0-

headline: WPK Birthday Significantly Celebrated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK significantly celebrated the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
An endless stream of the people yearning for PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilflowed to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the most sacred temple of Juche where the President and the Chairman  lie in state.
The visitors paid tribute with humble reverence to the peerlessly great men who built the WPK into a mass party absolutely supported and trusted by the people at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun.
Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before them.
Many people visited the Party Founding Museum associated with the great Party's founding history on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
There were national flag-raising ceremonies in different parts of the country.
Performances were given in Pyongyang and other parts of the country to celebrate the October holiday.
In Nampho Municipality workers and trade union members had an oratorical meeting and agricultural workers and members of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea a celebration meeting.
Officials of provincial-level institutions in Jagang Province played a sports game with ardent enthusiasm.
Dancing parties took place in different parts of the country including South and North Hwanghae provinces.
Service facilities in the capital city and other parts of the country were crowded with visitors.
The Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum, the Rungna People's Pleasure Park and other bases for cultural and emotional life were filled with happy laughter of working people and school youth and students.
Streets in the capital city were decorated with spectacular electric light. -0-

headline: Premier of State Council of PRC Li Qiang Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun and paid high tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Oct. 10.
He was accompanied by Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs.
A flower basket in the name of the party and government delegation of the PRC was laid before the statues of the great leaders.
Li Qiang made an entry to the visitor's book. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Military Parade to Celebrate 80th Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the military parade to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Generals, officers, commissioned officers and soldiers of the heroic Korean People's Army,
Officers and soldiers of the parade units,
Labour innovators and meritorious persons from across the country, Pyongyang citizens and overseas compatriots,
Esteemed guests of honour who are spending this significant night with us,
The parade of the armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the culmination of the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, is about to begin.
First of all, I warmly welcome the guests from all walks of life and our dear friends from different countries invited to this grand event.
I extend my heartfelt thanks and congratulations to all the people across the country who have devoted their precious sweat of creation and labour and their sincerity to this October day of glory.
I also express my deep gratitude to the parties and governments of different countries and international democratic organizations for their sincere congratulations to our Party, government and people on the occasion of the significant holiday.
Comrades and friends,
The elite representatives of the armed forces of the Republic, which our Party has built up for as long as 80 years, have now gathered here.
The steel-strong columns of our armed forces will now display the might developed by the WPK for the good of the people whom it embraced as its destiny and for socialism, the unanimous aspiration and choice of our people.
Today we will confirm once again the eternity of our sovereignty and our cause which can only be defended and guaranteed by strength and by victory.
I believe it is a source of exceptional honour and pride for a party leading the revolution with just ideals to celebrate its whole history and demonstrate its bright future through the parade of such brave armed forces.
All the officers and soldiers of the parade units,
I warmly congratulate you on having the greatest privilege of leaving historic steps on the track of glory as you keep the greatest pride of the WPK and the greatest honour of the DPRK.
Comrades and friends,
As I witness the dignity of the soldiers in parade and the warm respect emanating from their eyes on this grand occasion which our army arranged in celebration of the founding anniversary of the Party, I am wrapped in a solemn feeling at the thought of the officers and soldiers of our army who have always taken the lead in the journey made by the WPK with absolute loyalty and matchless bravery.
Our Party has led the Korean revolution for the last 80 years and reached the present day of glory. As we review its history, we feel infinite dignity and pride in having the loyal armed forces that can share the destiny with the Party.
Our army is the priceless creation and brilliant embodiment of our Party's ardent desire and firm will to safeguard and exalt the truthfulness of its ideals and the dignity of its people generation after generation.
Our Party regarded it as its sacred duty to take entire responsibility for the destiny and future of the country and the people; proceeding from this, we founded an army before the state, identified the character and mission of the army in reflection of its original ideals and spirit, and built regular revolutionary armed forces with the pioneer generation of the cause of party building as their backbone.
This led to the beginning of the long history of army building, which has advanced along with the leadership history of our Party, and also the beginning of the glorious history of our cause, which has been firmly supported by strong arms.
As the history records, each stage of victory guided by our Party is adorned with sacred exploits of loyalty and patriotism of our army which left traces of self-sacrifice and feats before others.
The mission of the army in our revolution under unique circumstances was by no means simple.
The distinguished role of the revolutionary armed forces was consolidated and matured in the struggle to defend the sovereignty of our state and its right to development and to safeguard the destiny and future of the people. It always served as the immutable fulcrum in writing a righteous history in line with the will of the Party and a powerful driving force propelling the Korean revolution straight ahead in the same direction indicated by the Party.
These are incomparable, outstanding exploits of our army that it has defended the Party and the lifeline of the revolutionary cause through a bloody struggle in the grim days when our sovereignty and the destiny of the revolution mattered on every step we took.
Along with the change of history, our army's combat capabilities have been upgraded day by day, but the staunch spirit of defending the Party Central Committee at the cost of life has remained unchanged; our army has always maintained its unique tradition of resolutely supporting the Party's cause in the forefront of pioneering and advance.
Our army, which has never been free from its heavy responsibility of containing the worst threat of aggression from the outset of its founding, left the traces of great feats, which no one could replace, on the key stages of reconstruction and socialist construction. This fact highlights the intrinsic nature and unique image of our army, which responds to the call of the Party absolutely and unconditionally.
Our people remember that the precious gains and monumental edifices attesting to the great history of socialist Korea and symbolizing the dignity and honour of our state are associated with the noble blood and sweat and heavier self-sacrifice of the revolutionary army than anyone else, for which our people are eternally thankful generation after generation.
No other group in our country can match the army in terms of such records and achievements.
We can say with credit that the People's Army was the staunch guard who defended the Party in each and every stage of our revolution and the powerful vanguard who supported the Party's leadership most actively throughout the history of our Party when every moment of implementation of the socialist cause was a hand-to-hand fight against counter-revolution and represented the stirring period of great transformation and creation.
What we can say with more confidence now is that the staunch fighting spirit of our army in support of the Party's cause is being displayed on an increasingly higher level with each passing day.
The new era of transformation, which can be called a watershed in the history of struggle of our Party, is a sacred age, i.e., the crystallization of the revolutionary traits, mass heroism and do-or-die fighting spirit of our army which has responded to the Party's decision only with perfect execution, taking it as an absolute truth and supreme order.
In recent years alone, we cannot think of a single major theatre of campaign apart from the involvement of the service personnel of the People's Army, ranging from the acute confrontation with the enemy, disaster relief projects to grand construction projects encompassing the capital and provincial areas. And in their execution the service personnel have never failed to live up to the expectations of the Party and the people.
Whenever we witness the miraculous results brought about by the officers and soldiers of our army, I feel a surge of strong emotion.
And what words can possibly describe such painstaking efforts and endeavours of theirs devoted to such feats of creation and struggle?
For me and for our Party, the army was a source of strength in the true sense of the word.
On the strength of indomitable spirit and invincible might, the army has always added doubled strength to our Party's efforts to overcome difficulties and bring earlier a bright future.
Our Party is always grateful to and proud of the army, for performing irreplaceable feats by unstintingly devoting their priceless blood and sweat. And inspired by its self-sacrificing spirit and heroic struggle, our Party is leading the people along the road to comprehensive development of socialism with confidence.
The heroic fighting spirit displayed, and the victory achieved, by our revolutionary armed forces on the foreign battlefields for international justice and genuine peace, demonstrated the ideological and spiritual perfection of our army which has grown powerful true to the intention and will of the Party.
The WPK will always remain powerful and its future forever bright as the reliable officers and soldiers are sacrificing all their dreams and youth to the country and the people–the iron-willed troops that are identical in the spirit of absolute service–are stoutly supporting our Party as unshakable pillars despite their difference in ranks.
That is why I am all the more glad and happy to spend this glorious moment of celebrating the founding anniversary of the WPK with our beloved officers and soldiers who will go together along the long road of revolution to the end.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I pay my deep respect to the anti-Japanese forerunners and elders representing the sacred founder generation of our revolutionary armed forces, and to the war veterans and officers and soldiers of the preceding generations who have supported the ideology and cause of our Party in the annals of the revolution with their noble patriotism and heroic struggle.
I extend militant salute to the officers and soldiers of the entire army who have made devoted efforts for this moment of celebration, both at impregnable defence posts for safeguarding the country and the people and at the socialist construction sites for carrying out the Party's plans.
I also offer warm encouragement, on behalf of the WPK and all the people, to the generals, officers and soldiers of the overseas military operations units who are reliably implementing the orders of the Party and the motherland.
Comrades,
Our Party is about to launch a next-stage struggle aimed at taking another step towards accomplishing the socialist cause, in reflection of the general will of history and the people.
Certainly, it will not be all smooth sailing, but our Party will, in the future, too, place the People's Army in the vanguard of the advance which will be more glorious for the country and the people and bring earlier a bright future by relying on the loyalty and courage of the revolutionary armed forces.
In this struggle, too, our army should glorify its dignity and honour as today, as the ranks of elite soldiers firmly armed with the ideas and will of the WPK, the ranks of strong soldiers that always win victory in every battle and the ranks of point-men who make a breakthrough in socialist construction.
To defend the sovereignty of the DPRK and protect the security and interests of the Korean people is the supreme duty and absolute mission assumed by our army.
Our army should continue to grow into an invincible entity that destroys all threats approaching our range of self-defence by dint of its political, ideological, military and technical superiority overwhelming the enemy, and it should steadily strengthen itself into elite armed forces which win victory after victory on the strength of morality and discipline.
I take this opportunity to affirm that our Party and the government of the Republic, together with the powerful revolutionary armed forces, will, in the future, too, fulfil their responsibilities in the joint struggle of the progressive mankind for opposing injustice and hegemony and defending justice and peace.
Our Party and revolutionary armed forces originated from the people, and their sacred purpose and mission are also for the people.
All the people across the country who are putting their minds on and turning their eyes to the plaza of this grand celebration are looking forward to greater victory and transformation.
I am convinced that the bold heroism, staunch stamina and matchless fighting spirit of our service personnel, who know of no impossibility, will continue to be displayed resolutely not only in the defence lines of the country but also at the outposts of socialist construction for realizing the people's aspirations and ideals and in the worthwhile project sites for the well-being of all generations to come.
Today's vigorous steps you take at this parade while flying high the colours of glory in defence of the Party's red flag, will be dynamically carried forward as full steps of patriotic loyalty to the country and the people.
Brave officers and soldiers of the Korean People's Army,
Let us all fight more vigorously for the eternal victory of the DPRK and its people and for the mightiness and shinning glory of the KPA under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The great history and heroic feats of the KPA marching past this glorious place will encourage our advance.
Glory to the heroic defenders of our cause!
Long live the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea! -0-

- An article deals with the faith of all the people across the country to uphold the leadership of the great Party.

Minju Joson
- The paper carries an article titled "Efforts of the International Society for Educational Development." -0-

headline:
Floral Tributes Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il

General Secretary of Central Committee of CPV To Lam Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun and paid high tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Oct. 10.
He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A flower basket in the name of To Lam was laid before the statues of the great leaders.
To Lam made en entry to the visitor's book. -0-

headline: Talks between DPRK and Indonesian FMs Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- Talks between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sugiono, foreign minister of the Republic of Indonesia, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on October 11.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Pak Sang Gil, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and other officials of the DPRK Foreign Ministry and from the opposite side were the party of the Indonesian foreign minister and the charge d'affaires ad interim of the Indonesian embassy here.
At the talks there was an exchange of views on the issues of further strengthening the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Indonesia and on regional and international issues of mutual concern.
Then, a memorandum of understanding on establishing a system of bilateral negotiation between the foreign ministries of the DPRK and Indonesia was signed. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Ongjin County, South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- New houses were built in Sudae-ri, Ongjin County, South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The wonderfully built modern houses are the ones of all blessings built under the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is devoting indefatigable efforts to provide the agricultural working people with a more affluent and civilized life.
Present at the ceremony for moving into new houses were officials, builders and agricultural workers in the province and the county.
A congratulatory speech was made there and licenses for the use of the houses were handed over to be followed by a resolution-taking speech.
Members of the mobile artistic motivation team of the county gave a performance and the whole village was filled with joy of moving into new houses. Officials visited houses of the farmers to congratulate them. -0-

headline: Delegation of United Russia Party Led by President Dmitri Medvedev Leaves Pyongyang
DPRK Acrobats Come Back Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- DPRK acrobats came back home on Saturday after taking part in the 20th Wuqiao International Acrobatics Festival.
The festival, held in China from Sept. 28 to Oct. 3, brought together more than 120 excellent acrobats from 18 countries including the DPRK, Russia, Mongolia and Australia.
The DPRK actors showed various movements of high technique in physical acrobatics to win praise from the judges and spectators.
The gold lion prize, the highest prize of the festival, was awarded to the DPRK physical acrobatics "Fly Higher" and the silver lion prize to the physical acrobatics "Wire-rope Walking".
Officials concerned, artistes and families of the acrobats greeted them at Pyongyang International Airport. -0-

headline: Public Procession and Torchlight Gala Take Place in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- The public procession and torchlight gala took place atKim Il SungSquare on Saturday to celebrate the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Amid the playing of state welcome music, Pak Thae Song and Choe Ryong Hae, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other leading officials of the Party and government took the platform.
Also taking the platform were veteran cadres who had worked for a long time in important posts of the state, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army, labor innovators and persons of merit.
Present there on invitation were members of overseas compatriots' congratulatory groups and delegations, overseas Koreans, foreign guests on a visit to the DPRK and diplomatic envoys here.
Present at the reserved seats for guests were the participants in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, members of the relay teams carrying letters of loyalty, officials and working people of ministries, national agencies, institutions and industrial establishments in Pyongyang.
Ju Chang Il, alternate member of the Political Bureau and department director of the WPK Central Committee, made a speech.
Noting that the procession indicative of the single-minded unity, that will march past the Square of glory associated with the history of victory of our revolution, would be the solemn depiction of yesterday, today and tomorrow of the WPK with the unbreakable backbone braving harsh challenges and pressure, he stressed that it will demonstrate to the whole world the will of the new generations to remain boundlessly loyal to the socialist cause of Juche led by our Party.
The public procession began with a float in the shape of a model symbolic of the WPK at its head, amid the playing of song "The People Offer Glory to the Party".
The audience broke into enthusiastic cheers when the column of marchers holding the portraits of the generation who pioneered the cause of Party building and passionate loyalists who upheld the Party with transparent revolutionary faith and moral obligation entered the Square in festive mood.
The columns of marchers carrying the symbols representing the years of glorious struggle passed through the Square one after another, demonstrating how the 80-year-long history of modern Korea could shine at the peak of dignity and honor.
As the column of marchers escorting the portrait of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unentered the Square full of high praises for the sacred history of founding and building the Party, the audience was overcome with ardent admiration for him.
And it was followed by the column of marchers hailing the Party building, the column of workers beating drums, the column of floats, the column of acclaiming regional rejuvenation, the column of dancing agricultural workers and the column of rhythmically stepping schoolchildren. They were eloquently telling that the last decade has witnessed the new heyday of strengthening the whole Party, a brilliant new era of our state-first principle and the era of gigantic change in which both men and landscapes are transformed beyond recognition, and those are the immortal revolutionary feats that could be performed only by the great ComradeKim Jong Un.
Then the column of dancers holding an extra big-sized national flag over their heads marched past the Square, together with the float carrying large slogan "Long Live the Great Workers' Party of Korea!". It demonstrated their unshakable faith and will to surely achieve the final victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche under the leadership of the great Party Central Committee.
At the end of the public procession, colorful fireworks were set off to display a beautiful sea of sparks.
Then it was followed by torchlight gala of youth and students "Forward, Young Patriots, the Reserves of the Workers' Party of Korea!"
When the solemn melody of the revolutionary hymn "Ode to GeneralKim Jong Un" resounded through the Square, the venue of the gala was filled with ardent reverence of the youth and students for the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who created a new history of attaching importance to youth on this land and built a dignified youth power.
The columns of marchers depicting with torchlight the large letters reading "The Strength of Korea", "Banner of Victory", etc. demonstrated the passion of the youth always advancing straight along the Party, flying the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
There appeared letters "People-first Principle" and "Land of Bliss" and pictures depicting monumental projects in the new eras of prosperity of Pyongyang and rural development, all of which were being presented by the torchlight, on the ground of the venue of the gala indicative of indomitable pioneering spirit and strong spirit of the young people who are performing miracles and feats in every field of socialist construction.
At the end of the gala, the columns of young vanguards depicting the emblem of the WPK and such large letters as "First Death-defying Corps" and "Glory to the Motherly Party!" passed through the Square amid the display of colorful and beautiful fireworks fantastically decorating the night sky of the capital city.
The public procession and torchlight gala for celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK powerfully demonstrated the true picture of single-minded unity peculiar to the DPRK where the Party and the popular masses formed a harmonious whole, its bright future and the invincible spirit of socialist Korea building a powerful and the happiest people's ideal society under the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Delegation of Russian Ministry of Culture Leaves Here for Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- The delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Russian Federation left here for home on October 11 after visiting the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the invitation of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The delegation was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by officials of the Ministry of Culture of the DPRK, officials concerned and the minister-councilor of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Delegation of Party and Government of People's Republic of China Leaves Here for Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) --  The delegation of the party and government of the People's Republic of China led by Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, which paid an official goodwill visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the invitation of the WPK Central Committee and the DPRK government, left here for home on October 11 after taking part in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
The national flags of the DPRK and the PRC were fluttering at the flagstaffs of Pyongyang International Airport and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the apron before the terminal.
The delegation was warmly seen off by Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Jong Myong Su, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, and Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs. -0-

There appeared letters "People-first Principle" and "Land of Bliss" and pictures depicting monumental projects in the new eras of prosperity of Pyongyang and rural development, all of which were being presented by the torchlight, on the ground of the venue of the gala indicative of indomitable pioneering spirit and strong spirit of the young people who are performing miracles and feats in every field of socialist construction.
At the end of the gala, the columns of young vanguards depicting the emblem of the WPK and such large letters as "First Death-defying Corps" and "Glory to the Motherly Party!" passed through the Square amid the display of colorful and beautiful fireworks fantastically decorating the night sky of the capital city.
The public procession and torchlight gala for celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK powerfully demonstrated the true picture of single-minded unity peculiar to the DPRK where the Party and the popular masses formed a harmonious whole, its bright future and the invincible spirit of socialist Korea building a powerful and the happiest people's ideal society under the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Talks between DPRK Premier and His Chinese Counterpart Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- Talks between Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, were held at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on October 11.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Kim Song Nam, alternate member of the Political Bureau and director of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee, Jong Myong Su, vice-premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and other officials concerned.
Present there from the Chinese side were Wu Zhenglong, state councilor and secretary-general of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the CPC, and members of the delegation of the party and government of the PRC.
Pak Thae Song said that the visit to the DPRK by the delegation of the party and government of the PRC marked an important occasion in further consolidating and developing the friendly relations between the two countries, expressing the invariable stand of the Party and government of the DPRK to steadily carve out a new phase of friendship.
He extended firm support to the policy and stand of the Chinese party and government to firmly defend the core interests including the Taiwan issue and advance the cause of socialism, stressing that the DPRK would oppose hegemony and jointly defend fair international order and peace with the Chinese comrades.
Warmly congratulating once again the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea on behalf of the Communist Party of China, the government of the People's Republic of China and the Chinese people, Li Qiang said it is the steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to successfully consolidate, successfully defend and successfully develop the traditional China-DPRK friendly relations no matter how the international situation may change.
He noted that the both sides would positively promote the socialist cause, support and encourage each other in the multilateral arena and realize international fairness and justice.
The talks discussed the issues of strengthening strategic communication between the two parties and the two countries and promoting exchange and cooperation in all fields true to the noble intention of the top leaders of the DPRK and China.
The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
The WPK Central Committee and the DPRK government hosted a reception in welcome of the delegation of the party and government of the PRC on the same day. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Chinese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China on October 9.
The reply message said:
Comrade General Secretary,
I express my heartfelt thanks to you, Comrade General Secretary, for sending a passionate and sincere message of greeting on the occasion of the 76th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China.
For 76 years after the founding of new China, the CPC has united and led the peoples of different nations across the country, thus successfully paving the way to socialism with the Chinese characteristics and entering the new course for comprehensively building a modern socialist state. And the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation has entered an irreversible historical course.
China and the DPRK are good neighbors, good friends and good comrades sharing destiny and helping each other and the traditional friendship between the two countries is growing stronger with the passage of time.
Days ago, you, Comrade General Secretary, visited China and participated in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People’s War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War. And I met with you, Comrade General Secretary, again and prepared with joint efforts a blueprint for the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries.
The Chinese side is ready to carry forward and further develop the traditional China-DPRK friendship to boost friendly exchange and mutually beneficial cooperation, strengthen strategic cooperation in international and regional affairs and provide the peoples of the two countries with better welfare and, at the same time, jointly defend peace and stability of the region and international fairness and justice together with the Korean comrades.
I believe that the Korean people will surely achieve fresh and greater successes in the cause of building socialism under the steadfast leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by you, Comrade General Secretary.
I wish you, Comrade General Secretary, good health and success in all your work.
I wish your country prosperity and the people happiness and well-being. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Enjoys Grand Mass Gymnastics and Artistic Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 13 (KCNA) -- The celebrations held with splendor on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea were recorded in the history of the country as a grand political festival which demonstrated to the whole world once again the absolute dignity and might of the Party and the state shining for centuries and gave full play to the ardent trust and loyalty of all the people across country to the Party.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Sunday congratulated the participants in the celebrations and those who made a contribution to splendidly celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK through the military parade, grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance, public procession and torchlight gala which depicted in a grand epic style the immortal revolutionary exploits of the WPK and enjoyed the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea" together with them.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Untook the tribune, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!", with the great excitement upon having the honor to greet again the supreme representative of the great Party dignified with invincibility and the DPRK, the glorious socialist motherland, and the dear leader of the people.
Kim Jong Unextended warm congratulations to all the participants who splendidly celebrated the 80th founding anniversary of the great Party with ardent loyalty and patriotism.
Taking the tribune were commanding officers, officials and creators who made a contribution to the preparation of the successful celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Prior to the performance,Kim Jong Unexpressed thanks to all the participants in the celebrations and service members, saying:
Esteemed Pyongyang citizens,
Our admirable students and young people,
Our enthusiastic artistes,
Our stalwart and courageous officers and soldiers of the parade units,
Comrades,
This time we have had splendid and perfect celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of our Party amid the extraordinary enthusiasm and renewed passion of all the people in the country, attracting the interest and attention of the world.
I really appreciate all of you for participating in the great political and cultural festivals, which have been held on a national scale to mark the anniversary, and working hard to make a success of them. You have made a substantial contribution to demonstrating the prestige of our Party and state.
The grand events took place one after another for several days, and each time I saw in all the spirited participants their genuine sincerity for, and dedication to, the Party and the state.
Our holiday was really a fantastic occasion which witnessed a succession of great political and cultural festivals.
The festivals climaxed with the grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance, the parade of our armed forces, the public procession of Pyongyang citizens and the torchlight procession of youth and students.
All these events required greater artistic skills and cultural attainments than ever before, not to mention a strong sense of organization and strict discipline.
The weather was unfavourable throughout the events, yet everybody performed their role both perfectly and creditably.
All the events were impeccable as a whole and in minute detail, satisfactorily showcasing the cultured aspects of our state and its mightiness.
Indeed, thanks to your utmost sincerity and devoted efforts, our celebrations of the holiday were wonderful, and this demonstrated the cohesion, potentials and might of our state adequately and successfully.
The weather was chilly owing to autumn rain and cold wind, but I felt my body and mind burning with fervour. I think this was because I deeply appreciated your spirit of serving the state.
Throughout the celebrations I felt so with deep gratitude and utmost sincerity.
This is by no means a rhetorical expression.
Today I have arranged this meeting at which all the participants in the celebrations are present, because I wanted to extend my heartfelt thanks and convey my feeling to you all.
I am so grateful to all of you and you are so precious to me.
On behalf of the Party Central Committee and the government of the Republic, I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks once again to you for having decorated the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Party as the most splendid of all festivals.
I extend my warm love and affection to your families, wishing all of you good health and happiness.
Comrades,
Finally, I suggest that we give cheers all together as an expression of our boundless affection and respect for our beloved country.
Long live the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, the beloved motherland of every one of us!
WhenKim Jong Unconcluded his speech, all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!"
They extended the unbounded gratitude and highest tribute toKim Jong Unwho meticulously led them with the great love and trust to demonstrate to the whole world the great history of our Party and the validity of its cause through peculiar political events and attributed all the successes to them with great affection.
The grand mass gymnastics and artistic performance took place.
All the performers, who had the honor of giving the performance again in the presence ofKim Jong Un, expressed their happiness and excitement through dynamic gymnastics, songs and beautiful dances.
The performance impressively reflected the stirring reality of the great era ofKim Jong Unfor realizing all the ideals of the people and the dream about comprehensive national rejuvenation by dint of self-reliance along with the immortal history of the WPK, which has dynamically carried on the journey of absolute service for the people since the day of its founding when it upheld the red flag of Mt Paektu for the people, and a new heyday of strengthening the whole Party.
The performers highly lauded the truth that there are today's peace and happiness and the bright future and prosperity of all generations to come thanks toKim Jong Un, the dignity, destiny and future of Juche Korea with songs in praise of the motherly Party resounding century after century.
The performance fully demonstrated the strong desire and will to dynamically advance toward the victory of the socialist cause, holding higher the red Party flag of Juche, under the leadership of the Party Central Committee in any storm and stress. The performance ended with the song "Our National Flag" which instills the great enthusiasm for the revolution and patriotism into the people.
At the end of the performance enthusiastic cheers burst out again and fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky in October.
Repeatedly appreciating that all the events to celebrate the auspicious holiday in October fully demonstrated the might of single-minded unity, the absolute strength and irresistible force of the DPRK,Kim Jong Ungave warm encouragement to the performers and audience again.
All the participants firmly pledged to make a genuine contribution to the prosperity of the country by continuing to thoroughly apply to their practical activities the patriotic and sincere efforts and revolutionary spirit of creation displayed for the grand festival in October, cherishing the great love and trust shown byKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Beijing Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 13 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Beijing hosted a reception on October 9 on the occasion the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there on invitation were Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China,  officials of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Transport, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Justice, the State Office for International Development and Cooperation and the People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and other officials concerned.
Present there were Ri Ryong Nam, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy members.
Speeches were made at the reception.
Ri Ryong Nam said that PresidentKim Il Sungaccomplished the cause of party building before the nation-building and army-building after the liberation and wisely led the Party-building work in the whole period of his revolutionary leadership and that ChairmanKim Jong Ilprovided the guidelines for the Party-building of the leader and carried them out without fail.
He said that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the outstanding idea and theory for preserving forever the noble ideas and character of the WPK including the five-point line of Party building in the new era, and is energetically leading the historic cause for strengthening the whole Party and achieving the comprehensive national rejuvenation.
The traditional DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations provided and cultivated with much care and handed down as a precious strategic legacy by the leaders of the elder generations of the two countries are steadily developing onto a higher stage under the intention and leadership of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, he noted.
Cai Qi said that under the seasoned leadership of the respected Comrade General Secretary, the WPK has consolidated the harmonious whole with the popular masses as firm as a rock, achieved many successes by directing efforts to strengthening the whole Party, developing economy and improving the people's living standards, and the Korean-style socialist cause is advancing more dynamically.
He hoped that the DPRK people would achieve steady success in socialist construction and significantly greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK under the leadership of the Party headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on October 9 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there on invitation were Gennadi Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, Ivan Melinikov, first deputy speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Buliga, vice-minister of Defense, and Vitaly Shulika, vice-minister of Interior, and other personages of the political parties, government, parliament, organizations and institutions of Russia including the State Duma, the Federation Council, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Interior, the Party for Peace and Unity, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Orchestra of the 21st Century and TASS.
DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol and staff members of his embassy were on hand.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
They looked round the photos dealing with the noble revolutionary careers of the President and the Chairman and the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, the immortal famous works of the peerlessly great men and the photos showing the invincible might and proud development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception.
The DPRK ambassador said that the WPK has pioneered the road of building a powerful country independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence while strengthening the irresistible might of single-minded unity with its experienced and seasoned leadership for a long period since its founding.
It is the greatest exploit of the WPK that it has put the dignity and prestige of the DPRK on the highest level while firmly defending the state sovereignty, development environment and security interests by increasing the strongest national defence capability in the present world where tyranny and arbitrary practices are rampant, the ambassador added.
The first deputy speaker of the State Duma said that the DPRK would be unthinkable apart from the transparent political will and resolute struggle of the WPK.
He said that the WPK has consistently applied the people-first principle and staunchly implemented the line of overall state development under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand that the Regional Development 20×10 Policy being pressed ahead with by the DPRK draws great attention of the world.
He went on:
The reality proves that for Russia, the relations with the DPRK are not one of world's agendas but a strategic state policy orientation serving the interests of the peoples of the two countries.
President Putin said that the relations between the two countries are special relations of trust, friendship and alliance.
I pay homage to the heroes who fell in battle fields, recollecting with gratitude the soldiers of the Korean People's Army who took part in the operations for liberating the Kursk area.
The fraternal relations between Russia and the DPRK are now positively expanding in all fields.
The deep trust between the top leaders of the two countries is dynamically developing the bilateral relations.
I am convinced that the Russia-DPRK friendly relations will develop in conformity with the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries, and the proud traditions of mutual cooperation and militant friendship will continue to be carried forward.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health ofKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the good health of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations.
Meanwhile, the DPRK missions in Vladivostok and Khabarovsk of Russia hosted receptions on Oct. 3 and 9 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK. -0-

headline: Use of Mineral Resources in Koryo Medical Treatment
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Koryo Medicine General Hospital has developed effective treatment apparatuses for treating diseases by processing natural minerals.
The hospital's team of technicians has intensified the research to develop efficacious treatment apparatuses with tourmaline, a natural mineral widely used for treating diseases.
In contact with the relevant units, it has processed tourmaline to activate human cells and promote blood flow of capillaries in order to stabilize blood pressure, and buckled down to the development of treatment apparatuses.
The health products made with thousands of tourmaline flakes are very efficacious for diseases, profitable in particular because they can be used while sleeping without deliberately arranging time for treatment
Its research findings were highly appreciated at the national exhibition of sci-tech achievements in the sector of public health-2024.
The team of technicians continues to direct efforts to developing various forms of treatment apparatuses using mineral resources. -0-

headline: Kim Il Sung Stadium Marks Its Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- TheKim Il SungStadium in the DPRK marked its 80th founding anniversary.
The 80-year-long history of the stadium is a glorious one recorded with the undying devotion, efforts and loving care of the peerlessly great men who devoted themselves to the development of the country's sports and the people's sports, cultural and leisure activities.
PresidentKim Il Sungtook a measure to rehabilitate the stadium by adopting the decision no. 2 of the Pyongyang City rehabilitation committee despite the postwar difficult period. He visited the construction site for more than 10 times to solve all problems arising in construction.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilinitiated the project for remodeling and expanding the stadium. He saw to it that the stadium was wonderfully turned into a modern seat for sports and culture with his energetic leadership. He also took a benevolent measure to call the then Moranbong Stadium theKim Il SungStadium and fix October 14, 1945, when the President made a historic speech of his triumphal return to the country, as its founding day.
On April 14, 2012, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uncame to the stadium to attend the national meeting for celebrating the centenary of birth of PresidentKim Il Sungand gave instructions on managing and operating it well. Later, he watched football matches at the stadium with citizens of the capital city for several times and clearly indicated the tasks and ways for sprucing up it.
Over the past 80 years, the stadium has contributed to developing the sports of the country and improving the sports, cultural and leisure activities of the people.
A meeting took place on October 13 to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the stadium. -0-

headline: Use of Mineral Resources in Koryo Medical Treatment
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Koryo Medicine General Hospital has developed effective treatment apparatuses for treating diseases by processing natural minerals.
The hospital's team of technicians has intensified the research to develop efficacious treatment apparatuses with tourmaline, a natural mineral widely used for treating diseases.
In contact with the relevant units, it has processed tourmaline to activate human cells and promote blood flow of capillaries in order to stabilize blood pressure, and buckled down to the development of treatment apparatuses.
The health products made with thousands of tourmaline flakes are very efficacious for diseases, profitable in particular because they can be used while sleeping without deliberately arranging time for treatment
Its research findings were highly appreciated at the national exhibition of sci-tech achievements in the sector of public health-2024.
The team of technicians continues to direct efforts to developing various forms of treatment apparatuses using mineral resources. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on October 9 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there on invitation were Gennadi Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, Ivan Melinikov, first deputy speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Buliga, vice-minister of Defense, and Vitaly Shulika, vice-minister of Interior, and other personages of the political parties, government, parliament, organizations and institutions of Russia including the State Duma, the Federation Council, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Interior, the Party for Peace and Unity, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK, the Orchestra of the 21st Century and TASS.
DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol and staff members of his embassy were on hand.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
They looked round the photos dealing with the noble revolutionary careers of the President and the Chairman and the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, the immortal famous works of the peerlessly great men and the photos showing the invincible might and proud development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception.
The DPRK ambassador said that the WPK has pioneered the road of building a powerful country independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence while strengthening the irresistible might of single-minded unity with its experienced and seasoned leadership for a long period since its founding.
It is the greatest exploit of the WPK that it has put the dignity and prestige of the DPRK on the highest level while firmly defending the state sovereignty, development environment and security interests by increasing the strongest national defence capability in the present world where tyranny and arbitrary practices are rampant, the ambassador added.
The first deputy speaker of the State Duma said that the DPRK would be unthinkable apart from the transparent political will and resolute struggle of the WPK.
He said that the WPK has consistently applied the people-first principle and staunchly implemented the line of overall state development under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand that the Regional Development 20×10 Policy being pressed ahead with by the DPRK draws great attention of the world.
He went on:
The reality proves that for Russia, the relations with the DPRK are not one of world's agendas but a strategic state policy orientation serving the interests of the peoples of the two countries.
President Putin said that the relations between the two countries are special relations of trust, friendship and alliance.
I pay homage to the heroes who fell in battle fields, recollecting with gratitude the soldiers of the Korean People's Army who took part in the operations for liberating the Kursk area.
The fraternal relations between Russia and the DPRK are now positively expanding in all fields.
The deep trust between the top leaders of the two countries is dynamically developing the bilateral relations.
I am convinced that the Russia-DPRK friendly relations will develop in conformity with the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries, and the proud traditions of mutual cooperation and militant friendship will continue to be carried forward.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health ofKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the good health of Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations.
Meanwhile, the DPRK missions in Vladivostok and Khabarovsk of Russia hosted receptions on Oct. 3 and 9 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK. -0-

headline: Young People of Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill Fulfill Their One-year or Two-year Plans
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 14 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of young workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill in the DPRK fulfilled their one-year or two-year national economic plans.
The members of the youth shock brigade of the yarn-winding workshop under the chemical fiber spinning combined workshop over-fulfilled their daily plans through their collective innovation.
The young people of the weaving workshop no. 1 raised the technical knowledge and skills and applied a rational machine tending and efficient piecing methods to produce lots of cloth.
Those of the dyeing and silk-spinning combined workshops conducted various mass movements.
More than 20 young people fulfilled their two-year plans by carrying out their plans by over 250 percent on a daily average. -0-

headline: Number of Animals Grows at Central Zoo
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 15 (KCNA) -- The number of animals is growing at the Central Zoo in the DPRK.
A thousand and hundreds of animals of over 100 species have bred this year, adding pleasure to visitors.
A Selenarctos thibetanus, an animal presented to ChairmanKim Jong Ilby a foreign businessman, brought forth a cub on January 1, 2025.
Dogs, gift animals, sent by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unproduced their puppies.
German pointer (dog) produced a puppy in February and Shih tzu, a pet dog, dropped two babies (a pair). They were 160-170 grams in weight and 13-14 centimeters in length at birth.
A Korean tiger, Papio hanadryas, brown bear and other animals produced younglings. -0-

headline: Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory
story_text:

Rodong Sinmun Calls for More Dynamically Advancing toward Glorious Congress of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 15 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial says that the whole country is now filled with the great joy and delight in which it splendidly celebrated the 80th founding anniversary of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea as the grand political festival and the great auspicious event of all the people to be specially recorded in the history of the country.
Let us more dynamically step towards the glorious Party Congress with the same spirit and mettle displayed for celebrating the October holiday. This is the revolutionary faith and will of our people going all out in the struggle for carrying out the five-year plan with the pride and honor of significantly celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the motherly Party, the editorial says, and goes on:
It is the ideological and spiritual qualities and the mode of struggle of our people to make a leap forward from the heyday of the revolution to the greatest heyday, not yielding to difficulties and not being carried away by victory.
Our country is advancing not by any special strength, but by the inexhaustible strength of the people, who are convinced of the validity of their cause and inevitability of its victory and have turned out as one, true to the call of the Party, and by the noble patriotic loyalty of all the people who regard the socialist system dearer than their lives and link their destiny to the state's destiny.
Our people are in high spirits as they are advancing toward the glorious Party Congress after celebrating the October holiday with splendor.
Today of our people is wonderful but their tomorrow will be more beautiful and brighter as the great Party guides our people and the latter upholds the leadership of the ever-victorious WPK with one mind. This is the immutable truth of history that our people bear deep in mind again, looking forward to the distant future.

headline: New Houses Built in Taedok Farm of Unhung County, Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 15 (KCNA) -- Eye-opening changes have taken place simultaneously in the rural areas across the DPRK in the era of the Workers' Party and the agricultural workers are enjoying a civilized material and cultural life. Their happy appearance is seen at the foot of Mt Paektu in the northern part of the country.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unindicated the orientation and ways for rural construction in Ryanggang Province, dispatched battalions of Party members and sent a lot of construction equipment to the province.
At the construction site of rural houses in Unhung County, the commanding officials and builders of the battalion of Party members from South Phyongan Province built dozens of low- and single-storied dwelling houses with modernity, cultural refinement and diversity.
A ceremony for moving into new houses took place at the Taedok Farm.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the county, builders and agricultural workers. An address was made there and licenses for using houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
At the end of the ceremony, a congratulatory performance and a cheerful dancing party were given, and moving into new houses began as the whole village was in a festive mood.

story_text:
Pyongyang, October 15 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial says that the whole country is now filled with the great joy and delight in which it splendidly celebrated the 80th founding anniversary of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea as the grand political festival and the great auspicious event of all the people to be specially recorded in the history of the country.
Let us more dynamically step towards the glorious Party Congress with the same spirit and mettle displayed for celebrating the October holiday. This is the revolutionary faith and will of our people going all out in the struggle for carrying out the five-year plan with the pride and honor of significantly celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the motherly Party, the editorial says, and goes on:
It is the ideological and spiritual qualities and the mode of struggle of our people to make a leap forward from the heyday of the revolution to the greatest heyday, not yielding to difficulties and not being carried away by victory.
Our country is advancing not by any special strength, but by the inexhaustible strength of the people, who are convinced of the validity of their cause and inevitability of its victory and have turned out as one, true to the call of the Party, and by the noble patriotic loyalty of all the people who regard the socialist system dearer than their lives and link their destiny to the state's destiny.
Our people are in high spirits as they are advancing toward the glorious Party Congress after celebrating the October holiday with splendor.
Today of our people is wonderful but their tomorrow will be more beautiful and brighter as the great Party guides our people and the latter upholds the leadership of the ever-victorious WPK with one mind. This is the immutable truth of history that our people bear deep in mind again, looking forward to the distant future.
The editorial calls upon all the people to advance more dynamically to successfully accomplish the grand programme for the revolution set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK and achieve the prosperity of our great state. -0-

headline: DPRK Weightlifters Take First Place on Medal Table in 2025 IWF World Championships
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 16 (KCNA) -- The International Weightlifting Federation recently announced that DPRK men's and women's weightlifting teams took the first place respectively on the medal table of countries and region in the 2025 IWF World Championships held in Norway.
At the first championships after the IWF newly set the relevant men's and women's body- weight events and standard records, the DPRK weightlifters displayed their high physical and technical abilities, giving an impression to many experts and spectators and evoking a great sensation of the world weightlifting circle.
The DPRK proved at the championships that it firmly takes the first place in the world weightlifting circle, the IWF said, adding that the DPRK team has showed definite predominance in various international games after returning to the world weightlifting arena in 2023.
The chairperson of the IWF, and members of the Asian Weightlifting Federation and weightlifting associations of different countries said that the DPRK players not only were very excellent in their physical and technical abilities but also showed their good sportsmanship. They praised the DPRK players for achieving admirable successes and having recently shown amazing abilities in light and heavy weights.
Chinese media said that the DPRK women players displayed their mysterious power and bagged 14 of 15 gold medals in total at the five body-weight events since the championships started on Oct. 2, adding that DPRK players are renewing world records and standard records one after another in international games in recent years. -0-

headline: National Sci-tech Presentation in Field of Disaster Management
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 16 (KCNA) -- A national sci-tech presentation in the field of disaster management took place at the Sci-Tech Complex from October 13 to 15 under the sponsorship of the Korean Disaster Management Association of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.
Present there were officials, teachers, researchers and graduate students of more than 10 units includingKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology, the State Academy of Sciences, the Urban Management Science Institute under the Ministry of Urban Management and the Taean Friendship Glass Factory.
Submitted to the presentation were dozens of scientific and technological proposals conducive to eliminating the danger of various kinds of natural disasters, putting the crisis control on a scientific, modern and IT basis and strengthening the state crisis control capability.
Highly appreciated were papers on the methods of determining the construction sequence of coastal protective facilities for preventing damage by tidal waves, estimating river sediments by use of hydro-meteorological data and mapping out an outline map for evacuating from disaster. -0-
