headline: Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 17 (KCNA) -- Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on October 16 on the occasion of the 77th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence, Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, An Hyon Min, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned.
Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand.
Aleksandr Matsegora made a speech at the reception.
He said that President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and President of the State AffairsKim Jong Unput the Russia-DPRK relations on a reliable and firm basis of complete mutual understanding and mutual support related to the most urgent issues of the two countries.
He said that he was greatly impressed by the scale and remarkable strength of the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK. And he affirmed that the Russian people would always remember the feats of service personnel of the Korean People's Army, saying that he can not still now repress his joy and emotion when he remembers the parade column of overseas military operations units marching pastKim Il SungSquare with the national flags of the two countries in their hands.
He called for not being carried away by the successes already made but courageously advancing toward the future for greater achievements in the multi-faceted bilateral exchange and cooperation in all fields including politics, economy and culture, firmly joining hands with each other.
Next, Choe Son Hui made a speech.
She referred to the fact that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Russia have entered a new era of overall efflorescence thanks toKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation.
She said that the bilateral relations are developing vigorously with unprecedented width and depth on the basis of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
She said that it is the steadfast will of the DPRK government to strongly push ahead with the DPRK-Russia good neighbourly relations and closely support and solidarize with Russia in the course of creating the steady wellbeing and beautiful future of the peoples of the two countries, adding that the DPRK would do everything to promote the overall development of the bilateral relations and further strengthen strategic and tactical cooperation in the future, too.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health of the heads of state of the two countries and the steady development of the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation and the alliance between the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline:
Warm Parental Love of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2025.10.17.]
story_text:
One August day in 2015, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the completed Pyongyang Old People's Home.
Looking at the peculiar edifice with the crane-shaped roof, he highly appreciated that the Pyongyang Old People's Home is wonderful and that its building looks like a piece of art. He said that he would look round the interior and exterior of the home in detail even if it took some time.
It was when he entered the entrance hall.
Looking down at its floor made of granite, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unsaid that carpet should be laid on the grinded granite floor so that the health seekers would not slip and fall.
The officials, who were absorbed only in the peculiar architectural beauty of the old people's home, were surprised.
They all regarded the glossy granite floor as excellent and wonderful.
ButKim Jong Un, who put the convenience of the people above all else, was anxious that the aged health seekers might slip and fall at the sight of the floor.
Looking up to him, the officials keenly realized once again that nothing in the world can match the tender love of him who thinks first of the convenience and interests of the people. -0-

Pyongyang, October 17 (KCNA) -- The 28th meeting of the Forestry Sub-Committee of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology was held here on October 16.
Present there were Han Yong Ho, chairman of the DPRK side to the Forestry Sub-Committee of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, officials concerned, a forestry delegation of the Russian Ministry of Industry and Trade led by Deputy Director Grigori Gusev, chairman of the Russian side to the Forestry Sub-Committee of the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, and a member of the Russian embassy here.
The meeting reviewed the implementation of the protocol of the 27th meeting of the forestry sub-committee and discussed the detailed matters arising in expanding and developing exchange and cooperation in the forestry field.
Then, the protocol of the 28th meeting of the Forestry Sub-Committee was signed. -0-

headline: Russian Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 17 (KCNA) -- Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on October 16 on the occasion of the 77th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence, Kim Song Nam, director of the International Department of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, An Hyon Min, vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned.
Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand.
Aleksandr Matsegora made a speech at the reception.
He said that President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and President of the State AffairsKim Jong Unput the Russia-DPRK relations on a reliable and firm basis of complete mutual understanding and mutual support related to the most urgent issues of the two countries.
He said that he was greatly impressed by the scale and remarkable strength of the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK. And he affirmed that the Russian people would always remember the feats of service personnel of the Korean People's Army, saying that he can not still now repress his joy and emotion when he remembers the parade column of overseas military operations units marching pastKim Il SungSquare with the national flags of the two countries in their hands.
He called for not being carried away by the successes already made but courageously advancing toward the future for greater achievements in the multi-faceted bilateral exchange and cooperation in all fields including politics, economy and culture, firmly joining hands with each other.
Next, Choe Son Hui made a speech.
She referred to the fact that the friendly and cooperative relations between the DPRK and Russia have entered a new era of overall efflorescence thanks toKim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation.
She said that the bilateral relations are developing vigorously with unprecedented width and depth on the basis of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership.
She said that it is the steadfast will of the DPRK government to strongly push ahead with the DPRK-Russia good neighbourly relations and closely support and solidarize with Russia in the course of creating the steady wellbeing and beautiful future of the peoples of the two countries, adding that the DPRK would do everything to promote the overall development of the bilateral relations and further strengthen strategic and tactical cooperation in the future, too.
The participants in the reception toasted the good health of the heads of state of the two countries and the steady development of the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation and the alliance between the peoples of the two countries. -0-

Respected Comrade General Secretary
I extend thanks to You, Comrade General Secretary for sending warm congratulations and cordial wishes on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
I could feel once again the special feelings of friendship and invariable support of You, Comrade General Secretary, and the Chinese Party and people to our Party and people on the occasion of the October holiday.
It is the consistent stand of our Party and the government of the Republic to successfully inherit the traditions of the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations and further strengthen and develop them as required by the new era.
We will as ever positively propel the vigorous development of the DPRK-China friendly relations in the common struggle for accomplishing the socialist cause together with the Chinese comrades and thus contribute to promoting the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries and defending the regional and global stability.
I hope that under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with You, Comrade General Secretary, as its core the Chinese people will successfully attain the goals set forth at the 20th Congress of the Party and achieve greater successes in the course of comprehensively building a modern socialist state. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers of Yombun Farm of Kyongsong County of North Hamgyong Province Move into New Houses

headline: Down-with-Imperialism Union
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 17 (KCNA) -- More than 90 years have passed since the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union (DIU).
The DIU was the first revolutionary youth organization in Korea composed of young people of the new generation aspiring after socialism and communism to achieve national liberation and class emancipation in the ideal of anti-imperialism and independence.
In the mid-1920s, PresidentKim Il Sungunited young passionate people with the same aspiration into one to provide the hard core, and actively pushed ahead with the efforts to form a new-type vanguard organization.
After holding the preliminary meeting of the hard-core members to discuss the issues of the name, character, fighting program and activity norms of the organization, the President organized the DIU, a vanguard organization of the revolution consisting of young communists of the new generation, on October 17, 1926.
The President said that the formation of the Down-with-Imperialism Union is a declaration of the decisive struggle to overthrow Japanese imperialism, and a declaration of confrontation with all imperialism on earth.
Since the historic day, the Korean revolution has followed the road of independent development with clear fighting goals and strategies, and the Korean people have carved out their destiny by themselves, taking charge of their own destiny.
Under the banner of DIU, the banner of Juche uplifted by the President, the DPRK people created legendary tales about heroes defeating the two imperialist countries in the same generation, and brought about a world historic change by building a socialist power independent in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliant in national defence on this land where only ashes were left.
The path indicated by the DIU's ideal is the one of the eternal victory and the spirit of the DIU is the most powerful weapon of invincibility. This is the precious truth the DPRK people acquired while following the great Workers' Party of Korea for decades.
The DPRK people's struggle for bringing earlier the victory in the building of socialism and communism by inheriting the noblest and sacred ideal and spirit are advancing more vigorously and confidently with redoubled confidence and high spirit. -0-

headline: Technology of Producing Oxide-film Insulated Wires Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, technicians of the Paeksung insulated wire production station under the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports developed a technology of producing oxide-film insulated wires and succeeded in establishing the production process of their own style.
The insulating structure of this wire is the film with aluminum oxide as its main component. This wire has good insulation property and is resistant to bending, heating and cooling. Application fields of this light electric wire are being expanded as it can take the place of enamel-coated copper wire, nichrome wire and electrode plate.
Its development and the establishment of its mass-producing process opened up a prospect for saving precious nonferrous metal resources of the country and lots of electricity.
Various kinds of power-saving heating products developed by the station in recent years are popular as their heating time is fast and heat efficiency is high.
The production process of the oxide film insulated aluminium wire registered as a patent of the DPRK is drawing the attention of the scientific circles for its great economic effectiveness. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Moves for Acquiring Capability for Preemptive Strike
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- Japan's military moves for a thorough transformation into a war state are inching close to a dangerous phase moment by moment.
It was made public by media recently that Aegis destroyer Chokai of the Japan Maritime "Self-Defense Force" left for the U.S. to arm itself with the U.S.-made Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles.
Japan's Aegis destroyer had already finalized preliminary preparations for the use of long-range attack weapons aboard including purchasing contracts and operational training. And it is now put on the final "straight course" for officially arm itself with the Tomahawk cruise missiles.
It was reported that eight Aegis destroyers possessed by the Maritime "Self-Defense Force" will carry such long-range missiles in the future.
As well known, Tomahawk missile with the range of 1 250-2 500 km is an ill-famed weapon the U.S. has actively used as a means of preemptive attack in various wars.
All facts suggest that Japan has launched the deployment of long-range strike means for preemptive attack with lightning speed.
It is a tendency that can never be ignored.
Japan is a war criminal state and defeated nation.
Therefore, its possession of long-range offensive means is strictly banned by international law and by its present constitution.
However, Japan has persistently resorted to the revenge-seeking moves for reinvasion.
It has long worked hard to realize the possession of long-range weapons at any cost, regarding it as its main strategic goal for realizing its ambition.
In particular, Japan retrogressively revised three security-related documents including the "national security strategy" despite strong concern at home and abroad in December 2022, casting off the deceptive cloak of "exclusive defense", and thus paved the road for openly securing long-range weapons.
After persistently stipulating the possession of the "capability of attacking enemy base" (counterstrike capability) in the retrogressively revised document, Japan set it as a de facto state policy and has worked hard to secure all kinds of long-range offensive means.
For example, Japan has already started mass-producing the ground-, submarine- and ship-launched and other homemade long-range missiles capable of launching from different positions.
Directing its main efforts to securing long-range offensive means, Japan is mulling to deploy long-range missiles in various military bases in Kyushu and accelerating their deployment in other parts of the archipelago.
Finally, Japan dispatched its Aegis destroyer to the U.S., bringing earlier the plan for purchasing Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles from 2026 to 2025. This is enough to guess the impatient calculation of Japan to complete the deployment of long-range weapons as soon as possible.
In a word, the military moves of Japan in recent years have been directed to perfecting the capability for preemptive attack.
It is self-evident that in case Japan, which has already made the political, military and legal preparations for overseas aggression, finally  perfects the capability to fight a war through the massive acquisition of long-range strike means and their subsequent forward deployment, it will soon embark on the road for overseas aggression.
What is more serious is that the long-range weapons possessed by Japan have the DPRK and other regional states within their striking range.
Given that Japan which inflicted indelible pains to Asian countries in the last century is still making desperate efforts to realize the old dream about the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", it is as clear as noonday where the arrow of reinvasion will fly first.
Herein lies the reason why the reckless moves of the descendants of militarism who are bringing earlier the moment of reinvasion by rounding off the capability for preemptive attack should never be overlooked. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Construction of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Again
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided again on the spot the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm in its final stage on October 17.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Pak Jong Chon, Kim Tok Hun, No Kwang Chol, Kim Jae Ryong, Kim Yong Su and other leading officials.
Kim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the units of the Korean People's Army involved in the construction and officials of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade and designing and relevant institutions.
True to the on-site instructions given byKim Jong Unon September 18, the KPA units and members of the youth shock brigade are pushing ahead with the last stage of construction after mainly completing the project covering the vast area.
The overall construction has been carried out at about 90 percent.
He went round the section of glasshouses on soil, the vegetable science research centre, Soho Branch Farm and other places of the construction site to learn in detail about equipment assembly and land leveling.
He said that the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm is another gigantic creative undertaking for promoting the independent and diversified development of the local economy and proving the validity and vitality of the Party's policy on regional development in the new era and therefore, it is necessary to open up a new path of rural civilization not only in architecture but also in the improvement of environment and afforestation.
Placing a particular emphasis on the issue of carrying out the afforestation in a distinctive way by making effective use of the natural environment while preserving the characteristics of the island area, he gave an instruction to direct all efforts and means to dynamically push ahead with the land leveling of the vast area of the greenhouse farm, afforestation and greening and the creation of a windbreak forest.
He pointed out some deviations revealed in designing and paving roads in the area of the greenhouse farm.
He set forth a series of important tasks arising in the last stage of construction, the operation of the farm and the protection of land and river, including the issue of making good preparations for the management of the farm, the issue of mobilizing the machinery to complete the clean-up of the surroundings of the construction site in a qualitative way and the issue of taking measures to raise the level of specialization in environmental protection and management.
He expressed belief that all the soldier-builders and members of the youth shock brigade would successfully complete the large-scale greenhouse farm without fail by making redoubled efforts and displaying heroic courage, always bearing in mind the trust and expectation of the Party and the people, and thus present it to the glorious Party congress. -0-

headline: WPK's Founding Anniversary Celebrated Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- Events took place in various countries from September 30 to October 12 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
They included meetings, book, photo and stamp exhibitions and film shows in China, Nepal, Laos, Myanmar, Pakistan, Denmark, Bulgaria, Sweden, Austria, Iceland, France, Finland, Nigeria and Mexico.

Screened at the film shows were films dealing with the exploits the respected ComradeKim Jong Unperformed in his external activities and videos on the sacred journey of the WPK.
Speeches were made at the events.
Congratulatory messages toKim Jong Unwere adopted at the events held in Nepal, Denmark, Sweden and Iceland. -0-

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Delegation of Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the delegation carrying the letter of loyalty sent by the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on October 16.
The letter said that delegations carrying the letters of loyalty sent by Chongryon have presented its letters of loyalty to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasions of auspicious holidays since the first delegation was organized in 1972 to present a letter of loyalty on the occasion of the 60th birth anniversary ofKim Il Sung.
In keeping with the tradition, the members of the delegation respectfully presented a letter of loyalty reflecting the ardent mind of all officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unon the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea upon the authorization of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, the letter pointed out.
What they cherished again during their visit to the homeland was the firm conviction that there can be no great Korean people and the powerful DPRK apart from the wise leadership of the WPK and that the Korean people will surely build a powerful socialist country which will prosper forever, it stressed.
Thanks to the 80-year-long history of the great WPK, the 70-year-long history of Chongryon shines and Koreans in Japan can proudly live as the great people in an alien land and strong Koreans, it noted.
The letter stressed that they would play the role of vanguard and shock brigade in the struggle for building powerful Chongryon with the faith that they surely emerge victorious thanks toKim Jong Un, loving the socialist motherland, even though they live in Japan. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Unjong Stockbreeding Farm of North Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- More dwelling houses were built at the Unjong Stockbreeding Farm under the North Hwanghae Provincial Rural Economy Committee.
Various forms of houses, built in unique harmony with topography of the middle mountainous area, and conspicuous landscaping clearly prove the validity and vitality of the policy on rural construction of the Party which set it as an important task to turn all rural villages across the country into rich and cultured socialist ideal villages in the near future.
A ceremony of moving into new houses took place on the spot. Present there were Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs and agricultural workers in Pongsan County.
A congratulatory address was made there and licenses for using houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
As moving into new houses began, a cheerful dancing party was given, and voices in praise of the Central Committee of the great WPK resounded from houses.
Officials visited the families of farmers moving into new houses and shared joy with them. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Delegation of Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the delegation carrying the letter of loyalty sent by the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on October 16.
The letter said that delegations carrying the letters of loyalty sent by Chongryon have presented its letters of loyalty to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasions of auspicious holidays since the first delegation was organized in 1972 to present a letter of loyalty on the occasion of the 60th birth anniversary ofKim Il Sung.
In keeping with the tradition, the members of the delegation respectfully presented a letter of loyalty reflecting the ardent mind of all officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unon the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea upon the authorization of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, the letter pointed out.
What they cherished again during their visit to the homeland was the firm conviction that there can be no great Korean people and the powerful DPRK apart from the wise leadership of the WPK and that the Korean people will surely build a powerful socialist country which will prosper forever, it stressed.
Thanks to the 80-year-long history of the great WPK, the 70-year-long history of Chongryon shines and Koreans in Japan can proudly live as the great people in an alien land and strong Koreans, it noted.
The letter stressed that they would play the role of vanguard and shock brigade in the struggle for building powerful Chongryon with the faith that they surely emerge victorious thanks toKim Jong Un, loving the socialist motherland, even though they live in Japan. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Group of GAKC Tours Various Places
Volume 67 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
Volume 67 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 67 of "Complete Collection ofKim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively contains the immortal classic works of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a chronological order.
The book includes 45 classic works published byKim Jong Ilfrom January to September 2004.
In his work "On Bringing about a Revolutionary Turn in the Party Work True to the Party's Songun Revolutionary Leadership", he clarified the tasks and ways for all the Party organizations and officials to take the lead in firmly upholding the Party's leadership, build up the Party and revolutionary ranks and dynamically enlist the entire Party, the whole army and all the people to implement the Party's revolutionary line.
In his several works, he stressed the need to make full combat preparations of sub-units, further intensify training and improve the unit management and the soldiers' life.
Some works deal with the ways for giving full play to the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance and developing the country's machine-building industry onto a new high stage as required by the new century.
There are also works indicating the tasks and ways for breeding better high-yielding strains true to the Party's policy on bringing about a radical turn in seed improvement, steadily pushing forward with the land realignment and increasing grain production.
Other works clarify the idea that art troupes should create more revolutionary art works reflecting the Party's ideas and intentions.
The book also contains classic works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical problems arising in various fields of the revolution and construction including the idea that revolutionary comradeship is the basis of single-hearted unity and the driving force of the Korean revolution and the issue of bringing about a fresh turn in capital construction. -0-

headline: AFC Coach of Year (Men) and AFC Youth Player of Year (Women) Awarded to DPRK Coach and Player
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- DPRK coach Ri Song Ho and DPRK player Choe Il Son were awarded the AFC Coach of the Year (Men) and the AFC Youth Player of the Year (Women) respectively at the AFC Awards Riyadh 2025 held in Saudi Arabia.
Ri Song Ho led the women's soccer team of the DPRK at the 2024 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup to take the first place. He  was awarded the AFC Coach of the Year (Men) in the DPRK for the third time following coach Choe Kwang Sok (2006) and coach Kim Kwang Min (2008).
Choe Il Son contributed to making the DPRK team win the World Cup by displaying her high physical and technical and goaling abilities at the 2024 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup. She became the fourth winner of the AFC Youth Player of the Year (Women) in the DPRK. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Moves for Acquiring Capability for Preemptive Strike
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- Japan's military moves for a thorough transformation into a war state are inching close to a dangerous phase moment by moment.
It was made public by media recently that Aegis destroyer Chokai of the Japan Maritime "Self-Defense Force" left for the U.S. to arm itself with the U.S.-made Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles.
Japan's Aegis destroyer had already finalized preliminary preparations for the use of long-range attack weapons aboard including purchasing contracts and operational training. And it is now put on the final "straight course" for officially arm itself with the Tomahawk cruise missiles.
It was reported that eight Aegis destroyers possessed by the Maritime "Self-Defense Force" will carry such long-range missiles in the future.
As well known, Tomahawk missile with the range of 1 250-2 500 km is an ill-famed weapon the U.S. has actively used as a means of preemptive attack in various wars.
All facts suggest that Japan has launched the deployment of long-range strike means for preemptive attack with lightning speed.
It is a tendency that can never be ignored.
Japan is a war criminal state and defeated nation.
Therefore, its possession of long-range offensive means is strictly banned by international law and by its present constitution.
However, Japan has persistently resorted to the revenge-seeking moves for reinvasion.
It has long worked hard to realize the possession of long-range weapons at any cost, regarding it as its main strategic goal for realizing its ambition.
In particular, Japan retrogressively revised three security-related documents including the "national security strategy" despite strong concern at home and abroad in December 2022, casting off the deceptive cloak of "exclusive defense", and thus paved the road for openly securing long-range weapons.
After persistently stipulating the possession of the "capability of attacking enemy base" (counterstrike capability) in the retrogressively revised document, Japan set it as a de facto state policy and has worked hard to secure all kinds of long-range offensive means.
For example, Japan has already started mass-producing the ground-, submarine- and ship-launched and other homemade long-range missiles capable of launching from different positions.
Directing its main efforts to securing long-range offensive means, Japan is mulling to deploy long-range missiles in various military bases in Kyushu and accelerating their deployment in other parts of the archipelago.
Finally, Japan dispatched its Aegis destroyer to the U.S., bringing earlier the plan for purchasing Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles from 2026 to 2025. This is enough to guess the impatient calculation of Japan to complete the deployment of long-range weapons as soon as possible.
In a word, the military moves of Japan in recent years have been directed to perfecting the capability for preemptive attack.
It is self-evident that in case Japan, which has already made the political, military and legal preparations for overseas aggression, finally  perfects the capability to fight a war through the massive acquisition of long-range strike means and their subsequent forward deployment, it will soon embark on the road for overseas aggression.
What is more serious is that the long-range weapons possessed by Japan have the DPRK and other regional states within their striking range.
Given that Japan which inflicted indelible pains to Asian countries in the last century is still making desperate efforts to realize the old dream about the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", it is as clear as noonday where the arrow of reinvasion will fly first.
Herein lies the reason why the reckless moves of the descendants of militarism who are bringing earlier the moment of reinvasion by rounding off the capability for preemptive attack should never be overlooked. -0-

headline: Efficacious Koryo Medicines Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 18 (KCNA) -- Koryo medicine production units in different parts of the DPRK are diversifying products.
The Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory in Pyongyang has produced a traditional Korean medicine, which is good for preventing and treating cerebral thrombosis and improving myocardial ischemia, and various other medicines including golden ginkgo nut hyperlipemia pills on the basis of a scientific analysis.
The Moranbong Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory is manufacturing medicines efficacious for angina pectoris and the Songyo Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory is producing effective pills for preventing and treating hepatitis and senile arteriosclerosis.
Similar achievements are being made at the Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories in North and South Hamgyong provinces and Nampho Municipality. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Paekam County, Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- New houses were built in Paekam County, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK.
The cosy houses built in Jungsan-ri and Yanggok-ri to suit the characteristics of the Paekmu Plateau are a precious fruition of the noble devoted service for the people rendered by the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea which is translating the long-cherished desire and ideal of the people into brilliant reality.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses were Ri Thae Il, chief secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials of the Party and power organs in the county, builders and agricultural workers.
An address was made there and licenses for using houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
When moving into new houses began, the laughter and songs of the agricultural workers resounded and cheerful dancing parties were given.
Officials visited the families of farmers moving into new houses to congratulate them and share joy with them. -0-

headline: Sci-Tech Library Inaugurated in Ryanggang Province
Story about Law on Spring Water Maintenance
story_text:
One day in September 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory.
After looking round the room for education in the revolutionary history, room dedicated to the history of the factory and other places, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unrecalled the exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilfor the factory and said with great pleasure that the Ryongaksan Spring Water renowned as the one for longevity has been supplied to the citizens of the capital city in all seasons under the loving care ofKim Jong Il.
That day, the respected General Secretary said that the supply of spring water to the people is not merely a matter of providing the people with drinking water but a matter related to the spirit of serving the people, indicating the tasks for normalizing the production of spring water at a high level.
And he gave detailed instructions to make a law on assessing the quality of spring water and controlling its production.
The "DPRK Law on Spring Water Maintenance" was adopted thanks to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary to establish a national system that reliably guarantees the quality of spring water for the people. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Products of Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factories Held in North Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of products of Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories was held in North Hwanghae Province, the DPRK some days ago, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Presented to the exhibition were more than 10 000 Koryo medicines of over 80 kinds produced by Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories in the province.
The Kyongam pharmaceutical office under the provincial Koryo medicine production management bureau presented many efficacious extracts of Koryo medicines.
The Sariwon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, which further improved quality inspection system for all processes ranging from raw material feeding to packing, presented various Koryo medicines to the exhibition.
The Singye County Disabled Soldiers' Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory presented a patented product with unique therapeutic effect made on the basis of the latest technology.
The Rinsan County Disabled Soldiers' Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory presented tonics made from animals and plants abundant in the country, attracting the attention of the visitors.
The exhibition also served as an occasion of exchanging and sharing successes and experiences gained in renewing brands and packaging of the products to suit the high level of modernization of the Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- A congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan for celebrating the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Pu Yong Uk, chairperson of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), visited Mangyongdae, the sacred place of the revolution.
Being briefed on the immortal revolutionary career and exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people and put his heart and soul into the development of Chongryon at his old home in Mangyongdae, the members of the congratulatory group looked round the historical relics preserved with much care.
They had a picture taken in memory of their visit to Mangyongdae.
They toured the Korean Revolution Museum, the Party Founding Museum and other places. -0-

headline: Choe Ryong Hae Inspects Different Sectors of South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of South Phyongan Province.
At the Paeksong Farm in Phyongsong City, he called for attaining the goal of grain production set forth by the Party without fail by doing the immediate threshing at the right time and in a proper way, concentrating efforts on preparing for next year's farming and making good preparations for paddy-field fish breeding as required by the Party's policy.
Going round the Phyongsong City Grain Management Station and the Phyongsong City Foodstuff Factory, he said that it is necessary to dry, store and process grain well while thoroughly ensuring water content as required by scientific and technical norms and increasing the rate of cleaned rice output, scrupulously manage equipment and machinery and steadily make great efforts to improve the quality of products and put production on a normal track.
At the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, he stressed the need to make substantial preparations for its modernization reflected in the Party's decisions and thoroughly ensure the hygienic safety of medicines by steadily improving the level of technicians and skilled workers.
At the Sunchon Catfish Farm, he acquainted himself with the supply of fish to coal mines and other units in the province and called for increasing the survival rate and weight ratio of catfish fries by actively introducing advanced fish farming methods, and raising productivity by taking measures for feeding.
Learning in detail about the work of the South Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, he discussed the problems arising in steadily strengthening guidance to various mass movements which are being conducted briskly throughout the society and law-abiding life and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- Personages of various circles in different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Personages of political parties, governments, organizations and institutions of different countries including the China World Peace Foundation, the China Association for International Friendly Contact, the Committee for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Gauteng Provincial Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in South Africa and the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea laid flower baskets and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland art works depicting the President and the Chairman standing together.
The vice-chairperson of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia, and the vice-chairperson and members of the Commission for International Relations of the People's Party of Cambodia paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK mission.
Meanwhile, the general secretary of the Algerian National Liberation Front Party sent a flower basket and a congratulatory card, and the Lao minister of Defense and the president of the Central Committee of the Lao Women's Union flower baskets to the DPRK missions respectively on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Flower baskets were also sent to the DPRK mission by the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry, the Vietnamese Ministry of Defense, the Vietnamese Ministry of Public Security, the Vietnamese Ministry of Industry and Commerce, the Vietnamese Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vietnam Union of Friendship Organizations, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the Vietnamese Academy of Social Sciences, the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee, the newspaper Nhan Dan, the Vietnam News Agency, etc. -0-

At the Paeksong Farm in Phyongsong City, he called for attaining the goal of grain production set forth by the Party without fail by doing the immediate threshing at the right time and in a proper way, concentrating efforts on preparing for next year's farming and making good preparations for paddy-field fish breeding as required by the Party's policy.
Going round the Phyongsong City Grain Management Station and the Phyongsong City Foodstuff Factory, he said that it is necessary to dry, store and process grain well while thoroughly ensuring water content as required by scientific and technical norms and increasing the rate of cleaned rice output, scrupulously manage equipment and machinery and steadily make great efforts to improve the quality of products and put production on a normal track.
At the Sunchon Pharmaceutical Factory, he stressed the need to make substantial preparations for its modernization reflected in the Party's decisions and thoroughly ensure the hygienic safety of medicines by steadily improving the level of technicians and skilled workers.
At the Sunchon Catfish Farm, he acquainted himself with the supply of fish to coal mines and other units in the province and called for increasing the survival rate and weight ratio of catfish fries by actively introducing advanced fish farming methods, and raising productivity by taking measures for feeding.
Learning in detail about the work of the South Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, he discussed the problems arising in steadily strengthening guidance to various mass movements which are being conducted briskly throughout the society and law-abiding life and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: Foreign Figures Visit DPRK Missions
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 19 (KCNA) -- Personages of various circles in different countries paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Personages of political parties, governments, organizations and institutions of different countries including the China World Peace Foundation, the China Association for International Friendly Contact, the Committee for External Affairs of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the Gauteng Provincial Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in South Africa and the Democratic Party of Equatorial Guinea laid flower baskets and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland art works depicting the President and the Chairman standing together.
The vice-chairperson of the FUNCINPEC Party of Cambodia, and the vice-chairperson and members of the Commission for International Relations of the People's Party of Cambodia paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK mission.
Meanwhile, the general secretary of the Algerian National Liberation Front Party sent a flower basket and a congratulatory card, and the Lao minister of Defense and the president of the Central Committee of the Lao Women's Union flower baskets to the DPRK missions respectively on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Flower baskets were also sent to the DPRK mission by the Vietnamese Foreign Ministry, the Vietnamese Ministry of Defense, the Vietnamese Ministry of Public Security, the Vietnamese Ministry of Industry and Commerce, the Vietnamese Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vietnam Union of Friendship Organizations, the Vietnam-DPRK Friendship Association, the Vietnamese Academy of Social Sciences, the Lang Son Provincial People's Committee, the newspaper Nhan Dan, the Vietnam News Agency, etc. -0-

headline: New Public Buildings and Production Facilities Inaugurated at Tapsang Farm in DPRK
New Public Buildings and Production Facilities Inaugurated at Tapsang Farm in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- Modern public buildings and production facilities have been built at the Tapsang Farm in Unsan County, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK, following the construction of hundreds of modern houses. As a result, all the farmers became to enjoy to the full a new life and civilization of rural rejuvenation.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaw to it that all the provinces built model farms suited to their specific conditions, and solved the problems arising in construction preferentially.
The farm, where a mosaic depicting the tender-hearted image ofKim Jong Unwas erected, has an office building, house of culture, Tapsang Health Complex, clinic, hostel, ten-day kindergarten, nursery and production buildings suitable for rural characteristics.
There took place an inauguration ceremony of those buildings on the spot.
Present there were Kim Chol Sam, chief secretary of the provincial committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Yong Man, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials of the Party and power organs in the county, builders and agricultural workers.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round various places of the farm which show another appearance of cultural efflorescence along with the era of the Workers' Party.
A cheerful dancing party was given and fireworks were set off, adding to the confidence in the beautiful future of the socialist countryside prospering day by day under the care of the Party. -0-

headline: Educational Aid Program Center Completed in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, Pyongyang Municipality has built an educational aid program center conducive to putting education on an IT basis.
The center is an education science research unit for developing educational aid programs and disseminating them and a regional base for putting education on an IT basis in relevant areas while performing the functions of collecting, classifying, storing and disseminating IT-based data and programs.
The modern center furnished with hundreds of equipment and fixtures of 20 kinds has a video conferencing room, server room and rooms for operating educational network and manufacturing multimedia. -0-

headline: Farmers of Honam Farm in DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- New dwelling houses have been built at the Honam Farm of the Pyongyang Municipal Rural Economy Committee, which adds to the joy and optimism of the agricultural workers who have greeted the autumn of a good harvest.
The houses in the suburbs of the capital city picture a new appearance of the socialist countryside prospering day by day and more beautiful future under the great benevolence and wise leadership of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea making an effort to provide the agricultural workers with better and more civilized living conditions.
A ceremony of moving into new houses took place on the spot on October 19.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang Municipality and Samsok District, builders and agricultural workers.
An address was made, and licenses for the use of dwelling houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
As a congratulatory performance and dancing party were given and the whole village was in a festive mood, moving into their new houses began.
Officials visited the owners of the new houses and presented them with daily necessities, sharing joy with them. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Resolution from Members of Delegation of Korean Social Scientists in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of resolution from the members of the delegation of Korean Social Scientists in Japan on October 18. They participated in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea  and the international seminar on the Juche idea.
The letter said that they took part in the international seminar on the Juche idea held in Pyongyang on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, at which they keenly realized once again that the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism is the banner of struggle of progressive mankind and the unique beacon of its hope for firmly defending the rights to sovereignty, existence and development of the country and the people and establishing a righteous and equal international order despite outrageous and arduous challenges.
Upon hearing the significant speeches made by the respected Marshal at the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK, they were fascinated and admired by his noble intention to guarantee the eternal existence and continuous development of socialist Korea and provide the beloved people with the highest civilization and all blessings to be envied by all people in the world with the outstanding people-first politics unprecedented in history, the letter noted.
It said that the eye-opening changes and the rare entities of the comprehensive national rejuvenation which are being made in the overall space of socialist construction by dint of self-reliance and self-respect they witnessed during their visit to the homeland clearly highlighted that the people-first idea of the respected Marshal and his seasoned and outstanding leadership are the fundamental source bringing the ideal society long-yearned by mankind into a brilliant reality on the land of the homeland.
It noted that they will deeply explain, prove and give wide publicity to the truth, originality and invincible vitality of the revolutionary ideas of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unand successfully discharge the sacred mission for systematizing the patriotic spirit created by the founder generation of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan in a scientific and theoretical way and handing it over to the descendants. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, October 20 (KCNA) -- The mining industry of the DPRK is laying the promising production foundations.

In the letter they stressed that they will further consolidate the General Association of Koreans in China, a patriotic legacy of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, into an overseas revolutionary organization which only yearns forKim Jong Unand trusts and follows only the WPK. -0-

headline: 80th Founding Anniversary of Choson Sinbo Observed in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo, Japan on October 17 to mark the 80th founding anniversary of Choson Sinbo, the organ of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon).
Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of the Organizational Department, Pae Jin Gu, vice-chairman and concurrently director general of the General Affairs Department, department directors and officials of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, and officials, journalists and editors of the Choson Sinbo Company and officials of Chongryon in the Kanto area.
First Vice-Chairman Pak Ku Ho made a congratulatory speech.
Referring to the fact that Choson Sinbo significantly greets its 80th founding anniversary under the special care of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, he underscored the need for the officials of the Choson Sinbo Company to bear in mind the instructions of the respected Marshal who called for writing a great new history of the movement of Koreans in Japan by carrying forward the patriotic spirit of the founder generation and carry out them without fail.
Introduced at the meeting were congratulatory messages from the Rodong Sinmun and other media organs of the homeland.
Then Director of the Choson Sinbo Company Rim Wang Ho made a report.
The reporter said that the course of 80 years was the one of glory covered by Choson Sinbo under the outstanding leadership of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, the great leader ComradeKim Jong Iland the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
He expressed his resolve to work responsibly to improve the contents and forms of Choson Sinbo and usher in a new era of Chongryon's prosperity in conformity with the mission of the times and the changing circumstances with the ambition to write a new Juche-oriented overseas media history in the great era ofKim Jong Unby inheriting the spirit and tradition of the founder generation.
A letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting. -0-

headline: Premier Pak Thae Song Inspects Various Sectors in North and South Phyongan Provinces
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors in North and South Phyongan provinces.
Making rounds of farms in Taedong, Mundok, Sukchon, Jungsan and Phyongwon counties and Jongju City, the premier called upon the officials of the agricultural guidance organs and farms to conduct the operation and guidance over harvesting and immediate farming processes in a responsible manner and thus successfully conclude this year's farming.
He stressed the need to increase the proportion of mechanization of farm work to finish threshing in a timely and qualitative way and, at the same time, widely introduce farming methods whose advantages were proven in reality and thus achieve more remarkable successes in the next year's agricultural production, and pointed out the ways for encouraging stockbreeding at farms.
The premier visited the Anju 121 Paper Factory at which he said that the factory should steadily improve the quality indices of products by dint of science and technology and push ahead with the work for fully producing papers of different uses in a long-term and planned way.
Acquainting himself with the assembling of equipment which is newly being installed at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the operation of production processes, he called upon officials to conduct the command of the project more dynamically on the basis of scientific operation and design and direct efforts to technical management and equipment management to bring about innovations in fertilizer production.
The field consultative meetings discussed the practical issues for the relevant units to fully supply raw materials, fuel and materials needed for paper production and normalize the production of fertilizers and functional greenhouse films. -0-

story_text:

Over 200 production lines and 20-odd products of 120 units won the control system authentication, food safety management system authentication, GMP (medicines and cosmetics) authentication and product authentication, and dozens of products of 18 units were registered as February 2 Goods.

headline: More Units Awarded February 2 Goods Certification and Quality Certification Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- Many units of the national economy were awarded February 2 Goods Certification and Quality Certification in the third quarter of the year through a campaign for improving quality.
Over 200 production lines and 20-odd products of 120 units won the control system authentication, food safety management system authentication, GMP (medicines and cosmetics) authentication and product authentication, and dozens of products of 18 units were registered as February 2 Goods.
In particular, 11 more units won the food safety management system authentication, 18 more units GMP (medicines) authentication, 9 more units product authentication and 3 more units February 2 Goods Certification as compared with the second quarter of the year. headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 21 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ryu Myong Ju, a woman centenarian living in Neighbourhood Unit No. 8, Ryangchaek Workers' District, Phihyon County, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK.
Receiving the great honor and happiness, she was deeply moved by the great love ofKim Jong Unwho had sent the birthday spread even to the ordinary old woman though he was busy with all state affairs. And she extended her gratitude to him.
She fulfilled her duty as an agricultural worker for decades. Even after becoming a pensioner, she did good deeds helpful to the economic life of the country.
Officials of the Phihyon County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea visited her family to congratulate her. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:

Speeches were made at the reception. -0-

headline: Joint Friendship Gathering of Youth of DPRK and Russia Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- A joint friendship gathering of youth of the DPRK and Russia took place at the Central Youth Hall on October 21.
Present there were Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, officials of the youth league, university students in Pyongyang and the members of the Russian youth friendship visiting group on a visit to the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the gathering.
Mun Chol stressed that the peoples and youth of the two countries would always demonstrate the great reputation of victors thanks to the deep friendship of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand President Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin and the common noble ideal struggling for justice and truth.
On behalf of the Russian youth friendship visiting group, Olga Popova, vice-chairperson of the National Council of the Russian Association of Youth and Children, and Sergei Mikhailov, a member of the group, said that it was a very meaningful occasion to visit the DPRK in October greeting important and significant days in the history of the Russia-DPRK relations.
Extending the most heartfelt thanks toKim Jong Unwho pays a special attention to developing the exchange and cooperation between the youth of the two countries, they stressed that they would make every effort to firmly carry forward the traditions of Russia-DPRK friendship.
The artistic information team of the Central Committee of the youth league performed at the gathering.
Put on the stage were songs and dances "Dear Father" and "My Strong Motherland", male guitar ensemble "We Are Successors to Revolution", male solo and chorus "We Are Koreans" and Russian songs "Way" and "Russia, Forward".
The young people of the DPRK and Russia deepened friendship, playing colorful sports and amusement games together. -0-

headline: WPK Founding Anniversary Marked in Mexico
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- A national seminar, themed "The Workers' Party of Korea and the Juche Idea", took place in Mexico on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Present there were members of the organization for the study of the Juche idea of Mexico and personages of academic circles.
Ramon Jimenez Lopez, chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism who is director general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea, made a keynote speech at the seminar.
The WPK has developed into a genuine party of the people and a revolutionary party which has led socialist construction to victory and made selfless, devoted efforts for promoting the wellbeing of the people, regarding the Juche idea as its firm guidelines for the past 80 years since its founding, he said, adding:
The validity and vitality of the Juche idea founded by ComradeKim Il Sungand developed and enriched by ComradeKim Jong Ilhave been clearly proved through the reality of the DPRK.
The WPK and the DPRK people would win only victories in socialist construction and the accomplishment of the cause of independence against imperialism under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un.
Eleazar Aldaran, secretary general of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, and other personages made speeches.
The participants looked round photos showing the noble revolutionary careers and exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, photos and picture albums introducing the successes made by the DPRK people in their struggle for the comprehensive national rejuvenation under the seasoned leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
They also watched videos showing the strong spirit and stamina of the DPRK people and the proud entities of regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Technology for Producing Biobinder Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- Scientists of the Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences of the DPRK have developed and introduced the technology for producing Korean-style biobinder conducive to putting the metallurgical industry on a Juche basis.
Members of the research group established the technology of biomass fast pyrolysis, the core of the research into binder, by our own way and clarified all indices for industrialization on a scientific way. The technology for producing biobinder for metallurgy based on our technology and raw materials has been introduced into the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex.
The establishment of the technology for producing and using biobinder with biomass abundant in the country opened up a prospect for producing various kinds of quality fire-proof materials and made progress in strengthening the Juche character and independence of the metallurgical industry.
Scientists of the Nano Engineering Branch are now conducting scientific researches into expanding and introducing the technology into different sectors of the national economy. -0-

Diverse and distinctive houses, harmonized with the natural environment of the northern mountainous area of the country, have been built at the farms. Such fairyland-like villages are the true feature of the countryside where the people's dreams and ideals come true.
There took place a ceremony of moving into new houses on the spot.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the county, builders and the agricultural workers who are to move into new houses. A congratulatory address was made there.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on October 19.
The message said:
Dear Comrade,
I extend my heartfelt thanks to you, Comrade, for sending a message of warm congratulations and best wishes on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
I express belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between our two parties and two countries with a long history and tradition would grow stronger in all fields in conformity with the spirit of the agreement reached at our recent meeting in Pyongyang.

headline: Dissemination of Excellent Folk Tradition in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK is widely disseminating the excellent folk tradition.
While finding intangible cultural heritages reflecting the manners and customs that have been handed down throughout history, the province is informing the working people, youth and students of the time-honored history and folk customs of the country.
The provincial art troupe is re-representing the folk song "Haeju Arirang", which has been handed down in the Hwanghae provincial area from ancient times, as male song and dance suited to the emotion and aesthetic tastes of the Korean people and disseminating it.
Haeju Restaurant and other public catering establishments of the province are encouraging Haeju rice mixed with spices and coriander kimchi which were registered as local intangible cultural heritages, and keeping alive their peculiar taste and fragrance, thus making them local specialties popular among all people.
Officials and researchers in relevant sectors of the province are transferring traditional methods and techniques for producing local specialties to newly-built regional-industry factories and condiments production units so as to help them make positive contributions to the people's life.
Cheerful peasant dancing parties are given at the ceremonies of moving into new houses at farms of the province and on other occasions. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories Produce Quality Products
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 22 (KCNA) -- The regional-industry factories, which were built as the first entities in implementing the regional development policy in the new era, are mass-producing the quality products favoured by the people.
The Kusong City Foodstuff Factory is developing new products by relying on the favourable natural and geographical conditions and economic foundations of the city abundant in wild fruit and with solid foundation of fruit farming.
The Yonthan County Daily Necessities Factory has steadily developed new products on the basis of the successes made in production of quality laundry soaps with locally available raw materials and thus produced detergent, washing powder, shampoo, conditioner and liquid soap.
The Hamju County Garment Factory has newly secured several pieces of modern knitwear equipment and produced various types of knitwear to meet the daily-growing demand of the inhabitants for clothes.
Similar successes have been made in Jangphung and Tongsin county foodstuff factories, Ichon and Onchon county daily necessities factories and Kim Hyong Jik and Unchon county garment factories. -0-

headline: Loving Care of Peerlessly Great Man for Convenience of People
story_text:
One day in October 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the construction site of the township of the then Samjiyon County, Ryanggang Province.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unascended the front steps of a house and suddenly stopped on the footpace.
He turned and looked at the steps for a while. Then he told officials that the last step was a little higher than the other steps.
The builders who had climbed and down the stairs many times while building the dwelling houses so far, as well as the officials in charge of the construction work, had never paid attention to the height of the steps.
But the respected General Secretary who is anxious about any inconvenience to the people to live in the dwelling house, paid deep attention to the different height of the step.
Looking at the step, the officials cherished once again the noble intention of the respected General Secretary that everything should be perfect for the people. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter of Resolution from Members of Congratulatory Group of Koreans in Japan
story_text:

headline: Best Place for Ryongaksan Soap Factory
story_text:
One day in June 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the construction site of the Ryongaksan Soap Factory.
That day, ComradeKim Jong Unnamed the factory "Ryongaksan Soap Factory". He acquainted himself with its construction and recollected its previous site which had been set by officials.
At that time, officials thought that the water quality and electricity supply conditions should be good for building a factory producing liquid soap. So, they had set its site in a place of Rangnang Street near the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and adjacent to the Taedong River.
After receiving the report on it,Kim Jong Unset a place at the foot of Mt Ryongak with picturesque scenery and clear water as the site of the factory.
The officials were impressed by the warm affection of him who chose an excellent site for the factory. Recollecting that time, they expressed their sincerity to him.
He said that he would spare nothing for the happiness of the people.
The officials did not repress their emotion, looking up to him who said that he would in the future, too, solve all problems arising in operating the Ryongaksan Soap Factory as it is the one directly related to the people's livelihood.
Indeed, the site of the factory was an excellent place that can be chosen only by him who is desiring earnestly to pluck even a star in the sky for the people while bearing in mind only the people. -0-

headline: Koryo Copper Mirror
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- Among the cultural heritages associated with the wisdom and talents of the Korean ancestors is the Koryo copper mirror.
The mirror handicraft of Korea, which boasted of its peculiar tradition with the mirror with a fine thread pattern from the period of Ancient Korea, was further developed in the Koryo period.
Most of the Koryo copper mirrors known so far were unearthed in tombs, sites of royal palaces and temples.
The shape of the mirrors is mainly rounded, but there are some square ones with various changes on their edges.
And there are special types which modeled after jars, bells, bottles, etc. and have handles.
The back of the mirror is decorated with various patterns.
Typical of the patterns are those depicting animals, plants, sceneries and buildings. Others also depicted dancing and hunting.
These patterns are decorated with beautiful lines and  patterns through delicate and elaborate relief techniques suited to the shapes of mirrors, thus adding to their artistry.
Some Koryo copper mirrors have no pattern and others have letters carved on them.
The Koryo copper mirror is one of the valuable cultural heritages showing the excellent metalworking techniques and formative artistic talents of the Korean ancestors. -0-
