headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony for Building  Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations Solemnly Takes Place
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats will be built in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, to pray for the immortality of the proud war heroes of the DPRK who performed undying feats in the overseas military operations with the ideological and moral superiority, mass heroism, matchless bravery and stamina peculiar to the army of the DPRK absolutely loyal to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The combatants of the armed forces of the Republic performed the brilliant military exploits and services in the military operations to liberate the Kursk Region of the fraternal Russian Federation at the cost of their blood and lives. It is a legend of miraculous victory to be specially recorded in the history of the Juche-oriented army building and the anti-imperialist revolutionary struggle, and a great feat which demonstrates the invincibility of the relations between the DPRK and Russia forged and further consolidated at the cost of blood and contributes to the existence, development and eternal prosperity of the two countries.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unput the combatants of the overseas operations units, who demonstrated the great prestige of strong men and glory of victors, on the peak of the times as the real heroes and representatives of the honor of the country. And he initiated the construction of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats that will hand down to posterity the noble self-sacrificing spirit and legendary combat feats of the brave soldiers, personally chose its site in the Hwasong area symbolic of modern Pyongyang and took special measures to form elite construction units.
The start of the construction of the sacred place, a grand monument of the times to bring all the honor to the noble soul of the heroic soldiers who devoted their lives without hesitation for the immortality and eternal prosperity of the great DPRK, is a vivid expression of the boundless thanks and noble moral obligation of the Party, the state and the people to the brave soldiers and serves as a significant political occasion of evolving the heroic spirit of our times to a higher stage.
The groundbreaking ceremony for building the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations took place solemnly on October 23.
The venue of the ceremony was full of boundless respect for and humble remembrance of the brave soldiers who displayed the indomitable disposition and fighting spirit of the DPRK army with combat capability unknown in history.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
Present there were Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, participants in overseas military operations, bereaved families of martyrs, senior officials of ministries and national agencies, commanding officers of large combined units and combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army, soldier-builders and youth and students.
Also present there were Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the groundbreaking ceremony, all the participants cheered enthusiastically, looking up to the benevolent father who is glorifying the noble life of the war heroes with ardent feeling of blood ties and creating a great history of noble love and obligation.
Kim Jong Unwas greeted by the commanding officers of construction units at all levels.
He made a meaningful speech.
Today we are holding the groundbreaking ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats that will hand down forever the shining life of the heroes and fallen soldiers of the overseas operations units, excellent sons of the Korean people and defenders of justice, he said, referring to the historic significance of the erection of the museum and the great victory and legendary combat feats which the soldiers have achieved for the past one year since they made a forceful march towards the battlefield in the alien land, expecting no reward or send-off.
With this project, two museums representing victories in the wars, the past one and the present one, will be sited in the capital city of our state, he said, adding that this proves in practice that the spirit of defending the country and indomitable heroism of the victorious wartime generation, whom we have put forward on the platform of dignity and always pay reverence to, were not confined to any special period, but have been carried forward stoutly for more than 70 years, and developed onto a higher level to be respected by the great years and the heroic generation.
The testimony by history to our state’s powerfulness never to be changed forever–this is the indelible meaning of this museum, he noted, stressing that the years of militant fraternity, in which a guarantee has been provided for the long-term development of the friendship between the DPRK and Russia at the cost of precious blood, will advance non-stop with the ennobling soul of the great heroes, and more honourable pages of strength and victory will be added to the great chronicles of bilateral ties between the two countries, both just and powerful.
After he finished his speech, the national anthems of the DPRK and the Russian Federation were solemnly played.
He dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the construction of the museum together with leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs.
Stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded again in the sky of October and throughout the venue for the groundbreaking ceremony, which was reminiscent of the precious immutable truth that the life devoted to the most just cause, the most just state and the most just people is immortal.
He met and hugged combatants in overseas military operations who were present at the ceremony and warmly encouraged them who have recovered to their health.
The venue was filled with deep emotion and excitement when the great brilliant commander was showing the noble paternal affection for the soldiers.
He expressed deep respect to the bereaved families of the fallen soldiers who were bursting into tears with their boundless gratitude.
He examined the plans for the museum and met the commanding officers of construction units at all levels.
He expressed the belief and expectation that the officers and men of the construction units would successfully build the museum, which will cultivate the heroism and patriotism of the army and people of the DPRK, with the comradely obligation and the pride and honor of taking part in the sacred work to hand down to posterity the feats performed by the brave soldiers who created a new great history of the KPA and wrote another glorious page in the history of war victory of the DPRK.
All the soldier-builders pledged to fully demonstrate the militant disposition and creation spirit of our army in the construction of the museum, bearing in mind the noble intention and desire of the Central Committee of the great Party.
The noble life of the war heroes in the great era ofKim Jong Unwho devoted their youth and lives to the immortal dignity and eternal prosperity of our powerful state, the precious glory of our people and the happiness of all generations to come will shine forever as the ever-shining stars of the country. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech by Comrade Kim Jong Un at Groundbreaking Ceremony for Building Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the groundbreaking ceremony for building the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
The full text of the speech is as follows:
Comrades,
Today we are holding the groundbreaking ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats that will hand down forever the shining life of the heroes and fallen soldiers of the overseas operations units, excellent sons of the Korean people and defenders of justice.
Present here are families of the martyrs and the soldiers who fought in the operations for liberating Kursk.
It is quite fortunate, pleasing and gratifying for me to see the soldiers, who were returned after being wounded and have recovered their health.
Also present at this groundbreaking ceremony are commanding officers of large and other combined units at all levels of our army and soldier-builders who will undertake this responsible and honourable construction project.
And dear Russian friends are present here to share this meaningful moment with us.
Comrades,
This is a moment which not only the bereaved families that sent their beloved sons, husbands and brothers but also the whole country awaited as one to see with the sincerest affection and greatest respect.
To be launched now is a grand undertaking for making immortal the ennobling spirit of the martyrs, who returned to the embrace of their motherland with victory they won at the cost of their lives true to the sacred mission, as a sentiment of our army, our people and our state and as a vital power for the relationship between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
The Eighth Enlarged Meeting of the Eighth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, held on May 28, decided to build a wonderful memorial museum as crystallization of our Party's and people's eternal thanks to and respect for the representatives of the great fame of our country, as well as a great symbol of the DPRK-Russia relationship that was forged at the cost of blood and is being consolidated day after day. After that, all preparations have been pushed ahead in a responsible way, and today we are now holding this significant groundbreaking ceremony.
First, I would like to avail myself of this meaningful opportunity to extend the most ennobling respect and warmest militant salute to the combatants in the operations for liberating Kursk, who fought in the most valuable and sacred battles for justice and dignity and performed imperishable feats for the times, history and posterity with their lofty sacrifices and heroic feats.
And I convey my encouragement to the fraternal Russian people and army, and offer warm greetings to the dear Russian friends present here.
Comrades,
There have been erected a number of monuments to the war exploits and other feats our armed forces have performed along with the long and glorious history of our Republic, and we have held one exciting ceremony after another recently to announce the commencement of ambitious revolutionary projects. Still, I feel really excited at this moment of the groundbreaking ceremony for the building of this museum.
This is not simply because the museum is to be dedicated to the feats of the officers and soldiers of the overseas detachments of the Korean People's Army, the first of its kind in the history of our nation building; nor is it because they have performed unrivalled feats and achieved heroic war results unprecedented in history.
Here at this place there will soon appear a monument with group sculptures of those heroes who, shouldering the most ennobling missions for their country and mankind, safeguarded justice by fighting bloody battles day after day and month after month, a monument to a great alliance with truthful and heartwarming pictures with no falsity.
Just one year ago from today the last group of the combatants of our expeditionary forces left for Russia.
They, strongly feeling the weight of their heavy mission, made a forceful march towards the battlefield in the alien land.
They left expecting no reward or send-off.
A full one year has passed since the Central Military Commission of the Party dispatched our combatants to the Kursk Region of the Russian Federation, and what we have experienced up to now is far more miraculous and meaningful than what we expected.
The sacred journey marked the beginning of a new history of militant solidarity between the DPRK and Russia. Their relations have been further elevated as those based on the highest trust with which they fight in the same trench for the same purpose, the most genuine and solid relations based on which they share the same destiny.
In the battlefields of fierce conflict between justice and injustice in the world, the relations between the two countries have passed the strictest test for their solidity.
Our heroes destroyed the fiendish neo-Nazi invaders with their staunch spirit not to tolerate any aggression but to annihilate the aggressors, thus striking the international camp of reactionaries with great uneasiness and terror, safeguarding the prestige and security of their fraternal people and making a tangible contribution to the common cause of humankind for justice and peace.
Even the transfusion of a huge volume of blood by the United States and its Western bloc turned out futile in making the righteous blood in the vessels of the two peoples cool, and even the appalling atrocities by fascism could not dampen the phoenix-like fighting spirit and valour.
The proud sons of our state and Russia demonstrated the impregnability of the DPRK-Russia alliance by winning the decisive victory, and etched in history the truth that the hegemony-seeking forces' wild ambition will inevitably be doomed to failure as long as justice is on our side.
Following the road paved by blood, we have reached a high plane of the relations between the two countries that spans two centuries, thus reconfirming the depth of the roots of the unshakable solidarity, and we are convinced of a greater and brighter future.
The alliance between the peoples of the two countries sharing ennobling ideals and desires is their correct option, and the solidarity and friendship forged at the cost of their precious blood and lives are really sacred and enduring.
Our people regard as a source of great dignity the victory they have achieved together with the Russian people in the sacred struggle to defend independence and justice, and place the heroes of the sacred war on the highest place of glory.
This museum will shine forever as a symbol of the most righteous people and the strongest army, and it will be built wonderfully as the incarnation of strong will and might to safeguard the aspirations of the times, which must never be turned back, and to put history to rights.
Comrades,
This place is the sanctuary provided by our country and people embracing the great sons who defended the most sacred thing at the cost of the most precious things in their life and praying for their immortality.
A cemetery, a memorial hall and a monument will be erected here as an integral whole, which will incorporate the traces of life left by the excellent sons of our state and people in the flames of fierce battles and their legendary combat feats and preserve their hearts' enduring beating and their ennobling spirit.
Their shining names, images and heroic life should never die out in our memory, and their ennobling spirit shall never fade out of our memory with the passage of time.
Still, I frequently imagine the eyes of our strong soldiers who must have known no fear of death even at the last moment of their lives, the eyes which must have twinkled only with pride and glory, with no regrets at all.
Even if they lived longer, they would live a sacred and ennobling life just as they did at the last moments of their lives.
The last moments of their brilliant lives were the acme of life, which the traces of their true service for the country would surely reach.
By building this museum, we can ensure that the heroic feats of the combatants, which I believe our service personnel and all the other people have reflected on with deep respect, go down in history as moments of immortality, and that they will be revered by all the later generations of the Republic.
Displayed here will be the photos and fine art works that will give a truthful portrayal of how our combatants waged bloody battles with ardent patriotism, as well as the remains of the hard-fought battles.
The exhibits will also include those featuring the words they said when facing death–the whistles of their soul and the echoes of their life–as well as the last requests they made in reflection of their lifelong desires.
Of course, these will tell of only a few of the countless heroic tales about how they created a new history of victory in the flames of fierce battles.
However, the exhibits will delineate the heroic images that have not been recorded in the past history of warfare, and they will illustrate the self-sacrificing spirit and whole-hearted affection between comrades-in-arms that are beyond imagination or probability. I think they will help us understand how strong human beings can grow, how lofty and beautiful their spirit and personality can get, and how glorious and ennobling their last moments can become.
This museum is a sacred sanctuary dedicated to the immortality of true patriots.
In the future all the visitors to this sanctuary will appreciate the precious lives of the heroic combatants, implanting in their minds the iron truth of struggle and victory to be told by the hearts that overflowed with ardent love for their motherland.
Comrades,
This museum, in which the soul of the combatants will rest, is located in the Hwasong area, a symbol of Pyongyang that boasts its youthful vigour and modern features transforming itself year after year.
Our Party's intention in building the museum here is to make sure that the combatants receive blessing for all ages while seeing the prosperity of their motherland, the thriving Pyongyang in particular; this is what every one of them yearned for so much, shedding their blood even at the moment when they unhesitatingly laid down their lives.
After the completion of Sappyol Street, which is now under construction in the vicinity of this museum, the martyrs will always be near their beloved parents, wives, children and siblings, sharing thoughts and kindred feelings with them.
Officers and soldiers of the construction units at all levels and officials and creative workers from several organs that are engaged in the construction project,
I hope that all of you, as befitting participants in this honourable project, give full play to your highest architectural skills and create ennobling artistic portrayal down to the last detail, so as to adequately represent the deep sincerity and respect for the heroes and moral obligation to them shown by our Party and government, their comrades-in-arms and other service personnel, and all the other people.
Comrades,
With this project, two museums representing victories in the wars, the past one and the present one, will be sited in the capital city of our state.
This proves in practice that the spirit of defending the country and indomitable heroism of the victorious wartime generation, whom we have put forward on the platform of dignity and always pay reverence to, were not confined to any special period, but have been carried forward stoutly for more than 70 years, and developed onto a higher level to be respected by the great years and the heroic generation.
What I want to boast most proudly at this place today is that the heroes of the self-sacrificing spirit unprecedented in history, who can never be found in any other countries in the world, are none other than our young, new generations.
Today's gigantic spiritual growth of the unyielding descendants that have carried forward the bloodline of their strong predecessors makes it possible to estimate more clearly its future.
I feel really moved by the infinite pride in foreseeing the appearance of the coming generation and the distant future of our motherland.
The country, which can build such museums telling of great victory and inheritance generation after generation, is an invincible one with confidence in its glorious future.
The testimony by history to our state's powerfulness never to be changed forever–this is the indelible meaning of this museum.
Comrades,
The DPRK-Russia friendship, which has increased its eternal vitality and the invincibility and power of which have been verified amid the grave tempest of history, is now rising to its historic peak.
This friendship, through which one defends the other by means of will and obligation and both are faithful to their obligations by dint of heroic struggle and death-defying devotion, is a precious wealth shared by the two countries, and it will enable them to enjoy the reputation of being powerful countries.
The confrontation between justice and injustice will get more serious, and challenges by the domination and tyranny will persist, but all this cannot hinder the development of the DPRK-Russia relationship, which has grown closer in the flames of bloody battles.
The years of militant fraternity, in which a guarantee has been provided for the long-term development of the bilateral friendship at the cost of precious blood, will advance non-stop with the ennobling soul of the great heroes, and more honourable pages of strength and victory will be added to the great chronicles of bilateral ties between the two countries, both just and powerful.
Pyongyang will always be with Moscow.
Our friendship and unity will last forever.
Long live our heroic army!
Long live the invincible DPRK-Russia friendship! -0-

headline: Koryo Copper Mirror
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 24 (KCNA) -- Among the cultural heritages associated with the wisdom and talents of the Korean ancestors is the Koryo copper mirror.
The mirror handicraft of Korea, which boasted of its peculiar tradition with the mirror with a fine thread pattern from the period of Ancient Korea, was further developed in the Koryo period.
Most of the Koryo copper mirrors known so far were unearthed in tombs, sites of royal palaces and temples.
The shape of the mirrors is mainly rounded, but there are some square ones with various changes on their edges.
And there are special types which modeled after jars, bells, bottles, etc. and have handles.
The back of the mirror is decorated with various patterns.
Typical of the patterns are those depicting animals, plants, sceneries and buildings. Others also depicted dancing and hunting.
These patterns are decorated with beautiful lines and  patterns through delicate and elaborate relief techniques suited to the shapes of mirrors, thus adding to their artistry.
Some Koryo copper mirrors have no pattern and others have letters carved on them.
The Koryo copper mirror is one of the valuable cultural heritages showing the excellent metalworking techniques and formative artistic talents of the Korean ancestors. -0-

headline: Construction of 10 000 Flats in Hwasong Area Progresses Apace at Final Stage
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 25 (KCNA) -- Soldier and civilian builders in the DPRK are pushing ahead with the construction of the 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong Area at the final stage.
The soldier-builders are carrying on the internal project and tiling exterior walls. They are introducing rational construction methods and observing the requirement of designs.
The Ryongsan brigade finished creating green belts and laying flagstones in a qualitative way. It is conducting the project for tiling exterior walls and interior finishing projects of dwelling houses and service amenities.
Builders of the battalion of the Ministry of Railway, the first brigade of the ministries and national agencies and the regiment of the Ministry of IT Industry are effecting collective innovations in the internal projects of dwelling houses and the construction of public and service amenities.
Thanks to the dynamic struggle of the soldier and civilian builders, the construction of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area is nearing its completion. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Return Home after Taking Part in ITTF Asian Para Championships 2025
DPRK Players Return Home after Taking Part in ITTF Asian Para Championships 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 25 (KCNA) -- DPRK players returned home on October 24 after taking part in the ITTF Asian Para Championships 2025 held in China.
The championships brought together more than 400 players from 18 countries and regions including the DPRK, India, Kazakhstan and Malaysia. The DPRK players bagged two gold medals and one sliver medal.
Jon Ju Hyon took the first place in the MS6. He defeated a Chinese player 3:0 in the quarter finals, ROK player 3:0 in the semifinals and Thai player 3:0 in the finals.
In the MS7, Kim Yong Rok beat Japanese and Chinese players in the quarter finals and semifinals. He defeated a player of Hong Kong, China, 3:1 and won a gold medal.
Meanwhile, Jon Ju Hyon and Kim Yong Rok took the second place in the MD14.
The players and coaches who displayed the honor of the country were greeted at Pyongyang Railway Station by Jon Chol Hi, chairman of the Central Committee of the Korean Federation for the Protection of the Disabled, officials concerned and families.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Cemetery of CPV Fallen Soldiers on Occasion of 75th Anniversary of Entry of CPV into Korean Front
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 25 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited the Cemetery of the Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province and paid a high tribute to them on Oct. 24 on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the entry of the CPV into the Korean front.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Pak Jong Chon and Kim Tok Hun, secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the cemetery.
The national anthems of the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
A flower basket in the name ofKim Jong Unand the flower baskets in the names of the Central Committee of the WPK and the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK were laid before the cemetery.
Kim Jong Unpaid a silent tribute in memory of the CPV fallen soldiers.
Then, he visited the grave of Mao Anying at the cemetery.
He placed a flower before the grave and paid homage.
The faces of the CPV fallen soldiers, who assisted the revolutionary war of our people at the cost of their blood with the spirit of internationalism and the feeling of fraternal friendship, remain deep in the hearts of the peoples of the two countries as a symbol of valuable DPRK-China friendship.
Our people will never forget the blood shed by the excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese people and their immortal feats even after a lapse of many years and the shift of generations.
The DPRK-China friendship forged at the cost of blood would powerfully demonstrate its inexhaustible vitality in the sacred struggle to realize the cause of independence against imperialism, the socialist cause, in the future, too. -0-

headline: SPA Delegation Returns Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 25 (KCNA) -- The delegation of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Director of the Academy of Medical Science of the Ministry of Public Health Ri Chol, chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Parliamentary Group, returned home on October 24 after visiting Russia.
The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league Kim Song Il, vice-chairman of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Parliamentary Group, and Aleksandr Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advances into Round of 16 at 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- The 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup is now underway in Morocco.
Divided into six groups, the teams competed in league matches and winners and runners-up from each group and four teams with high scores among the teams which came third will play knockout games.
The DPRK team, belonging to group B, defeated the Mexican team 2:0 in the first match and the Cameroonian team 2:1 in the second match. It played the last match with the Dutch team on Oct. 24 (local time).
The women footballers of the DPRK team took the initiative from the beginning of the match and made continuous attack to beat the rival 5:0.
Finally, the DPRK team took the first place in the group with nine points in total and advanced into the round of 16. -0-

headline: Farmers of Songnae Farm in DPRK Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- Another new villages were built at the Songnae Farm in Kyongwon County, North Hamgyong Province, the DPRK.
The picturesque villages are the ones of happiness built thanks to the noble intention of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto provide the agricultural workers with a more civilized and happier life.
There took place a ceremony of moving into new houses on the spot.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the county, builders and agricultural workers.
An address was made at the ceremony, and licenses for the use of dwelling houses were handed over. And speeches were made.
There were a congratulatory art performance and a dancing party.
Officials shared joy with the farmers at their new houses. -0-

Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of South Phyongan Province.
Choe Ryong Hae visited the Pit No. 5 at the Inpho Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, where he stressed the importance of coal production in developing the country's economy and improving the people's standard of living, calling upon officials and workers to wage a vigorous struggle for increased production with great patriotic enthusiasm and thus to attain this year's goal of coal production set forth by the Party without fail.
He also called for giving priority to tunneling as required by the Party's policy to create new coalfields, and for actively introducing advanced coal-mining methods and steadily increasing the capacity for carrying coal.
At the township farm in Unsan County, he called for effectively pushing ahead with the immediate farm work, including threshing, so as to conclude farming well, and for making steady preparations for next year's farming on the basis of this year's farming experience.
He underlined the need to actively apply advanced farming methods and methods of raising domestic animals under the uplifted banner of scientific farming and animal husbandry, to continue direct big efforts to increasing the proportion of the farm work done by machines, and to further consolidate the material and technical foundations of the farm.
At the Unsan Prospecting Machine Factory, Choe Ryong Hae stressed the need for its officials to hold fast to science and technology, to organize and direct production, and to improve the technical knowledge and skills of the employees so as to produce the quality prospecting machines, and he discussed the ways of doing so and took the necessary measures. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, October 26 (KCNA) -- Workers of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex in the DPRK produced 70 000-odd more tons of fertilizer than the plans till the third quarter of this year.
Thanks to their high enthusiasm, all processes and machines are in full-capacity operation.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex has introduced rational operating methods and devices for raising the hydrogen extraction rate in the process for separating carbon dioxide and recycling leakage gas, thus producing more fertilizer.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex provides a guarantee for increased fertilizer production by recycling.
It has made it possible to reuse parts essential for the normal operation of the compressor and has made progress in the establishment of catalyst recycling processes. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Field Guidance at Sci-Tech Complex Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- A meeting took place on the spot on Sunday to mark the tenth anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's field guidance at the Sci-Tech Complex.
Present there were Kim Song Bin, chairman of the State Commission of Science and Technology, officials and employees of the complex.
Ha Jong Bok, president of the Sci-Tech Complex, made a report.
The reporter said thatKim Jong Unvisited the Sci-Tech Complex ahead of its inauguration on Oct. 27, 2015 to define its mission as a multi-functional center for disseminating science and technology and a large-scale e-library and indicated important guidelines for its management and operation.
He said that the loving care ofKim Jong Un, who attended the inauguration ceremony of the complex on January 1, 2016 and solved all problems on several occasions, served as a driving force for its development.
He noted that over the past decade the complex has achieved many successes in the work to disseminate advanced new technologies and data to a lot of units across the country, true to the Party's idea of attaching importance to science and technology.
The reporter called on all the officials and employees to fulfill their responsibility and duty in fully displaying the validity and vitality of the Party's policy on making all the people well versed in science and technology by upholding the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unwith loyalty and patriotism. -0-

headline: Mt Jangsu in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- There are many famous mountains in the DPRK, of which territory is mountainous.
Mt Jangsu located in the border between Jaeryong and Sinwon counties in South Hwanghae Province is one of them.
It is divided into the twelve turning area, Myoum Temple area and Jangsusan Wall area.
The mountain has various seasonal names.
It has also many historic relics.
The scenic spots have the legends and stories associated with patriotism and living manners of Koreans.
The Korean ancestors called Mt Kumgang the king of the eastern mountainous area and Mt Jangsu the queen of the western plain area. -0-

headline: Korean Pine-Kasanryong-Natural Monument of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 27 (KCNA) -- Korean pine-Kasanryong is growing in Karim-ri, Hwaphyong County of Jagang Province, the DPRK.
This tree is believed to grow at this site since about 1480.
It is about 30 meters in height, 6.9 meters in girth of root neck and 8 meters in crown width.
The tree breaks into two main branches at the root neck, and their girth are 4.5 meters and 2 meters respectively.
The tree is the largest and oldest one among the pine-nut trees of the country and is of significance in studying the natural history of the Ogasan primeval forest. -0-

headline: Loving Care of Peerlessly Great Man for Animal House
story_text:
One day in June 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unlooked round an animal house in the newly-remodeled Mangyongdae Children's Camp.
There were few animals in the house.
After looking round various places of the house,Kim Jong Unwent to the campers' dwelling no. 1. Saying that there were only a few species of animals in the animal house, he taught that the species of animals should be increased.
Referring to the issue of expanding the animal house and bringing more animals to them should be solved in cooperation with the Central Zoo, he indicated the detailed ways.
Then he said with affection that if the animal house is expanded and animals are increased, children would like it.
That day, he was deeply concerned about the issue of supplying feeds arising in increasing animals. -0-

Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses held on the spot were officials of the Party and power organs in Ryanggang Province and Taehongdan County, builders and agricultural workers.
Kim Chol Nam, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, made a congratulatory speech and the licenses for the use of houses were handed over.

headline: Press Statement on Talks of Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Russia Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- A press statement on the talks between the foreign ministers of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation was released on October 27.
The press statement is as follows:
Talks between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergey Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, were held in Moscow on Oct. 27 at a time when the strategic and alliance character of the relations between the two countries has been further consolidated and their might and vitality have been fully demonstrated under the outstanding and seasoned guidance of the heads of state of the two countries.
At the talks, they had constructive and beneficial strategic communication with the main emphasis on the results of implementation of the top-level agreement between the heads of state, the high-level visits and multi-faceted cooperation plan between the two countries and diplomatic coordination on the major pending international issues of common concern, and they reached a consensus of views on all the issues discussed.
Recognizing that the comradely relations of friendship between the heads of state of both countries serve as the most powerful driving force guaranteeing the solidity and future purposefulness of the development of the DPRK-Russia relations, both sides reaffirmed their will to accelerate the multifaceted development of the bilateral relations under the strategic leadership at the highest level.
The Russian side expressed full support for the DPRK side's efforts and measures to firmly defend the state's present position, security interests and sovereign rights, and the DPRK side expressed invariable sympathy and support for all the measures taken by the Russian side to remove the root cause of the Ukrainian dispute and attain the strategic goal of special military operations. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Beijing Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Beijing hosted a reception on Oct. 25, the 75th anniversary of the entry of the Chinese People's Volunteers into the Korean front.
Present there on invitation were Ling Huanxin, political commissar of the Academy of Military Sciences of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, officials of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Foreign Ministry of China and officials concerned.
Present there were Ri Ryong Nam, DPRK ambassador to China, and his embassy members.
Speeches were made at the reception.
The speakers paid high tribute to the martyrs and veterans of the Chinese People's Volunteers who entered the Korean front and fought shoulder to shoulder with the Korean people. They said that looking back on the history of 75 years ago is of great significance in remembering the forerunners and inheriting their spirit.
They expressed the will to promote the traditional DPRK-China friendship on the road of accomplishing the socialist cause, opposing the imperialists' aggression and hegemony and defending regional peace and security, international fairness and justice.
On the same day, the DPRK consulate general in Shenyang of China and its Dandong branch hosted receptions. -0-

headline: DPRK Player Wins Gold Medal at Asian Youth Games
story_text:

headline: New Houses Built in Rural Area of North Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- According to the grand blueprint for rural rejuvenation unfolded by the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea, the entities of socialist civilization have risen up in different parts of the DPRK, adding to the joy of the agricultural workers who greeted the autumn of good harvest.
Modern dwelling houses built in Chilhyang-ri, Orang County, North Hamgyong Province, this year are associated with the great benevolence of the Party Central Committee which gives prominence to the patriotic loyalty of the agricultural workers defending the Party and the revolution with increased grain production and shows deep loving care for them.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses held on the spot were Kim Yong Hwan, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials, builders and agricultural workers in the county.

Officials, builders and agricultural workers congratulated the owners of the new houses and shared joy with them in the new villages in a festive mood. -0-

headline: 17th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- The 17th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair opened in the DPRK.
Presented to the fair were more than 1 400 kinds of tens of thousands of products, including electronic goods, machines, building-materials, seafood, sanitary and light industry goods and food and consumer goods. Those products were produced by over 210 enterprises and companies of the DPRK, Russia, China, Mongolia, Cambodia, Thailand and India including the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory, the Korean Kaesong Koryo Insam Trading Company, the Korean Sangwon Trading Company and the Korean Songchongang Trading Company.
There will be a briefing for economic exchange and cooperation during the fair.
An opening ceremony took place at the Central Youth Hall on Oct. 27.
Present there were Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations of the DPRK, officials concerned and officials of the exhibited units, delegations of different countries and members of the diplomatic corps here.
Ham Ju Sop, director of the Korean International Exhibition Corporation, made an opening address.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the venue of the fair. -0-

headline: Increased Production at Large-scale Greenhouse Farms in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- Large-scale greenhouse vegetable production bases in the DPRK are increasing output and varieties.
The Kangdong Greenhouse Complex, in contact with research institutes, takes measures to reduce the cost of production and increase the output per unit area.
The complex has conducted filtering, disinfection and addition of nutrient elements for the recovered nutrient solution in a scientific and technological way in order to increase the rate of reusing nutrient solution and thus provided a guarantee to raise the production at less cost than before.
The Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm works hard to put vegetable production on a modern, intensive and industrial basis of a higher level.
The farm is cultivating green crops, monitoring harmful insects, effectively using greenhouse space and managing plants and thus harvesting tens of tons of vegetables every day.
The Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm introduced dozens of varieties of vegetables including legume and balsam pear this year alone to increase the functional vegetable varieties favoured by the people.
The farm increases the area for cultivating functional vegetables while acclimatizing new varieties of vegetables to suit the climatic conditions of the region. -0-

headline: Press Statement on Talks of Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Russia Released
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- A press statement on the talks between the foreign ministers of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation was released on October 27.
The press statement is as follows:
Talks between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergey Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, were held in Moscow on Oct. 27 at a time when the strategic and alliance character of the relations between the two countries has been further consolidated and their might and vitality have been fully demonstrated under the outstanding and seasoned guidance of the heads of state of the two countries.
At the talks, they had constructive and beneficial strategic communication with the main emphasis on the results of implementation of the top-level agreement between the heads of state, the high-level visits and multi-faceted cooperation plan between the two countries and diplomatic coordination on the major pending international issues of common concern, and they reached a consensus of views on all the issues discussed.
Recognizing that the comradely relations of friendship between the heads of state of both countries serve as the most powerful driving force guaranteeing the solidity and future purposefulness of the development of the DPRK-Russia relations, both sides reaffirmed their will to accelerate the multifaceted development of the bilateral relations under the strategic leadership at the highest level.
The Russian side expressed full support for the DPRK side's efforts and measures to firmly defend the state's present position, security interests and sovereign rights, and the DPRK side expressed invariable sympathy and support for all the measures taken by the Russian side to remove the root cause of the Ukrainian dispute and attain the strategic goal of special military operations. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 28 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors of the national economy.
At the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, he learned about the supply of coal for thermal power plants and the operation of generating equipment and called for rationally forming the water-supply and preheating system and other auxiliary systems to reduce heat loss to the maximum, for tightening equipment and technical management and maximizing the output of generators while reducing coal consumption.
He met and encouraged the coal miners who are conducting a dynamic socialist patriotic movement for increased coal production at the underground cutting faces of the Tokchon Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex and the Ryongdung Coal Mine of the Kujang Area Coal Mining Complex.
He stressed once again the importance of the duty of the coal mines in South Phyongan Province in fully meeting the increased demand for coal in the national economy and called for conducting a brisk mass movement including the high-speed tunneling movement to secure enough new coal fields and for raising the proportion of mechanization at cutting faces to steadily increase the coal production.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of increasing the power production by improving the efficiency of generating equipment and the issue of fully supplying materials, equipment and accessories needed for coal mines and establishing a more well-regulated supply service system.
Meanwhile, he learned about the harvesting and vegetable cultivation at the Sampho Farm and the Pobu Farm of Kaechon City and the Songdo Farm of Pakchon County and stressed the need to generalize the farming methods and experience whose advantages were proved in this year's farming in conformity with the characteristics of relevant regions. -0-

headline: DPRK Missile Administration Conducts Test-fire of Sea-to-Surface Strategic Cruise Missiles
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted a test-fire of sea-to-surface strategic cruise missiles in the West Sea of Korea on October 28.
Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission and first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, the vice commander of Armaments of the Navy of the Korean People's Army and engineers of the shipboard weapon systems oversaw the test-fire.
The cruise missiles, improved for the launch from the ship, were fired vertically and flew for over 7 800 seconds along the preset route above the West Sea to destroy the target.
The vice-chairman of the Party Central Military Commission said:
Important successes are being made in putting our nuclear forces on a practical basis according to the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee for steadily expanding the sphere of application of the war deterrents. It is an extension of exercising the war deterrent and an act of exercising it in a more responsible manner to continuously test the reliability of different strategic offensive means and impress their abilities upon the enemies. The head of state has already defined that the deterrent guaranteed by powerful offensive power is just the most perfect war deterrent and defence capability. We should steadily update our combat capability. In particular, it is our responsible mission and duty to ceaselessly toughen the nuclear combat posture.
On the same day he learned about the training of the sailors of the destroyers Choe Hyon and Kang Kon for operating the ships and their weapon systems and assigned relevant tasks for further raising the military and practical qualifications of the sailors. -0-

headline: Pinus Bungeana-Kaesong - Natural Monument of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- Pinus bungeana-Kaesong is growing in Yongang-ri, Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality, the DPRK, for more than 500 years.
The tree is about 18 meters in height, 4 meters in girth of root neck, 5.5 meters in girth of trunk and 21 meters in crown width.
The tree ramifies into four large branches at the height of over 2 meters, and their girths are about 1.8 meters respectively. The crown resembles an umbrella shape.
The tree is the oldest one in the DPRK and is of great scientific significance. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) sent a reply message to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) on October 25.
The message said:
The WPK Central Committee expresses thanks to the CPV Central Committee for sending warm congratulations on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Expressing belief that the friendly relations between the two parties and the two countries with a long history and tradition will further develop as required by the times, we wish the Vietnamese people fresh success in their struggle to build a prosperous state under the leadership of the CPV. -0-

headline: Press Review
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- Following are major news items and articles in leading newspapers of the DPRK on Wednesday:
- Successes are being made in various units.
- The construction of regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties, hospitals and leisure complexes to be built this year is progressing apace at the final stage.
- A meeting for year-end account settlement and income distribution took place at the Junghung Farm in Samjiyon City, Ryanggang Province.
- The Sariwon Riding Club was newly built and inaugurated.

headline: Greetings to FM of Venezuela
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Yvan Eduardo Gil Pinto, foreign minister of the People's Power of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, on October 28 on the occasion of the 51st anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
The message extended firm support and solidarity to the government and people of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in their struggle for defending the sovereignty and security of the country. -0-

headline: DPRK Weightlifter Wins Gold Medal at Asian Youth Games
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- DPRK weightlifter Choe Jin Myong lifted 124kg in snatch (new record of the games) and won a gold medal in the men's 65kg category at the Third Asian Youth Games on October 27.
DPRK weightlifter Kim Ju Gyong bagged silver medals in snatch and jerk respectively at the women's 48kg category. -0-

headline: Greetings to Czech FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Jan Lipavsky, foreign minister of the Czech Republic, on October 28 on the occasion of its national day.
The message expressed expectation that the relations between the two countries would develop on the principle of mutual respect. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Proudly Greeting Ninth Congress of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial says that all the people across the country are taking greater steps forward in the general advance for the victorious conclusion of the five-year plan with high enthusiasm to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the one of victors and glory.
It is the unshakable faith and will of the DPRK people to make this year a watershed of history which holds the most brilliant place in the history of the Korean revolutionary struggle and greet the Ninth Party Congress with pride through extraordinary wisdom and bravery, responsible efforts and strenuous efforts beyond the days which passed with pioneering and advance, the editorial says, and goes on:
Today our people are faced with the task of the times and the heavy historic responsibility for confidently carrying forward the precious victory brought about by loyalty and patriotism to the Ninth Party Congress.
Efforts and results of the remaining days will determine the success or failure of the five-year plan which has been creditably carried out.
Now is the time to launch a dynamic offensive without stopping for the congress of victors and glory and greater victory of our cause.
Making more courageous, effective and intensive efforts is the spirit of advance to be fully demonstrated in the on-going all-people advance of great political and historical significance to devotedly defend the prestige of the Party Congress, the basic principle to be thoroughly applied and the fighting attitude to be maintained to the last.
We should greet the Ninth Party Congress by making more courageous, effective and intensive efforts everyday as we did when we proudly greeted the Seventh Party Congress through the 70-day campaign of loyalty and defended the Eighth Party Congress with great feats in the 80-day campaign.
Let us make contribution to successfully finishing the five-year plan by making more courageous, effective and intensive efforts and greet the Ninth Party Congress as the one of glory, the watershed to be specially recorded in the history of the leadership of our Party. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province
DPRK Missile Administration Conducts Test-fire of Sea-to-Surface Strategic Cruise Missiles
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted a test-fire of sea-to-surface strategic cruise missiles in the West Sea of Korea on October 28.
Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission and first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, the vice commander of Armaments of the Navy of the Korean People's Army and engineers of the shipboard weapon systems oversaw the test-fire.
The cruise missiles, improved for the launch from the ship, were fired vertically and flew for over 7 800 seconds along the preset route above the West Sea to destroy the target.
The vice-chairman of the Party Central Military Commission said:
Important successes are being made in putting our nuclear forces on a practical basis according to the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee for steadily expanding the sphere of application of the war deterrents. It is an extension of exercising the war deterrent and an act of exercising it in a more responsible manner to continuously test the reliability of different strategic offensive means and impress their abilities upon the enemies. The head of state has already defined that the deterrent guaranteed by powerful offensive power is just the most perfect war deterrent and defence capability. We should steadily update our combat capability. In particular, it is our responsible mission and duty to ceaselessly toughen the nuclear combat posture.
On the same day he learned about the training of the sailors of the destroyers Choe Hyon and Kang Kon for operating the ships and their weapon systems and assigned relevant tasks for further raising the military and practical qualifications of the sailors. -0-

headline: Delegation of Choson Sinbo Company of Chongryon Arrives Here
Delegation of Chinese People's Liberation Army Leaves for Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 29 (KCNA) -- The delegation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (CPLA) led by Xia Zhihe, political commissar of National Defence University of the CPLA, left here for home on October 28.
The delegation was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by officers of the Korean People's Army and the Chinese ambassador to the DPRK and members of the military attaché office of the Chinese embassy. -0-

headline: 80th Founding Anniversary of WPK Observed in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- A book, photo and art piece exhibition took place in China and seminars, friendly meetings, round-table talks, lectures, film shows and other celebrations in Bangladesh, Iran, Cambodia, Kuwait, Thailand, Germany, Romania, Bulgaria, Italy, Serbia, Guinea, Nigeria, DR Congo, Tanzania, Tunisia, Brazil, Venezuela and Peru on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).
Present there were personages of political parties, governments, organizations and institutions in those countries and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people.
Screened at the film shows were films dealing with the glorious journey of the ever-victorious WPK and videos showing the proud development of the DPRK.
At the events speeches were made by a vice-chairperson of the Commission for International Relations of the People's Party of Cambodia, the chairman of the Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association, the chairman and vice-chairpersons of the Socialist Party of Romania, the general secretary of the Communist Party of Italy, the general secretary of the Movement for Peace and Socialism of Italy, the chairman of the Bulgaria-Korea Friendship Association, a vice-chairperson of the Democratic Congo-Korea Friendship and Solidarity Association, the secretary general of the Tanzanian National Coordinating Committee of the Juche Idea Study Groups and figures of the Islamic Coalition Party of Iran, the Bangladesh Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the New Yugoslav Communist Party and the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and personages of political parties and organizations in Brazil.
They praised the immortal feats PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilperformed in founding and developing the WPK. They also said that the WPK which has greeted its new era of building a ruling party has developed into a powerful and invincible one and the promising one by holding the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin the vanguard. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Kim Jong Suk County of Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Sinsang Farm and the Samso Farm in Kim Jong Suk County of Ryanggang Province, the DPRK.
Amid the joy of the agricultural workers who became the owners of the new village built in harmony with the natural scenery on the bank of the River Amnok, a ceremony for moving into new houses took place. Present there were officials of the Party and power organs of the province and the county and builders.
Kim Chol Nam, chairman of the Ryanggang Provincial People's Committee, made an address and licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
A congratulatory performance was given and moving into the new houses began amid the cheerful peasants' music.
Officials visited the families moving into the modern houses to congratulate them. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Makes Effective Use of Solar Energy
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- Various units in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, are actively developing and making effective use of solar energy.
The Taedonggang District Restaurants Management Office created the generating capacity by dint of solar energy and is reducing the state electricity consumption.
More than 20 service establishments under the management office including the Tongmun Noodle House set the independent solar energy generating system to solve electricity for decorations and signboard lighting.
Scientists Hotel installed solar panels at a rational angle and is operating them on a normal basis.
The Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory created the generating capacity of tens of kW with natural energy and is saving electricity by taking measures to put the electricity production on a stable basis.
The Pyongyang Pharmaceutical Factory installed solar panels in different places and is supplying the produced electricity to the national grid and providing the electricity for streetlamps in the compound of the factory. -0-

headline: Invincible Is Cause of WPK: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article says that today the Workers' Party of Korea is demonstrating its might before the world as the most dignified and veteran Party which has written the longest history in the world as the socialist ruling party in its course.
The 80-year-long journey of the WPK is shining while holding a clear position in the human history of political parties. This is not because of the long-history of the socialist ruling party, the article says, and goes on:
The history of the WPK is the history for the people and the history it has relied on their strength. Herein lies the secret that the WPK could record only victories, its dignity and prestige be put on the platform of the century, its lifeline be carried forward forever and its future be rosy.
A revolutionary party responsible for the destiny of the people should have the correct lines and policies that illuminate the road ahead of it and have the motive force to powerfully push ahead with all the revolutionary projects while overcoming all challenges and difficulties in order to lead the popular masses' cause of independence and the cause of socialism to victory.
The road to socialism is an untrodden one and the driving force of the socialist cause is the masses of the people with inexhaustible resourcefulness, wisdom and strength.
Only the party, which thoroughly and perfectly carries out the tasks set forth by it by dint of the strength of the people, finding out the good methods of overcoming difficulties and performing miracles in their simple voices, can accelerate the advance toward their ideal society and successfully accomplish the revolutionary cause pioneered by the forerunners, while recording only victories in its course.
The WPK, which reflected in its red flag the idea and will to build a genuine new society of the people since the first day of its founding, has brought about many eye-opening changes racing against times on this land and significant events to be specially recorded in the history of the country, finding itself among the people and relying on them for decades.
The WPK has created a history of epochal changes by taking the untrodden snow-covered road of the prosperity by self-reliance and self-sustenance in order to carry out the transformative tasks under the situation in which outside forces' constant and persistent pressure, interference and threat of aggression are escalating historically and realistically and only defending the social system can be said a miracle. To do so with the ordinary sense is impossible. The infinite might of turning impossibility into a possibility is the will and strength of the people.
Invincible is the cause of the Party advancing together with the people who indicate the truth anytime, give the courage of irresistible strength and push forward the future. -0-

headline: State Academy of Sciences Updates Key Technology of Industrial Information System
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the State Academy of Sciences of the DPRK updated at a high level "Mirae 102" 4.0, the development environemnt of the industrial information system, which is the key technology of the industrial information system.
The key technology of the industrial information system has been updated in our own way and into a great up-to-the-minute technology with a competitive edge, thus providing another guarantee for putting the national economy on a modern and IT basis of a higher level.
"Mirae 102" 4.0 is giving full play to its advantage at many units in different sectors of the national economy. -0-

headline: 17th Pyongyang Autumn International Trade Fair Opens
Russian Economic Delegation Arrives
Apple and Pear Show Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- A show of apples and pears took place at the Food Festival House in Ryomyong Street of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on October 29.
Presented to the show for public evaluation were apples and pears of various species produced at the fruit production units across the country, including Pukchong, Kwail and Onchon counties.
The show was held in the way of evaluating sweetness, sourness, wetness and aroma of apples and pears of various strains on display by the jury consisting of ordinary persons.
Highly appreciated were the fruits produced by Pukchong and Kwail counties, the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm, the Toksong Apple Farm and the Onchon, Myonggan, Songhan and Anak fruit farms. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Prove Successful at Asian Youth Games
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- DPRK players Pak Hae Yon and Kim Hyon I bagged gold medals at the women's weightlifting and wrestling events of the Third Asian Youth Games.
DPRK weightlifter Pak Hae Yon lifted 88kg in snatch (new record of the world juvenile championships, new record of the Asian youth championships and new record of the games), 107kg in clean and jerk (new record of the world juvenile championships, new record of the Asian youth championships and new record of the games) at the women's 53kg category held on October 28 and thus took the first place in snatch and clean and jerk respectively and won two gold medals.
On the same day, DPRK wrestler Kim Hyon I took the first place at the women's 46kg category.
Meanwhile, Yu Yong Hun took the second place at the 60kg category of freestyle wrestling and Jo Hyon Gyong the third place at the 40kg category of women's wrestling. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advances into Quarterfinals of 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 30 (KCNA) -- The 16 knockout match between the DPRK team and the Moroccan team for the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup took place on October 28 (local time).
The DPRK players took the initiative and made strong offensive upon its rival team from the beginning of the match, thus making points one after another.
The DPRK team beat the Moroccan team 6:1 and became to advance into the quarterfinals. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Tokchon City of South Phyongan Province
Third Minsk International Conference on Eurasian Security Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 31 (KCNA) -- The Third Minsk International Conference on Eurasian Security was held in Belarus on Oct. 28 and 29.
Present there were high-level delegates from 48 countries and 7 international bodies including foreign ministers of the DPRK, Belarus, Russia, Hungary and Myanmar.
Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, delivered a speech at the opening high-level session.
Choe Son Hui in her speech extended congratulations on the successful opening of the Third Minsk International Conference on Eurasian Security, and said that the current conference is a political gathering of great significance in building partnership among countries and nations in Eurasia and promoting the creation of a secure, fair and just multi-polar world.
She referred to the fact that the world’s biggest war machine called NATO incites an extreme anti-Russia confrontation hysteria and brings dark clouds of war over the entire Europe in the western part of Eurasia and the U.S.-led tripartite military alliance of U.S., Japan and ROK starts its full-scale operation to gravely threaten the security environment of the region in the eastern part of Eurasia.
Today the global security, to say nothing of Eurasia, is badly shaken to the core, she said, adding that it is attributable to high-handed, arbitrary and double-dealing practices of the U.S. and its followers as they openly launch military invasion, interference in internal affairs and war schemes against sovereign states in a futile attempt to sustain their hegemonic unipolar world.
In recent years, various kinds of bilateral and multilateral war games against the DPRK take place simultaneously and continue without any gap in time and space, involving a scenario of actual use of nuclear weapons and unprecedented war crisis is being created, she said, adding: What is more serious is that NATO that is literally responsible for the security in the North Atlantic, is becoming all the more unspoken in its moves to start military intervention in the Korean peninsula and the Asia Pacific and the emergence of the second version of NATO is beginning to take shape in the Eastern hemisphere.
There is not a single country or nation that would willingly embrace other’s pressure and domination and it is the shared desire as much as it is the independent right of all sovereign states to grow their own strength and decide on their own course of development, she said, stressing that the DPRK will never stop even for one moment nor will it make the slightest concession in the road of bolstering-up self-defence capabilities for guaranteeing the dignity, prestige and the right to development and security interest of the state, and achieving peace in the region and the rest of the world.
She said that the joint statement reflecting the unanimous desire and aspiration of mankind for independence, justice and peace is of profound value in strengthening unity and collaboration among nations in the region and in safeguarding the peaceful and stable environment globally.
The DPRK government remains consistent in the stand to develop good neighbourly and friendly relations with all countries of the world championing justice and independence and fulfil the responsibility for an equality-based multi-polar world and global peace and security, she said.
Meanwhile, she laid a wreath before the monument to the victororious patriotic war in Minsk City. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kangdong County Hospital Nearing Completion
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kangdong County Hospital which is nearing completion on Oct. 30.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK.
Going round various places of the hospital including the underground parking lot, inpatient ward, operating room and doctors' room, he learned in detail about the construction.
He gave instruction to assemble and install in a responsible manner the medical equipment within November as the overall construction of the hospital has been completed at a highly qualitative level and indicated various tasks for the preparations for operating the hospital.
He underlined the need to disseminate the excellent experience gained in the construction of the hospital and exemplary creation spirit displayed in it to the regional construction units at all levels without delay in order to vigorously launch the full-scale project of public health modernization across the country at the highest qualitative level.
As the construction of hospitals, which is an ensemble of the latest medical technology and building techniques, is the sphere that requires higher level of functionality and proficiency than any other construction project, it presents itself as a primary task to build up the regional construction forces capable of pushing ahead with the huge projects for public health rejuvenation in order to accelerate its implementation on a scientific basis in a far-sighted way, he said.
Protecting the people's lives and promoting their health are the most important state affairs than any other one and therefore, the WPK's policy for the healthcare revolution should be steadily carried out in an expanded and intensified way, he stressed.
Our important goal of modernizing the public health sector from now is to build modern hospitals like the Kangdong County Hospital in 20 cities and counties without fail every year, he said, adding that a decisive measure should be taken to expand the forces for building the public health facilities in the country.
He said that the forthcoming plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee will examine the issue of establishing modern hospitals like the Kangdong County Hospital in the districts of Pyongyang.
He set forth the important tasks for the expansion and development of the healthcare revolution, including the issue of standardizing and optimizing the design of general hospital, special hospital and other hospitals in architectural and health and hygienic aspects according to their classes and categories in the building of hospitals and the issue of making a foresighted calculation of the conditions for supplying various kinds of materials as the medical service facilities will be densely stationed across the country. He also pointed out the backwardness and irrationality of the national system of training experts in the public health sector, and instructed to reexamine the issue of training experts in the medical sector and take realistic and substantial strong measures to readjust it.
The construction of the Kangdong County Hospital, the starting point of the development of the public health sector in the struggle for regional rejuvenation this year, will soon reach a successful result, he said, adding that the reality in which groundbreaking leads to inauguration in the same year is a clear proof of the validity and vitality of the Party's policy and an epitome showing the remarkable speed of the advance of socialist Korea.
He assigned the task related to the inauguration of the hospital. -0-

headline: Folk Dance "Tondollari"
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- The folk dance "Tondollari", which has been popular among people in Hamgyong provincial area from olden times, is known in the DPRK as a famous art piece with a strong regional character.
Seeing the dancers, who are dancing with their shoulders moving up and down to the tune of the "Tondollari" music while slapping the gourds upside-down on the large brass bowls with water, people say that the art piece shows well the characteristics of the dance peculiar to the area.
From olden times, the Korean people used to dance, making a voice of imitating the sound of beating a drum. The name of the dance is derived from it.
The folk dance "Tondollari" was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage on November 1, 2015. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Returns Home
Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il's Work Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilpublished the immortal famous work "Socialism Is a Science" on November 1, 1994.
In the work he comprehensively clarified the clear advantages of socialism over capitalism, the limitation of the preceding socialist theories, the scientific accuracy of the Juche-oriented socialist theory, the invincibility of Korean-style socialism and the theoretical and practical issues in accomplishing the socialist cause of Juche to the last.
The work serves as a powerful guideline that saved the socialist movement from crisis and put it on the track of revival, and a beacon of hope that illuminated the road ahead of the human cause of independence in the darkness of socialist frustration.
Thanks to the ideological and theoretical guidelines clearly indicating the road ahead of Juche-oriented socialism, the DPRK people could have not only defended socialism but also laid an eternal foundation for winning victory after victory, rallied close around the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, despite the vicious moves of the hostile forces against the DPRK, the grave natural disasters and economic difficulties.
The prestige of dignified and powerful Korean-style socialism has been further demonstrated thanks to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The DPRK's political and ideological might has been consolidated and its military and technical might reached the highest level along with the solemn thunder of Hwasongpho.
"Long live the Workers' Party!" and "Long live socialism!" resound across the country as modern  dwelling houses, schools, large-scale greenhouse farms, public health facilities and other structures for the people have been built one after another. Such realities have clearly proved once again the scientific accuracy, validity and vitality of the ideas and theories clarified by the work.
The DPRK is shining as a great country symbolizing the truth and invincibility of socialism as it is ushering in a new era of comprehensive national development under the guidance ofKim Jong Un. -0-
