headline: Folk Dance "Tondollari"
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 1 (KCNA) -- The folk dance "Tondollari", which has been popular among people in Hamgyong provincial area from olden times, is known in the DPRK as a famous art piece with a strong regional character.
Seeing the dancers, who are dancing with their shoulders moving up and down to the tune of the "Tondollari" music while slapping the gourds upside-down on the large brass bowls with water, people say that the art piece shows well the characteristics of the dance peculiar to the area.
From olden times, the Korean people used to dance, making a voice of imitating the sound of beating a drum. The name of the dance is derived from it.
The folk dance "Tondollari" was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage on November 1, 2015. -0-

headline: Many Units in DPRK Win Title of Model Technical Innovation Unit
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) -- Some days ago, more than 140 units in the DPRK won the Title of the Model Technical Innovation Unit (thrice and twice ones).
The construction workshop of the Kangdong Hydro-power Construction Complex won the Thrice Title of the Model Technical Innovation Unit. It has disseminated the advanced technical information and conducted technical study in an effective way through the operation of the sci-tech learning space, thus raising the technical knowledge and skills of the workers and encouraging them to take part in sci-tech activities.
The automation workshop No. 1 of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the hot-rolling workshop of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, too, received the Thrice Title of the Model Technical Innovation Unit. They made a digital turning speedometer for turbine and a digital measuring apparatus for waste gas temperature and invented technical innovation proposals conducive to putting the production of hot-rolled sheet and the operation of rolled goods production line on a normal footing.
Meanwhile, various units including the large-sized machine tool workshop of the Ryongsong Machine Complex, two workshops of the Sunchon Leather Shoes Factory, the Paechon Mine and the Youth Pit of the Ungok Coal Mine won the Twice Title of the Model Technical Innovation Unit. Among the units winning the Title of the Model Technical Innovation Unit are the Songsin Trolley Bus Station, the Nampho Medical Appliances Factory and pits Nos. 1 and 3 of the Myonghak Coal Mine. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Headquarters of 11th Corps of Korean People's Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 2 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the headquarters of the 11th Corps of the Korean People's Army on November 1.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the headquarters, all the officers and men of the special operations force raised stormy cheers of hurrah, looking up to the ever-victorious iron-willed commander who has ushered in a heyday of building a strong army and glorified the fighting efficiency and heroism of our army at the highest level with his outstanding and extraordinary commanding philosophy and art.
The special operations corps received the head of state with the highest reverence for him.
Present there were commanding personnel of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK.
Kim Jong Ungave a militant salute to the glorious colors of the large combined unit and exchanged warm greetings with the military and political officers of a combined unit under the large combined unit.
Representing the unanimous mind of all the officers and men, the commanding officers saluted with best wishesKim Jong Unwho has meticulously led the unit to be the ranks of elite soldiers with constant and particular attention to the development of the unit and visited the large combined unit today to give a venerable on-site guidance at it.
Kim Jong Unwaved as an encouragement to the officers and men of the large combined unit who are glorifying the years of their military service with distinguished successes in completing combat preparedness to be indefinitely faithful to their noble mission to safeguard the security of the state and the people.
He looked round the revolutionary museum in the first place.
Recalling the sacred and proud militant course covered by the unit under the leadership of the Party, he appreciated that the corps is the one clearly associated with the leadership exploits of the Party and the reliable vanguard combat ranks playing a role of cornerstone in demonstrating the noble prestige and immortal appellation of our army. He added that the corps can be justifiably called the symbol of the heroism of the People's Army only for its honourable deeds of producing a number of heroes of the Republic in the new era of the Juche revolution.
The deep spiritual world, popular heroism and matchless fighting spirit of the service personnel of the unit who have taken the idea and decision of the Party as a supreme order and responded to it with perfect execution are the exemplary model of our army, he said, adding it is the will and desire of the Party to turn the whole army into a strong and heroic one like the unit that always wins victory in every battle.
Saying that, as witnessed by history, all the stages of high prestige and victory of our state are associated with precious feats performed by our army rendering distinguished services at heavy cost, he said that the People's Army should steadily carry forward the tradition of loyalty and patriotism unparalleled by any others'.
Guided by the commander of the corps,Kim Jong Unvisited the operation study room.
He received a briefing from the commander of the corps on the plan of the military action of the large combined unit in view of different operations.
He set forth the strategic policies and important tasks for the development of the special operations forces of our armed forces.
Referring to the need to take a military organizational and structural measure for strengthening the pivotal and core forces of our armed forces, he said that the Party Central Military Commission will examine this issue on a full scale.
He said that, with the main stress on putting the training on a scientific and practical footing, we should make our army the one able to fight a real war, the one which wins only victory once they fight and the one which the enemies are afraid of. As he used to emphasize, it is the basic way of realizing the cause of building a strong army to bring about a substantial revolution in the training sector of our army, he said. And he referred to some important tasks for implementing the Party's policy of bringing about a radical turn in training.
He put special emphasis on the issue of making the popular heroism prevail over the whole army and clarified the importance of the ideological education in the army and major tasks for it.
At a meeting with the military and political officers of a combined unit under the corps, he highly appreciated their efforts to strengthen the unit's combat capabilities.
He warmly encouraged the political officers, saying that the ever-victorious fighting spirit, popular heroism and bravery of our soldiers are associated with the unknown merits of the political officers at all levels who have played the role of mudsill and pabulum for the spiritual growth of the officers and men of the unit.
The main factor deciding the victory or defeat in a war or battle is the ideology and our Party reposes great expectations in the important role of the political officers in implementing the line of making the KPA politically and ideologically stronger, he said. He earnestly requested the political officers at all levels of the KPA units to train the soldiers to be genuine revolutionaries who know the country, the revolution and the people and are ready to defend the honor of the KPA before possessing the military and technical qualifications.
Expressing firm belief that the military and political officers of a combined unit under the corps would train all the officers and men into a-match-for-a-hundred fighters strong in political, ideological, military and technical aspects, upholding with practical successes the Party's idea of building the special operations forces, he had a significant photo taken with them.
Then, he watched the training of the combatants of the special operations unit.
Seeing the training of the combatants fully demonstrating their unrivalled bravery and mettle, he expressed great satisfaction over the perfect war posture of our armed forces which are fully ready for carrying out the crucial mission of thoroughly defending the sovereignty and development rights of the state and reliably safeguarding the destiny and future of the people against the most vulgar and despicable enemies in the world.
He warmly encouraged the soldiers who are devotedly fulfilling their sacred duty with the will to record only the brilliant and victorious military achievements in the history of the proud unit with legendary heroic tales, and in the colors of glory and had a photo taken with them, which will go down forever in the history of army building.
On the same day, he had a significant photo taken with the officers and men of the headquarters in commemoration of his visit to the large combined unit.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the service personnel of the large combined unit would more firmly prepare themselves to be the honorable guards and the ranks of point-men of the Republic with their bold heroism, strong mettle and matchless fighting spirit as their peculiar features.
His visit to the headquarters of the 11th Corps of the KPA serves as a historic occasion of great significance in developing the armed forces of the Republic into modernized and invincible army that emerges ever-victorious in any form of war. -0-

Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- The exhibition of intangible cultural heritages-2025 closed with due ceremony at the Moranbong Youth Park on Sunday.
Exchanged during the exhibition were the achievements and experience which were gained in the work for protecting intangible cultural heritages, true to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to value the worthy creations and beautiful manners and customs associated with the wisdom and talents of the Korean people and carry forward and develop them as required by the times.
The book "Folklore Literature", "Table-setting Method", "Taekwon-Do", "Makkoli", "Mung-bean Jelly" and "Kite-flying" presented byKim Il SungUniversity, Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce, the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, the Taebo Noodle House of the Pothonggang District Restaurants Management Office, the Ryonghung Rice-cooking Shop No. 2 of the Taesong District Restaurants Management Office and Munhung Senior Middle School in Taedonggang District drew the attention of visitors as they showed well the time-honoured history, splendid  culture and beautiful manners and customs of Korea.
Highly appreciated were the intangible cultural heritages presented by Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Sinhung Restaurant in South Hamgyong Province, Wonsan Songdowon Restaurant in Kangwon Province, the North Hwanghae Provincial Art Troupe, the national traditional technique dissemination centre in the South Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee and Ponbu Kindergarten in Sinuiju City affiliated to Sinuiju Teacher Training College.
Present at the closing ceremony were Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials concerned, and officials and researchers of the exhibited units.

headline: Construction of Kaesong Municipal Tree Nursery Hastened at Final Stage
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Municipality in the DPRK is hastening the construction of municipal tree nursery at the final stage.
The municipality is directing its forces and means to the construction of the tree nursery and taking measures to supply materials.
Officials and builders of the municipal forest management bureau and the municipal construction brigade removed a huge amount of earth, completed the foundation project in a qualitative way and finished laying blocks and partition walls and plastering interior and exterior in the main.
Working people of the municipal forest management station in charge of the construction of office building, sapling exhibition hall, garage and warehouse are pushing ahead with interior finishing project while ensuring the quality at a high level.
Officials and working people of various units including the Kaesong Anti-Land-sliding Station built a welfare building, planted turf and cleaned canals before pushing forward with the building of boundary stones and land leveling.
Builders built a greenhouse with plastic sheets and a water pumping station and are doing the technical work for buildings as required by designs.
The municipality is installing various kinds of equipment in contact with relevant units in order to put the scientific, industrial and intensive production of saplings on a higher level. -0-

headline: Warm Love for Rising Generations
story_text:

headline: Exhibition of Intangible Cultural Heritages-2025 Closes
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 3 (KCNA) -- The exhibition of intangible cultural heritages-2025 closed with due ceremony at the Moranbong Youth Park on Sunday.
Exchanged during the exhibition were the achievements and experience which were gained in the work for protecting intangible cultural heritages, true to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to value the worthy creations and beautiful manners and customs associated with the wisdom and talents of the Korean people and carry forward and develop them as required by the times.
The book "Folklore Literature", "Table-setting Method", "Taekwon-Do", "Makkoli", "Mung-bean Jelly" and "Kite-flying" presented byKim Il SungUniversity, Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce, the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee, the Taebo Noodle House of the Pothonggang District Restaurants Management Office, the Ryonghung Rice-cooking Shop No. 2 of the Taesong District Restaurants Management Office and Munhung Senior Middle School in Taedonggang District drew the attention of visitors as they showed well the time-honoured history, splendid  culture and beautiful manners and customs of Korea.
Highly appreciated were the intangible cultural heritages presented by Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Sinhung Restaurant in South Hamgyong Province, Wonsan Songdowon Restaurant in Kangwon Province, the North Hwanghae Provincial Art Troupe, the national traditional technique dissemination centre in the South Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee and Ponbu Kindergarten in Sinuiju City affiliated to Sinuiju Teacher Training College.
Present at the closing ceremony were Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials concerned, and officials and researchers of the exhibited units.
The special diploma and best diplomas were awarded to the units which were highly appreciated in the exhibition.
At the end of the closing ceremony there was an art performance. -0-

headline: Kim Yong Nam Passes away
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Yong Nam, former chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, passed away at the age of 97 at 12:00 on November 3, 2025, due to multiple organ failure caused by carcinomatous poisoning.
An obituary of his death was announced on Nov. 3 by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet.
The obituary said:
The life of Kim Yong Nam was a brilliant one in which he was highly honoured for his allegiance to the revolution with pure loyalty and high ability under the care of the Party and the leader.
Born into a family of the ruined nation and lived in distress under the colonial rule of foreign imperialism, Kim Yong Nam greeted the national liberation at the age of 17. After the liberation he devoted his efforts to social activities for the prosperity and honor of the country and the freedom and happiness of the people.
He, who left to study abroad in the early days of building a democratic state, returned home in July 1952, when the homeland experienced a fierce war, and devoted himself to training Party cadres at the then Central Party School. He worked at the Central Committee of the WPK from the mid-1950s to the first half of the 1960s, contributing to enhancing the external prestige of the Party and conducting dynamic work with the progressive forces supporting and encouraging our cause in the international arena.
After working as a vice-minister of Foreign Affairs for four years, he successively held an important post in the field of international affairs of the Party from September 1967. In the period, he displayed strict principle and high practical ability in the important and difficult work of modeling the whole Party on the revolutionary idea of the leader, exposing and frustrating the moves of the counterrevolutionary forces that left a stain in the history of the world socialist movement and defending the revolutionary character and authority of our Party.
Since 1983, he had conducted dynamic political and diplomatic activities to defend the rights and interests of the dignified DPRK in the international arena for nearly 20 years as a vice-premier of the Administration Council and foreign minister.
In the days when he devoted all his wisdom and energy to thoroughly implementing the foreign policy of the state with independence, peace and friendship as its main idea, he made a great contribution to expanding the scope of the DPRK's external relations and creating environment favorable for socialist construction.
When our country and people were consolidating the foundations for building a powerful country under the uplifted banner of socialism in the face of severe trials, Kim Yong Nam assumed the post as the chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, faithfully supported the Party's ideas and leadership and demonstrated his unique ability and experience in the international arena, thus recording remarkable merits in the history of the DPRK's politics and diplomacy.
During his service as a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and a senior official of the DPRK supreme power organ, he remained faithful to his duty as a revolutionary veteran to ensure that the whole state affairs advanced along the correct track of development in the new era.
For nearly 80 years of his revolutionary activities, Kim Yong Nam had always served the Party, the country and the people with rich knowledge and high responsibility and devoted himself to writing precious books to convey to posterity the proud history of the Republic which has been associated only with victory and glory in spite of his great age of over 90.
The merits he performed by devoting his life to the Party, the revolution and the people will shine with the future of the DPRK which will win victory after victory and he will be remembered by the great history of the country and the people as a veteran of the state, the obituary said.
Kim Yong Nam was awarded Order ofKim Il Sungand Order ofKim Jong Il, the highest orders of the DPRK, and high-ranking Party and state commendations including the title of Labor Hero, for his feats for the Party, the revolution, the country and the people.
The Central Committee of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK announced a decision that the deceased Kim Yong Nam will be accorded a state funeral and the state funeral committee will be formed with the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, Comrade Pak Thae Song, Comrade Choe Ryong Hae and other 97 persons as its members.
The state funeral committee said that the bier of Kim Yong Nam is placed at the Sojang Club of Pothonggang District in Pyongyang and that the callers for condolence will be received from 09:00 to 19:00 of Nov. 4 and the coffin of the deceased will be carried out of the club at 09:00 of Nov. 5. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort and major enterprises in the city of Hamhung, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK.
Going round the tourist road, Ikkal Hotel, Potnamu Hotel and other projects in the Samjiyon Tourist Resort, the premier stressed the need to take measures for warming up the construction projects in keeping with the lowering temperature, push ahead with the projects as scheduled and enhance the responsibility and role of the construction officials and supervisors so as to thoroughly ensure the quality of projects.
He called for unconditionally finishing the construction projects planned this year by taking measures for supplying manpower, equipment and materials and for making preparations for next year's construction in a far-sighted way.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, he said that the complex should successfully attain the goal of the first-stage modernization project, true to the intention of the Party to turn the complex into a model of the machine-building industry, and put spurs to the current production in order to timely produce the major custom-built equipment in a qualitative way.
He underscored the need for the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex to steadily increase the productivity by making effective use of the existing production capacity and step up the construction of the line for producing slow effective granule urea fertilizer and thus make positive contributions to increasing the overall agricultural production of the country and improving the people's living standard.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of giving top priority to the supply of materials for the construction of the Samjiyon Tourist Resort, the issue of successfully finishing the first-stage modernization project at the Ryongsong Machine Complex and making good preparations for its inauguration and the issue of stably and steadily increasing the production of fertilizer.
Earlier, the premier acquainted himself with the production at the Jangsan Electric Appliances Factory and stressed the need to produce more electric motors and transformers urgently needed for various sectors of the national economy. -0-

headline: Mirae Scientists Street Representing WPK's Idea of Attaching Importance to Science and Talents
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the grand plan of the Workers' Party of Korea for capital city construction, new streets for the people are being built in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, one after another, demonstrating the national power and socialist civilization.
Among them is Mirae Scientists Street which was inaugurated in November 2015.
The street, built on the bank of the picturesque Taedong River, has tower- and group-type high-rise and super-high-rise apartment houses with thousands of flats, numbers of public buildings, commercial, public catering and public service establishments, resting places and sports parks.
It is a street of love provided under the benevolence of the WPK which puts forward the educators and scientists as genuine patriots and revolutionaries and provides them with all happiness.
Giving field guidance at the construction site of the apartment houses for educators of Kim Chaek University of Technology in May 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Ununfolded a grand plan to build a modern scientists street on the bank of the Taedong River and named the street to be newly built "Mirae Scientists Street".
He personally examined 590-odd street layouts and when visiting the construction site, he noted that all the structures should be built in a unique way so that they can be symbolic of the street of scientists while preserving their peculiar features and appearances.
Looking round the completed Mirae Scientists Street, he said that the more he saw the street, the more wonderful and magnificent it looked and it visually showed the WPK's idea of attaching importance to science and talents.
Picturing the ordinary educators and scientists who would live at the palace-like dwelling houses free of charge, he said this is the advantage of our socialist system that capitalism can neither imitate nor make.
The street is now full of joy and happiness of ordinary educators and scientists, and they are contributing to the prosperity and development of the country with the honor and pride of being educators and scientists of a great era.
Mirae Scientists Street representing the WPK's idea of attaching importance to science and talents is a pride of a prosperous socialist country. -0-

headline: Kim Yong Nam Passes away
Kim Yong Nam Passes away
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 4 (KCNA) -- Kim Yong Nam, former chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, passed away at the age of 97 at 12:00 on November 3, 2025, due to multiple organ failure caused by carcinomatous poisoning.
An obituary of his death was announced on Nov. 3 by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet.
The obituary said:
The life of Kim Yong Nam was a brilliant one in which he was highly honoured for his allegiance to the revolution with pure loyalty and high ability under the care of the Party and the leader.
Born into a family of the ruined nation and lived in distress under the colonial rule of foreign imperialism, Kim Yong Nam greeted the national liberation at the age of 17. After the liberation he devoted his efforts to social activities for the prosperity and honor of the country and the freedom and happiness of the people.
He, who left to study abroad in the early days of building a democratic state, returned home in July 1952, when the homeland experienced a fierce war, and devoted himself to training Party cadres at the then Central Party School. He worked at the Central Committee of the WPK from the mid-1950s to the first half of the 1960s, contributing to enhancing the external prestige of the Party and conducting dynamic work with the progressive forces supporting and encouraging our cause in the international arena.
After working as a vice-minister of Foreign Affairs for four years, he successively held an important post in the field of international affairs of the Party from September 1967. In the period, he displayed strict principle and high practical ability in the important and difficult work of modeling the whole Party on the revolutionary idea of the leader, exposing and frustrating the moves of the counterrevolutionary forces that left a stain in the history of the world socialist movement and defending the revolutionary character and authority of our Party.
Since 1983, he had conducted dynamic political and diplomatic activities to defend the rights and interests of the dignified DPRK in the international arena for nearly 20 years as a vice-premier of the Administration Council and foreign minister.
In the days when he devoted all his wisdom and energy to thoroughly implementing the foreign policy of the state with independence, peace and friendship as its main idea, he made a great contribution to expanding the scope of the DPRK's external relations and creating environment favorable for socialist construction.
When our country and people were consolidating the foundations for building a powerful country under the uplifted banner of socialism in the face of severe trials, Kim Yong Nam assumed the post as the chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, faithfully supported the Party's ideas and leadership and demonstrated his unique ability and experience in the international arena, thus recording remarkable merits in the history of the DPRK's politics and diplomacy.
During his service as a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and a senior official of the DPRK supreme power organ, he remained faithful to his duty as a revolutionary veteran to ensure that the whole state affairs advanced along the correct track of development in the new era.
For nearly 80 years of his revolutionary activities, Kim Yong Nam had always served the Party, the country and the people with rich knowledge and high responsibility and devoted himself to writing precious books to convey to posterity the proud history of the Republic which has been associated only with victory and glory in spite of his great age of over 90.
The merits he performed by devoting his life to the Party, the revolution and the people will shine with the future of the DPRK which will win victory after victory and he will be remembered by the great history of the country and the people as a veteran of the state, the obituary said.
Kim Yong Nam was awarded Order ofKim Il Sungand Order ofKim Jong Il, the highest orders of the DPRK, and high-ranking Party and state commendations including the title of Labor Hero, for his feats for the Party, the revolution, the country and the people.
The Central Committee of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK announced a decision that the deceased Kim Yong Nam will be accorded a state funeral and the state funeral committee will be formed with the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, Comrade Pak Thae Song, Comrade Choe Ryong Hae and other 97 persons as its members.
The state funeral committee said that the bier of Kim Yong Nam is placed at the Sojang Club of Pothonggang District in Pyongyang and that the callers for condolence will be received from 09:00 to 19:00 of Nov. 4 and the coffin of the deceased will be carried out of the club at 09:00 of Nov. 5. -0-

story_text:

The trees were planted as garden trees in around 1920. They are about 7 m in height, 0.8 m in girth of root neck, 0.5 m in girth of trunk, 2 m from the east to the west and 1 m from the north to the south in crown width.
They are tall among the juniper trees designated as natural monuments of the country.
Wonsan junipers are natural monuments of scenic significance. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at School Things Factory and School Fixtures Factory under Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the School Things Factory and the School Fixtures Factory under construction on November 4.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
He was greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence, the commanding officers of the units of the Korean People’s Army involved in the construction, officials of design institutions and officials concerned.
First, he visited the construction site of the School Things Factory.
After acquainting himself with the progress of the project, he went round the site.
He stressed once again that the construction of the School Things Factory, the School Fixtures Factory and the Educational Apparatus Factory which the Party attaches importance to are of great significance in consolidating the material foundation of the educational field of the DPRK and improving the educational conditions and environment.
Saying that thanks to the devoted efforts of the soldier-builders, the construction of the factory, which had been subject to empty talks in the educational field for several years, is to be completed in a matter of a few months and our army has created a precious wealth for the future of the country through a worthwhile day-and-night struggle for creation which no one can substitute, he highly appreciated their efforts.
He noted that the issue of consolidating the material and technical foundation of the educational field was dealt with as an important agenda in every plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee for the past few years, but the project was not carried out until the half of this year although five calendar years have passed. He said that this is a matter of viewpoint and attitude of the leading officials of the Cabinet and the educational field towards the Party's policies and the future of the state before taking into consideration the economic and practical conditions.
He went on:
Every plenary meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea adopted 8 same decisions on the establishment of those factories. However, they have not been implemented, and the relevant sector also has not presented a clear way for their implementation.
The plenary meeting to be held in December should strictly review the reason why the weighty policies of great significance on the most important of state affairs were neglected for several years.
Then, he went round the construction site of the School Fixtures Factory.
After receiving a report that the soldier-builders finished the construction of the factory's main frame and are stepping up the final work, he highly appreciated their efforts.
He expressed satisfaction over the fact that the soldier-builders are ensuring high quality in the construction. And he repeatedly commended them, saying that he could fully sense that all the elements covering every corner of the architectural space are associated with the steadfast ideological and moral world and pure loyalty of the People's Army committed to implementing the Party's policies.
He stressed that the School Things Factory, the School Fixtures Factory and the Educational Apparatus Factory should be flawless in all aspects of construction and equipment installation as well as the production and living environments as they are the key factories aimed to meet the demand of the whole country, clarifying the detailed tasks in completing the construction by the end of the year and running the factories within the first half of next year.
Looking at the samples of school fixtures to be supplied to all schools across the country, he emphasized the importance of establishing a system of supplying raw and other materials in a long-term and scientific way to fully satisfy proper standard, demand and quality according to schools, ages, figures and varieties and referred to the relevant measures to be taken in the future.
He earnestly requested all the soldier-builders to complete the construction projects for strengthening the educational foundation of the country into the monumental edifices clearly demonstrating the eye-opening development of our times, bearing deep in mind the pride and responsibility that they are building creations directly related to the future of the country by their own efforts true to the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee.
True to his militant call, the soldier-builders firmly pledged to attain a successful result to materialize the desire of the WPK as early as possible through high-pitched struggle and make a report of glory and loyalty to the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Folk Instrumental Music "Sinau", National Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- "Sinau" is a folk instrumental music that has long been executed by folk instrumental troupes and individuals.
In the Hamgyong provincial area, it is called the thungso (Korean bamboo flute) music "Sinau".
"Sinau" was used as war music in the fight against enemies by famous thungso masters from olden times and played on folk holidays of the people.
This folk instrumental music reflects the patriotic thoughts and feelings and strong militant spirit of the Korean ancestors who demonstrated their wisdom and courage in the fight against foreign aggressors.
"Sinau" which was played only as folk instrumental music in the past has been now re-represented by orchestra and other forms of stage music, displaying great influence and vitality.
The folk instrumental music "Sinau" gives the audience courage and zest as it is filled with the feelings and emotions peculiar to the DPRK people.
It is popular among people for its strong coloring, dynamic melody and peculiar mood as it produces enchanting sound of thungso in harmony with drum, gong, Janggu, flute, haegum (a Korean fiddle) and tanso (a Korean short bamboo flute).
The folk instrumental music "Sinau" was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage this year. -0-

headline: National Exhibition and Presentation of Forest Sci-tech Achievements Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- A national exhibition and presentation of forest sci-tech achievements were held at the Central Botanical Garden from October 29 to November 5 under the sponsorship of the Korean Forestry Association of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.
Present at the exhibition and presentation were officials, teachers and researchers ofKim Il SungUniversity, the State Academy of Sciences, the Forestry Institute under the Forest Guidance Bureau of the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the Forestry Equipment Factory, the Central Tree Nursery and other ministries, national agencies, scientific and educational institutions, production units and every provincial people's committee.
On display at the exhibition are forest machinery, utensils and tools, growth promoters and processed wild fruits produced by regional-industry factories.
The presentation heard the successes and experience gained in putting the afforestation and forest conservation on a scientific basis and examined and discussed the proposals dealing with the ways of doing so.
There were also a technical course, symposium and experience-sharing meeting on the cultivation and management of trees of good species being used in creating economic forests.
Certificates and prizes were awarded to the highly appreciated organizations and members. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Vice-Minister for U.S. Affairs of DPRK FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- Kim Un Chol, vice-minister for U.S. Affairs of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made public a press statement "We clarify our clear stance as we confirmed again the U.S. ulterior intention to be hostile towards our state to the last" on November 6.
The full text of his press statement is as follows:
The U.S. has fully betrayed again its wicked nature to be hostile towards the DPRK till the end.
Recently, the new U.S. administration has imposed its exclusive sanctions on the DPRK, the fifth of their kind since its assumption of office, which marked an occasion of putting an end to the speculation of the world and the public opinion on the change in the U.S. policy towards the DPRK.
By doing so, the U.S. administration showed to the full its stand that it would be hostile towards the DPRK to the last.
We clearly understood and reconfirmed the moves of the present U.S. administration to express its invariable hostile intention towards the DPRK again in an accustomed and traditional way.
The U.S. should not expect or desire to see its own mode of dealing, which is full of pressure, appeasement, threat and blackmail, working on the DPRK some day.

headline: Pak Thae Song Reads Elegy at Funeral Service for Late Kim Yong Nam
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, read an elegy at the ceremony of bidding farewell to the late Kim Yong Nam on Nov. 5.
Pak Thae Song said in the elegy that Kim Yong Nam was an excellent and ardent revolutionary and genuine patriot of the Korean people who left clear traces in defending the validity of the great revolutionary ideas and line and protecting the political and ideological might and interests of our state, while following the Party and keeping the life of glory with it for nearly 80 years.
Kim Yong Nam devoted his all to the country and the revolution as a prominent statesman and leading cadre of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and received deep respect and love of all the people for his noble traits and personality and merits, Pak Thae Song said, adding that his whole life was a shining career of true son boundlessly faithful to the country and the people.
As Kim Yong Nam said, the significant days and months when he was directly taught by PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwere the process of the turn of the destiny imbued with the new Juche idea and the unforgettable days in which he received mental nutrition to be kept more precious as time wears on, Pak Thae Song said, and went on:
Kim Yong Nam made a contribution to ensuring the successful external activities of our Party and the state regarding the strong independent stand and revolutionary principle as the life and arousing the support and encouragement of the progressive forces to the DPRK's cause on a world-wide scale by steadily enhancing the ideological, mental and practical preparations capable of perfectly fulfilling his mission under any condition and circumstances.
The proud pages of the DPRK's political and diplomatic history could be written along with the career of the revolutionary elders who defended the invincibility of the socialist cause and thoroughly embodied the foreign policy of our state with their transparent revolutionary faith, high political and theoretical level and seasoned diplomacy.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unalways respected and put forward him, who performed distinguished merits in the realization of the country's foreign strategy and the development of the people's power, as the state's veteran, awarded the title of the twice Labor Hero to him marking the 90th birthday, sent a warm greeting to him on the occasion of his 95th birthday and even left an unforgettable image by holding his hands who was difficult to move his body in July of last year. The warm love ofKim Jong Unserved as precious tonics to make him glorify his history of political activities with the ever-strong faith.
In view of the years working at important positions of the Party and the state and exploits performed by him, his perfect life has no scruples even though he spent his remaining days in good rest. But he repeatedly said it is still far to repay the trust and love, and devoted his all to writing a work dealing with the great state political history and undying exploits of the great leaders.
Though he, who had grown up under the trust of the Party and the leader and enjoyed the happiness and glory of his life on the road of sincerely supporting the Party and the leader, passed away, the traces of his life recorded in the history will not be erased and the noble revolutionary spirit of his loyalty will be alive in the hearts of all of us.
Pak Thae Song said that we will remember the shining traces of life of Kim Yong Nam who devoted his all to the development of our Republic and the steady advance of the Juche cause and bring earlier the bright future of the national rejuvenation true to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Un, as desired by him. -0-

headline: Folk Instrumental Music "Sinau", National Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- "Sinau" is a folk instrumental music that has long been executed by folk instrumental troupes and individuals.
In the Hamgyong provincial area, it is called the thungso (Korean bamboo flute) music "Sinau".
"Sinau" was used as war music in the fight against enemies by famous thungso masters from olden times and played on folk holidays of the people.
This folk instrumental music reflects the patriotic thoughts and feelings and strong militant spirit of the Korean ancestors who demonstrated their wisdom and courage in the fight against foreign aggressors.
"Sinau" which was played only as folk instrumental music in the past has been now re-represented by orchestra and other forms of stage music, displaying great influence and vitality.
The folk instrumental music "Sinau" gives the audience courage and zest as it is filled with the feelings and emotions peculiar to the DPRK people.
It is popular among people for its strong coloring, dynamic melody and peculiar mood as it produces enchanting sound of thungso in harmony with drum, gong, Janggu, flute, haegum (a Korean fiddle) and tanso (a Korean short bamboo flute).
The folk instrumental music "Sinau" was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage this year. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 6 (KCNA) -- The state funeral for the late Kim Yong Nam, former chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was solemnly held in the capital city of Pyongyang on Nov. 5.
The Sojang Club, where the bier of the deceased was laid, was wrapped in bitter grief over the loss of Kim Yong Nam, a revolutionary of the older generation who made distinguished achievements in the history of the development of the glorious Party and state.
The flag was hoisted at half-mast and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the state funeral venue.
Present at the funeral were the members of the state funeral committee including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs and the bereaved family of the deceased.
There took place a ceremony of carrying the coffin out of the club amid the playing of the dirge.
Guards of honor solemnly covered the sacred DPRK flag over it.
The participants saw it off, expressing their deepest condolences over his death.
Standing along all the routes to the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri, a large number of Pyongyang citizens expressed their condolences towards the funeral car out of the sorrow of bidding last farewell to the late Kim Yong Nam, who devoted his whole life to the Party, country and people and the victorious advance of the cause of Juche revolution and strove to carry out the honorable mission of demonstrating the dignity and might of our socialist state.
A ceremony of bidding last farewell to the late Kim Yong Nam took place at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas standing at the entrance to the cemetery together with leading officials of the Party and the government when the coffin arrived.
With the remains of the deceased at the head, the members of the state funeral committee and the bereaved family members climbed the cemetery.
When the start of the ceremony was announced, the DPRK national anthem was played.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and premier of the DPRK Cabinet made a condolatory address.
Kim Jong Unpaid silent tribute in memory of the late Kim Yong Nam together with all the participants in the ceremony.
The remains of the deceased were buried.
A volley was fired in reflection of the high reverence of our Party, state and people for the veteran revolutionary who glorified his precious life with ardent loyalty and genuine patriotism.
The wreaths were laid at the grave amid the playing of the wreath-laying music
All the participants prayed for the immortality of the pure soul and revolutionary spirit of Kim Yong Nam, who made a distinguished contribution to laying everlasting foundations for the eternal victory of socialism of our style true to the cause of the Party, along with the prosperity of the Republic.

Seasonal Divisions and Folklore of Korea in November
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- In November, there are the beginning of winter and the light snowfall as the 19th and 20th of the 24 seasonal divisions according to the lunar calendar.
The beginning of winter falls on November 7 or 8 and the light snowfall on November 22 or 23 in the solar calendar.
This year, the beginning of winter is November 7 and the light snowfall November 22.
Peculiar custom in the Korean people's diet in the said seasonal divisions is kimchi-making.
People used to make kimchi before and after the beginning of winter and so, November has been called kimchi-making month.
From olden times, the Korean people have attached great importance to kimchi-making, whose characteristics differ in every province in the way of making kimchi and in its taste.
They also made and ate dumplings with pickle stuffing, fermented fish and pop-rice cakes.
In those days, the Korean ancestors made preparations for wintering like repairing Korean hypocausts, while finishing yearly farming, including thrashing in the yard, drying, pounding and storing grains.
The folk games in those days were yut-game, Paduk, Korean chess and other indoor games, and kite-flying and shuttlecock game favoured by children. -0-

headline: Seasonal Divisions and Folklore of Korea in November
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 7 (KCNA) -- In November, there are the beginning of winter and the light snowfall as the 19th and 20th of the 24 seasonal divisions according to the lunar calendar.
The beginning of winter falls on November 7 or 8 and the light snowfall on November 22 or 23 in the solar calendar.
This year, the beginning of winter is November 7 and the light snowfall November 22.
Peculiar custom in the Korean people's diet in the said seasonal divisions is kimchi-making.
People used to make kimchi before and after the beginning of winter and so, November has been called kimchi-making month.
From olden times, the Korean people have attached great importance to kimchi-making, whose characteristics differ in every province in the way of making kimchi and in its taste.
They also made and ate dumplings with pickle stuffing, fermented fish and pop-rice cakes.
In those days, the Korean ancestors made preparations for wintering like repairing Korean hypocausts, while finishing yearly farming, including thrashing in the yard, drying, pounding and storing grains.
The folk games in those days were yut-game, Paduk, Korean chess and other indoor games, and kite-flying and shuttlecock game favoured by children. -0-

headline: Top Spinning, National Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 8 (KCNA) -- Among the folk games of Korea, there is top spinning which was widely disseminated in the period of the Three States and has been handed down up to now.
Top spinning is a children's game of whipping a top to make it spin on the ice or the ground.
There are many kinds of tops including the one with flat top and a point at the bottom, the one with pointed top and bottom, the one with a groove in the middle.
The whip for spinning a top consists of a string made of cotton thread and a straight stick whose length is about 50 cm.
Children about ten play top spinning by measuring how long their tops lasted after spinning them to run into each other, by competing how fast they can reach a destination while spinning a top and by watching how long their tops spun after releasing them to far away.
In the period of the feudal Joson dynasty, the top was called "Phingi" and it has been called today's "Phaengi" from modern times.
In folk holidays such as the lunar New Year's Day and the January 15th of the lunar calendar, children play various folk games including top spinning, shuttlecock game and rope-skipping.
While whittling a wood into a top and coloring it, children develop their thinking ability and hand skill. And they also develop their physical strength by spinning a top.
Top spinning has been registered as a national intangible cultural heritage. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Minister of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 8 (KCNA) -- No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Friday issued the press statement titled "The DPRK armed forces' cognition against the enemy and counteraction will be more clearly manifested", which said:
Recently, the U.S. military has become brazen in its military moves to threaten the security of the DPRK, intentionally escalating the political and military tension in the region.
Amid the ongoing U.S.-ROK joint air drill Freedom Flag, the appearance of the super-large nuclear carrier George Washington task force belonging to the U.S. Seventh Fleet heralds the critical excess, further escalating the tension on the Korean peninsula.
Prior to this, military bosses of the U.S. and the ROK visited the area near the southern border of the DPRK to fan up war hysterics and held an annual security consultative meeting in which they conspired the strengthening of their deterrence to the DPRK and the rapid promotion of the process of integrating the nuclear forces with the conventional forces.
This is a stark revelation and an unveiled intentional expression of their hostile nature to stand against the DPRK to the end.
The enemies are committing such doings on the Korean peninsula and in the region.
This is the true circumstances of the Korean peninsula and an everyday occurrence.
What does the world expect us to do, imagining what position we will be in under such circumstances?
We have no other choice.
We have correctly understood the hostility of the U.S. to stand in confrontation with the DPRK to the last and will never avoid the response to it.
In the future, all threats encroaching upon our sphere of security will become direct targets of the DPRK and be managed in a necessary way.
We are ready to respond to everything.
We will show more offensive action against the enemies' threat on the principle of ensuring security and defending peace by dint of powerful strength. -0-

headline: National Technical Innovation Contest Held

The contest, divided into the categories of foodstuff factories, daily necessities factories and garment factories, brought together the April 15 technical innovation shock brigades of over 50 regional-industry factories.
During the contest, many successes were registered through the technical innovations to ensure the normal operation of modern production processes and increase production capacity.
Progress has been made in increasing the proportion of locally available raw and other materials and reducing the consumption of electricity, materials and manpower through dynamic technological innovations for actively tapping and using resources in the relevant regions and raising the extraction rate of products.
And recycling and quality control have been improved. -0-

Experimental Apparatuses and Teaching Materials Produced by Universities and Schools in North Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 9 (KCNA) -- Universities and schools in North Phyongan Province are making successes by directing efforts to improving the educational conditions and environment.
Universities and schools in the field of general education in the province have produced over 19 500 pieces of experimental apparatuses and teaching materials of more than 460 kinds this year.
Teachers of Phihyon College of Land Management and Sinuiju College of Technology have manufactured dozens of experimental equipment including microwave sterilizer and PLC control device to improve the effectiveness of practical education.
Phyongbuk University of Technology and Sinuiju Medical University developed an experimental device for ultrasonic application and produced experimental apparatuses and teaching materials such as automatic high-pressure sterilizer to contribute to improving the laboratory and practical education.
Teachers of Amnokgang Secondary School No. 1 and Kusong Secondary School No. 1 invented and introduced computer pH measuring device, dust collector and a device showing principle of corona discharge to help improve practical ability of students.
Sinuiju Foreign Languages School introduced a teaching method of analyzing pronunciation according to different languages and improving speaking ability through games to develop the intellectual and creative ability of students.
The general education sector in Sinuiju and Jongju cities produced more than 200 experimental apparatuses and teaching materials including crossword robot and electromagnet-based dual electric system. -0-

headline: Paying Attention to Design of Product Labels of Regional-industry Factories
story_text:
One day in June 2013, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Changsong Foodstuff Factory.
Looking round the displayed samples, he appreciated that the products are very good though they were produced at a regional-industry factory, adding that even light industry factories in Pyongyang may not produce such goods.
Then he took a bottle of white distilled liquor on a sample table and carefully examined its label.
He told officials accompanying him that the label did not clearly represent the meaning of Hwanggumsan (gold mountains), the pride of Changsong County.
The officials of the factory reproached themselves for not paying attention to the label, which can be called the face of product.
That day he stressed that the labels of products should be made to vividly represent the meaning of Hwanggumsan.
The officials deeply grasped the noble intention of the respected General Secretary to make regional-industry factories produce goods which are excellent both in appearance and contents. -0-

headline: Development and Exploitation of Energy Resources in South Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province in the DPRK is creating a new generating capacity by exploiting various energy resources.
In contact with researchers ofKim Il SungUniversity, the province is building solar and wind power stations in the places favorable for the use of natural energies. It is solving scientific and technical problems arising in building and operating the power stations.
And it is taking measures to lay material and technical foundation of the newly-organized provincial natural energy electric power technology development station.
The technicians of the station have solved technical problems arising in operating solar power station built on the bank of the Songchon River in Hamhung City and the small-scale solar power stations set up in the compound of the provincial sci-tech library and in Hungnam District.
The province is establishing at the final stage the mixed power generation system based on hydropower, solar and wind power at the Hamhung Youth Power Station No. 1.
It is raising public interest in the use of natural energies by introducing the solar electric power production system into non-productive units.
It is introducing the pumping systems running by solar energy into the newly-built rural dwellings in cities and counties. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Wins 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- DPRK women football players took the first place in the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in Morocco and won the fourth World Cup.
The DPRK team overwhelmingly beat all its rivals in the group league, the round of 16, quarterfinals and semifinals and advanced into the finals. The finals between the DPRK team and the Dutch team, known as a powerful team of Europe, took place on November 8 (local time).
The DPRK players took the initiative from the beginning.
No. 15 Kim Won Sim scored the first goal at around 14 minutes.
No. 11 Pak Rye Yong and No. 7 Ri Ui Gyong succeeded in scoring goals at around 18 minutes and 42 minutes respectively.
After all, the DPRK team defeated the Dutch team 3:0 and won the World Cup.
At the awarding ceremony, the trophy and gold medals were awarded to the DPRK women footballers who won the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup, and the Golden Ball award, the best player prize, and Adidas Golden Boot, the top scorer prize, to Yu Jong Hyang, and the Silver Ball award and Adidas Silver Boot to Kim Won Sim. -0-

headline: Central Tree Nursery in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- The Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection is a large-scale sapling production base that produces tens of millions of saplings of more than one hundred species every year.
The tree nursery, whose capacity for producing saplings increased as compared with more than ten years ago, has also produced saplings for urban greening and sent them to different parts of the country.
It is associated with the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has made ceaseless efforts to cover the whole country with trees and flowers.
One day in November 2014,Kim Jong Unvisited the tree nursery and gave instructions on its work including expanding the nursery to produce more saplings, perfecting the method of planting and tending trees suited to the characteristics of the country and developing forest science and technology.
Kim Jong Unpaid deep attention to producing saplings, sent saplings of good species and seeds to the tree nursery and led the work for modernizing it including building outdoor cultivation grounds.
True to his noble intention, the officials and employees of the tree nursery have put the sapling production on a scientific, industrial and intensive basis of a higher level, thus contributing to covering the whole country with trees and flowers.
The tree nursery has steadily updated the technology of sapling cultivation and increased the species of trees with economic and ornamental value.
The saplings of tens of species produced by the tree nursery are contributing to creating useful forests in the country.
The tree nursery has established a tele-consultation system with the sci-tech learning spaces of the tree nurseries in provinces, cities and counties and exchanged technology with them, thus propelling the sapling production across the country. -0-

headline: Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex Marks Its 80th Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- The Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex in the DPRK marked its 80th founding anniversary.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who had paid deep attention to the work of the complex since he made a speech before the workers of the then Pyongyang Railway Factory on November 10, 1945, named the first electric locomotive made by its workers and reposed deep trust in them so that they display the spirit and mettle of the railway working class in the vanguard of socialist construction.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilmade sure that the significant day when the President gave the first field guidance at the factory was instituted as the founding day of the complex, and led it to thoroughly implement the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on railway transport.
Thanks to the wise leadership and warm love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the complex has developed into a leading rolling stock producer and parent enterprise playing an important role in the rail transport.
A commemorative meeting was held on Nov. 9.
Present there were Minister of Railways Kuk Myong Ho and officials and employees of the complex.
Manager O Yong Jae made a report. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Moving into New Houses Held at Kumsaem Farm of Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 10 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers of the Kumsaem Farm in Kumgang County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK became blessed owners of modern rural dwellings in the era of great upsurge when the capital and local areas, urban and rural areas are being rejuvenated simultaneously.
The beautiful fairyland village built at the foot of Mt Kumgang, a scenic spot on the East Sea, visually shows the warm love of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea which is cultivating a large flower garden for the people and opening a new history of rural rejuvenation on this land.
The village, where single- and low-storeyed houses were designed to fully serve the convenience of inhabitants while preserving the features peculiar to the mountainous area and beautiful scenery was created in harmony with the surrounding environment, is full of the people's happiness.
A ceremony of moving into new houses was held on the spot. Present there were officials of the province and the county and agricultural workers.
An address was made and licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
Amid the playing of peasants' music and dancing party, moving into new houses began in the village. -0-

headline: Organizations of Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea Conduct Mass Movement
story_text:

headline: Pukchang Thermal Power Complex in DPRK Promotes Production, Readjustment and Reinforcement
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 12 (KCNA) -- The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the readjustment and reinforcement while putting spurs to the production.
The complex carried out its daily, monthly and quarterly assignments for overhauls planned for this year, and is launching the last project for overhauling generator No. 16.
The technical problems for raising the efficiency of turbines were solved amid the work to increase the generating power per generator, and more waste-gas oxygen analyzers were installed at boilers so as to provide a guarantee for conducting their optimal operation by air volume control at a high level.
The complex is making sure that all the production, operation and supply units intensify the inspection of equipment and manage and operate the generating equipment as required by technical regulations and standard operating method. And it is ensuring the smooth production of electric power by shortening the time of unloading coal.
The complex is solving the problems in the winter electric power production according to a well thought-out plan, and taking measures to provide spare parts for the major generating equipment. -0-

headline: International Symposium Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- The International Symposium of Kim Chaek University of Technology-2025 took place on Nov. 11 and 12.
More than 120 sci-tech papers of great academic value and practical significance were presented to the symposium held under the theme of "Science and Technology-Driving Force of Development, Strategic Resources".
An opening ceremony of the symposium was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Nov. 11.
Present there were officials concerned, officials, teachers and researchers of Kim Chaek University of Technology and representatives of universities and scientific research institutions of Russia, China and other countries.
Pak Ji Min, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, made an opening address.
Expressing belief that the symposium would mark an occasion in further strengthening the academic ties between Kim Chaek University of Technology and educational and scientific research institutions of different countries, he declared the symposium open.
Ri Chang Sik, vice-minister of Education, said in his congratulatory speech thatKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other universities are making proud successes which propel the country's economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard.
Danis Nurgaliev, vice-president of Kazan Federal University of Russia, said in a congratulatory speech that the academic contact through symposium would make a positive contribution to exchanging ideas with each other and strengthening unity among the peoples of different countries aspiring after progress and wellbeing.
Then the international symposium was held at the e-library of Kim Chaek University of Technology, divided into panels of earth and environmental sciences, metal and materials engineering, mechanical and energy engineering, automation and IT, basic science and chemical engineering and bioengineering.
Speakers explained the academic achievements made in their scientific researches in such papers as "Effective non-vibration technique for exploring oil and gas resources", "Effect of laser output power and scanning speed on the characteristics of laser-induced graphen" and "Method for improving the accuracy of positioning based on the model of received signal strength in wireless sensor network".
The symposium closed on Nov. 12.
During the symposium, Kim Chaek University of Technology hosted a reception for the participants in the international symposium. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory has been known for its "Kkotmangul"-brand products across the DPRK.
The factory turning out various kinds of "Kkotmangul"-brand products was remodeled ten years ago thanks to the benevolent measures taken by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto provide the children with tasty and nutritious foodstuffs.
Visiting the remodeled factory one day in November 2015,Kim Jong Unsaid that when he hears the children's bright laughter, he would be optimistic about the rosy future, however difficult it may be at present.
He stressed the need for the officials and employees of the factory to produce many more nutritious foodstuffs and supply them to the children, bearing in mind that the normalization of production means preserving children's laughter.
Thanks to his loving care, the variety of "Kkotmangul"-brand products has increased in the past period.
The factory has given priority to observing the scientific and technological requirements according to quality indices in production lines. The production lines of candy, baby milk powder, etc. were awarded the food safety management system certificates and several products were registered as February 2 goods.
The factory developed and produced such health foodstuffs as peptide makkoli and parsley powder and is producing more nutritious foodstuffs of Korean style based on natural raw materials good for the growth and health protection of children.
On the basis of scientific confirmation of the rational mixture ratio of additives capable of preserving the taste and nutritive value peculiar to beef, the factory developed beef powder. And it established a method of producing pumpkin powder and made nutritious juice powder with such oil fruits as walnuts and pine nuts. -0-

headline: Highly Valuing Our Own Things
story_text:
One day in January 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill.
The respected General Secretary was very pleased to see various quality schoolbags made of bag cloth produced by the factory.
Then he went round the newly-built bag cloth production process. He repeatedly expressed satisfaction over it, noting that it is a production process of our own style it developed to satisfy the desire of the Party.
After looking round various places of the factory, he gave precious instructions for the management of the factory including the issue of producing more quality cloth such as school uniform cloth and varieties of textiles.
And he said in proud tone that all the equipment in the bag cloth production process is our own thing in name and reality associated with our strength, technology, creative wisdom and enthusiasm.
At that moment, the officials realized once again how intense his attachment to and pride in ours is.
True to his words, the officials pledged to steadily create our own things by giving fuller play to the spirit of self-reliance and thus bring earlier the prosperity of the country. -0-

headline: Modern Houses Built at Simpho Farm in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- Modern houses have been built at the Simpho Farm in Unhung County, Ryanggang Province, the DPRK.
The new village is the precious fruit of the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is putting his heart and soul into the work to provide the agricultural workers with an affluent and civilized life.
There took place a ceremony of moving into new houses on the spot.
Attending there were officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the county and agricultural workers.
A congratulatory speech was made there and licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.

headline: Technologies of Producing Reduced Iron and Synthetic Fuel by Coal Gasification Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the State Academy of Sciences developed the technologies for producing reduced iron and synthetic fuel based on coal gasification.
It serves as another valuable sci-tech guarantee of strengthening the independence of economy and developing the country's economic infrastructure.
Objectively proved at the national sci-tech examinations held in September and October were the advantages of the above-said technologies and their technical and economic effectiveness.
The State Commission of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry and other relevant sectors unanimously appreciated that the newly developed technologies can contribute to solving the steel and fuel problems by relying on our technology and resources.
The State Academy of Sciences is now stepping up technical preparations for introducing the above-said technologies into the sectors of metallurgical and chemical industries. -0-

headline: European Regional Seminar on Juche Idea Held in Finland
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- The European regional Juche idea seminar on "Independence, Peace and Social Development" took place in Helsinki, Finland on November 2 on the occasion of the 40th founding anniversary of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea.
The director general, secretary general and directors of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, personages of organizations for the study of the Juche idea in Europe including Russia, Denmark, Germany, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Slovakia, Austria, Britain, Italy, the Czech Republic, Finland and Poland and the secretary general of the International Institute of the Juche Idea attended the seminar directly or via video-conferencing.
Matteo Carbonelli, director general of the European Society for the Study of the Juche Idea, made an opening address at the seminar.
He said that the Workers' Party of Korea could lead the DPRK people to victory and glory for 80 years as it has thoroughly embodied the principle of independence and the people-first idea in all fields of the revolution and construction, regarding the Juche idea as its firm guiding idea.
The Juche idea is a great and original idea indicating the way to be followed by the progressive people aspiring after independence and socialism, he said, adding that the Juche idea indicates a clear way for the countries and nations longing for genuine independence and sovereignty to oppose hegemony and realize independent development.
He referred to the achievements made after the founding of the society, and stressed the need for it to further intensify the study and dissemination of the Juche idea in the future, too.
A congratulatory message from the Korean Association of Social Scientists was read out at the seminar.
Then speeches were made.
A congratulatory message to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwas adopted at the seminar.
The message said that the DPRK has advanced the revolution and construction on the basis of the Juche idea and made remarkable progress in bolstering up the defence capabilities, building economy and improving the people's living standard despite the imperialists' ceaseless sanctions and pressure. This would have been unthinkable apart from the Juche idea, the firm ideological and theoretical foundation, it added.
The message said that the Juche idea founded by PresidentKim Il Sungand developed and enriched by ChairmanKim Jong Ilhas been further developed by the respected General Secretary and gives perfect answers to more theoretical and practical issues, thus making the followers of the Juche idea hold fast to it as an invariable guideline. -0-

headline: International Symposium Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 13 (KCNA) -- The International Symposium of Kim Chaek University of Technology-2025 took place on Nov. 11 and 12.
More than 120 sci-tech papers of great academic value and practical significance were presented to the symposium held under the theme of "Science and Technology-Driving Force of Development, Strategic Resources".
An opening ceremony of the symposium was held at the Sci-Tech Complex on Nov. 11.
Present there were officials concerned, officials, teachers and researchers of Kim Chaek University of Technology and representatives of universities and scientific research institutions of Russia, China and other countries.
Pak Ji Min, president of Kim Chaek University of Technology, made an opening address.
Expressing belief that the symposium would mark an occasion in further strengthening the academic ties between Kim Chaek University of Technology and educational and scientific research institutions of different countries, he declared the symposium open.
Ri Chang Sik, vice-minister of Education, said in his congratulatory speech thatKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology and other universities are making proud successes which propel the country's economic development and the improvement of the people's living standard.
Danis Nurgaliev, vice-president of Kazan Federal University of Russia, said in a congratulatory speech that the academic contact through symposium would make a positive contribution to exchanging ideas with each other and strengthening unity among the peoples of different countries aspiring after progress and wellbeing.
Then the international symposium was held at the e-library of Kim Chaek University of Technology, divided into panels of earth and environmental sciences, metal and materials engineering, mechanical and energy engineering, automation and IT, basic science and chemical engineering and bioengineering.
Speakers explained the academic achievements made in their scientific researches in such papers as "Effective non-vibration technique for exploring oil and gas resources", "Effect of laser output power and scanning speed on the characteristics of laser-induced graphen" and "Method for improving the accuracy of positioning based on the model of received signal strength in wireless sensor network".
The symposium closed on Nov. 12.
During the symposium, Kim Chaek University of Technology hosted a reception for the participants in the international symposium. -0-
