headline: DPRK Women Mark Founding Anniversary of Women's Union
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- Exemplary women's union officials and communist mothers had a story-telling meeting "The worthy life of the blessed women" at the Hall of Women on November 13 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea.
Present there were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, women's union officials and members in Pyongyang.
Performers extended the noblest tribute and glory to the peerlessly great persons who gave ordinary women the genuine dignity and right and trained all the mothers to be women revolutionaries who glorify their worthy life on the path for the prosperity and development of the DPRK.
They said that they have turned women's union organizations into the groups of patriots and communist mothers who devote themselves to the country, true to the important tasks set forth at the historic speech made by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the 5th National Conference of Mothers.
The participants were moved by the stories told by the winners of the Communist Mother Honor Prize who have successfully brought up their children and invariably covered the road for supporting the army while cherishing that the happiness of families and rising generation is guaranteed when the country is defended.
The performers ardently called upon the participants to devote themselves to the prosperity of the country like the women of the preceding generations, remaining faithful to the idea and leadership of the great Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, released the following press statement titled "G7 has no right to oppose the DPRK's sovereign option" on Nov. 13.
The press statement said:
In Canada, foreign ministers of G7 recently issued a joint statement talking about someone's "complete denuclearization", ignoring the Constitution of the DPRK and violating it.
I express strong dissatisfaction and regret at the undisguised hostile act of G7 foreign ministers, a direct violation of our state's Constitution, and categorically denounce and reject it by using the most powerful rhetorical expression.
The inert deep attachment of G7 that still habitually choruses "denuclearization" which the world recognizes as an impossible concept only drives itself to the edge of the international community and goes to prove that it is a neglected minority interest group in a corner of international relations.
The present position of the DPRK does not change according to the rhetorical assertion of the outsiders, and in the present grim geopolitical environment, the possession of nukes is the most correct option to deter the most dangerous and hostile states.
No one has the right to force us to violate the Constitution and they should not try to make us amend it.
The way of ensuring the peace and stability on the Korean peninsula and in the Asia-Pacific region is not the advocating of the unrealistic "denuclearization" but the respecting of the Constitution of the DPRK.
As the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified, the DPRK's possession of nukes will remain an invariable reality whether the U.S. and its allies like it or not, no matter how repeatedly they may clamor for "denuclearization" for 10 or 20 years, nay 50 or 100 years.
The international community needs to pay attention to the clear fact that a substantial nuclear threat to global peace and security is coming from G7, a nuclear alliance group linked and colluded with nukes, with the world's biggest nuclear weapons state at the forefront.
The evasive and double-standard behavior of G7, which remains silent about the reckless nuclear rhetoric threat and nuclear proliferation attempt openly manifested in its group and insists only on someone's "denuclearization" that has already lost its meaning and justification, can not go down with anyone.
G7 has no right to tell independent sovereign states how to defend their security and is not in a position to discuss the sovereign option of the DPRK.
Steadfast is the will of the DPRK to guarantee the present and future of the state and the people and realize international justice by remaining faithful to the Constitution which perpetuates the possession of nukes as long as outside nuclear threat is not terminated and there exist forces seeking absolute hegemony, regarding nuclear weapons as a means of tyranny. -0-

headline: Mushroom Production Goes up in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- Mushroom farms across the DPRK are increasing the production by introducing advanced technology, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Tanchon City Mushroom Farm newly built a sci-tech learning space and is operating it in conformity with the actual conditions of the unit, thus raising the technical level of its officials and employees.
The Rason Mushroom Farm increased the production capacity of the indoor cultivation ground while readjusting and reinforcing equipment by its own technical forces. At the same time, it produced many earshaped mushrooms without special facilities in fields this year by solving various technical problems and is further developing its cultivation method.
The Koksan County Mushroom Farm established a method of cultivating Pleurotus ostreatus with the fermented substrate by adding rice bran to wheat and barley straws, thus providing a guarantee for lowering the cost and increasing the harvesting rate of mushroom per raw material by more than 50 percent.
The Tokchon City Mushroom Farm and the Samjiyon City Mushroom Farm have built up technical forces and introduced various scientific methods of mushroom cultivation suited to the regional characteristics. -0-

headline: Spotted-pattern Porcelain, Ceramic Craftwork Heritage of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- Along with Koryo celadon, the spotted-pattern porcelain is an excellent traditional ceramic craftwork heritage of the Korean nation created between the late 11th century and mid-12th century in the period of Koryo (918-1392).
In general, Koryo porcelain can be classified into celadon, white porcelain, black porcelain, spotted-pattern porcelain, etc. according to clay, surface color, glaze and manufacturing technique.
The spotted-pattern porcelain is made by mixing three or more colors of clay, kneading in various ways, putting glaze on porcelain and baking it. It gives a unique emotion as the colour patterns naturally go well with each other.
In the Koryo period, the spotted-pattern porcelain was produced only in some limited areas and only a few relics are available.
The spotted-pattern porcelain, which was created in the Koryo period and disappeared, could enjoy a rebirth thanks to the efforts of the creators.
Yu Kwan Jun, a creator of the North Hamgyong Provincial Art Studio, made a spotted-pattern porcelain in 2007 and further developed its manufacturing technique.
This technique has been carried forward and developed by him and his family.
Various styles of spotted-pattern porcelains are on display at the Korean Art Gallery, attracting the visitors.
The technique of making spotted-pattern porcelain was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2018. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Sets New Records in 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- The DPRK team set several new records in the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in Morocco.
The DPRK football team won every match and lifted the fourth World Cup.
In the match with the Japanese team, player Kim Won Sim scored the first goal just 38 seconds after the kickoff.
And the DPRK team set a new record for goals scored in a single U-17 Women's World Cup with 25 goals (an average of 3.57 goals per match) from the group matches to the finals.
In particular, Yu Jong Hyang, who was awarded the Golden Ball award, the best player prize, and Adidas Golden Boot, the top scorer prize, scored eight goals in the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup, and the goals are equivalent to the individual top scoring record set at the Women's World Cup.
The DPRK team has advanced into the finals of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup five times. -0-

headline: Spotted-pattern Porcelain, Ceramic Craftwork Heritage of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 14 (KCNA) -- Along with Koryo celadon, the spotted-pattern porcelain is an excellent traditional ceramic craftwork heritage of the Korean nation created between the late 11th century and mid-12th century in the period of Koryo (918-1392).
In general, Koryo porcelain can be classified into celadon, white porcelain, black porcelain, spotted-pattern porcelain, etc. according to clay, surface color, glaze and manufacturing technique.
The spotted-pattern porcelain is made by mixing three or more colors of clay, kneading in various ways, putting glaze on porcelain and baking it. It gives a unique emotion as the colour patterns naturally go well with each other.
In the Koryo period, the spotted-pattern porcelain was produced only in some limited areas and only a few relics are available.
The spotted-pattern porcelain, which was created in the Koryo period and disappeared, could enjoy a rebirth thanks to the efforts of the creators.
Yu Kwan Jun, a creator of the North Hamgyong Provincial Art Studio, made a spotted-pattern porcelain in 2007 and further developed its manufacturing technique.
This technique has been carried forward and developed by him and his family.
Various styles of spotted-pattern porcelains are on display at the Korean Art Gallery, attracting the visitors.
The technique of making spotted-pattern porcelain was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2018. -0-

headline: Tourist Souvenir Exhibition-2025 Opens in DPRK
Mining Industry Sector Readjusted and Reinforced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 15 (KCNA) -- The mining industry sector of the DPRK has concluded the readjustment and reinforcement planned for this year and registered higher production results than last year.
The Hyesan Youth Mine produced the materials needed for mineral production with the raw materials which is abundant in the country, improved the performance of equipment and ensured their normal operation, thus providing a guarantee for carrying out its yearly plan.
The Unpha Mine reinforced electric-car motors and narrow-gauged railroads and carried more than 1 000 tons of ores on a daily average in the second half of the year.
The team of technicians of the December 5 Youth Mine produced and installed equipment necessary for the normal operation of crystal mirabilite production process by the appointed date, thus increasing the production by 1.5 times as compared with the same period of last year.
The Munphyong Smeltery over-fulfilled its monthly index plan by solving the problems in ensuring the smooth operation of calcination-sulfuric acid production line and the electrolysis process, and the Manpho Smeltery is carrying out its production plan higher than last year's.
The Phungnyon Mine finished installing jaw crushers and conical crushers and increased the capacity of transport equipment. And it is pushing forward with the project for improving the quality index of phosphorus concentrates.
The Kangson Mining Machine Parts Factory manufactured and installed equipment of dozens of kinds and built a new process for producing hard alloys. -0-

headline: Visiting Two Fishery Stations on Mother's Day
story_text:
On November 16, 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the May 27 Fishery Station.
That day, the respected General Secretary went round the room for the education in the revolutionary history and the cultural hall and got on board a fishing boat of the fishery station that had just reached the wharf at the outdoor landing place.
Watching the work of taking out hard-finned sandfish from the hold and the sight of fish pouring on the landing place like waterfall, he appreciated that the fishery station caught plentiful fishes so far. He said that he was so pleased to receive the report on it this morning and came to the fishery station immediately with a thought of informing the people, who sent their sons and daughters to stand at the post for national defence, of this news.
Only then, officials came to know the reason why he visited the fishery station that day.
Time passed and lunchtime was near, but the respected General Secretary left for the January 8 Fishery Station without a moment's rest.
At the fishery station, he dropped in at the freezing chambers and saw with pleasure the fishes in the chambers and said that he was very pleased and that his fatigue was completely relieved, adding he feels pride of organizing this fishery station.
He earnestly called for catching more fishes and sending them to the baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphanages and old people's homes across the country with the feelings of being the parents of the orphanages and the children of the old people.
Like this, the respected General Secretary spent Mother's Day at fishery stations on the East Sea coast as the father of all the children and people of the country, bearing in mind the desire of all the mothers. -0-

headline: Lao FM Leaves Pyongyang
Large Numbers of Young People Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- This year, many young people across the DPRK volunteered to work at major worksites for implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea, schools in mountainous areas and branch schools on islets.
Dozens of young people in Kaechon and Tokchon cities, Pukchang and Mundok counties and other areas of South Phyongan Province joined the youth shock brigades in several coal mines.
Young people in Hoeryong City, Myongchon and Musan counties and other cities and counties of North Hamgyong Province volunteered to work at coal mines and mines.
An official of the youth league in Junggang County, Jagang Province, together with his family, volunteered for the county raw material base station.
Graduates of senior middle schools in Kangso, Waudo, Taean and Chollima districts of Nampho Municipality also petitioned to work at raw material base station.
Young people in Pyongyang joined district construction brigades.
Young people in North Phyongan, North Hwanghae, South Hamgyong, Jagang and Kangwon provinces also joined the construction brigades in relevant regions.
Among the volunteers are young people from Yomju, Sonchon, Cholsan, Unryul, Kim Jong Suk and Taehongdan counties and Haeju City and graduates of Hwangju Middle School for Orphans.
Members of the youth league of the Mangyongdae District Floricultural Station and the Taedonggang District Extracurricular Sports School decided to work at the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex.
Young people in Sinpho City, Ragwon County and other areas made decisions to work at the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and the Ragwon County Offshore Farm, and those in Rason Municipality applied for jobs with the construction mechanization brigade and the water supply and sewerage management station, etc.
Young people, including ex-servicemen in Manpho City and Kophung County, joined the volunteers' ranks with their enthusiasm to distinguish themselves at production sites and construction sites as the heroic youth.
Other young people volunteered to work at the iron works, steel plant, highway management station, ridgeway management station, forestry station and stockbreeding base.
The deeds of many graduates of Nampho University of Education, Phyongsong Teacher Training College and other universities and colleges across the country, who volunteered for schools on remote islets and in mountainous counties, show well the beautiful outlook on life of the new generations.
Graduates of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Phyongsong University of Education and other universities decided to work in the area of Mt Paektu. -0-

Graduates of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Phyongsong University of Education and other universities decided to work in the area of Mt Paektu. -0-

headline: Greeting Cards Produced in DPRK to Mark Mother's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- Various greeting cards were produced in the DPRK on the occasion of Mother's Day.
The cards reflect the respect and love for the mothers who are beautifully cultivating the flower garden of the large socialist family, fulfilling their duty for their families and society with warm maternal affection and boundless devotion.
Creators at the Art and Literature Publishing House and the Central Fine Arts Studio and teachers and students of Pyongyang University of Fine Arts produced 19 kinds of greeting cards reflecting their love for the mothers across the country.
Greeting cards carry such letters of various calligraphic styles as "November 16, Congratulations", "Mother! Congratulations", "November 16, Congratulations on Mother's Day", etc. and pictures of mothers receiving flowers from their children.
Those carrying the letters "Congratulations on November 16 ", "Congratulations on Mother's Day", etc. carry pictures of women workers who are displaying their honor as model workers at their worksites by devoting their patriotism. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Industrial Establishments
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors of the national economy.
He visited the Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, the Songnam Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and the Kaechon Coal Mine of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex to encourage the coal miners to wage a dynamic drive for increased production and creation for attaining this year's goal for coal production.
He called upon the officials to remember the importance of increasing coal production at present, to organize and direct production scrupulously, to give definite precedence to prospecting and tunneling, to secure enough reserve coal cutting faces, and to further increase the transport capacity and the proportion of the pit labor done by machines.
At the Chongchongang Thermal Power Plant, he underscored the need to successfully solve the problems in revitalizing production by reducing the costs of electricity production and improving the efficiency of generating equipment in close cooperation with a scientific research institute and thus unconditionally carry out the assigned electricity production plan.
He learned in detail about the production at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and stressed the need to ensure in a responsible manner the assembling of compressors which is being conducted at the final stage and their trial runs and to actively develop and apply rational operating methods so as to radically increase fertilizer production.
Inspecting the Hard Alloy Production Station of the Academy of Coal Mining Science under the Ministry of Coal Industry and the Ryonggang Stone Processing Factory, he called for pushing ahead with the modernization in a planned way and producing stone goods needed for major projects in a qualitative way.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of fully supplying coal mines with materials, equipment and accessories, the issue of scrupulously managing equipment and improving technical control to steadily boost the production of electricity and the issue of increasing fertilizer production by making effective use of the existing production capacity. -0-

headline: Pride of Mothers
Farmers of Songam Farm in Nampho Municipality Move into New Houses
New Houses Built at Sinyang Farm of Myonggan County
Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Indomitable Patriotic Fighter
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Kyong Chan on his 90th birthday.
The birthday spread reflects the deep love and trust of the peerlessly great man who wants the veteran revolutionary, who fought as befits a soldier of the Workers' Party of Korea with the loyalty to the leader and the conviction in the victory of the revolution, to implant the noble soul and spirit in the rising generation and live long, full of energy despite his advanced age.
Born into a poor peasant's family in Jangphung County before national liberation, he suffered every kind of humiliation and insult. He keenly realized how precious the country liberated by PresidentKim Il Sungis, and embarked on a patriotic struggle for the country and fought undauntedly, remaining faithful to his political creed and revolutionary principles.
The Party awarded Ri Kyong Chan the title of DPRK Hero and other high-class state commendations and took care of him to lead a happy life, enjoying the benefits of socialism, while inviting him to major events, including the celebrations of the 60th anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War, as a delegate.
Ri Kyong Chan and his family and relatives extended gratitude for the benevolence of the Party and hardened their will to devote their all to the dynamic prosperity of the great country by carrying forward the spirit of the heroic generation. -0-

headline: Benevolent Father of All Women
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of Mother's Day (November 16), warm congratulations are being offered to all the mothers in the DPRK who are devoting their heart and soul to the growth of their children, happiness of their families and the future of the state.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unsaw to it that the significant day when PresidentKim Il Sungmade a speech at the First National Conference of Mothers held in 1961 was instituted as Mother's Day and took a benevolent measure to observe this day every year.
The respected General Secretary took a measure to hold a grand conference on the occasion of the first Mother's Day and put the mothers who cultivate the harmony, prosperity and beautiful future of the great socialist family at the peak of happiness and glory.
He received a letter from a woman in the northern part of the country and wrote the autographic letters on it, reading that he thinks it is the mind of the mothers in the world to see their children making success in life and regard it as a lifelong pleasure that can never be bartered for anything. He also visited units of the Korean People's Army and had photos taken with the soldiers one by one to instill special pride in the mothers who sent their children to stand at the post for national defence. Such impressive stories and images are still kept in the mind of all the women.
The respected General Secretary, who saw to it that the Communist Mother Honor Prize was instituted, attended the Fifth National Conference of Mothers and called women beloved mothers again and again in his significant opening speech and the important speech.
Looking up to him who highly appreciated the feats of the mothers who have become models of true patriotism and roots of growing up many heroes and heroines in the glorious history of the country, the mothers across the country shed tears of excitement.
Bearing in mind his loving care and trust, many mothers of the country are making contributions to building a prosperous country, steadfastly carrying forward the family and national traits of loyalty and patriotism. -0-

headline: Pride of Mothers
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- All the DPRK people are significantly greeting Mother's Day, showing their respect and love for the mothers who are guaranteeing the rosy future as a firm pillar of the large socialist family.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unhas taken measures to map out the policies of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state for the prosperity of the country and wellbeing of the people and energetically led the struggle for their implementation to present the mothers with more pleasure and the families across the country with bright laughter in the new era of Juche revolution.
When the Third Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee discussed as an important agenda item the betterment of the Party's policy on childcare, all the mothers on this land were deeply moved by it.
At the Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Party Central Committee,Kim Jong Unset it as the consistent policy and eternal national policy of the Party and the state to supply school uniforms and things to the students across the country at state expense and took important measures to produce and supply new types of quality school uniforms and bags to all the students.
The fine schoolchildren's palaces, schoolchildren's halls and children's camps built in different parts of the country are associated with the loving care shown by the Party taking warm care of the rising generations just like their mothers who find the worth of life and pleasure in the well-growth of their children.
The mothers' desire to provide their children and family members with good meals is being translated into reality along with the proud creations for the comprehensive national rejuvenation, including the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex and the Ragwon County Offshore Farm.
The mothers with good children who have grown up, enjoying the benefits from the state, contributed to the prosperity of the country and demonstrated its honor are the source of pride of their families and the country along with the honors given by the Party.
The Party holds up the feats performed by the mothers with their sincerity to fulfill their duty assumed before the times and the history as an example of genuine human love and maternal affection. Last year alone, it awarded 21 women the Communist Mother Honor Prize.
The mothers who are invariably following the road of patriotism and loyalty, upholding the leadership of the great Party Central Committee with a single mind and purpose, whatever their positions are or wherever they live, are the pride of the families and the country. -0-

headline: Greeting Cards Produced in DPRK to Mark Mother's Day
Large Numbers of Young People Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- This year, many young people across the DPRK volunteered to work at major worksites for implementing the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea, schools in mountainous areas and branch schools on islets.
Dozens of young people in Kaechon and Tokchon cities, Pukchang and Mundok counties and other areas of South Phyongan Province joined the youth shock brigades in several coal mines.
Young people in Hoeryong City, Myongchon and Musan counties and other cities and counties of North Hamgyong Province volunteered to work at coal mines and mines.
An official of the youth league in Junggang County, Jagang Province, together with his family, volunteered for the county raw material base station.
Graduates of senior middle schools in Kangso, Waudo, Taean and Chollima districts of Nampho Municipality also petitioned to work at raw material base station.
Young people in Pyongyang joined district construction brigades.
Young people in North Phyongan, North Hwanghae, South Hamgyong, Jagang and Kangwon provinces also joined the construction brigades in relevant regions.
Among the volunteers are young people from Yomju, Sonchon, Cholsan, Unryul, Kim Jong Suk and Taehongdan counties and Haeju City and graduates of Hwangju Middle School for Orphans.
Members of the youth league of the Mangyongdae District Floricultural Station and the Taedonggang District Extracurricular Sports School decided to work at the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex.
Young people in Sinpho City, Ragwon County and other areas made decisions to work at the Sinpho City Offshore Farm and the Ragwon County Offshore Farm, and those in Rason Municipality applied for jobs with the construction mechanization brigade and the water supply and sewerage management station, etc.
Young people, including ex-servicemen in Manpho City and Kophung County, joined the volunteers' ranks with their enthusiasm to distinguish themselves at production sites and construction sites as the heroic youth.
Other young people volunteered to work at the iron works, steel plant, highway management station, ridgeway management station, forestry station and stockbreeding base.
The deeds of many graduates of Nampho University of Education, Phyongsong Teacher Training College and other universities and colleges across the country, who volunteered for schools on remote islets and in mountainous counties, show well the beautiful outlook on life of the new generations.
Graduates of Kim Hyong Jik University of Education, Phyongsong University of Education and other universities decided to work in the area of Mt Paektu. -0-

headline: Farmers of Songam Farm in Nampho Municipality Move into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- Farmers of the Songam Farm in Taean District, Nampho Municipality, the DPRK, moved into new houses.
The new modern houses at the farm in Nampho Municipality, a gateway city to Pyongyang, tell people about the deep love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is determined to make the agricultural workers enjoy socialist civilization, a worthwhile life and the joy of labor to their heart's content.
There took place a ceremony of moving into new houses on the spot.
Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in the municipality and the district, builders and agricultural workers.
At the ceremony, the speaker congratulated the agricultural workers who would move into the new houses built under the loving care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea which is ushering in a new era of regional transformation and rural rejuvenation on this land.
After receiving the licenses for using the houses, the farmers said with excitement that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis the greatest father in the world as he is translating the long-cherished desire of the agricultural workers into brilliant reality.
An art performance in congratulation of moving into new houses was given to add to the joy of the farmers and other residents. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Educational Experimental Apparatuses and Teaching Aids Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 16 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of educational experimental apparatuses and teaching aids was held in South Phyongan Province, the DPRK, according to Minju Joson.
The exhibition was attended by officials and teachers of universities and colleges at all levels, primary and secondary educational sectors and officials of the support organizations in the province. On display there were more than 2 000 pieces of experimental equipment, apparatuses, teaching aids and educational equipment of over 500 kinds.
The exhibition was held with an aim to further consolidate the material and technical foundations of education by raising the hot wind of creating experimental apparatuses and supporting education throughout society. It served as a good occasion for the development of education in the relevant regions and units, sharing successes with each other and eliminating shortcomings. -0-

headline: Rural Dwelling Houses Built in Ryanggang Province
DPRK Women Footballers Back Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The reliable women footballers of the DPRK have won the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup this year following last year, and lifted the fourth world cup.
They glorified the dignity and honor of the country with gold medals, flying the flag of our Republic again with high pride in the sky. The news of their proud victory is giving a great pleasure to the people across the country.
The DPRK players returned to Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Nov. 15 after winning every match at the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in Morocco.
They were greeted at the apron of Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports who doubles as chairman of the DPRK Football Association, officials concerned and those in the field of sports and the families of players.
The parents with pride and delight embraced their daughters who have grown up to be promising sportspersons while bringing their dreams and hopes into bloom under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: DPRK Women Footballers Back Home
Plant Epidemic Prevention Station and Pig-breeding Farm Built in Kaesong Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK newly built a plant epidemic prevention station and a pig-breeding farm.
The completion of the projects makes it possible to open up a prospect for further strengthening the agricultural production foundations in the region by producing biological agrochemicals according to farming processes by its own efforts and technology, putting insect monitoring on a scientific basis and breeding pigs of supra-species in large numbers. -0-

headline: Many Units Win Three-Revolution Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement is the highest level of campaign that directly puts forward the supreme programme of the Workers' Party of Korea on modeling the whole society on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as its fighting slogan, and it is a movement involving all the people across the country.
The movement started in November 1975 and its validity and vitality had been proved in the historic course of the revolution and construction under the energetic leadership of ChairmanKim Jong Il. It has been further developed in depth to a new high stage in the new era of the Juche revolution, serving as a driving force for accelerating the overall development and comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unin his historic letter to those attending the Fourth Conference of Frontrunners in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement "Let Us Bring About a Fundamental Turn in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement in Line with the Demands of the Developing Revolution" and other works clearly indicated the orientation and ways for bringing about a revolutionary turn in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement.
True to the important tasks set forth in his historic works, the mass movement for bringing about a great upsurge in the three spheres of ideology, technology and culture has been conducted briskly in cities and counties and at complexes. A large number of units won the Three-Revolution Red Flag this significant year marking the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK.
Party organizations in the sector of the key industry, which constitutes the main lifeline of the national economy, aroused officials, Party members and other working people to win the Three-Revolution Red Flag and intensified policy-oriented and political guidance so that its might could be fully displayed in the struggle to implement the Party's policies.
The sectors of the building-materials industry, agriculture and light industry also made a striking progress by pushing ahead with the three revolutions.
The mass movement for bringing about a great change in the three spheres of ideology, technology and culture as required by the era of overall development of socialism was conducted briskly in the fields of scientific research and education. -0-

headline: Brisk Rural Housing Construction in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The rural housing construction is making progress this year, too, along with the grand construction projects to build innovative entities symbolizing the new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation in the DPRK.
11 thousand and hundreds of rural dwellings were erected and farmers moved into them since the beginning of this year and several model farms were built.
The final projects for rural housing construction are being pushed forward on a full scale in different parts of the country.
Ryanggang Province and battalions of Party members from different provinces completed the rural housing construction. The builders devoted their wisdom and enthusiasm to improving the quality of construction.
North Hamgyong Province is concentrating on raising the proportion of mechanization in the construction and strengthening the supervision of construction. Cities and counties have introduced dozens of kinds of new utensils and tools to make substantial progress in decoration plastering and tiling.
Cities and counties in North Phyongan Province are expanding the successes in the construction while examining the technical innovation proposals made by builders, verifying their effectiveness and introducing them in a responsible manner.
South Phyongan and Jagang provinces are stepping up the rural housing construction while paying attention to introducing advanced construction methods, and Rason Municipality has made successes in the rural housing construction by directing efforts to strengthening the force of skilled workers both in quality and quantity.
Pyongyang Municipality and other provinces are pushing ahead with the rural housing construction while directing efforts to improving the quality control system of construction and laying the foundation for the production of finishing building materials.
And every province is now building a model farm in harmony with public and production buildings such as modern rural dwellings, cultural hall, neighborhood-serving amenity, clinic, kindergarten and nursery. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- Chongdan County, South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK, celebrated the birthday of   the third centenarian this year.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Yu Sun, a woman centenarian who is living in Neighborhood Unit No. 17 of Tokdal-ri, Chongdan County.
She extended thanks toKim Jong Unfor sending the birthday spread to an ordinary old woman.
She worked diligently at farm fields and even after becoming a pensioner, she did good things for society and the collective.
Officials of the county committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, villagers and relatives visited her house to congratulate her. -0-

headline: Illegal Ulsa Five-point Treaty Fabricated by Japanese Imperialists
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- It has been 120 years since the Japanese imperialists fabricated the Ulsa Five-point Treaty in a gangster-like way in the last century.
The Ulsa Five-point Treaty which reduced the Korean people into stateless ones and imposed misfortune and suffering on them is an illegal and fraud document cooked up by the Japanese imperialists by force of arms on November 17, 1905.
At that time, the Japanese imperialists forced Emperor Kojong and ministers of the government to unconditionally accept the original Ulsa Five-point Treaty already drafted by them in a bid to deprive Korea of its sovereignty.
When Emperor Kojong stubbornly refused it, the Japanese imperialists encircled the inside and outside of the imperial palace manifoldly with many armed forces and staged a military drill before the palace.
In this situation, the ministers of the feudal Korean government decided to reject the conclusion of the treaty at the ministerial meeting on the treaty held in the imperial palace on Nov. 17.
Upon hearing the news that the negotiations reached a breakdown, Hirobumi Ito, a ringleader of the invasion of Korea, went into the palace, made the ministers of the government gather in a room and forced them to approve the treaty.
In such coercive way, the Japanese imperialists unilaterally declared that the treaty was concluded. In order to give semblance of "legality" to the treaty, they did not hesitate to commit a base act of stealing the seal of the foreign minister and stamping it on the document.
The Japanese imperialists deprived Korea of its sovereignty with a completely illegal document which had no appearance as a treaty document. And they had inflicted vast human, material and mental damages upon the Korean people for more than 40 years which can not be compensated for anything.
However, Japan has still refused to admit, make an apology and reparation for its heinous crimes committed against the Korean people in the past, letting loose a spate of sophism that its colonial rule over Korea is "legally valid".
The more desperately Japan pursues its hostile policy toward the DPRK, making every effort to deny its past crimes of aggression, the stronger the Korean people's revenge on it to make it pay a dear price for its crimes is. -0-

headline: Mother's Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The people across the DPRK significantly marked Mother's Day.
People visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state, to pay high tribute to them.
Many people placed bouquets and flowers before the statues of the President and the Chairman and the mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men on Mansu Hill and in different places of the country and paid tribute to them.
Ceremonies of awarding the Communist Mother Honor Prize were held in different parts of the country on the occasion of Mother's Day.
Officials in all provinces, cities and counties met and encouraged exemplary women workers who contribute to achieving the prosperity of the country while fulfilling their responsibility and duty for the society and families.
There took place meetings and story-telling meetings in South Phyongan, North Hwanghae, Kangwon and Ryanggang provinces, Rason and Kaesong municipalities and other places.
Art performances were given in Pyongyang and other parts of the country, adding to the joy of holiday.
On the same day, the public catering establishments across the country rendered kind services to mothers. -0-

headline: Rural Dwelling Houses Built in Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The construction of thousands of rural dwellings planned for this year has been successfully completed in Ryanggang Province of the DPRK.
The whole province was astir with the ceremonies of moving into new houses held one after another in the counties of Unhung, Paekam, Pochon, Taehongdan, Kim Jong Suk, Kim Hyong Jik, Kim Hyong Gwon, Phungso, Samsu and Kapsan and the city of Hyesan, and reverberated with the songs boundlessly lauding the Workers' Party of Korea that the people sang with pleasure.
The cosy dwelling houses and public and production buildings built in harmony with the sceneries peculiar to the highlands while ensuring modernity, cultural refinement and diversity are the fruition of the noble devotion of the WPK to successfully turn the countryside into rich and cultural ideal villages with modern technology and civilization and thus achieve the rapid development of the socialist countryside.
An inauguration ceremony of public buildings at the Saphyong Farm and a ceremony of moving into new houses at the Namphung Farm in Kapsan County were held respectively on the spots, rounding off the rural construction in the province for this significant year.
Present at the ceremonies were Ri Thae Il, chief secretary of the provincial committee of the WPK, Kim Chol Nam, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the county, builders and agricultural workers. Congratulatory addresses and speeches were made there.
The modern hall of culture, leisure complex and others were filled with joy and optimism of working people. And the laughter of frolicsome children resounded at the nursery and kindergarten.

headline: DPRK Women Footballers Back Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The reliable women footballers of the DPRK have won the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup this year following last year, and lifted the fourth world cup.
They glorified the dignity and honor of the country with gold medals, flying the flag of our Republic again with high pride in the sky. The news of their proud victory is giving a great pleasure to the people across the country.
The DPRK players returned to Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Nov. 15 after winning every match at the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in Morocco.
They were greeted at the apron of Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Il Guk, minister of Physical Culture and Sports who doubles as chairman of the DPRK Football Association, officials concerned and those in the field of sports and the families of players.
The parents with pride and delight embraced their daughters who have grown up to be promising sportspersons while bringing their dreams and hopes into bloom under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Illegal Ulsa Five-point Treaty Fabricated by Japanese Imperialists
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- It has been 120 years since the Japanese imperialists fabricated the Ulsa Five-point Treaty in a gangster-like way in the last century.
The Ulsa Five-point Treaty which reduced the Korean people into stateless ones and imposed misfortune and suffering on them is an illegal and fraud document cooked up by the Japanese imperialists by force of arms on November 17, 1905.
At that time, the Japanese imperialists forced Emperor Kojong and ministers of the government to unconditionally accept the original Ulsa Five-point Treaty already drafted by them in a bid to deprive Korea of its sovereignty.
When Emperor Kojong stubbornly refused it, the Japanese imperialists encircled the inside and outside of the imperial palace manifoldly with many armed forces and staged a military drill before the palace.
In this situation, the ministers of the feudal Korean government decided to reject the conclusion of the treaty at the ministerial meeting on the treaty held in the imperial palace on Nov. 17.
Upon hearing the news that the negotiations reached a breakdown, Hirobumi Ito, a ringleader of the invasion of Korea, went into the palace, made the ministers of the government gather in a room and forced them to approve the treaty.
In such coercive way, the Japanese imperialists unilaterally declared that the treaty was concluded. In order to give semblance of "legality" to the treaty, they did not hesitate to commit a base act of stealing the seal of the foreign minister and stamping it on the document.
The Japanese imperialists deprived Korea of its sovereignty with a completely illegal document which had no appearance as a treaty document. And they had inflicted vast human, material and mental damages upon the Korean people for more than 40 years which can not be compensated for anything.
However, Japan has still refused to admit, make an apology and reparation for its heinous crimes committed against the Korean people in the past, letting loose a spate of sophism that its colonial rule over Korea is "legally valid".
The more desperately Japan pursues its hostile policy toward the DPRK, making every effort to deny its past crimes of aggression, the stronger the Korean people's revenge on it to make it pay a dear price for its crimes is. -0-

headline: Farmers of Tokryon, Naeyang and Yangchun Farms in DPRK Move into New Houses
Brisk Rural Housing Construction in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 17 (KCNA) -- The rural housing construction is making progress this year, too, along with the grand construction projects to build innovative entities symbolizing the new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation in the DPRK.
11 thousand and hundreds of rural dwellings were erected and farmers moved into them since the beginning of this year and several model farms were built.
The final projects for rural housing construction are being pushed forward on a full scale in different parts of the country.
Ryanggang Province and battalions of Party members from different provinces completed the rural housing construction. The builders devoted their wisdom and enthusiasm to improving the quality of construction.
North Hamgyong Province is concentrating on raising the proportion of mechanization in the construction and strengthening the supervision of construction. Cities and counties have introduced dozens of kinds of new utensils and tools to make substantial progress in decoration plastering and tiling.
Cities and counties in North Phyongan Province are expanding the successes in the construction while examining the technical innovation proposals made by builders, verifying their effectiveness and introducing them in a responsible manner.
South Phyongan and Jagang provinces are stepping up the rural housing construction while paying attention to introducing advanced construction methods, and Rason Municipality has made successes in the rural housing construction by directing efforts to strengthening the force of skilled workers both in quality and quantity.
Pyongyang Municipality and other provinces are pushing ahead with the rural housing construction while directing efforts to improving the quality control system of construction and laying the foundation for the production of finishing building materials.
And every province is now building a model farm in harmony with public and production buildings such as modern rural dwellings, cultural hall, neighborhood-serving amenity, clinic, kindergarten and nursery. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Confrontational Declaration of U.S.-ROK Alliance
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- Recently the U.S. and the ROK made public the "joint fact sheet" of the Kyongju U.S.-ROK summit agreement and the "joint statement" of the 57th U.S.-ROK annual security consultative meeting.
The joint agreement documents, published for the first time after the regime change in the U.S. and the ROK, reveal the true colors of the confrontational will of the U.S. and the ROK to remain hostile towards the DPRK to the end and predicts the future of the U.S.-ROK alliance that will get more dangerous and warns in advance the regional security situation that will become more unstable owing to it.

1. Hostility towards the DPRK and the confrontational ideal become policy again
The announcement of the agreement on the recent U.S.-ROK summit was the most vivid manifestation of the keynote of the policy toward the DPRK of the present U.S. administration which is nearing one year in office.
The U.S. positively promised to achieve the "complete denuclearization of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" together with the ROK at the summit level and this is an intensive expression of their confrontational will to deny the constitution of the DPRK to the last. It proves that their only option is confrontation with the DPRK.
This put an end to the burning question among media and experts about the true nature and orientation of the present U.S. administration's policy toward the DPRK, and the whole international community, as well as the DPRK, further confirmed their view on the U.S. stand towards the DPRK.
The U.S. and the ROK rulers have replaced the words of the "complete denuclearization on the Korean peninsula" which they touted for mere form's sake in the past with the ones of the "complete denuclearization of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea". It is the unanimous assessment of the international community that it is neither more or less than denying the entity and the existence of the DPRK.
This being a fact, the U.S. is talking about the implementation of the past DPRK-U.S. agreement which has been scrapped and nullified by the U.S. itself. This is the height of shamelessness and the way of thinking of Yankees that has made self-conceit their inveterate habit.
What we are faced with is not the past reminding us of disillusionment with the U.S. but the reality in which the U.S. reaffirmed its offer of "extended deterrence" to the ROK by mobilizing all means including nuclear weapons, pledged to strengthen cooperation through the Nuclear Consultative Group and affirmed that the primary target of the U.S. forces in the ROK is the DPRK.
The U.S. allowed the ROK's possession of nuclear submarine, disregarding the danger of the global nuclear arms race to be incurred by the nuclear proliferation to a non-nuclear state, and gave green light for the enrichment of uranium and the reprocessing of nuclear waste fuel, thus laying a springboard for its development into the "quasi-nuclear weapons state".  This is an intuitive view of the U.S. dangerous attempt at confrontation.
The results of the U.S.-ROK collusion based on the hostile view on the DPRK and the confrontational ideal are a microcosm of the anti-DPRK confrontational moves and escalation of tensions of the U.S. and the ROK which became more blatant since the emergence of the present U.S. administration.
This year alone, under the pretext of "demonstrating the ROK-U.S. alliance and increasing inter-operability", dozens of joint military exercises have been staged without any gap of time and the U.S. strategic means made frequent trip to the Korean peninsula (nuclear carrier for two times and strategic bomber for three times) started with the nuclear submarine Alexandria's entry into Pusan port in February last. This proves that the U.S. intention to be hostile towards the DPRK remains unchanged with consistency irrespective of regime change.
Days ago, the George Washington nuclear carrier taskforce, which had entered Pusan Port under the pretext of "supply of materials" and "rest of sailors", staged large-scale joint naval drills with the ROK navy. This reaffirmed the purpose of frequent deployment of strategic means which is to master the ability to fight a war against the DPRK.
Various bilateral and multilateral alliances, coalitions and consultation groups exist in the world under freewheeling pretexts, but there will be no such nexus of conspiracy as the U.S.-ROK alliance which directly targets a sovereign state and openly stipulated the confrontation with it as the line of the alliance.

2. Master and servant relations thoroughly serving realization of "America First" become Intensified
The ROK economy and national defence have been thoroughly subordinated to the realization of the self-righteous and hegemony-oriented "America-first". This is the most tangible "success" of the U.S.-ROK confabs.
The U.S. forced the ROK to pay tribute with astronomical amount of money that can completely drain the already vulnerable national economy in return for "slashing" the general tariff rate on the ROK to 15 percent, thus thoroughly turning the ROK economy into the colonial contract economy for the U.S. "economic prosperity".
On the other hand, the ROK decided to lift import restrictions on U.S. surplus goods including automobiles, foodstuffs and agricultural products and remove non-tariff barriers and thus opened its domestic market to the U.S.
This reminds the people of the humiliating and unequal Treaty of Jemulpo which granted the U.S. many economic privileges and restricted the Korean feudal government to provide the U.S. with privileges more than 140 years ago.
The tragedy of Jemulpo has clearly repeated in the military field.
The U.S. has more positively induced businesses of the ROK to participate in the "MASGA" plan for restoring the U.S. shipbuilding industry and reduced shipyards and harbors in the ROK into the repair, supply and maintenance bases for U.S. warships.
Meanwhile, the ROK pledged to increase the defense cost by 3.5 percent of its GDP for the first time as a non-NATO member among the U.S. treaty allied nations and thus was awarded the title of "exemplary ally" by the U.S.
In particular, the ROK decided to purchase U.S.-made weapons worth 25 billion US dollars and offer 33 billion US dollars for the upkeep of the U.S. forces in the ROK, coming under a yoke of the U.S. munitions industries by offering a brisk market for them by itself. This illuminates the master and servant relations between the U.S. and the ROK what they call the "best blood alliance".
The reality goes to prove that the alliance between the U.S. and the ROK is by no means the reciprocal and equal relations between states, but the relations between master and servant and that it serves as the straight road for realizing "America first" which seeks only the interests of the U.S. but totally ignores those of the ROK.

3. Dangerous nexus between the U.S. and the ROK extending to the globe beyond the regional range
The U.S. strategic scenario to use the ROK as a shock troop for realizing its Indo-Pacific strategy for holding the hegemony over the Korean peninsula, Northeast Asia and the rest of the Asia-Pacific region has been fully revealed through the present occasion.
The U.S. and the ROK agreed to boost the conventional deterrence posture under the pretext of coping with all regional threats to their allies and talked about the importance of ensuring "freedom of navigation" and peace and stability in the Taiwan Channel, revealing their sinister intention to deny territorial integrity and core interests of sovereign states in the region and openly interfere in the affairs in the international conflict areas.
They also decided to further intensify the tripartite drills, information sharing and military exchange for strengthening the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation and thus shaped as their policy the course of military action to promote the U.S.-ROK alliance to an entity of global military alliance, not a mere regional bloc.
In particular, the U.S. approval to the ROK's possession of nuclear submarine is a serious development that destabilizes the military security situation in the Asia-Pacific region beyond the Korean peninsula and causes the situation of impossible nuclear control in the global sphere.
The fact that the plan for building a nuclear submarine was secretly promoted in 2003 proves that the ROK's ambition to possess nuclear submarines is neither a "reflective measure" to cope with the DPRK's access to nuclear weapons nor a matter of defensive nature to cope with "regional threat" but the most dangerous step to open up the gate of realizing its long-cherished ambition to possess nuclear weapons.
The ROK's possession of nuclear submarine is a strategic move for "its own nuclear weaponization" and this is bound to cause a "nuclear domino phenomenon" in the region and spark a hot arms race.
The U.S. hegemonic scenario to encircle and contain rivals by forming a U.S.-led NATO-style security structure in the Asia-Pacific region by putting the U.S.-ROK alliance on a regional and modern basis is being translated into reality in detail. Such reality requires a more awakened way of looking at the regional and international security situation that will get more unstable and redoubled efforts to cope with it.
* * *
The U.S. and the ROK are openly ignoring the DPRK's legitimate security concern and aggravating the regional tension. Their provocative acts prove the correctness of the option of the DPRK which has indomitably covered the road of defending peace and security with practical acts, not words, properly informing the world community where the root of the instability on the Korean peninsula is.
The DPRK will take more justified and realistic countermeasures to defend the sovereignty and security interests of the state and regional peace, corresponding to the fact that the confrontational intention of the U.S. and the ROK to remain hostile towards the DPRK was formulated as their policy once again. -0-

headline: Emulation for Home Production of Building Materials in North Hwanghae Province
story_text:

Building-materials production units in the province, and cities and counties produce diversified building materials and develop more building materials capable of representing their regions by relying on their own raw materials resources.

headline: New Houses Built at Sinyang Farm in North Hamgyong Province
story_text:

Preserving the features peculiar to the rural area, cosy and modern houses have been built to ensure diversity in architecture formation. They represent the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which provides the agricultural workers across the country with new civilization and new life of Korean-style socialism.

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Ushering in Comprehensive Prosperity of State under Banner of Three Revolutions
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 18 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Tuesday dedicates an editorial to the 50th anniversary of the start of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement.
The 50-year-long history of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement is the one that the DPRK has built a prosperous state with self-sustenance and self-respect by consolidating our own strength to the full and the one that the DPRK has steadily brought about great leaps forward and great innovations in socialist construction by turning the achieved victories and successes into greater ones. In such proud course, the DPRK has developed into an invincible socialist state, the editorial notes, and goes on:
Today our socialist construction has entered a new higher stage demanding an extraordinary growth speed and a phase of comprehensive development.
The reality urgently calls for further accelerating the overall development of socialism by displaying the might of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement to the maximum under the slogan "Let us transform all our revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions!"
Holding higher the banner of the three revolutions at the present time is a prerequisite for more firmly preparing all members of the society into a powerful motive force to shoulder the great new era.
In the flames of the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement, people come to grow up to be the genuine revolutionaries who cherish loyalty to the leader as the inherent duty in life and are fully equipped with faith in socialism and class consciousness and to be the genuine human beings with extraordinary creative ability, noble moral traits and high cultural level.
Holding higher the banner of the three revolutions at the present time is an important guarantee for greatly expanding the phase of comprehensive development of our state by transforming all the revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions.
The editorial calls upon all the people to uphold the plan and intention of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on transforming all the revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions with signal successes in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and thus usher in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation with confidence. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Sagu Farm in Chongam District of Chongjin City, North Hamgyong Province
Instruction Given at Sample Room of Factory
story_text:
One day in July 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited a factory and dropped in at its sample room.
On display there were synthetic leather of various colours and leather goods produced by the factory.
An official of the factory told him that the products made with synthetic leather produced by the factory are better and more convenient to use than those made with synthetic leather imported from other countries.
Listening to his explanation,Kim Jong Unapproached the display stand where various bags are displayed, and took one of the bags in his hand and examined its quality. And he expressed his pleasure to produce various kinds of bags with synthetic leather.
And he instructed the official to display bags made by other countries, together with the ones produced by the factory, at the sample room.
Only then could the officials and employees of the factory strive to improve the quality of bags, comparing the bags made by the factory with those made by other countries, he added.
Looking up to him who devotes his all to providing the people with the best things in the world, the officials were deeply moved by his deep intention. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Ministry of Public Security
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, Tuesday visited the Ministry of Public Security of the DPRK to congratulate and encourage the officers and men of the Public Security Forces on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the public security organ.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Hyong Sik, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK.
When he arrived at the Ministry of Public Security, all the security personnel burst into enthusiastic cheers, looking up to him, the symbol of the mightiness of our Party and state and banner of all victories and glory, who is ushering in a new heyday of strengthening and developing the public security forces with his outstanding ideas and extraordinary leadership.
He was greeted respectfully by senior officials of the Ministry of Public Security including Minister Bang Tu Sop.
He extended warm congratulations to all the officers and men of the Public Security Forces on greeting the 80th founding anniversary on the militant journey of fulfilling their honorable mission of defending the revolution, social system and people, remaining faithful to the ideas and cause of the Party.
The national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
He handed the congratulatory message to the Ministry of Public Security on its 80th founding anniversary.
The officials of the Ministry of Public Security extended boundless thanks toKim Jong Unwho reposed great confidence in and showed warm love to them on the occasion of the significant founding anniversary of the ministry so that they can invariably follow the road of victory and glory.
The valuable traces of the service personnel of the PSF who devoted their blood and lives to the struggle for defending the outposts of the grim revolution accompanying the serious class struggle are shining brilliantly in the history of the WPK which has dynamically led the socialist cause of Juche to victory,Kim Jong Unsaid, adding that in those sacred days the PSF have stood as a strong fortress around the WPK as befitting one of the two core forces of the DPRK without a moment's deviation.
Noting that it is the important mission of the public security organ of the DPRK to guarantee by law and arms the activities of the Party and the government who devote all their energies to defending Korean-style socialist system and promoting the people's wellbeing, he highly appreciated the feats performed by all the service personnel of the PSF who have carried forward the high revolutionary spirit, class consciousness and spirit of unconditionally serving the people as their noble ideological and spiritual qualities and successfully made the 80-year-long history as the Party's political guards and guardian of the socialist state and the people's government.
He called upon all the service personnel of the PSF to firmly arm themselves with the Party's idea of building public security consistent with the people-first principle, make a fundamental change and development in preparing the ranks to be the political and ideological elite, bolstering up their combat capability and carrying out their revolutionary tasks by displaying pure loyalty and making patriotic and united efforts and thus invariably add luster to their glorious tradition and honor.
Expressing belief that all the officers and men of the PSF remaining loyal to the leadership of the WPK would carry on the annals of service more worthwhile and glorious than the 80-year-long history, he had a meaningful photo taken with officials of the Ministry of Public Security.
At the end of the photo session, thunderous shout of death-defying defence the participants raised again out of their pledge of loyalty reverberated throughout the sky of November.
All the participants hardened their firm determination to redouble their efforts to fulfill the sacred mission of the Public Security Forces, cherishing the great trust and glory shown byKim Jong Unall their lives and sharpening the treasured sword of the revolution and the red sword of the class, and thus reliably guarantee the victorious advance of the Juche revolution and the socialist cause. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visits to Supreme Court and Supreme Public Prosecutors Office
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 19 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, paid congratulatory visits to the Supreme Court and the Supreme Public Prosecutors Office of the DPRK on Nov. 18 on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the judicial and prosecution organs.
The officials of the judicial and prosecution organs were filled with great joy and excitement of greeting the most honorable and glorious moment to be cherished by them all their lives at a time when they were looking back with pride upon the brilliant history in which they have staunchly defended the cause of our Party in the long historic journey with their worthwhile reputation as reliable legal defenders of the Party, the revolution, the socialist system and the lives and properties of the people.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted respectfully by senior officials of the Supreme Court and the Supreme Public Prosecutors Office on the spots.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived, the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "hurrah!" with great emotion of receivingKim Jong Un, the supreme representative of the mightiness and dignity of our great state, in their institutions.
There were ceremonies of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK.
Kim Jong Unconveyed congratulatory messages to the Supreme Court and the Supreme Public Prosecutors Office on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the judicial and prosecution organs.
On the occasion of the significant founding anniversary of the prestigious law enforcement organs of the DPRK, he warmly congratulated and encouraged all the officials of the judicial and prosecution organs who are devoting themselves to carrying out the important revolutionary tasks of defending the state and the people with the sacred legal right granted by the Party.
He said that since the judicial and prosecution organs of the DPRK were founded as the fortress of securing the people's power and legal weapons for building a democratic, independent and sovereign state at the time of building a new Korea, they have developed into powerful law enforcement organs of our socialist state, adorning the whole course of 80 years with glorious merits true to the Party's ideas on Juche-oriented judicial and prosecution work.
The annals of our revolution, which brought about the precious victories and miraculous successes unprecedented in history, are clearly associated with the feats of the judicial and prosecution officials who have devoted themselves to accomplishing the socialist cause, sacrificing their all in the difficult legal struggle whether in grim days or in peaceful days, he said. He added that it is the great pride of our Party to have such an upright and powerful rank of law enforcement officials.
The period of comprehensive development of our state, which marks a great watershed in socialist construction with gigantic changes and steady leaps, also serves as a new heyday for the judicial and prosecution organs, he said, stressing the need for the officials of the judicial and prosecution organs to remain faithful to their class duty as defenders of the Party, the revolution, the country, the people and the socialist system and make tangible results in the work for the prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people, bearing deep in mind the heavy mission and responsibility they have assumed before the times and history.
Expressing expectation and belief that all the officials of the judicial and prosecution organs would further strengthen the socialist legal system by thoroughly applying the ideas of the Workers' Party of Korea and usher in a heyday of building Juche-oriented justice and thus continue to perform valuable feats and display the honor in the sacred struggle to firmly defend our ideology, system and single-minded unity, he had a meaningful photo session with them.
All the participants chanted the slogan of single-minded loyalty, reflecting the unshakable pledge to further glorify the honorable history and tradition of establishing solid legal foundations for building our dignified state under the leadership of the great Party and reliably guarantee by law the socialist construction which is developing onto a new stage of upsurge. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Inauguration Ceremony of Kangdong County Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 20 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Undelivered a speech at the inauguration ceremony of the Kangdong County Hospital.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades,
Just at this place over 280 days ago, we planned together the future of the revolution in public health.
It seems as if it were yesterday when we held the groundbreaking ceremony, but now we are holding the inauguration ceremony.
This is a moment that signals the second inauguration season for implementing the regional development policy, as well as a moment when we are seeing the first entity of modern regional hospitals.
A transformation worthy of proudly representing our eye-opening era has been brought about quickly enough to strike us with wonder.
Proclaiming inauguration in the year of groundbreaking is the standard speed of achieving our ideals, and this will be sufficient to show the acceleration of the substantial rejuvenation of the whole country, I think.
This is just our mettle and the speed of transformation and advance which we are going to achieve amid an uninterrupted surge–the speed of Korea.
The precedent for building in such a short period a healthcare facility, whose architectural processes are complicated, cannot be found in our proud history of construction.
Today’s inauguration ceremony testifies that not only things are changing and developing but also our ambitions will be realized earlier than we desired and imagined.
This year is the one of transformations worthy of note in the development history of Kangdong County.
Modern regional-industry factories have been built, and a leisure complex and its neighbour, a perfect county hospital, have sprung up.
Comrades,
Our struggle, aimed at bringing a beautiful and vibrant life to the regional people, has now entered a comprehensive and full-scale stage.
I am sure that the rapid steps we are taking from transformation to greater transformation will inevitably lead us to our far-reaching ideals of making the whole country change and prosper.
Our strong will and self-confidence and our abilities and practice will prove this.
Officers and soldiers of the Guards Hero construction unit, whom I am always proud of,
I extend my heartfelt thanks to your heroic creative mettle and unsparing devotion, with which you, as the banner of transformation for the wellbeing of the people, have ensured that our Party’s sincerity could reach the beloved people of Kangdong County to the full.
I also offer my greetings to the officials and working people of the relevant sectors, who have contributed to ensuring today’s inauguration through their responsible efforts and sincere involvement.
Comrades,
I am very happy that another perfect hospital has been built. What makes me more pleased and gratified is the fact that it will contribute to ensuring good health and a cultured life for the regional people.
This hospital has helped completely reversing the existing conception of a regional hospital; the course of its construction was exemplary and its operation will serve as an ideal model for the development of public health in the regions.
I believe that the medical workers, who will work at this wonderful hospital, are more excited than anybody else. I hope that they will always approach patients with heartfelt sincerity, tender care and warm affection and protect their health with high skills.
I will entrust the health of the precious people in the county, as well as this hospital, to the medical workers here.
The last month of the year 2025 will begin in ten days.
This ceremony will be followed by the inauguration of Kusong City Hospital, Ryonggang County Hospital and first-aid posts in the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area. Then we will have six modern medical facilities in all this year, including Pyongyang General Hospital. We can proudly say that this is a real transformation.
With these valuable results of the public health revolution, which embody the true objective of our struggle and bring us closest to it, we can confidently call 2025 a year of amazing transformation.
Comrades,
These first-stage results are really wonderful, but there can be no satisfaction in our work to promote the people’s health.
This hospital has encouraged us to conceive many plans and set ourselves more ambitious goals.
It is our Party’s determination to take revolutionary steps and advance more vigorously towards our-style modernization of public health to bring benefit to all the people in this country.
Modernization of public health will guarantee the long-term development of the country, and it will assure our socialist state of a bright future.
Let us take another step with ardent passion and soaring spirit befitting the pioneers of a great revolution for the good of our motherland and people.
The day will surely come when the regions have transformed themselves and we prosper while leading a cultured life.
Let us work harder for the beautiful future, when peace, laughter, happiness and amicability will brim over in all parts of our country.
My beloved citizens of Kangdong County!
I wish all of you good health and a happy life. -0-
