headline: Autumn Tree Planting in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 20 (KCNA) -- Autumn tree planting is brisk in different parts of the DPRK.
North Phyongan Province surveyed the state of securing saplings in cities and counties and is giving guidance over tree planting.
In particular, it pays attention to selecting the sites for tree planting and provides efficacious bioactivator to ensure the rooting rate. Many cities and counties, including Thaechon and Sakju counties and Kusong City, are now making good results by organizing manpower and supplying saplings well.
South Phyongan Province held a provincial demonstration related to autumn tree planting at the Chongok Farm in Phyongsong City and is planting trees in rural dwelling districts which have already been completed or are under construction.
After completing the arrangement of the area, the province makes sure that trees are planted in line with the soil conditions.
Hoeryong City, Onsong County and other parts of North Hamgyong Province are carrying out their daily tasks for tree planting on the principle of planting right tree on right soil and selecting right time and right species.
Cities and counties in South Hamgyong Province introduced advanced tree planting methods and selected species in a scientific way to raise the quality of tree planting.
Jagang and Kangwon provinces and Nampho Municipality, too, plant good species of trees and ensure the rooting rate while taking into consideration the geographical features, weather and soil conditions and symbiosis of trees. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Kangdong County Hospital Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 20 (KCNA) -- At a time when essential projects at a trial stage are being successfully completed as part of the meaningful process of more expansive and new qualitative development in achieving the epochal cause of regional change acclaimed by the people and urged by the times, a modern regional hospital was inaugurated to prove the vigorous speed and bright prospect of the development of public health of our own style.
The splendid inauguration ceremony of the Kangdong County Hospital for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held on Nov. 19 as another remarkable result of expanding and promoting the Party's grand programme for regional development on a long-term basis.
The venue of the inauguration ceremony was filled with great pride of soldier-builders who dedicated their toil and sweat to successfully build the creation of civilization for the people, following the road of valuable service at the outpost of the gigantic regional revolution, and excitement of the participants who gathered to celebrate the great auspicious event brought about by the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, arrived at the Kangdong County Hospital together with leading officials of the Party and government.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the inauguration ceremony.
The moment all the participants broke into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!"
All the participants paid the highest glory and tribute to
Kim Jong Unwho is making a sacred history of state building with his great pioneering spirit and absolute devotion, unfolding the bright blueprints for the all-round cultural efflorescence one after another out of his intense desire to provide the people with a new blessed life.
Present at the ceremony were secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK, members of the central leadership body of the Party in Pyongyang, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the Party, chairpersons of the provincial people's committees, officers and service personnel of construction units, working people in Kangdong County, senior officials of Party and power organs in the municipality and officials and employees in the field of public health.
Kim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech in commemoration of the inauguration of the Kangdong County Hospital.
Expressing his surging emotion of facing a moment that signals the second inauguration season for implementing the regional development policy and seeing the first entity of modern regional hospitals, he said that proclaiming inauguration in the year of groundbreaking is the standard speed of achieving our ideals and this will be sufficient to show the acceleration of the substantial rejuvenation of the whole country. And this is the speed of transformation and advance–the speed of Korea, he added.
This hospital has helped completely reversing the existing conception of a regional hospital; the course of its construction was exemplary and its operation will serve as an ideal model for the development of public health in the regions, he said, hoping that the medical workers, who will work at this wonderful hospital and are more excited than anybody else, will always approach patients with heartfelt sincerity, tender care and warm affection and protect their health with high skills.
Declaring that it is our Party’s determination to take revolutionary steps and advance more vigorously towards our-style modernization of public health to bring benefit to the people, he stressed that modernization of public health will guarantee the long-term development of the country and assure our socialist state of a bright future.
He ardently called for working harder with ardent passion and soaring spirit befitting the pioneers of a great revolution for the good of our motherland and people, for the day when the regions have transformed themselves and we prosper while leading a cultured life and for the beautiful future when peace, laughter, happiness and amicability will brim over in all parts of our country.
The participants responded with enthusiastic cheers to the passionate speech made byKim Jong Unthat gives a vivid picture of the future changes to be made in the life of the people across the country as soon as possible along with the realization of the long-cherished desire of the WPK which regards the people-first principle as its sacred political idea and lifeblood.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
Confetti was thrown and a large number of balloons rose up over the venue of the inauguration ceremony to be specially recorded in the nation-building history in the new era.
Warmly acknowledging the cheers of the participants,
Kim Jong Unwished the people in Kangdong County great joy and happiness in the future.
All the participants offered their boundless thanks to
Kim Jong Un, looking up with deep emotion to the benevolent father of the large socialist family, who is devoting himself to translating into reality the ideal life in which the whole country grows prosperous and everyone enjoys happiness and comfort and making the contemporaries lead the life.
Kim Jong Unwent round different places of the hospital.
He said that the hospital is a new sphere of regional rejuvenation developed by the WPK, a valuable result of making a breakthrough in accomplishing the historic cause of rebuilding the public health infrastructure on an advanced basis and a nation-wide scale and an epochal entity which newly formulated the concept of regional hospital in the true sense of the word.
For the WPK intended to guarantee the people's rights and interests and promote their health and build a more brilliant and affluent future, there is no more worthwhile and honorable revolutionary work than the struggle to build faster many more creations of new civilization warmly welcomed by the people so that they can see with their own eyes, get substantial benefits and feel happy about it, he added.
Saying that we must neither slow down nor come to a standstill in our struggle to comprehensively and scrupulously create a development environment for advanced civilization in all regions of the country, he stressed the need to expand the construction of regional public health on a full scale from the coming year on the basis of reviewing the experience gained in this year's construction of model hospitals of different categories.
Going round the hospital, the participants in the ceremony were struck with admiration at the civilized treatment environment and conditions of the hospital fully equipped with every condition for enabling inhabitants to fully enjoy an advanced medical service in their region like those in Pyongyang.
The inauguration of the Kangdong County Hospital serves as a significant and auspicious event of convincing the people of a new life and well-being to be come true in all parts of the country and an occasion of leap and progress of great practical significance in further expanding and implementing the WPK's policy for the healthcare revolution. -0-

headline: Kimchi-making Custom with Long History
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 21 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, November is the season to prepare kimchi for winter.
In the country, there are many kimchi factories, such as Hwasong Kimchi Factory, but most of the households are busy making kimchi with lots of whole cabbages and radishes as it is the traditional food of the country.
According to historical data, the name of kimchi is said to have originated from the word "Chimchae" meaning a vegetable preserved in salty water, or the word "Kumchae" meaning precious food like gold.
Ri Kyu Bo, a famous poet in the period of Koryo (918-1392), says in his poem that pickled radishes are a good side dish in summer and kimchi is eaten during winter. Judging by this, kimchi has been used as a main side dish indispensable to the Korean people's diet since olden times.
For a long time, the Korean people have been saying that they can not eat a good meal without kimchi, so they have always been having heavy or light meals with kimchi. During this, they created kimchi-related proverbs, such as "A tree grows on water, man lives on kimchi".
Households are now busy pickling cabbages cut into halves, chopping radishes to make hot pickles of the radishes, getting kimchi jars, etc.
The neighbours sit around and put hot chopped radishes between heads of the cabbages, which show well the beautiful trait and manner of our people helping and leading one another forward.
The DPRK people's custom of making kimchi was registered as one of the world intangible cultural heritages in 2015. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Speech of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Inauguration Ceremony of Hoeyang Army-People Power Station
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 21 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the inauguration ceremony of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Citizens of Hoeyang County and other people of Kangwon Province, who have come here with the most honourable and dignified memory of the quite arduous days,
Officials of the provincial Party committee and other Party organizations and government organs of the province,
Comrades,
In the period when the whole country is filled with enthusiasm to substantially wind up the year 2025 that must be recorded in history without fail as a year of victory, it is very auspicious that the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, another creation by the people of Kangwon Province, is to be inaugurated.
This is a precious success the province has achieved after taking a huge step in exploiting and enlisting the hydraulic resources as suited to its characteristics to solve its electricity problem, and at the same time meaningful fruition that demonstrates the self-reliant willpower and inexhaustible strength of its people who advance unyieldingly towards ambitious goals.
Today, seeing a transformation in the new era, which has been effected in another part of the country, and feeling personally the patriotic and loyal mind of the people of Kangwon Province, I cannot suppress the surging emotion.
Imprinted under the soaring dam and those mountains and their ridges are the traces of persevering efforts, and shining under them like gems are the pure patriotic minds. To think of it, I cannot look at them casually.
It is an appraisal the Party makes for the course of struggle of the people of Kangwon Province, who, after building the Anbyon Youth Power Station No. 2, Wonsan Youth Power Station and Wonsan Army-People Power Station, turned out to build another six power stations and, bravely overcoming manifold difficulties, have successively built them in Ichon, Munchon, Sepho, Phyonggang and Kosong and now in Hoeyang.
They are patriots, who have written our era in a chapter of history by building power stations. Those power stations, which have sprung up in different parts of the province that truthfully tells the history of the struggle of the army and the people to defend the country together, are fortresses of faith in socialism built by the concerted efforts of the soldiers and civilians to make firmer and more beautiful this precious land defended at the cost of blood.
Among the many projects aimed at achieving the prosperity and development of the country, building a power station for harnessing and transforming nature, to be frank, is a patriotic, long-term undertaking for posterity.
Looking back on the history of building our state from one century into the next, the projects to create material wealth by harnessing nature have been severest and most gigantic; and their spectacular results are still handed down as a symbol of the patriotic spirit and fighting power of those days and as a byword of miraculous feats.
What is really remarkable is that Kangwon Province, which has a smaller population and weaker industrial foundations than other provinces, has built by its own efforts these power stations that demanded a glorious and sacred but so arduous and difficult struggle.
In this province there would probably be no one who has not experienced the rage of nature in the construction sites of the power stations and no family that is not related with those days, I think.
The power stations tell the love of the local people for the country and native land and the history of the strenuous efforts they have written with their blood and sweat. They are patriotic monuments to the ennobling devotion made by the people in our era for the future, not merely for supplying power for civilization and prosperity.
For the future, for the coming generations–this is the inscription to be carved in the power stations in Kangwon Province by the times and history.
The honour to engrave the letters–gift to be presented to the Party Congress–on their creations is the right granted only to the true patriots who made a courageous start with patriotism and have reached a brilliant fruition through their vigorous struggle.
This is something that is above price and that can never be bartered for anything else.
I highly appreciate the pioneering spirit of the people of Kangwon Province, who courageously buckle down to the grand nature-harnessing projects no one dares to do so easily, but what I want to speak more highly of is their persevering character and disposition with which they follow stoutly and without hesitation a road, however thorny, and reach its end without fail.
Availing myself of this significant opportunity, I, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, extend warm thanks to the people of Kangwon Province and the service personnel of the Korean People’s Army for presenting to the Ninth Congress of our Party a valuable asset, which will bring benefits to the coming generations as well, by building solid power production bases, self-reliant and self-supporting, through a resolute and uninterrupted struggle with ennobling consciousness and steadfast will to defend the country, their motherland.
Comrades,
When the comprehensive development of our socialist state is being accelerated and the regional development policy is being powerfully promoted throughout the country, Kangwon Province is steadily building up its potential power for achieving prosperity by self-reliance. This is a great encouragement for us in the struggle towards the next-stage advance and upswing.
Increased and strengthened rapidly along with the construction of the power stations is the province’s force in terms of ideology, spirit, materials and technology. This provides the province with practical possibilities for conceiving higher development goals and pushing ahead with the projects in a bold way. In addition, it will play an important role in constantly expanding the sphere of development of the region.
All the officials and other Party members and working people of the province,
To regard experiencing troubles in our generation as good fortune and to lay bases of ever-lasting development and prosperity through strenuous and devoted efforts of our own–this is the worth of our struggle and our delight of making a revolution.
You have shown this not in words, written or spoken, but through a practical struggle.
Let us add more vigour to our sacred patriotic advance and usher in a golden age of transformation.
The spirit of creating a history of transformation by braving challenges and the disposition and mettle of doing without fail what is determined to do–this will inspire Kangwon Province more powerfully to lead the gigantic regional transformation.
I once again extend my warm greetings of encouragement to the conquerors of nature, artists of miracles in our era.
And I wish Kangwon Province a new appearance, which will be transformed and prosper as the days go by, and its people a happier life.
Long live the great spirit of Kangwon Province! -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Hoeyang Army-People Power Station Held with Splendour
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 21 (KCNA) -- Kangwon Province greeted the significant and auspicious event of inauguration which signals the completion of the hydropower stations it pledged before the Party when the whole country is full of the spirit of the vigorous advance of all the people to celebrate the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the one of great victory and glory.
The Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, which has been completed following the army-people power stations in Ichon, Munchon, Sepho, Phyonggang and Kosong, is the last project of the six hydropower stations on which Kangwon Province has concentrated all its efforts after setting it as an important task to build them without fail for the regional economic development and the improvement of the people's material and cultural life, true to the important task of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto go on to push ahead with the construction of small- and medium-sized hydropower stations.
The completion of another power base which the province had envisaged during the five-year plan for national economic development makes it possible for Kangwon Province to further strengthen its solid foundation for proudly writing a new history of prosperity along with the era of regional development and its development potential for creating a more affluent life by its own efforts.
The inauguration ceremony of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station was held with splendour on November 20.
The venue of the ceremony was filled with great pride and self-confidence of the people in Kangwon Province who have built valuable assets of prosperity with their own efforts and confidence in their own strength.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue of the inauguration ceremony, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" shook the earth and sky.
All the participants enthusiastically cheered, looking up toKim Jong Un, who personally visited the power station in the mountainous area to bestow great love and honour on them.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other leading officials of the Party and government, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, chairpersons of the provincial people's committees, officials and workers in Kangwon Province and Hoeyang County, military and civilian builders and employees of the power station.
The DPRK national anthem was played.
Ju Mun Jin, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, delivered an inaugural speech.
The speaker said that the people in Kangwon Province, who are imbued with the revolutionary idea of self-respect and self-sustenance of the WPK as absolute truth, greeted the moment of honour of making a report of loyalty and victory to the Party Central Committee on the building of another proud creation. The building of the six power stations simultaneously by the efforts of the province was a stiff and gigantic nature-remaking project baffling the existing idea and common sense and there were not a few obstacles in the construction, but thanks to the trust and leadership of the Party Central Committee, Party members and other working people in the province could wage a heroic struggle for the consecutive grand construction full of confidence and courage, he noted.
He referred to the fact thatKim Jong Unsolved all the problems and meticulously led the construction of the power stations saying that it is necessary to help Kangwon Province set an example in realizing the intention of the Party which calls for living on the strength of self-reliance.
He stressed that the power stations built in different parts of the province including the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station are a precious fruition of the revolutionary ideas ofKim Jong Unand a proud monument to the new era erected thanks to his absolute trust in the people in Kangwon Province and energetic leadership.
The speaker expressed the firm determination to make Kangwon Province take the lead in the worthwhile struggle for carrying out the tasks at the new stage of socialist construction to be set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK true to the ideas and leadership of the Party Central Committee.
Kim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech.
In the period when the whole country is filled with enthusiasm to substantially wind up the year 2025 that must be recorded in history without fail as a year of victory, it is very auspicious that the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station is to be inaugurated, he said. He noted that those power stations, which have sprung up in different parts of the province that truthfully tells the history of the struggle of the army and the people to defend the country together, are fortresses of faith in socialism built by the concerted efforts of the soldiers and civilians to make firmer and more beautiful this precious land defended at the cost of blood.
For the future, for the coming generations–this is the inscription to be carved in the power stations in Kangwon Province by the times and history, he said, extending warm thanks, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, to the people in Kangwon Province and the service personnel of the Korean People’s Army for presenting to the Ninth Congress of our Party a valuable asset, which will bring benefits to the coming generations as well, by building solid power production bases, self-reliant and self-supporting, through a resolute and uninterrupted struggle.
Hailing the indomitable spirit of the people in Kangwon Province of creating a history of transformation by braving challenges and the disposition and mettle of doing without fail what is determined to do as the great spirit of Kangwon Province, he extended once again warm greetings of encouragement to the conquerors of nature, artists of miracles in our era and wished Kangwon Province a new appearance, which will be transformed and prosper as the days go by, and its people a happier life.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his speech, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers as a token of their gratitude to the great father of the people who highly values the life and the struggle of the people in Kangwon Province as the culmination of the times.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
The fireworks were set off and a large number of balloons sent up into the sky of November, wonderfully adorning the venue of the inaugural ceremony that will shine forever as an immortal picture recorded on the glorious road of advance for self-reliance.
Kim Jong Unshook hands with every officials and meritorious persons, who performed remarkable labour feats in the construction of the power station, highly commending them for their efforts and devotion.
Then he went round the room dedicated to the history of the power station, control room, generator room, etc. to learn about their conditions.
Saying that Kangwon Province completed the construction of six hydropower stations including the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station during the term of the Eighth Party Central Committee, true to the pledge it made to the Party, he noted that it is a manifestation of the indomitable will of its people to unyieldingly go along the road of self-reliance, following the Party only, with unwavering faith in the justness of the line and policies of our Party.
He stressed that the people in Kangwon Province are, indeed, the embodiments of the pioneering spirit, models of our times who prove with their steadfast patriotic loyalty and persistent efforts the vitality of the Party's policy which demonstrates the truth that self-reliance is the only way to survive and anything is possible when one holds fast to the spirit of self-reliance ad self-development as the driving force. And he underscored the need for the whole country to learn after the fighting spirit of the people in Kangwon Province who unhesitatingly follow the road however arduous it may be and never fail to carry out whatever they undertake.
When we painstakingly take huge tasks without fear of the ordeals and difficulties and translate them into proud reality of the present times, it would represent the process of the development of the state and guarantee the happy future of our people and the generations to come, he said. He called for redoubled efforts to carry out the historic mission of the national rejuvenation given by the times and the revolution for the eternal prosperity of our great country and wellbeing of the people.
Enjoying the panoramic view of the magnificent dam of the power station, he noted that great is the might of the great unity between the army and the people and the monumental edifices which was recorded as another brilliant page in the history of the struggle of the people in Kangwon Province will hand down forever the patriotic feats of our generation who are ushering in the era of comprehensive national prosperity and writing a new history of regional transformation.
Acquainting himself with the construction of six hydropower stations Kangwon Province built by its own efforts and future plan for creating new capacity of generating electricity, he gave precious instructions to be implemented in building hydropower stations and strengthening the independent economic foundations of the province.
He expressed expectation and belief that the people in Kangwon Province would further exert their miraculous might, with which they opened up the clear prospect of solving the electricity problem most essential for developing the economy of their region and improving their material and cultural life, to continue taking the lead in the historic struggle for the victorious advance of the socialist construction of our style.
All the officials and working people in Kangwon Province, who were honoured with great love and trust bestowed upon them by the Party Central Committee, firmly pledged to erect many more entities for prosperity, which will contribute to the independent economic development and the improvement of the people's living, in the spirit of uninterrupted innovations and successive leaps without a moment's stagnation and thus glorify their honour as the forerunners of self-reliance.
The splendid inauguration ceremony attended by leading officials of the Party and government clearly proved the justness and vitality of the ideas and policies of our Party which calls for vigorously opening up a broad avenue for the comprehensive socialist development on the strength of self-reliance, and served as a meaningful occasion of further inspiring self-confidence that the eternal prosperity is in store for the people when they rely on their own strength and carve out their future by their own efforts. -0-

headline: Advanced Production Processes Developed
story_text:

headline: Art Performance Given to Commemorate Completion of Newly-built Army-people Power Stations in Kangwon Province
story_text:

An art performance "Our Marshal and People in Kangwon Province" was given at the Kangwon Provincial Art Theatre on Thursday to commemorate the completion of the new six army-people power stations.

Songs of struggle and advance reminded the audience of the unforgettable days of the power station construction with the ardent patriotism and the spirit of self-sustenance to build without fail the eternal wealth for the prosperity of the country by their own efforts.
The scenes impressively showing that the might of the great army-people unity, the mainstay of the revolution and the foundation of our society, performed world-startling miracles touched the heartstrings of the audience.
Through exciting and powerful numbers, the audience keenly felt the pure mental world of the creators of the spirit of Kangwon Province who are advancing in the vanguard of implementing the Party's policies and bringing earlier the bright future by dint of self-reliance, bearing in mind the firm faith that the Party's ideas and lines are precisely truth and victory.
The song "We Are Koreans" made the venue of the performance filled with emotion, giving the great pride of being the Koreans, the strongest in the world, and the masters of the most glorious great era ofKim Jong Unwho are advancing along the road of prosperity by dint of self-reliance that no one else in the world has ever trodden and racing against the age of gigantic miracle and the time of epoch-making creation and changes.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it demonstrated the iron will of the people in Kangwon Province to steadily display the worthwhile honor of the model province of implementing the Party's policies and creator of the spirit of the times on the road of glorifying the socialist state forever by dint of self-reliance which knows no impossibility under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Komdok Mining Complex Boosts Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- The Komdok Mining Complex in the DPRK has increased the mining, transport and dressing capacities twice as compared with the previous time by readjusting and reinforcing all production processes.
Efficient compressors, rock drills, jumbos, pneumatic loaders, electric cars and mine tubs were reinforced and compressed air pipes, drainage pipes and cables were replaced.
The pumping and compressor stations have been modernized to contribute to improving the efficiency of production at mining faces.
The complex put the production on a steady growth track by readjusting and reinforcing all processes. -0-

headline: Presentation and Exhibition of Agricultural Sector Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 22 (KCNA) -- A national presentation on technology and experience and exhibition of scientific research achievements in the agricultural sector took place at the Sci-Tech Complex in the DPRK from Nov. 17 to 21.
Shared and transferred at the presentation and exhibition were the research achievements, technology and experience gained in the sectors of agricultural production and scientific research across the country.
Submitted to the presentation and exhibition, divided into nine panels including the agricultural production panel and the seed panel, were more than 1 000 papers and experimental data and at least 10 000 exhibits of over 1 200 kinds.
Drawing the attention of the participants were research achievements conducive to establishing Korean-style green cultivation and fish farming methods, breeding and introduction of supra-species, etc.
Present at the closing ceremony held on Friday were officials, scientists, teachers and postgraduate students of the Agricultural Commission and scientific and educational institutions in the agricultural sector.
Certificates were awarded to those who announced technology, experience and scientific research achievements, and prizes were awarded to the units and members who were highly appreciated. -0-

headline: View on Home Production
story_text:
One day in June 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Sports Goods Factory.
Saying that we should make and use athletic apparatuses necessary for developing the country's specialized sports techniques and making sports mass-based and part of everyday life with our efforts, technology and raw and other materials, he said that if we increase the rate of home production, we can lower the cost of production as much.
He stressed the need to conduct a vigorous research into home production of raw and other materials needed for the production of athletic apparatuses.
An official of the factory toldKim Jong Unthat teachers and researchers of a university ensured 70 percent of adhesive needed for the production of balls with our own materials.
Hearing his reply,Kim Jong Unsaid what is important is its quality and that only when the quality of the equipment, raw and other materials made in our country reaches the international standard, can we estimate that they are locally available, adding that officials should have a correct understanding of the home production.
At that time, the officials of the factory had a view that home production precisely means the equipment, raw and other materials produced at home.
Kim Jong Uncorrected the wrong view of the officials.
Bearing in mind his teachings on the standard of home production, the officials of the factory were determined to fulfill their responsibility and duty in realizing the home production of athletic apparatuses. -0-

headline: Volume 68 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 68 of "Complete Collection ofKim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively contains classic works of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a chronological order.
The book contains 51 classic works including historic talks and speeches published by the Chairman from October 2004 to April 2005.
In his classic work "On Vigorously Conducting the Ideological Revolution", he clarified the tasks and ways for vigorously conducting ideological education, including firmly arming Party members and other working people with the spirit of collectivism and further intensifying education in socialist patriotism.
Some works deal with the ways for giving full play to the fine traits of unity between superiors and inferiors and unity between officers and men, improving the soldiers' life and decisively enhancing the political and practical qualifications of commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The Chairman in his works stressed the need for the creators and artistes in the field of art and literature to give ideological and moral pabulum to the DPRK people and encourage them in their struggle by creating many art pieces as intended by the Party.
The book also contains the classic works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction including the issue of sprucing up Mt Chilbo as a pleasure park for the people and the issue of printing many revolutionary novels for young people. -0-

headline: Volume 68 of "Complete Collection of Kim Jong Il's Works" Published
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 68 of "Complete Collection ofKim Jong Il's Works", a library of immortal Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism which comprehensively contains classic works of ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a chronological order.
The book contains 51 classic works including historic talks and speeches published by the Chairman from October 2004 to April 2005.
In his classic work "On Vigorously Conducting the Ideological Revolution", he clarified the tasks and ways for vigorously conducting ideological education, including firmly arming Party members and other working people with the spirit of collectivism and further intensifying education in socialist patriotism.
Some works deal with the ways for giving full play to the fine traits of unity between superiors and inferiors and unity between officers and men, improving the soldiers' life and decisively enhancing the political and practical qualifications of commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The Chairman in his works stressed the need for the creators and artistes in the field of art and literature to give ideological and moral pabulum to the DPRK people and encourage them in their struggle by creating many art pieces as intended by the Party.
The book also contains the classic works giving perfect answers to the theoretical and practical issues arising in the revolution and construction including the issue of sprucing up Mt Chilbo as a pleasure park for the people and the issue of printing many revolutionary novels for young people. -0-

headline: Measures Taken to Prevent Forest-Fire in Ryanggang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province in the DPRK is taking measures for preventing forest-fire in a farsighted way.
The province organized forest-fire prevention commanding forces in different regions and units and saw to it that officials conduct political work among the working people and residents to inspire all the people to turn out in the campaign for preventing forest-fire.
After establishing the information service system for monitoring forest-fire, cities and counties in the province have urged the relevant units to intensify real-time monitoring to prevent the forest-fire in advance. They rallied hundreds of fixed and mobile observation posts and have taken measures to intensify concentrated monitoring of forest areas and surrounding mountains of villages.
The forest supervision sector is intensifying the control and education for making the people observe the regulations on forest protection in case of entering mountains.
Samsu County has appointed people with high responsibility as forest-fire watchers to intensify monitoring and is pushing ahead with the work to build obstacles with stones and water-intake places.
Kim Jong Suk County is taking measures to prevent forest-fire while directing efforts to protecting forests around the township.
The electric-power industrial sector, including the provincial power transmission and distribution station, is reducing the risk of forest-fire by lopping the branches of trees around the railway roads and in the area where the power line has passed. -0-

headline: Many Women in Ryanggang Province Volunteer for Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- Thousands of primary officials and members of the women's union in Ryanggang Province in the DPRK volunteered for major worksites to implement the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea this year.
With patriotism, women's union members have devoted themselves at socialist rural areas, and raw material bases and light industry factories in their regions.
The deeds of the volunteers in Ryanggang Province with a single mind to cement the foundations for a powerful country with their diligent efforts are injecting vitality into the worksites vibrant with the new spirit of regional rejuvenation. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Hyongjesan District of Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 23 (KCNA) -- A fairyland village has appeared at the Hyongsan Vegetable Farm in Hyongjesan District, Pyongyang Municipality.
The picturesque modern houses built at the farm in the wake of last year are the homes of happiness provided thanks to the ardent love and devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Present at the ceremony of moving into new houses held on the spot were officials of the Party and power organs in the municipality and the district, builders and agricultural workers.
An address was made at the ceremony and licenses for the use of the houses were conveyed to be followed by speeches.
As people began to move into the new houses, the whole village was immersed in a festive mood and officials visited the owners of the new houses to give them daily necessities and share joy with them. -0-

headline: Functional Building Materials with Practicality in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 24 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, a unit of the DPRK developed building materials for finishing decoration of the interior of buildings with expansion vermiculite.
The building materials purify the air in room by accumulating anion from the nature of vermiculite and have the strong function of thermal insulation and thermal reflection and the soundproof effect.
Their practicality and value are very high as they do not need hydraulic moulding machines and other equipment at all and the decoration in relief can be made only with expansion vermiculite and adhesive.
They are very popular in various units and families. -0-

Rodong Sinmun Calls for Emulating Spirit of Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 24 (KCNA) -- At a dynamic time when a series of remarkable successes and changes are being made which clearly demonstrate the reality of the period of the comprehensive development of socialism, Kangwon Province of the DPRK has built solid power bases that will greatly contribute to the regional development and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
Rodong Sinmun says in an editorial on Monday that the fighting spirit, traits and mettle of the people in Kangwon Province are a thoroughgoing embodiment of the Workers' Party of Korea's idea of self-respect and self-sustenance, the spirit of the DPRK advancing bravely toward the realization of the far-reaching ideal and goal and a clear manifestation of the indomitable disposition and toughness peculiar to the Korean people.
The core of the spirit of Kangwon Province is the viewpoint that the Party's policies should be carried out unconditionally and the stand that no one else can implement the Party's policies instead of those who are directly responsible for carrying through them and that one should open up the road ahead by oneself, the editorial says, and continues:
The spirit of Kangwon Province reflects the spirit of overcoming challenges and creating a history of changes, and the disposition and mettle that one does to the last unconditionally what one is determined to do.
Our Party highly values the success of building powerful power bases in the face of difficulties and puts forward before anything else the fighting spirit of the people in Kangwon Province who made strenuous efforts to prove the validity and vitality of the Party's policies.
The spirit of Kangwon Province is full of the ardent love for the future with which to make devoted efforts to lay the foundations for prosperity of all ages, taking the pleasure in overcoming the hardships of the times.
The creators of the spirit of Kangwon Province clearly proved the validity and vitality of the Party's line and policies of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance at a time when new realms and spheres of development and civilization are being opened up and steadily expanded in all the sectors of socialist construction.
As there are the wise leadership of the great Party Central Committee and the heroic people who carve out the future in the great spirit of the era, the vigorous trend of the era of prosperity of our country will be accelerated day by day. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Farms of North Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 24 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Kumwi Farm in Hwadae County and the Hwanggok Farm in Myongchon County of North Hamgyong Province, the DPRK.
The beautiful landscape of the new villages showing a new era of rural development is a crystal of the will and love of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea which set it as an important policy task to turn all rural villages across the country into cultural ideal villages in the near future.
Attending the ceremonies of moving into new houses held on the spots were officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the counties, builders and agricultural workers.
Pak Myong Ho, chairman of the North Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, in his speech congratulated the agricultural workers who would move into the dwellings where modernity, cultural refinement and diversity are applied at a time when a new era of socialist rural construction is ushered in under the energetic leadership of the Party.
After receiving the licenses for the use of houses, working people at the Kumwi Farm and the Hwanggok Farm extended thanks to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor putting the agricultural workers on the peak of happiness and civilization.
As house-moving began, congratulatory performances and cheerful peasant dances were given and officials visited the owners of new houses to share joy with them. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Komdok Area of South Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 24 (KCNA) -- New modern houses have been built in Ryongchon-dong, Saemunhwa-dong, Ponsan-dong, Jonjin-dong No. 2 and Taehung-dong No. 1 of Tanchon City, South Hamgyong Province, the DPRK, this year, too.
Ceremonies for moving into new houses were held on the spots amid the joy and excitement of the miners and residents who would receive the new houses.
Congratulatory addresses were made at the ceremonies attended by officials of the province and the General Bureau of the Tanchon Area Mining Industry, officials concerned and working people who would move into new houses. Then licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by resolution-taking speeches.
As house-moving began, cheerful dancing parties were given and the happy laughter resounded at the new houses.
Officials visited the miners' families to hear their impressions of moving into new houses and encourage them to further increase the mineral production, cherishing the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which translates the people's dreams and ideals into reality. -0-

Korea April 26 Animation Studio
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 25 (KCNA) -- The Korea April 26 Animation Studio is contributing to the cultural and emotional life of the Korean people, youth and children.
The cartoons created by the studio with a high level of artistic representation and unique creative methods and techniques are favored by not only the children but also the people across the country, and show well the development of Korean cartoons.
One day in November 2014, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Korea April 26 Animation Studio and said that the cartoons created by the studio are a close companion of life and struggle, being favored by not only the children but also the people from all walks of life, and that the Korean cartoons are becoming increasingly popular worldwide.
He said that our cartoons are startling the world people for its originality, charm, high level of representation and rapid speed of creation, adding that our creators, who advanced into the world cartoon filmdom long ago, have showed their distinguished talents, thus fully demonstrating our cartoon production technique. And he stressed that we should turn our country into a world cartoon giant with full ambition.
In the past, officials, creators and artistes of the studio have built up the creative guidance force and the rank of creators and produced interesting cartoons of various themes and forms suited to the characteristics of objects and the sentiment and emotion of the people.
Produced in this course were popular cartoons including series of cartoons "The Boy General" and "The Clever Raccoon Dog", historical cartoons "Ko Ju Mong", "Prince Hodong and Princess Rangnang" the adults and children wait to watch.
The officials, creators and artistes of the studio are now devoting their wisdom and enthusiasm to creating more masterpieces favored by the people. -0-

headline: National Robot Contest among Schools Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 25 (KCNA) -- The national robot contest among schools in the field of general education-2025 took place at Pyongyang Teachers Training College in the DPRK from November 18 to 24.
The contest brought together children and students selected from across the country.
The contest was held, divided into the fields of kindergarten, primary school, junior middle school and senior middle school.
The participants conceived, manufactured and controlled various kinds of robots with the robot parts given to them according to the questions during a time limit, and announced their opinions on the points at issue they found in that course.
Pyongyang Municipality, Jagang Province, Nampho Municipality, Kangwon Province, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Chilgol Revolutionary School were highly appreciated at the contest.
Citations were awarded to excellent units and participants. -0-

headline: Modern Houses Built in Hochon and Rangnim Counties of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 25 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Township Farm in Hochon County, South Hamgyong Province, and the Insan Farm in Rangnim County, Jagang Province of the DPRK and the agricultural workers of the farms greeted the ceremonies of moving into new houses.
Modern dwellings built in the rural villages of the mountainous areas surrounded by high or low mountains like a folding screen tell of the great loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making ceaseless efforts to provide the agricultural workers with the happiest living conditions and environment in the world.
Ceremonies of moving into new houses took place on the spots. Congratulatory addresses were made at the ceremonies attended by Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, officials of the Party and power organs in the relevant areas, builders and agricultural workers who would move into the houses. Then, licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
Songs of happiness resounded in the fairyland-like villages and the owners of wonderful houses and others pleasantly danced to cheerful music.
Officials visited the families of the owners and shared joy with them. -0-

headline: Farm Implement Factory Remodeled in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 25 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Municipality in the DPRK has remodeled the farm implement factory.
The factory has been furnished with casting and sheet metal processing lines capable of producing various kinds of threshers, seeders and parts of farm machines. As a result, the material and technical foundations has been laid to put the comprehensive mechanization of the farms in the municipality on a higher stage. It also makes it possible to provide the workers with highly-civilized production conditions and living environment. -0-

headline: Photo Exhibition Attracting Many Visitors
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 26 (KCNA) -- A great number of officials and working people have visited the venue of the photo exhibition "The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area, a magnificent world created on the east coast in the great era ofKim Jong Un" since its opening on November 4.
At the exhibition venue, officials and working people of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Academy of Agricultural Sciences, the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and other units looked with deep emotion at the photos of the wonderfully changed Kalma peninsula and the modern coastal tourist city full of happiness and laughter of the people.
The photos of the respected ComradeKim Jong Ungiving instructions to build well the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area, a cultural recreation ground for the people, tells about the noble feats of the peerlessly great man who unfolded a grand blueprint for building a world-level cultural resort in Myongsasimni, a scenic spot on the East Sea, and led the work to flawlessly erect all the structures by staking the dignity of the state and the honor of our generation.
The photos of people enjoying sea bathing in the scenic spot on the East Sea, young people taking high-speed boats and motorcycles and working people enjoying amusement facilities in a water park make the visitors feel the joy and optimism of the people enjoying the new civilization and wellbeing to the full in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area. -0-

headline: Mausoleum of King Wang Kon
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) -- Kaesong was the capital city of Koryo (918-1392) and its political, economic, cultural and educational center for nearly 500 years.
Kaesong Municipality has many historical relics which show the wisdom and talents of the Korean people.
Among them are the Mausoleum of King Wang Kon, Mausoleum of King Kyonghyo, Kaesong Walls, Nam Gate of Kaesong, Sonjuk Bridge, Phyochung Monuments, Sungyang Confucian Shrine, Koryo Songgyungwan University, Manwoldae, the Kaesong Chomsongdae, etc. They were registered as world cultural heritages in June, 2013.
The Mausoleum of King Wang Kon located in Haeson-ri, Kaesong Municipality is the tomb of King Wang Kon (877-943), the founder of Koryo.
It was reconstructed magnificently in 1994 under the guidance of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
In front of its gate is the Monument to the Reconstruction of the Mausoleum of King Wang Kon, the founder of Koryo, inscribed with letters written by the President.
When visitors enter the gate, they can see the mausoleum of King Wang Kon, a typical earthen tomb with a stone chamber, on the highest stage at its rear after passing a temple and pavilion for a monument.
There are a coffin made of flagstones in the center of the chamber and stands for remains on the lower parts of its left and right walls and murals depicting pine, bamboo, etc. on the north, east and west walls.
The mound is eight meters high and four stone tigers stand on its corners. There are a stone table, a pair of stone posts and stone lantern in front of the mound.
Stone statues depicting the close associates of Wang Kon are standing on the second and third stages below the tomb.
There are an image of Wang Kon and murals on his life in the temple.
The mausoleum is preserved as a precious historic relic. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Construction Site of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Nearing Completion
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction site of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm nearing completion on Nov. 26.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Pak Jong Chon, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jae Ryong and Kim Yong Su, department directors of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Chol Sam, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK.
Kim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the units of the Korean People's Army and officials of the Paektusan Hero Youth Shock Brigade and designing and relevant institutions involved in the construction.
He went round such main buildings as dome-shaped glass hydroponic greenhouse and greenhouses on soil, trunk road in the area of the farm, embankment construction site, etc. to learn in detail about their progress.
Thanks to the devoted labor of the army units and the youth shock brigade members in the honorable day-and-night struggle for creation to greet the glorious Party Congress, the overall construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm is vigorously progressing at 97 percent. After the completion of the land leveling for the greening and the creation of a windbreak forest in the farm area, the land leveling of the areas around the natural parks and reservoir has been carried out at 97 percent and 87 percent respectively, the planting of turfs in the areas covering several hundred hectares at 95 percent and the pavement of trunk road in the farm area and roads in the greenhouse sections at 72 percent. And the farm is now making trial runs of the electric power, water supply and drainage systems for greenhouses, vegetable science research center, public buildings such as hostel, neighborhood-serving amenity, nursery and kindergarten and hundreds of dwellings.
According to the Party's decision, all the projects for the development of this area have progressed on the principle of optimization to ensure profitability, he said, adding that, in particular, the improvements of the vast surrounding area such as road construction and landscaping in permanent embankment section have been carried out at a high qualitative level to preserve the features of the region and it is really good. He noted with great satisfaction that the islet, once called a barren land, has turned into a golden islet with great potential for leading the regional development and the improvement of the material and cultural life of the local people.
Noting that we are witnessing the great changes in the region, which can never be neglected, he said that it is a pleasure to implement the grandiose plans and tasks for the comprehensive rejuvenation one by one and increase the wealth of creation but what our Party values more than it is that the young people are growing up to be the great cedars of patriotism in this course. He underscored that it is a pleasure and pride of our Party, state and people incomparable with fabulous wealth in the world that the new generations responsible for the future of this Korea have grown up to be the large unit of patriots who believe the motherland counts more than anything and feel the pride of doing revolution despite ordeals.
He put stress on some tasks for completing the project and clarified the ways for the preparation of the operation of the farm and its management. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- The U.S. reckless military moves that started at the very beginning of this year, gravely threatening the strategic stability in and around the Korean peninsula, are becoming more blatant even in the closing days of the year.
Recently the U.S. and the ROK staged an anti-special operation naval drill in the waters near Phyongthaek, Kyonggi Province under the pretext of countering someone's "infiltration" by mobilizing a guided missile destroyer, anti-submarine helicopters, sea-patrol planes and other naval and air forces.
And the U.S. has additionally deployed F-16 fighters to the Osan Air Base in Kyonggi Province, as part of the second-stage operational test of the "super-powerful wing", to intensify the joint operational capability.
The U.S. is running amuck in its moves to increase the operational capability of two "super-powerful wings" it formed after forward-deploying F-16 fighters from the Kunsan Air Base in the ROK and the Misawa Air Base in Japan to the Osan Air Base only 64km from Seoul. It is an irrefutable fact that it is aimed at deterring the DPRK and regional countries by force and securing air superiority in contingency.
The U.S.-ROK military drills and arms buildup targeting independent sovereign states in the region are not confined to the Korean peninsula.
According to the media, the U.S. and the ROK launched the combined anti-submarine warfare exercises "Silent Shark" involving submarines and sea-patrol planes in the waters near Guam on Nov. 18 and the U.S. marines set up the Forward Arming and Refueling Point on Yonagni Island, Japan, within hailing distance of the Taiwan Strait on Nov. 21.
Meanwhile, the U.S. often talked about "freedom of navigation" is going to stage the "Proliferation Security Initiative" drill in the sea of Japan from early December, together with its vassal forces including Japan and the ROK, aimed at violating the legitimate right of other countries to navigate and realizing the complete sea blockade.
The U.S. habitual and reckless military moves in disregard of the repeated concerns of the international community clearly indicate where the origin of the instability of the regional situation is and who is the performer of the "unilateral changes to status quo" advocated by it.
Through the military moves of the U.S. and the ROK, the regional countries are correctly diagnosing the essence of the "improved relations with regional countries" and "stability of situation" that they call for externally.
The stereotyped expression of "regular drill" can never cover up the aggressive nature of the provocative acts with extreme belligerence and offensive nature and the fact that the U.S. is just an evil factor fostering the possibility of armed conflict.
The U.S. is the chieftain threatening the peace and stability and destroying the strategic security balance. This fact has already been settled as an absolute value in the perception of the independent sovereign states in the region.
It is the consistent principle and immutable stand of the DPRK to be prepared for countering the confrontation-oriented moves of the enemy states and any development of the situation that may result from them.
We have already made it clear that all threats encroaching upon our sphere of security will become direct targets of the DPRK and be managed in a necessary way.
The DPRK will further devote itself to defending its national sovereignty and interests and protecting the regional peace and stability through the exercise of its essential rights as the U.S. continues to renew its record in the demonstration of its military strength threatening the regional countries. -0-

headline: New Research Successes Introduced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 28 (KCNA) -- According to the data available at the State Commission of Science and Technology, the certificate of the introduction of national scientific and technological success was awarded to more than 100 research findings that helped solve the urgent problems arising in economic practice this year, Rodong Sinmun says.
Scientists ofKim Il SungUniversity developed and introduced the technology of increasing the efficiency of a gas producer process and the boiler combustion air control system based on artificial intelligence and made a non-contact water supply pipe leaking detector to contribute to modernizing production lines and improving urban management.
Scientists at Kim Chaek University of Technology developed a profitable drawing technology, a system of simulated operation of a thermal power plant and a motor for a drilling machine, thus contributing to increasing the production of concrete sleepers, improving the technical power of thermal power plants and modernizing prospecting equipment.
Scientists at the State Academy of Sciences, too, developed the technology of desalinization of Lake Kangryong to ensure the sustainable growth of the agricultural production, established an advanced intelligent integrated production system in the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex and developed silicone sealing adhesive agent and rust-proof paint badly needed by the construction sector.
The Academy of Agricultural Sciences developed the technology of cultivating flood-tolerant crops and the technology of growing nutritive cold-bed rice-seedlings. And scientists at some other scientific research institutes demonstrated the sci-tech might in laying the foundations for the development of light industry, public health, fishing industry, poultry farming, etc.
The Taean Heavy Machine Complex manufactured and introduced an electrical drive wireless transport truck, a way of producing bearing steel with pig iron and a new welding rod, all of which are of great significance in modernizing its production lines and improving the quality of products. The Musan Mining Complex established a line for producing parts of a rotary drill to provide a guarantee for increasing its own technical power and the production of concentrated iron ore. -0-

headline: Foresighted Measure
story_text:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Masikryong Ski Resort under construction in August 2013.
While looking at the ski courses stretching down from the top of the Taehwa Peak, he asked an official about the state of the ski courses during the rainy season.
After hearing the official's reply that the ski courses were not affected by heavy rainfall during the rainy season, he said that our soldier-builders had built the ski courses in a qualitative way.
However, the fact is that a few months ago, he had foreseen the possible damage to the ski courses during the rainy season and given a special instruction to the officials to plant turfs on the ski courses.
He noted that it is needed to establish well a drainage system and plant turfs on the ski courses to prevent them from being washed away by rainwater. If the ski courses are planted with turfs, it would be good to protect the ski courses and look at them after the thaw, he said. And he explained in detail what species of turf should be planted and what kind of cement should be used.
The ski courses of the Masikryong Ski Resort tell still now of the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho foresees all possible circumstances and takes measures to build our structures into the monumental edifices which would be perfect even after long years. -0-
