topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Splendid Celebrations Held to Mark 80th Founding Anniversary of KPA Air Force
story_text:
Pyongyang, November 30 (KCNA) -- The Air Force of the Korean People's Army has defended the dignity and prestige of the great Workers' Party of Korea with absolute loyalty, heroic fighting spirit and matchless courage and firmly protected the inviolable sovereign airspace of the DPRK and the security of its people. It is celebrating its 80th founding anniversary in its history shining with victories and glory.
A celebration event took place with splendor at Kalma Airport of the 59th Kil Yong Jo Hero Flying Group of the Second Air Wing on Nov. 28 to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the KPA Air Force.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the celebration event to congratulate and encourage all the officers and men of the heroic people's Air Force.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by his dear daughter.
Kim Jong Unfirst visited the bust of Hero Kil Yong Jo.
Recollecting with deep emotion the worthwhile life of the hero pilot who left the indelible traces of loyalty over the sky with the steadfast spirit of defending the country and the revolution, he laid a flower before the bust of the martyr and paid tribute to him.
The air force base on the east coast, the venue for the celebration event, was seething with boundless excitement and joy of the service personnel of the Air Force who would significantly celebrate the historic day, the origin of the building of the Juche-oriented air forces, in the presence ofKim Jong Unwhom they have always longed for.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the airport amid the playing of welcome music, all the service personnel of the Air Force broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the invincible and iron-willed commander, the great father who has ushered in a great heyday of the development of the DPRK's armed forces with his outstanding army-building idea and extraordinary military wisdom and bestowed the greatest honor to be shined in the militant course of the people's Air Force forever.
The KPA Air Force courteously greeted the Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK with the highest respect.
He met Air Chief Marshal Kim Kwang Hyok, commander of the KPA Air Force, and Air Marshal Om Ju Ho, political commissar of the KPA Air Force, and extended warm congratulations to all the service personnel of the Air Force.
The DPRK national anthem was solemnly played.
The head of the guard of honour of the KPA Air Force made a salute.
Kim Jong Unpaid militant salute to the colours of the KPA Air Force and its subordinate units shining with legendary military feats and reviewed the guard of honour of the KPA Air Force.
Commanding officers of the combined air units at all levels of the Air Force, pilots, commanding officers of arms and missile soldiers raised stormy cheers of hurrah, looking up to the Supreme Commander.
Kim Jong Unwarmly congratulated them on the auspicious holiday of the people's Air Force and warmly waved back to them.
Leading officials of the Party and the military attended the ceremony of welcomingKim Jong Un.
ThenKim Jong Unwent up to the observation platform and watched the demonstration flight of the Air Force marking the Day of Air Men.
Planes of heroic pilots of the DPRK took off one after another with deafening sound to significantly celebrate the holiday.
He warmly encouraged the proud girl pilots An Ok Gyong and Son Ju Hyang, watching their demonstration flight in two-plane formation.
Pilots of the Air Force, who were making demonstration flight in the presence ofKim Jong Unon the significant founding anniversary, displayed their skillful flying technique to the full, giving off beautiful tricolour vapour trails and setting off fireworks in the clear and blue sky of the country.
Kim Jong Unencouraged and gave warm salute to the pilots each time whenever they displayed different combat aviation with flexible control.
The pilots flied at low altitude over the observation platform to express their absolute loyalty to and the most ardent trust inKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unmet the pilots after the demonstration flight and shook hands with every one of them, praising them for demonstrating high level of aviation capable of perfectly carrying out any combat mission.
Highly appreciating the aviation displayed by the girl pilots,Kim Jong Unsaid that they are proud comrades representing the women of the country and hoped that they would remain faithful to their duties with the honour of the Air Force and the dignity of the women of this country.
The confrontation in the sky, which must be settled only by victors and losers, life and death, is a confrontation of ideology and faith before being a confrontation of arms and equipment and the victory in the battle is decided not by the ultra-modern fighters but by pilots armed with indomitable spirit, he said, adding that it is the great strength and pride of our Party, state and people to have an elite Air Force with the overwhelming political and ideological might incomparable with any army of other countries. And he had a photo taken with the pilots.
Then he had a significant photo session with the service personnel of the KPA Air Force on the occasion of its 80th founding anniversary.
Every honorable flight path of the people's Air Force which has made the long journey of sacred defence in the last 80 years since it was founded as the flying corps of new Korea under the leadership of the Party was a world-startling legend, he said, adding that the myths of the invincible Air Force recorded in the high and clear sky are brilliantly shining in the history of the country as a symbol of high ideological and mental power, indomitable fighting spirit and heroism of our army.
He affirmed that the blue sky of the country would always be peaceful and the mightiness of the Air Force would be immortal as we have reliable service personnel of the Air Force who are performing feats during their flights of loyalty, dedicating their lives without hesitation both in the grim moments or peaceful days.
At the end of the photo session, the sky of November reverberated with thunderous shouts from the service personnel of the Air Force chanting the slogan of death-defying defence to demonstrate their immutable pledge to devote their youth and lives forKim Jong Un, the sun of eternal life and the sky of destiny, and for the future of the beloved motherland.
A commemorative meeting was held with splendor to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the KPA Air Force in the presence ofKim Jong Un.
Present there were Jo Yong Won, Pak Jong Chon and Jo Chun Ryong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence, commanding officers, pilots and service personnel of the KPA Air Force and its discharged veterans.
Kim Jong Unmet the discharged generals who were specially invited to the celebrations of the Day of Air Men and highly appreciated the devoted life and feats of the veteran generals of the Air Force who devoted their whole life to strengthening the defence capability of the country's airspace.
Air Chief Marshal Kim Kwang Hyok, commander of the KPA Air Force, made a commemorative report.
The reporter referred to the pride of the 80-year-long history of the air forces which have grown along with the sacred history of the Party as the first service founded under the care of the great WPK and waged a honorable struggle for the country, the revolution and the people, and to the militant course of the Air force which has developed into a core service of the People's Army under the leadership of the Party.
In the great era ofKim Jong Un, our Air Force is enjoying the greatest heyday of invincibleness and development as an ever-victorious heroic service, he said, adding that thanks to the great ambition and energetic leadership of the respected Supreme Commander who puts forward the strengthening of the Air Force as a crucial requirement for building a powerful army, a new era of developing the Air Force into the elite forces is being ushered in and the politico-ideological might of the Air Force and its full combat capability are being fully demonstrated.
He stressed that it is the greatest happiness of the service personnel of the Air Force to hold in high esteem the great brilliant commander, the great father who instills in them an unshakable revolutionary faith and strong will to defend the country unto death in any adversity, a courage and pluck to pierce through the clouds in countless layers and endless shower of bullets without hesitation and wisdom and bravery for sure victory and meticulously leads them.
Saying that the most powerful group of revolutionary soldiers demonstrating their might as the strong army for devotedly defending the Party Central Committee, the elite armed forces-this is a valuable appellation the country and the people gave to the Air Force which has always flown along the route of loyalty for 80 years and a great honor to be preserved forever by all the officers and men of the Air Force, the reporter ardently called upon all of them to more courageously fight for the eternal prosperity of the country and the security of the people, the immortal prestige and glory of the KPA Air Force, true to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the KPA Air Force.
Saying that he is pleased to attend the celebrations to recollect the proud history of the Air Force and pay tribute to its great 80-year-long journey, he extended warm congratulations to the valiant pilots significantly greeting the founding anniversary of the Air Force of the DPRK and all the service personnel of the Air Force who are now struggling for the defense of the airspace and the wellbeing of the people.
He said that he is proud of the founding year of the Air Force which coincides with the one of the Workers' Party of Korea as the numbers etched on the colours of the Air Force tell, and its reputation as the first-born service of the People's Army and moreover, he can not but feel reverence for its honorable militant flights for 80-long years. He noted that no rhetoric can represent the long and glorious history in which the Air Force has covered its course since it was founded and all its noble and heroic undertakings.
The Air Force should be counted first when we talk about a witness to the victories of the sacred defence struggle in the two centuries, he said, adding that among the three services of the KPA it has experienced more actual battles than other services in peacetime, not in wartime, and produced more than 130 heroes, including two double heroes, and dozens of hero units and sub-units since the first pilot hero of the KPA emerged. This clearly shows that the Air Force has always stood at the forefront of the struggle to protect the sovereignty and national interests, and that its distinguished military feats are holding the most brilliant place in the course of the development of the KPA, he said.
He expressed his deep affection for the Air Force which has stood by him at the crucial moments that decided the destiny and future of the state and the people and guaranteed reliable security through the absolute execution without any mistake. He noted that the mission of all the services and arms of the KPA to defend the sovereignty was heavy and they received orders with the same voice, but any military group was no match for the Air Force in terms of the unconditional and perfect implementation of the orders. And the appellation of the first-born service, the eldest service of the KPA is the proud honour it gained as it was founded first in the history of building the regular armed forces of the country and the service personnel of the Air Force performed distinguished feats by always carrying out on time without fail the duty which is more important than the ones of the other services and the arms, he noted.
Once ordered, our pilots never thought of their lives and their dogfight skills and the legendary tales about their air battles were the fruits of the bravery and heroism of the invincible pilots, he said. Even in the face of serious military threats and the irresistible natural disasters, they successfully carried out the orders without thinking of their only lives, and thus performed the unprecedented miracles and feats, he noted, adding this is the immortal characteristic peculiar to the Air Force.
Saying that the operating area of the Air Force includes the inviolable airspace, land and waters and places of great changes, he noted that the appellation of the Air Force will as ever shine in the vanguard of leading the whole army in the worthwhile struggle calling for the feats of the revolutionary army.
Noting that the Air Force will be given new strategic military assets and entrusted with a new important duty, he said that the expectations of the Party and the country for the Air Force which will play a role in the exercise of the nuclear war deterrent are very great, and that the Air Force should resolutely repulse and control all sorts of espionage acts and possible military provocations of the enemies to encroach upon the sovereign airspace of the DPRK with the overwhelming spiritual strength and offensive spirit.
Saying that he firmly believes that the sky of the country will be blue and the country will be in peace forever thanks to the pilots and he extends thanks to them for displaying the service spirit of always remaining faithful to the country, he wished the heroic Air Force military feats and the pilots good health.
Announcing that the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK adopted a decree on awarding the honourable Order ofKim Jong Ilto the Air Force marking its 80th founding anniversary at the proposal of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK, he said that he would convey a joint congratulatory message of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
All the participants raised enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the respected Supreme Commander who has repeatedly shown deep love and trust in the Air Force, glorifying its 80-year-long history at the zenith of the most worthy dignity and honour.
He conveyed the joint congratulatory message of the Central Committee and the Central Military Commission of the WPK to the KPA Air Force marking its 80th founding anniversary and conferred Order ofKim Jong Il, the highest order of the DPRK, on it.
He awarded the certificate of order to the commander of the Air Force and fixed Order ofKim Jong Ilon the colours of the KPA Air Force.
All the participants witnessed with deep emotion and joy the historic moment to be specially recorded in the history of the development of the Juche-oriented air forces.
Warmly congratulating the enthusiastically cheering service personnel of the Air Force,Kim Jong Unexpressed belief that all the pilots, commanding officers and service personnel of the brave air forces would glorify the 80-year-long proud history inscribed in the glorious colours with myths of continuous victory and firmly defend the dignity of the DPRK and happiness of its people.
Then an art performance was given at the Myongsasimni Theatre to mark the 80th anniversary of the founding of the KPA Air Force.
Kim Jong Unenjoyed the performance together with officers and men of the Air Force.
Put on the stage were numbers praising the feats performed by the heroic people's Air Force which has demonstrated its honour as the ranks of elite soldiers firmly armed with the ideas and will of the WPK, the ranks of strong soldiers that always win victory in every battle and the ranks of point-men who make a breakthrough in socialist construction.
The audience were deeply moved by the stirring songs of the revolutionary army expressing the firm will of the service personnel of the Air Force who would set the eternal coordinates of their life on the flight path of defending the Party Central Committee unto death and glorify the immortal appellation of the greatKim Jong Un's Air Force and its ever-victorious history forever.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it impressively represented through excellent artistic depiction the high ideological and spiritual world of the service personnel of the KPA Air Force and their devoted service for the country and the people.
That evening the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK hosted a banquet to mark the 80th anniversary of the founding of the KPA Air Force.
Present there on invitation were military and political commanding officers at all levels of the KPA Air Force, pilots, service personnel and discharged generals.
Kim Jong Unattended the banquet together with leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.
The venue of the banquet was wrapped in warm feelings of blood ties between the leader and the soldiers forged in the militant journey for defending the sacred sovereignty of our state and strengthening the capability for defending the airspace.
The commanding officers and pilots of the Air Force expressed thanks toKim Jong Unwho bestows all kinds of loving care and privileges on the service personnel of the Air Force, spending the whole day together with them. They vowed to become the most brilliant star for defending the country and the revolution, fully demonstrating the might of the lifeguards of the Party Central Committee and the DPRK.
The celebrations of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the KPA Air Force held with splendor in the presence ofKim Jong Unmarked a significant occasion in demonstrating the unshakable faith and will of the heroic people's Air Force to steadily carry forward the glorious tradition of loyalty and feats and firmly guarantee the history of the great succession of the Juche revolution forever as befitting the first-born service of our revolutionary armed forces. -0-

headline: Walled City of Kaesong, World Heritage in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
Walled City of Kaesong, World Heritage in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- The Walled City of Kaesong was a capital in the Koryo period (918-1392) and it encircles Kaesong Municipality of today.
The wall is 23 km round, of which the stone wall is 5.5km long and the earthen one 17.5km long.
The walled city consists of the imperial castle, royal castle and outer and inner walls.
The imperial castle, together with the royal castle, was built at the foot of Mt Songak in the early days of Koryo.
The 16 km-long outer wall was built from 1009 to 1029 to cope with the invasion by foreign aggressors.
The inner wall 8.5 km long was erected from 1391 to 1393. The remains of the walls tell of the time-honored history of Kaesong. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory message to the General Council of the United Russia Party on December 1.
The message said:
The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea extends warm congratulations and comradely greetings to the leadership and all the members of the United Russia Party on the occasion of its 24th founding anniversary.
This year the exchange and contacts between the high-level delegations of the WPK and the URP laid solid foundations for deepening the political cooperation between the two parties and the two countries and created a favorable environment for the development of the bilateral relations and we are pleased with this.
Expressing belief that the relations between the two parties would continue to develop in depth in the future in conformity with the DPRK-Russia alliance which has entered definitely a new heyday of its development, we wish the URP greater success in its responsible activities for building powerful Russia and defending the state sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren's Footwear and School Uniform Factories Inaugurated in DPRK
Walled City of Kaesong, World Heritage in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- The Walled City of Kaesong was a capital in the Koryo period (918-1392) and it encircles Kaesong Municipality of today.
The wall is 23 km round, of which the stone wall is 5.5km long and the earthen one 17.5km long.
The walled city consists of the imperial castle, royal castle and outer and inner walls.
The imperial castle, together with the royal castle, was built at the foot of Mt Songak in the early days of Koryo.
The 16 km-long outer wall was built from 1009 to 1029 to cope with the invasion by foreign aggressors.
The inner wall 8.5 km long was erected from 1391 to 1393. The remains of the walls tell of the time-honored history of Kaesong. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors of National Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
At the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex the premier stressed the need to conduct the check-up and repair of generating equipment in a far-sighted way so as to normalize the production of electricity in winter and to push ahead with the work to reinforce and perfect the heat insulation and de-dusting systems of boilers and steam conduits in cooperation with scientific research units.
At the Namdok Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex the premier met and encouraged coal miners who are bringing about good results every day through the patriotic movement for increased coal production, and he underlined the need to give precedence to prospecting and tunneling and, at the same time, to continue increasing the coal production by raising the operating rate of face equipment.
Acquainting himself with the operation of the Sunchon Phosphatic Fertilizer Factory and the progress made in the construction project for establishing the C-1 chemical industry, he stressed the need to rationally compose the processes and the systems with the main emphasis on lowering the energy consumption to the maximum, and take economic and technical measures to fully display the production capacity of the existing fertilizer and chemical factories.
He underscored the need for the Pyongyang Mining Machinery Factory to put spurs to the production of custom-built equipment and consolidate its scientific and technological forces and production foundation so as to raise the production capacity and processing accuracy and improve the quality of products.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of producing a large number of efficient coal mining equipment, the issue for relevant fields, including the metal and machine-building industries, and units to supply in good time the enough equipment and materials needed for increasing the production of electricity and coal and the issue of paying deep attention to employees' living conditions.
Earlier, the premier went round the Advanced Science and Technology and Products Exhibition-2025. -0-

headline: At Construction Site of Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- One day in October 2019, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uninspected the construction site of the then Samjiyon County.
He dropped in at a hospital under construction.
Looking at the hospital’s front yard, he said that the green section does not match with its surrounding environment well as only short trees were planted there. He stressed the need to plant tall trees even though it requires much labor.
He told officials that it is unnecessary to widen the pavement section as patients do not come to hospital by bus at once and therefore, it is necessary to create a globular or oval green section and plant turfs and white birches there.
He added that the hospital would look better if benches for patients are installed in the yard.
Receiving his instructions, officials felt remorse for copying a big hospital without reason, far from building the hospital in line with the characteristics of a mountainous city.
The time whenKim Jong Ungave the instructions on the green section of the hospital that day was not long, but it was the precious time that made officials keenly realize that even if they create a mere building, they should do it in conformity with the characteristics and specific conditions of their regions. -0-

headline: Youth and Students in DPRK Start Expedition of Mt Paektu Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 2 (KCNA) -- Young vanguard from across the DPRK began their expedition of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, flying the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League (SPYL).
A kick-off meeting took place at the plaza before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province on December 1.
Present there were Kang Sin Chang, secretary of the Ryanggang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and members of the expedition.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them.
Pak Myong Jin, vice-chairman of the SPYL Central Committee, made a report at the meeting to be followed by speeches.
The reporter and speakers referred to the fact that the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unled a horseback march to leave immortal traces in the sacred Mt Paektu area, fiercely kindled the flames of arming all the people across the country with the revolutionary spirit, and called the youth and students to the battle sites of Mt Paektu.
They called upon all the members of the expedition to fully demonstrate the might of patriotic youth in the on-going general advance for ushering in a period of the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism, remaining loyal to the ideology and leadership ofKim Jong Unby firmly carrying forward the tradition of loyalty and the baton of patriotism handed over by the pioneering generations of the revolution.
At the end of the meeting, the members of the expedition left for the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site. -0-

story_text:

headline: New Houses Built at Farms in North Phyongan and Jagang Provinces of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 3 (KCNA) -- Modern dwelling houses have been built at the Tongchon Farm in Cholsan County of North Phyongan Province and the Jonchang Farm in Songwon County of Jagang Province under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Congratulatory speeches were made at the meetings attended by Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, officials of the Party and power organs of the relevant regions, builders and agricultural workers who would move into new houses.
Speakers said that the new dwelling houses, which have risen up demonstrating the vibrant changes in the socialist countryside, show visually the validity and vitality of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era set forth by the Party.
After receiving the licenses for the use of houses, the speakers extended gratitude to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor providing the agricultural workers with an affluent and civilized life.
As art performances to celebrate the house-moving and joyful dancing parties were given, the villages were in a festive mood.
Officials visited the families of farmers who moved into the new houses to share joy with them.
Songs of happiness and laughter were heard from every house and fireworks were set off. -0-

headline: Large-scale Greenhouse Vegetable Production Base in North Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 3 (KCNA) -- The Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm, a large-scale greenhouse vegetable production base of the DPRK, mass-produces vegetables, contributing to improving the people's diet.
The farm is associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is working heart and soul to provide the people with an affluent and happy life.
Kim Jong Unpersonally chose the site of the farm, dispatched construction forces and energetically guided the whole course of the construction ranging from building work to supply of materials.
At the inauguration ceremony of the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm and the tree nursery on December 3, 2019, he said that quantitative indices are important in vegetable production but what's more important is nutritional indices and taste, adding that the farm should actively introduce advanced science and technology and achieve optimum results in the future.
True to his noble intention, the farm has increased production by depending on science and technology and strengthening its own technical forces.
The farm has transformed the former integrated production system into the intelligent one and introduced a cylindrical vegetable cultivation device to double productivity.
It has also increased the production of fruit vegetables such as cucumber and tomato and leaf vegetables like cabbage through the proper selection of varieties and distribution of crops, and directed efforts to producing functional vegetables.
This year, too, the farm studied and introduced dozens of varieties of functional vegetables including legume and balsam pear, increased the areas under cultivation and produced various varieties of functional vegetables to send them to the children of the Chongjin Baby Home, Chongjin Orphanage and Chongjin Middle School for Orphans and residents in the province. -0-

headline: National Economic Plans for November Fulfilled in Various Sectors and Units of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 3 (KCNA) -- National economic plans for November were fulfilled in various sectors and units of the DPRK.
Officials and workers in the sector of metallurgical industry made innovations in production in the creation spirit of self-sufficiency.
The Musan Mining Complex successfully ensured blasting of different scales including the blasting of one million cubic meter earth and waged a drive for increased production, thus increasing the earth-scrapping and the production of iron ore compared with the same period last year.
The chemical industrial sector has pushed ahead with the production of fertilizer and basic chemical products.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex produced more fertilizer every day than planned by lowering the standard of consumption of raw materials per unit, improving the quality of crushing raw materials and ensuring the full operation of oxygen separators and other equipment.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex fulfilled its monthly plan by introducing a rational method of operation suited to the characteristics of equipment and improving the indices according to the characteristics of catalyst.
The Ministry of Electric Power Industry successfully carried out its November plan.
The workers of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex increased the output of electricity while concentrating on laying material and technical foundations for the long-term development.
The coal miners over-fulfilled the monthly plan for the Ministry of Coal Industry by launching the socialist patriotic movement for increased coal production.
Officials and workers in the machine-building industrial sector made successes in the production of custom-built equipment.
Those in the mining industrial sector pushed ahead with the production of minerals and nonferrous metals with bold courage and vigour.
The Ministry of Forestry carried out its monthly plan at 120 percent.
The Paekam Mine Timber Production Station under the Ryanggang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau, the Hochon Mine Timber Production Station, the Komdok Mine Timber Production Station and the Jangjin Forestry Station under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau have fulfilled their daily assignments by strengthening their workteam cooperation to increase the amount of logging per unit time and introducing efficient working methods.
Officials and workers in the railway transport sector waged an increased transport drive to over-fulfill the freight transport plan in November for the Ministry of Railways.
The building-materials industrial sector revitalized production, injecting vitality and vigor into the socialist grand construction.
Workers in the light industrial sector made successes in the production of famous products and commodities favored by the people.
The Ministry of Fisheries fulfilled its monthly plan.
The North Phyongan Provincial Fishery Management Bureau, the South Phyongan Provincial Fishery Management Bureau, the South Hwanghae Provincial Fishery Management Bureau and the Nampho Fishery Station conducted rapid mobile operations on the basis of analysis of the main fishing grounds and adjusted the water layer in a scientific way to catch large quantities of fish. -0-

headline: Persons with Disabilities Enjoy Happy Life under Socialist System
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 3 (KCNA) -- December 3 is International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
Thanks to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK on protecting the disabled, the people with disabilities are ensured with all rights without any discrimination as full-fledged members of the state and society.
The Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Persons with Disabilities was amended and supplemented in November 2013 and the Law of the DPRK on Ensuring the Rights of the Disabled was adopted in September 2023, providing a legal guarantee for further improving the protection of persons with disabilities amid the concern of the whole society.
Children with disabilities enjoy the benefits of the socialist educational system at schools for persons with hearing and eyesight disorder, and students at Vocational Technology College for Disabled Persons acquire working knowledge useful in social life according to their interest and wishes.
The Korean Art Association of the Disabled and the Korea Sports Association of the Disabled are conducting positive activities with state support, and the Korean Rehabilitation Centre for Children with Disability and the Munsu Rehabilitation Clinic and other facilities for protecting the disabled have been built and their functions improved.
Every year on the occasion of the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, successes and experience gained in the protection of the people with disabilities are reviewed, issues of further promoting the work are discussed and sports games and art performances of persons with disabilities and other activities are organized.
Amid the ever-growing social trait of protecting, helping and leading the disabled people across the country, many beautiful stories about good deeds for the disabled have been produced. Among them are the ones about helping a child born with congenital lalopathy in all sincerity or treating a boy who was unable to walk to go on his own feet.
Under the advantageous socialist system of the DPRK, the disabled are leading a happy life, singing the song "We Are the Happiest in the World". -0-

headline: Large-scale Greenhouse Vegetable Production Base in North Hamgyong Province
story_text:

headline: Vietnamese Embassy Here Hosts Photo Exhibition and Reception
Korean Dressing Custom
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 4 (KCNA) -- The Korean dressing custom reflecting the noble and beautiful emotions, feelings and life of the Korean people is a part of the excellent mental and material heritage created by the ancestors.
While taking into account the natural and climatic conditions of the country and their way of life, emotions, hobbies, etc., the Korean people have developed their dressing custom since ancient times. It includes the dressing practices and the traditional skills and ways of making men's, women's and children's traditional clothes and footwear.
The traditional Korean costumes consist of lower and upper garments. Very typical of them are Jogori (men's and women's upper clothes), Paji (men's lower garment) and chima (women's lower garment). Among the traditional Korean clothes are turumagi (men's traditional Korean overcoat) and Paeja (women's traditional Korean waistcoat) for the relevant season. The main materials for those clothes were ramie cloth, silk and other natural fibers.
This custom is developing steadily in conformity with the socialist way of life.
In the DPRK, it is the custom for parents to make their young children wear traditional Korean clothes on their first birthdays and pray for their happy future. And the bride and bridegroom exchange their plain cloth for the traditional Korean bridal costume out of the mutual respect and the desire for love and happiness and get married in the clothing. It is a moral principle for children to present their parents with the traditional Korean clothes on their birthdays to express their respect for them and wish them good health.
On holidays and days when they move into new houses, the Korean people dress in elegant and beautiful traditional Korean clothes and dance to share their joy with each other, enriching the emotions of life.
The 19th meeting of the intergovernmental committee for the protection of intangible cultural heritages of the UNESCO, held in December 2024, adopted a decision on registering the Korean dressing custom, a part of our excellent cultural heritage, as a typical part of the intangible cultural heritage of mankind.
The said costume, which represents characteristic features of our unique and traditional costume culture, has enriched the diversity of the world human culture and given our people the greatest pride and self-confidence. -0-

headline: Ladder at Steep Water Slide for People
story_text:

The officials were moved by the tenderhearted benevolence ofKim Jong Unwho visited the water park, though he was busy, and took a measure so that the people do not feel even a slight inconvenience.

headline: Valuable Cultural Heritage of Korean Nation-Ssirum
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- Among the valuable cultural heritages of the Korean nation is Ssirum (Korean wrestling), a sports event.
Ssirum is a sports game in which two men grasp each other's thigh band (cloth belt made by joining waistband and leg belt together) and use their hands, legs and trunks to knock down their opponents.
Ssirum can be played without being affected by time, place and age.
Since ancient times, Korean people have played Ssirum games during break time to develop their physical abilities and, especially on folk holidays, they organized large-scale Ssirum games.
A bull had been awarded to the player who won the first place in the game.
Using thigh bands and awarding a bull are the features peculiar to Ssirum of the Korean nation.
Ssirum is a whole body exercise good for health, which not only fosters patience, fighting spirit, strength and wisdom but also helps achieve mutual trust, cooperation and close ties among people and collective unity.
Ssirum of the Korean nation was registered as a world intangible cultural heritage at the 13th meeting of the intergovernmental committee for the protection of intangible cultural heritages of the UNESCO, held in November 2018. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Regional-industry Factories Nearing Inauguration
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- This year has witnessed the proud and epochal achievements in the regional construction, which made another leap forward in ensuring modernity, economic profitability and prospect with a goal of reaching a level set higher than last year, according to the far-reaching regional development strategy of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected regional-industry factories in several counties nearing inauguration on December 3.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Pak Jong Chon, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee.
First, he went round the regional-industry factories in Sinyang County, South Phyongan Province.
He was greeted on the spots by the commanding officers of the army units involved in the construction, officials of design institutes, senior officials of the Party and power organs in Sinyang County and officials of the regional-industry factories.
He went round the production, cultural and welfare facilities of the foodstuff factory, garment factory and daily necessities factory in the county one by one to learn in detail about their construction and preparations for operation.
Saying that he could see the level of construction and technical equipment of the construction units has remarkably improved as compared with last year, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that lopsidedness has been definitely decreased and the level of balance and specialization increased in the whole construction process.
Noting that the evaluation of the quality of construction depends on the final construction, he indicated the orientation and ways for the construction units at all levels to radically raise the level of specialization and delicacy in the final construction.
He said that there might be difficulties as healthcare facilities, leisure complexes and others are expected to be added to regional construction projects from the coming year but the People's Army has tremendous potentiality for creditably guaranteeing the implementation of the Party's policy on regional development and will powerfully lead the regional construction revolution to a steady victory with its rich experience and heated enthusiasm for struggle.
Saying that modern regional-industry factories have been built in 40 cities and counties in less than two years since the regional-industry revolution started, he noted this represents the eye-opening regional changes. The rural construction and regional-industry construction are a gigantic revolution intended to fundamentally improve the quality of the people's living and lay the material and technical foundations for the independent development of the cities and counties, he said, underlining that we are right now passing through the most responsible and important historic period of transition.
He pointed out some deviations revealed in the construction of regional-industry factories and set forth some important tasks for operating the factories, normalizing their production and accommodating the inhabitants.
He inspected regional-industry factories in Pukchang County, South Phyongan Province.
Referring to the inconsistency in architectural and process designs in the construction of a foodstuff factory, he said that the irrational changes were made in contrast to the original design leading to the re-construction, which was attributable to the lack of proper guidance system and functional system to rectify such deviations in time.
In order to ensure high quality in construction as required by the drive for modernization and standardization and perfectly build factories as entities immediately demonstrating our style of civilization and development, it is necessary to establish a more thorough system of tripartite consultation between design, construction and management units, put construction on a scientific and integrated basis and steadily increase the proportion of dry construction in the building of industrial facilities and encourage it, he said.
Noting that the regular production and supply of various consumer goods basic and essential for the people's livelihood is the most important task in carrying out the Party's policy on regional industry, he put particular emphasis on the need to increase the number of varieties of specialties preserving the characters of regional areas and improve the quality of daily necessities.
He said that it is important for the whole Party and the state to pay attention to the development of regional economy, organize regional products shows every year and conduct significant reviews and appraisals of them so that regional-industry factories develop through competition.
Saying that the People's Army was assigned the historic task of regional changes and this is an expression of the noblest trust of the Party, the revolution, the era and the people in it, he expressed expectation and belief that the officers and men of the construction units would continue to give full play to the fighting spirit and creative mettle peculiar to the revolutionary army in the vanguard of the cause of realizing the long-cherished desire of the WPK and the wishes of the regional people.
He visited the Unsan Paper Factory newly built in Unsan County, South Phyongan Province.
He was greeted by Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials concerned and officials of the factory.
Saying that the paper factory has been built first in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province on a trial basis according to the Party's decision on setting up the modern paper factory in all provinces capable of satisfying their own demands, he stressed that the factory is of great significance in developing the Korean-style paper-making industry and satisfying the long-term nation-wide demands.
Looking at the multipurpose paper machine, the toilet-paper machine, the one for moulding paper into paper containers and others, all of which are associated with the pioneering spirit and creation enthusiasm of the scientists, technicians and workers, he said that it is really laudable that several enterprises of South Phyongan Province and the Paper Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences are taking the lead in solving one of the problems which greatly concern the Party. He noted that he is pleased that the said institute has a clear prospective goal for developing our own paper-making method and technology. He extended praise and encouragement to the scientists and technicians at the institute.
In order to meet the demand for paper badly needed for all the fields, including science, technology, education and cultural life, it is necessary to steadily develop our own paper-making method and technology based on the raw materials in the country, he said, adding that all other provinces should more thoroughly discuss and decide on the issue of building modern paper factories within the period of next five-year plan on the basis of the experience gained by South Phyongan Province in building a model factory.
The inauguration season has come to review the results of the proud one-year creation and labour campaign which will be estimated by the people, he noted, stressing that all the new regional-industry factories should make perfect preparations for their operation before their inauguration ceremonies which are due to be held in December. And he gave some instructions to promote the regional development policy. -0-

headline: Valuable Cultural Heritage of Korean Nation-Ssirum
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- Among the valuable cultural heritages of the Korean nation is Ssirum (Korean wrestling), a sports event.
Ssirum is a sports game in which two men grasp each other's thigh band (cloth belt made by joining waistband and leg belt together) and use their hands, legs and trunks to knock down their opponents.
Ssirum can be played without being affected by time, place and age.
Since ancient times, Korean people have played Ssirum games during break time to develop their physical abilities and, especially on folk holidays, they organized large-scale Ssirum games.
A bull had been awarded to the player who won the first place in the game.
Using thigh bands and awarding a bull are the features peculiar to Ssirum of the Korean nation.
Ssirum is a whole body exercise good for health, which not only fosters patience, fighting spirit, strength and wisdom but also helps achieve mutual trust, cooperation and close ties among people and collective unity.
Ssirum of the Korean nation was registered as a world intangible cultural heritage at the 13th meeting of the intergovernmental committee for the protection of intangible cultural heritages of the UNESCO, held in November 2018. -0-

headline: Korean Dressing Custom
December Seasonal Divisions and Folk Customs of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, in December, there are two seasonal divisions called Taesol (the heavy snowfall) and Tongji (the winter solstice).
Taesol is the day when it snows heavily, and Tongji is the day when the winter has come.
Unlike Haji (the summer solstice), Tongji is the day in the year when there are the longest hours of night.
This year Taesol falls on December 7 and Tongji on December 22.
Our ancestors said that if there is a heavy snowfall on Taesol, a good harvest will be reaped next year.
In the past, if Tongji fell on one of the first ten days of the eleventh lunar month, people called it Baby Tongji, and if the day fell on one of the rest of the month, they called it Old Tongji. And they said that if Baby Tongji comes, they will have a severe winter, but if Old Tongji comes, they will have a mild winter.
In December, the Korean people made or repaired farm implements, or collected manure for next year's farming.
The dishes enjoyed by the Korean people on the said days were rice and red-bean porridge and Raengmyon (a cold noodle dish), etc. The said porridge, a dish for Tongji, was the most famous of the dishes for the days.
According to a historical record, people ate rice and red-bean porridge on the day of Tongji, calling it "small New Year's Day". They kneaded with hot water glutinous Indian millet flour or glutinous rice flour to make flour balls and put them into the said porridge.
In the DPRK, it is the traditional custom for people to prepare the porridge and eat it with the neighbors on the day of Tongji so as to promote the concord.
In December, the children played a shuttlecock game as a folk game. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on November 28.
The reply message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I express my heartfelt thanks to you, Comrade, for sending me a beautiful flower basket on my birthday.
That you, Comrade, sent me the flower basket is not only an expression of your interest in and fraternity with me but also a demonstration of the good relations of friendship and cooperation between the two parties, two states and two peoples of Laos and the DPRK with a long tradition.
I am very pleased that the bilateral talks between us were successfully held in Pyongyang early in October 2025 and all the important issues discussed at the talks are being positively implemented and highly appreciate it.
I will further expand and develop the friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples of Laos and the DPRK with a long tradition through cooperation with you, Comrade, and between the leading officials of the parties and states of the two countries, thereby bringing substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contributing to peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the rest of the world.
I wish you, Comrade, and your family members good health and happiness and success in your noble work.
Please accept my high regards. -0-

headline: KCNA Report on Rapid Development of Agriculture
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency released a report on Friday, detailing the successes in consolidating the material and technical foundations of agriculture and rapidly increasing the grain production after the declaration of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
All the officials, Party members and other working people, who turned out in the grand campaign for creation true to the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, made remarkable progress in irrigation construction, including the completion of paddy field irrigation projects covering more than 500 000 hectares which was planned by the Workers' Party of Korea, successfully attained the annual goal according to the plan for the development of farm machines and turned over 13 500 hectares of dry fields into paddy fields, the report said, and went on:
The Party's policy on pushing ahead with rice and wheat farming by boldly changing the structure of agricultural production has been implemented. As a result, scientific farming methods and their solid foundation have been established and the experience has been gained in revitalizing wheat production and the area under wheat cultivation has been increased by more than 30 000 hectares this year alone as against last year.
Amid the hot wind of scientific farming and high-yielding emulation, many more cities, counties, farms, workteams, sub-workteams and farmers have reported bumper harvests to increase the grain production, leading to over-fulfillment of the annual state grain production plans.
The historic Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, which set forth the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, marked a turning point in developing the country's agriculture onto a stage of definite upswing by stepping up the rural rejuvenation and providing a milestone for victory for the rapid development of Korean-style socialist countryside.
Whenever the plenary meetings of the WPK Central Committee were convened, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the tasks and ways for steadily increasing the agricultural production of the country and took decisive measures to enlist the entire Party, the whole country and all the people to turn out in the campaign to give full manpower and material support to the countryside.
The material and technical foundations of agriculture have been further strengthened amid the intensified drive to implement the Party's programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
A nationwide struggle was waged to repair, reinforce and further perfect the irrigation system of the country.
In 2023, the first year when irrigation construction started at full speed, irrigation projects for more than 200 000 hectares of fields were successfully completed, including the construction and capacity expansion of groundwater facilities in more than 12 000 places, the construction of over 3 000 pumping stations and the laying of over 2 400 km of pipelines.
In 2024, irrigation facilities for over 60 000 hectares of fields were renovated in the drought-stricken areas to provide a guarantee for high and safe yields despite drought and high temperature.
Officials, working people and builders across the country completed the construction or the repair of over 1 300 pumping stations, the building or the overhaul of over 1 100 irrigation structures and the repair of over 17 000 kilometers of waterways and thus completing irrigation projects for more than 160 000 hectares of paddy fields and turning over 3 300 hectares of dry fields into paddy fields this year alone.
The work to radically increase the proportion of farm work done by machines was conducted to achieve unprecedented successes in realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture.
The farm machine production units which have been modernized under the care of the Party have increased production.
With the expansion of successes since the first year of implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, nearly 43 000 farm machines were secured in 2023 and the varieties of farm machines increased considerably last year, too.
This year alone, the varieties of farm machines have increased to more than 50 kinds and the proportion of farm work done by machines increased by more than 2 percent over the previous year.
Officials and working people in the agricultural sector turned out as one in attaining the grain production goal set by the Party.
Agricultural guidance organs at all levels have designed and carried out farming operations and guidance according to all farming processes in a scientific way.
The scientific farming promotion team has strengthened its role to support increased grain production by dint of science and technology.
A vigorous struggle was waged in different parts of the country to expand the area under wheat cultivation and raise its productivity.
Amid the deep interest and great enthusiasm of the whole country and society for wheat farming, the area under wheat cultivation has more than doubled in the past four years.
With the structure of grain production and farming methods changing and wheat production growing rapidly, many farms produced high yields in 2023, and in 2024 the national wheat production plan was over-fulfilled by more than 140 percent and more than 100 farms produced over 6 tons of wheat per hectare.
This year, 11 farms and over 170 workteams have produced more than 8 tons of grain per hectare on an average thanks to the efforts of agricultural officials and working people to harvest high yields in the farming of early crops this year.
The state grain production plan has been over-fulfilled since 2023 thanks to the struggle of the officials and working people in the agricultural sector who have turned out in attaining the goal of grain production.
In 2024, hundreds of thousands of tons of grain were produced more across the country as against 2023 as a result of the campaign for simultaneous and balanced development of all the regions and farms.
The proportion of the introduction of nutritive cold-bed seedlings has increased considerably throughout the country and advanced farming methods have been widely applied, leading to increased grain production.
In hearty response to the Party's policy, a struggle was waged across the country to introduce the method of organic farming through fish farming.
Thanks to the great vitality of the new agricultural policy of the WPK, more than 30 high-yield cities and counties were produced this year and many other units became high-yield farms, high-yield workteams and high-yield sub-workteams.
The news of the bumper harvest and year-end account settlement and income distribution in the socialist rural areas good to live and work in along with the new era of rural rejuvenation, is adding to the pleasure of the people across the country.
The stable agricultural foundation of the country which are steadily developing day by day and the increased grain production have convinced officials and working people once again that the Party's policy is science, truth and victory and that everything will go well if they follow only the Party's policy. -0-

headline: Struggle to Conclude Year-end Work in Mining Industrial Sector
story_text:

Workers and technicians of the Unpha Mine are carrying out their daily plans by applying rational drilling and blasting methods and increasing the mining and transport capacity.
The December 5 Youth Mine secured various kinds of accessories and materials and meticulously managed equipment and improved the technical control, thus raising the rate of carrying out the plan, and introduced valuable inventions to guarantee the quality of products.
The Hyesan Youth Mine secured many cutting faces by concentrating on deep development and pit construction, improved the performance of rock drills and vertical lifts and increased the dressing capacity.

headline: KCNA Report on Rapid Development of Agriculture
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 6 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency released a report on Friday, detailing the successes in consolidating the material and technical foundations of agriculture and rapidly increasing the grain production after the declaration of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
All the officials, Party members and other working people, who turned out in the grand campaign for creation true to the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, made remarkable progress in irrigation construction, including the completion of paddy field irrigation projects covering more than 500 000 hectares which was planned by the Workers' Party of Korea, successfully attained the annual goal according to the plan for the development of farm machines and turned over 13 500 hectares of dry fields into paddy fields, the report said, and went on:
The Party's policy on pushing ahead with rice and wheat farming by boldly changing the structure of agricultural production has been implemented. As a result, scientific farming methods and their solid foundation have been established and the experience has been gained in revitalizing wheat production and the area under wheat cultivation has been increased by more than 30 000 hectares this year alone as against last year.
Amid the hot wind of scientific farming and high-yielding emulation, many more cities, counties, farms, workteams, sub-workteams and farmers have reported bumper harvests to increase the grain production, leading to over-fulfillment of the annual state grain production plans.
The historic Fourth Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, which set forth the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, marked a turning point in developing the country's agriculture onto a stage of definite upswing by stepping up the rural rejuvenation and providing a milestone for victory for the rapid development of Korean-style socialist countryside.
Whenever the plenary meetings of the WPK Central Committee were convened, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the tasks and ways for steadily increasing the agricultural production of the country and took decisive measures to enlist the entire Party, the whole country and all the people to turn out in the campaign to give full manpower and material support to the countryside.
The material and technical foundations of agriculture have been further strengthened amid the intensified drive to implement the Party's programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
A nationwide struggle was waged to repair, reinforce and further perfect the irrigation system of the country.
In 2023, the first year when irrigation construction started at full speed, irrigation projects for more than 200 000 hectares of fields were successfully completed, including the construction and capacity expansion of groundwater facilities in more than 12 000 places, the construction of over 3 000 pumping stations and the laying of over 2 400 km of pipelines.
In 2024, irrigation facilities for over 60 000 hectares of fields were renovated in the drought-stricken areas to provide a guarantee for high and safe yields despite drought and high temperature.
Officials, working people and builders across the country completed the construction or the repair of over 1 300 pumping stations, the building or the overhaul of over 1 100 irrigation structures and the repair of over 17 000 kilometers of waterways and thus completing irrigation projects for more than 160 000 hectares of paddy fields and turning over 3 300 hectares of dry fields into paddy fields this year alone.
The work to radically increase the proportion of farm work done by machines was conducted to achieve unprecedented successes in realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture.
The farm machine production units which have been modernized under the care of the Party have increased production.
With the expansion of successes since the first year of implementing the programme for the rural revolution in the new era, nearly 43 000 farm machines were secured in 2023 and the varieties of farm machines increased considerably last year, too.
This year alone, the varieties of farm machines have increased to more than 50 kinds and the proportion of farm work done by machines increased by more than 2 percent over the previous year.
Officials and working people in the agricultural sector turned out as one in attaining the grain production goal set by the Party.
Agricultural guidance organs at all levels have designed and carried out farming operations and guidance according to all farming processes in a scientific way.
The scientific farming promotion team has strengthened its role to support increased grain production by dint of science and technology.
A vigorous struggle was waged in different parts of the country to expand the area under wheat cultivation and raise its productivity.
Amid the deep interest and great enthusiasm of the whole country and society for wheat farming, the area under wheat cultivation has more than doubled in the past four years.
With the structure of grain production and farming methods changing and wheat production growing rapidly, many farms produced high yields in 2023, and in 2024 the national wheat production plan was over-fulfilled by more than 140 percent and more than 100 farms produced over 6 tons of wheat per hectare.
This year, 11 farms and over 170 workteams have produced more than 8 tons of grain per hectare on an average thanks to the efforts of agricultural officials and working people to harvest high yields in the farming of early crops this year.
The state grain production plan has been over-fulfilled since 2023 thanks to the struggle of the officials and working people in the agricultural sector who have turned out in attaining the goal of grain production.
In 2024, hundreds of thousands of tons of grain were produced more across the country as against 2023 as a result of the campaign for simultaneous and balanced development of all the regions and farms.
The proportion of the introduction of nutritive cold-bed seedlings has increased considerably throughout the country and advanced farming methods have been widely applied, leading to increased grain production.
In hearty response to the Party's policy, a struggle was waged across the country to introduce the method of organic farming through fish farming.
Thanks to the great vitality of the new agricultural policy of the WPK, more than 30 high-yield cities and counties were produced this year and many other units became high-yield farms, high-yield workteams and high-yield sub-workteams.
The news of the bumper harvest and year-end account settlement and income distribution in the socialist rural areas good to live and work in along with the new era of rural rejuvenation, is adding to the pleasure of the people across the country.
The stable agricultural foundation of the country which are steadily developing day by day and the increased grain production have convinced officials and working people once again that the Party's policy is science, truth and victory and that everything will go well if they follow only the Party's policy. -0-

Sports Contest of Artistes Held
New Houses Built in Counties of South Hamgyong Province
story_text:

headline: Chairman of SPA Standing Committee Inspects Various Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors.
At the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, Choe Ryong Hae called upon officials to organize and guide the production in a more energetic and responsible manner in order to implement the Party's decision and make a stride forward in realizing the domestic production of catalyst by steadily strengthening its own scientific and technological capabilities and giving full play to the creative activeness of the masses.
He stressed the need for the workers of the complex to more dynamically conduct the socialist patriotic movement, the revolutionary mass movement, the driving force for creating miracles and innovations, and thus greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK with proud successes in increasing fertilizer production.
Going round the Unjon County Foodstuff Factory, he called for giving primary effort to the quality improvement of goods and actively developing and producing various kinds of foodstuffs peculiar to the county so as to make a substantial contribution to improving the people's standard of living.
At the township farm, the Posok Farm and the Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory in Unjon County, he underlined the need to make full preparations for next year's farming, further expand the areas for green cultivation and paddy-field fish breeding and fully tap the organic resources of the region to produce and supply organic compound fertilizer to the farms in the county.
Learning in detail about the work of the county people's committee, he called for further enhancing the function and role of the socialist law-observance guidance committee to reliably guarantee the implementation of the Party's policies by law and steadily improve the effectiveness of education in law observance.
Discussed at field consultative meetings were the issue of fully supplying electricity, raw and other materials necessary for fertilizer production, the issue of paying deep attention to the supply service and life for the employees and the issue of improving the organization and guidance over law-abiding life. -0-

headline: Production Foundations of Raw Material Bases Reinforced in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality in the DPRK is directing great efforts to reinforcing the material and technical foundations of raw material bases.
This year alone, the municipality provided the district and county raw material base stations with a lot of farm machines and small- and medium-sized farm implements, built new production buildings of several workteams of raw material base stations, and created over 630 hectares of Evodia Daniellii Benn forests and over 10 hectares of rape cultivation area.
Onchon County built a raw material base station and organized technical studies, demonstrations and passing-on technique meetings to raise the level of scientific farming and the proportion of mechanization and bring into full play the enthusiasm of the masses.
Ryonggang County built new buildings of the workteams of its raw material base station in various areas and sent various farm implements.
Hanggu District has remodeled the production buildings of the workteams of its raw material base station and sent farming materials, and Chollima District is increasing the area under Evodia Daniellii Benn cultivation through mass movements.
Waudo and Taean districts secured high-yielding varieties of seeds of sugar- and oil-bearing crops of high economic value and have taken technical measures to increase the yields. -0-

story_text:

It laid another foundation for producing and supplying many more trailing farm machines which are of significance in raising the proportion of mechanization of farm work in the province.
The factory qualitatively completed the huge construction project in a short span of time and pushed forward the technical upgrading of its production processes as scheduled.
Farm machines and parts produced by the remodeled factory were sent to relevant units in the province. -0-

Units of Physical Education Create New Teaching Methods
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 7 (KCNA) -- Units of physical education across the DPRK are improving their theoretical and practical education.
Korea University of Physical Education has developed measuring instruments and programs conducive to putting the sports psychological physiology and boxing practice sessions on a higher scientific and IT basis, thus improving the students' theory and practical skills according to their majors.
It has also made achievements in training sessions for badminton, judo, ice hockey, etc. by applying new teaching methods.
Central Sports School has developed auxiliary training instruments effective for intensifying football and swimming training sessions, thus further raising the students' ball control skills and physical and technical abilities.
Sinuiju College of Physical Education and Kanggye College of Physical Education are actively conducting the work to introduce new training means and methods into the training sessions for volleyball and handball.
The table tennis and track-and-field teachers of Chongjin College of Physical Education and Wonsan College of Physical Education developed effective enlightenment- and brainstorm-oriented teaching methods to improve the thinking ability of students and raise the enthusiasm for their studies.
Phyongsong College of Physical Education, Hamhung College of Physical Education and other units are improving the quality of teaching by combining theoretical education with practical education. -0-
