headline: Successes in Land and Environment Protection Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- This year, the land and environment protection sector in the DPRK marked on the map the objects vulnerable to flood damage and bad and dangerous places, which were surveyed and grasped across the country, and pushed ahead with the projects of preventing flood damage. As a result, it carried out the planned projects for river improvement, anti-land-sliding projects and projects for building, repairing and reinforcing coast protection structures.
In particular, it ensured the designing related to the project for permanent embankments in the city of Sinuiju and the islet area of the county of Uiju and provided the technical guidance for the projects in a responsible manner.
It also worked out a nationwide long-term water-conservation plan for managing floods in a rational way and developing and using water resources, thus providing a guarantee for pushing forward with scientific water conservation according to yearly and stage-by-stage plans under the unified guidance of the central organ.
The plans for planting trees, including wild fruit trees and firewood forests, were fulfilled at 103.8 percent across the country and the seed-picking and sapling-production plans over-fulfilled by ensuring the sapling cultivation and the operation of tree nurseries on a scientific basis.
Progress has also been made in the work to improve the roads and the ecological environment.
South Hwanghae Province finished the project for paving the Haeju-Jaeryong road, building retaining walls and protection walls for safety and installing road safety facilities and road signs by August, thus improving the road technical conditions.
The Ministry of Land and Environment Protection finished drawing up the master plan for land development which reflected the medium- and long-term nationwide green plan. It thus opened up the prospect of conducting economic construction and land management in a far-sighted way by closely combining them with ecological environment protection according to the master plan.
It concluded the nationwide ecological environment survey and comprehensively analyzed and evaluated the changes in ecological environment of the past decade. In this way, it laid the foundation for comprehensively setting scientific goals and ways for improving the ecological environment of the country. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Noble Life Shining with People-bound Train
story_text:

headline: Construction Mechanized Brigade in South Hwanghae Province
Successes in Land and Environment Protection Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 15 (KCNA) -- This year, the land and environment protection sector in the DPRK marked on the map the objects vulnerable to flood damage and bad and dangerous places, which were surveyed and grasped across the country, and pushed ahead with the projects of preventing flood damage. As a result, it carried out the planned projects for river improvement, anti-land-sliding projects and projects for building, repairing and reinforcing coast protection structures.
In particular, it ensured the designing related to the project for permanent embankments in the city of Sinuiju and the islet area of the county of Uiju and provided the technical guidance for the projects in a responsible manner.
It also worked out a nationwide long-term water-conservation plan for managing floods in a rational way and developing and using water resources, thus providing a guarantee for pushing forward with scientific water conservation according to yearly and stage-by-stage plans under the unified guidance of the central organ.
The plans for planting trees, including wild fruit trees and firewood forests, were fulfilled at 103.8 percent across the country and the seed-picking and sapling-production plans over-fulfilled by ensuring the sapling cultivation and the operation of tree nurseries on a scientific basis.
Progress has also been made in the work to improve the roads and the ecological environment.
South Hwanghae Province finished the project for paving the Haeju-Jaeryong road, building retaining walls and protection walls for safety and installing road safety facilities and road signs by August, thus improving the road technical conditions.
The Ministry of Land and Environment Protection finished drawing up the master plan for land development which reflected the medium- and long-term nationwide green plan. It thus opened up the prospect of conducting economic construction and land management in a far-sighted way by closely combining them with ecological environment protection according to the master plan.
It concluded the nationwide ecological environment survey and comprehensively analyzed and evaluated the changes in ecological environment of the past decade. In this way, it laid the foundation for comprehensively setting scientific goals and ways for improving the ecological environment of the country. -0-

headline: Korean-style Process for Producing Sodium Alginate Established
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK has newly established a Korean-style process for producing sodium alginate, laying another foundation for the economic development of the region and the improvement of the people's standard of living, according to Minju Joson.
Sodium alginate, with seaweeds including kelp as its main raw material, is a functional additive widely used in such various sectors and units of the national economy as textile, pulp paper-making, chemical, cosmetics, food, pharmaceutical, metallurgical and mining industries.
The province makes the relevant sector and units put spurs to the research and development for expanding the application range of sodium alginate while further raising the modernization level and production capacity of its production process and directing efforts into the normalization of production and the improvement of product quality. -0-

headline: New Regional-industry Factories in Taegwan County of DPRK
Phyochung Monuments in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- Phyochung monuments were erected by kings of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910) in praise of the loyalty of Jong Mong Ju, a high-ranking official, military man and diplomat active in the late period of Koryo dynasty (918-1392).
The monuments stand by the Sonjuk Bridge in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK.
The two monuments are in a house and each of them consists of floor stone made of granite, tortoise-shaped pedestal, body made of black marble and head.
The monument in the north was built in 1740. It is 3.17 meters high and 0.93 meters wide. The monument in the south was built in 1872. It is 3.58 meters high and 0.94 meters wide.
On the floor stone, there is the tortoise-shaped pedestal made of a monolith with weight of over ten tons.
Both heads of the monuments are in the form of hip-saddle roofs and each head has four dragons in relief.
The monuments are precious cultural heritage showing the rich artistic talents and developed cultural level of Korean ancestors. -0-

The spirit of new change and vigorous advance is filled in the remote mountain village thanks to the energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who planned the great historic cause of regional development that no one in the world may dare to do and has spent the days and nights of devoted service for the people's wellbeing, shouldering everything.

Ju Chang Il, together with officials and employees of the new factories, cut the inauguration tape, amid cheers of all the participants.
Confetti of celebration was set off and balloons soared high in the sky, adding to the joy and delight of the inauguration.

That evening fireworks were displayed to adorn the nocturnal sky of the county. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories and Leisure Complex Held with Splendor in Kangdong County
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea is accelerating the accomplishment of the epoch-making cause of reconstructing the regional economy completely based on new foundations, taking steps towards the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism in a responsible manner. Kangdong County greeted the day of inaugurating its regional-industry factories and leisure complex, adding to the joy of the second inauguration season in implementing the regional development policy which has come without delay thanks to the Party's guidance.
The modern light industry factories and multifunctional bases for cultural life, built in 20 cities and counties after seeing the exciting explosions in their ground-breaking ceremonies with the great joy, redoubled self-confidence and high spirit provided through the creative struggle in the first year for regional transformation, are significantly decorating the closing days of the historic year 2025, demonstrating the definite trend of the irreversible change and development.
An inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories and leisure complex in Kangdong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held with splendor on December 15.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!".
They extended the highest respect and glory toKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a heyday of changes, in which the outcomes of the gigantic revolution settle in the people's living as dear things as soon as possible, after setting the implementation of the regional development policy in the new era as a solemn oath and pledge the WPK made before the country and the people.
Present at the ceremony were senior officials of the Party, government and military organs, members of the Party central leadership body in Pyongyang, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang and Kangdong County, working people and officers and men of the construction units.
Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK made an inauguration address.
The speaker said with excitement that another splendid inauguration ceremony is being held in Kangdong County, where the start of the grand construction in 2025 was declared and the first modern regional hospital was built.
He said that those factories and leisure complex are the precious assets brought by the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Unwho dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the projects at the groundbreaking ceremony and visited the construction sites several times to guide and take care of them. And he warmly congratulated the people of Kangdong County who would enjoy a new beautiful and civilized life under the warm blessing of the great father.
The speaker also extended warm thanks and encouragement to the soldier-builders and the officials and workers in the relevant sector, who successfully carried out the projects for regional development policy, always remembering the great trust of the Party which made them stand in the vanguard of the struggle for the regional development, and made positive contributions to the construction with a high sense of responsibility for implementing the Party's decision.
It is the consistent goal ofKim Jong Un's policy on regional construction to make a nonstop leap forward with the passage of years in promoting the people's well-being and to orient and expand this undertaking in the direction of providing them with all the elements necessary for promoting the regional development and improving the people's living standards, he said, referring to the fact thatKim Jong Unenergetically led the construction of the light industrial factories and leisure complexes conducive to the improvement of the regional people's material life and their moral and cultural development so that they would be perfectly built as a symbol of our own style of civilization and development.
He stressed that the eye-opening changes in Kangdong County, where a modern hospital, regional-industry factories and leisure complex have been built at the same time in less than a year, would tell forever the greatness and tremendous vitality of our Party's regional development policy along with the appearance of the happy people enjoying a civilized and wealthy life.
The epoch-making cause of fundamentally transforming the local areas is entering an orbit of overall expansion amid the succession of groundbreaking and inauguration ceremonies every year, the speaker said, ardently calling upon all to think and act in accordance with the great patriotic will ofKim Jong Unand devote wisdom, strength and enthusiasm to the prosperity of the country.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
A large number of balloons rose up and fireworks were displayed over the venue of the inauguration ceremony overflowing with great emotion of the residents in Kangdong County who were significantly celebrating another auspicious event, to be specially recorded in the development history of the county, in the presence of the benevolent father of the large socialist family in their native place.
All the participants extended their boundless gratitude to the great artist of creation and construction and the outstanding leader of the people who is glorifying the annals of great changes for the regional development in the new era.
Kim Jong Unwent round the Kangdong County Foodstuff Factory and the Leisure Complex.
Expressing his surging emotion of witnessing the worthwhile struggle targeting the great changes across the country undergoing another proud process amid the full support of the people,Kim Jong Unsaid that to achieve a leap forward in the local areas and provide the people with precious entities of prosperity and civilization are a sacred undertaking which our Party serving the people should unconditionally and consistently push ahead without a moment's stagnation or delay.
The true value of the regional-industry revolution should be verified not only in creating material wealth but also in transforming the ideological consciousness of officials and working people in keeping with the demand of the new era, he said, adding that the spirit and fighting principle of upholding the Party's policies should remain unchanged but the goal and sphere of creation should be steadily updated and improved.
Saying that the regional people are the beneficiaries and enjoyers of the regional development policy in the new era,Kim Jong Unstressed the need to invariably preserve and glorify the true nature of Korean-style socialism where the Party policy is mapped out for the people and the people enjoy happiness to their heart's content thanks to it.
As the valuable successes and experience increase and the people's dreams and ideals grow higher, our Party will lead to endless upswing and expansion the era of dynamic movement beyond all precedents and limits in terms of speed of advance and changes for the national rejuvenation and breadth and depth of innovation and creation with its stronger will and strenuous efforts, he stressed.
The participants in the inauguration ceremony went round factories put on a modern, economic profitable and long-term basis to suit the regional situation and the Leisure Complex which will promote the cultural life of the regional people, delightedly sharing with each other about impressions on new life, new civilization and new wellbeing.
The grand inauguration of the regional industrial factories and the leisure complex in Kangdong County serves as another significant occasion in greatly increasing the joy and patriotic enthusiasm of the people across the country who are advancing towards the Ninth Congress of the WPK amid firework display celebrating the successes in implementing the regional development revolution. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Centenarian in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Pok Sun, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 136-1 in Hwawon Workers' District, Jangyon County, South Hwanghae Province.
After receiving the birthday spread amid the congratulations of officials of Jangyon County and villagers, the centenarian extended thanks to MarshalKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of the large socialist family.
Her family members and relatives were full of the enthusiasm and will to leave traces of loyalty and patriotism in the worthwhile struggle for bringing earlier the new era of regional rejuvenation under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, handing down this glory from generation to generation. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories Held in Rangnim County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- Rangnim County of the DPRK greeted the moments of celebrating the inauguration of regional-industry factories built under the energetic guidance of the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee which is powerfully leading the historic cause of bringing about a radical regional change to a brilliant success.
An inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories was held on December 15. Present there were Pak Jong Chon, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee, officials of the Party and power organs in the province and county, working people and employees of the regional-industry factories.
Pak Jong Chon made an inauguration address.
The speaker stressed that the miraculous and creative success in completing the construction of the factories in the year when it started, demonstrating the dynamic feature of the regional development would be unthinkable apart from the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is devoting himself with ardent loving care to making the ideal appearance of regional areas the true picture of socialist Korea, regarding the work for the people as his pride.
He stressed the need for the officials of Rangnim County and the province and employees of regional-industry factories to set the orientation and goal of development peculiar to the economy of their region as a mountainous county on the basis of the self-supporting economic bases provided by the Party, scrupulously lay long-term foundations for growth and increase the variety of products and actively develop and produce the specialties representing their region, thus making a substantial contribution to improving the people's standard of living.
He called on the officials and working people to work harder to change their native place with the confidence in the brighter future and redoubled efforts, bearing deep in mind the benevolence of the Party which provided the county with the wealth of prosperity, and thus hasten the comprehensive development of the great motherland.
Ri Yong Il, chief secretary of the Rangnim County Committee of the WPK, said that the regional-industry factories built thanks to the peerlessly great man's noble spirit and ardent devotion serve as a springboard for the county's economic development and a precious asset for improving the people's standard of living, adding that the factories would produce more goods favored by residents in the county and specialties of the county by directing primary efforts to improving the quality of products.
Pak Jong Chon cut the inauguration tape with employees of the factories.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants went round the wonderful factories with admiration.
A colorful art performance was given and the cheerful laughter of people echoed throughout the county.
That evening, the residents fully realized the new picture of change and prosperity, provided in the county under the WPK's policy, amid the display of spectacular fireworks celebrating the inauguration of the regional-industry factories. -0-

headline: New Regional-industry Factories in Sinyang County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- Regional-industry factories have been built in inland mountainous Sinyang County of the DPRK to fundamentally improve the quality of the regional people's living and powerfully promote the independent development of the region.
An inauguration ceremony took place on Dec. 15.
Present there were Jo Yong Won, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Ri Song Bom, chairman of the South Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, officials in the province and Sinyang County, working people and employees of the factories.
Jo Yong Won addressed the ceremony.
He said that the inauguration season, which has come without fail this year following the last year and will continue to be seen more wonderfully every year in the future, too, is a vivid manifestation of the unshakable will and outstanding leadership ability of the WPK to bring earlier the comprehensive national rejuvenation by pushing ahead with the implementation of the regional development policy.
Saying that a great number of edifices, which are springing up in different parts of the country to the effect that such a gigantic change, something unimaginable just two years ago, may be deemed an everyday occurrence, are the invaluable fruition of the noble intention and devotion of the Party Central Committee to carry out the sacred undertakings for the people faster and better, the speaker referred to the energetic guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho made sure that the construction of regional-industry factories were promoted vigorously in a more qualitative way, as expected by the people.
Thanks to warm sincerity of the great Party Central Committee, which always places the improvement of the people's wellbeing above all else, this year's construction of regional-industry factories has made greater progress than last year on the principle of further diversifying the architectural form, rationally arranging the production lines and ensuring economic effectiveness and profitability in conformity with regional characteristics and functions of industrial facilities.
Then, Kim Kwang Chol, chief secretary of the Sinyang County Committee of the WPK, made a speech.
He said that they would steadily and responsibly carry out the policy tasks for invigorating the factories in order to make the regional-industry factories actually prove effective and become solid and valuable assets for improving the living standards of the people in the county, always bearing in mind the on-site instructions given byKim Jong Un.
Jo Yong Won cut the inauguration tape, together with the working people who will lead a worthwhile and civilized labor life at the new factories.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the factories with modern production lines.
A colorful art performance was given, adding to the pleasure and joy of the people in Sinyang County greeting the significant day of inauguration.
That evening there was a fireworks display to celebrate the inauguration of the factories. -0-

headline: Preparations for Next Year's Farming in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK are putting spurs to the preparations for next year's farming.
In keeping with the growing proportion of introduction of nutritive cold-bed seedlings, the municipality has built one hundred and tens of greenhouses after providing raw materials necessary for the production of multi-nutrients for rice seedlings.
Its farms have established the food production cycle of agricultural production and stockbreeding, fruit farming and stockbreeding while pushing ahead with the production of self-sufficing manure including fermented manure "Sinyang No.2" and huminite.
Meanwhile, the municipality mapped out a step-by-step plan for raising the proportion of mechanization of farm work and is securing various kinds of farm machines including nutritive rice-transplanting machines and tractor trailers and introducing paddy-field fish breeding. -0-

headline: New Regional-industry Factories in Taegwan County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- Modern regional-industry factories have appeared in Taegwan County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK, adorning more brilliantly this historic year for the conclusion of the five-year plan decided at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with epochal achievements and sweeping the whole country with great joy and emotion.
Wonderful light-industry bases, which made another leap forward in architectural style, practicality, efficiency and level of automation and scientification, were newly built in the remote mountain county in just more than 290 days after the start of their ground-breaking in February.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Taegwan County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held on December 15.
Attending it were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Choe Yong Man, chairman of the North Phyongan Provincial People's Committee, officials and working people in the province and county, employees of the factories and soldier-builders.
Jo Chun Ryong addressed the ceremony.
The speaker referred to the fact that Taegwan County with poor economic foundation came to develop its economy through the light-industry bases capable of producing quality necessities and specialities with the trademarks of the county.
Saying that the comprehensive changes of regions are the motive power for building a civilized and prosperous state and its real picture, he called upon all the participants to make a dynamic advance towards the completion of the great programme on regional development and the victory of the cause of Korean-style socialism.
Ri Myong Jin, chief secretary of the Taegwan County Committee of the WPK, made a speech.
He expressed his firm resolution to become a true servant going through in the vanguard muddy roads and thorny fields for the people in the county, aware that the successes in implementing the WPK's new regional development policy are guaranteed by officials' transparent view on the people, and thus turn the county into a paradise full of happy singing to be envied by the people across the country.
Jo Chun Ryong cut the inauguration tape together with owners of the new factories.
Confetti of inauguration fluttered and a large number of balloons soared higher in the sky amid the cheers of celebration.
An art performance was given, adding to the pleasure of the participants celebrating the event witnessed in the county for the first time.
Fireworks were set off, picturing the future of Taegwan County to further prosper in the new era of change under the wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Immortal Exploits for Accomplishment of Human Cause of Independence
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilis an outstanding leader who performed immortal exploits for the accomplishment of the human cause of independence with his extraordinary ideology and theories and gigantic revolutionary practice.
Kim Jong Il, who cherished independence as his revolutionary faith all his life, made public such works as "On the Juche Idea" and "Independence Is the Lifeblood of the Country and Nation" to provide the ideological and theoretical weapon to be held fast to by the progressive mankind in the era of independence.
In April 1992 the Pyongyang Declaration on defending and advancing the socialist cause was adopted and issued. It was a historic declaration that heralded the fresh start of the world socialist movement advancing under the banner of the Juche idea, the banner of independence.
It is an extraordinary contribution he made to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence that he defended and advanced the country and the revolution, smashing the imperialists' moves to stifle the DPRK with his Songun revolutionary leadership.
He developed the friendly and cooperative relations between countries through the energetic external activities with his high international prestige. And he developed the DPRK-China and the DPRK-Russia friendships onto a new high stage through mutual visits with the top leaders of China and Russia in the new century on the basis of deep trust and good-neighborliness and powerfully promoted the common cause of mankind for independence, peace and prosperity.
In the whole period of his revolutionary leadership, he met a large number of foreign political and social figures and gave them the precious instructions which would serve as the guidelines for strengthening the unity and solidarity of the anti-imperialist independent forces.
The undying exploits of the Chairman, who devoted his noble life to the accomplishment of the human cause of independence, serve as a source of the strength making the progressives aspiring after independence hold higher the banner of socialism against imperialism for their richness, profundity and great influence. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Meet in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) and agricultural workers held a meeting to hear the noble virtues of ChairmanKim Jong Ilon December 16 on the occasion of the 14th anniversary of his demise.
Present there were officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers in Pyongyang.
The speakers told with deep emotion about the loving care for the people shown byKim Jong Ilwho walked along the rugged roads between farm fields till the last period of his revolutionary career to solve the food problem of the people.
They said that the Chairman visited the Migok Farm in Sariwon City, the Sinam Farm in Ryongchon County, the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County, the Unhung Farm in Thaechon County, etc. to kindle the flames of socialist emulation among farms and led them to glorify their honor as model farms in the van of agricultural production.
They highly praised the immortal feats ofKim Jong Ilwho always found himself among agricultural workers, paid deep attention to the issue of supplying vegetables to the citizens and took measures for it without taking a rest on holidays for the happiness of the people.
They stressed that he is the benevolent father and the great teacher of the DPRK people as he showed deep loving care and benevolence for the agricultural workers, devoting himself to improving the people's diet.
They called upon all the agricultural workers to become the genuine patriotic peasants, saying that a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation is being ushered in on this land under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is ceaselessly making the journey of devoted service for the people's wellbeing to translate the patriotic desire ofKim Jong Ilinto reality. -0-

headline: Peerlessly Great Man's Immortal Traces Left in All Parts of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Illeft immortal traces for the people while giving field guidance throughout his revolutionary career.
It was the creed and will ofKim Jong Ilthat if there is an almighty being in the world, it is the people and the country exists as the people exist and that one should pluck even a star from the sky and bring flowers into bloom even on a rock if the people wish.
Kim Jong Ilvisited more than 14 290 units all his life in order to make the people well-off, in spite of the biting cold of midwinter and the midsummer heat.
Countless is the number of light industrial, animal husbandry, fish farming, poultry and fruit production bases and other places visited by him.
He inspected nearly 1 000 units in the last three years of his revolutionary career.
Even in December 2011, he visited the Amusement Park of Kaeson Youth Park and the Kwangbok Area Supermarket nearing opening in order to provide the people with better conditions for cultured life.
Our people are looking back with deep emotion on his loving care and devotion for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. -0-

headline: DPRK Schoolchildren Meet to Tell Stories about Generalissimo Kim Jong Il's Noble Virtues
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- DPRK schoolchildren gathered at the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace on December 16 to tell stories about the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Il's noble virtues on the occasion of the 14th anniversary of his demise.
The storytellers praised the undying feats ofKim Jong Ilwho brightly illuminated the road ahead of the Korean Children's Union (KCU) in each period of the developing revolution and trained the schoolchildren to be stalwart successors and reserves of the cause of the Juche revolution.
They said that in his middle school days the Generalissimo instilled into schoolchildren the firm faith in the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand led them to be true sons and daughters and reliable pillars of the country who firmly trust and follow him.
They said thatKim Jong Ilmade ceaseless journeys for the revolutionary leadership, taking short and uncomfortable sleep and eating rice-balls, and spared nothing for the students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, adding that his loving care and benevolence are kept in the school's history and in the hearts of the children of revolutionary martyrs.
They said that the respected MarshalKim Jong Unis the benevolent father of the KCU members across the country as he sets the work for the younger generation as the foremost state affair and the most important affair and puts his heart and soul into the work for the bright laughter and happiness of schoolchildren.
Present at the meeting were officials of the youth league and schoolchildren in Pyongyang. -0-

headline:
DPRK Women Commemorate Anniversary of Demise of Chairman Kim Jong Il
[2025.12.17.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- Officials and members of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea (SWUK) held a meeting at the Hall of Women on Dec. 16 to hear the noble virtues of ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasion of the 14th anniversary of his demise.
Present there were Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the SWUK, officials concerned and officials of the women's union and its members in Pyongyang.
At the meeting the speakers said that the noble revolutionary career ofKim Jong Ilwho laid an eternal foundation for the prosperity of the socialist country and happiness of all generations with his outstanding idea and gigantic revolutionary practice is a history of warm love and boundless devotion.
They highly praised the undying ideo-theoretical exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho formulated the revolutionary idea of PresidentKim Il Sungas Kimilsungism and proclaimed the modeling of the whole society on Kimilsungism as the supreme programme of the Workers' Party of Korea after analyzing and reviewing the 100-year-long history of the ideology of the preceding working class in his early years.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel across the DPRK pay the highest tribute, with boundless yearning and ardent loyalty, to ChairmanKim Jong Il, looking back with deep emotion on the sacred revolutionary career and eternal exploits of the peerlessly great man, who set it as his lifelong cause to build on this land a country which will always be powerful and prosperous and devoted his all to its realization, on the occasion of the 14th anniversary of his demise.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00 on December 17, the greatest memorial day for our Party, state and people.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies, the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and the commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army.
Flower baskets were laid before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Kim Jong Un, together with other visitors, bowed before the statues as an expression of noble respects to the great leaders.
At the hall, where the Chairman lies in state,Kim Jong Un, together with other visitors, paid high tribute to him, praying for his immortality.
All the visitors made a firm pledge to remain true, with their whole heart and loyalty, to the ideology and leadership ofKim Jong Unwho is glorifying the patriotic exploits ofKim Jong Ilby opening up a new glorious history of comprehensive national rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Regional-Industry Factories in Hwangju County Inaugurated
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- The ardent desire of the Central Committee of the great Workers' Party of Korea has brought about stirring events in different parts of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, which are demonstrating the vigorous transformation in socialist Korea. Against this backdrop, regional-industry factories were inaugurated in Hwangju County, North Hwanghae Province.
An inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Hwangju County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy took place on December 16.
Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, members of the central leadership body of the Party in Pyongyang Municipality, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, officials of North Hwanghae Province and Hwangju County, working people and service personnel of the construction units.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.
The speaker said that Hwangju County, too, finished the projects in the year of their groundbreaking and greeted the great auspicious event of their inauguration thanks to the energetic guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who gave priority to the construction for the regional people and meticulously led it to make new pioneering and development in all aspects including design, construction and production techniques.
He said that the modern regional-industry factories are a precious fruition of the unique ideas and devotion ofKim Jong Unwho ushers in an era of epochal transformation to provide the regional people with a new happy life through his profound thought and energetic leadership with his ardent love for the people.
Jo Yong Won and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK, and No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, cut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were set off and a large number of balloons rose up over the venue of the inauguration ceremony to beautifully decorate the sky of December.
After the inauguration ceremony, leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs went round the regional-industry factories together with the participants.
People in the county were delighted to see various kinds of condiments, confectionery, daily necessities and clothes produced at the modern regional-industry factories with their county trademarks of "Kindungbol" and "Hwangjuchon".
Thak Chol Hyok, chairman of the Hwangju County People's Committee, said that the precious creations and valuable wealth representing the new era of regional change have been built in his place, extending thanks toKim Jong Unfor providing without fail the inauguration season of the smart factories in which all the regional people are waiting and welcoming every year,
He said that he would ensure the county's demand by normalizing production, put efforts into developing and producing more specialties favoured by the people, regarding it as the lifeline to improve quality, and thus fulfill his responsibility and duty to ensure that the modern regional-industry factories would serve as a strong fortress and fruitful asset for improving the people's standard of living.

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 19 (KCNA) -- Splendid inauguration ceremonies of regional-industry factories are taking place in the DPRK on a daily basis, adorning the closing days of the year of 2025 full of laughter of the people. Along with them, the residents in Janggang County of Jagang Province, too, are filled with great delight of greeting an affluent and happy new life of socialism.
The inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Janggang County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held on Dec. 18.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the Jagang Provincial People's Committee.
Ju Chang Il addressed the ceremony.
The speaker said that today's auspicious event would be unthinkable without the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who with his noble outlook on life, does not hesitate to go through all sorts of hardships for the people's happiness.
He referred to the fact that thanks to the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Unwho is making ceaseless field guidance for the improvement of the regional people's living standards day and night, the regional-industry factories in Janggang County were completed in the year of their groundbreaking.
He ardently called upon all the people to continue to work hard to bring earlier the bright future of the state, the era of regional efflorescence as soon as possible, upholding the ideology and leadership ofKim Jong Unwith one mind and loyalty.
Pak Won Chol, chief secretary of the Janggang County Committee of the WPK, made a speech.
The speaker said with deep emotion that the present stirring reality showing the start and the completion of projects almost at the same time makes everyone keenly cherish the ardent desire and intention ofKim Jong Unto provide his beloved people with the happiest life and the most wonderful civilization in the world.
He stressed the need to push ahead with the work of building raw material bases to energize the operation of the regional-industry factories and create a more solid asset for the independent development by relying on natural and geographical conditions of the county and mobilizing its economic potentials to the full, and thus turn the county into a richer and more civilized region.
Ju Chang Il cut the inaugural tape, together with working people full of the enthusiasm to glorify their honor as true servants of the people at the new workplaces built under the benevolence of the Party.
Confetti of celebration was set off and balloons soared high in the sky to beautifully decorate the venue of the inauguration ceremony.
Being briefed on the newly-built factories, the participants looked round various production lines.
An art performance reflecting the boundless reverence and praise of all the people for the motherly Party was given, adding to the joy of inauguration.
That evening, fireworks were displayed to adorn beautifully the nocturnal sky of Janggang County, blessing the bright future of its people. -0-

headline: Sungyang Confucian Shrine in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 19 (KCNA) -- Sungyang Confucian Shrine, historical relics in Sonjuk-dong, Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, was rebuilt in 1573 during the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910).
The shrine had been used as a place for giving education and disseminating Confucianism at that time.
Originally it was called Munchung Hall with the pen name of Jong Mong Ju, and since 1575, had been called Sungyang Confucian Shrine.
The shrine has three outer gates surrounded by high rectangular fence. Two buildings stand face to face on the left and right of its yard. There is a lecture hall on the high platform with three stairways in the front.
The hall, with five rooms in front and three rooms in side, stands on 1.6 meters-high platform and has a hip-saddle roof with only eaves. In the middle of the hall, the floor is covered with boards and the rooms on both sides have an under-floor heating system.
The two buildings, used as dormitories of students at that time, are large in size and have gabled roof.
The Sungyang Confucian Shrine still preserves the layout form and architectural structure, typical of a Confucian school in that period. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories in Jangyon County Inaugurated with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 19 (KCNA) -- Edifices symbolic of the era are springing up in different parts of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) to demonstrate its power for great progress toward comprehensive development of socialist construction. The endless laughter of its citizens, excited at this epoch-making transformation, further highlights the truthfulness and vitality of the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).
Regional-industry factories newly built under the Regional Development 20×10 Policy were inaugurated with a splendid ceremony in Jangyon County on Dec. 18.
The venue for the inauguration ceremony were filled with boundless gratitude and absolute trust in the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho opened up a bright prospect for building ideal socialist society, where all the people across the country enjoy new richer, happier and highly civilized life, and is translating it into present reality with his determined efforts.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
They extended the highest respect to the outstanding leader of the revolution and the benevolent father of the people, who is adorning every year on this land with gigantic changes through his days and months filled with his fervent love and devotion for the people.
Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials of South Hwanghae Province and the county, working people and soldier-builders.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.
The speaker warmly congratulated all the citizens in the county on holding a significant ceremony of inaugurating the new light industrial factories assuring them of their hometown's rosy future in the presence ofKim Jong Un, saying that the auspicious season of industrial factories' inauguration for successfully concluding this year, throughout which dynamic regional transformation has been pushed forward, has arrived in Jangyon County, too.
He also extended thanks to the soldier-builders, officials, workers, scientists and technicians in the relevant sector who added a new page of fresh transformation to the sacred history of regional development through an indomitable campaign.
Saying that the strong trend of the great era is rapidly transforming the whole country, he noted that modern hospitals, leisure complexes and other entities of transformation that match those in the capital city are being erected in cities and counties, and it is a remarkable change brought about by the noble intention and untiring efforts ofKim Jong Unto make the people more keenly realize in their daily life the advantages of their state system guided by the people-first principle through thoroughgoing and successful implementation of the regional development strategy.
Recalling thatKim Jong Un, who indicated the concrete orientation, tasks and methodologies for successfully carrying out the gigantic revolutionary undertaking to eliminate the centuries-old backwardness of the regions and realize the cherished desire of the regional citizens, has made sure that the yearly construction processes serve as leaps forward to a higher stage, the speaker said that under his outstanding leadership, one-tenth of the regions came to have the solid foundation for independent development last year and one-fifth of them this year already.
New structures, including a modern hospital and leisure complex, will be built in Jangyon County in the future as part of the efforts for implementing the regional development policy that are expanding year by year, he said, adding that the county should set much store by the assets of high civilization provided by the new era, push ahead with the undertakings for regional development on this basis and thus make more significant progress in improving the living standards of the county citizens.
He ardently called for remaining loyal to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unand waging more dynamic struggle for the steady implementation of the regional development policy and the future of the country which will be highly civilized and prosperous.
Kim Jong Uncut the inaugural tape.
At the venue of the inauguration ceremony, which witnessed the exciting moments to be eternally recorded in the history of the country along with the new era of regional development, fireworks of celebration were let off and a great number of balloons flied up into the sky over the county.
All the participants fervently cheered, so excited to have the great honor of celebrating with splendor the day of inauguration in the presence ofKim Jong Unwhom they have longed to see even in their dreams.
A child presented a bouquet of fragrant flowers toKim Jong Unin reflection of the county citizens' unanimous reverence for him.
Kim Jong Unmet some working people participating in the inauguration ceremony and shook hands with them one by one, warmly wishing them a happy future.
He went round the regional-industry factories.
He said that in the course of undergoing a significant change in the second year for bringing about a radical transformation in the regions and improving the living standards of the people across the country, we further hardened the belief that when we strenuously explore the path toward development and prosperity in our own way and make courageous efforts under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, there will be no unachievable ideal and a socialist paradise can be surely built on this land.
It is the desire of our Party and the primary goal of its regional development policy to turn all cities and counties of the country into self-supporting and well-off ones by firmly consolidating the foundation of regional development and radically improving the material and cultural living standards of the regional people, he added.
Tasting products of the county foodstuff factory, including wheat paste and sauce, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the factory attaches great importance to the quality of products.
Saying it is really spectacular to see the foodstuff factory making products with a local brand through an advanced beer production line, he stressed that it is the correct implementation of the Party policies and the further development to increase the indices of production conducive to improving the material life of the residents in the county with raw materials abundant in the region and bring out excellent products.
Saying that the taste and quality of products depend on the sincerity and skill of producers, he called for compiling the guidelines on the detailed quality indices and standard operation for every process, ranging from the sorting of raw materials to the shipping of products, and establishing a system for strictly observing them. At the same time, it is necessary to organize a brisk competition for developing new products and improving quality among the newly-built regional-industry factories in order to create and improve the atmosphere of advancing and developing all together, he said.
Saying that it is noticeable that progress has been made in a different fashion this year, when compared to last year, in architectural design, technical aspects of construction and indices of products, and that if we make strenuous efforts to attain the far-reaching ideal and high goal, the vitality of the regional development policy will get stronger with each passing year, he clarified some important tasks arising in building regional-industry factories next year and promoting the independence of provinces, cities and counties.
Highly appreciating the steadfast patriotic loyalty of all officers and men of the 124th regiments at different levels of the Korean People's Army, he expressed expectation and belief that they would successfully carry out the further expanded projects for regional development policy on the basis of the potentials and experience they gained through the construction of last year and this year.
Kim Jong Unearnestly asked the officials of Jangyon County and employees of the regional-industry factories to keep the production going at a high rate, mindful that to make the county citizens well off is just meant to live up to the benevolence of the Party.
Seeing the county citizens being pleased with various kinds of condiments, confectionery, daily necessities and clothes with county brands, the leading officials more keenly realized thatKim Jong Un's devoted efforts bring about the happiness of people and hasten the bright future of the prospering country.
The successive inauguration of regional-industry factories, the precious fruition of the people-first politics of the great WPK, is greatly encouraging the people across the country going all out in the patriotic advance for creation toward the glorious Party Congress with firm confidence in their cause and ideal. -0-

Sungyang Confucian Shrine in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 19 (KCNA) -- Sungyang Confucian Shrine, historical relics in Sonjuk-dong, Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, was rebuilt in 1573 during the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910).
The shrine had been used as a place for giving education and disseminating Confucianism at that time.
Originally it was called Munchung Hall with the pen name of Jong Mong Ju, and since 1575, had been called Sungyang Confucian Shrine.
The shrine has three outer gates surrounded by high rectangular fence. Two buildings stand face to face on the left and right of its yard. There is a lecture hall on the high platform with three stairways in the front.
The hall, with five rooms in front and three rooms in side, stands on 1.6 meters-high platform and has a hip-saddle roof with only eaves. In the middle of the hall, the floor is covered with boards and the rooms on both sides have an under-floor heating system.
The two buildings, used as dormitories of students at that time, are large in size and have gabled roof.
The Sungyang Confucian Shrine still preserves the layout form and architectural structure, typical of a Confucian school in that period. -0-

headline: Three-revolution Team Members Make Technological Innovations
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 20 (KCNA) -- The three-revolution team members active in different parts of the DPRK set themselves to research projects of resolving the scientific and technological problems arising in reality, and have conducted a brainstorming campaign to contribute to developing units and increasing production.
The team members active at the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Factory designed rationally a moisture separator, water feeding and blowing systems and dust absorbing process and made the necessary equipment and devices in a short span of time in cooperation with the technical force at the factory to increase the dust-absorbing efficiency. And they devised and applied a panel for controlling automatically the temperature of heat treatment furnace to provide a guarantee for boosting the actual extraction rate of products.
Those active at the Kangso Coal Mine produced grease with waste oil to operate coal-conveying equipment on a regular basis, and invented equipment for spraying concrete mixture with compressed air to save labor and increase work efficiency in slope-pit concreting.
The team members active at the Anbyon Youth Power Station remodeled a device of a hydraulic turbine in order to ensure the safety in operating equipment, carried out a technical innovation task for shortening the date of repairing the generator cooling system and increasing its operation time and thus promoted the growth of production and economic benefits of the unit.
At the South Hwanghae Provincial Tideland Reclamation General Enterprise, the team members increased the blasting efficiency by applying the contrary detonation blasting method.
The team members active at the Chonnaeri Cement Factory, too, conducted a vigorous technological innovation movement to manufacture and install a rational waste gas cleaning apparatus, thus preventing environmental pollution and improving the working conditions of employees. -0-

headline: Stockbreeding Bases Reinforced in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 20 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK is strengthening the material and technological foundations for its stockbreeding bases.
The municipality has ensured that districts and counties carry on in a three-dimensional way the projects to improve the cultural and welfare establishments for working people in the stockbreeding sector and put the raising and caring of domestic animals on a scientific basis and install more pieces of equipment for milk processing and storage.
It organized a demonstration for learning from the experience of the advanced units and generalizing it to actively apply the method of raising and caring young goats with artificial milk.
And it is ensuring that district and county goat farms cultivate sugar cane with high nutritive value and productivity at their limited grazing grounds. -0-

headline: Quality and Productivity Raised at Building Materials Production Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 20 (KCNA) -- Finishing building materials producers in the DPRK are intensifying a technological innovation campaign to boost both the quality and quantity of products. By doing so, they are ensuring the smooth supply of building materials needed for regional construction.
The Rason Building Materials Factory installed a new dust arrester in the shipping process and established an integrated production system, thereby reducing the waste of cement with less manpower and producing building materials in time.
The Rason Recycling Station established a process for recycling waste oil and produced tile releasing agent in order to ensure the quality of cement colored tiles and the gloss degree and compression strength of artificial marbles needed for floor construction with a rational raw material-mixing ratio.
The North Phyongan Provincial General Building-Materials Factory has produced quality furniture and paint to meet the demand of the province, and the Wonsan City Commercial Management Office has made the products with water-proofing and heat resistance with the locally available raw materials.
The Hyesan Essential Plastic Goods Production Station is increasing the productivity of various kinds of plastic goods by strengthening its technical force, and the Kaesong Building-Materials and Daily-Necessities Factory developed mixed colored mortar based on domestic raw materials to make progress in the domestic production of exterior finishing ornament building materials. -0-

headline: Regional-Industry Factories Inaugurated with Splendor in Sinpho City of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 21 (KCNA) -- The great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee is bringing earlier the eye-opening future of the comprehensive development of socialism through the epochal transformation of the whole country. Thanks to its dynamic and powerful leadership ability, a worthy and stirring era unprecedented in the history is being ushered in on this land.
The modern light industrial factories perfectly built this year in Sinpho City of South Hamgyong Province, which witnessed the completion of a new offshore farm last year, greeted the significant moment of their inauguration.
It signifies the establishment of another reliable material foundation, which will contribute to enabling the local people to lead a more affluent life, in the historic place, the venue of a consultative meeting on the development of the regional economy which was recorded as a Changsong Joint Conference of today in the history of the Korean revolution. This striking reality is a successful result of the unique state-building idea and energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is making ceaseless efforts to develop all the cities and counties across the country into the civilized and prosperous regional hubs.
The inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Sinpho City for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held with splendor on December 19.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", in reflection of their great emotion and delight of being honored to have him, the great father of the large family of the whole country who is translating all dreams and ideals of the people into reality of the present times, in their place again.
Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership organ of the Party, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials in South Hamgyong Province and Sinpho City, working people, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.
Saying that the coastal area of the East Sea is also overflowing with joy over the completion of modern regional-industry factories in different parts of the country, which highlights the historic significance of 2025, the year of great transformation, the speaker congratulated the residents in Sinpho City on greeting the moment of glory today again in the wake of the splendid inauguration ceremony of an offshore farm held in the presence ofKim Jong Una year ago.
As witnessed by history, the current transformation is precious fruition of the wise leadership ofKim Jong Unwho indicated the path and ways for Sinpho City to achieve development and prosperity with its own resources and took all measures to do so, he said.
He told in an excited tone about the devoted efforts ofKim Jong Unwho led Sinpho City step by step to turn it into a comprehensive industrial zone capable of making effective use of marine resources, saying that the Party's regional development policy should not go merely for symbolic sake but should be for radically improving the living conditions of the local people and promoting the peculiar development of the regions.
Recalling that 40 cities and counties have already laid the foundation for independent development in the second year as a result of the ongoing accelerated cause of transforming the whole country, he stressed that it is a striking demonstration of the truthfulness, inexhaustible might and bright prospect of our Party's regional development policy set forth and being guided byKim Jong Un.
When we continue to follow the course of bold creation and advance, valuing the precious fruits of the stubborn struggle, our strength will grow stronger and the goal of comprehensive rejuvenation, in which all cities and counties undergo transformation and development in a balanced way, will surely be attained earlier, he said, ardently calling upon all to dedicate themselves to bringing about the prosperity of our beloved motherland, more highly civilized and beautiful life, and a bright future of the rising generations, with their single-minded patriotism.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
The cheers of excitement resounded throughout the venue for the inauguration ceremony and fireworks were set off with many balloons rising up into the sky.
The residents of Sinpho City extended thanks toKim Jong Unfor repeatedly visiting their hometown, leaving the traces of his great guidance, to enable them to enjoy benefits from the regional-industry revolution earlier than others, and for showing his great benevolence for them once again as if it fell short of their expectations.
Lovely children presentedKim Jong Unwith bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the unanimous wishes of the residents.
Kim Jong Unwaved back to the enthusiastically cheering participants and warmly wished the city a bright future when it would be richer along with the history of the steady regional transformation.
He met commanding officers of the unit involved in the construction of the regional-industry factories in Sinpho City and encouraged all the officers and men of the unit who successfully built reliable production bases conducive to improving the regional people's living standards through their vanguard role in ushering in the era of regional transformation.
He went round the Phungo Shop and the Sinpho City Foodstuff Factory.
Looking at the products produced by regional-industry factories, he said that Sinpho City has now reliable potential and strong driving force for its independent development and that the Phungo-dong area has turned into a centre for regional economic development and a powerful base for improving the people's standard of living.
He reaffirmed the will and determination of the WPK to set a higher goal of regional development and further lengthen the stride for progress to unconditionally carry it out without an inch of deflection.
Going round various production rooms of the foodstuff factory, he said that it is important for the regional-industry factories recently built to exchange with each another their experience gained in production and generalize the advantages so as to positively inspire the light industrial production bases across the country to develop together.
He requested the officials of Sinpho City and employees of the regional-industry factories to steadily and persistently push ahead with the work for the normal operation and increased production of the light industrial bases in the spirit of devoted service for the people in order to make sure that the vitality of our Party's policy leads to the promotion of the well-being of the regional people.
Then he visited the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
He learned in detail about its aquiculture and processing process.
He expressed his great satisfaction, seeing every freezing chamber fully loaded with products.
Recollecting with deep emotion the time when he had a consultative meeting on the development of the regional economy in this place, which had only a pine forest and sandy beach in July of 2024, he noted with pleasure that the aquaculture base, which has entered the track of steady development in a matter of one and a half years, produces marine products on a regular basis and the light industrial bases of the city have a strong developmental potential for producing various kinds of processed seafood and daily necessities at their will.
Saying that the vitality of the Party's policy which has proved to be effective in reality makes us to harden our will to go along the road chosen by ourselves to the end with the pride of making a proper decision, he affirmed that our ideal, will and efforts reflected in our every step will surely bring earlier the prosperous future when all the people across the country will lead a happy life together.
He hoped Sinpho City, which is covering the course of development as a model for the cities and counties in the coastal areas of the DPRK, would be well known as a highly civilized and rich city which creates a new history of prosperity with confidence, relying on its independent foundation.
Thanks toKim Jong Un, who regards the people as Heaven and unconditionally subordinates everything to the people's wellbeing, our cause advancing with the most just and far-reaching ambition will be invincible forever and the happy laughter of the people will resound century after century along with the wealth of prosperity rising up across the country. -0-

headline: Press Statement by Director of Institute for Japan Studies under DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 21 (KCNA) -- On December 20, the director of the Institute for Japan Studies under the DPRK Foreign Ministry released the following press statement "The war criminal state Japan's attempt to go nuclear must be prevented at any cost as it will bring mankind a great disaster":
Recently, the new Cabinet of Japan has made extremely dangerous military moves that put the preceding governments into the shade, heightening the vigilance at home and abroad.
The Japanese ruling quarters are openly revealing their ambition to possess nuclear weapons, going beyond the red line for a war criminal state, while drastically revising their military security policies as evidenced by the strengthening of the preemptive-attack capability aimed at turning itself into a war state, the easing of arms export restrictions and the reexamination of the " three principles of denuclearization".
Shortly ago, a high-ranking official of the Japanese government unhesitatingly made very provocative remarks that Japan should possess nuclear weapons, talking about the security environment around Japan getting more serious and necessity for bolstering up its own deterrent.
This is not a misstatement or a reckless assertion, but clearly reflects Japan's long-cherished ambition for nuclear armament. It constitutes an open challenge to Japan's Constitution as well as all the international laws stipulating the duties of a defeated nation.
Such reckless remarks made by a high-ranking official in charge of recommending security policies to the government prove that the Japanese political circle is trying hard to possess nuclear weapons, and clearly show Japan's bellicose and aggressive nature.
It is a common perception of the international community that Japan, which started the research on and development of nuclear weapons in strict secrecy during the Second World War, has secretly laid the foundations for possessing the ability to manufacture nuclear weapons at any time after its defeat, and that what left is only its political decision.
As already known, availing itself of the situation of Ukraine, Japan has persistently sought the possibility and way of possessing nuclear weapons by raising the theory of sharing nuclear weapons calling for deploying U.S. nuclear weapons in it to jointly employ them and trying to join AUKUS, a nuclear alliance of Anglo-Saxon countries.
When it was reported that the U.S. allowed the ROK to possess a nuclear submarine, the chief Cabinet secretary, the minister of Defence and other high-ranking government officials of Japan immediately began to openly talk about the need to possess a nuclear-powered submarine which has been prohibited.
All facts go to prove that the Japanese authorities are scheming to pave the way for nuclear armament while examining the reaction of public opinion at home and abroad to their ambition for nuclear possession and misleading the public to get used to it gradually.
Japan is just a rogue state capable of arming itself with nuclear weapons and igniting another war of aggression once occasion comes, and Japan's true purpose of crying out about the threats from neighboring countries is to justify its moves to become a military giant with nuclear armament as its ultimate goal.
The shameless double-faced act of Japan, who openly talks about the world without nuclear weapons under the signboard of the world's only atomic-bombed country and works hard to go nuclear behind the scenes, is the greatest threat to be rejected by the international community with vigilance and a reckless act of evoking serious concern among regional countries.
The history of aggression of Japan clearly proves that in case Japan, a war criminal state, possesses even nuclear weapons, Asian countries will suffer a horrible nuclear disaster and mankind will face a great disaster.
The progressive mankind loving justice and peace should resolutely check the dangerous military acts of Japan, a war criminal state which is rushing toward nuclear armament with the backing of the U.S., denying its crime-woven history. -0-

headline: Scientific Afforestation in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 22 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK has made progress in the project for raising the level of scientific afforestation.
The province applied phytosin to transplanting saplings and large trees to increase the rate of rooting of planted trees.
It established a system for supplying cities and counties with various kinds of physiological activators and nutritive accelerants and made the masses understand the scientific and technological problems arising in their use.
The provincial forest science institute paid attention to concluding more than 10 scientific research tasks, including studying the method of raising new good species of saplings.

headline: House-Moving Ceremonies at Majon and Naeho Farms in Hamhung City and Paeksang Farm in Pujon County of South Hamgyong Province
Traditional Customs of Korean People
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 22 (KCNA) -- Today is the winter solstice.
From olden times the Korean people have called November in the Lunar calendar the 11th lunar month and the day with the longest nighttime and the shortest daytime in the month the winter solstice.
And they have considered the winter solstice as the beginning of the year as the daytime starts to get longer after it.
Ancient books such as Samguksagi (Chronicles of the Three Kingdoms) written in 1145 and the history of Koryo Dynasty in 1451 suggest that the winter solstice, one of the 24 seasonal divisions, had been celebrated as the traditional folk holiday in Korea from long ago.
The winter solstice is famous for the peculiar dish adzuki-bean gruel taken on the day. The Korean people had recollected the outgoing year and promoted harmony with neighbors taking the gruel on the winter solstice.
The adzuki-bean gruel is made by boiling adzuki-bean well and adding rice and much water to boil again. The gruel with small round lumps made of glutinous rice flour was a special dish for the season as it was nutritious and easy of digestion.
ChairmanKim Jong Il, who valued the beautiful manners and customs peculiar to our people, informed the officials on several occasions of the customs on the winter solstice and the method of making adzuki-bean gruel and led them to preserve the folk traditions including the customs on adzuki-bean gruel taken on the winter solstice. He also took measures to supply raw materials to the restaurants so that they can serve adzuki-bean gruel on the winter solstice.
The customs on adzuki-bean gruel taken on the winter solstice, which are still carried on by the people, was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2016. -0-

Okjon and Kanggye secondary schools No. 1 intensify practical education, attaching importance to developing students' proactive and creative thinking and activities. -0-
