headline: New Hotels Inaugurated in Samjiyon Tourist Resort of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 23 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the direct initiative and energetic leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, modern hotels have been newly built and inaugurated in Samjiyon City, whose attractive appearance undergoes a better transformation as a typical mountainous city in the northern part of the DPRK and a unique all-season mountainous tourist resort.
The hotels, built to exhibit special architectural beauty and provide peculiar service in good harmony with the magnificence of nature in the Mt Paektu area, along with the symbolic names peculiar to the Samjiyon area such as Sobaeksu, Ikal, Potnamu and Chongbong, are the proud creations of our era when a new phase has been opened up in building public service centres in all aspects of contents and forms.
Inauguration ceremonies of five hotels newly built in the Samjiyon Tourist Resort took place on December 20 and 21.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the inauguration ceremony of the Ikal and Milyong hotels on Dec. 20.
When he arrived, all the participants raised stormy cheers as a token of their great reverence for him who is bringing earlier the rosy future of Korean-style socialism with his untiring thought and devotion out of his fervent desire to make our people the most dignified who have nothing to envy in the world.
Present at the ceremonies were officials of ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, officials in Samjiyon City and employees of the hotels.
Speeches were made at the ceremonies.
Referring to the painstaking efforts made byKim Jong Unto bring about a great transformation in the Paektu area, where beautiful scenes, indescribable with the mysterious sceneries of nature only, are being witnessed, the speakers said that the hotels are the meaningful creations heralding the emergence of a large tourist zone covering Mt Paektu, Mt Pukphothae and Mt Namphothae.
Expressing belief that Samjiyon City will soon be renowned as an attractive mountainous tourist resort and leisure ground for the people, they declared the completion of the hotels.
Ceremonial services were given to commemorate the inauguration of the hotels.
Kim Jong Un, together with the participants, went round the hotels.
Going round bedrooms of hotels, cosy leisure spaces and commercial and public catering facilities, he appreciated that all elements are at a high level in terms of practicality, diversity and formative art to preserve their own attractiveness.
He said that he was pleased to see such wonderful public service facilities built in Samjiyon City.
Referring to the importance of the hotels' position and role in creating the culture of tourism in the country and promoting tourism, he said that service facilities are important in developing tourism, but the main thing is the quality of service. He called for directing primary efforts to improving the service capacity and professional qualifications of service workers in hotels.
To this end, it arises as an essential requirement to further expand and strengthen the national system of training professional service workers, he said, stressing the need to proactively develop new service industries capable of fully satisfying the customers' different demands.
He expressed his unshakable will to turn Samjiyon City better into an innovative and highly civilized city representing the tourism culture of the country, noting that to build the entities of modern civilization in tourist attractions on a large scale, along with the on-going new history of radical development and transformation in different parts of the capital and the regions, is just a clear proof of the ever-growing ideal of our people and our state's potential for development.
Expressing expectation and belief that the officials and employees of the hotels would achieve successes in their work, he wished the hotels prosperity.
Inauguration ceremonies of the Sobaeksu Hotel, Chongbong Hotel and the Potnamu Hotel took place on December 21.
The participants in the ceremonies went round smart rooms satisfying various tastes of guests, different service facilities providing abundant cultural living environments, indoor and outdoor spas arousing sweet feelings and fresh vitality in all seasons and other parts of the hotels.
They deeply realized the eye-opening reality of the country which is undergoing transformation with each passing year thanks to the noble intention and determined efforts ofKim Jong Un, who is absolutely subordinating everything to the sake of the people, and the new vibrant civilization coming closer to the people's life.
The completion of modern hotels demonstrating the dynamic changes in Samjiyon City vividly shows the high spirit of our state, which is advancing steadily toward a high stage of comprehensive prosperity and development under the great leadership ofKim Jong Un, and the bright prospect of the Mt Paektu area which will shine more brilliantly as a world-renowned scenic spot. -0-

headline: Yearly Economic Plan Fulfilled at Sunchon Cement Complex
story_text:

headline: Advanced Technology of Heat Treatment Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 24 (KCNA) -- Scientists ofKim Il SungUniversity in the DPRK have developed in a Korean way advanced technology of heat treatment urgently needed in the machine-building industry.
This new technique using medium-frequency and high-frequency current at the same time in one inductor makes it possible to produce high-quality gears with ordinary carbon steel. It can also drastically reduce the production cost, power consumption and manpower and increase productivity more than twice, causing no environmental pollution.
The new technology is drawing attention of experts as it can improve the quality of various kinds of machine parts including gears. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories and Leisure Complex Inaugurated with Splendour in Jongphyong County
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- Now that the whole country is pulsating with excitement at great transformation and fresh hope, an inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex, newly built in Jongphyong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, took place with splendour on December 24.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue for the ceremony, the participants raised deafening cheers with reverence for the great leader of the people.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a report on the completion of the project from the commanding officer of the military unit involved in the construction of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex in the county.
Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership body of the WPK, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province and Jongphyong County, soldier-builders and employees of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.
Saying the joy of great transformation in the new era of regional construction has also come to Jongphyong County, the speaker warmly congratulated the county citizens on the better life and new culture they will lead with the inauguration of modern regional-industry factories and leisure complex.
Thanks to the noble intention and sincerity of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unthat the people's wish is the wish of the Party and the struggle for bringing wellbeing earlier to the people should be intensified nonstop, the construction of regional light industrial factories, the level of which are as good as those in the capital city, has been pushed forward at the state expense, and the regional-industry factories, which are more advanced than those built last year, have appeared in 20 cities and counties across the country, he said.
He noted that the leisure complex in the county is a valuable creation embodying the high intention ofKim Jong Unto bring about a sure change in the cultural progress of the regions by providing the conditions for enjoying advanced civilization not only in material life but also in all aspects of mental and cultural life.
The speaker expressed belief that the officers and men of the construction units, who successfully built the regional-industry factories and leisure complex in Jongphyong County in the high revolutionary spirit peculiar to the People's Army remaining absolutely loyal to the order of the Party and earnest in fulfilling its desire, would perform brilliant feats in every site of the further expanded regional construction under the uplifted glorious colors of theirs.
Kim Jong Ununveiled the monument to the inauguration of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex.
Lovely children presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the unanimous gratitude of the county citizens.
Kim Jong Unmet some working people in the county and commanding officers of the construction units who participated in the inauguration ceremony, and shook hands with them one by one as a token of his warm encouragement.
He went round the leisure complex.
Going round various parts of the library and the general commercial district, he stressed the need to run and manage the complex effectively as befitting its characteristics as a public leisure centre for improving the regional cultures of life, study and commerce and training the regional citizens to be pioneers and creators of new culture.
Saying that the true significance of the regional revolution lies in raising the people's ideological consciousness and cultural level to the one corresponding to the new era and continuously setting higher goals and levels of creation, he clarified a series of tasks related to the next year's construction of leisure complexes in 20 cities and counties.
Then he visited the regional-industry factories.
There was an inauguration ceremony.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
He visited the Jongphyong County Foodstuff Factory.
When deciding on the Regional Development 20×10 Policy,  there were certainly some individuals being skeptical about its implementation even among cadres as the plan for regional development was largest ever in its scale, but not only those cadres but also all our people are now convinced of the validity of the Party policy, practical power for its implementation and its bright future, witnessing the domains of construction further expanding with each passing year and the inauguration season which has come without fail this year like last year.
He said that the popular masses' deeper trust in the Party and absolute confidence in its policy are, indeed, the greatest success registered in the struggle of two years for bringing about fundamental changes in the regions.
He earnestly requested the officials and employees of the regional-industry factories to regard the people's demands and evaluation as an absolute criterion and conduct management and operation in a responsible manner so as to keep the production going at a high rate.
He sincerely hoped that the new leisure complex and regional-industry factories in the county would make a substantial contribution to the economic development of the county and improvement of the living standards of its citizens. -0-

headline: New Houses Built at Farms in North Phyongan Province
Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on December 24:
Recently, the U.S. is getting more undisguised in its attempt to permanently fix a grave nuclear instability element in the security environment of the DPRK.
A nuclear attack submarine of the U.S. Navy entered the Pusan operation base of the ROK on Dec. 23, under the pretext of its crew members' rest and replenishment of munitions.
The repeated emergence of the U.S. strategic asset 46 days after the entry of the nuclear carrier George Washington strike group belonging to the U.S. Seventh Fleet into the ROK on November 7 constitutes a grave act of causing instability and escalating military tensions in the Korean peninsula and the region.
The U.S. reaffirmed its commitment to offering the ROK "extended deterrence" by mobilizing all defence forces including nuclear weapons at the fifth U.S.-ROK "nuclear consultative group" meeting recently held in Washington. Worse still, it has given the green light to the ROK's development of nuclear submarine and is frequently deploying its nuclear submarines there. Clear is what this fact hints at against the regional security structure.
This is a warning that the U.S. is getting closer to the critical level in its attempt to gain strategic advantage in the region by making its military alliance with the ROK more surely evolve into a nuclear confrontation bloc sharing its nuclear weapons.
Given that the U.S. confrontational intention to cement the structure of a nuclear-to-nuclear collision with the DPRK has been confirmed once again, the DPRK remains unchanged in its practical will to strongly propel the development of the defence capabilities for ensuring its prospective interests and defending security at present and in the future.
Nothing will change no matter how frequently the U.S. brings its nuclear submarine to highlight the visibility of its nuclear attack forces.
The U.S. nuclear threat that persists in the vicinity of our state is pushing us into securing earlier the strategic retaliatory capability for wiping out such threatening entities within the scope of our maritime sovereignty.
We will consider countermeasures corresponding to the U.S. nuclear muscle flexing, according to the doctrine of mutual containment between nuclear weapons states, and the way and time of their implementation will be chosen on the principle of symmetry and asymmetry. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Dec. 18.
The message said:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my wholehearted congratulations to you on the occasion of the New Year.
The past one year was of special significance in the relationship between Moscow and Pyongyang.
The heroic entry of soldiers of the Korean People's Army into the battles for liberating the Kursk region from occupiers and the subsequent activities of Korean engineers in the land of Russia clearly proved the invincible friendship and militant fraternity between the Russian Federation and the DPRK.
What is important is that the provisions of the historic treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership have been fulfilled in a planned way thanks to our joint efforts.
This has contributed to expanding remarkably the productive, bilateral cooperation in political, trade, economic, human and other fields.
I am convinced that we will in the future, too, strengthen the relations of friendship and alliance in every way and conduct constructive cooperation on regional and international issues.
This will undoubtedly accord with the fundamental interests of the peoples of our two countries and contribute to establishing a just order of the multi-polar world.
I wish you and your friends good health, wellbeing and successes, and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and prosperity.
Yours sincerely. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Message of Greeting from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Dec. 18.
The message said:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my wholehearted congratulations to you on the occasion of the New Year.
The past one year was of special significance in the relationship between Moscow and Pyongyang.
The heroic entry of soldiers of the Korean People's Army into the battles for liberating the Kursk region from occupiers and the subsequent activities of Korean engineers in the land of Russia clearly proved the invincible friendship and militant fraternity between the Russian Federation and the DPRK.
What is important is that the provisions of the historic treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership have been fulfilled in a planned way thanks to our joint efforts.
This has contributed to expanding remarkably the productive, bilateral cooperation in political, trade, economic, human and other fields.
I am convinced that we will in the future, too, strengthen the relations of friendship and alliance in every way and conduct constructive cooperation on regional and international issues.
This will undoubtedly accord with the fundamental interests of the peoples of our two countries and contribute to establishing a just order of the multi-polar world.
I wish you and your friends good health, wellbeing and successes, and all the citizens of the DPRK happiness and prosperity.
Yours sincerely. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Consumer Goods in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of consumer goods took place at the Sariwon Indoor Stadium, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, according to Minju Joson.
Presented to the exhibition were a lot of products manufactured in cities and counties and at the provincial-level factories.
Favored by the participants were bean paste, sesame pepper paste, shampoo and rinse presented by regional-industry factories in Unpha and Yonthan counties.
Consumer goods presented by Sohung and Sinphyong counties were appreciated by the visitors for their unique and peculiar brand designs.
Suan and Yonsan counties also established new oil refining processes to improve the quality of edible oil and increased the variety of foodstuffs.
Rinsan County-made products drew the attention of participants for their effective use of the regional features and resources.
Also presented to the exhibition were wine made by the Sariwon Winery, various kinds of plastic goods by the Sariwon Aeguk Essential Plastic Goods Factory and shoes by the Sariwon Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Building of Nuclear-powered Strategic Guided Missile Submarine
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the building of an 8 700-tonnage nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine on the spot.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by leading officials in the sectors of the warship-building industry and the defence science research and production.
Kim Jong Unwent round the site of building the nuclear-powered submarine and received a report on its progress.
Workers, scientists and technicians in the warship-building field, all out in the glorious struggle for implementing the WPK's policy of modernizing the navy, are pushing ahead with the building of a strategic nuclear attack submarine, one of the five-point major tasks for developing the defence capabilities set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK, by fully displaying the great power of self-reliance and inexhaustible patriotic enthusiasm.
Kim Jong Unstressed once again the importance and significance of building a strategic nuclear attack submarine in carrying out the self-reliant defence policy of the WPK and the government of the DPRK.
Noting that our defence policy is literally a defensive policy based on the strongest offensive power, he said that to this end, we regard the super-powerful offensive capability as the best shield for national security in developing the armed forces.
Saying that it is the noble mission and duty of the current generation to further strengthen the nuclear shield that represents the prestige and honour of the DPRK and absolutely guarantees its security and to consolidate the irreversible position, he stressed that the WPK and the government of the DPRK will remain unchanged in their determination to permanently ensure the peaceful environment and absolute security of the country by composing the nuclear forces that the enemy can't help fearing.
We have built in every way the nuclear shield capable of reliably defending our national security and secured the capability for expanding it to the extent necessary for ensuring the national security environment, he said, adding that the completion of a new nuclear submarine will serve as an epoch-making crucial change that further assures ourselves and even the enemy of the war deterrent level the DPRK has reached. He clarified the steadfast will and the strategic and tactical policy to steadily push forward with the nuclear weaponization of the navy.
The Party Central Committee is pleased to see the warship-building sector achieving signal production successes, true to the WPK's line of building up the naval force in the new century, he said, adding that the strategic nuclear attack submarine to be considered as an important component of the nuclear war deterrent will constitute the greatest immortal feats of the working class, defence scientists and technicians, the driving force of the DPRK, for the times and history.
He affirmed that the present world is by no means peaceful and such situation and the prospective threats to be posed highlight undoubtedly the decision made by the DPRK with regard to the future security of the country as the most just option and the manifestation of its will to safeguard its sovereignty and interests in a responsible manner.
Saying that the nuclear submarine development plan of the ROK, which Washington has agreed on at the solicitation of Seoul recently, will worsen the instability in the region of the Korean peninsula, he stressed that the DPRK regards it as an offensive act severely violating its security and maritime sovereignty and a threat to its security that must be countered.
Given the negative security situation that has come as present reality only, it is an urgent task and indispensable option to further accelerate the radical development of the modernization and nuclear weaponization of the naval force of the DPRK, he said.
Attack destroyers and nuclear submarines recently under construction will make a leap forward in bolstering up the combat capabilities of our fleets and contribute to defending the strategic sovereignty and security of our country, he said, adding that the DPRK will develop the navy and its strategic components in a constant and diverse way, steadily increase and expand the speed and scale of building various surface and underwater warships and continuously equip them with different offensive weapon systems.
Noting that the WPK and the DPRK government will stay definitely unchanged in their national security policy and their principle of deterring the enemy, he said it is needed to make the enemy understand with no doubt that they will be surely forced to pay a dear price when they violate the security of the DPRK's strategic sovereignty and that they will face a merciless retaliatory attack if they try to select a military option. The DPRK will continue to show such capabilities and this goes just as the responsible exercise of the true nuclear war deterrent and a reliable shield for defending sovereignty, he added.
That day, he learned in detail about the on-going research on the new underwater secret weapons under development and clarified a strategic plan for reorganizing the naval forces and establishing new units. -0-

headline: Successes at Western Maritime Research Institute
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- The Western Maritime Research Institute under the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration in the DPRK intensifies the researches for developing and using marine resources, according to Minju Joson.
This year the institute carried out basic research tasks for ensuring the scientific accuracy, correctness and promptness of marine forecast at a high level and using marine energy in the West Sea of Korea. And it developed and introduced application programs while building up marine research data to step up the tideland reclamation.
It also completed a research on the method of evaluating the sedimentation in the downstream of the West Sea Barrage to make contribution to establishing a scientific and technological plan for ensuring the normal operation of the West Sea Barrage and the surrounding marine ecological environment. And it carried out a marine research task for installing and using underwater structures to contribute to building offshore structures.
Meanwhile, it fulfilled various marine research projects of great national significance, including the research for accurately predicting marine disasters, putting marine activities on a scientific basis and improving the work for protecting marine ecological environment and the research for solving the basic problems arising in putting the buoy observation on a scientific basis.
The institute is putting spurs to the marine scientific research conducive to the economic development of the country and the improvement of people's living standards, including the research for establishing a marine forecast system in the waters off the offshore farms in the West Sea and the research for estimating the tidal current power and marine wind energy resource. -0-

Successes at Western Maritime Research Institute
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- The Western Maritime Research Institute under the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration in the DPRK intensifies the researches for developing and using marine resources, according to Minju Joson.
This year the institute carried out basic research tasks for ensuring the scientific accuracy, correctness and promptness of marine forecast at a high level and using marine energy in the West Sea of Korea. And it developed and introduced application programs while building up marine research data to step up the tideland reclamation.
It also completed a research on the method of evaluating the sedimentation in the downstream of the West Sea Barrage to make contribution to establishing a scientific and technological plan for ensuring the normal operation of the West Sea Barrage and the surrounding marine ecological environment. And it carried out a marine research task for installing and using underwater structures to contribute to building offshore structures.
Meanwhile, it fulfilled various marine research projects of great national significance, including the research for accurately predicting marine disasters, putting marine activities on a scientific basis and improving the work for protecting marine ecological environment and the research for solving the basic problems arising in putting the buoy observation on a scientific basis.
The institute is putting spurs to the marine scientific research conducive to the economic development of the country and the improvement of people's living standards, including the research for establishing a marine forecast system in the waters off the offshore farms in the West Sea and the research for estimating the tidal current power and marine wind energy resource. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprises
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited major munitions industry enterprises to acquaint himself with the missile and shell production in the fourth quarter of this year.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, leading officials in the defence science research field and managers of major munitions industry enterprises.
Kim Jong Unreceived a report on the achievements of the missile and shell production sector in 2025 and the production in the fourth quarter.
He underlined the need to work out the production plan for 2026 in a development-oriented way to meet the prospective requirements in the operation of the state missile and artillery forces. Saying to that end, it is necessary to reinforce the technical foundations of the relevant production enterprises in a balanced way to further expand the overall production capacity, he clarified the technical and economic tasks for doing so.
He highly appreciated that major munitions industry enterprises successfully fulfilled their production plans for 2025, the last year for implementing the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK, and made a pivotal and core contribution to implementing the plan for developing the defence capabilities in the period under review.
In order to satisfy the prospective demands of the missile and artillery forces of the Korean People's Army, it is necessary to continuously raise the level of modernization of the munitions industry by establishing new munitions industry enterprises as planned, the construction of which will be decided on at the 9th Congress of the WPK, and steadily updating the production structure of the existing factories in a more efficient and practical way, he said.
Saying that in particular, the missile and shell production sector is of paramount importance in bolstering up the war deterrent, he stressed that the Missile Administration of the DPRK and the relevant general bureau of the Second Economy Commission should make thorough preparations for unconditionally accepting and carrying out in a responsible manner the new modernization and production plans to be set forth at the 9th Congress of the WPK.
That day, he ratified the draft documents for modernization plan of major munitions industry enterprises to be submitted to the 9th Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Message of Greeting to Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on Dec. 27.
The message said:
Dear my comrade,
On behalf of the government of the DPRK and the Korean people, I extend the warmest and sincerest greeting of best wishes to you and, through you, to the government of the Russian Federation and the fraternal Russian people on the occasion of the New Year 2026.
The year 2025, filled with immortal events to be eternally recorded in the history of the relations between the two countries, was a really meaningful year when the two countries steadily wrote a great biography of the alliance in the new era through full mutual support and selfless encouragement in the grand course for carrying out the common sacred cause.
Along with the past days of 2025, the DPRK-Russia relations have been further consolidated into the sincerest alliance of sharing blood, life and death in the same trench, and their absolute solidity and mightiness have been more vividly etched in the pages of the times and history.
Now no one can break the relations between the peoples of the two countries and their unity, supported firmly by embodiment of the strong will and strength to defend the just aspirations of the times and set right history.
Dear Comrade Vladimir Putin,
I think that today's DPRK-Russia alliance, whose peculiar invincibility and might has been verified most thoroughly in the grave tempest of history, is a precious common asset to be carried forward forever not only in the present era but also by posterity generation after generation.
I have always felt boundless pride in creating and writing the great history of the DPRK-Russia relations, the long-term DPRK-Russia friendship, together with you, my dearest friend, and I am always very impressed with it.
Respected Comrade Putin,
Justice and truth, victory and glory will always stand by you and your Russia.
I affirm once again that I, the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and all the Korean people will always be with the fraternal Russian people.
I sincerely wish you, Comrade President Putin, good health and greater success in your responsible work for defending the dignity and interests of Russia on the occasion of the hopeful New Year 2026.
I sincerely hope that only happiness and prosperity will be in store for the Russian people. -0-

headline: Revolutionary and Popular Constitution of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the significant Constitution Day, the people in the DPRK recollect with deep emotion the immortal exploits PresidentKim Il Sungperformed by providing the socialist political charter of the Juche type that entirely serves the people.
The President enacted and enforced the first people's democratic constitution in the liberated country by applying the Juche-oriented legislative tradition he created during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and energetically led the work for drafting a new constitution in the 1970s.
He taught officials the orientation and ways for enacting a new constitution and refined every article and phrase of the draft constitution.
Thanks to his meticulous care, the Constitution of the DPRK was adopted at the First Session of the Fifth Supreme People's Assembly on December 27, 1972.
The enactment of the revolutionary and popular Constitution of the DPRK provided a legal guarantee for firmly defending our people-centred state and social system and gave our people with a powerful legal weapon for further accelerating the revolution and construction.
The Korean people are displaying the high spirit of law observance with the awareness that to abide by the DPRK laws is precisely the way for defending their interests and happiness and socialism. -0-

DPRK Papers Mark Constitution Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Saturday observes the Constitution Day.
The Constitution of the DPRK is the most popular one as it was enacted with the people's demands and interests as absolute standards and it grants genuine freedom and rights to the people and legally ensures the conditions for their substantial realization, says Rodong Sinmun in an article.
It continues:
There are many countries in the world and they have their own constitutions, but there is no such code of laws as the DPRK Constitution that pushes forward with the state building and social development under the absolute support of all the people.
The DPRK Constitution is a firm guideline guaranteeing the dignity and independent development of the state.
It specifies the successes achieved in our own way and by our own efforts in the revolution and construction and also comprehensively legalizes the state's independent policies for the political, economic, cultural and defence fields.
The DPRK Constitution is a powerful weapon for protecting and ensuring the rights, interests and happiness of the people.
It stipulates the principles for substantially giving all the people the position and role as masters of everything, and for providing them with all kinds of welfare.
Today it is steadily being amended and supplemented to fully conform with the people's interests.
The DPRK Constitution is lifeline to the state building and the precious wealth of all the citizens as it regards the people as the dearest, serves them thoroughly and ensures that the independent stand and socialist principles are fully embodied in state building.
Minju Joson in an editorial says that it is a high pride of the DPRK people to have the Constitution, the Juche-oriented political charter and code of the people firmly guaranteeing the prosperity and eternal future of our great state. -0-

headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories Held in Yomju County
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- In Yomju County, the northwestern coastal area of the DPRK, modern regional-industry factories have been built as a solid foundation for improving the people's standard of living.
An inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories in Yomju County was held with splendor on Dec. 26.
Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, officials and working people in North Phyongan Province and Yomju County and employees of regional-industry factories and officers and men of the construction regiment.
Choe Ryong Hae addressed the ceremony.
The speaker warmly congratulated the county people on celebrating the inauguration of the new factories while picturing the future of their hometown to be more civilized and richer.
He referred to the energetic guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has worked heart and soul to ensure that the projects for building regional-industry factories make fresher progress in all aspects than last year, including design and construction, and successfully complete them in the year when their construction began.
He called for advancing with greater confidence for the overall prosperity of the great state and the implementation of the Party's policy on regional development.
In his speech, Kim Hyon Chol, chief secretary of the Yomju County Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, extended deep gratitude to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who has always worked heart and soul to lead the historic groundbreaking ceremony to the inauguration ceremony of joy, shouldering all burdens so as to realize the regional people's long-cherished desires.
He expressed the resolution to steadily boost the quality of products, strengthen the material and technical foundations of raw material bases, train more technicians and skilled workers and make proactive efforts for optimizing the effective development and use of the economic resources and potential peculiar to the region so as to prove in practice the validity and vitality of the Party's regional development policy.
Choe Ryong Hae, together with the masters of the new workplaces, cut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were let off with many balloons rising up into the sky.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the foodstuff factory, garment factory, daily necessities factory and seafood processing factory, equipped with modern production lines.
An art performance was given to celebrate the inauguration of regional-industry factories in the county.
That evening, fireworks were displayed in the nocturnal sky over the county. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on December 20.

The closing year of 2025 was a year of consolidating the trend of steady development of the relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea which have reached the level of comprehensive strategic partnership, the message said and went on:

headline: Revolutionary and Popular Constitution of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the significant Constitution Day, the people in the DPRK recollect with deep emotion the immortal exploits PresidentKim Il Sungperformed by providing the socialist political charter of the Juche type that entirely serves the people.
The President enacted and enforced the first people's democratic constitution in the liberated country by applying the Juche-oriented legislative tradition he created during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, and energetically led the work for drafting a new constitution in the 1970s.
He taught officials the orientation and ways for enacting a new constitution and refined every article and phrase of the draft constitution.
Thanks to his meticulous care, the Constitution of the DPRK was adopted at the First Session of the Fifth Supreme People's Assembly on December 27, 1972.
The enactment of the revolutionary and popular Constitution of the DPRK provided a legal guarantee for firmly defending our people-centred state and social system and gave our people with a powerful legal weapon for further accelerating the revolution and construction.
The Korean people are displaying the high spirit of law observance with the awareness that to abide by the DPRK laws is precisely the way for defending their interests and happiness and socialism. -0-

headline: DPRK Papers Mark Constitution Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 27 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Saturday observes the Constitution Day.
The Constitution of the DPRK is the most popular one as it was enacted with the people's demands and interests as absolute standards and it grants genuine freedom and rights to the people and legally ensures the conditions for their substantial realization, says Rodong Sinmun in an article.
It continues:
There are many countries in the world and they have their own constitutions, but there is no such code of laws as the DPRK Constitution that pushes forward with the state building and social development under the absolute support of all the people.
The DPRK Constitution is a firm guideline guaranteeing the dignity and independent development of the state.
It specifies the successes achieved in our own way and by our own efforts in the revolution and construction and also comprehensively legalizes the state's independent policies for the political, economic, cultural and defence fields.
The DPRK Constitution is a powerful weapon for protecting and ensuring the rights, interests and happiness of the people.
It stipulates the principles for substantially giving all the people the position and role as masters of everything, and for providing them with all kinds of welfare.
Today it is steadily being amended and supplemented to fully conform with the people's interests.
The DPRK Constitution is lifeline to the state building and the precious wealth of all the citizens as it regards the people as the dearest, serves them thoroughly and ensures that the independent stand and socialist principles are fully embodied in state building.
Minju Joson in an editorial says that it is a high pride of the DPRK people to have the Constitution, the Juche-oriented political charter and code of the people firmly guaranteeing the prosperity and eternal future of our great state. -0-

headline: DPRK's Manwoldae - Part of World Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- Manwoldae, located at the southern foot of Mt Songak in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, is the site of the royal palace in the period of Koryo dynasty.
Koryo, founded in 918, built a large royal palace there in the following year.
The palace has a floor space of 1 250 000 square meters, and Kungsong covers an area of about 390 000 square meters.
Kungsong had king's palaces and Hwangsong central office buildings.
The main gate of Hwangsong was Kwanghwamun in the east, and there were Thaehwa Gate and Jangchu Gate in the north, Yongchu Gate in the west and Jujak Gate in the south. The main gate of Kungsong was Sungphyong Gate in the south.
Manwoldae is a valuable part of cultural heritage of the DPRK as it shows the creative talents and wisdom of the people of Koryo which inherited Koguryo through the size and layout of the royal palace, the plane structure of buildings and building materials. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: National Flag-raising and Oath-taking Ceremony Held to Mark Constitution Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- A national flag-raising and oath-taking ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Dec. 27 to mark Constitution Day of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, amid the struggle of the year 2025 for the country's comprehensive prosperity and development which has resulted in signal successes and patriotic enthusiasm of all the people remarkably soaring to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the one of victory and glory.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the commemorative event.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee, senior officials of the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, officials of judicial and public prosecutors offices and those of power organs in Pyongyang Municipality.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the venue for the commemorative ceremony.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK took place.
Members of the guard of honor of the KPA solemnly escorted the national flag of the DPRK to the venue for the ceremony.
All the participants paid high tribute to the national flag associated with the history of heroic struggle and the brave spirit of Juche Korea, which has firmly defended the dignity and honour of the country and the people and brought about the era of great changes by holding fast to the genuine people's code, the great political constitution, as a powerful weapon for the state development and invariably embodying its noble principles and ideals.
The glorious national flag was hoisted.
The venue was full of ardent desire to devote all wisdom and enthusiasm to the glorious and worthwhile struggle for the prosperity of the country in the stirring era when the great ambition and strong aspiration to lead the whole world by dint of the iron will fostered by the truth are being translated into reality.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a commemorative oath to mark Constitution Day of the DPRK.
Led by the head of state, the participants solemnly vowed before the national flag to dedicate themselves to glorifying forever the greatness and beauty of the country by always remaining faithful to promoting the people's well-being and the growth and development of the state, thoroughly defending the Constitution of the Republic, strictly carrying on their legal obligations, firmly defending the socialist ideal and system and staying faithful to the beloved motherland as responsible members who defend the sovereignty of the DPRK and the interests of the Korean people and serve the state and the people.
All the participants were full of enthusiasm to fully discharge their responsibility and duty entrusted by the people on the forefront of implementing the historic sacred cause so as to legally and firmly guarantee the comprehensive rejuvenation and development of our state by applying the original idea of the great ComradeKim Jong Unon establishing the people-first law and to consolidate the country into a socialist paradise, where the ideal of the people has been realized, and into an invincible fortress that no one in the world dares provoke. -0-

headline: Energy-saving Sugar Solution Concentration Technology Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- The Vinalon Institute under the Hamhung Branch of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK developed a new energy-saving technology for concentrating sugar solution, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Thanks to the introduction of this advanced concentration technology, the sugar solution production line has been turned into an energy-saving one, making it possible to save a lot of electricity and improve the productivity and quality of products.
The institute is now pushing ahead with a project to apply the said technology of our own style to the production lines at regional-industry factories. -0-

headline: DPRK Weightlifters Return Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- DPRK players returned home on Saturday after taking part in the Qatar International Weightlifting Cup 2025.
They bagged 18 gold medals and set three new world records in it.
O Kwang Ok won three gold medals in the women's 58kg category, with 105kg in snatch, 133kg in clean and jerk (new world record) and 238kg in total (new world record).
Ri Chong Song lifted 162kg in snatch, 204kg in clean and jerk and 366kg in total (new world record) in the men's 79kg category, clinching three gold medals.
Kim Hyok Song, Paek Hye Jong, Pak Jin Hae, Kim Kyong Ryong, too, bagged three gold medals respectively in the men's 65kg category and the women's 53kg , 63kg and 77kg categories.
They were warmly greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by officials concerned and their families. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets with Labor Innovators and Meritorious Persons
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of Constitution Day of the DPRK and the New Year at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Dec. 27.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the venue for the photo session, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" shook the venue.
All the participants were greatly excited to meetKim Jong Unon the platform of dream-like happiness with great pride and honor of being the labor innovators and meritorious persons representing the victorious and glorious year of 2025.
Kim Jong Unexpressed thanks to the patriotic devotion of the labor innovators and meritorious persons, as a token of his warm encouragement to them, for making contributions to glorifying the significant year of 2025 as the one of a great turn to be specially recorded in the history of the development of the Republic by dedicating their pure conscience to the rejuvenation and prosperity of the country.
He said that the country is prospering and our cause is dynamically advancing without a moment's stagnation, thanks to the well-known and unsung patriots who devote their diligent and sincere efforts to the work at their workplaces and posts, placing their obligations above the rights of citizens granted by the Constitution of the DPRK.
Saying that the Party and the government firmly believe in and exclusively rely on high patriotic enthusiasm of the people in the historic struggle for the overall development of socialist construction, he expressed expectation and belief that the participants would continue to creditably play their role as the vanguard and standard-bearers of the times, and had a photo session with them.
He met the women footballers and coaches who won the first place in the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup, and had a photo taken with them, wishing them greater successes in the future.
When the photo session was over, the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers again.
They vowed to firmly trust and follow the WPK single-mindedly and devote their all to the prosperity of the DPRK, regarding the great love and trust shown by him as their eternal lifeblood. -0-

headline: Unsan Paper Mill Inaugurated in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 29 (KCNA) -- At the time when the cheers of inaugurations celebrating the steady achievements of the regional development policy are stirring up the whole country with the exciting echoes in 2025, a modern paper mill was built in South Phyongan Province to greet the auspicious event of inauguration pioneering another new sphere for putting the regional industry on an advanced basis.
The paper mill, which has been built in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province as a model one according to the Workers' Party of Korea's decision to build a paper production base in all provinces capable of satisfying their demand, will mass-produce paper for writing, packing and toilet and other paper products.
The paper mill, built in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province, was inaugurated with due ceremony on Dec. 28.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
All the participants paid the highest tribute to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho came with warm blessings regarding the creations to contribute to improving the people's wellbeing as the most precious wealth.
Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, officials of ministries and national agencies, officials of South Phyongan Province and Unsan County, working people, employees of the mill and scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, delivered an inaugural address.
He warmly congratulated the scientists and technicians, builders of the province and workers of various enterprises on having successfully built the mill of weighty significance in developing the paper industry of Korean style and satisfying the country's long-term demand for paper.
He said that under the wise leadership ofKim Jong Un, who gave detailed guidance to the design and layouts of the structure and sent sci-tech force so that the professional and functional character as a paper production mill was ensured, the construction of the Unsan Paper Mill had been pushed forward with confidence from the beginning and it took on full appearance as a comprehensive production base.
The speaker noted thatKim Jong Unvisited the mill ahead of its inauguration to encourage and highly appreciate the scientists and technicians for contributing to the development of paper industry of the country and stressed the need to steadily develop the papermaking method and technology of Korean style, adding that his instructions served as an important guideline for putting the paper industry on a definite development stage.
He said that the officials and working people in the province, entrusted with a task for building a paper mill by the Party, dynamically launched the collective innovation movement to finish the construction work in a qualitative way and manufacture and install a lot of equipment, thus creating a model for the whole country in implementing the Party's policy on developing the regions and improving the people's living standards under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. He also noted that our scientists and technicians have achieved proud successes in establishing a new paper production technology, which the Party attaches importance to, with the extraordinary pioneering spirit and enthusiasm for creation.
The speaker called for continuously making strenuous efforts to successfully carry out the regional revolution most urgent in improving the people's standard of living and realizing the comprehensive state development, saying that the regional development is a sacred undertaking to steadily transform our life and environment into a high stage of modernity and progressive nature.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
He met officials, scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences who took part in the inauguration ceremony, and encouraged them who made a great contribution to the development of the country's paper industry by keeping the WPK's spirit of self-respect and self-sustenance as their faith.
He went round the Unsan Paper Mill.
He appreciated that the paper-manufacturing technology, capable of turning out various products with several species of wood and locally available raw materials, was introduced and a new mill of great economic efficiency and profitability was completed to provide a model experience for other provinces to build paper mills by themselves.
He said that the decision of the Party Central Committee to establish the paper industry in each province is a correct one as it embodied the principle of obtaining optimum results in construction and accurately reflected the present situation and economic potential of the regional areas.
Saying that we should maintain the clear goal and orientation of our-style papermaking method based on locally available raw materials and the development of papermaking technology in meeting the demand for paper essential in all fields such as science and technology, education and cultural life, he stressed the need for the mill to ensure the efficiency and sustained growth of production and thoroughly guarantee the quality of products by managing equipment and manpower and improving technical control in a responsible manner.
He clarified the principled issues to be adhered to in the construction of paper mills to be expanded and promoted on a nationwide scale on the basis of the experience gained in the construction and operation of the Unsan Paper Mill.
He highly praised the scientists and technicians of the Paper Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences for greeting the Ninth Congress of the WPK with proud successes.
Going round the mill, the participants in the inauguration ceremony keenly felt the indefatigable efforts of the great father, who is devoting himself to implementing the regional development policy to realize the desire of the people, and were convinced of the hopeful future of the country to be further thriving under his benevolent care. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Long-range Strategic Cruise Missile Launching Drill
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 29 (KCNA) -- A long-range strategic cruise missile launching drill was staged in the West Sea of Korea on Dec. 28.
The launching drill was aimed at checking the counter-offensive response posture and combat capability of long-range missile sub-units, making missile soldiers well versed in maneuver and procedures of fulfilling firing missions and inspecting the reliability of the relevant strategic weapon system.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, oversaw the strategic cruise missile launching drill.
The strategic cruise missiles flew along the flight orbit set in the sky above the West Sea of Korea for 10 199s and 10 203s to hit the target.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction, saying that the result of the launching drill is a practical verification and clear demonstration of the absolute reliability and combat readiness of our strategic counterattack capability.
He stressed that checking the reliability and rapid response of the components of the DPRK's nuclear deterrent on a regular basis and steadily demonstrating their might are just a responsible exercise of the right to self-defense and war deterrence under the present situation in which the DPRK is facing various security threats.
He affirmed that the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government would as ever devote all their efforts to the unlimited and sustained development of the state nuclear combat force. -0-

headline: Illustrious Commander Ushers in Golden Age in Strengthening Revolutionary Armed Forces
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- On December 30, 2011, the Workers' Party of Korea and the people of the DPRK held in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK.
Along with this significant day, the nature and character of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK have been firmly preserved, a decisive guarantee has been provided for carrying forward the ever-victorious history and traditions and the DPRK has been able to demonstrate its dignity and might as the strongest military power.
Kim Jong Unhas developed the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK into the elite ranks with his faith that the military muscle precisely means the national power and that the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people lie in bolstering up the military muscle in every way.
The ideas and theories on army building advanced byKim Jong Unincluding the idea of thoroughly establishing the Party’s monolithic command system across the entire army and invariably preserving the revolutionary nature of the people’s army  served as the important guidelines for ushering in a golden age in strengthening the military muscle.
Kim Jong Unconvened grand meetings of the entire army and led them to be a milestone in further strengthening the might of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK. He has made field inspections to train the People's Army into a matchless army.
He inspected the biggest hotspot on a small wooden boat, saying that he should go to any place where soldiers serve, however dangerous it may be.
Thanks to the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Un, who stressed the soldiers' mission, duty and feats at training grounds and trenches and led soldiers to spend their days of service with training, the People's Army could be prepared as a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army.
Shortly ago,Kim Jong Unguided the work to build a nuclear-powered strategic-guided missile submarine on the spot. Thanks to his devoted efforts for bolstering up the national defence capabilities, the DPRK could rapidly emerge as a strongest military power with the powerful national defence capabilities.
Watching with admiration the entities of the national defence capabilities at the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025, the people hardened their conviction that only victory is in store for the country as it is led byKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a golden age in bolstering up the revolutionary armed forces. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Hospital and Regional-industry Factories in Ryonggang County Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- The second year's tasks for the gigantic regional development policy, decided and powerfully led by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to turn all cities and counties of the country into regional hubs of the socialist state in a balanced and simultaneous way, have been successfully carried out along with the inauguration of the hospital and regional-industry factories in Ryonggang County.
Under the WPK's grand policy on regional development, light-industry bases were wonderfully built in the twenty cities and counties this year, following last year, and modern hospitals, leisure complexes and offshore farms commissioned in several cities and counties.
This proud reality adding more pride to the era of great changes through epochal successes is a precious fruition of the noble people-first idea of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who set it as a historic task to be boldly assumed and certainly implemented by our Party to provide all the people across the country with the happiest life and has pushed forward it through powerful leadership practice.
An inauguration ceremony of the hospital and regional-industry factories in Ryonggang County of Nampho Municipality was held with splendor on December 29, adding luster to the climax of the 2025 inauguration season.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
All the participants extended their highest respect toKim Jong Un, the great master of creation who is surely bringing about entities for prosperity on this land every year with his ardent love for the people.
Present at the inauguration ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, officials concerned, officials of Nampho Municipality and Ryonggang County, working people, soldier-builders and employees of the hospital and the regional-industry factories.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.
The speaker warmly congratulated the county people on receiving the modern hospital and light-industrial factories on the same day and at the same time in 2025, the first year of the public health revolution in the new era and the second year of implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy.
He extended warm thanks to the commanding officers and soldiers of the regional construction regiment of the 3rd Corps for having perfectly completed the projects for the regional construction policy as desired by the Party, true to the inherent duty of the Korean People's Army always faithful to the call of the country and the people.
The fruits of the efforts for transformation which have sprung up in all parts of the country, including its northern and southern ends and inland and coastal areas, are full of impressive stories telling people what the aim of our regional revolution is and where the strength of the nonstop advance lies in, he said, referring to the great painstaking efforts and devoted leadership ofKim Jong Unwho dedicated himself to carrying out the construction plan broader and deeper than last year.
He stressed that our growing ideal and self-confidence and the dynamic progress of the regional revolution are the true picture of socialist Korea displayed by the seasoned and strong leadership ofKim Jong Un, who possesses the transparent revolutionary outlook that the Party policy is the will, demand and interests of the people and regards the ardent patriotic will and the absolute standard that the people leading a happy life means national power as the supreme principle of all his revolutionary activities.
True to the long-cherished desire of the Party Central Committee to make the regional people lead a happy life as soon as possible, we should simultaneously build more structures, including modern light-industrial factories, hospitals and leisure complexes, in 20 cities and counties next year than this year and should make greater progress and a leap forward in their qualitative aspect, he said, calling upon all the officials to regardKim Jong Un's policy on regional construction, which they kept in mind again in this inauguration season, as absolute standard, and to fulfill their responsibility and duty in creation and construction for the promotion of the people's wellbeing.
Saying that our extraordinary will and our dynamic efforts would bring earlier the future of prosperity when all the people across the country lead a happy life, the speaker expressed the belief that such achievements as today's proud success demonstrating the truth of the Party's policy and the might of Korean-style socialism would be steadily made in the hopeful New Year 2026.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
The participants cheered enthusiastically out of the absolute trust in and boundless reverence forKim Jong Unwho saw to it that assets of prosperity are built in their region and personally attended the significant inauguration ceremony at the end of the year, adding to the pleasure and happiness.
Lovely children presented him bunches of flowers in reflection of the unanimous gratitude of the people of Ryonggang County.
Kim Jong Unsincerely hoped that the county people who greeted the auspicious event of meaningful inauguration would lead a happy life on their land of bliss.
He met commanding officers of the construction unit that successfully built the Ryonggang County Hospital and regional-industry factories to highly appraise the loyalty to the Party and the country they displayed, and sent warm militant salute to all the soldier-builders.
Then he looked around the Ryonggang County Hospital.
He said that through the implementation of the expanded regional development policy such as building standard regional hospitals in Kangdong County, Kusong City and Ryonggang County this year, we have gone through another course for the victorious advance of the sacred cause aimed at bringing about practical change of the whole country and accumulated precious successes and experience for putting the regional construction on a definite development stage.
Making the hard-won precious creations serve as powerful engine for the development of socialist public health is a heavy and responsible revolution task whose fulfillment is as important as their construction, he said, clarifying important tasks for the operation and medical service of regional hospitals to be built in cities and counties across the country with this year as the starting point.
He said that all the medical workers of the county hospital should fulfill their exclusive duty of being responsible for the health of the citizens with high level of medical service and sincere devotion, mindful of the Party's intention of placing the lives and security of the people and promotion of their health above all else.
Noting that the inauguration of the Ryonggang County Hospital and regional-industry factories successfully concluded the construction of model hospitals and leisure complexes and regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties planned for this year and opened up a new phase for further hastening the comprehensive development of socialist construction based on absolute support and patriotic zeal of the people, he said with pride that the year 2025 would be recorded as a historic year that proved more vividly the validity and vitality of the regional development policy through reality.
He expressed the firm belief that all the officers and men of the regional construction regiments at all levels of the large combined units of the KPA would more dynamically display the indomitable revolutionary spirit and creative mettle peculiar to our army, which remains absolutely loyal to the order of the Party and is dedicated to realizing the long-cherished desire of the Party, and always perform signal feats in the theaters of regional construction for the cause of the Party and the happy life of the people.
Leading officials of the Party and government went round the newly-built hospital and foodstuff factory, daily-necessities factory and garment factory, together with the participants in the inauguration ceremony.
The inauguration ceremony marked another occasion in further cementing the belief in the bright future of eternally prospering socialist Korea along with the brilliant results of the regional development policy which has been powerfully carried on year on year thanks to the unique state-building ideas of the great ComradeKim Jong Unand his wise leadership. -0-

headline: Artistic Motivational Team of C.C. UAWK Performs
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- The artistic motivational team of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) performed at the Academy of Agricultural Sciences on Monday to celebrate the 14th anniversary of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's assumption of the supreme commandership of the armed forces of the DPRK.
Among the audience were Han Jong Hyok, chairman of the Central Committee of the UAWK, officials concerned, officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers of the Academy of Agricultural Sciences.
The performers sang high praises of the boundless honour and happiness of holding in high esteem the peerlessly illustrious commander who developed the armed forces of the DPRK into the elite combat ranks which have the matchless military muscle with his extraordinary leadership ability to glorify the dignity and might of our state all over the world.
The atmosphere of the performance was revved up when female chorus and female solo were sung reflecting the happy looks of agricultural workers enjoying all blessings in the prosperous area along with the new era of change ushered in by the Workers' Party of Korea.
The performance, which showed the iron will of the officials of the UAWK and agricultural workers to make a genuine contribution to consolidating the military muscle of the country by reaping high yield every year, ended with poem and choruses "We Are Koreans" and "Dear Father". -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprise
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited a major munitions industry enterprise on Dec. 28 to learn about the production of weapons and combat equipment.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, and officials concerned of the munitions industry department of the C.C., WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the production of multiple rocket launchers to be equipped by major units of the Korean People's Army according to the decision of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
He repeatedly praised the firm revolutionary attitude of the workers of the enterprise who are waging a labor struggle to attain the goal of producing the multiple rocket system set by the Party while increasing production every day in high spirits.
Stressing once again the importance of the weapon system being produced by the enterprise, he encouraged the workers in their production campaign.
He said that the multiple rocket system, which will be the main strike means of the KPA, would completely change the composition of our artillery force and that the enterprise plays a pivotal role in implementing the Party's military strategic policy on modernizing and reinforcing long-range artillery pieces. And he expressed satisfaction, saying that the weapon system, which will be used in large quantities for concentrated attack in military operations, is a super-powerful weapon system as it can annihilate the enemy through sudden precise strike with high accuracy and devastating power and can also be used as a strategic attack means. It is really laudable success that we are producing with our own efforts and technology the world's only operational and tactical weapon system with the greatest military effect at will to meet the demand, he added.
He also referred to the prospective modernization project of the enterprise.
He said that we should bring about a revolution in upgrading the artillery weapon system and, to this end, it is necessary to further perfect the production structure of the enterprise in particular and improve the technical foundations of processes so as to equip the enterprise with strong production capacity and thus fully guarantee the successful attainment of the munitions production goals, to be set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK, on a material and technical basis.
He stressed the need for the overall munitions industry field as well as the enterprise to constantly push ahead with the establishment of advanced industrial structure, steady expansion of production capacity and innovative technological upgrading capable of producing more weapons and combat equipment in conformity with the development-oriented requirements of the defence science and industry of the present era and the goal of modernizing our army and its demand.
He ardently called for further expanding the successes achieved this year and achieving greater successes through strenuous efforts in the struggle for bolstering up the defence capabilities in 2026.
His field guidance on the day serves as a new milestone of great importance in increasing the country's war deterrent in a practical way. -0-
