headline: Farm Machines Exhibition Opens in DPRK
Illustrious Commander Ushers in Golden Age in Strengthening Revolutionary Armed Forces
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- On December 30, 2011, the Workers' Party of Korea and the people of the DPRK held in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK.
Along with this significant day, the nature and character of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK have been firmly preserved, a decisive guarantee has been provided for carrying forward the ever-victorious history and traditions and the DPRK has been able to demonstrate its dignity and might as the strongest military power.
Kim Jong Unhas developed the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK into the elite ranks with his faith that the military muscle precisely means the national power and that the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people lie in bolstering up the military muscle in every way.
The ideas and theories on army building advanced byKim Jong Unincluding the idea of thoroughly establishing the Party’s monolithic command system across the entire army and invariably preserving the revolutionary nature of the people’s army  served as the important guidelines for ushering in a golden age in strengthening the military muscle.
Kim Jong Unconvened grand meetings of the entire army and led them to be a milestone in further strengthening the might of the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK. He has made field inspections to train the People's Army into a matchless army.
He inspected the biggest hotspot on a small wooden boat, saying that he should go to any place where soldiers serve, however dangerous it may be.
Thanks to the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Un, who stressed the soldiers' mission, duty and feats at training grounds and trenches and led soldiers to spend their days of service with training, the People's Army could be prepared as a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army.
Shortly ago,Kim Jong Unguided the work to build a nuclear-powered strategic-guided missile submarine on the spot. Thanks to his devoted efforts for bolstering up the national defence capabilities, the DPRK could rapidly emerge as a strongest military power with the powerful national defence capabilities.
Watching with admiration the entities of the national defence capabilities at the military hardware exhibition Defence Development-2025, the people hardened their conviction that only victory is in store for the country as it is led byKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a golden age in bolstering up the revolutionary armed forces. -0-

headline: Ceremonies of Moving into New Houses Held in Jagang Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- Villages of the Konggwi Vegetable Farm in Kanggye City, and the Kaewon Farm in Wiwon County, Jagang Province of the DPRK, underwent cataclysmic changes.
Cultural houses with all living conditions in good harmony with the natural scenery of the mountainous areas are the homes of happiness brought about by the ardent love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Ceremonies of moving into houses were held on the spots. Present there were officials of the Party and power organs in Jagang Province, Kanggye City and Wiwon County, builders and agricultural workers.
Speeches were made at the ceremonies and licenses for the use of houses were handed over.
When the house-moving began, laughter and songs of the blessed agricultural workers resounded and dancing parties were given, the villages were in a festive mood.
Officials visited the families of farmers who moved into new houses and shared joy with them. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, December 31 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, president of the Arab Republic of Egypt, on Dec. 29.
The message said:
As we bid farewell to the past year and welcome a new one, I extend my warmest wishes to Your Excellency for a Happy New Year.
May the New Year 2026 mark a renewed commitment to revitalizing our collective efforts and constructive engagement, guided by dialogue and understanding, to transcend ongoing conflicts and advance our shared aspiration for a more peaceful, stable and secure future for our nations.
I look forward to strengthening our bilateral relations in the year ahead, fostering closer cooperation and yielding tangible benefits for our two friendly peoples.
Please accept, dear Mr. President, the assurances of my highest esteem and sincere wishes for a year filled with progress and prosperity for all peoples worldwide.
Highest considerations and appreciation
Happy New Year! -0-

headline: House-moving Ceremonies Held in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
Number of Animals Increases at Central Zoo of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, December 31 (KCNA) -- At the Central Zoo in the DPRK, the number of animals has increased by 1 100 of over 150 kinds. Among them the number of gift animals is more than 100 of over 40 species.
This gives greater pleasure to the visitors.
On January 1 an Asiatic black bear, a gift animal, had a cub.
The gift animal German pointer (dog) gave birth to a puppy in February and Shih tzu, a pet dog, dropped five pups in April, June and August.
The number of hamadryas baboon and brown bear has increased.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends New Year's Message to Officers and Soldiers of Overseas Operations Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a congratulatory message to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units on December 31, 2025 on the occasion of the new year.
The full text of the message is as follows:
To the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who are greeting the new year
My beloved comrades-in-arms – generals, officers and soldiers – who are greeting the new year in the overseas operations area,
On behalf of our Party and state and in reflection of the tender feelings of our people, the officers and soldiers of the entire army, and your parents, wives and children, I send new year greetings to all the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operations units.
As the whole country is enveloped in a festive atmosphere of greeting the new year, I all the more miss you, who are fighting bravely on the battlefields in the alien land even at this moment, true to the order of your homeland.
Though you are now far away from your homeland, our Party and people always think of you first, the proud sons of our country.
2025, the year we are seeing off with great pride and dignity, is shining more brilliantly thanks to the imperishable honour you have defended at the cost of your blood and lives.
All of you have safeguarded heroically the dignity and honour of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
You have demonstrated to the full with what determination and fortitude one should carry out the order of the Party and the country. You are a source of the greatest strength and pride and a strong pillar of our Party and state.
The coming year 2026 will be another year of the great DPRK along with the remarkable feats you will perform on the overseas battlefields.
I really miss you all.
I hope that I will have a warm reunion with you, all officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, as early as possible.
Your homeland is eagerly looking forward to your return home.
It is my greatest wish that all of you will return to your homeland in good health.
I request you all to pay special attention to your safety, mindful of my wish.
And be always brave.
For the fraternal Russian people,
For the mettle and characteristics of our people, for the spirit and dignity of the Korean people and for the immortal honour of our state,
And for the undying fame of our army,
Be brave.
Behind you are Pyongyang and Moscow.
Thanks to your self-sacrificing and devoted struggle, the militant fraternity and friendship and invincible alliance between our country and Russia grow firmer.
All officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units,
As I, together with your parents, wives and children, and all other people, look forward to the day when all of you will return home safely after accomplishing your mission, I once again send you new year greetings and warm militant salute. -0-

headline: National Flag-Hoisting Ceremony Held on New Year

Gorgeous fireworks were set off in the nocturnal sky over the capital city, adding pleasure to the people greeting the New Year 2026. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a congratulatory message to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on January 1.
The message said:
Seeing in the new year 2026, I extend my warm congratulations and compatriotic greetings to you and all other officials of Chongryon, as well as to other Korean compatriots in Japan.
Last year Chongryon, together with the fellow people in the homeland, celebrated in splendour the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 80th anniversary of national liberation, and on the occasion of its 70th founding anniversary, it also made remarkable progress in writing another greater chapter of the history and tradition of the movement of Koreans in Japan, as it deeply cherished the ennobling spirit of patriotism and historic achievements of its founder generation.
I extend my heartfelt thanks and encouragement to Chongryon officials and other Korean compatriots in Japan for having left sacred imprints of patriotic efforts throughout the year while strenuously coping with innumerable challenges and ordeals in the foreign land.
The new year is a historic one when the Ninth Congress of our Party is to be held. For Chongryon, it is a year of a fresh turning point and transformation, in which it should, at its 26th Congress, advance a clear target and strategy for a new struggle period up to its 80th founding anniversary and take a vigorous step forward towards successfully implementing its patriotic tasks for the first year of the period.
I am fully convinced that Chongryon officials and other Korean compatriots in Japan will, in the new year, too, make substantial progress in carrying out their overall patriotic tasks, including those to be tackled in defending their rights and interests and in bringing up the younger generation, so as to write a glorious page which will shine forever in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan.
I wish that in the hope-filled new year, our dear children and students in Japan will grow up to be lively, cheerful and upright, and all Chongryon officials and families of our compatriots live happily. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on January 1.
The letter said that the Chongryon Central Standing Committee paid the deepest tribute to the great PresidentKim Il Sungand GeneralKim Jong Ilon the first morning of the historic new year 2026 when the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea is to be held, and extended the highest glory and warmest congratulations to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unin reflection of the boundless reverence and loyalty of all the Chongryon officials and other Koreans in Japan.
The respected Marshal ushered in a new era of building up the national power and enhancing the national prestige, to be specially noted in the history of the development of the DPRK, and opened up a heyday of development of its armed forces, firmly defending the sovereignty of the country and wellbeing of its people, it noted.
It said that he personally sent a letter "Let Us Write a New Great Chapter in the History of the Movement of Koreans in Japan by Carrying Forward the Patriotic Spirit of the Founder Generation," to be served as guidelines, on the occasion of the 70th birthday of Chongryon, thus providing it with the strategy for invincibility and a grand blueprint for development, which enables it to ensure the eternal continuity of its glorious patriotic history characterized by the traditions of loyalty, unity and patriotism pioneered by the generation of the founders of Chongryon.
It stated that last year he sent Chongryon a huge amount of money as educational aid fund and stipend for the Korean children in Japan and invited a number of delegations and groups to visit the homeland, and showed such fatherly love as enabling Korean students in Japan to take part in the art performance for celebrating the new year 2026.
The letter expressed the pledge to go all out for implementing the three-point key undertakings, set forth in the important letter sent byKim Jong Unon the occasion of the 70th birthday of Chongryon, by keeping pace with the ever-soaring working spirit and morale of the socialist homeland that will enter a new phase of transformation with the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a momentum, so as to effect a new upsurge in the patriotic movement for safeguarding the rights and interests of Koreans in Japan, bringing up the rising generations to be robust and firmly preserving the national identity of the Korean community. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends New Year's Message to Officers and Soldiers of Overseas Operations Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a congratulatory message to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units on December 31, 2025 on the occasion of the new year.
The full text of the message is as follows:
To the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who are greeting the new year
My beloved comrades-in-arms – generals, officers and soldiers – who are greeting the new year in the overseas operations area,
On behalf of our Party and state and in reflection of the tender feelings of our people, the officers and soldiers of the entire army, and your parents, wives and children, I send new year greetings to all the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operations units.
As the whole country is enveloped in a festive atmosphere of greeting the new year, I all the more miss you, who are fighting bravely on the battlefields in the alien land even at this moment, true to the order of your homeland.
Though you are now far away from your homeland, our Party and people always think of you first, the proud sons of our country.
2025, the year we are seeing off with great pride and dignity, is shining more brilliantly thanks to the imperishable honour you have defended at the cost of your blood and lives.
All of you have safeguarded heroically the dignity and honour of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
You have demonstrated to the full with what determination and fortitude one should carry out the order of the Party and the country. You are a source of the greatest strength and pride and a strong pillar of our Party and state.
The coming year 2026 will be another year of the great DPRK along with the remarkable feats you will perform on the overseas battlefields.
I really miss you all.
I hope that I will have a warm reunion with you, all officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, as early as possible.
Your homeland is eagerly looking forward to your return home.
It is my greatest wish that all of you will return to your homeland in good health.
I request you all to pay special attention to your safety, mindful of my wish.
And be always brave.
For the fraternal Russian people,
For the mettle and characteristics of our people, for the spirit and dignity of the Korean people and for the immortal honour of our state,
And for the undying fame of our army,
Be brave.
Behind you are Pyongyang and Moscow.
Thanks to your self-sacrificing and devoted struggle, the militant fraternity and friendship and invincible alliance between our country and Russia grow firmer.
All officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units,
As I, together with your parents, wives and children, and all other people, look forward to the day when all of you will return home safely after accomplishing your mission, I once again send you new year greetings and warm militant salute. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on January 1.
The General Association of Koreans in China in its letter said that, in reflection of their boundless reverence and loyalty, the officials of the association and all Koreans in China greeting the hopeful New Year 2026 extend the highest glory and best wishes to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho has bolstered up the political, military and economic might peculiar to the DPRK a hundredfold and a thousandfold with his outstanding political caliber and patriotic devotion all year round.
2025 was a year of great shock and excitement, in which the hot wind of worship for the respected Marshal swept all over the planet and the myth of the mightiness of Juche Korea was consolidated as an established theory, and a year of great victory in which the dignity and national power of the DPRK were put on the highest level, the letter said.
The noble ideal and experienced leadership of the respected Marshal are fundamental source to make every year of Juche Korea woven with phenomenal successes and cheers for victory as he has written a new history of heroic Korea, in which the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army, the long-cherished desire of the nation spanning 5 000 years, was successfully accomplished, while making ceaseless journey of devotion to the people despite such grim situation that innumerable difficulties unparalleled in history have been witnessed one after another, it said, and went on:
It is the pride and happiness of our overseas compatriots to hold in high esteem the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the greatest and strongest father in the world who is tender-hearted and benevolent as he values and loves the overseas compatriots most and guides them step by step with his warm care.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at New Year Celebration
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at a New Year celebration.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Dear Pyongyang citizens,
Labour innovators and meritorious persons, who are invited to this meaningful new year celebration as representatives of our industrious and patriotic working people,
Faithful and courageous officers and soldiers of the Korean People’s Army,
Our students and artistes, who are adding more to the air of festivity of this night,
Comrades,
Happy New Year.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I extend new year greetings to the working people in all sectors, including the industrial and devoted agricultural workers and intellectuals, and other people across the country, who are greeting this meaningful moment at their workplaces, posts and streets, in their villages and houses, with high dignity and hopes.
And I send congratulations to the generals and other officers and soldiers of our heroic army, who are greeting the new year filled with the pride in having glorified the previous year with invaluable feats and with a pledge of sacred service. My militant salute goes to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who will be greeting the new year in the far-away alien land with deep yearning for their homeland.
I also convey warm greetings to the overseas compatriots, who are devoting themselves to the patriotic work for the development and prosperity of their motherland.
Comrades,
We have just seen off the unforgettable year 2025 with deep emotion.
It was a year filled with so fervent hopes and dear efforts.
We can feel proud that we boosted the strength and dignity of our country that year.
We rounded off everything perfectly, writing great events in every page of the year.
The civilization of the capital city transformed the regions, the transformation of the regions gave a spur to the development of the capital city, and all the regions, sectors and units across the country made progress in a competitive, balanced and simultaneous way. In this way, the historic cause aspiring to overall development of socialist construction has successfully passed its first stage.
Certainly, this is an honour that has resulted from our ideals and faith, our strength and strenuous efforts, and at the same time, it is clear proof that we are following the right path.
The year 2025 was a golden period of epochal significance and transformation that added value to the precious lives of our excellent people and their children, and it was a year, in which we saw in our mind’s eye the future of our state that will grow more powerful and beautiful thanks to their affection, wisdom and sweat.
I really appreciate everyone in this country for having worked hard all year round.
Last year, too, the service personnel of the People’s Army, who have always stood in the vanguard of our cause, went against heavy odds to lead the drive for creation and transformation and achieve amazing successes; they won precious victory even at the cost of their lives, thereby creating a heroic age to be revered by the coming generations.
We will always remember that the glory of this night has been brought by the ennobling sacrifice and exploits of the great sons of our country, and in the annals of our eternal victory, we will etch their names and images as ever-shining stars.
We entered the year 2025 with a heavy heart as we were confronted with huge tasks; what we believed in was nothing but our people’s patriotism and loyalty, and they were the real driving force that propelled our unprecedented struggle throughout the year.
So trustworthy were the workers at the Sangwon Cement Complex, who raised the torch of increased production ahead of others true to the Party’s intentions, so commendable were the agricultural workers, who reaped a bumper harvest by tilling their fields by the sweat of their brow in a display of patriotism, and really admirable were our young women footballers, who had the national flag of our Republic hoisted by winning international competitions.
All our people, irrespective of job or workplace – be it deep pit, construction site of a power station, school or scientific research institute –, gave full play to their self-respect, resourcefulness, strength and enthusiasm befitting Koreans, and they thus filled the pages of the chronicle for the great year with sincerity for the development and prosperity of their country.
Only a great people can write such a great chronicle for the times and history.
As this great people throw in their lot with the country and find their greatest honour and joy of life in devoting themselves to its victory and glory, our Party is invincible and our socialism is ever-prosperous.
I will never exchange for anything else the dignity and glory of living for our great people and waging the revolution for them, and live up to the expectations of all the people in the new year, too, by always remaining faithful to the socialism of their choice, to the sacred ideal of the people-first principle and to the dignity, rights and interests of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.
Comrades,
The year 2026 began a few minutes before.
A more strenuous struggle and a greater victory are awaiting us.
Let us all make another start full of confidence.
There is no dream we cannot fulfil as we have the confidence and will to live and prosper with dignity and the fighting mettle and creative strength we have assiduously cultivated and fostered.
Let us all unite more firmly on the strength of patriotism and advance more vigorously and courageously towards the new future to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party.
I sincerely hope that love, harmony, delight and happiness will brim over at all the families across the country in the new year.
Dear comrades,
I propose that we all raise a cheer once again to express our warm affection for, and infinite dignity and pride in, our state.
Long live our great country, the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea! -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Banquet for Labor Innovators and Meritorious Persons Given in Celebration of New Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The New Year banquet was given at the Mokran House on Wednesday for labor innovators and meritorious persons who contributed to glorifying the significant 2025 as a year of great turn that makes a new watershed in the history of growth and development of the DPRK.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the banquet.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the banquet, all the participants extended their thanks to the great father for inviting ordinary officials and working people, who did nothing great but remained faithful to their mission and duty for the citizens of the Republic, having a photo session with them and bestowing the high pride and honor of being the representatives of 2025, the year of victory and glory.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, other leading officials of the Party and the government, labor innovators and meritorious persons.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech.
He expressed his impression of having sat together with labor innovators representing our great people, all the beloved people of the country, to see the busy and successful year 2025 out and start a new struggle record of 2026, extending warm thanks to the labor innovators, meritorious persons and all other people for their patriotic efforts and devotion to all the successes of this year.
He said that our labor innovators and meritorious persons are possessed of excellent qualities and mettle of the Korean people, the strongest, most arduous and most resourceful in the world and today's place is glorious as there are those days in which they devoted their all, while burning their minds with patriotic loyalty, to making our country greater and our progress faster.
Saying that there are many labor innovators and meritorious persons like them in the country and this is the most important secret and pride that makes our Party, our state and our system be always strong and developing, he affirmed that as the great people are waging a grand struggle for creation with the great line of struggle, we are getting closer to our far-reaching ideal and will surely grow stronger and turn faster.
The first and foremost thing is that we have redoubled our confidence and strength, which can never be easily gained by anything, he said and extended warm New Year greetings to the participants in the banquet, and through them, to all the citizens in the whole regions of the country.
He wished all the participants good health and more worthwhile and valuable successes in the future and proposed a toast to harmony, happiness and laughter of all the families across the country.
All the participants pledged to perform proud feats to be recorded in the name of the present times and in the appearance of the present generation in the new struggle of 2026 that will bring greater glory and prosperity to our great state and people. -0-

headline: House-moving Ceremonies Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- Modern houses have sprung up at Kujang and Muan farms in Tokchon City and the Sampha Farm in Sinyang County, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The change of farm villages embodying the Workers' Party of Korea's idea of people-first architecture and its idea of rural construction in the new era is a precious fruition of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's devoted efforts for the people.
Ceremonies of moving into those new houses took place on the spots with the attendance of officials in the province, Tokchon City and Sinyang County and builders and agricultural workers.
Congratulatory addresses were made there and licenses for the use of new houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
When the house-moving began, congratulatory performances and cheerful peasant dance were displayed, and officials visited the owners of new houses to share joy with them. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Chairman of Chongryon Central Standing Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a congratulatory message to Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), on January 1.
The message said:
Seeing in the new year 2026, I extend my warm congratulations and compatriotic greetings to you and all other officials of Chongryon, as well as to other Korean compatriots in Japan.
Last year Chongryon, together with the fellow people in the homeland, celebrated in splendour the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 80th anniversary of national liberation, and on the occasion of its 70th founding anniversary, it also made remarkable progress in writing another greater chapter of the history and tradition of the movement of Koreans in Japan, as it deeply cherished the ennobling spirit of patriotism and historic achievements of its founder generation.
I extend my heartfelt thanks and encouragement to Chongryon officials and other Korean compatriots in Japan for having left sacred imprints of patriotic efforts throughout the year while strenuously coping with innumerable challenges and ordeals in the foreign land.
The new year is a historic one when the Ninth Congress of our Party is to be held. For Chongryon, it is a year of a fresh turning point and transformation, in which it should, at its 26th Congress, advance a clear target and strategy for a new struggle period up to its 80th founding anniversary and take a vigorous step forward towards successfully implementing its patriotic tasks for the first year of the period.
I am fully convinced that Chongryon officials and other Korean compatriots in Japan will, in the new year, too, make substantial progress in carrying out their overall patriotic tasks, including those to be tackled in defending their rights and interests and in bringing up the younger generation, so as to write a glorious page which will shine forever in the history of the movement of Koreans in Japan.
I wish that in the hope-filled new year, our dear children and students in Japan will grow up to be lively, cheerful and upright, and all Chongryon officials and families of our compatriots live happily. -0-

headline: New Buildings Erected at Farm in Kaesong Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The Tokam Farm of the Kaesong Municipal Rural Economic Committee in the DPRK has been renovated under the far-reaching plan of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee to turn the rural villages into more civilized and beautiful socialist fairyland.
New public buildings with good working and living conditions were erected at the farm in keeping with the wonderful modern dwellings built year after year to provide all the farmers with a new life of rural civilization.
A ceremony for inaugurating those public buildings and production buildings took place on the spot.
Present there were Ri Sung Jin, chairman of the Kaesong Municipal Rural Economy Committee, officials concerned, builders, and officials and working people of the farm.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants went round with emotion and joy various parts of the farm showing a new appearance of civilization along with the era of the Workers' Party.
An art performance was given to celebrate the auspicious event at the farm village and the happy laughter of people resounded. -0-

headline: Touching Story Associated with Orphanage on New Year's Day
story_text:
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Orphanage on the New Year of 2015 to keep his promise he made to its children.
He blessed the children on the New Year and watched their performance and said that he would have a photo taken with them.
At that moment a child came running ahead of others and went to his arms.
Kim Jong Ungave baby kisses twice to the child when he visited the orphanage last time.
He embraced the child and gave a baby kiss again and said with affection that this time is the third one.
The scene of the day was a touching picture displayed under the boundless love and benevolence of the respected fatherly Marshal who becomes the real father of the children and takes care of them so that they grow up without any shadow.
Thanks to the warm love of the dear father, all our children are growing up to be pillars of the future. -0-

Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The hopeful New Year 2026 has come, encouraging all the people of the DPRK to turn out in the vigorous advance towards a new great victory.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: New Year Celebration Performance Given in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The hopeful new year 2026 has come to the country dynamically advancing toward the grand goal of eternal prosperity for the comprehensive development of socialism and the promotion of the people's wellbeing under the leadership of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea.
All the people seeing off a significant year of victory and transformation, specially recorded in the history of the country, are filled with their absolute trust in and ardent reverence for the great WPK.
An art performance for celebrating the New Year 2026 was given with splendour at the May Day Stadium in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, adding great joy to the whole country ahead of the new year's journey to be more vigorous and gigantic.
Prior to the performance, there was a Taekwon-Do demonstration showing the wisdom and bravery of the Korean people.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, enjoyed the performance.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium amid the playing of welcome music, all the audience and performers paid boundless respects and eternal honour to him, the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution and the benevolent father of the people who is developing our socialist state into an eternal flower garden of all blessings for the people and ushering in the future of a powerful country that will be prosperous forever.
Kim Jong Unwaved back to the enthusiastically cheering masses and extended warm greetings to the beloved people across the country.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of ministries and national agencies, labour innovators and meritorious persons, officers and soldiers of overseas operations units and families of their commanding officers, men and officers of the Korean People's Army, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, builders involved in the capital city construction and citizens of Pyongyang.
Overseas compatriots staying in the socialist homeland enjoyed the performance.
The national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
All the audience paid high tribute to the sacred national flag with a resolve to make genuine contribution to the prosperity of the country by devoting their patriotic enthusiasm, wisdom and sincere sweat.
The performance began with the songs "We Love Our Country" and "The Glorious Country".
Put on the stage were such famous songs as patriotic songs reflecting the intense love of all the people for the country demonstrating its dignity and glory all over the world along with the great era ofKim Jong Un.
Through jubilant songs and dances, the performers showed the true picture of powerful Korea, the country of the people which guarantees the independent life and genuine happiness and dynamically advances along the road of self-respect and prosperity, overcoming all challenges of history.
The pictures showing the brilliant honor and unforgettable memos, which citizens and proud sons and daughters of the country sharing their breath and destiny with the country recorded in the history of 2025, touched the heartstrings of the audience.
The venue of the performance turned into a scene of excitement and enthusiasm with the song "We Are Koreans" pulsating with the patriotic desire of all the people to steadily carry forward the vigorous advance toward great victory and glory with the revolutionary spirit of self-sustenance and indomitable courage.
When the emotion-charged countdown for seeing 2025 off ended to signal the start of a new year, celebration torch was kindled and spectacular fireworks were set off.
Lovely children presented fragrant bouquets toKim Jong Unand paid New Year greetings to him.
The atmosphere of the performance was revved up amid the playing of the light melody of the song "Snow Is Falling on New Year's Day".
Kim Jong Unmade a speech to celebrate the New Year.
He extended militant salute to the working people in all sectors, including the industrial and devoted agricultural workers and intellectuals, and other people across the country, who are greeting the meaningful moment of the new year with high dignity and hopes, the generals and other officers and soldiers of our heroic army, who are filled with the pride in having glorified the previous year with invaluable feats and with a pledge of sacred service, and to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who will be greeting the new year in the far-away alien land with deep yearning for their homeland. He also extended warm greetings to the overseas compatriots who are devoting themselves to the patriotic work for the development and prosperity of their motherland.
Referring to the precious successes and phenomenal changes of 2025 which boosted the strength and dignity of our country with so fervent hopes and dear efforts, he said that this is certainly an honour that has resulted from our ideals and faith, our strength and strenuous efforts, and at the same time, it is clear proof that we are following the right path.
He affirmed with pride that 2025 is the image of the future of our state which will grow more powerful and beautiful thanks to our excellent people's affection, wisdom and sweat.
He ardently called for uniting more firmly on the strength of patriotism and advancing more vigorously and courageously towards the new future to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party. And he proposed that all the participants raise a cheer to express warm affection for, and infinite dignity and pride in, our state
All the participants shouted hurrah for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, their great motherland.
The people, greatly honored with the warm blessing and encouragement from the benevolent father in happiness and convinced of the brighter and rosier future of the country, broke into enthusiastic cheers.
As the performance went on, new songs reflecting the ardent wishes for the new year and pledge to wage strenuous struggle for greater victory decorated the New Year celebration stage.
The performance culminated with the song "Fly Forever, National Flag" reflecting the ardent patriotic will of all the people to fly higher in the sky of the century the sacred national flag which all the people have defended and glorified as their lives along with the glorious history of the DPRK.
At the end of the performance, enthusiastic cheers burst out again and fireworks were set off to beautifully adorn the night sky over the capital city.
Warmly waving back to the cheering masses,Kim Jong Unwished all families across the country love and happiness on the occasion of the New Year.
The New Year celebration performance, which signaled the grand start of 2026 promising the steady prosperity of the country and eternal happiness of the people, marked a significant occasion of redoubling the uplifted spirit and confidence in victory of all the people across the country in their struggle to dynamically accelerate the general advance of the new year under the bright blueprint to be unfolded by the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- Youth and students had an evening gala atKim Il SungSquare in Pyongyang on Wednesday evening on the occasion of the New Year 2026.
When the song "Cheers of the People" resounded in the night sky of the square, a delightful and optimistic dancing party began.
Through the dancing party, the participants paid the highest glory to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a new era of excitement and overall development in which the people's dreams and ideals come true with his extraordinary political ability and outstanding and seasoned leadership.
The participants danced to the tune of songs "Song of Youth" and "Let's Love Our Country". Their faces were full of determination to always march straight ahead and add luster to the precious name of the patriotic youth on the road of following the guiding Workers' Party of Korea.
The evening gala, which clearly demonstrated the revolutionary spirit of the young vanguard across the country to glorify the precious name of youth in the new year's journey which will be recorded in the glorious page of history on the road of development of the DPRK, beautifully decorated the night seeing the year out. -0-

headline: New Factories Inaugurated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The Cholryong Tile Factory and the Wonsan Building-materials Factory have been built in Kangwon Province of the DPRK.
The factories, furnished with efficient equipment needed for producing various kinds of tiles, roofing tiles and paving blocks, will help the province supply the finishing building materials by itself and push ahead with the regional and rural construction as required by the Workers' Party of Korea's policy.
Ceremonies for inaugurating them were held on the spots on December 31, 2025.
Present there were Paek Song Guk, chief secretary of the Kangwon Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials in the province, Wonsan City and Anbyon County, working people, builders and employees of the factories.
On the same day, officials of the Party and power organs in the province and relevant sectors visited the newly-built Wonsan Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory to discuss the issues of producing more efficacious medicines conducive to promoting the people's health. -0-

story_text:

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Emir of State of Kuwait
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Mishal Al Ahmad Al Jaber Al Sabah, emir of the State of Kuwait, on Dec. 22, 2025.
The message said:
I pay respect to you.
I am pleased to send the most heartfelt congratulations and wishes to Your Excellency on the occasion of the New Year 2026.
I hope that peace and stability will settle in the mankind as a whole and wellbeing and prosperity of all peoples of the world be realized in the new year.
I wish you good health, hoping that the excellent relations between our two friendly countries and peoples will grow stronger.
Yours sincerely. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Cuban President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and president of the Republic of Cuba, on January 1.
The message said:
Extending congratulations to you and the Cuban party, government and people on the occasion of the 67th anniversary of the victory in the Cuban revolution, I wish the Cuban people success in their struggle to defend the sovereignty of the country and the gains of the revolution. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends New Year's Message to Officers and Soldiers of Overseas Operations Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 1 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a congratulatory message to the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units on December 31, 2025 on the occasion of the new year.
The full text of the message is as follows:
To the officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, who are greeting the new year
My beloved comrades-in-arms – generals, officers and soldiers – who are greeting the new year in the overseas operations area,
On behalf of our Party and state and in reflection of the tender feelings of our people, the officers and soldiers of the entire army, and your parents, wives and children, I send new year greetings to all the commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operations units.
As the whole country is enveloped in a festive atmosphere of greeting the new year, I all the more miss you, who are fighting bravely on the battlefields in the alien land even at this moment, true to the order of your homeland.
Though you are now far away from your homeland, our Party and people always think of you first, the proud sons of our country.
2025, the year we are seeing off with great pride and dignity, is shining more brilliantly thanks to the imperishable honour you have defended at the cost of your blood and lives.
All of you have safeguarded heroically the dignity and honour of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
You have demonstrated to the full with what determination and fortitude one should carry out the order of the Party and the country. You are a source of the greatest strength and pride and a strong pillar of our Party and state.
The coming year 2026 will be another year of the great DPRK along with the remarkable feats you will perform on the overseas battlefields.
I really miss you all.
I hope that I will have a warm reunion with you, all officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units, as early as possible.
Your homeland is eagerly looking forward to your return home.
It is my greatest wish that all of you will return to your homeland in good health.
I request you all to pay special attention to your safety, mindful of my wish.
And be always brave.
For the fraternal Russian people,
For the mettle and characteristics of our people, for the spirit and dignity of the Korean people and for the immortal honour of our state,
And for the undying fame of our army,
Be brave.
Behind you are Pyongyang and Moscow.
Thanks to your self-sacrificing and devoted struggle, the militant fraternity and friendship and invincible alliance between our country and Russia grow firmer.
All officers and soldiers of the overseas operations units,
As I, together with your parents, wives and children, and all other people, look forward to the day when all of you will return home safely after accomplishing your mission, I once again send you new year greetings and warm militant salute. -0-

headline:
Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il

[2026.01.02.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the significant New Year 2026, all the people across the DPRK pay high tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, praying for their immortality.
On the morning of New Year's Day, officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the statues of the great leaders in different parts of the country to pay noble tribute to them.
Placed at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were flower baskets in the names of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army (KPA) and the Public Security Forces (PSF) and institutions and industrial establishments at all levels and universities in Pyongyang, and bouquets.
The visitors made bows before the statues of the President and the Chairman.
Flower baskets in the names of units of the KPA and the PSF and institutions and enterprises and bouquets were laid before the statues of the peerlessly great men in various parts of Pyongyang includingKim Il SungUniversity and the Mansudae Art Studio.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students across the country visited the statues of the great leaders in their residential areas to pay tribute to them. -0-

headline: House-moving Ceremony at Sinsaeng Farm in Chongdan County of South Hwanghae Province
New Year 2026 Significantly Greeted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- All the people across the DPRK significantly greeted the hopeful New Year 2026.
On the morning of New Year's Day, an endless stream of the people yearning for PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilflowed to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where the President and the Chairman lie in state.
The visitors paid tribute with humble reverence to the peerlessly great men at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun.
Officials, working people, service personnel, school youth and children visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before them and make bows.
The children and pupils of primary schools across the country received gifts associated with the loving care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea on the occasion of the New Year.
A circus was given by acrobats of the National Acrobatic Troupe at the Pyongyang Circus Theatre and one-act play at the National Theatre, adding to the joy of citizens.
Schoolchildren in Pyongyang also gave a performance for greeting the New Year, singing of the joy of greeting the New Year in which they will be happier under the care of the great father.
Art performances were given in South Phyongan, North Hwanghae, North Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces, Nampho Municipality and other parts of the country and sports and amusement games were played by officials, working people and youth and students in the South Hamgyong Provincial Sports Village and Hamhung Stadium.
Performances for greeting the New Year were given by children in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces, Kaesong Municipality and other areas.
The laughter of the working people, youth and students and children was heard at recreation grounds for the people including the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Munsu Water Park.
The public catering establishments in Pyongyang and local areas were crowded with visitors.
Different places of the capital city were decorated with gorgeous lights.
The happy looks of the people skating and sledding at the open-air ice rink in the central part of the capital which was decorated with amazing lights added to the joy on the night of the holiday. -0-

headline: New Year 2026 Significantly Greeted in DPRK

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Schoolchildren Participating in New Year Performance
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- Presented on New Year's Day was a picture showing the warm loving care and noble world of the benevolent father who represents the bright smile of the children, the hope and future of the DPRK, as the image of Korean-style socialism.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unon January 1 met with the schoolchildren participating in the New Year performance and warmly wished them the bright future.
The venue of the photo session was filled with the schoolchildren's great emotion and joy of meeting the fatherly Marshal, whom they had longed for even in their dreams, on New Year's Day.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue, members of the Children's Union presented fragrant bouquets to him, representing the deep thanks and New Year's greetings of all the schoolchildren across the country.
Acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers,Kim Jong Unextended warm greetings to all the schoolchildren across the country greeting the New Year.
He met the Children's Union members who glorified the honor of the country with gold medals and set examples in the study, organizational life and good-conduct movement.
He wished the bright future to the schoolchildren who are growing up smartly and boldly, having dreams about demonstrating the honor of the DPRK and studying hard to add more luster to the country.
Saying that the honest and lively features and dynamic steps of the successors and reserves who would ardently love the socialist country and add more luster to it are, indeed, the power of the DPRK making a leap forward and its proud spirit, he had a meaningful photo taken with those schoolchildren participating in the New Year performance, hoping that they would sing of their great ambition, will to carry forward the revolution and growing ideals and passion to the full.
He met with the staff members of an art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who visited their socialist homeland, and called upon them to successfully train the rising generations of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan to be the pillars who would carry forward the baton of the patriotic cause. -0-

headline: New Year Performance Given by Schoolchildren
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- Laughter and songs of the blessed younger generations growing up spiritedly and cheerfully under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea, which is beautifully shaping a bright future of the country with the ardent love and devotion to the rising generations, resound more clearly along with the hopeful New Year.

The audience enthusiastically clapped for the performers as they put on the stage such colorful numbers as songs and dances and a music and dance story, full of the dreams, ideals and passion of the schoolchildren who are preparing themselves into the masters of a powerful and prosperous country through their efforts to equip themselves with ample knowledge, high morality and strong body, enjoying the benefits of the socialist educational system.

headline: New Year 2026 Significantly Greeted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 2 (KCNA) -- All the people across the DPRK significantly greeted the hopeful New Year 2026.
On the morning of New Year's Day, an endless stream of the people yearning for PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilflowed to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where the President and the Chairman lie in state.
The visitors paid tribute with humble reverence to the peerlessly great men at the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun.
Officials, working people, service personnel, school youth and children visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before them and make bows.

Schoolchildren in Pyongyang also gave a performance for greeting the New Year, singing of the joy of greeting the New Year in which they will be happier under the care of the great father.
Art performances were given in South Phyongan, North Hwanghae, North Hamgyong and Ryanggang provinces, Nampho Municipality and other parts of the country and sports and amusement games were played by officials, working people and youth and students in the South Hamgyong Provincial Sports Village and Hamhung Stadium.
Performances for greeting the New Year were given by children in North Phyongan, South Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces, Kaesong Municipality and other areas.
The laughter of the working people, youth and students and children was heard at recreation grounds for the people including the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Munsu Water Park.
The public catering establishments in Pyongyang and local areas were crowded with visitors.
Different places of the capital city were decorated with gorgeous lights.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Congratulatory Speech to Young People and Soldier-builders Engaged in Construction of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a congratulatory speech to the young people and soldier-builders engaged in the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades, young people and officers and soldiers,
I have come here just after the national celebration to share the beginning of 2026 with you, who are greeting the new year while working at the northwestern tip of the country.
I have many things to do, but I have come here with the thought that I have to make a warm congratulatory and rallying speech to you, who are greeting the new year, working hard here far away from your families and dear homes.
Comrades,
I warmly congratulate you on greeting the new year 2026.
You deserve congratulations extended by the whole country.
You have really done a great thing.
I offer thanks to you for your efforts, with which you are erecting a monumental edifice of the times on a northwestern border of the country with your youthful strength and vigour; and greeting the new year, I convey to you salutation in the name of the Central Committee of our Party, the government of our Republic and all our people.
I really feel pleased and encouraged to see the ranks of our young people, who all look sturdier and more stalwart in the new year.
You look more dignified and manly than the columns standing in array for a military parade.
I really feel proud of you, who have turned out for this grand construction project, to which the Party and the state attach importance, and completely transformed this island, which was afflicted by a disaster, into an ideal country town in the new era within 500-odd days. I want to make a boast of you before the world.
With your spectacular feats, you have added brilliance to your glorious fame and etched the appearance of the Korean youth in the most stirring decade of our era.
I feel the real value of and always thankful for waging the revolution together with the ranks of the hot-blooded youth who are faithful and courageous all the time in supporting and implementing the plans and determination of our Party, together with the powerful artists of creation who are writing a new chapter of history of transformation through an unyielding pioneering struggle for the future.
I have made frequent visits to the construction site of this farm and today, at the outset of the new year, I have come here again not only because what you have done is enormous and important.
But it is because, with the gigantic construction struggle to transform this part of the country progressing further, I have felt it more valuable and laudable than anything else that our young people and soldier-builders are growing beyond recognition day after day.
You may also feel surprised at, and proud of, yourselves.
You are living your days of precious youth in the period of unprecedented transformation in our state’s development history. In these days you have chosen it to be worthwhile in your youth to experience hardship and training instead of enjoyment and comfort, and have cultivated a passionate spirit and strong will to learn how to overcome difficulties, how to make innovations and how to love your country. The days constitute the most valuable wealth in your life that cannot be bartered for a mountain of gold.
Witnessing the soaring spirit of our young people and seeing every creation associated with the passion and sincerity of our young generation, our people are picturing in their mind their motherland that will prosper forever; and seeing your vigorous growth, they are assured that our style of socialism is being succeeded.
For our Party responsible for the future of the country, this is a source of great happiness and satisfaction, and it is quite natural for me to call on you, our young patriots, first in the new year, to congratulate and encourage you.
Comrades,
Before long, the large-scale greenhouse farm permeated with your sweat and efforts will greet the moment when it will be dedicated as a token of loyalty to the glorious congress of the motherly Party.
And you will leave again for the theatres of gigantic creation at the call of the Party and country.
But the imprints you have left and the exploits you have performed will live long on this miraculous island, which encapsulates the level of development of your motherland that prospers day after day, and your proud creation and growth will be recorded in your autobiographies and the annals of history of the youth movement of our country.
I have no doubt that all the young vanguard and soldier-builders will further raise your indomitable spirit to present this greenhouse farm to the times as a model structure in the era of comprehensive rejuvenation of the state.
On the inauguration day, let us all pose without fail for a photo as souvenir in this place of transformation.
I am convinced that the hope-filled new year 2026 you opened with the priceless successes associated with your intense devotion will also become more glorious and livelier thanks to your burning passion, tremendous courage and wonderful creations.
On the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture, where you made your imposing departure, the Ninth Congress of the Party will greet our laudable young people.
Young vanguard and soldier-builders, who are brave pioneers of a new era,
Two days ago, Pyongyang raised a cheer in chorus for our state.
With a youthful vigour, let us also raise a cheer louder than that in Pyongyang in reflection of our infinite respect and affection for our mother Korea so that it can reverberate in Pyongyang and all other parts of the country and through the earth.
Long live the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, our glorious motherland that will prosper forever!
Comrades,
I extend new year greetings to you once again.
Let us all meet again on the inauguration day in good health with pride and dignity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Construction Site of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm to Encourage Young Builders
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 3 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the construction site of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm on Jan. 2 to congratulate and encourage all the young vanguard members and soldier-builders who greeted the significant new year in the struggle to glorify the Ninth Congress of the WPK with proud labour achievements.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK.
The young builders, who metKim Jong Unwhom they had been longing to see so much even in their dreams in the second morning of the new year, were filled with great excitement and joy.
WhenKim Jong Ungot off his private train, all the young builders fervently cheered with great reverence for him who paid his first visit in the significant new year to their construction site to offer them his warm parental greeting of best wishes.
Kim Jong Ungreatly encouraged the young people, officers and soldiers who added glory to the noble name of their generation before the times and history out of boundless patriotism, loyalty and indomitable pioneering spirit and through a heroic struggle, deeming the Party's regional development plan and decision a supreme order.
He made a meaningful congratulatory speech.
Saying that he had come there in haste right after the national events in Pyongyang to start the new year of 2026 together with the young vanguard members and soldier builders, who are greeting the new year in the northwestern tip of the country far away from their families and dear home, he extended warm greetings of encouragement to them on behalf of the Party Central Committee, the government of the Republic and all the people.
Saying that the young builders all came to the grand construction site, to which the Party and the state pay importance, so as to transform the island area, once severely hit by natural disaster, into an ideal greenhouse town symbolic of the new era in more than 500 days, he noted that during those days they opted for hardship and self-cultivation, instead of enjoyment and comfort, regarding it as a worthwhile choice of their youth, and cultivated their strong will and enthusiastic spirit of being able to overcome difficulties, make innovations and do patriotic work, and this is a valuable asset of life to be bought with nothing.
Witnessing the great strength of the youth and the edifices, all associated with enthusiasm and sincerity of our younger generation, our people are picturing the eternal prosperity of their country, he said, adding that seeing them growing up to be robust, the people also get convinced of the continuity of Korean-style socialism. headline: DPRK Men and Women Weightlifters Take First Place in Retaining World Records
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 4 (KCNA) -- The DPRK weightlifters took the first place in the country standings of retaining world records as they held ten world records in women's body-weight events and two world records in men's body-weight events in a little more than three months.
Since the International Weightlifting Federation decided to hold a new body-weight events from June 2025, DPRK weightlifters have set new world records one after another in every international game since the world championships in Norway in October.
Song Kuk Hyang and Ri Suk lifted 120 kg and 111 kg in the snatch, 150 kg and 142 kg in the clean and jerk and 270 kg and 253 kg in total in the women's 69 kg and 63 kg categories respectively, and retained all three world records of these weight categories.
Ri Song Gum and O Kwang Ok lifted 122 kg and 133 kg in the clean and jerk and 213 kg and 238 kg in total respectively in the women's 48 kg and 58 kg categories, breaking two world records respectively.
These ten world records set by DPRK women weightlifters exceed 80 percent of the total number of world records broken at present among the standard records (24) that the International Weightlifting Federation has newly set.
Meanwhile, the DPRK team took the first place in the standings of world record-holding in men's weightlifting, too, as Ro Kwang Ryol and Ri Chong Song broke world records in the clean and jerk of the 88kg category and in total of the 79kg category respectively. -0-

headline: With Motherly Affection
story_text:
One day in January 2017, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Bag Factory.
When he dropped in at the sample room of the factory, he was very satisfied with the many bags on display, saying that he would not forget that day.
After looking carefully at the bags of boys and girls from primary school to university on display for a while, he threw his eyes to the shoulder straps of the bags.
Sponges were put not only into their shoulder parts but also into their lower parts.
He said that it is not good to put the sponges into the lower parts of the straps as it will be inconvenient for the children with small hands to hold the straps and valuable materials will be wasted.
When visiting the sewing workshop, he repeatedly stressed that it is important to make even a shoulder strap well with motherly affection.
The manager of the factory was much moved by his teaching.
Since then, the factory has produced knapsack-style bags which are good-looking and high-quality, and convenient to shoulder. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Major Munitions Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 4 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited a major munitions factory on Jan. 3 to learn about the production of tactical guided weapons.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He first looked round the technically updated production areas to learn in detail about the modernization.
Expressing the view that a more innovative plan and establishment of rational system are necessary for the flexible manufacturing system and production areas, he said that, from a practical point of view, there are still some deficiencies in the modernization of assembly process and that the design of the process and the arrangement of equipment based on it are important in eliminating them. And he gave instructions to reexamine the overall plans for the new construction and modernization of munitions industry enterprises in 2026 and propose again good plans for obtaining optimum results taking into account the above aspects.
He stressed that our munitions industry should conduct economic organization and direct production and technical upgrading in a scrupulous way so as to suit the special characteristics and the present situation where the current munitions production and the modernization project should be pushed ahead with simultaneously.
He appraised multi-purpose precision guided weapons produced by the factory.
Saying that the potential military and technological power and effectiveness of our excellent tactical guided weapon system have military effective value great enough to replace even the multiple launch rocket system in the future, he stressed that major units will be equipped with this weapon system in an organized way from the first half of this year. And he underscored the need to decisively expand the current production capacity by about 2.5 times in order to meet the unit-specific demand for equipment planned by the Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff.
He stressed the need to pay deep attention to improving the quality of products under contract.
He expressed belief that all the officials, technicians and workers of the factory would take the lead in upholding the Party's policy on munitions industry with greater technological innovation and production results. -0-

headline: Kaesong Chomsongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 4 (KCNA) -- Kaesong Chomsongdae is a stone structure built in 919 as the central astronomical observatory of Koryo (918-1392).
It is situated in the western part of Manwoldae in Manwol-dong, Kaesong Municipality, the DPRK.
There remains now only an embankment built of granite. Originally, astronomical observation instruments were installed on the embankment.
The embankment is 2.8 meters high and each of its sides is 2.6 meters long.
The four sides of the embankment lie to the north, the south, the east and the west and its construction was precisely done.
The embankment shows that the structure is solid and the stone processing technique was high at that time.
From the outset of its founding, Koryo had astronomical and meteorological observation organs like Thaebokgam and Thaesaguk and made observation at Ryongdae (Astronomical Observatory) to record the results in detail.
There are more than 50 records of the sunspots observed from 1105 to the end of Koryo.
Besides, detailed records of solar eclipse, a planet occulted by moon, comet, meteor, and special astronomical phenomena are also available.
Kaesong Chomsongdae is a valuable relic showing the state of astronomical observation in the country at that time and the high architectural skills of the Middle Ages. -0-

headline: Many Units Awarded for Quality Products in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 5 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of units in the DPRK won the December 15 Quality Medal, February 2 Goods Certification and Quality Certification last year, amid a drive for increased production and creation in all sectors and units of the national economy.
Such products as primary schoolgirl bags and lysine cakes produced at the Phyongsong Bag Factory, the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory and other units were awarded the December 15 Quality Medal.
The Chongryu Pharmaceutical Factory and many other medicine producers won the GMP authentication for having put their production lines on a scientific and technological basis.
The Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory, the Kangso Mineral Water Factory and the Jangjasan General Foodstuff Factory won the food safety management system certificate for their advanced production lines.
Products of tens of units were registered as "February 2 Goods". They include the Songchon County Foodstuff Factory, the Songyo Knitwear Factory, the Pyongyang Corn Processing Factory, the Rason Samryong Footwear Factory and the Jongsong General Pharmaceutical Factory. This is unthinkable apart from sci-tech innovations. -0-

headline: Production Goes up at Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 5 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill in the DPRK are increasing the production.
After setting a high goal to renew last year's records, workers of its chemical fiber spinning combined workshop are raising the yarn production per hour through the normal operation of equipment.
Weavers of its weaving combined workshop have carried out their daily production plans by ensuring proper process-by-process engagement and introducing efficient and rational working methods.
Those at the spinning combined workshop are raising the operation rate of spinning machines and expanding their successes through a revolutionary mass movement.
The weaving shop No. 5 and the detron rayon fabrics shop under the silk-spinning combined workshop are making innovations in the production of school uniform cloth.
The dyeing combined workshop, too, is increasing production in the spirit of collectivism while taking technical measures to improve the quality of products. -0-

headline: Reception Given for Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 5 (KCNA) -- The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unprovided a reception for the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan who participated in the New Year performance. The reception was given at Okryu Restaurant on January 4.
Invited to it were members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan headed by Ri Chol Su, principal of Toshun Korean Primary School, and their parents.
Present there were officials concerned.
A speech was made at the reception.
The speaker warmly congratulated the members of the art troupe of Korean schoolchildren in Japan on the best fortune of having a photo taken with the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwhom they missed even in their dreams on the morning of New Year's Day and participating in the New Year performance.
He stressed that the respected Marshal, who is more concerned for the children in the distance than those near him, is their benevolent father who takes warm care of all sons and daughters in an alien land with his responsibility for their hope and future.
The speaker said that the patriotic cause of Chongryon (General Association of Korean Residents in Japan) will be more steadily carried forward when the Korean schoolchildren in Japan grow up lively, cheerfully and honestly, adding that the homeland will always make every effort to the growth of the children of compatriots and realizing their beautiful dreams.
The head of the art troupe in his reply speech extended thanks toKim Jong Unwho blessed the bright future of Korean schoolchildren in Japan, reflecting the unanimous mind of Chongryon officials and Koreans in Japan.
He expressed the firm resolution to take stoutly the road of patriotism and loyalty, deeply mindful of the earnest request of the respected fatherly Marshal for training the new generations of Chongryon into the pillars in carrying forward the baton of patriotic cause.
The participants in the reception wishedKim Jong Ungood health for the eternal prosperity of the socialist homeland and the victory of the patriotic cause of Chongryon.
There was an art performance at the reception. -0-
