topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Hypersonic Missile Launching Drill Conducted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 5 (KCNA) -- A sub-unit under a major firing strike group of the Korean People's Army conducted a missile launching drill on January 4.
The drill was conducted as part of the operational evaluation of the sustainability, effectiveness and operation of the DPRK's war deterrent while evaluating the readiness of the hypersonic weapon system, verifying and confirming its capability for fulfilling mission and developing the missile soldiers' firing capability.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the launching drill.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that it is a very important strategic task to maintain and expand a powerful and reliable nuclear deterrent through the sustained verification of key components of war deterrence and the improvement of its performance and the mastering of operational capabilities.
He said, appreciating the drill:
"Through today's launching drill, we can confirm that a very important technology task for national defence has been carried out.
The missile soldiers showed the readiness of the DPRK's nuclear forces without regret and gave confidence in it.
Important achievements have been recently made in putting our nuclear forces on a practical basis and preparing them for an actual war. This potential is an outcome of the Party's line on building up the national defences and its policy on attaching importance to defence science and technology and a valuable result of our outstanding scientific and technological group.
We must continuously upgrade the military means, especially offensive weapon systems. It is just an essential undertaking for self-defence. In addition, to make the rivals recognize the constant mobilization of our strategic offensive means and their fatality itself in a steady and repeated way is an important and effective mode of exercising war deterrence.
To be honest, our such activity is clearly aimed at gradually putting the nuclear war deterrent on a high-developed basis. Why it is necessary is exemplified by the recent geopolitical crisis and complicated international events."
The hypersonic missiles, launched from Ryokpho District, Pyongyang Municipality, to the northeast direction, hit the targets 1 000 km away from the East Sea of Korea.
Kim Jong Unexpressed thanks to the sub-unit participating in the drill for playing the prelude of the first combat drill in the new year with amazing launching and fully displaying the striking capability of the strong army, and extended New Year greeting to all the officers and men of the missile forces doing their best in carrying out their combat duty across the country and devoting themselves to their responsible duty for national defence.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the missile forces would remain faithful to their sacred mission as a reliable shield for defending the sovereignty and security of the DPRK by fulfilling their consistent and responsible combat duty under iron discipline.
Among the spectators were Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK and Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK. -0-

headline: January and Folk Customs of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- January is the coldest month of a year. And it has Sohan (moderate cold) and Taehan (intense cold), the last ones of the 24 seasonal divisions according to the lunar calendar.
Sohan comes before or after January 6 of the solar calendar every year, and it falls on January 5 this year.
Taehan falls on January 20 or 21 of the solar calendar every year. It is the last one of the 24 seasonal divisions of the lunar calendar.
From olden times, the Korean people, who regard farming as the great foundation of the country, have made steady preparations for farming even in January, making straw ropes and baskets in houses or collecting muck.
After Taehan, people have kept the outside and inside of their houses neat and tidy to greet the lunar New Year's Day in a clean environment and women have prepared clothes and foods for the day.
In January, the Korean people have used to enjoy hot dishes such as bean paste soup and casserole. Among them, Pyongyang Onban (cooked rice served in chicken soup), is well known for its peculiar flavour.
Besides, they have played various folk games such as yut-game, see-saw, kite-flying and sleighing.
Like this, the Korean people have created and carried forward diligent and diverse customs of life suited to the characteristics of January. -0-

headline: Many Rural Dwellings Built in DPRK Last Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- More than 32 000 rural dwellings were built across the DPRK last year.
Many agricultural workers in different parts of the country moved into new houses.
In particular, news of moving into new houses had been reported almost every day since October, inspiring the agricultural workers across the country with confidence and optimism in a new life and civilization.
The agricultural workers, who witness the new appearance of the socialist countryside which is changing beyond recognition every year, are extending thanks to the Workers' Party of Korea for putting them forward as the owners of the new rural dwellings. -0-

headline: Field Medical Service Conducted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- Public health organs in Pyongyang Municipality launched a field medical service campaign.
At the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant and the Rangnang Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory, medical workers from the Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital have explained the common knowledge of health care and general information on hygiene related to respiratory diseases while conducting medical examination in a responsible manner to encourage the workers in their drive for increased production.
Those from the Kim Man Yu Hospital and the Koryo Medicine General Hospital visited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the East Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant to conduct field treatment by applying traditional Koryo therapy with acupuncture, cupping and moxibustion in accordance with the physical constitutions of patients.
Doctors and nurses of the Ryugyong Dental Hospital gave sincere medical treatment to workers at the Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory to help them achieve bigger labor successes in good health. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Construction Site of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the construction site of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations with senior Party and government officials on January 5.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by the commanding officers of the army unit involved in the construction.
He gave encouragement to the soldier-builders, expressing thanks for devoting themselves to ensuring the best quality in every process of construction, bearing deep in mind the unanimous wish of all the people and the officers and men of the People's Army that the great heroes would be immortal.
He dug the first spadeful of earth for tree-planting under the plan for greening in the museum, together with senior officials.
He engaged himself in tree-planting for a long time with the soldier-builders, saying that even a single tree or a single blade of grass, to be rooted in the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, should be associated with our people's deep respects and noble moral obligation for the heroic soldiers who sacrificed themselves without hesitation, aspiring after the immortality and eternal prosperity of our glorious state.
He said that the noble sacrifice and heroic feats of the participants in the worthiest sacred war for justice and dignity would serve as the solid root and eternal cornerstone supporting the mightiness of the motherly DPRK, adding throb of patriotism to the mind of all generations in the Republic.
Then he went round the construction site of the museum to learn about the process of the construction project.
He said that the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations is the crystallization of our Party and people's eternal gratitude and respects for the representatives of the great fame of the country and a grand monument to the times symbolic of heroism and bravery of the Korean people's excellent sons.
He added that through the construction, another important ideological and spiritual base for education in the tradition of victory will be provided in the capital city of our state and, along with the establishment of the museum, our people will powerfully demonstrate before the world the immortality of the DPRK, our great motherland, and the invincibility of the Korean People's Army, celebrating major commemorative days including V-Day together with the heroes.
Recollecting in humble reverence the brilliant images of the war martyrs who are always alive as the eternal stars of the country, he affirmed that nobody in the world can match such army as those who readily dedicated their lives to the dignity and fame of their motherland, absolutely remaining faithful to the order of the Party and it is the immutable truth and law proven by history. And he gave precious teachings for completing the construction of the museum on the highest level.
That day,Kim Jong Unhad a photo of love and trust taken with officers and men who are devoting their all sincerity to the establishment of the museum.
All the soldier-builders made their firm pledge to perfectly build the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations into a sacred edifice of heroic Korea representing the great era ofKim Jong Un, more keenly feeling the ardent kinship of MarshalKim Jong Unwho is glorifying the noble life of the fallen servicepersons. -0-

headline: Young People Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- Young people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major worksites of socialist construction.
Young people in Sinpho City and Ragwon County volunteered to work at offshore farms, following the example of those who voluntarily advanced into regional-industry factories in Jongphyong County.
Youths in Hamhung City went to the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm and those in Sinhung, Yonggwang, Kowon, Hongwon and Hochon counties vowed to work at raw material base stations.
Young people in Tanchon City and Riwon, Pukchong, Toksong and other counties volunteered to work at construction brigade, school construction corps and other revolutionary posts called by the Workers' Party of Korea.
A meeting to congratulate the volunteers took place at the Hamhung Grand Theatre on January 5.
Present there were officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students in the province. Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers to be followed by congratulatory address and speeches.
At the end of the meeting, officials and young people encouraged the volunteers leaving for new posts, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: National Photo Exhibition Opens
National Photo Exhibition Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- A national photo exhibition "Ushering in an era of gigantic transformation for comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism" opened here to show the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unduring the term of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Displayed at the venue of the exhibition are photos ofKim Jong Unwho is ushering in a new era of national prosperity by wisely leading the all-people struggle for implementing the programme for the revolution set forth at the historic Eighth Party Congress, regarding independence in politics, self-supporting in economy and self-reliance in national defence as an invariable revolutionary line.
An opening ceremony took place at the Okryu Exhibition House on Jan. 5.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, officials concerned, officials of ministries and national agencies, working people, youth and students in the city.
Ju Chang Il made an opening address.
The speaker stressed that the term of the Eighth Party Central Committee was the one of excitement when the people across the country, rallied close around the Party Central Committee, waged a vigorous struggle to carry out the revolutionary line and important tasks set forth at the Party Congress, demonstrating the absolute power of the country to the whole world and making a series of epochal successes proving the phase of development of national prosperity in all sectors of socialist construction.
He declared the opening of the national photo exhibition, expressing belief that the exhibition would serve as an important occasion for fully demonstrating the dignity and might of the great country and greatly encouraging all the people to the revolutionary advance for implementing the new goals and tasks to be set forth at the Ninth Party Congress.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the venue of the exhibition. -0-

story_text:

headline: New Houses Built at Farms in South Hamgyong Province
Young People Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 6 (KCNA) -- Young people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major worksites of socialist construction.
Young people in Sinpho City and Ragwon County volunteered to work at offshore farms, following the example of those who voluntarily advanced into regional-industry factories in Jongphyong County.
Youths in Hamhung City went to the Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm and those in Sinhung, Yonggwang, Kowon, Hongwon and Hochon counties vowed to work at raw material base stations.
Young people in Tanchon City and Riwon, Pukchong, Toksong and other counties volunteered to work at construction brigade, school construction corps and other revolutionary posts called by the Workers' Party of Korea.
A meeting to congratulate the volunteers took place at the Hamhung Grand Theatre on January 5.
Present there were officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students in the province. Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers to be followed by congratulatory address and speeches.
At the end of the meeting, officials and young people encouraged the volunteers leaving for new posts, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 7 (KCNA) -- A performance of schoolchildren for greeting the New Year 2026 on the theme of "My Country Is the Best" is being given every day.
The performers artistically depicted the lively and cheerful feature of the rising generations growing up with nothing more to desire under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho is taking care of them with his love and affection, regarding the work related with the younger generation as the most important state affair.
The stage was colorfully decorated as members of the Children's Union and other children of talent showed their pride of honor pupils always taking the lead in the do-good-thing movement and sports activities, and their high artistic abilities and refined skills.
The music and dance story "We Grow up in the Bosom of the Marshal" touched the heartstrings of the audience as it showed the lively and cheerful appearance of the Korean schoolchildren in Japan honestly and staunchly growing up to be successors to the patriotic cause of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan, cherishing the honor of the unforgettable day when they met the respected fatherly Marshal in the yard of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Among the audience were students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School and Chilgol Revolutionary School and working people and schoolchildren in Pyongyang Municipality. -0-

Great Man and Child "Doctor"
story_text:
One day in July 2012, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the Kyongsang Kindergarten.
At its combined playroom,Kim Jong Unlooked lovely at the children making a play of doctors and then rolled up his sleeve, asking a child "doctor" in white gown to examine him.

headline: Mobile Educational Teams
story_text:
One day in August 2024, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Uninstructed officials to take decisive measures to look after the life of flood victims during the reconstruction of the flood-stricken areas in North Phyongan, Jagang and Ryanggang provinces.
Saying that officials should not be content only to bring them to Pyongyang and provide them with board and lodging, he stressed the need to take good care of them so that they could lead a comfortable life. And he gave an instruction to organize interim mobile educational teams in order to educate students of primary and middle schools from the flood-stricken areas.
Thanks to his loving care, a hundred and tens of rooms in the April 25 Hostel and the base for military parade training in the capital city of Pyongyang were turned into classrooms, laboratories, section rooms, Children's Union rooms and teachers' rooms and lots of educational equipment, school fixtures and textbooks supplied. And hundreds of school and kindergarten teachers joined the mobile educational teams and those responsible for feeding the schoolchildren with sweetened soymilk were appointed.
The organization of mobile educational teams for the children and students from flood-hit areas during their reconstruction was another important measure of love which could be taken only byKim Jong Unpossessed of the noble outlook on the rising generation that there are the children above the people being regarded as Heaven by the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: New Houses, Public and Production Buildings Built in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) -- Modern houses have been built at the Chilgol Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality and public and production buildings at the Toksan Farm under the South Hamgyong Provincial Rural Economy Committee, giving face-lifting to farm villages.
Mangyongdae District, Pyongyang Municipality successfully completed the project for building 150 low-storeyed flats, prioritizing the quality of structures.
A hall of culture, office building, pharmacy and kindergarten were newly built at the Toksan Farm under the South Hamgyong Provincial Rural Economy Committee to ensure the work of agricultural workers and offer the convenience in their life.
Attending the ceremony of moving into new houses and the inauguration ceremony of public and production buildings were Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang Municipality, Mangyongdae District, South Hamgyong Province and Jongphyong County, builders and agricultural workers.
Speeches were made there.
As congratulatory performances and cheerful dancing parties were given, farm villages were in a festive mood. -0-

headline: House-moving Ceremony at Jiha-ri, Phangyo County of Kangwon Province
Ryugyong Mushroom Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) -- The Ryugyong Mushroom Farm, situated in the suburbs of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, has contributed to improving the diet of citizens.
The farm is a modern mushroom producer with industrial and intensive production lines and all conditions necessary for mushroom cultivation.
On January 9, 2015, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built farm and said that the farm was built as intended by the Workers' Party of Korea, calling for helping Pyongyangites really benefit from it.
He indicated the tasks and ways for putting mushroom production on a scientific, intensive and industrial basis of a higher level.
True to his noble intention, the farm has put forward the solution of the substrate problem decisive of the success of mushroom production as its main task, studied and introduced substitute substrate to put production on a normal footing and used waste substrate for reproduction.
It remodeled the sterilizing furnace with its own efforts and technology to save its sterilizing time and put the worksite on a germ-free basis. It also ensured the proper temperature, moisture and ventilation in keeping with species of mushroom and characteristics of their growth stage, and increased production by using various kinds of nutrients.
The farm produces hundreds of tons of tasty and nutritious mushrooms every year and sends them to public catering establishments and many other units in Pyongyang, including baby home, orphanage, primary and middle schools for orphans and home for the aged. -0-

headline: Seven Tombs of Kaesong - Part of World's Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 8 (KCNA) -- In Haeson-ri, Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, there is a group of seven tombs dating back to the Koryo Dynasty which lie in order.
The round tombs have stone screens, stone railings and stone animals.
Some of them have a stone table, a stone lantern, a pair of stone posts, etc.
The first one in the west lies higher than the others located in order in the east.
It is still unknown who were buried there. But by judging their scales and makeup and the relics found, it is said that they are the ones of those connected to the royal family at the end of the Koryo Dynasty. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on December 31, 2025.

headline: Advanced Agricultural Sci-tech Products in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 9 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the DPRK is producing advanced agricultural sci-tech products for this year's farming.
The Institute of Agro-chemicalization directs efforts to the production of seed-covering material "Phungnyonmo No. 1" and mixed herbicide "Phuljabi No. 5" which contributed to the grain production last year.
The Plant Protection Institute developed a soilless substrate "Saessak No. 1" for cultivating rice seedlings of great significance in putting the rice seedling cultivation on an industrial basis.
The Agricultural Land Resource Institute developed a new fertilizer with the same effect as applying more nitrogen, phosphorus and potassic fertilizers.
The Agricultural Nano-technology Institute is pushing ahead with the production of agrochemical nano-additives capable of reducing the amount of agrochemicals used and increasing the weeding effect. Many other institutes are working hard to produce and supply the agricultural sci-tech products for increasing grain yields. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesman for General Staff of Korean People's Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the General Staff of the Korean People's Army made public a press statement "The Republic of Korea should be ready to pay a high price for having committed another provocation of infringing on the sovereignty of the DPRK with a drone" on January 9.
The following is the full text of the statement:
The Republic of Korea, a group of hooligans who stunned the world by causing an incident in which their drone violated the airspace of Pyongyang in October 2024, committed another grave infringement upon the sovereignty of the DPRK by making its drone violate the DPRK's airspace from the outset of the year.
On January 4, the Korean People's Army sub-units on duty for border air surveillance captured and tracked an air target moving northward from the sky over the area of Hado-ri, Songhae-myon, Kanghwa County of Inchon City. They tactically allowed it to fly 8 km away over the DPRK's airspace and struck it with special electronic warfare assets and forced it to fall into a place 1 200 meters away from Height 101.5 in Muksan-ri, Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality.
The crashed drone was equipped with surveillance devices.
Relevant intelligence and specialized investigation organs took away the remains of the fallen drone to analyze its flight plan, flight history and recorded photos.
According to the analysis result, the drone, which took off in an area of Kanghwa County, Inchon City of the ROK, at around 12:50 on January 4, was set to record by camera the DPRK's major objects while flying a total distance of 156 km at a height of 100~300 meters at the speed of 50 km an hour for three hours and ten minutes, entering Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality and the areas of Phyongsan and Kumchon counties of North Hwanghae Province under the DPRK's territory and then returning to Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province of the ROK, via Kaephung and Phanmun districts and Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality.
Recorded in the two cameras of the drone before its crash were videos of the DPRK's areas amounting to 6 minutes 59 seconds and 6 minutes 58 seconds.
The relevant video data are a clear proof that the drone violated the territorial air of the DPRK for surveillance and reconnaissance of its area.
Even after the change of a regime of hooligans in Seoul, the ROK has continued to committee such acts of provocation by drones near the border.
Availing ourselves of this opportunity, we cannot but mention about the fact that the ROK committed a provocative act of conducting surveillance and reconnaissance of our major objects by flying a drone into the territorial air of the DPRK in September last.
The enemy's drone, which took off in the area of Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province of the ROK, at around 11:15 on September 27 last year, was dropped by the electronic strike by the special military technology means of our 2nd Corps into a paddy field in the area of Sasi-ri, Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality at around 14:25 while returning via Kaesong Municipality after infiltrating into the sky above Phyongsan County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
According to the analysis of its input flight plan and recorded flight history, this drone took off at Jangja-ri, Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province, and it was set to record by camera our side's major objects, including some in Phyongsan County of North Hwanghae Province, Mt Janam in Kaesong Municipality, Panmunjom, former Kaesong Industrial Zone and military posts near the border line, while flying a total distance of 167 km at an altitude of 300 meters at the speed of 50 km an hour for three hours and twenty minutes in the sky over Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality, Phyongsan County of North Hwanghae Province and then Kaephung and Phanmun districts of Kaesong Municipality under the DPRK's territory before returning to its base.
Like the recently crashed drone, the then fallen drone is a small fixed-wing drone, a clear surveillance and reconnaissance mean capable of flying at a height of less than 500 meters for six hours at maximum and of capturing ground objects with a high-resolution optical camera tipped at the bottom of its body.
The communication and navigation mode applied to it, the flight plan input into it, the flight history and video data recorded in it, etc., go to prove that the drone conducted an air reconnaissance and was specially made for it.
Recorded in the camera of the then drone was 5-hour and 47-minute video data on major objects of our region.
Those drones freely passed through the sky over the area, where the ROK army has intensively deployed various radars for detecting low-altitude targets and anti-drone equipment, after making a daytime takeoff at a sensitive frontline area of the ROK where civilian access is strictly prohibited. The fact makes it easy to guess who is behind the drones' infiltration.
Saying in public that "it is necessary to drill even a hole like a needle point" in order to communicate with the DPRK, the ROK does not stop committing a provocative act against it. It helped us again to have hostility toward the real nature of the ROK.
Our stand is clear.
The ROK is the enemy most hostile towards us that can never be changed in nature, and the object to be certainly collapsed by us if it attacks.
The ROK is a perfect copy of Kiev's lunatics.
The international community should clearly understand what is the root cause of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula and inviting the danger of armed conflict.
We strongly denounce the hooligans' serial outrageous encroachment upon our sovereignty and undisguised provocative acts against us and seriously warn the ROK authorities who revealed once again their black-hearted intention to have a showdown with us.
They should immediately stop an act of inviting their destruction.
The ROK military warmongers will be surely forced to pay a dear price for their unpardonable hysteria.
The ROK authorities can never evade the responsibility for escalating tension. -0-

headline: Blessed New Year's Day

headline: Officials Conduct First Friday Labour in DPRK
story_text:

headline: Blessed New Year's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unmet the schoolchildren participating in the New Year performance on the first morning of 2026 and warmly blessed them.
Looking up to the benevolent Marshal who is blessing the future of the schoolchildren growing up while learning working knowledge to make the country stronger, the people across the country are looking back with emotion on the New Year's Day two years ago.
On January 1, 2024,Kim Jong Uncame to Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace to celebrate the New Year's Day with schoolchildren.
He warmly waved to the schoolchildren giving artistry presentation and watched their lovely appearances for a long time at the dance hall.
He listened to the story about the pride of exemplary Children's Union members about knowledge, virtue and strong physique and clapped for the performers while enjoying the New Year performance.
Upon hearing the moving news that the participants in the New Year performance had a photo session with the fatherly Marshal, people said with excitement that they are blessed on the New Year's Day thanks to the loving care of the benevolent father who always prioritizes the policy for the children out of his noble idea that our children are given priority over the people who are regarded by the Party as Heaven.
On this New Year's Day, too, the respected fatherly Marshal had a photo taken with them, hoping the participants in the New Year performance would sing of their ideal and ardent enthusiasm to their heart's content.
The laughter and songs of the children, who were blessed on the New Year's Day under the care of their tender-hearted father, will resound far and wide forever. -0-

headline: Statement of Spokesman for General Staff of Korean People's Army
Press Statement of Spokesman for General Staff of Korean People's Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 10 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the General Staff of the Korean People's Army made public a press statement "The Republic of Korea should be ready to pay a high price for having committed another provocation of infringing on the sovereignty of the DPRK with a drone" on January 9.
The following is the full text of the statement:
The Republic of Korea, a group of hooligans who stunned the world by causing an incident in which their drone violated the airspace of Pyongyang in October 2024, committed another grave infringement upon the sovereignty of the DPRK by making its drone violate the DPRK's airspace from the outset of the year.
On January 4, the Korean People's Army sub-units on duty for border air surveillance captured and tracked an air target moving northward from the sky over the area of Hado-ri, Songhae-myon, Kanghwa County of Inchon City. They tactically allowed it to fly 8 km away over the DPRK's airspace and struck it with special electronic warfare assets and forced it to fall into a place 1 200 meters away from Height 101.5 in Muksan-ri, Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality.
The crashed drone was equipped with surveillance devices.
Relevant intelligence and specialized investigation organs took away the remains of the fallen drone to analyze its flight plan, flight history and recorded photos.
According to the analysis result, the drone, which took off in an area of Kanghwa County, Inchon City of the ROK, at around 12:50 on January 4, was set to record by camera the DPRK's major objects while flying a total distance of 156 km at a height of 100~300 meters at the speed of 50 km an hour for three hours and ten minutes, entering Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality and the areas of Phyongsan and Kumchon counties of North Hwanghae Province under the DPRK's territory and then returning to Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province of the ROK, via Kaephung and Phanmun districts and Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality.
Recorded in the two cameras of the drone before its crash were videos of the DPRK's areas amounting to 6 minutes 59 seconds and 6 minutes 58 seconds.
The relevant video data are a clear proof that the drone violated the territorial air of the DPRK for surveillance and reconnaissance of its area.
Even after the change of a regime of hooligans in Seoul, the ROK has continued to committee such acts of provocation by drones near the border.
Availing ourselves of this opportunity, we cannot but mention about the fact that the ROK committed a provocative act of conducting surveillance and reconnaissance of our major objects by flying a drone into the territorial air of the DPRK in September last.
The enemy's drone, which took off in the area of Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province of the ROK, at around 11:15 on September 27 last year, was dropped by the electronic strike by the special military technology means of our 2nd Corps into a paddy field in the area of Sasi-ri, Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality at around 14:25 while returning via Kaesong Municipality after infiltrating into the sky above Phyongsan County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
According to the analysis of its input flight plan and recorded flight history, this drone took off at Jangja-ri, Joksong-myon, Phaju City, Kyonggi Province, and it was set to record by camera our side's major objects, including some in Phyongsan County of North Hwanghae Province, Mt Janam in Kaesong Municipality, Panmunjom, former Kaesong Industrial Zone and military posts near the border line, while flying a total distance of 167 km at an altitude of 300 meters at the speed of 50 km an hour for three hours and twenty minutes in the sky over Kaephung District of Kaesong Municipality, Phyongsan County of North Hwanghae Province and then Kaephung and Phanmun districts of Kaesong Municipality under the DPRK's territory before returning to its base.
Like the recently crashed drone, the then fallen drone is a small fixed-wing drone, a clear surveillance and reconnaissance mean capable of flying at a height of less than 500 meters for six hours at maximum and of capturing ground objects with a high-resolution optical camera tipped at the bottom of its body.
The communication and navigation mode applied to it, the flight plan input into it, the flight history and video data recorded in it, etc., go to prove that the drone conducted an air reconnaissance and was specially made for it.
Recorded in the camera of the then drone was 5-hour and 47-minute video data on major objects of our region.
Those drones freely passed through the sky over the area, where the ROK army has intensively deployed various radars for detecting low-altitude targets and anti-drone equipment, after making a daytime takeoff at a sensitive frontline area of the ROK where civilian access is strictly prohibited. The fact makes it easy to guess who is behind the drones' infiltration.
Saying in public that "it is necessary to drill even a hole like a needle point" in order to communicate with the DPRK, the ROK does not stop committing a provocative act against it. It helped us again to have hostility toward the real nature of the ROK.
Our stand is clear.
The ROK is the enemy most hostile towards us that can never be changed in nature, and the object to be certainly collapsed by us if it attacks.
The ROK is a perfect copy of Kiev's lunatics.
The international community should clearly understand what is the root cause of escalating tension on the Korean peninsula and inviting the danger of armed conflict.
We strongly denounce the hooligans' serial outrageous encroachment upon our sovereignty and undisguised provocative acts against us and seriously warn the ROK authorities who revealed once again their black-hearted intention to have a showdown with us.
They should immediately stop an act of inviting their destruction.
The ROK military warmongers will be surely forced to pay a dear price for their unpardonable hysteria.
The ROK authorities can never evade the responsibility for escalating tension. -0-

headline: Kelp Transplantation Starts at Fishery Units in West Coastal Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Kelp transplantation is in full swing at the fishery units in the west coastal area of the DPRK.
The Pupho Offshore Farm, which over-fulfilled its plan for seaweeds production last year, has achieved successes from the beginning of the year.
On the basis of the indices including the depth and the flow speed of sea water, culturists of the production workshops Nos. 1 and 2 are installing aquaculture equipment in good time.
Those of the production workshops Nos. 3 and 4 are speeding up their work while observing technical regulations.
The Kumipho Fishery Station has made successes in kelp transplantation.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Fourth-stage Construction Project in Hwasong Area Nearing Completion
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance over the four-stage construction project in the Hwasong area nearing completion on Jan. 10.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior party and government officials.
He was greeted on the spot by Vice-Premier Kim Jong Gwan and officials of the headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang and designing organs.
Thanks toKim Jong Un's grand plan for the capital city construction and energetic guidance to turn the capital city of the DPRK into a world-class civilized city, a large architectural group of another style different from the past embodying a good harmony of architectural formative and artistic beauty and advanced nature has sprung up in the Hwasong area to demonstrate its majestic and peculiar appearance.
The construction of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area, pushed forward under the 2025 capital city construction plan decided by the Eleventh Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, is now under way at 99 percent of the total project.
Kim Jong Unfirst looked at the layout of buildings and a general map showing the bird's-eye view of housing construction area in Hwasong to learn in detail about the construction project.
Through the struggle for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, which has been pushed ahead with in the period of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, our architectural field is making remarkable progress and the potential of our state is being redoubled, he said, adding this is great progress that vividly shows the prosperity and development of the country along with the success in remarkably enhancing the strategic function and position of the capital city.
He referred to the important feature of the fact that the construction of the Hwasong area, planned and started for the solution of the housing problem in the capital city, has been converted into the one of attaining all components and functions as a full-fledged urban administrative district.
He said that in the last two years we have put main stress on improving the rational arrangement and function of urban components in the capital city construction and focused great attention and guidance on it, adding that the function and appearance of the capital city are undergoing signal change accordingly and that we have formulated a theory and set a model example and result in the combination of urban formation and architectural elements.
Expressing satisfaction over the correct implementation of the Party's decision on building the Hwasong area as a functional prototype of administrative district, he said that if the construction plan for 2026 is carried out, the Hwasong area will be the most developed area in the capital city which perfectly embodies the political, economic and cultural functions as an urban administrative district, and this will powerfully lead the construction, to be carried out across the country in the future, as experience like a textbook and standard in not only prosperity and history of construction of our capital city but also the field of architecture, especially in the urban formation.
He expressed his view on drawing up a plan for the capital city construction to be submitted to the 9th Congress of the WPK.
He went round Saeppyol Street newly built in the Hwasong area.
Thanks to his direct initiative and guidance, another architectural group, in which high-rise, medium- and low-storied apartment houses, commercial and service facilities and other public buildings are in ideal harmony, is presenting a spectacular sight in the Hwasong area, apart from the construction plan of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage.
He said that the capital city should always play a leading role in promoting the steady cultural development of the country, adding that for this purpose it is necessary to regularize the construction law in detail, build in a peculiar way standardized facilities with the function for welfare and sports service essential to residential districts and actively develop and arrange new service occupations capable of satisfying the cultural needs and demands of citizens.
Going round houses in Saeppyol Street, he expressed satisfaction.
Watching with pleasure the Hwasong area which has become a brilliant landscape of socialist civilization, he said with pride that the capital city has really changed and that the five-year hard-fought struggle is worthwhile. The scope and goal of our struggle are being further expanded and raised and the eye-opening changes are becoming a sure trend representing today's Korea, along with the construction projects being widely conducted on a nationwide scale, he added.
He stressed that the speed of such changes should be defined as the speed of advance of the Korean revolution and it should be turned into the custom of Korean-style socialism to have a new miracle in the season when every year ends, saying that the Hwasong area is a symbol of the times convincing one of the bright future of our cause making a more dynamic advance and making a leap forward day by day towards the goal of building a highly civilized state with far-reaching ideal.
Saying that construction is a revolution disallowing self-congratulation or satisfaction even a moment and that architecture should be steadily oriented to new things and constantly developed as a visual expression of the contemporary ideology and cultural level, he stressed the need to steadily boost the potential capability of designing and construction work. And he set forth the important tasks that would serve as guidelines for implementing the construction policy.
Stressing that it is a major principle of the Party's policy on the capital city construction to set new standards in urban management and pay deep attention to cultural environmental management including greening, he indicated the orientation and ways for implementing it.
He expressed belief that the builders of the capital city would successfully complete the new streets for the people as monumental edifices of the times with their redoubled wisdom, enthusiasm and fighting spirit, cherishing the unusual honor and pride of being worthwhile creators and pioneers writing a new history of prosperity and development of the country. -0-

story_text:

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The ROK authorities can not evade their responsibility for the grave violation of our sovereignty" on January 10:
On January 10, the ROK Ministry of Defence repeatedly stressed that the recent drone infiltration was not a military operation and expressed its will to thoroughly investigate the possibility as a civilian deed. We pay attention to the publication of such stand.
I, personally, appreciate that the ROK Ministry of Defence took a wise choice for survival when it made pubic its official stand never to provoke or irritate us.
If the ROK opts for provocation against us again in the future, it will never be able to deal with the terrible consequences to be entailed by it.
The present authorities of Seoul are not entitled to treat the past case of drone infiltration into Pyongyang, committed by the former rouge Yoon regime, as other's deed.
Which regime committed the case is a matter of debate within the same family. To us, the case is a grave infringement upon the DPRK's inviolable sovereignty committed by the ROK, no matter whether Yoon or Ree did.
Fortunately, the ROK's military expressed an official stand that it was not done by itself and that it has no intention to provoke or irritate us. But a detail explanation should be made about the actual case of a drone that crossed the southern border of our Republic from the ROK.
Now in the ROK there exists an attempt to gloss the grave border-crossing infiltration as a "civilian case", alongside the assertion that "the drone was composed of low-cost conventional components that can be easily purchased" and "it is a type sold for recreational, commercial and industrial purposes." But the essence of the situation lies not in whether its manipulator is from the military or civilians.
We don't care whether it is a type that can be easily purchased and made or not, whether it is for military use or civilian use, whether its parts are low-cost or high-cost ones, and whether it is a military or civilian deed, as that is not the one we want to know.
Clear is just the fact that the drone from the ROK violated the airspace of our country.
It is undeniable that video data collected by the drone are related to the uranium mine and its settling pond, the former Kaesong industrial zone and our border guard posts, which they may have interest in. Furthermore, there actually existed the flight plan and records in the drone. This requires explicit explanation.
Given their assertion that it is not a military drone, it seems that they are seeking to argue that it is not a sovereignty violation.
No matter who is the perpetrator and whether it is a deed by any civilian organization or individual, the authorities responsible for national security can never evade their responsibility for it.
The ROK military once bragged about "real-time drone detection and response system based on latest technology", "multi-layer defence system based on the cooperation between citizens, government, military and police" and "dense anti-air defence network". They are insisting they were "ignorant" of the flying object crossing the border at a low altitude after taking off in broad daylight in an area near the border with our country. This is really unreasonable and will invite criticism from their population.
The ROK already earned a "reputation" for its sheer impudence and unreasonable insistence when it committed a provocation by infiltrating a drone into the sky above Pyongyang in 2024.
The ROK authorities can never evade the responsibility for infringing upon our sovereignty and would be well advised to seriously consider a dear price for it.
If they brand it as a deed of a civilian organization and then try to assert a theory that it is not an infringement upon the sovereignty, they will see a lot of UAVs by the DPRK's civilian organizations.
Anyhow, the recent drone infiltration helped us to have clearer understanding of the ROK, a group of hooligans and scrap, once again. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Neo-Militarism of Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- From the outset of the new year, the present ultra-right ruling forces of Japan are adding a serious danger to the security environment in the region and the rest of the world, openly challenging to the trend of the times and history.
It is a typical example that Japan is working hard to push forward the revision of the three security documents including the "national security strategy" within this year.
The main contents of the three security documents to be amended by Japan this time will include increased "defense cost", revision of the "three principles of denuclearization", cancellation of the restriction on arms export and massive development of offensive military capabilities.
Through it, Japan is mulling to throw away even the mask of "pacifist state" and make it a rule and national policy to evolve into a war state and an aggressor state.
This is a clear revelation of the neo-militarist frenzy to totally deny its past crimes and bring back the era of old empire at any cost through rapid rearmament.
The documents related with security including the "national security strategy" totally contrary to the international law adopted to prevent the revival of militarism after the end of the Second World War and the present constitution which stipulates the abandonment of belligerent rights and non- possession of combat power, are, in fact, far beyond the scope of "exclusive defense" and they are war strategies aimed at overseas expansion as recognized by the international community.
In fact, the "national security strategy" the Abe regime mapped out and announced for the first time in 2013, advocating "strong Japan", has been further modified and supplemented with more aggressive and offensive contents including the acquirement of the "capability of attacking enemy bases" (capability for counterattack) to legalize a preemptive attack on other countries.
The "defense cost" has been increased for 12 consecutive years, surpassing the world's military powers in the rate of its increase, and allotted to the improvement of the capabilities of the SDF forces for war including the development and purchase of various war means.
The present regime has employed all means and methods since its inauguration to realize the "cherished desire" of ultra-right political forces including the revision of the constitution which the former regimes failed to do.
In addition, a new process chart of the main plan for extending the operational sphere and military activities of the SDF even into space has been worked out and a hundred and tens of "powder storehouses" are being newly built on the archipelago to cope with a prolonged war.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan is now trying to turn itself into a nuclear weapons state.
The prime minister officially announced at the outset of the new year the revision of the three security documents including the "national security strategy" within the year amid the mounting nuclear frenzy among the Japanese rulers claiming that Japan should have access to nuclear weapons and no option should be excluded. This is pursuant to the frantic moves of the ultra-right forces for reinvasion to arm the archipelago with new militarism as early as possible.
It is by no means fortuitous that even Japanese media commented it is difficult to guarantee that Japan would not follow the fascist path in the period of militarism again.
The Japanese reactionaries' sinister intention to destroy the regional military balance and emerge as "leader of Asia" by copying the method of the "great Japanese empire", which had started overseas aggression while talking about "external threat", was brought to light.
The neo-militarism, obsessed with hatred for other nations, revanchism and ambition for conquest, started to rise up in the period of the Abe regime and has become rampant in the present era. This is the worst state of emergency in which peace and stability of the world can be harassed and the destiny of mankind slashed.
Japan will face a total destruction only through neo- militarism.
As historically proved, the destination of militarism was ruined Japan, not "strong Japan". -0-

headline: New Houses Built in Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at farm villages of Singye-ri, Hoeyang County and Jiha-ri, Phangyo County, Kangwon Province.
The houses designed to ensure modernity, cultural refinement and diversity while preserving the features of the relevant areas clearly demonstrate the validity and vitality of the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on rural construction aiming at turning all rural villages across the country into rich and cultured socialist ideal ones in the near future.
Congratulatory addresses were made at the ceremonies of moving into new houses attended by officials of the Party and power organs in Kangwon Province and Hoeyang and Phangyo counties, builders and agricultural workers.
At the ceremonies licenses for the use of houses were handed over and oath-taking speeches were made.
As the house-moving began amid the cheerful dancing parties, the officials congratulated the agricultural workers on moving into new houses and shared joy with them. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The ROK authorities can not evade their responsibility for the grave violation of our sovereignty" on January 10:
On January 10, the ROK Ministry of Defence repeatedly stressed that the recent drone infiltration was not a military operation and expressed its will to thoroughly investigate the possibility as a civilian deed. We pay attention to the publication of such stand.
I, personally, appreciate that the ROK Ministry of Defence took a wise choice for survival when it made pubic its official stand never to provoke or irritate us.
If the ROK opts for provocation against us again in the future, it will never be able to deal with the terrible consequences to be entailed by it.
The present authorities of Seoul are not entitled to treat the past case of drone infiltration into Pyongyang, committed by the former rouge Yoon regime, as other's deed.
Which regime committed the case is a matter of debate within the same family. To us, the case is a grave infringement upon the DPRK's inviolable sovereignty committed by the ROK, no matter whether Yoon or Ree did.
Fortunately, the ROK's military expressed an official stand that it was not done by itself and that it has no intention to provoke or irritate us. But a detail explanation should be made about the actual case of a drone that crossed the southern border of our Republic from the ROK.
Now in the ROK there exists an attempt to gloss the grave border-crossing infiltration as a "civilian case", alongside the assertion that "the drone was composed of low-cost conventional components that can be easily purchased" and "it is a type sold for recreational, commercial and industrial purposes." But the essence of the situation lies not in whether its manipulator is from the military or civilians.
We don't care whether it is a type that can be easily purchased and made or not, whether it is for military use or civilian use, whether its parts are low-cost or high-cost ones, and whether it is a military or civilian deed, as that is not the one we want to know.
Clear is just the fact that the drone from the ROK violated the airspace of our country.
It is undeniable that video data collected by the drone are related to the uranium mine and its settling pond, the former Kaesong industrial zone and our border guard posts, which they may have interest in. Furthermore, there actually existed the flight plan and records in the drone. This requires explicit explanation.
Given their assertion that it is not a military drone, it seems that they are seeking to argue that it is not a sovereignty violation.
No matter who is the perpetrator and whether it is a deed by any civilian organization or individual, the authorities responsible for national security can never evade their responsibility for it.
The ROK military once bragged about "real-time drone detection and response system based on latest technology", "multi-layer defence system based on the cooperation between citizens, government, military and police" and "dense anti-air defence network". They are insisting they were "ignorant" of the flying object crossing the border at a low altitude after taking off in broad daylight in an area near the border with our country. This is really unreasonable and will invite criticism from their population.
The ROK already earned a "reputation" for its sheer impudence and unreasonable insistence when it committed a provocation by infiltrating a drone into the sky above Pyongyang in 2024.
The ROK authorities can never evade the responsibility for infringing upon our sovereignty and would be well advised to seriously consider a dear price for it.
If they brand it as a deed of a civilian organization and then try to assert a theory that it is not an infringement upon the sovereignty, they will see a lot of UAVs by the DPRK's civilian organizations.
Anyhow, the recent drone infiltration helped us to have clearer understanding of the ROK, a group of hooligans and scrap, once again. -0-

headline: Kelp Transplantation Starts at Fishery Units in West Coastal Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 11 (KCNA) -- Kelp transplantation is in full swing at the fishery units in the west coastal area of the DPRK.
The Pupho Offshore Farm, which over-fulfilled its plan for seaweeds production last year, has achieved successes from the beginning of the year.
On the basis of the indices including the depth and the flow speed of sea water, culturists of the production workshops Nos. 1 and 2 are installing aquaculture equipment in good time.
Those of the production workshops Nos. 3 and 4 are speeding up their work while observing technical regulations.
The Kumipho Fishery Station has made successes in kelp transplantation.
With one mind to provide the people with tasty kelp, the culturists have introduced advanced methods of managing aquaculture grounds suited to sea water temperature and sunshine conditions.
Employees of the Ongjin Offshore Farm completed kelp transplantation in a short span of time while keeping the requirements of technical regulations. -0-

Press Statement of DPRK Permanent Mission to UN
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- The permanent mission of the DPRK to the United Nations issued the following press statement on January 12:
The U.S. is planning to hold at the UN headquarters a briefing on the report of the "multilateral sanctions monitoring team (MSMT)", an illegal ghost organization that has no connection with the UN in practice.
The permanent mission of the DPRK to the UN expresses serious concern over the extremely malicious attempt of the U.S. to attach "legitimacy" to the plot-breeding organization cooked up by itself and turn the sacred UN into a theatre of confrontation intended to make unreasonable accusation against a sovereign state, and resolutely opposes and rejects it.
The existence of the MSMT cooked up by some Western countries hostile to the DPRK at will outside the UN framework is illegal itself and its activities are also illegitimate.
It is a mockery of all UN member states and an open insult to the UN Charter that the briefing is going to be convened at the UN conference room in order to propagate the data fabricated by the illegal organization which is not internationally recognized.
The matter of concern of the UN member states with sound thought and reason at present is not the absurd sermon of the U.S. to imagine, fabricate and propagate someone's "cyber threat" but its rogue acts being exercised ruthlessly while making a profound confusing of right and wrong in the international arena.
The U.S. is withdrawing from UN organizations at random which it regards as unnecessary while openly violating the UN Charter and all principles of international laws. But the U.S. is speaking about "observing the resolutions" of the UN Security Council. It is the height of impudence and an extreme and intensive expression of double standards.
What should be questioned and openly discussed in the UN as the most important pending issue is the hideous criminal act of the U.S. which wantonly violates the spirit of the UN Charter and other international laws and ruthlessly destroys the international order through the outrageous use of force.
The U.S. despises the existence of the UN itself and gives up its due duty as a member state of the UN. Its irrationality and malpractice of abusing the UN arena to satisfy its geopolitical self-interest should never be allowed.
The UN member states should heighten their vigilance against the U.S. shameless illegal and immoral acts of trying to make a mockery of the UN arena for unilateral and selfish purposes and send unanimous denunciation and rejection to it.
We will not tolerate any attempt of the United States to use the UN as a means of denunciation and pressure against a sovereign state, but will continue to make efforts to defend genuine international justice as a responsible member of the United Nations. -0-

headline: Ferroalloy Furnace Remodeled in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, scientists of the Ferrous Metal Research Institute of the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK succeeded in remodeling the ferroalloy furnace at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex into an energy-saving one.
As a result, the grade of ferroalloy was improved, the electricity consumption reduced and the productivity increased. And a scientific and technological guarantee was provided for improving the quality of ferroalloy while lowering the standard of material consumption per unit. -0-

headline: Myongrung Tomb Cluster in Kaesong - World's Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- In Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK, there are three tombs called Myongrung tomb cluster. The tombs are located at the foot of a mountain about 1 km west of the Mausoleum of King Wang Kon.
One of them is the tomb of Hyon Hyo, the 29th king (1345-1348) of Koryo, and other two tombs are believed to have been built nearly in the same period as their architectural styles are the same with the former.
Constellations are drawn in the ceilings of one-chamber tombs. Their walls with mural paintings are made up of slab stones.
Myongrung tomb cluster helps grasp the process of memorial service in the period of Koryo dynasty through the layout of stone buildings at the royal palace and the structure of tomb chambers. -0-

headline: First Day of Sports Observed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 12 (KCNA) -- Citizens of the DPRK conducted mass sports activities on the first day of sports for this year.
Sports games were held at commissions, ministries and national agencies.
Officials of the Agricultural Commission, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry and the Ministry of Machine-building Industry played ball games, including basketball and volleyball, to show their good skills.
Those at the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Culture and the Taesongsan Guidance Bureau took part in Taekwon-Do and tennis and other games, in which they displayed their sports skills cultivated during their mass sports activities.
Working people at the industrial establishments in Pyongyang were overflowing with revolutionary enthusiasm.
Workers at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and other units played football, volleyball and other games. The players demonstrated their team spirit and solidarity amid the enthusiastic cheering of each team.
Universities and schools at all levels, includingKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology and Ryomyong Senior Middle School in Taesong District, held sports and folk games and sports and amusement games.
Various mass sports games took place in different parts of the country.
Sports and amusement games, including football, basketball, volleyball and riding, which took place at Hamhung Stadium and the South Hamgyong Provincial Sports Village, showed the enthusiasm of working people, youth and students in the industrial province.
At the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, etc., workers displayed their high spirit in sports games. -0-

headline: First Day of Sports Observed in DPRK
story_text:

Sports games were held at commissions, ministries and national agencies.
Officials of the Agricultural Commission, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, the Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry and the Ministry of Machine-building Industry played ball games, including basketball and volleyball, to show their good skills.
Those at the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Culture and the Taesongsan Guidance Bureau took part in Taekwon-Do and tennis and other games, in which they displayed their sports skills cultivated during their mass sports activities.

Workers at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill and other units played football, volleyball and other games. The players demonstrated their team spirit and solidarity amid the enthusiastic cheering of each team.

story_text:

headline: Preparations for Fishing Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- Fishery stations on the west coast of the DPRK are busy with the preparations for spring fishing.
The Mundok Thaehyang Fishery Station has secured materials of different kinds and sizes for repairing fishing boats and fishing tackles, new nets and anchors while overhauling wire ropes.
The station has produced accessories and parts needed for repairing fishing boats while ensuring the supply of power with fuel common in its region. The repaired fishing boats are undergoing a technical re-examination.
The Kamapho Fishery Station is stepping up the preparations for going out fishing, while mass-producing paint developed by itself.
Unjon and Jongju fishery stations are repairing fishing boats and fishing tackles to ensure intensive fishing.
Nampho and Haeju fishery stations, too, are making preparations for going out fishing, after setting the goals for improving the technical conditions of fishing boats and fishing tackles. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Permanent Representative of DPRK to UN
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- Kim Song, permanent representative of the DPRK to the UN, issued the following press statement on Jan. 13:
Another unusual meeting was convened in the UN arena today, undermining and sacrificing the sacred name and noble mission of the UN, a signpost and an absolute symbol of justice and equality.
The retaliatory blow of Russia was called into question.
The emergency meeting of the UN Security Council convened under Ukraine's unilateral claims never means the international support for the appeal of a "victim".
It is just an extension of the customary practice of the Western cavilers who used to groundlessly slander the just exercise of the right to self-defence of a sovereign state.
The target of denunciation and rejection is the Kiev authorities who committed illegal military terrorist attacks on Russia and those forces who actively patronized them.
I express serious concern and strongly denounce and reject the shameless acts of Ukraine which covered up its heinous terrorism against Russia and took issue with Russia over its legitimate measures against it.
The Ukrainian crisis was obviously caused by the confrontation policy of the U.S. and the West which have violated Russia's reasonable and legitimate security interests and escalated NATO's eastward advance.
The responsibility for all the incidents lies entirely with the parties who created the preconditions for them.
The terrorist act targeting the absolute sovereignty of a country can never be justified, and retaliation of justice can never be demonized by any assertion.
The use of military means by the armed forces of the Russian Federation is an expression of its absolute will not to tolerate threats to its national sovereignty and a just exercise of the right for defending its legitimate rights and interests.
Consistent and invariable is the DPRK's stand to fully support the just cause of the Russian Federation for defending the national sovereignty, territorial integrity, security and interests.
The international community should heighten vigilance over the West's sinister attempt to turn black and white, distort the facts and change the victim and perpetrator, and should make responsible efforts to defend genuine international justice, peace and stability. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 13 (KCNA) -- A photo exhibition "Bringing up a large contingent of successors to the revolution and patriotic youth with great policy of valuing the youth" opened with due ceremony at the Central Youth Hall on Monday to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
On display at the venue of the exhibition are the photos dealing with the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great men who brought up the rising generations to be reliable successors to the revolutionary cause of Juche with their unique policy of attaching importance to the youth.
Also on display there are the photos showing the heroic struggle and feats of the young people, who built many grand monumental edifices in different parts of the country, and the noble virtues and traits being displayed by them.
Present at the opening ceremony were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang.
Mun Chol, chairman of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, made an opening address.
The speaker said that the exhibition serves as an important occasion in making the young people grasp the greatness and exploits of the Party, which is writing a new history of the youth power without an equal in the world, and creditably discharge their mission and duty as the scout unit of the Party in the historic advance toward a new victory of the revolution.
He called upon all the officials of the youth league and the youth to advance more vigorously and courageously to greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK as the one of victors and glory, rallied close around the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwith patriotism.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the exhibition venue. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The Ministry of Public Health of the DPRK is directing efforts to training medical workers, true to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on public health.
Officials of the ministry and relevant units set a goal to innovate new contents and methods of vocational technical education and are carrying it out step by step.
The vocational technical education institute under the ministry has applied a research-type teaching method to subjects, raising the practical abilities and qualifications of teachers.
And it is taking measures to train students to be talents with practical abilities by drawing up a new curriculum for strengthening foreign language education from the new school year.
The provincial vocational technology colleges for medical workers and the classes for training nurses of city and county hospitals are directing efforts to practical education so that all the students can acquire the abilities and qualifications for treating and nursing patients well.

headline: Juche-oriented Civilian Defence Forces
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungdeveloped the plan to found the Juche-oriented civilian defence forces on the basis of the valuable experience gained in building the civilian armed forces during the anti-Japanese armed struggle and immediately after the liberation of the country.
One day in January 1959, the President visited Wonhwa village in Phyongwon County and talked with union members to learn in detail about the size and organization of the self-defence force of Wonhwa-ri, its emergency mobilization order and training.
He clarified the plan to build the people's self-defence forces into a stronger armed organization and learned about the intention of the union members.
He confirmed that the conditions for forming a civilian military organization of a new type were ripe from the people expressing absolute support for the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The simple voice of the people helped the President further cement the far-reaching plan for putting all the people under arms. He called an official by phone and finally confirmed the name of the new civilian armed forces.
Saying that it would be better to call the forces the "red guards" rather than the "red self-defense forces", the President suggested calling it the "Worker-Peasant Red Guards" in the sense of an armed organization comprising all the people including workers and peasants.
After confirming the name of the new civilian armed forces as the "Worker-Peasant Red Guards", he founded the Worker-Peasant Red Guards (then), the Juche-oriented civilian armed forces brilliantly carrying forward the traditions of the anti-Japanese struggle, on January 14, 1959.
The founding of the Juche-oriented civilian defence forces was an event of historic significance in establishing the all-people and nationwide defence system with the People's Army as the core and bolstering up its might in every way. -0-

headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Letter from Members of Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived on January 13 a letter from the members of the 35th Art Troupe of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan who participated in the 2026 New Year performance of schoolchildren.
Before leaving the homeland, we, on behalf of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and all Koreans in Japan, make a deep bow of thanks to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho regards the children of Korean compatriots in the alien land as gold and gems and provided them with the whole of glory and happiness they wished even in their dreams, the letter stressed.
The members said in the letter that whenever they heard the news of the revolutionary activities of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unalmost every day during their visit to the homeland, they devoted all their wisdom and enthusiasm to perfecting their performance, full of the desire to please with their dances and songsKim Jong Unwho is making a ceaseless forced march for devoted service for the people's wellbeing throughout the year.
They noted that they did not expect that the Marshal would give them presents associated with his love and have an honorable photo taken with them on the occasion of the New Year before they performed their dances and songs to give pleasure to him and repay his deep care.
They also said that the worthwhile days in the socialist homeland served as a significant occasion that would be unforgettable all their lives as the days that instilled the patriotic intention and will into the hearts of the younger generation of Chongryon and indicated the way to be followed by them, adding that all the members of the art troupe are full of the firm pledge to repay his love with patriotism and loyalty.
They also expressed their will to invariably take the road of patriotism following only the fatherly Marshal despite difficulties with the dignity and honor of being proud Koreans as they had pledged at the 2026 New Year performance.
They pledged to bear deep the earnest request of the Marshal and learn hard the Korean language, letters and culture, grow up to be cheerful and staunch and firmly carry forward the baton of the patriotic cause of Chongryon as befitting the new generation of Chongryon who inherited the sacred ideal and spirit of the founder generation as the baton of patriotism.
The letter wishedKim Jong Un, the whole of their destiny and the symbol of the dignified and powerful DPRK, good health for the eternal prosperity of the socialist homeland and its people. -0-

headline: Training of Medical Workers at Ministry of Public Health
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The Ministry of Public Health of the DPRK is directing efforts to training medical workers, true to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on public health.
Officials of the ministry and relevant units set a goal to innovate new contents and methods of vocational technical education and are carrying it out step by step.
The vocational technical education institute under the ministry has applied a research-type teaching method to subjects, raising the practical abilities and qualifications of teachers.
And it is taking measures to train students to be talents with practical abilities by drawing up a new curriculum for strengthening foreign language education from the new school year.
The provincial vocational technology colleges for medical workers and the classes for training nurses of city and county hospitals are directing efforts to practical education so that all the students can acquire the abilities and qualifications for treating and nursing patients well.
They are also engaging in improving the educational conditions and environments and equipping themselves with medical appliances and supplies necessary for experimental and practical education. -0-
