headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Centenarians
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent birthday spreads to Kim Sang Chun living in the Neighborhood Unit No. 16, Aedo-dong, Jongju City of North Phyongan Province, and O Pong Yon living in the Neighborhood Unit No. 10, Sinmu-ri, Samsu County of Ryanggang Province, on their 100th birthdays.
The women centenarians, being moved by the deep love ofKim Jong Un, expressed their gratitude to him.
Officials of the committees of Jongju City and Samsu County of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers congratulated the centenarians on their birthdays.
The old women, who had been subject to humiliation and contempt resulting from the sorrow of a stateless nation before national liberation, have led a worthwhile life in the country liberated by PresidentKim Il Sungas its masters  and are spending their days in good health under the socialist policies. -0-

headline: Agricultural Workers Move into New Houses in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 14 (KCNA) -- New houses have appeared at the Sugye Farm in Unsan County and the Mungok Stockbreeding Farm in Nyongwon County, South Phyongan Province thanks to the benevolence of the Workers' Party.
Trees of good species were planted in the villages, where dwelling houses of various styles have been built to meet the regional features and the convenience of agricultural workers in their lives. This adds to the sceneries of the socialist cultural countryside.

House-moving began amid congratulatory performances and cheerful dancing parties.
Laughter and songs of agricultural workers rang out from every house. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Raengmyon
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- It is winter now.
But Okryu Restaurant in the capital city of the DPRK is crowded with people coming to taste Pyongyang Raengmyon (cold noodle).
Pyongyang Raengmyon is popular among the Korean people along with the name of Okryu Restaurant.
It is the primary dish favored by people even in cold winter, to say nothing of hot summer, for its unique taste and high nutritive value.
It is also termed by foreigners as a "food rare to be seen in the East and the rest of the world".
Tasting the cold noodle during their visit to the homeland, overseas compatriots would unanimously say that the visitors to Pyongyang would have regretted for a long time if they didn't taste Raengmyon.
It is said that even foreigners who had tasted Pyongyang Raengmyon in the DPRK want to taste it in their countries and that they do not forget the Korean word "kuksu (noodle)" although they may forget other Korean words they learnt in the DPRK.
On January 15 and on November 18, 1966, ChairmanKim Jong Ilsaid that Pyongyang Raengmyon is the pride of Pyongyang and the DPRK, and taught how to make and eat it. And he instructed that Okryu Restaurant should strive to further develop the world-famous traditional Pyongyang Raengmyon. -0-

headline: Newspaper Saenal (New Day)
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 98th anniversary of the founding of the newspaper Saenal (New Day), the first revolutionary publication in Korea.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who embarked on the road of revolution in his early years with his great intention to liberate the country usurped by the Japanese imperialists, was convinced that if a newspaper loved by the masses was made and used well, it would be equivalent to hundreds of rounds of revolutionary art propaganda. And he put the publication of newspaper into practice.
The first revolutionary newspaper was issued on Jan. 15, 1928 thanks to the efforts and energetic guidance of the President who named the newspaper "Saenal" and devoted himself to the publication of the newspaper, personally writing important editorials and articles to be edited in the first number of the newspaper.
This opened up the historical origin of our revolutionary publications.
The newspaper Saenal, the organ of the then Saenal Children's Union, was a good means of linking the leader of the revolution with revolutionary organizations and the masses as a powerful educator, excellent propagandist and reliable organizer of the masses.
The newspaper was widely distributed to contribute to awakening the public politically.
The revolutionary publications Samil Wolgan, Sogwang and Jongsori were founded afterwards. They also contributed to kindling the flames of struggle in the hearts of the people and accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation (August 15, 1945). -0-

headline: Trolley Buses, Bus Stops and Roads Remodeled in Hamhung City of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK has modernized trolley buses, bus stops and roads in Hamhung City.
The province organized designing and construction forces with competent officials in order to carry out the projects for producing new trolley buses and remodeling bus stops and roads, and took practical measures while giving priority to the supply of equipment and materials.
Workers and technicians of the relevant units manufactured in a short span of time new trolley buses with improved internal environment which can run with less electricity by introducing advanced science and technology and rational working methods.
Officials and working people in the province and the city also further laid trolley bus lines, rebuilt dozens of bus stops, made decorative fences in the section extending more than 10 kilometers and paved the roads extending thousands of meters.
Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Hyon Chol, chairman of the South Hamgyong Provincial People's Committee, and officials concerned discussed the issues arising in ensuring the normal operation with priority to the convenience of citizens while going round the new trolley buses.
The trolley buses run along streets of the industrial city, adding its scenery and giving pleasure to citizens. -0-

headline: Socialist Emulation among Regional-industry Factories in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 15 (KCNA) -- The regional-industry factories built in 20 cities and counties across the DPRK are conducting a socialist emulation drive to improve the quality of products and expand their varieties.
The foodstuff factories in Unpha, Kumya, Hamju and Tongsin counties have upgraded the paste production lines, oil refining lines and bread and biscuit production lines and additionally installed equipment to improve the quality of various kinds of foodstuffs.
The Sukchon County Foodstuff Factory is increasing the variety of special products by introducing advanced technology and experience from light industrial factories in the capital city.
Songchon and Kyongsong county foodstuff factories are increasing the production of new goods by relying on their own raw materials and technical forces.
The daily necessities factories in Kusong City and Kujang, Ichon, Kosan, Jaeryong, Songchon and Usi counties have conducted a technical innovation movement and a socialist emulation drive to improve the quality of laundry soap. Their products were registered as the February 2 Goods. They are also producing various kinds of building materials, wooden goods and school fixtures.
The garment factories in Kosan County, Kusong City, Sukchon, Kumya and Kim Hyong Jik counties have given precedence to designing clothes according to sex, occupations and seasons, conducted technical study, contest among skilled workers and show of products to ensure the quality of various kinds of garments on a high level.
The achievements made at the regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties serve as the good experience for the regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties inaugurated last year. -0-

headline: Koryo Paper, Precious Cultural Heritage of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- Among the valuable cultural heritages created by the resourceful and intelligent Korean people is Koryo paper.
Koryo paper gained popularity in neighboring countries as the best one in the world.
Its kinds included Paekmunji (quality white paper), Kyonji (silkpaper), Achongji, leather paper, gold paper and tissue paper.
The general features of Koryo paper were white, tough, smooth, soft and worm-free.
Koryo paper was widely known abroad for its high quality.
In particular, Paekmunji, Kyonji and Achongji were exported to neighboring countries in the period of Koryo (918-1392) and thereafter. They were the necessaries of the nobles of other countries.
Koryo paper was not only famous in the East but also in European countries in modern ages.
The book "Korean Bibliography", published in Paris of France in 1894, estimated that Korean paper has soft and tough features, regardless of papers of any age, and that the books dating back to the period of Koryo found in European libraries, in particular, were neither yellowed nor worm-eaten.
It clearly shows the high quality and excellence of Koryo paper and the development of papermaking technology in the period of Koryo. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Teachers Training College
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang Teachers Training College is leading the Korean-style educational revolution while playing the role as a center of academic research and dissemination in the work to develop preschool education and primary school education and improve the teaching contents and methods of teachers training colleges.
The college is associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho unfolded the plan to turn our country into the one that gives top priority to education and has the most developed educational system in the world and is guiding the work for its realization.
On January 16, 2018,Kim Jong Unvisited the newly-reconstructed Pyongyang Teachers Training College and stressed the importance of the duty of teachers training colleges in bringing about a radical improvement in education in the new century to glorify the country as the state of education and a talent power.
The officials, teachers and researchers of the college, mindful of the trust and expectation of the Workers' Party of Korea which put forward the college as a "pedigree farm" for training teachers, are exalting its honor as model unit in the higher educational sector.
The college has improved the instruction and edification by applying the research-type teaching and studying methods. It manufactured and sent robots for education of children to Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Chilgol Revolutionary School, Pyongyang Primary School for Orphans and other schools and teachers training colleges and disseminated study aid books and education programs.
Many graduates of the college including those who were awarded the title of people's or merited teachers are devoting themselves to education. The college established a retraining system for teachers of primary schools and kindergartens in Pyongyang and teachers of training colleges across the country and has conducted the retraining for them in a planned way.
Teachers, researchers and students of Pyongyang Teachers Training College are now devoting their wisdom and enthusiasm to education and study, with one mind to become the root and foundation of education of the rising generation. -0-

headline: New Houses Built in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 16 (KCNA) -- At a time when a new life of socialist cultural efflorescence blooms all over the DPRK every day, modern dwelling houses were built in Munmu-ri, Sohung County, North Hwanghae Province, and in Huku-ri and Rodong-ri in Sangwon County of the province.

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Becoming Young Vanguard Boundlessly Loyal to Cause of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Saturday in an editorial says that the path covered by the Socialist Patriotic Youth League is shining as the glorious annals in which it has invariably followed the road of loyalty and patriotism under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
The 80-year-long history of the youth league is a proud course as it has invariably preserved its revolutionary nature of being intensely loyal to the ideas and cause of the WPK for a long period, the editorial says, and goes on:
The 80 years of victory and glory covered by the youth league have recorded in history the proud review that there are the main lifeline of existence and development of the youth organization and the worthwhile life of our young people on the road of holding the outstanding leader in high esteem and remaining faithful to his ideas and leadership.
The Korean youth movement is the revolutionary cause of the leader that can be linked only with the immortal exploits of the great leader, and herein lies the eternal lifeline of our youth organization.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unis the great teacher and tender-hearted father bringing up the young people to be reliable successors to the dignified WPK and masters shouldering the future of our socialist state.
He placed deep trust in young people living in gloom, saying that it is the firm will of the WPK to take all the young people born and grown up on this land to communist society. Under his loving care, all the youths on this land are preparing themselves to be young revolutionaries and patriots who know the country, revolution and requital.
Young men and women, unite firmly around the great Party Central Committee with patriotism and more vigorously struggle for the victorious advance of the socialist cause and for the prosperity and mightiness of our state.
Let us become the young vanguard unfailingly loyal to the cause of the Workers' Party of Korea! -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Conference in Celebration of 80th Anniversary of Founding of Socialist Patriotic Youth League
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the conference in celebration of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Young people of Korea, a source of strength and dignity of this country,
Reliable volunteers, who are devoting their beautiful youth to the patriotic struggle,
Steadfast and vigorous officials of the youth league,
Comrades,
I congratulate the young vanguard, who are attending this celebratory conference representing the most resourceful, courageous and patriotic young generation.
I feel really pleased and happy to share this significant moment of looking back on the glorious history of the youth league and foreseeing its bright future with you, brimming over with such a refreshing mettle and burning enthusiasm.
As the first national-level event in this significant year when the Ninth Congress of our Party will be held, we have arranged this large-scale gathering of young people in celebration of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the youth league.
The basic objective of this event is to greatly encourage and give wide publicity to our young people, who have always made more efforts than others in every realm of our cause, as well as to inspire them to make fresh, redoubled efforts and bring about innovations.
It is quite meaningful that the youth league, a loyal vanguard of our Party and a powerful organization of the patriotic youth, is celebrating the 80th anniversary of its founding in this grand way in the lead-up to the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Today, when it is reviewing the eye-opening struggle stages and foreseeing a new prospect of socialist construction, the whole country, together with you, is celebrating your holiday in a significant way, praising the brilliant history and exploits of the youth league.
This is an expression of its great affection for and encouragement to our young people and, at the same time, its great appreciation of the 80-year history of the youth league.
The Korean youth movement that has demonstrated its fame with heroic struggles and legendary feats will greet the glorious Party congress. Such an honourable moment is not something that comes of itself with the passage of time; it is something the youth organization that has shared its ideology and ideals with our Party and faithfully supported its cause can greet on its proud journey, I think.
Availing myself of this opportunity of celebrating the 80th anniversary of the youth league, I pay noble tribute to the glorious struggle history of the Korean youth movement that has invariably supported our revolutionary cause, and extend warm congratulations to all the young people, youth league organizations and their officials, who, with faithfulness to the Party and their country, are leaving lofty and beautiful imprints of their youth at their work places, military posts and school campuses.
Comrades,
It would be too much for me to recount the 80-year chronicles of the youth league as its origin and traditions are so sacred and its records of succession and development are so brilliant.
The history of the youth movement of Korea is so much honourable, and the exploits it has performed generation after generation is so much enormous.
Since it emerged in the first days of nation building as the banner of unity of young people from all walks of life who were aspiring after a prosperous and powerful nation, the youth league has followed a protracted course while writing the most proud and glorious pages in its chronicles thanks to the faithful and patriotic aspirations cherished, and the powerful strides made, by the ranks of young people.
The flag of the youth league has served as the guide for young people, who are always full of vigour and ambitions for progress and innovation, in their struggle to advance straight ahead along the path indicated by the Party; our young people have been a source of strength for pioneering and for transformation against all manner of challenges and trials of history.
The youth league has trained its members as the reliable main force for socialist construction and national defence, leaving in the annals of history their indelible traces as the advance party and their remarkable feats as the vanguard for creation and construction.
As they were well aware that their country means their motherly embrace and the cradle of their life and wellbeing, which they should defend and look after from one generation into the next, our young people, united as one under the banner of patriotism, have made strenuous efforts against all odds to help build theirs into a prosperous country with a strong army.
In the 1950s, the members of the democratic youth league defended their country in the flames of the war, and the Chollima movement pioneers rehabilitated this land on the debris of the war; in the grim period when the destiny of socialism was at stake, your parents' generation defended their country, their social system. In this way, all the generations of our Republic have left behind legendary tales and structures, signs of their exploits, which are symbolic of their youth and which are named after their generations.
Shining on all these achievements are the feats performed by the youth league in implanting in the young people the sense of duty and obligation as befits the successors to the revolution and in firmly maintaining the tradition of purity, patriotism and loyalty of the youth movement of Korea.
The journey of our revolution has been beset with challenges and obstacles which would have been impossible to cope with even with high spirits and youthful vigour; and there has never been an interruption in the wind of temptation aimed at degenerating our younger generations. Nevertheless, the red flag held by our young people, instead of fading with the passage of time in the face of historical ups and downs, has fluttered ever higher and more strongly as it has been empowered by pure and thoroughgoing succession.
The change of generations in the ranks of young people continued along with the advance of the revolution. But as our state has the successors who have always been faithful to their mission as the vanguard class fighters and pillars of socialist construction and to the duty of the times, its mainstay has remained steadfast, and the world of love and noble virtues created by them added more beauty to our society.
In the vigorous struggle for the revolution and construction, our young people have never misspent their youth, and in those days they have grown up beyond recognition in the ideological and spiritual aspects.
The youth movement has responded to the call of the country with heroic struggles. In the proud course it has covered along with the name of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, it has united the millions of young people behind the Party more firmly and trained them into honourable builders of socialism, opening a brilliant chapter of a new era of transformations by dint of their inexhaustible strength.
We were deeply impressed by the true looks of young successors, witnessing their heightened zeal for volunteering, which swept across the country after the Eighth Congress of the Party.
In their days full of dreams and ambitions our young people are preserving the original features of young Koreans and faithfully performing their mission of successors by dedicating their precious youth to the call of the times and their country.
Among them were the young people in Nampho, who volunteered ahead of others to work in the socialist countryside. They were followed by tens of thousands of other young people in the capital and other cities who volunteered for mountain, rural and island villages and for difficult and labour-consuming sectors, invariably and steadily following the road of patriotism.
They had the right to enjoyment and must have cherished precious dreams, but they translated their laudable decisions into practice, devoting their pure conscience and great sincerity to their motherland.
If they had no warm heart desirous of the country’s prosperity or firm faith in and ardent aspiration to socialism, they would not have been able to make such an admirable decision and, moreover, remain faithful to it.
This is an inspiring story which can be explained only with the noble ideological and spiritual traits of our young people.
They are not all.
Ours is called a heroic era filled with transformations, which shines more brilliantly with the exploits performed by the hundreds of thousands of young people who volunteered to work at the sites of building new streets and other grand construction theatres in hearty response to the call of the Party.
In looking back, the revolutionary ideology and ideals of our Party have always become those of the young people themselves and the course of our state building and development has always coincided with the course of worthwhile life of the young people. But there has not been such an era as today when the young people across the country are giving full play to their might at the many places to translate the grand blueprints of the Party into brilliant reality.
Our Party appreciates the record of victories achieved and all the monumental structures set up by the young people more highly than any other successes and wealth. It is because they are permeated with the fervent affection and enthusiasm of our younger generations for their socialist country, and they reflect the unshakable pledge and will of the successors.
The annals of history of our glorious Party and country are adorned more with pages the young people are writing with their blood and sweat, and one tale about the revolutionary spirit and heroic feats of the young Koreans is being produced after another along with the numerous transformations brought about on this land. These are clear proof to the ideological and spiritual inheritance that has run through the history of the Korean youth movement as its bloodline.
In the whole course of the Korean revolution beset with unprecedented difficulties, the young people have never been a burden to their country or tarnished their revolutionary nature.
In the present world, your peer group is in the centre of the unheard-of bloody catastrophe.
Young people, steeped in extreme misanthropy, money-is-almighty poison, moral depravity and pessimism, give rise to serious social problems and heartrending tragedy of bloodshed and discord in different places. This is an undeniable reality of the present world.
It is something that we can be proud of before the world that we have trustworthy, stout young revolutionaries who, bearing in their minds the appellation of successors as the honour of youth, temper and perfect themselves by braving trials together with the Party and their motherland.
Present here are also young soldiers, who have defended the dignity and honour of their country recently in the overseas special military operations by displaying the excellence, heroism, self-sacrificing spirit and character peculiar to their fellow people.
Not only these young soldiers but also their countless comrades-in-arms are devoting even at this moment their youth without hesitation at battlefields in the alien land in order solely to remain faithful to the order of their homeland without expecting any reward.
What they are desirous of is only the prosperity of their homeland, not any reward.
No one in the world will be ever able to find such soldiers as ours who go to battlefields expecting no reward or private interest, to fight to defend their country’s honour and their self-respect and to execute in good faith the orders given to them.
It is only the Koreans, only young Korean people, who can do this, so the world is yet to understand their spiritual world.
So ordinary were our soldiers as we could see them anywhere but, having been dispatched to engage in the overseas operations, they have fully demonstrated how wonderful are the character of young Korean people, sons of the Korean people, which is unique on this planet. They have set a noble example to be respected and followed by all the young people of future generations.
Having such young people is our state’s source of pride which is incomparable with anything else.
The 80-year history of struggle of the youth league is being reviewed in the light of the socialist ideals, noble patriotism, passionate sense of justice and pure spiritual world, which you and all the other young people across the country have now cherished as part of their faith and mental qualities. And this again raises the position and fame of our young Koreans on the highest level.
Linking the proud past of our state with its glorious present and building a rosier future by wonderfully preparing the next generation who will carry forward the baton of the revolution–this is the historic exploits and victory of the Korean youth movement, which cannot be compared with anything else nor achieved by anyone else.
Availing myself of this meaningful opportunity, I once again extend warm tribute to the days of youth of our Republic’s all generations who, by braving all sorts of hardships and trials and even sacrificing their youth and lives, have defended their motherland and, by performing noble feats and miracles, have brought prosperity to our country, as well as to the proud 80-year history of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
Comrades,
We can now talk about the invincibility of our revolution because its youth organization is strong, and our era is full of transformations because its young heroes are high in their ideals, strong in their sense of self-respect and soaring in their revolutionary enthusiasm.
The revolutionary cause to be accomplished generation after generation still demands that the youth league and young people carry out the important mission, and the steps of succession they have made decade after decade should continue.
All the activities of the youth league, in the future, too, should be oriented to training our young people into a powerful force capable of opening up an era of transformation, and its efforts continuously developed to rally as one the millions of young people on the strength of patriotism.
Together with the Party members, all the young people should, as they have done before, form the main current of our revolution, make the gains of socialism larger and richer through a vigorous struggle, and be braver than others in aspiring after the new, stepping up the change, abolishing the backwardness and accelerating progress.
The sturdy growth of young people is one of the core aims for the state development our Party wants to attain in the present struggle, as well as a big step forward towards the future.
As we remember respectfully the days of youth of your grandparents and parents who braved all difficulties for the country and the revolution, you should ensure that the coming generations remember your worthwhile, youthful days unfailingly.
Comrades,
Your motherly country has decided to confer the Order of
Kim Jong Il, a highest order of our state, on the Socialist Patriotic Youth League as an expression of its greatest appreciation of the steady succession to our cause the youth league has ensured by safeguarding its traditions and remaining faithful to its sacred obligations and duty over the past 80 years.
This will be a source of the greatest honour and dignity of all the young people of Korea.
Today with the expectation that our resourceful and brave young people will continue to record their shining names and feats in the glorious history of the Party and the country and firmly propel the succession and advance of our revolutionary cause in the future, too, I will pin the order of honour on the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
You should vigorously advance towards a new brilliant era, which will shine thanks to your resourcefulness and great might, proudly writing pages in the annals of socialist development and loudly singing the songs of creation and struggle.
The dream of Korea, the future of Korea, is calling our young people.
For the eternal prosperity of our motherland,
For our beautiful tomorrow, and
For the honour of the young people of Korea,
Let us struggle more bravely and more dynamically.
Long live the Democratic People's Republic of Korea! -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Conference Held with Splendour to Celebrate 80th Founding Anniversary of SPYL
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK are significantly greeting the 80th founding anniversary of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League in the course of their gigantic advance adding great vitality to the prosperous country pervaded by ardent patriotism and loyalty and soaring passion of the young vanguard in the era ofKim Jong Un.
The Juche-oriented youth organization, which has its origin in the early period of the sacred Korean revolution, was founded on the untrodden path of nation building. Since then, it has always been in its heyday along with the DPRK's ever-victorious cause. Its proud 80-year-long history is run through with miraculous victories and glory it has earned by bringing up the reliable younger generations, successors to the revolution ensuring the future of the country and the people, and by giving full play to their valiant might under the unique idea of the Workers' Party of Korea on valuing the youth and its outstanding leadership.
The WPK and the people extend warm greetings of encouragement and congratulations to the reliable young vanguard thoroughly and purely carrying forward the lifeline of the revolution only with patriotism and loyalty at a time of excitement when the dignity and prestige of the era of changes, unprecedented in the development history of the country, are being dynamically enhanced as never before.
A conference was held with splendour atKim Il SungStadium in the capital city of Pyongyang on January 16 to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the SPYL.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the commemorative event.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared on the platform, all the participants, who had the greatest pleasure to commemorate the significant founding anniversary in the presence of the fatherly Marshal whom they had longed to see even in their dreams, broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Youth delegates presented bouquets toKim Jong Un, reflecting the profound reverence of millions of young people for him.
Warmly acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers,Kim Jong Unextended greetings to the young people across the country who are performing valuable feats, dedicating their beautiful hope and aspiration to the prosperity of the country.
Present at the event were leading officials of the Party and the government and armed forces organs, officials of the youth league, officials concerned, participants in the commemorations of the 80th anniversary of the SPYL, young servicepersons and youth and students in Pyongyang.
When the conference was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Kim Jong Unmade a commemorative speech on the 80th anniversary of the SPYL.
Referring to the significance of celebrating the 80th anniversary of the youth league in the grand way in the lead-up to the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, he paid noble tribute to the glorious struggle history of the Korean youth movement that has invariably supported our revolutionary cause, and extended warm congratulations to all the young people, youth league organizations and their officials, who, with faithfulness to the Party and their country, are leaving lofty and beautiful imprints of their youth at their work places, military posts and school campuses.
Since it emerged in the first days of nation building as the banner of unity of young people from all walks of life who were aspiring after a prosperous and powerful nation, the youth league has followed a protracted course while writing the most proud and glorious pages in its chronicles thanks to the faithful and patriotic aspirations cherished, and the powerful strides made, by the ranks of young people, he said.
The 80-year history of struggle of the youth league is being reviewed in the light of the socialist ideals, noble patriotism, passionate sense of justice and pure spiritual world, which you and all the other young people across the country have now cherished as part of their faith and mental qualities. And this again raises the position and fame of our young Koreans on the highest level, he noted, saying with pride that linking the proud past of our state with its glorious present and building a rosier future by wonderfully preparing the next generation who will carry forward the baton of the revolution–this is the historic exploits and victory of the Korean youth movement, which cannot be compared with anything else nor achieved by anyone else.
Your motherly country has decided to confer the Order of
Kim Jong Il, a highest order of the state, on the Socialist Patriotic Youth League as an expression of its greatest appreciation of the steady succession to our cause the youth league has ensured by safeguarding its traditions and remaining faithful to its sacred obligations and duty over the past 80 years, he said, adding that he would pin the order of honour on the flag of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, with the expectation that our resourceful and brave young people will continue to record their shining names and feats in the glorious history of the Party and the country and firmly propel the succession and advance of our revolutionary cause in the future, too.
Saying that the dream of Korea, the future of Korea, is calling our young people,Kim Jong Uncalled for more bravely and dynamically struggling for the eternal prosperity of the motherland, our beautiful tomorrow and the honour of the young people of Korea.
In response to the ardent appeal of the great fatherly leader, the Korean youth raised rousing cheers of "Long live the Democratic People's Republic of Korea!"
All the participants took an oath of loyalty, looking up to the fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
The young people pledged to become the first death-defying corps and the first guards in devotedly protecting the fatherly Marshal, the heroes and patriots powerfully demonstrating the indomitable spirit and might of the Korean youth in the struggle for defending the country and achieving the comprehensive national rejuvenation, and the young vanguard of the WPK and true sons and daughters of the motherland dynamically advancing straight forward following the Party only.
Kim Jong Unextended warm encouragement to the young vanguard filled with the ardent single mind to live up to his trust and the will of succession.
The venue of the conference resounded with patriotic songs arousing patriotism and enthusiasm for revolution among the younger generations, who are ensuring the steady continuity of the spirit peculiar to the indomitable Korean people and realizing the great ideal of prosperity in the van by dint of inexhaustible strength of self-reliance.
The young people sang the songs in praise of the times out of their ardent desire to become youth heroes glorifying the great era ofKim Jong Un, flying high the national flag of the Republic and the flag of the youth league.
Kim Jong Unconferred the Order ofKim Jong Il, the highest order of the DPRK, on the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
He fixed the Order ofKim Jong Ilon the flag of the SPYL and awarded its certificate to the chairman of the C.C., the youth league.
Then he met exemplary young people who performed distinguished feats in defending the country and at major workplaces of the socialist construction.
He highly praised them for their distinguished deeds of responding to the call of the Party with their boundless loyalty and labour achievements, regarding it as their bounden duty and the greatest honor in their life to devote themselves to the motherland.
He said that the important role and brilliant exploits of the Korean youth and the youth league in accomplishing the cause of the Party century after century were, indeed, miraculous and great ones that no others could perform, noting that the young vanguard faithful to the Party has always formed a fortress around our Party leading the revolution to a great upsurge despite all challenges and ordeals of history.
The Party Central Committee has also planned and advanced today's gigantic cause of fully demonstrating before the world the dignity and prestige of the country and developing the whole country in a simultaneous and serial way, believing in none other than the young people, he said, adding it is the high pride of our Party, state and people and the unique DPRK power any physical strength cannot break to have a large contingent of the most revolutionary and patriotic youths.
Expressing his expectation and conviction that all the participants in the conference would continue to glorify their reputation of patriotic youth in the van of the general advance for building a prosperous powerful country by giving full play to their youthful wisdom, passion and tremendous strength and spirit as befits the master of Juche Korea without an equal in the world, he had a significant photo session with them to be recorded long in history.
When the photo session was over, the young people broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" and shouted the slogan of death-defying defence again, looking up to the respected Marshal.
Kim Jong Unwarmly waved back to the young vanguard for a long time.
All the participants, honoured with the great fatherly leader's warm blessings and encouragement, hardened their pledge to unite firmly as one with patriotism, fully support the socialist motherland and wage a more courageous and vigorous struggle for attaining the grand goal to be set by the Ninth Congress of the WPK and carrying forward to completion the revolutionary cause of Juche.
Only brilliant victory and rosy future will be always in store for the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and the Korean youth movement, thanks to the outstanding leadership of the great Party Central Committee which puts the young people on the glory of the times so that they can vigorously display their might as the reliable advancing group of the WPK. -0-

headline: Korean Youth Movement Steadily Makes Proud History of Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The Socialist Patriotic Youth League marks the 80th anniversary of its founding.
The Korean youth movement has advanced only along the road of glory and victory to creditably carry forward and accomplish the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered on Paektu generation after generation since the youth league was founded on January 17, 1946 under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sungafter the liberation of Korea.
It is now steadily making a proud history of its development, thanks to the idea of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unon valuing the youth and his outstanding and seasoned leadership.
Kim Jong Unregarded attaching importance to the youth as the eternal strategic line of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Korean revolution and put forward the young people as the masters of the future of the socialist state.
He made public famous works such as the letter to the Tenth Congress of the youth league "Demonstrate to the Full the Might of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League on the Historic March towards a Fresh Victory in the Revolution", kindling the flames of patriotism in the hearts of the young people and arousing them to the building of a thriving country.
He invited the young people who volunteered for major worksites of socialist construction to the celebrations of the Youth Day and sent a congratulatory letter of love to them.
He visited the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station to highly appreciate the feats performed by the members of the youth shock brigade, and made sure that young people take part in the capital city construction for pioneering a new phase of development of the Juche-oriented architecture. He also visited the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm under construction to place deep trust in the young vanguard devoting their youth life and feats to the construction.
The warm loving care and affection of the tender-hearted father serve as the nutrients for training the Korean youth into the successors to the revolution, reserves of the Workers' Party and pillars of socialist construction.
Under the care of the respected fatherly Marshal who entrusted the construction of major objects in the country to the young people and led them step by step, they successfully built the Paektusan Hero Youth Power Station and Jonwi Street of Pyongyang into grand monuments to the youth in the era of the Workers' Party and are building again a monumental edifice of the times in the northwestern part of the country.
The young people are defending the Party, the revolution, the country and the people, regarding the national defence as their greatest sacred duty. And they are fully demonstrating the dignity and might of the state to the world in devotedly implementing the Party's military combat order.
Thanks to the WPK's politics on attaching importance to the youth consistent with love and trust in the young people, the great strength of a large contingent of patriotic youths has been strikingly displayed in the struggle for prosperity and development of the country. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Becoming Young Vanguard Boundlessly Loyal to Cause of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Saturday in an editorial says that the path covered by the Socialist Patriotic Youth League is shining as the glorious annals in which it has invariably followed the road of loyalty and patriotism under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
The 80-year-long history of the youth league is a proud course as it has invariably preserved its revolutionary nature of being intensely loyal to the ideas and cause of the WPK for a long period, the editorial says, and goes on:
The 80 years of victory and glory covered by the youth league have recorded in history the proud review that there are the main lifeline of existence and development of the youth organization and the worthwhile life of our young people on the road of holding the outstanding leader in high esteem and remaining faithful to his ideas and leadership.
The Korean youth movement is the revolutionary cause of the leader that can be linked only with the immortal exploits of the great leader, and herein lies the eternal lifeline of our youth organization.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unis the great teacher and tender-hearted father bringing up the young people to be reliable successors to the dignified WPK and masters shouldering the future of our socialist state.
He placed deep trust in young people living in gloom, saying that it is the firm will of the WPK to take all the young people born and grown up on this land to communist society. Under his loving care, all the youths on this land are preparing themselves to be young revolutionaries and patriots who know the country, revolution and requital.
Young men and women, unite firmly around the great Party Central Committee with patriotism and more vigorously struggle for the victorious advance of the socialist cause and for the prosperity and mightiness of our state.
Let us become the young vanguard unfailingly loyal to the cause of the Workers' Party of Korea! -0-

New Houses Built in South Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- New houses have been built at the Kwangchon Farm in Kangryong County and the Sowon Farm in Pyoksong County of South Hwanghae Province.
There took place ceremonies for moving into those houses at the farms.
Present there were Kim Chol Bom, chairman of the South Hwanghae Provincial People's Committee, officials of the Party and power organs in the province and the counties, builders and agricultural workers who would move into their new houses.
Congratulatory addresses were made at the ceremonies and licenses for the use of houses were handed over to be followed by speeches.
Cheerful peasant dances and art performances reflecting the pleasure of the agricultural workers added to the atmosphere of house-moving. Officials visited the new houses to share joy with their owners. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spreads to Centenarians
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent birthday spreads to Kim Sun Han, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 49, Namsan-dong No. 2, Kaesong Municipality, and Ri Hi Gu, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 50, Hoesang-dong No. 1, Hoesang District, Hamhung City, South Hamgyong Province.
Officials in Kaesong Municipality and Hoesang District of Hamhung City and villagers congratulated the women centenarians on receiving the birthday spreads associated with the loving care ofKim Jong Un.
Kim Sun Han, who had lived with the sorrow of a stateless nation, enjoyed a worthwhile life in the liberated country and devoted her whole life to the education of the rising generation. And the Workers' Party of Korea awarded her a high state order and honorary title and trained her children to be officials loyal to the country and the people.
Ri Hi Gu is very proud of their children as their hopes and dreams for learning came true under the care of the motherly Party. Her children had the honour of becoming Party members and graduated from universities.
The women centenarians, who were deeply moved, expressed their gratitude toKim Jong Unfor showing deep benevolence for ordinary old women. -0-

headline: Sci-Tech Complex in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- It has been ten years since the Sci-Tech Complex declared its inauguration.
The complex has fulfilled its mission as a grand seat of learning for all the people and a center for disseminating latest science and technology to contribute to preparing many working people and schoolchildren to be intelligent workers and future talents.
It introduced latest artificial intelligence for putting on an unmanned basis the data management, thus providing a technical guarantee for adding millions of pieces of data to its database every year. A system of online electronic data delivery and a virtual network data transmission system were established to set up sci-tech database in various fields conducive to the country's economic development and the improvement of people's living standards.
The complex updated the website's interface on several occasions to improve the level of putting retrieval, data browsing and mode of service on an intelligent footing and developed a PDF document machine translation service system and other systems for the convenience of readers.
It introduced a comprehensive information service system and a system of collecting electronic data into regional sci-tech dissemination bases and developed a data browsing system and a sci-tech dissemination management support system for sci-tech dissemination bases in various sectors and units.
The city and county regional-industry factories, built as entities of the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea, are training their employees to be able to develop new technologies while studying through the sci-tech learning network system run by the complex. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives New Year Cards from Foreign State and Party Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived New Year cards from heads of state and government, political party leaders and personages of different countries on the occasion of the New Year 2026.
New Year cards came from the president of the Republic of Tajikistan, the president of the Republic of Indonesia, the president of the Republic of India, the president of the Republic of Serbia, the prime minister of the Republic of India, the national leader of the Communist Party of Canada (Marxist-Leninist), the secretary general of the InternationalKim Il SungPrize Council and the InternationalKim Jong IlPrize Council and the co-chairman of the Board of Directors of theKim Il Sung-Kim Jong IlFoundation. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Onban
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 18 (KCNA) -- Among the peculiar dishes traditionally handed down in Korea is Pyongyang Onban (cooked rice served in chicken soup).
Pyongyang Onban is one of the famous four dishes in Pyongyang served with boiled rice and mung-bean pancakes, chicken meat and fried mushroom as garnish and by pouring hot chicken broth into it.
There are similar dishes in different regions but pouring chicken broth on hot boiled rice is a feature peculiar to Pyongyang Onban.
Another feature of this dish is that the chicken broth is seasoned with salt instead of soy sauce.
In winter, Pyongyang people frequently took Pyongyang onban, which is unique in taste, together with bean paste soup and meat with cooked vegetables, for their diet, and especially enjoyed it as a holiday dish.
The restaurant, reputed to be good at Pyongyang Onban, is the Onban House in Ryomyong Street.
The visitors to the restaurant, who are taking Onban garnished with seasoning and chicken, pork, mushrooms and mung-bean pancakes, say that the hot Pyongyang Onban makes them feel warm and strong and is just good as a winter food.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilsaid that people would be pleased if they are served with Onban and that Onban house should be built in Pyongyang and run well. And he took a necessary measure. He even taught how to cook Onban, saying that it would be good to put pork together with chicken in order to make the dish smell nice.
The recipe for Pyongyang Onban, a special dish of Pyongyang, drew attention of visitors to the exhibition of intangible cultural heritages-2025. It was registered as the Pyongyang regional intangible cultural heritage in 2016. -0-

headline: Production Goes up in Mining Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- Workers of various units in the mining industry of the DPRK are making innovations in the production of minerals and nonferrous metals.
The Unpha Mine has applied rational drilling and blasting methods according to the conditions of mineral deposits and directed efforts to increasing the transport capacity to ramp up production.
The Riwon Mine has increased the output per hour by introducing neutralizing agent of blast gas to shorten the time of entrance into faces and raising the operation rate of rock drills and compressors. And the Inphyong Youth Mine concentrates efforts and means on restoring the flooded pits, expanding the cutting faces and tunneling.
Yongyu, Phungnyon and Jungsan mines are concentrating on solving technical problems arising in improving the performance of equipment to boost the production of minerals both in quality and quantity.
The Munphyong Smeltery is carrying out its plans on all indices by ensuring the normal operation of calcination-sulfuric acid production process, electrolysis process and zinc oxide production process and taking innovative measures for recycling waste materials in a timely manner.
The Manpho Smeltery, too, is scaling up efforts to ensure the full operation of equipment, lower cost and increase extraction rate of products. -0-

headline: Movement for Winning Title of Model County Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- Last year, cities and counties in the DPRK launched the movement for winning the title of model county, which covers all fabrics of social life including education, regional industry, land and environment protection and law-abiding life, thus making progress in the development of their regions.
Huichon City in Jagang Province was awarded the title of model education city as it improved the contents and methods of teaching at schools and strengthened the material and technical foundations of education.
Cities and counties in South Phyongan, Kangwon, South Hamgyong and other provinces launched the movement for winning the title of model education county, thus making progress in building schools and improving the educational conditions and environment of branch schools.
Samjiyon City in Ryanggang Province was awarded the title of model regional-industry city as it further perfected the production lines of regional-industry factories and put their production on a normal footing with locally available raw materials. Kimhwa County in Kangwon Province was awarded the title of model county in regional budget system as it increased the budget revenue by developing regional industry and agriculture and improving service activities, thus achieving many successes in developing the regional economy and improving the people's standard of living.
The cities and counties, where modern regional-industry factories were built as the first creations of the regional development policy, put the production of the factories on a normal basis and made good results through the mass movement for developing new products.
Through the movement for winning the title of model commerce county to preserve the true nature of socialist commerce, many cities and counties, including Kaechon City in South Phyongan Province, spruced up commercial outlets and public service establishments and improved commerce and service.
Cities and counties worked out their long-term plans for turning their areas into model for land and environment protection and pushed forward the work to carry them out, thus making progress in land development and management such as afforestation, road construction, river improvement and environment protection.
Phyongchon District in Pyongyang Municipality and Kwail County in South Hwanghae Province won the title of model law-observance county (district). -0-

headline: Students Visit Revolutionary Battle Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- Students of senior middle schools in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK made a study tour of the Kuksabong Revolutionary Battle Site.
Going round various places of the revolutionary battle site, the students of Nampho Secondary School No. 1 and Nampho Foreign Languages School keenly realized once again that the national liberation was a brilliant victory of the independent revolutionary idea and line of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand the internal revolutionary forces.
Looking round the relics and remains preserved in the revolutionary battle site, students from Waudo District and Ryonggang County cherished as the precious ideological and moral treasure the mental world of the fighters who devoted their youth and lives to the historic cause of national liberation.
They had meetings to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and contests of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array. -0-

headline: Rich Tourism Resources in Mt Paektu Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- The Mt Paektu area of the DPRK has abundant tourist resources.
The area presents peculiar scenery with its natural resources of tourism such as geological and topographical wonders produced by several volcanic eruptions, the distinct fauna and flora in the alpine environment and the eye-catching hydrologic movement in Lake Chon on the top of Mt Paektu.
Also available in the area are geological resources and various ecological resources of tourism, characterized by its special topography.
The area was registered as a global geopark in April 2025 and this highlighted its geological significance and high value in terms of tourism, providing good conditions for geological tourism.
It was included in the list of world network of biosphere reserves in April 1989. The primeval forests endlessly stretching at the foot of Mt Paektu satisfy those who like to camp in nature.
The area is also rich in resources of meteorological and climatic tourism. The meteorological and climatic tourism resources are available for sightseeing and climatotherapy.
Typically, the sunrise and double rainbow on Mt Paektu and waterspout in Lake Chon on its top are rare to be seen in other tourist resorts.
Its alpine climate is good for physical fitness, skincare, treatment of neuralgia and respiratory diseases and prevention of aging.
In addition, there are such resources of tourism as the Paektu Hot Spring for spa therapy and the Phothae area favorable for skiing.
The area of Mt Paektu is renowned for an organic combination of such peculiar factors of ecosystem, alongside its spectacular historic, cultural and traditional background. -0-

story_text:

The Chemical Faculty of the university developed Korean-style waste oil recycling technology and built a new large-capacity waste oil recycling process at the Taean Heavy Machine Complex.
The successful test run of the newly-built Korean-style waste oil recycling process made it possible to recycle waste oil at machine plants.
The Electric Power Industry Research Institute under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry developed a new digital protection system for the auto-consumption system at thermal power plants, thus making it possible to put the production of electricity on a stable basis and raise the scientific level of management at thermal power plants.
The Agrobiology Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences established a new tissue culture technology for mass-cultivating sweet potato seedlings in a short period of time.
The technology opened up another prospect for solving the sugar problem in cities and counties. -0-

Production Goes up in Mining Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- Workers of various units in the mining industry of the DPRK are making innovations in the production of minerals and nonferrous metals.
The Unpha Mine has applied rational drilling and blasting methods according to the conditions of mineral deposits and directed efforts to increasing the transport capacity to ramp up production.
The Riwon Mine has increased the output per hour by introducing neutralizing agent of blast gas to shorten the time of entrance into faces and raising the operation rate of rock drills and compressors. And the Inphyong Youth Mine concentrates efforts and means on restoring the flooded pits, expanding the cutting faces and tunneling.
Yongyu, Phungnyon and Jungsan mines are concentrating on solving technical problems arising in improving the performance of equipment to boost the production of minerals both in quality and quantity.
The Munphyong Smeltery is carrying out its plans on all indices by ensuring the normal operation of calcination-sulfuric acid production process, electrolysis process and zinc oxide production process and taking innovative measures for recycling waste materials in a timely manner.
The Manpho Smeltery, too, is scaling up efforts to ensure the full operation of equipment, lower cost and increase extraction rate of products. -0-

headline: Movement for Winning Title of Model County Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- Last year, cities and counties in the DPRK launched the movement for winning the title of model county, which covers all fabrics of social life including education, regional industry, land and environment protection and law-abiding life, thus making progress in the development of their regions.
Huichon City in Jagang Province was awarded the title of model education city as it improved the contents and methods of teaching at schools and strengthened the material and technical foundations of education.
Cities and counties in South Phyongan, Kangwon, South Hamgyong and other provinces launched the movement for winning the title of model education county, thus making progress in building schools and improving the educational conditions and environment of branch schools.
Samjiyon City in Ryanggang Province was awarded the title of model regional-industry city as it further perfected the production lines of regional-industry factories and put their production on a normal footing with locally available raw materials. Kimhwa County in Kangwon Province was awarded the title of model county in regional budget system as it increased the budget revenue by developing regional industry and agriculture and improving service activities, thus achieving many successes in developing the regional economy and improving the people's standard of living.
The cities and counties, where modern regional-industry factories were built as the first creations of the regional development policy, put the production of the factories on a normal basis and made good results through the mass movement for developing new products.
Through the movement for winning the title of model commerce county to preserve the true nature of socialist commerce, many cities and counties, including Kaechon City in South Phyongan Province, spruced up commercial outlets and public service establishments and improved commerce and service.
Cities and counties worked out their long-term plans for turning their areas into model for land and environment protection and pushed forward the work to carry them out, thus making progress in land development and management such as afforestation, road construction, river improvement and environment protection.
Phyongchon District in Pyongyang Municipality and Kwail County in South Hwanghae Province won the title of model law-observance county (district). -0-

headline: Scientific Research Successes Made in DPRK
story_text:

The Chemical Faculty of the university developed Korean-style waste oil recycling technology and built a new large-capacity waste oil recycling process at the Taean Heavy Machine Complex.
The successful test run of the newly-built Korean-style waste oil recycling process made it possible to recycle waste oil at machine plants.
The Electric Power Industry Research Institute under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry developed a new digital protection system for the auto-consumption system at thermal power plants, thus making it possible to put the production of electricity on a stable basis and raise the scientific level of management at thermal power plants.
The Agrobiology Institute under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences established a new tissue culture technology for mass-cultivating sweet potato seedlings in a short period of time.
The technology opened up another prospect for solving the sugar problem in cities and counties. -0-

headline: Rich Tourism Resources in Mt Paektu Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, January 19 (KCNA) -- The Mt Paektu area of the DPRK has abundant tourist resources.
The area presents peculiar scenery with its natural resources of tourism such as geological and topographical wonders produced by several volcanic eruptions, the distinct fauna and flora in the alpine environment and the eye-catching hydrologic movement in Lake Chon on the top of Mt Paektu.
Also available in the area are geological resources and various ecological resources of tourism, characterized by its special topography.
The area was registered as a global geopark in April 2025 and this highlighted its geological significance and high value in terms of tourism, providing good conditions for geological tourism.
It was included in the list of world network of biosphere reserves in April 1989. The primeval forests endlessly stretching at the foot of Mt Paektu satisfy those who like to camp in nature.
The area is also rich in resources of meteorological and climatic tourism. The meteorological and climatic tourism resources are available for sightseeing and climatotherapy.
Typically, the sunrise and double rainbow on Mt Paektu and waterspout in Lake Chon on its top are rare to be seen in other tourist resorts.
Its alpine climate is good for physical fitness, skincare, treatment of neuralgia and respiratory diseases and prevention of aging.
In addition, there are such resources of tourism as the Paektu Hot Spring for spa therapy and the Phothae area favorable for skiing.
The area of Mt Paektu is renowned for an organic combination of such peculiar factors of ecosystem, alongside its spectacular historic, cultural and traditional background. -0-
