topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm Inaugurated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- The rural areas across the DPRK are undergoing changes one after another to present new scenery of civilization all the year round, thanks to the steady implementation of the new programme for the rural revolution in the new era set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea. Against this backdrop, Samgwang-ri of Unjon County in North Phyongan Province has turned into a modern stockbreeding base and beautiful socialist ideal land to greet the auspicious moment of its inauguration.
Fashionable houses are standing in rows adding to the sentiments peculiar to the countryside in the fairyland villages, alongside different branch farms, processing grounds, breeding blocks, cultural and welfare establishments, solar power station, office building, house of culture, kindergarten, school, hospital, pharmacy and other public buildings. They are all impeccable in terms of architectural beauty and magnificent for being in good harmony. The stockbreeding farm is a model of the era to be proud of, which set a new standard in the socialist rural construction and the development of the livestock farming.
The eye-opening transformation in Samgwang area clearly showing the rapid development of the socialist countryside is proud fruition of the noble devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is confidently ushering in a bright future of Korean-style socialism with his outstanding ideas, theory and energetic leadership and another clear proof of the validity and vitality of the WPK's policy on rural construction.
An inauguration ceremony of the Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm under the North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee, built as a model of socialist rural construction and development of livestock farming in the new era, was held with splendour on February 2.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
All the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" out of their deep reverence for the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of all the people who is bringing about a new appearance of great prosperity, in which all the rural areas across the country change and thrive, by making endless journey of devotion day and night with his warmest love for the country and the people.

Kim Jong Unmade a historic speech in commemoration of the inauguration of the Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm.

He referred to the purpose and important significance of the construction of the Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm, which was started to pioneer a new starting point and innovative standard for the future development of the countryside and stockbreeding in the light of the lessons learned from the rural construction in the past.
Samgwang-ri clearly indicates the prospect of the socialist rural development we are going to achieve and we should bring the rural development to the phase of new substantial change by expanding the experience and successes accumulated in the course of building the Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm, he said, specifying different tasks for implementing the socialist rural development policy and definitely turning the livestock farming of the country into a modern one of world level.

He said that it is necessary to positively introduce such advanced stock-breeding technology as an intelligent management system of individual cow, goat, sheep and others and steadily perfect the Korean-style livestock production system and IT system.
In line with the intention of the Party which set as the five-point link in the development of stockbreeding the securement of supra-species, full supply of fodder, scientific raising and tending and thorough epizootic prevention together with the work of putting production and management control on an IT and intelligent basis, the farm should direct big efforts to lowering the production cost and improving the quality of products by optimizing and modernizing the technical control, management of equipment, raising and tending and management of fodder and thus ensure that the validity and vitality of the WPK's stockbreeding policy are proved by clear production result in the future, too.
Saying that scientific stockbreeding precisely means the increased production of livestock products, he stressed that the farm should steadily usher in a new phase of the development of stockbreeding and make uninterrupted innovations and progress, regarding it as a priority task to bolster up the scientific and technological capabilities in the production, management and operation.
The Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm should become a standard-bearer standing in the van of the whole country under the uplifted banner for implementing the Party's stockbreeding policy, he said, giving precious instructions for the management control of the farm including the issue of steadily developing the technology for recycling waste, the issue of creating new standards in the analysis and control of quality and the issue of stirring up the atmosphere of competitive development as well as exchange of experience among major stockbreeding farms.
He said that like this farm, modern and industrialized elements are being now positively introduced in rural areas and it is necessary to positively promote such trend and make it a policy. Noting that it is the enlarging and deepening of the programme for the rural revolution in the new era to develop the country's stockbreeding in a specialized way including the integration of production system at stockbreeding farm, the increase of veterinary medicine production and the establishment of a new stockbreeding information technology research unit, he clarified the ways for its implementation.
He learned about the milk production at the farm.
Appreciating that the farm is ensuring the environment of stabilized production and profitability through introduction of an intelligent milk production system based on the virtual physical production system, he said that lots of good experiences conducive to putting the production line on an intelligent and IT basis have been created recently, and this work should be steadily developed with a clear purposeful orientation.
Having a taste of milk product, he said that it tastes better than the products made in the capital city and it is very great for the unknown farm to mass-produce 10-odd kinds of milk products such as butter, cheese, milk powder and yoghurt. He added that he feels great pride to think that such good milk products would be supplied to the children and people.

Calling for building the rural villages to be impeccable without a parallel even in the distant future and to be advantageous in all aspects, he expressed his unshakable will to more strongly and confidently propel the overall development of the countryside.
Recalling that a model greenhouse vegetable farm was built in the area of the Wihwa Island and a new standard of stockbreeding development was set in the Samgwang area, he said it is the Korean-style traditional development mode and law to create a model and generalize it to the whole country. When this is well embodied in an organic manner in the construction of rural villages and regions, more epochal progress will be made in the implementation of the Party's programme for the rural revolution in the new era and policy of regional development, he added.
He stressed the need to further enhance the sense of mission and responsibility for the revolutionary cause and redouble their efforts to intensify the state guidance on the rural and regional construction, promote its constant development and ensure the state-sponsored investment and support, thus making sure that the rural construction policy and regional development policy of the Party become a historical review adding a proud page to the nation-building history.
Looking round the smart and cozy rural dwellings, breeding blocks, milk-producing ground and educational and leisure facilities, members of the central leadership body of the Party were assured of the rosier future of the socialist countryside that will prosper with each passing day under the outstanding guidance ofKim Jong Unand renewed their pledge to more creditably fulfill their duty in implementing the Party policies.
The inauguration of the Samgwang Stockbreeding Farm strikingly demonstrated the ambition and executive power of the WPK to transform all the rural villages of the country into the ideal ones under socialism, good to live and work in, and marked an epochal turning point of great significance in putting the national stockbreeding on an advanced basis. -0-

headline: Kite-flying - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- There is kite-flying among the DPRK's intangible cultural heritage.
Kite-flying is one of the folk games of children. They play with kites using the power of wind.
From olden times, kite-flying in our country began in late autumn and ended when the cold diminishes next year. It usually reached its peak from the beginning of January to the January 15th of the lunar calendar.
This period was called the kite-flying season.
"Yon" in Korean (kite) originated from a high-flying kite (hawk).
Kite-flying has long been popular across the country.
According to historical records, a scarecrow set alight was flied high with a kite in battles, which shows that the nation's kite-making and kite-flying technologies were very high at that time.
There were various kinds of kites at that time.
Among them the square- and ray-shaped kites are still flied now.
The size of kite is different according to local customs and wind strength.
For the key role played by the center hole, string and tie string in kite, they were called the three major elements in manufacturing and flying kites.
Kite game was played by high-flying, skill-showing, etc. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung and Song of River Amnok
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 3 (KCNA) -- Among the songs that PresidentKim Il Sungpreferred to sing all his life is the "Song of the River Amnok".
This song was created after the March First Popular Uprising (March 1, 1919) which was launched by the Korean people against the colonial rule of Japanese imperialism.
In January 1925, the President heard the news that his father had been arrested by the Japanese imperialists again and left Mangyongdae, his birthplace, at the age of thirteen. He walked 250 miles and reached Phophyong.
On February 3, he made a grim resolve that he would not return home unless Korea became independent, singing the "Song of the River Amnok" on the frozen river near the Phophyong Ferry.
Afterwards he organized and waged an armed struggle against the Japanese imperialists. When he led the unit to come out into the homeland by crossing the River Amnok in August 1938, he sang this song again at a secret camp not far from Phophyong.
He visited the Phophyong Ferry in September 1991 and sang the song again, recollecting with deep emotion the day 66 years ago. -0-

headline: Regional Development Policy-oriented Construction for 2026 Begins in Different Parts of DPRK
Spring Water Resources Abundant in DPRK
Spring Water Resources Abundant in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- Spring water resources can be found everywhere in the DPRK with picturesque mountains and clear water.
From olden times, the Korean ancestors called spring water gushing out from mountains the one for longevity.
With the era of the Workers' Party, a lot of spring water suited to the standard of health and longevity assessment have been discovered and served as drinking water and good resources of treatment for our people's health.
In the country, there are at least hundreds of springs. Among them are Adalsan Spring Water in Kangdong County of Pyongyang Municipality, Sindok Spring Water in Onchon County of Nampho Municipality and Masikryong Spring Water in Kangwon Province.
Ryongaksan, Hwaphogum and Kumgang spring water were registered as a natural monument of the state.
In particular, Ryongaksan Spring Water gushing out at the foot of Mt Ryongak in Wonro-ri, Mangyongdae District is famous as it has a good taste and various minerals and major ions beneficial to human health with great effect on the treatment of various kinds of diseases.
Thanks to the loving care of ChairmanKim Jong Il, the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory was built at the foot of Mt Ryongak.
In September 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the wonderfully remolded factory and said that there are a lot of water springs in different parts of the country and that spring water factories should be built with the Ryongaksan Spring Water Factory as a model.
A large number of spring water factories have been built across the country, true to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to supply the people with much more spring water. -0-

headline: Foundations of Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factories Strengthened in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 4 (KCNA) -- Cities and counties in North Hwanghae Province are putting spurs to strengthening the material and technical foundations of Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province organized visits and training courses to generalize the successes and experience gained at advanced units while building up the Sariwon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory as a model. And it dispatched working officials to cities and counties to ensure that they carry on projects as required by the standard design and intensify the technical guidance for putting the production processes on a GMP basis.
The provincial Koryo medicine production management bureau, in contact with relevant units, pushed ahead with the work to manufacture and secure various kinds of production equipment and supply them to cities and counties.
Singye County put production lines on a germ-free and dust-free basis of a higher level while ensuring the quality of buildings. Sinphyong County stepped up the modernization of production lines with the main emphasis on producing quality Koryo medicines by using abundant herbal resources.
Other cities and counties laid the foundations for mass-producing Koryo medicines. -0-

headline: Regional Development Policy-oriented Construction for 2026 Begins in Different Parts of DPRK
story_text:

headline: For Convenience of People
story_text:
One day in January 2012, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Mirae Shop.
While going round various parts of the shop, he suddenly halted in his stride and said that he went past the counter for sundry goods, not seeing spectacles. Then he went back to the spectacles display stand.
Taking out a pair of sunglasses from the display stand with various kinds of sunglasses and spectacles, he advised that the display stand be made to turn around so as to provide better convenience for guests choosing kind of spectacles.
He personally put on the sunglasses and asked where he could see mirror.
When a salesperson brought a mirror to him from the favorite article counter, he said that it was not for him and that the spectacles counter has mirrors to make guests see them in glasses.
Bearing in mind the teachings of him concerning for the convenience of the people first, the officials made up their mind to become faithful servants of the people. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories Expand Variety of Products
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- Newly-built regional- industry factories are striving to produce more quality goods favoured by the people, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Thanks to the efforts of their officials and workers, the variety of products has been expanded nearly three times, as compared with the early days of operation.
The Songchon County Foodstuff Factory set a goal to produce special products symbolic of its region by using Songchon chestnuts as raw materials.
The Jangphung County Foodstuff Factory developed ginger fermentation vinegar, ginger sugar, Punji (toothache tree fruit) paste and pickled Punji by using the medicinal and health functions of ginger and Punji trees widely cultivated in the county.
Foodstuff factories in Kumya, Sukchon and Onchon counties and the Orang County Seafood Processing Factory are producing tasty processed seafood of dozens of kinds.
The foodstuff factories in Kim Hyong Jik County, Usi County and other mountainous counties are turning out various kinds of products with locally available raw materials.
The Hamju County Daily Necessities Factory produces household goods and ventilators, siphons and other building materials for rural housing construction.
Ichon and Jangphung county daily necessities factories developed functional laundry soap by using fruits of Junglans cordiformis and sweet flag growing in their regions.
Kusong City, Kumya County and Kim Hyong Jik County garment factories are striving to turn out new products. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Return Home
Scientific Research Brisk at Power Bases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, scientists of the Electricity Institute under the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK are conducting scientific research at power bases across the country.
A research group for automation of electric power system settled the technical problems arising in remodeling the large-capacity thermal generator at the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex into a static self-excitation system. It is also making progress in the work to introduce the excitation control device and a speed regulator control system into the Sodusu Power Station No. 1.
At the Thaechon Power Station No. 1, scientists are solving sci-tech problems for the normal operation of generating equipment and increased power production.
A research group for relay protection has introduced a general automation system into the switch plant at the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex.
Scientists, dispatched to the Tanchon Power Station No. 5, solved the technical problems arising in restoring the integrated control system to successfully ensure trial operation. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Return Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- DPRK players returned home after taking part in the 2026 International Freestyle Wrestling Tournament "Ivan Yarygin Cup" held in Krasnoyarsk, Russia.
The tournament brought together more than 500 men and women players from over 20 countries including the DPRK, Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan. DPRK players won eight medals including five gold medals.
Won Myong Gyong, Choe Hyo Gyong, Son Il Sim, Kim Ok Ju and Pak Sol Gum took the first places and won gold medals in women's wrestling 50kg, 53kg, 57kg, 62kg and 68kg categories respectively.
O Kyong Ryong and Hong Pyol placed second in women's wrestling 53kg and 57kg categories and Han Chong Song third in freestyle wrestling 57kg category.
The players, who returned home after glorifying the honor of the country, were greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by officials in the field of sports, sportspersons and families on Wednesday. -0-

headline: Public and Production Buildings Inaugurated in Unpha County
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 5 (KCNA) -- New public and production buildings have appeared at the Taechong Farm in Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, thus giving face-lifting to the appearance of the area.
At the farm with a mosaic mural depicting the benevolent image of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism Study Hall was built as befitting the base for ideological education. And a united office building, production buildings of workteams, an agricultural sci-tech learning space and a hall of culture were newly built to prepare the agricultural workers to be proud masters of modern countryside and performers of the rural revolution.
Besides, general public service facility, hospital, pharmacy, kindergarten, rice mill and all other conditions and environment were provided to offer conveniences to working people in the region.
An inauguration ceremony of public and production buildings took place on February 4.
Present there were Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the Party and power organs in Unpha County, working people and farmers of the Taechong Farm.
At the ceremony, speakers said with excitement that the new appearance of Taechong-ri is a precious fruition of the warm love for the people ofKim Jong Unwho has devoted himself to making the agricultural workers enter communist society ahead of others.
At the end of the ceremony the participants went round various places of the farm with a new picture of civilization and efflorescence.
The county mobile artistic motivation team gave a congratulatory performance, revving up the inauguration mood. -0-

headline: KPA Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- February 8, 1948 is the day when the Korean People's Army, the regular revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK, was founded.
After the liberation of the country on August 15, 1945, PresidentKim Il Sungset the founding of a powerful regular army as an essential requirement for building an independent and sovereign state and made tireless efforts to realize it.
In his speech before military and political cadres, he said that our country should found its powerful army capable of defending the country and safeguarding the gains of the revolution in order to become a full-fledged independent and sovereign state.
The President made public immortal classic works such as "On Establishing the Pyongyang Institute" and "Let Us Found a True People's Army, a Modern Regular Army" and thus provided an immortal programme to be regarded as guidelines in building the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces and energetically led the work to found the regular revolutionary armed forces.
He designated the site for the Pyongyang Institute, the first base for training military and political cadres, and established the Central Security Officers Training School capable of training military and political cadres of all services and arms.
He organized the Security Officers Training Center training the core of the regular army and, on this basis, established and expanded various services, arms and sub-units.
He saw to it that newly-organized units of services and arms applied Korean-style military regulations, manuals, command and management methods and tactics and laid material and technical foundations for building the regular army including various kinds of military hardware and munitions.
On the basis of these preparations, he proclaimed the founding of the Korean People's Army, the successor to the anti-Japanese armed struggle and the revolutionary regular armed forces.
The birth of the Juche-oriented regular army enabled the DPRK to emerge as a dignified country with its own firm armed guarantees from the first day of its founding, and the DPRK people to lead a happy life on the land defended by their regular army for the first time in history and accelerate the building of a new country as full-fledged masters of the people's government. -0-

Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency Thursday released a report on the wonderful completion of an ideal large farm town in the new era under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee.
According to the report, an unprecedented large group of greenhouses was majestically erected in the northwestern part of the country under the outstanding leadership of the WPK.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a bold decision to turn the flood-hit island area of North Phyongan Province into an ideal large farm town in the new era, and organized and led the grand construction operation in the vanguard.
The military and civilian builders, all out in response to the intention of the Party Central Committee, completed the construction of a large-scale greenhouse farm in a matter of one year with their strong spiritual power and stubborn practical ability.
The area of Wihwa Island has turned into a treasure zone with the successful construction of a thousand and hundreds of modern greenhouses of different types, production and auxiliary buildings and various bases for cultural life.
In particular, the Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center, a combination of modern dwelling houses preserving the charms unique to the region and up-to-date trial cultivation greenhouses, was built as a scientific and technological research and dissemination center for putting greenhouse vegetable production on a scientific, intensive and industrial basis to demonstrate the prospect of the country's greenhouse vegetable production and development of a large farm town.
The great change on the shore of the Amnok River is unthinkable apart from the devoted service for the people's wellbeing of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the great father of the people.
The General Secretary attended a groundbreaking ceremony for the construction of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and the vegetable science research center in February 2025, encouraging the builders and digging up the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the construction project.
The young builders turned out in the grand construction campaign to carry out a new regional development plan, bearing in mind the great trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee.
They made a breakthrough in stepping up the main construction by giving precedence to the construction of raising and cutting millions of cubic meters of earth, the pavement of tens of kilometers of roads, the production of more than 11 million blocks and securing over 620 000 cubic meters of aggregate in a short span of time.
The soldier-builders finished in the main the frame project for greenhouses in their charge until May 2025 by conducting the work for demonstration lectures and technical study and strengthening technical forces in accordance with the order of successive processes with the main emphasis on improving the quality of construction.
The whole area of grand construction was seething with the offensive spirit of passionate youths who demonstrated the mettle of patriotic youth in building Jonwi Street in the capital city and recovering the flood-hit areas in North Phyongan Province.
The energetic guidance ofKim Jong Unwas a driving force that brought about the creation and changes in building the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm.
He provided lot of latest sci-tech data necessary for the construction of the farm and examined more than 170 pieces of layouts, including a master construction plan and panoramic drawings, and over 3 850 pieces of technical designs to turn the island area into a new model of regional development.
Under his great guidance, semi-closed glass hydroponic greenhouses, solar-heat greenhouses where the fish farming and the cultivation of vegetables are combined, and greenhouses with a solar power system could be built and the technical processes for main production and the equipment necessary for greenhouse management could be established.
At the same time, the first-stage embankment project was completed ahead of schedule in parallel with the construction of the greenhouse farm, thus laying a protective wall on the bank of the Amnok River free from any natural disaster.
In October when the 80th anniversary of the founding of the Party was significantly celebrated,Kim Jong Unvisited the construction site at the final stage and stressed the need to open up a new phase of rural civilization not only in architecture but also in environmental realignment and landscape creation as the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm is another gigantic creation work for promoting the independent and many-sided development of the regional economy and proving the validity and vitality of the regional development policy in the new era.
In November 2025, he again visited the construction site of the combined greenhouse farm nearing completion and said with high appreciation that it is pleasure to see the grandiose plans and tasks for comprehensive rejuvenation being carried out one by one and the wealth of creation increasing, but what our Party values more than anything else is the fact that the young people have grown up to be great cedars of patriotism in this course. And he indicated ways for operation and management of the farm.
This year, a more vigorous struggle was waged to complete the construction of the grand greenhouse farm.
On January 2, the General Secretary visited the construction site of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and congratulated the young vanguard and soldier-builders on the New Year. And he highly praised the feats they performed to transform the island area, afflicted by a disaster, into an ideal farm town in the new era.
With his appeal of love and trust kept in their mind, all the builders stepped up the tree planting and the environmental improvement in vast areas at the final stage in the spirit of finishing the construction project, assembly of greenhouse equipment and road construction.
Officials and working people across the country helped the construction, sharing the mind with the builders.
Thanks to the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Unand the efforts of the army-civilian builders faithful to the cause of the Party, the construction of a large group of greenhouses was successfully completed.
The changes of the farm, which has made another leap forward in terms of modernity, advanced nature and profitability and architectural level aspiring after higher development than already built greenhouse farms, are a noble picture of patriotic and devoted service for the people's wellbeing that can be presented only by the great Party Central Committee which has steadily set development-oriented goals in the struggle for national prosperity and the people's civilized and happy life and pushed ahead with the work for their attainment.
Through radical changes in the island area clearly and again showing the higher stage and development process of regional transformation, our people hardened their confidence that all regions of the country can be turned into a paradise within 10 or 20 years as there are the outstanding leadership ofKim Jong Unand single-mind unity of all the people closely rallied around the Party Central Committee.
On February 1,Kim Jong Unattended the inauguration ceremony of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and had a photo session with the builders and appreciated the valuable feats of the heroic youth in the new era who built in the area of Wihua Island another monument to the great struggle to go down in the sacred history of the Korean youth movement. And he expressed the expectation and belief that the youth, officers and soldiers would redouble their youthful strength and enthusiasm and more bravely and more stoutly struggle for the bright future of the powerful country and the honor of the Korean youth.
The farm, successfully completed ahead of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, will proudly demonstrate its name before the times and history year after year as a model edifice in the era of comprehensive national rejuvenation, thanks to the grand plan ofKim Jong Unfor regional construction and his seasoned leadership and patriotic loyalty of the army-civilian builders, the report stressed. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Educational Sector of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- The educational sector of the DPRK is taking practical measures to attain a new educational goal, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Ministry of Education has directed efforts to ensuring that officials and educators in the education sector grasp the new curriculum and make preparations for its implementation.
Cities and counties have conducted short courses for educators. The ministry makes preparations for a short course for relevant officials in provinces, cities and counties.
Teacher training colleges assessed the practical ability for teaching majors so that graduates can master the contents of teaching materials and the teaching methods according to the new educational programme.
Universities across the country strive to consolidate and further develop the successes achieved in improving the educational structure last year and raise the contents and methods of education to a higher level.
The ministry is intensifying the operation to put the overall education on a higher level through the work to narrow the gaps between Pyongyang and regions and between towns and countryside in educational level.
The field of general education is pushing ahead with the work to create and introduce educational methods in conformity with the age and psychological characteristics of schoolchildren, and universities are encouraging all teachers to improve their practical abilities and direct their efforts to making teaching programs. -0-

headline: National Economic Plans for January Fulfilled in Various Units of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- New standards and new records were set one after another at many units of the national economy, the national economic plans for January were fulfilled and dozens of projects were completed and inaugurated across the DPRK in a month.
The smelters of the blast furnace shops Nos. 1 and 2 of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex overfulfilled their daily pig iron production plan by applying advanced furnace operation methods capable of increasing the output of molten iron per charge.
The officials and workers of the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex increased the production of iron and steel by applying efficient furnace operation methods while ensuring the normal operation of the energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnace whose capacity improved.
Workers and technicians of the Chollima Steel Complex, the Posan Iron Works, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and the Chongjin Steel Plant steadily increased their production.
The Musan Mining Complex increased the production of concentrated iron ore by improving the operating ratio of equipment, and the miners of Unnyul and Jaeryong mines over-fulfilled their January quotas by giving priority to tunneling and earth-scrapping.
Workers and technicians of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex fulfilled their plans while providing favourable conditions for production and the Sunchon Chemical Complex carried out its production plan for fertilizer needed at greenhouse farms at 111 percent.
The nationwide electricity production plan for January was fulfilled thanks to the workers of every power base.
Colliers in the coal-mining industry carried out their national coal production plans for January at 103 percent.
The Ministry of Machine-building Industry fulfilled its plan for January.
The Komdok Mining Complex opened up a prospect of producing much more minerals by conducting a high-speed tunneling campaign and the Hyesan Youth Mine, Inphyong Youth Mine, Riwon Mine and the Sijung Mine overfulfilled their January plans by boosting cooperation between shifts and solving the technical problems arising in increasing production.
Thanks to the labor struggle of workers in the forestry sector, the nationwide timber production plan for January was carried out at 104 percent.
The workers in the railway transport sector carried out the nationwide freight transport plan for January at 102.4 percent.
The Sangwon Cement Complex fulfilled its January plan ahead of schedule and the Sunchon Cement Complex produced over 10 000 more tons of cement than planned.
The Taean Friendship Glass Factory fulfilled its sheet glass production plan for January at 104 percent.
Officials and workers in the light industry sector brought about an upsurge in production and thus concluded their national economic plan for January on all indices.
The fishing industry launched a drive for intensive fishing and put the sea culture on a scientific basis of higher level, thus bringing about innovations in production.
The news of the completion of projects conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living and the news of moving into new houses in the rural areas, which are becoming prosperous and civilized day by day, encouraged all the people across the country in the dynamic advance toward the Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, built as an unprecedented group of large greenhouses and a creation of love for the people in the northwestern part of the country, proves the validity and vitality of the policy of the WPK on regional development.
The first-stage modernization project of the Ryongsong Machine Complex was concluded, thus laying the material and technical foundations for the national economic development and a new progress in the machine-building industry as a whole.
The Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp was renovated into a comprehensive cultural recreation base and medical service center, and there appeared the Yombunjin Coastal Park with diverse service conditions and environment.
The Wonsan General Fishing Implements Factory, the Jikha Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm and the croaker pedigree farm under the Ongjin West Sea Fish Farm were successfully built.
The inaugurations of the Academy of Forest Science, the Farm Machine Institute, Sariwon Ri Kye Sun University of Education, the Sariwon Educational Apparatus Factory, Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture and the dormitory of Hamhung University of Medicine are the fruition of the policy of the WPK on making a leap forward by dint of science and guaranteeing the future by dint of education.
The First District of the Aedo Tideland in North Phyongan Province, the catalyst production base of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the catalyst production base and the slow effective granule urea fertilizer production line of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Kaesong Finishing Building Materials Factory, the Kyongam Building Materials Factory, the Kaesong Municipal Tree Nursery were inaugurated and the Haeju Farm Machine Factory, the Sariwon Tannery, the Unpha Cement Factory and the Unpha Corrugated Paper Factory renovated in January this year, providing solid foundations for the self-supporting economy and prosperity by dint of self-reliance.
The fourth large architectural group of another type, which combines architectural formative art with advancement, has been built in the Hwasong area in Pyongyang, nearing inauguration. -0-

headline: Many Rural Dwellings Built in DPRK Last Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 6 (KCNA) -- More than 32 000 rural dwellings were built in different parts of the country last year thanks to the efforts of officials and workers out in implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's programme for the rural revolution in the new era. And over 700 rural villages witnessed house-moving.
The cosy dwellings with modernity, cultural refinement and diversity as well as regional characteristics and public and production buildings in rural areas are an epitome of the people-first politics of the WPK and a striking demonstration of the validity and vitality of its programme for the rural revolution in the new era.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unset the rural housing construction as a major strategic plan, which the WPK attaches top priority to and which should be carried out, and clearly indicated the orientation and ways for the construction project.
Officials of the central headquarters for rural construction and every province, city and county conducted frontline-style political work at construction sites, rousing the masses to implement the Party's policies.
Measures were taken to produce various kinds of materials by boosting the ties with building-materials production units and to preferentially supply cement to Ryanggang and North Hamgyong provinces and Rason Municipality with a short period for construction.
The central and local design institutes completed the designs of rural dwellings convenient to the farmers' living while preserving the features and distinctive landscape of the relevant regions, and officials and workers of the Ministry of Railways carried freights to construction sites.
Material and technical foundations for the rural housing construction were strengthened in provinces, cities and counties.
Dozens of cities, counties and districts, including Tanchon City, Unsan County, Jongju City, Rangnang District, Mangyongdae District, Songnim City, Manpho City, Hoeryong City, Kangso District and Anju City, strengthened their construction workforces with skilled workers to speed up the housing construction.
South Hwanghae Province organized a provincial exhibition of finishing building materials to generalize the experience of advanced units and, at the same time, built a new base for producing building materials on its own and increased scientific and technological capabilities, thus making progress in diversifying building materials.
South Phyongan Province supplied quality building materials to cities and counties by strengthening building-materials production bases and taking measures to supply equipment and materials. North Phyongan and North Hwanghae provinces set stepwise goals for self-sufficiency in finishing building materials and carried them out.
Low- and single-storied and terraced dwelling houses of different forms were built in Mangyongdae, Ryokpho, Sadong, Samsok and Sunan districts and Kangdong County of Pyongyang Municipality to promote the convenience of farmers in their living.
Officials and builders in South Hamgyong and South Phyongan provinces completed the foundation, frame and roofing projects of thousands of houses and raised the level of specialization in different processes, thus making progress in implementing the Party's policies.
Nampho Municipality, North and South Hwanghae provinces, and Kangwon Province built dwelling houses of various styles with the characteristics of coastal, plain and mountainous areas and planted trees and flower shrubs of good species around them to preserve sentiments peculiar to the countryside.
The Tapsang Farm in Unsan County, the Taechong Farm in Unpha County and other farms displayed mosaic murals depicting the benevolent image ofKim Jong Unand built modern houses as well as production and public buildings to create a new scenery of cultural countryside.
Witnessing such grand transformation in the countryside, the agricultural workers across the country keenly realize how the WPK's desire is translated into a brilliant reality. -0-

Thanks to the labor struggle of workers in the forestry sector, the nationwide timber production plan for January was carried out at 104 percent.
The workers in the railway transport sector carried out the nationwide freight transport plan for January at 102.4 percent.
The Sangwon Cement Complex fulfilled its January plan ahead of schedule and the Sunchon Cement Complex produced over 10 000 more tons of cement than planned.
The Taean Friendship Glass Factory fulfilled its sheet glass production plan for January at 104 percent.
Officials and workers in the light industry sector brought about an upsurge in production and thus concluded their national economic plan for January on all indices.
The fishing industry launched a drive for intensive fishing and put the sea culture on a scientific basis of higher level, thus bringing about innovations in production.
The news of the completion of projects conducive to the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living and the news of moving into new houses in the rural areas, which are becoming prosperous and civilized day by day, encouraged all the people across the country in the dynamic advance toward the Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, built as an unprecedented group of large greenhouses and a creation of love for the people in the northwestern part of the country, proves the validity and vitality of the policy of the WPK on regional development.
The first-stage modernization project of the Ryongsong Machine Complex was concluded, thus laying the material and technical foundations for the national economic development and a new progress in the machine-building industry as a whole.
The Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp was renovated into a comprehensive cultural recreation base and medical service center, and there appeared the Yombunjin Coastal Park with diverse service conditions and environment.
The Wonsan General Fishing Implements Factory, the Jikha Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm and the croaker pedigree farm under the Ongjin West Sea Fish Farm were successfully built.
The inaugurations of the Academy of Forest Science, the Farm Machine Institute, Sariwon Ri Kye Sun University of Education, the Sariwon Educational Apparatus Factory, Sariwon Kye Ung Sang University of Agriculture and the dormitory of Hamhung University of Medicine are the fruition of the policy of the WPK on making a leap forward by dint of science and guaranteeing the future by dint of education.
The First District of the Aedo Tideland in North Phyongan Province, the catalyst production base of the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, the catalyst production base and the slow effective granule urea fertilizer production line of the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, the Kaesong Finishing Building Materials Factory, the Kyongam Building Materials Factory, the Kaesong Municipal Tree Nursery were inaugurated and the Haeju Farm Machine Factory, the Sariwon Tannery, the Unpha Cement Factory and the Unpha Corrugated Paper Factory renovated in January this year, providing solid foundations for the self-supporting economy and prosperity by dint of self-reliance.
The fourth large architectural group of another type, which combines architectural formative art with advancement, has been built in the Hwasong area in Pyongyang, nearing inauguration. -0-

headline: Groundbreaking Ceremony for Regional Development Policy-oriented Construction Held in Ragwon County of DPRK
Regional Development Policy-oriented Construction for 2026 Begins in Different Parts of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- Ground-breaking ceremonies took place respectively in Songhwa County, a granary on the west coast, Musan County and Taean District where a leading iron ore producer and a large machine-building base are located, and Phanmun District, the southernmost part of the country, on Feb. 6 to signal the start of construction projects for the new year, more vividly highlighting the validity and prospect of the Regional Development 20×10 Policy set forth by the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were Choe Tong Myong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Ju Chang Il, Kim Hyong Sik, Ju Chol Gyu, department directors of the WPK Central Committee, senior officials of the Party and power organs in South Hwanghae Province, North Hamgyong Province, Nampho Municipality and Kaesong Municipality, officials, working people and soldier-builders in the relevant areas.
At the ceremonies speakers noted that the significant ceremonies marking the start of the regional development policy-oriented construction for 2026, in which a new stage of the overall development of socialism will be opened, were to be held amid the great interest and expectation of the residents in Songhwa County, Musan County, Taean District and Phanmun District.
The unprecedented gigantic revolution to transform regional areas is being launched without letup, they said, adding that this reality is an eye-opening change that can be brought about only by the transparent outlook on the revolution and people of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is not complacent with the work for the people.
Noting it is the intention and firm will of the WPK that the long-term development of regional areas represents the everlasting future of our state and the prospect of Korean-style socialism, they ardently called for displaying indomitable patriotic spirit and fighting traits to uphold the Party Central Committee's policy on regional construction with a single mind and loyalty.
Then the commanders of the 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army made speeches.
The speakers said that they would devote their wisdom and passion to the patriotic work for creating the assets of the people, always aware of how substantial progress will be brought by the Party's policy for regional development in the new era depends on their own style of work.
They made a firm pledge to complete the projects on the highest level with the matchless creative spirit and devoted efforts and thus make a report of loyalty and glory to the great Party Central Committee.
As the venues of the ceremonies were full of excitement and joy of the regional people who will live in happiness and comfort in the new era of regional change, excavators, hydraulic loaders and trucks started their work. -0-

headline: Creator of People's Happiness and Pioneer of Civilization
Creator of People's Happiness and Pioneer of Civilization
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people are significantly greeting the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
The KPA has covered the road of development, performing distinguished military services in defending the country and its people for over 70 years since it had the letters "People" in its name.
Today the KPA is creditably fulfilling its honorable mission and duty as the creator of happiness and pioneer of civilization, as well as the defender of the country and the people under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The happy laughter of the people is resounding through the paradises of civilization built by service personnel--modern streets and dwelling houses, including Ryomyong Street, Songhwa Street, Hwasong Street and the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District, and the Masikryong Ski Resort and the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort.
Socialist fairyland-like villages were built in Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County and Taechong-ri, Unpha County of North Hwanghae Province and the Komdok area afflicted by terrible natural disasters, modern greenhouse farms completed and other edifices for the people erected one after another.
The entities of regional rejuvenation including modern light industrial factories, hospitals and leisure complexes in cities and counties across the country were built by service personnel, the frontline soldiers for accomplishing the sacred revolutionary cause of realizing the cherished desire of the local people.
It is a great pride of our country and its people to have a legendary and all-powerful heroic People's Army who are creating the people's happiness. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Flower Basket from Abroad
Education Improved at DPRK Universities
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- Several universities in the DPRK are pushing ahead with their efforts to improve education.
Pyongyang University of Mechanical Engineering has concentrated efforts on making good use of five centers for experimental education including the one for automotive engineering experimental education. It is also directing its effort to developing and manufacturing more equipment for experiment and practice.
Nampho University of Agriculture is intensifying the work to develop its overall education by realizing the integration of education, scientific research and production. By giving students research assignments and enrolling them in scientific research activities, it enables them to acquire knowledge, improve their practical abilities and complete their graduation papers through practice.
Sariwon Teacher Training College is concentrating its all efforts on broadening students' knowledge with the national assessment of the final-year students' practical ability for teaching majors in the sector of training teachers as an occasion. Through the inspection of classes at work, it analyzes new teachers' lectures and corrects their shortcomings. And it organizes the teaching contests among them to improve their qualifications. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Son Ae, a woman resident in Neighborhood Unit No. 33, Soryong-dong No. 2, Taedonggang District of Pyongyang Municipality, on her 100th birthday.
Officials of the Taedonggang District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and residents of the neighborhood unit visited her family to congratulate the centenarian.
After receiving the birthday spread, Ri expressed her gratitude toKim Jong Un.
The centenarian, who had to live in slavery since her childhood before the liberation of Korea, could lead a worthwhile life only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
She had supported the Party and the country with increased grain production on the socialist farm fields for decades and brought up her children well. Even after becoming a pensioner, she has done good things helpful to the country. -0-

headline: Immortal Leadership for Strengthening Military Muscle
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 7 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK significantly greet the 78th founding anniversary of the heroic Korean People's Army which is performing immortal feats in the struggle for national defence and socialist construction, regarding the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea as its lifeblood.
With the approach of the birth anniversary of the revolutionary armed forces, the service personnel and all the people are recollecting the days of the undying leadership of the illustrious commander who has visited drill grounds clouded with powder smoke to train the KPA into a matchless strong army with indomitable fighting spirit and capability for an actual war.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the line and tasks for making the KPA elite revolutionary armed forces and building a strong army at the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. He ushered in a great heyday of bolstering up the revolutionary armed forces while personally organizing and guiding drills for actual war and training contests.
At the first and second enlarged meetings of the Eighth Central Military Commission of the WPK held in February and June 2021, he clarified the strategic tasks and ways for the KPA to hold fast to, including thoroughly establishing the command system of the Party Central Committee across the entire army and further increasing its combat efficiency in conformity with the rapidly changing situation and the requirements of internal and external circumstances of the Korean revolution.
With the first workshop of commanding and political officers of the KPA, which set forth the important task for intensifying training under the five-point policy for effecting a revolution in training, as a momentum, a radical turn was brought about in bolstering up the efficiency of the KPA.
Kim Jong Unmade sure that military drills of different levels for real war were organized and wisely led the nuclear combat forces of the DPRK to maintain the strongest nuclear counteraction posture for defending the dignity and sovereignty of the country.
He ensured that the training of arms was conducted in an atmosphere of an actual war in order to remarkably increase the combat capabilities of the service personnel.
The training bases of the special operation units which have grown stronger to be the pivotal force of the armed forces of the DPRK absolutely and firmly defending the sovereignty of the country and the happiness of its people are associated with the sacred leadership of the heaven-sent great man.
The might of the KPA, which has grown into the elite revolutionary army under the idea of building a strong army, energetic leadership, great love and trust of the illustrious commander, is being further consolidated as the powerful strength capable of resolutely smashing any aggression and provocation by the hostile forces. -0-

headline: KPA Demonstrates Its Might as Elite Revolutionary Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the 78th Day of Army Founding, the DPRK people extend congratulations to the men and officers of the heroic Korean People's Army demonstrating their might in defending the country and building a powerful socialist country.
Under the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the KPA, always recording victories in the sacred colors, has developed into an elite revolutionary army capable of defeating any formidable enemy.
The General Secretary set it as a general goal of army building to model the entire army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. At the fourth conference of KPA artillerymen and the third meeting of activists at the Movement for Winning the Title of O Jung Hup-led Seventh Regiment of the KPA, he provided a great programme to be consistently held fast to in making the KPA an invincible and powerful revolutionary army.
He raised a hot wind of training within the People's Army, giving field guidance at the KPA Tankmen's Competition-2017, a firepower strike drill of KPA long-range artillery sub-units on the front, etc.
Thanks to the energetic leadership of him, who crossed the raging sea route aboard a small wooden boat to inspect the biggest hotspot and awake the servicepersons to their mission, and duty and feats, the KPA could be prepared as a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army.
He frequently visited defence science research bases and dangerous test grounds, standing in the vanguard of the death-defying struggle for the country and the people. Thanks to his devoted efforts, the DPRK rapidly emerged the strongest military power with tremendous defence capabilities.
The security of our country and the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche are definitely guaranteed as there is the elite revolutionary army possessed of formidable offensive power and overwhelming military muscle capable of deterring and controlling all sorts of blackmail from the hostile forces. -0-

headline: Conferences of Provincial (Municipal) Committees of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- Preparations are now under way in the DPRK to successfully hold the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, which will mark an epochal turning point in putting the great pioneering era of comprehensive development of socialism on a fresh higher stage.
Under the guidance of the Party Congress preparatory committee, the conferences of city and county Party committees were concluded. This was followed by conferences of Party organizations, including the provincial (municipal) Party committees and the Party committees serving the similar function such as those of the Cabinet, the Korean People's Army, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Railways.
Present at the conferences, held between January 28 and February 6, were leadership members of the relevant Party organizations and the delegates elected at the conferences of city and county Party committees.
Leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK guided those conferences.
The executive boards were elected at the conferences.
The conferences reviewed the work of the relevant Party committees for implementing the important tasks set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK and engaged in an in-depth discussion for setting development-oriented future goals and finding scientific ways for carrying them out on the basis of the experience and lessons gained and drawn during the past five years.
The reporters at the conferences referred to the successes made by the Party committees, the political staffs of the relevant regions, in playing the role of organizers and mobilizers in the struggle for implementing the Party policies while always prioritizing the work for more firmly establishing the Party Central Committee's unified leadership system.
The conferences concluded that when the Party committees direct primary efforts to strengthening their basic organizations and enhancing the role of their members, always guided by the line of the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural, the idea of attaching importance to cities and counties and the line of strengthening cities and counties, the working efficiency and activity of the Party organizations will be redoubled to make it possible for them to consolidate their regions, sectors and units into solid cornerstones for safeguarding national interests and guaranteeing comprehensive national rejuvenation.
Speakers at the conferences expressed their will to make full exertion and devotion in the vanguard of the struggle for national prosperity and development and wellbeing of the people by fundamentally innovating their ideological viewpoint and working manner.
The conferences authorized the Party committees to be elected to adopt and thoroughly implement the resolutions reflecting the tasks to be advanced at the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Leadership bodies of the relevant Party organizations were elected at the conferences.
The conferences elected the delegates to be sent to the Ninth Congress and appointed the observers.
All the delegates and observers were filled with the pledge to take part in the Congress in a responsible manner, always mindful of the general will and trust of their Party organizations, and fulfill their core and vanguard roles in every worksite for implementing the Party policies.
The preparatory undertakings are conducted dynamically, thanks to all the Party members, people and People's Army service personnel's political consciousness and zeal soaring ever in the run-up to the Congress. -0-

headline: Movement for Winning Title of Model Sports Unit Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, at least 600 institutions, industrial establishments, farms and schools across the DPRK became model sports units last year.
The Ministry of IT Industry and the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration arranged sports facilities and apparatuses and regularly conducted sports activities including table tennis, volleyball and tennis. In the course, they won the honor of model sports unit.
Many units, including the Changgwang Health Complex, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Steel Works, the Unjon County Foodstuff Factory and the South Hamgyong Provincial Communication Management Bureau, organized colorful sports games on a regular basis to make their employees acquire at least one sports technique, thus winning the title of twice model sports unit.
The Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm under the South Hamgyong Provincial Rural Economy Committee, the Township Farm of Suan County in North Hwanghae Province and the Jisin Vegetable Farm in Huichon City of Jagang Province encouraged such traditional sports games as wrestling, swinging and seesawing along with ball events. As a result, many farms across the country entered the ranks of model sports units.
Pyongyang University of Publication and Printing, Sariwon Primary School for Orphans and many other universities and schools became model sports units. -0-

headline: KPA Founding Anniversary Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Sunday dedicate editorials to the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
The papers say that the birth of the KPA inheriting the tradition of the anti-Japanese armed struggle on February 8, 1948 was a political event of epochal significance in the history of building the revolutionary armed forces and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche.
Over the past 78 years, the KPA has honorably defended the dignity of the country and the people while concluding every anti-imperialist confrontation with the undeniable clear victory and performed brilliant feats which no one can substitute for in the struggle for socialist construction and the promotion of people's wellbeing, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial, and goes on:
The KPA developed into the invincible ranks and elite revolutionary army under the wise guidance of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the founder-builder of the Juche-oriented revolutionary armed forces and iron-willed commander. Now it has greeted the greatest heyday of its development under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. Thanks to his outstanding guidance, the KPA is bravely smashing all challenges and crises with the strongest politico-ideological and military technological might and firmly guaranteeing the overall development of socialism.
The KPA is the revolutionary armed forces of the Workers' Party of Korea remaining absolutely loyal and obedient to the ideas and leadership of the Party Central Committee.
The character of the KPA is immutable as it has put the traces of sacrifice and feats on the stages of victory guided by the Party ahead of others, well aware of the plan and intention of the Party Central Committee, and shown no mercy to the enemies trying to check the cause of the Party.
The KPA is the creator of people's happiness as it has played a leading and core role in the vanguard of socialist construction.
The KPA is the pride of our Party and people and the symbol of our state's reputation and strength as it has defended the absolute dignity of the DPRK and the eternal happiness of the people with its indomitable spiritual strength and invincible might.
Minju Joson in an editorial says that the ever-victorious history of the heroic KPA led byKim Jong Un, the greatest brilliant commander, will be immortal century after century. -0-

headline: 27th Politburo Meeting of Eighth C.C., WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- The 27th Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on Feb. 7.
Attending the meeting were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK.
Present there as observers were vice directors of major departments of the C.C., WPK who are members of the relevant panels of the preparatory committee for the congress.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the meeting.
Upon authorization ofKim Jong Un, Jo Yong Won, Presidium member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, presided over the meeting.
The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee decided on the following agenda items:
First, "On the deliberation of qualifications of the delegates to the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Second, "On the deliberation of composition of the presidium, platform and secretariat for the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Third, "On the deliberation of schedule of the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
Fourth, "On the deliberation of documents to be submitted to the Ninth Congress of the WPK"
On the basis of hearing reports on the agenda items and discussing them, the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee approved relevant decisions.
Kim Jong Unmade an affirmative appreciation of the fact that the relevant panels of the congress preparatory committee have effectively pushed ahead with the preparations for the congress in every way, and clarified the principled issues and detailed tasks for the successful holding of the congress.
The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee adopted with unanimous approval a decision on opening the Ninth Congress of the WPK in Pyongyang, the capital of the revolution, in late February 2026. -0-

headline: Movement for Winning Title of Model Sports Unit Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, at least 600 institutions, industrial establishments, farms and schools across the DPRK became model sports units last year.
The Ministry of IT Industry and the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration arranged sports facilities and apparatuses and regularly conducted sports activities including table tennis, volleyball and tennis. In the course, they won the honor of model sports unit.
Many units, including the Changgwang Health Complex, the Ryuwon Footwear Factory, the Pyongyang Steel Works, the Unjon County Foodstuff Factory and the South Hamgyong Provincial Communication Management Bureau, organized colorful sports games on a regular basis to make their employees acquire at least one sports technique, thus winning the title of twice model sports unit.
The Ryonpho Greenhouse Farm under the South Hamgyong Provincial Rural Economy Committee, the Township Farm of Suan County in North Hwanghae Province and the Jisin Vegetable Farm in Huichon City of Jagang Province encouraged such traditional sports games as wrestling, swinging and seesawing along with ball events. As a result, many farms across the country entered the ranks of model sports units.
Pyongyang University of Publication and Printing, Sariwon Primary School for Orphans and many other universities and schools became model sports units. -0-

headline: Conferences of Provincial (Municipal) Committees of WPK Held
Conferences of Provincial (Municipal) Committees of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- Preparations are now under way in the DPRK to successfully hold the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, which will mark an epochal turning point in putting the great pioneering era of comprehensive development of socialism on a fresh higher stage.
Under the guidance of the Party Congress preparatory committee, the conferences of city and county Party committees were concluded. This was followed by conferences of Party organizations, including the provincial (municipal) Party committees and the Party committees serving the similar function such as those of the Cabinet, the Korean People's Army, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Railways.
Present at the conferences, held between January 28 and February 6, were leadership members of the relevant Party organizations and the delegates elected at the conferences of city and county Party committees.
Leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK guided those conferences.
The executive boards were elected at the conferences.
The conferences reviewed the work of the relevant Party committees for implementing the important tasks set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK and engaged in an in-depth discussion for setting development-oriented future goals and finding scientific ways for carrying them out on the basis of the experience and lessons gained and drawn during the past five years.
The reporters at the conferences referred to the successes made by the Party committees, the political staffs of the relevant regions, in playing the role of organizers and mobilizers in the struggle for implementing the Party policies while always prioritizing the work for more firmly establishing the Party Central Committee's unified leadership system.
The conferences concluded that when the Party committees direct primary efforts to strengthening their basic organizations and enhancing the role of their members, always guided by the line of the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural, the idea of attaching importance to cities and counties and the line of strengthening cities and counties, the working efficiency and activity of the Party organizations will be redoubled to make it possible for them to consolidate their regions, sectors and units into solid cornerstones for safeguarding national interests and guaranteeing comprehensive national rejuvenation.
Speakers at the conferences expressed their will to make full exertion and devotion in the vanguard of the struggle for national prosperity and development and wellbeing of the people by fundamentally innovating their ideological viewpoint and working manner.
The conferences authorized the Party committees to be elected to adopt and thoroughly implement the resolutions reflecting the tasks to be advanced at the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Leadership bodies of the relevant Party organizations were elected at the conferences.
The conferences elected the delegates to be sent to the Ninth Congress and appointed the observers.
All the delegates and observers were filled with the pledge to take part in the Congress in a responsible manner, always mindful of the general will and trust of their Party organizations, and fulfill their core and vanguard roles in every worksite for implementing the Party policies.
The preparatory undertakings are conducted dynamically, thanks to all the Party members, people and People's Army service personnel's political consciousness and zeal soaring ever in the run-up to the Congress. -0-

KPA Demonstrates Its Might as Elite Revolutionary Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the 78th Day of Army Founding, the DPRK people extend congratulations to the men and officers of the heroic Korean People's Army demonstrating their might in defending the country and building a powerful socialist country.
Under the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the KPA, always recording victories in the sacred colors, has developed into an elite revolutionary army capable of defeating any formidable enemy.
The General Secretary set it as a general goal of army building to model the entire army on Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. At the fourth conference of KPA artillerymen and the third meeting of activists at the Movement for Winning the Title of O Jung Hup-led Seventh Regiment of the KPA, he provided a great programme to be consistently held fast to in making the KPA an invincible and powerful revolutionary army.
He raised a hot wind of training within the People's Army, giving field guidance at the KPA Tankmen's Competition-2017, a firepower strike drill of KPA long-range artillery sub-units on the front, etc.
Thanks to the energetic leadership of him, who crossed the raging sea route aboard a small wooden boat to inspect the biggest hotspot and awake the servicepersons to their mission, and duty and feats, the KPA could be prepared as a-match-for-a-hundred revolutionary army.
He frequently visited defence science research bases and dangerous test grounds, standing in the vanguard of the death-defying struggle for the country and the people. Thanks to his devoted efforts, the DPRK rapidly emerged the strongest military power with tremendous defence capabilities.
The security of our country and the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche are definitely guaranteed as there is the elite revolutionary army possessed of formidable offensive power and overwhelming military muscle capable of deterring and controlling all sorts of blackmail from the hostile forces. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
story_text: Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- A flower basket in the joint name of Cui Tongjun and Wang Shuli, members of theKim Il Sung-Kim Jong IlFoundation, was laid before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill here on Saturday on the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army. -0-

headline: Regional Development Policy-oriented Construction Begins in Sinphyong and Sonchon Counties of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 8 (KCNA) -- Groundbreaking ceremonies for the regional development policy-oriented construction for the new year were held in Sinphyong and Sonchon counties of the DPRK on February 7, amid the growing patriotic will and fighting spirit of all the people to accelerate the overall prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism under the blueprint to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present at the ceremonies were Choe Ryong Hae, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ju Chang Il, department director of the C.C, WPK, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK, officials in the relevant provinces and counties, working people and service personnel.
At the ceremonies speakers said that a new era of national rejuvenation, an era of remarkable changes, is ushered in thanks to the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has boldly pioneered and invariably accomplished the unprecedented revolution for realizing the centuries-old desire of the regional people.
They said that the ceremonies add inexhaustible vitality to the ranks of general advance to glorify the significant year 2026, greeted with ardent patriotism and boundless pride, as a year of eventful successes and eye-opening changes to be specially recorded in the history of the country and to more vigorously usher in a period of the comprehensive national prosperity with the clear and sure development of regions.
They stressed that thanks to the wise guidance of the great Party Central Committee, which put forward the absolute popular spirit as the lifeblood of its policy, the wealth of prosperity will surely spring up in the relevant regions at the end of the year and the bright future, in which the people across the country live in happiness all together, will be brought earlier.
They ardently called on all the soldier-builders, officials and working people to glorify this year when the glorious Party Congress is to be held as a year of fresh advance and leap forward by faithfully upholding the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unwith single mind.
Then the commanders of 124th regiments of the Korean People's Army made pledge-taking speeches.
They vowed to make a new history of regional transformation with perfect practice by kindling the flames of collective and successive innovations and of setting new standards and new records at every construction site.
The projects began amid the stormy cheers and shouts for devoted implementation raised by the participants with surging enthusiasm. -0-
