topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The Korean People's Army, the ever-victorious elite ranks, has formulated the new concept of a powerful army and a new law of victory with its unique ideological and moral superiority of remaining absolutely loyal to the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, unparalleled mass heroism, matchless bravery and indomitable fighting spirit, and the honour of the revolutionary armed forces has reached its peak for its absolute might. It is marking its founding anniversary with pride, adding a page of shining victories and miracles to the great army-building history.
The KPA is adding to the greatness of the Party and the state and ushering in a new era of prosperity and development in the vanguard of the revolution advancing through struggle and transformation for the eternal prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people, true to the sacred letters embroidered on its glorious colors. Its legendary feats and dynamic advance constitute a great pride of the state and the people and a symbol of their strong dignity and inexhaustible strength.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK on February 8, the 78th founding anniversary of the KPA to congratulate and encourage all officers and men of the army.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee.
All the commanding officers were filled with boundless excitement and joy as they came to greet the great brilliant commander visiting the Ministry of National Defence with his ardent desire to put his trust, deepest ever for the existence and development of the revolutionary armed forces, in them again on the significant army-founding day.
There was a solemn ceremony of greeting the Supreme Commander.
Kim Jong Unreviewed the guard of honour of the Korean People's Army.
The Ministry of National Defence presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the boundless reverence of all the service personnel of the People's Army for him.
He was courteously greeted by major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the KPA large combined units.
He reviewed the flags of victory, symbols of honour of the large combined units and combined units of the KPA at all levels.
All the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the greatest commander in the world who has led the Juche-based cause of building a powerful army to victory with his outstanding army-building idea and commanding art, fully demonstrating the dignity, might and fame of the armed forces and adding eternal glory to the long army-building history.
The national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
The guard of honour of the KPA marched with pride, being reviewed by the Supreme Commander.
Kim Jong Undelivered a significant speech on the occasion of army-founding day.
In the speech, he said:
All the generals and other officers and soldiers of the heroic armed forces of the Republic,
Generals and other officers at the Ministry of National Defence, the supreme commanding organ of the Korean People's Army,
I congratulate you on the February 8 Army Founding Day.
This day, when we recall with pride our army's heroic building history and its ever-victorious course, is a revolutionary holiday which is significantly celebrated not only by the service personnel but also by all the people throughout the country.
On behalf of the Party and government, I extend warm congratulations and militant greetings to all the officers and soldiers on the occasion of Army Founding Day in reflection of my mind always thankful to our army that is playing every role and making infinite devotion for our great state and people, shouldering a great mission and heavy duty incomparable to those of other armies in the world.
I also pay my respects to the responsible efforts of the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and the military and political cadres of the large combined units, who are doing their best to perfectly embody the military lines and policies of the Party in the military and political activities of the entire army.
In particular, I extend warm encouragement and congratulations to the commanding officers and other combatants of the overseas special operations units, who are carrying out the order of their homeland in combat positions in the faraway alien land, staking the honour of their heroic army, as I want to see them all the more today.
Comrades,
We greet this day every year, but today I have come here with a really special feeling.
As it is the day we are celebrating in the lead-up to the Ninth Party Congress, which will open soon, I feel more keenly the greatness and preciousness of our army.
In looking back upon the victorious journey of our army over the past turbulent five years as it has always been since its founding, today's glory would never be conceivable separated from the enormous role our army has played. At this thought, I can hardly find enough words to express my heartfelt thanks to all the officers and soldiers of our army.
Officers and soldiers of the KPA,
You have done really great things to support the Party's cause and defend the security of the national sovereignty and safety of the people in the vanguard of the pioneering struggle, the struggle for achieving transformation, which was challenging year after year.
I would like to praise you for having done greater things last year than you had done in all the years of the past.
Last year was a year especially filled with unheard-of dramatic events and distinguished feats that could be performed only by our army. For this, it can be called a year when the Party's and people's trust in and affection for their army grew stronger and greater.
Our army has proved before the times and history that it is its mettle and original features to quicken more enormous and vigorous strides for loyalty and feats the greater the trust in and expectation for it is.
As you are all prepared for, this is a year of tremendous transformation, when the fighting front of our army will become more widened and which will demand more strenuous efforts.
Likewise, the coming five years that will be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party will be years when our army's outstanding role that no one else can perform will become further enhanced.
Our Party is always filled with confidence and feels proud as if it had won the world, as it has put in the vanguard of the struggle to create a new world the revolutionary armed forces, our army, boundlessly faithful to its cause.
Comrades,
On the occasion of Army Founding Day, I offer my warm congratulations once again to all the officers and soldiers of the army, and I hope you will make more strenuous efforts.
Our brave army will further accelerate its advance for the country and the people, and its fighting course will be adorned with brilliant feats and fame.
Long live the heroic Korean People’s Army!
His speech, filled with profound trust and affection of him who always places the armed forces of the Republic in the vanguard of the drive for implementing the sacred cause of the WPK, deeply moved all the service personnel.
When he finished his speech, the service personnel chanted the slogan of loyalty to him and sang a revolutionary military song in chorus as a token of their militant enthusiasm to dedicate themselves to ensuring the eternal prosperity and security of their socialist country and the happiness of the people by regarding as stimulants of their growth and lifeblood of their destiny the trust and loving care shown by him, who injects vitality into the revolutionary armed forces to be strong, signally glorious and invincible, and by becoming the service personnel, strong in their faith, moral obligation and ideology, who never deviate from the path indicated by the Party Central Committee, fully embodying its revolutionary idea.
He had a photo session with the major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the large combined units of the KPA.
A ceremonial performance was given by the central military band of the Ministry of National Defence.
The festive mood on the Day of Army was further deepened by the performers' rhythmic formations ever changing to the tune of revolutionary military songs full of the militant spirit, reminiscent of a bugle signal to the entire army for an advance toward a new victory, and smart and amazing rifle-handling skills shown by KPA honour guard members.
Kim Jong Unhad a photo taken with the generals and other officers of the headquarters of the ministry in commemoration of the army-founding day.
All the participants paid the highest glory and respect to the Supreme Commander who has led the service personnel step by step with his warm encouragement so that they win great victories and perform immortal exploits in the forefront of the struggle for carrying out the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army.
Kim Jong Unsaid that the course of eye-opening development and offensive advance of our country, which has brought about miraculous transformation and remarkable successes during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, is associated with the undying exploits of the KPA service personnel, admirable sons and daughters of the country and the people, who have made, by their ennobling devotion and priceless feats, a breakthrough for victory and effected new upsurges in the revolution in order to bring the great transformation to be seen in the future to present reality.
From the army-founding generation to the present generation, the revolutionary nature of our army voluntarily shouldering the heavy burden for the revolution has never changed and to be proud of is the militant path it has covered by making a bold advance to gain a series of victories in the face of trials and difficulties, and yet more worthwhile and glorious is the path ahead of it, he said, adding that the worksites of gigantic struggle, to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Party, are calling the service personnel of the KPA, the strongest in the world, invincible and heroic.
He expressed belief that the KPA, which has deemed the decisions of the Party the absolute truth and supreme military order and always said "Yes" in response, will glorify the current era by performing miraculous exploits transcending heroism of all historical ages in the ensuing new struggle and add lustre to the honour of the present generation to be admired by posterity.
All the participants loudly chanted the slogan of "Death-defying Defence", out of their firm pledge to add eternal brilliance to the great fame and glory of the KPA which has adorned the past years with legendary victories and miracles by dint of its unique spirit and soul, always living up to its sacred title - army of the Party and army of the people.
Kim Jong Unwatched a sports game of commanding officers of the ministry held in commemoration of the army-founding day.
Then he met the retired generals invited to the celebrations.
Saying that recorded in every page of the long army-building history, which always goes alongside the leadership history of the Party, is the ennobling devotion made by the retired generals who faithfully upheld the Party and the country with their unbounded self-sacrificing indomitable spirit during their long service in the revolutionary army, he had a photo session with them who dedicated themselves to bolstering up the military muscle.
His congratulatory visit to the Ministry of National Defence was a meaningful occasion for renewing the noble sense of mission of the service personnel and redoubling their efforts to remain faithful to their role as the vanguard of the revolutionary armed forces in the sacred struggle for safeguarding the national sovereignty and right to development and the people's destiny and future. -0-

headline: Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Harvests Vegetables
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The newly-built Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm in the DPRK harvested vegetables for the first time this year.
With high pride of living and working in an ideal farm town with a record group of large greenhouses which made another leap forward in modernity, advanced nature and profitability as well as architectural level, its officials and employees cultivated healthy vegetable sprouts while ensuring the control of temperature and humidity and the nutrient care as required by technical regulations according to the growing conditions of vegetable crops.
The farm transplanted the vegetable sprouts to greenhouses and cultivated them in a scientific and technological way while steadily raising the level of employees' technical knowledge and skills in contact with technicians and researchers of relevant units.
The joyful faces of employees harvesting such various kinds of vegetables as tomato, pepper, cucumber and cabbage at different types of greenhouses have presented another spectacular scene of the "Treasure Island".
The Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center, too, has produced different kinds of fruit and leaf vegetables.
Trucks carrying vegetables arrived at commercial service units, orphanage and primary and middle schools for orphans in the city of Sinuiju.
Laughter of orphans seeing fresh vegetables including red tomatoes resounded through the schools.
Service amenities in the city were crowded with inhabitants buying fresh vegetables.
The citizens expressed their impressions with delight that they could taste various kinds of vegetable dishes although the farm was inaugurated not long ago.
Officials and employees in the service sector of the city are giving sincere service to the inhabitants with pleasure. -0-

headline: Soil Environment Monitoring System Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The Environmental Science and Technology Institute under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in the DPRK newly established a nationwide soil environment monitoring system, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The establishment of the system capable of surveying and grasping the soil environment quality conditions across the country and conducting scientific analysis, assessment and monitoring provides another scientific guarantee for protecting and managing the land resources of the country.
National certificate of sci-tech success was awarded to those who contributed to establishing the nationwide monitoring system. -0-

headline: KPA Founding Anniversary Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel of the DPRK significantly celebrated the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
A large number of people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
At the plaza of the Palace, the visitors looked back in reverence upon the revolutionary careers and exploits of the great leaders who opened up the origin of the Juche-oriented army building and developed the KPA into an invincible revolutionary army.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country and mosaics depicting the images of the peerlessly great men to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers at them.
At the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, working people, youth and students paid high tribute to the Monument to the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs, recollecting the indomitable spirit and exploits of the victors of the great years who honorably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the Republic.
Many people visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery.
The national flags of the Republic fluttered at major places in Pyongyang and provincial, city and county seats and institutions, industrial establishments and farms across the country, and various posters and visual aids were displayed to rev up the festive mood.
Colorful performances were given at the National Theatre and other theatres and places in the capital city, giving pleasure and optimism to the working people, youth and students.
Performances were given in North and South Phyongan, South Hwanghae and South Hamgyong provinces, Nampho and Kaesong municipalities and other parts of the country.
On the same day, many working people, youth and students across the country visited and congratulated the war veterans enjoying the high glory of life and happiness.
Public catering establishments, Central Zoo, Natural History Museum, Munsu Water Park and other bases for cultural and leisure activities in Pyongyang and other parts of the country were crowded with working people enjoying the holiday, and  gorgeous illuminations were displayed in Songhwa, Hwasong and Jonwi streets to rev up the festive mood. -0-

headline: Sleighing - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- Sleighing is one of the folk games of Korea which has been enjoyed by children from long ago.
Sleighing on ice or snow was already popular in the early days of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910).
Sled was approximately 40 cm long, 35 cm wide and 10 cm high.
At the lower part of the sled were two blades made of bamboo, wire or metal.
To ride the sled, two poles were needed. Lengths of the poles 3 cm in diameter are as long as the sitting height of children and hammered to the lower part of the poles are iron nails.
A game of sled popular among the children was to return their starting point after turning the set point.
Today sleighing is widely conducted in various forms and methods.
Sleighing was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in October 2017. -0-

headline: Hwasong Taedonggang Beer House
story_text:
One day in April 2024, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Hwasong Taedonggang Beer House nearing its opening.
Enjoying a general view of the beer house with officials,Kim Jong Unsaid that the elevation of the beer house looks very good and the house was built well to show the modern architectural beauty and appearance as a special beer house through the front elevation.
He said with great satisfaction that the beer house fully shows its appearance and it is a building which directly has the best visual effect among structures of the country.
The accompanying officials were moved by his words.
In fact, the first elevation layout of the beer house was not designed as now.
After looking at the layout of the beer house several times,Kim Jong Ungave detailed guidance to depict the beer jug overflowing with froth and beer bottle in front of the beer house so that people can notice it from afar.
As a result, the Hwasong Taedonggang Bear House could be successfully built to visually show the magnificent character of the bear house thanks to the painstaking efforts ofKim Jong Unwho makes sure that every edifice for people is designed and built as the best one representing modern civilization. -0-

headline: Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Harvests Vegetables
KPA Commanding Officers Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
KPA Founding Anniversary Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel of the DPRK significantly celebrated the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
A large number of people visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
At the plaza of the Palace, the visitors looked back in reverence upon the revolutionary careers and exploits of the great leaders who opened up the origin of the Juche-oriented army building and developed the KPA into an invincible revolutionary army.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country and mosaics depicting the images of the peerlessly great men to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers at them.
At the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum, working people, youth and students paid high tribute to the Monument to the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs, recollecting the indomitable spirit and exploits of the victors of the great years who honorably defended the dignity and sovereignty of the Republic.
Many people visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery.
The national flags of the Republic fluttered at major places in Pyongyang and provincial, city and county seats and institutions, industrial establishments and farms across the country, and various posters and visual aids were displayed to rev up the festive mood.
Colorful performances were given at the National Theatre and other theatres and places in the capital city, giving pleasure and optimism to the working people, youth and students.
Performances were given in North and South Phyongan, South Hwanghae and South Hamgyong provinces, Nampho and Kaesong municipalities and other parts of the country.
On the same day, many working people, youth and students across the country visited and congratulated the war veterans enjoying the high glory of life and happiness.
Public catering establishments, Central Zoo, Natural History Museum, Munsu Water Park and other bases for cultural and leisure activities in Pyongyang and other parts of the country were crowded with working people enjoying the holiday, and  gorgeous illuminations were displayed in Songhwa, Hwasong and Jonwi streets to rev up the festive mood. -0-

headline: Flower Baskets Laid at Statues of Great Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- Officials, service personnel, working people, youth and students in the DPRK visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilacross the country to place flower baskets and flowers at them on the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Army.
Laid at the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill were flower baskets in the name of the Party, armed forces and power organs, ministries, national agencies, units of the KPA and the Public Security Forces, factories and universities.
Placed at the statues in different parts of Pyongyang, includingKim Il SungUniversity, were flower baskets in the name of KPA and PSF units, institutions and enterprises.
Officials, service personnel, working people, youth and students in other parts of the country visited the statues of the peerlessly great men in their residential areas to pay high tribute to them. -0-

headline: Soil Environment Monitoring System Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The Environmental Science and Technology Institute under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in the DPRK newly established a nationwide soil environment monitoring system, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The establishment of the system capable of surveying and grasping the soil environment quality conditions across the country and conducting scientific analysis, assessment and monitoring provides another scientific guarantee for protecting and managing the land resources of the country.
National certificate of sci-tech success was awarded to those who contributed to establishing the nationwide monitoring system. -0-

headline: KPA Commanding Officers Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- Greeting the Day of Army Founding, a proud holiday of our socialist state, all the service personnel and people pay the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the founder-builder of the armed forces of the DPRK.
No Kwang Chol, Jong Kyong Thaek, Ri Yong Gil and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and commanders of the services and large combined units visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on the occasion of the 78th anniversary of the heroic Korean People's Army.
The sacred temple of Juche was full of the boundless reverence for the great leaders who performed immortal great exploits in the history of building the Juche-based revolutionary armed forces with their outstanding ideas and extraordinary leadership.
Placed at the statues of the great leaders was a flower basket in the name of the KPA.
All the participants paid high tribute to the statues, reflecting the unanimous mind of the officers and men of the armed forces of the DPRK.
At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, the participants paid tribute to the great leaders in humblest reverence.
The KPA commanding officers made a firm pledge to devote themselves to fulfilling the sacred mission assigned by the times and the revolution on the road of defending the victorious advance of the Juche cause with arms, remaining absolutely loyal to the ideas and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Regional Development Policy-Oriented Construction Starts in Counties of DPRK
Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Harvests Vegetables
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- The newly-built Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm in the DPRK harvested vegetables for the first time this year.
With high pride of living and working in an ideal farm town with a record group of large greenhouses which made another leap forward in modernity, advanced nature and profitability as well as architectural level, its officials and employees cultivated healthy vegetable sprouts while ensuring the control of temperature and humidity and the nutrient care as required by technical regulations according to the growing conditions of vegetable crops.
The farm transplanted the vegetable sprouts to greenhouses and cultivated them in a scientific and technological way while steadily raising the level of employees' technical knowledge and skills in contact with technicians and researchers of relevant units.
The joyful faces of employees harvesting such various kinds of vegetables as tomato, pepper, cucumber and cabbage at different types of greenhouses have presented another spectacular scene of the "Treasure Island".
The Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center, too, has produced different kinds of fruit and leaf vegetables.
Trucks carrying vegetables arrived at commercial service units, orphanage and primary and middle schools for orphans in the city of Sinuiju.
Laughter of orphans seeing fresh vegetables including red tomatoes resounded through the schools.
Service amenities in the city were crowded with inhabitants buying fresh vegetables.
The citizens expressed their impressions with delight that they could taste various kinds of vegetable dishes although the farm was inaugurated not long ago.
Officials and employees in the service sector of the city are giving sincere service to the inhabitants with pleasure. -0-

headline: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students Celebrate Birthday of KPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 9 (KCNA) -- Dancing parties of youth and students were held in the DPRK on February 8, the 78th anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Army.
The venues of dancing parties in the capital city, including the plaza of the Pyongyang Grand Theatre, were filled with excitement and joy of the young people greeting the Day of Army Founding.
The participants danced, paying the highest glory to the peerlessly great men who founded the revolutionary armed forces of Juche and developed the KPA into an invincible revolutionary army with their unique idea of army building and outstanding leadership.
The atmosphere of dancing parties revved up amid the playing of songs "Arms and Youth" and "Let Us Meet on the Front" reflecting the faith of young people ready to turn out in the sacred war for defending the country with arms of the revolution and class if the enemy bring the dark clouds of war to this land.
Such dancing parties took place in all the provincial seats, cities and counties on the same day. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Metal Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 10 (KCNA) -- With a resolve to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea with proud successes in increased production, the metallurgical industry sector of the DPRK is strengthening the material and technical foundations to activate production.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex has striven to improve the management of equipment and manpower and the technical control and further perfect the Korean-style iron- and steel-making methods.
The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex has introduced rational inventions conducive to raising the operating level of energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnace, putting the blending of charge and furnace operation on a scientific basis according to the changes of indices such as temperature, humidity and grade and thus turning out a lot of molten iron every day.
The Chollima Steel Complex is producing different grades and sizes of rolled steel needed for various economic sectors, while raising the actual operation rate and ensuring the process-by-process engagement by checking up equipment in a responsible manner.
The Posan Iron Works, the Hungnam Electrode Factory and the Chongjin Steel Plant are enhancing the safety and efficiency of overall production processes and improving the actual extraction rate of products by conducting quality control in a responsible manner.
The Musan Mining Complex has raised the capacity for removing barren soil and made accessories for equipment by itself to provide a guarantee for increased production.
Unnyul, Jangsan, Ramjong and Taesong mines have improved mining conditions and increased the output of iron ore and fire-proof materials by operating excavators, compressors and vehicles at full capacity and introducing rational working methods. -0-

headline: Crimes of Japanese Imperialists, Sworn Enemy of Korean People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 10 (KCNA) -- The war of aggression, ignited by Japan against Korea in 1592 (Imjin Year), is sometimes called the "Hwalja (metal type) War".
This is because the Japanese aggressors wantonly looted the metal types associated with the creative wisdom and talents of the Korean people during the Imjin War.
The metal types were made in Korea for the first time in the world.
On the basis of experience gained in developing the technology of printing with wooden types in the period of Koryo (918-1392), the Korean people made metal types and used them for publishing and printing. In the period of the Feudal Joson Dynasty (1392-1910), they made hundreds of thousands of metal types to print many books such as the Chronicles of the Feudal Joson Dynasty.
Most of the metal types showing the excellence of the Korean people were looted by the Japanese aggressors during the war to seriously hinder the cultural development of Korea.
More than 200 000 metal types were plundered by the Japanese aggressor forces during the war. Japan printed books of political, military, economic and other fields by developing the printing, which was as good as scratch, with recourse to these metal types.
A Japanese scholar commented that the war was something regrettable but occasioned by it, the printing "revolution" began in Japanese society.
This sheds light on the vicious nature of Japanese aggressors.
Owing to the "Hwalja War", type foundries were all burned down and most of the bronze types disappeared in Korea, the world's first metal type maker. Since then, the type printing had suspended for about 70 years.
Japan's plunder of metal types was a brutal act of obstructing the cultural development of the Korean people. -0-

Young People's Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites Begins in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 10 (KCNA) -- To start their study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, students and other young men and women from across the country gathered at the plaza before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin Hyesan City, Ryanggang Province of the DPRK, on February 9.
Present there were officials concerned, officials of the youth league and expedition members.
They laid a flower basket and bouquets of flowers at the statues of the President and the Chairman and paid tribute to them.
Then, a report was made at the meeting to be followed by speeches.
The reporter and speakers stressed the need for all the expedition members to acquire the steadfast revolutionary spirit and indomitable fighting spirit of the first generation of the revolution and demonstrate the resourcefulness and courage peculiar to the Korean youth in the vanguard of the general advance for the comprehensive development of the great state.
After the meeting, the expedition members left for the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site under the flags of the DPRK and the Socialist Patriotic Youth League. -0-

headline: Paddy-field Fish Breeding Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 10 (KCNA) -- Paddy-field fish breeding has been expanded and introduced in different parts of the DPRK.
Pyongyang Municipality remodeled paddy fields, including making fish ways and pools at the fields selected as the right sites for paddy-field fish breeding. On this basis, it helps districts and counties improve the nutritional care of breeding fish in winter and make good preparations for hatching in spring.
South Phyongan Province is putting spurs to laying the foundations for producing animal protein feed including the supply of fish meal and Hermetia illucens habitat.
North Hwanghae Province, assisted by excellent university teachers and technicians of fish farming sector in the province, ensures that the officials of the agricultural guidance organ grasp the technical problems arising in introducing organic farming through fish farming.
North Phyongan Province built a breeding fish base, equipped with fodder crushing room, granulated feed production room and hatchery in a short span of time, and is taking measures to promote paddy-field fish breeding.
Jagang Province organized a show and training course on paddy-field fish breeding in the northern mountainous areas. -0-

headline: Working People's Organizations Publishing House Marks Its Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 10 (KCNA) -- The Working People's Organizations Publishing House in the DPRK marked its 80th founding anniversary.
After national liberation, PresidentKim Il Sunggave detailed guidance to the founding of the organs of mass organizations and indicated the way to be followed by them at each stage of the developing revolution.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilset February 9, 1946, when the "Workers' Newspaper" was founded, as the founding day of the publishing house, and led it to fulfill its mission as a powerful ideological weapon for making the working people's organizations the ranks of loyalty.
The publishing house is greeting a golden age of its development under the guidance of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
AsKim Jong Unshowed loving care and trust, solving the problems arising in making new innovations in publishing and editing and highly praising even small successes, the publishing house could display its might in educating the working people in a revolutionary way and arousing them to the implementation of the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A meeting to mark the 80th anniversary of the founding of the publishing house was held at the Central Hall of Workers on February 9.
Present there were Kim Jong Sun, department director of the WPK Central Committee, officials, journalists, editors and employees of the publishing house, and officials and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea and the Socialist Women's Union of Korea in Pyongyang.
Kong Son Il, director and editor-in-chief of the publishing house, made a commemorative report. -0-

New Educational Programme to be Enforced from New School Year in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 11 (KCNA) -- A new educational programme will be enforced in the primary and secondary education sector from the new school year this year, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The key point of the new programme is the optional curriculum.
It is divided into literature, science, art, sports and technology fields, and each field has specific subjects.
The primary and junior middle schools will teach general knowledge according to the unified standard curriculum set by the state, and the senior middle schools and technical senior middle schools give education of the above said fields according to individualities of students, so that all students can acquire more than one technical skill at the secondary education stage.
The educational sector has pushed ahead with the work of drawing up new compulsory curriculum, compiling textbooks and applying the optional curriculum in some cities and counties on a trial basis.
It has organized various short courses on the new curriculum for the officials and educators in the field of education and put spurs to the preparations for training more teachers and laying material and technical foundations in contact with provinces, cities and counties. -0-

headline: Reception Given by Russian Embassy

headline: New Educational Programme to be Enforced from New School Year in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 11 (KCNA) -- A new educational programme will be enforced in the primary and secondary education sector from the new school year this year, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The key point of the new programme is the optional curriculum.
It is divided into literature, science, art, sports and technology fields, and each field has specific subjects.
The primary and junior middle schools will teach general knowledge according to the unified standard curriculum set by the state, and the senior middle schools and technical senior middle schools give education of the above said fields according to individualities of students, so that all students can acquire more than one technical skill at the secondary education stage.
The educational sector has pushed ahead with the work of drawing up new compulsory curriculum, compiling textbooks and applying the optional curriculum in some cities and counties on a trial basis.
It has organized various short courses on the new curriculum for the officials and educators in the field of education and put spurs to the preparations for training more teachers and laying material and technical foundations in contact with provinces, cities and counties. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Flower Basket from Lao President
National Book and Art Exhibition Opens in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- A national book and art exhibition opened in the DPRK to celebrate the forthcoming Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea amid the daily growing political enthusiasm of the Party members and all other people of the country for greeting the Congress significantly and grandly.
An opening ceremony took place at the Korean Art Gallery on February 11.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, department director of the WPK Central Committee, officials, journalists and artists of ministries, national agencies and publishing and fine art sectors and working people in Pyongyang.
Sung Jong Gyu, minister of Culture, made an opening address.
He said that the exhibition is a significant political and cultural festival conveying long the greatness of the peerlessly great men and the immortal revolutionary exploits performed by them for the Party, the revolution, the country and the people, and showing the history of heroic struggle of the DPRK people who have won victories under the wise leadership of the Party Central Committee.
He declared the opening of the exhibition, saying that it would be an occasion of significance in demonstrating the dignity and invincible leadership of the great Party and redoubling the political awareness and revolutionary enthusiasm of the Party members and all other people of the country to advance toward the goal for a new victory to be set forth by the Ninth Party Congress.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the exhibition hall.
On display at the venue are more than 10 000 kinds of books, including books dealing with the glorious revolutionary history and immortal exploits of the Party, which is ushering in a new era of building a revolutionary party of Juche type and powerfully guiding the great cause of building a rich country with a strong army, books on literature and art and books on science and technology.
Some books are about the ideology and wise leadership of the great Party Central Committee which is resolutely ushering in a new era of comprehensive rejuvenation through simultaneous and qualitative changes and development of the capital city and local areas and of towns and countryside, and about the noble political idea, view of development and steadfast service spirit of the WPK which regards the people's laughter and happiness as a symbol of the socialist system and a standard of national power assessment. Such books add to the significance of the exhibition.
Also on show are art pieces reflecting the miraculous successes achieved in socialist construction during the term of the Eighth Party Central Committee and the new life of civilization greeted and enjoyed by the people.
An oil painting "Implanting ideal and spirit of Party founding" and a Korean painting "Absolute force for defending peace" and other art works show the undying exploits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho ushered in a new heyday of strengthening the whole Party with his outstanding ideas and gigantic leadership practice and has consolidated the absolute strength for eternal prosperity of the DPRK and the dignity and happiness of its people.
Enjoying art works vividly depicting the appearance of the DPRK changing rapidly along with the new era of the comprehensive development ushered in by the Party and the people's happiness, the participants had the confidence that the Party and the socialist system of Korean style are the best in the world and hardened their will to realize all dreams and ideals.
Sci-tech books, sculptures, craftworks and calligraphic works, too, deeply moved the participants as they help working people, youth and students enrich their cultural attainments. -0-

Rodong Sinmun on Regional Development Policy in New Era
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article says that the substantial and simultaneous development of regions is a striking demonstration of the absolute truth and innovative might of the regional development policy in the new era which comprehensively reflects the original state-building strategy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The regional development policy in the new era is a great revolutionary programme that can be clarified only by the WPK committed to the struggle to reduce the gap between the capital city and local areas in life, overcome the imbalance between regions and build an invincible socialist power, the article says, and goes on:
This policy reflects our Party's state-building plan to consolidate the foundations and potentials of regions in every way and radically improve the basic material and cultural life of regional people so as to achieve the comprehensive prosperity and growth of the state.
It is our Party's state-building strategy to strengthen the regions and consolidate their foundations and achieve more successes on this basis.
The essence of the regional development policy in the new era is to make all citizens in the country equally enjoy an affluent and civilized life under the socialist policy of the state, whether they live in the capital city or regions, towns or mountain villages.
This policy comprehensively embodies our Party's strategy to accelerate the overall development of socialism by firmly preparing the local people mentally and culturally.
The major political aim our Party is going to achieve in pushing ahead with the regional development policy-oriented construction is to transform the ideological and spiritual state of all the builders and thus make them creative human beings and builders of socialism.
Steadfast is the will of the WPK to build at an early date a dignified, powerful and prosperous country strong in national power, the best paradise of people envied by the world, by stepping up the development of regions as soon as possible. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Comprehensive Mechanization of Agriculture
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- Successes have been made in realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture in the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Since the programme for the rural revolution in the new era was unveiled, many farm machine production units across the country have been remodeled to expand their capacities, and home-made farm machines supplied to the rural areas every year to increase the proportion of mechanized farm work.
The first- and second-stage modernization projects of the Kumsong Tractor Factory were completed to lay a firm foundation for ensuring smooth production and quality of products. At present, the factory sees serial production of high-hp tractors and sends them to farms across the country, thus making a great contribution to realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture.
The Namsi Livestock Machine Factory, the Kangso Sprayer Factory, the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory and other units in the field of farm machinery were updated one after another and their material and technical foundations strengthened.
In 2023, 11 600 farm machines were produced and supplied to rural areas across the country and in 2024, their kinds increased.
South Hwanghae and North Phyongan provinces secured many farm machines. In Sukchon County of South Phyongan Province the proportion of mechanized farm work reached more than 50 percent. In 2025, the proportion of mechanized farm work increased as against that in the previous year to contribute to boosting the grain production.
Trade union organizations sent tractors dubbed "Jikmaeng" (trade union) to tideland farms in South Hwanghae Province in 2024. And last year they handed over high-performance farm machines to the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Organizations of the Union of Agricultural Workers sent "Nonggunmaeng" tractors and cultivators to the Ogye Farm in Anbyon County of Kangwon Province and "Nonggunmaeng" small tractors to farms in Jangphung County of Kaesong Municipality.
Farm machine stations in each city and county manufactured various kinds of farm machines, convenient to use and simple in structure, as well as parts and accessories to contribute to raising the proportion of mechanized farm work. -0-

headline: Efforts for Improving Regional Economy
story_text:
One day in November 2024, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited regional-industry factories under construction in Songchon County.
Giving instructions on the operation and management of regional-industry factories and on their long-term development, he inquired about the next year's construction project.
After hearing a reply from accompanying officials, he called for setting other regions for next year's industrial factories construction. He said that his intention was to boost the economy of the far-flung mountainous counties where the people's living is in the worst conditions.
The officials reproached themselves as they didn't live up to the loving care ofKim Jong Unto make happy laughter of people be heard first in the areas suffering hardship.
Inspecting the construction sites of regional-industry factories in Hamju County a few months earlier, he had corrected the wrong idea of some officials wanting to build regional-industry factories in a neighboring county the year after. At that time, he said that it is the requirement of the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea to build regional-industry factories first in the cities and counties with the weakest economic foundations.
Thanks to his steadfast creed and ardent love, fireworks of inauguration, alongside the laughter of the people, are being seen in the remote mountainous regions of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Challenging Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- Young people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major theaters of socialist construction.
Youths in Sepho and Changdo counties advanced into difficult posts such as the construction brigade.
Those in Thongchon and Kumgang counties petitioned to work at the posts of managing roads to carry forward the revolutionary spirit and fighting traits of the young vanguard of the preceding generation.
Among the patriotic young people are members of the youth league in Phangyo and Hoeyang counties who volunteered to work at the posts of managing ridge ways.
A meeting to congratulate the volunteers was held at the Kangwon Provincial Art Theatre on February 11.
Present there were Ju Mun Jin, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials of the youth league, youth and students in Wonsan City. Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers to be followed by a congratulatory address and resolution-taking speeches.
Officials, youth and students encouraged the volunteers, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

Koryo Paper Production Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Sunan Koryo Paper Mill is boosting the production of Koryo paper by dint of traditional papermaking technology associated with wisdom and talents of the Korean people.
Koryo paper, called "Korean paper" from olden times and spread to neighboring countries, is unique and excellent for being white, tough, smooth, soft and resistant to worms.
The Koryo paper produced at the mill is various in its kinds, including paper bearing natural landscapes and paper of various colors.
The mill is directing efforts to producing Koryo paper in an industrial way.
The mill, which already established a paper production process in contact with relevant units, has laid a foundation for mass-producing high-quality Koryo paper by intensifying research to gloss the both sides of paper with remodeled machines.
It also introduced Koryo paper into various sectors, including the cosmetics industry sector, and opened up a prospect for producing various kinds of sanitary goods. -0-

headline: DPRK Young People on Study Tour of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 12 (KCNA) -- Students and other young people from across the DPRK are now on an expedition to the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of the revolution.
They got to the top of the mountain on February 11. While climbing the mountain in the biting cold and snowstorm, the expedition members cherished again the indomitable revolutionary spirit of the fighters who had unyieldingly continued their arduous struggle, believing in PresidentKim Il Sungonly.
When arriving at the top of the mountain, the origin of the Korean revolution, symbol of victory and spiritual mainstay of the Korean people, the passionate youths were so excited and happy that they broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Earlier at the Mudubong Secret Camp, the expedition members went round the headquarters log cabin and trees bearing slogans to grasp the greatest patriotic exploits of the President, who led the sacred war for accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation to a brilliant victory, and the noble moral world of the anti-Japanese forerunners.
During the tour, they had a pencil drawing contest and a question-and-answer study contest. -0-

story_text:

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from General Secretary of C.C., CPV
story_text:

Respected Comrade General Secretary,
I express deep thanks to you for sending me a congratulatory message as regards the continuation of my work as general secretary of the CPV Central Committee under the trust of the 14th Central Committee of the CPV.
The 14th Congress of the CPV achieved very wonderful successes and this has become a historic milestone in the course of accomplishing the innovation cause for the past 40 years.
The Congress provided important cornerstones in the struggle to make Vietnam enter a new era of development with confidence and build a peaceful, independent, democratic, prosperous, civilized and happy country on the basis of breakthrough-like thinking and strategic vision.
The Vietnamese party, state and people always attach importance to promoting the traditional friendly relations with the DPRK.
The political trust, support and cooperative goodwill shown by you and the DPRK for Vietnam in the past have constituted a precious asset in consolidating the relations between the two countries.
I am convinced that the bilateral relations will as ever develop dynamically in a more profound and substantial way with each passing day for the interests of the two peoples and for regional and global peace, stability and development in the future course, thanks to the joint efforts of the two parties and the two countries and warm support by the two peoples.
I wish you, Comrade General Secretary, good health and happiness at all times and success in discharging your noble duties.
I hope that the Vietnam-DPRK relations would as ever reap a rich harvest in the future, too.
Please accept my high regards. -0-

headline: Chinese Ambassador to DPRK Gives Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 13 (KCNA) -- Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Wang Yajun Thursday hosted a reception at the embassy on the occasion of the lunar New Year's Day in 2026.
Present there on invitation were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and military attaches here and their wives.
Staff members of the Chinese embassy, Chinese guests staying in the DPRK and Chinese residents were on hand.
The participants watched a video dealing with the external revolutionary activities of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho attended the celebrations of the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and held a historic DPRK-China summit and talks.
Speeches were made at the reception.
The ambassador said that under the wise leadership of the WPK headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Unthe DPRK people celebrated the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK with splendor and successfully carried out all the tasks of the five-year plan set forth at the Eighth WPK Congress by dint of single-minded unity, thus making great progress in various fields.
It is the steadfast policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the traditional China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations, he said, expressing the will to thoroughly implement the important common understanding made by the top leaders of the two countries and thus advance the socialist cause of the two countries and defend the happiness of the two peoples and the regional peace and stability.
Kang Yun Sok noted that the bilateral relations reached a new stage of development with the historic DPRK-China summit meeting held in September last year as an occasion. And he expressed the will to make joint efforts with the Chinese comrades to develop the DPRK-China friendship in line with the noble intention of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries in the new year, too.
He congratulated the Chinese people on having splendidly commemorated the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and fulfilled the 14th five-year plan. And he hoped that they would achieve new successes in the work for comprehensively building a modern socialist state under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core this year marking the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC.
The participants toasted the health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the esteemed Comrade Xi Jinping and the steady development of the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations.
Prior to the reception, they watched stunts introducing the traditional culture of the Chinese people. -0-

headline: Chinese Ambassador to DPRK Gives Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 13 (KCNA) -- Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Wang Yajun Thursday hosted a reception at the embassy on the occasion of the lunar New Year's Day in 2026.
Present there on invitation were Kang Yun Sok, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Pak Myong Ho, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned and foreign diplomatic envoys and military attaches here and their wives.

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il and Ordinary Families
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- With the approach of the birthday of ChairmanKim Jong Il(February 16), the DPRK people are recollecting with deep emotion the noble life of him who made ceaseless field guidance, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven.
During his field guidance for the people, the Chairman visited houses of ordinary people and took warm care of their living.
When visiting a newly-built village of ex-servicemen in Taehongdan County of Ryanggang Province, he dropped in at the house of a newly wedded ex-serviceman.
He acquainted himself with their housekeeping with paternal affection. When the housewife requested the Chairman to name her baby, to be born, in a whisper, he accepted her request with good grace.
When visiting a house of Poman-ri, Sohung County of North Hwanghae Province, he said that nameplates should be put up at the entrances of houses as the same houses were lined up.
When he visited the house of a farmer in a village of electrified modern houses in Sinhung County of South Hamgyong Province, he taught how to keep the temperature of rooms on a normal state in winter.
When he dropped in at the house of an ex-serviceman working at the Hungju Youth Power Station, he acquainted himself with the state of furniture and kitchen utensils in the house.
Many houses visited by him, including those of a pasturer of the Hamhung City Youth Goat Farm and artistes of the National Theatrical Troupe, are associated with warm love for the people of the Chairman, who regarded as his pleasure the pains he took for the people's wellbeing.
Such noble scenes of the harmonious whole between the leader and the people tell forever the great personality of the Chairman who devoted his whole life to the people. -0-

headline: Seminars on Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Seminars on exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwere held in Cambodia, Pakistan, Romania, the Czech Republic and Algeria from January 27 to February 7 to commemorate his 84th birth anniversary.
Speeches were made at the events attended by personages of political parties, organizations and institutions and other citizens in those countries.
The secretary general of the Pakistan Association for Self-Reliance Studies, the chief of the Organization  of Women for the Study of the Juche Idea in Karachi of Pakistan, the chief of the Organization of Youth and Students for the Study of the Juche Idea in Karachi of Pakistan and other speakers praised ChairmanKim Jong Ilas an outstanding state leader and true leader of the people, who performed the greatest exploits to be lauded by posterity with his distinguished political calibre, noble personality and warm love for the people.
The chairman and the vice-chairperson of the Socialist Party of Romania praised the career ofKim Jong Ilwho made a ceaseless journey of field guidance for the people, saying that trust, love and devotion for the people constitute his gifted personality and political creed.
The chairperson of the Czech Group for the Study and Materialization of the Juche Idea said:
The progressive mankind will never forget the undying exploits of ComradeKim Jong Ilwho defended Korean-style socialism in the period of stern trials, unprecedented in history, with his extraordinary ideo-theoretical wisdom and outstanding leadership.
Under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, an era of comprehensive socialist development has been opened up in the DPRK, in which the capital city and the regions undergo transformations at the same time and the dreams and ideals of the people come true.
We are convinced that the Korean people will achieve bigger successes in their struggle for defending the national sovereignty and bringing about comprehensive national rejuvenation. -0-

headline: Senior Middle School Graduates of DPRK Volunteer for Forefront Border Posts
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of senior middle school graduates in Jagang Province of the DPRK have volunteered for military service in the forefront border.
Many graduates in Kanggye and Manpho cities and Chosan and Usi counties vowed to become soldiers defending the country with revolutionary arms.
They were joined by those in the counties of Tongsin, Janggang, Rangnim, Sijung and Hwaphyong where modern regional-industry factories have sprung up and new appearance of transformation has been displayed.
Those in Huichon City, and Songgan, Jonchon, Songwon and Wiwon counties are full of the enthusiasm for performing proud military exploits while dedicating their youth to the forefront posts, true to the spirit of the victorious wartime generation.
Those from Huichon Middle School for Orphans and from Jasong, Kophung and Ryongnim counties, expressed their will to glorify their youth on the road of defending their precious motherland.
A meeting was held in Kanggye City on February 13 to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the provincial people's committee, and other officials of the Party and power organs and the youth league in the province and students in Kanggye City.
Prior to the meeting, the graduates visited the Cemetery of Fallen Fighters of the Korean People's Army in the city of Kanggye and vowed to firmly defend their defence posts. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations under Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations under construction on Feb. 13.
He was greeted on the spot by Ju Chang Il, department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, commanding officers of the military units involved in the construction and officials of the designing and creation units.
Going round the construction site, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unacquainted himself in detail with the progress made in construction and creation and installation of sculptures.
Highly appreciating that the outer wall sculptural decorations were created well to preserve the theme-specific features, he said that the matchless bravery and mass heroism displayed by soldiers of the Korean People's Army, involved in the overseas military operations, must be imposingly etched in history as a banner of invincibility.
The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations is, before being a simple architectural structure, the crystal of the noble respect, paid by our Party, country and people to the sacred souls of the heroic martyrs who will be immortal for all ages, and the platform of dignity and honour for respectfully exalting their worthwhile life, he added.
Stressing the need to create all elements to be ideologically and artistically perfect in minute detail, he clarified a series of tasks and ways on modification.
He called upon the service personnel, designers and creators, involved in the construction of the memorial museum, to deeply cherish the profound feelings of respect of the Party and people and successfully build the museum into a sacred monument, an edifice representative of the era, which will be glorified eternally as a symbol of the feats and immortality of the fallen fighters. -0-

headline:
Schoolchildren's Art Performance Given to Celebrate Birthday of Chairman Kim Jong Il

[2026.02.14.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- Art group members of the Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace gave a performance "Song of Happiness Resounding in the Sky of February" on Feb. 13 to celebrate the 84th birth anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Il.
The performance began with prelude "We Sing of the Spring Holiday of February".
In the serial songs "Love of General", the performers impressively sang of the noble personality ofKim Jong Ilas a great man who made a ceaseless long journey of love and devotion to defend the bright laughter of schoolchildren and the future of the country.

Chairman Kim Jong Il and Ordinary Families
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 14 (KCNA) -- With the approach of the birthday of ChairmanKim Jong Il(February 16), the DPRK people are recollecting with deep emotion the noble life of him who made ceaseless field guidance, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven.
During his field guidance for the people, the Chairman visited houses of ordinary people and took warm care of their living.

When visiting a house of Poman-ri, Sohung County of North Hwanghae Province, he said that nameplates should be put up at the entrances of houses as the same houses were lined up.

Many houses visited by him, including those of a pasturer of the Hamhung City Youth Goat Farm and artistes of the National Theatrical Troupe, are associated with warm love for the people of the Chairman, who regarded as his pleasure the pains he took for the people's wellbeing.

headline: Custom of Lunar New Year's Day - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- Among the intangible cultural heritages of the DPRK is a custom of greeting the lunar New Year's Day.
From olden times, the Korean people have enjoyed the lunar New Year's Day with various ceremonies, and this year's lunar New Year's Day falls on February 17.
The custom on this day consists mainly of ancestor-memorial service, greeting, garb, food for treating guests and folk game.
The Korean people would make good preparations ahead of the lunar New Year's Day. When the day comes near, they clean up their homes and prepare holiday food.
On the lunar New Year's Day, they pay a memorial service for their ancestors before anything else and then make bows to their elders at home and in villages as well as their teachers.
They also exchange New Year greetings with their friends, which is called well-wishing remarks.
Meanwhile, the families all get up early on the morning of the day and wear their new clothes, which are called the lunar New Year's garb.
Important in the lunar New Year's Day custom is food. The Korean people would prepare rice-cake soup and other various dishes as holiday food and gather with their families and relatives and neighbors to share those dishes.
The folk games for the day included yut, seesawing, kite-flying and sleighing.
The custom of the lunar New Year's Day was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2015. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Feats for Development of Juche-oriented Musical Art
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 15 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilis the great master of musical art who laid an eternal foundation for development of the Juche-oriented musical art with his outstanding ideology, theory and leadership.
Regarding music as his first favorite, the Chairman authored such works as "On the Art of Music" to advance the original ideas and theories on building of musical art in the Juche era conducive to realizing independence of the popular masses.
And he personally created such celebrated masterpieces as "The Embrace of My Motherland", "Song of Best Wishes", "O Korea, I Will Add Glory to Thee", which have been handed down as precious eternal treasures and masterpieces of the country and people decades after decades.
One day, when he heard a piece of music re-represented by an art troupe, he grasped its essence in a moment and said that there was a fundamental difference between Korean and Western music in whether it was melody or rhythmic tune, adding that in any case, melody should be the main factor and rhythm subordinated to it.
Under his loving care, the Mansudae Art Troupe could successfully create and represent famous songs of the times and bring about changes in the creation of new and peculiar genres of instrumental music and styles of representing vocal music, demonstrating to the whole world the development of the Juche-oriented art.
Thanks to the thought and efforts ofKim Jong Il, the music of the Pochonbo Electronic Ensemble was created in Korean-style performance techniques, form and system and a heyday of the Juche-oriented electronic music was ushered in. And the National Symphony Orchestra could be developed into a prestigious art troupe while opening up a new phase in the building of Juche-oriented symphony.
The immortal exploits ofKim Jong Il, who enriched the treasure house of the Juche-oriented musical art, will remain long along with the socialist culture entering a new era of efflorescence. -0-

headline: Hot Springs in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- There are many hot springs good for the promotion of people's health and the treatment of diseases in all parts of the country, from the northern highlands to the plain areas.
The book on the natural treatment resources of the DPRK written by a research group of the Environmental Sanitation Institute under the Academy of Medical Science through an expedition to different parts of the country deals with detailed information on hot springs in our country.
According to the book, 60-odd hot springs are distributed across the country. Among them, there are 10-odd sulfurous springs including the Hwangjin Hot Spring in Myongchon County, North Hamgyong Province, and nearly 20 radon springs including the Talchon (Jongdal) Hot Spring in Samchon County, South Hwanghae Province, and others are chloride springs and hydrocarbonates springs.
Many hot springs across the country have very high effectiveness in treating diseases.
The Ryonggang Hot Spring in Onchon County, Nampho Municipality, is one of the hot springs with a high mineral content in our country. It contains bromine, iodine and other elements and is good for the treatment of hypertensives.
The hot springs in North Phyongan Province and Jagang Province, including Unsan, Sakju and Wonhung hot springs, are mostly hydrocarbonates, sulfurous and radon springs which are good for treating chronic gastritis, respiratory diseases, heart diseases and gynecopathy.
The Woegumgang Hot Spring in Kangwon Province is said to be suitable for the treatment of chronic gastritis and neuralgia as it promotes blood circulation, metabolism and desensitization.
North Hamgyong Province has more than 20 hot springs including Onpho, Myongchon and Sechon hot springs and Ryanggang Province Naegok and Paektu hot springs.
The hot spring areas famous from long time ago have been splendidly transformed under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea to provide the people with a better and happier life.
In particular, the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort was built in the hot spring area of Yangdok County, South Phyongan Province and the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp in the Onpho hot spring area of Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province, contributing to the promotion of the people's health and their cultural and emotional life. -0-

headline: Joint National Meeting of KCU Organizations Held in DPRK

Editorials on Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
[2026.02.16.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Monday dedicate editorials to the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The papers say that the lifeline of the Juche revolution and the ever-victorious tradition of the DPRK could be steadily carried forward and a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation opened up in the country thanks to the day of February 16, 1942.
Rodong Sinmun in an editorial says that ChairmanKim Jong Ilis a peerless patriot who had the highest level of personalities and qualifications of a leader of the revolution and performed great feats to be glorified forever for the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people.
It goes on:
ChairmanKim Jong Ilis a great master in ideology and theory as he illuminated the road ahead of Korean-style socialism with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom.
As the peerlessly great man clearly indicated the road of advance with his great idea consistent with the times, originality, philosophical profundity and encyclopedic and popular characters, the DPRK people could advance unyieldingly toward a new horizon of a prosperous power without an inch of deviation from the invariable road of socialism.
Kim Jong Ilis an outstanding statesman who built a country of single-minded unity modeled on the monolithic idea for the first time in history.
Under the banner of "monolithic ideological system" put forward byKim Jong Il, the revolutionary discipline and order in which only the idea and leadership of the leader are upheld were established in all spheres of the state and social life and a new image of the DPRK where all the people were united with one will and took the same steps was created.
Kim Jong Ilis a peerless patriot who laid a solid foundation for Korean-style socialism to prosper by dint of self-reliance.
The strongest self-defence capability of our state which no one dares to provoke and the increasing potential of the self-supporting economy are associated with the great exploits performed by the Chairman all his life.
Minju Joson in an editorial says that only victory and glory are in store for the DPRK and its people advancing with the ideas and exploits ofKim Jong Ilas an eternal foundation. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from General Association of Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China (GAKC) on February 16.
The GAKC said in its letter that it is celebrating with splendor the 84th birth anniversary of the great GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilas the greatest significant holiday at a time of upheaval when all the people in the homeland are creating the Korean speed and myth in all major fronts of socialist construction in order to glorify the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as a congress of victory and glory.
Born as the son of the guerrillas on Mt Paektu, a holy mountain of the revolution,Kim Jong Ilexperienced the days of the bloody anti-Japanese war and the hard-fought war, hardened his patriotic intention and will, courage and pluck of Paektu and led the DPRK and its people to victory with his great ambition to glorify the DPRK before the world, the letter noted, and went on:
The great General, brilliant commander of Mt Paektu, took the indefatigable long journey for Songun during the whole course of his revolutionary leadership with his firm will that the powerful arms ensure socialism and the security and happiness of the people. He built up the Korean People's Army into the army of the Party and the people, the army strong in idea and faith, firmly consolidated the matchless defence capabilities and performed undying feats in firmly defending the destiny of the country and its people and socialism of Juche by bringing about victory after victory in all-out confrontation with the hostile forces with his matchless courage and superb strategy.
His patriotic desire for building a powerful country is being translating into a brilliant reality in the motherland under the guidance of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, peerlessly great man.
Thanks to the devoted service for the people's wellbeing made byKim Jong Un, who has never felt contented in the work for the people and is devoting himself to them, grand monumental edifices for the people's happiness and civilization are being sprung up like bamboo shoots after rain, the letter said.

headline:
Editorials on Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il
[2026.02.16.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Monday dedicate editorials to the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The papers say that the lifeline of the Juche revolution and the ever-victorious tradition of the DPRK could be steadily carried forward and a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation opened up in the country thanks to the day of February 16, 1942.

It goes on:
ChairmanKim Jong Ilis a great master in ideology and theory as he illuminated the road ahead of Korean-style socialism with his rare ideological and theoretical wisdom.
As the peerlessly great man clearly indicated the road of advance with his great idea consistent with the times, originality, philosophical profundity and encyclopedic and popular characters, the DPRK people could advance unyieldingly toward a new horizon of a prosperous power without an inch of deviation from the invariable road of socialism.
Kim Jong Ilis an outstanding statesman who built a country of single-minded unity modeled on the monolithic idea for the first time in history.
Under the banner of "monolithic ideological system" put forward byKim Jong Il, the revolutionary discipline and order in which only the idea and leadership of the leader are upheld were established in all spheres of the state and social life and a new image of the DPRK where all the people were united with one will and took the same steps was created.
Kim Jong Ilis a peerless patriot who laid a solid foundation for Korean-style socialism to prosper by dint of self-reliance.
The strongest self-defence capability of our state which no one dares to provoke and the increasing potential of the self-supporting economy are associated with the great exploits performed by the Chairman all his life.
