headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Life for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- ChairmanKim Jong Ilgave ceaseless field guidance for the sake of the people all his life.
The number of units visited by the Chairman during his revolutionary leadership is more than 14 290.
Wherever he went and whoever he met, he always asked first if the people like or they feel happy.
There are some touching stories that our people recollect with deep emotion even now.
One day in September 2011 he visited the newly-built Pothongmun Street Fish and Meat Shop and asked officials accompanying him if the people like, seeing various kinds of meat products and canned goods.
That day, he said that the employees of the shop should be well aware of the people's demand and conduct commercial service activities in conformity with it, thus providing the people with a happier life.
When he visited the Amusement Park of the Kaeson Youth Park in cold winter in the last period of his life, he asked officials how many people come there and if the people like the park. He was very pleased to hear that the people really liked it.
When he visited a fish farm, he also acquainted himself with its output and supply and asked if the servicepersons and people like.
As mentioned above, the legends about love for the people were created wherever he went and the people's happiness grew day by day under his care.
Indeed, the Chairman was the benevolent father of the people who devoted his whole life to them, saying that he always found his joy and worth of life in their happiness. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Inauguration Ceremony of Saeppyol Street
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the inauguration ceremony of Saeppyol Street on Sunday.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Present here today are the bereaved family members of the fallen soldiers and other combatants as well as the combatants of the regiment of the engineers, who have been dispatched to the overseas military operations.
We are also here together with the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officers and soldiers of the units at all levels of the Korean People's Army, teaching staff and students of the revolutionary schools, and builders and Pyongyang citizens, who have been involved in the construction of Saeppyol Street.
Comrades,
The meaningful day has come when this street, to which the people across the country paid intense devotion and respect, has been completed to have its address in our capital city.
The new street has been built thanks to the ardent desire of our motherland that wishes that the precious lives of its excellent sons, who defended the most sacred things by sacrificing their most valuable things, will live forever. It is waiting for the moment when it will greet its honoured owners.
Thinking that my anxiousness would somewhat decrease if I brought this event even a day earlier, I have done my best and waited for this day to come. But now standing here, I rather feel sorry before feeling happy.
I once again extend the most ennobling respect to our proud martyrs, and, on behalf of the officers and soldiers of our army, Pyongyang citizens and all other people throughout the country, I offer consolation and thanks to all the bereaved family members of the fallen soldiers, the owners of this new street.
I also express deep thanks to the builders of the capital city, service personnel and officials and working people in the relevant sectors, who have wonderfully completed the street out of boundless respect for, and obligation to, our heroes.
Comrades,
Filled here is a solemn emotion that is quite different from what we felt whenever we saw the creations set up in various parts of the country.
The name Saeppyol Street has already been etched in all our hearts as a byword for the lives of the combatants, who sacrificed their all to their motherland so courageously to the last moments of their lives in the battlefields in a faraway alien land; this is something that others cannot perform throughout their life.
This is an emotive moment, when we record in the history of Pyongyang the most heroic era that embodies the strength of Korea, symbolizes the greatness of its people and has defended its sacred dignity and fame.
Saeppyol Street is a source of honour for our generation and a pride of Pyongyang and our state.
Dear bereaved family members of the martyrs,
With the construction of this street, the martyrs are now within hailing distance from the yards of their beloved families' houses, and they can feel the warmth of their kith and kin, whom they missed so much in the faraway alien land.
This is where the martyrs could feel the breathing of their dear family members every moment of the day; I would be most pleased if you live happily here generation after generation, priding yourself on having such excellent sons, husbands and fathers.
The comrades-in-arms who fought bloody battles with the martyrs, the families that have placed their dear children and husbands at the posts of national defence and all other people in this country will feel happy about today's inauguration; I believe that they sincerely hope the residents in the new street will lead a long and happy life here for the sake of the young martyrs.
Before their death, the heroic martyrs must have pictured in their mind's eye their dear families living in the ever-prospering country; the Party and the government will take all necessary steps to ensure that these families lead a proud and worthwhile life while enjoying the preferential treatment by the state and the loving care of the whole society.
I hope that this street, a place where the ennobling souls rest and reverence from all over the country converges, will always brim over with joy and happiness.
I am sure that this is the way to repay those who passed away.
Comrades,
We have the national flag of our dignified Democratic People's Republic of Korea hoisted on this street.
This is the flag which our combatants kept in their chests during bloody battles, and this is the one with which we covered the bodies of our admirable sons to bring them back to their motherland.
As the flag is shining its brilliance and fluttering in the wind, the martyrs' ennobling soul and pulsating hearts will give impetus to the development of our capital city, beautiful and thriving Pyongyang, and add eternal honour to our great motherland.
The moment when we are cutting the ribbon for the inauguration of the new street will be recorded as a moment of everlasting glory to etch the martyrs' names and images in history.
I pray for the immortality of our country's admirable sons.
Thank you. -0-

headline: Saeppyol Street Inaugurated with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 16 (KCNA) -- Saeppyol Street has made an imposing appearance in an excellent location in Hwasong area of Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK. It is a monumental architectural group reflecting the strong will of all the people to convey forever the shining star-like feats of the heroes who unhesitatingly sacrificed their lives for the immortal honour and eternal prosperity of their great motherland during the overseas military operations.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally initiated the construction of a new street for their bereaved families and named it to glorify the precious life of fine sons of the country generation after generation. He also energetically guided the whole course of its construction so that every element of buildings shows the warm sincerity of our Party and state for the families that the brave fighters left behind.
The unique architectural groups are presenting a spectacular scene as high-, medium- and low-storied apartment buildings with formative artistic, practical and convenient value and public buildings such as commercial and neighbourhood-serving amenities are in ideal harmony. It represents an immortal picture showing the noble moral obligation and fervent love of our Party determined to glorify the bereaved families as well as the heroes respected and revered by all the people and enable them to enjoy to the full the beautiful life in the motherland the martyrs protected at the cost of their lives.
An inauguration ceremony of Saeppyol Street took place with splendor on Feb. 15.
Its venue was overflowing with emotion and joy of the bereaved families who would move into new flats amid the blessing of military and civilian builders, who constructed a unique new street true to the intention and will of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, and all other people across the country.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unattended the ceremony.
He was greeted by the commanding officers of Korean People's Army units involved in the overseas operations.
He met and exchanged warm greetings with them and extended militant salute to all the officers and men of the overseas operations units.
All the participants broke into cheers of emotion, looking up to the great father who has put the war heroes and their bereaved families on the meridian of glory and made a great history of noble love and obligation with ardent feelings of kinship.
The ceremony was attended by senior Party, government and military officials, members of the central leadership body of the Party, bereaved families of the war heroes, combatants and officers and men of the engineering unit who were dispatched for the overseas military operations, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, servicepersons of KPA units at all levels, builders, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools and citizens in Pyongyang.
Kim Jong Unmade a speech in commemoration of the inauguration.
Saying with deep emotion that the meaningful day has come when Saeppyol Street has been completed thanks to the ardent desire of our motherland to have its address in our capital city, he noted that the inauguration of the street named Saeppyol that has already been etched in all our hearts as a byword for the glorious life of the combatants is an emotive moment when we record in the history of Pyongyang the most heroic era that embodies the strength of Korea, symbolizes the greatness of its people and has defended its sacred dignity and fame.
Noting that Saeppyol Street is a source of honour for our generation and a pride of Pyongyang and our state, he prayed for the immortality of the martyrs along with its inauguration which will etch the martyrs' names and images in history. He sincerely hoped that this street, a place where the ennobling souls rest and reverence from all over the country converges, will always brim over with joy and happiness.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
Fireworks were displayed with enthusiastic cheers and numerous balloons with five-pointed star marks rose up to the sky.
Then the licenses for the use of flats were handed over to the bereaved families of the martyrs.
Kim Jong Un, together with senior Party, government and military officials, gave the licenses in the name of the WPK Central Committee to the bereaved families.
The bereaved families in tears of emotion extended their deep gratitude to the benevolent father who has repeatedly shown his boundless love and affection for them, filled with pain and remorse for failing to bring to their families the proud sons of the motherland who created the world-startling miraculous and heroic legends.
An art performance was given, shaking Saeppyal Street where the huge national flag of the dignified DPRK is flying high in the sky.
Touching the participants were the songs arousing boundless respect and noble reverence for the martyrs, who displayed mass heroism and unparalleled self-sacrificing spirit, hard to be seen in any other armies of the world, to demonstrate the combat power of our army to the whole world and unhesitatingly dedicated their lives to faithfully implementing the orders of the motherland.
When the national anthem of the DPRK, our heroes sang from the bottom of their heart in every field of decisive battles, wishing for its eternal prosperity, was played, the participants were all afire with a will to display their patriotic enthusiasm for further glorifying the dignity and honour of the motherland the martyrs defended at the cost of their lives.
A touching scene of great love and moral obligation was witnessed in Saeppyol Street, in which each flat is associated with the boundless benevolence ofKim Jong Unwho has bestowed his warm affection and love for the war heroes on their families, ensuring that they enjoy the greatest happiness and glory.
Kim Jong Unmet bereaved family members who would move into new houses.
Noting that the inauguration of a street for the families of the fallen fighters in the overseas military operations reminds him of the heroic images of combatants who laid down their lives, praying for prosperity of their country and Pyongyang at their last moments, he said in an excited tone that it is the highest respect to the noble lives of the martyrs to make the country, associated with their desires and souls, richer and more beautiful and safeguard and glorify it.
Saying that the fallen fighters are model patriots and greatest heroes who unhesitatingly dedicated their precious lives to carrying out the order of the motherland for no reward, he stressed it is due obligation and noble mission of our Party and government to take care of the destiny and life of their parents, who brought them up to be excellent, and their wives and children, who were their strength and support, in the most responsible and sincerest manner.
He visited the house of Kim Jong Ok, widow of martyr O Thae Chol, and looked round its rooms and kitchen, listening to his family members' impression of the new house.
Saying she would miss her husband more than ever before in the new house, he hoped that she would overcome her sorrow as early as possible and lead a happy life. And he wished her son studying at the Mangyongdae Revolutionary School a bright future, saying that he should become an excellent person like his father.
Visiting the house of the couple Mun Ryong Mo and Ryu Sung Nam, whose twin sons dedicated their lives to the country, he said that thanks to such a patriotic family, the country grows stronger and steadily advances toward prosperity.
Saying that the Party and the government will entirely take care of the bereaved, he showed warm kinship affection, wishing them lasting happiness in their good houses.
He also visited the home of martyr Kim Tong Chun, twice Hero of the Republic, to wish his family members the best luck. The family members, greatly excited to have dream-like fortune, expressed their deep gratitude to him.
I think my anxieties have been removed a little, seeing the bereaved families who will lead a new beautiful life earlier than others in their houses in Pyongyang, he said, adding that the heroes, who performed the great exploits, to be etched in history, for the endless prosperity and mightiness of the country, and their families deserve the greatest glory and respect paid by the country and the people.
He repeatedly urged officials of the Party and power organs to thoroughly implement the measure taken to afford preference and privileges to the families of the martyrs, regarding it as an important policy task, and to always pay deep attention to their life so that they would never feel any inconvenience.
A historic moment, filled with parental affection of the great father, was captured in the street.
The families of the war martyrs, owners of a new street, looked round their new houses.
Seeing their houses furnished with all amenities, they keenly realized the great benevolence and love ofKim Jong Unand our Party.
Saeppyol Street, the crystal of eternal thanks and respect paid by the Party and the people to the heroes in the overseas military operations, will shed its rays for all ages along with its noble name, conveying a new legendary tale of love and moral obligation blooming in the great era ofKim Jong Unto posterity. -0-

headline: Dancing Parties of Youth and Students
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- Dancing parties of youth and students were held in the DPRK on Feb. 16 to celebrate the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The participants in the dancing party in the capital city had a circle dance amid the playing of cheerful songs "A Dear Name" and "Greeting Spring on Jong Il Peak".
They paid the highest glory to the Chairman who valued and loved our young people most and made a great history of attaching importance to the youth on this land in the whole period of the revolutionary leadership.
While dancing to the tune of songs such as "Glory to Our Great Party" and "Cheers of the People", they were filled with happiness and pride of being guided by the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho has ushered in a dynamic phase of comprehensive development of the state with his gigantic leadership practice while translating the people's dreams and ideals into brilliant reality.
The mood of the dancing party revved up amid the playing of songs reflecting the will to display the noble name of the patriotic youth in every theater of creation and increased production with the fighting spirit and traits peculiar to the Korean youth, regarding the love and trust of the motherly Party as the most valuable asset for life.

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people greet the Day of the Shining Star, the greatest national auspicious holiday, ahead of the historic Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea which will open up brighter prospects for the country and revolution. They are recollecting with deep emotion the noble revolutionary career and exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Ilthat will shine forever along with the victorious development of Juche Korea.
Senior Party and government officials visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Feb. 16, the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Among the visitors were Pak Thae Song, Choe Ryong Hae, Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other senior Party and government officials, officials of the Party Central Committee, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Party and administrative leading officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the armed forces organs.
The Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, was wrapped in a solemn atmosphere.
Laid before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilwas a flower basket in the name of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Also placed were flower baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet.
The participants paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the hall where the President and the Chairman lie in state, they extended best wishes for immortality to the great leaders.
All the participants pledged to fulfill their important responsibilities and duties assigned by the Party and the people in the vanguard of the sacred struggle to attain the grand goal to be advanced at the Ninth Congress of the WPK, true to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unand by holding higher the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism as the banner of eternal victory. -0-

headline: Party and State Commendations Conferred on Soldier-builders and Youth Shock Brigade Members in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- A ceremony was held in Pyongyang on Feb. 16 to award Party and state commendations to soldier-builders and youth shock brigade members who performed labor feats in the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm.
The soldier-builders and youth shock brigade members entered the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture where the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea is to be held.
Present there were Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Ri Il Hwan, Pak Jong Chon and Ri Hi Yong, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Jong Kyong Thaek, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, and other officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, and soldier-builders and youth shock brigade members who performed labor feats in the construction of the greenhouse farm, commanding officers of the KPA, youth league officials and youth and students.
Ri Il Hwan made a congratulatory address.
Upon authorization of the WPK Central Committee, he extended warm thanks and congratulations to the soldier-builders and youth shock brigade members, who presented the Ninth Party Congress with a grand monumental edifice for the wellbeing of the great DPRK people and demonstrated to the whole world the revolutionary spirit and fighting stamina of the young people upholding the ideology and cause of the Party in the vanguard, the advantages of socialism and the boundless potential for development.
He expressed belief that all the soldier-builders and youth shock brigade members would remain boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the WPK and add eternal luster to the honor of today as befitting the courageous young fighters in the next-stage struggle for dignity and prosperity of their beloved country.
Choe Ryong Hae read out a decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK.
Kim Yong Sam, Paek Hak Myong, Ri Hyon Su and others were awarded the title of Labor Hero of the DPRK along with Gold Medal (Hammer and Sickle) and Order of National Flag First Class.
Order ofKim Il Sungwas conferred on Jang Chol Yong, Ri Song Chol and Jon Hak Chol.
Order ofKim Jong Ilwent to Ri Tong Hyok, Hong Yun Chol and Kim Un Chol.
Watches bearing the august name of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwere awarded to Ri Chang Ho, Ri Myong Hyok, Jang Tu Il and others.
Citations ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, were conferred on Kim Thae Ryong, Song Po Hyon, Hong Tong Chol and others.
Kim Il SungYouth Honor Prize went to 21 persons andKim Jong IlYouth Honor Prize to 22 persons.
Order of National Flag First Class was awarded to 64 persons, Order of Labor to 54 persons, Order of National Flag Second Class to 570 persons, Order of National Flag Third Class to 1 476 persons, Distinguished Military Service Medal to 2 568 persons and Medal of Merit to 764 persons.
There were resolve-taking speeches. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Inauguration Ceremony of 10 000 Flats at Fourth Stage in Hwasong Area Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 17 (KCNA) -- The construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, powerfully carried on as the top-priority task of the historic Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, has been successfully concluded to be an epoch-making success in the new era of the comprehensive national rejuvenation.
Nearly 60 000 houses and public buildings with advanced civilization were built in Songsin, Songhwa and Hwasong areas to create new majestic and beautiful ideal streets of people, showing the eye-opening development of the people-first architecture, and a modern urban administrative district was formed. As a result, Pyongyang has been given a radical face-lift as befitting the capital city of socialist Korea in five short years.
With the over-fulfillment of the five-year plan for capital city construction, the WPK came to surely keep the promise it made to the people in the name of the dignified Party Congress. Through the struggle of past five years, experience like a textbook and a new standard of the Juche-oriented architecture have been created to dynamically guide the construction work on a nationwide scale that will be more widely conducted in the period of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.
This eye-opening reality symbolizing the era of great changes is another precious fruition of the far-reaching plan and wise leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who set it as an honorable revolutionary task to turn Pyongyang into a world-class city where all desires of the people come true and has energetically guided the whole course of grand construction from the significant first ground-breaking. It is also an immortal great victory of our Party's idea of believing in the people as in Heaven.
An inauguration ceremony of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area, to conclude the five-year plan for monumental capital city construction, was held with splendor on February 16, the auspicious holiday of our state.
The venue of the inauguration ceremony was filled with high pride of the capital city builders, who provided the biggest labor gift to the Ninth WPK Congress by perfectly building grand architectural groups adding brilliance to the great era ofKim Jong Ununder the flag of the housing construction headquarters for building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang given by the Party Central Committee, and deep emotion and joy of Pyongyang citizens keenly witnessing the imposing era of prosperity of Pyongyang.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived, all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the great master of creation, the outstanding leader of the revolution who is vigorously ushering in a brilliant heyday of the comprehensive development of socialism where the people's dreams and ideals come true.
Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership body of the Party, including senior Party, government and military officials, and officials of ministries and national agencies, working people to live in the new street, military-civilian builders, youth and students and Pyongyang citizens.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.
Saying that we came to greet the moment of emotion proudly declaring that the construction plan for 50 000 flats in the capital city was over-fulfilled by far through the dynamic construction revolution in the great era ofKim Jong Un, the speaker extended warm congratulations and thanks on the occasion of the significant inauguration to all the builders of the capital city, service personnel, and officials and working people in the relevant fields who helped keep the promise made by the Party to the people.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unensured that the housing construction was surely carried out, irrespective of condition and environment, with it as the core of the construction policy set forth at the Eighth WPK Congress, saying that socialism should be built in the mind of the people first and the housing problem is a matter of their greatest interest, the speaker noted, adding: Thanks to his noble intention and steadfast will, the construction of 50 000 flats was given absolute significance as the Party's cherished desire and has been carried on powerfully and vigorously at all times from its dynamic start
The speaker told in an excited tone about the tireless efforts and boundless devotion made by the General Secretary with his ardent will that the true picture of the WPK is in the appearance of the thriving country and in the happy looks of the people and out of his mind to provide the working people with new dwelling houses on the same day and at the same hour as if they had fallen from the sky and to see their happy looks as soon as possible.
Those modern large architectural groups are a symbol of the great ideology and politics of the WPK which warmly embraces the people and holds them in high esteem as Heaven, a sacred fortress of the strongest single-minded unity that nothing can break, and a demonstration of the indomitable spirit and inexhaustible power of socialist Korea, the speaker said, and extended the warmest gratitude toKim Jong Un, who is building a socialist paradise envied by the world on this land, in reflection of the unanimous mind of all the capital city builders, Pyongyang citizens and all other people across the country.
Stressing that it is the sacred duty and honor of the present generation to improve the appearance of the country through the dynamic construction revolution and create the richest and most civilized life with our wisdom and hands, the speaker called upon all the people to continuously work hard to glorify the capital city of Pyongyang as the most beautiful and great city in the world full of happiness of the people and realize the far-reaching goal of building a highly civilized and prosperous state at an early date under the new milestone of transformation to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Kim Jong Uncut the inauguration tape.
The moment, fireworks were set off, confetti was thrown and lots of balloons rose up into the sky above the venue of the ceremony, which witnesses the auspicious event to be specially recorded in the new era of prosperity of Pyongyang, to beautifully decorate the sky of the capital city.
The participants paid the highest tribute toKim Jong Unwho regards it as the strongest national power when all the people are equally prosperous and cultivates a large flower garden of all blessings where all the people across the country lead the happiest life in bright laughter.
Kim Jong Unreceived bouquets of fragrant flowers from cute children.
He met workers who received new houses.
They expressed gratitude out of deep emotion. He wished them happiness in the wonderful houses and all the families who would move into new houses joy and happiness.
The citizens were filled with tears of gratitude, being embraced in the bosom of the benevolent father who made ordinary working people enjoy the privileges, that no other people in the world could imagine, and even gave them blessings of love.
Kim Jong Unmet labor innovators who performed distinguished feats in the construction of the capital city.
Shaking hands with each of them, he said that thanks to the thoroughgoing implementers of the Party's policies like them, the important construction task decided by the Party could be successfully carried out and that the Party Central Committee would unfold a more gigantic construction project, believing in the revolutionary mettle of creation and fighting spirit of the capital city builders in the future, too. And he warmly encouraged them, hoping that they will once again fully display their honor and mettle as capital city builders in a new grand construction theater.
The capital city builders raised cheers of emotion, looking up toKim Jong Unwho attached importance to the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang as the forefront symbolizing the pioneering era of comprehensive rejuvenation, repeatedly showed them great love and trust in the whole period of the huge project, guided them to the creation of miracles and attributed all the successes to them.
There was a performance in celebration of the inauguration.
The Hwasong area reverberated with famous songs on patriotism singing highly of the greatest motherland where the people's paradise is being created with the principle of believing in the people as in Heaven.
The participants were filled with great joy while hearing the hymns of the era of great transformation in which a thriving power with the socialist civilization in full bloom is being built.
Solemnly played was the national anthem of the DPRK, the most advantageous people's country where all wealth is created for the people and enjoyed by the people from A to Z.
In the evening of the beautiful capital city, filled with the noble emotions peculiar to our state and people, the participants enthusiastically sang in chorus an all-people hymn "Dear Father" and beautiful fireworks were set off into the sky above the luxurious street.
Kim Jong Unlooked round the new street in the Hwasong area.
The newly-built Hwasong area looks so beautiful for its majestic appearance of large architectural group embodying the advanced civilization and, more importantly, as it is associated with the genuine happiness and bright images of the people, he said, adding that today is a very significant day in the time-honored history of Pyongyang, the capital city.
Stressing that it is our Party's faith, absolute outlook on the people and thoroughgoing spirit of serving them to provide them with anything they want and everything for them under any circumstances,Kim Jong Unsaid that our Party will make strenuous efforts without a moment's stagnation and deviation to bring earlier the future in which our people will enjoy a civilized and affluent life to their heart's content.
The capital city construction should be steadily boosted, leading the development and civilization of our own style, he said, adding that the successes achieved so far are really great and precious but they are only beginning in comparison with our dreams and abilities. And he expressed his firm will to perfect the Hwasong area as a model district equipped with all political, economic and cultural components and turn the whole area of the capital city into the one embodying the features of the new era.
On the basis of the remarkable successes and experience achieved and gained in the period of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, the Ninth Congress of the WPK will clarify the greater milestone and goal of creation and our people will witness again another exciting five years of their perfect implementation, he said.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the wonderful new street.
At modern dwellings and peculiar service amenities embodying a harmony of the architectural formative art and advanced civilization, they were filled with boundless reverence for and trust in the motherly Party which translates all desires of the people into reality.
The successful completion of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang proved before the whole world the truth that the Party's decision for the good of the people is science, practice and victory. And it is brilliantly recorded in the history of the country as an unprecedented construction miracle that convinced all the people that our capital city and the DPRK would prosper more wonderfully along the new road to the overall prosperity of socialism to be opened up at the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Mt Paektu, Ancestral Mountain of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 18 (KCNA) -- Mt Paektu has been called the ancestral mountain of the Korean nation since olden times.
Ancestors of Koreans called it Mt Thaebaek, Mt Pulham, Mt Tothae and Mt Paek for its height reaching the sky, divine nature and snowy peaks, regarding it as the origin of Korea's vitality.
Such fact is well illustrated by historical data.
Worship of the mountain is reflected in the myth of foundation of Ancient Korea (early 30th century B.C.-108 B.C.). According to the myth, the place Tangun's father landed from Heaven was described as "Mt Thaebaek."
Tae Jo Yong, founder of Palhae (698-926), declared the founding of the Kingdom of Palhae, deeming the area of mountain a sacred land. It was recorded in a historical document that Jo Yong, a former general of Koguryo whose family name was Tae, gathered soldiers to found a kingdom south of Mt. Thaebaek and named it Palhae.
In the period of Koryo (918-1392), too, Koreans worshiped the mountain as the cradle of nation-founding and ancestral mountain. A historical document says that ancestors of Wang Kon, founder of Koryo, came to Mt Songak from Mt Paektu to gain foothold.
Such facts historically prove that Mt Paektu has been linked with the rise and fall of the nation.
A book compiled in the 17th century tells that all the mountains of Korea originated from Mt Paektu. In a map drawn by a geographer in 1861, the Great Paektu Ranges are described in a bold line to highlight the mountain as the ancestral mountain of the Korean nation.
The travelogue "Travel to Mt Paektu" (18th Century) specified the rivers, valleys, soil quality and trees witnessed in the course of a 1 300-ri round trip. Giving a special description of the peaks on Mt Paektu, it noted that the long history and glorious cultural traditions of the Korean people benefit from "the sacred spirit of Mt Paektu." -0-

headline: National Ski Amateurs Contest Held
story_text:

More than 140 ski amateurs selected from across the country took part in the alpine ski events, divided into juvenile, youth and middle- and old-aged classes.
The finals of the players who proved successful at the preliminary stage were held on February 17.
Senior Party and government officials, officials of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports, officials concerned, officials and working people in Kangwon Province and ski amateurs enjoyed the contest.
Prior to the contest, there took place a demonstration of professional skiers.
The technical skills of the professional skiers aroused the admiration of the spectators.
Then the finals of relevant classes took place.
The ski amateurs showed their excellent skills.
The juvenile-class giant slalom and old-aged class men's giant slalom drew the attention of the spectators.
The spectators enjoyed a pleasant time, looking at the amateur players' interesting and "distinctive" skills.
The giant slaloms and slaloms of the middle-aged and youth classes also excited the spectators.
The ski courses on Masik Pass were filled with boundless joy and optimism.
The winners at the finals were awarded the prizes.
The 2026 National Ski Amateurs Contest added to the joy of the lunar New Year's Day along with working people enjoying a new socialist civilization to their heart's content. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, February 18 (KCNA) -- There was a significant ceremony ahead of the opening of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea which all the Party members have cherished in their hearts as a landmark of new victory and glory for the past five years of the heroic struggle for the steady advance of the Juche revolution and the prosperity of the country.
A ceremony of awarding the certificate of delegate to the Ninth WPK Congress was held at the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on February 17.
The ceremony declared that PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, pioneers of the sacred cause of Juche and eternal leaders of the WPK and the people, are held in high esteem as delegates to the Ninth Party Congress, according to the general will of all the Party organizations and Party members.
All the participants applauded with boundless reverence for the President and the Chairman who are always together with them in struggle and life and inspire them with brilliant victory and glory.
Speeches were made by leading officials of the Party and government.
They said that the Ninth Party Congress serves as an important occasion for the development of the WPK and the revolution as it will set new goals and guidelines for struggle to carry forward the trend of the times of steady creation and change on the basis of the proud successes made in ushering in a great pioneering period of the overall development of the state by dint of self-respect and self-reliance.
They mentioned that the WPK is the most militant and seasoned revolutionary Party advancing and winning victory thanks to the idea and leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un, and herein lies the invincibility, absolute dignity and prestige of the WPK taking care of their destiny and future and leading the country and the people to prosperity and happiness.

The certificate was awarded to delegates to the Ninth Party Congress.
All the delegates made a firm determination to contribute to making the Ninth Party Congress a historic turning point leading Korean-style socialism to a higher stage of overall development by taking an active part in the congress with a high political awareness and sense of responsibility. -0-

headline: Chairman Kim Jong Il's Birth Anniversary Celebrated in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 18 (KCNA) -- Koreans in Japan significantly celebrated the auspicious February holiday, the birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) met at the Korean Hall in Tokyo on Feb. 13 to lay a flower basket before the portrait ofKim Jong Il.
The participants paid tribute toKim Jong Il, praying for his immortality.
A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Korean Hall to celebrate the 84th birth anniversary ofKim Jong Il.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairman Nam Sung U, Vice-Chairman and Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Vice-Chairman Jo Il Yon, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Department for International Affairs So Chung On and Vice-Chairwoman and concurrently Chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan Kang Chu Ryon of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and, Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, and directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan and chairpersons of Chongryon regional headquarters in Kanto area.
Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and director of its Organization Department, made a report.
The reporter praisedKim Jong Ilas an outstanding leader who developed Chongryon into a patriotic pioneer, a model of patriotism and loyalty and a model of overseas compatriots' organization of the world and as a paternal father and defender of the destiny of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan.
Thanks to the great fortune of February, the DPRK is now greeting the era of miracles and changes bringing earlier the building of a powerful socialist country and a new era of overall state prosperity, he said.
He called upon all the officials and compatriots of Chongryon to turn out in the patriotic activities for writing a great new history of the movement of Koreans in Japan, cherishing the faith that the patriotic cause of Chongryon is invincible along with the cause of Juche under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
A congratulatory letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
A lecture was given by the Chongryon Central Standing Committee at the Korean Hall on February 14 to celebrate the 84th birth anniversary ofKim Jong Il. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, released the following press statement on February 18:
I highly appreciate that Jong Tong Yong, minister of Unification of the ROK, officially acknowledged the ROK-born drone's provocative intrusion into the airspace of our country, expressing regret once again and willingness to prevent reoccurrence on February 18.
Such a foolish act of imperiling oneself should not be repeated.
Terrible consequences will be entailed if such violation of the sovereignty of the DPRK reoccurs, no matter whom the mastermind is and by what means it is carried out. I stress this once again.
This is not a threat but a strong warning.
To take a measure for surely guaranteeing the prevention of reoccurrence of such serious violation of our sovereignty is entirely for the ROK's existence.
Our military leadership will take a step for heightening vigilance in all sectors along the southern border with the ROK.
The borderline with the enemy should be firmly guarded. -0-

headline: Fifth-Stage Construction of Hwasong Area Begins with Grand Ceremony in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of weight significance was held in the area of Hwasong in the DPRK, well known as an epitome representing socialist Korea's remarkable advance toward a grandiose future and as a symbol of new construction miracles and high civilization. The ceremony demonstrates the spirit of continuous revolution and the engine for vigorous progress peculiar to the Workers' Party of Korea.
Thanks to the far-sighted plan and ambition of the WPK to accelerate the simultaneous and comprehensive prosperity of the whole country by turning its capital city into an ideal one representing the socialist cultural efflorescence admired by the world and making sure that the appearance of the capital city undergoing ceaseless progress is reflected in other parts of the country, the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area will start in the run-up to the glorious Ninth Congress of the WPK.
The grand construction campaign is to be conducted without a moment's let-up to show strenuous upsurges in the efforts for Pyongyang's prosperity in the new era and ever-soaring confidence in the development of Korean-style high civilization, at a time when loud cheers have been heard at the inauguration ceremonies celebrating the remarkable over-fulfillment of the five-year plan of the capital city construction set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK. This is a vivid manifestation of the noble people-first political ideals of the WPK racing against the clock to bring earlier a rosy future of the country through a resolute and offensive struggle.
A ceremony of declaring the start of the fifth-stage construction in the Hwasong area took place with splendor on February 18, adding to the confidence of the people in their Party and social system, their strength and cause.
The venue for the ceremony was brimming with great enthusiasm of the builders to write with pride a new history of transformations of their beloved capital city of Pyongyang by displaying more strongly the spirit and morale they had shown in building magnificent monumental edifices symbolic of their era and generation by upholding the Party's grand plan of capital city development with miraculous construction successes.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended the ceremony.
Present there were leading cadres of the Party, power and armed forces organs, officials of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies, military-civilian builders and youth shock brigade members.
WhenKim Jong Unarrived at the venue, all the participants raised enthusiastic cheers for a long time with deep reverence for the great revolutionary, benevolent father who is translating the centuries-old desire of the people into a brilliant reality of the present times, leading to steady progress and shining victory the historic advance towards the comprehensive development and prosperity of Korean-style socialist construction.
Kim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech on the occasion of the start of the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area.
He noted that we will now launch into a construction project for the new year according the long-term plan for transforming our capital city of Pyongyang more wonderfully. Saying that with the beginning of the fifth-stage construction project in the Hwasong area today, the capital city construction that was basically aimed at solving the housing problem is switching over to a higher phase of transforming the overall appearance of the capital city on a large scale, he referred to the nature of the capital city construction and the goal and long-term plan to be attained in the next 5 years.
As befits the hub of our country and the origin of advanced culture and civilization, the capital city of Pyongyang should be perfect in all aspects and make uninterrupted progress, he said, adding that over the few years to come we will get rid of those elements that are inappropriate for the capital city in view of its overall formation and build modern streets and that this will bring about another facelift of the city, which will in turn augment its strategic position ad role.
Expressing belief that all the capital city builders will wonderfully carry out the first task in the new plan period by pooling all their efforts and creativity and render a great contribution to glorifying this significant year, when the Ninth Party Congress will be held, as a successful year without fail, he ardently called on all to vigorously turn out once again for the capital city of the motherland.
WhenKim Jong Unmade a militant appeal at the end of his speech, the capital city builders and other participants raised passionate cheers in reflection of their ardent reverence for and trust in him.
Kim Jong Undug the first spadeful earth to signal the start of the fifth-stage construction of the Hwasong area and pressed the button of a detonator.
The thrilling explosion shook the earth, convincing all the participants of the everlasting heyday of Pyongyang, the capital city of our state.
Kim Jong Unextended his warm encouragement to all the builders filled with enthusiasm for glorifying the precious name and honor of the capital city builders by performing a miracle of legendary construction and more magnificently transforming the Hwasong area into an exemplary entity of the development and civilization of our own style perfectly embodying our Party's people-first idea and politics.
He repeatedly expressed belief that the officials of the construction headquarters and the capital city builders would always bear in mind the trust and expectation of the Party and the people and faithfully discharge their responsibility and role in the vanguard of the construction revolution in the new era and thus make the next five years the remarkable heyday when Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, will be transformed into the most beautiful city full of happiness of the people once again.
The start of the fifth-stage construction in the Hwasong area is a striking demonstration of the strong revolutionary spirit and power for great progress exclusive to the WPK which is advancing toward the far-reaching plan and goal for building a highly civilized and prosperous country, giving top priority to actualizing the people's long-cherished desire. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Vice Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, released the following press statement on February 18:
I highly appreciate that Jong Tong Yong, minister of Unification of the ROK, officially acknowledged the ROK-born drone's provocative intrusion into the airspace of our country, expressing regret once again and willingness to prevent reoccurrence on February 18.
Such a foolish act of imperiling oneself should not be repeated.
Terrible consequences will be entailed if such violation of the sovereignty of the DPRK reoccurs, no matter whom the mastermind is and by what means it is carried out. I stress this once again.
This is not a threat but a strong warning.
To take a measure for surely guaranteeing the prevention of reoccurrence of such serious violation of our sovereignty is entirely for the ROK's existence.
Our military leadership will take a step for heightening vigilance in all sectors along the southern border with the ROK.
The borderline with the enemy should be firmly guarded. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Presenting 600mm-Calibre Multiple Rocket Launchers Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 19 (KCNA) -- The workers in the munitions industry of the DPRK is providing a sure guarantee for the continuous evolution and radical development of the self-defensive capability, giving a boost to invincibility and mightiness of our state in the outpost of the national defence industry revolution in the new era energetically led by the great Workers' Party of Korea. In this course, they presented 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers, carrying their spirit of devotedly implementing the Party's policies and fervent patriotism and loyalty, to the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
The workers of a leading munitions enterprise manufactured the main strike armaments as the most precious labor gift to give the strongest power to our heroic army through their indomitable struggle for creation and increased production in the van of the campaign to implement our Party’s idea of self-reliant defence – defending the state, the people and the revolutionary cause by our own efforts – and its strategic line on the development of the national defence.
A ceremony of presenting 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers to the Ninth Congress of the WPK by the workers of the munitions industry sector was held in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on February 18.
The absolute weapons, fully reflecting the patriotic soul of the soldiers of the national defence sector who devoted their all to the accomplishment of the historic mission to consolidate the self-defensive capacity as the strongest in the world and symbolizing the definite military superiority of the armed forces of the DPRK, were lined up in rows at the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture, demonstrating their might.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the venue, all the participants extended the highest respect and glory to the invincible iron-willed commander who has opened a new horizon of developing the national defence in our own way and reliably defended the prestige and security of our state and people with his far-sighted wisdom, outstanding leadership ability and strong pluck, guiding the great cause of strengthening the national defence capability.
Present at the ceremony were the participants to the Ninth Congress of the WPK and officials, scientists, technicians and workers of the munitions industry sector.
An official of a munitions enterprise made a presentation report.
He respectfully reported toKim Jong Unon presenting to the Ninth Congress of the WPK fifty 600mm-caliber multiple rocket launchers the workers of the enterprise additionally produced in two months, out of their mind to uphold the Party's cause of building a powerful army with their boundless patriotism and loyalty.
He courteously presented toKim Jong Unthe written donation reflecting the pledge of unshakable faith and loyalty of the workers in the munitions industry to uphold the revolutionary cause of the WPK with miraculous successes in the production of armaments.
Expressing thanks to it,Kim Jong Unmade a reply speech.
Saying that the workers in the munitions industry prepared the most precious gifts to be presented to the Congress of the WPK, he courteously suggested making rapturous applause as a token of thanks to the workers and officials of the major munitions industrial establishment who have brought powerful war hardware to the venue for the glorious Party Congress.
It is a pride of our Party Congress to see such an encouraging advance at the most crucial and responsible time, he said, referring to the military value and efficiency of the world's most advantageous weapon for concentrated super-powerful attack and the invariable will of the WPK to modernize the capabilities for national defence.
Saying that the main guarantee for ensuring the national security environment lies in thoroughly maintaining the resolute outlook on the enemy, building up the most powerful military muscle and applying the offensive mode of response, he expressed belief that the workers in the munitions industry would attain more excellent and encouraging successes in their efforts for carrying out their weighty mission for fulfilling the requirements of the revolution and implementing the strategic plan of the WPK.
He awarded the Order ofKim Il Sungto the major munitions enterprise which has made distinguished exploits in carrying out the WPK's policy of defence industry revolution in the new era.
He presented the written donation of 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers to the chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army.
He personally drove a launcher vehicle to review the weaponry symbolic of absolute power lined in the plaza of the venue for the glorious Party Congress.
Thunderous cheers reverberated through the plaza that witnessed an exciting event to be specially recorded in the history of the WPK for accomplishing the great historic cause of building a rich country with a strong army.
Repeatedly expressing his satisfaction that the 600mm-calibre multiple rocket launchers are admirable military equipment making it possible to successfully carry out the strategic plan for rapidly developing the national war deterrence, he highly praised the workers in the munitions industry as the greatest revolutionaries and patriots who steadfastly uphold the cause of the WPK with their strong ideological and spiritual power and inexhaustible creativity.
The venue of presentation ceremony was filled with boundless gratitude to and reverence for the great teacher and benevolent father who led them to the historic Party Congress by making sure that they have unflinchingly left the proud traces of loyalty and feats, true to the mission they shouldered before the Party and the country, and put them on the platform of the glory paid by the whole country.
The workers in the field of munitions industry were full of ardent enthusiasm to make a dash to attain higher goals of bolstering up the national defence capabilities to be indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK by dint of the invincible strength of trust, greater confidence and inexhaustible creativity, with which they follow their Party only.
After the ceremony, the delegates and observers of the Ninth Party Congress looked round the super-powerful military hardware presented to the Congress by the workers in the munitions industry.
The ceremony of presenting to the Ninth Congress of the WPK military hardware produced by the workers in the munitions industry will be recorded in history as a significant occasion for redoubling the unshakable will of all the people across the country to dynamically advance toward a new victory of the revolution, rallied close as one under the red flag of the WPK with firm faith in the validity and invincibility of their cause and absolute confidence in the future of the country which will be more powerful and prosperous. -0-
