headline: Senior Middle School Graduates Volunteer for Forefronts of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of senior middle school graduates in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered for forefronts of national defence.
There was a ceremony for cheering them at the Sinuiju Youth Open-Air Theatre on Sunday.
Present there were officials concerned, youth league officials and students in the province. Speakers said that national defence is the greatest expression of patriotism and nothing is more precious and patriotic than the life dedicated to national defence, calling on the new generation to perform proud military feats at sacred posts of defending and glorifying the country.
The graduates who took the floor vowed to glorify every moment of military service with loyalty and feats, following the noble spiritual world of the wartime heroic soldiers and the martyrs who participated in the overseas military operations, mindful of the requests of teachers of their alma maters and their folks at native places.
After the ceremony, there was a contest of singing wartime songs in chorus while marching. -0-

headline: Fourth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- The Fourth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held with splendor in Pyongyang from September 11 to 18, 1961.
After reviewing with high pride the brilliant successes achieved by the Party and the people for five years since the Third Congress of the WPK, PresidentKim Il Sungset forth the grand programme of the First Seven-Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy (1961-1967), a bright blueprint for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people, and the tasks for further strengthening the Party organizationally and ideologically and enhancing its leadership role.
He said at the congress that in order to successfully carry out the First Seven-Year Plan, we should firmly adhere to the Party's line of giving priority to the growth of the heavy industry while simultaneously developing the light industry and agriculture and developing science and culture in an overall way. He also said that to reeducate and unite the broad masses of people is a priority issue our Party has to deal with. And he clarified other important tasks to be accomplished in developing the Korean revolution onto a new high stage.
The Fourth Party Congress was a meeting of victors that reviewed the completion of laying foundations for socialism, a meeting of unity that eliminated factionalism which had existed for a very long time and demonstrated the invincible might of the whole Party firmly united behind the President, and a historic meeting that set forth a grand programme for completing the socialist industrialization and building socialism comprehensively. -0-

headline: Online Joint Seminar in Brazil
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- An online joint seminar of Brazilian political parties and organizations took place on Feb. 15 to mark the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present at the seminar titled "Immortal Exploits of ComradeKim Jong Il, Defender of Socialist Korea" were personages of Brazilian political parties and organizations including the Brazilian Communist Party, the Brazilian Center for Peace and Solidarity with Peoples, the Brazilian Institute of Paektu, the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Center of Studies of the Juche Idea in Goias and the Brazilian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association.
Members of Brazilian organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people attended the seminar.
Speeches were made at the seminar.
The speakers said that the Korean revolution could only follow the road of independence and victories without even a single mistake in shaping line as there was ComradeKim Jong Ilwho exactly carried forward the ideas and cause of PresidentKim Il Sung.
They noted that the immortal exploits of ComradeKim Jong Il, who consistently adhered to the independent-stand and led the Korean revolution to victory and glory in the complicated international political situation in which high-handed and arbitrary practices of imperialism are rampant, are the feats to be specially recorded in the modern history of politics -0-

headline: Fourth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- The Fourth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held with splendor in Pyongyang from September 11 to 18, 1961.
After reviewing with high pride the brilliant successes achieved by the Party and the people for five years since the Third Congress of the WPK, PresidentKim Il Sungset forth the grand programme of the First Seven-Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy (1961-1967), a bright blueprint for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people, and the tasks for further strengthening the Party organizationally and ideologically and enhancing its leadership role.
He said at the congress that in order to successfully carry out the First Seven-Year Plan, we should firmly adhere to the Party's line of giving priority to the growth of the heavy industry while simultaneously developing the light industry and agriculture and developing science and culture in an overall way. He also said that to reeducate and unite the broad masses of people is a priority issue our Party has to deal with. And he clarified other important tasks to be accomplished in developing the Korean revolution onto a new high stage.
The Fourth Party Congress was a meeting of victors that reviewed the completion of laying foundations for socialism, a meeting of unity that eliminated factionalism which had existed for a very long time and demonstrated the invincible might of the whole Party firmly united behind the President, and a historic meeting that set forth a grand programme for completing the socialist industrialization and building socialism comprehensively. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Sil Baek, who is living in neighbourhood unit No. 45 of Junhyok-ri, Kaechon City of South Phyongan Province, on her 100th birthday.
Excited to enjoy the glory and happiness she had imagined in a dream, Ri extended her gratitude toKim Jong Unfor sending the birthday spread to such an ordinary old rural villager as her though he is busy handling all state affairs.
She had been subjected to all maltreatments, being a landlord's slave, before national liberation. Only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country, she could lead a genuine life as a human being.
With a resolve to repay the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea, she fulfilled her duty in the agricultural sector for decades and continued her work for the country even after becoming a pensioner.
Officials of the Kaechon City Committee of the WPK and villagers congratulated the centenarian's family on its auspicious event, sharing joy with her family. -0-

headline: Proposal to Elect Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as WPK General Secretary
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- At the fourth-day sitting of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea on Feb. 22, Ri Il Hwan made a proposal for the election of the WPK general secretary.
In his speech he said that in order to firmly preserve the lifeline of the Korean revolution and successfully carry out the huge struggle tasks at the new stage of development, we have to further strengthen the leadership ability of our Party. This can be successfully carried out when we entrust the inheritor, who remains most faithful to the cause of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the great man possessed of prominent and experienced ability, with the responsibility for leadership, he stressed.
Thanks to the wise and steadfast guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, we could fill the days and months of the five years with the gigantic miracles and events we could not perform and bring about even when circumstances were favorable, the speaker said, and went on:
The great ComradeKim Jong Unadvanced the idea on building a comprehensively developed socialist state and the principles and strategies for political, economic, military and cultural construction to carry it into practice, the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, the line of building armed forces in the new era, the definition on three elements for military capabilities, a theory on deterring any enemy's aggression by dint of powerful counterattack muscle and other important programmes we have witnessed and received for the past five years. They are new and brilliant discoveries never to be found in the ideo-theoretical treasures accumulated by mankind and even in the treasure house of our revolution spanning one full century.
In such a grim and difficult situation, ComradeKim Jong Unread the aspiration and determination of the people to defend their Party and government and build their future by their own efforts, and there he found out the valuable possibilities for starting the revolutionary transformation and boldly made it a policy, regarding it as the requirement of the mature revolution.
His profound and energetic revolutionary thinking covered every field and realm for the good of our people and our DPRK, and the world of his extraordinary study specified the clear development goals for different sectors and units and ways for guaranteeing their implementation.
His peculiar way of thinking and extraordinary insight have become a model of the trend of our state's development as he steers the current of the times with constantly updated and innovative standards and new discoveries, which make today better than yesterday and tomorrow far better than today, always pursuing originality and perfection in any work while flatly rejecting triteness and formulism.
Having solved the complex and difficult theoretical and practical problems in the period of comprehensive development of socialism, ComradeKim Jong Unformulated and enunciated the ideas and theories that would have tremendous influence on the future development of our country by uniting the exploration and application of new principles and methods and the verification of their scientific accuracy and vitality.
The past five years, when all the goals were fully attained through the accelerated all-people advance along the path of bold pioneering unprecedented in history, has clearly proved the extraordinary leadership ability of ComradeKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great artist of politics.
The five-point Party-building line in the new era, clarified by his revolutionary ideas, marked an important milestone in our Party building to ensure the eternal future of the WPK by steadfastly carrying forward its original ideals and spirit.
The period of the comprehensive development of socialism has coincided with the heyday of our Party building and the five-year course of transformation coincided with the course of Party organizations at all levels for implementing Party decisions. This fact is an inevitability of history brought about by the greatness of the far-sighted wisdom of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The engine of our revolution, shouldering the destiny of the country and the people, has vigorously led the comprehensive development of socialism without a moment's stagnation. This would have been unthinkable without the extraordinariness, outstanding commanding art and leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, who placed the Korean People's Army in the vanguard of the struggle by remarkably strengthening it into the revolutionary armed forces of the WPK.
ComradeKim Jong Unmakes every place he goes and everybody he meets seethe with excitement and joy and moves the mind of people even in a word. His extraordinary affinity and influence were an extraordinary mobilization force that inspired all the people at a time and gave further momentum to their patriotic enthusiasm and initiative and ingenuity.
His noble greatness comes from the true and noble thoughts and feelings as the leader of the people who truly loves and takes care of the people, and it is based on the gifted great qualities and natural character as the great man.
Emotion of ardent patriotism taught by him as a living example has been implanted in the hearts of the people across the country, and today everyone is filled with the uncommon solemnity that they did not feel before whenever the solemn melody of the national anthem resounds and whenever they look up to the sacred national flag. And the sound of hurrah for our Republic, which was powerfully echoed in the sky of the country in response to his resonant voice, still resounds and ardently calls for patriotism.
The noble patriotic model and ardent appeal shown by ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally made all the people redouble the pride and honor of our great state and the unique thoughts and feelings of Koreans were fully displayed as a courageous force for building a rich country with a strong army.
In the era ofKim Jong Un, we have entered the world of advanced civilization at a stride and constantly learned how to make new things and innovations and made ourselves familiar with it, creating our own style of civilization and making great progress ideologically and culturally.
Under the guidance of ComradeKim Jong Un, who puts forward the young people as a wing of the great campaign for creation and assigns to them main construction projects of politically great significance and, through the course, leads them to display bravery and youthful strength and cultivate patriotism and revolutionary spirit, the ranks of successors to our cause are powerfully demonstrating their might as the main force that builds and brings earlier the bright future of socialism by their own efforts.
In the revolutionary world of ComradeKim Jong Un, there was not stagnation or retreat but the goal and solution of only progress and innovations.
The proud conclusion of the five-year plan for national economic development, over-fulfillment of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, construction of modern rural dwellings across the country, construction of tourist and cultural resorts and many other achievements and eye-opening struggle results were made thanks to ComradeKim Jong Un's spirit of uninterrupted revolution and proactive and offensive leadership mode.
All the fields from the Party work and the national defence work deciding the destiny of the revolution to the creation of masterpieces that touch the heartstrings of the people are associated with the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The leadership mode of ComradeKim Jong Unwas the driving force for rapid and steady development as he created and generalized the model of the new era in all fields and all spheres and set another model and generalized it when the goal of one stage was realized.
ComradeKim Jong Unwas strong in a sense of responsibility for the destiny of the country and the people and stronger with ardent love for the rising generations.
It was the most valuable victory of the brilliant ones won in the past five years to have provided the legal weapons and powerful strength that can surely guarantee the dignity and security of our country and the peace of rising generations and this was the great historic cause that could be accomplished only by ComradeKim Jong Un.
The whole course of specifying the policy on bolstering up the nuclear forces in the Constitution of the Republic and guaranteeing its position with overwhelming ability in the present world, where the legitimate exercise of the right to self-defence is branded as illegal and military attacks on sovereign states are perpetrated any time, was a death-defying battle with grave challenges and manifold difficulties and a de facto war that could not be overcome even an inch by ordinary willpower.
Pioneering with indefatigable spiritual strength this severe history that no one can control and overcome, ComradeKim Jong Unleft in the annals the strenuous efforts and sufferings as well as the most staunch patriotic faith and noble conscience.
As we hold in high esteem an outstanding great man as the leader whom no one can match, our country is strong, our people could be well and our dignity and strength are put on the world's highest level.
Thanks to him, we could win victory in the past and are still winning at present.
Our Party members and other people are convinced of the absolute strength and inevitability of victory to control any adversity and achieve everything we want in his outstanding ideas and theories, strategy, great political ability, leadership art, surprising pluck and determination.
The speaker stressed that all our people entrust their destiny and the future of their families and the most precious rising generations to only ComradeKim Jong Unand wholeheartedly hope that he will lead this country.
He courteously suggested before the Congress to entrust again the heavy duty of general secretary, the supreme post of the WPK which organizes and guides all victories of the Korean people, to the great ComradeKim Jong Un, in reflection of the unanimous wish of all the Party members and other people, for the strengthening of the WPK and the brilliant realization of its grand fighting programme, for the prosperity of our state and for the rosy future of socialism. -0-

Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- An online joint seminar of Brazilian political parties and organizations took place on Feb. 15 to mark the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present at the seminar titled "Immortal Exploits of ComradeKim Jong Il, Defender of Socialist Korea" were personages of Brazilian political parties and organizations including the Brazilian Communist Party, the Brazilian Center for Peace and Solidarity with Peoples, the Brazilian Institute of Paektu, the Brazilian Center for the Study of the Juche Idea, the Center of Studies of the Juche Idea in Goias and the Brazilian Branch of the Korean Friendship Association.
Members of Brazilian organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people attended the seminar.
Speeches were made at the seminar.
The speakers said that the Korean revolution could only follow the road of independence and victories without even a single mistake in shaping line as there was ComradeKim Jong Ilwho exactly carried forward the ideas and cause of PresidentKim Il Sung.
They noted that the immortal exploits of ComradeKim Jong Il, who consistently adhered to the independent-stand and led the Korean revolution to victory and glory in the complicated international political situation in which high-handed and arbitrary practices of imperialism are rampant, are the feats to be specially recorded in the modern history of politics -0-

headline: Proposal to Elect Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un as WPK General Secretary
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- At the fourth-day sitting of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea on Feb. 22, Ri Il Hwan made a proposal for the election of the WPK general secretary.
In his speech he said that in order to firmly preserve the lifeline of the Korean revolution and successfully carry out the huge struggle tasks at the new stage of development, we have to further strengthen the leadership ability of our Party. This can be successfully carried out when we entrust the inheritor, who remains most faithful to the cause of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the great man possessed of prominent and experienced ability, with the responsibility for leadership, he stressed.
Thanks to the wise and steadfast guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, we could fill the days and months of the five years with the gigantic miracles and events we could not perform and bring about even when circumstances were favorable, the speaker said, and went on:
The great ComradeKim Jong Unadvanced the idea on building a comprehensively developed socialist state and the principles and strategies for political, economic, military and cultural construction to carry it into practice, the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, the line of building armed forces in the new era, the definition on three elements for military capabilities, a theory on deterring any enemy's aggression by dint of powerful counterattack muscle and other important programmes we have witnessed and received for the past five years. They are new and brilliant discoveries never to be found in the ideo-theoretical treasures accumulated by mankind and even in the treasure house of our revolution spanning one full century.
In such a grim and difficult situation, ComradeKim Jong Unread the aspiration and determination of the people to defend their Party and government and build their future by their own efforts, and there he found out the valuable possibilities for starting the revolutionary transformation and boldly made it a policy, regarding it as the requirement of the mature revolution.
His profound and energetic revolutionary thinking covered every field and realm for the good of our people and our DPRK, and the world of his extraordinary study specified the clear development goals for different sectors and units and ways for guaranteeing their implementation.
His peculiar way of thinking and extraordinary insight have become a model of the trend of our state's development as he steers the current of the times with constantly updated and innovative standards and new discoveries, which make today better than yesterday and tomorrow far better than today, always pursuing originality and perfection in any work while flatly rejecting triteness and formulism.
Having solved the complex and difficult theoretical and practical problems in the period of comprehensive development of socialism, ComradeKim Jong Unformulated and enunciated the ideas and theories that would have tremendous influence on the future development of our country by uniting the exploration and application of new principles and methods and the verification of their scientific accuracy and vitality.
The past five years, when all the goals were fully attained through the accelerated all-people advance along the path of bold pioneering unprecedented in history, has clearly proved the extraordinary leadership ability of ComradeKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great artist of politics.
The five-point Party-building line in the new era, clarified by his revolutionary ideas, marked an important milestone in our Party building to ensure the eternal future of the WPK by steadfastly carrying forward its original ideals and spirit.
The period of the comprehensive development of socialism has coincided with the heyday of our Party building and the five-year course of transformation coincided with the course of Party organizations at all levels for implementing Party decisions. This fact is an inevitability of history brought about by the greatness of the far-sighted wisdom of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The engine of our revolution, shouldering the destiny of the country and the people, has vigorously led the comprehensive development of socialism without a moment's stagnation. This would have been unthinkable without the extraordinariness, outstanding commanding art and leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, who placed the Korean People's Army in the vanguard of the struggle by remarkably strengthening it into the revolutionary armed forces of the WPK.
ComradeKim Jong Unmakes every place he goes and everybody he meets seethe with excitement and joy and moves the mind of people even in a word. His extraordinary affinity and influence were an extraordinary mobilization force that inspired all the people at a time and gave further momentum to their patriotic enthusiasm and initiative and ingenuity.
His noble greatness comes from the true and noble thoughts and feelings as the leader of the people who truly loves and takes care of the people, and it is based on the gifted great qualities and natural character as the great man.
Emotion of ardent patriotism taught by him as a living example has been implanted in the hearts of the people across the country, and today everyone is filled with the uncommon solemnity that they did not feel before whenever the solemn melody of the national anthem resounds and whenever they look up to the sacred national flag. And the sound of hurrah for our Republic, which was powerfully echoed in the sky of the country in response to his resonant voice, still resounds and ardently calls for patriotism.
The noble patriotic model and ardent appeal shown by ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally made all the people redouble the pride and honor of our great state and the unique thoughts and feelings of Koreans were fully displayed as a courageous force for building a rich country with a strong army.
In the era ofKim Jong Un, we have entered the world of advanced civilization at a stride and constantly learned how to make new things and innovations and made ourselves familiar with it, creating our own style of civilization and making great progress ideologically and culturally.
Under the guidance of ComradeKim Jong Un, who puts forward the young people as a wing of the great campaign for creation and assigns to them main construction projects of politically great significance and, through the course, leads them to display bravery and youthful strength and cultivate patriotism and revolutionary spirit, the ranks of successors to our cause are powerfully demonstrating their might as the main force that builds and brings earlier the bright future of socialism by their own efforts.
In the revolutionary world of ComradeKim Jong Un, there was not stagnation or retreat but the goal and solution of only progress and innovations.
The proud conclusion of the five-year plan for national economic development, over-fulfillment of the construction of 50 000 flats in Pyongyang, construction of modern rural dwellings across the country, construction of tourist and cultural resorts and many other achievements and eye-opening struggle results were made thanks to ComradeKim Jong Un's spirit of uninterrupted revolution and proactive and offensive leadership mode.
All the fields from the Party work and the national defence work deciding the destiny of the revolution to the creation of masterpieces that touch the heartstrings of the people are associated with the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The leadership mode of ComradeKim Jong Unwas the driving force for rapid and steady development as he created and generalized the model of the new era in all fields and all spheres and set another model and generalized it when the goal of one stage was realized.
ComradeKim Jong Unwas strong in a sense of responsibility for the destiny of the country and the people and stronger with ardent love for the rising generations.
It was the most valuable victory of the brilliant ones won in the past five years to have provided the legal weapons and powerful strength that can surely guarantee the dignity and security of our country and the peace of rising generations and this was the great historic cause that could be accomplished only by ComradeKim Jong Un.
The whole course of specifying the policy on bolstering up the nuclear forces in the Constitution of the Republic and guaranteeing its position with overwhelming ability in the present world, where the legitimate exercise of the right to self-defence is branded as illegal and military attacks on sovereign states are perpetrated any time, was a death-defying battle with grave challenges and manifold difficulties and a de facto war that could not be overcome even an inch by ordinary willpower.
Pioneering with indefatigable spiritual strength this severe history that no one can control and overcome, ComradeKim Jong Unleft in the annals the strenuous efforts and sufferings as well as the most staunch patriotic faith and noble conscience.
As we hold in high esteem an outstanding great man as the leader whom no one can match, our country is strong, our people could be well and our dignity and strength are put on the world's highest level.
Thanks to him, we could win victory in the past and are still winning at present.
Our Party members and other people are convinced of the absolute strength and inevitability of victory to control any adversity and achieve everything we want in his outstanding ideas and theories, strategy, great political ability, leadership art, surprising pluck and determination.
The speaker stressed that all our people entrust their destiny and the future of their families and the most precious rising generations to only ComradeKim Jong Unand wholeheartedly hope that he will lead this country.
He courteously suggested before the Congress to entrust again the heavy duty of general secretary, the supreme post of the WPK which organizes and guides all victories of the Korean people, to the great ComradeKim Jong Un, in reflection of the unanimous wish of all the Party members and other people, for the strengthening of the WPK and the brilliant realization of its grand fighting programme, for the prosperity of our state and for the rosy future of socialism. -0-

headline: WPK Rules Revised at Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 23 (KCNA) -- A decision of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea "On the Revision of the Rules of the Workers' Party of Korea" was adopted on Feb. 22.
The decision is as follows:
The Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea deliberated the Rules of the WPK which were revised to reflect the practical issues arising in further improving the features and leadership ability peculiar to our Party and putting the Party work and activities on a more regular and standardized basis.
Stipulated in the Rules of the WPK are the contents that the political, organizational, ideological, discipline and work-style building is held fast to as the permanent Party-building line, reflecting the consistent stand and will of the WPK to usher in a golden age of strengthening the whole Party with the five-point Party-building line in the new era as its ideo-theoretical guidelines.
The revised rules also clearly define the authority and work system of the central leadership bodies of the Party on the principle of thoroughly establishing the monolithic leadership system of the Party Central Committee over the Party building and activities as a whole and strengthening the centralist discipline.
Some contents of chapters and provisions in the Rules were revised in the direction of consolidating the Party ranks in a qualitative way and innovatively improving the Party work, including the reinforcement of institutional mechanisms to maintain the scientific accuracy and impartiality in applying the Party discipline.
The current Congress decides to adopt the revised and supplemented Party rules as the Rules of the WPK, considering that they will play an important role in successfully fulfilling the fighting programme set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Party by further consolidating the organizational and ideological foundations of our Party and thoroughly ensuring its invincible leadership ability in a standardized way. -0-

headline: The Ragwon County Offshore Farm strives to raise the level of scientific and intensive sea culture
Fifth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The Fifth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held from November 2 to 13, 1970.
At the congress, PresidentKim Il Sungreviewed the historic victory, in which the DPRK turned into a powerful socialist industrial state, and other shining successes achieved in all fields of politics, economy, culture and military affairs. And he set forth the tasks for accelerating the three revolutions, ideological, technological and cultural, to bring earlier the complete victory of socialism.
The President advanced the grand task of the Six-Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy (1971-1976).
The fundamental task of the Six-Year Plan was to consolidate and develop the successes in industrialization and advance the technological revolution to a new high stage so as to further consolidate the material and technical foundations of socialism and liberate the working people from hard labour in all sectors of the national economy.
He also clarified in detail the issue of thoroughly accomplishing the three major tasks of the technological revolution to considerably narrow the disparity between heavy and light labour, and between agricultural and industrial work and to free women from the heavy burden of household chores by launching a widespread technical innovation movement in industry, agriculture and all other sectors of the national economy. And he elucidated the issue of steadily developing the work of transforming the whole society on a revolutionary and working-class pattern by giving definite precedence to the ideological revolution.
The Fifth Congress of the WPK was recorded in the history of the WPK as the one which brought about a great victory in industrialization and opened up a bright prospect of achieving a greater victory. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Concluding Speech at Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade an important concluding speech at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The full text of his concluding speech is as follows:
Dear comrade delegates,
The current Congress, the ninth in the history of our Party, has put on its agenda the crucial fighting plans for switchover of the comprehensive development stage of socialism to a fresh stage and the issues for the steady development of the Party in the face of the prevailing internal and external circumstances, and it is holding discussions of them.
Through the speeches on the information of the data and results of the work, the work of the Eighth Party Central Committee was reviewed and analyzed in detail and the principled requirements, struggle lines, strategies and tactics and main tasks were clarified for further accelerating the revolution and construction in the future.
The general analysis at this point of today of the struggle of the past five years, in particular, has given us an instructive occasion to take a due pride in the fruits of our persevering efforts and clearly understand what are the valuable experiences we should maintain and enrich in the future, the deviations we should put to rights and the lessons we should draw.
In the course of this, all the delegates must have got an overall understanding of the changes and level of development in socialist construction and Party building in the period under review and a correct estimation of the current corresponding level of development of their fields and units.
And I believe that, on learning the struggle orientation of the new five-year plan, they must have become aware of the standpoint and attitude they should take to meet the demands of the revolution and the times to lead the past five years of transformation to another five years of greater transformation, and made a solemn resolve to harden their self-confidence and renew their enthusiasm.
The current Congress has also deliberated and adopted the amended Party Rules which incorporate some articles that were decided at the plenary meetings of the Eighth Party Central Committee to be revised as required by the practical Party work, and which include new stipulations needed.
Along with this, it has formed the Ninth Party Central Committee, which will organize and lead the efforts for carrying out greater and heavier revolutionary tasks in the coming years, with the sound and excellent comrades who enjoy high reputation among the masses of the Party members and who are promising as they have been tested through practical struggle.
As a result, the current Congress has successfully reviewed the work of the Eighth Party Central Committee and handed over the responsibility for and role of leading the Party and revolutionary work as a whole to the newly elected Ninth Party Central Committee.
Comrade delegates,
At this Congress I was honored to be elected again to the highest leading position of the Workers’ Party of Korea thanks to the high and full confidence of all the delegates and other members of the Party.
We have just launched into a gigantic cause of translating the people’s ideals into reality, and I still have a long way to go to keep the promises I have made to the people on several occasions. Yet, you have entrusted me with the sacred, important responsibility again. I accept it sincerely as an expression of your complete trust in and high expectation of me as you want me to make greater efforts and more strenuous endeavor.
I make a solemn oath of invariable allegiance to the holiest mission and the heaviest responsibility I have assumed before the Party and the people to live up to the great expectation and confidence, which all the delegates and the millions of the Party members have shown me, to observe and implement the Rules and programme of the Party in a thoroughgoing way, to reliably defend the rights to development and security of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and to work wholeheartedly to bring wellbeing to the people as soon as possible by making devoted efforts for them every minute and every second.
The newly elected Ninth Party Central Committee will be faithful to its responsible leadership role true to the high confidence and expectation of all the Party organizations and the entire membership. It will work hard to speed up the development of our great state and bring more substantial benefits to our people at an earlier date, and this will bring it a fair and square assessment of its work.
Comrade delegates,
The main schedules left for the current Congress are to work out a long-term plan of each field for the coming five years and to make a decision on its result.
The vital success of a Party congress depends on how we define our struggle orientation of the coming five years, study and discuss the goals to be attained by each field and adopt relevant decisions.
That is why we highlighted this course at the Eighth Party Congress and placed the focus on it at this Congress.
I believe that all the delegates will take a faithful and sincere approach and attitude to fulfilling the weighty missions and responsibility they have assumed for the country, the revolution and the people, and work heart and soul to generate creativity so that every item of the decisions will be an epoch-making task in the five-year struggle.
In particular, the newly-elected members of the Party central leadership should display a high sense of responsibility and prudence in adopting policy-oriented tasks as the decisions of the Party Congress will serve as the action programme to be consistently adhered to during the term of their membership.
As mentioned in the report, the new five-year plan period will become a stage for stabilizing and consolidating our economy and bringing about its gradual qualitative development.
Accordingly, in deciding on the plans for the economic branches it is necessary to properly combine two aspects of qualitatively cementing the existing foundations and forces and further developing them and to maintain this orientation in discussing the plans for other sectors.
Comrade delegates,
Today’s struggle to achieve transformations by accelerating the comprehensive development of socialism, which will include the implementation of the new five-year plan, demands that all sectors and all units step up the three revolutions–ideological, technological and cultural.
These three revolutions are our Party’s general line in building socialism.
Since its beginning, our socialist construction has been run through with the three revolutions, and it has made progress in the course of the struggle to carry out the line of the three revolutions.
As we have pushed ahead with these revolutions by prioritizing ideological remoulding, i.e., the ideological revolution, at the same time as speeding up technological upgrading and cultural transformation, the socialism of our own style has advanced forward without vacillation even in the face of severe trials.
The great cause of comprehensive development, too, can be carried out much faster and more effectively only when the Party’s guidance and the state’s leading role are strengthened in conducting the three revolutions, and only when the masses of the people are involved in these revolutions with an attitude befitting masters.
The reality shows that changes in working conditions and living environment will not naturally lead to the improvement of the people’s ideological consciousness, technical standards and cultural attainments.
To cite a simple example, less than one year after new modern production and service facilities were built under the concern of the Party and the state, they are not managed and operated as properly as they should be, and the guidance and control over these facilities are neglected; such serious dereliction of duty, irresponsibility and other ingrained maladies of seeking only immediate gains instead of treasuring the products of Party policy are rearing their ugly heads again.
These facilities are the precious creations we have achieved with so much effort, so it is necessary to manage and operate them so well that they can become useful assets conducive to the development of our socialist society. This is a revolutionary task that is no less important and crucial than our extensive construction work.
A revolution does not simply mean physical transformation or the creation of material wealth. It is essentially aimed at remoulding the people’s ideological consciousness and training them as powerful beings with a high level of creativity.
We should be effective in conducting the three revolutions to free the people from the fetters of the outdated ideas, heighten their voluntary enthusiasm, and improve their technical standards and cultural attainments; otherwise, all our assets, however many, will evidently come to nothing soon.
We should push forward with the three revolutions also to educate all the people and prepare them to be new masters of the new era so that the viewpoint and work style of voluntarily striving to fulfil one’s basic duty will prevail across our society.
In particular, it is an urgent task to intensify the ideological revolution aimed at remodeling the officials and working people on a revolutionary pattern and assimilating them to the working class.
The successful advance of our socialist construction is inconceivable separated from the work of transforming people, the masters of society, along revolutionary and working-class lines.
Therefore, it is important for Party and working people’s organizations and power organs to organize and conduct all their activities with a view to accomplishing the three revolutions, especially with a focus on awakening and training people ideologically and spiritually.
They should work to meet the Party’s demand that the officials and working people possess revolutionary ideological consciousness and the collectivist spirit and work style of the working class as their mental attributes; they should do so purposefully as demanded by the present reality.
They should set forth new tasks as required by the developing times in all the ideological, technological and cultural fields, and adopt an innovative approach towards transforming nature, people and society. This is just the way to make continuous advance in our socialist construction.
The report on the work of the Eighth Party Central Committee highlighted the necessity of properly meeting the requirements of the times for comprehensive development in socialist construction.
Let me briefly summarize once again the requirements of the new era, which are largely divided into five categories:
To ensure complete unity of action and establish firm discipline in socialist construction as a whole;
To get rid of outdated forms and patterns, conservatism and empiricism, and make sustained efforts to create something new and innovative;
To adopt a scientific, far-sighted and cost-effective approach towards our work, and give priority to specialist qualifications;
To drastically improve the methods and styles of providing guidance over production and construction, and enhance officials’ leadership abilities; and
To thoroughly apply the ideology-first principle and the people-first principle.
This is a law-governed requirement of the times, when improving and innovating all the work in accordance with the era of comprehensive development has arisen as a practical matter; it is also an urgent task that devolves on us in view of the serious lessons we gained in the past five years of struggle.
The state and social life, every branch and unit of the economic field in particular, is seething with the spirit of advance in the new era, but backward remnants still coexist with them--this is the reality that we are all aware of.
We should not leave the old and outdated remnants as they are, but be braver in overcoming and eliminating those backwardness and evil practices.
The three revolutions are, in essence, a struggle to eliminate everything obsolete and create the new in the ideological, technological and cultural fields; therefore, the requirement of the times of comprehensive development should naturally be met in the course of implementing the three revolutions.
We should dynamically push ahead with socialist construction in our way of advance.
We worked out short-term strategies and plans and implemented them in a responsible manner and, with this as a solid foundation, expanded and consolidated the successes--this is the experience we gained in the period of the Eighth Party Central Committee.
Continuously formulating a plan every five years and implementing it steadily as we do now constitutes a stage, a course, which we must go through in building up the national strength and finally building an ideal society.
When every field attains its goal by going through such course, we will greatly increase on a solid basis the strength of the country on the level we are desirous of.
After ten and 20 years from now, we will greet the 90th and 100th founding anniversaries of our Party, and if we steadily push forward with our work for the development of the state and improvement of the people’s wellbeing in the current way of struggle, we can surely transform the whole country and improve the living standards of all the people. When the days come, our Party will feel due pride in having remained faithful to its mission and duty as a genuine people’s party.
Comrade delegates,
Just like we did in the past five-year struggle in which we pioneered the era of comprehensive development of socialism, we will completely rely on our internal force, the great might of our people, in the new upcoming five-year struggle.
As we have lifted the ideals of "The people are god," single-hearted unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, the Party Central Committee will invariably be faithful to the three ideals during its ninth term.
Our ideals, goals and advancing speed will ceaselessly change and develop, but those ideals peculiar to the Korean revolution will remain unchanged and their inexhaustible might will confidently propel our socialist construction towards a bright future.
No challenge or change in situation can delay or check our advance.
Let all of us struggle vigorously to bring earlier the day when our people’s ideals and long-cherished desires will come true by redoubling our enthusiasm and fighting spirit, full of confidence in the future of the socialist cause. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on Feb. 23.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my heartfelt congratulations to you on your reelection to the top post of the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
This decision clearly proves your absolute political authority and the unity of your Party led by you.
The Workers' Party of Korea, the genuine embodiment of the will of the people, has achieved significant results in carrying out the cause of the DPRK's development and made great successes in the work for strengthening the sovereignty and defence capabilities of the country under your leadership.
I am pleased to note that the cooperation between the United Russia Party and the Workers' Party of Korea is taking a special place in the relations between the two countries.
I am convinced that the close cooperation between our two parties will continue to play a key role in promoting the development of the comprehensive strategic partnership between Moscow and Pyongyang.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I wish you good health, happiness and well-being.
Yours sincerely. -0-

headline: Song Kuk Hyang - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons of 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Song Kuk Hyang, a woman weightlifter of the April 25 Combat Sports Team in the DPRK, is one of the DPRK's ten best sportspersons of 2025.
She bettered the world and Asian records in the clean and jerk and total in the women's 71kg category of the 2025 Asian Weightlifting Championships, and thus became the best player at the championships. And she won three gold medals and set three new world records in the women's 69kg category of the 2025 IWF World Championships.
Born in Unchon County, South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK, she began to learn weightlifting basic skills at the age of 12.
She proved successful at the 2017 Asian Junior and Juvenile Weightlifting Championship, the 19th Asian Games and other international sporting events.
In particular, she bagged six gold medals at the 2024 Asian Weightlifting Championships and the 2024 IWF World Championships, drawing attention of the weightlifting circles.
People's Athlete Song Kuk Hyang is still training hard with a resolve to live up to the expectation of the country and the people with gold medals. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Fifth-day Sitting of Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The delegates to the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea elected the great ComradeKim Jong Unto the top post of the dignified WPK again. With higher political enthusiasm, they are continuing their work, according to the schedule of the congress, full of confidence in victory and optimism about the bright future of the WPK, the eternal prosperity of the DPRK and the rosy future of Korean-style socialism.
The fifth-day sitting of the congress was held on Feb. 23.
Upon authorization of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, Jo Yong Won made a report to the congress on the decision of the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK held earlier.
Kim Jong Unmade an important concluding speech.
He said that the general analysis of the five-year-long struggle at the congress has given us an instructive occasion for all the delegates to bear in mind the precious experience and lessons, as well as the sense of pride in the achievements made with much effort, and to renew their solemn decision to make redoubled efforts to meet the demands of the revolution and the times for making the past five years of transformation lead on to the five years of greater transformation.
He said that the newly elected ninth-term Central Committee of the WPK will faithfully live up to the trust and expectations of all the Party organizations and members with its responsible leadership role and will have its work fairly appreciated through its efforts for accelerating the development of the great country and bringing more substantial benefits earlier to the people.
The whole course of our socialist construction is run through with the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural - and the socialist construction has advanced in the struggle for carrying out the line of the three revolutions, he said, stressing that the great cause of comprehensive development can also be accomplished earlier and more successfully only when the Party's leadership and the state's guidance are enhanced over the implementation of the three revolutions and the masses approach the work with a responsible attitude.
The new five-year struggle, too will rely entirely on our own forces and the great strength of our people and will invariably hold high the ideology of believing in the people as in Heaven, single-minded unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance as we did in the past five-year struggle which pioneered the period of comprehensive development of socialism, he said, ardently calling for a vigorous struggle to bring earlier the day when the people's ideals and aspirations will be wonderfully realized by redoubling confidence in the future of the socialist cause, enthusiasm and fighting spirit.
All the delegates responded with stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" to the conclusion full of ardent appeal and revolutionary will of General SecretaryKim Jong Uncalling the whole Party to the vanguard of the sacred struggle to bring the steady prosperity of our state and the rosy future of socialism.
The Congress went into the work procedure to study and discuss in detail the long-term goals and plans of the ninth-term Party Central Committee before reflecting them on the decision.
Study and consultative meetings are taking place, divided into the sectors of industry, agriculture, light industry, culture, construction, military affairs, arms industry, judicial affairs, foreign affairs and Party affairs. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to An Mi Ho, a woman centenarian living in Neighbourhood Unit No. 57, Kaeson-dong of Moranbong District, Pyongyang.
Deeply moved by the birthday spread she received, the woman centenarian and her family and relatives extended thanks toKim Jong Un.
An, who devoted herself to the development of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan together with her husband, had worked with sincerity at her revolutionary post for decades while leading a worthwhile life as a citizen of the DPRK under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea and socialist system.
She brought up her children well to be faithful to the country and, even after becoming a pensioner, she has kept herself busy to be helpful to the country to earn the respect of neighbours.
Officials of the Moranbong District Committee of the WPK congratulated her family on the happy event and encouraged them to fulfill their responsibility and duty at their worksites like their grandmother who devoted her whole life to the patriotic work for prosperity and development of the country. -0-

headline: First Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Ninth Central Committee of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The first enlarged plenary meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on February 23.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, presided over the plenary meeting.
Attending the plenary meeting were members and alternate members of the WPK Central Committee who were elected at the Ninth Party Congress.
Present there as observers were officials of departments of the WPK Central Committee, senior officials of ministries, national agencies, provinces, cities, counties and major industrial establishments and relevant commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
Saying today we are to start the first work to fulfill the responsible mission of the ninth-term Party central leadership elected by the general will of all the delegates and Party members at the historic Party congress, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated the members and alternate members of the Party Central Committee newly elected under the great trust and expectation of the Party and people.
The Presidium of the Political Bureau and the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee headed byKim Jong Unwere elected at the first enlarged plenary meeting of the Ninth WPK Central Committee.
Secretaries of the Party Central Committee were elected and the Secretariat was formed.
The Central Military Commission and the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK were elected.
The plenary meeting discussed the work for the inner-Party structure essentially needed in implementing the Party's political guidance and unanimously approved a relevant decision.
Department directors of the Party Central Committee and chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the Party were appointed.
Commanding officers for the key posts of the KPA were appointed.
The meeting decided to discuss the 2026 work plan for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress, make a joint study of draft decisions reflecting this year's plan at the sectional study and consultative meetings for drawing up a new five-year plan to be carried out in the period of the Party congress, and bring together opinions to submit them for deliberation at the newly-elected Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee.
It also decided to discuss the agenda item on the revision of the collection of slogans set forth by the Party Central Committee and the WPK Rules guide and distribute the relevant drafts to the whole Party after the study of them by the members of the Party Central Committee and the deliberation by the Political Bureau.
The enlarged plenary meeting decided to examine and adopt a proposal for reshuffling the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet and refer it to the new-term Supreme People's Assembly.
General SecretaryKim Jong Unsaid that we are now facing the new five years which will be a part of the glorious Party history and whether or not the ninth-term Party Central Committee fulfills the heavy mission entrusted by the supreme leadership entirely depends on the high sense of responsibility and activity of the members of the Party central leadership. And he added that the members of the Party central leadership should do their utmost to fulfill their heavy and sacred duty with a high sense of the Party spirit, the revolutionary spirit and the spirit of serving the people so as to live up to the deep trust and expectations of the Party members and other people.
The subjective and objective conditions and environment of the Korean revolution will not be smooth even in the period of implementing the new long-term plan but we should take the strategic initiative firmly and remain proactive in making redoubled efforts on full alert in order to bring about marked growth in the might of the Party and the state and provide the people with greater wellbeing, he stressed. -0-

headline: Song Kuk Hyang - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons of 2025
Song Kuk Hyang - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons of 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- Song Kuk Hyang, a woman weightlifter of the April 25 Combat Sports Team in the DPRK, is one of the DPRK's ten best sportspersons of 2025.
She bettered the world and Asian records in the clean and jerk and total in the women's 71kg category of the 2025 Asian Weightlifting Championships, and thus became the best player at the championships. And she won three gold medals and set three new world records in the women's 69kg category of the 2025 IWF World Championships.
Born in Unchon County, South Hwanghae Province, the DPRK, she began to learn weightlifting basic skills at the age of 12.
She proved successful at the 2017 Asian Junior and Juvenile Weightlifting Championship, the 19th Asian Games and other international sporting events.
In particular, she bagged six gold medals at the 2024 Asian Weightlifting Championships and the 2024 IWF World Championships, drawing attention of the weightlifting circles.
People's Athlete Song Kuk Hyang is still training hard with a resolve to live up to the expectation of the country and the people with gold medals. -0-

headline: Fifth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 24 (KCNA) -- The Fifth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held from November 2 to 13, 1970.
At the congress, PresidentKim Il Sungreviewed the historic victory, in which the DPRK turned into a powerful socialist industrial state, and other shining successes achieved in all fields of politics, economy, culture and military affairs. And he set forth the tasks for accelerating the three revolutions, ideological, technological and cultural, to bring earlier the complete victory of socialism.
The President advanced the grand task of the Six-Year Plan for the Development of the National Economy (1971-1976).
The fundamental task of the Six-Year Plan was to consolidate and develop the successes in industrialization and advance the technological revolution to a new high stage so as to further consolidate the material and technical foundations of socialism and liberate the working people from hard labour in all sectors of the national economy.
He also clarified in detail the issue of thoroughly accomplishing the three major tasks of the technological revolution to considerably narrow the disparity between heavy and light labour, and between agricultural and industrial work and to free women from the heavy burden of household chores by launching a widespread technical innovation movement in industry, agriculture and all other sectors of the national economy. And he elucidated the issue of steadily developing the work of transforming the whole society on a revolutionary and working-class pattern by giving definite precedence to the ideological revolution.
The Fifth Congress of the WPK was recorded in the history of the WPK as the one which brought about a great victory in industrialization and opened up a bright prospect of achieving a greater victory. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on Feb. 23.
The message said:
I extend sincere congratulations, on behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, to you on your election as the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
And I offer my felicitations to all the DPRK people on the ongoing successful Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Under the wise leadership of the WPK, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is advancing confidently along the road of building a powerful socialist state, while achieving remarkable successes in bolstering up its defence capabilities and developing science and cutting-edge technology, education and national economy.
The DPRK has firmly stood against ceaseless pressure of the hostile imperialist forces and overcome the arduous hardship caused by it and defended its sovereignty, independence and socialist principle.
80 years ago the peoples of our two countries forged fraternal friendship, shedding blood together in the joint struggle against fascism.
Today we are fighting shoulder to shoulder again against emerging neo-Nazism and the hegemonic forces for aggression, demonstrating to the world the invincible militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK.
The Communist Party of the Russian Federation expresses deep respect for the heroic feats of the DPRK soldiers who displayed bravery and self-sacrificing spirit in the struggle to liberate Kursk from the aggressors, carrying forward the most wonderful tradition of international solidarity.
Their feats represent an excellent inheritance of the militant friendship between the Soviet Union and the DPRK displayed during the Great Patriotic War.
The Communist Party of the Russian Federation highly appreciates the principled stand of the DPRK on the matters of defending the historical truth and ensuring the security of Russia, including its firm support for special military operations aimed to denazify and demilitarize Ukraine.
We attach special importance to the traditional and friendly relations between the two parties and will as ever make a positive contribution to boosting the multifaceted cooperation between the Russian Federation and the DPRK in conformity with the spirit of comprehensive strategic partnership.
I wish you good health and fresh success in your work for leading the great Korean people.
I hope that the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea will bring prosperity, peace and victory of socialist construction to the Korean people and the DPRK and serve as a powerful driving force for accomplishing all the tasks.
Please accept my respects. -0-

Sectional Study and Consultative Meetings of Ninth Congress of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea continues discussion in a responsible manner.
Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other members of the central leadership body of the Party are guiding the study and consultative meetings of various fields including economy, national defence, foreign affairs and Party work.
The consultative meetings, held on Feb. 24, intensified the discussion on the orientation and plans of the work of different sectors and units, on the basis of the essence and spirit of the report on the review of the work of the eighth-term Central Committee of the WPK and the important concluding speech made by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The discussion focused on ensuring the scientific accuracy and innovative nature in applying the general goal and principle of the five-year strategy, set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, to overall socialist construction.
The study and consultative meetings discussed in detail the realistic proposals for achieving gradual and qualitative development while stabilizing and consolidating the foundations for development laid during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee in the key industrial and other sectors of the national economy.
Also discussed were the technical measures to be taken in order for every sector to ensure the unity of action in dynamically pushing forward with the technical upgrading and modernization of major establishments of important significance in substantially and powerfully propelling the work for building the self-supporting national economy, the capital city construction and the regional development policy-oriented construction being carried out as the greatest desire of the Party.
Proposals are being put forward to correctly draw up scientific and reasonable plans guaranteeing the long-term development of different sectors and units, rather than immediate gains, while focusing on steadily improving the goal and standard of creation regarding the leading role of science and technology as the vital one, and to make sure that the implementation of the Party decisions turns into the course of development and creation for strengthening their own internal forces.
Fresh and forward-looking methods of ideological mobilization are being devised to steadily enhance the fighting efficiency and activity of Party organizations at all levels and boost the uplifted spirit of the masses in the struggle for carrying out the new long-term plans.
Fully displayed at the meetings are the extraordinary Party consciousness and high sense of responsibility of the delegates to make each provision of the plan for every sector the most scientific and rational cornerstone for the perfect implementation of our Party's fighting programme, and actively suggested there were innovative and creative opinions conducive to surely guaranteeing the success of the new five-year strategy.
The results of the collective discussion are submitted to the committee for drafting the decision of the Party Congress. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Different Countries

In the congratulatory messages and letters, they extended warm congratulations toKim Jong Unon the occasion of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Referring to the remarkable successes and development made by the Korean people in socialist construction over the past five years since the Eighth Congress of the WPK, they expressed expectation and belief that the Ninth Congress of the WPK would achieve success under the wise leadership ofKim Jong Un.
Meanwhile, the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea received congratulatory messages from the personages of various circles in Georgia, Pakistan, Armenia, Croatia and Poland.
Congratulatory messages were also sent to the Ninth Congress of the WPK from the Central Committee of the People's Party of Cambodia, the National Leadership of the Workers' Party of Mexico, the Central Committee of the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania, the general secretary of the Communist Party of Switzerland and other personages of various political parities and social and economic circles, Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in China, Russia, Romania, Switzerland, the Czech Republic, Britain and Spain. -0-

story_text:

It is the highest honor and boundless happiness of all the officials of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan to hold in high esteem the respected MarshalKim Jong Unagain at the top post of the WPK.
The Chongryon Central Standing Committee in the message said that it would share destiny with the motherly Party and make a tangible contribution to the building of a highly civilized and prosperous nation by firmly defending the dignity and prestige of the DPRK and making purely patriotic devotion, keeping pace with the people in the homeland all out in the new advance for making the pioneering period of overall development of socialism lead on to the greatest-ever upsurges, occasioned by the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Invincible WPK Winning Only Victories by Dint of Ideology
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade public the immortal classic work "Let Us Hasten the Final Victory through a Revolutionary Ideological Offensive" at the Eighth Conference of Ideological Workers of the Workers' Party of Korea on February 25, 2014.
The work is an important document which clarifies the unshakable faith and will of the WPK to hold higher the banner of the theory of giving precedence to ideology in the new era of the Juche revolution by inheriting the history and tradition of the Korean revolution which has advanced by dint of ideology.
The 80-odd-year-long history of the WPK is a history of ideological work in which it has performed world-startling miracles and innovations in the annals of the revolution and construction, overcoming manifold difficulties and trials by dint of ideology.
Kim Jong Unin his work set forth the militant slogan "Let Us Hasten the Final Victory through a Revolutionary Ideological Offensive!" to overcome all difficulties through a great ideological campaign. His wise leadership served as the driving force for a new creation and leap forward across the country.
Holding higher the banner of the Juche-oriented theory of giving precedence to ideology, the DPRK people have ushered in a new era of great changes in politics, economy, defence, education, culture, improvement of the people's living standards and all other fields in the past 10-odd years.
The proud successes and eye-opening events in the country clearly prove the validity and vitality of the Party's line of attaching importance to ideology to bring about the victory of the revolutionary cause of Juche by holding fast to the ideology as an all-powerful treasured sword. -0-

headline: Sixth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The Sixth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held from October 10 to 14, 1980 in the presence of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The Sixth Congress of the WPK was a glorious and significant one which demonstrated at home and abroad that the issue of carrying forward the revolutionary cause of the leader was successfully solved and a sure guarantee for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche was provided.
At the Congress, the President said that modeling the whole society on the Juche idea is the general task of our revolution, and he set it as the fundamental principle to be adhered to in the struggle to model the whole society on the Juche idea to solve all issues arising in the revolution and construction in our own way from the independent and creative standpoint. He also set it as the fundamental way to model the whole society on the Juche idea to thoroughly implement the line of the three revolutions, ideological, technological and cultural.
The Congress clearly defined the revolutionary idea of the President, the Juche idea, as the only guiding idea of the WPK, and clarified the issue of holding fast to the three revolutions- ideological, technological and cultural as the general line of socialist construction. And it clearly expounded the principled issues arising in the Party work and activities as required by the developing reality.
The Congress heldKim Jong Ilin high esteem as member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and secretary of the WPK Central Committee.
The Congress was the one of victors which fully demonstrated the overall victory of the great Juche idea and the invincible might of the WPK, and the historic one which indicated the bright road for the victorious advance of the Korean revolution. -0-
