The delegates adopted with unanimous approval the decision on invariably holdingKim Jong Unin high esteem as general secretary of the WPK, representing the general will of the whole Party.
The venue was filled with the absolute faith and fervent single-minded loyalty that as we hold in high esteemKim Jong Unas the centre of unity and leadership forever, we will always go along the road of justice and truth, our ideal and ambition are sure to be realized and our future will be beautiful and rosy forever.
According to the Party Rules, the general secretary of the WPK becomes a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, a member of the Political Bureau and the chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.
The first enlarged plenary meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK was held at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on February 23.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, presided over the plenary meeting.
The meeting elected the members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau.
Pak Thae Song, Jo Yong Won, Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan were elected members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK.
Elected as members of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee were Pak Thae Song, Jo Yong Won, Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Song Nam, Sin Yong Il, Ri Hi Yong, Ju Chang Il, Jo Chun Ryong, An Kum Chol, Kim Jong Gwan, Kim Sung Du, Choe Son Hui, No Kwang Chol, Kim Song Gi, Kim Tok Hun and Pak Jong Gun.
Kim Yo Jong, Pak Kwang Ung, Han Kwang Sang, Ju Chol Gyu, Jon Hyon Chol, Pak Hun, Ri Chol Man, Ri Yong Gil, Ri Chang Dae, Pang Tu Sop and Kim Chol Won were elected alternate members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK.
The secretaries of the Party Central Committee were elected and the Secretariat was formed.
Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Jong Kyong Thaek, Kim Song Nam, Sin Yong Il, Ri Hi Yong, Ju Chang Il, Jo Chun Ryong, An Kum Chol, Kim Jong Gwan and Kim Sung Du were elected secretaries of the C.C., WPK.
The Central Military Commission of the Party was elected.
Jong Kyong Thaek was elected vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and Jo Chun Ryong, No Kwang Chol, Kim Song Gi, Ri Yong Gil, Pang Tu Sop, Choe Chun Gil, Kim Jong Sik, Yu Kwang U and Ri Chang Ho were elected members of the commission.
The chairman, vice-chairmen and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the WPK were elected.
The plenary meeting discussed the work for the inner-Party structure essentially needed in implementing the Party's political guidance and unanimously approved a relevant decision.
Department directors of the Party Central Committee and chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the Party were appointed.
Commanding officers for the key posts of the KPA were appointed.
The meeting decided to discuss the 2026 work plan for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress, make a joint study of draft decisions reflecting this year's plan at the sectional study and consultative meetings for drawing up a new five-year plan to be carried out in the period of the Party Congress, and bring together opinions to submit them for deliberation at the newly-elected Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee.
It also decided to discuss the agenda item on the revision of the collection of slogans set forth by the Party Central Committee and the handbook on the Party rules and distribute them throughout the Party after the study of the relevant drafts by the members of the Party Central Committee and the deliberation by the Political Bureau.
The plenary meeting decided to examine and adopt a proposal for reshuffling the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly and the Cabinet and refer it to the new-term Supreme People's Assembly.
Kim Jong Unsaid that we are now facing the new five years which will be a part of the glorious Party history and whether or not the ninth-term Party Central Committee fulfills the heavy mission entrusted by the supreme leadership entirely depends on the high sense of responsibility and activity of the members of the Party central leadership. And he added that the members of the Party central leadership should do their utmost to fulfill their heavy and sacred duty with a high sense of the Party spirit, the revolutionary spirit and the spirit of serving the people so as to live up to the deep trust and expectations of the Party members and other people.
The subjective and objective conditions and environment of the Korean revolution will not be smooth even in the period of implementing the new long-term plan but we should take the strategic initiative firmly and remain proactive in making redoubled efforts on full alert in order to bring about marked growth in the might of the Party and the state and provide the people with greater wellbeing, he stressed.
The agenda items and relevant decisions discussed at the first enlarged plenary meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK were submitted to the Congress.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an important concluding speech.
He said that the general analysis at this point of today of the struggle of the past five years has given us an instructive occasion to take a due pride in the fruits of our persevering efforts and clearly understand what are the valuable experiences we should maintain and enrich in the future, the deviations we should put to rights and the lessons we should draw, and to make all the delegates have got an overall understanding of the changes and level of development in socialist construction and Party building in the period under review and a correct estimation of the current corresponding level of development of their fields and units.
He said that the newly elected Ninth Party Central Committee will be faithful to its responsible leadership role true to the high confidence and expectation of all the Party organizations and the entire membership and will work hard to speed up the development of our great state and bring more substantial benefits to our people at an earlier date, and this will bring it a fair and square assessment of its work.
Saying that our socialist construction has been run through with the three revolutions, and it has made progress in the course of the struggle to carry out the line of the three revolutions, he stressed that the great cause of comprehensive development, too, can be carried out much faster and more effectively only when the Party’s guidance and the state’s leading role are strengthened in conducting the three revolutions, and only when the masses of the people are involved in these revolutions with an attitude befitting masters.
He affirmed that just like we did in the past five-year struggle in which we pioneered the era of comprehensive development of socialism, we will completely rely on our internal force, the great might of our people, in the new upcoming five-year struggle and invariably uplift the ideals of "The people are god," single-hearted unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance.
Noting that no challenge or change in situation can delay or check our advance, he ardently called for vigorous struggle to bring earlier the day when our people’s ideals and long-cherished desires will come true by redoubling our enthusiasm and fighting spirit, full of confidence in the future of the socialist cause.
All the delegates responded with stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" to the concluding speech full of revolutionary will and the ardent appeal of the General Secretary who calls on the whole Party to stand in the vanguard of the sacred struggle for bringing about the steady prosperity of our state and the rosy future of socialism.
The sectional study and consultative meetings were held for two days to take correct measures for implementing the new five-year plan and reflect them in the decision of the Congress.
The newly-elected members of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK guided the study and consultative meetings.
Realistic and constructive opinions were actively proposed to ensure that all plans were fully based on feasibility and firmly oriented to laying the foundations for pioneering and prosperity.
The First Meeting of the Political Bureau of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK was held at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee on February 25.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the meeting.
The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK listened to and studied the opinions raised at sectional study and consultative meetings for drafting the decision of the Ninth Party Congress.
The Political Bureau confirmed the amended and supplemented draft decision and decided to submit it to the Party Congress.
The Political Bureau also deliberated the draft decision on the 2026 work plan and adopted it as the decision of the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.
The Political Bureau examined and perfected the draft collection of slogans set forth by the Party Central Committee and the draft handbook on the WPK Rules and decided to distribute them to the whole Party.
The draft decision on the first agenda item deliberated at the Politburo meeting of the Party Central Committee was submitted to the Congress.
Reflected in it were the more innovative goals and tasks for the struggle in all fields including the economy, national defence, culture and state and social control, set up in conformity with the requirements of the times when the socialist construction enters a new higher stage of transformation.
Specified in it are the action programs for all the economic sectors to achieve gradual qualitative development while stabilizing and consolidating the foundations for development laid during the eighth-term of the Party Central Committee, and expand and accelerate the regional development and the creation of rural civilization and steadily promote the people's well-being during the five-year plan for national economic development.
The draft decision also includes the positive and offensive work plans of relevant sectors to expand and strengthen external relations with the building of powerful national defence capabilities and defending of the interests of the state as the basic principle and ensure the immutable keynote of the struggle against the enemy and the fresh and enterprising goals and ways for developing in depth the Party building and work.
The Congress admitted that the draft decision, amended and supplemented on the basis of the wide and in-depth study and discussion of the delegates at the sectional consultative meetings, reflects a new five-year goal with perfect scientific accuracy, practicality, purposefulness and mobilization.
The Ninth Congress of the WPK adopted with unanimous approval a decision "On Thoroughly Carrying out the Tasks Set forth in the Report on the Review of the Work of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK".
The report ofKim Jong Unon the review of the work of the Eighth Party Central Committee and the relevant decision will be published as inner-Party documents and distributed to the Party organizations at all levels.
Kim Jong Unmade a closing address at the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Saying that the current Congress has drawn great interest at home and abroad as it was convened in a period when our socialist construction is being pushed ahead vigorously and the global political situation is experiencing a serious and rapid change, he noted that the millions of our Party members and all other people across the country have extended their loyal and patriotic minds to the Congress, which has made a sacred review of our past arduous yet grand five-year struggle, and their absolute support to its work through a more intense struggle for creation, a labor struggle.
Expressing his gratitude to all the delegates who, on behalf of all the organizations of the Party and all its members, have devoted, as one, sincere, proactive and responsible efforts to conducting successful discussions of the agenda items, he extended his warm thanks to all the Party members, the people across the country and all the service personnel of our army, who have injected great encouragement and strength into the Congress and guaranteed its successful work by dint of their unique disposition of supporting the Party with single-hearted loyalty and steadfastness.
He said that we are now faced again with a serious remolding struggle, a struggle for achieving transformation, which we must surely undergo in the course of advance towards an ideal society in which the independence of the masses of the people has been fully realized, and it is an indispensable struggle for carrying out more formidable tasks and gigantic projects than those we have done up to now but clear is the road ahead of us and definite is our success.
He said that the main idea and main spirit of the Ninth Congress of the WPK is, in a word, to consolidate the successes of the struggle for pioneering the era of comprehensive development and continue to lead them to a greater result.
Fully convinced that, thanks to the soaring revolutionary spirit and undaunted struggle of all the delegates and other members of the Party, the people across the country and the service personnel of the People’s Army, the lines, policies and decisions put forward at this Congress will surely be carried out with credit and a new historic turn will be brought about in the development of our Party and revolution and in socialist construction, he declared the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea closed.
The song "Internationale" was played.
The venue of the Congress was brimming with conviction and confidence that victory and glory are always in store for us, thanks to the wise leadership and sacred revolutionary activities ofKim Jong Un, the outstanding political strategist and great designer of socialist state building who is ushering in a new heyday of the revolutionary cause of Juche and firmly consolidating the eternal foundations for comprehensive national rejuvenation with high sense of responsibility for the destiny of the country and people, the present rejuvenation and the future prosperity.
All the delegates were filled with the revolutionary enthusiasm to devote themselves to fulfilling their duty befitting to the vanguard of the Party who shoulders the destiny of the Party's decision and the successful national rejuvenation, solemnly recollecting the importance of the great revolutionary tasks they pledged before the people to unconditionally carry out at the most important and decisive time in the history of development of the WPK and the DPRK.
An all-people grand march, which is to be launched in the immutable principle of self-sustenance and offensive way under the leadership of the Party Central Committee headed by the great ComradeKim Jong Un, will broadly open up a new proud period of national prosperity surpassing the past five years, with the Party Congress as an accelerated start.
The Ninth Congress of the WPK, recorded in the history as a great review of the arduous struggle and the start of a new journey, will be immortal as a political event that demonstrated the outstanding leadership ability and absolute prestige of the WPK which has always won victories on the road of the Juche revolution, and as a militant banner which powerfully encouraged our state and people to advance towards the brilliant peak of the powerful and highly civilized socialist construction. -0-

headline: Seventh WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 26 (KCNA) -- The 30-odd years from the Sixth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea to its Seventh Congress were the days of grim struggle and at the same time the years of glorious victory for our Party and people.
In the unprecedented period of stern trials when our Republic was the focus of the anti-socialist offensive of the imperialist allied forces, the Party and the people were forced to fight alone against the imperialist allied forces.
Thanks to the wise leadership of the outstanding leader and the might of the single-minded unity of the Party, the people and the army centered on the leader, our country could frustrate the imperialist allied forces' moves to stifle it, defend the gains of the revolution to the last and win proud victories.
The Seventh Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held in Pyongyang with splendor from May 6 to 9, 2016 as a significant one in the new era of the Juche revolution.
In his report on the work of the Party Central Committee at the congress, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uncomprehensively analyzed and reviewed the proud successes and experience gained by the WPK in the revolution and construction under the banner of the Juche idea and the Songun-based revolutionary line in the face of upheavals of history and set forth important tasks for accomplishing the socialist cause of Juche, realizing  the cause of global independence and bringing about a fresh turn in the development of the Party and its work under the banner of great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
The congress discussed and decided the five-year strategy for national economic development (2016-2020).
The Seventh Congress of the WPK was the one of victors and glory which laid a firm foundation for accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche and set a new milestone for completing the socialist cause. It was also the historic congress that powerfully demonstrated the invincible might of the Party which is firmly carrying forward the independent revolutionary line and mode of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, holding in high esteem the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, and set forth the grand goals and fighting programme for building a powerful socialist country. -0-

headline: Receptions Given to Commemorate Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Receptions were held in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Feb. 26 to commemorate the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The venues of the receptions including the Mokran House, the People's Palace of Culture, Okryu Restaurant and Chongryu Restaurant were filled with excitement of the participants who are to advance toward the greater victory with redoubled confidence and optimism, after receiving the new fighting programme for dynamic heyday of the great Party and comprehensive prosperity and development of the state at the glorious Party Congress.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, Jo Yong Won, Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and other members of the ninth-term Party central leadership and the delegates to the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Invited to the receptions were the members of congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China visiting the socialist homeland on the occasion of the Ninth WPK Congress.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Speeches were made at the receptions.
Speakers said that the receptions are of significance as the participants are filled with the honorable mission and will to make steady innovation and advance, as well as their great excitement and joy and high pride of having glorified the Ninth Party Congress as a great watershed for the developing revolution, holding the respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the top post of the WPK.
They referred to their highest honor of standing at the forefront of implementing the Party's decisions with the noble trust and glory of being representatives of the great Party in a new historic period when they will steadily record gigantic and sacred pages in the course of our state and people's struggle.
They called for displaying the high Party spirit, innovative creation traits, professional qualifications and thoroughgoing executive ability in the new struggle, mindful that the revolutionary work should be conducted with the cleanest conscience for the country and the people, absolute responsibility and full dedication.
They stressed that when all delegates think in a forward-looking manner and continue to advance, always placing their mind at the venue of the glorious Congress and raising a high demand by themselves, record-breaking successes and miracles will be made one after another in all sectors, regions and units and the dignity and decisions of the Party Congress will be perfectly defended.
The participants in the receptions toasted the eternal dignity and prosperity of the DPRK, their beloved country, and the dynamic upsurge and success for the comprehensive development of socialism to be surely achieved by their vigorous efforts. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the Ninth WPK Congress on February 26.
The delegates and observers were greatly excited to have a significant photo taken with the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, symbol of all victories of the Korean people and outstanding leader of the Juche revolution, against the background of the venue of the glorious Congress where they invariably held him in high esteem as the general secretary of the WPK.
When General SecretaryKim Jong Unarrived, all the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!", extending the highest glory to him, who has energetically led the WPK to fulfill its historic mission and role as the guiding banner of the socialist cause and as a genuine leading political organization while working heart and soul day and night for national prosperity and the people's well-being.
The General Secretary gave warm encouragement to the participants who displayed the high Party spirit, revolutionary spirit, and initiative and ingenuity in the responsible discussion reflecting the general will of all the Party members and other people, always aware of the deep trust and expectation of their Party organizations and the important mission entrusted by the times and history.
Expressing belief and conviction that all the participants would play a vanguard role in the sacred struggle for the national prosperity and the well-being of the people to carry out the important policy-oriented tasks set forth by the Party Congress, he had a significant photo session with them.
All the delegates and observers made their solemn pledge to fulfill their revolutionary duty as the core of the Party in the honorable struggle for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, true to the ideas and leadership of the Party Central Committee with the faith and will of absolute loyalty, deeply cherishing the noble intention and ardent emotion ofKim Jong Unwho repeatedly places deep trust in them to become the revolutionary vanguard serving the people. -0-

headline: Grand Art Performance Held to Commemorate Ninth Congress of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- A grand art performance was given at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Thursday to commemorate the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The venue of the performance was filled with great joy and excitement of the audience as it would be saturated with all-people praise for and trust in the great Workers' Party of Korea which set a new signpost for the steady prosperity of our state and its advance and leap forward after reviewing with pride the sacred five-year journey that brought about victories and glory through heroic pioneering and indomitable struggle.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other members of the ninth-term Party central leadership, delegates and observers to the Ninth Congress of the WPK, special guests, and members of the congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China.
Put on the stage of the performance, which began with the prelude "Song to the Motherly Party", were songs reflecting the ardent loyalty and reverence of the Korean people and service personnel of the People's Army for the WPK, the great mother to whom they entrust their destinies and future and follow to the last, and famous songs on patriotism.
The performers, through the numbers, paid high tribute to the great exploits of the Party which brought the centuries-old desire of the people into reality and put the prestige and reputation of the country and the people on the highest level in history.
Colorful numbers were filled with the spirit and pride of the DPRK where the Party and people are confidently ushering in a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation favored by the people by breaking through the upheavals of history, united as one organism sharing destinies, intention and affection. They excited the audience to make them feel tender sentiment and boundless joy.
The performance reached the climax with famous songs reflecting the iron truth that only eternal dignity and glory are in store for the DPRK and its people as they are led by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is bringing earlier the bright future of the rich country with a strong army by carrying forward the great unity, advance and victorious tradition as the eternal blood vessel of our revolution.
The performance, that fully displayed the revolutionary enthusiasm and single-hearted devotion to realize all dreams and ideals on the road of following the glorious Party Central Committee, ended with an all-people hymn "Dear Father".
The art performance commemorating the Ninth Congress of the WPK firmly demonstrated the iron faith and mettle of all the Party members and other people to give full play to their loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm in the course of struggle for the great new victory with redoubled self-confidence and vital power by cherishing the boundless glory and pride of invariably upholding the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas the general secretary of the WPK. -0-

headline: Eighth WPK Congress Recorded in History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- The Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea was held in Pyongyang from January 5 to 12, 2021, at a time of key importance in the course of strengthening our Party and building Korean-style socialism.
In his report on the review of the work of the Central Committee of the WPK at the congress, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uncomprehensively analyzed and reviewed in depth the work of the seventh-term Party Central Committee and advanced new lines and strategic and tactical policies for the epochal advance of socialist construction and important tasks for promoting the external relations and strengthening the Party work.
The congress clarified the new five-year plan for national economic development.
It set it as the general orientation of the five-year plan for national economic development to lay a solid foundation for revitalizing the overall national economy and improving the people's standard of living by concentrating efforts on the central link in economic development. headline: Nanhutou Meeting - History of Korean Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- It has been 90 years since the Nanhutou Meeting, recorded in the history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle as a significant meeting that provided a turning point in the Korean revolution.
In the mid-1930s, the Japanese imperialists further intensified their fascist suppression and plunder in Korea while preparing for a war of continental aggression. They pursued the policy of "making Koreans Japanese subjects" more coercively to obliterate the Korean people's consciousness of independence.
Against this backdrop, PresidentKim Il Sungorganized a meeting of military and political cadres of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army in Nanhutou from February 27 to March 3, 1936.
At the meeting he clarified the important tasks facing the Korean revolutionaries and set forth the policy of moving the main force of the KPRA to the border areas and the area of Mt Paektu and gradually extending the theatre of struggle into the homeland and the policy of actively stepping up the preparations for founding a party.
The policies, set forth at the meeting, served as a militant banner that indicated the way for bringing about a great upsurge in the Korean revolution, as required by the prevailing situation and the developing revolution, and a Juche-oriented programme of struggle that clarified the revolutionary way for accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation at an early date by the efforts of Koreans.
The Nanhutou meeting was the one that fully established Juche for the first time in the history of the Korean revolution. Herein lie the historical position and significance of this meeting.
With the meeting as a watershed, the Korean revolution came to greet a new period of upsurge.
The banner of Juche, held high byKim Il Sungat the Nanhutou meeting, served as the driving force that enabled the Korean revolutionaries to firmly maintain the Juche-oriented stand and victoriously advance the revolution and construction not only in the period of the anti-Japanese armed struggle but also in the annals of the Korean revolution. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Message from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez, first secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba, on Feb. 23.
The message said:
Respected Comrade,
I extend the warmest congratulations to you on your reelection as the general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and wish you success in your work and in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress.
The historic relations between our two parties are based on the unbreakable friendship, provided by Supreme Commander Fidel Castro Ruz and the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, and General Raul Castro Ruz and Supreme LeaderKim Jong Il, and we have inherited these relations while working at the top posts of our parties and states.
In this sense, I am recalling with special satisfaction the agreements reached during my visit to Pyongyang in November 2018 and our meeting in the People's Republic of China in September 2025.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I affirm my special will to continue to develop the Party ties in the interest of our two countries and peoples.
Please accept my best regards. -0-

headline: Seminars on Exploits of Chairman Kim Jong Il Held Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Seminars on the exploits of ChairmanKim Jong Iltook place in Nepal, Britain, Italy and Mexico from February 7 to 14 on the occasion of his 84th birth anniversary.
Speeches were made at the seminars attended by personages of political and social circles and masses in relevant countries.
The coordinator of the Organization of Communists of Italy and the chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea praised the undying ideo-theoretical exploits ofKim Jong Iland his Songun leadership exploits, saying that his exploits for the Korean revolution and the cause of building a powerful socialist country will be handed down century after century.
The chairman of the Mexican Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and other speakers laudedKim Jong Ilas a prominent thinker-theoretician, saying that the Juche idea comprehensively systematized by him is still illuminating the road to be followed by the world progressives aspiring after independence and justice.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the seminars held in Nepal and Britain.
Meanwhile, a seminar on the exploits ofKim Jong Ilwas held by the International Alliance of Societies for the Study of the Juche Idea in East European and Central Asian Regions on February 16, his birth anniversary. -0-

The visitors were filled with solemn emotion at the sacred temple of Juche, feeling a high sense of responsibility for their heavy duties as members of the Party central leadership elected by the deep trust and expectation of all the Party members at the Ninth WPK Congress, an important political event in guaranteeing the eternal dignity and development of the WPK.

The members of the Party central leadership solemnly hardened their firm will to fulfill their heavy duty in the responsible journey for brilliantly carrying out the fighting programme of the WPK, closely rallied as one in mind aroundKim Jong Unwho is most loyal to the cause of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism and represents the absolute prestige of the WPK and its matchless mightiness. -0-

In his report on the review of the work of the Central Committee of the WPK at the congress, the respected ComradeKim Jong Uncomprehensively analyzed and reviewed in depth the work of the seventh-term Party Central Committee and advanced new lines and strategic and tactical policies for the epochal advance of socialist construction and important tasks for promoting the external relations and strengthening the Party work.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Pang Kum Sun, a woman centenarian living in Neighbourhood Unit No. 32, Hungun-ri, Yonggwang County, South Hamgyong Province, on her 100th birthday.
As officials of the county, villagers and relatives visited her family to congratulate her, Pang's house was in a festive mood.
Before Korea's liberation, she had to experience the deep sorrow of a stateless nation while suffering from poverty. She could lead a genuine life under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea which provides the DPRK people with an independent and creative life.
After receiving the birthday spread with her great excitement, she extended her gratitude toKim Jong Unfor having shown such warm loving care even for an ordinary old woman who had not done a great thing for the country. -0-

headline: Preparations for New School Year Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 27 (KCNA) -- Educational units at all levels of the DPRK are making preparations for the new school year.
Kanggye University of Education and Sariwon Teacher Training College have prepared all their teachers to give lectures on majors in foreign languages while pushing ahead with the work to create and generalize research-type teaching and studying methods.
Teachers of Sinuiju, Sunchon and Phyongsong colleges of technology have drawn up syllabuses and teaching programmes in conformity with the pedagogical principles and made lecture programs and visual aids with high cognitive effectiveness, with main stress put on improving the level of specialization of students.
Kim Ju Hyok Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District and Munsin Senior Middle School in Tongdaewon District help their teachers improve their qualifications through short courses and pay attention to further updating the labs and fully furnishing them with experimental apparatuses.
Similar successes have been witnessed at Ponghwa Senior Middle School in Pothonggang District, Tongsong Senior Middle School in Central District and Songyo Primary School in Songyo District. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Military-Civilian Meeting and Public Procession
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- A Pyongyang military-civilian meeting and a public procession took place with splendor atKim Il SungSquare on Feb. 27. The participants pledged to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Taking the platform were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and other members of the Party central leadership.
Attending the meeting were the participants in the Ninth Party Congress, officials of ministries and national agencies, officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students in Pyongyang, and members of the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan and the congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China.
Ju Chang Il, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, addressed the meeting.
Thanks to the outstanding guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, our Party and state have glorified their dignity and prestige at the highest level and the people and the service personnel more deeply cherished the spirit of self-respect and self-development and self-confidence in their hearts, he said.
Stressing the basic idea and spirit of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, he said that a decisive guarantee of steadily advancing to the attainment of a far-reaching ideal in the face of challenges and trials lies in thoroughly implementing the five-point requirements of the times for comprehensive development, set forth by the Party Central Committee, under the uplifted banner of the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural -, the general line of the WPK.
He called upon all to redouble their efforts full of patriotic enthusiasm in order to accelerate the dynamic struggle for successful implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK and for prosperity and development of the DPRK, the glorious motherland.
Then speeches were made by Vice-Minister of National Defence Kim Yong Gun and Chairman of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the youth league Jo Chol Jun.
A letter of pledge to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
The public procession began with the playing of the song "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea".
Led by the columns with a float depicting the emblem of the WPK, the columns of marchers marched past the square, holding placards and signboards reading "Let's fully demonstrate the dignity and heroism of our state and people under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un!", "Forever with our Party Central Committee", "Single-minded unity", etc.
The marchers raised the stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" in reflection of their fervent reverence forKim Jong Unwho is demonstrating to the world the great dignity and might of the DPRK.
The square resounded with all-people songs praising the motherly Party and songs of advance representing the times, showcasing the high enthusiasm to concentrate on attaining the goals of the new five-year plan unveiled by the Party Congress, full of conviction in the victory of their idea and cause. -0-

story_text:

Attending the meeting were the participants in the Ninth Party Congress, officials of ministries and national agencies, officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students in Pyongyang, and members of the congratulatory group of Koreans in Japan and the congratulatory group of the General Association of Koreans in China.
Ju Chang Il, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, addressed the meeting.
Thanks to the outstanding guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, our Party and state have glorified their dignity and prestige at the highest level and the people and the service personnel more deeply cherished the spirit of self-respect and self-development and self-confidence in their hearts, he said.
Stressing the basic idea and spirit of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, he said that a decisive guarantee of steadily advancing to the attainment of a far-reaching ideal in the face of challenges and trials lies in thoroughly implementing the five-point requirements of the times for comprehensive development, set forth by the Party Central Committee, under the uplifted banner of the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural -, the general line of the WPK.
He called upon all to redouble their efforts full of patriotic enthusiasm in order to accelerate the dynamic struggle for successful implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK and for prosperity and development of the DPRK, the glorious motherland.

A letter of pledge to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
The public procession began with the playing of the song "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea".
Led by the columns with a float depicting the emblem of the WPK, the columns of marchers marched past the square, holding placards and signboards reading "Let's fully demonstrate the dignity and heroism of our state and people under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un!", "Forever with our Party Central Committee", "Single-minded unity", etc.

The square resounded with all-people songs praising the motherly Party and songs of advance representing the times, showcasing the high enthusiasm to concentrate on attaining the goals of the new five-year plan unveiled by the Party Congress, full of conviction in the victory of their idea and cause. -0-

headline: Short Course Given for Participants in Ninth Congress of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- There took place a short course for the participants in the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on February 27.
Lecturers were Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, and Ju Chang Il, secretary of the WPK Central Committee.
The short course dealt with the methodological and practical issues arising in making sure that the participants in the Ninth Party Congress, including the newly elected members of the Party Central Leadership, deeply grasp the idea and spirit of the Congress and fulfill their core and vanguard role in implementing the decisions of the Congress.
The lecturers called on all the participants in the Congress to make bolder efforts in the vanguard of the great struggle for national prosperity-oriented pioneering and transformation and work hard to pave a new avenue toward comprehensive prosperity of socialism, indicated by the Congress, so as to surely guarantee the successful implementation of the tasks for the gigantic struggle.
They underlined the need for the participants in the Congress to become the core and backbone in upholding the ideology and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, regarding it as their first mission and sacred duty to more thoroughly establish the Party Central Committee's unified leadership system.
They called for making the masses' inexhaustible spiritual strength and ever-soaring loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm result in the implementation of the Party decisions by giving definite priority to the political work and making fundamental innovations in the work of the sectors and units under their charge, while firmly maintaining the position and attitude of giving priority to the interests of the Party and the state.
The short course urged the participants to bring about sure progress and leaps forward by drawing up step-wise, annual plans for implementing the decisions of the Party congress in the manner of ensuring their development-oriented nature and scientific accuracy on the basis of a correct calculation of the specific situation and circumstances of the sectors and units under their charge and by giving full play to the working spirit and traits of self-reliance and self-sustenance.
The lecturers appealed to the participants to bring about substantial successes and actual changes awaited and welcomed by the people by making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people in the whole course of the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress, true to the intention of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmaking devoted service for the people's wellbeing.
They underscored the need for all provinces, cities and counties to more meticulously organize their work in order to make sure that the model establishments for regional development, built by much effort of the Party, tangibly contribute to the material and cultural life of the people, preserve regional features in developing economy and design and push ahead with the undertakings for the wellbeing of the people in a bold and big way.
The short course stressed the importance of the issue for the officials to give top priority to the work for improving the people's living standards, regarding the Party's outlook on people as a firm principle.
Through the short course, the participants deeply cherished the noble intention of the Party Central Committee to hasten the prosperity and development of our great state and bring more substantial benefits to the people as early as possible, invariably holding aloft the banner of struggle and progress - the idea of "The People Are God", the single-minded unity and self-reliance.
They were all filled with great enthusiasm to fully discharge their responsibility and display experienced leadership ability and high executive faculty in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress by single-mindedly and faithfully upholding the ideology and leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Salt Industry Sector Achieves Successes in New Year Salt Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Workers of the salt industry sector in the DPRK have achieved successes in salt production in the new year.
The Kwangryangman Salt Works has pushed ahead with the maintenance and updating of equipment such as water pump and electric motor and took measures to supply electricity based on natural energy, thus increasing production.
The Kwisong Salt Works built maintenance base to secure necessary materials and parts and is solving technical problems arising in raising salinity at evaporating ponds.
The Namyang Salt Works and the Kumsong Salt Works are ensuring full-capacity operation of vibrating compactors and salt loaders and directing efforts to expanding transport capacity and improving the efficiency of water circulation system.
The Nampho Salt Works, the Namsi Salt Works and other units are increasing output of salt per square meter while improving its quality. -0-

headline: 39th Science and Technology Festival of Kim Il Sung University
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The 39th Science and Technology Festival ofKim Il SungUniversity took place in the DPRK from February 25 to 27.
Presented to the festival on the theme "Steady increase of sci-tech power" were hundreds of valuable sci-tech achievements conducive to the economic development and the improvement of people's living standards.
The festival was held in the forms of presentation and exhibition of sci-tech achievements, exhibition contests among units and exchange of new technologies, divided into six panels including key industry, agriculture, IT and land and environment protection.
During the exhibition, new technologies and experience were shared and transferred through positive exchanges including sci-tech forum and question-and-answer session, and new research themes and directions were selected.
The rotating pennants and certificates were conferred on the units and participants who won a high appreciation. -0-

headline: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Held to Commemorate Ninth WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Youth and students had an evening gala atKim Il SungSquare on Friday.
Among the spectators were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and other members of the central leadership of the Party, the participants in the Ninth Congress of the WPK, and members of the congratulatory groups of Koreans in Japan and the General Association of Koreans in China, and Pyongyang citizens.
The evening gala of youth and students began amid the playing of the song "Dear Father".
The youth and students danced to the tune of songs such as "Cheers of the People" with deep reverence for the WPK which is bringing about steady prosperity of the DPRK and bringing its people's dreams and ideals into reality by dint of great strength of ideology and unity.
Beautifully decorating the nocturnal sky over the capital city were the fireworks of various colors representing the high self-confidence of the youth vanguard, who are glorifying the most glorious era of the Juche revolution.
The atmosphere of the evening gala was revved up as the song "Young People, Forward Following the Party" demonstrating the strong spirit of the passionate youth writing a new chapter of history of transformation in the vanguard of the general advance as befits the masters of the dignified youth power was sung along with a flag dance.
Fireworks were set off amid the playing of the song "We Are Koreans", redoubling the conviction that only the immortal victory and glory are always in store for Juche Korea advancing under the leadership of the Party. -0-

headline: Birth Anniversary of Chairman Kim Jong Il Celebrated Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Meetings were held in Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, Iceland and Finland from Feb. 13 to 16 in celebration of the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Present there were personages of political parties and organizations and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in those countries.
There were speeches at the meetings.
The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway said that HEKim Jong Ilbuilt the Workers' Party of Korea into a powerful revolutionary party of Juche with his outstanding leadership and laid a solid foundation for building a powerful socialist country.
The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association praisedKim Jong Ilas a great revolutionary who devoted his whole life to the Korean revolution and the cause of global independence and praised his energetic ideological and theoretical activities and Songun-based leadership exploits.
The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association praised the great ComradeKim Jong Ilas a strong leader of the revolution who firmly defended and developed Juche-oriented socialism by leading the DPRK in the period of unprecedentedly severe trials.
The international secretary of the Finnish Communists' League, the chairperson of the Society for the Promotion of the Relations between Austria and the DPRK and the chairperson of the Iceland-DPRK Friendship Association praisedKim Jong Ilas an extraordinary thinker-theoretician, peerless statesman, military genius and a person enjoying ardent reverence of all people, and explained in detail about the history of his immortal revolutionary leadership.
Congratulatory messages to the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the meetings. -0-

headline: Ragwon County Offshore Farm Produces Hundreds of Tons of Scallops and Seaweed
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- The Ragwon County Offshore Farm, built as a new iconic offshore farm, has produced a large amount of scallops and seaweed.
Since its inauguration, hundreds of tons of scallops and seaweed have been produced by its employees.
The proud reality in Ragwonpho is a clear demonstration of the validity and vitality of the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea on regional development to strengthen the independent foundations of the regional economy and improve the material life of regional people by developing the fishing industry in the coastal cities and counties.
Employees of the offshore farm are boosting the production by actively conducting fishing by creating an artificial fish bank and making use of favorable conditions for attracting a large number of migratory fishes in the culture grounds. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Gifts to Major Leading Cadres
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on February 27 met with major leading cadres and military commanding officers at the headquarters building of the Party Central Committee and gave them gifts he specially prepared.
After presenting a new-type sniper’s rifle to each of them, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid:
"Over the past five years, you have remained faithful to the historic mission and duty entrusted to you by the Party and the revolution and by the country and the people.
Greeting the Ninth Congress of the Party, I personally prepared special presents for you.
As was already made public, this new-generation sniper’s rifle our Academy of Defence Science developed and produced is really a wonderful weapon.
These presents represent my appraisal of your extraordinary devotion for the country and the people and an expression of my absolute trust in you.
I hope that you will, in the future too, discharge your official duties in a responsible manner for the victorious advance of our cause. "
The meaningful gifts were presented to the members of the WPK Central Military Commission, major commanding officers of the armed forces of the DPRK, commanders of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army and commanding officers of guard units, Jo Yong Won and Kim Jae Ryong, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Yo Jong, director of the General Affairs Department of the WPK Central Committee, and other leading cadres.
Kim Jong Unpersonally awarded the relevant certificates to them one by one.
The leading cadres patted the gifts reflecting his great expectation and trust, greatly pleased to receive the gifts bearing special meaning from him beyond their expectation.
ThenKim Jong Unspent his time with the leading cadres, enjoying shooting with the rifles at a firing range.
He had a photo session with the leading cadres that day.
The cadres, who received special gifts from him, made a pledge of single-minded loyalty to add glory to their worthwhile life as the very loyalists who support and defend the country and the people without an inch of deflection or deviation, deeply cherishing his deep trust and expectation. -0-

Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) -- Foreign personages paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in their countries on the occasion of the 84th birth anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Personages of political parties, organizations and institutions in different countries including the People's Socialist Party of Mexico, the Mexico-Korea Solidarity Committee, the Ethiopian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism, the Addis Ababa Youth Association of Ethiopia and the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center in China laid flower baskets and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the art pieces depicting them standing together and paid tribute to them.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Officers and Soldiers of Parade Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 28 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, on Feb. 27 met the officers and soldiers of units of the Korean People's Army at all levels who fully demonstrated the absolute support of the DPRK armed forces and all the people for the WPK's fighting programme and their confidence in sure victory by showcasing their vigorous stride in the military parade commemorating the Ninth WPK Congress.
The square was filled with great joy and excitement of the participants in the military parade who enjoyed the greatest privilege of making a vigorous stride of the revolutionary army of the WPK on the track of the glorious advance, indicated by the historic Party Congress, and then came to get the immense love and encouragement from the great brilliant commander.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived, a stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" resounded far and wide.
He was greeted with respect by senior officials of the Ministry of National Defence and the commanding officer of parade units.
All the participants extended highest glory to the great brilliant commander who is adding luster to the honor and reputation of the Korean People's Army by ensuring that a grand military parade was held at an important time when a watershed in the history of the WPK coincides with the new start of another stage.
Warmly acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers,Kim Jong Ungave a salute to the officers and soldiers of the parade units who demonstrated their absolute loyalty to the orders and instructions of the Party and the heroic fighting spirit as the honorable representative and symbol of the KPA and further convinced everyone of the victory in our cause that will be accelerated by the vanguard and core role of the revolutionary armed forces.
He said that the outstanding role and valuable feats of our army, which no one else could play or perform in place of them, in the crucial courses, every step of which determined our sovereignty and the destiny of the revolution, served as a powerful driving force that has pushed the Korean revolution straight in one direction indicated by the Party. It is the strongest power and great pride of our Party to have such invincible armed forces, the elite ranks of patriotic loyalty that share destiny, intention and will, ideal and aspirations with our Party, he added.
He met the officers and soldiers who participated in the military parade commemorating the Party Congress with brilliant military feats of demonstrating to the world the honor of the country in the overseas military operations. And he asked about the recovery of health of the wounded soldiers, warmly encouraging them to continue their dynamic march of patriotism and loyalty for the Party, the revolution, the country and the people in the future, too.
Today, our army is entrusted with a historic mission and responsibility, more important and heavier than ever before, he said, adding that it should continue to reliably play the leading role in our great era by displaying its great heroism, strong mettle and fighting spirit, with which it made the impossible the possible, in all theaters of grand struggle indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
He expressed expectation and belief that the new dynamic march the KPA bravely started with the military parade at the square of victory would be filled with proud feats and fame.
At the end of the photo session, all the participants, who received his great trust and warm encouragement, broke into stormy cheers, chanting slogans of "Kim Jong Un" and "Death-defying defence".
The participants in the military parade were full of militant enthusiasm to wage a dynamic struggle for achieving a new great victory, further demonstrating the dignity and honor of the guardian of the most just cause, state and people under the leadership of the Party Central Committee. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Co-presidents of Nicaragua
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and supreme commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Daniel Ortega Saavedra and Rosario Murillo, co-presidents of the Republic of Nicaragua, on Feb. 23.

headline: Folk Customs of DPRK Seen in March
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, March is a time when spring has fairly set in.
In March there are Kyongchip and Chunbun, ones of the 24 seasonal divisions of the year in the lunar calendar. Kyongchip means a time in which insects spending the winter sleeping under the ground start to move in surprise of the melting of ice, thunder and rain. Chunbun means the middle of the spring. At that time, the length of the day and the night is about the same. In this period, the weather is mild and the frozen land is completely melted.
From olden times, the Korean people have repaired fences and walls at their houses and cleaned up them and their surroundings to clear the traces of winter before starting farming in those periods.
In the periods, they would make delicious dishes with fresh herbs, typically pickpurse and giant garlic.
And they have gathered various medicinal herbs to use as drugs, while enjoying peasant dances with their hope that farming would be good for a year.
Kyongchip and Chunbun fall on March 5 and 20 respectively this year. -0-

headline: Senior Officials of Cities and Counties in DPRK Visit Samgwang Livestock Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- The chief secretaries of city and county committees of the Workers' Party of Korea and the chairpersons of city and county people's committees across the DPRK, who have launched a new journey for another qualitative leap forward for the comprehensive socialist construction after receiving the fighting strategy set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, on Feb. 28 visited the Samgwang Livestock Farm under the North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee turned into a modern stockbreeding base.
Thanks to the far-reaching plan and energetic leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto turn all the rural areas of the country into rich and civilized ones good to live in and work, Samgwang-ri has undergone a dramatic change to clearly show the new level of Korean-style rural civilization and the orientation of development of the animal husbandry.
The senior city and county officials, who arrived at the farm with great interest and expectation, were greatly impressed by the view of the ideal modern village which has been wonderfully built as a model of the rural construction and the development of animal husbandry in the new era.
Being briefed on the fact that all the requirements of the Party for the modernization of animal husbandry have been met in the whole course of production and management activities, the visitors went round various places of the farm including the first branch, protected cultivation floor and milk production ground.
Looking round the production facilities where all the factors for the development of animal husbandry have been perfectly introduced, they learned in depth the orientation and ways to build new stockbreeding bases in conformity with the characteristics and conditions of their regions, push ahead with modernization of existing facilities and radically increase the production of livestock products.
They realized once again the validity and vitality of the Party's policy, listening to the producers and technicians who are working in modern and civilized environment where advanced methods such as raising animals indoors regardless of the seasonal influence were introduced in raising grass-eating domestic animals and milk production and production processes were put on an automated and modern basis.
The beautiful scenery of Samgwang-ri, where modern dwelling houses, hospital, cultural hall, neighborhood-serving amenities and other public facilities are in good harmony with the natural environment to present a new appearance of the mountain village, gave the visitors a clearer understanding of the new standards and goals of the rural construction of our own style.
Through the visit, the senior officials keenly realized that the new era of regional development opened on this land can lead to the promotion of the wellbeing of the regional people and the comprehensive national rejuvenation only when they conduct the construction work in the relevant areas in a revolutionary way with scientific, innovative and prospective insight and plan.
They were full of revolutionary enthusiasm to fulfill their duties in the struggle for implementing the important tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK, hardening their determination and will to powerfully propel the regional development to a higher stage, true to the plan and intention of the great Party Central Committee. -0-

story_text:

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 1 (KCNA) -- The educational sector in the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work to improve the educational level of schools in rural areas and the academic level of local universities.
Competent teachers of central-level universities such asKim Il SungUniversity and Kim Chaek University of Technology and provincial-level universities conducted a number of practical courses on the spot or through video-conferences for local universities.
At the same time, they disseminated numerous teaching data and latest sci-tech information and co-wrote dozens of kinds of textbooks. Through the process, they played a great role in improving the qualifications of teachers of local universities.
The Central Teaching Institute and some educational units in Pyongyang conducted the work to assist in education of schools in the countryside and mountainous areas. The instructors of provincial teaching institutes and city and county teachers' retraining institutes and the excellent teachers of urban schools went to schools in rural areas and mountainous areas to improve the qualifications of teachers and students' abilities through training courses, class demonstrations, inspections of classes and discussions on teaching.
As a result, there has been a significant improvement in the qualifications of many rural school teachers and the educational level of thousands of rural schools throughout the country in recent years.
Meanwhile, Kim Hyong Jik University of Education and other universities launched the work to improve the practical ability of final-year students for teaching majors in diverse forms and by various methods. This led up to the competition among the universities and colleges in the capital city and local areas. As a result, progress has been made in raising the educational level of regional teacher-training universities and colleges to the level of those in the capital city. -0-

She set three new world records in the women's 63 kg category at the 2025 IWF World Championships and became a twice world champion.
She, born in Waudo District of Nampho Municipality, has been trained as a promising player at Central Sports School from the age of 11.
She showed her ability as a "powerful woman" in various international games, including the 2018 Asian Junior and Juvenile Weightlifting Championships.
She set one new world record and won three gold medals at the 2023 IWF Grand Prix. And at the 2024 IWF World Championships, she set two new world records and took a world championship of women's 64 kg category.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Sangwon Cement Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 2 (KCNA) -- The historic Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea unfolded a grand plan to further expand the construction work for the comprehensive development of the state and the promotion of the welfare of the people throughout the country during the new long-term plan and ardently appealed to all the relevant units, including building-materials production bases, to bring about a surge in production, surpassing the one of the past five years.
The Sangwon Cement Complex, which has faithfully repaid the Party's trust with the proud increased cement production decades after decades, is seething with the revolutionary enthusiasm and will to fulfill its honorable mission and vanguard role in the grand struggle for glorifying the ninth term of the Party Central Committee with steady advance and leap forward.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on March 1 paid a congratulatory visit to the Sangwon Cement Complex advancing under the banner of the patriotic movement for increased production and encouraged its workers in the new struggle to implement the decisions of the Party Congress.
He was accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and other senior officials of the C.C., WPK.
All the employees of the complex were filled with great emotion and joy as they came to have the dreamlike honor of receiving the great father, whom they had always desired to meet in the days of making new innovations and new miracles to glorify the era of great transformation, at their complex before others soon after the historic Party Congress.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived, they raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Looking up toKim Jong Un, all the participants extended their boundless thanks to him for always placing the workers of the complex before anyone else in his mind and repeatedly bestowing the great trust and love on them so that they can continue to perform feats in the vanguard of the heroic struggle.
Kim Jong Unwas courteously greeted by manager Yun Jae Hyok and other leading officials of the complex.
He extended warm encouraging greetings to the workers of the complex full of the extraordinary determination and enthusiasm to uphold the grand construction plan, set forth by the Party Congress, with eye-opening success in the cement production.
Kim Jong Unmade a significant speech of encouragement.
Telling his inmost thought to visit the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex first soon after the Ninth Party Congress, he offered high tribute to the history of development of the Sangwon Cement Complex and all its workers that have maintained an invariable attitude in providing faithful support to our Party’s resolute choice and made a tangible contribution to its implementation over the past five years, the period of really great difficulties, and that have written wonderful records of loyalty and patriotism alone since it went online.
There are a number of large and important enterprises in our country, but none of them has such a group of staunch and militant workers as the Sangwon workers, he said, highly appreciating the 40-odd-year history of the complex in which it has added luster to its name as the powerful enterprise that is able to do anything, in particular, the success of the complex which has strongly supported through practical cement production the Party's plan of achieving remarkable progress and overall upsurge in socialist construction, and opened up the greatest heyday of operation since its inauguration by expanding its production capacity and making ceaseless efforts for increased production, during the years of the eighth term of the Party Central Committee.
Supporting the Party and the country with boundless loyalty, aspiring after unlimited and daring innovation, and consistently prioritizing science and technology--this is the key to the complex's leaping forward and it is a formula for the increasing production achieved by our workers and also for the development of our times, he said. And he affirmed that the soaring patriotic enthusiasm and mettle for increased production, which the Sangwon workers display in making continuous innovation and advance, would constitute an absolute support for our Party's ideology and cause, and that it would be a torch inspiring the whole country to a heroic struggle.
Expressing firm belief that the complex will continue to glorify the honorable history and traditions of Sangwon, which has been a constant source of great strength and reliance for our Party,Kim Jong Unardently called on all its employees to make dynamic advance, rising up as one again for our great motherland while displaying to the full the Korean people's dauntless spirit and wisdom.
When he finished his speech, all the participants broke into cheers with great excitement, looking up to him who highly appreciated them and expressed great expectation that they would invariably become the standard-bearer in carrying out the new long-term plan.
Kim Jong Unvisited the central control room to learn about the cement production.
Praising the complex for registering high production results every month this year, the first year of carrying out the new five-year plan, he said that he still remembers the plenary meeting in December 2024 when the complex pledged before the Party to solve the most pending cement problem through increased production. It is a great encouragement to the Party and the state and their pride to have such warm and sincere patriotic loyalists who are ready to understand the Party's distress and the country's conditions before anyone else and devote themselves to their solution, a large contingent of ardent revolutionaries who regard the Party's plan as just rated capacity and unconditionally translate the Party's determination into reality, he added.
Noting that the complex has a more gigantic task to carry out during the ninth-term of the Party Central Committee and the whole country seething with transformation places its hope on the complex, he stressed that the complex should bring about a dynamic upsurge by dint of self-reliance based on advanced science and technology while giving full play to the inexhaustible spiritual power of the masses in all work in conformity with the immutable truth that the reserves for increased production depends on the mind of producers and as intended by the Party which attaches absolute importance to the ideological resource among the three resources of the revolution.
He had a photo session with the labor innovators, persons of merits and officials in commemoration of his visit to the complex.
When the photo session was over, the participants raised the stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" in reflection of their pledge of loyalty to the great ComradeKim Jong Unwho kindled the flames of vigorous struggle at the complex before others to arouse the whole country to attaining the new long-term goal.
Kim Jong Unkept waving back for a long time to the enthusiastically cheering crowds.
Cherishing the unshakable faith that the trust of the Party Central Committee is the life of the complex, the motive power of increased production and leap forward and the guarantee for sure victory and their heavy responsibility on behalf of the times and the revolution, all the workers, technicians and officials of the complex vowed to work more courageously and vigorously to attain the grandiose goal set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, displaying the redoubled strenuous spirit and power of execution. -0-
