headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Sangwon Cement Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 2 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the Sangwon Cement Complex.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrades,
Reliable workers and officials of the Sangwon Cement Complex, who are a source of pride and strength for the country and its most revolutionary force,
As I saw the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea end with success and have to launch a new struggle now, you were the first to come across my mind. I truly wanted in my mind all the time during the Congress, while recollecting the past five-year struggle, to offer my special thanks to you. As I have longed to see you, I am here at your enterprise as the first of my visits after the end of the Congress.
Over the past five years, the period of really great difficulties, you have maintained an invariable attitude in providing faithful support to our Party's resolute choice and made a tangible contribution to its implementation. Your good deeds deserve nationwide publicity and everybody's tribute.
Great records are to be found in each chapter of the chronicles of the past five years when our socialist construction was marked with unprecedented upsurges and transformations. They surely include the unbounded devotion and sincere efforts of you, Sangwon workers, and the whole country should have a deep understanding of this.
At the moment not a few people know the Sangwon cement is excellent, and yet few people know how hard you, Sangwon workers, are working.
Comrades,
Seeing you, enthusiastic and militant workers, here at this moment is good enough for me to feel the high spirit of the powerful working class who are the main driving force of the revolution.
First of all, I would like to offer my tribute to the history of development of the Sangwon Cement Complex that has written wonderful records of loyalty and patriotism alone since it went online, and extend my warmest greetings to all the workers of the complex.
Comrades,
There are a number of large and important enterprises in our country, but none of them has such a group of staunch and militant workers as you, my dear Sangwon workers.
A powerful enterprise which carries out, not by mere words or pledges but through practical production results and increased production, whatever the Party intends or plans to be done, an enterprise that is able to do anything it decides to do--this is the honorable appellation which can be identified in the whole history of the Sangwon Cement Complex spanning over 40 years.
In particular, during the years of the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, the complex strongly supported through practical cement production the Party's plan of achieving remarkable progress and overall upsurge in socialist construction, and opened up the greatest heyday of operation since its inauguration by expanding its production capacity and making ceaseless efforts for increased production.
As a matter of fact, the epochal events that threw the whole country into excitement year by year for the past five years, the time of great changes, were all associated with this complex.
In 2025, the last year in implementing the five-year plan, the Sangwon workers, in hearty response to the militant call of the Party, held up the torch of increased production and injected great vigor into each of the projects for socialist construction, thus doing an outstanding service for a proud review of the fighting tasks set by the Party.
Devoted efforts were made leading to amazing achievements in the grand construction projects that brought about radical changes in the capital city and provinces and to the erection of numerous structures that bring greater wellbeing to the people and serve them as guide to civilization in the new era. What comes to my mind as the most memorable of all the priceless efforts is the unusually hard work of the Sangwon workers.
At the theatres of creation and construction across the country the Sangwon Cement Complex stood not in the rear but in the forefront, and it played the active role of the vanguard, surpassing the mission of supporter.
With the Eighth Party Congress as the starting point, the complex increased its cement production volume to a level that was much higher than what it had ever produced to the maximum, and this was something it could not expect to achieve a decade ago. The complex has since exceeded the peak-year level on an annual basis, helping us move forward step by step with greater confidence and opening up possibilities for successfully carrying out huge projects. This cannot be called otherwise than a heroic exploit.
Thanks to such active support rendered by the workers of the complex, our Party could adopt policies with a view to achieving epochal transformations and expand their scope, and along with the miraculous achievements made in the construction sector, it could expect to see the fruits of the revolution ripening year after year.
Comrades,
The spirit, work style and traditions of Sangwon hold the secret to our development.
Supporting the Party and the country with boundless loyalty, aspiring after unlimited and daring innovation, and consistently prioritizing science and technology--this is the key to the complex’s leaping forward and it is a formula for the increasing production achieved by our workers and also for the development of our times.
Even when they were believed to have reached the final limits that could not be broken, the workers of the complex achieved a new breakthrough for increased production by dint of extraordinary mental power and science.
They are so faithful and sincere that, upon being given a new task for increased production, they understood that the added numbers were an indication of the Party's decision to plan and prepare for another massive transformation; they are so indomitable and creative that they pledged to implement any challenging task unconditionally and carried it out without fail as the country and the revolution required them to do so. Such are the workers at the Sangwon Cement Complex, so the air in Sangwon is always fresh and no enterprise can surpass it in terms of militant efficiency and capability.
In order to successfully carry out the tasks entrusted to them by the Party, all the workers and officials of the complex set increasingly high standards ideologically and spiritually, and in technical and practical terms and work hard to meet them. This is a manifestation of their purest and most intense loyalty to the Party and the state.
Witnessing the reality that the workers here committed themselves to increasing production and their soaring spirit spread across the country to raise fierce flames for a series of new innovations, I was deeply moved and filled with pride in having really excellent workers.
As honorable paragons and precious models of our times, they have taken on the role of the country's eldest sons by themselves to defend the Party and the revolution and advance our cause; their stout spirit and redoubled efforts are a constant source of strength for our Party.
I, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, extend my warm thanks once again to all the workers, technicians and officials of the Sangwon Cement Complex for making effort to achieve continued upsurge and innovations to exalt the great honor of our country and for demonstrating the might of the Korean working class and the mettle of our advancing socialism.
Comrades,
After conducting a great review of our arduous struggle, we have set higher ideals and ambitions for new development and made bigger strides to start our new journey for the future. This journey demands that our working class, the major force of socialist construction, perform a heavier, more important mission.
We have a mountain of bigger and tougher tasks to do for the prosperity and development of our country, for the wellbeing of our people and for the bright future of our younger generations. The Sangwon Cement Complex's pioneering position and role in carrying out these tasks can be said to be absolute.
This is a place that represents the spirit of the indomitable Korean people and embodies the potentials of our country, which is transforming and developing ceaselessly without recognizing any impossibility. Today, as I am here, I have been fully convinced that a new stage of our revolution will be brought to a successful completion, and I have also reconfirmed that the decisive guarantee for it--a powerful driving force of our struggle--has been firmly secured.
The soaring patriotic enthusiasm and mettle for increased production, which the Sangwon workers display in making continuous innovation and advance, will constitute an absolute support for our Party's ideology and cause, and this will be a torch inspiring the whole country to a heroic struggle.
The Party and the government value the Sangwon Cement Complex's production results as the most important strategic index for the development of the state; the more actively this complex supports them and the bigger progress it makes, the greater vitality our struggle will gain.
Workers and officials of the Sangwon Cement Complex,
I believe that you will continue to glorify the honorable history and traditions of Sangwon, which has been a constant source of great strength and reliance for our Party.
Let us all display to the full the Korean people's dauntless spirit and wisdom in the new struggle to add eternal glory to our beloved country and translate the people's long-cherished desires into reality.
I am in firm belief that you, Sangwon workers, will share one purpose with me, as you have done so far, for the prosperity and development of the country.
Thanks to your devotion and efforts, this country will surely advance forward, achieving dynamic transformations day after day, just as before.
I am completely certain of this.
I would like to extend my warm greetings to all of you, Sangwon workers, as I ask you once again to play your due role, which no one else can perform, and work hard for the prosperity and development of the country and for the wellbeing of the people.
I hope that victory and glory are always in store for this admirable enterprise in its sacred struggle as it embodies everything of our heroic working class.
Comrades,
Let us make an all-out effort again for the good of our great country and advance forward vigorously. -0-

headline: Customs of Korean People on First Full Moon Day - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 2 (KCNA) -- Among the folk holidays enjoyed by the Korean people is the first full moon day (January 15th of the lunar calendar).
From olden times, the Korean people have held various ceremonial events reflecting their desire for the new year's fortune and rich harvest.
Typical of them are a game of hanging crops on a long pole and enjoying the full moon.
There was a custom of composting fields early in the morning that day.
On the evening of the day, people irrespective of age or sex enjoyed the full moon on high mountains or hills in their villages, having pleasant talks.
Children played folk games like a game of pursuit, going to the place of enjoying the moon, and sang songs, enjoying the moon.
Special dishes of the day are boiled rice admixed with four other staple cereals and dishes made of nine kinds of dried edible herbs.
On the morning of the day, they drank ear-quickening wine.
Customs of the Korean people on the first full moon day were registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2014. -0-

headline: Fishing Boat Repair in Winter Completed
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 2 (KCNA) -- Fishery units in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are speeding up the preparations to go out fishing after completing the winter repairs to fishing boats.
The officials and workers of fishing units in the province repaired the fishing boats more than 10 days earlier than last year and are securing the fishing implements and materials necessary for fishing in spring.
The Haeju Fishery Station has drawn up a scientific plan for repairing fishing boats and taken measures to overcome the effects of changing weather conditions.
The Pupho Offshore Farm finished the hull repair ahead of schedule by speeding up processing and assembly while doing the technical management of equipment in a responsible manner.
It organized a scientific and technological study so that all fishermen can use advanced fishing methods and has pushed ahead with the work to make more effective use of a fish detector.
Progress is also being made in securing or repairing fishing implements and providing the supplies necessary for fishing. -0-

headline: Trade Union Officials Make Study Tour of Mt Paektu Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- Trade union officials from across the DPRK made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from February 24 to March 2.
The members of the study tour group left Hyesan and arrived at Pochonbo. They went round the command post of the Battle of Pochonbo, the police sub-station, the sub-county office, etc. and toured the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site and the Samjiyon Revolutionary Battle Site.
They walked into the Sobaeksu Valley, fluttering the national flag of the DPRK and the flag of the study tour group. At the headquarters log cabin and ChairmanKim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, they recollected the noble revolutionary careers of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
They looked round the trees bearing slogans preserved in the forests.
They climbed Mt Paektu.
Then they went round Mupho Bivouac, the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area, the Sinsadong Revolutionary Battle Site, etc.
Trade union officials and members from across the country held an oath-taking meeting before the statue ofKim Jong Ilin Samjiyon City on March 2.
All the participants vowed to carry thorough the important tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand thus contribute to the prosperity and development of the great DPRK.
During the study tour, trade union officials camped in forests and conducted colorful political and cultural activities like the anti-Japanese guerrillas and visited the Samjiyon Revolutionary Museum, the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory, etc. -0-

headline: Grand Art Performance Continues in DPRK
Pyongyang Old People's Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- On the bank of the picturesque River Taedong in Pyongyang, there is the Pyongyang Old People's Home, a Korean-style structure with a crane-shaped roof.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unpersonally initiated the construction of the splendid Pyongyang Old People's Home and provided meticulous guidance on all things ranging from designing to supply of materials.
The health-seekers at the home would say that all things, including rush mats in floor-heated rooms, soft Korean cushions and clothes chests, are associated with the warm paternal affection of General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
People are deeply moved to hear that the old persons eat all kinds of early fruits and receive new clothes from the state.
Health-seekers have frequently visited the children of Pyongyang Orphanage and Pyongyang Baby Home, both of which are located near the old people's home, and enjoyed cultural and emotional life while cultivating flowers at the fine hydroponic greenhouse of the home. All the old persons at the home say that they are the happiest as they enjoy tasty and nutritious healthy dishes.
Whenever seeing the happy looks of those old persons, people would recall with deep emotion the January 15th of the lunar calendar in 2015.
That day,Kim Jong Unvisited the then Pyongyang Municipal Old People's Home under construction and gave precious instructions on the construction of the home.
He paid close attention to such issues as building in a good harmony the rooms with floor-heating system and beds, supplying the tiles appropriate for floors at washrooms and bathhouse, and building a vegetable garden and a greenhouse for their healthy work.
Even on the folk holiday which the people across the country were enjoying,Kim Jong Ungave instructions for the old persons' convenience in their everyday life with a paternal affection.
At the home built under his warm loving care, the old persons are spending their remaining years in happiness. -0-

headline: Preparations for Rural Housing Construction Brisk in N. Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 3 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK puts spurs to the preparations for this year's rural housing construction.
The province conducted organizational and political work to further strengthen the material and technical foundations of construction brigades through exhibitions of construction equipment and utensils and tools in cities and counties.
It ensured that the city and county construction brigades, with the Taegwan County Construction Brigade as a model, push ahead with the work to build up the ranks of skilled workers and raise the level of construction equipment. And it also made sure that the builders turned a technical innovation movement for improving quality and saving materials into the work for themselves.
Officials of Phihyon, Kujang and Ryongchon counties are training those who will carry on the rural construction work, while operating the schools of skilled builders effectively.

headline: "Unyo-maru" Incident - Prelude to Japan's Armed Invasion of Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- Japan, an island country, regarded overseas aggression as the best way to survive and develop, and made desperate efforts to this end.
Japan began switching to military feudal capitalism occasioned by "the 1868 Meiji Restoration", known as bourgeois reform in its history, and advocated a brigandish "theory of the conquest of Korea" which means conquering Korea by armed forces.
Under this belligerent theory, the Japanese aggressors embarked on the road of military invasion of Korea and fabricated the "Unyo-maru" incident in 1875. This was a deliberate provocative plot aimed at making an excuse for an armed invasion of Korea.
In May and September of that year, Japan made the "Unyo-maru" trespass on the coastal waters of Korea under the pretexts of a shelling drill and "sea-route sounding". Its aim was to invent an excuse for forcing the Korean feudal government to conclude an unequal treaty with Japan.
Enraged by the acts of committing various military espionage against Korea and the atrocities of attacking defenseless areas and killing many innocent inhabitants, the Korean guards opened fire on the aggressors.
Availing themselves of the opportunity, the Japanese aggressors asserted that the Korean side conducted an act of hostility towards Japan, and then started an open armed intervention. They threatened and blackmailed the Korean feudal government with cannons and warships and enforced the conclusion of an aggressive and subordinate unequal treaty on it in February the following year.
Japan stipulated the extraterritorial rights in the treaty. In this way, it provided a legal guarantee for committing all sorts of criminal acts, including aggression and plunder, at will, irrespective of the law of the Korean feudal state. On this basis, it could stretch out its tentacles of aggression deep into Korea in political, economic, military and other fields.
The "Unyo-maru" incident was a prelude to Japan's armed invasion of Korea. -0-

headline: First Full Moon Day Observed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- The first full moon day (January 15th of the lunar calendar), a folk holiday, added pleasure and optimism to the DPRK people.
The folk holiday is greeted every year, but everyone greeted the first full moon day of this year, when the blueprint for a new great victory was unveiled, with unusual emotion and pride.
People's laughter and songs resounded far in all parts of the country on the pleasant holiday.
Families and neighbors gathered together to eat traditional holiday dishes such as boiled rice admixed with four other staple cereals and play folk games with zest.
Looking round the Rangnang Museum built in a peculiar way in Pyongyang, the working people, youth and students realized that the time-honored history, brilliant culture and excellent traditions of the Korean people are invariably kept and shining under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
On the same day, Okryu Restaurant, Chongryu Restaurant, Kyongamsan Noodle House in Sariwon, Sinhung Restaurant in Hamhung, Kaesong Folk Hotel and other public catering establishments in Pyongyang and regions were crowded with citizens enjoying the holiday with several kinds of special dishes.
The laughter of working people, youth and students was heard at the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and other leisure facilities.
On the night of the folk holiday, the people across the country committed themselves to working harder for the steady prosperity and development of the powerful country, true to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Agrarian Reform Law Reflecting Will and Demand of Korean Peasants
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 4 (KCNA) -- It has been 80 years since the Agrarian Reform Law was promulgated in Korea.
The law is the Juche-oriented programme for agrarian revolution that met the centuries-old wish of the Korean peasants to become true owners of land. It is also a historic land law that put an eternal end to the feudal relations of land ownership deeply rooted in the countryside.
PresidentKim Il Sungmade countless journeys to the countryside to carry on the agrarian reform as the starting point of democratic reforms after the liberation of Korea.
One day in February 1946, he visited a village in Taedong County, South Phyongan Province. He sat together with the villagers and said that they would lead a happy life as owners of land as the country would distribute the land owned by the landlords to the peasants. Land originally belongs to the peasants who till it, he added.
That day he discussed with the peasants for a long time the practical issues arising in the agrarian reform.
In a remote village on the west coast, at the edge of a field in Taedong County, and in a village of Junghwa County and other farm villages, he acquainted himself in detail with the overall rural situation and the peasants' demand and confirmed the principles and ways for the agrarian reform and, on this basis, personally completed the Agrarian Reform Law.
When the peasant representatives came to see him with petitions for land reflecting the desire of peasants all over the country, he again learned about the situation in the countryside and the demands of peasants. He amended and supplemented the draft until the day before the promulgation of the Agrarian Reform Law.
On the basis of such preparations, he promulgated the Agrarian Reform Law that reflected the will and demand of the peasants on March 5, 1946. -0-

headline: UAWK Officials Tour Revolutionary Battle Sites in Area of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) and officials of its primary organizations from across the DPRK made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from February 26 to March 4.
They toured the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site, Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site, Chongbong Bivouac, Konchang Bivouac, Paektusan Secret Camp, Taehongdan Revolutionary Battle Site, etc.
They laid bouquets before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilat revolutionary battle sites and in Hyesan and Samjiyon cities and paid tribute to the peerlessly great men.
They looked back upon the sacred revolutionary career and exploits ofKim Jong Ilat his birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp.
At the battle sites of the anti-Japanese war, they cherished the truth that the revolutionary traditions of Paektu are the eternal treasure of the revolution and the only tradition of the Korean revolution that can never be bartered for anything.
Going round the site of campfire, the site of cooking rice and trees bearing slogans, they grasped the noble revolutionary spirit and fighting traits of the fighters who had made long journeys of the bloody anti-Japanese struggle, holdingKim Il Sungin high esteem as the centre of unity and leadership.
The song "We Will Go to Mt Paektu" sung by them at the top of Mt Paektu reverberated throughout the mountain.
They held a resolution-taking meeting at the plaza before the statue ofKim Jong Ilin Samjiyon City. -0-

headline: First Democratic Reform Enforced in Liberated Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 80th anniversary of the promulgation of the Agrarian Reform Law.
The promulgation of the law was a great event that marked the first brilliant step in the history of rural construction in the country and a solemn declaration heralding the start of the epoch-making change in the countryside.
PresidentKim Il Sungset the agrarian reform as the first task in the enforcement of overall democratic reforms after the liberation of Korea in order to dispel forever the sorrow of the Korean peasants who suffered all sorts of exploitation and oppression as they had not owned land for a long time.
On the basis of the practical experience gained during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the President sat together with peasants to acquaint himself in detail with the actual conditions of the countryside and the demands of the peasants, confirming each of the provisions of the law.
On March 5, 1946, he promulgated the Agrarian Reform Law on the basis of preparations for enforcing the agrarian reform.
He dispatched to the countryside the groups supporting the agrarian reform, which were composed of advanced workers, together with excellent forces of the Party and power organs, for the successful agrarian reform.
As a result, the agrarian reform was carried out in a little over 20 days and more than one million hectares of land owned by the Japanese imperialists, pro-Japanese elements, traitors to the nation and landlords were confiscated free of charge and given to more than 720 000 households of peasants with no or little land for free.
The agrarian reform put an eternal end to the feudal landownership system which had lasted thousands of years, realized the centuries-old desire of the Korean peasants to do farming on their own land to their heart's content, and opened up a new chapter for accelerating the struggle for building a prosperous, independent and sovereign state.
Today, the undying feats performed byKim Il Sungfor rural construction in the period of building a new country are shining long along with the proud reality of the socialist countryside in the DPRK which is changing day by day, creating a new life and new civilization under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Shooting Contest of KPA Snipers
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) -- A shooting contest of snipers from Korean People's Army units at all levels took place at the Pyongyang Training Base No. 60 under the Capital City Defence Corps on March 3 to mark the Sniper's Day of the KPA.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the contest.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and other major leading cadres.
He was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of the KPA large combined units.
The contest was aimed at steadily improving the marksmanship of snipers whose role is more highly valued in modern battlefields.
It was attended by snipers selected from the special operations units of different services of the KPA and its large combined units at all levels.
In the contest, the special operations brigade of the Air Force came first, the 4th Corps second and the 1st Corps third.
It was followed by demonstration shootings by snipers of the Company of Snipers under the Operations Bureau of the General Staff. Then combatants of the special operations units gave a demonstration of their might.
Saying that the combat capability and role of snipers are more highly valued in the composition of our armed forces,Kim Jong Unnoted that it is an essential requirement for implementing the Party's line of building a powerful army and modernizing it to bring about a rapid and qualitative change in enhancing the combat capability of snipers in conformity with the developing aspects and trend of modern warfare.
He said that it is very important to frequently organize drills under the simulated conditions of an actual war and shooting contests which will give rise to the spirit of emulation among the units in order to train all the snipers of the KPA units at all levels into crack shots capable of dealing a fatal blow to the enemy in any weather and seasonal conditions and day and night.
Noting that the crack-shot marksmanship should be a symbol and feature of the matchless combat capability of the Korean People's Army, he gave important guidelines for training a-match-for-a-hundred all-round snipers well-versed in the Juche-oriented marksmanship. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Destroyer Choe Hyon
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 5 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected the Destroyer Choe Hyon on March 3 and 4 to observe its crew members' combat and political training and the shakedown for assessing its operational executive capability.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Senior Vice Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, and officials in the warship-building sector.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted by the leading officials of the Nampho Shipyard on the spot on March 3.
He mounted the Destroyer Choe Hyon to inspect the situation of the sailors' operation of the destroyer and the process of the shakedown for assessing the destroyer's performance and operational executive capabilities.
He praised the sailors of the destroyer for having achieved successes in the new year combat and political drill for perfectly acquiring the military and technological qualifications, the level of which was set by the Party Central Committee for the operation of the new-type destroyer.
On the destroyer he acquainted himself with the sailors' preparedness for controlling warship and handling various weapon systems.
A shakedown cruise took place in his presence that day to estimate the maneuverability of the destroyer.
The crew members of the destroyer were filled with high confidence of carrying out the shakedown under his supervision.
Kim Jong Unhighly appreciated that the maneuverability of the warship meets the requirements of operational performance and the warship control system is excellent.
Expressing satisfaction over the smooth tests of all systems of the destroyer for its commissioning for operations, he said:
"The tests of operational efficiency of the new-type destroyer, a new symbol of sea defence capability of our state, are going on smoothly as planned.
This is an appraisal, from another point of view, of the advantages of the design of the vessel.
Every year during the new five-year plan period we must build two surface warships of this class or of a higher class, and correctly implement the gigantic plan of increasing the fighting strength of surface warships.
Ensuring the concentrated and sustained character of the capability of the national defence economy is a major guarantee for the implementation of this plan.
We have sufficient potentials, i.e., powerful researchers group and shipbuilding industry.
Our Navy's forces for attacking from under and above water will grow rapidly.
The arming of the Navy with nuclear weapons is making satisfactory progress.
All these successes constitute a radical change in defending our maritime sovereignty, something that we have not achieved for half a century.
Our Navy will have a powerful offensive capability, which is, in effect, a capability for defending ourselves.
If any forces are apprehensive about our efforts to build up our defence capabilities, this means that they are precisely our enemy.
I will have a strongest navy built.
As I have stressed before, I am sure that the course of implementing the national defence development plan for the coming five years will be a course of transforming once again the structure of our armed forces; we will build reliable defence capability.
We will guarantee the defence of national sovereignty, not in spoken or written words, but through capability for real actions and through practice."
Reiterating the goals to be attained by the warship-building industry in the period for implementing the five-year plan, he specified the state-sponsored measures to be taken to modernize the Navy and a series of tasks such as intensified cooperation between the Second Economy Commission and the national defence scientific research group.
He oversaw a sea-to-surface strategic cruise missile test launch conducted on the warship on March 4.
He said that the test was an important core element in estimating the operational capabilities of the warship.
The test launch was successfully carried out.
He expressed great satisfaction at the sailors' very good readiness for a strategic attack.
He said that such a demonstration of great power is not only a clear expression of the will to defend the national sovereignty based on firm self-confidence but also a responsible exercise of its war deterrent.
That day he inspected the third Choe Hyon-class destroyer under construction at the shipyard.
He highly praised and encouraged the workers of the shipyard, renowned for its tradition and might of self-reliance as a reliable large-scale warship-building base of the country, and the technicians and officials in the warship-building sector, who are striving with high morale to successfully build another Choe Hyon-class destroyer until the birthday of the WPK this year, when its historic Congress was held, by further enhancing the spirit they displayed in making a breakthrough in implementing the historic cause of rapidly turning the country into a maritime power of the 21st century through the building of the first new-generation multi-purpose destroyer.
Saying that the officials and workers in the warship-building sector should faithfully uphold the Party's line of building a military power with the completion of powerful new-type warships, he called for making strenuous progress of uninterrupted innovations and consecutive leaps forward to accelerate the dramatic transformation of the Navy.
His inspection of the destroyer and the shipyard served as a significant occasion for signaling that the strategic plan of the Party Central Committee, aimed at gradual and qualitative strengthening of the naval forces that will shoulder the crucial mission in carrying out the national defense strategy and exercising the war deterrent, has begun demonstrating its might through actual development. -0-

headline: Comprehensive Illustrated Manual of Korean Marital Arts
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- "Mu Ye Do Bo Tong Ji" is an old book on military-related martial arts as it systematized in a comprehensive way the martial arts movements which had been handed down in Korea for a long time.
The book with a preface written by Jong Jo, the 22nd king of the feudal Joson dynasty, was compiled at his instruction and printed in wood block in April 1790. It mainly shows the traditional martial arts movements of Korea such as various arts of hand-to-hand fight, fencing, spear and club, and horse riding, along with martial arts movements of neighboring countries, through pictures and explanation.
Kim Hong Do, a famous painter in those days, painted the pictures of the book.
PresidentKim Il Sungtook a measure to find out all the national cultural heritages and preserve them under the control of the state during the Fatherland Liberation War. Thanks to this measure, the book was discovered in the area of Phyongan Province in 1952 and sent to the then state central library. It is now preserved at the Grand People's Study House.
The book is of weighty significance in studying the root and history of Taekwon-Do, the traditional martial arts of the DPRK, and its superiority as well as the martial arts of the East. UNESCO certified it as the Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia-Pacific in 2016 and the Memory of the World Regional Register in 2017. -0-

headline: Many Vocational Technology Colleges Modernized in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 6 (KCNA) -- Many vocational technology colleges across the DPRK have been modernized to prove their worth in training skilled workers, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Graduates of those colleges played a big role in raising the variety of products almost treble at new regional-industry factories as compared with the early days of their inauguration.
North Hwanghae Province directed efforts to building vocational technology colleges into the hub for training skilled workers. As a result, it trained hundreds of skilled workers in different jobs last year.
Janggang and Rangnim counties in Jagang Province readjusted classrooms of the colleges in conformity with major subjects and conducted the work to improve the qualifications of teachers. And they have ensured that students of the colleges practice at the newly-built modern regional-industry factories.
Cities and counties in North Phyongan Province including Jongju City and Unsan County, are pushing ahead with the work to lay material and technical foundations for the vocational technology colleges.
South Hamgyong Province and other provinces are training many skilled workers with occupational expertise and practical abilities by enhancing the function and role of vocational technology colleges. -0-

headline: Ssukttok-making - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- Ssukttok (grain cake seasoned with wormwood) has been widely known as a popular dish in dietary life of the Korean people.
More than 30 species of wormwood are growing in mountains and fields of the DPRK.
Wormwood is specially efficacious for illness resulting from body chill, hypertension and bronchitis as it has antipyretic, analgesic, diuretic, sterilizing and anti-poison effects.
According to "Tongguksesigi", a classic book of our country, women made and ate wheel-shaped ssukttok in the fifth month of the lunar calendar, hoping that their husbands return homes from the battle sites in good health.
From olden times, when spring comes, every family has made ssukttok, regarding that it makes people be not ill that year.
Ssukttok is efficacious and peculiar tasty. It can be made at homes in a simple way. Good mixing ratio between wormwood and grain is 3:7.
It can be made with such grains as rice, wheat, kaoliang and maize. It is more glutinous than other rice cakes and it helps prevent deterioration of food for its peculiar fragrance and essential oil substances.
The ssukttok-making was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in May 2016. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 7 (KCNA) -- Enlarged plenary meetings of Pyongyang municipal and provincial committees of the Workers' Party of Korea were held on March 5 and 6 to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK and the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.
Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and members of the Political Bureau and leading officials of the WPK Central Committee guided the plenary meetings.
Present there were members and alternate members of the provincial Party committees and, as observers, officials of the Party and power organs and administrative and economic organs in the relevant regions.
The plenary meetings discussed and decided the ways and practical issues for making more sure progress in the economic development of the provinces and the improvement of the people's living standards while further consolidating the successes and experience of the past five years.
They stressed that the long-term plans and tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK and the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK are the most scientific and revolutionary struggle strategies and grand action programmes to hasten the comprehensive rejuvenation of the DPRK and provide the people across the country with more improved and civilized, new life and well-being as much as possible and at an early date by their own strength, wisdom and strenuous efforts.
They set forth the tasks and ways for the provincial Party committees to direct their main efforts to establishing the unified leadership system of the Party Central Committee more thoroughly and push ahead with the implementation of the Party's decisions.
They indicated the ways for bringing about a clear result in attaining this year's goal, invariably holding aloft the idea of believing in the people as in Heaven, single-minded unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance.
The plenary meetings stressed the need to apply the principles and requirements of the five-point Party-building programme in the new era to the Party work and activities and implement them perfectly.
At the plenary meetings, speakers expressed the determination to conduct the work of their regions and units in a scientific, foresighted and profitable way and prove their Party spirit, revolutionary spirit and popular character with clear-cut results.
There were sectional consultative meetings to confirm the future goals of struggle on the basis of the idea and important tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK and implement them thoroughly.
At the plenary meetings, decisions were adopted with the unanimous approval amid the participants' high political enthusiasm. -0-

headline: Mass Rallies Held in Cities and Counties of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 8 (KCNA) -- Mass rallies took place in cities and counties of the DPRK on March 6 and 7 to vow to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were officials of local Party, power and economic organs, working people's organizations, industrial establishments, farms, etc, working people and youth.
At the mass rallies held in Sunchon City and Kangnam, Pukchang, Ryongchon, Jangyon, Hwaphyong, Phyonggang, Hamju, Kilju and Kapsan counties and Taean District, speakers said that they have turned out in a grand general advance for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK with the boundless honor and pride of upholding in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, their destiny and banner of victory, as general secretary of the WPK.
At the mass rallies held in Kangdong, Phyongwon, Unnyul, Unpha, Janggang, Jongphyong, Orang, Kim Jong Suk and Ryonggang counties, Kusong City and Kaephung District, speakers said that the idea on more dynamically making the three revolutions–ideological, technological and cultural– is greatly encouraging their struggle for new transformation.
At the mass rallies held in Samsok and Kangso districts, Songnim and Sinpho cities and Kyongsong, Kim Hyong Jik and Jangphung counties, speakers said with confidence and optimism that the DPRK would undergo another world-startling change within five years as it is led by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unand that it would get stronger and civilized day by day.
Speakers at the mass rallies ardently called upon all the people to make a dynamic struggle for the successful fulfillment of the WPK's fighting programme and the prosperity of Korean-style socialism, united closer around the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Letters of pledge toKim Jong Unwere adopted at the rallies. -0-

headline: Mt Paektu, Ancestral Mountain of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, February 25 (KCNA) -- The Korean nation worshipped Mt Paektu as the ancestral mountain of its nation. New historical relics showing their patriotism and customs were unearthed and ascertained recently.
In the course of intensifying the investigation and excavation of historical relics in the area of Mt Paektu, a research group of the History Faculty ofKim Il SungUniversity discovered five graves, akin to those already found on an islet of Lake Samji No.1, on the shores of Lake Chon on the top of the mountain and four graves in the areas of Taehongdan County of Ryanggang Province and Musan County of North Hamgyong Province. The research group scientifically confirmed the characteristics, origin and ages of the graves.
By fully analyzing the locations of the graves, differences in typical features of domestic and foreign graves and funeral custom, the research group found that the newly discovered graves are originated in such style and funeral customs from the Koreans of Palhae (698-926) living in the areas of Ryanggang Province and South and North Hamgyong provinces.
The research group clarified that the remains are of Koreans who lived between around mid-18th century and mid-19th century. The research group thus proved the historical truth that Koreans in the area of Mt Paektu had buried their ancestors' remains on the shores of Lake Chon.
The Archaeological Society of the DPRK concluded after examination that the remains in the newly found graves are of Koreans who inherited the customs of Palhae. -0-

headline: O Kyong Ryong - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons for 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- O Kyong Ryong, wrestler of the Pyongyang Sports Club, was listed as the one of the ten best players for 2025 in the DPRK.
She won gold medals at the 2025 Asian Wrestling Championship and the 2025 World Wrestling Championship to become the Asian and world champion in the women's wrestling 55kg category.
Born in Jongju City, North Phyongan Province, she learned basic wrestling skills at the extracurricular sports school of the Pyongyang Sports Club from the age of 12.
She won a gold medal in the women's 49kg category of the 2015 Asian junior wrestling championship and made good results at international games with various techniques.
She is training hard with a resolve to live up to the expectation of the country and the people with excellent successes in the future games. -0-

headline: National Inter-provincial Riding Contest Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- The National Inter-provincial Riding Contest-2026 was held at the Mirim Riding Club in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, to mark the March 8 International Women's Day.
Men and women riders selected from each province took part in such events as showjumping, quick relay with taking one's feet out of the stirrup and 1 600m race, held in indoor and outdoor riding courses.
The preliminary match was held on Mar. 7 and the finals on Mar. 8.
Among the spectators were Jo Yong Won and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK Central Committee, and their wives.
Present there on invitation were Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, Kim Yo Jong, department director of the C.C., WPK, and other women officials working at the C.C., WPK and government organs, officials of the C.C., Socialist Women's Union of Korea and women labor innovators.
Working people, youth and students in Pyongyang watched the contest.
There took place dressage and showjump demonstrations of the riders of the Mirim Riding Club and then the final match was held.
South Hamgyong Province came first in total standings, and Nampho Municipality and South Hwanghae Province second and third respectively.
The final match was followed by 1 600m race demonstration of men and women riders of the club.
Cups, diplomas and prizes were awarded to the provinces and municipality which won top places and to the players who proved successful in the events.
Prizes were also awarded to the horses that won the 1 600m race.
Then a performance was given by the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League to congratulate the March 8 International Women's Day. -0-

headline: Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech in Congratulation of Women across Country on Occasion of March 8 International Women's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech in congratulation of the women across the country on the occasion of the March 8 International Women's Day.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Greeting March 8, I, with my warmest feelings, extend congratulations to all our Korean women, for whom I have affection and respect all the time.
My hearty congratulations also go to all the overseas Korean women.
As they have always done, our women add harmony, beauty, warmth and affection to our society.
Today it is a joyful holiday, when the whole country brims over with the tender feelings of gratitude, blessing and respect for our women.
As we were to greet the women’s day some days after the Ninth Congress of our Party, in which we reviewed the precious successes achieved for the good of the country, I was reminded of all the exceptional and unknown efforts the women of this country had made for those successes. And I wanted to express my special thanks to them for what they had done, so I have decided to make a brief remark today, on the occasion of this opportunity.
I make a deep bow as an expression of my thanks to our women for the unknown efforts and sincerity they have devoted for the country and men.
However, I think that thanks is too simple a word and it would not be enough to encourage and repay them even a little for the extraordinary troubles and difficulties our women have experienced.
I can picture in my mind’s eye the looks of the women in this country, who would wear a gentle smile, as if they had gained all the reward for their silent efforts, after receiving a simple congratulatory remark, a greetings card or a flower from their dear husbands, children, boyfriends, relatives, acquaintances and disciples.
For these women, I cannot find any other better expression than really beautiful.
This expression does not simply imply the beautiful looks of Korean women.
Though physically weak, they are obviously strong-willed, their plain faces assuming courage and the wrinkles on them denoting their strenuous exertion and thus arousing much greater respect. So, they look incomparably beautiful, and I think this is a charm unique to our Korean women.
In the images of our grandmothers’ and mothers’ generations we can see the signs of the severe hardship which they have undergone, the tenacity with which they have gone against all the odds, and the strength of genuine love and benevolent affection which they have cherished while working hard to develop this country.
Also, when seeing the faces of our contemporary women of a new generation, we can feel the fresh vigor with which they are working to advance this country towards a bright future, and the optimism and self-confidence they show in overcoming trials cheerfully.
I want to say proudly that all the Korean women who are dear to us -- mothers, wives, daughters and girlfriends -- are really beautiful and great, as compared with women in other countries.
Korean women, who have remained honest in times of difficulties, stout-hearted in moments of sorrow and courageous even in the face of death, have recorded remarkable exploits in the annals of the revolution and in the pages of history. These exploits still remain in our memory, serving as our strong spiritual mainstay.
Korean women are by nature pure-hearted, upright and strong-willed, and these qualities have been purely inherited for generations. Our contemporary women, too, have become a solid buttress of the revolution bringing affection and delight to all the other people in this country and inspiring them with strength, courage and victory.
In all the positions of our revolution, be they posts for national defence, sites of socialist construction, factories or farms, wherever we go in the country, we can see our women, strong-willed, tenacious, pure-hearted and honest, who are unwilling to show their physical weakness and lag behind men.
The distinguished services rendered by our countless heroes, both known and unknown, as well as the meritorious persons and innovators in this country, are associated with the immeasurable pains that our women, who are their mothers or wives, have taken without expecting any reward.
Our women devote themselves without seeking self-interest or reward, and they find the worth of their life in doing so. Such a fine mind constitutes the basis of a spiritual strength that engenders boundless love and encourages others to defy death unhesitatingly in defence of the love.
Our soldiers are so brave in the life-and-death battles, because they are determined to bring not an iota of shame on their dear mothers, wives, girlfriends or daughters, whom they associate with the sacred appellation motherland.
Women have such incredible strength.
With the passage of time, wrinkles will appear on their beautiful faces. However, the genuine beauty of our Korean women will not fade forever, as they are so honest and upright to endure everything while concerning themselves more about the country and revolution than about their families.
Encouraged by the warm care of such excellent women, their husbands and children achieve innovations at their workplaces, and our revolution is progressing much faster thanks to their peculiar strength, talent and most ennobling self-sacrificing devotion.
In the future, too, our women will play a significant role in making this country more harmonious and prosperous.
So important and irreplaceable are their responsibility and role in developing the socialist society of our own style and finding proper solutions to many big and small social problems.
When they always behave as a role model for their children, encourage their husbands and become a source of happiness and pride for their parents, and when they carry forward the tradition of patriotism as faithfully as ever, our society will become more beautiful, more powerful and more prosperous.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I would like to extend my special thanks and greetings to all the mothers across the country.
Indeed, the sacred appellation mother is a source of great spiritual strength for everyone.
Woman is weak but mother is strong, as the saying goes. Our mothers cherish genuine maternal affection as they make unassuming efforts to bring up their children to be excellent persons, so this country has so many patriots. As such strong-willed mothers constitute the solid foundations, our rosy future is fully guaranteed.
I am hardening my resolve to make unsparing and strenuous efforts to do much more for the sake of these admirable mothers, for the wellbeing of our women.
I earnestly request all our women to fulfil the sacred mission and duty they have assumed before the times, history and the motherland in achieving the prosperity and development of our country and promoting the harmony and unity of our society.

headline: Grand Performance Given to Commemorate March 8 International Women's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 9 (KCNA) -- Now that the whole country is brimming with love, respect and warm congratulations to the women who are building the bright future, ensuring the continuity of the bloodline of patriotism generation after generation, a grand performance was given at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on March 8, International Women's Day.
The venue for the performance was full of joy and excitement of the women commemorating March 8 as the happiest holiday in the presence of the tender-hearted father whom they longed to see even in their dreams.
WhenKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, appeared in the auditorium, with his wife Ri Sol Ju and beloved daughter, the excitement of the participants keenly awaiting the moment of glory erupted into their stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Among the audience were leading cadres of the Party and the government, officials of the Central Committee of the women's union, exemplary women officials, labor innovators, meritorious women and women workers of institutions and enterprises in Pyongyang.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and members of foreign missions in the DPRK.
Kim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech of congratulations to the women across the country.
He told about his impression of the women's holiday being greeted shortly after the Ninth Congress of the WPK. He expressed his special thanks to all the Korean women for their unusual and unknown efforts, saying they are the strong pillars of the revolution who have added the pages of their most beautiful and greatest life to the annals of the revolution and history, still bringing love, laugh, strength, courage and victory to the country.
Saying when our women continue to carry forward the traditions of patriotism by fulfilling their irreplaceable responsibility and role, our society will get stronger and more prosperous, he warmly wished all the Korean women happiness, good health and eternal beauty for the country, revolution and future.
The audience raised fervent cheers, overwhelmed with great excitement at the warm blessings by the great fatherly leader who places the women in the van of the most precious people in the world, crowning their life with the laurels of all the victories achieved by the country and the revolution.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Amid the playing of the prelude "May Your Future Be Always in Springtime," members of the children's union presented bouquets to women in reflection of all the people's congratulations and respect.
Put on the stage of the performance were the odes to the Workers' Party sung heartily by the women, famous songs on patriotism and folk songs.
Singing the odes loved by all the people, the performers represented the deepest reverence of all the women in the country for the motherly Party which greatly values the pure conscience and selfless efforts they have dedicated to the prosperity of the country and gives them the highest honor and respect.
The performance reached its climax with female group singing and chorus "Long Live Our Korea" and mixed group singing and chorus "Oh, Korea, My Mother" that aroused their strong enthusiasm to add luster to the glory of Korean women by making patriotic devotion for the boundlessly benevolent Party and social system and the victory of the socialist cause.
The performance was loudly applauded by the audience as it represented the firm faith and will of the Korean women to invariably glorify their honorable title - women revolutionaries and communist mothers - on the road of single-mindedly following the respected MarshalKim Jong Unonly for the eternal harmony and prosperity of a large socialist family and the country which will be prosperous generation after generation. -0-

headline: Things of Our Own Produced with Domestic Equipment and Materials
story_text:
One day in January 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and looked round the bag cloth production line.
He stopped in front of a machine simultaneously weaving surface and lining cloth for bag production.
The machine was made by the workers and scientists of the DPRK with their own efforts.
Touching the cloth woven by the machine, he said that it is very good to produce cloth like this and highly appreciated the weaving combined workshop as the one implementing the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
That day, he said with great satisfaction that the equipment for the bag cloth production line are very precious as they were made with our own efforts, though they are not as flashy as the imported ones. And he added that he was very pleased to see the bag cloth production line built with our own efforts and technology.
Looking up to him being pleased with the bag production with domestic equipment and materials, the officials more deeply felt that self-reliance is the only way of genuine patriotism for achieving the prosperity of the country. -0-

headline: Sweet Rice Dish - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- Sweet rice dish is one of the national food peculiar to the Korean people.
From long ago, they made sweet rice dish with natural medicinal materials abundant in the country and used it for their diet.
They used to eat sweet rice dish as a special diet on folk holidays like the January 15th of the lunar calendar.
The method of making the sweet rice dish is as follows:
Soak the glutinous rice in water for a while before washing and steaming it in an earthenware steamer.
Peel off chestnuts and split them into pieces, and boil seeded jujubes in an oven to make thick juice.
Mix honey evenly with the steamed glutinous rice, season it with soy sauce and add sesame oil, chestnut pieces and jujube juice to it.
Put it in a pot or hollow bowl and seal them.
And steam it in an earthenware steamer or big oven with water in it for a long time.
Then sprinkle pine nuts and cinnamon on the steamed sweet rice dish.
The Korean people also put into the sweet rice dish the dried persimmon, dried bracken, mushroom and walnut as well as chestnut and jujube.
The sweet rice dish has also been widely used for refreshment and medical treatment.
It is effective in lowering blood pressure, preventing arteriosclerosis and treating diseases such as scorbutus, purpura and chronic gastritis. It helps clean blood and increase the resistance of the body.
It contains protein, vitamins and minerals needed for improving nutrition.
Even foreigners like the sweet rice dish for its quality food materials, the peculiar method of making it, high nutritional value and pharmacological action.
It was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in December 2016. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "Strong is the will of our state to defend peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the region" on March 10:
At a critical time when global security structure is collapsing rapidly and wars break out in different parts of the world due to the reckless acts of the outrageous international rogues, the U.S.-ROK war drill is being staged in the ROK. This will result in further destroying the stability of the region.
On March 9 the enemy states launched the large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield, intensively revealing once again their inveterate repugnancy toward the DPRK and habitual hostile policy toward it.
The drill, involving more than 18 000 troops of the ROK and the U.S. forces, is to be staged day and night for 10-odd days across the territorial ground, sea, air, outer space and cyberspace of the ROK. It is not a "military game" but provocative and aggressive war rehearsal of those simulating and planning the confrontation with the DPRK.
The enemies are again calling it "annual" and "defensive" but no matter what justification they may establish and how the elements of the drill may be coordinated, the clear confrontational nature of the high-intensity large-scale war drill staged by the most hostile entities in collusion at the doorstep of the DPRK never changes.
Given that the danger has escalated in recent years as a result of the drastic increase of command and actual field mobilization exercises to apply and get familiar with new modern war manuals and methods appropriate to the actual conditions of the Korean peninsula, accompanied by nuclear elements, such training is being further supplemented by practical and provocative military elements including information warfare and AI technology this year, too. This is another proof of the confrontational nature.
The recent global geopolitical crisis and complicated international events prove that all military maneuvers of the field warfare troops, to be conducted by the enemy states, assume no distinction between defence and attack, training and actual warfare, and that they should be suppressed through an extraordinarily overwhelming and preemptive super-offensive, rather than a responsive or proportional action, in order to get fully prepared to cope with them.
Our head of state has already clarified that it is undoubtedly a law and iron principle that the most powerful offensive capability constitutes the most reliable deterrent.
The muscle-flexing of the hostile forces near the areas of our state's sovereignty and security may cause unimaginably terrible consequences.
The enemies should never try to test our patience, will and capability.
We will watch to what extent the enemy violates the security of our state and what it is playing.
We will perfectly counter the strategic threats to the security of the state and the region through the bolstering of destructive power, including all available special means which cannot but be overwhelming, and the responsible exercise of such deterrent.
We will also constantly and repeatedly convince the enemies of our war deterrence and its fatality.
We will have the terrible destructive power, which the enemy dare not respond, to firmly defend the peace of the country.
The security sphere of the DPRK is absolutely inviolable and strong is the will of our state to thoroughly defend the security environment in the Korean peninsula and the region. -0-

headline: Construction of Greenhouses for Raising Rice Seedlings Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 10 (KCNA) -- The construction of greenhouses for raising rice seedlings is progressing apace in the DPRK.
This year, hundreds of thousands of square meters of greenhouses for raising rice seedlings will be built across the country to transplant rice seedlings, grown in an advanced way, in many areas.
Pyongyang Municipality worked out a plan for building more labor- and land-saving greenhouses and sped up the work for its fulfillment, thus providing conditions for transplanting in many paddy fields rice seedlings grown in greenhouses.
Districts and counties of Nampho Municipality have set the sites for building greenhouses in the areas with favorable water supply and rice seedling transport conditions and concentrated efforts and means on their construction.
Hamhung City, on the basis of giving precedence to the design of greenhouses suited to the actual conditions of the region, simultaneously pushed ahead with the work to make seedling containers with local raw materials and secure soilless substrates. As a result, more than 10 greenhouses were built to grow healthy rice seedlings safely without being affected by natural conditions.
Hoeryong City is building greenhouses for intensively growing rice seedlings.
Other regions, too, are building greenhouses with favorable conditions for raising rice seedlings. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Destroyer Choe Hyon Conducts Test-Fire of Strategic Cruise Missiles
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- Amid the continued tests of operational efficiency of the Destroyer Choe Hyon of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, a strategic cruise missile test-fire was conducted again on March 10.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unobserved the test-fire on TV.
The test-fire on the destroyer was aimed at evaluating the reliability of the national integrated control system of strategic weapons and the destroyer's detection and weapon systems and verifying the combat effectiveness of the integrated combat system in technical aspects,Kim Jong Unsaid, adding that on the other hand, it is to demonstrate the Navy's strategic attack posture and make sailors well versed in relevant military activities.
The Destroyer Choe Hyon received target information, and the launch was approved according to relevant procedures and cruise missiles launched simultaneously to hit several targets.
The launched cruise missiles flew along the flight orbit set in the sky above the West Sea of Korea for 10 116s to 10 138s and hit the individual island targets.
Kim Jong Unexpressed his great satisfaction over the verified reliability of the national integrated control system of strategic weapons and superiority of the destroyer's integrated combat system.
He gave important instructions on reexamining in our own way the organization of weapon systems of the destroyer, to be built in the future, in the light of the actual requirements in military aspects and from the development-oriented view.
Underlining the need to examine the military efficiency of the naval automatic gun installed on the warship in the light of our specific conditions, he expressed his view that it is more favorable to enhance the anti-warship and strategic attack capabilities, as required by operational features, by equipping high-speed warships of below 3 000 tonnage with such naval automatic guns and additionally installing supersonic weapon systems instead of those guns on the 5 000-tonnage, 8 000-tonnage destroyers in the future.
He gave an instruction on examining the plan of organizing such Korean-style weapon system and applying it to the warships to be built, including the third destroyer under construction.
Saying that it is a very important strategic task to maintain and expand the powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent, he said:
"The components of our war deterrent are now being included in the very sophisticated operational system in an effective and accelerated manner continuously and the country's nuclear forces have made a switch to the phase of multifaceted operation.
Important successes have been recently made in putting the strategic and tactical strike means on a practical basis and deploying them for an actual war.
Such successes have updated the readiness of our army for strategic action and enhanced the confidence in it.
Our belief and confidence based on those verified capabilities make it possible to take the initiative in the military activities for national defence and will play an important role in further developing our potential."
He stressed that the DPRK's offensive weapon systems undergoing constant development constitute an indispensable factor for self-defence literally.
He set forth a series of important tasks for rapidly increasing the fighting efficiency of the Navy, including the issue of delivering the destroyer to the Navy within the set time by finishing the assessment of its maneuverability and the operational capabilities of its such other weapon systems as anti-air, anti-submarine and torpedo weapon systems, the issue of stepping up the building of another destroyer to finish it  before the founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea this year and the issue of reinforcing the existing infrastructure of the naval base and building new one. -0-

story_text:

He is a wrestling star who won the 2025 Asian Wrestling Championship and the 2025 World Wrestling Championship.
He, born in Nampho Municipality, trained basic skills with a special attachment to wrestling from his childhood.
After becoming a player of the April 25 Combat Sports Team, he made efforts to prepare himself physically and technically.
It is the opinion of experts that he is an ingenious wrestler with high level of concentration and agility, who is able to apply various techniques according to the changing game situations.
He won a silver medal at the 19th Asian Games and a gold medal at the 37th CISM World Military Wrestling Championship.

Central Zoo
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 11 (KCNA) -- Service environments of the Central Zoo, a base for cultural and leisure activities for the people, have been improved, adding pleasure to the visitors.
Recently, the zoo made tour trailer and put its operation on a normal basis to meet the convenience of visitors.
The chassis frames, which are decorated like a flower cart, depict the heroes of cartoon films liked by children, so that everyone seemingly becomes a child with cheerful feelings on the trailer.
The trailer, designed to carry dozens of visitors at a time, shuttle between the aquarium and the gift animals' house, and people can watch a wide section of the zoo in the trailer with comfortable sitting.
A peculiar landscape in different places of the zoo adds to the visitors' pleasure.
The Central Zoo is associated with the devoted efforts of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the people.
Visiting the Central Zoo under remodeling on March 11, 2014, he instructed that new structures including the Penguin House be built to suit the ecological characteristics of animals and fully meet the convenience of visitors.
He called for building the aquarium and all other objects under remodeling into pleasant resting places giving laughter and joy to the people.
The employees of the zoo continue to push ahead with the work to provide better service conditions and environment, true to the intention ofKim Jong Unwho pays deep attention to the cultural and leisure activities of the people. -0-
