headline: Officials of WPK Central Committee Hold Loyalty-pledging Meeting to Implement Decisions of Ninth Party Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- There was a solemn ceremony at the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, the general staff of the revolution, representing the firm faith and will of millions of Party members and other people across the country to usher in an era of new upsurge in the Juche revolution by dint of the great strength of loyalty and patriotism along the bright path indicated by the Ninth Party Congress.
Officials of the Central Committee of the WPK had a loyalty-pledging meeting on March 11 to thoroughly implement the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress, true to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, with one mind.
Speeches were made by Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Jong Gwan and Kim Sung Du, secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK.
Referring to the unheard-of wonderful successes made in the overall Party and state affairs including the political, economic, cultural, defence and diplomatic fields over the past five years, the speakers said that their way is the one of justice, truth and victory, the ideal and ambition are sure to be achieved and their future would be beautiful and rosy as they are led byKim Jong Un. This is the absolute faith and iron-willed principle they have more deeply grasped on the road of revolution under the guidance of the General Secretary, they noted.
They expressed their firm determination to play the vanguard role in ensuring that the new fighting programme set forth by the Party Congress brings about brilliant fruition, true to the leadership ofKim Jong Unwith single-minded loyalty, saying that thanks to his far-reaching plan and extraordinary leadership, the country will make another leap forward in the next five years as it did in the past five years, startling the world.
They said that by actively applying the five-point Party-building programme in the new era to the Party work and activities, they will firmly maintain and consolidate the political climate peculiar to the Party with the monolithic ideology and leadership as the core, thoroughly establish the discipline of the revolutionary Party which is strong in discipline and sound in style of work and thus further develop the whole Party into an integral organization and an ideological pure entity sharing the ideas and intention withKim Jong Un.
They said that they would concentrate the efforts of the Party work on ensuring that the Party organizations thoroughly orient and subordinate all their work to strengthening the single-minded unity of the party and the masses, further cement the people's trust in the Party and unconditionally perform the tasks for carrying out the new five-year plan.
The Party ideological officials would enhance their role as microphones, powerful loudspeakers and hi-fi amplifiers faithful to the Party Central Committee in every worksite for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress, thus giving fuller play to the loyalty and strength of patriotism and unity of all the people and increasing the might of ideology and effectiveness of ideological work to the maximum, they noted.
They said that they would strengthen the Party's guidance for making the whole course of carrying out the new five-year plan become the course of accomplishing the three revolutions with a firm viewpoint that the comprehensive development of socialism is precisely the struggle for changes in the ideological, technological and cultural fields and thoroughly embody the five basic requirements of the comprehensive development in the new era in order to ceaselessly give full play to the surging spirit of the struggle everywhere.
The WPK and the revolution would always emerge victorious as they are holding in high esteemKim Jong Unwho has laid an eternal foundation for permanently guaranteeing the ruling power of the dignified WPK and steadily made the great history of the people-first politics, they said. They vowed to devote themselves to the brilliant accomplishment of the programme of the WPK's struggle, rallied closer aroundKim Jong Unas one.
A letter of pledge of loyalty was adopted at the meeting amid loud applause of the participants.
Officials of the Party Central Committee are full of the revolutionary enthusiasm to work harder with unyielding will, extraordinary determination and redoubled confidence in the first line and on the forefront of the struggle for carrying out the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress, keeping in mind the honorable mission and duty as members of the general staff of the revolution. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Munitions Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected a major munitions factory under the Second Economy Commission on March 11 to learn about the munitions production.
Accompanying him were the members of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and leading officials of the WPK Central Committee.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the fact that the factory started the production of new pistols according to its approved design, examined and ratified by the Central Military Commission of the WPK on February 19, 2025.
Saying that the factory is playing a very important role in increasing the combat efficiency of the army, public security forces and militia forces as it takes full charge of producing pistols and other portable light arms, he stressed the need to expand and create the production capacity of the factory in a far-sighted way and set a high level in modernization of the production line and cultured way of production in conformity with the demand, requirements and standards specified by the Party and implement it in a responsible manner.
He urged the Second Economy Commission to decisively raise the level of technical equipment of major munitions industry enterprises, establish strict quality control regulations and order and supply materials and products under contract in a planned way so as to organize the economic work well for producing weapons of thoroughly guaranteed quality in a serial way.
He stressed once again the need for all the munitions industry enterprises under the Second Economy Commission to organize and conduct the work for establishing cultured ways in production and life at a more developed stage and continue to create model standards.
That day, he visited the shooting gallery of the factory to acquaint himself with the combat performance of the new-type pistol that went into production.
Saying that he received a report from the Ministry of National Defence and the General Staff on the unanimous impression that the new-type pistol is superior in its structural performance, rate of hits, concentration fire and combat utility, he expressed satisfaction over the development of a really excellent pistol.
He clarified his view on the opinion of the Second Economy Commission with regard to the issue of establishing a new production line in addition at the factory during the period of the five-year plan for the development of national defence, and gave an important instruction for its implementation.
He stressed that the new production line should be established at a high level to be a model for modernization of the country's munitions industry.
He said that the examination of the plan for modernization of munitions factories in the period of the new five-year plan and of the budget bill for immediate modernization of three major munitions industry enterprises would be conducted at an enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission of the WPK to be convened in April.
Repeatedly expressing satisfaction over the development and production of the excellent pistol, he extended thanks to the officials, technicians and workers of the factory. -0-

story_text:

Present there were Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman and concurrently director of its Organization Department,  vice-chairpersons, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon and directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan.
The meeting was aimed at successfully concluding the 25th-term work during the run-up to the 26th Congress of Chongryon, true to the idea and spirit of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Pak Ku Ho made a report on the first agenda item "On Greeting the 26th Congress of Chongryon with High Patriotic Enthusiasm and Success in Work".
The reporter said that Chongryon would put spurs to the patriotic movement and the work of its branches ahead of the 26th Congress to encourage broad compatriots to play the role of masters in Chongryon work, and the organizations of different strata would launch an offensive mass movement in conformity with their characteristics.
He called upon the Chongryon officials to greet the 26th Congress with high political enthusiasm and successes in their work by thoroughly applying the ideas and leadership of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unto the work of Chongryon, bearing deep in mind the basic idea and spirit of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Then speeches were made.
Vice-chairman Nam Sung U made a report on the second agenda item "On Convening the 26th Congress of Chongryon".
A letter toKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Municipal Festival of Science and Technology Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 12 (KCNA) -- The 39th Pyongyang Municipal Festival of Science and Technology opened with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on March 11 under the sponsorship of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.
The festival, divided into 25 panels including metal, chemical, electric power and machine-building industries, will be held in various forms including presentation and exhibition of sci-tech achievements, sci-tech short course and exchange of new technologies and new products.

headline: Preparations for New School Year in DPRK

Cities and counties strive to provide schools with necessary conditions, given that a new educational programme is to be applied to the primary and secondary education from this year.
Songyo District of Pyongyang Municipality works hard to introduce more technical subjects into the schools in the district.
The district made sure that the schools select technical subjects which reflect the regional economic and geographical characteristics.
Changsong County of North Phyongan Province has chosen subjects with the main emphasis on farming and stockbreeding and directed big efforts to the preparations for training teachers.
It trained more teachers by appointing graduates from Changsong College of Technology as teachers.
It has taken measures to improve the qualifications of teachers by enlisting them in the online education network and pushed ahead with improving the qualifications of all teachers in the county.
Pyoksong County of South Hwanghae Province has introduced many technical subjects suited to the characteristics of rural areas and pushed ahead with laying a foundation for experiment and practice.
The preparations for the new school year are brisk in different parts of the country thanks to officials' attention and guidance. The preparations for teaching at schools are progressing at the final stage. -0-

headline: Murder of Myongsong, Empress of Korea
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- Recorded in the history of the Japanese imperialists' aggression on Korea is the murder of Empress Myongsong as a thrice-cursed killing and a hideous criminal act.
The Japanese aggressors' moves to colonize Korea reached the extremes in the late 19th century. The Japanese aggressors, unable to fulfill their wild ambition, sought a way out in eliminating Empress Myongsong.

headline: Kaesong Municipal Tree Nursery Produces Saplings of Good Species
Regional Security Environment Is Getting Severe Due to Japanese Militarism: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 13 (KCNA) -- Japan's moves for reviving militarism, aimed at rearmament, are leading to full-scale deployment of preemptive attack means for action.
Shortly ago, the Ministry of Defence of Japan made public that type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles with drastically increased firing range would be deployed for action in Kumamoto City for the first time.
Not content with this, Japan is planning to deploy surface-to-surface missiles for "defending islands" in Shizuoka Prefecture within this month and long-range missiles at the bases of the "Self-Defense Forces" in Hokkaido and Miyazaki prefectures in order from 2028.
If this plan comes true, Japan will have long-range missiles targeting the neighboring countries deployed in all parts of the archipelago.
It is a dangerous military attempt.
Openly saying that the development and deployment of long-range missiles constitute the "core of the capability of attacking enemy bases", Japan is concentrating huge human and material resources on them.
The type 12 missiles, the deployment of which Japan is trying to accelerate, are the ones remodeled for years to greatly increase the firing range, which can be launched from ground, warships and fighter jets. They put the waters off surrounding areas within their striking range.
They are also rated as long-range attack weapons because they have the multi-purpose capability to attack fixed targets on the ground including harbors and airports as well as marine targets.
The same can be said of the type of missiles Japan is planning to deploy for action while claiming that they are the ones for "defending the islands."
It can be well evidenced by the anti-ship missile for "defending the islands" which was made public with the assertion that it has long-range strike capability, based on stealth and interceptor evasion technology.
This missile is expected to be similar or more in striking range, compared to the type 12 anti-ship cruise missile with the firing range of 1 000 km. It will reportedly be updated in various forms in the future.
World media and military experts say that the missile can be loaded by various launchers, such as missile destroyers, escort ships, ground mobile launchers and fighters now possessed by the "Self-Defense Forces", analyzing that its firing range is second only to the U.S. Tomahawk cruise missiles in Japan.
Is the continuous development and deployment of different long-range strike means just for the "exclusive defense" as advocated by Japan?
No, it isn't. It is a part of the efforts for winding up its war preparations for launching reinvasion.
Japan is now making desperate efforts to justify its rearmament by trumpeting about "growing threat from neighboring countries" and "deteriorating security environment". And it is constantly filling all the spheres, including the ground, sea and space, with armed forces capable of attacking the neighboring countries by spending huge military expenditure while inciting the atmosphere of praising the past wars of aggression woven with heinous crimes through visits to the Yasukuni Shrine, etc.
Japan increased the import of weapons in 2021-2025 by 76 percent more than that in 2016-2020 and most of them are long-range strike means like Tomahawk cruise missiles. This clearly shows that Japan has recently become more active in securing the "capability of attacking enemy bases".
Japan, which has bolstered up its actual war capability in a diversified way by taking part in all military exercises staged in surrounding areas, is stepping up the deployment of long-range strike means for action while being hell-bent on the development and purchase of them. This fact proves that the time of their use is nearing.
It is needless to say that the targets of the long-range strike means are the neighboring countries including the DPRK, which Japan designated as "imminent threat" and "unprecedentedly biggest strategic challenge".
If Japan continues to behave in a foolish manner in despite of the strong concern and criticism of the world people, it will get involved in the bad thing of crossing the "red line," which surely incurs the "sinking" of the archipelago.
It is a reality that the regional security environment is getting more severe due to the revival of militarism of the war criminal state keen on reinvasion without any slightest guilty conscience of the past crimes. -0-

headline: Moving into New Houses Started in Saeppyol Street
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Moving into new houses started in Saeppyol Street here.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unrecently attended the inauguration ceremony of the new street, which was successfully built in a good place of the Hwasong area as a crystallization of eternal respect and reverence for the war heroes. And he personally gave licenses for the use of the houses to their bereaved families, bestowing great honor on them, and took a benevolent measure to let all of them enjoy a happy life as soon as possible.
The bereaved families, who are to move into modern houses in the capital city under the loving care of the great father, entered the new street amid warm welcome by the commanding officers of the Korean People's Army units and officials in Pyongyang and military-civilian builders engaged in their construction.
Senior Party and government officials including Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, greeted the bereaved families on the spot.
Senior officials of the Party and the government presented bouquets to the bereaved families and warmly congratulated them on moving into new houses. They told the bereaved families about the love and benevolence ofKim Jong Un, saying that he highly values the bereaved families, who instilled ardent patriotism into the war heroes, defenders of the dignity and honor of the country, and inspired them with unyielding strength and courage, and makes efforts to let them enjoy all blessings of socialism before others.
They said that it is the bounden duty of officials and an expression of the moral obligation of the people across the country to the martyrs to take care of the destiny and life of the parents and families of the war heroes with sincerity, adding that they would do their best to make the bereaved families feel the joy of prosperity before others and lead a proud and happy life.
The bereaved families made a pledge of patriotism and loyalty to remain faithful to the ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Unand devote themselves to the prosperity of the country like the heroes who are immortal in the memory of the country and people like a shining star. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Reply Message to Miguel Mario Diaz-Canel Bermudez
story_text:

headline: Noble Patriotic Devotion to Forestation
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Today is the Tree-planting Day in the DPRK.
On the occasion of the day, our people are recollecting with deep emotion the noble patriotic devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has dedicated himself to turning the whole country into a beautiful land with thick green woods.
Kim Jong Unvisited a unit of the Korean People's Army on the Tree-planting Day in 2012 and planted Picea Koraiensiskoreana and magnolia he brought personally. He said that it is the firm determination of the Workers' Party of Korea to turn the mountains and fields of the country into a socialist fairyland covered with green woods through a vigorous tree-planting campaign involving all the masses.
One day when he visited an air force unit which produced the 14 human bombs, he said that the unit should be an example of the entire army even in tree-planting. And he personally set a place for planting trees and planted trees together with pilots.
When planting trees with students at Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, he said that patriotism is not an abstract concept but a noble spirit of valuing even a tree in the country and devoting sweat and sincerity to cultivating it, stressing that patriotism gets stronger when the trees they planted and cultivate grow higher.
The tree-planting, he conducted in the Hwasong area together with the participants in the Second Conference of Secretaries of Primary Committees of the Workers' Party of Korea on the Tree-planting Day in 2022, marked a significant occasion in making all the people keenly realize how to approach the sacred patriotic work for planting the seeds of happiness and cultivating the future with their sweat and efforts.
The beautiful future of the socialist paradise is being brought earlier along with the country's mountains which are getting greener day by day thanks to the noble patriotic will ofKim Jong Unmaking the journey of great patriotic devotion. -0-

headline: Tree-planting Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 14 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK on Saturday dedicate editorials to the Tree-planting Day.
Given the fact that socialist construction has definitely entered the phase of comprehensive development, the issue of properly taking care of mountains covering a large area of the land is an essential undertaking not only for minimizing natural disasters but also for developing the economy and improving the people's living standards, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial.
This is the first year of implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and, at the same time, the first year of the second forest restoration work, the editorial says, and goes on:
Timber is needed for accelerating the building of modern factories and cities and the regional and rural construction and for producing much more coal and ore at coal and ore mines, and the rural economy also requires many trees for its development.
In order to fully solve the problems arising in the forest transformation, including finishing the tree planting in the treeless places in mountains and raw material bases of regional-industry sector during the new five-year plan, it is necessary to bring about innovations in this spring tree-planting campaign.
Only when all mountains are made profitable through afforestation, can the people's life be more abundant and the national power be increased to the maximum.
Forest is a precious asset of the country and a wealth to be handed down to posterity.
Minju Joson in an editorial calls upon all officials and working people to turn out in the spring tree-planting campaign and contribute to making the mountains of the country with green woods through their patriotic, sincere sweat and efforts. -0-

headline: IT Means for Monitoring Forest-fire Introduced in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, IT means for monitoring forest-fire are introduced in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
The province is providing equipment necessary for the city and county forest sectors and taking measures to supply electricity to them so that the equipment can be operated on a normal basis.
Attention is also paid to increasing the utilization rate and accuracy of monitoring equipment as a system has been established for monitoring forest-fire in real time in more than 10 places including Mt Kuwol and Mt Jangsu.
Several forest management stations have set up a dual power supply system to ensure the operation of equipment without interruption.
The province conducts the work in a methodological way to generalize to cities and counties the experience of Sinwon County which established an instant monitoring system capable of informing accidents happened in the course of monitoring forest-fire. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: KPA Long-range Artillery Sub-unit in Western Area Conducts Firepower Strike Drill
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) -- A long-range artillery sub-unit of the Korean People's Army in the western area conducted a firepower strike drill on March 14.
The drill involved twelve 600mm-calibre ultra-precision multiple rocket launchers and two artillery companies.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, observed the firepower strike drill on the spot.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unstated briefly that the drill was aimed at making the army do what it should do.
He said that the drill would expose the forces hostile to the DPRK, the enemies within the 420-km striking range, to uneasiness, making a signaling wave stronger than the aimed, and give them a deep understanding of the destructive power of tactical nuclear weapon.
He affirmed that the drill is a regular one for checking the DPRK's defensive posture and war deterrence and such drill will be frequently conducted in the future, too.
He authorized Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration accompanying him, to command the drill, and came out to the launching position to give an instruction on the firing method.
At the central command post, Jang Chang Ha gave an order to open fire.
Making the deafening sound rending the air, multiple rocket companies opened fire in waves.
The launched rockets battered the island target in the East Sea of Korea about 364.4 km away with the accuracy of 100 percent, proving once again the destructive capability of their concentration strike and the system's military value once again.
After overseeing the firing drill, he spoke highly of the soldiers of the artillery sub-unit for being prepared for deftly handling the state-of-the-art multiple rocket launcher system. Then he once again praised the combat performance of the 600mm-calibre ultra-precision multiple rocket launchers, saying:
"It is indeed a very deadly yet attractive weapon.
Worldwide, there exists no tactical weapon that surpasses the performance of this weapon system.
This will be so in the coming few years.
Certainly, however, we will never mark time till that time, being content with this.
I always hold our defence scientists in respect and appreciate them for developing such a weapon system.
As I have already stated, our powerful attacking capability is, in effect, for defending ourselves.
It is because the most powerful attacking capability precisely means a reliable defence capability.
It is, in the true sense of the word, a means of deterring war.
But in case such deterrents of a defensive nature do not prevent foreign forces from launching an armed provocation or invading our state to jeopardize the security of its sovereignty, they will immediately be used for their second mission, i.e., as a means of massive, destructive strike.
As I have said several times, if this weapon is used, the opponent's military infrastructure within its striking range can never survive.
Our Party and the government of the Republic will maintain durable peace by means of powerful military capabilities.
Peace is something that should be defended rather than desired."
Kim Jong Unstressed the need for all units of the army at different levels to organize and wage high-intensity practical maneuvers under the simulated conditions of an actual war, true to the Party's policy of bringing about a radical turn in training, and maintain their full response posture to thoroughly frustrate any provocation by the enemies with overwhelmingly strong power. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Plants Trees in Saeppyol Street on Tree-planting Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 15 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, planted trees at the pondside park in Saeppyol Street on March 14, the tree-planting day.
Present at the tree planting were major leading cadres of the Party and the government, families of the martyrs of the overseas military operations who moved into their new houses in Saeppyol Street, officials of the Party and power organs in Hwasong District and students of revolutionary schools.
The participants were filled with great excitement and joy as they were to plant trees in the presence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unin Saeppyol Street, a new street in the capital city where all the people across the country pay their respect and which represents the honor of our generation and pride of our state.
Ri Il Hwan, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a speech on tree planting.
He said today's tree-planting ceremony, held along with the start of the spring in 2026, is a manifestation of the sincerity to always remember the true patriots who added a new page to the history of the DPRK's glorious dignity and to add luster to the desire of the martyrs who wished their beloved motherland eternal prosperity with youthfulness, and an expression of the noble will to spruce up the country more beautifully and improve the environment of the capital city more wonderfully.
Noting that the unanimous intention and mind cherished in the hearts of all the people are to be planted together with trees, he added that it represents the sincerest love and thanks to the heroes and the patriotic mission and mind, fervent and invariable like theirs.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, together with other participants, planted for a long time the trees which will become new witnesses to the prospering capital city, saying that the true image of our generation following the noble spirit of heroic soldiers and reliably carrying forward the tradition of invincibility should be reflected, along with the history of the country growing stronger, in every tree that will grow with the souls of the martyrs of the overseas military operations, adding beauty to the landscape of Saeppyol Street full of joy of moving into new houses.
He said that the martyrs of the overseas military operations were the ardent ones who loved their native places, parents, wives and children more warmly than any others, and the ones strong in their ideological and mental power who turned the flavor and beautiful memory of the hometown, provided by a handful of earth they each had taken in the homeland, into their indomitable heroism under a shower of fire on the alien battlefields.
He hoped that the noble spirit of the martyrs would deeply permeate this land to build a solid pillar of patriotism in the hearts of all the people and help train all the coming generations to be the most righteous human beings.
Patriotism is the source of enthusiasm giving birth to the unlimited miraculous might and the driving force for creation and changes, he said, adding we will surely build a prosperous and strong country, the most powerful one in the world, by dint of great patriotism.
The participants lavished their sincerity on tree planting, cherishing the noble intention of the great father as the immutable truth and true value of patriotism.
The meaningful tree planting in Saeppyol Street, which took place in the presence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, was an event of great significance that added vitality to the capital city and the great country to be eternally thriving and implanted true patriotism in the minds of the people. -0-

headline: Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech to Workers and Officials of Chonsong Youth Coal Mine
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvoted in the election of deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly at the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine and made a speech to the workers and officials of the coal mine.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Dear voters,
Workers and officials of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, who are working with devotion for the country’s prosperity at an outpost of our self-supporting economy,
Comrades,
Today, here at the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, one of the leading coal mines in our country, I voted for a representative to the supreme power organ of our state.
I feel very pleased to have voted for a working-class candidate on the day of election to the Supreme People’s Assembly, the 15th of its kind in the history of our Republic, and to be seeing you, coal miners, whom I have always respected in my mind.
I would like to avail myself of this opportunity to extend warm encouragement to the workers and officials of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, who are reliably defending a part of the coal-mining front with a pure heart of faithfully and sincerely supporting the Party and the state and through an indomitable labour struggle.
I also express my gratitude to all the voters across the country, who are taking an active part in the election of the Deputies with a faith and pride in our socialist cause, with the awareness of being masters of state power and with patriotic enthusiasm.
I am in firm belief that, through today’s election, our people’s power will be consolidated as firm as a rock once again with the genuine representatives of the people and the functions and role of our Republic’s government further enhanced as required by the new stage of transformation.
Comrades,
Today is a significant day when the coal miners of Chonsong elect their representative who will take part in administering state affairs.
Every citizen of our Republic exercises the right to vote, but I don’t think it is easy for everyone to go to the polls with great pride and honour.
In our country advancing the socialist cause while blazing a new path of history, the working class is the most powerful force of creation and transformation and the vanguard that leads the whole society by dint of steadfast revolutionary spirit and noble traits.
Among them, the workers in the coal-mining sector are the hard core of the country performing the most valuable feats in the vanguard of state building.
The achievements the coal miners here in Chonsong made through a devoted struggle also formed part of the cornerstones of the steps of eye-opening advance and development our state ascended in the especially difficult and arduous last decade.
By writing an admirable chronicle of struggle in every decade of the revolution in defending the lifeline of the national economy and the rejuvenation and prosperity of the country, they have made uninterrupted innovations in coal production, rising up more vigorously without hesitation even in the face of hardships in the recent years.
It is impossible to describe their painstaking efforts with a few words.
I cannot but feel deep reverence for them to think that there is the path of patriotism the most beautiful and purest persons follow all their life under this ground people tread on casually and that the traces of unyielding efforts are unmistakable at every bend of the path.
There are a lot of families of patriotic miners working here at this colliery for three generations. Without genuine affection for this country, they could not have worked in such deep pits generation after generation–a job which other people find it hard to engage in.
As they are honest citizens who live for the good of their country with such faith and conscience, our coal miners are all the more valuable and trustworthy.
I would like to offer my heartfelt thanks to you again for your patriotic heart of devoting your precious sweat and enthusiasm unsparingly to the buildup of the lifeline of our self-supporting economy and to the stronger pulse of our era, as well as for your heroic struggle for, and exploits in, supporting our Party and state with devoted efforts at deep underground pits.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I also extend warm greetings to the miners’ wives and mothers who are making sincere, devoted efforts for the country’s coal production, sharing mind with their husbands and children, and also to the retired meritorious miners.
Comrades,
Coal is, as ever, the food for our industry and driving force for the development of our self-supporting economy.
The faster our progress gets and the faster our ideals turn into reality, the more urgent the need for coal is.
The fuel and raw materials for the backbone industries that serve as an engine of our state in pursuing prosperity and rejuvenation come just from coal.
For this reason, the Ninth Party Congress held recently set it as the struggle target of the coal-mining industry for the coming five years to boost its output 1.2 times what it is now.
As the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine has dug mountains of coal with great patriotic enthusiasm from each of the pits sharing their lifeline with the capital city of Pyongyang all the time, I believe that the mine will play the active role of a powerful engine in the lead of the struggle to attain the target of the new five-year plan by displaying such daring fighting morale and mettle.
You have been heroic and innovative, and I hope you will continue to exalt your great honour as eternal pacesetters and paragons of the coal-mining industry.
Comrades,
The Party Congress decided it as a major strategic task during the new long-term plan to build dwellings for coal miners, facelift the coal-mining areas and technically upgrade the coal-mining industry.
In the era, when the whole country is undergoing transformation and making progress, it is an important task which brooks no further delay and slackness and which our Party and state have to carry out without fail.
Along with another resolute revolution to eliminate the backward appearance of the coal-miners’ villages far removed from the country’s prestige and the requirements of the times, the most advanced new life and new culture of the working class will take its undisputed position in the centre of our times.
Comrades,
It is unavoidable for us to face challenges and obstacles in the way of our advance, but the citizens of our Republic who love their state and system and cherish steadfast faith in socialism and indomitable revolutionary spirit will always achieve successful results on the strength of their concerted efforts and unity.
Respected comrade coal miners in Chonsong,
The Party Central Committee firmly believes in you.
Let us achieve our beautiful and sacred ideals without fail, giving full play to the dignity and courage, wisdom and bravery of the heroic working class.
Let us make more passionate, innovative and persistent efforts to glorify ours as a country which will be powerful and prosperous for ever.
I wish all the coal miners of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine good health and their families delight and happiness. -0-

headline: Exemplary Agitators and Announcers Tour Area of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- Exemplary agitators and announcers of loudspeaker vans made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu from March 9 to 15.
At Chongbong and Konchang bivouacs, they grasped once again the immortal feats of PresidentKim Il Sungwho led the anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory with his original guerrilla tactics to accomplish the historic cause of national liberation.
At ChairmanKim Jong Il's birthplace in the Paektusan Secret Camp, they looked back upon the sacred revolutionary career and exploits ofKim Jong Ilwho was born as the son of Mt Paektu and made a long journey of devotion for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people all his life.
With a resolve to arm themselves more firmly with the great ideas and spirit of the revolutionary traditions of Paektu, they stepped up the march, singing revolutionary songs, to climb Mt Paektu.
Then they toured Mupho Bivouac, Taehongdan Revolutionary Battle Site, etc. while training their bodies and minds in the revolutionary spirit of Paektu.
At the Samjiyon Revolutionary Museum, they recollected the immortal feats of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who turned the area of Mt Paektu into a revolutionary university and Samjiyon City into a model of world-class cultured mountainous town.
They held a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and a poem-reciting meeting during their march.
And they went round various places of Samjiyon City. -0-

headline: Foreigners and Compatriots in China Visit Polling Stations in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- Diplomatic envoys and staff members of Russian, Swedish, Czech Republic, Polish and Bulgarian embassies here and China-resident Koreans staying in the homeland visited several polling stations in Pyongyang for the election of deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on March 15.
At the Sub-constituency No. 77 under the Constituency No. 3, the Sub-constituency No. 39 under the Constituency No. 10 and the Sub-constituency No. 17 under the Constituency No. 22, the visitors came to have a deep understanding of the democratic and people-oriented election system of the DPRK which comprehensively expresses the will of the people and ensures their rights and interests to the maximum in establishing the national sovereignty.
They were deeply moved to see the voters filled with joy at the fact that they have contributed to firmly consolidating the people's power and demonstrating once again the might of the single-minded unity of Juche Korea rallied close around its leader. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed in his important concluding speech at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea that as we have lifted the ideas of "The people are god", single-hearted unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance during the years of the eighth term of the Party Central Committee, we should invariably be faithful to the three ideas during the years of its ninth term.
The ideas of "The people are god", single-hearted unity and self-reliance are the powerful driving force for accelerating the comprehensive development of Korean-style socialism.
The ideal, goal and rate of advance of the DPRK are steadily changing and developing, but the above-said ideas peculiar to the Korean revolution are immutable and their inexhaustible strength is confidently pushing socialist construction of the DPRK to a bright future.

WPK's Fundamental Idea - "People are God"

"The people are god" is the fundamental idea of the WPK that holds the people in higher esteem with sincerity.
It reflects the constant demand of the WPK to firmly maintain the revolutionary climate of the Party with the whole Party's serving the people as the starting point of Party building and activities and the immutable principle.
We must turn everything desired by the people into brilliant entities and provide them with a new life and civilization in their lifetime, not in the distant future -- This is an invariable principle our Party has consistently maintained in its revolutionary leadership for the past five years.
The construction of 50 000 flats in the capital city, the regional development policy, the programme for the rural revolution, the socialist policy for the younger generation and the new childcare policy, all of which were set forth by the WPK, are based on the idea of "The people are god" of our Party which regards the people's intense desire as the starting point for formulating lines and policies and the realization of their dreams and ideals as the principle of its activities.
Our Party, which regards the idea as its noble political idea and creed, has taken practical measures to let the people substantially benefit from its people-oriented policies at the plenary meetings of the Party Central Committee and other major party meetings and made strenuous efforts to implement them.
The leadership of our Party with the high spirit of selfless, devoted service to the people is making a history of love in which it burdens itself with full responsibility to take care of them to the last. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Votes in Election of SPA Deputies and Encourages Workers at Chonsong Youth Coal Mine
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK took place at all the constituencies across the country on March 15 when the whole country was overflowing with the people's joy and excitement of greeting the historic day which would serve as an occasion to further consolidate the people-centered socialist system of Korean style and provide a powerful sovereign guarantee for the comprehensive development of the state.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex to vote at the polling station of the Sub-constituency No. 48 under the Constituency No. 150 for the election of SPA deputies.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the polling station, the coal miners and residents there broke into enthusiastic cheers, representing their boundless emotion and delight of being honored to have him, whom they longed to see even in their dreams, at their constituency on the meaningful election day which would serve as an occasion to consolidate the supreme power of the DPRK as firm as a rock with the hands of the people according to their will.
Kim Jong Unproceeded to the polling station, extending warm gratitude to the coal miners for having increased coal production to positively contribute to the development of the national economy with pure loyalty and gem-like patriotism to the Party and the revolution, the country and the people.
He was courteously greeted by Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, and leading officials of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine.
Accompanying him were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Tok Hun and Kim Yo Jong, senior officials of the Party and the government.
Kim Jong Unreceived a voting card from the chairperson of the election committee and voted for Jo Chol Ho, manager of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex who is a SPA deputy candidate.
He met and had a conversation with Jo. He warmly encouraged Jo, hoping that Jo would faithfully discharge his responsibility and duty as a genuine representative of the people, a person directly engaged in sovereign activities and a political activist, deeply mindful that the trust and expectation of the coal miners and residents there mean the earnest requests of the country and the people.
Then he made a historic important speech to the voters of the coal mine.
All the participants were deeply moved by the passionate speech ofKim Jong Unwho most highly appreciated the pure conscience and unknown efforts of the coal miners on behalf of the country and the times and unfolded a bright blueprint for transforming the coal mines across the country.
WhenKim Jong Unfinished his speech, they raised enthusiastic cheers, representing their boundless thanks to the outstanding leader of our revolution, the benevolent father of the people.
He learned about the conditions and production of the coal mine.
Underscoring again the importance of the coal industry's mission and role in ensuring the stable and sustained development of the national economy, he said that to shore up the coal front is a keystone of strategic significance not only in fulfilling the new five-year plan but also in developing the country in a forward-looking way.
He said that just as it is necessary to raise good crops for the living of the people, it is needed to increase the coal production for the running of a state. He stressed that the Party and the state should attach importance to the production of coal, the food of industry, and increase the state investment to it. He added that to build the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine into a standard one, where the mechanization and informatization of the work inside its pits are realized, is a starting point of the long-term project to transform the material and technical foundations of all the coal mines across the country and the working conditions of coal miners.
Whenever he looked back upon the arduous journey of our victorious struggle, he first thought of the unknown efforts of coal miners and always felt thankful for them, he said, adding that we should spare nothing for the coal miners. And he affirmed that it is the firm determination of the Party Central Committee to turn all the coal-mining villages into modern and cultural villages and towns during its ninth term, just like the Komdok area which has been ideally transformed in recent years, and that short-, medium- and long-term strategy for realizing it will be discussed at an earlier date.
That day,Kim Jong Unhad a significant photo session with coal miners, labor innovators and officials of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine in commemoration of his visit to it.
At the end of the photo session, the participants again broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up toKim Jong Un, which shook the mountains of the Chonsong area.
Warmly encouraging the coal miners full of great excitement,Kim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that the workers of the coal mine would glorify the first year of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress with proud successes in increased production in redoubled and uplifted spirit filled with fresh confidence and optimism.
The workers of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, deeply moved by strong passion and affection, warm love and trust of the great father, firmly pledged to demonstrate their absolute support for the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK through patriotic efforts for increased coal production and reliably guarantee the prosperity and development of the DPRK, bearing deeper in mind the honorable sense of obligation of defending the outpost for the development of the self-supporting economy.
Kim Jong Un's visit to the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine marked a historic occasion that finally broke with the technical and cultural backwardness in the coal industry and declared a fresh start for civilization and modernization, and an important political occasion that injected great vitality into the dynamic advance of the DPRK towards the comprehensive development. -0-

headline: Report of Central Election Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- The central election committee for the election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following report on March 15:
The election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is going on under the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels, amid the positive and unparalleled enthusiasm of all the voters to demonstrate the advantages and solidity of our state power with the people-first principle as its inherent political climate.

headline: Pang Chol Mi - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons for 2025
Pang Chol Mi - One of DPRK's Ten Best Sportspersons for 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 16 (KCNA) -- People's Athlete Pang Chol Mi, a boxer of the Kumgangsan Sports Club, is one of the ten best players of the DPRK for 2025.
This is the fifth time she has been listed as one of the ten best players of the DPRK.
She won gold medals at the IBA Women's World Boxing Championships in 2018 and 2025 and became a twice world championship holder.
At last year's championships, she inflicted a standing count on her several opponents, demonstrating the power of her iron fists.
It is IBA members' view that she is a world-class good player who can win the world championship again.
She was born into an ordinary farmer's family in Jongju City, North Phyongan Province.
She learned the basic boxing technique at the then Jongju City Juvenile Sports School and distinguished herself in national games, drawing the attention of experts.
She proved successful at the DPRK Championships in 2021, the 18th and 19th Asian Games, the 33rd Olympic Games and other national and international games.
She is now training hard after setting a higher goal of becoming a thrice world championship holder. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations under Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave on-site guidance at the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations under construction on March 16.
Accompanying him were the members of the WPK Central Military Commission, senior officials of the Party Central Committee and generals of the Korean People's Army.
He was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the military units involved in the construction and officials of the designing and creation institutions.
The construction is now under way at 93 percent of the total project.
Going round the interior of the memorial museum, the heroes' cemetery area, the captured weapons exhibition area and other places of the construction site, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the finishing project and the installation of sculptures and symbolic memorials.
Pointing out some irrational elements of the interior of the memorial museum, he clarified the direction of correcting them and gave detailed instructions on ensuring the highest quality in the finishing project.
He stressed once again the important significance of this construction project, saying that the memorial museum should be an aggregate showing the level of our architecture and fine art creation.
The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats will be inaugurated on the occasion of the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk, he said, giving an instruction that the service personnel, designers and creators, involved in the noble work for recording in history forever the matchless bravery and mass heroism displayed by our soldiers at overseas military operations, should successfully complete the memorial museum as an immortal sacred sanctuary with the solemn reverence of all the people. -0-

headline: Press Release of Central Election Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- The Central Election Committee for the Election of Deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press release on March 16:
The successful election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK took place on March 15, 2026, amid high political enthusiasm of all the voters at a time when the whole country launched a new gigantic struggle for greater creation and transformation along the brilliant path indicated by the Ninth Congress of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
The election was held in strict conformity with the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels.
All the voters, well aware of the importance of the voting card associated with the highest dignity and honor of their great country, took part in the election with solemn reverence for the DPRK national emblem and flag shining brightly at the polling stations.
According to the election returns, 99.99 percent of all the voters registered on the voter rolls across the country attended the election. 0.0037 percent of the voters failed to take part in the election as they are currently abroad or working in oceans and 0.00003 percent abstained.
99.93 percent of the electors balloted for and 0.07 percent against. As a result, under the Law of the DPRK on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels, 687 workers, farmers, intellectuals, servicepersons and officials were elected to be SPA deputies.
The result shows that, as patriotic citizens who have dedicated themselves to the country and the people, the elected SPA deputies have necessary qualification and ability of a state political activist for fulfilling important mission and responsibility in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Ninth WPK Congress, as required by the new period of great upsurge.
Through the election, all the voters clearly demonstrated their ardent desire and self-confidence to reliably defend their glorious state political system and successfully realize all ideals and happiness on the great strength of loyalty and patriotism.
The DPRK is the eternal state of the people and its national sovereignty is the one of the people being built by all the Korean people.
The election of deputies to the 15th SPA of the DPRK marked an important political occasion in further glorifying the great state-building ideas and exploits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand providing the powerful sovereign guarantee for accelerating the prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism, true to the fighting programme set forth by the Ninth WPK Congress.

headline: Notice about Convocation of DPRK SPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- The First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK will be convened in Pyongyang on March 22, 2026.
The session is to deliberate on the election of the president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the elections of the state leadership and sub-committees of the SPA, the revision and supplement of the Socialist Constitution, the issue of carrying through the Five-Year Plan for National Economic Development formulated by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, and the fulfillment of state budget for 2025 and the state budget for 2026.
Deputy registration will take place on March 21, 2026.
The SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK issued a relevant notice on March 16. -0-

headline: Press Release of Central Election Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- The Central Election Committee for the Election of Deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press release on March 16:
The successful election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK took place on March 15, 2026, amid high political enthusiasm of all the voters at a time when the whole country launched a new gigantic struggle for greater creation and transformation along the brilliant path indicated by the Ninth Congress of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
The election was held in strict conformity with the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels.
All the voters, well aware of the importance of the voting card associated with the highest dignity and honor of their great country, took part in the election with solemn reverence for the DPRK national emblem and flag shining brightly at the polling stations.
According to the election returns, 99.99 percent of all the voters registered on the voter rolls across the country attended the election. 0.0037 percent of the voters failed to take part in the election as they are currently abroad or working in oceans and 0.00003 percent abstained.
99.93 percent of the electors balloted for and 0.07 percent against. As a result, under the Law of the DPRK on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels, 687 workers, farmers, intellectuals, servicepersons and officials were elected to be SPA deputies.
The result shows that, as patriotic citizens who have dedicated themselves to the country and the people, the elected SPA deputies have necessary qualification and ability of a state political activist for fulfilling important mission and responsibility in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Ninth WPK Congress, as required by the new period of great upsurge.
Through the election, all the voters clearly demonstrated their ardent desire and self-confidence to reliably defend their glorious state political system and successfully realize all ideals and happiness on the great strength of loyalty and patriotism.
The DPRK is the eternal state of the people and its national sovereignty is the one of the people being built by all the Korean people.
The election of deputies to the 15th SPA of the DPRK marked an important political occasion in further glorifying the great state-building ideas and exploits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand providing the powerful sovereign guarantee for accelerating the prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism, true to the fighting programme set forth by the Ninth WPK Congress.
After examining the reports on election returns submitted by all constituency committees across the country, the Central Election Committee for the Election of Deputies to the 15th SPA of the DPRK announces the following list of the elected SPA deputies:

headline: Senior Middle School Graduates Volunteer for Forefront Border Military Posts
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- Senior middle school graduates in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered for military service in the forefront border posts.
Those in Sunchon City, firmly determined to devotedly defend the country with arms, petitioned their youth league organization to send them to the forefront posts.
Those in Phyongsong City vowed to stand at the posts of national defence.
Those in Songchon County are replete with a strong will to record military feats on their autobiographies before anything else.
Those in Hoechang, Sukchon and other counties, too, have a burning patriotic desire to glorify every moment of their military service with feats by learning from the spiritual world of heroic soldiers who fought in the Fatherland Liberation War and soldiers who participated in overseas military operations.
Those in Mundok and Pukchang counties, Anju City and other regions vowed to glorify the honor of soldiers and return to their alma maters as heroes, hardening their will to frustrate the enemies' moves for provoking a nuclear war and defend the sovereignty of the country and the security of the people. -0-

headline: Timber Production Goes up in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, 19 units in the forestry sector of the DPRK have fulfilled their yearly timber production plans.
The Hwaphyong Forestry Station under the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau and Jangjin, Toan and other forestry stations under the South Hamgyong Provincial Forestry Management Bureau set an example in the timber production by developing methods for increasing production while rationally organizing manpower and conducting technical innovation emulations in conformity with the conditions of felling places.
The timber producers at various units of Ryanggang and North Hamgyong provincial forestry management bureaus, including Paekja, Tokrip, Yonsa and Yonsang forestry stations, have over-fulfilled their daily assignments by boosting cooperation among processes.
Various units of North Phyongan and Kangwon provincial forestry management bureaus, too, increased the proportion of mechanization and conducted mass movements to record high results in carrying out their process-by-process plans. -0-

headline: Many DPRK Women Volunteer for Worksites to Implement Decisions of WPK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of women in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK have volunteered for worksites seething with a drive for increased production and creation.
Members of the women's union in Rinsan, Hwangju and Koksan counties volunteered to work at building-materials production bases and regional-industry factories, and those in Pongsan County petitioned their organizations to send them to the regional-industry factories to be newly built.
Among the women's union members who pledged to go to the places called by the Workers' Party of Korea are housewives in Yonthan, Sinphyong and Junghwa counties volunteering to work at raw material base stations.
Women's union members in Songnim City and Unpha County are full of enthusiasm to harvest bumper crops on every field as the performers and masters of the rural revolution.
Women in Sariwon City and Singye, Sohung and Sangwon counties vowed to take part in public life, out of their mind to contribute to demonstrating the validity and vitality of the Party's policies.
Officials and members of the women's union in the relevant regions saw off the volunteers leaving for their new posts, giving bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Shepherd's Purse Used as Spring Dish
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- From olden times, the Korean people have gathered many edible herbs in mountains and fields in spring to process them in various ways to stimulate their appetite.
Among them is shepherd's purse with rich protein, inorganic matters and vitamins.
In early spring, the Korean people have dug up shepherd's purse and then boiled soup with it or seasoned it with spices after parboiling it.
According to a book dating back to the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910), the shepherd's purse soup was one of the most popular spring dishes.
Ri Kyu Bo, a famous poet of Koryo period (918-1392), wrote a poem on delicious shepherd's purse soup.
The shepherd's purse soup, boiled with rice-washed water and peppered bean mash and shellfish, has a good taste and peculiar smell. It is good to restore energy in early spring when people feel languid and lose their appetite.
The shepherd's purse dish, seasoned with peppered bean mash and spices, is also popular among people.
The dishes made of shepherd's purse, efficacious for hypertention and arteriosclerosis, have been widely used in the diet of the people until now. -0-

headline: Motivation Activities for Increased Production Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- Art troupes and artistic information teams in the capital city of Pyongyang are conducting motivation activities for increased production at factories and enterprises.
Singing revolutionary songs at the Sangwon Cement Complex, the members of the central artistic information team encouraged its workers to produce even a ton of more cement necessary for the grand construction projects, mindful of the noble intention and love of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho visited the complex soon after the Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Members of the motivation team of artistes from national art troupes and the workers' artistic information team of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea boosted the workers' spirit of advance at the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex.
Artistes of the Mansudae Art Troupe gave performances at various coal mines under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, calling for glorifying this year with proud labor achievements.
At the Taean Heavy Machine Complex and the Kumsong Tractor Factory, members of the film artistes' information team boosted the revolutionary enthusiasm of working people putting spurs to the development of the country's machine industry and the realization of mechanization of the countryside, singing famous songs of the times and performing numbers reflecting the Party's policies and the spirit of general advance.
At the Chilgol Vegetable Farm in Mangyongdae District and the Oryu Vegetable Farm in Sadong District, the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea encouraged the farmers devoting their sweat and efforts to the farm fields. -0-

headline: Press Release of Central Election Committee
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 17 (KCNA) -- The Central Election Committee for the Election of Deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press release on March 16:
The successful election of deputies to the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK took place on March 15, 2026, amid high political enthusiasm of all the voters at a time when the whole country launched a new gigantic struggle for greater creation and transformation along the brilliant path indicated by the Ninth Congress of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
The election was held in strict conformity with the Law on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels.
All the voters, well aware of the importance of the voting card associated with the highest dignity and honor of their great country, took part in the election with solemn reverence for the DPRK national emblem and flag shining brightly at the polling stations.
According to the election returns, 99.99 percent of all the voters registered on the voter rolls across the country attended the election. 0.0037 percent of the voters failed to take part in the election as they are currently abroad or working in oceans and 0.00003 percent abstained.
99.93 percent of the electors balloted for and 0.07 percent against. As a result, under the Law of the DPRK on the Elections of Deputies to the People's Assemblies at All Levels, 687 workers, farmers, intellectuals, servicepersons and officials were elected to be SPA deputies.
The result shows that, as patriotic citizens who have dedicated themselves to the country and the people, the elected SPA deputies have necessary qualification and ability of a state political activist for fulfilling important mission and responsibility in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Ninth WPK Congress, as required by the new period of great upsurge.
Through the election, all the voters clearly demonstrated their ardent desire and self-confidence to reliably defend their glorious state political system and successfully realize all ideals and happiness on the great strength of loyalty and patriotism.
The DPRK is the eternal state of the people and its national sovereignty is the one of the people being built by all the Korean people.
The election of deputies to the 15th SPA of the DPRK marked an important political occasion in further glorifying the great state-building ideas and exploits of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand providing the powerful sovereign guarantee for accelerating the prosperity and development of Korean-style socialism, true to the fighting programme set forth by the Ninth WPK Congress.
After examining the reports on election returns submitted by all constituency committees across the country, the Central Election Committee for the Election of Deputies to the 15th SPA of the DPRK announces the following list of the elected SPA deputies:

headline: Sangwon Cement Complex Takes Lead in Implementing Decisions of Party Congress: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- The workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex are steadily making bold innovations by challenging the limits in high spirits. They are an honorable model and precious example of the times that translates the idea and spirit of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea into practice, says Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial.
Today when a new era of comprehensive national rejuvenation has been ushered in, the Sangwon Cement Complex represents the indomitable spirit of the DPRK people who are steadily advancing and making innovations, knowing no impossibility, the editorial says, and goes on:
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unpaid a congratulatory visit to the Sangwon Cement Complex and made a significant speech of encouragement. In his speech, he affirmed that the soaring patriotic enthusiasm and mettle for increased production, which the Sangwon workers display in making continuous innovations and advance, would constitute an absolute support for our Party's ideology and cause and a torch inspiring the whole country to a heroic struggle.
The Sangwon workers understand the Party's plan, determination, worry and agony before anybody else and support the Party's plan and determination with boundless loyalty. This is their noble mental world.
The torch of the Sangwon is a manifestation of the single-hearted unity demonstrating the might of strong socialist Korea, in which all the people are closely rallied around the Party Central Committee, and a dreadful blow to the hostile forces trying to check the advance of our state and an extremely delightful gun-report of victory.
To make the torch of heroic struggle, raised by Sangwon, flare up all over the country is the solemn call of our Party at present, the earnest demand of this exciting era and the ardent desire of the people that can be felt everywhere on this land.
The editorial stresses that the DPRK's spirit of advance toward the comprehensive rejuvenation will get more dynamic and its development speed will be remarkably accelerated as there are a model group leading the times and the people keeping pace with it. -0-

headline: Moving into New Flats in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's grand plan for the capital city construction and energetic leadership, the construction of 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area was completed. The new street is full of the excitement and joy of the owners of new houses who came to enjoy socialist civilization.
Officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang and builders congratulated those on moving into new flats with the licenses for the use of houses.
The working people were greatly excited by their new flats, looking round several rooms of the flats overflowing with the parental love ofKim Jong Un.
Rim Chun Sil, who presented a bouquet toKim Jong Unat the significant inauguration ceremony, said that families of ordinary people like her could receive the wonderful flats free of charge, thanks toKim Jong Unwho regards the people as in Heaven.
Ri Hye Suk, a war veteran, said that she received a new flat in the Hwasong area wonderfully built as an ideal street of the people under the loving care ofKim Jong Un, expressing her mind to fulfill the duty of the victorious wartime generation in glorifying the grateful social system generation after generation.
Yu Yong Guk and Ri Kyong Chol, special-class disabled soldiers, said that the Workers' Party of Korea, which bestows all kinds of loving care for the disabled soldiers, gave modern new flats to them before anyone else in consideration of the number of floors and is meticulously taking care of them so that they may not feel any inconvenience in their lives. They vowed to support the motherland as they did in the days of their military service.
The flats of families of discharged officers, educators, many children and other families were full of the boundless gratitude to the motherly Party, which brings the people's joy, laughter and happiness into full bloom, and the single mind of loyalty and patriotism to fulfill their duties better for the prosperity of the country.
Every flat was full of the pride of people who enjoy all blessings, holding in high esteem the respected MarshalKim Jong Unas the benevolent father of the large socialist family, along with songs "Dear Father" and "We Are the Happiest in the World". -0-

headline: Request with Deep Trust
story_text:
One day in September 2016, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unassigned officials detailed tasks and ways for building dwelling houses for the people before winter through a vigorous campaign for the recovery from flood damage in North Hamgyong Province.
However, one problem that concerned him very much was cement.
He entrusted the Sangwon Cement Complex with the task of taking the lead in the campaign and asked officials to convey to its workers his request for the production of cement needed for the recovery from flood damage.
The officials were deeply moved by his remarks, looking up to him who made a request to ordinary workers.
After receiving his remarks, the officials and workers of the complex produced and supplied the whole amount of cement needed for the recovery without fail in time.
It was because that his great trust implied in his request gave them infinite strength. -0-

headline: Reception Marking Significant Day between DPRK and Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here, hosted a reception at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on March 17 to mark the 77th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations of the DPRK, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials concerned.
Staff members of the Russian embassy were on hand.
Speeches were made at the reception. -0-
