headline: Moving into New Flats in Hwasong Area
Immutable Ideas of WPK (2)
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Single-hearted unity, the mainstay of the Korean revolution and an invincible weapon, is the revolutionary philosophy of the Workers' Party of Korea that is accelerating the comprehensive development of socialism by dint of one ideology and will and noble moral obligation.
The single-hearted unity of the Korean people rallied around the Party is the cornerstone of Korean-style socialism.
The past five years were a period when the unity and creativity of the masses were oriented to the triumphant conclusion of the first stage struggle for pioneering and transformation of the comprehensive development of socialism under the leadership of the Party holding aloft the banner of single-hearted unity.
By giving priority to the ideological work, the WPK has made the masses understand the truth and validity of its policies and turn out in implementing them, and kindled the flames of the socialist patriotic movement, revolutionary mass movement, to bring about a steady upsurge in the overall socialist construction by dint of unity based on one ideology and will.
Amid the remarkably growing enthusiasm to work new miracles and create new records, many people and youths volunteered for major worksites of socialist construction in response to the call of the Party.
Last year alone, the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex kindled the torch for miraculous increased production to glorify 2025 as an eventful year of perfectly implementing the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK and a year of change pioneering the upward trend towards a new stage of development. It burst into the flames of mass innovation movement throughout the country and, as a result, proud successes were achieved in all fields of socialist construction.
In those days the single-hearted unity reached the highest level and a new trend of the comprehensive development of socialism was pioneered.
The undertakings to realize the long-cherished desire, which were thought to be realized in the distant future, have been translated into reality of the present times. It is a powerful proof of the viability of the idea of the single-hearted unity upheld by our Party.
Over the past five years the Korean people have cherished the firm faith that the Party's policies are the absolute truth and the guarantee for accelerating the comprehensive development of socialism lies in implementing the Party's policies. -0-

headline: Development of Light Industry in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- In hearty response to the important tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the light industry sector of the DPRK is endeavoring to produce more consumer goods for the people.
In recent years, many modern consumer goods production bases conducive to improving the people's standard of living have been built or remodeled, and it resulted in an increase of the variety of consumer goods needed for the daily life of the people and considerable improvement of their qualities, giving pleasure to the people.
The reality witnessing the rapid development of the country's light industry is an outcome of the Workers' Party of Korea's energetic and devoted leadership.
At the National Meeting of Light Industrial Workers held in March 2013, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the main tasks for putting the light industry of the country on a high level, including radically increasing the production of mass consumer goods and dynamically propelling the work to place the production on a modern and scientific basis.
At the Eighth Congress of the WPK and other important meetings, he indicated the orientation and ways for developing the light industry, including the tasks for pushing ahead with the work for modernizing light industrial factories and building more modern light industrial factories and standard factories in a planned and proactive way and the issue of holding fast to the improvement of the quality of consumer goods as the seed and main direction of the revolution in the light industry.
He visited regional-industry factories and other light industrial factories built as the entities of the Party's Regional Development 20×10 Policy and saw light-industry goods made in the country, including schoolbags, shoes, socks and condiments. And he has made painstaking efforts to provide the people with quality goods.
The light-industry goods exhibitions held in the past few years clearly showed the development of the country's light industry making a leap forward day by day under the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: 2026 Spring National Sports Festival Opens in DPRK
Senior Middle School Graduates Volunteer for Forefront Border Military Posts
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Senior middle school graduates in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered for forefront border military posts.
Those in Chongjin City vowed to steadily carry forward the tradition of victory of our great country at the posts of national defence by emulating the loyalty to the leader and the bravery and patriotic spirit displayed by the defenders of the country in the 1950s.
Those in Kim Chaek City and Hwadae County, too, petitioned their youth league organizations to send them to the forefront military posts.
Those in Myongchon and Onsong counties joined the volunteers' ranks with a resolve to defend the security of the country and the happiness of the people, always mindful of the request of their beloved alma maters and native places.
Meetings to cheer the volunteers took place in relevant cities and counties.
Speakers expressed their determination to perform military feats at the posts of national defence by carrying forward the patriotic spirit of the brave soldiers during the Fatherland Liberation War, who devoted their youth without hesitation to the country and the people under the hail of bullets and bombs, and the soldiers who participated in overseas military operations.
The meetings were followed by contests of singing wartime songs in chorus while marching.
Officials, working people, youth and students encouraged senior middle school graduates enthusiastically singing theme songs for defending the leader and the country while flying high the national flags of the DPRK before the ranks. -0-

Review of Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 18 (KCNA) -- Following are major news items and articles in Rodong Sinmun, a leading newspaper of the DPRK, on Wednesday:
- An article says that after receiving the respected ComradeKim Jong Un's speech to the workers and officials of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, many coal miners across the country vow to live up to his warm affection and trust with increased coal production.
- An editorial calls for making a greater and more vigorous stride of fresh change, following the torch lit at the Sangwon Cement Complex.

headline: New Stamps Produced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- The State Stamp Bureau of the DPRK has produced new stamps (two sheets and six individuals) in commemoration of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Seen in the sheets bearing letters "Ninth WPK Congress" together with the Party emblem is the ennobling image of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who made an important concluding speech at the Party Congress and was elected as the general secretary of the WPK according to the unshakable will and desire of all the delegates and millions of Party members, all other people and service personnel across the country.
The individual stamps visually show the important tasks set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Party.
A stamp dealing with the content of bringing about a fresh turn in strengthening the whole Party and developing its work reflects the ideology of the WPK on dynamically conducting the three revolutions and embodying the principles and requirements of the five-point Party-building programme in the new era in its work and activities while invariably holding high the ideas of "The people are god", single-hearted unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance.
Another stamp bearing such letters as "Strong guarantee for the growth and development of the overall economy by consolidating the production foundations of the key industrial sector in a qualitative way" stresses the importance of the duty and role the metal, chemical, power, coal and machine-building industries have to play in giving continuity to the era of comprehensive national rejuvenation.
One of the stamps deals with the idea of holding fast to the seed improvement, scientific farming, tideland farming, double cropping and land improvement as an important guarantee for increased grain production in the agricultural sector and the idea of boosting the production of consumer goods with the main stress put on the improvement of quality and development of new products and building a new foundation in the light industry.
Another stamp shows the appearance of our country where the capital city and provinces are simultaneously changing. Reflected in it is the patriotic enthusiasm and will of the Korean people to renew the looks of regions and countryside every year through accelerated regional development and rural construction and turn Pyongyang into a world-class city through continued construction project.
There are also stamps reflecting the intention and idea of the WPK that more vigorous struggle should be waged for the development of science and technology and socialist culture and the building of powerful national defence capabilities. -0-

headline: Production of School Uniform Cloth Finished
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill in the DPRK has finished the production of school uniform cloth for new entrants.
The mill took steps to supply raw and other materials and solve the problems arising in production in contact with the Ministry of Light Industry while working out daily plans in a scientific way for the simultaneous production of school uniform and bag cloth.
Soon after the production of cloth, the mill delivered it to relevant sectors and units so that they could produce school uniforms for new entrants as scheduled. -0-

headline: Grand Choruses Given by Senior Middle School Graduates in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- Grand choruses were performed respectively by graduates of senior middle schools in North Phyongan Province and Nampho Municipality of the DPRK.
Put on the stages were numbers reflecting the ideological and moral world of the graduates determined to glorify their life at the outposts of defending the national sovereignty and the people.
The performers expressed their will to glorify their youth at the national defence posts, always keeping in their mind the days when they happily grew up under the loving care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
Mothers of soldiers involved in the overseas military operations took the stages to tell about the love and trust of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea which put the combatants on the meridian of the times as the greatest heroes.
They requested all the graduates to reliably defend the country with arms, holding high the national flag.
The performances demonstrated the mettle of the successors to carry forward the spirit of defending the country displayed by the heroes in the wartime.
Officials and youth league officials in North Phyongan Province and Nampho Municipality enjoyed the performances together with schoolchildren. They encouraged the graduates who volunteered for the national defence posts. -0-

headline: Women's Union Members Volunteer for Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- In recent one month, more than 600 women's union members in North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK volunteered for major worksites to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Women in Sunam and Songphyong districts of Chongjin City petitioned their organizations to dispatch them to school uniform factories.

headline: Spring Bowling Amateurs Tournament Held in DPRK
Crimes of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation, Seen through History
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 19 (KCNA) -- More than a century has passed since Japan and the U.S. cooked up the "Katsura-Taft agreement" with the aim of invading Korea.
Japan and the U.S. had a sinister intention to occupy Korea and furthermore dominate the whole world from long ago, and their moves for aggression became undisguised from the mid-19th century.
Joining hands with each other from the shared interest in aggression to dominate Korea, the then Japanese Prime Minister Taro Katsura and U.S. Secretary of the Army Taft met in Japan in 1905 to conclude the above-said criminal "agreement" in the form of exchanging secret notes.
In what was called "Katsura-Taft agreement", Japan affirmed that the Philippines would be dominated by the U.S. and Japan had no plan to invade the Philippines, and the U.S. recognized Japan's "suzerainty" to Korea.
Japan and the U.S. sought to keep such their illegal crime    buried into oblivion forever. However, the "agreement" was discovered at the U.S. Department of State archives in 20 years.
Japan had been more hell-bent on the scheme to colonialize Korea, after getting assurance for it from the U.S. through the "agreement".
Under the U.S. support and protection, Japan cooked up an illegal and invalid "Ulsa Five-point Treaty" soon after the fabrication of the "agreement", and then invented the "Jongmi Seven-point Treaty" to completely rob Korea of its right to administering its internal affairs.
In 1910, Japan also forged a brigandish "treaty" stipulating that the ruling power over Korea shall be handed over to the Japanese king on a complete and permanent basis and Korea shall be "annexed" to Japan.
Due to the illegal "Katsura-Taft agreement" which provided a crucial precondition for the occupation of Korea by the Japanese imperialists, the Korean people had to be subjected to all disgraces and sufferings as victims of the aggressors for a long time. -0-

headline: Preparations for Rural Construction in DPRK
story_text:

The central headquarters for rural construction has directed efforts to completing the layouts for new rural villages as required by the new policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.
And it has taken steps to supply enough cement for rural construction in close contact with officials in the field of railway transport.
It also urges cities and counties to step up the supply of manpower, the training of skilled builders, the provision of construction equipment and tools and the production of blocks and aggregates.
The Pyongyang municipal headquarters for rural construction has conducted the organizational and political work to ensure that districts and counties make material and technical preparations for rural housing construction this year. As a result, 120 000 cubic meters of mixed aggregates and millions of blocks have been secured so far in the city.
Preparations for rural construction are being made in Sariwon City, Yonthan and Koksan counties and other parts of North Hwanghae Province.
South Hwanghae Province has built up its construction forces while increasing the production of finishing building materials.
North Phyongan Province is carrying on the work to reinforce its city and county construction brigades.
Cities and counties in South Hamgyong Province have updated production lines for coating materials and tiles to expand the capacity.
Cities, counties and districts of North Hamgyong Province cement the foundations for producing sanitary ware, plastic pipes, paint and other finishing building materials.
Officials and working people in various provinces are modernizing the finishing building-materials production processes while paying attention to storing cement for rural construction without any waste. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Coordinated Offensive Tactical Drill of Infantrymen and Tankmen's Sub-units
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Pyongyang Training Base No. 60 under the Capital City Defence Corps of the Korean People's Army on March 19 to oversee a coordinated offensive tactical drill of infantrymen and tankmen's sub-units.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Kim Song Gi, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, and major commanding officers of the KPA.
The tactical drill was aimed at getting familiar with the coordinated order and combat methods in the tactical sub-units' offensive action to expand successes in their attack through an assault of tanks and infantrymen after striking, raiding and occupying the enemy's anti-armor defence line.
Involved in the drill were a company of the cavalry regiment, main armored unit belonging to the reserve operational group of the General Staff, and special operations sub-units.
When the tactical drill was launched, various kinds of attack drones struck the enemy's commanding base and anti-armor firing positions on the basis of real-time reconnaissance data.
Anti-tank missiles of an armored car sub-unit hit targets in salvo under the tactical fire support against the unexpectedly-emerging armored defence means of the enemy.
The rear strike sub-units destroyed the enemy drones and armed helicopters from their ambush position and then raided and occupied the enemy's anti-armor defence line and firing positions to provide the conditions for attack by the tanks and infantrymen.
There took place a demonstration charge by the tank company of the cavalry regiment equipped with new-type main battle tanks.
Through the drill, its aim was attained to confirm the tankmen's capabilities for an actual war and each sub-unit's combat cooperation and action methods according to different tactical missions.
Kim Jong Unsaid that he came to clearly recognize that the principle of intensifying practical trainings under the simulated conditions of an actual war has been adhered to recently in the training of tactical units, too, while seeing all sub-units in the drill share real-time information and ensure the unity of combat cooperation and action under various unexpected and extremely difficult combat situations to break through the enemy's strong anti-armor defence line by means of powerful strike, prompt raid and occupation and high mobility.
Watching with great pleasure the tanks violently make a charge, shaking the earth, he expressed satisfaction that the majestic scene of tanks imposingly advancing forward represents the inherent bravery and pluck of our army.
Saying that the new-type main battle tank, which made its debut to demonstrate the amazing combat efficiency again, is very superior, he added this is unequalled in the world in its striking power and mobility and, especially, self-defence capacity. Our army will be equipped with such most powerful tanks, he said with pride.
That day, there were various tests for examining the new-type main battle tank's active protection system.
The tank intercepted 100 percent anti-tank missiles and drones attacking it from different positions and directions to clearly prove the efficiency of its superior active protection system.
Acquainting himself again with its combat performance after the tactical drill was over,Kim Jong Unsaid:
"We have attained great successes and progress in modernizing the tank-building industry.
This new-type main battle tank, a proud fruit of the strategic plan the Party Central Committee worked out and has resolutely pressed ahead with for the second revolution in the armored forces, encapsulates our-style technology of armored weapon system.
The development of the tank's core technology, to which we directed special efforts, has taken seven years.
The Party Central Committee, through the role of its guidance team, and the Academy of Defence Science, through its correct specialist guidance, have opened a brighter prospect for the tank-building industry.
The armor structure and power system designs, integrated automatic remote-controlled strike system, electronic warfare complex, guided missile and active self-defensive system have remarkably improved. All the components of this tank are completely suitable for ensuring its powerful striking capability, improving its survivability and providing convenience for the service by its crew.
In developing this tank, we have attached special importance to improving the rate of its survival.
Applied to this tank are various special technologies developed for improving its survival rate, and it is equipped with a mobile self-defensive complex capable of reliably destroying such attacking air targets as different kinds of anti-tank guided missiles and UAVs at a high level of precision through a system of detecting threats from all directions. Therefore, I am sure that no armored weapon with as strong self-defensive capability as that of this tank exists in the world.
In particular, it is a great change that our armored forces that were ineffective during night operations have completely overcome their combat limitations.
The combat performance of our main battle tank is incomparably superior.
From now on, our ground forces will be equipped with these superior tanks extensively, and our armored forces developed onto a higher stage."
He stressed, in particular, that it is important to pay careful attention to the issue of steadily improving the main battle tank's performance so that it can hold a leading position and make good use of its combat value in the battle fields in conformity with the trend of ever-developing modern warfare.
Highly appreciating that all the drills have been recently switched into the ones with scientific and practical forms and methods for an actual war, he said that our army units at all levels should achieve rapid successes in completing war preparations by giving full play to the soaring spirit without letup.
As he has repeatedly stressed, the People's Army should organize training for an actual war and training competitions aimed to improve the combat efficiency, more intensively and more frequently, so that it can swiftly and exactly perform any combat missions under different situations in contingency, he said. He called for taking a revolutionary measure to further intensify the training revolution.
Commanding officers of the KPA and the combatants involved in the tactical drill pledged to achieve proud successes in perfecting combat preparations and unsparingly dedicate their sweat and efforts to increasing the combat power and thus remain loyal toKim Jong Unwho left his immortal and sacred imprints in the training ground to bestow great honor upon them and inspire their high spirit and added to the militant will and matchless bravery of the People's Army. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Expanded Japanese Munitions Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) -- The militarist entity of Japan, which has completely removed its veil of "exclusive defense", is openly coming out to the world.
Recently, the Liberal Democratic Party and the Restoration Party of Japan reportedly submitted to the prime minister a proposal on lifting in a principled way the ban on the export of all its weapons and equipment including lethal weapons.
The details of the proposal call for removing the five principles of the past that have limited Japan's equipment export to "disaster relief, transportation, guard, surveillance and clearing".
It is reported that if the proposal is formally passed through the prime minister, an issue of revising the system of arms export will be discussed even in the spring this year.
If this turns into a reality, Japan will be allowed to export fighters, escort ships, submarines and other lethal weapons and equipment to the countries with which it has signed an agreement on the export of "defense equipment" and the transfer of technology.
Japan has so far concluded the agreement with 17 countries and several Asia-Pacific countries are among them.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan is trying to remove the brake that it set as the principle not to transfer even non-lethal equipment to the dispute parties in the past.
This will legally allow Japan to export and support the lethal weapons to the "fellow country" where armed conflict broke out.
Militarist Japan's intention has become far too emboldened.
Dangerous and sinister intention is behind Japan's attempt to openly export the offensive lethal weapons to the countries with which it has signed the agreement on the export of the "defense equipment" and the transfer of technology.
Japan is drastically increasing its military expenditure every year and getting hell-bent on the development and introduction of various kinds of offensive weapons.
Based on this, the Japanese munitions industry, which has been limited to the delivery of military equipment to the "Self-Defense Forces", is expanding day by day to demand a new outlet and, thereby, is trying to advance to the hot spots of the world to meet its demand.
At the same time, Japan is trying to verify and confirm in a versatile way the advantages and disadvantages of its military hardware including the ability to operate in real war and the lethal effect in different parts of the world and rapidly increase the preemptive attack capability of the island country by rapidly updating the weapon systems.
Japan's moves to export massive offensive lethal weapons are a grave challenge to global peace and security.
This will certainly cause a serious arms race among the countries in the surrounding region, escalate the geopolitical crisis and, furthermore, make the world situation more unstable.
It is the intention of Japan to turn its economy into the one based on huge munitions industry as soon as possible and accelerate the militarization by relying on it and, at the same time, create a favorable environment for reinvasion by creating an imbalance of strength in the region and the world.
Japan should clearly understand. The road of reinvasion, which the war criminal state is trying to open up as a new outlet for arms export, will lead it to the irreversible ruin. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories Strive to Improve Quality of Products and Expand Their Varieties
Construction of New Coal Mines and Pits Accelerated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) -- The coal-mining industry of the DPRK is putting spurs to the construction of new coal mines and pits to satisfy the growing demand for coal, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Ministry of Coal Industry worked out a plan and an action program to finish their construction step by step on the basis of analysis of the successes, experience and lessons made in the past five years.
The Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex made a realistic plan to construct the Samrok Coal Mine during the new five-year plan. The complex is now striving to carry it into practice while impressing the masses with the importance of its construction to raise their enthusiasm.
The construction of a new coal mine and pit is also progressing apace at the Myongchon Area Coal Mining Complex.
The Kukdong Coal Mine is introducing various valuable technical innovations and rational work methods to kindle the flames for creating new standards and new records at worksites. Pit No. 1 of the Ryongban Coal Mine is making remarkable progress in tunneling of slope pit and capital tunneling, giving full play to the collectivist trait of a shift helping the other.
The Thaesan Coal Mine and Youth Pit No. 2 of the Ryongbuk Youth Coal Mine under the Kyongwon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Youth Pit at the Phunggok Youth Coal Mine under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, too, are making collective innovations to provide favorable working conditions. -0-

headline: Immutable Ideas of WPK (3)
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 20 (KCNA) -- Self-reliance, the tradition of the Korean revolution and the driving force for building a powerful socialist country, is the political line of the Workers' Party of Korea which builds a socialist paradise thriving in Korean style with reliance on the foundations of self-sustenance and potentials.
The WPK has set self-reliance as an invariable political line, to be consistently adhered to, after formulating it as the fundamental orientation and mode of development of socialist construction, not as a temporary measure to meet the demand of changing situation or overcome the difficulties standing in the way of its advance.
It is our Party's firm belief that we can successfully attain any goal and put our style socialism onto a higher stage of development as there are the solid foundations of the self-supporting economy and our people's revolutionary spirit of self-sustenance.
Thanks to this unshakable faith and will of the WPK, our people's revolutionary spirit of self-sustenance has been steadily cultivated and, accordingly, the five-year plan for national economic development, set forth at the Eighth Congress of the WPK, was fulfilled in the main. And the country's foundation for prosperity by dint of self-reliance has been further consolidated, as evidenced by the fact that the regions, which account for one-fifth of the country, came to have a solid foundation for their independent development until last year along with the second inauguration season of the execution of the regional development policy.
Remarkable changes were also made in bolstering up the country's defence capabilities over the past five years, thanks to the steady progress of the independent defence industry reliably supporting the inexhaustible strong power of the armed forces of the DPRK.
Under the leadership of the WPK which has regarded self-reliance as its lifeline, our strength of overcoming any difficulties with our own efforts has been remarkably augmented and the confidence in it further redoubled. This is a precious spiritual and material asset incomparable with anything else.
The DPRK people are now full of enthusiasm and will to create great changes in the coming five years that surpass the miracles performed in the past five years, true to the WPK's idea of self-reliance.
Invincible is the cause of the WPK invariably upholding the noble ideas of "The people are God", single-hearted unity and self-reliance as the banner of struggle and advance. -0-

Herein lies the main secret of the WPK, which has won only victory in any difficulty, trial and adversity, and the philosophy of the immortal vitality of the WPK's policies, the article notes, and goes on:

The dignity of the people and safety of their lives are the most important affair for the WPK as they should not be slightly violated but thoroughly defended in any case.
The WPK's policies are consistent with the steadfast spirit of serving the people whereby top priority is always given to the work for promoting their wellbeing.
Next, the absolutely people-oriented character of the WPK's policies is being manifested in the fact that if the people want, the WPK realizes it most thoroughly and perfectly without regards to any conditions.
It is the firm will of the WPK that the work for improving the people's livelihood brooks no further delay and it should be translated into reality even though it needs the unprecedentedly great efforts.
The WPK's policies are those that provide the people with everything at the highest level and most perfectly.
The absolutely people-oriented character of the WPK's policies is fully displayed in the fact that its people-oriented character is being further consolidated without any change with each passing day.
Only the policies of the WPK give the great hope for the rosy future to all the people in the present world where hope is fading.
The basic factor of making the WPK's policies the most revolutionary and popular ones with the absolutely people-oriented character as their vitality is that the WPK is holding in high esteem the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the genuine leader and benevolent father of the people, and is thoroughly upholding his idea and leadership.

headline: Staff of C.C., WPK and Defence Ministry Plant Turfs at Heroes' Cemetery Area of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- The sacred place where the heroic feats of the martyrs will go down forever in history is filled with the respect of all the people and servicepersons in the DPRK for the brave soldiers who sacrificed their precious lives for defending the inviolable dignity and honor of the country in the overseas military operations.
Under a plan of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, staff of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence planted turfs at the heroes' cemetery area of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations on March 20.
They were joined by secretaries of the WPK Central Committee including Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of its Political Bureau, and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.
They planted every blade of turfs with sincerity to finish greening the heroes' cemetery area, recollecting the proud sons of the country.
The staff of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence were more firmly convinced that the Memorial Museum, to be inaugurated before long, would shine forever as a platform of immortality praising the worthwhile life of the heroic soldiers and a symbol of the most righteous state and people and the strongest army. -0-

headline: Afforestation and Forest Conservation in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- March 21 is the International Forest Day.
In the DPRK where mountains make up the bulk of its territory, afforestation and forest conservation are conducted through an all-people movement on a nationwide scale every year.
True to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea on conducting a vigorous forest restoration campaign involving the entire Party, the whole army and all the people,  modern tree nurseries have been built and many forests, including hundreds of thousands of hectares of wild fruit forests, created in provinces, cities and counties for the last ten-odd years.
Tree nurseries, built in different parts of the country, strengthened their material and technical foundations to produce billions of saplings of 160-odd good species last year.
Progress was also made in the work to put afforestation and forest conservation on a scientific basis.
Forest science research institutes were built across the country to put afforestation and management on a scientific basis of higher level.
The Academy of Forest Science was inaugurated in January this year. The dynamic work has been done to widely propagate oil bearing trees acclimatized to climatic and soil conditions of the country such as high-yielding Evodia daniellii Benn, oil-bearing chestnut and Acer truncatum and wild fruit trees such as dwarf pine nut, calcium plum and Ribes nigrum.
The forest sector concluded a nationwide forest resource survey that combined the Korean-style forest resource survey and analysis system with field survey, thus providing a foundation for analyzing and evaluating the forest state in detail and conducting forest restoration in a scientific way.
Successes were also made in the forest conservation including the establishment of a nationwide information service system for monitoring forest fire and a forest insect monitoring and predicting system.
The state of the DPRK will as ever direct efforts to afforestation and forest conservation so as to promote the people's wellbeing and contribute to the global environmental protection. -0-

headline: Camping Cycle
story_text:
One day in December 2016, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the newly-remodeled December 6 Children's Camp in Kangwon Province.
Going round various places of the camp, he gave precious instructions and learnt about the camping cycle and winter camping.
After hearing an official's report that there is no winter camping, he called upon the camp to organize winter camping, to say nothing of the period from spring to autumn.
He said that a bus should be sent to the camp during the winter camping so that campers can go skiing at the Masikryong Ski Resort and that if children go camping and skiing rather than playing at home during the winter vacation, it will be good to develop their bravery.
After that, schoolchildren have spent pleasant camping days at this camp in every season and trained their bodies and minds, playing skiing at the Masikryong Ski Resort in winter. -0-

headline: Staff of C.C., WPK and Defence Ministry Plant Turfs at Heroes' Cemetery Area of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 21 (KCNA) -- The sacred place where the heroic feats of the martyrs will go down forever in history is filled with the respect of all the people and servicepersons in the DPRK for the brave soldiers who sacrificed their precious lives for defending the inviolable dignity and honor of the country in the overseas military operations.
Under a plan of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, staff of the WPK Central Committee and the Ministry of National Defence planted turfs at the heroes' cemetery area of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations on March 20.
They were joined by secretaries of the WPK Central Committee including Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of its Political Bureau, and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.
They planted every blade of turfs with sincerity to finish greening the heroes' cemetery area, recollecting the proud sons of the country.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Greetings to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on March 22.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations and comradely greetings to you and, through you, to the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and all the Party members on the occasion of the 71st founding anniversary of the LPRP.
The founding of the LPRP, a historic event of important significance in carving out the destiny of the Lao people, provided a turning point in the struggle to abolish the colonial rule of foreign forces and establish the people's democratic system.
I hope that the Lao people will make a fresh step forward in attaining the goal of building a state towards socialism by thoroughly implementing the decisions of the Twelfth Congress of the LPRP under the leadership of the Party headed by you.
Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between our two parties and two countries will grow stronger in conformity with the spirit of the agreement reached at our meeting in Pyongyang in October last year, I wish you good health and bigger success in your responsible work. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 22 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on March 18 to mark the 77th anniversary of the conclusion of the agreement on economic and cultural cooperation between the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
Present there on invitation were Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology, Mikhail Degtyarev, minister of Sports, and other figures of the parliament, government and organizations in Russia, including the State Duma, the Foreign Ministry, the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology, the Ministry of Sports, the Ministry of Interior, the Ministry of Industry and Trade and the Ministry of Health.
Ri Yong Jin, charge d'affaires ad interim, and staff members of the embassy were on hand.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquet before a photo dealing with the revolutionary activities of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand paid tribute to him.
Then they looked round the photos showing the precious revolutionary careers and exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the immortal exploits performed by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations, the immortal classic works of the peerlessly great men and photos showing the inexhaustible might and eye-opening development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made at the reception.
Ri Yong Jin said that the DPRK-Russia relations have been developed into the comprehensive strategic partnership and the relations of invincible alliance under the strategic guidance of the top leaders of the two countries, underscoring the need to boost the bilateral exchange and cooperation in the phase of implementation of the agreements reached at the historic summits.
Alexandr Kozlov said that the relations between the two countries reached a new high level as the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership was concluded at the Russia-DPRK summit held in Pyongyang on June 19, 2024, adding that the bilateral cooperation will be further strengthened in all fields by the joint efforts.
Mikhail Degtyarev said that the stand of Russia, which has fully supported the Korean people in their struggle for defending the country's independence and its rights to sovereignty and development, will remain unchanged in the future, too, expressing the belief that mutual cooperation in the field of sports will contribute to the development of sports and the strengthening of friendly relations between the two countries. -0-

The DPRK's mightiness is neither the strongest weaponry nor the one and only code itself, but the faith of self-respect and the political courage of ComradeKim Jong Unthat no one in the world can match.

All the things, which ComradeKim Jong Unexecuted in the worst of hardships, were the start of the people's new life of enjoying beautiful new civilization and happiness, their centuries-old desire, and the new biography of building the most popular socialist state.

headline: Youths in DPRK Volunteer for Revolutionary Posts Called by WPK
story_text:

Youth league members in Chongjin City and Kilju, Orang and Kyonghung counties petitioned their organizations to send them to construction brigades.
Youths in Hoeryong City and Myongchon and Yonsa counties vowed to advance into raw materials base stations and those in Kim Chaek City and Hwadae and Kyongwon counties volunteered to work at goat and other farms.
Graduate students of Chongjin O Jung Hup University of Education pledged to become information and motivation workers of the WPK who are stoutly defending the sacred lineage of the Korean revolution at the battle sites in the area of Paektu and firmly arming the Korean people with the spirit of Mt Paektu.
Those of Kim Jong Suk Teachers Training College decided to work at schools in mountain villages and rural areas and on islands.
Young people in Rason Municipality, too, petitioned to work at construction brigade and other posts.
Meetings were held on the spots to congratulate those volunteers.
Officials, youth and students encouraged the volunteers, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, released the following press statement on March 23:
It was reported by foreign media that the prime minister of Japan expressed her strong willingness to realize the DPRK-Japan summit during the U.S.-Japan summit held in Washington on March 19.
But this is not the one that comes true, as wanted or decided by Japan.
If the prime minister of Japan seeks to resolve its unilateral matter not recognized by us, our state leadership will have no intention to meet or sit face to face with her.
In order for the top leaders of the two countries to meet each other, Japan should first be determined to break with its anachronistic practice and habit.
But today's Japan has gone too far in the opposite direction.
We have nothing to talk face to face to such a party still keen on obsolete thinking and impossible idea.
I don't want to see the prime minister of Japan coming to Pyongyang. However, this is just my personal position. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Bustling with Moving into New Houses
Pyongyang Bustling with Moving into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, is witnessing another auspicious event of moving into new houses with the completion of building 10 000 flats at the fourth stage in the Hwasong area.
Moving into new houses has become a common scene in the city that can be seen in every spring.
Such scene was witnessed in Songhwa Street in 2022, Hwasong Street in 2023, Rimhung Street and Jonwi Street in 2024 and a new third-stage district in the Hwasong area in 2025.
A constant stream of removal vans flows to different parts of the new street, owners of new houses are filled with the delight of receiving the licenses for the use of new houses free of charge and the builders extend warm congratulations to them. Their looks are a happy scene of the large socialist family blossoming day by day under the care of the Workers' Party.
Such scenes as moving into new houses have been provided under the devoted service and warm benevolence of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the people.
In his speech at a ground-breaking ceremony for the building of 10 000 flats in Pyongyang on March 23, 2021, the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unsaid that to build 50 000 flats in Pyongyang is something our Party has long intended, made preparations for and aspired to do in order to provide the citizens of the capital city with more stable and cultured living conditions.
He gave detailed guidance to the preparations for grand construction at each stage, including 1 000-odd layouts for Songhwa Street, more than 1 630 layouts for the residential district at the first stage in the Hwasong area, and nearly 1 000 layouts for Rimhung Street, and led the whole course of construction projects so that they were stepped up substantially.
Thanks to the energetic leadership ofKim Jong Unwho visited the new streets under construction and guided to complete them without any slightest shortcomings, new streets for the people have appeared one after another and the scenes of moving into new houses have been displayed.
Such scenery shows the happiness of the people who will lead a new life and a new civilization of socialism under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea and the true picture of socialist Korea where the people-first politics is embodied. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Reelected as President of State Affairs of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- The election of the president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea representing the state and its people is the most important state affairs that the supreme power body determines on behalf of the unanimous will of all the Korean people for the destiny and future of tens of millions of people, the eternal dignity and mightiness of the DPRK and for leading the great pioneering period of national rejuvenation unprecedented in the history of its founding to an everlasting heyday.
The Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK reelected ComradeKim Jong Unas President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea at the First Session, the first state affairs activity of its 15th term, on March 22.
The Pyongyang Assembly Hall was full of the extraordinary political awareness and revolutionary enthusiasm of the SPA deputies who would decide in a responsible manner the most important state affair of great political significance in reliably guaranteeing the eternal cause of the Juche revolution on the basis of the mission and rights entrusted by the times and the people.
The 15th Supreme People's Assembly solemnly declared at home and abroad the historic decision to elect ComradeKim Jong Un, the outstanding leader of the Juche revolution, to the top post of the Republic, reflecting the unanimous will and desire of all the Korean people.
Invariably holdingKim Jong Unin high esteem as the head of our glorious DPRK is a political event, to be specially recorded in the history of our state's power activities, and another significant revolutionary auspicious event the Korean people greeted in the course of ushering in a new period of upturn for national prosperity along the bright path indicated by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The election ofKim Jong Un, the most prominent thinker-theoretician of the present world, the great strategist of state building and the great master of creation and change, to the top post of our state opened up a firm prospect for further strengthening the government of the Republic as a powerful political weapon for building a great power and realizing the great ideals and aspirations at an early date.
Growing stronger is the iron faith and will of all the people and service personnel in the country that Korean-style socialism will always emerge victorious and the historic cause of building a rich country with a strong army will surely be accomplished when they advance, always holding in high esteem at the helm of the revolution ComradeKim Jong Un, who has opened up the bright future for all generations while bringing about unprecedented great changes and great victories only in the course of the sacred struggle of our Party and the state.
Guided by him as the head of state, the DPRK will prosper as a dignified country of the people and a power independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in national defence advancing along the road of most sacred and bold pioneering. -0-

headline: Proposal for Electing Comrade Kim Jong Un as President of State Affairs of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- The First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted the important and responsible work for electing the head of state on March 22.
Deputy Ri Il Hwan made a proposal for electing the president of the State Affairs of the DPRK.
The speaker stressed that the success of socialist construction at a new stage facing the Korean people as well as the future and development of the DPRK and its people will be decided by the result of electing the head of state, the most important agenda of the 15th SPA.
Referring to the days that have made the Korean people keenly realize that all of daily happiness, regarded as so common things every day and every hour of the past years, were extraordinarily good fortune given to all of them and to the deep and great meaning of the powerful country that is being deeply cherished again today, he went on:
On this planet, only the strong has the right to defend the dignity and security of a state, and the greatness of ComradeKim Jong Unis the most powerful national strength of the DPRK.
The DPRK's mightiness is neither the strongest weaponry nor the one and only code itself, but the faith of self-respect and the political courage of ComradeKim Jong Unthat no one in the world can match.
Another strength that makes our state invincible, remaining unperturbed despite any world event or upheaval, is the single-minded unity in which the intention of the leader, who values the self-respect more than life, becomes the will of the people and the purpose of struggle and life.
The DPRK has the faithful people upholding in a single-minded and devoted manner the leader's firm faith that the dignity of the state is the life and cannot be bartered for anything and the revolutionary armed forces regarding it as their true nature to remain absolutely loyal and obedient to the orders of the leader.
This nobility and tenacity have made our country powerful and pushed our revolution to victory in all ages.
The great feats, which can neither be made in seven years nor be achieved even in 70 years, have been attained by the revolutionary spirit of the DPRK people closely rallied around ComradeKim Jong Un.
The speaker said that now the DPRK people have keenly realized how the aspirations and wishes kept in the days of founding the Republic are being translated into brilliant reality, adding that this is a new phase of the people-first politics unprecedented in the history of building the state where the people's aspirations and demands are reflected in the state's policies and laws and the service for the people has been established as the mode of state activities. And he referred to the undying exploits ComradeKim Jong Unperformed before the times and the revolution, the country and the people, and to his personality as a great man.
All the things, which ComradeKim Jong Unexecuted in the worst of hardships, were the start of the people's new life of enjoying beautiful new civilization and happiness, their centuries-old desire, and the new biography of building the most popular socialist state.
The people clearly see what country ComradeKim Jong Unis building, keenly experiencing how the historic and epoch-making tasks, which others have never thought of or have regarded as impossible, are adopted as top priority state affairs and are being realized without fail.
The DPRK is the country where people lead a life of equality, the country where they live in harmony, helping and leading each other, and the country where the results of the state affairs are reviewed by the laughter of the people. This is the image of the DPRK which the Korean people have seen under the care of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The Korean people have turned out in a new advance to consolidate the successes achieved in the struggle to usher in a heyday of state development unprecedented in the history of nation building and continue to lead them to greater and more substantial results, the speaker said, adding:
The great confidence in the unconditional success that our people have in the course for making great changes and development surpassing those in the past period is based on the powerful executive ability and strong guiding force of ComradeKim Jong Un, an outstanding politico-ideological theoretician, strategic designer of the building of a great state and great master of creation and change.
The outstanding leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, who arouses the patriotic consciousness and creativity of the masses and inspires the whole country to the struggle of the new era simultaneously, while effectively mobilizing the national forces and resources in any enormous work, has fully demonstrated the advantages of the socialist system and brought about miracles that can be achieved only by our own style of socialism.
Thanks to the road of development opened by him and the valuable and excellent wealth he made on this road, Korean-style socialism has been proved that it is creative socialism with great might not only in overcoming difficulties and challenges but also in promoting progress and innovation, and powerful and development-oriented socialism which is based on the ideological integration of all the people well versed in science and technology and which the value as a social being and the quality of life are coincided with the results of labor.
ComradeKim Jong Unhas successfully led the first stage of the new revolution to definitely put socialism, defended through a bloody struggle, on the track of prosperity. This is the distinguished exploits that has dispelled all sorts of abuses and sophism about socialism and demonstrated the bright future of our state and the invincibility of the socialist cause.
There can be no other option for the people who are firmly convinced that our future will be filled with another new and eye-opening development, just as ComradeKim Jong Unhas made our present quite different from the past.
Deputy Ri Il Hwan courteously proposed to the Supreme People's Assembly to entrust the heavy responsibility of the President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea to ComradeKim Jong Unagain, representing the unanimous will of all the people, for the invariable might of the DPRK and the new era of its prosperity and for the future generations to be always happy in its embrace. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK

I don't want to see the prime minister of Japan coming to Pyongyang. However, this is just my personal position. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: First-day Sitting of First Session of 15th SPA of DPRK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- The First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was opened in the capital city of Pyongyang at a historic time when all the people across the country have courageously turned out in the patriotic struggle to usher in a new heyday of steady leap forward and development of our great state, true to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
For the past seven years since the First Session of the 14th SPA was held, the DPRK's supreme power body has thoroughly embodied the WPK's original ideas of state building, independent revolutionary line and people-first principle in its activities and fulfilled its mission and duty entrusted by the Constitution in a responsible manner in response to the demand of the era of great transformation, thus firmly guaranteeing legally and institutionally the implementation of the policies of the Party and the state for the comprehensive prosperity and development.
The first-day sitting of the First Session of the 15th SPA was held on March 22.
The session was convened to further consolidate the state power and provide a solid legal foundation for socialist construction at a new stage. It was attended by the newly-elected SPA deputies and, as observers, officials concerned from Pyongyang and provinces including those of the Central Committee of the WPK, the SPA Standing Committee, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas present at the session.
WhenKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the session, all the participants welcomed with enthusiastic applause the peerlessly great man, the leader of the people who with his great ideas and outstanding political caliber, put the absolute dignity and national power of our state on the peak of the century and ushered in a new era of great prosperity in which the people's ideal and eternal happiness are realized in a comprehensive way.
Leading officials of the state took the platform.
Deputy Ko Kil Son, secretary general of the SPA Standing Committee, made an opening address.
When the session was declared open, the DPRK national anthem was played.
There was a speech by Choe Ryong Hae, chairman of the Standing Committee of the 14th SPA and chairman of the preparatory committee for the First Session of the 15th SPA.
He referred with pride to the great honor of his life when he has personally experienced the greatness of the ideas and leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unwhile working as the chairman of the Standing Committee of the 14th SPA which witnessed the opening of the era of great transformation unprecedented in the history of the development of the DPRK spanning nearly 80 years.
He recalled with deep emotion the achievements made by the 14th SPA in its sovereign activities, true to the intention of the Party Central Committee, including the enactment and amendment and supplement of hundreds of laws to perpetuate the position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state, give fuller play to the advantages of the Korean-style socialist system and promote the comprehensive development of the state, and innovative change in the state political activities of the deputies.
He stressed it is absolute truth he realized working as the chairman of the Standing Committee that the eternal prosperity and mightiness of our country and the promotion of the wellbeing of all the people in the country can be ensured only when we remain single-mindedly faithful to the state-building ideas and leadership ofKim Jong Un.
Expressing his regret for failing to repay the great trust of the Party and the expectation of the state and the people with greater successes, he earnestly asked all the deputies to glorify the days of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly as the ones of honor keeping pace with the Ninth Party Central Committee, true to the great ComradeKim Jong Un's grand plan for building a powerful country and his noble intention to make devoted service for the people's wellbeing.
The session expressed thanks to outgoing Chairman Choe Ryong Hae who made a significant contribution to implementing the policies of the Party and the state during his term of office and encouraged the deputies to the 15th SPA.
The session elected the chairman and vice-chairmen of the Supreme People's Assembly before discussing agenda items.
Deputy Jo Yong Won was elected as chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK and deputies Kim Hyong Sik and Ri Son Gwon as its vice-chairmen.
Deputy Jo Yong Won made a pledge to be always aware of his mission and duty before the Party and the people, remain faithful to the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Unand the Constitution of the DPRK and make selfless, devoted efforts for the realization of the people-first policy of the WPK and the prosperity and development of the state, bearing in mind the trust and expectation of the deputies for him to make single-minded efforts for the prosperity of the country and its people with warm love for and boundless devotion to the country and the people as the chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly.
The chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly presided over the session.
The following agenda items were brought up for discussion at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK:
First, on the election of the President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea
Second, on the election of the state leadership bodies of the DPRK
Third, on the election of the sectional committees of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK
Fourth, on the amendment and supplement to the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK
Fifth, on the thorough implementation of the five-year plan for national economic development set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea
Sixth, on the fulfillment of the state budget of the DPRK for 2025 and on the state budget for 2026
The session discussed the first agenda item.
The deputies to the SPA were extremely excited as they would represent the will of the people across the country at the most responsible time for the future of the country and the people and the prospects of the Juche cause.
Deputy Ri Il Hwan made a proposal for the election of the President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The  dignity and mightiness of the DPRK, directly linked to the destiny of tens of millions of Korean people, are unthinkable apart from the high prestige and leadership of the state leader, and the historic task of making the great pioneering period of national rejuvenation lead on to an everlasting heyday can be carried out only by the leadership of the prominent head of state, he said, adding that the agenda item is very weighty and crucial but our choice of decision on it is very clear.
He courteously proposed to the current Supreme People's Assembly to entrustKim Jong Unwith the heavy responsibility as President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea again for the eternal mightiness of the DPRK and the new era of its prosperity and for the descendants who will always lead a happy life under his care, representing the general will of all the people who unanimously trust and follow him who has given socialist Korea the great dignity, honor and glory and defended the destiny of the people and bears the responsibility for even the future of all generations to come.
All the participants expressed full support and approval for the proposal representing the unanimous will and ardent desire of all the people and service personnel across the country with the stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" and applause.
The Supreme People's Assembly solemnly declared thatKim Jong Un, who is leading the cause of building a powerful socialist country only to sure victory with his gifted ideological and theoretical wisdom and rare and outstanding leadership practice, was elected President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
His election as the head of state of the DPRK makes it possible for the DPRK and its people to glorify their sacred dignity and honor forever and more dynamically advance toward the goal of achieving the just and far-reaching ideal and prosperity with the outstanding ideology and political power and the invincible force of the harmonious whole.
The session elected the state leadership bodies as the second agenda item.
Kim Jong Unproposed a motion to form the State Affairs Commission.
The session elected the deputies, proposed by the President of the State Affairs of the DPRK, as first vice-president, vice-president and members of the State Affairs Commission.
It elected chairman, vice-chairmen, secretary general and members of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK.
And it elected the premier of the DPRK Cabinet.
Deputy Pak Thae Song, elected as premier of the Cabinet, proposed members of the Cabinet upon authorization of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and they were appointed with full approval.
The session appointed the director of the Supreme Public Prosecutors Office and elected the president of the Supreme Court.
Premier of the DPRK Cabinet Pak Thae Song, on behalf of his Cabinet members, took an oath to be loyal to the Constitution of the DPRK and live up to the trust and expectation of the Party and the people with remarkable results.
He vowed that the Cabinet would hold fast to it as a basic task for the socialist economic construction to lay the developmental foundations for the stable and sustainable growth in the country's economy and substantially improve the people's living standards, in accordance with the general goal and principle of development of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK, and make sure that the guidance and management by the Cabinet-Responsibility System, Cabinet-Centred System prove successful in ceaselessly bringing about upsurges in the new phase for the comprehensive development.
He solemnly promised the current Supreme People's Assembly and all the people that he would fulfill his heavy mission as the premier of the Cabinet in a responsible manner, deeply mindful of the heavy responsibility for the economic work of the country at a crucial time when the era of a new upsurge and a new change of the Juche revolution is being ushered in.
The session elected the Legislation Committee, the Budget Committee and the Foreign Affairs Committee, the sectional committees of the Supreme People's Assembly, through the discussion of the third agenda item. -0-

headline: Scientific Meteorological Observation and Forecast in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- March 23 is World Meteorological Day.
On the occasion of the day, the World Meteorological Organization set the theme "Observing Today, Protecting Tomorrow", stressing the need for each country to make meteorological observations and forecasts well to prevent the danger of disaster beforehand.
In the DPRK, weather forecast has been put on a scientific basis and observation equipment on a modern basis under the care of the state. The country is striving to provide accurate and prompt forecasts of weather situation while strengthening international cooperation in this field.
Recently, researchers of the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration established methods for raising the accuracy of disastrous weather forecast and confirmed the accuracy assessment indices and methods for various kinds of models and forecasting items by dint of AI, thus putting the weather forecast on a higher scientific basis.
They developed a county-level early warning system for downpour and flooding and introduced it into the southern areas in the central part of the country in 2024 and into the whole country by early April in 2025, thus making it prove effective in ensuring the scientific accuracy and promptness of weather forecast.
They put the marine forecast on a scientific basis, observation on a modern basis, data communication on an IT basis and forecast process on a real-time basis, thus making a series of successes in the work to improve service level for the marine and maritime weather data.
The DPRK joined the World Meteorological Organization in May 1975. -0-

headline: Title of Socialist Patriotic Forest Awarded to More than 12 000 Units in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- More than 12 000 units across the country have won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest for over ten years amid a mass campaign  to turn all the mountains of the country into gold and treasure ones with thick woods.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Central Tree Nursery under the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection in November 2014 and stressed the need to conduct such dynamic mass movements as a movement for winning the titles of Socialist Patriotic Forest and Model County in Afforestation.
In January 2019, the Ponghwa Chemical Factory and other units won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest for the first time and its ranks have increased every year.
The Sunan Ostrich Farm under the Pyongyang Poultry Production Bureau has produced a large number of saplings at its nursery every year and created forests in keeping with the climatic and soil conditions and symbiosis among trees.
The title of Socialist Patriotic Forest was conferred on the Naejung Farm in Yomju County, the Ryonji Farm in Hamju County, the township farm in Yonthan County and many other agricultural production units as they have created and conserved forests and planted many trees of good species and tended them carefully.
Women's union committees of Mangyongdae District, Unsan County and Phyongsong City have planted trees in a scientific and technological way in conformity with the characteristics of different species and soil conditions.
Phungyang Senior Middle School in Kim Jong Suk County and Hoean Senior Middle School in Pukchang County planted and cultivated trees of economic value. -0-
