story_text:
Pyongyang, March 23 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, released the following press statement on March 23:
It was reported by foreign media that the prime minister of Japan expressed her strong willingness to realize the DPRK-Japan summit during the U.S.-Japan summit held in Washington on March 19.
But this is not the one that comes true, as wanted or decided by Japan.
If the prime minister of Japan seeks to resolve its unilateral matter not recognized by us, our state leadership will have no intention to meet or sit face to face with her.
In order for the top leaders of the two countries to meet each other, Japan should first be determined to break with its anachronistic practice and habit.
But today's Japan has gone too far in the opposite direction.
We have nothing to talk face to face to such a party still keen on obsolete thinking and impossible idea.
I don't want to see the prime minister of Japan coming to Pyongyang. However, this is just my personal position. -0-

headline: Report on Cabinet's Work Submitted to First Session of 15th SPA of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- Deputy Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet, made a report on the work of the Cabinet at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK.
The reporter referred to the successes and shortcomings, made and revealed in the economic work of the country over the past five years and called for thoroughly implementing the five-year plan for national economic development set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The report noted the great successes, achieved in the historic course of remarkably increasing our state's internal strength, are that the foundations of self-supporting economy have been firmly consolidated and the overall economy of the country has been put on a track of sure upsurge.
During the period of the Five-Year Plan, the plans for electric power, rolling steel, coal, electrolytic copper, electrolytic zinc and cloth production and housing construction and rail freight transport were successfully carried out among the major indices advanced by the Eighth Congress of the WPK. In the major industrial sectors, the production of Juche iron increased 3.2 times, nitrogen fertilizer 1.5 times, nonferrous metals by 1.9 times, cement 1.4 times and fishery 1.9 times, as compared with the year 2020. The increased production in major indices as a whole clearly demonstrated the development of our economy.
The reporter stressed that the successes made in the period are a precious fruition of our people and service personnel's devoted efforts.
The Cabinet will carry out in a responsible manner the work of thoroughly implementing the five-year plan for national economic development to consolidate the economic muscle of the country as required by the comprehensive development, the report said, and went on:
The metallurgical industry will make the existing foundations for Juche-based iron production prove effective, increase the quality of steel, install more processes for producing various kinds of rolled steel, and take measures to ensure the supply of raw materials and fuel.
The chemical industry sector will direct efforts to giving fullest play to the existing production capacity, while pushing ahead with the work to complete the project for establishment of C1 chemical industry and build up new structure so as to attain the production goals set forth for the sector without fail.
The Cabinet will take strong measures to supply manpower and materials to the electric power industry, put the electricity production and management on a scientific basis and make effective use of the produced electricity.
It will guide the coal industry to secure prospective deposits, give priority to the supply of equipment and materials and step up the in-depth development of major coal mines, the construction of gravity-fed drain pits, new coal mines and new pits, while taking other state measures to increase coal production.
It will ensure that the machine-building industry sector modernize the production lines of major factories at a higher level and actively promote the development of various kinds of high-performance mining equipment and farm machines suited to our actual conditions.
It will take measures for the mining industry sector to increase the production of nonferrous metals and put the production on a normal footing at mines, smelteries and factories.
The forestry sector will make efforts to keep balance between timber production and afforestation and consolidate the material and technical foundations so as to produce timber and wood products satisfactorily.
The railway transport sector will improve the organization and control over transport services, promote the stability of railways and increases the capacity of railway freight transport.
The Cabinet will accelerate the modernization of the land and maritime transport sector, make proactive efforts to increase the transport capacity and expand the truck-based transport capacity.
It will make the construction sector push ahead with the capital city construction, build dwelling houses in rural and urban areas and coal mine villages, complete the industrial and land improvement projects of national significance and take strong measures to build up the construction guidance force and thoroughly ensure the quality and safety of structures.
The building-materials industry will adjust and reinforce the production lines at cement factories and apply sci-tech successes to increase cement output and realize the domestic production of various finishing building materials and diversify them, and the design sector will pioneer a new level in architectural creation by designing all structures to be multi-functional, multi-purpose and practical ones.
The Cabinet will help the IT industry step up the modernization of broadcasting and postal communication and the work for putting state business on an IT basis and undertake the work for studying, developing and introducing the integrated control system and integrated production system at a high level in conformity with the specific conditions of all sectors and units of the national economy.
It will press ahead with the efforts to decisively resolve the energy problem, including the creation of natural energy generating capacity in regions of the country favorable to it.
It will continuously conduct the vigorous forest restoration and transformation work to turn all the mountains of the country into "gold" and "treasure" mountains, and make sure that the tasks facing the field of land and environment protection are carried out in a responsible manner.
It will take measures to improve urban management.
It will ensure that the disaster prevention sector establish the state's unified crisis control system, ranging from the prevention of disasters to the response to any disaster and the recovery, in a more well-regulated way and make sustained efforts to increase the ability to cope with crisis. It will also put the hydro-meteorological work on a modern basis to ensure the scientific accuracy and promptness of weather forecast. The state anti-epidemic capability will be enhanced to make full preparations for proactively coping with any public health crisis.
The Cabinet will direct ceaseless efforts to building tourist resorts and exploiting tourist resources and actively conduct external economic activities.
It will concentrate all efforts on the farming to decisively solve the food problem for the people.
The livestock farming and fruit farming sectors will attain the production goals for meat, eggs, milk and fruit saplings, and large-scale greenhouse farms will introduce advanced vegetable cultivation technology and take measures to supply farm materials so as to produce more than 300 tons of vegetables per hectare.
The fishing sector will attain the goal of seafood production.
The light industry sector will increase the production of consumer goods with the main stress put on improving quality and developing new products, and build its new foundations.
The newly-built regional-industry factories will build up their raw materials bases and train technicians and skilled workers in a far-sighted way so as to put the production on a normal footing and turn out various kinds of high-quality goods.
The Cabinet will strive to actively preserve the nature of socialist trade in commercial service activities and steadily improve the work of the public service sector and the external service sector.
It will vigorously propel the projects for transforming the capital city of Pyongyang into a magnificent one with appearance as a world-class city and powerfully push ahead with the work for ushering in a new era of regional transformation.
The scientific and technological sector will focus on enhancing the independence and modernization level of the national economy and solving the urgent technical problems arising in improving the material and cultural life of the people and promote the development of core and future-oriented cutting-edge technologies.
The educational sector will train all the schoolchildren into talents competent enough to contribute to the revolutionary practices, narrow the gap in the educational level between towns and rural areas and modernize the country's educational foundation in a comprehensive way.
The public health sector will rapidly introduce the successes gained in the healthcare revolution started in 2025 to the whole public health sector.
The reporter said that though the tasks facing the DPRK are very huge, we are sure to win a victory as the Party, the people and socialism are united as one by the same destiny and there are millions of Party members and tens of millions of people upholding the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea with one mind. -0-

headline: On Fulfillment of State Budget of DPRK for 2025 and Its State Budget for 2026
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- There was a report on the fulfillment of the state budget for 2025 and on the state budget for 2026 deliberated by the Budget Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly at the First Session of the 15th SPA.
According to the report, all the people across the country executed the state budget for 2025 as planned in the struggle to fulfill the five-year plan for national economic development.
The report said that the state budgetary revenue plan for 2025 was carried out at 105.1 percent and grew to 107.2 percent as compared with the previous year and continued:
Many industrial establishments in the economic sector carried out their plans for central budgetary revenue at 104.6 percent and those for the regional budgetary revenue at 106.5 percent.
In the last year's state budget, funds equivalent to 103.7 percent as compared with 2024 were spent for further accelerating the comprehensive development of our state.
The defence sector was provided on a top priority basis with funds equivalent to 15.7 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure in order to contribute to guaranteeing security and defence of the country and protecting its interests.
In 2025, the capital investment increased to 101.1 percent as against the previous year, making a contribution to over-fulfilling the five-year plan for capital city construction and pushing ahead with the building of the regional development policy projects, the first-stage project for the Tanchon Power Station, the first-stage modernization project of the Ryongsong Machine Complex and other construction projects of the state.
Funds equivalent to 13.1 percent of the state budgetary expenditure were allotted to the work of national economy including metallurgical, chemical, electric power, machine-building and other key industrial sectors and major economic sectors.
Funds equivalent to 109.3 percent as against the previous year were spent for the development of science and technology.
Funds equivalent to 101.7 percent as against the previous year were allotted for the agricultural work and 38.9 percent of total state budgetary expenditure went to public health, literature and art and sports sectors, including the preferential provision of the necessary funds for improving the educational work.
Last year, too, funds were allotted for the anti-epidemic work in order to increase the ability to rapidly respond to various infectious diseases in the world.
The successful fulfillment of the state budget for 2025 is the result of the boundless patriotic devotion of all the people.
It is important to provide a reliable financial guarantee for the work and production activities of all sectors and units in order to successfully carry out the first-year tasks of the new five-year plan set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the report said, and went on:
The state budget for 2026 has been compiled to promote the development of all sectors and units including science, education, public health, literature and art and contribute to the improvement of the people's standard of living while concentrating its investment on the building of the stronger force capable of repelling all sorts of military threats for defending the sovereignty and security of the country and on the successful attainment of the production targets for this year in the national economy.
This year's state budgetary revenue is expected to grow to 100.5 percent over last year and the turnover tax and enterprise profits, major items of the budgetary revenue, will increase to 100.3 percent and 100.1 percent respectively, accounting for 84.4 percent of the total revenue.
The profits of cooperative organizations are expected to grow to 101.8 percent, depreciation 102.7 percent, real estate rent 102.5 percent, premium for social insurance 102.4 percent, income from property sale and price fluctuation 102.8 percent, income from money collection 102 percent, other incomes 104.3 percent and income from special economic zones 101.4 percent, as compared with last year.
The central budgetary revenue is expected to account for 72.2 percent of the state budgetary revenue, with the revenue from the central economy amounting to a large proportion, and provincial, city and county people's committees will provide some funds for the scientific research in the agricultural sector, medical work and others to the central budget.
This year's state budgetary expenditure is expected to increase to 105.8 percent over last year.
This year, funds equivalent to 15.8 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure will be spent on national defence, contributing to the steady expansion and strengthening of the powerful self-defensive nuclear deterrent and war capabilities.
Funds needed for socialist economic construction are to increase to 105.5 percent over last year, amounting to 43.8 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure.
Funds equivalent to 106.3 percent as against last year are allotted for the work of national economy in 2026 and they will be spent for the major sectors including metallurgical, chemical, electric power, coal and machine-building industries and railway transport.
Funds equivalent to 105.3 percent over last year will be used for the development of science and technology.
It is expected to disburse funds equivalent to 105.7 percent over last year for the agricultural work in order to contribute to the strengthening of material and technical foundations of rural economy.
This year's state budget allots funds equivalent to 106 percent to educational sector as compared with last year, 105.6 percent to the public health sector, 103.1 percent to the cultural sector and 102.8 percent to the sports sector for the people-centered policies and the social and cultural work.
Funds for the anti-epidemic work are expected to grow to 101.1 percent over last year.
This year, too, the state will send a lot of educational aid funds and stipends to the Korean children in Japan so that they can grow up to be reliable pillars who will carry forward the patriotic cause. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets and Encourages Newly-Appointed Cabinet Members and Deputies to SPA
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met and congratulated the Cabinet members, newly appointed at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly, and the deputies to the 15th SPA at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on March 23.
At a crucial time when a new historic advance, to be specially recorded in the history of prosperity and development of our Republic, was launched, the participants were filled with boundless emotion and joy of being warmly encouraged by the great leader after holding him in high esteem again as the top leader of the Party and the state and receiving from him the important administrative policy for leading the heyday of comprehensive national rejuvenation to a new victory.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated the members of the Cabinet who came to assume the heavy responsibilities under the deep trust and expectation of the Party and the people.
Saying that the present situation, in which socialist construction is switching over to a new phase of high-level changes, requires the positive and creative efforts of the Cabinet members who are steering the implementation of the five-year strategy advanced by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, he noted that the officials of the Cabinet should always be full of the will to perfectly carry out the Party decisions, stronger than any others, and throw themselves heart and soul into bringing about practical achievements for the country and the people.
Expressing expectation that the newly appointed members of the Cabinet would strongly lead the implementation of the Party's policies during the period of the new long-term plan, which will be the most responsible and important part of the struggle for our Party and state, with their firm viewpoint that the Cabinet's work precisely means the work of the Party Central Committee and the implementation of the Party's decisions is just the work of the Cabinet, he had a photo session with them.
He met DPRK ambassadors to foreign countries who came to participate in the important political meeting of the Party and the state. He had a photo taken with them, highly appreciating the efforts they have made by dedicating their wisdom and enthusiasm to the responsible work for reliably ensuring the socialist construction politically and diplomatically, adhering to the very mission of the DPRK's diplomacy set forth by the WPK.
Then, he congratulated the deputies on successfully concluding the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly.
Expressing belief that the deputies to the SPA would fulfill their honorable mission and duty as representatives of the people and state political activists in implementing the WPK's state-building strategy, he had a photo taken with them, which will be eternally recorded in the constitutional history of the DPRK.
All the participants were full of enthusiasm to uphold with single-minded efforts the leadership of the great Party Central Committee which is powerfully carrying out the epoch-making causes of permanent significance in the DPRK's existence and prosperity, deeply cherishing the great glory and trust bestowed by ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Measure Taken to Update Talent Management System
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The State Commission of Science and Technology in the DPRK strives to update the talent management system, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The commission has taken practical measures to realize the state's unified control and management over sci-tech talents by establishing the proper system and order.
It is discussing the practical matters to find out those possessed of high application ability and technical skills and make them display their scientific and technological qualifications and abilities. It is also drawing up and issuing relevant guides by itemizing and concretizing the method of talent management.
The commission is strengthening guidance and assistance so that provinces, cities and counties reinforce their own sci-tech forces in conformity with their regional characteristics.
Meanwhile, measures are being taken to mobilize sci-tech talents of excellent scientific research units in the development of key industrial sectors, the latest scientific research, the construction projects for regional development policy and the sustained growth of the agricultural productivity.
The commission is also studying the ways to treat the talents preferentially while providing them with better working and living conditions so that they can play leading and core roles in sci-tech activities.
The work of concretizing the relevant items in a realistic and way is being done through collective discussion in order to ensure the effectiveness in developing new technologies. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from V. Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on March 23.
The message said:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my wholehearted congratulations to you on your reelection as president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The decision of the deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly clearly proves the unanimous public support for the line you are pursuing to effectively settle the socio-economic tasks facing the DPRK and defend the sovereignty and legitimate interests of the country in the international arena.
Russia highly appreciates your direct contribution to consolidating the friendly and allied relations between the two countries.
We will, of course, continue to work closely together to further develop the comprehensive strategic partnership between Moscow and Pyongyang.
This undoubtedly corresponds to the fundamental interests of our two countries' peoples.
I wish you good health and well-being with a new success in your responsible state activities.
Yours sincerely. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Second-day Sitting of First Session of 15th SPA of DPRK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- The second-day sitting of the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was held on March 23.
The chairman and vice-chairmen of the SPA took the chair.
The newly elected leading officials of the state took the platform.
The session discussed the issue related to the amendments to the Constitution as its fourth agenda item.
Deputy Jo Yong Won, chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly, made a report.
The reporter said that to amend and supplement the Constitution of the Republic, the legal basis and political charter for the dignity and sovereignty of the country and the people and their independent development, as required by the new stage of the developing revolution, constitutes an important landmark in legally guaranteeing the victorious advance of socialist construction and our cause. He explained in detail the contents of the draft law amended and supplemented, including the renaming of the "Socialist Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" as the "Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea".
The session examined the draft law and adopted with full approval an ordinance of the DPRK SPA "On the amendment and supplement to the Socialist Constitution of the DPRK".
It discussed the issue of thoroughly implementing the new five-year plan for national economic development as the fifth agenda item.
Deputy Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet, made a report.
The reporter said that the past five years were the years of great changes when the Korean-style socialist construction definitely entered the stage of comprehensive development and remarkable progress was made in the struggle for the prosperity of the country and the wellbeing of the people, adding that this proud success is the brilliant fruition of the outstanding leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unwho clearly indicated the main tasks and ways for carrying out the economic construction and has energetically guided it.
He said that the historic Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea set it as a primary task for the socialist economic construction at the present stage to lay the developmental foundations for the stable and sustainable growth of the country's economy and substantially improve the people's living standards while consolidating the successes made during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee. And he referred to the Cabinet's action program and ways for thoroughly implementing the task.
The tasks facing us are huge, but we are sure to win as the Party and the people and socialism are united by the same destiny and there are tens of millions of people supporting the WPK leadership wholeheartedly, he said, expressing the firm will to unconditionally fulfill the new five-year plan for national economic development by enhancing the role of the Cabinet as an economic control tower in every way.
Attending the oral or written discussions were deputies Ri Chol Man, Paek Song Guk, Kim Kwang Nam, Yun Jae Hyok, Kim Sung Chan, Pak Jong Gun, Kim Yu Il, Kim Son Myong, Kim Sung Jin and Ri Song Bom.
They reviewed the work of relevant sectors and units for implementing the Party and the state's policies over the past five years, stressing that through hard yet honorable struggle, they came to keenly realize that a shortcut to making a leap forward is to make bold innovations going beyond the limit and consistently prioritize science and technology with confidence in victory.
They pledged to carry through the new long-term plan by fulfilling their responsibilities and duties in the work to bring about epoch-making results in the new high-stage struggle on the basis of the past successes, experience and lessons.
The session adopted with unanimous approval an ordinance of the DPRK SPA "On thoroughly carrying out the five-year plan for national economic development set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea".
The session discussed the issue of the state budget, the sixth agenda item.
The Supreme People's Assembly recognized that the state budget for 2025 was implemented correctly as planned in the struggle to successfully discharge the final year's task during the eighth term of the Party Central Committee and that the state budget for 2026 has been properly set up to ensure the simultaneous and balanced development of all sectors and provide a financial guarantee for the improvement of the people's living standards while concentrating investment in bolstering up the national defence capabilities and successfully attaining the goals of economic sectors as required by the decisions of the Ninth Party Congress and the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Party Central Committee.
The session adopted a decision of the DPRK SPA "On approving the fulfillment of the state budget of the DPRK for 2025" and an ordinance of the DPRK SPA "On the state budget of the DPRK for 2026".
There was a policy speech of the head of state at the session.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appeared at the venue of the session to clarify the important policy orientation of the DPRK government.
All the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, extending highest respects to ComradeKim Jong Unwho is building the DPRK into an eternally powerful and prosperous socialist country, solid with single-minded unity and strong with matchless national power, with his spirit of devoted service to the country and its people and seasoned and tested leadership.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a historic policy speech.
He congratulated all the deputies who were elected as members of the 15th supreme power body of our dignified state by the deep trust and support of all the people across the country, and reviewed the state affairs during the 14th Supreme People's Assembly which brought about successful years through the arduous struggle. And he set forth important tasks and ways for the DPRK government to promote the prosperity of the state and the wellbeing of the people as in keeping with the requirement of the reality in which the socialist cause of our style has entered a new phase.
Stressing the importance of more dynamically stepping up the three revolutions - ideological, technical and cultural - in keeping with the present phase of socialist construction while consistently adhering to the principle of independent politics, self-supporting economy and self-reliant defence and the people-first principle in state building and activities, he called upon the SPA deputies to make painstaking efforts as befitting the masters of state affairs and representatives of the people so as to turn the future five years into the ones of better and more worthwhile transformation and for the future of the DPRK which will grow stronger.
All the participants expressed full support and approval with enthusiastic applause toKim Jong Un's speech which comprehensively and scientifically clarified the path of victory, to be followed by our state, and its perfect action programs at a new stage of accomplishing the socialist cause.
His historic policy speech is an immortal state-building programme that enables our people to make the unprecedented epoch-making victory, gained in building a prosperous power through their heroic and bold pioneering struggle, lead on to the dynamic prosperity and leap forward.
All the participants hardened their will to fully discharge their duties entrusted by the people in firmly defending Korean-style socialism centered on the popular masses and accelerating the comprehensive development of the state by thoroughly applying the fighting strategy and ways, set forth byKim Jong Un, in the overall state affairs.
Deputy Jo Yong Won, chairman of the SPA, made a closing address.
The First Session of the 15th SPA served as a historic occasion that greatly raised the patriotic enthusiasm of all the people across the country to usher in a period of comprehensive prosperity of the state by redoubling the fighting spirit with which they have pioneered the period of changes unprecedented in history, true to the leadership of the great ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Forest Fire Prevention Put on Higher Scientific Basis

headline: On Fulfillment of State Budget of DPRK for 2025 and Its State Budget for 2026
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 24 (KCNA) -- There was a report on the fulfillment of the state budget for 2025 and on the state budget for 2026 deliberated by the Budget Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly at the First Session of the 15th SPA.
According to the report, all the people across the country executed the state budget for 2025 as planned in the struggle to fulfill the five-year plan for national economic development.
The report said that the state budgetary revenue plan for 2025 was carried out at 105.1 percent and grew to 107.2 percent as compared with the previous year and continued:
Many industrial establishments in the economic sector carried out their plans for central budgetary revenue at 104.6 percent and those for the regional budgetary revenue at 106.5 percent.
In the last year's state budget, funds equivalent to 103.7 percent as compared with 2024 were spent for further accelerating the comprehensive development of our state.
The defence sector was provided on a top priority basis with funds equivalent to 15.7 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure in order to contribute to guaranteeing security and defence of the country and protecting its interests.
In 2025, the capital investment increased to 101.1 percent as against the previous year, making a contribution to over-fulfilling the five-year plan for capital city construction and pushing ahead with the building of the regional development policy projects, the first-stage project for the Tanchon Power Station, the first-stage modernization project of the Ryongsong Machine Complex and other construction projects of the state.
Funds equivalent to 13.1 percent of the state budgetary expenditure were allotted to the work of national economy including metallurgical, chemical, electric power, machine-building and other key industrial sectors and major economic sectors.
Funds equivalent to 109.3 percent as against the previous year were spent for the development of science and technology.
Funds equivalent to 101.7 percent as against the previous year were allotted for the agricultural work and 38.9 percent of total state budgetary expenditure went to public health, literature and art and sports sectors, including the preferential provision of the necessary funds for improving the educational work.
Last year, too, funds were allotted for the anti-epidemic work in order to increase the ability to rapidly respond to various infectious diseases in the world.
The successful fulfillment of the state budget for 2025 is the result of the boundless patriotic devotion of all the people.
It is important to provide a reliable financial guarantee for the work and production activities of all sectors and units in order to successfully carry out the first-year tasks of the new five-year plan set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the report said, and went on:
The state budget for 2026 has been compiled to promote the development of all sectors and units including science, education, public health, literature and art and contribute to the improvement of the people's standard of living while concentrating its investment on the building of the stronger force capable of repelling all sorts of military threats for defending the sovereignty and security of the country and on the successful attainment of the production targets for this year in the national economy.
This year's state budgetary revenue is expected to grow to 100.5 percent over last year and the turnover tax and enterprise profits, major items of the budgetary revenue, will increase to 100.3 percent and 100.1 percent respectively, accounting for 84.4 percent of the total revenue.
The profits of cooperative organizations are expected to grow to 101.8 percent, depreciation 102.7 percent, real estate rent 102.5 percent, premium for social insurance 102.4 percent, income from property sale and price fluctuation 102.8 percent, income from money collection 102 percent, other incomes 104.3 percent and income from special economic zones 101.4 percent, as compared with last year.
The central budgetary revenue is expected to account for 72.2 percent of the state budgetary revenue, with the revenue from the central economy amounting to a large proportion, and provincial, city and county people's committees will provide some funds for the scientific research in the agricultural sector, medical work and others to the central budget.
This year's state budgetary expenditure is expected to increase to 105.8 percent over last year.
This year, funds equivalent to 15.8 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure will be spent on national defence, contributing to the steady expansion and strengthening of the powerful self-defensive nuclear deterrent and war capabilities.
Funds needed for socialist economic construction are to increase to 105.5 percent over last year, amounting to 43.8 percent of the total state budgetary expenditure.
Funds equivalent to 106.3 percent as against last year are allotted for the work of national economy in 2026 and they will be spent for the major sectors including metallurgical, chemical, electric power, coal and machine-building industries and railway transport.
Funds equivalent to 105.3 percent over last year will be used for the development of science and technology.
It is expected to disburse funds equivalent to 105.7 percent over last year for the agricultural work in order to contribute to the strengthening of material and technical foundations of rural economy.
This year's state budget allots funds equivalent to 106 percent to educational sector as compared with last year, 105.6 percent to the public health sector, 103.1 percent to the cultural sector and 102.8 percent to the sports sector for the people-centered policies and the social and cultural work.
Funds for the anti-epidemic work are expected to grow to 101.1 percent over last year.
This year, too, the state will send a lot of educational aid funds and stipends to the Korean children in Japan so that they can grow up to be reliable pillars who will carry forward the patriotic cause. -0-
