headline: Congratulatory Statements Issued by Foreign Political Parties and Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 28 (KCNA) -- Political parties and organizations of different countries issued congratulatory statements as regards the fact that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas invariably held in high esteem as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Ninth Congress of the WPK was successfully held.
The People's Socialist Party of Mexico in its statement extended warm congratulations to ComradeKim Jong Unupon his reelection as general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea at its Ninth Congress.
The statement of the Mexico-Korea Solidarity Committee said that to invariably hold ComradeKim Jong Unin high esteem as the top leader of the WPK is a decisive factor in firmly guaranteeing the victory in the cause of the Korean people.
The Kuwait-DPRK Friendship Association in a statement said that the long-term plans and tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK would serve as an inspiring banner for instilling confidence and optimism into the Korean people and bringing about fresh miracles and innovations in all fields of the state building.
The Vienna Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism in Austria in a statement expressed belief that the DPRK would in the future, too, continue to achieve many successes under the wise leadership of His ExcellencyKim Jong Un.
The Nigerian National Committee for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism said in a statement:
The WPK will as ever demonstrate its reputation as an invincible party leading the Korean people to victory.
Its Congress will mark another new milestone in the sacred journey for the development of the WPK and socialist construction.
The Egypt-Korea Friendship Association in a statement wished the WPK bigger successes in the drive for the development and prosperity of the DPRK and the wellbeing of its people under the outstanding leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Preparations for 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival Brisk in Different Countries
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 28 (KCNA) -- The April Spring Friendship Art Festival is a festival which has been held with splendor in praise of a great man for decades under the idea of independence, peace and friendship.
The festival, started in April 1982 for the first time amid the boundless reverence and best wishes of all people for PresidentKim Il Sung, has made great contributions to promoting friendship, unity and cultural exchange among peoples and artistes of different countries and developing the music and art of mankind with concerted efforts.
Over the past 40-odd years, nearly 20 000 foreigners and overseas Koreans from more than 2 090 art troupes, cultural delegations, visiting groups and support organizations of many countries have participated in the festival.
This year, too, art troupes and artistes in many countries spare no effort in their preparations for the festival to decorate the April holiday with a beautiful flower garden of art.
At present, art troupes and famous artistes from dozens of countries applied for their participation in the festival and sent art pieces they prepared with sincerity.
Songs, dances, acrobatics and other art pieces reflecting the boundless sincerity of all people admiring and lauding the peerlessly great men will add to the joy and excitement of celebrating the significant April holiday. -0-

headline: Greenhouse Vegetables Supplied to Inhabitants in Sinuiju City
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 28 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, Sinuiju City in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK is stepping up the supply to inhabitants of various kinds of fresh vegetables, produced at the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and the Sinuiju Vegetable Science Research Center.
The city has already supplied cucumber, pepper, tomato and other vegetable fruits, leaf vegetables and functional vegetables to orphanage, and primary and secondary schools for orphans. And it is now taking measures to supply them to war veterans and families of disabled soldiers.
In order to ensure that greenhouse vegetables are supplied to the residential households far from the city, it is solving ahead of schedule the problems arising in transport.
It has also urged the relevant units to provide necessary transport containers for preventing greenhouse vegetables from being damaged.
Facilities related to the supply of vegetables are set up everywhere so that the inhabitants can receive vegetables from their residential quarters.
The service facilities in the city are crowded with people being supplied with fresh vegetables. -0-

headline: Fertilizer Production Increased in DPRK
story_text:

Many units have vied with each other to present new technical innovation proposals so as to contribute to carrying out the plan of the complex.
Amid the brisk April 15 technological innovation shock brigade campaign, the complex has produced hundreds of more tons of fertilizer than the planned while saving a lot of anthracite by reducing the standard of material consumption per unit. -0-

headline: Peculiar Mother-of-pearl Work
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 28 (KCNA) -- The peculiar mother-of-pearl art is part of the cultural heritage showing the talents and wisdom of Koreans.
The mother-of-pearl art is a form of craftwork in which thinly processed shells are cut into various forms and inlaid into the surface of things as decoration.
In ancient times, Korean ancestors created the mother-of-pearl art by getting an idea from the formative beauty in combination of lacquering and shell decoration in woodwork and from inlaying in ceramics.
The art further developed in the period of Koryo Dynasty. Mother-of-pearl craftworks in the period were diverse in decorative materials and unique in decorative methods. Craftworks are magnificent and delicate as they are patterned with clam shell, tortoise shell, silver thread, copper thread and gold and silver powder.
Typical of them were such works as "grapevine-patterned mother-of-pearl book box", "chrysanthemum vine-patterned round box" and "chrysanthemum vine-patterned mother-of-pearl box", which are known still today.
Today, the mother-of-pearl art is being carried forward and developed with more refined and unique embellishment in conformity with the feelings of the times and the emotion of the people.
Mother-of-pearl craftworks showing the beautiful and happy life of the Korean people are exhibited at the annual national sculpture and craftwork festival in recent years to draw the attention of visitors. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Ground Jet Test of High-Thrust Carbon Fiber Solid-Fuel Engine
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 29 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw a ground jet test of high-thrust solid-fuel engine using the composite carbon fiber material.
The maximum thrust of the newly upgraded solid-fuel engine is 2 500kN and the test is a part of the national defence development plan in the period of the new five-year plan which set the steady upgrading of strategic strike means as a major goal.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK.
He referred to the strategic significance of the upgraded engine's test.
He said that the test of great significance in putting the country's strategic military muscle on the highest level fully conforms with the national strategy and the military demand for modernizing the strategic forces.
He affirmed that the development trend of the DPRK's defence capabilities, which has already entered a significant phase of change in the building of the strategic forces, would be further transformed and accelerated by the development and introduction of better components with superior economic and technical effectiveness as proven in the test.
He referred to the major tasks for further stepping up the development of the state strategic forces both in quality and quantity.
Present there were Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, officials of the Missile Administration and the missile research sector and scientists, technicians and officials of the relevant sector including the Institute of Solid-fuel Engine and the Missile Engine Production Factory. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 29 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Min Pu Yong, a woman living in the Neighborhood Unit No. 15 of Yonha-dong, Haeju City of South Hwanghae Province, on her 100th birthday.
Born into a poor peasant family before national liberation, Min experienced the sorrow of a stateless nation and lived in pain. She could lead a genuine life and happiness only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
With a resolve to repay the benevolence of the Party, she had worked sincerely at her post and led her children to fulfill their duty as the masters of the country.
Seeing her who was so impressed by the benevolent birthday spread, her family members and relatives were full of enthusiasm to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the worthwhile struggle to usher in an era of great changes, always remembering the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Officials of the Party and power organs in Haeju City and villagers celebrated the auspicious event of the family together. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 29 (KCNA) -- Kangwon Province of the DPRK is stepping up the construction of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station No. 2 and the Ichon Army-People Power Station No. 2, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The command team of the provincial army-people power station construction division worked out an annual plan for speeding up the construction of the power stations and detailed the assignments.
Builders in charge of the foundation excavation of the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station No. 2 are expanding the successes by displaying their strong practical ability even under unfavorable working circumstances. The respected ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the relevant test as it served as an occasion to show well how excellent our new-type MBT is and how dependable combat means it is through actual action, not words.
He said today's test proved that the functionality of our new-type MBT's interceptor system is fully equipped with a thorough capability for destroying almost all existing anti-tank means.
Commenting on the new-type MBT which demonstrated remarkable combat performance, he said it has been confirmed again that there is no doubt in our view, already declared, that no tank in the world is comparable to this tank.
The test, conducted in various aspects on the day to check the active protection system of the new-type MBT, examined in detail the combat effectiveness of the protection system against anti-tank means attacking in different directions and confirmed the perfect defensive function with 100 percent probability. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 29 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the special operations training base directly under the authority of the Operations Bureau of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army to acquaint himself with the training of special operations sub-units at all levels.

Kim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the KPA General Staff, Kim Song Gi, director of the KPA General Political Bureau, and other military and political commanding officers of the headquarters of the Ministry of National Defence and all services and large combined units.
All the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander who is ushering in a great heyday of building a powerful army with his outstanding military strategic ideology and extraordinary commanding art.
The training of the day was aimed at estimating the capabilities of physical and military action of the combatants of special operations sub-units at all levels.
The training was observed by major leading officials of the Party and the government.
The special operations sub-units of services and large combined units at all levels, which have further strengthened the matchless combat efficiency, leaving vivid footprints of loyalty and patriotism in the difficult and arduous training course, true to the Party's training-first policy, fully displayed their crack-shot marksmanship and military technical and physical ability in a competitive way.
Kim Jong Unsaid that our army at all levels should get fully prepared in conformity with the trend of modern warfare by thoroughly implementing and applying the Juche-oriented policy of bringing about a radical turn in training, well aware of the iron truth that much more sweat in the peacetime training leads to less blood in the battlefield.
He expressed his views on the programme for reorganizing the special operations forces of our army, to be implemented in the future, and the follow-up measures.
On the same day, there was a demonstration performance of ace combatants of special operations sub-units.
The soldiers in the demonstration performance strikingly showed the physical and technical ability they have prepared to be a-match-for-a hundred combatants with iron fists.
While watching with pleasure the training of women special warfare soldiers full of self-confidence,Kim Jong Unwarmly encouraged them.
The leading officials extended warm applause and high praise to the soldiers, watching their training pulsating with the fighting spirit and heroic stamina of our invincible army to unconditionally annihilate the enemy.
Expressing great satisfaction at the absolute might and dauntless courage of the special operations forces, the pivotal component of the KPA reliably defending the sovereignty of the DPRK and the wellbeing of its people,Kim Jong Unhad a meaningful photo taken with the reliable and admirable officers and soldiers.
At the end of the photo session, the passionate guards broke into thunderous cheers of absolute loyalty in token of their will to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee headed by ComradeKim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Unexpressed belief that our army at all levels, directly entrusted with the task of fighting a war as the main force of national defence, would as ever remain faithful to the sacred mission of defending the country, the revolution and the people and reliably guarantee the victorious advance of our country and our cause with the powerful military strength. -0-

headline: Work for Creating Rape Fields Brisk at Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 29 (KCNA) -- The work for creating rape fields is brisk at the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm area in the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Officials and working people from various regions and units in North Phyongan Province have turned out in the work to create vast areas of rape fields.
Officials and designers of the Agricultural Design Branch of the North Phyongan Provincial Design Institute made a field survey of large areas from the Hadan Branch Farm No. 1 to the Soho Branch Farm and completed the design in a short span of time.
Working people of various industrial establishments in the province and members of the women's union in Sinuiju City set a goal of carrying 200 tons of humus soil per hectare to the rape fields and conducted the work for its execution.
The units in charge of the creation of irrigation facilities for rape fields and the installation of irrigation and pumping equipment are displaying a high sense of responsibility.
Officials and working people of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm carried out their tasks such as securing and transporting manure, ploughing and making ridges between fields. They, who harvested the first vegetables in a few days after the inauguration of the farm, secured high-quality manure resources and made effective use of vehicles to carry hundreds of tons of humus soil and manure on a daily average.
A demonstration was held before starting the sowing of rape seeds in vast areas. -0-

Seeing her who was so impressed by the benevolent birthday spread, her family members and relatives were full of enthusiasm to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the worthwhile struggle to usher in an era of great changes, always remembering the loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea.

headline: Multipurpose Organic Wastewater Purifier Developed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- The Nano Science and Technology Institute at Kim Chaek University of Technology in the DPRK developed an efficacious multipurpose organic wastewater purifier, which is easy to use, according to Minju Joson.
As its purifying process is simple, it can be used by all production units including foodstuff factories and paper mills.
This high-tech product, which is also effective in sewage treatment, has been introduced into dozens of units.

headline: Saeppyol Street Seethes with Moving into New Houses
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- Saeppyol Street, a pride of Pyongyang, is greeting the owners who are moving into new houses every day.
Saeppyol Street was provided by the world of love and obligation of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee for the war heroes, who devoted their precious youth to defending the dignity and honor of the country for its eternal prosperity, and for their bereaved families. Officials in Pyongyang and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army units and military-civilian builders engaged in the construction warmly congratulated the bereaved families on moving into their new houses with the licenses for the use of houses.
The owners of the new houses are cherishing the benevolence of the WPK, looking at the magnificent landscapes of the dwelling houses in which the formative art, practicality and convenience were ensured at the highest level and the residential area in which the commercial and service facilities are in ideal harmony.
All the bereaved families expressed thanks to the motherly Party, saying they were deeply moved by the warm sincerity for their living including the supply of various kinds of daily necessities and foodstuffs lest they felt any slight inconvenience.
Looking at the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, they are hardening their will to work hard for the prosperity of the country just as their husbands and children did. -0-

headline: Technology of Cultivating Oil-bearing Tree Established in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- The Botany Institute of the State Academy of Sciences of the DPRK has recently established a technology of cultivating Quercus Rubra of high economic value, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Tens of kilograms of oil can be extracted from one ton of its fruit. And edible alcohol can be made from the residue, the rest used for feeding domestic animals and its timber used for manufacturing furniture.
At present, North and South Hwanghae provinces are converting shrubberies into forests of Quercus Rubra and a lot of areas are following suit as it requires little investment and has great economic benefits.
Scientists of the institute are giving scientific and technological guidance at its introduction in contact with relevant areas and, at the same time, making efforts to perfect the cultivation technology including increasing fruit production and raising the alive rate of graft. -0-

headline: DPRK Salt Industry Sector Fulfills Quarterly National Economic Plan
story_text:
Pyongyang, March 30 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers in the salt industry sector fulfilled its national economic plan for the first quarter of this year.
The Kwangryangman Salt Works carried out its quarterly plan at more than 157 percent by dint of science and technology.
Officials and employees of the Namyang Salt Works registered remarkable results by concentrating their efforts on raising the proportion of mechanization. They secured spare parts and strengthened the responsibility and role of operators and water caretakers. As a result, the operation rate of equipment used for the realignment of salt fields and transport and the efficiency of water circulation system were improved to produce hundreds of tons of more salt than planned.
Kwisong, Unha and Kumsong salt works took technical measures to raise the salinity of seawater and conducted socialist emulations while taking responsible care of evaporating and crystallization ponds and storage facilities, thus revitalizing production.
The Onchon Tile Factory and the Salt-making Machine Repair Plant made successive innovations while improving the performance of kilns and machine tools and giving precedence to the supply of raw and other materials. -0-

headline: Emergency Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau of C.C., WPK Held in Flood-hit Area
story_text:
Some areas of North Phyongan Province and Jagang Province of the DPRK suffered flood damage in late July 2024.
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unpersonally guided on the spot the work to rescue and evacuate the inhabitants in the flood-hit area and the area that damage was predicted in North Phyongan Province.
The inhabitants were saved. However, the material damage was serious and the restoration work to be done in the future was enormous.
The General Secretary planned the next-stage essential undertakings without delay.
He could convene a meeting in Pyongyang as the worst of sudden crisis was over but he could not delay it even a moment.
He decided to convene a meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea on the spot as the miserable circumstance of the flood-hit area still came into his mind and inconvenience the inhabitants would feel at temporary residences in such sweltering weather every moment came across his mind as an unbearable pain.
So, the 22nd emergency enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK was held at a train which stopped near a flooded paddy field between the flood waving like sea and a bank.
At the meeting, the General Secretary said that we had undergone such crisis more than once and at every time we had been always brave and offensive in the face of crisis and worked miracles only, stressing the need to turn out in the struggle for overcoming the crisis once again to bring about miraculous achievements.
Adopted at the meeting was a decision of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee "On rapidly recovering the damage from flood in North Phyongan and Jagang provinces".
The emergency enlarged meeting on the day, to be specially recorded in the history of the WPK, was another impressive picture showing what are the revolutionary character and the mode of existence of the WPK and where its vigorous guiding force comes from. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, March 31 (KCNA) -- North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK has expanded the areas under wheat and barley cultivation, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province set the goal for cultivating wheat and barley in larger areas and organized the work for its realization.
In particular, it worked out a plan for cultivating wheat and barley well even in the northern intermediate and mountainous areas and took scientific and technological measures. At the same time, it urged farms to expand the areas under wheat and barley cultivation.
Sowing wheat and barley seeds was conducted actively at the farms.
Sowing wheat and barley seeds was finished in the right season in many areas, including Kilju and Hwadae counties, and the farms in northern intermediate and mountainous areas including Kyongwon and Kyonghung counties have increased their sowing results every day.

headline: Appeal to Working Class and Trade Union Members across DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea issued an appeal to the working class and trade union members across the country on March 30, under the title "Let us fully demonstrate the strong spirit of the heroic Korean working class in the sacred struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism, cherishing the great trust of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea as lifeblood".
The appeal said that an all-people general advance for the brilliant fulfillment of the new Five-Year Plan began along the road of victory indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
The Party Central Committee designed a brighter future of our country, believing in the mettle of the struggle of our working class who invariably carried forward the traditions of loyalty and patriotism in the annals of the revolution, the appeal said, and went on:
All the working class and trade union members!
Let us take the lead in ushering in a new proud era of national prosperity surpassing the past five years with more innovative and more strenuous efforts, bearing in mind the ardent patriotic idea and intention of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The workers and trade union members in the metallurgical industry sector, the key industry of our economy!
Let us systematically increase the production of iron and steel, as befitting the eldest son of the country who has set high goals for himself, challenged the impossibility and upheld the Party's plan and determination, thus strongly guaranteeing the growth and development of the overall economy.
The workers and trade union members in the chemical industry sector!
You should hold fast to self-reliance and science and technology as lifeline and kindle the flames of the drive for increased production and creation so as to push ahead with the drive for putting the chemical industry on an independent and modern basis.
The workers and trade union members in the electric-power and coal industries!

headline: Folk Customs of DPRK Seen in April
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- From olden times, the Korean people have created and inherited various customs of life suited to the seasonal characteristics of warm April.
In April there are Chongmyong and Kogu, part of the 24 seasonal divisions of the year in the lunar calendar.
Chongmyong means the time when the sky is getting gradually bright and Kogu means the time when rain favorable for the growth of crops falls.
When Chongmyong comes, the Korean people clear up the traces of winter, sow various kinds of flower seeds in flower gardens, and cultivate fruit trees around their houses.
They also visit the graves of their ancestors, repair the damaged parts and pay tribute.
There is a Korean proverb that the land dries in depth when it doesn't rain on the day of Kogu. This shows that people in the past attached great importance to the rain on the day.
Koreans were busy with farming in that important period decisive of farming for the year.
In the period between Chongmyong and Kogu, the Korean people played various kinds of folk games and caught fish in rivers and seas.
Chongmyong and Kogu this year are April 5 and 20. -0-

headline: Success at Koryo Medicine General Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 1 (KCNA) -- The Constitutions Institute of Koryo Medicine General Hospital in the DPRK has developed the Koryo medicine-based system 2.0 of classifying human constitutions, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The system is composed of categories of constitutional examination and knowledge.
The constitutional examination analyzes the constitution by examining relevant indices reflecting the structural elements of constitutions through verbal and ocular inspection, voice analysis, constitutional elements analysis and 3-D constitutional probing. The constitutional knowledge tells daily regimen, prescriptions and therapies suited to different constitutions, including constitutional characteristics and know-how in regimen.
The system helps minimize the morbidity and prevent diseases by classifying the human constitutions more accurately and informing the users of the appropriate regimen and methods of treatment. In addition it makes it possible to conduct a scientific diagnosis according to constitutions, thus shortening the period of treatment and increasing the effect of treatment.
In December last year, the medical workers of the institute, who made achievements conducive to the development of Koryo medicine, were awarded the certificate of application of state sci-tech achievements. -0-

headline: School-opening Ceremony Held at Korean Rehabilitation Centre
Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement on Thursday:
Shortly ago, the UN Human Rights Council adopted another illegal "resolution" malignantly pulling up the DPRK over its human rights situation.
The "resolution", cooked up actively by those countries habituated to inveterate repugnancy toward the DPRK, is a political fraud document full of false data that totally distorted the DPRK's policy for ensuring genuine human rights and its actual situation.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry brands the adoption of this anti-DPRK "human rights resolution" as a grave political provocation to the dignity and sovereignty of the DPRK and denounces and rejects it in the most powerful language.
In the DPRK where the state has promoted the people's rights and well-being in an entirely responsible manner, genuine human rights are guaranteed in full accord with the independent demand and interests of the working masses.
The "human rights" racket, frequently kicked up at the UN arena by the hostile forces obsessed with prejudice and malignant viewpoint on the DPRK, does never represent the mindset of the international community aspiring after justice and equality. And the selective human rights discussion system targeting individual countries is a hostile act contrary to the spirit of the UN Charter which stipulates the principles of sovereignty equality and non-interference in internal affairs.
The practice of adopting such anti-DPRK "human rights resolution" which has lasted for 20-odd years is a epitome fully showing the deplorable present situation of the UN human rights arena which has been extremely polluted by politicization, selectivity and double standards.
The urgent task facing the UN Human Rights Council at present is to thoroughly investigate the hideous unethical crimes caused by the hegemonic forces' state-sponsored terrorism and infringement upon sovereignty and take practical measures for calling them to account.
In the Middle East, massacres are being committed one after another to put the crimes against humanity committed during the Second World War into the shade. Even, more than a hundred of children, to be specially protected in any case, became the targets of precisely guided weapons to be killed. Such a tragedy has been a daily occurrence in that region.
The cold reality, in which the international law and norms and order are mercilessly violated and the encroachment on national sovereignty is led to human rights abuses due to the hegemonic forces' ambition for aggression, implants deep in the world people the iron truth that to defend the national sovereignty precisely means the defending of human rights.
The DPRK remains unchanged in its stand to defend in every way the dignity and sovereignty of the state and the rights and interests of the people from any threat and smear campaign of the hostile forces.
The recent malicious behavior of those countries, who were involved in slandering and insulting the most popular and righteous state and social system of the DPRK while blindly following the hostile forces, will be surely taken into account.
The DPRK will as ever remain faithful to its responsibility and mission to thoroughly guarantee the peace, wellbeing and genuine right to life of its people. -0-

It is the unshakable conviction and confidence of all the DPRK people that their advance toward a better future will lead to greater success and victory as the revolutionary ideas of the great leader have illuminated the road ahead of their struggle century after century. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Choe Ho Won, a woman living in Neighborhood Unit No. 55, Samma-dong, Jongju City, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
The centenarian expressed her deep gratitude to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unfor having shown his loving care for an ordinary old woman.
Officials of the Jongju City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers congratulated her family on its auspicious event.
Choe suffered all manner of humiliation and insult before the liberation of Korea. She could enjoy a worthwhile and happy life after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country, and had dedicated herself to the grain production for decades to repay the benevolence of the President.
The best in the world is our socialist system, a large harmonious family in which doctors very often visit her to examine her health and people help and lead each other forward, she said, requesting her descendants to do more work for the grateful country. -0-

headline: New School Year for 2026 Begins in DPRK
Successes Made at Scientific Research Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- Scientific research units in the DPRK commit themselves to major projects for economic development, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The State Academy of Sciences is directing all efforts to solve pending problems in the country's development of science, technology and economy. In particular, it concentrates its force and means on the research to solve the energy problem. It keeps on doing research into further perfecting the paper-making method and technology based on locally-available raw materials and makes preparations for expanding the successes made in the development of Korean-style forced airflow fine coal gasification technology.
Over 450 members of the scientific farming promotion team are now active in different parts of the country to give scientific guidance for this year's farming while raising the regeneration rate of wheat and barley.
The Academy of Agricultural Science is conducting researches into breeding seeds that can produce a good crop in a stable way despite unfavorable weather conditions and developing labor-saving and cost-saving agricultural scientific and technological products. After finishing the production of seed-covering material "Phungnyonmo-1" with effectiveness and superiority proven in the past as well as bacterial fertilizer effective for land improvement, it has taken measures to send them to farms.
Scientists of the Academy of Light Industry under the Ministry of Light Industry are bringing about good results in the research project of great significance in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Crimes of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 2 (KCNA) -- The Japanese imperialists, who fabricated the "Ulsa Five-point Treaty" by means of military blackmail and fraud, set up the residency-general in Korea, a barbarous colonial ruling body, in 1906, despite the fact that the "treaty" was illegal and invalid in the light of  international law.
In the period of the resident-general's rule, the Japanese imperialists established a foundation for their colonial rule over Korea in earnest.
They promulgated an ordinance on prohibiting "free entry" into the royal palace so as to disallow any Korean to meet the Korean emperor without their approval and shackle the emperor. And they let the Japanese dispatched by the residency-general rule all the fields directly. The resident-general was just the supreme ruler with the authority to handle all legislative, judicial, administrative and military affairs of Korea.
The Japanese imperialists realized their domination over the whole of Korea by relying on the residency-general. They cooked up "Mineral mining law", "Oriental Development Company" and others to plunder underground, marine and land resources of Korea and take control of its finance.
And they enforced colonial slave education and closed patriotic private schools, while bringing huge troops to Korea to support the rule of the resident-general.
At the order of Hirobumi Ito, the first resident-general, the Japanese imperialists brutally massacred the patriots of Korea who rose up in resistance to the colonial rule. They hurled armed troops into major cities and even remote mountainous areas of Korea to commit hideous massacre and arson, destroying and looting cultural assets at random.
Owing to the resident-general's rule spanning nearly five years, feudal Joson (Korea) collapsed completely and the colonial fascist ruling system of the Japanese imperialists was established. Therefore, Koreans were forced to undergo untold misfortune and sufferings. -0-

headline: Distillation of Riganggo - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- Riganggo is a kind of liquor distilled in combination of pear and ginger famous in Hwanghae Province of Korea. Riganggo means pear and ginger in Korean.
It is recorded in old books that Riganggo is one of famous liquors in the country, together with Kamhong-ro of Pyongyang.
Riganggo is cream-colored liquor with refreshing and delicious flavors.
From olden times the residents in Hwanghae Province have distilled the liquor for their dietary life.
The method of distilling Riganggo is as follows:
Ferment starch-containing materials with malt.
Distil crude liquor from them.
Mix it with pear and ginger juice and honey, and complete distilling Riganggo on a low heat.
The distillation of Riganggo was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in May 2018. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Dangerous Military Attempt
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- Against the backdrop of massive structural reorganization among the Japanese armed forces this spring, the "Space Operations Group" under the Air "Self-Defense Force" was recently raised to the status of the "Space Operations Squadron".
At the same time, the number of persons has increased more than twice.
A small unit in full charge of the space was formed in 2020, and the number of service personnel has increased dozens of times in just a few years. And its name and formation changed into the said names every two to three years, arousing a serious concern of the international community about the reality of the rapidly growing Japanese space force.
Not content with this, the "Space Operations Squadron" will become the "Space Operations Corps" within this year and the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" will be reportedly renamed the aerospace "Self-Defense Force".
The rapid expansion of the space operations force cannot be seen merely as part of the structural reorganization of the expanded military force as a whole.
As recognized by the public at home and abroad, Japan has long laid legal, material and technical foundations with the ambition to expand the operations scope of the "Self-Defense Forces" into space.
Behind the deceptive "bill" on the use of space for peaceful purposes, Japan had been secretly conducting spy satellite research since the late 1970s. It adopted the "Basic Law on Space" in 2008 to allow military use of outer space under the signboard of "defense" and in 2012 it amended even the clause specifying that aerospace development shall be limited to the peaceful purpose, thus eliminating the legal obstacles hindering the weaponization of outer space.
In 2018, Japan officially declared space to be a new sphere of defense through the new "defense program" and "Midterm Defence Capability Buildup Outline", thus further consolidating the legal foundation for weaponization of outer space.
Japan has established an information gathering satellite system capable of monitoring the whole earth for 24 hours through spy satellites. And it has expanded into a force capable of fighting even a space war by equipping itself even with missile technology and missile interception system.
Against this backdrop, the Japanese reactionaries openly made bellicose remarks that "the exercise of the right to collective self-defense is possible even in space."
What merits more serious attention is that a neo-militarist force has recently become influential in the Japanese political circles, which encourages the ill-boding move to gain the position for preemptive attack even in outer space, while the deployment of the overall military muscle is being changed into an offensive form.
In July last year, the Japanese Defense Ministry adopted for the first time the "Guidelines for Defending Outer Space" for bolstering up the defense capability in outer space. Pulling up China and Russia over its satellite development as a threat to Japan, it clearly specified that it would accelerate the use of space for establishing the so-called "Stand-off Defense Capability" capable of attacking out of the enemy's range of fire.
At a meeting of the aerospace development strategy headquarters in December, it decided on a new process table of the space main plan stipulating that it shall conduct a verification test to cope with a hypersonic glide weapon in outer space, and engage in the launch of a satellite capable of grasping the trend of satellites of other countries.
This shows that the Japanese reactionaries are pushing ahead with the move to develop the space operations force into the one next to the ground, naval and air forces and into a typical preemptive attack force in order to hold a military edge in the outer space.
This is evidenced by the fact that the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" has worked out an operations plan and staged actual drills for completing a military posture in space in separate drills or in U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral military drills in a few years.
Japan, a war criminal state deprived of the right to have an army, participate in a war and to belligerency, has turned the SDF into a full-fledged offensive force by challenging the international community. Not content with this, it is making desperate efforts to seize outer space as its sphere of activity. This reality clearly shows the dangerous ambition for reinvasion and endless belligerence of the reactionaries of the island country.
The international community is strictly watching Japan's reckless moves for weaponization of outer space that violates the calmness of the universe and the peace of the planet. -0-

headline: National Cooking Festival Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- The 29th National Cooking Festival took place at Hwasong Restaurant from March 31 to April 3 on the occasion of the auspicious April holiday.
Taking part in the festival were cooks, waiters and waitresses, and housewives selected from the sectors of the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service, public catering establishments of Pyongyang and provinces (municipalities), external service, ministries and national agencies and Pyongyang municipal women's union organizations. Presented to it were more than 600 peculiar dishes and drink beverages and over 130 scientific and technological achievements.
There were a cookery show aiming at the exchange of excellent cooking technology and experience, show of dishes for folk holidays, show of dishes peculiar to regions and show of health dishes.
Displayed at the exhibition of culinary sci-tech achievements were the inventions conducive to putting the cookery on a scientific and modern basis in the form of objects, visual aids and multimedia.
During the festival, there were also a competition of cooks and waiters and waitresses, a demonstration of cooks, and a competition of housewives in Pyongyang.
Present at the closing ceremony held on Friday were officials concerned, cooks, waiters and waitresses and housewives selected from Pyongyang and provinces (municipalities).
At the ceremony, the jury results were announced and diplomas, medals and certificates awarded to the excellent units and participants. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Wang Yi, foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, on March 26.
Extending warm congratulations to Choe Son Hui on her reappointment as foreign minister of the DPRK, the message stressed that a new phase was opened and an important opportunity for development was greeted in the China-DPRK relations under the joint guidance of General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
It expressed the readiness to strive to promote the development of the traditional China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations by thoroughly implementing the common understandings of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries and boosting communication and cooperation between the diplomatic fields of the two countries. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Li Qiang, premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, on March 27.
In the message, Li Qiang, on behalf of the Chinese government, extended sincere congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his reappointment as premier of the DPRK Cabinet at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly.
He sincerely hoped that the DPRK people would steadily achieve fresh and bigger successes in accomplishing the socialist cause of the DPRK under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Saying that China and the DPRK are the friendly neighbors linked by the same mountain and rivers, the message noted that the bilateral relations greeted a new historic period and have been steadily put on a higher stage under the strategic guidance and personal care of General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unin recent years.
It expressed the readiness to thoroughly implement the important common understandings of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries and thus encourage the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation to achieve fresh and greater development and provide wellbeing to the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Dangerous Military Attempt
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- Against the backdrop of massive structural reorganization among the Japanese armed forces this spring, the "Space Operations Group" under the Air "Self-Defense Force" was recently raised to the status of the "Space Operations Squadron".
At the same time, the number of persons has increased more than twice.
A small unit in full charge of the space was formed in 2020, and the number of service personnel has increased dozens of times in just a few years. And its name and formation changed into the said names every two to three years, arousing a serious concern of the international community about the reality of the rapidly growing Japanese space force.
Not content with this, the "Space Operations Squadron" will become the "Space Operations Corps" within this year and the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" will be reportedly renamed the aerospace "Self-Defense Force".
The rapid expansion of the space operations force cannot be seen merely as part of the structural reorganization of the expanded military force as a whole.
As recognized by the public at home and abroad, Japan has long laid legal, material and technical foundations with the ambition to expand the operations scope of the "Self-Defense Forces" into space.
Behind the deceptive "bill" on the use of space for peaceful purposes, Japan had been secretly conducting spy satellite research since the late 1970s. It adopted the "Basic Law on Space" in 2008 to allow military use of outer space under the signboard of "defense" and in 2012 it amended even the clause specifying that aerospace development shall be limited to the peaceful purpose, thus eliminating the legal obstacles hindering the weaponization of outer space.
In 2018, Japan officially declared space to be a new sphere of defense through the new "defense program" and "Midterm Defence Capability Buildup Outline", thus further consolidating the legal foundation for weaponization of outer space.
Japan has established an information gathering satellite system capable of monitoring the whole earth for 24 hours through spy satellites. And it has expanded into a force capable of fighting even a space war by equipping itself even with missile technology and missile interception system.
Against this backdrop, the Japanese reactionaries openly made bellicose remarks that "the exercise of the right to collective self-defense is possible even in space."
What merits more serious attention is that a neo-militarist force has recently become influential in the Japanese political circles, which encourages the ill-boding move to gain the position for preemptive attack even in outer space, while the deployment of the overall military muscle is being changed into an offensive form.
In July last year, the Japanese Defense Ministry adopted for the first time the "Guidelines for Defending Outer Space" for bolstering up the defense capability in outer space. Pulling up China and Russia over its satellite development as a threat to Japan, it clearly specified that it would accelerate the use of space for establishing the so-called "Stand-off Defense Capability" capable of attacking out of the enemy's range of fire.
At a meeting of the aerospace development strategy headquarters in December, it decided on a new process table of the space main plan stipulating that it shall conduct a verification test to cope with a hypersonic glide weapon in outer space, and engage in the launch of a satellite capable of grasping the trend of satellites of other countries.
This shows that the Japanese reactionaries are pushing ahead with the move to develop the space operations force into the one next to the ground, naval and air forces and into a typical preemptive attack force in order to hold a military edge in the outer space.
This is evidenced by the fact that the Japan Air "Self-Defense Force" has worked out an operations plan and staged actual drills for completing a military posture in space in separate drills or in U.S.-led bilateral and multilateral military drills in a few years.
Japan, a war criminal state deprived of the right to have an army, participate in a war and to belligerency, has turned the SDF into a full-fledged offensive force by challenging the international community. Not content with this, it is making desperate efforts to seize outer space as its sphere of activity. This reality clearly shows the dangerous ambition for reinvasion and endless belligerence of the reactionaries of the island country.
The international community is strictly watching Japan's reckless moves for weaponization of outer space that violates the calmness of the universe and the peace of the planet. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) - - The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on March 31.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I, on behalf of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, the government and the people of Laos and on my own behalf, extend warm congratulations to you on your reelection as President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK held on March 22, 2026.
Still now, I remember vividly that paying an official visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on October 7-8, 2025, I and my delegation met you in Pyongyang and received a warm and grand hospitality.
I am firmly convinced that the traditional and close strategic relations of friendship and cooperation between the Lao People's Democratic Republic and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with common ideals will steadily develop in depth in the future, too, to bring substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contribute to peace, stability, cooperation and development in the region and the rest of the world.
Availing myself of this auspicious opportunity, I sincerely wish you good health and happiness and greater success in your noble and honorable work.
I pay high tribute to you. -0-

headline: University Graduates Volunteer for Worksites to Implement Party's Decisions
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- University graduates in South Phyongan, South Hwanghae and Ryanggang provinces of the DPRK have responded to the call of the country and the era amid the growing patriotic enthusiasm of the young vanguard to usher in the era of a giant new transformation, true to the great fighting programme set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Graduates of Phyongsong University of Education and Phyongsong Teachers Training College are full of the enthusiasm to fulfill their responsibility and duty as educators at remote mountainous schools and branch schools in Kaechon City and Taehung and Yangdok counties.
Those of Haeju Kim Jong Thae University of Education and Haeju Jo Ok Hui Teachers Training College volunteered to work at revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and schools in islet villages and mountainous areas.
Those of Hyesan Teachers Training College and Kim Jong Suk University of Education set it as their lifetime motto to work at schools in Samjiyon City and Kim Hyong Jik and Unhung counties.
Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers at the meetings attended by officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth and students.
Speeches were made and art performances were given at the meetings.
Officials, youth and students encouraged the volunteers, giving bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Enlarged Plenary Meeting of DPRK Cabinet Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- An enlarged plenary meeting of the Cabinet of the DPRK was held at the Cabinet through video-conferencing on Friday.
The meeting was guided by Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Kim Tok Hun, first vice-premier of the Cabinet, and Pak Jong Gun, vice-premier of the Cabinet and chairman of the State Planning Commission.
Present there were Vice-Premiers Pak Hun and Ri Kyong Il and other members of the Cabinet.
Attending it as observers were officials of the organs under the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies, chairpersons of the provincial, city and county people's committees and officials of the agricultural guidance organs and major industrial establishments.
The meeting reviewed the work in the first quarter of the year to thoroughly implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK and the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK and discussed the measures for carrying through the important tasks set forth in the historic policy speech the respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly.
Pak Thae Song conveyed the relevant contents of the policy speech made by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unat the First Session of the 15th SPA.
Kim Tok Hun made a report.
The reporter referred to the fact that at the historic Party Congress, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the immortal great programme illuminating the bright path for leading to greater victory the cause of the DPRK, which entered the period of comprehensive development, and bringing more comprehensive and innovative progress in all realms of the revolution and construction and is guiding the struggle for its realization.
He said that various sectors and units have successfully fulfilled their national economic plans for the first quarter of the year in the course of accelerated advance to carry out the main tasks for socialist economic construction clarified at the Party Congress.
He noted that thanks to the extraordinary enthusiasm for the revolution and struggle and patriotism of all the people boundlessly faithful to the leadership of the Party Central Committee, the torch of the emulation movement for increased production was kindled in Sangwon, Chonsong and other parts of the country and the first precious fruition of this year was brought about for making a breakthrough in implementing the new Five-Year Plan.
The reporter stressed the need for all officials to steadily raise their qualifications and abilities, attach importance to principles and figures and thoroughly overcome all negative elements hindering the DPRK's advance, with their extraordinary readiness that the Party's decisions should be perfectly implemented under any conditions and with a keen sense of responsibility for their duty.
Speeches were made at the meeting.
The enlarged plenary meeting called for carrying out the national economic plan for the second quarter of the year without fail and further enhancing the role of the Cabinet in attaining the new long-term goals set forth at the Party Congress, and took necessary practical measures. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Algerian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 4 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Abdelmadjid Tebboune, president of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, on April 2.
The message said:
Your Excellency President of the State Affairs,
I extend warm congratulations to you on your reelection as President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and most sincerely wish you success in your noble work.
Availing myself of this opportunity, I reaffirm the readiness to continue to make efforts together with you to consolidate the historic relations of friendship and solidarity between Algeria and the DPRK and develop the bilateral cooperation into a higher level in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two friendly countries.
I pay the highest tribute to Your Excellency President of the State Affairs. -0-

headline: New Teaching and Training Methods Introduced at Extracurricular Sports Schools in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- Extracurricular sports schools in Pyongyang, which started teaching and training in the new school year 2026, are striving to introduce Korean-style superior training methods.
Table tennis instructors of Songyo District Extracurricular Sport School are improving the level of various hitting technique by concentrating efforts on theoretical education on ball contact and the control of the angle of the racket according to various ball spinning in conformity with the age and psychological characteristics and preparedness of the students, and by conducting the intensive training for ball hitting.
Basketball and wrestling instructors are enhancing the tactical and special skills of teams and individual students through game-way training.
Sosong District Extracurricular Sports School has introduced rational volleyball teaching and training methods to raise the physical and technical abilities of students.
Tongdaewon District Extracurricular Sports School has introduced effective training means for developing the strength of snatch, clean and jerk and waist to provide a guarantee for updating the previous records among students.
The teaching and training methods created by the badminton, boxing and judo instructors of Taedonggang, Ryongsong and Ryokpho district extracurricular sports schools were proven effective in practice.
Moranbong, Taesong and Hyongjesan district extracurricular sports schools are also pushing ahead with the work to apply teaching and training methods of practical significance. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception to Mark Ninth Congress of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- A reception was given by the DPRK embassy in Moscow on March 31 to mark the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there on invitation were Andrei Klimov, member of the Bureau of the Supreme Council of the United Russia Party, personages of the government, political parties, parliament and institutions of Russia including the Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of Interior, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Party for Peace and Unity and foreign diplomatic envoys in Russia.
On hand there were Sin Hong Chol, DPRK ambassador to Russia, and members of his embassy.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before a photo dealing with the revolutionary activity of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand paid tribute to him.
Then, they looked round the photos showing the revolutionary careers and exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland the exploits performed by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unin developing the DPRK-Russia relations of friendship, works of the peerlessly great men and photos dealing with the invincible might and proud development of the DPRK.
Speeches were made there.
Sin Hong Chol referred to the fact that the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea invariably held in high esteem the great ComradeKim Jong Unat its top post in reflection of the firm faith, unanimous will and desire of all the DPRK people.
He stressed that the WPK would make a positive contribution to further developing the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries by boosting cooperation with several political parties of Russia including the United Russia Party.
Andrei Klimov said that the reelection of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unas General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea serves as an event showing the inheritance of generation once again and promising the rosy future of the two countries.
He added that under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, the DPRK people have still made great achievements despite all sorts of obstacles by evil forces including imperialism and the DPRK is now advancing towards future with confidence. -0-

headline: University and College Graduates in DPRK Volunteer for Posts at WPK's Call
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- University and college graduates in South Hamgyong Province and Nampho Municipality volunteered to work at schools in forefront and mountainous areas and islet villages.
Graduates of Sinpho Kim Hyong Gwon University of Technology and Education vowed to become true educators who train the children of soldiers' families at the frontline border posts and children of the workers at the Komdok Mining Complex to be pillars for building a thriving nation.
Graduates of Hamhung University of Education and Hamhung Choe Hui Suk Teachers Training College volunteered for mountainous schools in Jangjin and Pujon counties.
A graduate of Hamhung College of Technology who volunteered to work in Samjiyon City is full of enthusiasm to contribute to the patriotic work for implementing the regional development policy in the new era.
Graduates of Nampho University of Education and Nampho Teachers Training College asked their youth league organizations to make themselves work at schools at rural areas and islet villages.
There were meetings to congratulate the volunteers. Present at the meetings were officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth and students.
Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers and congratulatory speeches and resolution-taking speeches were made at those meetings.
At the end of the meetings art performances were given to congratulate the volunteers. -0-

headline: Cement Production Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- Officials and workers of cement production units across the DPRK are steadily increasing the production.
The workers and technicians in charge of the main production line of the Sangwon Cement Complex have actively introduced inventions and increased the number of checking equipment more than twice as against the past period to provide a guarantee for revitalizing production.
The huge repair of the calcination system No. 2 has been qualitatively finished in a short span of time and defective elements have been removed, thus registering high production results every day.
The miners of the Sangwon Limestone Mine have increased the mineral output by applying an efficient blasting method and the Samchong Mine and the Hwachon Coal Mine have increased the proportion of mechanization and directed efforts to ensuring the normal operation of tunneling and mining equipment and vehicles.
Technicians and skilled workers of the calcination shop, cement shop, raw material shop and coal-milling shop of the Sunchon Cement Complex are closely boosting cooperation among processes and solving the technical problems arising in updating the performance of equipment and thus laying a foundation for increased production.
The Sunchon Limestone Mine, the Clay Slate Mine and Jikdong Gypsum Mine have established a system of inspecting and repairing machines and equipment and raised their operating rate to produce a lot of ore every day.
The Chonnaeri Cement Factory, Sunghori Cement Factory and other units are boosting production. -0-

headline: With Single Mind to Bring about Bumper Crop in This Year's Farming
Performances of Foreign Artistes Participating in 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- The 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival is going on every day.
Artistes of different countries are staging songs of praising the peerlessly great men and art pieces of various themes on the stage of the festival.
Through male chorus revolutionary hymn "Ode to GeneralKim Jong Un" and other numbers, artistes of the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation showed well the boundless trust of the Russian people in the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho made contributions to the development of the DPRK-Russia relations of friendship and cooperation.
The National Dance Theatre of the "Cossacks of Russia" and the Ryazan State Academic People's Chorus Named after E. Popov artistically depicted the noble mental world, national emotion and romantic life of the Russian people, as befitting authorized art troupes.
The performance of Russian artistes who depicted Korean songs such as "Ardent Desire" and "Ardent Wish" with high artistic skill gave a deep impression to the audience.
Artistes of Chinese art troupe prepared and put on the stage such numbers as the mixed chorus immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" which ardently praised the exploits of the peerlessly great men and reflected the desire of the DPRK people.
The Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army decorated the festival stage with female solo "Song about the Country", a song loved and enjoyed by the DPRK people.
The performances of artistes of different countries are revving up the festive atmosphere of Pyongyang greeting the April spring holiday. -0-

headline: Preparations for Rural Housing Construction Brisk in Ryanggang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, Ryanggang Province in the DPRK is preparing the construction of rural houses for this year.
The province has paid attention to reinforcing and perfecting the construction equipment and tools of city and county construction brigades. It sent much construction equipment and tools to city and county construction brigades and made sure that they repaired vehicles and heavy machines and kept them in good conditions.
Cities and counties, too, are making successes in the work of providing construction brigades with construction equipment and tools.
Meanwhile, the province conducted a training course for supervisors in the field of rural construction and is pushing ahead with the work to organize sectional training courses of construction brigades.
Tens of heat-insulating production bases with large capacity have been built in the province and all cities and counties are producing building parts and elements and securing materials in a farsighted way. -0-

headline: Forest Reformation and Tree Planting Conducted in Nampho Municipality of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- True to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea, Nampho Municipality of the DPRK is conducting a mass campaign to turn the mountains in the region into useful mountains conducive to the economic development and improvement of the people's standard of living.
This year alone, the municipality conducted the reformation of more than 180 hectares of forests and planted hundreds of thousands of trees.
The municipal tree nursery and the parents nurseries in districts and counties, including Chollima District and Onchon County, put the sapling production on a more scientific and intensive basis, so the saplings such as young pine-nut trees grow well.
Now that the saplings have been secured, the municipality organized a demonstration to introduce the newly-developed growth promoter and intensified policy-oriented and technical guidance in order to plant trees on the principle of planting a right tree on right soil.
Officials of the organs at a municipal level dedicated themselves to planting trees in line with the scientific and technical requirements, with the main emphasis on raising the rate of rooting of saplings.
Chollima Steel Complex and Nampho Port planted trees in a proper way.
Kangso and Hanggu districts created large area of Evodia daniellii Benn forests and planted oil-bearing chestnut trees and black walnut trees in a responsible manner.
Meanwhile, the municipality is taking measures to protect forests, while conducting mass movements such as a movement for winning the titles of Socialist Patriotic Forest and Model County in Afforestation. -0-

headline: Building-materials Production Bases Built in S. Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK is making progress in consolidating its foundation for producing finishing building materials, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province has directed efforts to raising the production capacity of the Songchongang Tile Factory and other units for producing finishing building materials, thus supplying tiles, plastic windows and paints needed for rural construction to cities and counties.
The Hamhung Ironware Factory built a metal fixtures production base, and the Hamhung Chongryon Plastic Processing Factory a water supply pipe production base, thus laying the foundations for producing finishing building materials needed for rural construction.
The province intensified the guidance so that cities and counties have directed efforts to building their own production bases and increasing production indices.
Kumya, Jongphyong and Hamju counties increased the output of finishing building materials through the introduction of advanced technology while exchanging and sharing experience and technologies with each other.
Pukchong County increased the plastic pipe production capacity of the essential plastic goods factory at 1.5 times and dozens of building-materials production bases were newly built or rebuilt in the province to lay the foundations for pushing ahead with rural housing construction. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Performances of Foreign Artistes Participating in 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- The 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival is going on every day.
Artistes of different countries are staging songs of praising the peerlessly great men and art pieces of various themes on the stage of the festival.
Through male chorus revolutionary hymn "Ode to GeneralKim Jong Un" and other numbers, artistes of the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation showed well the boundless trust of the Russian people in the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho made contributions to the development of the DPRK-Russia relations of friendship and cooperation.
The National Dance Theatre of the "Cossacks of Russia" and the Ryazan State Academic People's Chorus Named after E. Popov artistically depicted the noble mental world, national emotion and romantic life of the Russian people, as befitting authorized art troupes.
The performance of Russian artistes who depicted Korean songs such as "Ardent Desire" and "Ardent Wish" with high artistic skill gave a deep impression to the audience.
Artistes of Chinese art troupe prepared and put on the stage such numbers as the mixed chorus immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" which ardently praised the exploits of the peerlessly great men and reflected the desire of the DPRK people.
The Song and Dance Ensemble of the Mongolian Army decorated the festival stage with female solo "Song about the Country", a song loved and enjoyed by the DPRK people.
The performances of artistes of different countries are revving up the festive atmosphere of Pyongyang greeting the April spring holiday. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 5 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
At the Sunchon Cement Complex, the premier said that the complex should give definite priority to the ideological and political work to learn from the fighting spirit and traits of the workers at the Sangwon Cement Complex, steadily raise the operation rate of equipment and conduct a proactive mass technological innovation movement, so as to attain the goal of cement production set forth by the Party this year without fail.
At several farms in Suan, Singye and Sohung counties, he learned about the state of the growth of earlier crops and preparations for immediate farm work, and stressed the need to minimize the damage caused by drought by properly taking care of the nutrition of the crops according to the characteristics of the crops of various species in all the fields and maintaining and repairing irrigation facilities properly.
He stressed the need for agricultural production units to actively introduce advanced farming methods and continue to increase the area of the fields for grain-to-grain double cropping, and for agricultural officials to steadily intensify technical guidance on farm work.
At Pyongyang Middle School for Orphans and the Educational Books Printing Plant, the premier stressed once again the importance of the work for improving the qualifications of teachers and providing educational books in the implementation of the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme. He called for steadily exploring and applying superior teaching methods to train orphans into talents with practical abilities, and for directing great efforts to the management of equipment and technical control to bring about innovations in textbook production.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of providing raw materials needed for cement production in a responsible manner, the issue of taking thorough technical measures to repair equipment in a qualitative way and improve the efficiency of dust collection, the issue of providing orphans with sufficient study and living conditions and the issue of producing and providing textbooks.
Meanwhile, the premier inspected the Hard-Alloy Raw-Materials Production Station under the Pyongyang Cermet Tools Development Company to learn about the problems arising in production and take the relevant measures. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Loving Care for Children
story_text:
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Kyongsang Nursery one day in May 2012.
Learning about the construction of the nursery with full necessary conditions for childcare and education, he entered the nursery, guided by officials.
At a room of the nursery he went out to its veranda and looked around carefully.
The accompanying officials could not make out why he went out. At that time he told them that cold wind might affect the room temperature in winter.
At the dining room, he touched its floor to estimate its temperature and gave an instruction to keep it warmer.
Touched by his meticulous care, the accompanying officials pledged to do their best for the joy and happiness of the rising generation, true to his noble intention. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on April 6:
Lee Jae Myung, president of the ROK, said on April 6 that he felt sorry about causing unnecessary military tensions through an irresponsible and reckless act, as regards the ROK-borne drone's violation of the DPRK's airspace.
The ROK president personally expressed regret and talked about a measure for preventing recurrence. Our government appreciated it as a very fortunate and wise behavior for its own sake.
Our head of state commented it as a manifestation of frank and broad-minded man's attitude.
For its own security, the ROK side should stop any reckless provocation against the DPRK and refrain from any attempt at contact, instead of paying lip-service to the utmost importance of peace and security.
The ROK side should be mindful that it will be forced to pay a price too much for it, as already warned, if such a provocation as violating the inalienable sovereignty of our state occurs again. -0-

story_text:
