headline: Drive for Increased Production Launched at Industrial Establishments of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, various units of the national economy are waging a drive for increased production to attain this year's goal.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex is focusing on bettering the Korean-style method of iron production, while pushing ahead with the plan for rolled steel production set higher than last year through responsible equipment management and technical control.
The Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex are striving to increase iron and steel production by intensifying inter-process cooperation and conducting the socialist emulation among shifts and units.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex carried out its fertilizer production plan for the first-quarter of the year by waging a campaign to reduce the cost, increase productivity and put production processes on a higher scientific basis by relying on its own technical manpower.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex boosts production by conducting a technical innovation campaign to ensure coal pulverization rate and balanced supply and improve the efficiency of turbine generators.
The Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex has produced hundreds of more tons of coal than the planned every day by tapping all reserves and possibilities and introducing efficient cutting methods.
The workers and technicians of the Taean Heavy Machine Complex are directing efforts to consolidating the material and technical foundations, thus increasing the production of custom-built equipment.
The workers of the Anju Pump Factory over-fulfilled its first quarterly plan for the production of pumps to be sent to the coal-mining industry, while ensuring the smooth operation of all production lines.
The Sunchon Cement Complex and the Chonnaeri Cement Factory have sent a lot of cement to the construction sites while improving the quality of refractory and ensuring a rational rate of mixing raw materials.
Workers of the Taean Friendship Glass Factory and other units are keeping production going at a high rate by manufacturing and installing efficient high-tech devices and applying advanced technology to improving the quality of products. -0-

headline: Young People in Jagang Province Volunteer for Worksites to Implement Party's Decisions
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Dozens of young people in Jagang Province of the DPRK have volunteered for worksites seething with a drive for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Youths in Kanggye, Huichon and Manpho cities and Hyangsan, Songgan and Janggang counties vowed to work at city and county construction brigades.
Those in Hwaphyong, Jonchon, Ryongnim, Rangnim, Jasong and Tongsin counties petitioned their youth league organizations to dispatch them to raw materials base stations and goat farms.
Graduates of Kanggye University of Education volunteered to work at revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu and schools in mountainous areas.
A meeting was held at the Jagang Provincial Art Theatre to congratulate the volunteers.
Certificates of petition were awarded to the volunteers at the meeting attended by Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the WPK, officials concerned, youth league officials, youth and students. Then, a congratulatory address was made to be followed by speeches.
Officials, youths and students encouraged the volunteers, presenting bouquets to them and putting garlands around their necks. -0-

headline: Socialist Emulation for Improvement of Low-yielding Farm Fields
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- Organizations of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea at all levels in the DPRK launched a socialist emulation for the improvement of low-yielding farm fields.
The UAWK organizations in South Hamgyong Province conducted a socialist emulation in a methodological way to increase the fertility of thousands of hectares of low-yielding fields.
Agricultural workers and UAWK members in North Phyongan Province transported large quantities of self-sufficing manure to farms and carpeted the farm fields with humus soil in a qualitative way.
UAWK officials in Mangyongdae District of Pyongyang are bringing about a good result in increasing the fertility of soil with their enterprising work style and attitude.
Agricultural workers in Sariwon City and Junghwa County of North Hwanghae Province are improving the soil affected by cold and humidity and the acid soil through scientific application of self-sufficing manure based on field- and plot-specific soil analysis.
UAWK officials and members in South Hwanghae, South Phyongan and Kangwon provinces made successes in the work to increase the fertility of soil through a collective innovation movement. -0-

headline: Construction of Offshore Farm Accelerated in S. Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 6 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the construction of the Riwon County Offshore Farm.
An excavation project for the wharf was completed in the main. And the foundation excavation for one hundred and tens of houses and public buildings were finished to be followed by the completion of ground concrete tamping.
Many blocks and box-shape prefab parts needed for the projects for framing of buildings and wharf are being produced and progress is being made in planting trees for the creation of windbreak forest and forming main road. -0-

headline: Third Workshop of Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees Held
Congratulations to DPRK Premier
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Pham Minh Chinh, prime minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on March 23.
The Vietnamese prime minister in the message extended warm congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his assumption of office as premier of the Cabinet, and said that he is pleased to see the DPRK making successes in the state building and the cause of development.
The message stressed that to confirm the orientations of social and economic development and carry them out at a new stage, with the main emphasis placed on the implementation of the 2026-2030 five-year national economic plan for building a stable and solid foundation for economic growth and improving the people's living, will as ever provide an important motive force in the development of the DPRK.
It wished the fraternal DPRK people many new continuous successes in their cause of building a prosperous and happy state, hoping that the traditional friendly relations between the two countries would grow stronger. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Le Hoai Trung, foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on March 23.
The Vietnamese foreign minister in the message congratulated Choe Son Hui on continuing to work as foreign minister, and said that he is pleased to see the steady development of the traditional Vietnam-DPRK relations of friendship, personally provided by President Ho Chi Minh and PresidentKim Il Sungand developed by the leaders of different generations of the two countries.
It is the consistent stand of the Vietnamese party and state to maintain and promote the traditional Vietnam-DPRK relations of friendship in conformity with the desire of the peoples of the two countries and develop them in a more substantial and effective way and thus contribute to regional and global peace, stability, cooperation and development, the message said.
The message expressed the readiness to closely cooperate for developing and promoting as ever the relations between the two countries on the basis of the successes made in the past. -0-

headline: Crimes of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- After fabricating the "Ulsa Five-point Treaty" in a brigandish way, the Japanese imperialists buckled down to annexing Korea to Japan and making the Korean people its slaves.
To this end, the imperialists sought to provide a legal mechanism for usurping the feudal Korean government's authority for handling internal affairs, which existed only for form's sake.
The Japanese imperialists regarded as the first obstacle Emperor Kojong who remained opposed to their seizure of Korea's sovereignty at that time. Therefore, they left no means and methods untried to eliminate him.
Emperor Kojong sent emissaries to the Second International Peace Conference held in 1907 to disclose the illegality and invalidity of the "Ulsa (1905) Five-point Treaty" and the injustice of Japan's colonial rule over Korea. Regarding it as a golden opportunity, the Japanese imperialists forcibly dethroned Emperor Kojong through threat and blackmail, pressure and cunning tricks.
Later, they put Sunjong on the throne and let Hirobumi Ito, resident-general of Korea, cook up the "Jongmi Seven-point Treaty".
The "treaty" required the feudal Korean government to go under the instructions of the resident-general of Japan in the policy issues and obtain his approval before revising law or making important administrative decisions. It also obliged the feudal Korean government to appoint any senior government official with the consent of the resident-general and to appoint Japanese nominated by the resident-general as a high-ranking government official.
After completely seizing the right to internal affairs of the feudal Korean government, ranging from the judicial, legislative and administrative affairs to the appointment of government officials by invoking the "Jongmi Seven-point Treaty", an illegal fraud document devoid of legitimacy, the Japanese imperialists had enforced barbarous colonial rule over Korea. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulations to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) --Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on April 1.
The message said:
Dear Comrade,
I extend heartfelt congratulations to you on your reelection as president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic at the First Session of the Tenth National Assembly of Laos.
Your re-assumption of the heavy responsibility as president of the LPDR is an expression of the Lao party, government and people's deep trust and firm support for you who have made responsible and devoted efforts to carry out the two strategic tasks of national defence and development.
Expressing belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between our two parties and two countries will continue to develop in conformity with the spirit of the agreement reached at our meeting in Pyongyang last October, I wish you good health and bigger success in your work. -0-

headline: Efforts for Developing Public Health in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- April 7 is World Health Day.
It is the eternal state policy of the DPRK to steadily develop the public health of the country.
The DPRK has paid deep attention the public health for protecting the lives of the people and promoting their health, thus making many successes.
The DPRK government set it as an important policy to rebuild and dramatically develop the country's public health on an advanced basis so that the people can enjoy good health under excellent medical service, and has pushed forward with this work.
Pharmaceutical factories and medical appliances factories were modernized and such modern hospitals as the Ryugyong General Ophthalmic Hospital and the Samjiyon City Hospital and standard pharmacies built in different parts of the country.
Last year, the world-class Pyongyang General Hospital was built as a model to be followed by the whole country in terms of technology and experience. The Kangdong County Hospital, Kusong City Hospital and Ryonggang County Hospital were built as models for the development of regional public health, making it possible for the Korean people to receive more advanced medical service.
The work continues to bring substantial benefits of socialist healthcare to the people and put the country's healthcare foundation on a higher level.
The DPRK will as ever more briskly carry on the public health service to protect the lives of the people and promote their health in close cooperation with the World Health Organization.
The DPRK joined the World Health Organization in May 1973. -0-

headline: Vegetable Production Based on Scientific Manuring and Cultivation
Press Statement of Jang Kum Chol, First Vice-Minister and Director General of Tenth Department of Foreign Ministry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Jang Kum Chol, first vice-minister and director general of the Tenth Department of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, issued the following press statement "The true colors of the ROK, the most hostile enemy state, can never change":
The department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea made public a press statement related to the ROK on Monday night.
Voices of Chongwadae and various circles in the ROK analyzing it are really something to see.
If the ROK side lets out nonsense, regarding the rapid response from our government as an "exceptional friendly response" and a "quick mutual confirmation of intentions by the top leaders," this will also be recorded as world-startling fools' "hope-filled dream reading".
The thematic core of the press statement was a clear warning.
As for the press statement of the department director of the Party Central Committee, she evidently gave a witty warning to the ROK with very short and gentle sentences and expressions.
As they have a bad ear and cannot understand, I would like to awaken them to the true meaning of the press statement I read.
"You did something good. If you want to live safely, you should candidly admit your sin like this. It is, indeed, beyond my imagination that there is such a quite frank man in a pack of brazen-faced ones. You should prevent recurrence if you want to be secure. You will have to pay dearly if you persist in rash acts before us. Do not irritate us if you want to live in comfort." This is the main idea of the press statement I read.
While referring to the so-called "resolution" cooked up a few days ago by the UN Human Rights Council, Department Director Kim Yo Jong told me today that those of the ROK are little short of the dogs affected by mange that blindly bark to the tune of neighboring dogs. She also asked me whether her last night's press statement was interesting.
Of course, I replied to her that the ROK side's "hope-filled dream reading" was very interesting.
The identity of the ROK, the enemy state most hostile to the DPRK, can never change with any words or conduct by its chief executive. -0-

headline: Birthday Spreads to Centenarians in North Hwanghae and North Hamgyong Provinces
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent birthday spreads to Ho Kum Ok, a woman living in the Neighborhood Unit No. 22 of the township of Thosan County, North Hwanghae Province, and Kim Kum Sol, a woman living in the Neighborhood Unit No 23, Rakphyong-ri, Hoeryong City, North Hamgyong Province, on their 100th birthdays.
After receiving birthday spreads amid the congratulations from officials in Thosan County and Hoeryong City, families, relatives and neighbors, the centenarians expressed deep thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
They, who keenly felt through their miserable life before national liberation that the country is so dear to them, had worked devotedly at worksites with a resolve to repay the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea which had them become the masters of a new country where a genuine life of human being was blooming.
They are always asking their children to support with loyalty the Party and the state that are making selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people, saying that the Korean-style socialist system centered on the popular masses is the best in the world. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Jang Kum Chol, First Vice-Minister and Director General of Tenth Department of Foreign Ministry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- Jang Kum Chol, first vice-minister and director general of the Tenth Department of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, issued the following press statement "The true colors of the ROK, the most hostile enemy state, can never change":
The department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea made public a press statement related to the ROK on Monday night.
Voices of Chongwadae and various circles in the ROK analyzing it are really something to see.
If the ROK side lets out nonsense, regarding the rapid response from our government as an "exceptional friendly response" and a "quick mutual confirmation of intentions by the top leaders," this will also be recorded as world-startling fools' "hope-filled dream reading".
The thematic core of the press statement was a clear warning.
As for the press statement of the department director of the Party Central Committee, she evidently gave a witty warning to the ROK with very short and gentle sentences and expressions.
As they have a bad ear and cannot understand, I would like to awaken them to the true meaning of the press statement I read.
"You did something good. If you want to live safely, you should candidly admit your sin like this. It is, indeed, beyond my imagination that there is such a quite frank man in a pack of brazen-faced ones. You should prevent recurrence if you want to be secure. You will have to pay dearly if you persist in rash acts before us. Do not irritate us if you want to live in comfort." This is the main idea of the press statement I read.
While referring to the so-called "resolution" cooked up a few days ago by the UN Human Rights Council, Department Director Kim Yo Jong told me today that those of the ROK are little short of the dogs affected by mange that blindly bark to the tune of neighboring dogs. She also asked me whether her last night's press statement was interesting.
Of course, I replied to her that the ROK side's "hope-filled dream reading" was very interesting.
The identity of the ROK, the enemy state most hostile to the DPRK, can never change with any words or conduct by its chief executive. -0-

headline: Third Workshop of Chief Secretaries of City and County Party Committees Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 7 (KCNA) -- The third workshop of chief secretaries of city and county Party committees took place from April 4 to 6.
The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea arranged the workshop for the first time after the Ninth Party Congress, prioritizing the position and role of the city and county Party committees, the political staff of the relevant regions, in carrying out the state-building strategy for making the regional development represent the advance and development of our state and making the ideal appearance of the regions symbolize the development of Korean-style socialism.
Present there were chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees and secretaries of the Party Central Committee, officials of relevant departments of the provincial Party committees and officials related to the local Party work.
Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, secretary and concurrently director of the Organizational Leadership Department of the Party Central Committee, made an opening address.
The workshop heard a report on the work done by the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to implement the Party's idea of attaching importance to the cities and counties and its line of strengthening the cities and counties for the past five years since the first workshop.
The reporter noted that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unformulated the political, organizational, ideological, discipline and work-style building as the five-point Party-building line in the new era to provide an important guideline to be adhered to by the party organizations of the whole Party and the city and county Party committees, and led the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to fulfill their mission and duty as befitting delegates of the Party Central Committee and servants of the people.
The report appreciated the work of many chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees, including the Party committees of Mangyongdae District, Hoeryong City, Kimhwa County, Jangyon County and Hamju County which have firmly consolidated the political and ideological positions and the class positions and strived for the distinctive development of the regional economy and the improvement of the regional people's material and cultural life, true to the noble intention of the Party Central Committee, for the past five years.
The report referred to the shortcomings revealed in the work of some city and county Party committees, and analyzed and reviewed their causes and lessons.
The reporter stressed the need for all the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees to embody the strong Party spirit, revolutionary spirit and popular spirit and make more dynamic and steady efforts to implement the Party's line of strengthening the cities and counties and thus fulfill their responsibility and duty in making socialism take deeper root in the minds of the people.
Then, speeches were made.
The speakers expressed their resolve to make redoubled efforts with fresh determination and readiness in keeping with the requirements of the era of comprehensive development to thoroughly implement the long-term plans and action programmes for developing the regional areas and building rural civilization set forth by the Ninth Party Congress, and thus turn their regions into a people's paradise where their happy laughter and hurrah for the Workers' Party resound.
Through the workshop, the chief secretaries of the city and county Party committees have fully acquired the precious ideological and spiritual pabulum and methodologies necessary for strengthening the working efficiency of the city and county Party committees and putting the regional development on a new stage by holding fast to the five-point Party-building line in the new era. -0-

headline: Dozens of Sci-tech Successes and High-tech Products Made in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, scores of research achievements, which made substantial contribution to the economic development and the improvement of the people's living standards in the DPRK this year, were awarded the certificate of application of state sci-tech achievements, and several intellectual products registered as high-tech products.
Various universities and scientific research institutes developed a technology capable of improving the technical and economic effectiveness of an oxygen heat blast furnace and a research method capable of increasing the operation efficiency of hydropower stations and ensuring their high efficiency and high water level running, thus contributing to optimizing the consumption of raw materials at iron production bases and normalizing the power production.
A profitable and superior design method was established to design production lines of regional-industry factories more scientifically and ensure the prompt and correct calculation of workloads, and a gluten-reinforcing agent was developed to make tasty flour products with flour produced in our country.
Also developed were high-tech products with great economic efficiency such as low-alloy high-strength steel welding rods made with rare earth inoculants and a flotation-reinforcing agent.
Meanwhile, the Sukchon County Commission of Science and Technology in South Phyongan Province developed an additive capable of increasing the concrete strength, thus making a substantial contribution to regional construction.
It is said that the compression strength of ordinary cement can be increased by more than 1.2 times even with additive amounting to 0.3% of cement. The additive, whose effectiveness has been verified through several trials, is now used at many construction sites. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to Vietnamese President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to To Lam, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on April 8.
The message said:
I extend warm congratulations and comradely greetings to you on your election as president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam at the First Session of the 16th National Assembly.
Your assumption of the heavy responsibility as president of the country is an expression of deep trust and expectation of the Communist Party of Vietnam and all the Vietnamese people about you who have successfully guided the work for national development and prosperity and promotion of the people's wellbeing.
Taking this opportunity, I express belief that the traditional friendly and cooperative relations between our two parties and two countries would grow stronger in conformity with the aspirations and desires of the two peoples on the basis of the spirit of the agreement reached at our meeting in Pyongyang last October.
I wish you good health and success in your responsible work for leading the party and the state. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Single-minded Unity of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Wednesday says in an article that single-minded unity is the most powerful national strength of our state and the motive force of propelling steady progress and leap forward in the revolution and construction.
Single-minded unity is the lifeline of our state and social system and the cornerstone of its eternal existence, the article notes, and goes on:
The true nature of our single-minded unity and great harmonious whole which no one can imitate is found in the fact that the unity gets stronger even in the face of manifold difficulties and hardships, not weakening. Nothing can destroy a country with such unity.
The irresistible might of single-minded unity is a firm guarantee of the high prestige and absolute mightiness of the DPRK.
The sovereignty and right to existence, dignity and reputation of the state and people are defended and glorified by dint of the might of single-minded unity.
Unity precisely means strength, sovereign rights and national prestige.
The strength of single-minded unity, in which all the people across the country are firmly rallied around their leader with the same ideology and intention, can neither be calculated in any figures nor matched with any physical force.
The irresistible might of single-minded unity is the inexhaustible motive power for the comprehensive rejuvenation and prosperity of our state.
For our Party and state opening a broad avenue to the comprehensive national rejuvenation, the ever-increasing unity and unparalleled revolutionary enthusiasm of all the people are the greatest strategic resources.
Our people are now realizing the new great changes brought about by their own efforts, and they are more firmly united and rallied with the pride for the country and the single mind to devote themselves to it.
Our advance will be further accelerated thanks to the tremendous economic and technological potential which has been consolidated for centuries, the ardent loyalty of all the people who are upholding the plan and determination of the Workers' Party of Korea through their thoroughgoing practical action, and the irresistible strength of single-minded unity. -0-

headline: Three-revolution Red Flag Movement Brisk in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- A mass movement is brisk in Nampho Municipality of the DPRK to accelerate the overall development of socialism under the uplifted banner of the three revolutions - ideological, technological and cultural.
The municipality is intensifying the Party guidance to encourage all the institutions, enterprises and units to turn out in the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement and make sure that its might is manifested in the struggle to implement the decisions of the 9th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Chollima Steel Complex and the Taean Heavy Machine Complex are conducting the education in the Party leadership exploits in conformity with the actual conditions, thus inspiring the working people with loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm.
The Taean Friendship Glass Factory and Nampho Port established the spaces for ideological education and instilled the exploits of the peerlessly great men into their employees to prepare them to be strong in idea and faith and remain faithful to the Party and the revolution.
The Kangso Sprayer Factory is boosting the production of sprayers and sprinklers for the countryside while improving the technical and skill levels of the working people through the operation of sci-tech learning space.
The Chongsan Farm in Kangso District, the Taedae Vegetable Farm in Waudo District and the Kangson Farm in Chollima District are focusing on raising the level of the agricultural workers' ideological consciousness to make them aware that they are entirely responsible for the rural revolution in the new era, while improving the rural living environment.
The Posan Iron Works and the Nampho Wheat Processing Plant, too, are conducting the socialist patriotic movement and revolutionary mass movement to carry out the new Five-Year Plan. -0-

headline: Joint Meeting of Political Parties and Organizations in Nordic Region
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- A joint meeting and a commemorative reception of political parties and organizations in the Nordic region took place in Sweden to celebrate the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were members of political parties and organizations, organizations for the study of the Juche idea, organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people and persons from various circles in Norway, Denmark, Sweden and Finland and the charge d'affaires ad interim of the DPRK embassy in Sweden.
The participants laid bouquets before an art work depicting PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilstanding together and paid tribute to them.
Speeches were made at the event.
Figures of the Communist Party of Sweden and the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association said that the WPK demonstrated its might of unity and firm faith in socialism through its Congress.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un's reelection as General Secretary of the WPK fully shows the DPRK people's absolute support and boundless trust in their leader and the harmonious whole between the Party and the popular masses, they said, adding that the Ninth Congress of the WPK marked another milestone in the history of the DPRK shining with victory.
A joint statement of political parties and organizations in the Nordic region was adopted at the event.
The statement expressed support and solidarity with the cause of the WPK as well as the stand of political parties and organizations in the Nordic region to further strengthen their friendship with the DPRK people. -0-

headline: Aid to Educational Sector in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- In hearty response to the Workers' Party of Korea's idea of attaching importance to education, enthusiasm for supporting the educational sector is growing stronger in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
On display at an educational aids exhibition held at Phyongsong University of Medicine were thousands of various electronic equipment, experimental apparatuses and furnishings of 20-odd kinds provided by scores of sponsoring organizations.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex sent computers and LCD TVs to Sunchon Ri Su Bok University of Chemical Engineering and Anju University of Technology.
Officials and other working people of many sponsoring organizations have donated educational facilities and fixtures and repair materials to teacher training universities and colleges.
Officials of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex, the Anju Area Coal-mining Complex, the Sunchon Cement Complex and the provincial rural economy committee set an example in strengthening the educational foundation of Phyongsong University of Coal Mining and in providing necessary equipment and materials for remodeling and modernizing Phyongsong University of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry and Sukchon University of Agriculture.
The Ponghak Foodstuff Factory, the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine, the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the Sunchon Chemical Complex, the provincial forestry management bureau, the provincial fishery management bureau, etc. sent a lot of equipment and materials to universities and schools, thus contributing to consolidating the material and technical foundations of the educational sector. -0-

headline: Korean-Style Orchestra Combined with Electronic Instruments
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 8 (KCNA) -- The orchestra combined with electronic instruments, which suits the thoughts and feelings, aesthetic view and daily-growing emotional demand of the Korean people, was formed to create musical art of new style.
The orchestra greatly excited the audience through its unheard-of play at the grand performance celebrating the 74th birthday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and recent national celebration performances.
Experts say that the orchestra is varied in timbre, emotional in expressiveness and sound, and plays music in perfect three-dimensional way.
It produces a beautiful timbre, which could not be heard in classical orchestral music, and the sounds of flowing water and birds and other innumerable sounds in nature, thus supporting the contents of the words and melodies.
The development of such peculiar Korean-style orchestra would have been unthinkable without the guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
The respected General SecretaryKim Jong Ungave an instruction on combining orchestra with electronic music in Korean style and clarified the best ways to do so. Thanks to his meticulous guidance, the unique orchestral pieces could be created to suit the demand and aesthetic feelings of the Korean people.
While enjoying the songs "The National Anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea", "My Strong Motherland", etc., audience expressed their opinions that the orchestra enriched the contents and emotional timbre of music pieces through the playing of preludes by electronic instruments, harmonized well the timbre of each instrument and showed well the world of mysterious and conspicuous music. -0-

headline: Techniques of Water-paint Woodblock Print - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- Among the DPRK's intangible cultural heritage is a technique of water-paint woodblock print.
The print, created before the eighth century, is a form of woodblock print based on water paint.
This is based on the principle of depiction of Korean paintings, and it is clear, soft and smart in color.
Its technique includes original painting, engraving and printing method.
The water-paint woodblock print evokes diverse and delicate aesthetic feelings.
The technique of water-paint woodblock print was registered as national intangible cultural heritage in October 2017. -0-

headline: DPRK Defence Science Research Institutes Conduct Tests of Important Weapon Systems
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- The Academy of Defence Science and the Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted the tests of electromagnetic weapon system, carbon fiber sham bombs scattering, verifying combat reliability of mobile short-range anti-aircraft missile system and estimating combat application and power of cluster bomb warhead of tactical ballistic missile on April 6, 7 and 8.
The tests were guided by Full General Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee.
He said that the electromagnetic weapon and carbon fiber bomb are special assets of strategic nature to be combined with and applied to various military means in different spheres.
The Anti-Air Weapon System Research Bureau of the Missile Administration conducted a test to verify the combat reliability of the mobile short-range anti-aircraft missile system.
The Ballistic Missile System Institute and the Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration conducted a test of estimating the combat application and cluster munitions power of tactical ballistic missile warhead, and confirmed that the surface-to-surface tactical ballistic missile Hwasongpho-11 Ka tipped with the cluster bomb warhead can reduce to ashes any target covering an area of 6.5~7 hectares with the highest-density power.
There was a firing for testing the maximum workload of engine using low-cost materials.
The Missile Administration said that the above tests are of great significance in the development of the armed forces of the DPRK and are a part of the regular activities of the administration and its affiliated defence scientific research institutes to constantly develop and upgrade weapon systems. -0-

headline: Congratulations to DPRK Premier
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Sonexay Siphandone, prime minister of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on March 31.
The message extended sincere congratulations to Pak Thae Song on his reappointment as premier of the Cabinet at the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK.
Expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries would steadily grow stronger, it hoped that the good bilateral relations of friendship and cooperation with a history of over 50 years would be further strengthened in the future to bring substantial interests to the peoples of the two countries and contribute to the peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the world. -0-

headline: At Regional-industry Factories in Jaeryong County
story_text:
One day in January 2025, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the regional-industry factories in Jaeryong County.
Going round various parts of a foodstuff factory, he dropped in at its cake production room. And he took one of the cakes on a production line to taste it, saying that cake with deep yellow means that it is well baked.
Then he stressed the need to bake cake well by regulating the time of passing dough through the oven or raising the temperature of the oven.
That day he indicated the ways for improving the quality of cake and increasing its variety. -0-

headline: Russian Artistes Praise Great Men
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- Russian artistes are expressing their boundless reverence for the peerlessly great men through their performances at the 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival.
Artistes of the Academy Ensemble of the National Guard of the Russian Federation showed well through immortal revolutionary songs that the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungand the great leader ComradeKim Jong Ilare always alive in the hearts of the world progressives and the great exploits they performed before the times and history are shining forever.
Through their performances, artistes of the Russian State Academic People's Chorus Named after M.E. Pyatnichki and the Russian Army Academic Song and Dance Ensemble Named after Alexandrov expressed the reverence for the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho opened a new chapter of the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations.
Those in the State Dance Ensemble Ural of Russia, the Russian State Academy Unaccompanied Chorus Named after A.A. Yurulov, the Moscow City Symphony Russian Philharmonic and the Circus of the State Acrobatic Company of Russia made sincere efforts to celebrate the April spring holiday with splendor. They fully displayed their artistic talents through dances, orchestral music, physical acrobatics and other numbers.
Those in the Sankt-Peterburg State Academic Catella Choir and Symphony Orchestra of Russia and the State Academic Folk Dance Company of the Republic of Bashkortostan of Russia Named after Fayzi Gaskarov demonstrated their will to further consolidate the ties of friendship between the peoples of the two countries through their beautiful dances and songs. -0-

headline: Preparations for Paddy-field Fish Breeding Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- Preparations for paddy-field fish breeding are being pushed forward across the DPRK.
South Phyongan Province organized a video show and video conference and sent officials to farms to confirm the area of paddy-field fishing breeding through a field survey with relevant members of cities and counties.
This year, it held a passing-on-technique meeting under the plan of building mud snail breeding grounds at farms and workteams planning to conduct paddy-field fish breeding.
The Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County, the Township Farm in Thaethan County and many other farms in South Hwanghae Province, which are working hard to build breed-fish grounds, established foundations for producing catfish fries by themselves and are increasing their survival rate while ensuring appropriate water temperature and supply of protein feed.
Kangwon Province selected right places for paddy-field fish breeding, considering the water resources and water quality, pollution in the surrounding area, watering and drainage, and is paying attention to the production of catfish fries.
North Hamgyong Province is introducing advanced hatching methods to secure breed-fish and establishing foundations for increasing the production of fish fodder and non-cereal feed.
South Hamgyong Province and Nampho Municipality take measures to expand paddy-field fish breeding. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Cuban President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from Miguel Diaz-Canel Bermudez, president of the Republic of Cuba, on April 1.
The message said:
Respected Comrade President,
I, on behalf of the Cuban people and on my own behalf, extend the most fraternal congratulations to you on your reelection as President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Taking this opportunity, I affirm that I am attaching greatest importance to the relations with the DPRK based on the firm foundation and the common struggle for advancing socialist construction.
I affirm once again our will to expand the ties of friendship, cooperation and solidarity between the two countries.
Please accept my highest regard. -0-

headline: DPRK Defence Science Research Institutes Conduct Tests of Important Weapon Systems
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 9 (KCNA) -- The Academy of Defence Science and the Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted the tests of electromagnetic weapon system, carbon fiber sham bombs scattering, verifying combat reliability of mobile short-range anti-aircraft missile system and estimating combat application and power of cluster bomb warhead of tactical ballistic missile on April 6, 7 and 8.
The tests were guided by Full General Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee.
He said that the electromagnetic weapon and carbon fiber bomb are special assets of strategic nature to be combined with and applied to various military means in different spheres.
The Anti-Air Weapon System Research Bureau of the Missile Administration conducted a test to verify the combat reliability of the mobile short-range anti-aircraft missile system.
The Ballistic Missile System Institute and the Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration conducted a test of estimating the combat application and cluster munitions power of tactical ballistic missile warhead, and confirmed that the surface-to-surface tactical ballistic missile Hwasongpho-11 Ka tipped with the cluster bomb warhead can reduce to ashes any target covering an area of 6.5~7 hectares with the highest-density power.
There was a firing for testing the maximum workload of engine using low-cost materials.
The Missile Administration said that the above tests are of great significance in the development of the armed forces of the DPRK and are a part of the regular activities of the administration and its affiliated defence scientific research institutes to constantly develop and upgrade weapon systems. -0-

headline: DPRK Government Hosts Reception for Chinese FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- The government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a reception on Thursday evening for Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, on a visit to the DPRK.
Invited to the reception were the entourage of the Chinese foreign minister and Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Wang Yajun and his embassy officials.
Present were Choe Son Hui, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and foreign minister of the DPRK, and officials of the Foreign Ministry.
Choe Son Hui made a speech at the reception.
Warmly welcoming Wang Yi and his party on behalf of the DPRK government, she said that the visit is a manifestation of the firm stand of the Chinese party and government to revitalize the high-level visits and communication between the two sides and further consolidate the ties of friendship by thoroughly implementing the important agreement reached at the historic DPRK-China summit meeting and talks held last September.
It is the consistent policy of the WPK and the DPRK government to value and steadily develop the friendly relations with China, which have given steady continuity to the good traditions of unity and cooperation with socialism as their core, overcoming all the tempests of history, she said.
She wished the Chinese people fresh and bigger successes in the struggle for accomplishing the cause of national prosperity by stepping up the Chinese-style modernization under the leadership of the CPC with Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping as its core.
Then, Wang Yi made a speech.
Expressing thanks for the warm hospitality, he said that the new successes made by the DPRK in socialist construction despite the ever-escalating moves of the U.S. and other Western forces to isolate and stifle it are the fruition of diligence and wisdom displayed by the Korean people under the wise leadership of Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Noting that the traditional China-DPRK friendship is a common precious asset as it was forged in the revolutionary struggle and has constantly developed in the course of socialist construction, he stressed that the historic meeting between Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping and Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unlast September opened up a new phase of the China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations.
He expressed the belief that the bilateral cooperation would further develop, sincerely hoping that the Korean people would achieve fresh victories ceaselessly in socialist construction and create a happier life under the firm leadership of the WPK headed by Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The participants in the reception toasted the health of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the esteemed Comrade Xi Jinping and the steady development and beautiful future of the invincible DPRK-China friendly relations.
The reception proceeded in a friendly and amicable atmosphere. -0-

Pulgungori Senior Middle School in Pothonggang District of Pyongyang enlisted students in the relevant groups according to their aptitudes and talents so that they can learn special knowledge, technique and skills.
Sangsin Primary School in Sosong District of Pyongyang, which operates a robot group, made the education contents of the group in a fresh way and applied them to the educational practice. Sonchon Primary School in Sonchon County of North Phyongan Province organized a short course, an experience presentation on running the after-school groups and a judgment of teaching ability to help all teachers acquire the qualifications and ability to run more than one after-school group. headline: Innovators Produced in Various Economic Sectors of DPRK
story_text:

The members of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade at the Tukjang Youth Coal Mine carried out their first half-yearly tunneling plans by mid-March and are now making uninterrupted innovations  to complete their two-year and six-month plans by the end of this year.
The tunneling workers of the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine and the O Jung Hup Youth Shock Brigade of the Phunggok Youth Coal Mine have made remarkable progress in securing coal reserves.
More than 20 engineers of the Chongryong Rolling Stock Corps carried out their first half-yearly transport plans ahead of schedule, and several crews of the Pyongyang Service Brigade of Engine and the Tanchon Youth Service Brigade of Engine became labor innovators through a campaign for increased transport.
Workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill and the Kusong Textile Mill set examples in carrying out their plans. -0-

headline: JUK Officials Start Study Tour of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 10 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Journalists Union of Korea (JUK) started their study tour of Mt Paektu.
A kick-off meeting took place at the plaza before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin Hyesan City on April 9.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them.
At the meeting, a speaker referred to the fact that the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who demonstrated to the whole world the advance spirit of Juche Korea by making a historic horseback march, has called the officials of the JUK to the strategic base of the Korean revolution and the center for education in the revolutionary traditions.
The speaker stressed the need for the members of the study tour group to deeply understand how the roots of the Korean revolution were provided in the battlefields of Mt Paektu and how the tradition of loyalty has been carried forward, and to prepare themselves as the ardent followers and staunch defenders who thoroughly implement the revolutionary ideas of the Workers' Party of Korea.

headline: North Phyongan Province Intensifies Organization and Guidance over Law-abiding Life
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK is directing efforts to the organization and guidance over the law-abiding life.
Changsong County places strict demands on the officials of all the units so that they popularly explain the laws in combination with reality and the education in law observance proves effective in the struggle to implement the decisions of the Workers' Party of Korea, thus adding glory to the honor of a model law-observance county.

Kujang, Pakchon and Sakju counties are organizing lectures and explanatory meetings on the subject of the education in law-observance on several occasions to inform the masses of the advantages and popular character of the Constitution of the DPRK.
Cholsan, Ryongchon and Nyongbyon counties are stepping up the movement for winning the title of Model Law-Observance Unit in a purposeful way and distributing the newly-adopted, revised and supplemented data on judicial affairs to every institution, factory, farm, school, dong and neighborhood unit. story_text:
Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the irrigation system established in the rural areas of the DPRK proves effective in this year's farming.
The rural areas in South Hwanghae Province have taken measures to irrigate the fields of wheat and barley vulnerable to drought to minimize the yield reduction. Jaeryong and Anak counties are paying attention to ensuring the operation of pumping equipment at full capacity in order to minimize the damage caused by the disastrous abnormal weather. The farms in Unchon, Jangyon and Kangryong counties strive to minimize the drought damage to wheat and barley through a mass movement.
The rural areas in North Hwanghae Province, too, are directing efforts to supplying irrigation water to the fields of wheat and barley. Hwangju County has introduced various irrigation methods, as required by different field conditions, to increase the efficiency of irrigation water.
Rinsan and Sohung counties are ensuring that water is fully supplied to all fields by putting the pumping equipment on a normal operation.
Kaesong Municipality and South Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces are making redoubled efforts to reap a good harvest in wheat and barley farming this year. -0-

headline: Mangyongdae, Pyongyang's Pride
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- In Pyongyang there is a place called Mangyongdae, widely known for its beautiful scenery from olden times.
The name Mangyongdae originated from Mangyong Hill.
10 famous scenes of Hwachon constitute the beautiful scenery of Mangyongdae from olden times.
The best one is its scenic beauty in spring reminiscent of a large flower garden.
Among the famous scenes are also the nocturnal appearances of islands being bathed in the moonlight reflected on the surface of the River Taedong that flows around the foot of Mangyong Hill, the mountainous terrain symbolic of strong spirit and youthful vigor, nostalgic looks of the valleys full of calves freely grazing on the grass, and the views of surrounding places seething with fishermen and seed-sowing farmers.
Old historical documents term the scenic beauty in the area of Hwachon the best of Pyongyang.
In Mangyongdae there is the birthplace of PresidentKim Il Sung, a peerlessly great man praised and revered by not only the Korean people but also other progressive peoples in the world.
Mangyongdae is the time-honored sacred place of the Korean revolution and a pride of Pyongyang and the DPRK, well known for its unique landscape and beautiful scenery. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Chinese FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, on a visit to the DPRK, on April 10.
Present there were Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee and director of its International Department.
Also present were Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and Hua Chunying, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC.
ComradeKim Jong Ungladly received Wang Yi and exchanged warm greetings and had a talk with him in a comradely atmosphere.
At the talk, Wang Yi courteously conveyed the warm greetings from Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee and president of the PRC, to ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for it and asked the Chinese foreign minister to convey his greetings to Comrade Xi Jinping.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that it is important for the DPRK and China to further intensify the visits and contacts at different levels and boost mutual support and cooperation for the protection of the common interests and the multi-faceted and sustained development of the bilateral relations, in view of the present international geopolitical situation and the long-term strategic interests of the two countries. And he expressed the stand of the WPK and the DPRK government on the issues of regional and international situation of mutual concern.
Wang Yi expressed the steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to successfully develop the China-DPRK friendly relations, which have greeted a new phase of development in accordance with the important common understanding reached at the summit meeting and talks between the top leaders of the two countries held in Beijing last September, in keeping with the desire and interests of the peoples of the two countries, and the view on the regional and international issues.
Affirming that it is the steadfast stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to place the greatest value on, give top priority to and further develop the DPRK-China friendly relations with socialism as their core, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the WPK and the DPRK government would fully support all the internal and external policies of the Chinese party and government for realizing the territorial integrity of the country on the basis of the "one-China" principle and building a fair and just multi-polar world.
ComradeKim Jong Unexchanged warm farewells with Wang Yi, wishing the Chinese party, government and people greater success in the course of accomplishing the cause of socialist modernization and national prosperity under the outstanding leadership of Comrade Xi Jinping. -0-

headline: Climatotherapy Resources
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 12 (KCNA) -- The DPRK is rich in mineral water and hot spring resources as well as climatotherapy resources conducive to the improvement of people's health.
The climatotherapy resources include different climatic zones and various weather elements according to seasons and zones.
According to Ri Hye Gyong, director of the Natural Health Research Institute under the Ministry of Public Health, the climatic zones of the DPRK can be divided into mountainous, coastal and plain climatic zones in consideration of the topographical, meteorological and climatic features.
Among them are the mountainous climatic zones of North Hamgyong Province, the climatic highlands of Ryanggang Province, the coastal climatic zones of South Hamgyong Province and Kangwon Province and the plain climatic zones of South Phyongan Province.
Experts believe that the rational use of the mountain climate can improve the state of health of those suffering from such ischemic heart diseases as myocarditis and myocardial infarction, arteriosclerosis, hypertension (stage 1), hypotension, chronic bronchitis, pneumonia, chronic hepatitis, nerve centre diseases, etc.
The coastal climate is suitable for recovering from the fatigue and effective in restoring the endocrine system function and preventing and treating chronic inflammatory diseases of the upper airway as it contains a lot of mineral salts, including chlorine, iodine and bromine, in the beautiful natural environment and clean air.
Warm and dry climate of the plains, too, is conducive to the treatment of urinary diseases and various metabolic disorders.
Because of the DPRK's various climates, people can select healthy climatic zones in different seasons.
According to data, the inland plains are good for people's health as there are Kangso mineral water, Sinchon hot spring, and Samma and Kyongam mineral waters in those areas.
In summer, alpine climatic zones, such as Pochonnaegok hot spring resort, and Onyang hot spring resort are good for the health.
In autumn the typical healthy climatic zones are Sinchon and Ryonggang hot spring resorts and Samma mineral water area and in winter Songdowon area in the east coast of the country.
Thanks to the popular policies of the Workers' Party of Korea, sanatoriums and recreation centers for climatotherapy have been built in different parts of the country. -0-

story_text:

Pyongyang in April is always wrapped up in an atmosphere of boundless reverence of the Korean people and the world progressives for the President, the founder of socialist Korea.

headline: WPK Is Revolutionary Party for People: Rodong Sinmun
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- The great Workers' Party of Korea is dynamically leading the struggle for great transformation to ensure the long-term state development. Thanks to its ever-victorious leadership, the history of the brilliant dignity, powerful strength and brilliant prosperity, which all the generations of the DPRK have desired, is being given steady continuity on this land, says Rodong Sinmun Monday in an article.
The WPK is the genuine people's Party which has adopted all its lines and policies as intended by the people and led them to a new life and civilization, the article says, and goes on:
Our Party's policy is based on the people-first principle, which is consistent with selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people from A to Z, and is oriented to realizing the people's cherished desire.
Our Party, guided by the political idea of believing in the people as in Heaven, is expanding the scope and depth of its policy.
The WPK is the seasoned general staff of the revolution which has oriented the faith and wisdom of all the people to the struggle for great transformation to open up a new phase of comprehensive state development.
The victory in the past five years' struggle, in which we pioneered a new trend of prosperity, irreversible and irresistible, in the face of the worst crisis and challenges ever in history, is the precious fruit of our Party's ideology-first principle.
It is the eternal mode of struggle of our Party to hold fast to the Juche-oriented theory of ideology as the key to everything.
The WPK is a great party which awakens the people to its noble ideals and great ambition and builds a bright future by inspiring them.
The leader's noble outlook on the people, noble outlook on happiness and extraordinary outlook on life are recorded in each page of the sacred history of the Party.
The WPK is a great party which makes any decision boldly if it is for the people, and implements it without fail. It is also an invincible party with noble responsibility and strong practical ability which unconditionally keeps any promise to the people. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung Always among People
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 13 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungwas a benevolent father of the people as he had always found himself among them, regarding it as his motto to believe in them as in Heaven.
With the auspicious April holiday approaching, the Korean people are recollecting with deep emotion the devoted efforts of the President, who continued a long journey along the rough road, saying that he should visit every place where the people live.
One day in January 1962, the President gave on-the-spot guidance to Sinchon County, South Hwanghae Province. When he finished his talk with officials, it was lunch time
Before going to his lodgings, he asked an official about the farm where women stopped the lead-off car.
He came to know the fact that it was the Wonam Cooperative Farm (then) and the official let the women, who came to see the President, go back. Then the President said that he should meet them even if he missed his lunch, and went to the farm to gratify the wishes of the people.
When he visited a mountain village, the President said that the living standards of inhabitants in the mountainous areas may be lower than those in the plain areas but they would be better in the future, and indicated the orientations and ways for it.
It was none other than the President who visited houses of the people to acquaint himself with their living conditions, opening the lids of rice crock and cooking pot before anything else, and visited workers' hostels to open wardrobes and chests of quilts and met children to look into textbooks and pencils of schoolbags.
That's why the DPRK people are still singing such songs as "When We Walk along the Road between Fields" and "Our Leader" with their deeper yearning for the President. -0-

headline: Peerlessly Great Man Opens up and Glorifies Era of Independence
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- The immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" sung by artistes of different countries is resounding at the stages of the 34th April Spring Friendship Art Festival.
Watching art performances which reflected boundless reverence for PresidentKim Il Sung, the Korean people and the world progressives are recollecting with deep emotion the immortal exploits the President performed for the times and the revolution and for the human cause of independence.
The President founded the Juche idea and put forward the oppressed and maltreated popular masses as the masters of history and led them to hew out their destiny by their own efforts, at the centre of the times and history.
In October 1972 the President met a friendly government delegation of Burkina Faso on a visit to the DPRK. He told its members that they should increase their economic strength in order to defend their political independence, and if they worship big countries and depend on them, they will have an idea that their own things are bad and the others' things are good.
Hearing the teachings given by the President, the members of the delegation cherished the truth that independence in politics can be realized only through self-support in the economy.
The members of a Guinean party and government delegation, who met the President, came to know the truth of independence while hearing his teachings.
Whenever he met many personages of political and public circles around the world who visited the DPRK, the President said that to maintain independence in the party and state activities is the most just policy that meets the requirements of the present era and that all the matters arising in the revolutionary struggle should be solved in conformity with the actual conditions of their countries by relying on the efforts of their people.
Indeed, PresidentKim Il Sungis a peerless sage who devoted his all to accomplishing the human cause of independence under the uplifted banner of independence all his life. -0-

headline: Destroyer Choe Hyon Conducts Test-fire of Weapon Systems
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- The test-fire of strategic cruise missiles and anti-warship missiles was conducted again in the operational efficiency test system of destroyer Choe Hyon of the Navy of the Korean People's Army on April 12.
ComradeKim Jong Un, together with leading officials in the field of national defence and commanding officers of the Navy, observed the test-fire.
The test-fire was aimed at checking the launching control line of the warship's integrated weapon commanding system and familiarizing the seamen with the missile firing action, as well as confirming the accuracy and the rate of hits of the improved active anti-jamming navigation system.
Two strategic cruise missiles and three anti-warship missiles were test-fired from destroyer Choe Hyon.
The launched strategic cruise missiles flew for 7 869s to 7 920s and anti-warship missiles for 1 960s to 1 973s along the flight orbits set in the sky above the West Sea of Korea and struck the targets with ultra-precision hit accuracy.
On the same day, ComradeKim Jong Unheard a report on the examined formation plan of weapon systems for the destroyers Nos. 3 and 4 under construction and made an important conclusion.
He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the preparedness of our army's strategic action has been strengthened in a qualitative way with various achievements recently made in the field of defence science.
Saying that it is our Party's invariable national defence line and most important priority task to steadily and unlimitedly bolster up the powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent, he clarified the important tasks for further strengthening the strategic and tactical attack capability, a key component of the nuclear war deterrent, and for improving and sophisticating the prompt response posture. -0-

headline: "Song of General Kim Il Sung" Popularized in Jakarta
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungwas the greatest man and great sage of history who was boundlessly revered and respected by all people.
Among the foreign friends attracted by the personality of the President as a great man was former Indonesian President Soekarno.
After visiting the DPRK, he made sure that the immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" was popularized to his country.
On hearing the news that PresidentKim Il Sungwas to visit Indonesia, Soekarno formed a reception committee for the President and personally became the chairman of the committee to push forward with the preparations for welcoming him.
On the day when PresidentKim Il Sungarrived in Jakarta in April 1965, the Indonesian government, under the instruction of its president, declared a special rest in Jakarta and organized a grand welcome work.
Hundreds of thousands of citizens gathered at the airport and held a ceremony greeting the most distinguished guest to warmly welcome PresidentKim Il Sung's visit to Indonesia.
When the President arrived at the square, huge crowds of citizens loudly sang "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" in Korean, waving flags of the two countries and bouquets.
Even at a banquet for the leaders of different countries who participated in an international event held in his country a few days later, President Soekarno saw to it that this song was played.
He said that "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" is the one he and all the Indonesian people know well, adding that the song is a world-famous one as PresidentKim Il Sungis well known to the world.
The immortal revolutionary hymn "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung" is still resounding as the song praising the great man. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Policy Section Chief of Institute for Japan Studies under DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The policy section chief of the Institute for Japan Studies under the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK issued a press statement titled "Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky document to beautify its extreme militarist moves with 'threat from the neighboring countries'" on April 14.
The press statement is as follows:
Shortly ago, Japan announced the "2026 diplomatic blue book" woven with conventional gangster-like logic and absurdity.
I do not care whether Japan announced the diplomatic blue book or not, but I can never overlook the fact that it called into question the DPRK's exercise of right to legitimate self-defence, in an absurd attempt to shake the position of a nuclear weapons state specified in the Constitution of the DPRK.
Japan termed the DPRK's measures for bolstering up its defence capabilities, which belong to the right to self-defence, "grave and urgent threat" and "clear and serious challenge" and made an anachronistic and evasive assertion like "complete, verifiable and irreversible dismantlement" and "complete implementation of the resolution of the UN Security Council".
This is a grave provocation encroaching upon the sovereign rights, security interests and development rights of our sacred state and, at the same time, it fully reveals Japan's deep-rooted hostility and confrontational intention toward the DPRK.
In the diplomatic blue book, Japan talked about the "international order based on rules" and "governing by law", but refused to mention its master's top-class rogue act of unhesitatingly resorting to aggression and use of armed forces against sovereign states to hold its unilateral hegemony.
Japan, a vassal state of the U.S., which has neither clear political view nor independence, is making desperate efforts to deny the position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state. This is impudent and ridiculous act not quite fit for it.
Whenever an opportunity presents itself, Japan is letting loose rhetoric about the exercise of the right to self-defence by neighboring countries. Such move is aimed at covering up its criminal nature of shaking the keynote of security in the region while pursuing legal and institutional completion as a war state and expansion of its aggressive attack capability.
Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky and confrontation document from A to Z to beautify the militarist moves of the Japanese authorities who are dreaming of bringing about the second imperial era and rushing headlong into its realization with "threat from the neighboring countries" as an excuse. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Policy Section Chief of Institute for Japan Studies under DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The policy section chief of the Institute for Japan Studies under the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK issued a press statement titled "Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky document to beautify its extreme militarist moves with 'threat from the neighboring countries'" on April 14.
The press statement is as follows:
Shortly ago, Japan announced the "2026 diplomatic blue book" woven with conventional gangster-like logic and absurdity.
I do not care whether Japan announced the diplomatic blue book or not, but I can never overlook the fact that it called into question the DPRK's exercise of right to legitimate self-defence, in an absurd attempt to shake the position of a nuclear weapons state specified in the Constitution of the DPRK.
Japan termed the DPRK's measures for bolstering up its defence capabilities, which belong to the right to self-defence, "grave and urgent threat" and "clear and serious challenge" and made an anachronistic and evasive assertion like "complete, verifiable and irreversible dismantlement" and "complete implementation of the resolution of the UN Security Council".
This is a grave provocation encroaching upon the sovereign rights, security interests and development rights of our sacred state and, at the same time, it fully reveals Japan's deep-rooted hostility and confrontational intention toward the DPRK.
In the diplomatic blue book, Japan talked about the "international order based on rules" and "governing by law", but refused to mention its master's top-class rogue act of unhesitatingly resorting to aggression and use of armed forces against sovereign states to hold its unilateral hegemony.
Japan, a vassal state of the U.S., which has neither clear political view nor independence, is making desperate efforts to deny the position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state. This is impudent and ridiculous act not quite fit for it.
Whenever an opportunity presents itself, Japan is letting loose rhetoric about the exercise of the right to self-defence by neighboring countries. Such move is aimed at covering up its criminal nature of shaking the keynote of security in the region while pursuing legal and institutional completion as a war state and expansion of its aggressive attack capability.
Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky and confrontation document from A to Z to beautify the militarist moves of the Japanese authorities who are dreaming of bringing about the second imperial era and rushing headlong into its realization with "threat from the neighboring countries" as an excuse. -0-

headline:
"Nostalgia", Song Loved by President Kim Il Sung
[2026.04.15.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung, the people in the DPRK are thinking about the song "Nostalgia" with deep emotion.
This immortal classic masterpiece not only arousing love and yearning for the hometown but also implanting preciousness of the homeland into one's mind was created by the President during the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle.
In good or bad days and whenever he did a good thing for the wellbeing of the people, he would sing this song. Even in his advanced age of eighty, he sang the song, deeply cherishing the noble sense of mission and responsibility he assumed for the country and its people.
During the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the President instilled noble patriotism and steadfast revolutionary spirit into the hearts of the fighters, singing the song "Nostalgia".
When he met the heroes of the Republic and model fighters in late June 1951, the period of the Fatherland Liberation War, he accepted their request and sang this song, encouraging them to perform the greater heroic feats.
In the early 1990s when the imperialists were talking about the "end" of socialism, the "Nostalgia" sung by the President reflected his great expectation and belief that Korean-style socialism should be firmly defended and glorified generation after generation.
The immortal classic masterpiece "Nostalgia" resounds endlessly, telling about the sacred life of the President who devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Sok Ryo, a woman living in Neighborhood Unit No. 52, Ponbu-dong, Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
The centenarian, who received the birthday spread amid congratulations of officials of the Sinuiju City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and neighbours, expressed her gratitude to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwith excitement.
Born into a fisherman's daughter before the liberation of Korea, she had been subjected to all sorts of maltreatment and contempt while undergoing sorrow as a stateless nation. She could lead a worthwhile life only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated Korea and built a genuine people's country.
Out of her mind to contribute to the prosperity of the country she devoted herself to her duty, and had done a lot of good things for the sake of the country even after becoming a pensioner.
She is always asking her descendants to work harder to defend and glorify the grateful socialist system. -0-
