headline: Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulatory Letter from GAKC
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a congratulatory letter from the General Association of Koreans in China on April 15.
The letter said that April 15, 1912 when the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungwas born as the sun of Juche with the destiny of the fellow countrymen in his mind, was a day of great fortune for our country and people and a historic day when the dawn of the era of independence was illuminated in the future of the world progressives.
The great leader devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people, always leading the revolution with his ardent love and devotion to the people, regarding it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven all his life since he embarked on the road of revolution, the letter said.
Indeed, he was the great revolutionary and the great sage who performed immortal great exploits for the country and its people, the times and history with his outstanding ideology, extraordinary leadership, gigantic revolutionary practice and noble virtues under the uplifted banner of independence, it said, adding:
The revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered and led to victory by the great leadersKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilis now winning victories under the guidance of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man, and the sacred history of the sun is invariably being given steady continuity.
The respected Marshal is making ceaseless forced march of devoted service for the people's wellbeing with his far-reaching desire to provide the happiest life in the world to the Korean people whom the great leadersKim Il SungandKim Jong Ilregarded as heaven.
The new regional development policy and great changes like the rural revolution and the public health revolution have been made on a nationwide scale, bringing about a new life and new civilization of the people in all parts of the country, and the voices of admiration and envy are being heard among world people. Such reality of today is adding to the pride and honor of being Koreans holding the respected Marshal in high esteem as their father.
The letter wished the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the great sun of Juche Korea and benevolent father of Koreans in China, good health, reflecting the unanimous wish of all Koreans in China. -0-

Pyongyang, April 15 (KCNA) -- The policy section chief of the Institute for Japan Studies under the Foreign Ministry of the DPRK issued a press statement titled "Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky document to beautify its extreme militarist moves with 'threat from the neighboring countries'" on April 14.
The press statement is as follows:
Shortly ago, Japan announced the "2026 diplomatic blue book" woven with conventional gangster-like logic and absurdity.
I do not care whether Japan announced the diplomatic blue book or not, but I can never overlook the fact that it called into question the DPRK's exercise of right to legitimate self-defence, in an absurd attempt to shake the position of a nuclear weapons state specified in the Constitution of the DPRK.
Japan termed the DPRK's measures for bolstering up its defence capabilities, which belong to the right to self-defence, "grave and urgent threat" and "clear and serious challenge" and made an anachronistic and evasive assertion like "complete, verifiable and irreversible dismantlement" and "complete implementation of the resolution of the UN Security Council".
This is a grave provocation encroaching upon the sovereign rights, security interests and development rights of our sacred state and, at the same time, it fully reveals Japan's deep-rooted hostility and confrontational intention toward the DPRK.
In the diplomatic blue book, Japan talked about the "international order based on rules" and "governing by law", but refused to mention its master's top-class rogue act of unhesitatingly resorting to aggression and use of armed forces against sovereign states to hold its unilateral hegemony.
Japan, a vassal state of the U.S., which has neither clear political view nor independence, is making desperate efforts to deny the position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state. This is impudent and ridiculous act not quite fit for it.
Whenever an opportunity presents itself, Japan is letting loose rhetoric about the exercise of the right to self-defence by neighboring countries. Such move is aimed at covering up its criminal nature of shaking the keynote of security in the region while pursuing legal and institutional completion as a war state and expansion of its aggressive attack capability.
Japan's diplomatic blue book is a tricky and confrontation document from A to Z to beautify the militarist moves of the Japanese authorities who are dreaming of bringing about the second imperial era and rushing headlong into its realization with "threat from the neighboring countries" as an excuse. -0-

headline: Happy Children's Laughter on Day of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unsent benevolent gifts to the orphans, primary school pupils and children across the DPRK on the occasion of the auspicious April holiday.
Expressing thanks to the respected fatherly Marshal who takes care of and brings up them with love and affection, the students of Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Chilgol Revolutionary School and other revolutionary schools have made a firm determination to always go along the road of loyalty and patriotism by carrying forward the ideas and faith of the forerunners.
Those children at baby homes, orphanages, primary and middle schools for orphans, nurseries and kindergarteners and pupils at the primary schools across the country were happy to have received various kinds of confectionery and other foodstuffs, school things and sportswear. Their happy looks added to the joy of the significant spring holiday.
Seeing the happy children, the nurses, teachers, teaching staff and parents felt gratitude to the Workers' Party of Korea and the state exerting all loving care and sincerity for the rising generations. -0-

headline: Improvement of Evodia daniellii Benn Forests Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- More than 130 cities and counties of the DPRK expand successes in a drive to completely improve the Evodia daniellii Benn forests, created in the past, by cooperating with the Academy of Forest Science, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The campaign for grafting buds and branches of high-yielding trees on the low-yielding ones was conducted simultaneously across the country.
Researchers of the Academy of Forest Science in the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians made a survey of the Evodia daniellii Benn forests in different parts of the country. They also completed the summer grafting technology deemed impossible.
The work for securing the high-yielding tree branches was successfully completed, thanks to the efforts of the employees of the city and county oil-bearing tree forest stations and researchers of the Academy.
Good results are being made in the forest improvement in different cities and counties across the country, including Songchon and Unchon counties and Anju city. -0-

headline: Beautiful Pyongyang in April -Landscape on Moran Hill in Spring
Evening Gala and Firework Display Held in DPRK

Art Performance Marks Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung
[2026.04.16.]
Birth Anniversary of President Kim Il Sung Celebrated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel in the DPRK celebrated with splendor the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
An endless stream of visitors with deep yearning flew into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children laid flower baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men in different parts of the country including Mansu Hill and paid tribute to them.
On the occasion of the April spring holiday, working people visited the President's birthplace at Mangyongdae to deeply grasp the immortal exploits of the peerlessly great man, who regarded it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven and made a sacred history of the people-first principle.
The national flags and visual aids were displayed at major places in the capital city and provincial, city and county seats and at institutions, industrial establishments and farms across the country, adding to the festive mood.
Pupils in all parts of the country joined the Korean Children's Union on the significant Day of the Sun.
Colorful performances were given at theatres and other places in the capital city and local areas.
There was a demonstration of riders of the riding club in Kanggye City.
The joy and excitement of celebrating the Day of the Sun were also overflowing at dancing party venues in South Phyongan, North Hwanghae and Ryanggang provinces, Rason Municipality and other parts of the country.
The Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and other cultural recreation grounds were replete with the people's joy and happiness and public catering establishments across the country were crowded with visitors. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK celebrating the auspicious Day of the Sun in the historic first year's advance for realizing the fighting programme clarified by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea are extending eternal glory to PresidentKim Il Sung, the founder of socialist Korea and the great sage of the revolution.
Senior Party and government officials visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on April 15, the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present there were Pak Thae Song and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, and other senior officials of the Party and the government, leading officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the armed forces organs.
A flower basket from ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid at the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Also, placed were flower baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the DPRK State Affairs Commission, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet.
The participants paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the participants made deep bows to them, praying for their immortality.
All the participants pledged to demonstrate before the world the dignity and might of the DPRK by upholding with single-minded loyalty the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, who is dynamically ushering in an era of historic changes for the prosperity of our state and the wellbeing of the people, a period of comprehensive development of socialist construction, under the uplifted banner of the great Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism. -0-

It added: With the precious money sent for the children of Korean compatriots in Japan as the life-giving water, we will develop the democratic national education into the one responsible for the future of the movement of Koreans in Japan and the one to which the compatriots can leave their children at ease, as intended by the respected Marshal.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Artillery Firing Contest of Artillery Sub-units Held on Significant Day of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw an artillery firing contest of artillery sub-units under the large combined units of the Korean People's Army in the western area organized on April 15, the Day of the Sun.
ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of the KPA large combined units in the western area.
The artillery firing contest was conducted according to the contest rules set up in conformity with the simulated tactical environment.
In the contest, the artillery sub-units powerfully demonstrated their militant marksmanship they have consolidated to the full with a high desire to perfect combat preparations, and clearly showed their full war posture.
The artillery sub-unit of the Capital City Defence Corps won the first place in the contest.
The 4th Corps of the KPA came second, the 2nd Corps third, the 8th Corps fourth and the 3rd Corps fifth.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed satisfaction over the fact that the artillery firing contest, held to mark the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation, served as an important occasion in enhancing the training enthusiasm of our artillerymen and remarkably strengthening their militant might.
The positive utilization of the artillery force is the most important factor deciding the victory in operation and battle and furthermore in war, he said, stressing that the People's Army should as ever put spurs to the artillery combat readiness, true to the Party's policy of attaching importance to the artillery and strengthening the artillery force and that the Party Central Committee's strategic plan for modernization of the artillery force should be thoroughly implemented within the new five-year plan for the development of the national defence.
He said that it is good to frequently organize training contests at all levels of the army on national holidays and other major occasions as seen today and the People's Army should be engrossed only in the training for rounding off the combat preparations, adding that it is precisely the way for realizing the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung's desire for building a powerful army and an expression of loyalty to the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and the duty of the army.
The sub-unit which won the training contest was awarded a diploma, medal and badge.
That day, ComradeKim Jong Unmet the soldiers of the successful artillery sub-unit and appreciated their high combat capability before having a photo session with officers and men.
The KPA commanding officers and artillerymen, blessed with the warm love and trust of the great brilliant commander on the auspicious spring holiday of April, hardened their pledge to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee and reliably safeguard the inviolable sovereignty and dignity of the glorious DPRK and the honor of the Korean People's Army with remarkable success in strengthening the combat power of the artillery. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Ri Chun Hong, a woman living in Neighborhood Unit No. 34, Namchongang-dong, Kaechon City, South Phyongan Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
The centenarian, who received the birthday spread amid congratulations of officials of the Kaechon City Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and villagers, expressed her gratitude to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwith excitement.
Born into a poor peasant's family before the liberation of Korea, she had to undergo sorrow as a stateless nation. She keenly felt through her experience the gratefulness to the Party and the state which gave her genuine dignity and happiness after the liberation of the country. With a single mind to live up to them, she had voluntarily done good things for the sake of the society and collective.
Saying that our Party and our socialist country which make selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people are the best in the world, she is encouraging her descendants to fulfill their duty at their revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advances to Final of 2026 AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- The semi-finals between the DPRK team and the ROK team for the 2026 AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup took place in Thailand on April 15 (local time).
On the basis of the experience gained in the group league match, the DPRK players made a strong attack to pressurize their rival from the beginning.
Amid fierce attacks and counterattacks, No. 14 Pak Il Sim and No. 12 Kang Ryu Mi of the DPRK team made scores about 24 and 34 minutes into the first half of the match. Around 84 minutes after the start of the match in the second half, No. 10 Choe Yon A again succeeded in scoring a goal.
After all, the DPRK team defeated the ROK team 3:0 and advanced to the final.
The DPRK team will play the final with its Japanese rival on April 18 (local time). -0-

headline: Koreans in Japan Significantly Celebrate Auspicious April Holiday
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- Koreans in Japan significantly celebrated the auspicious April holiday.
Officials of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) held a meeting at the Korean Hall in Tokyo, Japan on April 13 to lay a flower basket before the portrait of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The participants paid tribute to the President, praying for his immortality.
A meeting of Koreans in Japan took place at the Korean Hall to celebrate the 114th birth anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho, Vice-Chairman Nam Sung U, Vice-Chairman and Director General of the General Affairs Department Pae Jin Gu, Vice-Chairman Jo Il Yon, Vice-Chairman and Director of the Department for International Affairs So Chung On of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, and Vice-Chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and concurrently Chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Democratic Women's Union in Japan Kang Chu Ryon, Chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon Ri Myong Yu, and directors of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan and chairpersons of Chongryon regional headquarters in Kanto area.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Pak Ku Ho made a report.
The reporter said that the motherland is greeting the April holiday at a time when it started a grand march to usher in a era of new upsurge and gigantic new changes in the Juche revolution with the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK as the starting point. He paid the highest respect and tribute to the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung, praying for his immortality.
He called upon all the officials and compatriots to glorify forever the revolutionary career of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand the immortal leadership exploits performed for the movement of Koreans in Japan and to turn out as one in the patriotic activities of writing a new great history of the movement of Koreans in Japan under the bright blueprint of the prosperity of Chongryon unfolded by the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
A congratulatory letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting.
A lecture was held at the Korean Hall on April 11 to celebrate the 114th birth anniversary of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung. -0-

headline: Dancing Party of Women Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- A dancing party of women's union officials and members was held at the plaza of the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium in the DPRK on April 15 to celebrate the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The plaza was brimming with joy and excitement of the women's union officials and members greeting the significant April spring holiday. The dancing party began with the song "The Day of the Sun, Spring Holiday".
With boundless reverence for the President who devoted all his life to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people, the participants danced to the tune of such songs as "Song of Mangyongdae" and "Mine Is Always the Country ofKim Il Sung".
They continued dancing to the tune of songs "Our Leader Loved by People" and "Your Embrace is the Best", full of confidence that our future will be brighter under the guidance of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
The atmosphere of the dancing party was revved up amid the eruption of unanimous desire of the participants to glorify their lives as women revolutionaries and patriotic citizens making a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country while steadily keeping the great socialist family's trait of loyalty and patriotism.
There took place dancing parties of women's union officials and members in provincial, city and county seats on the same day. -0-

The provincial rural economy committee has carried on the work to select varieties of crops and set their sowing periods in conformity with the climatic conditions of the plains, middle and mountainous areas and the characteristics of crops, and push ahead with their cultivation in a scientific and technological way.
Agricultural production units are fertilizing with phytosin and nutrient accelerants.
They are introducing into large areas the method of soil-covering cultivation by biodegradable paper to increase the per-hectare yield of field crops, while taking steps to conduct the immediate spring ploughing and seeding in a qualitative way at the right time and cope with the changing weather climate.

headline: Nampho Municipality Takes Measures to Improve Ecological Environment
Koryo Celadon, Part of Korean National Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- Koryo Celadon Craftwork is part of the intangible cultural heritage of the DPRK.
Koryo celadon is blue-colored pottery created in the period of Koryo (918-1392).
Koryo celadon, which had been in its heyday in the 11th and 12th centuries, further developed in the 13th and 14th centuries.
It was so clear and clean in colour that it was likened to blue sky in autumn, blue sky after the rain, blue water flowing in deep mountains, clear water in Sangpaldam (eight pools) of Mt Kumgang and jade. For this reason, the blue ceramics of Koryo were called "Koryo jaded green porcelain" and "Koryo celadon".
Koryo celadon is classified into pure celadon, engraved celadon and inlaid celadon, according to decorative techniques.
Decorative patterns of Koryo celadon were used in various ways to go well with the colors of things and phenomena existing in nature such as vine patterns and exclusive patterns.
The shapes of Koryo celadon are almost long curved so they look thin, flexible, lively and vigorous. The pattern lines, drawn with confidence, represent reasonable yet strong assertion and express optimistic feelings of life, so it is sometimes called "pottery of patterns".
Koryo celadon, manufactured and completed by various techniques and thermal engineering principles, has reached the height of ceramic art for a harmonious combination of shape, decorative patterns and green blue colour.
Koryo celadon craftwork was registered as a part of national intangible cultural heritage in May 2014. -0-

headline: Efforts Directed to Developing High-Performance Farm Machines in DPRK
story_text:

The institute is subordinating and orienting all its work to resolving scientific and technological problems after reflecting the main research projects in its plan.
The technical group of the institute invented a rice-transplanting machine suited to actual conditions and regional characteristics, thus providing a scientific and technological guarantee for ensuring even depth of seedling transplantation in the work of the nutritive cold-bed rice-transplanting machine and reducing its plant-missing rate.
The researchers also completed the design of devices capable of improving the performance of rice-transplanting machine in a short span of time and took technical measures to make their operation smoother while using less fuel.
The research findings helpful to increasing the wheat and barley threshing capacity and enhancing the effect of seed selection are also associated with the enterprising spirit of the researchers of the institute working hard to develop farm machines suited to the specific conditions of the country.
They have also played a decisive role in designing and manufacturing efficient machines for making fish paths in paddy fields by developing the compaction apparatus and depth control apparatus suited to the soil conditions of paddy fields. -0-

headline: Large Numbers of School Graduates Volunteer for Army in DPRK This Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 19 (KCNA) -- This year, large numbers of senior middle school graduates in the DPRK determined to wear the military uniform of the revolution or volunteered for the forefront border posts.
The North Hwanghae Provincial Youth League Committee let the graduates enjoy art performances given by members of the schoolchildren's art squad and their mothers, and educated them about patriotism. As a result, more than 1 000 students of over 50 classes volunteered for the frontline border posts.
The district and county youth league committees in Pyongyang conducted various activities including study tours of revolutionary battle sites and revolutionary sites and contests of singing wartime songs in chorus while marching to make students realize that youth devoted to national defence is the most valuable and worthwhile one. And thus more than 500 graduates of 20-odd classes vowed to take the lead in defending the country.
Graduates of many senior middle schools in North Phyongan Province and Nampho Municipality also expressed their ardent desire to join the army in order to repay the love and benevolence they received from the country.
Graduates of Hadan Senior Middle Schools Nos. 1 and 2 in Sinuiju City volunteered for the army.
Students of the Wolmae Senior Middle School in Taean District at their meeting for volunteering for the army expressed their will to stand at the posts for defending the national sovereignty and the people.
Graduates of various senior middle schools in Ichon County, Kangwon Province, and those of Sinho Technology Senior Middle School in Sinpho City, South Hamgyong Province, joined the honorable ranks hoping to enter the army.
Among the volunteers are graduates of Kaesong Secondary School No. 1, Sonjuk Senior Middle School and Koryo Senior Middle School in Kaesong Municipality and those of senior middle schools in Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province, Kosong County of Kangwon Province, Sinhung County of South Hamgyong Province, Kyonghung County of North Hamgyong Province and Kangso District of Nampho Municipality. -0-

headline: Russians Visit Mangyongdae
Rural Houses and Farmers' Opinions
story_text:
One day in August 2020, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited flood-stricken Taechong-ri, Unpha County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
After acquainting himself with the flood damage in the area, the General Secretary kindly asked a farmer's opinion on the site for new houses.
Listening to the honest opinion, he gave an instruction on rebuilding modern well-arranged dwellings in the flood-hit villages.
After a while, he asked the farmer again what kind of a house the farmers liked.
Listening to the farmer, the General Secretary said that it is necessary to design detached and semi-detached houses for farmers and that the designs should be examined by the farmers at every work-team, not by officials.
Officials were deeply moved by his instruction full of the tender-hearted father's deep affection and love for the people.
Thanks to his warm love for the people, rural houses fully reflecting the farmers' opinions could be built in the area. -0-

headline: Vice-Chairman of SPA Standing Committee Meets Russian Delegation
Success in Breeding Rana ornativentris
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- The Sungjin Biological Technology Development Center of the Three-Revolution Exhibition House has developed and introduced a technology of breeding Rana ornativentris, drawing attention of many people, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The development center found frogs of good stock in Kaesong Municipality, North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces and other areas and succeeded in completing the low-cost, semi-artificial breeding method of Korean-style based on advanced science and technology.
In recent years, it has released more than 3 million young frogs into forests of various regions and around revolutionary sites. As a result, damage caused by harmful insects in forests including pine caterpillar has been considerably reduced.
It introduced the semi-artificial breeding method into the forests of 14 regions and units and built a base for annually producing 3 million young frogs.
It is also developing various kinds of health foods and cosmetics with Rana ornativentris.
It is taking a practical step to help the cities and counties with forests breed Rana ornativentris by themselves. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- After occupying Korea illegally in the last century, the Japanese imperialists  replaced the residency-general in Korea with the government-general in Korea, a colonial fascist ruling body, and enforced the government-general administration from October 1910.
In the first period of the government-general administration, the Japanese imperialists enforced a military rule based on the gendarme and police system and set up a lot of repressive machinery including police everywhere in Korea to harshly suppress and massacre the Korean people.
It is well proved by the fact that the number of Koreans arrested by the Japanese imperialists in 1918 increased more than ten times as compared with 1912.
The Japanese imperialists kept in force the "Security Law" and "Press Law", which was enforced with the aim of depriving the Korean people of all their rights and suppressing the anti-Japanese struggle, while cooking up and promulgating new evil laws such as "rally control ordinance". As a result, the fierce atmosphere of terror politics pervaded the whole of Korea.
Frightened by the towering anti-Japanese sentiment of the Korean people in 1919, the Japanese imperialists replaced the military rule with "cultural rule" and increased the secret police instead of gendarme and police.
They made desperate efforts to force the Korean people to change their names to Japanese ones and obliterate the spoken and written Korean language. Owing to their cruel government-general rule, Korea turned into a veritable hell and a dark land where massacres were rampant.
A website in Latin America carried an article on Japan's past crimes, noting that although the colonial era existed in human history, only Japan enforced such a heinous predatory policy of depriving the Koreans of their language and names and robbing even bowls and spoons at each home. It revealed that human, material and mental damage the Japanese imperialists inflicted to the Korean people during their colonial rule is countless. -0-

headline: New Teaching Methods Created in Sector of General Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, many educational units in the general education sector of the DPRK have created new beneficial and advantageous teaching methods to contribute to educational practice.
Mangyongdae Revolutionary School created four new teaching methods and generalized them across the country.
Changdok School developed an enlightenment-oriented teaching method, which encourages the students to visit factories or enterprises related to the contents of the next lessons during their after-school hours and conceive, design and implement the most realistic and rational experimental plans so that they can theoretically understand the contents of education, thus consolidating the foundation for training creative and practical talents.
New teaching methods were also invented by Chilgol Revolutionary School, Moranbong Secondary School No. 1, Haeun Junior Middle School in Phyongchon District, Sohung Primary School in Moranbong District affiliated to Pyongyang Teachers Training College and Changjon Primary School in Central District.
Among them are new teaching methods for systematically improving the students' foreign language skills. -0-

headline: DPRK Missile Administration Test-fires Tactical Ballistic Missiles
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted a test-fire on April 19 to evaluate the power of warhead of the improved surface-to-surface tactical ballistic missile Hwasongpho-11 Ra.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the DPRK, supervised the test-fire.
Among the spectators were Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Lieut. General An Yong Hwan, commander of the 1st Corps of the Korean People's Army, Lieut. General Ju Song Nam, commander of the 2nd Corps of the KPA, Lieut. General Jong Myong Nam, commander of the 4th Corps of the KPA, and Lieut. General Ri Jong Guk, commander of the 5th Corps of the KPA.
The purpose of the test-fire is to verify the characteristics and power of cluster bomb warhead and fragmentation mine warhead applied to the tactical ballistic missile.
Five tactical ballistic missiles, launched towards the target area around an island about 136 km away, struck the area of 12.5~13 hectares with the very high density, fully displaying their combat might.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the test results, saying that the development and introduction of different cluster bomb warheads can meet the operational demand of the KPA in a more satisfactory and effective way and that it is of weighty significance in military actions to boost the high-density striking capability to quell a specific target area as well as the high-precision striking capability.
He appreciated that the technology and records we have acquired and updated today are a valuable result of clearly proving that the organization of a group specializing in research into missile warheads and the five years spent for it were not in vain.
He encouraged the defence science research groups, hoping that they will continuously make successes in the important undertakings to acquire and update various ultra-modern technologies necessary for the combat preparedness of our army. -0-

He developed more than 30 kinds of quality paints, waterproofs and concrete additives, thus contributing to diversifying building materials and implementing the construction policy of the Workers' Party of Korea.

headline: Book "Among the People" Brought out in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 21 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea Publishing House brought out Volume 114 of the book "Among the People", a winner ofKim Il SungPrize, on the occasion of the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The book "Among the People", which has been brought out in serial volumes to be popular among the public for 64 years, is a national treasure of Juche Korea showing the unshakable faith and will of all the people to add eternal glory to the revolutionary career and exploits of the President.
The newly published volume contains 16 memoirs dealing with the wise leadership and noble personality of the President who devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people.
Since Vol. 1 was brought out on the occasion of the 50th birth anniversary of the President, serials of the book have been brought out continuously. They contain thousands of memoirs written by anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters, officials of the Party and power organs and working people's organizations, workers, farmers, intellectuals, bereaved families of the revolutionary and patriotic martyrs, honored disabled soldiers, servicepersons' families and overseas compatriots.
Vol. 1 was published in March 1962 and Vol. 52 in July 1994 when the President passed away.
People from all walks of life still write memoirs even after his demise to convey the greatness of the peerlessly great man to posterity. -0-

"Guerrillas Actions", Original Manual for Guerrilla Tactics
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 22 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungfounded the Korean People's Revolutionary Army on April 25, 1932 and created and applied unique strategies and tactics and methods for guerrilla warfare in the days of leading the anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory.
Among them is the "Guerrillas Actions", a manual for guerrilla tactics authored by the President on April 25, 1933, one year after the foundation of the KPRA.
The manual deals with the fundamental matters ranging from the guerrillas' spiritual and moral qualities to the general principles of guerrilla warfare.
Specified in it are all the principles and methods related to combat actions of the KPRA such as defensive battle, march and bivouac, and firing, handling weapons and discipline.
The "Guerrillas Actions" had served as a guideline for combat actions and life of the KPRA commanding officers and members.
The officers and members of the KPRA dealt a heavy blow to the Japanese imperialists by skillfully applying the guerrilla tactics and strategies clarified in the "Guerrillas Actions".
In this regard, the Japanese imperialists admitted that the KPRA's protean tactics of guerrilla warfare could not be found in any military books of the Japanese army and its strategy and tactics.
Thanks to the original principles, methods and tactics of guerrillas' activities created by the President in the days of the anti-Japanese war, the KPRA could defeat the Japanese imperialists superior in numbers and military technology and accomplish the historic cause of national liberation on August 15, 1945. -0-

Symbolic and decorative towers, tens of meters high on the roofs of skyscrapers in Mirae Scientists Street and Ryomyong Street, and chimney and compounding tower newly built at the smeltery and large chemical base are associated with his sincere thinking, enthusiasm and efforts. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Ministers of DPRK and Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 22 (KCNA) -- Talks between Pang Tu Sop, minister of Public Security of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Vladimir Kolokoltev, minister of Interior of the Russian Federation, were held at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on April 21.
Present there from the DPRK side were Kim Song Nam, vice-minister of Public Security, and officials concerned and from the Russian side were members of the delegation of the Ministry of Interior of the Russian Federation and Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here.
At the talks, both sides exchanged the successes and experience gained by the public security and interior service organizations of the two countries in the field of law enforcement and discussed in depth the issues of expanding and developing exchange and cooperation.
The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
At the end of the talks, a 2026-2027 plan for exchanging delegations was signed between the Ministry of Public Security of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Ministry of Interior of the Russian Federation.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Noble Devotion for People
story_text:
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the inaugurated Jongphyong County Foodstuff Factory on December 24, 2025.
Saying that he would taste wheat paste and soy sauce produced by the foodstuff factory, the General Secretary headed for the production room.
He tasted the soy sauce and taught the officials accompanying him how to improve the quality of soy sauce.
Then he tasted wheat paste and said with a broad smile that the wheat paste produced by the factory tasted good like fermented soybean paste.
Hearing the reply of an official at the factory saying that it was pure wheat paste, the General Secretary said that it tasted best among those produced by the city and county foodstuff factories inaugurated that year.
The accompanying officials looked at the General Secretary in reverence, touched by his noble virtue. Working hard to provide the regional people with tasty condiments, he even tasted the wheat paste produced by a regional foodstuff factory.
They keenly realized once again that the living standards of the regional people are improving thanks to the noble devotion and warm care of the respected General Secretary. -0-

headline: President Kim Il Sung, Legendary Hero
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 23 (KCNA) -- The Korean People's Revolutionary Army, the first Juche-type revolutionary armed forces of our country, was founded on April 25, 1932.
In the run-up to its founding anniversary, the DPRK people look back with deep emotion on the immortal exploits performed by PresidentKim Il Sungin leading the anti-Japanese revolutionary war to victory by creating an epoch-making model of guerrilla warfare.
The battle of Xiaoyingziling, organized and commanded by the President in May 1932, was the first victorious ambush in which the young Korean People's Revolutionary Army wiped out the enemy at a single stroke by taking advantage of the favourable terrain.
The President applied outstanding military tactics, such as a sudden strike, a tactic of disintegrating the enemy and a preemptive strike at the enemy's heart, at the assault on Dongning county town. Those military tactics were the decisive factor that made it possible for a small unit to defeat a large unit of the enemy by dint of strategic and tactical superiority.
Among the tactics created by the President are the tactic of marching a long distance at a step, combined with tactics of allurement and deception, blitz tactics, massing and dispersing of troops and their moves, and circling tactics whose might was fully demonstrated in guerrilla activities.
The Korean People's Revolutionary Army won the battle of Fusong county town with a tactic of appearing now in the east and now in the west in a flash. And it also won a great victory at the battle on Mt Hongtou by annihilating the enemy in a trap valley. Various other battles, which made a breakthrough in the final offensive operations for national liberation, shook the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule to its very foundation.
The Juche-oriented tactics created by the President during the anti-Japanese revolutionary war were invincible weapons that made it possible to defeat with guerrilla warfare the aggressor army using regular warfare. -0-

headline: Ground-breaking Ceremony for Building DPRK-Russia Friendship Hospital Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 23 (KCNA) -- The DPRK-Russia Friendship Hospital will be built at the scenic Myongsasimni shore of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area on the East Sea of Korea amid many-sided exchange and cooperation for providing the peoples of the two countries with substantial welfare by further strengthening the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Russia.
The construction of the hospital, an important agreement made at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit, marked another milestone in deepening friendship and fraternity between the peoples of the two countries and a significant occasion in proving the development of the bilateral friendly relations which are being remarkably developed at a new high stage.
The ground-breaking ceremony for the construction of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Hospital took place in Wonsan City on Wednesday amid the deep interest and expectation of the governments and peoples of the two countries.
Present at the ceremony were Kim Tok Hun, first vice-premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Kim Tu Won, minister of Public Health, Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations who is chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Ju Mun Jin, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned, builders and working people in Wonsan City.
Present there were Minister of Health Mikhail Murashuko, Minister of Natural Resources and Ecology and Chairman of the Russian side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology Alexandr Kozlov, and other members of the Russian government delegation, staff members of the Russian embassy in Pyongyang and Oleg Kosheev, consul general of the Russian Federation in Chongjin.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were played.
Congratulatory speeches and remarks were made at the ceremony.
Kim Tu Won extended warm congratulations on behalf of the DPRK government to the designers and builders of the hospital and friends of the two countries who devoted positive efforts and sincerity to the successful start of the construction of the DPRK-Russia Friendship Hospital.
Today, the DPRK-Russia friendly relations have been developed into invincible strategic alliance under the special care of the top leaders of the two countries and gigantic and meaningful joint plans for the prosperity of the states and the promotion of the welfare of the two peoples have been pushed forward vigorously, adding pleasure and joy to all, he said.
The completion of the hospital will inject vitality into the beautiful life of not only the regional people but also the visitors to the world-class tourist resort, he said.
He stressed that the DPRK-Russia Friendship Hospital would be built as a monumental edifice for unity and cooperation and an advanced health center with excellent treatment environment and medical service system to further bring the flower garden of friendship into full bloom.
Mikhail Murashuko warmly congratulated the participants in the ceremony for the construction of the hospital on behalf of the government of the Russian Federation, saying that today's event is not merely to lay the foundation of the hospital but to lay the foundation for long-term and beneficial cooperation in the field of public health of the two countries.
The construction of the friendship hospital is of special significance as it is an event of implementing the agreement reached by Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, and ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, at the historic meeting, he said, adding that this is a clear example of the steady development of cooperation between the two countries.
Hoping that the successes in the construction of the hospital and the training of medical workers would be achieved, he expressed belief that the hospital would contribute to the promotion of people's health and symbolize the solid friendly relations between Russia and the DPRK.
Referring to the fact that the joint plan for the construction of the friendship hospital was drawn up and is to be put into practice, Alexandr Kozlov said that the patients would receive good treatment at the modern hospital to be built at the tourist resort of the DPRK which is being visited by many guests at home and abroad.
The friendly and good-neighborly relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea are based on equality, mutual respect and trust, he said, adding that the current ground-breaking ceremony proves that the Russia-DPRK border is not a wall but an open door for friends.
He congratulated the participants in the ground-breaking ceremony once again and expressed the will to successfully push ahead with the vast cooperation between the two countries in the future.
Leading officials of the governments of the two countries dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of construction. -0-

Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Devotion for People
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- On September 18, 2025 the respected ComradeKim Jong Unguided the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and regional development project on the spot.
Feasting his eyes on the looks of the area undergoing dramatic changes, he expressed satisfaction, saying that the strength of service personnel and young people is really great, and the area of the island, once regarded as barren land due to floods that hit the area every year, turned into a treasure island with very great potentials to effect the radical development of regional economy and the improvement of the material life of the regional people.
The respected Comrade General Secretary stressed that there should not be any slight defect in the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm as it is the largest-ever project organized by the Workers' Party of Korea for the self-supporting and many-sided development of the regional economy and its result is a crucial one directly related to the improvement of the material life of the regional people.
The accompanying officials looked at the respected Comrade General Secretary in reverence, reminding themselves of his day and night devotion for providing the people with the best things.
Keenly realizing the peerlessly great man's noble outlook on the people and devotion for them, the officials got assured once again that the people's laughter would resound louder throughout the country and the bright future to be envied by the world come earlier, thanks to the tender-hearted father who works hard to make the people the happiest in the world. -0-

headline: Historical Mementoes with Birth of First Revolutionary Armed Force of Juche Type
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 24 (KCNA) -- Preserved at the Korean Revolution Museum in the DPRK are significant historical relics dealing with the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, the first revolutionary armed forces of Juche type.
Among them are the historic speech "On the Occasion of Founding the Anti-Japanese People's Guerilla Army" made by PresidentKim Il Sungon April 25, 1932 and the flag of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (the then Anti-Japanese People's Guerrilla Army).
Looking at the historical mementoes, visitors recollect the day when the KPRA was founded.
At the founding ceremony of the KPRA, the President declared that the KPRA, made up of workers, peasants and patriotic youths who opposed the Japanese imperialists and their stooges and loved the country and people, was the revolutionary armed forces that truly protect the interests of the people.
The KPRA, whose mission was to overthrow the colonial rule of the Japanese imperialists in Korea and achieve the independence and social emancipation of the Korean people, won in the battle of Xiaoyingziling, the first one conducted under the leadership of the President, adding shine to the history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary war.
The birth of the KPRA provided the driving force for taking charge of and leading the armed struggle and made it possible to deal a decisive blow to the Japanese imperialists and develop the anti-Japanese national liberation struggle in Korea onto a higher stage.
The historical mementoes tell about the immortal exploits of the President who founded a genuine people's army and accomplished the historic cause of national liberation. -0-

headline: Day of Historic Significance in Building Revolutionary Armed Forces
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) -- The people in the DPRK are significantly celebrating the 94th anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
PresidentKim Il Sungadvanced a line that the armed enemy should be defeated with arms, and founded the KPRA on April 25, 1932 on the basis of the political and military foundation laid for founding a revolutionary armed force.
The birth of the KPRA was a historic event that ushered in a new era of the Juche revolution relying on the powerful revolutionary armed forces. The significance of the event does not merely lie in the fact that the Korean people, who had been subject to miserable fate in the vicissitudes of history, came to have their genuine army and cherish the hope of independence, but rather in the fact that the Korean revolutionaries declared at home and abroad their firm anti-imperialist revolutionary idea to fight against those, who hurt the dignity and sovereignty of the Korean people, to the end by force of arms, and their will to achieve without fail the freedom and liberation of the country and the victory of the revolution with their own strength.
Today's development of our revolutionary armed forces under the leadership of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Unfurther highlights the historic significance of April 25.
Thanks to his military strategic ideology and commanding art, the revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK are demonstrating their reputation and might as the most powerful elite forces, strong in idea and faith, which are carrying forward the sprit of Mt Paektu and the revolutionary traditions of Paektu, and firmly defending the prosperity of the country and the wellbeing and happiness of the people with arms. -0-

headline: Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Forerunners
DPRK Newspapers Mark Founding Anniversary of KPRA
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 25 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK dedicate editorials to the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
The newspapers say the founding of the KPRA was a historic event that ushered in a new era of the Juche revolution depending on a strong revolutionary army, as well as the start of the sacred history of our army.
Succession to the revolutionary cause is not merely a shift in generations but the inheritance of the fighting spirit and souls, immortal and indomitable, Rodong Sinmun notes, and goes on:
The core of the noble spirit peculiar to the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners, who recorded the first page of the history of the arduous Korean revolution, is the spirit of Mt Paektu.
The spirit of Mt Paektu is the strong faith and will, with which they held PresidentKim Il Sungin high esteem as the center of unity and leadership and hewed out the untrodden snowy path in Mt Paektu.
The spirit of Mt Paektu, shining along with the everlasting history of resistance, has added the cornerstone of invincibility and immense strength to the sacred history of the Korean revolution with its inexhaustible traction and undying vitality.
The anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners bequeathed the noble spirit to be eternally cherished by our people and the officers and men of the People's Army. This constitutes the forerunners' undying exploits for the revolution.
The spirit of Mt Paektu, pioneered by the revolutionary forerunners through a protracted hard-fought anti-Japanese war, is being carried forward from one generation after another as the spirit of our country, eternal and unshakable.
When all the people and service personnel of the People's Army more firmly arm themselves with the spirit of Mt Paektu, there are no difficulty insurmountable and no great goals unachievable. This is the unshakable faith of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
When the spirit of Mt Paektu further develops into the all-people thought and feeling, a series of new miracles and innovations will be performed on all fronts of comprehensive national development.
Minju Joson says the eternal prosperity of the DPRK and happiness of posterity lies in preserving and creditably carrying forward the traditions of victory created in the forests of Paektu. -0-

story_text:

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Firing Contest of Mortarmen under KPA Large Combined Units Held to Mark Significant April 25
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- A firing contest of mortarmen of light infantry units under the large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army took place on April 25, the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the firing contest.
Among the spectators were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of the KPA large combined units.
The firing contest was conducted in the way of judging combat methods of the sub-units that are to rapidly conquer the natural and artificial interception lines, maneuver and deploy and destroy different targets within a set time and then hide and get away from the place according to their tactical missions.
Strikingly demonstrated in the contest were the high militant effectiveness and power in the use of mortars by shock troops of the light infantry units at all levels and their full war posture.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the results of the contest.
He extended warm encouragement to the units participating in the mortar firing contest, who significantly commemorated the birthday of the KPRA, an especially significant holiday for our state and revolutionary armed forces, with proud training success for perfecting the combat preparedness, and to the officers and men of the entire army. He highly appreciated that the enthusiasm for effecting a revolution in the training to enhance the combat efficiency is nowadays growing stronger the army units at all levels.
The mortar sub-unit under a combined unit of the 11th Corps of the KPA won the first place in the firing contest.
The 2nd Corps of the KPA came second, the 91st Corps third, the 1st Corps fourth, the 4th Corps fifth and the 5th Corps sixth.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the combat drill should be organized and conducted with the main emphasis on bolstering up in every way the combat capability to completely destroy the enemy by thoroughly embodying the WPK's military strategic idea and all the requirements of the Juche-oriented tactics. And he gave detailed instructions on the development of training contests among units at all levels and among core and sub-units of the entire army in a more intensive and competitive way. -0-

headline: Football Match Held to Celebrate 94th KPRA Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- A football match between the Kalmaegi Team of the Navy and the Jebi Team of the Air Force of the Korean People's Army took place on April 25 on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA), the revolutionary holiday of the Korean people.
Among the spectators were Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other generals, officers and soldiers of the headquarters of the ministry, military and political commanding officers of the large combined units and service personnel of the Navy and the Air Force of the KPA.
The match was so keen all the time because of the competitive spirit of the players of the two teams which took part in the match, staking the honor of their services forming twin pillars of the KPA, and enthusiastic cheering.
The two teams tied 2:2 in the first and second halves of the match and the Kalmaegi Team of the Navy beat the Jebi Team of the Air Force in the 11 meter penalty kick.
A prize-giving ceremony was held amid the applause of the spectators.
Their pleasant and enthusiastic figures displayed in the stadium, adding to the joy of the significant holiday of April 25, clearly demonstrated the militant morale and mettle of the service personnel of the KPA holding the great Supreme Commander in high esteem. -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of KPRA Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The people and service personnel in the DPRK significantly celebrated the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
An endless stream of visitors with deep yearning flew into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
At the Palace plaza, the visitors paid the highest tribute to the great leaders who set an epoch-making example in building the revolutionary armed forces of Juche type.
The people, service personnel and school youth and children visited the statues of the great leaders and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men in different parts of the country to pay floral tribute to them.
Many officials, working people, youth and students made a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu to deeply grasp the steadfast revolutionary spirit of the forerunners who devoted their youth and lives to the sacred war for national liberation while waging the long bloody anti-Japanese struggle.
Working people of different strata visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong to pay high respect to the revolutionary martyrs who created the great traditions of the Korean revolution shining with the history of succession and performed undying feats in the sacred struggle for the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people.
An endless stream of successors flew into the revolutionary battle sites and the revolutionary sites across the country, including the Yonggwang County Revolutionary Battle Site and the Kuksabong Revolutionary Battle Site.
National flags and visual aids were displayed at major places in the capital city and provincial, city and county seats and at institutions, industrial establishments and farms across the country, adding to the festive mood.
Celebration performances were given in the capital city and local areas.
Dancing parties of youth and students and women's union members in different parts of the country revved up the festive atmosphere.
On the same day, public catering establishments in Pyongyang and other parts of the country including Okryu Restaurant and Phyongnam Noodle House, and cultural and leisure facilities such as the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Munsu Water Park were crowded with visitors enjoying a pleasant time. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and chief of the party group of the State Duma, on April 23.
The message said:
On behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, I extend sincere congratulations to you on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of your first visit to Russia and the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk Region from the Bandera forces, the two occasions of weighty importance in the history of the Russia-DPRK relations.
Your state visit to Russia in April 2019 served as a historic event for the two countries and powerfully promoted the development of Russia-DPRK cooperation based on the glorious tradition of friendship and good neighborliness provided in the period of the Soviet Union.
As the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was concluded, our relations have reached to an unprecedented high level and entered a new era.
The terms of the treaty could be perfectly implemented as units of the Korean People's Army were deployed in Kursk Region to liberate it from the neo-Nazi invaders according to your decision.
The successful termination of the Kursk liberation operations demonstrated before the world the durability and invincibility of the militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK.
We would like to express our heartfelt thanks to you and all the Korean people for your help in the liberation of Kursk Region, and we will never forget the heroic feats of the valiant Korean soldiers who shed their bloods and sacrificed their lives for Russia and for our common freedom.
We value the traditional relations of friendship between the two parties very much and will make every effort to steadily strengthen the friendship between Russia and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea for the interests of the peoples of the two countries in the future, too.
I wish you good health and happiness and the fraternal Korean people great success and prosperity.
I pay high tribute to you. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Combined Unit under KPA Mechanized Infantry Division in Western Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The elite combat ranks, who are consolidating in every way their matchless war capabilities in the vanguard of building a powerful army while powerfully demonstrating the noble name of a symbolic unit of the heroic Korean People's Army which has creditably carried forward the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and the tradition of invincibility, greeted the moment of glory to be shined forever in its history.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to a combined unit under the KPA mechanized infantry division in the western area on April 25, the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, and encouraged its officers and men.
The service personnel were full of great excitement and joy to have at their unit the Supreme Commander, whom they have been eager to see even in their dreams in the days of the glorious military service, on the significant day when the DPRK's revolutionary armed forces made the historic first stride with bayonets of self-reliance.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the headquarter of the combined unit, all its officers and men broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" with the highest respect for him, the iron-willed commander who is ushering in a new era of building a rich country with a strong army in which the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered with arms and its steady advance are reliably guaranteed by the strongest military strength.
ComradeKim Jong Unwas greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK including Minister No Kwang Chol and the military and political commanding officers of the KPA mechanized infantry division in the western area and its combined units.
Officers presented fragrant bouquets to ComradeKim Jong Un, reflecting the unanimous reverence of all the service personnel for him.
ComradeKim Jong Unlaid a bouquet at the monument to field guidance of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungstanding in the unit and paid tribute to it.
He visited the revolutionary museum after looking round with deep emotion the monuments to the sacred exploits of the peerlessly great men in leading the army.
He said that the mechanized group with its sacred name and its subordinate units are the glorious ranks organized under the deep trust of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sunghoping that they would take the lead in the vanguard of the whole army in reliably defending the Party and the revolution, the country and the people by carrying forward the brilliant traditions of the anti-Japanese war. The proud history of the anti-Japanese guerrillas who won only victories is reflected in the names of units, he added.
The combined unit is situated in the historic place where the slogan of defending the Party Central Committee unto death was put up first in the entire army and the Red Flag Company Movement started, he said, adding this is the first place where the faith of our revolutionary armed forces to preserve the ideological lineage and carry it forward took roots.
It is our Party's invariable idea of building a powerful army and its outlook on war that making soldiers ideologically elite is a treasured sword for invincibility, he said, stating that the only army strong in ideology, always aware of its linage and root, can resolutely contain and frustrate any formidable enemy.
Stressing that the combined unit, intensively associated with the chronicle of guidance of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungand the great leader ComradeKim Jong Ilover the Party's army, should be a model of the entire army in conducting the political and ideological work for soldiers and perfecting combat preparedness in conformity with its characteristics and position, he clarified the tasks to this end.
ComradeKim Jong Unhad a photo, to be recorded forever in the army-building history, taken with all the officers and men of the brigade significantly greeting the founding anniversary of the KPRA.
On the same day, he watched sports games with the service personnel of the unit.
The service personnel were full of boundless joy, pride and excitement as they significantly spent the happy holiday in the presence of the Supreme Commander.
All those officers and men, who received great affection and the highest honor of having ComradeKim Jong Unat their unit on the significant day when the historic roots of our revolutionary armed forces were taken, pledged to creditably carry forward the sacred mission, ideal and indomitable fighting spirit of the army-founding generation and thus add shine to the KPA's glorious history of victory. -0-

headline: DPRK's Superior Intellectual Property Protection System
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- April 26 is World Intellectual Property Day.
The intrinsic characteristic of the intellectual property protection system of the DPRK is that it gives priority to the interests of the state and the collective, guarantees the interests of the creators and the right holders and promotes the development of science, technology and culture of the country.
Under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, the regular system of guidance on intellectual property has been established in the country and the intellectual property protection system has been strengthened to provide the foundations and environment for promoting science and technology and economic development.
The law on intellectual property was adopted in September 2025 which allows the broad masses of the people to take part in the development and creation of technology, work with knowledge and technology, and contribute to the social progress and development.
Last year alone, hundreds of new technological achievements made in various economic sectors were registered as inventions.
Information activities have been conducted through the national industrial art exhibition, the intellectual property development exhibition, the seminar in the field of intellectual property, etc. to raise the public interest in this work.
Last year, the he WIPO National Inventor Award was conferred on a chief ofKim Il SungUniversity and an official of the Moksong External Construction Economic and Technical Cooperation who developed an intellectual product with an rare-earth element as the main raw material, the WIPO National Creation Award on a teacher ofKim Il SungUniversity who created a full-length novel "Make the Youth Green" and the WIPO National Children Award to a student of Changdok School who invented a science fiction model "Agricultural Robot".
The Korea Oriental Instant Pharmaceutical Company received the WIPO National Business Award as it produced many patent products, medicines and health foods.
The DPRK joined the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) in August 1974. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and chief of the party group of the State Duma, on April 23.
The message said:
On behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, I extend sincere congratulations to you on the occasion of the seventh anniversary of your first visit to Russia and the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk Region from the Bandera forces, the two occasions of weighty importance in the history of the Russia-DPRK relations.
Your state visit to Russia in April 2019 served as a historic event for the two countries and powerfully promoted the development of Russia-DPRK cooperation based on the glorious tradition of friendship and good neighborliness provided in the period of the Soviet Union.
As the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was concluded, our relations have reached to an unprecedented high level and entered a new era.
The terms of the treaty could be perfectly implemented as units of the Korean People's Army were deployed in Kursk Region to liberate it from the neo-Nazi invaders according to your decision.
The successful termination of the Kursk liberation operations demonstrated before the world the durability and invincibility of the militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK.
We would like to express our heartfelt thanks to you and all the Korean people for your help in the liberation of Kursk Region, and we will never forget the heroic feats of the valiant Korean soldiers who shed their bloods and sacrificed their lives for Russia and for our common freedom.
We value the traditional relations of friendship between the two parties very much and will make every effort to steadily strengthen the friendship between Russia and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea for the interests of the peoples of the two countries in the future, too.
I wish you good health and happiness and the fraternal Korean people great success and prosperity.
I pay high tribute to you. -0-

headline: University and College Students in South Hamgyong Province of DPRK Tour Revolutionary Battle Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- University and college students in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK including those of Hamhung University of Chemical Engineering, Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, Hamhung University of Medicine and Hamhung Choe Hui Suk Teachers Training College toured the Yonggwang County Revolutionary Battle Site on the occasion of the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
The revolutionary battle site is associated with the undying feats of PresidentKim Il Sungwho roused up the people to the all-people resistance for national liberation while organizing and guiding the activities of small units, groups and political workers of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army in September 1937.
Looking round the venue of the meeting on Mt Sambat where the President made a historic speech "For a Fresh Upsurge in the Revolutionary Struggle in the Homeland" before political workers from the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and chiefs of underground revolutionary organizations, the university and college students keenly realized that the revolutionary traditions created during the anti-Japanese armed struggle are the strong root of our revolution.
They went round the camping site, spring site, the site of cooking rice, etc. associated with the personality of the revolutionary forerunners who overcame all difficulties with firm faith in the victory of the revolution and optimism, holding the President in high esteem as the centre of unity and leadership.
In front of the trees bearing the slogans preserved with much care, the visitors recalled the strong and noble mental world of the fighters who waged a death-defying struggle with the determination to beat the enemy though one may die a thousand deaths.
They had a meeting for hearing impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas, a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array and a poem-reciting meeting during their tour. At the meetings and the contest they said that the spirit of devotedly defending the leader, ardent patriotism and revolutionary optimism possessed by the revolutionary forerunners serve as the banner of sure victory to be carried forward by the new generations. -0-
