headline: Chairman of Standing Committee of DPRK SPA Meets with Speaker of State Duma of Russian Federation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- There was a meeting between Jo Yong Won, chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, at the Kumsusan State Guesthouse on April 25.
Present at the meeting were Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned, leading members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation and Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here.
Jo Yong Won said that the dispatch of a high-level delegation to the inaugural ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations by the leadership of the Russian Federation is a manifestation of sincere support and reverence of all the Russian people for the Korean people who are recollecting in humble reverence the shining lives of the war martyrs of the overseas military operations units and praying for their immortality, expressing the stand to boost the bilateral relations true to the noble intention of the top leaders of the two countries.
Vyacheslav Volodin expressed his sincere thanks to ComradeKim Jong Unand all the Korean people who rendered support to expel the Ukrainian neo-Nazi occupiers from Kursk Region, stressing that Russia will never forget the feats of the DPRK's heroic officers and soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the operations for liberating Kursk Region.
The meeting exchanged the issues arising in further boosting the exchange and cooperation between the parliaments of the two countries and opinions on mutual concerns and reaffirmed the will of both sides to thoroughly implement the agreements reached at the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit.
The DPRK Supreme People's Assembly hosted a reception in welcome of the official delegation of the Russian Federation at the Kumsusan State Guesthouse that evening. -0-

headline: Official Delegation of Russian Federation Arrives
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- An official delegation of the Russian Federation led by Speaker of the State Duma Vyacheslav Volodin arrived here on April 25 at the invitation of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly and the Ministry of National Defence to attend an inaugural ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
The national flags of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation were fluttering at the flagstaffs of Pyongyang International Airport and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the apron of the Terminal.
Jo Yong Won, chairman of the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly, warmly greeted Vyacheslav Volodin.
The delegation was greeted by Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here, and staff members of the embassy. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of the significant April 25, the whole country is paying respects to the first generation of the revolution who handed down the precious ideological and spiritual treasures that will never be changed to the descendants of this land.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, Ri Hi Yong and Sin Yong Il, secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK, and other officials of the Party, government and military, and officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet and the armed forces organs visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on April 25.
Bereaved children of the anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs and anti-Japanese patriotic martyrs, and the teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools also visited the cemetery.
All the participants paid silent tribute to the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred cause of national liberation and the people's happiness.
Then the participants looked round the cemetery.
The participants laid flowers before the busts of the martyrs and paid high tribute to them, solemnly recollecting the undying feats of the revolutionary forerunners, who created the heroic history of struggle against the imperialist tyranny with self-reliance by holding in high esteem PresidentKim Il Sungas the centre of unity and leadership and laid a foundation of building a rich country with a strong army by creating the ever-victorious precious tradition. -0-

Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- An official delegation of the Russian Federation led by Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, on a visit the DPRK to attend the inaugural ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on April 25.

headline: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and Participants in Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the participants in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations received a letter from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation.
The letter is as follows:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
Dear friends,
I extend my heartfelt greetings to you on the occasion of the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations in Pyongyang.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
On the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk land from the aggressors, I express my deep thanks to you and to all the comrades who made a contribution to carrying out this large-scale plan in the shortest possible time.
The militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK has a glorious history.
At the end of World War II, the Soviet Army, together with the Korean patriots, provided assistance to freeing your country from Japan's colonial rule and to defending the independence of the DPRK in the fight against foreign aggressors in the 1950s.
Today, when the enemies occupied some parts of Kursk, Pyongyang helped us resolutely without hesitation.
The Korean soldiers, fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Russian comrades-in-arms, displayed their extraordinary bravery and genuine devotion and glorified themselves with immortal honor.
Their unrivalled feats will remain forever in the hearts of all Russian citizens.
This museum, which is being inaugurated with splendor today, has a mission to convey long the Korean People's Army soldiers' heroism and their sacrifices to the common victory.
This museum will undoubtedly be a clear symbol of the friendship and solidarity between the peoples of our two countries.
I am convinced that we will continue to strengthen the comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the DPRK by joint efforts.
I would like to express my sincere thanks to the brave Korean soldiers who participated in the operations to liberate Kursk Region, and pay tribute to the memory of the heroes who devoted their lives. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Officers and combatants of the overseas operations units of the Korean People’s Army, who are here by accomplishing a sacred mission and earning invaluable honour,
Officers and soldiers of the People's Army,
Bereaved family members of the martyrs,
Citizens of Pyongyang,
Soldier-builders, officials and creative workers, who have wonderfully completed this important and responsible construction project,
Members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation on a visit to Pyongyang to share this significant moment with us, as well as dear friends,
Comrades,
Today we are holding the ceremony of inaugurating the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations that will tell forever the heroic feats and ennobling spirit of the proud sons of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, who sacrificed their precious lives in the sacred battles for justice and dignity.
Our motherland has built a monument in the capital city, which the combatants so dearly cherished in their hearts and always respected, to honour their precious lives and soul, and is greeting the moment of embracing them.
Everyone of this country has waited for this day.
As the bereaved family members, seeing here from a stone's throw away, have waited for the day when their beloved ones would be embraced, the comrades-in-arms of the martyrs, all the officers and soldiers of our army and all the people of our country have longed to see the place where they will lay flowers to wish for the martyrs' immortality, appreciating with infinite ennobling feelings the heroic and precious features of our army they did not fully realize in the past.
Thanks to this ardent wish and sincerity, this museum, where the martyrs will live forever as true and proud sons of their country, has been built.
Thus has been achieved my wish to bring back all our officers and soldiers, who dedicated their precious lives too early, cover their bodies in the national flag and bury them in their motherland, the wish of other officers and soldiers of our army, as their comrades-in-arms who performed military service with them while braving the hail of bullets and gunfire, to pay their warm respect to them and the wish of all other people, as citizens of this country, to offer gratitude and honour to their defenders.
On behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I extend heartfelt thanks to the officers and soldiers of the construction units of the army at all levels and officials and creative workers of the relevant units, who have devoted unsparing efforts and wisdom for the construction of this museum in reflection of the earnest wish of all the people of the country and the officers and soldiers of the entire army to add lustre to the precious lives of the martyrs for all eternity.
I offer my thanks to the dear comrades of the delegation of the Russian Federation who are here with the feelings of warm tribute and solemn obligation from the people of the fraternal country.
Comrades,
Today marks the first anniversary of the end of the operations for liberating Kursk.
The soldiers of Korea and Russia, who are faithful to the ideal of justice, fought in the same trench shoulder to shoulder to defend peace and national sovereignty, and achieved a result decisive in checking the resurrection of fascism and frustrating the hegemonic forces' ambition for a war.
The operations were military activities conducted in one region in a few months, but the strategic significance of the result is very great.
Justice and injustice have always co-existed in the whole history of mankind, and the confrontation between them has been acute all the time. But there has been no such a situation as that of today in which the forces of domination and tyranny attempt to destroy the desire for national sovereignty and freedom, after they emerged brazenly on this planet as the most shameless and aggressive ultra-rightist reactionary alliance, discarding any sleazy mask or veneer.
In the rigorous and crucial years when the undoubted demand of a country and a nation for its rights to political self-determination and development and the implementation of its obligations have become the target of tyranny, the armies of the DPRK and Russia demonstrated the strength of justice through their bloody struggle, fully aware of the noblest duties they have assumed for their countries and mankind.
The soldiers of the two countries have clearly proved that there does exist in the world a tremendous might capable of overturning the society of evils created by imperialism, by dint of the hearts afire with justice and death-defying strength, and that the tyranny of injustice can never conquer mankind.
In the course of this, the fine sons of the two countries have set examples of true friendship and dedicated their precious blood for the common aim.
There will be neither more sacred contribution nor more correct expression of obligation than sacrificing one's life.
In the sacred war to wipe out the Ukrainian armed invaders who blatantly violated the sovereignty and security of the Russian Federation, our fraternal country, and liberate the Kursk region, the overseas operations units of our Korean People's Army won the priceless victory by displaying matchless bravery, mass heroism, indomitable fighting spirit and noble self-sacrificing spirit.
Thanks to the valiant struggle of the Korean People's Army that repulsed and wiped out the aggressors, shoulder to shoulder with the Russian army, the hegemonic attempt and military adventure pursued by the United States and the West were frustrated.
Standing before us are the war heroes, who should line up here most honourably, with the national flag of dignity and glory in their hands, full of indomitable soul and faith which did not burn even in the flames.
Now everyone knows full well for what they dedicated their youth on the alien battlefields.
But it is scarcely known how each of them fell in what circumstances, for what they wished at the last moment of their lives and what requests they left.
To our remorse, we could not portray every detail of their last moments here.
Probably there will be no museum in the world which can exhibit such loftiness, purity and beauty without regret.
Our soldiers who had been inconspicuous, plain and simple in ordinary days demonstrated their merits most clearly in battles.
The powerful resistance and undaunted offensive they persevered with against all odds and to their death, their trait of not giving up executing the orders till the last moment of their lives, their matchless self-sacrificing spirit of bravely facing death and their heroic choice at the moment of life and death - all these were so unprecedented and legendary that they struck us with wonder before striking the world with wonder and that even the wartime generation would admire.
Every one of those ennobling sacrifices became a valuable stepping stone in the hard-fought battles for our army to hasten the day of liberation.
The symbolic monument at this museum is not a portrayal of a specific martyr; it represents the soldiers of the Korean People's Army, every one of whom is brave, and all the martyrs, who are heroes epitomizing the spirit and mettle of Koreans.
The world of a hero does not find expression in any distinguished feat alone, and heroic behaviour does not come out of any spontaneous impulse.
The fierce battles in the Kursk region were an extension and part of the service by our army for the Party, the revolution, the homeland and the people.
Their deaths were also a moment of the service.
They were all loyalists, patriots and genuine men no matter where they were killed and how.
They must have never imagined they might leave their country even once. They must have taken arms pledging to become a handful of dirt of their homeland when they had to die. However, they unhesitatingly went to the battle sites in a foreign country where their bodies could not be retrieved if they were killed. And when crossing the border they hardened their resolve to execute the orders at the cost of their lives, far from thinking about their native homes, parents, wives and children that became far away. This is too lofty to explain merely with the soldiers' sense of obligation.
As the photos and relics on display here in this museum show, none of them, though they were in an alien country, forgot the Party nor lived separated from the embrace of their homeland even for a moment.
The national flag they would look up to with a solemn feeling before charge while praying for the safety and prosperity of Pyongyang and swearing to defend the homeland, the pouch of soil from the homeland each of them kept in his chest as a reminder of its warmth, the letters they wrote requesting to believe that they would remain honourable before their homeland which had given life to them, as well as before their parents, wives and children, even though they could not return home alive, the letters of pledge that they would implement the orders at the cost of their lives and the blood-stained letters they wrote applying for admittance to the Workers' Party of Korea - these tell many stories about their praiseworthy choices and heroic deaths.
As they could not live separated from their country and they were inseparably bound with it in destiny, they did not expect any compensation, though they performed distinguished feats, nor any reward for their self-sacrifice through self-blasting.
They left only the request for carrying out the order given by the Party, as they fell in action shedding blood, and prayed only for their country's prosperity shouting "Long live Pyongyang!" as they died a heroic death.
What desire, if any, they had was to remain remembered by the Party and the country and, even if they failed to be remembered, they had no greater pride and happiness, if they could feel the self-satisfaction that they accomplished their combat missions given by the Party and the pride that they dedicated their all to the motherland.
Their final moments lasted for some minutes or some seconds, but that brief moment clearly highlighted their pure loyalty to the Party and the country and their maxim of true service.
The self-sacrifice expecting no compensation and the devotion expecting no reward - this will be the definition of the height of loyalty of our army.
Such pure-hearted loyalty comprises the root of extraordinary heroism, the sacred oath, the will to punish the enemy and the personality of the strong who regard even death as their honour.
As they were so loyal to the Party and the country, they could have the undying courage and the strength of charge far surpassing the law of human physiology, opt for their last that the world still fails to understand and display the scenes of laying down their lives for their comrades-in-arms.
The overseas military operations of our army were unheard-of activities conducted by the service personnel who upheld the order of the Party and the country not only according to the military discipline and morals of obedience and execution but also with their voluntary conscience and moral rights, the most sincere and beautiful men who burned their hearts with pure, strong loyalty and overcame the extreme limits with its infinite viability.
There was neither distinction between arms, duties, ages and military ranks nor difference between Party members and youth league members in their spiritual strength and feats.
The participants in the military operations lived in the world of heroes before becoming heroes after death and in the noble spiritual world of Party members before becoming Party members.
Not only the heroes who unhesitatingly opted for self-blasting, suicide attack, in order to defend the great honour, but also those who fell in the vanguard of charges and those who writhed in frustration at the failure to fulfil their duties as soldiers who were given orders, rather than in pain in their bodies torn by bullets and shells, cannot but be called the soldiers faithful to the Party, patriots.
It is said that for soldiers in battlefields, nothing is more honourable than feats and victories, but what is more sublime and valuable is the pure conscience dedicated to their Party and country and firm faith in them.
Our combatants knew that after they fell in action, their dead bodies might be left at the mercy of the wind blowing through the snow-covered forests in the alien land. However, they sacrificed their lives as they believed that their greatest honour was to contribute to implementing the orders and add to the prestige of their great country. If one tries to measure such an ideological feeling, both pure and beautiful, only with the yardstick of certain exploits, one will be underrating so many admirable soldiers' true feelings of love, tears and priceless sacrifices.
They are sons of our Party and our country, who, though fighting at the other end of the earth, could identify the roots of their lives only with such feelings of love and loyalty.
That is why we honour such intense loyalty to the Party and the country and the noble sacrificing spirit stemming from the loyalty - rather than any outstanding military exploits or feats - as symbols of our army's fighting efficiency and our country's heroism.
The memorial wall in this museum can be called an emblem of immortality for the martyrs who, though dead and gone, will live forever as shining examples for their fellow countrymen.
Glorifying the imperishable lives of the martyrs and their unchangeable soul, the stars on the memorial wall shine brightly day and night, and they will teach people the truth of immortality and help them understand the position and significance of this museum.
This museum is a colossal fortress in which the souls of these loyalists and their hearts burning with patriotism rest, as the whole world can see.
As a decoration dedicated to this land by our admirable sons, such a museum could not be set up even at a cost of millions of tons of gold.
As time passes, this museum will continue to bring the heroes closer to all the coming generations of our Republic, and our army's successors will warmly embrace the combatants, adding one page after another to the history of patriotism and loyalty lest their sacrifices be brought to naught.
The country supported by patriotic and loyal defenders will remain powerful and great for all ages.
Today's inauguration ceremony will be recorded in a page of history as a sacred event that has injected absolute immutability into our state's inviolable dignity and prestige.
Comrades,
In this museum we have recorded a new chapter in the history of DPRK-Russia friendship that was written in blood, the history of justice that was achieved at the cost of blood.
This symbolizes the steadfastness of succession and our will.
Our future is certain.
In order to defend national sovereignty and interests in the current rapidly-changing times, we should keep turning into a formidable rival to the enemy and we should unite and grow stronger to become formidable.
As I have mentioned on several occasions, we should develop ours into a genuine, devoted and powerful stronghold, always coping in united efforts with any crises irrespective of the time and place of their occurrence and of any change in the rules of war.
Peoples of the two countries aspiring after independence, dignity, peace and prosperity are desirous of this, and the history of fidelity and unity written in blood indicates this.
As that immortal group sculpture of the soldiers of the two countries shows, the times expect us to be always ready, to be able to devote ourselves and to be resolute like them.
In front of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations born with our history of resolution, history of justice and obligation, we get firmer in our determination towards the future.
Comrades,
Our army will continue to fight bravely for the dignity and honour of its motherland, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Along with the history of defence we are writing with the sacred sense of mission and fortitude, this museum will shine in the world and the martyrs will live forever in the brilliant rays.
Sincerely hoping that the precious lives of our people's proud sons, great soldiers, will shine forever, I declare the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations open. -0-

Speeches were made at the parties.
The speakers offered deep condolences to the bereaved families of the KPA martyrs in the special military operations who dedicated their precious and noble lives to defending the inviolable dignity and honor of our state with courage.
They noted that ComradeKim Jong Unhas made great painstaking efforts to glorify forever the lofty soul and valuable feats of the martyrs who unhesitatingly dedicated their youth and precious lives to the mightiness and rosy future of our country and to ease the pains of their bereaved families.
They said that the life of the heroes came to shine long as the stars of the country under the loving care of the great father who kept all the martyrs, who created a true example of the heroic spirit of our era, in his heart rather than the ground and made indefatigable efforts to build an immortal memorial museum and erect an unheard-of wall of immortality with stars reflecting the expression of eyes and looks of the martyrs who had been pure and brave till their last moments.
The martyrs will always be together in our struggle and life, teaching the truth of genuine life and invincibility, the speakers said, adding that the everlasting military feats they performed at the cost of their blood and lives, shouting hurrah for the leader, the country and Pyongyang, and the loyalty and noble self-sacrificing spirit they fully displayed under the combat gunfire, would serve as an eternal nutrient for our people, service personnel and posterity to redouble their patriotic enthusiasm and indomitable mental power.
They hoped that all the bereaved families of the martyrs would lead a happy and worthwhile life under the special care of the Party and the government and the respect of all the people across.
All the bereaved families made a firm determination to devote themselves to the prosperity of the beloved country so earnestly desired by the martyrs, cherishing deep in mind the warm love and benevolence of ComradeKim Jong Unwho glorifies the life and feats of the martyrs at the peak of perpetuity. -0-

headline: Russian State Commendation to Servicepersons of KPA Overseas Operations Units
story_text:

Attending it were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and officials of the Ministry of National Defence, together with those involved in the overseas military operations.
Andrei Beloussov conferred the Order of Bravery on commanding officers and combatants of the overseas operations units and made a speech.
He paid tribute to the genuine heroes of the present era, the pride of the Korean armed forces, commending the Korean servicepersons who remain boundlessly loyal to their country and made a great contribution to the liberation of Kursk, upon authorization by President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
He said that the Korean servicepersons are always ready to become an impregnable wall against any threat with bravery and courage, adding that they are carrying forward the glorious tradition and valiance of their legendary ancestors.
He stressed that the state commendation is not merely for praising the professionalism of servicepersons but for praising the noble spirit they displayed in the fiercest battles and wakeful nights to carry out their duties and save their comrades-in-arms by withstanding severe mental and physical pressure and dedicating their lives.
He expressed deep thanks in the name of all the Russian people, saying that the bravery and resolute will of the servicepersons of the Korean People's Army made a great contribution to achieving common successes.
Andrei Beloussov conveyed to No Kwang Chol the state commendation and the presidential decree of the Russian Federation for the martyrs who performed heroic feats in the battles of liberating Kursk Region.
No Kwang Chol expressed thanks to the Russian government for highly appreciating the combat feats of the KPA servicepersons involved in overseas military operations. -0-

headline: Memorial Concert Given for War Martyrs at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- A memorial concert "Stars of the Motherland" for the war martyrs, excellent sons of the glorious Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was held outside the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, built as a monumental edifice in the great era, on Sunday evening.
The venue of the concert, where a group sculpture of heroic soldiers involved in the special military operations of the Korean People's Army is standing imposingly to show the political and ideological mightiness peculiar to our army, was wrapped in an atmosphere of mourning the heroic soldiers cherished deep in the hearts of the country and the people as eternal stars.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the memorial concert, together with leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officers and men of the overseas operations units, bereaved families of the martyrs and other participants in the inauguration ceremony.
Present there were Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense, and other members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation and staff members of the Russian embassy here.
Put on the stage of the concert, which began with orchestral music "Morning Star" and narrative poem "Immortality", were hymns full of deep respect for and recollection of the warriors involved in the overseas military operations and famous songs on patriotism.
The performers paid the highest tribute to the proud sons, combat heroes in the era ofKim Jong Unwho created the immortal myth of strong army at the cost of their lives by demonstrating to the full the excellence and bravery of the DPRK and its people through their indomitable heroic struggle in the overseas special military operations, true to the order of the country, and returned to the motherland they longed for even in their dreams.
Watching the numbers showing the days and months of life-and-death bloody battles filled with obligation and decisive battle, blood and tears and indignation and revenge, and pathetic scenes of death-defying hand-to-hand fights and heroic suicidal explosions the young soldiers chose without hesitation, the audience keenly felt with painful resentment and grim resolution what a dear price the soldiers have paid for the dignity of the strong and immortal fame.
The audience were deeply moved by the emotional scenes showing the lights from the window of the Party Central Committee that never went down, wishing for the safety of the soldiers in the alien battlefield, and the world of parental love and agony of the great father who repressed hard the great pain of loss upon receiving every sad news and wrapped them in the sacred national flag to glorify their precious lives shining like stars though they fell down, to epically prove how the Koreans and the Korean People's Army are strong and ever-victorious.
The audience enthusiastically sang with the performers "Eternal Reverence" and "Only Victory" and other famous songs that arouse the strong will to cherish the immutable truth of patriotic loyalty and immortality, taught by the shining names, images and heroic lives that will never be mossed with time, and build without fail a thriving country, the world's most powerful country desired by the martyrs.
Also put on the stage were Russian famous songs.
The memorial night was heated by the bitter sorrow and heartache being jointly overcome on the road for justice and peace and the militant friendship and peculiar feelings that have laid foundations for the eternal development of the DPRK-Russia friendship.
The concert ended with the playing of national anthems of the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
Air echelons of the KPA Air Force flew over Saeppyol Street, setting off fireworks in reverence for the representatives of the precious honor of the country.
The memorial concert wishing that the passionate pulse and spirit of the great heroic soldiers, who defended the dignity and honor of the motherland at cost of their lives, embodying the DPRK's absolute strength and symbolizing its people's mightiness and justice, would be eternal as the breath of the DPRK and its army and people, had deep resonances for the audience. -0-

headline: DPRK's Best Scientists and Technicians for 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- Prof. and Dr. Sin Kyong Il, dean of the hydraulic engineering faculty of Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering, is one of the DPRK's best scientists and technicians for 2025.
He perfected in our own way the three-dimensional calculation method, which had been a knotty problem in scientifically and accurately assessing the safety of concrete gravitational dams for many years.
The calculation method made it possible to raise the national disaster-prevention capability and put the operation of hydro-power stations on a scientific basis to produce more electricity. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and Participants in Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the participants in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations received a letter from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation.
The letter is as follows:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
Dear friends,
I extend my heartfelt greetings to you on the occasion of the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations in Pyongyang.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
On the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk land from the aggressors, I express my deep thanks to you and to all the comrades who made a contribution to carrying out this large-scale plan in the shortest possible time.
The militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK has a glorious history.
At the end of World War II, the Soviet Army, together with the Korean patriots, provided assistance to freeing your country from Japan's colonial rule and to defending the independence of the DPRK in the fight against foreign aggressors in the 1950s.
Today, when the enemies occupied some parts of Kursk, Pyongyang helped us resolutely without hesitation.
The Korean soldiers, fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Russian comrades-in-arms, displayed their extraordinary bravery and genuine devotion and glorified themselves with immortal honor.
Their unrivalled feats will remain forever in the hearts of all Russian citizens.
This museum, which is being inaugurated with splendor today, has a mission to convey long the Korean People's Army soldiers' heroism and their sacrifices to the common victory.
This museum will undoubtedly be a clear symbol of the friendship and solidarity between the peoples of our two countries.
I am convinced that we will continue to strengthen the comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the DPRK by joint efforts.
I would like to express my sincere thanks to the brave Korean soldiers who participated in the operations to liberate Kursk Region, and pay tribute to the memory of the heroes who devoted their lives. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations Solemnly Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The magnificent memorial museum of combat feats was erected in the best place of the capital city to praise the great heroic spirit of the brave Korean People's Army soldiers involved in overseas military operations who created the legend of miraculous victory unprecedented in history with ardent patriotism and loyalty to defend the sacred prestige and dignity of the DPRK.
The immortal edifice, which will convey forever the ideological and moral superiority, popular heroism and unrivalled bravery peculiar to the KPA displayed in the special military operations to liberate Kursk Region of the fraternal Russian Federation with the sacred mission and duty, is a symbol of the most righteous people and the strongest army of the DPRK and a great monument giving eternal vitality to the development of the DPRK-Russia relations forged and being consolidated at the cost of blood.
ComradeKim Jong Unhas put on the highest place of glory the excellent sons of the country who performed immortal exploits before the times and history and the generations to come with their noble sacrifices and heroic military feats. He energetically led the whole construction course of the memorial museum from its design and construction work to the arrangement of contents of combat feats and the creation of symbolic memorials so that the names and images of the war martyrs can shine forever as a group of eternal stars.
The monumental edifice, which shows the traces of life in battlefields and remarkable military achievements, made by the officers and soldiers of KPA overseas operation units, and their passionate pulsation and noble soul through the highest architecture and careful artistic portrayal, is associated with the boundless sincerity, reverence and noble moral obligation of our Party and government and our people and service personnel for the brave war soldiers, and it represents the heroism of our times and the invincibility of our cause.
An inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations was solemnly held on April 26, the first anniversary of the conclusion of the operations to liberate Kursk of the Russian Federation.
Pervading the ceremony venue were deep respect for and remembrance of the heroic war soldiers who had been unfailingly faithful to the orders of the country and dedicated their lives without hesitation to the dignity and honor of our great state.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
Present there were Jo Yong Won, Jo Chun Ryong, No Kwang Chol, and other senior Party, government and military officials, commanders of the KPA large combined units, officers and men of the overseas operations units and engineering unit, the bereaved families of the war martyrs, leading officials of the ministries and national agencies, the soldier-builders and creators who contributed to the construction of the museum, students of revolutionary schools, youth and students and citizens of Pyongyang.
Attending the ceremony were also Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense, and other members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation and staff members of the Russian embassy here.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the inauguration ceremony, all the participants broke into cheers of emotion, looking up to him, the peerlessly illustrious commander and great father who has trained the KPA into a politico-ideologically strong army without parallel in the world and into an invincible revolutionary army winning every battle and puts the lives of the heroic soldiers on the highest place of immortality with his noblest love and obligation.
ComradeKim Jong Unmet brigade and battalion commanders of the overseas military operations units who participated in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
He gave warm militant encouragement to all the commanding officers of the overseas operations units who fully demonstrated the outstanding fighting spirit and bravery peculiar to the KPA through skillful combat command and made contributions to glorifying the mightiness and inviolable authority of our state.
Looking up to ComradeKim Jong Unembracing every one of the reliable commanding officers who advanced through the fierce gunfire in the van and giving warm paternal affection, the participants extended enthusiastic applauses.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the DPRK were played.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a significant speech in commemoration of the inauguration.
Expressing his deep emotion to have the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations erected by the wish of all the KPA service personnel and the ardent desire and sincerity of the people across the country, he extended heartfelt thanks on behalf of the Party and the government to the officers and men of the construction units at all levels, officials of the relevant organs and creators who devoted their all efforts and wisdom to the construction of the museum.
He referred to the strategic significance of the operations for liberating Kursk, in which the armies of the DPRK and Russia faithful to the ideal of justice fought shoulder to shoulder in the same trench for peace and sovereignty, and to the unrivalled bravery, mass heroism, indomitable fighting spirit and noble sacrifice displayed by the DPRK people's excellent sons in the bloody battles to set a model of the militant fraternity.
He said that the overseas military operations of the KPA were the ones without parallel in history as they were conducted by the servicepersons who implemented the orders of the Party and the country with their own conscience and moral rights, the most sincere and beautiful persons who burned their hearts with pure loyalty and went beyond the limits with their infinite vitality, adding that today's inauguration ceremony will be recorded in the history as the one that gave absolute immutability to the dignity and reputation of our state.
He affirmed that the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations will shine all over the world and the martyrs be immortal in its bright rays, along with the biographies of defense written with the sacred sense of mission and toughness. Then he declared the inauguration of the museum, sincerely wishing that the precious life of the great servicepersons would shine forever.
All the participants kept in mind with great emotion that the noble spirit and mettle of the martyrs would be immortal enjoying the respect of rising generations thanks to the benevolent care of the great leader ensuring that the images and names of the martyrs, who dedicated their lives to the sacred war of justice, are etched in golden letters on the immortal monument.
Then, Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, read out a letter from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to the participants in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
In the letter, President Putin extended congratulations on the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations in Pyongyang on the occasion of the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk and expressed his sincere gratitude and high respect to those involved in the Kursk liberation operations and the fallen heroes, saying that the unprecedented feats the KPA service personnel performed by displaying their outstanding bravery and genuine spirit of self-sacrifice while fighting shoulder to shoulder with their Russian comrades-in-arms, will remain forever in the hearts of all the Russian citizens.
Minister of National Defence of the DPRK No Kwang Chol and Russian Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov cut the inauguration tape.
A large number of white balloons flew up, reflecting the noble reverence for the heroic sacrifices and great exploits of the excellent sons of the DPRK people.
A ceremony of burying the remains of the war martyrs in the overseas military operations was solemnly held.
No Kwang Chol said that our precious officers and soldiers, whom we neither wanted to send nor lose, finally came to the warm embrace of the motherland they had so longed for and wanted to return even at their last moments, adding that their precious desire and faith as well as their undying feats will be preserved forever by the unanimous will and steadfast struggle of all the service personnel and people.
ComradeKim Jong Uncovered with earth the remains of martyr Kim Son Chol, hardly repressing his pain of loss and regret of not being able to bring back to life the genuine patriots and brave and passionate revolutionaries who sacrificed themselves unhesitatingly upon the call of the country.
Guards of honor of the KPA covered the remains of the martyrs with earth, praying for the souls of the great sons of the DPRK people and for immortality of the most genuine soldiers and the most genuine human beings.
ComradeKim Jong Unrecollected with reverence the last heroic moments of the brave soldiers who devoted their precious lives to the dignity and honor of the great motherland.
Amid the playing of music "Song about the Country", the historic moments passed to convey the world of noble love and obligation of the great father who, as the heaven of destiny embracing the stars of loyalty, gives the everlasting pulse of life to the martyrs who failed to return and takes care of the destiny and future of their kinsmen.
The bereaved families were in tears of emotion, looking up to ComradeKim Jong Unwho is grieving over the young heroes, who wished nothing but only the prosperity of the country and dedicated their lives, even though he provided the house of immortality pulsating with their souls and breath that cannot be mossed with time, beside the homes of the bereaved families who have just started to lead a happy life amid the respect and blessing of all the people.
ComradeKim Jong Unonce again paid warm tribute to the bereaved families who are regarding the noble life and glorious death of their beloved sons and husbands as proud and honorable and strongly overcoming the grief over the loss of the most precious persons.
A volley of rifles was fired, in reflection of the noble respect for the brave soldiers who showed through their admirable patriotic deeds how the KPA soldiers should live for the Party and the country and what they should leave before the country and brought invincibility of the heroic Korea to a higher level.
A wreath in the name of ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid at the Monument to the Korean People's Army Martyrs in the Special Military Operations.
Wreaths were laid in the name of the speaker of the State Duma and the minister of Defense of the Russian Federation.
And placed were wreaths in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK and the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the DPRK Cabinet, the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and the three services of the KPA.
All the participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the war martyrs, the proud sons of the DPRK people who created a new history of great victory and indomitable heroic feats, to be immortal, for the country and the revolution and all the generations to come in the sacred war for defending justice, dignity and peace.
ComradeKim Jong Unwent round the museum together with major members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation, and senior party, government and military officials.
He laid a flower before the memorial wall where the war martyrs, who demonstrated the great appellation of the strong and the glory of victors with their loyalty to the Party and the country, ardent patriotism and popular heroism peculiar to the KPA, are shining as immortal stars, and paid high tribute to them.
Also laid there were flowers presented by members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation, senior party, government and military officials, the bereaved families of the martyrs and other participants in the ceremony.
ComradeKim Jong Unlooked round with deep emotion the photos and exhibits showing the boundless loyalty to the order of the country, ardent patriotism and the indomitable mettle with which they greeted even death as glory to defend the honor of the strong, which all the generations of the DPRK should keep forever and carry forward.
He visited rooms where the remains are enshrined and laid a flower before them.
He affirmed that the dignified figures standing in the front ranks of the KPA can not be seen again, but the soul and spirit of the martyrs, the defenders of the precious honor of the country, will serve as the symbol of the heroic spirit of the DPRK people and the banner of the mightiness of our army and powerfully encourage the victorious advance of the peoples of the two countries struggling for the common cause of independence and justice.
He went to the room of visitor's book and wrote:"The soul of the martyrs will be eternal along with the great honor they defended although their lives are buried with the earth with which they fought in their bosoms.
I would like to present 'the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations', the platform of honor, to the proud sons, officers and soldiers of this country.
Kim Jong Un
2026. 4.26"
Speaker of the State Duma Vyacheslav Volodin and Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov of the Russian Federation made entries in the visitor's book.
ComradeKim Jong Unwent round the exhibition hall of captured arms at the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats.
He expressed belief that the museum wishing for immortality of the war martyrs, who defended the dignity and safety of the fraternal peoples at the cost of their precious blood, proved the militant friendship between the DPRK and Russia and the solid fraternal relations of alliance between the two peoples and raised the dignity, honor and pride and glory of our generation to be admired by the coming generations, would shine forever as the house of national treasure of Juche Korea and the monument to the great alliance embodying the strong will and power of the two peoples aspiring after justice and peace.
Looking round the sanctuary of education in patriotism associated with the feats of the heroes who made a dash in response to the orders of the country and resounded with the echo of their beautiful life left by them at the last moments, all the participants hardened their firm will to build a prosperous state and the most powerful country in the world the martyrs desired so ardently, always remembering their noble soul and ambition.
The burning soul of the war martyrs will be immortal with the prestige and eternal prosperity of the DPRK, to be strong for all ages, along with the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations symbolizing the greatness of the DPRK people and bearing witness to the era ofKim Jong Un, the most heroic era of the DPRK. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Speaker of State Duma of Russian Federation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Sunday met Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, on a visit to the DPRK to attend the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
He warmly greeted Vyacheslav Volodin and had a friendly talk.
Volodin courteously conveyed the best congratulations and wishes from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for it and asked Volodin to convey his warm greetings to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
Warmly welcoming the visit of the official delegation of the Russian Federation to the DPRK, he highly appreciated that it is an expression of the stand and will of the Russian leadership to attach importance to and consolidate the relations of alliance between the two countries that Comrade President Putin sent a high-level delegation led by Vyacheslav Volodin to the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
It was a historic event proving the mightiness and firmness of the DPRK-Russia alliance that the armies and peoples of the two countries fought shoulder to shoulder and won a victory in the operations for liberating Kursk, he noted, adding that the current visit of the Russian official delegation would be an important occasion in boosting the feelings of friendship and unity between the peoples of the two countries to a new high level.
Vyacheslav Volodin said that it is his honor to take part in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations today and express his heartfelt thanks once again to the DPRK soldiers, who died in the sacred struggle to liberate the Russian territory from the Ukrainian Nazi forces, and their bereaved families. And he stressed that the Russian people would always remember the feats of the DPRK people and soldiers who provided fraternal assistance to liberating Kursk.
The talk reaffirmed the will to develop the DPRK-Russia relations in a comprehensive way in line with the spirit of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership and thus promote the national interests of the two countries and the wellbeing of the two peoples.
The talk proceeded in a warm and trustworthy atmosphere. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un and Participants in Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unand the participants in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations received a letter from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation.
The letter is as follows:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
Dear friends,
I extend my heartfelt greetings to you on the occasion of the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations in Pyongyang.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
On the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk land from the aggressors, I express my deep thanks to you and to all the comrades who made a contribution to carrying out this large-scale plan in the shortest possible time.
The militant friendship between Russia and the DPRK has a glorious history.
At the end of World War II, the Soviet Army, together with the Korean patriots, provided assistance to freeing your country from Japan's colonial rule and to defending the independence of the DPRK in the fight against foreign aggressors in the 1950s.
Today, when the enemies occupied some parts of Kursk, Pyongyang helped us resolutely without hesitation.
The Korean soldiers, fighting shoulder to shoulder with the Russian comrades-in-arms, displayed their extraordinary bravery and genuine devotion and glorified themselves with immortal honor.
Their unrivalled feats will remain forever in the hearts of all Russian citizens.
This museum, which is being inaugurated with splendor today, has a mission to convey long the Korean People's Army soldiers' heroism and their sacrifices to the common victory.
This museum will undoubtedly be a clear symbol of the friendship and solidarity between the peoples of our two countries.
I am convinced that we will continue to strengthen the comprehensive strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the DPRK by joint efforts.
I would like to express my sincere thanks to the brave Korean soldiers who participated in the operations to liberate Kursk Region, and pay tribute to the memory of the heroes who devoted their lives. -0-

headline: Crucial Decision Made on Rubber Boat
story_text:
In July 2024, some areas of the DPRK's North Phyongan Province were hit by floods.
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, together with officials, went to the spot on a rubber boat to learn about the damage of flood-hit areas.
The rubber boat carrying the General Secretary slowly cleaved flooded areas.
Unlike rivers and seas, the flooded area could be a dangerous rock area where it was unable to figure out the flow, direction and depth of water. The accompanying officials were not aware of what thinking was kept in the mind of him looking silently at the view of flooded areas.
On the rubber boat, the General Secretary made a crucial decision to clean up everything in the flooded areas and build wonderful new houses and erect a strong embankment like a fortress so as to provide the inhabitants in flood-hit areas with better living conditions.
That day, he went round the flooded areas on the rubber boat for nearly two hours.
After all, the island area in North Phyongan Province, which was damaged by natural calamities, has turned into an ideal farm city in the new era, thanks to the crucial decision made by the General Secretary on the rubber boat. -0-

headline: Research Findings Conducive to Economic Development Made in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 28 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, scientific research units in the DPRK have made achievements conducive to the economic development and the improvement of people's living.
Scientists of the Ferrous Metal Research Institute under the State Academy of Sciences developed a new material production technology for increasing the serviceable life of coal wagon wheels and pumps.
Those of the Sunchon Mining Engineering Institute of the Academy of Coal Mining Science proved the scientific accuracy and efficiency of a new blasting method combined with drilling speed accelerator and efficient cross-detonating method and introduced it in an expanded way to contribute to increasing the coal production. They also raised the efficiency of the drainage system of coal mine by manufacturing and introducing a substantial packing.
Those of the May 28 Metal Research Institute of the Ministry of Metal Industry invented a technology to produce firebricks with a longer serviceable life.

There are young people in all countries but there is no country as powerful as ours where the congress of youths is held with splendor under the special care and solicitude of the Party, the state and the people and the sky-high spirit and enthusiasm of the youths are fully displayed as the inexhaustible strength of the country, the article says, and goes on:

The dignity of a powerful state is not given by anyone, but must be defended and glorified by the efforts of its people. The state, where a large contingent of righteous and brave young people are standing in the forefront for defending its interests and enhancing its prestige, will demonstrate its might as an eternal bulwark of dignity.
It is the desire of life and purification of patriotism of the youths in our times to devote their precious youth and beautiful hopes without hesitation for the high dignity and honor of the country, their destiny and eternal future.
Now, our reliable and presentable young people are defending this land as the impregnable fortress with arms in their hands at every trench of the country's defence line
The DPRK will remain impregnable forever as the large contingent of defenders are spending their precious youth life with arms for the dignity and prosperity of our great state and finding honor and pride in it.
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who bears responsibility for the present and future of the Party and the revolution, the country and the people, has trained the young people into a reliable vanguard for national prosperity with the steadfast revolutionary spirit and extraordinary creativity through the gigantic practical process embracing all fields of struggle for transformation in the new era. This is the great feat that can be performed only by the respected General Secretary.
Only the immortal glory and bright future are in store for the Korean youths who are dynamically advancing straight forward under the leadership of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 28 (KCNA) -- Emperor Kojong of Korea was murdered by poison in January 1919. This case is a historical proof of the brutality and viciousness of the Japanese imperialists who mercilessly killed anyone against their colonial rule.
At that time, anxious about the ever-increasing moves of the Japanese imperialists to invade Korea, Emperor Kojong resolutely rejected their demand for the conclusion of the "Ulsa Five-point Treaty" and later refused all the forcible demands aimed at seizing the sovereign rights.
When the Japanese imperialists illegally cooked up the "treaty", Kojong maintained his anti-Japanese stand through secret diplomatic activities to neutralize it.
At last, the Japanese imperialists formed a cabinet with pro-Japanese traitors to reduce the power of the emperor. With the Hague emissary case as an occasion, they plotted to dethrone and kill Kojong.
After forcibly dethroning Kojong by applying persistent pressure and trickeries, they cruelly poisoned him. In order to cover their atrocities, they took those who had examined the body of the emperor into custody and assassinated even the waiting maids who had witnessed his death.
The "Second Declaration of Independence", published by the Korean "provisional government" in China in 1921, says that Kojong's eyes were blood-colored and his whole body was marked with many red spots after he died.
Ten-odd years ago, a diary of the then director of the auditing bureau at Japan's royal office in 1919 was made public at an international academic conference. The diary disclosed the fact that Terauchi, the first governor-general in Korea, ordered the commander of the Japanese army in Korea to poison Emperor Kojong who refused to recognize the "Ulsa Five-point Treaty".
As seen above, the case was a heinous state-sponsored terrorist act committed by the Japanese imperialists in an organized and planned way. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Law of DPRK on Nursing and Upbringing of Children Marked
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- 50 years have passed since the Law of the DPRK on the Nursing and Upbringing of Children was adopted on April 29, 1976.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unset it as the most important policy and the greatest desire of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state to bring up the children, the future of the country, well and ensure better conditions for rearing them, and devoted his all to its realization.
He initiated the construction of a modern children's hospital in the Munsu area on the bank of the River Taedong, led it to be completed at the highest level and named the hospital "Okryu Children's Hospital".
Thanks to his loving care, wonderful baby homes and orphanages were built in different parts of the country, including the Pyongyang Baby Home and Orphanage, and model kindergartens such as the Kyongsang Kindergarten were erected.
Even in those days when the emergency anti-epidemic crisis was created unexpectedly, transportation of milk and rice powder for babies by vehicles was not suspended in every part of the country.
The contents and methods of pre-school education have been improved and strengthened in keeping with the requirements of bringing about a radical improvement in education in the new century and the trend of the development of the world's education, and all the kindergartens across the country have been turned into excellent educational institutions, institutions of nursing and upbringing children and cradles of happiness.
The new childcare policy of supplying dairy products and other nutritious foods to the children across the country at the state expense reflects the Party's intention to provide them with the most wonderful and best things.
The happy songs of the children are resounding far and wide under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho takes great pleasure in hearing the bright laughter of the children. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- Upon hearing news of the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, an endless stream of people visits the sacred land in reverence for the martyrs. The museum is devoted to the heroic feats and noble spirit performed and displayed by the brave fighters of the Korean People's Army who fought in the sacred war for justice and dignity on the order of the motherland.
From early morning to late night every day many officials, working people, service personnel of the People's Army, school youth and children are visiting the monumental museum, imposingly built under the warm loving care of the great father who has placed on the peak of glory the feats of the war martyrs who unhesitatingly dedicated their lives to demonstrating the dignity of their sacred country and the invincibility of the Korean People's Army to the world.
The visitors pay high tribute to the Monument to the Korean People's Army Martyrs in the Special Military Operations, which vividly reflects the heroism of the fighters involved in the overseas military operations, who added glory to the greatness of the strong and the victors by displaying loyalty to the Party and the country, fervent patriotism and popular heroism, and the spirit and mettle of the Korean people.
They lay flowers at the Memorial Wall and the graves of the heroic martyrs as tokens of their grateful thanks, respect and prayers of immortality to the martyrs. The Memorial Wall is sparkling with the stars of loyalty and patriotism peculiar to the martyrs, who taught everyone what life lives forever in high esteem and memory of the country and the people by dedicating their blood and lives to safeguarding the dignity and honour.
In all parts of the museum the visitors keenly feel the warm loving care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand his noble sense of obligation. He made sure that the museum was built as an edifice of immortality, never to be found in other parts of the world, highly praising the proud sons of the country, who sacrificed their beautiful ideals and youth, as the greatest heroes representing the national honour.
Looking at the photos, relics and materials dealing with their exploits, displayed at the museum, the visitors imagine the last moments of the heroes who laid down their lives hoping for the prosperity of the country, the proud sons of the country who brought about great miracles and victory with their noble spirit and phoenix-like bravery.
They are moved to see the flags of the DPRK, blood-stained letters of pledge and letters of application for Party membership kept by the martyrs in their hearts, the letters to beloved parents and wives and children left by them. They eloquently tell about the origin of the worthwhile life and indomitable strength of the heroic soldiers who dedicated their lives to saving their honour under the baptism of fire.
The images of the dedicated soldiers so brave on the hard-fought battlefields silently dwelt in their individual photos on display but it seems that the cries they let out at their last moments throwing themselves into the enemy pillboxes and committing suicide with their last bullets and grenades still resound as an echo of eternal life, moving all the visitors, young or old, to tears.
The visitors feel great emotion surging inside them, seeing the undying pictures showing what the heroes wished and desired at their last moments and realizing how they laid down their lives to save their sacred honour as soldiers of the Korean People's Army, turning their love for their beloved parents, wives and children into their hardened will to annihilate the enemy.
Going around the outdoor captured weaponry exhibition area, they recollect with great pride the feats of the warriors who demonstrated the ideological and spiritual superiority and invincible mettle of the Korean People's Army by inflicting merciless death on the aggressors on alien battlefields by dint of Korean-style tactics.
All the visitors are full of the strong enthusiasm to give full play to their loyalty and patriotism in the sacred struggle to glorify the most heroic era of their country, the great era ofKim Jong Un, cherishing the noble souls and desire of the martyrs. -0-

headline: Demand for Processed Chestnuts of Songchon County Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- Chestnut-based products of the Songchon County Foodstuff Factory were popular during the National Foodstuff Exhibition-2026.
The factory produces seven kinds of products with Songchon chestnut, the local specialty.
The Songchon chestnut, which has long been famous, contain carbohydrate, protein, fiber, calcium and other minerals and vitamins A and B.
The processed chestnut products are popular among the people as they are tasty and good for the health.
At last year's exhibitions, too, those products were highly appreciated. In particular, chestnuts preserved in honey and chestnut jam have been registered as February 2 goods.
This year, too, the factory set a goal of further increasing the quality and productivity of finished chestnut products, and solved the technical problems arising in chestnut storage to provide a guarantee for producing those products in every season.
Now that the demand for the chestnut products has risen, the factory has increased the output and made proactive efforts to develop new kinds of chestnut products. As a result, the factory produces various finished chestnut products as the local specialties.
It is the Workers' Party of Korea's policy that cities and counties develop and make maximum use of the economic resources and potential peculiar to them. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Enjoys Concert Marking 80th Founding Anniversary of Central Military Band of Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed a concert commemorating the 80th founding anniversary of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence on April 28.
Since it made its debut in the opening ceremony of the Pyongyang Institute, founded as a base for training military and political cadres of the country after the liberation of Korea, the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence has made proud achievements in the history of development of the heroic Korean People's Army, upholding the Party and the country and powerfully encouraging the whole army to victory with the revolutionary military music pulsating with the spirit of the times and the strong army.
Among the audience were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officials of the WPK Central Committee, officials of ministries and national agencies and institutions and enterprises in Pyongyang, creators and artistes of military and civilian art troupes and service personnel.
The concert began with the solemn playing of the national anthem of the DPRK. Its performers played the stirring melodies of the revolutionary military music filled with the militant spirit to powerfully demonstrate the course of development of the heroic KPA, which has defended the vigorous advance of the ever-victorious Juche revolution under the leadership of the WPK and reliably guaranteed the invincibility and mightiness of our state.
The concert was acclaimed by the audience as it impressively showed the deep ideological and moral world and the will of loyalty of the service personnel to add eternal luster to the honor of the KPA, which has always been faithful to the orders of the country and the sacred appellation the army of the Party and the people and won legendary victories and created tales of miracles.
ComradeKim Jong Uncongratulated the performers on their successful performance, praising them for giving an excellent concert pulsating with the revolutionary character and militant spirit of our army.
He said that the shining history of the KPA is clearly associated with the feats of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence as it has displayed the tremendous might incomparable with any military hardware, encouraging the brave and heroic army with the revolutionary military music decade after decade. He added that he has always paid respect to the military band as a group of soldiers representing the revolutionary army, not as an art troupe.
ComradeKim Jong Unhighly appreciated that the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence is the face of our state and symbol of the KPA, saying that wherever the military music resounded, there were the stirring scenes of those displaying matchless courage and bringing about the epoch-making changes.
He said that the creators and players of the military band should have boundless loyalty to the Party, the country and the people and high artistic ability and encourage the advance of the KPA with their revolutionary military music. And he had a photo session with all the creators, players and officials, expressing belief that the Central Military Band would always remain faithful to its most honorable mission.
The members of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence extended boundless gratitude to ComradeKim Jong Unwho is giving great trust and warm blessings, glorifying the band's honorable 80-year history of following the Party, and made a firm determination to usher in a new heyday of development of the revolutionary military music, powerfully encouraging the vigorous historic advance of the army and people of the DPRK for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK with thunderous military music. -0-

headline: DPRK's Best Scientists and Technicians for 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- Hong Song Sik, director of an institute of the Academy of Poultry Science, was selected as one of the DPRK's best scientists and technicians for 2025.
True to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to provide our people with much more meat and eggs, he bred a new breed of battery hen and another new breed much better than the existing one at laying eggs and resisting disease.
He also bred "Pyongyang Chicken No. 1" of good taste and made a contribution to establishing a system of preserving and improving purebred chicken and to developing the ways of raising the chicken. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- Personages of different countries and regional bodies paid congratulatory visits to the DPRK missions in relevant countries on the occasion of the 114th birth anniversary of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Personages of organizations and institutions in China, including the Association for International Friendly Contact, a branch of the China Institute of Strategy and Management and the Beijing Chao Ya International Cultural Exchange Center laid flower baskets and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland bowed to them.

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Farms
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 30 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of farms in South Phyongan Province and North and South Hwanghae provinces.
He learned in detail about the growth of winter wheat and barley, and discussed measures for minimizing the drought damage at farms in Mundok, Phyongwon and Sukchon counties of South Phyongan Province and Sinchon, Thaethan, Ongjin, Paechon, Kangryong and Pyoksong counties of South Hwanghae Province and Phyongsan, Singye and Suan counties of North Hwanghae Province.
He called upon officials and agricultural workers to draw up workable plans and unyieldingly carry them out, bearing in mind that only when this year's severe drought is surmounted, can the guarantee be provided to reap a good harvest of crops including the first crops.
He also called for finding all the water resources and making effective use of them and reinforcing and perfecting the irrigation systems and, at the same time, mobilizing all the watering means and equipment, including motors, sprinklers and small water pumps. And he underlined the need to actively introduce scientific farming methods, including spraying  various kinds of nutrient adjuvants and growth regulators as required by technical regulations, so as to ensure the safe growth of crops.
Learning in detail about the preparations for rice farming, the premier referred to the issue of steadily expanding the areas under rice seedling cultivation, the issue of decisively increasing the proportion of mechanization in rice-transplanting and the issue of pushing ahead with various farm works according to foresighted plans.
Earlier, the premier visited the fifth stage-construction site in the Hwasong area to discuss the issue of correctly carrying out the projects according to schedules on the principle of giving priority to improving quality and the issue of making the relevant sectors and units provide equipment and materials needed for the construction in time, and took the relevant measures. -0-
