headline: DPRK's Best Scientists and Technicians for 2025
Ranks of Medical Workers Reinforced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, April 30 (KCNA) -- The public health sector of the DPRK directs efforts to strengthening the ranks of medical workers both in quality and quantity, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Measures are being taken to improve the level of clinical technology and academic qualifications of medical workers at city and county hospitals.
The mobile treatment and education team was formed with medical workers of rich clinical experience and high qualifications from the Korea General Red Cross Hospital, Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital, Kim Man Yu Hospital and other central-level hospitals. It now works at the Kangdong County Hospital, Kusong City Hospital and Ryonggang County Hospital.
The members of the team are directing efforts to the guidance and assistance for putting the management of hospitals on a more regular and standardized basis while intensifying the practical education for improving the clinical skills of local medical workers.
Passing-on technique is under way for medical workers of the new city and county hospitals to be built this year.
The Pyongyang General Hospital, Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital and other central-level hospitals started the first technical workshop for at least 250 medical workers of city and county hospitals in March.
Medical workers of the central-level hospitals are conducting field medical service in major theaters of the national economy and, at the same time, focusing on technical lectures to improve the academic qualifications and clinical practice ability of medical workers in relevant areas.
Efforts are being made to reform the medical education system and improve the practical educational conditions of students so as to train competent and promising health professionals on a large scale. -0-

headline: Event Held at DPRK Embassy in Moscow
story_text:

Present at the event were personages of Russia's parliament, government, political parties and organizations, including the Federal Assembly, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the General People's Union Party, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the Association for the Study of the Juche Idea, and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and staff members of his embassy.
The participants laid bouquets at the photo dealing with the revolutionary activities of General SecretaryKim Jong Unand paid tribute.
They also looked at the photos showing the historic DPRK-Russia summit meetings.
Speeches were made at the event. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, April 30 (KCNA) -- Various kinds of high-quality products produced by modern regional-industry factories in mountainous counties of the DPRK are spreading across the country, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Unsan County Foodstuff Factory presented pine-nut products at several exhibitions held in Pyongyang last year, being widely known to the people across the country including citizens in the capital city. Public demands for processed pine-nut products such as pine-nut candy and cake are now on the steady increase across the country.
The Unsan County Daily Necessities Factory is increasing the production of liquid soap, shampoo, rinse, detergent and various kinds of plastic goods to meet the growing public demand.
The special products in Usi County such as wild grape jam, pear jam and apricot jam, too, are popular among the people.
The Usi County Daily Necessities Factory produces sponge cucumber soaps, registered as February 2 goods, and various kinds of quality plastic tubes which are popular in adjacent areas.
The Tongsin County Foodstuff Factory developed a mulberry-based beverage with unique taste and color, and the demand for it continues to grow.
Pumpkin seed oil, a new product developed at the Kim Hyong Jik County Foodstuff Factory, has become the best souvenir for visitors to the region as it is very good for human health. -0-

headline: Working People in DPRK Lead Worthwhile Life
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 1 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people significantly greet May Day, the international holiday of the working people the world over.
All of them are now striving to repay the warm loving care and benevolence of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who has provided the working people with a genuine life and high glory.
Regarding the working people as the most precious beings, General SecretaryKim Jong Unhas put them on the stage of glory and happiness with all sorts of love and affection.
He had photo sessions with labor innovators and meritorious persons striving for the country, invited them to significant celebration banquets and put them forward as owners of the deluxe houses in Kyongru-dong. Under his warm care, ordinary working people are leading a dignified life as excellent, heroic and great people.
Thanks to his loving care, an ideal street for the people has been built every year and working people have enjoyed socialist civilization to their heart's content at workers' hostels, palaces for the workers, and at the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort, Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area, Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp and other cultural resorts.
The life and happiness of the Korean people will grow better and higher day by day under the leadership of the respected General Secretary guiding them to fully demonstrate their dignity and might as the working people of Juche Korea. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 1 (KCNA) -- The Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League was held in Pyongyang from April 28 to 30.
The congress reviewed in a comprehensive way the work done by the youth league during the period under review, and discussed practical tasks and ways for channeling the great strength of the large contingent of young people into the implementation of the fighting programme of the Workers' Party of Korea to further cement it as the powerful driving force for the overall prosperity and development of socialism.
Attending it were delegates elected by youth league organizations at all levels.
Present as observers were officials of the Party and armed forces organs, ministries, national agencies and the field of education of youths and children.
The platform was taken by Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Ju Chang Il, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Kim Song Gi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army, executive members of the C.C., SPYL, chairpersons of the provincial youth league committees, exemplary youth league officials and members, officials in charge of youth work in the field of the armed forces and service personnel.
The congress elected the presidium and the secretariat.
The agenda items discussed at the congress are as follows:
1. Review of the Work of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League
2. On the Revision of the SPYL Rules
3. Election of the Central Leadership of the SPYL
Kim Jae Ryong read out a congratulatory letter of the WPK Central Committee to the participants in the Eleventh Congress of the SPYL and all other youths across the country.
Mun Chol, chairman of the SPYL Central Committee, made a report on the first agenda item.
The reporter noted that the DPRK young people have grown up to be creators and performers of feats and vanguard fighters of the revolution in the struggle to pioneer a new era of comprehensive national prosperity, flying high the sacred flag of the youth league.
He also briefed about the valuable successes achieved in the course of directing the work of the youth league to training all the young people as the patriotic youth who staunchly defend socialism and devote themselves to the struggle for socialist construction.
He referred to the wise leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho set it as a matter of great importance for the steady development of our cause to prepare our young people as the reliable driving force of socialist construction and energetically led the work.
The reporter highlighted the great heroic feats performed by young servicepersons in the forefronts of defending the country, revolution and people and in major theaters of socialist construction at the cost of their blood, lives and sweat over the past five years, true to the orders and instructions of the Party.
The young servicepersons, who regard the Party's order as their absolute mission and unconditionally realize the Party's desire, fully displayed their honor as reliable revolutionary soldiers and hardcore youth not only in defending the country's existence and the people's health from the global health crisis but also in the gigantic creation campaigns such as accomplishing the historic cause of regional transformation and building 50 000 flats in Pyongyang Municipality, he said.
He reviewed the achievements made in ideologically educating young people and enhancing the activity of the youth league organizations during the period under review.
Stating that the youth league organizations will steadily develop only when they thoroughly overcome the shortcomings and deviations in line with the requirements of the times while consolidating the successes and experience, the reporter comprehensively analyzed and reviewed the shortcomings revealed in the work of the youth league in the period under review and their causes and the ways for overcoming them on the basis of the data on the actual states of the youth league organizations at all levels.
The reporter ardently called upon all to courageously advance, redoubling the firm faith and will for the eternal dignity and glory of the DPRK and for the brilliant hope of youth and bright future as befitting the young vanguard in the great era ofKim Jong Un.
Speeches were made on the first agenda item.
Introduced in the speeches were excellent experiences gained in educating and training young people into reliable revolutionary soldiers and hardcore youth of the WPK, regarding the ideas and leadership of the Party Central Committee as the lifeline, and in training them to be honorable pioneers of socialist construction and those ready to make practical contribution to the country by conducting the  organization and guidance over the youth league organizational and ideological life in close combination with the implementation of the revolutionary tasks.
The speakers expressed their resolve to bring about a new innovation in the youth league work, strictly analyzing the shortcomings and causes in the work of the youth league during the period under review.
The congress discussed the second agenda item "On the Revision of the SPYL Rules".
There was a report on the revision of the rules of the youth league.
The reporter summarized the contents of the rules to be amended and supplemented in conformity with the new tasks facing the youth league and the principles of building the youth league.
Noting that the rules of the youth league to be revised reflected the practical requirements for developing the youth league into elite militant reserves of the WPK and enhancing its organizing ability, unity and activity, the reporter submitted it for deliberation at the congress.
A decision on the revision of the rules of the youth league was adopted with full approval.
The congress discussed the "Election of the Central Leadership of the SPYL" as the third agenda item.
First, the Central Committee of the youth league was elected.
All the candidates for the members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league were elected members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league with the unanimous approval of the delegates.
The First Plenary Meeting of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League was held.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made public the decision of the First Plenary Meeting.
The executive committee of the SPYL Central Committee was elected.
Paek Un Chol was elected chairman of the Central Committee of the youth league and Kim Ju Hyok, Pak Myong Jin, Wang Chol U, Kim Song Il, Ri Myong Hyok and Kim Song Il were elected vice-chairmen.
The Organizing Committee of the SPYL Central Committee was formed.
The chairperson, vice-chairpersons and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the youth league were elected.
Department directors of the SPYL Central Committee were appointed.
The congress elected a committee for drafting the decision of the congress with members of the newly elected eleventh-term central leadership of the youth league, and the committee deliberated the creative and constructive opinions raised by the delegates and supplemented the draft decision.
The decision of the Eleventh Congress of the youth league was adopted with the unanimous approval of the delegates.
A letter of pledge to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas adopted amid all the delegates' enthusiasm for single-minded loyalty.
The congress ended with the chorus "We Will Defend GeneralKim Jong Unwith Our Lives". -0-

headline: Evening Gala and Torchlight Procession of Youth and Students Held to Mark Eleventh SPYL Congress
Eleventh Congress of Socialist Patriotic Youth League Held
Congratulatory Letter of C.C., WPK to Eleventh Congress of SPYL
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 1 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory letter to the participants in the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and all other youths across the country on April 28.
The letter said that through its eleventh congress, the youth league, the ranks of successors loyal to the leadership of our Party, is going to review its proud course of implementing the Party's line and policies for the past five years and make a new milestone in its struggle and advance aimed to carry out the decisions of the Ninth WPK Congress.
The past five years, when new miracles and bold innovations were brought about under the leadership of the Party Central Committee to glorify the immortal appellation patriotic youth, were worthwhile and glorious years that witnessed an unprecedented heyday in the 80-year-long history of the youth league under the leadership of the Party, the letter said, and went on:
The young people have always taken an active part and played a courageous role in implementing the most important and difficult tasks of the struggle for historic transformation organized and waged by our Party, and the flag of the youth league was fluttering in the gigantic sites pulsating with the spirit of leaping forward to build monumental edifices of the times.
The young service personnel displayed the revolutionary spirit of executing the order of the Party and the extraordinary creative traits in the course of their honorable service to firmly defend the state's sovereignty and peace and increase the people's wealth and the sound of their laughter. It serves as a great force giving full play to the ideological and moral power and fighting capacity of the people and young people across the country.
In particular, the young soldiers involved in the overseas military operations became bombs and flames for annihilating enemies to defend the honor of the country, clearly demonstrated to the whole world the heroism and indomitable mettle of the Korean youth who grew up under the care of the Party, and put the mass heroism of our people onto a new level.
The fervent patriotic spirit and mettle of the youth, who are demonstrating the mightiness and dignity of our state and injecting boundless vitality into the struggle for its overall prosperity, have been fully manifested in the grand political and cultural festivals and the revolutionary mass movement promoting the economic construction and the improvement of the people's standard of living and in displaying communist traits helping and leading one another forward in difficult times and magnificently flying the flag of the DPRK in the international arena.
The young people in the new era have linked their precious youthful days to the cause of the Party and the state, registered on their personal accounts of youth their strenuous efforts for loyalty and patriotism and performed feats and created praiseworthy episodes to pen them in the written application for their accession to the Party. Their worthwhile struggle is recorded as a new page in the history of the youth movement alongside the honorable Order ofKim Jong Ilshining on the flag of the youth league.
Now that our Party and revolution are making the first start for implementing a new task of struggle, the Party's expectation of the youth and youth league organizations across the country is very great, the letter stressed and continued:
The present era requires the youth league to invariably demonstrate its reputation as the vanguard of patriotism in the historic advance to lead the successes that opened up an era of a new upsurge for national development to a greater result.
The main task facing the youth league at present is to concentrate efforts on steadily giving fuller play to the revolutionary spirit and patriotic enthusiasm of the young people so that the organizations and members of the league at all levels can play active role in the van of carrying out the new Five-Year Plan, thus making the next five years an era of more powerfully vitalizing the Korean youth movement.
The youth league should make all its efforts to educate and train all the young people as ardent patriots who set it as their lifelong aim to realize the Party's ideal and find the worth and happiness of youth in attaining it.
It should inspire the youths to keep in their hearts the strong and pure spirit of the young people of the preceding generation, who laid the foundations for national prosperity with valuable feats in their youthful days and of the war martyrs of the overseas operations units who devoted their youth to the implementation of the order of the Party and the country, thus preparing all the young people in our era to unanimously desire to lead the same patriotic and heroic life as they did.
Always mindful of the developing reality and the changes in consciousness of the new generations, the youth league organizations should make positive improvements in the forms and methods of education in conformity with the features of youth education that require freshness, flexibility, diversity and concreteness so as to make education on every occasion serve as real political work that touches the heartstrings of youths.
All the members of the youth league should devote their youth to implementing the decisions of the Party Congress with the ambition and will to become the masters of the worthwhile and stirring era, thus opening up a road of charge and performing feats that excite the whole country.
The spiritual and moral growth of young people is one of the important goals our Party intends to attain in the struggle of a new stage for building a powerful socialist country.
The youth league should steadily give full play to the ideological, spiritual and moral superiority of the Korean youth by placing the moral training of young people high on its agenda and intensifying education and control to make its members possess a correct outlook on morality.
The steel-like fighting efficiency of the youth league is part of our national power, and only when the youth league intensifies the organizational life, is it possible to guarantee it and remain faithful to the historic mission.
It is needed to establish a voluntary way of observing discipline in the youth league and ceaselessly improve the method of guidance so that its organizational life can be a good process of growth enabling its members to understand the value and might of collective and consolidate their revolutionary outlook on life.
The youth league should concentrate its guidance on enhancing the role of the Korean Children's Union organizations in conformity with the actual conditions in which its ranks have expanded, so as to prepare all the KCU members across the country to become reliable future pillars who love the country and value their organizations and collective.
The surging ideological and moral spirit and vigorous role of the ranks of youths aware of their solemn mission are an important guarantee for pure-heartedly giving continuity to our Party's metabolism, our state's affair to hand down its spirit to posterity without fail despite the change of generations.
In letter the WPK Central Committee expressed firm belief that the SPYL would more powerfully demonstrate its dignity and fighting efficiency as a youth organization of the Party, with the congress as a watershed, and creditably discharge the sacred duty assigned by the country, revolution, era and history in the struggle for a new phase of transformation. -0-

headline: Regional-industry Factories in Unchon County Focus on Increasing Variety and Improving Quality of Products
Papers Observe International Holiday of Working People
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 1 (KCNA) -- Leading newspapers of the DPRK Friday dedicate editorials to the 136th May Day, the international holiday of working people the world over.
Rodong Sinmun says that May Day is a significant holiday powerfully demonstrating the revolutionary spirit of the Korean working people who have made epoch-making miracles and changes through their unyielding struggle under the leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea despite all sorts of trials.
Today our working people are devoting their wisdom and enthusiasm to the prosperity of the country, cherishing deep in their mind the benevolence of the Party and the state amid the daily-increasing benefits of socialism, the paper says and goes on:
Our working people are faithful persons who can read the grand plan of the Party Central Committee in our Party's ideas and lines, and they are the indomitable strong ready to do any huge task unconditionally, if it is determined by the Party.
The Juche weaponry carrying the absolute strength of the DPRK and the proud creations symbolizing the era of overall transformation are associated with the boundless loyalty of our working people, and the pure patriotism of our working class and agricultural workers is also reflected in the independent development foundations of the national economy and the rapid growth of agricultural production.
As such loyal and patriotic working people, who have always been a great force and support to our Party, have upheld the cause of the Party, a new trend of overall development could be pioneered and a firm guarantee provided for leaping forward to a higher stage.
As there are the working people upholding the Party and the state with their precious sweat and passion while sharing the destiny with the country, our Party is so strong and Korean-style socialism is always emerging victorious.
Minju Joson says that the great history of miracles and changes will be given steady continuity, thanks to the working people of Juche Korea who are contributing to the national prosperity with boundless enthusiasm and devoted efforts, upholding the respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the helm of the revolution. -0-

headline: Many Trees Planted in Spring
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 1 (KCNA) -- Spring tree planting is brisk in different parts of the DPRK.
The Ministry of Land and Environment Protection examined the plans of cities and counties for planting trees in spring and has directed efforts to creating timber, oil-bearing and paper-based forests for regional-industry factories.
The Forest Guidance Bureau under the ministry and the forestry sector across the country worked out daily and weekly plans to suit the characteristics of different regions and species of trees, and have pushed ahead with the forest restoration in a scientific and long-term way.
Provinces urged the cities and counties to choose in detail the areas for afforestation and select species of trees suited to the climate and soil conditions in the relevant areas and, on this basis, have made sure that the work by process is carried out in accordance with technical regulations and the planting of trees is conducted in a qualitative way.
As a result, more than 100 millions of trees have been planted throughout the country since the start of the spring tree planting. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Congratulations from Different Countries
story_text:

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Congratulate Working People on May Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 2 (KCNA) -- The whole country is overflowing with joy and optimism of greeting the international holiday of working people all over the world.
Senior Party and government officials visited factories and enterprises across the country on May 1 to significantly mark the May Day together with working people.
Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials and officials of the Party and power organs at all levels visited the Sangwon Cement Complex, the Chollima Steel Complex, the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex, the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex, the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex, the Pyongyang Construction Commission, the State Academy of Sciences, etc. to congratulate the working people on their holiday.
They met and encouraged the innovators who are raising a hot wind of creating new standards and records at worksites.
They requested the innovators to continue to glorify the honor of being models and pioneers of the collective in the future, too.
Senior Party and government officials watched sports and amusement games together with working people. -0-

headline: May Day Celebrated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 2 (KCNA) -- All the people across the country significantly celebrated the May Day.
Streets and villages in Pyongyang and provinces, cities and counties, industrial establishments and farms were filled with joy and optimism of the workers, farmers, intellectuals and other patriotic working people enoying colorful sports and amusement games.
At the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the masses solemnly recalled the sacred life of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, who built a socialist state where the people are the masters and glorified the dignity and honor of the working masses at the highest level.
Officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren visited the statues of the great leaders on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country and mosaics depicting the peerlessly great men and laid flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before paying tribute to them.
At the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, the visitors looked round photos of the martyrs and relics and materials showing their feats.
Officials of the Party and power organs across the country significantly celebrated the May Day together with working people.
They congratulated the working class on making innovative successes day by day by devoting their sincere sweat and efforts to successfully carrying out the first-year tasks for the new Five-Year Plan set forth by the Party.
Colorful performances were given at theatres and outdoor stages in the capital city and other parts of the country, adding to the joy of the holiday.
Public catering establishments in Pyongyang and local areas gave diverse services to the working people, and cultural recreation grounds including the Central Zoo and the Natural History Museum were crowded with people enjoying the holiday. -0-

headline: House of Happiness Full of Children's Laughter
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 2 (KCNA) -- On the shore of Songdowon, a scenic spot in the East Sea of Korea, there is a camp for schoolchildren.
The Songdowon International Children's Camp, where modern campers' dwellings are in harmony with the beautiful beach scenery, has all the things conducive to making the schoolchildren acquire rich knowledge, noble moral traits and strong physical strength.
At the aquarium for rare marine animals and the flower greenhouse, the campers are experiencing a fascinating sea world and rich natural scenery and acquiring wide knowledge.
There are also the mirror house, video-game room, 4D simulation cinema, indoor gymnasium and cooking practice room.
During the winter camping, campers can ski at the Masikryong Ski Resort.
The camp is associated with the loving care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho spares nothing for the rising generations.
The respected fatherly Marshal repeatedly visited the camp under reconstruction and gave detailed guidance so that all its structures and facilities were built into another precious asset to be handed down to the posterity.
On May 2, 2014, he attended the inauguration ceremony of the camp and wished a happy future of the younger generation and spent all day for schoolchildren, watching a football game of the boy footballers.
Children's camping began again on the occasion of the auspicious April holiday, in the wake of the first camping in winter this year. Children's laughter and songs of happiness are heard at the camp all the year round. -0-

headline: Activities of Mobile Treatment and Education Teams Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 2 (KCNA) -- Mobile treatment and education teams, formed with medical workers of central-level hospitals, are active at the local hospitals newly built last year, according to Minju Joson.
The Ministry of Public Health made sure that competent medical workers from Kim Man Yu Hospital, Pyongyang University of Medicine Hospital and Okryu Children's Hospital were involved in the teams. The ministry also worked out detailed plans for the teams to do work such as helping medical workers of the local hospitals handle modern medical equipment skillfully and improve professional qualifications and abilities and put the medical activities and management at hospitals on a more regular and standardized basis.
At the Kangdong County Hospital, members of the team are orienting technical lectures and practical training at relevant departments to raising the clinical and technical level of medical workers and helping effectively manage and operate the comprehensive information system of medical activities and management established at the hospital.
At the Kusong City Hospital, those of the team are conducting technical lectures and practice in a methodological way to instruct various roentgen image interpretation methods.

headline: House of Happiness Full of Children's Laughter
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 2 (KCNA) -- On the shore of Songdowon, a scenic spot in the East Sea of Korea, there is a camp for schoolchildren.
The Songdowon International Children's Camp, where modern campers' dwellings are in harmony with the beautiful beach scenery, has all the things conducive to making the schoolchildren acquire rich knowledge, noble moral traits and strong physical strength.
At the aquarium for rare marine animals and the flower greenhouse, the campers are experiencing a fascinating sea world and rich natural scenery and acquiring wide knowledge.
There are also the mirror house, video-game room, 4D simulation cinema, indoor gymnasium and cooking practice room.
During the winter camping, campers can ski at the Masikryong Ski Resort.
The camp is associated with the loving care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho spares nothing for the rising generations.
The respected fatherly Marshal repeatedly visited the camp under reconstruction and gave detailed guidance so that all its structures and facilities were built into another precious asset to be handed down to the posterity.
On May 2, 2014, he attended the inauguration ceremony of the camp and wished a happy future of the younger generation and spent all day for schoolchildren, watching a football game of the boy footballers.
Children's camping began again on the occasion of the auspicious April holiday, in the wake of the first camping in winter this year. Children's laughter and songs of happiness are heard at the camp all the year round. -0-

headline: Key Industry Sector of DPRK Boosts Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 3 (KCNA) -- The key industry sector of the DPRK boosts production.
The workers in the metallurgical industry sector are consolidating the already reinforced foundations for the production of Juche iron and giving full play to its capacity as part of their campaign for increased production of iron and steel.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex and the Chollima Steel Complex have steadily updated the technical and economic indices of energy-saving oxygen heat blast furnaces and UHP electric arc furnaces and reduced the time of melting and charging raw materials to make innovations in the production of iron and steel every day.
The electric-power industry is producing much more electricity while actively combining thermal and hydroelectric power generation capacities.
Suphung, Jangjingang and Sodusu hydro-power stations put water control on a scientific basis and ensure the high water level and high efficiency operation.

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Participants in Eleventh SPYL Congress and Has Photo Session with Them
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 3 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met the participants in the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League on May 2.
Present there were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan and Ju Chang Il, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army.
The participants in the congress were filled with excitement and joy as they greeted a moment of enjoying the privilege and happiness they had wished even in their dreams at a time when they started the struggle for a new stage of change with redoubled enthusiasm and spirit and boundless pride and honor of performing feats as the advancing group and shock brigade in the vanguard of accomplishing the cause of our Party.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the plaza in front of the venue of the congress, the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the outstanding leader of the Juche-oriented youth movement, the benevolent father of the young people across the country.
Young man and woman delegates presented fragrant bouquets to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, reflecting their boundless reverence and wishes for him.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated the newly elected chairman and vice-chairmen of the eleventh Central Committee of the youth league, shaking hands with them one by one.
He met the youth delegates, who have performed distinguished feats and displayed communist traits in achieving the prosperity of the country and glorifying the socialist system of our own style, and highly appreciated their efforts.
Acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers of the participants in the congress, he warmly congratulated them on the successful Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League held amid special interest and expectation of the Party and the people.
In the past years, too, the ideas and ideal of the Party had always been the ones of the young people themselves and the course of building and developing our state had coincided with the course of their worthwhile life, but there has been no such era as the present one when high patriotic consciousness, towering enthusiasm for the revolution and valiant effort of the young people pervade all the sectors of socialist construction, he said, adding that the noble traits and iron-willed fighting efficiency of the young people unprecedented in any other country in the world are a proud symbol of our national power.
As time goes on, more pages written with blood and sweat of the youth are being added to the history of the country and the legendary feats of the young people are constantly being recorded along with the great era of change, he said, adding that this is the great pride of our Party and the great motive force of our cause. And he stressed that the strength and honor of the youth league, the powerful vanguard of patriotic youths, should be steadily boosted in the era full of unprecedented heroism and bravery.
The reality when our Party and revolution are faced with new and huge tasks requires more active advance and courageous role of the young people, he said, stressing the need to orient all the work of the youth league towards preparing all the youths as passionate patriots who regard it as their life goal to realize the Party's ideal and feel pride and happiness of their youth in attaining it.
Saying that the dynamic steps of the ranks of the young people firmly united under the banner of patriotism represent the lively motion of the new era of change and the vigorous advance of our cause, he emphasized the need to focus on strengthening the lower-echelon organizations so that the revolutionary spirit and fighting efficiency of the young people can be steadily inherited generation after generation and to cover the journey for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress with feats of the youth exciting the whole country through the dynamic revolutionary mass movement and the socialist patriotic movement, the precious foundation for training young people to be pioneers and shock brigade of the times.
Expressing belief that the youth league would dynamically inspire the young vanguard across the country to display their remarkably high revolutionary spirit and patriotic zeal in order to usher in an era of the more powerful and active Korean youth movement, ComradeKim Jong Unhad a significant photo session with the participants in the congress.
The participants burst into enthusiastic cheers again with the infinite excitement of receiving the great trust and affection of the great father.
Led by the chairman of the SPYL Central Committee making a pledge of faith to become the socialist patriotic youth glorifying the great era ofKim Jong Un, the participants in the congress enthusiastically shouted slogans of patriotic loyalty.
ComradeKim Jong Ungave militant encouragement to the young vanguard cheering like an erupting volcano.
All the participants were full of ardent enthusiasm to carry forward in the purest and most thoroughgoing way the proud tradition of the youth movement, which has responded to the call of the Party and the country with heroic struggle, and perform fresh miracles and feats in every theater for great changes intended by the Ninth Congress of the WPK. -0-

headline: Sleeping Time of Orphans
story_text:
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Baby Home and the Pyongyang Orphanage on the occasion of the New Year 2015.
He told the officials that he came to the baby home and orphanage first after making his New Year Address to celebrate the New Year's Day with the children.
After looking round the baby home, he headed for the orphanage.
When he entered the lower class No. 2, the children were singing to the accompaniment of a kindergarten teacher's organ.
Seeing with bright smile on his face the happy looks of the children loudly singing a song about their joyful life, the General Secretary suddenly told the head of the orphanage that it must be the sleep time of children and that they should be sent to bed.
When the head of the orphanage said that it was all right and that children could not sleep as the fatherly Marshal visited them, he shook his head and said that the children should go to bed even though he came.
He said that he wanted to see the children sleeping in the cradle as well and headed for the sleeping room.
After all, the children came to fall asleep in the cradle of happiness.
The respected General Secretary paid such deep attention to keep the children's sleeping time so that their growth and the work of nursing and upbringing them are not hindered even a bit. -0-

story_text:

headline: Participants in Eleventh SPYL Congress Visit Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 4 (KCNA) -- The participants in the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League visited the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations standing imposingly as a symbol of legendary military feats and brave spirit of the young soldiers in the era ofKim Jong Un.
Being briefed on the sacred place, the visitors were in the grip of solemn emotion, keenly feeling the ardent love of the great father who has valued as the representatives of the dignity and honor of the country the brave soldiers who participated in the overseas military operations to make an unprecedented legendary history of heroes by devoting their precious youth and lives to defending the sacred prestige of the glorious DPRK and justice.
Praying for immortality of the war martyrs before the Monument to the Korean People's Army Martyrs in the Special Military Operations, they paid high tribute to them, the noble models of the Korean youth and patriotic loyalty.
The group sculptures of immortality depicting the passionate brave soldiers, who left the most resolute and self-sacrificing steps in the life-and-death bloody battles for genuine justice and peace, taught all the visitors that the hot-hearted youths should respond to the order of the Workers' Party of Korea and the motherland with what kind of extraordinary determination and do-or-die efforts.
At the memorial museum, they laid flowers at the Memorial Wall where the noble soul and spirit of the martyrs are alive as the eternal shinning stars, and looked round photos, art pieces, relics and others on display with tears of emotion to deeply grasp the boundless loyalty to the Party and ardent patriotism of the heroic soldiers.
The visitors were touched while reading the combat records and the blood-stained written application for accession to the Party that show the heroic last moments of the young soldiers, who offered their lives to save their comrades-in-arms at a crucial moment and opened up the route of charge without hesitation or vacillation in order to be honorable before the motherland and their parents and siblings.
The visitors were also moved to see the immortal scenes of showing the brave soldiers who mercilessly punished the enemies in battlefields with the fighting spirit and mettle of the invincible heroic KPA.
Going round the Memorial Museum, they pledged to further glorify the dignity and honor of our great state and fully demonstrate the wisdom and heroism of the Korean youth in accelerating the victorious advance of the Juche cause by inheriting the noble soul and spirit of patriotic loyalty cherished by the martyrs. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Ushering in New Era of Prosperity
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 4 (KCNA) -- Let us usher in a new era of prosperity with the same spirit and mettle as was displayed in pioneering the era of comprehensive development of socialism. This is the requirement of the times and revolution, says Rodong Sinmun in an editorial on Monday.

The noble loyalty devoted to realizing the plans and determination of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea without fail runs through the pioneering spirit that opened up a new stage of transformation in the comprehensive development of socialism.
The era of comprehensive development of socialism is a precious output of the strong spiritual strength of the great Korean people boundlessly loyal to the ideas and cause of the Party Central Committee and a great victory of unity brought by the harmonious whole firmly rallied around the Party Central Committee with a single mind and purpose.
The said pioneering spirit embodies the spirit of self-respect and self-sustenance to build a powerful and prosperous country without fail with our own efforts and wisdom.
The DPRK people's spirit of self-respect and self-sustenance has created the dynamic advancing spirit of our state which is making a series of changes and transformations in a three-dimensional and offensive way and leaping higher, faster and more vigorously.
The pioneering spirit is associated with the patriotic spirit of linking the country with one's own destiny and devoting one's own sincere sweat and efforts to the work for the prosperity of the state.
The pioneering struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism clearly proves once again the truth that if we unite in a patriotic mind, we will produce tremendous strength.
The editorial calls upon all the people to dynamically usher in a new era of prosperity with the same spirit and mettle as was displayed in pioneering the era of comprehensive development, united as one in mind around the respected ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

story_text:

headline: Historic Event in Struggle for National Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 5 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 90th anniversary of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland, founded by PresidentKim Il Sungduring the anti-Japanese revolutionary war.
The ARF was an influential underground revolutionary organization embracing the broad strata of patriotic people who opposed Japanese imperialism and aspired after the independence of the country.
Regarding it as a key issue deciding the victory of the revolution to unite all the people under the banner of patriotism, the President advanced the policy of forming a permanent organization involving all the anti-Japanese patriotic forces in the mid-1930s and pushed ahead with the preparations for its realization.
He personally worked out the programme, rules and inauguration declaration of the ARF in a campfire of bivouac during arduous battles and march.
Under such preparations, he held a meeting of military and political cadres of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and proclaimed the founding of the ARF.
The participants were greatly excited to receive the report on bringing about a fresh upsurge in the overall Korean revolution, made by the President at the meeting, and the "Ten-Point Programme of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland", "Inaugural Declaration of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland" and "Rules of the Association for the Restoration of the Fatherland", personally announced by him.
All the participants in the meeting, including representatives of Chondoists, peasants, teachers and workers, elected the President as chairman of the ARF, reflecting the unanimous will and desire of the Korean people.
The birth of the ARF made it possible to build up the driving force of the revolution with its organizational network as the base and rally all the anti-Japanese patriotic forces firmly and thus mobilize them for the struggle to the liberate the country.
The President wrote in his reminiscences "With the Century" that the birth of the ARF marked a historic event that provided a new turning point for the development of the Korean revolution and gave a bright hope of national liberation. -0-

headline: Efforts to Minimize Drought Damage
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 5 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, scientific farming promotion teams active in different parts of the DPRK strive to minimize the negative impact of the persistent drought on wheat and barley farming.
Their members active in Sukchon, Phyongwon, Anak, Chongdan, Pukchang and Kosan counties have measured soil humidity at various depths to determine the order and quantity of watering in wheat and barley fields.
Fertilizing wheat and barley fields with various kinds of nutrient reinforcing agents and growth regulators has been conducted under the guidance of those members.
The teams are also taking measures to enhance weeding effect by chemical methods. -0-

headline: Greetings to Polish FM
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 5 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to her Polish counterpart Radoslaw Sikorski on May 3 on the occasion of the national day of the Republic of Poland.
The message hoped that the relations between the DPRK and Poland would develop in the interests of the peoples of the two countries. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Spring Int'l Trade Fair Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 5 (KCNA) -- The 24th Pyongyang Spring International Trade Fair opened.
Presented to the fair on the theme of "For the common development and prosperity" are excellent products that more than 290 enterprises and companies of the DPRK, Russia, China, Mongolia, Switzerland and Thailand produced by introducing advanced science and technology.
Tens of thousands of products of over 1 700 kinds, including electronic appliances, machines, building materials, goods in the fields of agriculture, public health, fishery and light industry and foodstuffs and daily necessities, are displayed at the Central Youth Hall and the Okryu Exhibition House.
During the fair there will take place an introduction of enterprises and companies for economic exchange and cooperation and a briefing of products.
An opening ceremony took place at the Central Youth Hall on May 4.
Present there were Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations of the DPRK, officials concerned and officials of the exhibitor units, delegations of different countries and members of the diplomatic corps here.
Yun Jong Ho made an opening address.
The speaker stressed that it is the consistent external economic policy of the DPRK to continue to develop bilateral and multilateral cooperation while strengthening external economic relations with different countries and regions of the world on the principle of equality and mutual benefit.
He affirmed that the DPRK would as ever steadily expand its external economic relations with all countries respecting its sovereignty and taking friendly attitude to it and strive to build a just and peaceful new world.
At the end of the ceremony the participants went round the venue of the fair. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Spring Int'l Trade Fair Opens
Vegetable Gardens and Greenhouses at Wisong Scientists Residential District
story_text:
One day in June 2014, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Wisong Scientists Residential District under construction.
While guiding the district construction, the General Secretary pointed to a wide vacant lot between apartments and asked about what to be built there.
After hearing the officials' reply that it was planned to build a resting place and a playground, he said it would be better to turn the vacant lot into a vegetable garden. And he added that scientists would be glad, if vegetable gardens are created between apartments to prepare vegetables for winter Kimchi, along with small greenhouses built to suit the characteristics of the residential district in a suburb of Pyongyang.
Then he instructed the officials to reflect in the general layout such vegetable gardens and greenhouses and include their construction in the project plan so as to build them in a qualitative way.
The officials looking up to him were filled with excitement. They had never thought that October, when the residential district was to be inaugurated, was on the eve of kimchi-making season. They only cared about the number of rooms and their width at modern multi-storey apartments in the district and about its structures, and nobody was concerned even about the vegetables issue for the owners to live there.
After all, the vegetable gardens and greenhouses with good vegetable yields came to appear at the time of moving into new houses in the Wisong Scientists Residential District. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 6 (KCNA) -- The pent-up grudge and resentment of the Korean people toward the Japanese imperialists' cruel and brutal military rule erupted into a nationwide anti-Japanese resistance on March 1, 1919.
The March First Popular Uprising, started with a mass demonstration in Pyongyang, swept the whole of Korea and spread to the areas abroad where Koreans lived.
The panic-stricken Japanese imperialists mobilized all the repressive forces in Korea at that time to suppress the peaceful demonstration. Not content with this, they even shipped huge forces into Korea from the mainland of Japan.
They fully revealed their true colors as beasts in the suppression of the March First Popular Uprising.
Japanese imperialist murderers rushed to a young schoolgirl, who participated in the demonstration march, and cut her two arms with knives and killed her by hacking her body to pieces.
They committed all sorts of thrice-cursed atrocities. They broke the skulls of uprisers by striking the back of their heads with metal bars and hooks, stabbed their whole bodies with short swords to ensanguine and tore the mouth of a young boy with a knife and killed him mercilessly as he shouted a slogan of independence.
More than 100 000 Koreans lost their lives during the March First Popular Uprising alone due to the barbarous massacre of the Japanese imperialists.
As regards the crucial and atrocious massacre of the peaceful demonstration participants, even a government-patronized scholar of Japan confessed that the Japanese were hell-bent on the suppression too cruel to see.
A foreign witness said that the wild beating and crucial atrocities perpetrated by Japanese against an innocent Korean were so heinous and brutal that reminded him of an act of beast against human being, adding that the Japanese, though they committed such extreme atrocities, felt sorry for the lack of more extreme method.
During the March First Popular Uprising, the Japanese imperialists dyed the whole of Korea with the blood of innocent people. -0-

headline: Quality of Products Improved in Food Industrial Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 6 (KCNA) -- Different units in the food industrial sector of the DPRK are making successes in improving the quality of products and expanding their varieties by dint of science and technology.
A number of products were registered as February 2 goods at the National Foodstuff Exhibition-2026 held in April.
The Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory established production line and created production environment to meet the requirements of quality engineering and scientifically confirmed the additive amount of substances good for the growth of children, and thus has produced tasty and nutritious cakes, candies and bread.
The Amnokgang General Foodstuff Factory organized show, passing-on technique meeting, technical innovation prize contest and enhanced the responsibility and role of field engineers and process inspectors to operate and manage the integrated production system in a detailed way and ensure the hygienic safety of consumer goods.
The Paeksong General Foodstuff Factory and the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory brought about good results by directing efforts to improving the quality of products.
Pyongyang, Haeju and Sariwon condiments factories have made big efforts to solve technical problems arising in diversifying their products to bring about the growth of condiments both in quality and quantity. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Reply Message from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 6 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a reply message from Comrade Thongloun Sisoulith, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on April 30.
The reply message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I express sincere thanks to you for extending warm congratulations full of friendship to me on my reelection as president of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.
Your warm congratulations and best wishes, as an expression of fraternal and comradely friendship, unity and interest, show the close relations between our two parties, two states and the peoples of the two countries with a long tradition and, at the same time, serve as a great encouragement to me to continue to carry on the noble duty of leading the Lao party, state and people.
I will further expand and develop the relations of friendship between the Lao People's Democratic Republic and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with a long tradition onto a new high stage in close cooperation with you in the future, thus bringing substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contributing to peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the rest of the world.
I wish you good health and happiness and success in the accomplishment of your noble cause for building a powerful socialist country.
I pay high tribute to you. -0-

Production of Quality Blueberry Goods
Congratulatory Group of Korean Youth League in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 6 (KCNA) -- A congratulatory group of the Korean Youth League in Japan led by Ri Kwang Il, chairman of its Central Standing Committee, visited Mangyongdae, the sacred place of the revolution.
Being briefed on the mementoes at the historic old home in Mangyongdae, the group members deeply grasped the personality of PresidentKim Il Sungas a peerlessly great man who embarked on the road of the revolution in his early years and devoted his whole life to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people.
The group also toured the Korean Revolution Museum and regional-industry factories and a leisure complex in Kangdong County. -0-

headline: DPRK's Best Scientists and Technicians for 2025
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 6 (KCNA) -- Pak Hyon Uk, director of the Geology Institute under the State Academy of Sciences, is one of the DPRK's best scientists and technicians for 2025.
He contributed to adding luster to Mt Paektu, a world-famous mountain and pride of the Korean people.
For several years, he has made efforts to improve the accuracy of data interpretation through survey of gravity, magnetic force and radioactivity in order to assess the movements and activity of magma.
He scientifically proved the stability of the magmatic activity of volcano in Mt Paektu and contributed to estimating the distribution area and depth of magma.
He comprehensively analyzed in a scientific way the eruption stage and the geological evolution of volcano in Mt Paektu and proved the lithological characteristics and newly proved the scientific, pedagogical and tourist values of dozens of geological relics, thus contributing to making the area of Mt Paektu renowned as a global geopark. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Permanent Representative of DPRK to UN
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- Kim Song, permanent representative of the DPRK to the UN, issued the following press statement on May 6:
At the 11th NPT review conference now under way at the UN Headquarters, the U.S. and some vassal countries are dampening the atmosphere of the conference, groundlessly taking issue with the present position and exercise of sovereign rights of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a nuclear weapons state outside the treaty.
The NPT review conference, which should contribute to addressing the international issue of nuclear disarmament and the root cause of the danger of nuclear conflict, fails to fulfill its original mission and turns into a place of malicious accusation against the sovereign states, pursuant to the sinister political attempt of the U.S. and Western forces. This is the fundamental reason why the global non-proliferation system is weakening.
I denounce and reject in the strongest tone the brigandish and shameless acts of certain countries including the U.S. which are taking issue with the DPRK's realistic and just access to nuclear weapons through the legal channels and exercise of its inherent defensive rights as a sovereign state.
The wrong behavior of the U.S. and Western countries forcing the DPRK, which transparently exercised the right to withdraw from the treaty according to Article 10 of the NPT, to fulfill the treaty obligations is a wanton violation of the spirit of the treaty and a total disregard of the purpose and principle of international law.
Before insisting obstinately on the observance of treaty obligations of the DPRK, which legally withdrew from the NPT decades ago, the U.S. should answer first whether the same criteria apply to the implementation of the obligations of various international treaties and international organizations conventions it had quit.
The soundness and legality of the NPT are not challenged by the exercise of the rights of a sovereign state existing outside the treaty, but are eroding from inside due to the defection by some treaty member states including the U.S. which are arbitrarily abusing the nature and application scope of the treaty.
It should be the essential point in implementing the NPT and the main agenda item of the current review conference to rectify the violation of treaty obligations of the U.S. and some countries which are now neglecting the obligations to nuclear disarmament as the signatories to the NPT and resorting to such proliferation acts as offer of "extended deterrence" and transfer of nuclear submarine technology to non-nuclear states.
The position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state does not change by rhetorical assertion or unilateral desire of outsiders.
Clarifying once again, the DPRK is not bound by the NPT in any case.
The DPRK will make a positive contribution to the efforts of the international community to ensure international peace and security and promote global strategic stability by remaining faithful to the law on the state nuclear force policy, which clarifies the mission of nuclear force, the principle of using nuclear weapons and the obligation to prevent proliferation in a most transparent way, and to the implementation of its obligations under the national constitution which fixes its legal position as a nuclear weapons state. -0-

headline: Young Volunteers Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- Tens of young people in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major worksites for socialist construction.
An instructor of the Pakchon County Youth League Committee advanced into the county raw materials base station and a teacher of Ponbu Primary School in Sinuiju City affiliated to Sinuiju Teacher Training College proposed to the youth league organization volunteered to work at the branch school on a remote islet.
Senior middle schools graduates and youths in Changsong and Sindo counties vowed to work at the Changsong Sheep Breeding Ground and the Reed Combined Farm in Sindo County. Graduates of Sinuiju Middle School for Orphans petitioned to work at the Samgwang Livestock Farm under the North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee.
A meeting was held on May 6 to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were Yang Myong Chol, chief secretary of the North Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and young people.
Certificates of petition were awarded to be followed by a congratulatory address and resolution-making speeches.
Officials and young people in the province presented bouquets to the volunteers leaving for new revolutionary posts and encouraged them. -0-

headline: Russian Delegation Arrives
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Hydro-Meteorological and Environmental Monitoring Bureau of the Russian Federation led by Director Igor Shmakov arrived here on Wednesday.
The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by officials of the State Hydro-Meteorological Administration and the charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here and its staff members. -0-

headline: Group of Young Koreans in China Visits Mangyongdae
Rodong Sinmun on Three Revolutions as Powerful Force for Comprehensive Development
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Thursday in an article says that the line of the three revolutions is an ever-victorious action programme for building Korean-style socialism.
It is the steadfast determination and will of the Workers' Party of Korea to extensively promote and expand the comprehensive development of the great state by setting forth new tasks for the development of the times in all aspects of ideology, technology and culture and conducting the work for remoulding nature, man and society in a revolutionary way, the article says, and goes on:
The three revolutions--ideological, technical and cultural-- are the ever-victorious banner and all-powerful weapon as they have displayed great attraction and immortal viability for their scientific accuracy and truth in the whole course of socialist construction.
The ideological remoulding, the ideological revolution, is to build up our own driving force and guarantee the vigorous vitality of socialist construction and the victorious advance of the revolution. This is the truth proved by the past days and months.
It is our Party's intention that the more the times develop and socialist construction intensifies, the more definitely precedence should be given to the ideological revolution to prepare officials and working people to be those possessed of revolutionary ideological consciousness, the collectivist spirit and fighting traits of the working class.
Science and technology are the engine leading socialist construction and the main motive force for the development of the national economy. To steadily strengthen the scientific and technological force through the vigorous scientific and technological revolution is the best strategy for putting the country's economy on a stable and sustainable track of development in a short span of time and accelerating the comprehensive development of socialism.
Cultural level is an important criterion for evaluating personality of a human being as well as the level of civilization of a society. It would be possible to further speed up the comprehensive development of socialism when everyone embodies noble moral traits and high cultural attainments and possesses the communist virtues and traits helping and leading each other forward.
Today the three red flags are more fiercely fluttering thanks to the strong confidence, ardent desire, steadfast faith and will of the DPRK people to bring earlier the brighter future by holding fast to the line of three revolutions as a weapon for advance and development. -0-

headline: Boundless Respect to Noble Patriotism of War Martyrs
Patriotic Women of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- The noble moral world of Korean women cultivating the garden of virtue while adding vitality to the large socialist family is further being displayed in the general advance for the steady prosperity of the country.
Officials of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea and women's union officials and members in Pyongyang, together with their children, visited bereaved families of martyrs involved in the overseas military operations. Through the meeting, they encouraged their children to glorify their youth on the road for the country as the martyrs did.
Women's union officials and members in Phyongwon County of South Phyongan Province and Kusong City of North Phyongan Province have dedicated themselves to improving war veterans' health and affording convenience to them in their everyday life.
Women in Phyongsan County of North Hwanghae Province and Hwaphyong County of Jagang Province encouraged honored disabled soldiers to keep the flowers of the revolution in bloom, arranging their wedding ceremonies with parental affection. This shows a true picture of our society.
Women's union members in Unnyul County of South Hwanghae Province and Taean District of Nampho Municipality visited the soldier-builders performing feats at theaters for regional transformation to stir up their morale through public service activities. Women's union officials and members in Hamhung City of South Hamgyong Province and Kyongwon County of North Hamgyong Province devoted all their sincerity to the soldiers. -0-

headline: Production of Nitrogenous Fertilizer Boosted
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex in the DPRK have produced 5 000 more tons of nitrogenous fertilizer than the planned this year, saving a lot of coal.
In the first quarter of the year, the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex lowered the standard of material consumption per unit while registering high production results every month.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex improved technical indices in the operation of gas generator and increased the output of gas per hour while saving anthracite, thus putting the fertilizer production on a normal basis. -0-

headline: Advanced Test System Established at Electric Power Industry Research Institute
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- The Electric Power Industry Research Institute under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry in the DPRK established an advanced test system of weighty significance in developing new high-voltage electrical equipment, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This system helps test the insulating structure and characteristics of high-voltage electrical equipment by generating impulse high voltage of up to thousands of kV and conduct researches of various purposes related to the development of electric power equipment and lightning protection device and thus contribute to consolidating the self-supporting foundation of the electric power industry.
Scientists developed a new efficient lightning protection system and introduced it into many objects including substations, giving economic benefits to the country.
Now, universities and scientific research institutes are conducting tests on the characteristics for the development of new high-voltage electrical equipment through the said system. -0-

I denounce and reject in the strongest tone the brigandish and shameless acts of certain countries including the U.S. which are taking issue with the DPRK's realistic and just access to nuclear weapons through the legal channels and exercise of its inherent defensive rights as a sovereign state.
The wrong behavior of the U.S. and Western countries forcing the DPRK, which transparently exercised the right to withdraw from the treaty according to Article 10 of the NPT, to fulfill the treaty obligations is a wanton violation of the spirit of the treaty and a total disregard of the purpose and principle of international law.
Before insisting obstinately on the observance of treaty obligations of the DPRK, which legally withdrew from the NPT decades ago, the U.S. should answer first whether the same criteria apply to the implementation of the obligations of various international treaties and international organizations conventions it had quit.
The soundness and legality of the NPT are not challenged by the exercise of the rights of a sovereign state existing outside the treaty, but are eroding from inside due to the defection by some treaty member states including the U.S. which are arbitrarily abusing the nature and application scope of the treaty.
It should be the essential point in implementing the NPT and the main agenda item of the current review conference to rectify the violation of treaty obligations of the U.S. and some countries which are now neglecting the obligations to nuclear disarmament as the signatories to the NPT and resorting to such proliferation acts as offer of "extended deterrence" and transfer of nuclear submarine technology to non-nuclear states.
The position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state does not change by rhetorical assertion or unilateral desire of outsiders.
Clarifying once again, the DPRK is not bound by the NPT in any case.
The DPRK will make a positive contribution to the efforts of the international community to ensure international peace and security and promote global strategic stability by remaining faithful to the law on the state nuclear force policy, which clarifies the mission of nuclear force, the principle of using nuclear weapons and the obligation to prevent proliferation in a most transparent way, and to the implementation of its obligations under the national constitution which fixes its legal position as a nuclear weapons state. -0-

headline: Boundless Respect to Noble Patriotism of War Martyrs
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 7 (KCNA) -- Many people from all walks of life in the DPRK are visiting the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, a seat of immortality showing the great heroic spirit and the noble soul of patriotic loyalty of the brave soldiers involved in the overseas military operations, the proud sons of the country.
For the past ten days since its opening, the memorial museum has been visited by more than 232 000 working people, service personnel and schoolchildren, including the participants in the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, who paid high tribute to the war martyrs representing the dignity and honor of the country.
The flowers, laid in succession at the Memorial Wall where the precious lives of the martyrs are shining as the eternal stars, are boundless respect and reverence for the noble patriotism of the war heroes, who demonstrated the reputation and mightiness of the country with their noble sacrifices and heroic feats and wished the prosperity of Pyongyang when meeting the end of lives with their option of pure conscience, and an expression of the Korean people's love and passion for the country.
Cherishing the truth of struggle and victory taught by the hearts of passionate youths pulsating with patriotism, the visitors have hardened their firm will to devote themselves to the sacred cause for the safety and prosperity of the great state. Their looks tell that though the martyrs passed away, their noble soul and spirit have been cherished in the minds of the people to add loyalty and patriotism to them.
All visitors without reference to age and sex were deeply impressed to see the photos and relics showing feats of the heroes, who made a charge in the teeth of death on the orders of the country, and traces of fierce battles.
Looking at the photo of a hero of the same age, university students wrote down his last request in their pocketbooks. Service personnel recalled in tears the feats of the brave fighters, who made a breakthrough for the victory, devoting their precious youth. All their faces were shone with ardent mind to strive for the steady prosperity of the DPRK, always remembering the desire of the martyrs.
Being briefed on the heroic end of the martyrs who showed the patriotic loyalty to the country with their records of bloody battles, the visitors were convinced that the DPRK is so strong and great and its august name will shine forever as the banner of victory and glory as it is supported by the ardent patriotism and loyalty of tens of millions of the people.
The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, which shines thanks to the great love and revolutionary obligation of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unputting the lives of the defenders devoted to the sacred war for justice and dignity on the highest peak of glory and honor, injects inexhaustible vitality into the patriotic all-people general advance for the comprehensive development of socialism, along with the steady current of respect. -0-
