topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Destroyer Choe Hyon and Observes Test of Assessing Its Maneuverability
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 8 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on May 7 visited the Destroyer Choe Hyon and observed the test to make a general assessment of its maneuverability before its commissioning.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau, and leading officials in the national defence and warship-building sectors.
ComradeKim Jong Unboarded the Destroyer Choe Hyon to learn about a navigation plan for the test.
He highly appreciated the successes made by the crew members of the destroyer in their training to fully equip with the professional qualifications to operate the new-type destroyer, a combination of modern military and technical capabilities.
He went round the combined control center, weapon system control room and other combat duty spaces and elements of the destroyer to learn about its operational preparations.
A navigation test to assess various maneuvering elements of the destroyer was conducted with ComradeKim Jong Unin presence in the West Sea of Korea 120 n·miles away from the shore.
The crew members of the destroyer were in full excitement and high morale as they had the honor of making a voyage in the presence of ComradeKim Jong Unagain.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed satisfaction over the fact that the combat maneuverability of the warship agreed with the operational requirements and the advantages of the warship control system of our own style were proved.
Appreciating that all the tests for the operational commissioning of the destroyer were progressing smoothly, he ordered to hand over it to the navy in oncoming mid-June as planned.
He laid down the position, disposition and operational duty of new-type destroyers under construction and clarified a series of tasks to be carried out by the Navy for them.
He specially stressed the important tasks related to the establishment of a new naval base.
At a consultative meeting with officials in the warship-building sector on the day, ComradeKim Jong Unreceived a report on the results of examination over the design changes and the newly-planned weapon system of the warships Nos. 3 and 4 under construction and made an important conclusion. He particularly stressed the meaning that our new decision on the revised and changed warship building plan is of a crucial strategic nature and such decision will fundamentally update the readiness of our army's strategic action while bringing about a great change in the building of war deterrent.
He said that we have reliable and powerful defence research group and the shipbuilding industry, expressing great expectation and belief that new decision tasks will be carried out without fail by their irresistible might of self-reliance.
Reaffirming the steadfast will of our Party to build a powerful navy at any cost, he mentioned the long-term plan for navy building and some planned work.
On the same day, he sat together with all the seamen of the destroyer and encouraged their unusual pride and self-confidence in carrying on the honorable duty, stressing the need to continuously put spurs to the training with a sense of important duty and a high sense of responsibility in order to remarkably increase the combat capability.
He had a significant photo taken with the seamen of the destroyer on the deck of the warship.
The seamen, who were honored to see ComradeKim Jong Unand received great glory and trust from him again, made a firm determination to reliably defend our country's maritime sovereignty and remain faithful to their original and sacred mission of taking charge a part of war deterrent by actively conducting intense training to possess the tremendous capability for an actual war as befitting the brave seamen of our Party. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprise
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 8 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on May 6 visited a major munitions industry enterprise and acquainted himself with the production of major weapons and combat equipment in the first half of the year.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence, and Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences.
ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the production of new-type self-propelled gun-howitzers for three battalions to be deployed at the long-range artillery unit in the southern borderline within this year under the decision of the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.
He heard in detail the opinions of experts on the results of various traveling, topographical overcoming and submergence crossing test of the new-type 155 mm self-propelled gun-howitzer carriage and the test-fire of improved shell conducted under the supplementary test plan.
He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the research group and the working class in the field of defence sciences have made signal successes in manufacturing new-generation artillery weapon with very high mobility and striking power.
He extended militant encouragement to the workers at the enterprise who are waging a dynamic labor struggle to attain the set artillery weapon production goal, registering high results every day with the bold creation stamina and revolutionary spirit, true to the idea and decision of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee.
Appreciating the advantage of the new-type 155 mm self-propelled gun-howitzer system being produced at the enterprise for the first time, ComradeKim Jong Unmentioned about its military and strategic value.
He said that the striking range of this large-caliber rifled gun for the frontline units to newly equip themselves, along with various operational and tactical missile systems and powerful multiple rocket launcher systems, is over 60 km and such rapid extension of striking range and remarkable improvement of striking capability will provide a great change and advantage in the land operations of our army. And he added that we should redefine the operational concept of the use of forces and equipment on the basis of the actual conditions in which new weapons and equipment are being introduced.
He said that the new-type artillery weapon system with superior mobility, high combat environment information processing capability and automatic firing system will bring about a radical improvement in the composition of our artillery force and have an important significance in implementing the Party's military strategic policy on bolstering up the long-range artillery force.
Referring to some defects latent in the composition of production system, processing district and arrangement of equipment at the enterprise, he gave an instruction on working out a plan to introduce an automatic streamlined production system supported by a more efficient and innovative idea.
He stressed the need to always pay deep attention to constantly improving the production conditions and environment.
That day, ComradeKim Jong Uninspected a new-type main battle tank and various launchers which are being produced by the Armored Weapons Institute and several munitions industry enterprises.
He said that it is urgent to technically remodel into an ultra-modern level in the shortest period the major munitions industry enterprises, which are in a key position in the work to improve the modernity of our armed forces, and to build up a modern production and management system, adding that the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK will examine and approve the plans for technical renovation of the relevant munitions industry enterprises and the related budget.
He reaffirmed that the year 2026 will also record an unprecedented upgrade in the course of struggle for bolstering up the national defence capability of the country, calling for achieving signal successes every day by making strenuous efforts to bolster up the national defence capability, the most vivid expression of patriotism.
ComradeKim Jong Un's on-site guidance over the defence field on the day is an important occasion in increasing the country's defence capabilities in a practical way. -0-

headline: Efforts Made to Introduce Organic Farming through Fish Breeding
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 8 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Agricultural Commission in the DPRK set a goal to introduce organic farming through fish breeding in large areas this year and is organizing the work for its realization in a substantial way.
The commission has made it sure that the provincial, city and county agricultural guidance organs and farms choose right fields for the introduction of paddy-field fish breeding and conduct a project for infrastructures, including the work to make fish paths in a qualitative way.
It has directed efforts to selecting fish species suited to mountainous and highland and plain areas and to stepping up the production of fries.
Attention is also paid to securing feed for paddy-field fish breeding. The commission takes technical measures to ensure that the rural communities across the country provide various kinds of feed resources suited to the regional characteristics and produce and use animal feed including Hermetia illucens.
It is now striving to complete the technical system for putting on a scientific basis all the processes of introducing organic farming through fishing breeding. -0-

headline: World Migratory Birds Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 9 (KCNA) -- May 9 is World Migratory Birds Day.
The world, due to the importance of the protection of migratory birds, set the second Saturday of May and October as world migratory birds day and is conducting activities for the protection of migratory birds and their habitats on these occasions.
The theme of this year is that Every Bird Counts - Your Observation Matter.
The DPRK is regarded as a major flyway of migratory birds and stoppage place on their way in Northeast Asia.
In recent years, the Biodiversity Institute under the State Academy of Sciences has made a comprehensive survey of migratory birds' stoppage places in Mundok, Kumya, Sindo and other migratory bird reserves during the spring and autumn migratory periods and their breeding state during summer.
Its research group made a field survey of all the migratory birds reserves in the country to clarify the recent state of the distribution of protected objects and their protection value. On this basis, it newly set migratory bird reserves and possible reserve sites through the ascertainment of the areas of the main migration distribution and completed the design of the network of migratory bird reserves helpful to increasing the area step by step.
The international exchange and cooperation for the protection of migratory birds have been conducted to make progress in studying the ecological activities of migratory birds and taking measures for their protection.
The DPRK joined the East Asian-Australasian Flyway Partnership in 2017. -0-

On behalf of the government and people of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I extend the sincerest congratulations to you, the Russian state leadership and all the fraternal Russian people on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of the Russia's victory in the Great Patriotic War.
I take this opportunity to pay high respect to the war veterans of the preceding generation who destroyed fascism and defended the freedom and liberation of mankind and the peace and security of the world with their matchless bravery and noble patriotic spirit, and to the Great Years.
Esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin
I am always pleased and proud of the fact that we, together with you, are leading the present DPRK-Russia relations and writing a new brilliant history of independence, dignity, peace and prosperity suited to the common ideal and desire of the peoples of the two countries.
Reaffirming the stand of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to give top priority to the comprehensive strategic partnership of alliance character between our two countries and invariably develop it, I affirm once again that we will always be responsible for the implementation of the obligations of the inter-state treaty between the DPRK and Russia.
Dear Vladimir Vladimirovich,
Pyongyang is always with you and the fraternal Russian people.
I sincerely wish you good health and bigger success in your responsible work for defending the dignity and interests of Russia on the occasion of Russia's great V-day.
I wish the fraternal Russian people only victory and glory in their way.
The history of Russia's great victory in the war will continue. -0-

headline: Production of Equipment and Parts for Irrigation Projects Hastened in DPRK

The Sinuiju Irrigation Machine Factory has stepped up the production of pumps of different capacities and parts including valves. It increased the production of molten steel and introduced new jigs and equipment necessary for processing to ensure high quality and speed.

headline: Wreaths Laid at Liberation Tower and Cemetery of Fallen Fighters of Soviet Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 10 (KCNA) -- Staff members of the Russian embassy here laid a wreath at the Liberation Tower on May 9 on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Russia's victory in the Great Patriotic War.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the tower.
Present at the wreath-laying ceremony were Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy, and its staff members, members of the diplomatic corps and the military attaches corps here and officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the DPRK were played.
A wreath in the name of the Russian embassy was placed at the tower amid the playing of wreath-laying music.
The participants paid silent tribute to the memory of the fallen fighters of the Soviet Army before going round the tower.
On the same day, the members of the Russian embassy laid a wreath, bouquets and flowers at the cemetery of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in Sadong District.
Earlier, members of the Russian embassy visited the monuments to the Soviet Army in Sinuiju, Uiju, Tongrim, Wonsan, Hamhung, Nampho and Haeju and members of the Russian consulate general in the city of Chongjin the liberation tower and graves of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in the city. -0-

Progress Made in Fishing Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 10 (KCNA) -- The fishing sector of the DPRK boosts the production of aquatic products while consolidating its material and technical foundations.
This year, hundreds of fishing boats have been repaired and fishing gear overhauled throughout the Ministry of Fisheries.
The Mundok Fishery Station is increasing fish hauls by proactively creating conditions favorable for fishing.
Kamapho and Unjon fishery stations have raised the haul of fish per netting through active fishing in combination of dispersion and concentration while conducting socialist emulation among units.
The Chongjin feed supply fishery station for the central zoo has conducted an intensive fishing campaign in the main fishing grounds after capturing the sea conditions and the motion of shoals through analysis based on satellite information data and scientific fishing detection.
Pupho and Ongjin offshore farms and the Kumipho Fishery Station are turning out a large amount of kelp through the scientific cultivation.
The Wonsan Marine Product Processing Station and the Songdowon Fishery Station are registering high results in the production of mussel.
Fishery stations and offices for stocking rivers with fishes under the Sinpho Distant-Sea Fishery Complex released millions of fry including flat-fish and salmon into the sea. -0-

headline: Many People Visit Class Education House
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 10 (KCNA) -- Many people in the DPRK visit the Sinchon Class Education House. This year, the house has been visited by more than 100 000 officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren.
Officials and lecturers of the Sinchon Class Education House are striving to implant the clear outlook on the arch enemy by explaining with detailed data about the murderous acts of the U.S. imperialists and class enemies, who massacred in the most brutal way over 35 000 innocent inhabitants in Sinchon County, one-fourth of its population, during the last Fatherland Liberation War on the part of the Korean people.

Students ofKim Il SungUniversity and Kang Pan Sok Senior Middle School cherished once again the truth that any illusion about the enemy is just death, looking at wax figures and exhibits vividly showing the atrocities of the beasts.

headline: Letter to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un from Congratulatory Group of Association of Young Korean Nationals in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the congratulatory group of the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, who took part in the celebrations of the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, on May 8.
In the letter they said that it was their greatest honor and fortune to attend the celebrations of the Eleventh SPYL Congress as members of the congratulatory group representing the association and all the Korean youths in China.
Their home-visiting days still make them feel great excitement and strong emotion as everything they saw, heard and felt was wonderful while receiving the news of the congress of the youth in the homeland that made them filled with youthful vigor and their hearts burn with ardent patriotism, the letter said.
The letter noted that the traces left by the youth together with the motherland in the past five years and the victorious results achieved at the cost of blood and sweat, especially the heroic military feats made by the brave soldiers in the overseas military operations in the alien battlefields for defending justice and peace, have purified their spirit and made their hearts pulsate with the blood of patriotism.
All the victories and glories of the invincible youth power and the epics of the heroic struggle representing the youth in the era ofKim Jong Unare the brilliant fruition of the ideas of valuing the youth of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho gave the youth the precious appellation the reserves of the Workers' Party of Korea and successors to the Juche revolution and brings them up with passion and affection, love and trust, the letter said.
The letter stressed that they would keep in mind the honor of taking part in the celebrations of the Eleventh SPYL Congress as the most precious treasure of their lives and keep pace with the dynamic spirit and rapid advance of the youth in the homeland who have strong sense of justice and ardent patriotism anytime and anywhere. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un from Congratulatory Group of Korean Youth League in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the congratulatory group of the Korean Youth League in Japan on May 9.
In the letter, the congratulatory group members expressed gratitude in reflection of all the Korean youths and students in Japan to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unfor inviting them to the homeland at an important time when the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League took place to participate in its celebrations, being considerate of the intention of the Korean youths and students in Japan, and showing special loving care for them during their stay.
They said that their time in the homeland was unforgettable days when they keenly felt the intense loyalty, ardent patriotism and indomitable fighting spirit of the youth in the homeland who are erecting edifices for new life and new well-being of the people through the unyielding struggle in the van of building a socialist power.
While enjoying the evening gala and torchlight procession of youth and students and the performance of the art squad of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and schoolchildren held to mark the Eleventh SPYL Congress which fully demonstrated the revolutionary enthusiasm of the passionate youth, they keenly realized the unshakable faith and firm pledge of the youth in the homeland to build a manifold fortress around the respected MarshalKim Jong Unand only follow the road of invariable loyalty and repayment under his guidance forever, the letter noted.
In the letter, they vowed to play a vanguard role in the patriotic movement for glorifying the new decade's struggle of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and make the Korean community in Japan seethe with youthful vigor of new generation, while breathing the same breath and taking the same step with the youth in the homeland, true to the important letter sent by the respected Marshal on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the formation of Chongryon.
They wished the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of the Korean youths and students in Japan and their destiny and future, good health. -0-

headline: Pattern of Three Animals on Children's Socks
story_text:
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory one day in August 2014.

Looking at the senior official of the factory with a smile on his face, he said it would be good to put on socks a pattern of raccoon dog, cat and bear, three friends on the cartoon film "The Clever Raccoon Dog".
The senior official, looking up to him who had a broad smile on his face as if he had pictured the children putting on socks with delight, was deeply moved by his noble intention to implant in our children the attitude of loving and valuing our own things.
Thus, socks with a pattern of three friends on the animated cartoon "The Clever Raccoon Dog" came into being. -0-

Young People Volunteer for Major Theaters of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- Tens of young people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered for major posts of socialist construction.
Youth league members in Ragwon County requested their organization to dispatch them to the Ragwon County Offshore Farm, and a senior middle school teacher in Sapho District of Hamhung City vowed to work at a mountain village school.
Young people in the counties of Jongphyong, Sinhung and Pukchong volunteered to work at construction brigade, goat farm, raw material base and work-teams maintaining roads over mountains. And those in Tanchon City, Jangjin County and other areas decided to work devotedly for the sake of the country and its people.
A meeting was held in Hamhung City on May 10 to congratulate those volunteers.
Present at the meeting were officials concerned, youth league officials, youth and students. At the meeting, petition certificates were conferred on the volunteers. And then a congratulatory speech and resolution-making speeches were made.
Officials, youth and students warmly saw off the volunteers leaving for their new revolutionary posts. -0-

headline: Significant Research Successes Made in Various Units of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, significant research successes have been made in various units of the DPRK.
The Metal Materials Institute of the Material Science Faculty ofKim Il SungUniversity developed a technology for producing various kinds of titanium carbide metal ceramic cutting tools for CNC machine tools. This technology provides a guarantee to mass-produce cutting tools with domestic resources as the main raw materials, opening another prospect for solving the problem of tools in the machine-building industry.
The Electronics Faculty of Kim Chaek University of Technology developed a multimedia display for vehicles in combination of a rearview system. This product with camera monitoring, video recording and multimedia display functions was introduced into the 80hp homemade tractors, and its developers won a certificate of introduction of the state sci-tech achievements.
The Medical Appliances Research Institute of the Medical Appliances Industry Management Bureau under the Ministry of Public Health developed Korean-style infrared and ultraviolet irradiation therapy devices and photoelectric colorimeter for medical treatment.
The infrared therapy device proves effective in the treatment of various diseases and the ultraviolet irradiation therapy device is used for skin diseases. The photoelectric colorimeter is a test instrument for various chronic diseases and is being introduced into the newly-built city and county hospitals and provincial general hospitals.
These medical appliances won a high appreciation at the last year's national exhibition of sci-tech achievements in public health sector. -0-

headline: Custom for Utilizing Matrimony Vine Fruits in Kyongsong of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 11 (KCNA) -- The custom for utilizing matrimony vine fruits in the area of Kyongsong was registered as the local intangible cultural heritage of the DPRK in 2025.
From long ago, inhabitants in the Sungam area of Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province, the original place of matrimony vine in the DPRK, have hedged their houses with matrimony vines to use their fruits for diet or medical care.
Matrimony vine fruits there are in high demand among the people because of their high medicinal value.
The county is increasing their products in conformity with the characteristics of the area most suitable for the cultivation and growth of matrimony vine.
The Kyongsong County Foodstuff Factory has produced various kinds of products with matrimony vine fruits.
Those products were highly favored by visitors at a show of products of newly-built regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties and the light industrial goods exhibition "Development of Light Industry-2025" held last year. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 12 (KCNA) -- Last century, the Japanese imperialists were hell-bent on the moves to obliterate the Korean language, making absurd sophism that "the Japanese and the Korean are of the same ancestry" and "Japan and Korea are one community", after occupying Korea by force of arms.
They mobilized the government-general in Korea and provincial and county offices, police stations and substations and all other administrative and police organs as well as the military policemen to obliterate the Korean language. They even declared without hesitation that Japanese was a "mother tongue" compulsory for the Koreans.
The government-general in Korea established a system of making and submitting "a report on the training course on mother tongue (Japanese language)" from November 1912, and subsequently took a coercive measure to write all the official documents in Japanese.
The Japanese imperialists cooked up a lot of evil laws aimed at obliterating the Korean language and furthermore fabricated and revised the "Ordinance on Education in Korea" several times, which reflected the aggressive and brigandish demand that the important purpose of general education is to disseminate the Japanese language and the Korean language is defined as an optional subject at middle schools.
They demanded to compile textbooks in Japanese and, on the other hand, imposed such harsh sanctions on students speaking in Korean as insults, fines and expulsion from schools.
They refused to sell train tickets to those who were not speaking in Japanese and punished them with fines or used violence against them. The Japanese imperialists' moves to obliterate the Korean language, which were viciously perpetrated in all fields of family and social life, led to their evil acts to even deprive the Koreans of their surnames and names.
They recklessly oppressed the Koreans who did not change their names into the ones in Japanese and even rejected the reports of birth.
The Japanese imperialists' brigandish and vicious moves to obliterate the Korean language, unprecedented in history, were terrible mental torture forced on the Korean people. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 12 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Ju Hyon, a woman living in Neighborhood No. 17 of Jangchung-dong No.2 in Songyo District of Pyongyang on her 100th birthday.
Deeply moved to receive the birthday spread amid congratulations of officials of the Songyo District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and neighbors, the centenarian expressed thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of a large socialist family.
She, born in an alien land and forced to hard labor since her childhood with the sorrow of statelessness, could lead a genuine life as a human being only after returning to liberated Korea.
In the period of the last Fatherland Liberation War and socialist construction, she worked devotedly out of a single mind to repay the benevolence of the Party which put her forward as a master of the country, and brought up her children well so that they could dedicate themselves to the national prosperity. -0-

headline: Abundant Spring Water Resources for Medical Treatment in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 12 (KCNA) -- There are springs gushing out from mountains among the abundant mineral water resources in the DPRK.
The spring water resources for medical treatment are one of the effective means for promoting the people's health and treating diseases and one of the country's precious natural resources for medical treatment.
From olden times, the Korean ancestors called spring water gushing out from mountains the one for longevity.
The DPRK has many springs that conform to the standard of health and longevity assessment.
In the capital city of Pyongyang, there are tens of healthy springs with a high mineral content including Mangyongdae Spring Water Nos. 1 and 2.
Sindok Spring Water in Onchon County, registered as a natural monument, is well known to the world for its water quality.
Besides, there are many springs in every part of the country, including Yangdok Spring Water, Okgye Spring Water, Tami Spring Water, Ryonggang Spring Water, Thaetan Spring Water and Yonthan Spring Water.
Jongbangsan Spring Water, too, has good taste, health and longevity indexes.
The DPRK is steadily exploring new spring water resources. -0-

The Japanese imperialists cooked up a lot of evil laws aimed at obliterating the Korean language and furthermore fabricated and revised the "Ordinance on Education in Korea" several times, which reflected the aggressive and brigandish demand that the important purpose of general education is to disseminate the Japanese language and the Korean language is defined as an optional subject at middle schools.
They demanded to compile textbooks in Japanese and, on the other hand, imposed such harsh sanctions on students speaking in Korean as insults, fines and expulsion from schools.
They refused to sell train tickets to those who were not speaking in Japanese and punished them with fines or used violence against them. The Japanese imperialists' moves to obliterate the Korean language, which were viciously perpetrated in all fields of family and social life, led to their evil acts to even deprive the Koreans of their surnames and names.
They recklessly oppressed the Koreans who did not change their names into the ones in Japanese and even rejected the reports of birth.
The Japanese imperialists' brigandish and vicious moves to obliterate the Korean language, unprecedented in history, were terrible mental torture forced on the Korean people. -0-

headline: Congratulatory Letter of C.C., WPK to Ninth Congress of GFTUK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory letter to the participants in the Ninth Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea and the workers and trade union members across the country on May 11.
In the letter, the WPK Central Committee said that the period under review of the GFTUK is shining with the pride and honor of the trade union organizations and their officials and workers who have injected vigor and vitality into the advance of the Korean revolution by turning out as one to live up to the expectation of the Party Central Committee which put them forward as the vanguard unit in the struggle for fresh upswing and development of socialist construction.
The atmosphere of performing collective feats to attain the 12 major goals of national economic development and fulfill the five-year plan was given further momentum and a steady upsurge took place in the struggle to implement the decisions of the Party Congress as the organizations at all levels and officials of the GFTUK vigorously organized mass patriotic movement while focusing on the fresh education to enhance the political consciousness of the trade union members and enlist their spiritual strength at production sites, the letter said, and went on:
The heroic struggle of workers at the Ryongsong Machine Complex to keep the pledge they made before the Party without fail through perseverance for the honor of the working class of the new generation created the Chollima spirit of the new era, and the dynamic drive for increased production and creation of the workers in the field of building materials including the workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex, who broke the highest records every year, has made a great contribution to boosting the enthusiasm for a leap forward across the country and bringing about eye-opening changes in the capital city and regional areas.
Thanks to the ardent patriotic loyalty and sincere efforts of the workers in the coal-mining industry, who turned out in the socialist patriotic movement for increased coal production, and other workers in the key industry sectors and light industry sector, the foundations of the self-supporting economy could be consolidated and the validity and vitality of the Party and state policies for the people and the rising generation clearly demonstrated despite the unprecedented difficulties.
In the fields of science, education, public health, literature and arts, too, our working people made achievements in putting the national economy on a modern and IT basis and bringing about a radical improvement in education and public health in the new century and brought good results for promoting the people's wellbeing and civilization, thus making a positive contribution to ushering in a new era of progress and development.
The workers and trade union members in the field of munitions industry have made a great contribution to firmly consolidating the national defence capabilities by achieving outstanding successes one after another in the production of cutting-edge military hardware as planned and intended by the Party.
The steadfast revolutionary spirit of devoting oneself to the self-reliant and hard-fought struggle for increased production with the unshakable faith in socialism served as a powerful motive force for demonstrating the new heyday of the DPRK and a precious asset for building a rich country with a strong army, and gave great strength and encouragement to the WPK which is leading the socialist cause, overcoming all obstacles and challenges.
The struggle of new stage to make the period of unprecedented upturn in the state development lead onto a period of steady upswing requires the working class, the main force of socialist construction, to enhance their vanguard role in all spheres of ideology, technology and culture and bring about a radical improvement in the fighting efficiency and mode of activities of the GFTUK.
It is the basic task facing the GFTUK at present to prepare its members and workers to be revolutionized and patriotic core force capable of more dynamically leading the great new era for national development and the powerful vanguard for carrying out the three revolutions.
The GFTUK, as an organization for ideological education both in name and reality, should direct primary efforts to the ideological and spiritual growth of the workers and its members and conduct all its work with the main emphasis on training them to be the masters of the new era with high creativity and cultural and moral traits.
All its members should bear in mind the Party's intention to further intensify the transformation of the society on a revolutionary and working-class pattern, make deliberate efforts to equip with the features and traits befitting the advanced class and play the role of standard-bearer in establishing a revolutionary and sound atmosphere throughout the country.
Trade union organizations should establish a cultured way of production and life at the level of the new era and conduct mass sports activities and mass art activities briskly so that every worksite bubbles over with revolutionary optimism and great enthusiasm and the working class continues to glorify their honor as the creators of advanced culture.
The new five-year plan period is a very important time when the patriotic enthusiasm and execution power of the working class and trade union members, who are very faithful to the cause of the Party and state and their responsibility as the eldest son of the country, should be redoubled.
Trade union organizations should ensure that the working class and trade union members turn out as one to perform proud feats and make miraculous successes from the first year of implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, bearing deep in mind the importance and significance of duties of their sectors and units in the course of the development of the new stage.
The success in strengthening the GFTUK depends on the role of its officials. In particular, only when a change is made in the ideological consciousness, work style, qualifications and traits of the officials of the GFTUK Central Committee and the provincial, city and county committees of the GFTUK, can the overall work of the GFTUK be conducted vigorously with fresh vigour.
In the present era, when we can develop non-stop only by a new leap forward and miraculous increased production, the Party's expectation for the GFTUK is very great.
The WPK Central Committee in its congratulatory letter said that it is confident that all the working class and trade union members will fully demonstrate their honor as the most thoroughgoing champion and implementer of the Party's policies and core unit of socialist construction in the future struggle for carrying out the new five-year plan just as they brought about a change of the new era to be specially recorded in the history, true to the Party's leadership. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Several Munitions Industrial Enterprises
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at several munitions industrial enterprises on May 11.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence, and Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences.
ComradeKim Jong Unvisited several munitions industrial enterprises to learn about the implementation of munitions production assignments for the first half of the year 2026.
He expressed thanks for the patriotic devotion of the workers in the munitions industry, who are making a great contribution to strengthening the combat power of our armed forces by achieving record growth in the production of various shells and bullets in hearty response to the decisions of the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK, and gave encouragement to them.
Referring to the defects still latent in the structure, production system and facilities of our munitions industry, he stressed the need to concentrate on the modernization such as practical upgrading of production structure and rational arrangement of production lines and to wage a dynamic struggle intended to optimize the technical control and the management of talents and workforce and steadily increase the efficiency of production.
He also underlined the need for the munitions industrial enterprises to further modernize the product inspection system and to subdivide the inspection indices in a more scientific way and thoroughly establish a habit of strictly adhering to them.
He said that it is important to consistently hold fast to the modernization of munitions production equipment and the improvement of production environments and conditions and the promotion of supply service for the employees.
Acquainting himself with the production at a bullet production factory that day, he set forth an important task for establishing the production system to meet the demands for high-precision multi-purpose bullets of different calibers, special-function bullets and training bullets.
He repeatedly stressed the need to strengthen the mortar and howitzer forces and advanced some important tasks for setting up a specialized artillery production complex and a small-arms production factory to meet the prospective demand of our armed forces and for improving the production structure and the level of modernization and specialization of bullet and shell production factories.
He expressed expectation and belief that the officials and workers in the sector of munitions industry would make strenuous efforts to achieve the higher goal of strengthening the defence capabilities with redoubled confidence and inexhaustible creativity, true to the spirit and tasks of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
The tasks and important instructions, given by ComradeKim Jong Unduring his field guidance at the enterprises, are scientific and vital guidelines indicating the shortest and correct way to the modernization of our munitions industry, and they serve as an important milestone for bringing about a radical turn in implementing the Party's policy of building up the national defence by further accelerating the qualitative, quantitative and technical transformation in munitions production. -0-

headline: Special Envoy of General Secretary of C.C.,  Communist Party of Vietnam Arrives

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The Ninth Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea was held here on May 11 and 12.
The congress analyzed and reviewed in depth the work done by the GFTUK during the period under review and discussed the practical tasks and ways for the federation to fully discharge its mission and role as an ideological education organization in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea by radically improving its work as required by the era of comprehensive development.
Present there were the members of the 8th-term GFTUK central leadership and delegates elected by trade union organizations at all levels.
Officials of the Party, armed forces organs, ministries and national agencies and those concerned were on hand as observers.
The platform was taken by Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Ju Chang Il, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Kim Tok Hun, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and first vice-premier of the Cabinet, executive members of the C.C., GFTUK, chairpersons of the provincial committees of the GFTUK, exemplary trade union officials and members and officials in charge of the trade union work of armed forces organs.
The congress elected the presidium and the secretariat.
The agenda items discussed at the congress are as follows:
1. Review of the Work of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea
2. On the Revision of the GFTUK Rules
3. Election of the Central Leadership of the GFTUK
Kim Jae Ryong read out a congratulatory letter of the Central Committee of the WPK to the participants in the Ninth Congress of the GFTUK and all the workers and trade union members across the country.
The WPK Central Committee in the letter said that the period under review of the GFTUK is shining with the pride and honor of the trade union organizations and their officials and workers who injected vigor and vitality into the advance of our revolution by turning out as one to live up to the expectations of the Party Central Committee which put them forward in the vanguard of the struggle for fresh upswing and development in  socialist construction, and highly appreciated their responsible and devoted efforts for it.
The period of the new Five-Year Plan is a very important period when the patriotic enthusiasm and practical ability of the working class and trade union members, who are intensely loyal to the cause of the Party and the state and their responsibility as the eldest son of the country, should be redoubled, the letter said, indicating the basic tasks and ways for the GFTUK in inspiring the working people to perform proud feats from the first year of implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Ri Won Jong, chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK, made a report on the first agenda item.
The reporter reviewed the work of the 8th-term GFTUK Central Committee.
He referred to the fact that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unput forward the working class and trade union members as the vanguard and backbone unit that are taking the lead in ushering in a new era of upsurge for the comprehensive national prosperity and developed the GFTUK into an ideologically pure and organizationally integrated entity for the past five years.
He noted that a great upsurge in production has been brought about and unprecedented successes achieved in increasing production in the major fields of implementing the Five-Year Plan set forth by the Eighth Congress of the WPK thanks to the patriotic devotion and extraordinary creativity of the working class and trade union members.
He said that true to the intention of the Party Central Committee to prepare the GFTUK to be a revolutionary organization by preserving its nature as a mass political organization of the working class, the GFTUK has attached importance to its internal work and raised a strong wind of enhancing its fighting efficiency and strengthening its primary organizations.
All the successes achieved during the period under review are the brilliant fruition of the wise leadership of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho led our workers in every aspect of their work to remain faithful to the historic mission they assumed before the Party and the country, the times and the revolution, the reporter stressed.
He called for bringing about a radical improvement in the GFTUK work as required by the era of comprehensive development.
The report analyzed and reviewed a series of deviations revealed by trade union organizations at all levels during the period under review and their causes on the basis of detailed data and indicated practical ways for putting the GFTUK work on the track of new qualitative development.
The reporter called for more dynamically conducting the revolutionary mass movement, the socialist patriotic movement to arouse the enthusiasm, initiative and ingenuity of the trade union members and make miracles and innovations on all fronts of economic construction.
Speeches were made on the first agenda item.
20 delegates including Kong Un Chol, delegate of the trade union organization of South Hamgyong Province, Ri Kwang Dok, delegate of the trade union organization of the Pyongyang Construction Commission, and Kim Yong Chol, delegate of the trade union organization of the Ministry of Railways made speeches and presented written speeches.
The congress discussed the revision of the GFTUK Rules as its second agenda item.
There was a report on the revision of the trade union rules.
The reporter submitted the revised rules for deliberation at the congress.
The congress adopted a decision on the revision of the GFTUK rules with full approval.
The congress discussed the election of the Central Leadership of the GFTUK as the third agenda item.
First, the Central Committee of the GFTUK was elected.
All the candidates were elected members and alternate members of the GFTUK Central Committee with the unanimous approval of the delegates.
The First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the GFTUK was held.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made public a decision of the plenary meeting.
The Executive Committee of the GFTUK Central Committee was elected.
Ri Won Jong was elected chairman of the Central Committee of the GFTUK and Choe Jong Chol, Choe Song Nam, Pak Yang Thae and Kim Song Ho were elected vice-chairmen.
The Organizing Committee of the Central Committee of the GFTUK was formed.
The chairperson, vice-chairpersons and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the GFTUK were elected.
Department directors of the Central Committee of the GFTUK were appointed.
The congress elected a committee for drafting the decision of the congress with members of the newly elected ninth-term central leadership of the GFTUK, and the committee deliberated the realistic and constructive opinions raised by delegates and supplemented the draft decision.
The decision of the Ninth Congress of the GFTUK was adopted with unanimous approval.
A letter of pledge to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted at the congress. -0-

headline: Technology of Making Colorful Painting - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 13 (KCNA) -- The technology of making colorful painting is one of the intangible cultural heritages of the DPRK.
The colorful painting is used in decorating or painting patterns with various colors on woods, walls and ceilings of buildings.
It came into being from application of organic preservatives to prevent the corrosion of woods in buildings.
Animal and vegetable oils were used as surface adhesives.
Koguryo tomb murals discovered so far are relatively good for preservation state, thus giving a presentation of the splendid colors at that time.
The main colors used in the Koguryo tomb murals were red, yellowish brown, yellow, green, blue, dark blue, purple, etc.
In the period of Koryo, a systematic color scheme was formed, free from the primitive mode of colouring.
As history develops and the level of people's consciousness is gradually on a higher stage, the aesthetic demands have been increased.
From such demands, the art of colorful painting has steadily developed. Through the course, paints and adhesives suited to the characteristics of timbers have emerged.
And it developed into a decorative method of painting pictures or patterns on columns, rafters and ceilings of buildings as its ever-increasing decorative significance.
The technology of making colorful painting, which has been handed down through a long historical transformation process, was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in November 2023. -0-

headline: Mausoleum of King Tongmyong
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- In Ryongsan-ri, Ryokpho District, Pyongyang Municipality, there is the Mausoleum of King Tongmyong (B.C.298 - B.C.259), the founder of Koguryo, which demonstrated its might as a powerful state that existed in the East for one thousand years.
In front of the gate of the mausoleum is the "Monument to the Reconstruction of the Mausoleum of King Tongmyong" with the autographic letters of PresidentKim Il Sung.
The mausoleum consists of the tomb with more than 160 platforms, the image of King Tongmyong, over 30 stone sculptures, dozens of fine art pieces showing the fortitude and customs of the Koguryo people, the Jongrung Temple and other architectural structures.
In its surrounding, there are the Jinju pond, vast open space, armful-thick pine trees, greenery and flowering plants, resembling a recreation ground.
The mausoleum, which was destroyed beyond recognition owing to the Japanese imperialists' vicious moves to obliterate the national culture and to the three-year Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953), was wonderfully reconstructed thanks to the wise leadership of the President.
When he visited the mausoleum in August 1953, PresidentKim Il Sungsaw to it that an excavating team with experts was organized to comprehensively unearth and ascertain it, and gave an instruction on sprucing up the surrounding area.
Later, he went round the mausoleum several times to ensure that the principle of the Juche character and the principle of historicism were maintained in excavating and restoring the mausoleum and clarified in detail the issues arising in doing so.
Under his meticulous guidance, the mausoleum was inaugurated on May 14, 1993 as a precious national cultural heritage of the Korean people and a relic of national treasure.
The Mausoleum of King Tongmyong was registered as a world cultural heritage in July 2004. -0-

headline: Secretary and Director of International Department of C.C.,WPK Meets Special Envoy of General Secretary of C.C., CPV and President of SRV
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau, secretary and director of the International Department of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, met Le Hoai Trung, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam and foreign minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, on a visit to the DPRK as a special envoy of the general secretary of the CPV Central Committee who is president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on May 13.
Kim Song Nam said that the WPK would further boost exchange and cooperation with the CPV as the DPRK-Vietnam friendly relations have been put on a new level with the historic Pyongyang meeting of ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade To Lam in October last year as an occasion.
Le Hoai Trung informed him of the successful 14th Congress of the CPV and expressed the steadfast stand of the CPV to develop the friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK which have been firmly consolidated on the road of advancing the socialist cause.
Both sides discussed the issue of strengthening the political ties between the WPK and the CPV and other topics of common concern and reached a consensus of views on them.
Present there from the DPRK side were Vice Department Director Mun Song Hyok and other officials of the International Department of the WPK Central Committee and from the Vietnamese side the special envoy's party and Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Vietnam
Secretary and Director of International Department of C.C.,WPK Meets Special Envoy of General Secretary of C.C., CPV and President of SRV
Afforestation and Forest Conservation in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unmade public the immortal classical work"Modern Tree Nurseries Should Be Built to Conduct a More Vigorous Forest Restoration Campaign"on May 14, 2016.
The work indicates the tasks and ways for covering the whole country with trees and flowers, including the issue of building land- and labor-saving tree nurseries that produce saplings in a scientific, industrial and intensive way in all provinces and the issue of dynamically conducting a mass movement for bringing about a turn in afforestation and forest conservation.
Thanks to his patriotic intention to turn the DPRK into a socialist paradise with green woods, signal progress has been made in the work for forest restoration over the past decade.
Following the construction of the splendid Kangwon Provincial Tree Nursery, tree nurseries with automated and streamlined production lines sprang up in North Hamgyong Province and other provinces.
Material and technical foundations were strengthened at city and county tree nurseries. As a result, the nationwide sapling production has increased more than two times as compared with the one of ten years ago and the area planted with trees expanded every year. In the course, more than 12 000 units won the title of Socialist Patriotic Forest.
Forest science research bases were built across the country to further enliven the afforestation and forest conservation based on science and technology.
This year, the second forest restoration campaign began. Amid the great patriotic zeal of all the people for increasing the country's forest resources, 100 million and tens of millions of trees were planted throughout the country in spring alone.
The country is turning green as afforestation and forest conservation is being pushed forward at a new stage across the country. -0-

story_text:

Talks Held between Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Vietnam
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 14 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Le Hoai Trung, foreign minister of Vietnam on a visit to the DPRK as a special envoy of the general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam who is president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on May 13.
Choe Son Hui expressed the stand of the DPRK government to develop the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between the DPRK and Vietnam in conformity with the aspirations and desire of the two peoples on the basis of the spirit of the agreement made between the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries at the historic Pyongyang meeting in October 2025.
Le Hoai Trung said that To Lam, general secretary of the C.C., Communist Party of Vietnam and president of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and the Vietnamese party, state and people are always paying deep attention to consistently giving importance to and strengthening the friendly and cooperative relations with the DPRK, wishing the Korean people bigger success in their struggle to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
At the talks both sides agreed to further deepen exchange and cooperation between the two countries in various fields and strengthen strategic communication and support and collaboration between foreign policy organs. And they exchanged views on regional and international issues.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Vice-Minister Pak Sang Gil and other officials of the Foreign Ministry and from the Vietnamese side the special envoy's party and Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK gave a reception in welcome of the special envoy that evening. -0-

headline: Photo of Blessing
story_text:
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited an air force unit of the Korean People's Army on March 8, 2015.
Cooks of the unit, who were busy with preparing meals for the pilots, wanted to see him even for a moment.
The ordinary cooks came to realize their wishes, because the respected General Secretary entered the kitchen with a bright smile on his face.
Warmly returning the salute of the cooks, he congratulated them devoting themselves to the pilots on the March 8 International Women's Day.
The cooks, who had been moved by simple words of their husbands' congratulation and the pilots' sincere flowers, received the blessing of the respected General Secretary. Their emotion and joy were infinite.
When leaving the kitchen, he said that he was going to have a photo taken with the cooks working hard for the pilots on the March 8 International Women's Day, and called them out to have a photo session with them.
The photo taken on the March 8 International Women's Day conveys the benevolence and magnanimousness of the respected General Secretary who wants to hold the DPRK women in high esteem as the happiest and dignified women in the world. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The embassy of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam in Pyongyang organized a photo exhibition and a friendly gathering at the Taedonggang Diplomatic Club on May 14 to congratulate the successful holding of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the 14th Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Displayed at the venue of the exhibition were photos showing the immortal exploits performed by PresidentKim Il Sung, ChairmanKim Jong Iland the respected ComradeKim Jong Untogether with the party and state leaders of Vietnam for the development of the friendly relations between the two parties and the two countries.
Present there on invitation were Pak Sang Gil, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and officials concerned.

headline: Special Envoy of General Secretary of C.C., CPV and His Party Visit Central Cadres Training School of WPK
Answer Given by DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on May 15 as regards the fact that Britain committed an extremely provocative act of putting the Songdowon International Children's Camp into the recently-issued list of sanctions against Russia:
On May 11, the British Foreign Office included our Songdowon International Children's Camp in the list of sanctions, while announcing "sanctions measures" against Russia's "organizational activities" to "forcibly transfer" and "militarize" Ukrainian children.
Britain's such reckless act is a heinous unethical politically-motivated provocation to tarnish the external image of our state and disparage the DPRK-Russia relations of friendship and cooperation by unreasonably linking our children's camping facility with the groundless issue of "forcible migration" of Ukrainian children.
We strongly denounce and reject the malicious act of the British government which targets even the camp, a sacred base for education and growth of children, for achieving its purpose of political machination.
So far, Britain has followed zealously the U.S. acts of hostility toward the DPRK, taken issue in every way with the exercise of sovereign rights of our state and participated in the war drills against the DPRK at any time, thus systematically aggravating the bilateral relations.
The British government's recent designation of the Songdowon International Children's Camp as a target of "sanctions" as part of its conspiratorial moves to demonize Russia is an intolerable insult to our dignified state and proves that its hostility toward the DPRK is exceeding the limits.
Now that Britain has committed such reckless acts as toying with even the rights and interests of the children that our state values the most, we have the adequate rights to counter London's malicious behavior.
The British government will be wholly responsible for all the consequences to be entailed from its grave hostile act toward our state. -0-

headline: Area of Oil Crop Cultivation Expanded in N. Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK is expanding the area of oil crop cultivation.
The province disseminated the experience gained in oil crop cultivation and its economic benefits and ensured that cities and counties gave precedence to securing seeds.
It selected a model unit and conducted a demonstration on scientific and technological problems arising in cultivating rape as an earlier crop to heighten the enthusiasm for emulation among cities and counties for introducing high-yielding oil crops.
As a result, not only the city and county raw material bases but also many farms planted rape as the first crop, thus increasing the area of oil crop cultivation by hundreds of hectares.
The province is encouraging cities and counties to cultivate oil crops suited to their geographical and climatic conditions. -0-

headline: Juche-oriented Architecture
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The 23rd May 21 Architectural Festival is under way at the Sci-Tech Complex in the DPRK.
At the festival held on the theme of "Comprehensive development of socialism to a higher stage and Juche-oriented architecture", visitors are greatly impressed by the rapid development of Juche-oriented architecture.
Under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, new streets boasting of modern architectural beauty have been built in Pyongyang every year, and dwelling houses peculiar to each region constructed in local areas, changing the appearance of the country from day to day.
In recent years, modern streets including Songhwa Street, Hwasong Street and the Pothonggang Riverside Terraced Residential District, and bases for cultural life have been built, adding to the grace and solemnity of Pyongyang.
Every street has symbolic buildings representing the overall architectural formation and ensured artistic mutuality, compatibility and connectivity in the formation of streets by diversifying architectural shapes and colors.
Cultured country towns and modern villages were built across the country, demonstrating the development of regional construction.
In particular, modern urban-style high- and low-storied buildings were built in Hadan-ri, Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province, showing a new appearance of rural development.
New streets, cultured country towns and modern villages in the capital and local areas are the precious fruition of the people-first idea and architectural aesthetic idea of the Party. -0-

DPRK Team Advances to Final of 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The semifinal for the 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup was held between DPRK and Chinese teams on May 14.
The DPRK team defeated the Chinese team 4:2 and advanced to the final.
The final will take place on May 17. -0-

headline: Second Enlarged Plenary Meeting of Eleventh C.C., SPYL Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The Second Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League was held in the DPRK on May 14.
Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the youth league.
Present there as observers were officials of the Central Committee of the youth league, and ministry, national agency, provincial, city and county committees of the youth league.
The meeting discussed the issue of thoroughly implementing the tasks set forth in the congratulatory letter sent by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to the participants in the Eleventh Congress of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League and other young people across the country.
First of all, the congratulatory letter was read out at the meeting.
Then resolution-making speeches were made.
The speakers said that they would conduct proactive political and ideological education methodologically to arouse all the youth league organizations and members to the struggle to thoroughly carry out the tasks advanced in the congratulatory letter.
They expressed their resolve to bring about a radical turn in the work of the youth league by fundamentally improving the style and manner of work with the Party's ideas and policies as absolute standards, and to prepare youth league members to be true young vanguard who will dedicate themselves to building a prosperous country with their noble loyalty to the Party and ardent patriotism.
The meeting studied and discussed the tasks and ways of making the future five years a more powerful dynamic period of the Korean youth movement by conducting the ideological work for steadily increasing the revolutionary spirit and enthusiasm of the young people so that all the youth league organizations and members will take the lead in carrying out the new Five-Year Plan.
The meeting adopted a relevant decision on the basis of the study and discussion of the draft decision. -0-

headline: DPRK Player Wins Three Gold Medals in 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- DPRK player Kim Il Gyong won three gold medals in the women's 58kg category of the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships on May 13.
She took the first place in snatch, clean and jerk and total respectively by lifting 105kg in snatch (new Asian record), 125kg in clean and jerk and 230kg in total.
Meanwhile, in men's 65kg category, Pak Myong Jin bagged silver medals in clean and jerk and total, and a bronze medal in snatch. -0-

headline: 23rd May 21 Architectural Festival Opens in DPRK
Young People Volunteer for Major Theatres of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- Tens of young people in North Hamgyong Province in the DPRK volunteered for the major theatres of socialist construction.
Those in Myonggan and Kyonghung counties pledged to devote their sincere efforts to implementing the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on regional development.
Those in Chongjin City, and Kyongsong, Orang and Kyongwon counties volunteered to work at city and county construction brigades.
Among the volunteers are young people in Hoeryong City and Myongchon County who petitioned to work at mines and farms.
A meeting was held in Chongjin City on Thursday to congratulate the volunteers.
Present at the meeting were officials concerned, youth league officials and youth.
Petition certificates were conferred on the volunteers and then a congratulatory speech and resolution-making speeches were made.
At the end of the meeting there was an art performance congratulating the volunteers.
Youth and students warmly saw off the volunteers leaving for new revolutionary posts, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Participants in Ninth GFTUK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 15 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had a photo session with the participants in the Ninth Congress of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea on May 14.
The venue of the photo session was filled with great excitement and joy of the participants who took part in the significant congress held amid the great interest of the working people across the country out in the struggle for a new stage of transformation in socialist construction and had the highest honor and happiness they wished for even in their dreams.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue, a stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" burst out.
All the participants paid the highest tribute to him, who respectfully put forward our working class and trade union members as the core unit of the revolution and self-reliant vanguard and bestowed deep trust and love on them so that they could demonstrate the proud honor of the socialist patriotic workers in the van of the struggle for national prosperity.
ComradeKim Jong Unmet and congratulated the newly elected chairman and vice-chairmen of the 9th Central Committee of the GFTUK. And he appreciated the efforts of the meritorious trade union officials and members.
Acknowledging the enthusiastic cheers of the participants, he encouraged them who glorified the Ninth Congress of the GFTUK as a significant occasion for demonstrating cohesion and revolutionary disposition of our working class and trade union members rallied close around the Party and accelerating the all-people advance for implementing the Party's decisions.
He said that in the last five years after the Eighth Congress of the GFTUK, our working people fully demonstrated their intense loyalty to the Party, patriotic consciousness and inexhaustible creativity. He highly appreciated that the outstanding feats of the working class, who broke precedents, went beyond limitations and proved that anything is possible to push ahead with the overall socialist construction, and the role of the GFTUK in mobilizing the ideological power served as a great strength for the Party which ushered in the great pioneering period of the comprehensive rejuvenation.
He stressed that there is no such group in the world as the reliable and loyal working class as they firmly defend the cause of the Party, being a fortress of unshakable faith no matter how frequently the times are changed and a generation is replaced by a new one. He added that the Party Central Committee is vigorously waging the struggle of new-stage transformation for the eye-opening development of the state, believing in the strong revolutionary disposition and patriotic loyalty of all the working people including the heroic workers.
The period of gigantic transformation facing us requires the constant active vanguard role of the working class, the main force of creation and construction, and their extraordinary efforts, he said, stressing that it is the basic task facing the working class and trade union members at the present stage of socialist construction to give fuller play to the fighting spirit of self-reliance and self-sufficiency in all spheres of ideology, technology and culture with absolute confidence in the Party's lines and policies.
Noting that all the workers and trade union members should play a vanguard role for the change of times and dynamically lead the whole country to attain the new five-year goal under the uplifted banner of the three revolutions, he emphasized that it is important for the GFTUK to fulfill its mission and duty as an organization for ideological education in firmly preparing them as a revolutionized and patriotic core force for national development and powerful vanguard for carrying out the three revolutions.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the participants in the congress would become standard-bearers and core elements leading the rapid development of all sectors and units in the worthwhile struggle to build a powerful and prosperous country through more fierce, innovative and determined struggle, and had a meaningful photo session with them.
When the photo session was over, the participants broke into enthusiastic and thunderous cheers, representing the faith and pledge of the working class and trade union members to remain boundlessly loyal to the leadership of the Party.
All the participants made a firm determination to fully demonstrate the self-respect, pluck, resourcefulness and courage of the heroic DPRK working class, socialist workers, and more vigorously struggle for the prosperity of our glorious country and the promotion of the wellbeing of our people, bearing in mind the great trust shown by ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun on Politico-Ideological Might
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Saturday in an article says that the tremendous strength for building a powerful state lies in politico-ideological might.
There is no such precedent in history as the DPRK has pushed its way through the severest trials, the article says, and goes on:
It had been natural in the human history of state development that a country gradually withers away as a series of severe trials sustain. However, the DPRK has worked out miracles despite the unprecedented heavy pressures lasting decade after decade.
In the past ten-odd years, the DPRK brought about a series of eye-opening victories in succession and entered a new era of self-respect and prosperity, pioneering a new trend of comprehensive development despite the harsh trials whereby others would have yielded or collapsed more than a hundred times. If we had not had the politico-ideological might of the leader, the party and the masses united as one, there would have been no present of our powerful state praised by the world people.
Today the Korean revolution has entered a new road of advance toward greater success and change. The decisive guarantee for attaining higher goals on the basis of victory and successes that bravely hewed out the new era of transformation despite all manner of trials is to strengthen the politico-ideological might, the irresistible might of bringing about a steady advance and leap forward of the DPRK.
Today the political and ideological might peculiar to our state is growing stronger under the guidance of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
All the officials, Party members and other working people should give full play to the politico-ideological might of them rallied closer around the General Secretary to strikingly demonstrate the dignity and prestige of our state to the whole world. -0-

headline: Jo Yong Won Meets Special Envoy of General Secretary of C.C., CPV
