headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors of the national economy.
At the Tokchon Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Hoean Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, he called upon officials and coal miners to bear in mind the policy requirement of giving definite precedence to prospecting and tunneling and conduct a dynamic high-speed tunneling campaign so as to keep securing new coal fields and steadily consolidate the material and technical foundations of the coal mines including increasing the capacity to mine and transport coal.
Looking round various production lines of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, he referred to the importance of increased electricity production in carrying out the new long-term plan and stressed the need to actively invent and introduce optimum innovations for further improving the performance of generating equipment and  stably and continuously increasing the power production.
At the Chollima Steel Complex, the premier called for steadily improving the iron production method to suit the specific conditions and, at the same time, further boosting the operating efficiency of equipment and strengthening cooperation between production processes and between shifts in order to fulfill the iron and steel production plan without fail.
Inspecting the Chongsan Farm and other farms in Kangso District, he emphasized the need to actively apply rational methods of manuring and cultivating crops in order to raise the yields of wheat and barley, regarding scientific farming as the lifeline, and to effectively organize and direct farming so that rice transplanting can be finished in the right season and in a qualitative way.
At the Pyongyang Mining Machinery Factory he underlined the need to modernize production lines to radically improve the quality of products. And he called on officials and producers to regularly listen to the opinions of coal miners and other users of equipment and to produce efficient mining equipment in larger quantities.
At the fifth-stage construction site in the Hwasong area, the premier acquainted himself in detail with the construction of major projects and underscored the need for officials and builders to strictly observe the requirements of the construction methods and carry out the construction as planned.
The field consultative meetings on the spots took measures after discussing the issue for the coal, electric-power and metallurgical industrial sectors to work out realistic scientific and technological plans for further increasing the production capacity, the issue for the agricultural sector to actively introduce advanced farming methods for producing high and stable yields despite unfavorable weather conditions, and the issue of providing in time the materials needed for the fifth-stage construction in the Hwasong area and the production of custom-built equipment.
Earlier, the premier learned about the fertilizer production and management at the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: Variety of Traditional Medicines Increased in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- The remodeled city and county Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories in the DPRK are turning out various kinds of efficacious traditional medicines suited to the regional characteristics, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Phyongchon Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, which won the 2025 products exhibition of Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories, has laid a foundation for producing more than 180 kinds of traditional medicines. Medicines and health foods produced at the factory are helpful to promoting the people's health.
The Sinyang County Disabled Soldier's Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory, known as one of the best enterprises, has developed more than 10 kinds of Koryo medicines every year. It is striving to produce more Koryo medicines favoured by the people, including ginseng injection.
Taedonggang, Songyo, Sariwon and many other Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories across the country have increased the variety of traditional medicines. -0-

headline: Irrigation Projects in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- The DPRK is going ahead with the irrigation projects planned for this year.
North Phyongan Province has carried on the work to lay plastic pipelines extending tens of kilometers under the ground in rape fields of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, while  repairing and enlarging the earthen canal of the Thaechon Power Station No. 5-Unjon, Jongju and Kwaksan Waterway.
The province is building a water pumping station necessary for irrigation of paddy fields.
Hwangju County, Yonsan County and other rural areas in North Hwanghae Province are  watering newly-made paddy fields at the final stage, including enlarging waterways, building water pumping stations and installing large-capacity pumping equipment.
South Phyongan Province completed the construction of more than 100 water pumping stations and is carrying on the irrigation projects for paddy and non-paddy fields including the project for waterway structures  for draining flooded areas.
Other regions are completing the planned irrigation projects for paddy and non-paddy fields. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Win Seven Gold Medals in 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 16 (KCNA) -- DPRK players are achieving good results in the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships every day.
They won seven gold medals and set new world and Asian records on Thursday.
In the women's 63kg category, Ri Suk won gold medals in clean and jerk and total and a silver medal in snatch by lifting 111kg in snatch, 143kg in clean and jerk (new world record, new Asian record) and 254kg in total (new world record, new Asian record).
In the men's 71kg category, Ri Won Ju placed first in clean and jerk and total and second in snatch by lifting 154kg in snatch, 197kg in clean and jerk (new world record, new Asian record) and 351kg in total (new world record, new Asian record).
In the men's 79kg category, Ri Ryong Hyon bagged gold medals by lifting 206kg in clean and jerk (new world record, new Asian record) and 364kg in total and a silver medal in snatch. In the same category, Ri Chong Song bagged a gold medal by lifting 161kg in snatch and silver medals in clean and jerk and total respectively. -0-

Scientific Cultivation of Wheat and Barley Promoted
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- Farms in South Phyongan Province, Nampho Municipality, North Hwanghae Province and other parts of the DPRK are tending the earlier crops in the second half of their growth in a sci-tech way.
They have sprayed leaves of the crops with phytosin, multi-element mineral fertilizer and other plant nutrients and growth activators to improve the state of their growth.
At the same time, they have made good use of groundwater-tapping facilities to irrigate the farm fields in a responsible manner in order to ensure proper soil humidity.
Now that rice transplanting has begun, they are digging ditches around the fields and making deep furrows between the levees to prevent water from flowing into the wheat fields.
The farms give farmers the knowledge of kinds of harmful insects and their growth and movements and teach how to exterminate them, while taking strict measures to observe and forecast them and using various germicides and insecticides. -0-

story_text:

The regional-industry factories in Paechon County concentrated efforts on the development of new specialties while increasing the variety of laundry soaps and boosting the output of plastic goods and furniture and improving their quality.

headline: Wheat-Processing Capacity Boosted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the grain administration sector of the DPRK has built new wheat-processing bases and modernized the existing ones now that wheat production increases every year.
Wheat-processing factories with a large capacity were newly built in Kangryong and Singye counties suited to the cultivation of wheat, and similar bases in South Hwanghae Province, Nampho Municipality, North Hwanghae Province and South Hamgyong Province were modernized.
New wheat-processing lines were established at the grain management stations in Sariwon City and other cities and counties to raise the wheat-processing capacity more than two times.
The variety of wheat products is being increased.
The Unchon County Foodstuff Factory raised the variety of wheat products more than four times as compared with the first period of operation, and the Kyongsong County Foodstuff Factory expanded the variety of wheat products, including bread, in a matter of one year.
The Kumya County Foodstuff Factory and other regional-industry factories have made substantial progress by directing efforts to the development of new products to meet the daily-growing demand for wheat products. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Convenes Meeting of Commanding Officers of Divisions and Brigades of Entire Army and Meets Them
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 18 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, convened a meeting of the commanding officers of the divisions and brigades of the entire army on May 17 and met them.
Present there were Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, and Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK.
The commanding officers were filled with great excitement as they were to meet the Supreme Commander at the sacred headquarters building of the Party Central Committee which the KPA service personnel have always cherished in their minds at every post in the sky, ground and sea of the country.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared, the commanding officers broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the outstanding leader of the revolution who is dynamically guiding the inexhaustible development of our army to glory and victory with his distinguished commanding philosophy and art.
Highly appreciating the extraordinary services of the commanding officers who are leading the combined units while devoting their sincere efforts to the country and the people, he warmly encouraged them.
He met the commanding officers of the combined units at all levels of the entire army and had a talk with them on a series of important military issues.
Stressing that the tasks of the commanders of the combined units are very important, he said that the historic assignment to develop our army into the strongest one in the world is entrusted to the commanders of the divisions and brigades. And he referred to the main orientation arising in carrying out the military and political tasks at present.
Reiterating that the training for perfecting the combat preparedness is the main task of the army, he advanced a policy for readjusting the training system and intensifying the practical training in keeping with the changing aspects of modern warfare and the trend of the development of our army.
Noting that a structural measure for updating our army in a military organizational and military technical way is to be taken in the future, he stressed that the responsibility and role of the commanding officers are very important in correctly implementing it.
He said that planned projects, too, should be stepped up to newly define the concept of operations in all spheres in keeping with the rapid modernization of the military and technical equipment of our army and apply it to the combat training of the units.
Mentioning the Party's policy of territorial defence on strengthening the first-line units in the southern border and turning the border line into an impregnable fortress, he expressed a plan for remodeling the military organizational  structure and strengthening the first-line units and other major units in military and technical aspects as an important decision to more thoroughly deter war.
Briefing on a prospect of modernization of the KPA and progress made in developing the military and technical equipment, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that we are building a powerful army and affirmed that as already clarified, if the tasks for the period of the Five-Year Plan are carried out, preparedness of the KPA's strategic action will be renewed beyond comparison with the present and a great change will be made in an aspect of deterring war.
He stressed that the commanding officers of the entire army and all levels should continue to raise their class consciousness, outlook on the arch enemy, and remain faithful to their sacred duty of defending the sovereignty while always keeping highly alert.
Saying that the KPA should defend the country with its ideology and faith than physical strength and that the ideology and faith are the unique secret of the combat capability of our army which can exceed the limit of physical strength, he added that the KPA should continue to carry forward its tradition of overwhelming the enemy with ideology and faith by steadily waging the ideological revolution with firm belief in its cause and that only then can the KPA reliably maintain its honor and position as the strongest army in the world.
Our Party and people's expectation in the KPA commanding officers is very high, he said, expressing belief that the KPA commanding officers would remain faithful to their sacred duty, bearing deep in mind the heavy responsibility for their mission, no matter who may know it or not.
That day, ComradeKim Jong Unhad a photo session with the commanders of the combined units of the entire army in the yard of the Party Central Committee.
The commanders of the KPA combined units at all levels, who were honored to meet the great brilliant commander and receive the great trust from him, vowed to cherish the important teachings of the Supreme Commander as the coordinates of struggle and boundlessly remain faithful to the important mission and duty they assumed before the Party and the revolution and thus fully demonstrate the honor of the KPA commanding officer in the most glorious and strongest era led by him. -0-

headline: Blueberries in Area of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 18 (KCNA) -- The custom of using blueberries in the area of Mt Paektu has recently been registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage.
The blueberries are one of the famous specialties of the DPRK.
The blueberries grow thickly in the high area of Mt Paektu and mountainous areas including the Paekmu Plateau.
Blueberries have lots of physiological activators. Other fruits have no such substances or little ones. The blueberry has high medicinal properties.
According to experts, this plant is effective in preventing senescence, enhancing memory and treating cataract, night blindness and other diseases.
It promotes metabolic process in the human body, enhances organism resistance and is also good for the prevention and treatment of intestinal diseases.
Thanks to the pharmacological action of blueberries, the Korean people make various kinds of foodstuffs such as sweet jelly and juice to widely use them as their diet.
The Paektusan Blueberry Processing Factory and the Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory produce various kinds of processed blueberry products and send them to commercial service networks. -0-

headline: DPRK Wins 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 18 (KCNA) -- The final for the 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup took place between DPRK and Japanese teams on May 17.
The DPRK team defeated the Japanese team 5:1 to win the game.
At the awarding ceremony, the trophy and gold medals were conferred on the DPRK women footballers who won the 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup, and the best player prize and the top scorer prize on Yu Jong Hyang, the best goalkeeper prize on Kim Son Gyong and the prize of morality on the DPRK team. -0-

headline: Innovations Made in Freight Transport
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 18 (KCNA) -- The workers of the Chongryong Rolling Stock Corps in the DPRK have carried out their daily plan at 103 percent after setting it as a goal to fulfill their yearly freight transport plan by the founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The crewmen vigorously conducted a drive for extra-haulage on schedule without accident while intensifying the self-check and self-repair and making good use of operation methods suited to the running section. As a result, they are transporting in time materials necessary for socialist construction theaters.
More than 20 workers fulfilled their first half-yearly national economic plans and the ranks of innovators are increasing day by day.
The workers of the corps are concentrating on strengthening its material and technical foundations. -0-

headline: Campaign for Rotating Fruit Trees in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 18 (KCNA) -- The Agricultural Commission in the DPRK is striving to put the fruit farming on a scientific and intensive basis, according to Minju Joson. After working out a plan to rotate fruit trees in thousands of hectares this year, it has intensified the economic organization and technical guidance for its implementation.
Attention is being paid to increasing the dense cultivation area of high-yielding fruit trees. It made sure that all fruit production units give precedence to the preparations for high-yielding saplings under the plan for rotating fruit trees before the spring tree planting period.
Efforts are directed to raising the rate of rooting by meeting the requirements of technical regulations in all the processes of planting trees.
Fruit farms in Kwail and Pukchong counties and other fruit farms in different parts of the country are carrying on their plans for rotating fruit trees as scheduled. -0-

headline: New Production Line to be Established at Taean Heavy Machine Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 19 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Taean Heavy Machine Complex in the DPRK is establishing a high-grade alloy steel production line.
Workers and technicians of various units at the complex have stepped up the project for expanding the ingotting process with the main emphasis on increasing the alloy steel production capacity.
They are manufacturing and installing a slag re-melting furnace which plays an important role in improving the quality of alloy steel.
The medium-sized machine shop, the generating equipment processing shop No. 2 and other shops are producing parts necessary for the manufacture of slag re-melting furnace while increasing the operation rate of equipment.
After finishing the installation of slag re-melting furnace No. 1 in March, the complex has sped up the preparations for its test operation while manufacturing the slag re-melting furnace No. 2. -0-

headline: Construction of Solar Power Plants Accelerated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 19 (KCNA) -- Solar power plants are being built in different parts of the DPRK.
Ryanggang Province established a solar power plant with the capacity of thousands of kilowatts in the area of Phabal-ri of Kim Hyong Gwon County.
Haeju City of South Hwanghae Province inaugurated a solar power plant with the capacity of 10 000 kilowatts.
The capital city of Pyongyang built solar power plants in three districts last year, and the work to increase the production of electricity by making effective use of solar energy is brisk in all districts and counties this year, too.
South Hamgyong Province built Soho and Tonghung solar power plants and a grid parallel solar power plant on the bank of the River Songchon.
South Phyongan Province is establishing a solar power generation system with the capacity of thousands of kilowatts on the basis of experience, technology and economic effectiveness gained in the operation of the solar power plant in the River Phyongsong.
North Hwanghae and North Hamgyong provinces and other regions of the country are increasing the solar power generation capacity. -0-

headline: Paternal Affection Associated with Extracurricular Education Bases
Paternal Affection Associated with Extracurricular Education Bases
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 19 (KCNA) -- The warm love of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea, which puts forward the work for the rising generations as the most important affair and spares nothing for them, is reflected in the children's camps, comprehensive extracurricular education bases for schoolchildren.
On May 19, 2013, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the Pyongyang Municipal Myohyangsan Children's Alpine Camp and learned in detail about the camping life of Korean Children's Union members. And he said it is the Party's determination to splendidly remodel not only the said camp but also all other children's camps, palaces and halls across the country.
Under his loving care, the Songdowon International Children's Camp was turned into a world-class comprehensive extracurricular education base for schoolchildren, which is full of laughter of campers in all seasons.
The Mangyongdae Children's Camp at the foot of picturesque Mt Ryongak, too, was built into a splendid palace of children, true to his noble intention that we should pluck even a star from the sky for the sake of posterity.
Schoolchildren are now enjoying camping at the December 6 Children's Camp in Kangwon Province, where all the structures have been renovated to suit the topographical features of the sea.
The children's camps in the areas near Lake Yonphung, Mt Jangja, Lake Sohung and other scenic spots, too, are all associated with the boundless love of the fatherly Marshal who is devoting himself to the children.
The song "We Are the Happiest in the World" sung by schoolchildren at all those camps, built in different parts of the country under the warm loving care of the respected fatherly Marshal, is reverberating far and wide. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- Among many crimes committed by the Japanese imperialists against the Korean people in the past is the hideous crime of destroying and plundering precious cultural assets.
The Japanese imperialists infested the tombs of kings under the pretext of "investigating" the historical relics of Korea to loot large quantities of gold crowns and articles. They plundered many cultural assets from the royal palace and other buildings under the pretext of "research" in architecture.
From November 1905 to April 1907 alone, they raided some king tombs dating back to the Koryo period.
None of the tombs of the Koryo kings remained intact. This proves the Japanese imperialists' hideous atrocities.
The Japanese imperialists dug up more than 1 400 ancient tombs in the area of the Taedong River and Ryongyon Sub-county (then) in ten years, demolishing the Walled City of Pyongyang and many other forts under the pretext of railways project and the construction of cities, factories and military facilities.
They raided bookstores and Confucian temples and even private houses likely to have cultural relics across the country in order to obliterate the classics.
The Japanese imperialists plundered tens of thousands of cultural assets in Korea, including metal products of great technical art value such as bells and Buddhist statues at temples.
They took the robbed cultural relics to Japan and impudently made them public as their "national treasure".
Such hideous crimes are unpardonable as they were, in essence, aimed at obliterating the traditions and patriotism of the Korean people. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
Many Units Win Three-Revolution Red Flag and Honored Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- Many units in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK have won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag this year amid a vigorous three-revolution red flag movement across the country.
The provincial revolutionary museum was awarded the title of Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag as it aroused Party members and other working people to implement the Workers' Party of Korea's policies by raising its employees' political and theoretical level and lecture skills.
The Sakju County Hotel, the Town Vegetable Farm in Sakju County and the Sakju County Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory were honored with the titles of Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag and Three-Revolution Red Flag.
The workteam No.1 of the Ryonggye Farm in Uiju County and the workteam No.2 of the agricultural production branch of the Sindo County Reed Combined Farm won the Three-Revolution Red Flag by making achievements in agricultural production.
Teachers of Kim Kum Sun Senior Middle School in Sinuiju City, Amnokgang Secondary School No. 1 and Sinuiju Secondary School No. 1 were awarded the titles of Thrice and Twice Three-Revolution Red Flag as they set an example in making innovations in teaching contents and methods. They are now striving to implement the Party's policy on education. -0-

headline:
Name of Pleasure Park Given by Respected Comrade General Secretary Kim Jong Un
[2026.05.20.]
story_text:
One day in April 2012, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Rungna People's Pleasure Park under construction.
After looking round the construction site, the General Secretary said with great satisfaction that if Chongnyu and Rungna bridges as well as objects under construction in the area of Rungna Islet are decorated with electric light, the nocturnal view of the area will be fantastic.
At that time an official requested the General Secretary to write his autograph sign boards on the buildings in the pleasure park.
After accepting the request with pleasure, the General Secretary said that it is necessary to name the pleasure park in the area of Rungna Islet as a whole, but the word "people" should never be omitted in the name of the pleasure park.
He said that it would be best to call it the Rungna People's Pleasure Park, in view of the noble intention of ComradeKim Il Sungand ComradeKim Jong Il, the great leaders who devoted their all to the people all their lives.
Reflected in the name of the Rungna People's Pleasure Park was the firm will of the respected General Secretary to turn this land into a paradise of the people, true to the intention of the great leaders who devoted themselves to the people.
Afterwards, the park has been turned into a cultural recreation base for working people, youth and students. -0-

Natural History Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- Many schoolchildren and working people visit the Natural History Museum at the foot of picturesque Mt Taesong in Pyongyang.
The museum has halls dealing with knowledge about outer space, Paleozoic era, Mesozoic era, Cenozoic era, fauna and flora. Visitors are acquiring comprehensive knowledge of animals and plants.
The museum, built for cultural and leisure activities and peculiar education, is associated with the guidance of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unfor enabling our people to acquire richer knowledge.
On May 20, 2016, the General Secretary visited the Natural History Museum nearing completion. At that time he said that the museum was built as another peculiar educational base and cultural recreation ground for youth and students and working people.
Noting that the museum would tangibly contribute to the education of schoolchildren and students and working people and scientific research, he gave instructions to further spruce up the museum on the principle of scientific accuracy, practicality and kindness.
The museum has added more than 1 000 video clips and hundreds of pieces of academic data to its database in recent years. Over 360 stuffed animal specimen of 158 species were also newly displayed.
Employees of the museum are working hard to discover more secrets of nature and provide visitors with richer knowledge. -0-

headline: First-stage Construction of Tanchon Power Station Completed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 20 (KCNA) -- The first-stage construction of the Tanchon Power Station, which is of great significance in the development of the country's electric power industry, has been successfully completed.
All the army-people builders excavated a waterway tunnel through rugged mountain ranges in the northern part of the country and built Tanchon power stations Nos. 1, 5 and 6 and two dams, thus laying another solid foundation for the economic development and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
The completion of such great power base is a striking demonstration of the inexhaustible potentials of the DPRK which is accelerating the overall development of Korean-style socialism with confidence in sure victory under the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
A ceremony for inaugurating the first stage of the Tanchon Power Station took place on the spot on May 18.
Present there were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior Party and government officials, officials of the command team of the Tanchon Power Station Construction Division and relevant units, officials and working people in Hochon County, army-people builders and employees of the power station.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Premier Pak Thae Song addressed the ceremony.
Noting that the waterway tunnel covering tens of kilometers has been excavated at the cost of blood and sweat for several years and the dams and power stations built by devoted efforts, wisdom and enthusiasm, the premier stressed that they prove the indomitable revolutionary spirit and strong fighting traits of the builders.
With the completion of the construction of Tanchon power stations Nos. 1, 5 and 6, a remarkable success was made in the development of largest-scale hydraulic resources for diverting the courses of several rivers and streams to the East Sea and valuable experience was accumulated to push forward the future construction of power stations with greater confidence, he said.
There were countless difficulties in the construction of power stations, but the outstanding idea and leadership of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unserved as a source of tremendous strength to overcome all of them and bring about the changes, he noted.
Saying that a large elite force united with patriotism, the powerful conquerors of the nature, could be grown up under the warm love and affection shown by the great father for the builders having struggled with the nature for several years, he stressed that it is the most valuable and precious success achieved in the construction of the Tanchon Power Station.
He said that the edifices erected in the course of the first-stage construction of the Tanchon Power Station are a historic monument strikingly demonstrating the looks of the revolutionaries in our era and the spirit of the Koreans who are paving the road of prosperity by dint of their own efforts, remaining boundlessly loyal to the great patriotic ideas and the revolutionary leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Expressing belief that all the builders would surely bring about the completion of the construction of the power station by more vigorously turning out with the high pride of recording a new brilliant page in the country's history of hydro-power station construction, he declared the completion of the first stage of the Tanchon Power Station.
The premier cut the inauguration tape.
Following the ceremony, an art performance was given to congratulate the builders of the power station and fireworks were displayed to add joy to the inauguration.
The participants went round the Tanchon power stations Nos. 1 and 5, dams and dwelling houses for employees. -0-

headline: U.S. and ROK's Reckless Arms Build-up Will Incite DPRK to Further Strength Military Deterrent: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- The U.S. has further boosted its arms sales to its vassal countries in the Korean peninsula and the Northeast Asian region, and this has emerged as a challenge to regional security that should no longer be overlooked.
Recently, the U.S. Department of State approved the sale of 24 MH-60Rs, new-type helicopters for maritime operation, and parts of AH-64E Apache helicopters to ROK in the amount of more than four billion US dollars, asserting that it would contribute to improving the ROK's ability for coping with the current and future threats and equipping it with creditable military capabilities strong enough to deter enemy.
This is a part of the U.S. arms sales and the ROK's ill-intended arms build-up, being pushed forward according to the agreement made at the U.S.-ROK summit held last October that specified the ROK's purchase of U.S.-made military equipment amounting to 25 billion US dollars until 2030.
In essence, through the arms sales the U.S. seeks to maximize its financial gains by taking advantage of the ROK's ever-increasing military spending, and at the same time, use the ROK as its armed shock brigade for materializing its strategic hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region.
Such unilateral arms build-up that goes beyond the defensive nature will only provoke the other party's corresponding measures for securing overwhelming military muscle.
With regard to it, a spokesman for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea answered to a question raised by KCNA, clarifying the stand that the massive U.S. arms exports to the ROK, Japan, Taiwan and other allies and partners in the Asia-Pacific region constitute a cause of ever-escalating regional military tensions including the Korean Peninsula and Taiwan Strait and predict the gloomy prospect of the regional situation.
The spokesman added that the gravity of such arms build-up and sales lies in the fact that they are going far beyond the ordinary defensive demands and being conducted in a specific way aimed at military attack on specific countries, strictly subject to the materialization of the U.S. strategy for securing military edge.
Today the ROK's irrational wild ambition for arms buildup is a typical product of the execution of the new military strategy by the present U.S. administration seeking to ensure the flexibility of military attack posture against the rival nations throughout the Asia-Pacific region.
Last year the U.S. pressurized NATO to make its European allies increase their military expenditure to 5 percent of their GDPs. Now it presses its Asian allies to follow it, pressing them to boost their military expenditure.
Under such pressure, the ROK agreed to increase its military spending to 3.5 percent of its GDP at an early date, buy U.S.-made weaponry costing 25 billion US dollars until 2030 and offer the U.S. 33 billion US dollars as the upkeep for the U.S. forces in the ROK. The ROK was termed "exemplary ally" in return.
The U.S. agreed to sell 624 GBU-39 long-range guided bombs to the ROK last December, hosted a contract between it and the Boeing Company for improving F-15Ks of the ROK air force in February and approved the sale of airborne communication security equipment amounting to 0.2 billion US dollars in March.
Meanwhile, the U.S. approved its sale of eight kinds of combat equipment including HIMARS, Javelin anti-tank missile, howitzer and suicide drone and relevant parts amounting to 11.1 billon US dollars to Taiwan last December. It also systematically transfers Tomahawk cruise missiles and other attack weapons to Japan.
Global security crises that break out in a chain go to prove that such transfer of latest lethal weaponry by the U.S., the world's biggest death merchant, cyclically causes ever-escalating regional military conflict and contradiction and ever-deepening unpredictability and ever-worsening instability.
Such arms buildup pursued by a belligerent party can never be overlooked by the other party and it is clear that the latter will take corresponding measures.
To thoroughly deter the imbalance of power enforced by the U.S. and its vassal forces and strongly cope it is a prerequisite to safeguarding national sovereign rights and ensuring regional peace and stability.
The defence power of the DPRK will strongly deter all security threats, posed by the enemy nations, through ceaseless update and evolution and full war readiness, creditably defend the national sovereignty and security and regional peace and proactively contribute to ensuring global strategic stability. -0-

headline: Drainage Pump Production Pushed forward at Final Stage
story_text:

Its workers contributed to fulfilling the production plan by introducing efficient working methods to shorten the processing and assembling time of parts.
The factory has increased the precision of its products through a mass technological innovation movement and invented a new molding jig. -0-

headline: S. Hwanghae Provincial Delegation of DPRK Leaves for Russia
Pothong River Improvement Project
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- Eighty years have passed since the ceremony for starting the Pothong River improvement project was held in the DPRK.
Before national liberation (August 15, 1945), the Pothong River in Pyongyang was in floods in every rainy season, claiming huge casualties and destroying surrounding villages and fields.
After the country's liberation, PresidentKim Il Sungdecided to carry out the Pothong River improvement project as the start of great nature transformation for building a prosperous, independent and sovereign state and roused the public to the project.
On May 21, 1946, he attended the ceremony for starting the improvement project, where he said that the successful building of a democratic Korea depends entirely on the own efforts and enthusiasm of the Korean people and called on them to complete the projects like the Pothong River improvement one after another despite tightening belts.
The Korean people, who turned out as one in the patriotic project for nature transformation, worked a miracle by finishing such a large project as removing more than 420 000 cubic meters of earth and building 5 km-long embankment within 55 days.
With the completion of the project, the river started to flow along a new waterway to the Taedong River and the banks of the Pothong River became invulnerable to any flood.
The completion of the project was the first victory the Korean people gained in the great nature transformation by believing in their efforts under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sungafter national liberation.
The Korean people built the Monument to the Pothong River Improvement Project on the Ponghwasan Hill on May 21, 1971 in order to convey to posterity the President's immortal exploits associated with the history of the great change of the Pothong River. -0-

headline: Cage-Net Fish Farming in S. Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- Cage-net fish farming gets popular in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Dozens of units conduct the cage-net fish farming in the province.
The province set a goal to develop cage-net fish farming on a large scale in conformity with the natural and geographical features of the province having many lakes and reservoirs, and generalized the experience gained by various units in Unchon County which achieved successes in the cage-net fish farming.
Ongjin, Pyoksong, Sinchon and Unnyul counties have secured fast-growing breeding fish adapted to local conditions.
Relevant regions and units increased the puffed feed production and prepared animal protein feed. As a result, cage-net fish farms have increased in lakes and reservoirs in the province. -0-

headline: Korean Dressing Custom - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 21 (KCNA) -- The Korean dressing custom was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in November 2013.
The custom consists of making method and attire of the traditional Korean clothes, which were formed through long historical period in consideration of the country's natural and climatic conditions and its people's way of life, emotions, hobbies, etc.
The Korean people have developed their dressing custom since ancient times. It includes the traditional skills and ways of making men's, women's and children's clothes and footwear.
They used such natural fiber as hemp, ramie, silk and cotton cloth in making clothes.
The Korean dressing custom has promoted the sustained development and preserved its unique colors, being harmonized naturally with other elements of cultural heritages including traditional handicraft and traditional art through its development.
The 19th meeting of the intergovernmental committee for the protection of intangible cultural heritages of the UNESCO, held in December 2024, adopted a decision on registering the Korean dressing custom as a typical intangible cultural heritage of mankind. -0-

headline: Protection of Biodiversity Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 22 (KCNA) -- May 22 is the International Day of Biological Diversity.
Despite increasing interest in biodiversity and ecosystem protection, the number of species worldwide is still decreasing due to human activities and various factors, and many animals and plants are at a crisis of extinction.
The Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity and other international organizations call upon relevant units in all countries and regions to implement the global goals set forth in the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. This year's theme is "Acting locally for global impact".
The DPRK is actively protecting the biodiversity by increasing the areas of various forms of reserves by stages throughout the country.
The Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the Biodiversity Institute under the State Academy of Sciences and other relevant units have conducted field survey of major reserves including biosphere reserves and wildlife sanctuaries in recent years. On this basis, they set up a nationwide ecological route to regularly update the lists of species and endangered species in the country.
On the basis of the nationwide assessment of biodiversity, they settled possible reserve sites and have made provinces, cities and counties take measures to eliminate the factors that adversely affect the ecological environment.
Meanwhile, they are protecting and increasing the biodiversity of the country in various forms and methods including the supervision and control for protecting animal and plant resources, the information work for raising public interest, sci-tech presentation, seminar and short course. -0-

headline: Land Management in DPRK
story_text:

headline: Custom of Cultivating and Using Koryo Insam - Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 25 (KCNA) -- Koryo Insam is a specialty of the DPRK as it has been widely cultivated since the period of Koryo.
The original home of insam is Kaesong. Its root shape resembles figure of man.
Insam, cultivated in the Kaesong area with peculiar soil, water quality, meteorological factor and cultivation method, has medicinal effect which can not be compared with others.
The cultivation of insam was more brisk in Koryo period with the accumulation of cultivating experience and growing demand.
Especially in the eleventh and twelfth centuries, its cultivation was widely spread and Kaesong flourished as the center of its cultivation.
Since it was exported to other countries, it has been known to the world as "Koryo Insam" and "Kaesong Insam".
Insam is divided into red insam, white insam and sugar insam according to its processing methods.
Red insam is made by steaming fresh insam in a certain temperature and drying it, white insam by drying the fresh one and the sugar insam by boiling the fresh one in sugar water.
Koryo insam contains various glycosides good for human health, essential amino acid, various kinds of vitamins and minerals.
The Korean people have used insam for their diet, and a typical traditional dish is chicken soup boiled with insam.
The chicken soup boiled with insam as well as chestnut, jujube, ginkgo, garlic, etc. has been regarded as health and macrobiotic food among the Korean people from olden times.
The custom of cultivating and using Koryo Insam was registered as one of the national intangible cultural heritage in May 2016. -0-

Pyongyang, May 25 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on May 24.

I heartily hope that the Chinese people will eradicate the aftermath of the damage as soon as possible under the leadership of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese government with you, Comrade General Secretary, as the core and the bereaved families will overcome their sorrow and regain a stable life. -0-

headline: Mountaineering Route in Mt Myohyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 25 (KCNA) -- In the spring season, many working people, youth and students in the DPRK are visiting Mt Myohyang, a famous mountain of the country.
Mt Myohyang is famous for its magnificent and mysterious peaks, big rocks and deep valleys, high cliffs, crystal-clear water and waterfalls, thick forests, twittering of birds and sound of babbling brooks.
The mountaineering route covering picturesque Sangwon Ravine, Manphok Ravine famous for waterfalls and Piro Peak (now called Hyangbiro Peak) fragrant with alpine plants has facilities for providing the visitors with maximum convenience and safety and many pavilions and recreation places.
This route in Mt Myohyang is associated with the love of ChairmanKim Jong Il, who personally hewed the way for providing the people with a better cultural recreation site while walking the rough mountain range irrespective of bad weather.
Visiting the mountain one day in May 1981, he came to know that the mountaineering route had not yet been opened. So, he climbed the cliff road to open up more than 24-kilometer-long mountaineering route in the area of Piro Peak and chose the sites for pavilions and recreation places. He also gave detailed instructions on the issues related to the organization of mountaineering on a wide scale, the period of climbing according to ages, the route and the place of lodging.
Thanks to the great love of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwho made ceaseless devotion for the people, many scenic spots were built in a more peculiar way and new mountaineering routes pioneered in Mt Myohyang. The mountain is demonstrating its attraction not only as natural scenery and but also a resort for the people. -0-

headline: Sand Beach in Rungna Water Park
story_text:
One day in May 2012, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Rungna Water Park under construction in the capital city of Pyongyang to give detailed guidance over its construction.
Examining its draft design despite the dust wind, the General Secretary said that if only tiles or paving blocks are laid on the side of water tank at the park, there would be no place for people to lie after coming out from water. And he added that it would be advisable to create in space between the bathing booth and the water tank a lawn or a sandy beach.
Then, he instructed officials to make a sand beach with quality sand from Monggumpho, saying that people would like a sandy beach better than a lawn to lie on.
The officials were so surprised with the fact that sand beach would be made at the water park, rather than a seaside resort, with famous Monggumpho sand.
After all, the Rungna Water Park came to have a sand beach covered with sand from Monggumpho in Ryongyon County of South Hwanghae Province. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 26 (KCNA) -- A great earthquake hit the Kanto area of Japan on September 1, 1923. Fire caused by the strong earthquake turned the Kanto area into a sea of flame, leaving many people homeless.
The inhabitants in the disaster-stricken area raised their voices in protest against the government, which had not taken an urgent relief measure, and even showed signs of starting an uprising.
Upset by such developments, the Japanese authorities plotted to appease their antipathy against the government by directing the spearhead of extreme public discontent to the Koreans in Japan and use the natural disaster as an opportunity for massive suppression and massacre of Koreans.
The Japanese imperialists promulgated a martial law as the royal ordinance, talking about the groundless rumors about "Koreans' uprising", and pasted in different places the fabrication paper reading "Koreans put fire" and the notice to kill the resisting Koreans in order to instigate Japanese to killing Koreans.
Under the instruction of the government, the Japanese imperialist murderers installed checkpoints on every road and made the Koreans speak a Japanese word difficult for them to pronounce. If their pronunciation were incorrect, the Japs unconditionally caught them to kill them brutally. After all, at least 23 000 Koreans were killed.
A note of Japanese proving the massacre of Koreans at the time of the great Kanto quake was disclosed in Japan six years ago. Recorded in it are the detailed data that the Japanese imperialists incited a hostile atmosphere against the Korean people to slaughter them.
This is a part of the evidence indicting the massacre of the Japanese imperialists who stained the Kanto area with the blood of Koreans. -0-

headline: Deep Respect to Noble Patriotism of War Martyrs
story_text:

Seeing the records of battles inscribed with gold letters on the pillar walls at the memorial museum, blood-stained written pledges and applications for accession to the Party, and letters to their beloved parents, the visitors hardened their will to make innovations and increase production at their posts and workplaces by carrying forward the soul of the brave soldiers who faced even the death in the indomitable spirit of the Korean people, always with yearning for the homeland.
Photos, relics and data on feats showing the spiritual world of the passionate young soldiers, who highly displayed revolutionary comradeship at the decisive battlefield and unhesitatingly dashed to the enemy's positions, make the visitors' mind pulsate with loyalty and patriotism.
The DPRK will be dignified, powerful and strong forever thanks to such great heroes as the brave soldiers, and the new generations will, along with the memorial museum, warmly embrace the brave soldiers, handing down the matchless war records forever and continuing to write the history of patriotism and loyalty. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 26 (KCNA) -- A great earthquake hit the Kanto area of Japan on September 1, 1923. Fire caused by the strong earthquake turned the Kanto area into a sea of flame, leaving many people homeless.
The inhabitants in the disaster-stricken area raised their voices in protest against the government, which had not taken an urgent relief measure, and even showed signs of starting an uprising.
Upset by such developments, the Japanese authorities plotted to appease their antipathy against the government by directing the spearhead of extreme public discontent to the Koreans in Japan and use the natural disaster as an opportunity for massive suppression and massacre of Koreans.
The Japanese imperialists promulgated a martial law as the royal ordinance, talking about the groundless rumors about "Koreans' uprising", and pasted in different places the fabrication paper reading "Koreans put fire" and the notice to kill the resisting Koreans in order to instigate Japanese to killing Koreans.
Under the instruction of the government, the Japanese imperialist murderers installed checkpoints on every road and made the Koreans speak a Japanese word difficult for them to pronounce. If their pronunciation were incorrect, the Japs unconditionally caught them to kill them brutally. After all, at least 23 000 Koreans were killed.
A note of Japanese proving the massacre of Koreans at the time of the great Kanto quake was disclosed in Japan six years ago. Recorded in it are the detailed data that the Japanese imperialists incited a hostile atmosphere against the Korean people to slaughter them.
This is a part of the evidence indicting the massacre of the Japanese imperialists who stained the Kanto area with the blood of Koreans. -0-

headline: Teams of KCU Members Carrying Letters of Loyalty to Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Run toward Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 26 (KCNA) -- The relay teams of Korean Children's Union members in all provinces of the DPRK carrying their letters of loyalty presented to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unon the occasion of the 80th KCU birthday are now running toward the capital city of Pyongyang.
The relay teams from North and South Phyongan and South Hwanghae provinces have passed through relevant areas.
Their members toured regional-industry factories in Sukchon and Jaeryong counties and went round different types of greenhouses at the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm.
At the Sinchon House of Class Education, they cherished the truth of the class struggle that illusions about the enemy are death and that they should fight the enemy to the last.
Those from North Hwanghae, Jagang and Kangwon provinces gave motivation performances at construction sites for the regional development policy in Pongsan County and visited the Kosanjin Revolutionary Site associated with the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung's exploits for the war victory.
They also went round the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, a precious output of self-supporting and self-reliant efforts.
The teams from North and South Hamgyong provinces conducted motivation activities at the Jikjol Vegetable Farm in Tanchon City and the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex.
Those from Ryanggang Province and Rason Municipality visited the Pochonbo Revolutionary Battle Site and the Taehongdan Revolutionary Battle Site and toured various parts of Samjiyon, a model mountain cultural town, and the Rason Education Apparatus Factory and the Rason General Foodstuff Factory.
Meanwhile, a kick-off meeting of the team of KCU members in Pyongyang took place at Changdok School on May 25.
Present there were Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials concerned, officials of the youth league and KCU members. headline: 26th Congress of Chongryon Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 26 (KCNA) -- The 26th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) was held at the Korean Hall of Culture in Tokyo on May 23 and 24.
Present there were Chairman Ho Jong Man, First Vice-Chairman and Director of the Organization Department Pak Ku Ho and vice-chairpersons Nam Sung U, Pae Jin Gu, Jo Il Yon, So Chung On and Kang Chu Ryon of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, members of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, the director of the Research Institute on History of Korean Residents in Japan, headquarters chairpersons of Chongryon, leading officials of central organizations of Chongryon and its affiliates, members of the Central Audit Committee and deputies elected from institutions, organizations and bodies at all levels of Chongryon.
The national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played at the congress.
Nam Sung U read out a congratulatory message from the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly to the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
After a report on the examination of qualifications, the congress adopted as its agenda items "On the review of the work of the 25th term of Chongryon and the tasks of its 26th term", "On the revision of the programme and rules of Chongryon", "On the financial settlement of the 25th term and the budget for the 26th term" and "Election of the officials of the central organizations of Chongryon".
Pak Ku Ho made a report on the first agenda item.
The reporter said that Chongryon has dynamically conducted the patriotic work under the meticulous guidance and paternal love of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unduring the period under review and that it would set a new period of struggle till the 80th formation anniversary of Chongryon and wage a dynamic patriotic movement.
He also set forth the main tasks of Chongryon in the 26th term and stressed the need to decisively strengthen the internal forces of Chongryon as required by the new period of struggle.
The reporter called upon the deputies to the 26th Congress to fulfill their honorable mission and duty in the struggle to achieve the overall development of the movement of Koreans in Japan with the patriotic strength of compatriots as the only driving force, bearing in mind the firm faith and will that the victory of the Juche cause and the Chongryon's patriotic cause is a science as they are guided by the respected Marshal.
Then speeches were made.
Introduced at the congress were congratulatory messages and videos from institutions, organizations and officials in the homeland, overseas compatriots' organizations, organizations and individual personages of Japan and foreign friendship organizations.
Delegates of Korean youth and students in Japan entered the venue of the congress to congratulate the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
Ri Myong Yu, chairman of the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon, made a report on the work of the audit committee.
The congress adopted the report of the Central Committee of Chongryon on the first agenda item as a decision of the congress.
It also unanimously adopted a report of the examination committee for the revision of the programme and rules of Chongryon on the second agenda item and a report of the financial settlement and budget review committee on the third agenda item.
The congress elected Ho Jong Man as chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon.
It also elected the first vice-chairman, vice-chairpersons, the director general of the General Affairs Department and members of the Central Committee of Chongryon and members of its Central Audit Committee.
A letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas adopted at the congress.
At the end of the congress, the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon was formed at the First Session of the 26th Central Committee of Chongryon, and the Central Audit Committee of Chongryon elected its chairman and vice-chairmen.
During the congress, an art performance and a photo exhibition were held to celebrate the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
There was also an exhibition showing the successes made in the Chongryon's development of national education. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un from Participants in 26th Chongryon Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 26 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the participants in the 26th Congress of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on May 24.
As the respected Marshal has shown care for and guided Chongryon with his paternal love and benevolent solicitude, the 26th Congress of Chongryon could be brilliantly recorded as a congress of loyalty, patriotism and unity which set a new milestone in the history of the Juche-oriented movement of Koreans in Japan and as a significant congress which enabled Chongryon to turn out in the grand march toward the 80th anniversary of its formation, the letter said, and went on:
The respected MarshalKim Jong Unis a great strategist of state building and a great master of creation and transformation who performed great exploits for the country and the revolution, the times and history by setting forth the action programs and fighting strategies for national prosperity and the well-being of the people and making eye-opening leaps and miracles one after another in all spheres of socialist construction with his gifted ideo-theoretical wisdom and extraordinary leadership practice.
He unfolded a bright blueprint for the prosperity of Chongryon by giving important instructions, including his historic letters sent on the occasions of the 25th Congress and the 70th formation anniversary of Chongryon during its 25th term. He also gave a boost to the patriotic movement of Chongryon by showing such favor as having a photo session with the members of the Korean schoolchildren's art troupe in Japan who participated in the New Year performance and inviting the Chongryon congratulatory group and delegations to the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea and other important events.
The congress proudly reviewed the valuable successes made in the past four years through hard-fought struggle for the happiness of compatriots and the future of rising generations, set the orientation and goal of the new period of struggle till the 80th formation anniversary of Chongryon and decided on the main tasks and ways for the next four years.
We will rally the compatriots, the foundation of Chongryon organizations and inexhaustible patriotic strength, more broadly and put them forward as the masters of the sacred struggle to write a new history of the movement of Koreans in Japan, as instructed by the respected Marshal.
The letter said that all deputies to the congress firmly pledged to make tangible achievements in their work by devoting themselves to implementing the decisions of the 26th Congress which set a milestone in the new period of struggle toward the 80th formation anniversary of Chongryon and thus live up to the deep trust and expectation of the respected Marshal with loyalty. -0-

headline: Defence Science Research Institutions of DPRK Conduct Tests of Major Weapons
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 27 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration and the Academy of Defence Sciences of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted tests of newly-developed lightweight multi-purpose missile launching system and multiple tactical cruise missile weapon system, as a part of the plan for modernizing the artillery and missile armed forces to attain the five-year goal for national defence development, on May 26.
ComradeKim Jong Unoversaw the tests.
The relevant tests analyzed and estimated the power of special mission warhead of tactical ballistic missile, the reliability of 240mm controlled artillery rocket with expanded firing range which employed an ultra-precision autonomous navigation system, and the AI-guided hit accuracy of tactical cruise missile.
Highly appreciating the test results, ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great satisfaction over the fact that important ultra-high defence science and technologies were introduced into the practical weapon tests.
He made a positive assessment of the military worth of the tactical cruise missile to be deployed at the long-range artillery brigades in the southern border area in particular.
The tactical cruising shell, which has a combination of the ultra-precision autonomous navigation system and the TERCOM (terrain contour matching) navigation system and employed an AI terminal guidance function, is a powerful weapon system that can strike in an ultra-precision way any target 100 kilometers away by multimode flight based on gliding and propelling.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that today's tests of major weapon systems are a clear signal of upgrading of our military force and an event of showing great technical progress in the strengthening of our army's combat power.
What is noteworthy is that the firing control system and automation system of all the launching vehicles have been finally updated to suit the proper conditions of modern warfare so as to enhance their application to combat, he said, adding that thanks to such successful development of the most powerful tactical-level weapon systems, our army's firepower systems came to be fully put on an automatic, long-range and ultra-precision basis.
Noting that the present situation is accelerating the steady upgrading of military capabilities, he affirmed that the validity of the development direction of the artillery and missile forces modernization plan, decided and assigned by the Party Congress, and its prospect are certain, scientific and successful as they are based on the already-made high-level defence technical achievements.
It is our top-priority policy direction for the building of armed forces to build the most modern and powerful artillery force which no one can match, he said, adding: It is essential condition for our army's operations to have such destructive power as enough to make any encountering force impossible to survive theoretically, apart from fortune. Such capability will give extreme uneasiness and fear to the enemy, and it will be a major link and a responsible exercise for deterring war.
Saying that it is the main task facing our armed forces and defence science sector to defend the security of sovereignty and guarantee the development of socialism with powerful war deterrence, ComradeKim Jong Unassigned important tasks arising in stepping up the steady growth of the national defence capability and the work to put the military hardware on an ultra-modern basis.
The line of our Party and government to steadily accelerate the strengthening of the nuclear force and conventional armed force remains unchanged, he said, adding that our plan to defend the military sovereignty and exercise the right to self-defence in a responsible manner will be expressed in a clearer action.
Present to observe the tests were Marshal Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Full General Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the C.C., WPK, Full General Kim Jong Sik, first department director of the C.C., WPK, Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Lieut. General Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, Lieut. General Kim Kang Il, director of the General Armaments Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence, Maj. General Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, and Senior Colonel Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence. -0-

headline: Traditional Silk Production Technique - Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- From olden times Korea has been known to the world as a country of beautiful silk.
According to a historical record, the Korean ancestors began to breed wild silkworms after acclimatization from early times and obtain raw silk from silkworms to weave silk cloth in ancient times.
Silk thread processing and the texture of silk cloth have also been developed.
As the hemp cloth was the first one woven in Korea, the silk-weaving apparatus was the same as the loom.
At that time, the vertical loom was used in weaving silk cloth. There were various weaving methods including plain weave, twill weave, sateen weave and distortion weave.
The Korean people invented the printing for the first time in the world to apply it to weave silk cloth.
The cloth printing, an easy method among cloth patterns, was further refined with the introduction of various printing technique with the passage of times.
The silk cloth of Korea is the most durable, light and beautiful among natural fiber. It is cool in summer and warm in winter.
It is not wrinkled easily for its good elasticity.
The traditional silk production technique was registered as one of the national intangible cultural heritage in October 2017. -0-

headline: Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry on QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on May 28 as regards the fact that the recent U.S.-led QUAD foreign ministers' meeting made public a "joint statement", which includes the content pulling up the DPRK:
The "joint statement" not only seriously distorted the immediate and urgent challenges and threats faced by the countries in the Asia-Pacific region but also clearly exposed the hostile intention against specific countries.
QUAD talked about the strengthening of cooperation while expressing "concern" over the situation in the South Sea and East Sea of China. It is aimed at justifying Japan's moves for rearmament and Australia's possession of a nuclear submarine, which are arousing concern of the international community.
The creation of the "Critical Minerals Initiative Framework" newly, agreed by QUAD, also contains an exclusive and confrontational nature as it is pursuant to the foreign strategy of the present U.S. administration to hold a hegemonic position in the world supply chain by expanding the concept of security to the economic field.
In particular, the U.S.-led QUAD members took issue with the DPRK's legitimate exercise of sovereign rights, calling for "denuclearization". This goes to prove that QUAD is nothing but a political and diplomatic tool serving the U.S. strategy for unipolar domination.
The signboard of "peace and stability" cannot be a means for justifying the U.S. policy of inter-camp confrontation.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK resolutely denounces and rejects the U.S.-led QUAD's hostile stand against the DPRK and other regional countries, and strongly demands that it drop its attempt to escalate inter-camp confrontation destroying regional peace and stability.
Explicitly speaking once again, the "denuclearization" of the DPRK will never happen forever.

headline: Success Made at Rubber Materials Institute
story_text:

Scientists manufactured and introduced hundreds of winch friction pieces to mechanize the tunnel work at the Komdok Mining Complex and began home production of large-sized rubber rollers needed for normalizing the production at a plastic daily essential plastic goods factory.
They also made and introduced thousands of elastic couplings urgently needed for cement production and made rubber products for the updating of a large-scale machine-building base.

Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry on QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on May 28 as regards the fact that the recent U.S.-led QUAD foreign ministers' meeting made public a "joint statement", which includes the content pulling up the DPRK:
The "joint statement" not only seriously distorted the immediate and urgent challenges and threats faced by the countries in the Asia-Pacific region but also clearly exposed the hostile intention against specific countries.
QUAD talked about the strengthening of cooperation while expressing "concern" over the situation in the South Sea and East Sea of China. It is aimed at justifying Japan's moves for rearmament and Australia's possession of a nuclear submarine, which are arousing concern of the international community.
The creation of the "Critical Minerals Initiative Framework" newly, agreed by QUAD, also contains an exclusive and confrontational nature as it is pursuant to the foreign strategy of the present U.S. administration to hold a hegemonic position in the world supply chain by expanding the concept of security to the economic field.
In particular, the U.S.-led QUAD members took issue with the DPRK's legitimate exercise of sovereign rights, calling for "denuclearization". This goes to prove that QUAD is nothing but a political and diplomatic tool serving the U.S. strategy for unipolar domination.
The signboard of "peace and stability" cannot be a means for justifying the U.S. policy of inter-camp confrontation.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK resolutely denounces and rejects the U.S.-led QUAD's hostile stand against the DPRK and other regional countries, and strongly demands that it drop its attempt to escalate inter-camp confrontation destroying regional peace and stability.
Explicitly speaking once again, the "denuclearization" of the DPRK will never happen forever.
We will thoroughly defend the sovereign rights, security interests and development rights of the state no matter what others may say, and actively join the international efforts to oppose the formation of an exclusive group and inter-camp confrontation in the region and promote the mutual trust, cooperation, peace and co-prosperity among nations. -0-

Scientific Research Achievements Conducive to Implementing Regional Development Policy
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 28 (KCNA) -- In late March, the highest science and technology prize of the DPRK was awarded to five research achievements conducive to establishing production processes at regional-industry factories and offshore farms, and more than 20 officials and scientists of various universities and scientific research units, who played a key role in carrying out the project, received the certificate of the February 16 Science and Technology Prize.
A research group ofKim Il SungUniversity developed an integrated production system for offshore farm, which is of significance in increasing productivity and improving the management of marine ecological environment, taking into consideration the natural and geographical conditions of the relevant water areas and the marine ecological environment conditions.
By developing and building an integrated production system of our own style, it opened up a prospect for putting the whole processes ranging from the management of breeding grounds to the maintenance of ecological environment at offshore farms on a higher scientific basis.
Scientists of Pyongyang Han Tok Su University of Light Industry newly completed the Korean-style oil refining process, laying a foundation for producing tasty and high-quality oil with locally available raw materials in many cities and counties across the country.
Researchers of Pyongyang Jang Chol Gu University of Commerce put forward a technical preparation method for optimizing the production of clothing products and improving the quality of products at regional garment factories.
A research group of the Control Machine Institute under the State Academy of Sciences played a big role in domestic production of foodstuff equipment capable of producing bread of various kinds and sizes.
Scientists of the Food Research Institute of the Food and Consumer Goods Research Institute under the Ministry of Regional Industry have built a process of producing gluten-reinforcing agent with large capacity to strengthen the gluten strength of flour. -0-

headline: Traditional Silk Production Technique - Intangible Cultural Heritage
Jongbangchae, Local Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 29 (KCNA) -- Among the local intangible cultural heritage of the DPRK is Jongbangchae, a special dish of North Hwanghae Province.
Jongbangchae, a popular foodstuff made with salted radish, was registered as the local intangible cultural heritage in 2017 as it is of significance in inheriting and developing the dietary culture of our people.
The Jongbang Foodstuff Production Cooperative in Sariwon City produces side dishes such as pickles which our people have made with various kinds of vegetables from olden times.
Jongbangchae is associated with the care of PresidentKim Il Sung.
One day in May 1971, the President visited the foodstuff cooperative and praised its products.
He saw the foodstuff made with salted radish and personally named it"Jongbangchae".
Since then, the foodstuff has been well known throughout the country. -0-

headline: February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians Active in Various Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, May 29 (KCNA) -- The members of the February 17 Shock Brigade of Scientists and Technicians are playing active role in solving sci-tech problems arising in various sectors of the national economy. Among them are those dispatched to the non-permanent central committee for promoting Regional Development 20×10 Policy, the Ministry of Coal Industry, the tideland reclamation command team and the Tanchon Power Station Construction Division command team, according to Rodong Sinmun.
They manufactured soap packing equipment for daily necessities factories in local areas. And they are now exploring ways of producing comprehensive analytical equipment and various pumps by themselves.
They developed new efficient blasting methods for the coal mines, confirmed their scientific accuracy and effectiveness through the tests for their introduction, and improved the performance of hydraulic drilling machine in order to increase the tunneling speed.
They also developed a hardening agent with tideland soil to ensure safe running of vehicles and applied rational blasting methods to speed up the reclamation of tideland.
And they established integrated automation systems for several power plants and made successful trial runs. -0-
