headline: Joint Friendship Gathering Marks International Children's Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- A joint friendship gathering took place at the Taesongsan Pleasure Park on June 1 to mark the 76th anniversary of International Children's Day.
Attending it were officials concerned, senior officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang Municipality, officials of the women's union, teachers and parents, children of the Pyongyang Baby Home and the Pyongyang Orphanage and kindergarteners in the municipality.
Present were envoys and members of diplomatic missions here and members of a delegation of Korean schoolchildren in Japan on a visit to the socialist homeland to take part in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union and overseas compatriots staying in the homeland.
Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the Central Committee of the women's union, made a speech at the gathering. She warmly congratulated the children across the country and foreign children from different countries on International Children's Day.
A congratulatory performance of students of Kumsong Secondary School No. 1 and artistes of the National Acrobatic Troupe added joy and pleasure to the participants.
Amid the playing of juvenile songs, children displayed beautiful dances and sang songs reflecting their happy life.
Then, followed folk play and sports and amusement games. The games, in which little players competed with each other in wisdom and strength, and a game, in which their mothers took part, added to the pleasure and optimism of the participants.
Children and participants played a cheerful circle dance, decorating the end of the gathering. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- During their colonial rule over Korea, the Japanese imperialists forcibly drafted and kidnapped more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged Koreans and forced medieval slave labor upon them or used them as cannon fodder.
They cooked up various evil laws such as "the National Mobilization Law" and "Ordinance on Labor Conscription", deprived the Koreans of even the elementary freedom and rights of human beings and did not provide them with the minimum working conditions.
The Koreans were compelled to slave labour at construction sites of military establishments, coal mines, mines and construction sites of dams without any labour protection facilities.
The data dating back to 1944-1945 found in Japan show that Koreans were taken to more than 540 construction sites of military facilities in Japan at that time.
The construction sites were a trap of death for them who had to do heavy physical work for 16 to 18 hours a day and 21 hours to the maximum.
At a coal mine in Kyushu of Japan, many Korean boys under the age of 15 toiled and moiled, and tens of them were buried alive at once owing to the cave-in accident.
The Japanese imperialists mercilessly massacred the people who displeased them even a bit, not being content with making them disabled.
During the period from 1940 to 1944, more than 60 000 Koreans lost their lives due to the harsh maltreatment in coal mines of Japan alone.
The Japanese imperialists' forcible drafting of Koreans was a harsh human rights abuse aimed at forcing the murderous slave labor upon them. -0-

headline: International Children's Day Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 2 (KCNA) -- Happy children across the DPRK greeted the June 1 International Children's Day with pleasure.
The children at all nurseries, kindergartens, baby homes and orphanages in the capital city and local areas spent a pleasant holiday amid the blessings of nurses and kindergarten teachers and parents.
Those of Kim Jong Suk Nursery, Kyongsang Kindergarten, Changgwang Kindergarten and Pyongyang Baby Home and Pyongyang Orphanage received apples and pears associated with the benevolence of the Workers' Party of Korea on their holiday.
Filled with the festive mood were Mirae Kindergarten in Phyongchon District, Ryomyong Kindergarten in Taesong District, Raengchon Kindergarten in Tongdaewon District, Hwasong Kindergarten No. 3 in Hwasong District, Segori Kindergarten in Pothonggang District, Tongsong-dong Nursery in Central District and Thosong-dong No. 1 Nursery in Rangnang District of Pyongyang.
The children, in art performances, sang such songs as "We Yearn for MarshalKim Jong Un" and danced to the tune of various songs.
They took part in the sports and amusement games, divided into "Chong" (blue) and "Hong" (red) teams, "Aircraft" and "Tank" teams, making the on-lookers delighted.
The children of Kanggye Baby Home, Phyongsong Orphanage, Sariwon Orphanage and Nampho Orphanage gave special performances.
Children at Kindergarten No. 2 of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm, Kuje Kindergarten of Haeju City affiliated to Haeju Jo Ok Hui Teachers Training College, Phyonghwa Kindergarten in Wonsan City and Chongmae-dong Nursery in Sinuiju City enjoyed themselves with various folk games and amusement games.
On the same day, commercial service establishments, parks and pleasure grounds across the country were crowded with children spending a pleasant time with their parents. -0-

headline: Mangyongdae Schoolchildren's Palace
Remarks on "Dagger in Heart of Asia" Is Intensive Manifestation of U.S. Hegemonism and Cold War Mentality
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, made public the following article "The remarks on the 'dagger in the heart of Asia' are an intensive manifestation of the U.S. hegemonism and Cold War mentality" on June 3:
Brunson, commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK, in a recent interview described the ROK as the "dagger in the heart of Asia", triggering an international controversy.
He said that when they look out from the east coast of China, what they see is there's the ROK, the "dagger in the heart of Asia". He added that Japan plays the role of sort of a shield as well as the role of checking China's ambition to make inroads into the South China Sea and then the Philippines down to its southeast.
The Chinese Embassy in the ROK said Brunson's comments "crossed the line", and asked the commander: "Are your remarks rife with hostility and aggression regarding China authorized by Washington?"
The ROK also expressed its discomfort, saying that it has been "maintaining communication" with the U.S. And the media expressed concern that Brunson's comments might be interpreted as an intention to expand the ROK-U.S. alliance and the role of the U.S. forces in the ROK in "containing China".
And Brunson made up some excuses, saying that his remarks were misreported and he merely intended to explain the operational conditions. But his assertion served as an occasion of revealing once again the position of the ROK as an advanced base for carrying out the U.S. Indo-Pacific Strategy.
In fact, his remarks are not an impromptu assertion but fully reflect the strategic vision of the successive U.S. administrations intended to use the ROK as an important geopolitical instrument to realize its regional strategy aimed at containing China.
The U.S. has occupied the ROK and used it as a military springboard for invasion of the Asian continent since the 1940s, uttering that the Korean peninsula is just like a "dagger" for cutting a "lump of meat" called Asia. And so far it has ceaselessly sharpened the "dagger" for its regional hegemony.
In particular, the U.S. has put forward the Asia-Pacific rebalancing strategy aimed at containing China and the Indo-Pacific strategy, a detailed and extended version of the former strategy, and focused on attaining the military edge in the region since the end of the Cold War.
To this end, it has tightened its grip on the ROK militarily through the deployment of THAAD and joint military exercises and accelerated the efforts to increase the combat capability of the U.S. forces in the ROK and improve their ability to launch integrated operations with allies.
The U.S., which had expressed its plan to reorganize the U.S. forces in the ROK into the "strategic task force" and "regional expeditionary force" since 2004, reached an agreement with the ROK on "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK in January 2006, and in the 2010 Defense Department report, it clarified for the first time that the U.S. forces in the ROK could be dispatched to other regions according to the principle of "strategic flexibility".
Recently, it more openly advocated the "modernization of the U.S.-ROK alliance" talking about "bolstering up conventional deterrent against all threats in the region" and "ensuring peace and security in the Taiwan Strait" at the 57th U.S.-ROK annual security consultative meeting in November last year. And in the National Security Strategy Report in December that year, it stressed the need for the regional allies including the ROK to increase the defence expenditure with the main emphasis on strengthening the capabilities needed for containing hostile countries and protecting the "first island chain".
According to such policy, the U.S. resorted to arms buildup by forming an "expeditionary reconnaissance battalion" involving the multi-mission drone MQ-9 Reaper in the ROK and deploying more F-16 fighters for establishing the "super-powerful wing".
Recently alone, it approved the sale of 24 new-type helicopters for naval operation MH-60R and parts of attack helicopters AH-64E Apache to the ROK and conducted the training of the U.S. Army multi-domain mobile task force created with the aim of containing neighboring countries within the "first island chain", promoting the coordination of the U.S. military posture in the region.
International media and experts unanimously comment that such U.S. attempt is aimed at coordinating the role, mission and military posture of the U.S. forces in the ROK and the ROK army in the direction of concentrating on deterring major rival states in the Asia-Pacific region.
This makes it possible to realize that the U.S.-ROK nuclear submarine cooperation and the integration of nuclear and conventional forces, which are causing concern of the international community, are, in the long run, directly linked to the attempt to ensure the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the region and make use of the ROK for containing China.
All these facts clearly prove that the U.S.-ROK alliance is the core axis in the new national defense strategy of the U.S. mainly aimed at encircling and deterring its major rival in the Asia-Pacific region.
The U.S.-ROK alliance, which is evolving into a more confrontation-oriented one day by day, has become a fundamental factor in further deteriorating military tension and creating constant instability in the Asia-Pacific region, arousing due vigilance of the regional countries and the international community aspiring after peace and stability.
It is by no means fortuitous that regional countries are recently becoming increasingly critical of the U.S. and the ROK strengthening their alliance and, in particular, expressing deep concern that the ROK may eventually be driven into the same plight as that of Ukraine as it is standing at the strategic crossroads in the competitive relations between the U.S. and China.
The recent remarks of the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK clearly show the vicious appearance of the U.S. as the chieftain of harassing peace and the world's worst war empire, which has regarded the Korean peninsula and its vicinity as the main battlefield for camp confrontation and new Cold War.
The U.S. attempt to bolster up the collective deterrence against the anti-imperialist independent forces in the Asia-Pacific region will inevitably invite security concerns of neighboring powers and promote increased cooperation to offset it. -0-

headline: Relay Teams Carrying Letters of Loyalty near Pyongyang
Japan's Expansion of Arms Export is Dangerous Act Fully Revealing True Colors of War Merchant
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- Kim Ryo Won, an international security analyst of the DPRK, Tuesday issued the following article "Japan's expansion of arms export is a dangerous act fully revealing the true colors of a war merchant":
Taking the advantage of the present unstable international situation in which armed conflicts are frequent in different parts of the planet due to the U.S. arbitrary practices and tyranny, Japan is going beyond the red-line in its frantic moves to free itself from the political and military fetters of the defeated nation and realize its ambition for reinvasion.
Its latest example is Japan's amendments to the "three principles of defense equipment transfer" and the guidelines for its operation in April, which had restricted the arms export just for form's sake, despite concern and strong opposition at home and abroad. And Japan is now keen on expanding arms export while justifying it.
Days ago, the present chief executive of Japan justified the criminal nature of the amendments to the "three principles of defense equipment transfer" by asserting that the essential point is that it makes it possible to increase the deterrent for defence and prevent disputes in advance in the most severe security environment after the war.
Japan, a war criminal state, has revised its policy of arms export, talking about the "dramatic turn of its security policy". This is by no means a matter to be overlooked in view of its intention and purpose.
It is well known that Japan, which is banned by the international law and its own constitution from possessing the right to belligerency, the right to participate in a war and war potentials, has removed the institutional obstacles one by one in a dodged way to export weapons, not content with its frantic development of offensive weapons and equipment.
In the 1960s and 1970s Japan put forward the "three principles of arms export" and "all-round expansion of the principle of banning arms export" as the signboard of a "pacifist state" but behind the scenes it pursued its own purposes.
It is an open secret that the parts of various kinds of lethal weapons used in the sites for aggression wars, big or small, launched by the U.S. to realize its hegemonic strategy, including the Gulf War and the Yugoslavia War, were marked with brands of Japanese munitions monopolies.
In 2014, the then Abe cabinet abolished the "three principles of arms export", a hindrance to the realization of its goal to become a military giant. And it cooked up the so-called "three principles of defense equipment transfer" whose keynote is to allow the export of lethal weapons to those countries taking part in the co-development of weapons and equipment and the export of equipment for non-combatant purpose such as "disaster relief, transportation, guard, surveillance and clearing" to other countries.
In 2023, Japan amended it and sold its home-made Patriot missiles to the U.S. under the permission of its enterprises. In this roundabout way, Japan sent a lot of lethal weapons to the Ukrainian battlefield.
Not content with this, Japan completely removed the restrictions on the export of weapons and equipment at this time and added an exceptional clause that allows it not to observe the principle of banning arms exports to a party in a conflict under "the special circumstances." By doing so, Japan opened up a legitimate way to unrestrictedly sell all kinds of lethal weapons to any conflict zone in the world.
Accordingly, Japan is busy exporting all kinds of lethal weapons, including escort ships, submarines and missiles, through frequent arms sales negotiations with its so-called like-minded countries.
The world people still remember the criminal act committed by Japan which got a windfall through the supply of vast quantities of munitions as a logistic base of the U.S. during the Korean War in the 1950s, and embarked upon the road of reviving militarism with it as its asset.
Japan's expansion of arms export is a dangerous act that fully revealed its true colors as a war merchant intended to expand the munitions industry and realize its ambition to be a major military power at any cost through the selling of a large number of deadly weapons.
And Japan seeks to accelerate the preparations for reinvasion by worsening geopolitical conflicts in the hot spots of the world and making much money through the bloodshed. Herein lies the injustice and dangerousness of Japan's arms export expansion.
Japan once resorted to political and military provocations against the neighboring country, suggesting its intervention in "Taiwan contingency", and it is now developing into a war state by finding a market for selling various lethal weapons. So, Japan's destination is quite self-evident.
The international community should thoroughly check and frustrate ever-increasing moves of Japan, a war criminal state, to become a military giant as it has completely discarded even the veil of "pacifist state", obsessed with its ambition for reinvasion, and seriously threatens global peace and security. -0-

headline: Loach Soup - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- Loach soup is a specialty of the Kaesong area in the DPRK. It is a spicy food boiled hard with other ingredients.
According to historical data, the people of the Koryo (ancient Korean state) enjoyed loach soup.
The records dating back to the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910) tell that there was a special loach soup processed with blocks of bean curd with loaches in them as well as ordinary loach soup.
The preparation of loach soups is different according to regions.
In particular, inhabitants in the Kaesong area usually season the flesh of loaches and then thoroughly boil it with Kaesong peppered bean paste.
In every region, the people flavour loach soups with ginger juice or betony.
Loach is good for the health of people. It is easy to digest and effective in invigorating and restoring liver function.
Therefore, the Korean people have made soup with fleshy and nutritious loaches in autumn every year to regain strength.
Loach soup was registered as part of the national intangible cultural heritage in October 2017. -0-

headline: Good Kelp Harvest at Offshore Farms in N. Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the offshore farms in North Hamgyong Province in the DPRK have a record kelp harvest this year.
The Chongjin Fishery Station, Kim Chaek Fishery Station and other fishery stations further expanded the areas for aquaculture this year and thus their kelp output is expected to be more than doubled as compared with last year.
The offshore farms in the province are now harvesting hundreds of tons of kelp every day. -0-

headline: Newly-established Winter Camping System
story_text:
One day in May 2013, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unvisited the Songdowon International Children's Camp.
He went round various places of the camp and indicated in detail the orientation and ways for its reconstruction. Then, he learned about the period of its operation in the whole year.
After being told that the camp was run only in summer, the respected fatherly Marshal said that if the camp building was provided with proper heating system, it would be quite possible to ensure camping in winter. It would be good to make exemplary Children's Union members selected from different parts of the country enjoy camping in winter while skiing at the Masikryong Ski Resort, he added.
And he said that the start of the camping in winter at the Songdowon International Children's Camp will serve as a new camping system in the country.
Thanks to the loving care of the respected fatherly Marshal who is devoting his all to the younger generation, children could enjoy camping at the indoor wading pool of the Songdowon International Children's Camp and at the Masikryong Ski Resort in the winter season. -0-

headline: Increased Production of Fries for Paddy-field Fish Breeding in N. Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province in the DPRK remade hundreds of hectares of paddy fields for fish breeding. And it is now focusing its attention on the production of fries, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Sonsang spawning station of the provincial rural economy committee was successfully completed. And Sinuiju, Kusong and Jongju cities and Sonchon County built or rebuilt spawning grounds to suit their actual conditions.
The Sonsang spawning station and city and county spawning grounds are trying to raise the technical and skill levels and responsibility of their employees to produce more fries.
The province is taking scientific and technological measures to increase the production of fries and, at the same time, intensifying technical guidance and assistance to raise the survival rate of more than 10 million fries it has already produced. -0-

In the 1960s and 1970s Japan put forward the "three principles of arms export" and "all-round expansion of the principle of banning arms export" as the signboard of a "pacifist state" but behind the scenes it pursued its own purposes.
It is an open secret that the parts of various kinds of lethal weapons used in the sites for aggression wars, big or small, launched by the U.S. to realize its hegemonic strategy, including the Gulf War and the Yugoslavia War, were marked with brands of Japanese munitions monopolies.
In 2014, the then Abe cabinet abolished the "three principles of arms export", a hindrance to the realization of its goal to become a military giant. And it cooked up the so-called "three principles of defense equipment transfer" whose keynote is to allow the export of lethal weapons to those countries taking part in the co-development of weapons and equipment and the export of equipment for non-combatant purpose such as "disaster relief, transportation, guard, surveillance and clearing" to other countries.
In 2023, Japan amended it and sold its home-made Patriot missiles to the U.S. under the permission of its enterprises. In this roundabout way, Japan sent a lot of lethal weapons to the Ukrainian battlefield.
Not content with this, Japan completely removed the restrictions on the export of weapons and equipment at this time and added an exceptional clause that allows it not to observe the principle of banning arms exports to a party in a conflict under "the special circumstances." By doing so, Japan opened up a legitimate way to unrestrictedly sell all kinds of lethal weapons to any conflict zone in the world.
Accordingly, Japan is busy exporting all kinds of lethal weapons, including escort ships, submarines and missiles, through frequent arms sales negotiations with its so-called like-minded countries.
The world people still remember the criminal act committed by Japan which got a windfall through the supply of vast quantities of munitions as a logistic base of the U.S. during the Korean War in the 1950s, and embarked upon the road of reviving militarism with it as its asset.
Japan's expansion of arms export is a dangerous act that fully revealed its true colors as a war merchant intended to expand the munitions industry and realize its ambition to be a major military power at any cost through the selling of a large number of deadly weapons.
And Japan seeks to accelerate the preparations for reinvasion by worsening geopolitical conflicts in the hot spots of the world and making much money through the bloodshed. Herein lies the injustice and dangerousness of Japan's arms export expansion.
Japan once resorted to political and military provocations against the neighboring country, suggesting its intervention in "Taiwan contingency", and it is now developing into a war state by finding a market for selling various lethal weapons. So, Japan's destination is quite self-evident.
The international community should thoroughly check and frustrate ever-increasing moves of Japan, a war criminal state, to become a military giant as it has completely discarded even the veil of "pacifist state", obsessed with its ambition for reinvasion, and seriously threatens global peace and security. -0-

headline: Remarks on "Dagger in Heart of Asia" Is Intensive Manifestation of U.S. Hegemonism and Cold War Mentality
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 3 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, made public the following article "The remarks on the 'dagger in the heart of Asia' are an intensive manifestation of the U.S. hegemonism and Cold War mentality" on June 3:
Brunson, commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK, in a recent interview described the ROK as the "dagger in the heart of Asia", triggering an international controversy.
He said that when they look out from the east coast of China, what they see is there's the ROK, the "dagger in the heart of Asia". He added that Japan plays the role of sort of a shield as well as the role of checking China's ambition to make inroads into the South China Sea and then the Philippines down to its southeast.
The Chinese Embassy in the ROK said Brunson's comments "crossed the line", and asked the commander: "Are your remarks rife with hostility and aggression regarding China authorized by Washington?"
The ROK also expressed its discomfort, saying that it has been "maintaining communication" with the U.S. And the media expressed concern that Brunson's comments might be interpreted as an intention to expand the ROK-U.S. alliance and the role of the U.S. forces in the ROK in "containing China".
And Brunson made up some excuses, saying that his remarks were misreported and he merely intended to explain the operational conditions. But his assertion served as an occasion of revealing once again the position of the ROK as an advanced base for carrying out the U.S. Indo-Pacific Strategy.
In fact, his remarks are not an impromptu assertion but fully reflect the strategic vision of the successive U.S. administrations intended to use the ROK as an important geopolitical instrument to realize its regional strategy aimed at containing China.
The U.S. has occupied the ROK and used it as a military springboard for invasion of the Asian continent since the 1940s, uttering that the Korean peninsula is just like a "dagger" for cutting a "lump of meat" called Asia. And so far it has ceaselessly sharpened the "dagger" for its regional hegemony.
In particular, the U.S. has put forward the Asia-Pacific rebalancing strategy aimed at containing China and the Indo-Pacific strategy, a detailed and extended version of the former strategy, and focused on attaining the military edge in the region since the end of the Cold War.
To this end, it has tightened its grip on the ROK militarily through the deployment of THAAD and joint military exercises and accelerated the efforts to increase the combat capability of the U.S. forces in the ROK and improve their ability to launch integrated operations with allies.
The U.S., which had expressed its plan to reorganize the U.S. forces in the ROK into the "strategic task force" and "regional expeditionary force" since 2004, reached an agreement with the ROK on "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the ROK in January 2006, and in the 2010 Defense Department report, it clarified for the first time that the U.S. forces in the ROK could be dispatched to other regions according to the principle of "strategic flexibility".
Recently, it more openly advocated the "modernization of the U.S.-ROK alliance" talking about "bolstering up conventional deterrent against all threats in the region" and "ensuring peace and security in the Taiwan Strait" at the 57th U.S.-ROK annual security consultative meeting in November last year. And in the National Security Strategy Report in December that year, it stressed the need for the regional allies including the ROK to increase the defence expenditure with the main emphasis on strengthening the capabilities needed for containing hostile countries and protecting the "first island chain".
According to such policy, the U.S. resorted to arms buildup by forming an "expeditionary reconnaissance battalion" involving the multi-mission drone MQ-9 Reaper in the ROK and deploying more F-16 fighters for establishing the "super-powerful wing".
Recently alone, it approved the sale of 24 new-type helicopters for naval operation MH-60R and parts of attack helicopters AH-64E Apache to the ROK and conducted the training of the U.S. Army multi-domain mobile task force created with the aim of containing neighboring countries within the "first island chain", promoting the coordination of the U.S. military posture in the region.
International media and experts unanimously comment that such U.S. attempt is aimed at coordinating the role, mission and military posture of the U.S. forces in the ROK and the ROK army in the direction of concentrating on deterring major rival states in the Asia-Pacific region.
This makes it possible to realize that the U.S.-ROK nuclear submarine cooperation and the integration of nuclear and conventional forces, which are causing concern of the international community, are, in the long run, directly linked to the attempt to ensure the "strategic flexibility" of the U.S. forces in the region and make use of the ROK for containing China.
All these facts clearly prove that the U.S.-ROK alliance is the core axis in the new national defense strategy of the U.S. mainly aimed at encircling and deterring its major rival in the Asia-Pacific region.
The U.S.-ROK alliance, which is evolving into a more confrontation-oriented one day by day, has become a fundamental factor in further deteriorating military tension and creating constant instability in the Asia-Pacific region, arousing due vigilance of the regional countries and the international community aspiring after peace and stability.
It is by no means fortuitous that regional countries are recently becoming increasingly critical of the U.S. and the ROK strengthening their alliance and, in particular, expressing deep concern that the ROK may eventually be driven into the same plight as that of Ukraine as it is standing at the strategic crossroads in the competitive relations between the U.S. and China.
The recent remarks of the commander of the U.S. forces in the ROK clearly show the vicious appearance of the U.S. as the chieftain of harassing peace and the world's worst war empire, which has regarded the Korean peninsula and its vicinity as the main battlefield for camp confrontation and new Cold War.
The U.S. attempt to bolster up the collective deterrence against the anti-imperialist independent forces in the Asia-Pacific region will inevitably invite security concerns of neighboring powers and promote increased cooperation to offset it. -0-

headline: Battle of Pochonbo
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 4 (KCNA) -- Today marks the 89th anniversary of the historic Battle of Pochonbo organized and commanded by PresidentKim Il Sungduring the anti-Japanese revolutionary war.
In the 1930s, the Japanese imperialists intensified their fascist suppression of our people.
Korea turned into a huge prison due to the Japanese imperialists' brutal atrocities of fabricating all sorts of evil laws and of arresting, imprisoning and killing people at random.
PresidentKim Il Sungdecided to march to the homeland and attack a stronghold of the enemy as soon as possible in order to give confidence in the country's liberation to the Korean people suffering from a prolonged nightmare and encourage them to turn out in the war of resistance against Japan.
The gun report of Pochonbo rang out on June 4, 1937 thanks to the transparent and independent faith and indomitable will of the President.
With a gun report by the President as a signal, members of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army made a rapid assault and wiped out the enemy's ruling organs including the police sub-station in Pochonbo, one of the main military positions of the enemy and the centers of colonial rule and plunder in the border area.
After the Battle of Pochonbo, the President launched thrilling operations to wipe out the enemy in pursuit once again, leading the Battle on Mt Kouyushui and the Battle of Jiansanfeng to great victory.
Recollecting those battles, he wrote in his reminiscences"With the Century"that the Battle of Pochonbo demonstrated to the public at home and abroad the revolutionary will of our people to put an end to the Japanese imperialist colonial rule and win back national independence and sovereignty, and their indomitable fighting spirit.
The Battle of Pochonbo demonstrated to the whole world that Korea is alive. With the battle as an occasion, our people turned out more vigorously in the war of resistance against Japan. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Newly-Inaugurated Nuclear Materials Production Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 4 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the newly-inaugurated nuclear materials production factory on June 3.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the munitions industry department of the WPK Central Committee and the Nuclear Weapons Institute of the DPRK.
Going round new production lines based on more sophisticated technology, ComradeKim Jong Unlearned about the factory's operation indices and its long-term production plan.
He highly appreciated the fact that the nuclear materials production sector is correctly implementing the decisions adopted at recent plenary meetings of the WPK Central Committee.
He praised the group of nuclear experts for having provided a firm guarantee to improve the efficiency of all system elements in the production line and further strengthen the foundation for the production of weapons-grade nuclear materials by settling the problems decisive in putting the production of nuclear materials on a Juche basis.
Saying that the weapons-grade nuclear materials production capacity more than doubled during the past 5-year course of bolstering up the nuclear force under the direct guidance of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the WPK's line of bolstering up nuclear forces is being thoroughly carried out thanks to the high technical capability developed by the nuclear science research group.
He recalled that the Ninth Congress of the WPK adopted a strategic decision to further expand the nuclear materials production capacity and continue to increase the nuclear arsenals in line with the prospective demand of the DPRK's nuclear force, when deciding on a new five-year plan for the strengthened nuclear force to steadily enhance the country's nuclear war deterrent.
The peculiarities of the Korean revolution inevitably accompanied by long-term confrontation with the most ferocious enemies, the existing threats getting more serious every moment, potential threats and unpredictable long-term crises further highlight the urgency and responsibility of the historic mission to bolster up both in quality and quantity and in a sustained and accelerated way the nuclear war deterrent, the basic guarantee and strong safety device for reliably ensuring the security, interests and development rights of the country, he noted.
Very clear is the stand taken by our Party and government to deal with all these complex changes in the subjective and objective environments and actively cope with them, and accordingly, it is the invariable political and military stand and responsible duty we should maintain to further expand and strengthen the state nuclear forces, the pivot in implementing the strategy to deter a war and fight a war, and thoroughly exercise the position of a nuclear weapons state, he declared.
That day, there was an important consultative meeting for bolstering up the nuclear forces.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade an important conclusion clarifying the action guidelines for rapidly accelerating the qualitative and quantitative strengthening of the DPRK's nuclear forces, saying that the conditions in which the nuclear materials production capacity has greatly expanded and the development of sophisticated nuclear technology create a mature environment for going into the new next-stage of bolstering up the nuclear forces and they offer the possibility of carrying out larger plans.
Finishing his important conclusion, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid:
"Today we have updated the digits that are critical for our nuclear activities, and discussed some key matters.
In doing so, we have comprehensively considered the tactical and strategic requirements for building up our nuclear deterrent and, on the basis of this, adopted a highly responsible and crucial decision.
We have confirmed the order of priority for implementing the ambitious future plan designed to beef up our state’s nuclear forces at an exponential rate, as well as a requisite guarantee for the purpose.
This signifies an amazing, successful change that is beyond rhetorical description, a historic event that has set up an epochal milestone in rapidly upgrading our nuclear capabilities.
This nuclear potential that we have now is inconceivable apart from the worthwhile struggle we have conducted over the past five years.
Today, I would like to pay tribute, once again, to our nuclear scientists."
He stressed that the DPRK will as ever more thoroughly and more courageously take action to defend its constitution and sovereignty and reliably ensure the security of the state by exercising in a responsible manner the inviolable authority granted by the DPRK Constitution.
He expressed expectation and belief that the DPRK's group of nuclear experts would remain faithful to the fulfillment of the sacred mission for the perfect implementation of the decision adopted by the Party for the security of the country in the present and in the future.
ComradeKim Jong Un's inspection of the new nuclear materials production factory serves as an important occasion in clearly highlighting once again the invariable will of our Party and state to bolster up the nuclear forces in order to guarantee the country's security and right to development, deter war and defend the regional and global peace and stability by highly developing the nuclear weapons, and the great potentialities and unlimited prospect. -0-

headline: Participants in Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday Tour Various Parts of Pyongyang
Korean Children's Union
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- June 6 is the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who regarded the work of bringing up the rising generation as an important issue related to the future destiny of the revolution, formed the Saenal Children's Union (December 15, 1926) in the days of his early revolutionary activities. Its formation was the origin of the revolutionary children's movement in the country.
The President also formed different children's organizations and organized the Children's Corps in the period of the anti-Japanese armed struggle to train the rising generation into the pillars of the revolution and masters of the future.
Under his leadership, the KCU, which inherited the revolutionary tradition of the Saenal Children's Union and the Anti-Japanese Children's Corps, was founded on June 6, 1946, after the liberation of the country.
On this historic day, the President attended a joint meeting of the children's union organizations in Pyongyang Municipality  for founding the KCU and hoped the KCU members would grow up healthily and learn well as befits the treasure of new Korea and masters of new Korea and become heroes building a new, democratic Korea.
The founding of the KCU ushered in a new era of the children's movement in our country.
The KCU members performed proud feats and left patriotic traces in laying the foundation of a new democratic Korea, fighting to defend their native places during the Fatherland Liberation War and making contributions to the socialist construction and the country's economy. -0-

headline: Environmental Protection Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 5 (KCNA) -- The UN General Assembly in 1972 raised environmental protection as an important issue to be addressed by the whole world and decided to commemorate the World Environment Day on June 5 every year.
In the past, the work for environmental protection was conducted as a nationwide and all-people movement in the DPRK.
According to the environmental protection policy of the DPRK government, the Law on the Protection of Environment was adopted in April 1986 and innovative measures were taken to conserve forests, prevent pollution of rivers and reduce greenhouse gas emission.
Afterwards, the Law on the Protection of Environment was amended and supplemented several times to contribute to making the appearance of the land more beautiful, protecting and promoting the people's health and providing them with cultural and hygienic living environment and working conditions.
Officials, working people, youth and students have turned out in the drive for making all mountains of the country into gold and treasure ones in every spring and autumn period of the general mobilization for land administration.
Mass media including Korean Central TV conduct intensive propaganda on environmental protection such as disseminating common sense and explaining it so that all the people take an active part in this work.
The work is being conducted in different parts of the country to improve environment such as river improvement, road reconstruction, landscaping streets and villages, repairing houses and sprucing up parks and recreation grounds.
Many foreign visitors say that cities and air are clean in the DPRK. -0-

headline:

story_text:

On the occasion of the significant day, the DPRK people extend congratulations to the KCU members growing up to be masters of the future while fully realizing their beautiful dreams and hopes and cultivating their talents to the full under the care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.

headline: Foundations for Raw Materials Bases Strengthened
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 6 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK directs its efforts to consolidating the material and technical foundations of raw materials bases.
After surveying non-cultivating land and low-yielding fields, the municipality turned more than 180 hectares of land into bases for producing raw materials this year alone. It has also taken steps to properly plant oil, sugar and aromatic crops, etc. and increase the per-hectare yields, while putting the production of raw materials on a more intensive basis through effective measures.
In order to boost production at the regional-industry factories, Onchon County provided a raw materials base station with farm machines and small and medium-sized farm implements.
Chollima and Kangso districts supplied cultivators, tractor parts and knapsack sprayers to the raw materials production units to contribute to increasing the proportion of the farm work done by machines.
Ryonggang and Taean districts planted rape in more fields than planned and Waudo and Hanggu districts turned tens of hectares of treeless zones into Evodia daniellii Benn forests and are now taking care of them in a scientific and technological way.
The municipality is building pumping stations in dozens of places and digging more water holes and tube wells. -0-

Pothonggang District and Central District remodeled Kumrando and Unhado sports parks and Yokjon Park and equipped them with modern facilities and exercise apparatuses. And they planted trees and flowering shrubs of good species in the surrounding lawn to add to scenic beauty of the parks.
Floricultural stations in the districts of Taesong and Taedonggang took technical measures to prevent flowers from being affected by the abnormal weather, and planted in flowerpot stands highly ornamental flowers which bloom relatively long. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Observes Navigation Test of Destroyer Kang Kon
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 6 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Destroyer Kang Kon of the Navy of the Korean People's Army, which has entered the shakedown for assessing its capability of executing operations, and observed its navigation test on June 4.
He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, Kim Myong Son, director of the Armaments Examination Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence, commanding officers of the Navy and senior officials in the field of shipbuilding.
ComradeKim Jong Unboarded the Destroyer Kang Kon and learned about the actual conditions of various combat duty spaces and elements of the destroyer including the combined control center, the plan for the navigation test and the phased schedule of the test of the warship's weapon systems.
A navigation test was conducted to assess different maneuvering elements of the destroyer with ComradeKim Jong Unon board the warship.
ComradeKim Jong Unpraised the sailors for their high ability to operate the warship and expressed satisfaction over the cruise and high-speed maneuvering systems of the warship whose maneuverability is very good to meet operational requirements.
Referring to the global trend of the developing shipbuilding industry and the structural features of warship design, he clarified the important tasks for further perfecting the warship control system in our own way so as to meet the requirements for the performance of operational mission of our Navy.
It is possible to deter war and defend peace only when we possess substantial and powerful military muscle capable of exercising military sovereignty in a responsible manner in any space of the ground, the sea and the air, he said, adding this is the invariable view of the WPK and its national defence policy.
In particular, the issue of rapidly developing and strengthening the naval force of the DPRK into a force capable of reliably taking charge of a part of the nuclear war deterrent and into a group that can deal a deadly blow at the enemy any moment under the water or on the water is a matter which the WPK regards as the most important core task in the new five-year national defence development policy, he said.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed great trust and expectation that the vast plans for bolstering up the warship force, including the development and production of underwater secret weapons and the building of 10 000-tonnage destroyers under the five-year plan for modernizing the Navy approved by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, would be surely carried out by our reliable and powerful defence science research group, self-supporting shipbuilding industry and competent and intelligent workers in the munitions industry.
He warmly encouraged the officials, scientists and technicians of warship and weapon system research organs, hoping that they will successfully conduct the shakedown for assessing the operational executive capability of the destroyer and put the destroyers Choe Hyon and Kang Kon into commission for the Navy as soon as possible with an honorable sense of obligation and high sense of responsibility. -0-

headline: Mass Movement Launched by Trade Union Organizations in Kangwon Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- Trade union organizations in Kangwon Province of the DPRK are actively conducting a mass movement conducive to the development of the regional economy and the improvement of the people's standard of living.
Officials of the provincial trade union committee and itinerant lecturers of the trade union organizations at provincial-level units encouraged the working people to a campaign for increased production and economy while conducting motivation activities at the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex, the Munchon Valve Factory and other units.
Trade union organizations at the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory and the Wonsan School Uniform Factory are encouraging their members to make progress in raising the quality of products and increasing the production by improving the effectiveness of ideological work to make them contribute to the development of the unit.
Trade union officials at the Wonsan Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory, the Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory and the Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory are making progress in training their members into highly skilled workers and all-round machinists.
100-odd farm machine repair support teams, dispatched by trade union organizations in the province, have made the round of farms to overhaul tractors, rice-transplanting machines, water pumps and motors.
Trade union members of the provincial-level units sent many farm machines to the farms.
The trade union organizations in Cholwon, Chonnae, Anbyon and Phyonggang counties boosted the enthusiasm of agricultural workers for rich harvest by providing them with tractor spare parts, vinyl sheets for farming and knapsack sprayers. -0-

Pak Thae Song and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Ri Hi Yong, Jong Kyong Thaek, Sin Yong Il, Jo Chun Ryong, An Kum Chol, Kim Jong Gwan, Kim Tok Hun, Jon Hyon Chol and other senior Party and government officials visited all provinces (municipalities) of the country on June 6 to celebrate the KCU founding anniversary with the schoolchildren.

Senior Party and government officials also enjoyed the sports and amusement games together with the schoolchildren. -0-

headline: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Participants in Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Conference Held with Splendor to Commemorate 80th KCU Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The Korean Children's Union, a mass political organization of schoolchildren who are the future and hope of our state and people, is proudly marking its 80th founding anniversary in its history of glorious succession and growth.
The KCU has steadily developed into the ranks of juvenile revolutionaries and patriots who are firmly carrying on the revolution and patriotism generation after generation, adding luster to the sacred history and tradition created in the battlefields of Mt Paektu, for the past 80 years since it was founded as the Juche-oriented children's revolutionary organization in the first period of nation building.
All the people across the country are convinced of the bright future of our state and our cause when they look at the bright and lively appearance of the rising generation who are growing up to be stalwart pillars of the DPRK in the future, bringing their hope and talents into full bloom under the care of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea and the grateful socialist motherland. And they are extending warm congratulations to the KCU members across the country on the significant June holiday.
A conference in commemoration of the 80th KCU founding anniversary was held with splendor atKim Il SungStadium in the capital city of Pyongyang on June 6 amid special concern and expectation of the Party, government and people.
MarshalKim Jong Un, the benevolent father of all the schoolchildren across the country, attended the conference.
When MarshalKim Jong Unappeared on the platform, the schoolchildren broke into cheers as an expression of their highest honour and pride of significantly commemorating the founding anniversary of the KCU with the fatherly Marshal, whom they yearned for even in their dreams, in presence and fireworks were set off, rocking the stadium.
All the participants extended thanks to the fatherly Marshal who has worked heart and soul to make the schoolchildren enjoy the greatest happiness in the most dignified country, powerful and prosperous, regarding the work for the younger generation as the most important affair directly linked with the future of the revolution and the destiny of the state.
Representatives of the KCU organizations presented bouquets of fragrant flowers to MarshalKim Jong Unand tied a red necktie of the KCU around his neck.
The fatherly Marshal extended warm congratulations to the members of the KCU on its significant 80th founding anniversary amid the blessing of the whole country.
Present there were Kim Jae Ryong, Ri Il Hwan, Ju Chang Il and Kim Sung Du, secretaries of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Su Kil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK, representatives of the KCU organizations including the members of relay teams carrying letters of loyalty, members of the delegation of Korean schoolchildren in Japan, students of revolutionary schools, members of the KCU, sub-branch instructors and officials of the youth league in Pyongyang.
There was a ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK.
The exemplary KCU members hoisted the glorious national flag amid the solemn playing of the DPRK national anthem.
The sacred national flag, being hoisted in solemn reverence, made the hearts of the participants burn with the desire to demonstrate the dignity and honor of our most beautiful and greatest country generation after generation.
The representatives of the KCU organizations courteously presented the fatherly Marshal with letters of loyalty reflecting the boundless wishes of the KCU members across the country and their pledge of succession.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made a report at the conference.
The reporter said that the KCU members are celebrating the auspicious founding anniversary of their organization with the greatest joy and happiness and it is the honor that they can receive only under the care of the motherly WPK which brings earlier the prosperous ideal society with love and sincerity for the rising generation. He referred to the proud 80-year history of the KCU which has recorded all the annals of its founding and development with patriotic loyalty.
He said that the KCU members are growing up to be juvenile revolutionaries and patriots dynamically advancing along the road of patriotism as they are holding in high esteem the fatherly Marshal who pursues the socialist policy for schoolchildren as the consistent policy of the Party and the eternal state policy of the DPRK and takes warm care of them so that they can learn with nothing more to desire, grow up excellently and bring their hope and talents into full bloom.
He extended the warmest thanks to the fatherly Marshal for bringing up the KCU members to be true sons and daughters of the socialist country and showing constant loving care and benevolence to them, reflecting the unanimous mind of the schoolchildren, educators and parents across the country.
The reporter said that the new era of national prosperity, in which everything on this land is undergoing change beyond recognition, leads the beautiful dreams and hopes of the KCU members towards a brighter future, calling on the schoolchildren to more firmly prepare themselves as reserves for socialist construction.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unmade a significant congratulatory speech on the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union.
"Our proud Children’s Union members,
This is June 6, your holiday.
On this holiday, 80th founding anniversary of your organization, the whole country is sending greetings of congratulation to all of you, Children’s Union members, who are precious sons and daughters of our people and masters of the future of this Korea.
As I see your neat and vigorous appearance, I really feel reassured.
Children’s Union members,
Overcoming the harsh trials as it sees you and creating more with greater exertion as it wishes that the rising generation will lead a happy life with nothing to envy--this is the course of, and secret to, this country achieving prosperity.
Beloved Children’s Union members,
You should not forget that the richer knowledge you acquire, the more healthily and stoutly you grow up and the greater feeling of helping and leading one another forward you cherish in your mind, the stronger your country will become and the happier the laughter will be in the streets, villages, workplaces and houses across the country.
You should steadily shoulder the future of this country.
My wish is that you will all be filial to your parents, study hard and be exemplary in the organizational life in good health.
I really feel happier today than any other days.
It is because I am sure that, as it has you, our country will become more youthful and beautiful.
Children’s Union members,
Let us all march forward courageously towards the future as befitting the sons and daughters of Korea."
When the Marshal finished his speech, the members of the KCU, who received great love and trust from the benevolent father, broke into enthusiastic cheers of "Hurrah!"
All the participants made a pledge of loyalty to the fatherly Marshal.
The members of the KCU made a solemn oath to become reliable pillars of the country and true sons and daughters boundlessly loyal to the country by learning and learning for the DPRK, always bearing deep in mind the gratitude to the motherly Workers' Party of Korea, which is taking warm care of them as the new generation of the DPRK.
Then followed a march of resolution of the new generation.
With a column under the national flag of the DPRK in the van, the KCU members marched vigorously, flying the flag of the KCU ahead of their columns, as a pledge of loyalty and repayment.
The columns of revolutionary schools and the columns of the provincial KCU members dynamically marched with the enthusiasm to glorify the glorious tradition of the Anti-Japanese Children's Corps generation after generation and become the masters of a prosperous power, who are knowledgeable, moral and healthy and imbued with ardent patriotism.
The sky of June resounded with the slogans chanted by the marchers reflecting the firm determination of all the KCU members to be always ready for the socialist country, trusting and following only the fatherly Marshal who defends and brings into full bloom the dreams and hopes of the rising generation and the bright future of the country which will be rosy forever.
The conference significantly concluded amid the resounding of the song "MarshalKim Jong UnIs Our Father" sang by the KCU members in chorus out of their boundless gratitude to the fatherly Marshal who took a benevolent measure to celebrate June 6 as a national holiday every year and brings the greatest happiness to them.
The fatherly Marshal warmly waved to the new generation, the reliable successors to the revolution who would firmly carry forward the baton of the Juche cause, and wished the KCU members the bright future.
The conference marked a significant occasion of clearly showing the proud appearance and mettle of our KCU members, who are growing up to be pillars of future socialist Korea under the guidance of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, and of further encouraging the people across the country to bring earlier the bright future of national prosperity with towering self-confidence and redoubled enthusiasm. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following statement on June 6:
Still, some officials in the United States have failed to wake from their escapist and anachronistic dreams.
A spokesperson for the U.S. Department of State on June 5 said in response to a request by one of its media for comment that the China-U.S. summit held in May reconfirmed the shared goal for the "denuclearization" of the DPRK.
This is nothing but an old practice of the U.S. for spreading false information.
The U.S. representative of trade had already intimated last month that the China-U.S. summit reconfirmed what was called "denuclearization". However, it is just a complete fabrication and false information. And it may be a hope of the U.S. officials very much fond of uttering the archaic word "denuclearization" but it is absolutely untrue.
We have the most accurate information about the fact.
And we also make it clear that we do not discuss with anyone our core sovereignty and security and the insolent act of violating the state constitution which should be observed in the most sacred way.
The U.S. assertion to backbite the status of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state has no legally binding force and no one will be bound by the U.S. unilateral rhetoric.
The forces, which have remained most hostile to the DPRK and expressed through undisguised speech and behavior their sinister intention to be most outrageous in the present and future, should stop slandering the just policy of the DPRK for self-defence and, in particular, give up the daydream about "denuclearization".
We are now eyeing the course of the dangerous evolution of the nuclear alliance against the DPRK.
All acts of shaking the security of the DPRK and the region down to the roots, including the expansion and development of aggressive military blocs sharing nukes, the conduct of various military drills premised on the use of nuclear weapons and the constant deployment of nuclear strategic assets, clearly prove the justness and legitimacy of building a solid nuclear shield of the DPRK.
As far as today's news is concerned, we also have something to say.
The U.S. Department of State has reportedly decided to approve the export of JDAM and associated equipment to the ROK.
The enemy is busy with such an act.
This is the reason why we are concentrating on bolstering up the self-defence capacity for defending the security of the state from the ceaseless arms buildup of the hostile countries and we will have to do this.
In order to protect its sovereignty and security and ensure regional stability and peace, the DPRK will never remain a passive onlooker to the situation in which the equilibrium of forces is destroyed.
The line of steadily beefing up the nuclear war deterrent for self-defence, clarified by the head of state, is an irreversible final conclusion to be carried out unconditionally.
It sends the world a clear signal that we will never compromise as regards the issue of defence and sovereignty.

headline: River Improvement and Technical Remodeling of Roads in Jagang Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- Jagang Province of the DPRK is directing efforts to the river improvement and technical remodeling of roads.
This year, the province dredged more than 900 000 cubic meters of riverbed, built hundreds of thousands of square meters of retaining wall and finished road pavement and bridge construction between cities and counties.
After working out a plan to spruce up the regional appearance and conducting survey of the state of rivers and roads, the province has stepped up the project to raise the water passing capacity and hasten the technical remodeling of roads.
Huichon City concentrated its forces and means on the construction and reinforcement of embankments in the Chongchon River area, dredged riverbeds and built retaining walls on dangerous sites.
Songwon and Rangnim counties completed the improvement of small and medium rivers and Junggang and Hyangsan counties took measures for preventing flood damage.
Officials and working people in the province finished the pavement of road between Hyangsan and Huichon within 20-odd days and are conducting the asphalt pavement of road between Huichon and Tongsin.
Janggang County raised the ground level and laid broken stones in a section of road extending more than 10 kilometers and built new bridges.
Usi, Hwaphyong and Jasong counties are improving the overall appearance of roads in the area. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren in DPRK Celebrate KCU Birthday
Photo Session with Delegates to KCU Congress
story_text:
It was January 1, 2023.
That day, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Untold officials that he would have a photo session with the delegates to the Ninth Congress of the Korean Children's Union.
He noted that he had prepared special gifts for the KCU delegates, making them stay in Pyongyang for more than ten days to have the congress and tour various places so as to celebrate the New Year's Day with them, and enjoyed a grand New Year performance together with them.
Stressing that the children attending the congress are sons and daughters of ordinary working people, he said that the KCU delegates would badly wait for him today, New Year's Day, and their parents would feel very regrettable if he failed to have a photo taken with them.
After all, the participants in the Ninth KCU Congress came to have the honor of having a photo session with the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwhom they wanted to see so much. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Major Munitions Industrial Enterprise to Learn about First Half-Yearly Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected a major munitions industrial enterprise on June 6 to acquaint himself with the main weapons production in the first half of 2026.
Accompanying him were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence and director of the General Armaments Bureau, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, and leading officials of the Missile Administration.
ComradeKim Jong Unhighly praised the enterprise for fulfilling its first half-yearly plan for the main weapons production ahead of schedule and putting spurs to the preparations for the production in the second half of the year.
That day, he heard a report on the Missile Administration's long-term plan for expanding the capacity to produce various ballistic missiles and cruise missiles and gave an instruction to submit it to the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK for deliberation.
It is necessary to boost the existing production capacity 2.5 times within the Five-Year Plan period on an annual growth basis in order to supply enough quantity of missiles the demand for which will drastically increase as our armed forces' operational group formation and combat organization are to be modified, he said, stressing that it is a core task of very important significance.
Underlining the need for the enterprise to establish the strict regulations and order for quality control and thoroughly observe the requirements of the inspection process so as to further improve the quality of products, he gave a series of instructions for its production and management. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren in DPRK Celebrate KCU Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The Korean Children's Union recorded the 80th founding anniversary in the proud course of its development. On this occasion, the whole country is overflowing with joy and optimism of the KCU members.
All the schools across the country were full of happiness and joy of the schoolchildren who were giving art performances and playing sports and amusement games amid the congratulations of their teachers and parents.
All the KCU members placed flower baskets, bouquets and flowers at the statues of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Ilin their residential areas and paid tribute to them.
The provincial, city and county youth league committees and KCU organizations at schools organized general meetings of KCU organizations, meetings of young activists in noble traits and meetings to hear stories about the pride of KCU members.
Art performances of schoolchildren and other cultural events took place across the country, adding pleasure to the holiday.
Officials of Party and government organs in all the provinces, cities and counties visited the KCU members to congratulate them on the founding anniversary.
Through various numbers, the performers showed well the bright and cheerful looks of the schoolchildren who are bringing their hopes and talents into full bloom by making them knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The venues for dancing parties, too, were overflowing with joy and optimism of schoolchildren significantly celebrating the KCU birthday.
Sports and amusement games, including a tug of war, running with their ankles tied and a basketball, took place at schools across the country. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Has Photo Session with Delegates to Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The whole country is overflowing with the love and blessing of the benevolent father, who puts forward the schoolchildren as a pleasure and pride of the country and brings them the greatest honour and happiness, on the occasion of the 80th foundation anniversary of the Korean Children's Union (June 6).
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unmet on June 6 the representatives from Korean Children's Union organizations participating in the celebrations of the anniversary.
When he arrived at the venue for the photo session, the schoolchildren felt so happy that they broke into cheers of "Hurrah!"
The fatherly Marshal extended warm congratulations to the KCU members who attended the celebrations on behalf of all the KCU organizations of the country.
The course of the development of the KCU with its glorious history and tradition features a proud journey of having glorified the Workers' Party of Korea's idea of the Juche-oriented children's movement and leadership exploits and firmly prepared the rising generations as pillars of socialist Korea, he said, adding that it is the greatest strength and pride for our Party, state and people to have a revolutionary children's organization steadily inheriting the mind of pure loyalty and patriotism.
From the bright and cheerful looks of the new generation and their beautiful and noble ideological and moral qualities, our Party and people are getting indomitable strength and redoubled courage to overcome any trials and difficulties cheerfully, he said, adding with emotion that the bold spirit and dynamic footsteps of the KCU members growing up to be pillars for building a powerful country while flying high the flag of the KCU represent the strong breath and bright future of the country advancing nonstop.
He said that future Korea belongs to the KCU members and that our Party and people have shouldered the heavy burden of creation and construction for amazing changes and progress despite all sorts of difficulties and determinedly carried into effect in order to hand down the strongest and most beautiful country to the coming generations. And he asked the KCU members to study hard and strive to become fine revolutionary and patriotic talents who will demonstrate the DPRK as the best country with their high ambition and ideal, iron will and wisdom.
Wishing happiness always to the KCU members, the future of socialist Korea, our powerful country, he had a photo session with the representatives.
The future of our country will be boundlessly bright and rosy as the new generations are growing up to be the masters of the future, holding MarshalKim Jong Unin high esteem as their benevolent father. -0-

headline: Vice General Director of General Armaments Bureau of DPRK Ministry of National Defence Clarifies Stand on U.S.-ROK Arms Dealings
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The vice general director of the General Armaments Bureau of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on June 7 as regards the fact that the U.S. has approved the sales of JDAM and associated equipment to the ROK:
Recently, the U.S. announced that it approved the sales of 708 KMU-557 JDAM tail kits and 58 KMU-572 JDAM guidance sets, amounting to 106 million US dollars, at the request of the ROK.
The U.S. approval heralds the change of the military role of the U.S. forces in the ROK and the military tension in the region to be entailed by it as it is pursuant to the "defence strategy" for strengthening the conventional forces of the ROK to assume the primary responsibility for deterring the DPRK.
This is proved by the fact that military hardware being transferred from the U.S. to its allies in Asia on a full scale are assuming a clear offensive nature, covering the all-round domains of ground, sea, underwater and air.
In the past few months alone, the U.S. approved the sale of GBU-39 long-range guided bombs and spare parts for new-type helicopter for naval operation MH-60R and attack helicopter AH-64E Apache to the ROK one after another while showing active cooperation with the ROK attempting to introduce nuclear submarine.
It also approved the sales of combat equipment and spare parts, including HIMARS, Javelin anti-tank missile, howitzer and suicide drone, to Taiwan, while intending to deliver Tomahawk cruise missile and other long-range attack weapons to Japan systematically.
The U.S. irresponsible arms sale and its allies' frantic arms buildup, aimed at realizing the strategic and tactical schemes for sudden and preemptive strike, are the main factor creating instability in the situation of the Korean peninsula and other regions and escalating military tension.
The U.S. reckless arms sale adds to unpredictability on the regional and international scale and inevitably lead to the abuse of strength. This fact is evidently proven by the present geopolitical events.
It is the priority task for the armaments sector of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence to take the symmetric or asymmetric military and technical measures in every way to cope with the arms buildup of the enemy countries going far beyond the defensive limit.
The DPRK will thoroughly contain any attempt for the imbalance of strength in the region through the accelerated and renewed evolution of its self-defensive deterrent and let the hostile forces recognize in a sustained way that their irresponsible arms dealing and arms buildup are inefficient and meaningless. -0-

headline: Increased Production in Machine-building Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The machine-building industry of the DPRK boosts the production while giving precedence to science and technology.
The Ryongsong Machine Complex is pushing ahead with the second-stage reconstruction and modernization project. It has solved technical problems arising in production, concentrating efforts on putting science, technology and production on an integral basis.
The Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 has made technical innovations to improve the performance of rolling mills, large-scale drawing machines and other equipment, while strengthening inter-process relations and cooperation and enhancing the responsibility and role of process inspectors to increase the production.
The Pyongyang and Ryangchaek bearing factories are increasing production while introducing advanced measuring apparatuses and raising the utilization rate of detecting means.
The Anju Insulating Material Factory improved the quality and productivity of products by stepping up the technical upgrading of various production lines. The Taedonggang Electric Appliances Factory has put management of equipment and technical control on a scientific basis and is operating machines at full capacity to boost production. -0-

headline: Respected Fatherly Marshal Kim Jong Un Sends Gifts to Participants in Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 7 (KCNA) -- The love of the great father who spares nothing for the younger generation and takes care of them with ardent affection is being repeatedly shown to the schoolchildren who participated in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unpersonally attended the conference in commemoration of the 80th KCU birthday to wish the KCU members across the country the bright future in his meaningful congratulatory speech and had a photo taken with the participants in the celebrations. And then he took a benevolent measure to send gifts to them.
A meeting was held on June 6 to convey the gifts sent by the fatherly Marshal to the participants in the celebrations of the 80th KCU birthday.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other officials of the WPK Central Committee, officials of the youth league and the participants in the celebrations.
Ju Chang Il made an address for conveying gifts.
The speaker warmly congratulated the KCU members who celebrated with splendor the 80th founding anniversary of the KCU as a significant holiday under the great love of the fatherly Marshal, to be remembered for life, and came to receive the gifts of love.
He said that the gifts of love are associated with the boundlessly warm and profound affection of the Marshal who wishes the KCU members to grow up uprightly and stoutly.
The speaker asked all the KCU members to study hard and take an active part in the organizational life of the KCU and thus prepare themselves to be reliable pillars of prosperous Korea, knowledgeable, virtuous and healthy, and young revolutionaries and patriots supporting the country.
The KCU members, who received the gift lists and gifts associated with the tender affection and love of the benevolent father, extended boundless thanks to the fatherly Marshal for his great loving care.
The participants in the celebrations of the 80th KCU birthday hardened their resolve to grow up to be sons and daughters boundlessly loyal to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unand competent builders of socialist Korea, cherishing today's glory and happiness as the most beautiful memory in the days as KCU members. -0-
