headline: Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant
Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site
Rodong Sinmun Warmly Welcomes Goodwill Mission of Chinese People
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- Rodong Sinmun Monday in an editorial says that the Korean people ardently welcome Comrade Xi Jinping visiting the DPRK again with the feelings of warm friendship of the fraternal Chinese people.
Xi Jinping's visit to the DPRK marks a significant occasion in strikingly demonstrating the invincibility and vitality of the DPRK-China friendship growing stronger day by day under the deep care of the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries and serves as support and encouragement to our Party and people in the struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism, the editorial says, and goes on:
The DPRK-China relations are the invincible friendly relations closely united with comradely friendship and bloody ties in the protracted struggle to oppose foreign aggressors and build socialism.
True to the intention of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, the Korean revolutionaries helped the Chinese revolution with blood in the arduous anti-Japanese struggle. The Chinese people, too, regarded the Korean revolutionaries fighting for the national liberation as their own flesh and blood and rendered material and moral assistance to the Korean people in their struggle.
The brilliant victories won by the Chinese people in the arduous revolutionary civil war and by the Korean people in the fierce Fatherland Liberation War would have been unthinkable without the fraternal friendship and class ties which have been steadily carried forward and consolidated between the revolutionaries, service personnel and peoples of the two countries.
Thanks to the strategic guidance of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping, the communication between the two parties and two countries and friendship and unity between the peoples of the two countries have been further strengthened, and thus the DPRK-China relations are developing into more solid friendly relations.
It is the unshakable will and stand of our Party, government and people to steadily develop the DPRK-China friendly relationship with socialism as its core.
The Korean people sincerely hope that the Chinese people will achieve greater successes in the struggle for comprehensively building a modern and powerful socialist country, rallied close around the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping as its core, and firmly defend the national sovereignty, territorial integrity and interests for development.
We will, in the future, too, join hands with the Chinese comrades on the road of advancing the socialist cause and defending peace and security in the region and the rest of the world. -0-

headline: Coal Production Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- The workers of the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex in the DPRK, out to implement their tasks for the first year of the new Five-year Plan, are increasing the coal production as compared with the same period of last year.
The Jagang Provincial Supply Coal Mine introduced working methods suited to the conditions of coal beds and organized a socialist emulation among units to fulfill its daily plan.
The Kaechon Coal Mine increased its transport capacity 1.3 times and has repaired the mine cars by itself to register high results in production.
The Kaechon Coal-mining Machine Factory and other self-reliance bases have supplied a large number of coal wagons, V-shaped iron props and accessories necessary for coal production. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- Many people visit the Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant situated on the picturesque bank of the River Taedong.
The restaurant has indoor ponds of various kinds of freshwater and saltwater fish, various types of dining rooms and processed marine products counters. It is a public catering service base instantly cooking various kinds of fishes of higher quality to suit the tastes and needs of the people.
At the restaurant, the visitors spend a pleasant time, tasting various dishes cooked with sturgeon, freshwater salmon, Ryongjong fish and others.
The visitors say in unison that the restaurant is like an aquarium and a fish museum, watching the indoor ponds full of various fishes.
On June 8, 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built restaurant and named it the"Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant", expressing great satisfaction.
Making rounds of various places of the restaurant, he said with pleasure that it is another public catering service base representing Pyongyang like the Okryu Restaurant.
Today the Pyongyang Taedonggang Seafood Restaurant is striving to increase the kinds of dishes, preserving the nutritive ingredients of fishes of higher quality. -0-

headline: Boy's Final for Eleventh National Children's Football Tournament Held
Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- The Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site is the sacred place of victory associated with the undying feats of PresidentKim Il Sungwho brought about victory on this land, shattering the myth of the "mightiness" of the U.S. imperialists with his outstanding military idea, rare commanding art, matchless courage and pluck.
From January 1951 to the end of the war, the President set it as the Supreme Headquarters of the Korean People's Army for two years and seven months.
Until the early 1950s, many people did not know about the site, and the site was marked as only a small dot on the map.
The operation room of the Supreme Headquarters was a small and simple half-underground room.
In this small operation room, the President visualized operational plans for winning victory in the war and created many Juche-oriented tactics including the tank-hunting team movement. He guided more than 200 major meetings, wrote the report to the Fifth Plenary Meeting of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and other famous works and aroused all the people to the struggle for winning victory in the war.
On June 8, 2015, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site and said that the President led the war to victory while staying in such dangerous place and there is no example in the world history of wars.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed that the Fatherland Liberation War Historic Site is the sacred place associated with the exploits performed by the President in winning victory in the war and the place in which the first victory was won in the war against the U.S. -0-

headline: Birthday Party of KCU Members
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- A meeting was held on June 7 to congratulate Korean Children's Union members on their birthdays. Those members are participating in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the KCU.
The respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unbestowed great benevolence to make sure that birthday spreads are given to KCU members during the celebrations.
Those schoolchildren, who received the significant birthday spreads, were deeply moved by the loving care of the tender-hearted father who invited children of ordinary working people to the grand celebrations and made sure that birthday spreads were given for them.
Paek Un Chol, chairman of the C.C., Socialist Patriotic Youth League, said in a speech that this significant meeting of today provided under the warm loving care of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwould be cherished as the beautiful memory during the days of the Children's Union.
The schoolchildren spent a pleasant time, singing in praise of the warm love of the respected fatherly Marshal who shows his parental affection for them on behalf of their parents and siblings and teachers. -0-

headline: Farms in DPRK Concentrate Efforts on Wheat and Barley Cultivation
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- Farms across the DPRK concentrate their efforts on manuring and cultivating wheat and barley and making preparations for their harvest.
The Agricultural Commission and agricultural guidance organs at all levels are taking timely measures while concentrating all efforts on the manuring and cultivation of crops in the second half of their growth in order to increase the per-hectare yield and making full preparations for their harvest.
South Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces take the leading in this work.
Farms in North Hwanghae and North Hamgyong provinces and Nampho Municipality have paved threshing grounds and maintained various kinds of farm machines including tractors, directing their efforts to manuring and cultivating wheat and barley. -0-

headline: Power Generation Increases in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 8 (KCNA) -- The Ryesonggang Power Station in the DPRK increases the power generation while ensuring the stability of production.
The power station is updating technical and economic indices of production processes and introducing a scientific method of water control.
After finding a way for boosting the electricity output in raising the efficiency of generating equipment and ensuring the normal management, it has developed and introduced valuable technical innovation proposals by enhancing the role of technicians and skilled workers.
The Ryesonggang youth power stations Nos. 2, 3 and 4 have successfully fulfilled their daily and ten-day plans by managing the generating equipment and structures in a responsible way and ensuring non-accident operation.
The workers of the Ryesonggang Power Station are strengthening the material and technical foundations for the sustained growth of electricity production. -0-

headline: Additional Camping for Children in Flood-hit Areas
story_text:
One day in October 2016, the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unasked an official how many junior middle school students in the flood-hit areas have not yet enjoyed camping at the Songdowon International Children's Camp.
The official replied that more than 1 000 schoolchildren have enjoyed so far for the camp's accommodation and at least 670 not yet.
The respected fatherly Marshal said nothing for a while, thinking about the schoolchildren who may feel envy at those leaving for camping.
Then he told officials that it would be advisable to organize one more term of camping for the year additionally for those schoolchildren.
After all, a step of love was taken for the schoolchildren who failed to enjoy camping at the Songdowon International Children's Camp.
A few days later, Chongjin Youth Railway Station came to be crowded with the schoolchildren and their teachers leaving for camping and the officials and citizens seeing them off, who were all emotion-charged. -0-

headline: DPRK Government Economic Delegation Returns Home
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- A DPRK government economic delegation led by Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations, returned home on Monday after taking part in the international exhibition Belagro-2026 held in Belarus and the Petersburg International Economic Forum-2026 held in Russia.
It was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Ryu Un Hae, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, and Vladimir Topekha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony of Welcoming Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The Korean people are warmly welcoming the goodwill mission of the fraternal Chinese people on a state visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as the greatest state guest.
A ceremony took place atKim Il SungSquare on June 8 to welcome Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China.
Seen at the square with the national flags of the DPRK and China fluttering were the guard of honor and the honorary cavalry of the Korean People's Army and the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence.
Attending the ceremony were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the WPK.
Pyongyang citizens, youth and students and children were standing with national flags of the two countries and flowers.
ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, came to the venue for the ceremony.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car arrived atKim Il SungSquare.
Amid the playing of welcome music, ComradeKim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, warmly greeted Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
ComradeKim Jong Unintroduced to Comrade Xi Jinping senior Party, government and military officials of the DPRK.
ComradeKim Jong Unexchanged greetings with entourage members of the Chinese side including Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Tang Fangyu, director of the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, Dong Jun, minister of National Defence of the PRC, Zeng Shanjie, head of the National Development and Reform Committee of the PRC, and Wang Wentao, minister of Commerce of the PRC.
A ceremony of welcoming Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, began.
A 21-gun salute was fired amid the solemn playing of the national anthems of the PRC and the DPRK.
Comrade Xi Jinping received a salute from the chief of the KPA guard of honor.
Guided by ComradeKim Jong Un, Comrade Xi Jinping reviewed the KPA guard of honor.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.
When the welcoming ceremony was over, loud cheers were raised.
Comrade Xi Jinping expressed heartfelt thanks to the Korean Party, government and people for their hospitality.
The masses broke into enthusiastic cheers, looking up to the top leaders who are further consolidating the ties of DPRK-China friendship, which have steadily maintained their nature century after century and generation after generation, and energetically guiding them to the strategic expansion and development in conformity with the requirements of the new era and the aspirations and wishes of the peoples of the two countries.
The top leaders of the DPRK and China warmly waved back to the cheering masses.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car headed toward the Kumsusan State Guesthouse, lodging quarters, getting an ovation along the route.
ComradeKim Jong Unaccompanied Comrade Xi Jinping to his lodgings.
The Pyongyang meeting overflowing with close friendship and warm feelings between the top leaders of the two countries was clearly recorded in history as an event of showing once again the DPRK-China relationship that has invariably carried forward the good tradition generation after generation and is making a new history of friendship and solidarity for the more beautiful future. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Hosts Banquet in Welcome of Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, on Visit to DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, hosted a banquet at the Mokran House on the evening of June 8 in welcome of Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China.
Invited to the banquet were entourage members of the Chinese side including Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Tang Fangyu, director of the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, Dong Jun, minister of National Defence of the PRC, Zeng Shanjie, head of the National Development and Reform Committee of the PRC, and Wang Wentao, minister of Commerce of the PRC, and staff members of the Chinese embassy here.
Present there were Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and other senior Party and government and military officials.
ComradeKim Jong Untogether with his wife Ri Sol Ju gladly met with Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at the Mokran House and had a photo session against the background of the national flags of the two countries.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the banquet hall together with Comrade Xi Jinping, all the participants welcomed the top leaders of the two parties and two countries with enthusiastic applause.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech in welcome of Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C., CPC and president of the PRC.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that he warmly welcomed Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping, who paid a state visit to the DPRK with the warm feelings of fraternity and friendship with the DPRK people once again, on behalf of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK and on his own behalf, adding that the great enthusiasm for welcome witnessed on the streets of Pyongyang and along the route clearly shows the comradely friendship and fraternal feelings of the WPK and DPRK people toward Comrade Xi Jinping and the Chinese party and people and power of the invincible DPRK-China friendly relations.
ComradeKim Jong Unnoted that the will of the peoples of the two countries to jointly build a beautiful future on the road of struggle for socialism was reaffirmed through the Pyongyang meeting and talks.
Saying that the two parties and two countries could consolidate the bonds of unity and cooperation, sharing their destiny for a long time as they are not merely neighbors naturally and topographically but they are united on the basis of the commonness of ideology and militant friendship, he expressed the will to develop the DPRK-China friendship with good history and tradition as the foundation into a model of the most powerful and strategic relations between socialist countries by leading it to a new height.
Sincerely hoping that under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping as its core, the Chinese people will make greater changes in the sacred cause for comprehensively building a modern and powerful socialist country, attaining the second century goal and realizing the great prosperity of the Chinese nation, he expressed belief that the DPRK-China friendship growing stronger day by day with the common will and efforts on the basis of long fraternal friendship and trust would greet a brighter future.
Then Comrade Xi Jinping made a reply speech.
He expressed his sincere thanks to ComradeKim Jong Unand the Korean party and government and people for sincere, splendid and warm hospitality to the Chinese delegation, saying that he was pleased to visit the DPRK again in the beautiful season full of vigor and vitality and share friendship with Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unto the full and discuss the future together with him.
He said that China and the DPRK have always shared their destiny and the traditional China-DPRK friendship is the invincible one with a long history, referring to the great friendship between the peoples of the two countries who shared life and death, sweets and bitters in the annals of the revolution.
Saying that the China-DPRK relations are at a new historic starting point this year marking the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the China-DPRK Treaty on Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance and he had an important common understanding with ComradeKim Jong Unduring his current visit, he expressed the will to develop the China-DPRK relations on a high level, open up a more beautiful prospect for the socialist cause of the two countries and promote the steady progress of human society in cooperation with each other.
He said that the Ninth Congress of the WPK convened this year drew up a strategic plan for long-term development of the Party and state affairs and made a crucial assignment, thus opening up a new era of overall development of socialism in the DPRK, sincerely hoping that under the firm leadership of the WPK headed by Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, the DPRK people will steadily open up a new phase of the socialist cause of the DPRK by smoothly achieving the goals and tasks set forth at the Party Congress.
The participants in the banquet toasted to the steady development of the DPRK-China friendship.
The banquet proceeded in a warm atmosphere full of friendship and fraternity. -0-

headline: Rice-transplanting Completed in S. Hamgyong Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK finished rice-transplanting in the main area.
Farms have set the order of rice transplantation, ensured the number of rice seedlings in a proper way and directed their efforts to finishing all farming processes earlier than the same period of last year, thus transplanting rice seedlings in more areas than planned every day.
They ensured proper process-by-process engagement while increasing the proportion of mechanization in farming and mobilizing all forces and means.
They organized a socialist emulation among workteams and sub-workteams on the basis of correctly grasping the characteristic of rice seedlings and fertility of soil.
Working people in the province are now manuring and cultivating rice seedlings after finishing rice-transplanting in the main area. -0-

headline: Participants in Celebrations of Founding Anniversary of KCU Visit Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The participants in the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union visited the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations on June 8 to pay high tribute to the heroes who defended the dignity and honor of the DPRK at the cost of their lives.
They laid flowers before the Memorial Wall at the sacred place associated with the patriotic spirit of the brave soldiers who fought for the bright future of the glorious country.
They were deeply impressed with data on the feats performed by the brave soldiers who wrote heroic biographies on battlefields with a resolve to add glory to the motherland.
They hardened their will to carry forward the great spirit displayed by the war martyrs generation after generation and prepare themselves to be dependable reserves for socialist construction who firmly support their country. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Arrives in Pyongyang to Pay State Visit to DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The historic Pyongyang meeting between the top leaders of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the People's Republic of China was arranged again at a time when the traditional DPRK-China friendship, forged in the long journey for independence against imperialism, peace and the accomplishment of the socialist cause, weathering all hard-ships of the times, is being developed at a new strategic level.
Comrade Xi Jinping's visit to the DPRK in the significant year marking the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance serves as the important and meaningful one in developing the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations, the strategic option and valuable common asset of the two parties and the peoples of the two countries.
The national flags of the two countries were fluttering at the flagstaffs.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unand his wife Ri Sol Ju came to Pyongyang International Airport to greet Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Present at the airport were Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private plane landed at the airport at noon on Monday.
ComradeKim Jong Unhad an impressive meeting with Comrade Xi Jinping.
ComradeKim Jong Unshook hands with Comrade Xi Jinping, expressing his pleasure over their reunion in Pyongyang nine months after the significant meeting in Beijing last September.
Comrade Xi Jinping expressed his deep thanks to ComradeKim Jong Unfor warmly welcoming him, while giving his impressions of revisit to Pyongyang in seven years.
Accompanying him were Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, Tang Fangyu, director of the Policy Research Office of the CPC Central Committee, Dong Jun, minister of National Defence of the PRC, Zeng Shanjie, head of the National Development and Reform Committee of the PRC, Wang Wentao, minister of Commerce of the PRC, and other entourage members.
Lovely children presented bunches of flowers to Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car left the airport, escorted by motorcycles.
In Sunan District and along streets including Rimhung and Saeppyol streets, Pyongyang citizens warmly welcomed Comrade Xi Jinping who has come with warm feelings of friendship of the fraternal Chinese people towards the DPRK people.
Citizens gave a welcome with the warm feelings of friendship and solidarity deeply rooted in the hearts of the peoples of the two countries and firmly based on the comradely relationship. -0-

headline: Development of New Products and Improvement of Their Quality in Light Industry Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The light industry sector of the DPRK is developing new products and improving their quality.
The Hamhung Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory has recently produced various kinds of toys and raincoats necessary for fishing. It proved the scientific accuracy of a new manufacturing technique and introduced it into production, thus opening up a prospect for manufacturing impeccable products with low cost.
The Hamhung Knitwear Factory has made sure that all its employees draw more than one new design every month and regularly learned about the people's demand for knitwear products and produced goods according to it. As a result, it has produced various forms of men's and women's pajamas and T-shirts.
Technicians and workers of the Sinuiju Disabled Soldiers' Knitwear Factory invented and manufactured efficient equipment capable of guaranteeing the quality and productivity of school uniform sweaters and the Sinuiju Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory is directing its efforts to improving the skills of its employees. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The sexual slavery against Korean women committed by the Japanese imperialists in the past was the crime organized and put into practice by the then Japanese government and military.
The Japanese imperialists, who set up comfort stations in an organized way and buckled down to fostering gang rape, mobilized all government and military power to forcibly abduct the Korean women massively.
Seiji Yoshita, who was involved in it, in an interview with the Hokkaido Shimbun in February 1992, confessed that what is clear is that they did not recruit the comfort women but arrest them and that no one willingly complied with it.
As confessed by the Japanese, it is quite clear that it was impossible to take away 200 000 Korean women one by one, but only by the exercise of unlimited government and military power.
The Japanese imperialists, who mobilized not only administrative and police organs but also gendarmerie and army, forcibly abducted and drafted many Korean women including unmarried women under or over the age of 20 and women with infants. Even teenage girls were included.
The Japanese imperialists took the women to the places where they invaded, and committed to brutal atrocities that made even the brutes blush.
They killed in a cruel way the women who resisted the unbearable insults, maltreatment and evil deeds, and did not obey their demands.
In this regard, a Japanese woman Sumiko Shimizu said at the 3rd Pyongyang Seminar on "Peace in Asia and Role of Women" that the Japanese imperialists committed the most vicious act against the Korean people, violating the sexuality and human rights of Koreans and destroying their lives. She denounced that it was an international crime committed organizationally and violently by the Japanese army and government.
The world had never witnessed such heinous and tremendous unethical atrocities as the sexual slavery committed by the Japanese imperialists which is unimaginable with the reason of human being. -0-

headline: Kimchi, One of World's Five Health Foods
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- Nowadays, an increasing number of people have come to public service amenities in different parts of the DPRK to buy refreshing kimchi as the hot weather persists.
Kimchi, a traditional food of the Korean people, is famous as one of the five health foods in the world. It is a low-fat health food high in vitamins A and C, lactic acid bacteria helpful to digestion and polysaccharide and lignin.
There are many kinds of kimchi including tasty and spicy whole cabbage kimchi, sweet-favoured chonggak kimchi and radish kimchi spiced with parsley, shizandra or other herbs.
The Hwasong Kimchi Factory in Hwasong Street of Pyongyang has industrialized the production of various kinds of kimchi including whole cabbage kimchi.
According to Yun Hyon Chol, manager of the factory, it is the secret of making delicious kimchi to thoroughly observe the technical indices for giving the strongest distinctive flavor to kimchi, add various lactic acid bacterium and apply effective processing methods in the production process.
On June 9, 2016, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built Hwasong Kimchi Factory. He said that kimchi is widely known as one of the world's five health foods, adding that the factory should make kimchi produced by industrial methods more delicious than homemade ones and thus make it the one always favored by our people, the best food in the world.
In 2015 the UNESCO registered the DPRK's custom of making kimchi as part of the world intangible cultural heritage. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Artistic Performance Given in Welcome of Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- An artistic performance was given with splendor at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on the night of June 8 to welcome Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, who is on a state visit to the DPRK, opening up a good prospect in the course of the DPRK-China friendship in the new era.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the performance together with Comrade Xi Jinping.
ComradeKim Jong Unand his wife Ri Sol Ju greeted Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at the plaza of the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of WPK and President of State Affairs of DPRK, Has Talks with Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 9 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on June 8.
ComradeKim Jong Uncame to the Kumsusan State Guesthouse to exchange warm greetings with Comrade Xi Jinping and had a photo taken against the background of the national flags of the two countries.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee and director of the International Department of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, and Kim Tok Hun, first vice-premier of the DPRK Cabinet.
Present from the Chinese side were Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC and minister of Foreign Affairs, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC, Tang Fangyu, director of the Policy Research Office of the C.C., CPC, Dong Jun, minister of National Defence of the PRC, Zeng Shanjie, head of the National Development and Reform Committee of the PRC, Wang Wentao, minister of Commerce of the PRC, and other entourage members and Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly welcomed Comrade Xi Jinping, who has visited Pyongyang in seven years, as the greatest state guest, saying that your visit to Pyongyang as the first foreign trip for this year is an expression of your top priority to the DPRK-China friendship as well as the most encouraging support to the Korean people. Pyongyang deems it as its honor, he said, adding your current visit will mark an important occasion of showing once again that the DPRK and China have always stood together on the right side of history for independence and justice and their relations are definitely solid as they have stood the test of history under any international upheavals.
Mentioning the constancy and invincibility of the DPRK-China relationship which is special in terms of the tradition of friendship, the common cause of socialism and the invariable inheritance, he gave a high appreciation of the fact that exchange and cooperation between the two countries have vigorously developed in various aspects after the Beijing meeting in September of 2025.
He affirmed that the WPK and the DPRK government will as ever maintain the DPRK-China friendship as the most important top-priority strategic work and do their utmost to strengthen the bilateral relations into a model of the relationship between socialist states and into an invariably special, genuine and solid strategic relationship and that this is our immutable choice and will.
Our party, government and people are rejoiced over the fact that the Chinese party, government and people have achieved great world-startling successes in building a modern socialist country and raised their international position to the absolute height under the wised guidance of Comrade Xi Jinping, he said, stating that, no matter however the situation may change, our party and government will fully support the policy and stand of the Chinese party and government to defend the core interests on the "one-China" principle.
Expressing his impressions of his revisit to beautiful Pyongyang, Comrade Xi Jinping said he was pleased that in recent years ComradeKim Jong Unhas made important achievements, guiding the Korean-style socialism.
He said that the Chinese party and government will remain unchanged in their firm stand to place very importance on the traditional China-DPRK friendship, their firm support to the socialist cause of the DPRK led by Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unand their firm determination to defend the common interests of the both sides and good strategic environment no matter how the international situation may change.
He expressed his willingness to promote greater advance of the China-DPRK relations along with the times by providing a blueprint for the development of the China-DPRK relations together with ComradeKim Jong Un, with his visit as an opportunity, and steadily boosting exchange and cooperation and thus to make a positive contribution to accomplishing the socialist cause of the two countries and promoting the wellbeing of the two peoples and promoting peace, stability and prosperity in the region and rest of the world.
The top leaders of the DPRK and China sincerely exchanged the experience gained in party- and state-building in the course of advancing the socialist cause and discussed important issues for putting the traditional DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations on a more solid basis.
They also agreed to hold celebrations, further strengthen the strategic communication through high-level visits between the two parties and two countries and expand and develop exchanges and cooperation in political, economic, cultural and other fields on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, in order to open a new chapter of the development of the DPRK-China relations.
The talks exchanged views on international and regional issues, discussed the issues for boosting the strategic coordination and cooperation between the two parties and two countries, firmly defending the sovereignty, security, development and interests of the two countries and jointly defending peace and development in the region and rest of the world in the complicated world political situation and reached a satisfactory consensus of views on them.
The talks took place in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
The Pyongyang talks between ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, marked a historic occasion of clearly demonstrating the invincibility of the DPRK-China friendship which has steadily developed in the common struggle for accomplishing the socialist cause and making a new milestone for the development of the strategic cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries. -0-

headline: Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Leaves Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, left here by his private plane in the afternoon of June 9 after paying a state visit to the DPRK at the invitation of ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
ComradeKim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, saw off Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at Pyongyang International Airport.

Comrade Xi Jinping's recent visit, to be specially recorded in the history of the development of the DPRK-China relations in the new era, constitutes a clear demonstration of the invincibility and immutability of the DPRK-China friendship and the most powerful political encouragement to our Party and state.
Streets of the capital city were overflowing with the warm atmosphere of seeing off Comrade Xi Jinping who was about to depart, leaving his sincerest feelings behind after visiting Pyongyang as his first foreign trip this year to greatly encourage the DPRK people in their drive to accomplish the socialist cause.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private car left the Kumsusan State Guesthouse, the lodging place, and headed for Pyongyang International Airport, being warmly greeted by citizens along streets of the capital city.
People from all walks of life warmly saw off the close friends of the neighboring country, waving national flags of the two countries and bouquets and chanting the slogan for the DPRK-China friendship.
ComradeKim Jong Un, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju, came to Pyongyang International Airport to say goodbye to Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.

Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy officials were present.
Comrade Xi Jingping's private car arrived at Pyongyang International Airport crowed with many citizens and children who came there to see off him.
ComradeKim Jong Unand his wife Ri Sol Ju greeted Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Guided by ComradeKim Jong Un, Comrade Xi Jinping reviewed the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army.
Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan warmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering people.
ComradeKim Jong Unclasped the hands of the Chinese entourage members for goodbye.
Comrade Xi Jinping exchanged farewells with leading officials of the DPRK.
ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping firmly shook hands with each other and exchanged farewells full of warm trust and friendship, expressing their unshakable will to lead the sacred cause for the co-prosperity and development and revolutionary unity of the peoples of the two countries and the victory of socialism on to a higher stage in conformity with the requirement of the new era.
Comrade Xi Jinping expressed his sincere gratitude to ComradeKim Jong Unand the Korean Party, government and people for their sincere and cordial hospitality during his significant visit to Pyongyang.
Comrade Xi Jinping's private plane departed from Pyongyang amid a good send-off by the people.
The common cause of the two parties and peoples of the two countries to invariably support, actively encourage and share the destiny in the sacred journey for socialism, independence and justice is invincible thanks to the great ideas, firm faith and wise leadership of the top leaders of the DPRK and China, and the DPRK-China friendship will be immortal, recording a new great history. -0-

headline: Science and Technology Prioritized in Nampho of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK strives to develop its economy and improve its citizens' standard of living in reliance on science and technology.
Researchers of the municipal industrial technology institute are devoting their creative wisdom and passion to the research for using slag from iron works as raw materials for non-roasting cement.
Nampho University of Education confirmed a scientific and technological guarantee for using fluvial plants as feed for goats and is introducing it into all goat farms in the municipality.
The Taean District Science and Technology Committee is conducting technical innovation activities to produce powdered soap with locally available raw materials.
The Onchon County Science and Technology Committee developed industrial essential oil needed for soap production and has directed efforts to the research for establishing a sugar production process based on sweet potato.
Various units in the municipality have striven to establish a plywood production process and use waste coal as fuel for inhabitants. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Central Cadres Training School of WPK and Plants Tree with Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on a state visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea on Tuesday.
ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, accompanied him to the school.
Among the Chinese visitors were Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the C.C., CPC, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the C.C., CPC and minister of Foreign Affairs, and other entourage members and Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK.
Present there were secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, including Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the C.C., WPK.
Being honored to have the great leaders of the two parties on its campus soon after it marked its 80th founding anniversary, the school, the supreme political one of the DPRK, was filled with a warm atmosphere for welcoming them at a historic time when communication, concerted action and close cooperation between the two ruling parties of the two countries constantly advancing under the banner of socialism have been placed on a new strategic level.
ComradeKim Jong Ungreeted Comrade Xi Jinping at the school.
A teacher presented a bouquet to Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, in welcome of his visit to the school.
Comrade Xi Jinping went round the school, guided by ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unbriefed Comrade Xi Jinping on the history of the school which has contributed to the cause of building the working-class party by performing its sacred mission and role to guarantee the lifeline and future of the Party for a long period of the Korean revolution.
ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping inspected a lecture on the Party policy at the hall no. 3.
Comrade Xi Jinping appreciated that the school was wonderfully built as befits the pedigree establishment for training the backbone, guarantors of the permanent future of the socialist ruling party, and it has concentrated its efforts on arming itself with theories and spirit and improving its qualifications for training Party cadres while deeply imbuing the students with the innovative ideas and theories of the WPK.
The students expressed gratitude to the top leaders of the two parties with loud applause for their visit to the school on the occasion of great importance in the history of the development of the DPRK-China relations in the new era, which would remain in the memory forever.
The top leaders of the two parties took an electric car to go round the campus of the school while exchanging open-hearted views on the system of training future party cadres and educational system and contents peculiar to the party school.
They expressed their willingness to exert common efforts to make the party cadres training schools play a proper role in strengthening the parties together while exchanging in depth the excellent party-building experience and earnestly learning from each other by further boosting exchange and cooperation between the two parties of the DPRK and China.
ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping planted a tree together in commemoration of their visit to the school.
A fir tree took root in the sacred land, conveying the noble intention of the top leaders of the two parties to open up a new chapter of firm comradely friendship, revolutionary unity and sincere support and cooperation between the two parties and peoples of the two countries and cultivate a more beautiful and rosier future.
A monument to the meaningful tree-planting was unveiled.
When Kim Jae Ryong, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, and Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, unveiled the monument together, leading officials and entourages of both sides and teaching staff and students of the school warmly clapped, looking up to the top leaders who are glorifying the new era of the development of the friendly relations between the two parties and two countries.
Inscribed in the monument were the letters in Korean and Chinese reading "DPRK-China friendship will be evergreen. Tree planted by ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping on June 9, 2026".
ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping had a photo taken against the background of the tree and monument. -0-

headline: Message of Thanks to Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un from Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of thanks from Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on June 9.
The message reads as follows:
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un,
I, on behalf of the Chinese party, government and people and in the name of myself and my wife Prof. Peng Liyuan, express the warmest greetings and the most heartfelt thanks to you, Comrade General Secretary, and your wife Ri Sol Ju and to the Korean party, government and people as regards the successful state visit to the DPRK.
You, Comrade General Secretary, made sincere and detailed arrangements for the visit and the Korean party, government and people splendidly and enthusiastically welcomed the Chinese delegation.
This fully showed the deep friendship between the two parties and two countries of China and the DPRK.
I and you, Comrade General Secretary, made an in-depth exchange of views on the issues of mutual interest and achieved a series of important common understanding. It added the new contents of the times to the China-DPRK relations and showed the firm determination of both sides to add luster to the traditional friendship, promote development and prosperity together and defend peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world.
I am satisfied with the result of my visit.
The China-DPRK relations have already entered a new historic journey.
Looking ahead into the future, I am ready to, together with you, Comrade General Secretary, steadily and successfully defend, successfully consolidate and successfully develop the China-DPRK relations by taking hold of the trend of the times and on the basis of the fundamental and long-term interests of the two countries, and thus make a new and greater contribution to the progressive work for promoting powerful advance of the socialist cause of the two countries, providing the peoples of the two countries with better welfare and achieving the global peace and development.
I am looking forward to meet you, Comrade General Secretary, again.
I sincerely hope that you, Comrade General Secretary, would enjoy good health and your work go well.
I hope that the China-DPRK friendship would be handed down generation after generation and evergreen forever. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
32nd Congress of Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- The 32nd Congress of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan was held at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on June 6.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon), Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee and chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan (UDKW), and vice-chairwomen and members of the Central Standing Committee of the UDKW and advisors to the C.C., UDKW, major headquarters chairwomen of the union and deputies elected by organizations at all levels.
The national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played at the congress.
Nam Ju Hyon, vice-chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the union, read out a message of greeting from the Standing Committee of the DPRK Supreme People's Assembly to the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
A congratulatory message from the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea was introduced.
Kang Chu Ryon made a report to be followed by speeches.
At the congress Kang Chu Ryon, vice-chairwoman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee, was reelected chairwoman of the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan.
Pak Ku Ho made a speech.
He called for giving full play to the loyalty, patriotism, unity and strong practical ability of the union officials, part-time officials and active compatriots in a new struggle period till the 80th formation anniversary of Chongryon and turning out as one in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the congress.
Kang Chu Ryon made a closing address.
A letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas adopted at the congress.
At the end of the congress, the First Session of the 32nd Central Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan was held. -0-

headline: Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC, Lays Flower Basket at Friendship Tower
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 10 (KCNA) -- Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on a state visit to the DPRK, laid a flower basket at the Friendship Tower on June 9.
ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, together with his wife Ri Sol Ju came to the Friendship Tower to greet Comrade Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan.
Accompanying Comrade Xi Jinping were Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission of the CPC Central Committee and minister of Foreign Affairs, and other entourage members and Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK.
Present there were Kim Jae Ryong and Ri Il Hwan, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, and other leading officials of the Party and the government.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up in front of the Friendship Tower filled with the respect for the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers, excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese nation and true comrades-in-arms of the Korean people.
The national anthems of the PRC and the DPRK were played.
A flower basket in the name of Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the C.C., CPC and president of the PRC, was laid there.
Written on the ribbon of the flower basket were letters reading "The martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers will be immortal".
The top leaders of the two countries, together with the participants, paid a silent tribute to the memory of the CPV martyrs who displayed the matchless bravery and self-sacrificing spirit in the Korean people's sacred war to repel the imperialists' armed invasion.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.
Comrade Xi Jinping looked round inside of the tower, an immortal symbol of the DPRK-China friendship.
ComradeKim Jong Unbriefed Comrade Xi Jinping on the historic data, photos and oil paintings showing the brave CPV fighters who courageously made an entry into the Korean front in the genuine internationalism and fraternity, fought bloody battles shoulder to shoulder with the Korean people and rendered sincere aids to the post-war rehabilitation and construction.
Turning over the leaves of the list of fallen CPV fighters, Comrade Xi Jinping recollected them, who clearly demonstrated the militant friendship and the spirit of comradely cooperation of the peoples in the two countries, linked with the same destiny, and are still alive in their mind as the noble icon of friendship.
Saying that the days when the peoples of the two countries were in the same trench for battles, sharing life and death, sweets and bitters, are recorded as an eternal event in history, a record that can never be discolored and erased even after many years, the top leaders of the two countries expressed the same opinion on the need to jointly preserve and manage the memorial facilities dedicated to the fallen CPV martyrs well, deepen education in the revolutionary tradition and ideology and morality among the young people and carry forward the traditional DPRK-China friendship generation after generation. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Return Home
Swinging - Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 11 (KCNA) -- Swinging is one of the favourite folk games of Korean people.
In Korea, there was a custom in which village women gathered in the swinging site and played swinging until sunset on holidays.
Swinging was not only played by girls and young ladies, but also by middle-aged women.
Swinging was very popular in the period of the feudal Joson dynasty and developed into a large-scale game.
It was conducted in different forms including single and double swinging.
Swinging was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in November 2015. -0-

headline: Millions of Fries Released into Sea
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 11 (KCNA) -- The North Hamgyong Provincial Fishery Management Bureau of the DPRK has released millions of fries into the sea this year.
The management bureau selected fishes of good species and is putting the fry production process on a modern and scientific basis.
Employees of the Jikha Atlantic Salmon Pedigree Farm have released many Pacific salmon fries by introducing advanced fish farming technology.
The Sapho Office for Stocking Sea with Fishes raised the survival rate and weight ratio of Pacific salmon fries while adjusting the proportion of feed mixing according to the size and growth stage of fishes and introducing advanced fish farming methods.
Ryonjin and Chongjin fishery stations released into the sea fry of flatfishes more than planned by putting the breeding of fries on a scientific and technological basis suited to their nutrition and size. -0-

headline: Education in Morality Intensified at Schools in DPRK
story_text:

Kumsong Secondary School No. 1 has made sure that its students follow the noble mental world of the preceding generations and the beautiful deeds displayed by the model KCU members through reading of Sonyon Sinmun and explanation of books on the theme of moral education on several occasions.
Changgwang Senior Middle School in Central District and Sariwon Foreign Languages School are striving to ensure that schoolchildren are neatly dressed and observe social order and public morale voluntarily.

headline: Delegation of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan Visits Mangyongdae
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 12 (KCNA) -- A delegation of Korean schoolchildren in Japan led by Pak Ji Jun, principal of Korean Primary Middle and High School in Hiroshima, visited Mangyongdae, the sacred place of the revolution.
Being briefed on the mementoes preserved with much care at the historic old home in Mangyongdae, the visitors deeply grasped the personality of the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungas the heaven-sent great man, who embarked on the road of revolution in his early years and devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and the happiness of the people.

headline: Wreaths Laid at Liberation Tower and Cemetery of Fallen Fighters of Soviet Army
Construction of Pharmacies
story_text:
One day in September 2020, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited Kangbuk-ri in Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK.
Looking at the seat village of Kangbuk-ri, newly built to recover from the flood damage, he said with great satisfaction that the village looked like a picture and a work of art and dwelling houses and public buildings were built well in terms of architectural aesthetics.
Then, pointing at the hospital next to a cultural house, he asked whether it was a hospital or a clinic.
An official told him that it is a hospital built in Kangbuk-ri, explaining there are a hospital in a large ri and a clinic in a small ri.
ComradeKim Jong Unasked again if there was a pharmacy in Kangbuk-ri.
Getting an answer from the official, he stressed the need to wonderfully build a pharmacy.
Officials more keenly felt the loving care of the respected Comrade General Secretary who always gives priority to the interests of the people and devotes his all to their happiness and health. -0-

headline: Plenary Meeting of DPRK SPA Standing Committee Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 12 (KCNA) -- The First Plenary Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was held at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on June 11.
Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and chairman of the SPA Standing Committee, presided over the plenary meeting.
Present there were Vice-Chairman Kim Hyong Sik, Secretary General Ko Kil Son and other members of the SPA Standing Committee.
Present as observers were officials concerned of the SPA Standing Committee, the Secretariat of the Cabinet, and ministries and national agencies.
The plenary meeting discussed as agenda items the issue of deliberating and adopting the Law of the DPRK on Academic Degrees and Titles and the issue of electing judges and people's assessors of the Supreme Court.
There was a report on the main contents of the draft law examined at the Legislation Committee of the SPA.
On the basis of study and discussion of the draft law, the plenary meeting adopted with full approval the decree of the SPA Standing Committee "On Adopting the Law of the DPRK on Academic Degrees and Titles".
The plenary meeting elected judges and people's assessors of the Supreme Court of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Tenth Department of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Tenth Department of the DPRK Foreign Ministry on June 13 issued the following press statement titled "As expected, the ROK is an invariable enemy state obsessed with hostility and confrontation":
The chief executive of the ROK threw off the bothersome mask of "peace".
The president of the ROK, on a visit to Europe, had talks with top leaders of the European Union and made public a joint statement employing provocative words that the DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state and its exercise of sovereign rights including the DPRK-Russia military cooperation are "illegal" and that they would never "recognize", but "strongly denounce" them.
This is a clear infringement on the sovereignty of our state and a grave hostile act, and it is little short of throwing away such camouflaged signboards as "respect for social system" and "no-seeking after hostility" which the ROK has talked so much.
It has already been highlighted at home and abroad that the ROK regards hostility and confrontation as its foundation and it can not exist even a moment without them.
The ROK is the first enemy state, which can never exist without pursuing hostility toward the DPRK, and the U.S. "dagger" for invading the DPRK and the rest of the Asian Continent. This is just the entity and destiny of the ROK.
As its inevitable consequence, the U.S. favorite "dagger" finally stuck out from the silk kerchief called "peace".
Through the above-said confrontational declaration, the chief executive of the ROK voluntarily proved before the world that there can never be "peaceful coexistence" between the DPRK and the ROK and the hostile relations will be maintained between them forever and that the ROK is an accomplice with same ulterior motives as the Ukrainian puppet forces.
That the chief executive of the ROK displayed his unusual "frankness" shows that he lost his face to resort the deceptive farce about "peace declaration" and "theory on two peaceful states" any more.
Whatever the Seoul rulers say and do, the DPRK will deem it a challenge and remain unchanged in its principle of confronting the enemy aimed to definitely treat the ROK as a hostile state. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Distortion of History
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Japan has recently got more vicious in its moves to distort history, irritating its neighboring countries.
According to report, Japan is going to update the exhibition boards at the Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum within 2026. What merits attention is that it is trying to delete the word "massacre" in the board dealing with the Nanjing Massacre and write the words "Nanjing Incident" in it.
The Nanjing Massacre is a horrible crime the Imperial Japanese Army committed by massacring more than 300 000 people in the region between December and January 1938 during their aggression on China. It has been deeply recognized by the world people as the greatest tragedy in the 20th century.
This atrocity in Nanjing was defined as "massacre" even in the decision of the Far Eastern Military Tribunal, held to judge Japan's aggression war crimes, and the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) registered it as the Memory of the World Regional Register.
However, Japan is making desperate efforts to describe as a trifling "incident" such hideous past crime that can never be concealed or distorted. The fact shows to what extent the neo-militarists' moves to distort history have reached.
As well known, the Japanese imperialists killed more than one million people in Korea alone and forcibly drafted more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged people for battle sites of aggression and slave labor sites.
In particular, they abducted and drafted 200 000 Korean women for the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. Such atrocity is the hideous state-sponsored crime unprecedented in the history of wars.
But, the Japanese politicians imposingly organized what is called "Society for New History Textbook Reform" long ago to cover up the reality and distort history.
Moreover, they adopted a decision of the Cabinet meeting that considers "improper" such expressions referring to Japan's past crimes as "forcible conscription" and "comfort women for the Imperial Japanese Army", claiming that teaching the history of aggression as it is means "self-tormenting outlook on history".
Under this decision, the Japanese textbooks do not mention about the massacres committed by the Imperial Japanese Army during their occupation of Korea and neighboring countries and the death toll, and the victims of the sexual slavery are insulted in those textbooks as "prostitutes" and "volunteers for money".
The expression "aggression" had gradually disappeared in textbooks as Japan's aggression upon Asian countries in the past began to be described with such sophistic expression as "liberation of Asia", and at present the phrase "aggression" was totally erased.
The past crimes of Japan, which left incurable wounds to the Korean people and neighboring countries in Asia, are now being distorted in all aspects.
Then, is it right to think what the Japanese government intends while so desperately trying to distort the truth of history, which can never be concealed, is to merely deny its past crimes and evade making apology and settlement?
No.
In fact, the "Self-Defense Forces" of Japan have completed all preparations for overseas aggression and is now emerging the most dangerous aggression forces in the region, advocating "threat from outside".
Owing to Japan, an emergency is being created in the Asia-Pacific region, a situation where there will be nothing unusual even if a war breaks out at once.
What is most important for Japan at this time is to prepare the younger generation to be those in direct charge of war and those who are engaged in it.
Herein lies the reason why Japan persistently clings to infiltrating wrong view on history through exhibition and curriculum.
Japan should be mindful that the more desperate efforts it makes to distort history, the earlier such action will bring its self-destruction. -0-

headline: Chief of External Policy Office of DPRK Foreign Ministry Comments on U.S. Sale of Military Hardware
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The chief of the External Policy Office of the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Saturday gave the following answer to a written request of KCNA to comment about the U.S. approval to the sale of latest air-to-air missiles and associated equipment to the ROK:
Despite reasonable concern of the international community, the U.S. and the ROK are systematically tightening their military collusion and nexus to drive tensions in the Korean peninsula and its vicinity to an extreme.
It is a typical example that the U.S. Department of State approved the sale of latest air-to-air missiles and associated equipment worth nearly 300 million U.S. dollars to the ROK in the way of "Foreign Military Sales".
Earlier, the U.S. administration approved the sale of new-type helicopters for naval operation, attack helicopters, precision guided bombs and other military hardware worth billions of U.S. dollars in less than a month, more openly revealing its intention to increase the ROK's military potentials and thus drive it to the advanced post for intensified confrontation with regional countries.
This is only a part of the U.S. strategic attempt to deliver various kinds of weapons and military hardware worth 25 billion U.S. dollars to the ROK till 2030 and thus incite it to military confrontation with the DPRK and other regional countries.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry strongly denounces the U.S. and the ROK for rapidly accelerating arms buildup in a very worrisome direction to destroy the military balance in the Korean peninsula and threaten the regional security environment, warning of the grave consequences to be entailed by it.
The U.S. arms export just means war export and the introduction of U.S.-made weapons is little short of the accumulation of tension and confrontation.
In fiscal year 2025 alone, the export scale of weapons, the U.S. administration licensed through the "FMS" and direct commercial sale mode, amounted to more than 330 billion U.S. dollars and the number of arms transactions approved through the "FMS" reached more than 16 000.
The massive arms supply by the U.S. to the ROK, Japan and Taiwan is the root cause of aggravating military tension in the Asia-Pacific region including the Korean peninsula and the Taiwan Strait, and its scope is expanding worldwide, forecasting the unstable prospect of global peace.
The gradually escalating U.S.-ROK military conspiracy and the U.S.-led arms buildup of collective character invite due vigilance and awakening among regional countries and serve as a sufficient reason for reinforcing corresponding defensive measures.
Clear is the stand of the DPRK to remove new threats and maintain the balance of strength in the region by steadily updating and bolstering its deterrent for self-defence to cope with the provocative arms buildup of the U.S. and its allies, and the DPRK will redouble its responsible efforts to defend peace and security on the Korean peninsula and in the region in the future, too. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for Tenth Department of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:

This is a clear infringement on the sovereignty of our state and a grave hostile act, and it is little short of throwing away such camouflaged signboards as "respect for social system" and "no-seeking after hostility" which the ROK has talked so much.
It has already been highlighted at home and abroad that the ROK regards hostility and confrontation as its foundation and it can not exist even a moment without them.
The ROK is the first enemy state, which can never exist without pursuing hostility toward the DPRK, and the U.S. "dagger" for invading the DPRK and the rest of the Asian Continent. This is just the entity and destiny of the ROK.
As its inevitable consequence, the U.S. favorite "dagger" finally stuck out from the silk kerchief called "peace".
Through the above-said confrontational declaration, the chief executive of the ROK voluntarily proved before the world that there can never be "peaceful coexistence" between the DPRK and the ROK and the hostile relations will be maintained between them forever and that the ROK is an accomplice with same ulterior motives as the Ukrainian puppet forces.
That the chief executive of the ROK displayed his unusual "frankness" shows that he lost his face to resort the deceptive farce about "peace declaration" and "theory on two peaceful states" any more.
Whatever the Seoul rulers say and do, the DPRK will deem it a challenge and remain unchanged in its principle of confronting the enemy aimed to definitely treat the ROK as a hostile state. -0-

headline: Coal Mine Youth Shock Brigades Organized in S. Phyongan Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of young people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered for newly-organized coal mine youth shock brigades.
Youths in Kaechon City put their names on the rolls of the Kang Kon Youth Shock Brigade at the Jagang Provincial Supply Coal Mine under the Kaechon Area Coal-mining Complex, the Ri Tae Hun Youth Shock Brigade at the Kaechon Coal Mine and the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade at the Pongchon Coal Mine.
Those in Pukchang County were determined to become members of the Kang Ho Yong Youth Shock Brigade at the Phunggok Youth Coal Mine and the Kang Kon Youth Shock Brigade at the Inpho Youth Coal Mine under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Brigade at the Tukjang Youth Coal Mine under the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex.
A meeting was held in Phyongsong City on June 12 to organize coal mine youth shock brigades.
Present there were Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league, members of the coal mine youth shock brigades and young people in the city.
After a report was made at the meeting, flags were awarded to the youth shock brigades to be followed by oath-taking speeches.
Officials and young people presented bouquets to the shock brigade members who responded to the Party's call with group volunteering. -0-

headline: Production System for Recycling Waste Materials Established at Munphyong Smeltery
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The Munphyong Smeltery in the DPRK completed a production system for recycling the waste materials, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This production system, highly appreciated at the 39th National Festival of Science and Technology, is a success that makes it possible to protect the ecological environment and firmly guarantee the sustainable development of Juche-oriented nonferrous metal production.
The smeltery set up a process for producing sublimated matter by using waste materials in the course of producing lead and zinc. And this sublimated matter is sent to the electrolytic zinc production line to be used as a raw material. A process of extracting iron oxide from the waste slag generated in producing sublimated matter was also established.
The smeltery is now pushing ahead with technical preparations for producing various kinds of blocks and tiles by using silicon compound created after extracting iron oxide in the process of producing sublimated matter. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Sin Chol Sim, a woman living in Neighborhood Unit No. 60 of Saeppyol-dong, Tonghungsan District, Hamhung City, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.
Deeply moved by the loving care, the centenarian expressed her boundless gratitude to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
Her house was crowded with officials of Tonghungsan District, her family members and relatives and neighbors who came to congratulate her.
Born as a daughter of fire-field peasant, she suffered humiliation and insults before national liberation. She could lead a genuine life only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
She always asks her descendents to do more things at sacred revolutionary posts for national prosperity to defend and add shine to the grateful socialist system which values the working people. -0-
