headline: Efforts Made to Improve Educational Conditions and Environment
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- A project to improve the educational conditions and environment is gaining momentum in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.
Officials of the Party and power organs in Pothonggang District provided Kyonghung Senior Middle School with materials necessary for laying artificial turfs on its play ground.
The educators of Kim Ju Hyok Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District spruced up foreign language study halls in a peculiar way and displayed vocabularies, expressions and everyday words in different parts of the school, thus setting an example in creating the environment and conditions favorable for studying foreign languages.
Officials of the Sosong District Public Prosecutors Office and the Sosong District Industrial Goods Management Office provided Sangsin and Namgyo senior middle schools in the district with enough equipment and facilities including computers, LCD TVs and projectors needed at labs.  They are now making sincere efforts to afford the convenience of teachers in their life.
Officials and supporters' organizations in Moranbong District have striven to strengthen the material foundations at educational units while rendering active assistance to the remodeling of buildings and gymnasium at Inhung Senior Middle School.
Songyo, Tongdaewon, Taedonggang and other districts, too, are providing schools, kindergartens and teachers' retraining institutes in the districts with materials and educational apparatuses necessary for improving their educational conditions and environment. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Distortion of History
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 13 (KCNA) -- Japan has recently got more vicious in its moves to distort history, irritating its neighboring countries.
According to report, Japan is going to update the exhibition boards at the Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum within 2026. What merits attention is that it is trying to delete the word "massacre" in the board dealing with the Nanjing Massacre and write the words "Nanjing Incident" in it.
The Nanjing Massacre is a horrible crime the Imperial Japanese Army committed by massacring more than 300 000 people in the region between December and January 1938 during their aggression on China. It has been deeply recognized by the world people as the greatest tragedy in the 20th century.
This atrocity in Nanjing was defined as "massacre" even in the decision of the Far Eastern Military Tribunal, held to judge Japan's aggression war crimes, and the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) registered it as the Memory of the World Regional Register.
However, Japan is making desperate efforts to describe as a trifling "incident" such hideous past crime that can never be concealed or distorted. The fact shows to what extent the neo-militarists' moves to distort history have reached.
As well known, the Japanese imperialists killed more than one million people in Korea alone and forcibly drafted more than 8.4 million young and middle-aged people for battle sites of aggression and slave labor sites.
In particular, they abducted and drafted 200 000 Korean women for the sexual slavery for the Imperial Japanese Army. Such atrocity is the hideous state-sponsored crime unprecedented in the history of wars.
But, the Japanese politicians imposingly organized what is called "Society for New History Textbook Reform" long ago to cover up the reality and distort history.
Moreover, they adopted a decision of the Cabinet meeting that considers "improper" such expressions referring to Japan's past crimes as "forcible conscription" and "comfort women for the Imperial Japanese Army", claiming that teaching the history of aggression as it is means "self-tormenting outlook on history".
Under this decision, the Japanese textbooks do not mention about the massacres committed by the Imperial Japanese Army during their occupation of Korea and neighboring countries and the death toll, and the victims of the sexual slavery are insulted in those textbooks as "prostitutes" and "volunteers for money".
The expression "aggression" had gradually disappeared in textbooks as Japan's aggression upon Asian countries in the past began to be described with such sophistic expression as "liberation of Asia", and at present the phrase "aggression" was totally erased.
The past crimes of Japan, which left incurable wounds to the Korean people and neighboring countries in Asia, are now being distorted in all aspects.
Then, is it right to think what the Japanese government intends while so desperately trying to distort the truth of history, which can never be concealed, is to merely deny its past crimes and evade making apology and settlement?
No.
In fact, the "Self-Defense Forces" of Japan have completed all preparations for overseas aggression and is now emerging the most dangerous aggression forces in the region, advocating "threat from outside".
Owing to Japan, an emergency is being created in the Asia-Pacific region, a situation where there will be nothing unusual even if a war breaks out at once.
What is most important for Japan at this time is to prepare the younger generation to be those in direct charge of war and those who are engaged in it.
Herein lies the reason why Japan persistently clings to infiltrating wrong view on history through exhibition and curriculum.
Japan should be mindful that the more desperate efforts it makes to distort history, the earlier such action will bring its self-destruction. -0-

headline: DPRK Acrobats Win Top Prize at World Festival of Circus Art
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- The World Festival of Circus Art "Idol-2026" took place in Moscow of Russia from May 30 to June 7.
The festival brought together more than 180 excellent acrobats from twelve countries including the DPRK, China, Russia, Mongolia and Italy.
At the physical acrobatics "Wire-rope Walking", the DPRK acrobats were acclaimed by the audience for their wonderful skills on an 8-meter high wire-rope.
At a prize-awarding ceremony, the Grand Prize, the highest prize of the festival, and other gold prizes were awarded to the DPRK's physical acrobatics "Wire-rope Walking" and the Idol silver prize to the physical acrobatics "Balancing Etude". -0-

headline: Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement on Saturday:
The U.S. and its satellite countries had such confabs for nuclear war as a "nuclear consultative group" meeting and "extended deterrence dialogue" what they called. They let loose rhetoric about the nuclear threat to the DPRK and made assertion about someone's "denuclearization" again.
It is an unreasonable talk and fantastic daydream to mention about disarming the other belligerent party's nuclear weapons in meetings for shaping the use of nuclear weapons targeting the DPRK and other regional countries as a policy and plotting a detailed plan for it.
The DPRK Foreign Ministry strictly denounces and rejects the U.S.-Japan-ROK racket with collective nature for nuclear confrontation and the sinister attempt of Western countries to impose an unconstitutional act on a sovereign state in the international arena and warns of the consequences to be entailed by such provocations.
The U.S. and its vassal forces' meaningless rhetoric against the DPRK and cooperation in posing a nuclear threat to it can never affect the irreversible position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state.
The "denuclearization" is an irreversibly finalized matter.
The U.S. is busy with war moves simulating the use of nuclear weapons while massively delivering various types of military hardware including latest air-to-air missile to the ROK and Japan. The reality clearly proves the reason and justness for our state to concentrate its efforts on bolstering up the capacity for self-defence essential for ensuring its security.
The building up of our nuclear shield is a legitimate process for deterring interference and threat from outside, guaranteeing the sovereignty and security of the state and ensuring regional peace and stability.
In coping with the enemy countries' daily-growing nuclear threat to it, our state is taking military and technical countermeasures on the all-round scopes in use of possible capabilities and means of every category.
The DPRK is firm and unshakable in its determination to control and deal with nuclear weapons the nuclear threat by the enemy countries to encroach upon its absolute and inviolable sovereignty and security on the principle of ensuring security and defending peace by dint of powerful strength.
No matter how hard the U.S., Japan and the ROK may quibble, they will never change the present position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state.
No one can recover the "denuclearization" permanently missed in the trend of the times.
The expansion of the DPRK's nuclear capacity and its self-defensive capability based on it is irreversible and this is a strong security guarantee for regional stability and peace. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Consumer Goods Held in North Hwanghae Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of consumer goods took place in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
On display at the exhibition were consumer goods presented by hundreds of units in the province.
The products presented by the regional-industry factories in Koksan and Unpha counties attracted many visitors for their low cost and new and unique regional characteristics.
In particular, the Koksan County Foodstuff Factory presented delicious condiments made with wheat as their main source, the Hwangju County Foodstuff Factory various health foodstuffs made by locally available lotus root and the Unpha County Daily Necessities Factory various kinds of water soap.
Besides, several light industrial factories presented various kinds of smart and convenient shoes and bags by realizing the production with locally available raw materials and recycling.
At the exhibition, the participating units shared their successes and experience with each other and conducted various forms of exchange to explore practical ways of improving quality. -0-

The delegation was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by Kim Song Nam, vice-minister of Public Security of the DPRK, and Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: Technological Innovations Made in Kangwon Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- The three-revolution team members active in Kangwon Province of the DPRK are taking the lead in the work for regional economic development and improvement of the people's livelihood.
Thanks to their efforts, more than 100 valuable technical innovations have been introduced into production and construction in the province this year.
The three-revolution team members active at the Chonnaeri Cement Factory invented a profitable technical innovation plan conducive to proper maintenance of equipment, thus providing a guarantee for increased cement production while saving a lot of manpower and materials.
Those active at the Kalma Offshore Farm laid a foundation for putting the scallop farming on a scientific basis, irrespective of the sea water condition, and enabled the farm to reenergize the sea cucumber farming by means of proprietary water circulation system.
Those active at the provincial information and communications management station developed an efficient cable detecting and identifying machine in cooperation with technicians of the station, and those in Kumgang County and Munchon City opened up a prospect for producing various kinds of spices and paving blocks with their own efforts and technology.
The three-revolution team members in cities and counties and at farms in the province are conducting researches for increased grain production while solving sci-tech problems arising in fish farming in paddy fields. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 14 (KCNA) -- Workers of the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory in the DPRK are greeting the day when the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Ungave field guidance at the factory.
On June 15, 2016, the respected Comrade General Secretary visited the factory and went round various production processes. And he highly praised that the Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory most correctly implemented the Party's policy on realizing the home production of equipment and the factory is holding high the banner of Juche.
Over the last decade, the factory has contributed to improving the people's standard of living and developing the foodstuff industry by stepping up the modernization of production lines and improving the quality of products.
It designed and manufactured lots of production equipment by its own efforts and technology and established a new germ-free, dust-free, automated and streamlined foodstuff production process.
It saved much fund and materials for boiler operation by introducing a technology for removing scale by means of small molecular water and established a new method of corn processing, thus greatly raising the efficiency of management and production.
It provided a foundation for solving the sugar problem by stepping up the research into the establishment of sugar production lines and introduced lots of technical innovation proposals to make progress in supplying domestic raw and other materials for production and consolidating the production foundation.
A food safety management system was established in production lines of processing workshop and corn syrup workshop and more than 10 products were registered as February 2 goods.
The factory won the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag and Twice "Lathe No.26" Model Machine Prize. -0-

headline:
Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory Associated with Love of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2026.06.15.]
Schoolchildren Climb Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren from across the DPRK are making a study tour of the revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu, the sacred mountain of the revolution.
They climbed the top of Mt Paektu on June 14 by accelerating the march, recalling the immortal revolutionary exploits of PresidentKim Il Sung, who accomplished the historic cause of national liberation through the bloody anti-Japanese struggle, and the mental world of the anti-Japanese revolutionary forerunners, who recorded the first page of the history of the Korean revolution with victory.
Looking at the vast sea of trees associated with the everlasting history of resistance, they were full of the enthusiasm to remain faithful to the ideology and leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unby carrying forward the indomitable soul and fighting spirit of the forerunners.
The song "We Are Koreans" sung by them echoed throughout the mountains.
Earlier, they toured the Chongbong Bivouac and the Rimyongsu Revolutionary Site.
They are going on their march. -0-

headline: Good Idea
story_text:
One day in May 2018, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected the completed Koam-Tapchon Railways.
He looked with satisfaction at the Sokjonman Bridge extending across Sokjon Bay between the Koam area in Munchon City and the Songjon peninsula.
Then he went round the Sokjonman Bridge. After stressing the need to properly manage the railways and structures, he looked at the railways and the sidewalks alternately and said that there was one thing to regret.
Officials looked at each other, not knowing the reason.
The respected Comrade General Secretary told the officials that there was no roadway.
He said that if the bridge had been widened for motorcars, it would have been a very good bridge. And he proposed a good idea for turning the bridge into multi-purpose one for the operation of railway trains and motorcars, saying that there is nothing impossible to do when one is determined and that if the bridge is made to operate motorcars, the bridge will become a utility one to raise the economic efficiency.
It was, indeed, a good idea of gaining many benefits with one thing.
Afterwards, the builders made the Sokjonman Bridge multi-purpose for trains and motorcars in a short span of time as taught by the respected Comrade General Secretary, and the area was further changed by decoration. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Ministers of Public Security of DPRK and Vietnam
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- Talks between Pang Tu Sop, minister of Public Security of the Democratic People's Republic Korea, and Luong Tam Quang, minister of Public Security of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, were held at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on June 14.
Present there from the DPRK side were Kim Song Nam, vice-minister of Public Security, and officials concerned and, from the Vietnamese side were members of the delegation of the Ministry of Public Security of the SRV.
At the talks, both sides exchanged the successes and experience gained by the public security organizations of the two countries in the field of law enforcement and discussed the issues of expanding and developing bilateral exchange and cooperation.
The talks proceeded in a friendly atmosphere. -0-

headline: Talks Held between Ministers of Public Security of DPRK and Vietnam
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
At farms in Sinchon, Thaethan, Ongjin and Kangryong counties of South Hwanghae Province, the premier acquainted himself with the immediate farming situation, giving pep talks to officials and agricultural workers who have striven to bring about a rich harvest in the first year's farming, true to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
He called for setting the right harvest time on the basis of detailed calculation of the ripening rate of earlier wheat and barley and weather conditions and gathering in them without waste by raising the operation rate of combine harvesters and other farm machines.
He underscored the need to cultivate rice and maize in a sci-tech way in conformity with their growth state, make foresighted preparations for coping with the disastrous abnormal weather, actively introduce advanced farming methods whose advantages have been proved in reality and organize and conduct brisk activities to generalize the experience of advanced units so as to increase the ranks of high-yield farms, workteams and sub-workteams.
Learning about the situation of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, the premier stressed the need to bring about innovations in coal production by further raising the proportion of face work done by machines and to step up the remodeling of the Sunchon Coal-mining Machine Factory in a planned way with the emphasis on putting production processes on a streamlined and specialized basis.
He stated that the units in charge of providing supplies to the coal miners in the Sunchon area should steadily improve the management method and take reasonable measures for the supply of raw and other materials so as to increase the kinds and quantity of goods for supply service.
Discussed at field consultative meetings were the issue for the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and other ministries and national agencies to ensure timely supply of materials and equipment necessary for farming in South Hwanghae Province, the issue of actively developing and introducing cutting face equipment suited to the coal mine situation and the issue of holding fast to the strengthening of talent forces as a main link in the chain of the unit development.
Earlier, the premier visited the Phyongsong Wheat Processing Factory under construction and underlined the need to rationally arrange production processes and raise the level of modernization of equipment so as to increase the wheat processing capacity. He also urged the Phyongsong Irrigation Machine Factory to direct big efforts to reducing the production cost. -0-

headline:
Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory Associated with Love of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un
[2026.06.15.]
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory in the DPRK is a foodstuff production base which plays an important role in improving the people's standard of living.
The factory has remodeled the peanut sorter into the form of multi-stage cylinder to save much manpower while producing tasty confectionery with high hygienic safety in the modernized and home-made production lines.
In the course of putting the production on a scientific basis, six lines of producing cake, candy, corn syrup, etc. won the food safety management system certificate.
The factory is associated with the love of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unfor the people.
On June 15, 2016, the respected Comrade General Secretary visited the finely-remodeled Pyongyang Cornstarch Factory, despite the vicious, untimely rain. And he said that he was pleased to see the factory producing various kinds of foodstuffs satisfying various nutritive and hygienic requirements.
He stressed that the factory can put the production on a normal footing to produce and supply much more confectionery to the people only when a proper measure is taken to supply raw materials.
Expressing expectation and belief that the officials and employees of the factory would produce more tasty and nutritious foodstuffs, he had a photo session with them.
The factory recently achieved many successes, including the establishment of the processes of producing grain chips and packing bottles of corn syrup and the increase of the variety of foodstuffs. -0-

headline: Women in Kangwon Province Volunteer for Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- The patriotic will of the women in Kangwon Province of the DPRK is growing stronger at every worksite for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
This year, more than 1 000 women in the province have volunteered for major worksites of socialist construction to do good things conducive to the regional development.
Women's union members in Wonsan City volunteered to work at the Wonsan School Uniform Factory with the desire to uphold the noble intention of the motherly Party with pure conscience.
Those in Chonnae County decided to work at the Chonnae Area Coal-mining Complex.
Women in Munchon City and Cholwon County advanced to work at raw materials base stations and farms to lead a worthwhile life as working people.
Women's union members in Kosan, Sepho, Anbyon, Kosong and other counties sent to farms the machines and materials they provided, and many women's union officials and others in the province are fulfilling their duty as citizens in the work to render labor assistance to farms. -0-

headline: Letter to Respected Marshal Kim Jong Un from Delegation of Korean Schoolchildren in Japan to Celebrations of 80th KCU Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- The respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter of resolution on June 13 from the members of the delegation of Korean schoolchildren in Japan to the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Korean Children's Union.
The letter extended thanks to the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who made children of Koreans in Japan participate in the celebrations of the 80th KCU birthday and provided them with high glory and happiness, reflecting the unanimous mind of all Koreans and their schoolchildren in Japan.
It said that the 15 days and nights they spent in the homeland were precious ones when they cherished the pride and honor of Koreans, deeply grasping the noble compatriotism of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unand his outlook on the rising generations and keenly realizing the mightiness and rosy future of the homeland.
At the venues of the celebrations of the 80th KCU birthday, they came to be convinced of the bright future of the homeland which would be eternally rosy and prosperous, seeing the vigorous and healthy looks of the KCU members, and hardened their patriotic faith to prepare themselves to be pillars of the patriotic cause of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan desired by the fatherly Marshal, the letter said, and went on:
Witnessing new streets and monumental edifices of socialist civilization, we cherished the strong sentiment and the great heroic spirit of the homeland to build a dignified power by its own efforts and with love for the future.
The respected MarshalKim Jong Unloving the future and devoting his all to it is the benevolent father of the schoolchildren in the homeland and the Korean schoolchildren in Japan.
The letter wished the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un, who represents their destiny and future as well as powerful Korea, good health for the eternal prosperity of the socialist homeland and the brighter laughter and happiness of the rising generations. -0-

headline: Yuphyong Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 15 (KCNA) -- The Yuphyong Revolutionary Site in Changsong County, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK is a significant place where PresidentKim Il Sunginspired the commanding officers and soldiers of the Korean People's Army with confidence in victory during the grim period of the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) and unfolded an operational plan to annihilate the aggressors by going over to a counteroffensive on all fronts.
At dawn of one day in October 1950, the President arrived there and matured his outstanding idea and tactics to bring about a radical turn in the Fatherland Liberation War, spending the whole day at a plain farmhouse.
After receiving a report on the first day of the battle in the Unsan area, a powerful counterattack which was the prelude to a new counteroffensive of the People's Army, he ordered KPA units to tighten the encirclement ring and annihilate the enemies completely through a violent attack.
He took measures to further strengthen defence in various regions and make full preparations for the combat of the units of the People's Army. After acquainting himself with the wartime farming of the peasants in the village, he took a measure to increase the food production and send them to the front.
On June 15, 2013, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Yuphyong Revolutionary Site and said that the day that the President spent there is an unforgettable day to be recorded forever in the history of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Yuphyong Revolutionary Site is telling forever the immortal exploits of the President who opened a new phase of victory in the war by unfolding an operational plan to defeat the U.S. imperialists and other imperialist allied forces. -0-

headline: Jo Yong Won Meets Vietnamese Minister of Public Security
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, first vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, met Luong Tam Quang, minister of Public Security of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, who paid a courtesy call on him, at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on June 15.
Jo Yong Won had a talk in a friendly atmosphere with Luong Tam Quang.
Present there were Kim Song Nam, vice-minister of Public Security of the DPRK, and officials concerned and leading members of the delegation of the Ministry of Public Security of the SRV and Le Ba Vinh, Vietnamese ambassador to the DPRK. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Verbal Message and Flower Basket to Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory verbal message and a congratulatory flower basket to Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China, on June 15 on the occasion of his birthday.
In his verbal message, ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping on his birthday.
He sincerely wished the general secretary good health and greater success in leading the cause of socialist construction in China as the leading core of the CPC.
Written on a ribbon of the flower basket were the letters "I warmly congratulate Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping on your birthday."
The DPRK ambassador to the PRC courteously conveyed the congratulatory verbal message and flower basket sent by ComradeKim Jong Unto a senior official of the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC. -0-

headline: Vietnamese Delegation Tours Various Places of DPRK
Jo Yong Won Meets Vietnamese Minister of Public Security
Work for Cultivating Dry-field Rice Hastened in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The work for cultivating dry-field rice is being hastened in different parts of the DPRK.
South Hwanghae, North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces are taking technical measures to increase the per-hectare yield on the basis of the scientific selection of the right soil and right time after expanding the cultivation area of dry-field rice and choosing the variety of dry-field rice suitable to double cropping.

headline: Efforts Paid to Development of Koryo Medicine
story_text:

headline: KCNA Report on Miracles and Innovations Made in Implementing New Five-year Plan
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 16 (KCNA) -- The Korean Central News Agency Monday released a report on the fact that the working class and all other people across the DPRK are going all out for the implementation of the new five-year plan, true to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea and the First Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Party Central Committee.
All sectors and units of the national economy have turned out under the leadership of the Party Central Committee, waging a vigorous mass technical innovation movement and in the course, the overall industrial production showed 5 percent increase in the past 100 days since the Party Congress, the report said, and went on:
At the Ninth Congress of the WPK, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the direction of advance and the policies of struggle to boost the overall socialist development with confidence and aroused all the people to the grand revolutionary advance once again, with firm belief in the working class who has devotedly defended the Party Central Committee with proud labor achievements by displaying the revolutionary spirit of self-reliance in every decade of the revolution.
The fighting morale of the people out in the general advance for attaining the new long-term goals has been high from the beginning.
Workers of the Sangwon Cement Complex carried out their production plan at 107 percent on a daily average in March and attained highly-set cement production plan in April and May, too, thus giving vitality to the socialist construction sites.
Those of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex showed six percent increase in production than the same period of last year.
The workers of the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine produced a thousand and hundreds of more tons of coal than planned in May alone through various mass movements.
The Sunchon Cement Complex turned out tens of thousands of more tons of cement for 100 days. And other cement production units brought about an unprecedented upsurge in production, thus showing increase in cement production than planned on a nationwide scale.
The Musan Mining Complex over-fulfilled its production plans of concentrated iron ore in March, April and May and workers and technicians of the Unnyul Mine provided a guarantee for revitalizing the production of iron ore and concentrated ore.
The chemical industry sector, in which technological innovation is being turned into the work of the masses themselves, has increased its production.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex over-fulfilled its highly-set fertilizer production plan by finding reserves for increased production in technical innovation and actively introducing original inventions.
The Hungnam Fertilizer Complex produced a thousand and hundreds of more tons of fertilizer than planned by applying the operating method suited to the conditions for supplying raw materials and taking technical measures to increase the output of gas per hour.
The number of units boosting the production by dint of science and technology has increased in the electrical power industry, too.
The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex updated technical and economic indices of generating equipment such as increasing combustion efficiency by introducing the method of building the ignition bands of boiler fire boxes with far-infrared heating element as a whole and thus boosted electricity output, saving a large amount of coal.
Suphung, Jangjingang and Sodusu power stations increased the electricity output by controlling load dispatch according to the technical specifications of generators and ensuring the high-water level and high-efficiency operation based on scientific water control.
The workers in the machine-building industry conducted the April 15 technical innovation shock brigade campaign to improve the technical performance of equipment and increase production both in quality and quantity.
The Pyongyang Electric Cable General Factory 326 has made innovations in the production of various kinds of quality electric cables by pushing ahead with the technical upgrading of plastic mixer, rolling mill, large-size elongation machine and others.
The Anju Insulating Material Factory increased the production of paints and insulating materials by ensuring the normal operation of already-built production lines while stepping up the work to build up its own technical force and modernize the production process of insulating varnish.
The mining and light industrial sectors, too, conducted a mass technological innovation movement, giving importance to science and technology and creating economic levers in every way so that all the working people have a keen interest in preparing themselves as intelligent and technical personnel.
The railway transport workers, timber producers and fishery workers, too, have carried out their monthly plans for rail freight transport, timber production and seafood production.
The report said that thanks to the struggle of the heroic working class who have made strenuous and confident efforts to carry out the tasks for the first year of the new Five-Year Plan, the overall industrial production has been increased by far than planned to provide a sure guarantee for steady and sustained growth of the country's economy. -0-

headline: New Products Developed at Regional-Industry Factories in Jongphyong County
80 000 Wooden Blocks of Complete Collection of Buddhist Scriptures
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 17 (KCNA) -- Among the precious cultural heritages of the Korean nation is "80 000 Wooden Blocks of Complete Collection of Buddhist Scriptures" made in the period of Koryo (918-1392).
The complete collection, known as a Buddhist encyclopedia dealing with the Buddhist scriptures and relevant books, consists of 6 793 volumes in over 1 530 kinds. As the number of wooden blocks for its printing reaches more than 80 000, it is called "80 000 Wooden Blocks of Complete Collection of Buddhist Scriptures".
The first complete collection consisting of more than 6 000 volumes was printed in the first half of the eleventh century and another complete collection consisting of 4 769 volumes in 1 000-odd kinds was reprinted and supplemented in the latter half of the twelfth century. But the wooden blocks were burnt by foreign aggressors.
The third complete collection was finished from 1236 to 1251 and it is "80 000 Wooden Blocks of Complete Collection of Buddhist Scriptures" which has been handed down up to now.
Wooden blocks remind of a sculpture for their delicacy.
Machilus thunbergii, Betula schmidtii and Betula platyphylla were used as materials for wooden blocks. The wooden bars were laid doubly on both ends of the lacquered block and bronze bands were placed on its four corners.
The date of composition, titles of scriptures and volume numbers, etc. were also carved on the blocks.
When visiting the Myohyangsan History Museum on June 17, 1989, PresidentKim Il Sungcame to know that only some of the wooden blocks were on display there and indicated the ways for showing full wooden blocks to the visitors.
The "80 000 Wooden Blocks of Complete Collection of Buddhist Scriptures" is recognized as the most perfect standard complete collection of Buddhist scriptures among the ancient ones in the world. -0-

story_text:

Amid a brisk mass movement for establishing socialist cultured way of life, nearly 20 dongs and 1 100 neighborhood units in the city won the title of the Loyal July 11 Red Flag Dong and Neighborhood Unit (including twice and thrice) in the first half of the year alone.
Mangyongdae District conducted a movement for winning the title of the Loyal July 11 Red Flag Dong and Neighborhood Unit and a movement to create Families Exemplary in Socialist Cultured Way of Life and generalized experience of the advanced units and, thereby, six dongs and 150-odd neighborhood units were honored with the title of the Loyal July 11 Red Flag Dong and Neighborhood Unit of higher degree.
Women's union organizations in Hyongjesan District spruced up many dongs and neighborhood units by displaying a high sense of responsibility and meticulous manner of work.
Women's union members in Taedongmun-dong and Kyongnim-dong of Central District, which won the title of the Thrice Loyal July 11 Red Flag Dong, improved the appearance of parks and resting sites, and those in Unha-dong of Ryongsong District carried on the project to create greenery and build retaining walls.
Women's union officials and members in Rangnang, Sunan and Tongdaewon districts created landscapes with trees and flower shrubs of good species and spruced up children's parks to suit modern aesthetic tastes.
The Kangdong county committee of the women's union generalized the experience gained in the work to turn the Rimgyong workers' district into a model unit.
Women's union officials and members in Pothonggang, Taesong and Sosong districts have turned streets and villages into socialist fairyland while directing efforts to the normal management of remodeled parks in their areas. -0-

headline: Persons with Disabilities in DPRK Enjoy Worthwhile Life under Policy of WPK and State
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- June 18 is the Day of Persons with Disabilities in the DPRK.
The Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Persons with Disabilities was adopted on June 18, 2003.
On the occasion of the Day of Persons with Disabilities, various events including a commemorative meeting and the work to help the disabled are annually being conducted in the country and, in the course, the public interest in the disabled is increasing.
The DPRK guarantees the rights and interests of the disabled in all fields of social life and fully provides them with stable and convenient living environment and conditions.
Persons with disabilities are working as public officials according to their qualifications and abilities and expressing their views conducive to social progress and development through publications and art pieces.
Measures are being taken for the disabled to make them receive education and sufficient medical assistance through advanced methods in conformity with their physical conditions and enjoy the rights to work.
Cultural organizations such as the Korean Art Association of the Disabled and the Korean Sports Association for the Disabled are active in the country, and art activities and sports games of persons with disabilities have been briskly conducted.
Last year alone, persons with disabilities of the DPRK bagged gold medals in various events in the international games including the ITTF World Para Future Taipei 2025, the ITTF World Para Challenger Kaohsiung 2025 and the Fifth Asian Youth Para Games.
Thanks to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and state on protecting the disabled, persons with disabilities are enjoying a worthwhile life. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following statement on June 18:
The miserable position of the West, which has to remain faithful to the customary practice of shouting "denuclearization" in chorus although they admit the fact that it is an empty goal that can never be realized, has been clearly revealed once again.
At the G7 summit held in France, the U.S. and other Western countries repeated their anachronistic assertion about "denuclearization" while slandering the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with unfounded politically-motivated rhetoric.
G7, the chief culprit of destroying global peace and security and the international nuclear non-proliferation system, has neither qualifications to discuss the sovereign option of the DPRK nor right to deny it.
I express strong dissatisfaction and regret at the excess of authority of G7, a direct violation of the constitution of our state, and resolutely denounce and reject it in the most explicit tone.
They must be aware of the fact that "denuclearization", which is an irreversibly finalized agenda, can never be realized, and if they really do not know, it will only reveal their lack of political discrimination and lack of sense of the reality.
Obviously, the argument about "denuclearization" has gone completely out of date and this can by no means be changed even though the voice of accusation of any group goes louder.
Due to its destructive power, the nuclear weapon can be turned into the means of tyranny to harm the mankind if it is in the hands of injustice but it will be tremendous deterrent to contain injustice if it is in the hands of justice.
It is impossible to defeat injustice only by advocating justice, peace, international order and principle, and nothing is more foolish than to sit with folded arms in the face of military threats accompanied by nuclear weapons.
The DPRK got access to nuclear weapons to defend itself as it has constantly and persistently been the target of nuclear threat from its enemies and, therefore, the DPRK's nukes will lead to concern of no one but the enemies who are trying to harm the DPRK. And the illogic nature of the assertion about our "nuclear threat" should be considered focused on this.
Nuclear weapons are powerful means of defending sovereignty and cornerstone for ensuring peace, defined by the law of the DPRK.
The DPRK's nukes as a means for self-defence and countermeasures will remain unchanged in their identity and persistence.
The DPRK's access to nuclear weapons is its core interests to be preserved without fail and "denuclearization" is the line of no retreat that can never be crossed.
In any case, anyone who tries to hurt the core interests of a nuclear weapons state would make the worst option of inviting disaster. -0-

headline: Persons with Disabilities in DPRK Enjoy Worthwhile Life under Policy of WPK and State
Persons with Disabilities in DPRK Enjoy Worthwhile Life under Policy of WPK and State
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 18 (KCNA) -- June 18 is the Day of Persons with Disabilities in the DPRK.
The Law of the DPRK on the Protection of Persons with Disabilities was adopted on June 18, 2003.
On the occasion of the Day of Persons with Disabilities, various events including a commemorative meeting and the work to help the disabled are annually being conducted in the country and, in the course, the public interest in the disabled is increasing.
The DPRK guarantees the rights and interests of the disabled in all fields of social life and fully provides them with stable and convenient living environment and conditions.
Persons with disabilities are working as public officials according to their qualifications and abilities and expressing their views conducive to social progress and development through publications and art pieces.
Measures are being taken for the disabled to make them receive education and sufficient medical assistance through advanced methods in conformity with their physical conditions and enjoy the rights to work.
Cultural organizations such as the Korean Art Association of the Disabled and the Korean Sports Association for the Disabled are active in the country, and art activities and sports games of persons with disabilities have been briskly conducted.
Last year alone, persons with disabilities of the DPRK bagged gold medals in various events in the international games including the ITTF World Para Future Taipei 2025, the ITTF World Para Challenger Kaohsiung 2025 and the Fifth Asian Youth Para Games.
Thanks to the policy of the Workers' Party of Korea and state on protecting the disabled, persons with disabilities are enjoying a worthwhile life. -0-

headline: Namhung Youth Chemical Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, a leading chemical base of the DPRK, is expanding the fertilizer production.
The complex has over-fulfilled its monthly fertilizer production plan of this year by waging a drive to reduce the cost, increase productivity and put production processes on a higher scientific basis by relying on its own technical forces.
In particular, it produced more than 7 500 more tons of fertilizer than planned in March and April.
The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex is associated with the leadership of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho led it to take the lead in the struggle for building a powerful socialist country.
On June 19, 2013, when he visited the complex, the respected Comrade General Secretary said that the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, which produces fertilizer for the agricultural sector, is like an arsenal on the socialist agricultural front.
That day, he said that more fertilizer should be produced at the complex to solve the problem arising in increasing fertilizer production.
After his field guidance, the complex has held fast to the increase of scientific and technological force as the main link of boosting production and pushed ahead with the work to manage equipment and improve technical control, thus providing a guarantee for increased fertilizer production.
Through the exhibition of successes in technological innovation, it has waged a mass technological innovation movement to share and generalize advanced technology and experience and improve the safe operation and efficiency of the overall production system.
Recently, the complex has increased fertilizer production by introducing more than 10 valuable technical innovation proposals. -0-

The repair and distemper painting of 960-odd multi-storey dwelling houses were completed and thousands of square meters of green lands were newly created. And the province has planted tens of thousands of trees and flowering shrubs of good species to add beauty to streets and villages.

Officials, teachers and researchers of the Ministry of Physical Culture and Sports and Korea University of Physical Education intensified the researches to creatively apply the Korean-style scientific training method to teaching and training along with the work to systematize the method theoretically.
The advantages and effectiveness of new teaching material, completed thanks to their efforts, have been proved in the course of its introduction into sports teaching and training practice in recent years.
The relevant units are introducing and generalizing Korean-style sports teaching and training science to teaching and training units and sports education units across the country. -0-

headline: Dental Hygiene Products Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 19 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Dental Hygiene Products Factory in the DPRK is associated with the loving care of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho is regarding it as his disposition to make selfless, devoted efforts for the people and spare nothing for the promotion of their wellbeing.
The factory, built under the direct initiative and meticulous guidance of the respected Comrade General Secretary, is a comprehensive dental hygiene products base equipped with modern production processes.

The technicians and workers of the factory have made successes in developing new products and improving their quality.
Thanks to their efforts, many functional dental hygiene products including toothpastes and mouth gargles have been developed and produced to help people in their dental treatment.
Kaesong Koryo Insam toothpaste, active nutritive toothpaste and other products were registered as February 2 goods and awarded the December 15 Quality Medal. And its various production processes received GMP authentication.
The products of the factory drew attention of many people at the light industrial goods exhibition "Development of Light Industry-2023" and the national exhibition of scientific and technological achievements in public health-2025.
The factory was selected as one of the ten best enterprises in 2023 and received rotating pennant and certificates several times as it fulfilled its annual national economic plans.
Now the technicians and workers of the factory are striving to develop and produce quality dental hygiene goods in larger quantities. -0-

headline: Photo and Book Exhibition Opens in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- A photo and book exhibition opened in Moscow on June 17 to mark the second anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present at its opening ceremony were personages of Russian government, political parties, organizations and institutions, including the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma of Russia, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the Korean War Veterans' Council, and the DPRK ambassador to Russia and his embassy members.
Speeches were made at the ceremony.
The DPRK ambassador mentioned the historic significance of the DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit in June 2024 and stressed that the bilateral solidarity and cooperation have been further strengthened in all fields over the past two years.
He expressed belief that the photo and book exhibition would contribute to consolidating the ties of friendship between the peoples of the two countries and carrying forward the comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia forever.
A secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation who is head of the Russia-DPRK Friendship Parliamentary Group of the State Duma said that the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries is a new milestone in the history of the Russia-DPRK relations and, at a same time, a great motive force for expanding the bilateral relations in all fields of cooperation.
He expressed the resolve to strive for further developing the alliance between the two countries in the future, too. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Production of Electric Appliances
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- The Kyongsong Electric Appliances Factory in the DPRK has steadily boosted the production of various kinds of electric appliances for various economic sectors after carrying out its first half-yearly quota ahead of schedule.
The factory has intensified technical guidance with the main emphasis on ensuring both quality and quantity of products and, at the same time, taken measures to supply materials while scrupulously organizing alternated production.
It saved a lot of electricity through the remodeling of equipment and introduced more than 10 valuable technical innovation proposals into production.
The factory has made its employees acquire expertise according to their occupations and conducted weekly review and evaluation to ensure that all the employees have an interest in improving the quality of products and enhance their sense of responsibility.

headline: Wheat and Barley Harvest Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers across the country are speeding up the harvest of wheat and barley.
Officials of the Agricultural Commission and other agricultural guidance organs at all levels have conducted operations and commands to conclude the harvest of earlier crops by mobilizing all manpower and means.
Posters, slogans and flash news boards were displayed on every field and the results of wheat and barley harvest are growing higher day by day amid the brisk frontline-style motivation activities.
Haeju City and Samchon, Unchon, Anak, Jaeryong and other counties of South Hwanghae Province finished the harvest of wheat and barley in a short span of time.
Rinsan, Thosan, Unpha and Yonthan counties in North Hwanghae Province have ensured the speed and quality of harvesting wheat and barley while taking into consideration the ripening of ears.
Rural areas in South Hamgyong Province have introduced different methods and mobilized machines to harvest wheat and barley in large areas every day.

headline: Driving Device for Glass Automatic Door Developed at Control Machine Institute
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the Control Machine Institute under the State Academy of Sciences in the DPRK developed a driving device for glass automatic door in its own way.
The institute ensured smooth opening and closing of glass automatic door in the method of speed control suited to the world trend and solved sci-tech problems arising in applying superior function. On this basis, it developed a high-quality and low-cost driving device for glass automatic door in a short span of time and introduced it into the entrance of a newly built major project.

headline: Technology of Recycling Slag Introduced at Pukchang Thermal Power Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 21 (KCNA) -- The Pukchang Thermal Power Complex in the DPRK developed and introduced a technology for recycling slag.
Ii solved technical problems arising in extracting the necessary ingredients from slag in close cooperation with scientific research units. Therefore, the complex provided sci-tech guarantees for recycling slag, including the technology for using waste oil as a flotation reagent raw material.
With the introduction of the technology for recycling slag, the complex has obtained burned coal and raw materials for producing building materials with high utility from slag which became obstacles in production and environmental protection, thus saving the cost for removing slag and gaining great profit. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill
story_text:

The respected Comrade General Secretary said that the fighting spirit of the great Chollima era should be invariably carried forward forever, adding that the workers of the mill should continue to glorify the proud tradition and honor of the mill.
The Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill is a proud silk thread production base along with the Chollima era when world-startling miracles and innovations were created in socialist construction.
It overfulfilled its national economic plan every year during the great Chollima upswing, thus winning the titles of Chollima Workteam and Chollima Factory before others in Pyongyang Municipality.
In those days, Kil Hwak Sil, an ordinary workteam leader of the mill, became a forerunner of communist education and a labour hero known to the whole country. Thanks to her devoted efforts, her workteam became a united group helping and leading each other forward, and made innovations in production. As a result, her workteam was honored with the title of the first Chollima workteam in the mill.
The mill is still adding luster to the honor of model factory and model unit, succeeding to the fighting spirit of the Chollima era.
All the employees have turned out in the struggle to learn from the heroes of the Chollima era, holding high the slogan "One for all and all for one!" In this course, the mill produces a lot of labour innovators every year. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Municipality Releases Nearly 200 Million Fry into Rivers
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Pyongyang Municipality Fish Farming Management Bureau released nearly 200 million fry into the Taedong River and several medium and small rivers in the municipality.
The management bureau has intensified its guidance so that all the spawning units put the work to breed seed fish and collect eggs on a sci-tech basis according to seasons.
The Taedonggang Spawning Station and the Ryongsong Breed-fish Station introduced advanced technology into breeding fry to ensure the survival rate and weight ratio of fry at a high level.
The Kangnam and Youth Tudan breed-fish stations have established a system of breeding fry and paid attention to improving the technical and practical skills of their employees, thus breeding large quantities of fry.
Other spawning units also directed great efforts to breed fry and made much preparation for releasing fry.
Meanwhile, several spawning units sent hundreds of thousands of young catfish to the rural areas in the municipality where paddy-field fish breeding is conducted. -0-

headline: Kelp Production Increased
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- The Kim Chaek Taesong fishery enterprise in the DPRK has more than doubled the kelp production as compared with the same period of last year.
After securing fast-growing and high-yielding species of kelps, the enterprise directed efforts to cultivating them in a scientific and technological way and took measures to ensure the safety of aquaculture facilities.
It organized scientific and technological study and demonstration so that the cultivators could learn advanced methods of kelp cultivation and, at the same time, set high demands for them to work as required by technical regulations.
It studied and introduced scientific cultivation methods to raise productivity and harvested kelps by concentrating manpower and means. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Silk Mill
Achievements Made in Railway Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the devoted efforts of workers in the railway transport sector of the DPRK, the Ministry of Railways finished in the main the production of concrete sleepers for the first half of the year and successfully replaced the old sleepers with new ones in the railway sections extending hundreds of kilometers.
All the railway bureaus have increased the proportion of work done by machines and replaced the old sleepers with new ones meticulously on their railway sections.
The railway transport sector is steadily advancing toward the attainment of higher goal for railway modernization. -0-

headline: Conferences of Chongryon Regional Headquarters Held in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 22 (KCNA) -- Conferences of regional headquarters of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) were held in different parts of Japan to discuss the issue of thoroughly implementing the decisions of the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
The 26th Conference of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon took place at Osaka Korean Middle and High School on June 7.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho, first vice-chairman of the Central Standing Committee of Chongryon, and deputies elected at units of all levels under the headquarters.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played at the conference.
Read out at the conference was a congratulatory message from the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK to the 26th Congress of Chongryon.
A report on the work of the Executive Committee of the Osaka Prefectural Headquarters of Chongryon was followed by speeches.
Pak Ku Ho made a concluding speech.
Noting that the respected MarshalKim Jong Unin his letter to Chongryon on its 70th founding anniversary set the task to develop Chongryon into a body putting the compatriots above all and serving them faithfully, with the coming decade till its 80th founding anniversary as a new struggle period, he stressed that all the organizations under Chongryon should redouble their efforts to protect the compatriots' community and further promote the patriotic movement.
A letter to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwas adopted at the conference.
The 26th Conference of the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters of Chongryon took place at the Central Hall of Chongryon in Tokyo on June 13.
Present there were Pak Ku Ho and deputies elected at units of all levels under the Tokyo Metropolitan Headquarters.
Similar conferences were held by more than 10 regional headquarters of Chongryon, including Hokkaido, Kyoto, Aichi, Yamaguchi and Chiba prefectural headquarters. -0-

headline: DPRK Players Prove Successful in International Games This Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 23 (KCNA) -- The proud successes made by the reliable sportspersons in demonstrating the dignity and might of Juche Korea all over the world this year are injecting vitality into the all-people general advance for ushering in the era of comprehensive prosperity of our country.
The Naegohyang Team of the DPRK lifted a trophy for the first time in the 2025-2026 AFC Women's Champions League to qualify for the FIFA Women's Champions Cup 2027.
And DPRK women footballers came first at the 2026 AFC U-17 Women's Asian Cup to qualify for the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
At the 2026 Asian Weightlifting Championships, DPRK players bagged 18 gold medals and set eight new world records and ten new Asian records.
They proved successful at the 2026 Asian Wrestling Championship and the 2026 International Freestyle Wrestling Tournament Ivan Yarygin Cup. And two women players became champions at the 2026 Asian Judo Championship.
DPRK players proved successful in the 2026 Konstantin Korotkov International Boxing Tournament, the New Taipei City Athletics Open 2026, the Seventh Senior and Junior Trampoline Asian Championships and the Second Asian Trampoline Age Group Competition and other international games.
Our players have won more than 80 medals and four trophies including 39 gold medals and set 18 new world and Asian records in international games so far this year. -0-
