topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Newly-built Facilities in Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the newly-built facilities in the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area on June 24.
He was accompanied by secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK and major commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
Going round the newly-built Kalma Tourist Railway Station, ComradeKim Jong Unacquainted himself in detail with its construction and preparations for its operation.
He praised the builders for their efforts to build a modern railway station in just one year, saying that it seemed as if it was a few days ago when he chose the construction site near the coastal tourist area in order to promote the convenience for passengers visiting the tourist area.
He said that all the elements of the railway station were harmoniously arranged in conformity with the Party's idea on architectural aesthetics, principle of practical layout and requirements of the times and another progress made in the construction of the railway station. He noted with satisfaction that it would be an important occasion for establishing the standard for remodeling the local railway stations and changing the perception of it.
Saying that the importance of the rational combination of technical design and architectural design, intended to fully meet the specific technical and special requirements in the construction of railway station, has been proved again, he clarified the principled issues arising in putting the design of railway infrastructure on a scientific, functional and specialized basis.
Referring to some shortcomings revealed in the final construction of passenger station, he said that the construction sector should direct main efforts to completing a more detailed system of evaluating quality control of construction, building up the construction guidance force and raising the technical and skill levels of builders.
He also said that it is necessary to continuously supplement and perfect the construction law including a legal regulation that requires the construction units to take responsibility for the structural quality and repair and maintain the original state of the structures for a certain period as well as strengthening the role of construction supervisory institutions.
ComradeKim Jong Unmentioned his idea of modernizing the railway stations in provincial seats across the country on the basis of the successes and experience gained in the construction of the railway station, and instructed to give precedence to the scientific design based on the features and functional demand of the relevant areas, including passenger and freight traffic capacity, and to draft and examine the budget bill.
He set forth a series of tasks including the issue of taking measures to supply vehicles and equipment for various purposes necessary for the management of the railway station and the issue of composing and operating trains for the exclusive use of tourists.
Then ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the newly-built first-aid post in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area.
He went round various places of the first-aid post, including emergency room, operating room, observation room and examination room, and learned about its construction.
He said it is important to build up the ranks of medical workers of the first-aid post and improve the quality of medical service.
Pointing to some shortcomings revealed in the arrangement and design of elements inside the facility, ComradeKim Jong Unrepeatedly stressed that it is important to establish a system for properly drawing up the technical assignments, a prerequisite process and basis for the construction project, and that in order to optimize the design and improve the functionality and specialization of the facility, it is necessary to thoroughly apply the Party's requirement for strengthening the tripartite consultation among the designing, construction and operation units in the deliberation of designs and construction.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid it is essential to further raise the specialized level of design, strengthen the political guidance so that all the processes of construction including design, deliberation, consultation and budgeting are strictly conducted according to scientific and legal procedures under the construction law, and direct greater efforts to improving the practical qualifications of designers since modern hospitals are be continuously built in 20 cities and counties every year.
ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the tasks for operation and medical service of the first-aid post, including enough supply of first-aid medicines and consumables necessary for the efficient and normal operation of various equipment. -0-

headline: Measures to Minimize Damage by Disastrous Abnormal Weather in Nampho Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality in the DPRK is taking technical and practical measures to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
Agricultural workers in Onchon County are restoring 100-odd pumping stations and conducting management of rice-paddy irrigation in a responsible manner while manuring and cultivating paddy rice in a scientific and technological way.
Farms in Chollima District are spraying growth promoters and bioactivators to provide favorable conditions for the growth of paddy rice.
After grasping the danger-prone spots of tideland farms, the municipality mobilized mechanical means to finish the reinforcement project of the embankment No. 2 of the Kumsong Tideland with over 10 000 cubic meters of stones.
Ryonggang County and Kangso District finished dredging rivers, reinforcing the embankment, and the Onchon Anti-tidal Dyke Station is repairing embankment by introducing efficient working methods.
Taean, Hanggu and Waudo districts are conducting the anti-land-sliding projects in a massive way to protect the farmland from being washed away by floods and landslides. -0-

headline: Great Love Shown to Workers of Nampho Shipyard
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 26 (KCNA) -- The trust and love of the motherly Workers' Party of Korea are endless as it glorifies the devoted efforts of ordinary working people for the sacred patriotic cause of consolidating the national power of the DPRK.
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unshowed another warm love to the workers of Nampho Shipyard who made a contribution to the building of a powerful naval combat system unprecedented in the history of our army by building a destroyer.
He personally attended the commissioning ceremony of the destroyer Choe Hyon and extended warm gratitude to the workers of the shipyard who contributed to the building of the warship. And he sent gifts to them as a token of his affection for them on the occasion of its founding anniversary.
All the workers, technicians and officials of the shipyard were deeply impressed by the benevolence of the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who has dedicated himself to the rapid growth of our naval forces and showed the credit for all the successes in the course to them.
The officials and employees of the shipyard extended their deep gratitude to the respected General Secretary for highly appreciating their efforts and bestowing all kinds of love on them.
They spent a significant day with high pride and joy of having the splendid commissioning ceremony of the destroyer in the presence of ComradeKim Jong Unto be specially recorded in the history of our Navy.
All the workers, technicians and officials of the Nampho Shipyard were full of the strong will to make a positive contribution to building up the naval combat power by building powerful warships of our own style in larger numbers with boundless loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm, bearing in mind the great love and trust of the Party Central Committee as the driving force for performing miracles. -0-

headline: Many Units in Pyongyang Win Three-Revolution Red Flag and Honored Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Working people in Pyongyang Municipality of the DPRK have made successes by putting spurs to carrying out the three revolutions, ideological, technical and cultural.
47 units in the municipality have won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag (including Twice and Thrice) in the first half of the year through the mass movement.
The Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement was launched by many units, including the ones of education, public health and commerce. As a result, more units won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag (including twice and thrice) than the same period of last year.
Through the movement, those units gave fuller play to the spirit of fresh innovation, bold creation and steady advance, and a radical turn was brought about in the work of regions and units.
The municipality is now carrying on the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement more vigorously as required by the era of comprehensive development of socialism. -0-

headline: Contests of Lathe Operators and Pipe-makers Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Contests of lathe operators and pipe-makers were held as part of the Contest of Skilled Workers with Different Jobs in Various Sectors of National Economy-2026 at the Kumsong Tractor Factory in the DPRK from June 10 to 25.
The contests assessed the basic theoretical knowledge, workload and quality of products. They brought together tens of skilled workers selected from ministries and national agencies, including the Ministry of Railways and the Ministry of Machine-building Industry, and Pyongyang Municipality and provincial people's committees.
The participants ensured at a high level the quality indices for processing parts and sheet metal products needed for the production of tractors and tillers while displaying their skills they have improved through the vigorous campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them.
The standings were announced on June 26 and the excellent skilled workers were awarded trophies and medals and diplomas in the name of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea. And the prizes were awarded. -0-

headline: Nampho Municipality Repairs Tide-water Control Dyke
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, Nampho Municipality in the DPRK finished repairing tide-water control dyke in Onchon County.
After investigating the actual condition of the tide-water control dykes in Onchon County, the municipality established a scientific plan to prevent damage by tidal wave and typhoon and put spurs to its implementation.
Thanks to the high enthusiasm of the working people who turned out in the project, the tide-water control dykes in the county were firmly reinforced to prevent damage by tidal wave and typhoon. -0-

headline: Many Youths in DPRK Volunteer to Work at Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- More than 100 young people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK volunteered to work at major worksites of socialist construction.
Dozens of young people in Sunchon, Kaechon and Tokchon cities and Pukchang and Mundok counties volunteered to work at coal mines in the province.
Youth league members in Anju City and Hoechang, Jungsan and Unsan counties advanced into construction brigades and raw materials base stations with a resolve to usher in a new era in which local areas are prospering and face-lifted.
Young people in Songchon, Yangdok and Sinyang counties petitioned to work at workteams for maintaining roads over mountains and forestry management stations.
A meeting was held in Phyongsong City on June 26 to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were officials concerned, officials of the youth league, volunteers and youth and students in the city. Petition certificates were awarded to the volunteers and a congratulatory speech and speeches were made.
Officials in the province and working people in the city warmly saw off the volunteers leaving for worksites of socialist construction. -0-

headline: Many Units in Pyongyang Win Three-Revolution Red Flag and Honored Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Working people in Pyongyang Municipality of the DPRK have made successes by putting spurs to carrying out the three revolutions, ideological, technical and cultural.
47 units in the municipality have won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag (including Twice and Thrice) in the first half of the year through the mass movement.
The Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement was launched by many units, including the ones of education, public health and commerce. As a result, more units won the Three-Revolution Red Flag and the Honored Red Flag (including twice and thrice) than the same period of last year.
Through the movement, those units gave fuller play to the spirit of fresh innovation, bold creation and steady advance, and a radical turn was brought about in the work of regions and units.
The municipality is now carrying on the Three-Revolution Red Flag Movement more vigorously as required by the era of comprehensive development of socialism. -0-

headline: Commemorative Events Held in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Events took place in Russia between June 11 and 24 to mark the second anniversary of the historic DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit and the conclusion of the Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation.
Present there were personages of the government, parliament, political parties, organizations and institutions of Russia and members of the DPRK mission in Russia.
Speeches were made at the events.
At the seminar participated by personages of the Russian Foreign Ministry, Academy of Sciences of Russia, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the Russian Group for International Solidarity with the DPRK, speakers said that Russia would always remember the DPRK's strong support to Russia in its most difficult period and that the DPRK set a living example in implementing the treaty in practice, not in words, adding that no outside forces' obstructive moves can undermine the Russia-DPRK friendship.
Personages of the Khabarovsk Territorial Branch of the United Russia Party and the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation referred to the significance of the DPRK-Russia Pyongyang summit, the historic position of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the DPRK and Russia and the successes made in the development of the relations between the two countries over the past two years.
Personages of the Ministry of Culture of the Khabarovsk Territorial Government and the legislative assembly of Khabarovsk Territory and the representative of the Foreign Ministry in Khabarovsk said at an opening ceremony of the DPRK book, photo and art and handicrafts exhibition that the Russia-DPRK alliance forged with the joint struggle against Japanese militarism as a start serves as the cornerstone for stability in the Asia-Pacific region and that the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership is an important foundation for the development of the relations between the two countries.
The chairperson of the Maritime Territorial Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity" and the chairperson of the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the conclusion of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership is an event of very important significance in the history of friendly relations between the two countries and that the conclusion of the treaty helped strengthen the Russia-DPRK relations into a solid alliance.
Personages of political and social circles of the Republic of Buryatia said that the combatants of the DPRK armed forces regarded the territory of Russia as the territory of their country and fought with the Russian soldiers in the same trench to liberate the Kursk area from the neo-Nazi forces, adding that this is attributable to the leaders of the two countries who signed the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership and put the Russia-DPRK friendly relations on a firm legal basis.
Congratulatory messages to the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the events. -0-

headline: New Regional-industry Factories Exchange Technology and Swap Experiences
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 27 (KCNA) -- Campaigns in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them are under way among the newly-built modern regional-industry factories in 40 cities and counties.
The new regional-industry factories in Kim Hyong Jik and Kim Jong Suk counties, Ryanggang Province, intensifies technology exchange over various issues including the development of special products, improvement of the quality of condiments and reduction of the cost of daily necessities production.
Kusong City, Kujang, Unsan, Yomju and Taegwan counties in North Phyongan Province are conducting the work to share or transfer the advanced technology among the new regional-industry factories in a planned way.
The new regional-industry factories in Unpha, Yonthan, Koksan and Hwangju counties in North Hwanghae Province exchanged technology and swapped experiences with the exhibition of consumer goods as an occasion.
This year, officials of the relevant sectors in Onchon County, Nampho Municipality visited a county in South Hamgyong Province where the new regional-industry factories were built and exchanged views on the management and activities of enterprises. -0-

headline: Warm Encouragement to Pioneers of Revolution in Warship-building Industry in New Era and Performers of Labor Feats
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK extends warm congratulations to the workers of the Nampho Shipyard who made a great contribution to strengthening the Juche-oriented naval forces by building a powerful destroyer of our own style.
Officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea visited the Nampho Shipyard and conveyed letters and aid materials to encourage its workers.
They in their letters congratulated and encouraged the officials, workers and technicians of the shipyard who are making steady progress and innovations again after putting the first destroyer of a new generation into commission for the navy, true to the grand strategic plan of the WPK.
Providing aid materials, they asked the workers and technicians of the shipyard to further boost the spirit of unconditionally carrying out the Party decisions and the spirit of self-reliance displayed by them in the days of building the destroyer and thus build more modern warships.
They stressed that the heroic struggle of the workers of the Nampho Shipyard would give further momentum to the all-people grand advance in a new stage.
Commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence extended militant greetings to the workers of the Nampho Shipyard who are upholding the Party Central Committee's plan for building an advanced maritime power with their boundless patriotic loyalty and unconditioned practice. And they told them that all the officers and men are firmly determined to more reliably defend the territorial waters, airspace and territory of the country, mindful of the intention of the workers.
Officials of the Party and power organs, working people from all walks of life and youth and schoolchildren in Pyongyang, too, expressed their excited feelings in their letters.
In the letters, they expressed their resolve to further intensify a new patriotic drive for increased production, saying that the successes made by the workers of the shipyard greatly encourage all the people across the country striving to implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Encouraged by the warm sincerity of officials of the Party Central Committee, commanding officers of the Korean People's Army and citizens of the capital city, the workers of the Nampho Shipyard are full of the strong will to build more powerful warships during the period of attaining the new long-term goals with redoubled efforts and fighting spirit and thus make a tangible contribution to realizing the cause of the Party Central Committee for building a rich country with a strong army. -0-

headline: Military Miracles Performed during Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- The Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) was a war in which the DPRK (founded on September 9, 1948) honorably defended its freedom and independence of the country from the aggression of the imperialist allied forces headed by the U.S. imperialists.
The war, which can be called a confrontation between a rifle and A-bomb, witnessed military miracles unprecedented in the history of world wars thanks to the outstanding military ideas, Juche-oriented war tactics and superb strategy and tactics of PresidentKim Il Sung.

Liberation of Seoul, the Stronghold of the Enemy, in Just Three Days through Immediate Counterattack

The fate of the war depends on how to cope with the sudden large-scale aggression of the enemy.
The history of world wars records those countries which suffered repeated defeats as they failed to respond to the enemies' aggression in time even though they had strong military muscle.
No one had imagined that the Korean People's Army, which was just two years old, would launch an immediate and decisive counterattack and general offensive all over the front against the enemy's sudden invasion.
It was a bold decision that could be made only by PresidentKim Il Sungpossessed of military wisdom and extraordinary commanding art.
On June 25, 1950, the first day of the war, he convened an emergency meeting of the Cabinet and ordered to launch a decisive counterattack to wipe out the invaders. He gave instructions to deal a fatal blow at the enemies in the area of the 38th parallel and Seoul where the main group of the enemy is concentrated with the strongest density of firepower, regarding it as the main point of counterattack.
According to the strategic measures and operational policies of the President, the units of the People's Army rapidly expanded their combat successes throughout the front, concentrating their main forces on the operation for liberating Seoul.
Over the fact that the KPA repulsed the armed invasion of the enemy within a few hours through an immediate counterattack, the world admired that it was a miracle unprecedented in the history of world wars.
The tide of the war was turned in a moment and the DPRK's victory became certain from the beginning.
The enemies who lost Seoul lamented that their defeat was not just a defeat but a collapse.
The victory in the operation for liberating Seoul, the fruition of the President's correct choice of the main strike direction and his extraordinary military art and Juche-oriented strategy and tactics on concentration of forces and equipment and combination of large units' operation and small units' operation, is proudly recorded on the first page of the history of the Fatherland Liberation War. -0-

headline: Proactive Efforts Made to Train Reserve Teachers
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- Teacher-training universities and colleges in the DPRK are making proactive efforts to train qualified teachers.
Sariwon Ri Kye Sun University of Education and Sariwon Teachers Training College have created and introduced the research-type teaching and studying methods to improve the creative thinking faculty and application ability of students by putting the educational contents on a more concrete, diversified and practical basis.
Kanggye University of Education introduced new foreign language teaching methods. And it invented and made apparatuses for experiment and practice conducive to improving practical abilities.
Phyongsong University of Education has ensured that new teachers are well versed in the educational contents and teaching methods under the new educational programme.
Now that the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme is being enforced, teachers of Chongjin O Jung Hup University of Education has incorporated relevant educational contents into the curriculum and taught the students effectively, speeding up the production of necessary teaching aids and educational aid programs.
Wonsan Ri Su Dok Teachers Training College turned some places into foreign language study halls and made and applied modern experimental apparatuses to train competent teachers.
Teachers at Hamhung Choe Hui Suk Teachers Training College are devoting their wisdom and enthusiasm to teaching and education. -0-

headline: Art Pieces for Class Education Created
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- This year, artists in the DPRK have created lots of art works showing the brutal nature of the U.S. and Japanese imperialists and class enemies and their atrocities.
Oil painting "Land of Wrath" depicts an endless stream of avengers coming to Sinchon, a synonym for the untold sufferings and sorrow recorded in the history of the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War and the bitter lesson we must always remember.
Korean painting "Lessons of Blood" and others remind people of the lesson that the nature of the class enemies, who committed unimaginable atrocities as the stooges of the aggressors, can never change even after the passage of many years and replacement of generations.
Oil paintings such as "Group of Burglars" clearly show the craftiness, viciousness and cruelty of the Japanese imperialists who occupied Korea and robbed it of human and material resources. And they tell the truth that people will be doomed to bitter fate if they have no strength to defend themselves.
Looking at those art pieces, officials, working people and youth and students from across the country have hardened their will to bring about leaps forward and innovations in their workplaces and posts for the strengthening of the country's national power, always mindful that the U.S. imperialists and other hostile forces are still getting hell-bent on the war drills for aggression on the DPRK. -0-

headline: Enthusiasm for Volunteering for Army Displayed in 1950s
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people from all walks of life turned out as one in the sacred Fatherland Liberation War to defeat the provokers who invaded the country. It was clearly evidenced by their great enthusiasm for volunteering for the army.
Young students and working people volunteered for the army, in response to the historic radio speech"Go All Out for Victory in the War"made by PresidentKim Il Sungon June 26, 1950.
Most of the students vowed to join in the army just three or four days after the outbreak of the war. Among them were more than 2 800 students ofKim Il SungUniversity and 500 students of Pyongyang College of Technology (then).
Workers of the then Pyongyang Railway Factory, the Sadong Briquette Factory and many other factories and enterprises pledged to go to the front at the meetings of the employees. Workers in the industrial districts organized workers' regiments and went to the front.
Peasants who became masters of the land after the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945), held meetings of activists and volunteered to go to the front. Intellectuals in the fields of science, education, culture, art and public health joined the ranks of volunteering for the army.
KCNA on July 1, 1950 reported that a large number of working youths including men and women students fromKim Il SungUniversity and other universities and colleges and senior middle schools petitioned to join in the army. The number of young patriots who volunteered to go to the front has already reached 81 858.
Rodong Sinmun on July 15, 1950 said that young people were volunteering to go to the front with burning patriotism. The number of young people who volunteered for the army exceeds 740 000 and of them, the number of women youths are 230 000.
The enthusiasm of volunteering for the army that swept the whole country more than 70 years ago was a manifestation of the Korean people's ardent will to disallow the aggressors to occupy their country which was the only cradle of life liberated by the President again.
The transparent spirit of defending the country displayed by the wartime generation in the 1950s is still carried forward as the proud tradition of our Republic. -0-

headline: 37th Regular General Meeting of Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- The 37th Regular General Meeting of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan was held in Tokyo of Japan on June 20.
Present there were First Vice-Chairman Pak Ku Ho and Vice-Chairman and Director of the Economic Department Hyon Tae Sik of the Central Standing Committee of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) and delegates of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
The chairman of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan made an opening address to be followed by a report.
The reporter noted that the federation has made valuable successes in the past two years by protecting and revitalizing the compatriots' enterprises and dynamically conducting the overall work under the trust and loving care of the respected MarshalKim Jong Un.
The federation is faced with the task of creditably carrying forward the spirit and tradition of the founder generation as instructed by the respected MarshalKim Jong Unand thus developing itself into a body based on the compatriots-first idea, the reporter said, stressing the need for the federation to thoroughly carry out the decisions of the 26th Congress of Chongryon and fulfill its duty as the main force in the work for development of the patriotic movement and the prosperity of the homeland.
Then speeches were made.
Song Won Jin was elected chairman of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan.
Pak Ku Ho made a concluding speech.
He recalled that PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilhighly praised the Korean businessmen as progressive and patriotic ones and showed special love and trust in them and that the respected MarshalKim Jong Uninvariably puts forward them as the main force of the movement of Koreans in Japan.
Telling about the proud history of the federation spanning 80 years, he called upon the businessmen to continue to dynamically advance, closely united as one in keeping with the requirement of the new fighting period of Chongryon.
After the meeting, there was an enlarged meeting of the First Session of the 37th Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan.
Meanwhile, events took place in Tokyo on the same day to mark the 80th anniversary of the formation of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan. Present at the events was Ho Jong Man, chairman of the Chongryon Central Standing Committee. -0-

headline: Young People in Pyongyang Volunteer for Service at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 28 (KCNA) -- Tens of youths in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, have volunteered to advance into major worksites of socialist construction.
Young people in Kangdong County vowed to work at the county construction brigade.
Youth league members in the districts of Songyo and Ryongsong decided to work at the Kangdong Greenhouse Complex.
Youths in Taesong and Sunan districts decided to work at a water supply and sewerage management station and an irrigation management station.
A meeting was held on June 26 to congratulate the volunteers. Present there were officials concerned, youth league officials and youth and students.
Petition certificates were awarded to the volunteers and a congratulatory address and speeches were made.
Youth and students presented bouquets of flowers to the volunteers leaving for the worksites to implement the Party's decisions, and saw them off. -0-

headline: Project for Expanding Grain Drying Capacity Planned for This Year in Field of Grain Management
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, another good result was achieved in the field of grain management in the DPRK.
The new grain drying process planned for this year was built at 20-odd city and county grain management stations and dozens of grain intermediate storehouses across the country till June 12, and thus the foundation for supplying quality grain to the people was further consolidated.
Now, cities and counties are pushing ahead with the work to store and process grain in good time. -0-

headline: Video Game Room at Mangyongdae Amusement Park
story_text:
One day in October 2012, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwent round a video game room at the finely-remodeled Mangyongdae Amusement Park.
Saying with pleasure that the room has lots of various electronic recreation apparatuses, he turned his eyes to a car-playing apparatus.
At that time, a service worker was playing the game there. With a mind to give a pleasure to the respected General Secretary, the service worker tried to smoothly run the apparatus but the driving skill was not so good perhaps for the lack of understanding or uneasiness.
Looking at the worker's gesture, the General Secretary said that the service worker seemed not to get a "driving license".
A pleasant laugh broke out in the room.
His humorous words came to be kept in the mind of officials as a meaning that one should be well versed in one's own job and in one's own unit work to act as a faithful servant for the people. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Reckless Acts of Japan, Defeated Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- Japan's moves to turn itself into a military giant are getting evermore undisguised. Against this backdrop, it launched frenzied drill Resolute Dragon in the archipelago in collusion with the U.S.
The annual drill Resolute Dragon is a war rehearsal simulating an actual war, which started from 2021 under the signboard of "improving the U.S.-Japan joint capability to counter the threat of aggression" by someone, non-existent. Japan has steadily increased its capability to launch an act of aggression through the drill.
In the last year's drill alone, Japan increased the number of the "Self-Defense Forces" by ten times as compared with the first drill in which some 1 400 forces were involved, and greatly expanded the facilities used for the drill.
Moreover, the SDF's role was remarkably enhanced in training for reconnaissance, the primary stage in preemptive attack on opponents.
This year's drill is also being thoroughly subordinated to reconfirming the operational capability of the war machine called Japan and hastening the moment of actual war.
V-22 Osprey cargo planes of the Ground "SDF" are using the U.S. military base in Okinawa Prefecture for the first time and increasing the capability to rapidly transport aggression forces anywhere in the archipelago. And furthermore the drill includes a drone training aimed to draw on the experience of the Ukrainian battlefields and master new combat methods in modern warfare.
This fully proves the aggressive and offensive nature of the Resolute Dragon.
What matters is that recently Japan has further promoted military ties with the U.S., aggravating the situation in the surrounding region.
In February, Japan repeatedly staged joint air drills with the U.S. in the sky above the surroundings of the Korean peninsula with the mobilization of F-2 and F-15 fighters. And subsequently it conducted the joint drill Iron Fist with the U.S. Marines in its mainland.
Especially, Japan dispatched the "SDF" troops to take an active part in the U.S.-led multinational military drill in the Asia-Pacific region between April and May for the first time.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan, which had participated in the military drill as an observer until last year, not only hurled war forces this year but also openly launched long-range strike means developed for preemptive attack on neighboring countries during the drill.
Clear is Japan's purpose of deepening military integration with the U.S. It is the real intention of the Japanese militarists to justify Japan's transformation into a war state and become the "leader of Asia" at an early date by taking advantage of the present chaotic international situation created by their master's rogue act intended to contain the enemy countries and rival states in the region and realize its ambition for hegemony.
Originally, it is Japan's inveterate bad habit to attain its aggressive purpose with the backing of a big country.
It is obvious that if the defeated country of Asia, closely watched by the international community, completes all preparations for the operation of war machine for overseas aggression under the active backing of the U.S., it will surely create a grave crisis threatening peace and stability 1n the Korean peninsula and the region.
However, Japan should not act rashly, mindful that its rush to mount a reinvasion while serving the world's biggest war merchant will only bring a miserable end. -0-

headline: Big Efforts Paid to Gradual Development of Fisheries
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Ministry of Fisheries of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the work for the gradual qualitative development of the fisheries.
The ministry has ensured that the fishing stations on the east coast conduct the intensive fishing campaign for migratory fish by reducing the period of repair of fishing boats and making good preparations for fishing implements, and that fishing boats on the west coast go to the Cho Islet-Monggumpho fishing zones to wage mobile fishing operations.
The Mundok Fishery Station built high-performance fishing boats and seven fishing stations including the Kim Chaek Fishery Station turned 12 fishing boats into all-purpose fishing boats in the first quarter of the year.
The ministry has also made fish farming and pedigree units increase the production of fry and stock rivers, lakes and reservoirs with them.
Meanwhile, it has urged the fishery production units on the east coast to push ahead with the preparations for increasing the area of mussel cultivation, and the aquaculture production units put the cultivation and management of aquaculture on a scientific basis and increase the productivity per ship.
The ministry is pushing ahead with the remodeling project of the Soho Fishery Station, the overhaul repair of breakwater at the Kim Chaek Fishery Station and the construction of the seaweed combined processing plant at the Pupho Offshore Farm. -0-

headline: Big Role of Sinuiju Textile Mill in Development of Light Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- The fighting spirit of the workers of the Sinuiju Textile Mill in the northwestern part of the DPRK is growing stronger. The factory plays a big role in the development of light industry.
The factory has produced more than 10 workers who fulfilled their national economic plans for the full year this year. It has developed new suit fabric, printed fabric, waterproof fabric, Lyocell shirting fabric and antibiosis shoe fabric and expanded and introduced the successes.
The factory also carries the traces of devotion of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is devoting all his efforts to the development of light industry of the country.
On June 30, 2018, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the mill and said that radically developing the textile industry is of great significance in making a breakthrough in improving the people's living standards, indicating the tasks and ways for modernizing the mill as required by the present era.
That day, the respected Comrade General Secretary said that he would build a good hostel at the factory, personally chose the site of the hostel and took measures to mobilize powerful construction forces.
The factory has stepped up the reconstruction and modernization project by relying on its own efforts and technical forces for remodeling shuttle looms into air looms to improve the productivity four times and install dozens of spinning equipment and dyeing equipment.
It has turned the technical innovation movement into the work of the masses themselves to introduce valuable inventions and push ahead with the upgrading of the performance of equipment and technical upgrading, thus fulfilling the cloth production plan on all indices every year. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Reckless Acts of Japan, Defeated Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- Japan's moves to turn itself into a military giant are getting evermore undisguised. Against this backdrop, it launched frenzied drill Resolute Dragon in the archipelago in collusion with the U.S.
The annual drill Resolute Dragon is a war rehearsal simulating an actual war, which started from 2021 under the signboard of "improving the U.S.-Japan joint capability to counter the threat of aggression" by someone, non-existent. Japan has steadily increased its capability to launch an act of aggression through the drill.
In the last year's drill alone, Japan increased the number of the "Self-Defense Forces" by ten times as compared with the first drill in which some 1 400 forces were involved, and greatly expanded the facilities used for the drill.
Moreover, the SDF's role was remarkably enhanced in training for reconnaissance, the primary stage in preemptive attack on opponents.
This year's drill is also being thoroughly subordinated to reconfirming the operational capability of the war machine called Japan and hastening the moment of actual war.
V-22 Osprey cargo planes of the Ground "SDF" are using the U.S. military base in Okinawa Prefecture for the first time and increasing the capability to rapidly transport aggression forces anywhere in the archipelago. And furthermore the drill includes a drone training aimed to draw on the experience of the Ukrainian battlefields and master new combat methods in modern warfare.
This fully proves the aggressive and offensive nature of the Resolute Dragon.
What matters is that recently Japan has further promoted military ties with the U.S., aggravating the situation in the surrounding region.
In February, Japan repeatedly staged joint air drills with the U.S. in the sky above the surroundings of the Korean peninsula with the mobilization of F-2 and F-15 fighters. And subsequently it conducted the joint drill Iron Fist with the U.S. Marines in its mainland.
Especially, Japan dispatched the "SDF" troops to take an active part in the U.S.-led multinational military drill in the Asia-Pacific region between April and May for the first time.
What should not be overlooked is that Japan, which had participated in the military drill as an observer until last year, not only hurled war forces this year but also openly launched long-range strike means developed for preemptive attack on neighboring countries during the drill.
Clear is Japan's purpose of deepening military integration with the U.S. It is the real intention of the Japanese militarists to justify Japan's transformation into a war state and become the "leader of Asia" at an early date by taking advantage of the present chaotic international situation created by their master's rogue act intended to contain the enemy countries and rival states in the region and realize its ambition for hegemony.
Originally, it is Japan's inveterate bad habit to attain its aggressive purpose with the backing of a big country.
It is obvious that if the defeated country of Asia, closely watched by the international community, completes all preparations for the operation of war machine for overseas aggression under the active backing of the U.S., it will surely create a grave crisis threatening peace and stability 1n the Korean peninsula and the region.
However, Japan should not act rashly, mindful that its rush to mount a reinvasion while serving the world's biggest war merchant will only bring a miserable end. -0-

headline: Steps Taken to Cope with Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 29 (KCNA) -- Kangwon Province of the DPRK strives to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
The province has ensured the repair of houses and public buildings in a responsible manner while taking steps to boost the passing capacity of rain-water and sewage networks and prevent feeder pillars and roadside trees from falling by strong winds.
It has consolidated embankments and dredged rivers in the flood-prone sections by raising the operation rate of hydraulic excavators, trucks, etc.
Meanwhile, it has carried on the project to repair the irrigation structures and perfect the drainage system so as to protect farmlands from heavy rain, flood and typhoon, concentrating efforts on minimizing the damage of crops.
Hydroelectric power stations in the province have paid attention to grasping the pondage and variation of water level and protecting the hydraulic structures and equipment from strong winds and heavy rain.
The coastal areas are stepping up the project to repair or reinforce dykes and breakwaters. -0-

headline: Kalun Meeting
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- The Kalun Meeting held more than 90 years ago under the guidance of PresidentKim Il Sungis recorded in the history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle as one in which the Juche idea was founded and the path of the Korean revolution illuminated.
PresidentKim Il Sung, who embarked on the road of revolution to save the country and the people, formulated the Juche-oriented stand and line on the Korean revolution one by one with ceaseless thinking.
On this basis, the President convened a meeting of leading personnel of the young communist league and the anti-imperialist youth league in Kalun from June 30 to July 2, 1930, and made a historic report "The Path of the Korean Revolution."
In his report, the President clarified the stand that the Korean people are the masters of the Korean revolution and the Korean revolution should be made by the Korean people themselves in conformity with the actual conditions of the country. This was a great declaration that proclaimed the founding of the Juche idea shining as the great guiding ideology in the era of independence.
The character and duty of the Korean revolution, the line of the anti-Japanese armed struggle and the policy of founding the party set forth at the meeting serve as the core of the Juche idea.
Thanks to the banner of Juche upheld by the President in Kalun, the Korean revolution could demonstrate only the ever-victorious proud history generation after generation with its original independent line, strategy and tactics. -0-

headline: Feats of Heroes of Republic Shinning in History of Great War Victory
story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- During the Fatherland Liberation War, the brave soldiers of the People's Army displayed matchless bravery and mass heroism from the first day of the war.
A decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK on enacting the title of Hero of the Republic was issued on June 30, 1950, under the great benevolence of PresidentKim Il Sungto add eternal shine to the feats of the soldiers of the People's Army.
After the lapse of a half month the title was awarded to more than 10 persons including officers of the Second Torpedo Boat Squadron who sank the U.S. imperialists' heavy cruiser Baltimore and destroyed a light cruiser with four torpedo boats, pilots who shot down the U.S. imperialists' bombers B-29 described as a "flying fortress" and tankmen who performed distinguished military feats in the battle for liberating Seoul.
Among the heroes are an 18-year-old soldier who dedicated his youth and life to the motherland without hesitation, a nurse who destroyed the enemy tank with a bunch of grenades and a driver who reliably transported munitions to the front.
The feats of many heroes including the coast artillerymen who defeated the enemy's huge forces for three days with only four artillery pieces in the battle for defending the Wolmi Islet are shining in the history of the great war victory.
The title of Twice Hero of the Republic was awarded to teen-aged aircraft-hunter team member who shot down more than 10 enemy fighters with heavy machine gun, an assault team member who destroyed three enemy tanks and opened up a road of advance by blocking an enemy's gun muzzle with his breast and scouts who contributed to the unit's victory in a battle through bold and skilful reconnaissance activities.
More than 600 heroes were produced in the three years of the war and five of them were twice heroes of the Republic. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, June 30 (KCNA) -- During the Fatherland Liberation War, the myth of the U.S. imperialists' "mightiness" was shattered not only on the ground and in the sea but also in the air.

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 1 (KCNA) -- As for the Japanese imperialists' experiment on human bodies, all Koreans think first of the notorious Unit 731.
The Japanese imperialists, who regarded poisonous gas and germ weapons with high killing rate as the main secret of "victory in the war," organized units for their research and production and conducted the experiment on human bodies to verify their effectiveness. Among the units is the Unit 731.
The main objects of experiment on human bodies were most of the Koreans who were arrested during the anti-Japanese struggle.
In the Unit 731 the Japanese imperialist beasts threw living persons into an airtight room made with special bullet-proof glass, filled it with poison gas, photographed the persons wriggling in a pain, and watched them dying. They committed all sorts of thrice-cursed crimes to find out what does the thing happen if a person was put in the rapidly rotating centrifuge and how much blood could be drawn from one person.
In addition, bacteria were injected into healthy person to get infectious diseases, frostbite experiment was conducted, and then they killed the said persons by wielding flame throwers.
The Unit 731 frequently committed atrocities to dissect living person in order to obtain a sample from the infected person.
The book published in Japan says that at least 1 000 people were dissected in 1945, the year when the Japanese imperialists were defeated.
The Japanese imperialists sent specimens of human bodies made by cutting the heads and limbs of Koreans and pulling out their internal organs to the military medical college of their home country, and buried them in the ground to conceal the traces of their crimes when their defeat was imminent.
In July 2006, the Japanese Asahi Shimbun carried an article dealing with the discovery of human bones at the seat of the military medical college of the Imperial Japanese Army in Shinjuku. It revealed that there was a possibility that bones for more people were buried around the seat of the military medical college in the Imperial Japanese army, where bones for more than 100 persons were found 17 years ago.
All facts prove that the Japanese imperialists are a group of hideous human butchers and brutal and ferocious beasts. -0-

headline: Folk Customs of DPRK Seen in July
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 1 (KCNA) -- In July there are Soso and Taeso, ones of the 24 seasonal divisions of the year in the lunar calendar, in the DPRK.
Soso falls early in the sixth lunar month and on July 6-8 of the solar calendar when the summer heat begins. Taeso falls late in the sixth lunar month and on July 22-23 of the solar calendar when the summer heat is at its height.
Soso and Taeso fall on July 7 and July 23 this year.
By the time of Soso and Teaso, all kinds of cereals and fruits grow well. Therefore, it is necessary to properly weed for crops in the season to yield good harvest in farming.
In July, there are the first and second periods of the midsummer heat in the country called Chobok and Jungbok.
Chobok and Jungbok fall on July 15 and July 25 respectively.
From olden times the Korean people have made various kinds of food in the hottest period of summer.
The dishes in the period include tangogi soup, chicken soup boiled with ginseng and adzuki-bean gruel.
In particular, tangogi soup stimulates the appetite and supplements nutrition to weakened body in hot summer.
The favorite folk game in July is Koni game. -0-

headline: Destroyer Kang Kon Has Performance Test of Its Weapon Systems
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- The destroyer Kang Kon on Friday conducted a test-fire of strategic cruise missile and a test of major weapon systems such as naval artillery, automatic machine guns and electronic warfare means under its plan to assess and test the performance of its combat systems.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the tests.
Among the spectators were Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Pak Jong Chon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defence, Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the Navy, Kim Yong Hwan, president of the Academy of Defence Sciences, and Kim Kwang Il, minister of Shipbuilding, and other leading officials in the field of national defence and shipbuilding industries.
The relevant tests are part of a process for examining and confirming the ability to apply various kinds of weapon systems on board the destroyer in combat.
Prior to the tests, ComradeKim Jong Unheard from members of the weapon systems assessment group detailed reports on the stepwise plan to examine and test the performance of weapon systems on board the warship.
Then there took place the inspection of the warship's target-detecting and information-processing capability and combined firepower system and the test-fires aimed to assess the performance of warship artillery and automatic machine guns in accordance with the plan to assess and test the performance of weapon systems.
They were followed by the launch of a strategic cruise missile from the destroyer.
Noting that the combat power and creditability of anti-warship, anti-submarine and anti-aircraft weapon systems and strategic offensive weapon systems on board the destroyer Kang Kon are being verified in a responsible manner, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that it is enough to have confidence in potential for the development of naval combat system of our own style in view of the recent trend of development of our weapon systems and this provides the great possibility to bring on a change in the readiness posture of our army's strategic action.
He clarified the tasks to be carried out by stages in developing various surface and underwater combat systems and deploying them in the waters for military action under the crucial strategic idea of our Party for national defence.
Noting that it is necessary for us to further speed up the projects to maintain and steadily expand the reliable war deterrent and capability to fight a war, he affirmed that we will demonstrate through more obvious actions our political will and determination to have an absolute power.
Recalling the fact that the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK adopted a decision to build naval fleet bases into a hub of naval command, culture and combat capability and expand the capacity of the shipyards at all levels, he expressed his determination to take national steps to build up our Navy which plays an important role in defending the maritime sovereignty of the country and exercising the war deterrent.
He encouraged the warship and weapon system institutes to achieve greater success in their efforts to implement the Party Central Committee's idea and line of building a powerful army, deeply mindful of their historic mission.
He gave an instruction to complete the trial process of the destroyer in a responsible manner and commission it for the Navy within two months.
That day he convened an important consultative meeting for the development of the warship building industry. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnGives Field Guidance at Construction Projects for Regional Development Policy in Ragwon County
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 5 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the construction projects for the regional development policy in Ragwon County of South Hamgyong Province on July 3.
He was accompanied by leading officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and the Ministry of National Defence and officials of the designing organs.
This year, modern regional-industry factories, an advanced public health facility and a multi-functional leisure complex, which will contribute to the development of the regional economy and the promotion of the inhabitants' health and their material and cultural life, are being built in Ragwon County, which is undergoing a radical change into the fairyland like its name along with the new era of regional change opened up by the Party, under the third year's plan for implementing the regional development policy.
The construction of regional-industry factories, hospital and leisure complex in Ragwon County is now progressing at 67.5 percent, 47 percent and 54 percent of the total construction projects respectively, thanks to the soldier-builders who are leaving traces of worthwhile creation and feats day by day to uphold the cherished desire of the Party Central Committee with honorable fruits of patriotic devotion and efforts.
First, ComradeKim Jong Ungave field guidance at the construction sites of regional-industry factories in Sepho-ri, Ragwon County.
He was greeted on the spot by Ri Jong Nam, chief secretary of the South Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the WPK, and commanding officers of the construction units involved in the construction projects for the regional development policy in Ragwon County.
He went round foodstuff factory, daily necessities factory and garment factory under construction to learn in detail about the construction.
Praising the fact that the quality of construction for all the architectural spaces and elements is being ensured on a high level, he said with great satisfaction that the specialization and technical equipment level of construction units have been certainly improved to a higher stage as compared with last year and the environment around the construction site arranged in a clean way.
Saying that the construction quality and speed have been improved in the overall construction projects for the regional development policy as a result of the sustained efforts made to increase the proportion of mechanization in construction and strengthen the ranks of skilled workers, ComradeKim Jong Unstressed the need to continue to reinforce construction equipment and, at the same time, make effective judgment on technical skill rating for the builders and properly evaluate according to them.
Enjoying a bird's-eye view of the area of Sepho-ri showing the traction and vitality of the Party's regional development policy, he said with pleasure that this was a shabby place when he made up his mind to build the Ragwon County Offshore Farm but there sprang up an advanced offshore farm and an ideal modern fishing village. He added that the construction of modern regional-industry factories and a greenhouse farm is turning the area into an industrial zone.
Acquainting himself with the operation of the offshore farm in the county, he said that since a good asset has been provided to lay foundations for the improved material and cultural life of its residents and independent economic development, the County Party Committee and the County People's Committee should hold fast to the main link and carry out all the tasks in a responsible manner and thus turn the county into a place with its own characteristics as a coastal area good to live in while creating and leading the civilization in the new era. He advanced detailed tasks and ways to do so.
He also called for making the struggle for the implementation of the Party's regional development policy an important political occasion cultivating the working spirit and voluntary revolutionary consciousness of all the residents who are determined to carve out their future by themselves.
He went round the hospital and leisure complex being built in the township of Ragwon County.
Learning about the construction, he highly praised the soldier-builders for thoroughly ensuring the quality of construction, aware that every structure will be associated with the leadership feats of our Party and conscience of the service personnel.
Although structures have the same purposes, their characteristics as the mountainous, coastal and flat areas have to be preserved and new things applied steadily and they should be harmonized with surrounding natural landscape, he said, adding that this is an important requirement of the Party's regional construction policy. And he stressed that the whole construction sector should have a proper understanding of this and create a new standard and a new record every year and steadily renew them.
Since new hospitals, leisure complexes and regional-industry factories have to be built in 20 cities and counties every year, it is needed to supply sufficient material and technical means for designing and building and steadily develop the builders' activeness and creativeness so that all the structures can be successfully built to fully embody the Party's idea on architectural aesthetics and meet the architectural engineering requirements, he said.
Saying that the important significance of construction work is being more highlighted in bringing all-people struggle for the overall development of socialism to a steady upsurge at present, he expressed his idea to further accelerate the regional transformation by expanding and deepening the regional development policy in a gigantic way in the future.
The epoch-making changes in local areas at which even we admire are historic miracles that can be created only by our army, he said, adding that the entire Party, the whole country and all the people  should give full play to the spirit of assisting the army with sincerity.
He called upon construction units at all levels to put constant efforts into the political and ideological education so as to firmly prepare all the soldier-builders to be staunch defenders and implementers of the Party's policies and make them fully display their excellent political awareness and morality and patriotism in the fields of socialist construction.
He clarified the important tasks arising in the completion of the construction and the operation of objects, including the issue of strictly meeting the requirements of the method of construction at the finishing work and intensifying supervision, the issue of conducting the designs for afforestation well and giving precedence to the afforestation and greening in time, the issue of building up the county's own construction forces and directing primary efforts to improving urban management including the provision of domestic water for inhabitants and the removing of sewage, the issue of preparing the ranks of medical workers to run modern hospitals without any deviation, the issue of taking responsible measures for the supply of raw materials to regional-industry factories and the issue of paying deeper attention to the living conditions of soldier-builders.
He expressed expectation and belief that all the soldier-builders involved in the construction projects for the regional development policy would invariably remain faithful to their honorable duty and vanguard role, with the awareness that they are the core and engine leading the comprehensive development of socialism, and thus glorify the first year of implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK as a year of proud victory in which regional areas are making another leap forward in their transformation.
Encouraged by the field guidance and the greatest trust of ComradeKim Jong Un, all the soldier-builders pledged to uphold the Party's policy on regional development with high results at the level required by the new era of comprehensive development. -0-

headline: Japan's Overseas Aggression Is Not Fiction but Reality: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 7 (KCNA) -- Japan, keen on bolstering up its military capabilities for overseas aggression, has shown another dangerous behavior, raising serious concern from region and international community.
Shortly ago, the Japanese government began examining a plan to develop and introduce on a full scale an unmanned submarine capable of attacking a warship under the pretext of "tightened defence system in the Pacific Ocean".
The said submarine Japan seeks to possess is said to be capable of sailing long distance for a long time with torpedoes or mines loaded.
If this plan is realized, Japan will have a condition to hide invisible "re-aggression monsters". In other words, Japan seeks to hide such attack means as unmanned submarines near the shores of the DPRK and other neighboring countries and make preemptive strike at the warships of its opponent countries in contingency and thus escalate the flames of aggression.
This is a grave situation showing that Japan has openly withdrawn from the oft-repeated "exclusive defence".
In fact, Japan's military muscle has rapidly evolved into a form of attack and aggression, not "defence" in recent years.
It has mass-produced home-made long-range missiles which can be launched from different spheres, including ground-launched, submarine-launched and warship-launched ones, and stepped up the research and development of new-type ballistic missiles with a range of 3 000 km. It is also speeding up the introduction of two kinds of foreign-made missiles including U.S.-made cruise missile Tomahawk.
In March, Japan deployed improved versions of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles with drastic increase in range and type 25 high-speed gliding projectiles flying at supersonic speed at high altitude in Kumamoto and Shizuoka prefectures respectively for the first time in the country. Recently, it deployed the launcher of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles and a reconnaissance drone for confirming the target position on its island in the Pacific Ocean.
Japan's military muscle is now being turned into a forward-deployment and actual war-deployment type so that it can carry out a war at any moment.
Moreover, Japan introduced a lot of Israeli weapons and equipment after the outbreak of crisis in the Gaza Strip. This shows that its "Self-Defence Forces" are armed with notorious lethal equipment whose practicality has been verified in actual war.
Its rapid acquisition and deployment of preemptive attack and long-range strike means and its mass purchase of lethal weapons actually used in modern warfare go to prove once again that it is not an imagination but a stark reality for Japan to embark on the road of continental aggression.
In other words, the Japanese aggression forces have already slipped the "safety catch" and what remains to be done is to pull the trigger toward the goal of reinvasion. It is as clear as noonday what the result will be.
Those who fail to draw lessons from the past will surely repeat their faults.
If Japan, a war criminal state and a defeated nation, makes a revanchist option of overseas aggression, the future of this island country will surely come to an end. -0-

headline: Commentary on Dangerous Japan-ROK Military Nexus
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- Kang Chol Su, section chief of the DPRK Institute of Enemy State Studies, on July 8 issued the following commentary titled "Dangerous military nexus courting self-destruction":
The military nexus between Japan, a war criminal state dashing toward a military giant, and the ROK has recently got more undisguised, further endangering the security situation in the Korean peninsula.
Early this year, the ROK air-force squadron got refueling from the Japan Air Self-Defence Force at a Japanese military base, which was something unprecedented in history. In June, a search and rescue drill between Japan and the ROK was resumed in nine years and the Japanese defense minister flew to Seoul to have a confab on the issue of security cooperation between the two countries.
It is by no means fortuitous that the word has spread in Japan and the ROK that the level of military cooperation between Japan and the ROK has jumped one step.
What should not be overlooked is that the security cooperation between Japan and the ROK is directed to concluding the "logistic support agreement" which provides each other with munitions including ammunition in contingency.
Japanese media reported that the Japan-ROK security policy council held in May was aimed at concrete successes for the conclusion of the "logistic support agreement" between the two sides, and the chief executive of the ROK openly talked about the need to conclude the "logistic support agreement" with Japan.
The international community has already sounded a note of warning against the nature and danger of the conclusion of the "logistic support agreement" between Japan and the ROK that it is the final stage of the establishment of military alliances and the substantial integration of military systems.
The U.S. ambition for hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region has become more undisguised and the confrontation maniacs of the ROK are hell-bent on arms buildup, modernization of armed forces and war drills for aggression against the DPRK, unhesitatingly spitting out the provocative remarks that the "DPRK regime and the Korean People's Army are their enemy". Timed to coincide with such moves, Japan and the ROK are strengthening the military nexus. Their purpose is as clear as noonday.
Japan's security cooperation is precisely a confrontation cooperation targeting the DPRK and part of the establishment of the "triangular cooperation system over the nuclear issue" to militarily contain neighboring countries by taking advantage of the U.S. strategy for hegemony.
It is also revealed in the fact that Japan and the ROK are talking about the "importance of the U.S.-Japan-ROK cooperation", deploying long-range missiles far beyond their defense sphere and attempting to possess nuclear-powered submarines.
The reality goes to prove once again that the DPRK's continuous development of nuclear force and thorough exercise of its position as a nuclear weapons state are the only way to actively cope with the acute and unpredictably changing international situation and defend peace and security in the Korean peninsula and the region.
No matter what military alliance Japan and the ROK may conclude, there will never be a change in the absolute mechanical structure of no retreat built in the Korean peninsula by the strongest nuclear weapons state.
The reckless military nexus of the enemy states under the eyes of the nuclear weapons state is nothing but a foolish act of courting self-destruction. -0-
