headline: Flower Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from Nigerian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- Bola Ahmed Adekunle Tinubu, president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and commander-in-chief of the Nigerian Armed Forces, sent a flower basket to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 32nd anniversary of demise of ComradeKim Il Sung.
The flower basket was laid at the statues of the great leaders on July 8. -0-

headline: DPRK People Pay Highest Tribute to President Kim Il Sung
Steps Taken to Cope with Disastrous Abnormal Weather
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 9 (KCNA) -- The metal industry of the DPRK steps up the project to cope with the disastrous abnormal weather.
The Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex completed the dredging in the shortest time by concentrating excavators on the rivers designated as risk objects. And it has carried out the building of retaining walls and the embankment project.
The Chollima Steel Complex finished the project to expand the sewerage network and increased the water passage capacity. It also replaced the steel sheets for roofs of the ingot and smelter shops to ensure the safety of production buildings and equipment.
The Musan Mining Complex carried out the planned dredging and the anti-land-sliding projects for valley streams and has realigned the mining steps and dressing plants to protect concentrated iron ores from being washed away.
The Puryong Ferroalloy Factory, Unnyul and Ramjong mines, the Nampho Welding Rod Factory and other units, too, have repaired the drainage facilities and provided spare parts for the regular production. -0-

headline: Women's Union Members Conduct Patriotic Movement
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The women's union members in the DPRK are waging a good-conduct movement on the fronts of socialist construction.
Those in Pyongyang have conducted various welfare service activities at the housing construction sites at the fifth stage in the Hwasong area and gave aid materials to the builders, encouraging them.
Those in Sunchon City of South Phyongan Province conducted afforestation and greening and land leveling at major construction sites, and those in Pukchang County sent lots of labour protection materials to the workers of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and conducted the work conducive to the production of electricity.
Those in Hwangju County of North Hwanghae Province and Hoeryong City of North Hamgyong Province worked together with builders of modern rural dwellings and conducted agit-prop activities.
Women in the coal-mining sector including Sunchon and Pukchang area youth coal-mining complexes have conducted a do-good-thing movement including collecting spilled coal.
Women's union officials and members in South Hwanghae Province and Kaesong Municipality are contributing to the immediate farming process at farms. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: First Enlarged Meeting of Ninth WPK Central Military Commission Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The First Enlarged Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea was held on July 9.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, Chairman of the WPK Central Military Commission and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the meeting.
Present there were members of the WPK Central Military Commission and, as observers, major commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, military and political commanding officers of the large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army and officials of relevant departments of the WPK Central Committee.
The meeting discussed important political and military tasks for bolstering up the politico-ideological and military technical might of the People's Army and bringing about a qualitative change in strengthening the combat readiness of the army units at all levels since the strategic orientation, goals and policies for building the armed forces to reflect the present military and political situation and the requirements of the times were set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK and the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK.
Saying that the prestige, honor and destiny of socialist Korea are unthinkable apart from the powerful defence capabilities, ComradeKim Jong Unstated that the security and peace of the country and the people can not be defended with the willingness alone and that only when we build the strong army and control all and contain threats with its powerful strength, is it possible to achieve the true peace.
The People's Army should invariably play a leading and core role not only in defending socialism but also in the struggle for comprehensive development of the state, he stressed, saying that the far-reaching plan and confidence in the future struggle are based on the absolute trust in our army.
He declared that it is our Party's steadfast policy on building a powerful army to turn the People's Army into a strong army united as one in mind sharing the ideas and intention with the Party Central Committee and to develop it into invincible armed forces by steadily strengthening its politico-ideological mightiness and spiritual-moral superiority and military technical superiority.
Stressing the need to thoroughly put the People's Army on a field warfare and modern basis and enhance its actual war capability, he advanced the important tasks facing the army units at all levels.
The meeting decided on the issue for upgrading the technical infrastructure of combat systems, bolstering up the nuclear force both in quality and quantity and pushing ahead with the plan for standardizing, specializing and modernizing military bases in a far-sighted way. And it confirmed the specific orientation and ways for bringing about a substantial change in training sector and putting spurs to the revolution in military education.
The meeting suggested tasks and ways for expanding in a many-sided way the functions and missions of the General Reconnaissance and Intelligence Bureau, which plays a pivotal role in controlling the potential enemies' threats and gathering key information, and enhancing its capability of military reconnaissance and intelligence activities in a radical way.
The meeting also confirmed the direction of activities of the People's Army and its detailed tasks to accelerate the construction of modern naval bases and the technical updating for expanding the capacity of shipyards at all levels in keeping with the start of signal transformation in our Navy's position and role and to accomplish the great historic cause for completely remodeling the coal-mining areas across the country. And it discussed a structural measure for implementing them and a proposal for mobilizing troops.
Saying it is the greatest trust and honor given by the times and the revolution to the People's Army that it is entrusted with the important projects, decisive of the state development and existence, ComradeKim Jong Unstressed that the whole army should be inspired to turn out in proving once again before history that it is the trait and fighting mettle peculiar to our army to make greater and more vigorous stride of loyalty and feats as the struggle front becomes wider and larger.
ComradeKim Jong Unsigned seven written orders on the important military measures, discussed and decided at the Party Central Military Commission.
The meeting conveyed the directive of the WPK Central Military Commission on the immediate military structural measure.
The meeting dealt with the organizational matter of dismissing, transferring and newly appointing leading officers for key posts of the People's Army.
The important military measures, discussed and decided at the First Enlarged Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, serve as a significant practical step for giving great impetus to the struggle for implementing the WPK's line of building a powerful army on turning the DPRK's armed forces into the strongest one in the world and remarkably enhancing the combat power, activity and leading role of our army in defending socialism and in all spheres of socialist construction. -0-

headline: Musan Mining Complex Increases Production
Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory Wins Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory in the DPRK won the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag.
True to the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea to transform all the revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three revolutions, the officials and employees of the factory set a realistic goal of winning the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag and turned out as one in the mass movement.
A meeting was held on July 9 to award the Thrice Three-Revolution Red Flag.
A decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly was read out and a citation, Order of the Three-Revolution Red Flag and Three-Revolution Red Flag were conferred on the Pyongyang Children's Foodstuff Factory.
Then speeches were made. -0-

headline: Young People in North Hwanghae Volunteer for Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- Dozens of young people in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK volunteered for worksites of socialist construction.
Young people in Songnim City, Yonthan and Hwangju counties volunteered to work at raw materials base stations.
Those in Sohung and Sangwon counties also volunteered for county oil-bearing forest stations.
Youth league members in Yonsan, Phyongsan and Junghwa counties vowed to work at the construction brigades.
Among the volunteers are young people in Unpha County and Sariwon City who volunteered for mines and farms.
Officials, youth and students encouraged the volunteers, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Grass Handicraft
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- The grass handicraft is a form of Koreans' folk handicraft that has been created and handed down since ancient times.
This handicraft has been popular mainly among the people for its abundant materials, easy making method and usefulness.
In the period of Koryo Dynasty, Korean ancestors manufactured various kinds of grass crafts including straw mat, basket and wicker basket with such materials as sedge, bush clover, reed, willow branch, rice straw, hemp and arrowroot and widely used them in life. In this period, the making technique of grass crafts became skilled and elaborated, and thus grass crafts were well known to foreigners.
In the course of creative activities to meet the growing demand for grass crafts, the grass handicraft was further developed.
Today the grass handicraft favored by the people is becoming more diverse.
The grass handicraft was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in November 2015. -0-

headline: Treasured Factory
story_text:
One day in July 2016, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory.
Before going round its production lines, he went to the room for education in the revolutionary history. Intensively seeing the photos of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungand the great leader ComradeKim Jong Ilgiving field guidance at the factory and valuable historic mementoes, he said that the Phyongsong Artificial Leather Factory has grown to be a treasured factory of the country conducive to improving the people's standard of living under the special loving care of the great leaders.
That day, the General Secretary stressed the need for the officials accompanying him to take measures for providing the factory with sufficient raw and other materials so that it could play its role as a treasured factory.
Leaving the factory, he again said that the factory should continue to glorify its honor as a treasured factory.
Indeed, this call reflected his warm sincerity to provide our people with an affluent and civilized life as soon as possible as well as his deep trust and expectation that the factory would fulfill its responsibility and role in developing the country's light industry and improving the people's standard of living. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- Before and after the defeat of the Japanese imperialists, many Koreans were killed by sinking of Japanese ships.
The explosion of Ukishima-maru was one of them. After the liberation of the country from Japan's colonial rule (August 15, 1945), Koreans, who were compelled to forced labor in Japan, got aboard the ship with a desire to return to their homeland where their parents, brothers, sisters, wives and children were waiting. But they were buried in the sea all at once by the explosion of the ship.
On August 22, 1945, the Japanese naval transport ship Ukishima-maru anchored at Ominato naval port in Aomori Prefecture, Japan.
At that time, thousands of Koreans, who had toiled and moiled at coal mines and construction sites in the surrounding areas, gathered at the port to return to their homeland.
They, deceived by the propaganda of the Japanese navy gendarmes who said that Ukishima-maru was tasked to repatriate Koreans, got aboard the ship.
That night, the ship left the port and sailed to the south along the coastline of Japan. On August 24 when it reached the vicinity of Maizuru Port in Kyoto Prefecture, the gendarmes veered the ship to the port on the pretext of filling up water.
Suddenly, loud explosive sounds were heard several times and the ship was sunk, broken in two, in the water some 300 meters off from the coastline of Maizuru Port and the Koreans were buried in the sea at once.
After the incident, the Japanese reactionaries claimed that the ship was sunk by a mine, but it was a sophism to conceal their crimes.
The facts that the Japanese imperialists took the Koreans on board by appeasing and compelling them and loaded the ship with little amount of fuel and the Japanese sailors and gendarmes escaped by lifeboats go to prove that the incident was not an accident caused by a mine but a planned crime.
The explosion of Ukishima-maru, widely known to the world, is a deliberate massacre committed by the Japanese government under its plan to kill Koreans. -0-

topic: 32nd Anniversary of Kim Il Sung 's Demise
headline: PresidentKim Il SungRemembered in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 10 (KCNA) -- A round-table talk of families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle took place at the DPRK embassy in Beijing on July 6 to commemorate the 32nd anniversary of demise of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present there were the families of those related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle including Feng Songguang, son of Feng Zhongyun, Yue Zhiyun, daughter of Zhang Weihua's daughter, Pan Xiaomin, daughter-in-law of mentor Shang Yue, and Yu Ming, son of Li Zade.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland paid tribute to them.
They looked round photos showing the energetic revolutionary activities of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
At the round-table talk, speakers said that the whole life of PresidentKim Il Sungis that of a great revolutionary, adding that he performed immortal exploits for the country's independence and the cause of nation building and laid a firm foundation for the development of the DPRK. He devoted his all to the prosperity of the country and happiness of the people and made a great contribution to the world revolution, they stressed.
They expressed belief that the Korean people would achieve bigger successes in socialist construction, closely rallied as one in mind around their leader, noting that General Secretary Xi Jinping met General SecretaryKim Jong Unin Pyongyang some days ago and that the top leaders of the two countries gave fresh vitality to the China-DPRK relations. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Congratulatory Message to Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a congratulatory message to Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China, on July 11.
The message said:
Esteemed Comrade General Secretary,
I, on behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government and people of the DPRK and on my own behalf, extend warm congratulations and comradely greetings to you, Comrade General Secretary, and, through you, to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the government of the People's Republic of China and the fraternal Chinese people on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance between the DPRK and the PRC.
The treaty, concluded 65 years ago, laid a solid legal foundation for the permanent development of the DPRK-China relations of militant friendship, unity and mutually beneficial cooperation which were formed in the bloody struggle for independence against imperialism, peace and the accomplishment of the socialist cause.
Over the past years, the two countries have fully demonstrated to the whole world the constancy and invincibility of the DPRK-China friendly relations, special in terms of the tradition of friendship, the common cause of socialism and the invariable inheritance, while firmly supporting and cooperating with each other in all trials of history.
The DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations, the strategic option and common precious asset of the two parties and peoples of the two countries, are now developing at a new strategic level and making a great contribution to firmly protecting the sovereignty, security and development interests of the two countries and defending peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world under the complicated international situation.
It is the steadfast stand of our Party and government to more dynamically develop the traditional DPRK-China relations of friendship and cooperation with socialism as the core in various fields in conformity with the requirements of the times and the aspirations and desires of the peoples of the two countries.
Through the historic Pyongyang meeting, I and you, Comrade General Secretary, reaffirmed the will to build together the beautiful future of the two peoples on the road of struggle for the victorious advance of the socialist cause.
I am ready to develop the DPRK-China friendship with good history and tradition as its foundation into a model of the most powerful and strategic relations between socialist countries by guiding it to a new height, together with you, Comrade General Secretary.
I hope that the Chinese people, who significantly celebrated the 105th anniversary of the founding of the CPC with a proud history of development, will make bigger epoch-making successes in accomplishing the gigantic cause of comprehensively building a modern and powerful socialist country and achieving the great prosperity of the Chinese nation under the leadership of the CPC with you, Comrade General Secretary, as its core.
I sincerely wish the People's Republic of China prosperity and the Chinese people happiness. -0-

headline: PresidentKim Il SungRemembered Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- Memorial meetings, seminars, lectures, book and photo exhibitions and film shows took place in Myanmar, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Italy and Serbia from June 27 to July 3 on the occasion of the 32nd anniversary of demise of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present at the events were personages of political parties, organizations and institutions and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the DPRK people in those countries.
Screened at the film shows were a film dealing with the noble life of the President praised by all people and videos showing the successes made by the Korean people on the road of comprehensive development of socialism.
Speeches were made at the events.
The general secretary of the Communist Party of Italy, the chairman of the Italian Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea and other speakers praised the President for his ideological and theoretical exploits and nation-building exploits. They said that ComradeKim Il Sungmade a great contribution to the Korean revolution and the world revolution and that his exploits would be kept in the hearts of the world progressives forever as he set a brilliant example in the national-liberation struggle in colonies and victoriously advanced the cause of independence against imperialism.
They praised the President for his life of believing in the people as in Heaven and stressed that the political philosophy of ComradeKim Il Sung's love for the people is steadily being carried forward by the respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
A message to the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwas adopted at the event held in Switzerland. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Report on Joint Meeting of Party, Government and Army of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK are carrying out the most righteous mission and great historic cause, taking full responsibility for the destiny and future of the people. Their prestige and mightiness are based on the strict national law and strong and sound discipline system.
The Ninth Congress of the WPK put forward it as the foremost requirement of the times to ensure the complete unity of action and establish the strong discipline in socialist construction as a whole. And the state law of the DPRK is directing the spearhead of resolute struggle against the acts of exercising privilege, abusing power and resorting to illegalities and corruption which destroy the basis of the Korean revolution and erode socialist state system.
A joint meeting of the Party, the government and the army took place in Pyongyang on July 10 to give a warning to all sorts of anti-revolutionary, anti-socialist, anti-people acts going against the trend of the times when the whole Party and the entire people are going all out for implementing the decisions of the Party congress, and signify the intensified high-intensity struggle.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the joint meeting.
Present at the meeting were senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, commanding officers of the Korean People's Army units at all levels, leading officials of the ministries, national agencies, Party and power organs and major industrial establishments and officials in the discipline inspection sector and law enforcement organs.
Put on the agenda at the meeting was the issue of drawing a serious lesson from the crimes committed by corrupt elements in the political organ of the People's Army who were engrossed in high-profile irregularities and corruption.
The joint meeting informed the participants of the data exposing high-profile irregularities and corruption committed by Pak Hui Chol, former vice-director in charge of organizational affairs of the General Political Bureau of the People's Army, and his followers.
The Central Military Commission of the WPK took a measure in late June to bring a charge of irregularities and corruption against Pak Hui Chol and investigate him.
Pursuant to the measure, the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the WPK decided to dismiss him from the Party central leadership body and refer him to a law enforcement organ.
The highest law enforcement organ of the DPRK examined the crimes of the accused, who engaged in acquiring ill-gotten wealth by various means while holding an important post in the political organ of the People's Army, and accomplices who catered to his heinous irregularities and corruption.
All the crimes committed by the accused were clearly proved by objective evidence at the trial.
The accused Pak Hui Chol committed scandals and illegally acquired wealth by abusing his power of arranging organizational work and appointing cadres, seriously betraying the trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee and the people and challenging the Party's line of strengthening discipline. He exerted a very harmful influence on strengthening the ranks of cadres of the People's Army in a qualitative way, enhancing its fighting efficiency and establishing sound military traits by receiving a large amount of bribes and leading a dissipated life.
During the past four years when he had been in a responsible post of the political organ, he created special illusions about him while being engrossed in all sorts of abuses of authority and arbitrariness, and received a large amount of bribes from dishonest elements obsessed with greed and thirst for a high post.
He fostered the acts of buying and selling posts, receiving bribes and committing political fraud in the army and seriously hindered the establishment of the Party's monolithic command system across the entire army by appointing his confidants and toadies to important posts.
He neglected every affair related with the implementation of the Party's command policy across the entire army by plundering the maximum amount of state funds, materials and dwelling houses and squandering them in dissolute and depraved life.
Pak Hui Chol's scandals are extra-large crimes that go beyond imagination in view of their dangerousness and harmfulness.
As a result of the strict struggle against scandal, our army came to be provided with a powerful motive force capable of removing the poison and evil practices lurking inside the military and political guidance organ at the right time and further renewing its militant prestige.
Through the serious political struggle, the People's Army has made a stride forward in making the entire army ideologically elite. The reality proved that the further the struggle against scandals is intensified, the stronger the army becomes, the cleaner its purity becomes and the deeper the trust of the Party and the people in the heroic strong army becomes.
The participants in the meeting realized once again the necessity and urgency of observing the strict political and moral discipline and intensifying the uncompromising struggle, which have defended the qualitative growth and firm union of the revolutionary ranks, in the present important historical course.
A verdict on the accused was issued.
The Supreme Court of the DPRK sharply condemned extra-large scandal corrupt elements for their crimes and imposed penalties on them.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade an important concluding speech.
The essence of the recent case lies in the fact that the person in a responsible position, who has heavy duty and authority to contain, detect and eradicate such an act as illicit accumulation of wealth so despised by the Party and the people, abused the authority as a weapon for his own interests and emerged as the chief culprit of irregularities and corruption, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid, stating that this is a political crime against the Party's line of building discipline and a deliberate act of embezzlement and plunder against the interests of the state and the people.
Seriously pointing to the gravity of this high-profile corruption that occurred when our Party declared an all-out war against the abuse of power, bureaucratism and irregularities and corruption and has steadily enhanced the intensity of the struggle, he cautioned the discipline inspection units at all levels.
Saying it is a lesson taught by the recent case that if we fail to steadily intensify education and control to prevent the officials from getting contaminated with irregularities and corruption and abandoning Party principles, it is impossible to prevent such wrongdoings, he stressed that all the officials should keep principle and uprightness as their lifeblood and should be mindful of the Party's trust and think of the people first.
ComradeKim Jong Unclarified the solemn stand of the Party Central Committee to steadily enhance the intensity of the organizational and ideological offensive for transforming the ranks of cadres into an elite and the legal struggle for rooting out irregularities and corruption.
The joint meeting strongly signaled that there is no place for irregularities and corruption harmful to the developing revolution and the elements infected by them to exist. And it re-expressed the unshakable will of the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government to proactively and positively suppress and repel all sorts of corruption and violations of discipline and thus open up a new phase of building a ruling party, strong and sound in discipline and full of a vital revolutionary climate, and dynamically accelerate the building of a powerful nation under the strict legal discipline. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Meets Chairman of NPC Standing Committee of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- Premier Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on an official visit to the People's Republic of China, met Zhao Leji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of China and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC, at the Great Hall of the People on Friday afternoon.
The meeting expressed the will to successfully implement the important common understanding reached between the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries, add luster to the traditional friendship, strengthen the mutual-beneficial cooperation and deepen exchange and cooperation between legislative bodies so as to promote greater development in the DPRK-China relations.
Present there were Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, and other leading members of the DPRK party and government delegation, and Liu Qi, secretary general of the NPC Standing Committee of China, and other officials concerned. -0-

headline: Premier of DPRK Cabinet Pak Thae Song Meets Chinese President Xi Jinping
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, who is on an official visit to China by leading the party and government delegation of the DPRK, met Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of July 10.
Pak Thae Song courteously conveyed the warm greetings and best wishes from the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto Comrade Xi Jinping.
Expressing deep thanks for this, Comrade Xi Jinping asked the premier to convey his warmest comradely greetings and best wishes to ComradeKim Jong Un.
Pak Thae Song said that the DPRK and China have supported and closely cooperated with each other on the road for independence against imperialism and for socialism and powerfully propelled the socialist cause in the spirit of the treaty of friendship, cooperation and mutual assistance and firmly defended the regional and global peace. In particular, the DPRK-China Pyongyang summit in June last marked a historic occasion in clearly demonstrating the invariability of the DPRK-China friendship and setting a new milestone in the development of the bilateral relations, he stressed.
Under the deep care of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, the events for marking the anniversary of the conclusion of treaty are to be held with splendor this year, strikingly demonstrating once again the strategic character of the DPRK-China friendship, the premier noted, saying that the DPRK would as ever do its best to actively promote the revolutionary unity, the co-prosperity and development and the socialist cause of the two countries at a new high stage as required by the new era.
Comrade Xi Jinping noted that through his recent state visit to the DPRK, he, together with Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, provided the strategic guidelines for consolidating and developing the traditional China-DPRK friendship. The China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance laid an important political and legal foundation for consolidating the militant friendship forged by the peoples of the two countries at the cost of their blood, he said, adding that it is a clear feature of the consistent China-DPRK relations to share friendship and destiny and defend and help each other generation after generation.
Saying that the relations between the two parties and the two countries should advance along with the times, consolidate the socialist cause all the time and ensure that the great China-DPRK friendship is handed down through generations, he expressed the willingness to strengthen the strategic cooperation between the two countries and firmly defend the sovereignty, security and development interests so as to create an environment favorable for advancing along the road of socialism.
The talk proceeded in a warm and friendly atmosphere.
Present there were Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, and other leading members of the DPRK party and government delegation, and Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the C.C., CPC and foreign minister of the PRC, and officials concerned. -0-

headline: Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- In Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, there is the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp, well-known throughout the country for its famous Onpho hot spring which is good for human health and treatment.
The Onpho hot spring area is located in a cosy valley surrounded by mountains. The area covered with thick forest has a wholesome climate. It is also a scenic place where hot springs gush out in all seasons.
This strong alkaline hot spring has high pharmacological and therapeutic effects as it contains ingredients good for strengthening blood circulation and promoting metabolism.
The Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp has turned into a monumental edifice representing the country's hot spring culture, opening up a new sphere of cultural and emotional life for the people.
On July 11, 2018, the respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the then Onpho Holiday Camp. He stressed that the camp should be turned into a comprehensive service centre and a medical service centre equipped with all service networks so that people can have a good rest and receive hot spring treatment and that it should be built as a model of the hot spring holiday camps without an equal in our country by making its design unique to the characteristics of the hot spring area.
Jo Mi Suk, manager of the holiday camp, said that the camp with nearly 80 year-long history has undergone a radical change in its appearance and that the visitors will regain their health and vigor in the peculiar emotion of the scenic spot and feel pride and joy of life.
The camp is now crowded with working people enjoying a pleasant recreation life or taking hot-spring cure and climate treatment. -0-

headline: Reception Given in Beijing to Mark 65th Anniversary of Conclusion of DPRK-China Treaty
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- A reception was given at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing on July 10 to mark the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Present there was a party and government delegation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on an official visit to the People's Republic of China.
Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau, member of the Secretariat and director of the General Office of the C.C., Communist Party of China, made a speech at the reception.
Noting that the peoples of the two countries fought shoulder to shoulder in the days of achieving the national independence and liberation and established close comradeship with blood, he said that the conclusion of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance provided a solid political and legal basis for the bilateral friendship.
The China-DPRK friendship has advanced, consolidated and developed along with the times, standing the trials of ever-changing international situation, he said, stressing that Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping and Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unhave paved the way and guided the China-DPRK relations to enter a new historic period, looking forward into the distant future.
He expressed the will to carry forward the traditional friendship, regarding the important common understanding reached between the top leaders of the two parties and two countries as the basic and strategic guidelines, and encourage the socialist cause in the two countries and their traditional relations of friendship and cooperation to steadily take a new stage.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the DPRK State Affairs Commission and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a speech.
He said that he was pleased to pay an official visit to the PRC, a friendly neighbor, and hold a significant event together with the friendly Chinese comrades on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
During the historic Pyongyang summit in June, ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping discussed the issues of strengthening the strategic coordination and cooperation between the two parties and two countries, firmly safeguarding the sovereignty, security and development interests of the two countries and jointly defending peace and development in the region and the world and reached a consensus of views on them, he noted.

headline: Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- A spokesman of the DPRK Foreign Ministry issued the following press statement on Saturday:
At the recent NATO summit, the U.S. and its vassal forces denounced the DPRK's exercise of its just sovereign right as a "threat", and more openly showed their intention for inter-camp confrontation through the NATO's arms buildup and the intensified military cooperation with their Asia-Pacific allies.
The U.S., Japan and the ROK had a separate confab, at which they talked about "complete denuclearization of the DPRK" and "response to cyber threat". And the secretary general of NATO expressed the intention to intensify NATO's interference in the affairs of the Asia-Pacific region, maliciously finding fault with the normal development of relations among sovereign states including the DPRK.
The U.S.-led NATO allies and their partners incited the confrontation throughout the NATO summit. This clearly proved that the North Atlantic Treaty Organization is a war and confrontation body that goes against the international peace and security in all parts of the world, including the Asia-Pacific region and the European region, while pursuing exclusive geopolitical interests.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK expresses serious concern over the fact that the U.S. and its vassal allies are adding an element of instability to the international situation through massive arms buildup, while being so engrossed in the unfounded and malicious politically-motivated denunciation of sovereign states and the strengthening of a military bloc of aggressive nature, and strongly condemns and rejects it.
"The DPRK's denuclearization" is an agenda which reached an irreversible and final conclusion both theoretically and practically.
The U.S., Japan and the ROK's call for "denuclearization", which completely lost the timeliness and practical feasibility, can never affect the position of the DPRK, and the reality faced by the forces who have denied it for decades is a sufficient answer to this.
The concept of denuclearization should be applied on a priority basis to the attempts of Japan and the ROK to go nuclear by themselves in an extremely dangerous phase under the active patronage of the U.S. and to the ambition for nuclear confrontation of NATO member states sharing the U.S. nukes.
NATO is systematically exacerbating the security environment of Europe through the implementation of its reckless easternward advance policy and expansion of its support for the neo-Nazi forces to maintain illegal justification for its existence which should have been extinct with the end of the Cold War, and creating instability in the Asia-Pacific region by shifting its responsibility on to other countries. Its provocative moves can never be overlooked.
The reckless acts of the confrontation forces posing a destructive threat to the world security mechanical structure give a realistic justification to the renewal and expansion of the physical deterrent to confront them.
The DPRK will reliably defend the national sovereignty and security interests and the regional peace and stability by building up at an accelerated pace the strength capable of deterring the enemy countries' ever-increasing attempt for collective confrontation and their military threats and exercising its sovereignty in a responsible manner. -0-

headline: Premier of DPRK Cabinet Pak Thae Song Meets Chinese President Xi Jinping
Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp
Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Congratulations from Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of C.C., CPC and President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 11 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a congratulatory message from Comrade Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China, on July 11.
The message said:
Comrade General Secretary,
I, on behalf of the Communist Party of China, the Chinese government and the Chinese people, extend warm congratulations to you and the Workers' Party of Korea, the DPRK government and the Korean people on the occasion of the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
The treaty, concluded by the leaders of the elder generation of the two countries in 1961, has served as an important political and legal basis for consolidating the militant friendship sealed in blood by the peoples of the two countries and played an important role in developing the China-DPRK friendship down through generations and defending peace and stability in the region and the rest of the world.
For 65 years, both sides have fought shoulder to shoulder and supported and cooperated with each other in accordance with the spirit of the treaty, giving a vivid demonstration of the distinct features of the China-DPRK friendly relations of sharing their destiny and defending and helping each other for generations.
During my successful state visit to the DPRK in June this year I, together with you, Comrade General Secretary, achieved an important shared understanding of the issue of inheriting and consolidating the traditional China-DPRK friendship and attaching a new meaning of the times to it and laid out a strategic orientation and a new blueprint for the development of the China-DPRK relations in a new period.
In order to cope with the rapidly changing phase of the world unprecedented in one hundred years, I am ready to have closer strategic communication with you, Comrade General Secretary, and make a positive contribution to leading the friendship and cooperation between the two sides to bring better wellbeing to the peoples of the two countries and promoting the regional peace and development by firmly maintaining the orientation of the development of the relations between the two countries.
I affirm again that there would be no change in the firm stand of the Chinese party and government attaching great importance to the traditional China-DPRK friendship, their firm support for the socialist cause of the DPRK led by Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unand their firm determination to defend the common interests and good strategic environment of both sides no matter how the international situation may change.
I am convinced that the Korean people will steadily achieve new greater successes in accomplishing the cause of socialist construction by comprehensively implementing the decisions and assignments of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea under its leadership headed by you, Comrade General Secretary.
I wish your country prosperity and people happiness and well-being.
I wish the China-DPRK friendship immortality. -0-

headline: Feats Performed by Fighters in Wolmi Islet
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- Recorded in the history of the Fatherland Liberation War is the feats of the soldiers of the Korean People's Army who fought for Wolmi Islet, a small one in the West Sea.
The U.S. imperialists, who had been driven to a narrow area along the coastline of the South Sea by the successive strikes of the People's Army, dispatched the army of the ground, naval and air forces of the U.S. which had been deployed in the direction of the Pacific and some of the U.S. Mediterranean Fleet, more troops of their ground forces in the mainland and armies of satellite countries to the Korean War in order to realize their aggressive purpose at any cost.
While attempting to wage "general offensive" on the line of the Rakdong River with increased troops, they conducted large-scale Inchon landing operation.
In mid-September 1950, a fierce battle was fought between a coast artillery company with four artillery pieces and an infantry company of the Korean People's Army and about 1 000 planes, hundreds of warships and more than 50 000 troops of the U.S. imperialists in Wolmi Islet, which has an area of 0.66 square kilometers with a coastline of only 4 kilometers in the waters off Inchon.
The U.S. imperialists turned the islet into a sea in flames through indiscriminate bombing and naval bombardment, but the defenders of Wolmi Islet did not vacillate or withdraw. When shells were out of stock and even the last artillery was destroyed, the defenders smashed the enemy's tanks with anti-tank grenades and wiped out the enemies with hand-to-hand battle.
The brave soldiers in Wolmi Islet made a great contribution to implementing the strategic policy of the second stage of the war set forth by PresidentKim Il Sungby sinking and destroying 13 warships of various kinds including three destroyers of the enemies in the three-day battle.
The feats performed by them who worked miracles in the world history of wars are shining in the memory of the country and people generation after generation. -0-

headline: Coal Production Increases in Chonsong Youth Coal Mine
story_text:

headline: Education for Implanting Soul and Spirit of Victorious Wartime Generation Brisk in DPRK
story_text:

Kim Ju Hyok Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District and other schools in the municipality are conducting education in various forms and methods through the data on combat feats of heroic soldiers who devoted their youth to the dignity and honor of the country.
Through the organization of composition reading and oratorical meetings, they have made all students prepare themselves to be reliable pillars and genuine revolutionary talents of the future possessed of many-sided knowledge as well as noble mental and moral traits.
Students have visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and other educational bases and redoubled their will to firmly defend the country and the grateful social system.
The schools are educating the students to follow the loyalty and bravery of the soldiers of the People's Army who worked miracles unprecedented in the world history of wars, true to the order of the leader at the cost of their lives, through the reading of Rodong Sinmun and gatherings for expressing impressions on the Reminiscences of the Participants in the Fatherland Liberation War.
Listening to the feats of the war veterans, the students bear in mind where the mental strength of the victorious wartime generation which brought about the victory on July 27 is based on. -0-

headline: PresidentKim Il SungRemembered by Overseas Koreans' Organizations

headline: Premier of DPRK Cabinet Pak Thae Song Meets Li Qiang, Premier of PRC State Council

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 12 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, had talks with Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on July 11.
Pak Thae Song said that the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance is a firm political and legal guarantee for dynamically promoting the development of the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries, adding that the complicated international political situation requires the two parties and two countries to continue to give full play to the spirit of the treaty with defending the unity, cooperation and common interests for the victorious advance of the socialist cause as the core.
Noting that the DPRK-China friendly relations have reached a new high level thanks to the direct interest and wise leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping, he stressed that the DPRK would make positive efforts to steadily strengthen the DPRK-China friendship and solidarity, true to the noble intention of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries.
Li Qiang said that China and the DPRK are neighbors sharing destiny and defending and helping each other, adding that General Secretary Comrade Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the DPRK to achieve important shared understanding and provide strategic guidelines on deepening the China-DPRK relations with Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
It is the consistent and steadfast policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations, he said, expressing the will to steadily preserve the spirit of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance so as to maintain close ties through high-level visits and expand and develop the political mutual trust and practical cooperation and thus promote the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries and make positive contributions to the peaceful development of the region and the rest of the world.
The talks discussed the issues of expanding and developing exchange and cooperation in all spheres according to the agreement reached by the top leaders of the DPRK and China at the historic Pyongyang summit.
The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere..
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the C.C., WPK, and other leading members of the Party and government delegation of the DPRK, and from the Chinese side were Wu Zhenglong, member and secretary-general of the State Council of the PRC, and other officials of the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC and the International Liaison Department of the C.C., CPC,.

headline: Bench Newly Put at Dressing Room of Rungna People's Pleasure Park

story_text:

story_text:

headline: Eighth Congress of Socialist Women's Union of Korea Held
Afforestation and Forest Conservation Brisk in DPRK
C.C., WPK Sends Congratulatory Letter to Participants in Eighth Congress of SWUK and All Other Women's Union Members
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 15 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea sent a congratulatory letter to the participants in the Eighth Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea and all other women's union members on July 13.
The C.C., WPK in the congratulatory letter said that the period of five years from the day when the Seventh Congress of the SWUK was held, to the present is the one when the era witnessed the activities of the women's union which wrote new pages in the history of the Korean women's movement under the leadership of the WPK and the noble traits of the Korean women.
Recorded in the history of the women's union, which has advanced with the guidance of the Party and the leader as its lifeline and lifeblood, are its seven congresses shining as the fruits of loyalty and patriotism, but there was no such congress as the current one which proudly reviews the days full of honor and pride of our women's genuine life and their valuable contributions to the Party and the country, the congratulatory letter said, and went on:
The beautiful imprints and indelible traces of conscience our women left in the successes reviewed by the Party Congress and the monumental edifices representing the dignity and advance of the DPRK serve as the most correct and valuable proof of the women's union work.
In the days when the country dynamically advanced with the firm ideal despite manifold difficulties brought by unexpected crises and acute situation, the women served as a cornerstone to help their husbands and children stay undisturbed at their worksites and posts and make numerous records and feats admired by the world. For these efforts and exploits alone, our women should be deeply respected.
Furthermore, coal mines, power stations and other major worksites for economic construction and the construction sites for regional development across the country witness the devoted efforts of our women. They also dedicate themselves to sprucing up streets and villages and aiding the army.
Our women, who are ready to go all out for resolving all the problems the Party is worried about and prioritizes, have cultivated farmland with sincere efforts and secured "Nyomaeng" farm machines and military equipment with their sincerity. And they did various good deeds for the country, created many forests, spruced up their living environments and helped orphans and old persons without any caregivers and families with difficulties, regarding all of them as their duties.
Our women, mothers in our country, are pure-minded conscientious human beings as they know how every policy for them is adopted at a time when the country has so much work to do and has to economize in the use of money and how much the country considers to do so, and they placed the duty of repayment above the right to enjoying and voluntarily did what they have to do.
As our women are well aware that they should entrust their most precious families and beloved children to the grateful embrace and defend it, all of them have the excellent spirit of remaining true to the Party, loving and defending their social system, and dedicating themselves to national affairs rather than their family affairs.
The congratulatory letter stressed that the vigorous transformation struggle in the new era for national prosperity calls for further enhancing the functions and roles of the working people's organizations, as transmission belt of the Party, which take their deep roots among the masses and encourage them to the implementation of the Party policies.
The letter continued:
The Socialist Women's Union of Korea should fulfill their honorable duty before the Party and the revolution and the times and the country by remaining faithful to the important mission of training millions of women into the social human beings sharing the ideology, intention, breath and pace with our Party only.
The women's union should concentrate its efforts on the ideological education before anything else and continue to maintain the character and nature of the Korean women advancing along only the road indicated by the Party with firm belief in its lines and policies, the invariable purity and traits peculiar to them.
At present, the education in patriotism and the class and moral education are an important task the women's union should direct special effort to.
The women's union organizations at all levels should vigorously organize and launch various mass movements and socialist emulations and review and appreciate them properly so as to glorify the women's devoted efforts in every part of the country as precious patriotic feats.
It is important to make all the women the communist mothers, who think and act as required by the changed environment and developing era, and the excellent communist educators for their children.
The women's union, an organization of mothers going towards communism, should direct great efforts to educating the children, pay deep attention to the families with many children and methodologically conduct the work for learning from the mother heroes and other fine mothers. So, it has to make sure that many reliable pillars are prepared to take responsibility for the future of the country and the revolution.
Our Party will as ever creditably defend the life and homes of the women and our rising generation and continue striving to realize as early as possible the desire of mothers for their children's better life.
The C.C., WPK in the congratulatory letter expressed the belief that the women's union organizations at all levels and the women's union officials and members would fully display the upright and noble traits of Korean women in the sacred and worthwhile struggle for national prosperity, always united as one in mind. -0-

headline: Illustrated Story Books
story_text:
One day in July 2012, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Kyongsang Kindergarten.
He went round some places of the kindergarten and then told an official to quickly fetch illustrated story books he brought along with him.
In fact, he acquainted himself with the supply of new picture books good for children's intellectual education and took a measure to send the kindergarten lots of such books during his visit to it over 40 days ago.
Nevertheless, he brought again those illustrated story books to the kindergarten.
He told officials that he brought various books for children including pictorial puzzle books, adding that some of them might be the same ones as he had sent before, but several children will be able to enjoy the same books at the same time if they have many copies. He stressed that if children read such pictorial puzzle books, they can cultivate the ability to study, analyze and judge things.
Leaving the kindergarten, he said that he went round the kindergarten again as it is important to equip and operate well the kindergarten so that it can develop the intellectual faculties of preschool children and train them into talented ones.
The story about illustrated story books makes the people deeply cherish the noble intention of the General Secretary who prioritizes the education of the rising generation. -0-

Formation of Second Front during Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 15 (KCNA) -- The formation of the powerful second front behind the enemy lines by combined units of the Korean People's Army during the Fatherland Liberation War was something unprecedented in the world history of wars.
It was common sense widely acknowledged at the time that the second front was feasible only when the main front was in a stable state. There were precedents for individual units or guerrilla units fighting to disperse the enemy's forces through the struggle behind the enemy, but there was no precedent for the formation and military activities of the second front behind the enemy lines by combined units of the regular army under the unified command of the Supreme Headquarters.
At that time, the western and eastern sectors of the front, where the main forces of the 8th and 10th corps of the U.S. imperialist aggressor forces had been concentrated, were mostly rugged mountainous areas, and an intermediate zone was created between them.
The attacking enemy forces, advancing mainly along wide roads, had no support on their flanks. Furthermore, inter-unit unified command and cooperative operation were impossible.  That was the fatal weak point.
PresidentKim Il Sungconvened an operational meeting of the Supreme Headquarters of the KPA in September 1950 and advanced the strategic and tactical policy of forming the powerful second front behind the enemy lines for a radical turn in the future progress of the war.
According to the President's operational plan, the second front was formed behind the enemy lines by some combined units of the main KPA forces which had been retreating organizationally from the Rakdong River front with the Second Corps as its pivot.
The second front units conducted harassing and striking operations behind the enemy lines in contact with the people's guerrilla army in the mountainous areas of Kangwon Province, South Phyongan Province and Hwanghae Province (then). In a short span of time, they built guerrilla bases in the rear of the enemy, annihilated enemy troops through surprise attacks and dealt telling blows to the enemy in their strategic and operational depth across the area of thousands of square kilometers.
Entering the third stage of the Fatherland Liberation War, the second front units waged a more vigorous struggle behind the enemy lines. During the first-round operation, they conducted more than 200 large battles to deter 100 000 enemy troops from advancing to the front line.
Until mid-December 1950, they killed and captured more than 31 200 enemy troops, liberated the enemy-occupied areas of nearly 30 000 square kilometers, smashed the enemy's attempt at intermediate defence and made a great contribution to driving the aggressors out to the area south of the 38th Parallel. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Eighth Congress of Socialist Women's Union of Korea Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 15 (KCNA) -- The Eighth Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea took place in Pyongyang on July 13 and 14.
The congress comprehensively analyzed and reviewed the work done by the women's union during the period under review and discussed the practical tasks and ways for the women's union to play more active role as a transmission belt linking the Party with the masses and as a creditable assistant of the Party and fully discharge its mission and role as an ideological education organization in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Present there were the members of the seventh-term SWUK central leadership body and delegates elected by the women's union organizations at all levels.
Officials of the Party, armed forces organs, ministries and national agencies and those concerned were on hand as observers.
The platform was taken by Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, Jong Kyong Thaek and Ju Chang Il, members of the Political Bureau and secretaries of the WPK Central Committee, executive members of the SWUK Central Committee, chairwomen of the provincial committees of the SWUK, exemplary women's union officials and members and officials in charge of the women's union work at the armed forces organs.
When the congress was declared open, the DPRK national anthem was played.
The congress elected the presidium and the secretariat.
The agenda items discussed at the congress are as follows:
1. Review of the Work of the Central Committee of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea
2. On the Revision of the SWUK Rules
3. Election of the Central Leadership Body of the SWUK
Jo Yong Won read out a congratulatory letter of the WPK Central Committee to the participants in the Eighth Congress of the SWUK and all the women's union members.
Stating that the beautiful imprints and indelible traces of conscience our women left in the successes reviewed by the Party Congress and the monumental edifices representing the dignity and advance of the DPRK serve as the most correct and valuable proof of the women's union work, the letter highly praised the SWUK for performing the feat of glorifying the image of all our people as well as the tough-minded and beautiful looks of the Korean women along with the times. And it extended the warm congratulations and encouraging greetings to all the women's union officials and members across the country.
It indicated the main task faced by the women's union in the resolute struggle for transformation in the new era for the prosperity of our state and the practical ways for further enhancing the function and role of the women's union organizations.
Jon Hyang Sun, chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee, made a report on the first agenda item.
The reporter reviewed the work of the Seventh-term Central Committee of the SWUK.
She referred to the fact that the respected ComradeKim Jong Unushered in a new heyday of the Juche-oriented women's movement and developed the women's union into a competent group of patriots promoting the comprehensive development of socialism with his outstanding ideas and deep trust in and affection for it.
She said that more than four hundreds of thousands of women's union officials and members volunteered to work at the difficult and challenging sites and made positive contributions to the successful implementation of the Five-Year Plan at the major worksites seething with enthusiasm for carrying out the decisions of the Eighth Congress of the WPK through the dynamic socialist patriotic movement, the revolutionary mass movement.
She noted that over 50 women won the Communist Mother Honor Prize for educating and brining up the rising generation to be successors who will take responsibility for the future of the revolution and many women the title of Labor Hero, the highest honor of a DPRK citizen, and other high-class state commendations for giving birth to and rearing well a large number of children.
She stressed that all the successes the SWUK made during the period under review are the shining fruition of the energetic guidance of the WPK, which wisely guided the women's union to remarkably enhance its fighting efficiency at the crucial period of turn in our revolution.
The report analyzed and reviewed a series of deviations, revealed by women's union organizations at all levels during the period under review, and their causes on the basis of detailed data and referred to the practical ways for putting the SWUK work on the track of new qualitative development.
The reporter stressed that our state, the greatest in the world, would grow stronger and prosper when all the women's union officials and members fulfill their responsibility and duty they assumed before the times and history and the country and steadily carry on the tradition of loyalty and patriotism.
Speeches were made on the first agenda item.
20 delegates including Han Hye Sun, delegate of the women's union organization of North Phyongan Province, Jon Song Ok, delegate of the women's union organization of South Hamgyong Province and Ri Hyang Suk, delegate of the women's union organization of Pyongyang Municipality, made speeches or presented written speeches.
The congress discussed the revision of the SWUK Rules as its second agenda item.
There was a report on the revision of the women's union rules.
The reporter submitted the revised rules for deliberation at the congress.
The congress adopted a decision on the revision of the SWUK Rules with unanimous approbation.
The congress discussed the election of the SWUK central leadership body as the third agenda item.
First, the Central Committee of the SWUK was elected.
All the recommended candidates were elected members and alternate members of the SWUK Central Committee with the unanimous approval of the delegates.
The First Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the SWUK was held.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, informed the participants of the decision of the plenary meeting.
The Executive Committee of the SWUK Central Committee was elected.
Jon Hyang Sun was elected chairwoman of the SWUK Central Committee and Cha Hyon OK, Ri Hyang Suk, Ri Sun Ok and Ri Hae Im were elected vice-chairwomen.
The Organizing Committee of the SWUK Central Committee was formed.
The chairwoman, vice-chairwomen and members of the Central Inspection Commission of the SWUK were elected.
Department directors of the SWUK Central Committee were appointed.
The congress elected a committee for drafting the decision of the congress with members of the newly elected eighth-term central leadership body of the SWUK, and the committee deliberated the realistic and constructive opinions raised by delegates and supplemented the draft resolution with them.
The decision of the Eighth Congress of the SWUK was adopted with unanimous approval. -0-

headline: Chinese Party and Government Delegation Arrives
Jo Yong Won, Secretary of C.C., WPK Has Talks with Wang Huning, Chairman of National Committee of CPPCC
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 16 (KCNA) -- Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, had talks with Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on July 15.
Jo Yong Won said that the ever-changing present international political situation has required the two countries to further strengthen the militant unity, support and solidarity and steadily intensify and develop the friendly and cooperative relations for the victorious advance of the common cause of socialism in conformity with the basic spirit of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Noting that the DPRK-China friendly relations have greeted the new period of vitality of their development under the direct concern and wise leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unand Comrade Xi Jinping, he expressed the stand to expand and develop the bilateral relations in a many-sided way while maintaining close strategic communications and tactical cooperation between the two parties and two countries.
Wang Huning said that the conclusion of the treaty between China and the DPRK laid a legal foundation to consolidate the militant friendship formed at the cost of blood, stressing that it is an important common understanding of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries to splendidly mark the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the treaty.
He affirmed the will of the Chinese party and government to regard it as the fundamental principle to implement the important agreement reached in the historic Pyongyang meeting between the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, which wrote a beautiful chapter in the history of the traditional China-DPRK friendship and injected the powerful energy into it and promote the China-DPRK relations onto a higher stage.
The talks discussed the issues of promoting the wellbeing of the two countries by strengthening party exchange between the two parties and two countries and deepening cooperation in economy, culture and all other fields.
The talks proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere.
Present at the talks from the DPRK side were Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, and Kim Myong Su, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, and Kang Chol Ho, vice-minister of the Ministry of Urban Management, and from the Chinese side Wang Dongfeng, vice-chairman and secretary general of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Qi Yu, secretary of the Party Committee of the Foreign Ministry, Pei Jinjia, minister of Veterans Affairs, and other leading members of the party and government delegation of the PRC and Chinese Ambassador to the DPRK Wang Yajun.
The Central Committee of the WPK and the government of the DPRK gave a reception in welcome of the party and government delegation of the PRC that evening. -0-
