headline: Chinese Party and Government Delegation Arrives
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 16 (KCNA) -- At the invitation of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the DPRK, a party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, arrived here on July 15 to pay an official goodwill visit to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and attend the celebrations of the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Accompanying Wang Huning are Wang Dongfeng, vice-chairman and secretary general of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Liu Haixing, head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee, and other suite members.
The national flags of the DPRK and the PRC were fluttering at the flagstaffs of Pyongyang International Airport and the guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the apron of the airport.
The delegation was warmly greeted by Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the C.C., the WPK, Kim Myong Su, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and his embassy members.
A woman worker presented a bouquet to Wang Huning.
The masses welcomed the friendly guests of China, waving national flags of the two countries and bouquets. -0-

headline: Party and Government Delegation of PRC Visits Cemetery of CPV Fallen Soldiers
PresidentKim Il SungRemembered Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- Memorial meetings, seminars, lectures, photo exhibitions and film shows took place in Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Iceland and Finland from July 5 to 8 on the occasion of the 32nd anniversary of demise of PresidentKim Il Sung.
Present at the events were personages of political parties and organizations and members of Juche idea study organizations and friendship and solidarity organizations in those countries.
Screened at film shows were videos dealing with the popular career and exploits of the President.
Speeches were made at the events.
The chairman of the Ostfold County Committee of the Communist Party of Norway praised PresidentKim Il Sungas a great revolutionary and peerless patriot who led the Korean revolution to victory and devoted his whole life to the country and people under the uplifted banner of Juche.
The chairman of the Denmark-DPRK Friendship Association said that PresidentKim Il Sungclearly indicated the path to be followed by progressive mankind aspiring after independence against imperialism and actively helped the peoples of many countries in their struggle for national liberation from colonial rule. The President's exploits for accomplishing the cause of global independence are being conveyed throughout generations, the chairman added.
The chairman of the Sweden-Korea Friendship Association praised the President's exploits for national liberation, war victory and the founding of the Party, nation and army, and praised him as a peerlessly great man and outstanding state leader recognized by the world.
The chairman of the Iceland-DPRK Friendship Association said that ComradeKim Il Sung, the greatest man and peerless statesman in the 20th century, devoted his whole life to the victorious advance of the Korean revolution and the world revolution, adding that his noble revolutionary spirit, exploits and legacy have been successfully carried forward by ComradeKim Jong Iland ComradeKim Jong Un. He expressed belief that the Korean people would more dynamically advance along the road of independence and socialism, rallied close around their leader.
Messages to the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwere adopted at the events. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Major Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- Young people in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK have volunteered for worksites of socialist construction.
An official of primary organization of the youth league volunteered to work at a farm.
Other youths and youth league members vowed to work at construction brigades, farms and raw material base stations, out of their mind to contribute to the national prosperity and the regional development.
A meeting was held at the Municipal Cultural Hall on July 15 to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Kaesong Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the youth league, youth and students.
Petition certificates were awarded to the volunteers and a congratulatory address and resolution-making speeches were made at the meeting.
After a congratulatory performance, officials, youth and students saw the volunteers off, presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on RIMPAC
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- The U.S. and many other countries have staged RIMPAC, the largest-ever joint naval drill in the world since June 24, raising violent waves of aggravated tension in the Pacific.
The drill will continue in vast waters off Hawaii and the Pacific until July 31, with over 30 warships of various missions, 5 submarines, over 200 fighters and 30 000 troops involved.
The U.S. described the drill as an opportunity for special training aimed at strengthening the joint forces of the allies for "free and open Indo-Pacific".
It is tantamount to an admission that RIMPAC is not a customary drill against a potential enemy but a special war rehearsal of the U.S. and its vassal forces targeting the regional states, main obstacles to the realization of the U.S. Asia-Pacific strategy.
It is clearly evidenced by the number of participating countries in the drill and its scale.
The puppet ROK is taking part in the drill as a main force for the first time and the participating countries, including the defeated countries Japan, Germany and Italy, number a total of 30, the largest in its history.
And we cannot remain a passive onlooker to the drill as it is timed to coincide with the moves of the warmongers of the puppet ROK, the war criminal state Japan and NATO. In other words the ROK making more frantic efforts for the confrontation with the DPRK, and Japan running amuck to turn itself into a military power are getting evermore undisguised in their moves for the military nexus, and the ROK, Japan and NATO are getting evermore pronounced in their attempt to strengthen the military cooperation.
The contents and form of the drill are also a source of serious concern.
The preemptive attack elements the U.S., the ROK and Japan mastered in aggressive war exercises like Ulji Freedom Shield and Freedom Edge have been introduced into the whole course of RIMPAC including ground and landing drills, etc.
Based on the experience in modern warfare, the drill has set it as its important part to apply artificial intelligence and practice the integrated operation of unmanned and manned weapon systems.
In particular, the U.S. and ROK marines staged a combined air mobility and air assault exercise under the simulated conditions of "infiltrating the area behind the enemy line" at the U.S. Navy's amphibious assaulting ship Essex as part of RIMPAC.
What merits more serious attention is that the U.S. Navy's nuclear carrier Theodore Roosevelt is playing a main role in the drill and fanning up the war fever in the combined operation with the war stooges.
As a result, the Pacific has turned into a battlefield permeated with the smell of gunpowder, unlike its name.
All the facts indicate who is undermining the basis of the global peace and security and predict that an undesirable contingency may occur soon in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the region.
It is obvious that the countries in the region will never look on with folded arms at the largest-ever war drill being staged by the most outrageous rogue-led group of stooges and other countries from across the ocean.
The regional countries will take a series of proportional countermeasures to determinedly contain and control the reckless act of the rogues in the world.
It is the inviolable independent right of the relevant countries to beef up the war deterrent in order to protect their sovereignty and security interests and regional peace and stability from military challenges and threats of all the hostile forces.
Explicitly speaking, the U.S. and its vassal forces must take the blame for the unpredictable escalation of the tensions in the region. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Pak Kum Ok, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 51 in Ryusa-dong No. 2, Hanggu District, Nampho Municipality of the DPRK.
The centenarian expressed her gratitude to the respected MarshalKim Jong Un, deeply moved by the great loving care of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Born into a poor peasant's family during the Japanese imperialist colonial rule, she had to undergo the sorrow of a stateless nation in an alien land. She could lead a genuine life as a human being only after the liberation of the country.
Through her life, she keenly felt the gratitude for the WPK, which makes selfless, devoted efforts for the good of the people, and the socialist system. She devoted herself to the prosperity of the country.
Officials of the Hanggu District Party Committee and villagers visited the centenarian's house to congratulate her. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- A party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK visited the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea on Thursday.
Being briefed on the fact that the school has developed into the highest seat of training Party cadres which ensures the organizational and ideological consolidation of the Party and its governing activities through educational practices and academic studies, the members of the delegation went round various places such as a library.

headline: Reception Given to Mark 65th Anniversary of Conclusion of DPRK-China Treaty
Reception Given to Mark 65th Anniversary of Conclusion of DPRK-China Treaty
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- A reception was given at Yanggakdo International Hotel on Thursday to mark the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Present there were a party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, vice-president of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK and premier of the Cabinet, made a speech at the reception.
He said that the visit to the DPRK by the party and government delegation of the PRC marked a significant occasion in splendidly commemorating the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance and demonstrating the strategic character of the treaty and the vitality of the DPRK-China friendship.
He said that the DPRK-China friendship has entered a new stage of development in various fields under the direct guidance of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, expressing the steadfast stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to steadily develop the friendly and cooperative relations with socialism as the core.
He expressed the will to firmly join hands with the Chinese comrades as ever in the course of actively promoting the co-prosperity and new development of friendship of the two countries, opposing hegemonism and victoriously advancing the socialist cause.
Next, Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, made a speech.
He said that the treaty is an important legal foundation for the development of the friendly relations between the two countries, adding that the peoples of the two countries have shared life and death and formed great militant friendship at the cost of blood in the struggle for achieving national independence and the liberation of the countries.
He said it is a vivid feature of the relations between China and the DPRK that they support and cooperate with each other, share destiny and protect and help each other, adding that Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping and Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unmet seven times to lead the traditional China-DPRK friendship to open a new chapter of history.
He said that the firm stand of the Chinese party and government placing great importance on China-DPRK friendship will remain unchanged and the firm support for the cause of Korean socialism led by Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwill never be changed, adding that the Chinese side will, together with the DPRK side, hold aloft the banner of socialism and ensure that the baton of Chinese-DPRK friendship is handed down through generations.
The participants in the reception toasted the eternal DPRK-China friendship and prosperity of the two countries.
A performance was given by the Ensemble of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK.
The reception proceeded in a comradely and friendly atmosphere. -0-

Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Communist Party of Belarus led by Sergei Syrankov, first secretary of the Party Central Committee, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Thursday to pay tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnMeets Chinese Party and Government Delegation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Thursday received a party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Communist Party of China and chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK to mark the 65th anniversary of the conclusion of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance.
Present there was Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK.
ComradeKim Jong Ungladly met and exchanged warm greetings with Wang Huning and leading members of the delegation.
Wang Huning courteously conveyed the best wishes and comradely greetings from Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the PRC, to ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed deep thanks for it and asked Wang Huning to convey his greetings to Comrade Xi Jinping.
Warmly welcoming the visit of the party and government delegation of the PRC to the DPRK, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid with high appreciation that it is a manifestation of the steadfast will to attach importance to the DPRK-China relations and definitely implement the agreements made during the Pyongyang summit that Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping dispatched the high-ranking party and government delegation headed by Wang Huning to the DPRK.
Noting that the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, an inter-state treaty which defines the strategic character of the bilateral relations and advances its strategic direction, has played an important role in defending the basic interests of the two countries and ensuring the regional and global peace and security, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that it is the steadfast policy of the WPK and the DPRK government to more vigorously develop the traditional friendly and cooperative relations with socialism as a core in several fields on the basis of the spirit of the treaty and in line with the requirement of the changing times and the aspiration and desire of the two peoples.
Expressing thanks to the Party, government and people of the DPRK for giving the delegation a cordial reception, Wang Huning expressed the readiness to comprehensively implement all the important common understanding and agreements the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries reached in the historic Pyongyang meeting and thus promote the political mutual trust and bilateral solidarity and expand and develop the mutual collaboration and cooperation.
ComradeKim Jong Unaffirmed that the WPK and the DPRK government would as ever support the socialist cause with the Chinese characteristics in the new era led by Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping, sincerely hoping that the Chinese people, who significantly celebrated the 105th anniversary of the foundation of the CPC, would make greater achievements in the historic course of comprehensively building a modern socialist power and achieving the great prosperity of the Chinese nation under the leadership of the CPC. -0-

headline: Young People Meet with War Veterans
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- Youth and students in Jagang Province of the DPRK held a meeting with war veterans on July 16 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
At the meeting, the war veterans said that the miraculous victory won by the DPRK in the Fatherland Liberation War is the victory of the outstanding military idea, Juche-based war methods and superb strategy and tactics of PresidentKim Il Sungand a brilliant fruition of patriotism and staunch spirit of defending the country displayed by the army and people rallied close around the leader.
They told about the feats they performed in the days when they defeated the aggressors while breaking through the flames of fierce battles with the love for their grateful social system, hometowns, workplaces and parents and siblings and the hatred for the enemies trying to deprive them of all.
They called upon the younger generation to glorify their youth on the road of defending the country, deeply mindful of the truth of history that only when they fight with powerful force can they defend the sovereignty of the country and the happiness of the people.
Young speakers expressed their resolve to devote their all to the sacred road of defending the country like the war veteran generation and perform miracles and feats with youthful vigor and mass heroism in every field for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The war veterans handed over the national flag of the DPRK, calling upon all the youth and students to uphold the ideology and leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwith single-minded loyalty. -0-

headline: Party and Government Delegation of PRC Visits Cemetery of CPV Fallen Soldiers
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 17 (KCNA) -- A party and government delegation of the People's Republic of China led by Wang Huning, chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK laid a flower basket at the Cemetery of the Fallen Soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers in Sunan District, Pyongyang Municipality on Thursday.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnMeets and Has Photo Session with Participants in Eighth SWUK Congress
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met with the participants in the Eighth Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea on July 17.
The venue for the photo session was overflowing with the great excitement and joy of women's union officials and members who were waiting for the moment of glory and happiness, their earnest desire, after attending the significant congress held amid the great interest and congratulation of all other people of the country.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", looking up to the tender-hearted father who put forward our women before the era and has shown them great trust and love.
An official of the women's union respectfully presented a bouquet of fragrant flowers to him, representing boundless reverence and best wishes for him.
ComradeKim Jong Uncongratulated the newly elected chairwoman and vice-chairwomen of the Eighth Central Committee of the SWUK, shaking hands with them.
He extended warm greetings of encouragement to the participants, who displayed through the largest-ever gathering in the history of the women's union the noble loyalty, preeminent revolutionary spirit, inexhaustible might of unity and patriotic enthusiasm of the Korean women unconditionally supporting what the Party is determined to do and faithfully carrying it out and successfully completed the work of the congress.
The past five years which have passed along with the great pioneering period of comprehensive rejuvenation are clearly associated with the devoted efforts of our strongest, steadfast, diligent and resourceful women who dynamically accelerated the advance of the country, he said, adding that the role of the women's union as educator and organizer and mobilizer obviously proved that when the women unite with a single will and intention and pool their wisdom, strength and enthusiasm, they can surmount any difficulties and realize any ideals.
It is our Party's highest pride and our state's great strength to have the women's organization full of the noble spirit of firmly trusting and following our Party only and passionately loving and defending socialism, a powerful group of women patriots without a parallel in their active role and fighting efficiency, he noted.
Our Party's great historic cause will be successfully accomplished and our state's dignity and might more fully demonstrated as our women are adding to beauty and freshness of their families and the society and giving steady continuity to the generation of patriotism and revolution with the noble viewpoint on life intended to place the duty to repay above the right to enjoy and feel a sense of pride of genuine life and joy on the road of patriotism and with the genuine maternal affection, he stressed
The gigantic struggle for transformation in the new era highlights the need to further strengthen the women's union in charge of a part of the revolution, he said, stating that the women's union organizations at all levels should first of all concentrate on the ideological education so as to firmly maintain the revolutionary nature, pure mind and beauty of our women who regard the Party's lines and policies as their faith and advance along only the road indicated by the Party.
He expressed the expectation and belief that all the women's union officials and members would always keep in mind their missions and duties they assumed before the era and the revolution, their families and society and become genuine patriots making a tangible contribution to the prosperity of the country always with a single mind and intention, and communist mothers and educators bringing their children up to be fine ones. And then he had a photo taken with them.
After the photo session, the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers, expressing their faith and will to firmly unite under the banner of the WPK and greet all happiness and glory under its loving care.
ComradeKim Jong Unwaved back to and extended warm encouragement to the participants who were raising stormy cheers in expression of their ardent loyalty and patriotic enthusiasm.
All the participants hardened their iron will to fully display with redoubled self-confidence and exertion the fighting efficiency of the women's union in the worthwhile struggle for the prosperity of our great state and the happiness and bright future of the rising generations. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Victorious Sandinist People's Revolution Celebrated in DPRK

The plane carrying the Chinese friendship mission left Wonsan amid the send-off by the masses. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesman for DPRK Ministry of National Defence
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement on Saturday:
The U.S.-Japan-ROK military collusion, which has recently been taking a more dangerous form with a nuclear element in it, is the root cause of undermining peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region.
At the U.S.-Japan-ROK Trilateral Chiefs of Defence meeting held in Washington on July 15, the enemy countries agreed to further strengthen the tripartite military cooperation, including the holding of Freedom Edge, the multi-domain joint military exercises targeting regional countries, taking issue with the constitutional position of the DPRK.
This clearly shows the invariable hostile attempt of the U.S., Japan and the ROK to attain a military superiority in the region and seek their hegemonic geopolitical interests through intensified trilateral military cooperation.
The DPRK Ministry of National Defence cautions about the danger of the provocative trilateral military cooperation that creates a possibility for worrisome military confrontation and conflict in the Korean peninsula and gives a stern warning about its negative consequences for the regional security environment.
The U.S.-Japan-ROK military nexus and war drills openly disregarding the security concerns of regional countries are persistently deteriorating the security environment in the Korean peninsula and the region.
On July 13 the U.S. and the ROK launched Buddy Squadron air drills aimed at increasing the joint attack capability and staged the largest-ever Combined Joint Sustainment Training with more than 4 400 troops and over 600 warships and planes involved.
And the U.S. permanently deployed Los Angeles-class nuclear attack submarine on Guam as part of its effort to bolster underwater combat strength in the western Pacific and is now staging RIMPAC, the largest-ever multinational joint naval drill in the world led by the U.S., Japan and the ROK, in the waters off Hawaii.
We can never remain indifferent to the serious security challenge posed by the U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military cooperation, which is being integrated and developed in an offensive way day by day under the manipulation of the U.S., to the Korean peninsula and the region beyond it.
The DPRK reaffirms its stand to deter the military moves of the enemy countries and thoroughly manage the security environment in the Korean peninsula with its responsible will and effective actions to cope with the prevailing threat.
Proceeding from the viewpoint of powerful strength, the armed forces of the DPRK will never allow the imbalance of force in the region forced by the U.S.-Japan-ROK military nexus and always remain faithful to the constitutional mission to neutralize the actual security challenges and potential threats and reliably defend the security of the country and the regional peace. -0-

headline: Military Miracles in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- Even in the crucible of the Fatherland Liberation War, PresidentKim Il Sungturned adversity into a favorable condition with his outstanding military strategy and tactics and seasoned commanding art, thus opening up the phase of victory in the war on his own initiative.
The U.S. imperialists once launched the "Thanksgiving Day offensive" aimed to fulfill its ambition to finish the Korean War before the Thanksgiving Day and occupy the whole of Korea. They were bringing huge aggression troops into the north in an attempt to occupy the Unsan area by hurling main units into it and then break through the defence line of the Korean People's Army in cooperation with other units.
The President set forth the strategic policy for the third stage of the war to bring about a radical turn in the war situation and took a measure to open up a prelude for a re-advance in the Unsan area. He personally went to the forefront command post to learn about the topography of the Unsan area and ordered to encircle and annihilate the enemies through ambush and surprise attack.
By the order of the President, the KPA started general counterattack in the Unsan area on October 25, 1950.
The KPA soldiers displayed matchless bravery and mass heroism to mercilessly wipe out the enemies.
In the battle in the Unsan area, the Second Corps of the ROK puppet army consisting of two divisions and 6 regiments was totally destroyed except two regiments. The eighth cavalry regiment of the U.S. first cavalry division, which was dispatched to fill in for the collapsed right flank of the U.S. Eighth Army, was encircled and annihilated by the People's Army as soon as it appeared in the battlefield. The First Corps of the U.S. imperialist aggression army also suffered a heavy blow.
The enemies recorded the defeat in the area of Unsan as a "tragedy of Unsan".
Upset by the "tragedy of Unsan", Walker, commander of the U.S. Eighth Army, ordered all units to retreat.
The powerful counterattack of the KPA frustrated the enemy’s attack and foiled the US imperialists’ attempt to conclude the Korean War before the Thanksgiving Day.
Under the wise guidance of PresidentKim Il Sung, the battle in the Unsan area, a prelude to a new counteroffensive operation, was successfully concluded. -0-

headline: Construction of Compound Granulated Fertilizer Production Base Hastened in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 18 (KCNA) -- The construction of compound granulated fertilizer production base is progressing apace in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The completion of the compound granulated fertilizer production base with a capacity of tens of thousands of tons will bring about a prospect for boosting the per-hectare yield in wheat and barley farming by mass-producing and supplying the fertilizer with nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium as the basic ingredients.
The provincial rural economy committee in charge of capital construction organized a powerful construction force and gave precedence to the supply of materials to push ahead with the 10-odd projects in a three-dimensional way and a lightening tempo, thus completing the construction work in the main in a short span of time.
The manufactory of high-tech goods under the provincial science and technology commission, the Sariwon Equipment Assembly Station, the Sariwon Boiler Factory and other units are conducting a fierce 24-7 struggle to carry out the production of custom-built equipment and the Singye Apatite Mine is hastening the project for expanding its production capacity.
The Sariwon Organic Compound Fertilizer Factory in charge of assembling equipment is speeding up the assembling of equipment while introducing valuable technical innovation proposals to improve the automation level of production processes and ensure quality indices of products. -0-

Speeches were made at the event.
The ambassador referred to the feats performed by the Sandinist National Liberation Front and the fighters in the resistance struggle in overthrowing the pro-U.S. dictatorial regime and opening the road to the building of a new free, equal society.
He expressed the stand to strengthen and develop friendly relations with other countries in the efforts to build a free and righteous society.
Jong Tong Hak referred to the fact that PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilassisted materially and morally the Sandinist people's revolution and the respected ComradeKim Jong Unis paying close attention to developing the ties between the two countries.
He wished the Nicaraguan people success in their efforts to defend the sovereignty of the country and achieve the socio-economic development.

headline: Indoor Swimming Pool
story_text:
One day in October 2014, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Undropped into Wisong Primary School when he was inspecting newly built Wisong Scientists Residential District.
He entered the indoor swimming pool of the school and examined its interior. And then he looked at its window.
He told the officials that it is difficult to ensure the proper temperature in the indoor swimming pool in winter because of the large window, adding it is useless as there are lighting apparatus in the swimming pool.
After learning about the heating system in the indoor swimming pool, he pointed out that it was not designed to have a water heater and use it in winter, early spring and late autumn. He said that if it is intended to use it only in summer, it would be better to build an outdoor swimming pool.
He stressed that the indoor swimming pool should be used in all seasons, adding that if it is difficult to establish an underground heating system for the swimming pool, it is necessary to build a water-hearting house next to the swimming pool in order to ensure the proper temperature in it.
The officials were deeply moved by what he said to provide the rising generations with a perfect structure. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 19 (KCNA) -- The Japanese imperialists, who illegally occupied Korea in last century, committed all sorts of vicious crimes to prevent the Korean people from building a new country before their defeat.
Among them is the crime of deliberately destroying the industrial establishments in Korea.
The Japanese imperialists completely destroyed tens of major equipment and converters, including more than ten compressors at the then Hungnam Fertilizer Factory.
They pulled down 19 hydroelectric power stations and exploded power and transformer facilities at various power stations.
They submerged or destroyed 164 coal mines including Kowon Coal Mine and 178 mines including Unryul Mine. They also mercilessly destroyed railway factories, tunnels, railways, locomotives and wagons.
A typical example is that they drove a train carrying blasting powder into a tunnel of Saenggi Hill in Kyongsong County, North Hamgyong Province and exploded it and throw into the sea all the machinery and equipment of the then Rajin Railway Factory.
They took away all the available vehicles when they run away.
Soon after the liberation of the country on August 15, 1945, there was no vehicle and facilities in the railway sector, and the railway operation came to standstill.
Such situation of railway transport, which accounted for over 90 per cent of the total passenger and freight transport, seriously hindered our people’s struggle for building a new society and the overall development of the national economy.
The Korean people can not rehabilitate the destroyed factories and enterprises because of the shortage of transport and operate the factories owing to the failure of the transport of raw and other fuel and other materials to the production places in time.
The Japanese imperialists thoroughly destroyed water transport facilities.
At the time of their defeat, they buried 70 machine ships amounting to 99 000 tons at sea in various ports and destroyed facilities including Chongjin and Rajin ports and small ferry facilities used in river transport.
The destruction of the industrial establishments in Korea is a hideous criminal act to prevent the Korean people from using them as an economic basis for political independence and as material means for creating a new life and improving their well-being after the liberation of the country. -0-

The first secretary of the Khabarovsk Territorial Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation said:
The august name of ComradeKim Il Sung, the most prominent leader in the 20th century and peerlessly great man who made immortal contributions to the accomplishment of the cause of global independence, is deeply cherished in the minds of mankind.
The eye-opening development of the DPRK would have been unthinkable without his wise leadership.
It is one of his exploits that he laid a firm foundation for the traditional Russia-DPRK friendly relations and handed them down to posterity.
The chairwoman and the vice chairman of the Party for Peace and Unity and the chairperson of the Khabarovsk Youth Association for the Study of the Juche Idea praised PresidentKim Il Sungas the founder of the glorious Democratic People's Republic of Korea, distinguished political activist and the greatest man who ushered in the era of independence by founding the Juche idea.
The chairperson of the Maritime Territorial Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity"  and the chairman of the Russian Association for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the Korean people are dynamically advancing along the road of independent development under the wise leadership of ComradeKim Jong Unwho is carrying forward ComradeKim Il Sung's ideology and cause of the anti-imperialist independence, though the U.S. and other imperialists are carrying on the whole gamut of intrigues to stifle the DPRK. headline: Military Miracles in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 20 (KCNA) -- The "general Christmas offensive," which the U.S. imperialists had frantically prepared with their huge ground, naval and air forces, was brought to total bankruptcy by the Juche-oriented military tactics and commanding art of PresidentKim Il Sungduring the Fatherland Liberation War.
In late October 1950, the U.S. imperialists failed to realize their ambition for occupying whole Korea before Thanksgiving due to the Korean People's Army's strike. Then they attempted to launch a large-scale "general Christmas offensive" in November.
The "general Christmas offensive" was a plan of attack for "concluding the war" by occupying the areas of the Amnok and Tuman rivers before Christmas.
To this end, the U.S. imperialists brought five corps to the front and bragged about numerical and technical superiority.
To cope with the enemy's "general offensive", the President set forth the policy of the second-round operation for the third stage of the war. With the main strike direction fixed in the western sector of the front, the policy called for launching counterattack in all sectors of the front, encircling and annihilating the main groups of the enemy and liberating the whole area of the DPRK through joint operations of the main units of the People's Army and the second front units.
The President set the night of November 25, a day after the enemy's start of the "general offensive" in the western sector of the front, as the counterattack time. He made sure that the combined units in the eastern sector of the front launched successive counterattacks, following the combined units in the western sector of the front expanding achievements in the main strike direction.
When the enemy launched the "general offensive", the units of the People's Army in the main strike direction of the front responded with a counteroffensive. The People's Army encircled and annihilated the enemy forces under the U.S. Eighth Army, including the U.S. First and Ninth Corps, by driving them into the upper reaches of the Chongchon and Taedong rivers, thus pushing the main enemy forces in the western sector of the front to the brink of total ruin.
The units of the People's Army in the eastern sector of the front also encircled and annihilated through assault and ambush the main forces of the U.S. Tenth Corps, including the First Division of the U.S. Marines, near Lake Jangjin.
Steadily expanding the gains, the units of the People's Army annihilated the enemy in cooperation with the second front units in the rear of the enemy, smashed the U.S. imperialists' "general Christmas offensive" until December 24 that year and achieved such a proud success as liberating the whole territory of the Republic.
After all, the "general Christmas offensive" prepared by the U.S. imperialists with much effort ended in their general retreat. For this, MacArthur, commander of the U.S. forces in the Far East and commander of the "UN forces," was given the  "honour" of dismissal, and Smith, commander of the First Division of the U.S. Marines, who had most of his officers and soldiers buried on the shore of Lake Jangjin, was given such disgraceful title as "grave general". -0-

headline: Press Statement on Third Strategic Dialogue between Foreign Ministers of DPRK and Russian Federation
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 21 (KCNA) -- A press statement on the third strategic dialogue between the foreign ministers of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation was issued on July 20.
The press statement is as follows:
The third strategic dialogue between Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and Sergey Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, was held in Moscow on July 20 at a time when the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries is vigorously developing thanks to the strategic guidance of the heads of state of the two countries.
The strategic dialogue between the two foreign ministers involved constructive and beneficial strategic communication, with the main emphasis on the implementation of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries, high-level visits, the plan for multi-faceted cooperation between the two countries and diplomatic coordination on major international issues of mutual concern, and reached a consensus on all the issues brought up for discussion.
Acknowledging that the comradely relations of friendship between the heads of state of the two countries serve as the most powerful driving force for guaranteeing the durable and future-oriented development of the DPRK-Russia relations, the two sides reaffirmed their steadfast political will to accelerate the long-term multi-faceted development of the bilateral relations, irrespective of the changing situation, under the strategic guidance at the highest level.
The side of the Russian Federation expressed full support for all efforts and measures of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to oppose all hostile acts posing a serious threat to its present position and the right to development and defend its national sovereign rights and security interests.
The DPRK side expressed invariable support for all the internal and external policies of the Russian Federation to eliminate the root cause of the Ukrainian dispute and defend its national sovereignty, territorial integrity and international justice from the imperialist moves for hegemony.
To cope with the development of the situation having negative influence on global peace and stability, the two sides agreed to defend the purpose and principles of the UN Charter and other international law with sovereignty equality and non-interference in internal affairs as the core, find solutions to effectively counter the regional and global security challenges and continue the exchange of views between the external policy organs of the two countries including the strategic dialogue at ministerial level.
The third strategic dialogue between the foreign ministers of the DPRK and Russia serves as a significant occasion for further accelerating the comprehensive expansion and development of the bilateral relations and making positive contributions to ensuring regional and global peace and security in conformity with the spirit of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership. -0-

headline: Story about Tile Carton
story_text:

headline: Military Miracles in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 22 (KCNA) -- During the Fatherland Liberation War, PresidentKim Il Sungadvanced the original tunnel tactics, which can be called a model of unique defence warfare, so that the Korean People's Army repelled the U.S. imperialist aggressors superior in terms of their number and technology. It was a military miracle in history of wars.
The U.S. imperialists suffered an irretrievable military and political defeat one year after their provocation of the Korean war. Nevertheless, they did not abandon their ambition to occupy the DPRK and made desperate efforts to expand the war.
At that time the war dragged on and the warring parties were standing in confrontation with one another. To cope with the new military and political situation, the President put forward the original tunnel tactics to dig tunnels and take an initiative in fighting by using them as main defense positions.
The tactics were Juche-oriented one of our own style that made it possible to keep our armed forces to the maximum and hold the initiative in the war, driving back the enemy's attacks.
The advantages and vitality of the tactics were fully demonstrated in the whole period of the 4th stage of the Fatherland Liberation War (June 11, 1951-July 27, 1953).
In September 1951, the President personally came to the Height 1211 in the eastern part of the front and indicated the orientation and ways to smash the U.S. imperialists' "autumn offensive" and took measures to tunnel the defensive positions.
As a result, the tunnel-type positions were built on the main front, and, in particular, tunnels of various shapes and sizes were dug under the tactically important heights. And they were combined with field positions to form a solid system of positions.
In 1952 alone, the U.S. imperialists dropped 4 160 bombs, fired 527 260 shells and machine-gunned more than 1 810 bullets per one square kilometer on Height 1211 and the surrounding area.
The defenders of Height 1211 turned the enemy's indiscriminate bombing, shelling and "attack in waves" into a useless ones by relying on the solid tunnel-type defense positions. More than 29 000 enemy soldiers were killed or taken captive, at least 40 enemy planes shot down and over 60 enemy tanks and many other weapons and combat and technical equipment captured and destroyed.
Ridgway, the then war chief of the U.S. imperialists, screamed that the tunnel-type defence line of the People's Army would be the most powerful one known to the world. -0-

headline: Remains of Martyrs Newly Buried at Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 22 (KCNA) -- Remains of martyrs were buried at the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. They are Ji Chon Ryul and Kim Pong Guan, heroes of the DPRK.
In the days of the hard-fought Fatherland Liberation War, the martyrs performed heroic feats in the decisive struggle against the imperialist aggressors, true to the outstanding military idea and Juche-based tactics of PresidentKim Il Sung.
From June to December 1951, Ji Chon Ryul was awarded the title of DPRK Hero for his feats of shooting down eight enemy planes. Later, he shot down several enemy planes in an aircraft-hunting team.
In 1953, Kim Pong Gwan joined a sniper team and performed a brilliant feat of shooting 160 enemy soldiers in a little over six months during the war and worked hard for the prosperity of the country after the war.
Ceremonies for burying the remains of the martyrs took place at the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on July 21.
The remains of the wife of Kim Pong Gwan were buried together. Remains of the wives of the already-buried martyrs Cha Ho Nam, Kim Kwang Su, Ri Wan Gun, Chae Jong Bo, Choe Un Hak and Ri Hui Gap were buried with their husbands'.
The participants in the ceremonies laid bouquets at the tombstones of the martyrs and paid silent tribute. -0-

headline: Young Students in S. Hamgyong Province Solve Sci-tech Problems
story_text:

Students of Hamhung University of Computer Science, Tanchon College of Technology, Pukchong College of Technology and Hamhung Branch of University of Sciences solved technical problems for promoting regional development by intensifying the researches into advanced science and technology. -0-

headline: Party and State Commendations Awarded to Creative Units, Officials and Creators of Mansudae Art Studio
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 22 (KCNA) -- The Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations is a sacred one showing the invincible militant spirit and might of the heroic Korean People's Army and the height of loyalty of the army boundlessly faithful to the call of the country.
With the noble mission of proudly engraving in history the matchless bravery and mass heroism displayed by the proud sons of this country as the banner of sure victory, the officials and creators of the Mansudae Art Studio devoted their sincerity to successfully erecting the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats as a great monument of the times.

After a decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was read out, the sculpture creation group and others were awarded the citation of the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, Order of National Flag First Class and the title of Merited Creators' Group.
Order ofKim Jong Ilwas conferred on Kim Chun Ryong and the watch bearing the august name of ChairmanKim Jong Ilwent to Kim Myong Chol.

headline: Disaster Prevention Campaign Brisk in DPRK
Samdaem Sand Bath in Kaesong
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 23 (KCNA) -- The Samdaem sand bath is one of the customs handed down from olden times among the people in Kaesong area. And they usually have the sand bath during the hottest period of summer every year.
Samdaem is the name of the long sandy beach along the Mammy stream 4 km away from the centre of Kaesong Municipality. Its meaning is that it is second in the health benefits only to insam (Korean ginseng).
The sand there contains various mineral components.
The water flowing into the sandy beach also contains several ingredients, thus enhancing its medicinal value.
The treatment method is as follows:
Cover the whole body or a part of the body to be treated with the sand heated to 40-45°C. After about 10 minutes, wash the whole body clean in running water. Do the same three times a day for three days.
The Samdaem sand bath is efficacious for neuralgia, arthritis, chronic gastritis, arteriosclerosis, slipped disk, chronic bronchitis and other diseases.
Kaesong Municipality remodeled the sand beach and built service facilities and treatment places for the convenience of the people.
The Samdaem sand bath was registered as a part of local intangible cultural heritage of the DPRK in 2016. -0-

Being briefed on the fact that PresidentKim Il Sung, invincible and iron-willed commander, performed immortal exploits before the times and history by leading the war to the victory, they looked round various places of the site.

headline: Natural History Museum in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 24 (KCNA) -- It has been ten years since the completion of the Natural History Museum, a complex for disseminating the knowledge of natural science and a special base for cultural and leisure activities, at the foot of Mt Taesong in Pyongyang Municipality.
Over 2.8 million working people, youth and students visited the museum to acquire a diverse and rich knowledge of nature and its evolution and development, spending a pleasant time.
As compared with the period of its completion, hundreds of scientific data were added to the museum, over 900 specimens of animals and plants of more than 200 species were newly displayed and various educational environments were additionally created.
Many visitors said that they seemed to become doctors as they get knowledge from lecturers under the excellent educational environment.
Foreigners who visited the museum said that it is the best seat for study in terms of form and contents and what is surprising is that all of the museum serve ordinary people, adding that it is a vivid expression of the true loving care shown by the respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor the people.

headline: Military Miracles in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 24 (KCNA) -- During the Fatherland Liberation War, the Korean People's Army carried out three rounds of the powerful striking operations on the whole front from May to July 1953 according to the operational plan of PresidentKim Il Sung. They were a military offensive that enabled to hasten the final victory in the war.
In 1953 when their "New Offensive" ended in total failure, the U.S. imperialists had no option but to resume the armistice talks in April of that year. However, the talks were hindered by their unreasonable and unilateral assertions.
Meanwhile, the enemy deployed large numbers of troops on the front and launched indiscriminate bombings on the rear area of the DPRK.
To cope with the prevailing situation, the President advanced a policy on offensive operations aimed to deal a powerful military blow to the enemy on the whole front.
According to the operational policy, the KPA units carried out the first round of the striking operations from May 13 to 26, the second round from May 27 to June 15 and the third round from July 13 to 27.
They hit 21 targets 30 times to kill more than 4 000 enemy soldiers and occupy several heights in the first round and targeted 56 places over 70 times and thus killed and took captive more than 42 000 enemy soldiers, destroyed and captured a large number of combat and technical equipment and took control of 33 heights covering 55 square kilometers in the second round.
In the third round, too, they seized the areas covering 160 square kilometers including heights of strategic significance, killed and took captive more than 78 000 enemies and destroyed and captured many combat and technical equipment.
Their successful combat actions including an attack on 351 Height, a battle on 811.7 height and a battle on 339 height dealt a heavy blow to the U.S. imperialists resorting to double-dealing tactics behind the curtain of the armistice talks.
Clark, who dreamed of the honorable ceasefire, cried in panic that the merciless strike of the Korean People's Army was a moment of receiving a heavy blow from behind.
The U.S. imperialists were driven in a tight corner, forced to sign the Armistice Agreement on July 27, 1953 and our army and people won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War. -0-

headline: Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:

The DPRK respects the leading position and role of ASEAN to ensure regional peace and security on the principles of respect for sovereignty, sovereignty equality and non-interference in internal affairs and pays attention to the fact that ASEAN aspires after co-prosperity and unity as a regional community.
However, the U.S. and some countries following it are raising waves of confrontation while inciting division and antagonism, abusing the ASEAN arena as a space for justifying their evil intention, contrary to the general will of regional countries prioritizing peace, development, stability and cooperation.
The diplomatic authorities of the U.S., Japan and the ROK have resorted to the hostile rhetoric toward the DPRK, talking about "its denuclearization" and debated the issue of the Taiwan Strait under the pretext of "freedom of navigation". This proves the fact that the U.S., Japan and the ROK are the root cause of regional instability and the main obstacle to ensuring peace.
Southeast Asia can never be a region subjected to promoting the U.S. "security and prosperity" and the ASEAN arena should not be a field of searching for an opportunity of criticizing other countries and inciting hostility towards them.
The U.S.-Japan-ROK futile attempt to deny and infringe upon the constitutional rights of the DPRK can neither bring up for discussion again the issue of "denuclearization", which was irreversibly and finally concluded, nor affect the new mechanical structure of the region being built against the background of the present position of our state.
The crucial threat to be feared and guarded by the region and the international community is the exclusive security and economic bloc being formed, led by the U.S., and the attempt of Japan and the ROK systematically violating the nuclear non-proliferation system under the active patronage of the U.S. to go nuclear.
Consistent is the stand of the DPRK to develop friendly and cooperative relations with the ASEAN member states, which respect the sovereignty and right to development of our state and take friendly attitude to it, and make responsible contributions to ensuring regional peace and security.
The DPRK will as ever actively promote regional peace and development and cooperation on the principle of mutual benefit and co-prosperity, thoroughly deter any attempt of the hostile forces to encroach upon the inviolable sovereign rights of the state and firmly defend the core interests of national security. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- The Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery at the foot of Mt Sokbak in Pyongyang is a grand monument of the times built thanks to the warm revolutionary comradeship and noble obligation of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unto provide the defenders of the country in the 1950s with eternal life.
The remains of many heroic soldiers who dedicated their lives without hesitation to defending their country during the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950-July 27, 1953) were buried at the cemetery.
The respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who initiated the construction of new martyrs cemetery on the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the victory in the war, personally chose the site in a good place of the capital city and renamed the cemetery "Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery." Its original name was "Cemetery of Fallen Fighters of the Korean People's Army". He energetically guided the whole course of the construction, ranging from the layout of the graves to the design of gravestones and the style of letters to be inscribed on them.
He visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery nearing completion and said that the Workers' Party of Korea is the owner of the graves of the known and unknown fallen fighters of the People's Army who laid down their lives in the Fatherland Liberation War.
At the inauguration ceremony of the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on July 25, 2013, the respected Comrade General Secretary personally cut the inauguration tape and paid high tribute to the victors of the great years.
Visiting the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery, the Korean people deeply realize the noble obligation of the peerlessly great man, who makes sure that the revolutionary soldiers enjoy immortality under his warm loving care, and the spirit of defending the country displayed by the great wartime generation. -0-

headline: Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- The Songdowon General Foodstuff Factory in Wonsan City, Kangwon Province is renowned for its various quality foodstuffs.
Its quality products are popular among the public for being as tasty as those of the famous foodstuff factories in the capital city.
The factory manufactured and installed new high-performance equipment for streamlining the production process. It has also made progress in updating the existing instant noodle production line.
The factory was awarded the rotating pennant and citation for its best role in carrying out the national economic plan for 2025. Seven kinds of its products were registered as February 2 Goods at the National Foodstuff Exhibition-2026 held in April.

headline: Leading State Officials Visit Families of War Veterans on Occasion of Day of War Victory
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- Leading officials of the DPRK visited the families of war veterans on July 23 and 24 amid the reverence for the victorious wartime generation deepening across the country on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet, and other senior officials of the Party and government and armed forces organs warmly congratulated the veterans on the war victory day.
They talked about the boundless benevolence being shown by the Party for the war veterans, defenders of the great years and the paragons of life and struggle for all successive generations, who proudly wrote the first page of victory in the history of the Republic.
It is the due obligation and duty of the descendants to respect the victorious wartime generation who showed in practice how to defend and glorify the country, the leading officials expressed thanks, on behalf of all the people across the country, to the war veteran families who are devoting their sincerity to taking care of the war veterans.
The veterans earnestly asked the leading officials to remain loyal to the leadership of the Party Central Committee leading the country to eternal prosperity, extending deep thanks to the respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho regards them as dear teachers who made great history and brings the greatest glory and happiness to them. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Hwanghae Iron and Steel Complex
KCNA Commentary on Japan's Nuclear Policy
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 25 (KCNA) -- The present authorities of Japan are more openly revealing their ambition for nuclear weapons.
With regard to France's declaration of its plan to increase the number of nuclear warheads and the Finnish parliament's approval of a revised bill on allowing the deployment of nuclear weapons in its territory in contingency, the Japanese minister of Defence on July 17 advocated the need to change Japan's nuclear policy, saying that it is difficult for Japan to comment on the fact, but one thing that deserves comment is nuclear.
The minister of Defence, who is in charge of the security policy of Japan, unreservedly talked about the revision of nuclear policy. This is not just a slip of the tongue to the press or bombast from temerity.
No wonder, the Japanese chief executive told the House of Councilors shortly ago that revision of the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles" would be brought up for discussion alongside the revision of the three security-related documents including the national security strategy.
By making such shameless remarks, the Japanese regime has openly revealed its intention to go straight to adopt it as a major state policy decision to arm itself with nuclear weapons, which it has long dreamed of, instead of merely placing it under debate.
Japan's revision of nuclear policy just means the war criminal state's access to nuclear weapons.
As recognized by the international community, the revision of the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles" should never be Japan's "subject of debate".
Japan is a heinous war criminal state which plunged the Asia-Pacific region into a sea of blood, using warships, planes, cannons and bayonets for realizing the wild ambition to enslave all mankind a century ago. It is, at the same time, an inhuman criminal state which still denies its past crimes, distorts history and doggedly evades the legal and moral responsibility it assumes for the international community.
For the past 80 years since its defeat, the "Self-Defence Forces" of Japan have undergone a transformation from the "mainland defence type" to the "overseas attack type" aimed at launching a preemptive attack on other countries with its official right to the possession of the "capability of attacking the enemy base." The defence expenses are also hitting an all-time high every year under the deceptive veil of "exclusive defence," going far beyond the "minimum necessary limit" of a "pacifist state".
The successive rulers of Japan laid institutional and legal foundations for reinvasion bit by bit by adopting the "law on overseas dispatches", the "law to deal with contingencies in areas surrounding Japan", the "law on special measures for terrorism" and the "security legislation" alongside their persistent effort to revise the constitution.
In particular, the present ruling forces, which carried out the revision of the "Three Principles on Transfer of Defence Equipment and Technology" and its operation guidelines which stipulated the export of lethal weapons at the outset of their office, are now seeking to forcibly revise the "three principles of denuclearization". Such neo-militarist moves clearly prove that Japan, a defeated nation in Asia, is accelerating its transformation into a war state, regarding the current complicated situation as a golden opportunity for getting rid of all sorts of chains shackling its emergence as a military giant.
It is not secret that Japan has advanced nuclear technology and has stockpiled plutonium and enriched uranium that might be used in making many nuclear bombs and is capable of actualizing the mass production of nuclear weapons at any moment.
It is the immutable truth taught by history that nuclear weapons, for their tremendous destructive power, will turn into a means of tyranny against mankind if they are in the hands of injustice, but will be the greatest deterrent to injustice if they are in the hands of justice.
This is why the world people are getting increasing vocal in their demand that war criminal nation's wild ambition for nuclear weapons should be nipped in the bud for high possibility of repeating the offense.
82 local councils in the archipelago submitted a letter of opinion strongly urging the government and the diet to preserve the "three principles of denuclearization" and the public is blaming the authorities for seeking to "restore the politics deceiving the people." Such mounting criticism is a due denunciation and expression of resentment and protest against the dangerous act of the present ruling forces to make a new history of aggression by realizing their wild nuclear ambition.
The whole world should impose stern punishment on the vicious attempt of neo-militarism to bring nuclear holocaust to mankind under the revanchist ambition, carrying the signboard of the "world's only victim of atomic bombs" to gain sympathy.
Japan's pursuance of neo-militarism will inevitably result in digging its own grave, as those who forget the past repeat the past. -0-

headline: War Veterans and Persons of Wartime Merits Arrive Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- A grand event will take place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, to celebrate the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.
Warm congratulations are extended from across the country to the heroes of the legendary era, who are glorifying their honourable life as the first-generation defenders of the country and dear revolutionary forerunners held in respect by the Workers' Party of Korea and the people, in the run-up to July 27, the war victory day.
The war veterans and persons of wartime merits invited to the significant V-day celebrations were warmly seen off by officials of the Party and power organs, working people, families and relatives in the relevant areas.
They arrived here on July 25 and senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea warmly greeted them at Pyongyang Railway Station and lodging quarters.
Citizens, youth and students waved their hands toward the buses carrying them as a token of respect and congratulations along the streets. -0-

story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- On the occasion of July 27, many officials, working people, service personnel and schoolchildren in the DPRK have visited Yuphyong, Changgol, Kosanjin and Hyangha revolutionary sites associated with the undying feats of PresidentKim Il Sungfor the victory in the war.
At the revolutionary sites, the visitors deeply grasped the fact that the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was a victory of world-historic significance brought about by the outstanding military idea, strategy and tactics, matchless pluck and extraordinary commanding art of the President.
All the visitors hardened their will to glorify forever the tradition of victory of heroic Korea by remaining faithful to the leadership of the respected ComradeKim Jong Unand to bring earlier the new victory of the revolution by turning out in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren Meet with War Veterans
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren held meetings with war veterans in North and South Phyongan provinces, North and South Hwanghae provinces, North Hamgyong Province and Nampho Municipality.
When Hero of the Republic Ri Tong Guk and other war veterans Kim Kyong Ho, Kil Song Ran, Phyon Chan Gyu, Kang Song Ok and Sin Mun Chol arrived at the venue of meetings, schoolchildren warmly welcomed them with bouquets.
At the meetings the war veterans said that the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War is shining as an event to be specially recorded in the world history of wars as it was the victory of the Juche-oriented military idea and brilliant strategy and tactics of PresidentKim Il Sung, the invincible and iron-willed commander, and the victory of the heroic spirit of defending the country displayed by the service personnel of the Korean People's Army and the DPRK people.
They impressively told about the heroic feats performed by the brave KPA soldiers who devoted their youth and lives to victory with ardent love for the country and soaring hatred against the enemy and delivered wholesale deaths to the aggressors.
The war veterans handed over the national flag of the DPRK to their successors, asking the rising generations to firmly carry forward heroic Korea's tradition of victory, true to the leadership of the respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Un.
The meetings were followed by congratulatory performances and contests of singing wartime songs in chorus. -0-

headline: War Veterans and Persons of Wartime Merits Arrive Here
Hundreds of Sci-tech Achievements Patented in DPRK This Year
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- Hundreds of valuable scientific and technological achievements have been patented this year, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Many inventions were made to consolidate the production foundations of the key industrial sectors of the national economy including metal, chemical, electric power, coal and machine-building industries.
Many intellectual creations of great significance were developed and introduced to develop agricultural production including the light control system of cylindrical vegetable cultivation apparatus and walking sprayer.
There are also many patented inventions conducive to modernizing the production lines in the light industrial establishments and improving the quality of their products, including the non-contact three-dimensional human body measuring system.
Technological achievements of diverse themes and weighty significance were registered as patented inventions, for they contribute to the health promotion and material and cultural life of the people in the sectors of public health, sports and ecological environment protection.
The Musan Mining Complex, the Kangso Spray Factory and other units have made valuable scientific and technological achievements for development.
Automatic drain gate for fish ponds, cylindrical separator and gypsum-free cement production method, associated with the creativity and enthusiasm of ordinary citizens, will contribute to the economic and social development of the country. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Gifts to War Veterans across DPRK on Occasion of V-day
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 26 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea's love and benevolence for the victorious wartime generation, the first proud defenders of the DPRK who safeguarded the country at the cost of blood in the most grim years, are growing stronger with the passage of time.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent gifts to war veterans across the country on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
The gifts reflect the great sincerity of the respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho is adding vitality to the life to the war veterans with his boundless love, saying that their good health is great strength for the Party and people and great encouragement for the revolution.
The gifts sent by ComradeKim Jong Unwere courteously conveyed to war veterans across the country.
The veterans and their families extended deep thanks to the respected MarshalKim Jong Unfor highly praising the exploits performed by the victorious wartime generation and showing great benevolence to ensure that they enjoy proud life and happiness.
The war veterans are full of enthusiasm to glorify their lives as true educators, who train the rising generations to be strong-willed ones defending the country and the revolution, with the undying spirit and mettle they displayed during the war. -0-
