story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The Academy of Pedagogical Science in the DPRK is putting spurs to the efforts to put the education on a higher scientific basis.
The academy carried out proactive research into helping teachers have excellent art of lecturing and into improving the ability of pupils in the stages of elementary and secondary education. By doing so, it contributed to the teaching of teachers.
The academy is busy writing various books on education psychology and education statistics.
Its researchers have gone to schools in rural areas in Kangso District of Nampho Municipality and Taehung County of South Phyongan Province in order to help the teachers work out teaching plans and create new teaching methods, and are pooling their creative wisdom in making educational aid programs and multimedia programs for students in their study of foreign language and for deaf persons.
The academy also made proactive efforts to increase the ranks of persons with academic degrees and help teachers to further raise the level of their educational theory. -0-

headline: Military Miracles in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung, the invincible and iron-willed commander, the service personnel and people of the DPRK defeated the enemy's numerical and military and technical superiority by means of their politico-ideological and strategic and tactical superiority and won a brilliant victory in the Fatherland Liberation War (June 25, 1950 - July 27, 1953).
When they ignited the Korean War, the U.S. imperialists miscalculated that the young DPRK would be easily conquered by their huge military muscle.
During the three-year war, the U.S. imperialists hurled into the Korean front the troops amounting to more than two millions, including one third of the U.S. Army, one fifth of the U.S. Air Force, most of the U.S. Pacific Fleet and the armies of its satellite countries they mobilized by abusing the name of the UN, and spent over 73 million tons of munitions, 11 times those they consumed in the Pacific War.
But the myth of "mightiness" of the U.S. imperialists, who boasted of being the "strongest" in the world, was shattered and their new-type weapons destroyed since the start of the war.
During the war, the Korean People's Army killed, wounded and captured more than 1 567 120 enemies including 405 490 U.S. imperialist aggressor troops and captured and destroyed a huge amount of combat equipment including 12 220 aircrafts, 3 250 tanks and armored vehicles.
This was nearly 2.3 times as much as the losses the U.S. imperialists suffered in the four-year Pacific War during the Second World War.
Taft, the then commander of the U.S. forces, said that it was very clear that the U.S. was defeated in Korea, and that there was no enough army to repel the Korean People's Army in the world. Ridgway, commander of the "UN Forces", said that the U.S. should not forget the bitter mistakes and lessons it suffered in the Korean War and the armistice talks with the DPRK.
Clark, commander of the U.S. forces in the Far East and commander of the "UN Forces", also deplored that he came to be dishonored as the first commander of the U.S. forces who did not win victory and signed the armistice agreement in the history of the U.S.
The U.S. imperialists' fate was so miserable as to ignite the Korean War, and the victory won by the brave army and people of the DPRK in the war was recorded as a miracle in the world history of wars. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnVisits Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on Occasion of V-Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel of the Korean People's Army in the DPRK significantly celebrate July 27, a symbol of heroism and invincibility of the DPRK, paying high tribute to the honorable first defenders of the state and creators of the precious tradition of victory shining as the gold star of immortality along with the honor of the great victor nation.
The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery on July 26 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the war victory.
ComradeKim Jong Ungladly met with war veterans and warmly wished them good health and long life.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, war veterans, persons of wartime merits, bereaved families of war martyrs, students of revolutionary schools and Pyongyangites.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the cemetery.
ComradeKim Jong Unplaced a flower at the memorial "Soul of Heroes" and paid high tribute, praying for immortality of the martyrs who recorded the first page of the defence of the country, adding majestic shine to the dignity of heroic Korea with their precious blood in the first period of the foundation of the state.
A gun salute was fired in memory of the Fatherland Liberation War martyrs.
ComradeKim Jong Unwent round the cemetery.
He said that although many years have passed since the ceasefire of the war, the great victory won by the young DPRK in the cradle to devotedly defend not only the dignity and sovereignty of the state but also the global peace and security in a heavy and hot war against the U.S. imperialists, the chieftain of imperialism, and their followers is shining as the most eye-opening and signal victory and eternal biography of heroes unprecedented in the human history of wars.
He stressed that the miracle of July 27 won by the ordinary army and people on this land with ardent love and indomitable might should be the precious ideological and moral wealth and infinite latent energy of the Korean revolution to be invariably and thoroughly carried forward regardless of the replacement of generations and the growing gains of the revolution in the long journey of building a power.
He affirmed that our cause of building a rich country with a strong army would emerge victorious when we always remember the worthwhile spirit of self-respect, matchless stubbornness and noble self-sacrificing spirit displayed by the wartime generation who pioneered the heroic history of the Republic with their blood and remain faithful to their intention and will.
The participants laid flowers at the graves of the martyrs, recalling the brilliant names and images and heroic lives of the martyrs and praying for their immortality.
Fireworks were displayed in the sky of July as a manifestation of respects to the immortal and legendary feats of the sung and unsung war martyrs.
The heroic merits of the participants in the Fatherland Liberation War and their immortal exploits, recorded in the revolutionary history of our people with the brilliant gold letters, will be handed down to posterity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnVisits Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong to Mark 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on July 26 to mark the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The KPA guard of honor lined up at the cemetery.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
A wreath bearing the august name of ComradeKim Jong Unwas placed at the wreath-laying stand amid the playing of the wreath-laying music.
Wreaths in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the Cabinet of the DPRK were laid at the cemetery.
ComradeKim Jong Un, together with all the participants, paid a silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred cause for the independence and sovereignty of the country and the defence of its sovereignty and the people's wellbeing and happiness.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.
ComradeKim Jong Unplaced flowers before the busts of Kim Chaek, Kang Kon and Choe Hyon on Jujak Peak who made a distinguished contribution to the war victory, with deep reverence for the revolutionaries of the first generation who created and glorified the ever-victorious tradition and history, fighting in the bloody anti-Japanese war and the flames of the Fatherland Liberation War under the leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung.
He said that the fighters' absolute loyalty to the leader, spirit of devotedly implementing the revolutionary tasks and courageous will without impossibility were developed into the ideological and moral qualities of the defenders of the country in the 1950s and this was the basic foundation that made the victorious wartime generation the most heroic generation of the DPRK and the model of the indomitable Korean people.
He affirmed that the glory of July 27 would continue with greater and more dynamic victory in the course of advance of our cause sacred with great pioneering and succession and that our country associated with the patriotic soul of the forerunners would be prosperous forever as a powerful socialist state.
He paid high tribute to the revolutionary martyrs who created the precious revolutionary spirit and tradition to be handed down to posterity and laid the eternal foundation for the national prosperity, praying for their immortality as a model of brilliant life and struggle for all the successive generations of the DPRK and a mainstay of their firm faith. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit War Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and other leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and senior officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies visited the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum on July 26 to mark the 73rd anniversary of the war victory.
A flower basket in the name of ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat the museum.
Also, placed were flower baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK, the Cabinet of the DPRK and the Korean People's Army.
The visitors paid high tribute to the statue of the President.
They went round the halls at the museum showing the period from the first stage of the war to its forth stage, the hall of guards units, the hall of victory, etc.
They recollected with deep emotion the outstanding feats of the peerlessly brilliant commander, who trained the army and people of the DPRK to be the heroic army and people, set a brilliant example in the anti-imperialist revolutionary war and laid an eternal cornerstone for carrying forward the revolutionary traditions of Juche while covering the bloody path untrodden by any state and braving the worst challenges. -0-

headline: Earnest Request of Respected ComradeKim Jong Un
story_text:
One day in July 2021, the respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uncame to the venue of the photo session in order to have a photo taken with the participants in the Seventh National Conference of War Veterans.
As the respected Comrade General Secretary approached the war veterans, they crowded around him, unable to suppress their excitement.
The respected Comrade General Secretary listened carefully to the stories of war veterans, who told him about their impression during the conference, and complied with a war veteran's request with a good grace.
He warmly grasped the hands of a woman war veteran, who said that she really wanted to see him, and kindly told her to be good health.
He embraced her, who was filled with happiness and at a loss what to do, and earnestly asked her again"good health."
That day, whenever he moved from one place to another for having a photo taken, the respected Comrade General Secretary earnestly asked the veterans to be good health while shaking hands with them.
This request reflects the ardent sincerity of the respected Comrade General Secretary who spares nothing for the brave defenders of the country in the 1950s and wishes them a long life. -0-

headline: War Veterans Leading Worthwhile Life in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- The DPRK people are significantly celebrating the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the great Fatherland Liberation War.
On this occasion, all the people across the country extend warm congratulations to the war veterans who demonstrated before the world the indomitable spirit of heroic Korea by dedicating their youth and lives during the war.
The victorious wartime generation is the war participants and victors of the great years who, under the guidance of PresidentKim Il Sung, honorably defended the DPRK in the hard-fought three-year Fatherland Liberation War against the U.S.-led imperialist allied forces.
The war veterans in the DPRK are enjoying a worthwhile life under the care of the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who has shown all kinds of love, putting forward them as admirable heroes and genuine patriots who devotedly defended the country and people, and as precious treasures of the country incomparable with gold and silver.
The noble image of the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who made a bow before the victors of the great years in the celebrations of the war victory, is deeply cherished in the people's mind.
Whenever conferences of war veterans were held, the war veterans across the country came to Pyongyang with decorations by special planes, special trains, ships and buses, thanks to the measures taken by the respected General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
The General Secretary made meaningful speeches at the conferences of war veterans, provided grand banquets for them and had photo sessions with them.
The war veterans have regularly spent a pleasant time every year at the sanatoriums wonderfully built in different parts of the country under the care of the Party and the state.
Thanks to the benevolent loving care shown by the Party which puts forward all the war veterans as models to be followed by everyone, the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum could be built as a seat of victory conveying to the world the heroic feats of the victorious wartime generation and their noble spirit of defending the country and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery as a monument of the times.
It is one of the national traits of the DPRK to put forward the war veterans, treat them warmly and sincerely take care of them so that they do not feel any inconvenience in their lives. -0-

headline: Heroic Feats of Soldiers of KPA Overseas Operations Units Remembered in Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- A tablet was unveiled with due ceremony at the Pantheon of Defenders of the Motherland run by the Defence Ministry in Moscow Region on July 24 to convey the heroic feats of soldiers of the Korean People's Army overseas operations units involved in the operation to liberate Kursk Region of the Russian Federation.
Seen on the tablet are letters written in Russian reading "Russia will never forget the feats performed by the DPRK combatants in Kursk Region", together with the image of a KPA soldier involved in the operation to liberate Kursk Region standing at the battlefield with an automatic rifle against the background of the DPRK flag.
Present at the unveiling ceremony were officials of the Defence Ministry and the General Staff of the Armed Forces and officials concerned of the Russian Federation.
On hand were the DPRK ambassador to Russia and staff members of his embassy.
Speeches were made at the ceremony.
Wreaths in the name of the DPRK embassy and the Defence Ministry of the Russian Federation were laid at the tablet amid the playing of wreath-laying music. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 27 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on July 27:
The ASEAN Regional Forum foreign ministers' meeting, recently held in the Philippines, made public a poor chair's statement distorting the essence of the situation in the Korean peninsula and calling for "complete denuclearization of the Korean peninsula".
I express strong dissatisfaction with the forum's undisguised hostile attitude of going along with the U.S. trumpeting about "denuclearization", ignoring the constitution of the DPRK and running counter to it, and resolutely denounce and reject this with the sternest rhetorical expression.
Such an act of the U.S. and its vassal forces to change the status of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state, permanently settled by its state constitution, only with a piece of document without any legal restraint is nothing but a foolish attempt.
If the ASEAN Regional Forum is to fulfill its mission as a consultative body truly promoting regional peace and security, it should guard against an opportunity and space of being misused as a hired mouthpiece for the U.S.
It is a failure in strategic thinking and logic and a manifestation of a stupid and foolish wild dream to still adhere to the "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" which had already lost its meaning conceptually and practically.
There will never be a change in the existing situation according to rhetoric or "hope" of any outside force.
The present geopolitical crisis being created by the U.S. and its vassal forces proves once again that national security is an absolutely important matter that can never be entrusted to others.
Resolute and clear is the DPRK's stand that nuclear deterrence is the ultimate shield for national sovereignty and the supreme guarantee for defending sovereignty.
Whatever others may say, the position and significance of existence of the DPRK as a responsible nuclear weapons state to keep the balance of strength and ensure the geopolitical security in and over the Korean peninsula are final and irreversible.
The DPRK's nuclear capability will be updated steadily without a momentary stagnation. -0-

He was accompanied by Jo Yong Won, Kim Song Nam and Ju Chang Il, secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the DPRK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence, and Pak Jong Chon, adviser to the Ministry of National Defence.

ComradeKim Jong Unpaid a silent tribute to the memory of the fallen soldiers of the Chinese People's Volunteers.
Then he visited the grave of Mao Anying at the cemetery. He placed a flower at the grave and paid homage.
The ennobling soul and self-sacrificing spirit of the brave CPV soldiers, who shed their blood to assist the DPRK people in the war of justice in the most difficult and fateful years, are clearly associated with the victory won by the DPRK people and they are shining as the foundation for the DPRK-China friendship with socialism as its core.
The DPRK people will never forget the merits and heroic feats of the excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese people who unsparingly dedicated their hot blood and precious lives, fighting shoulder to shoulder with our army and people in the same trench of the unprecedented death-defying struggle for repelling the imperialists' invasion. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremonial Parade of Columns Symbolic of Units Fought in Fatherland Liberation War Marks 73rd Anniversary of Its Victory
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- The whole country is overflowing with joy and excitement of greeting the great holiday of war victory with the high pride of winning new victories of great importance to glorify the immortal honour and dignity of the heroic Korea, which the first defenders of the Republic imposingly raised as a great power in an eastern part of the earth, and heroic people.
A ceremonial parade of the columns symbolic of the units that fought in the Fatherland Liberation War was held in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on the evening of July 27 to mark the 73rd anniversary of war victory, unfolding historic scenes demonstrating the tradition of victory which has been firmly carried forward as the bloodline of the Korean revolution and the indomitable heroic spirit which has been displayed to the full century after century.
The plaza before the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium and its surroundings were crowded with citizens who gathered with the great pride of celebrating the unprecedented legendary victory won by the two-year-old state, a new-born country in a cradle, and the two-year-old army which fought against the imperialist allied forces to defend the inviolable sovereignty and prevent the ravages of a new world war.
To the tune of the vibrant song of the revolutionary army, the columns of paraders in military uniforms like the ones the soldiers wore during the war, and with rifles in their hands which vividly show the traces of hand-to-hand fight entered the plaza.
Prior to the parade, a combined military band depicted the heroic course of Juche Korea which has firmly defended and added luster to the glory of July 27 through colorful formation changes and light rhythmic movements.
When the respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, appeared on the platform, the participants broke into stormy cheers of "hurrah!" and gorgeous fireworks were displayed in the sky over the capital city.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly acknowledged the enthusiastically cheering participants.
Leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and the commanders of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army took their seats on the platform together with war veterans.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation staying in the DPRK.
Seen in the auditorium were war veterans, persons of wartime merits, officials of the Party Central Committee, senior officials of ministries and national institutions, service personnel of the People's Army, officials and lecturers engaged in the administration of revolutionary relics associated with the victorious war, Pyongyang citizens including descendants of war heroes, students of revolutionary schools and other youth and students.
No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defense of the DPRK, made a speech.
Saying that the celebrations of the Day of Victory reaches the climax with tonight's ceremonial parade arranged to keep the memory of and pride in the past history and incite the complete succession to the great tradition and the declaration of a fresh victory, the speaker noted that today's march of the columns represents the heroic advance during the days in the flames of fierce battles and vividly shows the tradition of victory running through the past annals.
The victorious wartime generation are still standing before us as an exemplar of the persons leading a patriotic life with the motherland and a respectful teacher encouraging the descendants to engage in the heroic struggle and perform feats by exciting their mental world, he said, adding that we will forever thank and respect the great generation who won the most disastrous war to ensure the most beautiful future and made this country strong by devoting their passionate youth and all their valuable things.
The speaker noted that our army will as ever open up in the van the unprecedented era of a power with transparent faith and through the unexampled struggle, stressing that the successors will continue to march forward year after year with the indomitable heroism, displayed by the defenders of the motherland in the 1950s in their struggle, and the mission of the class and their grandiose advance and courageous spirit immortalize the honour of our state.
All the paraders burst into cheers of "hurrah!" in expression of their militant enthusiasm for determinedly making strides to inherit the honour of war victory achieved at the dear cost and winning a greater victory in the van of the gigantic struggle to build a prosperous and powerful country.
Then there was a review of the preparations for the parade.
KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon reviewed the columns of the parade units.
He courteously reported to ComradeKim Jong Unon the completion of the preparations for the parade.
The commander of the parade gave the order to start the ceremonial parade.
The column symbolic of the bodyguard company marched at the head of the parade units, holding high the ennobling image of GeneralKim Il Sung, the iron-willed commander in those days over 70 years ago. It eloquently proved what is the source of all victories of the great Korean revolution and where is the irresistible might of our ever-victorious army.
And shining like a group of loyal stars in the column were the portraits of the first generation bodyguards of our army who became a bulletproof wall to defend the supreme headquarters in the hard-fought and fateful years with a firm faith that it is possible to ensure the war victory, destiny of the motherland and happiness and future of the people when they defend the leader at the cost of their lives.
The columns symbolic of the legendary guards divisions entered the plaza, flying high their glorious colours which demonstrate their military exploits of annihilating the U.S. imperialists' ill-famed "undefeated divisions", "elite divisions" in the three years of the fierce war when the soldiers had to step on empty cartridges more than the soil on mountains and killed more enemies with bayonets than they did with rifles.
Among them were the columns symbolic of the Kang Kon Guards 2nd Infantry Division, the Seoul Kim Chaek Guards 4th Infantry Division and other units bearing the names of anti-Japanese generals, fighters who rendered distinguished services in founding the army and performed indelible exploits in the great history of war victory. The paraders marched, holding high portraits of the commanding officers of anti-Japanese guerrilla background who implemented the operational plans of the leader with absolute faith and distinguished military qualifications.
The spectators paid high tribute to the greatest loyalists and heroes as they set the living example of genuine loyalty to PresidentKim Il Sung, who led Korea to victory with his unique military ideas and strategy and tactics hard to find in any other military theories in the world, which should be regarded by all the generations of the Republic as a textbook.
The columns marched in fine array, making the spectators recall numerous legendary feats performed in the operation of liberating Seoul, a world-startling miracle created in 72 hours, the operation of liberating Taejon, a brilliant example of a contemporary battle of encirclement, the battle for defending Height 1211, a trap valley which heralded the destruction of the enemies, and others during the Fatherland Liberation War.
Fireworks were displayed as a sign of victory and celebration to wonderfully decorate the nocturnal sky of the Day of Victory. And the columns symbolic of the Guards Second Torpedo Boat Squadron and the Guards 56th Hero Kim Ji Sang Pursuit Plane Regiment marched past the plaza. They were telling about the feats performed by the heroic seamen, who created the miracle of Jumunjin and the myth on Wolmi Islet to be specially recorded in the world history of naval battles, and the pilots who became human bombs to reduce the air superiority of the U.S. imperialists to the leaves falling in the autumn wind.
ComradeKim Jong Unsent warm greetings to the columns dynamically passing through the plaza, flying the flag of the Guards associated with the heroic fighting spirit, matchless bravery and spirit of annihilating the enemy of the victorious wartime generation.
The portraits of the immortal fighters, who annihilated the invaders with the love for their native home and parents and siblings and the hatred of the enemies and became human bombs to destroy the enemies' pillboxes and tanks while crying for "long live the leader" as they are the generation deeply moved by benevolence shown by the leader who put forward them as the master of the country, factory and land, were seen in the columns symbolic of the guard regiments.
Among the columns were those of the Ministry of Interior and the Ministry of Railways which produced known or unknown heroes who fought for war victory on the front or in the rear during the three-year war.
The foot columns were followed by those of combined mechanized carriages and motorcycles, symbols of the mechanized units engaged in the Fatherland Liberation War.
The columns made the participants recollect the merits of the victors in the great years who proved the truth that if the ideas and tactics are great, it is possible to defeat any formidable enemy with inferior arms, by winning the most brilliant victory despite the most rigorous ordeals.
The plaza was full of reverence for the masters of the heroic times who made a legendary history of resistance at the cost of their warm blood, firmly cemented the foundations of the Republic with the victory they won at the cost of their lives and opened up the rosy future of the Korean revolution.
Appeared at the plaza were the columns of the three services of the Korean People's Army, demonstrating the features of the dignified revolutionary armed forces of the DPRK which incomparably became strong.
Sky-high was the spirit of the guards of the new generation who firmly defend the inviolable territorial lands, waters and air of our state with absolute defence capability while steadily and invariably inheriting the tradition of loyalty, patriotism and victory created in the flames of the war and adding luster to the history of Juche Korea wining victory after victory.
ComradeKim Jong Unextended warm militant encouragement to the invincible elite ranks and representatives of the matchless army who newly defined the concept of the strong army and the law of victory and placed the absolute might of the revolutionary armed forces at the peak of honour with loyalty to the Party and the country, ardent patriotism, mass heroism and indomitable fighting spirit peculiar to the army.
The paraders marched past the plaza with the firm pledge to charge absolute weaponry, the strongest in the world, with the revolutionary idea of the Workers' Party of Korea and fully display the honour of our generation with the miraculous merits and fresh legendary about victory surpassing heroism displayed in the annals of history.
At the end of the parade, the stormy cheers of excitement were broken and fireworks displayed in the nocturnal sky to commemorate the V-Day.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering masses.
The parade fully demonstrated once again the firm faith and fighting spirit of the generation of successors to add great victories to the immortal feats of the victorious wartime generation under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, the banner of all victories, and usher in the era of building a prosperous power unprecedented in history. -0-

headline: Intensive Training of Skilled Workers for Regional Foodstuff Factories in DPRK
story_text:

As a result, the factory was equipped with more than 10 kinds of main production processes and secondary production processes for packing, raw materials pre-treatment processes, etc.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Art Performance Marks 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:

A splendid art performance was given to mark the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War in the capital city of Pyongyang on July 27 when the whole country was overflowing with the respect for the heroic defenders of the motherland in wartime and the great honour and self-confidence of the successors who are firmly preserving and glorifying the high honour of war victory and opening up the wonderful era of transformation for the prosperity of the country.

The performers and audience paid the highest tribute to ComradeKim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness of our Party, state and people and banner of all the victories and glory, raising enthusiastic cheers.
ComradeKim Jong Unextended congratulations to the war veterans, the persons of wartime merits and all the people across the country and officers and men of the whole army who are significantly celebrating the holiday of great war victory.
He met with war veterans and sincerely wished them long life in good health.
Lovely children presented bouquets of fragrant flowers to ComradeKim Jong Unand war veterans.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of ministries and national agencies, service personnel of the People's Army, officials and lecturers engaged in the administration of revolutionary relics associated with the victorious war, Pyongyang citizens including descendants of war heroes, students of revolutionary schools and other youth and students.
Diplomatic envoys of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation staying in the DPRK were invited.
The art performance began with preludes "July 27, Our Victory Day" and "July 27 March", adding to the excitement of the meaningful Day of Victory that made the audience recall the ever-victorious history of our glorious Republic and convinced them of the greater victory in the future. Put on the stage were wartime songs and others in praise of war victory resounded in the annals of succession.
The performers warmly congratulated war veterans and persons of wartime merits, the first generation defenders of the motherland who created the great history of war victory of our state, representing the unanimous desire of all the people across the country.
Children's Union members and boys and girls presented bouquets to war veterans and persons of wartime merits.
The performers sang in an excited tone wartime songs in high praise of the spirit of defending the country and revolution displayed by the wartime generation who bravely fought in the fierce war to safeguard the sovereignty and honour of the motherland with the transparent revolutionary faith that the motherland is just the embrace of PresidentKim Il Sungand they are sure to win when they absolutely believe in and follow him. The audience were filled with great emotion as the songs made them respectfully recollect the legendary annals.
Song "Red Blossom" newly composed on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of war victory was an eruption of the warmest respect of our people for the wartime generation who defended the sacred sovereign right and beautiful future with infinite loyalty to the Party and revolution and ardent patriotism and created the indomitable and heroic spirit, a motive force of sure victory.
The audience were deeply touched by videos showing the matchless self-sacrificing spirit, heroism and brilliant feats of excellent sons and daughters of the Chinese people who shared life and death, fighting shoulder to shoulder with our people in the same trench of the struggle of repelling the invasion of the imperialists, and Chinese songs such as "Battle Song of Chinese People's Volunteers".
The performers artistically and superbly depicted the DPRK people's eternal thanks to the brave fighters of the Chinese People's Volunteers, who assisted our people in their sacred and righteous war under the uplifted banner of resisting America and aiding Korea even in the difficult days of building the country and made an important contribution to the war victory and the defence of global peace and security, and the truth that the DPRK-China friendship based on the shared ideal and militant fraternity will be immortal along with the history of the great war victory.
Watching documentaries on the three years of war which imposed miserable misfortune and pains on our people filled with the delight of greeting the liberation and joy over new life, terrible disasters in rigorous 1129 days and lessons of history they should never forget, the audience bore in mind as their strong will the important sense of duty of our generation to adorn with the greater victory the glory and honour of our state the defenders of the motherland in the 1950s achieved at the cost of their blood and reliably hand them down to the next generation.
The art performance was acclaimed by the audience as it helped them have a firmer conviction that as long as the noble spirit and soul, sources of winning war victory, are alive, and the new generation faithful to the intention march on proudly, victory belongs to the DPRK forever.
At the end of the art performance, war veterans and persons of wartime merits gave bouquets to performers.
Through the art performance, the successors further hardened their faith and will to firmly defend and carry forward our ideology and system, precious tradition of victory the first defenders of the Republic safeguarded at the cost of their blood and glorify the DPRK, our beloved motherland, as the more powerful and endlessly prospering socialist power. -0-

headline: Natural Resources for Medical Tourism in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 28 (KCNA) -- The DPRK has many natural resources for medical tourism specially good for health and treatment of the people.
Among them are mineral waters and hot springs including Kangso Mineral Water, Sokwang Temple Mineral Water, Sambang Mineral Water, Paektu Hot Spring, Hwangjin Hot Spring, Yangdok Hot Spring and Ryonggang Hot Spring.
There are also the resources for mud treatment such as mud in Lake Sijung and Kwangryang Bay and many resources for climate treatment including clear and clean air and beautiful landscape.
Such natural resources are effective in treating various diseases including high blood pressure and rheumatic, skin, spinal, gynecological and gastrointestinal diseases, eczema and diabetes.
In particular, insam, platycodon, Ganoderma and Rhododendron are well known to the world and in great demand among tourists.
The famous Armillaria in Mt Chilbo area is popular for its nutritive value and efficiency in treatment and Kaesong Koryo insam is used as a basic material for making Koryo medicines as it has distinct medicinal effect on various diseases.
Besides, there are other resources like antler, musk, sea-cucumber and ear shell. -0-

headline: Korean Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 29 (KCNA) -- The kayagum production technology is the traditional one of making kayagum, a string instrument peculiar to the Korean people.
Kayagum invented by gifted musician Uruk in the early 6th century is a wooden and rectangular musical instrument. It is a zither-like string instrument.
In kayagum, the letter ”gum” is a term used in ancient times to refer to the rectangular instruments, which is also called "go" in Korean.
In an old book, kayagum was described as kayago.
The body of kayagum was made of paulownia, and in the Koryo period, its soundboard was made of paulownia and its back panel was made of chestnut.
In the period of the feudal Joson dynasty, several sound holes symbolizing the sun, moon and clouds were arranged in harmony on the back panel of kayagum, and the number of strings, which had been twelve, was also increased to thirteen.
The kayagum production technology has been handed down for a long time through a process of change but it has not been changed in main. The number of its strings has been increased to nineteen from thirteen, and nowadays it is twenty one. Its range was further expanded and it has been developed to make it easier to tune.
The kayagum production technology was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in April 2017. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren's Camping Groups Tour Pyongyang
Oath-taking Meeting of Young Vanguard and March of Succession Held in DPRK
Koryo Insam Cultural Tourist Resort in Kaesong Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 29 (KCNA) -- Koryo insam cultural tourist resort was built in a unique manner at Kaesong Municipality where there are many historic spots and scenic spots.
The municipality decided to build the Koryo insam cultural tourist resort on the basis of feedback from the old persons growing insam for a long time and a scientific survey, which confirmed that the best place for the effect of insam is within 10 km off Mt Songak.
Since the tourist resort was open near the Koryo Museum, many tourists have visited it.
Especially in autumn, when the leaves of insam are yellow and the roots are grown to the maximum, the resort is swarming with tourists every day. They carefully dig out the main roots, branch roots and hairy roots of insam and then keep it in the container-based moss, grass and dry humus or make tea and other drinks with it.
The Sam Street's insam rock is also one of the main tourist attractions. The municipality helps the tourists enjoy a bird's-eye view of landscape being preserved in original state on the convenient climbing route.
It also remodeled the Samdaem sand bath site which contributes to promoting the people's health by using the traditional therapy in Kaesong area.
PresidentKim Il Sungsaid that Kaesong Municipality would be a popular tourist resort for Pakyon Falls and insam fields.
Kaesong Municipality is to develop more tourist areas blending well with the beautiful natural scenery by preserving its regional features. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Citizens Enjoy Art performance to Mark 73rd Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 29 (KCNA) -- The art performance marking the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War was given again on Wednesday, following its debut on Tuesday.
Among the audience were working people, youth and students in Pyongyang.
Put on the stage were wartime songs and others in praise of the war victory that helped the audience have a clear awareness of the truth that the lives of those who devoted themselves to the sacred war of defending the country are the most worthwhile ones and redouble the will of the successors to add more shine to the great victory of the DPRK.
Wartime songs in praise of the steadfast spirit of defending the country and revolution displayed by the war veterans and persons of wartime merits made the audience recollect the victors of the great years.
The song "Red Blossom" newly created on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War deepened the respect and reverence for the benefactors, the victorious wartime generation, who should be admired forever.
Videos dealing with the feats of the martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers and Chinese songs decorated the stage colorfully.
The audience was deeply moved by the song "My Career" dealing with the brilliant life of the commanding officers of the anti-Japanese guerilla origin.
Through the performance the audience hardened their will of the successors to carry forward the noble soul of the victorious wartime generation and steadily make a history of fresh victory. -0-

headline: Production Increases at Kangdong Greenhouse Complex

story_text:

They are extending the highest tribute and deep thanks to the peerlessly great men who created a beautiful flower garden of respect for women on this land on the occasion.
Thanks to the wise guidance of respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho have carried through the noble intention of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilto value and respect women, the Korean women's movement is now in the greatest heyday of its development and the social dignity of our women is brilliantly shining with glory.
All people are still deeply moved by the revolutionary anecdotes about the warm affection and devotion of respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho puts forward women as the masters of the times and bestows loving care and trust to them.
A revolutionary anecdote about the loving care of respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho convened the Fourth National Conference of Mothers in November 2012 and had a photo taken with the participants in the conference eloquently shows how the DPRK women enjoy a life under the great loving care.
Among the anecdotes are those about the lofty traits of the peerlessly great man who personally guided as a builder and operator the construction of public health facilities for the promotion of women's health and hostels for weavers and silk-reel workers and made sure that women's dress exhibitions were held.

headline: Great Man who Realized Women's Long-cherished Desire
Patriotic Efforts of Meritorious Women in DPRK
Great Man who Realized Women's Long-cherished Desire
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 30 (KCNA) -- It has been 80 years since PresidentKim Il Sungpromulgated the Law on Sex Equality.
From the first period when he embarked on the road of the revolution, he put forward the issue of women as one of the fundamental problems arising in the social revolution and made great efforts to settle it.
During the days of the anti-Japanese war, he saw to it that the Anti-Japanese Women's Association, a revolutionary women's mass organization, was organized and set an example of sex equality and women's emancipation in the guerrilla bases and the ranks of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army and thus gave birth to the Juche-oriented Korean women's movement.
After the liberation of the country, he set the issue of realizing the women's social emancipation and sex equality as a task to be solved without fail in the anti-imperialist, anti-feudal democratic revolution and clarified it in the political line of the Party. He saw to it that women's organization was formed for the first time among social organizations and led women to take an active part in settling the issue of women's emancipation.
Whenever the different democratic reforms were enforced, he made sure that women received the land with the same right with men and had the right equal to men even in labor life and mothers receive various privileges.
On July 30, 1946, he promulgated the Law on Sex Equality on the basis of laying a foundation for solving the issue of women.
The promulgation of the Law on Sex Equality enabled the DPRK women to emerge proudly before the times and history as the master of the country and powerful force pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot, free from the feudal fetters which had tied them generation after generation. -0-

headline: Scientific and Technological Achievements Exhibition and Scientific Research Presentation Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 30 (KCNA) -- A national exhibition of scientific and technological achievements of university students-2026 and a national scientific research presentation of university students took place in the DPRK from July 22 to 29.

headline: Modern Industrial Zone Is Being Formed in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 30 (KCNA) -- Modern regional-industry factories, an advanced public health facility and a multi-functional leisure complex, are being built in Ragwon County, according to Rodong Sinmun.
Ragwonpho, which was undergone a dramatic turn with the completion of an advanced offshore farm and an ideal modern fishing village, is being turning into an industrial zone with the construction of modern regional-industry factories and a greenhouse farm.
If an industrial zone is formed, various kinds of regional-industry goods, seafood and fresh vegetables will be produced, making a substantial contribution to the peculiar development of the regional economy and the improvement of material life of residents.
Thanks to the efforts of the soldier-builders and the officials and working people in the province, Ragwonpho is emerging as a modern industrial zone. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Victory in Fatherland Liberation War Marked by Koreans in China
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 30 (KCNA) -- Celebrations were held by the General Association of Koreans in China on July 26 on the occasion of the 73rd anniversary of the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
Laid before the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin, China were flower baskets in the name of the General Association of Koreans in China, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Jilin City branch of the Jilin Provincial Association of the General Association of Koreans in China and the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle.

headline: Patriotic Efforts of Meritorious Women in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 30 (KCNA) -- Among reliable women in the DPRK are a number of meritorious ones of socialist patriotism who are spending days and months of devotion at worksites out of a patriotic desire to contribute to the prosperity of the country.
Typical of them are a merited weaver of the weaving shop No. 1 of the general weaving shop of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, who has produced lots of fabrics through a dynamic multi-machine tending campaign for decades since her girlhood, and a chief oculist of the North Hwanghae Provincial General Hospital who has successfully treated the eyes of many patients with her warm sincerity and high medical skill. The people are calling them meritorious woman of socialist patriotism, regarding them as the model of our women's life.
A woman worker at the Ranam District Water Supply and Sewerage Management and Heating Station in Chongjin City was also honoured with the title of meritorious woman of socialist patriotism for having devoted herself to the supply of tap water for inhabitant.
A woman in Changdo County has taken care of more than 30 orphans and brought them up to be soldiers of the People's Army and workers in major sectors of socialist construction. And she sincerely helped the work of her husband, a postman, and raised her own child to follow in the footsteps of the father. As a result, she became the winner of the title of meritorious woman of socialist patriotism and the Communist Mother Honour Prize.
There are many meritorious women who are working hard to fill the granary of the country on fields all year round, just like the peasants of the previous generations, in our country.
The merited women, who have carried through the Workers' Party of Korea's intention with pure conscience and high educational achievements, have reached the peak in their honour. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on U.S. Moves to Transform USFJ into "Warfighting" Force
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- The U.S. is adding a new element of strategic instability to the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region, bringing dark clouds of war.
The commander of the U.S. Forces in Japan in an interview with a Japanese newspaper on July 26 bragged that over 200 personnel had been added to the USFJ headquarters to give it more authority, it enabled the USFJ to make a rapid response, once impossible, and the USFJ has the number of personnel that can sustain 24/7 operations across all combat functions.
He also noted that he will make sure the USFJ is as ready as possible with Japan, anticipating that not an "if", but "when" a crisis will manifest in the Asia-Pacific region.
This is part of the plan to transform the USFJ, which had been mainly responsible for the administrative missions including the administration of the Japan-U.S. Status of Forces Agreement in the past, into a unified military command with substantial operational command authority. And it proves that the USFJ is transforming itself into a real "warfighting" force to command the U.S. forces and all the armed forces of vassal states in the region.
It is known to the public that the U.S. has been pushing ahead with the reorganization of the U.S. forces in Japan since last year to set up a unified military command and give it some of operational command authority of the U.S. Pacific Command in Hawaii.
The main key of the three-stage reorganization of the U.S. Forces in Japan is to make it possible for the U.S. and Japan to carry out a joint operation in emergency by unifying the commanding systems of Japan's "integrated operation command", which was formed in March last year to control the Japan ground, maritime and air "self-defense forces", and the U.S. Forces in Japan.
Through its moves, the U.S. aims to further strengthen its overseas aggression forces into the field forces possessed of independent wartime operational capability. But, most importantly, it seeks a sinister intention to use the Japan "Self-Defense Forces" as a shock brigade and main combat force for an all-out war in the Asia-Pacific region in case of emergency.
The U.S. already announced that Japan will stand at the forefront of all contingencies that the U.S. may face in the western Pacific region, when it started to reorganize the U.S. Forces in Japan last year.
Opposition parties and the public across Japan are getting vocal expressing concern that SDF would come under the control of the U.S. forces.
Given that the core reinforcements to be dispatched to the ROK first would be the U.S. Forces in Japan in contingency on the Korean peninsula, it is undeniable that the first target of this "war command" is just the DPRK.
As the enemies have admitted, the physical conflict on the Korean peninsula is a matter of time when it would break out, rather than a matter of possibility whether or not it would occur.
Shortly ago, the U.S. conducted the largest-ever "Combined Joint Sustainment Training" together with the ROK puppet military gangsters to enhance the capabilities for protracted war in the operational theater of the Korean peninsula. And it held a U.S.-Japan-ROK Trilateral Chiefs of Defense meeting, in which it again called for strengthening "tripartite security cooperation" including the holding of "Freedom Edge", the multi-domain joint military exercises.
Such adventurous military maneuvers of the U.S. working hard to secure large-scale offensive forces and long-term high-intensity operational capabilities while fully betraying its unshakable hostile intention to stand in confrontation with the DPRK are pushing the latter again to the irreversible final conclusion that it should further strive for ceaseless development and evolution of its nuclear war deterrent for self-defence.
The command of the U.S. forces in the Far East, which had been stationed in Japan to have charge of the Korean War, came to a tragic end, earning such brand as "defeated command".
The transformation of the headquarters of the U.S. Forces in Japan into a "war command" is a short cut to its emergence as disgraceful ”defeated command”. -0-

headline: Designing for Remodeling Coal-mine Villages Accelerated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- The DPRK designing field is concentrating on designing modern coal-mine villages.
The State General Bureau of Design and relevant units of the DPRK are making designs of the villages that suit the characteristics of coal mining area and fully conform to the requirements for modernity, convenience and practicality.
The Paektusan Institute of Architecture has deepened a technical study of the global trend of development in the construction of coal-mine villages and formed the designing group with competent persons in order to draw up plans for layout of the villages and prepare drafts.
The Pyongyang City Planning and Designing Institute scientifically set the location according to the topography of the relevant areas and the number of households and confirmed the number of floors of the dwelling houses. Based on them, it worked out a plan for the layout of the buildings. The Pyongyang Geological Surveying and Designing Institute and the South Phyongan Provincial Designing Institute completed topographic survey and map.
Designers and researchers of the Pugang Designing Institute, Pyongyang University of Architecture and other units are directing efforts to ensure the designing of coal mines at the highest level. -0-

headline: Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- People's laughter and song of happiness are heard at the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp built as a monumental edifice representing the hot spring culture of the DPRK.
A great number of labor innovators and persons of merits including workers and technicians of the Kim Chaek Iron and Steel Complex, the Sunchon Cement Complex, the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex and the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and high-yielding farmers in South Hwanghae Province spent a pleasant time at the holiday camp after its opening in February.
The outdoor and indoor hot spring resorts were crowded with rest-home visitors.
They experienced the new level of flourishing Korea-style hot spring culture, taking a spa bath in multi-purpose hot spring tanks of various forms.
Guided by the kind-hearted service workers, they had hot water or shower bathes and received various kinds of medical care in the hot spring treatment room equipped with modern medical facilities. -0-

headline: Anniversary of Promulgation of Law on Sex Equality Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- All the DPRK women significantly marked the 80th anniversary of the promulgation of the Law on Sex Equality.
Officials and members of the women's union laid bouquets and flowers before the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill and in different parts of the country and made bows to them.
Various political and cultural events took place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, provinces, cities and counties to mark the 80th anniversary of the promulgation of the Law on Sex Equality, adding to the pride of women.
Officials and members of the women's union in Pyongyang Municpality, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces and other parts of the country held story-telling meetings and met with mothers who brought up brave soldiers who participated in the overseas military operations.

At a performance, officials and members of the women's union in South Hwanghae Province also sang the praises of the loving care and trust of the benevolent father who convened a grand meeting of the DPRK women this year and had a photo taken with them.
Sports and amusement games were played in different parts of the country, adding joy and optimism to women.
A yut-game was played by women's union officials and members at the Moranbong Youth Park in Pyongyang.
Women spent a pleasant time, playing sports and amusement games at streets, villages, parks and pleasure parks in Jagang Province, Rason Municipality, etc. -0-

headline: Zeal for Supporting Coal Mines Heightened in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- Officials of ministries and national agencies and other officials and working people in different parts of the DPRK sent lots of equipment, materials and items for labor protection to coal mines in July, inspiring the coal miners.
The Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the Ministry of Natural Resources Development, the Ministry of Fisheries and the Sericulture and Silk Industrial Bureau helped Hyongbong, Tokchon and Wolbong coal mines to resolve problems arising in laying their material and technical foundations.
The State Commission of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Public Health, the National Tourism Administration, the Revolutionary Relics Administration Guidance Bureau and the Bureau for the Protection of National Cultural Heritage supplied a lot of coal wagon bearings and consumer goods to Sochang Youth Coal Mine and Toksong and Jenam coal mines, thereby encouraging the coal miners to turn out in the drive for increased production.

The Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League, the Ministry of Regional Industry, the Ministry of Mining Industry, the Ministry of Labour, the Ministry of State Construction Control, the Ministry of External Economic Relations, the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, the Bureau for Construction of Revolutionary Sites, and the Guidance Bureau of Public Catering Service sent materials needed for boosting production to the relevant mines.
The Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport, the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the Ministry of Light Industry, the Central Bank, the State Inspection Commission, and the Maritime Administration of the DPRK, too, donated materials to some coal mines.

headline: National Sci-tech Presentation in Field of Land and Maritime Transport Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, July 31 (KCNA) -- A national sci-tech presentation in the field of land and maritime transport took place at Nampho Port on July 29 and 30 under the sponsorship of the Korean Land and Maritime Transport Association of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.

story_text:

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation

headline: KCNA Commentary on NATO's Frantic War Preparations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 1 (KCNA) -- The world community is watching keenly NATO's frantic war preparations.
Shortly ago, NATO approved the reorganization of the military fuel transport system dating back to the Cold War period.
According to the so-called NATO Fuel Supply Chain Capability Programme Plan, the existing NATO fuel supply chain in western Europe, which has a total length of about 10 000 km, will be connected to its new member states in eastern and northern Europe. And huge projects, ranging from the construction and modernization of new fuel pipelines to the construction of energy storage facilities, will reportedly be launched.
Originally, there were disagreements among the member states because of huge cost, but they were finally settled. This shows that NATO is clinging to the provision of strategic reserves for war while regarding it as a vital matter.
Moreover, an assertion that NATO will get stronger with the establishment of fuel pipelines is being made among NATO member states. This is a clear proof that NATO is developing into a more aggressive military bloc.
What merits attention is that foreign news are commenting that NATO worked out such an ambitious plan to cope with a potential war with Russia. But the issue is more serious.
In recent years, NATO, which has talked about the inseparability of the security in Europe and the Asia-Pacific region, is more frequently introducing strategic assets of its member states into the Asia-Pacific region, demonstrating its military existence, and frequently staging adventurous muscle flexing in the vicinity of the Korean peninsula in collusion with the countries hostile towards the DPRK.
NATO member states including Germany and Italy, the defeated nations in Europe in the past, actively participated in RIMPAC, the largest-ever joint naval drill in the world, which was conducted in the large area of sea around Hawaii and the Pacific Ocean. This clearly proves that NATO always regards the Asia-Pacific region as the theatre of war.
The grave reality, in which NATO is pushing ahead with the provision of strategic reserves as well as massive arms buildup, hints at many things.
In a word, it is the evil intention of NATO to stockpile enough fuel and other war supplies and thus kindle the flames of war any time in any part of the world.
Several decades have passed since NATO was founded as a military bloc but it is unprecedented that it prepares for war so openly as now.
The grave nature of NATO as a war bloc is becoming more obvious.
The fair international community aspiring after justice and peace will never tolerate the dangerous and challenging act of NATO dashing toward war but make a resolute counterattack to them.
NATO's hastened efforts for igniting a war will bring earlier its ruin. -0-

headline: Happy Day for Respected ComradeKim Jong Un
story_text:
One day in August 2024, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a helicopter unit of the Air Force of the Korean People's Army to congratulate it on its distinguished feats in rescuing citizens in flood-hit areas of North Phyongan Province.
The respected Comrade General Secretary, who arrived at the windy helicopter landing ground, made an encouraging speech before the officers and men of the unit.
Saying that August 2 was not a national holiday for him and the Party but he was as happy as greeting a holiday, he noted that he was so pleased to highly commend the brave service personnel of the air force that he hurried his visit although he had so many things to do due to severe flood damage.
The service personnel, greatly honoured to see the respected Comrade General Secretary, were deeply moved again by his words of great trust for them who carried out their duty only.
As he was so happy to see all the flood victims being rescued and so glad to commend the pilots for the successful rescuing operation, the respected Comrade General Secretary felt as if he was celebrating a holiday at that time.
That day was just like a holiday for the respected Comrade General Secretary who regards the people as Heaven. -0-

headline: Hyesan City in Ryanggang Province Given Facelift
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 2 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province is directing efforts to sprucing up Hyesan City.
In order to renew the appearance of Hyesan as befits a border gateway city, the province set stepwise plans in a realistic way. It has given precedence to the supply of materials while launching an information campaign and rationally organizing construction and labour forces.
The officials and workers of the construction units, involved in the reconstruction and renovation project, have carried out their daily plans, meeting the requirements of construction methods.
Thanks to their efforts, the appearance of the flats in the central part of the city and over 100 neighborhood-serving amenities were renewed.
Special bus stops have been built in different parts of the city to meet the public convenience and street lamps newly installed.
Needle-leaf-trees and flower shrubs were planted at the provincial three-revolution exhibition house and the Hyesan Park.
The province is paying attention to providing the inhabitants with a clean ecological environment and cultural and emotional life by newly installing thousands of meters of water pipes and repairing the infrastructure.
All people's neighborhood units are involved in beautifying the city. -0-

headline: Chollima Tile Factory in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 2 (KCNA) -- The Chollima Tile Factory, a leading building-materials production base in the DPRK, is striving to attain the new long-term goals set forth by the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The factory, whose production capacity has doubled in the heyday of construction, is timely supplying tiles to the great construction sites across the country every year.
In recent years, the factory put the production lines on a multi-functional basis and streamlined the grinding process for outer wall tiles by attaching importance to training talents and conducting a mass-based technological innovation movement.
It has boosted production by ensuring the material-specific mixing ratio in a scientific manner, intensifying the research into the method for promoting the actual extraction rate and installing a new conveyer.
It has fully supplied tiles to the builders of dwelling houses in Songhwa Street, the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District and the Komdok area in 2021. Last year it produced over one million square meters of more tiles than the year before and sent them to major construction sites.
This year workers of the factory have come up with new technical innovation proposals conducive to further boosting the tile production, devoting their wisdom and efforts to perfecting the method for optimizing management.
Visiting the factory on August 2, 2014, respected ComradeKim Jong Unstressed the importance of the duty and role of the factory in ushering in a new heyday of construction and building world-level structures representing the times. -0-

headline: Exhibitions Held in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 2 (KCNA) -- There took place an exhibition of educational experimental apparatuses and teaching aids and educational aid programs and an exhibition of educational aids in South Phyongan Province.
On display there were hundreds of experimental equipment, apparatuses, teaching aids and educational aid programs presented by institutions of ordinary and higher education in the province and over 15 000 pieces of educational equipment and materials for experiment and practice provided by supporters' organizations.
The participants were attracted by an electronic stethoscope and one-chip computer combined practice apparatus displayed by Phyongsong University of Medicine, Phyongsong University of Technology and Phyongsong College of Technology.
Highly appreciated there were an experimental apparatus and insect-mimetic obstacle-avoiding robot presented by Toksong Senior Middle School in Phyongsong City and Songchon Senior Middle School in Songchon County.
Other exhibits presented by different units were also appreciated.
Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and officials concerned looked around the venue of the exhibition. -0-

headline: Mass Movements of Trade Union Organizations Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 2 (KCNA) -- The working class and members of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea are striving to attain a new long-term goal set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Officials of the trade union organizations of the Tokchon Area Coal Mining Complex and the Sunchon Area Youth Coal Mining Complex have encouraged coal miners to make innovations while organizing a socialist emulation among units and conducting on-the-spot motivation activities. As a result, the high-speed tunneling platoons of the Seventh Pit of the Jenam Coal Mine and the First Pit of the Ryongdae Youth Coal Mine carried out their plans for July ahead of schedule.
The primary trade union organization of the Phunggok Youth Coal Mine under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal Mining Complex launched a technical innovation movement to raise the blasting efficiency and increase the amount of coal mining per shift, thus contributing to overfulfilling its monthly production plan by 140 percent.
Officials of the trade union organizations of the Sariwon Tractor Parts Factory and the Sariwon Knitwear Factory have set a high goal for socialist emulation and boosted the masses' spirit of emulation through the ideological work to ensure the full operation of equipment.
Conducting mass movements including multi-loom and multi-spindle tending campaign, dozens of trade union members of the Kusong Textile Mill fulfilled their yearly national economic plans and over 140 workers of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill fulfilled their yearly plans.
The Unpha Mine, Nyongbyon Silk Mill and the Sukchon County Daily Necessities Factory are also conducting the collective innovation movement. -0-

Jagang Province drew up annual plans with the aim of building several small- and medium-sized power stations during the new five-year plan and is pushing ahead with the construction of power stations while giving priority to the supply of equipment and materials.
Efforts are being directed to the construction of small- and medium-sized power stations including the Tokchon Power Station and the Hamhung Youth Power Station No. 2 in South Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces.
