headline: Seminar and Presentation in Field of General Education Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- A seminar on teaching methods and presentation on experience of teaching in the field of general education-2026 took place at the Central Teaching Institute from July 28 to August 2.
At the seminar and presentation held, divided into several panels, the new teaching methods and experience created and gained by officials, teachers and kindergarteners in the field of general education in Pyongyang, North Phyongan Province, North Hamgyong Province, South Hamgyong Province and South Phyongan Province were appreciated for their pedagogical effectiveness and cognitional and educational significance. -0-

headline: Leisure Complexes Boom in Local Areas of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- The leisure complexes, which have been built as bases for people's cultural life in Kangdong County, Jongphyong County and Kaephung District of the DPRK, are now full of happiness and joy of the working people enjoying a new life and a new civilization.
The Kangdong County Leisure Complex is crowded with people full of joy.
At the library which has advanced scientific and technological data, working people and students are preparing themselves as core of the development of the unit and future pillars.
Watching films at the cinema equipped with modern sound and projection equipment, the audiences are unanimously saying that it is very exciting and interesting to see films and they would like to boast of their hometown with such a wonderful leisure complex.
The inhabitants are pleased to purchase various kinds of high-quality goods at the counters of the general commercial section of the leisure complex in the township area of Jongphyong County. Their bright appearances prove the validity and vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on regional development.
The Kaepung District Leisure Complex is also crowded with people who take various kinds of dishes at the well-furnished restaurant.
The faces of the residents, who receive kind service at the beauty parlor and barbershop, are overflowing with profound gratitude to respected ComradeKim Jong Un, tender-hearted father. -0-

headline: Folk Customs of DPRK Seen in August
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 3 (KCNA) -- In August there are Ripchu and Choso, ones of the 24 seasonal divisions of the year in the lunar calendar, in the DPRK.
Ripchu means the beginning of autumn and Choso the decrease of summer weather.
Ripchu and Choso fall on August 7 and August 23 this year.
From olden times, the Korean ancestors pulled up barnyard grass, set up scarecrows on paddy fields in order to prevent crops from birds and animals and mowed for next year's farming in the period.
On the other hand, they planted and cultivated vegetables for kimchi-making.
Vegetables grown in autumn are radish, cabbage, etc.
In the period, people enjoyed various folk dances and folk games.
Typical of them are shoulder dance, dance of handclaps and camp-hitting.
In August people have made various kinds of foods according to the seasonal characteristics of August.
Typical are green corn and eggplant foods.
As seen above, the diligent Korean people have created and steadily carried forward various customs of life in conformity with the seasonal characteristics of August from long ago. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson on U.S. Groundless "Theory of Cyber Threat"
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on August 3 as regards the fact that the U.S. incited the atmosphere of denunciation against the DPRK to mislead public opinion about its "cyber threat":
The U.S. and its followers' "joint warning" about the "cyber threat" by the DPRK is nothing but a stereotyped political accusation with a sinister purpose to tarnish the image of our state.
The repeated malicious assertion of the member states of the multilateral sanctions monitoring team merely aims to spread false information devoid of credibility. Such assertion only brings to light the illegality of ghost mechanism the West organized of its own accord and the gravity of its moves for inter-camp confrontation, not a "threatening nature" by someone.
The dishonest forces are now turning the cyber space, which should contribute to peace and co-prosperity of mankind and progress and development of society, into a theatre of confrontation and veiled enmity to pursue their selfish purpose. And it is an undeniable fact that the U.S. should be blamed for it
The U.S., which was the first in the world to form a cyber command, is hell-bent on joint cyber drills including the Cyber Flag with its allies. And it also formed a military-industrial complex for cyber warfare to steadily expand and strengthen its cyber attack force.
The concept of cyber operation, which has been applied to every joint military drill frequently staged by the U.S. with its vassal forces, is by no means for "defense" but part of its war preparations to attain superiority in electronic information warfare and even in battlefields in contingency.
The U.S. moves to form an exclusive camp in IT field, openly asserting that AI is equivalent to nuclear weapons, are worsening the instability of cyberspace on a global scale and causing a new security crisis.
It is illogical that the U.S., which has possessed and operated the biggest cyber force in the world by monopolizing the core resources of cyber space, is talking about "cyber threat" from other countries. And it is a mere excuse for justifying its illegal policy on placing pressure on sovereign states.
The U.S. and other hostile forces' moves to establish hegemony in cyber space, a treasure common to mankind, with the "theory of cyber threat" fabricated with misinformation can never be tolerated.
The DPRK will never allow any politically- and ideologically-motivated attempt of the U.S. and other hostile forces to use the cyber issue as the means of criticism and pressure on other countries, and make steady and practical efforts to defend the security and development interests of the state in all domains. -0-

headline: Many Young People Active in Helping 5th-Stage Construction in Hwasong Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- More than 41 000 young people in Pyongyang Municipality took part in the activities of a youth shock brigade organized to render assistance to the 5th-stage construction in the Hwasong area at nighttime.
Officials and members of youth league organizations at all levels in the municipality including those of the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies are playing a big role in building a people's ideal street at the construction sites after their day's work.
The deeds of the young people engaged in transporting different materials and realigning the zones are a manifestation of the noble mental world of the young people of our era.
Officials of the youth league and young people gave letters of encouragement and supplies to the builders who are making collective innovations.
The number of young people engaged in the activities of the youth shock brigade has been increasing with each passing day, and the shock brigade members have carried out a lot of work. -0-

Military Commentator on Moves of U.S., Japan and ROK to Threaten Security in Asia-Pacific Region
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Following is the full text of "Threat Posed by the Trinity of the U.S., Japan and the ROK which is settled as a new security crisis in the Asia-Pacific region", an article released by a military commentator on August 3:
Clearly illuminated is the threat by the trinity of the U.S., Japan and the ROK to ensure a military edge by openly ignoring the security concerns of the regional countries and steadily strengthening their ability to carry out the combined war.
This is proved by RIMPAC, the largest-ever joint naval drill in the world, which was recently conducted in the Pacific Ocean, led by the U.S.
It is not a secret that the U.S., which had staged RIMPAC joint military exercises targeting the former Soviet Union since 1971, has steadily expanded the scale and contents of the exercises with the aim of containing the marine advance of other countries and establishing regional hegemony under the pretext of defending the maritime security after the end of the Cold War.
This year, too, the U.S. and its vassal allies conducted more than 500 maritime drills and 2 400-odd flight drills involving over 30 000 troops, above 30 surface warships, five submarines and at least 190 aircraft.
The recent joint military exercises have raised concern of the international community because of not only the large-scale forces and military hardware reminiscent of the Pacific War but also the reality in which the nature and color of RIMPAC, the war drill against the sovereign states in the region, have become clearer and the leading role with which Japan and the ROK have played pursuant to the U.S. hegemonic strategy.
The ROK, which has participated in RIMPAC since 1990, performed the commandership of the joint naval component army commanding the naval forces of the participating countries for the first time, and Japan undertook the deputy commandership of the joint mobile unit in the said drill.
This clearly shows the strategic attempt of the U.S. to strengthen its interoperability with the ROK and Japan under the simulated conditions of a real war and to establish an absolute military hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region by imposing more security burden on them.
The deputy commander of the U.S. Pacific Fleet openly said that the commanding role of the ROK and Japan was not a symbolic one but for the actual operation. This goes to prove that RIMPAC, the largest-ever naval drill in the world, is, in fact, a war rehearsal of aggression led by the U.S., Japan and the ROK.
The U.S. is more openly manifesting such military orientation in the region around the Korean peninsula, the biggest hotspot in the Asia-Pacific region.
In July alone, the U.S. and the ROK staged Buddy Squadron air drills under the pretext of strengthening their capability of cooperation in the air and conducted on an unprecedented scale the Combined Joint Sustainment Training aimed at providing logistic support to the ROK from the U.S. mainland and overseas military bases in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula.
The U.S. speeds up the transformation of the U.S. Forces in Japan into a unified military command with independent operational functions with an aim to strengthen cooperation in command control with the integrated operation command of the Self-Defence Forces of Japan and schemes to deploy in the ROK the medium-range strategic missile system Typhon with the regional countries in its striking range after its deployment in Japan.
Japan launched Tomahawk long-range cruise missile it purchased from the U.S. in the Pacific Ocean amid open debate about going nuclear on its own accord, completely throwing away the deceptive mask of "exclusive defense". And the ROK has been developing a nuclear submarine in real earnest, citing the "naval threat" from neighboring countries.
Apparently, the U.S. confrontational racket and reckless acts of Japan and the ROK which avail themselves of the former's moves have already crossed the red line and their ill-looking war alliance is approaching the international community, threatening global peace and security.
The threat posed by the trinity of the U.S., Japan and the ROK is being settled as a new security crisis in the Asia-Pacific region.
It is the DPRK's invariable mode of controlling situation and crisis to response to a threat of new level with a deterrence of new level.
It is needed to keep an eye on and deter the emergence of the U.S.-led "axis of confrontation" which undermines the security of the region and precipitates instability with the aim of establishing hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region. -0-

headline: Korean-style Roof - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
Korean-style Roof - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Korean-style roof has a long history of its refined form and pattern showing the aesthetic feelings, wisdom and outstanding architecture of the Korean people.
Korean-style gabled, hipped and crane-shaped roofs are all characterized by their graceful and beautiful curves.
The Pohyon Temple, a historical site on Mt Myohyang, typifies the outstanding architecture and excellent artistic skill.
The Taeung Hall, the largest and most splendid building at the Pohyon Temple, is well balanced structurally for its not so high walls and hip-saddle roof.
The Korean ancestors tiled roofs and erected pillars in a curved manner and painted them in soft, gentle and bright colours.
The elegant Korean-style roof has undergone steady development in its formative art to represent the optimistic way of life and resourceful spirit of the Korean people.
Korean-style roof was registered as a part of national intangible heritage in October 2017. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and Posan Iron Works
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field survey of the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex and the Posan Iron Works.
The premier visited the electric locomotive complex and encouraged its workers making innovations in carrying out the important policy tasks of the complex, true to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
The premier acquainted himself in detail with the production of rolling stock of various kinds, the upgrading of the plating process and the operation safety of the newly manufactured tram and the quality of its fittings. He stressed the needs for the officials and workers to know well the height of creation required by the new era, further raise the qualitative level of manufacturing rolling stock and turn the plating shop into a comprehensive and modern plating base.
At the Posan Iron Works, Pak Thae Song said that the officials and workers should attain their production targets without fail by directing efforts to the management of equipment and technical control and increasing the number of operating days of the rotary kiln in keeping with the ever-increasing demand for the iron and steel.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue for the relevant sectors and units to produce and supply equipment and materials necessary for the modernization of the plating process and the production of rolling stock at the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex, the issue of giving preferential treatment to the technicians and skilled workers of the iron works and improving the supply service for its employees, etc. -0-

headline: Efforts Paid to Training Able Persons at Factory Colleges
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- Factory colleges in different parts of the DPRK are actively pushing ahead with the work to train competent persons of practical abilities.
Haeun and Sinuiju colleges of technology created and introduced a new exam system by an AI-based program.
Chongjin and Kangson colleges of technology are steadily raising the teachers' level of educational practice and improving their professional knowledge so that students can acquire useful knowledge faster and deeper.
Komdok College of Technology organized a presentation of ideas to widely generalize the successes and experience, while Ryongsong College of Foodstuff and Kyongsong College of Technology have trained students to be pillars with versatile knowledge and creative ability, closely combining education with production and theory with practice.
Sangnong College of Technology and Ryongsong College of Mechanical Engineering are also contributing to the development of the relevant units by conducting scientific research for placing the production of industrial establishments on a normal footing and putting their equipment on a modern basis, and training skilled workers in a responsible manner. -0-

headline: Salt Industry Sector Increases Salt Production with Underground Ultra-saline Water
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 4 (KCNA) -- The salt industry sector in the DPRK is making successes in producing the salt with underground ultra-saline water.
The Kwisong Salt Works over-fulfilled its plan for July as it secured spare parts necessary for the full operation of equipment and properly controlled the level of water in the crystallization ponds.
The Namyang Salt Works took good care of evaporating ponds and storage facilities and solved technical problems arising in increasing the salinity to carry out its daily and ten-day plan.
The Kumsong Salt Works readjusted in a responsible manner the salt fields with due regard to the weather conditions and increased the storage capacity of salt water by raising the operation rate of the pumping and power equipment.
The Yonbaek Salt Works is also boosting the production of the salt by applying rational working methods, regarding it as the main line to put the operation of equipment and machinery on a scientific basis and improve the quality of products. -0-

headline: Greenhouse Farm and Tree Nursery Built under Care of Respected ComradeKim Jong Un
story_text:
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected the construction sites of the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm and a tree nursery in the northern tip of the DPRK in October 2019.
At a gazebo he was so pleased to enjoy a bird's eye view of the modern vegetable greenhouse farm covering an area of scores of hectares and the tree nursery capable of producing 20 million saplings per year. Feasting his eyes on hundreds of low-storied houses for the employees of the farm and the tree nursery, public buildings, school, kindergarten, nursery, hospital and various service facilities, he said with pleasure that such dramatic transformation was brought about from scratch.
Dusk was falling when the respected Comrade General Secretary went out after looking round the buildings of the Jungphyong Greenhouse Farm for a long time.
When an accompanying official told him that it was getting dark, he said that it was all right and he would regret if he left there without visiting the new dwelling houses for the employees.
Greatly satisfied to see the houses with all amenities, he said that the employees would be so happy and excited that they would sing the song "We Are the Happiest in the World" in such wonderful houses.
Then, he told the accompanying officials that he was very pleased with a new big thing done for the people and he felt like his pent-up fatigue had gone, adding he works hard for this reason. -0-

headline: Rodong Sinmun Calls for Advancing and Making Leap Forward through Emulation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- With an upward trend in effecting uninterrupted transformation, the spirit of fresh innovation is now running high in all fields of socialist construction. The present reality requires the whole society to take part in a vigorous emulation, says Rodong Sinmun Wednesday in an editorial.
The editorial notes:
Emulation is a shortcut to the rapid progress and a key to the creation of miracles. This is the precious truth our state proved in the course of its development.
In the past five years, the whole country was overflowing with the spirit of innovation, creation and advance amid the fierce emulation throughout the society and the motherland underwent changes beyond recognition, offering a striking contrast between yesterday and today. And the historic cause for comprehensive development of socialist construction could successfully pass through its first stage, along with the advance of all regions, sectors and units in emulation with each other. This is an honor won by our ideals and faith and our strength and efforts as well as a clear proof of the vitality of emulation movement.
Today the comprehensive development of socialism has entered a new high stage, and we are faced with heavy and huge tasks. This reality urgently requires all the sectors, units and people to conduct a more dynamic socialist emulation among them. Only when the enthusiasm for emulation grows higher, can we make eye-opening miracles in the struggle for comprehensive national prosperity, sharing successes and experience with each other, transferring them to others and bringing about collective innovations while redoubling efforts to leap higher. Now is the time for all the sectors, units and people to accept emulation as a vital requirement and intensify it for mutual development and thus bring about a new proud era of national prosperity.
Let us all give further momentum to the socialist emulation as intended by the Workers' Party of Korea and thus accelerate the comprehensive prosperity and development of our state. -0-

headline: Chicken Soup Boiled with Insam, Healthy Dish in Midsummer
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- A Korean proverb says "Like cures like".
Therefore, the Korean people have regarded it as a custom good for health to make hot foods in the hottest period of summer.
Among them is chicken soup boiled with insam, forest asiabell, glutinous rice and dates in its stomach.
Its main ingredients are insam with great medicinal properties and nutritious chicken easy to digest.
It is efficacious for recovering health declined due to hot weather and preventing or treating diseases such as diabetes, liver malfunction and anemia.
Now when the sultry weather persists, many guests are going to Roast Chicken House in Changgwang street of a chain of restaurants and the Changjon Haemaji Restaurant and other restaurants in Pyongyang to enjoy chicken soup boiled with insam.
The area famous for the dish is Kaesong.
Insam in the area has a medicinal effect incomparable with those in other regions for its peculiar soil and water quality and unique cultivation method. So, chicken soup boiled with insam in the area of Kaesong gains popularity among not only the Korean people but also overseas Koreans and foreigners. -0-

headline: Motivation Activities by Art Troupes and Artistic Information Teams
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- Art troupes and artistic information teams in the capital city of Pyongyang have conducted motivation activities for increased production at coal mines across the country.
Members of the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea gave full play to the revolutionary enthusiasm and fighting spirit of the workers of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine and the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex through agitprop activities.
Members of the motivation team of artistes from national art troupes boosted the morale of coal miners with songs, comic stories and comic acrobatics at the Songnam Youth Coal Mine of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and the Myonghak Coal Mine of the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex.
The central artistic information team has boosted the enthusiasm of workers at different coal mines of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex through its brisk information and motivation activities.
The artistic information team of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea, too, conducted motivation activities for increased production at the Hukryong Coal Mine under the Kangdong Area Coal-mining Complex. -0-

headline: N. Hwanghae Province Accelerates Rural Housing Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK steps up the rural housing construction on a full scale.
Pongsan, Sangwon and other counties have accelerated the final projects for the interior and exterior of dwelling houses and the land leveling by applying advanced building methods.
The counties involved persons with high skills in the construction brigades and launched a brisk passing-on-technique team movement to raise the rate of carrying out the daily plans.
They are pressing ahead the construction project in a three-dimensional way by giving detailed technical guidance according to processes while reinforcing the construction forces and increasing the operation rate of mechanical means. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "War criminal state Japan's possession of the capability for preemptive attack is a grave threat destroying global peace and security" on August 5:
Japan, a war criminal state, is accelerating its transformation into a war state, taking advantage of the acute and variable trend of the present international situation in which global geopolitical conflicts and inter-camp confrontation are getting fiercer.
Some days ago, Japan conducted a test-fire of Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles loaded on Aegis destroyer Chokai of the Japan Maritime "Self-Defense Force" in the Pacific Ocean.
Earlier, it took part in the U.S.-led joint military drills on the northern coast of Luzon Island, the Philippines in May and committed the launch of offensive missiles outside its territory for the first time after its defeat.
Such military actions prove that Japan's moves to formulate the possession of the capability for preemptive attack through the revision of the "national security strategy" at the end of 2022, contrary to the international law and its constitution which disallowed the possession of war potentials, the right to participate in a war and the right to belligerency, are entering the stage of the actual act.
In March, Japan deployed type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles with a range of about 1,000 km and type 25 high-speed gliding projectiles flying at supersonic speed at high altitude at the posts of the Ground "Self-Defense Force" in Kumamoto and Shizuoka prefectures respectively, thus opening up the prelude to the possession of the capability for preemptive attack.
Recently, it deployed the launcher of type 12 surface-to-ship guided missiles and a reconnaissance drone for confirming the target position on its island in the Pacific Ocean. It is stepping up the delivery of cruise missiles to be loaded into the "F-35A" fighters of the Air "Self-Defense Force" and planning to develop and introduce an unmanned submarine capable of attacking a warship under the pretext of "tightened defense system in the Pacific Ocean".
The mass possession of different kinds of long-range strike means with an unexpectedness of preemptive attack and a drastic increase in the radius of their operation and their deployment of multi-demesne forward spaces for actual war, including sea, underwater and air, make Japan reorganize its overall armed forces as a formation of preemptive attack and overseas aggression.
Japan has so far behaved as a "peace-loving state" in the international arena, branding neighboring countries' measures for bolstering up their self-defense capabilities as "threat" and "provocation". It is now clear that such moves were, after all, a camouflaged tactic to cover up its ambition for a military giant.
What should not be overlooked is that the U.S. is behind such dangerous military moves of Japan.
It is not a secret that the U.S. has handed over Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles to Japan, remodeled a warship to be used in its operation and provided all conditions and environment for its test-fire including the place of launch.
The U.S. is threatening the strategic space of Russia in Europe by placing NATO in front and violating peace and security in the Middle East. It is also seriously encroaching upon the security interests of the independent countries against imperialism by letting its junior stooges like Japan and the ROK as shock brigade in the Asia-Pacific region.
Japan's military expansion in the Asia-Pacific region, which is being turned into the world's biggest hotspot due to the U.S. exclusive and aggressive foreign policy with its hegemonic maintenance as its ultimate goal, is a dangerous development of the situation that seriously threatens international peace and stability.
Japan has not made public detailed information about the water area it conducted the test-fire, the number of missiles, targets of range and other things, but it is undeniable that it is a long-range weapon test with the DPRK and other neighboring countries in the striking range.
If the descendants of militarism, who have inherited the genes of cunning and aggression, have seized deadly weapons in their hands, something unpleasant will happen.
There is no guarantee that Japan, a war criminal state which has gradually made a political, military and legal footing for reinvasion, while denying and embellishing its history of aggression, will not inflict tragic disaster upon humankind again in case the preemptive attack capability is in its hands.
The international community should heighten vigilance against the reckless military ambition of the descendants of the war criminal state keen on realizing the old daydream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere" with the backing of the U.S. and never open the way to a military giant for Japan.
The voices of denunciation and warning alone cannot cool the wild ambition of the gangs of island country for reinvasion.
One effective way is to make Japan feel that its security has been exposed to greater danger due to its greediness.
We should make it regret.
We will never remain a passive onlooker to the military evolution of Japan which may pose a grave threat to the security of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
I make it clear upon authorization that the armed forces of the DPRK and the military leadership will set up additional military options which are obviously due to Japan's transformation of these days. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Putting Fish Farming on Scientific and Intensive Basis
Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 5 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Choe Myong Ok, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood unit No. 44, Jongbaek-dong No. 2, Rangnang District, Pyongyang Municipality, on her 100th birthday.
Choe Myong Ok, who received the birthday spread amid congratulations of officials of the Rangnang District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and residents, expressed her gratitude to Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, deeply moved by the great benevolence of the Party.
Born into a poor peasant's family before the liberation of Korea, she was subjected to all sorts of humiliation and contempt. She could lead a worthwhile life only after the liberation of the country.
She had worked in the textile industry sector for decades and brought up her children well to put them at major posts of socialist construction. -0-

headline: Sci-tech Achievements Exhibition Opens in DPRK
Immediate Farming Work Put on Sci-tech Basis
Three-Revolution Exhibition House Marks Its 80th Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- The Three-Revolution Exhibition House in the DPRK marked its 80th founding anniversary.
PresidentKim Il Sunggave field guidance at the democratic construction exhibition hall, the predecessor of the Three-Revolution Exhibition House, on August 6, 1946. Since then he had frequently visited the exhibition house to develop it into a unique exhibition house of Korean style giving a visual panorama of the validity and vitality of the Workers' Party of Korea's general line of socialist construction.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilgave precious instructions on improving the forms and methods of exhibition while repeatedly visiting the exhibition house. And he had energetically guided it so that it could be turned into a place favored by the people and a base comprehensively dealing with the leadership exploits of the Party.
Under the wise guidance of respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho unfolded a far-reaching plan to open up a new period of development of Korean-style socialism by transforming all the revolutionary positions in line with the demands of the three-revolutions, the Three-Revolution Exhibition House greeted a new phase of its development as a base comprehensively showing the national power of the country.
For the past 80 years, the exhibition house has widely explained to many visitors including foreigners and overseas compatriots the greatness and immortal leadership exploits of the peerlessly great men and the originality and truth of the WPK's line of the three revolutions and hosted national and international exhibitions.
A meeting took place on August 5 to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the Three-Revolution Exhibition House.
Present there were officials concerned and officials and employees of the exhibition house.
Son Chol Jin, curator of the exhibition house, made a commemorative report. -0-

headline: Pyongyang Hosiery Factory
Pyongyang Hosiery Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- Choljuk-trademarked hosiery are popular among the DPRK people.
The hosiery produced by the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory are quality and smart. They are diverse in variety and shape.
The factory, which plays a big role in the production of consumer goods, is associated with the guidance of respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho has worked heart and soul to provide the people with better daily necessities.
On August 6, 2014, he visited the Pyongyang Hosiery Factory and taught the issues arising in improving the quality of goods including the betterment of colors and patterns of hosiery as required by developing reality and the tastes of people, and in putting production on a normal basis.
The factory designed hundreds of kinds of hosiery suited to the tastes, likings and the characteristics of seasons, sexes and ages and perfected rational methods of dyeing different fibers, thus making the products diverse and multicolored.
It has developed and produced tens of kinds of hosiery like functional hosiery with strong antibiosis and good for absorption and exhalation of sweat. The number of expanded varieties reached more than 300 this year.
Choljuk-trademarked hosiery attracted attention of many people at the 16th Commodity Exhibition at Pyongyang Department Store No. 1 and the light industrial goods exhibition "Development of Light Industry-2025". And various products and production processes were registered as February 2 Goods and won the certification of quality control system.
The factory was selected as one of the ten best enterprises in 2024 and 2025
It was awarded rotating pennants and citations several times as it fulfilled the yearly national economic plans. -0-

headline: Brisk Activities of Students' Mobile Motivation Teams and Brass Bands
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- Students' mobile motivation teams and brass bands in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK launched their activities at industrial establishments in the province.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, students from Hamhung University of Hydraulic Engineering and Hamhung University of Technology conducted information and motivation activities to touch the hearts of workers.
Students' mobile motivation teams and brass bands from Hamhung University of Agriculture, Hamhung Commercial Service College, Hamhung University of Computer Science, and Hamhung College of Construction gave artistic motivational performances at the modernized Hamhung Trailing Farm Machine Factory. Their performances encouraged the workers to over-fulfill the daily plans.
The said motivation activities inspired the workers dedicating themselves to carrying out the new Five-Year Plan with greater confidence and courage. -0-

headline: Efforts Paid to Training Promising Taekwon-Do Players
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- Taekwon-Do teaching and reserves training units across the DPRK conduct the teaching and training in an innovative way to train many promising players.
The units have introduced effective training methods to improve jumping ability, flexibility and reaction speed, thus preparing players to perform diverse technical movements.
Theoretical education on methodological issues are given so that students can apply techniques on their own way. Efforts are also directed to creatively introducing training means conducive to improving various striking techniques.
The units have applied teaching methods conducive to rounding off various kicking movements and conducted functional physical training in various forms and methods to improve the physical and technical abilities of students.
They are also striving to put the organizing and guidance of teaching and training on a more scientific basis. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 6 (KCNA) -- The Japanese reactionary government, which had cooperated with the U.S. imperialists in their preparations for a war to invade Korea for a long time, set the issue of its participation in the war as a national policy as soon as the Korean war broke out and joined the war.
On July 4, 1950, a week after the outbreak of the Korean war, then Japanese Prime Minister Yoshida officially declared the support to the U.S. imperialists, the chieftain of the Korean war.
The Japanese militarists offered their territory to the US. Army to use it as dispatch, logistic and supply bases which the member states of the "UN Forces" can not perform by mobilizing all their military and economic potentials.
French newspaper L'Humanite said that the Japanese authorities, at the call of the U.S., sent 200 former generals and officers of the Imperial Japanese Army to the front line immediately after the outbreak of the Korean war (June 25, 1950).
Foreign reports said that the number of Japanese troops who participated in the Korean war in July of that year amounted to 25 000.
The Japanese reactionaries had mobilized almost all the combat forces of the services and arms in the war.
They placed their pilots of the imperial army in U.S. imperialists' B-26 and B-17 planes to transport military supplies and drop bombs. They even mobilized 50 Japanese warships and 2 000 crewmen to join in the Inchon landing operation of the U.S. imperialists.
The Japanese noncombatant "technicians", too, backed the U.S. military actions in the fields of railway transport, communications, harbor, etc. in the puppet ROK.
The Japanese germ experts gave lectures on the use of germ weapons and their dropping and made a field survey of the results for several tens of times in the puppet ROK. The said facts are recorded as the one page of crimes in the Korean war history.
In June 1952, the Japanese reactionary government played the role as a top-class belligerent state with nearly 400 large-scale factories involved in the production of munitions. They established a wartime system in the transport sector and mobilized all the means of transportation in carrying military supplies and troops. From July to October 1950, they carried 995 800 tons of the U.S. military supplies by mobilizing 248 warships in the Korean war.
All the facts are part of the evidence that Japan is the top-class belligerent state in the Korean war. -0-

headline: Rebuilt Vestibule for Old People's Home
story_text:
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the then Pyongyang Municipal Old People's Home under construction on March 5, 2015.
He urged the designers to examine and correct the designs of the exterior and interior of the home to retain its distinction.
Looking at its building at the yard for a while, he said that the exterior of its vestibule was unfit for an old people's home. At that time, the vestibule of the home was designed like that of a scientific research institute or a high-rise apartment house.
He advised that the exterior of the vestibule and the stairs in front of it should be designed and built well to preserve the features as a home for the aged.
He said that among the old people who would live in the home, there might be disabled persons, so it would be better to form two or three low stairs in front of the entrance.
Officials were moved to hear such instruction of him who thinks about convenience of the people before anything else.
After all, the vestibule of the home came to be rebuilt. -0-

headline: Do-good-thing Movement Brisk at Women's Union Organizations
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- Women's union officials and members in Kaesong Municipality of the DPRK are vigorously conducting the do-good-thing movement at farm fields.
They went to farms in Kaephung and Phanmun districts to give full play to the enthusiasm of farmers in carrying out their immediate farming process.
They provided accessories necessary for the full operation of tractors, displaying the communist traits of helping and leading each other and devoting themselves to farming with patriotism.
They transported hundreds of tons of self-sufficing mature to the farms and provided a lot of farm materials to encourage the agricultural workers. -0-

headline: Measures Taken to Minimize Damage from High Temperature
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- Agricultural workers in the DPRK strive to minimize crop damage caused by high temperature.
Farms across the country have made water caretakers of paddy fields enhance their role and intensified farming guidance such as lowering temperature of water in paddy fields and soil by rational water control methods and supplementing various nutrients.
They have also informed the farmers of varieties of major harmful insects and damage caused by high temperature, introduced substitute agrochemicals with good insecticidal and fungicidal effects and installed light traps in farm fields to protect crops.
Agricultural workers are applying leaf fertilizing in a scientific way according to farm fields and plots to minimize the damage. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Light Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- The light industry sector in the DPRK makes successes by concentrating efforts on the work to develop new products and improve their quality.
Factories in the knitting industry have recently developed new products with various effects by dint of science and technology.
They also made various kinds of juvenile underwear suited to children's psychology.
Those in the field of shoe-making industry invented and manufactured new types of shoes and have made progress in improving quality.
The textile, daily-use and cosmetics industry sectors are striving to produce more quality goods.
They produced cloth with good draping property and softness, printed cotton, neckerchief and kerchief.
The Pyongyang Essential Oil Factory increased the intensity of incense 1.2 times to contribute to improving the quality of products at regional-industry factories. -0-

headline: Kumsanpho Fish Pickling Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) -- In the Kumsanpho area on the west coast of the DPRK there is the Kumsanpho Fish Pickling Factory, a large-scale seafood processing base for producing pickled fish by industrial methods.
The factory produces more than 50 kinds of products of over 30 kinds including pickled shrimps, anchovies and shellfishes, and fermented mullet and flatfish.
There are more than 10 kinds of pickled shrimps mixed with green pepper, unripe garlic, leek and perilla leaves.
It produces canned pickles and makes sauce with by-products.
The factory was awarded the top prize at national exhibition of processed marine products and some kinds of pickles were registered as February 2 Goods.
The factory is associated with the warm love of respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho has devoted himself to providing the people with the happiest life in the world.
He proposed building a modern processing factory which produces pickled fish products by industrial method and named it"Kumsanpho Fish Pickling Factory".
On August 7, 2018, when visiting the factory, he looked at the pickled fish products filled at store and said that he feels proud and worthwhile to think that the people's diet would be improved, adding that the factory is like a treasure house in the West Sea port for improving the people's diet.
Thanks to the warm care of the Workers' Party of Korea, the goods of the factory, which are sold at the Kumsanpho specialty shops and stalls in Pyongyang and other parts of the country, gain popularity among the people. -0-

headline: New Documentary and Science Films Produced in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 7 (KCNA) --The Korean Documentary and Science Film Studio produced new documentary and science films conducive to cultural and leisure activities, according to Rodong Sinmun.
A documentary film "Great Enthusiasm for Sports in 2025" vividly shows the proud appearances of sportspersons who displayed the honor of the country with successful results in various international games including the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup and the mass sports activities in different parts of the country last year.
A documentary film "Meritorious Persons of Socialist Patriotism" (5) deals with the meritorious persons of socialist patriotism who are leaving a clear mark in the front ranks of the patriotic struggle to open up a broad avenue to the comprehensive national rejuvenation even in their old ages of life.
A documentary film "Embrace Which the Triplets Live" shows the appearances of triplets enjoying a happy life under the care of the tender-hearted father.
The studio produced science films which give theoretical and visual representation of sci-tech achievements of great practical significance conducive to the economic development of the country and the promotion of the people's health. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Letter of Congratulations to National Symphony Orchestra on Its 80th Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a letter of congratulations to the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on Saturday, its 80th founding anniversary.
The full text of his letter is as follows:
I, in the name of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, extend warm congratulations and greetings of encouragement to the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on greeting its 80th founding anniversary with a sense of honour and pride in having glorified its brilliant history together with our beloved motherland.
Quite extraordinary are the remembrances of the history of the meaningful Moranbong Theatre and of the National Symphony Orchestra that have aroused emotions among the people with the solemn and characteristic sounds of the works of mixed orchestra of our own style.
Having proclaimed its birth as the first orchestra of a new Korea on August 8, 1946 with the playing of "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung", it powerfully demonstrated the ideological will and strong aspiration of all the people to achieve civilization and prosperity with a soaring spirit and mettle for nation building; it has injected renewed vitality and vigour into social progress with model masterpieces of the times. These are etched in the pages of our history.
In the days when the country was experiencing harsh trials, the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra willingly followed the arduous road and rendered support to the revolution with the musical instruments as a weapon of struggle. In the decades that seethed with creation and construction, they proudly sang of the worthwhile life of the people who were shaping a rosy future with affection for their socialist country. In this way, they offered great encouragement to the progress of our cause. These feats of theirs are never trifling.
From the first days of its founding, it has portrayed the songs of praise of our Party and socialism as orchestral works and symphonic suites and medleys, thus presenting them as monumental masterpieces. Its creative activities constitute patriotic feats that recorded in history by dint of solemn and fresh sounds the victorious course our glorious Republic has traversed.
The general title of the works the orchestra has portrayed and put on stage over the past 80 years, sharing the history of our people's struggle to accomplish the gigantic social transformations under the leadership of the Party, should be called "Symphony of Socialism" on its own terms.
In the stirring decade when an era of overall efflorescence of Juche-oriented art was being ushered in, it re-presented such masterpieces as "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain", "The Dear Home in My Native Village", "The Girl on the Swing" and "Arirang", pioneering a new realm of symphony of our own style and bringing home to the people the unusual might of music that leads them to share the destiny of their country and promotes its development. Our people still remember vividly these creative activities of the orchestra.
It can be said that every work represents the language of faith and conscience and the melody of love and passion, which can be expressed only by the musicians of Korea who regard our Party's ideas on aesthetics and musical theories as the only ideology and banner for their creation and by true artistes who treasure everything beautiful on this land and are determined to sing of it to the last moment of their lives.
Comrades Ho Jae Bok, Kim Pyong Hwa, Choe Ki Hyok and other talented conductors and instrumentalists of the orchestra made a contribution to cultivating the rich flower garden of the Juche-oriented art with unflagging passion. Their images still remain implanted in the eyes of our people, and serve as a model of worthwhile life of the revolutionary men of art and literature who sang of their motherland throughout their lives.
The ennobling aspirations and painstaking efforts of the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra to add lustre to its fine history and traditions with innovative achievements can be clearly seen in the fact that they are demonstrating the might of the Juche-oriented symphony in the present era of transformation by arranging famous musical works, loved by the people, to suit the works' emotional contents and modern aesthetic tastes.
In recent years alone, they have created a large number of refined works and gave splendid concerts in celebration of major national holidays, boosting the ennobling feelings of patriotism cherished deeply in the hearts of our people and giving a strong impetus to their spiritual and cultural growth. Their performing activities have left an indelible impression on the people for their peculiar features and moods.
The orchestra has always preserved its competent creative guidance forces and skilled instrumentalists and kept creating symphonies of various themes while successfully re-presenting historical works. These add more to the proud history of the authoritative orchestra.
I think this is an expression and outcome of their true and devoted attitude and outlook on life to support the Party and the country with performing activities, not out of mere sense of duty or with artistic skills, but out of a desire to remain faithful to their jobs assigned by their country without expecting any reward or honour.
Such an excellent spiritual world, with which they are invariably and faithfully fulfilling their duty and steadily writing the history of the orchestra by dint of ennobling consciousness and pure conscience, is the most precious one beyond compare.
Over the past eight decades the orchestra has faithfully preserved its original features of patriotic enthusiasm and sincere artistic creation in their pure forms, exalting its prestige and honour as befitting a national-level art institution that carries on the history of development of Juche-oriented music. It is a precious treasure of our state and a source of great pride for our Party and our people.
Throughout those long years, the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra have remained loyal to its initial aim and basic mission, thereby enjoying the affection and trust of their country and fellow people, and strove to maintain their proud reputation and traditions with constant renovations and progress. For this, I highly appreciate all of them.
Creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra,
The art of music has been a powerful engine for the development of our state, and it will be so, in the future, too.
Our Party's consistent principle in musical creation is to ensure high ideological and artistic qualities, sustain the characteristics of the times and apply a people-oriented approach to the letter.
You should, just as you have done so far, accept the Party's policies on art and literature as absolute and work only as intended by the Party; firmly united in ideology and purpose and also in feeling and emotion, you should work hard to usher in a golden age of the art of music in the new era.
Melodies have a peculiar attraction of greatly stirring up a person's ideological feelings and drawing them into an emotional world that is inexpressibly rich and profound.
As creative workers and instrumentalists of the orchestra, which is in effect a national icon, you ought to excel in artistic insight and skills, and also stand in the vanguard in creating masterpieces that are representative of our era.
Our Party hopes that you will steadily improve your abilities to create and stage any work in a flawless and perfect way, thus continuing to add brilliance to your orchestra's prestige and honour befitting the best music group in our country that boasts a long history and traditions.
Today, when we are advancing towards greater transformation, enthusiastically singing revolutionary songs and other musical works as a march for our struggle and creation, a masterpiece pulsating with the spirit of the times will serve as an invaluable spiritual sustenance.
I firmly believe that all of you, creative workers and artistes of the orchestra, always mindful of the Party's and people's trust and expectations, will continue to write the pages of honourable history of Juche-oriented symphony by improving your practical abilities and conducting proactive and enterprising activities for artistic creation.
I pay tribute to the National Symphony Orchestra's glorious 80-year-long history. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
State Commendations Conferred on Meritorious Creators and Artistes of National Symphony Orchestra
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- Meritorious creators and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra were awardedKim Il SungPrize and orders of the DPRK.
Kim Il SungPrize was conferred on Conductor Ho Mun Yong, Order of National Flag First Class on composer Kang Su Gi, Order of Labour on instrumentalists An Ryong Hwan, Pyon Song Ok and Han Chol, Order of National Flag Second Class on instrumentalists Kim Song Ho, Ri Chol, Yun Chol Ho and Jong Hyon Hui, and Order of National Flag Third Class on instrumentalists Pae Ki Yong, Ri Kyong Gun, Ri Song Jin, Hwang Il Sok and Choe U Chol and Composer Kim Hak Il.
They have made a positive contribution to creating and depicting masterpieces of the era of the Workers' Party by displaying their creative wisdom and enthusiasm while firmly equipping themselves with the Party's Juche-oriented ideology and theory on art and literature and working for a long time in the art sector, and to encouraging the masses of the people to implement the Party's policies through revolutionary art activities.
A relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was issued on August 8. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
At the Kumsong Tractor Factory, the premier called upon the officials and workers to make redoubled efforts to attain the tractor and farm machine production goals decided by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, bearing deep in mind the great trust and expectation of the Party Central Committee which puts forward the factory as a treasure factory leading the development of the farm machine industry of the country.
Going round various production processes including gear workshop, assembly workshop and standardized goods workshop, he called for further increasing the accuracy of processing accessories, reinforcing and perfecting measuring equipment and steadily increasing the efficiency and productivity of equipment.
The field consultative meeting discussed the issues of ensuring the smooth supply of products under contract and materials necessary for tractor production and actively developing efficient farm machines suited to the topographical conditions and actual conditions of the country and took relevant measures.
After acquainting himself with the farming at the Sosin Vegetable Farm in Ryokpho District and the Tanggok Farm in Kangnam County, he called upon the agricultural sector to cultivate crops in a more scientific way in conformity with the abnormal weather condition which high temperature persists and the growth state of crops, and to widely introduce double cropping and triple cropping methods based on first and second crops cultivation and inter after-cropping and thus raise the intensive level of agricultural production. -0-

headline: Famous Orchestral Music "A Bumper Harvest in Chongsan Plain"
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- The National Symphony Orchestra, an art troupe of national treasure in the DPRK, greets its 80th founding anniversary (August 8, 1946).
Everyone in the country loves and enjoys the works of the National Symphony Orchestra including orchestral music "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain", "Blue Sky over My Country", "The Girl on the Swing" and "Mungyong Pass".
In particular, "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain" has widely been known among the people as a typical masterpiece of orchestral music.
The National Symphony Orchestra successfully represented the famous song (words by Kim Sang O and music by Kim Ok Song) produced in 1960, a year of high yield in the history of agricultural development of the country, as a typical work of Korean-style orchestra under the guidance of ChairmanKim Jong Il.
The prelude to the music gives the audience a feeling of looking at the field with bumper crop. It vividly represents the stirring life on the socialist land through vibrant tune and the cheerful and optimistic melody of the folk song.
The audience enthusiastically sent loud applauses to saenap solo reminiscent of the panoramic view of the distribution place where the peasant dance is going on and to total ensemble
This year, too, many people enjoyed the concert given by the National Symphony Orchestra at the Moranbong Theatre on the occasion of May Day, the international holiday of the working people all over the world. They said that they seem to see the bumper harvest in the Chongsan plain through the orchestral music "A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain" and they sang the song with great excitement.
"A Bumper Harvest in the Chongsan Plain" given by the National Symphony Orchestra, a typical masterpiece of Korean music, is also evoking admiration among overseas Koreans and foreigners for its peculiar sound of mixed orchestra of the Juche type. -0-

headline: Project for Improving Medical Workers' Qualifications
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 8 (KCNA) -- Doctor retraining units in the DPRK step up the project for improving the practical qualifications of medical workers at preventive and curative institutions.
Pyongyang Doctor Retraining College has trained teachers to be talents well versed in their major field of study and possessed of wide knowledge in related fields. It dispatched excellent teachers to local preventive and curative institutions to give mobile lectures on advanced medical technology.
The North Phyongan provincial doctor retraining institute has made efforts to raise the level of foreign languages while effectively organizing internships, sci-tech presentations and seminars on experience to expand the intellectual horizon of medical workers.
The North Hwanghae provincial doctor retraining institute has conducted a training course for medical workers in charge of households and retraining on relevant subjects including general surgery, obstetrics and gynecology and pediatrics in a planned way. It also actively applies the clinical experience gained by the preventive and curative medical institutions in the province to teaching practice.
The South Hwanghae provincial doctor retraining institute, too, put all the teaching plans on a practical and comprehensive basis in order to transfer the necessary knowledge to trainees in an efficient way and has improved the quality of experimental and practical education with purposefulness. -0-

headline: Chairman of IMAGC Arrives Here
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- Ri Yong Son, chairman of the International Martial Arts Games Committee who is president of the International Taekwon-Do Federation, arrived here on Saturday to attend an event for lighting a fire at the Tenth International Martial Arts Games.
He was greeted at Pyongyang International Airport by officials of the Korean Taekwon-Do Committee. -0-

headline: Concert Given by National Symphony Orchestra to Mark Its 80th Birthday
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- The National Symphony Orchestra of the DPRK, founded as the first orchestra in a new Korea, marked its 80th founding anniversary with high pride. The orchestra opened up a new phase of Juche-oriented symphony, singing of our Party, country and people with its high musical ability and through proactive and enterprising creative activities.
Since the declaration of its birth with the playing of "Song of GeneralKim Il Sung", an immortal revolutionary hymn, the orchestra has enriched the treasure house of Juche-oriented music and art by representing with monumental orchestral music, symphonic suites and symphonic serial songs the ideological will of all the people and the strong pulse of the times. Its excellent history and tradition and successes of artistic creation are a precious treasure of our state and a source of great pride for our Party and people.
A concert was given at the Moranbong Theatre on Saturday to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the National Symphony Orchestra, a national-level art institution embodying the development of Juche-oriented music.
Among the audience were senior Party and government officials and officials, creators and artistes in the field of culture and arts.
The concert began with orchestral prelude for the piano "Glory to the Workers' Party of Korea". Put on the stage were famous songs of the times, songs praising the Workers' Party and songs about the motherland which gave great impetus to the victorious advance of socialist Korea.
All the art pieces made the audience recollect the proud history of the orchestra, which has elevated noble patriotism and promoted the spiritual and cultural growth while sharing its history with the struggle of the people who have brought great social changes under the leadership of the Party. They also aroused the admiration of the audience for matured performance.
The orchestra "selection of world famous songs" decorated the end of the concert with splendor.
The concert, representing a profound musical world with the solemn and peculiar mixed orchestra of Korean style, showed the ardent aspiration and creative world of creators and artistes who will steadily write the history of honorable development of Juche-oriented symphony through ceaseless pioneering and advance, by remaining invariably faithful to the real intention and original mission of the foundation despite the passage of time.
The audience congratulated the performers on their successful performance, presenting bouquets to them.
The concert, held to mark the 80th founding anniversary of the National Symphony Orchestra, gave deep impression to the audience with profound ideological and artistic qualities and solemn sound of the "Socialist Symphony". -0-

headline: Steps Taken to Put Cage-net Fish Farming and Sea Urchins Aquaculture on Scientific Basis
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Ministry of Fisheries in the DPRK concentrates efforts on the cage-net fish farming and sea urchins aquaculture with good prospect and high economic efficiency.
The ministry has taken measures to supply to the Ongjin West Sea Fish Farm the materials necessary for manufacturing and repairing net cages and, at the same time, strived to explore and introduce advanced fish farming methods related to the artificial collection of eggs and breeding of fry in connection with the Academy of Fishery Science.
It is making efforts to conduct cage-net fish farming in rivers, lakes and reservoirs.
It has ensured that provinces, cities and counties intensify technical guidance and assistance to the cage-net fish farming units in introducing scientific fish farming methods suited to the physiological and ecological characteristics of fishes.
More than 100 000 square meters of net cages have been installed in suitable areas across the country and millions of young fishes bred there.
The ministry dispatches groups of researchers of the Academy of Fishery Sciences to various units in the east and west seas to reaffirm the places suited to sea urchin farming and solve the sci-tech problems arising in artificial breeding and aquaculture of sea urchins.
It is also concentrating efforts on solving the technical problems arising in the sea urchin farming. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnHas Photos Taken with Creative Workers and Artistes of National Symphony Orchestra Greeting Its 80th Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on August 8 met and congratulated the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra on its 80th founding anniversary.
All the creative workers and artistes of the orchestra were filled with great excitement and joy as they came to realize their greatest desire to have ComradeKim Jong Un, for whom they yearned so much, at their theatre on the significant founding anniversary.
ComradeKim Jong Unwas courteously greeted at the Moranbong Theatre by officials of the Central Committee of the WPK, Hyon Un Chol, minister of Culture of the DPRK, and leading officials of the National Symphony Orchestra.
When he entered the main lobby of the theatre, the excitement of creative workers and artistes greeting the moment of greatest happiness developed into thunderous cheers.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated all the creative workers and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra significantly commemorating its founding anniversary with the glory and pride of having made the brilliant history with the beloved country, and had a photo session with them.
He presented a bouquet of congratulation to Ho Mun Yong, a conductor who was honored withKim Il SungPrize, and had photos taken with the creative workers and artistes who were honored with high-class state commendations amid the pride of having contributed to the development of Juche-oriented symphony.
All the creative workers and artistes broke into stormy cheers and chanted slogans of loyalty in reflection of their firm resolution to continue to write the pages of honorable development history of Juche-oriented symphony by conducting proactive and enterprising activities for artistic creation, bearing deep in mind the love and trust of the benevolent MarshalKim Jong Unwho sent a letter of congratulations to the orchestra greeting its 80th founding anniversary and repeatedly showed great benevolence.
ComradeKim Jong Unappreciated that it is the high pride of our Party, state and people to have such an art group with an excellent history and tradition and high creative ability as the National Symphony Orchestra, which has cultivated the flower garden of Juche-oriented musical art, enthusiastically singing revolutionary songs and other musical works as a march for struggle and creation in the development course of our Republic.
The authoritative National Symphony Orchestra should play a role as an engine in developing the musical art, which is as ever strong motivating power for prosperity of our state, he said, adding that when the solemn and characteristic sounds of the works of our own style orchestra give greater impetus to the Korean revolution and lead the heyday of development of the musical art in the new era, our cause will emerge victorious with greater strength and full vitality.
Very high is our Party and people's expectation in the orchestra which has faithfully preserved its original features of patriotic enthusiasm and sincere artistic creation in their pure forms over the past eight decades, he said, and gave precious instructions to be adhered to as a guideline by the orchestra to exalt its prestige and august name as befitting an artistic group of national value that carries on the history of development of Juche-oriented music. -0-
