Hamhung Pine, Natural Monument
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- In the DPRK, there are many pine trees specially designated and protected as natural monuments.
Among them is Hamhung Pine in Hungdok District, Hamhung City, South Hamgyong Province.
The 400-odd-year-old tree is a rare heteromorphic pine.
Its trunk is inclined southeastward and then split into two branches, extending straight to the southwest.
Many twigs spread from the two branches to overhang the land and form a beautiful tray-shaped crown.
In August 1967 ChairmanKim Jong Ilstressed the need to take good care of this tree, saying it is a rare one.
The tree, rare-to-be-seen in the world, is attracting the attention of experts for its significance in botanical research. -0-

headline: Progress Made in Coal Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- The Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex in the DPRK makes successes in a drive for increased production.
The complex has concentrated efforts on tunneling to provide sufficient coalfields and invented and introduced valuable innovations to increase the proportion of mechanization in the face work.
The Namyang Coal Mine has produced 23 000 more tons of coal than scheduled this year and the Hyongbong Coal Mine has registered high results every day by improving the overall processes including prospecting, tunneling and coal-cutting.
The Wolbong Coal Mine has increased its productivity far more than the same period of last year.
The Tokchon Coal-mining Machine Factory sent hundreds of coal wagons, various accessories and tools to coal mines so as to give vitality to the increased production.
The complex has concentrated its workforce and means on the faces rich in deposits and favorable for mining conditions and to increase the coal production, while striving to realize the mechanization of work in pits and diversify the transport means. -0-

headline: State Commendations Conferred on Creators and Artistes of National Symphony Orchestra
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of awarding state commendations to meritorious creators and artistes of the National Symphony Orchestra took place on Saturday to mark its 80th founding anniversary.
After a relevant decree of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK was read out, Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, conferred the state commendations.
Kim Il SungPrize was conferred on Ho Mun Yong, a conductor of the orchestra. Order of National Flag First Class was awarded to a composer Kang Su Gi and Order of Labor to instrumentalists An Ryong Hwan, Pyon Song Ok and Han Chol.
Order of National Flag Second Class was conferred on instrumentalists Kim Song Ho, Ri Chol, Yun Chol Ho and Jong Hyon Hui, and Order of National Flag Third Class on a composer Kim Hak Il and instrumentalists Pae Ki Yong, Ri Kyong Gun, Ri Song Jin, Hwang Il Sok and Choe U Chol. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Consumer Goods Goes on in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 9 (KCNA) -- The 2026 National Exhibition of August 3 Consumer Goods is going on at the Pyongyang Underground Shop.
The venue of the exhibition has been crowded with visitors every day as it displays colorful products developed and produced by over 400 units across the country.
Appreciated by purchasers are various kinds of children's garments, ornamental flowers and bags made by production units of consumer goods in Pothonggang and Tongdaewon districts with the effective use of materials lying idle.
Different kinds of quilts and plastic goods, produced by the Taean District Home Workteam Management Station and the Kangso District Consumer Goods Cooperative Production Station with locally available raw materials, give confidence in things of their own.
Consumer goods presented by the Wonsan City Consumer Goods Cooperative Production Station and the Unpha County Home Workteam Management Station draw the attention of visitors. -0-

headline: National Sports Contest of University Teachers and Students-2026 Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- The National Sports Contest of University Teachers and Students-2026 took place at Kim Chaek University of Technology from July 29 to August 9.
The contest brought together more than 1 000 teachers and students selected from over 40 universities in the capital city and provinces. The players competed in the volleyball matches (students) and table tennis matches (teachers and students), divided into categories of central-level universities and provincial-level ones.
Kim Il SungUniversity and Phyongsong University of Medicine came first in the men's volleyball matches, Kim Chaek University of Technology and Chongjin University of Medicine in the teachers' table tennis matches, andKim Il SungUniversity and Phyongsong University of Technology in the students' table tennis matches.
Wonsan Jong Jun Thaek University of Economics won the first place in the women's volleyball matches.
Successful units and players were awarded trophy cups, medals and commendations. -0-

headline: Improved Quality of Koryo Medicines
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- Jagang Province and Nampho Municipality of the DPRK direct efforts to the medical science research and the improvement of quality of Koryo medicines.
An exhibition of sci-tech achievements in health sector was recently held in Jagang Province. Presented to it were devices and medical appliances developed by public health establishments at all levels in the province.
A prostate gland kneader and other devices, developed by medical workers at the provincial general hospital, won a high appreciation as they are effective in treating patients.
Medical appliances and a digital water quality analyzer, developed by Kanggye University of Medicine, attracted the visitors' attention as they help ensure rapidity in curing illnesses and analyzing water quality.
Nampho Municipality arranged an exhibition of goods, produced at Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories, to encourage quality competition.
The Chollima District Koryo Medicine Pharmaceutical Factory produced efficacious medicines by modernizing equipment.
Nampho, Kangso District, Onchon County and Ryonggang County Koryo medicine pharmaceutical factories are contributing to the promotion of people's health by mass-producing quality Koryo medicines with locally available herbs. -0-

headline: Law on Nationalization of Major Industries
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- Today is the 80th anniversary of the promulgation of the law on nationalization of major industries by PresidentKim Il Sung.
Today the DPRK people are looking back with deep emotion on the feats performed by the President in leading the struggle for nationalization of major industries to victory so as to put the workers forward as the masters of the factories, the ones of the means of production.
Before Korea's liberation most of its industries were monopolized by Japanese imperialists and comprador capitalists. And this noticeably prevented its economic development.
After Korea's liberation (August 15, 1945) the President acquired a deep insight into the requirement of the developing revolution and organized and led the struggle for nationalization of major industries.
Factionalists completely infected with flunkeyism and dogmatists asserted that nationalization of industries should be carried out at the stage of the socialist revolution, and that all the industries nationalized. And they also insisted that industries should be owned by capitalists as the Korean revolution means the bourgeois revolution. They even argued that there is no need to promulgate the law on nationalization of industries because major industries belonged to the Korean people, following the defeat of the Japanese imperialists.
Taking into account the specific conditions of the country, the President set nationalization of industries, which was regarded as a task for the socialist revolution in the past, as an important task for the anti-imperialist, anti-feudal democratic revolution.
To realize nationalization of major industries, the President set forth the slogan "Factories to the Workers" and took such measures as the organization of factory committees assigned to seize and operate the industrial facilities and economic organs, the objects of nationalization, and the establishment of a well-regulated system of controlling and managing them within the people's government organs.
The President promulgated "Law on Nationalization of Industries, Transport, Communications, Banks and So On" on August 10, 1946.
According to the law on nationalization of major industries, more than 1 000 major industrial facilities amounting to over 90 percent of all the industries became all-people property.
Nationalization of major industries enabled our workers to become legitimate masters of factories and means of production and made it possible to use major means of production for the prosperity of the country and the promotion of the working people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Steps Taken to Protect Power System from High Temperature
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- The power transmission and distribution sector in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, concentrates all its efforts on protecting the power system from high temperature and ensuring its normal operation.
The Pyongyang Municipal Power Transmission and Distribution Station has regularly supplied electricity needed for the operation of pumping stations so that the supply of domestic water for households is not hindered.
It has taken practical measures to prevent overload of main transformers and pole type transformers installed in the relevant areas and paid attention to supply electricity with normal frequency to rural areas.
The Pothonggang District Power Distribution Station has intensified the inspection of its sections and meticulously controlled the power equipment to thoroughly prevent abnormal phenomena caused by high temperature.
Phyongchon and Sosong district power distribution stations have arranged power distribution lines effectively to protect and manage the electrical installation in a responsible manner. -0-

headline: Xiaohaerbaling Conference
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- In the glorious history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle Xiaohaerbaling conference has been recorded as a historic gathering of weighty significance in making preparations to actively meet the great event of the liberation of the country.
In the 1940s the Japanese imperialists ignited aggressive wars in Southeast Asia while carrying out the large-scale "punitive operations" against the Korean People's Revolutionary Army (KPRA) and oppressing the Korean people more viciously than ever before.
PresidentKim Il Sungwas sanguine about victory in the revolution even in the grave situation and convened a conference of military and political cadres of the KPRA in Xiaohaerbaling, Dunhua County on August 10 and 11, 1940.
The President set it as a new strategic task to preserve and build up the forces of the KPRA, the pivotal hard core of the Korean revolution, and to train them into competent political and military cadres as part of preparations to actively meet the liberation of the country.
In order to carry out the strategic task, the President adopted the policy of switching over from large-unit operations to small-unit actions.
In line with the said policy, the small units and groups of the KPRA delivered a telling political and military blow to Japanese imperialists everywhere through brave mobile warfare and inspired the people to the anti-Japanese struggle. In this way, they created a favorable condition to launch final offensive operations for the liberation of the country.
Looking back on the conference, the President said, "If we had continued with large-unit operations in pursuit of only immediate successes, unable to see the trend of developments at the opportune moments, it would have been impossible to preserve our force and we would have been wiped out, to be remembered by history as mere martyrs." -0-

headline: Schoolchildren Conduct Motivational Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 10 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren in North Phyongan Province of the DPRK conducted motivational activities at major worksites in the province.
They gave an appealing art performance at the construction site in the area of Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm where the project for the regional development policy is being carried out.
Cheerful band music gave greater confidence and courage to the soldier-builders who are glorifying the precious name of the pioneers of socialist civilization and creators of the people's happiness while leaving worthwhile traces of creation and exploits.
They also rendered encouraging letters and aid materials to coal miners while giving a colorful performance for them.
At a building-materials production base, they encouraged the workers through cheerful songs and dances. -0-

headline: Japan's Defense White Paper Is Reinvasion-minded One for Legalization of Operation of War Machine: International Security Analyst
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 11 (KCNA) -- Kang Won Chol, an international security analyst of the DPRK, issued the following article "Japan's defense white paper is a reinvasion-minded one for the legalization of the operation of war machine":
Japan has been rushing headlong into militarization, seized with an ambition for reinvasion. Against this backdrop, it issued the 2026 Defense White Paper.
In the white paper, being rejected as the one for aggression at home and abroad, Japan groundlessly described the DPRK and other neighboring countries as a "serious and imminent threat" and the "greatest strategic challenge" in order to justify its reckless arms buildup.
It is nothing but an act of turning black into white that Japan stipulated the "threat" from neighboring countries in the white paper although it has been putting spurs to the tightening of the alliance with the U.S. and its followers after setting it as a "state policy" to negate its past crimes and realize its ambition to become a military power.
As everybody knows, Japan, a war criminal state responsible for inflicting a great disaster upon the humankind in the first half of the 20th century, refuses to discard the militarist ambition for reinvasion in the face of all the political and legal restrictions, and have been heading for its conversion into a military power out of vengeance for its defeat for over 80 years. This poses an imminent and serious threat to the world at present.
Following the publication of the white paper, Defence Minister Koizumi stressed the need to beef up and renovate the military muscle with a sense of urgency and crisis in response to the escalating threats from the neighboring countries. This clearly shows how desperately he is pushing Japan into following an extremely dangerous road in the vanguard for militarization.
The reality proves that Japan's political climate and true colors characterized by an aggression gene remain unchanged and mutate into more dangerous forms with each passing day.
No matter how hard Japan tries to describe its real intention for aggression as "defense", it will never conceal its true colors as a root cause of endangering the peace and escalating the tensions in the region.
To build up in every way an overwhelming and powerful war deterrent for self-defence capable of containing and frustrating the enemy states' ambition for reinvasion and their attempt to unleash an aggressive war serves as an indispensable contribution to reliably defending the sovereignty of the country and maintaining the regional peace and stability.
Japan's frantic moves to turn itself into a war state and invasion-minded state will only further endanger Japan's future.
The international community should sharpen vigilance against Japan's neo-militarist move to seriously destroy the regional peace and security and turn itself into a more dangerous entity each day, and strongly condemn and reject it. -0-

headline: DPRK Officials Pay Condolatory Visit to Lao Embassy
Method of Grilling Korean-Style Steak - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- From olden times, steak, one of the three favorite foods of the Korean people, had been widely known to other countries as "Maekjok" (Korean-style steak).
Maekjok means steak eaten by the Maekjok tribe (original inhabitants of the state of Koguryo) who had existed in ancient times of Korea.
Typical of the Korean steak is beefsteak.
It has been well known for its peculiar taste from olden times as it is prepared by grilling tasty Korean beef seasoned with garlic and sesame oil over charcoal fire.
The method of grilling steak was further developed in the period of Koguryo (B.C. 277-A.D. 668). Therefore, "Maekjok" was once called Koguryo-style steak.
Its kinds were more diversified and the cuisine was developed in the period of Koryo (918-1392) and the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910).
Among the steaks of the DPRK, beefsteak grilled over charcoal fire has been well known to the world.
The method of grilling Korean-style steak was registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage in November 2015. -0-

headline: Jonggwang Temple
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- There is Jonggwang Temple in Riwon County, South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK. It was built in the mid-seventh century.
The temple preserves in original state historical relics including paintings.
Originally there were more than ten buildings at the temple. However most of them were disappeared due to the Japanese imperialists' destruction and plunder and now only a few such as Taeung Hall are standing there.
Taeung Hall, the main building, has hip-saddle roof and double eaves and its decorative engravings are very excellent.
The hip-saddle roof which was harmonized with a green forest shows the excellence of the Korean architecture strong in national sentiments.
The temple also has Myongbu Hall and a stone pagoda.
On August 12, 2007, ChairmanKim Jong Illooked round Jonggwang Temple and gave precious instructions for preserving and managing historical and cultural relics associated with the excellent architecture and outstanding artistic talents of the Korean people. -0-

headline: Signal Progress Made in Coal Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- More than 20 youth shock brigades in the coal industry of the DPRK carried out their two-year or yearly national economic plans.
Youth shock brigades at the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex have steadily increased the operation rate of equipment and introduced advanced blasting methods to make more achievements in tunneling.
A youth shock brigade at the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex implemented its yearly plan ahead of schedule. And it carried out the two-year national economic plan by June.
Those of Anju and Kaechon area coal-mining complexes, too, have registered high production results every day.
Those of the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex are recording achievements through a sequence of drilling and blasting. -0-

headline: Students in DPRK Tour Revolutionary Battle Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Senior middle school students in North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK made a study tour of the Jongbangsan Revolutionary Battle Site on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The site is associated with the feats of small unit members of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army who inspired many people to the all-people resistance, true to the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sung's Juche-oriented revolutionary line on actively preparing for the great event of the national liberation.
The visitors recalled the patriotic feats of the Generalissimo, who organized and led the unprecedentedly arduous anti-Japanese war to brilliant victory, holding aloft the banner of self-reliant independence.
Being told about the small unit members' activities for rallying people under the banner of the anti-Japanese struggle, the students cherished as a precious ideological and moral asset the moral world of the fighters who carried out the operational plan of the Generalissimo thoroughly.
They had a meeting to hear impressions of the reminiscences of anti-Japanese guerrillas and a contest of singing revolutionary songs in chorus while marching in array, displaying the high spirit and strong will of the younger generation to steadfastly carry forward the baton of loyalty and patriotism under the flag of the Korean Children's Union by inheriting the proud traditions of the Children's Corps during the anti-Japanese struggle. -0-

headline: Symposium on Wheat Cultivation Technology
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- A symposium on the breeding of high-yielding wheat strains suitable for double-cropping and their cultivation technology took place at the Academy of Agricultural Sciences on August 11 under the co-sponsorship of the Agricultural Technology Association of Korea and the Breeding Society of Korea of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea.
Attending the symposium were scientists and technicians from more than 30 units, including Wonsan University of Agriculture and the Ryumyong Farm of the Nampho Municipal Rural Economy Committee.
Dozens of valuable papers were submitted to the symposium. Those papers proved effective in growing and introducing high-yielding varieties of wheat suited to the climatic and soil conditions of the country and reaping a good harvest through scientific cultivation.
Highly appreciated were innovations to boost the per-hectare wheat harvest and apply various agricultural sci-tech products to growing wheat.
During the symposium there was a lecture on cultivating high-yielding varieties of wheat. -0-

headline: Ski Resort
story_text:
One day in December 2019, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Yangdok Hot Spring Resort. First he dropped in at the ski service building.
Looking at ski equipment in front of the equipment service counter, he said with great satisfaction that the people would like the ski resort very much as they could receive ski service as well as hot spring treatment.
Then he went round various places of the resort.
He told the officials he felt the need to go back to the ski area and headed for a cable car. Officials were so bewildered. An official told him that it would be better to get there by car.
He said that even if you had test operations for ten times, it would be much better for him to take a cable car. Then he personally got in the cable car, saying that the people could take the cableway at ease if they knew that he used it.
At the summit, he looked at the young people skiing down the steep skiing track with a bright smile on his face.
The officials were overcome with emotion, looking up to the respected General Secretary who devoted himself to providing our people with the ski resort. -0-

headline: International Affairs Analyst of DPRK on Japan's Policy of "Using Atomic Power"
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Ri Myong Nam, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, Wednesday issued the following article "What does the policy of 'using an atomic power', timed to coincide with the Japanese high-ranking politicians' assertion of access to nuke, suggest?":
At a recent cabinet ministerial conference on the atomic power policy, Japan reportedly decided an action guideline calling for "making the utmost use of atomic power for energy security and decarbonization".
The essence of the guideline is to build 2~5 new nuclear reactors of the next generation by the 2040s and 11~14 reactors by the 2050s as regards the fact that the reactors of most domestic atomic power plants are superannuated, and to focus on investment, research and development and training of talents to this end.
At a glance, it is illuminated as a medium- and long-term plan for satisfying the daily-increasing domestic energy demand, but in view of the relations with the policy of atomic power pursued by Japan, the guideline contains a sinister and cunning strategic attempt that can never be overlooked.
It is an open secret that Japan planned to develop and use atomic bombs targeting the enemy states during World War II and has persistently pursued the possession of nuclear weapons so far.
Japan's atomic power policy is an extremely double-dealing and deceptive one as it has persistently pursued the nuclear armament under the specious name of "peaceful use of atomic power".
It is proved by the successive Japanese rulers from the Kishi Cabinet in the 1950s to the Abe Cabinet in the 2010s through Sato, Fukuta, Nakasone and Hata cabinets, who said that "Japan would have nuclear weapons if the requirement for defense was imminent", "Japan can have nuclear weapons for exclusive defense under the constitution," and "Japan is certainly capable of possessing nuclear weapons".
In fact, the Japanese government and the "Self-Defense Forces" have never stopped the internal examination on nuclear armament for the past decades, and it goes without saying that Japan's ambition for nuclear armament is based on the vast amount of nuclear material and nuclear technology seized through the operation of nuclear power plants at home.
Under the active patronage and connivance of the U.S., Japan is enjoying the privilege of extracting, stockpiling and reusing plutonium by reprocessing spent nuclear fuel among non-nuclear states. And it has now stockpiled 44.4 tons of plutonium and is planning to complete the spent nuclear fuel reprocessing plant within this year.
Nuclear power plants in Japan have reportedly piled up large quantities of spent nuclear fuel rods which can be used in extracting plutonium at any time and their quantities have already approached the limit of storage capacity.
It is the opinion of experts that Japan, which has secured huge quantities of nuclear material and possessed sensitive nuclear technology for military purposes, has turned into a de facto "quasi-nuclear weapons state" capable of making nuclear weapons within several months once it is determined to do.
What should not be overlooked is the fact that the Japanese government's decision on the nuclear power-related guidelines is timed to coincide with the recent call for nuclear possession by ultra-right politicians.
The present Takaichi Cabinet, which emerged in October last year, is pushing ahead with neo-militarist internal and external policies such as the revision of the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles" and the possession of nuclear submarines, while the theory of nuclear armament is openly being discussed among high-ranking politicians including the minister of Defense and an assistant to the prime minister.
Japan is hell-bent on the deployment of various kinds of ultra-modern military hardware including Tomahawk cruise missile for actual war and the expansion of firing range with the back of its American master keen on maintaining military hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region. It is as clear as noonday that what the purpose of Japan is through a decision on guidelines related to medium and long-term atomic power.
It is the real intention of the Japanese ruling quarters in advertising "the maximum use of atomic power" to maximize the striking power of military hardware deployed for action in parallel with the building of military infrastructure possessed of preemptive attack means far beyond the territory of the archipelago.
Even now when 80-odd years have passed after the war, neo-militarist Japan is sharpening the sword of revenge while persistently denying its past history of aggression and advocating the "story of threats from neighboring countries". If Japan has nuclear weapons, a catastrophe unprecedented in history will surely come true.
Japan's nuclear armament, another malicious variable, seriously threatens the strategic security balance of the region along with the U.S.-Japan-ROK cooperation system which is evolving into a military bloc containing nuclear elements. The prevailing situation demands that the independent states in the region bolster up the war deterrent capable of overwhelmingly suppressing the dangerous military acts of the enemy countries.
If Japan, a war criminal state frantically dashing toward the threshold, hallucinated by militarism, persists in its nuclear weapons ambition, it will surely reach the tragic end of ruin of the whole of the archipelago.
The international community aspiring after justice and peace should never tolerate Japan's reckless and dangerous scheme for nuclear armament. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Jang Kum Chol, First Vice-Minister and Director General of Tenth Department of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 12 (KCNA) -- Jang Kum Chol, first vice-minister and director general of the Tenth Department of the DPRK Foreign Ministry, Wednesday issued the following press statement "The ROK's scheme for possessing a nuclear submarine, which constitutes a new dangerous element to the security in the Asia-Pacific region, will certainly meet stranding":
The ROK's scheme for possessing a nuclear submarine, which has recently entered the phase of practice, is amplifying the instability of the regional security environment.
The ROK, which announced in May the "Jangbogo-N Project" for the development and introduction of its own nuclear submarine by the mid-2030s, is now intensifying its moves to implement it.
At the first meeting of the "future defense strategy committee" held at the naval submarine command in Jinhae, South Kyongsang Province a few months ago, the chief executive of the ROK justified the development of nuclear submarine, claiming that the plan for building a nuclear submarine is an expression of the will to take responsibility for peace and security on the Korean peninsula.
The ROK Ministry of National Defense, too, clarified that the nuclear submarine will use low-enriched uranium fuel and the whole process of development and building will take place at home. Thus, it officially declared that the development of nuclear submarine has switched over to the stage of practice from the planning stage.
Early in June, a U.S. delegation led by the U.S. undersecretary of State for Political Affairs, which comprised officials of the State Department, the Department of Energy and the Department of Defense, visited the ROK to agree to accelerate the consultation on nuclear submarine and establish a tripartite cooperation framework for the introduction of small modular reactor between the U.S., Japan and the ROK. It is a typical example of the fact that the prior environment necessary for the ROK's development of nuclear submarine is being created.
The ROK's persistent attempt to possess nuclear submarine can never be regarded as a defense measure to cope with someone's "threat".
The ROK has secretly pushed ahead with its plan for building a nuclear submarine since 2003, more than 20 years ago. Such fact goes to prove that the ROK's ambition to possess nuclear submarine is neither a "reflective measure" to respond to the DPRK's possession of nuclear weapons nor a matter of defensive nature to cope with the "regional threat".
Obviously, the ROK harbors another ambition.
The ROK raised the issue of enriched uranium for nuclear fuel as an item of preferential solution prior to the design, hull building and reactor development of nuclear submarine and demanded the revision of the "U.S.-ROK Nuclear Agreement". The fact hints at many things.
It is the final goal of the ROK to secure the right to produce nuclear materials, free from the restraint of the item on reprocessing nuclear waste fuel and prohibiting uranium enrichment, and ultimately pave the way for making a leap forward to nuclear armament.
The secret intention of the ROK, which is working hard to develop a nuclear submarine with its own nuclear armament in sight, can never be diluted, no matter how it talks about the "nuclear threat" from someone or "building up of self-defense capabilities".
The ROK's possession of nuclear submarine will inevitably result in nuclear dominoes in the Asia-Pacific region.
Japan has already disclosed its ambition not to exclude all possible options for the introduction of nuclear submarine, throwing off the mask of the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles" with the ROK's scheme to possess nuclear submarine as an occasion.
The ROK's scheme to possess nuclear submarine is not a matter to be considered as the military ambition of a country.
This is part of the U.S. great strategy to build an axis of nuclear hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region with the proliferation of nuclear submarine as a vehicle and thus restructure the military balance in the global scale in favor of it.
The U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation system, which is turning into a nuclear alliance, and AUKUS, the U.S., UK and Australia nuclear submarine alliance, are already in existence in the Asia-Pacific region.
The ROK's possession of nuclear submarine will inevitably be a preparatory step for developing the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military alliance into the "second AUKUS", and if the international community overlooks this, it will have no other choice but to face the waves of confrontation made by the U.S.-led nuclear submarine alliance in the Asia-Pacific region including the waters around the Korean Peninsula, the Taiwan Strait and the South Sea of China.
The geopolitical security environment in the Asia-Pacific region is facing a grave challenge due to the U.S. which oversteps the conception of alliance and openly connives and encourages the attempt of its allies to go nuclear and the ROK engrossed in greedy ambition.
The plan for developing a nuclear submarine agreed by Washington which granted a request of Seoul will further aggravate instability in the Korean Peninsula, and this constitutes a grave challenge to the security of our state and its maritime sovereignty and a security threat to be countered without fail.
The new reality of amplifying regional instability reminds us why it is the first national strategic affair to possess the most perfect and complex operational combat strength capable of reliably defending the maritime sovereignty of the state while initiatively and preferentially coping with any change of the security environment.
The possession of the unparalleled power capable of neutralizing all sorts of existing or newly-emerging potential threats and responding to any military attempt of the enemy states to provoke the strategic sovereignty security of our state with the retaliatory attack which make them impossible to survive and revive will be the most responsible option for deterring a war. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 14 (KCNA) -- The spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on August 13:
The U.S. and the ROK announced that they would stage the large-scale joint military exercises Ulji Freedom Shield from August 17.
The exercises are expected to involve tens of thousands of troops and combat equipment, including forces of the U.S., the ROK and member states of the "UN Command", and field maneuvers such as Warrior Shield and various drills for real war simulating the environments for the ultra-modern operations like drone, electronic and cyber warfare.
The U.S. announced that the forthcoming exercises are quite different from the ones of the past five years and intended to master the ability of fighting a war on the basis of the new aspects of modern warfare. By doing so, it did not conceal its aim to complete preparations for the substantial military confrontation with the DPRK.
This is tantamount to an admission that the exercises, which the U.S. and the ROK describe as "annual" and "defensive" ones, are a rehearsal for an aggressive war.
Furthermore, the exercises are going to be staged again at a time when military and political situation is becoming more serious with each passing day in Europe, the Middle East and other parts of the world and the U.S. abuse of strength has become part of its daily routine. They are incurring the instability in the Korean peninsula and other regional countries, which is more serious than before.
The coordination of the U.S. forces' offensive posture which has begun in earnest across the world, the expansion of strategic flexibility by the U.S. forces in the ROK which is getting serious as part of it, the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation system which is turning into a nuclear alliance and the strengthening of the military muscle by Japan and the ROK more clearly show how dangerous the said exercises involving all the military assets and war-fighting modes of the U.S. and the ROK are.
The enemy states' exercises for an aggressive war which have more serious provocative nature and dangerousness than last year are posing a grave threat to security sphere of our state and regional security environment.
The U.S. can never succeed in its attempt to seize military hegemony again and rebuild the unilateral threatening structure, which becomes an irreversible thing of the past in the Korean peninsula, by steadily replacing the old war scenario with a new one and holding rehearsals.
It is our consistent principle of ensuring security to respond to a new level of a threat with a new level of a deterrent.
The DPRK remains steadfast in its will to frustrate outsiders' hostile acts with the most powerful and overwhelming force and absolutely defend the supreme interests of the state security.
The DPRK will not tolerate the grave confrontational situation which is being created by the enemy states but more clearly express its stance on the enemies to cope with any threats and challenges through the responsible and decisive exercise of the right to legitimate self-defense. -0-

The U.S. moves for nuclear hegemony aimed at gaining the absolute superiority in strength has entered a new dangerous stage. This is giving a rise to concern and vigilance among the international community.
According to a foreign report, the present U.S. administration has begun to draw up a new nuclear strategy intended to lower the threshold for nuclear use.
At a recent closed-door consultative meeting of the U.S. strategic command, the under secretary for policy affairs of the U.S. Defense Department asserted that the U.S. needs a reasonable nuclear option while discussing the small tactical nuclear weapons and regional war issue.
Commenting on it, the media and experts said that the present U.S. administration has started to map out a new nuclear strategy with the emphasis on the expansion of its capacity of launching an attack with tactical nuclear weapons in order to cope with the potential regional disputes with China and Russia.
This shows that the U.S. nuclear strategy is offensively turning into the one for using nukes in real war from so-called one for deterrence.
All the successive U.S. administrations examined their nuclear strategies on a regular basis, but the attempt to work out a new nuclear strategy clearly proves how adventurous and serious the U.S. moves for maintaining the nuclear hegemony are.
Given the fact that the U.S. has the world's biggest arsenal of nuclear weapons, we should not overlook the destructive aftereffects of the new nuclear strategy of the present U.S. administration on the global nuclear balance and security environment.
The U.S., the only country in the world which used nuclear weapons, has persistently sought to modernize nuclear forces rapidly and use nukes in a real war, regarding nuclear weapons as a main means for attaining hegemonic and aggressive political and military purposes for a long time.
In the nuclear posture review issued in 2018, the U.S. announced that it would launch the modernization of strategic nuclear forces and the development of the low-yield nuclear weapons and the condition of using nukes is also applicable to the case of being attacked by conventional weapons.
Accordingly the U.S. is busy upgrading the three nuclear strategy assets , including the development and production of And it is putting spurs to deploy the low-yield nuclear warhead W76-2 and the tactical nuclear bomb B61-12 for action.
Shortly ago the U.S. announced that it would enable 19 new Virginia-class attack nuclear submarines to carry guided missiles and make them carry more missiles. This means the U.S. is going to sharply increase the operational capability of its nuclear forces.
The U.S. is also spending enormous funds on modernizing its overseas military bases in order to deploy more tactical nuclear weapons in NATO allies of Europe.
In particular, the U.S. is pressing ahead with its moves to carry out the first test fire of the new missile defense shield Golden Dome within this year as part of its hegemonic space arms buildup.
All the facts prove that the U.S. new nuclear strategy aimed at facilitating the use of nukes in a real war has already entered the implementation stage before its announcement.
Explicitly speaking, the U.S. new nuclear doctrine is a serious dangerous factor as it destroys the nuclear balance in the world, escalates a nuclear arms race and drives global security environment into the threshold of a nuclear war.
It is crystal clear that its new nuclear strategy will most adversely affect the security environment in the Asia-Pacific region where there are many nuclear weapons states.
After making it a fait accompli to unleash a nuclear war against the DPRK, the U.S. has drawn up nuclear operation guidelines in collusion with the ROK, held regular meetings of Nuclear Consultative Group and promised that it would provide Japan with extended deterrence including nuclear weapons.
It predicts that the first target of the new nuclear strategy may be the Korean peninsula.
The reality goes to prove that to overwhelmingly raise the level of versatility, functionality and practicability of the nuclear forces in the direction of more faithfully carrying out two missions of deterrence and retaliation, war prevention and war fighting serves as the best action option to maintain the balance of strength with the enemy states and ensure our state's security right and regional peace.
The most powerful offensive power is the most reliable defense capacity.
We will as ever steadily expand and strengthen the nuclear deterrent for self-defence capable of completely frustrate any nuclear threats and make the enemy states realize the catastrophic consequences to be entailed by their adventurous option against the DPRK.
The U.S. new nuclear strategy will never produce the security interests it calculated. -0-

headline: Grand Monuments Symbolic of Historic Feats of National Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 14 (KCNA) -- A great number of people from all walks of life are visiting the Arch of Triumph at the foot of Moran Hill in Pyongyang on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
The Arch of Triumph, built as an edifice in the era of the Workers' Party in April 1982, is a grand monument representing the history of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle of PresidentKim Il Sungwho liberated Korea against the one-million strong Japanese army without the support of the state-backing home front and regular army.
Grand monuments of the times were erected in different parts of the DPRK to convey the immortal exploits performed by the President for the historic cause of national liberation.
The Wangjaesan Grand Monument conveys the exploits of the President who convened the historic Wangjaesan Meeting in March 1933 and expanded and developed the armed struggle into the homeland, giving hope for national liberation and confidence in the victory of the revolution to the Korean people groaning under the Japanese imperialists' bayonet.
The Monument to the Victorious Battle of Pochonbo, built in Hyesan City, Ryanggang Province, comprehensively deals with the main contents of the revolutionary traditions of our Party, created in the course of the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, with the main stress on the Battle of Pochonbo. In June 1937 the President led the main force of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army into Pochonbo and fought the battle to deal a heavy blow to the Japanese imperialists, demonstrating to the whole world that Korea is alive, not dead.
There are also the Samjiyon Grand Monument and the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Musan Area which convey in ideological and artistic way the historical fact that the President made a gun report of victory in the homeland again and instilled confidence in national liberation into our people in May 1939, proving the armed struggle is the only way out and arms are the guarantee for the victory of the Korean revolution.
The grand monuments of the times are shining as the symbol of the immortal revolutionary exploits of the President and the eternal treasures of our revolution. -0-

headline: Samjiyon Food Show-2026 Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- The Samjiyon Food Show-2026 was held in Samjiyon City of the DPRK from August 10 to 14 under the sponsorship of the Central Committee of the Korean Association of Cooks.
The show was held on the theme of "Culinary culture in mountainous tourist resort". It was attended by public service and foreign service sectors, public catering sector in Pyongyang, service sectors in ministries and national agencies, provincial (municipal) catering service sectors, and hotels and public catering service sector in the Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Resort.
The show was held in the method of making all the participating organizations prepare, display and serve designated dishes according to categories.
Attracting the attention of the visitors were sweet pumpkin pancake, vegetable bread, catfish fry, etc. presented by cooks of Chongryu Restaurant, Changgwang General Restaurant and Pyongyang Catfish Soup Restaurant.
Cooks of public catering establishments in Pothonggang, Phyongchon and Mangyongdae districts presented dumplings, mixed sauté of bean-curd and mushroom, and twist of bread in which they preserved peculiar taste and attributes of food according to the jury indices by displaying their skill.
Local specialty dishes also attracted the attention of experts.
The public catering establishments in North Phyongan, South Phyongan and Kangwon provinces presented various kinds of dishes and drinks with local characteristics including bellflower salad, potato punch and hawthorn tea.

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnVisits Monuments to Pay Tribute to Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Martyrs on National Liberation Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Friday visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation.
Present there were senior Party, government and military officials, including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
The KPA guard of honor lined up there.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
A wreath in the name of ComradeKim Jong Unwas placed at the wreath-laying stand of the cemetery amid the playing of wreath-laying music.
Also, laid were wreaths in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the DPRK SPA Standing Committee and the DPRK Cabinet.
ComradeKim Jong Un, together with all the participants, paid a silent tribute to the memory of the revolutionary martyrs who devoted their precious lives to the sacred struggle for the independence and sovereignty of the country and its prosperity.
There took place a march-past of the KPA guard of honor.
Noting that the revolutionaries of the first generation fought a bloody war of resistance to save the country and the nation and retake the dignity with their minds burned with the noble sense of duty to bear the responsibility for the destiny of the country and descendants, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that their steadfast independent spirit and undying feats are ideological and moral treasure and precious revolutionary legacy to be inherited for all ages.
The anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters' beautiful ideal of communism, transparent revolutionary faith and indomitable fighting spirit are injecting eternal viability into our people in their struggle to build a prosperous powerful country the martyrs desired, he said, stating that the cause of the great Korean people will be ever-victorious as they are carrying forward the high revolutionary spirit and noble view of life generation after generation.
Then he visited the Monument to Fallen Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Fighters.
With reverence for the well-known and unsung anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs, who made a contribution to accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation, remaining faithful to the ideology and leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung, he placed a flower at the monument and observed a moment's silence in memory of them.
Looking at a sculpture of three members of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army fighting a heroic battle and a stone monument bearing many martyrs' names, he said that although the bodies of the martyrs who dedicated their precious youth to the revolution to retake the dignity and freedom of the country and the people were buried in unknown mountains and fields, their proud images and feats are clearly recorded in the history of the country.
He hoped that the pioneering generation of the Korean revolution, who created the priceless revolutionary traditions of Paektu and handed them down to the new generations, would be always remembered at the peak of the highest honor and dignity along with the advance and development of the ever-victorious socialism of our own style. -0-

headline: Wreaths Laid at Liberation Towers and Cemeteries of Soviet Army Soldiers
story_text:

And members of the Russian consulate general in Chongjin visited the liberation tower and the cemetery of fallen fighters of the Soviet Army in Chongjin and Rason. -0-

headline: Senior Party and Government Officials Visit Korean Revolution Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Senior Party and government officials visited the Korean Revolution Museum, a grand seat of education in revolutionary traditions, on August 14 on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Among the visitors were Pak Thae Song and Jo Yong Won, members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
Being briefed on the feats PresidentKim Il Sungperformed by founding the immortal Juche Idea and leading the anti-Japanese armed struggle to a brilliant victory under the uplifted banner of self-reliant independence, the visitors went round several rooms of the Hall for the Period of Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Struggle.
At the Hall of Revolutionary Comrades-in-Arms, they keenly cherished once again the world of noble love and obligation of the peerlessly great men who put forward soldiers with same intention and feelings as their eternal comrades on the road of revolution and glorified their immortal life.
All the visitors were fully determined to give steady continuity to the glorious history of the dignified Republic under the leadership of respected ComradeKim Jong Un, bearing deeper in mind the immutable truth that a guarantee for the bright future of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the steady advance of Korean-style socialism is to firmly defend the revolutionary traditions of Paektu and purely carry them forward. -0-

headline: PresidentKim Il Sung, Legendary Hero
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Today is the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation from the colonial rule of Japanese imperialism.
August 15, 1945 is a historic day of great significance not only for the Korean people but also for the world people.
A foreign personage said that the reason he attaches a special importance to Korea's liberation and correlates it with the world is because Korea's liberation had decisive implications on the global change as well as on the independent development of the Korean people. He added that PresidentKim Il Sungstood at the centre of such historical change and the 20th century was a process in which the world had changed based on the idea of the President.
PresidentKim Il Sungset forth the Juche-oriented revolutionary line at the Kalun meeting in 1930 and led the arduous anti-Japanese war to victory despite hardships without support of state-backing home front and regular army and experience worthy of reference to in the guerrilla struggle, thus achieving the great historic cause of national liberation.
The brilliant victory in the anti-Japanese revolutionary war instilled confidence and courage into many oppressed peoples of the world who were groaning under colonial domination and longing for freedom and independence.
Peoples of many countries had won national independence through the struggle against domination and subjugation by the imperialists and colonists.
State leaders of Cuba, Vietnam, Zimbabwe, Mozambique and other countries praised the anti-Japanese armed struggle organized and led by the President as a precious example of the national liberation struggle in colonies that the peoples in colonies should follow in their struggle for national liberation.
The world progressives have held colorful events every year on the occasion of the day of Korea's liberation to praise the immortal exploits of the President who opened up a new era of the national liberation struggle in colonies. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from D. Medvedev, president of the United Russia Party, on August 14.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend my heartfelt congratulations to you on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation from the Japanese colonial rule.
In 1945, soldiers of the Red Army and patriots of Korea dealt an annihilating defeat to the Japanese occupiers and thus liberated Korea.
Still now, the tradition of sacred militant friendship handed down by our heroic preceding generations serves as a durable foundation for developing cooperation between Moscow and Pyongyang.
I am convinced that to steadily deepen the bilateral cooperation in all fields including cooperation between the United Russia Party and the Workers' Party of Korea accords with the fundamental interests of the peoples of the two countries and contributes to consolidating stability and security in the Asia-Pacific region and establishing a just order of the multi-polar world.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I wish you good health and fresh success and all citizens of the DPRK achievement and happiness. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 15 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Comrade V. Putin, President of the Russian Federation, on August 14.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend heartfelt congratulations to you on the occasion of Liberation Day, a national holiday of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
This holiday is symbolic of heroism and toughness of the Korean patriots and soldiers of the Red Army who fought together to liberate your country from Japan's colonial tyranny.
Created just at that severe time were the lasting traditions of militant friendship and mutual assistance that have served as foundations for the development of the friendly and good neighborly relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The ties between Moscow and Pyongyang have now been raised to the unprecedentedly high level of comprehensive strategic partnership.
Our states are actively cooperating in all the sectors while making concerted efforts to ensure the regional security and stability.
I am convinced that we would as ever conduct constructive joint undertakings on the pressing bilateral and international issues for the wellbeing of the peoples of Russia and the DPRK and for the establishment of a more righteous and genuine democratic world order.
I heartily wish you success in good health and all the DPRK citizens happiness and prosperity.
Yours sincerely. -0-

story_text:

For Sake of People
story_text:
One day in August 2018, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected a general stock farm. His collar was soaked with perspiration when going round a good breed raising institute and other parts of the farm.
Nevertheless, he gave important instructions on raising the stockbreeding science and technology to a new higher level as soon as possible, including the issues for rearing pigs of new breeds, growing pasture and improving the breeds of cattle.
The officials accompanying him desired him to have a rest in the shade for a while, but he learned in detail about the actual conditions of the stock farm even at a building where there were cattle of various breeds.
When an official told him that they were very sorry to let him go through midsummer heat, the General Secretary said with a smile on his face that it was very sweltering, but he was pleased to inspect the stock farm.
He stressed that his journey is for the people and it should be made unconditionally, despite hot or cold weather.
The officials were deeply touched to hear his remarks reflecting the iron will to provide our people with an affluent better life. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from Co-Presidents of Republic of Nicaragua
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 16 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Daniel Ortega Saavedra and Rosario Murillo, co-presidents of the Republic of Nicaragua, on August 12.
The message said:
Dear Comrade,
We are celebrating August 15, 2026, the 81st anniversary of national liberation, with you and the WPK members, your heroic people and the DPRK government.
On the occasion of this significant day of celebrating the heroic victory the people of your country achieved by fighting against the colonial occupation with the historic will for the sovereignty and the indomitable spirit for freedom, we, on behalf of the Nicaragua reconciliation and national unity government and its people, the Sandinist National Liberation Front and on our own behalf, extend the warmest congratulations.
We take this opportunity to pay tribute to tens of thousands of people of the DPRK who dedicated their lives to peace and wellbeing of the people with great heroism, bravery and love of the motherland.
On the occasion of this significant day, we are looking back on the eternal legacy of PresidentKim Il Sung, founder of the DPRK, and the tenacity and wisdom of ComradeKim Jong Iland admire the undaunted courage and correct leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the WPK and head of state.
We express the conviction that we will continue to struggle with you to achieve the wellbeing, prosperity and development of the two peoples and to build the peaceful, safe, righteous world where the peoples lead an independent and free life.
Dear Comrade,
We extend to you the fraternal and revolutionary embrace from the blessed and eternally free Nicaragua and sincerely wish you and your people happiness. -0-

headline: DPRK Machine-Building Industry Focuses on Production of Custom-built Equipment for Coal Mines
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 16 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, workers in the machine-building industry are stepping up the production of custom-built equipment for coal mines.
Workers at the Ryongsong Machine Complex are putting spurs to the production of compressors while applying technical innovations to process parts more quickly and increase their precision.
The Taean Heavy Machine Complex is processing rotor axes of motors in a responsible manner by improving the performance of the equipment and using various jigs and machines. In this way it is boosting motor production while improving their quality.
Workers at the Ranam Coal-mining Machine Factory are fulfilling their production task on the strength of science and technology by developing and introducing the innovation to guarantee the safety of the braking system of winches of 300hp.
The Pyongyang Mining Machinery Factory and the Anju Pump Factory are taking innovative measures to upgrade production lines and boost the quality of the products and their productivity. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Reply Message to Russian President
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 16 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, President of the Russian Federation, on August 15.
The message said:
Dear friend Comrade Vladimir Putin,
I express deep thanks to you for sending a message of warm greeting on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Korea's liberation on August 15 was an auspicious event of our people that put an end to the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule spanning decades and won national independence and sovereignty, and a great political event that opened up a broad road for building an independent powerful country.
The sacred history of national liberation of our people who ended the distress-torn history of stateless Korean nation and retook the independent dignity is associated with the feats of the officers and men of the Red Army who fought bravely in the sacred war for annihilating the common enemy.
I am always proud to be able to expect more excellent future of the bilateral relations by leading, together with you, the DPRK-Russia ties that has carried forward the history of common struggle for justice and precious traditions of friendship.
I take this opportunity to express again the firm belief that the fraternal army and people of Russia would certainly accomplish the sacred cause of defending the sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity of the country and building powerful Russia under your wise leadership, and heartily wish you good health and greater success in your responsible work. -0-
