headline: Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- The Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm is located in the Wonhung area of Samsok District, Pyongyang Municipality. The farm has a bumper harvest this year, too.
The fruits produced by the farm are favored by the DPRK people for their high quality.
The people also like the processed fruits produced by the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Processing Factory, including various kinds of syrup, jam and wine.
On August 17, 2016, respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm. He gave precious instructions to be regarded as guidelines for the management and operation of the farm, including the issue of positively introducing high-yielding and tasty fruit seeds and keeping the production of high-yielding fruit saplings going at a high rate and the issue of briskly conducting a socialist emulation among the fruit farms across the country.
In recent years alone, the farm has dug pits extending hundreds of kilometers and newly planted one million and hundreds of thousands of saplings, thus opening up a bright prospect for increasing fruit production.
The farm overfulfilled its fruit production plan last year and was highly appreciated at the public judgment for evaluating the taste of apple and pear produced by different fruit farms across the country.
The Taedonggang Combined Fruit Farm has increased the production by putting fruit production on a scientific and intensive basis and boosting the fertility of orchards and keeping the production of high-yielding fruit saplings going at a high rate. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Pok Sun, a woman centenarian living in neighbourhood unit No. 2, Songil-ri of Sunan District in Pyongyang.
She extended her gratitude to respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor sending birthday spread to her, an ordinary old woman.
Born into a poor peasant family before liberation of the country, she lived in grief of statelessness. After the national liberation she devoted her sweat and efforts to farming for decades with a single mind to uphold our Party with increased grain production.
All the villagers respect her for bringing up children to be pillars of the country and positively doing good things for the country even after she was pensioned.
Officials of the Sunan District Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea congratulated her and her family on the auspicious event and encouraged them to fulfill their responsibility and duty like the centenarian. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnEnjoys Circus of National Acrobatic Troupe Celebrating 81st Anniversary of National Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A circus of the National Acrobatic Troupe celebrating the 81st anniversary of national liberation was given at the Pyongyang Circus Theatre on August 16, amid joy and excitement of the people in the DPRK greeting the significant day when their great motherland newly emerged with pride.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the performance.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the auditorium amid the playing of welcome music, the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
On the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation, ComradeKim Jong Unextended warm congratulations to all the people and the servicepersons who are creating a new era of comprehensive development with boundless love for their precious and sacred country and confidence and optimism about their cause.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior Party and government officials, children of anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs and anti-Japanese patriotic martyrs, teaching staff and students of revolutionary schools, officials of ministries and national agencies and armed forces organs, and officials and labor innovators of industrial establishments and youth and students in Pyongyang.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Put on the stage were colorful numbers including physical acrobatics "Wire-rope Walking" and "Fly Higher" which won top prizes at international circus festivals.
The elegant folk acrobatic works and refined numbers of high technique, full of deep emotion and vibrant vitality, showed well the appearance of the DPRK's acrobatic art blooming and developing day by day.
The peculiar pieces given by a juggler familiar with the people made the audience imbued with the world of mysterious jugglery.
The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it drew out excitement, admiration and cheerful laughter.
Expressing great satisfaction over the acrobats' successful performance, ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated them.
He met creative workers, artistes and officials of the National Acrobatic Troupe who added to joy and optimism on the National Liberation Day through their excellent performance.
Saying that the troupe is an authoritative art organization as it has glorified the honor and prestige of the country while being loved by the people through creation of world-famous acrobatic works and active performance activities for over 70 years, he highly appreciated the merits of the creative workers and artistes of the troupe who have contributed to the development of socialist culture with influence peculiar to the acrobatic art.
Expressing belief and expectation that the creative workers and artistes of the troupe would create and perform more excellent acrobatic pieces, welcomed by the times and the people, by giving full play to their extraordinary creative talents, high skill and patriotic enthusiasm and thus usher in a new heyday of development of the acrobatic art, he had a photo taken with them. -0-

headline: DPRK Embassy in Moscow Hosts Reception to Mark 81st Anniversary of Korea's Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- The DPRK embassy in Moscow hosted a reception on Aug. 14 on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Present there on invitation were Andrei Belousov, minister of Defense, Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology and figures of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology and other relevant fields.
DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol and staff members of his embassy were on hand.
Speeches were made there.
The DPRK ambassador highly praised PresidentKim Il Sung, who achieved the historic cause of national liberation, as a great hero of all ages.
The matchless sacrificial spirit and merits of officers and men of the Red Army are recorded in the great history of national liberation which brought about a radical turn in carving out the destiny of the Korean people, he said, adding that the militant friendship and unity forged in the resistance against the common enemy serve as the cornerstone that has developed the DPRK-Russia friendly and cooperative relations into the most solid relations of comrade-in-arms and comprehensive strategic partnership.
The minister of Defense of the Russian Federation congratulated the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation, saying:
The working people of Korea drove the Japanese aggressors out of their homeland by displaying their fortitude, bravery and indomitable will under the leadership of ComradeKim Il Sung.
The victory won by the Korean people in the struggle for independence made a great contribution to the end of the Second World War.
The common victory won by us in the battlefields laid a solid foundation for the strategic partnership between the two countries.
The alliance and fraternal relations were established between Russia and the DPRK thanks to President Putin and ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the DPRK.
The minister of Natural Resources and Ecology said that the DPRK's firm support for the special military operations against Ukraine proved that the historical roots of the relations between the two countries are being inherited and clearly demonstrated the common view of Russia and the DPRK respecting the sovereignty and national interests of the states.
The trustworthy dialogue between the leaders of the two countries confirmed the desire to deepen the relations between Russia and the DPRK, and a series of significant events this year fully reflect our stand on the development of the relations, he said. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Sports Events Held to Mark 81st Anniversary of National Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- A swimming and diving contest took place on August 16 under the schedule of sports cultural events marking the National Liberation Day.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed the contest.
All the participants were filled with great excitement and joy as they came to significantly celebrate the National Liberation Day with sports cultural events in the presence of ComradeKim Jong Un.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared in the natatorium, all the players and spectators raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
Among the spectators were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officials of the WPK Central Committee, the Cabinet, ministries and national agencies and commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence.
A swimming contest was held by six teams, divided into men's 100 meter freestyle and 100 meter breaststroke, women's 100 meter freestyle and 100 meter breaststroke, and 4×400 meter mixed medley relay in which each of four swimmers in a team uses backstroke, freestyle, breaststroke and butterfly stroke for each 100 meters.
The contest was so close amid the enthusiastic cheers of the audience.
And a diving contest was held by three teams, divided into men and women's individual 10 meter platform diving and mixed 10 meter synchronized platform.
In the swimming contest, the Sobaeksu Sports Team came first, the Ministry of Fisheries Sports Club second and the Suyangsan Sports Club third.
The Sobaeksu Sports Team came first in total standings of the diving contest.
Then, followed a synchronized swimming demonstration.
An awarding ceremony was held amid the applause of the participants.
The sports cultural event for celebrating the 81st anniversary of national liberation revved up the festive mood of the August 15 holiday. -0-

headline: Intensive Information Activities Brisk at Coal Mines in South Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- Intensive information activities are brisk at coal mines of South Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
More than 100 lecturers in the province engaged in information and motivation activities for increased production at over 20 coal mines in Tokchon, Tukjang, Anju and Kaechon areas in a week alone.
At the Wolbong Coal Mine, intensive lecture and information team members from the provincial Party committee encouraged coal miners with lectures and political work data strong in appeal and motivation.
Intensive lecture and information team members from Anju City and the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex encouraged the workers of Yonphung and Pongchon coal mines to make a better result in production.
The Party information workers in Phyongsong and Sunchon cities also conducted motivation activities at the Hyongbong Coal Mine and the Mujindae Youth Coal Mine to encourage the  colliers to increase coal production while working with them and providing them with labor protection materials.
Meanwhile, the Party organizations at all levels of  Pyongyang Municipality, Jagang Province, the Ministry of Culture and the Taesongsan Guidance Bureau dispatched lecturers to coal mines to conduct information activities with clear political standard and strong influence so that the colliers bring about new innovations. -0-

headline: Wreaths Laid before Monument to Soviet Army
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 17 (KCNA) -- Members of the Russian sailing ship for educational practice Pallada on a friendly visit to Wonsan City laid wreaths before the Monument to the Soviet Army on August 16.
Present there were officials of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, the charge d'affaires ad interim and members of the Russian embassy here and the president of Far-Eastern State University of Fishery Technique.
After the wreaths were laid, the participants paid tribute to the fallen fighters of the Soviet Army.
They looked round the Monument to the Soviet Army. -0-

headline: Competition of Bakers Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- A competition of bakers took place at the Unsan County Foodstuff Factory from August 6 to 17 as part of the Contest of Skilled Workers with Different Jobs in Various Sectors of National Economy-2026.
The competition brought together skilled workers selected from ministries, national agencies and provincial people's committees.
The participants baked different kinds of wheat bread, displaying technical skills they acquired in the course of conducting the campaign in which one overtakes and learns from others and swaps experiences with them.
The standings were announced on August 17 and the excellent skilled workers were awarded trophies, medals and diplomas in the name of the Central Committee of the General Federation of Trade Unions of Korea. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
Evening Gala and Firework Display Mark National Liberation Day in DPRK
DPRK FM Receives Message from Her Russian Counterpart
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Sergey Lavrov, foreign minister of the Russian Federation, on August 14 on the occasion of the National Liberation Day.
The message said that the service personnel of the Red Army of the Soviet Union and patriots of Korea defeated Japanese militarism in 1945 and liberated the Korean people from the Japanese imperialists' colonial rule spanning many years, hastening the end of the Second World War.
The participation of service personnel of the Korean People's Army in the operations to drive the Ukrainian Nazi clique and foreign mercenaries out of Kursk is a clear proof of the tradition of the militant friendship forged by the heroic preceding generations, the message said.
Noting that Moscow and Pyongyang are now fighting on the same front to establish a new and righteous world order on the basis of multipolarization, genuine equality and national interests, it expressed belief that they will invariably advance along the line of boosting cooperation between Russia and the DPRK in a multifaceted way in the future, too,  indicated by Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, and this will meet the wellbeing of the peoples of the two countries and contribute to ensuring regional and international security. -0-

headline: Women's Union Members Volunteer for Worksites of Socialist Construction
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- In a month after the Eighth Congress of the Socialist Women's Union of Korea, more than 4 000 members of the women's union volunteered for worksites of socialist construction.
Women's union members in Hyongjesan District and Taedonggang District petitioned to work at road management office or water supply and sewerage management station and many other members of the women's union in Pyongyang volunteered to work in various fields of the national economy.
The people are deeply moved by the patriotic deeds of members of the women's union of the Hoeryong City in North Hamgyong Province and the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex, who are working sincere efforts at coal mines with their pure conscience.
Women in Toksong County, South Hamgyong Province volunteered to work in the forestry sector.
Among them are hundreds of women's union members in Phyonggang County, Kangwon Province who decided to work at the county raw materials base station and women in Nampho Municipality who went to the Chollima Steel Complex, construction brigade and salt works with their intention to dedicate their all to society and the collective.
Women's union members in North Phyongan, North Hwanghae and Jagang provinces and Rason and Kaesong municipalities who volunteered for difficult and labor-consuming worksites show well the noble outlook on life of our women who find themselves worth living and feel pride in implementing the intention of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: DPRK FM Sends Message to Her Indonesian Counterpart
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to her Indonesian counterpart Sugiono on August 17 on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of its independence.
The message expressed expectation that the agreements reached at the first talks in last October would be successfully implemented to promote the development of the bilateral friendly and cooperative relations. -0-

headline: Russian Sailing Ship Leaves Wonsan Port
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- The sailors and trainees of the Russian sailing ship for educational practice Pallada left Wonsan Port on August 17 after paying a goodwill visit to the city of Wonsan on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of national liberation.
They were seen off by officials of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee and officials concerned, the president of the Far-Eastern State University of Fishery Technique, etc. -0-

headline: Dairy Products Vans for Children in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Five years have passed since the Third Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was convened in June 2021 to discuss and decide as the most important policy an issue of improving the conditions for upbringing the children, the future of the country.
According to data available, hundreds of thousands of tons of dairy products have been supplied to children across the country over the past five years.
At present, the nationwide supply of dairy products amounts to a hundred and tens of tons per day.
Dozens of vans are transporting dairy products along the streets of the capital city, conveying the benevolence of the Party to posterity.
One van runs an average of 32 kilometers a day and it means that all the vans run over 280 000 kilometers a year. This is equivalent to traveling the distance round the earth 7 times.
The provinces, cities and counties across the country are also putting the operation of similar vans on a normal footing.
In Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province, vans run hundreds of kilometers every day to supply dairy products to children in the city.
And a van runs nearly 40 kilometers per day in Sinpho City, South Hamgyong Province to supply dairy products to its children.
In particular, a van carrying dairy products is running for only a few children in Uam-dong, Sonbong District of Rason City.
This reality fully proves the loving care of our Party, which puts forward the children as the king of the country and spares nothing for them.
Still now, the Party's love for our children permeates every part of the country. -0-

headline: People's Laughter Resounds through Resorts in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Many working people, youth and students in the DPRK are enjoying themselves at all the holiday and tourist resorts, including the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area.
Myongsasimni, the east coastal scenic spot of the DPRK, is full of people enjoying the socialist civilization.
Many people are visiting the city of Samjiyon to enjoy a sightseeing tour of the Samjiyon area and spa bath.
An endless stream of people is flowing into Munsu, Mangyongdae and Rungna water parks in the capital city of Pyongyang.
Schoolchildren, youth and old persons are enjoying themselves at the bathing beaches of the east and west coasts.
The people's laughter and songs of happiness resound at the Onpho Working People's Holiday Camp, a monumental edifice symbolic of the spa culture of the country.
Working people, youth and students are enjoying themselves at bases for cultural and leisure activities in other scenic spots. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong Un's Efforts to Turn All Mountains into Golden and Treasure Ones
story_text:
One day in June 2019, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unraised the issue of creating forests and making good use of them during his conversation with senior officials of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The officials were filled with remorse. It was because they did not pay due attention to turning all mountains of the country into golden and treasure ones even though they were talking much about it.
Looking round the officials, he said that officials of provinces, cities and counties should pay attention to turning all mountains of the country into golden and treasure ones and it is important to plant many trees of good species to that end. And he stressed that forest restoration should be done with an aim to turn a treeless mountain into a really useful mountain, not a merely green mountain.
After a while, he set forth the slogan "Let us turn all mountains into useful golden mountains!" And he emphasized that the implementation of the second-stage tasks of the forest restoration should be reviewed, taking into consideration of the quantity of trees of good species the relevant units planted to make forests useful.
Really useful mountain!
Listening to his instructions, officials bore deep in  mind once again that the work to create golden and treasure mountains is a patriotic work to provide the rising generation with substantial benefits and a cradle of happiness. -0-

headline: Members of Russian Sailing Ship Tour Wonsan
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Members of the Russian sailing ship for educational practice Pallada toured various places in Wonsan City.
At the Songdowon International Children's Camp, the sailors and trainees of the ship looked round campers' dwellings and indoor gymnasium and aquarium, being briefed on the fact that schoolchildren from different countries are spending pleasant time at the camp successfully built as a comprehensive extracurricular education base.
They enjoyed a performance given by artistes of the Kangwon Provincial Art Troupe and toured the Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Resort and the Kalma Foodstuff Factory.
They deepened friendship with students in Wonsan City while playing colorful sports games with them. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Birthday Spreads to Centenarians
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent birthday spreads to Jang Ryong Nyo, a woman centenarian living in neighbourhood unit No. 9, Churanjon-ri, Sinphyong County, North Hwanghae Province, and Kim Po Bae, a woman centenarian living in neighbourhood unit No. 7, Janghak-ri, Jangphung County, Kaesong Municipality, on their 100th birthday.
The centenarians who received the birthday spreads amid congratulations of officials of the counties and villagers extended gratitude to respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
They, who had lived under maltreatment and contempt, suffering the miserable lot of an enslaved nation before the liberation of the country, could lead a worthwhile life after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
They took the lead in assisting the People's Army during the Fatherland Liberation War and postwar reconstruction and worked heart and soul to increase grain production for decades.
They always request their children to do more good things for the grateful country, saying that the Korean-style socialist system is the best in the world. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 18 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
At the Huichon Precision Machine Plant, the premier encouraged the workers in the machine plant in their vigorous drive for production in hearty response to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK and called for raising the quality of products and productivity while paying constant attention to consolidating the material and technical foundations, bearing in mind the importance of the factory's duty in developing the country's vehicle-building industry.
In particular, he stressed the need for officials to enhance their responsibility and role in implementing the Party's decisions, further improve production and management while regarding the spiritual strength of the masses and science and technology as the lifeline of the development of the unit and actively introduce valuable and innovative inventions based on an advanced technology.
At the Jonchon Rock Drill Factory, Pak Thae Song called for carrying out the assigned production plan without fail by raising the utilization rate of equipment in keeping with the increased demand for rock-drills in various sectors of the national economy and effectively developing and producing new-type rock-drills with high performance.
Going round various workshops and newly-built production processes of the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill, he stressed the need for the employees to improve the efficiency of labour by raising the level of technical skill and mastering the equipment and thus steadily expand the successes in production.
Discussed at field consultative meetings were issues of directing efforts to acquiring and introducing new technology through sci-tech learning space, strengthening the ranks of technicians and skilled workers and fully supplying equipment and materials necessary for developing new products and producing them.
Earlier, Pak Thae Song visited the Salt Industry Bureau to learn about its production state and discussed the problems arising in production and took necessary measures. -0-

headline: Members of Russian Sailing Ship Tour Wonsan
Celebrations of Organizations of Koreans in China Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) -- Organizations of Koreans in China organized events on August 14 and 15 on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Placed at the statue of PresidentKim Il Sungat Yuwen Middle School in Jilin of China were flower baskets in the name of the General Association of Koreans in China, the Association of Korean Women in China, the Association of Young Korean Nationals in China, the Jilin City Branch of the Jilin Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China and the family of Hwang Paek Ha, a Korean in China related to the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle.
Officials of the headquarters of the General Association of Koreans in China and citizens affiliated with the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China laid bouquets before the picture of respected ComradeKim Jong Unat the DPRK mission in Shenyang, China and paid tribute to him.
Videos dealing with the anti-Japanese revolutionary exploits of the President were screened at the meeting room of the headquarters of the General Association of Koreans in China.
Present there were officials of the headquarters of the General Association of Koreans in China and citizens affiliated with the Shenyang City Branch of the Liaoning Regional Association of the General Association of Koreans in China.
First Vice-chairman Ri Sun Nam praised the President as a legendary hero and peerlessly great man who defeated the Japanese imperialists' million-strong army to liberate the country and built an invincible socialist power independent, self-supporting and self-reliant in defence.
Ri noted that our country liberated by the President and glorified by ChairmanKim Jong Ilis now demonstrating its might as the most powerful and invincible politico-ideological, military and nuclear power in the world under the leadership of respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the peerlessly great man. -0-

headline: Prospect for Breeding Sea Urchin in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) -- Korean people have widely used sea urchin, which has high food value and contains many medicinal ingredients, to their diet.
The salted sea urchin eggs with crude protein, crude fat, carbohydrate, phosphorus, vitamins, etc. have unique taste and aroma and are nutritious and digestive.
People say that they feel warm and relaxed in 30 minutes after eating sea urchin eggs.
Sea urchin eggs are also used as medicines to prevent or treat bed-wetting.
In this regard, Sim Yong Ju, department director of the Ministry of Fisheries, said as follows:
The DPRK seas have favorable conditions and environment for breeding sea urchin as the sea water quality is good and temperature is suitable as well as many gravels and rocks.
The fact that resources of sea urchins are increasing in waters off Chongjin City and Myongchon and Kosong Counties waters in the East Sea of Korea proves enough possibility of developing sea urchin farming.
The fishing sector is actively conducting the work to develop the sea urchin breeding, including solving scientific and technological problems related to the artificial breeding of sea urchins and innovating the breeding method. The Chongam offshore salmon feed supply station has produced sea urchin 1.5 times more this year than last year.
In the country fish farming and sea culture are being put forward as the main direction of the development of the fishing industry and conducted on a large scale. -0-

headline: Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK, Clarifies Her Stand on Major International Affairs
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Wednesday expressed the following stand as regards the major international issues escalating the global security crisis:
The trend of the present unpredictable and complicated international situation is a source of the escalation of the geopolitical crisis in different parts of the world and serious concern of the international community aspiring after peace and stability.
As the evil cycle of confrontation persists in the Middle East, the epitome of conflict and chaos in the world, distrust and discord among regional countries further deepen, bloodshed lasts without cease and the unprecedented political and economic instability gets worse on a worldwide scale.
And the phase of prolonged armed conflict has entered a more serious stage in Europe owing to the reckless confrontational intention of the Western group to impose a strategic defeat on Russia by using Ukraine as an agent of a proxy war.
Even in the Korean peninsula, the biggest hotspot in the world for centuries, the regional security environment is facing constant challenges due to the U.S. and its vassal forces' attempt at geopolitical expansion and their greedy arms buildup.
The present situation of the world, where the vicious cycle of tension persists in not only the Middle East and Europe but also the Asia-Pacific region including the Korean peninsula due to the high-handed practice and the abuse of power by the hegemonic forces, calls upon all the countries to make their principled stand clearer in pursuing justice and equity and defending their national security and interests.
The DPRK remains unchanged in its view and stand that the U.S. and the West's threat to the security of Russia that has been systematically getting serious since the end of the Cold War is the main factor that triggered the present Ukrainian crisis.
The better future of Europe can not be realized apart from the core interests and will of the Russian Federation.
We think that uprooting the cause of the conflict is the main solution to putting an end to the Ukrainian crisis and ensuring sustainable and durable peace in the region. And we fully support the righteous action of the Russian government and people to defend the national sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity.
Availing of this opportunity, I make clear that the theory of the "dispatch of additional troops" of our army, which the Zelenskiy group invented and propagates, is an ungrounded farce of Kiev and that the U.S. and the West are entirely responsible for the start of the Ukrainian crisis and its prolongation.
The overall cooperation between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation is strictly in accordance with the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership between the two sides which is in conformity with the purpose and principle of the UN Charter and is a legal domain of exercise of sovereign right.
The DPRK constantly maintains concentration on its duty as a contracting party of the inter-state treaty between the DPRK and Russia in conformity with its allied nature and remains boundlessly faithful to it.
The DPRK is seriously following the reckless attempt of Japan for military expansion, a dangerous factor of causing imbalance of strength in the Asia-Pacific region including the Korean peninsula and consider it a potential and prospective threat.
The DPRK regards Japan's reweaponization as a serious threat. This means that the DPRK pays more attention to Japan and gets strong perception that it regards the latter as a military target. It also hints that Japan's security is in more dangerous state.
Our military leadership already started to regard it as part of its military strategy to deter and contain the threat of Japan, which is evolving into a serious security challenge, or do something more beyond it.
In other words, this means that if Japan tries to make a wrong choice, it will face immediate annihilating blow impossible to survive.
Japan's military development is a suicidal act of taking oil to extinguish the fire.
We will constantly maintain a fundamental way of approach for removing danger and ensuring genuine peace and stability from the standpoint of strong power and on the basis of the stark reality that the greatest threat to the security interests of our state and the regional security environment is coming from the U.S.
As for the reduction of the U.S.-ROK joint military drill abruptly announced by the U.S. president a few days ago, we regard it as the one unworthy of comment and have no interest in it at all.
The reduction of the scale and duration of the drill does not mean the change of the nature of the military drill with a provocative and offensive feature.
This year alone, the U.S. and the ROK have conducted joint military exercises in different spaces and spheres without space-time gap, including the bilateral air drills Buddy Squadron in February, the combined small unit drill and large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield in March, the U.S.-ROK Navy combined salvage exercise, combined mine warfare exercise and the combined large-scale air drills Freedom Flag in April, combined air training Hercules Guardians in May and the combined logistics support drill and bilateral air drills Buddy Squadron in July.
This suggests that the drill which was recently said to be reduced is fully substituted for such drills.
This being a hard fact, the ROK claimed that the ongoing war drill is military one of a defensive nature simulating someone's attack and talked about the strengthening of the "firm ROK-U.S. alliance" and acceleration of introduction of a nuclear submarine, fully exposing its hostile nature.
We are paying more attention to the fact that the joint military drills between the U.S. and the ROK have been steadily staged and are still under way, not to the reduction or shortening of individual drills, and we are correctly seeing through the fact that this is an obvious expression of open hostility toward the DPRK.
If the U.S. calculates that it can propagate its recent measure as the one of so-called good faith, they will not get desired answer.
As for the news from Washington that shortly ago, there was a communication between the leaders of the DPRK and the U.S., I am not aware of it at all, and perhaps it may be the only thing I do not know as regards the foreign policy of our supreme leadership.
I had already clarified several times that our head of state has good memories and feelings about Trump personally.
The relationship between the two leaders is still excellent.
It is well known to the world and not a matter to be surprised, I think.
However, the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK has remained unchanged and the U.S. and its followers are now violently conducting hostile military activities against the DPRK even this moment.
Likewise, I would like to stress that the exercise of the sovereign rights of the DPRK intended to contain the forces threatening its security is very reasonable, appropriate and essential and it has nothing to do with the excellent relations between the leaders of the two countries.
History and reality prove that it is possible to maintain balanced and stable security structure of the region when the DPRK has stronger deterrent. -0-

headline: Dynamic Land Management Campaigns in Different Parts of Country
People's Laughter Resounds through Resorts in DPRK
We Will Exercise Our Right to Self-defence for Neutralizing Military Threat from Hostile Forces through More Transparent Action: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) -- The large-scale U.S.- ROK joint military exercises, Ulji Freedom Shield, began in every part of the ROK on August 17. The drill poses the most immediate and open threat to the DPRK and the regional security.
The exercises will last for over 10 days, involving U.S. troops in the ROK and the ROK army as the mainstay of the exercises as well as extra-regional U.S. reinforcements and forces of member states of the "UN Command". And these frantic exercises cover all spheres of carrying out wartime operations including the ground, sea, air, space, cyber and psychological information. This is pushing again the tensions on the Korean peninsula to the threshold of a war.
In particular, all the major units under the U.S. 8th Army, including the 2nd Infantry Division, the 19th Sustainment Command, the 501st Military Intelligence Brigade, and the 35th Air Defense Artillery Brigade, are taking part in the drill. And various actual maneuvers of the drill include a combined arms live-firing exercise aimed at verifying the capability for joint precision strike and mobility, a combined wet gap crossing exercise and a joint logistic support maneuver for providing war supplies in contingency.
Nevertheless, prior to the exercises, the military warmongers of the U.S. and the ROK described the drill as "annual" and "defensive" one in public with the aim of hiding the aggressive and provocative nature of the largest-ever exercises.
Such drill, which has been staged for decades despite the changes of regimes in the U.S. and the ROK, cannot be regarded only as a bad habitual military practice of the enemy states. And we can never get used to it.
As everybody knows, the enemies' war drill differs in its mission, form, scale and training methods every time.
All the elements of the war drill have been developing into extremely dangerous ones, quite different from the past ones. And it is being desperately oriented towards improving the actual fighting capacity in the war exercises against the DPRK and gaining the decisive ascendancy in the security structure in the Korean peninsula and the rest of the region.
The main point of the drill is to perform "practical training reflecting the changing security environment" and to "improve effectiveness". And its scenarios are being tailored to adapt to new modern war manuals and ways analyzed in recent wars.
The U.S.-ROK command post training under the simulated conditions of contingency in the Korean peninsula, the field training exercise which was waged more than ten times and even the "all-government combined exercise" which the ROK is staging independently by enlisting more than 4 000 agencies and over 580 000 personnel across the country feature supplemented elements of ultra-modern operations such as AI, drone and cyber.
What is all the more serious is that the U.S.-led "UN Command" which played an auxiliary role in the Ulji Freedom Shield exercises only a few years ago is kick-starting in real earnest to revive its combat function and expand its role, talking about "contribution in new spheres such as intelligence, cyber and space" with the ongoing exercises as an occasion.
Prior to the drill, the deputy commander of the "UN Command" said that it would be the strongest deterrence when the countries sharing the same intention counter together and the strong combination of posture when the ROK-U.S. alliance and UN Command are added, making it a fait accompli to hurl into an actual war the largest-ever multinational aggression forces by misusing the name of the "UN forces" in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula as it did in the 1950s of the last century.
This is a development that can not be overlooked. It visually shows that the ROK bordering the DPRK is turning into not only the training ground of the U.S.-ROK military alliance but also a gathering place of multinational aggression forces and a test ground of modern warfare for occupying the security sphere of the DPRK and the independent countries in the region.
The dangerous escalation of the war drills staged by the U.S. and its vassal forces is posing a more serious threat to the security rights of the DPRK and this will lead to the further deterioration of the situation of the Korean peninsula and the Asia-Pacific region.
The present situation makes us keenly realize what we should do.
The DPRK's exercise of its right to self-defence will continue to completely neutralize the enemies' military threat until the enemy states give up their reckless dream of overwhelming someone by force and completely abandon their attempt to break the balance of strength in Northeast Asia and the Asia-Pacific region beyond the Korean peninsula.
It is necessary to counter the threatening maneuvers of the enemies which are getting serious as the time goes by with newly-developed strength.
The DPRK will always put all the enemies violating and threatening its sovereign security in the sighting range for precision and annihilating strike by its retaliatory means.
All the war drills for aggression staged by the enemy states in the Korean peninsula and the region will never produce the result desired by them. -0-

headline: Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 19 (KCNA) -- There is the Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory, a hub of the medical appliance industry, in Hyangsan County, Jagang Province of the DPRK.
The factory has put its production and management on a scientific and IT basis. It produces dozens of kinds of modern medical appliances including general dental treatment apparatus, all-purpose operating table, defibrillator, life-saving apparatus and micro-injector.
The convenient consulting bed, delivery bed and operating table for gynecologic section developed by the factory are comprehensively equipped with all functions necessary for treatment. In particular, the universal ear-nose-throat-treating chair is the latest medical equipment which enables a doctor and a patient to see simultaneously the computer images obtained by endoscope and patients to receive telemedicine service.
Under the wise leadership of respected ComradeKim Jong Un, the factory has developed into the one which plays a leading role in the country's medical appliance industry.
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the factory on August 19, 2018.  He said that it is needed to radically raise the material and technical foundations of the public health sector in order to make the people fully enjoy the benefits of modern medical service, and gave instructions on turning the factory into an icon and important one which plays a leading role in the medical appliance industry and took important measures for it.
The remodeled and modernized Myohyangsan Medical Appliances Factory was inaugurated on October 4, 2020 on the occasion of the 75th founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. The inauguration of the factory made it possible to give fuller play to the advantages of the Korean-style socialist system and recorded one page in pioneering the new development of the country's medical appliance industry.
The factory produced the varieties of modern medical equipment and appliances on the principle of lowering cost and improving quality and sent them to ri hospitals and clinics in Samjiyon City and preventive and curative medical institutions at all levels across the country.
The factory won the Lather No. 26 Model Machine Prize and the title of the model technical innovation unit. It has made technical innovations to develop various parts of medical equipment in recent years. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:

Trump issued a sudden order to reduce the scale of the drill. This has placed Seoul in a poor plight of discontinuing the "war game" it liked very much.
It will be something like the first "trouble" to the ROK, unprecedented in the history of U.S.-ROK joint military exercises, in the context that it has never seen the scale of a war game reduced to become coreless right after its kick-off with no prior discussion.
The ROK cannot let out a single word of protest at the GIs leaving without any mutual coordination at the U.S. chief executive's unilateral order. This is the inevitable fate of the puppet army, whose right to command has been left in the hands of the U.S., and the true situation of the ROK, whose security has been placed at stake due to a reduction of the joint military drill and who brags about its "enough capability for self-defence" despite its defence and security being under the care of outsiders.
The plight of the ROK, which is compelled to stop the "war game" it liked very much, is showing the structure of the relation between master and servant called the "U.S.-ROK blood alliance" of which it has boasted.
As recognized generally, this unforeseen consequence is an evident disaster brought by the unrealistic and anachronistic security outlook pursued by the ROK authorities who have ceaselessly repeated unnecessary attempts to reverse the regional mechanical structure controlled by a nuclear-armed nation, blinded by their firm belief in the U.S. master.
The ROK has reaped what it sowed.
The ROK authorities are hyping it as an "occasion for new phase and good opportunity for a change in relations" to cover up their poor plight, which is nothing but a lame excuse.
Lee Jae Myung curried favor with the U.S. in public by uttering shameful words that he pays "respects" for Trump's "decisive rollback decision" and it was a "decision from deep consideration" and then talked about "independent national defence" and "independent buildup of military capabilities" to prepare for the "worst scenario". Such double-dealing behaviour vividly proves uneasiness and impatience of the ROK.
The world witnesses that the U.S. security aids are no longer free of charge.

Seoul should be aware of the unavoidable fate of the "puppet". -0-

headline: Successful Stockbreeding

The WPK Central Committee in its congratulatory message said that the 50 year-long history of the bureau started in the sacred area of Mt Paektu in the historic period when a heyday of the construction of the revolutionary sites was ushered in the 1970s. This is part and epitome of the history of the Workers' Party of Korea which has defended and glorified the revolutionary traditions of Juche, it noted.
The bureau defended the position of the revolutionary and powerful construction group with countless achievements of creation as main force in the historic day when the revolutionary spirit and development of Juche Korea were displayed to the world through the successive erection of grand monuments of national treasure and in the stirring years when a great golden age of construction was ushered in to bring about a fresh turn in the development of the state, it said.
The message extended warm congratulations to all the builders and officials of the Bureau for Construction of Revolutionary Sites on the occasion of the 50th founding anniversary of the bureau as they have made contributions to the steady succession and development of our cause by successfully building structures symbolizing the glorious revolutionary history and representing the great era with their noble spirit and unshakable practice.
A commemorative report was followed by speeches. -0-

headline: Traditional Stone Chamber Sauna Therapy of Kaesong area
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- From olden times the Korean people have created excellent Koryo medical treatments and made active use of them for the promotion of health by relying on the rich resources of the country.
Among them is the traditional stone chamber sauna in Kaesong area.
The stone chamber sauna is done by burning rice chaff in a vaulted crucible of granite to provide a high temperature of 100-150 degrees Celsius, taking out ash from it and then sweating in it.
In the period of Koryo Dynasty, the therapy was derived from the folk legend that some potters of a pottery in Kaesong sweated in a hot crucible and jumped into a creek and cured all kinds of diseases.
The stone chamber sauna therapy is efficacious for excreting poisonous materials and treating and preventing various diseases including arthritis, obesity, skin disease, circulatory system disease and nervous system disease.
In particular, steam from ochre and granite used in the crucible and pine leaves on the floor contains minerals and anions, refreshes people's moods and produces a good effect on health.
The stone chamber sauna registered as a local intangible cultural heritage in 2016 is popular among the people in Kaesong area for its unique efficacy and widely used in promoting health. -0-

headline: Immortal Guideline Clarifying Path of Building New Independent Country
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- After the liberation of Korea, PresidentKim Il Sungclearly indicated the path of building an independent new Korea and thus successfully accomplished the cause of building the party, state and army.
On August 20, 1945, he made a speech"On Founding the Party, State and Armed Forces in the Liberated Homeland"before military and political cadres.
In his speech he advanced the idea of steadily advancing the Korean revolution on the basis of the successes made in accomplishing the historic cause of national liberation and building a prosperous and independent and sovereign state by the Korean people themselves and the three major tasks for building the party, state and army for implementing it.
The line of building a new country advanced by the President is consistent with the transparent independent stand that the building of a new country should be carried out by our own efforts and in our own way in conformity with the actual conditions of our country, not by anyone else, just as our people accomplished the historic cause of national liberation.
The President energetically led the work to found the party, state and army, solving all problems arising in building a new country as required by the Korean revolution.
Under the leadership of the President, the Juche-type revolutionary party (October 10, 1945) and the Korean People's Army (February 8, 1948), the revolutionary regular armed forces, and the DPRK (September 9, 1948), the genuine people's country, were founded, ushering in a proud new history of an independent and sovereign state.
The undying feats of the President who set forth the path of building a new country and successfully accomplished the historic cause of building the party, state and army are shining along with the history of prosperous socialist Korea. -0-

headline: Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District-Cradle of Ordinary DPRK Working People
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 20 (KCNA) -- There is the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District built for ordinary workers on the bank of the Pothong River in Pyongyang.
The residential district is a cradle of love shown by respected ComradeKim Jong Unfor labor innovators, meritorious persons, scientists, educators, writers and other working people in all fields who are devoting themselves to the country and people.
The district was formed in the excellent location on the bank of the River Pothong in the centre of the capital city, bringing about a sea change. It is associated with the loving care of the respected General Secretary to provide the DPRK people with the material and cultural well-being with nothing more to desire in the world.
On August 20, 2021, the respected General Secretary visited the construction site of the Pothong Riverside Terraced Residential District and said that the residential district should be built for the main purpose of ensuring the convenience of every resident, to say nothing of architectural beauty.
He stressed need to provide the residents with good walking paths and rational traffic facilities so that they can get down straight from their houses without going round the district and use them.
He said that it would be good to call the residential district "Kyongru-dong" in the meaning of beautiful marble turret.
Today, residents of Kyongru-dong are full of determination to always cover the path of repayment with the boundless gratitude to the respected General Secretary who provided ordinary working people with a cradle of happiness and love. -0-

headline: Celebrations Held in Different Countries
story_text:

The chairperson and members of the Nepali Literary Forum for the Study of Juche praised PresidentKim Il Sungas an ever-victorious brilliant commander who defeated the Japanese imperialists armed to the teeth with his superb strategy and tactics, saying that August 15, 1945 is the day of Korea's liberation.
The chairman of the Left National Party of Romania, the vice-chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania and personages of the Romanian Association of Friends of the DPRK in Romania said that thanks to PresidentKim Il Sungthe Korean people could get rid of the destiny of colonial slavery and embark on the road of creating a new life.
A reporter and speakers including the secretary general of the Bulgarian Group for the Study of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism praised PresidentKim Il Sungas a great revolutionary, anti-Japanese legendary hero and peerless patriot as he devoted his all to the freedom and liberation of the people.
The chairman of the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the DPRK, which was the target of imperialist aggression and plunder a century ago, is now fully demonstrating its might as the most dignified and powerful socialist state in the world as it was led by ComradeKim Jong Un, another great man.
The vice-chairman of the Socialist Freedom Party of Egypt and members of the Egypt-Korea Friendship Association said that the exploits PresidentKim Il Sungperformed for national liberation are shining along with the glorious course of the DPRK which has emerged as a world power under the guidance of respected HEKim Jong Un.

headline: Training Course for Chairpersons of Youth League Committees in Cities and Counties of DPRK
story_text:

headline: Whole Country Should Go over to Communism Together
story_text:

headline: National Workshop Held in DPRK
National Workshop Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 21 (KCNA) -- A national workshop for teachers in the field of training Party cadres took place in Pyongyang on August 19 and 20.
Attending it were officials, teachers and researchers from the Party schools at all levels, including the Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea, and relevant officials of the WPK Central Committee, the provincial, city and country Party committees and the Party committees guiding the Party schools directly under them.
The workshop dealt with the ideo-theoretical and methodological issues to be adhered to by the Party schools at all levels in adding luster to the original name of the Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist school, the political school of ComradeKim Jong Un, and boosting the level of education and improving its environment and climate as required by the times of comprehensive development.
Ju Chang Il, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an opening address.
When the workshop was declared open, the national anthem of the DPRK was played.
Choe Chang Hak, first vice-department director of the WPK Central Committee, made a report on reviewing the work of the Party schools at all levels to implement the important tasks respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth at the inaugural and opening ceremonies of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK.
The reporter noted that the respected Comrade General Secretary clarified the original idea that the historic cause for succession starts to advance from the "pedigree farm" for training reserve cadres of the Party to its completion, defined it as the fundamental mission of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK to train diligent and enthusiastic revolutionaries of ideal and firm faith, armed with the Party's original ideals and spirit, and put forward other important principles and tasks for improving the work of the Party schools.
The report referred to a series of shortcomings revealed in the work of some Party schools in the past and strictly analyzed their main causes.
The reporter called upon all the attendants to more creditably train many more Party cadre talents, passionate reserve cadres permeated with the red flag idea capable of reliably carrying forward the great historic cause - the strengthening of the whole Party and the comprehensive national rejuvenation - true to the Party cadres training idea and policy in the new era clarified by respected ComradeKim Jong Un.
Then lectures were given.
The lectures stressed the need to firmly arm with the idea and spirit of respected ComradeKim Jong Un's speech made on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the foundation of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK.
They dealt with the issue for holding fast to the work of more firmly establishing the monolithic leadership system of the WPK Central Committee as the key point of the Party cadres training.
They called for preparing the students to be true officials possessed of the Party's outlook on the people and specialist qualifications.
And they emphasized that it is important for the Party schools to take the lead in steadily exploring and introducing advanced educational contents and methods befitting the new era of national prosperity and improve the educational administration in order to powerfully promote the country's overall education development.
They also laid emphasis on the issue of further enhancing the responsibility and role of the teachers and officials at the Party schools in the efforts to train the Party cadres in the new era.
The attendants more keenly realized the noble intention of the Party Central Committee which gives top priority to the Party cadres training and acquired the principled issues and innovative methodologies for improving the education of the Party schools. -0-

headline: Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area Crowded with Many Visitors
story_text:
