The visitors have felt pride and joy when they get on electric cars or trams to enjoy the magnificent view of the tourist area which includes modern hotels, hostels and sea-bathing service facilities and various commercial and public catering service bases standing in a row along the coastline.
The bathing beach, outdoor wading pool, e-game hall and other service facilities are crowded with people enjoying the coastal tourist culture.
It is worth seeing high-speed boats or water skis running at full speed over the sea. And the beach volleyball matches and motorcycling on the white sands are conspicuous.
The tourists are spending the unforgettable days of tourism, trying a variety of special dishes at the public catering establishments and enjoying an animated chat with each other at lodging quarters in the evening.
Successful performances by national art troupes and the Kangwon Provincial Art Troupe at the Myongsasimni Theatre in the coastal tourist area give the tourists a great pleasure.
Many people have said in excited tones that they had visited many bathing beaches on the east or west coasts in the past, but they could not feel such great pleasure as in the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist area and that they do not want to leave this area and will come again next year together with their families or friends. -0-

headline: Schoolchildren's Motivation Activities
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK conduct their dynamic motivation activities at worksites for socialist construction.
A brass band of schoolchildren from Haeju Middle School for Orphans gave a performance at the Haeju Farm Machine Factory. Famous songs of the times resounded at the sites where various kinds of farm machines are serially produced, inspiring workers to increase production.
Schoolchildren of Haechong Senior Middle School in Haeju City, affiliated to Haeju Kim Jong Thae University of Education, encouraged the builders with dynamic and optimistic brass music at the construction site for the Haeju Schoolchildren's Palace.
Schoolchildren of Unnyul Senior Middle School gave a performance to boost the morale of soldier-builders at construction sites for implementing the regional development policy in Unnyul County.
Encouraged by the brass band activities of schoolchildren from Jangyon Senior Middle School in Jangyon County, employees of the county foodstuff factory have striven to provide the regional children and inhabitants with more tasty and nutritious foodstuffs.
Schoolchildren in Jaeryong, Kangryong and Chongdan counties, too, toured factories and farms to conduct motivation activities. -0-

headline: JUK Delegation Leaves for Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Journalists Union of Korea led by Vice-Chairman of its Central Committee Ryom Chol Ho left here on Friday to take part in the 30th modern press forum "All Russia-2026" to be held in Sochi of Russia.
The delegation was seen off by officials of the JUK Central Committee at Pyongyang International Airport. -0-

headline: National Exhibition of Materials for Education in Law Observance-2026 Closes
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- The national exhibition of materials for education in law observance-2026 came to a close with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Friday.
The materials and means with unique contents and methods for education in law observance drew the attention of visitors for their high cognitive and educational value in raising the law-abiding spirit of the masses.
The jury announced the results and diplomas were awarded to the excellent units.
Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, made a closing address. -0-

headline: Production Goes up at Chemical Complex
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- The Namhung Youth Chemical Complex is intensifying a mass technical innovation movement.
Officials and workers of the complex fulfilled their July plan, regarding sci-tech development as a key to their unit's development, and have carried out their daily quotas by 105 percent in August.
The complex set the fulfillment of the technical development task as an important item of the socialist emulation programme, and has reviewed and appraised the results while organizing presentation and exhibition to arouse interest of the masses in technical innovation.
It is operating the sci-tech learning space on a normal footing to ensure that everyone learns and utilizes new technology. Meanwhile, it is giving the assignments for technical development and introduction to technicians and skilled workers. Such campaign has turned into a mass-based one.
The complex is also putting spurs to the mass technological innovation movement for improving the efficiency of fertilizer production. -0-

headline: Torch-Kindling Ceremony for Int'l Martial Arts Games Held
Japan's Increased Defence Budget Will Escalate "Security Deficit": KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Japan's sinister intention to accelerate its drive for turning itself into a war state while deceiving the international community has been brought to light.
It was reported on Aug. 18 that the Japanese Defence Ministry is going to request about 8.9 trillion yen as the fiscal 2027 budget for "defence cost".
But the final amount of the "defense cost" will reportedly increase to 10 trillion yen at the time of budgeting at the end of the year, for there exist more than 150 "items required" without specific cost.
Such increase in Japan's "defence cost," which will hit an all-time high, means the expansion of the dangerous war budget that will bring new turmoil to the region and other parts of the world.
Historically, Japan has increased the "defence cost" to a record level every year and turned the "Self-Defence Forces" into modern preemptive attack forces in a crafty way of adding to the budget, hyping "threat from neighboring countries".
According to three security documents, including the "national security strategy" published at the end of 2022, the Japanese reactionaries set the "defence cost" for 2023-2027 totaling about 43 trillion yen and assert that it is adjusted and spent by yearly installments. This is no more than a lame excuse and deceptive farce.
As for the "defence cost" for 2026 only, the present Japanese regime claimed it is 9.0353 trillion yen, 3.8 percent increase  from the initial budget in 2025, but in fact it has made the biggest "leap" by exceeding 10 trillion yen.
It is not difficult to imagine the tremendous scale of next year's military spending, which will further expand at the end of this year, and it is clear that such huge military spending will lead to arms buildup for rounding off the preparations for a war of aggression.
In fact, Japan is to spend the money for the development of underwater-launched hypersonic missile, massive deployment of attack drones, such strengthened response to "new warfare" as the introduction of AI into the SDF command system and additional deployment of long-range missiles "capable of attacking enemy bases".
What merits attention is the fact that Japan's military spending, the highest in the world, is accompanied by the astronomical amount of state debt.
As known, Japan's state debt exceeded 1 343 trillion yen at the end of 2025, an increase of 1.5 percent from the previous year's, consecutively breaking records over a decade.
Meanwhile, Japan renewed the previous record in its "defence cost", thus becoming the world's sixth largest weapon importer in 2021-2025.
Despite such deteriorating financial situation, the Japanese reactionaries are spending a huge amount of money, collected from the people as taxes, for massively securing various long-range strike means like the U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missiles and developing offensive weaponry. It is as clear as noonday that this is not for building a "pacifist state".
It is a foolish dream to think that their vicious militarist nature, characterized by aggression and war, can be concealed with the veil of "defence" and "self- defence".
With such reckless arms buildup, it is impossible to guarantee the future of the archipelago and the record-breaking war budget will only escalate its "security deficit".
The righteous regional community will never overlook the military evolution of the descendants of the war criminal nation disturbing peace and security of the world but thoroughly counter it by concerted efforts. -0-

headline: Technical Exchange for Improving Quality of Wheat Products Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Wheat processing factories and enterprises in the field of grain management are striving to improve the quality of processed wheat products, according to Rodong Sinmun.
This was well illustrated by a show held at the Wonsan Wheat Processing Factory.
The show served as a significant occasion for steadily improving the quality of products with the public demand and evaluation as absolute criterion and for sharing and generalizing advanced technologies and experience gained in the efforts for improving quality.
On display at the show were wheat flour (special, A- and B- grades) and other processed products brought out by wheat processing factories and enterprises in the field of grain management.
Drawing the attention of the visitors were wheat flour products and by-products presented by the Nampho, Hamhung and Wonsan wheat processing factories.
During the show technicians, analysts and others of the wheat processing factories shared experience and advanced technologies for improving quality. -0-

headline: Historical Spot Symbolic of Korean Nation's Distinguished Architecture
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- There is Thonggunjong, a pavilion dating back to the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910), in Uiju County, North Phyongan Province.
The pavilion, symbolic of the architecture of the Korean people, has long been one of the eight scenic spots in the northwestern part of Korea, for being located in a beautiful place.
The pavilion was built in a manner suitable for commanding soldiers while viewing the Amnok River beneath it and the surrounding area.
According to a historical document, the current pavilion is the one remodeled in 1478.
Later, it was repaired in 1538 and on other several occasions but it still takes on the appearance dating back to the 15th Century.
It has four frontal and four lateral spaces inside. Flower-spray decorations can be seen at the top of the pillars.
As a seven-girder building, its hip-saddle roof, double eaves and splendid colour painting add to its majesty.
It serves as a valuable historical relic, for it represents the pavilion design in the early years of the feudal dynasty.
Acknowledging the structural magnificence of the building during his visit on August 22, 1966, ChairmanKim Jong Ilcalled for taking pride in the wisdom and architecture of the ancestors.
The pavilion, associated with the history of Korean people's brave struggle against outside aggressors, is preserved as a part of national treasure. Many people enjoy their leisure time there. -0-

headline: UAWK Officials Make Study Tour of Revolutionary Battle Sites in Mt Paektu Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 22 (KCNA) -- Officials of the Union of Agricultural Workers of Korea (UAWK) from across the country began their study tour of revolutionary battle sites in the area of Mt Paektu.
A kicking-off meeting for the study tour was held at the plaza in front of the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin Hyesan City of Ryanggang Province on Friday.
Attending it were officials concerned, officials of the UAWK and members of the study tour group.
The participants laid a flower basket and bouquets at the statues of the great leaders and paid tribute to them.
A reporter and speakers at the meeting noted that respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade sure that a study tour of the strategic base of the Korean revolution and a center for education in the revolutionary traditions was organized for the officials of the union.
They said that the study tour would serve as an important occasion for officials and primary officials of the union to realize the noble spirit and soul of the forerunners who provided the traditions of noble loyalty and unity in the early period of the Korean revolution.
At the end of the meeting, the members of the study tour group went round the Monument to the Victorious Battle of Pochonbo and the Ryanggang Provincial Revolutionary Museum. -0-

headline: Wonsan-Kalma Coastal Tourist Area Crowded with Many Visitors
N. Hwanghae Province Focuses on Rural Technical Revolution
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- North Hwanghae Province of the DPRK is directing efforts to training the primary officials and agricultural workers of the farms to be masters of the rural technical revolution, persons in charge of the scientific farming.
The Provincial Rural Economy Committee has arranged organizational and political work in a concrete way to improve the contents and methods of education at city, county agricultural technology schools, which play an important role in training rural technical forces, and reinforce their material and technical foundations.
Sariwon City remodeled its agricultural technology school. And it is now making efforts to improve the qualifications of teachers, teach students in a theoretical and popularized way on the basis of the Party policies and introduce the research-type teaching methods to the subjects of study.
The agricultural technology schools in Sangwon, Junghwa and Rinsan counties are educating their students about farming, stockbreeding, pomiculture and agricultural information technology in combination with practices to prepare them to be knowledgeable workers.
Songnim City and Yonthan County are raising the ability and intellectual level of their primary officials by updating the contents of retraining them in conformity with the trend of the development of modern agriculture and regional features and organizing on-site inspections and practices.
The teachers of agricultural technology schools in Hwangju and Kumchon counties are arranging itinerant lectures in a substantial way with an aim to help farmers enrich their knowledge and teach them practical knowledge for farming.
Unpha and Thosan counties have also paid attention to the educational work at agricultural technology schools and established a system of training skilled workers to prepare them to be those capable of realizing the mechanization of agriculture. -0-

headline: Laudable Deeds of DPRK Young People
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Youth people in the DPRK are leaving the traces of their beautiful life at major worksites for socialist construction.
Those honored with the audience of respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unin the celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League are taking the lead in the all-people patriotic struggle.
Young people in North Hwanghae, North Phyongan and South Hamgyong provinces decided to join construction brigades, graduates of Kanggye University of Education decided to work in the area of Mt Paektu and many other young people volunteered for difficult and labour-consuming worksites in this year alone.
A girl of the Cha Kwang Su Youth Shock Brigade at the Hoean Youth Coal Mine affiliated to the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex saved her comrades at the cost of her precious life in an emergency in April. Her deed eloquently proves the moral world of the youth in our era.
Young people of the large-size machine tools shop at the Ryongsong Machine Complex are making innovative achievements in processing compressor parts and scores of youth people of the Samchong Mine at the Sangwon Cement Complex are increasing production by taking good care of equipment and conducting a mass technological innovation movement.
The chief Children's Union instructor at Rason Secondary School No. 1 is among those who gave sincere assistance to the fifth-stage housing construction in the Hwasong area, out of their desire to make a contribution to implementing the Party's grand idea of the capital city construction. -0-

headline: Foundations for Cement Production Further Strengthened
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- The Sunchon Cement Complex in the DPRK makes progress in reinforcing its material and technical foundations.
The complex has turned a technical innovation movement into the one for the masses themselves and intensified technical guidance on ensuring the normal operation of equipment.
Amid the mass technical innovation movement, it introduced efficient casting method to lengthen the operating life of various kinds of crushers, thus providing a guarantee for increased production.
Its technical team remodeled a coal crusher to raise the output of pulverized coal 1.3 times and improve its fineness, making it possible to raise the combustion rate and save a great amount of fuel.
Meanwhile, the complex has stepped up the manufacture and introduction of electric furnace intended to increase the equipment production capacity as well as the project to replace firebricks for a shaft kiln, repair a cooler and install external circulating air separator.
Workers at Sunchon Limestone Mine, Ryongwon Mine, Jikdong Gypsum Mine and other mines, too, are concentrating their efforts on the technical development to lay the foundations for long-term production and raise the operation rate of transport system and drainage system. -0-

headline: Paduk - Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- Paduk is a folk game made by the resourceful and talented Korean people.
Paduk based on the ancient people's view on space has been handed down for a long time.
The flat board symbolizes the land, the square shape of the board means spring, summer, autumn and winter, and 361 intersections of the horizontal and vertical lines signify one year.
The intersection on the center of the board was called the "Chonwonjom" because the ancient people believed that the earth was the center of the universe.
The round Paduk stones symbolize the round universe. Black and white stones are symbolic of day and night.
Paduk was registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage in May 2014. -0-

headline: Kumsong Tractor Factory
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- The Kumsong Tractor Factory in Nampho Municipality is an important factory playing a vanguard role in realizing the comprehensive mechanization of agriculture in the DPRK.
The factory has ultra-modern equipment and advanced production processes capable of manufacturing high-horsepower tractors and various kinds of efficient farm machines, a product exhibition hall and a gymnasium.
The factory turned into a modern one thanks to the warm loving care respected ComradeKim Jong Unhas shown to free the agricultural workers from difficult and labour-consuming work by developing the country's farm machine industry.
He indicated the orientation and ways of modernizing the factory and took important measures to push ahead with it.
On August 23, 2023, he visited the factory to learn in detail about its first-stage modernization and to indicate important issues that should not be overlooked in the next stage of modernization.
His field guidance served as a historic occasion when the targets for the factory's technical modernization were properly set.
As a result, the workers of the factory, scientists and technicians of relevant units and soldier-builders successfully completed the second-stage modernization of the factory.
Bearing in their minds the trust of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea that put forward the factory as the important one leading the development of the country's agricultural machine industry, the workers are making strenuous efforts to produce many more efficient farm machines as well as tractors. -0-

headline: S. Phyongan Province Gives Assistance to Youth Workteams and Subworkteams
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- South Phyongan Province of the DPRK is giving considerable assistance to the youth workteams and subworkteams at farms.
The provincial youth league committee arranged the organizational and political work and assigned concrete tasks to its members to fulfill its plan to establish a cultured way in production and life of all the youth workteams and subworkteams at farms.
At the same time, the committee took practical measures to encourage the young people to take the lead in carrying on the Three-Revolution in the countryside and improve the youth workteam movement and youth subworkteam movement.
Cities and counties paid much attention to aid those teams. As a result, in a recent one month alone, dozens of those teams have undergone radical transformation in their appearances.
Officials of the province and heads of those teams visited an exemplary youth workteam in Sunchon City. -0-

National Contest of Schoolchildren's Brass Bands Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 23 (KCNA) -- A national contest of schoolchildren's brass bands took place at the fifth-stage construction site in the Hwasong area of the DPRK from Aug. 19 to 22.
More than 500 schoolchildren, selected from across the country, conducted motivational activities with band music.
Schoolchildren of Konguk Senior Middle School in Mangyongdae District, Tongri Senior Middle School in Sariwon City, Phyongsong Middle School for Orphans and Thongnam Senior Middle School in Songchongang District of Hamhung City revved up the atmosphere of the construction site with their cheerful band music full of optimism.
Those of Tong Senior Middle School in Sinuiju City, Paechon Mine Technical Senior Middle School in Paechon County, Kim Kum Su Senior Middle School in Usi County and Sangdong Senior Middle School in Wonsan City encouraged the builders by playing appealing marches. -0-

headline: Japan Will Perish in Flames of Neo-Militarism: KCNA Commentary
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Dignitaries again flocked to the Yasukuni Shrine on the day of Japan's defeat.
High-ranking politicians of Japan, buoyed up by the wild ambition for continental aggression, frequent there on different occasions every year. It is the fact well known to the world already that what they seek is just to secure a spiritual pillar for proactively supporting their militaristic policy.
But this time the gravity of the issue is further highlighted by the group visit assuming so unusual colours.
Prime Minister Takaichi, who had made an offering to the shrine on August 15, made a bow toward the shrine, on her way to the national mourning ceremony for the war dead. She was not far from the shrine at that time.
It is something rare to be seen that the incumbent prime minister made a bow toward the shrine on the day of defeat.
As foreign media commented it as "remote tribute" and "a quarter of a step forward to pay visiting tribute," it is not difficult to see Takaichi's militaristic ambition that has gone to extremes.
Since its emergence, the Takaichi regime has pursued such extremely dangerous military policy, never to be seen in the preceding regimes, as deployment of preemptive attack weapons indispensable for launching reinvasion, modification of the "Three Principles on Transfer of Defence Equipment and Technology" and its guidelines and attempted revision of the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles" for arming itself with nuclear weapons.
By paying such "surprise tribute" in that context, little short of visiting tribute, Takaichi has openly revealed her intention to actualize the "long-cherished desire" for overseas expansion at the earliest date by rendering the social atmosphere of supporting reinvasion strong enough to facilitate the war preparations being accelerated by the present regime.
No wonder, she neither spoke any words of reflection on Japan's history of aggression nor made no-war pledge in her address to the so-called national ceremony for mourning the war dead she attended after her "tribute" to the shrine.
On the contrary, she employed a crafty trick in her speech to evade the responsibility for the last century's wars of aggression that inflicted untold misfortune and pain upon the Asian people.
Keeping pace with the chief executive rashly behaving in denial of the past crimes to revive militarism, a number of conservative politicians vied with each other to visit the shrine and pay tribute to the special-class war criminals.
Notably, the Japanese minister of Defence, said to be in charge of "national security", visited the shrine this time, too, which clearly shows the gravity of the issue.
The shameless descendants of militarism, the only ones who have not yet liquidated their sinful past, are desperately "worshiping" the hideous aggressors and murderers who spearheaded the overseas invasion and working hard to ignite a revenge war. Such serious tendency constitutes a blatant challenge to the desire of humankind for global peace and security.
Japan is bound to repeat its past as it never draws a lesson but wantonly denies its past as a war criminal country and a defeated nation.
The island nation will perish in the flames of neo-militarism fanned on the day of defeat. -0-

headline: Visit to Cholryong Revolutionary Site
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Officials and working people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK have visited the Cholryong Revolutionary Site every day on the occasion of the historic day when ChairmanKim Jong Ilstarted his leadership over the revolutionary armed forces.
At a meeting to hear the noble virtues of the Chairman held during the study tour, the performers praised the immortal revolutionary career of the peerlessly great man who regarded it as his motto to believe in the people as in Heaven and made a ceaseless high-intensity forced march for the prosperity of the country and the improvement of the people's standard of living till the last moments of his great life.
After arriving at the top of Chol Pass, the visitors laid bouquets at the monument to the revolutionary activities of the Chairman there.
They were briefed by a lecturer on the fact that the Chairman firmly defended the destiny of the country and the people and the destiny of socialism while making ceaseless journeys for revolutionary guidance under the uplifted banner of Songun.
The visitors keenly realized once again that the Chairman crossed the pass 18 times and it was a sacred course that consolidated the country's military muscle into an invincible one capable of defeating any formidable enemy. -0-

headline: Rugged Mountain Road Taken by Top Leader
story_text:
One August day in 2018, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited Yangdok County with his grand plan to build a wonderful hot spring cultural resort for the people.
The collar of the General Secretary walking along the rough mountain road was wet with sweat.
His eyes were filled with a glow of regret when he dropped in at a hot spring to estimate the amount of water gushing out. It was because the amount fell short of his expectation.
He and his entourage crossed a rough hill and reached another hot spring. At that time, a rain cloud suddenly appeared in the sky and it began to pelt down. However, he continued his way.
At last he found an appropriate hot spring and smiled broadly as if he had found something rare. He told the accompanying officials that he felt exhausted but he was so happy to set the site for a combined hot spring hostel, another asset for promoting the health and wellbeing of the people.
The officials were greatly moved by his painstaking efforts for the people. -0-

headline: Landscaping in Samjiyon City
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- Landscaping gets brisk in Samjiyon City of the DPRK.
The city drew up a stepwise greening plan and organized a show of technical issues arising in the cultivation and management of planted trees, while ensuring that the city horticultural station and tree nurseries produce good species of saplings.
The Samjiyon Blueberry Drink Factory, the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory, the Samjiyon Soybean Paste Factory and other factories have taken good care of trees, flower shrubs and turfs of good species to turn the compound into a forest and park.
Ikal Hotel, Potnamu Hotel and other units arranged flowering plants in a fashionable way to beautify buildings and set up peculiar flower beds and flowerpot stands.
The citizens of Potnamu and Ikal dongs strive to improve the appearance of the mountainous cultural city by creating flower beds in streets, parks, playgrounds and resting places and planting cosmos, calendula officinalis and other flowers through a socialist emulation among dongs and neighborhood units.
The landscaped children's traffic park and sports park attract many visitors for their botanical decorations and elegant natural beauty suited to the surroundings.
The city continues to direct great efforts to the cultivation of trees of high ornamental value adapted to the climatic and soil conditions of the Mt Paektu area in tree nurseries. -0-

headline: Regional-Industry Factories Bring out Many Kinds of Products
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- New regional-industry factories across the DPRK are now bringing out many new kinds of products, as compared with the early period of their operation, contributing to the improvement of the living standard of regional citizens, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The varieties of foodstuff have increased by 2 times, clothing by 12 times and daily necessities by 6 times on average at the city and county foodstuff, garment and daily necessities factories across the country.
The Jaeryong County Foodstuff Factory, which produced 60 kinds of products at the time of its inauguration, is now producing 130 kinds of tasty and nutritious foodstuff.
The Sukchon County Garment Factory is bringing out over 100 kinds of clothing by directing efforts to new product development.
The Hamju County Daily Necessities Factory has increased the varieties of products to contribute to the development of the county and the improvement of the living standard of inhabitants.
The regional-industry factories, built in the second year of the regional-industry revolution, have proactively introduced the successes and experience gained by the factories built in the first year to accelerate the development of new products. -0-

headline: Building-materials Complex Renovated in N. Phyongan Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 24 (KCNA) -- North Phyongan Province of the DPRK has renovated the provincial building-materials complex to expand its production capacity, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province pushed ahead with the remodeling project after setting a goal to locally produce various building materials needed for cities and counties.
Provincial assistance helped paint the exterior of buildings, pave compound roads and technically upgrade equipment.
More injection moulding machines were installed to produce various plastic pipes and 10-odd kinds of plastic building materials.
A new tile paint production line was established, alongside the provision of full conditions for producing fittings, furniture and various electric wires.
As a result, material and technical foundations have been laid for supplying a lot of quality building materials to cities and counties every year. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
DPRK Premier Inspects Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Resort and Industrial Establishments in Hamhung City
Efforts Concentrated on Farming
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- The agricultural workers of the DPRK concentrate their efforts on the cultivation of crops in the latter half of their growth.
Rural areas across the country, including South Hwanghae, Hamgyong and Phyongan provinces, have introduced advanced methods of cultivation and management so that paddy rice growth is not disturbed.
Waterways and levees are well managed so that crops are not flooded. Various plant nutrients and growth regulators are applied to increasing their resistance to diseases.
They have made detailed study of the growth of crops in fields and plots, taken thorough agro-technological measures and directed efforts to the nutrition management of paddy rice.
While increasing the photosynthetic capacity of paddy rice and promoting their ear ripening, they have given precedence to the prevention of harmful insects caused by wet weather and raised the scientific level of manuring.
Agricultural workers are striving to increase the per-hectare yields as high as possible until harvest and make preparations to cope with the ever-changing situation promptly by examining the vulnerable sites in detail. -0-

headline: New Passenger Battery-operated Bus Route to Be Set up in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- New passenger battery bus routes are increasing every year in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK.
According to Minju Joson, a new passenger battery-operated bus route will be set up in the section from Pyongyang Railway Station to Jonjin-dong in Rangnang District this year.
The Pyongyang Municipal General Passenger Service Enterprise, in close contact with relevant sectors and units, has given precedence to designing and preparation of construction forces, resolving problems such as supply of necessary materials and accessories to help push ahead with the production of battery-operated buses and the construction of the Jonjin Battery-operated Bus Station.
The Pyongyang Trolley Bus Factory has made successes in manufacturing new battery-operated buses. It is pushing ahead with converting trolley buses into battery-based ones.
The Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences is ensuring the supply of necessary batteries. -0-

headline: University and College Graduates Volunteer to Work at Local Schools in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- This year, more than 100 graduates from universities of education and teachers training colleges in different parts of the DPRK have volunteered to work as teachers at schools on islands and in mountainous areas and farm villages.
After leaving their beloved native places, alumnae from Haeju Kim Jong Thae University of Education and Sinuiju Cha Kwang Su University of Education have dedicated themselves to the education at senior middle schools on solitary islands.
A graduate from a teachers training college in the city of Hoeryong, who is a discharged soldier, volunteered to go with his family to Ryongchon Branch School of Wonryong Technical Senior Middle School and work as a teacher there.
Graduates from Phyongsong University of Education and Phyongsong Teachers Training College, too, decided to become teachers at Huksu Technical Senior Middle School in a mountain village of Taehung County.
An alumna from Wonsan Ri Su Dok Teachers Training College, who wonKim Il Sungscholarship and the University Student Scientific Research Prize, and others volunteered for teachers at Hero Haegumgang Technical Senior Middle School in Kosong County.
Among the volunteers are graduates from Wonsan, Hamhung and Songdo universities of education and Sariwon Teachers Training College. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Resort and Industrial Establishments in Hamhung City
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of the construction of the Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Resort and industrial establishments in Hamhung City.
Looking round various objects under construction in the Samjiyon Mountainous Tourist Resort being built in a grand way true to the Party's far-reaching plan and intention for the promotion of the people's wellbeing, the premier acquainted himself in detail with the construction and presided over an review meeting.
The premier said at the meeting that the success in implementing the Party's policies depends on the strong organizing ability and executive power of the officials, calling for successfully completing the planned project by making the most effective use of the good construction time, simultaneously pushing ahead with the preparations for operation and service. He called on the relevant units to give top priority to supplying necessary equipment and materials.
At the Ryongsong Machine Complex, Pak Thae Song encouraged the workers of the complex who are making innovations in the struggle to implement the decisions of the plenary meeting of the Party Central Committee and stressed the need to steadily expand the successes by producing various kinds of custom-built equipment indispensable for different sectors of the national economy and pushing ahead with the second-stage modernization project in a three-dimensional way.
Going round the Hungnam Fertilizer Complex, he called for finishing the intensive overhaul of different production lines ahead of schedule, putting the fertilizer production on a normal basis and technically upgrading the unreasonable elements in a planned way.
Learning about the production at the Hungnam Pharmaceutical Factory, he said that officials of the factory should thoroughly resolve the problems by dint of science and technology, bearing in mind that the development of science and technology means the growth of production, and unconditionally carry out the plan for this year's production of medicines on all indices.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issues of ensuring sufficient supply of materials necessary for the second-stage modernization project of the Ryongsong Machine Complex, steady and sustainable growth of fertilizer production and boosting the production of medicines. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- The Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Central Council of the Communist Parties-the Communist Party of the Soviet Union sent flower baskets to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill on the occasion of the 15th anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il's visit to the Siberian and the Far Eastern Regions.
The flower baskets were laid before the statues of the great leaders on Monday. -0-

headline: Exhibition of Technological Innovations by Three-revolution Teams Closed
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- The seventh national exhibition of technological innovations made by three-revolution teams closed with due ceremony at the Sci-Tech Complex on Monday.
During the exhibition, the participants shared and exchanged valuable sci-tech successes and experience gained in the course of their brisk technical innovation movement for economic development and improvement of the people's living in units and regions to which they were dispatched.
Highly appreciated at the exhibition were more than 250 sci-tech achievements conducive to enhancing the Juche character and independence of the national economy and realizing the Workers' Party of Korea's policy on regional development.
Present at the closing ceremony were Kim Sung Du, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Sung Guk, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials of commissions, ministries, national agencies and relevant sectors and three-revolution team members.
Diplomas were awarded to the successful units and members of their three-revolution teams. -0-

headline: Talented Persons Increase in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 25 (KCNA) -- The number of talented persons, including best scientists, technicians and inventors, is on the increase in the DPRK in recent years. They contribute to developing the country's economy and improving the people's living standard and taking the lead in developing their sectors, units and regions, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The highest science and technology prize and medals were awarded to over 20 projects conducive to accelerating the national prosperity and development, and hundreds of officials, scientists and technicians received the February 16 Science and Technology Prize in the past three years after the establishment of the national system of managing the pool of sci-tech talents.
19 persons became the best scientists and technicians of the country.
Dozens of people were selected as the best scientists and technicians of ministries, national agencies and provinces for 2025.
Four working people, who made distinguished inventions conducive to the development of the country, were selected as the first best inventors. The number has increased to dozens in five years.
The number of sci-tech talents at the national level is increasing. They present sci-tech proposals of great significance in the country's economic development and sci-tech development and play a leading role in putting them into practice. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Fourth Enlarged Meeting of Political Bureau of Ninth Central Committee of WPK Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- The Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea convened its fourth enlarged meeting on August 25 to take more political and practical measures for guaranteeing the successful implementation of the major policy tasks for 2026, the first year for implementing the new Five-Year Plan set forth by the historic Ninth Congress of the Party.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK, and members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK. Present as observers were vice-premiers of the Cabinet, major ministers, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and senior officials of relevant departments of the C.C., WPK.
ComradeKim Jong Unguided the meeting.
The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee first heard a report on the progress made in this year's major policy-oriented projects, adopted and assigned by the first and second plenary meetings of the Ninth Central Committee of the Party, and on the current situation of major economic sectors.
The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee positively appreciated the important changes and successes demonstrating the transition to a new phase of development, being made in overall state work from the first year of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress.
The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau underlined the need to set a clear goal and orientation of the struggle and secure a scientific and efficient guarantee for bringing about certain attainment, now that the valuable successes, achieved by strenuous efforts, are being accumulated and the plans, greater than the past, are being worked out.
The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau recalled the character and significance of this year's struggle, which is crucial for successfully attaining the gigantic long-term goals set forth by the Party Congress, and stressed the need for the Cabinet, the State Planning Commission and other economic guidance organs and the policy-oriented guidance departments of the Party Central Committee to display extraordinary responsibility and high prudence.
The Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee examined the strategic coordination and timely measures for successful completion of the projects planned for this year and strengthened capability for implementing short-, intermediate- and long-term tasks on the principle of encouraging successes and experience, constantly drawing lessons and securing solutions in conformity with the characteristics of the times and the requirements of the reality, in which a creative struggle, unprecedented in terms of the width and depth of state development and the gigantic nature of its long-term goals, is underway.
The enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau specified the principles and a series of policies for the state economic guidance organs to prudently and strategically tide over the unfavorable conditions and difficulties arising alongside ever-changing circumstances, and ensure concentration in the construction of major policy-oriented objects, in particular.
Pointing out a series of deviations revealed in the course of implementing the decisions of the Party Congress, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that they are the consequences of the immature operation and leadership of the economic guidance organs failing to keep abreast of our greater ideals and progress and such shortcomings can be overcome and eliminated by the efforts redoubled with a new determination and struggle will.
Noting that the important duty to steer all sectors of socialist construction to fresh innovations and changes and eye-opening rate of growth has been placed on the shoulders of the leading cadres, he called upon all the Party organizations to more dynamically conduct their organizational and political work to give full play to the spiritual strength of the masses as required by the invariable policy of the Party Central Committee on giving priority to ideological work in every undertaking.
Saying that the on-going advance requires extraordinary courage and strenuous efforts beyond precedents and limits, he noted that the goals of transformations set forth by the Ninth Party Central Committee are not merely the numbers in practical plans but important political tasks for preserving the dignity of the country and proving the superiority of the social system.
He stressed the need for the officials responsible for the implementation of the Party decisions to successfully conclude this year's struggle without fail and thus pave a broad avenue to attaining the new long-term goals, always mindful that the current daily successes, symbolic of the on-going accelerated advance and development, will just lead to the promotion of the people's wellbeing. -0-

headline: Water Park Construction in Hyesan City
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Ryanggang Province of the DPRK is pushing ahead with the construction of the Hyesan Water Park, according to Minju Joson.
The province set the site of the water park on a bank of the Amnok River in Songhu-dong, Hyesan City and made full preparations for its construction.
Foundation concrete tamping, framing and other processes were speeded up so as to complete the construction of an embankment in the Amnok River in a short span of time, alongside the exterior project and land leveling completed in the main.
The production of water park facilities is stepped up in contact with relevant units and the work for ensuring the timely supply of finishing building materials necessary for interior decoration is pushed forward at the same time. -0-

headline: Activities of Medical Education Teams Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- The field medical education teams dispatched to newly-built city and county hospitals are intensifying their activities, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The field medical education teams, consisting of competent medical workers of Pyongyang General Hospital, Kim Man Yu Hospital, Korean General Red Cross Hospital and other national-level hospitals are helping improve the technical and practical qualifications of the medical workers of Kangdong County Hospital, Kusong City Hospital and Ryonggang County Hospital.
Members of the mobile medical education teams are engaging in technical lectures, practical and technical training and patient consultation to improve the clinical and technical level and academic qualifications of the local medical workers on the spot.
In July alone, they gave more than 1 500 technical lectures, over 3 000 technical workshops and at least 4 000 rounds of consultation with patients, thus further improving the level of local medical service.
The local medical workers are increasingly eager to learn more in technical lectures and workshops.
Diagnostic and therapeutic methods are being introduced into clinical practice in keeping with the trend of the development of modern medicine amid the efforts to provide advanced medical service to the local people in cooperation with the members of the field medical education teams. -0-

headline: Dynamic Drive for Increased Production and Creation
Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Even after their defeat, the Japanese reactionaries persistently pursued the heinous hostile policy toward the Korean people, oppressing the Koreans in Japan and mercilessly violating their human rights.
After their defeat, the Japanese reactionaries enacted and promulgated the "decree on foreigner registration" aimed at registering and oppressing all Koreans in Japan, which accounted for 90 percent of foreigners, and forcibly expelling them if necessary.
As a result, the Japanese reactionaries, who laid the foundation for indiscriminately oppressing Koreans in Japan at will, committed such cruel human rights abuses as monitoring and disturbing their residence, entry and exit under unreasonable pretexts.
Koreans were harassed or killed under the pretext of "stowaway crackdown". In 1946, they arrested more than 26 000 Koreans and imprisoned them in camps in Kyushu area. Not content with subjecting them to all sorts of insult, the reactionaries killed hundreds of Koreans from April to August that year.
The Japanese reactionaries massacred Koreans in Japan by charging them with "violation of registration decree." On September 7, 1947, a Japanese gang in Kitami City, Hokkaido, at the instigation of the government, attacked more than 40 Koreans with clubs, daggers, etc., killing two and seriously wounding five.
Such atrocities continued later.
In the 1960s Koreans were killed in Omiya City, Saitama Prefecture, Tenri City of Nara Prefecture, etc.
Japan's frantic chauvinistic moves against the Korean people, including the vicious atrocities the Japanese reactionaries committed by raiding and destroying the dwellings of Koreans in Japan, are countless. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 26 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Han Chun Ok, a woman living in neighborhood unit No. 23, Sondok-ri, Jongphyong County of South Hamgyong Province, on her 100th birthday.
Receiving the birthday spread amid warm congratulations from officials of the Party and power organs in the county and villagers, the centenarian said in an excited tone that such glory is unthinkable apart from the benevolent social system, whereby working people are the masters of the country and selfless, devoted efforts are made for the good of the people.
She had been subjected to all sorts of maltreatment and contempt before national liberation. She could lead a genuine human life as a farmer only after PresidentKim Il Sungliberated the country.
With a resolve to repay even a bit the benevolence of the country, she devoted her pure conscience and sincere efforts to the farming for decades and brought up her children to be robust ones responsible for national defence and socialist construction. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Minister Receives Greetings from Her Counterpart of Seychelles
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, received a message of greeting from Barry Faure, minister of Foreign Affairs and the Diaspora of the Republic of Seychelles, on August 24 on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
Saying that the 50th anniversary serves as a proof of the lasting ties of friendship and mutual respect between the two countries, the message sincerely wished the DPRK steady success and prosperity. -0-

headline: Efforts Made to Put Farming on Scientific Basis of Higher Level
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Farms in Kangwon Province of the DPRK strive to put the manure and cultivation of crops on a higher-level scientific basis under changing weather conditions.
They have actively applied the method of managing paddy water and exterminated harmful insects on a sci-tech basis to provide good conditions for the growth of crops.
They are taking foresighted measures to increase the per-hectare yield before harvest while applying plant growth promoters properly and managing the water-conducting ditches regularly to enhance the root activity of paddy rice.
They are increasing the thousand-kernel weight and the ripening rate by clearing drainage channels and waterways and manuring and cultivating paddy rice and maize in a proper way.
They have taken steps to introduce the experience gained by advanced units in manuring and cultivating crops in conformity with the actual conditions and to minimize the damage caused by downpour and heavy rain. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson on U.S. Hostile Moves
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea gave the following answer to a question raised by KCNA on Thursday as regards the fact that the U.S. is repeatedly resorting to a series of hostile moves adversely affecting the security environment of the DPRK and the regional situation:
Recently, the U.S. Department of State decided to sell the ROK AIM-9X Sidewinder air-to-air missiles, the latest ultra-modern tactical missile currently operated by the U.S. army and which can be used to attack ground targets, and their related equipment worth 125 million US$.
Earlier, it announced its plan to allot millions of U.S. dollars to the "human rights" smear campaign in order to create conditions favorable for grasping so-called "human rights situation" in the DPRK and gathering information about the DPRK.
The above-said acts are another case proving the persistence and sequence of the U.S. hostile moves to add a new threat to the security sphere of the DPRK and create instability in the social system of our state.
This year alone, the U.S. approved the sale of various lethal equipment worth an astronomical sum of money, including the latest air-to-air missiles, new-type helicopters for naval operation, attack helicopters and precisely guided bombs, encouraging the ROK to boost its capability to fight a war.
Now that the military integration of the U.S. and its allies is being accelerated in the Asia-Pacific region, we can not overlook the adverse effect of the U.S. sale of its weapons to the ROK on the regional security environment.
The reality clearly proves how actively and zealously the U.S. is trying to expand the new threat to the DPRK.
We once again and clearly recognized the expression of the U.S. open attitude to be always hostile to the DPRK.
The DPRK is well aware of the reality that there always exists outsiders' malignant attempt and threat to the DPRK's security and its political stability, and will make a serious, immediate and powerful response to the hostile acts in different spheres. -0-

headline: National Students' Sports Games Closes
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- The 2026 national students' sports games came to a close.
In the games opened on August 19, the players fully displayed their team spirit and high sports skills they had cultivated through mass sports activities.
Pyongyang Municipality came first in total standings.
Citations, trophies and medals were awarded to the successful organizations and players at the closing ceremony held in Phyongsong City on August 26. -0-

headline: Events Held in Russia to Mark 81st Anniversary of Korea's Liberation
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Meetings were held by the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee and the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and the Maritime Territorial Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity" to celebrate the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Present there were personages of the Russian government, political parties, organizations and institutions and members of organizations for the study of the Juche idea and for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people.
Speeches were made at the meetings.
Personages of the Russian Veterans' Union, the Federation of International Peace Fund and the Institute of Oriental Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences said that the day of Korea's liberation is a significant day not only for the Korean people but also for the Russian people, adding that the militant friendship between the Korean guerrillas and the Soviet Union army provided in the course of struggle to annihilate Japanese militarism more than 80 years ago is being carried forward generation after generation.
They praised the DPRK people for accomplishing the cause of national liberation on the basis of the idea of self-reliant independence advanced by ComradeKim Il Sungand consistently adhering to the principle of independence even in the period of unprecedentedly severe trials.
The first secretaries of the Maritime Territorial Branch Committee and the Sakhalin Regional Branch Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the chairperson of the Maritime Territorial Branch of the All-Russia War Veterans' Social Organization "Militant Fraternity" said that the DPRK and Russian peoples recollect the Korean revolutionaries and officers and men of the Red Army, who dedicated their youth and lives to the sacred cause of Korea's liberation, on every August 15.
A congratulatory message to respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwas adopted at the meeting held by the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK.
Meanwhile, an event took place in Khabarovsk to mark the 15th anniversary of ChairmanKim Jong Il's visit to the Siberian and Far Eastern regions of the Russian Federation and the 81st anniversary of Korea's liberation.
Personages of political and social circles were present in the event. They praised PresidentKim Il Sung's exploits for Korea's liberation and explained the significance of ChairmanKim Jong Il's visit to the Siberian and Far Eastern regions.
They expressed their will to make positive contributions to the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations. -0-

headline: Cultivating Crops on Sci-tech Basis
Preparations for New School Term Brisk in Pyongyang
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- The general education units in Pyongyang are pushing ahead with the preparations for teaching in the new school term.
Schools regularly organize the demonstration teaching and discussion on teaching to improve the qualifications of teachers and positively introduce the excellent teaching experience.
They have built rooms for cooking and building techniques and steadily improved the contents and methods of education, thus making the implementation of the newly-introduced system of voluntarily selecting subjects effective in reality.
They introduced heuristic, inquiry and discussion-style teaching methods and are drawing up teaching plans and make teaching aids in a qualitative way in conformity with the characteristics of different schools, grades and subjects.
Schools are making the preparations for teaching in the new school term, while combining theoretical education with practical education. -0-

headline: Greetings to Minister of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of Republic of Seychelles
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of greeting to Barry Faure, minister of Foreign Affairs and the Diaspora of the Republic of Seychelles, on Monday on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
The message expressed the belief that the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries would grow stronger. -0-

headline: Patriotic Youth's Spirit of Advance Displayed in Grand Construction Theaters
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- Young people across the DPRK are now demonstrating the spirit peculiar to the Korean youth in every major worksite for socialist construction.
Over 1 800 youths across the country have fulfilled their national economic plans for three years, two years and a year ahead of schedule. And over 150 rural youth workteams and sub-workteams have reaped bumper harvests in wheat and barley farming this year.
Members of the Kim Kwang Chol Youth Shock Brigade at the Ryongdung Coal Mine under the Kujang Area Coal-mining Complex performed such a miracle as fulfilling the three-year national economic plan ahead of schedule.
Youth shock brigades under the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, including the Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade and the Ri Su Bok Youth Shock Brigade of the Chonsong Youth Coal Mine, demonstrated the might of the vanguard and shock brigade.
The Kim Hyok Youth Shock Brigade members at the Komdok Mining Complex have steadily increased the speed of advance while introducing efficient working methods suited to the conditions of lithology, and the Ri Song Il-led Youth Tunneling Workteam at the April 5 Pit of the Kumgol Mine  implemented its yearly plan.
Hundreds of girl weavers at the Pyongyang Kim Jong Suk Textile Mill fulfilled their one- and two-year production plans, and many young people of various units, including Sinuiju and Sariwon textile mills, fulfilled their yearly quotas.
Youths at the Samsu Forestry Station of the Forestry Complex 121 and the Hwaphyong Forestry Station of the Jagang Provincial Forestry Management Bureau have taken the lead in timber production for the year.
Many rural youth workteams and sub-workteams across the country brought about high yields in wheat and barley farming this year. -0-

headline: Second-stage Construction Project for Tanchon Power Station Accelerated
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 27 (KCNA) -- The Kumgang Trade Guidance Bureau Brigade in the DPRK has carried out the tunneling of a drift for a main waterway by over 90 percent so far, with a resolve to complete the second-stage construction project for the Tanchon Power Station.
The brigade has given precedence to the supply of materials and inspired its members with enthusiasm after mapping out a plan for the waterway project.
While conducting effective scientific and technological study with the main emphasis on finding a rational way to successfully complete the waterway project, it is taking measures to introduce advanced technologies and reduce the consumption of materials to the maximum.
On the basis of the survey of the geological conditions of its section, the brigade invented various blasting methods to attain good results. -0-

headline: Performance Given to Mark Youth Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- A performance "Young People, Be Loyal to Our Party" was given by the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League at the Pyongyang Municipal Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on August 27 to mark the Youth Day.
Put on the stage of the performance which started with the playing of the national anthem of the DPRK were colorful numbers reflecting the pride and honor of the new generations glorifying their worthwhile life as successors to the revolution and masters of the youth power.
The young people's deep reverence for respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Untraining them to be heroes of the times and creators of feats was expressed in narrative poem "The Great Loving Care for the Youth" and female solo and pangchang "We Cannot Live without You".
There were numbers showing the joy and optimism of the young vanguards, who are displaying the revolutionary enthusiasm and bravery peculiar to the Korean youth and covering the road of patriotism and repayment at major worksites of socialist construction.
The atmosphere of the performance reached its climax amid the playing of such famous songs of the new era as "We Are Koreans".
"Young People, Be Loyal to Our Party" and other songs reflecting the unshakable will of the new generations to work miracles inspired the young people with the revolutionary enthusiasm and fighting spirit.
Among the audience were officials concerned, officials of the youth league and youth and students in Pyongyang. -0-

headline: Unknown
Young People of DPRK under Care of Top Leader
story_text:
In 2021, respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unorganized grand celebrations for the Youth Day. He met several young people, who volunteered to work in difficult and labor-consuming fields of socialist construction, and made a fresh start in their life.
Being briefed on their ages and careers, he personally took their hands one after another. He said that he fully supported their determination to start life again with a clean slate after breaking with their dishonorable past and work at the most difficult and labor-consuming posts for national prosperity out of their sincere gratitude to the Workers' Party of Korea and the socialist system which have taken care of and brought them up.
They, who had made disgraceful careers, repented of their sins and did what they are obliged to do for the Party and the country. But the respected fatherly Marshal highly praised it as a proud and excellent deed. They were so excited that they all burst into tears.
He told them that they might feel tired and hungry and fall into trouble in the course of putting their decision into practice but they should always live unyieldingly, mindful of their original determination to start life again with a clean slate.
Then he had a photo taken with them, expressing his belief that they would make new honorable careers.
Indeed, his warm love and trust constitute the very lifeblood that enabled the young people to pursue a successful career without vacillation. -0-

headline: Myongsasimni Railway Station Inaugurated in Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Myongsasimni Railway Station has been built in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area of the DPRK crowded with tourists enjoying their fantastic holiday under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea which seeks to provide the people with a new brighter and richer life and high civilization.
The station, with a total floor space of 7 000 square meters, was built in a unique architectural style to suit the characteristics of the coastal tourist city. It is a standard local railway station built practically in terms of its mission, function and service to ensure sightseeing.
Myongsasimni Railway Station, another valuable asset for the people impeccable in its appearance and amenities, is a precious fruit of devotion made by respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho finds his greatest pleasure in working hard for the people's happiness.
Its inauguration ceremony took place on Thursday.
Present there were Pak Hun, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Hwang Man Bok, chairman of the Kangwon Provincial People's Committee, officials concerned, officials in the field of railway transport, employees of Myongsasimni Railway Station, builders, working people, youth and students in the province.
Kim Ha Gyu, minister of Railways, addressed the ceremony.
He said that Myongsasimni Railway Station was successfully built under the energetic guidance of the Party Central Committee which regards the people's laughter and happiness as a symbol of the socialist system and a criterion of national power and devotes all to providing the people with the happiest life and the best civilization in the world.
True to the noble intention of the Party which set forth the task of building a new station in the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area and clearly indicated the orientation and ways for completing the project at the highest qualitative level, the builders and railway workers devoted their patriotic sweat and enthusiasm to the construction of railways and structures and created unique landscape around the station, he said.
He stressed that Myongsasimni Railway Station, built as a model of Korean-style local railway station in the coastal wonderland, clearly shows level of creation and civilization in the era of the Workers' Party that subordinates all affairs of the country to the welfare of the people.
He called upon the officials and workers in the railway transport sector to thoroughly establish the unified command system and put transport organization and command on a scientific and rational basis and the employees of Myongsasimni Railway Station to well manage the station building and the railway and conduct guide service in a responsible manner so that the travelers deeply feel the love and benevolence of the motherly Party.
The speaker stressed that all the officials and working people should single-mindedly and devotedly uphold the ideas and leadership of respected ComradeKim Jong Unso as to fulfill their responsibility and role in the sacred drive for overall development of Korean-style socialism and promotion of the people's wellbeing along the path indicated by the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the railway station. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Message of Sympathy to President of PRC
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of sympathy to Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and president of the People's Republic of China, on August 28.
The message says:
I express the deepest condolences to you, Comrade General Secretary, the Chinese party, government, people, victims and bereaved families, upon the sad news that landslide caused heavy casualties in the Tibet Autonomous Region of your country.
I sincerely hope that the aftermath of the damage will be eradicated as soon as possible and the inhabitants in the afflicted areas will regain peace and stable life under the leadership of the Communist Party of China and the Chinese government with you, Comrade General Secretary Xi Jinping, as the core. -0-

headline: Myongsasimni Railway Station Inaugurated in Wonsan Kalma Coastal Tourist Area
Young People Advance into Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Young people in South Hamgyong Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at major socialist construction theaters.
Youths in the county of Ragwon decided to work at the county offshore farm.
Those in Riwon County vowed to perform miracles and feats at an offshore farm under construction.
Those in Hamhung City and Jangjin, Pujon and Yonggwang counties volunteered to work at the construction brigades.
Those in Tanchon and Sinpho cities and Jongphyong County hardened their will to glorify the youth at pass-maintaining work-teams and goat farms.
A meeting was held at the Hamhung Youth Open-Air Theatre to congratulate those volunteers.
Present there were officials concerned, youth league officials, youth and students.
The volunteers were awarded the certificates. A congratulatory address and resolution-taking speeches were made at the meeting.
Then there was a story-telling meeting "Patriotism and youth" of youth and students in the province. -0-

headline: Invincible KPA Navy
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- Today (August 28) is the Navy Day.
The DPRK people are extending warm congratulations and high tribute to the officers and men of the Navy of the Korean People's Army who are reliably defending the sea of the country.
After the national liberation, PresidentKim Il Sungled the struggle to found modern naval force together with several services.
In June 1946, he organized the maritime security force and appointed a site for the Maritime Security Officers Training School, a mother base for training cadres of the Navy. Then he named the regular naval force with the maritime security force as the mother the "Fleet of Korea" and declared the founding of the KPA Navy on August 28, 1949.
During the past Fatherland Liberation War, seamen of the KPA Navy buried the U.S. imperialists' heavy cruiser called a "moving islet" at sea with four torpedo boats and destroyed a light cruiser, making a military miracle to be specially recorded in the world history of sea battles. In the 1960s they seized the U.S. armed spy ship Pueblo and thus demonstrated the might of heroic KPA, slapping the face of U.S. imperialism.
The Navy of the KPA, which has worked miracles and myths of victory with the matchless fighting spirit, making the imperialist pirates shudder, is now greeting the greatest heyday of its development under the care of respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un.
Under the energetic guidance of the General Secretary who is ushering in a great new era of strengthening the navy, the naval force of the KPA has developed into an invincible service.
The appearance of new-type destroyers in the wake of the launching ceremony of the Korean-style tactical nuclear attack submarine has boosted the heroic militant spirit of our seamen and injected vitality into them.
Seeing the new-type destroyers and naval warriors of new generation who will guarantee peace in the sea of the country by developing the naval power in a more comprehensive and accelerated way, the DPRK people are convinced that the dignity and stamina of the DPRK's Navy will be more fully displayed under the guidance of the great brilliant commander. -0-

headline: Young People Make Miracles and Innovations at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 28 (KCNA) -- This year, many young people in the DPRK, who volunteered to work at major worksites of socialist construction, have made new miracles and innovations.
Graduates of Kanggye University of Education, who advanced into the area of Mt Paektu, have fulfilled their responsibility and duty in preparing the people and rising generations to be those strong in ideology and faith with the revolutionary spirit and soul of Paektu.
A young man, who volunteered to be a member of the Kang Ho Yong Youth Shock Brigade at the Phunggok Youth Coal Mine under the Pukchang Area Youth Coal-mining Complex, has contributed to over-fulfilling the tunneling plan of the shock brigade.

headline: Mud-therapy in Lake Sijung
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 29 (KCNA) -- Lake Sijung, a lagoon in Thongchon County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK, is 2.94 square kilometers in area, and the mud layer of its bed is 4 to 5 metres thick.
Since it was prospected and tested for the first time in 1955-1956, mud of Lake Sijung has been used as one of the natural therapy resources. The black grey mud has no smell.
Mud in Lake Sijung is effective in treating arthritis of various causes, liver disease, chronic cholecystitis, chronic gastritis, gastric and duodenal ulcers, chronic colitis, trauma and surgical sequelae, nervous system diseases and gynecologic diseases.
The treatment methods include the one of putting a certain amount of mud and water in a tub and immersing the whole body or a certain part in it. This can be accompanied by electrotherapy, ultrasound therapy and phototherapy. Application temperature is usually 42~50℃ but it is sometimes applied at its original temperature.
Treatment duration is about 20 to 25 minutes. A total of 12 to 15 rounds of treatment are necessary, done once a day or once every two days.
Lake Sijung mud therapy was registered as a part of national intangible cultural heritage in October 2017. -0-
