headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 31 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on Monday:
We can witness the U.S. stand of confrontation with the DPRK being more clearly expressed recently.
A spokesperson for the Department of State and other officials concerned of the U.S. administration on August 26 clarified the stand that there has been no change in the U.S. policy toward the DPRK, asserting that the U.S. remains committed to the complete denuclearization of the DPRK.
It also more openly betrayed its extremely sinister and vicious hostile attempt to tarnish the image of our country and create its internal instability, talking about someone's "human rights abuses".
Meanwhile, the U.S. military announced its plan to stage the U.S.-Japan-ROK multi-domain joint military exercises Freedom Edge, which constitute a threat to the DPRK and regional countries, as scheduled, and is perpetrating air espionage and other anti-DPRK military provocations one after another.
The Trump administration has thus fully reconfirmed its invariable hostile policy to wantonly violate the sovereignty, political system and security interests of the DPRK through the "denuclearization" racket, "human rights" smear campaign and military threat.
The U.S. hostility toward the DPRK, manifested in its stand of confrontation that gets clearer in terms of rhetoric and behavior, has become a root cause of pushing the tensions on the Korean peninsula to a more dangerous level and escalating the structural instability of the region.
It is pointless to expect any detente in the region, given the grave situation where the U.S. persistent hostile policy toward the DPRK is evolving in a more dangerous way.
Our nukes serve as an absolute guarantee for defending its sovereignty and the nuclear weapons in possession of the DPRK and their sustained bolstering are the most responsible and correct option for ensuring regional peace and security.
This can be fully explained by the unstable security environment brought to the region by the U.S. nuclear posture transforming into more offensive one and Japan's rearmament and the ROK's arms buildup being accelerated in the framework of the U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military cooperation system.
The present position of the DPRK, fixed on a permanent basis by its supreme state law, can neither be weakened nor be diluted by the U.S. repeated expression of stand on "denuclearization".
To absurdly stick to the past can never get a grip on reality or deter the future.
The DPRK will be more resolute and clear in its exercise of sovereignty to defend the supreme interests of its national security, based on the premise that the U.S. policy toward the DPRK never changes and there will be no change in the future, too.
There is no change in our policy toward the U.S. to respond to its invariable hostile policy with the toughest stand to the last. -0-

headline: Educational Exhibitions Close in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, August 31 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of educational experimental apparatuses, teaching aids and educational aid programs and an exhibition of donated educational equipment closed with due ceremony atKim Il SungUniversity on August 30.
The participants were attracted by an AI experimental device using humanoid robot, a model board showing coal production process, a model of word-making robot, greenhouse environment control system, an electromagnetic phenomenon comprehensive presentation apparatus, an active magnetic levitation device and mechanical motion comprehensive experimental apparatus.
Highly appreciated were programs produced by teachers, researchers and kindergarten teachers ofKim Il SungUniversity, Kim Chaek University of Technology, Pyongyang University of Education No. 1, Mangyongdae Revolutionary School, Moranbong Secondary School No. 1, Jungdok Primary School in Phyongsong City affiliated to Phyongsong Teachers Training College and Changgwang Kindergarten.
Different kinds of educational equipment, presented by the Ministry of Electric Power Industry, the Ministry of Land and Environment Protection, the Ministry of IT Industry, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Fisheries, the State Academy of Sciences and other ministries and national agencies, clearly showed the daily-growing enthusiasm for supporting education throughout the society.
Present at the closing ceremony were Kim Sung Du, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Sung Guk, vice-premier of the Cabinet, officials concerned, officials of ministries, national agencies and educational sectors, teachers, researchers and kindergarten teachers.
A closing address was made by Minister of Education Ri Yong Chol. -0-

headline: Agricultural Technology Schools in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Tens of thousands of agricultural workers are now studying at 170-odd city and county agricultural technology schools across the country built last year to prepare themselves to be practical talents with qualifications needed to carry out the rural revolutionary programme in the new era, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The agricultural technology schools train skilled workers including tractor drivers, stockbreeders and electricians as well as technicians in various fields of agriculture including farming, stockbreeding, fruit farming, farm machine and agricultural IT.
The agricultural workers are acquiring the technical knowledge and skills in the field of farm machine through experiments and practice at the schools.
In the course of their study, they make inventions related to various fields by directing efforts to studying major subjects. -0-

headline: Youths in DPRK Volunteer for Difficult and Labor-consuming Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- Tens of young people in Kangwon Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at difficult and labor-consuming sectors of socialist construction.
Those in the counties of Kimhwa and Changdo decided to work at a raw material base and those in the counties of Anbyon and Phangyo volunteered for road- and pass-maintaining work-teams.
Those in Munchon City and Kosong County asked their youth league organizations to send them to the regional construction brigades.
A meeting was held at the Songdowon Youth Open-Air Theatre to congratulate the volunteers.
Present there were officials concerned, youth league officials, youth and students. The volunteers were awarded certificates and then congratulatory and resolution-taking speeches were made.
Officials, youth and students warmly saw the volunteers off, putting garlands around their necks and presenting bouquets to them. -0-

headline: Pondside Park in Hwasong Area of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 1 (KCNA) -- The Hwasong area embodying a good harmony of architectural formative and artistic beauty and advanced civilization has a very attractive pondside park in Saeppyol Street.
The pondside park is well harmonized with water, lawn, trees and peculiar architectural groups. It gives the people rich emotion, optimistic life and improved ecological environment and adds beauty to the scenery of the modern city.
The open pondside park has no fixed entrance or exit, so people can enter it from anywhere at any time. It is the character of the pondside park.
The artificial pond, where the lawn and the waterside are in perfect harmony and large rock stones dot along its shore, resembles a large natural lake.
The wonderful scenery of the lawn covering nearly 30 hectares also gives the people a gentle and lyrical impression as it was planted with trees and flowers with good ornamental effect.
Thanks to the noble intention of respected ComradeKim Jong Unto make our people enjoy a civilized life, the pondside park well-matched to a modern city came into being in the Hwasong area. -0-

headline: Dynamic Mass Technological Innovation Movement
Profitable Kumyagang Power Station No. 2
story_text:
One day in May 2019, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the Kumyagang Power Station No. 2. After arriving at the power station, he went to its dam together with officials.
Commanding a bird's-eye view of the dam at the post for monitoring its sluice gate, the General Secretary said with great satisfaction that it was wonderful and profitable power station. He was very pleased to see the reservoir filled with water even in the dry season. And he told the officials that his visit was aimed to build many small- and medium-sized power stations, and taught them that the hydro-power stations should be built like the Kumyagang Power Station No. 2.
The officials came to realize his intention of visiting a small power station in a local county.
Shortly afterwards, the General Secretary noted that he gave an instruction on enlisting hydroelectric resources of the whole country to the maximum as it is important to make effective use of them.
When he reached the open space behind the power station, he looked at the sluice gate of the dam, saying that the power station was built well and its surrounding environment and volume of water are all right and it is a profitable one.
This valuable appraisal reflected his earnest requests that officials should make a concrete plan to make effective use of hydroelectric resources in their regions, if they are to build a power station. -0-

headline: Educational Foundations Consolidated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) -- After the 14th National Conference of Teachers, the educational structure in the DPRK has improved and the teaching force strengthened. Hundreds of integrated schools, more than 1 630 schools, over 1 590 branch schools and over 1 100 kindergartens were newly built or modernized across the country.
The Ministry of Education and relevant units have striven to make ours the most superior and ideal education, and the whole society has given active support to the education sector. Against this backdrop, the overall educational foundations of the country were further consolidated.
Progress was made in the project for improving the country's educational structure in a rational and efficient way and further raising the level of educational contents and methods to give students more advanced and practical education.
The active operation of the online education system has contributed to implementing the plan for making all the people well versed in science and technology.
The education sector has produced a large number of those who won the title of the country's ten best teachers, best scientists and the February 16 Science and Technology Prize every year.
And many educational institutions were newly built and modernly remodeled amid a nation-wide campaign to consolidate the material and technical foundations of education.
The establishment of the private network for education sector makes a contribution to the educational work in the whole area, and educational aid program centers have been built in Pyongyang and every province to provide bases for making education modern and IT-based. -0-

headline: Folk Customs of DPRK Seen in September
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) -- In September there are Paekro and Chubun, ones of the 24 seasonal divisions of the year in the lunar calendar, in the DPRK.
Paekro means the beginning of autumn and Chubun means the middle part of autumn.
On the day of Chubun, the length of the day and the night is almost the same, and from that day on the night is gaining.
This year Paekro and Chubun fall on September 7 and 23 respectively.
September is harvest time.
In this month there is a typical folk holiday called Chusok (Harvest Moon Day, Hangawi). This year's Chusok is September 25.
From olden times our people hold a memorial service with food made of new crop of the year before the tombs of their ancestors on the occasion of Chusok. This is a reflection of the noble beautiful manners and customs of our courteous and faithful people who respect their elders.
The dishes of Chusok are varied and tasteful.
Among them is half-moon-shaped rice cake, and various folk games such as wrestling, swinging and tug of war are popular on the day. -0-

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 2 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsent a birthday spread to Kim Sun Mae, a woman centenarian living in Neighborhood Unit No. 1, Hanchon-dong, Kim Chaek City, North Hamgyong Province of the DPRK, on her 100th birthday.

During the Fatherland Liberation War, she took the lead in supporting the front. She did her job devotedly for decades and brought her children up to be fine soldiers and builders. Even after becoming a pensioner, she has worked for the prosperity and development of the country. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong Un's Loving Care and Trust in Educators

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong Un's Speech at Opening Meeting of 15th National Conference of Teachers
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 3 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the opening meeting of the 15th National Conference of Teachers.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Comrade educators who have entered the venue of this significant conference with the unusual pride and honour of bringing up the younger generations of our country,
I attach importance to the work of this conference now with a feeling and expectations that are clearly different from those I have at other conferences and sectoral short courses.
It is an unquestionable fact and our consistent principle that the education work is the most important state affair that cannot and should not lag behind the work of any other fields.
I am really pleased to take this opportunity to directly offer you once again a greeting of deep respect I have always wanted to pay to the benevolent persons who are fostering the growth of the dear descendants of the country.
As I have come face to face with you like this, I am filled with gratitude to you at the thought that the talented personnel, who are a source of pride for the country and resourcefulness for the people, are growing up and the beauty and mightiness of this country are being given steady continuity thanks to many educators like you.
Respected teachers,
I think this way.
If there is anything in the world that can be put alongside the sacred and noble appellation of mother, it is probably that of teacher.
There is no more precious and valuable title in the world than that of mother and teacher.
Where mothers give children life, our teachers are just the benefactors who nurture and train them.
The mother's right is not granted by anyone, but the appellation of teacher is a qualification and honour one is granted for voluntarily choosing the occupation of an educator who rears and leads those who are born on this land to be true persons and for fulfilling one's duty.
I genuinely take off my hat and I am deeply impressed whenever I think how many stories the teachers have kept to themselves while teaching, and how many nights they have stayed up for teaching, since the sacred appellation is not defended by any others, but should be defended by themselves.
Teachers care for every aspect of students’ studies and life, as well as imparting of knowledge to and moral education for them who are different from one another in aspiration, personality, taste, family background and everything, and the trouble the teachers take through the eventful and busy daily routine is as immeasurably enormous as the pains taken by mothers who bring up their children, and nobody can go to such trouble in place of teachers.
Our educators reliably support the future affairs of the country by devoting everything, even the love that should be shown to their beloved children, families, parents and siblings, to their students, and they regard it as their mission and duty.  They are respected by all the people across the country as their life is an exemplar of the most beautiful and ennobling patriotism.
As they have followed in their meticulous mind the footprints their disciples leave at hundreds or thousands of jobs and posts, they sometimes might have shed tears of deep sorrow over the death of their disciples who fell in battle, and subsequently their hair turned grey and their faces got deep wrinkles earlier than usual. Their tears touch my heart and I face them with greater respect.
Each of the heroes who laid down their precious lives to carry out the orders of their country and defend its honour, the outstandingly talented personnel who brought dignity to powerful Korea through the arduous journey of research and the faithful and patriotic meritorious persons supporting the country at factories, coal mines and farm fields all their life with immaculately pure conscience, must be the disciple of an excellent teacher.
But none of the teachers have shared their disciples' honour although they have put their heart and soul into the guidance of them since their childhood.
And few people know or ask who taught them and how great the services their teachers rendered for their successful career were.
As they have selflessly devoted themselves to their disciples' development without expecting any reward, the teachers have never thought of, or tried to take, their share in their old students' feats: for the sole reason that they used to be their students, the teachers take great pleasure and pride of life.
Teachers are the benefactors all other people in this country owe heartfelt thanks, and the best of the patriots who deserve to be put on the high platform of honour, which we build with such a deep emotion, before anyone else.
This is the true profile of the educators of our country that everyone ought to know, remember and hold in the highest respect.
Availing myself of this meaningful opportunity, I would like to offer the highest tribute and thanks to all educational workers across the country who chose the honourable yet challenging career of teacher for themselves and keep their sacred posts with an ennobling sense of responsibility and by dint of their lofty personality.
Also, I extend warm thanks and encouragement to all the educators of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) who, as champions of the right to national education, stoutly bring up the rising generations of the Korean community and Chongryon with their invariable patriotic-minded determination and resolute struggle in the alien land.
And I highly appreciate exemplary support organizations and officials who are making all unsparing, sincere efforts to strengthen the educational foundations true to the Party’s educational policy.
The venue of this conference is now overflowing with sincere wishes from not only the students, disciples and their parents but also all families in this country that have relations with schools.
This is because the teachers are entrusted with the task of training the beloved children and the descendants who will be born and grow without interruption will be trained by them.
We are now etching the 15th grand meeting of teachers in the history of its kind, but I do not think that any of the previous conferences is on a par with the current one as the teachers have greeted it honourably and proudly with the priceless fruits dedicated to the country and the achievements recognized by their fellow people.
When changes and innovations are taking place in all sectors as our socialist construction is in the period of unprecedented transformation, the educational sector is undergoing a truly dramatic change in the wide realm of system and structure, content and method, conditions and environment, and public interest and support.
Considering that the qualitative change, which presents a sharp contrast between the past and the present, has taken place in only a few years, instead of in one decade or two, it can be called a revolution.
It is just you, participants in this conference, and all other educators across the country who opened the prelude to a gigantic transformation aimed at creating the most advanced education and have elevated education to today’s level in the present era of pursuing still higher civilization.
Truly ennobling and laudable are the patriotic enthusiasm, sense of mission for the times and communist traits that our educators have displayed in the effort to achieve the goal and milestone of building an educational power and a talented nation, as planned by the Workers’ Party of Korea.
As it is the first-ever, unprecedentedly ambitious goal after our country’s founding, the educators must have faced many unfamiliar, formidable tasks to deal with, and often found themselves almost crumbling in exhaustion, but they have been paving their way strenuously to this day in the face of difficulties with the resolution and enthusiasm to attain the goal at all costs.
I believe anyone present here has unforgettable stories of those days and honourable memories of their hard work which is worth being regarded as happiness and pride of life.
The traits and qualities cultivated, and the experience and lessons learned with great efforts through trying ordeals, are truly invaluable as they will serve as strong support for successes in the revolution which will continue hereafter.
Our Party and country derive the greatest source of their strength from the ranks of revolutionary teachers who have an ennobling spirit, high intelligence and firm self-confidence.
Comrades,
Education acts as a bridge which links the past of a country and nation with its present and future by dint of spirit and knowledge.
In fact, thanks to the consistent policy of attaching importance to education and the advantageous socialist educational system, we have written a glorious history and come to demonstrate such dignity and national power as of today and are making a vigorous advance towards a more prosperous and powerful future.
Our education has trained and put forward powerful forces that cherish the revolutionary ideology and spirit of patriotism which remain unchanged even with the passage of time and that are possessed of noble ethics and morality and comprehensive knowledge. Its baton should be firmly carried forward in the future, too.
The future of this country can be entrusted only to the talented personnel who have embodied the great history and traditions of the country and the people, who have absorbed the intelligence and civilization attained by mankind, who cherish an ambition to make their country powerful and rich, and who possess the abilities to realize it.
At present, our education sector is going through a very responsible and critical stage.
From this year our education, based on the success achieved in the course of implementing the first universal 12-year compulsory education programme, is implementing the second programme, and the higher education sector has definitely entered a stage of evolution, different from the previous ones.
At this point of time when our education is taking a new course, only when every work directly linked with educational development is planned in a far-sighted way and implemented to the letter, can we reach the level we set, while adding greater resilience to state building.
The correct effort for education is the investment in the future, a stepping stone for future development, and a guarantee for everything we pursue as an ideal.
We have so far laid the foundation to attain the goal we set for placing our education in the front rank of the world. From now on, we should produce the definite fruit to present the clear full picture of the most advanced and excellent education, and surely succeed in the educational revolution in the new era which we launched with determination for the future of the country and the revolution.
In this sense, it can be said that this conference has been convened at a very appropriate time, as it will analyze and review the overall educational work and discuss the practical issues for spurring the new qualitative development of education.
Comrade educators,
It is the ideal and will of our Party to make ours the best education that everyone is envious of and wants to get, the world-class education that dynamically leads the effort for achieving the prosperity of the country.
The Party and the state have entrusted the important affair decisive of the future of the country to you, comrades, our teachers.
Educators are the designers and builders of the mainstay of the state and the revolution and the motive force of the educational revolution.
When they remain faithful to their duty with an awareness that every teaching plan and every second and every minute of the lessons and lectures they give serve as the light illuminating the future and the nourishment for growing a large number of talented personnel, the educational revolution in the new era will get an ever stronger driving force with each passing day.
Students' performances at school are evaluated by their teachers but the latter’s achievements are measured by the footprints of their students’ life.
Educators should be the teachers who train new generations to be the pillars, who will shoulder the future of the country, by dint of their noble personality traits that will remain forever as a textbook of genuine life and their academic prestige every student truly admires and appreciates.
Schools may be different in campus size and number of students, but all our schools should train all the students of new generations to be faithful and kind-hearted persons who will become the pillars of the country and a source of pride of their families.
If our educators take care of and lead all their students with affection of a mother who devotes more sincerity to a bad child than a good one, then we will feel at ease about the future.
Comrades,
The value of education, the soil where the country’s best resources grow and the motive force of national development, cannot be measured in terms of money.
I reaffirm that education is the most important state affair and educators should be held in higher esteem than anyone else.
Many undertakings are being carried out in wide realms and lots of them require a great deal of effort. However, our Party and state will make unsparing efforts and show devotion to lead the progress of education and to support the teaching platform you are standing on.
I feel infinite strength and courage to push forward with the sacred cause of educational revolution from the passion pervading this venue and your dignified manner.
As trustworthy teachers like you are taking charge of our education, it will be everlasting as the cradle that brings dignity and mightiness to the country and a base for shaping a prosperous and civilized future.
I repeatedly request all our educators to fulfil their sacred mission and defend their blessed appellation amid boundless respect and affection of all the fellow people of this country.
Fully convinced that this conference will achieve great success that all the people ardently expect and hope for, I declare the 15th National Conference of Teachers open. -0-

headline: Significant Greeting to Educators

headline: 15th National Conference of Teachers Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 3 (KCNA) -- The 15th National Conference of Teachers opened with splendor in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on Wednesday at a historic time when the educational revolution for turning our state into the most advanced country in education across the world has been intensified at a new high stage under the original idea of the Workers' Party of Korea on attaching importance to education and under its wise guidance.
The conference, convened amid the special concern of the Party and the government regarding the training of the rising generation and talents as the most important affair of the revolution and the great expectation of all the people, constitutes an essential and responsible process for successfully attaining the grand goals set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK before the educational sector, including the thorough implementation of the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme.
The conference will analyze and review in depth the implementation of the Party's educational policy for the past seven years after the 14th National Conference of Teachers and discuss the realistic issues for promoting the new qualitative development of our education.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the conference.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared at the venue of the conference, the participants raised stormy cheers.
All the participants paid the highest tribute and glory to the outstanding leader, the great teacher who is ushering in a brilliant heyday of development of the Juche-oriented education with his distinguished idea and leadership and ardent love for the rising generation.
Present at the conference were exemplary educators from across the country, leading personnel in the field of education from Pyongyang and local areas, officials of relevant units and members of the delegation of educators of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon).
Its platform was taken by senior Party and government officials, chief secretaries of provincial committees of the WPK, leading officials of major educational institutions, exemplary teachers and educational workers, officials of the sponsoring organizations and the head of the Chongryon delegation of educators.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a significant speech to open the conference.
The educational work is the state's top-priority affair as it cannot and must not be placed after any other affairs and this is indisputable truth and our consistent principle, he said, expressing his pleasure of personally conveying the expectation of the WPK Central Committee attaching special importance to the current conference and extending the warm respectful greetings he always wanted to offer the teachers.
Mothers give birth to their children, but our teachers are beneficent ones who bring the children up to be nice ones, he noted, and extended the warmest respects and thanks to all the educators of the country and the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan who have been working as honorable teachers with high sense of responsibility and noble personality since they chose the glorious yet difficult career as educators of their own accord.
He said that the national conference of teachers was held 15 times until now but there was no such conference as the present one our educators greet proudly with the priceless fruits presented to the country and successes recognized by the people, praising the reality of the educational sector in which remarkable changes have been made just for a few years, not ten or twenty years, in such vast ranges as the system, structure, contents and methods, conditions and environment, social concern and support.
He once again expressed the ideal and will of the Party to make ours the world's best education which all other peoples admire and want to receive and which can help to dynamically lead the efforts to achieve the national prosperity, and the deep trust in all the educators who are designers and builders for the long-term development of the country and the revolution and the driving force of the educational revolution. And he declared the opening of the conference with his confidence in its success.
The participants burst into stormy cheers, out of their boundless reverence and gratitude to ComradeKim Jong Unwho shows great trust and love for the teachers, putting them forward as true patriots cultivating the future of the country to the envy of the world.
The national anthem of the DPRK was played.
A congratulatory group of the Korean Children's Union entered the venue to recite a congratulatory poem.
At the end of the recitation, the venue was overflowing with great excitement of the participants again.
Expressing his conviction of the successful conference once again, ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly encouraged all the participants.
The venue was filled with the boundless pride of the participants glorifying the honor of soldiers and committed revolutionaries standing at the forefront of the talent education in the great era of transformation.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, made a report.
He said that the past seven years since the 14th National Conference of Teachers are the proud annals which witnessed a radical change and remarkable progress in education along with the powerful trend towards ushering in a great golden age of the DPRK true to the outstanding ideology of respected ComradeKim Jong Unand under his leadership.
He noted that ComradeKim Jong Un, who holds up talented persons and science and technology as the main strategic resources and the most powerful motive force of self-sustenance and self-development, comprehensively clarified the tasks of teachers to implement the Party's policy on bringing about a radical turn in education. He added that at the 8th Congress of the WPK, ComradeKim Jong Unset it as the general goal of education to develop education to the extent that it can be entrusted with guaranteeing the future of the country and clearly indicated the principle and ways for carrying out the revolution in education.
The reporter said that according to the steadfast will and determination of the WPK Central Committee which values each process and chain of the educational work as the affair for the eternal prosperity of the country and the revolution, the education was placed high on the agenda at important Party and state meetings and policies were adopted to dynamically make a turning point in the educational revolution.
He referred to the wise leadership and undying feats of ComradeKim Jong Un, who set it forth as the main task of the educational sector to improve the structure, contents and methods of education and as a prerequisite for the development of education to build up the ranks of teachers, took practical measures to this end and made sure that the work for improving the educational conditions and environment was pushed forward in all spheres including the capital city, regions and urban and rural areas on a large scale.
The reporter noted that all educators across the country have led a worthwhile and happy life under the care of ComradeKim Jong Un, who highly praises the teachers devoting all their wisdom and energy to education as true patriots and meritorious persons and puts them on the platform of glory.
Saying that ComradeKim Jong Unis the outstanding leader ushering in a heyday of the development of education with his noblest outlook on the younger generation and future and with his far-sighted view and wise leadership and bringing earlier the rosy future of our powerful and prosperous state, the reporter reviewed the remarkable successes achieved in the educational sector over the past seven years under the care of the WPK Central Committee.
It is the immutable truth confirmed in the course spanning seven years that we can turn the DPRK into a world-class educational power and a talent power only when we remain faithful to the unique idea of the WPK Central Committee on attaching importance to education and its wise leadership, he said and extended the highest glory and deep gratitude to respected ComradeKim Jong Un, reflecting the unanimous mind of all educators across the country.
The report pointed to a series of deviations.
The reporter recalled that the Ninth Congress of the WPK set forth it as the goal of the education during the new long-term plan to scrupulously train all students to be useful talents contributing to the revolutionary practice, decisively reduce the difference in the educational level between urban and rural areas and perfect the overall educational foundation of the country in a modern way, and referred to the tasks for attaining the goal.
The reporter referred to the intention and determination of the WPK Central Committee to make the world recognize that the DPRK is the country giving top priority to education and the most advanced country in education, and called upon all the participants to attain without fail the goal of the educational development set forth by the Ninth Congress of the WPK, with the noble consciousness that they are those in direct charge of bringing about a radical improvement in education and soldiers standing at the forefront of talent training, and with the patriotic attitude, redoubled passion and efforts and thus dynamically usher in the period of making a leap forward in building an education power.
Then followed speeches.
The conference is going on successfully amid high political enthusiasm of all the participants honored to receive high appreciation and credit given by the WPK Central Committee. -0-

headline: National Sculpture and Craftwork Festival Opens in DPRK
Sci-tech Presentations and Symposium Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 4 (KCNA) -- A national sci-tech presentation in the field of green architecture and a national sci-tech presentation and symposium in the field of mining industry took place on Sep. 2 and 3 respectively.
The national sci-tech presentation in the field of green architecture was sponsored by the Korean Green Architectural Society of the C.C., General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Papers submitted by the Green Architecture Institute of the State Academy of Sciences, Pyongyang University of Architecture and the Paektusan Institute of Architecture won a high appreciation at the presentation as they are practically helpful to the development of green architecture.
During the presentation, there were technical lectures on the roof greening method for public buildings and the green building materials evaluation system.
The national sci-tech presentation in the field of mining industry was sponsored by the Korean Mining Industry Association of the C.C., General Federation of Science and Technology of Korea. Submitted to it were more than 120 valuable papers on putting the production on a normal footing at some mines, realizing the home production of new mining equipment and measuring equipment, protecting the ecological environment and establishing energy-, manpower- and cost-saving production lines.
The symposium discussed the realistic and reasonable ways for developing the field of mining industry, including research and introduction of the latest science and technology. -0-

headline: 15th National Conference of Teachers Closes
story_text:

They noted that they persistently pushed ahead with the improvement of the overall educational conditions and environment in their regions as part of the work of their Party committees to remodel the educational facilities befitting the ones in the era of comprehensive development, and made a remarkable progress in implementing the Party's policy on bringing about a radical turn in education through the devoted efforts to better the working and living conditions of educators.

headline: Participants in 15th National Conference of Teachers Take Short Course
Increased Solar Power Generation Capacity in South Hwanghae Province
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 4 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, South Hwanghae Province is conducting a mass campaign to solve the problem of electricity by using natural energy sources.
Recently, thousands of kilowatts of solar power generation capacity have been newly created in the province.
In July, the province organized a demonstration of integrated solar charge inverter with a capacity of tens of kilowatts in use in several units.
Many institutions, enterprises and leisure facilities in the province have attained electricity self-sufficiency by creating the solar power generation capacity.
The solar power generation systems were set up on roofs of many high-rise apartment buildings and low- and single-storied dwelling houses in urban and rural areas. The number of households using the systems is on the increase. -0-

headline: 15th National Conference of Teachers Closes
Participants in 15th National Conference of Teachers Take Short Course
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 4 (KCNA) -- The participants in the 15th National Conference of Teachers received a short course on September 3.
Kim Sung Du, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Sung Guk, vice-premier of the Cabinet, and Ri Yong Chol, minister of Education, gave them the short course.
The short course dealt with an issue arising in implementing to the letter the Party's educational policy of training all the students to be strong talented persons who will make a contribution to the revolutionary practice.
One of the lecturers stressed that our Party's policy on education is a great action program as it makes it possible to successfully attain the main goal of the educational revolution in the new century by bringing about a fresh turn in training talented persons and placing our education on a higher level in keeping with the requirement of the era for comprehensive development.
He also called on all the teachers to be fully aware that education requires conscience, devotion and patriotism, to fully prepare themselves as a true professional revolutionary with the noble traits which will always serve as an example of a genuine life, and to become a genuine teacher always respected and remembered by the disciples and a model teacher whose example is followed by students.
The short course also dealt with the ways of fundamentally eliminating the differences in educational level between the capital city and provinces and between urban and rural areas as required by the era of the comprehensive development of socialism.
The other lecturer stressed the need for all the educational workers to draw up scientific and workable plans for raising the educational level of the local and rural areas and carry out them to the letter, bearing in mind that it is their own important job to train talented persons who are capable of propelling the development of the relevant areas.
Another subject of the short course was to push ahead with the work to perfectly modernize all the educational foundations of the country.
A lecturer appealed to all the officials to be well aware of the important measures taken by the state to radically consolidate the material and technical foundations of the educational sector and fulfill their responsibility and duty in perfecting the educational foundations.
The participants heard the good deeds and experience of the units that have remained true to the Party's educational policy by dedicating their sincere efforts to strengthening the educational foundations as devoted parents of students and sponsors with a sense of duty that they share the same responsibility for education with educators. The short course referred to the measures to be taken to give full play to the social trait of treating teachers preferentially and render material and moral assistance to the educational sector. -0-

headline: Maize Harvest Promoted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) -- Agricultural officials and workers in the DPRK are now busy with the maize harvest.
Under the intensive guidance of officials of the Agricultural Commission and agricultural guidance organs at all levels, the farms are concentrating the workforce and means on reaping maize and taking measures to prevent maize from being lost and from decaying during the transport and storage.
Agricultural workers in South Hwanghae Province are reaping maize in thousands of hectares of fields every day.
The farms in North Phyongan Province have drawn up detailed daily plans for every field and every variety and carried them out now that various processes of farm work are being conducted at the same time.
South Phyongan Province sets the right harvest time according to the features of all the fields and rationalizes manpower allotment to push ahead with the maize harvest.
Agricultural workers in Pyongyang and Nampho municipalities are meeting the requirements for carrying and drying maize while reaping more maize. -0-

headline: Development of Juche-oriented Education
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) -- PresidentKim Il Sungmade public the immortal classic work"Theses on Socialist Education"on September 5, 1977.
The work comprehensively deals with all problems arising in education, including the basic principles of pedagogy and the contents and methods of socialist education.
The publication of the theses was an epoch-making event that brought about a new turning point in the development of education in the DPRK.
True to the noble intention of respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unto train the rising generations into reliable pillars of the socialist country, the DPRK's education is now writing a proud history of its development as the most advantageous and ideal one that can be entrusted with guaranteeing the future of the country.
The universal 12-year compulsory education has been enforced, the optional curriculum and the system of voluntarily selecting subjects introduced at senior middle schools and the educational contents put on a more concrete, diversified and practical basis. Like this, a great change has been made in the education of the DPRK.
Amid the nationwide and social attention and support, many school buildings have been newly built across the country and education has been put on an IT and modern basis to radically improve the appearance of educational institutions. And the tele-education system was established to consolidate the solid foundation for making all the people well versed in science and technology.
Schoolchildren's palaces, children's camps and primary and middle schools for orphans were successfully built in different parts of the country. And homemade school uniforms, things, bags and shoes are supplied to the schoolchildren across the country. This is the proud reality that can be found only in the socialist system of the DPRK which gives priority to education and puts it forward as the first state affair.
The DPRK brings earlier the future of a powerful socialist country and guarantees the eternal future by making a new turn in education. It is developing into an educational power and talent power with each passing day. -0-

headline: Custom of Utilizing Blueberries in Area of Mt Paektu
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 5 (KCNA) -- From olden times the Korean people have widely used blueberry, a local specialty in the area of Mt Paektu, for their diet and medical treatment.
The Korean people have preferred to eat the raw blueberry as it has high nutritional value and pharmacological efficacy. And the processed products including wine, syrup and jelly, and medicines like a cough drop, obstruent and hemostatic, which were made from the blueberry, have also been popular among them.
The blueberry is a deciduous shrub which grows 30-40 centimeters high or 1.2 meters high to the maximum in high mountainous areas including the Paektu Plateau and Piro Peak of Mt Kumgang.
Its bark is grey brown, its young branches are hairy and its leaves are 0.9-3 centimeters long. The surface of the leaf is green and its back is light white.
Its flowers bloom between in late June and late July. Various shapes of its fruits ripen from late July to late September and they are dark purple.
The blueberry is usually propagated by seeds, roots, and branches.
The custom of utilizing the blueberry was registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage in February 2026. -0-

headline: Happy Cause of Anxiety
story_text:
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm in May 2026.
Looking round hydroponic and soil greenhouses of different shapes and hothouses for experimental culture, he acquainted himself in detail with production and vegetable science research at the farm and its management.
He said with a broad smile on his face that the farm is fantastic. The manager of the farm told him that the farm reaps hundreds of tons of vegetables of scores of kinds at the greenhouses every day and supplies them to orphanages, baby homes, primary schools for orphans and commercial units on a regular basis, and thus contributes to improving the local people's diet.
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unexpressed his great satisfaction with it.
Then officials of the farm vied with each other in proudly telling him that all the hothouses are full of vegetables and they can not dispose of them in time.
He burst into laughter and called it a happy cause of anxiety.
The officials were deeply moved by what he said.
The phrase happy cause of anxiety could be created only by the deep revolutionary moral world of the respected Comrade General Secretary who regards it as the happiness and the greatest honor to make painstaking efforts for his people. And the farm's success was the precious fruit of the great painstaking efforts of the respected Comrade General Secretary who brings a flower into bloom even on a rock for his people. -0-

headline: Quality of Products Improved at Regional-industry Factories in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 6 (KCNA) -- Newly-built regional-industry factories and factories producing school uniforms, shoes and bags have actively shared and transferred advanced technology to increase the varieties of products and improve their qualities.
The Pukchang, Sinyang, Songchon and Kilju county foodstuff factories are boosting production by introducing inventions to improve the quality of goods.
The Unsan County Garment Factory raised the utility rate of equipment by 1.5 times to increase the production of clothes.  Technicians and skilled workers of the Kujong County Garment Factory invented and introduced various kinds of jigs and equipment to improve the quality of products.
The Kangdong County Daily Necessities Factory established a new shampoo and rinse production process and increased the rotational speed of screws in the soap production process, thus increasing the production.
The Pyongyang, Phyongsong and Hamhung school uniform factories put the production on a scientific and modern basis by installing more digital sewing machines and steam generators.
The Pyongyang Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory has made successes by upgrading the shoe-making process and the Sariwon Schoolchildren's Footwear Factory has updated the performance of equipment to ensure quality in the production of shoes.
The Wonsan Disabled Soldiers' Bag Factory installed various kinds of new equipment and established a scientific mass-based quality control system, thus further improving the quality of schoolbags. -0-
