topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong Un's Speech at Commissioning Ceremony of Destroyer Kang Kon
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech at the commissioning ceremony of the destroyer Kang Kon.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Admirable workers of Chongjin and Rajin shipyards and talented persons of the technical teams in the shipbuilding and defence science sectors,
Sailors of the destroyer Kang Kon and brave officers and other sailors of our Navy,
Dear Wonsan citizens,
Comrades,
Today we are greeting another noteworthy moment in the course of our advance for accelerating the buildup of our powerful naval forces.
Three months ago, the destroyer Choe Hyon sounded a whistle of its commissioning on the West Sea of Korea, and today a ceremony for commissioning another destroyer is being held in splendour here on the East Sea of Korea.
This is a remarkable reality that showcases the speed of change of our Navy.
I would like, first of all, to pay my heartfelt tribute to the workers of Chongjin and Rajin and the sci-tech teams in the shipbuilding and defence industry sectors who have unsparingly devoted their patriotic sweat and passion for this significant day of etching new coordinates in the course of strengthening our maritime sovereignty in the new era.
Comrades,
The excitement and emotion I feel today is beyond description as a ceremony that injects new strength into our Navy is being held not anywhere else but at this historic port.
If there is a most heart-gladdening and emotive historic moment in the history of building our nation and our armed forces, that will be today.
In this September, 81 years ago, the ranks led by ComradeKim Il Sunglanded here at Wonsan Port by a warship on a triumphant return to their country which they had so missed.
Mooring now at the harbour, where the Kaeson put into on that historic day, is a destroyer of a new generation that gives a glimpse into our naval capability and its development.
At the port, where the anchor of national liberation was dropped with a cheerful dream, our destroyer will raise its anchor with a far-reaching ambition of sailing to the ocean.
From this very moment, not just in the near future, that powerful naval combat complex will put out to sea to defend the national sovereignty and write the first page of its log, reflecting the desire of the great people.
As the great ambition for a prosperous country with a strong army harboured by the small Kaeson is now to be carried forward to the vast ocean by this ultramodern warship at this very memorable port, this emotion will remain in my memory forever.
I am really glad to share this historic emotion with you comrades.
The forerunners, who, at this port, stepped on the soil of their country, are not here now, but they would share their desire with us today, I am sure.
The primary significance of the commissioning of the Kang Kon, held in splendour in the meaningful September, is that we are proudly raising the anchor of building a maritime power at the place where the anchor of national liberation was dropped.
Today this port has gained a new significance as a historic place, where the warships of our Republic will raise anchor one after another to defend our national sovereignty and security in every way, and as an area, which will exhibit the uninterrupted improvement of our naval combat capability.
Comrades,
We are now seeing historic things symbolically showing the past and present of our naval combat capability.
That warship at the quay by the museum over there is just the Kaeson.
That warship represents our past and this one before us, our present.
Nothing can explain more impressively than this what turn has been brought about now by a history in which it was impossible to hold the esteemed man, benevolent liberator of a country and nation and founder of a state, in all respect and sincerity.
What we should pay attention to is that a more important thing than this historical comparison or the dramatic contrast that is clearly visible is the fact that such a change has been made in only two or three years.
As I have already stated, the workers, scientists and technicians of our generation have accomplished the thing, which had failed to be done for nearly 80 years since the founding of our Navy, with the enthusiastic support of all the people and amid their expectations.
Modernization of the naval armaments has always been an essential requirement for the geopolitical factors of our state, and the efforts of the Korean people desirous of a powerful navy have never stopped, but until a few years ago our Navy failed to have warships commensurate with its mission and military achievements.
Of course, it may also be attributed to the military and strategic demands of the past and present times, but this is not the only reason.
To tell the truth, this is related with our history.
It reflects the peculiarities and arduousness of our revolution and the history of hardship which we were compelled to experience inevitably for that, and contains a myriad of stories beyond what we know and have seen.
It is by no means easy to arm the Navy this much under the situation in which everything is difficult as it is now.
But by transcending everything, we evaluated the needs of history and the present times with a responsible attitude and viewpoint towards the thoroughgoing security of the present and future, and valiantly confronted challenges in our own way of calculation.
Such attitude and new awareness doubled the self-consciousness and sense of mission of our generation never to pass over to the coming generations the great historic cause of building a powerful navy in line with the position of a maritime nation that is bounded by the sea on both sides.
The course of naval modernization can be said to be a process of adhering to the principle of bringing ability in step with a goal set by the times, instead of setting a goal based on the calculation of ability, and a process of attaining the goal without compromise or delay under any circumstances.
But for the viewpoint, stand, courage and calculation method that there should be the will to attain an aim before a guarantee for the attainment of it is provided, our Navy would have still remained in the past.
Our future cannot be bought with financial resources.
We are a people who cannot wait.
The Kang Kon is a manifestation of the sense of self-respect and will of this Korea and the crystallization of its indomitable spirit to defend its rights and interests, before being an ensemble of our economic, defence and sci-tech strength.
The commissioning of the new-type destroyer here today will be an important occasion for redoubling our will of, and our motive power for, transformation amid genuine recollection.
Comrades,
Our Navy has eagerly waited for the moment when a new-type destroyer of ours would leave its wake just here on the East Sea, not elsewhere.
Today we are witnessing with our own eyes how the aspirations and dreams the Korean people have cherished for ages are coming true.
In the past, because of the limitations of our military equipment, we had no other alternative but to leave the enemy warships move rampantly around our territorial waters as they wanted, although we had such great courage and mettle to defend the seas of our country firmly. Such a thing of the past shall never be repeated.
The security of our country is exposed to constant and direct threats from all sides–on the land, in the air and on the sea–and the first and foremost of them is what comes from the East Sea of Korea and the neighbouring waters.
No waters can be found around any other country than ours where warships of the belligerents appear any time to move and deploy nuclear assets and conduct joint war rehearsals freely, using our waters as a theatre for tracking and inhibiting even our legitimate exercise of the right to self-defence.
These days we have often witnessed here the tireless efforts of our enemies to improve their readiness for war against us.
Our national security is now under serious threat posed by the open hostile military actions of the enemies to wreck the regional stability.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea can never allow such phenomena to go unheeded any longer.
Dangerous shadows must be removed as early as possible.
We must cope with these threats resolutely by employing quite a professional and overwhelming power, with a willingness to use it and a sufficient ability for it.
In this sense, the commissioning of the Kang Kon has virtually incomparable significance, although it is identical in terms of class and weaponry to the Choe Hyon which was already delivered to the West Sea Fleet.
The proclamation of the commissioning of this virtually attack destroyer itself is enough to inform the world of our views and attitudes.
The fact that the warship has officially been commissioned to the naval group on the East Sea, and the information that naval bases are under construction on the East Sea will give a clear signal to the enemies, who will inevitably find themselves in deep distress.
It is high time we exercised our sovereignty properly both on and under the sea.
We have become able to use stronger and more deadly power.
We will exercise the legitimate right to self-defence and respond as much as necessary.
The results of our views and efforts are successfully preventing the geopolitical threat from the enemies.
We need to change faster.
As I mentioned at the previous commissioning ceremony for the Choe Hyon, the change of our Navy does not simply mean that its vessels are becoming larger and that the shipborne weapons systems are getting further modernized.
The most important change and the most significant progress worth mentioning is that it is a source of the greatest fear for the enemies.
It means that the programme of equipping our Navy with nuclear weapons has been realized so as to become more suitable, diversified and practical for the use of their deterrence.
By further bolstering up the powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent, we should develop for an actual war the multifaceted and efficient operation of nuclear combat systems and make clearer the military activities for maritime defence and war deterrence.
It is the constitutional duty of the armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to safeguard the absolute security of the state, maintain the strategic stability and the balance of forces in the region and contain geopolitical threats.
The responsible activities and important role of our Navy will strictly restrain the enemies' aggressive fleets and surely result in forcing them to make a strategic retreat.
As was proved yesterday and is proved today, there is no other option for safeguarding peace than maintaining the balance of forces.
Our stand is clear.
We should make the enemies fear us.
Only when the enemies fear us, can they never dare provoke us, and can we defend the peace and development environment of our country.
In order to cope thoroughly with the existing, lurking and prospective threats, we must continue to build up overwhelming military muscle.
I emphasize once again.
We will deploy the most powerful strategic assets in the most important waters in order to show our principled and responsible will to defend the maritime sovereignty of our Republic, the security environment in Northeast Asia and the global peace, and also make a great contribution to this end.
Comrades,
Our state's security and our national interests have never been separated from the defence of maritime sovereignty, and a powerful navy is a stout pillar for national defence and a reliable means for exercising national sovereignty.
Like the goals all maritime countries pursue, we must put the modernized naval weapons systems on the axis for deterring and fighting a war so as to defend today and the future.
We should make the world know what we are doing and how we are preparing ourselves to defend our rights and interests with a bolder decision and a faster and perfect result.
The appellation for the strong and for a power in the 21st century can be obtained only by making ceaseless efforts and can be won without any regret only by bringing about vigorous innovations and upsurge.
Our massive plans include the building and commissioning of warships of various types which are compatible with the two aspects of war deterrence and fighting of war and which can satisfy such needs, the modernization of shipyards and the construction of infrastructure, the reorganization of the naval forces and the establishment of new units. These are great undertakings our generation must accomplish without fail.
We should make clearer our courageous stance and efforts to implement these tasks of the present times and push ahead with them at top speed.
Today marks another new start in the relay which should continue uninterruptedly.
We are now carrying out an important plan for the buildup of the naval forces.
I will prove this to the world once again eight months later.
Comrades,
Our warships going out to wider waters must sail across the boundless ocean valiantly at full throttle.
Let us dash unremittingly until we can satisfy our steadfast will to defend our national sovereignty and lofty self-respect.
Commanding officers and other sailors of the destroyer Kang Kon,
You will soon be assigned with a strategic mission.
It is because this warship is a means and force included in the country's nuclear counteraction system.
You ought to play an important role through your responsible service.
As the first crewmen of the destroyer, you, with the pride and mettle of standing in the most responsible position in safeguarding the country, should prepare and train yourselves thoroughly to perform various tasks in different circumstances and in this way you can record only victorious battles in the history of the destroyer.
If our enemies dare to have recourse to armed force against us, I will order you to use our absolute strength, which would deal the most fatal blow to them.
You must deal an annihilating retaliatory strike to the enemies if such an order is issued at any time.
The professionalism and bravery you would display and the unlimited strength you have possessed will further boost the fighting efficiency and fame of our East Sea Fleet.
I hope that the ensign fluttering over the Kang Kon will always shine radiantly as a symbol of dignity and honour, a banner of victory and feats, of our Navy.
Brave sailors of the destroyer,
Forward for our great motherland! -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Ceremony for Marking Commissioning of Destroyer Kang Kon Held with Splendor
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- At a time when the era of eye-opening transformation in strengthening the Juche-oriented naval forces is being ushered in thanks to the outstanding military strategic ideas and energetic leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, another powerful warship, which will reliably defend the inviolable maritime sovereignty and interests of our state, was commissioned into the Navy of the Korean People's Army.
The destroyer Kang Kon is the second Choe Hyon-class destroyer possessed of the complex combat capability to perfectly complete the operational mission assigned to it even in any waters by accepting the original conceptions for bolstering the naval combat power in a Korean way. Its commissioning serves as a significant occasion in demonstrating the steadfast will of the Party Central Committee to build an ocean fleet with the ardent desire and aspiration for a rich country with a strong army and its nonstop progress towards the modernization of the Navy.
A ceremony took place at Wonsan Port on September 6 to commemorate the commissioning of the destroyer Kang Kon.
The port, which shows the past and present development of our naval forces as a whole, was filled with the boundless gratitude to ComradeKim Jong Unwho is translating into the present reality the long-cherished desire of the people who had longed for the powerful navy and is injecting the vitality of sure victory into our navy.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When ComradeKim Jong Unarrived at the venue of the ceremony amid the welcome music, the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers out of their absolute trust and boundless reverence for him who set forth the original development orientation for building the modern naval forces and has powerfully guided the struggle for its realization to usher in a new stirring heyday of the navy capable of fully demonstrating the strong strength and spirit of the DPRK in ocean.
The KPA Navy courteously greeted ComradeKim Jong Un, the outstanding leader and great defender of our state and people, with the highest respect.
There took place a ceremony of greeting the head of state.
ComradeKim Jong Unreviewed the glorious flag and guard of honor of the KPA Navy.
There was a march-past of the guard of honor of the Navy.
Present there were senior Party and government officials including members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of ministries and national agencies, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and the KPA large combined units, officers and men of the Navy, sailors of the destroyer Kang Kon, naval generals of the former generation, workers, scientists, technicians and officials in the field of shipbuilding industry and citizens, youth and students in Wonsan City.
The sacred flag of the DPRK was hoisted amid the solemn playing of the national anthem.
An art performance was given to commemorate the commissioning of the new-type destroyer.
Put on the stage were pieces of music dealing with the militant course of the Navy of the Republic, which has demonstrated the matchless heroism, bravery and spirit of annihilating enemies to defend the inviolable sea of the motherland, and the life of sailors shining on the voyage of loyalty and songs on the theme of patriotism.
The performance showed through wonderful artistic depiction the high ideological and moral world of the officers and men of the Navy, who are determined to invariably remain faithful to their sacred mission assigned by the Party and the country, setting the coordinates of their life on the voyage of defending the country forever and adding eternal shine to the immortal ennobling name of ComradeKim Jong Un's navy and its history of victory. It added pleasure to the significant and auspicious event in September.
Then followed a commissioning ceremony of the destroyer.
Jo Chun Ryong, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made a report on the preparations for the commissioning of the destroyer Kang Kon.
He said that the destroyer Kang Kon will be formally commissioned into the KPA Navy at a historic time when a new heyday of strengthening the Juche-oriented naval forces is being put on a higher stage, adding that after its launching, the destroyer's combat efficiency and reliability have been comprehensively verified through several-stage professional assessment and test.
On behalf of the workers, scientists and officials in the field of defence industry including Chongjin Shipyard and Rajin Shipyard, he courteously declared that the destroyer Kang Kon with the mission to defend the sea of the DPRK was ready to be delivered to the Navy of the KPA.
Thanks to the outstanding and correct guidance of the Party Central Committee, the rapid growth and development of the naval forces of the Republic has been put on a firm track, he stressed.
Saying that it is the firm faith and high enthusiasm of the workers in the shipbuilding industry and the national defence scientific research group to glorify the great era by building and launching more powerful warships every year, he expressed the determination to ensure the radical development of the naval forces of the DPRK by making more responsible efforts and struggles true to the line of developing the national defence clarified by the Party Congress.
Minister of Shipbuilding Kim Kwang Il handed over the document of delivery of the destroyer Kang Kon to the Navy of the KPA.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a meaningful speech.
Expressing his historic emotion over the fact that with the high ambition for ocean navigation the destroyer of a new generation came to commence its operation at the port, where the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighters led by PresidentKim Il Sungdropped anchor of liberation to return home in triumph in September eighty one years ago, he said that the great ambition to build a rich country with a strong army reflected in the small boat "Kaeson(triumphal entry)" has now come to reach the ocean from this memorable port with the latest warship.
Noting that now when everything is insufficient, we have appreciated the requirements of history and present era from the responsible attitude and viewpoint on security in the present and future and courageously challenged with our own style system of calculation, and it was started from the consciousness and mission of the generation never to shift to rising generations the historic great cause of building a powerful navy in conformity with the geographical conditions of a maritime country, he said that the destroyer Kang Kon is an outcome of the DPRK's self-respect, will and strong spirit to defend its rights and interests before being an aggregate of its economic, defence and scientific and technological capabilities.
We should make sure that the diversified and effective operation of nuclear combat systems is conducted for an actual war through developing our navy into a nuclear armed force and military activities for maritime defence and war deterrence are more clearly conducted, and this is the constitutional duty of the armed forces of the DPRK, he said, stating that the responsible activities and important role of the Navy of the DPRK will strictly restrain the enemies' aggression fleets and definitely bring about a result of making them retreat strategically.
Saying that there is no other guarantee for defending peace but to ensure the balance of force and we will show our principled and responsible will to defend the maritime sovereignty of the Republic, the security environment in Northeast Asia and the world peace by deploying the most powerful strategic assets in the most important waters, he clarified again the invariable stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to continuously develop the overwhelming military muscle feared by the hostile forces.
When ComradeKim Jong Unfinished his speech, all the participants expressed their firm pledge to uphold with the most thoroughgoing practical successes the unshakable will of the Party Central Committee to defend the national sovereignty and its policy of building a powerful army, breaking into thunderous cheers of "Hurrah!"
Upon authorization, Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, read out the order of the WPK Central Military Commission on commissioning the destroyer Kang Kon into the KPA Navy, and handed it to Senior Vice Admiral Pak Kwang Sop, commander of the KPA Navy.
On the order of the WPK Central Military Commission, the destroyer will be commissioned into the East Sea Fleet of the KPA Navy to fulfill the responsible mission of defending the maritime sovereignty of the DPRK as the nuclear war deterrent.
On behalf of the sailors of the destroyer, Senior Commander Choe Chol Jin, captain of the destroyer, made an oath-taking speech.
Referring to the great honor and pride of commanding the powerful new-type warship, the captain extended high tribute and thanks on behalf of the warship to the workers of the Chongjin and Rajin shipyards and the relevant sectors of defence industry faithfully upholding the Party Central Committee's grand plan for building the naval forces.
He said that they will sail along the course indicated by the Party Central Committee without an inch of deviation as befits the sailors of the destroyer Kang Kon, a capital ship of the Navy in the new era which shoulders a heavy responsibility of defending the maritime sovereignty with the immortal soul of the army-founding generation, and exercise in a responsible manner the invincible defence capability and tremendous deterrent assigned by the country and the people to the warship.
The captain expressed the will of sure victory of the sailors of the destroyer to vigorously make the voyage of ocean the course of the most brilliant feats, always cherishing the pledge made before ComradeKim Jong Unand the country and its people at the commissioning ceremony, and thus more highly and fully demonstrate the dignity and honor of the glorious DPRK.
Then, amid the enthusiastic encouragement and cheers of the participants in the ceremony, the sailors of the destroyer got on the warship with the honor of being sailors of the Republic, holding high the fleet flag and the ensign in the van.
There took place a ceremony of hoisting the ensign of the destroyer Kang Kon of the KPA Navy.
Amid the boom of a 9 gun-salute, the ensign was solemnly hoisted on the warship with the wish and militant salute of all the participants.
ComradeKim Jong Ungot on the destroyer.
The captain greeted ComradeKim Jong Unwith the great honor of having the head of state on his warship again before leaving the port.
Going round various combat spaces of the warship, ComradeKim Jong Unextended warm congratulations and militant encouragement to all the commanding officers and sailors who start their honorable military service together with the DPRK's new-generation destroyer No. 2, which was named after the anti-Japanese revolutionary fighter, with the sacred and important mission of defending the inviolable national sovereignty.
ComradeKim Jong Unmet the sailors on the bow of the destroyer.
The destroyer Kang Kon was awarded the binocular in the name of ComradeKim Jong Un.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that today's ceremony of transferring the warship held with splendor amid the blessing of the country and the people constitutes a historic event of making another step forward in improving the operational capability of our navy to the strategic level and a clear proof of the inevitability of our cause of ushering in a heyday of the navy.
He said that once ordered anytime, the new-generation destroyer should deal a deadly retaliatory blow at the enemies as it is a force involved in the state nuclear counteraction system. He expressed belief and expectation that the commanding officers and sailors of the destroyer Kang Kon possessed of the might, spirit and courage of the DPRK would win only victory, covering the militant course of the Navy of the Republic with greater glory, and had a significant photo taken with them.
All the commanding officers and sailors of the destroyer solemnly pledged to glorify the honor of the Navy of the Republic with a record of proud victory, holding fast to the steering of invariable faith and sailing the ocean along the course indicated by the Party Central Committee.
ComradeKim Jong Ungot off the warship and met with the navy commanding officers of the former generation who took part in the ceremony.
The commander of the Navy ordered the destroyer Kang Kon to leave the port.
All the warships of the Navy staying in the port raised the code flags of congratulation at once amid the gong of departure of the destroyer and the let-off of fireworks and balloons.
The participants extended their warmest and enthusiastic congratulations to the sailors of the destroyer, waving their hands.
ComradeKim Jong Unsent a militant salute to the destroyer, hoping that it would demonstrate only the honor of invincibility.
On the same day, senior Party and government officials and other participants went round the venues of the exhibition of warship military hardware and the photo exhibition of the history of the Navy and realized with deep emotion the rapid development of our Navy being accelerated beyond precedent and limits thanks to the energetic around-the-clock leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un.
The KPA Navy hosted a reception in commemoration of the commissioning of the destroyer.
The commissioning of the destroyer Kang Kon clearly proved the epoch-making progress and development of the building of the modern naval forces led by ComradeKim Jong Unand gave redoubled strength and encouragement to the ranks of the all-people general advance working heart and soul for the successful implementation of the grand revolutionary programme set forth by the historic Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Only traces of victory and glory will always be recorded in the future of our Navy thanks to ComradeKim Jong Un, the symbol of the mightiness of the great DPRK and the invincible and iron-willed commander. -0-

headline: DPRK Men's Football Team Qualified for 2027 AFC U-20 Asian Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Group C matches for qualification for the 2027 AFC U-20 Asian Cup took place in Vietnam.
The forthcoming Asian Cup will bring together eight teams which came first in group matches, seven teams with high points among those that came second, and the host country team.
The men players of the DPRK defeated their Vietnamese rivals 3:0 in the first match and Iranian rivals 2:1 in the second match.
They played the last match with their Palestinian rivals on Sept. 6. In the match the DPRK team beat the opponent 4:0.
As a result, the DPRK team scored 9 points in total to take the first place in the group and won the qualifiers for the 2027 AFC U-20 Asian Cup. -0-

headline: PresidentKim Il Sung's Immortal Nation-building Exploits
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- September 9 is the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
On the occasion of the day, the DPRK people recollect with deep emotion the nation-building exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho founded the DPRK and developed it into an invincible socialist country.
During the anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle, the President put forward the Juche-oriented line of building the people's government and gained valuable experience in building the government.
After the national liberation, he set forth the most accurate nation-building line and defined the form of government as the people's government defending and realizing the interests of the broad working masses, including workers, peasants and intellectuals, and stepped up preparations for building the government under complicated circumstances.
In those days, the people's democratic government was established to carry out the tasks of the anti-imperialist, anti-feudal democratic revolution and such democratic reforms as the Law on Agrarian Reform, the Law on Nationalization of Major Industries and the Labor Law were enforced to provide conditions for building new society in Korea.
On this basis, the President declared the birth of the DPRK on September 9, 1948.
The founding of the DPRK was a brilliant victory of the Juche-oriented nation-building line advanced by the President and a historic event that made Korea, once eclipsed on the world map, an independent and sovereign state, and its people genuine masters of the state and society.
The exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungwho pioneered the building of a socialist state centered on the popular masses are shining forever along with the prosperity of the DPRK. -0-

headline: Korea April 26 Animation Studio
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- The Korea April 26 Animation Studio in the central part of Pyongyang is well known throughout the country as a popular animation creators group.
It has produced many cartoons loved by not only children but also adults.
Typical ones are "The Boy General", "The Clever Raccoon Dog" and "Ko Ju Mong".
The theme of "The Boy General" (100 parts) is the anti-aggression struggle of the people in Koguryo (B.C. 277-A.D. 668) and their patriotism. "Ko Ju Mong" (50 parts) deals with the figures recorded in history. They gave pleasure to the people throughout the country with interesting life story, relations between lifelike characters and great dramatic attraction.
"The Clever Raccoon Dog" contributes to the development of intelligence and study of children and students for its themes dealing with valuable fundamentals.
The studio is now producing a historical cartoon "Prince Hodong and Princess Rangnang" on the basis of actual historical facts. The 3-D cartoon, based on advanced technology, also gains popularity for its lifelike characters, dramatic composition and lively music.
The studio has widened the range of subject and introduced new depictive technologies to produce cartoons earlier with a combination of 3-D work and speech record.
The Korea April 26 Animation Studio, a leading animation producer of the country, was founded on September 7, 1957. -0-

headline: Education in Patriotism Intensified in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Youth league organizations at universities and colleges and Children's Union organizations at schools in South Hwanghae Province of the DPRK are striving to prepare the younger generation to be excellent pillars of the future with ardent patriotism.
Universities and colleges have organized meetings with meritorious persons of socialist patriotism and young forerunners to encourage the youth league officials and students to follow their virtues and beautiful traits and do good things for national prosperity.
Through meetings to recite patriotic poems, disseminate patriotic songs and watch videos on patriotism, all the students are preparing themselves to be genuine revolutionary talents who know the preciousness of the country before science and technology.
The senior middle schools have purposefully conducted education through national symbols and directed primary efforts to instilling into the graduates the awareness that national defence is the sacred duty of a citizen.
The primary schools, too, are conducting education to help the pupils cherish the love for their native places, alma maters and friends. -0-

headline: Cambodian King and Great Queen Send Large Flower Baskets to DPRK Embassy
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Great Queen Norodom Monineath Sihanouk sent large flower baskets to the DPRK embassy in Phnom Penh on September 4 on the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
The flower baskets were laid before the portraits of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Minister of National Defence of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 7 (KCNA) -- Kim Song Gi, minister of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, issued the following press statement on Monday:
The U.S., Japan and the ROK are staging the provocative tripartite multi-domain joint military exercises Freedom Edge again under the pretext of coping with the "nuclear and missile threats" from the DPRK.
Timed to coincide with this, the U.S. military is planning to stage Orient Shield, the largest-ever joint military drills, with Japan and Australia, from September 8 to 24 and to deploy in Japan the Strategic Mid-range Fires System Typhon with the regional countries in its striking range during the drills.
Moreover, the U.S. schemes to bring its army multi-domain mobile task force, a special unit formed with the aim of militarily deterring the neighboring countries within the first island chain in the Asia-Pacific region, within this year.
The U.S.-led war rehearsals are being staged one after another with no time gap now that the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation system is being transformed into a dangerous offensive entity with nuclear elements. This constitutes a grave security threat pushing the instability on the Korean peninsula and beyond the region to the critical point.
If the U.S. and its allies attempt at a new military confrontation with us, we will also take strong corresponding countermeasures from the standpoint of power.
The most proper way to strictly control the ever-growing potential danger of conflict and thoroughly defend the sovereignty and security interests of the country is to constantly apply new evolved responsive force.
It is the consistent principle of military activities of the armed forces of the DPRK not to hesitate in the least to fulfill its constitutional duty to deter the hostile sources threatening national security and punish the provocateurs.
I give a serious warning to the U.S. and its satellite countries on their reckless military maneuvers to create a serious military confrontation and possibility of conflict on the Korean peninsula and their ensuing consequences.
If necessary, we will express our will and ability to respond to the enemies' moves through more powerful and resolute action. -0-

headline: Steak Restaurant Inaugurated in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- A steak restaurant was newly built and inaugurated with due ceremony in Kanggye City, Jagang Province of the DPRK, on Monday.
The restaurant with several hundred-seat service and dining rooms and an open-air steak service ground is located in the scenic spot on the bank of the picturesque Jangja River.  People in the province will enjoy various traditional dishes with good taste and high nutritive value at this public catering establishment.
Present at the inauguration ceremony were Pak Song Chol, chief secretary of the Jagang Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the province and Kanggye City, working people, builders and employees of the restaurant.
Sin Chang Gil, chairman of the provincial people's committee, addressed the ceremony. Then a speech was made.
After the ceremony the participants went round the restaurant.
The first service was given to the heroes, meritorious persons and labor innovators in the province. -0-

headline: Tuman River Motor Bridge Named after Yakov Nobichenko Inaugurated
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- At a time when multi-faceted cooperation and exchange between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation are further developing with each passing day on the basis of the comprehensive strategic partnership and the relations of invincible alliance, the Tuman River Motor Bridge linking Rason Municipality with Khasan, border cities of the two countries, has been successfully completed.
True to the noble intention of ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, President of the Russian Federation, the governments and builders of the two countries successfully built the bridge, in keeping with designing and construction needs, in a short span of 495 days with a single mind to demonstrate the durable and future-oriented friendship and contribute to promoting the wellbeing of the two peoples.
The completion of the motor bridge, which can ensure the safe passage of various kinds of vehicles and personnel traffic, provides a guarantee for building up and reinforcing an important infrastructure for economic cooperation between the two countries and revitalizing multi-faceted cooperation including human exchange, tourism and commodity circulation.
The monumental edifice to be brilliantly recorded in the history of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations was named after Yakov Nobichenko, an officer of the Red Army and an internationalist soldier. This is a manifestation of the steadfast will of the leaderships and peoples of both countries to invariably develop the good-neighborly relations between the two peoples into genuine comradely relations of trust.
The inauguration ceremony of the Tuman River Motor Bridge named after Yakov Nobichenko took place simultaneously in Rason Municipality, a border city of the DPRK, and Khasan, a border city of the Russian Federation, on Monday.
Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and Mikhail Vladimirovich Mishustin, prime minister of the Russian Federation, attended the inauguration ceremony in Pyongyang and Moscow on TV.
Present there were Kim Tok Hun, first vice-premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, Yun Jong Ho, minister of External Economic Relations and chairman of the DPRK side to the DPRK-Russia Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Yang Yong Jin, minister of Land and Environment Protection, Sin Chang Il, chairman of the Rason Municipal People's Committee, Kim Jong Gyu, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, officials concerned, builders and working people in Rason Municipality.
Vladimir Topekha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here, and Oleg Kosheev, Russian consul general in Chongjin, were on hand.
The national anthems of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Russian Federation were played.
Mikhail Vladimirovich Mishustin, prime minister of the Russian Federation, made a congratulatory speech.
He said that the cooperation on the construction of transport objects between the two governments was an item of the agreement reached at the meeting between Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, in Pyongyang two years ago, adding that they are witnessing a historic event of inauguration of the motor bridge.
The relations between Russia and the DPRK have been put on an unprecedentedly high level of comprehensive strategic partnership, he said, adding that the two countries are actively cooperating with each other in all fields and directing their efforts to ensuring the regional peace and stability.
He said that the long-standing friendship, good-neighborliness and mutual assistance between the two countries are irrespective of the international situation, adding that Russia would as ever do its utmost for the multifaceted development of the bilateral relations.
Pak Thae Song, premier of the DPRK Cabinet, made a congratulatory speech.
He expressed sincere thanks to the designers, builders and those of relevant institutions of the two countries who devoted their inexhaustible enthusiasm and efforts to bringing earlier the inauguration of the Tuman River Motor Bridge.
The completion of the bridge is a significant event adding a new dynamic movement to the overall bilateral cooperation, he said, stressing that the eye-opening reality, in which the monumental wealth of the DPRK-Russia friendship and cooperation is growing, gives pleasure and joy to the peoples of the two countries while injecting vitality to the development of the bilateral relations.
He noted that the governments of the two countries would as ever continue to achieve substantial fruitions in cooperation for the common development and prosperity, based on the valuable successes and experience accumulated through the construction of the bridge.
As instructed by the heads of governments of the two countries, Kim Tok Hun, first vice-premier of the DPRK Cabinet, and Vladimir Topekha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy to the DPRK, cut the inauguration tape at the venue of the inaugural ceremony in Rason Municipality and Alexandr Kozlov, minister of Natural Resources and Ecology of Russia who is chairman of the Russian side to the Russia-DPRK Inter-governmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology, Minister of Transport Andrei Nikitin, Minister of Development of the Far East and Arctic Aleksei Chekunkov and DPRK Ambassador to Russia Sin Hong Chol at the venue of the inaugural ceremony in Khasan.
Trucks of both sides passed through the bridge amid the let-off of fireworks to congratulate the completion of the bridge and the loud applause of the participants.
The heads of governments in their concluding speeches said that the Tuman River Motor Bridge is a new symbol and proud creation of friendship between the two countries, expressing the steadfast stand of the two governments to actively implement the agreement made at the historic meeting between the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia.
Then the participants went round the bridge.
The inauguration of the bridge serves as a significant occasion in designing and actively implementing the equally-beneficial bilateral exchanges and long-term cooperative plans in all fields under the outstanding foresightedness and strategic guidance of the top leaders of the DPRK and Russia. -0-

headline: Neo-Militarists' Moves Will Bring Terrible Disaster to Japan: Int'l Security Affairs Analyst
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 8 (KCNA) -- Kang Won Chol, an international security affairs analyst of the DPRK, released the following article "Neo-militarists' moves to turn the Japanese archipelago into an 'invincible aircraft carrier' will bring terrible disaster to Japan":
The neo-militarists of Japan, who have emerged as a warlike force after putting off the veil of "pacifist state", are bringing a whirlwind of building a war-capable state and reviving an aggressor nation to the archipelago. This pushes peace and security environment in the Northeast Asian region to a seriously critical phase.
As made public, Orient Shield will reportedly be staged by the Japan "Self-Defense Forces" in the largest-ever scale with the U.S. and Australian forces in and around Hokkaido of Japan from September 8 to 24, timed to coincide with the U.S.-Japan-ROK multi-domain tripartite joint military exercises that will be staged from September 7 to 11 in the Korean peninsula region.
Orient Shield is the military drill the ground SDF and U.S. army have staged since 1982 almost every year. Australian army joined it last year.
Asserting that the drill codenamed "Orient Shield" is aimed at "strengthening solidarity for coping with various threats in East Asia", Japan has openly pursued military confrontation with other regional countries.
3 700 troops from Japan, the U.S. and Australia will reportedly take part in the exercises to be staged around Hokkaido. The exercises involve live-ammunition firing, airborne dropping and the use of U.S. intermediate missile system Typhon deployed in Japan for Valiant Shield, large-scale mobile exercises of the U.S. Pacific forces held in June.
The Typhon system, composed of Mk41 vertical launching platforms, is capable of launching Tomahawk long-range cruise missile and SM-6 ship-to-air missile with each range of 1 600 km and 300 km, which means that it can be used to strike naval and ground targets.
Japan, which has focused on deploying long-range strike means in recent years by lavishing a huge amount of money as military expenditure, resorts to bilateral and multilateral joint military exercises with the U.S. and its vassal forces more eagerly than ever. This is a manifestation of their sinister scheme to round off its real war capabilities against the DPRK and other neighboring countries.
Japan, a defeated nation banned from possessing war capabilities, the right to participate in war and the right to belligerence, conducted the first test launch of Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles from a warship in the Pacific Ocean at the end of July in violation of its constitution. It is seeking to introduce even the U.S. forces' Typhon system into the war rehearsal. This is just targeting the regional sovereign countries and it is bad enough to amplify due concern and vigilance.
Moreover, the present Japanese regime seeks to stage a series of war games at the doorstep of neighboring countries with the backing of their American master seriously destroying and violating the existing international order through illegal and arbitrary practices and tyranny. Therefore, their dangerous military maneuvers indicate the present address of Japan evolving in an offensive manner with the passage of time.
The neo-militarist warmongers of Japan, who have added an item of "new combat mode" to the 2026 Defense White Paper, are persistently pushing ahead with such militarist policies as the determination of the highest-ever military expenditure, development of underwater-launched hypersonic missile and unmanned submarine capable of long-distance navigation, introduction of AI into the SDF commanding system and an attempt to reorganize the mechanism of the Ministry of Defense. Due to their moves, the hot air of reinvasion in the archipelago is reaching to an extreme.
In the past 80-odd years since its defeat, Japan has put its whole territory of archipelago ranging from Hokkaido to Kyushu into a nuclear forward base and a logistic base of the U.S. for aggression on the DPRK, clamoring about a "unsinkable aircraft carrier". Even now, it threw away the yoke of the defeated and is rushing headlong along neo-militarism. The international community should never remain a passive onlooker to this grave situation.
All the facts prove once again that the only prescription for controlling the descendants of militarism who inherited the genes of aggression is to have overwhelming and unparalleled war deterrent.
The more Japan tries to largely expand the scope of preemptive attack and secure actual war capability while giving off powder fumes in front of the nuclear weapons states, the more clearly the mainland of Japan will be in the sight of the neighboring countries.
The attempt of the neo-militarists of Japan to turn the whole archipelago into an "unsinkable aircraft carrier" will inevitably bring about enormous misfortune. -0-

It is the consistent and steadfast policy of the Chinese party and government to successfully defend, consolidate and develop the China-DPRK relations.
In June this year I paid an official visit to the DPRK and met you again to open up a new chapter in the development of the relations between the two parties and the two countries.
I am willing to strive, together with you, Comrade General Secretary, to make greater contributions to constantly improving the wellbeing and friendship of the peoples of the two countries and promoting the regional and global peace and stability, development and prosperity by steadily intensifying the strategic guidance over the relations between the two parties and two countries and joining hands with you to accelerate the development of each side's party and state affairs.

Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- The labor innovators and persons of merit, who were invited to the celebrations of the 78th founding anniversary of the DPRK, on September 8 visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
The visitors paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the President and the Chairman lie in state, they made deep bows to them, the eternal images of socialist Korea and great sages of the revolution, praying for their immortality. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Wednesday received a message of greeting from Thongloun Sisoulith, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and President of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.
The message said:
Dear ComradeKim Jong Un,
I extend warm congratulations and best wishes on behalf of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and all the Lao people and on my own behalf to you and, through you, to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and all the fraternal Korean people on the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
I am very pleased over the fact that over the past 78 years the fraternal Korean people have achieved comprehensive and great successes in their work to firmly defend the country, develop the economy and steadily improve the people’s living standards by waging a vigorous struggle for national defence and development under the wise leadership of the Workers’ Party of Korea.
With great satisfaction over the fact that the traditional relations of friendship between the LPDR and the DPRK have steadily developed over the past years, I am firmly convinced that the long-standing good relations of friendship and cooperation between the two countries will grow stronger thanks to the joint efforts of both sides, thus bringing substantial benefits to the peoples of the two countries and contributing to peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the world.
Availing myself of this auspicious opportunity, I wish you good health and happiness and greater fresh successes in your noble and honorable work.
And I hope that the fraternal Korean people will always be happy and prosperous.
I pay high tribute to you. -0-

headline: Street Parade and Evening Gala Held to Mark Founding Anniversary of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 9 (KCNA) -- A street parade and evening gala took place in Pyongyang on Tuesday to celebrate the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Mansu Hill, a historic place where the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilare solemnly standing, was crowded with Pyongyang citizens who gathered to take part in the significant street parade.
Before starting the parade, Kim Su Gil, chief secretary of the Pyongyang Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, made a speech.
He said that the solemn parade will show the firm faith and will of the people to display the mightiness and beauty of the beloved motherland forever with single-minded loyalty on the occasion of the significant national day.
Amid the playing of "Song of the Proclamation of the People's Republic", the parade began with the column holding a large national flag of the Republic in the lead.
The participants in the parade extended the highest glory to the President and the Chairman who set an epochal example in building a prosperous and powerful socialist state independent in politics, self-supporting in the economy and self-reliant in defence with their outstanding ideology and leadership.
All the columns, including column with a float depicting the national emblem, column of rhythmic national flags and column of persons in three-color clothes, extended the highest tribute to respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is ushering in the era of the most powerful country in the 5 000-year history, the era of our state-first principle, shouting slogans with sonorous voices.
The columns of the parade enteredKim Il SungSquare.
Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and leading officials of ministries, national agencies and working people's organizations appeared on the platform of the square.
Members of the diplomatic corps here took their seats for invited guests of the platform.
Labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of the national day, participants in the 15th National Conference of Teachers, service personnel, youth and students and schoolchildren of revolutionary schools warmly welcomed the columns of the parade entering the square.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK took place solemnly.
All the participants paid high tribute to the dignified national flag of the DPRK, full of pride and patriotic enthusiasm and confidence in the bright future.
Looking up to the national flag, the columns of the street parade passed through the square with a pledge to make patriotic and precious successes in every theater of struggle for the prosperity of the country.
Then an evening gala of youth and students took place.
The participants in the evening gala danced to the tune of "Song of Youth" and "Dear Father", flying the national flags of the Republic. They were replete with boundless reverence and gratitude to respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho has put forward the young people as an advancing group of socialist construction and brought them up to be heroes of the times while entrusting them with huge worksites of creation as a whole.
The melody of songs "The Desire" and "We Are Koreans" resounded through the square and the spectacular fireworks were displayed to decorate the end of the evening gala beautifully. -0-

headline: 2026 Table Tennis Tournament for Disabled and Amateurs Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- The 2026 Table Tennis Tournament for Disabled and Amateurs took place in Pyongyang from August 25 to September 9.
Disabled persons and amateurs, divided into eight groups, competed in knockouts after league matches.
The participants in the tournament fully demonstrated the skills they had cultivated in the days of mass sports activities. The tournament vividly showcased their happy life under the most advantageous socialist system.
Cups and medals were awarded to the successful teams. -0-

headline: Performance Given to Celebrate 78th Founding Anniversary of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- All the Korean people's intense love and pride in their country, dignified with independence and strong with self-sustenance and self-reliance century after century, is growing stronger along with glorious September. Against this backdrop, national day celebrations in the DPRK culminated in a grand art performance given before the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on Wednesday evening.
The venue for the performance was filled with excitement and joy of Pyongyang citizens who significantly and splendidly celebrate the 78th founding day, when the great nation-building cause of Juche was accomplished, in the course of carrying out the epoch-making cause of comprehensive development that is of eternal significance in the existence and prosperity of the DPRK.
Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and other leading cadres of the Party and the government watched the performance together with the labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the national day celebrations, the participants in the 15th National Conference of Teachers, officials of ministries and national agencies, deputies to the Supreme People's Assembly in Pyongyang, the teaching staff and students of the revolutionary schools, and Pyongyang citizens.
The performance began with "Song of the Proclamation of the People's Republic" and "The Glorious Motherland", the monumental odes to the country reminding the participants of the fervent enthusiasm and valiant spirit of new Korea embarking on building a thriving nation. Put on the stage were famous songs on the theme of patriotism which resounded in the course of the founding and development of the Republic.
Enthusiastically singing the paeans of the times, produced by the people's strong aspirations and desire and noble experience, the performers paid high tribute to the 70-odd years of the glorious Republic which included the letters Inmin(people) in its sacred name and has proudly won and defended the honor and prestige of the Juche power by overcoming the difficulties and severe challenges decisive to the destiny of the country through indomitable pioneering and heroic advance.
Listening to the memorable famous songs, which inspired the persevering patriotic will in every period of the revolution, at the crucial moment when they are glorifying with a new great victory their faith and efforts, advancing single-mindedly toward the noblest ideal and purpose, the audience hardened the will to more firmly uphold their socialist country with redoubled courage and self-confidence in their strength and cause so that it is admired by the whole world.
Impressive songs and dances were put on the stage to represent the thought and feelings of all the people seeking to continuously achieve fresh victories so as to preserve the precious honor they have gained generation after generation and add new pages of creative feats and immortal miracles to the history of national prosperity, true to the far-reaching nation-building idea and ambition to outpace the world by dint of the powerful strength based on the truth. The performance reached the climax with "The National Anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea".
Fireworks were successively let off to brighten the nocturnal sky of celebrations.
The performance commemorating the national day sang high praises of the patriotic and revolutionary enthusiasm of the DPRK people to achieve all victories and glory along with their motherland admired by the world as an entity of the eternal dignity and honor, heroic struggle and great creativity of tens of millions of Koreans and as a powerful country advancing toward a rosy future in the course of glorious development. -0-

headline: "Pomhyanggi" Manager, Name Given by Top Leader with Affection
story_text:
It was September 8, 2021.
That day, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uncalled labor innovators and meritorious persons, who took part in the celebrations of the significant 73rd birthday of the DPRK, to the headquarters building of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea. He had a photo session with them before giving a grand banquet in the garden of the headquarters building.
Among the participants sharing the affection like members of the same family with the General Secretary in the banquet was the manager of the Sinuiju Cosmetics Factory.
The manager rose up from her seat to express gratitude to the General Secretary for inviting her to the significant place. She approached and courteously made a deep bow to him, introducing herself.
After receiving her compliment, the General Secretary said in a pleasant tone that he had already recognized her face and that it would be better to introduce her as "Pomhyanggi (spring fragrance)" manager.
Then he personally filled a cup for the manager wetting her eyes with soaring excitement.
"Pomhyanggi" manager, this call reflected the General Secretary's deep trust and earnest request that she should live as a true servant for the people with the spirit of selfless, devoted service. -0-

headline: Women's Dancing Parties Held in DPRK to Mark National Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- A dancing party of women's union officials and members took place on September 9, the 78th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
The plaza of the Arch of Triumph, the venue for the dancing party, was overflowing with joy and excitement of officials and members of the women's union celebrating the founding anniversary of their motherland.
The dancing party began with the playing of the song "Fly Our Tri-color National Flag of the Republic".
The participants danced with boundless pride and joy of leading a worthwhile life on the road of national prosperity as a powerful force pushing one of the two wheels of the revolutionary chariot under the care of the great Workers' Party of Korea.
The dancers were full of gratitude and reverence for respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho has ushered in a new great era of the comprehensive development of socialism and demonstrated the dignity and prestige of the country all over the world with his outstanding idea and immortal patriotic devotion.
The dancing party, which vividly showed the mettle and noble spiritual world of the Korean women determined to fully display their patriotism in the struggle for accelerating the comprehensive prosperity and development of the country, ended with the song "Our Leader Loved by People".
Dancing parties of women's union officials and members were held in other parts of the country on the same day. -0-

The congratulatory messages came from the Standing Council of the Korean Federation of Workers in Commerce in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Korean Youth League in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Democratic Korean Women in Japan, the Central Standing Management Board of the Korean Youth Commercial Association in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Teachers and School Clerks in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Educationists Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Social Scientists Association in Japan, the Standing Council of the Korean Sportsmen's Federation in Japan, the Central Standing Committee of the Union of Korean Writers and Artists in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Health Workers Association in Japan, the Central Standing Council of the Korean Human Rights Association in Japan and other central organizations of Chongryon and their affiliated organizations, the Choson Sinbo Company, the Korean News Service, the Hagu Bookshop, the Kumgang-san Opera Troupe, the Kumgang Insurance Company and other businesses, regional headquarters of Chongryon, Korea University and other Korean schools at different levels in Japan.
The messages paid the highest tribute to the great leader GeneralissimoKim Il Sungand the great leader GeneralissimoKim Jong Il, who pioneered the cause of Juche and laid an eternal foundation for accomplishing the socialist cause, on the occasion of the 78th birthday of the DPRK, the glorious motherland.
They extended the greatest glory and warmest congratulations to respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho is leading the struggle for bringing about the overall development of socialism and the era of prosperity of the country along the road of victory, translating the patriotic desire of the great leaders for building a powerful country into a brilliant reality.
The messages wished respected MarshalKim Jong Un, the great sun of Juche Korea and benevolent father of Chongryon and Koreans in Japan, good health for the eternal prosperity of the glorious motherland and for the development of the revolutionary cause of Juche and the patriotic cause of Chongryon. -0-
