topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: National Flag-hoisting and Oath-taking Ceremony Takes Place on Birthday of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- All the citizens and families of the DPRK greeted the 78th national day amid ever-soaring patriotic enthusiasm of all the people to make great transformations and strides, true to the revolutionary programme unveiled at the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A national flag-hoisting and oath-taking ceremony took place solemnly at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on September 9, the 78th founding anniversary of the glorious motherland Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the commemorative event.
Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other leading cadres of the Party, government and armed forces organs, senior officials of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies, commanding officers of the Korean People's Army and deputies to the SPA in Pyongyang.
The KPA guard of honour lined up at the venue for the commemoration.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK took place.
Guards of honour of the KPA solemnly escorted the national flag of the DPRK to the venue of the ceremony.
All the participants paid high tribute to the glorious national flag symbolic of the pride and valiant spirit of heroic Korea and its heroic people that have won priceless victories and demonstrated the dignity and honour of the Republic to the world, bravely treading the untrodden path of history with a strong sense of patriotism.
The glorious national flag of the DPRK was hoisted.
The venue was overflowing with intense desire of the participants to devote all their strength, wisdom and enthusiasm to the glorious and worthwhile struggle for bringing earlier a bright future, adding lustre to the great history of their ever-victorious country.
Led by the head of state,  the participants solemnly pledged before the sacred national flag to remain boundlessly sincere in promoting the people's well-being and the growth and development of the country, firmly defend the Constitution of the Republic, strictly observe the legal duty, firmly defend the socialist ideology and the socialist system and remain faithful to their beloved motherland so as to add eternal glory to its greatness and beauty as responsible members defending the sovereignty of the DPRK and interests of its people and serving the state and people.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade a congratulatory address to all the people on the occasion of the national day.
He extended warm congratulations and thanks to the working people, service personnel and families across the country for their continuous creation, boundless devotion and responsible contribution to the prosperity and development of the country on the occasion of the national day.
His warm congratulations also went to the overseas compatriots' organizations and overseas compatriots that always share their breath and mind with the homeland, praying for the brilliant journey of the Republic. And he paid special thanks and high tribute to the commanding officers and soldiers of the army involved in overseas military operations.
Our ideal is being realized rapidly thanks to patriotism, voluntary service and devoted contributions by all citizens praying for the country's prosperity, and our fighting morale for reaching the goal has also been greatly boosted, he said, adding that the national prestige and dignity have been further enhanced year by year, thanks to the arduous struggle of the Korean people, alongside their ever-soaring spirit to bring earlier a dignified, powerful, peaceful, secure, revolutionary and prosperous era.
Saying the further our socialist cause advances, the higher ideals and ambitions we have, instead of greater joy and satisfaction, he noted that the reality of the Korean revolution, in which all are waging the struggle for tomorrow with higher and more goals than today and make vigorous progress of their own style, fully demonstrates the inexhaustible potentials and united strength of the country and the absolute confidence in the future, and this remarkable development is being realized by the resourceful Korean people.
Noting that the righteous minds and efforts of the people loving and supporting the country and serving it with loyalty have become the pillars of irresistible might to fully prop up the current brilliant reality of the country, he said that the extraordinary pride and self-confidence in the great country, fervent patriotism and outstanding talents and strong self-respect of the Korean people make everyone aspire to a stronger, more prosperous and more beautiful future of the DPRK. This shared desire unites our country and all our people, steadily increases the national power and provides confidence, courage and inexhaustible creative power enabling them to race against time, he added.
Expressing his will to ensure that the Party and the government make all efforts to shoulder heavier responsibility, make a bigger stride and achieve dynamic advance, he wished all the people and families across the country warm peace, joy and happiness, affirming that only victory and glory are in store for the great, resourceful and brave people.
The participants were greatly excited by the enthusiastic speech made by ComradeKim Jong Unwho declared the unshakable faith and will to bring earlier the powerful, prosperous and beautiful future of the nation, firmly believing in the ardent patriotism, wisdom and inexhaustible creativity of the great, resourceful and brave Korean people.
When ComradeKim Jong Unfinished his speech, all the participants burst into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"
All the participants hardened their strong will to fulfill the important responsibility and duty, entrusted by the people, with tireless enthusiasm and strenuous efforts in the vanguard of the historic sacred cause for the immortal glory of their country and the victory of Korean-style socialism, true to the original idea of the great ComradeKim Jong Unon building a country guided by the people-first principle. -0-

headline: Social Trait of Respecting and Treating Revolutionary Forerunners Preferentially
New Steak Restaurant Inaugurated in Sinuiju City of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- A new steak restaurant has appeared in Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province of the DPRK.
The restaurant, another catering service facility for the people, was built in a peculiar way at a scenic place of the border city. It has hundreds of seats, alongside various service rooms meeting the convenience of guests.
Its inauguration ceremony took place on Tuesday.
Present there were officials of the province and the city, working people, builders and employees of the restaurant.
Choe Yong Man, chairman of the provincial people's committee, addressed the ceremony. Then a speech was made.
After the ceremony the participants looked round the restaurant.
War veterans, honoured disabled soldiers, labour innovators, meritorious persons and other citizens were served that day. -0-

headline: New Steak Restaurant Inaugurated in Sinuiju City of DPRK
DPRK's 78th Birthday Celebrated
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- All the people across the country significantly celebrated the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, their beloved motherland.
An endless stream of visitors flew into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the eternal leaders of the Party and the people, lie in state.
At the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the visitors paid the highest tribute to the great leaders, the founder and builder of the glorious DPRK.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the statues of the peerlessly great leaders and the mosaics depicting them on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before them.
At the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery, other martyrs cemeteries, memorial towers for the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army and cemeteries of fallen fighters in different parts of the country, the visitors deeply grasped the noble spirit and moral world of the anti-Japanese revolutionary martyrs, patriotic martyrs and fallen fighters of the KPA who dedicated themselves to the struggle for national liberation and prosperity.
There took place national flag-hoisting ceremonies in different parts of the country.
At the venue for the national sculpture and craftwork festival opened on the occasion of the national day, the visitors keenly felt the mightiness of their great country and the boundless pride of being citizens of the dignified DPRK.
Meetings between meritorious persons of socialist patriotism and youth and students took place in North Hwanghae, Kangwon and North Hamgyong provinces, Nampho Municipality, etc.
At story-telling and oratorical meetings of working people and youth and students held in different parts of the country, the participants expressed their will to devote their wisdom, strength and enthusiasm to the prosperity of the country, sharing their destiny with it.
Performances were given in Pyongyang and local areas, adding pleasure to the significant holiday.
The festive mood of the national day was revved up by the cheerful dancing parties of youth and students and members of the women's union held in different parts of the country.
On the same day, public catering establishments in Pyongyang and all other parts of the country, including Okryu Restaurant, Phyongnam Noodle House and Sinhung Restaurant in Hamhung, were full of visitors receiving holiday service.
Leisure complexes, including the Central Zoo, the Natural History Museum and the Munsu Water Park, were overflowing with working people and schoolchildren enjoying the holiday. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnMeets and Congratulates Labor Innovators and Meritorious Persons Invited to Celebrations of National Day
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of the 78th founding anniversary of the DPRK at the Pyongyang Assembly Hall on September 9.
The participants, who were honored to be present at the glorious moment they had greatly yearned, broke into enthusiastic cheers with reverence for ComradeKim Jong Un, whom they had so much longed to see, with pride and honor of having devoted patriotic enthusiasm and efforts to the crucial course of advance for making a breakthrough in attaining the new long-term goals set by the historic Ninth Congress of the Party.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly congratulated the delegates from different sectors, who were invited to the celebrations of the national day with the labor achievements they made with inexhaustible devotion, sharing intention and will with the Party in the vanguard of the struggle for adding to the greatness of the country and accelerating its progress.
The ranks of patriots regarding it as the most honorable and happy life to dedicate themselves to the victory and glory of the Republic, sharing their destiny with the country, are increasing day by day, he said, adding that this is the very key and inexhaustible strength guaranteeing the vigorous development of the country and the success of the Party policies.
He said that the struggle at a new stage for making the period of unprecedented upsurge in the development of the state lead up to steady upswing will add another page of great transformation to the history of building a thriving nation, thanks to more positive activities of the pioneers personifying the characteristics and mettle of Koreans, strongest and most diligent and resourceful in the world, and the patriotic enthusiasm of all other people striving in response.
Expressing the expectation that all the participants would fully demonstrate the proud honor as dignified paragons of the times and socialist patriotic workers by making more enthusiastic, innovative and strenuous efforts in the course of the development and offensive advance of the country, ComradeKim Jong Unhad a photo session with them.
When the photo session was over, cheers of excitement echoed in the sky of auspicious September.
All the participants were full of enthusiasm to dedicate themselves to the struggle for realizing earlier the beautiful and sacred ideals and ambitions under the leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un. -0-

headline: DPRK's 78th Birthday Celebrated
Paddy-field Fish Breeding Brisk in Farms of DPRK
High-performance Dry Mill Developed
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, scientists of the Hi-Tech Exchange Company ofKim Il SungUniversity developed a Korean-style high-performance dry mill.
It is a suspension centrifugal roller mill that can be used to grind various minerals such as coal, cement clinker, ferrous and nonferrous metals, glass, magnesia clinker, etc.
The dry mill has been introduced into various sectors including the phosphoritic fertilizer production line under construction in North Hamgyong Province.
The developers of the Korean-style dry mill won a certificate of introduction of the state sci-tech achievements. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Officials, working people, service persons, youth and students in the DPRK paid floral tribute to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill were flower baskets in the name of the Party, power and armed forces organs, social organizations, ministries, national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces and institutions and industrial establishments at all levels and universities in Pyongyang.
The visitors made a bow before the statues of the great leaders.
Flower baskets in the name of institutions, enterprises, KPA and PSF units and bouquets and flowers were laid at the statues of the great leaders in various parts of the capital city.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students across the country visited the statues of the great leaders in their residential areas to pay high tribute. -0-

headline: DPRK Founding Anniversary Celebrated Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 10 (KCNA) -- Seminars took place in Romania, Austria, the Czech Republic and Serbia between August 28 and September 3 to mark the 78th founding anniversary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Speeches were made at the seminars attended by personages of political parties and organizations and members of Juche idea study organizations and organizations for friendship and solidarity with the Korean people in those countries.
The chairman of the Socialist Party of Romania said that under the wise leadership of PresidentKim Il Sung, ComradeKim Jong Iland ComradeKim Jong Unfor the past 78 years, the DPRK has invariably followed the road of socialism despite the imperialist allied forces' persistent sanctions and pressure.
He said that the DPRK serves as the beacon of hope for the world progressives aspiring after socialism and the experience of the Workers' Party of Korea in socialist construction as a precious example for many progressive political parties.
The chairperson of the Serbian National Committee for the Study of the Juche Idea said that the founding of the DPRK was the birth of a legitimate state founded by the general will of all the Korean people, adding that the birth of the DPRK made the Korean people become full-fledged masters of an independent and sovereign state with sovereignty in their hands.

headline: Ssirum (Korean Wrestling)
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 12 (KCNA) -- Ssirum (Korean wrestling) is a game in which two players compete with each other in physical strength and skills in a certain area of open space.
Ssirum started at the end of Ancient Korea (early 30th century B.C.-108 B.C.). It became a well-regulated sport in the period of Koguryo (B.C. 277-A.D. 668). Ssirum was a major sport of army soldiers in the period of Koryo (918-1392). It was popular among ordinary people in the period of the feudal Joson dynasty (1392-1910).
The Ssirum ground was a round circle 4 meters in diameter with its floor carpeted with sand.
Ssirum was divided into left-side and right-side wrestling, according to which legs the players wore their thigh bands, and the two rivals sometimes played without thigh bands.
Ssirum includes three basic techniques and their combos, etiquette rules and the way of declaring winner.
Techniques are knee-whack, arm trip, leg lock and belly throw.
Ssirum has regional features and it is sometimes called Phyongan provincial ssirum, Hwanghae provincial ssirum and Hamgyong provincial ssirum. There are infant-level, middle-level, senior-level and recreational games.
Ssirum was registered as a part of national intangible cultural heritage of the DPRK in November 2013. -0-

story_text:

KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, and Major General Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff of the KPA, guided the joint firepower attack drill.
Subunits selected from the five artillery and missile joint units participated in the drill. The drill involved new combat systems such as attack drones of various kinds, tactical cruise missile, large-caliber thermal-pressure multiple rocket launcher and tactical ballistic missile.
Marshal Pak Jong Chon said that the drill is aimed at making the army do what it should do.
Director of the Artillery Bureau Yu Chang Son said that it is one of the training tasks prioritized by the army to get familiar with the procedure for the operation of the integrated firepower control system, the systematic component of the strategic weapons combined management system, improve the specialty of the integrated automatic firepower control of various combat systems and increase the efficiency of destroying the targets with concentrated fire.
He also stressed that such drills are very helpful to qualitatively enhancing the strategic counteraction posture of striking units at all levels and acquiring the rapid reaction capabilities of sub-units at all levels in case of emergency.
He said that the joint concentrated fire drill of the major missile subunits and the long-range artillery subunits would boost the militant morale of the soldiers and improve the level of specialization to bring down the enemy's armed forces organizationally and structurally once an order is issued. We will, in the future, too, steadily master the procedures for counterattack posture on the enemy through practical drills, he added.
All strike weapon systems demonstrated the huge destructive power of concentration fire by hitting the targets with 100 percent hit accuracy at a stroke, ensuring the unity and simultaneity of firepower attack. -0-

headline: Medical Oxygen Factory in DPRK
Ogasan Yew, Natural Monument of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 14 (KCNA) -- In virgin forest in the Ogasan Nature Reserve in Karim-ri, Hwaphyong County, Jagang Province of the DPRK, there is Ogasan Yew growing for more than 1 100 years.
Ogasan Yew is growing thick verdure thanks to the national heritage protection policy of the state.
The tree is 16.5 meters high, 4.1 meters wide in its root neck and 3.6 meters wide in girth of trunk. And the crown width is about 7 meters.
The shape of tree is elongated and the branches are almost horizontally oriented, with the lower branches slightly down and the upper branches up.
The bark is thin and red brown and there are deep striations on the trunk.
Ogasan Yew is the tallest and oldest tree among yews in the country. It serves as a precious natural treasure of the country proving the natural history of Mt Oga and a natural monument of significance in education of the rising generation and scientific research. -0-

headline: Ssirum (Korean Wrestling)
Considering Even Slight Inconvenience of Shooters

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
DPRK Premier Inspects Various Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 15 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, made a field survey of various sectors.
The premier visited the Tukjang Youth Coal Mine of the Tukjang Area Coal-mining Complex and the Jenam Coal Mine of the Tokchon Area Coal-mining Complex and encouraged their employees who are putting spurs to the coal production, true to the intention of the Party to successfully conclude this year's struggle and pave a broad avenue for attaining the new long-term goal.
He called for continuously securing new coal fields by giving priority to prospecting and tunneling, increasing the mining and transport capacity and boosting the coal miners' mental power and creativity to decisively increase coal production and thus repay the deep trust and expectation of the Party with increased production.
Going round various production sites of the Pukchang Thermal Power Complex, the premier stressed the need to reduce the coal consumption by directing efforts to the management of equipment and technical control for increasing the output of generators and direct close attention to the protection of the ecological environment by introducing advanced dust collection methods.
After acquainting himself with the construction project for establishing the C1 chemical industry, he stressed the need to reinforce the ranks of highly skilled workers and enhance the responsibility and role of the scientists and technicians and thus finish the construction of new processes planned for this year in a qualitative way.
At the Farm Machine Institute of the Agricultural Commission, the premier learned in detail about the development of pumps using natural energy and called for studying and introducing modern and efficient farm machines suited to the country's natural and geographical characteristics and actual conditions.
Field consultative meetings dealt with an issue for the Cabinet, the Ministry of Metal Industry and other ministries and national agencies to timely supply equipment, materials and parts necessary for the normal production of coal mines and thermal power plants and the construction project for the establishment of the C1 chemical industry, an issue for the officials to pay deep attention to the health and working and living conditions of scientists, researchers and workers, etc.
Earlier, the premier visited the Ryonggang Stone Processing Factory to learn about its production and discussed the issue of supplying more building stones to major construction sites. -0-

The fraternal Korean people are now rushing toward the goal of building a socialist power, overcoming the difficulties encountered, united close around the Workers' Party of Korea headed by General SecretaryKim Jong Un, he noted, adding: We are sincerely pleased with this as a good neighbor, good friend and good comrade.
He noted that General Secretary Xi Jinping and General SecretaryKim Jong Unhad several historic meetings and have kept close visits in various forms, guiding the traditional China-DPRK friendly and cooperative relations to a new era of history.
Ambassador Ri Ryong Nam said that on the occasion of the founding anniversary of the DPRK, the Korean people are recollecting with pride the glorious course in which they have dynamically advanced for building a powerful socialist country, despite all trials and difficulties, under the wise guidance of the great leader ComradeKim Il Sung, the great leader ComradeKim Jong Iland respected ComradeKim Jong Un.

headline: Spokesman for DPRK Ministry of National Defence Clarifies Stand
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK clarified the following stand through KCNA on Wednesday as regards the fact that the U.S. military and the ROK puppet army have more openly revealed their scheme for military confrontation with the DPRK recently, talking about response to someone's "WMD threat":
The U.S. forces and the warmongers of the ROK puppet army on Sept. 10 held a meeting of the WMD response committee, at which they agreed to set up an information-sharing system to cope with "potential WMD attack" by the DPRK, enhance the joint counteraction capability and intensify joint counteraction training.
What should not be overlooked is that the U.S. and the ROK called for strengthened joint defense posture, the keynote of which is to use military muscle against the DPRK, hyping someone's "WMD threat".
This is an open declaration of confrontation to make the use of nuclear and biochemical weapons against the DPRK in case of contingency on the Korean peninsula a fait accompli and accelerate the war preparations for its execution. It is also a grave move of aggravating the situation to push the danger of the use of WMDs to extremes.
The U.S. and the ROK got familiar with the procedures of "WMD response" during the recent large-scale joint military exercises Freedom Shield. This time they agreed to intensify the training involving nuclear and biochemical weapons again. This fact goes to prove that the enemy's plan to use WMDs has entered an extremely reckless phase.
The U.S. stated in its past "strategy for coping with WMDs" that it would establish a joint force capable of fighting in a nuclear and biochemical warfare environment and increase its investment in the research and development of WMDs under the pretext of "threat" from the DPRK and other sovereign states. This provides full explanation for the confrontational design and ultimate goal pursued by them.
In recent years, the U.S. has set up a network of 30 biological weapons research institutes in the territory of Ukraine and established biological laboratories in its military bases in the ROK. Furthermore, it has been intensifying military biological activities and biochemical weapons development in over 200 different parts of the world. It has also specified in the bill on national defence right for fiscal 2026 that it would spend hundreds of millions of dollars for the development, test, maintenance and operation of biochemical weapons.
Such situation goes to prove that the rumor about someone's "WMD threat" spread by the U.S. is nothing but an ill-intended pretext to cover up its development and proliferation of WMDs.
Such a threat of WMD attack and use by the enemy against the DPRK may be considered a crucial security challenge that requires the latter to invoke the relevant provision of the law on the state nuclear force policy.
I recommend that the U.S. correctly interprets the meaning  of the invoking of the relevant provision and accepts it as a grave warning.
The armed forces of the DPRK will always keep track of the new military attempts of the U.S. and its allied forces, regularly assessing their threat to its national security. -0-

headline: Int'l Security Affairs Analyst on Washington's Moves to Expand Nuclear Submarine Alliance
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 16 (KCNA) -- Choe Ju Hyon, an international security affairs analyst of the DPRK, released the following article "Washington's moves to expand nuclear submarine alliance - an absolute factor of disturbing global nuclear security":
Washington is getting more pronounced in the nuclear proliferation moves with the approach of the fifth anniversary of the AUKUS, the U.S.-led exclusive nuclear security technology alliance that threatens the foundation of the international nuclear non-proliferation system.
Recently, the U.S. naval chief executive made remarks intended to instigate Japan and the ROK to possess nuclear submarines, saying that Japan with atomic power plants has been already possessed of technology, the basis of nuclear submarines, and that the ROK needs to set the purpose of possession of nuclear submarine with its characteristics of distant navigation as a premise and so it is wrong to purchase it symbolically.
This is another telling evidence showing eloquently who is the major chieftain of the worldwide nuclear proliferation.
The U.S. has already put the AUKUS, the nuclear submarine proliferation matrix, to the fore, increasing the danger level of nuclear proliferation by geometrical progression, to ensure the practical application of the "America first" that resorts to all sorts of means and methods in disallowing "dominance" and "seizure" of other countries over strategically important regions.
The U.S. made the confrontational address of AUKUS clear through the sale of nuclear submarines and transfer of nuclear technology to Australia, joint development of deep-sea unmanned submarine, and regularization of various kinds of joint military exercises among member states. And it is trying to generalize the experience to the ROK, Japan and other allies. Such dangerous behavior is raising serious concern from the international community
Seoul suggested to Washington the issues of securing enriched uranium for nuclear fuel and revising the "U.S.-ROK Nuclear Agreement" for the acquisition of the right to enrichment intended to carry on its nuclear submarine building plan. And the rulers of Tokyo have unreservedly advocated the theory of possession of nuclear submarines. The reality goes to prove that Washington's plan for "AUKUS 2.0", which allows the transfer of nuclear technology for munitions to non-nuclear allies, has entered the phase of full-scale expansion.
The reckless acts of the ROK and Japan seeking access to nuclear submarines show what dangerous extent the U.S. military adventurism to contain its rival states in the Asia-Pacific region by setting up its allies as shock brigades has reached.
The U.S. outwardly calls for defence of the nuclear non-proliferation system, but inwardly seeks to unhesitatingly offer nuclear attack means to its junior allies for handsome profit. Such hypocritical behavior of the U.S. is nothing but a cheap trick to cover up its criminal trace of nuclear proliferation.
The NATO-style nuclear sharing model and its variant U.S.-ROK "Nuclear Consultative Group" and the U.S.-Japan "extended deterrence dialogue" are in normal operation. This reality clearly shows the harmful aftereffect of the U.S. dangerous nuclear proliferation on the global security environment.
The U.S. continued irresponsible and malicious practice in the nuclear field is the top risk factor accelerating the erosion of the international nuclear non-proliferation system, and this more strongly highlights the need for our state to bolster up its nuclear war deterrent means both in quality and quantity without the slightest stagnation and stalemate.
The international community should make a fair and uncompromising assessment of the U.S. scheme to bring about a catastrophic nuclear domino happening while getting keen on the nuclear proliferation in different parts of the world, and make concerted and responsible efforts against it. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on Sept. 17:
Violation of UNSC resolutions, threat to international peace and security, complete and irreversible denuclearization, honouring of international obligation…
As expected, such a string of nonsense we have so much heard was let out at the 70th Session of the IAEA (International Atomic Energy Agency) General Conference again.
They are all noises, not surprising and not new, as we can always hear them at this time every year, like the sounds from the automated teller machine.
Those who gathered to shout for changing the present position of our state should clearly understand what a foolish dream they have dreamed of and what a useless thing they are doing.
If they believe that it is really possible, they will be termed idiots knowing nothing of the world.
In fact, if there were no rogues behaving badly toward the DPRK, many countries would probably not need to waste time with empty talk but live in a safer and peaceful world.
No matter how loudly the IAEA and the West may cry out for denuclearization according to a ready-made script at their periodic meetings, they can have no impact on the determination and practical ability of the DPRK to take all necessary measures to defend the supreme interests of the state.
The DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state is something immutable, never to be reversed with anything, and its powerful existence makes a significant contribution to deterring the outrageous acts of international rogues and ensuring peace and security.
No matter the rhetorical denial by the hostile forces, the reality, in which the nuclear-armed position of the DPRK has been permanently fixed physically and legally, can never change.
Nobody and nothing can ever reverse the crucial change in the strength and position of the DPRK and deter it in the future, too. -0-

headline: Kosan Combined Fruit Farm
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- The Kosan Combined Fruit Farm is located in Kosan County, Kangwon Province of the DPRK.
The area, called Jingosan and Phunggosan in the past as it was muddy and windy, has turned into a socialist land of bliss in the era of the Workers' Party, making a leap forward in fruit production.
The farm is associated with the guidance of respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho has made painstaking efforts to provide the people with plenty of fruit.
One day in September 2016, he visited the farm and said that its apples of various varieties are pretty in color and delicious in taste, adding that the people would be glad to receive the apples harvested that year.
He set forth the tasks facing the farm, stressing that it should take the lead in holding high the banner of scientific fruit farming and completely settle the housing problem for its employees and more pig farms should be built to establish the food production cycle of fruit farming and animal husbandry.
True to his intention, the farm has over-fulfilled its production plan every year by directing efforts to the fruit farming.
It won a citation and a rotating pennant at the review of the  socialist emulation for increased production in the farming sector in 2016. And in 2017, it increased the fruit production more than 1.5 times by rationally arranging early, middle and late varieties.
The farm has a rich crop every year and supplies fruits to baby homes, orphanages, primary and secondary schools for orphans, old people's homes, hospitals, cities and counties including Wonsan City and Chonnae County. -0-

headline: Wonsan Kalma Cooking Festival-2026 Opens
Successes Made in Coal Industry of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 17 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, workers in the country's coal industry are making successes in the construction and reconstruction of high-capacity belt conveyors, while producing coal as planned.
The Chonsong Youth Coal Mine completed the updating of the existing belt conveyors in a short span of time and has stepped up the construction of new belt conveyors extending hundreds of meters.
The February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine finished the project for installing a new belt conveyor extending a hundred and dozens of meters and is remodeling the existing 1 500 meter-long belt conveyor.

The Jenam Coal Mine, too, is putting spurs to the remodeling of belt conveyors. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of National Defence Attends 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence took part in the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum held in China.
The forum on the theme of "Build Consensus on Stability, Advance Security Governance Together" brought together delegations, experts and scholars from more than 100 countries, regions and international organizations.
Kim Kang Il, vice-minister of National Defence who is heading the DPRK delegation, made a speech at the third full-dress meeting of the forum on Sept. 17.
Saying that it is the common desire of mankind to achieve independent development and prosperity in a peaceful world free from domination, subjugation, aggression and war, he noted that the DPRK has made every possible effort to ensure lasting peace and stability in the Korean peninsula, a hotspot of the world.
When the basis of global peace and stability has been seriously shaken owing to the recent brigandish and unlimited geopolitical greed and abuse of strength of the U.S. and its vassal forces, the aggressive military bloc sharing nuclear weapons has been expanded and strengthened and various military drills on the premise of using nukes have been openly staged in the Korean peninsula, gravely encroaching upon the security of our state, he pointed out.
He stated that the main reason why the situation of the Korean peninsula has not been freed from the evil cycle of confrontation and escalated tension is the reckless political and military confrontational moves of the U.S. and its vassal forces, which have gradually raised the level of preparations for a nuclear war, regarding the hostility toward the DPRK as their invariable state policy for many years.
The DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state, fixed by the Constitution, the supreme law of the state, is definite and irreversible, and the enemy countries with the most hostile and ferocious intention against it should stop criticizing the DPRK's just self-defence policy and abandon their unrealistic daydream for "denuclearization", he stressed.
He affirmed that the further the hostile forces maximize their nuclear threat to the DPRK and the more persistently they intensify their confrontation moves, the further the DPRK will steadily bolster up its nuclear war deterrent for self-defence on the principle of ensuring security and peace with great strength and thus reliably defend peace and stability in the Korean peninsula and the region.
Calling on the international community to properly understand the source of escalated tension in the Asia-Pacific region including the Korean peninsula and lift up the common voice for international justice, he stated that the DPRK would develop good-neighborly relations with all countries of the world aspiring after justice and independence and make joint efforts to oppose hegemony and unilateralism and establish a fair international order.
That day the head of the delegation of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence met with the minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.
Discussed at the talk were the issue for expanding practical cooperation and achieving the joint development of both sides by boosting the strategic communication between the armies of the two countries and promoting their mutual trust and the issue for strengthening cooperation to oppose hegemony, high-handed politics and tendency for neo-militarism in the international arena.
Meanwhile, the DPRK delegation visited the venue of the 14th China International Defence Exhibition and was invited to a reception given by the Chinese Ministry of National Defense. -0-

headline: Sanatorium for Disabled Soldiers Inaugurated in DPRK
Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- On the Wihwa Island in Sinuiju City of North Phyongan Province, the DPRK, there is the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm visualizing the rapid development in the era of the Workers' Party of Korea.
It is an ideal farm town in the new era, with good combination of a thousand and hundreds of greenhouses, vegetable science research center, modern houses, various bases for cultural life and peculiar landscape.
The Wihwa Island was a place where only sand dust was flying about by the strong river wind with natural disasters year by year.
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Ununfolded a grand blueprint for turning this barren island into a new model of regional development with full potential. And he visited it several times and energetically guided the gigantic project for regional development.
One day in September 2025, he guided on the spot the construction of the Sinuiju Combined Greenhouse Farm and the work for regional development, indicating the tasks and ways for successfully finishing the construction project, including the issue of putting the farm management on an IT and automation basis of high level.
The farm, inaugurated in February this year, has increased production as compared with the early days of its operation, harvesting hundreds of tons of vegetables of dozens of varieties every day to supply them to orphanages, baby homes, primary schools for orphans and commercial units.
It completed the rearrangement of farm fields of hundreds of hectares in a short span of time and directed efforts to manuring and cultivating rape by dint of science and technology. As a result, it has reaped a good harvest. -0-

headline: For People's Health
story_text:
Respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected the Samjiyon Potato Farina Production Factory in July 2018.
While going round the factory, he suddenly asked the accompanying officials about a hospital being built in the then county of Samjiyon.
He stressed that the hospital should be built as a model for other county hospitals across the country, giving an instruction to work out a plan for furnishing the hospital with all necessary equipment so as to enable it to satisfactorily fulfill its function and role as a mountainous county hospital.
He emphasized the need to supply good medical appliances not only to central hospitals but also to the highly populated regions or areas far away from big hospitals. He added that it would be inappropriate for the sick people in the model county to go to the provincial seat for medical examination.
That day he also stressed the need to take proper measures for ensuring medical care of the residents of the county during the reconstruction of the hospital. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The U.S.-led regular war rehearsals constitute the main source of ever-worsening situation of the Korean peninsula and the region" on Sept. 18:
The frantic military moves of the U.S. to destroy the balance of power in the Asia-Pacific region have profoundly negative impact on the situation of the Korean peninsula and the region.
Shortly ago, the U.S. staged the joint multinational naval drill Pacific Vanguard 2026 with Japan, the puppet ROK and other satellite forces in the waters near Guam.
During the war rehearsal, various naval training for U.S.-centered anti-warship, anti-air and anti-submarine warfare was staged intensively for more than ten days. This was another threatening "war game" invented by the U.S. for inter-camp confrontation in the region.
When it launched the first round of Pacific Vanguard in 2019, the U.S. did not conceal the confrontational nature of the drill, asserting that the drill is aimed at "effectively and cooperatively responding to various incidents that may occur in the region" and, the number of the countries involved in it is on the steady increase.
This is a part of the U.S. political and military design to prolong its hegemony by relying on the military strength of the exclusive camp in the Asia-Pacific region where there are many big powers regarded as its major rivals.
In fact, the U.S. realizes more keenly with the lapse of time that the reorganization in the relations of forces in the Asia-Pacific region is very unfavorable to the actualization of its ambition for hegemony.
Much upset by the fast-changing mechanical structure in the region, the U.S. seeks to pressurize other countries and expand the sphere of its military power by frequently staging big and small military exercises involving its vassal forces.
This year alone, many U.S.-led multinational military drills were conducted in the Asia-Pacific region, including the joint multinational drill Cobra Gold, the joint air drill Pitch Black, the largest-ever joint naval drill RIMPAC involving a number of NATO member states in Europe and the joint military drill Super Garuda Shield which was staged in parallel with Pacific Vanguard.
The above-said drills were also staged under the pretext of "enhancing capability for jointly coping with marine threats" and "checking joint operation capability in environment of complex air operation". All facts cast light on the sinister purpose of joint military drills.
In particular, Japan and the ROK have always joined such military training together and this unpleasant fact suggests that the U.S.-led bellicose military moves are being intensified with the U.S.-Japan-ROK tripartite military cooperation system in full operation as an axis.
The gravity of the U.S.-led multinational military maneuvers is further highlighted by the stark reality that the primary target of the U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military cooperation is the DPRK.
The regular U.S.-led war rehearsal is the main source of ever-worsening situation in the Korean peninsula and the region.
Such deplorable situation prevailing in the region, where the vicious cycle of escalating tensions is repeated due to the reckless provocative moves for hegemony of the U.S. seeking to put the region under their control through power concentration, reminds us more clearly of the things we should do.
In my personal opinion, it is inevitable that outsiders' greater threat to our national security makes our physical power grow stronger ceaselessly in a corresponding manner.
And all the unstable environments "provided" by the enemies are proving the validity and scientific accuracy of the DPRK's defence policy and emphasizing the inevitability of the steady upgrading of our national defence capability.
In some aspects, it can be said that the enemies give us good "help".
The present situation, in which new records are set in terms of practical action hostile toward the DPRK, stresses the need to break records in our responsive action, proportional or more offensive in its nature.
We are well aware that this is necessary.
Our will to defend our sovereignty will be expressed in clearer action and there will be never ever change in the course of intensifying the nuclear war deterrence.
I remind the enemy once again that if it is judged that the supreme interests of our nation and its military sovereignty and security environment in the region have been seriously violated by their military maneuvers, the armed forces of the DPRK will invoke the relevant provisions true to their constitutional obligations and mobilize all means available to cope with it. -0-

headline: Intensive Workshop for Officials in Construction Sector-2026 Held in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 18 (KCNA) -- The intensive workshop of officials in the construction sector-2026 took place in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, from September 13 to 17.
Present there were officials and commanding officers of the units in charge of major construction projects, officials in charge of designing, construction, building materials production and supervision, officials of the Cabinet, the Ministry of Construction and Building-Materials Industry, the Ministry of State Construction Control, the State General Bureau of Design and the Pyongyang Construction Commission, and officials of relevant departments of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Kim Jong Gwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an opening address.
The speaker noted that respected ComradeKim Jong Unset forth at the historic Ninth WPK Congress the important task of consolidating the foundation for strengthened national power, leading the people to a new civilization and promoting their wellbeing by continuing the construction campaign during the period of implementing the new long-term plan, too, and made sure that a decision on modernizing the coal-mine villages across the country was adopted at the Second Plenary Meeting of the Ninth Central Committee of the Party.
Expressing the belief that the intensive workshop would offer an occasion for making a fresh turn in the work of officials in the construction sector to uphold the Party's Juche-oriented idea on architecture and construction policy with their high political consciousness and professional qualifications as the core and pivot of the revolution in construction of the new era, he declared the opening of the workshop.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un's instructions on the work of the construction sector were courteously conveyed to the audiences.
Then lectures were given.
The workshop first dealt with the need for the officials to be well aware of the requirements of the Party policy, set forth for the construction sector, and thoroughly meet them.
Referring to the issues arising in successfully implementing the Party policy on optimizing the architectural designs, the workshop mentioned its significance and importance and the ways of ensuring the maximum economic effectiveness and profitability in producing architectural designs.
Attracting the attention of the participants were the lectures which explained, on the basis of the experience whose advantages and benefits have been proven in practice, the issue of applying pre-fab building methods to the construction of dwelling houses, an important issue arising in the qualitative construction of framework buildings and the issues of finishing building work and road construction.
Lectures underlined the need for the officials and commanding officers in the construction sector to fulfill their responsibility in the work for taking precautionary measures for labour safety at the construction sites, and for the officials in the construction inspection organs to do their bit on principle and in a scientific way.
The participants watched a video dealing with efficient and advanced construction methods, building materials, modern construction equipment and tools. They also made a field survey and engaged in a question-and-answer session at the Leisure Complex under construction in Kangnam County. This helped the officials in the construction sector broaden their knowledge and improve their professional qualifications.
Through the intensive workshop, the participants armed themselves more firmly with the Party's Juche-oriented architectural idea and construction policy and acquired new and wide-ranging technical knowledge, essential methodologies and best ways for pushing ahead with the grand construction campaign in the era of comprehensive development. They renewed their resolve to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the vanguard of the construction revolution as intended by the Party Central Committee. -0-

Receiving the birthday spread amid the congratulations of officials of the Party and power organs in the district, family members and relatives and neighbors, the centenarian expressed her gratitude to respected ComradeKim Jong Un.

After the national liberation, she took the lead in building a new country in response to the patriotic call of PresidentKim Il Sungand devoted herself to the victory in the Fatherland Liberation War.
She had discharged her revolutionary duty in a responsible manner for decades, playing her role as a good revolutionary forerunner and educator and encouraging her descendants to do more good things for the beloved motherland.

story_text:

story_text:

headline: Third Workshop for Officials in Information Sector of WPK Opens
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- The Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea was opened in Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on September 18 amid the traditional work being intensified in every sector to grasp again and rearm with the Party's ideas, theories and strategic policies in an overall and profound way to thoroughly guarantee the successful implementation of the revolutionary programme set forth at the historic Ninth WPK Congress.
The WPK Central Committee organized the workshop for the third time in the WPK's history to amplify the absolute superiority and mental and moral advantages peculiar to the DPRK emerging ever-victorious by dint of the ideology-first principle and to more thoroughly prepare the information workers of the whole Party into competent political activists and men of ability with matured qualifications and traits corresponding to the requirements of the new phase of development.
ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, guided the workshop.
When ComradeKim Jong Unappeared on the platform, the participants burst into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" as a token of their highest tribute to the outstanding political strategist, the great master of ideology and theory who is glorifying the DPRK as a dignified politico-ideological power to the whole world.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly waved back to the officials in the information sector of the whole Party who are devoting all their wisdom and enthusiasm to the sacred work to consolidate in every way the single-minded unity, the most powerful might of our Party and our social system, while linking the Party and the masses with one ideology and breath.
The first row of the platform was taken by Ri Il Hwan and Ju Chang Il, secretaries of the C.C., WPK, Pak Yong Il, secretary of the Korean People's Army Committee of the WPK, and First Vice Director Choe Chang Hak and other leading officials of the Information and Publicity Department of the C.C., WPK, and the second row by secretaries in charge of information work at the provincial and provincial-level committees of the WPK and leading officials of other relevant sector.
Attending the workshop were officials of the Information and Publicity Department and relevant departments of the C.C., WPK, officials in the information and publicity sector of provincial, city and county committees of the WPK and the Party committees performing the same functions, information workers of ministries, national agencies and other institutions, industrial establishments and farms, officials in the fields of revolutionary relics, theoretical information, class education, literature and art, and media, and officials of Party cadre training institutions and working people's organizations.
ComradeKim Jong Unmade an important speech on the occasion of the opening of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The Ninth Congress of the WPK indicated the direction of work covering an extensive sphere and the goals to be attained in view of the development phase of the Korean revolution and the requirements of the times and now our struggle is a entering a new phase in its sphere and all activities, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid, adding that we are waging a new struggle as we have made progress in all fields and therefore, a higher stage of struggle is needed.
Referring to the view of the Party Central Committee on the importance of the workshop for officials in the information sector, organized to more strictly adhered to the Party's consistent principle and stand of attaching importance to ideology and giving precedence to the ideological work in the course of pioneering a new era and a new sphere of struggle, he went on:
The course of development, which we have successfully pioneered so far, was made entirely thanks to the ideological resources our Party has long accumulated, the indomitable mental strength and courage of our people, not by relying on any conditions or circumstances.
This is stark reality recognized not only by ourselves but by the world.
In order to ensure the successful accomplishment of the gigantic and huge tasks set forth at the Ninth Congress of our Party in the future, too, it should be premised on and guaranteed by the inexhaustible ideological and mental strength of our Party and people.
In reality, the tasks facing us and the difficulties arising at the same time highlight with each passing moment that the key to solve all these problems is only in the strength of ideology and that the genuine prosperity and civilization, which we aspire to and aim at, lie in maximizing the might of the ideological work.
We are now particularly emphasizing the need to start all the undertakings from ideological work in order to further develop the extraordinary potential peculiar to the Korean revolution, which has advanced and triumphed by dint of ideology, to the level of the new era.
ComradeKim Jong Unappreciated that the information sector is now directing more efforts to intensifying the ideological offensive than ever before and, accordingly, the social atmosphere has been revved up and mass enthusiasm has been greatly uplifted.
However, we should be cautious of self-praise and self-satisfaction, encourage self-reproach and self-reflection and always maintain the revolutionary and responsible work style of struggling in mental agony and pains and working with a foresighted way and on a long-term basis, he said, reviewing and analyzing the deviations latent in the information work.
Noting that the fundamental improvement in the ideological work and the qualitative strengthening of the ideological position are urgently needed at present when many changes have taken place in the subjective and objective environments and the sphere of socialist construction is being expanded incomparably, he said that it is important to consolidate the Party information force in every way so as to meet the requirement of our Party and the developing revolution at present and further intensify the ideological work, the most important in the Party work.
It seems that the trend of change in objective environment is now faster than the transformation of means and methods of ideological work, he said, adding it is a principled requirement consistently maintained by our Party that the positive change in our Party's ideological work with the excellent history and tradition should naturally surpass the trend of change of the times and that ideological work should be conducted in an offensive manner ahead of reality.
ComradeKim Jong Unin his speech particularly stressed that the issue that should be always prioritized is to lead the social development with ideological work.
He said: We have the great ideology and theories that can not be found in any other parts of the world, excellent tradition of ideological work and well-regulated ideological work system and order.
If all comrades present here powerfully guide the qualitative improvement in ideological work as required by the times and the developing revolution, it will be possible to reliably ensure the steady advance of our revolutionary cause, to say nothing of the implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Expecting all the participants to study in depth the contents of the workshop in an active and sincere manner in combination with the immediate and practical requirements and long-term demand of the revolution, ComradeKim Jong Unstressed as follows:
Each era of the revolution and struggle demands the might of ideology peculiar and suited to it.
Today's ideological campaign should be an innovative, creative and offensive one leading the times.
It is easy to follow the old ones, but this is very dangerous. Whereas, it is difficult to create new ones suitable for today, but this is very necessary.
We must not forget that many well-known and unknown information workers active in the annals of our revolution had devoted much wisdom and efforts to fulfilling their revolutionary duty assigned by their eras and, consequently, the precious ideological wealth of our revolution and the tradition of ideological work were provided.
When you actively explore and apply new, novel and effective means and methods of information work that meet the requirements of the Party, the times and the reality, our ideological position will become stronger with the rapid advance of our times.
Therefore, all the participants should have a correct understanding of the importance and significance of the current workshop and devote themselves to acquiring the essence, the knack and matured methodology of ideological work in line with the intention of the Party Central Committee, thus making the period of the workshop a useful and meaningful occasion.
Expressing once again the stand of the Party Central Committee that attaches greater importance and expectation in the current workshop, which will serve as a milestone of epochal turn to register another clear page in our Party's history of ideological work, than any other sectional conference or workshop, ComradeKim Jong Undeclared the opening of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The participants in the workshop responded with enthusiastic cheers and applause to the revolutionary stand of ComradeKim Jong Unwho manifested his will to firmly consolidate the precious tradition of the Korean revolution, which was pioneered and has emerged victorious with ideology, as the mainstay for the eternal victory of our cause.
The national anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea was played.
Choe Chang Hak, first vice director of the Information and Publicity Department of the C.C., WPK, made a report.
The reporter said that the past two years since the Second Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK were a sacred revolutionary journey, in which the political and ideological position of the DPRK was further consolidated despite manifold trials and adversity under the outstanding guidance of Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unand the leadership and invincibility of our Party dynamically ushering in a new era of comprehensive development by dint of ideology were fully demonstrated.
He noted that the General Secretary attached greater importance to the Party ideological work as socialist construction expanded day by day and the advance speed of the revolution accelerated and indicated the important guidelines for increasing the might of ideology and the effectiveness of ideological work to the maximum.
While energetically guiding the ideological work of the Party to make it a fresh and effective political work process suited to the requirements of the times and the developing revolution and our national status and prestige with clear purpose and aim, the General Secretary clarified ideas and theories which serve as precious treasures for further enriching the treasure house of ideological building of the WPK for their profundity and scientific accuracy, the reporter stressed.
The reporter recalled that the General Secretary put forth the ideological work as the main focus of the Party work and set a great model and precious example of solving all the problems through political work of enlisting the might of ideology in the course of the struggle to usher in a period of comprehensive development for national rejuvenation.
The recent trend of change witnessed in the field of ideological work, in which brisk activities are being launched to constantly explore and apply new forms and methods in conformity with the people's mentalities, is attributable to the energetic leadership of the General Secretary who indicated concrete methodology for information and motivation work to the details, he said.
The report stressed the importance and urgency of innovation in the ideological work being further highlighted in the present struggle to consolidate the successes made in the course of opening up the era of comprehensive development and lead them to a greater result.
Saying that the Party information sector is faced with the important revolutionary task for modeling the whole Party and society on the revolutionary idea of the Party Central Committee and giving full play to the inexhaustible ideological and mental strength of all the people in the struggle to attain the new long-term goals set forth at the Ninth Congress of the Party, the reporter referred to the principled issues for more thoroughly preparing the officials in the Party information sector as faithful spokespersons of the Party Central Committee and the revolution.
The present era calls the masters of the ideological campaign, who have acquired the Juche-oriented theory of giving importance to ideology as their mental qualities, to the forefront of the struggle, the reporter said, calling for deeply grasping the great revolutionary ideas and leadership mode of ComradeKim Jong Unand his noble outlook on the people and thoroughly applying them to the Party ideological work and thus making great innovations and leaps forward in information and motivation work and more vigorously and dynamically opening up a new era of strengthening the whole Party and rejuvenating the whole state.
Ri Il Hwan appeared in the first lecture.
All the participants, who received the warm encouragement and expectation of Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unin boundless excitement, are taking part in the workshop with high political awareness and enthusiasm. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement "The prejudiced viewpoint and double standards of the IAEA are the main factor that incurred the collapse of the international nuclear non-proliferation system" on Sept. 19:
With the 70th Session of the IAEA General Conference held in Vienna of Austria as an occasion, the IAEA's chronic prejudice and double-standard behavior was revealed again.
On September 17, the IAEA forcibly adopted an anti-DPRK "resolution" to call into question our state's self-defensive and legitimate nuclear activities, disregarding the grave situation in which the DPRK's security environment is exposed to constant nuclear threat of outside forces.
Such meaningless and inefficient "resolution", which the IAEA is cooking up every year at the instigation of the U.S. and the West, is not something new for us and has no effect on the DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state.
The nuclear activities of the DPRK, a nuclear weapons state outside the NPT which withdrew from the IAEA through legal routes decades ago, are not object of jurisdiction of the IAEA and, the agency has no authority or qualifications to interfere in them.
Therefore, we never recognize any anti-DPRK "resolution" cooked up in the arena of the IAEA.
On the other hand, the IAEA has consistently kept silence, failing to say a right word about the undisguised nuclear proliferation act of the U.S., a depository of the NPT, and the grave plan for the introduction of nuclear submarine by the ROK, a non-nuclear state.
This is another typical example clearly showing the extreme two-faced nature and prejudice of the agency.
As a result, the IAEA vividly revealed its true nature as a Western power organization, unfortunately and completely being deprived of its representative character and impartiality as a UN specialized organization and representing only the interests of the U.S. and its allies.
The double standard of the IAEA is not confined to the Korean peninsula but is being witnessed in Europe, Oceania, the Middle East and other parts of the world.
The fact that the U.S. deployed nuclear weapons in Europe and shared them with NATO member states, while wantonly violating the non-proliferation obligation of NPT stipulating that nuclear weapons and their management should not be handed over directly and indirectly to anyone, the fact that it actively dragged the ROK and Japan in its plan for nuclear weapons use and its implementation under the pretext of "offer of extended deterrence" and the fact that it is planning to provide nuclear submarine technology for the ROK - all those facts do not become the subject of discussion and concern of the agency in any case.
Moreover, the agency is disregarding Japan's unusual excess accumulation of weapons-grade nuclear materials under the patronage of the U.S. despite the protest of the international community.
The two-faced nature of the agency has led to the creation of a new "nuclear non-proliferation standard" whereby the nuclear activities of a relevant country are regulated as "legitimate" or "illegal" according to whether the nuclear issue is of the West or not. This is the present reality of the nuclear non-proliferation system led by the U.S. and the West.
In fact, the IAEA has certainly been reduced to the U.S. atomic energy organization, and it is no exaggeration to say that the international nuclear non-proliferation system has degenerated into the U.S.-led nuclear proliferation system.
The injustice, prejudice and double standards of the IAEA are the main factors eroding the nuclear non-proliferation system on a global scale, and the U.S. open nuclear proliferation behavior being committed in parallel with this is a serious threat disturbing international peace and security and increasing the danger of outbreak of a nuclear war.
The main mission of the IAEA is to provide all member states with the right to peaceful use of nuclear power and to block the military use of nuclear technology, and it is by no means to connive at and foster undisguised nuclear proliferation.
In my personal view, the IAEA might save its disgraced face even a bit if it takes courage to say a single right word about who is the chieftain of undermining the nuclear non-proliferation system.
The further the IAEA interferes in the sovereignty and internal affairs of the DPRK, a non-member state, the worse its reputation and fame will be damaged, and it should judge by itself who will benefit from it.
Conniving at the nuclear threat and proliferation of the U.S. and other hostile forces and asking the DPRK to abandon its nuclear weapons are just like telling us to give up our existence and right to live.
We will not in any case mortgage our sovereignty and security rights to the "tolerance" of the U.S. and the West.
The present grave geopolitical situation, in which the international nuclear order is at the brink of complete collapse due to the radical nuclear arms buildup and undisguised nuclear proliferation of the U.S. and to the double-dealing behavior and lack of principle of the IAEA, requires the DPRK to make a more responsible option.
It is the most important matter for the national security to ensure that the credibility of the nuclear force is not questioned in any case for the DPRK which is constantly exposed to the nuclear threat of the hostile forces. -0-

The DPRK has not been a member of the NPT and the IAEA from long ago and, therefore, it is illegal and the height of impudence to talk about the position of our state and its efforts to bolster up the defence capabilities.
The DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state does not need the recognition of the U.S., the West and the IAEA. It is guaranteed by the actual nuclear deterrent and irreversibly and permanently fixed by the supreme law of the state.
Pitifully, the "resolution" cooked up by the U.S. and the West has no effect on the DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state.
No matter how desperately the hostile forces may try to deny our constitutional position in and around the IAEA, the position of the DPRK as a nuclear weapons state, which is permanently and absolutely settled by the law, is irreversible.
It is the DPRK's invariable line of national defence to more offensively implement its strategic and long-term plans for building reliable self-defensive deterrent to cope with the ever-worsening international security environment.
As a responsible nuclear weapons state, the DPRK will as ever firmly defend the sovereignty and fundamental interests of the state and thoroughly guarantee peace and security in the region and the rest of the world by deterring all challenges and threats from outside by overwhelming force. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnGuides Work of Defence Industry
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 19 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, learned about the production at major munitions industrial enterprises from September 16 to 18.
He was accompanied by Vice-Chairman Pak Jong Chon and member Kim Jong Sik of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, and Ri Pyong Chol, Ri Il Hwan, Kim Yo Jong, Kim Jae Ryong and O Yong Jae, who are cadres of the Central Committee of the WPK, and leading officials in the sector of defence science research.
ComradeKim Jong Unlearned in detail about the production of each enterprise.
In hearty response to the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK, the major munitions industrial enterprises turned out in attaining the new year's production goals. They are steadily increasing the revolutionary enthusiasm and making upsurge in production, recording high results every day.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly encouraged the working class who are reliably stepping up the radical growth of our munitions industry and its more independent and advanced development through their energetic and devoted labour struggle, always full of revolutionary zeal.
He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the major munitions industrial enterprises are fulfilling their plans for the production of combat equipment on the most important indices of urgent military significance in a responsible manner without fail and, as a result, the huge plans issued by the Party Central Military Commission are being successfully carried out one by one.
He appreciated the major munitions industrial enterprises for carrying on without an inch of deflection the projects for expanding the production capacity assigned by the Party to meet the requirements of the all-round plan for reorganizing and modernizing the artillery combat force of our army.
Stressing that the fulfillment of this year's production plans is most essential in attaining the new Five-Year Plan aimed at fresh progress and leap forward in the building of a powerful army and the defence industry, he said that the major munitions industrial enterprises should continue to consolidate the current trend in production and dynamically and simultaneously conduct a series of technical infrastructure reinforcement for promoting the long-term munitions production plans.
He said that the building of a powerful artillery force is the core for deterring and fighting war, adding that our artillery should have the most concentrated and destructive, massive and versatile offensive capability and responsibly perform the two missions of deterring and fighting war. He stressed that the achievements made by the DPRK in all fields to modernize all components of the national defence capability including artillery are meaning a significant change in the composition and means of our armed forces and their plan for countering a war. Stating that the enemy's military systems would be gradually damaged and useless by action of the irresistible might which we have already possessed or will soon possess, he said that the munitions industrial enterprises at all levels under the Second Economy Commission should play a bigger role in carrying out the strategic policy of the Party on building the most powerful army and the country's munitions industry should be further expanded and strengthened.
He said that the production success at the major munitions industrial enterprises is not merely significant for increased production but it is of weight significance as it is undoubtedly a product of the will and efforts of the working class to defend our sovereign security, and this is a great contribution for the state.
Stressing that major munitions industrial enterprises have a very pivotal role to play in steadily augmenting the country's war deterrent and war-fighting capability, he encouraged them to vigorously continue their patriotic production drive for steadily equipping our army with the most powerful and overwhelming strategic strength.
He clarified important policy-oriented tasks for the enterprises' production and management, including the issue of steadily accelerating the expansion of production capacity and the modernization of technical processes, raising the level of artificial intelligence of offensive and defensive combat weapon systems and putting the armor and automation of artillery weapons on a higher stage and the issue of bettering the conditions and environment for production.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that all the officials, technicians and workers serving at important core factories would continue to fully display their inherent creation spirit and fighting spirit and thus powerfully propel the radical strengthening of our armed forces. -0-

headline: Janggun Peak of Mt Paektu, Natural Monument of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 20 (KCNA) -- Janggun Peak is the highest peak of Mt Paektu.
Janggun Peak is 2 750 meters above sea level. It represents the height of Mt Paektu. It is the highest of the mountains of the DPRK and is one of the highest peaks in Northeast Asia.
It was called Paektu Peak in the past, but now is called Janggun Peak, reflecting the unanimous desire of the Korean people to convey the revolutionary exploits of PresidentKim Il Sungshining along with Mt Paektu to posterity.
The earth on Janggun Peak melts to a depth of about 70 centimetres only in three months of a year, and underneath it is permafrost.
During the short period of three-month thawing season, hundreds of kinds of flowers bloom at the foot of Mt Paektu to exhibit a unique scenery of the alpine region.
Janggun Peak of Mt Paektu was registered as a natural monument as it is of high value in studying the characteristics of the alpine region. -0-
