headline: Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry Spokesperson
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on Monday:
The foolish behavior of the U.S. and the West is again sparking off criticism and ridicule of the world as they have openly ignored the principles of international law with respect for sovereignty and non-interference as the core and sought to save the structure of sanctions and pressure on the DPRK from its total bankruptcy.
Recently, the U.S.-led "multilateral sanctions monitoring team (MSMT)" cooked up and announced a "report" pulling up the beneficial and routine economic cooperative relations between the DPRK and other countries and thus vividly revealed its true colors as a plot-breeding organization which distorts normal as abnormal and brands legal as illegal.
The MSMT is a ghost group lacking any legality in the justification and purpose of existence. Its illegal act committed under the signboard of implementing the UN "resolution" is just a violation of the UN Charter and international law and a mockery of the international community.
The U.S.-led isolated minority group has never been given the mission and authority to act on behalf of the UN, and "resolutions" against the DPRK cooked up by the UN Security Council wantonly violating the sovereignty and the rights to development of a sovereign state have never been recognized by the DPRK.
What the MSMT, made up of pseudo experts addicted to the compilation of sanctions, has done is nothing but to devise all sorts of conspiracy theories under the U.S. command, and there is no room for discussion about the reliability and objectivity of such documents they have produced.
The DPRK's relations of exchange and cooperation with other countries cannot be subject to interference or investigation of a third party in any case as they are the exercise of legitimate rights under bilateral and multilateral treaties and agreements.
The UN Charter stipulates as one of the main purposes of the UN to develop friendly relations among nations on the principle of equality and self-determination, and the declaration on the principles of international law on friendship and cooperation among nations under the UN Charter, adopted as Resolution 2625 of the UN General Assembly, specifies that any country or group of states has no right to interfere in the internal affairs and external affairs of other countries.
What should be questioned and rejected in the present international relations are bad behaviors of the U.S. and the West openly conducted worldwide, in contravention of the purpose and principle of the UN Charter which disallows the use of and threat by force against the political independence and territorial integrity of any country.
No matter how zealously the U.S. and the West resort to chop logic, it is unchangeable that the MSMT is no more than a political tool for ensuring their specific interests and pressurizing sovereign states.
No matter what new document of sanctions the hostile forces may cook up and no matter what semblance of "legality" they may give to their illegal conspiratorial organization, they cannot break the steadfast will of the DPRK to thoroughly defend its core interests and grow stronger nor check its constant development trend.
The DPRK, as in the present so in the future, too, will never tolerate the malicious attempt of the hostile forces to bind and obstruct the state development and normal and reciprocal cooperative relations of independent countries but will strongly counter it and thoroughly defend the dignity and development interests of the state. -0-

headline: Mt Kuwol
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 21 (KCNA) -- Mt Kuwol is a famous mountain on the west coast of the DPRK.
The mountain, located in the northwestern part of South Hwanghae Province, has peculiar seasonal looks. In particular, it is spectacular in autumn. Visitors can feast their eyes on the mountain covered with red and yellow maple leaves from the middle to the end of September. It is said that its name originated from the ninth month of the year (kuwol in Korean) when its beauty is at its height. The mountain has 99 high or low peaks, including the highest Sahwang Peak. Long weathering and erosion shaped all the peaks into wonderful ones.
In its deep valleys there are waterfalls, such as the Ryongyon Falls and the Samhyongje Falls, and small ponds.
The mountain has many historic spots, including Tangundae, said to be the place where Tangun who founded Ancient Korea cultivated his courage, and the Woljong Temple dating back more than 1 000 years.
In the autumn of 1996, ChairmanKim Jong Ilvisited the Kuwolsan Pleasure Ground under construction, where he said that the picturesque mountain is one of the country's famous mountains and that it would be very good to turn it into a holiday resort for the people as it has many historic spots, legends and the height suitable for mountaineering.
He called for developing the mountain into another eternal asset for the people.
The mountain has transformed into a popular holiday destination under the people-oriented policy of the Party and the state.
The area was registered as a part of the World Network of Biosphere Reserves in 2004 for its eye-catching mountainous terrain, wonderful valleys and biodiversity. -0-

headline: Crime of Japan, Sworn Enemy of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Japanese reactionaries, not content with suppressing Koreans in Japan, committed the crudest sort of evil act against defenseless girl students wearing Korean chima (skirt) and jogori (jacket).
Typical example is the violence against a Korean schoolgirl happened in Japan in November 1983.
Letting loose outburst that "Koreans get out of Japan", a Japanese gangster hit a girl in Korean dress on the head to trance with a wooden club when she was coming back from the school.
Early in December, 10-odd days later from that incident, another Korean schoolgirl suffered a sword stroke by a gangster.
The General Association of Korean Residents in Japan and Japan-resident Koreans strongly demanded an immediate probe into the cases and the prevention of reoccurrence, but the Japanese police authorities shut their eyes to the criminal acts while postponing the investigation and dismissing them as "game of tag by some hooligans".
Similar incidents continued to occur thereafter.
More than 160 cases of such violence against Korean schoolgirls were reported in Japan in 1994 alone.
In November 1998, a girl student of Tokyo Korean Middle and High School was stabbed on the way home from Sinjuku Station. Such violence against Korean schoolgirls wearing skirt and jacket ran up to tens or hundreds of cases every year from the early 1980s to the late 1990s.
Over such incidents occurred afterwards, a Japanese newspaper said that a monster appeared in Japan to doggedly commit all sorts of curses and outrages against weak Korean schoolgirls wearing chima and jogori and that Japan seemed to be a land good for the monster to live in. -0-

headline: DPRK Missile Administration Tests New, Important Combat Weapon System
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea successfully tested a new-type weapon, which is of great significance in the rapid technological development of weapon systems, on September 20.
The test did not have any adverse impact on the security of neighboring countries.
It is an extension of the regular activities of the DPRK Missile Administration and its defence science research institutes aimed at implementing the national defence policy.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the test.
Saying that the test was undoubtedly a striking demonstration of ultra-modern defence technology and clear progress in the modernization of the armed forces, he stressed that it represents the irresistible might.
To acquire such a technology is of weighty significance in the state's readiness for war and the future development of the armed forces, he said, adding that the enemy will know better what such progress means without any explanation in the aspect of military technology. He affirmed that such reality would give the enemy an incurable headache and a very cruel and unavoidable blow.
Today's success is the priceless fruit brought by a special think tank of the sci-tech forces involved in development of the important weapon system for a specific purpose and their sincere efforts, he said, expressing thanks to the Missile Administration and its defence science institutes and working groups. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of Culture Leaves for Russia
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of Culture of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Hyon Un Chol, minister of Culture, left here on September 21 to attend the 12th Sankt-Peterburg International Cultural Forum.
It was seen off at Pyongyang International Airport by Pak Kyong Chol, vice-minister of Culture, and Vladimir Topekha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here. -0-

headline: Successes Made in Rolling-stock Production
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- According to Minju Joson, the Kim Jong Thae Electric Locomotive Complex in the DPRK makes progress in the rolling-stock production.
The complex has ensured the management of equipment in a sci-tech way and raised their operation rate to produce steel castings and forgings needed for the manufacture of electric locomotives.
The production of electric locomotives, tourist trains and tram cars is steadily increasing and the test-run is being conducted to ensure the technical performance of newly-manufactured rolling-stock. -0-

headline: Performance Reflecting Sprit of Times
story_text:
One day in September 2015, respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unenjoyed an art performance given by the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the Socialist Patriotic Youth League.
Congratulating the team on its successful performance, he said with high appreciation that the performance carried all what he wanted to say to the youth and it is a performance pulsating with the spirit of the times, the best of the performances of artistic information teams he has ever watched so far.
The creators and members of the artistic information team were deeply moved by his tender-hearted love.
The respected fatherly Marshal said to them in a great excitement that the artistic information team of the Central Committee of the youth league should, in the future, too, conduct its performing activities in an offensive way in conformity with the characteristics of young people who have a strong enterprising and are sensitive to new approaches.
His high appreciation reflected his deep trust and expectation that the artistic information team would fulfill its responsibility and duty. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnMakes Important Speech at Closing Ceremony of Third Workshop for Officials in Information Sector of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an important speech at the closing ceremony of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK on September 21.
He said in the speech:
Comrades,
I think that this workshop has been conducted well in keeping with the intended purpose of making it an important occasion for bringing about an innovation in the ideological work.
First, you must have acquired a full understanding of our Party's immutable ideology-first principle, the common aspiration to a new level of ideological work demanded by the times and its indispensability.
While attending the opening ceremony of the workshop and receiving the report on its daily course, I could feel the high degree of determination and passion of the participants who, with a unanimous awareness of the compelling mission of the times to transform the ideological work, have maintained self-consciousness and attitude to learn even one more thing.
Such attitude of yours has made me, General Secretary, quite pleased.
I could reaffirm that the information workers are surely higher in political awareness, more sensitive and more enthusiastic than the officials in other sectors.
I am convinced that as the ranks of information workers are so prepared ideologically and so exalted spiritually, I can expect more vigorous efforts and substantial changes in the strengthening of the ideological front, the ideological work, from now on.
You must not have learned all the contents of the practical information work in the few days of the workshop, and you will have to promote development while continuing to learn during your practical work. But I think this workshop must have been an important occasion for renewing your sacred revolutionary consciousness and sense of heavy responsibility that we should increase our ideological resources and consolidate the guarantee of succession to our cause.
This is important, I think.
What matters is how we apply this into practice from now on.
More important and valuable than countless oral determinations are propagation of truth that, even though once, raises and develops the consciousness of the masses and the high-pitched motivation work that inspires them with enthusiasm and courage.
Today, before the closing of the workshop, I would like to stress some more points for the information workers, the core frontline workers of our Party.
Comrades,
We need to be always aware of what we should be like as communists.
That is the Juche-oriented theory of ideology that should never change even though everything else in the world may change, and we are thoroughgoing advocates of the ideology-first principle.
Anything else cannot display the strength of the revolutionary ideology as much, nor can it overwhelm the strength.
We are now absolutely confident in our future because we have ideological assets that we have accumulated in the long course of the revolutionary struggle and that will display their inexhaustible might in the future, too.
The biggest asset of our Party is the great revolutionary ideology as well as the powerful forces for the information and motivation work that can turn the ideology into strength for transformation, and the ever-victorious leadership ability of our Party is just based on the strength of its peculiar information and motivation work.
We should prove this in the proud history of perfectly implementing what we aspire to and what we are going to achieve.
As we all experience, the struggle tasks we are faced with are not a representation of the goals we set in the past decades, but their striking development as well as another transformation in the dynamic course of our revolution.
As long as we have shaped the course and assumed the heavy tasks for ourselves, we must carry them out by our own efforts.
What are essential and urgent in the new struggle course are not any material foundations but the patriotic enthusiasm and extraordinary courage of all officials, Party members and other citizens and the strength of ideological motivation capable of amplifying the enthusiasm and courage for pioneering and creation.
Now is the time for all the people, ranging from leading officials to the citizens living in tips of this country, to stake their destiny and future on the development of the state, orient their wisdom and enthusiasm to the goals of a new stage, and overcome all challenges and obstacles with their indomitable fighting spirit and proactive creative initiative.
Being overpowered by objective factors and adapting to them is something that is alien to us, Korean revolutionaries. We should consistently maintain our unique principle of shaping our future and winning opportunities on the strength of the ideology-first principle whereby we synthesize all the people's great spiritual potentials and patriotic exertion in a concentrated way and bring them into full play.
We should harden our revolutionary stand to realize our ideals without fail by holding higher the banner of ideological oneness, which others cannot hold up even if they want to, namely, the philosophy based on the ideological theory that only our Party can advance in making the revolution with a great people.
Comrades,
After this workshop is over, the masses of Party members and other people will certainly focus their attention on our information workers' attitude and style of work, closely watching their future activities.
As a matter of fact, our people are now looking forward to new changes and innovations in the information and motivational work and cultural creation, which will inspire them in their struggle and enrich their life.
The tasks facing the Party's information sector are much heavier than they were in the past, and accordingly, the Party, the revolution and the times demand a great deal from its information workers.
The wider the area of our advance becomes and the faster we move forward, the greater challenges and difficulties we will inevitably face, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid, stressing that responsible and sincere thinking and efforts are required to overcome one bottleneck after another.
He continued:
Our Party's information work should be improved remarkably and it should be more skilful, profound and effective than ever before.
This can be called a challenge for our information workers to overcome, or a big mountain for them to scale.
They should resolutely overcome this challenge with a renewed sense of their mission and through strenuous exertion, thus making sure that this workshop is recorded in our Party's history as a significant milestone in bringing about innovations and improvement in its overall ideological work.
We should, first of all, develop and enrich the contents of ideological education in keeping with the requirements and characteristics of the new era.
The might of ideological work is determined by its contents, and the development of its contents demands improvement of its forms, methods and means.
Sticking to the conventional contents and materials in disregard of the rapid and diversifying changes in the present era or repeating stereotyped logics and arguments cannot be called otherwise than an anachronistic error.
We keep setting ourselves greater ideals and goals in the economy, national defence, culture and all other realms of social life, which we translate into reality at a rapid pace, and our people are witnessing substantial changes in their living environment. Such being the case, the contents of our Party's ideological work should be composed and enriched in an innovative fashion.
By this I never mean that we should reject or reform the traditional contents of our ideological education, but that we should develop them in depth as required by the cause of the advancing revolution.
Therefore, achieving new innovations and a radical improvement in the information and education work should naturally begin with an in-depth development of the contents of the ideological education.
After referring to the importance of conducting the information and education work in a logical and realistic way, ComradeKim Jong Unwent on:
In ensuring that all the people cherish our truthful and advantageous ideology and policies as an element of their unshakeable faith, and in making our ideology and policies serve as a source of their great strength with which to brave difficulties and trials, no method is better than giving them a clear theoretical understanding of the justice of their cause and the inevitability of its victory.
If we adopt a schematic and cramming approach towards the information work, regardless of the principles of things and phenomena and the laws of life and cognition, the truth may be perverted or distorted, and this will finally evoke suspicion and denial.
It is beyond dispute that the ideological education should be not only logical but also down-to-earth.
Truth has an absolute power that defies description by any flowery language.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that if there were ten or one hundred prescriptions for educating people in the past era, there should be one thousand or ten thousand prescriptions in the present era, and went on:
To base oneself on the concrete living conditions and environment of the people and their psychology is just to base oneself on the reality.
You, information workers, should prepare a lecture plan while always delving into people's inner thoughts and feelings and putting yourselves in their place, and give them an explanation in a way that you can build rapport with them through it and it can result in a substantial change in their cognition.
The forms and means of our information and education work should also steadily be updated in keeping with the development of the times.
The originality and influence of the ideological education work also depend largely on its forms and means, as well as its contents and methods.
As the saying goes, clothing makes the man. Even if it is a good material for information and education, it can neither draw the interest and attention of the masses nor have influence on their thoughts and feelings without the help of new forms and means.
People reject even the right words, if the method is trite. This is human psychology.
ComradeKim Jong Unsaid it is a lesson of history that an ideology can either be a source of inexhaustible strength for victory and success or be a terrible toxin for frustration and failure, according to how much a party and a state that are building socialism attach importance to ideological work and how they conduct it, and continued:
If we do not pay attention to ideological education and arming of people with a spirit and to making constant innovations in this regard, while praising ourselves over the modern buildings rising up and the appearance of the country undergoing changes, it will be as good as building a castle on sand by depleting the foremost resources of the state.
The advance of the times is the flow of people's struggle and life and, therefore, in order to apply the character of the times to the ideological work, we should make an in-depth study of the people of today and explore and apply new forms, means and methods to suit them.
The information sector should concentrate the thinking and study on achieving greater effectiveness by finding out and grasping the forms and means that can attract the people, even if the contents of ideological education is on the same theme, and make the creation of new things a habitual trait.
It should not confine itself to conducting information and education work, but constantly improve it by making a scientific and quantitative analysis of how much it is effective and which means, forms and methods are most effective.
And efforts should be directed to the use of modern IT and other technical means in the direction of increasing the promptness and effectiveness of the information and education work and completely stopping the spread of reactionary ideology and culture.
Comrades,
The demand for innovation of ideological work boils down to the demand for the increasing of the awareness and capabilities of the officials in the information sector of the Party.
In order for our ideological work to raise the revolutionary spirit and revolutionary fighting morale of the masses and lead the times, information workers should be the first to have an extraordinary sense of responsibility and devotion.
As the information and education work is the work with the psychology of the people in all walks of life, even a lecture or motivation for increased production requires much effort.
The character of information workers, who can find the worth of making the revolution in doing difficult work without regarding it as trouble, is formed and consolidated just by an unusual sense of responsibility.
The mind of officials in the information sector should always be dominated by a sense of responsibility that if they fall back, their units, regions and sectors will collapse, and filled with the thinking and search as to how to improve the information work.
It is the responsible attitude of Party information workers to be able to feel the psychology of the masses even through a single word by them or a look of their eyes and promptly respond to the negative ideological elements with a keen sense as sharp as the blade of a knife touching the flesh.
They, whose life and blood can be said to be ideology, should fulfil their duty not only at work but also in their daily life. If they, who transmit the Party's ideas and policies, say this in front of the masses and act in a different way behind the scenes, it will foster distrust among the masses and cause the consequence of destroying the ideological position by themselves.
Officials in the information sector should not compromise with negative practices that are detrimental to the Party's ideology and the socialist principles, even if they may be struck by lightning or threatened with a dagger on their neck. In particular, they should never be involved in abuse of power, bureaucracy and accumulation of wealth by illicit means.
To decisively improve their level and abilities is a pressing task which has a direct bearing on the substantial innovation of the ideological work.
Recently it has been continually stressed that officials throughout the Party should acquire good writing and oratorical abilities, and these abilities are all the more vital and essential for information workers.
Party information workers should be fully versed in the Party's ideas and policies, ever prepared to influence the masses with the Party's intentions at any place and at any time and to give proper guidance and assistance to the work of primary information workers, and they should make steady efforts to improve their qualifications.
They should be all-round officials who are qualified politically and ideologically, well-versed in economic affairs and modern science and technology, and rich in cultural attainments and emotions.
Today, every field and unit needs talented personnel more than ever before, but the information sector demands that every worker be a talented person.
The information sector should take revolutionary measures to decisively improve the level of political and theoretical qualifications and practical abilities of its workers, and I think that it is natural that the endeavour to this end should begin in the Information and Publicity Department of the Party Central Committee.
It is natural that the department should plan and vigorously lead the innovative, creative and offensive ideological campaign required by the present era.
By forcefully pushing ahead with an all-out ideological campaign, it must restore its original features and resilience as the department which specializes in leading the Party's ideological work as a whole and conducting information and motivation work.
It should work out a scrupulous plan for innovating the Party-wide ideological work, adopt scientific, realistic and novel tactical measures, and make it its daily routine to strictly review information and motivation work on the basis of its efficiency and take relevant measures.
A change in the level and work style of its officials will bring about an improvement in the professional qualifications and work style of the information workers of the entire Party.
ComradeKim Jong Unstressed the need to make every element of the ideological work an ideological and spiritual sustenance indispensable to everyone in the new era of transformation and a driving force of their genuine life and struggle, calling on all the participants to make their work run through with the principles, tactics and methods they acquired in the workshop, steadily learn and consolidate them through practice and constantly explore new keys to innovating the ideological work, thereby further enriching the wealth of the ideological work of the Party.
He continued:
Comrades,
Party information workers in all sectors and at all levels,
Ideology is, as has always been, fuel to the Korean revolution and the foremost resource for our state building.
It is a source of the greatest honour and special glory to live and work as an information worker of the Workers' Party of Korea which regards ideology as the first and foremost weapon and leads the revolution on its strength.
I am convinced that all the participants in the workshop will, by bravely shouldering their responsibility assigned by the times and revolution, play the vanguard role in dynamically writing textbooks for the ideological revolution which will be remembered in the history of our Party and handed down to posterity along with our era of transformation.
On this opportunity, I feel reassured to see your responsible attitude, overflowing vigour and pronounced confidence.
Greater successes and epochal achievements will continuously be etched on our journey for bringing earlier the attainment of our great ideals, a beautiful future, by dint of the invincible might of ideology.
Believing that all the participants and officials will open up the road of advance in the new era holding high the great banner of ideology-first principle and with enthusiasm and courage as befit ideological guards of the Workers' Party of Korea, I declare the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector close. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Third Workshop for Officials in Information Sector of WPK Closes
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- The Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea, which has added another brilliant page to the history of ideological work of the WPK, closed on September 21 after successfully concluding its scheduled work.
ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, attended the closing ceremony and made an important speech.
When he took the platform together with accompanying officials, all the audiences broke into enthusiastic cheers in reverence for Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho organized the workshop in the crucial historic period of deciding the brilliant success and future of our cause and is working thoughtfully and painstakingly to make it an occasion of a radical turn in consolidating the politico-ideological might, the greatest national power of the DPRK, in every way.
In his speech, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that the workshop was successfully held in conformity with the desired purpose of making it a major process for innovating ideological work, whereby all the officials in the information sector of the Party have a full understanding of the Party's immutable ideology-first principle and their sense of duty to innovate the ideological work.
Saying that the officials in the information sector of the Party have hardened in a fresh manner their sacred revolutionary awareness and sense of heavy responsibility to increase our ideological resources a hundred times and consolidate the guarantee for carrying forward our cause, he referred to the fundamental principle the officials should always keep in mind as communists and to the absolute viability of the Juche-based theory of giving importance to ideology. And he clarified the firm stand of the Party Central Committee to realize our ideal without fail in the future dynamic struggle on the strength of the great revolutionary ideology, the greatest asset of the Party, and the might of the information and motivation work peculiar to the Party which turns the ideology into the might of transformation.
ComradeKim Jong Unset forth the principled issues, to be adhered to in putting the contents, forms, methods and means of ideological work on the basis of progress and development in line with the expectations of the times, the revolution and the people waiting eagerly for fresh changes and innovations in information and motivation work and creation of cultures that will encourage and further diversify our struggle and life, and the important tasks and ways for ensuring the innovation in the ideological work of the whole Party.
He declared the workshop closed, stressing that a series of greater successes and innovations would be witnessed in our struggle for bringing earlier the great ideal and bright future with the irresistible might of ideology, he expressed the belief that all the participants would dynamically pave the avenue for advance in the new era with the zeal and courage befitting the ideological guards of the WPK under the uplifted banner of the ideology-first principle.
All the participants responded with stormy cheers and rapturous applause to his speech adding glory to their high honor as information workers of the ever-victorious WPK, which regards ideology as the most important weapon and guides the revolution by dint of ideology, and further hardening their sense of duty for the times and redoubling their revolutionary zeal.
They loudly sang in chorus the song "Long live the Workers' Party of Korea", in reflection of their faith and pledge to fulfill their duty as ideological guards in steadily writing textbooks on the ideological revolution, to be recorded in our Party history and handed down forever along with our era of transformation, by successfully carrying forward and developing the sacred history and tradition of our Party which pioneered a new era of Juche by rousing the people to the revolution on the strength of ideology.
The venue was filled with revolutionary enthusiasm of all the participants to further consolidate our political and ideological position and dynamically carry forward the upsurge in the overall development of socialism through a powerful ideological offensive, holding aloft the red Party flag of Juche.
The four-day workshop was held amid the extraordinary political consciousness and enthusiasm of all the participants to take the lead in the vigorous campaign for bringing about a radical change in ideological work and qualitatively strengthening the ideological position, an indispensable guarantee and key requirement for the steady succession to the cause of the WPK, with their fresh determination, redoubled efforts, mature qualifications and positive cultivation of traits.
There was an intensive study for deeply grasping the essence of the important speech made by ComradeKim Jong Unat the opening ceremony of the Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the WPK.
Studying in depth the important document, which comprehensively deals with the precious guidelines for further developing the ideological resources, accumulated by our Party for a long time, the extraordinary potentials peculiar to the Korean revolution, at the level required by a new era, an era of comprehensive development when we have entered a new phase in the spheres of our struggle and in all our activities,  all the participants hardened their revolutionary will to carry out without fail the policy of the Party Central Committee expecting positive changes in ideological work of the Party, which are stronger than the trend of the changing times and offensive-oriented in surpassing reality.
The workshop was held amid their high awareness that the success of ideological work depends on the qualifications and ability of them taking full charge of the ideological and information work.
Senior officials of the Information and Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the WPK and educational workers of the Central Cadres Training School of the WPK gave lectures at the workshop.
First, there was a lecture on concentrating all efforts of the ideological work of the Party on preparing all members of society as true loyalists and ardent patriots armed with the revolutionary ideas of great ComradeKim Jong Unas their faith.
The lecturer theoretically explained that ComradeKim Jong Un's revolutionary ideas are the guidelines of our Party and state in the new era and an encyclopedic action program for the revolution and construction as they comprehensively deal with the path and the strategy for carrying forward and accomplishing the revolutionary cause of Juche generation after generation under the banner of Kimilsungism-Kimjongilism.
The lecture referred to the detailed issues for improving the effectiveness of the ideological and political work by further enhancing the sense of obligation and responsibility of the officials in the information sector of the Party in the struggle for modeling the entire Party and the whole society on the revolutionary ideology of great ComradeKim Jong Un.
Then the workshop dealt with the issue of successfully conducting the education in the revolutionary relics and the leadership exploits of the Party, regarding it as the key point of ideological education.
The lecturer explained the methodological ways for further enhancing the cognitional and educational effect in education through the revolutionary relics and the leadership exploits of the Party, the root and starting point of the ideological work of the Party, and intensifying it in a substantial way on the principle of historicism and scientific accuracy.
There was a lecture on stepping up the information and publicity offensive to rouse the masses to implementation of the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Through the lecture, the participants kept deep in their minds  the orientation of information and agitation work and all principled issues arising in making sure that the working spirit and traits, displayed in pioneering the era of comprehensive development, and the trend of gigantic changes prevailing in all sectors of socialist construction result in steady upsurge,  and in properly setting the focus of ideological work in conformity with the specific conditions of every sector and unit to wage an intensive campaign for joint and collective innovations.
The workshop also dealt with the issue of studying fresh forms and methods of ideological work and conducting information work in a realistic and appealing manner and the issue of conducting motivation and agitation with visual aids as required by the Party's policy to maximize their effectiveness.
The lecturers explained the principled and theoretical issues, including the one of exploring and applying new forms and methods of ideological work while studying the Party's policies, the situation and the undertakings from an enterprising and positive standpoint, the one of thoroughly ensuring the politico-ideological characters, timeliness, visualization and culture in displaying political visual aids and preparing the information workers to be the ideological standard-bearers of our Party possessed of high political and professional qualifications and noble humanity.
The participants watched videos dealing with the successes, experience and lessons recently gained and drawn by information units at different levels and there was a question-and-answer session on the practical issues arising in the Party's ideological work.
While deeply studying the contents of the lectures during the workshop in organic correlation with the immediate practical requirements and the prospective requirements of the revolution, they focused their thinking and research on broadly acquiring the essence, exquisite principle and mature methodology of ideological work.
They actively exchanged and shared the good views and experience that would help acquire the innovative work style and manner of always aspiring after new things and development as a habit and ensure the purposeful and meticulous nature of ideological work under a good plan.
A letter of pledge to ComradeKim Jong Unwas adopted with fervent applause of the participants.
The Third Workshop for Officials in the Information Sector of the Workers' Party of Korea, held under the guidance of ComradeKim Jong Un, marked a significant occasion in further strengthening the Party and the revolutionary ranks into a fortress of single-minded unity and an ideologically pure entity and reliably guaranteeing the steady advance and succession of our cause by boosting the might of the Juche-based theory of attaching importance to ideology in the course of opening up a new era and a new sphere of struggle. -0-

headline: DPRK Team Advances to Semifinals of 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 22 (KCNA) -- A quarterfinal between DPRK and Canadian teams for the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup took place on September 20 (local time).
The DPRK team took the initiative from the beginning of the game and kept up its intense attack on its rival. No. 11 Choe Rim Jong scored the first goal at about two minutes of the extra time of the second half, and No. 13 Ho Kyong scored another goal about six minutes of the extra time.
The DPRK team thus defeated its Canadian rival 2:0.
There will be a semifinal between DPRK and Colombian teams on September 23 (September 24 Pyongyang time). -0-

story_text:

headline: Pyongyang General Hospital
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) -- The Pyongyang General Hospital is situated on a picturesque bank of the River Taedong.
The Pyongyang General Hospital is composed of multi-storey buildings. It has outpatient and inpatient wards furnished with ultra-modern facilities. In the best environment, it can provide medical service of all categories, including diagnosis, treatment and health care, in a rational and effective way.
It has the image diagnosis department, emergency department, general experimental test department, specialized treatment departments such as dental department and internal intensive treatment department, general operating room, inpatient ward, service facilities, conference hall and helipad.
Inpatient wards were designed to automatically measure and monitor the life indicators and health of patients and fully meet their convenience.
One day in September 2025, respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the hospital on the eve of its inauguration. At that time he stressed that Pyongyang General Hospital should play a key and leading role in implementing the healthcare revolution policy of the Party intending to rebuild and dramatically improve the national public health system.
So pleased to see one of the long-cherished desires came true, he said in an excited tone that the Pyongyang General Hospital would be recorded in the history of new-era nation building as a monumental entity, symbolic of the first year of the public health revolution led by our Party and the start of the public health rejuvenation.
The hospital has introduced into clinical practice advanced operation methods requiring high technical skills and carried out thousands of operations. It has also produced more than 10 academic holders this year. -0-

DPRK Premier Inspects Various Economic Sectors
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected various economic sectors.
Going round various farms in Taedong, Jungsan, Phyongwon, Sukchon and Mundok counties of South Phyongan Province, the premier encouraged the agricultural workers working hard to successfully conclude the farming this year, the first year for carrying out the new five-year plan.
Learning in detail about the progress in immediate farming such as crop yields on different rice fields and operation of farm machines, he called on the farms to concentrate efforts and means on gathering the crops, cultivated with much effort, without any waste to increase the per-hectare yield to the maximum.
He underscored the need to widely introduce the scientific farming methods whose advantages have been proved in practice, finish the sowing of winter wheat and barley in the right time and in a qualitative way and promote the catfish breeding in paddy fields.
At the Namhung Youth Chemical Complex, he called for timely finishing the overhauling of the fertilizer production process by the appointed day and steadily increasing the fertilizer production by putting efforts into equipment management and technical control while reducing the consumption of raw materials.
At the fifth-stage construction sites in Hwasong area, he urged the construction units to give priority to ensuring quality, push ahead with the projects in their charge as planned and make sure all working processes meet the requirements of designs and construction rules through meticulous operations and guidance.
Earlier, he visited the Pyongyang Building Materials Factory and stressed the need to regard sci-tech development as a main link in the chain growth of production, strengthen the talented work force and actively apply innovative inventions to produce more quality building materials.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of directing efforts to the supply and transport of building materials to the fifth-stage construction sites in Hwasong area and supervising the construction in a responsible manner, the issue of officials to methodologically innovate the management of enterprises and business with clear goals and scientific insight for the growth of production, and the issue of waging a dynamic campaign for exploiting reserves for increased production. -0-

headline: National Day Celebrated by DPRK Missions Abroad
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) -- Events took place at the DPRK missions abroad to celebrate the 78th founding anniversary of the country from Sept. 2 to 9.

headline: Samgwang Livestock Farm in DPRK Profits from Indoor Stockbreeding
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 23 (KCNA) -- Indoor stockbreeding is encouraged in the DPRK as it has not many pastures.
The Samgwang Livestock Farm of the North Phyongan Provincial Rural Economy Committee, inaugurated in February, is profiting from indoor stockbreeding.
According to the farm manager Choe Myong Hak, the rearing of livestock in buildings makes it possible to save lots of manpower, plots and feed, produce milk in all seasons and prevent food poisoning and parasitic diseases caused by pasturing.
He says that indoor stockbreeding is suitable for introducing standard raising technologies and advanced management methods.
Its branch farm No. 1 uses a RFID device for each animal and data from the analysis of assorted feed ingredients, thus assessing the daily amount of nutritive substance needed by every animal and scientifically fixing the appropriate mixing rate and amount of feed for each strain, season and state of growth. Such information is transferred to the feed processing plant.
The farm has established an automatic control system of measuring the temperature, humidity, gas density, etc. in real time to create the most favorable growth conditions.
The raisers, who used to graze their livestock in the mountains in sultry weather or rainstorm, now raise the animals in sci-tech, industrial ways through the control system in modern animal sheds. As the indoor raising method develops on a higher IT and intelligent footing, stockbreeding is put on a more scientific, intensive and specialized basis to make big profits.
They say that the method lowers the energy consumption among animals and makes it possible to produce much more milk and lengthen the milking time with the same amount of feed.
The farm has a modern workshop for producing dairy products such as yogurt and cheese.
It has also begun to make cream butter and others, thus expanding the variety of dairy products by three times, as compared with its early days of operation.
Samgwang-brand dairy products sell at shops in Pyongyang Municipality, Sinuiju City of North Phyongan Province, etc. -0-

headline: Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Minister
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- Choe Son Hui, foreign minister of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Thursday released the following press statement "The DPRK remains unchanged in its will to keep nuclear weapons forever":
The U.S., Japan and the ROK fully expressed their anachronistic and confrontational nature once again to remain invariably hostile to the DPRK by raising the unrealistic "denuclearization" target.
At the tripartite talks held on the sideline of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly, the diplomatic authorities of the U.S., Japan and the ROK made public a "joint statement", in which they reconfirmed the firm will to "denuclearize" someone according to the "resolution" of the UN Security Council.
This proved once again that no matter how the U.S. and its allies change their expressions and let loose a string of rhetoric, they do not give up a daydream about "denuclearization" and can never drop it.
It is not new that the "denuclearization" issue was discussed at the meeting of the U.S., Japan and the ROK which have adopted antagonism toward the DPRK as their state policies, and on the contrary, it would have been surprised and questionable if there had been no mention about it.
As the foreign minister of the DPRK, I reaffirm and reconfirm in the strongest tone of voice the steadfast will of our state to keep nuclear weapons through all ages, which is irreversible in any case and will remain unchanged forever.
The strong-arm policy against the DPRK came to failure, and any state or force can never compel us to withdraw from defending the national sovereignty and the core interests.
The coexistence of confrontation and dialogue may be workable for anyone, but they can never be considerable one for the DPRK.
Steadfast is our appreciation and stand that nuclear weapons are the core component of national sovereignty and the most reliable guarantee for defending sovereign rights that no one can provoke. And the more loudly the U.S. and its allies may cry out for "denuclearization", the more it will only prove the validity of our state's just access to nuclear weapons and give a justification for strengthening them and harden its stand against the U.S. and the enemies.
To deny the reality is to give up the future.
There is no change in the fact that the DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state will be everlasting as inviolable one in disregard of the hostile forces' rhetorical assertion, and it is inevitable to reorganize and fix the geopolitical structure centered on the DPRK with nukes. -0-

He said today's sports game is to appreciate their efforts and express thanks to them.
Among the spectators were Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the WPK, and secretaries of the Central Committee of the WPK.
The football match was held between Hwasong team of the Missile Administration and Ponghwa team of the Second Economy Commission.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed his thanks to the group of defence scientists and technicians and the munitions industrial workers for the contributions they have made by performing an unprecedented miracle, to be specially recorded in the history of sacred struggle for modernizing the DPRK's armed forces and bolstering the war-fighting capability, and clearly proving the matchless development and absolute superiority of our defence capability. He said that their patriotism and loyalty and devoted efforts constitute a priceless contribution, the most invaluable one never to be bartered for anything, in terms of the security, eternal development and prosperity of the country.
He called on the defence scientists and technicians and the munitions industrial workers to further redouble their revolutionary optimism and high spirit and continuously bring about a series of leaps forward and innovations in augmenting the national defence capability by their concerted efforts and thus defend the DPRK's inviolable sovereignty and security, safeguard peace and reliably guarantee the eternal development of the socialist motherland with the absolute superiority of strength.
The two teams, greatly honoured to play the match in front of ComradeKim Jong Un, fiercely contended for the glory of their units. Hwasong team beat its rival 4:1.

All the participants, who were honoured to have ComradeKim Jong Un's great trust and encouragement, made a pledge of loyalty to stay more faithful to the important historic mission and duty they have assumed before the Party and the revolution, the country and its people, and consolidate the national defence capability to be most powerful. -0-

headline: Test of Updated 240 mm-Calibre Controlled Multiple-Launch Rockets Conducted in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- Under the artillery and missile forces modernization plan for attaining the five-year goal of national defence development, the defence scientific research sector of the DPRK conducted a test of updated 240 mm-calibre controlled multiple-launch rockets on September 22.
The test was guided by Ko Pyong Hyon, chairman of the Second Economy Commission of the DPRK.
The test was overseen by KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea, Full General Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, and Major General Yu Chang Son, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army.
The autonomous pinpoint guide system was applied to the updated 240 mm-calibre controlled multiple-launch rockets. The updated rockets are capable of striking the targets 100 km away in a trajectory flight mode and those 115 km away in a combined glide mode.
That day's test proved the hit accuracy and superiority of the range-extended rockets.
The leading cadres expressed their unanimous view that the development of range-extended rockets assures them of a significant change in the firepower readiness along the southern border.
Referring to the idea of the head of state on giving priority to the development of the army artillery and missile forces, KPA Marshal Pak Jong Chon stressed the need to concentrate the deadliest and destructive attack forces on southern border.
Recalling the idea of the instructions given by the head of state that to constantly expose the enemy to extreme uneasiness and fear constitutes an important and decisive part in exercising the war deterrent, he underscored the need to make the enemy aware of the fact that we have replaced all our armed forces' long-range strike means with the latest ones at the earliest date.
To build the most powerful artillery force is our Party's principal defence building strategy emphasized again at the Second Meeting of the Ninth Central Military Commission of the WPK, he said, requesting for greater efforts and activities of the defence science research sector and the munitions industrial workers to bolster up the military muscle. -0-

headline: Large Area of New Pastures Created in Jagang Province of DPRK
story_text:

The province set a step-wise goal for creating pastures during the period of implementing the new Five-Year Plan and has pushed ahead with the project.
Huichon City, and Janggang, Chosan, and Hwaphyong counties made progress in the work.
Meanwhile, the province has organized a visit to the units profiting from pastures in their regions to generalize their experience.
The province is now concentrating on increasing the number of grass-eating domestic animals on a large scale. -0-

headline: Traditional Food of Korean Nation
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- On the day of Chusok (Harvest Moon Day), a folk holiday of Koreans, they prepared various dishes.
Among them are Songphyon (a half-moon-shaped rice cake stuffed with beans and flavored with pine needles).
On all other folk holidays, Koreans enjoy this dish. Such a rice cake is more delicious when it is made from new rice on the day of Chusok. The rice cake prepared on the day is called Chusok Songphyon.
Every region of the country makes unique Songphyon of various shapes and sizes.
In Kangwon Province, they make such a cake from potato farina and groundnuts.
Chusok falls on the 25th of September (the 15th day of the eighth lunar month) this year. -0-

headline: Spokesman for DPRK Foreign Ministry Issues Press Statement
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- A spokesman for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on September 24:
A "joint statement" accusing the DPRK of its self-defensive nuclear activities was cooked up and released at a recent ministerial meeting of the "Friends of the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty" held in New York.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK strongly condemns and rejects as a grave political provocation against the DPRK such behavior of the hostile forces who took issue with the DPRK's legitimate and just exercise of its sovereign rights under the pretext of the promotion of earlier effectuation of the CTBT.
The member states of the "Friends of the CTBT", which sponsored the recent ministerial meeting, are the allies or satellite countries of the U.S., the chief culprit systematically destroying the international nuclear non-proliferation system. So they have neither qualification nor face to debate the DPRK's legitimate exercise of its right to self-defence.
It has been 30 years since the conclusion of the CTBT, but it has not yet come into effect. It is entirely because of the U.S. and its vassal forces which have openly committed criminal nuclear proliferation out of their wild ambition to secure their global nuclear hegemony.
The U.S.-led nuclear proliferation, from the sharing of nuclear weapons with NATO in the 1950s and deployment of its nuclear weapons abroad to the emergence of the nuclear submarine alliance AUKUS and the transfer of nuclear submarine technology to the ROK, has been recorded as grave threats to international peace and security.
In particular, remilitarization of Japan revealing its ill-intended scheme to arm itself with nuclear weapons through the modification of the Three Non-Nuclear Principles and the retrogressive constitutional amendments, oblivious of the lesson from its defeat in the Second World War, constitutes an actual security challenge to be strictly watched and deterred by the international community.
The criminal acts of the countries failing to honour their nuclear-disarmament and nuclear non-proliferation duty are being connived at, but a sovereign state's legitimate exercise of its right to self-defence is being faulted. As such abnormal situation lingers, the international nuclear disarmament system and the nuclear non-proliferation system are being shaken to their roots.
Such stereotyped racket of some dishonest forces has no impact on the DPRK's position as a nuclear weapons state.
The DPRK will never tolerate any attempts to deny its national sovereignty and constitutional position but make positive contributions to the international efforts for ensuring peace of the Korean peninsula and the rest of the world as a responsible nuclear weapons state. -0-

The DPRK is now performing a series of world-startling miracles and changes, in the face of imperialists' sanctions and pressure, under the seasoned leadership of respected ComradeKim Jong Un, he said.
The chairman of the Russian Association for Friendship and Cultural Cooperation with the DPRK and personages of the Veterans' Federation and the Academy of Sciences said that the DPRK could build genuine people's power and follow the brilliant path of development thanks to the nation-building exploits of ComradeKim Il Sung. The DPRK is making remarkable development thanks to the policy of its leadership oriented to national prosperity and the people's wellbeing and the strenuous efforts of the people to thoroughly implement it, they said, adding the DPRK is making a great contribution to global peace and security, clearly clarifying its principled stand in the international arena.

headline: Remains of Martyrs Buried at Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- Remains of the martyrs, who dedicated themselves to faithfully upholding the ideas and leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, were buried at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri.
Ri Pyong Sam, winner of the Title of DPRK Labour Hero, Order ofKim Il Sungand Order ofKim Jong Il, was the former advisor to the then Political Bureau of the Korean People's Internal Security Forces. He made great contributions to establishing the unified command system of the Party Central Committee in the public security organs and training the service personnel of the KPISF as the frontline soldiers defending the revolution, social system and people.
Choe Kyong Song, a former general of the Korean People's Army, is the winner of Order ofKim Il Sungand Order ofKim Jong Il. He was a true military commander who faithfully upheld the WPK's cause of building a powerful army.
War veteran Ji Yong Chun, a former lecturer of the Victorious Fatherland Liberation War Museum and winner of the Title of DPRK Hero and Order ofKim Il Sung, and Ryom Chol Song, a former KPA general and winner of Order ofKim Il Sung, are also among the martyrs.
Jo Kyong Sun, former vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, tangibly contributed to the development of Juche-based cinematic art. He is the winner of the Title of DPRK Labour Hero, Order ofKim Il SungandKim Il SungPrize.
Prof. and Dr. Kim Ung Chol, former director of the Nano Engineering Branch of the State Academy of Sciences, contributed to the development of self-supporting economy and improvement of people's living standards. He is the winner of the Title of DPRK Labour Hero and Order ofKim Il Sung.
Ceremonies of burying the remains of the martyrs took place at the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery.
Speakers at the ceremonies said that the life and merits of the martyrs are shining forever thanks to respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho takes care of the destiny of the revolutionary soldiers to the end.
The remains of the martyrs were buried and the participants laid wreaths, bouquets and flowers at the gravestones of the martyrs and paid silent tribute. -0-

Pyongyang, September 24 (KCNA) -- The Electric Power Information Institute under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry in the DPRK has made valuable achievements.
Its scientists and researchers made contributions to ensuring the completion of the first-stage Tanchon Power Station construction project by technically perfecting the integrated control system for the hydropower plants No. 1, No. 5 and No. 6 and conducting its trial operation.
They resolved the problems arising in the operation of the real-time flow measurement system and set it up at Jangjingang, Pujongang and Sodusu power stations, thus providing a sci-tech guarantee for increasing the overall efficiency of the power plants.
An integrated control system of hydraulic power plants, established at the Hoeyang Army-People Power Station, makes it possible to properly operate generators, according to their technical characteristics and the quantity of water, and ensure their high-efficiency running. Trial operation of the virtual physical production system has been successfully conducted to make progress in putting the operation of power plants on an intelligent footing.
They also attached data concentrators to scores of pole type transformers in relevant regions and set up a system for monitoring, controlling and tackling the power consumption of factories and enterprises in real time, thus opening up a good prospect for putting control of the electricity grid, planning of the electricity supply and organization of alternated production on a scientific basis. -0-

headline: "Decisive Centre of Collective Defence" Will Be Decisive Target of Collective Punishment: Section Chief of DPRK Institute of Enemy State Studies
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 25 (KCNA) -- An article of Kang Chol Su, section chief of the DPRK Institute of Enemy State Studies, titled "The 'decisive centre of collective defence' will be a decisive target of collective punishment" was published on September 25.
The following is the full text of the article:
The U.S. is more openly revealing its gangster-like nature to use the ROK as its key base for implementing its hegemonic strategy and as its mercenaries in the regional conflict.
At a recent "ROK-U.S. international security seminar", the commander of U.S. forces in the ROK termed the ROK a "decisive centre for collective defence," asserting that the security on the Korean peninsula is directly linked with the stability of Northeast Asia, the western hemisphere and the whole Pacific.
He talked about the redesigning of the security of the Korean peninsula, stressing the need for the ROK and the U.S. to jointly cope with the threat from outside the Korean peninsula.
This is a clearer manifestation of the attempt to completely discard the deceptive veil of "defense of the ROK," which has so far been used as the justification for the existence of the U.S.-ROK alliance, and to tie the ROK to the aggressive "collective defense" system for implementing the strategy for world hegemony.
The "collective defense" is a keynote of the present U.S. administration's "National Defence Strategy". It is a brigandish doctrine of aggression aimed at driving its allies to any strife-torn areas in the world under the pretext of "joint response to a common threat".
The fact that the military value of the ROK has been promoted to "decisive center of collective defense" means that the whole territory of the ROK will play the role of a key base for the U.S. in fighting the overseas aggressive war and the ROK's forces will be deployed as first mercenaries, earlier than any others, in any place indicated by their American master.
Getting clearer is the reason why the U.S. has openly revealed its intention to use the geopolitical position of the ROK for carrying out its strategy for hegemony outside the Korean peninsula under a "upside down map," highlighting the ROK's position as a fixed aircraft carrier for deterring the DPRK, China and Russia and a dagger in the heart of Asia.
In fact, the U.S. attempt to place the ROK at the centre of the "collective defence" system has been put into speedy practice to pose real danger.
The U.S. has reduced its forces in Europe and other regions, but deployed MQ-9 Reaper drone unit for strategic purposes and more F-16 fighters in the ROK. It even seeks to deploy the multi-domain mobile task force. This is a part of its practical design to involve the ROK in the "collective defence" system.
This has been proved by the fact that the U.S. has enhanced the joint operation system and integrated operation capacity by involving the ROK forces in such multi-national military exercises in the Asia-Pacific region as RIMPAC and Pacific Vanguard conducted far beyond the Korean peninsula and its vicinity, not content with Ulji Freedom Shield and other joint military drills with the ROK and Japan.
Shackled by the U.S. "collective defense" system, the ROK is playing a suicidal role as top-class war servant of the U.S. by willingly accepting to increase its defense cost, build nuclear submarines, introduce multi-domain operational system and integrated missile defense system, massively purchase U.S. war hardware and build and overhaul U.S. warships, all of which are transcending its "defense requirements."
The U.S. strategy of "modernizing the alliance," which is being carried out on a global scale, beyond the boundary of the Korean peninsula, under the signboard of "collective defense", and sycophancy of the ROK blindly following it are exposing the security of the Korean peninsula, the region and the world to graver danger.
The ROK, which will play the role of a "decisive center for collective defense," has turned into the most obvious cancer-like entity that stokes the instability of the region and the world, and this will inevitably provoke the heightened vigilance and strengthened readiness of the countries and the region regarding it as a threat.
The DPRK, which borders the ROK, has already made full preparations in anticipation of such developments and clarified its resolute stand to mercilessly deter and frustrate any challenge doing harm to the sphere of its security by dint of its superpowerful military muscle.
The ROK, which has emerged as a "decisive center for collective defense," pursuant to the U.S. strategic interests, will become a decisive target of collective punishment. -0-

headline: Hamhung Barbecue Restaurant Inaugurated in DPRK
Daily-developing Education in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 25 (KCNA) -- The law on enforcing the universal 12-year compulsory education was promulgated at the Sixth Session of the 12th Supreme People's Assembly of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on September 25, 2012.
Education is steadily developing in the DPRK thanks to the guidance of respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unwho set it as the main link in the whole chain of bringing about a radical improvement in education in the new century to decisively intensify secondary general education and has worked heart and soul to successfully enforce the universal 12-year compulsory education including the work to draft a new compulsory education programme and improve educational conditions and environment.
At the Eighth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea, the respected Comrade General Secretary set it as the main tasks to be carried out in the field of education to improve the structure, content and method of education. He called for making innovations in the educational structure at major meetings of the Party and the state and on several occasions and took all measures for it.
As a result, the work to turning the educational course in the sector of secondary education into the new one based on optional curriculum has been accelerated on a full scale.
A proposal for forming classes specializing in science, literature, art, sports and technology at senior middle schools and technical senior middle schools was made and according to it, the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme was worked out and the work to write textbooks according to each school, grade and subject was conducted.
The optional curriculum has been enforced at senior middle schools in Hoechang County, South Phyongan Province, Songrim City, North Hwanghae Province and Jongphyong County, South Hamgyong Province from April last year.
From April this year, the optional curriculum has been enforced at all senior middle schools and technical senior middle schools across the country according to the new education programme.
This made a breakthrough in putting the secondary general education of the country onto a higher stage and provided an important guarantee for achieving a stride forward in education.
Officials and educators across the country have turned out in the work to cement the teachers' forces and strengthen the bases for experiment and practice at schools. As a result, the second universal 12-year compulsory education programme is being successfully implemented. -0-

headline: Chusok Holiday Custom
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 25 (KCNA) -- Chusok is a folk holiday of the Korean nation.
In autumn, when the five grains become ripe, Koreans celebrated the evening of the fifteenth day of the lunar month with a clear moon as a holiday. Chusok means an evening in autumn.
A historical document refers to Chusok customs of the Korean nation.
On the day of Chusok, first, our people prepared various dishes, such as Songphyon (half-moon-shaped rice cake) and glutinous rice cake, with new crops of the year and visited their forefathers' graves in clean clothes.
Songphyon is associated with Chusok.
On Chusok evenings, Korean ancestors cherished their desires while seeing a full moon on the top of a mountain or in front of their houses.
Chusok falls on the 25th of September this year.
The Chusok holiday custom was registered as a part of national intangible cultural heritage in May 2014. -0-

headline: DPRK People Celebrate Traditional Folk Holiday
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 26 (KCNA) -- Chusok is one of the traditional folk holidays of the DPRK people.
It is their custom to visit their forefathers' graves to pay tribute on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month (Chusok).
On the occasion of this day, they visit the graves of the martyrs and late comrades who dedicated themselves to the prosperity of the country. They also meet their families to look back with deep emotion on their feats and careers.
From early morning of September 25 (this year's Chusok), many working people, young people and students visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery on Mt Taesong, the Patriotic Martyrs Cemetery in Sinmi-ri and the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs Cemetery to pay floral tribute.
Lots of people visited the Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery in Hyesan and other martyrs' cemeteries and graves across the country, where they pledged to follow in the footsteps of the revolutionary forerunners.

headline: Milk-producing Units Boost Milk Output
story_text:

This year the national milk output has increased by 1.3 times as compared with the same period of last year.
They expanded the number of mother domestic animals of good breeds by introducing scientific anti-epizootic techniques. Cultivation of feed crops with high productivity is brisk and functional nutrients are applied to increase the production of cow milk.
They have steadily increased their milk production capacity by establishing advanced feed processing technology and introducing latest science and technology into the management of dairy cattle.

headline: Oungum
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 26 (KCNA) -- Oungum is one of the national string instruments of the DPRK.
The musical instrument, composed of a gourd-shaped soundboard, neck with frets and head, is played in solo, concert, ensemble, etc. It is made of paulownia wood.
ChairmanKim Jong Ilinitiated and guided the development of Oungum when he coached his fellow students ofKim Il SungUniversity in military training in Oundong in the period from August 20 to October 4, 1962.
He gave a detailed instruction on the materials, shape and preservation of traditional Korean tone colour of the musical instrument. Under his meticulous guidance, students succeeded in developing it.
After examining the instrument, he said that it would be good to call it Oungum as it was made in Oundong Valley where the military training was conducted.
Oungum, which was created under the guidance of the peerlessly great man, contributes to enriching the culture of the Korean people for its unique timbres produced by various techniques.
Oungum-making technology was registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage in 2024. -0-

headline: Ryugyong Dental Hospital

In recent years, it has developed and applied advanced remedies, dental materials and medical appliances.
By conducting research into the existing operation methods, doctors of the hospital developed advanced operation methods which reduce the time and steps of operation and the surgical pain of the patient and increase the postoperative recovery rate.

headline: Tourism Brisk in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 27 (KCNA) -- Today (September 27) is World Tourism Day.
Tourism in the DPRK is becoming brisk with each passing day as special tourist resorts have been built in the country, called a beautiful land from olden times, under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea in recent years.
The Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist area in Myongsasimni on the east sea has been crowded with tourists this year in the wake of last year. Working citizens are enjoying the highest coastal tourist civilization there.
Amid the brisk tour of Samjiyon City turned into a typical mountainous town in the northern part of the country, a lot of tourists have spent a pleasant time with sightseeing and hot-spring cure. They enjoy a civilization at the hotels, game houses and fatigue-relieving centers in the city wonderfully built in harmony with the nature of Mt Paektu.
The resorts and leisure complexes in Onpho, Yombunjin and other areas of the country are crowded with visitors spending a pleasant time.
Guided by tourist workers, tourists go to resorts without any inconvenience, using Pyongyang-Kalma air route, Pyongyang-Samjiyon express, Pyongyang-Orang tourist train and bus.
The northern part of Mt Phothae in Samjiyon City is being turned into a large-scale ski resort under the nationwide interest. Like this, the work to increase the national tourist resource is progressing apace in different parts of the country.
Going round major neighborhood-serving networks built in the then Kalma Coastal Resort in December 2024, respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that the country has rich and diverse tourist resources to be envied by world people and set forth the tasks for the development of national tourism.
The DPRK became a member state of the World Tourism Organization in September 1987. -0-
