headline: Bright Blueprint Unfolded by Supreme Leader
story_text:
One day in September 2020, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited Kangbuk-ri, Kumchon County of North Hwanghae Province, an area recovered from the flood damage.
Being very pleased to see the model socialist rural village looking like a beautiful picture, the General Secretary said that he felt as if he was in different world.
That day, he stressed the need to step up the civilized development of the countryside for steadily improving its appearance and further enhance the state's support to the responsible and important work for turning the countryside into a rich and cultured socialist one with modern technology.
Then, he stated that more sincere research and measures for our Party's immediate task and long-term goals are urgently needed to implement at an early date the great programme for socialist rural construction planned by PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Iland that the Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea will give a correct answer to this important issue.
The sacred imprints left by the respected General Secretary that day were a significant step to unfold a grand plan, a bright blueprint for the rural construction in our country. -0-

headline: Work to Preserve Historical Sites and Relics and Restore Intangible Cultural Heritage in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 28 (KCNA) -- South Hwanghae Province in the DPRK is taking measures to preserve and mange historical sites and relics and scenic spots and discover and restore intangible cultural heritage, according to Minju Joson.
The province is pushing ahead with the work to finish the repair of painting work of the Puyong Pavilion in a qualitative way after digging hundreds of cubic meters of mud in the pond of the pavilion and realigning the area of thousands of square meters.
It is speeding up the repair of the Sungbang Pavilion of the Woljong Temple in Mt. Kuwol and the mausoleum of Kogukwon in Oguk-ri, Anak County at the final stage.
The province also registered the folk song "Haeju Arirang", bean paste made by mixing and steaming boiled bean and spices, Haeju rice mixed with spices, vegetables, meat, etc., coriander Kimchi, Kangryong rice boiled with oysters, grasswork, etc. as national and local intangible cultural heritage. It is now conducting the work to examine and register a traditional drink and a folk song, and to restore the folk song and dance play "Kangryong Masked Dance" and put it on the stage. -0-

headline: Ceremony of Unveiling Tablet to Group of Sculptures of KPA Soldiers Held in Vietnam
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 28 (KCNA) -- A ceremony of unveiling the tablet installed at the platform where the group of sculptures of soldiers of the Korean People's Army is to be erected in the outdoor exhibition area of the Vietnam Military History Museum in Hanoi, the capital city of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, was held on the spot on Sept. 25.
Present at the ceremony were a delegation of the DPRK Ministry of National Defence led by Vice-Minister Ryo Chol Ung which is on a visit to Vietnam and DPRK Ambassador to Vietnam Ri Sung Guk and his embassy members.
Attending there were Deputy Minister of Defence Nguyen Truong Thang, Deputy Head of the General Political Department of the Vietnam People's Army Le Quang Minh, and other officials concerned of the Ministry of Defence, the General Political Department and the Vietnam Military History Museum.
On either side of the platform were guards of honor of the Vietnamese People's Army.
Ryo Chol Ung and Nguyen Truong Thang unveiled the tablet.
Written in the tablet are the letters reading "Feelings of Friendship between Vietnam and DPRK" and the explanation board are articles that Vietnam and the DPRK established diplomatic relations in January 1950, the DPRK rendered material and moral assistance and helped the Vietnamese people in the period of the anti-U.S. resistance to national salvation by dispatching experts, thus contributing to the victory of the Vietnamese revolution, and the combat spirit and self-sacrificing spirit displayed by Korean soldiers are a noble and beautiful symbol of the good international unity and contributed to the consolidation of the friendly relations between Vietnam and the DPRK.
Flower baskets and bouquets were laid before the platform.
Written in the ribbons of the flower baskets were letters "We pay tribute to the soldiers of the Korean People's Army" and "From the Ministry of Defence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam".
Meanwhile, the DPRK delegation of the Ministry of the National Defence visited the memorial district for the fallen soldiers of the Korean People's Army in Bac Ninh City in the northern part of Vietnam and laid a wreath before the memorial monument. -0-

headline: Appearance of Farms Improved in Nampho of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 28 (KCNA) -- Nampho Municipality of the DPRK directs efforts to improving the appearance of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams.
The municipality built a youth school, an agricultural sci-tech learning space, bedrooms, an animal husbandry, etc. at the newly-organized youth workteam at the Ansok Farm in Onchon County and provided it with farm machines and small and medium-sized farm implements.
Chollima District, Waudo District and Onchon County erected buildings for production and living at the youth sub-workteams of the Kangson Farm, the Ryongnam Cotton Farm and the Sohwa Farm, while Kangso and Hanggu districts conducted the work to provide the members of rural youth workteams and sub-workteams with better working and living conditions.
The municipal youth league committee has generalized the experience of advanced units through visits to the newly-built youth workteams and sub-workteams, thus bringing about a turn in the rural youth workteam and youth sub-workteam movement. -0-

story_text:

On September 28, he lifted 165kg in snatch, 214kg in clean and jerk (a new world record, a new Asian record and a new record of the games) and 379kg in total (a new world record, a new Asian record and a new record of the games) to bag a gold medal in the 85kg category.
In the meantime, DPRK player Kim Hyon Suk finished third in the women's 25m pistol event. -0-

story_text:

headline: Exhibition of Donation toKim Il SungUniversity Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- An exhibition of donation toKim Il SungUniversity took place on Monday.
On display at the exhibition held on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity were many experimental equipment and apparatuses, vehicles and materials offered by the Cabinet, commissions, ministries, national agencies, provincial people's committees and other units.
The Cabinet and the State Planning Commission provided equipment and building materials conducive to holding the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilin a brighter and more respectful manner and to improving the educational conditions and environment.
The Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of External Economic Relations and other units presented aid materials conducive to consolidating the material and technical foundations of the university.
Officials and working people in Pyongyang and Nampho municipalities, Kangwon and Jagang provinces and other parts of the country made sincere efforts for the development of the university.
Kim Sung Du, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Jon Sung Guk, vice-premier of the Cabinet, Ri Yong Chol, minister of Education, officials of the support units, and teaching staff and students ofKim Il SungUniversity went round the exhibition hall. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
The premier visited the Unryul and Jaeryong mines, the iron ore production bases in the western part of the country, and acquainted himself in detail with the deposits of ore and the state of mining and maintaining and reinforcing production systems, stressing the importance of the missions assumed by the mines in attaining the goal of iron production set forth by the Party.
He stressed the need for the mines to take measures for the removal of the earth and draining of water and increase the production of iron ore by introducing efficient mining methods as required by the Party's policy and push ahead with the work to investigate and confirm the deposits of ore in detail.
Going round the Kumsan Farm in Unryul County and the township farm and the Samjigang Farm in Jaeryong County and other agricultural production units, he stressed the need to increase the proportion of mechanized farming to finish rice harvest, threshing, winter wheat and barley planting in the right time and widely popularize the farming methods in which the advantages have been proved in this year's farming.
Learning about the power production at the Pyongyang Thermal Power Plant, he stressed the need to finish the overhaul of turbine generators and boilers ahead of schedule, increase the output of per generator and put main efforts into operating the equipment at full capacity to steadily increase the power production.
He underscored the need for the officials of the Pyongyang Rubber Factory to further improve the production and management and put spurs to the building of new production processes, regarding the mental power of the masses and science and technology as the lifeline of the development of the unit, thus ensuring the quality production of various types of rubber goods necessary for various sectors of the national economy.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of further strengthening the relations and cooperation between the sci-tech sector and production units, the issue of improving the supply service for the employees and the issue of reducing the power consumption of the power plants to the maximum and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: More Barbecue Restaurants Built in DPRK
story_text:

Present there were Kim Tu Il, chief secretary of the North Hamgyong Provincial Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials in the province and the city, working people, builders and employees of the restaurant.
Pak Myong Ho, chairman of the provincial people's committee, addressed the ceremony and then followed speeches.
At the end of the ceremony, the participants looked round the restaurant.
That day the restaurant made its first service for war veterans, meritorious persons, labor innovators and other citizens. -0-

headline: DPRK Foreign Ministry's Memorandum Issued to Disclose Truth and Danger of U.S. Nuclear Proliferation
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 29 (KCNA) -- The Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea on September 27 issued a memorandum to disclose the truth and danger of nuclear proliferation by the U.S., which has irresponsibly neglected its disarmament duty as a nuclear weapons state, plunging the international nuclear non-proliferation system into the worst crisis.
The U.S. is the chief culprit of the vertical proliferation bringing a global nuclear nightmare, the memorandum said, and went on:
In July 1945, more than 80 years ago, the U.S. raised nuclear mushroom clouds on the desert of New Mexico State for the first time in the human history and, since then, has made no scruple of resorting to all kinds of means and methods to lead the preemptive nuclear possession to a permanent nuclear monopoly.
It conducted 1 032 rounds of nuclear tests from 1945 to 1994 and had more than 32 500 nuclear attack means when the Cold War was at its height. The fact and figures go to prove eloquently how tremendous disaster the human history might face due to the nukes in the hands of the "evil empire".
The U.S., which had overestimated its exclusive nuclear advantage until the 1950s, resorted to a craftier artifice to gain a nuclear preponderance behind the curtain of nuclear disarmament in the mid-1960s, because of its financial burden caused by excessive military expenditure and apprehension for the Soviet Union's nuclear superiority as the world's second nuclear weapons state.
The U.S. is planning to resume its nuclear explosion tests under the pretext of "fair competition" while building up a world public opinion about "nuclear tests" in other countries. Such scheme is motivated only by its intention to plunge its strategic rivals into the whirlpool of nuclear arms race and realize the radical acceleration of its nuclear power buildup.
The modernization of the U.S. nuclear force is now being promoted at a level reminiscent of the Cold War period in its width and depth, under the keynote policy of the present U.S. administration advocating "America first" and "peace through strength".
Recently, the U.S. military officially recognized its possession of "space control weapons in orbit". This is a manifestation of its dangerous attempt to secure outer space for operation more favorable for strategic nuclear attack on enemy states, as a prolonged policy of dominating space.
What should not be overlooked is the fact that the U.S. is conducting in a more frantic manner its nuclear force buildup and modernization to ensure the absolute nuclear superiority in the "four-point operational sphere" involving the land, sea, air and space.
The U.S. has resorted to drawing up a new nuclear strategy, which envisages the use of tactical nuclear weapons by drastically lowering the door of restriction on the use of nukes. The fact shows that such nuclear weapons are not merely "deterrence means" of provision for the purpose of "removing threats" from the enemy states, but weapons for actual war to be used on battle sites in case of emergency.
The memorandum disclosed that the U.S. is the chieftain of horizontal proliferation disturbing the international nuclear non-proliferation system.
The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, signed in 1968, stipulates the commitment of each nuclear weapons state and non-nuclear weapons state to non-proliferation, the right to use nuclear energy for peaceful purposes and the promotion of negotiations on nuclear disarmament, thus assuming the mission as a cornerstone of the international non-proliferation system.
But, the U.S. has openly handed over nuclear weapons technology to its vassal forces, going against the core provisions of the NPT and made the nuclear sharing with NATO member states an uncontrollable object of the treaty. Today it is massively deploying its nuclear attack means in foreign territories under the pretext of offering "nuclear umbrella" and "extended deterrence".
Moreover, the U.S. cooked up "nuclear operation guidelines" with the ROK and put the operation of "Nuclear Consultative Group" on a regular basis. And then it made a commitment that it would include nukes in the provision of "extended deterrence" to Japan. The facts vividly go to prove the true colors of the U.S.-Japan-ROK triangular military cooperation system which is evolving into a nuclear alliance under the leading role of the U.S.
Israel's possession of nukes and several pro-American countries' efforts to arm themselves with nuclear weapons, which are still arousing international concern and fear, are a product of the U.S patronage, connivance and backing from A to Z.
What should not be overlooked is that the U.S. is scheming to turn the AUKUS into a world's biggest nuclear submarine alliance by drawing Japan, the ROK, New Zealand, Canada and other allies into it.
The U.S. approval of the ROK's possession of nuclear submarines is another proof of the AUKUS-style proliferation with nuclear submarines as a vehicle, which is a dangerous development adding new instability to the political and military security environment in the Asia-Pacific region.
If the reckless nuclear proliferation acts of the U.S. are allowed to go on, the "Pandora's box" will be completely opened and humankind will face a terrible nuclear disaster.
The present geopolitical situation, in which the international nuclear order has reached the state of total collapse due to the U.S. radical nuclear arms buildup and undisguised nuclear proliferation, requires the DPRK to play a more positive role in defending the world peace and ensuring the global strategic security, the memorandum said, and went on:
The DPRK's option of action as a responsible nuclear weapons state will be strictly based on the grave reality in which no international body or treaty is deterring the U.S. from bolstering up its nuclear power and going on its nuclear proliferation.
This will be a clear criterion in the DPRK's efforts to protect the national security interests and the regional security environment. -0-

headline: Work for Independent Development Hastened in South hamgyong Province of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- South Hamgyong Province is intensifying the work for independent development of the region, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The province is directing efforts to expanding the capacity and improving the quality of tile by reinforcing the production process at the Songchongang Tile Factory and increasing the output of cement and enhancing the quality by stepping up the renovation of the Puraesan Cement Factory.
Several projects are under way to spruce up Ragwon County. The Ragwonpho Greenhouse Branch Farm is showing its appearance and the construction of a small-storeyed apartment in the township area of Ragwon County and the reconstruction of the Ragwon Fishery Station are also being stepped up.
The province has built an automated pitch mixture production line based on coal to open up a prospect for paving the roads in cities and counties, to say nothing of those in provincial seat.
It made successes in remodeling the outer walls of the apartment houses in the seats of Hamhung City and Ragwon and Riwon counties by building a plastic windows production base. On this basis, it has urged the cities and counties to remodel the outer walls of the apartment houses in the seats and directed efforts to building 1 000-odd flats and service network at the Komdok area. -0-

headline: Brisk Work to Implement Regional Development Policy
Dredging Project Propelled in Land and Maritime Transport Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- The land and maritime transport sector is pushing ahead with the dredging project at several ports and in the route of the Taedong River, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The Harbor Transportation Bureau of the Ministry of Land and Maritime Transport completed the dredging tasks planned for this year at Chongjin, Nampho and Tanchon ports, while the Taedonggang Barrage Bureau has made big progress in the dredging of the route of the Taedong River between the Mirim and Sunchon barrages. -0-

headline: Delegation of DPRK Ministry of National Defence Visits Socialist Republic of Vietnam
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- A delegation of the Ministry of National Defence of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea led by Vice-Minister Ryo Chol Ung visited the Socialist Republic of Vietnam from September 24 to 28.
During the stay, Ryo Chol Ung paid a courtesy call on Phan Van Giang, minister of Defence of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and had a talk with Deputy Minister of Defence Nguyen Truong Thang.
The talks discussed the issues of further boosting the military cooperation between the two countries in conformity with the DPRK-Vietnam friendly relations which have entered a new developing phase with the historic Pyongyang summit meeting in October 2025 as an occasion.
The delegation of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK also laid a wreath before the graveyard of President Ho Chi Minh and visited a unit of the Vietnam People's Army, a military medical university and other units. It was invited to a welcome reception given by Deputy Minister of Defence Nguyen Truong Thang. -0-

headline: KCNA Commentary on Japan's Moves to Expand Powder Magazine
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- Recently, the Japanese reactionaries have buckled down to the extension of gunpowder houses for the Self-Defense Forces under the pretext of supplementing ammunition for "bolstering up the defense capabilities".
The Japan SDF with 1 400 gunpowder houses across the country is planning to additionally build at least 130 gunpowder houses under the standardized designs by 2032.
At present, the construction sites for 65 gunpowder houses were settled and the designs and construction projects are being conducted. Of them, three gunpowder houses were already completed by August this year. The designing for the remaining 65-odd gunpowder houses is to start later in 2027 after choosing their construction sites.
It is reported that the scale of extended gunpowder houses will increase more than scheduled under the three security documents, including the "national security strategy", the Japanese authorities are planning to formally revise within this year.
The extension of gunpowder magazine means that Japan is anticipating a long-drawn-out war.
It is by no means fortuitous that the present chief executive of Japan has asserted from the outset of the year that Japan should make preparations for a long-drawn-out war.
This is vivid evidence that Japan, a war criminal state, made a war for aggression and its prolongation a fait accompli and has made preparations for bolstering up its sustained combat capacity.
The Japanese reactionaries are now getting more frantic in the open scheme to realize the war strategy for materializing their reinvasion ambition.
Since the emergence of Takaichi regime, the Japanese authorities have openly pursued such extremely dangerous neo-militarist policy as the revision of the Three Principles on Transfer of Defense Equipment and Technology for operation of the "war industry" and its operational guidelines and the massive increase of "defense budget" the preceding regimes did not dare to do.
They are also hell-bent on rounding off the war preparations for aggression, investing huge amount of funds in the development of underwater-lunched hypersonic missiles, massive deployment of attack drones and introduction of AI into the SDF command system and other countermeasures to the "new combat mode" and the additional deployment of long-range missiles with "capability of attacking enemy base".
As well-known to everyone, Japan as a war criminal state is banned to have regular army, to say nothing of the right to take part in any war or right to belligerence. Nevertheless, it is scheming to increase its gunpowder houses in all parts of the country with a view to a long-drawn-out war, after getting fully prepared for a war state.
The militarist serpents' moves to increase the gunpowder houses for entering the road of overseas aggression at an early date are self-destructive acts of turning the whole of the archipelago into a huge powder box.
It is undeniable historical fact that the Japanese militarists, who ignited a bloody war of aggression under the ambition to dominate the whole world a century ago, were plunged into the mud of a long-drawn-out war in Asia and finally defeated.
The Japanese neo-militarists should clearly understand that if they are to make desperate efforts to realize the wild dream of the "Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere", oblivious of the bitter lessons of the past, they will only face the second defeat of Japan. -0-

headline: DPRK Women's Footballers Advance to Finals of 20th Asian Games
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- A women's football semifinal of the 20th Asian Games was held between the DPRK and Chinese teams on September 29.
Around 54 minutes of the match, an own goal was made by a Chinese player and around 79 minutes, DPRK player No. 7 Myong Yu Jong succeeded in scoring.
After all, the DPRK team defeated its Chinese rival 2:0.
The DPRK team will play the final match with the Japanese team on October 2.
Meanwhile, DPRK player Jo Jin Mi won a bronze medal at the diving women's 10-meter platform event. -0-

headline: Head of DPRK Delegation Makes Speech at 81st Session of UN General Assembly
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- Kim Son Gyong, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs who is heading the DPRK delegation, made a speech at the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly on September 28.
Noting that over the past one year, the world has witnessed the grave reality, in which the global instability and disorder have reached the extreme due to mutual distrust, confrontation, violation of sovereignty and military conflict, almost every day, he said:
The UN still remains a malfunction due to the high-handedness and unilateralism of some countries seeking after only their exclusive interests.
All the member states of the UN will have to thoroughly defend the original purpose and principle of the UN Charter and seek a proper way for settling any issue with priority given to the mutual unity and cooperation, in order to overcome all the existing crises and challenges and promote peace, security and sustainable development.
The DPRK people have undertaken new huge projects with confidence so as to bring about a bigger fruition while consolidating the successes achieved in the struggle for opening up the period of overall development under the wise leadership of ComradeKim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
There are countless challenges and difficulties ahead of us, but we will surely achieve everything we aim at by relying on our own strength, no matter how the situation may change.
The Korean Peninsula and its surrounding region are now facing extreme instability and tension worse than last year due to the constant hostile policy of the U.S. and its satellite states toward the DPRK and their escalating military confrontation moves.
The DPRK head of state declared that the sovereignty and security of our state have been reliably guaranteed by the powerful strength and they would remain invariable in the future, too.
The nuclear deterrent possessed by the DPRK is outright an absolute force and an irresistible might to defend its sovereignty, security and peace from the outside aggression and threat.
The DPRK will as ever remain more faithful to its mission as a responsible nuclear weapons state in firmly defending the national sovereignty and fundamental interests and ensuring the regional and global peace and security by strictly controlling all sorts of threat from outside with the overwhelming force.
The ever-changing present times urgently demands that the UN remarkably enhance its role to deal with the challenges and crises facing mankind in conformity with the common interests of mankind, he said, and went on:
The top-priority pressing task is to build the United Nations into the one for all which is faithful to the purpose and principle of the Charter and where fairness and objectivity are thoroughly guaranteed.
It's time to reform the United Nations.
The UN should be truly democratic so that the will and interests of all its member states are represented on an equal footing, not on the basis of reform centred on specified countries.
The DPRK government will further strive to promote the international justice and co-prosperity and the regional and global peace and security while thoroughly defending the national sovereignty, security and interests and development rights. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, September 30 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement titled "Ringleaders of provocation should be prepared for paying price for the farce of their own making" on Sept. 29:
Recently, the ROK military gangsters committed another provocation against the DPRK, announcing the "investigation results" in connection with the incident of mine explosion that occurred in the southern border area.
It is too low and dirty as befitting the tribes of the ROK.
Of course, such a farce is by no means a new.
When the mine explosion in question occurred on September 21, we had already anticipated the scenario of Seoul and seen through the true intention of the conspiratorial farce being staged by the ROK military gangsters.
In conclusion, the incident is a clear farce reminiscent of the "wooden-box mine incident" which disturbed the world more than ten years ago, in consideration of the time and method of provocation.
At that time the puppet forces forcibly linked the "mine explosion incident" that occurred on the western border with the DPRK and continuously escalated the tension under the pretext of it.
What should not be overlooked is the fact that the armed gangsters of the ROK are now cooking up the groundless results and "justifying their conduct" for political and military provocation against the DPRK, openly talking about "reasonable and corresponding enforcement of measures".
How can we sit and watch their despicable act of rashly doubting anyone after exploding a mine of doubtful provenance and talking about the breach of the Armistice Agreement.
Where can we find else such an absurd, malicious and gangster-like attitude?
The rulers of Seoul including those of the "People Power Party" have already unanimously said that the withdrawn loudspeaker against the DPRK should be set up in keeping with the futile bravery of the new minister of Defense.
It is absurd that they made a conclusion about the origin of the said mine exploded in the barren land which they had never set foot for more than a half century.
It is the height of impudence that the tribes of the ROK are trying to fabricate "material evidence" for proving it after shifting the blame for the incident onto the other.
We are closely watching why the ROK military rogues need the "mine incident" at this time in connection with their extremely scandalous acts which have been witnessed repeatedly in the southern border area in recent days.
The enemies' provocative acts near the southern border area are going beyond the limit with each passing day.
As the world knows, our army has been building the barriers in the southern border area as part of the work of strengthening the border two years ago, and this is only a thorough exercise of sovereignty unrelated with any military purpose.
However, the ROK military warmongers are seriously threatening the personal safety of our soldiers through warning broadcasting and warning shots, teasing our personnel mobilized for building the border barriers about the groundless "crossing of the border".
Especially from August, the enemy has been engaged in warning broadcasting and warning shots every day.
The "crossing the border" of our soldiers touted by the ROK military is a deliberate and planned strained assertion to shift the responsibility for escalating tension on to the DPRK.
Clearly speaking, our soldiers have never crossed the border.
This is a clear cavil and a provocation.
The ROK military should think first of all about what the world will say about its inability to distinguish its own land and other's land, failing to properly distinguish the boundary which can be confirmed by the naked eye.
We will never remain a passive onlooker to the hostile acts causing great concern in the border area.
When a single bullet is hit on our land, they must be prepared for a lot.
If the ROK military gangsters fire at our soldiers carrying on the permanent project for the southern border, not warning shots, our border units will take immediate and merciless retaliate attack.
The counteraction principles against them have already been issued to the border defence units and the army of the DPRK decided to take measures to increase the tactical counterattack means in the direction of the demilitarized zone of the 21st Infantry Division of the 3rd Corps of the ROK army where the provocations are frequent in recent days.
Explicitly speaking once again, it is clear that if the frequency of malicious accusation and provocation against us in the border region are frequent and lead to an encroachment on our actual territory and military sovereignty, the rogue group will have to face a situation that has not yet been experienced.
I seriously warn you that it would be a good idea to weigh the relative advantages with reasonable thinking.
If you are going to display "bravery" with an unpopular barbarous courage, you will only face a miserable and catastrophic position.
The dramatic culmination of the farce of Seoul will never be fun and the responsibility for all consequences will be entirely for the party to the provocation. -0-

headline: Second DPRK-Russia Rector Forum Held
Reception Given to Mark 77th Birthday of PRC
Wonsan Barbeque Restaurant Inaugurated in DPRK
Int'l Scientific Conference for Marking 80th Birthday ofKim Il SungUniversity Held
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- An international scientific conference for marking the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity took place here.
Its opening ceremony was held atKim Il SungUniversity on September 29.
Present there were Ri Yong Chol, minister of Education of the DPRK, officials, teachers and researchers ofKim Il SungUniversity, a Russian delegation led by Konstantin Mogilevski, vice-minister of Science and High Education, and other delegations and delegates of universities, scientific research institutes and organizations from different countries and a delegation of Korea University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan.
Present on invitation were members of the diplomatic corps here.
Kim Sung Chan, president ofKim Il SungUniversity, made an opening address.
He expressed thanks to the close friends who visited the DPRK to significantly celebrate the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity. And then he noted that the university has developed into a prestigious center for training talents and the highest seat of Juche-oriented science and education, recording the glorious history under the meticulous loving care of the peerlessly great men.
He declared the conference open, saying that it would contribute to deepening the friendly ties betweenKim Il SungUniversity and universities and research institutes of different countries and to the development of science and education and social progress.
Minister of Education Ri Yong Chol made a congratulatory speech.
He expressed belief that the conference would serve as an important occasion for sharing and learning the successes made in the scientific researches and reenergizing exchange and cooperation among universities.
Then there were congratulatory speeches made by Konstantin Mogilevski, vice-minister of Science and High Education of the Russian Federation, Dmitri Pyshny, president of Novosibirsk State University, and Fang Fang, vice-president of Beijing University of China.
Congratulating the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity, speakers said that the university has produced a large number of excellent talents to contribute to the development of the country while adhering to the line of socialist education under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The conference was held under the theme of "Development of science and education and social progress", divided into panels of socio-politics, economics, linguistics, mathematics and physics, biology and environmental protection, chemistry and material science and IT and automation engineering.
The speakers profoundly explained in their papers the academic achievements made in researches in various fields of social and natural sciences.
The conference closed on September 30.
A letter to respected ComradeKim Jong Unfrom the participants in the international scientific conference was adopted at the closing ceremony.
Kim Il SungUniversity hosted a reception at Okryu Restaurant for the participants in the conference that evening.
Agreements and a letter of understanding on exchange and cooperation betweenKim Il SungUniversity and universities of Russia, China and Belarus were signed during the conference. -0-

headline: Chinese Ambassador to DPRK Hosts Reception
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, gave a reception at his embassy on September 30 on the occasion of the 77th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China.
Present there on invitation were Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, Mun Song Hyok, vice department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Myong Su, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, Ryu Un Hae, vice-minister of External Economic Relations, officials concerned and members of the diplomatic corps in the DPRK.
Staff members of the Chinese embassy and Chinese guests staying here were on hand.
Wang Yajun made a speech at the reception.
Referring to the innovative development made by new China in various fields, including state administration, economy and people's living, he said all the successes are the fruits of the strong leadership of the Communist Party of China and the indomitable united struggle of the Chinese people.
The top leaders of the two parties and two countries indicated the orientation for the China-DPRK relations to develop with the times through the two historic Pyongyang summit meetings, thus injecting fresh vitality into the socialist cause of the two countries, he noted.
Then, Kim Hyong Sik made a speech.
He said that the founding of the People's Republic of China is an epochal event that opened up a new phase in shaping the destiny of the Chinese people and laid a firm foundation for them to proudly emerge in the world arena and achieve the prosperity of the Chinese nation.
He expressed the will to make joint efforts, together with the Chinese comrades, to promote exchange and cooperation in all fields and consolidate the DPRK-China friendship in the interests of the peoples of the two countries, true to the spirit of the important agreement between the top leaders of the two parties and two countries.
The participants in the reception toasted the health of respected ComradeKim Jong Unand respected Comrade Xi Jinping, the prosperity of the People's Republic of China and the steady development of the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations.
That day the Chinese consul general in Chongjin hosted a reception. -0-

The conference, held under the theme of "Development of science and education and social progress", marked a significant occasion in further strengthening the exchange, friendship and cooperation between universities of different countries andKim Il SungUniversity to more dynamically promote the progress of human society with the development of science and technology and education, it said.
The letter noted that during the conference, its participants came to know well about the warm love and trust of HEKim Jong Unwho has treasured and put forward scientists and educators and about the policy of the DPRK government to build a promising country which makes a leap forward by dint of science and technology and firmly guarantees the future by dint of education.
Through the conference, the scholars of different countries came to have a firm common understanding that it is very beneficial to the development of science and technology and the development of education for the progress of human society to steadily expand the many-sided academic exchange and contact withKim Il SungUniversity, it said.

headline: ComradeKim Jong Un's Speech at Celebration of 80th Founding Anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Unmade a speech"Respects to the Glorious 80-Year History ofKim Il SungUniversity"on September 30 on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity.
The full text of the speech is as follows:
Teachers, researchers and students ofKim Il SungUniversity, our state's number one base for training talented personnel and the highest institution of science and education,
Officials and employees of the university,
Dear comrades,
I am very pleased to be celebrating with you the historic day when this prestigious university is greeting its 80th founding anniversary.
As I am standing here, I can see the university's thousands of educators and 10 000 or so students brimming with enthusiasm. This fills my heart with trust and confidence in the powerful body of personnel who will shoulder the responsibility for the future of our state.
This university is the parent body in which the training of our state's native cadres began, the "pedigree farm" where large numbers of backbone personnel with loyalty to the Party and the revolution have been produced, and the highest academic institution which represents Korea's intellect and civilization. Indeed, the university's 80th founding anniversary is a source of great pride and an auspicious event for our country.
On the occasion of this anniversary of the university, which is famed for its most honourable name and history, I would like, first of all, to extend my heartfelt congratulations to all its teachers and researchers who are devoting themselves heart and soul to performing their ennobling duties faithfully at this sacred educational institution.
I also offer my warm encouragement to all the students who are applying themselves to learning and research with an ambitious aim and passion to exalt the honour of this country.
In addition, my greetings go to the foreign students, who, together with our students, work hard to enrich their knowledge and deepen the feelings of friendship, as well as to the Korean educationalists from overseas and foreign friends who have been invited here to share this significant event with us.
I send my greetings also to many comrades who are present at this celebration, and to all the graduates from this university who, wherever they live in the country, would be recollecting their student days with deep emotion and extending their best wishes to their alma mater on its founding anniversary.
Comrades,
As I am on this historic campus, I more deeply appreciate the ennobling ideal that was set forth in the initial days of nation building 80 years ago.
This "pedigree farm" for training talented personnel who would form the backbone of our state was built before anything else, and it was based on a determination to establish a powerful, independent and sovereign state lest another bitter disgrace of history be brought upon the Korean people, resourceful, diligent and righteous. I cannot but admire the loftiness of this ideal.
This day 80 years back was a momentous day which witnessed, along with the birth of a new, democratic Korea, the founding of the parent body for training its valuable native cadres, and it was a historic watershed which highlighted Korea's firm determination to shape its future confidently on the principle of achieving prosperity by dint of self-reliance.
This was how Korea's education took its first step.
Many universities in the world boast long histories and high reputations, but I am sure there is no such university asKim Il SungUniversity, which was established from scratch thanks to the efforts of the working people, has remained faithful to those people for so long years and has produced so many excellent personnel who have worked with devotion to build a genuine people's state.
As the highest educational institution in the country, this is an authoritative university that symbolizes our state and has propelled it towards prosperity and development, and a prestigious university that has produced most talented personnel representing our people's wisdom and creativity.
At the time of its establishment in the initial days of nation building, the university had only 68 teachers, seven faculties and 1 500 or so students. However, the first step it took was very significant and admirable, since it represented the Korean people's high aspirations and self-confidence.
In following its historic course through decades and generations, the university has rendered a great contribution to promoting the development of the state.
With this university as the parent body, a number of universities and colleges have been established, which has helped setting the framework of our education. By responding to the call of the times for the past 80 years, graduates from this university have strived hard to perform their ennobling duties and responsibilities as main pillars at the Party's and the state's leadership organs and in major sectors and units; their role as the state's loyal and devoted servants has been very active.
Still today, these graduates hold the state's important positions.
This fact illustrates the university's role and position in the development of the state.
Glorious is the university's 80-year history; from the first days of our Republic to this date, the university has achieved notable successes in education and scientific research to support this country's foundations and provide a firm guarantee for its future prosperity.
I courteously propose that we pay our respects to the university's first Chancellor Ho Hon as well as to Kim Ji Jong, To Sang Rok, Pak Si Hyong, Chae Hui Guk, So Sang Guk and other elder educators, who left an indelible imprint on the pages of its glorious history through their high academic authority and successes in education and scientific research.
Comrades,
At this moment when we look back on the annals of history of the university, which is replete with ennobling programmes of patriotism and succession, we ought to recollect instructions with due attention.
At the celebration held on the first anniversary of this university, the great leader ComradeKim Il Sungsaid that its characteristics lie in the fact that it is a people's university which provides the sons and daughters of the people with the freedom to learn and serves the purpose of promoting the people's wellbeing, developing our national culture to be worthy of the world's admiration and building a people's country.
This is a truly meaningful remark.
Kim Il SungUniversity is a solid, core stronghold that reliably guarantees the advance of the socialist cause by employing the Juche-based ideas on nation building and education for its mainstay and by training talented personnel who personify the wisdom and resourcefulness of the people.
Just at its inception, the university began to share its destiny with our state, and its development has since been part and parcel of our state's development.
The prestige and dignity the university has won through its historic struggle and exploits is something to be proud of, but we must in no way hold it simply for a historical record or a legacy of the past.
More important for us is the coming 80 years than the past 80 years, and heavier is the responsibility we bear for the future.
This is the time when the functions and role of the university are incomparably important and decisive for the present and future of our country.
We must be much more powerful.
Surpassing the era of harbouring a great ambition, dreams and desires, we should usher in an era of putting them into practice and reality, and more importantly, we should have such a will and self-confidence.
In reality, our socialist construction is going on in greater depth in greater realms, so it requires competent cadres and able personnel who can skilfully lead the relevant sectors, fields and regions with confidence in their revolutionary cause. This demands that the university further enhance its leading role in developing the science and education of the country by leaps and bounds and in terms of quality.
This is clearly an era when both national sovereignty and prestige depend on educational development and sovereignty in scientific and technological research.
Only when this university produces such good revolutionary personnel, namely, first-rate personnel equipped with an ennobling spirit and morality, high scientific and theoretical qualifications and creative abilities, can we preserve the character of the Korean revolution which is free from stagnation or retreat, and make an excellent success of our strategy for nation building.
It is by no means wrong to say that the future of our country, to say nothing of today and tomorrow of education and science, is determined precisely at this campus.
In our country none of its peers could be on a par with this university in terms of importance of their missions as each of its affairs has a direct bearing on the dignity and future of the country.
Needless to say, the university should take the lead in the honourable struggle to build a powerful and prosperous country.
This view of ours and the common understanding and expectations of everyone in this country precisely stand for the honour, glory and sacred duty of this university.
Considering this serious demand of the times and the expectations of the people, and facing this crucial historic point of national development, no other unit but this very university should rise up just like it did to lay the foundations for education and scientific research in its initial days. In this way it can make another event worth mentioning as its re-founding, and lay a solid strategic line for the future.
In recent years the Party Central Committee put forward the line of building an educational power and a talent power, and has consistently maintained the stand with which to give priority to educational development; it made a series of important decisions for modernization of education and the building of an educational power, and has effectively led the educational sector to achieve historic successes and make a trend of change and development.
An educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power to be built are the three essential requirements and a basic guarantee for the development of our style of socialism, which our Party advocates at the moment.
It is essential to prepare the leading, driving force if we are to accomplish the three-point strategic task, that is, building an educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power, and this university should take the position. This is the view and expectation of the Party Central Committee.
The university should play a core and leading role in carrying out several urgent tasks that still remain undone in the field of education and, more importantly, in overhauling the education system of the country as a whole.
The educational power we are going to build is a revolutionary, advanced and people-oriented one of our own style. To this end, the main orientation should be to guarantee the development and prosperity of our socialist state by dint of education; the fundamental principle, to strictly adhere to the Party's ideas and theories on education; the basic task, to train talented revolutionaries, possessed of excellent spiritual and moral traits and high intellectual and practical abilities, who will serve the state and the people; the main goal, to reduce regional differences in the educational level and make all the people well-versed in science and technology; the important function, to support and lead the comprehensive development of the state; the main motive force for development, to build up the ranks of teachers in terms of quality; the basic way, to update the educational structure, system, contents and methods and ensure the qualitative improvement of the educational conditions and environment; and the basic guarantee, to strengthen the guidance and assistance by the Party and the state and increase social support for education. In the long run, we will develop our education into the one to which we can fully entrust the future of our state and people.
Kim Il SungUniversity should bolster its position as a reliable centre for training talented personnel that symbolizes the level of our education, represents the development of our state, and showcases our bright future.
It should train talented revolutionaries who will serve their country and people both in name and in reality.
Because of a historical factor that compelled our state to pioneer a path for national defence and prosperity in a very special geopolitical environment, and because of our people's strong desire for building a powerful country, the levels and hallmarks of talented personnel required by our country were also unusual.
The university should produce not merely experts with qualifications in their specialist fields; it is required to train able revolutionary personnel who will faithfully serve our state and our people.
In trying to develop it into one of the most prestigious universities in the world, we are not aiming to raise its prestige or imitate others; our goal is to train more excellent personnel who will make a genuine contribution to accomplishing our revolutionary cause and become strong buttresses in building up our national power and providing our people with a happy life.
The contents and methods of teaching should be steadily updated in keeping with the trend of the times, but the true intention behind founding the university and its main function should remain unchanged.
The aspirations of all officials, teachers, researchers and students of the university should be in accord with the ennobling ideal of patriotism.
The university should set it as its immutable educational programme, its first and foremost one, to train all its students to be elite personnel who cherish the Party's intention and will as an element of their own faith and regard it as their lifelong goal to build the future as designed by the Party.
It should encourage all its students to have a good understanding of our Party's ideas and policies, cultivate revolutionary traits, and learn from the thoughts, spirit and willpower which their seniors cherished in training their minds and broadening their horizons of knowledge to leave remarkable imprints in the history of development of the Party and the state.
It should work out and put into effect proper courses of education and edification so that the students, fully aware of their heavy duty, can train themselves in practice while gaining firsthand experience of the reality through various production internships and socio-political activities.
I stress once again: This is a people's university which was established thanks to the ardent patriotism of our people who were determined to develop theirs into a prosperous and powerful country, and its dignified name, symbolic of its prestige and honour, was also instituted according to the unanimous will of our people.
Our people's expectations of the university were always unusual, and their desire for it still remains unchanged.
Before being recognized by the world in terms of any certain indexes or items, it should naturally be appreciated by the country and the people for its true and sound educational courses and the successes resulting from them, and its position should be verified by them.
As it is a learning space for the people's sons and daughters, the university should not produce self-centred or fame-seeking persons who try to gain academic qualifications or to lay a springboard for their own careers; it should produce genuine patriots who will make devoted efforts for the country and the people, true servants who will faithfully support the country.
Any unfair and ambiguous elements that are detested by the people and unacceptable to them must never be allowed to exist in this people's university.
The discipline ofKim Il SungUniversity, which trains the hardcore personnel for nation building, is directly linked with the national trait.
There should prevail on this campus the discipline and climate of remaining faithful to the Constitution of the Republic and to moral obligation, and all hues of lazy and unsound trends that run counter to the mission and principles of socialist education and have nothing to do with the revolutionary atmosphere of our times should be prevented from getting a foothold in the university.
Comrades,
Today, availing myself of this opportunity when I am meeting with you, teachers and researchers of the university, I want to make a particular reference to the need to improve the quality of education.
We should adhere to the principle of setting the high objective for qualitative development as the lifeblood of education at all levels, and set up an educational system of high qualitative level as quickly as possible.
The university, shouldering the important political responsibility for achieving the qualitative development of education, should provide a guarantee for ensuring that the policy-oriented decisions and directives of the Party Central Committee on advanced education prove effective in practice.
By comparing the present state of our education with the global trends in educational development, it should discover a shortcut to attaining a higher stage and study and update its educational structure and system so that it can produce more excellent revolutionary personnel as we need.
It should improve the contents and methods of education in keeping with the present reality that is different from the past and according to the rapidly-changing trends of the times.
It should improve the contents of education in the direction of training personnel who are possessed of a scientific way of thinking and practical methodology in addition to a rich knowledge of their major and relevant fields, and it should also steadily develop its teaching methods so that the students can have great abilities to analyze, think creatively and apply in practice.
The fundamental key to improving the quality of education is decisively to enhance the qualifications of teachers.
I regard strengthening the ranks of university teachers as the most important prerequisite for building an educational power.
However advanced the educational equipment, facilities, system, environment, methods and others may be, the qualitative instruction by a teacher is unthinkable apart from his or her leading role. So, it is essential to reinforce and perfect the teacher training system, and this should be the starting point for all affairs, I think.
The quality of education atKim Il SungUniversity represents our state's level of education.
The university should create standard models for most rational, productive and efficient structure, system, contents and methods of education, and use its influence in developing the country's education as a whole.
Comrades,
Kim Il SungUniversity is the highest academic institution that supports the country's dignity and prosperity with the twin pillars of education and science.
Our Party expects that the university, as befitting the country's cardinal and authoritative educational institution and its academic research institute, will play a greater role in developing the country's science.
The university should defend our Party's revolutionary ideology and theories, steadily explore and develop more academic domains needed for the present and future of nation building, enhance the state's competitive edge in science and technology, and give a strong push to the research projects that are conducive to putting the economy on an advanced and modern basis.
The university should encourage the sector of basic sciences, which is its peculiar advantage and a source of pride for it, to perform a distinct role in rendering services to carrying out the ambitious tasks for the technological revolution in the new era and opening up a shortcut to the future.
In order to add lustre to its honour as an authoritative and influential university in line with the demands of both global trend and our reality, it should play a core role in creating cutting-edge industries.
This university, which has nearly all academic subjects of theoretical and applied sciences and many outstanding personnel, can serve as a base for establishing those industries. It also can be called fertile soil capable of growing new sprouts and stems of our economy that will compete with the world on its own terms.
This is quite feasible if scientific planning is followed by investment and organizational work, since the university has prestigious research institutes of distinguished service, and has accumulated experience in the course of integrating education, scientific research and production.
I believe the university will take a lion's share in completely upgrading the features of our national economy and putting it on a new trajectory of development.
As befitting a world-class university and the highest-level university in the country, it should proactively conduct exchanges and cooperation with famous universities and scientific research institutions in other countries.
All the teachers and researchers of the university should make strenuous efforts to become the foundations for training excellent revolutionary personnel, not with their honour or academic degrees and titles but with conscience as educators and with whole-hearted devotion.
The illustrious educators who had their names recorded in the history of the university were stronger than any others in their desire for, and demand in, training even one more talented person in their academic fields for the good of the country.
They were literally faithful servants of the country and patriots, before being teachers.
When all the educators of the new generation hold in reverence the ennobling spirit and conscience of the preceding generations and adopt the aspiration and will to carry them forward as their ideological feelings, the history in which patriotism begets patriotism and a talent trains more talented personnel will go on.
All the educators of the university should, with a more soaring spirit and with more steadfast fortitude and will, open up a new, great phase of socialist education in the new era and contribute to the rapid development and prosperity of the country.
Dear students ofKim Il SungUniversity,
The honour of this dignified university and the future of the country depend on your shoulders.
You should set by yourselves the height of your practical abilities to be attained during your university days and value every second of your university life with a single desire to remain honourable before your motherland by dint of your knowledge and talents.
With a sense of sacred consciousness, you should continue to cultivate a good habit of studying and to create an atmosphere of innovation and competition.
You should have a strong sense of self-respect and self-confidence to make your country more powerful and prosperous, an ambition and courage to strike the world with admiration, and excellent academic records associated with your conscience and passion.
I put trust in the educators and students ofKim Il SungUniversity and its graduates.
You should learn and work harder for the prosperity of our state, the wellbeing of our people, and the advance of our cause.
As our goal is far-reaching and our task is enormous, the existence of talented personnel will be brought into bolder relief day by day, and the strenuous, devoted efforts made for the present struggle will produce rich, valuable fruits.
I appeal to all comrades who are full of enthusiasm on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the university to write its dignified history more proudly.
Let us advance forward, full of greater confidence, for Korea, our great motherland, and for our great ideals and for our great successes.
I wishKim Il SungUniversity eternal development and glory.
Thank you. -0-

headline: Emotion-Charged Meeting on Wihwa Island
story_text:
In January 2026, respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unarrived in the northwestern tip of the country by his private train.
As he desired to celebrate the beginning of the year 2026 with the young builders who were seeing in the New Year on windy Wihwa Island far away from their families and beloved homes, he left for his destination right after the events in Pyongyang.
Shaking hands with young builders, he gave a pep talk to them. Then he delivered an appealing speech to all the young builders.
He said that they deserve the whole country's congratulations for their exploits. His rousing speech greatly excited them, who weathered hardship and trials for more than 500 days, and they all burst into tears.
He paid a visit to the young builders as his first significant guidance for the year to place his great trust on the young people, seeing the sure continuity of Korean-style socialism in the growth of the young people. When he proposed making cheers of "Hurrah!" with great enthusiasm of the youth in reflection of great respect and love for the motherland, all the young builders were all overwhelmed with excitement.

headline: First University of People in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 1 (KCNA) -- October 1 of this year is the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity. It is the first university of the people built in the DPRK on the initiative of PresidentKim Il Sung.
After the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945), the President wisely led the construction of the university, after acquiring a deep insight into the fact that only when cadres to shoulder the Korean revolution are trained, can it possible to build a prosperous, independent and sovereign state.
One day in November 1945, the President met officials in the field of education and said that it is urgently needed for the actual conditions of the country to found the university and that if the university is established, it is possible to train cadres to work in all fields of politics, economy and culture at the same time.
Noting that if the university is established first, many universities will be built in a short span of time on the basis of it, he said that the university will become a strong cadre-training base of the country and a parent body of universities.
The President stressed the need to make the university a genuine people's university that gives educations to the sons and daughters of the working people and trains cadres for the working people.
At that time when the building of a new country was undergoing, there were not many teachers who would stand on the platform of the university and those who had basic knowledge to receive higher education, and there were no university building, dormitory and educational facilities to speak of.
The President energetically led the preparations for the founding of the university by mobilizing the efforts of the patriotic people.
He chose the site of the university, sent the rice donated out of patriotism by a peasant to the construction of the university building, and set up a preparatory committee for founding the university so that the work of building the university could be conducted on a nationwide scale.
In July next year he made sure that an important decision on founding the university was declared and paid great efforts to found the university including the issue of selecting teachers and students.
Under the leadership of the President, a genuine people's university was born on October 1, 1946.
The Korean people named their first proud university afterKim Il Sung, the august name of the peerless patriot.
The foundation ofKim Il SungUniversity opened up a new history of training the sons and daughters of the people as pillars shouldering the future of the new Korea and Juche-oriented higher education and made it possible to build an independent people's state. -0-

Paying his respect to the noble idea of having built before anything else the pedigree establishment for training talents to be the backbone of the DPRK in the first days of nation building 80 years ago, he stressed thatKim Il SungUniversity is the highest dignified educational institution symbolizing our state and dynamically promoting its prosperity and development and a meritorious school of high reputation as it has trained the best talents representing the wisdom and creativity of our people with high pride.
Recalling the proud 80-year history of the university which has reliably guaranteed the far-sighted plan of the country with remarkable educational and scientific achievements since the outset of the history of the Republic, he referred to the importance of the university with a history of noble patriotism and succession to play the powerful role as an engine in ensuring remarkable success of state-building strategy at the times when the national sovereignty and prestige are guaranteed by the educational development and sci-tech sovereignty, the most important and decisive period for the present and future of our motherland.
The university should stand in the vanguard of the honorable struggle for building a powerful and prosperous country, he said, clarifying the principled issues for it to implement in the van the Party Central Committee’s line of building an educational power and a talent power and lay a firm strategic orbit for the future in line with the solemn requirements of the times and expectations of the people.
Noting that the building of an educational power, a sci-tech power and a talent power is the three essential requirements and basic guarantee for the development of Korean-style socialism insisted by our Party at present, he expressed the view and expectation of the Party Central Committee on the core and leading position and role of the university in carrying out this strategic task and advanced the tasks and ways for opening up a great new phase of socialist education in the new era with high and qualitative development of the university.
ComradeKim Jong Unardently called for advancing with greater confidence for the DPRK, our great motherland, and for the great ideal and great success of all the people, wishingKim Il SungUniversity eternal development and glory.
His passionate speech, which indicates the immortal education programme guaranteeing the rosy future of socialist Korea for all ages with his steadfast will to glorify the DPRK as a country of education, science and talents, greatly excited the participants.
When ComradeKim Jong Unfinished his speech, all the participants raised stormy cheers as a token of their solemn pledge to firmly carry forward the proud history and tradition of the university and fulfill the honorable responsibility and duty before the times and history with its core and leading role in the country’s educational and sci-tech development.
Then, a performance for commemorating the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity was given with splendor in the presence of ComradeKim Jong Un.

The audience was deeply moved by numbers recalling the important and distinguished role and proud feats of the university shining along with the victorious journey of the revolutionary cause of Juche.

headline: Advanced Farming Methods Bring Successes
National Intangible Cultural Heritage
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 2 (KCNA) -- There are many pine-nut trees in mountains of the DPRK.
Pine nut contains much content of vitamin B1 and protein. It also has rich lysine and amino acid essential for the physical growth and linolic acid effective for the preventive treatment of hypertension and arteriosclerosis.
For this reason, the Korean people have widely used pine nuts in their dietary life.
They made pine-nut porridge by mixing with rice.
The porridge cooked with pine nuts, specialty of Mt Kumgang, was famous.
The cooking method of this dish, called Kumgang pine-nut porridge, is as follows:
First, boil rice soaked for about an hour with certain amount of water.
Grind certain amount of rice and roasted pine nuts of which inner shells are peeled to make pine-nut juice.
Mix the pine-nut juice with rice porridge.
As a typical Koryo medicinal food, the pine-nut porridge is good for refreshment and improving nutritive conditions.
It was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage. -0-

Publishing of "reports" and enforcement of the "special rapporteur" system to randomly estimate the human rights situations of the DPRK and other countries in the name of the UN are a typical example that shows how impotent and submissive the UN speaking for the international community and its head are toward the U.S. and the West high-handed and arbitrary practices.
Now international peace and security has plunged into the most critical phase ever since the end of Cold War and the UN has been exposed to the worst structural and moral crisis ever since its foundation. It is no exaggeration to say that the current UN secretary-general is wholly to blame for this as he has connived at the U.S. and its vassal forces' high-handed and arbitrary practices and even followed them.
During the term of Secretary-General Guterres, the UN has been reduced into an unfair and undemocratic body that speaks for the exclusive interests of a specific nation and minority, instead of general interests of the international community, contrary to the purpose of the founding of the UN and the principle of its Charter.
We expect nothing from the current UN secretary-general who has betrayed the confidence of the international community and will soon retire from office. But we will never tolerate the repetition of such prejudiced and provocative conduct politicizing the human rights issue in the term of the next secretary-general.
For us, human rights are just national rights and absolute sovereignty never to be surrendered in any case.
If anyone hurts the dignity and system of the DPRK and encroaches upon its people's interests, it will be regarded as a grave violation of the latter's sovereignty and the former will be surely blamed for it.
The DPRK will ensure its rights and interests in overall fields including sovereignty, human rights and security by itself and thoroughly exercise them and continuously make great efforts to eliminate the UN's partiality and double standards and realize democracy and impartiality in the organization. -0-

headline: Korean Bow-Intangible Cultural Heritage of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 3 (KCNA) -- From olden times the Korean people have expressed their courtesy by bowing to each other.
Korean bow is a form of greeting in which people bend their heads or bodies forward for showing each other respect or etiquette in case of meeting or leaving.
Korean bow can be divided into two, a sitting bow and a standing bow.
It reflects the personality and feelings of the Korean people who are modest, strong, gentle and kind.
Korean bow was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in November 2021. -0-

headline: Work to Increase Generating Capacity by Natural Energy Accelerated in DPRK
True Meaning of Modernization
story_text:
One day in November 2014, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited a foodstuff factory.
Saying with satisfaction that the panorama of the newly-remodeled factory is very wonderful, he went round its various parts with pleasure.
At the combined control room, he saw a large display board installed on the front wall and expressed satisfaction at the establishment of an integrated production management system.
He kindly asked an official to explain it and listened to his explanation carefully.
Then he stressed that each foodstuff factory should realize the modernization of production lines on a higher level like this factory, adding that modernization based on foreign equipment, not on our own efforts and technology, cannot be termed modernization in its true sense.
He stated that modernization demanded by the Workers' Party of Korea is the one based on our Juche-oriented forces and technology, not based on the strength and technology of other countries.
His meaningful teachings reflected the iron truth that to strictly rely on one's own strength and technology is the key to developing the country's economy and hastening the national prosperity. -0-

headline: Strategic Weapon Launching Drill Conducted: Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 3 (KCNA) -- At dawn of this morning, a drill of firing a strategic weapon toward the East Sea of Korea was conducted.
An intermediate-range strategic missile was used for the drill.
The head of state personally oversaw the drill of a firepower sub-unit undertaking an exclusive special mission.
The joint chiefs of staff of the ROK, which tracked our drill, announced that the missile flew more than 700 km, while the Japan defence ministry termed the range 680 km.
They are interesting numbers.
We have already witnessed similar announcements four times   and, finally, we came to the conclusion that the superiority of the special flight mode applied to the missiles in our possession has been verified in practice.
Of course, we should neither believe the enemy's tracking results nor satisfy ourselves of them, but such figures help take a look at the limitations of the enemy's tracking capability and the special features of our missiles.
Whenever we applied the wave-like trajectory mode to missiles, the enemy failed to track the targets from their first skip points.
Extension of the trajectory at the downward stage gives the numbers quite similar to the numbers of the ranges announced by the enemy.
The enemy always made such a lame excuse that there is a limit to the detection capability because of the curvature of the earth's surface, but in fact this just serves as a proof of our perfect missile capability and the most scientific "evaluation index" confirming the power and reliability of our weapon system.
They should acknowledge the speed of the missile.
And they would be well advised to recollect our announcements that it is capable of changing its flight orbit at a low altitude and AI was introduced into it.
In other words, this means that there is no way to avoid this attack.
Representatives of the Missile Administration reported to the head of state that it is possible to set at least four flight orbit modes according to a purpose and target with the technology recently introduced.
The head of state expressed the belief that any country in the world could not have access to such technology for at least several years. -0-

headline: Young People Volunteer for Worksites Seething with Implementation of Party Policies
story_text:

Those in Junghwa and Sohung counties vowed to work at honorable construction posts to urbanize, civilize and modernize rural villages.
