Officials in the province, youth and students presented bouquets to the volunteers leaving for new revolutionary posts and encouraged them. -0-

headline: Korean Tune, Valuable Musical Heritage of Korean People
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- Korean tune is a valuable musical heritage of the Korean people.
From olden times the Korean people have widely used various rhythms in many songs and dances they have created in the course of their working life.
Korean tune is varied, and its resonance is so subtle and delicate that it has a unique charm that makes the audience dance with their shoulders moving up and down. Korean tune is very diverse and rich.
Typical of them is Yangsando tune.
Yangsando tune is used in many musical works for its pleasant, optimistic and splendid emotional characteristics.
"Ballad of Gold Mountains", "Song of Big Hauls in the Sea" and other songs and dances created on the basis of Korean tune that sustain their peculiarities enrich the treasure house of the Juche-oriented musical art and contribute to the cultural and emotional life of the people.
Korean tune was registered as a national intangible cultural heritage in August this year. -0-

headline: Major Construction Projects Brisk in DPRK

headline: Birthday Spread to Woman Centenarian

Officials of the Party and power organs in the county and villagers congratulated the centenarian on having received the birthday spread associated with the warm love of respected MarshalKim Jong Unwho respects the aged as revolutionary forerunners and elders and takes warm care of them.

headline: Sci-tech Products Developed by Agricultural Scientists Popular among Various Units
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- Agricultural sci-tech products developed by scientists of the Institute of Agro-chemicalization under the Academy of Agricultural Sciences are popular among agricultural production units, according to Rodong Sinmun.
The number of units who are introducing the slow-effective weed-killer Jihyo 1 is increasing day by day.
This weed-killer keeps the weeding effect of over 95 percent in paddy fields for about two months. It can kill various kinds of weeds growing in paddy fields in a comprehensive way without giving harming effect on rice seedlings and growth.
The institute introduced the newly-developed slow-effective fertilizer into rice and corn cultivation, proving scientifically that it is helpful to increasing the per-hectare yield while using less fertilizer than before.
The institute also newly developed the wheat and barley seed-coating material Phungnyonmo 3 and is increasing the area of its introduction. It is winning popularity among farms as it helps remove the former process of disinfecting wheat seed.
As a result of the introduction of Phungnyonmo 3, many farms considerably increased the per-hectare wheat yield this year. -0-

headline: Strategic Missile Launching Drill Conducted in Eastern Region of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 4 (KCNA) -- At dawn of October 3, a drill was staged to launch an intermediate-range strategic missile from an eastern region of the DPRK toward the East Sea of Korea.
The drill was conducted as part of the efforts to train the missile soldiers operating the hypersonic strategic weapon system in handling their equipment and evaluate the reliability, efficiency and mobility of the DPRK's war deterrent.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the launching drill on the spot.
Among the spectators were Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, and Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK.
Noting that it is a very important measure for ensuring national security and a responsible action of our army to build up the powerful and reliable nuclear deterrent through sustained verification of major components of the war deterrent, improvement of their performance and mastery of the capabilities for their successful operation and to show the counterattack means of our army in constant mobilization posture, ComradeKim Jong Unsaid:
"Through today's launching drill, the strategic missile soldiers have fully demonstrated their professional qualifications and counterattack posture, clearly showing that they are very good at operating the major offensive weapon system and they are always available for mobilization. They also added confidence to our deterrent.
I highly appreciate commanding officers and soldiers of the missile unit who participated in the drill.
We must continue our responsible efforts nonstop to constantly and repeatedly make the enemy recognize the reliability and fatality of our strategic offensive means.
This is a form of exercising deterrent.
As always expressed clearly, such activities on our part are definitely aimed at more rapidly developing the country's nuclear war deterrent.
This is indispensable for protecting national security and stability in today's geopolitical environment. There will be no change in such view and line of ours.
We must deter various threats by dint of powerful deterrent and ensure a safer environment for the building and activities of our state."
The missile used in the drill was launched towards the northeast direction and hit the target point at 43°36' 28.04" latitude and 138°00' 47.02" longitude, 1 000 km away on the East Sea of Korea.
ComradeKim Jong Unexpressed expectation and belief that all the missile forces would remain faithful to their missions of defending the sovereignty and security of the Republic in a responsible combat posture. -0-

headline: "Archaeopterix Coreanica"
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 5 (KCNA) -- "Archaeopterix coreanica", registered as a natural monument, is on display at the Natural History Museum ofKim Il SungUniversity.
It was discovered in Paektho-dong, Sinuiju City, North Phyongan Province, the DPRK on March 10, 1989.
PresidentKim Il Sungwas told that it is a progenitor bird fossil discovered in the stratum dating back about 150 million years. He named it"Korean archaeopteryx"and said that the excavation of the fossil shows that our country is the cradle of birds.
The fossil is composed of a skull, pterygoid, neck bone and feathers. The pterygoid has clear hook-shaped talons.
The Korean archaeopteryx with the most primitive shape of a bird clearly proves that the birds originated from the reptiles.
The age of the Korean archaeopteryx was most suitable for the birth and development of life. The fossil is of great significance in the study of biodiversity and ecological environment as it was unearthed with fossil fish, insects, pterodactyls and plants, etc. -0-

headline: New Products Developed in Vehicle-building Industry
story_text:

It works hard to establish a new-type 80 hp tractor engine production process.
The Sunchon Engine Factory invents and manufactures jigs and equipment necessary for establishing new-type tractor engine production processes and pushes ahead with the projects of consolidating the material and technical foundations of the factory, including the one of putting the existing equipment on a modern basis.
While reducing fuel consumption, the factory is resolving technical problems arising in establishing a new engine production process with more improved performance than the previous engine.
A remarkable success is being made in the development of new products.

The Kumgang Prime Motor Factory under the general small farm machine production enterprise developed 6 hp diesel engines and is pushing ahead with the work for realizing its serial production. -0-

headline: Pyongyang General Hospital Marks Its Founding Anniversary
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 6 (KCNA) -- It has been one year since the inauguration of the Pyongyang General Hospital.
During the past one year, the general hospital has offered advanced and different medical service to more than 400 000 persons and conducted at least 1 000 rounds of consultations and technical lectures for regional hospitals through a telemedicine service system.
Through its efforts to put various operations and curing diseases on a scientific basis, it succeeded in operating patients with rare diseases.
It brought a lot of patients back to life by introducing advanced medical technologies.
It offered ten-odd rounds of technical lectures to medical workers at provincial, city and county preventive and curative institutions while regularly operating the telemedicine service system and conducted consultations with provincial general hospitals in a responsible way to help them take relevant measures for treatment.
Symposiums sponsored by the general hospital served as opportunities for broadening the view of medical workers and helping them exchange achievements and experience gained in researches. -0-

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 6 (KCNA) -- Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and premier of the DPRK Cabinet, inspected various sectors of the national economy.
The premier visited the February 8 Jikdong Youth Coal Mine of the Sunchon Area Youth Coal-mining Complex and met and encouraged the coal miners who were working hard to increase coal production with a high sense of responsibility for taking an important part in the coal production. He acquainted himself in detail with the production of the coal mine.
He said the coal mine should reinforce the tunneling forces in the coal mine to secure enough reserve coal fields, actively introduce efficient mining methods and equipment into the pit-face work and raise the enthusiasm for mass movement so that all the coal miners turn out as one in the patriotic struggle for increased coal production.
Learning about the current production and remodeling project of the Sunchon Engine Factory, he underscored the need to put the priority on improving the quality as required by the Party's policy, ensure the accuracy of processing accessories so as to produce high-performance tractor engines and step up the design and construction on the principle of optimizing the production processes.
Meanwhile, Pak Thae Song inspected various farms in Ongjin, Kangryong and Pyoksong counties of South Hwanghae Province and stressed the need to properly fix the time for harvesting according to fields and varieties and rationally allocate manpower and machines in order to finish the rice harvest and threshing in time so that the rich harvest of this year can lead to a real yield.
Watching the wheat and barley sowing machine made by the Haeju Farm Machine Factory, he underscored the need to produce and supply different kinds of practical farm machines in keeping with the increase of the area of sowing wheat and barley in the whole area and the timely simultaneous harvesting of late crop and sowing of early crops.
The field consultative meetings discussed the issue of ensuring that relevant units fully produce and supply rock drills, loaders and other equipment and tools necessary for face working and the issue of actively generalizing advanced farming methods in the agricultural field and encouraging the cultivation of oil-bearing crops and sugar crops and took relevant measures. -0-

headline: Ryuwon Footwear Factory Benefits from Natural Energy
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 6 (KCNA) -- The Ryuwon Footwear Factory in the DPRK has a natural energy power station, according to Rodong Sinmun.
One thousand and hundreds of well-arranged solar panels were installed on roofs of all buildings covering an area of thousands of square meters.

With energy from the solar panels, the factory ensures the electricity supply to sewing machines, cooling-and-heating equipment, lighting and canteen.

headline: DPRK Premier Inspects Several Sectors of National Economy
Press Statement of DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 6 (KCNA) -- The Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea issued the following press statement "We will be more resolute and clear in exercising our sovereignty toward the most hostile state" on Tuesday:
New danger of war is prevailing along the southern border of the DPRK, bounded by the state most hostile toward it.
The ROK made public the "final investigation results", in which it forcibly linked with us the "mine explosion case" that occurred in a border area, and called for "responsive diplomatic and military steps" to be taken against our state with a "mine-removing operation" as the start.
As we already stated, the ROK fully betrayed and proved itself what the ulterior purpose of the farce plotted and orchestrated by Seoul is.
The "mine-explosion case" is a sinister obstructive move intended to brand our fortification of the southern border, downright exercise of the sovereignty, as a "military invasion" and delay and check it, and this is no more than a poor trick of the ROK military to shift the blame for its own accident onto us.
The ROK seeks to hold the DPRK accountable for the premeditated farce, fabricated and determined unilaterally by it, and tarnish the latter's international image. It is a grave provocation never to be overlooked and a wanton violation of our sovereignty that deserves sure punishment.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK categorically rejects the despicable attempt of the ROK and solemnly clarifies that our state will exercise its just sovereign rights in a more resolute and bold manner to ensure the security of the southern border.
We do not care about them trying to remove the mines irrelevant to us, and we have no reason to pay heed to such farce of the ROK.
However, if a jackboot or a spark of fire from the ROK goes even a millimeter beyond the border to violate our territory, the border guard forces of the DPRK will take immediate and powerful counteraction.
We make it clear that if a similar thing happens again in the ROK in the future, we are not responsible for it but the side, which sustained it, is entirely accountable.
As already clarified, the DPRK will never discuss with the enemy countries the issue of exercising its military sovereignty within its territory but defend its territorial sovereignty by thoroughly exercising its power, not by negotiations.
We take this opportunity to reaffirm that it is the official stand of the DPRK government.
The malicious attempt of the ROK to attain its sinister purpose through a mean farce can never work in any case.
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea will be most resolute and definite in exercising its sovereignty toward the relation with the most hostile state, in which any slightest tolerance, concession and connivance are disallowed. -0-

headline: Sangwon Cement Complex Fulfills Third-Quarterly National Economic Plan
Experience in Paddy-field Fish Breeding at Samjigang Farm of Jaeryong County
U.S. Is Acting Rashly: International Affairs Analyst
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 7 (KCNA) -- Kim Myong Chol, an international affairs analyst of the DPRK, released the following article "The U.S. is acting rashly":
"Peace and stability of the Taiwan Strait" is something always repeated by the United States and its allies in the international arena.
However, the U.S. has systematically destroyed regional stability and persistently escalated the situation under the pretext of "opposing unilateral attempt at change of phenomenon" in the Taiwan Strait.
The emergence of fighter jets sold by the U.S. on the island of Taiwan a few days ago is another typical example of the U.S. "peculiar contribution" to "peace and stability" of the Taiwan Strait.
The U.S. says that the sale of weapons to Taiwan is for "peace in the strait", but this is nothing but a shameless act of planting a bomb at the gate of other's house and asserting that the bomb is for ensuring the security of the house.
When the People's Republic of China and the U.S. established their diplomatic relations, the latter recognized the government of the former as the only legitimate government of China and Taiwan as a part of the former. But the U.S. made it its policy and obligation to sell weapons to Taiwan, irrespective of the change of its administration, and has supported the separatist forces pursuing "Taiwan's independence" and challenging the "one-China" principle.
In the past decade alone, the cost of munitions supplied by the U.S. to Taiwan in the form of overseas arms sales totaled more than 39 billion US dollars. This includes 11 billion US dollars, the largest-ever arms sales approved by the present U.S. administration at the end of last year.
Not content with this, the U.S. has made it a fait accompli to additionally sell weapons worth 14 billion US dollars to Taiwan.
Herein lies the reason why peace and stability have not been restored in the Taiwan Strait for decades.
Recently, the U.S. proclaimed the first island chain including Taiwan as the forefront for suppressing China. It seeks to deploy the latest missiles on an island of Japan closest to Taiwan and "internationalize" the Taiwan issue by making its warships and aircraft pass through the Taiwan Strait under the signboard of "freedom of navigation".
This proves once again that "peace and stability of the Taiwan Strait" touted by the U.S. is, in essence, "support for Taiwan's power-based independence" and that the "one-China" policy advocated by it is nothing but the one for "perpetuating the division of China by force".
The Taiwan issue is an internal affair of China, so how to settle it is entirely the affair of the Chinese people, and no outside forces have the right to interfere in it.
Obviously, the U.S. did up the wrong button on the Taiwan issue and has taken again a dangerous course whose consequences are difficult to imagine.
Some American fighters to be deployed in Taiwan may be a comfort to the separatists for a while, but it cannot bridge the striking gap between the both sides in terms of capability.
No matter what method the Taiwanese separatists employ and what support the U.S. renders to Taiwan, it can neither deny the fact that Taiwan is a part of China nor influence the basic recognition of the international community that adheres to the principle of "one China".
The U.S. should think twice whether it is ready to stand in frontal confrontation with the powerful national power of the People's Republic of China for the security of Taiwan and whether it can cope with its consequences. If it is worried about the consequences, it had better think and act rationally.
Justice is not afraid of confrontation with injustice.
No one should question the ability and will of the People's Republic of China to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity and core interests.
China's effort to retake Taiwan is an indispensable and just sacred cause for making abnormalities normality, making injustice justice and making instability stability. It is an irrefutable law-governed historical process that the island of Taiwan becomes a part of China again.
The instability of the Taiwan Strait precisely means the crisis of the United States. Taiwan's return to China is a matter of time. -0-

headline: WPK's Emblem Clearly Shows Character of Popular Masses
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 7 (KCNA) -- A foreign personage said with excitement that there are many communist party leaders in the world, but only PresidentKim Il Sungmade sure that a hammer and sickle symbolizing workers and peasants and a brush symbolizing intellectuals were depicted in the party emblem. The foreign personage highly praised the President's exploits, saying that it was entirely reasonable for ComradeKim Il Sungto do so.
The emblem of the Workers' Party of Korea was personally drawn by PresidentKim Il Sung.
In the days when he developed the party into a mass party of the working people after national liberation (August 15, 1945), the President personally initiated the creation of the Party emblem. He referred to the shortcomings of the Party emblems depicting only workers and peasants except intellectuals, and made sure that a brush was drawn together with a hammer and a sickle.
He saw to it that a brush, instead of a pen, was drawn as a symbol of intellectuals and the hammer and sickle used by Korean workers and peasants were drawn.
Looking at the design of the emblem presented by creators, he also made sure that the hammer, sickle and brush crossed each other at the midpoint of their handles in order to symbolize the unity and cohesion of the working masses including the working class, peasants and intellectuals.
Saying that the brush should be placed in the middle slightly higher than others, he explained that it means workers and peasants should acquire high knowledge and cultural level and make a tangible contribution to the building of a prosperous and civilized independent and sovereign state in the future, personally drawing the emblem of the Party.
Everyone still recalls with deep emotion that the design of the Party emblem drawn by the President reflected his unshakable faith and will to build our Party into the people's one taking care of the destiny of the people to the end.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Unsaid that our Party emblem clearly reflects the revolutionary and popular character of our Party, adding that it symbolizes the party struggling for the demand and interests of the popular masses, deeply rooted among them. -0-

headline: For Convenience of Researchers
story_text:

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Congratulatory Message to President of Russian Federation
story_text:

The message said:
My dearest friend, Comrade Vladimir Putin,
I extend my sincerest warm congratulations and best wishes to you on your significant birthday.
Over the past two decades the Russian Federation has firmly consolidated its dignity and position as a big power, written a new biography of epoch-making development and proudly ranked as a world-famous powerful and prosperous country under your outstanding and seasoned leadership.
All these are a precious product of devoted efforts and strong will of you who have always cherished the aspiration and expectations of the Russian people desirous of building a powerful state and remained faithful to your sacred mission, braving countless challenges and trials, and for this, you enjoy the great trust and support of the Russian people.
I am pleased to have good friendship with you and open up a new chapter for the development of the relations between our two countries.
It is the steadfast policy of the DPRK government and my unshakable option to attach importance to the comprehensive strategic partnership and alliance forged with the fraternal Russian Federation and to steadily expand and develop the joint work.
I reaffirm my invariable support for you and the Russian Federation, being firmly convinced that the Russian people's sacred war of justice for defending the sovereignty, security interests and territorial integrity of the country will surely end with their victory.
I offer my congratulations on the significant day, praying that victory and glory will be in store for you and your Russia.
Extending noble tribute and militant greetings,

headline: Press Statement of Kim Yo Jong, Department Director of C.C., WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, issued the following press statement on Thursday:
The rogues, who endangered the situation in the Korean peninsula through a self-composed farce, causing a stir, orchestrate another farce on the theme of "good will" this time, stunning the world people.
On October 7, the authorities of the ROK made public that they submitted a "request for exemption from sanctions" to the UNSC sanctions committee on the DPRK in May so as to "offer medical equipment" to the DPRK and, consequently, won the "approval for exemption".
In particular, guys of the ROK thoughtlessly stated in the "request" that they would make a contribution to the "improvement of the primary medical service for a vulnerable class", talking about someone's "lack of medicines and medical equipment and deterioration of public health situation".
This is an insult to our state and mutant political-motivated provocation against it and a grave encroachment upon our national law.
It is, indeed, a noisy and ugly act.
Another farce, orchestrated in parallel with the "mine explosion" farce, is also an extraordinary spectacle.
Under the situation in which many doubtable points about the recent "mine explosion case" have not been cleared, a series of dog fights has continued between the two sides claiming "accident or provocation" in the ROK.
Official of the ROK Jong Tong Yong, too, confessed that it is difficult to judge that the "mine explosion case" is a deliberate attack by the DPRK.
Now when it is impossible to expect a good box-office record from their poor farce, they have created another farce titled "a scenario for aiding medical equipment", the part 2 of the "mine explosion case".
It is not too difficult to understand why they created contradictory farces simultaneously.
The ROK, which is crying out for the implementation of the strong "diplomatic and military countermeasures" together with the announcement of the "final investigation result" related to the "mine explosion" farce, has suddenly revealed its plot for "aid" which has been pursued for months, talking about the "building of confidence" under the signboard of "humanism".
We know enough about their real intention.
Under the present situation, those, who must be aware of the fact that medical equipment supported by the ROK cannot enter our territory and there is no way for introducing them, are resorting to such a farce. This is a sinister political calculation to get anything by comparing their "well-meaning attitude" with our "conflicting attitude" to reject them.
All their acts cannot be easily understood in common sense.
The Seoul authorities' acts are mixed with unilateral judgment, unilateral decision and unilateral announcement. There are two doubts whether they are political immature guys or truly born idiots who can never be remodeled.
If they really want to reverse the relations between the DPRK and the ROK, they should be conscious of their rival's feelings in every word and action and show their utmost respect, solicitude and sincerity before anything.
The Seoul authorities are revealing their more despicable colors with the passage of time.
The chief culprits, who cooked up the farce called "mine explosion case" and declared the all-out confrontation with the DPRK, are talking about "humanitarian aid". This is the true picture of the ROK characterized by peculiar duplicity, impudence and shamelessness hard to be found anywhere.
We have nothing to exchange or go with the ROK and no need to face to face with it. We make it clear once again that it is the unshakable stand of the DPRK.
No matter whether the most disgusting and mean betesnoires have an evil intention or "good faith", any attempt of theirs will be regarded as a challenge and grave provocation to the DPRK and a violation of its sovereignty.
We will never sit face to face with the ROK forever, and we will make them feel again the fact that history can never be reversed.
This time the ROK authorities made another big mistake.
The crime committed by the ROK, which insulted our inviolable state and people with the list of dirty things, will be settled accounts thoroughly, downright and without regret.
There will be no change in the true colors of the ROK most hostile to the DPRK and the hostile nature of the DPRK-ROK relations. -0-

headline: Party Founding Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 8 (KCNA) -- Many people have visited the Party Founding Museum in Central District, Pyongyang, the capital city of the DPRK, on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The museum is a significant place where PresidentKim Il Sungfounded the Party and led the building of a new country to victory after the liberation of Korea (August 15, 1945).
Displayed at the museum are historic data and relics showing the feats performed by the President in building the Party, state and army.
The President proclaimed the founding of the WPK in the building on October 10, 1945.
With the founding of the Party, the Korean people could successfully carve out their destiny with their reliable vanguard unit and militant staff and since then a new history of building a revolutionary party in the era of independence has opened up.
On October 8, 2025, respected ComradeKim Jong Unvisited the Party Founding Museum on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK and made a significant speech there.
In his speech he clarified the position of the Party Founding Museum with the meaningful definition that it is the birthplace of the WPK and the sacred sanctuary which carries on the lineage of the WPK and the its ever-victorious traditions for all ages.
Going round the Party Founding Museum, the visitors are deeply grasping the immortal exploits of the President who set a brilliant example in building a revolutionary party and wisely led the struggle to enhance the leadership role of the Party.
Overseas Koreans and foreigners visited the museum and praised the exploits of the President for party building and the invincibility of the Party, expressing belief that the WPK would demonstrate its dignity and might as a glorious Kimilsungist-Kimjongilist Party forever. -0-

headline: Department Director Kim Yo Jong of C.C., WPK Re-clarifies Stand through KCNA
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 9 (KCNA) -- Kim Yo Jong, department director of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea made public through KCNA the following judgment and stand of the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea toward the hooligans of the ROK on October 9:
There is nothing more disgusting than the "good will" covered as "ill will".
The racket of "mine explosion" and the farce of "medical equipment support" orchestrated by the ROK are just the two sides of the same coin minted by its inveterate bad habit of escalating confrontation with our state. They were all instigated by a single black-hearted scheme; to tarnish the prestige and image of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea at any cost.
This time the duplicity and shamelessness of the ROK, which touted "humanitarian aids" for someone, have become visible to the naked eye.
The hooligans of the ROK have been hit hard once again.
They employed a suicidal trick and "utterly disgraced" themselves militarily and diplomatically.
Though disgusting, I have so far watched the deceptive behavior of the ROK. However, such ill-minded idiots as the present authorities of the ROK were rare to be seen.
The recent farce staged again under the signboard of "humanitarian aids" is another part of the "serial comedy drama", so mean and stupid, designed to contrast their "goodwill attitude and effort" with our "negative stand" in the eyes of the international community.
They seemingly want to highlight this; "As you see, we do everything we could do with 'good will' and Seoul is not responsible for ever-escalating tensions."
This is, indeed, an abnormal act peculiar to the enemy. This is impossible if he or she is not an animal.
What a simple ulterior purpose and mean method.
The ROK will surely be caught in a more unfavorable situation for its despicable act.
Maybe the ROK has earned a thing but it has lost two, three and ten things.
This reminds me of the idiots jumping into fire with faggot on their backs and adding fuel to the fire.
In Part One of the "serial comedy drama," they played "victims" and in Part Two they suddenly disguised themselves as "angels" preaching the merits of "humanitarianism." We will take time for this funny show to see its box-office result.
The farces recently staged by Seoul are unprecedented politically-motivated, military and moral provocations against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. They have become the decisive historical records perpetuating our understanding of the ROK human scum down through generations.
They constitute the epitome of Seoul's meanness.
Upon authorization of our head of state and according to the general will of the people of the DPRK, I clarify that we will more definitely disregard and reject the human scum of the ROK in the future. -0-

Colorful numbers revved up the atmosphere of the performance as they reflected the patriotic desire of all the women across the country to firmly carry forward the wonderful traits of the great socialist family and make a genuine contribution to the prosperity and development of the country with their pure conscience and sincere efforts.
The performance ended with the poem and chorus "We Will Follow Our Party Forever" and "Dear Father". It showed well the revolutionary enthusiasm of our women to fulfill their mission and duty as women revolutionaries and communist mothers in the struggle for implementing the decisions of the Party Congress. -0-

headline: Women's Ice Hockey Match Marks 81st Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- A women's ice hockey match between Taesongsan team and Pyongyang Railway Bureau team took place at the Ice Rink on October 9 to mark the 81st anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Among the spectators were Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., WPK and premier of the Cabinet of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and other senior Party and government officials, leading officials of sports events sponsoring organizations, labor innovators, famous sportspersons, teachers and researchers of party-cadre training institutions and Pyongyang citizens.
That day the Taesongsan team beat its rival 3:1.
The match added to the festive mood of the people celebrating the founding anniversary. -0-

headline: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Receives Flower Basket from Russian Political Party Leader
Flower Baskets to Statues of Great Leaders from Abroad
Members of WPK Central Leadership Visit Kumsusan Palace of Sun
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- All the people in the DPRK pay the highest tribute to PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il, the founder and builder of the ever-victorious Workers' Party of Korea, on the significant occasion of the founding anniversary of the Party which has demonstrated to the world the prestige of our state and people with the great revolutionary idea and outstanding leadership ability since its foundation as the vanguard of the revolution representing the demands and interests of the working people.
Members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other members of the Party Central Leadership, officials of the Party Central Committee and leading Party officials of ministries and national agencies visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on Friday on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A flower basket from ComradeKim Jong Unwas laid at the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il.
Also placed were flower baskets in the name of the WPK Central Committee, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK and the DPRK Cabinet.
The visitors paid high tribute to the statues of the great leaders.
At the halls where the great leaders lie in state, the visitors made deep bows to them, praying for their immortality.
All the visitors hardened their iron will to firmly carry forward forever the noble political idea of the WPK upheld in the early days of Party founding and work hard in the van of the struggle for carrying out the sacred cause for eternal dignity and prosperity of our state and happiness of the people, true to ComradeKim Jong Un's original idea and line of Party building in the new era. -0-

Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Foreign figures and organization sent flower baskets to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Laid before the statues of the President and the Chairman were flower baskets in the name of the Switzerland-Korea Committee, and Liu Wei, general manager of the Jinwanda Economic Trade Co. topic: News about Celebrations of 81st WPK Founding Anniversary
headline: Many People Visit Party Founding Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- The Party Founding Museum in the DPRK is drawing an endless stream of visitors in October when the whole country is overflowing with the great reverence for the dignified Workers' Party of Korea.
More than 100 000 officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students from across the country have visited the museum this year to deeply grasp the immortal feats of the peerlessly great men, who indicated the path of building a revolutionary party of Juche, accomplished the historic cause of founding the Party and laid an eternal cornerstone for the victory and development of the Party.
The museum, located at the foot of Haebang Hill, comprehensively deals with the glorious revolutionary history of PresidentKim Il Sungwho set an epoch-making example in building a revolutionary party in the era of independence with his original party-building idea and outstanding leadership and wisely led our people's struggle for building a new country.
In May 2025, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Un, who paid deep attention to ensuring that the museum fulfills its mission and role as an educational base conveying to posterity the immortal exploits of the President who accomplished the cause of founding a revolutionary party of Juche type, stressed the need to improve the composition of academic system and the exhibition form so as to show better the leadership exploits of the President who founded the Party and developed it into a mass party of the working people after national liberation.
True to the noble intention of the respected General Secretary, the officials and employees of the museum renewed the composition of academic system and exhibition form at its rooms in order to more vividly show the party-building leadership feats of the President according to contents and each period on the occasion of the 80th founding anniversary of the Party, replaced the existing photos and art pieces of the peerlessly great men with the improved ones, and displayed more historical materials.
Many visitors to the Party Founding Museum look back with deep emotion upon the sacred history of the Workers' Party of Korea which has performed immortal exploits for the country and the people century after century with its outstanding ideas and invincible leadership. -0-

On the same day, respected ComradeKim Jong Unreceived flower baskets from V. V.  Yakushev, secretary of the General Council of the United Russia Party, and Jin Xian, director of the Board of Directors of theKim Il Sung-Kim Jong IlFoundation. -0-

headline: Press Statement of Spokesperson for DPRK Foreign Ministry
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- A spokesperson for the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea released the following press statement on Friday:
Recently the U.S. Department of State committed another grave politically-motivated provocation of malignantly slandering the DPRK through the "2026 Trafficking in Persons Report" which is full of lies, fabrications, prejudice and hostility.
This clearly proved once again the U.S. vicious and malicious intention to politicize and weaponize human rights and use them as the primary lever for its hostile policy toward the DPRK.
The Foreign Ministry of the DPRK brands the U.S. deceptive "report," which has nothing to do with genuine human rights as an intensive expression of the hostile policy encroaching upon the sovereignty and internal affairs of our state and hurting the rights and interests of our citizens, and denounces and rejects it in the strongest terms.
The U.S. "human rights" reports, which deviated from the basic principles of human rights and seriously distorted their core values, are nothing but false documents to justify interference in internal affairs and overthrow of social systems in other countries, and herein lies the moral and ethical vulgarity and problematic policy pursued by the U.S.
Human traffic has been an evil of American society for a long time, and it is also the U.S. "specialty" which is difficult to imitate.
The U.S. is the world's most heinous human-trafficker nation which is run and administered by a national flesh-traffic organization and is prospering thanks to it.
We will never regard the U.S. publication of the "report" as an annual and formal habitual practice, but as an unconditional and invariable continuation of the hostile policy toward the DPRK and as a nonstop confrontational attempt aimed at overthrowing the social system of the DPRK and disintegrating it from within.
The essence of the U.S. policy toward the DPRK is to obliterate our people's inalienable right to existence and development, and herein lies the main reason why we should concentrate our more efforts on building up powerful strength for defending our sovereignty.
The U.S. "human rights" racket against the DPRK, which poses a serious threat to the DPRK's sovereign rights and the rights and interests of its citizens, will be the first target of the toughest counteraction against the U.S. together with other hostile acts.
Falsehood has a short life and it cannot cover up the truth in any case.
The DPRK will redouble its practical efforts to neutralize the U.S. hostile acts, lay heavy responsibility on those who did malicious practices and implement justice through the most resolute and decisive action for defending its sovereignty and social system, uncompromising criterion of human rights. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnSends Reply Message to Lao President
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a reply message to Comrade Thongloun Sisoulith, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and President of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on October 8.
The message said:
I express thanks to you, Comrade, for sending warm congratulations and best wishes on the occasion of the 78th founding anniversary of the DPRK.
Expressing belief that the traditional relations of friendship and cooperation between our two countries would grow stronger in the spirit of the agreement reached at our meeting in Pyongyang in October last year, I wish you good health and bigger success in your responsible work. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from General Secretary of C.C., LPRP
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces of the DPRK, received a message of greeting from Comrade Thongloun Sisoulith, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and President of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, on October 8.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
On behalf of the Lao party, state and people, I extend warm congratulations and best wishes to you, Comrade, and, through you, to the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, all the Party members and the fraternal Korean people on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the WPK (October 10, 1945-October 10, 2026).
I am very proud of the fact that the DPRK government and the fraternal Korean people have firmly defended the gains of the revolution, achieved political stability in the country, built modern defence and security forces and achieved great successes in the work for the economic development and the improvement of the people's living standards over the past 81 years when the Workers' Party of Korea has grown strong since its founding.
I am firmly convinced that the Korean Party, government and people will thoroughly implement the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the Party and achieve greater successes in defending the country and building a powerful socialist country under the powerful leadership of the WPK headed by ComradeKim Jong Un.
Highly appreciating the successes achieved at the bilateral talks with you during my official visit to the DPRK in 2025 last year, I will continue to cooperate with you and the Korean Party and government to thoroughly implement the agreements reached at the talks in the future and thus steadily develop the long-standing friendly and cooperative relations between the two parties, two states and two peoples in conformity with the interests of the peoples of the two countries and contribute to peace, stability, cooperation and development of the region and the world.
On this auspicious occasion, I sincerely wish ComradeKim Jong Ungood health and happiness and success in carrying out the noble cause. -0-

headline: Kim Il SungPrize Conferred on Composer
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) --Kim Il SungPrize was conferred on Sol Thae Song, head of a creation department of the State Merited Chorus, who composed the famous song of the times, "Song about the Country", which is very popular among all the people of the DPRK.
Sol Thae Song, who grew up to be a well-known composer and creative worker under the care of the Workers' Party of Korea, created many famous songs, including "Ode to the Motherland", "We Love Our Country" and "Song to the Motherly Party", to greatly encourage the patriotic struggle of the Korean people and contribute to enriching the treasure house of the Juche-oriented musical art.
In particular, "Song about the County" is a masterpiece of national treasure as it impressively sings the great pride in our great country and all-people thoughts and feelings to always love and glorify the dignified DPRK with all the devoted efforts.
A ceremony was held on October 9 to awardKim Il SungPrize to People's Artist Sol Thae Song.
Present there were Ju Chang Il, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Hyong Sik, vice-chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, and officials, creators and artistes of the State Merited Chorus.
After the decree of the SPA Standing Committee of the DPRK was read out,Kim Il SungPrize was awarded to Sol Thae Song.
Resolution-taking speeches were made at the ceremony.
The speakers said with deep emotion that the rare wisdom and outstanding leadership of respected ComradeKim Jong Un, who has ushered in a new era of great dignity and prosperity to be warmly sung by our creators and artistes and provides precious guidelines for the creation of famous songs, serve as an inexhaustible driving force for producing famous songs welcomed by the country and the people.
They pledged to more thoroughly apply the WPK's idea and theory on Juche-oriented art and literature to the art creation activities and thus to create lots of famous songs highly praising the dignity and honor of the great Party and the great country. -0-

headline: Sonyon Farm Machines Donated
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Schoolchildren in Pyongyang have provided farm machines through a brisk do-good-thing movement on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
A meeting for donating Sonyon farm machines was held in the front yard of the Pyongyang Municipal Youth Park Open-Air Theatre on Oct. 9.
Attending it were officials concerned, officials of the youth league and schoolchildren. An address was made there.
The speaker warmly congratulated the Korean Children's Union members in the capital city who prepared those farm machines on the occasion of the significant Party founding anniversary, saying that the farm machines, associated with the patriotic mind of the new generation, would give great encouragement and strength to those out in implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
He stressed the need for all schoolchildren to distinguish themselves in study and organizational life and conduct various do-good-thing movement and socio-political activities and thus glorify the KCU days with higher pride.
A written donation of Sonyon farm machines was handed over to be followed by speeches.
At the end of the meeting, Sonyon farm machines left for the relevant farms amid the send-off of schoolchildren. -0-

headline: Workers' Party of Korea Realizing Ideal of People
Ceremony of Moving into New Houses Held in Singye County of DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Under the great love of the motherly Worker's Party of Korea for the promotion of the people's well-being, socialist fairyland-like villages have appeared one after another in different parts of the DPRK.
Ceremonies of moving into new houses took place in Singye County, North Hwanghae Province on Friday.
Hundreds of dwelling houses and commercial service establishments with regional features and modern beauty were built in the county township, Wangdang-ri and Masok-ri to add pleasure and joy to the residents significantly celebrating the 81st anniversary of the founding of the Party.
Present there were Pak Chang Ho, chief secretary of the North Hwanghae Provincial Committee of the WPK, Kim Tong Chil, chairman of the provincial people's committee, officials concerned, builders, working people and residents in Singye County.
Speakers at the ceremonies said that today's auspicious events are a brilliant fruition of the noble devotion of respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho always cherishes the people at the forefront of his mind and takes care of them with much affection.
They called upon all officials, working people and residents to turn their native places into a better socialist paradise, always remembering the great love and trust of the motherly Party.
Licenses for the use of new houses were handed over to the residents. The owners of the new houses were full of gratitude to the overcautious fatherly leader, going round the houses. -0-

headline: Barbecue Restaurant Inaugurated in Rason Municipality
Women's Ice Hockey Match Marks 81st Founding Anniversary of WPK
Barbecue Restaurant Inaugurated in Rason Municipality
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- A new barbecue restaurant has appeared in Rason Municipality of the DPRK.
The restaurant with all service conditions and environment was built in the scenic spot of Anju-dong, Rajin District, to provide the citizens with various kinds of steaks, cold noodles and soft drinks. They can enjoy a new life and a new civilization.
The inaugural ceremony of the Rason Barbecue Restaurant was held on Oct. 9, with the attendance of Sin Yong Chol, chief secretary of the Rason Municipal Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials, working people and builders in the municipality and employees of the restaurant.
At the end of the ceremony the participants looked round the restaurant.
That day the restaurant was crowded with war veterans, meritorious persons, labor innovators and citizens in the municipality invited for its first service. -0-

headline: Young People in DPRK Volunteer for Service at Major Worksites
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Tens of young people in South Phyongan Province of the DPRK have volunteered to work at difficult and labor consuming posts of socialist construction in response to the call of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Those in Sunchon and Kaechon cities and Mundok and Pukchang counties decided to become members of coal-mine youth shock brigades.
Those in the cities of Phyongsong and Anju vowed to work at raw material bases and construction brigades, and those in the counties of Songchon and Yangdok made up their minds to become members of the work-teams which maintain mountain passes.
A meeting was held in the city of Phyongsong on October 8 to congratulate those young volunteers.
Present there were officials concerned, youth league officials and youth and students in the city.
Certificates were conferred on the volunteers before congratulatory and other speeches were made.
Young people gave the volunteers a pep talk, presenting bouquets of flowers to them. -0-

Flower Basket to Statues of Great Leaders from Co-presidents of Nicaragua
story_text: Pyongyang, October 10 (KCNA) -- Daniel Ortega Saavedra and Rosario Murillo, co-presidents of the Republic of Nicaragua, on Friday sent a flower basket to the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilon Mansu Hill here on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. -0-

headline: Clear Theme of Design and Construction
story_text:
In June 2014, respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Uninspected the May Day Stadium under renovation.
Going round the stadium, he acquainted himself in detail with the renovation, and stressed the importance of the modernization of the grandstand.
Looking at the red plastic seats on the first floor of the stand, he said they look nice. He added that now that the seats are red, it is necessary to make the floor of the stand white and the staircase blue to make them symbolize the flag of the DPRK. He also emphasized that the staircase should look like a blue carpet.
He said that the construction sector should make the theme of design and construction clear, adding that even the color of a structure should mean something.
Under the leadership of the respected General Secretary, who makes sure that every structure reflects our own aesthetic tastes, the May Day Stadium was turned into a monumental edifice symbolizing and further giving full play to the patriotism of our people. -0-

headline: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Held to Celebrate Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- Youth and students in the DPRK had an evening gala atKim Il SungSquare in the capital city of Pyongyang on October 10, the 81st anniversary of the founding of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The evening gala began amid the playing of the song "Mother's Birthday".
Youth and students danced to the tune of the song, extending the highest glory to respected fatherly MarshalKim Jong Unwho is developing the WPK into the powerful guiding force of the Juche revolution and the genuine motherly party which is responsible for the destiny of the people and taking care of them with his outstanding and seasoned leadership.
The atmosphere of the evening gala was revved up when the song "Dear Father", a monumental hymn, resounded in the sky of the capital city, reflecting the ardent reverence for the respected fatherly Marshal who is bringing happiness and joy of the great socialist family into full bloom with boundless love and devotion.
Gorgeous fireworks were displayed over the sky of the capital city.
The song "Do Prosper, My Motherland" and other songs resounded at the venue of the gala, reflecting the firm pledge of the passionate young people to always straight forward, following the Party, and faithfully uphold the cause of the Party in the van.
The evening gala of youth and students vividly showed the revolutionary enthusiasm and will of the new generation to fully demonstrate their noble honor as the young vanguard of the Workers' Party of Korea in the struggle for paving a wide avenue to national prosperity. -0-

headline: Women's Dancing Party Held to Mark Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- A dancing party of women's union officials and members took place at the plaza of the Monument to Party Founding on Oct. 10, the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The dancing party began with the song "Mother's Birthday".
The participants unrolled a sea of celebration dances, extending the highest glory to respected ComradeKim Jong Unwho is glorifying the sacred history of the WPK forever, regarding the people-first principle as the eternal political ideals and mode of the WPK.
They were full of boundless pride and self-confidence as they are leading a happy life under the care of the Party which glorifies the dignity and position of the women at the highest peak of the times.
The song "I Will Live like a Star Following Party" reflected the aspiration and desire of the women to cultivate the harmony and bright future of the great socialist family and invariably follow the road of loyalty and patriotism with their sincere devotion and a genuine outlook on life that puts the duty of repayment before the right to enjoyment.
The dancing party ended with the song "Appearance of Korea". -0-

headline: Founding Anniversary of WPK Marked in DPRK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- All the people across the DPRK significantly celebrated the 81st anniversary of the founding of the glorious Workers' Party of Korea.
An endless stream of visitors flowed into the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the sacred temple of Juche, where PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Illie in state.
At the plaza of the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, the visitors paid the highest tribute to the great leaders.
Officials, working people, service personnel, youth and students visited the statues of the peerlessly great men and the mosaics depicting them on Mansu Hill and in other parts of the country to lay flower baskets, bouquets and flowers before them, recollecting with deep emotion the immortal exploits of the President and the Chairman who demonstrated before the world the might and dignity of the Workers' Party of Korea and provided a firm cornerstone for the prosperity of the country.
Working people's organizations in South Hamgyong Province, North Hamgyong Province, Nampho Municipality and other regions met to tell stories about the noble virtues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Il. They also held celebration meetings and oratorical meetings.
Performances were given in Pyongyang and other parts of the country to celebrate the significant October holiday.
Dancing parties of youth and students and women's union members were held across the country, adding to the festive mood.
Public catering establishments across the country, including Okryu Restaurant, Phyongnam Noodle House and Sinhung Restaurant in Hamhung, were full of visitors receiving holiday service.
Leisure complexes, including the Central Zoo and the Natural History Museum, were crowded with working people enjoying the holiday. -0-

story_text: Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- A delegation of Korea University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) left here by air on October 10 after visiting the socialist homeland to attend the international scientific conference for marking the 80th founding anniversary ofKim Il SungUniversity. -0-

topic: WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un 's Revolutionary Activities
headline: Performance Given to Celebrate 81st Founding Anniversary of WPK
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- A celebration performance was given with splendor at the Pyongyang Indoor Stadium on Oct. 10, the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea, now that the people's absolute confidence in the WPK, the great guide and invincible vanguard for the Juche revolution, is growing stronger along with the significant October holiday.
The WPK is ushering in an era of dignity and glory, a long-cherished desire of all generations of this land, while firmly preserving its revolutionary character and true nature, never to be found in other parts of the world, without any deviation and fading from the day when it solemnly declared its founding with the emblem representing the people embroidered on the red flag held aloft in Paektu. The venue of the performance was overflowing with deep reverence for the Party, alongside the audiences recollecting with deep emotion the sacred founding history of the Party and its immortal exploits.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, watched the performance.
Stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" went up among the audiences paying the highest glory and respect to ComradeKim Jong Un, the great leader of the ever-victorious WPK, who is representing the dignity and mightiness of the DPRK.
ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly waved back to the enthusiastically cheering crowds as a token of his congratulations to all the participants on the Party founding day.
Among the audience were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, creators, artistes, youth and students and other citizens in Pyongyang.
Present there on invitation were diplomatic envoys and members of foreign missions here.
The performance began with prelude "Long Live the Workers' Party of Korea" and "Fly High, Our Party Flag". Put on the stage were all-people hymns to the WPK and patriotic songs, played in good artistic harmony with vocals, dance, acrobatics, gymnastics and military band's performance.
Enthusiastically singing the odes to the Party, produced by the sacred experiences of the people, the performers sang high praises of the glorious history and immortal exploits of the WPK that built on this land a dignified country, where people's dreams and ideals come true, and made great world-startling miracles and changes century after century, hewing the untrodden path of the socialist cause, arduous yet sacred, for over 80 years.
The audience fervently applauded the famous songs which made them feel proud of the greatness and mightiness of the WPK that has written the longest history as a ruling party in the world, fulfilling the most righteous mission and implementing the noble idea, reminding them of their great honor and fortune of having the wise political staff confidently steering our cause straight to victory.
Performers gave other colorful numbers representing the ardent desire and enthusiasm of the people determined to realize the far-reaching ambition for the comprehensive development of socialism, single-mindedly supporting their motherly Party.
The performance, which ended with the finale "The National Anthem of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea", added to the conviction and optimism that the path being taken by the DPRK is always the one of justice and truth and an immensely beautiful and bright future is in store for it as it is led by the great Party.
The performance was highly acclaimed by the audiences for the songs of undying faith and patriotism.
Expressing satisfaction at the successful performance, ComradeKim Jong Unwarmly waved back to the performers and audiences.
The performance added to the joy of all the people celebrating the birthday of the great motherly Party, the most sacred and glorious holiday. -0-

headline: Evening Gala of Youth and Students Held to Celebrate Founding Anniversary of WPK
Letter to Respected MarshalKim Jong Unfrom Members of Delegation of Korea University of Chongryon
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- Respected MarshalKim Jong Unreceived a letter from the members of the delegation of Korea University of the General Association of Korean Residents in Japan (Chongryon) on October 10.
In the letter they said that they fully felt the benevolent parental love and affection of the respected Marshal as the officials and people of the homeland warmly welcomed and took warm care of them so that they would have any inconvenience in their living from the moment they arrived at the motherland that they had been longing to see so much even in their dreams.
The letter noted that the moment they were honoured to greet the respected Marshal who paid a congratulatory visit toKim Il SungUniversity on the day they took part in the celebrations of the 80th anniversary of the university, they shouted hurrah again and again at the top of their voices, full of happiness and indescribable joy.
It said that they could convincingly picture the bright future of socialist education in the new era to be brought about by the peerlessly great man who is greatly determined to glorify the DPRK as a country of education, science and talents, listening to the passionate speech made by the respected Marshal who reviewed the glorious 80-year history ofKim Il SungUniversity and indicated the immortal programme guaranteeing the rosy future of socialist Korea.
It stressed that they would prepare all the teachers of Korea University more politically, ideologically, scientifically and theoretically and educate and train in a responsible way reliable successors and competent patriotic talents of the movement of Koreans in Japan with the conscience and boundless devotion as genuine teachers, just like the teachers and researchers ofKim Il SungUniversity who are honored as teacher revolutionaries and possessed of ardent patriotism and loyalty and high academic prestige under the care of the respected Marshal. -0-

Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
Technological Innovation Competition Brisk in DPRK Light Industry Sector
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, the light industry sector of the DPRK is conducting a socialist emulation drive aimed at improving the quality of products.
The Pyongyang Hosiery Factory designs the products reflecting the opinions and demands of users, and develops and introduces valuable technological innovations for reducing production costs and improving the quality of the products. It is also sharing with other units the successes and experience it gained in upgrading standards and improving quality.
The Hamhung Disabled Soldiers' Essential Plastic Goods Factory is making successes in improving the technical knowledge and skill of its employees, and in increasing the quality of its plastic products.
The Songyo Knitwear Factory also conducts quality competition while maintaining the quality control system and order in every production line
The Ryuwon Footwear Factory is making technological innovations in increasing the variety of products and improving their quality, and the Wonsan Leather Shoes Factory is making progress in lowering production costs and improving quality by automating the adhesive-coating process. -0-

headline: DPRK People's Custom of Using Wild Fruit
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- People in the DPRK mountainous areas are now busy gathering wild fruits.
The custom of using wild fruit is traditional in the DPRK as its territory is mostly mountainous.
This custom was created in the course of using freshness and medical ingredients of wild fruits.
North Phyongan, Jagang, North Hwanghae and Kangwon provinces and other mountainous areas gathered lots of wild fruits to contribute to improving the local people's living standards.
Foodstuff factories have been built in different parts of the country under the leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea ushering in a new era of regional transformation. Those factories produce various kinds of foodstuffs with wild fruits.
This custom was registered as a part of the national intangible cultural heritage in August. -0-

headline: Floral Tribute Paid to Statues of Great Leaders
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- Officials, working people, service personnel, school youth and children in the DPRK visited the statues of PresidentKim Il Sungand ChairmanKim Jong Ilacross the country to lay flower baskets and flowers on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Placed at the statues of the President and the Chairman on Mansu Hill were flower baskets in the name of the Party, power and armed forces organs, ministries, national agencies, units of the Korean People's Army and the Public Security Forces, institutions, enterprises and universities at all levels in Pyongyang.
The visitors made a bow to the statues of the great leaders.
Bouquets and flower baskets in the name of KPA and PSF units, institutions and enterprises were laid at the statues of the peerlessly great men in different places of the capital city, includingKim Il SungUniversity and the Mansudae Art Studio.
Officials, working people, service personnel and school youth and children across the country paid floral tribute to the statues of the great leaders in their residential areas. -0-

headline: Members of WPK Central Leadership Visit Party Founding Museum
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 11 (KCNA) -- Members of the central leadership of the Workers' Party of Korea, officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the Party committees of ministries, national agencies, districts (counties) of Pyongyang Municipality, and municipal organs and political workers of the armed forces organs visited the Party Founding Museum on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
Looking round the historic house which is preserved in original state to tell visitors about the great party-founding history, they looked back with deep emotion on the beginning of the glorious journey of the WPK which brought about a great turn and glory in carving out the destiny of our country and people.
The historical relics and materials displayed in different places of the museum show the personality of PresidentKim Il Sungas the great man who laid the foundation for developing the WPK into a powerful political staff of the revolution and a genuine motherly party and provided a sure guarantee for the eternal prosperity of socialist Korea.
Being told about the fact that respected Comrade General SecretaryKim Jong Unvisited the museum in October 2025 to set forth a great revolutionary programme enabling the Party to more fully display its might as the most dignified socialist ruling party which has taken root deep among the popular masses, they deeply grasped the revolutionary exploits of the Comrade General Secretary who is ushering in a great heyday of building our Party in the new era and achieving comprehensive national rejuvenation.
All the visitors were filled with revolutionary enthusiasm and great confidence that the cause of the Workers' Party of Korea is invincible thanks to the respected Comrade General Secretary, who leads the Juche revolution only to victory and glory with his great revolutionary ideas and outstanding leadership.
At the end of the visit, the visitors held a resolution-taking meeting at the museum with the will to steadily carry forward the great struggle history and traditions of the WPK and the revolutionary spirit displayed by the generation that pioneered the cause of building the Party.
The speakers said that the steadfast revolutionary faith and indomitable fighting spirit of the party-founding generation who cleared the untrodden path to bring a new world of communism under the uplifted red flag are the examples of life and struggle to be followed by our officials, the leading members of the revolution.
They pledged to fully apply the people-first idea to Party work, true to the Party's line of building the Party in a new era and to give full play to the inexhaustible spiritual strength of all the people in their struggle to implement the Party's grand fighting programme, and thus to fulfill their responsibility and duty in the vanguard of the sacred struggle for the comprehensive development of socialism. -0-

headline: Respected ComradeKim Jong UnReceives Greetings from Russian Party Leader
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- Respected ComradeKim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces of the DPRK, received a congratulatory message from G. A. Zhuganov, chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, on October 10.
The message said:
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
On behalf of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Russian Federation, I extend sincere congratulations to you on the occasion of the 81st founding anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea.
October 10, 1945 was a starting point of the heroic annals of the Workers’ Party of Korea.
The motherly Party, which the DPRK people call with love and respect, has been the guiding force of the DPRK society for more than 80 years.
The glorious course covered by the Workers' Party of Korea is inseparably related with the august names of the outstanding state activists.
ComradeKim Il Sung, the founder of the Party and the state, rallied the people against the colonialists and imperialists and ComradeKim Jong Illed the DPRK to a fresh victory even under the complicated circumstances, while steadily strengthening the national defence and economy.
Under your wise leadership, the WPK is confidently implementing the line on comprehensive development based on self-reliance.
The eye-opening successes made in bolstering up the defence capability and developing the economy, science and education clearly prove the validity of the line chosen by the Party and its leading role in the building of the state.
The DPRK people, united around the Workers’ Party of Korea, are building a powerful and prosperous state, firmly defending socialism despite difficulties and external pressure.
The Communist Party of the Russian Federation is paying high tribute to heroism of the DPRK soldiers who displayed matchless self-sacrificing spirit, resolution and bravery in the struggle to liberate Kursk Region from the neo-Nazis by carrying forward the tradition of the best internationalist solidarity.
The combatants of the Korean People's Army honorably carried forward the tradition of militant friendship between the Soviet Union and the DPRK which had been consolidated at the cost of blood in the midst of flames and the grim trials.
Their exploits are always recorded in the history of Russia-DPRK friendship.
We highly value the traditional ties of friendship and unity that link the Communist Party of the Russian Federation and the Workers' Party of Korea.
I am convinced that the cooperation between the two parties will grow in all aspects in the spirit of comprehensive strategic partnership in the future, too.
Respected ComradeKim Jong Un,
We wish you good health and fresh success in state activities and the DPRK people happiness and well-being.
With assurances of my highest consideration. -0-

headline: DPRK FM Sends Congratulations to His Indonesian Counterpart
story_text:

headline: Ginkgo Tree at Koryo Songgyungwan University
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- Two ginkgo trees (staminate) registered as natural monuments are growing at the Koryo Songgyungwan University in Kaesong Municipality.
The tree in the east is 31.5 meters high, its root collar is 6.3 meters round and its crown is 20 meters wide.
The tree in the west is 33.7 meters high, its root collar is 6.7 meters round and its crown is 28.7 meters wide.
In May 1992, PresidentKim Il Sungsaid that though the trees have grown for a long time, they are not worm-eaten but green and it is important to take good care of them as they are registered as precious natural monuments of the country. And he had a photo taken against the background of the trees.
The gigantic Ginkgo trees are of great scientific significance and also add beauty to the Songgyungwan University, a historical building in the period of Koryo. -0-

headline: Banks of Pothong River Spruced up
story_text:
Pyongyang, October 12 (KCNA) -- According to Rodong Sinmun, Pyongyang Municipality spruced up the banks of the Pothong River.
Granite parapets, columns and flower pots were newly set up in the section extending hundreds of kilometers, adding pleasure to the people who take a rest.
The newly-installed fishing spots are favored by anglers and other people.
Promenades were newly paved, tens of hundreds of square meters of green area took on a new look and plants of good species were transplanted, adding beauty to the banks of the river.
The Pothongmun Bridge was remodeled, new resting places were set up and attractive boating-grounds were newly rebuilt, giving pleasure to the people. -0-
